meta.source: Midvash bible-data (KJV, WEB, ASV, Almeida Livre); BibleAquifer ReinaValera1909

verses.KJV: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.WEB: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.ASV: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: No princípio criou Deus os céus e a terra.
verses.RVR09: EN el principio crió Dios los cielos y la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.WEB: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
verses.ASV: And the earth was waste and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra estava desordenada e vazia, e as trevas estavam sobre a face do abismo, e o Espírito de Deus se movia sobre a face das águas.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra estaba desordenada y vacía, y las tinieblas estaban sobre la haz del abismo, y el Espíritu de Dios se movía sobre la haz de las aguas.

verses.KJV: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.WEB: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
verses.ASV: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Haja luz; e houve luz.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Sea la luz: y fué la luz.

verses.KJV: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.WEB: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.ASV: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu Deus que a luz era boa: e separou Deus a luz das trevas.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Dios que la luz era buena: y apartó Dios la luz de las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
verses.WEB: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
verses.ASV: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Deus à luz Dia, e às trevas chamou Noite: e foi a tarde e a manhã o primeiro dia.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Dios á la luz Día, y á las tinieblas llamó Noche: y fué la tarde y la mañana un día.

verses.KJV: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
verses.WEB: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
verses.ASV: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Haja expansão em meio das águas, e separe as águas das águas.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Haya expansión en medio de las aguas, y separe las aguas de las aguas.

verses.KJV: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.WEB: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
verses.ASV: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Deus a expansão, e separou as águas que estavam debaixo da expansão, das águas que estavam sobre a expansão: e foi assim.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Dios la expansión, y apartó las aguas que estaban debajo de la expansión, de las aguas que estaban sobre la expansión: y fué así.

verses.KJV: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
verses.WEB: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.ASV: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Deus à expansão Céus: e foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia segundo.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Dios á la expansión Cielos: y fué la tarde y la mañana el día segundo.

verses.KJV: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
verses.WEB: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
verses.ASV: And God said, Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Juntem-se as águas que estão debaixo dos céus em um lugar, e descubra-se a porção seca; e foi assim.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Júntense las aguas que están debajo de los cielos en un lugar, y descúbrase la seca: y fué así.

verses.KJV: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
verses.WEB: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
verses.ASV: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Deus à porção seca Terra, e à reunião das águas chamou Mares; e viu Deus que era bom.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Dios á la seca Tierra, y á la reunión de las aguas llamó Mares: y vió Dios que era bueno.

verses.KJV: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.WEB: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.
verses.ASV: And God said, Let the earth put forth grass, herbs yielding seed, [and] fruit-trees bearing fruit after their kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Produza a terra erva verde, erva que dê semente; árvore de fruto que dê fruto segundo a sua espécie, que sua semente esteja nela, sobre a terra: e foi assim.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Produzca la tierra hierba verde, hierba que dé simiente; árbol de fruto que dé fruto según su género, que su simiente esté en él, sobre la tierra: y fué así.

verses.KJV: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.WEB: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.ASV: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E produziu a terra erva verde, erva que dá semente segundo sua natureza, e árvore que dá fruto, cuja semente está nele, segundo a sua espécie; e viu Deus que era bom.
verses.RVR09: Y produjo la tierra hierba verde, hierba que da simiente según su naturaleza, y árbol que da fruto, cuya simiente está en él, según su género: y vió Dios que era bueno.

verses.KJV: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
verses.WEB: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.ASV: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia terceiro.
verses.RVR09: Y fué la tarde y la mañana el día tercero.

verses.KJV: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
verses.WEB: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
verses.ASV: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Haja luminares na expansão dos céus para separar o dia e a noite: e sejam por sinais, e para as estações, e para dias e anos;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Sean lumbreras en la expansión de los cielos para apartar el día y la noche: y sean por señales, y para las estaciones, y para días y años;

verses.KJV: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.WEB: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
verses.ASV: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sejam por luminares na expansão dos céus para iluminar sobre a terra: e foi.
verses.RVR09: Y sean por lumbreras en la expansión de los cielos para alumbrar sobre la tierra: y fué así.

verses.KJV: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
verses.WEB: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
verses.ASV: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: [he made] the stars also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Deus os dois grandes luminares; o luminar maior para que exerça domínio no dia, e o luminar menor para que exerça domínio na noite; fez também as estrelas.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Dios las dos grandes lumbreras; la lumbrera mayor para que señorease en el día, y la lumbrera menor para que señorease en la noche: hizo también las estrellas.

verses.KJV: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.WEB: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
verses.ASV: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: E as pôs Deus na expansão dos céus, para iluminar sobre a terra,
verses.RVR09: Y púsolas Dios en la expansión de los cielos, para alumbrar sobre la tierra,

verses.KJV: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
verses.WEB: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
verses.ASV: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para exercer domínio no dia e na noite, e para separar a luz e as trevas: e viu Deus que era bom.
verses.RVR09: Y para señorear en el día y en la noche, y para apartar la luz y las tinieblas: y vió Dios que era bueno.

verses.KJV: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
verses.WEB: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.ASV: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia quarto.
verses.RVR09: Y fué la tarde y la mañana el día cuarto.

verses.KJV: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
verses.WEB: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
verses.ASV: And God said, Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Produzam as águas répteis de alma vivente, e aves que voem sobre a terra, na expansão aberta dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Produzcan las aguas reptil de ánima viviente, y aves que vuelen sobre la tierra, en la abierta expansión de los cielos.

verses.KJV: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.WEB: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.ASV: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that moveth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E criou Deus as grandes criaturas marinhas, e toda coisa viva que anda arrastando, que as águas produziram segundo a sua espécie, e toda ave de asas segundo sua espécie: e viu Deus que era bom.
verses.RVR09: Y crió Dios las grandes ballenas, y toda cosa viva que anda arrastrando, que las aguas produjeron según su género, y toda ave alada según su especie: y vió Dios que era bueno.

verses.KJV: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
verses.WEB: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
verses.ASV: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus os abençoou dizendo: Frutificai e multiplicai, e enchei as águas nos mares, e as aves se multipliquem na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y Dios los bendijo diciendo: Fructificad y multiplicad, y henchid las aguas en los mares, y las aves se multipliquen en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
verses.WEB: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.ASV: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia quinto.
verses.RVR09: Y fué la tarde y la mañana el día quinto.

verses.KJV: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
verses.WEB: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.
verses.ASV: And God said, Let the earth bring forth living creatures after their kind, cattle, and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind: and it was so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Produza a terra seres viventes segundo a sua espécie, animais e serpentes e animais da terra segundo sua espécie: e foi assim.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Produzca la tierra seres vivientes según su género, bestias y serpientes y animales de la tierra según su especie: y fué así.

verses.KJV: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.WEB: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.ASV: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and the cattle after their kind, and everything that creepeth upon the ground after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Deus animais da terra segundo a sua espécie, e gado segundo a sua espécie, e todo animal que anda arrastando sobre a terra segundo sua espécie: e viu Deus que era bom.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Dios animales de la tierra según su género, y ganado según su género, y todo animal que anda arrastrando sobre la tierra según su especie: y vió Dios que era bueno.

verses.KJV: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.WEB: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
verses.ASV: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Façamos ao ser humano à nossa imagem, conforme nossa semelhança; e domine os peixes do mar, e as aves dos céus, e os animais, e toda a terra, e todo animal que anda arrastando sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Hagamos al hombre á nuestra imagen, conforme á nuestra semejanza; y señoree en los peces de la mar, y en las aves de los cielos, y en las bestias, y en toda la tierra, y en todo animal que anda arrastrando sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.WEB: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
verses.ASV: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E criou Deus o ser humano à sua imagem, à imagem de Deus o criou; macho e fêmea os criou.
verses.RVR09: Y crió Dios al hombre á su imagen, á imagen de Dios lo crió; varón y hembra los crió.

verses.KJV: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.WEB: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
verses.ASV: And God blessed them: and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus os abençoou; e disse-lhes Deus: Frutificai e multiplicai, e enchei a terra, e subjugai-a, e dominai os peixes do mar, as aves dos céus, e todos os animais que se movem sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y los bendijo Dios; y díjoles Dios: Fructificad y multiplicad, y henchid la tierra, y sojuzgadla, y señoread en los peces de la mar, y en las aves de los cielos, y en todas las bestias que se mueven sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
verses.WEB: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
verses.ASV: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Eis que vos dei toda erva que dá semente, que está sobre a face de toda a terra; e toda árvore em que há fruto de árvore que dá semente, vos será para comer.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: He aquí que os he dado toda hierba que da simiente, que está sobre la haz de toda la tierra; y todo árbol en que hay fruto de árbol que da simiente, seros ha para comer.

verses.KJV: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
verses.WEB: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
verses.ASV: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, [I have given] every green herb for food: and it was so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todo animal da terra, e a todas as aves dos céus, e a tudo o que se move sobre a terra, em que há vida, toda erva verde lhes será para comer: e foi assim.
verses.RVR09: Y á toda bestia de la tierra, y á todas las aves de los cielos, y á todo lo que se mueve sobre la tierra, en que hay vida, toda hierba verde les será para comer: y fué así.

verses.KJV: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
verses.WEB: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
verses.ASV: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu Deus tudo o que havia feito, e eis que era bom em grande maneira. E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia sexto.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Dios todo lo que había hecho, y he aquí que era bueno en gran manera. Y fué la tarde y la mañana el día sexto.

verses.KJV: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
verses.WEB: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
verses.ASV: And the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram concluídos os céus e a terra, e tudo o que neles há.
verses.RVR09: Y FUERON acabados los cielos y la tierra, y todo su ornamento.

verses.KJV: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verses.WEB: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
verses.ASV: And on the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acabou Deus no dia sétimo sua obra que fez, e repousou o dia sétimo de toda sua obra que havia feito.
verses.RVR09: Y acabó Dios en el día séptimo su obra que hizo, y reposó el día séptimo de toda su obra que había hecho.

verses.KJV: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
verses.WEB: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
verses.ASV: And God blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; because that in it he rested from all his work which God had created and made.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abençoou Deus ao dia sétimo, e o santificou, porque nele repousou de toda sua obra que havia Deus criado e feito.
verses.RVR09: Y bendijo Dios al día séptimo, y santificólo, porque en él reposó de toda su obra que había Dios criado y hecho.

verses.KJV: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,
verses.WEB: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
verses.ASV: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Jehovah God made earth and heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as origens dos céus e da terra quando foram criados, no dia que o SENHOR Deus fez a terra e os céus,
verses.RVR09: Estos son los orígenes de los cielos y de la tierra cuando fueron criados, el día que Jehová Dios hizo la tierra y los cielos,

verses.KJV: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
verses.WEB: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,
verses.ASV: And no plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Jehovah God had not caused it to rain upon the earth: and there was not a man to till the ground;
verses.ALMEIDA: E antes que toda planta do campo existisse na terra, e antes que toda erva do campo nascesse; porque ainda não havia o SENHOR Deus feito chover sobre a terra, nem havia homem para que lavrasse a terra;
verses.RVR09: Y toda planta del campo antes que fuese en la tierra, y toda hierba del campo antes que naciese: porque aun no había Jehová Dios hecho llover sobre la tierra, ni había hombre para que labrase la tierra;

verses.KJV: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.WEB: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
verses.ASV: but there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas subia da terra um vapor, que regava toda a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Mas subía de la tierra un vapor, que regaba toda la faz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.WEB: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Formou, pois, o SENHOR Deus ao homem do pó da terra, e assoprou em seu nariz sopro de vida; e foi o homem em alma vivente.
verses.RVR09: Formó, pues, Jehová Dios al hombre del polvo de la tierra, y alentó en su nariz soplo de vida; y fué el hombre en alma viviente.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.WEB: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God planted a garden eastward, in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia o SENHOR Deus plantado um jardim em Éden ao oriente, e pôs ali ao homem que havia formado.
verses.RVR09: Y había Jehová Dios plantado un huerto en Edén al oriente, y puso allí al hombre que había formado.

verses.KJV: And out of the ground made the Lord God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
verses.WEB: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.ASV: And out of the ground made Jehovah God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia o SENHOR Deus feito nascer da terra toda árvore agradável à vista, e boa para comer: também a árvore da vida em meio do jardim, e a árvore do conhecimento do bem e do mal.
verses.RVR09: Y había Jehová Dios hecho nacer de la tierra todo árbol delicioso á la vista, y bueno para comer: también el árbol de vida en medio del huerto, y el árbol de ciencia del bien y del mal.

verses.KJV: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
verses.WEB: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.
verses.ASV: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became four heads.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saía de Éden um rio para regar o jardim, e dali se repartia em quatro ramificações.
verses.RVR09: Y salía de Edén un río para regar el huerto, y de allí se repartía en cuatro ramales.

verses.KJV: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
verses.WEB: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
verses.ASV: The name of the first is Pishon: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
verses.ALMEIDA: O nome de um era Pisom: este é o que cerca toda a terra de Havilá, onde há ouro:
verses.RVR09: El nombre del uno era Pisón: éste es el que cerca toda la tierra de Havilah, donde hay oro:

verses.KJV: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
verses.WEB: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.
verses.ASV: and the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o ouro daquela terra é bom; há ali também bdélio e pedra ônix.
verses.RVR09: Y el oro de aquella tierra es bueno: hay allí también bdelio y piedra cornerina.

verses.KJV: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
verses.WEB: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.
verses.ASV: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Cush.
verses.ALMEIDA: O nome do segundo rio é Giom; este é o que rodeia toda a terra de Cuxe.
verses.RVR09: El nombre del segundo río es Gihón: éste es el que rodea toda la tierra de Etiopía.

verses.KJV: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
verses.WEB: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.ASV: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth in front of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nome do terceiro rio é Tigre; este é o que vai diante da Assíria. E o quarto rio é o Eufrates.
verses.RVR09: Y el nombre del tercer río es Hiddekel: éste es el que va delante de Asiria. Y el cuarto río es el Eufrates.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
verses.WEB: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR Deus tomou o homem, e o pôs no jardim de Éden, para que o lavrasse e o guardasse.
verses.RVR09: Tomó, pues, Jehová Dios al hombre, y le puso en el huerto de Edén, para que lo labrara y lo guardase.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
verses.WEB: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou o SENHOR Deus ao homem, dizendo: De toda árvore do jardim comerás;
verses.RVR09: Y mandó Jehová Dios al hombre, diciendo: De todo árbol del huerto comerás;

verses.KJV: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
verses.WEB: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
verses.ASV: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas da árvore do conhecimento do bem e do mal não comerás dela; porque no dia que dela comeres, morrerás.
verses.RVR09: Mas del árbol de ciencia del bien y del mal no comerás de él; porque el día que de él comieres, morirás.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
verses.WEB: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR Deus: Não é bom que o homem esteja só; farei para ele ajuda idônea para ele.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová Dios: No es bueno que el hombre esté solo; haréle ayuda idónea para él.

verses.KJV: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
verses.WEB: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.
verses.ASV: And out of the ground Jehovah God formed every beast of the field, and every bird of the heavens; and brought them unto the man to see what he would call them: and whatsoever the man called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Formou, pois, o SENHOR Deus da terra todo animal do campo, e toda ave dos céus, e trouxe-os a Adão, para que visse como lhes havia de chamar; e tudo o que Adão chamou aos animais viventes, esse é seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Formó, pues, Jehová Dios de la tierra toda bestia del campo, y toda ave de los cielos, y trájolas á Adam, para que viese cómo les había de llamar; y todo lo que Adam llamó á los animales vivientes, ese es su nombre.

verses.KJV: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
verses.WEB: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
verses.ASV: And the man gave names to all cattle, and to the birds of the heavens, and to every beast of the field; but for man there was not found a help meet for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs Adão nomes a todo animal e ave dos céus e a todo animal do campo: mas para Adão não achou ajuda que estivesse idônea para ele.
verses.RVR09: Y puso Adam nombres á toda bestia y ave de los cielos y á todo animal del campo: mas para Adam no halló ayuda que estuviese idónea para él.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
verses.WEB: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR Deus fez cair sonho sobre Adão, e ele adormeceu: então tomou uma de suas costelas, e fechou a carne em seu lugar;
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová Dios hizo caer sueño sobre Adam, y se quedó dormido: entonces tomó una de sus costillas, y cerró la carne en su lugar;

verses.KJV: And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
verses.WEB: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
verses.ASV: and the rib, which Jehovah God had taken from the man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da costela que o SENHOR Deus tomou do homem, fez uma mulher, e trouxe-a ao homem.
verses.RVR09: Y de la costilla que Jehová Dios tomó del hombre, hizo una mujer, y trájola al hombre.

verses.KJV: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
verses.WEB: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
verses.ASV: And the man said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Adão: Esta é agora osso de meus ossos, e carne de minha carne: esta será chamada Mulher, porque do homem foi tomada.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Adam: Esto es ahora hueso de mis huesos, y carne de mi carne: ésta será llamada Varona, porque del varón fué tomada.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
verses.WEB: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, deixará o homem a seu pai e a sua mãe, e se achegará à sua mulher, e serão uma só carne.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, dejará el hombre á su padre y á su madre, y allegarse ha á su mujer, y serán una sola carne.

verses.KJV: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
verses.WEB: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
verses.ASV: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estavam ambos nus, Adão e sua mulher, e não se envergonhavam.
verses.RVR09: Y estaban ambos desnudos, Adam y su mujer, y no se avergonzaban.

verses.KJV: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
verses.WEB: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”
verses.ASV: Now the serpent was more subtle than any beast of the field which Jehovah God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of any tree of the garden?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a serpente era astuta, mais que todos os animais do campo que o SENHOR Deus havia feito. E ela disse à mulher: Deus vos disse: Não comais de toda árvore do jardim?
verses.RVR09: EMPERO la serpiente era astuta, más que todos los animales del campo que Jehová Dios había hecho; la cual dijo á la mujer: ¿Conque Dios os ha dicho: No comáis de todo árbol del huerto?

verses.KJV: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
verses.WEB: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
verses.ASV: And the woman said unto the serpent, Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat:
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher respondeu à serpente: Do fruto das árvores do jardim podemos comer;
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer respondió á la serpiente: Del fruto de los árboles del huerto comemos;

verses.KJV: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
verses.WEB: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”
verses.ASV: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas do fruto da árvore que está no meio do jardim, Deus disse: Não comereis dele, nem o tocareis, para que não morrais.
verses.RVR09: Mas del fruto del árbol que está en medio del huerto dijo Dios: No comeréis de él, ni le tocaréis, porque no muráis.

verses.KJV: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
verses.WEB: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,
verses.ASV: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a serpente disse à mulher: Não morrereis;
verses.RVR09: Entonces la serpiente dijo á la mujer: No moriréis;

verses.KJV: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
verses.WEB: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
verses.ASV: for God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as God, knowing good and evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus sabe que no dia que comerdes dele, vossos olhos serão abertos, e sereis como deuses, sabendo o bem e o mal.
verses.RVR09: Mas sabe Dios que el día que comiereis de él, serán abiertos vuestros ojos, y seréis como dioses sabiendo el bien y el mal.

verses.KJV: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
verses.WEB: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
verses.ASV: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat; and she gave also unto her husband with her, and he did eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher viu que a árvore era boa para se comer, agradável aos olhos, e árvore desejável para se obter conhecimento. E ela tomou de seu fruto, e comeu; e deu também ao seu marido com ela, e ele comeu.
verses.RVR09: Y vió la mujer que el árbol era bueno para comer, y que era agradable á los ojos, y árbol codiciable para alcanzar la sabiduría; y tomó de su fruto, y comió; y dió también á su marido, el cual comió así como ella.

verses.KJV: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
verses.WEB: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
verses.ASV: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig-leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram abertos os olhos de ambos, e conheceram que estavam nus. Então coseram folhas de figueira, e fizeram para si aventais.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron abiertos los ojos de entrambos, y conocieron que estaban desnudos: entonces cosieron hojas de higuera, y se hicieron delantales.

verses.KJV: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.
verses.WEB: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
verses.ASV: And they heard the voice of Jehovah God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Jehovah God amongst the trees of the garden.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviram a voz do SENHOR Deus, que passeava no jardim à brisa do dia; e o homem e sua mulher esconderam-se da presença do SENHOR Deus entre as árvores do jardim.
verses.RVR09: Y oyeron la voz de Jehová Dios que se paseaba en el huerto al aire del día: y escondióse el hombre y su mujer de la presencia de Jehová Dios entre los árboles del huerto.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
verses.WEB: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God called unto the man, and said unto him, Where art thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR Deus chamou ao homem, e lhe disse: “Onde estás?
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Jehová Dios al hombre, y le dijo: ¿Dónde estás tú?

verses.KJV: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
verses.WEB: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
verses.ASV: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: “Ouvi tua voz no jardim, e tive medo, porque estava nu; e me escondi”.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Oí tu voz en el huerto, y tuve miedo, porque estaba desnudo; y escondíme.

verses.KJV: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
verses.WEB: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
verses.ASV: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: “Quem te ensinou que estavas nu? Comeste da árvore de que te mandei que não comesses?”
verses.RVR09: Y díjole: ¿Quién te enseñó que estabas desnudo? ¿Has comido del árbol de que yo te mandé no comieses?

verses.KJV: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
verses.WEB: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
verses.ASV: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem respondeu: “A mulher que me deste por companheira me deu da árvore, e eu comi”.
verses.RVR09: Y el hombre respondió: La mujer que me diste por compañera me dió del árbol, y yo comí.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
verses.WEB: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God said unto the woman, What is this thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR Deus disse à mulher: “Por que fizeste isto?” E a mulher disse: “A serpente me enganou, e comi”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová Dios dijo á la mujer: ¿Qué es lo que has hecho? Y dijo la mujer: La serpiente me engañó, y comí.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
verses.WEB: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, cursed art thou above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR Deus disse à serpente: “Porque fizeste isto, maldita serás entre todos os animais selvagens e entre todos os animais do campo; sobre teu ventre andarás, e pó comerás todos os dias da tua vida.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová Dios dijo á la serpiente: Por cuanto esto hiciste, maldita serás entre todas las bestias y entre todos los animales del campo; sobre tu pecho andarás, y polvo comerás todos los días de tu vida:

verses.KJV: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verses.WEB: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
verses.ASV: and I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed: he shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei inimizade entre ti e a mulher, e entre tua descendência e a descendência dela; esta te ferirá a cabeça, e tu lhe ferirás o calcanhar”.
verses.RVR09: Y enemistad pondré entre ti y la mujer, y entre tu simiente y la simiente suya; ésta te herirá en la cabeza, y tú le herirás en el calcañar.

verses.KJV: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
verses.WEB: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
verses.ASV: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy pain and thy conception; in pain thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para a mulher disse: “Multiplicarei grandemente as tuas dores e teus sofrimentos de parto; com dor darás à luz filhos; e o teu desejo será para o teu marido, e ele te dominará”.
verses.RVR09: A la mujer dijo: Multiplicaré en gran manera tus dolores y tus preñeces; con dolor parirás los hijos; y á tu marido será tu deseo, y él se enseñoreará de ti.

verses.KJV: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
verses.WEB: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
verses.ASV: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in toil shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao homem disse: “Porque deste ouvidos à voz de tua mulher, e comeste da árvore de que te mandei dizendo, ‘Não comerás dela’, maldita será a terra por causa de ti; com dor comerás dela todos os dias da tua vida;
verses.RVR09: Y al hombre dijo: Por cuanto obedeciste á la voz de tu mujer, y comiste del árbol de que te mandé diciendo, No comerás de él; maldita será la tierra por amor de ti; con dolor comerás de ella todos los días de tu vida;

verses.KJV: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
verses.WEB: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
verses.ASV: thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
verses.ALMEIDA: Espinhos e cardos te produzirá, e comerás erva do campo.
verses.RVR09: Espinos y cardos te producirá, y comerás hierba del campo;

verses.KJV: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
verses.WEB: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”
verses.ASV: in the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
verses.ALMEIDA: No suor do teu rosto comerás o pão até que voltes à terra, porque dela foste tomado; porque pó és, e ao pó voltarás”.
verses.RVR09: En el sudor de tu rostro comerás el pan hasta que vuelvas á la tierra; porque de ella fuiste tomado: pues polvo eres, y al polvo serás tornado.

verses.KJV: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
verses.WEB: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
verses.ASV: And the man called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou o homem o nome de sua mulher, Eva; porquanto ela era mãe de todos o viventes.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó el hombre el nombre de su mujer, Eva; por cuanto ella era madre de todos los vivientes.

verses.KJV: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the Lord God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
verses.WEB: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God made for Adam and for his wife coats of skins, and clothed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR Deus fez ao homem e à sua mulher túnicas de peles, e os vestiu.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová Dios hizo al hombre y á su mujer túnicas de pieles, y vistiólos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
verses.WEB: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever—
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR Deus: Eis que o homem é como um de Nos sabendo o bem e o mal; agora, pois, para que não estenda sua mão, e tome também da árvore da vida, e coma, e viva para sempre:
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová Dios: He aquí el hombre es como uno de Nos sabiendo el bien y el mal: ahora, pues, porque no alargue su mano, y tome también del árbol de la vida, y coma, y viva para siempre:

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
verses.ASV: therefore Jehovah God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirou-o o SENHOR do jardim de Éden, para que lavrasse a terra de que foi tomado.
verses.RVR09: Y sacólo Jehová del huerto de Edén, para que labrase la tierra de que fué tomado.

verses.KJV: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
verses.WEB: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.ASV: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden the Cherubim, and the flame of a sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lançou, pois, fora ao homem, e pôs ao oriente do jardim de Éden querubins, e uma espada acesa que se revolvia a todos os lados, para guardar o caminho da árvore da vida.
verses.RVR09: Echó, pues, fuera al hombre, y puso al oriente del huerto de Edén querubines, y una espada encendida que se revolvía á todos lados, para guardar el camino del árbol de la vida.

verses.KJV: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the Lord.
verses.WEB: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”
verses.ASV: And the man knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man with [the help of] Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Adão conheceu a sua mulher Eva, a qual concebeu e deu à luz a Caim, e disse: Obtive um homem pelo SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y CONOCIÓ Adam á su mujer Eva, la cual concibió y parió á Caín, y dijo: Adquirido he varón por Jehová.

verses.KJV: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.WEB: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.ASV: And again she bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois deu à luz a seu irmão Abel. E foi Abel pastor de ovelhas, e Caim foi lavrador da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y después parió á su hermano Abel. Y fué Abel pastor de ovejas, y Caín fué labrador de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.
verses.ASV: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, decorrendo o tempo, que Caim trouxe do fruto da terra uma oferta ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció andando el tiempo, que Caín trajo del fruto de la tierra una ofrenda á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
verses.WEB: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,
verses.ASV: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And Jehovah had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abel trouxe também dos primogênitos de suas ovelhas, e de sua gordura. E olhou o SENHOR com agrado a Abel e à sua oferta;
verses.RVR09: Y Abel trajo también de los primogénitos de sus ovejas, y de su grosura. Y miró Jehová con agrado á Abel y á su ofrenda;

verses.KJV: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
verses.WEB: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
verses.ASV: but unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas não olhou com bons olhos a Caim e à sua oferta. Caim irritou-se muito, e descaiu-lhe o semblante.
verses.RVR09: Mas no miró propicio á Caín y á la ofrenda suya. Y ensañóse Caín en gran manera, y decayó su semblante.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Caim: Por que te irritaste, e por que o teu semblante descaiu?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Caín: ¿Por qué te has ensañado, y por qué se ha inmutado tu rostro?

verses.KJV: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
verses.WEB: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”
verses.ASV: If thou doest well, shall it not be lifted up? and if thou doest not well, sin coucheth at the door; and unto thee shall be its desire; but do thou rule over it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se bem fizeres, não serás aceito? E se não fizeres bem, o pecado está à porta; contra ti será o seu desejo, porém tu deves dominá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Si bien hicieres, ¿no serás ensalzado? y si no hicieres bien, el pecado está á la puerta: con todo esto, á ti será su deseo, y tú te enseñorearás de él.

verses.KJV: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
verses.WEB: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.
verses.ASV: And Cain told Abel his brother. And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois Caim falou a seu irmão Abel; e aconteceu que, estando eles no campo, Caim se levantou contra seu irmão Abel, e o matou.
verses.RVR09: Y habló Caín á su hermano Abel: y aconteció que estando ellos en el campo, Caín se levantó contra su hermano Abel, y le mató.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: am I my brother’s keeper?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Caim: Onde está teu irmão Abel? E ele respondeu: Não sei; sou eu guarda do meu irmão?
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Caín: ¿Dónde está Abel tu hermano? Y él respondió: No sé; ¿soy yo guarda de mi hermano?

verses.KJV: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
verses.ASV: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Que fizeste? A voz do sangue do teu irmão clama a mim desde a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: ¿Qué has hecho? La voz de la sangre de tu hermano clama á mí desde la tierra.

verses.KJV: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
verses.WEB: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
verses.ASV: And now cursed art thou from the ground, which hath opened its mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, maldito sejas tu da terra que abriu sua boca para receber o sangue de teu irmão de tua mão:
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, maldito seas tú de la tierra que abrió su boca para recibir la sangre de tu hermano de tu mano:

verses.KJV: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
verses.WEB: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”
verses.ASV: when thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee its strength; a fugitive and a wanderer shalt thou be in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando lavrares a terra, não te voltará a dar sua força: errante e fugitivo serás na terra.
verses.RVR09: Cuando labrares la tierra, no te volverá á dar su fuerza: errante y extranjero serás en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Cain said unto the Lord, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.WEB: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.ASV: And Cain said unto Jehovah, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Caim ao SENHOR: Grande é minha iniquidade para ser perdoada.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Caín á Jehová: Grande es mi iniquidad para ser perdonada.

verses.KJV: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
verses.WEB: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”
verses.ASV: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the ground; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth; and it will come to pass, that whosoever findeth me will slay me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que me expulsas hoje da face da terra, e de tua presença me esconderei; e serei errante e fugitivo na terra; e sucederá que qualquer um que me achar, me matará.
verses.RVR09: He aquí me echas hoy de la faz de la tierra, y de tu presencia me esconderé; y seré errante y extranjero en la tierra; y sucederá que cualquiera que me hallare, me matará.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And Jehovah appointed a sign for Cain, lest any finding him should smite him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhe o SENHOR: Certo que qualquer um que matar a Caim, sete vezes será castigado. Então o SENHOR pôs sinal em Caim, para que não o ferisse qualquer um que o achasse.
verses.RVR09: Y respondióle Jehová: Cierto que cualquiera que matare á Caín, siete veces será castigado. Entonces Jehová puso señal en Caín, para que no lo hiriese cualquiera que le hallara.

verses.KJV: And Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
verses.WEB: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
verses.ASV: And Cain went out from the presence of Jehovah, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu Caim de diante do SENHOR, e habitou na terra de Node, ao oriente de Éden.
verses.RVR09: Y salió Caín de delante de Jehová, y habitó en tierra de Nod, al oriente de Edén.

verses.KJV: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.WEB: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.ASV: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E conheceu Caim a sua mulher, a qual concebeu e deu à luz a Enoque: e edificou uma cidade, e chamou o nome da cidade do nome de seu filho, Enoque.
verses.RVR09: Y conoció Caín á su mujer, la cual concibió y parió á Henoch: y edificó una ciudad, y llamó el nombre de la ciudad del nombre de su hijo, Henoch.

verses.KJV: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
verses.WEB: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
verses.ASV: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael; and Mehujael begat Methushael; and Methushael begat Lamech.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Enoque nasceu Irade, e Irade gerou a Meujael, e Meujael gerou a Metusael, e Metusael gerou a Lameque.
verses.RVR09: Y á Henoch nació Irad, é Irad engendró á Mehujael, y Mehujael engendró á Methusael, y Methusael engendró á Lamech.

verses.KJV: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.WEB: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
verses.ASV: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou para si Lameque duas mulheres; o nome de uma foi Ada, e o nome da outra Zilá.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó para sí Lamech dos mujeres; el nombre de la una fué Ada, y el nombre de la otra Zilla.

verses.KJV: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
verses.WEB: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
verses.ASV: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents and [have] cattle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ada deu à luz a Jabal, o qual foi pai dos que habitam em tendas, e criam gados.
verses.RVR09: Y Ada parió á Jabal, el cual fué padre de los que habitan en tiendas, y crían ganados.

verses.KJV: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
verses.WEB: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
verses.ASV: And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and pipe.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nome de seu irmão foi Jubal, o qual foi pai de todos os que manejam harpa e flauta.
verses.RVR09: Y el nombre de su hermano fué Jubal, el cual fué padre de todos los que manejan arpa y órgano.

verses.KJV: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
verses.WEB: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.
verses.ASV: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zilá também deu à luz a Tubalcaim, feitor de toda obra de bronze e de ferro: e a irmã de Tubalcaim foi Naamá.
verses.RVR09: Y Zilla también parió á Tubal-Caín, acicalador de toda obra de metal y de hierro: y la hermana de Tubal-Caín fué Naama.

verses.KJV: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
verses.WEB: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.
verses.ASV: And Lamech said unto his wives: Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: For I have slain a man for wounding me, And a young man for bruising me:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Lameque a suas mulheres: Ada e Zilá, ouvi minha voz; Mulheres de Lameque, escutai meu dito: Que matei um homem por ter me ferido, E um rapaz por ter me golpeado:
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Lamech á sus mujeres: Ada y Zilla, oid mi voz; mujeres de Lamech, escuchad mi dicho: que varón mataré por mi herida, y mancebo por mi golpe:

verses.KJV: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
verses.WEB: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”
verses.ASV: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se sete vezes será vingado Caim, Lameque em verdade setenta vezes sete o será.
verses.RVR09: Si siete veces será vengado Caín, Lamech en verdad setenta veces siete lo será.

verses.KJV: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
verses.WEB: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
verses.ASV: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For, [said she], God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E conheceu de novo Adão à sua mulher, a qual deu à luz um filho, e chamou seu nome Sete: Porque Deus (disse ela) me substituiu outra descendência em lugar de Abel, a quem matou Caim.
verses.RVR09: Y conoció de nuevo Adam á su mujer, la cual parió un hijo, y llamó su nombre Seth: Porque Dios (dijo ella) me ha sustituído otra simiente en lugar de Abel, á quien mató Caín.

verses.KJV: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enosh. Then began men to call upon the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Sete também lhe nasceu um filho, e chamou seu nome Enos. Então os homens começaram a invocar o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y á Seth también le nació un hijo, y llamó su nombre Enós. Entonces los hombres comenzaron á llamarse del nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
verses.WEB: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
verses.ASV: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o livro das gerações de Adão. No dia em que criou Deus ao ser humano, à semelhança de Deus o fez;
verses.RVR09: ESTE es el libro de las generaciones de Adam. El día en que crió Dios al hombre, á la semejanza de Dios lo hizo;

verses.KJV: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
verses.WEB: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.
verses.ASV: male and female created he them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
verses.ALMEIDA: Macho e fêmea os criou; e os abençoou, e chamou o nome deles Adão, no dia em que foram criados.
verses.RVR09: Varón y hembra los crió; y los bendijo, y llamó el nombre de ellos Adam, el día en que fueron criados.

verses.KJV: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, and after his image; and called his name Seth:
verses.WEB: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
verses.ASV: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begat [a son] in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Adão cento e trinta anos, e gerou um filho à sua semelhança, conforme sua imagem, e chamou seu nome Sete.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Adam ciento y treinta años, y engendró un hijo á su semejanza, conforme á su imagen, y llamó su nombre Seth.

verses.KJV: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and the days of Adam after he begat Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram os dias de Adão, depois que gerou a Sete, oitocentos anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron los días de Adam, después que engendró á Seth, ochocientos años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
verses.WEB: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
verses.ASV: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias que viveu Adão novecentos e trinta anos, e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días que vivió Adam novecientos y treinta años, y murió.

verses.KJV: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
verses.WEB: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
verses.ASV: And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begat Enosh:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Sete cento e cinco anos, e gerou a Enos.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Seth ciento y cinco años, y engendró á Enós.

verses.KJV: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Seth lived after he begat Enosh eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Sete, depois que gerou a Enos, oitocentos e sete anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Seth, después que engendró á Enós, ochocientos y siete años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
verses.WEB: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
verses.ASV: and all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias de Sete novecentos e doze anos; e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días de Seth novecientos y doce años; y murió.

verses.KJV: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
verses.WEB: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
verses.ASV: And Enosh lived ninety years, and begat Kenan:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Enos noventa anos, e gerou a Cainã.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Enós noventa años, y engendró á Cainán.

verses.KJV: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Enosh lived after he begat Kenan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Enos depois que gerou a Cainã, oitocentos e quinze anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Enós después que engendró á Cainán, ochocientos y quince años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
verses.WEB: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
verses.ASV: and all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias de Enos novecentos e cinco anos; e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días de Enós novecientos y cinco años; y murió.

verses.KJV: And Cainan lived seventy years and begat Mahalaleel:
verses.WEB: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
verses.ASV: And Kenan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalalel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Cainã setenta anos, e gerou a Maalalel.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Cainán setenta años, y engendró á Mahalaleel.

verses.KJV: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
verses.ASV: and Kenan lived after he begat Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Cainã, depois que gerou a Maalalel, oitocentos e quarenta anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Cainán, después que engendró á Mahalaleel, ochocientos y cuarenta años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
verses.WEB: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
verses.ASV: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias de Cainã novecentos e dez anos; e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días de Cainán novecientos y diez años; y murió.

verses.KJV: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
verses.WEB: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
verses.ASV: And Mahalalel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Maalalel sessenta e cinco anos, e gerou a Jarede.
