verses.RVR09: Y vivió Mahalaleel sesenta y cinco años, y engendró á Jared.

verses.KJV: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Mahalalel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Maalalel, depois que gerou a Jarede, oitocentos e trinta anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Mahalaleel, después que engendró á Jared, ochocientos y treinta años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
verses.WEB: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
verses.ASV: and all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias de Maalalel oitocentos noventa e cinco anos; e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días de Mahalaleel ochocientos noventa y cinco años; y murió.

verses.KJV: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
verses.WEB: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
verses.ASV: And Jared lived a hundred sixty and two years, and begat Enoch:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Jarede cento e sessenta e dois anos, e gerou a Enoque.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Jared ciento sesenta y dos años, y engendró á Henoch.

verses.KJV: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Jarede, depois que gerou a Enoque, oitocentos anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Jared, después que engendró á Henoch, ochocientos años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
verses.WEB: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
verses.ASV: and all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias de Jarede novecentos e sessenta e dois anos; e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días de Jared novecientos sesenta y dos años; y murió.

verses.KJV: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
verses.WEB: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
verses.ASV: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Enoque sessenta e cinco anos, e gerou a Matusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Henoch sesenta y cinco años, y engendró á Mathusalam.

verses.KJV: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E caminhou Enoque com Deus, depois que gerou a Matusalém, trezentos anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y caminó Henoch con Dios, después que engendró á Mathusalam, trescientos años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
verses.WEB: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
verses.ASV: and all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias de Enoque trezentos sessenta e cinco anos.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días de Henoch trescientos sesenta y cinco años.

verses.KJV: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
verses.WEB: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
verses.ASV: and Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caminhou, pois, Enoque com Deus, e desapareceu, porque Deus o levou.
verses.RVR09: Caminó, pues, Henoch con Dios, y desapareció, porque le llevó Dios.

verses.KJV: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech.
verses.WEB: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
verses.ASV: And Methuselah lived a hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Matusalém cento e oitenta e sete anos, e gerou a Lameque.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Mathusalam ciento ochenta y siete años, y engendró á Lamech.

verses.KJV: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Matusalém, depois que gerou a Lameque, setecentos e oitenta e dois anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Mathusalam, después que engendró á Lamech, setecientos ochenta y dos años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
verses.WEB: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
verses.ASV: and all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foram, pois, todos os dias de Matusalém, novecentos e sessenta e nove anos; e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Fueron, pues, todos los días de Mathusalam, novecientos sesenta y nueve años; y murió.

verses.KJV: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
verses.WEB: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
verses.ASV: And Lamech lived a hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Lameque cento e oitenta e dois anos, e gerou um filho:
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Lamech ciento ochenta y dos años, y engendró un hijo:

verses.KJV: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord hath cursed.
verses.WEB: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”
verses.ASV: and he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, [which cometh] because of the ground which Jehovah hath cursed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou seu nome Noé, dizendo: Este nos aliviará de nossas obras, e do trabalho de nossas mãos, por causa da terra que o SENHOR amaldiçoou.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó su nombre Noé, diciendo: Este nos aliviará de nuestras obras, y del trabajo de nuestras manos, á causa de la tierra que Jehová maldijo.

verses.KJV: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.WEB: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Lameque, depois que gerou a Noé, quinhentos noventa e cinco anos: e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Lamech, después que engendró á Noé, quinientos noventa y cinco años: y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
verses.WEB: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
verses.ASV: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias de Lameque setecentos e setenta e sete anos; e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días de Lamech setecientos setenta y siete años; y murió.

verses.KJV: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.WEB: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.ASV: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sendo Noé de quinhentos anos, gerou a Sem, Cam, e a Jafé.
verses.RVR09: Y siendo Noé de quinientos años, engendró á Sem, Châm, y á Japhet.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
verses.WEB: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the ground, and daughters were born unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando começaram os homens a multiplicar-se sobre a face da terra, e lhes nasceram filhas,
verses.RVR09: Y ACAECIÓ que, cuando comenzaron los hombres á multiplicarse sobre la faz de la tierra, y les nacieron hijas,

verses.KJV: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
verses.WEB: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
verses.ASV: that the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all that they chose.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendo os filhos de Deus que as filhas dos homens eram belas, tomaram para si mulheres, escolhendo entre todas.
verses.RVR09: Viendo los hijos de Dios que las hijas de los hombres eran hermosas, tomáronse mujeres, escogiendo entre todas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, My Spirit shall not strive with man for ever, for that he also is flesh: yet shall his days be a hundred and twenty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR: Não brigará meu espírito com o ser humano para sempre, porque certamente ele é carne: mas serão seus dias cento e vinte anos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová: No contenderá mi espíritu con el hombre para siempre, porque ciertamente él es carne: mas serán sus días ciento y veinte años.

verses.KJV: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
verses.WEB: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
verses.ASV: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them: the same were the mighty men that were of old, the men of renown.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia gigantes na terra naqueles dias, e também depois que entraram os filhos de Deus às filhas dos homens, e lhes geraram filhos: estes foram os valentes que desde a antiguidade foram homens de renome.
verses.RVR09: Había gigantes en la tierra en aquellos días, y también después que entraron los hijos de Dios á las hijas de los hombres, y les engendraron hijos: éstos fueron los valientes que desde la antigüedad fueron varones de nombre.

verses.KJV: And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
verses.WEB: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR viu que a maldade dos seres humanos era muita na terra, e que todo desígnio dos pensamentos dos seus corações era só mau continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Jehová que la malicia de los hombres era mucha en la tierra, y que todo designio de los pensamientos del corazón de ellos era de continuo solamente el mal.

verses.KJV: And it repented the Lord that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
verses.WEB: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
verses.ASV: And it repented Jehovah that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR se arrependeu de haver feito o ser humano na terra, e pesou-lhe em seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y arrepintióse Jehová de haber hecho hombre en la tierra, y pesóle en su corazón.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the ground; both man, and beast, and creeping things, and birds of the heavens; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR: Apagarei os seres humanos que criei de sobre a face da terra, desde o ser humano até o animal, e até o réptil e as aves do céu; porque me arrependo de havê-los feito.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová: Raeré los hombres que he criado de sobre la faz de la tierra, desde el hombre hasta la bestia, y hasta el reptil y las aves del cielo: porque me arrepiento de haberlos hecho.

verses.KJV: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.
verses.WEB: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.
verses.ASV: But Noah found favor in the eyes of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Noé achou favor aos olhos do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Empero Noé halló gracia en los ojos de Jehová.

verses.KJV: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
verses.WEB: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.
verses.ASV: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, [and] perfect in his generations: Noah walked with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as gerações de Noé: Noé, homem justo, foi íntegro em suas gerações; Noé andava com Deus.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las generaciones de Noé: Noé, varón justo, perfecto fué en sus generaciones; con Dios caminó Noé.

verses.KJV: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.WEB: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.ASV: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E gerou Noé três filhos: a Sem, a Cam, e a Jafé.
verses.RVR09: Y engendró Noé tres hijos: á Sem, á Châm, y á Japhet.

verses.KJV: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.WEB: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.ASV: And the earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a terra se corrompeu diante de Deus, e a terra encheu-se de violência.
verses.RVR09: Y corrompióse la tierra delante de Dios, y estaba la tierra llena de violencia.

verses.KJV: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
verses.WEB: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
verses.ASV: And God saw the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted their way upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus olhou a terra, e eis que estava corrompida; porque toda carne havia corrompido seu caminho sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y miró Dios la tierra, y he aquí que estaba corrompida; porque toda carne había corrompido su camino sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.WEB: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.
verses.ASV: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus a Noé: O fim de toda carne veio diante de mim; porque a terra está cheia de violência por causa deles; e eis que eu os destruirei com a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios á Noé: El fin de toda carne ha venido delante de mí; porque la tierra está llena de violencia á causa de ellos; y he aquí que yo los destruiré con la tierra.

verses.KJV: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verses.WEB: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
verses.ASV: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze-te uma arca de madeira de gôfer: farás aposentos na arca e a selarás com betume por dentro e por fora.
verses.RVR09: Hazte un arca de madera de Gopher: harás aposentos en el arca, y la embetunarás con brea por dentro y por fuera.

verses.KJV: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.WEB: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
verses.ASV: And this is how thou shalt make it: the length of the ark three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desta maneira a farás: de trezentos côvados o comprimento da arca, de cinquenta côvados sua largura, e de trinta côvados sua altura.
verses.RVR09: Y de esta manera la harás: de trescientos codos la longitud del arca, de cincuenta codos su anchura, y de treinta codos su altura.

verses.KJV: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
verses.WEB: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.
verses.ASV: A light shalt thou make to the ark, and to a cubit shalt thou finish it upward; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma janela farás à arca, e a acabarás a um côvado de elevação pela parte de cima: e porás a porta da arca a seu lado; e lhe farás piso abaixo, segundo e terceiro.
verses.RVR09: Una ventana harás al arca, y la acabarás á un codo de elevación por la parte de arriba: y pondrás la puerta del arca á su lado; y le harás piso bajo, segundo y tercero.

verses.KJV: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
verses.WEB: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.
verses.ASV: And I, behold, I do bring the flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; everything that is in the earth shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu, eis que eu trago um dilúvio de águas sobre a terra, para destruir toda carne em que haja espírito de vida debaixo do céu; tudo o que há na terra morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y yo, he aquí que yo traigo un diluvio de aguas sobre la tierra, para destruir toda carne en que haya espíritu de vida debajo del cielo; todo lo que hay en la tierra morirá.

verses.KJV: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.WEB: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

verses.ASV: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
verses.ALMEIDA: E esperou ainda outros sete dias, e voltou a enviar a pomba fora da arca.
verses.RVR09: Y esperó aún otros siete días, y volvió á enviar la paloma fuera del arca.

verses.KJV: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.WEB: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.
verses.ASV: and the dove came in to him at eventide; and, lo, in her mouth an olive-leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a pomba voltou a ele à hora da tarde; e eis que trazia uma folha de oliveira tomada em seu bico; então Noé entendeu que as águas haviam se retirado de sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y la paloma volvió á él á la hora de la tarde; y he aquí que traía una hoja de oliva tomada en su pico: y entendió Noé que las aguas se habían retirado de sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
verses.WEB: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.
verses.ASV: And he stayed yet other seven days, and sent forth the dove; and she returned not again unto him any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esperou ainda outros sete dias, e enviou a pomba, a qual não voltou já mais a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y esperó aún otros siete días, y envió la paloma, la cual no volvió ya más á él.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.WEB: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dried.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que no ano seiscentos e um de Noé, no mês primeiro, ao primeiro do mês, as águas se enxugaram de sobre a terra e tirou Noé a cobertura da arca, e olhou, e eis que a face da terra estava enxuta.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que en el año seiscientos y uno de Noé, en el mes primero, al primero del mes, las aguas se enjugaron de sobre la tierra; y quitó Noé la cubierta del arca, y miró, y he aquí que la faz de la tierra estaba enjuta.

verses.KJV: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
verses.WEB: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
verses.ASV: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dry.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no mês segundo, aos vinte e sete dias do mês, se secou a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y en el mes segundo, á los veintisiete días del mes, se secó la tierra.

verses.KJV: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
verses.WEB: God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.ASV: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Deus a Noé dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Dios á Noé diciendo:

verses.KJV: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.WEB: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.ASV: Go forth from the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sai da arca tu, a tua mulher, os teus filhos, e as mulheres dos teus filhos contigo.
verses.RVR09: Sal del arca tú, y tu mujer, y tus hijos, y las mujeres de tus hijos contigo.

verses.KJV: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
verses.WEB: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
verses.ASV: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee of all flesh, both birds, and cattle, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os animais que estão contigo de toda carne, de aves e de animais e de todo réptil que anda arrastando sobre a terra, tirarás contigo; e vão pela terra, e frutifiquem, e multipliquem-se sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Todos los animales que están contigo de toda carne, de aves y de bestias y de todo reptil que anda arrastrando sobre la tierra, sacarás contigo; y vayan por la tierra, y fructifiquen, y multiplíquense sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
verses.WEB: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
verses.ASV: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então saiu Noé, e seus filhos, e sua mulher, e as mulheres de seus filhos com ele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces salió Noé, y sus hijos, y su mujer, y las mujeres de sus hijos con él.

verses.KJV: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
verses.WEB: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.
verses.ASV: every beast, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatsoever moveth upon the earth, after their families, went forth out of the ark.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os animais, e todo réptil e toda ave, tudo o que se move sobre a terra segundo suas espécies, saíram da arca.
verses.RVR09: Todos los animales, y todo reptil y toda ave, todo lo que se mueve sobre la tierra según sus especies, salieron del arca.

verses.KJV: And Noah builded an altar unto the Lord; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.WEB: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.ASV: And Noah builded an altar unto Jehovah, and took of every clean beast, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt-offerings on the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou Noé um altar ao SENHOR e tomou de todo animal limpo e de toda ave limpa, e ofereceu holocaustos sobre o altar.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó Noé un altar á Jehová, y tomó de todo animal limpio y de toda ave limpia, y ofreció holocausto en el altar.

verses.KJV: And the Lord smelled a sweet savour; and the Lord said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
verses.WEB: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah smelled the sweet savor; and Jehovah said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake, for that the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more everything living, as I have done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E percebeu o SENHOR cheiro suave; e o SENHOR disse em seu coração: Não voltarei mais a amaldiçoar a terra por causa do ser humano; porque o intento do coração do ser humano é mau desde sua juventude: nem voltarei mais a destruir todo vivente, como fiz.
verses.RVR09: Y percibió Jehová olor de suavidad; y dijo Jehová en su corazón: No tornaré más á maldecir la tierra por causa del hombre; porque el intento del corazón del hombre es malo desde su juventud: ni volveré más á destruir todo viviente, como he hecho.

verses.KJV: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verses.WEB: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
verses.ASV: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto a terra durar, a sementeira e a colheita, o frio e calor, verão e inverno, dia e noite, não cessarão.
verses.RVR09: Todavía serán todos los tiempos de la tierra; la sementera y la siega, y el frío y calor, verano é invierno, y día y noche, no cesarán.

verses.KJV: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.WEB: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.ASV: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus abençoou Noé e seus filhos, e disse-lhes: Frutificai, e multiplicai, e enchei a terra:
verses.RVR09: Y BENDIJO Dios á Noé y á sus hijos, y díjoles: Fructificad, y multiplicad, y henchid la tierra:

verses.KJV: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
verses.WEB: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
verses.ASV: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every bird of the heavens; with all wherewith the ground teemeth, and all the fishes of the sea, into your hand are they delivered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vosso temor e vosso pavor será sobre todo animal da terra, e sobre toda ave dos céus, em tudo o que se mover na terra, e em todos os peixes do mar: em vossa mão são entregues.
verses.RVR09: Y vuestro temor y vuestro pavor será sobre todo animal de la tierra, y sobre toda ave de los cielos, en todo lo que se moverá en la tierra, y en todos los peces del mar: en vuestra mano son entregados.

verses.KJV: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
verses.WEB: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
verses.ASV: Every moving thing that liveth shall be food for you; as the green herb have I given you all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo o que se move e vive vos será para mantimento: assim como os legumes e ervas, vos dei disso tudo.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que se mueve y vive, os será para mantenimiento: así como las legumbres y hierbas, os lo he dado todo.

verses.KJV: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.WEB: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
verses.ASV: But flesh with the life thereof, [which is] the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a carne com sua vida, que é seu sangue, não comereis.
verses.RVR09: Empero carne con su vida, que es su sangre, no comeréis.

verses.KJV: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
verses.WEB: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.
verses.ASV: And surely your blood, [the blood] of your lives, will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it: and at the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, will I require the life of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque certamente exigirei o sangue de vossas vidas; da mão de todo animal o exigirei, e da mão do ser humano; da mão do homem seu irmão exigirei a vida do ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Porque ciertamente demandaré la sangre de vuestras vidas; de mano de todo animal la demandaré, y de mano del hombre; de mano del varón su hermano demandaré la vida del hombre.

verses.KJV: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
verses.WEB: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
verses.ASV: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que derramar sangue humano, pelo ser humano seu sangue será derramado; porque à imagem de Deus o ser humano foi feito.
verses.RVR09: El que derramare sangre del hombre, por el hombre su sangre será derramada; porque á imagen de Dios es hecho el hombre.

verses.KJV: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
verses.WEB: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
verses.ASV: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós frutificai, e multiplicai-vos; procriai abundantemente na terra, e multiplicai-vos nela.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros fructificad, y multiplicaos; procread abundantemente en la tierra, y multiplicaos en ella.

verses.KJV: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.WEB: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.ASV: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Deus a Noé e a seus filhos com ele, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Dios á Noé y á sus hijos con él, diciendo:

verses.KJV: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.WEB: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
verses.ASV: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu mesmo estabeleço meu pacto convosco, e com vossa descendência depois de vós;
verses.RVR09: Yo, he aquí que yo establezco mi pacto con vosotros, y con vuestra simiente después de vosotros;

verses.KJV: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
verses.WEB: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
verses.ASV: and with every living creature that is with you, the birds, the cattle, and every beast of the earth with you; of all that go out of the ark, even every beast of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com toda alma vivente que está convosco, de aves, de animais, e de toda fera da terra que está convosco; desde todos os que saíram da arca até todo animal da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y con toda alma viviente que está con vosotros, de aves, de animales, y de toda bestia de la tierra que está con vosotros; desde todos los que salieron del arca hasta todo animal de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And I will establish my covenant with you, neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.WEB: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
verses.ASV: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of the flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estabelecerei meu pacto convosco, e não será mais exterminada toda carne com águas de dilúvio; nem haverá mais dilúvio para destruir a terra.
verses.RVR09: Estableceré mi pacto con vosotros, y no fenecerá ya más toda carne con aguas de diluvio; ni habrá más diluvio para destruir la tierra.

verses.KJV: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.WEB: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.ASV: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus: Este será o sinal do pacto que estabeleço entre mim e vós e toda alma vivente que está convosco, por tempos perpétuos:
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios: Esta será la señal del pacto que yo establezco entre mí y vosotros y toda alma viviente que está con vosotros, por siglos perpetuos:

verses.KJV: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.WEB: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.ASV: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu arco porei nas nuvens, o qual será por sinal de aliança entre mim e a terra.
verses.RVR09: Mi arco pondré en las nubes, el cual será por señal de convenio entre mí y la tierra.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
verses.WEB: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud,
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que quando fizer vir nuvens sobre a terra, se deixará ver então meu arco nas nuvens.
verses.RVR09: Y será que cuando haré venir nubes sobre la tierra, se dejará ver entonces mi arco en las nubes.

verses.KJV: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.WEB: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.ASV: and I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me lembrarei do meu pacto, que há entre mim e vós e toda alma vivente de toda carne; e não serão mais as águas por dilúvio para destruir toda carne.
verses.RVR09: Y acordarme he del pacto mío, que hay entre mí y vosotros y toda alma viviente de toda carne; y no serán más las aguas por diluvio para destruir toda carne.

verses.KJV: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.WEB: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”
verses.ASV: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estará o arco nas nuvens, e o verei para me lembrar do pacto perpétuo entre Deus e toda alma vivente, com toda carne que há sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y estará el arco en las nubes, y verlo he para acordarme del pacto perpetuo entre Dios y toda alma viviente, con toda carne que hay sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.WEB: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
verses.ASV: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse, pois, Deus a Noé: Este será o sinal do pacto que estabeleci entre mim e toda carne que está sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Dijo, pues, Dios á Noé: Esta será la señal del pacto que he establecido entre mí y toda carne que está sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.WEB: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Noah, that went forth from the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Noé que saíram da arca foram Sem, Cam e Jafé: e Cam é o pai de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Noé que salieron del arca fueron Sem, Châm y Japhet: y Châm es el padre de Canaán.

verses.KJV: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
verses.WEB: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
verses.ASV: These three were the sons of Noah: and of these was the whole earth overspread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes três são os filhos de Noé; e deles foi cheia toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Estos tres son los hijos de Noé; y de ellos fué llena toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
verses.WEB: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.
verses.ASV: And Noah began to be a husbandman, and planted a vineyard:
verses.ALMEIDA: E começou Noé a lavrar a terra, e plantou uma vinha;
verses.RVR09: Y comenzó Noé á labrar la tierra, y plantó una viña:

verses.KJV: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.WEB: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.
verses.ASV: and he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E bebeu do vinho, e se embriagou, e estava descoberto dentro de sua tenda.
verses.RVR09: Y bebió del vino, y se embriagó, y estaba descubierto en medio de su tienda.

verses.KJV: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.WEB: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
verses.ASV: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Cam, pai de Canaã, viu a nudez de seu pai, e disse-o aos seus dois irmãos do lado de fora.
verses.RVR09: Y Châm, padre de Canaán, vió la desnudez de su padre, y díjolo á sus dos hermanos á la parte de afuera.

verses.KJV: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
verses.WEB: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.
verses.ASV: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Sem e Jafé tomaram a roupa, e a puseram sobre seus próprios ombros, e andando para trás, cobriram a nudez de seu pai tendo seus rostos virados, e assim não viram a nudez de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Sem y Japhet tomaron la ropa, y la pusieron sobre sus propios hombros, y andando hacia atrás, cubrieron la desnudez de su padre, teniendo vueltos sus rostros, y así no vieron la desnudez de su padre.

verses.KJV: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
verses.WEB: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.
verses.ASV: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E despertou Noé de seu vinho, e soube o que havia feito com ele seu filho o mais jovem;
verses.RVR09: Y despertó Noé de su vino, y supo lo que había hecho con él su hijo el más joven;

verses.KJV: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.WEB: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Maldito seja Canaã; Servo de servos será a seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Maldito sea Canaán; siervo de siervos será á sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.WEB: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.
verses.ASV: And he said, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Shem; And let Canaan be his servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais: Bendito o SENHOR o Deus de Sem, E seja-lhe Canaã servo.
verses.RVR09: Dijo más: Bendito Jehová el Dios de Sem, y séale Canaán siervo.

verses.KJV: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.WEB: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”
verses.ASV: God enlarge Japheth, And let him dwell in the tents of Shem; And let Canaan be his servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Engrandeça Deus a Jafé, E habite nas tendas de Sem, E seja-lhe Canaã servo.
verses.RVR09: Engrandezca Dios á Japhet, y habite en las tiendas de Sem, y séale Canaán siervo.

verses.KJV: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.WEB: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.
verses.ASV: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Noé depois do dilúvio trezentos e cinquenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Noé después del diluvio trescientos y cincuenta años.

verses.KJV: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.WEB: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
verses.ASV: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram todos os dias de Noé novecentos e cinquenta anos; e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron todos los días de Noé novecientos y cincuenta años; y murió.

verses.KJV: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
verses.ASV: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, [namely], of Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as gerações dos filhos de Noé: Sem, Cam e Jafé, aos quais nasceram filhos depois do dilúvio.
verses.RVR09: ESTAS son las generaciones de los hijos de Noé: Sem, Châm y Japhet, á los cuales nacieron hijos después del diluvio.

verses.KJV: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.WEB: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.ASV: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Jafé: Gômer, e Magogue, e Madai, e Javã, e Tubal, e Meseque, e Tiras.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Japhet: Gomer, y Magog, y Madai, y Javán, y Tubal, y Meshech, y Tiras.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Gômer: Asquenaz, e Rifate, e Togarma.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Gomer: Ashkenaz, y Riphat, y Togorma.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.WEB: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Javã: Elisá, e Társis, Quitim, e Dodanim.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Javán: Elisa, y Tarsis, Kittim, y Dodanim.

verses.KJV: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.WEB: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
verses.ASV: Of these were the isles of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por estes foram repartidas as ilhas das nações em suas terras, cada qual segundo sua língua, conforme suas famílias em suas nações.
verses.RVR09: Por éstos fueron repartidas las islas de las gentes en sus tierras, cada cual según su lengua, conforme á sus familias en sus naciones.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Cam: Cuxe, e Mizraim, e Pute, e Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Châm: Cush, y Mizraim, y Phut, y Canaán.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.WEB: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Cuxe: Sebá, Havilá, e Sabtá, e Raamá, e Sabtecá. E os filhos de Raamá: Sabá e Dedã.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Cush: Seba, Havila, y Sabta, y Raama, y Sabtecha. Y los hijos de Raama: Sheba y Dedán.

verses.KJV: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.WEB: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.ASV: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Cuxe gerou a Ninrode, este começou a ser poderoso na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y Cush engendró á Nimrod: éste comenzó á ser poderoso en la tierra.

verses.KJV: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord.
verses.WEB: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.
verses.ASV: He was a mighty hunter before Jehovah: wherefore it is said, Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este foi vigoroso caçador diante do SENHOR; pelo qual se diz: Assim como Ninrode, vigoroso caçador diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Este fué vigoroso cazador delante de Jehová; por lo cual se dice: Así como Nimrod, vigoroso cazador delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.WEB: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.ASV: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a cabeceira de seu reino Babel, e Ereque, e Acade, e Calné, na terra de Sinear.
verses.RVR09: Y fué la cabecera de su reino Babel, y Erech, y Accad, y Calneh, en la tierra de Shinar.

verses.KJV: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
verses.WEB: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
verses.ASV: Out of that land he went forth into Assyria, and builded Nineveh, and Rehoboth-Ir, and Calah,
verses.ALMEIDA: De esta terra saiu Assur, e edificou a Nínive, e a Reobote-Ir, e a Calá,
verses.RVR09: De aquesta tierra salió Assur, y edificó á Nínive, y á Rehoboth, y á Calah,

verses.KJV: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
verses.WEB: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
verses.ASV: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (the same is the great city).
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Resém entre Nínive e Calá; a qual é cidade grande.
verses.RVR09: Y á Ressen entre Nínive y Calah; la cual es ciudad grande.

verses.KJV: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.WEB: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.ASV: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Mizraim gerou a Ludim, e a Anamim, e a Leabim, e a Naftuim,
verses.RVR09: Y Mizraim engendró á Ludim, y á Anamim, y á Lehabim, y á Naphtuhim,

verses.KJV: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
verses.WEB: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
verses.ASV: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (whence went forth the Philistines), and Caphtorim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Patrusim, e a Casluim de onde saíram os filisteus, e a Caftorim.
verses.RVR09: Y á Pathrusim, y á Casluim, de donde salieron los Filisteos, y á Caphtorim.

verses.KJV: And Canaan begat Sidon his first born, and Heth,
verses.WEB: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
verses.ASV: And Canaan begat Sidon his first-born, and Heth,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Canaã gerou a Sidom, seu primogênito e a Hete,
verses.RVR09: Y Canaán engendró á Sidón, su primogénito, y á Heth,

verses.KJV: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
verses.WEB: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
verses.ASV: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos jebuseus, e aos amorreus, e aos gergeseus,
verses.RVR09: Y al Jebuseo, y al Amorrheo, y al Gergeseo,

verses.KJV: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.WEB: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
verses.ASV: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos heveus, e aos arqueus, e aos sineus,
verses.RVR09: Y al Heveo, y al Araceo, y al Sineo,

verses.KJV: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
verses.WEB: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
verses.ASV: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanite spread abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos arvadeus e aos zemareus, e aos hamateus: e depois se derramaram as famílias dos cananeus.
verses.RVR09: Y al Aradio, y al Samareo, y al Amatheo: y después se derramaron las familias de los Cananeos.

verses.KJV: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
verses.WEB: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
verses.ASV: And the border of the Canaanite was from Sidon, as thou goest toward Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest toward Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim, unto Lasha.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o termo dos cananeus desde Sidom, vindo a Gerar até Gaza, até entrar em Sodoma e Gomorra, Admá, e Zeboim até Lasa.
verses.RVR09: Y fué el término de los Cananeos desde Sidón, viniendo á Gerar hasta Gaza, hasta entrar en Sodoma y Gomorra, Adma, y Zeboim hasta Lasa.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os filhos de Cam por suas famílias, por suas línguas, em suas terras, em suas nações.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los hijos de Châm por sus familias, por sus lenguas, en sus tierras, en sus naciones.

verses.KJV: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
verses.WEB: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
verses.ASV: And unto Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também lhe nasceram filhos a Sem, pai de todos os filhos de Héber, e irmão mais velho de Jafé.
verses.RVR09: También le nacieron hijos á Sem, padre de todos los hijos de Heber, y hermano mayor de Japhet.

verses.KJV: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.WEB: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.ASV: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Sem: Elão, e Assur, e Arfaxade, e Lude, e Arã.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Sem: Elam, y Assur, y Arphaxad, y Lud, y Aram.

verses.KJV: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.WEB: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Aram: Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Arã: Uz, e Hul, e Géter, e Mas.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Aram: Uz, y Hul, y Gether, y Mas.

verses.KJV: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
verses.WEB: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
verses.ASV: And Arpachshad begat Shelah; and Shelah begat Eber.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Arfaxade gerou a Salá, e Salá gerou a Héber.
verses.RVR09: Y Arphaxad engendró á Sala, y Sala engendró á Heber.

verses.KJV: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
verses.WEB: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.ASV: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Héber nasceram dois filhos: o nome de um foi Pelegue, porque em seus dias foi repartida a terra; e o nome de seu irmão, Joctã.
verses.RVR09: Y á Heber nacieron dos hijos: el nombre del uno fué Peleg, porque en sus días fué repartida la tierra; y el nombre de su hermano, Joctán.

verses.KJV: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.WEB: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.ASV: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joctã gerou a Almodá, e a Salefe, e Hazarmavé, e a Jerá,
verses.RVR09: Y Joctán engendró á Almodad, y á Sheleph, y Hazarmaveth, y á Jera,

verses.KJV: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.WEB: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.ASV: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Hadorão, e a Uzal, e a Dicla,
verses.RVR09: Y á Hadoram, y á Uzal, y á Dicla,

verses.KJV: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.WEB: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.ASV: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Obal, e a Abimael, e a Sabá,
verses.RVR09: Y á Obal, y á Abimael, y á Seba,

verses.KJV: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.WEB: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.ASV: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Ofir, e a Havilá, e a Jobabe: todos estes foram filhos de Joctã.
verses.RVR09: Y á Ophir, y á Havila, y á Jobad: todos estos fueron hijos de Joctán.

verses.KJV: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
verses.WEB: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
verses.ASV: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi sua habitação desde Messa vindo de Sefar, monte à parte do oriente.
verses.RVR09: Y fué su habitación desde Mesa viniendo de Sephar, monte á la parte del oriente.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Sem por suas famílias, por suas línguas, em suas terras, em suas nações.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Sem por sus familias, por sus lenguas, en sus tierras, en sus naciones.

verses.KJV: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.WEB: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.
verses.ASV: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and of these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as famílias de Noé por suas descendências, em suas nações; e destes foram divididas os povos na terra depois do dilúvio.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las familias de Noé por sus descendencias, en sus naciones; y de éstos fueron divididas las gentes en la tierra después del diluvio.

verses.KJV: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
verses.WEB: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
verses.ASV: And the whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
verses.ALMEIDA: Era, então, toda a terra de uma língua e umas mesmas palavras.
verses.RVR09: ERA entonces toda la tierra de una lengua y unas mismas palabras.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.WEB: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as they journeyed east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando se partiram do oriente, acharam um vale na terra de Sinear; e ali passaram a habitar.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, como se partieron de oriente, hallaron una vega en la tierra de Shinar, y asentaron allí.

verses.KJV: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
verses.WEB: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
verses.ASV: And they said one to another, Come, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram uns aos outros: Vinde, façamos tijolos e o cozamos com fogo. E foi-lhes os tijolos em lugar de pedra, e o betume em lugar de argamassa.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron los unos á los otros: Vaya, hagamos ladrillo y cozámoslo con fuego. Y fuéles el ladrillo en lugar de piedra, y el betún en lugar de mezcla.

verses.KJV: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.WEB: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
verses.ASV: And they said, Come, let us build us a city, and a tower, whose top [may reach] unto heaven, and let us make us a name; lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram: Vamos, edifiquemo-nos uma cidade e uma torre, cuja ponta chegue ao céu; e façamo-nos um nome, para que não sejamos espalhados sobre a face de toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron: Vamos, edifiquémonos una ciudad y una torre, cuya cúspide llegue al cielo; y hagámonos un nombre, por si fuéremos esparcidos sobre la faz de toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.WEB: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desceu o SENHOR para ver a cidade e a torre que edificavam os filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió Jehová para ver la ciudad y la torre que edificaban los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language; and this is what they begin to do: and now nothing will be withholden from them, which they purpose to do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR: Eis que o povo é um, e todos estes têm uma língua; e começaram a agir, e nada lhes restringirá agora do que pensaram fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová: He aquí el pueblo es uno, y todos éstos tienen un lenguaje: y han comenzado á obrar, y nada les retraerá ahora de lo que han pensando hacer.

verses.KJV: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
verses.WEB: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”
verses.ASV: Come, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, desçamos, e confundamos ali suas línguas, para que ninguém entenda a fala de seu companheiro.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, descendamos, y confundamos allí sus lenguas, para que ninguno entienda el habla de su compañero.

verses.KJV: So the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
verses.WEB: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.
verses.ASV: So Jehovah scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off building the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os espalhou o SENHOR desde ali sobre a face de toda a terra, e deixaram de edificar a cidade.
verses.RVR09: Así los esparció Jehová desde allí sobre la faz de toda la tierra, y dejaron de edificar la ciudad.

verses.KJV: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the Lord scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.WEB: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
verses.ASV: Therefore was the name of it called Babel; because Jehovah did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did Jehovah scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isto foi chamado o nome dela Babel, porque ali confundiu o SENHOR a língua de toda a terra, e desde ali os espalhou sobre a face de toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Por esto fué llamado el nombre de ella Babel, porque allí confundió Jehová el lenguaje de toda la tierra, y desde allí los esparció sobre la faz de toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
verses.WEB: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.
verses.ASV: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old, and begat Arpachshad two years after the flood:
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as gerações de Sem: Sem, de idade de cem anos, gerou a Arfaxade, dois anos depois do dilúvio.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las generaciones de Sem: Sem, de edad de cien años, engendró á Arphaxad, dos años después del diluvio.

verses.KJV: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Shem lived after he begat Arpachshad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Sem, depois que gerou a Arfaxade quinhentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Sem, después que engendró á Arphaxad, quinientos años, y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
verses.WEB: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
verses.ASV: And Arpachshad lived five and thirty years, and begat Shelah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Arfaxade viveu trinta e cinco anos, e gerou a Salá.
verses.RVR09: Y Arphaxad vivió treinta y cinco años, y engendró á Sala.

verses.KJV: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Arpachshad lived after he begat Shelah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Arfaxade, depois que gerou a Salá, quatrocentos e três anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Arphaxad, después que engendró á Sala, cuatrocientos y tres años, y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
verses.WEB: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.
verses.ASV: And Shelah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Salá trinta anos, e gerou a Héber.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Sala treinta años, y engendró á Heber.

verses.KJV: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Shelah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Salá, depois que gerou a Héber, quatrocentos e três anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Sala, después que engendró á Heber, cuatrocientos y tres años, y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
verses.WEB: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
verses.ASV: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Héber trinta e quatro anos, e gerou a Pelegue.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Heber treinta y cuatro años, y engendró á Peleg.

verses.KJV: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Héber, depois que gerou a Pelegue, quatrocentos e trinta anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Heber, después que engendró á Peleg, cuatrocientos y treinta años, y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
verses.WEB: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.
verses.ASV: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Pelegue, trinta anos, e gerou a Reú.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Peleg treinta años, y engendró á Reu.

verses.KJV: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Pelegue, depois que gerou a Reú, duzentos e nove anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Peleg, después que engendró á Reu, doscientos y nueve años, y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
verses.WEB: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.
verses.ASV: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Reú viveu trinta e dois anos, e gerou a Serugue.
verses.RVR09: Y Reu vivió treinta y dos años, y engendró á Serug.

verses.KJV: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Reú, depois que gerou a Serugue, duzentos e sete anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Reu, después que engendró á Serug, doscientos y siete años, y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
verses.WEB: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
verses.ASV: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Serugue trinta anos, e gerou a Naor.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Serug treinta años, y engendró á Nachôr.

verses.KJV: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Serugue, depois que gerou a Naor, duzentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Serug, después que engendró á Nachôr, doscientos años, y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
verses.WEB: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.
verses.ASV: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Naor vinte e nove anos, e gerou a Terá.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Nachôr veintinueve años, y engendró á Thare.

verses.KJV: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: and Nahor lived after he begat Terah a hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Naor, depois que gerou a Terá, cento e dezenove anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Nachôr, después que engendró á Thare, ciento diecinueve años, y engendró hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.WEB: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.ASV: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Terá setenta anos, e gerou a Abrão, e a Naor, e a Harã.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Thare setenta años, y engendró á Abram, y á Nachôr, y á Harán.

verses.KJV: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
verses.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
verses.ASV: Now these are the generations of Terah. Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as gerações de Terá: Terá gerou a Abrão, e a Naor, e a Harã; e Harã gerou a Ló.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las generaciones de Thare: Thare engendró á Abram, y á Nachôr, y á Harán; y Harán engendró á Lot.

verses.KJV: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.WEB: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.
verses.ASV: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Harã antes que seu pai Terá na terra de seu nascimento, em Ur dos caldeus.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Harán antes que su padre Thare en la tierra de su naturaleza, en Ur de los Caldeos.

verses.KJV: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.WEB: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.
verses.ASV: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram Abrão e Naor para si mulheres: o nome da mulher de Abrão foi Sarai, e o nome da mulher de Naor, Milca, filha de Harã, pai de Milca e de Iscá.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron Abram y Nachôr para sí mujeres: el nombre de la mujer de Abram fué Sarai, y el nombre de la mujer de Nachôr, Milca, hija de Harán, padre de Milca y de Isca.

verses.KJV: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.WEB: Sarai was barren. She had no child.
verses.ASV: And Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Sarai era estéril, e não tinha filho.
verses.RVR09: Mas Sarai fué estéril, y no tenía hijo.
