verses.KJV: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.WEB: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
verses.ASV: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Terá a Abrão seu filho, e a Ló filho de Harã, filho de seu filho, e a Sarai sua nora, mulher de Abrão seu filho: e saiu com eles de Ur dos caldeus, para ir à terra de Canaã: e vieram até Harã, e assentaram ali.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Thare á Abram su hijo, y á Lot hijo de Harán, hijo de su hijo, y á Sarai su nuera, mujer de Abram su hijo: y salió con ellos de Ur de los Caldeos, para ir á la tierra de Canaán: y vinieron hasta Harán, y asentaron allí.

verses.KJV: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.WEB: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
verses.ASV: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram os dias de Terá duzentos e cinco anos; e morreu Terá em Harã.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron los días de Thare doscientos y cinco años; y murió Thare en Harán.

verses.KJV: Now the Lord had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
verses.WEB: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
verses.ASV: Now Jehovah said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto the land that I will show thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR disse a Abrão: “Sai da tua terra, e da tua parentela, e da casa de teu pai, para terra que eu te mostrarei.
verses.RVR09: EMPERO Jehová había dicho á Abram: Vete de tu tierra y de tu parentela, y de la casa de tu padre, á la tierra que te mostraré;

verses.KJV: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verses.WEB: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
verses.ASV: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and be thou a blessing:
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei de ti uma grande nação, e te abençoarei, e engrandecerei o teu nome, e tu serás uma bênção.
verses.RVR09: Y haré de ti una nación grande, y bendecirte he, y engrandeceré tu nombre, y serás bendición:

verses.KJV: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
verses.WEB: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
verses.ASV: and I will bless them that bless thee, and him that curseth thee will I curse: and in thee shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abençoarei os que te abençoarem, e amaldiçoarei os que te amaldiçoarem; e em ti todas as famílias da terra serão benditas.”
verses.RVR09: Y bendeciré á los que te bendijeren, y á los que te maldijeren maldeciré: y serán benditas en ti todas las familias de la tierra.

verses.KJV: So Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.WEB: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
verses.ASV: So Abram went, as Jehovah had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se foi Abrão, como o SENHOR lhe dissera; e Ló foi com ele. Abrão tinha setenta e cinco anos de idade quando saiu de Harã.
verses.RVR09: Y fuése Abram, como Jehová le dijo; y fué con él Lot: y era Abram de edad de setenta y cinco años cuando salió de Harán.

verses.KJV: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
verses.WEB: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abrão tomou a Sarai, sua mulher, e a Ló, filho de seu irmão, e todos os seus pertences que haviam ganhado, e as pessoas que eles haviam adquirido em Harã, e saíram para ir à terra de Canaã; e à terra de Canaã chegaram.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Abram á Sarai su mujer, y á Lot hijo de su hermano, y toda su hacienda que habían ganado, y las almas que habían adquirido en Harán, y salieron para ir á tierra de Canaán; y á tierra de Canaán llegaron.

verses.KJV: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
verses.WEB: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.
verses.ASV: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem, unto the oak of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passou Abrão por aquela terra até o lugar de Siquém, até o carvalho de Moré; e os cananeus estavam então na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y pasó Abram por aquella tierra hasta el lugar de Sichêm, hasta el valle de Moreh: y el Cananeo estaba entonces en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the Lord appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the Lord, who appeared unto him.
verses.WEB: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto Jehovah, who appeared unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR apareceu a Abrão, e lhe disse: À tua descendência darei esta terra. E ele edificou ali um altar ao SENHOR, que lhe havia aparecido.
verses.RVR09: Y apareció Jehová á Abram, y le dijo: A tu simiente daré esta tierra. Y edificó allí un altar á Jehová, que le había aparecido.

verses.KJV: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the Lord, and called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: And he removed from thence unto the mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Ai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto Jehovah, and called upon the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passou-se dali a um monte ao oriente de Betel, e estendeu sua tenda, tendo a Betel ao ocidente e Ai ao oriente: e edificou ali altar ao SENHOR e invocou o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y pasóse de allí á un monte al oriente de Bethel, y tendió su tienda, teniendo á Bethel al occidente y Hai al oriente: y edificó allí altar á Jehová, é invocó el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
verses.WEB: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.
verses.ASV: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the South.
verses.ALMEIDA: E moveu Abrão dali, caminhando e indo até o Sul.
verses.RVR09: Y movió Abram de allí, caminando y yendo hacia el Mediodía.

verses.KJV: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
verses.WEB: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.
verses.ASV: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was sore in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve fome na terra, e desceu Abrão ao Egito para peregrinar ali; porque era grande a fome na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y hubo hambre en la tierra, y descendió Abram á Egipto para peregrinar allá; porque era grande el hambre en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
verses.WEB: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando estava para entrar no Egito, disse a Sarai sua mulher: Eis que, agora conheço que és mulher bela à vista;
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que cuando estaba para entrar en Egipto, dijo á Sarai su mujer: He aquí, ahora conozco que eres mujer hermosa de vista;

verses.KJV: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
verses.WEB: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.
verses.ASV: and it will come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they will say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que quando te houverem visto os egípcios, dirão: Sua mulher é: e matarão a mim, e a ti te preservarão a vida.
verses.RVR09: Y será que cuando te habrán visto los Egipcios, dirán: Su mujer es: y me matarán á mí, y á ti te reservarán la vida.

verses.KJV: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
verses.WEB: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”
verses.ASV: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister; that it may be well with me for thy sake, and that my soul may live because of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, dize que és minha irmã, para que eu vá bem por tua causa, e viva minha alma por causa de ti.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, di que eres mi hermana, para que yo haya bien por causa tuya, y viva mi alma por amor de ti.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
verses.WEB: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando entrou Abrão no Egito, os egípcios viram a mulher que era bela em grande maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, como entró Abram en Egipto, los Egipcios vieron la mujer que era hermosa en gran manera.

verses.KJV: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
verses.WEB: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.ASV: And the princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Viram-na também os príncipes de Faraó, e a elogiaram; e foi levada a mulher a casa de Faraó:
verses.RVR09: Viéronla también los príncipes de Faraón, y se la alabaron; y fué llevada la mujer á casa de Faraón:

verses.KJV: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
verses.WEB: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
verses.ASV: And he dealt well with Abram for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he-asses, and men-servants, and maid-servants, and she-asses, and camels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez bem a Abrão por causa dela; e teve ovelhas, e vacas, e asnos, e servos, e criadas, e asnas e camelos.
verses.RVR09: E hizo bien á Abram por causa de ella; y tuvo ovejas, y vacas, y asnos, y siervos, y criadas, y asnas y camellos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
verses.WEB: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR feriu a Faraó e à sua casa com grandes pragas, por causa de Sarai mulher de Abrão.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová hirió á Faraón y á su casa con grandes plagas, por causa de Sarai mujer de Abram.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
verses.WEB: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó chamou a Abrão e lhe disse: Que é isto que fizeste comigo? Por que não me declaraste que era tua mulher?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón llamó á Abram, y le dijo: ¿Qué es esto que has hecho conmigo? ¿Por qué no me declaraste que era tu mujer?

verses.KJV: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
verses.WEB: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”
verses.ASV: why saidst thou, She is my sister, so that I took her to be my wife? now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que disseste: “É minha irmã”, pondo-me em risco de tomá-la para mim por mulher? Agora, pois, eis aqui tua mulher, toma-a e vai-te.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué dijiste: Es mi hermana? poniéndome en ocasión de tomarla para mí por mujer? Ahora pues, he aquí tu mujer, tómala y vete.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh gave men charge concerning him: and they brought him on the way, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó deu ordem a seus homens acerca de Abrão; e lhe acompanharam, e à sua mulher com tudo o que tinha.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón dió orden á sus gentes acerca de Abram; y le acompañaron, y á su mujer con todo lo que tenía.

verses.KJV: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
verses.WEB: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
verses.ASV: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the South.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subiu, pois, Abrão do Egito até o Sul de Canaã, ele e sua mulher, com tudo o que tinha, e com ele Ló.
verses.RVR09: SUBIÓ, pues, Abram de Egipto hacia el Mediodía, él, y su mujer, con todo lo que tenía, y con él Lot.

verses.KJV: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.WEB: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
verses.ASV: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abrão era riquíssimo em gado, em prata e ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y Abram era riquísimo en ganado, en plata y oro.

verses.KJV: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
verses.WEB: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
verses.ASV: And he went on his journeys from the South even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Ai,
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou por suas jornadas da parte do Sul até Betel, até o lugar onde havia estado antes sua tenda entre Betel e Ai;
verses.RVR09: Y volvió por sus jornadas de la parte del Mediodía hacia Bethel, hasta el lugar donde había estado antes su tienda entre Bethel y Hai;

verses.KJV: Unto the place of the altar, which he had make there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao lugar do altar que havia feito ali antes: e invocou ali Abrão o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Al lugar del altar que había hecho allí antes: é invocó allí Abram el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.WEB: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.
verses.ASV: And Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também Ló, que andava com Abrão, tinha ovelhas, e vacas, e tendas.
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo Lot, que andaba con Abram, tenía ovejas, y vacas, y tiendas.

verses.KJV: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.WEB: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.
verses.ASV: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra não os podia sustentar para que habitassem juntos; porque a riqueza deles era muita, e não podiam morar num mesmo lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra no podía darles para que habitasen juntos: porque su hacienda era mucha, y no podían morar en un mismo lugar.

verses.KJV: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
verses.WEB: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.
verses.ASV: And there was a strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdsmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelt then in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve briga entre os pastores do gado de Abrão e os pastores do gado de Ló: e os cananeus e os ferezeus habitavam então na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y hubo contienda entre los pastores del ganado de Abram y los pastores del ganado de Lot: y el Cananeo y el Pherezeo habitaban entonces en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
verses.WEB: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.
verses.ASV: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdsmen and thy herdsmen; for we are brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abrão disse a Ló: Não haja agora briga entre mim e ti, entre meus pastores e os teus, porque somos irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abram dijo á Lot: No haya ahora altercado entre mí y ti, entre mis pastores y los tuyos, porque somos hermanos.

verses.KJV: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.WEB: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”
verses.ASV: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if [thou wilt take] the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if [thou take] the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não está toda a terra diante de ti? Eu te rogo que te separes de mim. Se fores à esquerda, eu irei à direita: e se tu à direita, eu irei à esquerda.
verses.RVR09: ¿No está toda la tierra delante de ti? Yo te ruego que te apartes de mí. Si fueres á la mano izquierda, yo iré á la derecha: y si tú á la derecha, yo iré á la izquierda.

verses.KJV: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
verses.WEB: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.
verses.ASV: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the Plain of the Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before Jehovah destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Jehovah, like the land of Egypt, as thou goest unto Zoar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou Ló seus olhos, e viu toda a planície do Jordão, que toda ela era bem regada, antes que destruísse o SENHOR a Sodoma e a Gomorra, como o jardim do SENHOR, como a terra do Egito entrando em Zoar.
verses.RVR09: Y alzó Lot sus ojos, y vió toda la llanura del Jordán, que toda ella era de riego, antes que destruyese Jehová á Sodoma y á Gomorra, como el huerto de Jehová, como la tierra de Egipto entrando en Zoar.

verses.KJV: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
verses.WEB: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.
verses.ASV: So Lot chose him all the Plain of the Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Ló escolheu para si toda a planície do Jordão: e partiu-se Ló ao Oriente, e separaram-se um do outro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Lot escogió para sí toda la llanura del Jordán: y partióse Lot de Oriente, y apartáronse el uno del otro.

verses.KJV: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
verses.WEB: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
verses.ASV: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the Plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abrão assentou na terra de Canaã, e Ló assentou nas cidades da planície, e foi pondo suas tendas até Sodoma.
verses.RVR09: Abram asentó en la tierra de Canaán, y Lot asentó en las ciudades de la llanura, y fué poniendo sus tiendas hasta Sodoma.

verses.KJV: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly.
verses.WEB: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.
verses.ASV: Now the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners against Jehovah exceedingly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os homens de Sodoma eram maus e pecadores para com o SENHOR em grande maneira.
verses.RVR09: Mas los hombres de Sodoma eran malos y pecadores para con Jehová en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art, northward and southward and eastward and westward:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Abrão, depois que Ló se separou dele: Levanta agora teus olhos, e olha desde o lugar onde estás até o norte, e ao sul, e ao oriente e ao ocidente;
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Abram, después que Lot se apartó de él: Alza ahora tus ojos, y mira desde el lugar donde estás hacia el Aquilón, y al Mediodía, y al Oriente y al Occidente;

verses.KJV: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.WEB: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
verses.ASV: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque toda a terra que vês, a darei a ti e à tua descendência para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Porque toda la tierra que ves, la daré á ti y á tu simiente para siempre.

verses.KJV: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.WEB: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.
verses.ASV: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then may thy seed also be numbered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei tua descendência como o pó da terra: que se alguém puder contar o pó da terra, também tua descendência será contada.
verses.RVR09: Y haré tu simiente como el polvo de la tierra: que si alguno podrá contar el polvo de la tierra, también tu simiente será contada.

verses.KJV: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
verses.WEB: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”
verses.ASV: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for unto thee will I give it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, vai pela terra ao longo dela e à sua largura; porque a ti a tenho de dar.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, ve por la tierra á lo largo de ella y á su ancho; porque á ti la tengo de dar.

verses.KJV: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Abram moved his tent, and came and dwelt by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built there an altar unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abrão, pois, removendo sua tenda, veio e morou nos carvalhos de Manre, que é em Hebrom, e edificou ali altar ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Abram, pues, removiendo su tienda, vino y moró en el alcornocal de Mamre, que es en Hebrón, y edificó allí altar á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
verses.WEB: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu nos dias de Anrafel, rei de Sinear, Arioque, rei de Elasar, Quedorlaomer, rei de Elão, e Tidal, rei de nações,
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ en los días de Amraphel, rey de Shinar, Arioch, rey de Elazar, Chêdorlaomer, rey de Elá, y Tidal, rey de naciones,

verses.KJV: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
verses.WEB: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
verses.ASV: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar).
verses.ALMEIDA: Que estes fizeram guerra contra Bera, rei de Sodoma, e contra Birsa, rei de Gomorra, e contra Sinabe, rei de Admá, e contra Semeber, rei de Zeboim, e contra o rei de Belá, a qual é Zoar.
verses.RVR09: Que éstos hicieron guerra contra Bera, rey de Sodoma, y contra Birsha, rey de Gomorra, y contra Shinab, rey de Adma, y contra Shemeber, rey de Zeboim, y contra el rey de Bela, la cual es Zoar.

verses.KJV: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
verses.WEB: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
verses.ASV: All these joined together in the vale of Siddim (the same is the Salt Sea).
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes se juntaram no vale de Sidim, que é o mar salgado.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos se juntaron en el valle de Siddim, que es el mar salado.

verses.KJV: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.WEB: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.ASV: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Doze anos haviam servido a Quedorlaomer, e ao décimo terceiro ano se rebelaram.
verses.RVR09: Doce años habían servido á Chêdorlaomer, y al décimotercio año se rebelaron.

verses.KJV: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emins in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
verses.WEB: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
verses.ASV: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
verses.ALMEIDA: E no ano décimo quarto veio Quedorlaomer, e os reis que estavam de sua parte, e derrotaram aos refains em Asterote-Carnaim, aos zuzins em Hã, e aos emins em Savé-Quiriataim.
verses.RVR09: Y en el año décimocuarto vino Chêdorlaomer, y los reyes que estaban de su parte, y derrotaron á los Raphaitas en Ashteroth-carnaim, á los Zuzitas en Ham, y á los Emitas en Shave-Kiriataim.

verses.KJV: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.
verses.WEB: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
verses.ASV: and the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos horeus no monte de Seir, até a El-Parã, que está junto ao deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y á los Horeos en el monte de Seir, hasta la llanura de Parán, que está junto al desierto.

verses.KJV: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
verses.WEB: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.
verses.ASV: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat (the same is Kadesh), and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazazon-tamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltaram e vieram a En-Mispate, que é Cades, e devastaram todas as terras dos amalequitas, e também aos amorreus, que habitavam em Hazazom-Tamar.
verses.RVR09: Y volvieron, y vinieron á Emmisphat, que es Cades, y devastaron todas las haciendas de los Amalecitas, y también al Amorrheo, que habitaba en Hazezón-tamar.

verses.KJV: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.WEB: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim
verses.ASV: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar); and they set the battle in array against them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu o rei de Sodoma, e o rei de Gomorra, e o rei de Admá, e o rei de Zeboim, e o rei de Belá, que é Zoar, e ordenaram contra eles batalha no vale de Sidim;
verses.RVR09: Y salió el rey de Sodoma, y el rey de Gomorra, y el rey de Adma, y el rey de Zeboim, y el rey de Bela, que es Zoar, y ordenaron contra ellos batalla en el valle de Siddim;

verses.KJV: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
verses.WEB: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
verses.ASV: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
verses.ALMEIDA: A saber, contra Quedorlaomer, rei de Elão, e Tidal, rei de nações, e Anrafel, rei de Sinear, e Arioque, rei de Elasar; quatro reis contra cinco.
verses.RVR09: Es á saber, contra Chêdorlaomer, rey de Elam, y Tidal, rey de naciones, y Amraphel, rey de Shinar, y Arioch, rey de Elasar; cuatro reyes contra cinco.

verses.KJV: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.WEB: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.
verses.ASV: Now the vale of Siddim was full of slime pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there, and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o vale de Sidim estava cheio de poços de betume: e fugiram o rei de Sodoma e o de Gomorra, e caíram ali; e os demais fugiram ao monte.
verses.RVR09: Y el valle de Siddim estaba lleno de pozos de betún: y huyeron el rey de Sodoma y el de Gomorra, y cayeron allí; y los demás huyeron al monte.

verses.KJV: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
verses.WEB: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.
verses.ASV: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram toda a riqueza de Sodoma e de Gomorra, e todos os seus mantimentos, e se foram.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron toda la riqueza de Sodoma y de Gomorra, y todas sus vituallas, y se fueron.

verses.KJV: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.WEB: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.ASV: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomaram também Ló, filho do irmão de Abrão, que morava em Sodoma, e sua riqueza, e se foram.
verses.RVR09: Tomaron también á Lot, hijo del hermano de Abram, que moraba en Sodoma, y su hacienda, y se fueron.

verses.KJV: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
verses.WEB: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.
verses.ASV: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew: now he dwelt by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and these were confederate with Abram.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio um dos que escaparam, e denunciou-o a Abrão o hebreu, que habitava no vale de Manre, amorreu, irmão de Escol e irmão de Aner, os quais tinham feito pacto com Abrão.
verses.RVR09: Y vino uno de los que escaparon, y denunciólo á Abram el Hebreo, que habitaba en el valle de Mamre Amorrheo, hermano de Eschôl y hermano de Aner, los cuales estaban confederados con Abram.

verses.KJV: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
verses.WEB: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.
verses.ASV: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he led forth his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Abrão que seu irmão estava prisioneiro, e armou seus criados, os criados de sua casa, trezentos e dezoito, e seguiu-os até Dã.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Abram que su hermano estaba prisionero, y armó sus criados, los criados de su casa, trescientos dieciocho, y siguiólos hasta Dan.

verses.KJV: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.WEB: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.ASV: And he divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E derramou-se sobre eles de noite ele e seus servos, e feriu-os, e foi os seguindo até Hobá, que está à esquerda de Damasco.
verses.RVR09: Y derramóse sobre ellos de noche él y sus siervos, é hiriólos, y fuélos siguiendo hasta Hobah, que está á la izquierda de Damasco.

verses.KJV: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.WEB: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
verses.ASV: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E recuperou todos os bens, e também a Ló seu irmão e sua riqueza, e também as mulheres e gente.
verses.RVR09: Y recobró todos los bienes, y también á Lot su hermano y su hacienda, y también las mujeres y gente.

verses.KJV: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
verses.WEB: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
verses.ASV: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him, at the vale of Shaveh (the same is the King’s Vale).
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu o rei de Sodoma a recebê-lo, quando voltava da derrota de Quedorlaomer e dos reis que com ele estavam, ao vale de Savé, que é o vale do Rei.
verses.RVR09: Y salió el rey de Sodoma á recibirlo, cuando volvía de la derrota de Chêdorlaomer y de los reyes que con él estaban, al valle de Shave, que es el valle del Rey.

verses.KJV: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
verses.WEB: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
verses.ASV: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Melquisedeque, rei de Salém, tirou pão e vinho; o qual era sacerdote do Deus altíssimo;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Melchîsedec, rey de Salem, sacó pan y vino; el cual era sacerdote del Dios alto;

verses.KJV: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.WEB: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.
verses.ASV: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: E abençoou-lhe, e disse: Bendito seja Abrão do Deus altíssimo, possuidor dos céus e da terra;
verses.RVR09: Y bendíjole, y dijo: Bendito sea Abram del Dios alto, poseedor de los cielos y de la tierra;

verses.KJV: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
verses.WEB: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
verses.ASV: and blessed be God Most High, who hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him a tenth of all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E bendito seja o Deus altíssimo, que entregou teus inimigos em tua mão.
verses.RVR09: Y bendito sea el Dios alto, que entregó tus enemigos en tu mano. Y dióle Abram los diezmos de todo.

verses.KJV: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
verses.WEB: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”
verses.ASV: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei de Sodoma disse a Abrão: Dá-me as pessoas, e toma para ti a riqueza.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey de Sodoma dijo á Abram: Dame las personas, y toma para ti la hacienda.

verses.KJV: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the Lord, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.WEB: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.ASV: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lifted up my hand unto Jehovah, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Abrão ao rei de Sodoma: Levantei minha mão ao SENHOR Deus altíssimo, possuidor dos céus e da terra,
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Abram al rey de Sodoma: He alzado mi mano á Jehová Dios alto, poseedor de los cielos y de la tierra,

verses.KJV: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
verses.WEB: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
verses.ASV: that I will not take a thread nor a shoe-latchet nor aught that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
verses.ALMEIDA: Que desde um fio até a correia de um calçado, nada tomarei de tudo o que é teu, para que não digas: Eu enriqueci a Abrão:
verses.RVR09: Que desde un hilo hasta la correa de un calzado, nada tomaré de todo lo que es tuyo, porque no digas: Yo enriquecí á Abram:

verses.KJV: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
verses.WEB: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”
verses.ASV: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men that went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tirando somente o que os rapazes comeram, e a porção dos homens que foram comigo, Aner, Escol, e Manre; eles tomem a sua parte.
verses.RVR09: Sacando solamente lo que comieron los mancebos, y la porción de los varones que fueron conmigo, Aner, Eschôl, y Mamre; los cuales tomarán su parte.

verses.KJV: After these things the word of the Lord came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
verses.WEB: After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
verses.ASV: After these things the word of Jehovah came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, [and] thy exceeding great reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois destas coisas a palavra do SENHOR veio a Abrão em visão, dizendo: Não temas, Abrão; eu sou o teu escudo; a tua recompensa será muito grande.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS de estas cosas fué la palabra de Jehová á Abram en visión, diciendo: No temas, Abram; yo soy tu escudo, y tu galardón sobremanera grande.

verses.KJV: And Abram said, Lord God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
verses.WEB: Abram said, “Lord GOD, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
verses.ASV: And Abram said, O Lord Jehovah, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and he that shall be possessor of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?
verses.ALMEIDA: Abrão respondeu: Senhor DEUS, que me darás, sendo que não tenho filho, e o herdeiro da minha casa é Eliézer de Damasco?
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Abram: Señor Jehová ¿qué me has de dar, siendo así que ando sin hijo, y el mayordomo de mi casa es ese Damasceno Eliezer?

verses.KJV: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
verses.WEB: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
verses.ASV: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais Abrão: Eis que não me deste descendência, e eis que meu herdeiro é um nascido em minha casa.
verses.RVR09: Dijo más Abram: Mira que no me has dado prole, y he aquí que es mi heredero uno nacido en mi casa.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the word of the Lord came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
verses.ASV: And, behold, the word of Jehovah came unto him, saying, This man shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo a palavra do SENHOR veio a ele dizendo: Não esse não herdará de ti, mas sim o que sairá de tuas entranhas será o que de ti herdará.
verses.RVR09: Y luego la palabra de Jehová fué á él diciendo: No te heredará éste, sino el que saldrá de tus entrañas será el que te herede.

verses.KJV: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
verses.WEB: The LORD brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”
verses.ASV: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and number the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirou-lhe fora, e disse: Olha agora aos céus, e conta as estrelas, se as podes contar. E lhe disse: Assim será tua descendência.
verses.RVR09: Y sacóle fuera, y dijo: Mira ahora á los cielos, y cuenta las estrellas, si las puedes contar. Y le dijo: Así será tu simiente.

verses.KJV: And he believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
verses.WEB: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.
verses.ASV: And he believed in Jehovah; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E creu ao SENHOR, e contou-lhe por justiça.
verses.RVR09: Y creyó á Jehová, y contóselo por justicia.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, I am the Lord that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
verses.WEB: He said to Abram, “I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, I am Jehovah that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Eu sou o SENHOR, que te tirei de Ur dos caldeus, para dar-te a herdar esta terra.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole: Yo soy Jehová, que te saqué de Ur de los Caldeos, para darte á heredar esta tierra.

verses.KJV: And he said, Lord God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
verses.WEB: He said, “Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
verses.ASV: And he said, O Lord Jehovah, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Senhor DEUS, com que saberei que a vou herdar?
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Señor Jehová, ¿en qué conoceré que la tengo de heredar?

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Take me a heifer three years old, and a she-goat three years old, and a ram three years old, and a turtle-dove, and a young pigeon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe disse: Separa-me uma bezerra de três anos, e uma cabra de três anos, e um carneiro de três anos, uma rolinha também, e um pombinho.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo: Apártame una becerra de tres años, y una cabra de tres años, y un carnero de tres años, una tórtola también, y un palomino.

verses.KJV: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
verses.WEB: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
verses.ASV: And he took him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each half over against the other: but the birds divided he not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou ele todas estas coisas, e partiu-as pela metade, e pôs cada metade uma em frente de outra; mas não partiu as aves.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó él todas estas cosas, y partiólas por la mitad, y puso cada mitad una enfrente de otra; mas no partió las aves.

verses.KJV: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
verses.WEB: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
verses.ASV: And the birds of prey came down upon the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desciam aves sobre os corpos mortos, e enxotava-as Abrão.
verses.RVR09: Y descendían aves sobre los cuerpos muertos, y ojeábalas Abram.

verses.KJV: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
verses.WEB: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
verses.ASV: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, a horror of great darkness fell upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao pôr do sol veio o sono a Abrão, e eis que o pavor de uma grande escuridão caiu sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Mas á la caída del sol sobrecogió el sueño á Abram, y he aquí que el pavor de una grande obscuridad cayó sobre él.

verses.KJV: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
verses.WEB: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.
verses.ASV: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be sojourners in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse a Abrão: Tem certeza que a tua descendência será peregrina em terra que não é sua, e serão escravizados e afligidos por quatrocentos anos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo á Abram: Ten por cierto que tu simiente será peregrina en tierra no suya, y servirá á los de allí, y serán por ellos afligidos cuatrocientos años.

verses.KJV: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
verses.WEB: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;
verses.ASV: and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas também a nação a quem servirão, eu julgarei; e depois disto sairão com grande riqueza.
verses.RVR09: Mas también á la gente á quien servirán, juzgaré yo; y después de esto saldrán con grande riqueza.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
verses.WEB: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
verses.ASV: But thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, porém, virás aos teus pais em paz, e serás sepultado em boa velhice.
verses.RVR09: Y tú vendrás á tus padres en paz, y serás sepultado en buena vejez.

verses.KJV: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
verses.WEB: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
verses.ASV: And in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.
verses.ALMEIDA: E na quarta geração voltarão para cá; porque ainda não está completa a maldade dos amorreus até aqui.
verses.RVR09: Y en la cuarta generación volverán acá: porque aun no está cumplida la maldad del Amorrheo hasta aquí.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
verses.WEB: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch that passed between these pieces.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, depois de posto o sol, e já estando escuro, apareceu um fogo fumegando, e uma tocha de fogo que passou por entre os animais divididos.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que puesto el sol, y ya obscurecido, dejóse ver un horno humeando, y una antorcha de fuego que pasó por entre los animales divididos.

verses.KJV: In the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.WEB: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.ASV: In that day Jehovah made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia fez o SENHOR um pacto com Abrão dizendo: À tua descendência darei esta terra desde o rio do Egito até o rio grande, o rio Eufrates;
verses.RVR09: En aquel día hizo Jehová un pacto con Abram diciendo: A tu simiente daré esta tierra desde el río de Egipto hasta el río grande, el río Eufrates;

verses.KJV: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
verses.WEB: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
verses.ASV: the Kenite, and the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os queneus, e os quenezeus, e os cadmoneus,
verses.RVR09: Los Cineos, y los Ceneceos, y los Cedmoneos,

verses.KJV: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
verses.WEB: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
verses.ASV: and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os heteus, e os perizeus, e os refains,
verses.RVR09: Y los Hetheos, y los Pherezeos, y los Raphaitas,

verses.KJV: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
verses.WEB: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
verses.ASV: and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os amorreus, e os cananeus, e os girgaseus, e os jebuseus.
verses.RVR09: Y los Amorrheos, y los Cananeos, y los Gergeseos, y los Jebuseos.

verses.KJV: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.WEB: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.ASV: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bare him no children: and she had a handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Sarai, mulher de Abrão não lhe dava filho: e ela tinha uma serva egípcia, que se chamava Agar.
verses.RVR09: Y SARAI, mujer de Abram, no le paría: y ella tenía una sierva egipcia, que se llamaba Agar.

verses.KJV: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the Lord hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.WEB: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.ASV: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, Jehovah hath restrained me from bearing; go in, I pray thee, unto my handmaid; it may be that I shall obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse, pois, Sarai a Abrão: Já vês que o SENHOR me fez estéril: rogo-te que entres a minha serva; talvez terei filhos dela. E atendeu Abrão ao dito de Sarai.
verses.RVR09: Dijo, pues, Sarai á Abram: Ya ves que Jehová me ha hecho estéril: ruégote que entres á mi sierva; quizá tendré hijos de ella. Y atendió Abram al dicho de Sarai.

verses.KJV: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
verses.WEB: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
verses.ASV: And Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her handmaid, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Sarai, mulher de Abrão, tomou a Agar sua serva egípcia, ao fim de dez anos que havia habitado Abrão na terra de Canaã, e deu-a a Abrão seu marido por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y Sarai, mujer de Abram, tomó á Agar su sierva egipcia, al cabo de diez años que había habitado Abram en la tierra de Canaán, y dióla á Abram su marido por mujer.

verses.KJV: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.WEB: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.ASV: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele se deitou com Agar, a qual concebeu: e quando viu que havia concebido, olhava com desprezo à sua senhora.
verses.RVR09: Y él cohabitó con Agar, la cual concibió: y cuando vió que había concebido, miraba con desprecio á su señora.

verses.KJV: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the Lord judge between me and thee.
verses.WEB: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May the LORD judge between me and you.”
verses.ASV: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I gave my handmaid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: Jehovah judge between me and thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Sarai disse a Abrão: Minha afronta seja sobre ti; eu pus minha serva em teus braços, e vendo-se grávida, me olha com desprezo; julgue o SENHOR entre mim e ti.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Sarai dijo á Abram: Mi afrenta sea sobre ti: yo puse mi sierva en tu seno, y viéndose embarazada, me mira con desprecio; juzgue Jehová entre mí y ti.

verses.KJV: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thine hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
verses.WEB: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
verses.ASV: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her that which is good in thine eyes. And Sarai dealt hardly with her, and she fled from her face.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Abrão a Sarai: Eis aí tua serva em tua mão, faze com ela o que bem te parecer. E quando Sarai a afligiu, fugiu de sua presença.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Abram á Sarai: He ahí tu sierva en tu mano, haz con ella lo que bien te pareciere. Y como Sarai la afligiese, huyóse de su presencia.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo do SENHOR a achou junto a uma fonte de água no deserto, junto à fonte que está no caminho de Sur.
verses.RVR09: Y hallóla el ángel de Jehová junto á una fuente de agua en el desierto, junto á la fuente que está en el camino del Sur.

verses.KJV: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
verses.WEB: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Hagar, Sarai’s handmaid, whence camest thou? and whither goest thou? And she said, I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe disse: Agar, serva de Sarai, de onde vens tu, e para onde vais? E ela respondeu: Fujo de diante de Sarai, minha senhora.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijo: Agar, sierva de Sarai, ¿de dónde vienes tú, y á dónde vas? Y ella respondió: Huyo de delante de Sarai, mi señora.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe o anjo do SENHOR: Volta à tua senhora, e põe-te submissa sob a mão dela.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole el ángel de Jehová: Vuélvete á tu señora, y ponte sumisa bajo de su mano.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, I will greatly multiply thy seed, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe também o anjo do SENHOR: Multiplicarei tanto tua linhagem, que não será contada por causa da multidão.
verses.RVR09: Díjole también el ángel de Jehová: Multiplicaré tanto tu linaje, que no será contado á causa de la muchedumbre.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Behold, thou art with child and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the Lord hath heard thy affliction.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son; and thou shalt call his name Ishmael, because Jehovah hath heard thy affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe ainda o anjo do SENHOR: Eis que concebeste, e darás à luz um filho, e chamarás seu nome Ismael, porque o SENHOR ouviu a tua aflição.
verses.RVR09: Díjole aún el ángel de Jehová: He aquí que has concebido, y parirás un hijo, y llamarás su nombre Ismael, porque oído ha Jehová tu aflicción.

verses.KJV: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.WEB: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”
verses.ASV: And he shall be [as] a wild ass among men; his hand [shall be] against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell over against all his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele será homem como um jumento selvagem; sua mão será contra todos, as mãos de todos serão contra ele, e habitará à margem de todos os seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y él será hombre fiero; su mano contra todos, y las manos de todos contra él, y delante de todos sus hermanos habitará.

verses.KJV: And she called the name of the Lord that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
verses.WEB: She called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”
verses.ASV: And she called the name of Jehovah that spake unto her, Thou art a God that seeth: for she said, Have I even here looked after him that seeth me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então chamou o nome do SENHOR que com ela falava: Tu és o Deus da vista; porque disse: Não vi também aqui ao que me vê?
verses.RVR09: Entonces llamó el nombre de Jehová que con ella hablaba: Tú eres el Dios de la vista; porque dijo: ¿No he visto también aquí al que me ve?

verses.KJV: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.WEB: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.ASV: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo qual chamou ao poço, Poço do Vivente que me vê. Eis que está entre Cades e Berede.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual llamó al pozo, Pozo del Viviente que me ve. He aquí está entre Cades y Bered.

verses.KJV: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
verses.WEB: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
verses.ASV: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bare, Ishmael.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Agar deu à luz um filho a Abrão, e Abrão chamou o nome do seu filho que Agar lhe deu à luz Ismael.
verses.RVR09: Y parió Agar á Abram un hijo, y llamó Abram el nombre de su hijo que le parió Agar, Ismael.

verses.KJV: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
verses.WEB: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.ASV: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era Abrão de idade de oitenta e seis anos, quando deu à luz Agar a Ismael.
verses.RVR09: Y era Abram de edad de ochenta y seis años, cuando parió Agar á Ismael.

verses.KJV: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
verses.WEB: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.
verses.ASV: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, Jehovah appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am God Almighty; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Abrão tinha a idade de noventa e nove anos, o SENHOR lhe apareceu, e disse-lhe: Eu sou o Deus Todo-Poderoso; anda diante de mim, e sê íntegro.
verses.RVR09: Y SIENDO Abram de edad de noventa y nueve años, aparecióle Jehová, y le dijo: Yo soy el Dios Todopoderoso; anda delante de mí, y sé perfecto.

verses.KJV: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
verses.WEB: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
verses.ASV: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E constituirei meu pacto entre mim e ti, e te multiplicarei em grandíssima maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré mi pacto entre mí y ti, y multiplicarte he mucho en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
verses.WEB: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
verses.ASV: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abrão prostrou-se com o rosto ao chão, e Deus falou com ele, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abram cayó sobre su rostro, y Dios habló con él diciendo:

verses.KJV: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
verses.WEB: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.ASV: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto a mim, este é o meu pacto contigo: Serás pai de multidão de nações:
verses.RVR09: Yo, he aquí mi pacto contigo: Serás padre de muchedumbre de gentes:

verses.KJV: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
verses.WEB: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.ASV: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for the father of a multitude of nations have I made thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não se chamará mais teu nome Abrão, mas sim que será teu nome Abraão, porque te pus por pai de multidão de nações.
verses.RVR09: Y no se llamará más tu nombre Abram, sino que será tu nombre Abraham, porque te he puesto por padre de muchedumbre de gentes.

verses.KJV: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
verses.WEB: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
verses.ASV: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te multiplicarei muito em grande maneira, e te porei em nações, e reis sairão de ti.
verses.RVR09: Y multiplicarte he mucho en gran manera, y te pondré en gentes, y reyes saldrán de ti.

verses.KJV: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
verses.WEB: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.
verses.ASV: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee and to thy seed after thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estabelecerei meu pacto entre mim e ti, e tua descendência depois de ti em suas gerações, por aliança perpétua, para ser para ti por Deus, e à tua descendência depois de ti.
verses.RVR09: Y estableceré mi pacto entre mí y ti, y tu simiente después de ti en sus generaciones, por alianza perpetua, para serte á ti por Dios, y á tu simiente después de ti.

verses.KJV: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
verses.WEB: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
verses.ASV: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land of thy sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E darei a ti, e à tua descendência depois de ti, a terra de tuas peregrinações, toda a terra de Canaã em herança perpétua; e serei o Deus deles.
verses.RVR09: Y te daré á ti, y á tu simiente después de ti, la tierra de tus peregrinaciones, toda la tierra de Canaán en heredad perpetua; y seré el Dios de ellos.

verses.KJV: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
verses.WEB: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
verses.ASV: And God said unto Abraham, And as for thee, thou shalt keep my covenant, thou, and thy seed after thee throughout their generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse de novo Deus a Abraão: Tu, porém, guardarás meu pacto, tu e tua descendência depois de ti por suas gerações.
verses.RVR09: Dijo de nuevo Dios á Abraham: Tú empero guardarás mi pacto, tú y tu simiente después de ti por sus generaciones.

verses.KJV: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
verses.WEB: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.ASV: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee: every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este será meu pacto, que guardareis entre mim e vós e tua descendência depois de ti: Será circuncidado todo macho dentre vós.
verses.RVR09: Este será mi pacto, que guardaréis entre mí y vosotros y tu simiente después de ti: Será circuncidado todo varón de entre vosotros.

verses.KJV: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
verses.WEB: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
verses.ASV: And ye shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of a covenant betwixt me and you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Circuncidareis, pois, a carne de vosso prepúcio, e será por sinal do pacto entre mim e vós.
verses.RVR09: Circuncidaréis, pues, la carne de vuestro prepucio, y será por señal del pacto entre mí y vosotros.

verses.KJV: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
verses.WEB: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.
verses.ASV: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any foreigner that is not of thy seed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de idade de oito dias será circuncidado todo macho entre vós por vossas gerações: o nascido em casa, e o comprado a dinheiro de qualquer estrangeiro, que não for de tua descendência.
verses.RVR09: Y de edad de ocho días será circuncidado todo varón entre vosotros por vuestras generaciones: el nacido en casa, y el comprado á dinero de cualquier extranjero, que no fuere de tu simiente.

verses.KJV: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.WEB: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.ASV: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deve ser circuncidado o nascido em tua casa, e o comprado por teu dinheiro: e estará meu pacto em vossa carne para aliança perpétua.
verses.RVR09: Debe ser circuncidado el nacido en tu casa, y el comprado por tu dinero: y estará mi pacto en vuestra carne para alianza perpetua.

verses.KJV: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
verses.WEB: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
verses.ASV: And the uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o macho incircunciso que não houver circuncidado a carne de seu prepúcio, aquela pessoa será exterminada de seu povo; violou meu pacto.
verses.RVR09: Y el varón incircunciso que no hubiere circuncidado la carne de su prepucio, aquella persona será borrada de su pueblo; ha violado mi pacto.

verses.KJV: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
verses.WEB: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.
verses.ASV: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse também Deus a Abraão: A Sarai tua mulher não a chamarás Sarai, mas Sara será seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Dijo también Dios á Abraham: A Sarai tu mujer no la llamarás Sarai, mas Sara será su nombre.

verses.KJV: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
verses.WEB: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
