verses.ASV: And I will bless her, and moreover I will give thee a son of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be [a mother of] nations; kings of peoples shall be of her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a abençoarei, e também te darei dela filho; sim, a abençoarei, e virá a ser mãe de nações; dela surgirão reis de povos.
verses.RVR09: Y bendecirla he, y también te daré de ella hijo; sí, la bendeciré, y vendrá á ser madre de naciones; reyes de pueblos serán de ella.

verses.KJV: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
verses.WEB: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
verses.ASV: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is a hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abraão postrou-se com o rosto ao chão, riu, e disse em seu coração: A um homem de cem anos nasceráfilho? E Sara, já de noventa anos, há de dar à luz?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abraham cayó sobre su rostro, y rióse, y dijo en su corazón: ¿A hombre de cien años ha de nacer hijo? ¿y Sara, ya de noventa años, ha de parir?

verses.KJV: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
verses.WEB: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
verses.ASV: And Abraham said unto God, Oh that Ishmael might live before thee!
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Abraão a Deus: Que Ismael viva diante de ti!
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Abraham á Dios: Ojalá Ismael viva delante de ti.

verses.KJV: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
verses.WEB: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.
verses.ASV: And God said, Nay, but Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his seed after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Deus: Certamente Sara tua mulher te dará à luz um filho, e chamarás seu nome Isaque; e confirmarei meu pacto com ele por aliança perpétua para sua descendência depois dele.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Dios: Ciertamente Sara tu mujer te parirá un hijo, y llamarás su nombre Isaac; y confirmaré mi pacto con él por alianza perpetua para su simiente después de él.

verses.KJV: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.WEB: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.ASV: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto a Ismael, também te ouvi; eis que o abençoarei, e lhe farei frutificar e multiplicar em grandíssima maneira; doze príncipes gerará, e dele farei grande nação.
verses.RVR09: Y en cuanto á Ismael, también te he oído: he aquí que le bendeciré, y le haré fructificar y multiplicar mucho en gran manera: doce príncipes engendrará, y ponerlo he por gran gente.

verses.KJV: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
verses.WEB: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
verses.ASV: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas meu pacto estabelecerei com Isaque, ao qual Sara te dará à luz por este tempo no ano seguinte.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo estableceré mi pacto con Isaac, al cual te parirá Sara por este tiempo el año siguiente.

verses.KJV: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.WEB: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
verses.ASV: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acabou de falar com ele, e Deus subiu da presença de Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y acabó de hablar con él, y subió Dios de con Abraham.

verses.KJV: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
verses.WEB: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.
verses.ASV: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomou Abraão a Ismael seu filho, e a todos os servos nascidos em sua casa, e a todos os comprados por seu dinheiro, a todo homem entre os domésticos da casa de Abraão, e circuncidou a carne do prepúcio deles naquele mesmo dia, como Deus lhe havia dito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces tomó Abraham á Ismael su hijo, y á todos los siervos nacidos en su casa, y á todos los comprados por su dinero, á todo varón entre los domésticos de la casa de Abraham, y circuncidó la carne del prepucio de ellos en aquel mismo día, como Dios le había dicho.

verses.KJV: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.WEB: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.ASV: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Era Abraão de idade de noventa e nove anos quando circuncidou a carne de seu prepúcio.
verses.RVR09: Era Abraham de edad de noventa y nueve años cuando circuncidó la carne de su prepucio.

verses.KJV: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.WEB: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.ASV: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ismael seu filho era de treze anos quando foi circuncidada a carne de seu prepúcio.
verses.RVR09: E Ismael su hijo era de trece años, cuando fué circuncidada la carne de su prepucio.

verses.KJV: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
verses.WEB: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
verses.ASV: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: No mesmo dia foi circuncidado Abraão e Ismael seu filho.
verses.RVR09: En el mismo día fué circuncidado Abraham é Ismael su hijo.

verses.KJV: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
verses.WEB: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
verses.ASV: And all the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money of a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os homens de sua casa, o servo nascido em casa, e o comprado por dinheiro do estrangeiro, foram circuncidados com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los varones de su casa, el siervo nacido en casa, y el comprado por dinero del extranjero, fueron circuncidados con él.

verses.KJV: And the Lord appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
verses.WEB: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah appeared unto him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
verses.ALMEIDA: E apareceu-lhe o SENHOR nos carvalhos de Manre, estando ele sentado à porta de sua tenda no calor do dia.
verses.RVR09: Y APARECIÓLE Jehová en el valle de Mamre, estando él sentado á la puerta de su tienda en el calor del día.

verses.KJV: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
verses.WEB: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
verses.ASV: and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood over against him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou seus olhos e olhou, e eis que três homens que estavam junto a ele: e quando os viu, saiu correndo da porta de sua tenda a recebê-los, e inclinou-se até a terra,
verses.RVR09: Y alzó sus ojos y miró, y he aquí tres varones que estaban junto á él: y cuando los vió, salió corriendo de la puerta de su tienda á recibirlos, é inclinóse hacia la tierra,

verses.KJV: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
verses.WEB: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.
verses.ASV: and said, My lord, if now I have found favor in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Senhor, se agora achei favor aos teus olhos, rogo-te que não passes de teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Señor, si ahora he hallado gracia en tus ojos, ruégote que no pases de tu siervo.

verses.KJV: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
verses.WEB: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
verses.ASV: let now a little water be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
verses.ALMEIDA: Que se traga agora um pouco de água, e lavai vossos pés; e recostai-vos debaixo de uma árvore,
verses.RVR09: Que se traiga ahora un poco de agua, y lavad vuestros pies; y recostaos debajo de un árbol,

verses.KJV: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
verses.WEB: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”
verses.ASV: and I will fetch a morsel of bread, and strengthen ye your heart; after that ye shall pass on: forasmuch as ye are come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trarei um bocado de pão, e confortai vosso coração; depois passareis; pois por isso passastes perto de vosso servo.
verses.RVR09: Y traeré un bocado de pan, y sustentad vuestro corazón; después pasaréis: porque por eso habéis pasado cerca de vuestro siervo. Y ellos dijeron: Haz así como has dicho.

verses.KJV: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
verses.WEB: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
verses.ASV: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abraão foi depressa à tenda a Sara, e lhe disse: Toma logo três medidas de boa farinha, amassa e faz pães cozidos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abraham fué de priesa á la tienda á Sara, y le dijo: Toma presto tres medidas de flor de harina, amasa y haz panes cocidos debajo del rescoldo.

verses.KJV: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
verses.WEB: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.
verses.ASV: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it unto the servant; and he hasted to dress it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E correu Abraão às vacas, e tomou um bezerro tenro e bom, e deu-o ao jovem, e deu-se este pressa a prepará-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y corrió Abraham á las vacas, y tomó un becerro tierno y bueno, y diólo al mozo, y dióse éste priesa á aderezarlo.

verses.KJV: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
verses.WEB: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
verses.ASV: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou também manteiga e leite, e o bezerro que havia preparado, e o pôs diante deles; e ele estava junto a eles debaixo da árvore; e comeram.
verses.RVR09: Tomó también manteca y leche, y el becerro que había aderezado, y púsolo delante de ellos; y él estaba junto á ellos debajo del árbol; y comieron.

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
verses.WEB: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe disseram: Onde está Sara tua mulher? E ele respondeu: Aqui na tenda.
verses.RVR09: Y le dijeron: ¿Dónde está Sara tu mujer? Y él respondió: Aquí en la tienda.

verses.KJV: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.WEB: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.ASV: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee when the season cometh round; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse: De certo voltarei a ti segundo o tempo da vida, e eis que Sara, tua mulher, terá um filho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo: De cierto volveré á ti según el tiempo de la vida, y he aquí, tendrá un hijo Sara tu mujer. Y Sara escuchaba á la puerta de la tienda, que estaba detrás de él.

verses.KJV: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
verses.WEB: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
verses.ASV: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, [and] well stricken in age; it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abraão e Sara eram idosos, avançados em dias; a Sara já havia cessado o costume das mulheres.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham y Sara eran viejos, entrados en días: á Sara había cesado ya la costumbre de las mujeres.

verses.KJV: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
verses.WEB: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
verses.ASV: And Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
verses.ALMEIDA: Riu, pois, Sara consigo mesma, dizendo: Depois que envelheci terei prazer, sendo também meu senhor já velho?
verses.RVR09: Rióse, pues, Sara entre sí, diciendo: ¿Después que he envejecido tendré deleite, siendo también mi señor ya viejo?

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, who am old?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Abraão: Por que Sara riu dizendo: Será verdade que darei à luz, sendo já velha?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Abraham: ¿Por qué se ha reído Sara diciendo: Será cierto que he de parir siendo ya vieja?

verses.KJV: Is any thing too hard for the Lord? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.WEB: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”
verses.ASV: Is anything too hard for Jehovah? At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há para Deus alguma coisa difícil? Ao tempo assinalado voltarei a ti, segundo o tempo da vida, e Sara terá um filho.
verses.RVR09: ¿Hay para Dios alguna cosa difícil? Al tiempo señalado volveré á ti, según el tiempo de la vida, y Sara tendrá un hijo.

verses.KJV: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
verses.WEB: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”
verses.ASV: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Sara negou dizendo: Não ri; pois teve medo. Mas ele disse: Não é assim, mas riste.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Sara negó diciendo: No me reí; porque tuvo miedo. Y él dijo: No es así, sino que te has reído.

verses.KJV: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.WEB: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.
verses.ASV: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os homens se levantaram dali, e olharam até Sodoma: e Abraão ia com eles acompanhando-os.
verses.RVR09: Y los varones se levantaron de allí, y miraron hacia Sodoma: y Abraham iba con ellos acompañándolos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, Shall I hide from Abraham that which I do;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse: Encobrirei eu a Abraão o que vou a fazer,
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo: ¿Encubriré yo á Abraham lo que voy á hacer,

verses.KJV: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.WEB: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?
verses.ASV: seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Havendo de ser Abraão em uma nação grande e forte, e havendo de ser benditas nele todas as nações da terra?
verses.RVR09: Habiendo de ser Abraham en una nación grande y fuerte, y habiendo de ser benditas en él todas las gentes de la tierra?

verses.KJV: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the Lord, to do justice and judgment; that the Lord may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
verses.WEB: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”
verses.ASV: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Jehovah, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Jehovah may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu o conheci, sei que mandará a seus filhos e a sua casa depois de si, que guardem o caminho do SENHOR, fazendo justiça e juízo, para que faça vir o SENHOR sobre Abraão o que falou acerca dele.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo lo he conocido, sé que mandará á sus hijos y á su casa después de sí, que guarden el camino de Jehová, haciendo justicia y juicio, para que haga venir Jehová sobre Abraham lo que ha hablado acerca de él.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR lhe disse: Porquanto o clamor de Sodoma e Gomorra se aumenta mais e mais, e o pecado deles se agravou em extremo,
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová le dijo: Por cuanto el clamor de Sodoma y Gomorra se aumenta más y más, y el pecado de ellos se ha agravado en extremo,

verses.KJV: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
verses.WEB: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
verses.ASV: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
verses.ALMEIDA: Descerei agora, e verei se consumaram sua obra segundo o clamor que veio até mim; e se não, eu o saberei.
verses.RVR09: Descenderé ahora, y veré si han consumado su obra según el clamor que ha venido hasta mí; y si no, saberlo he.

verses.KJV: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the Lord.
verses.WEB: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the men turned from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apartaram-se dali os homens, e foram até Sodoma: mas Abraão estava ainda diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y apartáronse de allí los varones, y fueron hacia Sodoma: mas Abraham estaba aún delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.WEB: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
verses.ASV: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou consume the righteous with the wicked?
verses.ALMEIDA: E aproximou-se Abraão e disse: Destruirás também ao justo com o ímpio?
verses.RVR09: Y acercóse Abraham y dijo: ¿Destruirás también al justo con el impío?

verses.KJV: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
verses.WEB: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?
verses.ASV: Peradventure there are fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
verses.ALMEIDA: Talvez haja cinquenta justos dentro da cidade: destruirás também e não perdoarás ao lugar por cinquenta justos que estejam dentro dela?
verses.RVR09: Quizá hay cincuenta justos dentro de la ciudad: ¿destruirás también y no perdonarás al lugar por cincuenta justos que estén dentro de él?

verses.KJV: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
verses.WEB: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”
verses.ASV: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked, that so the righteous should be as the wicked; that be far from thee: shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
verses.ALMEIDA: Longe de ti o fazer tal, que faças morrer ao justo com o ímpio e que seja o justo tratado como o ímpio; nunca faças tal. O juiz de toda a terra, não há de fazer o que é justo?
verses.RVR09: Lejos de ti el hacer tal, que hagas morir al justo con el impío, y que sea el justo tratado como el impío; nunca tal hagas. El juez de toda la tierra, ¿no ha de hacer lo que es justo?

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então respondeu o SENHOR: Se achar em Sodoma cinquenta justos dentro da cidade, perdoarei a todo este lugar por causa deles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió Jehová: Si hallare en Sodoma cincuenta justos dentro de la ciudad, perdonaré á todo este lugar por amor de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
verses.WEB: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
verses.ASV: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, who am but dust and ashes:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão replicou e disse: Eis que agora que comecei a falar a meu Senhor, ainda que sou pó e cinza:
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham replicó y dijo: He aquí ahora que he comenzado á hablar á mi Señor, aunque soy polvo y ceniza:

verses.KJV: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
verses.WEB: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
verses.ASV: peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, I will not destroy it, if I find there forty and five.
verses.ALMEIDA: Talvez faltem de cinquenta justos cinco; destruirás por aqueles cinco toda a cidade? E disse: Não a destruirei, se achar ali quarenta e cinco.
verses.RVR09: Quizá faltarán de cincuenta justos cinco: ¿destruirás por aquellos cinco toda la ciudad? Y dijo: No la destruiré, si hallare allí cuarenta y cinco.

verses.KJV: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.
verses.WEB: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”
verses.ASV: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for the forty’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a falar-lhe, e disse: Talvez se acharão ali quarenta. E respondeu: Não o farei por causa dos quarenta.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á hablarle, y dijo: Quizá se hallarán allí cuarenta. Y respondió: No lo haré por amor de los cuarenta.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
verses.WEB: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Não se ire agora meu Senhor, se falar: talvez se achem ali trinta. E respondeu: Não o farei se achar ali trinta.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: No se enoje ahora mi Señor, si hablare: quizá se hallarán allí treinta. Y respondió: No lo haré si hallare allí treinta.

verses.KJV: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.
verses.WEB: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Eis que agora que me empreendi em falar a meu Senhor: talvez se achem ali vinte. Não a destruirei, respondeu, por causa dos vinte.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: He aquí ahora que he emprendido el hablar á mi Señor: quizá se hallarán allí veinte. No la destruiré, respondió, por amor de los veinte.

verses.KJV: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.
verses.WEB: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a dizer: Não se ire agora meu Senhor, se falar somente uma vez: talvez se achem ali dez. Não a destruirei, respondeu, por causa dos dez.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á decir: No se enoje ahora mi Señor, si hablare solamente una vez: quizá se hallarán allí diez. No la destruiré, respondió, por amor de los diez.

verses.KJV: And the Lord went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
verses.WEB: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah went his way, as soon as he had left off communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi-se o SENHOR, logo que acabou de falar a Abraão: e Abraão se voltou a seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y fuése Jehová, luego que acabó de hablar á Abraham: y Abraham se volvió á su lugar.

verses.KJV: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
verses.WEB: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
verses.ASV: And the two angels came to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face to the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Chegaram, pois, os dois anjos a Sodoma ao cair da tarde; e Ló estava sentado à porta de Sodoma. E vendo-os Ló, levantou-se a recebê-los, e inclinou-se até o chão;
verses.RVR09: LLEGARON, pues, los dos ángeles á Sodoma á la caída de la tarde: y Lot estaba sentado á la puerta de Sodoma. Y viéndolos Lot, levantóse á recibirlos, é inclinóse hacia el suelo;

verses.KJV: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
verses.WEB: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”
verses.ASV: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn aside, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your way. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Agora, pois, meus senhores, vos rogo que venhais à casa de vosso servo e vos hospedeis, e lavareis vossos pés: e pela manhã vos levantareis, e seguireis vosso caminho. E eles responderam: Não, que na praça nos ficaremos esta noite.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Ahora, pues, mis señores, os ruego que vengáis á casa de vuestro siervo y os hospedéis, y lavaréis vuestros pies: y por la mañana os levantaréis, y seguiréis vuestro camino. Y ellos respondieron: No, que en la plaza nos quedaremos esta noche.

verses.KJV: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
verses.WEB: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
verses.ASV: And he urged them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele insistiu com eles muito, e se vieram com ele, e entraram em sua casa; e fez-lhes banquete, e cozeu pães sem levedura e comeram.
verses.RVR09: Mas él porfió con ellos mucho, y se vinieron con él, y entraron en su casa; é hízoles banquete, y coció panes sin levadura, y comieron.

verses.KJV: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
verses.WEB: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
verses.ASV: But before they lay down, the men of the city, [even] the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both young and old, all the people from every quarter;
verses.ALMEIDA: E antes que se deitassem, cercaram a casa os homens da cidade, os homens de Sodoma, todo o povo junto, desde o mais jovem até o mais velho;
verses.RVR09: Y antes que se acostasen, cercaron la casa los hombres de la ciudad, los varones de Sodoma, todo el pueblo junto, desde el más joven hasta el más viejo;

verses.KJV: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
verses.WEB: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”
verses.ASV: and they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men that came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamaram a Ló, e lhe disseram: Onde estão os homens que vieram a ti esta noite? tira-os a nós, para que os conheçamos.
verses.RVR09: Y llamaron á Lot, y le dijeron: ¿Dónde están los varones que vinieron á ti esta noche? sácanoslos, para que los conozcamos.

verses.KJV: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
verses.WEB: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.
verses.ASV: And Lot went out unto them to the door, and shut the door after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Ló saiu a eles à porta, e fechou as portas atrás de si,
verses.RVR09: Entonces Lot salió á ellos á la puerta, y cerró las puertas tras sí,

verses.KJV: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
verses.WEB: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
verses.ASV: And he said, I pray you, my brethren, do not so wickedly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Eu vos rogo, meus irmãos, que não façais tal maldade.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Os ruego, hermanos míos, que no hagáis tal maldad.

verses.KJV: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
verses.WEB: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
verses.ASV: Behold now, I have two daughters that have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing, forasmuch as they are come under the shadow of my roof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui agora eu tenho duas filhas que não conheceram homem; eu as tirarei fora para vós, e fazei delas como bem vos parecer: somente a estes homens não façais nada, pois que vieram à sombra de meu telhado.
verses.RVR09: He aquí ahora yo tengo dos hijas que no han conocido varón; os las sacaré afuera, y haced de ellas como bien os pareciere: solamente á estos varones no hagáis nada, pues que vinieron á la sombra de mi tejado.

verses.KJV: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
verses.WEB: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.
verses.ASV: And they said, Stand back. And they said, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and drew near to break the door.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: Sai daí: e acrescentaram: Veio este aqui para habitar como um estrangeiro, e haverá de levantar-se como juiz? Agora te faremos mais mal que a eles. E faziam grande violência ao homem, a Ló, e se aproximaram para romper as portas.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: Quita allá: y añadieron: Vino éste aquí para habitar como un extraño, ¿y habrá de erigirse en juez? Ahora te haremos más mal que á ellos. Y hacían gran violencia al varón, á Lot, y se acercaron para romper las puertas.

verses.KJV: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
verses.WEB: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.
verses.ASV: But the men put forth their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os homens estenderam a mão, e meteram a Ló em casa com eles, e fecharam as portas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los varones alargaron la mano, y metieron á Lot en casa con ellos, y cerraron las puertas.

verses.KJV: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.WEB: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.ASV: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos homens que estavam à porta da casa desde o menor até o maior, feriram com cegueira; mas eles se cansavam tentando achar a porta.
verses.RVR09: Y á los hombres que estaban á la puerta de la casa desde el menor hasta el mayor, hirieron con ceguera; mas ellos se fatigaban por hallar la puerta.

verses.KJV: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
verses.WEB: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:
verses.ASV: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whomsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of the place:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram os homens a Ló: Tens aqui alguém mais? Genros, e teus filhos e tuas filhas, e tudo o que tens na cidade, tira-o deste lugar:
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron los varones á Lot: ¿Tienes aquí alguno más? Yernos, y tus hijos y tus hijas, y todo lo que tienes en la ciudad, sácalo de este lugar:

verses.KJV: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the Lord; and the Lord hath sent us to destroy it.
verses.WEB: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it.”
verses.ASV: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxed great before Jehovah; and Jehovah hath sent us to destroy it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vamos destruir este lugar, porquanto o clamor deles subiu demais diante do SENHOR; portanto o SENHOR nos enviou para destruí-lo.
verses.RVR09: Porque vamos á destruir este lugar, por cuanto el clamor de ellos ha subido de punto delante de Jehová; por tanto Jehová nos ha enviado para destruirlo.

verses.KJV: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the Lord will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
verses.WEB: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.
verses.ASV: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for Jehovah will destroy the city. But he seemed unto his sons-in-law as one that mocked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então saiu Ló, e falou a seus genros, os que haviam de se casar com suas filhas, e lhes disse: Levantai-vos, saí deste lugar; porque o SENHOR vai destruir esta cidade. Mas pareceu a seus genros como que se ridicularizava.
verses.RVR09: Entonces salió Lot, y habló á sus yernos, los que habían de tomar sus hijas, y les dijo: Levantaos, salid de este lugar; porque Jehová va á destruir esta ciudad. Mas pareció á sus yernos como que se burlaba.

verses.KJV: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
verses.WEB: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”
verses.ASV: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters that are here, lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao raiar a alva, os anjos davam pressa a Ló, dizendo: Levanta-te, toma tua mulher, e teus dois filhas que se acham aqui, para que não pereças no castigo da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y al rayar el alba, los ángeles daban prisa á Lot, diciendo: Levántate, toma tu mujer, y tus dos hijas que se hallan aquí, porque no perezcas en el castigo de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the Lord being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
verses.WEB: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.
verses.ASV: But he lingered; and the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters, Jehovah being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E demorando-se ele, os homens pegaram por sua mão, e pela mão de sua mulher, e pelas mãos de suas duas filhas segundo a misericórdia do SENHOR para com ele; e o tiraram, e o puseram fora da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y deteniéndose él, los varones asieron de su mano, y de la mano de su mujer, y de las manos de sus dos hijas, según la misericordia de Jehová para con él; y le sacaron, y le pusieron fuera de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
verses.WEB: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the Plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que quando os tirou fora, disse: Escapa por tua vida; não olhes atrás de ti, nem pares toda esta planície; escapa ao monte, não seja que pereças.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que cuando los hubo sacado fuera, dijo: Escapa por tu vida; no mires tras ti, ni pares en toda esta llanura; escapa al monte, no sea que perezcas.

verses.KJV: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:
verses.WEB: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.
verses.ASV: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my lord:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ló lhes disse: Não, eu vos rogo, senhores meus;
verses.RVR09: Y Lot les dijo: No, yo os ruego, señores míos;

verses.KJV: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
verses.WEB: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
verses.ASV: behold now, thy servant hath found favor in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy lovingkindness, which thou hast showed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que agora achou teu servo favor em teus olhos, e engrandeceste tua misericórdia que fizeste comigo dando-me a vida; mas eu não poderei escapar ao monte, não seja caso que me alcance o mal e morra.
verses.RVR09: He aquí ahora ha hallado tu siervo gracia en tus ojos, y has engrandecido tu misericordia que has hecho conmigo dándome la vida; mas yo no podré escapar al monte, no sea caso que me alcance el mal, y muera.

verses.KJV: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
verses.WEB: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
verses.ASV: behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape thither (is it not a little one?), and my soul shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que agora esta cidade está próxima para fugir ali, a qual é pequena; escaparei agora ali, (não é ela pequena?) e viverá minha alma.
verses.RVR09: He aquí ahora esta ciudad está cerca para huir allá, la cual es pequeña; escaparé ahora allá, (¿no es ella pequeña?) y vivirá mi alma.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which thou hast spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe respondeu: Eis que recebi também tua súplica sobre isto, e não destruirei a cidade de que falaste.
verses.RVR09: Y le respondió: He aquí he recibido también tu súplica sobre esto, y no destruiré la ciudad de que has hablado.

verses.KJV: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.WEB: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.ASV: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apressa-te, escapa-te ali; porque nada poderei fazer até que ali tenhas chegado. Por isto foi chamado o nome da cidade, Zoar.
verses.RVR09: Date priesa, escápate allá; porque nada podré hacer hasta que allí hayas llegado. Por esto fué llamado el nombre de la ciudad, Zoar.

verses.KJV: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
verses.WEB: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
verses.ASV: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot came unto Zoar.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sol saía sobre a terra, quando Ló chegou a Zoar.
verses.RVR09: El sol salía sobre la tierra, cuando Lot llegó á Zoar.

verses.KJV: Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven;
verses.WEB: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky.
verses.ASV: Then Jehovah rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Jehovah out of heaven;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então choveu o SENHOR sobre Sodoma e sobre Gomorra enxofre e fogo da parte do SENHOR desde os céus;
verses.RVR09: Entonces llovió Jehová sobre Sodoma y sobre Gomorra azufre y fuego de parte de Jehová desde los cielos;

verses.KJV: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
verses.WEB: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
verses.ASV: and he overthrew those cities, and all the Plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E destruiu as cidades, e toda aquela planície, com todos os moradores daquelas cidades, e o fruto da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y destruyó las ciudades, y toda aquella llanura, con todos los moradores de aquellas ciudades, y el fruto de la tierra.

verses.KJV: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.WEB: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.ASV: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a mulher de Ló olhou atrás, às costas dele, e se tornou estátua de sai.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la mujer de Lot miró atrás, á espaldas de él, y se volvió estatua de sal.

verses.KJV: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the Lord:
verses.WEB: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu Abraão pela manhã ao lugar onde havia estado diante do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Y subió Abraham por la mañana al lugar donde había estado delante de Jehová:

verses.KJV: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.WEB: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.ASV: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the Plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhou até Sodoma e Gomorra, e até toda a terra daquela planície olhou; e eis que a fumaça subia da terra como a fumaça de um forno.
verses.RVR09: Y miró hacia Sodoma y Gomorra, y hacia toda la tierra de aquella llanura miró; y he aquí que el humo subía de la tierra como el humo de un horno.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
verses.WEB: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the Plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim foi que, quando destruiu Deus as cidades da planície, lembrou-se Deus de Abraão, e enviou fora a Ló do meio da destruição, ao assolar as cidades onde Ló estava.
verses.RVR09: Así fué que, cuando destruyó Dios las ciudades de la llanura, acordóse Dios de Abraham, y envió fuera á Lot de en medio de la destrucción, al asolar las ciudades donde Lot estaba.

verses.KJV: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.WEB: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
verses.ASV: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Ló subiu de Zoar, e assentou no monte, e suas duas filhas com ele; porque teve medo de ficar em Zoar, e se abrigou em uma caverna ele e suas duas filhas.
verses.RVR09: Empero Lot subió de Zoar, y asentó en el monte, y sus dos hijas con él; porque tuvo miedo de quedar en Zoar, y se alojó en una cueva él y sus dos hijas.

verses.KJV: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
verses.WEB: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
verses.ASV: And the first-born said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a maior disse à menor: Nosso pai é velho, e não resta homem na terra que entre a nós conforme o costume de toda a terra:
verses.RVR09: Entonces la mayor dijo á la menor: Nuestro padre es viejo, y no queda varón en la tierra que entre á nosotras conforme á la costumbre de toda la tierra:

verses.KJV: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.WEB: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
verses.ASV: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vem, demos a beber vinho a nosso pai, e durmamos com ele, e conservaremos de nosso pai geração.
verses.RVR09: Ven, demos á beber vino á nuestro padre, y durmamos con él, y conservaremos de nuestro padre generación.

verses.KJV: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.WEB: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.ASV: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the first-born went in, and lay with her father; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram a beber vinho a seu pai aquela noite: e entrou a maior, e dormiu com seu pai; mas ele não sentiu quando se deitou com ela nem quando se levantou.
verses.RVR09: Y dieron á beber vino á su padre aquella noche: y entró la mayor, y durmió con su padre; mas él no sintió cuándo se acostó ella, ni cuándo se levantó.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.WEB: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the first-born said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.ALMEIDA: O dia seguinte disse a maior à menor: Eis que eu dormi a noite passada com meu pai; demos a ele de beber vinho também esta noite, e entra e dorme com ele, para que conservemos de nosso pai geração.
verses.RVR09: El día siguiente dijo la mayor á la menor: He aquí yo dormí la noche pasada con mi padre; démosle á beber vino también esta noche, y entra y duerme con él, para que conservemos de nuestro padre generación.

verses.KJV: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.WEB: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.
verses.ASV: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram a beber vinho a seu pai também aquela noite: e levantou-se a menor, e dormiu com ele; mas não conseguiu perceber quando se deitou com ela, nem quando se levantou.
verses.RVR09: Y dieron á beber vino á su padre también aquella noche: y levantóse la menor, y durmió con él; pero no echó de ver cuándo se acostó ella, ni cuándo se levantó.

verses.KJV: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
verses.WEB: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.
verses.ASV: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E conceberam as duas filhas de Ló, de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y concibieron las dos hijas de Lot, de su padre.

verses.KJV: And the first born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
verses.WEB: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
verses.ASV: And the first-born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu à luz a maior um filho, e chamou seu nome Moabe, o qual é pai dos moabitas até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y parió la mayor un hijo, y llamó su nombre Moab, el cual es padre de los Moabitas hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
verses.WEB: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
verses.ASV: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: A menor também deu à luz um filho, e chamou seu nome Ben-Ami, o qual é pai dos amonitas até hoje.
verses.RVR09: La menor también parió un hijo, y llamó su nombre Ben-ammí, el cual es padre de los Ammonitas hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
verses.WEB: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
verses.ASV: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the land of the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur; and he sojourned in Gerar.
verses.ALMEIDA: De ali partiu Abraão à terra do Sul, e assentou entre Cades e Sur, e habitou como peregrino em Gerar.
verses.RVR09: DE allí partió Abraham á la tierra del Mediodía, y asentó entre Cades y Shur, y habitó como forastero en Gerar.

verses.KJV: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.WEB: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.ASV: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Abraão de Sara sua mulher: É minha irmã. E Abimeleque, rei de Gerar, enviou e tomou a Sara.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Abraham de Sara su mujer: Mi hermana es. Y Abimelech, rey de Gerar, envió y tomó á Sara.

verses.KJV: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
verses.WEB: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”
verses.ASV: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, because of the woman whom thou hast taken; for she is a man’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Deus veio a Abimeleque em sonhos de noite, e lhe disse: Eis que morto és por causa da mulher que tomaste, a qual é casada com marido.
verses.RVR09: Empero Dios vino á Abimelech en sueños de noche, y le dijo: He aquí muerto eres á causa de la mujer que has tomado, la cual es casada con marido.

verses.KJV: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
verses.WEB: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?
verses.ASV: Now Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay even a righteous nation?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Abimeleque não havia chegado a ela, e disse: Senhor, matarás também a gente justa?
verses.RVR09: Mas Abimelech no había llegado á ella, y dijo: Señor, ¿matarás también la gente justa?

verses.KJV: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
verses.WEB: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
verses.ASV: Said he not himself unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and the innocency of my hands have I done this.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me disse ele: É minha irmã; e ela também disse: É meu irmão? Com sinceridade de meu coração, e com limpeza de minhas mãos fiz isto.
verses.RVR09: ¿No me dijo él: Mi hermana es; y ella también dijo: Es mi hermano? Con sencillez de mi corazón, y con limpieza de mis manos he hecho esto.

verses.KJV: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
verses.WEB: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.
verses.ASV: And God said unto him in the dream, Yea, I know that in the integrity of thy heart thou hast done this, and I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Deus em sonhos: Eu também sei que com integridade de teu coração fizeste isto; e eu também te detive de pecar contra mim, e assim não te permiti que a tocasses.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Dios en sueños: Yo también sé que con integridad de tu corazón has hecho esto; y yo también te detuve de pecar contra mí, y así no te permití que la tocases.

verses.KJV: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore restore the man’s wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, devolve a mulher a seu marido; porque é profeta, e orará por ti, e viverás. E se tu não a devolveres, sabe que certamente morrerás, com tudo o que for teu.
verses.RVR09: Ahora, pues, vuelve la mujer á su marido; porque es profeta, y orará por ti, y vivirás. Y si tú no la volvieres, sabe que de cierto morirás, con todo lo que fuere tuyo.

verses.KJV: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
verses.WEB: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abimeleque se levantou de manhã, e chamou a todos os seus servos, e disse todas estas palavras aos ouvidos deles; e temeram os homens em grande maneira.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abimelech se levantó de mañana, y llamó á todos sus siervos, y dijo todas estas palabras en los oídos de ellos; y temieron los hombres en gran manera.

verses.KJV: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
verses.WEB: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”
verses.ASV: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and wherein have I sinned against thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois chamou Abimeleque a Abraão e lhe disse: Que nos fizeste? e em que pequei eu contra ti, que atraíste sobre mim e sobre meu reino tão grande pecado? o que não devias fazer fizeste comigo.
verses.RVR09: Después llamó Abimelech á Abraham, y le dijo: ¿Qué nos has hecho? ¿y en qué pequé yo contra ti, que has atraído sobre mí y sobre mi reino tan gran pecado? lo que no debiste hacer has hecho conmigo.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
verses.WEB: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse mais Abimeleque a Abraão: Que viste para que fizesses isto?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo más Abimelech á Abraham: ¿Qué viste para que hicieses esto?

verses.KJV: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
verses.WEB: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
verses.ASV: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão respondeu: Porque disse para mim: Certamente não há temor de Deus neste lugar, e me matarão por causa de minha mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham respondió: Porque dije para mí: Cierto no hay temor de Dios en este lugar, y me matarán por causa de mi mujer.

verses.KJV: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.WEB: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.ASV: And moreover she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife:
verses.ALMEIDA: E na verdade também é minha irmã, filha de meu pai, mas não filha de minha mãe, e tomei-a por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y á la verdad también es mi hermana, hija de mi padre, mas no hija de mi madre, y toméla por mujer.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
verses.WEB: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
verses.ASV: and it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt show unto me: at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que, quando Deus me fez sair sem rumo da casa de meu pai, eu lhe disse: Esta é a lealdade que tu me farás, que em todos os lugares onde chegarmos, digas de mim: É meu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que, cuando Dios me hizo salir errante de la casa de mi padre, yo le dije: Esta es la merced que tú me harás, que en todos los lugares donde llegáremos, digas de mí: Mi hermano es.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
verses.WEB: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abimeleque tomou ovelhas e vacas, e servos e servas, e deu-o a Abraão, e devolveu-lhe a Sara sua mulher.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abimelech tomó ovejas y vacas, y siervos y siervas, y diólo á Abraham, y devolvióle á Sara su mujer.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
verses.WEB: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Abimeleque: Eis que minha terra está diante de ti, habita onde bem te parecer.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Abimelech: He aquí mi tierra está delante de ti, habita donde bien te pareciere.

verses.KJV: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
verses.WEB: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”
verses.ASV: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, it is for thee a covering of the eyes to all that are with thee; and in respect of all thou art righted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Sara disse: Eis que dei mil moedas de prata a teu irmão; olha que ele te é por véu de olhos para todos os que estão contigo, e para com todos: assim foi repreendida.
verses.RVR09: Y á Sara dijo: He aquí he dado mil monedas de plata á tu hermano; mira que él te es por velo de ojos para todos los que están contigo, y para con todos: así fué reprendida.

verses.KJV: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
verses.WEB: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.
verses.ASV: And Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maid-servants; and they bare children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abraão orou a Deus; e Deus sanou a Abimeleque e a sua mulher, e a suas servas, e voltaram a ter filhos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abraham oró á Dios; y Dios sanó á Abimelech y á su mujer, y á sus siervas, y parieron.

verses.KJV: For the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
verses.WEB: For the LORD had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque havia por completo fechado o SENHOR toda madre da casa de Abimeleque, por causa de Sara, mulher de Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Porque había del todo cerrado Jehová toda matriz de la casa de Abimelech, á causa de Sara mujer de Abraham.

verses.KJV: And the Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.WEB: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah visited Sarah as he had said, and Jehovah did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR visitou Sara, como disse, e o SENHOR fez com Sara como havia falado.
verses.RVR09: Y VISITÓ Jehová á Sara, como había dicho, é hizo Jehová con Sara como había hablado.

verses.KJV: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.WEB: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.ASV: And Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu e deu à luz Sara a Abraão um filho em sua velhice, no tempo que Deus lhe havia dito.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió y parió Sara á Abraham un hijo en su vejez, en el tiempo que Dios le había dicho.

verses.KJV: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
verses.WEB: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
verses.ASV: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Abraão o nome de seu filho que lhe nasceu, que lhe deu à luz Sara, Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Abraham el nombre de su hijo que le nació, que le parió Sara, Isaac.

verses.KJV: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.WEB: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.ASV: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E circuncidou Abraão a seu filho Isaque de oito dias, como Deus lhe havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: Y circuncidó Abraham á su hijo Isaac de ocho días, como Dios le había mandado.

verses.KJV: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
verses.WEB: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
verses.ASV: And Abraham was a hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era Abraão de cem anos, quando lhe nasceu Isaque seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y era Abraham de cien años, cuando le nació Isaac su hijo.

verses.KJV: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
verses.WEB: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
verses.ASV: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh; every one that heareth will laugh with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Sara: Deus me fez rir, e qualquer um que o ouvir, se rirá comigo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Sara: Dios me ha hecho reir, y cualquiera que lo oyere, se reirá conmigo.

verses.KJV: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
verses.WEB: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
verses.ASV: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should give children suck? for I have borne him a son in his old age.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acrescentou: Quem diria a Abraão que Sara havia de dar de mamar a filhos? pois que lhe dei um filho em sua velhice.
verses.RVR09: Y añadió: ¿Quién dijera á Abraham que Sara había de dar de mamar á hijos? pues que le he parido un hijo á su vejez.

verses.KJV: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.WEB: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.ASV: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cresceu o menino, e foi desmamado; e fez Abraão grande banquete no dia que foi desmamado Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Y creció el niño, y fué destetado; é hizo Abraham gran banquete el día que fué destetado Isaac.

verses.KJV: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
verses.WEB: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
verses.ASV: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne unto Abraham, mocking.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu Sara ao filho de Agar a egípcia, o qual havia esta dado a Abraão, que o ridicularizava.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Sara al hijo de Agar la Egipcia, el cual había ésta parido á Abraham, que se burlaba.

verses.KJV: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
verses.WEB: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this handmaid and her son: for the son of this handmaid shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto disse a Abraão: Expulsa a esta serva e a seu filho; que o filho desta serva não herdará com meu filho, com Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto dijo á Abraham: Echa á esta sierva y á su hijo; que el hijo de esta sierva no ha de heredar con mi hijo, con Isaac.

verses.KJV: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
verses.WEB: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
verses.ASV: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este dito pareceu grave em grande maneira a Abraão por causa de seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Este dicho pareció grave en gran manera á Abraham á causa de su hijo.
