verses.KJV: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.WEB: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.
verses.ASV: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy handmaid; in all that Sarah saith unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Deus a Abraão: Não te pareça grave por causa do jovem e de tua serva; em tudo o que te disser Sara, ouve sua voz, porque em Isaque será chamada tua descendência.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Dios á Abraham: No te parezca grave á causa del muchacho y de tu sierva; en todo lo que te dijere Sara, oye su voz, porque en Isaac te será llamada descendencia.

verses.KJV: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
verses.WEB: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
verses.ASV: And also of the son of the handmaid will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também do filho da serva farei nação, porque é descendência tua.
verses.RVR09: Y también al hijo de la sierva pondré en gente, porque es tu simiente.

verses.KJV: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.WEB: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.ASV: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and [gave her] the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abraão se levantou manhã muito cedo, e tomou pão, e um odre de água, e deu-o a Agar, pondo-o sobre seu ombro, e entregou-lhe o jovem, e despediu-a. E ela partiu, e andava errante pelo deserto de Berseba.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abraham se levantó muy de mañana, y tomó pan, y un odre de agua, y diólo á Agar, poniéndolo sobre su hombro, y entrególe el muchacho, y despidióla. Y ella partió, y andaba errante por el desierto de Beer-seba.

verses.KJV: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.WEB: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.ASV: And the water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E faltou a água do odre, e deitou ao jovem debaixo de uma árvore;
verses.RVR09: Y faltó el agua del odre, y echó al muchacho debajo de un árbol;

verses.KJV: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bow shot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
verses.WEB: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
verses.ASV: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not look upon the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi-se e sentou-se em frente, afastando-se como um tiro de arco; porque dizia: Não verei quando o jovem morrer: e sentou-se em frente, e levantou sua voz e chorou.
verses.RVR09: Y fuése y sentóse enfrente, alejándose como un tiro de arco; porque decía: No veré cuando el muchacho morirá: y sentóse enfrente, y alzó su voz y lloró.

verses.KJV: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
verses.WEB: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
verses.ASV: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Deus a voz do jovem; e o anjo de Deus chamou a Agar desde o céu, e lhe disse: Que tens, Agar? Não temas; porque Deus ouviu a voz do jovem onde está.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Dios la voz del muchacho; y el ángel de Dios llamó á Agar desde el cielo, y le dijo: ¿Qué tienes, Agar? No temas; porque Dios ha oído la voz del muchacho en donde está.

verses.KJV: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
verses.WEB: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
verses.ASV: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thy hand; for I will make him a great nation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, ergue ao jovem, e pegue-o por tua mão, porque farei dele uma grande nação.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, alza al muchacho, y ásele de tu mano, porque en gran gente lo tengo de poner.

verses.KJV: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.WEB: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.
verses.ASV: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então abriu Deus os olhos dela, e ela viu uma fonte de água; e foi, e encheu o odre de água, e deu de beber ao jovem.
verses.RVR09: Entonces abrió Dios sus ojos, y vió una fuente de agua; y fué, y llenó el odre de agua, y dió de beber al muchacho.

verses.KJV: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.WEB: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.
verses.ASV: And God was with the lad, and he grew; and he dwelt in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi Deus com o jovem; e cresceu, e habitou no deserto, e foi atirador de arco.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Dios con el muchacho; y creció, y habitó en el desierto, y fué tirador de arco.

verses.KJV: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitou no deserto de Parã; e sua mãe lhe tomou mulher da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y habitó en el desierto de Parán; y su madre le tomó mujer de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
verses.WEB: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu naquele mesmo tempo que falou Abimeleque, e Ficol, príncipe de seu exército, a Abraão dizendo: Deus é contigo em tudo quanto fazes.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció en aquel mismo tiempo que habló Abimelech, y Phicol, príncipe de su ejército, á Abraham diciendo: Dios es contigo en todo cuanto haces:

verses.KJV: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
verses.WEB: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”
verses.ASV: now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, jura-me aqui por Deus, que não tratarás com falsidade a mim, nem a meu filho, nem a meu neto; mas sim que conforme a bondade que eu fiz contigo, farás tu comigo e com a terra onde peregrinaste.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, júrame aquí por Dios, que no faltarás á mí, ni á mi hijo, ni á mi nieto; sino que conforme á la bondad que yo hice contigo, harás tú conmigo, y con la tierra donde has peregrinado.

verses.KJV: And Abraham said, I will swear.
verses.WEB: Abraham said, “I will swear.”
verses.ASV: And Abraham said, I will swear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Abraão: Eu jurarei.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Abraham: Yo juraré.

verses.KJV: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
verses.WEB: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
verses.ASV: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of the well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão reclamou com Abimeleque por causa de um poço de água, que os servos de Abimeleque lhe haviam tirado.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham reconvino á Abimelech á causa de un pozo de agua, que los siervos de Abimelech le habían quitado.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing; neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
verses.WEB: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech said, I know not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to-day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Abimeleque: Não sei quem tenha feito isto, nem tampouco tu me fizeste saber, nem eu o ouvi até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Abimelech: No sé quién haya hecho esto, ni tampoco tú me lo hiciste saber, ni yo lo he oído hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
verses.WEB: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.
verses.ASV: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and they two made a covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Abraão ovelhas e vacas, e deu a Abimeleque; e fizeram ambos aliança.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Abraham ovejas y vacas, y dió á Abimelech; é hicieron ambos alianza.

verses.KJV: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.WEB: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.ASV: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs Abraão sete cordeiras do rebanho à parte.
verses.RVR09: Y puso Abraham siete corderas del rebaño aparte.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
verses.WEB: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Abimeleque a Abraão: Que significam essas sete cordeiras que puseste à parte?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Abimelech á Abraham: ¿Qué significan esas siete corderas que has puesto aparte?

verses.KJV: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
verses.WEB: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”
verses.ASV: And he said, These seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that it may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Que estas sete cordeiras tomarás de minha mão, para que me sejam em testemunho de que eu cavei este poço.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Que estas siete corderas tomarás de mi mano, para que me sean en testimonio de que yo cavé este pozo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
verses.WEB: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
verses.ASV: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isto chamou a aquele lugar Berseba; porque ali ambos juraram.
verses.RVR09: Por esto llamó á aquel lugar Beer-seba; porque allí juraron ambos.

verses.KJV: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.WEB: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.ASV: So they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: and Abimelech rose up, and Phicol the captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim fizeram aliança em Berseba: e levantaram-se Abimeleque e Ficol, príncipe de seu exército, e se voltaram à terra dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: Así hicieron alianza en Beer-seba: y levantóse Abimelech, y Phicol, príncipe de su ejército, y se volvieron á tierra de los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.
verses.WEB: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.
verses.ASV: And [Abraham] planted a tamarisk tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of Jehovah, the Everlasting God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E plantou Abraão um bosque em Berseba, e invocou ali o nome do SENHOR Deus eterno.
verses.RVR09: Y plantó Abraham un bosque en Beer-seba, é invocó allí el nombre de Jehová Dios eterno.

verses.KJV: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
verses.WEB: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
verses.ASV: And Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morou Abraão na terra dos filisteus por muitos dias.
verses.RVR09: Y moró Abraham en tierra de los Filisteos muchos días.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
verses.WEB: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that God did prove Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham; and he said, Here am I.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, depois dessas coisas, que Deus provou Abraão, e disse-lhe: Abraão. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ después de estas cosas, que tentó Dios á Abraham, y le dijo: Abraham. Y él respondió: Heme aquí.

verses.KJV: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
verses.WEB: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son, whom thou lovest, even Isaac, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt-offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Toma agora teu filho, teu único, Isaque, a quem amas, e vai à terra de Moriá, e oferece-o ali em holocausto sobre um dos montes que eu te direi.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Toma ahora tu hijo, tu único, Isaac, á quien amas, y vete á tierra de Moriah, y ofrécelo allí en holocausto sobre uno de los montes que yo te diré.

verses.KJV: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
verses.WEB: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
verses.ASV: And Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he clave the wood for the burnt-offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão se levantou manhã muito cedo, e preparou seu asno, e tomou consigo dois servos seus, e a Isaque seu filho: e cortou lenha para o holocausto, e levantou-se, e foi ao lugar que Deus lhe disse.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham se levantó muy de mañana, y enalbardó su asno, y tomó consigo dos mozos suyos, y á Isaac su hijo: y cortó leña para el holocausto, y levantóse, y fué al lugar que Dios le dijo.

verses.KJV: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.WEB: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
verses.ASV: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao terceiro dia levantou Abraão seus olhos, e viu o lugar de longe.
verses.RVR09: Al tercer día alzó Abraham sus ojos, y vió el lugar de lejos.

verses.KJV: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
verses.WEB: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”
verses.ASV: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass, and I and the lad will go yonder; and we will worship, and come again to you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Abraão a seus servos: Esperai aqui com o asno, e eu e o jovem iremos até ali, e adoraremos, e voltaremos a vós.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Abraham á sus mozos: Esperaos aquí con el asno, y yo y el muchacho iremos hasta allí, y adoraremos, y volveremos á vosotros.

verses.KJV: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.WEB: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.
verses.ASV: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took in his hand the fire and the knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Abraão a lenha do holocausto, e a pôs sobre Isaque seu filho: e ele tomou em sua mão o fogo e a espada; e foram ambos juntos.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Abraham la leña del holocausto, y púsola sobre Isaac su hijo: y él tomó en su mano el fuego y el cuchillo; y fueron ambos juntos.

verses.KJV: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
verses.WEB: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
verses.ASV: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold, the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt-offering?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então falou Isaque a Abraão seu pai, e disse: Meu pai. e ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, meu filho. E ele disse: Eis aqui o fogo e a lenha; mas onde está o cordeiro para o holocausto?
verses.RVR09: Entonces habló Isaac á Abraham su padre, y dijo: Padre mío. Y él respondió: Heme aquí, mi hijo. Y él dijo: He aquí el fuego y la leña; mas ¿dónde está el cordero para el holocausto?

verses.KJV: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
verses.WEB: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
verses.ASV: And Abraham said, God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son: so they went both of them together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Abraão: Deus se proverá de cordeiro para o holocausto, filho meu. E iam juntos.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Abraham: Dios se proveerá de cordero para el holocausto, hijo mío. E iban juntos.

verses.KJV: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
verses.WEB: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
verses.ASV: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegaram ao lugar que Deus lhe havia dito, edificou ali Abraão um altar, e compôs a lenha, e amarrou a Isaque seu filho, e pôs-lhe no altar sobre a lenha.
verses.RVR09: Y como llegaron al lugar que Dios le había dicho, edificó allí Abraham un altar, y compuso la leña, y ató á Isaac su hijo, y púsole en el altar sobre la leña.

verses.KJV: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.WEB: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
verses.ASV: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estendeu Abraão sua mão, e tomou a espada, para degolar a seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y extendió Abraham su mano, y tomó el cuchillo, para degollar á su hijo.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o anjo do SENHOR lhe gritou do céu, e disse: Abraão, Abraão. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el ángel de Jehová le dió voces del cielo, y dijo: Abraham, Abraham. Y él respondió: Heme aquí.

verses.KJV: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
verses.WEB: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do thou anything unto him; for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son, from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Não estendas tua mão sobre o jovem, nem lhe faças nada; que já conheço que temes a Deus, pois que não me recusaste o teu filho, o teu único;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: No extiendas tu mano sobre el muchacho, ni le hagas nada; que ya conozco que temes á Dios, pues que no me rehusaste tu hijo, tu único.

verses.KJV: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
verses.WEB: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
verses.ASV: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, behind [him] a ram caught in the thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então levantou Abraão seus olhos, e olhou, e eis um carneiro a suas costas preso em um arbusto por seus chifres: e foi Abraão, e tomou o carneiro, e ofereceu-lhe em holocausto em lugar de seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces alzó Abraham sus ojos, y miró, y he aquí un carnero á sus espaldas trabado en un zarzal por sus cuernos: y fué Abraham, y tomó el carnero, y ofrecióle en holocausto en lugar de su hijo.

verses.KJV: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the Lord it shall be seen.
verses.WEB: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”
verses.ASV: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of Jehovah it shall be provided.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Abraão o nome daquele lugar, O SENHOR proverá. Portanto se diz hoje: No monte do SENHOR se proverá.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Abraham el nombre de aquel lugar, Jehová proveerá. Por tanto se dice hoy: En el monte de Jehová será provisto.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah called unto Abraham a second time out of heaven,
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou o anjo do SENHOR a Abraão segunda vez desde o céu,
verses.RVR09: Y llamó el ángel de Jehová á Abraham segunda vez desde el cielo,

verses.KJV: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
verses.WEB: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
verses.ASV: and said, By myself have I sworn, saith Jehovah, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son,
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Por mim mesmo jurei, diz o SENHOR, que porquanto fizeste isto, e não me recusaste teu filho, teu único;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Por mí mismo he jurado, dice Jehová, que por cuanto has hecho esto, y no me has rehusado tu hijo, tu único;

verses.KJV: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
verses.WEB: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.
verses.ASV: that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heavens, and as the sand which is upon the sea-shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
verses.ALMEIDA: certamente te abençoarei, e multiplicarei tua descendência como as estrelas do céu, e como a areia que está na beira do mar; e tua descendência possuirá as portas de seus inimigos:
verses.RVR09: Bendiciendo te bendeciré, y multiplicando multiplicaré tu simiente como las estrellas del cielo, y como la arena que está á la orilla del mar; y tu simiente poseerá las puertas de sus enemigos:

verses.KJV: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
verses.WEB: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”
verses.ASV: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tua descendência serão abençoadas todas as nações da terra, porquanto obedeceste à minha voz.
verses.RVR09: En tu simiente serán benditas todas las gentes de la tierra, por cuanto obedeciste á mi voz.

verses.KJV: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
verses.WEB: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
verses.ASV: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou Abraão a seus servos, e levantaram-se e se foram juntos a Berseba; e habitou Abraão em Berseba.
verses.RVR09: Y tornóse Abraham á sus mozos, y levantáronse y se fueron juntos á Beer-seba; y habitó Abraham en Beer-seba.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
verses.WEB: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she also hath borne children unto thy brother Nahor:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu depois destas coisas, que foi dada notícia a Abraão, dizendo: Eis que também Milca havia dado à luz filhos a teu irmão Naor:
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció después de estas cosas, que fué dada nueva á Abraham, diciendo: He aquí que también Milca ha parido hijos á Nachôr tu hermano:

verses.KJV: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.WEB: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.ASV: Uz his first-born, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.ALMEIDA: A Uz, seu primogênito, e a Buz, seu irmão, e a Quemuel, pai de Arã.
verses.RVR09: A Huz su primogénito, y á Buz su hermano, y á Kemuel padre de Aram,

verses.KJV: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
verses.WEB: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
verses.ASV: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Quésede, e a Hazo, e a Pildas, e a Jidlafe, e a Betuel.
verses.RVR09: Y á Chêsed, y á Hazo, y á Pildas, y á Jidlaph, y á Bethuel.

verses.KJV: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
verses.WEB: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
verses.ASV: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight did Milcah bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Betuel gerou Rebeca. Milca deu à luz estes oito de Naor, irmão de Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y Bethuel engendró á Rebeca. Estos ocho parió Milca á Nachôr, hermano de Abraham.

verses.KJV: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
verses.WEB: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.ASV: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she also bare Tebah, and Gaham, and Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua concubina, que se chamava Reumá, deu à luz também a Tebá, e a Gaã, e a Taás, e a Maaca.
verses.RVR09: Y su concubina, que se llamaba Reúma, parió también á Teba, y á Gaham, y á Taas, y á Maachâ.

verses.KJV: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.WEB: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
verses.ASV: And the life of Sarah was a hundred and seven and twenty years: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a vida de Sara cento e vinte e sete anos; estes foram os anos da vida de Sara.
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ la vida de Sara ciento veintisiete años: tantos fueron los años de la vida de Sara.

verses.KJV: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.WEB: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.ASV: And Sarah died in Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron), in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Sara em Quiriate-Arba, que é Hebrom, na terra de Canaã; e Abraão veio para ficar de luto por Sara e para chorar por ela.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Sara en Kiriath-arba, que es Hebrón, en la tierra de Canaán: y vino Abraham á hacer el duelo á Sara, y á llorarla.

verses.KJV: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.WEB: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,
verses.ASV: And Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spake unto the children of Heth, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se Abraão de diante de sua morta, e falou aos filhos de Hete, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Abraham de delante de su muerto, y habló á los hijos de Heth, diciendo:

verses.KJV: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
verses.WEB: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
verses.ASV: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Peregrino e estrangeiro sou entre vós; dá-me propriedade de sepultura convosco, e sepultarei minha falecida de diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: Peregrino y advenedizo soy entre vosotros; dadme heredad de sepultura con vosotros, y sepultaré mi muerto de delante de mí.

verses.KJV: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.WEB: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.ASV: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E responderam os filhos de Hete a Abraão, e disseram-lhe:
verses.RVR09: Y respondieron los hijos de Heth á Abraham, y dijéronle:

verses.KJV: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
verses.WEB: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”
verses.ASV: Hear us, my lord; thou art a prince of God among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve-nos, senhor meu, és um príncipe de Deus entre nós; no melhor de nossas sepulturas sepulta a tua falecida; nenhum de nós te impedirá sua sepultura, para que enterres tua falecida.
verses.RVR09: Oyenos, señor mío, eres un príncipe de Dios entre nosotros; en lo mejor de nuestras sepulturas sepulta á tu muerto; ninguno de nosotros te impedirá su sepultura, para que entierres tu muerto.

verses.KJV: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
verses.WEB: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.
verses.ASV: And Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão se levantou, e inclinou-se ao povo daquela terra, aos filhos de Hete;
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham se levantó, é inclinóse al pueblo de aquella tierra, á los hijos de Heth;

verses.KJV: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.WEB: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.ASV: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou com eles, dizendo: Se queres que eu sepulte minha falecida de diante de mim, ouvi-me, e intercedei por mim com Efrom, filho de Zoar,
verses.RVR09: Y habló con ellos, diciendo: Si tenéis voluntad que yo sepulte mi muerto de delante de mí, oidme, é interceded por mí con Ephrón, hijo de Zohar,

verses.KJV: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
verses.WEB: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”
verses.ASV: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for the full price let him give it to me in the midst of you for a possession of a burying-place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que me dê a caverna de Macpela, que tem na extremidade de sua propriedade: que por seu justo preço a dê a mim, para possessão de sepultura em meio de vós.
verses.RVR09: Para que me dé la cueva de Macpela, que tiene al cabo de su heredad: que por su justo precio me la dé, para posesión de sepultura en medio de vosotros.

verses.KJV: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.WEB: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.ASV: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Este Efrom achava-se entre os filhos de Hete: e respondeu Efrom Heteu a Abraão, aos ouvidos dos filhos de Hete, de todos os que entravam pela porta de sua cidade, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Este Ephrón hallábase entre los hijos de Heth: y respondió Ephrón Hetheo á Abraham, en oídos de los hijos de Heth, de todos los que entraban por la puerta de su ciudad, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
verses.WEB: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”
verses.ASV: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the children of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não, senhor meu, ouve-me: eu te dou a propriedade, e te dou também a caverna que está nela; diante dos filhos de meu povo a dou a ti; sepulta tua falecida.
verses.RVR09: No, señor mío, óyeme: te doy la heredad, y te doy también la cueva que está en ella; delante de los hijos de mi pueblo te la doy; sepulta tu muerto.

verses.KJV: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
verses.WEB: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
verses.ASV: And Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão se inclinou diante do povo da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham se inclinó delante del pueblo de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
verses.WEB: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”
verses.ASV: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt, I pray thee, hear me: I will give the price of the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu a Efrom aos ouvidos do povo da terra, dizendo: Antes, se for do teu agrado, rogo-te que me ouças; eu darei o preço da propriedade, toma-o de mim, e sepultarei nela minha falecida.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió á Ephrón en oídos del pueblo de la tierra, diciendo: Antes, si te place, ruégote que me oigas; yo daré el precio de la heredad, tómalo de mí, y sepultaré en ella mi muerto.

verses.KJV: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.WEB: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.ASV: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Efrom a Abraão, dizendo-lhe:
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Ephrón á Abraham, diciéndole:

verses.KJV: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
verses.WEB: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”
verses.ASV: My lord, hearken unto me: a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver, what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Senhor meu, escuta-me: a terra vale quatrocentos siclos de prata: que é isto entre mim e ti? Enterra, pois, tua falecida.
verses.RVR09: Señor mío, escúchame: la tierra vale cuatrocientos siclos de plata: ¿qué es esto entre mí y ti? entierra pues tu muerto.

verses.KJV: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
verses.WEB: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.
verses.ASV: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current [money] with the merchant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abraão concordou com Efrom, e pesou Abraão a Efrom o dinheiro que disse, ouvindo-o os filhos de Hete, quatrocentos siclos de prata, de acordo com o padrão dos mercadores.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abraham se convino con Ephrón, y pesó Abraham á Ephrón el dinero que dijo, oyéndolo los hijos de Heth, cuatrocientos siclos de plata, de buena ley entre mercaderes.

verses.KJV: And the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
verses.WEB: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded
verses.ASV: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the border thereof round about, were made sure
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficou a propriedade de Efrom que estava em Macpela em frente de Manre, a propriedade e a caverna que estava nela, e todas as árvores que havia na herança, e em todo o seu termo ao derredor,
verses.RVR09: Y quedó la heredad de Ephrón que estaba en Macpela enfrente de Mamre, la heredad y la cueva que estaba en ella, y todos los árboles que había en la heredad, y en todo su término al derredor,

verses.KJV: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
verses.WEB: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.
verses.ASV: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para Abraão em possessão, à vista dos filhos de Hete, e de todos os que entravam pela porta da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Por de Abraham en posesión, á vista de los hijos de Heth, y de todos los que entraban por la puerta de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (the same is Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois disto sepultou Abraão a Sara, sua mulher, na caverna da propriedade de Macpela em frente de Manre, que é Hebrom na terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Y después de esto sepultó Abraham á Sara su mujer en la cueva de la heredad de Macpela enfrente de Mamre, que es Hebrón en la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
verses.WEB: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.
verses.ASV: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a burying-place by the children of Heth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficou a propriedade e a caverna que nela havia, para Abraão, em possessão de sepultura adquirida dos filhos de Hete.
verses.RVR09: Y quedó la heredad y la cueva que en ella había, por de Abraham, en posesión de sepultura adquirida de los hijos de Heth.

verses.KJV: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.WEB: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.ASV: And Abraham was old, [and] well stricken in age: and Jehovah had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão era velho, e cheio de dias; e o SENHOR havia abençoado a Abraão em tudo.
verses.RVR09: Y ABRAHAM era viejo, y bien entrado en días; y Jehová había bendecido á Abraham en todo.

verses.KJV: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
verses.WEB: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.
verses.ASV: And Abraham said unto his servant, the elder of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Abraão a um criado seu, o mais velho de sua casa, que era o que governava em tudo o que tinha: Põe agora tua mão debaixo de minha coxa,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Abraham á un criado suyo, el más viejo de su casa, que era el que gobernaba en todo lo que tenía: Pon ahora tu mano debajo de mi muslo,

verses.KJV: And I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
verses.WEB: I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
verses.ASV: and I will make thee swear by Jehovah, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that thou wilt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
verses.ALMEIDA: E te juramentarei pelo SENHOR, Deus dos céus e Deus da terra, que não tomarás mulher para meu filho das filhas dos cananeus, entre os quais eu habito;
verses.RVR09: Y te juramentaré por Jehová, Dios de los cielos y Dios de la tierra, que no has de tomar mujer para mi hijo de las hijas de los Cananeos, entre los cuales yo habito;

verses.KJV: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
verses.WEB: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
verses.ASV: but thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son Isaac.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso irás à minha terra e à minha parentela, e tomarás mulher para meu filho Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Sino que irás á mi tierra y á mi parentela, y tomarás mujer para mi hijo Isaac.

verses.KJV: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
verses.WEB: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”
verses.ASV: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o criado lhe respondeu: Talvez a mulher não queira vir atrás de mim a esta terra; farei voltar, pois, teu filho à terra de onde saíste?
verses.RVR09: Y el criado le respondió: Quizá la mujer no querrá venir en pos de mí á esta tierra: ¿volveré, pues, tu hijo á la tierra de donde saliste?

verses.KJV: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
verses.WEB: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
verses.ASV: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão lhe disse: Guarda-te que não faças voltar a meu filho ali.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham le dijo: Guárdate que no vuelvas á mi hijo allá.

verses.KJV: The Lord God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
verses.WEB: The LORD, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
verses.ASV: Jehovah, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my nativity, and who spake unto me, and who sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he will send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife for my son from thence.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR, Deus dos céus, que me tomou da casa de meu pai e da terra de minha parentela, e me falou e me jurou, dizendo: À tua descendência darei esta terra; ele enviará seu anjo diante de ti, e tu tomarás dali mulher para meu filho.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, Dios de los cielos, que me tomó de la casa de mi padre y de la tierra de mi parentela, y me habló y me juró, diciendo: A tu simiente daré esta tierra; él enviará su ángel delante de ti, y tú tomarás de allá mujer para mi hijo.

verses.KJV: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
verses.WEB: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”
verses.ASV: And if the woman be not willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath; only thou shalt not bring my son thither again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se a mulher não quiser vir atrás de ti, serás livre deste meu juramento; somente que não faças voltar ali a meu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y si la mujer no quisiere venir en pos de ti, serás libre de este mi juramento; solamente que no vuelvas allá á mi hijo.

verses.KJV: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
verses.WEB: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
verses.ASV: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning this matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o criado pôs sua mão debaixo da coxa de Abraão seu senhor, e jurou-lhe sobre este negócio.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el criado puso su mano debajo del muslo de Abraham su señor, y juróle sobre este negocio.

verses.KJV: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
verses.WEB: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
verses.ASV: And the servant took ten camels, of the camels of his master, and departed, having all goodly things of his master’s in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o criado tomou dez camelos dos camelos de seu senhor, e foi-se, pois tinha à sua disposição todos os bens de seu senhor: e posto em caminho, chegou à Mesopotâmia, à cidade de Naor.
verses.RVR09: Y el criado tomó diez camellos de los camellos de su señor, y fuése, pues tenía á su disposición todos los bienes de su señor: y puesto en camino, llegó á Mesopotamia, á la ciudad de Nachôr.

verses.KJV: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.WEB: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.ASV: And he made the camels to kneel down without the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez ajoelhar os camelos fora da cidade, junto a um poço de água, à hora da tarde, à hora em que saem as moças por água.
verses.RVR09: E hizo arrodillar los camellos fuera de la ciudad, junto á un pozo de agua, á la hora de la tarde, á la hora en que salen las mozas por agua.

verses.KJV: And he said O Lord God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
verses.WEB: He said, “LORD, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
verses.ASV: And he said, O Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, send me, I pray thee, good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, dá-me, te rogo, o ter hoje bom encontro, e faze misericórdia com meu senhor Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Jehová, Dios de mi señor Abraham, dame, te ruego, el tener hoy buen encuentro, y haz misericordia con mi señor Abraham.

verses.KJV: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
verses.WEB: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
verses.ASV: Behold, I am standing by the fountain of water; and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu estou junto à fonte de água, e as filhas dos homens desta cidade saem por água:
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo estoy junto á la fuente de agua, y las hijas de los varones de esta ciudad salen por agua:

verses.KJV: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
verses.WEB: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”
verses.ASV: and let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast showed kindness unto my master.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja, pois, que a moça a quem eu disser: Baixa teu cântaro, te rogo, para que eu beba; e ela responder: Bebe, e também darei de beber a teus camelos: que seja esta a que tu destinaste para teu servo Isaque; e nisto conhecerei que haverás feito misericórdia com meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Sea, pues, que la moza á quien yo dijere: Baja tu cántaro, te ruego, para que yo beba; y ella respondiere: Bebe, y también daré de beber á tus camellos: que sea ésta la que tú has destinado para tu siervo Isaac; y en esto conoceré que habrás hecho misericordia con mi señor.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
verses.WEB: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que antes que ele acabasse de falar, eis que Rebeca, que havia nascido a Betuel, filho de Milca, mulher de Naor irmão de Abraão, a qual saía com seu cântaro sobre seu ombro.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que antes que él acabase de hablar, he aquí Rebeca, que había nacido á Bethuel, hijo de Milca, mujer de Nachôr hermano de Abraham, la cual salía con su cántaro sobre su hombro.

verses.KJV: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.WEB: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.ASV: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the fountain, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a moça era de muito belo aspecto, virgem, à que homem não havia conhecido; a qual desceu à fonte, e encheu seu cântaro, e se voltava.
verses.RVR09: Y la moza era de muy hermoso aspecto, virgen, á la que varón no había conocido; la cual descendió á la fuente, y llenó su cántaro, y se volvía.

verses.KJV: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
verses.WEB: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”
verses.ASV: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Give me to drink, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o criado correu até ela, e disse: Rogo-te que me dês a beber um pouco de água de teu cântaro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el criado corrió hacia ella, y dijo: Ruégote que me des á beber un poco de agua de tu cántaro.

verses.KJV: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
verses.WEB: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.
verses.ASV: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela respondeu: Bebe, meu senhor; e apressou-se a baixar seu cântaro sobre sua mão, e lhe deu a beber.
verses.RVR09: Y ella respondió: Bebe, señor mío: y dióse prisa á bajar su cántaro sobre su mano, y le dió á beber.

verses.KJV: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
verses.WEB: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”
verses.ASV: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando acabou de dar-lhe de beber, disse: Também para teus camelos tirarei água, até que acabem de beber.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando acabó de darle á beber, dijo: También para tus camellos sacaré agua, hasta que acaben de beber.

verses.KJV: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
verses.WEB: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
verses.ASV: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apressou-se, e esvaziou seu cântaro no bebedouro, e correu outra vez ao poço para tirar água, e tirou para todos os seus camelos.
verses.RVR09: Y dióse prisa, y vació su cántaro en la pila, y corrió otra vez al pozo para sacar agua, y sacó para todos sus camellos.

verses.KJV: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.WEB: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.ASV: And the man looked stedfastly on her, holding his peace, to know whether Jehovah had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem estava maravilhado dela, permanecendo calado, para saber se o SENHOR havia prosperado ou não sua viagem.
verses.RVR09: Y el hombre estaba maravillado de ella, callando, para saber si Jehová había prosperado ó no su viaje.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
verses.WEB: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que quando os camelos acabaram de beber, presenteou-lhe o homem um pendente de ouro que pesava meio siclo, e dois braceletes que pesavam dez;
verses.RVR09: Y fué que como los camellos acabaron de beber, presentóle el hombre un pendiente de oro que pesaba medio siclo, y dos brazaletes que pesaban diez:

verses.KJV: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
verses.WEB: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”
verses.ASV: and said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee. Is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: De quem és filha? Rogo-te me digas, há lugar em casa de teu pai onde possamos passar a noite?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: ¿De quién eres hija? Ruégote me digas, ¿hay lugar en casa de tu padre donde posemos?

verses.KJV: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
verses.WEB: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”
verses.ASV: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bare unto Nahor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela respondeu: Sou filha de Betuel, filho de Milca, o qual deu à luz ela a Naor.
verses.RVR09: Y ella respondió: Soy hija de Bethuel, hijo de Milca, el cual parió ella á Nachôr.

verses.KJV: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
verses.WEB: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
verses.ASV: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acrescentou: Também há em nossa casa palha e muita forragem, e lugar para passar a noite.
verses.RVR09: Y añadió: También hay en nuestra casa paja y mucho forraje, y lugar para posar.

verses.KJV: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the Lord.
verses.WEB: The man bowed his head, and worshiped the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the man bowed his head, and worshipped Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem então se inclinou, e adorou ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El hombre entonces se inclinó, y adoró á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master's brethren.
verses.WEB: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, who hath not forsaken his lovingkindness and his truth toward my master: as for me, Jehovah hath led me in the way to the house of my master’s brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Bendito seja o SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, que não afastou sua misericórdia e sua verdade de meu senhor, guiando-me o SENHOR no caminho à casa dos irmãos de meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Bendito sea Jehová, Dios de mi amo Abraham, que no apartó su misericordia y su verdad de mi amo, guiándome Jehová en el camino á casa de los hermanos de mi amo.

verses.KJV: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.
verses.WEB: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.
verses.ASV: And the damsel ran, and told her mother’s house according to these words.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a moça correu, e fez saber na casa de sua mãe estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y la moza corrió, é hizo saber en casa de su madre estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
verses.WEB: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
verses.ASV: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the fountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Rebeca tinha um irmão que se chamava Labão, o qual correu fora ao homem, à fonte;
verses.RVR09: Y Rebeca tenía un hermano que se llamaba Labán, el cual corrió afuera al hombre, á la fuente;

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
verses.WEB: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he saw the ring, and the bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he was standing by the camels at the fountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que quando viu o pendente e os braceletes nas mãos de sua irmã, que dizia, Assim me falou aquele homem; veio a ele: e eis que estava junto aos camelos à fonte.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que como vió el pendiente y los brazaletes en las manos de su hermana, que decía, Así me habló aquel hombre; vino á él: y he aquí que estaba junto á los camellos á la fuente.

verses.KJV: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
verses.WEB: He said, “Come in, you blessed of the LORD. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of Jehovah; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Vem, bendito do SENHOR; por que estás fora? eu limpei a casa, e o lugar para os camelos.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole: Ven, bendito de Jehová; ¿por qué estás fuera? yo he limpiado la casa, y el lugar para los camellos.

verses.KJV: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
verses.WEB: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
verses.ASV: And the man came into the house, and he ungirded the camels; and he gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men that were with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o homem veio à casa, e Labão desatou os camelos; e deu-lhes palha e forragem, e água para lavar os pés dele, e os pés dos homens que com ele vinham.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el hombre vino á casa, y Labán desató los camellos; y dióles paja y forraje, y agua para lavar los piés de él, y los piés de los hombres que con él venían.

verses.KJV: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
verses.WEB: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”
verses.ASV: And there was set food before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram diante dele comida; mas ele disse: Não comerei até que tenha dito minha mensagem. E ele lhe disse: Fala.
verses.RVR09: Y pusiéronle delante qué comer; mas él dijo: No comeré hasta que haya dicho mi mensaje. Y él le dijo: Habla.

verses.KJV: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
verses.WEB: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.ASV: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse: Eu sou criado de Abraão;
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo: Yo soy criado de Abraham;

verses.KJV: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.WEB: The LORD has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. The LORD has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks and herds, and silver and gold, and men-servants and maid-servants, and camels and asses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR abençoou muito a meu senhor, e ele se engrandeceu: e lhe deu ovelhas e vacas, prata e ouro, servos e servas, camelos e asnos.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová ha bendecido mucho á mi amo, y él se ha engrandecido: y le ha dado ovejas y vacas, plata y oro, siervos y siervas, camellos y asnos.

verses.KJV: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
verses.WEB: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.
verses.ASV: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Sara, mulher de meu senhor, deu à luz em sua velhice um filho a meu senhor, quem lhe deu tudo quanto tem.
verses.RVR09: Y Sara, mujer de mi amo, parió en su vejez un hijo á mi señor, quien le ha dado todo cuanto tiene.

verses.KJV: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
verses.WEB: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
verses.ASV: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
verses.ALMEIDA: E meu senhor me fez jurar, dizendo: Não tomarás mulher para meu filho das filhas dos cananeus, em cuja terra habito;
verses.RVR09: Y mi amo me hizo jurar, diciendo: No tomarás mujer para mi hijo de las hijas de los Cananeos, en cuya tierra habito;

verses.KJV: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
verses.WEB: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’
verses.ASV: but thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso irás à casa de meu pai, e à minha parentela, e tomarás mulher para meu filho.
verses.RVR09: Sino que irás á la casa de mi padre, y á mi parentela, y tomarás mujer para mi hijo.

verses.KJV: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
verses.WEB: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’
verses.ASV: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Talvez a mulher não queira me seguir.
verses.RVR09: Y yo dije: Quizás la mujer no querrá seguirme.

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, The Lord, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
verses.WEB: He said to me, ‘The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, Jehovah, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele me respondeu: O SENHOR, em cuja presença tenho andado, enviará seu anjo contigo, e fará teu caminho ser bem-sucedido; e tomarás mulher para meu filho de minha linhagem e da casa de meu pai;
verses.RVR09: Entonces él me respondió: Jehová, en cuya presencia he andado, enviará su ángel contigo, y prosperará tu camino; y tomarás mujer para mi hijo de mi linaje y de la casa de mi padre:

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
verses.WEB: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’
verses.ASV: then shalt thou be clear from my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give her not to thee, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então serás livre de meu juramento, quando houveres chegado à minha linhagem; e se não a derem a ti, serás livre de meu juramento.
verses.RVR09: Entonces serás libre de mi juramento, cuando hubieres llegado á mi linaje; y si no te la dieren, serás libre de mi juramento.

verses.KJV: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
verses.WEB: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘The LORD, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—
verses.ASV: And I came this day unto the fountain, and said, O Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
verses.ALMEIDA: Cheguei, pois, hoje à fonte, e disse: SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, se tu fazes bem-sucedido agora meu caminho pelo qual ando;
verses.RVR09: Llegué, pues, hoy á la fuente, y dije: Jehová, Dios de mi señor Abraham, si tú prosperas ahora mi camino por el cual ando;

verses.KJV: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
verses.WEB: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”
verses.ASV: behold, I am standing by the fountain of water; and let it come to pass, that the maiden that cometh forth to draw, to whom I shall say, Give me, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher to drink;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu estou junto à fonte de água; seja, pois, que a virgem que sair por água, à qual disser: Dá-me de beber, te rogo, um pouco de água de teu cântaro;
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo estoy junto á la fuente de agua; sea, pues, que la doncella que saliere por agua, á la cual dijere: Dame á beber, te ruego, un poco de agua de tu cántaro;

verses.KJV: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the Lord hath appointed out for my master's son.
verses.WEB: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.’
verses.ASV: and she shall say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom Jehovah hath appointed for my master’s son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela me responder, Bebe tu, e também para teus camelos tirarei água: esta seja a mulher que destinou o SENHOR para o filho de meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y ella me respondiere, Bebe tú, y también para tus camellos sacaré agua: ésta sea la mujer que destinó Jehová para el hijo de mi señor.

verses.KJV: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
verses.WEB: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’
verses.ASV: And before I had done speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the fountain, and drew: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E antes que acabasse de falar em meu coração, eis que Rebeca saía com seu cântaro sobre seu ombro; e desceu à fonte, e tirou água; e lhe disse: Rogo-te que me dês de beber.
verses.RVR09: Y antes que acabase de hablar en mi corazón, he aquí Rebeca, que salía con su cántaro sobre su hombro; y descendió á la fuente, y sacó agua; y le dije: Ruégote que me des á beber.

verses.KJV: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
verses.WEB: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.
verses.ASV: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E prontamente baixou seu cântaro de cima de si, e disse: Bebe, e também a teus camelos darei a beber. E bebi, e deu também de beber a meus camelos.
