verses.RVR09: Y prestamente bajó su cántaro de encima de sí, y dijo: Bebe, y también á tus camellos daré á beber. Y bebí, y dió también de beber á mis camellos.

verses.KJV: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, the daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
verses.WEB: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.
verses.ASV: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the ring upon her nose, and the bracelets upon her hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe perguntei, e disse: De quem és filha? E ela respondeu: Filha de Betuel, filho de Naor, que Milca lhe deu. Então pus nela um pendente sobre seu nariz, e braceletes sobre suas mãos;
verses.RVR09: Entonces preguntéle, y dije: ¿De quién eres hija? Y ella respondió: Hija de Bethuel, hijo de Nachôr, que le parió Milca. Entonces púsele un pendiente sobre su nariz, y brazaletes sobre sus manos:

verses.KJV: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.
verses.WEB: I bowed my head, and worshiped the LORD, and blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.
verses.ASV: And I bowed my head, and worshipped Jehovah, and blessed Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E inclinei-me, e adorei ao SENHOR, e bendisse ao SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, que me havia guiado pelo caminho de verdade para tomar a filha do irmão de meu senhor para seu filho.
verses.RVR09: E inclinéme, y adoré á Jehová, y bendije á Jehová, Dios de mi señor Abraham, que me había guiado por camino de verdad para tomar la hija del hermano de mi señor para su hijo.

verses.KJV: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
verses.WEB: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”
verses.ASV: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, se vós fazeis misericórdia e verdade com meu senhor, declarai-o a mim; e se não, declarai-o a mim; e irei embora à direita ou à esquerda.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, si vosotros hacéis misericordia y verdad con mi señor, declarádmelo; y si no, declarádmelo; y echaré á la diestra ó á la siniestra.

verses.KJV: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the Lord: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
verses.WEB: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from the LORD. We can’t speak to you bad or good.
verses.ASV: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from Jehovah: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Labão e Betuel responderam e disseram: Do SENHOR saiu isto; não podemos falar-te mal nem bem.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Labán y Bethuel respondieron y dijeron: De Jehová ha salido esto; no podemos hablarte malo ni bueno.

verses.KJV: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the Lord hath spoken.
verses.WEB: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as the LORD has spoken.”
verses.ASV: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as Jehovah hath spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aí Rebeca diante de ti; toma-a e vai-te, e seja mulher do filho de teu senhor, como o disse o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: He ahí Rebeca delante de ti; tómala y vete, y sea mujer del hijo de tu señor, como lo ha dicho Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the Lord, bowing himself to the earth.
verses.WEB: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi, que quando o criado de Abraão ouviu suas palavras, inclinou-se à terra ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y fué, que como el criado de Abraham oyó sus palabras, inclinóse á tierra á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
verses.WEB: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.
verses.ASV: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o criado tirou objetos de prata, objetos de ouro e roupas, e deu a Rebeca: também deu coisas preciosas a seu irmão e a sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Y sacó el criado vasos de plata, y vasos de oro y vestidos, y dió á Rebeca: también dió cosas preciosas á su hermano y á su madre.

verses.KJV: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
verses.WEB: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”
verses.ASV: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comeram e beberam ele e os homens que vinham com ele, e dormiram; e levantando-se de manhã, disse: Autorizai-me voltar a meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron y bebieron él y los varones que venían con él, y durmieron; y levantándose de mañana, dijo: Enviadme á mi señor.

verses.KJV: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
verses.WEB: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”
verses.ASV: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us [a few] days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então respondeu seu irmão e sua mãe: Espere a moça conosco ao menos dez dias, e depois irá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió su hermano y su madre: Espere la moza con nosotros á lo menos diez días, y después irá.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the Lord hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing Jehovah hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Não me detenhais, pois que o SENHOR fez prosperar meu caminho; despede-me para que me vá a meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: No me detengáis, pues que Jehová ha prosperado mi camino; despachadme para que me vaya á mi señor.

verses.KJV: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
verses.WEB: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”
verses.ASV: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles responderam então: Chamemos a moça e perguntemos a ela.
verses.RVR09: Ellos respondieron entonces: Llamemos la moza y preguntémosle.

verses.KJV: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
verses.WEB: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”
verses.ASV: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: Irás tu com este homem? E ela respondeu: Sim, irei.
verses.RVR09: Y llamaron á Rebeca, y dijéronle: ¿Irás tú con este varón? Y ella respondió: Sí, iré.

verses.KJV: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
verses.WEB: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.
verses.ASV: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então deixaram ir a Rebeca sua irmã, e à sua criada, e ao criado de Abraão e a seus homens.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dejaron ir á Rebeca su hermana, y á su nodriza, y al criado de Abraham y á sus hombres.

verses.KJV: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
verses.WEB: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”
verses.ASV: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Our sister, be thou [the mother] of thousands of ten thousands, and let thy seed possess the gate of those that hate them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abençoaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: És nossa irmã; sejas em milhares de milhares, e tua geração possua a porta de seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Y bendijeron á Rebeca, y dijéronle: Nuestra hermana eres; seas en millares de millares, y tu generación posea la puerta de sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.WEB: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.ASV: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantou-se então Rebeca e suas moças, e subiram sobre os camelos, e seguiram ao homem; e o criado tomou a Rebeca, e foi embora.
verses.RVR09: Levantóse entonces Rebeca y sus mozas, y subieron sobre los camellos, y siguieron al hombre; y el criado tomó á Rebeca, y fuése.

verses.KJV: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.
verses.WEB: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
verses.ASV: And Isaac came from the way of Beer-lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the land of the South.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vinha Isaque do poço do Vivente que me vê; porque ele habitava na terra do Sul;
verses.RVR09: Y venía Isaac del pozo del Viviente que me ve; porque él habitaba en la tierra del Mediodía;

verses.KJV: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
verses.WEB: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.
verses.ASV: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia saído Isaque a orar ao campo, à hora da tarde; e levantando seus olhos, olhou, e eis os camelos que vinham.
verses.RVR09: Y había salido Isaac á orar al campo, á la hora de la tarde; y alzando sus ojos miró, y he aquí los camellos que venían.

verses.KJV: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
verses.WEB: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.
verses.ASV: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she alighted from the camel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rebeca também levantou seus olhos, e viu a Isaque, e desceu do camelo;
verses.RVR09: Rebeca también alzó sus ojos, y vió á Isaac, y descendió del camello;

verses.KJV: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
verses.WEB: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.
verses.ASV: And she said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant said, It is my master: and she took her veil, and covered herself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque havia perguntado ao criado: Quem é este homem que vem pelo campo até nós? E o servo havia respondido: Este é meu senhor. Ela então tomou o véu, e cobriu-se.
verses.RVR09: Porque había preguntado al criado: ¿Quién es este varón que viene por el campo hacia nosotros? Y el siervo había respondido: Este es mi señor. Ella entonces tomó el velo, y cubrióse.

verses.KJV: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
verses.WEB: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.ASV: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o criado contou a Isaque tudo o que havia feito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el criado contó á Isaac todo lo que había hecho.

verses.KJV: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
verses.WEB: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.ASV: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her. And Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trouxe-a Isaque à tenda de sua mãe Sara, e tomou a Rebeca por mulher; e amou-a: e consolou-se Isaque depois da morte de sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: E introdújola Isaac á la tienda de su madre Sara, y tomó á Rebeca por mujer; y amóla: y consolóse Isaac después de la muerte de su madre.

verses.KJV: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.WEB: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.ASV: And Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão tomou outra mulher, cujo nome foi Quetura;
verses.RVR09: Y ABRAHAM tomó otra mujer, cuyo nombre fué Cetura;

verses.KJV: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.WEB: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.ASV: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual lhe deu à luz a Zinrã, e a Jocsã, e a Medã, e a Midiã, e a Jisbaque, e a Suá.
verses.RVR09: La cual le parió á Zimram, y á Joksan, y á Medan, y á Midiam, y á Ishbak, y á Sua.

verses.KJV: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.WEB: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.ASV: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jocsã gerou a Seba, e a Dedã: e filhos de Dedã foram Assurim, e Letusim, e Leummim.
verses.RVR09: Y Joksan engendró á Seba, y á Dedán: é hijos de Dedán fueron Assurim, y Letusim, y Leummim.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E filhos de Midiã: Efá, e Efer, e Enoque, e Abida, e Elda. Todos estes foram filhos de Quetura.
verses.RVR09: E hijos de Midiam: Epha, y Epher, y Enech, y Abida, y Eldaa. Todos estos fueron hijos de Cetura.

verses.KJV: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
verses.WEB: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,
verses.ASV: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Abraão deu tudo quanto tinha a Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham dió todo cuanto tenía á Isaac.

verses.KJV: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
verses.WEB: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.
verses.ASV: But unto the sons of the concubines, that Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts; and he sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos filhos de suas concubinas deu Abraão presentes, e enviou-os para longe de Isaque seu filho, enquanto ele vivia, até o oriente, à terra oriental.
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de sus concubinas dió Abraham dones, y enviólos de junto Isaac su hijo, mientras él vivía, hacia el oriente, á la tierra oriental.

verses.KJV: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
verses.WEB: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
verses.ASV: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os dias de vida que viveu Abraão: cento e setenta e cinco anos.
verses.RVR09: Y estos fueron los días de vida que vivió Abraham: ciento setenta y cinco años.

verses.KJV: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
verses.WEB: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
verses.ASV: And Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full [of years], and was gathered to his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E expirou, e morreu Abraão em boa velhice, ancião e cheio de dias e foi unido a seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y exhaló el espíritu, y murió Abraham en buena vejez, anciano y lleno de días, y fué unido á su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
verses.WEB: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,
verses.ASV: And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sepultaram-no Isaque e Ismael seus filhos na caverna de Macpela, na propriedade de Efrom, filho de Zoar Heteu, que está em frente de Manre;
verses.RVR09: Y sepultáronlo Isaac é Ismael sus hijos en la cueva de Macpela, en la heredad de Ephrón, hijo de Zoar Hetheo, que está enfrente de Mamre;

verses.KJV: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.WEB: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
verses.ASV: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Herança que comprou Abraão dos filhos de Hete; ali foi Abraão sepultado, e Sara sua mulher.
verses.RVR09: Heredad que compró Abraham de los hijos de Heth; allí fué Abraham sepultado, y Sara su mujer.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.
verses.WEB: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed Isaac his son: and Isaac dwelt by Beer-lahai-roi.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu, depois de morto Abraão, que Deus abençoou a Isaque seu filho: e habitou Isaque junto a Beer-Laai-Roi.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió, después de muerto Abraham, que Dios bendijo á Isaac su hijo: y habitó Isaac junto al pozo del Viviente que me ve.

verses.KJV: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
verses.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.
verses.ASV: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as gerações de Ismael, filho de Abraão, que lhe deu à luz Agar egípcia, serva de Sara:
verses.RVR09: Y estas son las generaciones de Ismael, hijo de Abraham, que le parió Agar Egipcia, sierva de Sara:

verses.KJV: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.ASV: and these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois, são os nomes dos filhos de Ismael, por seus nomes, por suas linhagens: O primogênito de Ismael, Nebaiote; logo Quedar, e Adbeel, e Mibsão,
verses.RVR09: Estos, pues, son los nombres de los hijos de Ismael, por sus nombres, por sus linajes: El primogénito de Ismael, Nabaioth; luego Cedar, y Abdeel, y Mibsam,

verses.KJV: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
verses.WEB: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
verses.ASV: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Misma, e Dumá, e Massá,
verses.RVR09: Y Misma, y Duma, y Massa,

verses.KJV: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
verses.WEB: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.ASV: Hadad, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

verses.RVR09: Hadad, y Tema, y Jetur, y Naphis, y Cedema.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.
verses.ASV: these are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os filhos de Ismael, e estes seus nomes por suas vilas e por seus acampamentos; doze príncipes por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los hijos de Ismael, y estos sus nombres, por sus villas y por sus campamentos; doce príncipes por sus familias.

verses.KJV: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
verses.WEB: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.
verses.ASV: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os anos da vida de Ismael, cento e trinta e sete anos: e expirou Ismael, e morreu; e foi unido a seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y estos fueron los años de la vida de Ismael, ciento treinta y siete años: y exhaló el espíritu Ismael, y murió; y fué unido á su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.WEB: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.
verses.ASV: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: he abode over against all his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitaram desde Havilá até Sur, que está em frente do Egito vindo a Assíria; e morreu em presença de todos os seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y habitaron desde Havila hasta Shur, que está enfrente de Egipto viniendo á Asiria; y murió en presencia de todos sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:
verses.WEB: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.
verses.ASV: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as gerações de Isaque, filho de Abraão. Abraão gerou a Isaque:
verses.RVR09: Y estas son las generaciones de Isaac, hijo de Abraham. Abraham engendró á Isaac:

verses.KJV: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
verses.WEB: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
verses.ASV: and Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era Isaque de quarenta anos quando tomou por mulher a Rebeca, filha de Betuel arameu de Padã-Arã, irmã de Labão arameu.
verses.RVR09: Y era Isaac de cuarenta años cuando tomó por mujer á Rebeca, hija de Bethuel Arameo de Padan-aram, hermana de Labán Arameo.

verses.KJV: And Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.WEB: Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren. The LORD was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.ASV: And Isaac entreated Jehovah for his wife, because she was barren: and Jehovah was entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.ALMEIDA: E orou Isaque ao SENHOR por sua mulher, que era estéril; e aceitou-o o SENHOR, e concebeu Rebeca sua mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y oró Isaac á Jehová por su mujer, que era estéril; y aceptólo Jehová, y concibió Rebeca su mujer.

verses.KJV: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, wherefore do I live? And she went to inquire of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos se combatiam dentro dela; e disse: Se é assim para que vivo eu? E foi consultar ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos se combatían dentro de ella; y dijo: Si es así ¿para qué vivo yo? Y fué á consultar á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, And two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels: And the one people shall be stronger than the other people; And the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhe o SENHOR: Duas nações há em teu ventre, E dois povos serão divididos desde tuas entranhas: E um povo será mais forte que o outro povo, e o maior servirá ao menor.
verses.RVR09: Y respondióle Jehová: Dos gentes hay en tu seno, y dos pueblos serán divididos desde tus entrañas: y el un pueblo será más fuerte que el otro pueblo, y el mayor servirá al menor.

verses.KJV: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.WEB: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.ASV: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se cumpriram seus dias para dar à luz, eis que havia gêmeos em seu ventre.
verses.RVR09: Y como se cumplieron sus días para parir, he aquí mellizos en su vientre.

verses.KJV: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
verses.WEB: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.
verses.ASV: And the first came forth red, all over like a hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu o primeiro ruivo, e todo ele peludo como uma veste; e chamaram seu nome Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Y salió el primero rubio, y todo él velludo como una pelliza; y llamaron su nombre Esaú.

verses.KJV: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
verses.WEB: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
verses.ASV: And after that came forth his brother, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois saiu seu irmão, pegando com sua mão o calcanhar de Esaú: e foi chamado seu nome Jacó. E era Isaque de idade de sessenta anos quando ela os deu à luz.
verses.RVR09: Y después salió su hermano, trabada su mano al calcañar de Esaú: y fué llamado su nombre Jacob. Y era Isaac de edad de sesenta años cuando ella los parió.

verses.KJV: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
verses.WEB: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
verses.ASV: And the boys grew: and Esau was a skilful hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cresceram os meninos, e Esaú foi hábil na caça, homem do campo: Jacó porém era homem quieto, que habitava em tendas.
verses.RVR09: Y crecieron los niños, y Esaú fué diestro en la caza, hombre del campo: Jacob empero era varón quieto, que habitaba en tiendas.

verses.KJV: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.WEB: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.ASV: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: and Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E amou Isaque a Esaú, porque comia de sua caça; mas Rebeca amava a Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y amó Isaac á Esaú, porque comía de su caza; mas Rebeca amaba á Jacob.

verses.KJV: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
verses.WEB: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.
verses.ASV: And Jacob boiled pottage: and Esau came in from the field, and he was faint:
verses.ALMEIDA: E cozinhou Jacó um guisado; e voltando Esaú do campo cansado,
verses.RVR09: Y guisó Jacob un potaje; y volviendo Esaú del campo cansado,

verses.KJV: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
verses.WEB: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.
verses.ASV: and Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red [pottage]; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse a Jacó: Rogo-te que me dês a comer disso vermelho, pois estou muito cansado. Portanto foi chamado seu nome Edom.
verses.RVR09: Dijo á Jacob: Ruégote que me des á comer de eso bermejo, pues estoy muy cansado. Por tanto fué llamado su nombre Edom.

verses.KJV: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
verses.WEB: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob said, Sell me first thy birthright.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó respondeu: Vende-me neste dia tua primogenitura.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob respondió: Véndeme en este día tu primogenitura.

verses.KJV: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
verses.WEB: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”
verses.ASV: And Esau said, Behold, I am about to die: and what profit shall the birthright do to me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Esaú: Eis que vou morrer; para que, pois, me servirá a primogenitura?
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Esaú: He aquí yo me voy á morir; ¿para qué, pues, me servirá la primogenitura?

verses.KJV: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
verses.WEB: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.
verses.ASV: And Jacob said, Swear to me first; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jacó: Jura-me hoje. E ele lhe jurou, e vendeu a Jacó sua primogenitura.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jacob: Júramelo en este día. Y él le juró, y vendió á Jacob su primogenitura.

verses.KJV: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
verses.WEB: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
verses.ASV: And Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: so Esau despised his birthright.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jacó deu a Esaú pão e do guisado das lentilhas; e ele comeu e bebeu, e levantou-se, e foi-se. Assim menosprezou Esaú a primogenitura.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jacob dió á Esaú pan y del guisado de las lentejas; y él comió y bebió, y levantóse, y fuése. Así menospreció Esaú la primogenitura.

verses.KJV: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
verses.WEB: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.
verses.ASV: And there was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines, unto Gerar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve fome na terra, além da primeira fome que foi nos dias de Abraão: e foi-se Isaque a Abimeleque rei dos filisteus, em Gerar.
verses.RVR09: Y HUBO hambre en la tierra, además de la primera hambre que fué en los días de Abraham: y fuése Isaac á Abimelech rey de los Filisteos, en Gerar.

verses.KJV: And the Lord appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
verses.WEB: The LORD appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
verses.ALMEIDA: E apareceu-lhe o SENHOR, e disse-lhe: Não desças ao Egito: habita na terra que eu te disser;
verses.RVR09: Y apareciósele Jehová, y díjole: No desciendas á Egipto: habita en la tierra que yo te diré;

verses.KJV: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
verses.WEB: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
verses.ASV: sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
verses.ALMEIDA: Habita nesta terra, e serei contigo, e te abençoarei; porque a ti e à tua descendência darei todas estas terras, e confirmarei o juramento que jurei a Abraão teu pai:
verses.RVR09: Habita en esta tierra, y seré contigo, y te bendeciré; porque á ti y á tu simiente daré todas estas tierras, y confirmaré el juramento que juré á Abraham tu padre:

verses.KJV: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
verses.WEB: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,
verses.ASV: and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these lands; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
verses.ALMEIDA: E multiplicarei tua descendência como as estrelas do céu, e darei à tua descendência todas estas terras; e todas as nações da terra serão abençoadas em tua descendência.
verses.RVR09: Y multiplicaré tu simiente como las estrellas del cielo, y daré á tu simiente todas estas tierras; y todas las gentes de la tierra serán benditas en tu simiente:

verses.KJV: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
verses.WEB: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”
verses.ASV: because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porquanto ouviu Abraão minha voz, e guardou meu preceito, meus mandamentos, meus estatutos e minhas leis.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto oyó Abraham mi voz, y guardó mi precepto, mis mandamientos, mis estatutos y mis leyes.

verses.KJV: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
verses.WEB: Isaac lived in Gerar.
verses.ASV: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
verses.ALMEIDA: Habitou, pois, Isaque em Gerar.
verses.RVR09: Habitó, pues, Isaac en Gerar.

verses.KJV: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
verses.WEB: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”
verses.ASV: and the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, My wife; lest, [said he], the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os homens daquele lugar lhe perguntaram acerca de sua mulher; e ele respondeu: É minha irmã; porque teve medo de dizer: É minha mulher; que talvez, disse, os homens do lugar me matem por causa de Rebeca; porque era de belo aspecto.
verses.RVR09: Y los hombres de aquel lugar le preguntaron acerca de su mujer; y él respondió: Es mi hermana; porque tuvo miedo de decir: Es mi mujer; que tal vez, dijo, los hombres del lugar me matarían por causa de Rebeca; porque era de hermoso aspecto.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
verses.WEB: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, depois que ele esteve ali muitos dias, Abimeleque, rei dos filisteus, olhando por uma janela, viu a Isaque que acariciava Rebeca sua mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que, después que él estuvo allí muchos días, Abimelech, rey de los Filisteos, mirando por una ventana, vió á Isaac que jugaba con Rebeca su mujer.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife; and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
verses.WEB: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die because of her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Abimeleque a Isaque, e disse: Eis que ela é certamente tua mulher: como, pois, disseste: É minha irmã? E Isaque lhe respondeu: Porque disse: Talvez eu morra por causa dela.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Abimelech á Isaac, y dijo: He aquí ella es de cierto tu mujer: ¿cómo, pues, dijiste: Es mi hermana? E Isaac le respondió: Porque dije: Quizá moriré por causa de ella.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
verses.WEB: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might easily have lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abimeleque disse: Por que nos fizeste isto? Por pouco haveria dormido alguém do povo com tua mulher, e haverias trazido sobre nós o pecado.
verses.RVR09: Y Abimelech dijo: ¿Por qué nos has hecho esto? Por poco hubiera dormido alguno del pueblo con tu mujer, y hubieras traído sobre nosotros el pecado.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech charged all the people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Abimeleque mandou a todo o povo, dizendo: O que tocar a este homem ou a sua mulher certamente morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abimelech mandó á todo el pueblo, diciendo: El que tocare á este hombre ó á su mujer, de cierto morirá.

verses.KJV: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the Lord blessed him.
verses.WEB: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. The LORD blessed him.
verses.ASV: And Isaac sowed in that land, and found in the same year a hundredfold: and Jehovah blessed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E semeou Isaque naquela terra, e achou aquele ano cem por um: e o SENHOR o abençoou.
verses.RVR09: Y sembró Isaac en aquella tierra, y halló aquel año ciento por uno: y bendíjole Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
verses.WEB: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
verses.ASV: And the man waxed great, and grew more and more until he became very great:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem se engrandeceu, e foi engrandecendo-se cada vez mais, até fazer-se muito poderoso:
verses.RVR09: Y el varón se engrandeció, y fué adelantando y engrandeciéndose, hasta hacerse muy poderoso:

verses.KJV: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
verses.WEB: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.
verses.ASV: and he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great household: and the Philistines envied him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teve rebanho de ovelhas, e rebanho de vacas, e grande número de servos; e os filisteus tiveram inveja dele.
verses.RVR09: Y tuvo hato de ovejas, y hato de vacas, y grande apero; y los Filisteos le tuvieron envidia.

verses.KJV: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
verses.WEB: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
verses.ASV: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os poços que os criados de Abraão seu pai haviam aberto em seus dias, os filisteus os haviam fechado e enchido da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los pozos que habían abierto los criados de Abraham su padre en sus días, los Filisteos los habían cegado y llenado de tierra.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
verses.WEB: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Abimeleque a Isaque: Aparta-te de nós, porque muito mais poderoso que nós te fizeste.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Abimelech á Isaac: Apártate de nosotros, porque mucho más poderoso que nosotros te has hecho.

verses.KJV: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.WEB: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.
verses.ASV: And Isaac departed thence, and encamped in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Isaque se foi dali; e assentou suas tendas no vale de Gerar, e habitou ali.
verses.RVR09: E Isaac se fué de allí; y asentó sus tiendas en el valle de Gerar, y habitó allí.

verses.KJV: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.WEB: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.ASV: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a abrir Isaque os poços de água que haviam aberto nos dias de Abraão seu pai, e que os filisteus haviam fechado, depois de Abraão ter morrido; e chamou-os pelos nomes que seu pai os havia chamado.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á abrir Isaac los pozos de agua que habían abierto en los días de Abraham su padre, y que los Filisteos habían cegado, muerto Abraham; y llamólos por los nombres que su padre los había llamado.

verses.KJV: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
verses.WEB: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.
verses.ASV: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os servos de Isaque cavaram no vale, e acharam ali um poço de águas vivas.
verses.RVR09: Y los siervos de Isaac cavaron en el valle, y hallaron allí un pozo de aguas vivas.

verses.KJV: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
verses.WEB: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
verses.ASV: And the herdsmen of Gerar strove with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os pastores de Gerar brigaram com os pastores de Isaque, dizendo: A água é nossa: por isso chamou o nome do poço Eseque, porque haviam brigado com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y los pastores de Gerar riñeron con los pastores de Isaac, diciendo: El agua es nuestra: por eso llamó el nombre del pozo Esek, porque habían altercado con él.

verses.KJV: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
verses.WEB: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.
verses.ASV: And they digged another well, and they strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abriram outro poço, e também brigaram sobre ele: e chamou seu nome Sitna.
verses.RVR09: Y abrieron otro pozo, y también riñeron sobre él: y llamó su nombre Sitnah.

verses.KJV: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the Lord hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
verses.WEB: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
verses.ASV: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now Jehovah hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apartou-se dali, e abriu outro poço, e não brigaram sobre ele: e chamou seu nome Reobote, e disse: Porque agora nos fez alargar o SENHOR e frutificaremos na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y apartóse de allí, y abrió otro pozo, y no riñeron sobre él: y llamó su nombre Rehoboth, y dijo: Porque ahora nos ha hecho ensanchar Jehová, y fructificaremos en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
verses.WEB: He went up from there to Beersheba.
verses.ASV: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali subiu a Berseba.
verses.RVR09: Y de allí subió á Beer-seba.

verses.KJV: And the Lord appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
verses.WEB: The LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apareceu-lhe o SENHOR aquela noite, e disse: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão teu pai: não temas, que eu sou contigo, e eu te abençoarei, e multiplicarei tua descendência por causa do meu servo Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y apareciósele Jehová aquella noche, y dijo: Yo soy el Dios de Abraham tu padre; no temas, que yo soy contigo, y yo te bendeciré, y multiplicaré tu simiente por amor de Abraham mi siervo.

verses.KJV: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.
verses.WEB: He built an altar there, and called on the LORD’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.
verses.ASV: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of Jehovah, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou ali um altar, e invocou o nome do SENHOR, e estendeu ali sua tenda: e abriram ali os servos de Isaque um poço.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó allí un altar, é invocó el nombre de Jehová, y tendió allí su tienda: y abrieron allí los siervos de Isaac un pozo.

verses.KJV: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
verses.WEB: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.
verses.ASV: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his host.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abimeleque veio a ele desde Gerar, e Auzate, amigo seu, e Ficol, capitão de seu exército.
verses.RVR09: Y Abimelech vino á él desde Gerar, y Ahuzzath, amigo suyo, y Phicol, capitán de su ejército.

verses.KJV: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
verses.WEB: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”
verses.ASV: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore are ye come unto me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes Isaque: Por que vindes a mim, pois que haveis me odiado, e me expulsastes dentre vós?
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Isaac: ¿Por qué venís á mí, pues que me habéis aborrecido, y me echasteis de entre vosotros?

verses.KJV: And they said, We saw certainly that the Lord was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
verses.WEB: They said, “We saw plainly that the LORD was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,
verses.ASV: And they said, We saw plainly that Jehovah was with thee: and we said, Let there now be an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: Vimos que o SENHOR é contigo; e dissemos: Haja agora juramento entre nós, entre nós e ti, e faremos aliança contigo:
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: Hemos visto que Jehová es contigo; y dijimos: Haya ahora juramento entre nosotros, entre nosotros y ti, y haremos alianza contigo:

verses.KJV: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the Lord.
verses.WEB: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of the LORD.”
verses.ASV: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que não nos faças mal, como nós não te tocamos, y como somente te fizemos bem, e te enviamos em paz: tu agora, bendito do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Que no nos hagas mal, como nosotros no te hemos tocado, y como solamente te hemos hecho bien, y te enviamos en paz: tú ahora, bendito de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
verses.WEB: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
verses.ASV: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lhes fez banquete, e comeram e beberam.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él les hizo banquete, y comieron y bebieron.

verses.KJV: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.WEB: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.ASV: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se levantaram de madrugada, e juraram um ao outro; e Isaque os despediu, e eles se partiram dele em paz.
verses.RVR09: Y se levantaron de madrugada, y juraron el uno al otro; é Isaac los despidió, y ellos se partieron de él en paz.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
verses.WEB: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele dia sucedeu que vieram os criados de Isaque, e deram-lhe notícias acerca do poço que haviam aberto, e lhe disseram: Achamos água.
verses.RVR09: Y en aquel día sucedió que vinieron los criados de Isaac, y diéronle nuevas acerca del pozo que habían abierto, y le dijeron: Agua hemos hallado.

verses.KJV: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.
verses.WEB: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.
verses.ASV: And he called it Shibah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou-o Seba: por cuja causa o nome daquela cidade é Berseba até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y llamólo Seba: por cuya causa el nombre de aquella ciudad es Beer-seba hasta este día.

verses.KJV: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
verses.WEB: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
verses.ASV: And when Esau was forty years old he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Esaú foi de quarenta anos, tomou por mulher a Judite filha de Beeri heteu, e a Basemate filha de Elom heteu:
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Esaú fué de cuarenta años, tomó por mujer á Judith hija de Beeri Hetheo, y á Basemat hija de Elón Hetheo:

verses.KJV: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
verses.WEB: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.
verses.ASV: and they were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram amargura de espírito a Isaque e a Rebeca.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron amargura de espíritu á Isaac y á Rebeca.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
verses.WEB: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Here am I.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando havia Isaque envelhecido, e seus olhos se ofuscaram ficando sem vista, chamou a Esaú, seu filho o maior, e disse-lhe: Meu filho. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que cuando hubo Isaac envejecido, y sus ojos se ofuscaron quedando sin vista, llamó á Esaú, su hijo el mayor, y díjole: Mi hijo. Y él respondió: Heme aquí.

verses.KJV: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
verses.WEB: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.
verses.ASV: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Eis que já sou velho, não sei o dia de minha morte:
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: He aquí ya soy viejo, no sé el día de mi muerte:

verses.KJV: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
verses.WEB: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.
verses.ASV: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison;
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma, pois, agora tuas armas, tua aljava e teu arco, e sai ao campo, e pega-me caça;
verses.RVR09: Toma, pues, ahora tus armas, tu aljaba y tu arco, y sal al campo, y cógeme caza;

verses.KJV: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
verses.WEB: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”
verses.ASV: and make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E faze-me um guisado, como eu gosto, e traze-o a mim, e comerei: para que te abençoe minha alma antes que morra.
verses.RVR09: Y hazme un guisado, como yo gusto, y tráemelo, y comeré; para que te bendiga mi alma antes que muera.

verses.KJV: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
verses.WEB: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
verses.ASV: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Rebeca estava ouvindo, quando falava Isaque a Esaú seu filho: e foi-se Esaú ao campo para pegar a caça que havia de trazer.
verses.RVR09: Y Rebeca estaba oyendo, cuando hablaba Isaac á Esaú su hijo: y fuése Esaú al campo para coger la caza que había de traer.

verses.KJV: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
verses.WEB: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,
verses.ASV: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Rebeca falou a Jacó seu filho, dizendo: Eis que eu ouvi a teu pai que falava com Esaú teu irmão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Rebeca habló á Jacob su hijo, diciendo: He aquí yo he oído á tu padre que hablaba con Esaú tu hermano, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.
verses.WEB: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before the LORD before my death.’
verses.ASV: Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless thee before Jehovah before my death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Traze-me caça, e faze-me um guisado, para que coma, e te abençoe diante do SENHOR antes que eu morra.
verses.RVR09: Tráeme caza, y hazme un guisado, para que coma, y te bendiga delante de Jehová antes que yo muera.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, filho meu, obedece à minha voz no que te mando;
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, hijo mío, obedece á mi voz en lo que te mando;

verses.KJV: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
verses.WEB: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.
verses.ASV: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savory food for thy father, such as he loveth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai agora ao gado, e traze-me dali dois bons cabritos das cabras, e farei deles iguarias para teu pai, como ele gosta;
verses.RVR09: Ve ahora al ganado, y tráeme de allí dos buenos cabritos de las cabras, y haré de ellos viandas para tu padre, como él gusta;

verses.KJV: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
verses.WEB: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”
verses.ASV: and thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, so that he may bless thee before his death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu as levarás a teu pai, e comerá, para que te abençoe antes de sua morte.
verses.RVR09: Y tú las llevarás á tu padre, y comerá, para que te bendiga antes de su muerte.

verses.KJV: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
verses.WEB: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
verses.ASV: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó disse a Rebeca sua mãe: Eis que Esaú meu irmão é homem peludo, e eu liso:
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob dijo á Rebeca su madre: He aquí, Esaú mi hermano es hombre velloso, y yo lampiño:

verses.KJV: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
verses.WEB: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”
verses.ASV: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Talvez meu pai me apalpe, e me terá por enganador, e trarei sobre mim maldição e não bênção.
verses.RVR09: Quizá me tentará mi padre, y me tendrá por burlador, y traeré sobre mí maldición y no bendición.

verses.KJV: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
verses.WEB: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”
verses.ASV: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son; only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua mãe respondeu: Filho meu, sobre mim tua maldição: somente obedece à minha voz, e vai e traze-os a mim.
verses.RVR09: Y su madre respondió: Hijo mío, sobre mí tu maldición: solamente obedece á mi voz, y ve y tráemelos.

verses.KJV: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
verses.WEB: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
verses.ASV: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele foi, e tomou, e trouxe-os à sua mãe: e sua mãe fez guisados, como seu pai gostava.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él fué, y tomó, y trájolos á su madre: y su madre hizo guisados, como su padre gustaba.

verses.KJV: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
verses.WEB: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.
verses.ASV: And Rebekah took the goodly garments of Esau her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Rebeca as roupas de Esaú seu filho maior, as melhores, que ela tinha em casa, e vestiu a Jacó seu filho menor:
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Rebeca los vestidos de Esaú su hijo mayor, los preciosos, que ella tenía en casa, y vistió á Jacob su hijo menor:

verses.KJV: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
verses.WEB: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.
verses.ASV: and she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez-lhe vestir sobre suas mãos e sobre o pescoço onde não tinha pelo, as peles dos cabritos das cabras;
verses.RVR09: E hízole vestir sobre sus manos, y sobre la cerviz donde no tenía vello, las pieles de los cabritos de las cabras;

verses.KJV: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
verses.WEB: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
verses.ASV: and she gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entregou os guisados e o pão que havia preparado, em mão de Jacó seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y entregó los guisados y el pan que había aderezado, en mano de Jacob su hijo.

verses.KJV: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
verses.WEB: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”
verses.ASV: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele foi a seu pai, e disse: Meu pai: e ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, quem és, filho meu?
verses.RVR09: Y él fué á su padre, y dijo: Padre mío: y él respondió: Heme aquí, ¿quién eres, hijo mío?

verses.KJV: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.WEB: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first-born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó disse a seu pai: Eu sou Esaú teu primogênito; fiz como me disseste: levanta-te agora, e senta, e come de minha caça, para que me abençoe tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob dijo á su padre: Yo soy Esaú tu primogénito; he hecho como me dijiste: levántate ahora, y siéntate, y come de mi caza, para que me bendiga tu alma.

verses.KJV: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord thy God brought it to me.
verses.WEB: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because the LORD your God gave me success.”
verses.ASV: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because Jehovah thy God sent me good speed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Isaque disse a seu filho: Como é que a achaste tão depressa, filho meu? E ele respondeu: Porque o SENHOR teu Deus fez que se encontrasse diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Isaac dijo á su hijo: ¿Cómo es que la hallaste tan presto, hijo mío? Y él respondió: Porque Jehová tu Dios hizo que se encontrase delante de mí.

verses.KJV: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
verses.WEB: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
verses.ASV: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Isaque disse a Jacó: Aproxima-te agora, e te apalparei, filho meu, para [que eu saiba] se és meu filho Esaú ou não.
verses.RVR09: E Isaac dijo á Jacob: Acércate ahora, y te palparé, hijo mío, por si eres mi hijo Esaú, ó no.

verses.KJV: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
verses.WEB: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegou-se Jacó a seu pai Isaque; e ele lhe apalpou, e disse: A voz é a voz de Jacó, mas as mãos, as mãos de Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Y llegóse Jacob á su padre Isaac; y él le palpó, y dijo: La voz es la voz de Jacob, mas las manos, las manos de Esaú.

verses.KJV: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.
verses.WEB: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.
verses.ASV: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não lhe reconheceu, porque suas mãos eram peludas como as mãos de Esaú: e lhe abençoou.
verses.RVR09: Y no le conoció, porque sus manos eran vellosas como las manos de Esaú: y le bendijo.

verses.KJV: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
verses.WEB: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: És tu meu filho Esaú? E ele respondeu: Eu sou.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: ¿Eres tú mi hijo Esaú? Y él respondió: Yo soy.

verses.KJV: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine and he drank.
verses.WEB: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.ASV: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Aproxima-a a mim, e comerei da caça de meu filho, para que te abençoe minha alma; e ele a aproximou, e comeu: trouxe-lhe também vinho, e bebeu.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Acércamela, y comeré de la caza de mi hijo, para que te bendiga mi alma; y él se la acercó, y comió: trájole también vino, y bebió.

verses.KJV: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
verses.WEB: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”
verses.ASV: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Isaque seu pai: Aproxima-te agora, e beija-me, filho meu.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Isaac su padre: Acércate ahora, y bésame, hijo mío.

verses.KJV: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the Lord hath blessed:
verses.WEB: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.
verses.ASV: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son Is as the smell of a field which Jehovah hath blessed:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele se chegou, e lhe beijou; e cheirou Isaque o cheiro de suas roupas, e lhe abençoou, e disse: Eis que o cheiro de meu filho é como o cheiro do campo que o SENHOR abençoou;
verses.RVR09: Y él se llegó, y le besó; y olió Isaac el olor de sus vestidos, y le bendijo, y dijo: Mira, el olor de mi hijo como el olor del campo que Jehová ha bendecido:

verses.KJV: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
verses.WEB: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
verses.ASV: And God give thee of the dew of heaven, And of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of grain and new wine:
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, pois, te dê do orvalho do céu, e das gorduras da terra, e abundância de trigo e de mosto.
verses.RVR09: Dios, pues, te dé del rocío del cielo, y de las grosuras de la tierra, y abundancia de trigo y de mosto.

verses.KJV: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
verses.WEB: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”
verses.ASV: Let peoples serve thee, And nations bow down to thee: Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: Cursed be every one that curseth thee, And blessed be every one that blesseth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sirvam-te povos, E nações se inclinem a ti: Sê senhor de teus irmãos, e inclinem-se a ti os filhos de tua mãe; malditos os que te amaldiçoarem, e benditos os que te abençoarem.
verses.RVR09: Sírvante pueblos, y naciones se inclinen á ti: sé señor de tus hermanos, e inclínense á ti los hijos de tu madre: malditos los que te maldijeren, y benditos los que te bendijeren.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.WEB: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, logo que havia Isaque de abençoar a Jacó, e apenas havia saído Jacó de diante de Isaque seu pai, que Esaú seu irmão veio de sua caça.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, luego que hubo Isaac acabado de bendecir á Jacob, y apenas había salido Jacob de delante de Isaac su padre, que Esaú su hermano vino de su caza.

verses.KJV: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.WEB: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”
verses.ASV: And he also made savory food, and brought it unto his father; and he said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também ele fez guisado, e trouxe a seu pai, e disse-lhe: Levante-se meu pai, e coma da caça de seu filho, para que me abençoe tua alma.
verses.RVR09: E hizo él también guisados, y trajo á su padre, y díjole: Levántese mi padre, y coma de la caza de su hijo, para que me bendiga tu alma.

verses.KJV: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
verses.WEB: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”
verses.ASV: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy first-born, Esau.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Isaque seu pai lhe disse: Quem és tu? E ele disse: Eu sou teu filho, teu primogênito, Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Isaac su padre le dijo: ¿Quién eres tú? Y él dijo: Yo soy tu hijo, tu primogénito, Esaú.

verses.KJV: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
verses.WEB: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”
