verses.ASV: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who then is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, [and] he shall be blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Estremeceu-se Isaque com grande estremecimento, e disse: Quem é o que veio aqui, que agarrou caça, e me trouxe, e comi de tudo antes que viesses? Eu o abençoei, e será bendito.
verses.RVR09: Y estremecióse Isaac con grande estremecimiento, y dijo: ¿Quién es el que vino aquí, que cogió caza, y me trajo, y comí de todo antes que vinieses? Yo le bendije, y será bendito.

verses.KJV: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
verses.WEB: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”
verses.ASV: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Esaú ouviu as palavras de seu pai clamou com uma muito grande e muito amarga exclamação, e lhe disse: Abençoa também a mim, meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Como Esaú oyó las palabras de su padre, clamó con una muy grande y muy amarga exclamación, y le dijo: Bendíceme también á mí, padre mío.

verses.KJV: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
verses.WEB: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Thy brother came with guile, and hath taken away thy blessing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Veio teu irmão com engano, e tomou tua bênção.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Vino tu hermano con engaño, y tomó tu bendición.

verses.KJV: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
verses.WEB: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”
verses.ASV: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Bem chamaram seu nome Jacó, que já me enganou duas vezes; tirou minha primogenitura, e eis que agora tomou minha bênção. E disse: Não guardaste bênção para mim?
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Bien llamaron su nombre Jacob, que ya me ha engañado dos veces; alzóse con mi primogenitura, y he aquí ahora ha tomado mi bendición. Y dijo: ¿No has guardado bendición para mí?

verses.KJV: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
verses.WEB: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”
verses.ASV: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with grain and new wine have I sustained him: and what then shall I do for thee, my son?
verses.ALMEIDA: Isaque respondeu e disse a Esaú: Eis que eu o pus por senhor teu, e lhe dei por servos a todos os seus irmãos: de trigo e de vinho lhe provi: que, pois, farei a ti agora, filho meu?
verses.RVR09: Isaac respondió y dijo á Esaú: He aquí yo le he puesto por señor tuyo, y le he dado por siervos á todos sus hermanos: de trigo y de vino le he provisto: ¿qué, pues, te haré á ti ahora, hijo mío?

verses.KJV: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.WEB: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.ASV: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Esaú respondeu a seu pai: Não tens mais que uma só bênção, meu pai? Abençoa também a mim, meu pai. E levantou Esaú sua voz, e chorou.
verses.RVR09: Y Esaú respondió á su padre: ¿No tienes más que una sola bendición, padre mío? bendíceme también á mí, padre mío. Y alzó Esaú su voz, y lloró.

verses.KJV: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
verses.WEB: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.
verses.ASV: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, of the fatness of the earth shall be thy dwelling, And of the dew of heaven from above;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Isaque seu pai falou e disse-lhe: Eis que será tua habitação sem gorduras da terra, E sem orvalho dos céus de acima;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Isaac su padre habló y díjole: He aquí será tu habitación en grosuras de la tierra, y del rocío de los cielos de arriba;

verses.KJV: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
verses.WEB: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”
verses.ASV: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and thou shalt serve thy brother; And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt break loose, That thou shalt shake his yoke from off thy neck.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por tua espada viverás, e a teu irmão servirás: E sucederá quando te dominares, Que descarregarás seu jugo de teu pescoço.
verses.RVR09: Y por tu espada vivirás, y á tu hermano servirás: y sucederá cuando te enseñorees, que descargarás su yugo de tu cerviz.

verses.KJV: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
verses.WEB: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
verses.ASV: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E odiou Esaú a Jacó pela bênção com que lhe havia abençoado, e disse em seu coração: Chegarão os dias do luto de meu pai, e eu matarei a Jacó meu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y aborreció Esaú á Jacob por la bendición con que le había bendecido, y dijo en su corazón: Llegarán los días del luto de mi padre, y yo mataré á Jacob mi hermano.

verses.KJV: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
verses.WEB: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.
verses.ASV: And the words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah; and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, [purposing] to kill thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram ditas a Rebeca as palavras de Esaú seu filho mais velho: e ela enviou e chamou a Jacó seu filho mais novo, e disse-lhe: Eis que, Esaú teu irmão se consola acerca de ti com a ideia de matar-te.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron dichas á Rebeca las palabras de Esaú su hijo mayor: y ella envió y llamó á Jacob su hijo menor, y díjole: He aquí, Esaú tu hermano se consuela acerca de ti con la idea de matarte.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
verses.WEB: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, filho meu, obedece à minha voz; levanta-te, e foge-te a Labão meu irmão, a Harã.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, hijo mío, obedece á mi voz; levántate, y húyete á Labán mi hermano, á Harán;

verses.KJV: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
verses.WEB: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—
verses.ASV: and tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;
verses.ALMEIDA: E mora com ele alguns dias, até que a ira de teu irmão se diminua;
verses.RVR09: Y mora con él algunos días, hasta que el enojo de tu hermano se mitigue;

verses.KJV: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
verses.WEB: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”
verses.ASV: until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que se aplaque a ira de teu irmão contra ti, e se esqueça do que lhe fizeste: eu enviarei então, e te trarei dali: por que serei privada de vós ambos em um dia?
verses.RVR09: Hasta que se aplaque la ira de tu hermano contra ti, y se olvide de lo que le has hecho: yo enviaré entonces, y te traeré de allá: ¿por qué seré privada de vosotros ambos en un día?

verses.KJV: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
verses.WEB: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”
verses.ASV: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Rebeca a Isaque: Desgosto tenho de minha vida, por causa das filhas de Hete. Se Jacó toma mulher das filhas de Hete, como estas, das filhas desta terra, para que quero a vida?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Rebeca á Isaac: Fastidio tengo de mi vida, á causa de las hijas de Heth. Si Jacob toma mujer de las hijas de Heth, como éstas, de las hijas de esta tierra, ¿para qué quiero la vida?

verses.KJV: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
verses.WEB: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Isaque chamou a Jacó, e o abençoou, e mandou-lhe dizendo: Não tomes mulher das filhas de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES Isaac llamó á Jacob, y bendíjolo, y mandóle diciendo: No tomes mujer de las hijas de Canaán.

verses.KJV: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughers of Laban thy mother's brother.
verses.WEB: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
verses.ASV: Arise, go to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, vai a Padã-Arã, à casa de Betuel, pai de tua mãe, e toma ali mulher das filhas de Labão, irmão de tua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, ve á Padan-aram, á casa de Bethuel, padre de tu madre, y toma allí mujer de las hijas de Labán, hermano de tu madre.

verses.KJV: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
verses.WEB: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,
verses.ASV: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a company of peoples;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Deus Todo-Poderoso te abençoe e te faça frutificar, e te multiplique, até vir a ser congregação de povos;
verses.RVR09: Y el Dios omnipotente te bendiga, y te haga fructificar, y te multiplique, hasta venir á ser congregación de pueblos;

verses.KJV: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
verses.WEB: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”
verses.ASV: and give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land of thy sojournings, which God gave unto Abraham.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te dê a bênção de Abraão, e à tua descendência contigo, para que herdes a terra de tuas peregrinações, que Deus deu a Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y te dé la bendición de Abraham, y á tu simiente contigo, para que heredes la tierra de tus peregrinaciones, que Dios dió á Abraham.

verses.KJV: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.
verses.WEB: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
verses.ASV: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Paddan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim enviou Isaque a Jacó, o qual foi a Padã-Arã, a Labão, filho de Betuel arameu, irmão de Rebeca, mãe de Jacó e de Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Así envió Isaac á Jacob, el cual fué á Padan-aram, á Labán, hijo de Bethuel Arameo, hermano de Rebeca, madre de Jacob y de Esaú.

verses.KJV: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughers of Canaan;
verses.WEB: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”
verses.ASV: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu Esaú como Isaque havia abençoado a Jacó, e lhe havia enviado a Padã-Arã, para tomar para si mulher dali; e que quando lhe abençoou, lhe havia mandado, dizendo: Não tomarás mulher das filhas de Canaã;
verses.RVR09: Y vió Esaú cómo Isaac había bendecido á Jacob, y le había enviado á Padan-aram, para tomar para sí mujer de allí; y que cuando le bendijo, le había mandado, diciendo: No tomarás mujer de las hijas de Canaán;

verses.KJV: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;
verses.WEB: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.
verses.ASV: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan-aram:
verses.ALMEIDA: E que Jacó havia obedecido a seu pai e a sua mãe, e se havia ido a Padã-Arã.
verses.RVR09: Y que Jacob había obedecido á su padre y á su madre, y se había ido á Padan-aram.

verses.KJV: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
verses.WEB: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.
verses.ASV: and Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esaú viu que as filhas de Canaã pareciam mal ao seu pai Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Vió asimismo Esaú que las hijas de Canaán parecían mal á Isaac su padre;

verses.KJV: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
verses.WEB: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.
verses.ASV: and Esau went unto Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Esaú foi a Ismael, e tomou para si por mulher, além de suas outras mulheres, a Maalate, filha de Ismael, filho de Abraão, irmã de Nebaiote.
verses.RVR09: Y fuése Esaú á Ismael, y tomó para sí por mujer á Mahaleth, hija de Ismael, hijo de Abraham, hermana de Nabaioth, además de sus otras mujeres.

verses.KJV: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.WEB: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.ASV: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó saiu de Berseba, e foi a Harã;
verses.RVR09: Y salió Jacob de Beer-seba, y fué á Harán;

verses.KJV: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.WEB: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.ASV: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: ele chegou a um lugar, e ali dormiu, porque o sol já se havia posto. E tomou uma das pedras daquele lugar e a pôs por sua cabeceira, e deitou-se naquele lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y encontró con un lugar, y durmió allí, porque ya el sol se había puesto: y tomó de las piedras de aquel paraje y puso á su cabecera, y acostóse en aquel lugar.

verses.KJV: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
verses.WEB: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
verses.ASV: And he dreamed; and behold, a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven; and behold, the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sonhou, e eis uma escada que estava posta na terra, e seu topo tocava no céu; e eis que anjos de Deus subiam e desciam por ela.
verses.RVR09: Y soñó, y he aquí una escala que estaba apoyada en tierra, y su cabeza tocaba en el cielo: y he aquí ángeles de Dios que subían y descendían por ella.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the Lord stood above it, and said, I am the Lord God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.
verses.ASV: And, behold, Jehovah stood above it, and said, I am Jehovah, the God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que o SENHOR estava no alto dela, e disse: “Eu sou o SENHOR, o Deus de teu pai Abraão, e o Deus de Isaque; a terra em que estás deitado, eu a darei a ti e à tua descendência.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, Jehová estaba en lo alto de ella, el cual dijo: Yo soy Jehová, el Dios de Abraham tu padre, y el Dios de Isaac: la tierra en que estás acostado te la daré á ti y á tu simiente.

verses.KJV: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.WEB: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.
verses.ASV: and thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a tua descendência será como o pó da terra, e te estenderás ao ocidente, ao oriente, ao norte, e ao sul; e todas as famílias da terra serão abençoadas em ti e na tua descendência.
verses.RVR09: Y será tu simiente como el polvo de la tierra, y te extenderás al occidente, y al oriente, y al aquilón, y al mediodía; y todas las familias de la tierra serán benditas en ti y en tu simiente.

verses.KJV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
verses.WEB: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
verses.ASV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que eu estou contigo, e te guardarei por onde quer que fores, e te farei voltar a esta terra; porque não te deixarei, até que eu tenha feito o que te disse.”
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, yo soy contigo, y te guardaré por donde quiera que fueres, y te volveré á esta tierra; porque no te dejaré hasta tanto que haya hecho lo que te he dicho.

verses.KJV: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not.
verses.WEB: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely Jehovah is in this place; and I knew it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jacó despertou-se de seu sonho, e disse: “Certamente o SENHOR está neste lugar, e eu não sabia.”
verses.RVR09: Y despertó Jacob de su sueño, y dijo: Ciertamente Jehová está en este lugar, y yo no lo sabía.

verses.KJV: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
verses.WEB: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”
verses.ASV: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teve medo, e disse: “Quão temível é este lugar! Não é outra coisa, senão casa de Deus e porta do céu.”
verses.RVR09: Y tuvo miedo, y dijo: ¡Cuán terrible es este lugar! No es otra cosa que casa de Dios, y puerta del cielo.

verses.KJV: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
verses.WEB: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.
verses.ASV: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jacó levantou-se de manhã cedo, tomou a pedra que havia colocado de cabeceira, e a pôs por coluna, e derramou azeite sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Jacob de mañana, y tomó la piedra que había puesto de cabecera, y alzóla por título, y derramó aceite encima de ella.

verses.KJV: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
verses.WEB: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
verses.ASV: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou o nome daquele lugar Betel, porém antes o nome da cidade era Luz.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Beth-el, bien que Luz era el nombre de la ciudad primero.

verses.KJV: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
verses.WEB: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,
verses.ASV: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó fez um voto, dizendo: “Se Deus for comigo, e me guardar nesta viagem que vou, e me der pão para comer e roupa para vestir,
verses.RVR09: E hizo Jacob voto, diciendo: Si fuere Dios conmigo, y me guardare en este viaje que voy, y me diere pan para comer y vestido para vestir,

verses.KJV: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the Lord be my God:
verses.WEB: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,
verses.ASV: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Jehovah will be my God,
verses.ALMEIDA: e se eu voltar em paz à casa de meu pai, o SENHOR será meu Deus,
verses.RVR09: Y si tornare en paz á casa de mi padre, Jehová será mi Dios,

verses.KJV: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
verses.WEB: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”
verses.ASV: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: e esta pedra que pus por coluna será casa de Deus; e de tudo o que me deres, darei a ti o dízimo.
verses.RVR09: Y esta piedra que he puesto por título, será casa de Dios: y de todo lo que me dieres, el diezmo lo he de apartar para ti.

verses.KJV: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
verses.WEB: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
verses.ASV: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó seguiu o seu caminho, e foi à terra dos filhos do oriente.
verses.RVR09: Y SIGUIÓ Jacob su camino, y fué á la tierra de los orientales.

verses.KJV: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.
verses.WEB: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.
verses.ASV: And he looked, and, behold, a well in the field, and, lo, three flocks of sheep lying there by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and the stone upon the well’s mouth was great.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhou, e viu um poço no campo: e eis três rebanhos de ovelhas que estavam deitados próximo dele; porque daquele poço davam de beber aos gados: e havia uma grande pedra sobre a boca do poço.
verses.RVR09: Y miró, y vió un pozo en el campo: y he aquí tres rebaños de ovejas que yacían cerca de él; porque de aquel pozo abrevaban los ganados: y había una gran piedra sobre la boca del pozo.

verses.KJV: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.
verses.WEB: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.
verses.ASV: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in its place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntavam-se ali todos os rebanhos; e revolviam a pedra de sobre a boca do poço, e davam de beber às ovelhas; e voltavam a pedra sobre a boca do poço a seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y juntábanse allí todos los rebaños; y revolvían la piedra de sobre la boca del pozo, y abrevaban las ovejas; y volvían la piedra sobre la boca del pozo á su lugar.

verses.KJV: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
verses.WEB: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence are ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes Jacó: Irmãos meus, de onde sois? E eles responderam: De Harã somos.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Jacob: Hermanos míos, ¿de dónde sois? Y ellos respondieron: De Harán somos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Conheceis a Labão, filho de Naor? E eles disseram: Sim, nós o conhecemos.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: ¿Conocéis á Labán, hijo de Nachôr? Y ellos dijeron: Sí, le conocemos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Is it well with him? And they said, It is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Ele está bem? E eles disseram: Está bem; e eis que Raquel sua filha vem com o gado.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: ¿Tiene paz? Y ellos dijeron: Paz; y he aquí Rachêl su hija viene con el ganado.

verses.KJV: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
verses.WEB: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Eis que ainda é cedo do dia; não é hora de recolher o gado; dai de beber às ovelhas, e ide apascentá-las.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: He aquí el día es aún grande; no es tiempo todavía de recoger el ganado; abrevad las ovejas, é id á apacentarlas.

verses.KJV: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.
verses.WEB: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”
verses.ASV: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: Não podemos, até que se juntem todos os gados, e removam a pedra de sobre a boca do poço, para que demos de beber às ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: No podemos, hasta que se junten todos los ganados, y remuevan la piedra de sobre la boca del pozo, para que abrevemos las ovejas.

verses.KJV: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she kept them.
verses.WEB: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
verses.ASV: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep; for she kept them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estando ainda ele falando com eles Raquel veio com o gado de seu pai, porque ela era a pastora.
verses.RVR09: Estando aún él hablando con ellos, Rachêl vino con el ganado de su padre, porque ella era la pastora.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.
verses.WEB: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, quando Jacó viu Raquel, filha de Labão irmão de sua mãe, e as ovelhas de Labão, o irmão de sua mãe, chegou-se Jacó, e removeu a pedra de sobre a boca do poço, e deu de beber ao gado de Labão irmão de sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que, como Jacob vió á Rachêl, hija de Labán hermano de su madre, y á las ovejas de Labán el hermano de su madre, llegóse Jacob, y removió la piedra de sobre la boca del pozo, y abrevó el ganado de Labán hermano de su madre.

verses.KJV: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.WEB: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.ASV: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó beijou a Raquel, e levantou sua voz, e chorou.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob besó á Rachêl, y alzó su voz, y lloró.

verses.KJV: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
verses.WEB: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.
verses.ASV: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó disse a Raquel como ele era irmão de seu pai, e como era filho de Rebeca: e ela correu, e deu as novas a seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob dijo á Rachêl como él era hermano de su padre, y como era hijo de Rebeca: y ella corrió, y dió las nuevas á su padre.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
verses.WEB: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim que ouviu Labão as novas de Jacó, filho de sua irmã, correu a recebê-lo, e abraçou-o, e beijou-o, e trouxe-lhe à sua casa: e ele contou a Labão todas estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y así que oyó Labán las nuevas de Jacob, hijo de su hermana, corrió á recibirlo, y abrazólo, y besólo, y trájole á su casa: y él contó á Labán todas estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
verses.WEB: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.
verses.ASV: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Labão lhe disse: Certamente és osso meu e carne minha. E esteve com ele durante um mês.
verses.RVR09: Y Labán le dijo: Ciertamente hueso mío y carne mía eres. Y estuvo con él el tiempo de un mes.

verses.KJV: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
verses.WEB: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
verses.ASV: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Labão a Jacó: Por ser tu meu irmão, me hás de servir de graça? Declara-me o que será teu salário.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Labán á Jacob: ¿Por ser tú mi hermano, me has de servir de balde? declárame qué será tu salario.

verses.KJV: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.WEB: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.ASV: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Labão tinha duas filhas: o nome da mais velha era Lia, e o nome da mais nova, Raquel.
verses.RVR09: Y Labán tenía dos hijas: el nombre de la mayor era Lea, y el nombre de la menor, Rachêl.

verses.KJV: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
verses.WEB: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
verses.ASV: And Leah’s eyes were tender; but Rachel was beautiful and well favored.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os olhos de Lia eram tenros, mas Raquel era de lindo semblante e de bela aparência.
verses.RVR09: Y los ojos de Lea eran tiernos, pero Rachêl era de lindo semblante y de hermoso parecer.

verses.KJV: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
verses.WEB: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob loved Rachel; and he said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó amou a Raquel, e disse: Eu te servirei sete anos por Raquel tua filha mais nova.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob amó á Rachêl, y dijo: Yo te serviré siete años por Rachêl tu hija menor.

verses.KJV: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
verses.WEB: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
verses.ASV: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Labão respondeu: Melhor é que a dê a ti, que não que a dê a outro homem: fica-te comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y Labán respondió: Mejor es que te la dé á ti, que no que la dé á otro hombre: estáte conmigo.

verses.KJV: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
verses.WEB: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
verses.ASV: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim serviu Jacó por Raquel sete anos: e pareceram-lhe como poucos dias, porque a amava.
verses.RVR09: Así sirvió Jacob por Rachêl siete años: y pareciéronle como pocos días, porque la amaba.

verses.KJV: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
verses.WEB: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jacó a Labão: Dá-me minha mulher, porque meu tempo é cumprido para que me deite com ela.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jacob á Labán: Dame mi mujer, porque mi tiempo es cumplido, para que cohabite con ella.

verses.KJV: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
verses.WEB: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
verses.ASV: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Labão juntou a todos os homens daquele lugar, e fez banquete.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Labán juntó á todos los varones de aquel lugar, é hizo banquete.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
verses.WEB: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que à noite tomou sua filha Lia, e a trouxe; e ele se deitou com ela.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que á la noche tomó á Lea su hija, y se la trajo: y él entró á ella.

verses.KJV: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.
verses.WEB: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
verses.ASV: And Laban gave Zilpah his handmaid unto his daughter Leah for a handmaid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu Labão sua serva Zilpa à sua filha Lia por criada.
verses.RVR09: Y dió Labán su sierva Zilpa á su hija Lea por criada.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
verses.WEB: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning that, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E vinda a manhã, eis que era Lia: e ele disse a Labão: Que é isto que me fizeste? Não te servi por Raquel? Por que, pois, me enganaste?
verses.RVR09: Y venida la mañana, he aquí que era Lea: y él dijo á Labán: ¿Qué es esto que me has hecho? ¿no te he servido por Rachêl? ¿por qué, pues, me has engañado?

verses.KJV: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
verses.WEB: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
verses.ASV: And Laban said, It is not so done in our place, to give the younger before the first-born.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Labão respondeu: Não se faz assim em nosso lugar, que se dê a mais nova antes da mais velha.
verses.RVR09: Y Labán respondió: No se hace así en nuestro lugar, que se dé la menor antes de la mayor.

verses.KJV: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
verses.WEB: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”
verses.ASV: Fulfil the week of this one, and we will give thee the other also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cumpre a semana desta, e se te dará também a outra, pelo serviço que fizeres comigo por outros sete anos.
verses.RVR09: Cumple la semana de ésta, y se te dará también la otra, por el servicio que hicieres conmigo otros siete años.

verses.KJV: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
verses.WEB: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.
verses.ASV: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Jacó assim, e cumpriu a semana daquela; e ele lhe deu a sua filha Raquel por mulher.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Jacob así, y cumplió la semana de aquélla: y él le dió á Rachêl su hija por mujer.

verses.KJV: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
verses.WEB: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.
verses.ASV: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her handmaid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu Labão a Raquel sua filha por criada a sua serva Bila.
verses.RVR09: Y dió Labán á Rachêl su hija por criada á su sierva Bilha.

verses.KJV: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
verses.WEB: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.
verses.ASV: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deitou-se também com Raquel: e amou-a também mais que a Lia: e serviu a ele ainda outros sete anos.
verses.RVR09: Y entró también á Rachêl: y amóla también más que á Lea: y sirvió con él aún otros siete años.

verses.KJV: And when the Lord saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
verses.WEB: The LORD saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu o SENHOR que Lia era mal-amada, e abriu sua madre; mas Raquel era estéril.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Jehová que Lea era aborrecida, y abrió su matriz: pero Rachêl era estéril.

verses.KJV: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the Lord hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
verses.WEB: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because the LORD has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”
verses.ASV: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Because Jehovah hath looked upon my affliction; for now my husband will love me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu Lia, e deu à luz um filho, e chamou seu nome Rúben, porque disse: Já que olhou o SENHOR minha aflição; agora, portanto, meu marido me amará.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió Lea, y parió un hijo, y llamó su nombre Rubén, porque dijo: Ya que ha mirado Jehová mi aflicción; ahora por tanto me amará mi marido.

verses.KJV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the Lord hath heard I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
verses.WEB: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.
verses.ASV: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and said, Because Jehovah hath heard that I am hated, he hath therefore given me this [son] also: and she called his name Simeon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Porquanto ouviu o SENHOR que eu era mal-amada, me deu também este. E chamou seu nome Simeão.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió otra vez, y parió un hijo, y dijo: Por cuanto oyó Jehová que yo era aborrecida, me ha dado también éste. Y llamó su nombre Simeón.

verses.KJV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
verses.WEB: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.
verses.ASV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have borne him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Agora esta vez meu marido se apegará a mim, porque lhe dei três filhos; portanto, chamou seu nome Levi.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió otra vez, y parió un hijo, y dijo: Ahora esta vez se unirá mi marido conmigo, porque le he parido tres hijos: por tanto, llamó su nombre Leví.

verses.KJV: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the Lord: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.
verses.WEB: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
verses.ASV: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, This time will I praise Jehovah: therefore she called his name Judah; and she left off bearing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Esta vez louvarei ao SENHOR; por isto chamou seu nome Judá; e deixou de dar à luz.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió otra vez, y parió un hijo, y dijo: Esta vez alabaré á Jehová: por esto llamó su nombre Judá: y dejó de parir.

verses.KJV: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
verses.WEB: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”
verses.ASV: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and she said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Raquel que não dava filhos a Jacó, teve inveja de sua irmã, e dizia a Jacó: Dá-me filhos, ou senão, morro.
verses.RVR09: Y VIENDO Rachêl que no daba hijos á Jacob, tuvo envidia de su hermana, y decía á Jacob: Dame hijos, ó si no, me muero.

verses.KJV: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
verses.WEB: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”
verses.ASV: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó se irritava contra Raquel, e dizia: Estou eu em lugar de Deus, que te impediu o fruto de teu ventre?
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob se enojaba contra Rachêl, y decía: ¿Soy yo en lugar de Dios, que te impidió el fruto de tu vientre?

verses.KJV: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.
verses.WEB: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”
verses.ASV: And she said, Behold, my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; that she may bear upon my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse: Eis aqui minha serva Bila; deita-te com ela, e dará à luz sobre meus joelhos, e eu também terei filhos por meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: He aquí mi sierva Bilha; entra á ella, y parirá sobre mis rodillas, y yo también tendré hijos de ella.

verses.KJV: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
verses.WEB: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
verses.ASV: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim lhe deu a Bila sua serva por mulher; e Jacó se deitou com ela.
verses.RVR09: Así le dió á Bilha su sierva por mujer; y Jacob entró á ella.

verses.KJV: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
verses.WEB: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
verses.ASV: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu Bila, e deu à luz a Jacó um filho.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió Bilha, y parió á Jacob un hijo.

verses.KJV: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
verses.WEB: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.
verses.ASV: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Raquel: Julgou-me Deus, e também ouviu minha voz, e deu-me um filho. Portanto chamou seu nome Dã.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Rachêl: Juzgóme Dios, y también oyó mi voz, y dióme un hijo. Por tanto llamó su nombre Dan.

verses.KJV: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
verses.WEB: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
verses.ASV: And Bilhah Rachel’s handmaid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu outra vez Bila, a serva de Raquel, e deu à luz o segundo filho a Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió otra vez Bilha, la sierva de Rachêl, y parió el hijo segundo á Jacob.

verses.KJV: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
verses.WEB: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
verses.ASV: And Rachel said, With mighty wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Raquel: Com lutas de Deus disputei com minha irmã, e venci. E chamou seu nome Naftali.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Rachêl: Con luchas de Dios he contendido con mi hermana, y he vencido. Y llamó su nombre Nephtalí.

verses.KJV: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
verses.WEB: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.ASV: When Leah saw that she had left off bearing, she took Zilpah her handmaid, and gave her to Jacob to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Lia que havia deixado de dar à luz, tomou a Zilpa sua serva, e deu-a a Jacó por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Lea que había dejado de parir, tomó á Zilpa su sierva, y dióla á Jacob por mujer.

verses.KJV: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.
verses.WEB: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.
verses.ASV: And Zilpah Leah’s handmaid bare Jacob a son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zilpa, serva de Lia, deu à luz a Jacó um filho.
verses.RVR09: Y Zilpa, sierva de Lea, parió á Jacob un hijo.

verses.KJV: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
verses.WEB: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
verses.ASV: And Leah said, Fortunate! and she called his name Gad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Lia: Veio a boa sorte. E chamou seu nome Gade.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Lea: Vino la ventura. Y llamó su nombre Gad.

verses.KJV: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.
verses.WEB: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.
verses.ASV: And Zilpah Leah’s handmaid bare Jacob a second son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zilpa, a sirva de Lia, deu à luz outro filho a Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y Zilpa, la sierva de Lea, parió otro hijo á Jacob.

verses.KJV: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
verses.WEB: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
verses.ASV: And Leah said, Happy am I! for the daughters will call me happy: and she called his name Asher.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Lia: Para alegria minha; porque as mulheres me chamarão de feliz; e chamou seu nome Aser.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Lea: Para dicha mía; porque las mujeres me dirán dichosa: y llamó su nombre Aser.

verses.KJV: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
verses.WEB: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
verses.ASV: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi Rúben em tempo da colheita dos trigos, e achou mandrágoras no campo, e trouxe-as a sua mãe Lia; e disse Raquel a Lia: Rogo-te que me dês das mandrágoras de teu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Rubén en tiempo de la siega de los trigos, y halló mandrágoras en el campo, y trájolas á Lea su madre: y dijo Rachêl á Lea: Ruégote que me des de las mandrágoras de tu hijo.

verses.KJV: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.
verses.WEB: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”
verses.ASV: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken away my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to-night for thy son’s mandrakes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela respondeu: É pouco que tenhas tomado meu marido, mas também levarás as mandrágoras de meu filho? E disse Raquel: Ele, pois, dormirá contigo esta noite pelas mandrágoras de teu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y ella respondió: ¿Es poco que hayas tomado mi marido, sino que también te has de llevar las mandrágoras de mi hijo? y dijo Rachêl: Pues dormirá contigo esta noche por las mandrágoras de tu hijo.

verses.KJV: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
verses.WEB: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.
verses.ASV: And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for I have surely hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Jacó voltava do campo à tarde, Lia saiu ao encontro dele, e lhe disse: Deitarás comigo, porque em verdade te aluguei em troca das mandrágoras de meu filho. E dormiu com ela naquela noite.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Jacob volvía del campo á la tarde, salió Lea á él, y le dijo: A mí has de entrar, porque á la verdad te he alquilado por las mandrágoras de mi hijo. Y durmió con ella aquella noche.

verses.KJV: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
verses.WEB: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
verses.ASV: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a fifth son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Deus a Lia; e concebeu, e deu à luz a Jacó o quinto filho.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Dios á Lea: y concibió, y parió á Jacob el quinto hijo.

verses.KJV: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
verses.WEB: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
verses.ASV: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I gave my handmaid to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Lia: Deus me deu minha recompensa, porque dei minha serva a meu marido; por isso chamou seu nome Issacar.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Lea: Dios me ha dado mi recompensa, por cuanto dí mi sierva á mi marido: por eso llamó su nombre Issachâr.

verses.KJV: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
verses.WEB: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
verses.ASV: And Leah conceived again, and bare a sixth son to Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu Lia outra vez, e deu à luz o sexto filho a Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió Lea otra vez, y parió el sexto hijo á Jacob.

verses.KJV: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
verses.WEB: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.
verses.ASV: And Leah said, God hath endowed me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Lia: Deus me deu uma boa dádiva: agora meu marido morará comigo, porque lhe dei seis filhos; e chamou seu nome Zebulom.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Lea: Dios me ha dado una buena dote: ahora morará conmigo mi marido, porque le he parido seis hijos: y llamó su nombre Zabulón.

verses.KJV: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.WEB: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.
verses.ASV: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois deu à luz uma filha, e chamou seu nome Diná.
verses.RVR09: Y después parió una hija, y llamó su nombre Dina.

verses.KJV: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.WEB: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.ASV: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lembrou-se Deus de Raquel, e Deus a ouviu, e abriu sua madre.
verses.RVR09: Y acordóse Dios de Rachêl, y oyóla Dios, y abrió su matriz.

verses.KJV: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
verses.WEB: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”
verses.ASV: And she conceived, and bare a son: and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu, e deu à luz um filho: e disse: Deus tirou minha humilhação;
verses.RVR09: Y concibió, y parió un hijo: y dijo: Quitado ha Dios mi afrenta:

verses.KJV: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The Lord shall add to me another son.
verses.WEB: She named him Joseph, saying, “May the LORD add another son to me.”
verses.ASV: and she called his name Joseph, saying, Jehovah add to me another son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou seu nome José, dizendo: Acrescente-me o SENHOR outro filho.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó su nombre José, diciendo: Añádame Jehová otro hijo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
verses.WEB: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, quando Raquel havia dado à luz a José, que Jacó disse a Labão: Permite-me ir embora, e irei a meu lugar, e à minha terra.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, cuando Rachêl hubo parido á José, que Jacob dijo á Labán: Envíame, é iré á mi lugar, y á mi tierra.

verses.KJV: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
verses.WEB: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”
verses.ASV: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service wherewith I have served thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-me minhas mulheres e meus filhos, pelas quais servi contigo, e deixa-me ir; pois tu sabes os serviços que te fiz.
verses.RVR09: Dame mis mujeres y mis hijos, por las cuales he servido contigo, y déjame ir; pues tú sabes los servicios que te he hecho.

verses.KJV: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the Lord hath blessed me for thy sake.
verses.WEB: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that the LORD has blessed me for your sake.”
verses.ASV: And Laban said unto him, If now I have found favor in thine eyes, [tarry]: [for] I have divined that Jehovah hath blessed me for thy sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Labão lhe respondeu: Ache eu agora favor em teus olhos, e fica-te; experimentei que o SENHOR me abençoou por tua causa.
verses.RVR09: Y Labán le respondió: Halle yo ahora gracia en tus ojos, y quédate; experimentado he que Jehová me ha bendecido por tu causa.

verses.KJV: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
verses.WEB: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Define-me teu salário, que eu o darei.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Señálame tu salario, que yo lo daré.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
verses.WEB: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle have fared with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Tu sabes como te servi, e como esteve teu gado comigo;
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Tú sabes cómo te he servido, y cómo ha estado tu ganado conmigo;

verses.KJV: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the Lord hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
verses.WEB: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. The LORD has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”
verses.ASV: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it hath increased unto a multitude; and Jehovah hath blessed thee whithersoever I turned: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pouco tinhas antes de minha vinda, e cresceu em grande número; e o SENHOR te abençoou com minha chegada: e agora quando tenho de fazer eu também por minha própria casa?
verses.RVR09: Porque poco tenías antes de mi venida, y ha crecido en gran número; y Jehová te ha bendecido con mi llegada: y ahora ¿cuándo tengo de hacer yo también por mi propia casa?

verses.KJV: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.
verses.WEB: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.
verses.ASV: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me aught: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed thy flock and keep it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Que te darei? E respondeu Jacó: Não me dês nada; se fizeres por mim isto, voltarei a apascentar tuas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: ¿Qué te daré? Y respondió Jacob: No me des nada: si hicieres por mí esto, volveré á apacentar tus ovejas.

verses.KJV: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
verses.WEB: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.
verses.ASV: I will pass through all thy flock to-day, removing from thence every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and [of such] shall be my hire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu passarei hoje por todas tuas ovelhas, pondo à parte todas as reses manchadas e de cor variada, e todas as reses de cor escura entre as ovelhas, e as manchadas e de cor variada entre as cabras; e isto será meu salário.
verses.RVR09: Yo pasaré hoy por todas tus ovejas, poniendo aparte todas las reses manchadas y de color vario, y todas las reses de color oscuro entre las ovejas, y las manchadas y de color vario entre las cabras; y esto será mi salario.

verses.KJV: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
verses.WEB: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”
verses.ASV: So shall my righteousness answer for me hereafter, when thou shalt come concerning my hire that is before thee: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that, [if found] with me, shall be counted stolen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim responderá por mim minha justiça amanhã quando me vier meu salário diante de ti: toda a que não for pintada nem manchada nas cabras e de cor escura nas ovelhas minhas, se me há de ter para furto.
verses.RVR09: Así responderá por mí mi justicia mañana, cuando me viniere mi salario delante de ti: toda la que no fuere pintada ni manchada en las cabras y de color oscuro en las ovejas mías, se me ha de tener por de hurto.

verses.KJV: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
verses.WEB: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”
verses.ASV: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Labão: Eis que seja como tu dizes.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Labán: Mira, ojalá fuese como tú dices.

verses.KJV: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.WEB: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.ASV: And he removed that day the he-goats that were ringstreaked and spotted, and all the she-goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele separou naquele mesmo dia os machos de bode rajados e manchados; e todas as cabras manchadas e de cor variada, e toda rês que tinha em si algo de branco, e todas as de cor escura entre as ovelhas, e as pôs em mãos de seus filhos;
verses.RVR09: Y apartó aquel día los machos de cabrío rayados y manchados; y todas las cabras manchadas y de color vario, y toda res que tenía en sí algo de blanco, y todas las de color oscuro entre las ovejas, y púsolas en manos de sus hijos;

verses.KJV: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
verses.WEB: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
verses.ASV: and he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs três dias de caminho entre si e Jacó: e Jacó apascentava as outras ovelhas de Labão.
verses.RVR09: Y puso tres días de camino entre sí y Jacob: y Jacob apacentaba las otras ovejas de Labán.

verses.KJV: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.WEB: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.ASV: And Jacob took him rods of fresh poplar, and of the almond and of the plane-tree; and peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou para si Jacó varas de álamo verdes, e de aveleira, e de plátano, e descascou nelas mondaduras brancas, descobrindo assim o branco das varas.
verses.RVR09: Y tomóse Jacob varas de álamo verdes, y de avellano, y de castaño, y descortezó en ellas mondaduras blancas, descubriendo así lo blanco de las varas.

verses.KJV: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.WEB: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.
verses.ASV: And he set the rods which he had peeled over against the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink; and they conceived when they came to drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs as varas que havia riscado nos bebedouros, diante do gado, nos bebedouros da água aonde vinham a beber as ovelhas, as quais se aqueciam vindo a beber.
verses.RVR09: Y puso las varas que había mondado en las pilas, delante del ganado, en los abrevaderos del agua donde venían á beber las ovejas, las cuales se recalentaban viniendo á beber.

verses.KJV: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.WEB: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.ASV: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks brought forth ringstreaked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebiam as ovelhas diante das varas, e geravam crias listradas, pintadas e salpicadas de diversas cores.
verses.RVR09: Y concebían las ovejas delante de las varas, y parían borregos listados, pintados y salpicados de diversos colores.

verses.KJV: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.
verses.WEB: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.
verses.ASV: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstreaked and all the black in the flock of Laban: and he put his own droves apart, and put them not unto Laban’s flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: E separava Jacó os cordeiros, e os punha com seu rebanho, os listradas, e tudo o que era escuro no rebanho de Labão. E punha seu rebanho à parte, e não o punha com as ovelhas de Labão.
verses.RVR09: Y apartaba Jacob los corderos, y poníalos con su rebaño, los listados, y todo lo que era oscuro en el hato de Labán. Y ponía su hato aparte, y no lo ponía con las ovejas de Labán.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.WEB: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger of the flock did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedia que quantas vezes se aqueciam as fortes, Jacó punha as varas diante das ovelhas nos bebedouros, para que concebessem à vista das varas.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedía que cuantas veces se recalentaban las tempranas, Jacob ponía las varas delante de las ovejas en las pilas, para que concibiesen á la vista de las varas.

verses.KJV: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
verses.WEB: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
verses.ASV: but when the flock were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vinham as ovelhas fracas, não as punha: assim eram as fracas para Labão, e as fortes para Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando venían las ovejas tardías, no las ponía: así eran las tardías para Labán, y las tempranas para Jacob.

verses.KJV: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.WEB: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.ASV: And the man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, and maid-servants and men-servants, and camels and asses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cresceu o homem muito, e teve muitas ovelhas, e servas, servos, camelos, e asnos.
verses.RVR09: Y acreció el varón muy mucho, y tuvo muchas ovejas, y siervas y siervos, y camellos y asnos.

verses.KJV: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
verses.WEB: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”
verses.ASV: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father’s; and of that which was our father’s hath he gotten all this glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvia ele as palavras dos filhos de Labão que diziam: Jacó tomou tudo o que era de nosso pai; e do que era de nosso pai adquiriu toda esta grandeza.
verses.RVR09: Y OÍA él las palabras de los hijos de Labán, que decían: Jacob ha tomado todo lo que era de nuestro padre; y de lo que era de nuestro padre ha adquirido toda esta grandeza.

verses.KJV: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
verses.WEB: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
verses.ASV: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as beforetime.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhava também Jacó o semblante de Labão, e via que não era para com ele como antes.
verses.RVR09: Miraba también Jacob el semblante de Labán, y veía que no era para con él como ayer y antes de ayer.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o SENHOR disse a Jacó: Volta-te à terra de teus pais, e à tua parentela; que eu serei contigo.
