verses.RVR09: También Jehová dijo á Jacob: Vuélvete á la tierra de tus padres, y á tu parentela; que yo seré contigo.

verses.KJV: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
verses.WEB: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,
verses.ASV: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Jacó, e chamou a Raquel e a Lia ao campo a suas ovelhas,
verses.RVR09: Y envió Jacob, y llamó á Rachêl y á Lea al campo á sus ovejas,

verses.KJV: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
verses.WEB: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
verses.ASV: and said unto them, I see your father’s countenance, that it is not toward me as beforetime; but the God of my father hath been with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Vejo que o semblante de vosso pai não é para comigo como antes: mas o Deus de meu pai tem sido comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: Veo que el semblante de vuestro padre no es para conmigo como ayer y antes de ayer: mas el Dios de mi padre ha sido conmigo.

verses.KJV: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.WEB: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.
verses.ASV: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós sabeis que com todas minhas forças servi a vosso pai:
verses.RVR09: Y vosotras sabéis que con todas mis fuerzas he servido á vuestro padre:

verses.KJV: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
verses.WEB: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
verses.ASV: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vosso pai me enganou, e me mudou o salário dez vezes: mas Deus não lhe permitiu que me fizesse mal.
verses.RVR09: Y vuestro padre me ha engañado, y me ha mudado el salario diez veces: pero Dios no le ha permitido que me hiciese mal.

verses.KJV: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
verses.WEB: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.
verses.ASV: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the flock bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstreaked shall be thy wages; then bare all the flock ringstreaked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ele dizia assim: Os pintados serão teu salário; então todas as ovelhas geravam pintados: e se dizia assim: Os listrados serão teu salário; então todas as ovelhas geravam listrados.
verses.RVR09: Si él decía así: Los pintados serán tu salario; entonces todas las ovejas parían pintados: y si decía así: Los listados serán tu salario; entonces todas las ovejas parían listados.

verses.KJV: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
verses.WEB: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
verses.ASV: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim tirou Deus o gado de vosso pai, e deu-o a mim.
verses.RVR09: Así quitó Dios el ganado de vuestro padre, y diómelo á mí.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
verses.WEB: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the time that the flock conceive, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the he-goats which leaped upon the flock were ringstreaked, speckled, and grizzled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que ao tempo que as ovelhas se aqueciam, levantei eu meus olhos e vi em sonhos, e eis que os machos que cobriam às fêmeas eram listrados, pintados e malhados.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que al tiempo que las ovejas se recalentaban, alcé yo mis ojos y vi en sueños, y he aquí los machos que cubrían á las hembras eran listados, pintados y abigarrados.

verses.KJV: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
verses.WEB: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’
verses.ASV: And the angel of God said unto me in the dream, Jacob: and I said, Here am I.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-me o anjo de Deus em sonhos: Jacó. E eu disse: Eis-me aqui.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome el ángel de Dios en sueños: Jacob. Y yo dije: Heme aquí.

verses.KJV: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
verses.WEB: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.
verses.ASV: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see: all the he-goats which leap upon the flock are ringstreaked, speckled, and grizzled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Levanta agora teus olhos, e verás todos os machos que cobrem às ovelhas são listrados, pintados e malhados; porque eu vi tudo o que Labão te fez.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Alza ahora tus ojos, y verás todos los machos que cubren á las ovejas listados, pintados y abigarrados; porque yo he visto todo lo que Labán te ha hecho.

verses.KJV: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
verses.WEB: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”
verses.ASV: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou anointedst a pillar, where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy nativity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o Deus de Betel, onde tu ungiste a coluna, e onde me fizeste um voto. Levanta-te agora, e sai desta terra, e volta-te à terra de teu nascimento.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el Dios de Beth-el, donde tú ungiste el título, y donde me hiciste un voto. Levántate ahora, y sal de esta tierra, y vuélvete á la tierra de tu naturaleza.

verses.KJV: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
verses.WEB: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
verses.ASV: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Raquel e Lia, e disseram-lhe: Temos ainda parte ou herança na casa de nosso pai?
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Rachêl y Lea, y dijéronle: ¿Tenemos ya parte ni heredad en la casa de nuestro padre?

verses.KJV: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
verses.WEB: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
verses.ASV: Are we not accounted by him as foreigners? for he hath sold us, and hath also quite devoured our money.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não nos tem já como por estranhas, pois que nos vendeu, e ainda consumiu de todo nosso valor?
verses.RVR09: ¿No nos tiene ya como por extrañas, pues que nos vendió, y aun se ha comido del todo nuestro precio?

verses.KJV: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
verses.WEB: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”
verses.ASV: For all the riches which God hath taken away from our father, that is ours and our children’s: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque toda a riqueza que Deus tirou a nosso pai, nossa é e de nossos filhos: agora, pois, faze tudo o que Deus te disse.
verses.RVR09: Porque toda la riqueza que Dios ha quitado á nuestro padre, nuestra es y de nuestros hijos: ahora pues, haz todo lo que Dios te ha dicho.

verses.KJV: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
verses.WEB: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
verses.ASV: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon the camels;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se levantou Jacó, e subiu seus filhos e suas mulheres sobre os camelos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se levantó Jacob, y subió sus hijos y sus mujeres sobre los camellos.

verses.KJV: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: and he carried away all his cattle, and all his substance which he had gathered, the cattle of his getting, which he had gathered in Paddan-aram, to go to Isaac his father unto the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs em caminho todo seu gado, e todos os seus pertences que havia adquirido, o gado de seu ganho que havia obtido em Padã-Arã, para voltar-se a Isaque seu pai na terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Y puso en camino todo su ganado, y toda su hacienda que había adquirido, el ganado de su ganancia que había obtenido en Padan-aram, para volverse á Isaac su padre en la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
verses.WEB: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.
verses.ASV: Now Laban was gone to shear his sheep: and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Labão havia ido tosquiar suas ovelhas; e Raquel furtou os ídolos de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y Labán había ido á trasquilar sus ovejas: y Rachêl hurtó los ídolos de su padre.

verses.KJV: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
verses.WEB: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.
verses.ASV: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enganou Jacó o coração de Labão arameu, em não lhe fazer saber que se fugia.
verses.RVR09: Y recató Jacob el corazón de Labán Arameo, en no hacerle saber que se huía.

verses.KJV: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
verses.WEB: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.
verses.ASV: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fugiu, pois, com tudo o que tinha; e levantou-se, e passou o rio, e pôs seu rosto ao monte de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Huyó, pues, con todo lo que tenía; y levantóse, y pasó el río, y puso su rostro al monte de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.WEB: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
verses.ASV: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dito a Labão ao terceiro dia como Jacó havia fugido.
verses.RVR09: Y fué dicho á Labán al tercero día como Jacob se había huído.

verses.KJV: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
verses.WEB: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.ASV: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey; and he overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomou a seus irmãos consigo, e foi atrás dele caminho de sete dias, e alcançou-lhe no monte de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Entonces tomó á sus hermanos consigo, y fué tras él camino de siete días, y alcanzóle en el monte de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.WEB: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”
verses.ASV: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said unto him, Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Deus a Labão arameu em sonhos aquela noite, e lhe disse: Guarda-te que não fales a Jacó descomedidamente.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Dios á Labán Arameo en sueños aquella noche, y le dijo: Guárdate que no hables á Jacob descomedidamente.

verses.KJV: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
verses.WEB: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.ASV: And Laban came up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain: and Laban with his brethren encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alcançou, pois, Labão a Jacó, e este havia fixado sua tenda no monte: e Labão pôs a sua com seus irmãos no monte de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Alcanzó pues Labán á Jacob, y éste había fijado su tienda en el monte: y Labán plantóla con sus hermanos en el monte de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
verses.WEB: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?
verses.ASV: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters as captives of the sword?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Labão a Jacó: Que fizeste, que me furtaste o coração, e trouxeste a minhas filhas como prisioneiras de guerra?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Labán á Jacob: ¿Qué has hecho, que me hurtaste el corazón, y has traído á mis hijas como prisioneras de guerra?

verses.KJV: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
verses.WEB: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;
verses.ASV: Wherefore didst thou flee secretly, and steal away from me, and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth and with songs, with tabret and with harp;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que te escondeste para fugir, e me furtaste, e não me deste notícia, para que eu te enviasse com alegria e com cantares, com tamborim e harpa?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué te escondiste para huir, y me hurtaste, y no me diste noticia, para que yo te enviara con alegría y con cantares, con tamborín y vihuela?

verses.KJV: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.
verses.WEB: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.
verses.ASV: and didst not suffer me to kiss my sons and my daughters? now hast thou done foolishly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que ainda não me deixaste beijar meus filhos e minhas filhas. Agora loucamente fizeste.
verses.RVR09: Que aun no me dejaste besar mis hijos y mis hijas. Ahora locamente has hecho.

verses.KJV: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.WEB: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’
verses.ASV: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Poder há em minha mão para fazer-vos mal; mas o Deus de vosso pai me falou de noite dizendo: Guarda-te que não fales a Jacó descomedidamente.
verses.RVR09: Poder hay en mi mano para haceros mal: mas el Dios de vuestro padre me habló anoche diciendo: Guárdate que no hables á Jacob descomedidamente.

verses.KJV: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.WEB: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”
verses.ASV: And now, [though] thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house, [yet] wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.ALMEIDA: E já que te ias, porque tinhas saudade da casa de teu pai, por que me furtaste meus deuses?
verses.RVR09: Y ya que te ibas, porque tenías deseo de la casa de tu padre, ¿por qué me hurtaste mis dioses?

verses.KJV: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
verses.WEB: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’
verses.ASV: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Lest thou shouldest take thy daughters from me by force.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó respondeu, e disse a Labão: Pois tive medo; porque disse, que talvez me tirasse à força tuas filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob respondió, y dijo á Labán: Porque tuve miedo; pues dije, que quizá me quitarías por fuerza tus hijas.

verses.KJV: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.WEB: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.ASV: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, he shall not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em quem achares teus deuses, não viva: diante de nossos irmãos reconhece o que eu tiver teu, e leva-o. Jacó não sabia que Raquel havia os furtado.
verses.RVR09: En quien hallares tus dioses, no viva: delante de nuestros hermanos reconoce lo que yo tuviere tuyo, y llévatelo. Jacob no sabía que Rachêl los había hurtado.

verses.KJV: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
verses.WEB: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
verses.ASV: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two maid-servants; but he found them not. And he went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrou Labão na tenda de Jacó, e na tenda de Lia, e na tenda das duas servas, e não os achou, e saiu da tenda de Lia, e veio à tenda de Raquel.
verses.RVR09: Y entró Labán en la tienda de Jacob, y en la tienda de Lea, y en la tienda de las dos siervas, y no los halló, y salió de la tienda de Lea, y vino á la tienda de Rachêl.

verses.KJV: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
verses.WEB: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.
verses.ASV: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, and put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat upon them. And Laban felt about all the tent, but found them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Raquel os ídolos, e os pôs em uma albarda de um camelo, e sentou-se sobre eles: e provou Labão toda a tenda e não os achou.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Rachêl los ídolos, y púsolos en una albarda de un camello, y sentóse sobre ellos: y tentó Labán toda la tienda, y no los halló.

verses.KJV: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched but found not the images.
verses.WEB: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.
verses.ASV: And she said to her father, Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise up before thee; for the manner of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the teraphim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse a seu pai: Não se ire meu senhor, porque não me posso levantar diante de ti; pois estou com o costume das mulheres. E ele buscou, mas não achou os ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo á su padre: No se enoje mi señor, porque no me puedo levantar delante de ti; pues estoy con la costumbre de las mujeres. Y él buscó, pero no halló los ídolos.

verses.KJV: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
verses.WEB: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?
verses.ASV: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast hotly pursued after me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jacó se irou, e brigou com Labão; e respondeu Jacó e disse a Labão: Que transgressão é a minha? Qual é meu pecado, que com tanto ardor vieste a me perseguir?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jacob se enojó, y regañó con Labán; y respondió Jacob y dijo á Labán: ¿Qué prevaricación es la mía? ¿cuál es mi pecado, que con tanto ardor has venido en seguimiento mío?

verses.KJV: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
verses.WEB: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.
verses.ASV: Whereas thou hast felt about all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? Set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us two.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois que apalpaste todos os meus móveis, acaso achaste algum dos objetos de tua casa? Põe-o aqui diante de meus irmãos e teus, e julguem entre nós ambos.
verses.RVR09: Pues que has tentado todos mis muebles, ¿qué has hallado de todas las alhajas de tu casa? Ponlo aquí delante de mis hermanos y tuyos, y juzguen entre nosotros ambos.

verses.KJV: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
verses.WEB: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.
verses.ASV: These twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flocks have I not eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes vinte anos estive contigo; tuas ovelhas e tuas cabras nunca abortaram, nem eu comi carneiro de tuas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Estos veinte años he estado contigo: tus ovejas y tus cabras nunca abortaron, ni yo comí carnero de tus ovejas.

verses.KJV: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
verses.WEB: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
verses.ASV: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca te trouxe o arrebatado pelas feras; eu pagava o dano; o furtado tanto de dia como de noite, de minha mão o exigias.
verses.RVR09: Nunca te traje lo arrebatado por las fieras; yo pagaba el daño; lo hurtado así de día como de noche, de mi mano lo requerías.

verses.KJV: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
verses.WEB: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
verses.ASV: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from mine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: De dia me consumia o calor, e de noite a geada, e o sono se fugia de meus olhos.
verses.RVR09: De día me consumía el calor, y de noche la helada, y el sueño se huía de mis ojos.

verses.KJV: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.WEB: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
verses.ASV: These twenty years have I been in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy flock: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim estive vinte anos em tua casa: catorze anos te servi por tuas duas filhas, e seis anos por teu gado; e mudaste meu salário dez vezes.
verses.RVR09: Así he estado veinte años en tu casa: catorce años te serví por tus dos hijas, y seis años por tu ganado; y has mudado mi salario diez veces.

verses.KJV: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
verses.WEB: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”
verses.ASV: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the Fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now hadst thou sent me away empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o Deus de meu pai, o Deus de Abraão, e o temor de Isaque, não fossem comigo, certamente me enviarias agora vazio; Deus viu minha aflição e o trabalho de minhas mãos, e repreendeu-te de noite.
verses.RVR09: Si el Dios de mi padre, el Dios de Abraham, y el temor de Isaac, no fuera conmigo, de cierto me enviarías ahora vacío: vió Dios mi aflicción y el trabajo de mis manos, y reprendióte anoche.

verses.KJV: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
verses.WEB: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?
verses.ASV: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, The daughters are my daughters, and the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children whom they have borne?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Labão, e disse a Jacó: As filhas são filhas minhas, e os filhos, filhos meus são, e as ovelhas são minhas ovelhas, e tudo o que tu vês é meu; e que posso eu fazer hoje a estas minhas filhas, ou a seus filhos que elas geraram?
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Labán, y dijo á Jacob: Las hijas son hijas mías, y los hijos, hijos míos son, y las ovejas son mis ovejas, y todo lo que tú ves es mío: ¿y qué puedo yo hacer hoy á estas mis hijas, ó á sus hijos que ellas han parido?

verses.KJV: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.WEB: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”
verses.ASV: And now come, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vem, pois, agora, façamos aliança eu e tu; e seja em testemunho entre mim e ti.
verses.RVR09: Ven pues ahora, y hagamos alianza yo y tú; y sea en testimonio entre mí y entre ti.

verses.KJV: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.WEB: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.ASV: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jacó tomou uma pedra, e levantou-a por coluna.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jacob tomó una piedra, y levantóla por título.

verses.KJV: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.WEB: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.
verses.ASV: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made a heap: and they did eat there by the heap.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jacó a seus irmãos: Recolhei pedras. E tomaram pedras e fizeram um amontoado; e comeram ali sobre aquele amontoado.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jacob á sus hermanos: Coged piedras. Y tomaron piedras é hicieron un majano; y comieron allí sobre aquel majano.

verses.KJV: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.WEB: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.ASV: And Laban called it Jegar-saha-dutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Labão o chamou Jegar-Saaduta; e Jacó o chamou Galeede.
verses.RVR09: Y llamólo Labán Jegar Sahadutha: y lo llamó Jacob Galaad.

verses.KJV: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.WEB: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed
verses.ASV: And Laban said, This heap is witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Labão disse: Este amontoado é testemunha hoje entre mim e entre ti; por isso foi chamado seu nome Galeede.
verses.RVR09: Porque Labán dijo: Este majano es testigo hoy entre mí y entre ti; por eso fué llamado su nombre Galaad;

verses.KJV: And Mizpah; for he said, The Lord watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.WEB: and Mizpah, for he said, “The LORD watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
verses.ASV: and Mizpah, for he said, Jehovah watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Mispá, porquanto disse: Vigie o SENHOR entre mim e entre ti, quando nos separarmos um do outro.
verses.RVR09: Y Mizpa, por cuanto dijo: Atalaye Jehová entre mí y entre ti, cuando nos apartáremos el uno del otro.

verses.KJV: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
verses.WEB: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”
verses.ASV: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, and if thou shalt take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se afligires minhas filhas, ou se tomares outras mulheres além de minhas filhas, ninguém está conosco; olha, Deus é testemunha entre mim e ti.
verses.RVR09: Si afligieres mis hijas, ó si tomares otras mujeres además de mis hijas, nadie está con nosotros; mira, Dios es testigo entre mí y entre ti.

verses.KJV: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee:
verses.WEB: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.
verses.ASV: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold the pillar, which I have set betwixt me and thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais Labão a Jacó: Eis que este amontoado, e eis que esta coluna, que erigi entre mim e ti.
verses.RVR09: Dijo más Labán á Jacob: He aquí este majano, y he aquí este título, que he erigido entre mí y ti.

verses.KJV: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.WEB: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
verses.ASV: This heap be witness, and the pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Testemunha seja este amontoado, e testemunha seja esta coluna, que nem eu passarei contra ti este amontoado, nem tu passarás contra mim este amontoado nem esta coluna, para o mal.
verses.RVR09: Testigo sea este majano, y testigo sea este título, que ni yo pasaré contra ti este majano, ni tú pasarás contra mí este majano ni este título, para mal.

verses.KJV: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.WEB: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.
verses.ASV: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the Fear of his father Isaac.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus de Abraão, e o Deus de Naor julgue entre nós, o Deus de seus pais. E Jacó jurou pelo temor de Isaque seu pai.
verses.RVR09: El Dios de Abraham, y el Dios de Nachôr juzgue entre nosotros, el Dios de sus padres. Y Jacob juró por el temor de Isaac su padre.

verses.KJV: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
verses.WEB: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.
verses.ASV: And Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jacó ofereceu sacrifícios no monte, e chamou seus parentes para comer pão; e comeram pão, e dormiram aquela noite no monte.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jacob inmoló víctimas en el monte, y llamó á sus hermanos á comer pan: y comieron pan, y durmieron aquella noche en el monte.

verses.KJV: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.WEB: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.
verses.ASV: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se Labão de manhã, beijou seus filhos e suas filhas, e os abençoou; e retrocedeu e voltou a seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Labán de mañana, y besó sus hijos y sus hijas, y los bendijo; y retrocedió y volvióse á su lugar.

verses.KJV: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.WEB: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.ASV: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó se foi seu caminho, e saíram-lhe ao encontro anjos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y JACOB se fué su camino, y saliéronle al encuentro ángeles de Dios.

verses.KJV: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.WEB: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.ASV: And Jacob said when he saw them, This is God’s host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jacó quando os viu: Este é o acampamento de Deus; e chamou o nome daquele lugar Maanaim.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jacob cuando los vió: El campo de Dios es este: y llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Mahanaim.

verses.KJV: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.WEB: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
verses.ASV: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Jacó mensageiros diante de si a Esaú seu irmão, à terra de Seir, campo de Edom.
verses.RVR09: Y envió Jacob mensajeros delante de sí á Esaú su hermano, á la tierra de Seir, campo de Edom.

verses.KJV: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
verses.WEB: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.
verses.ASV: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye say unto my lord Esau: Thus saith thy servant Jacob, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed until now:
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou-lhes dizendo: Assim direis a mim senhor Esaú: Assim diz teu servo Jacó: Com Labão morei, e detive-me até agora;
verses.RVR09: Y mandóles diciendo: Así diréis á mi señor Esaú: Así dice tu siervo Jacob: Con Labán he morado, y detenídome hasta ahora;

verses.KJV: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
verses.WEB: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”
verses.ASV: and I have oxen, and asses, [and] flocks, and men-servants, and maid-servants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in thy sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tenho vacas, e asnos, e ovelhas, e servos, e servas; e envio a dizê-lo a meu senhor, para achar favor em teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Y tengo vacas, y asnos, y ovejas, y siervos y siervas; y envío á decirlo á mi señor, por hallar gracia en tus ojos.

verses.KJV: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
verses.WEB: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”
verses.ASV: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and moreover he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os mensageiros voltaram a Jacó, dizendo: Viemos a teu irmão Esaú, e ele também veio a receber-te, e quatrocentos homens com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y los mensajeros volvieron á Jacob, diciendo: Vinimos á tu hermano Esaú, y él también viene á recibirte, y cuatrocientos hombres con él.

verses.KJV: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
verses.WEB: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.
verses.ASV: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed: and he divided the people that were with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two companies;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jacó teve grande temor, e angustiou-se; e partiu o povo que tinha consigo, e as ovelhas e as vacas e os camelos, em dois grupos;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jacob tuvo gran temor, y angustióse; y partió el pueblo que tenía consigo, y las ovejas y las vacas y los camellos, en dos cuadrillas;

verses.KJV: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
verses.WEB: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”
verses.ASV: and he said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the company which is left shall escape.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Se vier Esaú a um grupo e o ferir, o outro grupo escapará.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Si viniere Esaú á la una cuadrilla y la hiriere, la otra cuadrilla escapará.

verses.KJV: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the Lord which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
verses.WEB: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’
verses.ASV: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, O Jehovah, who saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will do thee good:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jacó: Deus de meu pai Abraão, e Deus de meu pai Isaque, o SENHOR, que me disseste: Volta-te à tua terra e à tua parentela, e eu te farei bem.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jacob: Dios de mi padre Abraham, y Dios de mi padre Isaac, Jehová, que me dijiste: Vuélvete á tu tierra y á tu parentela, y yo te haré bien;

verses.KJV: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
verses.WEB: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.
verses.ASV: I am not worthy of the least of all the lovingkindnesses, and of all the truth, which thou hast showed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two companies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Menor sou que todas as misericórdias, e que toda a verdade que usaste para com teu servo; que com meu bordão passei este Jordão, e agora estou sobre dois grupos.
verses.RVR09: Menor soy que todas las misericordias, y que toda la verdad que has usado para con tu siervo; que con mi bordón pasé este Jordán, y ahora estoy sobre dos cuadrillas.

verses.KJV: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
verses.WEB: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.
verses.ASV: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he come and smite me, the mother with the children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra-me agora da mão de meu irmão, da mão de Esaú, porque o temo; não venha talvez, e me fira a mãe com os filhos.
verses.RVR09: Líbrame ahora de la mano de mi hermano, de la mano de Esaú, porque le temo; no venga quizá, y me hiera la madre con los hijos.

verses.KJV: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.WEB: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”
verses.ASV: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu disseste: Eu te farei bem, e tornarei tua descendência como a areia do mar, que não se pode contar de tão numerosa.
verses.RVR09: Y tú has dicho: Yo te haré bien, y pondré tu simiente como la arena del mar, que no se puede contar por la multitud.

verses.KJV: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
verses.WEB: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:
verses.ASV: And he lodged there that night, and took of that which he had with him a present for Esau his brother:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dormiu ali aquela noite, e tomou do que lhe veio à mão um presente para seu irmão Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió allí aquella noche, y tomó de lo que le vino á la mano un presente para su hermano Esaú:

verses.KJV: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
verses.WEB: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.ASV: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.ALMEIDA: Duzentas cabras e vinte machos de bode, duzentas ovelhas e vinte carneiros,
verses.RVR09: Doscientas cabras y veinte machos de cabrío, doscientas ovejas y veinte carneros,

verses.KJV: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
verses.WEB: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
verses.ASV: thirty milch camels and their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten foals.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trinta camelas de cria, com seus filhotes, quarenta vacas e dez novilhos, vinte asnas e dez jumentos.
verses.RVR09: Treinta camellas paridas, con sus hijos, cuarenta vacas y diez novillos, veinte asnas y diez borricos.

verses.KJV: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
verses.WEB: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”
verses.ASV: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entregou-o em mão de seus servos, cada manada à parte; e disse a seus servos: Passai diante de mim, e ponde espaço entre manada e manada.
verses.RVR09: Y entrególo en mano de sus siervos, cada manada de por sí; y dijo á sus siervos: Pasad delante de mí, y poned espacio entre manada y manada.

verses.KJV: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
verses.WEB: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’
verses.ASV: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou ao primeiro, dizendo: Se meu irmão Esaú te encontrar, e te perguntar, dizendo De quem és? E: Para onde vais? E: para quem é isto que levas diante de ti?
verses.RVR09: Y mandó al primero, diciendo: Si Esaú mi hermano te encontrare, y te preguntare, diciendo: ¿De quién eres? ¿y adónde vas? ¿y para quién es esto que llevas delante de ti?

verses.KJV: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
verses.WEB: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”
verses.ASV: then thou shalt say, [They are] thy servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, he also is behind us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então dirás: Presente é de teu servo Jacó, que envia a meu senhor Esaú; e eis que também ele vem atrás de nós.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dirás: Presente es de tu siervo Jacob, que envía á mi señor Esaú; y he aquí también él viene tras nosotros.

verses.KJV: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
verses.WEB: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.
verses.ASV: And he commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou também ao segundo, e ao terceiro, e a todos os que iam atrás aquelas manadas, dizendo: Conforme isto falareis a Esaú, quando o achardes.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó también al segundo, y al tercero, y á todos los que iban tras aquellas manadas, diciendo: Conforme á esto hablaréis á Esaú, cuando le hallareis.

verses.KJV: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
verses.WEB: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”
verses.ASV: and ye shall say, Moreover, behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E direis também: Eis que teu servo Jacó vem atrás de nós. Porque disse: Apaziguarei sua ira com o presente que vai adiante de mim, e depois verei seu rosto; talvez lhe serei aceito.
verses.RVR09: Y diréis también: He aquí tu siervo Jacob viene tras nosotros. Porque dijo: Apaciguaré su ira con el presente que va delante de mí, y después veré su rostro: quizá le seré acepto.

verses.KJV: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
verses.WEB: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.
verses.ASV: So the present passed over before him: and he himself lodged that night in the company.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passou o presente adiante dele; e ele dormiu aquela noite no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y pasó el presente delante de él; y él durmió aquella noche en el campamento.

verses.KJV: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
verses.WEB: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.ASV: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two handmaids, and his eleven children, and passed over the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se aquela noite, e tomou suas duas mulheres, e suas duas servas, e seus onze filhos, e passou o vau de Jaboque.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse aquella noche, y tomó sus dos mujeres, y sus dos siervas, y sus once hijos, y pasó el vado de Jaboc.

verses.KJV: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
verses.WEB: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
verses.ASV: And he took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou-os, pois, e passou-os o ribeiro, e fez passar o que tinha.
verses.RVR09: Tomólos pues, y pasólos el arroyo, é hizo pasar lo que tenía.

verses.KJV: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.WEB: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
verses.ASV: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficou Jacó sozinho, e lutou com ele um homem até que raiava a alva.
verses.RVR09: Y quedóse Jacob solo, y luchó con él un varón hasta que rayaba el alba.

verses.KJV: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
verses.WEB: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.
verses.ASV: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained, as he wrestled with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando viu que não podia com ele, tocou no lugar da juntura de sua coxa, e desconjuntou-se a coxa de Jacó enquanto com ele lutava.
verses.RVR09: Y como vió que no podía con él, tocó en el sitio del encaje de su muslo, y descoyuntóse el muslo de Jacob mientras con él luchaba.

verses.KJV: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
verses.WEB: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Deixa-me, que raia a alva. E ele disse: Não te deixarei, se não me abençoares.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Déjame, que raya el alba. Y él dijo: No te dejaré, si no me bendices.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Qual é teu nome? E ele respondeu: Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: ¿Cuál es tu nombre? Y él respondió: Jacob.

verses.KJV: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
verses.WEB: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for thou hast striven with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Não se dirá mais teu nome Jacó, mas sim Israel: porque lutaste com Deus e com os homens, e venceste.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: No se dirá más tu nombre Jacob, sino Israel: porque has peleado con Dios y con los hombres, y has vencido.

verses.KJV: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.WEB: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.
verses.ASV: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jacó lhe perguntou, e disse: Declara-me agora teu nome. E ele respondeu: Por que perguntas por meu nome? E abençoou-o ali.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jacob le preguntó, y dijo: Declárame ahora tu nombre. Y él respondió: ¿Por qué preguntas por mi nombre? Y bendíjolo allí.

verses.KJV: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
verses.WEB: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for, [said he], I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Jacó o nome daquele lugar Peniel: porque vi a Deus face a face, e foi livrada minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Jacob el nombre de aquel lugar, Peniel: porque vi á Dios cara á cara, y fué librada mi alma.

verses.KJV: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
verses.WEB: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.
verses.ASV: And the sun rose upon him as he passed over Penuel, and he limped upon his thigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu-lhe o sol quando passou a Peniel; e andava mancando de sua coxa.
verses.RVR09: Y salióle el sol pasado que hubo á Peniel; y cojeaba de su anca.

verses.KJV: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
verses.WEB: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.
verses.ASV: Therefore the children of Israel eat not the sinew of the hip which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isto até o dia de hoje os filhos de Israel não comem do tendão que se contrai, o qual está na juntura da coxa; porque o homem tocou a Jacó este lugar de sua coxa no tendão que se contrai.
verses.RVR09: Por esto no comen los hijos de Israel, hasta hoy día, del tendón que se contrajo, el cual está en el encaje del muslo: porque tocó á Jacob este sitio de su muslo en el tendón que se contrajo.

verses.KJV: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.WEB: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.
verses.ASV: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando Jacó seus olhos, olhou, e eis que vinha Esaú, e os quatrocentos homens com ele: então repartiu ele os filhos entre Lia e Raquel e as duas servas.
verses.RVR09: Y ALZANDO Jacob sus ojos miró, y he aquí venía Esaú, y los cuatrocientos hombres con él: entonces repartió él los niños entre Lea y Rachêl y las dos siervas.

verses.KJV: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.WEB: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
verses.ASV: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs as servas e seus filhos adiante; logo a Lia e a seus filhos; e a Raquel e a José os últimos.
verses.RVR09: Y puso las siervas y sus niños delante; luego á Lea y á sus niños; y á Rachêl y á José los postreros.

verses.KJV: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.WEB: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.ASV: And he himself passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele passou diante deles, e inclinou-se à terra sete vezes, até que chegou a seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y él pasó delante de ellos, é inclinóse á tierra siete veces, hasta que llegó á su hermano.

verses.KJV: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.WEB: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
verses.ASV: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Esaú correu a seu encontro, e abraçou-lhe, e lançou-se sobre seu pescoço, e o beijou; e choraram.
verses.RVR09: Y Esaú corrió á su encuentro, y abrazóle, y echóse sobre su cuello, y le besó; y lloraron.

verses.KJV: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
verses.WEB: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”
verses.ASV: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are these with thee? And he said, The children whom God hath graciously given thy servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou seus olhos, e viu as mulheres e os filhos, e disse: Quem são estes que estão contigo? E ele respondeu: São os filhos que Deus deu a teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y alzó sus ojos, y vió las mujeres y los niños, y dijo: ¿Qué te tocan éstos? Y él respondió: Son los niños que Dios ha dado á tu siervo.

verses.KJV: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.WEB: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.ASV: Then the handmaids came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se chegaram as servas, elas e seus meninos, e inclinaram-se.
verses.RVR09: Y se llegaron las siervas, ellas y sus niños, é inclináronse.

verses.KJV: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.WEB: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.ASV: And Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegou-se Lia com seus filhos, e inclinaram-se: e depois chegou José e Raquel, e também se inclinaram.
verses.RVR09: Y llegóse Lea con sus niños, é inclináronse: y después llegó José y Rachêl, y también se inclinaron.

verses.KJV: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.WEB: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”
verses.ASV: And he said, What meanest thou by all this company which I met? And he said, To find favor in the sight of my lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Qual é a tua intenção com todos estes grupos que encontrei? E ele respondeu: Achar favor aos olhos de meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: ¿Qué te propones con todas estas cuadrillas que he encontrado? Y él respondió: El hallar gracia en los ojos de mi señor.

verses.KJV: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
verses.WEB: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”
verses.ASV: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; let that which thou hast be thine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Esaú: Tenho o bastante, meu irmão; seja para ti o que é teu.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Esaú: Harto tengo yo, hermano mío: sea para ti lo que es tuyo.

verses.KJV: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.WEB: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.
verses.ASV: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found favor in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand; forasmuch as I have seen thy face, as one seeth the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jacó: Não, eu te rogo, se achei agora favor em teus olhos, toma meu presente de minha mão, pois vi teu rosto como se houvesse visto o rosto de Deus; e me aceitaste.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jacob: No, yo te ruego, si he hallado ahora gracia en tus ojos, toma mi presente de mi mano, pues que así he visto tu rostro, como si hubiera visto el rostro de Dios; y hazme placer.

verses.KJV: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.WEB: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.
verses.ASV: Take, I pray thee, my gift that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma, eu te rogo, minha dádiva que te é trazida; porque Deus me fez misericórdia, e tudo o que há aqui é meu. E insistiu com ele, e tomou-a.
verses.RVR09: Toma, te ruego, mi dádiva que te es traída; porque Dios me ha hecho merced, y todo lo que hay aquí es mío. Y porfió con él, y tomóla.

verses.KJV: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.WEB: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Anda, e vamos; e eu irei adiante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Anda, y vamos; y yo iré delante de ti.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.WEB: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young: and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Meu senhor sabe que os meninos são tenros, e que tenho ovelhas e vacas de cria; e se as cansam, em um dia morrerão todas as ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Mi señor sabe que los niños son tiernos, y que tengo ovejas y vacas paridas; y si las fatigan, en un día morirán todas las ovejas.

verses.KJV: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
verses.WEB: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”
verses.ASV: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passe agora meu senhor diante de seu servo, e eu me irei pouco a pouco ao passo do gado que vai adiante de mim, e à passagem dos meninos, até que chegue a meu senhor a Seir.
verses.RVR09: Pase ahora mi señor delante de su siervo, y yo me iré poco á poco al paso de la hacienda que va delante de mí, y al paso de los niños, hasta que llegue á mi señor á Seir.

verses.KJV: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.WEB: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
verses.ASV: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find favor in the sight of my lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Esaú disse: Deixarei agora contigo da gente que vem comigo. E ele disse: Para que isto? ache eu favor aos olhos de meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y Esaú dijo: Dejaré ahora contigo de la gente que viene conmigo. Y él dijo: ¿Para qué esto? halle yo gracia en los ojos de mi señor.

verses.KJV: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.WEB: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
verses.ASV: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se voltou Esaú aquele dia por seu caminho a Seir.
verses.RVR09: Así se volvió Esaú aquel día por su camino á Seir.

verses.KJV: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.WEB: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.ASV: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó se partiu a Sucote, e edificou ali casa para si, e fez abrigos para seu gado; por isso chamou o nome daquele lugar Sucote.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob se partió á Succoth, y edificó allí casa para sí, é hizo cabañas para su ganado: por tanto llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Succoth.

verses.KJV: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
verses.WEB: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.
verses.ASV: And Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan-aram; and encamped before the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Jacó são à cidade de Siquém, que está na terra de Canaã, quando vinha de Padã-Arã; e acampou diante da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Jacob sano á la ciudad de Sichêm, que está en la tierra de Canaán, cuando venía de Padan-aram; y acampó delante de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.
verses.WEB: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.
verses.ASV: And he bought the parcel of ground, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of money.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comprou uma parte do campo, onde estendeu sua tenda, da mão dos filhos de Hamor, pai de Siquém, por cem peças de moeda.
verses.RVR09: Y compró una parte del campo, donde tendió su tienda, de mano de los hijos de Hamor, padre de Sichêm, por cien piezas de moneda.

verses.KJV: And he erected there an altar, and called it EleloheIsrael.
verses.WEB: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
verses.ASV: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E erigiu ali um altar, e chamou-lhe: Deus, o Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y erigió allí un altar, y llamóle: El Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.WEB: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.ASV: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu Diná a filha de Lia, a qual esta havia dado a Jacó, para ver as mulheres nativas.
verses.RVR09: Y SALIÓ Dina la hija de Lea, la cual había ésta parido á Jacob, á ver las hijas del país.

verses.KJV: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
verses.WEB: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
verses.ASV: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her; and he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu-a Siquém, filho de Hamor heveu, príncipe daquela terra, e tomou-a, e deitou-se com ela, e a desonrou.
verses.RVR09: Y vióla Sichêm, hijo de Hamor Heveo, príncipe de aquella tierra, y tomóla, y echóse con ella, y la deshonró.

verses.KJV: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
verses.WEB: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
verses.ASV: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sua alma se apegou a Diná a filha de Lia, e apaixonou-se pela moça, e falou ao coração da jovem.
verses.RVR09: Mas su alma se apegó á Dina la hija de Lea, y enamoróse de la moza, y habló al corazón de la joven.

verses.KJV: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
verses.WEB: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
verses.ASV: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Siquém a Hamor seu pai, dizendo: Toma-me por mulher esta moça.
verses.RVR09: Y habló Sichêm á Hamor su padre, diciendo: Tómame por mujer esta moza.

verses.KJV: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
verses.WEB: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.
verses.ASV: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they came.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Jacó que havia Siquém violado a Diná sua filha: e estando seus filhos com seu gado no campo, Jacó ficou em silêncio até que eles viessem.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Jacob que había Sichêm amancillado á Dina su hija: y estando sus hijos con su ganado en el campo, calló Jacob hasta que ellos viniesen.

verses.KJV: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
verses.WEB: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.
verses.ASV: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dirigiu-se Hamor pai de Siquém a Jacó, para falar com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y dirigióse Hamor padre de Sichêm á Jacob, para hablar con él.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter: which thing ought not to be done.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Jacó vieram do campo quando o souberam; e se entristeceram os homens, e se irritaram muito, porque fez depravação em Israel por ter se deitado com a filha de Jacó, o que não se devia haver feito.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Jacob vinieron del campo cuando lo supieron; y se entristecieron los varones, y se ensañaron mucho, porque hizo vileza en Israel echándose con la hija de Jacob, lo que no se debía haber hecho.

verses.KJV: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
verses.WEB: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
verses.ASV: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you, give her unto him to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hamor falou com eles, dizendo: A alma de meu filho Siquém se apegou à vossa filha; rogo-vos que a deis por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y Hamor habló con ellos, diciendo: El alma de mi hijo Sichêm se ha apegado á vuestra hija; ruégoos que se la deis por mujer.

verses.KJV: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
verses.WEB: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
verses.ASV: And make ye marriages with us; give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aparentai-vos conosco; dai-nos vossas filhas, e tomai vós as nossas.
verses.RVR09: Y emparentad con nosotros; dadnos vuestras hijas, y tomad vosotros las nuestras.

verses.KJV: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
verses.WEB: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”
verses.ASV: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitai conosco; porque a terra estará diante de vós; morai e negociai nela, e tomai nela possessão.
verses.RVR09: Y habitad con nosotros; porque la tierra estará delante de vosotros; morad y negociad en ella, y tomad en ella posesión.

verses.KJV: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
verses.WEB: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.
verses.ASV: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find favor in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
verses.ALMEIDA: Siquém também disse a seu pai e a seus irmãos: Ache eu favor em vossos olhos, e darei o que me disserdes.
verses.RVR09: Sichêm también dijo á su padre y á sus hermanos: Halle yo gracia en vuestros ojos, y daré lo que me dijereis.

verses.KJV: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
verses.WEB: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
verses.ASV: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aumentai muito a exigência de meu dote e presentes, que eu darei quanto me disserdes, e dá-me a moça por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Aumentad á cargo mío mucho dote y dones, que yo daré cuanto me dijereis, y dadme la moza por mujer.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
verses.WEB: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
