verses.ASV: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with guile, and spake, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
verses.ALMEIDA: E responderam os filhos de Jacó a Siquém e a Hamor seu pai com engano; e falaram, porquanto havia violado a sua irmã Diná.
verses.RVR09: Y respondieron los hijos de Jacob á Sichêm y á Hamor su padre con engaño; y parlaron, por cuanto había amancillado á Dina su hermana.

verses.KJV: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
verses.WEB: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.
verses.ASV: and said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram-lhes: Não podemos fazer isto de dar nossa irmã a homem que tem prepúcio; porque entre nós é abominação.
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronles: No podemos hacer esto de dar nuestra hermana á hombre que tiene prepucio; porque entre nosotros es abominación.

verses.KJV: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.WEB: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,
verses.ASV: Only on this condition will we consent unto you: if ye will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas com esta condição vos consentiremos: se haveis de ser como nós, que se circuncide entre vós todo homem;
verses.RVR09: Mas con esta condición os haremos placer: si habéis de ser como nosotros, que se circuncide entre vosotros todo varón;

verses.KJV: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.WEB: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.ASV: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vos daremos nossas filhas, e tomaremos nós as vossas; e habitaremos convosco, e seremos um povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces os daremos nuestras hijas, y tomaremos nosotros las vuestras; y habitaremos con vosotros, y seremos un pueblo.

verses.KJV: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
verses.WEB: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
verses.ASV: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se não nos prestardes ouvido para vos circuncidar, tomaremos nossa filha, e nos iremos.
verses.RVR09: Mas si no nos prestareis oído para circuncidaros, tomaremos nuestra hija, y nos iremos.

verses.KJV: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
verses.WEB: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
verses.ASV: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pareceram bem seus palavras a Hamor e a Siquém, filho de Hamor.
verses.RVR09: Y parecieron bien sus palabras á Hamor y á Sichêm, hijo de Hamor.

verses.KJV: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.
verses.WEB: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.
verses.ASV: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was honored above all the house of his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não tardou o jovem fazer aquilo, porque a filha de Jacó lhe havia agradado: e ele era o mais honrado de toda a casa de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y no dilató el mozo hacer aquello, porque la hija de Jacob le había agradado: y él era el más honrado de toda la casa de su padre.

verses.KJV: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
verses.WEB: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,
verses.ASV: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Hamor e Siquém seu filho vieram à porta de sua cidade, e falaram aos homens de sua cidade, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Hamor y Sichêm su hijo vinieron á la puerta de su ciudad, y hablaron á los varones de su ciudad, diciendo:

verses.KJV: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.WEB: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.
verses.ASV: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for, behold, the land is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes homens são pacíficos conosco, e habitarão nesta terra, e comercializarão nela; pois eis que a terra é bastante ampla para eles; nós tomaremos suas filhas por mulheres, e lhes daremos as nossas.
verses.RVR09: Estos varones son pacíficos con nosotros, y habitarán en el país, y traficarán en él: pues he aquí la tierra es bastante ancha para ellos: nosotros tomaremos sus hijas por mujeres, y les daremos las nuestras.

verses.KJV: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
verses.WEB: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.
verses.ASV: Only on this condition will the men consent unto us to dwell with us, to become one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas com esta condição nos estes homens consentirão em habitar conosco, para que sejamos um povo: se se circuncidar em nós todo homem, assim como eles são circuncidados.
verses.RVR09: Mas con esta condición nos harán estos hombres el placer de habitar con nosotros, para que seamos un pueblo: si se circuncidare en nosotros todo varón, así como ellos son circuncidados.

verses.KJV: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of their's be our's? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.WEB: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”
verses.ASV: Shall not their cattle and their substance and all their beasts be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus gados, e sua riqueza e todos seus animais, serão nossas; somente concordemos com eles, e habitarão conosco.
verses.RVR09: Sus ganados, y su hacienda y todas sus bestias, serán nuestras: solamente convengamos con ellos, y habitarán con nosotros.

verses.KJV: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.WEB: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
verses.ASV: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E obedeceram a Hamor e a Siquém seu filho todos os que saíam pela porta da cidade, e circuncidaram a todo homem, dentre os que saíam pela porta de sua cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y obedecieron á Hamor y á Sichêm su hijo todos los que salían por la puerta de la ciudad, y circuncidaron á todo varón, á cuantos salían por la puerta de su ciudad.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
verses.WEB: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city unawares, and slew all the males.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que ao terceiro dia, quando sentiam eles a maior dor, os dois filhos de Jacó, Simeão e Levi, irmãos de Diná, tomaram cada um sua espada, e vieram contra a cidade animosamente, e mataram a todo homem.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que al tercer día, cuando sentían ellos el mayor dolor, los dos hijos de Jacob, Simeón y Leví, hermanos de Dina, tomaron cada uno su espada, y vinieron contra la ciudad animosamente, y mataron á todo varón.

verses.KJV: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
verses.WEB: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
verses.ASV: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Hamor e a seu filho Siquém mataram a fio de espada; e tomaram a Diná de casa de Siquém, e saíram.
verses.RVR09: Y á Hamor y á Sichêm su hijo los mataron á filo de espada: y tomaron á Dina de casa de Sichêm, y saliéronse.

verses.KJV: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.WEB: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.ASV: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Jacó vieram aos mortos e saquearam a cidade; porquanto haviam violado à sua irmã.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Jacob vinieron á los muertos, y saquearon la ciudad; por cuanto habían amancillado á su hermana.

verses.KJV: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
verses.WEB: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,
verses.ASV: They took their flocks and their herds and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomaram suas ovelhas e vacas e seus asnos, e o que havia na cidade e no campo,
verses.RVR09: Tomaron sus ovejas y vacas y sus asnos, y lo que había en la ciudad y en el campo,

verses.KJV: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
verses.WEB: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.
verses.ASV: and all their wealth, and all their little ones and their wives, took they captive and made a prey, even all that was in the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os seus pertences; se levaram cativos a todos as suas crianças e suas mulheres, e roubaram tudo o que havia nas casas.
verses.RVR09: Y toda su hacienda; se llevaron cautivos á todos sus niños y sus mujeres, y robaron todo lo que había en casa.

verses.KJV: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
verses.WEB: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and, I being few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and smite me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Jacó a Simeão e a Levi: Vós me perturbastes em fazer-me detestável aos moradores desta terra, os cananeus e os ferezeus; e tendo eu poucos homens, se juntarão contra mim, e me ferirão, e serei destruído eu e minha casa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Jacob á Simeón y á Leví: Habéisme turbado con hacerme abominable á los moradores de aquesta tierra, el Cananeo y el Pherezeo; y teniendo yo pocos hombres, juntarse han contra mí, y me herirán, y seré destruído yo y mi casa.

verses.KJV: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
verses.WEB: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”
verses.ASV: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam Havia ele de tratar à nossa irmã como à uma prostituta?
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: ¿Había él de tratar á nuestra hermana como á una ramera?

verses.KJV: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
verses.WEB: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
verses.ASV: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, who appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus a Jacó: Levanta-te, sobe a Betel, e fica ali; e faze ali um altar ao Deus que te apareceu quando fugias de teu irmão Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Y DIJO Dios á Jacob: Levántate, sube á Beth-el, y estáte allí; y haz allí un altar al Dios que te apareció cuando huías de tu hermano Esaú.

verses.KJV: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
verses.WEB: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.
verses.ASV: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the foreign gods that are among you, and purify yourselves, and change your garments:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jacó disse à sua família e a todos os que com ele estavam: Tirai os deuses alheios que há entre vós, e limpai-vos, e mudai vossas roupas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jacob dijo á su familia y á todos los que con él estaban: Quitad los dioses ajenos que hay entre vosotros, y limpiaos, y mudad vuestros vestidos.

verses.KJV: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
verses.WEB: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
verses.ASV: and let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantemo-nos, e subamos a Betel; e farei ali altar ao Deus que me respondeu no dia de minha angústia, e foi comigo no caminho que andei.
verses.RVR09: Y levantémonos, y subamos á Beth-el; y haré allí altar al Dios que me respondió en el día de mi angustia, y ha sido conmigo en el camino que he andado.

verses.KJV: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.WEB: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.ASV: And they gave unto Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hand, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim deram a Jacó todos os deuses alheios que havia em poder deles, e os brincos que estavam em suas orelhas; e Jacó os escondeu debaixo de um carvalho, que estava junto a Siquém.
verses.RVR09: Así dieron á Jacob todos los dioses ajenos que había en poder de ellos, y los zarzillos que estaban en sus orejas; y Jacob los escondió debajo de una encina, que estaba junto á Sichêm.

verses.KJV: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.WEB: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed: and a terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiram-se, e o terror de Deus foi sobre as cidades que havia em seus arredores, e não seguiram atrás dos filhos de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y partiéronse, y el terror de Dios fué sobre las ciudades que había en sus alrededores, y no siguieron tras los hijos de Jacob.

verses.KJV: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
verses.WEB: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
verses.ASV: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan (the same is Beth-el), he and all the people that were with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegou Jacó a Luz, que está em terra de Canaã, (esta é Betel) ele e todo o povo que com ele estava;
verses.RVR09: Y llegó Jacob á Luz, que está en tierra de Canaán, (esta es Beth-el) él y todo el pueblo que con él estaba;

verses.KJV: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.WEB: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.ASV: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el; because there God was revealed unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou ali um altar, e chamou o lugar El-Betel, porque ali lhe havia aparecido Deus, quando fugia de seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó allí un altar, y llamó al lugar El-Beth-el, porque allí le había aparecido Dios, cuando huía de su hermano.

verses.KJV: But Deborah, Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.
verses.WEB: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
verses.ASV: And Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried below Beth-el under the oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bacuth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então morreu Débora, ama de Rebeca, e foi sepultada às raízes de Betel, debaixo de um carvalho: e chamou-se seu nome Alom-Bacute.
verses.RVR09: Entonces murió Débora, ama de Rebeca, y fué sepultada á las raíces de Beth-el, debajo de una encina: y llamóse su nombre Allon-Bacuth.

verses.KJV: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
verses.WEB: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
verses.ASV: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came from Paddan-aram, and blessed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apareceu-se outra vez Deus a Jacó, quando se havia voltado de Padã-Arã, e abençoou-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Y aparecióse otra vez Dios á Jacob, cuando se había vuelto de Padan-aram, y bendíjole.

verses.KJV: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
verses.WEB: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
verses.ASV: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Deus: Teu nome é Jacó; não se chamará mais teu nome Jacó, mas sim Israel será teu nome: e chamou seu nome Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Dios: Tu nombre es Jacob; no se llamará más tu nombre Jacob, sino Israel será tu nombre: y llamó su nombre Israel.

verses.KJV: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.WEB: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
verses.ASV: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Deus: Eu sou o Deus Todo-Poderoso: cresce e multiplica-te; uma nação e conjunto de nações procederá de ti, e reis sairão de teus lombos:
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Dios: Yo soy el Dios Omnipotente: crece y multiplícate; una nación y conjunto de naciones procederá de ti, y reyes saldrán de tus lomos:

verses.KJV: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
verses.WEB: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”
verses.ASV: and the land which I gave unto Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra que eu dei a Abraão e a Isaque, a darei a ti: e à tua descendência depois de ti darei a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra que yo he dado á Abraham y á Isaac, la daré á ti: y á tu simiente después de ti daré la tierra.

verses.KJV: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
verses.WEB: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
verses.ASV: And God went up from him in the place where he spake with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi-se dele Deus, do lugar onde com ele havia falado.
verses.RVR09: Y fuése de él Dios, del lugar donde con él había hablado.

verses.KJV: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
verses.WEB: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
verses.ASV: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spake with him, a pillar of stone: and he poured out a drink-offering thereon, and poured oil thereon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó erigiu uma coluna no lugar onde havia falado com ele, uma coluna de pedra, e derramou sobre ela libação, e deitou sobre ela azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob erigió un título en el lugar donde había hablado con él, un título de piedra, y derramó sobre él libación, y echó sobre él aceite.

verses.KJV: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
verses.WEB: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
verses.ASV: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Jacó o nome daquele lugar onde Deus havia falado com ele, Betel.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Jacob el nombre de aquel lugar donde Dios había hablado con él, Beth-el.

verses.KJV: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was still some distance to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiram de Betel, e havia ainda como alguma distância para chegar a Efrata, quando deu à luz Raquel, e houve trabalho em seu parto.
verses.RVR09: Y partieron de Beth-el, y había aún como media legua de tierra para llegar á Ephrata, cuando parió Rachêl, y hubo trabajo en su parto.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
verses.WEB: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; for now thou shalt have another son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, que quando havia trabalho em seu parto, disse-lhe a parteira: Não temas, que também terás este filho.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que como había trabajo en su parir, díjole la partera: No temas, que también tendrás este hijo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.WEB: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que ao sair dela a alma, (pois morreu) chamou seu nome Benoni; mas seu pai o chamou Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció que al salírsele el alma, (pues murió) llamó su nombre Benoni; mas su padre lo llamó Benjamín.

verses.KJV: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
verses.WEB: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
verses.ASV: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath (the same is Beth-lehem).
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim morreu Raquel, e foi sepultada no caminho de Efrata, a qual é Belém.
verses.RVR09: Así murió Rachêl, y fué sepultada en el camino de Ephrata, la cual es Beth-lehem.

verses.KJV: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
verses.WEB: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
verses.ASV: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her grave: the same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs Jacó uma coluna sobre sua sepultura: esta é a coluna da sepultura de Raquel até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y puso Jacob un título sobre su sepultura: este es el título de la sepultura de Rachêl hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
verses.WEB: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
verses.ASV: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiu Israel, e estendeu sua tenda da outra parte de Migdal-Eder.
verses.RVR09: Y partió Israel, y tendió su tienda de la otra parte de Migdaleder.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.WEB: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, while Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, morando Israel naquela terra, que foi Rúben e dormiu com Bila a concubina de seu pai; o qual chegou a entender Israel. Agora bem, os filhos de Israel foram doze:
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció, morando Israel en aquella tierra, que fué Rubén y durmió con Bilha la concubina de su padre; lo cual llegó á entender Israel. Ahora bien, los hijos de Israel fueron doce:

verses.KJV: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
verses.WEB: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
verses.ASV: the sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob’s first-born, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Lia: Rúben o primogênito de Jacó, e Simeão, e Levi, e Judá, e Issacar, e Zebulom.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Lea: Rubén el primogénito de Jacob, y Simeón, y Leví, y Judá, é Issachâr, y Zabulón.

verses.KJV: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
verses.WEB: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.ASV: the sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Raquel: José, e Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Rachêl: José, y Benjamín.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
verses.WEB: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
verses.ASV: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid: Dan and Naphtali;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Bila, serva de Raquel: Dã, e Naftali.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Bilha, sierva de Rachêl: Dan, y Nephtalí.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid: Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.
verses.WEB: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
verses.ASV: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid: Gad and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, that were born to him in Paddan-aram.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Zilpa, serva de Lia: Gade, e Aser. Estes foram os filhos de Jacó, que lhe nasceram em Padã-Arã.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Zilpa, sierva de Lea: Gad, y Aser. Estos fueron los hijos de Jacob, que le nacieron en Padan-aram.

verses.KJV: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.WEB: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
verses.ASV: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father to Mamre, to Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Jacó a Isaque seu pai a Manre, à cidade de Arba, que é Hebrom, onde habitaram Abraão e Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Jacob á Isaac su padre á Mamre, á la ciudad de Arba, que es Hebrón, donde habitaron Abraham é Isaac.

verses.KJV: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
verses.WEB: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
verses.ASV: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and fourscore years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram os dias de Isaque cento e oitenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron los días de Isaac ciento ochenta años.

verses.KJV: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.WEB: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
verses.ASV: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, old and full of days: and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E expirou Isaque, e morreu, e foi recolhido a seus povos, velho e farto de dias; e sepultaram-no Esaú e Jacó seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y exhaló Isaac el espíritu, y murió, y fué recogido á sus pueblos, viejo y harto de días; y sepultáronlo Esaú y Jacob sus hijos.

verses.KJV: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
verses.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
verses.ASV: Now these are the generations of Esau (the same is Edom).
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as gerações de Esaú, o qual é Edom.
verses.RVR09: Y ESTAS son las generaciones de Esaú, el cual es Edom.

verses.KJV: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.WEB: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
verses.ASV: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Esaú tomou suas mulheres das filhas de Canaã: a Ada, filha de Elom heteu, e a Oolibama, filha de Aná, filha de Zibeão os heveus;
verses.RVR09: Esaú tomó sus mujeres de las hijas de Canaán: á Ada, hija de Elón Hetheo, y á Aholibama, hija de Ana, hija de Zibeón el Heveo;

verses.KJV: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
verses.WEB: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.ASV: and Basemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Basemate, filha de Ismael, irmã de Nebaiote.
verses.RVR09: Y á Basemath, hija de Ismael, hermana de Navaioth.

verses.KJV: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
verses.WEB: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
verses.ASV: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Basemath bare Reuel;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ada deu à luz de Esaú a Elifaz; e Basemate deu à luz a Reuel.
verses.RVR09: Y Ada parió á Esaú á Eliphaz; y Basemath parió á Reuel.

verses.KJV: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: and Oholibamah bare Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, that were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Oolibama deu à luz a Jeús, e a Jalão, e a Corá: estes são os filhos de Esaú, que lhe nasceram na terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Y Aholibama parió á Jeús, y á Jaalam, y á Cora: estos son los hijos de Esaú, que le nacieron en la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
verses.WEB: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
verses.ASV: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan; and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Esaú tomou suas mulheres, e seus filhos, e suas filhas, e todas as pessoas de sua casa, e seus gados, e todos seus animais, e todos os seus pertences que havia adquirido na terra de Canaã, e foi-se a outra terra de diante de Jacó seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y Esaú tomó sus mujeres, y sus hijos, y sus hijas, y todas las personas de su casa, y sus ganados, y todas sus bestias, y toda su hacienda que había adquirido en la tierra de Canaán, y fuése á otra tierra de delante de Jacob su hermano:

verses.KJV: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.WEB: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
verses.ASV: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojournings could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a riqueza deles era grande, e não podiam habitar juntos, nem a terra de sua peregrinação os podia sustentar por causa de seus gados.
verses.RVR09: Porque la hacienda de ellos era grande, y no podían habitar juntos, ni la tierra de su peregrinación los podía sostener á causa de sus ganados.

verses.KJV: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
verses.WEB: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
verses.ASV: And Esau dwelt in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Esaú habitou no monte de Seir: Esaú é Edom.
verses.RVR09: Y Esaú habitó en el monte de Seir: Esaú es Edom.

verses.KJV: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
verses.WEB: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
verses.ASV: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as linhagens de Esaú, pai de Edom, no monte de Seir.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los linajes de Esaú, padre de Edom, en el monte de Seir.

verses.KJV: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
verses.WEB: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
verses.ASV: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, filho de Ada, mulher de Esaú; Reuel, filho de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los nombres de los hijos de Esaú: Eliphaz, hijo de Ada, mujer de Esaú; Reuel, hijo de Basemath, mujer de Esaú.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.WEB: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Elifaz foram Temã, Omar, Zefô, Gatã, e Quenaz.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Eliphaz fueron Temán, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, y Cenaz.

verses.KJV: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
verses.WEB: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.
verses.ASV: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these are the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Timna foi concubina de Elifaz, filho de Esaú, a qual lhe deu à luz a Amaleque: estes são os filhos de Ada, mulher de Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Y Timna fué concubina de Eliphaz, hijo de Esaú, la cual le parió á Amalec: estos son los hijos de Ada, mujer de Esaú.

verses.KJV: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.ASV: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Reuel foram Naate, Zerá, Samá, e Mizá: estes são os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Reuel fueron Nahath, Zera, Samma, y Mizza: estos son los hijos de Basemath, mujer de Esaú.

verses.KJV: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.WEB: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.ASV: And these were the sons of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú, filha de Aná, que foi filha de Zibeão: ela deu à luz de Esaú a Jeús, Jalão, e Corá.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Aholibama, mujer de Esaú, hija de Ana, que fué hija de Zibeón: ella parió á Esaú á Jeús, Jaalam, y Cora.

verses.KJV: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
verses.WEB: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
verses.ASV: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the first-born of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os duques dos filhos de Esaú. Filhos de Elifaz, primogênito de Esaú: o duque Temã, o duque Omar, o duque Zefô, o duque Quenaz,
verses.RVR09: Estos son los duques de los hijos de Esaú. Hijos de Eliphaz, primogénito de Esaú: el duque Temán, el duque Omar, el duque Zepho, el duque Cenaz,

verses.KJV: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
verses.WEB: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
verses.ASV: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O duque Corá, o duque Gatã, e o duque Amaleque: estes são os duques de Elifaz na terra de Edom; estes foram os filhos de Ada.
verses.RVR09: El duque Cora, el duque Gatam, y el duque Amalec: estos son los duques de Eliphaz en la tierra de Edom; estos fueron los hijos de Ada.

verses.KJV: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.ASV: And these are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os filhos de Reuel, filho de Esaú: o duque Naate, o duque Zerá, o duque Samá, e o duque Mizá: estes são os duques da linha de Reuel na terra de Edom; estes filhos vêm de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los hijos de Reuel, hijo de Esaú: el duque Nahath, el duque Zera, el duque Samma, y el duque Mizza: estos son los duques de la línea de Reuel en la tierra de Edom; estos hijos vienen de Basemath, mujer de Esaú.

verses.KJV: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.ASV: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs that came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os filhos de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú: o duque Jeús, o duque Jalão, e o duque Corá: estes foram os duques que saíram de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú, filha de Aná.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los hijos de Aholibama, mujer de Esaú: el duque Jeús, el duque Jaalam, y el duque Cora: estos fueron los duques que salieron de Aholibama, mujer de Esaú, hija de Ana.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs: the same is Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois, são os filhos de Esaú, e seus duques: ele é Edom.
verses.RVR09: Estos, pues, son los hijos de Esaú, y sus duques: él es Edom.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os filhos de Seir horeu, moradores daquela terra: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Aná,
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los hijos de Seir Horeo, moradores de aquella tierra: Lotán, Sobal, Zibeón, Ana,

verses.KJV: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.WEB: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.ASV: and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disom, Eser, e Disã: estes são os duques dos horeus, filhos de Seir na terra de Edom.
verses.RVR09: Disón, Ezer, y Disán: estos son los duques de los Horeos, hijos de Seir en la tierra de Edom.

verses.KJV: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
verses.WEB: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.ASV: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Heman; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Lotã foram Hori e Hemã; e Timna foi irmã de Lotã.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Lotán fueron Hori y Hemán; y Timna fué hermana de Lotán.

verses.KJV: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.WEB: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.ASV: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Sobal foram Alvã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefô, e Onã.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Sobal fueron Alván, Manahath, Ebal, Sepho, y Onán.

verses.KJV: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.WEB: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
verses.ASV: And these are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; this is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Zibeão foram Aiá, e Aná. Este Aná é o que descobriu as fontes termais no deserto, quando apascentava os asnos de Zibeão seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Zibeón fueron Aja, y Ana. Este Ana es el que descubrió los mulos en el desierto, cuando apacentaba los asnos de Zibeón su padre.

verses.KJV: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.WEB: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
verses.ASV: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Aná foram Disom, e Oolibama, filha de Aná.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Ana fueron Disón, y Aholibama, hija de Ana.

verses.KJV: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.WEB: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.ASV: And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os filhos de Disom: Hendã, Esbã, Itrã, e Querã.
verses.RVR09: Y estos fueron los hijos de Disón: Hemdán, Eshbán, Ithram, y Cherán.

verses.KJV: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.WEB: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.ASV: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and Akan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os filhos de Eser: Bilã, Zaavã, e Acã.
verses.RVR09: Y estos fueron los hijos de Ezer: Bilhán, Zaaván, y Acán.

verses.KJV: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
verses.WEB: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.ASV: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Disã: Uz, e Harã.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Disán: Huz, y Arán.

verses.KJV: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
verses.WEB: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
verses.ASV: These are the chiefs that came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os duques dos horeus: o duque Lotã, o duque Sobal, o duque Zibeão, o duque Aná.
verses.RVR09: Y estos fueron los duques de los Horeos: el duque Lotán, el duque Sobal, el duque Zibeón, el duque Ana,

verses.KJV: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
verses.WEB: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
verses.ASV: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
verses.ALMEIDA: O duque Disom, o duque Eser, o duque Disã: estes foram os duques dos horeus: por seus ducados na terra de Seir.
verses.RVR09: El duque Disón, el duque Ezer, el duque Disán: estos fueron los duques de los Horeos: por sus ducados en la tierra de Seir.

verses.KJV: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse rei sobre os filhos de Israel, foram estes:
verses.RVR09: Y los reyes que reinaron en la tierra de Edom, antes que reinase rey sobre los hijos de Israel, fueron estos:

verses.KJV: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.WEB: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.ASV: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Belá, filho de Beor, reinou em Edom: e o nome de sua cidade foi Dinabá.
verses.RVR09: Bela, hijo de Beor, reinó en Edom: y el nombre de su ciudad fué Dinaba.

verses.KJV: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Belá, e reinou em seu lugar Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Bela, y reinó en su lugar Jobab, hijo de Zera, de Bosra.

verses.KJV: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Jobabe, e em seu lugar reinou Husão, da terra de Temã.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Jobab, y en su lugar reinó Husam, de tierra de Temán.

verses.KJV: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.WEB: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
verses.ASV: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Husão, e reinou em seu lugar Hadade, filho de Bedade, o que feriu a Midiã no campo de Moabe: e o nome de sua cidade foi Avite.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Husam, y reinó en su lugar Adad, hijo de Badad, el que hirió á Midián en el campo de Moab: y el nombre de su ciudad fué Avith.

verses.KJV: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Hadade, e em seu lugar reinou Samlá, de Masreca.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Adad, y en su lugar reinó Samla, de Masreca.

verses.KJV: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Samlá, e reinou em seu lugar Saul, de Reobote do rio.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Samla, y reinó en su lugar Saúl, de Rehoboth del Río.

verses.KJV: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Saul, e em seu lugar reinou Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Saúl, y en lugar suyo reinó Baalanán, hijo de Achbor.

verses.KJV: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.WEB: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.ASV: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor, e reinou Hadar em seu lugar: e o nome de sua cidade foi Paú; e o nome de sua mulher Meetabel, filha de Matrede, filha de Mezaabe.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Baalanán, hijo de Achbor, y reinó Adar en lugar suyo: y el nombre de su ciudad fué Pau; y el nombre de su mujer Meetabel, hija de Matred, hija de Mezaab.

verses.KJV: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
verses.WEB: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
verses.ASV: And these are the names of the chiefs that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois, são os nomes dos duques de Esaú por suas linhagens, por seus lugares, e seus nomes: o duque Timna, o duque Alva, o duque Jetete,
verses.RVR09: Estos, pues, son los nombres de los duques de Esaú por sus linajes, por sus lugares, y sus nombres: el duque Timna, el duque Alva, el duque Jetheth,

verses.KJV: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.WEB: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.ASV: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.ALMEIDA: O duque Oolibama, o duque Elá, o duque Pinom,
verses.RVR09: El duque Aholibama, el duque Ela, el duque Pinón,

verses.KJV: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.WEB: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.ASV: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.ALMEIDA: O duque Quenaz, o duque Temã, o duque Mibzar,
verses.RVR09: El duque Cenaz, el duque Temán, el duque Mibzar,

verses.KJV: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
verses.WEB: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
verses.ASV: chief Magdiel, chief Iram: these are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
verses.ALMEIDA: O duque Magdiel, e o duque Hirão. Estes foram os duques de Edom por suas habitações na terra de sua possessão. Edom é o mesmo Esaú, pai dos edomitas.
verses.RVR09: El duque Magdiel, y el duque Hiram. Estos fueron los duques de Edom por sus habitaciones en la tierra de su posesión. Edom es el mismo Esaú, padre de los Idumeos.

verses.KJV: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And Jacob dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings, in the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitou Jacó na terra onde peregrinou seu pai, na terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Y HABITÓ Jacob en la tierra donde peregrinó su padre, en la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
verses.WEB: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.
verses.ASV: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and he was a lad with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought the evil report of them unto their father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas foram as gerações de Jacó. José, sendo de idade de dezessete anos apascentava as ovelhas com seus irmãos; e o jovem estava com os filhos de Bila, e com os filhos de Zilpa, mulheres de seu pai: e contava José a seu pai as más notícias acerca deles.
verses.RVR09: Estas fueron las generaciones de Jacob. José, siendo de edad de diez y siete años apacentaba las ovejas con sus hermanos; y el joven estaba con los hijos de Bilha, y con los hijos de Zilpa, mujeres de su padre: y noticiaba José á su padre la mala fama de ellos.

verses.KJV: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
verses.WEB: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.
verses.ASV: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colors.
verses.ALMEIDA: E amava Israel a José mais que a todos os seus filhos, porque lhe havia tido em sua velhice: e lhe fez uma roupa de diversas cores.
verses.RVR09: Y amaba Israel á José más que á todos sus hijos, porque le había tenido en su vejez: y le hizo una ropa de diversos colores.

verses.KJV: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.WEB: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.
verses.ASV: And his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren; and they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo seus irmãos que seu pai o amava mais que a todos os seus irmãos, odiavam-lhe, e não lhe podiam falar pacificamente.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo sus hermanos que su padre lo amaba más que á todos sus hermanos, aborrecíanle, y no le podían hablar pacíficamente.

verses.KJV: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
verses.WEB: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
verses.ASV: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sonhou José um sonho e contou-o a seus irmãos; e eles vieram a odiar-lhe mais ainda.
verses.RVR09: Y soñó José un sueño, y contólo á sus hermanos; y ellos vinieron á aborrecerle más todavía.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Ouvi agora este sonho que sonhei:
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Oíd ahora este sueño que he soñado:

verses.KJV: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
verses.WEB: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”
verses.ASV: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves came round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que atávamos feixes no meio do campo, e eis que meu feixe se levantava, e estava em pé, e que vossos feixes estavam ao redor, e se inclinavam ao meu.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que atábamos manojos en medio del campo, y he aquí que mi manojo se levantaba, y estaba derecho, y que vuestros manojos estaban alrededor, y se inclinaban al mío.

verses.KJV: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.WEB: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.
verses.ASV: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.ALMEIDA: E responderam-lhe seus irmãos: Reinarás tu sobre nós, ou serás tu senhor sobre nós? E o odiaram ainda mais por causa de seus sonhos e de suas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiéronle sus hermanos: ¿Has de reinar tú sobre nosotros, ó te has de enseñorear sobre nosotros? Y le aborrecieron aún más á causa de sus sueños y de sus palabras.

verses.KJV: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
verses.WEB: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”
verses.ASV: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed yet a dream; and, behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars made obeisance to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sonhou ainda outro sonho, e contou-o a seus irmãos, dizendo: Eis que sonhei outro sonho, e eis que o sol e a lua e onze estrelas se inclinavam a mim.
verses.RVR09: Y soñó aún otro sueño, y contólo á sus hermanos, diciendo: He aquí que he soñado otro sueño, y he aquí que el sol y la luna y once estrellas se inclinaban á mí.

verses.KJV: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
verses.WEB: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”
verses.ASV: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren; and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: E contou-o a seu pai e a seus irmãos: e seu pai lhe repreendeu, e disse-lhe: Que sonho é este que sonhaste? Viremos eu e tua mãe, e teus irmãos, a nos inclinarmos a ti em terra?
verses.RVR09: Y contólo á su padre y á sus hermanos: y su padre le reprendió, y díjole: ¿Qué sueño es este que soñaste? ¿Hemos de venir yo y tu madre, y tus hermanos, á inclinarnos á ti á tierra?

verses.KJV: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
verses.WEB: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
verses.ASV: And his brethren envied him; but his father kept the saying in mind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos lhe tinham inveja, mas seu pai guardava isso em mente.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos le tenían envidia, mas su padre paraba la consideración en ello.

verses.KJV: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
verses.WEB: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
verses.ASV: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram seus irmãos a apascentar as ovelhas de seu pai em Siquém.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron sus hermanos á apacentar las ovejas de su padre en Sichêm.

verses.KJV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
verses.WEB: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”
verses.ASV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Are not thy brethren feeding the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Israel a José: Teus irmãos apascentam as ovelhas em Siquém: vem, e te enviarei a eles. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Israel á José: Tus hermanos apacientan las ovejas en Sichêm: ven, y te enviaré á ellos. Y él respondió: Heme aquí.

verses.KJV: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.ASV: And he said to him, Go now, see whether it is well with thy brethren, and well with the flock; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Vai agora, olha como estão teus irmãos e como estão as ovelhas, e traze-me a resposta. E enviou-o do vale de Hebrom, e chegou a Siquém.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Ve ahora, mira cómo están tus hermanos y cómo están las ovejas, y tráeme la respuesta. Y enviólo del valle de Hebrón, y llegó á Sichêm.

verses.KJV: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
verses.WEB: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”
verses.ASV: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: E achou-o um homem, andando ele perdido pelo campo, e perguntou-lhe aquele homem, dizendo: Que buscas?
verses.RVR09: Y hallólo un hombre, andando él perdido por el campo, y preguntóle aquel hombre, diciendo: ¿Qué buscas?

verses.KJV: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.
verses.WEB: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”
verses.ASV: And he said, I am seeking my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they are feeding [the flock].
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Busco a meus irmãos: rogo-te que me mostres onde apascentam.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Busco á mis hermanos: ruégote que me muestres dónde pastan.

verses.KJV: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
verses.WEB: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
verses.ASV: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele homem respondeu: Já se foram daqui; eu lhes ouvi dizer: Vamos a Dotã. Então José foi atrás de seus irmãos, e achou-os em Dotã.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel hombre respondió: Ya se han ido de aquí; y yo les oí decir: Vamos á Dothán. Entonces José fué tras de sus hermanos, y hallólos en Dothán.

verses.KJV: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
verses.WEB: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.
verses.ASV: And they saw him afar off, and before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eles o viram de longe, antes que perto deles chegasse, tramaram contra ele para matar-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Y como ellos lo vieron de lejos, antes que cerca de ellos llegara, proyectaron contra él para matarle.

verses.KJV: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
verses.WEB: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
verses.ASV: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram um ao outro: Eis que vem o sonhador;
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron el uno al otro: He aquí viene el soñador;

verses.KJV: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
verses.WEB: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”
verses.ASV: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, An evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, vinde, e o matemos e o lancemos em uma cisterna, e diremos: Alguma fera selvagem o devorou: e veremos que serão seus sonhos.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, venid, y matémoslo y echémosle en una cisterna, y diremos: Alguna mala bestia le devoró: y veremos qué serán sus sueños.

verses.KJV: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
verses.WEB: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
verses.ASV: And Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, Let us not take his life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Rúben ouviu isto, livrou-o de suas mãos e disse: Não o matemos.
verses.RVR09: Y como Rubén oyó esto, librólo de sus manos, y dijo: No lo matemos.

verses.KJV: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
verses.WEB: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
verses.ASV: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood; cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand upon him: that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes Rúben: Não derrameis sangue; lançai-o nesta cisterna que está no deserto, e não ponhais mão nele; para livrá-lo assim de suas mãos, para fazê-lo virar a seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Rubén: No derraméis sangre; echadlo en esta cisterna que está en el desierto, y no pongáis mano en él; por librarlo así de sus manos, para hacerlo volver á su padre.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;
verses.WEB: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stripped Joseph of his coat, the coat of many colors that was on him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, quando chegou José a seus irmãos, eles fizeram desnudar a José sua roupa, a roupa de cores que tinha sobre si;
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que, cuando llegó José á sus hermanos, ellos hicieron desnudar á José su ropa, la ropa de colores que tenía sobre sí;

verses.KJV: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
verses.WEB: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
verses.ASV: and they took him, and cast him into the pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram-no, e lançaram-lhe na cisterna; mas a cisterna estava vazia, não havia nela água.
verses.RVR09: Y tomáronlo, y echáronle en la cisterna; mas la cisterna estaba vacía, no había en ella agua.

verses.KJV: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.WEB: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.ASV: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a caravan of Ishmaelites was coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sentaram-se a comer pão: e levantando os olhos olharam, e eis uma companhia de ismaelitas que vinha de Gileade, e seus camelos traziam aromas e bálsamo e mirra, e iam a levá-lo ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y sentáronse á comer pan: y alzando los ojos miraron, y he aquí una compañía de Ismaelitas que venía de Galaad, y sus camellos traían aromas y bálsamo y mirra, é iban á llevarlo á Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
verses.WEB: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.ASV: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Judá disse a seus irmãos: Que proveito há em que matemos a nosso irmão e encubramos sua morte?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Judá dijo á sus hermanos: ¿Qué provecho el que matemos á nuestro hermano y encubramos su muerte?

verses.KJV: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
verses.WEB: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.
verses.ASV: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother, our flesh. And his brethren hearkened unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, e o vendamos aos ismaelitas, e não seja nossa mão sobre ele; que nosso irmão é nossa carne. E seus irmãos concordaram com ele.
verses.RVR09: Venid, y vendámosle á los Ismaelitas, y no sea nuestra mano sobre él; que nuestro hermano es nuestra carne. Y sus hermanos acordaron con él.

verses.KJV: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.WEB: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.ASV: And there passed by Midianites, merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. And they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando passavam os midianitas mercadores, tiraram eles a José da cisterna, e trouxeram-lhe acima, e o venderam aos ismaelitas por vinte peças de prata. E levaram a José ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y como pasaban los Midianitas mercaderes, sacaron ellos á José de la cisterna, y trajéronle arriba, y le vendieron á los Ismaelitas por veinte piezas de plata. Y llevaron á José á Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
verses.WEB: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
verses.ASV: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Rúben voltou à cisterna, e não achou a José dentro, e rasgou suas roupas.
verses.RVR09: Y Rubén volvió á la cisterna, y no halló á José dentro, y rasgó sus vestidos.

verses.KJV: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
verses.WEB: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”
verses.ASV: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a seus irmãos e disse: O jovem não aparece; e eu, aonde irei eu?
verses.RVR09: Y tornó á sus hermanos, y dijo: El mozo no parece; y yo, ¿adónde iré yo?

verses.KJV: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
verses.WEB: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.
verses.ASV: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a he-goat, and dipped the coat in the blood;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles tomaram a roupa de José, e degolaram um cabrito das cabras, e tingiram a roupa com o sangue;
verses.RVR09: Entonces tomaron ellos la ropa de José, y degollaron un cabrito de las cabras, y tiñeron la ropa con la sangre;

verses.KJV: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.
verses.WEB: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”
verses.ASV: and they sent the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, This have we found: know now whether it is thy son’s coat or not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviaram a roupa de cores e trouxeram-na a seu pai, e disseram: Achamos isto, reconhece agora se é ou não a roupa de teu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y enviaron la ropa de colores y trajéronla á su padre, y dijeron: Esta hemos hallado, reconoce ahora si es ó no la ropa de tu hijo.
