verses.KJV: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
verses.WEB: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”
verses.ASV: And he knew it, and said, It is my son’s coat: an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele a reconheceu, e disse: A roupa de meu filho é; alguma fera selvagem o devorou; José foi despedaçado.
verses.RVR09: Y él la conoció, y dijo: La ropa de mi hijo es; alguna mala bestia le devoró; José ha sido despedazado.

verses.KJV: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.WEB: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.ASV: And Jacob rent his garments, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jacó rasgou suas roupas, e pôs saco sobre seus lombos, e fez luto por seu filho muitos dias.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jacob rasgó sus vestidos, y puso saco sobre sus lomos, y enlutóse por su hijo muchos días.

verses.KJV: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
verses.WEB: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.
verses.ASV: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down to Sheol to my son mourning. And his father wept for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantaram-se todos os seus filhos e todas as suas filhas para consolá-lo; mas ele não quis receber consolação, e disse: Porque eu tenho de descer ao meu filho com luto ao Xeol. E seu pai chorou por ele.
verses.RVR09: Y levantáronse todos sus hijos y todas sus hijas para consolarlo; mas él no quiso tomar consolación, y dijo: Porque yo tengo de descender á mi hijo enlutado hasta la sepultura. Y llorólo su padre.

verses.KJV: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.
verses.WEB: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
verses.ASV: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os midianitas o venderam no Egito a Potifar, oficial de Faraó, capitão dos da guarda.
verses.RVR09: Y los Midianitas lo vendieron en Egipto á Potiphar, eunuco de Faraón, capitán de los de la guardia.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.WEB: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu naquele tempo, que Judá desceu da presença de seus irmãos, e foi-se a um homem adulamita, que se chamava Hira.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ en aquel tiempo, que Judá descendió de con sus hermanos, y fuése á un varón Adullamita, que se llamaba Hira.

verses.KJV: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
verses.WEB: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.
verses.ASV: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua; and he took her, and went in unto her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu ali Judá a filha de um homem cananeu, o qual se chamava Sua; e tomou-a, e se deitou com ela:
verses.RVR09: Y vió allí Judá la hija de un hombre Cananeo, el cual se llamaba Súa; y tomóla, y entró á ella:

verses.KJV: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
verses.WEB: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
verses.ASV: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual concebeu, e deu à luz um filho; e chamou seu nome Er.
verses.RVR09: La cual concibió, y parió un hijo; y llamó su nombre Er.

verses.KJV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
verses.WEB: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
verses.ASV: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, e chamou seu nome Onã.
verses.RVR09: Y concibió otra vez, y parió un hijo, y llamó su nombre Onán.

verses.KJV: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
verses.WEB: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
verses.ASV: And she yet again bare a son, and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a conceber, e deu à luz um filho, e chamou seu nome Selá. E estava em Quezibe quando o deu à luz.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á concebir, y parió un hijo, y llamó su nombre Sela. Y estaba en Chezib cuando lo parió.

verses.KJV: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
verses.WEB: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
verses.ASV: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, and her name was Tamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Judá tomou mulher para seu primogênito Er, a qual se chamava Tamar.
verses.RVR09: Y Judá tomó mujer para su primogénito Er, la cual se llamaba Thamar.

verses.KJV: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord slew him.
verses.WEB: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.
verses.ASV: And Er, Judah’s first-born, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and Jehovah slew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Er, o primogênito de Judá, foi mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e tirou-lhe o SENHOR a vida.
verses.RVR09: Y Er, el primogénito de Judá, fué malo á los ojos de Jehová, y quitóle Jehová la vida.

verses.KJV: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
verses.WEB: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
verses.ASV: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother unto her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Judá disse a Onã: Deita-te com mulher de teu irmão, e casa-te com ela, e suscita descendência a teu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Judá dijo á Onán: Entra á la mujer de tu hermano, y despósate con ella, y suscita simiente á tu hermano.

verses.KJV: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
verses.WEB: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.
verses.ASV: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabendo Onã que a descendência não havia de ser sua, sucedia que quando se deitava com mulher de seu irmão derramava em terra, para não dar descendência a seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y sabiendo Onán que la simiente no había de ser suya, sucedía que cuando entraba á la mujer de su hermano vertía en tierra, por no dar simiente á su hermano.

verses.KJV: And the thing which he did displeased the Lord: wherefore he slew him also.
verses.WEB: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.
verses.ASV: And the thing which he did was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and he slew him also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desagradou aos olhos do SENHOR o que fazia, e também tirou a ele a vida.
verses.RVR09: Y desagradó en ojos de Jehová lo que hacía, y también quitó á él la vida.

verses.KJV: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
verses.WEB: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
verses.ASV: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter-in-law, Remain a widow in thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown up; for he said, Lest he also die, like his brethren. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Judá disse a Tamar sua nora: Fica-te viúva em casa de teu pai, até que cresça Selá meu filho; porque disse: Para que não aconteça que morra ele também como seus irmãos. E foi-se Tamar, e ficou em casa de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y Judá dijo á Thamar su nuera: Estáte viuda en casa de tu padre, hasta que crezca Sela mi hijo; porque dijo: Que quizá no muera él también como sus hermanos. Y fuése Thamar, y estúvose en casa de su padre.

verses.KJV: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.WEB: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.
verses.ASV: And in process of time Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheep-shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passaram muitos dias, e morreu a filha de Sua, mulher de Judá; e Judá se consolou, e subia aos tosquiadores de suas ovelhas a Timna, ele e seu amigo Hira o adulamita.
verses.RVR09: Y pasaron muchos días, y murió la hija de Súa, mujer de Judá; y Judá se consoló, y subía á los trasquiladores de sus ovejas á Timnath, él y su amigo Hira el Adullamita.

verses.KJV: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
verses.WEB: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
verses.ASV: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold, thy father-in-law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dado aviso a Tamar, dizendo: Eis que teu sogro sobe a Timna a tosquiar suas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y fué dado aviso á Thamar, diciendo: He aquí tu suegro sube á Timnath á trasquilar sus ovejas.

verses.KJV: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
verses.WEB: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
verses.ASV: And she put off from her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she was not given unto him to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tirou ela de sobre si as roupas de sua viuvez, e cobriu-se com um véu, e envolveu-se, e se pôs à porta das águas que estão junto ao caminho de Timna; porque via que havia crescido Selá, e ela não era dada a ele por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Entonces quitó ella de sobre sí los vestidos de su viudez, y cubrióse con un velo, y arrebozóse, y se puso á la puerta de las aguas que están junto al camino de Timnath; porque veía que había crecido Sela, y ella no era dada á él por mujer.

verses.KJV: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
verses.WEB: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
verses.ASV: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a harlot; for she had covered her face.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu-a Judá, e teve-a por prostituta, porque havia ela coberto seu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Y vióla Judá, y túvola por ramera, porque había ella cubierto su rostro.

verses.KJV: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
verses.WEB: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”
verses.ASV: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Come, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee: for he knew not that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E desviou-se do caminho até ela, e disse-lhe: Eia, pois, agora deitarei contigo; porque não sabia que era sua nora; e ela disse: Que me darás, se deitares comigo?
verses.RVR09: Y apartóse del camino hacia ella, y díjole: Ea, pues, ahora entraré á ti; porque no sabía que era su nuera; y ella dijo: ¿Qué me has de dar, si entrares á mí?

verses.KJV: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
verses.WEB: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
verses.ASV: And he said, I will send thee a kid of the goats from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele respondeu: Eu te enviarei do gado um cabrito das cabras. E ela disse: Terás de me dar penhor até que o envies.
verses.RVR09: El respondió: Yo te enviaré del ganado un cabrito de las cabras. Y ella dijo: Hasme de dar prenda hasta que lo envíes.

verses.KJV: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
verses.WEB: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
verses.ASV: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet and thy cord, and thy staff that is in thy hand. And he gave them to her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele disse: Que penhor te darei? Ela respondeu: Teu anel, e teu manto, e teu bordão que tens em tua mão. E ele lhe deu, e se deitou com ela, a qual concebeu dele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él dijo: ¿Qué prenda te daré? Ella respondió: Tu anillo, y tu manto, y tu bordón que tienes en tu mano. Y él se los dió, y entró á ella, la cual concibió de él.

verses.KJV: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.WEB: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.ASV: And she arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se, e foi-se: e tirou o véu de sobre si, e vestiu-se das roupas de sua viuvez.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse, y fuése: y quitóse el velo de sobre sí, y vistióse las ropas de su viudez.

verses.KJV: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
verses.WEB: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
verses.ASV: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Judá enviou o cabrito das cabras por meio de seu amigo o adulamita, para que tomasse o penhor da mão da mulher; mas não a achou.
verses.RVR09: Y Judá envió el cabrito de las cabras por mano de su amigo el Adullamita, para que tomase la prenda de mano de la mujer; mas no la halló.

verses.KJV: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
verses.WEB: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
verses.ASV: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the wayside? And they said, There hath been no prostitute here.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perguntou aos homens daquele lugar, dizendo: Onde está a prostituta das águas junto ao caminho? E eles lhe disseram: Não esteve aqui prostituta.
verses.RVR09: Y preguntó á los hombres de aquel lugar, diciendo: ¿Dónde está la ramera de las aguas junto al camino? Y ellos le dijeron: No ha estado aquí ramera.

verses.KJV: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
verses.WEB: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
verses.ASV: And he returned to Judah, and said, I have not found her; and also the men of the place said, There hath been no prostitute here.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele se voltou a Judá, e disse: Não a achei; e também os homens do lugar disseram: Aqui não esteve prostituta.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él se volvió á Judá, y dijo: No la he hallado; y también los hombres del lugar dijeron: Aquí no ha estado ramera.

verses.KJV: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
verses.WEB: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
verses.ASV: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be put to shame: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Judá disse: Tome ela dessas coisas para si, para que não sejamos menosprezados: eis que eu enviei este cabrito, e tu não a achaste.
verses.RVR09: Y Judá dijo: Tómeselo para sí, porque no seamos menospreciados: he aquí yo he enviado este cabrito, y tú no la hallaste.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
verses.WEB: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter-in-law hath played the harlot; and moreover, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que ao fim de uns três meses foi dado aviso a Judá, dizendo: Tamar tua nora cometeu imoralidade sexual, e além disso está grávida das promiscuidades. E Judá disse: Tirai-a, e seja queimada.
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció que al cabo de unos tres meses fué dado aviso á Judá, diciendo: Thamar tu nuera ha fornicado, y aun cierto está preñada de las fornicaciones. Y Judá dijo: Sacadla, y sea quemada.

verses.KJV: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
verses.WEB: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”
verses.ASV: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and the cords, and the staff.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela quando a tiravam, enviou a dizer a seu sogro: Do homem a quem pertence estas coisas, estou grávida: e disse mais: Olha agora a quem pertence estas coisas, o anel, e o manto, e o bordão.
verses.RVR09: Y ella, cuando la sacaban, envió á decir á su suegro: Del varón cuyas son estas cosas, estoy preñada: y dijo más: Mira ahora cúyas son estas cosas, el anillo, y el manto, y el bordón.

verses.KJV: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
verses.WEB: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
verses.ASV: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She is more righteous than I, forasmuch as I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Judá os reconheceu, e disse: Mais justa é que eu, porquanto não a dei a Selá meu filho. E nunca mais a conheceu.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Judá los reconoció, y dijo: Más justa es que yo, por cuanto no la he dado á Sela mi hijo. Y nunca más la conoció.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.WEB: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que ao tempo de dar à luz, eis que havia dois em seu ventre.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que al tiempo del parir, he aquí había dos en su vientre.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
verses.WEB: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that one put out a hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu, quando dava à luz, que tirou a mão um, e a parteira tomou e amarrou à sua mão um fio de escarlate, dizendo: Este saiu primeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió, cuando paría, que sacó la mano el uno, y la partera tomó y ató á su mano un hilo de grana, diciendo: Este salió primero.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
verses.WEB: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, Wherefore hast thou made a breach for thyself? therefore his name was called Perez.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém foi que voltando ele a recolher a mão, eis que seu irmão saiu; e ela disse: Como fizeste sobre ti rompimento? E chamou seu nome Perez.
verses.RVR09: Empero fué que tornando él á meter la mano, he aquí su hermano salió; y ella dijo: ¿Por qué has hecho sobre ti rotura? Y llamó su nombre Phares.

verses.KJV: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
verses.WEB: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
verses.ASV: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zerah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois saiu seu irmão, o que tinha em sua mão o fio de escarlate, e chamou seu nome Zerá.
verses.RVR09: Y después salió su hermano, el que tenía en su mano el hilo de grana, y llamó su nombre Zara.

verses.KJV: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.
verses.WEB: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.
verses.ASV: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hand of the Ishmaelites, that had brought him down thither.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levado José ao Egito, comprou-o Potifar, oficial de Faraó, capitão dos da guarda, homem egípcio, da mão dos ismaelitas que o haviam levado ali.
verses.RVR09: Y LLEVADO José á Egipto, comprólo Potiphar, eunuco de Faraón, capitán de los de la guardia, varón Egipcio, de mano de los Ismaelitas que lo habían llevado allá.

verses.KJV: And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verses.WEB: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR foi com José, e foi homem próspero: e estava na casa de seu senhor o egípcio.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová fué con José, y fué varón prosperado: y estaba en la casa de su señor el Egipcio.

verses.KJV: And his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
verses.WEB: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand.
verses.ASV: And his master saw that Jehovah was with him, and that Jehovah made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu seu senhor que o SENHOR era com ele, e que tudo o que ele fazia, o SENHOR o fazia prosperar em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Y vió su señor que Jehová era con él, y que todo lo que él hacía, Jehová lo hacía prosperar en su mano.

verses.KJV: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
verses.WEB: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
verses.ASV: And Joseph found favor in his sight, and he ministered unto him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim achou José favor em seus olhos, e servia-lhe; e ele lhe fez mordomo de sua casa, e entregou em seu poder tudo o que tinha.
verses.RVR09: Así halló José gracia en sus ojos, y servíale; y él le hizo mayordomo de su casa, y entregó en su poder todo lo que tenía.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the Lord blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the Lord was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
verses.WEB: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. The LORD’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass from the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that Jehovah blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of Jehovah was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, desde quando lhe deu o encargo de sua casa, e de tudo o que tinha, o SENHOR abençoou a casa do egípcio por causa de José; e a bênção do SENHOR foi sobre tudo o que tinha, tanto em casa como no campo.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, desde cuando le dió el encargo de su casa, y de todo lo que tenía, Jehová bendijo la casa del Egipcio á causa de José; y la bendición de Jehová fué sobre todo lo que tenía, así en casa como en el campo.

verses.KJV: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.
verses.WEB: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.
verses.ASV: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not aught [that was] with him, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was comely, and well-favored.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deixou tudo o que tinha em mão de José; nem com ele sabia de nada mais que do pão que comia. E era José de belo semblante e bela presença.
verses.RVR09: Y dejó todo lo que tenía en mano de José; ni con él sabía de nada más que del pan que comía. Y era José de hermoso semblante y bella presencia.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
verses.WEB: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu depois disto, que a mulher de seu senhor pôs seus olhos em José, e disse: Dorme comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció después de esto, que la mujer de su señor puso sus ojos en José, y dijo: Duerme conmigo.

verses.KJV: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
verses.WEB: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.
verses.ASV: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master knoweth not what is with me in the house, and he hath put all that he hath into my hand:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele não quis, e disse à mulher de seu senhor: Eis que meu senhor não sabe comigo o que há em casa, e pôs em minha mão tudo o que tem:
verses.RVR09: Y él no quiso, y dijo á la mujer de su señor: He aquí que mi señor no sabe conmigo lo que hay en casa, y ha puesto en mi mano todo lo que tiene:

verses.KJV: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
verses.WEB: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”
verses.ASV: he is not greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back anything from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há outro maior que eu nesta casa, e nenhuma coisa me há reservado a não ser a ti, porquanto tu és sua mulher; como, pois, faria eu este grande mal e pecaria contra Deus?
verses.RVR09: No hay otro mayor que yo en esta casa, y ninguna cosa me ha reservado sino á ti, por cuanto tú eres su mujer; ¿cómo, pues, haría yo este grande mal, y pecaría contra Dios?

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
verses.WEB: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, [or] to be with her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que falando ela a José cada dia, e não escutando-a ele para deitar-se ao lado dela, para estar com ela.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que hablando ella á José cada día, y no escuchándola él para acostarse al lado de ella, para estar con ella,

verses.KJV: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
verses.WEB: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass about this time, that he went into the house to do his work; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aconteceu que entrou ele um dia em casa para fazer seu ofício, e não havia ninguém dos da casa ali em casa.
verses.RVR09: Aconteció que entró él un día en casa para hacer su oficio, y no había nadie de los de casa allí en casa:

verses.KJV: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
verses.WEB: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.
verses.ASV: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pegou-o ela por sua roupa, dizendo: Dorme comigo. Então ele deixou sua roupa nas mãos dela, e fugiu, e saiu-se fora.
verses.RVR09: Y asiólo ella por su ropa, diciendo: Duerme conmigo. Entonces dejóla él su ropa en las manos, y huyó, y salióse fuera.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
verses.WEB: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando viu ela que lhe havia deixado sua roupa em suas mãos, e havia fugido fora,
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció que cuando vió ella que le había dejado su ropa en sus manos, y había huído fuera,

verses.KJV: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
verses.WEB: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.
verses.ASV: that she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in a Hebrew unto us to mock us: he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamou aos de casa, e falou-lhes dizendo: Olhai que ele nos trouxe um hebreu, para que fizesse zombaria de nós: veio ele a mim para dormir comigo, e eu dei grandes vozes;
verses.RVR09: Llamó á los de casa, y hablóles diciendo: Mirad, nos ha traído un Hebreo, para que hiciese burla de nosotros: vino él á mí para dormir conmigo, y yo dí grandes voces;

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
verses.WEB: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
verses.ASV: and it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled, and got him out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo que eu erguia a voz e gritava, deixou junto a mim sua roupa, e fugiu, e saiu-se fora.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo que yo alzaba la voz y gritaba, dejó junto á mí su ropa, y huyó, y salióse fuera.

verses.KJV: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
verses.WEB: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
verses.ASV: And she laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela pôs junto a si a roupa dele, até que veio seu senhor à sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y ella puso junto á sí la ropa de él, hasta que vino su señor á su casa.

verses.KJV: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
verses.WEB: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,
verses.ASV: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, whom thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe falou ela semelhantes palavras, dizendo: O servo hebreu que nos trouxeste, veio a mim para desonrar-me;
verses.RVR09: Entonces le habló ella semejantes palabras, diciendo: El siervo Hebreo que nos trajiste, vino á mí para deshonrarme;

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
verses.WEB: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
verses.ASV: and it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eu levantei minha voz e gritei, ele deixou sua roupa junto a mim, e fugiu fora.
verses.RVR09: Y como yo alcé mi voz y grité, él dejó su ropa junto á mí, y huyó fuera.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
verses.WEB: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que quando ouviu seu senhor as palavras que sua mulher lhe falara, dizendo: Assim me tratou teu servo; acendeu-se seu furor.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedió que como oyó su señor las palabras que su mujer le hablara, diciendo: Así me ha tratado tu siervo; encendióse su furor.

verses.KJV: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
verses.WEB: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.
verses.ASV: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou seu senhor a José, e pôs-lhe na casa do cárcere, onde estavam os presos do rei, e esteve ali na casa do cárcere.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó su señor á José, y púsole en la casa de la cárcel, donde estaban los presos del rey, y estuvo allí en la casa de la cárcel.

verses.KJV: But the Lord was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.WEB: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah was with Joseph, and showed kindness unto him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR foi com José, e estendeu a ele sua misericórdia, e deu-lhe favor aos olhos do chefe da casa do cárcere.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová fué con José, y extendió á él su misericordia, y dióle gracia en ojos del principal de la casa de la cárcel.

verses.KJV: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
verses.WEB: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.
verses.ASV: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o chefe da casa do cárcere entregou em mão de José todos os presos que havia naquela prisão; tudo o que faziam ali, ele o fazia.
verses.RVR09: Y el principal de la casa de la cárcel entregó en mano de José todos los presos que había en aquella prisión; todo lo que hacían allí, él lo hacía.

verses.KJV: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the Lord was with him, and that which he did, the Lord made it to prosper.
verses.WEB: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper.
verses.ASV: The keeper of the prison looked not to anything that was under his hand, because Jehovah was with him; and that which he did, Jehovah made it to prosper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não via o chefe do cárcere coisa alguma que em sua mão estava; porque o SENHOR era com ele, e o que ele fazia, o SENHOR o fazia prosperar.
verses.RVR09: No veía el principal de la cárcel cosa alguna que en su mano estaba; porque Jehová era con él, y lo que él hacía, Jehová lo prosperaba.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
verses.WEB: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu depois destas coisas, que o copeiro do rei do Egito e o padeiro transgrediram contra seu senhor o rei do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ después de estas cosas, que el copero del rey de Egipto y el panadero delinquieron contra su señor el rey de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh was wroth against his two officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E irou-se Faraó contra seus dois eunucos, contra o principal dos copeiros, e contra o principal dos padeiros:
verses.RVR09: Y enojóse Faraón contra sus dos eunucos, contra el principal de los coperos, y contra el principal de los panaderos:

verses.KJV: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
verses.WEB: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
verses.ASV: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os pôs em prisão na casa do capitão dos da guarda, na casa do cárcere onde José estava preso.
verses.RVR09: Y púsolos en prisión en la casa del capitán de los de la guardia, en la casa de la cárcel donde José estaba preso.

verses.KJV: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
verses.WEB: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
verses.ASV: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he ministered unto them: and they continued a season in ward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o capitão dos da guarda deu responsabilidade deles a José, e ele lhes servia: e estiveram dias na prisão.
verses.RVR09: Y el capitán de los de la guardia dió cargo de ellos á José, y él les servía: y estuvieron días en la prisión.

verses.KJV: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.
verses.WEB: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
verses.ASV: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ambos, o copeiro e o padeiro do rei do Egito, que estavam detidos na prisão, viram um sonho, cada um seu sonho em uma mesma noite, cada um conforme a declaração de seu sonho.
verses.RVR09: Y ambos á dos, el copero y el panadero del rey de Egipto, que estaban arrestados en la prisión, vieron un sueño, cada uno su sueño en una misma noche, cada uno conforme á la declaración de su sueño.

verses.KJV: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
verses.WEB: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.
verses.ASV: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and saw them, and, behold, they were sad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a eles José pela manhã, e olhou-os, e eis que estavam tristes.
verses.RVR09: Y vino á ellos José por la mañana, y mirólos, y he aquí que estaban tristes.

verses.KJV: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?
verses.WEB: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”
verses.ASV: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in ward in his master’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sad to-day?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele perguntou àqueles oficiais de Faraó, que estavam com ele na prisão da casa de seu senhor, dizendo: Por que parecem hoje mal vossos semblantes?
verses.RVR09: Y él preguntó á aquellos eunucos de Faraón, que estaban con él en la prisión de la casa de su señor, diciendo: ¿Por qué parecen hoy mal vuestros semblantes?

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
verses.WEB: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell it me, I pray you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe disseram: Tivemos um sonho, e não há quem o declare. Então lhes disse José: Não são de Deus as interpretações? Contai-o a mim agora.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le dijeron: Hemos tenido un sueño, y no hay quien lo declare. Entonces les dijo José: ¿No son de Dios las declaraciones? Contádmelo ahora.

verses.KJV: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
verses.WEB: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,
verses.ASV: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o chefe dos copeiros contou seu sonho a José, e disse-lhe: Eu sonhava que via uma vide diante de mim,
verses.RVR09: Entonces el principal de los coperos contó su sueño á José, y díjole: Yo soñaba que veía una vid delante de mí,

verses.KJV: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
verses.WEB: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.
verses.ASV: and in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, [and] its blossoms shot forth; [and] the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
verses.ALMEIDA: E na vide três sarmentos; e ela como que brotava, e surgia sua flor, vindo a amadurecer seus cachos de uvas:
verses.RVR09: Y en la vid tres sarmientos; y ella como que brotaba, y arrojaba su flor, viniendo á madurar sus racimos de uvas:

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”
verses.ASV: and Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que o copo de Faraó estava em minha mão, e tomava eu as uvas, e as espremia no copo de Faraó, e dava eu o copo em mão de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y que la copa de Faraón estaba en mi mano, y tomaba yo las uvas, y las exprimía en la copa de Faraón, y daba yo la copa en mano de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
verses.WEB: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: the three branches are three days;
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe José: Esta é sua declaração: Os três sarmentos são três dias:
verses.RVR09: Y díjole José: Esta es su declaración: Los tres sarmientos son tres días:

verses.KJV: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
verses.WEB: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.
verses.ASV: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head, and restore thee unto thine office: and thou shalt give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

verses.RVR09: Al cabo de tres días Faraón te hará levantar cabeza, y te restituirá á tu puesto: y darás la copa á Faraón en su mano, como solías cuando eras su copero.

verses.KJV: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
verses.WEB: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.
verses.ASV: But have me in thy remembrance when it shall be well with thee, and show kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te, pois, de mim para contigo quando tiveres esse bem, e rogo-te que uses comigo de misericórdia, e faças menção de mim a Faraó, e me tires desta prisão:
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate, pues, de mí para contigo cuando tuvieres ese bien, y ruégote que uses conmigo de misericordia, y hagas mención de mí á Faraón, y me saques de esta casa:

verses.KJV: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
verses.WEB: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”
verses.ASV: for indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque furtado fui da terra dos hebreus; e tampouco fiz aqui para que me houvessem de pôr no cárcere.
verses.RVR09: Porque hurtado he sido de la tierra de los Hebreos; y tampoco he hecho aquí porqué me hubiesen de poner en la cárcel.

verses.KJV: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
verses.WEB: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.
verses.ASV: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo o chefe dos padeiros que havia interpretado para o bem, disse a José: Também eu sonhava que via três cestos brancos sobre minha cabeça;
verses.RVR09: Y viendo el principal de los panaderos que había declarado para bien, dijo á José: También yo soñaba que veía tres canastillos blancos sobre mi cabeza;

verses.KJV: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
verses.WEB: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”
verses.ASV: and in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of baked food for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no cesto mais alto havia de todos os alimentos de Faraó, obra de padeiro; e que as aves as comiam do cesto de sobre minha cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y en el canastillo más alto había de todas las viandas de Faraón, obra de panadero; y que las aves las comían del canastillo de sobre mi cabeza.

verses.KJV: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
verses.WEB: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.
verses.ASV: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: the three baskets are three days;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então respondeu José, e disse: Esta é sua declaração: Os três cestos três dias são;
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió José, y dijo: Esta es su declaración: Los tres canastillos tres días son;

verses.KJV: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
verses.WEB: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”
verses.ASV: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao fim de três dias tirará Faraó tua cabeça de sobre ti, e te fará enforcar na forca, e as aves comerão tua carne de sobre ti.
verses.RVR09: Al cabo de tres días quitará Faraón tu cabeza de sobre ti, y te hará colgar en la horca, y las aves comerán tu carne de sobre ti.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.WEB: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o terceiro dia o dia do aniversário de Faraó, e fez banquete a todos os seus servos: e levantou a cabeça do chefe dos copeiros, e a cabeça do chefe dos padeiros, entre seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y fué el tercero día el día del nacimiento de Faraón, é hizo banquete á todos sus sirvientes: y alzó la cabeza del principal de los coperos, y la cabeza del principal de los panaderos, entre sus servidores.

verses.KJV: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
verses.WEB: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;
verses.ASV: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez voltar a seu ofício ao chefe dos copeiros; e deu ele o copo em mão de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: E hizo volver á su oficio al principal de los coperos; y dió él la copa en mano de Faraón.

verses.KJV: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.WEB: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.ASV: but he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas fez enforcar ao principal dos padeiros, como lhe havia declarado José.
verses.RVR09: Mas hizo ahorcar al principal de los panaderos, como le había declarado José.

verses.KJV: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
verses.WEB: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
verses.ASV: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o chefe dos copeiros não se lembrou de José, ao invés disso lhe esqueceu.
verses.RVR09: Y el principal de los coperos no se acordó de José, sino que le olvidó.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
verses.WEB: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que passados dois anos teve Faraó um sonho: Parecia-lhe que estava junto ao rio;
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que pasados dos años tuvo Faraón un sueño: Parecíale que estaba junto al río;

verses.KJV: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
verses.WEB: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.
verses.ASV: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, well-favored and fat-fleshed; and they fed in the reed-grass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que do rio subiam sete vacas, belas à vista, e muito gordas, e pastavam entre os juncos:
verses.RVR09: Y que del río subían siete vacas, hermosas á la vista, y muy gordas, y pacían en el prado:

verses.WEB: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.
verses.ASV: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill-favored and lean-fleshed, and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que outras sete vacas subiam depois delas do rio, de feia aparência, e magras de carne, e pararam perto das vacas belas à beira do rio;
verses.RVR09: Y que otras siete vacas subían tras ellas del río, de fea vista, y enjutas de carne, y se pararon cerca de las vacas hermosas á la orilla del río:

verses.KJV: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.WEB: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.ASV: And the ill-favored and lean-fleshed kine did eat up the seven well-favored and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que as vacas de feia aparência e magras de carne devoravam as sete vacas belas e muito gordas. E despertou Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y que las vacas de fea vista y enjutas de carne devoraban á las siete vacas hermosas y muy gordas. Y despertó Faraón.

verses.KJV: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
verses.WEB: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.
verses.ASV: And he slept and dreamed a second time: and, behold, seven ears of grain came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dormiu de novo, e sonhou a segunda vez: Que sete espigas cheias e belas subiam de uma só haste:
verses.RVR09: Durmióse de nuevo, y soñó la segunda vez: Que siete espigas llenas y hermosas subían de una sola caña:

verses.KJV: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
verses.WEB: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
verses.ASV: And, behold, seven ears, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que outras sete espigas miúdas e abatidas do vento oriental, saíam depois delas:
verses.RVR09: Y que otras siete espigas menudas y abatidas del Solano, salían después de ellas:

verses.KJV: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
verses.WEB: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
verses.ASV: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as sete espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas espessas e cheias. E despertou Faraó, e eis que era sonho.
verses.RVR09: Y las siete espigas menudas devoraban á las siete espigas gruesas y llenas. Y despertó Faraón, y he aquí que era sueño.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que à manhã estava movido seu espírito; e enviou e fez chamar a todos os magos do Egito, e a todos os seus sábios: e contou-lhes Faraó seus sonhos, mas não havia quem a Faraó os interpretasse.
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció que á la mañana estaba agitado su espíritu; y envió é hizo llamar á todos los magos de Egipto, y á todos sus sabios: y contóles Faraón sus sueños, mas no había quien á Faraón los declarase.

verses.KJV: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
verses.WEB: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.
verses.ASV: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o chefe dos copeiros falou a Faraó, dizendo: Lembro-me hoje de minhas faltas:
verses.RVR09: Entonces el principal de los coperos habló á Faraón, diciendo: Acuérdome hoy de mis faltas:

verses.KJV: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:
verses.WEB: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.
verses.ASV: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, me and the chief baker:

verses.RVR09: Faraón se enojó contra sus siervos, y á mí me echó á la prisión de la casa del capitán de los de la guardia, á mí y al principal de los panaderos:

verses.KJV: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.WEB: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.ASV: and we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu e ele vimos um sonho uma mesma noite: cada um sonhou conforme a interpretação de seu sonho.
verses.RVR09: Y yo y él vimos un sueño una misma noche: cada uno soñó conforme á la declaración de su sueño.

verses.KJV: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
verses.WEB: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.
verses.ASV: And there was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava ali conosco um jovem hebreu, servente do capitão dos da guarda; e o contamos a ele, e ele nos interpretou nossos sonhos, e interpretou a cada um conforme seu sonho.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba allí con nosotros un mozo Hebreo, sirviente del capitán de los de la guardia; y se lo contamos, y él nos declaró nuestros sueños, y declaró á cada uno conforme á su sueño.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
verses.WEB: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que como él nos declaró, así fué: á mí me hizo volver á mi puesto, é hizo colgar al otro.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that when thou hearest a dream thou canst interpret it.

verses.RVR09: Y dijo Faraón á José: Yo he tenido un sueño, y no hay quien lo declare; mas he oído decir de ti, que oyes sueños para declararlos.

verses.KJV: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
verses.WEB: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu José a Faraó, dizendo: Não está em mim; Deus será o que responda paz a Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió José á Faraón, diciendo: No está en mí; Dios será el que responda paz á Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
verses.WEB: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the brink of the river:

verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón dijo á José: En mi sueño parecíame que estaba á la orilla del río:

verses.KJV: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
verses.WEB: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;
verses.ASV: and, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fat-fleshed and well-favored: and they fed in the reed-grass:
verses.ALMEIDA: E que do rio subiam sete vacas de gordas carnes e bela aparência, que pastavam entre os juncos:
verses.RVR09: Y que del río subían siete vacas de gruesas carnes y hermosa apariencia, que pacían en el prado:

verses.KJV: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
verses.WEB: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.
verses.ASV: and, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill-favored and lean-fleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
verses.ALMEIDA: E que outras sete vacas subiam depois delas, magras e de muito feio aspecto; tão abatidas, que não vi outras semelhantes em toda a terra do Egito em feiura:
verses.RVR09: Y que otras siete vacas subían después de ellas, flacas y de muy fea traza; tan extenuadas, que no he visto otras semejantes en toda la tierra de Egipto en fealdad:

verses.KJV: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
verses.WEB: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;
verses.ASV: and the lean and ill-favored kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
verses.ALMEIDA: E as vacas magras e feias devoravam as sete primeiras vacas gordas:
verses.RVR09: Y las vacas flacas y feas devoraban á las siete primeras vacas gruesas:

verses.KJV: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.WEB: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.ASV: and when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill-favored, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entravam em suas entranhas, mas não se conhecia que houvesse entrado nelas, porque sua aparência era ainda má, como de antes. E eu despertei.
verses.RVR09: Y entraban en sus entrañas, mas no se conocía que hubiesen entrado en ellas, porque su parecer era aún malo, como de primero. Y yo desperté.

verses.KJV: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
verses.WEB: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;
verses.ASV: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up upon one stalk, full and good:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi também sonhando, que sete espigas subiam em uma mesma haste, cheias e belas;
verses.RVR09: Vi también soñando, que siete espigas subían en una misma caña llenas y hermosas;

verses.KJV: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
verses.WEB: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
verses.ASV: and, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, [and] blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E que outras sete espigas miúdas, definhadas, abatidas do vento oriental, subiam depois delas:
verses.RVR09: Y que otras siete espigas menudas, marchitas, abatidas del Solano, subían después de ellas:

verses.KJV: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
verses.WEB: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”
verses.ASV: and the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears: and I told it unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas belas: e disse-o aos magos, mas não há quem o interprete a mim.
verses.RVR09: Y las espigas menudas devoraban á las siete espigas hermosas: y helo dicho á los magos, mas no hay quien me lo declare.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.WEB: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: what God is about to do he hath declared unto Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então respondeu José a Faraó: O sonho de Faraó é um mesmo: Deus mostrou a Faraó o que vai fazer.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió José á Faraón: El sueño de Faraón es uno mismo: Dios ha mostrado á Faraón lo que va á hacer.

verses.KJV: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
verses.WEB: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.
verses.ASV: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
verses.ALMEIDA: As sete vacas belas são sete anos, e as espigas belas são sete anos; o sonho é um mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Las siete vacas hermosas siete años son; y las espigas hermosas son siete años: el sueño es uno mismo.

verses.KJV: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
verses.WEB: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.
verses.ASV: And the seven lean and ill-favored kine that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind; they shall be seven years of famine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também as sete vacas magras e feias que subiam atrás elas, são sete anos; e as sete espigas miúdas e definhadas do vento oriental serão sete anos de fome.
verses.RVR09: También las siete vacas flacas y feas que subían tras ellas, son siete años; y las siete espigas menudas y marchitas del Solano, siete años serán de hambre.

verses.KJV: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.ASV: That is the thing which I spake unto Pharaoh: what God is about to do he hath showed unto Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto é o que respondo a Faraó. O que Deus vai fazer, mostrou-o a Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Esto es lo que respondo á Faraón. Lo que Dios va á hacer, halo mostrado á Faraón.

verses.KJV: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
verses.WEB: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.
verses.ASV: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vêm sete anos de grande fartura toda a terra do Egito:
verses.RVR09: He aquí vienen siete años de grande hartura en toda la tierra de Egipto:

verses.KJV: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.WEB: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
verses.ASV: and there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se levantarão depois eles sete anos de fome; e toda a fartura será esquecida na terra do Egito; e a fome consumirá a terra;
verses.RVR09: Y levantarse han tras ellos siete años de hambre; y toda la hartura será olvidada en la tierra de Egipto; y el hambre consumirá la tierra;

verses.KJV: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
verses.WEB: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.
verses.ASV: and the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine which followeth; for it shall be very grievous.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquela abundância não mais será vista por causa da fome seguinte, a qual será gravíssima.
verses.RVR09: Y aquella abundancia no se echará de ver á causa del hambre siguiente, la cual será gravísima.

verses.KJV: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.WEB: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.ASV: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh, it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o suceder o sonho a Faraó duas vezes, significa que a coisa é firme da parte de Deus, e que Deus se apressa a fazê-la.
verses.RVR09: Y el suceder el sueño á Faraón dos veces, significa que la cosa es firme de parte de Dios, y que Dios se apresura á hacerla.

verses.KJV: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, providencie Faraó agora um homem prudente e sábio, e ponha-o sobre a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, provéase ahora Faraón de un varón prudente y sabio, y póngalo sobre la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
verses.WEB: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.
verses.ASV: Let Pharaoh do [this], and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faça isto Faraó, e ponha governadores sobre esta terra, e tome a quinta parte da terra do Egito nos sete anos da fartura;
verses.RVR09: Haga esto Faraón, y ponga gobernadores sobre el país, y quinte la tierra de Egipto en los siete años de la hartura;

verses.KJV: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
verses.WEB: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
verses.ASV: And let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntem toda a provisão destes bons anos que vêm, e acumulem o trigo sob a mão de Faraó para mantimento das cidades; e guardem-no.
verses.RVR09: Y junten toda la provisión de estos buenos años que vienen, y alleguen el trigo bajo la mano de Faraón para mantenimiento de las ciudades; y guárdenlo.

verses.KJV: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
verses.WEB: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”
verses.ASV: And the food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esteja aquela provisão em depósito para esta terra, para os sete anos de fome que serão na terra do Egito; e esta terra não perecerá de fome.
verses.RVR09: Y esté aquella provisión en depósito para el país, para los siete años del hambre que serán en la tierra de Egipto; y el país no perecerá de hambre.

verses.KJV: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.WEB: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.ASV: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o negócio pareceu bem a Faraó, e a seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y el negocio pareció bien á Faraón, y á sus siervos.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”
