verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom the spirit of God is?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Faraó a seus servos: Acharemos outro homem como este, em quem haja espírito de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Faraón á sus siervos: ¿Hemos de hallar otro hombre como éste, en quien haya espíritu de Dios?

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath showed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Faraó a José: Pois que Deus te fez saber tudo isto, não há entendido nem sábio como tu:
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Faraón á José: Pues que Dios te ha hecho saber todo esto, no hay entendido ni sabio como tú:

verses.KJV: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
verses.WEB: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”
verses.ASV: thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu serás sobre minha casa, e pelo que disseres se governará todo o meu povo; somente no trono serei eu maior que tu.
verses.RVR09: Tú serás sobre mi casa, y por tu dicho se gobernará todo mi pueblo: solamente en el trono seré yo mayor que tú.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais Faraó a José: Eis que te pus sobre toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Dijo más Faraón á José: He aquí yo te he puesto sobre toda la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verses.WEB: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó tirou seu anel de sua mão, e o pôs na mão de José, e fez-lhe vestir de roupas de linho finíssimo, e pôs um colar de ouro em seu pescoço;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón quitó su anillo de su mano, y púsolo en la mano de José, é hízole vestir de ropas de lino finísimo, y puso un collar de oro en su cuello;

verses.KJV: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he set him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o fez subir em seu segundo carro, e proclamaram diante dele: Dobrai os joelhos; e pôs-lhe sobre toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: E hízolo subir en su segundo carro, y pregonaron delante de él: Doblad la rodilla: y púsole sobre toda la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Faraó a José: Eu sou Faraó; e sem ti ninguém levantará sua mão nem seu pé toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Faraón á José: Yo Faraón; y sin ti ninguno alzará su mano ni su pie en toda la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-paneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Faraó o nome de José, Zefenate-Paneia; e deu-lhe por mulher a Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om. E saiu José por toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Faraón el nombre de José, Zaphnath-paaneah; y dióle por mujer á Asenath, hija de Potipherah, sacerdote de On. Y salió José por toda la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era José de idade de trinta anos quando foi apresentado diante de Faraó, rei do Egito: e saiu José de diante de Faraó, e transitou por toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y era José de edad de treinta años cuando fué presentado delante de Faraón, rey de Egipto: y salió José de delante de Faraón, y transitó por toda la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
verses.WEB: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
verses.ASV: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez a terra naqueles sete anos de fartura a amontoados.
verses.RVR09: E hizo la tierra en aquellos siete años de hartura á montones.

verses.KJV: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.WEB: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.
verses.ASV: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele juntou todo o mantimento dos sete anos que foram na terra do Egito, e guardou mantimento nas cidades, pondo em cada cidade o mantimento do campo de seus arredores.
verses.RVR09: Y él juntó todo el mantenimiento de los siete años que fueron en la tierra de Egipto, y guardó mantenimiento en las ciudades, poniendo en cada ciudad el mantenimiento del campo de sus alrededores.

verses.KJV: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
verses.WEB: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.
verses.ASV: And Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left off numbering; for it was without number.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ajuntou José trigo como areia do mar, muito em extremo, até não se poder contar, porque não tinha número.
verses.RVR09: Y acopió José trigo como arena de la mar, mucho en extremo, hasta no poderse contar, porque no tenía número.

verses.KJV: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.WEB: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.
verses.ASV: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On, bare unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nasceram a José dois filhos antes que viesse o primeiro ano da fome, os quais lhe deu à luz Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om.
verses.RVR09: Y nacieron á José dos hijos antes que viniese el primer año del hambre, los cuales le parió Asenath, hija de Potipherah, sacerdote de On.

verses.KJV: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
verses.WEB: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph called the name of the first-born Manasseh: For, [said he], God hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou José o nome do primogênito Manassés; porque disse: Deus me fez esquecer todo o meu sofrimento, e toda a casa de meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó José el nombre del primogénito Manasés; porque Dios (dijo) me hizo olvidar todo mi trabajo, y toda la casa de mi padre.

verses.KJV: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
verses.WEB: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
verses.ASV: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nome do segundo chamou-o Efraim; porque disse: “Deus me fez frutífero na terra de minha aflição”.
verses.RVR09: Y el nombre del segundo llamólo Ephraim; porque Dios (dijo) me hizo fértil en la tierra de mi aflicción.

verses.KJV: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
verses.WEB: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
verses.ASV: And the seven years of plenty, that was in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cumpriram-se os sete anos da fartura, que houve na terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y cumpliéronse los siete años de la hartura, que hubo en la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.WEB: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.ASV: And the seven years of famine began to come, according as Joseph had said: and there was famine in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E começaram a vir os sete anos de fome, como José havia dito; e houve fome em todos os países, mas em toda a terra do Egito havia pão.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzaron á venir los siete años del hambre, como José había dicho: y hubo hambre en todos los países, mas en toda la tierra de Egipto había pan.

verses.KJV: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
verses.WEB: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”
verses.ASV: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se sentiu a fome toda a terra do Egito, o povo clamou a Faraó por pão. E disse Faraó a todos os egípcios: Ide a José, e fazei o que ele vos disser.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando se sintió el hambre en toda la tierra de Egipto, el pueblo clamó á Faraón por pan. Y dijo Faraón á todos los Egipcios: Id á José, y haced lo que él os dijere.

verses.KJV: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the store-houses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine was sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a fome estava por toda a extensão daquela terra. Então abriu José todo depósito de grãos onde havia, e vendia aos egípcios; porque havia crescido a fome na terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y el hambre estaba por toda la extensión del país. Entonces abrió José todo granero donde había, y vendía á los Egipcios; porque había crecido el hambre en la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
verses.WEB: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
verses.ASV: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph to buy grain, because the famine was sore in all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a terra vinha ao Egito para comprar de José, porque por toda a terra havia aumentado a fome.
verses.RVR09: Y toda la tierra venía á Egipto para comprar de José, porque por toda la tierra había crecido el hambre.

verses.KJV: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
verses.WEB: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”
verses.ASV: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Jacó que no Egito havia alimentos, disse a seus filhos: Por que estais olhando uns para os outros?
verses.RVR09: Y VIENDO Jacob que en Egipto había alimentos, dijo á sus hijos: ¿Por qué os estáis mirando?

verses.KJV: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
verses.WEB: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Eis que, eu ouvi que há alimentos no Egito; descei ali, e comprai dali para nós, para que possamos viver, e não nos morramos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: He aquí, yo he oído que hay víveres en Egipto; descended allá, y comprad de allí para nosotros, para que podamos vivir, y no nos muramos.

verses.KJV: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
verses.WEB: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy grain from Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desceram os dez irmãos de José a comprar trigo ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y descendieron los diez hermanos de José á comprar trigo á Egipto.

verses.KJV: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
verses.WEB: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”
verses.ASV: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure harm befall him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jacó não enviou a Benjamim irmão de José com seus irmãos; porque disse: Não seja acaso que lhe aconteça algum desastre.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jacob no envió á Benjamín hermano de José con sus hermanos; porque dijo: No sea acaso que le acontezca algún desastre.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Israel came to buy among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram os filhos de Israel a comprar entre os que vinham: porque havia fome na terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron los hijos de Israel á comprar entre los que venían: porque había hambre en la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
verses.WEB: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.
verses.ASV: And Joseph was the governor over the land; he it was that sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves to him with their faces to the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José era o senhor da terra, que vendia a todo o povo da terra: e chegaram os irmãos de José, e inclinaram-se a ele rosto por terra.
verses.RVR09: Y José era el señor de la tierra, que vendía á todo el pueblo de la tierra: y llegaron los hermanos de José, é inclináronse á él rostro por tierra.

verses.KJV: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
verses.WEB: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly with them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José quando viu seus irmãos, reconheceu-os; mas fez que não os conhecesse, e falou-lhes asperamente, e lhes disse: De onde viestes? Eles responderam: Da terra de Canaã, para comprar alimentos.
verses.RVR09: Y José como vió á sus hermanos, conociólos; mas hizo que no los conocía, y hablóles ásperamente, y les dijo: ¿De dónde habéis venido? Ellos respondieron: De la tierra de Canaán á comprar alimentos.

verses.KJV: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
verses.WEB: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.
verses.ASV: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
verses.ALMEIDA: José, pois, reconheceu a seus irmãos; mas eles não o reconheceram.
verses.RVR09: José, pues, conoció á sus hermanos; pero ellos no le conocieron.

verses.KJV: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.WEB: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se lembrou José dos sonhos que havia tido deles, e disse-lhes: Sois espias; viestes ver a fraqueza desta terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se acordó José de los sueños que había tenido de ellos, y díjoles: Espías sois; por ver lo descubierto del país habéis venido.

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
verses.WEB: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe responderam: Não, meu senhor; teus servos vieram comprar alimentos.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le respondieron: No, señor mío: mas tus siervos han venido á comprar alimentos.

verses.KJV: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
verses.WEB: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”
verses.ASV: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos nós somos filhos de um homem; somos homens honestos; teus servos nunca foram espias.
verses.RVR09: Todos nosotros somos hijos de un varón: somos hombres de verdad: tus siervos nunca fueron espías.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Não; viestes ver a fraqueza desta terra.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: No; á ver lo descubierto del país habéis venido.

verses.KJV: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
verses.WEB: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”
verses.ASV: And they said, We thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: Teus servos somos doze irmãos, filhos de um homem na terra de Canaã; e eis que o menor está hoje com nosso pai, e outro desapareceu.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: Tus siervos somos doce hermanos, hijos de un varón en la tierra de Canaán; y he aquí el menor está hoy con nuestro padre, y otro no parece.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:
verses.WEB: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:
verses.ALMEIDA: E José lhes disse: Isso é o que vos disse, afirmando que sois espias;
verses.RVR09: Y José les dijo: Eso es lo que os he dicho, afirmando que sois espías:

verses.KJV: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
verses.WEB: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.
verses.ASV: hereby ye shall be proved: by the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisto sereis provados: Vive Faraó que não saireis daqui, a não ser quando vosso irmão menor vier aqui.
verses.RVR09: En esto seréis probados: Vive Faraón que no saldréis de aquí, sino cuando vuestro hermano menor aquí viniere.

verses.KJV: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
verses.WEB: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”
verses.ASV: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be bound, that your words may be proved, whether there be truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviai um de vós, e traga a vosso irmão; e vós ficai presos, e vossas palavras serão provadas, se há verdade convosco: e se não, vive Faraó, que sois espias.
verses.RVR09: Enviad uno de vosotros, y traiga á vuestro hermano; y vosotros quedad presos, y vuestras palabras serán probadas, si hay verdad con vosotros: y si no, vive Faraón, que sois espías.

verses.KJV: And he put them all together into ward three days.
verses.WEB: He put them all together into custody for three days.
verses.ASV: And he put them all together into ward three days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntou-os no cárcere por três dias.
verses.RVR09: Y juntólos en la cárcel por tres días.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:
verses.WEB: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao terceiro dia disse-lhes José: Fazei isto, e vivei; eu temo a Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y al tercer día díjoles José: Haced esto, y vivid: Yo temo á Dios:

verses.KJV: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
verses.WEB: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.
verses.ASV: if ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in your prison-house; but go ye, carry grain for the famine of your houses:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se sois homens honestos, fique preso na casa de vosso cárcere um de vossos irmãos; e vós ide, levai o alimento para a fome de vossa casa;
verses.RVR09: Si sois hombres de verdad, quede preso en la casa de vuestra cárcel uno de vuestros hermanos; y vosotros id, llevad el alimento para el hambre de vuestra casa:

verses.KJV: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
verses.WEB: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.
verses.ASV: and bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém haveis de trazer-me a vosso irmão mais novo, e serão comprovadas vossas palavras, e não morrereis. E eles o fizeram assim.
verses.RVR09: Pero habéis de traerme á vuestro hermano menor, y serán verificadas vuestras palabras, y no moriréis. Y ellos lo hicieron así.

verses.KJV: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
verses.WEB: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”
verses.ASV: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E diziam um ao outro: Verdadeiramente pecamos contra nosso irmão, que vimos a angústia de sua alma quando nos rogava, e não o ouvimos; por isso veio sobre nós esta angústia.
verses.RVR09: Y decían el uno al otro: Verdaderamente hemos pecado contra nuestro hermano, que vimos la angustia de su alma cuando nos rogaba, y no le oímos: por eso ha venido sobre nosotros esta angustia.

verses.KJV: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
verses.WEB: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”
verses.ASV: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore also, behold, his blood is required.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Rúben lhes respondeu, dizendo: Não vos falei eu e disse: Não pequeis contra o jovem; e não escutastes? Eis que também o sangue dele é requerido.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Rubén les respondió, diciendo: ¿No os hablé yo y dije: No pequéis contra el mozo; y no escuchasteis? He aquí también su sangre es requerida.

verses.KJV: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
verses.WEB: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
verses.ASV: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles não sabiam que os entendia José, porque havia intérprete entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos no sabían que los entendía José, porque había intérprete entre ellos.

verses.KJV: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
verses.WEB: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
verses.ASV: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and he returned to them, and spake to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apartou-se ele deles, e chorou: depois voltou a eles, e lhes falou, e tomou dentre eles a Simeão, e aprisionou-lhe à vista deles.
verses.RVR09: Y apartóse él de ellos, y lloró: después volvió á ellos, y les habló, y tomó de entre ellos á Simeón, y aprisionóle á vista de ellos.

verses.KJV: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
verses.WEB: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.
verses.ASV: Then Joseph commanded to fill their vessels with grain, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus was it done unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou José que enchessem seus sacos de trigo, e devolvessem o dinheiro de cada um deles, pondo-o em seu saco, e lhes dessem comida para o caminho; e fez-se assim com eles.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó José que llenaran sus sacos de trigo, y devolviesen el dinero de cada uno de ellos, poniéndolo en su saco, y les diesen comida para el camino: é hízose así con ellos.

verses.KJV: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
verses.WEB: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.
verses.ASV: And they laded their asses with their grain, and departed thence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles puseram seu trigo sobre seus asnos, e foram-se dali.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos pusieron su trigo sobre sus asnos, y fuéronse de allí.

verses.KJV: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.
verses.WEB: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.
verses.ASV: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the lodging-place, he espied his money; and, behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abrindo um deles seu saco para dar de comer a seu asno no lugar de parada, viu seu dinheiro que estava na boca de seu saco.
verses.RVR09: Y abriendo uno de ellos su saco para dar de comer á su asno en el mesón, vió su dinero que estaba en la boca de su costal.

verses.KJV: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?
verses.WEB: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they turned trembling one to another, saying, What is this that God hath done unto us?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a seus irmãos: Meu dinheiro se me foi devolvido, e ainda ei-lo aqui em meu saco. Alarmou-se, então, o coração deles e, espantados, disseram um ao outro: Que é isto que Deus nos fez?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á sus hermanos: Mi dinero se me ha devuelto, y aun helo aquí en mi saco. Sobresaltóseles entonces el corazón, y espantados dijeron el uno al otro: ¿Qué es esto que nos ha hecho Dios?

verses.KJV: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
verses.WEB: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,
verses.ASV: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that had befallen them, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindos a Jacó seu pai em terra de Canaã, contaram-lhe tudo o que lhes havia acontecido, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y venidos á Jacob su padre en tierra de Canaán, contáronle todo lo que les había acaecido, diciendo:

verses.KJV: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.WEB: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.ASV: The man, the lord of the land, spake roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele homem, senhor da terra, nos falou asperamente, e nos tratou como espias da terra:
verses.RVR09: Aquel varón, señor de la tierra, nos habló ásperamente, y nos trató como á espías de la tierra:

verses.KJV: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
verses.WEB: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.
verses.ASV: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós lhe dissemos: Somos homens honestos, nunca fomos espias:
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros le dijimos: Somos hombres de verdad, nunca fuimos espías:

verses.KJV: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’
verses.ASV: we are twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Somos doze irmãos, filhos de nosso pai; um desapareceu, e o menor está hoje com nosso pai na terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Somos doce hermanos, hijos de nuestro padre; uno no parece, y el menor está hoy con nuestro padre en la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
verses.WEB: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.
verses.ASV: And the man, the lord of the land, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men: leave one of your brethren with me, and take [grain for] the famine of your houses, and go your way;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele homem, senhor da terra, nos disse: Nisto conhecerei que sois homens honestos; deixai comigo um de vossos irmãos, e tomai para a fome de vossas casas, e ide,
verses.RVR09: Y aquel varón, señor de la tierra, nos dijo: En esto conoceré que sois hombres de verdad; dejad conmigo uno de vuestros hermanos, y tomad para el hambre de vuestras casas, y andad,

verses.KJV: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
verses.WEB: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”
verses.ASV: and bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffic in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trazei-me a vosso irmão o mais novo, para que eu saiba que não sois espias, mas sim homens honestos: assim vos darei a vosso irmão, e negociareis na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y traedme á vuestro hermano el menor, para que yo sepa que no sois espías, sino hombres de verdad: así os daré á vuestro hermano, y negociaréis en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.WEB: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack: and when they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que esvaziando eles seus sacos, eis que no saco de cada um estava o pacote de seu dinheiro: e vendo eles e seu pai os pacotes de seu dinheiro, tiveram temor.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que vaciando ellos sus sacos, he aquí que en el saco de cada uno estaba el atado de su dinero: y viendo ellos y su padre los atados de su dinero, tuvieron temor.

verses.KJV: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
verses.WEB: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então seu pai Jacó lhes disse: Vós me privastes de meus filhos; José desapareceu, nem Simeão tampouco, e a Benjamim o levareis; contra mim são todas estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces su padre Jacob les dijo: Habéisme privado de mis hijos; José no parece, ni Simeón tampoco, y á Benjamín le llevaréis: contra mí son todas estas cosas.

verses.KJV: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.
verses.WEB: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”
verses.ASV: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Rúben falou a seu pai, dizendo: Podes matar meus dois filhos, se eu não o devolver a ti; entrega-o em minha mão, que eu o devolverei a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y Rubén habló á su padre, diciendo: Harás morir á mis dos hijos, si no te lo volviere; entrégalo en mi mano, que yo lo volveré á ti.

verses.KJV: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.WEB: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”
verses.ASV: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left: if harm befall him by the way in which ye go, then will ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Não descerá meu filho convosco; que seu irmão é morto, e ele somente restou; e se lhe acontecer algum desastre no caminho por onde vades, fareis descer meus cabelos brancos com tristeza ao Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: No descenderá mi hijo con vosotros; que su hermano es muerto, y él solo ha quedado: y si le aconteciere algún desastre en el camino por donde vais, haréis descender mis canas con dolor á la sepultura.

verses.KJV: And the famine was sore in the land.
verses.WEB: The famine was severe in the land.
verses.ASV: And the famine was sore in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a fome era grande na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y EL hambre era grande en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.WEB: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando acabaram de comer o trigo que trouxeram do Egito, disse-lhes seu pai: Voltai, e comprai para nós um pouco de alimento.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que como acabaron de comer el trigo que trajeron de Egipto, díjoles su padre: Volved, y comprad para nosotros un poco de alimento.

verses.KJV: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.WEB: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’
verses.ASV: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Judá, dizendo: Aquele homem nos advertiu com ânimo decidido, dizendo: Não vereis meu rosto sem vosso irmão convosco.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Judá, diciendo: Aquel varón nos protestó con ánimo resuelto, diciendo: No veréis mi rostro sin vuestro hermano con vosotros.

verses.KJV: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
verses.WEB: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;
verses.ASV: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se enviares a nosso irmão conosco, desceremos e te compraremos alimento:
verses.RVR09: Si enviares á nuestro hermano con nosotros, descenderemos y te compraremos alimento:

verses.KJV: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.WEB: but if you don’t send him, we won’t go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”
verses.ASV: but if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down; for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se não lhe enviares, não desceremos: porque aquele homem nos disse: Não vereis meu rosto sem vosso irmão convosco.
verses.RVR09: Pero si no le enviares, no descenderemos: porque aquel varón nos dijo: No veréis mi rostro sin vuestro hermano con vosotros.

verses.KJV: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
verses.WEB: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”
verses.ASV: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Israel: Por que me fizestes tanto mal, declarando ao homem que tínheis mais irmão?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Israel: ¿Por qué me hicisteis tanto mal, declarando al varón que teníais más hermano?

verses.KJV: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
verses.WEB: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?”
verses.ASV: And they said, The man asked straitly concerning ourselves, and concerning our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye [another] brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we in any wise know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: Aquele homem nos perguntou expressamente por nós, e por nossa parentela, dizendo: Vive ainda vosso pai? Tendes outro irmão? E lhe declaramos conforme estas palavras. Podíamos nós saber que havia de dizer: Fazei vir a vosso irmão?
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: Aquel varón nos preguntó expresamente por nosotros, y por nuestra parentela, diciendo: ¿Vive aún vuestro padre? ¿tenéis otro hermano? y declarámosle conforme á estas palabras. ¿Podíamos nosotros saber que había de decir: Haced venir á vuestro hermano?

verses.KJV: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.
verses.WEB: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.
verses.ASV: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Judá disse a Israel seu pai: Envia ao jovem comigo, e nos levantaremos e iremos, a fim que vivamos e não morramos nós, e tu, e nossos filhos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Judá dijo á Israel su padre: Envía al mozo conmigo, y nos levantaremos é iremos, á fin que vivamos y no muramos nosotros, y tú, y nuestros niños.

verses.KJV: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
verses.WEB: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;
verses.ASV: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou fiador dele; a mim me pedirás conta dele; se eu não o devolver a ti e o puser diante de ti, serei para ti o culpado todos os dias:
verses.RVR09: Yo lo fío; á mí me pedirás cuenta de él: si yo no te lo volviere y lo pusiere delante de ti, seré para ti el culpante todos los días:

verses.KJV: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
verses.WEB: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”
verses.ASV: for except we had lingered, surely we had now returned a second time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que se não nos tivéssemos detido, certo agora teríamos já voltado duas vezes.
verses.RVR09: Que si no nos hubiéramos detenido, cierto ahora hubiéramos ya vuelto dos veces.

verses.KJV: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
verses.WEB: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;
verses.ASV: And their father Israel said unto them, If it be so now, do this: take of the choice fruits of the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spicery and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Israel seu pai lhes respondeu: Pois que assim é, fazei-o; tomai do melhor da terra em vossos vasos, e levai àquele homem um presente, um pouco de bálsamo, e um pouco de mel, aromas e mirra, nozes e amêndoas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Israel su padre les respondió: Pues que así es, hacedlo; tomad de lo mejor de la tierra en vuestros vasos, y llevad á aquel varón un presente, un poco de bálsamo, y un poco de miel, aromas y mirra, nueces y almendras.

verses.KJV: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
verses.WEB: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.
verses.ASV: and take double money in your hand; and the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks carry again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomai em vossas mãos dobrado dinheiro, e levai em vossa mão o dinheiro que voltou nas bocas de vossos sacos; talvez tenha sido erro.
verses.RVR09: Y tomad en vuestras manos doblado dinero, y llevad en vuestra mano el dinero vuelto en las bocas de vuestros costales; quizá fué yerro.

verses.KJV: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
verses.WEB: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.
verses.ASV: take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomai também a vosso irmão, e levantai-vos, e voltai àquele homem.
verses.RVR09: Tomad también á vuestro hermano, y levantaos, y volved á aquel varón.

verses.KJV: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
verses.WEB: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”
verses.ASV: and God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release unto you your other brother and Benjamin. And if I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Deus Todo-Poderoso vos dê misericórdias diante daquele homem, e vos solte ao outro vosso irmão, e a este Benjamim. E se eu tiver de ser privado de meus filhos, assim seja.
verses.RVR09: Y el Dios Omnipotente os dé misericordias delante de aquel varón, y os suelte al otro vuestro hermano, y á este Benjamín. Y si he de ser privado de mis hijos, séalo.

verses.KJV: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.WEB: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.ASV: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomaram aqueles homens o presente, e tomaram em sua mão dobrado dinheiro, e a Benjamim; e se levantaram, e desceram ao Egito, e apresentaram-se diante de José.
verses.RVR09: Entonces tomaron aquellos varones el presente, y tomaron en su mano doblado dinero, y á Benjamín; y se levantaron, y descendieron á Egipto, y presentáronse delante de José.

verses.KJV: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
verses.WEB: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”
verses.ASV: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, Bring the men into the house, and slay, and make ready; for the men shall dine with me at noon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu José a Benjamim com eles, e disse ao mordomo de sua casa: Mete em casa a esses homens, e degola um animal, e prepara-o; porque estes homens comerão comigo ao meio-dia.
verses.RVR09: Y vió José á Benjamín con ellos, y dijo al mayordomo de su casa: Mete en casa á esos hombres, y degüella víctima, y aderézala; porque estos hombres comerán conmigo al medio día.

verses.KJV: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.
verses.WEB: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.
verses.ASV: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o homem como José disse; e meteu aquele homem aos homens em casa de José.
verses.RVR09: E hizo el hombre como José dijo; y metió aquel hombre á los hombres en casa de José.

verses.KJV: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
verses.WEB: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”
verses.ASV: And the men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aqueles homens tiveram temor, quando foram metidos na casa de José, e diziam: Pelo dinheiro que voltou em nossos sacos a primeira vez nos trouxeram aqui, para virem contra nós, e nos atacar, e tomar por servos a nós, e a nossos asnos.
verses.RVR09: Y aquellos hombres tuvieron temor, cuando fueron metidos en casa de José, y decían: Por el dinero que fué vuelto en nuestros costales la primera vez nos han metido aquí, para revolver contra nosotros, y dar sobre nosotros, y tomarnos por siervos á nosotros, y á nuestros asnos.

verses.KJV: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
verses.WEB: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,
verses.ASV: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spake unto him at the door of the house,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aproximaram-se do mordomo da casa de José, e lhe falaram à entrada da casa.
verses.RVR09: Y llegáronse al mayordomo de la casa de José, y le hablaron á la entrada de la casa.

verses.KJV: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
verses.WEB: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.
verses.ASV: and said, Oh, my lord, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram: Ai, senhor meu, nós em realidade de verdade descemos ao princípio a comprar alimentos:
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron: Ay, señor mío, nosotros en realidad de verdad descendimos al principio á comprar alimentos:

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
verses.WEB: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.
verses.ASV: and it came to pass, when we came to the lodging-place, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando viemos ao lugar de parada e abrimos nossos sacos, eis que o dinheiro de cada um estava na boca de seu saco, nosso dinheiro em seu justo peso; e o devolvemos em nossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que como vinimos al mesón y abrimos nuestros costales, he aquí el dinero de cada uno estaba en la boca de su costal, nuestro dinero en su justo peso; y hémoslo vuelto en nuestras manos.

verses.KJV: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
verses.WEB: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”
verses.ASV: And other money have we brought down in our hand to buy food: we know not who put our money in our sacks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trouxemos também em nossas mãos outro dinheiro para comprar alimentos: nós não sabemos quem pôs nosso dinheiro em nossos sacos.
verses.RVR09: Hemos también traído en nuestras manos otro dinero para comprar alimentos: nosotros no sabemos quién haya puesto nuestro dinero en nuestros costales.

verses.KJV: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
verses.WEB: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.
verses.ASV: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Paz a vós, não temais; vosso Deus e o Deus de vosso pai vos deu o tesouro em vossos sacos: vosso dinheiro veio a mim. E tirou a Simeão a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Paz á vosotros, no temáis; vuestro Dios y el Dios de vuestro padre os dió el tesoro en vuestros costales: vuestro dinero vino á mí. Y sacó á Simeón á ellos.

verses.KJV: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
verses.WEB: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.
verses.ASV: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele homem levou àqueles homens na casa de José: e deu-lhes água, e lavaram seus pés: e deu de comer a seus asnos.
verses.RVR09: Y metió aquel varón á aquellos hombres en casa de José: y dióles agua, y lavaron sus pies: y dió de comer á sus asnos.

verses.KJV: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
verses.WEB: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.
verses.ASV: And they made ready the present against Joseph’s coming at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles prepararam o presente antes que viesse José ao meio-dia, porque haviam ouvido que ali haviam de comer pão.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos prepararon el presente entretanto que venía José al medio día, porque habían oído que allí habían de comer pan.

verses.KJV: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
verses.WEB: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.
verses.ASV: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed down themselves to him to the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio José a casa, e eles lhe trouxeram o presente que tinham em sua mão dentro de casa, e inclinaram-se a ele em terra.
verses.RVR09: Y vino José á casa, y ellos le trajeron el presente que tenían en su mano dentro de casa, é inclináronse á él hasta tierra.

verses.KJV: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
verses.WEB: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”
verses.ASV: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lhes perguntou como estavam, e disse: Vosso pai, o ancião que dissestes, passa bem? Vive ainda?
verses.RVR09: Entonces les preguntó él cómo estaban, y dijo: ¿Vuestro padre, el anciano que dijisteis, lo pasa bien? ¿vive todavía?

verses.KJV: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
verses.WEB: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.
verses.ASV: And they said, Thy servant our father is well, he is yet alive. And they bowed the head, and made obeisance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: Bem vai a teu servo nosso pai; ainda vive. E se inclinaram, e fizeram reverência.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: Bien va á tu siervo nuestro padre; aun vive. Y se inclinaron, é hicieron reverencia.

verses.KJV: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
verses.WEB: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”
verses.ASV: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin his brother, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your youngest brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando ele seus olhos viu Benjamim seu irmão, filho de sua mãe, e disse: É este vosso irmão mais novo, de quem me falastes? E disse: Deus tenha misericórdia de ti, filho meu.
verses.RVR09: Y alzando él sus ojos vió á Benjamín su hermano, hijo de su madre, y dijo: ¿Es éste vuestro hermano menor, de quien me hablasteis? Y dijo: Dios tenga misericordia de ti, hijo mío.

verses.KJV: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
verses.WEB: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.
verses.ASV: And Joseph made haste; for his heart yearned over his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então José se apressou, porque se comoveram suas entranhas por causa de seu irmão, e procurou onde chorar: e entrou-se em sua câmara, e chorou ali.
verses.RVR09: Entonces José se apresuró, porque se conmovieron sus entrañas á causa de su hermano, y procuró donde llorar: y entróse en su cámara, y lloró allí.

verses.KJV: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
verses.WEB: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”
verses.ASV: And he washed his face, and came out; and he refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lavou seu rosto, e saiu fora, e controlou-se, e disse: Ponde pão.
verses.RVR09: Y lavó su rostro, y salió fuera, y reprimióse, y dijo: Poned pan.

verses.KJV: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.
verses.ASV: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, that did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram para ele à parte, e separadamente para eles, e à parte para os egípcios que com ele comiam: porque os egípcios não podem comer pão com os hebreus, o qual é abominação aos egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron para él aparte, y separadamente para ellos, y aparte para los Egipcios que con él comían: porque los Egipcios no pueden comer pan con los Hebreos, lo cual es abominación á los Egipcios.

verses.KJV: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
verses.WEB: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.
verses.ASV: And they sat before him, the first-born according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one with another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sentaram-se diante dele, o mais velho conforme sua primogenitura, e o mais novo conforme sua idade menor; e estavam aqueles homens atônitos olhando-se um ao outro.
verses.RVR09: Y sentáronse delante de él, el mayor conforme á su mayoría, y el menor conforme á su menoría; y estaban aquellos hombres atónitos mirándose el uno al otro.

verses.KJV: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of their's. And they drank, and were merry with him.
verses.WEB: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.
verses.ASV: And he took [and sent] messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele tomou iguarias de diante de si para eles; mas a porção de Benjamim era cinco vezes como qualquer uma das deles. E beberam, e alegraram-se com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y él tomó viandas de delante de sí para ellos; mas la porción de Benjamín era cinco veces como cualquiera de las de ellos. Y bebieron, y alegráronse con él.

verses.KJV: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
verses.WEB: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
verses.ASV: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou José ao mordomo de sua casa, dizendo: Enche os sacos destes homens de alimentos, quanto puderem levar, e põe o dinheiro de cada um na boca de seu saco:
verses.RVR09: Y MANDÓ José al mayordomo de su casa, diciendo: Hinche los costales de aquestos varones de alimentos, cuanto pudieren llevar, y pon el dinero de cada uno en la boca de su costal:

verses.KJV: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.WEB: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.ASV: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his grain money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás meu copo, o copo de prata, na boca do saco do mais novo, com o dinheiro de seu trigo. E ele fez como disse José.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás mi copa, la copa de plata, en la boca del costal del menor, con el dinero de su trigo. Y él hizo como dijo José.

verses.KJV: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
verses.WEB: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.
verses.ASV: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinda a manhã, os homens foram despedidos com seus asnos.
verses.RVR09: Venida la mañana, los hombres fueron despedidos con sus asnos.

verses.KJV: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
verses.WEB: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?
verses.ASV: [And] when they were gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
verses.ALMEIDA: Havendo eles saído da cidade, da qual ainda não haviam se afastado, disse José a seu mordomo: Levanta-te, e segue a esses homens; e quando os alcançares, dize-lhes: Por que retribuístes com o mal pelo bem?
verses.RVR09: Habiendo ellos salido de la ciudad, de la que aun no se habían alejado, dijo José á su mayordomo: Levántate, y sigue á esos hombres; y cuando los alcanzares, diles: ¿Por qué habéis vuelto mal por bien?

verses.KJV: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
verses.WEB: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”
verses.ASV: Is not this that in which my lord drinketh, and whereby he indeed divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é isto no que bebe meu senhor, e pelo que costuma adivinhar? Fizestes mal no que fizestes.
verses.RVR09: ¿No es ésta en la que bebe mi señor, y por la que suele adivinar? habéis hecho mal en lo que hicisteis.

verses.KJV: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
verses.WEB: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.
verses.ASV: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these words.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele os alcançou, disse-lhes estas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y como él los alcanzó, díjoles estas palabras.

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
verses.WEB: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, Wherefore speaketh my lord such words as these? Far be it from thy servants that they should do such a thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe responderam: Por que diz meu senhor tais coisas? Nunca tal façam teus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le respondieron: ¿Por qué dice mi señor tales cosas? Nunca tal hagan tus siervos.

verses.KJV: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
verses.WEB: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?
verses.ASV: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que, o dinheiro que achamos na boca de nossos sacos, o voltamos a trazer a ti desde a terra de Canaã; como, pois, havíamos de furtar da casa de teu senhor prata nem ouro?
verses.RVR09: He aquí, el dinero que hallamos en la boca de nuestros costales, te lo volvimos á traer desde la tierra de Canaán; ¿cómo, pues, habíamos de hurtar de casa de tu señor plata ni oro?

verses.KJV: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
verses.WEB: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”
verses.ASV: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele de teus servos em quem for achado o copo, que morra, e ainda nós seremos servos de meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Aquel de tus siervos en quien fuere hallada la copa, que muera, y aun nosotros seremos siervos de mi señor.

verses.KJV: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
verses.WEB: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my bondman; and ye shall be blameless.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Também agora seja conforme vossas palavras; aquele em quem se achar, será meu servo, e vós sereis sem culpa.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: También ahora sea conforme á vuestras palabras; aquél en quien se hallare, será mi siervo, y vosotros seréis sin culpa.

verses.KJV: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
verses.WEB: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.
verses.ASV: Then they hasted, and took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles então se deram pressa, e derrubando cada um seu saco em terra, abriu cada qual o seu saco.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces se dieron prisa, y derribando cada uno su costal en tierra, abrió cada cual el costal suyo.

verses.KJV: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
verses.WEB: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
verses.ASV: And he searched, [and] began at the eldest, and left off at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
verses.ALMEIDA: E buscou; desde o mais velho começou, e acabou no mais novo; e o copo foi achado no saco de Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Y buscó; desde el mayor comenzó, y acabó en el menor; y la copa fué hallada en el costal de Benjamín.

verses.KJV: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
verses.WEB: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.
verses.ASV: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles rasgaram suas roupas, e carregou cada um seu asno, e voltaram à cidade.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos rasgaron sus vestidos, y cargó cada uno su asno, y volvieron á la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
verses.WEB: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.
verses.ASV: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; and he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegou Judá com seus irmãos à casa de José, que ainda estava ali, e prostraram-se diante dele em terra.
verses.RVR09: Y llegó Judá con sus hermanos á casa de José, que aun estaba allí, y postráronse delante de él en tierra.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
verses.WEB: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? know ye not that such a man as I can indeed divine?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes José: Que obra é esta que fizestes? Não sabeis que um homem como eu sabe adivinhar?
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles José: ¿Qué obra es esta que habéis hecho? ¿no sabéis que un hombre como yo sabe adivinar?

verses.KJV: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
verses.WEB: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”
verses.ASV: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord’s bondmen, both we, and he also in whose hand the cup is found.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Judá: Que diremos a meu senhor? Que falaremos? Ou com que nos justificaremos? Deus achou a maldade de teus servos: eis que, nós somos servos de meu senhor, nós, e também aquele em cujo poder foi achado o copo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Judá: ¿Qué diremos á mi señor? ¿qué hablaremos? ¿ó con qué nos justificaremos? Dios ha hallado la maldad de tus siervos: he aquí, nosotros somos siervos de mi señor, nosotros, y también aquél en cuyo poder fué hallada la copa.

verses.KJV: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
verses.WEB: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Far be it from me that I should do so: the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my bondman; but as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Nunca eu tal faça: o homem em cujo poder foi achado o copo, ele será meu servo; vós ide em paz a vosso pai.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Nunca yo tal haga: el varón en cuyo poder fué hallada la copa, él será mi siervo; vosotros id en paz á vuestro padre.

verses.KJV: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh, my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant; for thou art even as Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Judá se chegou a ele, e disse: Ai senhor meu, rogo-te que fale teu servo uma palavra aos ouvidos de meu senhor, e não se acenda tua ira contra teu servo, pois que tu és como Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Judá se llegó á él, y dijo: Ay señor mío, ruégote que hable tu siervo una palabra en oídos de mi señor, y no se encienda tu enojo contra tu siervo, pues que tú eres como Faraón.

verses.KJV: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
verses.WEB: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’
verses.ASV: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu senhor perguntou a seus servos, dizendo: Tendes pai ou irmão?
verses.RVR09: Mi señor preguntó á sus siervos, diciendo: ¿Tenéis padre ó hermano?

verses.KJV: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
verses.WEB: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’
