verses.ASV: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loveth him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós respondemos a meu senhor: Temos um pai ancião, e um jovem que lhe nasceu em sua velhice, pequeno ainda; e um irmão seu morreu, e ele restou sozinho de sua mãe, e seu pai o ama.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros respondimos á mi señor: Tenemos un padre anciano, y un mozo que le nació en su vejez, pequeño aún; y un hermano suyo murió, y él quedó solo de su madre, y su padre lo ama.

verses.KJV: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
verses.WEB: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’
verses.ASV: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu disseste a teus servos: Trazei-o a mim, e porei meus olhos sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y tú dijiste á tus siervos: Traédmelo, y pondré mis ojos sobre él.

verses.KJV: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
verses.WEB: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’
verses.ASV: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós dissemos a meu senhor: O jovem não pode deixar a seu pai, porque se o deixar, seu pai morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros dijimos á mi señor: El mozo no puede dejar á su padre, porque si le dejare, su padre morirá.

verses.KJV: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
verses.WEB: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’
verses.ASV: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseste a teus servos: Se vosso irmão mais novo não descer convosco, não vejais mais meu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Y dijiste á tus siervos: Si vuestro hermano menor no descendiere con vosotros, no veáis más mi rostro.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.WEB: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aconteceu, pois, que quando chegamos a meu pai teu servo, nós lhe contamos as palavras de meu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Aconteció pues, que como llegamos á mi padre tu siervo, contámosle las palabras de mi señor.

verses.KJV: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
verses.WEB: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’
verses.ASV: And our father said, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse nosso pai: Voltai a comprar-nos um pouco de alimento.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo nuestro padre: Volved á comprarnos un poco de alimento.

verses.KJV: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.
verses.WEB: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’
verses.ASV: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down; for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós respondemos: Não podemos ir: se nosso irmão for conosco, iremos; porque não podemos ver o rosto do homem, não estando conosco nosso irmão o mais novo.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros respondimos: No podemos ir: si nuestro hermano fuere con nosotros, iremos; porque no podemos ver el rostro del varón, no estando con nosotros nuestro hermano el menor.

verses.KJV: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
verses.WEB: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
verses.ASV: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então teu servo meu pai nos disse: Vós sabeis que dois me deu minha mulher;
verses.RVR09: Entonces tu siervo mi padre nos dijo: Vosotros sabéis que dos me parió mi mujer;

verses.KJV: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
verses.WEB: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.
verses.ASV: and the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I have not seen him since:
verses.ALMEIDA: E um saiu de minha presença, e penso certamente que foi despedaçado, e até agora não o vi;
verses.RVR09: Y el uno salió de conmigo, y pienso de cierto que fué despedazado, y hasta ahora no le he visto;

verses.KJV: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.WEB: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’
verses.ASV: and if ye take this one also from me, and harm befall him, ye will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se tomardes também este de diante de mim, e lhe acontecer algum desastre, fareis descer meus cabelos grisalhos com tristeza ao Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Y si tomareis también éste de delante de mí, y le aconteciere algún desastre, haréis descender mis canas con dolor á la sepultura.

verses.KJV: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
verses.WEB: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;
verses.ASV: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad is not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, quando chegar eu a teu servo meu pai, e o jovem não for comigo, como sua alma está ligada à alma dele,
verses.RVR09: Ahora, pues, cuando llegare yo á tu siervo mi padre, y el mozo no fuere conmigo, como su alma está ligada al alma de él,

verses.KJV: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
verses.WEB: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.
verses.ASV: it will come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not [with us], that he will die: and thy servants will bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sucederá que quando perceber a ausência do jovem, morrerá; e teus servos farão descer os cabelos grisalhos de teu servo, nosso pai, com tristeza ao Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Sucederá que cuando no vea al mozo, morirá: y tus siervos harán descender las canas de tu siervo nuestro padre con dolor á la sepultura.

verses.KJV: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
verses.WEB: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’
verses.ASV: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then shall I bear the blame to my father for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como teu servo saiu por fiador do jovem com meu pai, dizendo: Se eu não o devolver a ti, então eu serei culpável para meu pai todos os dias;
verses.RVR09: Como tu siervo salió por fiador del mozo con mi padre, diciendo: Si no te lo volviere, entonces yo seré culpable para mi padre todos los días;

verses.KJV: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, let thy servant, I pray thee, abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo-te, portanto, que fique agora teu servo pelo jovem por servo de meu senhor, e que o jovem vá com seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Ruégote por tanto que quede ahora tu siervo por el mozo por siervo de mi señor, y que el mozo vaya con sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
verses.WEB: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”
verses.ASV: For how shall I go up to my father, if the lad be not with me? lest I see the evil that shall come on my father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque como irei eu a meu pai sem o jovem? Não poderei, por não ver o mal que sobrevirá a meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿cómo iré yo á mi padre sin el mozo? No podré, por no ver el mal que sobrevendrá á mi padre.

verses.KJV: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
verses.WEB: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
verses.ASV: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não podia já José se conter diante de todos os que estavam ao seu lado, e clamou: Fazei sair de minha presença a todos. E não ficou ninguém com ele, ao dar-se a conhecer José a seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: NO podía ya José contenerse delante de todos los que estaban al lado suyo, y clamó: Haced salir de conmigo á todos. Y no quedó nadie con él, al darse á conocer José á sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.WEB: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.ASV: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se deu a chorar por voz em grito; e ouviram os egípcios, e ouviu também a casa de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se dió á llorar á voz en grito; y oyeron los Egipcios, y oyó también la casa de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
verses.WEB: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse José a seus irmãos: Eu sou José: vive ainda meu pai? E seus irmãos não puderam lhe responder, porque estavam perturbados diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo José á sus hermanos: Yo soy José: ¿vive aún mi padre? Y sus hermanos no pudieron responderle, porque estaban turbados delante de él.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
verses.WEB: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. He said, “I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse José a seus irmãos: Achegai-vos agora a mim. E eles se achegaram. E ele disse: Eu sou José vosso irmão o que vendestes para o Egito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo José á sus hermanos: Llegaos ahora á mí. Y ellos se llegaron. Y él dijo: Yo soy José vuestro hermano el que vendisteis para Egipto.

verses.KJV: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
verses.WEB: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
verses.ASV: And now be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, não vos entristeçais, nem vos pese de haver me vendido aqui; que para preservação de vida me enviou Deus diante de vós:
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, no os entristezcáis, ni os pese de haberme vendido acá; que para preservación de vida me envió Dios delante de vosotros:

verses.KJV: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
verses.WEB: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.
verses.ASV: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and there are yet five years, in which there shall be neither plowing nor harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que já houve dois anos de fome em meio da terra, e ainda restam cinco anos em que nem haverá arada nem colheita.
verses.RVR09: Que ya ha habido dos años de hambre en medio de la tierra, y aun quedan cinco años en que ni habrá arada ni siega.

verses.KJV: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verses.WEB: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
verses.ASV: And God sent me before you to preserve you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus me enviou adiante de vós, para que vós restásseis na terra, e para vos dar vida por meio de grande salvamento.
verses.RVR09: Y Dios me envió delante de vosotros, para que vosotros quedaseis en la tierra, y para daros vida por medio de grande salvamento.

verses.KJV: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, pois, não me enviastes vós aqui, mas sim Deus, que me pôs por pai de Faraó, e por senhor de toda sua casa, e por governador de toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Así pues, no me enviasteis vosotros acá, sino Dios, que me ha puesto por padre de Faraón, y por señor de toda su casa, y por gobernador en toda la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
verses.WEB: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.
verses.ASV: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not;
verses.ALMEIDA: Apressai-vos, ide a meu pai e dizei-lhe: Assim diz teu filho José: Deus me pôs por senhor de todo Egito; vem a mim, não te detenhas:
verses.RVR09: Daos priesa, id á mi padre y decidle: Así dice tu hijo José: Dios me ha puesto por señor de todo Egipto; ven á mí, no te detengas:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
verses.WEB: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitarás na terra de Gósen, e estarás perto de mim, tu e teus filhos, e os filhos de teus filhos, teus gados e tuas vacas, e tudo o que tens.
verses.RVR09: Y habitarás en la tierra de Gosén, y estarás cerca de mí, tú y tus hijos, y los hijos de tus hijos, tus ganados y tus vacas, y todo lo que tienes.

verses.KJV: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
verses.WEB: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’
verses.ASV: and there will I nourish thee; for there are yet five years of famine; lest thou come to poverty, thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali te alimentarei, pois ainda restam cinco anos de fome, para que não pereças de pobreza tu e tua casa, e tudo o que tens:
verses.RVR09: Y allí te alimentaré, pues aun quedan cinco años de hambre, porque no perezcas de pobreza tú y tu casa, y todo lo que tienes:

verses.KJV: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
verses.WEB: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
verses.ASV: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que, vossos olhos veem, e os olhos de meu irmão Benjamim, que meu boca vos fala.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, vuestros ojos ven, y los ojos de mi hermano Benjamín, que mi boca os habla.

verses.KJV: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
verses.WEB: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”
verses.ASV: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen: and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fareis pois saber a meu pai toda minha glória no Egito, e tudo o que vistes: e apressai-vos, e trazei a meu pai aqui.
verses.RVR09: Haréis pues saber á mi padre toda mi gloria en Egipto, y todo lo que habéis visto: y daos priesa, y traed á mi padre acá.

verses.KJV: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.WEB: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
verses.ASV: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançou-se sobre o pescoço de Benjamim seu irmão, e chorou; e também Benjamim chorou sobre seu pescoço.
verses.RVR09: Y echóse sobre el cuello de Benjamín su hermano, y lloró; y también Benjamín lloró sobre su cuello.

verses.KJV: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
verses.WEB: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.
verses.ASV: And he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E beijou a todos os seus irmãos, e chorou sobre eles: e depois seus irmãos falaram com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y besó á todos sus hermanos, y lloró sobre ellos: y después sus hermanos hablaron con él.

verses.KJV: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.WEB: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.ASV: And the report thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu-se a notícia na casa de Faraó, dizendo: Os irmãos de José vieram. E pareceu bem aos olhos de Faraó e de seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y oyóse la noticia en la casa de Faraón, diciendo: Los hermanos de José han venido. Y plugo en los ojos de Faraón y de sus siervos.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye: lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Faraó a José: Dize a teus irmãos: Fazei isto: carregai vossos animais, e ide, voltai à terra de Canaã;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Faraón á José: Di á tus hermanos: Haced esto: cargad vuestras bestias, é id, volved á la tierra de Canaán;

verses.KJV: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
verses.WEB: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’
verses.ASV: and take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomai a vosso pai e vossas famílias, e vinde a mim, que eu vos darei o bom da terra do Egito e comereis a gordura da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y tomad á vuestro padre y vuestras familias, y venid á mí, que yo os daré lo bueno de la tierra de Egipto y comeréis la grosura de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.WEB: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.ASV: Now thou art commanded, this do ye: take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu manda: Fazei isto: tomai para vós da terra do Egito carros para vossos filhos e vossas mulheres; e tomai a vosso pai, e vinde.
verses.RVR09: Y tú manda: Haced esto: tomaos de la tierra de Egipto carros para vuestros niños y vuestras mujeres; y tomad á vuestro padre, y venid.

verses.KJV: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is your's.
verses.WEB: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”
verses.ASV: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não se vos dê nada de vossos pertences, porque o bem da terra do Egito será vosso.
verses.RVR09: Y no se os dé nada de vuestras alhajas, porque el bien de la tierra de Egipto será vuestro.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.WEB: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram-no assim os filhos de Israel: e deu-lhes José carros conforme a ordem de Faraó, e deu alimentos para o caminho.
verses.RVR09: E hiciéronlo así los hijos de Israel: y dióles José carros conforme á la orden de Faraón, y suministróles víveres para el camino.

verses.KJV: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
verses.WEB: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.
verses.ASV: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
verses.ALMEIDA: A cada um de todos eles deu mudas de roupas, e a Benjamim deu trezentas peças de prata, e cinco mudas de roupas.
verses.RVR09: A cada uno de todos ellos dió mudas de vestidos, y á Benjamín dió trescientas piezas de plata, y cinco mudas de vestidos.

verses.KJV: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
verses.WEB: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.
verses.ASV: And to his father he sent after this manner: ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she-asses laden with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a seu pai enviou isto: dez asnos carregados do melhor do Egito, e dez asnas carregadas de trigo, e pão e comida, para seu pai no caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y á su padre envió esto: diez asnos cargados de lo mejor de Egipto, y diez asnas cargadas de trigo, y pan y comida, para su padre en el camino.

verses.KJV: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
verses.WEB: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”
verses.ASV: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E despediu a seus irmãos, e foram-se. E ele lhes disse: Não brigais pelo caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y despidió á sus hermanos, y fuéronse. Y él les dijo: No riñáis por el camino.

verses.KJV: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
verses.WEB: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.
verses.ASV: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiram do Egito, e chegaram à terra de Canaã a Jacó seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y subieron de Egipto, y llegaron á la tierra de Canaán á Jacob su padre.

verses.KJV: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.
verses.WEB: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.
verses.ASV: And they told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt. And his heart fainted, for he believed them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram-lhe as novas, dizendo: José vive ainda; e ele é senhor toda a terra do Egito. E seu coração se desmaiou; pois não cria neles.
verses.RVR09: Y diéronle las nuevas, diciendo: José vive aún; y él es señor en toda la tierra de Egipto. Y su corazón se desmayó; pues no los creía.

verses.KJV: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
verses.WEB: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.
verses.ASV: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe contaram todas as palavras de José, que ele lhes havia falado; e vendo ele os carros que José enviava para levá-lo, o espírito de Jacó seu pai reviveu.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le contaron todas las palabras de José, que él les había hablado; y viendo él los carros que José enviaba para llevarlo, el espíritu de Jacob su padre revivió.

verses.KJV: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
verses.WEB: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
verses.ASV: and Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Israel: Basta; José meu filho vive ainda: irei, e lhe verei antes que eu morra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Israel: Basta; José mi hijo vive todavía: iré, y le veré antes que yo muera.

verses.KJV: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.WEB: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
verses.ASV: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiu-se Israel com tudo o que tinha, e veio a Berseba, e ofereceu sacrifícios ao Deus de seu pai Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Y PARTIÓSE Israel con todo lo que tenía, y vino á Beer-seba, y ofreció sacrificios al Dios de su padre Isaac.

verses.KJV: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
verses.WEB: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.ASV: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Deus a Israel em visões de noite, e disse: Jacó, Jacó. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.RVR09: Y habló Dios á Israel en visiones de noche, y dijo: Jacob, Jacob. Y él respondió: Heme aquí.

verses.KJV: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.WEB: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
verses.ASV: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Eu sou Deus, o Deus de teu pai; não temas de descer ao Egito, porque eu te farei ali em grande nação.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Yo soy Dios, el Dios de tu padre; no temas de descender á Egipto, porque yo te pondré allí en gran gente.

verses.KJV: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.WEB: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”
verses.ASV: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu descerei contigo ao Egito, e eu também te farei voltar; e José porá sua mão sobre teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Yo descenderé contigo á Egipto, y yo también te haré volver: y José pondrá su mano sobre tus ojos.

verses.KJV: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.WEB: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.ASV: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se Jacó de Berseba; e tomaram os filhos de Israel a seu pai Jacó, e a seus filhos, e a suas mulheres, nos carros que Faraó havia enviado para levá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Jacob de Beer-seba; y tomaron los hijos de Israel á su padre Jacob, y á sus niños, y á sus mujeres, en los carros que Faraón había enviado para llevarlo.

verses.KJV: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.WEB: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,
verses.ASV: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram seus gados, e sua riqueza que havia adquirido na terra de Canaã, e vieram-se ao Egito, Jacó, e toda sua descendência consigo;
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron sus ganados, y su hacienda que había adquirido en la tierra de Canaán, y viniéronse á Egipto, Jacob, y toda su simiente consigo;

verses.KJV: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.WEB: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.
verses.ASV: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

verses.RVR09: Sus hijos, y los hijos de sus hijos consigo; sus hijas, y las hijas de sus hijos, y á toda su simiente trajo consigo á Egipto.

verses.KJV: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
verses.ASV: And these are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s first-born.

verses.RVR09: Y estos son los nombres de los hijos de Israel, que entraron en Egipto, Jacob y sus hijos: Rubén, el primogénito de Jacob.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.WEB: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Pallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Rúben: Enoque, e Palu, e Hezrom, e Carmi.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Rubén: Hanoch, y Phallu, y Hezrón, y Carmi.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
verses.WEB: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Simeón: Jemuel, y Jamín, y Ohad, y Jachîn, y Zohar, y Saúl, hijo de la Cananea.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.WEB: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Levi: Gérson, Coate, e Merari.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Leví: Gersón, y Coath, y Merari.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.WEB: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Judá: Er, e Onã, e Selá, e Perez, e Zerá: mas Er e Onã, morreram na terra de Canaã. E os filhos de Perez foram Hezrom e Hamul.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Judá: Er, y Onán, y Sela, y Phares, y Zara: mas Er y Onán, murieron en la tierra de Canaán. Y los hijos de Phares fueron Hezrón y Hamul.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
verses.WEB: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puvah, and Iob, and Shimron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Issacar: Tola, e Puva, e Jó, e Sinrom.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Issachâr: Thola, y Phua, y Job, y Simrón.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.WEB: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Zebulom: Serede e Elom, e Jaleel.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Zabulón: Sered, y Elón, y Jahleel.

verses.KJV: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bare unto Jacob in Paddan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Lia, os que deu a Jacó em Padã-Arã, e além de sua filha Diná: trinta e três as almas todas de seus filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Lea, los que parió á Jacob en Padan-aram, y además su hija Dina: treinta y tres las almas todas de sus hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.WEB: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Gade: Zifiom, e Hagi, e Suni, e Ezbom, e Eri, e Arodi, e Areli.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Gad: Ziphión, y Aggi, y Ezbón, y Suni, y Heri, y Arodi, y Areli.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.WEB: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Aser: Imna, e Isva, e Isvi y Berias, e Sera, irmã deles. Os filhos de Berias: Héber, e Malquiel.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Aser: Jimna, é Ishua, é Isui, y Beria, y Sera, hermana de ellos. Los hijos de Beria: Heber, y Malchîel.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Zilpa, a que Labão deu a sua filha Lia, e deu estes a Jacó; todas dezesseis almas.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Zilpa, la que Labán dió á su hija Lea, y parió estos á Jacob; todas diez y seis almas.

verses.KJV: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.WEB: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.ASV: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Raquel, mulher de Jacó: José e Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Rachêl, mujer de Jacob: José y Benjamín.

verses.KJV: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.WEB: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
verses.ASV: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On, bare unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nasceram a José na terra do Egito Manassés e Efraim, os que lhe deu Azenate, filha Potífera, sacerdote de Om.
verses.RVR09: Y nacieron á José en la tierra de Egipto Manasés y Ephraim, los que le parió Asenath, hija de Potipherah, sacerdote de On.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.WEB: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Benjamim foram Belá, e Bequer e Asbel, e Gera, e Naamã, e Eí, e Rôs e Mupim, e Hupim, e Arde.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Benjamín fueron Bela, y Bechêr y Asbel, y Gera, y Naamán, y Ehi, y Ros y Muppim, y Huppim, y Ard.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Raquel, que nasceram a Jacó: ao todo, catorze almas.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Rachêl, que nacieron á Jacob: en todas, catorce almas.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
verses.WEB: The son of Dan: Hushim.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Dã: Husim.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Dan: Husim.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.WEB: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Naftali: Jazeel, e Guni, e Jezer, e Silém.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Nephtalí: Jahzeel, y Guni, y Jezer, y Shillem.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Bila, a que deu Labão a Raquel sua filha, e ela deu à luz estes a Jacó; todas sete almas.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Bilha, la que dió Labán á Rachêl su hija, y parió estos á Jacob; todas siete almas.

verses.KJV: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
verses.WEB: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
verses.ASV: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, that came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as pessoas que vieram com Jacó ao Egito, procedentes de seus lombos, sem as mulheres dos filhos de Jacó, todas as pessoas foram sessenta e seis.
verses.RVR09: Todas las personas que vinieron con Jacob á Egipto, procedentes de sus lomos, sin las mujeres de los hijos de Jacob, todas las personas fueron sesenta y seis.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
verses.WEB: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.
verses.ASV: and the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, that came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de José, que lhe nasceram no Egito, duas pessoas. Todas as almas da casa de Jacó, que entraram no Egito, foram setenta.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de José, que le nacieron en Egipto, dos personas. Todas las almas de la casa de Jacob, que entraron en Egipto, fueron setenta.

verses.KJV: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.WEB: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.ASV: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to show the way before him unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou a Judá adiante de si a José, para que lhe viesse a ver a Gósen; e chegaram à terra de Gósen.
verses.RVR09: Y envió á Judá delante de sí á José, para que le viniese á ver á Gosén; y llegaron á la tierra de Gosén.

verses.KJV: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.WEB: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.ASV: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen; and he presented himself unto him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José preparou seu carro e veio a receber a Israel seu pai a Gósen; e se manifestou a ele, e lançou-se sobre seu pescoço, e chorou sobre seu pescoço bastante.
verses.RVR09: Y José unció su carro y vino á recibir á Israel su padre á Gosén; y se manifestó á él, y echóse sobre su cuello, y lloró sobre su cuello bastante.

verses.KJV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
verses.WEB: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
verses.ASV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, that thou art yet alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Israel disse a José: Morra eu agora, já que vi teu rosto, pois ainda vives.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Israel dijo á José: Muera yo ahora, ya que he visto tu rostro, pues aun vives.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.WEB: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and tell Pharaoh, and will say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.ALMEIDA: E José disse a seus irmãos, e à casa de seu pai: Subirei e farei saber a Faraó, e lhe direi: Meus irmãos e a casa de meu pai, que estavam na terra de Canaã, vieram a mim;
verses.RVR09: Y José dijo á sus hermanos, y á la casa de su padre: Subiré y haré saber á Faraón, y diréle: Mis hermanos y la casa de mi padre, que estaban en la tierra de Canaán, han venido á mí;

verses.KJV: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.WEB: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’
verses.ASV: and the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os homens são pastores de ovelhas, porque são homens criadores de gado: e trouxeram suas ovelhas e suas vacas, e tudo o que tinham.
verses.RVR09: Y los hombres son pastores de ovejas, porque son hombres ganaderos: y han traído sus ovejas y sus vacas, y todo lo que tenían.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
verses.WEB: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Faraó vos chamar e disser: qual é vosso ofício?
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Faraón os llamare y dijere: ¿cuál es vuestro oficio?

verses.KJV: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
verses.ASV: that ye shall say, Thy servants have been keepers of cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então direis: Homens de criação de gado foram teus servos desde nossa juventude até agora, nós e nossos pais; a fim que moreis na terra de Gósen, porque os egípcios abominam todo pastor de ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces diréis: Hombres de ganadería han sido tus siervos desde nuestra mocedad hasta ahora, nosotros y nuestros padres; á fin que moréis en la tierra de Gosén, porque los Egipcios abominan todo pastor de ovejas.

verses.KJV: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
verses.WEB: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”
verses.ASV: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José veio, e fez saber a Faraó, e disse: Meu pai e meus irmãos, e suas ovelhas e suas vacas, com tudo o que têm, vieram da terra de Canaã, e eis que, estão na terra de Gósen.
verses.RVR09: Y JOSÉ vino, é hizo saber á Faraón, y dijo: Mi padre y mis hermanos, y sus ovejas y sus vacas, con todo lo que tienen, han venido de la tierra de Canaán, y he aquí, están en la tierra de Gosén.

verses.KJV: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And from among his brethren he took five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dentre seus irmãos tomou cinco homens, e os apresentou diante de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y de los postreros de sus hermanos tomó cinco varones, y presentólos delante de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Faraó disse a seus irmãos: Qual é vosso ofício? E eles responderam a Faraó: Pastores de ovelhas são teus servos, tanto nós como nossos pais.
verses.RVR09: Y Faraón dijo á sus hermanos: ¿Cuál es vuestro oficio? Y ellos respondieron á Faraón: Pastores de ovejas son tus siervos, así nosotros como nuestros padres.

verses.KJV: They said morever unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
verses.WEB: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”
verses.ASV: And they said unto Pharaoh, To sojourn in the land are we come; for there is no pasture for thy servants’ flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram ademais a Faraó: Por morar nesta terra viemos; porque não há pasto para as ovelhas de teus servos, pois a fome é grave na terra de Canaã: portanto, te rogamos agora que habitem teus servos na terra de Gósen.
verses.RVR09: Dijeron además á Faraón: Por morar en esta tierra hemos venido; porque no hay pasto para las ovejas de tus siervos, pues el hambre es grave en la tierra de Canaán: por tanto, te rogamos ahora que habiten tus siervos en la tierra de Gosén.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
verses.WEB: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó falou a José, dizendo: Teu pai e teus irmãos vieram a ti;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón habló á José, diciendo: Tu padre y tus hermanos han venido á ti;

verses.KJV: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
verses.WEB: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”
verses.ASV: the land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and thy brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any able men among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra do Egito diante de ti está; no melhor da terra faze habitar a teu pai e a teus irmãos; habitem na terra de Gósen; e se entendes que há entre eles homens competentes, põe-os por administradores do meu gado.
verses.RVR09: La tierra de Egipto delante de ti está; en lo mejor de la tierra haz habitar á tu padre y á tus hermanos; habiten en la tierra de Gosén; y si entiendes que hay entre ellos hombres eficaces, ponlos por mayorales del ganado mío.

verses.KJV: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José introduziu a seu pai, e apresentou-o diante de Faraó; e Jacó abençoou a Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y José introdujo á su padre, y presentólo delante de Faraón; y Jacob bendijo á Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How many are the days of the years of thy life?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Faraó a Jacó: Quantos são os dias dos anos de tua vida?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Faraón á Jacob: ¿Cuántos son los días de los años de tu vida?

verses.KJV: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verses.WEB: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”
verses.ASV: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty years: few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó respondeu a Faraó: Os dias dos anos de minha peregrinação são cento e trinta anos; poucos e maus foram os dias dos anos de minha vida, e não chegaram aos dias dos anos da vida de meus pais nos dias de sua peregrinação.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob respondió á Faraón: Los días de los años de mi peregrinación son ciento treinta años; pocos y malos han sido los días de los años de mi vida, y no han llegado á los días de los años de la vida de mis padres en los días de su peregrinación.

verses.KJV: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jacó abençoou a Faraó, e saiu-se de diante de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y Jacob bendijo á Faraón, y salióse de delante de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.WEB: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.ASV: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim José fez habitar a seu pai e a seus irmãos, e deu-lhes possessão na terra do Egito, no melhor da terra, na terra de Ramessés como mandou Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Así José hizo habitar á su padre y á sus hermanos, y dióles posesión en la tierra de Egipto, en lo mejor de la tierra, en la tierra de Rameses como mandó Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.
verses.WEB: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.
verses.ASV: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alimentava José a seu pai e a seus irmãos, e a toda a casa de seu pai, de pão, segundo o número de seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y alimentaba José á su padre y á sus hermanos, y á toda la casa de su padre, de pan, hasta la boca del niño.

verses.KJV: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
verses.WEB: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
verses.ASV: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não havia pão toda a terra, e a fome era muito grave; pelo que desfaleceu de fome a terra do Egito e a terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Y no había pan en toda la tierra, y el hambre era muy grave; por lo que desfalleció de hambre la tierra de Egipto y la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
verses.WEB: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.ASV: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E recolheu José todo o dinheiro que se achou na terra do Egito e na terra de Canaã, pelos alimentos que dele compravam; e meteu José o dinheiro na casa de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y recogió José todo el dinero que se halló en la tierra de Egipto y en la tierra de Canaán, por los alimentos que de él compraban; y metió José el dinero en casa de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
verses.WEB: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”
verses.ASV: And when the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for [our] money faileth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acabado o dinheiro da terra do Egito e da terra de Canaã, veio todo Egito a José dizendo: Dá-nos pão: por que morreremos diante de ti, por haver-se acabado o dinheiro?
verses.RVR09: Y acabado el dinero de la tierra de Egipto y de la tierra de Canaán, vino todo Egipto á José diciendo: Danos pan: ¿por qué moriremos delante de ti, por haberse acabado el dinero?

verses.KJV: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
verses.WEB: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José disse: Dai vossos gados, e eu vos darei por vossos gados, se se acabou o dinheiro.
verses.RVR09: Y José dijo: Dad vuestros ganados, y yo os daré por vuestros ganados, si se ha acabado el dinero.

verses.KJV: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
verses.WEB: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.
verses.ASV: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph; and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their cattle for that year.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles trouxeram seus gados a José; e José lhes deu alimentos por cavalos, e pelo rebanho das ovelhas, e pelo rebanho das vacas, e por asnos: e sustentou-os de pão por todos os seus gados aquele ano.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos trajeron sus ganados á José; y José les dió alimentos por caballos, y por el ganado de las ovejas, y por el ganado de las vacas, y por asnos: y sustentólos de pan por todos sus ganados aquel año.

verses.KJV: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
verses.WEB: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.
verses.ASV: And when that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide from my lord, how that our money is all spent; and the herds of cattle are my lord’s; there is nought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
verses.ALMEIDA: E acabado aquele ano, vieram a ele o segundo ano, e lhe disseram: Não encobriremos a nosso senhor que o dinheiro certamente se acabou; também o gado é já de nosso senhor; nada restou diante de nosso senhor a não ser nossos corpos e nossa terra.
verses.RVR09: Y acabado aquel año, vinieron á él el segundo año, y le dijeron: No encubriremos á nuestro señor que el dinero ciertamente se ha acabado; también el ganado es ya de nuestro señor; nada ha quedado delante de nuestro señor sino nuestros cuerpos y nuestra tierra.

verses.KJV: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
verses.WEB: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”
verses.ASV: wherefore should we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land be not desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que morreremos diante de teus olhos, tanto nós como nossa terra? Compra a nós e a nossa terra por pão, e seremos nós e nossa terra servos de Faraó; e dá-nos semente para que vivamos e não morramos, e não seja assolada a terra.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué moriremos delante de tus ojos, así nosotros como nuestra tierra? Cómpranos á nosotros y á nuestra tierra por pan, y seremos nosotros y nuestra tierra siervos de Faraón: y danos simiente para que vivamos y no muramos, y no sea asolada la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.
verses.WEB: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.
verses.ASV: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine was sore upon them: and the land became Pharaoh’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então comprou José toda a terra do Egito para Faraó; pois os egípcios venderam cada um suas terras, porque se agravou a fome sobre eles: e a terra veio a ser de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Entonces compró José toda la tierra de Egipto para Faraón; pues los Egipcios vendieron cada uno sus tierras, porque se agravó el hambre sobre ellos: y la tierra vino á ser de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
verses.WEB: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.
verses.ASV: And as for the people, he removed them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao povo o fez passar às cidades desde um fim do termo do Egito até o outro fim.
verses.RVR09: Y al pueblo hízolo pasar á las ciudades desde el un cabo del término de Egipto hasta el otro cabo.

verses.KJV: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
verses.WEB: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.
verses.ASV: Only the land of the priests bought he not: for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them; wherefore they sold not their land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente a terra dos sacerdotes não comprou, porquanto os sacerdotes tinham ração de Faraó, e eles comiam sua ração que Faraó lhes dava: por isso não venderam sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Solamente la tierra de los sacerdotes no compró, por cuanto los sacerdotes tenían ración de Faraón, y ellos comían su ración que Faraón les daba: por eso no vendieron su tierra.

verses.KJV: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
verses.WEB: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
verses.ASV: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José disse ao povo: Eis que comprei hoje vós e vossa terra para Faraó: vede aqui semente, e semeareis a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y José dijo al pueblo: He aquí os he hoy comprado y á vuestra tierra para Faraón: ved aquí simiente, y sembraréis la tierra.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
verses.WEB: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass at the ingatherings, that ye shall give a fifth unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que dos frutos dareis o quinto a Faraó, e as quatro partes serão vossas para semear as terras, e para vosso mantimento, e dos que estão em vossas casas, e para que comam vossos meninos.
verses.RVR09: Y será que de los frutos daréis el quinto á Faraón, y las cuatro partes serán vuestras para sembrar las tierras, y para vuestro mantenimiento, y de los que están en vuestras casas, y para que coman vuestros niños.

verses.KJV: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
verses.WEB: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”
verses.ASV: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: A vida nos deste: achemos favor aos olhos de meu senhor, e sejamos servos de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: La vida nos has dado: hallemos gracia en ojos de mi señor, y seamos siervos de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part, except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.
verses.WEB: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.
verses.ASV: And Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth; only the land of the priests alone became not Pharaoh’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então José o pôs por estatuto até hoje sobre a terra do Egito, assinalando para Faraó o quinto; exceto somente a terra dos sacerdotes, que não foi de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Entonces José lo puso por fuero hasta hoy sobre la tierra de Egipto, señalando para Faraón el quinto; excepto sólo la tierra de los sacerdotes, que no fué de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.WEB: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.ASV: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they gat them possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim habitou Israel na terra do Egito, na terra de Gósen; e apossaram-se nela, y se aumentaram, e multiplicaram em grande maneira.
verses.RVR09: Así habitó Israel en la tierra de Egipto, en la tierra de Gosén; y aposesionáronse en ella, y se aumentaron, y multiplicaron en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
verses.WEB: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.
verses.ASV: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were a hundred forty and seven years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viveu Jacó na terra do Egito dezessete anos: e foram os dias de Jacó, os anos de sua vida, cento quarenta e sete anos.
verses.RVR09: Y vivió Jacob en la tierra de Egipto diecisiete años: y fueron los días de Jacob, los años de su vida, ciento cuarenta y siete años.

verses.KJV: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
verses.WEB: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,
verses.ASV: And the time drew near that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found favor in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me: bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: E achegaram-se os dias de Israel para morrer, e chamou a José seu filho, e lhe disse: Se achei agora favor em teus olhos, rogo-te que ponhas tua mão debaixo de minha coxa, e farás comigo misericórdia e verdade; rogo-te que não me enterres no Egito;
verses.RVR09: Y llegáronse los días de Israel para morir, y llamó á José su hijo, y le dijo: Si he hallado ahora gracia en tus ojos, ruégote que pongas tu mano debajo de mi muslo, y harás conmigo misericordia y verdad; ruégote que no me entierres en Egipto;

verses.KJV: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
verses.WEB: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” Joseph said, “I will do as you have said.”
verses.ASV: but when I sleep with my fathers, thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying-place. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando dormir com meus pais, me levarás de Egito, e me sepultarás no sepulcro deles. E ele respondeu: Eu farei como tu dizes.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando durmiere con mis padres, llevarme has de Egipto, y me sepultarás en el sepulcro de ellos. Y él respondió: Yo haré como tú dices.

verses.KJV: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
verses.WEB: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.
verses.ASV: And he said, Swear unto me: and he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Jura-me isso. E ele lhe jurou. Então Israel se inclinou sobre a cabeceira da cama.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Júramelo. Y él le juró. Entonces Israel se inclinó sobre la cabecera de la cama.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.WEB: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that one said to Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu depois destas coisas que foi dito a José: Eis que teu pai está enfermo. E ele tomou consigo seus dois filhos Manassés e Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Y SUCEDIÓ después de estas cosas el haberse dicho á José: He aquí tu padre está enfermo. Y él tomó consigo sus dos hijos Manasés y Ephraim.

verses.KJV: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
verses.WEB: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.
verses.ASV: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se fez saber a Jacó, dizendo: Eis que teu filho José vem a ti. Então se esforçou Israel, e sentou-se sobre a cama;
verses.RVR09: Y se hizo saber á Jacob, diciendo: He aquí tu hijo José viene á ti. Entonces se esforzó Israel, y sentóse sobre la cama;

verses.KJV: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
verses.WEB: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
verses.ASV: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a José: O Deus Todo-Poderoso me apareceu em Luz na terra de Canaã, e me abençoou,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á José: El Dios Omnipotente me apareció en Luz en la tierra de Canaán, y me bendijo,

verses.KJV: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
verses.WEB: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’
verses.ASV: and said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a company of peoples, and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-me: Eis que, eu te farei crescer, e te multiplicarei, e te porei por conjunto de povos: e darei esta terra à tua descendência depois de ti por herança perpétua.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome: He aquí, yo te haré crecer, y te multiplicaré, y te pondré por estirpe de pueblos: y daré esta tierra á tu simiente después de ti por heredad perpetua.

verses.KJV: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
