verses.WEB: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.
verses.ASV: And now thy two sons, who were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, shall be mine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora teus dois filhos Efraim e Manassés, que te nasceram na terra do Egito, antes que viesse a ti à terra do Egito, meus são; como Rúben e Simeão, serão meus:
verses.RVR09: Y ahora tus dos hijos Ephraim y Manasés, que te nacieron en la tierra de Egipto, antes que viniese á ti á la tierra de Egipto, míos son; como Rubén y Simeón, serán míos:

verses.KJV: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
verses.WEB: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
verses.ASV: And thy issue, that thou begettest after them, shall be thine; they shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que depois deles geraste, serão teus; pelo nome de seus irmãos serão chamados em suas propriedades.
verses.RVR09: Y los que después de ellos has engendrado, serán tuyos; por el nombre de sus hermanos serán llamados en sus heredades.

verses.KJV: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.
verses.WEB: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”
verses.ASV: And as for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when there was still some distance to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way to Ephrath (the same is Beth-lehem).
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quando eu vinha de Padã-Arã, se me morreu Raquel na terra de Canaã, no caminho, como certa distância vindo a Efrata; e sepultei-a ali no caminho de Efrata, que é Belém.
verses.RVR09: Porque cuando yo venía de Padan-aram, se me murió Rachêl en la tierra de Canaán, en el camino, como media legua de tierra viniendo á Ephrata; y sepultéla allí en el camino de Ephrata, que es Bethlehem.

verses.KJV: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?
verses.WEB: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”
verses.ASV: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu Israel os filhos de José, e disse: Quem são estes?
verses.RVR09: Y vió Israel los hijos de José, y dijo: ¿Quiénes son éstos?

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
verses.WEB: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me here. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu José a seu pai: São meus filhos, que Deus me deu aqui. E ele disse: Achegai-os agora a mim, e os abençoarei.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió José á su padre: Son mis hijos, que Dios me ha dado aquí. Y él dijo: Allégalos ahora á mí, y los bendeciré.

verses.KJV: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
verses.WEB: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
verses.ASV: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os olhos de Israel estavam tão agravados da velhice, que não podia ver. Fez-lhes, pois, chegar a ele, e ele os beijou e abraçou.
verses.RVR09: Y los ojos de Israel estaban tan agravados de la vejez, que no podía ver. Hízoles, pues, llegar á él, y él los besó y abrazó.

verses.KJV: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
verses.WEB: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
verses.ASV: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath let me see thy seed also.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Israel a José: Não pensava eu ver teu rosto, e eis que Deus me fez ver também tua descendência.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Israel á José: No pensaba yo ver tu rostro, y he aquí Dios me ha hecho ver también tu simiente.

verses.KJV: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.WEB: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.ASV: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees; and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então José os tirou dentre seus joelhos, e inclinou-se à terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces José los sacó de entre sus rodillas, é inclinóse á tierra.

verses.KJV: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.
verses.WEB: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.
verses.ASV: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou-os José a ambos, Efraim à sua direita, à esquerda de Israel; e a Manassés à sua esquerda, à direita de Israel; e fez-lhes chegar a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y tomólos José á ambos, Ephraim á su diestra, á la siniestra de Israel; y á Manasés á su izquierda, á la derecha de Israel; é hízoles llegar á él.

verses.KJV: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
verses.WEB: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
verses.ASV: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the first-born.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Israel estendeu sua mão direita, e a pôs sobre a cabeça de Efraim, que era o mais novo, e sua esquerda sobre a cabeça de Manassés, colocando assim suas mãos propositadamente, ainda que Manassés era o primogênito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Israel extendió su diestra, y púsola sobre la cabeza de Ephraim, que era el menor, y su siniestra sobre la cabeza de Manasés, colocando así sus manos adrede, aunque Manasés era el primogénito.

verses.KJV: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
verses.WEB: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,
verses.ASV: And he blessed Joseph, and said, The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God who hath fed me all my life long unto this day,
verses.ALMEIDA: E abençoou a José, e disse: O Deus em cuja presença andaram meus pais Abraão e Isaque, o Deus que me mantém desde que eu sou até hoje,
verses.RVR09: Y bendijo á José, y dijo: El Dios en cuya presencia anduvieron mis padres Abraham é Isaac, el Dios que me mantiene desde que yo soy hasta este día,

verses.KJV: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
verses.WEB: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
verses.ASV: the angel who hath redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Anjo que me liberta de todo mal abençoe a estes moços: e meu nome seja chamado neles, e o nome de meus pais Abraão e Isaque: e multipliquem em grande maneira em meio da terra.
verses.RVR09: El Angel que me liberta de todo mal, bendiga á estos mozos: y mi nombre sea llamado en ellos, y el nombre de mis padres Abraham é Isaac: y multipliquen en gran manera en medio de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
verses.WEB: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
verses.ASV: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vendo José que seu pai punha a direita sobre a cabeça de Efraim, causou-lhe isto desgosto; e pegou a mão de seu pai, para mudá-la de sobre a cabeça de Efraim à cabeça de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: Entonces viendo José que su padre ponía la mano derecha sobre la cabeza de Ephraim, causóle esto disgusto; y asió la mano de su padre, para mudarla de sobre la cabeza de Ephraim á la cabeza de Manasés.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
verses.WEB: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father; for this is the first-born; put thy right hand upon his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse José a seu pai: Não assim, meu pai, porque este é o primogênito; põe tua mão direita sobre sua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo José á su padre: No así, padre mío, porque éste es el primogénito; pon tu diestra sobre su cabeza.

verses.KJV: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
verses.WEB: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”
verses.ASV: And his father refused, and said, I know [it], my son, I know [it]; he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: howbeit his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas seu pai não quis, e disse: Eu sei, meu filho, eu sei: também ele virá a ser um povo, e será também acrescentado; porém seu irmão mais novo será maior que ele, e sua descendência será plenitude de povos.
verses.RVR09: Mas su padre no quiso, y dijo: Lo sé, hijo mío, lo sé: también él vendrá á ser un pueblo, y será también acrecentado; pero su hermano menor será más grande que él, y su simiente será plenitud de gentes.

verses.KJV: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.WEB: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.ASV: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee will Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abençoou-os aquele dia, dizendo: Em ti Israel abençoará, dizendo: Deus faça de ti Deus como a Efraim e como a Manassés. E pôs a Efraim diante de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: Y bendíjolos aquel día, diciendo: En ti bendecirá Israel, diciendo: Póngate Dios como á Ephraim y como á Manasés. Y puso á Ephraim delante de Manasés.

verses.KJV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
verses.WEB: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
verses.ASV: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God will be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Israel a José: Eis que eu morro, mas Deus será convosco, e vos fará voltar à terra de vossos pais.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Israel á José: He aquí, yo muero, mas Dios será con vosotros, y os hará volver á la tierra de vuestros padres.

verses.KJV: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
verses.WEB: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”
verses.ASV: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu dei a ti uma parte sobre teus irmãos, a qual tomei eu da mão dos amorreus com minha espada e com meu arco.
verses.RVR09: Y yo te he dado á ti una parte sobre tus hermanos, la cual tomé yo de mano del Amorrheo con mi espada y con mi arco.

verses.KJV: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
verses.WEB: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
verses.ASV: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said: Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the latter days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Jacó a seus filhos, e disse: Juntai-vos, e vos declararei o que vos há de acontecer nos últimos dias.
verses.RVR09: Y LLAMÓ Jacob á sus hijos, y dijo: Juntaos, y os declararé lo que os ha de acontecer en los postreros días.

verses.KJV: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
verses.WEB: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
verses.ASV: Assemble yourselves, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; And hearken unto Israel your father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Juntai-vos e ouvi, filhos de Jacó; E escutai a vosso pai Israel.
verses.RVR09: Juntaos y oid, hijos de Jacob; y escuchad á vuestro padre Israel.

verses.KJV: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
verses.WEB: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
verses.ASV: Reuben, thou art my first-born, my might, and the beginning of my strength; The pre-eminence of dignity, and the pre-eminence of power.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rúben, tu és meu primogênito, minha força, e o princípio do meu vigor; Principal em dignidade, principal em poder.
verses.RVR09: Rubén, tú eres mi primogénito, mi fortaleza, y el principio de mi vigor; principal en dignidad, principal en poder.

verses.KJV: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
verses.WEB: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.
verses.ASV: Boiling over as water, thou shalt not have the pre-eminence; Because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; Then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
verses.ALMEIDA: Corrente como as águas, não sejas o principal; Porquanto subiste ao leito de teu pai: Então te contaminaste, subindo a meu estrado.
verses.RVR09: Corriente como las aguas, no seas el principal; por cuanto subiste al lecho de tu padre: entonces te envileciste, subiendo á mi estrado.

verses.KJV: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
verses.WEB: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
verses.ASV: Simeon and Levi are brethren; Weapons of violence are their swords.
verses.ALMEIDA: Simeão e Levi, irmãos: Armas de violência são suas armas.
verses.RVR09: Simeón y Leví, hermanos: armas de iniquidad sus armas.

verses.KJV: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
verses.WEB: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
verses.ASV: O my soul, come not thou into their council; Unto their assembly, my glory, be not thou united; For in their anger they slew a man, And in their self-will they hocked an ox.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seu secreto não entre minha alma, nem minha honra se junte em sua companhia; Que em seu furor mataram homem, E em sua vontade aleijaram bois.
verses.RVR09: En su secreto no entre mi alma, ni mi honra se junte en su compañía; que en su furor mataron varón, y en su voluntad arrancaron muro.

verses.KJV: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
verses.WEB: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
verses.ASV: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; And their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, And scatter them in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito seu furor, que foi bravio; E sua ira, que foi dura: Eu os dividirei em Jacó, E os espalharei em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Maldito su furor, que fué fiero; y su ira, que fué dura: yo los apartaré en Jacob, y los esparciré en Israel.

verses.KJV: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
verses.WEB: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
verses.ASV: Judah, thee shall thy brethren praise: Thy hand shall be on the neck of thine enemies; Thy father’s sons shall bow down before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Judá, teus irmãos te louvarão: Tua mão esterá sobre o pescoço de teus inimigos: Os filhos de teu pai se inclinarão a ti.
verses.RVR09: Judá, alabarte han tus hermanos: tu mano en la cerviz de tus enemigos: los hijos de tu padre se inclinarán á ti.

verses.KJV: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verses.WEB: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
verses.ASV: Judah is a lion’s whelp; From the prey, my son, thou art gone up: He stooped down, he couched as a lion, And as a lioness; who shall rouse him up?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jovem leão é Judá: Da presa subiste, filho meu: Encurvou-se, lançou-se como leão, Assim como leão velho; quem o despertará?
verses.RVR09: Cachorro de león Judá: de la presa subiste, hijo mío: encorvóse, echóse como león, así como león viejo; ¿quién lo despertará?

verses.KJV: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
verses.WEB: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.
verses.ASV: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, Nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, Until Shiloh come; And unto him shall the obedience of the peoples be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não será tirado o cetro de Judá, E o legislador dentre seus pés, Até que venha Siló; E a ele se congregarão os povos.
verses.RVR09: No será quitado el cetro de Judá, y el legislador de entre sus piés, hasta que venga Shiloh; y á él se congregarán los pueblos.

verses.KJV: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
verses.WEB: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
verses.ASV: Binding his foal unto the vine, And his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; He hath washed his garments in wine, And his vesture in the blood of grapes:
verses.ALMEIDA: Atando à vide seu jumentinho, E à videira o filho de sua jumenta, Lavou no veio sua roupa, E no sangue de uvas seu manto:
verses.RVR09: Atando á la vid su pollino, y á la cepa el hijo de su asna, lavó en el vino su vestido, y en la sangre de uvas su manto:

verses.KJV: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
verses.WEB: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
verses.ASV: His eyes shall be red with wine, And his teeth white with milk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus olhos mais vermelhos que o vinho, E os dentes mais brancos que o leite.
verses.RVR09: Sus ojos bermejos del vino, y los dientes blancos de la leche.

verses.KJV: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
verses.WEB: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
verses.ASV: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; And he shall be for a haven of ships; And his border shall be upon Sidon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Zebulom em portos de mar habitará, E será para porto de navios; E seu termo até Sidom.
verses.RVR09: Zabulón en puertos de mar habitará, y será para puerto de navíos; y su término hasta Sidón.

verses.KJV: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
verses.WEB: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
verses.ASV: Issachar is a strong ass, Couching down between the sheepfolds:
verses.ALMEIDA: Issacar, asno de forte estrutura deitado entre dois apriscos:
verses.RVR09: Issachâr, asno huesudo echado entre dos tercios:

verses.KJV: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
verses.WEB: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
verses.ASV: And he saw a resting-place that it was good, And the land that it was pleasant; And he bowed his shoulder to bear, And became a servant under taskwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu que o descanso era bom, E que a terra era deleitosa; E baixou seu ombro para levar, E serviu em tributo.
verses.RVR09: Y vió que el descanso era bueno, y que la tierra era deleitosa; y bajó su hombro para llevar, y sirvió en tributo.

verses.KJV: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.WEB: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.ASV: Dan shall judge his people, As one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dã julgará a seu povo, Como uma das tribos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Dan juzgará á su pueblo, como una de las tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
verses.WEB: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.
verses.ASV: Dan shall be a serpent in the way, An adder in the path, That biteth the horse’s heels, So that his rider falleth backward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será Dã serpente junto ao caminho, víbora junto à vereda, que morde os calcanhares dos cavalos, e faz cair por detrás ao cavaleiro deles.
verses.RVR09: Será Dan serpiente junto al camino, cerasta junto á la senda, que muerde los talones de los caballos, y hace caer por detrás al cabalgador de ellos.

verses.KJV: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.
verses.WEB: I have waited for your salvation, LORD.
verses.ASV: I have waited for thy salvation, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua salvação espero, ó SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Tu salud esperé, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
verses.WEB: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
verses.ASV: Gad, a troop shall press upon him; But he shall press upon their heel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gade, exército o atacará; mas ele contra-atacará ao fim.
verses.RVR09: Gad, ejército lo acometerá; mas él acometerá al fin.

verses.KJV: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.WEB: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
verses.ASV: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, And he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pão de Aser será espesso, E ele dará deleites ao rei.
verses.RVR09: El pan de Aser será grueso, y él dará deleites al rey.

verses.KJV: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
verses.WEB: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
verses.ASV: Naphtali is a hind let loose: He giveth goodly words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naftali, serva solta, que diz belas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Nephtalí, sierva dejada, que dará dichos hermosos.

verses.KJV: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
verses.WEB: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
verses.ASV: Joseph is a fruitful bough, A fruitful bough by a fountain; His branches run over the wall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ramo frutífero é José, ramo frutífero é junto à fonte, cujos ramos se estendem sobre o muro;
verses.RVR09: Ramo fructífero José, ramo fructífero junto á fuente, cuyos vástagos se extienden sobre el muro.

verses.KJV: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
verses.WEB: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:
verses.ASV: The archers have sorely grieved him, And shot at him, and persecuted him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E causaram-lhe amargura, e flecharam-lhe, e os arqueiros o odiaram;
verses.RVR09: Y causáronle amargura, y asaeteáronle, y aborreciéronle los archeros:

verses.KJV: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
verses.WEB: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
verses.ASV: But his bow abode in strength, And the arms of his hands were made strong, By the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob (From thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas seu arco manteve-se forte, E os braços de suas mãos se fortaleceram pelas mãos do Forte de Jacó, (Dali é o Pastor, e a Pedra de Israel,)
verses.RVR09: Mas su arco quedó en fortaleza, y los brazos de sus manos se corroboraron por las manos del Fuerte de Jacob, (de allí el pastor, y la piedra de Israel,)

verses.KJV: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
verses.WEB: even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
verses.ASV: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee, And by the Almighty, who shall bless thee, With blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that coucheth beneath, Blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do Deus de teu pai, o qual te ajudará, E do Todo-Poderoso, o qual te abençoará com bênçãos dos céus de acima, com bênçãos do abismo que está abaixo, Com bênçãos do seio e da madre.
verses.RVR09: Del Dios de tu padre, el cual te ayudará, y del Omnipotente, el cual te bendecirá con bendiciones de los cielos de arriba, con bendiciones del abismo que está abajo, con bendiciones del seno y de la matriz.

verses.KJV: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
verses.WEB: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.
verses.ASV: The blessings of thy father Have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors Unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: As bênçãos de teu pai Foram maiores que as bênçãos de meus progenitores: Até o termo das colinas eternas serão sobre a cabeça de José, E sobre o topo da cabeça do que foi separado de seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Las bendiciones de tu padre fueron mayores que las bendiciones de mis progenitores: hasta el término de los collados eternos serán sobre la cabeza de José, y sobre la mollera del Nazareo de sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
verses.WEB: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”
verses.ASV: Benjamin is a wolf that raveneth: In the morning he shall devour the prey, And at even he shall divide the spoil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benjamim, lobo arrebatador; de manhã comerá a presa, e à tarde repartirá os despojos.
verses.RVR09: Benjamín, lobo arrebatador: á la mañana comerá la presa, y á la tarde repartirá los despojos.

verses.KJV: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
verses.WEB: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.
verses.ASV: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes foram as doze tribos de Israel: e isto foi o que seu pai lhes disse, e os abençoou; a cada um por sua bênção os abençoou.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos fueron las doce tribus de Israel: y esto fué lo que su padre les dijo, y bendíjolos; á cada uno por su bendición los bendijo.

verses.KJV: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.WEB: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.ASV: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mandou-lhes logo, e disse-lhes: Eu vou a ser reunido com meu povo: sepultai-me com meus pais na caverna que está no campo de Efrom os heteus;
verses.RVR09: Mandóles luego, y díjoles: Yo voy á ser reunido con mi pueblo: sepultadme con mis padres en la cueva que está en el campo de Ephrón el Hetheo;

verses.KJV: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
verses.WEB: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
verses.ASV: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a burying-place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na caverna que está no campo de Macpela, que está diante de Manre na terra de Canaã, a qual comprou Abraão com o mesmo campo de Efrom os heteus, para herança de sepultura.
verses.RVR09: En la cueva que está en el campo de Macpela, que está delante de Mamre en la tierra de Canaán, la cual compró Abraham con el mismo campo de Ephrón el Hetheo, para heredad de sepultura.

verses.KJV: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
verses.WEB: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
verses.ASV: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah—
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali sepultaram a Abraão e a Sara sua mulher; ali sepultaram a Isaque e a Rebeca sua mulher; ali também sepultei Lia.
verses.RVR09: Allí sepultaron á Abraham y á Sara su mujer; allí sepultaron á Isaac y á Rebeca su mujer; allí también sepulté yo á Lea.

verses.KJV: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
verses.WEB: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
verses.ASV: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O campo e a cova que nele está foram comprados dos filhos de Hete.
verses.RVR09: La compra del campo y de la cueva que está en él, fué de los hijos de Heth.

verses.KJV: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.WEB: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.
verses.ASV: And when Jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando acabou Jacó de dar ordens a seus filhos, encolheu seus pés na cama, e expirou; e foi reunido com seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y como acabó Jacob de dar órdenes á sus hijos, encogió sus pies en la cama, y espiró: y fué reunido con sus padres.

verses.KJV: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
verses.WEB: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.
verses.ASV: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se lançou José sobre o rosto de seu pai, e chorou sobre ele, e o beijou.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES se echó José sobre el rostro de su padre, y lloró sobre él, y besólo.

verses.KJV: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.WEB: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.ASV: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou José a seus servos médicos que embalsamassem a seu pai; e os médicos embalsamaram a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó José á sus médicos familiares que embalsamasen á su padre: y los médicos embalsamaron á Israel.

verses.KJV: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
verses.WEB: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.
verses.ASV: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of embalming: and the Egyptians wept for him threescore and ten days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cumpriam-lhe quarenta dias, porque assim cumpriam os dias dos embalsamados, e choraram-no os egípcios setenta dias.
verses.RVR09: Y cumpliéronle cuarenta días, porque así cumplían los días de los embalsamados, y lloráronlo los Egipcios setenta días.

verses.KJV: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.WEB: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.ASV: And when the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found favor in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E passados os dias de seu luto, falou José aos da casa de Faraó, dizendo: Se achei agora favor em vossos olhos, vos rogo que faleis aos ouvidos de Faraó, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y pasados los días de su luto, habló José á los de la casa de Faraón, diciendo: Si he hallado ahora gracia en vuestros ojos, os ruego que habléis en oídos de Faraón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
verses.WEB: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”
verses.ASV: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu pai me fez jurar dizendo: Eis que eu morro; em meu sepulcro que eu cavei para mim na terra de Canaã, ali me sepultarás; rogo, pois, que vá eu agora, e sepultarei a meu pai, e voltarei.
verses.RVR09: Mi padre me conjuró diciendo: He aquí yo muero; en mi sepulcro que yo cavé para mí en la tierra de Canaán, allí me sepultarás; ruego pues que vaya yo ahora, y sepultaré á mi padre, y volveré.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Faraó disse: Vai, e sepulta a teu pai, como ele te fez jurar.
verses.RVR09: Y Faraón dijo: Ve, y sepulta á tu padre, como él te conjuró.

verses.KJV: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.WEB: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.ASV: And Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então José subiu a sepultar a seu pai; e subiram com ele todos os servos de Faraó, os anciãos de sua casa, e todos os anciãos da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces José subió á sepultar á su padre; y subieron con él todos los siervos de Faraón, los ancianos de su casa, y todos los ancianos de la tierra de Egipto,

verses.KJV: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.WEB: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.ASV: and all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a casa de José, e seus irmãos, e a casa de seu pai: somente deixaram na terra de Gósen seus filhos, e suas ovelhas e suas vacas.
verses.RVR09: Y toda la casa de José, y sus hermanos, y la casa de su padre: solamente dejaron en la tierra de Gosén sus niños, y sus ovejas y sus vacas.

verses.KJV: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
verses.WEB: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company.
verses.ASV: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiram também com ele carros e cavaleiros, e fez-se um esquadrão muito grande.
verses.RVR09: Y subieron también con él carros y gente de á caballo, é hízose un escuadrón muy grande.

verses.KJV: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
verses.WEB: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.
verses.ASV: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram até a eira de Atade, que está à outra parte do Jordão, e lamentaram ali com grande e muito grave lamentação: e José fez a seu pai luto por sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Y llegaron hasta la era de Atad, que está á la otra parte del Jordán, y endecharon allí con grande y muy grave lamentación: y José hizo á su padre duelo por siete días.

verses.KJV: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
verses.WEB: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo os moradores da terra, os cananeus, o pranto na eira de Atade, disseram: Pranto grande é este dos egípcios: por isso foi chamado seu nome Abel-Mizraim, que está à outra parte do Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo los moradores de la tierra, los Cananeos, el llanto en la era de Atad, dijeron: Llanto grande es este de los Egipcios: por eso fué llamado su nombre Abelmizraim, que está á la otra parte del Jordán.

verses.KJV: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
verses.WEB: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,
verses.ASV: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram, pois, seus filhos com ele, segundo lhes havia mandado:
verses.RVR09: Hicieron, pues, sus hijos con él, según les había mandado:

verses.KJV: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
verses.WEB: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.
verses.ASV: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burying-place, of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois seus filhos o levaram à terra de Canaã, e o sepultaram na caverna do campo de Macpela, a que havia comprado Abraão com o mesmo campo, para herança de sepultura, de Efrom o heteu, diante de Manre.
verses.RVR09: Pues lleváronlo sus hijos á la tierra de Canaán, y le sepultaron en la cueva del campo de Macpela, la que había comprado Abraham con el mismo campo, para heredad de sepultura, de Ephrón el Hetheo, delante de Mamre.

verses.KJV: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.WEB: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.ASV: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou José ao Egito, ele e seus irmãos, e todos os que subiram com ele a sepultar a seu pai, depois que o sepultou.
verses.RVR09: Y tornóse José á Egipto, él y sus hermanos, y todos los que subieron con él á sepultar á su padre, después que le hubo sepultado.

verses.KJV: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
verses.WEB: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”
verses.ASV: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo os irmãos de José que seu pai era morto, disseram: Talvez José nos odeie, e nos retribua de todo o mal que lhe fizemos.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo los hermanos de José que su padre era muerto, dijeron: Quizá nos aborrecerá José, y nos dará el pago de todo el mal que le hicimos.

verses.KJV: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
verses.WEB: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,
verses.ASV: And they sent a message unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviaram a dizer a José: Teu pai mandou antes de sua morte, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y enviaron á decir á José: Tu padre mandó antes de su muerte, diciendo:

verses.KJV: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
verses.WEB: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
verses.ASV: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the transgression of thy brethren, and their sin, for that they did unto thee evil. And now, we pray thee, forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim direis a José: Rogo-te que perdoes agora a maldade de teus irmãos e seu pecado, porque mal te trataram: portanto agora te rogamos que perdoes a maldade dos servos do Deus de teu pai. E José chorou enquanto falavam.
verses.RVR09: Así diréis á José: Ruégote que perdones ahora la maldad de tus hermanos y su pecado, porque mal te trataron: por tanto ahora te rogamos que perdones la maldad de los siervos del Dios de tu padre. Y José lloró mientras hablaban.

verses.KJV: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
verses.WEB: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”
verses.ASV: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we are thy servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram também seus irmãos, e prostraram-se diante dele, e disseram: Eis-nos aqui por teus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron también sus hermanos, y postráronse delante de él, y dijeron: Henos aquí por tus siervos.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
verses.WEB: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhes José: Não temais: estou eu em lugar de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Y respondióles José: No temáis: ¿estoy yo en lugar de Dios?

verses.KJV: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
verses.WEB: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
verses.ASV: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós pensastes mal sobre mim, mas Deus o encaminhou para o bem, para fazer o que vemos hoje, para manter em vida muito povo.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros pensasteis mal sobre mí, mas Dios lo encaminó á bien, para hacer lo que vemos hoy, para mantener en vida á mucho pueblo.

verses.KJV: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
verses.WEB: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.
verses.ASV: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, não tenhais medo; eu sustentarei a vós e a vossos filhos. Assim os consolou, e lhes falou ao coração.
verses.RVR09: Ahora, pues, no tengáis miedo; yo os sustentaré á vosotros y á vuestros hijos. Así los consoló, y les habló al corazón.

verses.KJV: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
verses.WEB: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
verses.ASV: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esteve José no Egito, ele e a casa de seu pai; e viveu José cento dez anos.
verses.RVR09: Y estuvo José en Egipto, él y la casa de su padre: y vivió José ciento diez años.

verses.KJV: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.
verses.WEB: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.
verses.ASV: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were born upon Joseph’s knees.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu José os filhos de Efraim até a terceira geração: também os filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, foram criados sobre os joelhos de José.
verses.RVR09: Y vió José los hijos de Ephraim hasta la tercera generación: también los hijos de Machîr, hijo de Manasés, fueron criados sobre las rodillas de José.

verses.KJV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.WEB: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die; but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E José disse a seus irmãos: Eu me morro; mas Deus certamente vos visitará, e vos fará subir desta terra à terra que jurou a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y José dijo á sus hermanos: Yo me muero; mas Dios ciertamente os visitará, y os hará subir de aquesta tierra á la tierra que juró á Abraham, á Isaac, y á Jacob.

verses.KJV: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
verses.WEB: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”
verses.ASV: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez jurar José aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Deus certamente vos visitará, e fareis levar daqui meus ossos.
verses.RVR09: Y conjuró José á los hijos de Israel, diciendo: Dios ciertamente os visitará, y haréis llevar de aquí mis huesos.

verses.KJV: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.WEB: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.ASV: So Joseph died, being a hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu José da idade de cento e dez anos; e embalsamaram-no, e foi posto num caixão no Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y murió José de edad de ciento diez años; y embalsamáronlo, y fué puesto en un ataúd en Egipto.

verses.KJV: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
verses.WEB: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):
verses.ASV: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Israel que entraram em Egito com Jacó; cada um entrou com sua família:
verses.RVR09: ESTOS son los nombres de los hijos de Israel, que entraron en Egipto con Jacob; cada uno entró con su familia.

verses.KJV: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.WEB: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.ASV: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Rúben, Simeão, Levi e Judá;
verses.RVR09: Rubén, Simeón, Leví y Judá;

verses.KJV: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.WEB: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.ASV: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.ALMEIDA: Issacar, Zebulom e Benjamim;
verses.RVR09: Issachâr, Zabulón y Benjamín;

verses.KJV: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.WEB: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
verses.ASV: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dã e Naftali, Gade e Aser.
verses.RVR09: Dan y Nephtalí, Gad y Aser.

verses.KJV: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
verses.WEB: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
verses.ASV: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: and Joseph was in Egypt already.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, todas as pessoas que descenderam do corpo de Jacó foram setenta. Porém José estava no Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las almas de los que salieron del muslo de Jacob, fueron setenta. Y José estaba en Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
verses.WEB: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.
verses.ASV: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois que morreram José, todos os seus irmãos, e toda aquela geração,
verses.RVR09: Y murió José, y todos sus hermanos, y toda aquella generación.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: os filhos de Israel cresceram e multiplicaram, e foram aumentados e fortalecidos grandemente; de maneira que a terra encheu-se deles.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Israel crecieron, y multiplicaron, y fueron aumentados y corroborados en extremo; y llenóse la tierra de ellos.

verses.KJV: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
verses.WEB: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
verses.ASV: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who knew not Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantou-se, entretanto, um novo rei sobre o Egito, que não conhecia José.
verses.RVR09: Levantóse entretanto un nuevo rey sobre Egipto, que no conocía á José; el cual dijo á su pueblo:

verses.KJV: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
verses.WEB: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
verses.ASV: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele disse ao seu povo: Eis que o povo dos filhos de Israel é maior e mais forte que nós;
verses.RVR09: He aquí, el pueblo de los hijos de Israel es mayor y más fuerte que nosotros:

verses.KJV: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
verses.WEB: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”
verses.ASV: come, let us deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they also join themselves unto our enemies, and fight against us, and get them up out of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, sejamos astutos para com ele, a fim de que não se multiplique, e aconteça que caso venha guerra, ele se alie aos nossos inimigos, lute contra nós, e saia desta terra.
verses.RVR09: Ahora, pues, seamos sabios para con él, porque no se multiplique, y acontezca que viniendo guerra, él también se junte con nuestros enemigos, y pelee contra nosotros, y se vaya de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.WEB: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.
verses.ASV: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh store-cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então puseram sobre [o povo de Israel] capatazes para os oprimirem com trabalhos forçados; e edificaram a Faraó as cidades de armazenamento, Pitom e Ramessés.
verses.RVR09: Entonces pusieron sobre él comisarios de tributos que los molestasen con sus cargas; y edificaron á Faraón las ciudades de los bastimentos, Phithom y Raamses.

verses.KJV: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread abroad. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, quanto mais os oprimiam, mais se multiplicavam e cresciam. Por isso eles detestavam os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Empero cuanto más los oprimían, tanto más se multiplicaban y crecían: así que estaban ellos fastidiados de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
verses.WEB: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,
verses.ASV: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigor:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os egípcios fizeram os filhos de Israel servirem duramente,
verses.RVR09: Y los Egipcios hicieron servir á los hijos de Israel con dureza:

verses.KJV: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
verses.WEB: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.
verses.ASV: and they made their lives bitter with hard service, in mortar and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field, all their service, wherein they made them serve with rigor.
verses.ALMEIDA: e amargaram a vida deles com dura servidão, em fazerem barro e tijolos, em todo trabalho do campo, e em todo o seu serviço, ao qual os obrigavam com rigor.
verses.RVR09: Y amargaron su vida con dura servidumbre, en hacer barro y ladrillo, y en toda labor del campo, y en todo su servicio, al cual los obligaban con rigorismo.

verses.KJV: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
verses.WEB: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,
verses.ASV: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei do Egito falou às parteiras das hebreias, uma das quais se chamava Sifrá, e outra Puá, e disse-lhes:
verses.RVR09: Y habló el rey de Egipto á las parteras de las Hebreas, una de las cuales se llamaba Siphra, y otra Phúa, y díjoles:

verses.KJV: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
verses.WEB: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”
verses.ASV: and he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the birth-stool; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him; but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando fizerdes o parto das hebreias, e olhardes os assentos, se for filho, matai-o; e se for filha, então viva.
verses.RVR09: Cuando parteareis á las Hebreas, y mirareis los asientos, si fuere hijo, matadlo; y si fuere hija, entonces viva.

verses.KJV: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
verses.WEB: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
verses.ASV: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men-children alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas as parteiras temeram a Deus, e não fizeram como o rei do Egito lhes mandara; em vez disso, preservaram a vida dos meninos.
verses.RVR09: Mas las parteras temieron á Dios, y no hicieron como les mandó el rey de Egipto, sino que reservaban la vida á los niños.

verses.KJV: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
verses.WEB: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”
verses.ASV: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men-children alive?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei do Egito mandou chamar às parteiras e lhes perguntou: Por que fizestes isto, que preservastes a vida dos meninos?
verses.RVR09: Y el rey de Egipto hizo llamar á las parteras, y díjoles: Por qué habéis hecho esto, que habéis reservado la vida á los niños?

verses.KJV: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
verses.WEB: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”
verses.ASV: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwife come unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: As parteiras responderam a Faraó: As mulheres hebreias não são como as egípcias; pois são fortes, de maneira que dão à luz antes que a parteira chegue a elas.
verses.RVR09: Y las parteras respondieron á Faraón: Porque las mujeres Hebreas no son como las Egipcias: porque son robustas, y paren antes que la partera venga á ellas.

verses.KJV: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
verses.WEB: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.
verses.ASV: And God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Deus fez bem às parteiras. E o povo se multiplicou, e se fortaleceu muito.
verses.RVR09: Y Dios hizo bien á las parteras: y el pueblo se multiplicó, y se corroboraron en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
verses.WEB: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them households.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por as parteiras terem temido a Deus, ele constituiu famílias a elas.
verses.RVR09: Y por haber las parteras temido á Dios, él les hizo casas.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó deu a todo o seu povo a seguinte ordem: Lançai no rio todo filho que nascer, e a toda filha preservai a vida.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón mandó á todo su pueblo, diciendo: Echad en el río todo hijo que naciere, y á toda hija reservad la vida.

verses.KJV: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
verses.WEB: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.
verses.ASV: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um homem da família de Levi foi, e tomou por mulher uma filha de Levi:
verses.RVR09: UN varón de la familia de Leví fué, y tomó por mujer una hija de Leví:

verses.KJV: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
verses.WEB: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
verses.ASV: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual concebeu, e deu à luz um filho: e vendo-o que era belo, teve-lhe escondido três meses.
verses.RVR09: La cual concibió, y parió un hijo: y viéndolo que era hermoso, túvole escondido tres meses.

verses.KJV: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.
verses.WEB: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
verses.ASV: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch; and she put the child therein, and laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não podendo ocultar-lhe mais tempo, tomou uma cesta de juncos, e vedou-a com piche e betume, e colocou nela ao menino, e o pôs entre os juncos à beira do rio:
verses.RVR09: Pero no pudiendo ocultarle más tiempo, tomó una arquilla de juncos, y calafateóla con pez y betún, y colocó en ella al niño, y púsolo en un carrizal á la orilla del río:

verses.KJV: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
verses.WEB: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.
verses.ASV: And his sister stood afar off, to know what would be done to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficou parada uma irmã sua ao longe, para ver o que lhe aconteceria.
verses.RVR09: Y paróse una hermana suya á lo lejos, para ver lo que le acontecería.

verses.KJV: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.
verses.ASV: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river-side; and she saw the ark among the flags, and sent her handmaid to fetch it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a filha de Faraó desceu a lavar-se ao rio, e passeando suas virgens pela beira do rio, viu ela a cesta entre os juncos, e enviou uma criada sua a que a tomasse.
verses.RVR09: Y la hija de Faraón descendió á lavarse al río, y paseándose sus doncellas por la ribera del río, vió ella la arquilla en el carrizal, y envió una criada suya á que la tomase.

verses.KJV: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
verses.WEB: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
verses.ASV: And she opened it, and saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando a abriu, viu ao menino; e eis que o menino chorava. E tendo compaixão dele, disse: Dos meninos dos hebreus é este.
verses.RVR09: Y como la abrió, vió al niño; y he aquí que el niño lloraba. Y teniendo compasión de él, dijo: De los niños de los Hebreos es éste.

verses.KJV: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
verses.WEB: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”
verses.ASV: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então sua irmã disse à filha de Faraó: Irei a chamar-te uma ama das hebreias, para que te crie este menino?
verses.RVR09: Entonces su hermana dijo á la hija de Faraón: ¿Iré á llamarte un ama de las Hebreas, para que te críe este niño?

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maiden went and called the child’s mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a filha de Faraó respondeu: Vai. Então foi a virgem, e chamou à mãe do menino;
verses.RVR09: Y la hija de Faraón respondió: Ve. Entonces fué la doncella, y llamó á la madre del niño;

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the women took the child, and nursed it.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed him.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
verses.ALMEIDA: À qual disse a filha de Faraó: Leva este menino, e cria-o para mim, e eu te o pagarei. E a mulher tomou ao menino, e o criou.
verses.RVR09: A la cual dijo la hija de Faraón: Lleva este niño, y críamelo, y yo te lo pagaré. Y la mujer tomó al niño, y criólo.

verses.KJV: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
verses.WEB: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”
verses.ASV: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses, and said, Because I drew him out of the water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando cresceu o menino, ela o trouxe à filha de Faraó, a qual o adotou, e pôs-lhe por nome Moisés, dizendo: Porque das águas o tirei.
verses.RVR09: Y como creció el niño, ella lo trajo á la hija de Faraón, la cual lo prohijó, y púsole por nombre Moisés, diciendo: Porque de las aguas lo saqué.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
verses.WEB: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown up, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he saw an Egyptian smiting a Hebrew, one of his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naqueles dias aconteceu que, crescido já Moisés, saiu a seus irmãos, e viu suas cargas: e observou a um egípcio que feria a um dos hebreus, seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y en aquellos días acaeció que, crecido ya Moisés, salió á sus hermanos, y vió sus cargas: y observó á un Egipcio que hería á uno de los Hebreos, sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
verses.WEB: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
verses.ASV: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he smote the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhou a todas as partes, e vendo que não parecia ninguém, matou ao egípcio, e escondeu-o na areia.
verses.RVR09: Y miró á todas partes, y viendo que no parecía nadie, mató al Egipcio, y escondiólo en la arena.

verses.KJV: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
verses.WEB: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”
verses.ASV: And he went out the second day, and, behold, two men of the Hebrews were striving together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu ao dia seguinte, e vendo a dois hebreus que brigavam, disse ao que fazia a injúria: Por que feres a teu próximo?
verses.RVR09: Y salió al día siguiente, y viendo á dos Hebreos que reñían, dijo al que hacía la injuria: ¿Por qué hieres á tu prójimo?

verses.KJV: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
verses.WEB: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? thinkest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely the thing is known.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Quem te pôs a ti por príncipe e juiz sobre nós? Pensas matar-me como mataste ao egípcio? Então Moisés teve medo, e disse: Certamente esta coisa é descoberta.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: ¿Quién te ha puesto á ti por príncipe y juez sobre nosotros? ¿piensas matarme como mataste al Egipcio? Entonces Moisés tuvo miedo, y dijo: Ciertamente esta cosa es descubierta.

verses.KJV: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
verses.WEB: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.
verses.ASV: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo Faraó este negócio, procurou matar a Moisés: mas Moisés fugiu de diante de Faraó, e habitou na terra de Midiã; e sentou-se junto a um poço.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo Faraón este negocio, procuró matar á Moisés: mas Moisés huyó de delante de Faraón, y habitó en la tierra de Madián; y sentóse junto á un pozo.

verses.KJV: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.
verses.WEB: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
verses.ASV: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tinha o sacerdote de Midiã sete filhas, as quais vieram a tirar água, para encher os bebedouros e dar de beber as ovelhas de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Tenía el sacerdote de Madián siete hijas, las cuales vinieron á sacar agua, para llenar las pilas y dar de beber á las ovejas de su padre.

verses.KJV: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.WEB: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.ASV: And the shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os pastores vieram, e expulsaram-nas: Então Moisés se levantou e defendeu-as, e deu de beber às suas ovelhas.
