verses.RVR09: Mas los pastores vinieron, y echáronlas: Entonces Moisés se levantó y defendiólas, y abrevó sus ovejas.

verses.KJV: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?
verses.WEB: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
verses.ASV: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to-day?
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltando elas a Reuel seu pai, disse-lhes ele: Por que viestes hoje tão cedo?
verses.RVR09: Y volviendo ellas á Ragüel su padre, díjoles él: ¿Por qué habéis hoy venido tan presto?

verses.KJV: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
verses.WEB: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”
verses.ASV: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: E elas responderam: Um homem egípcio nos defendeu da mão dos pastores, e também tirou a água, e deu de beber as as ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y ellas respondieron: Un varón Egipcio nos defendió de mano de los pastores, y también nos sacó el agua, y abrevó las ovejas.

verses.KJV: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
verses.WEB: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a suas filhas: E onde está? Por que deixastes esse homem? Chamai-lhe para que coma pão.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á sus hijas: ¿Y dónde está? ¿por qué habéis dejado ese hombre? llamadle para que coma pan.

verses.KJV: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
verses.WEB: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
verses.ASV: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés concordou em morar com aquele homem; e ele deu a Moisés a sua filha Zípora:
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés acordó en morar con aquel varón; y él dió á Moisés á su hija Séphora:

verses.KJV: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
verses.WEB: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
verses.ASV: And she bare a son, and he called his name Gershom; for he said, I have been a sojourner in a foreign land.
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual lhe deu à luz um filho, e ele lhe pôs por nome Gérson: porque disse: Peregrino sou em terra alheia.
verses.RVR09: La cual le parió un hijo, y él le puso por nombre Gersom: porque dijo: Peregrino soy en tierra ajena.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
verses.WEB: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the course of those many days, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que depois de muitos dias morreu o rei do Egito, e os filhos de Israel suspiraram por causa da servidão, e clamaram: e subiu a Deus o clamor deles com motivo de sua servidão.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que después de muchos días murió el rey de Egipto, y los hijos de Israel suspiraron á causa de la servidumbre, y clamaron: y subió á Dios el clamor de ellos con motivo de su servidumbre.

verses.KJV: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.WEB: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.ASV: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Deus o gemido deles, e lembrou-se de seu pacto com Abraão, Isaque e Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Dios el gemido de ellos, y acordóse de su pacto con Abraham, Isaac y Jacob.

verses.KJV: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.
verses.WEB: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.
verses.ASV: And God saw the children of Israel, and God took knowledge [of them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus olhou os filhos de Israel, e Deus os reconheceu.
verses.RVR09: Y miró Dios á los hijos de Israel, y reconociólos Dios.

verses.KJV: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
verses.WEB: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.
verses.ASV: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to the mountain of God, unto Horeb.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apascentando Moisés as ovelhas de Jetro seu sogro, sacerdote de Midiã, levou as ovelhas ao outro lado do deserto, e veio a Horebe, monte de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y APACENTANDO Moisés las ovejas de Jethro su suegro, sacerdote de Madián, llevó las ovejas detrás del desierto, y vino á Horeb, monte de Dios.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apareceu-lhe o anjo do SENHOR em uma chama de fogo em meio de uma sarça: e ele olhou, e viu que a sarça ardia em fogo, e a sarça não se consumia.
verses.RVR09: Y apareciósele el Angel de Jehová en una llama de fuego en medio de una zarza: y él miró, y vió que la zarza ardía en fuego, y la zarza no se consumía.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said, I will turn aside now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés disse: Irei eu agora, e verei esta grande visão, por que causa a sarça não se queima.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés dijo: Iré yo ahora, y veré esta grande visión, por qué causa la zarza no se quema.

verses.KJV: And when the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
verses.WEB: When the LORD saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.ASV: And when Jehovah saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o SENHOR viu que ia ver, Deus o chamou do meio da sarça, e disse: Moisés, Moisés! E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Jehová que iba á ver, llamólo Dios de en medio de la zarza, y dijo: ¡Moisés, Moisés! Y él respondió: Heme aquí.

verses.KJV: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
verses.WEB: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Não te aproximes daqui; tira teus calçados de teus pés, porque o lugar em que estás é terra santa.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: No te llegues acá: quita tus zapatos de tus pies, porque el lugar en que tú estás, tierra santa es.

verses.KJV: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
verses.WEB: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.
verses.ASV: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Eu sou o Deus de teu pai, Deus de Abraão, Deus de Isaque, Deus de Jacó. Então Moisés cobriu seu rosto, porque teve medo de olhar a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Yo soy el Dios de tu padre, Dios de Abraham, Dios de Isaac, Dios de Jacob. Entonces Moisés cubrió su rostro, porque tuvo miedo de mirar á Dios.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people that are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR: Vi a aflição do meu povo que está no Egito, e ouvi seu clamor por causa de seus opressores; pois conheço suas angústias.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová: Bien he visto la aflicción de mi pueblo que está en Egipto, y he oído su clamor á causa de sus exactores; pues tengo conocidas sus angustias:

verses.KJV: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.WEB: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.ASV: and I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso desci para livrá-los da mão dos egípcios, e tirá-los daquela terra, fazendo-os subir para uma terra boa e larga, para uma terra que flui leite e mel, para o lugar dos cananeus, dos heteus, dos amorreus, dos perizeus, dos heveus e dos jebuseus.
verses.RVR09: Y he descendido para librarlos de mano de los Egipcios, y sacarlos de aquella tierra á una tierra buena y ancha, á tierra que fluye leche y miel, á los lugares del Cananeo, del Hetheo, del Amorrheo, del Pherezeo, del Heveo, y del Jebuseo.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.WEB: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.ASV: And now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: moreover I have seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o clamor dos filhos de Israel veio a mim, e tenho visto a opressão com que os egípcios os oprimem.
verses.RVR09: El clamor, pues, de los hijos de Israel ha venido delante de mí, y también he visto la opresión con que los Egipcios los oprimen.

verses.KJV: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
verses.ASV: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vem, pois, agora, e te enviarei a Faraó, para que tires meu povo, os filhos de Israel, do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Ven por tanto ahora, y enviarte he á Faraón, para que saques á mi pueblo, los hijos de Israel, de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
verses.WEB: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés respondeu a Deus: Quem sou eu, para que vá a Faraó, e tire do Egito aos filhos de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés respondió á Dios: ¿Quién soy yo, para que vaya á Faraón, y saque de Egipto á los hijos de Israel?

verses.KJV: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
verses.WEB: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be the token unto thee, that I have sent thee: when thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe respondeu: Vai, porque eu serei contigo; e isto te será por sinal de que eu te enviei: logo que houveres tirado este povo do Egito, servireis a Deus sobre este monte.
verses.RVR09: Y él le respondió: Ve, porque yo seré contigo; y esto te será por señal de que yo te he enviado: luego que hubieres sacado este pueblo de Egipto, serviréis á Dios sobre este monte.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
verses.WEB: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? What shall I say unto them?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés a Deus: Eis que, quando eu chegar aos filhos de Israel, e lhes disser, O Deus de vossos pais me enviou a vós; se eles me perguntarem: Qual é seu nome? que lhes responderei?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Dios: He aquí que llego yo á los hijos de Israel, y les digo, El Dios de vuestros padres me ha enviado á vosotros; si ellos me preguntaren: ¿Cuál es su nombre? ¿qué les responderé?

verses.KJV: And God said unto Moses, I Am That I Am: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I Am hath sent me unto you.
verses.WEB: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
verses.ASV: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus respondeu a Moisés: EU SOU O QUE SOU. E disse: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: EU SOU me enviou a vós.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Dios á Moisés: YO SOY EL QUE SOY. Y dijo: Así dirás á los hijos de Israel: YO SOY me ha enviado á vosotros.

verses.KJV: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, the Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
verses.WEB: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.
verses.ASV: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, Jehovah, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse mais Deus a Moisés: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: o SENHOR, o Deus de vossos pais, o Deus de Abraão, Deus de Isaque e Deus de Jacó, me enviou a vós. Este é meu nome para sempre, este é meu memorial por todos os séculos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo más Dios á Moisés: Así dirás á los hijos de Israel: Jehová, el Dios de vuestros padres, el Dios de Abraham, Dios de Isaac y Dios de Jacob, me ha enviado á vosotros. Este es mi nombre para siempre, este es mi memorial por todos los siglos.

verses.KJV: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
verses.WEB: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.
verses.ASV: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, Jehovah, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, hath appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and [seen] that which is done to you in Egypt:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, e junta os anciãos de Israel, e dize-lhes: O SENHOR, o Deus de vossos pais, o Deus de Abraão, de Isaque, e de Jacó, me apareceu, dizendo: Certamente vos visitei, e vi o que se faz convosco no Egito;
verses.RVR09: Ve, y junta los ancianos de Israel, y diles: Jehová, el Dios de vuestros padres, el Dios de Abraham, de Isaac, y de Jacob, me apareció, diciendo: De cierto os he visitado, y visto lo que se os hace en Egipto;

verses.KJV: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.WEB: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’
verses.ASV: and I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Eu vos tirarei da aflição do Egito à terra dos cananeus, e dos heteus, e dos amorreus, e dos perizeus, e dos heveus, e dos jebuseus, a uma terra que flui leite e mel.
verses.RVR09: Y he dicho: Yo os sacaré de la aflicción de Egipto á la tierra del Cananeo, y del Hetheo, y del Amorrheo, y del Pherezeo, y del Heveo, y del Jebuseo, á una tierra que fluye leche y miel.

verses.KJV: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.
verses.WEB: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD, our God.’
verses.ASV: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, Jehovah, the God of the Hebrews, hath met with us: and now let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Jehovah our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvirão tua voz; e irás tu, e os anciãos de Israel, ao rei do Egito, e lhe direis: O SENHOR, o Deus dos hebreus, nos encontrou; portanto nós iremos agora caminho de três dias pelo deserto, para que sacrifiquemos ao SENHOR nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y oirán tu voz; é irás tú, y los ancianos de Israel, al rey de Egipto, y le diréis: Jehová, el Dios de los Hebreos, nos ha encontrado; por tanto nosotros iremos ahora camino de tres días por el desierto, para que sacrifiquemos á Jehová nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
verses.WEB: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.
verses.ASV: And I know that the king of Egypt will not give you leave to go, no, not by a mighty hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu sei que o rei do Egito não vos deixará ir a não ser por mão forte.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo sé que el rey de Egipto no os dejará ir sino por mano fuerte.

verses.KJV: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
verses.WEB: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.
verses.ASV: And I will put forth my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu estenderei minha mão, e ferirei ao Egito com todas minhas maravilhas que farei nele, e então vos deixará ir.
verses.RVR09: Empero yo extenderé mi mano, y heriré á Egipto con todas mis maravillas que haré en él, y entonces os dejará ir.

verses.KJV: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty.
verses.WEB: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.
verses.ASV: And I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu darei a este povo favor aos olhos dos egípcios, para que quando vos partirdes, não saiais vazios:
verses.RVR09: Y yo daré á este pueblo gracia en los ojos de los Egipcios, para que cuando os partiereis, no salgáis vacíos:

verses.KJV: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”
verses.ASV: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall despoil the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso pedirá cada mulher à sua vizinha e à sua visitante vasos de prata, vasos de ouro, e roupas; os quais poreis sobre vossos filhos e vossas filhas, e despojareis ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: Sino que demandará cada mujer á su vecina y á su huéspeda vasos de plata, vasos de oro, y vestidos: los cuales pondréis sobre vuestros hijos y vuestras hijas; y despojaréis á Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The Lord hath not appeared unto thee.
verses.WEB: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘The LORD has not appeared to you.’”
verses.ASV: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice; for they will say, Jehovah hath not appeared unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés respondeu, e disse: Eis que eles não crerão em mim, nem ouvirão minha voz; porque dirão: O SENHOR não apareceu a ti.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES Moisés respondió, y dijo: He aquí que ellos no me creerán, ni oirán mi voz; porque dirán: No te ha aparecido Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto him, What is that in thy hand? And he said, A rod.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse: Que é isso que tens em tua mão? E ele respondeu: Uma vara.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo: ¿Qué es eso que tienes en tu mano? Y él respondió: Una vara.

verses.KJV: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
verses.WEB: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
verses.ASV: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Lança-a em terra. E ele a lançou em terra, e tornou-se uma cobra: e Moisés fugia dela.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Échala en tierra. Y él la echó en tierra, y tornóse una culebra: y Moisés huía de ella.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Put forth thy hand, and take it by the tail: (and he put forth his hand, and laid hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand);
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Estende tua mão, e toma-a pela cauda. E ele estendeu sua mão, e tomou-a, e tornou-se vara em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Jehová á Moisés: Extiende tu mano, y tómala por la cola. Y él extendió su mano, y tomóla, y tornóse vara en su mano.

verses.KJV: That they may believe that the Lord God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
verses.WEB: “This is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”
verses.ASV: that they may believe that Jehovah, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isto crerão que se te apareceu o SENHOR, o Deus de teus pais, o Deus de Abraão, Deus de Isaque, e Deus de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Por esto creerán que se te ha aparecido Jehová, el Dios de tus padres, el Dios de Abraham, Dios de Isaac y Dios de Jacob.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
verses.WEB: The LORD said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said furthermore unto him, Put now thy hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as [white as] snow.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe mais o SENHOR: Mete agora tua mão em teu peito. E ele meteu a mão em seu peito; e quando a tirou, eis que sua mão estava leprosa como a neve.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole más Jehová: Mete ahora tu mano en tu seno. Y él metió la mano en su seno; y como la sacó, he aquí que su mano estaba leprosa como la nieve.

verses.KJV: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.
verses.WEB: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.
verses.ASV: And he said, Put thy hand into thy bosom again. (And he put his hand into his bosom again; and when he took it out of his bosom, behold, it was turned again as his [other] flesh.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Volta a meter tua mão em teu peito; e ele voltou a meter sua mão em seu peito; e voltando-a a tirar do peito, eis que se havia voltado como a outra carne.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Vuelve á meter tu mano en tu seno: y él volvió á meter su mano en su seno; y volviéndola á sacar del seno, he aquí que se había vuelto como la otra carne.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
verses.WEB: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se acontecer, que não te crerem, nem obedecerem à voz do primeiro sinal, crerão à voz do último.
verses.RVR09: Sí aconteciere, que no te creyeren, ni obedecieren á la voz de la primera señal, creerán á la voz de la postrera.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.
verses.WEB: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe even these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se ainda não crerem nestes dois sinais, nem ouvirem tua voz, tomarás das águas do rio, e as derramará em terra; e se tornarão aquelas águas que tomarás do rio, se tornarão sangue na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y si aun no creyeren á estas dos señales, ni oyeren tu voz, tomarás de las aguas del río, y derrámalas en tierra; y volverse han aquellas aguas que tomarás del río, se volverán sangre en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the Lord, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
verses.WEB: Moses said to the LORD, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Oh, Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Moisés ao SENHOR: Ai Senhor! Eu não sou homem de palavras de ontem nem de anteontem, nem ainda desde que tu falas a teu servo; porque sou lento no fala e incômodo de língua.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Moisés á Jehová: ¡Ay Señor! yo no soy hombre de palabras de ayer ni de anteayer, ni aun desde que tú hablas á tu siervo; porque soy tardo en el habla y torpe de lengua.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the Lord?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, the LORD?
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh [a man] dumb, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? is it not I, Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR lhe respondeu: Quem deu a boca ao homem? Ou quem fez ao mudo e ao surdo, ao que vai e ao cego? não sou eu, o SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová le respondió: ¿Quién dió la boca al hombre? ¿ó quién hizo al mudo y al sordo, al que ve y al ciego? ¿no soy yo Jehová?

verses.KJV: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
verses.WEB: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora pois, vai, que eu serei em tua boca, e te ensinarei o que tenhas de falar.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, ve, que yo seré en tu boca, y te enseñaré lo que hayas de hablar.

verses.KJV: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Oh, Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Ai Senhor! envia por meio do que hás de enviar.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: ¡Ay Señor! envía por mano del que has de enviar.

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is there not Aaron thy brother the Levite? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR se irou contra Moisés, e disse: Não conheço eu a teu irmão Arão, levita, e que ele fala bem? E ainda eis que ele sairá para te receber, e vendo-te, se alegrará em seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová se enojó contra Moisés, y dijo: ¿No conozco yo á tu hermano Aarón, Levita, y que él hablará? Y aun he aquí que él te saldrá á recibir, y en viéndote, se alegrará en su corazón.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
verses.WEB: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put the words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu falarás a ele, e porás em sua boca as palavras, e eu serei em tua boca e na sua, e vos ensinarei o que deveis fazer.
verses.RVR09: Tú hablarás á él, y pondrás en su boca las palabras, y yo seré en tu boca y en la suya, y os enseñaré lo que hayáis de hacer.

verses.KJV: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
verses.WEB: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
verses.ASV: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people; and it shall come to pass, that he shall be to thee a mouth, and thou shalt be to him as God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele falará por ti ao povo; e ele te será a ti em lugar de boca, e tu serás para ele em lugar de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y él hablará por ti al pueblo; y él te será á ti en lugar de boca, y tú serás para él en lugar de Dios.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
verses.WEB: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
verses.ASV: And thou shalt take in thy hand this rod, wherewith thou shalt do the signs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomarás esta vara em tua mão, com a qual farás os sinais.
verses.RVR09: Y tomarás esta vara en tu mano, con la cual harás las señales.

verses.KJV: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
verses.WEB: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”
verses.ASV: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren that are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se foi Moisés, e voltando a seu sogro Jetro, disse-lhe: Irei agora, e voltarei a meus irmãos que estão em Egito, para ver se ainda vivem. E Jetro disse a Moisés: Vai em paz.
verses.RVR09: Así se fué Moisés, y volviendo á su suegro Jethro, díjole: Iré ahora, y volveré á mis hermanos que están en Egipto, para ver si aun viven. Y Jethro dijo á Moisés: Ve en paz.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt; for all the men are dead that sought thy life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse também o SENHOR a Moisés em Midiã: Vai, e volta-te ao Egito, porque mataram todos os que procuravam tua morte.
verses.RVR09: Dijo también Jehová á Moisés en Madián: Ve, y vuélvete á Egipto, porque han muerto todos los que procuraban tu muerte.

verses.KJV: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
verses.WEB: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.
verses.ASV: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés tomou sua mulher e seus filhos, e os pôs sobre um asno, e voltou-se à terra do Egito: tomou também Moisés a vara de Deus em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés tomó su mujer y sus hijos, y púsolos sobre un asno, y volvióse á tierra de Egipto: tomó también Moisés la vara de Dios en su mano.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, When thou goest back into Egypt, see that thou do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in thy hand: but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Quando houverdes voltado ao Egito, olha que faças diante de Faraó todas as maravilhas que pus em tua mão: eu, porém, endurecerei seu coração, de modo que não deixará ir ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová á Moisés: Cuando hubiereis vuelto á Egipto, mira que hagas delante de Faraón todas las maravillas que he puesto en tu mano: yo empero endureceré su corazón, de modo que no dejará ir al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
verses.WEB: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘The LORD says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
verses.ASV: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith Jehovah, Israel is my son, my first-born:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dirás a Faraó: O SENHOR disse assim: Israel é meu filho, meu primogênito.
verses.RVR09: Y dirás á Faraón: Jehová ha dicho así: Israel es mi hijo, mi primogénito.

verses.KJV: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.
verses.WEB: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”
verses.ASV: and I have said unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me; and thou hast refused to let him go: behold, I will slay thy son, thy first-born.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já te disse que deixes ir a meu filho, para que me sirva, mas não quiseste deixá-lo ir: eis que eu vou a matar a teu filho, o teu primogênito.
verses.RVR09: Ya te he dicho que dejes ir á mi hijo, para que me sirva, mas no has querido dejarlo ir: he aquí yo voy á matar á tu hijo, tu primogénito.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the Lord met him, and sought to kill him.
verses.WEB: On the way at a lodging place, the LORD met Moses and wanted to kill him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the way at the lodging-place, that Jehovah met him, and sought to kill him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu no caminho, que em uma parada o SENHOR lhe saiu ao encontro, e quis matá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció en el camino, que en una posada le salió al encuentro Jehová, y quiso matarlo.

verses.KJV: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
verses.WEB: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”
verses.ASV: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, Surely a bridegroom of blood art thou to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Zípora agarrou uma pedra afiada, e cortou o prepúcio de seu filho, e lançou-o a seus pés, dizendo: Em verdade tu me és um esposo de sangue.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Séphora cogió un afilado pedernal, y cortó el prepucio de su hijo, y echólo á sus pies, diciendo: A la verdad tú me eres un esposo de sangre.

verses.KJV: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.
verses.WEB: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.
verses.ASV: So he let him alone. Then she said, A bridegroom of blood [art thou], because of the circumcision.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim lhe deixou logo ir. E ela disse: Esposo de sangue, por causa da circuncisão.
verses.RVR09: Así le dejó luego ir. Y ella dijo: Esposo de sangre, á causa de la circuncisión.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mountain of God, and kissed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Arão: Vai receber a Moisés ao deserto. E ele foi, e encontrou-o no monte de Deus, e beijou-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Aarón: Ve á recibir á Moisés al desierto. Y él fué, y encontrólo en el monte de Dios, y besóle.

verses.KJV: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
verses.WEB: Moses told Aaron all the LORD’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.
verses.ASV: And Moses told Aaron all the words of Jehovah wherewith he had sent him, and all the signs wherewith he had charged him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então contou Moisés a Arão todas as palavras do SENHOR que lhe enviava, e todas o sinais que lhe havia dado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces contó Moisés á Aarón todas las palabras de Jehová que le enviaba, y todas las señales que le había dado.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram Moisés e Arão, e juntaram todos os anciãos dos filhos de Israel:
verses.RVR09: Y fueron Moisés y Aarón, y juntaron todos los ancianos de los hijos de Israel:

verses.KJV: And Aaron spake all the words which the Lord had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.WEB: Aaron spoke all the words which the LORD had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.ASV: and Aaron spake all the words which Jehovah had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Arão todas as palavras que o SENHOR havia dito a Moisés, e fez o sinais diante dos olhos do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y habló Aarón todas las palabras que Jehová había dicho á Moisés, é hizo las señales delante de los ojos del pueblo.

verses.KJV: And the people believed: and when they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.WEB: The people believed, and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.ASV: And the people believed: and when they heard that Jehovah had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo creu; e ouvindo que o SENHOR havia visitado os filhos de Israel, e que havia visto sua aflição, inclinaram-se e adoraram.
verses.RVR09: Y el pueblo creyó: y oyendo que Jehová había visitado los hijos de Israel, y que había visto su aflicción, inclináronse y adoraron.

verses.KJV: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”
verses.ASV: And afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said unto Pharaoh, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois entraram Moisés e Arão a Faraó, e lhe disseram: O SENHOR, o Deus de Israel, disse assim: Deixa ir meu povo a celebrar-me festa no deserto.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS entraron Moisés y Aarón á Faraón, y le dijeron: Jehová, el Dios de Israel, dice así: Deja ir á mi pueblo á celebrarme fiesta en el desierto.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the Lord, neither will I let Israel go.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said, “Who is the LORD, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know the LORD, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said, Who is Jehovah, that I should hearken unto his voice to let Israel go? I know not Jehovah, and moreover I will not let Israel go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Faraó respondeu: Quem é o SENHOR, para que eu ouça sua voz e deixe ir a Israel? Não conheço o SENHOR, nem tampouco deixarei Israel ir.
verses.RVR09: Y Faraón respondió: ¿Quién es Jehová, para que yo oiga su voz y deje ir á Israel? Yo no conozco á Jehová, ni tampoco dejaré ir á Israel.

verses.KJV: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the Lord our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
verses.WEB: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”
verses.ASV: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice unto Jehovah our God, lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles disseram: O Deus dos hebreus nos encontrou: iremos, pois, agora caminho de três dias pelo deserto, e sacrificaremos ao SENHOR nosso Deus; para que não venha sobre nós com pestilência ou com espada.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos dijeron: El Dios de los Hebreos nos ha encontrado: iremos, pues, ahora camino de tres días por el desierto, y sacrificaremos á Jehová nuestro Dios; porque no venga sobre nosotros con pestilencia ó con espada.

verses.KJV: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
verses.WEB: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”
verses.ASV: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, loose the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei do Egito lhes disse: Moisés e Arão, por que fazeis cessar ao povo de sua obra? Ide a vossas cargas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey de Egipto les dijo: Moisés y Aarón, ¿por qué hacéis cesar al pueblo de su obra? idos á vuestros cargos.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land are now many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse também Faraó: Eis que o povo da terra é agora muito, e vós lhes fazeis cessar de suas cargas.
verses.RVR09: Dijo también Faraón: He aquí el pueblo de la tierra es ahora mucho, y vosotros les hacéis cesar de sus cargos.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
verses.WEB: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,
verses.ASV: And the same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou Faraó aquele mesmo dia aos capatazes do povo que o tinham à sua responsabilidade, e a seus governadores, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y mandó Faraón aquel mismo día á los cuadrilleros del pueblo que le tenían á su cargo, y á sus gobernadores, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.WEB: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.ASV: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: De aqui adiante não dareis palha ao povo para fazer tijolos, como ontem e antes de ontem; vão eles e recolham por si mesmos a palha;
verses.RVR09: De aquí adelante no daréis paja al pueblo para hacer ladrillo, como ayer y antes de ayer; vayan ellos y recojan por sí mismos la paja:

verses.KJV: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
verses.WEB: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’
verses.ASV: And the number of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish aught thereof: for they are idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E haveis de pôr-lhes a tarefa dos tijolos que faziam antes, e não lhes diminuireis nada; porque estão ociosos, e por isso levantam a voz dizendo: Vamos e sacrificaremos a nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y habéis de ponerles la tarea del ladrillo que hacían antes, y no les disminuiréis nada; porque están ociosos, y por eso levantan la voz diciendo: Vamos y sacrificaremos á nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
verses.WEB: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”
verses.ASV: Let heavier work be laid upon the men, that they may labor therein; and let them not regard lying words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agrave-se a servidão sobre eles, para que se ocupem nela, e não atendam a palavras de mentira.
verses.RVR09: Agrávese la servidumbre sobre ellos, para que se ocupen en ella, y no atiendan á palabras de mentira.

verses.KJV: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
verses.WEB: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.
verses.ASV: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saindo os capatazes do povo e seus governadores, falaram ao povo, dizendo: Assim disse Faraó: Eu não vos dou palha.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo los cuadrilleros del pueblo y sus gobernadores, hablaron al pueblo, diciendo: Así ha dicho Faraón: Yo no os doy paja.

verses.KJV: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
verses.WEB: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”
verses.ASV: Go yourselves, get you straw where ye can find it: for nought of your work shall be diminished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide vós, e recolhei palha de onde a achardes; que nada se diminuirá de vossa tarefa.
verses.RVR09: Id vosotros, y recoged paja donde la hallareis; que nada se disminuirá de vuestra tarea.

verses.KJV: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
verses.WEB: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
verses.ASV: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o povo se espalhou por toda a terra do Egito a colher restolho em lugar de palha.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pueblo se derramó por toda la tierra de Egipto á coger rastrojo en lugar de paja.

verses.KJV: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
verses.WEB: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”
verses.ASV: And the taskmasters were urgent saying, Fulfil your works, [your] daily tasks, as when there was straw.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os capatazes os apressavam, dizendo: Acabai vossa obra, a tarefa do dia em seu dia, como quando se vos dava palha.
verses.RVR09: Y los cuadrilleros los apremiaban, diciendo: Acabad vuestra obra, la tarea del día en su día, como cuando se os daba paja.

verses.KJV: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
verses.WEB: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”
verses.ASV: And the officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task both yesterday and to-day, in making brick as heretofore?
verses.ALMEIDA: E açoitavam aos supervisores dos filhos de Israel, que os capatazes de Faraó haviam posto sobre eles, dizendo: Por que não cumpristes vossa tarefa de tijolos nem ontem nem hoje, como antes?
verses.RVR09: Y azotaban á los capataces de los hijos de Israel, que los cuadrilleros de Faraón habían puesto sobre ellos, diciendo: ¿Por qué no habéis cumplido vuestra tarea de ladrillo ni ayer ni hoy, como antes?

verses.KJV: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
verses.WEB: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?
verses.ASV: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os supervisores dos filhos de Israel vieram a Faraó, e se queixaram a ele, dizendo: Por que o fazes assim com teus servos?
verses.RVR09: Y los capataces de los hijos de Israel vinieron á Faraón, y se quejaron á él, diciendo: ¿Por qué lo haces así con tus siervos?

verses.KJV: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.
verses.WEB: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”
verses.ASV: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se dá palha a teus servos, e, contudo, nos dizem: Fazei os tijolos. E eis que teus servos são açoitados, e teu povo cai em falta.
verses.RVR09: No se da paja á tus siervos, y con todo nos dicen: Haced el ladrillo. Y he aquí tus siervos son azotados, y tu pueblo cae en falta.

verses.KJV: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.WEB: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
verses.ASV: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and sacrifice to Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Estais ociosos, sim, ociosos, e por isso dizeis: Vamos e sacrifiquemos ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Estáis ociosos, sí, ociosos, y por eso decís: Vamos y sacrifiquemos á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
verses.WEB: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”
verses.ASV: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the number of bricks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide, pois, agora, e trabalhai. Não se vos dará palha, e haveis de dar a tarefa dos tijolos.
verses.RVR09: Id pues ahora, y trabajad. No se os dará paja, y habéis de dar la tarea del ladrillo.

verses.KJV: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.
verses.WEB: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”
verses.ASV: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, when it was said, Ye shall not diminish aught from your bricks, [your] daily tasks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os supervisores dos filhos de Israel se viram em aflição, tendo lhes dito: Não se diminuirá nada de vossos tijolos, da tarefa de cada dia.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los capataces de los hijos de Israel se vieron en aflicción, habiéndoseles dicho: No se disminuirá nada de vuestro ladrillo, de la tarea de cada día.

verses.KJV: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
verses.WEB: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
verses.ALMEIDA: E encontrando a Moisés e a Arão, que estavam à vista deles quando saíam de Faraó,
verses.RVR09: Y encontrando á Moisés y á Aarón, que estaban á la vista de ellos cuando salían de Faraón,

verses.KJV: And they said unto them, The Lord look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
verses.WEB: They said to them, “May the LORD look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”
verses.ASV: and they said unto them, Jehovah look upon you, and judge: because ye have made our savor to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhes: Olhe o SENHOR sobre vós, e julgue; pois nos fizestes repulsivos diante de Faraó e de seus servos, dando-lhes a espada nas mãos para que nos matem.
verses.RVR09: Dijéronles: Mire Jehová sobre vosotros, y juzgue; pues habéis hecho heder nuestro olor delante de Faraón y de sus siervos, dándoles el cuchillo en las manos para que nos maten.

verses.KJV: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
verses.WEB: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?
verses.ASV: And Moses returned unto Jehovah, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou dealt ill with this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés se voltou ao SENHOR, e disse: Senhor, por que afliges a este povo? para que me enviaste?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés se volvió á Jehová, y dijo: Señor, ¿por qué afliges á este pueblo? ¿para qué me enviaste?

verses.KJV: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
verses.WEB: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”
verses.ASV: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath dealt ill with this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque desde que vim a Faraó para falar-lhe em teu nome, afligiu a este povo; e tu tampouco livraste a teu povo.
verses.RVR09: Porque desde que yo vine á Faraón para hablarle en tu nombre, ha afligido á este pueblo; y tú tampoco has librado á tu pueblo.

verses.KJV: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for by a strong hand shall he let them go, and by a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR respondeu a Moisés: Agora verás o que eu farei a Faraó; porque com mão forte os deixará ir; e com mão forte os expulsará de sua terra.
verses.RVR09: JEHOVÁ respondió á Moisés: Ahora verás lo que yo haré á Faraón; porque con mano fuerte los ha de dejar ir; y con mano fuerte los ha de echar de su tierra.

verses.KJV: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the Lord:
verses.WEB: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Falou, todavia, Deus a Moisés, e disse-lhe: Eu sou o SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Habló todavía Dios á Moisés, y díjole: Yo soy JEHOVÁ;

verses.KJV: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name Jehovah was I not known to them.
verses.WEB: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name the LORD I was not known to them.
verses.ASV: and I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Jehovah I was not known to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apareci a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó sob o nome de Deus Todo-Poderoso, mas em meu nome, EU-SOU, não me notifiquei a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y aparecí á Abraham, á Isaac y á Jacob bajo el nombre de Dios Omnipotente, mas en mi nombre JEHOVÁ no me notifiqué á ellos.

verses.KJV: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
verses.WEB: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
verses.ASV: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their sojournings, wherein they sojourned.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também estabeleci meu pacto com eles, de dar-lhes a terra de Canaã, a terra em que foram estrangeiros, e na qual peregrinaram.
verses.RVR09: Y también establecí mi pacto con ellos, de darles la tierra de Canaán, la tierra en que fueron extranjeros, y en la cual peregrinaron.

verses.KJV: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.WEB: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.ASV: And moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também eu ouvi o gemido dos filhos de Israel, aos quais fazem servir os egípcios, e lembrei-me de meu pacto.
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo yo he oído el gemido de los hijos de Israel, á quienes hacen servir los Egipcios, y heme acordado de mi pacto.

verses.KJV: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the Lord, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
verses.WEB: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.
verses.ASV: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am Jehovah, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto dirás aos filhos de Israel: EU SOU O SENHOR; e eu vos tirarei de debaixo das cargas do Egito, e vos livrarei de sua servidão, e vos resgatarei com braço estendido, e com grandes juízos;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto dirás á los hijos de Israel: Yo JEHOVÁ; y yo os sacaré de debajo de las cargas de Egipto, y os libraré de su servidumbre, y os redimiré con brazo extendido, y con juicios grandes:

verses.KJV: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.ASV: and I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah your God, who bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos tomarei por meu povo e serei vosso Deus: e vós sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tiro de debaixo das cargas do Egito:
verses.RVR09: Y os tomaré por mi pueblo y seré vuestro Dios: y vosotros sabréis que yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios, que os saco de debajo de las cargas de Egipto:

verses.KJV: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: And I will bring you in unto the land which I sware to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for a heritage: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos meterei na terra, pela qual levantei minha mão que a daria a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó: e eu vos a darei por herança. EU SOU O SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y os meteré en la tierra, por la cual alcé mi mano que la daría á Abraham, á Isaac y á Jacob: y yo os la daré por heredad. Yo JEHOVÁ.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.WEB: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.ASV: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desta maneira falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel: mas eles não escutavam a Moisés por causa da angústia de espírito, e da dura servidão.
verses.RVR09: De esta manera habló Moisés á los hijos de Israel: mas ellos no escuchaban á Moisés á causa de la congoja de espíritu, y de la dura servidumbre.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.WEB: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”
verses.ASV: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entra, e fala a Faraó rei do Egito, que deixe ir de sua terra aos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Entra, y habla á Faraón rey de Egipto, que deje ir de su tierra á los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake before the Lord, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
verses.WEB: Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”
verses.ASV: And Moses spake before Jehovah, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Moisés diante do SENHOR, dizendo: Eis que os filhos de Israel não me escutam: como, pois, me escutará Faraó, ainda mais sendo eu incircunciso de lábios?
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Moisés delante de Jehová, diciendo: He aquí, los hijos de Israel no me escuchan: ¿cómo pues me escuchará Faraón, mayormente siendo yo incircunciso de labios?

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés e a Arão, e deu-lhes mandamento para os filhos de Israel, e para Faraó rei do Egito, para que tirassem aos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová habló á Moisés y á Aarón, y dióles mandamiento para los hijos de Israel, y para Faraón rey de Egipto, para que sacasen á los hijos de Israel de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.
verses.WEB: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
verses.ASV: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os chefes das famílias de seus pais. Os filhos de Rúben, o primogênito de Israel: Enoque e Palu, Hezrom e Carmi: estas são as famílias de Rúben.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las cabezas de las familias de sus padres. Los hijos de Rubén, el primogénito de Israel: Hanoch y Phallú, Hezrón y Carmi: estas son las familias de Rubén.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.
verses.WEB: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman; these are the families of Simeon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Simeão: Jemuel, e Jamim, e Oade, e Jaquim, e Zoar, e Saul, filho de uma cananeia: estas são as famílias de Simeão.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Simeón: Jemuel, y Jamín, y Ohad, y Jachîn, y Zoar, y Saúl, hijo de una Cananea: estas son las familias de Simeón.

verses.KJV: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.
verses.ASV: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were a hundred thirty and seven years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Levi por suas linhagens: Gérson, e Coate, e Merari: E os anos da vida de Levi foram cento trinta e sete anos.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los nombres de los hijos de Leví por sus linajes: Gersón, y Coath, y Merari. Y los años de la vida de Leví fueron ciento treinta y siete años.

verses.KJV: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
verses.WEB: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
verses.ASV: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Gérson: Libni, e Simei, por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Gersón: Libni, y Shimi, por sus familias.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
verses.WEB: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were a hundred thirty and three years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Coate: Anrão, e Izar, e Hebrom, e Uziel. E os anos da vida de Coate foram cento e trinta e três anos.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Coath: Amram, é Izhar, y Hebrón, y Uzziel. Y los años de la vida de Coath fueron ciento treinta y tres años.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
verses.WEB: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Merari: Mali, e Musi: estas são as famílias de Levi por suas linhagens.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Merari: Mahali, y Musi: estas son las familias de Leví por sus linajes.

verses.KJV: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
verses.WEB: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.
verses.ASV: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were a hundred and thirty and seven years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Anrão tomou por mulher a Joquebede sua tia, a qual lhe deu à luz a Arão e a Moisés. E os anos da vida de Anrão foram cento e trinta e sete anos.
verses.RVR09: Y Amram tomó por mujer á Jochêbed su tía; la cual le parió á Aarón y á Moisés. Y los años de la vida de Amram fueron ciento treinta y siete años.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.WEB: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Izar: Corá, e Nefegue e Zicri.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Izhar: Cora, y Nepheg y Zithri.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
verses.WEB: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Uziel: Misael, e Elzafã e Sitri.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Uzziel: Misael, y Elzaphán y Zithri.

verses.KJV: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.WEB: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
