verses.ASV: And Aaron took him Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou para si Arão por mulher a Eliseba, filha de Aminadabe, irmã de Naassom; a qual lhe deu à luz a Nadabe, e a Abiú, e a Eleazar, e a Itamar.
verses.RVR09: Y tomóse Aarón por mujer á Elisabeth, hija de Aminadab, hermana de Naasón; la cual le parió á Nadab, y á Abiú, y á Eleazar y á Ithamar.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
verses.WEB: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Corá: Assir, e Elcana, e Abiasafe: estas são as famílias dos coraítas.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Cora: Assir, y Elcana, y Abiasaph: estas son las familias de los Coritas.

verses.KJV: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
verses.WEB: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.
verses.ASV: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the Levites according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eleazar, filho de Arão, tomou para si mulher das filhas de Putiel, a qual lhe deu à luz a Fineias: E estes são os chefes dos pais dos levitas por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Y Eleazar, hijo de Aarón, tomó para sí mujer de las hijas de Phutiel, la cual le parió á Phinees: y estas son las cabezas de los padres de los Levitas por sus familias.

verses.KJV: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the Lord said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
verses.WEB: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”
verses.ASV: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom Jehovah said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é aquele Arão e aquele Moisés, aos quais o SENHOR disse: Tirai aos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito por seus esquadrões.
verses.RVR09: Este es aquel Aarón y aquel Moisés, á los cuales Jehová dijo: Sacad á los hijos de Israel de la tierra de Egipto por sus escuadrones.

verses.KJV: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
verses.WEB: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.
verses.ASV: These are they that spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os que falaram a Faraó rei do Egito, para tirar do Egito aos filhos de Israel. Moisés e Arão foram estes.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los que hablaron á Faraón rey de Egipto, para sacar de Egipto á los hijos de Israel. Moisés y Aarón fueron estos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the day when the Lord spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.WEB: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the day when Jehovah spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o SENHOR falou a Moisés na terra do Egito,
verses.RVR09: Cuando Jehová habló á Moisés en la tierra de Egipto,

verses.KJV: That the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, I am the Lord: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”
verses.ASV: that Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying, I am Jehovah: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I speak unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo: Eu sou o SENHOR; dize a Faraó rei do Egito todas as coisas que eu te digo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo: Yo soy JEHOVÁ; di á Faraón rey de Egipto todas las cosas que yo te digo á ti.

verses.KJV: And Moses said before the Lord, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
verses.WEB: Moses said before the LORD, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
verses.ASV: And Moses said before Jehovah, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés respondeu diante do SENHOR: Eis que sou incircunciso de lábios; como, pois, Faraó me ouvirá?
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés respondió delante de Jehová: He aquí, yo soy incircunciso de labios, ¿cómo pues me ha de oir Faraón?

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, See, I have made thee as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR disse a Moisés: Olha, eu te constituí como um deus para Faraó, e teu irmão Arão será teu profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ dijo á Moisés: Mira, yo te he constituído dios para Faraón, y tu hermano Aarón será tu profeta.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
verses.WEB: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee; and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu dirás todas as coisas que eu te mandarei, e Arão teu irmão falará a Faraó, para que deixe os filhos de Israel saírem de sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Tú dirás todas las cosas que yo te mandaré, y Aarón tu hermano hablará á Faraón, para que deje ir de su tierra á los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu endurecerei o coração de Faraó, e multiplicarei na terra do Egito meus sinais e minhas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Y yo endureceré el corazón de Faraón, y multiplicaré en la tierra de Egipto mis señales y mis maravillas.

verses.KJV: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
verses.WEB: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
verses.ASV: But Pharaoh will not hearken unto you, and I will lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth my hosts, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Faraó não vos ouvirá; mas eu porei minha mão sobre o Egito, e tirarei meus exércitos, meu povo, os filhos de Israel, da terra do Egito, com grandes juízos.
verses.RVR09: Y Faraón no os oirá; mas yo pondré mi mano sobre Egipto, y sacaré á mis ejércitos, mi pueblo, los hijos de Israel, de la tierra de Egipto, con grandes juicios.

verses.KJV: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
verses.WEB: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”
verses.ASV: And the Egyptians shall know that I am Jehovah, when I stretch forth my hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os egípcios saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu estender minha mão sobre o Egito, e tirar os filhos de Israel do meio deles.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrán los Egipcios que yo soy Jehová, cuando extenderé mi mano sobre Egipto, y sacaré los hijos de Israel de en medio de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded them, so did they.
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron did so. As the LORD commanded them, so they did.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron did so; as Jehovah commanded them, so did they.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Moisés e Arão como o SENHOR lhes mandou; fizeram-no assim.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Moisés y Aarón como Jehová les mandó: hiciéronlo así.

verses.KJV: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era Moisés de idade de oitenta anos, e Arão de idade de oitenta e três, quando falaram a Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y era Moisés de edad de ochenta años, y Aarón de edad de ochenta y tres, cuando hablaron á Faraón.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés y á Aarón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.
verses.WEB: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”
verses.ASV: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Show a wonder for you; then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, that it become a serpent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se Faraó vos responder dizendo, Mostrai milagre; dirás a Arão: Toma tua vara, e lança-a diante de Faraó, para que se torne cobra.
verses.RVR09: Si Faraón os respondiere diciendo, Mostrad milagro; dirás á Aarón: Toma tu vara, y échala delante de Faraón, para que se torne culebra.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the Lord had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as the LORD had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so, as Jehovah had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vieram, pois, Moisés e Arão a Faraó, e fizeram como o SENHOR o havia mandado; e Arão lançou sua vara diante de Faraó e de seus servos, e tornou-se cobra.
verses.RVR09: Vinieron, pues, Moisés y Aarón á Faraón, é hicieron como Jehová lo había mandado: y echó Aarón su vara delante de Faraón y de sus siervos, y tornóse culebra.

verses.KJV: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
verses.WEB: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.
verses.ASV: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers: and they also, the magicians of Egypt, did in like manner with their enchantments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó chamou também sábios e encantadores; e os encantadores do Egito com seus encantamentos fizeram também o mesmo;
verses.RVR09: Entonces llamó también Faraón sabios y encantadores; é hicieron también lo mismo los encantadores de Egipto con sus encantamientos;

verses.KJV: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
verses.WEB: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
verses.ASV: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois lançou cada um sua vara, as quais se tornaram cobras; mas a vara de Arão devorou as varas deles.
verses.RVR09: Pues echó cada uno su vara, las cuales se volvieron culebras: mas la vara de Aarón devoró las varas de ellos.

verses.KJV: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as Jehovah had spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não os escutou; como o SENHOR o havia dito.
verses.RVR09: Y el corazón de Faraón se endureció, y no los escuchó; como Jehová lo había dicho.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn, he refuseth to let the people go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: O coração de Faraó está endurecido, que não quer deixar o povo ir.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Moisés: El corazón de Faraón está agravado, que no quiere dejar ir al pueblo.

verses.KJV: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.
verses.WEB: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.
verses.ASV: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink to meet him; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai pela manhã a Faraó, eis que ele estará saindo às águas; e põe-te à beira do rio diante dele, e toma em tua mão a vara que se tornou cobra,
verses.RVR09: Ve por la mañana á Faraón, he aquí que él sale á las aguas; y tú ponte á la orilla del río delante de él, y toma en tu mano la vara que se volvió culebra,

verses.KJV: And thou shalt say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
verses.WEB: You shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”
verses.ASV: And thou shalt say unto him, Jehovah, the God of the Hebrews, hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou hast not hearkened.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize-lhe: O SENHOR, o Deus dos hebreus, me enviou a ti, dizendo: Deixa meu povo ir, para que me sirvam no deserto; e eis que até agora não quiseste ouvir.
verses.RVR09: Y dile: Jehová el Dios de los Hebreos me ha enviado á ti, diciendo: Deja ir á mi pueblo, para que me sirvan en el desierto; y he aquí que hasta ahora no has querido oir.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, In this thou shalt know that I am the Lord: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “In this you shall know that I am the LORD. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, In this thou shalt know that I am Jehovah: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in my hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim disse o SENHOR: Nisto conhecerás que eu sou o SENHOR: eis que ferirei com a vara que tenho em minha mão a água que está no rio, e se converterá em sangue:
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: En esto conocerás que yo soy Jehová: he aquí, yo heriré con la vara que tengo en mi mano el agua que está en el río, y se convertirá en sangre:

verses.KJV: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
verses.WEB: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”
verses.ASV: And the fish that are in the river shall die, and the river shall become foul; and the Egyptians shall loathe to drink water from the river.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os peixes que há no rio morrerão, e federá o rio, e os egípcios terão asco de beber a água do rio.
verses.RVR09: Y los peces que hay en el río morirán, y hederá el río, y tendrán asco los Egipcios de beber el agua del río.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thy hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood; and there shall be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Toma tua vara, e estende tua mão sobre as águas do Egito, sobre seus rios, sobre seus ribeiros e sobre seus tanques, e sobre todos os seus depósitos de águas, para que se convertam em sangue, e haja sangue por toda a região do Egito, tanto nos vasos de madeira como nos de pedra.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Di á Aarón: Toma tu vara, y extiende tu mano sobre las aguas de Egipto, sobre sus ríos, sobre sus arroyos y sobre sus estanques, y sobre todos sus depósitos de aguas, para que se conviertan en sangre, y haya sangre por toda la región de Egipto, así en los vasos de madera como en los de piedra.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the Lord commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron did so, as Jehovah commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés e Arão fizeram como o SENHOR havia mandado; e levantando a vara feriu as águas que havia no rio, em presença de Faraó e de seus servos; e todas as águas que havia no rio se converteram em sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés y Aarón hicieron como Jehová lo mandó; y alzando la vara hirió las aguas que había en el río, en presencia de Faraón y de sus siervos; y todas las aguas que había en el río se convirtieron en sangre.

verses.KJV: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And the fish that were in the river died; and the river became foul, and the Egyptians could not drink water from the river; and the blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os peixes que havia no rio morreram; e o rio se contaminou, que os egípcios não podiam beber dele; e houve sangue por toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo los peces que había en el río murieron; y el río se corrompió, que los Egipcios no podían beber de él: y hubo sangre por toda la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the Lord had said.
verses.WEB: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
verses.ASV: And the magicians of Egypt did in like manner with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as Jehovah had spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os encantadores do Egito fizeram o mesmo com seus encantamentos: e o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não os escutou; como o SENHOR o havia dito.
verses.RVR09: Y los encantadores de Egipto hicieron lo mismo con sus encantamientos: y el corazón de Faraón se endureció, y no los escuchó; como Jehová lo había dicho.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he lay even this to heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Faraó, tornando, voltou-se a sua casa, e não pôs seu coração ainda nisto.
verses.RVR09: Y tornando Faraón volvióse á su casa, y no puso su corazón aun en esto.

verses.KJV: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
verses.WEB: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.
verses.ASV: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por todo o Egito fizeram poços ao redor do rio para beber, porque não podiam beber das águas do rio.
verses.RVR09: Y en todo Egipto hicieron pozos alrededor del río para beber, porque no podían beber de las aguas del río.

verses.KJV: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the Lord had smitten the river.
verses.WEB: Seven days were fulfilled, after the LORD had struck the river.
verses.ASV: And seven days were fulfilled, after that Jehovah had smitten the river.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cumpriram-se sete dias depois que o SENHOR feriu o rio.
verses.RVR09: Y cumpliéronse siete días después que Jehová hirió el río.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Entra à presença de Faraó, e dize-lhe: O SENHOR disse assim: Deixa meu povo ir, para que me sirvam.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES Jehová dijo á Moisés: Entra á Faraón, y dile: Jehová ha dicho así: Deja ir á mi pueblo, para que me sirvan.

verses.KJV: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
verses.WEB: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.
verses.ASV: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não o quiseres deixar ir, eis que ferirei com rãs todo os teu território;
verses.RVR09: Y si no lo quisieres dejar ir, he aquí yo heriré con ranas todos tus términos:

verses.KJV: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:
verses.WEB: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.
verses.ASV: and the river shall swarm with frogs, which shall go up and come into thy house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneading-troughs:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rio criará rãs, que subirão, e entrarão em tua casa, e no teu quarto, e sobre tua cama, e nas casas de teus servos, e em teu povo, e em teus fornos, e em tuas amassadeiras;
verses.RVR09: Y el río criará ranas, las cuales subirán, y entrarán en tu casa, y en la cámara de tu cama, y sobre tu cama, y en las casas de tus siervos, y en tu pueblo, y en tus hornos, y en tus artesas:

verses.KJV: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
verses.WEB: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”
verses.ASV: and the frogs shall come up both upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as rãs subirão sobre ti, e sobre teu povo, e sobre todos os teus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y las ranas subirán sobre ti, y sobre tu pueblo, y sobre todos tus siervos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thy hand with thy rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Estende tua mão com tua vara sobre os rios, ribeiros, e tanques, para que faça vir rãs sobre a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Di á Aarón: Extiende tu mano con tu vara sobre los ríos, arroyos, y estanques, para que haga venir ranas sobre la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Arão estendeu sua mão sobre as águas do Egito, e subiram rãs que cobriram a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Aarón extendió su mano sobre las aguas de Egipto, y subieron ranas que cubrieron la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And the magicians did in like manner with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os encantadores fizeram o mesmo com seus encantamentos, e fizeram vir rãs sobre a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y los encantadores hicieron lo mismo con sus encantamientos, é hicieron venir ranas sobre la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the Lord, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat the LORD, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”
verses.ASV: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Entreat Jehovah, that he take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó chamou Moisés e Arão, e disse-lhes: Orai ao SENHOR que tire as rãs de mim e de meu povo; e deixarei ir ao povo, para que sacrifique ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón llamó á Moisés y á Aarón, y díjoles: Orad á Jehová que quite las ranas de mí y de mi pueblo; y dejaré ir al pueblo, para que sacrifique á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?
verses.WEB: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Have thou this glory over me: against what time shall I entreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, that the frogs be destroyed from thee and thy houses, and remain in the river only?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés a Faraó: Tem a honra em meu lugar [de dizer] quando orarei por ti, e por teus servos, e por teu povo, para que as rãs sejam tiradas de ti, e de tuas casas, e que somente se restem no rio.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Faraón: Gloríate sobre mí: ¿cuándo oraré por ti, y por tus siervos, y por tu pueblo, para que las ranas sean quitadas de ti, y de tus casas, y que solamente se queden en el río?

verses.KJV: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the Lord our God.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.
verses.ASV: And he said, Against to-morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word; that thou mayest know that there is none like unto Jehovah our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Amanhã. E Moisés respondeu: Será feito conforme tua palavra, para que conheças que não há ninguém como o SENHOR nosso Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Mañana. Y Moisés respondió: Se hará conforme á tu palabra, para que conozcas que no hay como Jehová nuestro Dios:

verses.KJV: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
verses.WEB: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”
verses.ASV: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as rãs se irão de ti, e de tuas casas, e de teus servos, e de teu povo, e somente se ficarão no rio.
verses.RVR09: Y las ranas se irán de ti, y de tus casas, y de tus siervos, y de tu pueblo, y solamente se quedarán en el río.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the Lord because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to the LORD concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto Jehovah concerning the frogs which he had brought upon Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então saíram Moisés e Arão da presença de Faraó, e clamou Moisés ao SENHOR acerca das rãs que havia posto a Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Entonces salieron Moisés y Aarón de con Faraón, y clamó Moisés á Jehová sobre el negocio de las ranas que había puesto á Faraón.

verses.KJV: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
verses.WEB: The LORD did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR fez conforme a palavra de Moisés, e morreram as rãs das casas, dos pátios, e dos campos.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Jehová conforme á la palabra de Moisés, y murieron las ranas de las casas, de los cortijos, y de los campos.

verses.KJV: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
verses.WEB: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.
verses.ASV: And they gathered them together in heaps; and the land stank.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as juntaram em amontoados, e faziam cheirar mal a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y las juntaron en montones, y apestaban la tierra.

verses.KJV: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
verses.WEB: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
verses.ASV: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them, as Jehovah had spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Faraó que lhe haviam dado repouso, agravou seu coração, e não os escutou; como o SENHOR o havia dito.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Faraón que le habían dado reposo, agravó su corazón, y no los escuchó; como Jehová lo había dicho.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Estende a tua vara, e fere o pó da terra, para que se voltem piolhos por toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Moisés: Di á Aarón: Extiende tu vara, y hiere el polvo de la tierra, para que se vuelva piojos por todo el país de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And they did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and there were lice upon man, and upon beast; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles o fizeram assim; e Arão estendeu sua mão com sua vara, e feriu o pó da terra, o qual se tornou piolhos, tanto nos homens como nos animais; todo o pó da terra se tornou piolhos em toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos lo hicieron así; y Aarón extendió su mano con su vara, é hirió el polvo de la tierra, el cual se volvió piojos, así en los hombres como en las bestias: todo el polvo de la tierra se volvió piojos en todo el país de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
verses.WEB: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.
verses.ASV: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: and there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os encantadores tentaram fizeram assim também, para tirar piolhos com seus encantamentos; mas não puderam. E havia piolhos tanto nos homens como nos animais.
verses.RVR09: Y los encantadores hicieron así también, para sacar piojos con sus encantamientos; mas no pudieron. Y había piojos así en los hombres como en las bestias.

verses.KJV: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
verses.WEB: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
verses.ASV: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as Jehovah had spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os magos disseram a Faraó: Dedo de Deus é este. Mas o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não os escutou; como o SENHOR o havia dito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los magos dijeron á Faraón: Dedo de Dios es este. Mas el corazón de Faraón se endureció, y no los escuchó; como Jehová lo había dicho.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Levanta-te de manhã e põe-te diante de Faraó, eis que ele estará saindo às águas; e dize-lhe: o SENHOR disse assim: Deixa meu povo ir, para que me sirva.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Levántate de mañana y ponte delante de Faraón, he aquí él sale á las aguas; y dile: Jehová ha dicho así: Deja ir á mi pueblo, para que me sirva.

verses.KJV: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.
verses.WEB: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.
verses.ASV: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se não deixares meu povo ir, eis que enviarei sobre ti, e sobre teus servos, e sobre teu povo, e sobre tuas casas toda variedade de moscas; e as casas dos egípcios se encherão de toda variedade de moscas, e também a terra onde eles estiverem.
verses.RVR09: Porque si no dejares ir á mi pueblo, he aquí yo enviaré sobre ti, y sobre tus siervos, y sobre tu pueblo, y sobre tus casas toda suerte de moscas; y las casas de los Egipcios se henchirán de toda suerte de moscas, y asimismo la tierra donde ellos estuvieren.

verses.KJV: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.
verses.WEB: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am the LORD on the earth.
verses.ASV: And I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am Jehovah in the midst of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele dia separarei a terra de Gósen, na qual meu povo habita, para que nenhuma variedade de moscas haja nela; a fim de que saibas que eu sou o SENHOR no meio da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel día yo apartaré la tierra de Gosén, en la cual mi pueblo habita, para que ninguna suerte de moscas haya en ella; á fin de que sepas que yo soy Jehová en medio de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.
verses.WEB: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”
verses.ASV: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: by to-morrow shall this sign be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu porei remissão entre meu povo e o teu. Amanhã será este sinal.
verses.RVR09: Y yo pondré redención entre mi pueblo y el tuyo. Mañana será esta señal.

verses.KJV: And the Lord did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.
verses.WEB: The LORD did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses: and in all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR o fez assim: veio toda variedade de moscas incômodas sobre a casa de Faraó, e sobre as casas de seus servos, e sobre toda a terra do Egito; e a terra foi contaminada por causa delas.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová lo hizo así: que vino toda suerte de moscas molestísimas sobre la casa de Faraón, y sobre las casas de sus siervos, y sobre todo el país de Egipto; y la tierra fué corrompida á causa de ellas.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó chamou a Moisés e a Arão, e disse-lhes: Andai, sacrificai a vosso Deus nesta terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón llamó á Moisés y á Aarón, y díjoles: Andad, sacrificad á vuestro Dios en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the Lord our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
verses.WEB: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?
verses.ASV: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to Jehovah our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés respondeu: Não convém que façamos assim, porque sacrificaríamos ao SENHOR nosso Deus a abominação dos egípcios. Eis que, se sacrificássemos a abominação dos egípcios diante deles, não nos apedrejariam?
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés respondió: No conviene que hagamos así, porque sacrificaríamos á Jehová nuestro Dios la abominación de los Egipcios. He aquí, si sacrificáramos la abominación de los Egipcios delante de ellos, ¿no nos apedrearían?

verses.KJV: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the Lord our God, as he shall command us.
verses.WEB: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.”
verses.ASV: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Jehovah our God, as he shall command us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caminho de três dias iremos pelo deserto, e sacrificaremos ao SENHOR nosso Deus, como ele nos dirá.
verses.RVR09: Camino de tres días iremos por el desierto, y sacrificaremos á Jehová nuestro Dios, como él nos dirá.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to Jehovah your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: entreat for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Faraó: Eu vos deixarei ir para que sacrifiqueis ao SENHOR vosso Deus no deserto, contanto que não vades mais longe; orai por mim.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Faraón: Yo os dejaré ir para que sacrifiquéis á Jehová vuestro Dios en el desierto, con tal que no vayáis más lejos: orad por mí.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the Lord that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “Behold, I am going out from you. I will pray to the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow; only don’t let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will entreat Jehovah that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to-morrow: only let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Moisés: Eis que, quando eu sair de tua presença, rogarei ao SENHOR que as diversas variedades de moscas se afastem de Faraó, e de seus servos, e de seu povo amanhã; contanto que Faraó não falte mais, não deixando o povo ir sacrificar ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Moisés: He aquí, en saliendo yo de contigo, rogaré á Jehová que las diversas suertes de moscas se vayan de Faraón, y de sus siervos, y de su pueblo mañana; con tal que Faraón no falte más, no dejando ir al pueblo á sacrificar á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the Lord.
verses.WEB: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and entreated Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés saiu da presença de Faraó, e orou ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés salió de con Faraón, y oró á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
verses.WEB: The LORD did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR fez conforme a palavra de Moisés; e tirou todas aquelas moscas de Faraó, e de seus servos, e de seu povo, sem que restasse uma.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová hizo conforme á la palabra de Moisés; y quitó todas aquellas moscas de Faraón, y de sus siervos, y de su pueblo, sin que quedara una.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he did not let the people go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Faraó agravou ainda esta vez seu coração, e não deixou o povo ir.
verses.RVR09: Mas Faraón agravó aún esta vez su corazón, y no dejó ir al pueblo.

verses.KJV: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ASV: Then Jehovah said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Entra a Faraó, e dize-lhe: o SENHOR, o Deus dos hebreus, diz assim: Deixa ir a meu povo, para que me sirvam;
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES Jehová dijo á Moisés: Entra á Faraón, y dile: Jehová, el Dios de los Hebreos, dice así: Deja ir á mi pueblo, para que me sirvan;

verses.KJV: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,
verses.WEB: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,
verses.ASV: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se não o queres deixar ir, e os detiverdes ainda,
verses.RVR09: Porque si no lo quieres dejar ir, y los detuvieres aún,

verses.KJV: Behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.
verses.WEB: behold, the LORD’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.
verses.ASV: behold, the hand of Jehovah is upon thy cattle which are in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the herds, and upon the flocks: [there shall be] a very grievous murrain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que a mão do SENHOR será sobre teus gados que estão no campo, cavalos, asnos, camelos, vacas e ovelhas, com pestilência gravíssima:
verses.RVR09: He aquí la mano de Jehová será sobre tus ganados que están en el campo, caballos, asnos, camellos, vacas y ovejas, con pestilencia gravísima:

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children's of Israel.
verses.WEB: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah shall make a distinction between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt; and there shall nothing die of all that belongeth to the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR fará separação entre os gados de Israel e os do Egito, de modo que nada morra de todo o dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová hará separación entre los ganados de Israel y los de Egipto, de modo que nada muera de todo lo de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Lord appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the Lord shall do this thing in the land.
verses.WEB: The LORD appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah appointed a set time, saying, To-morrow Jehovah shall do this thing in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR assinalou tempo, dizendo: Amanhã fará o SENHOR esta coisa na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová señaló tiempo, diciendo: Mañana hará Jehová esta cosa en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the Lord did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
verses.WEB: The LORD did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah did that thing on the morrow; and all the cattle of Egypt died; but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o dia seguinte o SENHOR fez aquilo, e morreu todo o gado do Egito; mas do gado dos filhos de Israel não morreu um.
verses.RVR09: Y el día siguiente Jehová hizo aquello, y murió todo el ganado de Egipto; mas del ganado de los hijos de Israel no murió uno.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he did not let the people go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó enviou, e eis que do gado dos filhos de Israel não havia um morto sequer. Mas o coração de Faraó se agravou, e não deixou ir ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón envió, y he aquí que del ganado de los hijos de Israel no había muerto uno. Mas el corazón de Faraón se agravó, y no dejó ir al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés e a Arão: Tomai punhados de cinza de um forno, e espalha-a Moisés até o céu diante de Faraó:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés y á Aarón: Tomad puñados de ceniza de un horno, y espárzala Moisés hacia el cielo delante de Faraón:

verses.KJV: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”
verses.ASV: And it shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E virá a ser pó sobre toda a terra do Egito, o qual originará sarna que cause feridas com ulcerações nos homens e nos animais, por toda a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrá á ser polvo sobre toda la tierra de Egipto, el cual originará sarpullido que cause tumores apostemados en los hombres y en las bestias, por todo el país de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.
verses.WEB: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.
verses.ASV: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man and upon beast.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram a cinza do forno, e puseram-se diante de Faraó, e espalhou-a Moisés até o céu; e veio uma sarna que causava feridas com ulcerações tanto nos homens como nos animais.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron la ceniza del horno, y pusiéronse delante de Faraón, y esparcióla Moisés hacia el cielo; y vino un sarpullido que causaba tumores apostemados así en los hombres como en las bestias.

verses.KJV: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.
verses.ASV: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os magos não podiam estar diante de Moisés por causa das feridas, porque houve sarna nos magos e em todos os egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Y los magos no podían estar delante de Moisés á causa de los tumores, porque hubo sarpullido en los magos y en todos los Egipcios.

verses.KJV: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had spoken unto Moses.
verses.WEB: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken to Moses.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them, as Jehovah had spoken unto Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR endureceu o coração de Faraó, e não os ouviu; como o SENHOR o disse a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová endureció el corazón de Faraón, y no los oyó; como Jehová lo había dicho á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Levanta-te de manhã, e põe-te diante de Faraó, e dize-lhe: o SENHOR, o Deus dos hebreus, disse assim: Deixa ir a meu povo, para que me sirva.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Moisés: Levántate de mañana, y ponte delante de Faraón, y dile: Jehová, el Dios de los Hebreos, dice así: Deja ir á mi pueblo, para que me sirva.

verses.KJV: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.
verses.WEB: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.
verses.ASV: For I will this time send all my plagues upon thy heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu enviarei esta vez todas minhas pragas a teu coração, sobre teus servos, e sobre teu povo, para que entendas que não há outro como eu em toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo enviaré esta vez todas mis plagas á tu corazón, sobre tus siervos, y sobre tu pueblo, para que entiendas que no hay otro como yo en toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
verses.WEB: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;
verses.ASV: For now I had put forth my hand, and smitten thee and thy people with pestilence, and thou hadst been cut off from the earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque agora eu estenderei minha mão para ferir a ti e a teu povo de pestilência, e serás tirado da terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque ahora yo extenderé mi mano para herirte á ti y á tu pueblo de pestilencia, y serás quitado de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.WEB: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,
verses.ASV: but in very deed for this cause have I made thee to stand, to show thee my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à verdade eu te pus para declarar em ti meu poder, e que meu Nome seja contado em toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y á la verdad yo te he puesto para declarar en ti mi potencia, y que mi Nombre sea contado en toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
verses.WEB: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.
verses.ASV: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia te exaltas tu contra meu povo, para não deixá-los ir?
verses.RVR09: ¿Todavía te ensalzas tú contra mi pueblo, para no dejarlos ir?

verses.KJV: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.
verses.WEB: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.
verses.ASV: Behold, to-morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que amanhã a estas horas eu farei chover granizo muito grave, qual nunca foi em Egito, desde o dia que se fundou até agora.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que mañana á estas horas yo haré llover granizo muy grave, cual nunca fué en Egipto, desde el día que se fundó hasta ahora.

verses.KJV: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.
verses.WEB: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.”’”
verses.ASV: Now therefore send, hasten in thy cattle and all that thou hast in the field; [for] every man and beast that shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envia, pois, a recolher teu gado, e tudo o que tens no campo; porque todo homem ou animal que se achar no campo, e não for recolhido a casa, o granizo descerá sobre ele, e morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Envía, pues, á recoger tu ganado, y todo lo que tienes en el campo; porque todo hombre ó animal que se hallare en el campo, y no fuere recogido á casa, el granizo descenderá sobre él, y morirá.

verses.KJV: He that feared the word of the Lord among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
verses.WEB: Those who feared the LORD’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.
verses.ASV: He that feared the word of Jehovah among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos servos de Faraó o que temeu a palavra do SENHOR, fez fugir seus criados e seu gado a casa:
verses.RVR09: De los siervos de Faraón el que temió la palabra de Jehová, hizo huir sus criados y su ganado á casa:

verses.KJV: And he that regarded not the word of the Lord left his servants and his cattle in the field.
verses.WEB: Whoever didn’t respect the LORD’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.
verses.ASV: and he that regarded not the word of Jehovah left his servants and his cattle in the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que não pôs em seu coração a palavra do SENHOR, deixou seus criados e seus gados no campo.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que no puso en su corazón la palabra de Jehová, dejó sus criados y sus ganados en el campo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Stretch forth thy hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Estende a tua mão até o céu, para que venha granizo em toda a terra do Egito sobre os homens, e sobre os animais, e sobre toda a erva do campo na terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Extiende tu mano hacia el cielo, para que venga granizo en toda la tierra de Egipto sobre los hombres, y sobre las bestias, y sobre toda la hierba del campo en el país de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the Lord rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and the LORD sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. The LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and Jehovah sent thunder and hail, and fire ran down unto the earth; and Jehovah rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés estendeu sua vara até o céu, e o SENHOR fez trovejar e cair granizo, e o fogo corria pela terra; e choveu o SENHOR granizo sobre a terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés extendió su vara hacia el cielo, y Jehová hizo tronar y granizar, y el fuego discurría por la tierra; y llovió Jehová granizo sobre la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
verses.WEB: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
verses.ASV: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve, pois, granizo, e fogo misturado com o granizo, tão grande, qual nunca houve em toda a terra do Egito desde que foi habitada.
verses.RVR09: Hubo pues granizo, y fuego mezclado con el granizo, tan grande, cual nunca hubo en toda la tierra de Egipto desde que fué habitada.

verses.KJV: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
verses.WEB: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.
verses.ASV: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele granizo feriu em toda a terra do Egito todo o que estava no campo, tanto homens como animais; o granizo também feriu toda erva do campo, e quebrou os galhos de todas as árvores daquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel granizo hirió en toda la tierra de Egipto todo lo que estaba en el campo, así hombres como bestias; asimismo hirió el granizo toda la hierba del campo, y desgajó todos los árboles del país.

verses.KJV: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.
verses.WEB: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.
verses.ASV: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente na terra de Gósen, onde os filhos de Israel estavam, não houve granizo.
verses.RVR09: Solamente en la tierra de Gosén, donde los hijos de Israel estaban, no hubo granizo.

verses.KJV: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the Lord is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. The LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: Jehovah is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Faraó mandou chamar a Moisés e a Arão, e lhes disse: Pequei esta vez: o SENHOR é justo, e eu e meu povo ímpios.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Faraón envió á llamar á Moisés y á Aarón, y les dijo: He pecado esta vez: Jehová es justo, y yo y mi pueblo impíos.

verses.KJV: Intreat the Lord (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
verses.WEB: Pray to the LORD; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”
verses.ASV: Entreat Jehovah; for there hath been enough of [these] mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Orai ao SENHOR: e cessem os trovões de Deus e o granizo; e eu vos deixarei ir, e não vos detereis mais.
verses.RVR09: Orad á Jehová: y cesen los truenos de Dios y el granizo; y yo os dejaré ir, y no os detendréis más.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the Lord; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the Lord's.
verses.WEB: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to the LORD. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is the LORD’s.
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto Jehovah; the thunders shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know that the earth is Jehovah’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhe Moisés: Em saindo eu da cidade estenderei minhas mãos ao SENHOR, e os trovões cessarão, e não haverá mais granizo; para que saibas que do SENHOR é a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y respondióle Moisés: En saliendo yo de la ciudad extenderé mis manos á Jehová, y los truenos cesarán, y no habrá más granizo; para que sepas que de Jehová es la tierra.

verses.KJV: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the Lord God.
verses.WEB: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear the LORD God.”
verses.ASV: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear Jehovah God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu sei que nem tu nem teus servos temereis todavia a presença do Deus o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo sé que ni tú ni tus siervos temeréis todavía la presencia del Dios Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.
verses.WEB: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.
verses.ASV: And the flax and the barley were smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was in bloom.
verses.ALMEIDA: O linho, pois, e a cevada foram feridos; porque a cevada estava já espigada, e o linho em flor.
verses.RVR09: El lino, pues, y la cebada fueron heridos; porque la cebada estaba ya espigada, y el lino en caña.

verses.KJV: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
verses.WEB: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.
verses.ASV: But the wheat and the spelt were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o trigo e o centeio não foram feridos; porque eram tardios.
verses.RVR09: Mas el trigo y el centeno no fueron heridos; porque eran tardíos.

verses.KJV: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the Lord: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
verses.WEB: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to the LORD; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.
verses.ASV: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto Jehovah: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saído Moisés da presença de Faraó da cidade, estendeu suas mãos ao SENHOR, e cessaram os trovões e o granizo; e a chuva não caiu mais sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y salido Moisés de con Faraón de la ciudad, extendió sus manos á Jehová, y cesaron los truenos y el granizo; y la lluvia no cayó más sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
verses.WEB: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
verses.ASV: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Faraó que a chuva havia cessado e o granizo e os trovões, perseverou em pecar, e agravou seu coração, ele e seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Faraón que la lluvia había cesado y el granizo y los truenos, perseveró en pecar, y agravó su corazón, él y sus siervos.

verses.KJV: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the Lord had spoken by Moses.
verses.WEB: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as the LORD had spoken through Moses.
verses.ASV: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the children of Israel go, as Jehovah had spoken by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não deixou ir aos filhos de Israel; como o SENHOR o havia dito por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y el corazón de Faraón se endureció, y no dejó ir á los hijos de Israel; como Jehová lo había dicho por medio de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show these my signs among them;
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I may show these my signs in the midst of them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Vai à presença de Faraó; porque agravei o coração dele, e o coração de seus servos, para fazer entre eles estes meus sinais;
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ dijo á Moisés: Entra á Faraón; porque yo he agravado su corazón, y el corazón de sus siervos, para dar entre ellos estas mis señales;

verses.KJV: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know that I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: and that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son’s son, what things I have wrought upon Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: e para que contes a teus filhos e a teus netos as coisas que eu fiz em Egito, e meus sinais que realizei entre eles; e para que saibais que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y para que cuentes á tus hijos y á tus nietos las cosas que yo hice en Egipto, y mis señales que dí entre ellos; y para que sepáis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vieram Moisés e Arão a Faraó, e lhe disseram: O SENHOR, o Deus dos hebreus disse assim: Até quando não quererás te humilhar diante de mim? Deixa ir a meu povo para que me sirvam.
verses.RVR09: Entonces vinieron Moisés y Aarón á Faraón, y le dijeron: Jehová, el Dios de los Hebreos, ha dicho así: ¿Hasta cuándo no querrás humillarte delante de mí? Deja ir á mi pueblo para que me sirvan.

verses.KJV: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:
verses.WEB: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,
verses.ASV: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to-morrow will I bring locusts into thy border:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se ainda recusas deixá-lo ir, eis que trarei amanhã gafanhotos em teu território,
verses.RVR09: Y si aun rehusas dejarlo ir, he aquí que yo traeré mañana langosta en tus términos,

verses.KJV: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
verses.WEB: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.
verses.ASV: and they shall cover the face of the earth, so that one shall not be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
verses.ALMEIDA: os quais cobrirão a face da terra, de modo que não se possa ver a terra; e ela comerá o que restou salvo, o que vos restou do granizo; comerão também toda árvore que vos produz fruto no campo;
verses.RVR09: La cual cubrirá la faz de la tierra, de modo que no pueda verse la tierra; y ella comerá lo que quedó salvo, lo que os ha quedado del granizo; comerá asimismo todo árbol que os produce fruto en el campo:

verses.KJV: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.
