verses.WEB: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, “Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt”;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que Faraó deixou ir ao povo, Deus não os levou pelo caminho da terra dos filisteus, que estava próxima; porque disse Deus: Que talvez não se arrependa o povo quando virem a guerra, e se voltem ao Egito:
verses.RVR09: Y luego que Faraón dejó ir al pueblo, Dios no los llevó por el camino de la tierra de los Filisteos, que estaba cerca; porque dijo Dios: Que quizá no se arrepienta el pueblo cuando vieren la guerra, y se vuelvan á Egipto:

verses.KJV: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: but God led the people about, by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea: and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas fez Deus ao povo que rodeasse pelo caminho do deserto do mar Vermelho. E subiram os filhos de Israel do Egito armados.
verses.RVR09: Mas hizo Dios al pueblo que rodease por el camino del desierto del mar Bermejo. Y subieron los hijos de Israel de Egipto armados.

verses.KJV: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
verses.WEB: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”
verses.ASV: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou também consigo Moisés os ossos de José, o qual havia juramentado aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Deus certamente vos visitará, e fareis subir meus ossos daqui convosco.
verses.RVR09: Tomó también consigo Moisés los huesos de José, el cual había juramentado á los hijos de Israel, diciendo: Dios ciertamente os visitará, y haréis subir mis huesos de aquí con vosotros.

verses.KJV: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.WEB: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.ASV: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Sucote, assentaram acampamento em Etã, à entrada do deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Succoth, asentaron campo en Etham, á la entrada del desierto.

verses.KJV: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verses.WEB: The LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:
verses.ASV: And Jehovah went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them the way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; that they might go by day and by night:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR ia diante deles de dia em uma coluna de nuvem, para guiá-los pelo caminho; e de noite em uma coluna de fogo para iluminá-los, a fim de que andassem de dia e de noite.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová iba delante de ellos de día en una columna de nube, para guiarlos por el camino; y de noche en una columna de fuego para alumbrarles; á fin de que anduviesen de día y de noche.

verses.KJV: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
verses.WEB: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.
verses.ASV: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, departed not from before the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca se partiu de diante do povo a coluna de nuvem de dia, nem de noite a coluna de fogo.
verses.RVR09: Nunca se partió de delante del pueblo la columna de nube de día, ni de noche la columna de fuego.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal-zephon: over against it shall ye encamp by the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel que deem a volta, e assentem seu acampamento diante de Pi-Hairote, entre Migdol e o mar até Baal-Zefom: diante dele assentareis o campo, junto ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel que den la vuelta, y asienten su campo delante de Pihahiroth, entre Migdol y la mar hacia Baalzephón: delante de él asentaréis el campo, junto á la mar.

verses.KJV: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’
verses.ASV: And Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Faraó dirá dos filhos de Israel: Estão andando confusos na terra, o deserto os encurralou.
verses.RVR09: Porque Faraón dirá de los hijos de Israel: Encerrados están en la tierra, el desierto los ha encerrado.

verses.KJV: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the Lord. And they did so.
verses.WEB: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD.” They did so.
verses.ASV: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he shall follow after them; and I will get me honor upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host: and the Egyptians shall know that I am Jehovah. And they did so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu endurecerei o coração de Faraó para que os siga; e serei glorificado em Faraó e em todo o seu exército; e saberão os egípcios que eu sou o SENHOR. E eles o fizeram assim.
verses.RVR09: Y yo endureceré el corazón de Faraón para que los siga; y seré glorificado en Faraón y en todo su ejército; y sabrán los Egipcios que yo soy Jehová. Y ellos lo hicieron así.

verses.KJV: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
verses.WEB: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”
verses.ASV: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people were fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed towards the people, and they said, What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dado aviso ao rei do Egito como o povo se fugia: e o coração de Faraó e de seus servos se voltou contra o povo, e disseram: Como fizemos isto de haver deixado ir a Israel, para que não nos sirva?
verses.RVR09: Y fué dado aviso al rey de Egipto cómo el pueblo se huía: y el corazón de Faraón y de sus siervos se volvió contra el pueblo, y dijeron: ¿Cómo hemos hecho esto de haber dejado ir á Israel, para que no nos sirva?

verses.KJV: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
verses.WEB: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him;
verses.ASV: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E preparou seu carro, e tomou consigo seu povo;
verses.RVR09: Y unció su carro, y tomó consigo su pueblo;

verses.KJV: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
verses.WEB: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.
verses.ASV: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over all of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: e tomou seiscentos carros escolhidos, e todos os carros do Egito, e os capitães sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó seiscientos carros escogidos, y todos los carros de Egipto, y los capitanes sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
verses.WEB: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E endureceu o SENHOR o coração de Faraó rei do Egito, e seguiu aos filhos de Israel; mas os filhos de Israel haviam saído com mão poderosa.
verses.RVR09: Y endureció Jehová el corazón de Faraón rey de Egipto, y siguió á los hijos de Israel; pero los hijos de Israel habían salido con mano poderosa.

verses.KJV: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
verses.WEB: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.
verses.ASV: And the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses [and] chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seguindo-os, pois, os egípcios, com toda a cavalaria e carros de Faraó, seus cavaleiros, e todo seu exército, alcançaram-nos assentando o acampamento junto ao mar, ao lado de Pi-Hairote, diante de Baal-Zefom.
verses.RVR09: Siguiéndolos, pues, los Egipcios, con toda la caballería y carros de Faraón, su gente de á caballo, y todo su ejército, alcanzáronlos asentando el campo junto á la mar, al lado de Pihahiroth, delante de Baalzephón.

verses.KJV: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Faraó se aproximou, os filhos de Israel levantaram seus olhos, e eis que os egípcios vinham atrás deles; por isso temeram muito, e os filhos de Israel clamaram ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Faraón se hubo acercado, los hijos de Israel alzaron sus ojos, y he aquí los Egipcios que venían tras ellos; por lo que temieron en gran manera, y clamaron los hijos de Israel á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
verses.WEB: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?
verses.ASV: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to bring us forth out of Egypt?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram a Moisés: Não havia sepulcros no Egito, que nos tiraste para morrermos no deserto? Por que o fizeste assim conosco, que nos tiraste do Egito?
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron á Moisés: ¿No había sepulcros en Egipto, que nos has sacado para que muramos en el desierto? ¿Por qué lo has hecho así con nosotros, que nos has sacado de Egipto?

verses.KJV: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”
verses.ASV: Is not this the word that we spake unto thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it were better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é isto o que te falamos no Egito, dizendo: Deixa-nos servir aos egípcios? Pois melhor nos teria sido servir aos egípcios, que morrermos no deserto.
verses.RVR09: ¿No es esto lo que te hablamos en Egipto, diciendo: Déjanos servir á los Egipcios? Que mejor nos fuera servir á los Egipcios, que morir nosotros en el desierto.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.WEB: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of Jehovah, which he will work for you to-day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to-day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés disse ao povo: Não temais; ficai quietos, e vede a salvação do SENHOR, que ele fará hoje convosco; porque os egípcios que hoje vistes, nunca mais para sempre os vereis.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés dijo al pueblo: No temáis; estáos quedos, y ved la salud de Jehová, que él hará hoy con vosotros; porque los Egipcios que hoy habéis visto, nunca más para siempre los veréis.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.WEB: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
verses.ASV: Jehovah will fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR lutará por vós, e vós ficai quietos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová peleará por vosotros, y vosotros estaréis quedos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: “Por que clamas a mim? Diz aos filhos de Israel que marchem.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Moisés: ¿Por qué clamas á mí? di á los hijos de Israel que marchen:

verses.KJV: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
verses.WEB: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground.
verses.ASV: And lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thy hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go into the midst of the sea on dry ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto a ti, ergue a tua vara, estende a tua mão sobre o mar, e divide-o. Que os filhos de Israel entre por meio do mar em seco.
verses.RVR09: Y tú alza tu vara, y extiende tu mano sobre la mar, y divídela; y entren los hijos de Israel por medio de la mar en seco.

verses.KJV: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.WEB: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.
verses.ASV: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall go in after them: and I will get me honor upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu, eis que endurecerei o coração dos egípcios, para que os sigam. E eu me glorificarei em Faraó, e em todo o seu exército, e em suas carruagens, e em sua cavalaria;
verses.RVR09: Y yo, he aquí yo endureceré el corazón de los Egipcios, para que los sigan: y yo me glorificaré en Faraón, y en todo su ejército, y en sus carros, y en su caballería;

verses.KJV: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.WEB: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”
verses.ASV: And the Egyptians shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have gotten me honor upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os egípcios saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu me glorificar em Faraó, em seus carros, e em seus cavaleiros.”
verses.RVR09: Y sabrán los Egipcios que yo soy Jehová, cuando me glorificaré en Faraón, en sus carros, y en su gente de á caballo.

verses.KJV: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
verses.WEB: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.
verses.ASV: And the angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud removed from before them, and stood behind them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo de Deus que ia diante do acampamento de Israel, se separou, e ia detrás deles; e também a coluna de nuvem que ia diante deles, separou-se, e pôs-se atrás deles;
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel de Dios que iba delante del campo de Israel, se apartó, é iba en pos de ellos; y asimismo la columna de nube que iba delante de ellos, se apartó, y púsose á sus espaldas:

verses.KJV: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
verses.WEB: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.
verses.ASV: and it came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel; and there was the cloud and the darkness, yet gave it light by night: and the one came not near the other all the night.
verses.ALMEIDA: e ia entre o acampamento dos egípcios e o acampamento de Israel; e era nuvem e trevas para aqueles, e iluminava a Israel de noite; e em toda aquela noite não se aproximaram uns dos outros.
verses.RVR09: E iba entre el campo de los Egipcios y el campo de Israel; y era nube y tinieblas para aquéllos, y alumbraba á Israel de noche: y en toda aquella noche nunca llegaron los unos á los otros.

verses.KJV: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.WEB: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.ASV: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Jehovah caused the sea to go [back] by a strong east wind all the night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estendeu Moisés sua mão sobre o mar, e fez o SENHOR que o mar se retirasse por forte vento oriental toda aquela noite; e tornou o mar em seco, e as águas restaram divididas.
verses.RVR09: Y extendió Moisés su mano sobre la mar, é hizo Jehová que la mar se retirase por recio viento oriental toda aquella noche; y tornó la mar en seco, y las aguas quedaron divididas.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os filhos de Israel entraram por meio do mar em seco, tendo as águas como muro à sua direita e à sua esquerda;
verses.RVR09: Entonces los hijos de Israel entraron por medio de la mar en seco, teniendo las aguas como muro á su diestra y á su siniestra:

verses.KJV: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.WEB: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.ASV: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the midst of the sea, all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seguindo-os os egípcios, entraram atrás deles até o meio do mar, toda a cavalaria de Faraó, seus carros, e seus cavaleiros.
verses.RVR09: Y siguiéndolos los Egipcios, entraron tras ellos hasta el medio de la mar, toda la caballería de Faraón, sus carros, y su gente de á caballo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
verses.WEB: In the morning watch, the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning watch, that Jehovah looked forth upon the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and discomfited the host of the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu à vigília da manhã, que o SENHOR olhou ao campo dos egípcios desde a coluna de fogo e nuvem, e perturbou o acampamento dos egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció á la vela de la mañana, que Jehová miró al campo de los Egipcios desde la columna de fuego y nube, y perturbó el campo de los Egipcios.

verses.KJV: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the Lord fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians!”
verses.ASV: And he took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for Jehovah fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirou-lhes as rodas de seus carros, e transtornou-os gravemente. Então os egípcios disseram: Fujamos de diante de Israel, porque o SENHOR luta por eles contra os egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Y quitóles las ruedas de sus carros, y trastornólos gravemente. Entonces los Egipcios dijeron: Huyamos de delante de Israel, porque Jehová pelea por ellos contra los Egipcios.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Stretch out thy hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Estende tua mão sobre o mar, para que as águas voltem sobre os egípcios, sobre seus carros, e sobre sua cavalaria.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Extiende tu mano sobre la mar, para que las aguas vuelvan sobre los Egipcios, sobre sus carros, y sobre su caballería.

verses.KJV: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
verses.WEB: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. The LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.
verses.ASV: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and Jehovah overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés estendeu sua mão sobre o mar, e o mar se voltou em sua força quando amanhecia; e os egípcios iam até ela: e o SENHOR derrubou aos egípcios em meio do mar.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés extendió su mano sobre la mar, y la mar se volvió en su fuerza cuando amanecía; y los Egipcios iban hacia ella: y Jehová derribó á los Egipcios en medio de la mar.

verses.KJV: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
verses.WEB: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.
verses.ASV: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, even all the host of Pharaoh that went in after them into the sea; there remained not so much as one of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltaram as águas, e cobriram os carros e a cavalaria, e todo o exército de Faraó que havia entrado atrás eles no mar; não restou deles nenhum.
verses.RVR09: Y volvieron las aguas, y cubrieron los carros y la caballería, y todo el ejército de Faraón que había entrado tras ellos en la mar; no quedó de ellos ni uno.

verses.KJV: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.WEB: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
verses.ASV: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel foram por meio do mar em seco, tendo as águas por muro à sua direita e à sua esquerda.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Israel fueron por medio de la mar en seco, teniendo las aguas por muro á su diestra y á su siniestra.

verses.KJV: Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
verses.WEB: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
verses.ASV: Thus Jehovah saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea-shore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim salvou o SENHOR aquele dia a Israel da mão dos egípcios; e Israel viu aos egípcios mortos à beira do mar.
verses.RVR09: Así salvó Jehová aquel día á Israel de mano de los Egipcios; é Israel vió á los Egipcios muertos á la orilla de la mar.

verses.KJV: And Israel saw that great work which the Lord did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses.
verses.WEB: Israel saw the great work which the LORD did to the Egyptians, and the people feared the LORD; and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses.
verses.ASV: And Israel saw the great work which Jehovah did upon the Egyptians, and the people feared Jehovah: and they believed in Jehovah, and in his servant Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu Israel aquele grande feito que o SENHOR executou contra os egípcios: e o povo temeu ao SENHOR, e creram no SENHOR e em Moisés seu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Israel aquel grande hecho que Jehová ejecutó contra los Egipcios: y el pueblo temió á Jehová, y creyeron á Jehová y á Moisés su siervo.

verses.KJV: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.WEB: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD, and said, “I will sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
verses.ASV: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto Jehovah, and spake, saying, I will sing unto Jehovah, for he hath triumphed gloriously: The horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então cantou Moisés e os filhos de Israel este cântico ao SENHOR, e disseram: Cantarei eu ao SENHOR, porque se triunfou grandemente, Lançando no mar ao cavalo e ao que nele subia.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES cantó Moisés y los hijos de Israel este cántico á Jehová, y dijeron: Cantaré yo á Jehová, porque se ha magnificado grandemente, echando en la mar al caballo y al que en él subía.

verses.KJV: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
verses.WEB: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is my strength and song, And he is become my salvation: This is my God, and I will praise him; My father’s God, and I will exalt him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é minha força, e minha canção, E foi-me por salvação: Este é meu Deus, e a este engrandecerei; Deus de meu pai, e a este exaltarei.
verses.RVR09: Jehová es mi fortaleza, y mi canción, y hame sido por salud: éste es mi Dios, y á éste engrandeceré; Dios de mi padre, y á éste ensalzaré.

verses.KJV: The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name.
verses.WEB: The LORD is a man of war. The LORD is his name.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is a man of war: Jehovah is his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR, homem de guerra; o SENHOR é seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, varón de guerra; Jehová es su nombre.

verses.KJV: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
verses.WEB: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
verses.ASV: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea; And his chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os carros de Faraó e a seu exército lançou no mar; E seus escolhidos príncipes foram afundados no mar Vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Los carros de Faraón y á su ejército echó en la mar; y sus escogidos príncipes fueron hundidos en el mar Bermejo.

verses.KJV: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
verses.WEB: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
verses.ASV: The deeps cover them: They went down into the depths like a stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os abismos os cobriram; Como pedra desceram aos profundos.
verses.RVR09: Los abismos los cubrieron; como piedra descendieron á los profundos.

verses.KJV: Thy right hand, O Lord, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
verses.WEB: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces.
verses.ASV: Thy right hand, O Jehovah, is glorious in power, Thy right hand, O Jehovah, dasheth in pieces the enemy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua mão direita, ó SENHOR, foi engrandecida em força; Tua mão direita, ó SENHOR, quebrantou ao inimigo.
verses.RVR09: Tu diestra, oh Jehová, ha sido magnificada en fortaleza; tu diestra, oh Jehová, ha quebrantado al enemigo.

verses.KJV: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
verses.WEB: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.
verses.ASV: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou overthrowest them that rise up against thee: Thou sendest forth thy wrath, it consumeth them as stubble.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com a grandeza de tua poder transtornaste aos que se levantaram contra ti: Enviaste teu furor; os tragou como o restolho.
verses.RVR09: Y con la grandeza de tu poder has trastornado á los que se levantaron contra ti: enviaste tu furor; los tragó como á hojarasca.

verses.KJV: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.WEB: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.ASV: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were piled up, The floods stood upright as a heap; The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o sopro de tuas narinas se amontoaram as águas; Pararam-se as correntezas como em um amontoado; Os abismos se solidificaram em meio do mar.
verses.RVR09: Con el soplo de tus narices se amontonaron las aguas; paráronse las corrientes como en un montón; los abismos se cuajaron en medio de la mar.

verses.KJV: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
verses.WEB: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’
verses.ASV: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; My desire shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
verses.ALMEIDA: O inimigo disse: Perseguirei, prenderei, repartirei despojos; Minha alma se encherá deles; Tirarei minha espada, minha mão os destruirá.
verses.RVR09: El enemigo dijo: Perseguiré, prenderé, repartiré despojos; mi alma se henchirá de ellos; sacaré mi espada, destruirlos ha mi mano.

verses.KJV: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
verses.WEB: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
verses.ASV: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: They sank as lead in the mighty waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sopraste com teu vento, cobriu-os o mar: Afundaram-se como chumbo nas impetuosas águas.
verses.RVR09: Soplaste con tu viento, cubriólos la mar: hundiéronse como plomo en las impetuosas aguas.

verses.KJV: Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.WEB: Who is like you, LORD, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.ASV: Who is like unto thee, O Jehovah, among the gods? Who is like thee, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem como tu, SENHOR, entre os deuses? Quem como tu, magnífico em santidade, Terrível em louvores, autor de maravilhas?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién como tú, Jehová, entre los dioses? ¿quién como tú, magnífico en santidad, terrible en loores, hacedor de maravillas?

verses.KJV: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
verses.WEB: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.
verses.ASV: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, The earth swallowed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estendeste a tua mão direita; a terra os tragou.
verses.RVR09: Extendiste tu diestra; la tierra los tragó.

verses.KJV: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
verses.WEB: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
verses.ASV: Thou in thy lovingkindness hast led the people that thou hast redeemed: Thou hast guided them in thy strength to thy holy habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conduziste em tua misericórdia a este povo, ao qual salvaste; Levaste-o com tua força à habitação de teu santuário.
verses.RVR09: Condujiste en tu misericordia á este pueblo, al cual salvaste; llevástelo con tu fortaleza á la habitación de tu santuario.

verses.KJV: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
verses.WEB: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
verses.ASV: The peoples have heard, they tremble: Pangs have taken hold on the inhabitants of Philistia.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouviram-no os povos, e tremerão; Dor se apoderará dos moradores da filístia.
verses.RVR09: Oiránlo los pueblos, y temblarán; apoderarse ha dolor de los moradores de Palestina.

verses.KJV: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
verses.WEB: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
verses.ASV: Then were the chiefs of Edom dismayed; The mighty men of Moab, trembling taketh hold upon them: All the inhabitants of Canaan are melted away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os príncipes de Edom se perturbarão; Aos robustos de Moabe os ocupará tremor; Todos os moradores de Canaã se abaterão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los príncipes de Edom se turbarán; á los robustos de Moab los ocupará temblor; abatirse han todos los moradores de Canaán.

verses.KJV: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O Lord, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.
verses.WEB: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, LORD, until the people you have purchased pass over.
verses.ASV: Terror and dread falleth upon them; By the greatness of thine arm they are as still as a stone; Till thy people pass over, O Jehovah, Till the people pass over that thou hast purchased.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caia sobre eles tremor e espanto; À grandeza de teu braço emudeçam como uma pedra; Até que tenha passado teu povo, ó SENHOR, Até que tenha passado este povo que tu resgataste.
verses.RVR09: Caiga sobre ellos temblor y espanto; á la grandeza de tu brazo enmudezcan como una piedra; hasta que haya pasado tu pueblo, oh Jehová, hasta que haya pasado este pueblo que tú rescataste.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O Lord, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.
verses.WEB: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, LORD, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, The place, O Jehovah, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, The sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu os introduzirás e os plantarás no monte de tua herança, No lugar de tua morada, que tu preparaste, ó SENHOR; No santuário do Senhor, que firmaram tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Tú los introducirás y los plantarás en el monte de tu heredad, en el lugar de tu morada, que tú has aparejado, oh Jehová; en el santuario del Señor, que han afirmado tus manos.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”
verses.ASV: Jehovah shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR reinará pelos séculos dos séculos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová reinará por los siglos de los siglos.

verses.KJV: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
verses.WEB: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.
verses.ASV: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Jehovah brought back the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the midst of the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Faraó entrou cavalgando com seus carros e seus cavaleiros no mar, e o SENHOR voltou a trazer as águas do mar sobre eles; mas os filhos de Israel foram a seco por meio do mar.
verses.RVR09: Porque Faraón entró cabalgando con sus carros y su gente de á caballo en la mar, y Jehová volvió á traer las aguas de la mar sobre ellos; mas los hijos de Israel fueron en seco por medio de la mar.

verses.KJV: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
verses.WEB: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
verses.ASV: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Miriã a profetisa, irmã de Arão, tomou um pandeiro em sua mão, e todas as mulheres saíram atrás dela com pandeiros e danças.
verses.RVR09: Y María la profetisa, hermana de Aarón, tomó un pandero en su mano, y todas las mujeres salieron en pos de ella con panderos y danzas;

verses.KJV: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.WEB: Miriam answered them, “Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”
verses.ASV: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to Jehovah, for he hath triumphed gloriously; The horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Miriã lhes respondia: Cantai ao SENHOR; porque em extremo se engrandeceu, Lançando no mar ao cavalo, e ao que nele subia.
verses.RVR09: Y María les respondía: Cantad á Jehová; porque en extremo se ha engrandecido, echando en la mar al caballo, y al que en él subía.

verses.KJV: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.WEB: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.ASV: And Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Moisés que partisse Israel do mar Vermelho, e saíram ao deserto de Sur; e andaram três dias pelo deserto sem achar água.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Moisés que partiese Israel del mar Bermejo, y salieron al desierto de Shur; y anduvieron tres días por el desierto sin hallar agua.

verses.KJV: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
verses.WEB: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
verses.ASV: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram a Mara, e não puderam beber as águas de Mara, porque eram amargas; por isso lhe puseram o nome de Mara.
verses.RVR09: Y llegaron á Mara, y no pudieron beber las aguas de Mara, porque eran amargas; por eso le pusieron el nombre de Mara.

verses.KJV: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
verses.WEB: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”
verses.ASV: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o povo murmurou contra Moisés, e disse: Que beberemos?
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pueblo murmuró contra Moisés, y dijo: ¿Qué hemos de beber?

verses.KJV: And he cried unto the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
verses.WEB: Then he cried to the LORD. The LORD showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.
verses.ASV: And he cried unto Jehovah; and Jehovah showed him a tree, and he cast it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés clamou ao SENHOR; e o SENHOR lhe mostrou uma árvore, a qual quando a meteu dentro das águas, as águas se tornaram doces. Ali lhes deu estatutos e ordenanças, e ali os provou;
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés clamó á Jehová; y Jehová le mostró un árbol, el cual metídolo que hubo dentro de las aguas, las aguas se endulzaron. Allí les dió estatutos y ordenanzas, y allí los probó;

verses.KJV: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.
verses.WEB: He said, “If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am the LORD who heals you.”
verses.ASV: and he said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of Jehovah thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his eyes, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases upon thee, which I have put upon the Egyptians: for I am Jehovah that healeth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Se ouvires atentamente a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, e fizeres o correto diante de seus olhos, e deres ouvido a seus mandamentos, e guardares todos os seus estatutos, nenhuma enfermidade das que enviei aos egípcios te enviarei a ti; porque eu sou o SENHOR que te sara.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Si oyeres atentamente la voz de Jehová tu Dios, é hicieres lo recto delante de sus ojos, y dieres oído á sus mandamientos, y guardares todos sus estatutos, ninguna enfermedad de las que envié á los Egipcios te enviaré á ti; porque yo soy Jehová tu Sanador.

verses.KJV: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
verses.WEB: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.
verses.ASV: And they came to Elim, where were twelve springs of water, and threescore and ten palm-trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram a Elim, onde havia doze fontes de águas, e setenta palmeiras; e assentaram ali junto às águas.
verses.RVR09: Y llegaron á Elim, donde había doce fuentes de aguas, y setenta palmas; y asentaron allí junto á las aguas.

verses.KJV: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois que partiram de Elim, toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel veio ao deserto de Sim, que está entre Elim e Sinai, aos quinze dias do segundo mês depois que saíram da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y PARTIENDO de Elim toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, vino al desierto de Sin, que está entre Elim y Sinaí, á los quince días del segundo mes después que salieron de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
verses.WEB: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;
verses.ASV: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness:
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel murmurou contra Moisés e Arão no deserto;
verses.RVR09: Y toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel murmuró contra Moisés y Aarón en el desierto;

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
verses.WEB: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”
verses.ASV: and the children of Israel said unto them, Would that we had died by the hand of Jehovah in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh-pots, when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
verses.ALMEIDA: E diziam-lhes os filhos de Israel: Bom seria se tivéssemos morrido por meio do SENHOR na terra do Egito, quando nos sentávamos junto às panelas das carnes, quando comíamos pão em fartura; pois nos tirastes a este deserto, para matar de fome a toda esta multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y decíanles los hijos de Israel: Ojalá hubiéramos muerto por mano de Jehová en la tierra de Egipto, cuando nos sentábamos á las ollas de las carnes, cuando comíamos pan en hartura; pues nos habéis sacado á este desierto, para matar de hambre á toda esta multitud.

verses.KJV: Then said the Lord unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.
verses.ASV: Then said Jehovah unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Eis que eu vos farei chover pão do céu; e o povo sairá, e colherá para cada um dia, para que eu lhe prove se anda em minha lei, ou não.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: He aquí yo os haré llover pan del cielo; y el pueblo saldrá, y cogerá para cada un día, para que yo le pruebe si anda en mi ley, ó no.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
verses.WEB: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao sexto dia prepararão o que coletarem, que será o dobro do que costumam colher cada dia.
verses.RVR09: Mas al sexto día aparejarán lo que han de encerrar, que será el doble de lo que solían coger cada día.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the Lord hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that Jehovah hath brought you out from the land of Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Moisés e Arão a todos os filhos de Israel: À tarde sabereis que o SENHOR vos tirou da terra do Egito:
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Moisés y Aarón á todos los hijos de Israel: A la tarde sabréis que Jehová os ha sacado de la tierra de Egipto:

verses.KJV: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the Lord; for that he heareth your murmurings against the Lord: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
verses.WEB: In the morning, you shall see the LORD’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”
verses.ASV: and in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of Jehovah; for that he heareth your murmurings against Jehovah: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
verses.ALMEIDA: E à próxima manhã vereis a glória do SENHOR; porque ele ouviu as vossas murmurações contra o SENHOR; pois quem somos nós, para que vós murmureis contra nós?
verses.RVR09: Y á la mañana veréis la gloria de Jehová; porque él ha oído vuestras murmuraciones contra Jehová; que nosotros, ¿qué somos, para que vosotros murmuréis contra nosotros?

verses.KJV: And Moses said, This shall be, when the Lord shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the Lord heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “Now the LORD will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said, [This shall be], when Jehovah shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that Jehovah heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés: o SENHOR vos dará à tarde carne para comer, e à manhã pão em fartura; pois o SENHOR ouviu as vossas murmurações com que murmurais contra ele; pois quem somos nós? As vossas murmurações não são contra nós, mas sim contra o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés: Jehová os dará á la tarde carne para comer, y á la mañana pan en hartura; por cuanto Jehová ha oído vuestras murmuraciones con que habéis murmurado contra él: que nosotros, ¿qué somos? vuestras murmuraciones no son contra nosotros, sino contra Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the Lord: for he hath heard your murmurings.
verses.WEB: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to the LORD, for he has heard your murmurings.’”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before Jehovah; for he hath heard your murmurings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés a Arão: Dize a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel: Aproximai-vos à presença do SENHOR; que ele ouviu vossas murmurações.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Aarón: Di á toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel: Acercaos á la presencia de Jehová; que él ha oído vuestras murmuraciones.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.
verses.WEB: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the LORD’s glory appeared in the cloud.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of Jehovah appeared in the cloud.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falando Arão a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, olharam até o deserto, e eis a glória do SENHOR, que apareceu na nuvem.
verses.RVR09: Y hablando Aarón á toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, miraron hacia el desierto, y he aquí la gloria de Jehová, que apareció en la nube.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”
verses.ASV: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu ouvi as murmurações dos filhos de Israel; fala-lhes, dizendo: Ao entardecer comereis carne, e pela manhã vos fartareis de pão, e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Yo he oído las murmuraciones de los hijos de Israel; háblales, diciendo: Entre las dos tardes comeréis carne, y por la mañana os hartaréis de pan, y sabréis que yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
verses.WEB: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at even, that the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vinda a tarde subiram codornizes que cobriram o acampamento; e à manhã desceu orvalho em derredor do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y venida la tarde subieron codornices que cubrieron el real; y á la mañana descendió rocío en derredor del real.

verses.KJV: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
verses.WEB: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
verses.ASV: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness a small round thing, small as the hoar-frost on the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o orvalho cessou de descer, eis sobre a face do deserto uma coisa miúda, redonda, miúda como uma geada sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y como el rocío cesó de descender, he aquí sobre la haz del desierto una cosa menuda, redonda, menuda como una helada sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the Lord hath given you to eat.
verses.WEB: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.
verses.ASV: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, What is it? for they knew not what it was. And Moses said unto them, It is the bread which Jehovah hath given you to eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo-o os filhos de Israel, se disseram uns aos outros: Que é isto? porque não sabiam que era. Então Moisés lhes disse: É o pão que o SENHOR vos dá para comer.
verses.RVR09: Y viéndolo los hijos de Israel, se dijeron unos á otros: ¿Qué es esto? porque no sabían qué era. Entonces Moisés les dijo: Es el pan que Jehová os da para comer.

verses.KJV: This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.
verses.WEB: This is the thing which the LORD has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”
verses.ASV: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, Gather ye of it every man according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, shall ye take it, every man for them that are in his tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou: Colhereis dele cada um segundo puder comer; um gômer por cabeça, conforme o número de vossas pessoas, tomareis cada um para os que estão em sua tenda.
verses.RVR09: Esto es lo que Jehová ha mandado: cogeréis de él cada uno según pudiere comer; un gomer por cabeza, conforme al número de vuestras personas, tomaréis cada uno para los que están en su tienda.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered some more, some less.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel o fizeram assim: e recolheram uns mais, outros menos:
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Israel lo hicieron así: y recogieron unos más, otros menos:

verses.KJV: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
verses.WEB: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.
verses.ASV: And when they measured it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mediam-no por gômer, e não sobrava ao que havia recolhido muito, nem faltava ao que havia recolhido pouco: cada um recolheu conforme o que havia de comer.
verses.RVR09: Y medíanlo por gomer, y no sobraba al que había recogido mucho, ni faltaba al que había recogido poco: cada uno recogió conforme á lo que había de comer.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
verses.WEB: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto them, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes Moisés: Nenhum deixe nada disso para amanhã.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Moisés: Ninguno deje nada de ello para mañana.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
verses.WEB: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.
verses.ASV: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and became foul: and Moses was wroth with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles não obedeceram a Moisés, mas sim que alguns deixaram dele para outro dia, e criou bichos, e apodreceu-se; e irou-se contra eles Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos no obedecieron á Moisés, sino que algunos dejaron de ello para otro día, y crió gusanos, y pudrióse; y enojóse contra ellos Moisés.

verses.KJV: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
verses.WEB: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.
verses.ASV: And they gathered it morning by morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E recolhiam-no cada manhã, cada um segundo o que havia de comer: e logo que o sol aquecia, derretia-se.
verses.RVR09: Y recogíanlo cada mañana, cada uno según lo que había de comer: y luego que el sol calentaba, derretíase.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
verses.WEB: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: No sexto dia recolheram comida em dobro, dois gômeres para cada um; e todos os príncipes da congregação vieram a Moisés, e contaram-lhe isso.
verses.RVR09: En el sexto día recogieron doblada comida, dos gomeres para cada uno: y todos los príncipes de la congregación vinieron á Moisés, y se lo hicieron saber.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, This is that which the Lord hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the Lord: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “This is that which the LORD has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, This is that which Jehovah hath spoken, To-morrow is a solemn rest, a holy sabbath unto Jehovah: bake that which ye will bake, and boil that which ye will boil; and all that remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Isto é o que o SENHOR disse: Amanhã é o repouso, o santo sábado do SENHOR; o que houverdes de assar, assai-o hoje, e o que houverdes de cozinhar, cozinhai-o; e tudo o que vos sobrar, guardai-o para amanhã.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Esto es lo que ha dicho Jehová: Mañana es el santo sábado, el reposo de Jehová: lo que hubiereis de cocer, cocedlo hoy, y lo que hubiereis de cocinar, cocinadlo; y todo lo que os sobrare, guardadlo para mañana.

verses.KJV: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
verses.WEB: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.
verses.ASV: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not become foul, neither was there any worm therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles o guardaram até a manhã, segundo que Moisés havia mandado, e não se apodreceu, nem houve nele bicho.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos lo guardaron hasta la mañana, según que Moisés había mandado, y no se pudrió, ni hubo en él gusano.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the Lord: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.
verses.ASV: And Moses said, Eat that to-day; for to-day is a sabbath unto Jehovah: to-day ye shall not find it in the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés: Comei-o hoje, porque hoje é sábado do SENHOR: hoje não achareis no campo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés: Comedlo hoy, porque hoy es sábado de Jehová: hoy no hallaréis en el campo.

verses.KJV: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
verses.WEB: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”
verses.ASV: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nos seis dias o recolhereis; mas o sétimo dia é sábado, no qual não se achará.
verses.RVR09: En los seis días lo recogeréis; mas el séptimo día es sábado, en el cual no se hallará.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
verses.WEB: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that there went out some of the people to gather, and they found none.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que alguns do povo saíram no sétimo dia a recolher, e não acharam.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que algunos del pueblo salieron en el séptimo día á recoger, y no hallaron.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Até quando não querereis guardar meus mandamentos e minhas leis?
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: ¿Hasta cuándo no querréis guardar mis mandamientos y mis leyes?

verses.KJV: See, for that the Lord hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
verses.WEB: Behold, because the LORD has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”
verses.ASV: See, for that Jehovah hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai que o SENHOR vos deu o sábado, e por isso vos dá no sexto dia pão para dois dias. Fique, pois, cada um em sua morada, e ninguém saia de seu lugar no sétimo dia.
verses.RVR09: Mirad que Jehová os dió el sábado, y por eso os da en el sexto día pan para dos días. Estése, pues, cada uno en su estancia, y nadie salga de su lugar en el séptimo día.

verses.KJV: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.WEB: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.ASV: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o povo repousou o sétimo dia.
verses.RVR09: Así el pueblo reposó el séptimo día.

verses.KJV: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
verses.WEB: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
verses.ASV: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers [made] with honey.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a casa de Israel o chamou maná; e era como semente de coentro, branco, e seu sabor como de bolos com mel.
verses.RVR09: Y la casa de Israel lo llamó Maná; y era como simiente de culantro, blanco, y su sabor como de hojuelas con miel.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
verses.ASV: And Moses said, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, Let an omerful of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread wherewith I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou: Encherás um gômer dele para que se guarde para vossos descendentes, a fim de que vejam o pão que eu vos dei a comer no deserto, quando eu vos tirei da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés: Esto es lo que Jehová ha mandado: Henchirás un gomer de él para que se guarde para vuestros descendientes, á fin de que vean el pan que yo os dí á comer en el desierto, cuando yo os saqué de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the Lord, to be kept for your generations.
verses.WEB: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept throughout your generations.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omerful of manna therein, and lay it up before Jehovah, to be kept throughout your generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés a Arão: Toma um vaso e põe nele um gômer cheio de maná, e põe-o diante do SENHOR, para que seja guardado para vossos descendentes.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Aarón: Toma un vaso, y pon en él un gomer lleno de maná, y ponlo delante de Jehová, para que sea guardado para vuestros descendientes.

verses.KJV: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.WEB: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.ASV: As Jehovah commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Arão o pôs diante do testemunho para guardá-lo, como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y Aarón lo puso delante del Testimonio para guardarlo, como Jehová lo mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel did eat the manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat the manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os filhos de Israel comeram maná por quarenta anos, até que entraram em terra habitada; comeram maná até que chegaram ao limite da terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Así comieron los hijos de Israel maná cuarenta años, hasta que entraron en la tierra habitada: maná comieron hasta que llegaron al término de la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
verses.WEB: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.
verses.ASV: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um gômer é a décima parte do efa.
verses.RVR09: Y un gomer es la décima parte del epha.

verses.KJV: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.WEB: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the LORD’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.ASV: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, by their journeys, according to the commandment of Jehovah, and encamped in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel partiu do deserto de Sim, por suas jornadas, ao mandamento do SENHOR, e assentaram o acampamento em Refidim: e não havia água para que o povo bebesse.
verses.RVR09: Y TODA la congregación de los hijos de Israel partió del desierto de Sin, por sus jornadas, al mandamiento de Jehová, y asentaron el campo en Rephidim: y no había agua para que el pueblo bebiese.

verses.KJV: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the Lord?
verses.WEB: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the LORD?”
verses.ASV: Wherefore the people strove with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why strive ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: E brigou o povo com Moisés, e disseram: Dá-nos água que bebamos. E Moisés lhes disse: Por que brigais comigo? Por que tentais ao SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Y altercó el pueblo con Moisés, y dijeron: Danos agua que bebamos. Y Moisés les dijo: ¿Por qué altercáis conmigo? ¿por qué tentáis á Jehová?

verses.KJV: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
verses.WEB: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”
verses.ASV: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore hast thou brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
