verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que o povo teve ali sede de água, e murmurou contra Moisés, e disse: Por que nos fizeste subir do Egito para matar-nos de sede a nós, e a nossos filhos e a nossos gados?
verses.RVR09: Así que el pueblo tuvo allí sed de agua, y murmuró contra Moisés, y dijo: ¿Por qué nos hiciste subir de Egipto, para matarnos de sed á nosotros, y á nuestros hijos, y á nuestros ganados?

verses.KJV: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
verses.WEB: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
verses.ASV: And Moses cried unto Jehovah, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they are almost ready to stone me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então clamou Moisés ao SENHOR, dizendo: Que farei com este povo? Daqui um pouco me apedrejarão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces clamó Moisés á Jehová, diciendo: ¿Qué haré con este pueblo? de aquí á un poco me apedrearán.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Pass on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thy hand, and go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Passa diante do povo, e toma contigo dos anciãos de Israel; e toma também em tua mão tua vara, com que feriste o rio, e vai:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Pasa delante del pueblo, y toma contigo de los ancianos de Israel; y toma también en tu mano tu vara, con que heriste el río, y ve:

verses.KJV: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu estou diante de ti ali sobre a rocha em Horebe; e ferirás a rocha, e sairão dela águas, e beberá o povo. E Moisés o fez assim em presença dos anciãos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que yo estoy delante de ti allí sobre la peña en Horeb; y herirás la peña, y saldrán de ella aguas, y beberá el pueblo. Y Moisés lo hizo así en presencia de los ancianos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the Lord, saying, Is the Lord among us, or not?
verses.WEB: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us, or not?”
verses.ASV: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the striving of the children of Israel, and because they tempted Jehovah, saying, Is Jehovah among us, or not?
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou o nome daquele lugar Massá e Meribá, pela briga dos filhos de Israel, e porque tentaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Está, pois, o SENHOR entre nós, ou não?
verses.RVR09: Y llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Massah y Meribah, por la rencilla de los hijos de Israel, y porque tentaron á Jehová, diciendo: ¿Está, pues, Jehová entre nosotros, ó no?

verses.KJV: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.WEB: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.ASV: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Amaleque e lutou com Israel em Refidim.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Amalec, y peleó con Israel en Rephidim.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
verses.WEB: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to-morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés a Josué: Escolhe para nós homens, e sai, luta com Amaleque: amanhã eu estarei sobre o cume do morro, e a vara de Deus em minha mão.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Josué: Escógenos varones, y sal, pelea con Amalec: mañana yo estaré sobre la cumbre del collado, y la vara de Dios en mi mano.

verses.KJV: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.WEB: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.ASV: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Josué como lhe disse Moisés, lutando com Amaleque; e Moisés e Arão e Hur subiram ao cume do morro.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Josué como le dijo Moisés, peleando con Amalec; y Moisés y Aarón y Hur subieron á la cumbre del collado.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.WEB: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed; and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedia que quando erguia Moisés sua mão, Israel prevalecia; mas quando ele baixava sua mão, prevalecia Amaleque.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedía que cuando alzaba Moisés su mano, Israel prevalecía; mas cuando él bajaba su mano, prevalecía Amalec.

verses.KJV: But Moses hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.WEB: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.
verses.ASV: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as mãos de Moisés estavam pesadas; pelo que tomaram uma pedra, e puseram-na debaixo dele, e se sentou sobre ela; e Arão e Hur sustentavam suas mãos, o um de uma parte e o outro de outra; assim houve em suas mãos firmeza até que se pôs o sol.
verses.RVR09: Y las manos de Moisés estaban pesadas; por lo que tomaron una piedra, y pusiéronla debajo de él, y se sentó sobre ella: y Aarón y Hur sustentaban sus manos, el uno de una parte y el otro de otra; así hubo en sus manos firmeza hasta que se puso el sol.

verses.KJV: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.WEB: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.ASV: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué derrotou a Amaleque e a seu povo a fio de espada.
verses.RVR09: Y Josué deshizo á Amalec y á su pueblo á filo de espada.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”
verses.ASV: and Jehovah said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Escreve isto para memória em um livro, e dize a Josué que de todo tenho de apagar a memória de Amaleque de debaixo do céu.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Escribe esto para memoria en un libro, y di á Josué que del todo tengo de raer la memoria de Amalec de debajo del cielo.

verses.KJV: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
verses.WEB: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.
verses.ASV: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés edificou um altar, e chamou seu nome O SENHOR é minha bandeira;
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés edificó un altar, y llamó su nombre Jehová-nissi;

verses.KJV: For he said, Because the Lord hath sworn that the Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
verses.WEB: He said, “The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”
verses.ASV: and he said, Jehovah hath sworn: Jehovah will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Porquanto há mão sobre o trono do SENHOR, o SENHOR terá guerra com Amaleque de geração em geração.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Por cuanto la mano sobre el trono de Jehová, Jehová tendrá guerra con Amalec de generación en generación.

verses.KJV: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt;
verses.WEB: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
verses.ASV: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, how that Jehovah had brought Israel out of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Jetro, sacerdote de Midiã, sogro de Moisés, todas as coisas que Deus havia feito com Moisés, e com Israel seu povo, e como o SENHOR havia tirado a Israel do Egito:
verses.RVR09: Y OYÓ Jethro, sacerdote de Madián, suegro de Moisés, todas las cosas que Dios había hecho con Moisés, y con Israel su pueblo, y cómo Jehová había sacado á Israel de Egipto:

verses.KJV: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,
verses.WEB: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
verses.ASV: And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Jetro, sogro de Moisés a Zípora a mulher de Moisés, depois que ele a enviou,
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Jethro, suegro de Moisés, á Séphora la mujer de Moisés, después que él la envió,

verses.KJV: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
verses.WEB: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.
verses.ASV: and her two sons; of whom the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been a sojourner in a foreign land:
verses.ALMEIDA: E a seus dois filhos; um se chamava Gérson, porque disse: Peregrino fui em terra alheia;
verses.RVR09: Y á sus dos hijos; el uno se llamaba Gersom, porque dijo, Peregrino he sido en tierra ajena;

verses.KJV: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
verses.WEB: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”
verses.ASV: and the name of the other was Eliezer; for [he said], The God of my father was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o outro se chamava Eliézer, porque disse, O Deus de meu pai me ajudou, e me livrou da espada de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y el otro se llamaba Eliezer, porque dijo, El Dios de mi padre me ayudó, y me libró del cuchillo de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
verses.WEB: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.
verses.ASV: And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the mount of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jetro o sogro de Moisés, com seus filhos e sua mulher, chegou a Moisés no deserto, onde tinha o acampamento junto ao monte de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y Jethro, el suegro de Moisés, con sus hijos y su mujer, llegó á Moisés en el desierto, donde tenía el campo junto al monte de Dios;

verses.KJV: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
verses.WEB: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”
verses.ASV: and he said unto Moses, I, thy father-in-law Jethro, am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a Moisés: Eu teu sogro Jetro venho a ti, com tua mulher, e seus dois filhos com ela.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á Moisés: Yo tu suegro Jethro vengo á ti, con tu mujer, y sus dos hijos con ella.

verses.KJV: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
verses.WEB: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.
verses.ASV: And Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and did obeisance, and kissed him: and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés saiu a receber a seu sogro, e inclinou-se, e beijou-o: e perguntaram-se um ao outro como estavam, e vieram à tenda.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés salió á recibir á su suegro, é inclinóse, y besólo: y preguntáronse el uno al otro cómo estaban, y vinieron á la tienda.

verses.KJV: And Moses told his father in law all that the Lord had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the Lord delivered them.
verses.WEB: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
verses.ASV: And Moses told his father-in-law all that Jehovah had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how Jehovah delivered them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés contou a seu sogro todas as coisas que o SENHOR havia feito a Faraó e aos egípcios por causa de Israel, e todo o trabalho que haviam passado no caminho, e como os havia livrado o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés contó á su suegro todas las cosas que Jehová había hecho á Faraón y á los Egipcios por amor de Israel, y todo el trabajo que habían pasado en el camino, y cómo los había librado Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the Lord had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.ASV: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Jehovah had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alegrou-se Jetro de todo o bem que o SENHOR havia feito a Israel, que o havia livrado da mão dos egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Y alegróse Jethro de todo el bien que Jehová había hecho á Israel, que lo había librado de mano de los Egipcios.

verses.KJV: And Jethro said, Blessed be the Lord, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.ASV: And Jethro said, Blessed be Jehovah, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jetro disse: Bendito seja o SENHOR, que vos livrou da mão dos egípcios, e da mão de Faraó, e que livrou ao povo da mão dos egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Y Jethro dijo: Bendito sea Jehová, que os libró de mano de los Egipcios, y de la mano de Faraón, y que libró al pueblo de la mano de los Egipcios.

verses.KJV: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
verses.WEB: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
verses.ASV: Now I know that Jehovah is greater than all gods; yea, in the thing wherein they dealt proudly against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora conheço que o SENHOR é maior que todos os deuses, até naquilo em que se vangloriavam contra o povo.
verses.RVR09: Ahora conozco que Jehová es grande más que todos los dioses; hasta en lo que se ensoberbecieron contra ellos.

verses.KJV: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.
verses.WEB: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
verses.ASV: And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt-offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Jetro, sogro de Moisés, holocaustos e sacrifícios para Deus: e veio Arão e todos os anciãos de Israel a comer pão com o sogro de Moisés diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Jethro, suegro de Moisés, holocaustos y sacrificios para Dios: y vino Aarón y todos los ancianos de Israel á comer pan con el suegro de Moisés delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
verses.WEB: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood about Moses from the morning unto the evening.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que outro dia se sentou Moisés a julgar ao povo; e o povo esteve diante de Moisés desde a manhã até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que otro día se sentó Moisés á juzgar al pueblo; y el pueblo estuvo delante de Moisés desde la mañana hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
verses.WEB: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”
verses.ASV: And when Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand about thee from morning unto even?
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo o sogro de Moisés tudo o que ele fazia com o povo, disse: Que é isto que fazes tu com o povo? por que te sentas tu sozinho, e todo o povo está diante de ti desde a manhã até à tarde?
verses.RVR09: Y viendo el suegro de Moisés todo lo que él hacía con el pueblo, dijo: ¿Qué es esto que haces tú con el pueblo? ¿por qué te sientas tú solo, y todo el pueblo está delante de ti desde la mañana hasta la tarde?

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
verses.WEB: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto his father-in-law, Because the people come unto me to inquire of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés respondeu a seu sogro: Porque o povo vem a mim para consultar a Deus:
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés respondió á su suegro: Porque el pueblo viene á mí para consultar á Dios:

verses.KJV: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
verses.WEB: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”
verses.ASV: when they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando têm negócios, vem a mim; e eu julgo entre o um e o outro, e declaro as ordenanças de Deus e suas leis.
verses.RVR09: Cuando tienen negocios, vienen á mí; y yo juzgo entre el uno y el otro, y declaro las ordenanzas de Dios y sus leyes.

verses.KJV: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
verses.WEB: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.
verses.ASV: And Moses’ father-in-law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sogro de Moisés lhe disse: Não fazes bem:
verses.RVR09: Entonces el suegro de Moisés le dijo: No haces bien:

verses.KJV: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
verses.WEB: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for the thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desfalecerás de todo, tu, e também este povo que está contigo; porque o negócio é demasiado pesado para ti; não poderás fazê-lo tu sozinho.
verses.RVR09: Desfallecerás del todo, tú, y también este pueblo que está contigo; porque el negocio es demasiado pesado para ti; no podrás hacerlo tú solo.

verses.KJV: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
verses.WEB: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.
verses.ASV: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God be with thee: be thou for the people to God-ward, and bring thou the causes unto God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve agora minha voz; eu te aconselharei, e Deus será contigo. Está tu pelo povo diante de Deus, e traze tu os negócios a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Oye ahora mi voz, yo te aconsejaré, y Dios será contigo. Está tú por el pueblo delante de Dios, y somete tú los negocios á Dios.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
verses.WEB: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt teach them the statutes and the laws, and shalt show them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ensina a eles as ordenanças e as leis, e mostra-lhes o caminho por onde andem, e o que hão de fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y enseña á ellos las ordenanzas y las leyes, y muéstrales el camino por donde anden, y lo que han de hacer.

verses.KJV: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
verses.WEB: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.ASV: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ademais busca dentre todo o povo homens de virtude, temerosos de Deus, homens de verdade, que odeiem a ganância; e constituirás a estes sobre eles líderes sobre mil, sobre cem, sobre cinquenta e sobre dez.
verses.RVR09: Además inquiere tú de entre todo el pueblo varones de virtud, temerosos de Dios, varones de verdad, que aborrezcan la avaricia; y constituirás á éstos sobre ellos caporales sobre mil, sobre ciento, sobre cincuenta y sobre diez.

verses.KJV: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
verses.WEB: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.
verses.ASV: and let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge themselves: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear [the burden] with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais julgarão ao povo ao todo tempo; e será que todo negócio grave o trarão a ti, e eles julgarão todo negócio pequeno: alivia assim a carga de sobre ti, e eles a levarão contigo.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales juzgarán al pueblo en todo tiempo; y será que todo negocio grave lo traerán á ti, y ellos juzgarán todo negocio pequeño: alivia así la carga de sobre ti, y llevarla han ellos contigo.

verses.KJV: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
verses.WEB: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”
verses.ASV: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people also shall go to their place in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se isto fizeres, e Deus te o mandar, tu poderás persistir, e todo este povo se irá também em paz a seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Si esto hicieres, y Dios te lo mandare, tú podrás persistir, y todo este pueblo se irá también en paz á su lugar.

verses.KJV: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
verses.WEB: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
verses.ASV: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Moisés a voz de seu sogro, e fez tudo o que disse.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Moisés la voz de su suegro, é hizo todo lo que dijo.

verses.KJV: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.WEB: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.ASV: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.ALMEIDA: E escolheu Moisés homens de virtude de todo Israel, e os pôs por chefes sobre o povo, líderes sobre mil, sobre cem, sobre cinquenta, e sobre dez.
verses.RVR09: Y escogió Moisés varones de virtud de todo Israel, y púsolos por cabezas sobre el pueblo, caporales sobre mil, sobre ciento, sobre cincuenta, y sobre diez;

verses.KJV: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.WEB: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.ASV: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: E julgavam ao povo ao todo tempo; o negócio árduo traziam-no a Moisés, e eles julgavam todo negócio pequeno.
verses.RVR09: Y juzgaban al pueblo en todo tiempo: el negocio arduo traíanlo á Moisés, y ellos juzgaban todo negocio pequeño.

verses.KJV: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
verses.WEB: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.
verses.ASV: And Moses let his father-in-law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E despediu Moisés a seu sogro, e foi-se à sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Y despidió Moisés á su suegro, y fuése á su tierra.

verses.KJV: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.WEB: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.ASV: In the third month after the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao mês terceiro da saída dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, naquele dia vieram ao deserto de Sinai.
verses.RVR09: AL mes tercero de la salida de los hijos de Israel de la tierra de Egipto, en aquel día vinieron al desierto de Sinaí.

verses.KJV: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
verses.WEB: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.
verses.ASV: And when they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque partiram de Refidim, e chegaram ao deserto de Sinai, e assentaram no deserto; e acampou ali Israel diante do monte.
verses.RVR09: Porque partieron de Rephidim, y llegaron al desierto de Sinaí, y asentaron en el desierto; y acampó allí Israel delante del monte.

verses.KJV: And Moses went up unto God, and the Lord called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
verses.WEB: Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
verses.ASV: And Moses went up unto God, and Jehovah called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés subiu a Deus; e o SENHOR o chamou desde o monte, dizendo: Assim dirás à casa de Jacó, e anunciarás aos filhos de Israel:
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés subió á Dios; y Jehová lo llamó desde el monte, diciendo: Así dirás á la casa de Jacob, y denunciarás á los hijos de Israel:

verses.KJV: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.WEB: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
verses.ASV: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós vistes o que fiz aos egípcios, e como vos tomei sobre asas de águas, e vos trouxe a mim.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros visteis lo que hice á los Egipcios, y cómo os tomé sobre alas de águilas, y os he traído á mí.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
verses.WEB: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;
verses.ASV: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be mine own possession from among all peoples: for all the earth is mine:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora pois, se deres ouvido à minha voz, e guardardes meu pacto, vós sereis meu especial tesouro sobre todos os povos; porque minha é toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, si diereis oído á mi voz, y guardareis mi pacto, vosotros seréis mi especial tesoro sobre todos los pueblos; porque mía es toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”
verses.ASV: and ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós sereis meu reino de sacerdotes, e gente santa. Estas são as palavras que dirás aos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros seréis mi reino de sacerdotes, y gente santa. Estas son las palabras que dirás á los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the Lord commanded him.
verses.WEB: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.
verses.ASV: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Jehovah commanded him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio Moisés, e chamou aos anciãos do povo, e propôs em presença deles todas estas palavras que o SENHOR lhe havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces vino Moisés, y llamó á los ancianos del pueblo, y propuso en presencia de ellos todas estas palabras que Jehová le había mandado.

verses.KJV: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the Lord hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: All the people answered together, and said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And all the people answered together, and said, All that Jehovah hath spoken we will do. And Moses reported the words of the people unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o povo respondeu em unidade, e disseram: Tudo o que o SENHOR disse faremos. E Moisés referiu as palavras do povo ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el pueblo respondió á una, y dijeron: Todo lo que Jehová ha dicho haremos. Y Moisés refirió las palabras del pueblo á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and may also believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Eis que, eu venho a ti em uma nuvem espessa, para que o povo ouça enquanto eu falo contigo, e também para que te creiam para sempre. E Moisés anunciou as palavras do povo ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: He aquí, yo vengo á ti en una nube espesa, para que el pueblo oiga mientras yo hablo contigo, y también para que te crean para siempre. Y Moisés denunció las palabras del pueblo á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to-day and to-morrow, and let them wash their garments,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Vai ao povo, e santifica-os hoje e amanhã, e lavem suas roupas;
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Ve al pueblo, y santifícalos hoy y mañana, y laven sus vestidos;

verses.KJV: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the Lord will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.WEB: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.
verses.ASV: and be ready against the third day; for the third day Jehovah will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estejam prontos para o dia terceiro, porque ao terceiro dia o SENHOR descerá, à vista de todo o povo, sobre o monte de Sinai.
verses.RVR09: Y estén apercibidos para el día tercero, porque al tercer día Jehová descenderá, á ojos de todo el pueblo, sobre el monte de Sinaí.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.WEB: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.ALMEIDA: E assinalarás termo ao povo em derredor, dizendo: Guardai-vos, não subais ao monte, nem toqueis a seu termo: qualquer um que tocar o monte, certamente morrerá:
verses.RVR09: Y señalarás término al pueblo en derredor, diciendo: Guardaos, no subáis al monte, ni toquéis á su término: cualquiera que tocare el monte, de seguro morirá:

verses.KJV: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.WEB: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”
verses.ASV: no hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, he shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não lhe tocará mão, mas será apedrejado ou flechado; seja animal ou seja homem, não viverá. Em havendo soado longamente a trombeta, subirão ao monte.
verses.RVR09: No le tocará mano, mas será apedreado ó asaeteado; sea animal ó sea hombre, no vivirá. En habiendo sonado largamente la bocina, subirán al monte.

verses.KJV: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.WEB: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.ASV: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their garments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desceu Moisés do monte ao povo, e santificou ao povo; e lavaram suas roupas.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió Moisés del monte al pueblo, y santificó al pueblo; y lavaron sus vestidos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
verses.WEB: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not near a woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ao povo: Estai prontos para o terceiro dia; não chegueis a mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo al pueblo: Estad apercibidos para el tercer día; no lleguéis á mujer.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
verses.WEB: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the third day, when it was morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of a trumpet exceeding loud; and all the people that were in the camp trembled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu ao terceiro dia quando veio a manhã, que vieram trovões e relâmpagos, e espessa nuvem sobre o monte, e som de trombeta muito forte; e estremeceu-se todo o povo que estava no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció al tercer día cuando vino la mañana, que vinieron truenos y relámpagos, y espesa nube sobre el monte, y sonido de bocina muy fuerte; y estremecióse todo el pueblo que estaba en el real.

verses.KJV: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.WEB: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.
verses.ASV: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés tirou do acampamento ao povo a receber a Deus; e puseram-se ao abaixo do monte.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés sacó del real al pueblo á recibir á Dios; y pusiéronse á lo bajo del monte.

verses.KJV: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.WEB: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the LORD descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.
verses.ASV: And mount Sinai, the whole of it, smoked, because Jehovah descended upon it in fire; and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o monte de Sinai fumegava, porque o SENHOR havia descido sobre ele em fogo: e a fumaça dele subia como a fumaça de um forno, e todo o monte se estremeceu em grande maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el monte de Sinaí humeaba, porque Jehová había descendido sobre él en fuego: y el humo de él subía como el humo de un horno, y todo el monte se estremeció en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.WEB: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.ASV: And when the voice of the trumpet waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o som da trombeta ia fortalecendo-se em extremo: Moisés falava, e Deus lhe respondia em voz.
verses.RVR09: Y el sonido de la bocina iba esforzándose en extremo: Moisés hablaba, y Dios le respondía en voz.

verses.KJV: And the Lord came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the Lord called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.WEB: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah came down upon mount Sinai, to the top of the mount: and Jehovah called Moses to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desceu o SENHOR sobre o monte de Sinai, sobre o cume do monte: e chamou o SENHOR a Moisés ao cume do monte, e Moisés subiu.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió Jehová sobre el monte de Sinaí, sobre la cumbre del monte: y llamó Jehová á Moisés á la cumbre del monte, y Moisés subió.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the Lord to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto Jehovah to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Desce, exige ao povo que não ultrapassem o termo para ver ao SENHOR, para que não caia multidão deles.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Desciende, requiere al pueblo que no traspasen el término por ver á Jehová, porque caerá multitud de ellos.

verses.KJV: And let the priests also, which come near to the Lord, sanctify themselves, lest the Lord break forth upon them.
verses.WEB: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them.”
verses.ASV: And let the priests also, that come near to Jehovah, sanctify themselves, lest Jehovah break forth upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também os sacerdotes que se achegam ao SENHOR, se santifiquem, para que o SENHOR não faça neles dano.
verses.RVR09: Y también los sacerdotes que se llegan á Jehová, se santifiquen, porque Jehová no haga en ellos estrago.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the Lord, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.WEB: Moses said to the LORD, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Jehovah, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou didst charge us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés disse ao SENHOR: O povo não poderá subir ao monte de Sinai, porque tu nos hás exigiste dizendo: Assinala termos ao monte, e santifica-o.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés dijo á Jehová: El pueblo no podrá subir al monte de Sinaí, porque tú nos has requerido diciendo: Señala términos al monte, y santifícalo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the Lord, lest he break forth upon them.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break out against them.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto him, Go, get thee down; and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto Jehovah, lest he break forth upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR lhe disse: Vai, desce, e subirás tu, e Arão contigo: mas os sacerdotes e o povo não ultrapassem o termo para subir ao SENHOR, para que não faça neles dano.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová le dijo: Ve, desciende, y subirás tú, y Aarón contigo: mas los sacerdotes y el pueblo no traspasen el término por subir á Jehová, porque no haga en ellos estrago.

verses.KJV: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
verses.WEB: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.
verses.ASV: So Moses went down unto the people, and told them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés desceu ao povo e falou com eles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés descendió al pueblo, y habló con ellos.

verses.KJV: And God spake all these words, saying,
verses.WEB: God spoke all these words, saying,
verses.ASV: And God spake all these words, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Deus todas estas palavras, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Dios todas estas palabras, diciendo:

verses.KJV: I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.WEB: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, de casa de servos.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy JEHOVÁ tu Dios, que te saqué de la tierra de Egipto, de casa de siervos.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.WEB: “You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não terás deuses alheios diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: No tendrás dioses ajenos delante de mí.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
verses.WEB: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not make unto thee a graven image, nor any likeness [of any thing] that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te farás imagem, nem nenhuma semelhança de coisa que esteja acima no céu, nem abaixo na terra, nem nas águas debaixo da terra:
verses.RVR09: No te harás imagen, ni ninguna semejanza de cosa que esté arriba en el cielo, ni abajo en la tierra, ni en las aguas debajo de la tierra:

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
verses.WEB: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.ASV: thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them; for I Jehovah thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation of them that hate me,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te inclinarás a elas, nem as honrarás; porque eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, forte, zeloso, que visito a maldade dos pais sobre os filhos, sobre os terceiros e sobre os quartos, aos que me aborrecem,
verses.RVR09: No te inclinarás á ellas, ni las honrarás; porque yo soy Jehová tu Dios, fuerte, celoso, que visito la maldad de los padres sobre los hijos, sobre los terceros y sobre los cuartos, á los que me aborrecen,

verses.KJV: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
verses.WEB: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.ASV: and showing lovingkindness unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que faço misericórdia em milhares aos que me amam, e guardam meus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Y que hago misericordia en millares á los que me aman, y guardan mis mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.WEB: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not take the name of Jehovah thy God in vain; for Jehovah will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tomarás o nome do SENHOR teu Deus em vão; porque não dará por inocente o SENHOR ao que tomar seu nome em vão.
verses.RVR09: No tomarás el nombre de Jehová tu Dios en vano; porque no dará por inocente Jehová al que tomare su nombre en vano.

verses.KJV: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.WEB: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.ASV: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te lembrarás do dia do repouso, para santificá-lo:
verses.RVR09: Acordarte has del día del reposo, para santificarlo:

verses.KJV: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
verses.WEB: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
verses.ASV: Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work;
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis dias trabalharás, e farás toda tua obra;
verses.RVR09: Seis días trabajarás, y harás toda tu obra;

verses.KJV: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
verses.WEB: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
verses.ASV: but the seventh day is a sabbath unto Jehovah thy God: [in it] thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy man-servant, nor thy maid-servant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o sétimo dia será repouso para o SENHOR teu Deus: não faças nele obra alguma, tu, nem teu filho, nem tua filha, nem teu servo, nem tua criada, nem teu animal, nem teu estrangeiro que está dentro de tuas portas:
verses.RVR09: Mas el séptimo día será reposo para Jehová tu Dios: no hagas en él obra alguna, tú, ni tu hijo, ni tu hija, ni tu siervo, ni tu criada ni tu bestia, ni tu extranjero que está dentro de tus puertas:

verses.KJV: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.WEB: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
verses.ASV: for in six days Jehovah made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore Jehovah blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em seis dias fez o SENHOR os céus e a terra, o mar e todas as coisas que neles há, e repousou no sétimo dia: portanto o SENHOR abençoou o dia do repouso e o santificou.
verses.RVR09: Porque en seis días hizo Jehová los cielos y la tierra, la mar y todas las cosas que en ellos hay, y reposó en el séptimo día: por tanto Jehová bendijo el día del reposo y lo santificó.

verses.KJV: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
verses.WEB: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
verses.ASV: Honor thy father and thy mother, that thy days may be long in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, para que teus dias se alarguem na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá.
verses.RVR09: Honra á tu padre y á tu madre, porque tus días se alarguen en la tierra que Jehová tu Dios te da.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.WEB: “You shall not murder.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não cometerás homicídio.
verses.RVR09: No matarás.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.WEB: “You shall not commit adultery.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não cometerás adultério.
verses.RVR09: No cometerás adulterio.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.WEB: “You shall not steal.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não furtarás.
verses.RVR09: No hurtarás.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.WEB: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não falarás contra teu próximo falso testemunho.
verses.RVR09: No hablarás contra tu prójimo falso testimonio.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.
verses.WEB: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbor’s wife, nor his man-servant, nor his maid-servant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor anything that is thy neighbor’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não cobiçarás a casa de teu próximo, não cobiçarás a mulher de teu próximo, nem seu servo, nem sua criada, nem seu boi, nem seu asno, nem coisa alguma de teu próximo.
verses.RVR09: No codiciarás la casa de tu prójimo, no codiciarás la mujer de tu prójimo, ni su siervo, ni su criada, ni su buey, ni su asno, ni cosa alguna de tu prójimo.

verses.KJV: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
verses.WEB: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.
verses.ASV: And all the people perceived the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the voice of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they trembled, and stood afar off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o povo considerava as vozes, e as chamas, e o som da trombeta, e o monte que fumegava: e vendo-o o povo, tremeram, e puseram-se de longe.
verses.RVR09: Todo el pueblo consideraba las voces, y las llamas, y el sonido de la bocina, y el monte que humeaba: y viéndolo el pueblo, temblaron, y pusiéronse de lejos.

verses.KJV: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
verses.WEB: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
verses.ASV: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear; but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram a Moisés: Fala tu conosco, que nós ouviremos; mas não fale Deus conosco, para que não morramos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron á Moisés: Habla tú con nosotros, que nosotros oiremos; mas no hable Dios con nosotros, porque no muramos.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
verses.WEB: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before you, that ye sin not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés respondeu ao povo: Não temais; que para provar-vos veio Deus, e para que seu temor esteja em vossa presença para que não pequeis.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés respondió al pueblo: No temáis; que por probaros vino Dios, y porque su temor esté en vuestra presencia para que no pequéis.

verses.KJV: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
verses.WEB: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
verses.ASV: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o povo se pôs de longe, e Moisés se chegou à escuridão na qual estava Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pueblo se puso de lejos, y Moisés se llegó á la osbcuridad, en la cual estaba Dios.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: Vós vistes que falei desde o céu convosco.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Así dirás á los hijos de Israel: Vosotros habéis visto que he hablado desde el cielo con vosotros.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
verses.WEB: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not make [other gods] with me; gods of silver, or gods of gold, ye shall not make unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não façais comigo deuses de prata, nem deuses de ouro vos fareis.
verses.RVR09: No hagáis conmigo dioses de plata, ni dioses de oro os haréis.

verses.KJV: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
verses.WEB: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
verses.ASV: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt-offerings, and thy peace-offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in every place where I record my name I will come unto thee and I will bless thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da terra farás altar para mim, e sacrificarás sobre ele teus holocaustos e tuas ofertas pacíficas, tuas ovelhas e tuas vacas: em qualquer lugar onde eu fizer que esteja a memória de meu nome, virei a ti, e te abençoarei.
verses.RVR09: Altar de tierra harás para mí, y sacrificarás sobre él tus holocaustos y tus pacíficos, tus ovejas y tus vacas: en cualquier lugar donde yo hiciere que esté la memoria de mi nombre, vendré á ti, y te bendeciré.

verses.KJV: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
verses.WEB: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
verses.ASV: And if thou make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stones; for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se me fizeres altar de pedras, não as faças lavradas; porque se levantares teu buril sobre ele, tu o profanarás.
verses.RVR09: Y si me hicieres altar de piedras, no las labres de cantería; porque si alzares tu pico sobre él, tú lo profanarás.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
verses.WEB: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
verses.ASV: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not uncovered thereon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não subirás por degraus a meu altar, para que tua nudez não seja junto a ele descoberta.
verses.RVR09: Y no subirás por gradas á mi altar, porque tu desnudez no sea junto á él descubierta.

verses.KJV: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
verses.WEB: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:
verses.ASV: Now these are the ordinances which thou shalt set before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as ordenanças que lhes proporás.
verses.RVR09: Y ESTOS son los derechos que les propondrás.

verses.KJV: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.WEB: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
verses.ASV: If thou buy a Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se comprares servo hebreu, seis anos servirá; mas ao sétimo sairá livre de graça.
verses.RVR09: Si comprares siervo hebreo, seis años servirá; mas el séptimo saldrá horro de balde.

verses.KJV: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.WEB: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.ASV: If he come in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he be married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se entrou sozinho, sozinho sairá: se tinha mulher, sairá ele e sua mulher com ele.
verses.RVR09: Si entró solo, solo saldrá: si tenía mujer, saldrá él y su mujer con él.

verses.KJV: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.WEB: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.ASV: If his master give him a wife and she bear him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se seu amo lhe houver dado mulher, e ela lhe houver dado à luz filhos ou filhas, a mulher e seus filhos serão de seu amo, e ele sairá sozinho.
verses.RVR09: Si su amo le hubiere dado mujer, y ella le hubiere parido hijos ó hijas, la mujer y sus hijos serán de su amo, y él saldrá solo.

verses.KJV: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
verses.WEB: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
verses.ASV: But if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o servo disser: Eu amo a meu senhor, a minha mulher e a meus filhos, não sairei livre:
verses.RVR09: Y si el siervo dijere: Yo amo á mi señor, á mi mujer y á mis hijos, no saldré libre:

verses.KJV: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.WEB: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.
verses.ASV: then his master shall bring him unto God, and shall bring him to the door, or unto the door-post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então seu amo o fará chegar aos juízes, e o fará chegar à porta ou ao umbral; e seu amo lhe furará a orelha com ferramenta pontiaguda, e será seu servo para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Entonces su amo lo hará llegar á los jueces, y harále llegar á la puerta ó al poste; y su amo le horadará la oreja con lesna, y será su siervo para siempre.

verses.KJV: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
verses.WEB: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
verses.ASV: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maid-servant, she shall not go out as the men-servants do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando alguém vender sua filha por serva, não sairá como costumam sair os servos.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando alguno vendiere su hija por sierva, no saldrá como suelen salir los siervos.

verses.KJV: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.WEB: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.ASV: If she please not her master, who hath espoused her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a foreign people he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ela não agradar ao seu senhor, o qual não a tomou por esposa, permitirá a ela que se resgate, e ela não a poderá vender a povo estrangeiro, visto que não cumpriu seu compromisso com ela.
verses.RVR09: Si no agradare á su señor, por lo cual no la tomó por esposa, permitirle ha que se rescate, y no la podrá vender á pueblo extraño cuando la desechare.

verses.KJV: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.WEB: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
verses.ASV: And if he espouse her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se a houver desposado com seu filho, fará com ela segundo o costume das filhas.
verses.RVR09: Mas si la hubiere desposado con su hijo, hará con ella según la costumbre de las hijas.

verses.KJV: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.WEB: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
verses.ASV: If he take him another [wife]; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tomar para si outra, não diminuirá seu alimento, nem sua porção de roupa, nem o direito conjugal.
verses.RVR09: Si le tomare otra, no disminuirá su alimento, ni su vestido, ni el débito conyugal.

verses.KJV: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
verses.WEB: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
verses.ASV: And if he do not these three things unto her, then shall she go out for nothing, without money.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se nenhuma destas três coisas fizer, ela sairá de graça, e não terá que lhe pagar dinheiro.
verses.RVR09: Y si ninguna de estas tres cosas hiciere, ella saldrá de gracia sin dinero.

verses.KJV: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
verses.WEB: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
verses.ASV: He that smiteth a man, so that he dieth, shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que ferir á alguém, fazendo-lhe assim morrer, ele morrerá.
verses.RVR09: El que hiriere á alguno, haciéndole así morir, él morirá.

verses.KJV: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
verses.WEB: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
verses.ASV: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver [him] into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que não armou ciladas, mas sim que Deus o pôs em suas mãos, então eu te assinalarei lugar ao qual há de fugir.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que no armó asechanzas, sino que Dios lo puso en sus manos, entonces yo te señalaré lugar al cual ha de huir.

verses.KJV: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
verses.WEB: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
verses.ASV: And if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbor, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, se alguém se ensoberbecer contra seu próximo, e o matar traiçoeiramente, de meu altar o tirarás para que morra.
verses.RVR09: Además, si alguno se ensoberbeciere contra su prójimo, y lo matare con alevosía, de mi altar lo quitarás para que muera.

verses.KJV: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.WEB: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
verses.ASV: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que ferir a seu pai ou a sua mãe, morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y el que hiriere á su padre ó á su madre, morirá.

verses.KJV: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o que roubar uma pessoa, e a vender, ou se achar em suas mãos, morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo el que robare una persona, y la vendiere, ó se hallare en sus manos, morirá.

verses.KJV: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: And he that curseth his father or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Igualmente o que amaldiçoar a seu pai ou a sua mãe, morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Igualmente el que maldijere á su padre ó á su madre, morirá.

verses.KJV: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:
verses.WEB: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;
verses.ASV: And if men contend, and one smite the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keep his bed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ademais, se alguns brigarem, e algum ferir a seu próximo com pedra ou com o punho, e não morrer, mas cair em cama;
verses.RVR09: Además, si algunos riñeren, y alguno hiriere á su prójimo con piedra ó con el puño, y no muriere, pero cayere en cama;

verses.KJV: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
verses.WEB: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
verses.ASV: if he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se se levantar e andar fora sobre seu cajado, então será o que lhe feriu absolvido: somente lhe pagará o tempo que esteve parado, e fará que lhe curem.
verses.RVR09: Si se levantare y anduviere fuera sobre su báculo, entonces será el que le hirió absuelto: solamente le satisfará lo que estuvo parado, y hará que le curen.

verses.KJV: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
verses.WEB: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.
verses.ASV: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall surely be punished.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém ferir a seu servo ou a sua serva com pau, e morrer sob sua mão, será castigado:
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno hiriere á su siervo ó á su sierva con palo, y muriere bajo de su mano, será castigado:

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
verses.WEB: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
verses.ASV: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se durar por um dia ou dois, não será castigado, porque seu dinheiro é.
verses.RVR09: Mas si durare por un día ó dos, no será castigado, porque su dinero es.

verses.KJV: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.WEB: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
verses.ASV: And if men strive together, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart, and yet no harm follow; he shall be surely fined, according as the woman’s husband shall lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguns brigarem, e ferissem a mulher grávida, e esta abortar, mas sem haver morte, será multado conforme o que lhe impuser o marido da mulher e julgarem os juízes.
verses.RVR09: Si algunos riñeren, é hiriesen á mujer preñada, y ésta abortare, pero sin haber muerte, será penado conforme á lo que le impusiere el marido de la mujer y juzgaren los árbitros.

verses.KJV: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
verses.WEB: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
verses.ASV: But if any harm follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se houver morte, então pagarás vida por vida,
verses.RVR09: Mas si hubiere muerte, entonces pagarás vida por vida,

verses.KJV: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.WEB: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.ASV: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.ALMEIDA: Olho por olho, dente por dente, mão por meio, pé por pé,
verses.RVR09: Ojo por ojo, diente por diente, mano por mano, pie por pie,

verses.KJV: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.WEB: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
verses.ASV: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Queimadura por queimadura, ferida por ferida, golpe por golpe.
verses.RVR09: Quemadura por quemadura, herida por herida, golpe por golpe.

verses.KJV: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
verses.WEB: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
verses.ASV: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, and destroy it; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando alguém ferir o olho de seu servo, ou o olho de sua serva, e o destruir, lhe dará liberdade por razão de seu olho.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando alguno hiriere el ojo de su siervo, ó el ojo de su sierva, y lo entortare, darále libertad por razón de su ojo.

verses.KJV: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
