verses.WEB: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.
verses.ASV: And if he smite out his man-servant’s tooth, or his maid-servant’s tooth, he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se tirar o dente de seu servo, ou o dente de sua serva, por seu dente lhe deixará ir livre.
verses.RVR09: Y si sacare el diente de su siervo, ó el diente de su sierva, por su diente le dejará ir libre.

verses.KJV: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
verses.WEB: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.
verses.ASV: And if an ox gore a man or a woman to death, the ox shall be surely stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se um boi chifrar homem ou mulher, e de resultado morrer, o boi será apedrejado, e não se comerá sua carne; mas o dono do boi será absolvido.
verses.RVR09: Si un buey acorneare hombre ó mujer, y de resultas muriere, el buey será apedreado, y no se comerá su carne; mas el dueño del buey será absuelto.

verses.KJV: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
verses.WEB: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
verses.ASV: But if the ox was wont to gore in time past, and it hath been testified to its owner, and he hath not kept it in, but it hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and its owner also shall be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se o boi era chifrador desde o passado, e a seu dono lhe foi feito advertência, e não o houver guardado, e matar homem ou mulher, o boi será apedrejado, e também morrerá seu dono.
verses.RVR09: Pero si el buey era acorneador desde ayer y antes de ayer, y á su dueño le fué hecho requerimiento, y no lo hubiere guardado, y matare hombre ó mujer, el buey será apedreado, y también morirá su dueño.

verses.KJV: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.WEB: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.
verses.ASV: If there be laid on him a ransom, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se lhe for imposto resgate, então dará pelo resgate de sua pessoa quanto lhe for imposto.
verses.RVR09: Si le fuere impuesto rescate, entonces dará por el rescate de su persona cuanto le fuere impuesto.

verses.KJV: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.WEB: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
verses.ASV: Whether it have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quer tenha chifrado filho, ou tenha chifrado filha, conforme este juízo se fará com ele.
verses.RVR09: Haya acorneado hijo, ó haya acorneado hija, conforme á este juicio se hará con él.

verses.KJV: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.WEB: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.ASV: If the ox gore a man-servant or a maid-servant, there shall be given unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o boi chifrar servo ou serva, pagará trinta siclos de prata seu senhor, e o boi será apedrejado.
verses.RVR09: Si el buey acorneare siervo ó sierva, pagará treinta siclos de plata su señor, y el buey será apedreado.

verses.KJV: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
verses.WEB: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
verses.ASV: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein,
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém abrir fosso, ou cavar cisterna, e não a cobrir, e cair ali boi ou asno,
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno abriere hoyo, ó cavare cisterna, y no la cubriere, y cayere allí buey ó asno,

verses.KJV: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.WEB: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
verses.ASV: the owner of the pit shall make it good; he shall give money unto the owner thereof, and the dead [beast] shall be his.
verses.ALMEIDA: O dono da cisterna pagará o dinheiro, ressarcindo a seu dono, e o que foi morto será seu.
verses.RVR09: El dueño de la cisterna pagará el dinero, resarciendo á su dueño, y lo que fué muerto será suyo.

verses.KJV: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
verses.WEB: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
verses.ASV: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, so that it dieth, then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the price of it; and the dead also they shall divide.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o boi de alguém ferir ao boi de seu próximo, e este morrer, então venderão o boi vivo, e partirão o dinheiro dele, e também partirão o morto.
verses.RVR09: Y si el buey de alguno hiriere al buey de su prójimo, y éste muriere, entonces venderán el buey vivo, y partirán el dinero de él, y también partirán el muerto.

verses.KJV: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.WEB: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.
verses.ASV: Or if it be known that the ox was wont to gore in time past, and its owner hath not kept it in; he shall surely pay ox for ox, and the dead [beast] shall be his own.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se era notório que o boi era chifrador desde o passado, e seu dono não o houver guardado, pagará boi por boi, e o morto será seu.
verses.RVR09: Mas si era notorio que el buey era acorneador de ayer y antes de ayer, y su dueño no lo hubiere guardado, pagará buey por buey, y el muerto será suyo.

verses.KJV: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.WEB: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.ASV: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando alguém furtar boi ou ovelha, e lhe degolar ou vender, por aquele boi pagará cinco bois, e por aquela ovelha quatro ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: CUANDO alguno hurtare buey ú oveja, y le degollare ó vendiere, por aquel buey pagará cinco bueyes, y por aquella oveja cuatro ovejas.

verses.KJV: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
verses.WEB: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
verses.ASV: If the thief be found breaking in, and be smitten so that he dieth, there shall be no bloodguiltiness for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o ladrão for achado arrombando uma casa, e for ferido e morrer, o que lhe feriu não será culpado de sua morte.
verses.RVR09: Si el ladrón fuere hallado forzando una casa, y fuere herido y muriere, el que le hirió no será culpado de su muerte.

verses.KJV: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.WEB: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.ASV: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be bloodguiltiness for him; he shall make restitution: if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o sol houver sobre ele saído, o matador será réu de homicídio: o ladrão haverá de restituir completamente; se não tiver, será vendido por seu furto.
verses.RVR09: Si el sol hubiere sobre él salido, el matador será reo de homicidio: el ladrón habrá de restituir cumplidamente; si no tuviere, será vendido por su hurto.

verses.KJV: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.WEB: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
verses.ASV: If the theft be found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep, he shall pay double.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se for achado com o furto na mão, seja boi ou asno ou ovelha vivos, pagará o dobro.
verses.RVR09: Si fuere hallado con el hurto en la mano, sea buey ó asno ú oveja vivos, pagará el duplo.

verses.KJV: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.WEB: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
verses.ASV: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall let his beast loose, and it feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém fizer pastar campo ou vinha, e meter seu animal, e comer a terra de outro, do melhor de sua terra e do melhor de sua vinha pagará.
verses.RVR09: Si alguno hiciere pacer campo ó viña, y metiere su bestia, y comiere la tierra de otro, de lo mejor de su tierra y de lo mejor de su viña pagará.

verses.KJV: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.WEB: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.ASV: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando irromper um fogo, e achar espinhos, e for queimado amontoado, ou plantação, ou campo, o que acendeu o fogo pagará o queimado.
verses.RVR09: Cuando rompiere un fuego, y hallare espinas, y fuere quemado montón, ó haza, ó campo, el que encendió el fuego pagará lo quemado.

verses.KJV: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.WEB: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
verses.ASV: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, he shall pay double.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando alguém der a seu próximo prata ou joias a guardar, e for furtado da casa daquele homem, se o ladrão se achar, pagará o dobro.
verses.RVR09: Cuando alguno diere á su prójimo plata ó alhajas á guardar, y fuere hurtado de la casa de aquel hombre, si el ladrón se hallare, pagará el doble.

verses.KJV: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
verses.WEB: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.
verses.ASV: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall come near unto God, [to see] whether he have not put his hand unto his neighbor’s goods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o ladrão não se achar, então o dono da casa será apresentado aos juízes, para ver se pôs sua mão na riqueza de seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: Si el ladrón no se hallare, entonces el dueño de la casa será presentado á los jueces, para ver si ha metido su mano en la hacienda de su prójimo.

verses.KJV: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.WEB: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
verses.ASV: For every matter of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, [or] for any manner of lost thing, whereof one saith, This is it, the cause of both parties shall come before God; he whom God shall condemn shall pay double unto his neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre todo negócio de fraude, sobre boi, sobre asno, sobre ovelha, sobre roupa, sobre toda coisa perdida, quando um disser: Isto é meu, a causa de ambos virá diante dos juízes; e o que os juízes condenarem, pagará o dobro a seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: Sobre todo negocio de fraude, sobre buey, sobre asno, sobre oveja, sobre vestido, sobre toda cosa perdida, cuando uno dijere: Esto es mío, la causa de ambos vendrá delante de los jueces; y el que los jueces condenaren, pagará el doble á su prójimo.

verses.KJV: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.WEB: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;
verses.ASV: If a man deliver unto his neighbor an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém houver dado a seu próximo asno, ou boi, ou ovelha, ou qualquer outro animal a guardar, e se morrer ou se for aleijado, ou for levado sem vê-lo ninguém;
verses.RVR09: Si alguno hubiere dado á su prójimo asno, ó buey, ú oveja, ó cualquier otro animal á guardar, y se muriere, ó se perniquebrare, ó fuere llevado sin verlo nadie;

verses.KJV: Then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
verses.WEB: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.ASV: the oath of Jehovah shall be between them both, whether he hath not put his hand unto his neighbor’s goods; and the owner thereof shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.ALMEIDA: Juramento do SENHOR terá lugar entre ambos de que não lançou sua mão à riqueza de seu próximo: e seu dono o aceitará, e o outro não pagará.
verses.RVR09: Juramento de Jehová tendrá lugar entre ambos de que no echó su mano á la hacienda de su prójimo: y su dueño lo aceptará, y el otro no pagará.

verses.KJV: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.WEB: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.
verses.ASV: But if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se lhe houver sido furtado, ressarcirá a seu dono.
verses.RVR09: Mas si le hubiere sido hurtado, resarcirá á su dueño.

verses.KJV: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.WEB: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.ASV: If it be torn in pieces, let him bring it for witness: he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se lhe houver sido arrebatado por fera, trará a ele testemunho, e não pagará o arrebatado.
verses.RVR09: Y si le hubiere sido arrebatado por fiera, traerle ha testimonio, y no pagará lo arrebatado.

verses.KJV: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.WEB: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
verses.ASV: And if a man borrow aught of his neighbor, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se alguém houver tomado emprestado animal de seu próximo, e for ferido ou morto, ausente seu dono, deverá pagá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Pero si alguno hubiere tomado prestada bestia de su prójimo, y fuere estropeada ó muerta, ausente su dueño, deberá pagarla.

verses.KJV: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
verses.WEB: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
verses.ASV: If the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be a hired thing, it came for its hire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o dono estava presente, não o pagará. Se era alugado, ele virá por seu aluguel.
verses.RVR09: Si el dueño estaba presente, no la pagará. Si era alquilada, él vendrá por su alquiler.

verses.KJV: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.WEB: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
verses.ASV: And if a man entice a virgin that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém enganar a alguma virgem que não for desposada, e dormir com ela, deverá pagar o dote por ela e tomá-la por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno engañare á alguna doncella que no fuere desposada, y durmiere con ella, deberá dotarla y tomarla por mujer.

verses.KJV: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.WEB: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.ASV: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se seu pai não quiser dá-la a ele, ele lhe pesará prata conforme o dote das virgens.
verses.RVR09: Si su padre no quisiere dársela, él le pesará plata conforme al dote de las vírgenes.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.WEB: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not suffer a sorceress to live.
verses.ALMEIDA: À feiticeira não deixarás que viva.
verses.RVR09: A la hechicera no dejarás que viva.

verses.KJV: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que tiver ajuntamento com animal, morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que tuviere ayuntamiento con bestia, morirá.

verses.KJV: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.WEB: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.ASV: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto Jehovah only, shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que sacrificar a deuses, exceto a somente o SENHOR, será morto.
verses.RVR09: El que sacrificare á dioses, excepto á sólo Jehová, será muerto.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And a sojourner shalt thou not wrong, neither shalt thou oppress him: for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao estrangeiro não enganarás, nem angustiarás, porque estrangeiros fostes vós na terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y al extranjero no engañarás, ni angustiarás, porque extranjeros fuisteis vosotros en la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.WEB: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nenhuma viúva nem órfão afligireis.
verses.RVR09: A ninguna viuda ni huérfano afligiréis.

verses.KJV: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.WEB: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.ASV: If thou afflict them at all, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que se tu chegas a afligir-lhe, e ele a mim clamar, certamente ouvirei eu seu clamor;
verses.RVR09: Que si tú llegas á afligirle, y él á mí clamare, ciertamente oiré yo su clamor;

verses.KJV: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.WEB: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.ASV: and my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meu furor se acenderá, e vos matarei a espada, e vossas mulheres serão viúvas, e órfãos vossos filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y mi furor se encenderá, y os mataré á cuchillo, y vuestras mujeres serán viudas, y huérfanos vuestros hijos.

verses.KJV: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
verses.WEB: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.
verses.ASV: If thou lend money to any of my people with thee that is poor, thou shalt not be to him as a creditor; neither shall ye lay upon him interest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se deres a meu povo dinheiro emprestado, ao pobre que está contigo, não te portarás com ele como agiota, nem lhe imporás juros.
verses.RVR09: Si dieres á mi pueblo dinero emprestado, al pobre que está contigo, no te portarás con él como logrero, ni le impondrás usura.

verses.KJV: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
verses.WEB: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
verses.ASV: If thou at all take thy neighbor’s garment to pledge, thou shalt restore it unto him before the sun goeth down:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tomares em penhor a roupa de teu próximo, a pôr do sol o devolverás a ele:
verses.RVR09: Si tomares en prenda el vestido de tu prójimo, á puestas del sol se lo volverás:

verses.KJV: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.WEB: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
verses.ASV: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque somente aquilo é sua coberta, é aquela a roupa para cobrir suas carnes, no que há de dormir: e será que quando ele a mim clamar, eu então lhe ouvirei, porque sou misericordioso.
verses.RVR09: Porque sólo aquello es su cubierta, es aquél el vestido para cubrir sus carnes, en el que ha de dormir: y será que cuando él á mí clamare, yo entonces le oiré, porque soy misericordioso.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
verses.WEB: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not revile God, nor curse a ruler of thy people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não insultarás aos juízes, nem amaldiçoarás ao príncipe de teu povo.
verses.RVR09: No denostarás á los jueces, ni maldecirás al príncipe de tu pueblo.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
verses.WEB: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not delay to offer of thy harvest, and of the outflow of thy presses. The first-born of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não adiarás as primícias de tua colheita, nem de teu licor, me darás o primogênito de teus filhos.
verses.RVR09: No dilatarás la primicia de tu cosecha, ni de tu licor: me darás el primogénito de tus hijos.

verses.KJV: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.WEB: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
verses.ASV: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, [and] with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with its dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim farás com o de teu boi e de tua ovelha: sete dias estará com sua mãe, e ao oitavo dia me o darás.
verses.RVR09: Así harás con el de tu buey y de tu oveja: siete días estará con su madre, y al octavo día me lo darás.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.WEB: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.ASV: And ye shall be holy men unto me: therefore ye shall not eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E haveis de ser para mim homens santos: e não comereis carne arrebatada das feras no campo; aos cães a lançareis.
verses.RVR09: Y habéis de serme varones santos: y no comeréis carne arrebatada de las fieras en el campo; á los perros la echaréis.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.WEB: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not take up a false report: put not thy hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não admitirás falso rumor. Não serás cúmplice com o ímpio para ser falsa testemunha.
verses.RVR09: NO admitirás falso rumor. No te concertarás con el impío para ser testigo falso.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verses.WEB: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to turn aside after a multitude to wrest [justice]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não seguirás aos muitos para mal fazer; nem responderás em litigio inclinando-te à maioria para fazer injustiças;
verses.RVR09: No seguirás á los muchos para mal hacer; ni responderás en litigio inclinándote á los más para hacer agravios;

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.WEB: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
verses.ASV: neither shalt thou favor a poor man in his cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: nem ao pobre privilegiarás em sua causa.
verses.RVR09: Ni al pobre distinguirás en su causa.

verses.KJV: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.WEB: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
verses.ASV: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se encontrares o boi de teu inimigo ou seu asno extraviado, traze-o de volta.
verses.RVR09: Si encontrares el buey de tu enemigo ó su asno extraviado, vuelve á llevárselo.

verses.KJV: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
verses.WEB: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.
verses.ASV: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, thou shalt forbear to leave him, thou shalt surely release [it] with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vires o asno do que te aborrece caído debaixo de sua carga, lhe deixarás então desamparado? Sem falta ajudarás com ele a levantá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Si vieres el asno del que te aborrece caído debajo de su carga, ¿le dejarás entonces desamparado? Sin falta ayudarás con él á levantarlo.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.WEB: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not wrest the justice [due] to thy poor in his cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não perverterás o direito de teu pobre em seu pleito.
verses.RVR09: No pervertirás el derecho de tu mendigo en su pleito.

verses.KJV: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.WEB: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.ASV: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: De palavra de mentira te afastarás, e não matarás ao inocente e justo; porque eu não justificarei ao ímpio.
verses.RVR09: De palabra de mentira te alejarás, y no matarás al inocente y justo; porque yo no justificaré al impío.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.WEB: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt take no bribe: for a bribe blindeth them that have sight, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não receberás suborno; porque o suborno cega aos que veem, e perverte as palavras justas.
verses.RVR09: No recibirás presente; porque el presente ciega á los que ven, y pervierte las palabras justas.

verses.KJV: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And a sojourner shalt thou not oppress: for ye know the heart of a sojourner, seeing ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não angustiarás ao estrangeiro: pois vós sabeis como se acha a alma do estrangeiro, já que estrangeiros fostes na terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y no angustiarás al extranjero: pues vosotros sabéis cómo se halla el alma del extranjero, ya que extranjeros fuisteis en la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.WEB: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
verses.ASV: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the increase thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis anos semearás tua terra, e recolherás sua colheita:
verses.RVR09: Seis años sembrarás tu tierra, y allegarás su cosecha:

verses.KJV: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.
verses.WEB: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
verses.ASV: but the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie fallow; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beast of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, [and] with thy oliveyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas no sétimo a deixarás vazia e liberarás, para que comam os pobres de teu povo; e do que restar comerão os animais do campo; assim farás de tua vinha e de teu olival.
verses.RVR09: Mas el séptimo la dejarás vacante y soltarás, para que coman los pobres de tu pueblo; y de lo que quedare comerán las bestias del campo; así harás de tu viña y de tu olivar.

verses.KJV: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.WEB: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.
verses.ASV: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest; that thine ox and thine ass may have rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the sojourner, may be refreshed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis dias farás teus negócios, e ao sétimo dia folgarás, a fim que descanse teu boi e teu asno, e tome refrigério o filho de tua serva, e o estrangeiro.
verses.RVR09: Seis días harás tus negocios, y al séptimo día holgarás, á fin que descanse tu buey y tu asno, y tome refrigerio el hijo de tu sierva, y el extranjero.

verses.KJV: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.WEB: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
verses.ASV: And in all things that I have said unto you take ye heed: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em tudo o que vos disse sereis avisados. E nome de outros deuses não mencionareis, nem se ouvirá de vossa boca.
verses.RVR09: Y en todo lo que os he dicho seréis avisados. Y nombre de otros dioses no mentaréis, ni se oirá de vuestra boca.

verses.KJV: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.WEB: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
verses.ASV: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.ALMEIDA: Três vezes no ano me celebrareis festa.
verses.RVR09: Tres veces en el año me celebraréis fiesta.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.WEB: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
verses.ASV: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep: seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it thou camest out from Egypt); and none shall appear before me empty:
verses.ALMEIDA: A festa dos pães ázimos guardarás: Sete dias comerás os pães sem levedura, como eu te mandei, no tempo do mês de Abibe; porque nele saíste do Egito: e ninguém comparecerá vazio diante de mim:
verses.RVR09: La fiesta de los ázimos guardarás: siete días comerás los panes sin levadura, como yo te mandé, en el tiempo del mes de Abib; porque en él saliste de Egipto: y ninguno comparecerá vacío delante de mí:

verses.KJV: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.WEB: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
verses.ASV: and the feast of harvest, the first-fruits of thy labors, which thou sowest in the field: and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when thou gatherest in thy labors out of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também a festa da colheita, os primeiros frutos de teus trabalhos que houveres semeado no campo; e a festa da colheita à saída do ano, quando haverás recolhido teus trabalhos do campo.
verses.RVR09: También la fiesta de la siega, los primeros frutos de tus labores que hubieres sembrado en el campo; y la fiesta de la cosecha á la salida del año, cuando habrás recogido tus labores del campo.

verses.KJV: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord God.
verses.WEB: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Três vezes no ano comparecerá todo homem teu diante do Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Tres veces en el año parecerá todo varón tuyo delante del Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.WEB: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my feast remain all night until the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não oferecerás com pão levedado o sangue de meu sacrifício, nem a gordura de meu animal sacrificado ficará da noite até a manhã.
verses.RVR09: No ofrecerás con pan leudo la sangre de mi sacrificio; ni el sebo de mi víctima quedará de la noche hasta la mañana.

verses.KJV: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.WEB: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.ASV: The first of the first-fruits of thy ground thou shalt bring into the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.
verses.ALMEIDA: As primícias dos primeiros frutos de tua terra trarás à casa do SENHOR teu Deus. Não cozerás o cabrito com o leite de sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Las primicias de los primeros frutos de tu tierra traerás á la casa de Jehová tu Dios. No guisarás el cabrito con la leche de su madre.

verses.KJV: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
verses.ASV: Behold, I send an angel before thee, to keep thee by the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu envio o anjo diante de ti para que te guarde no caminho, e te introduza no lugar que eu preparei.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo envío el Angel delante de ti para que te guarde en el camino, y te introduzca en el lugar que yo he preparado.

verses.KJV: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
verses.WEB: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
verses.ASV: Take ye heed before him, and hearken unto his voice; provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgression: for my name is in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda-te diante dele, e ouve sua voz; não lhe sejas rebelde; porque ele não perdoará vossa rebelião: porque meu nome está nele.
verses.RVR09: Guárdate delante de él, y oye su voz; no le seas rebelde; porque él no perdonará vuestra rebelión: porque mi nombre está en él.

verses.KJV: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.WEB: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
verses.ASV: But if thou shalt indeed hearken unto his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se em verdade ouvires sua voz, e fizeres tudo o que eu te disser, serei inimigo a teus inimigos, e afligirei aos que te afligirem.
verses.RVR09: Pero si en verdad oyeres su voz, é hicieres todo lo que yo te dijere, seré enemigo á tus enemigos, y afligiré á los que te afligieren.

verses.KJV: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.WEB: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
verses.ASV: For mine angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite: and I will cut them off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque meu anjo irá adiante de ti, e te introduzirá aos amorreus, e aos heteus, e aos perizeus, e aos cananeus, e aos heveus, e aos jebuseus, aos quais eu farei destruir.
verses.RVR09: Porque mi Angel irá delante de ti, y te introducirá al Amorrheo, y al Hetheo, y al Pherezeo, y al Cananeo, y al Heveo, y al Jebuseo, á los cuales yo haré destruir.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.WEB: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works; but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and break in pieces their pillars.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te inclinarás a seus deuses, nem os servirás, nem farás como eles fazem; antes os destruirás por completo, e quebrarás inteiramente suas estátuas.
verses.RVR09: No te inclinarás á sus dioses, ni los servirás, ni harás como ellos hacen; antes los destruirás del todo, y quebrantarás enteramente sus estatuas.

verses.KJV: And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.WEB: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
verses.ASV: And ye shall serve Jehovah your God, and he will bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao SENHOR vosso Deus servireis, e ele abençoará teu pão e tuas águas; e eu tirarei toda enfermidade do meio de ti.
verses.RVR09: Mas á Jehová vuestro Dios serviréis, y él bendecirá tu pan y tus aguas; y yo quitaré toda enfermedad de en medio de ti.

verses.KJV: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.WEB: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
verses.ASV: There shall none cast her young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não haverá mulher que aborte, nem estéril em tua terra; e eu cumprirei o número de teus dias.
verses.RVR09: No habrá mujer que aborte, ni estéril en tu tierra; y yo cumpliré el número de tus días.

verses.KJV: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.WEB: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
verses.ASV: I will send my terror before thee, and will discomfit all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu enviarei meu terror diante de ti, e abaterei a todo povo onde tu entrares, e te darei o pescoço de todos os teus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Yo enviaré mi terror delante de ti, y consternaré á todo pueblo donde tú entrares, y te daré la cerviz de todos tus enemigos.

verses.KJV: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.WEB: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
verses.ASV: And I will send the hornet before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu enviarei a vespa diante de ti, que lance fora aos heveus, e aos cananeus, e aos heteus, de diante de ti:
verses.RVR09: Yo enviaré la avispa delante de ti, que eche fuera al Heveo, y al Cananeo, y al Hetheo, de delante de ti:

verses.KJV: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
verses.WEB: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
verses.ASV: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the beasts of the field multiply against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não os expulsarei de diante de ti em ano, para que não fique a terra deserta, e se aumentem contra ti as feras do campo.
verses.RVR09: No los echaré de delante de ti en un año, porque no quede la tierra desierta, y se aumenten contra ti las bestias del campo.

verses.KJV: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.WEB: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
verses.ASV: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pouco a pouco os expulsarei de diante de ti, até que te multipliques e tomes a terra por herança.
verses.RVR09: Poco á poco los echaré de delante de ti, hasta que te multipliques y tomes la tierra por heredad.

verses.KJV: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.WEB: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
verses.ASV: And I will set thy border from the Red Sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness unto the River: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand: and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu porei teu termo desde o mar Vermelho até o mar de filístia, e desde o deserto até o rio: porque porei em vossas mãos os moradores da terra, e tu os expulsarás de diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Y yo pondré tu término desde el mar Bermejo hasta la mar de Palestina, y desde el desierto hasta el río: porque pondré en vuestras manos los moradores de la tierra, y tú los echarás de delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.WEB: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não farás aliança com eles, nem com seus deuses.
verses.RVR09: No harás alianza con ellos, ni con sus dioses.

verses.KJV: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.WEB: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
verses.ASV: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me; for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tua terra não habitarão, não seja que te façam pecar contra mim servindo a seus deuses: porque te será de tropeço.
verses.RVR09: En tu tierra no habitarán, no sea que te hagan pecar contra mí sirviendo á sus dioses: porque te será de tropiezo.

verses.KJV: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
verses.WEB: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.
verses.ASV: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto Jehovah, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a Moisés: Sobe ao SENHOR, tu, e Arão, Nadabe, e Abiú, e setenta dos anciãos de Israel; e vos inclinareis desde longe.
verses.RVR09: Y DIJO á Moisés: Sube á Jehová, tú, y Aarón, Nadab, y Abiú, y setenta de los ancianos de Israel; y os inclinaréis desde lejos.

verses.KJV: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.WEB: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”
verses.ASV: and Moses alone shall come near unto Jehovah; but they shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Moisés somente se chegará ao SENHOR; e eles não se aproximem, nem suba com ele o povo.
verses.RVR09: Mas Moisés sólo se llegará á Jehová; y ellos no se lleguen cerca, ni suba con él el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the Lord hath said will we do.
verses.WEB: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”
verses.ASV: And Moses came and told the people all the words of Jehovah, and all the ordinances: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which Jehovah hath spoken will we do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés veio e contou ao povo todas as palavras do SENHOR, e todos os estatutos: e todo o povo respondeu em uma voz, e disseram: Executaremos todas as palavras que o SENHOR disse.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés vino y contó al pueblo todas las palabras de Jehová, y todos los derechos: y todo el pueblo respondió á una voz, y dijeron: Ejecutaremos todas las palabras que Jehová ha dicho.

verses.KJV: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.WEB: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Moses wrote all the words of Jehovah, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the mount, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés escreveu todas as palavras do SENHOR, e levantando-se de manhã edificou um altar ao pé do monte, e doze colunas, segundo as doze tribos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés escribió todas las palabras de Jehová, y levantándose de mañana edificó un altar al pie del monte, y doce columnas, según las doce tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt-offerings, and sacrificed peace-offerings of oxen unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou aos rapazes dos filhos de Israel, os quais ofereceram holocaustos e sacrificaram pacíficos ao SENHOR, bezerros.
verses.RVR09: Y envió á los mancebos de los hijos de Israel, los cuales ofrecieron holocaustos, y sacrificaron pacíficos á Jehová, becerros.

verses.KJV: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.WEB: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.ASV: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés tomou a metade do sangue, e a pôs em bacias, e espargiu a outra metade do sangue sobre o altar.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés tomó la mitad de la sangre, y púsola en tazones, y esparció la otra mitad de la sangre sobre el altar.

verses.KJV: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.WEB: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”
verses.ASV: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that Jehovah hath spoken will we do, and be obedient.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou o livro da aliança, e leu aos ouvidos do povo, o qual disse: Faremos todas as coisas que o SENHOR disse, e obedeceremos.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó el libro de la alianza, y leyó á oídos del pueblo, el cual dijo: Haremos todas las cosas que Jehová ha dicho, y obedeceremos.

verses.KJV: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.
verses.WEB: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”
verses.ASV: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Jehovah hath made with you concerning all these words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés tomou o sangue, e salpicou sobre o povo, e disse: Eis o sangue da aliança que o SENHOR fez convosco sobre todas estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés tomó la sangre, y roció sobre el pueblo, y dijo: He aquí la sangre de la alianza que Jehová ha hecho con vosotros sobre todas estas cosas.

verses.KJV: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
verses.WEB: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.
verses.ASV: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiram Moisés e Arão, Nadabe e Abiú, e setenta dos anciãos de Israel;
verses.RVR09: Y subieron Moisés y Aarón, Nadab y Abiú, y setenta de los ancianos de Israel;

verses.KJV: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
verses.WEB: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.
verses.ASV: and they saw the God of Israel; and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of sapphire stone, and as it were the very heaven for clearness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viram ao Deus de Israel; e havia debaixo de seus pés como um pavimento de safira, semelhante ao céu quando está claro.
verses.RVR09: Y vieron al Dios de Israel; y había debajo de sus pies como un embaldosado de zafiro, semejante al cielo cuando está sereno.

verses.KJV: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
verses.WEB: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
verses.ASV: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: and they beheld God, and did eat and drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não estendeu sua mão sobre os príncipes dos filhos de Israel: e viram a Deus, e comeram e beberam.
verses.RVR09: Mas no extendió su mano sobre los príncipes de los hijos de Israel: y vieron á Dios, y comieron y bebieron.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee the tables of stone, and the law and the commandment, which I have written, that thou mayest teach them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Sobe a mim ao monte, e espera ali, e te darei tábuas de pedra, e a lei, e mandamentos que escrevi para ensiná-los.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Moisés: Sube á mí al monte, y espera allá, y te daré tablas de piedra, y la ley, y mandamientos que he escrito para enseñarlos.

verses.KJV: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.WEB: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
verses.ASV: And Moses rose up, and Joshua his minister: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se Moisés, e Josué seu assistente; e Moisés subiu ao monte de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Moisés, y Josué su ministro; y Moisés subió al monte de Dios.

verses.KJV: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
verses.WEB: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: whosoever hath a cause, let him come near unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse aos anciãos: Esperai-nos aqui até que voltemos a vós: e eis que Arão e Hur estão convosco: o que tiver negócios chegue-se a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á los ancianos: Esperadnos aquí hasta que volvamos á vosotros: y he aquí Aarón y Hur están con vosotros: el que tuviere negocios, lléguese á ellos.

verses.KJV: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
verses.WEB: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
verses.ASV: And Moses went up into the mount, and the cloud covered the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés subiu ao monte, e uma nuvem cobriu o monte.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés subió al monte, y una nube cubrió el monte.

verses.KJV: And the glory of the Lord abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
verses.ASV: And the glory of Jehovah abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a glória do SENHOR repousou sobre o monte Sinai, e a nuvem o cobriu por seis dias: e ao sétimo dia chamou a Moisés do meio da nuvem.
verses.RVR09: Y la gloria de Jehová reposó sobre el monte Sinaí, y la nube lo cubrió por seis días: y al séptimo día llamó á Moisés de en medio de la nube.

verses.KJV: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And the appearance of the glory of Jehovah was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a aparência da glória do SENHOR era como um fogo abrasador no cume do monte, aos olhos dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y el parecer de la gloria de Jehová era como un fuego abrasador en la cumbre del monte, á los ojos de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.WEB: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.ASV: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud, and went up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrou Moisés em meio da nuvem, e subiu ao monte: e esteve Moisés no monte quarenta dias e quarenta noites.
verses.RVR09: Y entró Moisés en medio de la nube, y subió al monte: y estuvo Moisés en el monte cuarenta días y cuarenta noches.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they take for me an offering: of every man whose heart maketh him willing ye shall take my offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize aos filhos de Israel que tomem para mim oferta: de todo homem que a der de sua vontade, de coração, tomareis minha oferta.
verses.RVR09: Di á los hijos de Israel que tomen para mí ofrenda: de todo varón que la diere de su voluntad, de corazón, tomaréis mi ofrenda.

verses.KJV: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.WEB: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
verses.ASV: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them: gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a oferta que tomareis deles: Ouro, e prata, e bronze,
verses.RVR09: Y esta es la ofrenda que tomaréis de ellos: Oro, y plata, y cobre,

verses.KJV: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.WEB: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
verses.ASV: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ [hair],
verses.ALMEIDA: E material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho fino, e pelo de cabras,
verses.RVR09: Y jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino fino, y pelo de cabras,

verses.KJV: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.WEB: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
verses.ASV: and rams’ skins dyed red, and sealskins, and acacia wood,
verses.ALMEIDA: E couros de carneiros tingidos de vermelho, e couros finos, e madeira de acácia;
verses.RVR09: Y cueros de carneros teñidos de rojo, y cueros de tejones, y madera de Sittim;

verses.KJV: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.WEB: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
verses.ASV: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.ALMEIDA: Azeite para a luminária, especiarias para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático;
verses.RVR09: Aceite para la luminaria, especias para el aceite de la unción, y para el sahumerio aromático;

verses.KJV: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.WEB: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
verses.ASV: onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedras de ônix, e pedras de engastes, para o éfode, e para o peitoral.
verses.RVR09: Piedras de onix, y piedras de engastes, para el ephod, y para el racional.

verses.KJV: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.WEB: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
verses.ASV: And let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farão para mim um santuário, e eu habitarei entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y hacerme han un santuario, y yo habitaré entre ellos.

verses.KJV: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.WEB: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
verses.ASV: According to all that I show thee, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the furniture thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme tudo o que eu te mostrar, o desenho do tabernáculo, e o desenho de todos os seus objetos, assim o fareis.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á todo lo que yo te mostrare, el diseño del tabernáculo, y el diseño de todos sus vasos, así lo haréis.

verses.KJV: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.WEB: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.ASV: And they shall make an ark of acacia wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farão também uma arca de madeira de acácia, cujo comprimento será de dois côvados e meio, e sua largura de côvado e meio, e sua altura de côvado e meio.
verses.RVR09: Harán también un arca de madera de Sittim, cuya longitud será de dos codos y medio, y su anchura de codo y medio, y su altura de codo y medio.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.WEB: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cobrirás de ouro puro; por dentro e por fora a cobrirás; e farás sobre ela uma borda de ouro ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y la cubrirás de oro puro; por dentro y por fuera la cubrirás; y harás sobre ella una cornisa de oro alrededor.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.WEB: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four feet thereof; and two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para ela farás de fundição quatro anéis de ouro, que porás a seus quatro cantos; dois anéis ao um lado dela, e dois anéis ao outro lado.
verses.RVR09: Y para ella harás de fundición cuatro anillos de oro, que pondrás á sus cuatro esquinas; dos anillos al un lado de ella, y dos anillos al otro lado.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.WEB: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make staves of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás umas varas de madeira de acácia, as quais cobrirás de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y harás unas varas de madera de Sittim, las cuales cubrirás de oro:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.WEB: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, wherewith to bear the ark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meterás as varas pelos anéis aos lados da arca, para levar a arca com elas.
verses.RVR09: Y meterás las varas por los anillos á los lados del arca, para llevar el arca con ellas.

verses.KJV: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.WEB: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
verses.ASV: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.ALMEIDA: As varas se estarão nos anéis da arca: não se tirarão dela.
verses.RVR09: Las varas se estarán en los anillos del arca: no se quitarán de ella.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.WEB: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás no arca o testemunho que eu te darei.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás en el arca el testimonio que yo te daré.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.WEB: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make a mercy-seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás uma coberta de ouro fino, cujo comprimento será de dois côvados e meio, e sua largura de côvado e meio.
verses.RVR09: Y harás una cubierta de oro fino, cuya longitud será de dos codos y medio, y su anchura de codo y medio.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.WEB: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make two cherubim of gold; of beaten work shalt thou make them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também dois querubins de ouro, lavrados a martelo os farás, nas duas extremidades do propiciatório.
verses.RVR09: Harás también dos querubines de oro, labrados á martillo los harás, en los dos cabos de la cubierta.

verses.KJV: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.WEB: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
verses.ASV: And make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end: of one piece with the mercy-seat shall ye make the cherubim on the two ends thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás, pois, um querubim ao extremo de um lado, e um querubim ao outro extremo do lado oposto: da qualidade do propiciatório farás os querubins em suas duas extremidades.
verses.RVR09: Harás, pues, un querubín al extremo de un lado, y un querubín al otro extremo del lado opuesto: de la calidad de la cubierta harás los querubines en sus dos extremidades.

verses.KJV: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.WEB: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
verses.ASV: And the cherubim shall spread out their wings on high, covering the mercy-seat with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the mercy-seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os querubins estenderão por encima as asas, cobrindo com suas asas o propiciatório: suas faces a uma em frente da outra, olhando ao propiciatório as faces dos querubins.
verses.RVR09: Y los querubines extenderán por encima las alas, cubriendo con sus alas la cubierta: sus caras la una enfrente de la otra, mirando á la cubierta las caras de los querubines.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.WEB: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás o propiciatório encima da arca, e no arca porás o testemunho que eu te darei.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás la cubierta encima del arca, y en el arca pondrás el testimonio que yo te daré.

verses.KJV: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy-seat, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali me declararei a ti, e falarei contigo de sobre o propiciatório, dentre os dois querubins que estão sobre a arca do testemunho, tudo o que eu te mandarei para os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y de allí me declararé á ti, y hablaré contigo de sobre la cubierta, de entre los dos querubines que están sobre el arca del testimonio, todo lo que yo te mandaré para los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.WEB: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make a table of acacia wood: two cubits [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também uma mesa de madeira de acácia: seu comprimento será de dois côvados, e de um côvado sua largura, e sua altura de côvado e meio.
verses.RVR09: Harás asimismo una mesa de madera de Sittim: su longitud será de dos codos, y de un codo su anchura, y su altura de codo y medio.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.WEB: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cobrirás de ouro puro, e lhe farás uma borda de ouro ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y la cubrirás de oro puro, y le has de hacer una cornisa de oro alrededor.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.WEB: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make unto it a border of a handbreadth round about; and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também para ele também uma moldura ao redor, da largura de uma mão, à qual moldura farás uma borda de ouro ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Hacerle has también una moldura alrededor, del ancho de una mano, á la cual moldura harás una cornisa de oro en circunferencia.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.WEB: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe farás quatro anéis de ouro, os quais porás aos quatro cantos que correspondem a seus quatro pés.
verses.RVR09: Y le harás cuatro anillos de oro, los cuales pondrás á las cuatro esquinas que corresponden á sus cuatro pies.

verses.KJV: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.WEB: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
verses.ASV: Close by the border shall the rings be, for places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os anéis estarão antes da moldura, por lugares das varas, para levar a mesa.
verses.RVR09: Los anillos estarán antes de la moldura, por lugares de las varas, para llevar la mesa.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.WEB: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás as varas de madeira de acácia, e as cobrirás de ouro, e com elas será levada a mesa.
