verses.RVR09: Y harás las varas de madera de Sittim, y las cubrirás de oro, y con ellas será llevada la mesa.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.WEB: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and the spoons thereof, and the flagons thereof, and the bowls thereof, wherewith to pour out: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também seus pratos, e suas colheres, e seus jarros, e suas bacias, com que se fará libações: de ouro fino os farás.
verses.RVR09: Harás también sus platos, y sus cucharas, y sus cubiertas, y sus tazones, con que se libará: de oro fino los harás.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.WEB: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set upon the table showbread before me alway.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás sobre a mesa o pão da proposição diante de mim continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás sobre la mesa el pan de la proposición delante de mí continuamente.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.WEB: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made, even its base, and its shaft; its cups, its knops, and its flowers, shall be of one piece with it:
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também um candelabro de ouro puro; lavrado a martelo se fará o candelabro: seu pé, e sua cana, seus copos, seus botões, e suas flores, serão do mesmo:
verses.RVR09: Harás además un candelero de oro puro; labrado á martillo se hará el candelero: su pie, y su caña, sus copas, sus manzanas, y sus flores, serán de lo mismo:

verses.KJV: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.WEB: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
verses.ASV: and there shall be six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: E sairão seis braços de seus lados: três braços do candelabro do um lado seu, e três braços do candelabro do outro seu lado:
verses.RVR09: Y saldrán seis brazos de sus lados: tres brazos del candelero del un lado suyo, y tres brazos del candelero del otro su lado:

verses.KJV: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.WEB: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
verses.ASV: three cups made like almond-blossoms in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three cups made like almond-blossoms in the other branch, a knop and a flower: so for the six branches going out of the candlestick:
verses.ALMEIDA: Três copos em forma de amêndoas em um braço, um botão e uma flor; e três copos, forma de amêndoas no outro braço, um botão e uma flor: assim, pois, nos seis braços que saem do candelabro:
verses.RVR09: Tres copas en forma de almendras en el un brazo, una manzana y una flor; y tres copas, figura de almendras, en el otro brazo, una manzana y una flor: así pues, en los seis brazos que salen del candelero:

verses.KJV: And in the candlesticks shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
verses.WEB: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
verses.ASV: and in the candlestick four cups made like almond-blossoms, the knops thereof, and the flowers thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: E no candelabro quatro copos em forma de amêndoas, seus botões e suas flores.
verses.RVR09: Y en el candelero cuatro copas en forma de almendras, sus manzanas y sus flores.

verses.KJV: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.WEB: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
verses.ASV: and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haverá um botão debaixo dos dois braços do mesmo, outro botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, e outra botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, em conformidade aos seis braços que saem do candelabro.
verses.RVR09: Habrá una manzana debajo de los dos brazos de lo mismo, otra manzana debajo de los otros dos brazos de lo mismo, y otra manzana debajo de los otros dos brazos de lo mismo, en conformidad á los seis brazos que salen del candelero.

verses.KJV: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.WEB: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.ASV: Their knops and their branches shall be of one piece with it; the whole of it one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus botões e seus braços serão do mesmo, todo ele uma peça lavrada a martelo, de ouro puro.
verses.RVR09: Sus manzanas y sus brazos serán de lo mismo, todo ello una pieza labrada á martillo, de oro puro.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.WEB: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the lamps thereof, seven: and they shall light the lamps thereof, to give light over against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás para ele sete lâmpadas, as quais acenderás para que iluminem à parte de sua dianteira:
verses.RVR09: Y hacerle has siete candilejas, las cuales encenderás para que alumbren á la parte de su delantera:

verses.KJV: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.WEB: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
verses.ASV: And the snuffers thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também suas tenazes e seus apagadores, de ouro puro.
verses.RVR09: También sus despabiladeras y sus platillos, de oro puro.

verses.KJV: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.WEB: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
verses.ASV: Of a talent of pure gold shall it be made, with all these vessels.
verses.ALMEIDA: De um talento de ouro fino o farás, com todos estes objetos.
verses.RVR09: De un talento de oro fino lo harás, con todos estos vasos.

verses.KJV: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.WEB: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
verses.ASV: And see that thou make them after their pattern, which hath been showed thee in the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olha, e faze-os conforme seu modelo, que te foi mostrado no monte.
verses.RVR09: Y mira, y hazlos conforme á su modelo, que te ha sido mostrado en el monte.

verses.KJV: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
verses.WEB: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.
verses.ASV: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim the work of the skilful workman shalt thou make them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás o tabernáculo de dez cortinas de linho torcido, azul, e púrpura, e carmesim: e farás querubins de obra delicada.
verses.RVR09: Y HARÁS el tabernáculo de diez cortinas de lino torcido, cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí: y harás querubines de obra delicada.

verses.KJV: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.WEB: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.ASV: The length of each curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comprimento da uma cortina de vinte e oito côvados, e a largura da mesma cortina de quatro côvados: todas as cortinas terão uma medida.
verses.RVR09: La longitud de la una cortina de veintiocho codos, y la anchura de la misma cortina de cuatro codos: todas las cortinas tendrán una medida.

verses.KJV: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.WEB: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
verses.ASV: Five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and [the other] five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cinco cortinas estarão juntas a uma com a outra, e cinco cortinas unidas a uma com a outra.
verses.RVR09: Cinco cortinas estarán juntas la una con la otra, y cinco cortinas unidas la una con la otra.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.WEB: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is outmost in the second coupling.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás laçadas de azul na beira da uma cortina, na margem, na juntura: e assim farás na beira da última cortina na juntura segunda.
verses.RVR09: Y harás lazadas de cárdeno en la orilla de la una cortina, en el borde, en la juntura: y así harás en la orilla de la postrera cortina en la juntura segunda.

verses.KJV: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.WEB: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.
verses.ASV: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling; the loops shall be opposite one to another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cinquenta laçadas farás na uma cortina, e cinquenta laçadas farás na margem da cortina que está na segunda juntura: as laçadas estarão contrapostas a uma à outra.
verses.RVR09: Cincuenta lazadas harás en la una cortina, y cincuenta lazadas harás en el borde de la cortina que está en la segunda juntura: las lazadas estarán contrapuestas la una á la otra.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
verses.WEB: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains one to another with the clasps: and the tabernacle shall be one [whole].
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também cinquenta colchetes de ouro, com os quais juntarás as cortinas a uma com a outra, e se formará um tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Harás también cincuenta corchetes de oro, con los cuales juntarás las cortinas la una con la otra, y se formará un tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
verses.WEB: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ [hair] for a tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também cortinas de pelo de cabras para uma tenda sobre o tabernáculo; onze cortinas farás.
verses.RVR09: Harás asimismo cortinas de pelo de cabras para una cubierta sobre el tabernáculo; once cortinas harás.

verses.KJV: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
verses.WEB: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
verses.ASV: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comprimento de uma cortina será de trinta côvados, e a largura da mesma cortina de quatro côvados: uma medida terão as onze cortinas.
verses.RVR09: La longitud de la una cortina será de treinta codos, y la anchura de la misma cortina de cuatro codos: una medida tendrán las once cortinas.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntarás as cinco cortinas à parte e as outras seis cortinas separadamente; e dobrarás a sexta cortina diante da face do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Y juntarás las cinco cortinas aparte y las otras seis cortinas separadamente; y doblarás la sexta cortina delante de la faz del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.WEB: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops upon the edge of the curtain which is [outmost in] the second coupling.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás cinquenta laçadas na orla de uma cortina, à extremidade na juntura, e cinquenta laçadas na orla da segunda cortina na outra juntura.
verses.RVR09: Y harás cincuenta lazadas en la orilla de la una cortina, al borde en la juntura, y cincuenta lazadas en la orilla de la segunda cortina en la otra juntura.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.WEB: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of brass, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também cinquenta colchetes de alambre, os quais meterás pelas laçadas: e juntarás a tenda, para que se faça uma só cobertura.
verses.RVR09: Harás asimismo cincuenta corchetes de alambre, los cuales meterás por las lazadas: y juntarás la tienda, para que se haga una sola cubierta.

verses.KJV: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: And the overhanging part that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o excedente que resulta nas cortinas da tenda, a metade da uma cortina que sobra, ficará às costas do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Y el sobrante que resulta en las cortinas de la tienda, la mitad de la una cortina que sobra, quedará á las espaldas del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.WEB: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.ASV: And the cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um côvado da uma parte, e outro côvado da outra que sobra no comprimento das cortinas da tenda, pendurará sobre os lados do tabernáculo da uma parte e da outra, para cobri-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y un codo de la una parte, y otro codo de la otra que sobra en la longitud de las cortinas de la tienda, cargará sobre los lados del tabernáculo de la una parte y de la otra, para cubrirlo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.
verses.WEB: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sealskins above.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também à tenda uma coberta de couros de carneiros, tingidos de vermelho, e uma coberta de couros finos encima.
verses.RVR09: Harás también á la tienda una cubierta de cueros de carneros, teñidos de rojo, y una cubierta de cueros de tejones encima.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
verses.WEB: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás para o tabernáculo tábuas de madeira de acácia, que estejam na vertical.
verses.RVR09: Y harás para el tabernáculo tablas de madera de Sittim, que estén derechas.

verses.KJV: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
verses.WEB: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
verses.ASV: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comprimento de cada tábua será de dez côvados, e de côvado e meio a largura de cada tábua.
verses.RVR09: La longitud de cada tabla será de diez codos, y de codo y medio la anchura de cada tabla.

verses.KJV: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: Two tenons shall there be in each board, joined one to another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dois encaixes terá cada tábua, unidos um com o outro; assim farás todas as tábuas do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Dos quicios tendrá cada tabla, trabadas la una con la otra; así harás todas las tablas del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.WEB: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás, pois, as tábuas do tabernáculo: vinte tábuas ao lado do sul.
verses.RVR09: Harás, pues, las tablas del tabernáculo: veinte tablas al lado del mediodía, al austro.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.WEB: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons:
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás quarenta bases de prata debaixo das vinte tábuas; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua para seus dois encaixes, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua para seus dois encaixes.
verses.RVR09: Y harás cuarenta basas de plata debajo de las veinte tablas; dos basas debajo de la una tabla para sus dos quicios, y dos basas debajo de la otra tabla para sus dos quicios.

verses.KJV: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
verses.WEB: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
verses.ASV: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao outro lado do tabernáculo, à parte do norte, vinte tábuas;
verses.RVR09: Y al otro lado del tabernáculo, á la parte del aquilón, veinte tablas;

verses.KJV: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.WEB: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.ASV: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas quarenta bases de prata: duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua.
verses.RVR09: Y sus cuarenta basas de plata: dos basas debajo de la una tabla, y dos basas debajo de la otra tabla.

verses.KJV: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.WEB: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
verses.ASV: And for the hinder part of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para o lado do tabernáculo, ao ocidente, farás seis tábuas.
verses.RVR09: Y para el lado del tabernáculo, al occidente, harás seis tablas.

verses.KJV: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.WEB: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.
verses.ASV: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também duas tábuas para as esquinas do tabernáculo nos dois ângulos posteriores;
verses.RVR09: Harás además dos tablas para las esquinas del tabernáculo en los dos ángulos posteriores;

verses.KJV: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.WEB: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.ASV: And they shall be double beneath, and in like manner they shall be entire unto the top thereof unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais se unirão por abaixo, e também se juntarão por seu alto a uma argola: assim será das outras duas que estarão às duas esquinas.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales se unirán por abajo, y asimismo se juntarán por su alto á un gozne: así será de las otras dos que estarán á las dos esquinas.

verses.KJV: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.WEB: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.ASV: And there shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que serão oito tábuas, com suas bases de prata, dezesseis bases; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua.
verses.RVR09: De suerte que serán ocho tablas, con sus basas de plata, diez y seis basas; dos basas debajo de la una tabla, y dos basas debajo de la otra tabla.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.WEB: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também cinco barras de madeira de acácia, para as tábuas de um lado do tabernáculo,
verses.RVR09: Harás también cinco barras de madera de Sittim, para las tablas del un lado del tabernáculo,

verses.KJV: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
verses.WEB: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
verses.ASV: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the hinder part westward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cinco barras para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo, e cinco barras para o outro lado do tabernáculo, que está ao ocidente.
verses.RVR09: Y cinco barras para las tablas del otro lado del tabernáculo, y cinco barras para el otro lado del tabernáculo, que está al occidente.

verses.KJV: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.WEB: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
verses.ASV: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a barra do meio passará por meio das tábuas, de uma extremidade à outra.
verses.RVR09: Y la barra del medio pasará por medio de las tablas, del un cabo al otro.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.WEB: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cobrirás as tábuas de ouro, e farás seus anéis de ouro para meter por eles as barras: também cobrirás as barras de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y cubrirás las tablas de oro, y harás sus anillos de oro para meter por ellos las barras: también cubrirás las barras de oro.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.WEB: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which hath been showed thee in the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantarás o tabernáculo conforme sua planta que te foi mostrada no monte.
verses.RVR09: Y alzarás el tabernáculo conforme á su traza que te fué mostrada en el monte.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
verses.WEB: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubim the work of the skilful workman shall it be made:
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás também um véu de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e de linho torcido: será feito de primoroso trabalho, com querubins:
verses.RVR09: Y harás también un velo de cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y de lino torcido: será hecho de primorosa labor, con querubines:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
verses.WEB: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks [shall be] of gold, upon four sockets of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E hás de pô-lo sobre quatro colunas de madeira de acácia cobertas de ouro; seus capitéis de ouro, sobre bases de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y has de ponerlo sobre cuatro columnas de madera de Sittim cubiertas de oro; sus capiteles de oro, sobre basas de plata.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
verses.WEB: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the clasps, and shalt bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony: and the veil shall separate unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás o véu debaixo dos colchetes, e meterás ali, do véu dentro, a arca do testemunho; e aquele véu vos fará separação entre o lugar santo e o santíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás el velo debajo de los corchetes, y meterás allí, del velo adentro, el arca del testimonio; y aquel velo os hará separación entre el lugar santo y el santísimo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.WEB: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás a coberta sobre a arca do testemunho no lugar santíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás la cubierta sobre el arca del testimonio en el lugar santísimo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.WEB: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set the table without the veil, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás a mesa fora do véu, e o candelabro em frente da mesa ao lado do tabernáculo ao sul; e porás a mesa ao lado do norte.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás la mesa fuera del velo, y el candelero enfrente de la mesa al lado del tabernáculo al mediodía; y pondrás la mesa al lado del aquilón.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
verses.WEB: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás à porta do tabernáculo uma cortina de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido, obra de bordador.
verses.RVR09: Y harás á la puerta del tabernáculo una cortina de cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido, obra de bordador.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.WEB: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold: their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás para a cortina cinco colunas de madeira de acácia, as quais cobrirás de ouro, com seus capitéis de ouro: e as farás de fundição cinco bases de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Y harás para la cortina cinco columnas de madera de Sittim, las cuales cubrirás de oro, con sus capiteles de oro: y hacerlas has de fundición cinco basas de metal.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
verses.WEB: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também altar de madeira de acácia de cinco côvados de comprimento, e de cinco côvados de largura: será quadrado o altar, e sua altura de três côvados.
verses.RVR09: HARÁS también altar de madera de Sittim de cinco codos de longitud, y de cinco codos de anchura: será cuadrado el altar, y su altura de tres codos.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.WEB: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof; the horns thereof shall be of one piece with it: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás suas pontas a seus quatro cantos; as pontas serão do mesmo; e as cobrirás de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Y harás sus cuernos á sus cuatro esquinas; los cuernos serán de lo mismo; y lo cubrirás de metal.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
verses.WEB: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make its pots to take away its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its flesh-hooks, and its firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também seus caldeirões para lançar sua cinza; e suas pás, e suas bacias, e seus garfos, e seus braseiros: farás todos os seus vasos de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Harás también sus calderas para echar su ceniza; y sus paletas, y sus tazones, y sus garfios, y sus braseros: harás todos sus vasos de metal.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.WEB: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make for it a grating of network of brass: and upon the net shalt thou make four brazen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe farás uma grelha de bronze de obra de malha; e sobre a grelha farás quatro anéis de bronze a seus quatro cantos.
verses.RVR09: Y le harás un enrejado de metal de obra de malla; y sobre el enrejado harás cuatro anillos de metal á sus cuatro esquinas.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
verses.WEB: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put it under the ledge round the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o porás dentro da borda do altar abaixo; e chegará a grelha até o meio do altar.
verses.RVR09: Y lo has de poner dentro del cerco del altar abajo; y llegará el enrejado hasta el medio del altar.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.WEB: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of acacia wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também varas para o altar, varas de madeira de acácia, as quais cobrirás de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Harás también varas para el altar, varas de madera de Sittim, las cuales cubrirás de metal.

verses.KJV: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
verses.WEB: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
verses.ASV: And the staves thereof shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, in bearing it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas varas se meterão pelos anéis: e estarão aquelas varas a ambos lados do altar, quando houver de ser levado.
verses.RVR09: Y sus varas se meterán por los anillos: y estarán aquellas varas á ambos lados del altar, cuando hubiere de ser llevado.

verses.KJV: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
verses.WEB: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
verses.ASV: Hollow with planks shalt thou make it: as it hath been showed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
verses.ALMEIDA: De tábuas o farás, oco: da maneira que te foi mostrado no monte, assim o farás.
verses.RVR09: De tablas lo harás, hueco: de la manera que te fué mostrado en el monte, así lo harás.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.WEB: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen a hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.ALMEIDA: Também farás o átrio do tabernáculo: ao lado do sul, terá o átrio cortinas de linho torcido, de cem côvados de comprimento cada um lado;
verses.RVR09: Asimismo harás el atrio del tabernáculo: al lado del mediodía, al austro, tendrá el atrio cortinas de lino torcido, de cien codos de longitud cada un lado;

verses.KJV: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.WEB: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.ASV: and the pillars thereof shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets [shall be] of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas vinte colunas, e suas vinte bases serão de bronze; os capitéis das colunas e suas molduras, de prata.
verses.RVR09: Sus veinte columnas, y sus veinte basas serán de metal; los capiteles de las columnas y sus molduras, de plata.

verses.KJV: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.WEB: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.ASV: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings a hundred cubits long, and the pillars thereof twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da mesma maneira ao lado do norte haverá ao comprimento cortinas de cem côvados de comprimento, e suas vinte colunas, com suas vinte bases de bronze; os capitéis de suas colunas e suas molduras, de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y de la misma manera al lado del aquilón habrá á lo largo cortinas de cien codos de longitud, y sus veinte columnas, con sus veinte basas de metal; los capiteles de sus columnas y sus molduras, de plata.

verses.KJV: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.WEB: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.ASV: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a largura do átrio do lado ocidental terá cortinas de cinquenta côvados; suas colunas dez, com suas dez bases.
verses.RVR09: Y el ancho del atrio del lado occidental tendrá cortinas de cincuenta codos; sus columnas diez, con sus diez basas.

verses.KJV: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.WEB: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.ASV: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: E na largura do átrio pela parte do oriente, haverá cinquenta côvados.
verses.RVR09: Y en el ancho del atrio por la parte de levante, al oriente, habrá cincuenta codos.

verses.KJV: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.WEB: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.ASV: The hangings for the one side [of the gate] shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as cortinas de um lado serão de quinze côvados; suas colunas três, com suas três bases.
verses.RVR09: Y las cortinas del un lado serán de quince codos; sus columnas tres, con sus tres basas.

verses.KJV: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.WEB: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.ASV: And for the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao outro lado quinze côvados de cortinas; suas colunas três, com suas três bases.
verses.RVR09: Al otro lado quince codos de cortinas; sus columnas tres, con sus tres basas.

verses.KJV: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
verses.WEB: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
verses.ASV: And for the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à porta do átrio haverá uma cortina de vinte côvados, de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido, de obra de bordador: suas colunas quatro, com suas quatro bases.
verses.RVR09: Y á la puerta del atrio habrá un pabellón de veinte codos, de cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido, de obra de bordador: sus columnas cuatro, con sus cuatro basas.

verses.KJV: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.WEB: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
verses.ASV: All the pillars of the court round about shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as colunas do átrio em derredor serão cingidas de prata; seus capitéis de prata, e suas bases de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Todas las columnas del atrio en derredor serán ceñidas de plata; sus capiteles de plata, y sus basas de metal.

verses.KJV: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.WEB: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.
verses.ASV: The length of the court shall be a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comprimento do átrio será de cem côvados, e a largura cinquenta por um lado e cinquenta pelo outro, e a altura de cinco côvados: suas cortinas de linho torcido, e suas bases de bronze.
verses.RVR09: La longitud del atrio será de cien codos, y la anchura cincuenta por un lado y cincuenta por el otro, y la altura de cinco codos: sus cortinas de lino torcido, y sus basas de metal.

verses.KJV: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.WEB: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.
verses.ASV: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os utensílios do tabernáculo em todo o seu serviço, e todos os seus pregos, e todos os pregos do átrio, serão de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Todos los vasos del tabernáculo en todo su servicio, y todos sus clavos, y todos los clavos del atrio, serán de metal.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
verses.WEB: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu mandarás aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite puro de olivas, prensado, para a luminária, para fazer arder continuamente as lâmpadas.
verses.RVR09: Y tú mandarás á los hijos de Israel que te traigan aceite puro de olivas, molido, para la luminaria, para hacer arder continuamente las lámparas.

verses.KJV: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the Lord: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: In the tent of meeting, without the veil which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah: it shall be a statute for ever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: No tabernáculo do testemunho, fora do véu que está diante do testemunho, as porá em ordem Arão e seus filhos, diante do SENHOR desde a tarde até a manhã, como estatuto perpétuo dos filhos de Israel por suas gerações.
verses.RVR09: En el tabernáculo del testimonio, afuera del velo que está delante del testimonio, las pondrá en orden Aarón y sus hijos, delante de Jehová desde la tarde hasta la mañana, como estatuto perpetuo de los hijos de Israel por sus generaciones.

verses.KJV: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
verses.WEB: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
verses.ASV: And bring thou near unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu aproxima a ti a Arão teu irmão, e a seus filhos consigo, dentre os filhos de Israel, para que sejam meus sacerdotes; a Arão, Nadabe e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar, filhos de Arão.
verses.RVR09: Y TÚ allega á ti á Aarón tu hermano, y á sus hijos consigo, de entre los hijos de Israel, para que sean mis sacerdotes; á Aarón, Nadab y Abiú, Eleazar é Ithamar, hijos de Aarón.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
verses.WEB: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, for glory and for beauty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás vestimentas sagradas a Arão teu irmão, para honra e formosura.
verses.RVR09: Y harás vestidos sagrados á Aarón tu hermano, para honra y hermosura.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.WEB: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu falarás a todos os sábios de coração, aos quais eu enchi de espírito de sabedoria; a fim de que façam as roupas de Arão, para consagrar-lhe a que me sirva de sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Y tú hablarás á todos los sabios de corazón, á quienes yo he henchido de espíritu de sabiduría, á fin que hagan los vestidos de Aarón, para consagrarle á que me sirva de sacerdote.

verses.KJV: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.WEB: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.ASV: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a coat of checker work, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.ALMEIDA: As vestimentas que farão são estes: o peitoral, e o éfode, e o manto, e a túnica bordada, a mitra, e o cinturão. Façam, pois, as sagradas vestimentas a Arão teu irmão, e a seus filhos, para que sejam meus sacerdotes.
verses.RVR09: Los vestidos que harán son estos: el racional, y el ephod, y el manto, y la túnica labrada, la mitra, y el cinturón. Hagan, pues, los sagrados vestidos á Aarón tu hermano, y á sus hijos, para que sean mis sacerdotes.

verses.KJV: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.WEB: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
verses.ASV: And they shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomarão ouro, e azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido.
verses.RVR09: Tomarán oro, y cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido.

verses.KJV: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
verses.WEB: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
verses.ASV: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skilful workman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farão o éfode de ouro e azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido de obra de bordador.
verses.RVR09: Y harán el ephod de oro y cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido de obra de bordador.

verses.KJV: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
verses.WEB: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.
verses.ASV: It shall have two shoulder-pieces joined to the two ends thereof, that it may be joined together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Terá duas ombreiras que se juntem a seus dois lados, e se juntará.
verses.RVR09: Tendrá dos hombreras que se junten á sus dos lados, y se juntará.

verses.KJV: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.WEB: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.ASV: And the skilfully woven band, which is upon it, wherewith to gird it on, shall be like the work thereof [and] of the same piece; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o artifício de seu cinto que está sobre ele, será de sua mesma obra, do mesmo; de ouro, azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido.
verses.RVR09: Y el artificio de su cinto que está sobre él, será de su misma obra, de lo mismo; de oro, cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.WEB: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomarás duas pedras de ônix, e gravarás nelas os nomes dos filhos de Israel:
verses.RVR09: Y tomarás dos piedras oniquinas, y grabarás en ellas los nombres de los hijos de Israel:

verses.KJV: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.WEB: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.
verses.ASV: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os seis de seus nomes em uma pedra, e os outros seis nomes na outra pedra, conforme o nascimento deles.
verses.RVR09: Los seis de sus nombres en la una piedra, y los otros seis nombres en la otra piedra, conforme al nacimiento de ellos.

verses.KJV: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
verses.WEB: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.
verses.ASV: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be inclosed in settings of gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: De obra de escultor em pedra a modo de gravuras de selo, farás gravar aquelas duas pedras com os nomes dos filhos de Israel; farás para eles ao redor engastes de ouro.
verses.RVR09: De obra de escultor en piedra á modo de grabaduras de sello, harás grabar aquellas dos piedras con los nombres de los hijos de Israel; harásles alrededor engastes de oro.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.WEB: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before Jehovah upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás aquelas duas pedras sobre os ombros do éfode, para pedras de memória aos filhos de Israel; e Arão levará os nomes deles diante do SENHOR em seus dois ombros por memória.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás aquellas dos piedras sobre los hombros del ephod, para piedras de memoria á los hijos de Israel; y Aarón llevará los nombres de ellos delante de Jehová en sus dos hombros por memoria.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
verses.WEB: You shall make settings of gold,
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make settings of gold,
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás, pois, engastes de ouro,
verses.RVR09: Harás pues, engastes de oro,

verses.KJV: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
verses.WEB: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.
verses.ASV: and two chains of pure gold; like cords shalt thou make them, of wreathen work: and thou shalt put the wreathen chains on the settings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E duas correntinhas de ouro fino; as quais farás de feitura de trança; e fixarás as correntes de feitura de trança nos engastes.
verses.RVR09: Y dos cadenillas de oro fino; las cuales harás de hechura de trenza; y fijarás las cadenas de hechura de trenza en los engastes.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.WEB: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skilful workman; like the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também o peitoral do juízo de primorosa obra, lhe farás conforme a obra do éfode, de ouro, e azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido.
verses.RVR09: Harás asimismo el racional del juicio de primorosa obra, le has de hacer conforme á la obra del ephod, de oro, y cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido.

verses.KJV: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
verses.WEB: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.
verses.ASV: Foursquare it shall be [and] double; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será quadrado e duplo, de um palmo de comprimento e um palmo de largura:
verses.RVR09: Será cuadrado y doble, de un palmo de largo y un palmo de ancho:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
verses.WEB: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle shall be the first row;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o encherás de pedrarias com quatro ordens de pedras: uma ordem de uma pedra sárdio, um topázio, e um carbúnculo; será a primeira ordem;
verses.RVR09: Y lo llenarás de pedrería con cuatro órdenes de piedras: un orden de una piedra sárdica, un topacio, y un carbunclo; será el primer orden;

verses.KJV: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.WEB: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
verses.ASV: and the second row an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;
verses.ALMEIDA: A segunda ordem, uma esmeralda, uma safira, e um diamante;
verses.RVR09: El segundo orden, una esmeralda, un zafiro, y un diamante;

verses.KJV: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.WEB: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.ASV: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.ALMEIDA: A terceira ordem, um rubi, uma ágata, e uma ametista;
verses.RVR09: El tercer orden, un rubí, un ágata, y una amatista;

verses.KJV: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
verses.WEB: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
verses.ASV: and the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be inclosed in gold in their settings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a quarta ordem, um berilo, um ônix, e um jaspe: estarão engastadas em ouro em seus encaixes.
verses.RVR09: Y el cuarto orden, un berilo, un onix, y un jaspe: estarán engastadas en oro en sus encajes.

verses.KJV: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
verses.WEB: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
verses.ASV: And the stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serão aquelas pedra segundo os nomes dos filhos de Israel, doze segundo seus nomes; como gravuras de selo cada uma com seu nome, virão a ser segundo as doze tribos.
verses.RVR09: Y serán aquellas piedras según los nombres de los hijos de Israel, doce según sus nombres; como grabaduras de sello cada una con su nombre, vendrán á ser según las doce tribus.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.WEB: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains like cords, of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também no peitoral correntes de feitura de tranças de ouro fino.
verses.RVR09: Harás también en el racional cadenetas de hechura de trenzas de oro fino.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.WEB: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás no peitoral dois anéis de ouro, os quais dois anéis porás às duas pontas do peitoral.
verses.RVR09: Y harás en el racional dos anillos de oro, los cuales dos anillos pondrás á las dos puntas del racional.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.WEB: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás as duas tranças de ouro nos dois anéis às duas pontas do peitoral:
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás las dos trenzas de oro en los dos anillos á las dos puntas del racional:

verses.KJV: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
verses.WEB: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
verses.ASV: And the [other] two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod in the forepart thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as duas extremidades das duas tranças sobre os dois engastes, e as porás aos lados do éfode na parte dianteira.
verses.RVR09: Y los dos cabos de las dos trenzas sobre los dos engastes, y las pondrás á los lados del ephod en la parte delantera.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
verses.WEB: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também dois anéis de ouro, os quais porás às duas pontas do peitoral, em sua orla que está ao lado do éfode da parte de dentro.
verses.RVR09: Harás también dos anillos de oro, los cuales pondrás á las dos puntas del racional, en su orilla que está al lado del ephod de la parte de dentro.

verses.KJV: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.WEB: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and shalt put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também dois anéis de ouro, os quais porás aos dois lados do éfode abaixo na parte dianteira, diante de sua juntura sobre o cinto do éfode.
verses.RVR09: Harás asimismo dos anillos de oro, los cuales pondrás á los dos lados del ephod abajo en la parte delantera, delante de su juntura sobre el cinto del ephod.

verses.KJV: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
verses.WEB: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.
verses.ASV: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntarão o peitoral com seus anéis aos anéis do éfode com um cordão de azul, para que esteja sobre o cinto do éfode, e não se separe o peitoral do éfode.
verses.RVR09: Y juntarán el racional con sus anillos á los anillos del ephod con un cordón de jacinto, para que esté sobre el cinto del ephod, y no se aparte el racional del ephod.

verses.KJV: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.
verses.WEB: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
verses.ASV: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levará Arão os nomes dos filhos de Israel no peitoral do juízo sobre seu coração, quando entrar no santuário, para memória diante do SENHOR continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Y llevará Aarón los nombres de los hijos de Israel en el racional del juicio sobre su corazón, cuando entrare en el santuario, para memoria delante de Jehová continuamente.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.
verses.WEB: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before Jehovah: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before Jehovah continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás no peitoral do juízo Urim e Tumim, para que estejam sobre o coração de Arão quando entrar diante do SENHOR: e levará sempre Arão o juízo dos filhos de Israel sobre seu coração diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás en el racional del juicio Urim y Thummim, para que estén sobre el corazón de Aarón cuando entrare delante de Jehová: y llevará siempre Aarón el juicio de los hijos de Israel sobre su corazón delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.WEB: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás o manto do éfode todo de material azul:
verses.RVR09: Harás el manto del ephod todo de jacinto:

verses.KJV: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
verses.WEB: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.
verses.ASV: And it shall have a hole for the head in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it be not rent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em meio dele por acima haverá uma abertura, a qual terá uma borda ao redor de obra de tecelão, como a abertura de um colarinho, para que não se rompa.
verses.RVR09: Y en medio de él por arriba habrá una abertura, la cual tendrá un borde alrededor de obra de tejedor, como el cuello de un coselete, para que no se rompa.

verses.KJV: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
verses.WEB: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
verses.ASV: And upon the skirts of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the skirts thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
verses.ALMEIDA: E abaixo em suas orlas farás romãs de material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, por suas bordas ao redor; e entre elas sinos de ouro ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y abajo en sus orillas harás granadas de jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, por sus bordes alrededor; y entre ellas campanillas de oro alrededor:

verses.KJV: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
verses.WEB: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
verses.ASV: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um sino de ouro e uma granada, sino de ouro e granada, pelas orlas do manto ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Una campanilla de oro y una granada, campanilla de oro y granada, por las orillas del manto alrededor.

verses.KJV: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the Lord, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
verses.WEB: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he not die.
verses.ASV: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and the sound thereof shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before Jehovah, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estará sobre Arão quando ministrar; e se ouvirá seu som quando ele entrar no santuário diante do SENHOR e quando sair, porque não morra.
verses.RVR09: Y estará sobre Aarón cuando ministrare; y oiráse su sonido cuando él entrare en el santuario delante de Jehová y cuando saliere, porque no muera.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, Holiness To The Lord.
verses.WEB: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO THE LORD.’
verses.ASV: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLY TO JEHOVAH.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás também uma prancha de ouro fino, e gravarás nela gravura de selo, SANTIDADE AO SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Harás además una plancha de oro fino, y grabarás en ella grabadura de sello, SANTIDAD Á JEHOVÁ.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
verses.WEB: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a porás com um cordão de azul, e estará sobre a mitra; pela frente anterior da mitra estará.
verses.RVR09: Y la pondrás con un cordón de jacinto, y estará sobre la mitra; por el frente anterior de la mitra estará.

verses.KJV: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord.
verses.WEB: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estará sobre a testa de Arão: e levará Arão o pecado das coisas santas, que os filhos de Israel houverem consagrado em todas as suas santas ofertas; e sobre sua testa estará continuamente para que tenham favor diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y estará sobre la frente de Aarón: y llevará Aarón el pecado de las cosas santas, que los hijos de Israel hubieren consagrado en todas sus santas ofrendas; y sobre su frente estará continuamente para que hayan gracia delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.
verses.WEB: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt weave the coat in checker work of fine linen, and thou shalt make a mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make a girdle, the work of the embroiderer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E bordarás uma túnica de linho, e farás uma mitra de linho; farás também um cinto de obra de bordador.
verses.RVR09: Y bordarás una túnica de lino, y harás una mitra de lino; harás también un cinto de obra de recamador.

verses.KJV: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
verses.WEB: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.
verses.ASV: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and head-tires shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para os filhos de Arão farás túnicas; também lhes farás cintos, e lhes formarás tiaras para honra e adorno.
verses.RVR09: Y para los hijos de Aarón harás túnicas; también les harás cintos, y les formarás chapeos (tiaras) para honra y hermosura.
