verses.KJV: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
verses.ASV: And he received it at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, and made it a molten calf: and they said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual os tomou das mãos deles, e formou-o com buril, e fez disso um bezerro de fundição. Então disseram: Israel, estes são teus deuses, que te tiraram da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: El cual los tomó de las manos de ellos, y formólo con buril, é hizo de ello un becerro de fundición. Entonces dijeron: Israel, estos son tus dioses, que te sacaron de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the Lord.
verses.WEB: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And when Aaron saw [this], he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To-morrow shall be a feast to Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo isto Arão, edificou um altar diante do bezerro; e apregoou Arão, e disse: Amanhã será festa ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo esto Aarón, edificó un altar delante del becerro; y pregonó Aarón, y dijo: Mañana será fiesta á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.WEB: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.ASV: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt-offerings, and brought peace-offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia seguinte madrugaram, e ofereceram holocaustos, e apresentaram pacíficos: e sentou-se o povo a comer e a beber, e levantaram-se a regozijar-se.
verses.RVR09: Y el día siguiente madrugaron, y ofrecieron holocaustos, y presentaron pacíficos: y sentóse el pueblo á comer y á beber, y levantáronse á regocijarse.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, that thou broughtest up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Anda, desce, porque teu povo que tiraste da terra do Egito se corrompeu:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Moisés: Anda, desciende, porque tu pueblo que sacaste de tierra de Egipto se ha corrompido:

verses.KJV: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
verses.ASV: they have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed unto it, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo se apartaram do caminho que eu lhes mandei, e se fizeram um bezerro de fundição, e o adoraram, e sacrificaram a ele, e disseram: Israel, estes são teus deuses, que te tiraram da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Presto se han apartado del camino que yo les mandé, y se han hecho un becerro de fundición, y lo han adorado, y han sacrificado á él, y han dicho: Israel, estos son tus dioses, que te sacaron de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais o SENHOR a Moisés: Eu vi a este povo, que por certo é povo de dura cerviz:
verses.RVR09: Dijo más Jehová á Moisés: Yo he visto á este pueblo, que por cierto es pueblo de dura cerviz:

verses.KJV: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
verses.WEB: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”
verses.ASV: now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, deixa-me que se acenda meu furor neles, e os consuma: e a ti eu porei sobre grande gente.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, déjame que se encienda mi furor en ellos, y los consuma: y á ti yo te pondré sobre gran gente.

verses.KJV: And Moses besought the Lord his God, and said, Lord, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
verses.WEB: Moses begged the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
verses.ASV: And Moses besought Jehovah his God, and said, Jehovah, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, that thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés orou à face do SENHOR seu Deus, e disse: Ó SENHOR, por que se acenderá teu furor em teu povo, que tu tiraste da terra do Egito com grande força, e com mão forte?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés oró á la faz de Jehová su Dios, y dijo: Oh Jehová, ¿por qué se encenderá tu furor en tu pueblo, que tú sacaste de la tierra de Egipto con gran fortaleza, y con mano fuerte?

verses.KJV: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
verses.WEB: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.
verses.ASV: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, saying, For evil did he bring them forth, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que hão de falar os egípcios, dizendo: Para o mal os tirou, para matá-los nos montes, e para exterminá-los de sobre a face da terra? Volta-te do furor de tua ira, e arrepende-te do mal de teu povo.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué han de hablar los Egipcios, diciendo: Para mal los sacó, para matarlos en los montes, y para raerlos de sobre la haz de la tierra? Vuélvete del furor de tu ira, y arrepiéntete del mal de tu pueblo.

verses.KJV: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
verses.WEB: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”
verses.ASV: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te de Abraão, de Isaque, e de Israel teus servos, aos quais juraste por ti mesmo, e disse-lhes: Eu multiplicarei vossa semente como as estrelas do céu; e darei a vossa semente toda esta terra que disse, e a tomarão por herança para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de Abraham, de Isaac, y de Israel, tus siervos, á los cuales has jurado por ti mismo, y dícholes: Yo multiplicaré vuestra simiente como las estrellas del cielo; y daré á vuestra simiente toda esta tierra que he dicho, y la tomarán por heredad para siempre.

verses.KJV: And the Lord repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
verses.WEB: So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah repented of the evil which he said he would do unto his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR se arrependeu do mal que disse que havia de fazer a seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová se arrepintió del mal que dijo que había de hacer á su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.WEB: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.
verses.ASV: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, with the two tables of the testimony in his hand; tables that were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.ALMEIDA: E virou-se Moisés, e desceu do monte trazendo em sua mão as duas tábuas do testemunho, as tábuas escritas por ambos os lados; de uma parte e de outra estavam escritas.
verses.RVR09: Y volvióse Moisés, y descendió del monte trayendo en su mano las dos tablas del testimonio, las tablas escritas por ambos lados; de una parte y de otra estaban escritas.

verses.KJV: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
verses.WEB: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
verses.ASV: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as tábuas eram obra de Deus, e a escritura era escritura de Deus gravada sobre as tábuas.
verses.RVR09: Y las tablas eran obra de Dios, y la escritura era escritura de Dios grabada sobre las tablas.

verses.KJV: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
verses.WEB: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
verses.ASV: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo Josué o clamor do povo que gritava, disse a Moisés: Barulho de batalha há no campo.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo Josué el clamor del pueblo que gritaba, dijo á Moisés: Alarido de pelea hay en el campo.

verses.KJV: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
verses.WEB: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”
verses.ASV: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome; but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Não é eco de gritos de vitória de fortes, nem eco de gritos de fracos: eu ouço barulho de cantorias.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: No es eco de algazara de fuertes, ni eco de alaridos de flacos: algazara de cantar oigo yo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
verses.WEB: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, que quando chegou ele ao acampamento, e viu o bezerro e as danças, acendeu-se a ira a Moisés, e lançou as tábuas de suas mãos, e quebrou-as ao pé do monte.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que como llegó él al campo, y vió el becerro y las danzas, enardeciósele la ira á Moisés, y arrojó las tablas de sus manos, y quebrólas al pie del monte.

verses.KJV: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
verses.WEB: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.
verses.ASV: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it with fire, and ground it to powder, and strewed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou o bezerro que fizeram, e queimou-o no fogo, e moeu-o até reduzi-lo a pó, que espalhou sobre as águas, e deu-o a beber aos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó el becerro que habían hecho, y quemólo en el fuego, y moliólo hasta reducirlo á polvo, que esparció sobre las aguas, y diólo á beber á los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.WEB: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought a great sin upon them?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés a Arão: Que te fez este povo, que trouxeste sobre ele tão grande pecado?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Aarón: ¿Qué te ha hecho este pueblo, que has traído sobre él tan gran pecado?

verses.KJV: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
verses.WEB: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
verses.ASV: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are [set] on evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Arão: Não se ire meu senhor; tu conheces o povo, que é inclinado ao mal.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Aarón: No se enoje mi señor; tú conoces el pueblo, que es inclinado á mal.

verses.KJV: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.WEB: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
verses.ASV: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque me disseram: Faze-nos deuses que vão adiante de nós, que a este Moisés, o homem que tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe aconteceu.
verses.RVR09: Porque me dijeron: Haznos dioses que vayan delante de nosotros, que á este Moisés, el varón que nos sacó de tierra de Egipto, no sabemos qué le ha acontecido.

verses.KJV: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.WEB: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
verses.ASV: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off: so they gave it me; and I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu lhes respondi: Quem tem ouro? Separai-o. E o deram a mim, e lancei-o no fogo, e saiu este bezerro.
verses.RVR09: Y yo les respondí: ¿Quién tiene oro? apartadlo. Y diéronmelo, y echélo en el fuego, y salió este becerro.

verses.KJV: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
verses.WEB: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),
verses.ASV: And when Moses saw that the people were broken loose, (for Aaron had let them loose for a derision among their enemies,)
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Moisés que o povo estava descontrolado, porque Arão o havia deixado se descontrolarem para vergonha entre seus inimigos,
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Moisés que el pueblo estaba despojado, porque Aarón lo había despojado para vergüenza entre sus enemigos,

verses.KJV: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.WEB: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on the LORD’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
verses.ASV: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Whoso is on Jehovah’s side, [let him come] unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pôs-se Moisés à porta do acampamento, e disse: Quem é do SENHOR? junte-se comigo. E juntaram-se com ele todos os filhos de Levi.
verses.RVR09: Púsose Moisés á la puerta del real, y dijo: ¿Quién es de Jehová? júntese conmigo. Y juntáronse con él todos los hijos de Leví.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Put ye every man his sword upon his thigh, and go to and fro from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Assim disse o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel: Ponde cada um sua espada sobre sua coxa: passai e voltai de porta em porta pelo acampamento, e matai cada um a seu irmão, e a seu amigo, e a seu parente.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Así ha dicho Jehová, el Dios de Israel: Poned cada uno su espada sobre su muslo: pasad y volved de puerta á puerta por el campo, y matad cada uno á su hermano, y á su amigo, y á su pariente.

verses.KJV: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.WEB: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Levi o fizeram conforme o dito de Moisés: e caíram do povo naquele dia como três mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Leví lo hicieron conforme al dicho de Moisés: y cayeron del pueblo en aquel día como tres mil hombres.

verses.KJV: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the Lord, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said, Consecrate yourselves to-day to Jehovah, yea, every man against his son, and against his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés disse: Hoje vos consagrastes ao SENHOR, porque cada um se consagrou em seu filho, e em seu irmão, para que dê ele hoje bênção sobre vós.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés dijo: Hoy os habéis consagrado á Jehová, porque cada uno se ha consagrado en su hijo, y en su hermano, para que dé él hoy bendición sobre vosotros.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the Lord; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
verses.WEB: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto Jehovah; peradventure I shall make atonement for your sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que no dia seguinte disse Moisés ao povo: Vós cometestes um grande pecado: mas eu subirei agora ao SENHOR; talvez lhe consiga apaziguar o furor acerca de vosso pecado.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que el día siguiente dijo Moisés al pueblo: Vosotros habéis cometido un gran pecado: mas yo subiré ahora á Jehová; quizá le aplacaré acerca de vuestro pecado.

verses.KJV: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
verses.WEB: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
verses.ASV: And Moses returned unto Jehovah, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então voltou Moisés ao SENHOR, e disse: Rogo-te, pois este povo cometeu um grande pecado, porque fizeram para si deuses de ouro,
verses.RVR09: Entonces volvió Moisés á Jehová, y dijo: Ruégote, pues este pueblo ha cometido un gran pecado, porque se hicieron dioses de oro,

verses.KJV: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
verses.WEB: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”
verses.ASV: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que perdoes agora seu pecado, e se não, apaga-me agora de teu livro que escreveste.
verses.RVR09: Que perdones ahora su pecado, y si no, ráeme ahora de tu libro que has escrito.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR respondeu a Moisés: Ao que pecar contra mim, a este apagarei eu de meu livro.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová respondió á Moisés: Al que pecare contra mí, á éste raeré yo de mi libro.

verses.KJV: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
verses.WEB: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”
verses.ASV: And now go, lead the people unto [the place] of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine angel shall go before thee; nevertheless in the day when I visit, I will visit their sin upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, pois, agora, leva a este povo aonde te disse: eis que meu anjo irá diante de ti; que no dia de minha visitação eu visitarei neles seu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Ve pues ahora, lleva á este pueblo donde te he dicho: he aquí mi ángel irá delante de ti; que en el día de mi visitación yo visitaré en ellos su pecado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.WEB: The LORD struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah smote the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR feriu ao povo, porque fizeram o bezerro que formou Arão.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová hirió al pueblo, porque habían hecho el becerro que formó Aarón.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, Depart, go up hence, thou and the people that thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land of which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Vai, sobe daqui, tu e o povo que tiraste da terra do Egito, à terra da qual jurei a Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, dizendo: À tua semente a darei:
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ dijo á Moisés: Ve, sube de aquí, tú y el pueblo que sacaste de la tierra de Egipto, á la tierra de la cual juré á Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob, diciendo: A tu simiente la daré:

verses.KJV: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.WEB: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.ASV: and I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu enviarei diante de ti o anjo, e lançarei fora aos cananeus e aos amorreus, e aos heteus, e aos perizeus, e aos heveus e aos jebuseus:
verses.RVR09: Y yo enviaré delante de ti el ángel, y echaré fuera al Cananeo y al Amorrheo, y al Hetheo, y al Pherezeo, y al Heveo y al Jebuseo:

verses.KJV: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
verses.WEB: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”
verses.ASV: unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee, for thou art a stiffnecked people, lest I consume thee in the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: (À terra que flui leite e mel); porque eu não subirei em meio de ti, porque és povo de dura cerviz, não seja que te consuma no caminho.
verses.RVR09: (A la tierra que fluye leche y miel); porque yo no subiré en medio de ti, porque eres pueblo de dura cerviz, no sea que te consuma en el camino.

verses.KJV: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
verses.WEB: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.
verses.ASV: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo o povo esta desagradável palavra, vestiram luto, e ninguém se pôs seus ornamentos:
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo el pueblo esta sensible palabra, vistieron luto, y ninguno se puso sus atavíos:

verses.KJV: For the Lord had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people; if I go up into the midst of thee for one moment, I shall consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Dize aos filhos de Israel: Vós sois povo de dura cerviz: em um momento subirei em meio de ti, e te consumirei: tira de ti, pois, agora teus ornamentos, que eu saberei o que te tenho de fazer.
verses.RVR09: Pues Jehová dijo á Moisés: Di á los hijos de Israel: Vosotros sois pueblo de dura cerviz: en un momento subiré en medio de ti, y te consumiré: quítate pues ahora tus atavíos, que yo sabré lo que te tengo de hacer.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from mount Horeb onward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os filhos de Israel se despojaram de seus ornamentos desde o monte Horebe.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los hijos de Israel se despojaron de sus atavíos desde el monte Horeb.

verses.KJV: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the Lord went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
verses.WEB: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought the LORD went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.
verses.ASV: Now Moses used to take the tent and to pitch it without the camp, afar off from the camp; and he called it, The tent of meeting. And it came to pass, that every one that sought Jehovah went out unto the tent of meeting, which was without the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés tomou o tabernáculo, e estendeu-o fora do acampamento, longe do acampamento, e chamou-o o Tabernáculo do Testemunho. E foi que qualquer um que buscava ao SENHOR saía ao tabernáculo do testemunho, que estava fora do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés tomó el tabernáculo, y extendiólo fuera del campo, lejos del campo, y llamólo el Tabernáculo del Testimonio. Y fué, que cualquiera que requería á Jehová, salía al tabernáculo del testimonio, que estaba fuera del campo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the Tent, that all the people rose up, and stood, every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the Tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedia que, quando saía Moisés ao tabernáculo, todo o povo se levantava, e estava cada qual em pé à porta de sua tenda, e olhavam por trás de Moisés, até que ele entrava no tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Y sucedía que, cuando salía Moisés al tabernáculo, todo el pueblo se levantaba, y estaba cada cual en pie á la puerta de su tienda, y miraban en pos de Moisés, hasta que él entraba en el tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.
verses.WEB: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the LORD spoke with Moses.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, and stood at the door of the Tent: and [Jehovah] spake with Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Moisés entrava no tabernáculo, a coluna de nuvem descia, e punha-se à porta do tabernáculo, e o SENHOR falava com Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Moisés entraba en el tabernáculo, la columna de nube descendía, y poníase á la puerta del tabernáculo, y Jehová hablaba con Moisés.

verses.KJV: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
verses.WEB: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.
verses.ASV: And all the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man at his tent door.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo todo o povo a coluna de nuvem, que estava à porta do tabernáculo, levantava-se todo o povo, cada um à porta de sua tenda e adorava.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo todo el pueblo la columna de la nube, que estaba á la puerta del tabernáculo, levantábase todo el pueblo, cada uno á la puerta de su tienda, y adoraba.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his minister Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the Tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falava o SENHOR a Moisés face a face, como fala qualquer um a seu companheiro. E voltava-se ao campo; mas o jovem Josué, seu criado, filho de Num, nunca se afastava do meio do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Y hablaba Jehová á Moisés cara á cara, como habla cualquiera á su compañero. Y volvíase al campo; mas el joven Josué, su criado, hijo de Nun, nunca se apartaba de en medio del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the Lord, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
verses.WEB: Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Jehovah, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found favor in my sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés ao SENHOR: Olha, tu me dizes a mim: Tira este povo: e tu não me declaraste a quem hás de enviar comigo: porém, tu dizes: Eu te conheci por teu nome, e achaste também graça em meus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Jehová: Mira, tú me dices á mí: Saca este pueblo: y tú no me has declarado á quién has de enviar conmigo: sin embargo tú dices: Yo te he conocido por tu nombre, y has hallado también gracia en mis ojos.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found favor in thy sight, show me now thy ways, that I may know thee, to the end that I may find favor in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, se achei graça em teus olhos, rogo-te que me mostres agora teu caminho, para que te conheça, para que ache graça em teus olhos: e olha que teu povo é esta gente.
verses.RVR09: Ahora, pues, si he hallado gracia en tus ojos, ruégote que me muestres ahora tu camino, para que te conozca, porque halle gracia en tus ojos: y mira que tu pueblo es aquesta gente.

verses.KJV: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.WEB: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
verses.ASV: And he said, My presence shall go [with thee], and I will give thee rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Meu rosto irá contigo, e te farei descansar.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Mi rostro irá contigo, y te haré descansar.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
verses.WEB: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not [with me], carry us not up hence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Se teu rosto não for comigo, não nos tires daqui.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Si tu rostro no ha de ir conmigo, no nos saques de aquí.

verses.KJV: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
verses.ASV: For wherein now shall it be known that I have found favor in thy sight, I and thy people? is it not in that thou goest with us, so that we are separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: E em que se conhecerá aqui que achei favor em teus olhos, eu e teu povo, se não em andar tu conosco, e que eu e teu povo sejamos separados de todos os povos que estão sobre a face da terra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y en qué se conocerá aquí que he hallado gracia en tus ojos, yo y tu pueblo, sino en andar tú con nosotros, y que yo y tu pueblo seamos apartados de todos los pueblos que están sobre la faz de la tierra?

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken; for thou hast found favor in my sight, and I know thee by name.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Também farei isto que disseste, porquanto achaste favor em meus olhos, e te conheci por teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: También haré esto que has dicho, por cuanto has hallado gracia en mis ojos, y te he conocido por tu nombre.

verses.KJV: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Show me, I pray thee, thy glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: O então disse: Rogo-te que me mostres tua glória.
verses.RVR09: El entonces dijo: Ruégote que me muestres tu gloria.

verses.KJV: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
verses.WEB: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the LORD’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”
verses.ASV: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and will proclaim the name of Jehovah before thee; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhe: Eu farei passar todo o meu bem diante de teu rosto, e proclamarei o nome do SENHOR diante de ti; e terei misericórdia do que terei misericórdia, e serei clemente para com o que serei clemente.
verses.RVR09: Y respondióle: Yo haré pasar todo mi bien delante de tu rostro, y proclamaré el nombre de Jehová delante de ti; y tendré misericordia del que tendré misericordia, y seré clemente para con el que seré clemente.

verses.KJV: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
verses.WEB: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Thou canst not see my face; for man shall not see me and live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais: Não poderás ver meu rosto: porque não me verá homem, e viverá.
verses.RVR09: Dijo más: No podrás ver mi rostro: porque no me verá hombre, y vivirá.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
verses.WEB: The LORD also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon the rock:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ainda o SENHOR: Eis aqui um lugar junto a mim, e tu estarás sobre a rocha:
verses.RVR09: Y dijo aún Jehová: He aquí lugar junto á mí, y tú estarás sobre la peña:

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verses.WEB: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;
verses.ASV: and it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a cleft of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand until I have passed by:
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, quando passar minha glória, eu te porei em uma brecha da rocha, e te cobrirei com minha mão até que tenha passado:
verses.RVR09: Y será que, cuando pasare mi gloria, yo te pondré en una hendidura de la peña, y te cubriré con mi mano hasta que haya pasado:

verses.KJV: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
verses.WEB: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
verses.ASV: and I will take away my hand, and thou shalt see my back; but my face shall not be seen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois tirarei minha mão, e verás minhas costas; mas não se verá meu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Después apartaré mi mano, y verás mis espaldas; mas no se verá mi rostro.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon the tables the words that were on the first tables, which thou brakest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Entalha para ti duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras, e escreverei sobre essas tábuas as palavras que estavam nas tábuas primeiras que quebraste.
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ dijo á Moisés: Alísate dos tablas de piedra como las primeras, y escribiré sobre esas tablas las palabras que estaban en las tablas primeras que quebraste.

verses.KJV: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
verses.WEB: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.
verses.ASV: And be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me on the top of the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: Prepara-te, pois, para amanhã, e sobe pela manhã ao monte de Sinai, e fica diante de mim ali sobre o cume do monte.
verses.RVR09: Apercíbete, pues, para mañana, y sube por la mañana al monte de Sinaí, y estáme allí sobre la cumbre del monte.

verses.KJV: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
verses.WEB: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”
verses.ASV: And no man shall come up with thee; neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não suba homem contigo, nem apareça alguém em todo o monte; nem ovelhas nem bois apascentem diante do monte.
verses.RVR09: Y no suba hombre contigo, ni parezca alguno en todo el monte; ni ovejas ni bueyes pazcan delante del monte.

verses.KJV: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
verses.WEB: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.
verses.ASV: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as Jehovah had commanded him, and took in his hand two tables of stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés entalhou duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras; e levantou-se pela manhã, e subiu ao monte de Sinai, como lhe mandou o SENHOR, e levou em sua mão as duas tábuas de pedra.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés alisó dos tablas de piedra como las primeras; y levantóse por la mañana, y subió al monte de Sinaí, como le mandó Jehová, y llevó en su mano las dos tablas de piedra.

verses.KJV: And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR desceu na nuvem, e esteve ali com ele, proclamando o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová descendió en la nube, y estuvo allí con él, proclamando el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verses.WEB: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah passed by before him, and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth;
verses.ALMEIDA: E passando o SENHOR por diante dele, proclamou: SENHOR, SENHOR, forte, misericordioso, e piedoso; tardio para a ira, e grande em benignidade e verdade;
verses.RVR09: Y pasando Jehová por delante de él, proclamó: Jehová, Jehová, fuerte, misericordioso, y piadoso; tardo para la ira, y grande en benignidad y verdad;

verses.KJV: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
verses.WEB: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”
verses.ASV: keeping lovingkindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin; and that will by no means clear [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que guarda a misericórdia em milhares, que perdoa a iniquidade, a rebelião, e o pecado, e que de nenhum modo justificará ao malvado; que visita a iniquidade dos pais sobre os filhos e sobre os filhos dos filhos, sobre os de terceira, e quarta gerações.
verses.RVR09: Que guarda la misericordia en millares, que perdona la iniquidad, la rebelión, y el pecado, y que de ningún modo justificará al malvado; que visita la iniquidad de los padres sobre los hijos y sobre los hijos de los hijos, sobre los terceros, y sobre los cuartos.

verses.KJV: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
verses.WEB: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
verses.ASV: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés, apressando-se, baixou a cabeça até o chão e encurvou-se;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés, apresurándose, bajó la cabeza hacia el suelo y encorvóse;

verses.KJV: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
verses.WEB: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”
verses.ASV: And he said, If now I have found favor in thy sight, O Lord, let the Lord, I pray thee, go in the midst of us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Se agora, Senhor, achei favor em teus olhos, vá agora o Senhor em meio de nós; porque este é povo de dura cerviz; e perdoa nossa iniquidade e nosso pecado, e possui-nos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Si ahora, Señor, he hallado gracia en tus ojos, vaya ahora el Señor en medio de nosotros; porque este es pueblo de dura cerviz; y perdona nuestra iniquidad y nuestro pecado, y poséenos.

verses.KJV: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the Lord: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
verses.WEB: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.
verses.ASV: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been wrought in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of Jehovah; for it is a terrible thing that I do with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Eis que, eu faço concerto diante de todo o teu povo: farei maravilhas que não foram feitas em toda a terra, nem em nação alguma; e verá todo o povo em meio do qual estás tu, a obra do SENHOR; porque será coisa terrível a que eu farei contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: He aquí, yo hago concierto delante de todo tu pueblo: haré maravillas que no han sido hechas en toda la tierra, ni en nación alguna; y verá todo el pueblo en medio del cual estás tú, la obra de Jehová; porque ha de ser cosa terrible la que yo haré contigo.

verses.KJV: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.WEB: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.ASV: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda o que eu te mando hoje; eis que eu expulso de diante de tua presença aos amorreus, e aos cananeus, e aos heteus, e aos perizeus, e aos heveus, e aos jebuseus.
verses.RVR09: Guarda lo que yo te mando hoy; he aquí que yo echo de delante de tu presencia al Amorrheo, y al Cananeo, y al Hetheo, y al Pherezeo, y al Heveo, y al Jebuseo.

verses.KJV: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
verses.WEB: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;
verses.ASV: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda-te que não faças aliança com os moradores da terra de onde hás de entrar, para que não sejam por tropeço em meio de ti:
verses.RVR09: Guárdate que no hagas alianza con los moradores de la tierra donde has de entrar, porque no sean por tropezadero en medio de tí:

verses.KJV: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
verses.WEB: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;
verses.ASV: but ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their Asherim;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas derrubareis seus altares, e quebrareis suas estátuas, e cortareis seus bosques:
verses.RVR09: Mas derribaréis sus altares, y quebraréis sus estatuas, y talaréis sus bosques:

verses.KJV: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
verses.WEB: for you shall worship no other god; for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
verses.ASV: (for thou shalt worship no other god: for Jehovah, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God);
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não te hás de inclinar a deus alheio; que o SENHOR, cujo nome é zeloso, Deus zeloso é.
verses.RVR09: Porque no te has de inclinar á dios ajeno; que Jehová, cuyo nombre es Celoso, Dios celoso es.

verses.KJV: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
verses.WEB: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;
verses.ASV: lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they play the harlot after their gods, and sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee and thou eat of his sacrifice;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto não farás aliança com os moradores daquela terra; pois senão fornicarão após seus deuses, e sacrificarão a seus deuses, e te chamarão, e comerás de seus sacrifícios;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto no harás alianza con los moradores de aquella tierra; porque fornicarán en pos de sus dioses, y sacrificarán á sus dioses, y te llamarán, y comerás de sus sacrificios;

verses.KJV: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
verses.WEB: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.
verses.ASV: and thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters play the harlot after their gods, and make thy sons play the harlot after their gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou, se tomarem de suas filhas para teus filhos, e fornicarem suas filhas após seus deuses, farão também fornicar a teus filhos atrás dos deuses delas.
verses.RVR09: O tomando de sus hijas para tus hijos, y fornicando sus hijas en pos de sus dioses, harán también fornicar á tus hijos en pos de los dioses de ellas.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
verses.WEB: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não farás deuses de fundição para ti.
verses.RVR09: No harás dioses de fundición para ti.

verses.KJV: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
verses.WEB: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.
verses.ASV: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: A festa dos pães ázimos guardarás: sete dias comerás sem levedar, segundo te mandei, no tempo do mês de Abibe; porque no mês de Abibe saíste do Egito.
verses.RVR09: La fiesta de los ázimos guardarás: siete días comerás por leudar, según te he mandado, en el tiempo del mes de Abib; porque en el mes de Abib saliste de Egipto.

verses.KJV: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
verses.WEB: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
verses.ASV: All that openeth the womb is mine; and all thy cattle that is male, the firstlings of cow and sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o que abre madre, meu é; e de teu gado todo primeiro de vaca ou de ovelha que for macho.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que abre matriz, mío es; y de tu ganado todo primerizo de vaca ó de oveja que fuere macho.

verses.KJV: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
verses.WEB: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.
verses.ASV: And the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break its neck. All the first-born of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém resgatarás com cordeiro o primeiro do asno; e se não o resgatares, lhe cortarás a cabeça. Resgatarás todo primogênito de teus filhos, e não serão vistos vazios diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: Empero redimirás con cordero el primerizo del asno; y si no lo redimieres, le has de cortar la cabeza. Redimirás todo primogénito de tus hijos, y no serán vistos vacíos delante de mí.

verses.KJV: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
verses.WEB: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
verses.ASV: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in plowing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis dias trabalharás, mas no sétimo dia cessarás: cessarás ainda na arada e na colheita.
verses.RVR09: Seis días trabajarás, mas en el séptimo día cesarás: cesarás aun en la arada y en la siega.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.
verses.WEB: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, [even] of the first-fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te farás a festa das semanas aos princípios da colheita do trigo: e a festa da colheita à volta do ano.
verses.RVR09: Y te harás la fiesta de las semanas á los principios de la siega del trigo: y la fiesta de la cosecha á la vuelta del año.

verses.KJV: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.
verses.WEB: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: Three times in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Três vezes no ano será visto todo homem teu diante do Soberano SENHOR, Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Tres veces en el año será visto todo varón tuyo delante del Señoreador Jehová, Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the Lord thy God thrice in the year.
verses.WEB: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before the LORD, your God, three times in the year.
verses.ASV: For I will cast out nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou goest up to appear before Jehovah thy God three times in the year.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu lançarei as nações de tua presença, e alargarei teu termo: e ninguém cobiçará tua terra, quando tu subires para ser visto diante do SENHOR teu Deus três vezes no ano.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo arrojaré las gentes de tu presencia, y ensancharé tu término: y ninguno codiciará tu tierra, cuando tú subieres para ser visto delante de Jehová tu Dios tres veces en el año.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
verses.WEB: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não oferecerás com levedado o sangue de meu sacrifício; nem ficará da noite para a manhã o sacrifício da festa da páscoa.
verses.RVR09: No ofrecerás con leudo la sangre de mi sacrificio; ni quedará de la noche para la mañana el sacrificio de la fiesta de la pascua.

verses.KJV: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.WEB: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
verses.ASV: The first of the first-fruits of thy ground thou shalt bring unto the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.
verses.ALMEIDA: A primícia dos primeiros frutos de tua terra meterás na casa do SENHOR teu Deus. Não cozerás o cabrito no leite de sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: La primicia de los primeros frutos de tu tierra meterás en la casa de Jehová tu Dios. No cocerás el cabrito en la leche de su madre.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Escreve tu estas palavras; porque conforme estas palavras fiz a aliança contigo e com Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Escribe tú estas palabras; porque conforme á estas palabras he hecho la alianza contigo y con Israel.

verses.KJV: And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
verses.WEB: He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
verses.ASV: And he was there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele esteve ali com o SENHOR quarenta dias e quarenta noites: não comeu pão, nem bebeu água; e escreveu em tábuas as palavras da aliança, os dez dizeres.
verses.RVR09: Y él estuvo allí con Jehová cuarenta días y cuarenta noches: no comió pan, ni bebió agua; y escribió en tablas las palabras de la alianza, las diez palabras.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
verses.WEB: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of the testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses knew not that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, descendo Moisés do monte Sinai com as duas tábuas do testemunho em sua mão, enquanto descia do monte, não sabia ele que a pele de seu rosto resplandecia, depois que havia com ele falado.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que descendiendo Moisés del monte Sinaí con las dos tablas del testimonio en su mano, mientras descendía del monte, no sabía él que la tez de su rostro resplandecía, después que hubo con El hablado.

verses.KJV: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
verses.WEB: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
verses.ASV: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhou Arão e todos os filhos de Israel a Moisés, e eis que a pele de seu rosto era resplandescente; e tiveram medo de chegar-se a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y miró Aarón y todos los hijos de Israel á Moisés, y he aquí la tez de su rostro era resplandeciente; y tuvieron miedo de llegarse á él.

verses.KJV: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
verses.WEB: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
verses.ASV: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses spake to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou-os Moisés; e Arão e todos os príncipes da congregação voltaram-se a ele, e Moisés lhes falou.
verses.RVR09: Y llamólos Moisés; y Aarón y todos los príncipes de la congregación volvieron á él, y Moisés les habló.

verses.KJV: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the Lord had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
verses.WEB: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
verses.ASV: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that Jehovah had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois se chegaram todos os filhos de Israel, aos quais mandou todas as coisas que o SENHOR lhe havia dito no monte de Sinai.
verses.RVR09: Y después se llegaron todos los hijos de Israel, á los cuales mandó todas las cosas que Jehová le había dicho en el monte de Sinaí.

verses.KJV: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
verses.WEB: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
verses.ASV: And when Moses had done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando acabou Moisés de falar com eles, pôs um véu sobre seu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubo acabado Moisés de hablar con ellos, puso un velo sobre su rostro.

verses.KJV: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
verses.WEB: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
verses.ASV: But when Moses went in before Jehovah to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vinha Moisés diante do SENHOR para falar com ele, tirava-se o véu até que saía; e saindo, falava com os filhos de Israel o que lhe era mandado;
verses.RVR09: Y cuando venía Moisés delante de Jehová para hablar con él, quitábase el velo hasta que salía; y saliendo, hablaba con los hijos de Israel lo que le era mandado;

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the veil upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viam os filhos de Israel o rosto de Moisés, que a pele de seu rosto era resplandescente; e voltava Moisés a pôr o véu sobre seu rosto, até que entrava a falar com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y veían los hijos de Israel el rostro de Moisés, que la tez de su rostro era resplandeciente; y volvía Moisés á poner el velo sobre su rostro, hasta que entraba á hablar con El.

verses.KJV: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the Lord hath commanded, that ye should do them.
verses.WEB: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which the LORD has commanded, that you should do them.
verses.ASV: And Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said unto them, These are the words which Jehovah hath commanded, that ye should do them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés fez juntar toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e disse-lhes: Estas são as coisas que o SENHOR mandou que façais.
verses.RVR09: Y MOISÉS hizo juntar toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, y díjoles: Estas son las cosas que Jehová ha mandado que hagáis.

verses.KJV: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the Lord: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
verses.WEB: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.
verses.ASV: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of solemn rest to Jehovah: whosoever doeth any work therein shall be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis dias se fará obra, mas o dia sétimo vos será santo, sábado de repouso ao SENHOR: qualquer um que nele fizer obra morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Seis días se hará obra, mas el día séptimo os será santo, sábado de reposo á Jehová: cualquiera que en él hiciere obra, morirá.

verses.KJV: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.WEB: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”
verses.ASV: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não acendereis fogo em todas as vossas moradas no dia do sábado.
verses.RVR09: No encenderéis fuego en todas vuestras moradas en el día del sábado.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord commanded, saying,
verses.WEB: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
verses.ASV: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Moisés a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Moisés á toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, diciendo: Esto es lo que Jehová ha mandado, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Take ye from among you an offering unto the Lord: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the Lord; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.WEB: ‘Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,
verses.ASV: Take ye from among you an offering unto Jehovah; whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, Jehovah’s offering: gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomai dentre vós oferta para o SENHOR: todo generoso de coração a trará ao SENHOR: ouro, prata, bronze;
verses.RVR09: Tomad de entre vosotros ofrenda para Jehová: todo liberal de corazón la traerá á Jehová: oro, plata, metal;

verses.KJV: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.WEB: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
verses.ASV: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ [hair],
verses.ALMEIDA: E azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho fino, e pelo de cabras;
verses.RVR09: Y cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino fino, y pelo de cabras;

verses.KJV: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.WEB: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
verses.ASV: and rams’ skins dyed red, and sealskins, and acacia wood,
verses.ALMEIDA: E couros vermelhos de carneiros, e couros finos, e madeira de acácia;
verses.RVR09: Y cueros rojos de carneros, y cueros de tejones, y madera de Sittim;

verses.KJV: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.WEB: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
verses.ASV: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.ALMEIDA: E azeite para a luminária, e especiarias aromáticas para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático;
verses.RVR09: Y aceite para la luminaria, y especias aromáticas para el aceite de la unción, y para el perfume aromático;

verses.KJV: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.WEB: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
verses.ASV: and onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pedras de ônix, e demais pedrarias, para o éfode, e para o peitoral.
verses.RVR09: Y piedras de onix, y demás pedrería, para el ephod, y para el racional.

verses.KJV: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the Lord hath commanded;
verses.WEB: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the LORD has commanded:
verses.ASV: And let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Jehovah hath commanded:
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo sábio de coração dentre vós, virá e fará todas as coisas que o SENHOR mandou:
verses.RVR09: Y todo sabio de corazón entre vosotros, vendrá y hará todas las cosas que Jehová ha mandado:

verses.KJV: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.WEB: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.ASV: the tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.ALMEIDA: O tabernáculo, sua tenda, e sua coberta, e seus anéis, e suas tábuas, suas barras, suas colunas, e suas bases;
verses.RVR09: El tabernáculo, su tienda, y su cubierta, y sus anillos, y sus tablas, sus barras, sus columnas, y sus basas;

verses.KJV: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
verses.WEB: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;
verses.ASV: the ark, and the staves thereof, the mercy-seat, and the veil of the screen;
verses.ALMEIDA: A arca, e suas varas, o propiciatório, e o véu da tenda;
verses.RVR09: El arca, y sus varas, la cubierta, y el velo de la tienda;

verses.KJV: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
verses.WEB: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;
verses.ASV: the table, and its staves, and all its vessels, and the showbread;
verses.ALMEIDA: A mesa, e suas varas, e todos os seus utensílios, e o pão da proposição.
verses.RVR09: La mesa, y sus varas, y todos sus vasos, y el pan de la proposición.

verses.KJV: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
verses.WEB: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;
verses.ASV: the candlestick also for the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
verses.ALMEIDA: O candelabro da luminária, e seus utensílios, e suas lâmpadas, e o azeite para a luminária;
verses.RVR09: El candelero de la luminaria, y sus vasos, y sus candilejas, y el aceite para la luminaria;

verses.KJV: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
verses.WEB: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
verses.ASV: and the altar of incense, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o altar do incenso, e suas varas, e o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático, e a cortina da porta, para a entrada do tabernáculo;
