verses.RVR09: Y el altar del perfume, y sus varas, y el aceite de la unción, y el perfume aromático, y el pabellón de la puerta, para la entrada del tabernáculo;

verses.KJV: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.WEB: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;
verses.ASV: the altar of burnt-offering, with its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;
verses.ALMEIDA: O altar do holocausto, e sua grelha de bronze, e suas varas, e todos os seus utensílios, e a pia com sua base;
verses.RVR09: El altar del holocausto, y su enrejado de metal, y sus varas, y todos sus vasos, y la fuente con su basa;

verses.KJV: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
verses.WEB: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
verses.ASV: the hangings of the court, the pillars thereof, and their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
verses.ALMEIDA: As cortinas do átrio, suas colunas, e suas bases, e a cortina da porta do átrio;
verses.RVR09: Las cortinas del atrio, sus columnas, y sus basas, y el pabellón de la puerta del atrio;

verses.KJV: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
verses.WEB: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;
verses.ASV: the pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords;
verses.ALMEIDA: As estacas do tabernáculo, e as estacas do átrio, e suas cordas;
verses.RVR09: Las estacas del tabernáculo, y las estacas del atrio, y sus cuerdas;

verses.KJV: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.WEB: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”
verses.ASV: the finely wrought garments, for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.ALMEIDA: As vestimentas dos serviço para ministrar no santuário, as sagradas vestimentas de Arão o sacerdote, e as vestimentas de seus filhos para servir no sacerdócio.
verses.RVR09: Las vestiduras del servicio para ministrar en el santuario, las sagradas vestiduras de Aarón el sacerdote, y las vestiduras de sus hijos para servir en el sacerdocio.

verses.KJV: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.WEB: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.ASV: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel de diante de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y salió toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel de delante de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the Lord's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
verses.WEB: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought the LORD’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.
verses.ASV: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, [and] brought Jehovah’s offering, for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all the service thereof, and for the holy garments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio todo homem a quem seu coração estimulou, e todo aquele a quem seu espírito lhe deu vontade, e trouxeram oferta ao SENHOR para a obra do tabernáculo do testemunho, e para toda sua confecção, e para as sagradas vestimentas.
verses.RVR09: Y vino todo varón á quien su corazón estimuló, y todo aquel á quien su espíritu le dió voluntad, y trajeron ofrenda á Jehová para la obra del tabernáculo del testimonio, y para toda su fábrica, y para las sagradas vestiduras.

verses.KJV: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, [and] brought brooches, and ear-rings, and signet-rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man that offered an offering of gold unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram tanto homens como mulheres, todo voluntário de coração, e trouxeram correntes e pendentes, anéis e braceletes, e toda joia de ouro; e qualquer um oferecia oferta de ouro ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron así hombres como mujeres, todo voluntario de corazón, y trajeron cadenas y zarcillos, sortijas y brazaletes, y toda joya de oro; y cualquiera ofrecía ofrenda de oro á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.
verses.WEB: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.
verses.ASV: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ [hair], and rams’ skins dyed red, and sealskins, brought them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo homem que se achava com material azul, ou púrpura, ou carmesim, ou linho fino, ou pelo de cabras, ou odres vermelhos de carneiros, ou couros finos, o trazia.
verses.RVR09: Todo hombre que se hallaba con jacinto, ó púrpura, ó carmesí, ó lino fino, ó pelo de cabras, ó cueros rojos de carneros, ó cueros de tejones, lo traía.

verses.KJV: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the Lord's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.WEB: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.ASV: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought Jehovah’s offering; and every man, with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que oferecia oferta de prata ou de bronze, trazia ao SENHOR a oferta: e todo o que se achava com madeira de acácia, trazia-a para toda a obra do serviço.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que ofrecía ofrenda de plata ó de metal, traía á Jehová la ofrenda: y todo el que se hallaba con madera de Sittim, traíala para toda la obra del servicio.

verses.KJV: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
verses.WEB: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
verses.ASV: And all the women that were wise-hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, the blue, and the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso todas as mulheres sábias de coração fiavam de suas mãos, e traziam o que haviam fiado: azul, ou púrpura, ou carmesim, ou linho fino.
verses.RVR09: Además todas las mujeres sabias de corazón hilaban de sus manos, y traían lo que habían hilado: cárdeno, ó púrpura, ó carmesí, ó lino fino.

verses.KJV: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.
verses.WEB: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.
verses.ASV: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ [hair].
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as mulheres cujo coração as levantou em sabedoria, fiaram pelos de cabras.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las mujeres cuyo corazón las levantó en sabiduría, hilaron pelos de cabras.

verses.KJV: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.WEB: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;
verses.ASV: And the rulers brought the onyx stones, and the stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os príncipes trouxeram pedras de ônix, e as pedras dos engastes para o éfode e o peitoral;
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes trajeron piedras de onix, y las piedras de los engastes para el ephod y el racional;

verses.KJV: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.WEB: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.ASV: and the spice, and the oil; for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a especiaria aromática e azeite, para a luminária, e para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático.
verses.RVR09: Y la especia aromática y aceite, para la luminaria, y para el aceite de la unción, y para el perfume aromático.

verses.KJV: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the Lord, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the Lord had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses.
verses.ASV: The children of Israel brought a freewill-offering unto Jehovah; every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Jehovah had commanded to be made by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Israel, tanto homens como mulheres, todos os que tiveram coração voluntário para trazer para toda a obra, que o SENHOR havia mandado por meio de Moisés que fizessem, trouxeram oferta voluntária ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Israel, así hombres como mujeres, todos los que tuvieron corazón voluntario para traer para toda la obra, que Jehová había mandado por medio de Moisés que hiciesen, trajeron ofrenda voluntaria á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the Lord hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.WEB: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, Jehovah hath called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés aos filhos de Israel: Olhai, o SENHOR nomeou a Bezalel filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á los hijos de Israel: Mirad, Jehová ha nombrado á Bezaleel, hijo de Uri, hijo de Hur, de la tribu de Judá;

verses.KJV: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.WEB: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;
verses.ASV: and he hath filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o encheu de espírito de Deus, em sabedoria, em inteligência, e em conhecimento, e em todo artifício,
verses.RVR09: Y lo ha henchido de espíritu de Dios, en sabiduría, en inteligencia, y en ciencia, y en todo artificio,

verses.KJV: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.WEB: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
verses.ASV: and to devise skilful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para projetar inventos, para trabalhar em ouro, e em prata, e em bronze,
verses.RVR09: Para proyectar inventos, para trabajar en oro, y en plata, y en metal,

verses.KJV: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
verses.WEB: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.
verses.ASV: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all manner of skilful workmanship.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em obra de pedrarias para engastar, e em obra de madeira, para trabalhar em toda invenção engenhosa.
verses.RVR09: Y en obra de pedrería para engastar, y en obra de madera, para trabajar en toda invención ingeniosa.

verses.KJV: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.WEB: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.ASV: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs em seu coração o que podia ensinar, tanto ele como Aoliabe filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã:
verses.RVR09: Y ha puesto en su corazón el que pueda enseñar, así él como Aholiab, hijo de Ahisamac, de la tribu de Dan:

verses.KJV: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
verses.WEB: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
verses.ASV: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of workmanship, of the engraver, and of the skilful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any workmanship, and of those that devise skilful works.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os encheu de sabedoria de coração, para que façam toda obra de artifício, e de invenção, e de recamado em azul, e em púrpura, e em carmesim, e em linho fino, e em tear; para que façam todo trabalho, e inventem todo desenho.
verses.RVR09: Y los ha henchido de sabiduría de corazón, para que hagan toda obra de artificio, y de invención, y de recamado en jacinto, y en púrpura, y en carmesí, y en lino fino, y en telar; para que hagan toda labor, é inventen todo diseño.

verses.KJV: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the Lord had commanded.
verses.WEB: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”
verses.ASV: And Bezalel and Oholiab shall work, and every wise-hearted man, in whom Jehovah hath put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Jehovah hath commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez, pois, Bezalel e Aoliabe, e todo homem sábio de coração, a quem o SENHOR deu sabedoria e inteligência para que soubessem fazer toda a obra do serviço do santuário, todas as coisas que havia mandado o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: HIZO, pues, Bezaleel y Aholiab, y todo hombre sabio de corazón, á quien Jehová dió sabiduría é inteligencia para que supiesen hacer toda la obra del servicio del santuario, todas las cosas que había mandado Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the Lord had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
verses.WEB: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.
verses.ASV: And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Jehovah had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés chamou a Bezalel e a Aoliabe, e a todo homem sábio de coração, em cujo coração havia dado o SENHOR sabedoria, e a todo homem a quem seu coração lhe moveu a chegar-se à obra, para trabalhar nela;
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés llamó á Bezaleel y á Aholiab, y á todo varón sabio de corazón, en cuyo corazón había dado Jehová sabiduría, y á todo hombre á quien su corazón le movió á llegarse á la obra, para trabajar en ella;

verses.KJV: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
verses.WEB: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.
verses.ASV: and they received of Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, wherewith to make it. And they brought yet unto him freewill-offerings every morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram de diante de Moisés toda a oferta que os filhos de Israel haviam trazido para a obra do serviço do santuário, a fim de fazê-la. E eles lhe traziam ainda oferta voluntária cada manhã.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron de delante de Moisés toda la ofrenda que los hijos de Israel habían traído para la obra del servicio del santuario, á fin de hacerla. Y ellos le traían aún ofrenda voluntaria cada mañana.

verses.KJV: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
verses.WEB: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
verses.ASV: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they wrought;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vieram, portanto, todos os mestres que faziam toda a obra do santuário, cada um da obra que fazia.
verses.RVR09: Vinieron, por tanto, todos los maestros que hacían toda la obra del santuario, cada uno de la obra que hacía.

verses.KJV: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the Lord commanded to make.
verses.WEB: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”
verses.ASV: and they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work which Jehovah commanded to make.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falaram a Moisés, dizendo: O povo traz muito mais do que é necessário para o trabalho de fazer a obra que o SENHOR mandou que se faça.
verses.RVR09: Y hablaron á Moisés, diciendo: El pueblo trae mucho más de lo que es menester para la atención de hacer la obra que Jehová ha mandado que se haga.

verses.KJV: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.WEB: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.ASV: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés mandou apregoar pelo acampamento, dizendo: Nenhum homem nem mulher faça mais obra para oferecer para o santuário. E assim foi o povo impedido de oferecer;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés mandó pregonar por el campo, diciendo: Ningún hombre ni mujer haga más obra para ofrecer para el santuario. Y así fué el pueblo impedido de ofrecer;

verses.KJV: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
verses.WEB: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.
verses.ASV: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tinha material abundante para fazer toda a obra, e sobrava.
verses.RVR09: Pues tenía material abundante para hacer toda la obra, y sobraba.

verses.KJV: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
verses.WEB: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
verses.ASV: And all the wise-hearted men among them that wrought the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim, the work of the skilful workman, [Bezalel] made them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os sábios de coração entre os que faziam a obra, fizeram o tabernáculo de dez cortinas, de linho torcido, e de material azul, e de púrpura e carmesim; as quais fizeram de obra prima, com querubins.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los sabios de corazón entre los que hacían la obra, hicieron el tabernáculo de diez cortinas, de lino torcido, y de jacinto, y de púrpura y carmesí; las cuales hicieron de obra prima, con querubines.

verses.KJV: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
verses.WEB: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
verses.ASV: The length of each curtain was eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains had one measure.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comprimento da uma cortina era de vinte e oito côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados: todas as cortinas tinham uma mesma medida.
verses.RVR09: La longitud de la una cortina era de veintiocho codos, y la anchura de cuatro codos: todas las cortinas tenían una misma medida.

verses.KJV: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
verses.WEB: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
verses.ASV: And he coupled five curtains one to another: and [the other] five curtains he coupled one to another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntou as cinco cortinas a uma com a outra: também uniu as outras cinco cortinas uma com aa outra.
verses.RVR09: Y juntó las cinco cortinas la una con la otra: asimismo unió las otras cinco cortinas la una con la otra.

verses.KJV: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.WEB: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
verses.ASV: And he made loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the second coupling.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez as laçadas de cor de material azul na orla de uma cortina, na margem, à juntura; e assim fez na orla à extremidade da segunda cortina, na juntura.
verses.RVR09: E hizo las lazadas de color de jacinto en la orilla de la una cortina, en el borde, á la juntura; y así hizo en la orilla al borde de la segunda cortina, en la juntura.

verses.KJV: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
verses.WEB: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.
verses.ASV: Fifty loops made he in the one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling: the loops were opposite one to another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cinquenta laçadas fez em um cortina, e outras cinquenta na segunda cortina, na margem, na juntura; umas laçadas em frente das outras.
verses.RVR09: Cincuenta lazadas hizo en la una cortina, y otras cincuenta en la segunda cortina, en el borde, en la juntura; las unas lazadas enfrente de las otras.

verses.KJV: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
verses.WEB: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
verses.ASV: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também cinquenta colchetes de ouro, com os quais juntou as cortinas, uma com a outra; e fez-se um tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también cincuenta corchetes de oro, con los cuales juntó las cortinas, la una con la otra; é hízose un tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
verses.WEB: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
verses.ASV: And he made curtains of goats’ [hair] for a tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também cortinas de pelo de cabras para a tenda sobre o tabernáculo, e as fez em número de onze.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo cortinas de pelo de cabras para la tienda sobre el tabernáculo, é hízolas en número de once.

verses.KJV: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
verses.WEB: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
verses.ASV: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of each curtain: the eleven curtains had one measure.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comprimento de uma cortina era de trinta côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados: as onze cortinas tinham uma mesma medida.
verses.RVR09: La longitud de la una cortina era de treinta codos, y la anchura de cuatro codos: las once cortinas tenían una misma medida.

verses.KJV: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.WEB: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.ASV: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntou as cinco cortinas à parte, e as seis cortinas à parte.
verses.RVR09: Y juntó las cinco cortinas de por sí, y las seis cortinas aparte.

verses.KJV: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.WEB: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
verses.ASV: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which was [outmost in] the second coupling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também cinquenta laçadas na orla da última cortina na juntura, e outras cinquenta laçadas na orla da outra cortina na juntura.
verses.RVR09: Hizo además cincuenta lazadas en la orilla de la postrera cortina en la juntura, y otras cincuenta lazadas en la orilla de la otra cortina en la juntura.

verses.KJV: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.WEB: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
verses.ASV: And he made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também cinquenta colchetes de bronze para juntar a tenda, de modo que fosse uma.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también cincuenta corchetes de metal para juntar la tienda, de modo que fuese una.

verses.KJV: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.
verses.WEB: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
verses.ASV: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sealskins above.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez uma coberta para a tenda de couros vermelhos de carneiros, e uma coberta encima de couros finos.
verses.RVR09: E hizo una cubierta para la tienda de cueros rojos de carneros, y una cubierta encima de cueros de tejones.

verses.KJV: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
verses.WEB: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
verses.ASV: And he made the boards for the tabernacle, of acacia wood, standing up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também fez as tábuas para o tabernáculo de madeira de acácia, para estarem na vertical.
verses.RVR09: Además hizo las tablas para el tabernáculo de madera de Sittim, para estar derechas.

verses.KJV: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
verses.WEB: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
verses.ASV: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comprimento de cada tábua de dez côvados, e de côvado e meio a largura.
verses.RVR09: La longitud de cada tabla de diez codos, y de codo y medio la anchura.

verses.KJV: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
verses.ASV: Each board had two tenons, joined one to another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada tábua tinha dois encaixes fixos um diante do outro: assim fez todas as tábuas do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Cada tabla tenía dos quicios enclavijados el uno delante del otro: así hizo todas las tablas del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
verses.WEB: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
verses.ASV: And he made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez, pois, as tábuas para o tabernáculo: vinte tábuas ao lado do sul.
verses.RVR09: Hizo, pues, las tablas para el tabernáculo: veinte tablas al lado del austro, al mediodía.

verses.KJV: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.WEB: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.ASV: and he made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também as quarenta bases de prata debaixo das vinte tábuas: duas bases debaixo de uma tábua para seus dois encaixes, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua para seus dois encaixes.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también las cuarenta basas de plata debajo de las veinte tablas: dos basas debajo de la una tabla para sus dos quicios, y dos basas debajo de la otra tabla para sus dos quicios.

verses.KJV: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
verses.WEB: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards
verses.ASV: And for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards,
verses.ALMEIDA: E para o outro lado do tabernáculo, à parte do norte, fez vinte tábuas,
verses.RVR09: Y para el otro lado del tabernáculo, á la parte del aquilón, hizo veinte tablas,

verses.KJV: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.WEB: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.ASV: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com suas quarenta bases de prata: duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua.
verses.RVR09: Con sus cuarenta basas de plata: dos basas debajo de la una tabla, y dos basas debajo de la otra tabla.

verses.KJV: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.WEB: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.ASV: And for the hinder part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para o lado ocidental do tabernáculo fez seis tábuas.
verses.RVR09: Y para el lado occidental del tabernáculo hizo seis tablas.

verses.KJV: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.WEB: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
verses.ASV: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para as esquinas do tabernáculo nos dois lados fez duas tábuas,
verses.RVR09: Para las esquinas del tabernáculo en los dos lados hizo dos tablas,

verses.KJV: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
verses.WEB: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
verses.ASV: And they were double beneath; and in like manner they were entire unto the top thereof unto one ring: thus he did to both of them in the two corners.
verses.ALMEIDA: As quais se juntavam por baixo, e também por cima a uma argola: e assim fez à uma e à outra nos dois cantos.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales se juntaban por abajo, y asimismo por arriba á un gozne: y así hizo á la una y á la otra en las dos esquinas.

verses.KJV: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
verses.WEB: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.
verses.ASV: And there were eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; under every board two sockets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eram, pois, oito tábuas, e suas bases de prata dezesseis; duas bases debaixo de cada tábua.
verses.RVR09: Eran, pues, ocho tablas, y sus basas de plata dieciséis; dos basas debajo de cada tabla.

verses.KJV: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.WEB: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.ASV: And he made bars of acacia wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também as barras de madeira de acácia; cinco para as tábuas do um lado do tabernáculo,
verses.RVR09: Hizo también las barras de madera de Sittim; cinco para las tablas del un lado del tabernáculo,

verses.KJV: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
verses.WEB: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
verses.ASV: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cinco barras para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo, e cinco barras para as tábuas do lado do tabernáculo à parte ocidental.
verses.RVR09: Y cinco barras para las tablas del otro lado del tabernáculo, y cinco barras para las tablas del lado del tabernáculo á la parte occidental.

verses.KJV: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.WEB: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.ASV: And he made the middle bar to pass through in the midst of the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez que a barra do meio passasse por meio das tábuas do um extremo ao outro.
verses.RVR09: E hizo que la barra del medio pasase por medio de las tablas del un cabo al otro.

verses.KJV: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.WEB: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.ASV: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold for places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cobriu as tábuas de ouro, e fez de ouro os anéis delas por de onde passassem as barras: cobriu também de ouro as barras.
verses.RVR09: Y cubrió las tablas de oro, é hizo de oro los anillos de ellas por donde pasasen las barras: cubrió también de oro las barras.

verses.KJV: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
verses.WEB: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
verses.ASV: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubim, the work of the skilful workman, made he it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez assim o véu de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido, o qual fez com querubins de delicada obra.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo el velo de cárdeno, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido, el cual hizo con querubines de delicada obra.

verses.KJV: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
verses.WEB: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
verses.ASV: And he made thereunto four pillars of acacia, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para ele fez quatro colunas de madeira de acácia; e cobriu-as de ouro, os capitéis das quais eram de ouro; e fez para elas quatro bases de prata de fundição.
verses.RVR09: Y para él hizo cuatro columnas de madera de Sittim; y cubriólas de oro, los capiteles de las cuales eran de oro; é hizo para ellas cuatro basas de plata de fundición.

verses.KJV: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
verses.WEB: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
verses.ASV: And he made a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o véu para a porta do tabernáculo, de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido, obra de bordador;
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el velo para la puerta del tabernáculo, de jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido, obra de recamador;

verses.KJV: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
verses.WEB: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
verses.ASV: and the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold; and their five sockets were of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas cinco colunas com seus capitéis: e cobriu as cabeças delas e suas molduras de ouro: mas suas cinco bases as fez de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Y sus cinco columnas con sus capiteles: y cubrió las cabezas de ellas y sus molduras de oro: pero sus cinco basas las hizo de metal.

verses.KJV: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
verses.WEB: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.ASV: And Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também Bezalel a arca de madeira de acácia: seu comprimento era de dois côvados e meio, e de côvado e meio sua largura, e sua altura de outro côvado e meio:
verses.RVR09: HIZO también Bezaleel el arca de madera de Sittim: su longitud era de dos codos y medio, y de codo y medio su anchura, y su altura de otro codo y medio:

verses.KJV: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
verses.WEB: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
verses.ASV: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cobriu-a de ouro puro por de dentro e por de fora, e fez-lhe uma borda de ouro em derredor.
verses.RVR09: Y cubrióla de oro puro por de dentro y por de fuera, é hízole una cornisa de oro en derredor.

verses.KJV: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
verses.WEB: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
verses.ASV: And he cast for it four rings of gold, in the four feet thereof; even two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez-lhe também de fundição quatro anéis de ouro a seus quatro cantos; em um lado dois anéis e no outro lado dois anéis.
verses.RVR09: Hízole además de fundición cuatro anillos de oro á sus cuatro esquinas; en el un lado dos anillos y en el otro lado dos anillos.

verses.KJV: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.WEB: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.ASV: And he made staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também as varas de madeira de acácia, e cobriu-as de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también las varas de madera de Sittim, y cubriólas de oro.

verses.KJV: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.WEB: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.ASV: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meteu as varas pelos anéis aos lados da arca, para levar a arca.
verses.RVR09: Y metió las varas por los anillos á los lados del arca, para llevar el arca.

verses.KJV: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.WEB: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
verses.ASV: And he made a mercy-seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half [was] the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também a coberta de ouro puro: seu comprimento de dois côvados e meio, e sua largura de côvado e meio.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo la cubierta de oro puro: su longitud de dos codos y medio, y su anchura de codo y medio.

verses.KJV: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
verses.WEB: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
verses.ASV: And he made two cherubim of gold; of beaten work made he them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também os dois querubins de ouro, os fez lavrados a martelo, aos duas extremidades do propiciatório:
verses.RVR09: Hizo también los dos querubines de oro, hízolos labrados á martillo, á los dos cabos de la cubierta:

verses.KJV: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.WEB: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
verses.ASV: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end: of one piece with the mercy-seat made he the cherubim at the two ends thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um querubim desta parte ao um extremo, e o outro querubim da outra parte ao outro extremo do propiciatório: fez os querubins a suas duas extremidades.
verses.RVR09: El un querubín de esta parte al un cabo, y el otro querubín de la otra parte al otro cabo de la cubierta: hizo los querubines á sus dos cabos.

verses.KJV: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
verses.WEB: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
verses.ASV: And the cherubim spread out their wings on high, covering the mercy-seat with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the mercy-seat were the faces of the cherubim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os querubins estendiam suas asas por cima, cobrindo com suas asas o propiciatório: e seus rostos um em frente do outro, até o propiciatório os rostos dos querubins.
verses.RVR09: Y los querubines extendían sus alas por encima, cubriendo con sus alas la cubierta: y sus rostros el uno enfrente del otro, hacia la cubierta los rostros de los querubines.

verses.KJV: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
verses.WEB: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
verses.ASV: And he made the table of acacia wood: two cubits [was] the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também a mesa de madeira de acácia; seu comprimento de dois côvados, e sua largura de um côvado, e de côvado e meio sua altura;
verses.RVR09: Hizo también la mesa de madera de Sittim; su longitud de dos codos, y su anchura de un codo, y de codo y medio su altura;

verses.KJV: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
verses.WEB: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
verses.ASV: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cobriu-a de ouro puro, e fez-lhe uma borda de ouro em derredor.
verses.RVR09: Y cubrióla de oro puro, é hízole una cornisa de oro en derredor.

verses.KJV: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
verses.WEB: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
verses.ASV: And he made unto it a border of a handbreadth round about, and made a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez-lhe também uma moldura ao redor, da largura de uma mão, à qual moldura fez a borda de ouro ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Hízole también una moldura alrededor, del ancho de una mano, á la cual moldura hizo la cornisa de oro en circunferencia.

verses.KJV: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
verses.WEB: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
verses.ASV: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that were on the four feet thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez-lhe também de fundição quatro anéis de ouro, e os pôs aos quatro cantos que correspondiam aos quatro pés dela.
verses.RVR09: Hízole asimismo de fundición cuatro anillos de oro, y púsolos á las cuatro esquinas que correspondían á los cuatro pies de ella.

verses.KJV: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.WEB: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.
verses.ASV: Close by the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante da moldura estavam os anéis, pelos quais se metessem as varas para levar a mesa.
verses.RVR09: Delante de la moldura estaban los anillos, por los cuales se metiesen las varas para llevar la mesa.

verses.KJV: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
verses.WEB: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
verses.ASV: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez as varas de madeira de acácia para levar a mesa, e cobriu-as de ouro.
verses.RVR09: E hizo las varas de madera de Sittim para llevar la mesa, y cubriólas de oro.

verses.KJV: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
verses.WEB: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
verses.ASV: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, the dishes thereof, and the spoons thereof, and the bowls thereof, and the flagons thereof, wherewith to pour out, of pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também fez os utensílios que haviam de estar sobre a mesa, seus pratos, e suas colheres, e suas tigelas e suas bacias com que se havia de fazer libações, de ouro fino.
verses.RVR09: También hizo los vasos que habían de estar sobre la mesa, sus platos, y sus cucharas, y sus cubiertos y sus tazones con que se había de libar, de oro fino.

verses.KJV: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
verses.WEB: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
verses.ASV: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick, even its base, and its shaft; its cups, its knops, and its flowers, were of one piece with it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o candelabro de ouro puro, e o fez lavrado a martelo: seu pé e sua haste, seus copos, seus botões e suas flores eram do mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo el candelero de oro puro, é hízolo labrado á martillo: su pie y su caña, sus copas, sus manzanas y sus flores eran de lo mismo.

verses.KJV: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
verses.WEB: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:
verses.ASV: And there were six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: De seus lados saíam seis braços; três braços de um lado do candelabro, e outros três braços do outro lado do candelabro:
verses.RVR09: De sus lados salían seis brazos; tres brazos del un lado del candelero, y otros tres brazos del otro lado del candelero:

verses.KJV: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.WEB: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
verses.ASV: three cups made like almond-blossoms in one branch, a knop and a flower, and three cups made like almond-blossoms in the other branch, a knop and a flower: so for the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em um braço, três copos forma de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor; e no outro braço três copos forma de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor: e assim nos seis braços que saíam do candelabro.
verses.RVR09: En el un brazo, tres copas figura de almendras, una manzana y una flor; y en el otro brazo tres copas figura de almendras, una manzana y una flor: y así en los seis brazos que salían del candelero.

verses.KJV: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
verses.WEB: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
verses.ASV: And in the candlestick were four cups made like almond-blossoms, the knops thereof, and the flowers thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: E no candelabro havia quatro copos forma de amêndoas, seus botões e suas flores:
verses.RVR09: Y en el candelero había cuatro copas figura de almendras, sus manzanas y sus flores:

verses.KJV: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
verses.WEB: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
verses.ASV: and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um botão debaixo dos dois braços do mesmo, e outro botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, e outro botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, conforme os seis braços que saíam dele.
verses.RVR09: Y una manzana debajo de los dos brazos de lo mismo, y otra manzana debajo de los otros dos brazos de lo mismo, y otra manzana debajo de los otros dos brazos de lo mismo, conforme á los seis brazos que salían de él.

verses.KJV: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.WEB: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.ASV: Their knops and their branches were of one piece with it: the whole of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus botões e seus braços eram do mesmo; tudo era uma peça lavrada a martelo, de ouro puro.
verses.RVR09: Sus manzanas y sus brazos eran de lo mismo; todo era una pieza labrada á martillo, de oro puro.

verses.KJV: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
verses.WEB: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
verses.ASV: And he made the lamps thereof, seven, and the snuffers thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, of pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também suas sete lâmpadas, e seus tenazes, e seus apagadores, de ouro puro;
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo sus siete candilejas, y sus despabiladeras, y sus platillos, de oro puro;

verses.KJV: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
verses.WEB: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
verses.ASV: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: De um talento de ouro puro o fez, com todos os seus utensílios.
verses.RVR09: De un talento de oro puro lo hizo, con todos sus vasos.

verses.KJV: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
verses.WEB: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
verses.ASV: And he made the altar of incense of acacia wood: a cubit was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, foursquare; and two cubits was the height thereof; the horns thereof were of one piece with it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o altar do incenso de madeira de acácia: um côvado seu comprimento, e outro côvado sua largura, era quadrado; e sua altura de dois côvados; e suas pontas da mesma peça.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el altar del perfume de madera de Sittim: un codo su longitud, y otro codo su anchura, era cuadrado; y su altura de dos codos; y sus cuernos de la misma pieza.

verses.KJV: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.WEB: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
verses.ASV: And he overlaid it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: and he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cobriu-o de ouro puro, sua mesa e suas paredes ao redor, e suas pontas: e fez-lhe uma coroa de ouro ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y cubriólo de oro puro, su mesa y sus paredes alrededor, y sus cuernos: é hízole una corona de oro alrededor.

verses.KJV: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.WEB: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
verses.ASV: And he made for it two golden rings under the crown thereof, upon the two ribs thereof, upon the two sides of it, for places for staves wherewith to bear it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez-lhe também dois anéis de ouro debaixo da coroa nos dois cantos aos dois lados, para passar por eles as varas com que havia de ser conduzido.
verses.RVR09: Hízole también dos anillos de oro debajo de la corona en las dos esquinas á los dos lados, para pasar por ellos las varas con que había de ser conducido.

verses.KJV: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.WEB: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.ASV: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez as varas de madeira de acácia, e cobriu-as de ouro.
verses.RVR09: E hizo las varas de madera de Sittim, y cubriólas de oro.

verses.KJV: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
verses.WEB: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
verses.ASV: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o azeite santo da unção, e o fino incenso aromático, de obra de perfumista.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo el aceite santo de la unción, y el fino perfume aromático, de obra de perfumador.

verses.KJV: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
verses.WEB: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
verses.ASV: And he made the altar of burnt-offering of acacia wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof, foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Igualmente fez o altar do holocausto de madeira de acácia: seu comprimento de cinco côvados, e sua largura de outros cinco côvados, quadrado, e de três côvados de altura.
verses.RVR09: IGUALMENTE hizo el altar del holocausto de madera de Sittim: su longitud de cinco codos, y su anchura de otros cinco codos, cuadrado, y de tres codos de altura.

verses.KJV: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
verses.WEB: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
verses.ASV: And he made the horns thereof upon the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of one piece with it: and he overlaid it with brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez-lhe suas pontas a seus quatro cantos, os quais eram da mesma peça, e cobriu-o de bronze.
verses.RVR09: E hízole sus cuernos á sus cuatro esquinas, los cuales eran de la misma pieza, y cubriólo de metal.

verses.KJV: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
verses.WEB: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.
verses.ASV: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basins, the flesh-hooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também todos os utensílios do altar: caldeirões, e tenazes, e bacias, e garfos, e pás: todos os seus utensílios fez de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo todos los vasos del altar: calderas, y tenazas, y tazones, y garfios, y palas: todos sus vasos hizo de metal.

verses.KJV: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
verses.WEB: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
verses.ASV: And he made for the altar a grating of network of brass, under the ledge round it beneath, reaching halfway up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez para o altar a grelha de bronze, de feitura de rede, que pôs em sua borda por debaixo até o meio do altar.
verses.RVR09: E hizo para el altar el enrejado de metal, de hechura de red, que puso en su cerco por debajo hasta el medio del altar.

verses.KJV: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
verses.WEB: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
verses.ASV: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grating of brass, to be places for the staves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também quatro anéis de fundição aos quatro extremos da grelha de bronze, para meter as varas.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también cuatro anillos de fundición á los cuatro cabos del enrejado de metal, para meter las varas.

verses.KJV: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
verses.WEB: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
verses.ASV: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez as varas de madeira de acácia, e cobriu-as de bronze.
verses.RVR09: E hizo las varas de madera de Sittim, y cubriólas de metal.

verses.KJV: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
verses.WEB: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
verses.ASV: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, wherewith to bear it; he made it hollow with planks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meteu as varas pelos anéis aos lados do altar, para levá-lo com elas: oco o fez, de tábuas.
verses.RVR09: Y metió las varas por los anillos á los lados del altar, para llevarlo con ellas: hueco lo hizo, de tablas.

verses.KJV: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And he made the laver of brass, and the base thereof of brass, of the mirrors of the ministering women that ministered at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também fez a pia de bronze, com sua base de bronze, dos espelhos das que vigiavam à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: También hizo la fuente de metal, con su basa de metal, de los espejos de las que velaban á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
verses.WEB: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;
verses.ASV: And he made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, a hundred cubits;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o átrio; à parte sul as cortinas do átrio eram de cem côvados, de linho torcido:
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo el atrio; á la parte austral del mediodía las cortinas del atrio eran de cien codos, de lino torcido:

verses.KJV: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.WEB: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.ASV: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas colunas vinte, com suas vinte bases de bronze: os capitéis das colunas e suas molduras, de prata.
verses.RVR09: Sus columnas veinte, con sus veinte basas de metal: los capiteles de las columnas y sus molduras, de plata.

verses.KJV: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.WEB: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.ASV: And for the north side a hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à parte do norte cortinas de cem côvados: suas colunas vinte, com suas vinte bases de bronze; os capitéis das colunas e suas molduras, de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y á la parte del aquilón cortinas de cien codos: sus columnas veinte, con sus veinte basas de metal; los capiteles de las columnas y sus molduras, de plata.

verses.KJV: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.WEB: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.ASV: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: À parte do ocidente cortinas de cinquenta côvados: suas colunas dez, e suas dez bases; os capitéis das colunas e suas molduras, de prata.
verses.RVR09: A la parte del occidente cortinas de cincuenta codos: sus columnas diez, y sus diez basas; los capiteles de las columnas y sus molduras, de plata.

verses.KJV: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.WEB: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,
verses.ASV: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à parte oriental, ao levante, cortinas de cinquenta côvados:
verses.RVR09: Y á la parte oriental, al levante, cortinas de cincuenta codos:

verses.KJV: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.WEB: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;
verses.ASV: The hangings for the one side [of the gate] were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao um lado cortinas de quinze côvados, suas três colunas, e suas três bases;
verses.RVR09: Al un lado cortinas de quince codos, sus tres columnas, y sus tres basas;

verses.KJV: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.WEB: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.ASV: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao outro lado, de uma parte e da outra da porta do átrio, cortinas de a quinze côvados, suas três colunas, e suas três bases.
verses.RVR09: Al otro lado, de la una parte y de la otra de la puerta del atrio, cortinas de á quince codos, sus tres columnas, y sus tres basas.

verses.KJV: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
verses.WEB: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.
verses.ASV: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as cortinas do átrio ao redor eram de linho torcido.
verses.RVR09: Todas las cortinas del atrio alrededor eran de lino torcido.

verses.KJV: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.WEB: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.
verses.ASV: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver; and the overlaying of their capitals, of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as bases das colunas eram de bronze; os capitéis das colunas e suas molduras, de prata; também as cobertas das cabeças delas, de prata: e todas as colunas do átrio tinham molduras de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y las basas de las columnas eran de metal; los capiteles de las columnas y sus molduras, de plata; asimismo las cubiertas de las cabezas de ellas, de plata: y todas las columnas del atrio tenían molduras de plata.

verses.KJV: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.WEB: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.
verses.ASV: And the screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cortina da porta do átrio foi de obra de bordado, de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido: o comprimento de vinte côvados, e a altura na largura de cinco côvados, conforme as cortinas do átrio.
verses.RVR09: Y el pabellón de la puerta del atrio fué de obra de recamado, de jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido: la longitud de veinte codos, y la altura en el ancho de cinco codos, conforme á las cortinas del atrio.

verses.KJV: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
verses.WEB: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.ASV: And their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of brass; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas colunas foram quatro com suas quatro bases de bronze: e seus capitéis de prata; e as cobertas dos capitéis delas e suas molduras, de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y sus columnas fueron cuatro con sus cuatro basas de metal: y sus capiteles de plata; y las cubiertas de los capiteles de ellas y sus molduras, de plata.

verses.KJV: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
verses.WEB: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.
verses.ASV: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as estacas do tabernáculo e do átrio ao redor foram de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las estacas del tabernáculo y del atrio alrededor fueron de metal.

verses.KJV: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
verses.WEB: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.ASV: This is the sum of [the things for] the tabernacle, even the tabernacle of the testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as contas do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho, o que foi contado de ordem de Moisés por meio de Itamar, filho de Arão sacerdote, para o ministério dos levitas.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las cuentas del tabernáculo, del tabernáculo del testimonio, lo que fué contado de orden de Moisés por mano de Ithamar, hijo de Aarón sacerdote, para el ministerio de los Levitas.

verses.KJV: And Bezaleel the son Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Bezalel, filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá, fez todas as coisas que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y Bezaleel, hijo de Uri, hijo de Hur, de la tribu de Judá, hizo todas las cosas que Jehová mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.WEB: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.
verses.ASV: And with him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skilful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in fine linen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com ele estava Aoliabe, filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã, artífice, e desenhador, e bordador em material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho fino.
verses.RVR09: Y con él estaba Aholiab, hijo de Ahisamac, de la tribu de Dan, artífice, y diseñador, y recamador en jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino fino.

verses.KJV: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.WEB: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.ASV: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o ouro gasto na obra, em toda a obra do santuário, o qual foi ouro de oferta, foi vinte e nove talentos, e setecentos e trinta siclos, segundo o siclo do santuário.
verses.RVR09: Todo el oro empleado en la obra, en toda la obra del santuario, el cual fué oro de ofrenda, fué veintinueve talentos, y setecientos y treinta siclos, según el siclo del santuario.

verses.KJV: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.WEB: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.ASV: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was a hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.ALMEIDA: E a prata dos contados da congregação foi cem talentos, e mil setecentos setenta e cinco siclos, segundo o siclo do santuário:
verses.RVR09: Y la plata de los contados de la congregación fué cien talentos, y mil setecientos setenta y cinco siclos, según el siclo del santuario:

verses.KJV: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
verses.WEB: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
verses.ASV: a beka a head, [that is], half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that passed over to them that were numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meio por cabeça, meio siclo, segundo o siclo do santuário, a todos os que passaram por contagem de idade de vinte anos e acima, que foram seiscentos três mil quinhentos cinquenta.
