verses.RVR09: Medio por cabeza, medio siclo, según el siclo del santuario, á todos los que pasaron por cuenta de edad de veinte años y arriba, que fueron seiscientos tres mil quinientos cincuenta.

verses.KJV: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.WEB: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.
verses.ASV: And the hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the veil; a hundred sockets for the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve também cem talentos de prata para fazer de fundição as bases do santuário e as bases do véu: em cem bases cem talentos, a talento por base.
verses.RVR09: Hubo además cien talentos de plata para hacer de fundición las basas del santuario y las basas del velo: en cien basas cien talentos, á talento por basa.

verses.KJV: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
verses.WEB: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
verses.ASV: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five [shekels] he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos mil setecentos setenta e cinco siclos fez os capitéis das colunas, e cobriu os capitéis delas, e as cingiu.
verses.RVR09: Y de los mil setecientos setenta y cinco siclos hizo los capiteles de las columnas, y cubrió los capiteles de ellas, y las ciñó.

verses.KJV: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.WEB: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
verses.ASV: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o bronze da oferta foi setenta talentos, e dois mil quatrocentos siclos;
verses.RVR09: Y el metal de la ofrenda fué setenta talentos, y dos mil cuatrocientos siclos;

verses.KJV: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.WEB: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,
verses.ASV: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tent of meeting, and the brazen altar, and the brazen grating for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.ALMEIDA: Do qual fez as bases da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, e o altar de bronze, e sua grelha de bronze, e todos os utensílios do altar.
verses.RVR09: Del cual hizo las basas de la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, y el altar de metal, y su enrejado de metal, y todos los vasos del altar.

verses.KJV: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.WEB: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.
verses.ASV: and the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the gate of the court, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as bases do átrio ao redor, e as bases da porta do átrio, e todas as estacas do tabernáculo, e todas as estacas do átrio ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y las basas del atrio alrededor, y las basas de la puerta del atrio, y todas las estacas del tabernáculo, y todas las estacas del atrio alrededor.

verses.KJV: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made finely wrought garments, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E do material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, fizeram as vestimentas do ministério para ministrar no santuário, e também fizeram as vestiduras sagradas para Arão; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y DEL jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, hicieron las vestimentas del ministerio para ministrar en el santuario, y asimismo hicieron las vestiduras sagradas para Aarón; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.WEB: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.ASV: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o éfode de ouro, de azul e púrpura e carmesim, e linho torcido.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el ephod de oro, de cárdeno y púrpura y carmesí, y lino torcido.

verses.KJV: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
verses.WEB: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.
verses.ASV: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, the work of the skilful workman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estenderam as placas de ouro, e cortaram cachos para tecê-los entre o azul, e entre a púrpura, e entre o carmesim, e entre o linho, com delicada obra.
verses.RVR09: Y extendieron las planchas de oro, y cortaron hilos para tejerlos entre el jacinto, y entre la púrpura, y entre el carmesí, y entre el lino, con delicada obra.

verses.KJV: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
verses.WEB: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.
verses.ASV: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joined together; at the two ends was it joined together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram-lhe as ombreiras que se juntassem; e uniam-se em seus dois lados.
verses.RVR09: Hiciéronle las hombreras que se juntasen; y uníanse en sus dos lados.

verses.KJV: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And the skilfully woven band, that was upon it, wherewith to gird it on, was of the same piece [and] like the work thereof; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o cinto do éfode que estava sobre ele, era do mesmo, conforme sua obra; de ouro, material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y el cinto del ephod que estaba sobre él, era de lo mismo, conforme á su obra; de oro, jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And they wrought the onyx stones, inclosed in settings of gold, graven with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lavraram as pedras de ônix cercadas de engastes de ouro, gravada de gravura de selo com os nomes dos filhos de Israel:
verses.RVR09: Y labraron las piedras oniquinas cercadas de engastes de oro, grabadas de grabadura de sello con los nombres de los hijos de Israel:

verses.KJV: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as pôs sobre as ombreiras do éfode, por pedras de memória aos filhos de Israel; como o SENHOR o havia a Moisés mandado.
verses.RVR09: Y púsolas sobre las hombreras del ephod, por piedras de memoria á los hijos de Israel; como Jehová lo había á Moisés mandado.

verses.KJV: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.WEB: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.ASV: And he made the breastplate, the work of the skilful workman, like the work of the ephod; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o peitoral de primorosa obra, como a obra do éfode, de ouro, azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el racional de primorosa obra, como la obra del ephod, de oro, jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido.

verses.KJV: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
verses.WEB: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.
verses.ASV: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being double.
verses.ALMEIDA: Era quadrado; dobrado fizeram o peitoral: sua comprimento era de um palmo, e de um palmo sua largura, dobrado.
verses.RVR09: Era cuadrado: doblado hicieron el racional: su longitud era de un palmo, y de un palmo su anchura, doblado.

verses.KJV: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
verses.WEB: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
verses.ASV: And they set in it four rows of stones. A row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle was the first row;
verses.ALMEIDA: E engastaram nele quatro ordens de pedras. A primeira ordem era um sárdio, um topázio, e um carbúnculo: este a primeira ordem.
verses.RVR09: Y engastaron en él cuatro órdenes de piedras. El primer orden era un sardio, un topacio, y un carbunclo: este el primer orden.

verses.KJV: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.WEB: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
verses.ASV: and the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;
verses.ALMEIDA: A segunda ordem, uma esmeralda, uma safira, e um diamante.
verses.RVR09: El segundo orden, una esmeralda, un zafiro, y un diamante.

verses.KJV: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.WEB: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.ASV: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.ALMEIDA: A terceira ordem, um jacinto, uma ágata, e uma ametista.
verses.RVR09: El tercer orden, un ligurio, un ágata, y un amatista.

verses.KJV: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
verses.WEB: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
verses.ASV: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in inclosings of gold in their settings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a quarta ordem, um berilo, um ônix, e um jaspe: cercadas e encaixadas em seus engastes de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y el cuarto orden, un berilo, un onix, y un jaspe: cercadas y encajadas en sus engastes de oro.

verses.KJV: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.WEB: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
verses.ASV: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: As quais pedras eram conforme os nomes dos filhos de Israel, doze segundo os nomes deles; como gravuras de selo, cada uma com seu nome segundo as doze tribos.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales piedras eran conforme á los nombres de los hijos de Israel, doce según los nombres de ellos; como grabaduras de sello, cada una con su nombre según las doce tribus.

verses.KJV: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.WEB: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
verses.ASV: And they made upon the breastplate chains like cords, of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram também sobre o peitoral as correntes pequenas de feitura de trança, de ouro puro.
verses.RVR09: Hicieron también sobre el racional las cadenas pequeñas de hechura de trenza, de oro puro.

verses.KJV: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.WEB: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.ASV: And they made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram também os dois engastes e os dois anéis, de ouro; os quais dois anéis de ouro puseram nas duas extremidades do peitoral.
verses.RVR09: Hicieron asimismo los dos engastes y los dos anillos, de oro; los cuales dos anillos de oro pusieron en los dos cabos del racional.

verses.KJV: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.WEB: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
verses.ASV: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram as duas tranças de ouro naqueles dois anéis aos extremos do peitoral.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron las dos trenzas de oro en aquellos dos anillos á los cabos del racional.

verses.KJV: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
verses.WEB: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
verses.ASV: And the [other] two ends of the two wreathen chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, in the forepart thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fixaram as duas extremidades das duas tranças nos dois engastes, que puseram sobre as ombreiras do éfode, na parte dianteira dele.
verses.RVR09: Y fijaron los dos cabos de las dos trenzas en los dos engastes, que pusieron sobre las hombreras del ephod, en la parte delantera de él.

verses.KJV: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
verses.WEB: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
verses.ASV: And they made two rings of gold, and put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram dois anéis de ouro, que puseram nas duas extremidades do peitoral, em sua orla, à parte baixa do éfode.
verses.RVR09: E hicieron dos anillos de oro, que pusieron en los dos cabos del racional en su orilla, á la parte baja del ephod.

verses.KJV: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.WEB: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.ASV: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram também dois anéis de ouro, os quais puseram nas duas ombreiras do éfode, abaixo na parte dianteira, diante de sua juntura, sobre o cinto do éfode.
verses.RVR09: Hicieron además dos anillos de oro, los cuales pusieron en las dos hombreras del ephod, abajo en la parte delantera, delante de su juntura, sobre el cinto del ephod.

verses.KJV: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And they did bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ataram o peitoral de seus anéis aos anéis do éfode com um cordão de material azul, para que estivesse sobre o cinto do mesmo éfode, e não se separasse o peitoral do éfode; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y ataron el racional de sus anillos á los anillos del ephod con un cordón de jacinto, para que estuviese sobre el cinto del mismo ephod, y no se apartase el racional del ephod; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
verses.WEB: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
verses.ASV: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o manto do éfode de obra de tecelão, todo de azul.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el manto del ephod de obra de tejedor, todo de jacinto,

verses.KJV: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
verses.WEB: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.
verses.ASV: and the hole of the robe in the midst thereof, as the hole of a coat of mail, with a binding round about the hole of it, that it should not be rent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com sua abertura em meio dele, como a abertura de um colarinho, com uma borda em derredor da abertura, para que não se rompesse.
verses.RVR09: Con su abertura en medio de él, como el cuello de un coselete, con un borde en derredor de la abertura, porque no se rompiese.

verses.KJV: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
verses.WEB: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
verses.ASV: And they made upon the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, [and] twined [linen].
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram nas orlas do manto as romãs de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido.
verses.RVR09: E hicieron en las orillas del manto las granadas de jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, y lino torcido.

verses.KJV: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
verses.WEB: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
verses.ASV: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the skirts of the robe round about, between the pomegranates;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram também os sinos de ouro puro, os quais sinos puseram entre as romãs pelas orlas do manto ao redor entre as romãs:
verses.RVR09: Hicieron también las campanillas de oro puro, las cuales campanillas pusieron entre las granadas por las orillas del manto alrededor entre las granadas:

verses.KJV: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about, to minister in; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um sino e uma romã, um sino e uma romã ao redor, nas orlas do manto, para ministrar; como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Una campanilla y una granada, una campanilla y una granada alrededor, en las orillas del manto, para ministrar; como Jehová lo mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.WEB: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,
verses.ASV: And they made the coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.ALMEIDA: Igualmente fizeram as túnicas de linho fino de obra de tecelão, para Arão e para seus filhos;
verses.RVR09: Igualmente hicieron las túnicas de lino fino de obra de tejedor, para Aarón y para sus hijos;

verses.KJV: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
verses.WEB: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,
verses.ASV: and the mitre of fine linen, and the goodly head-tires of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,
verses.ALMEIDA: Também a mitra de linho fino, e os adornos das tiaras de linho fino, e os calções de linho, de linho torcido;
verses.RVR09: Asimismo la mitra de lino fino, y los adornos de los chapeos (tiaras) de lino fino, y los pañetes de lino, de lino torcido;

verses.KJV: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: and the girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o cinto de linho torcido, e de material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, de obra de bordador; como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: También el cinto de lino torcido, y de jacinto, y púrpura, y carmesí, de obra de recamador; como Jehová lo mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, Holiness To The Lord.
verses.WEB: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.
verses.ASV: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like the engravings of a signet, HOLY TO JEHOVAH.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram também a prancha da coroa santa de ouro puro, e escreveram nela de gravura de selo, o rótulo, SANTIDADE AO SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Hicieron asimismo la plancha de la diadema santa de oro puro, y escribieron en ella de grabadura de sello, el rótulo, SANTIDAD Á JEHOVÁ.

verses.KJV: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it upon the mitre above; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram nela um cordão de azul, para colocá-la em alto sobre a mitra; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron en ella un cordón de jacinto, para colocarla en alto sobre la mitra; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.WEB: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.
verses.ASV: Thus was finished all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting: and the children of Israel did according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses; so did they.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi acabada toda a obra do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho: e fizeram os filhos de Israel como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés: assim o fizeram.
verses.RVR09: Y fué acabada toda la obra del tabernáculo, del tabernáculo del testimonio: é hicieron los hijos de Israel como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés: así lo hicieron.

verses.KJV: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.WEB: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
verses.ASV: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the Tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.ALMEIDA: E trouxeram o tabernáculo a Moisés, o tabernáculo e todos os seus utensílios; seus colchetes, suas tábuas, suas barras, e suas colunas, e suas bases;
verses.RVR09: Y trajeron el tabernáculo á Moisés, el tabernáculo y todos sus vasos; sus corchetes, sus tablas, sus barras, y sus columnas, y sus basas;

verses.KJV: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
verses.WEB: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,
verses.ASV: and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of sealskins, and the veil of the screen;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a coberta de peles vermelhas de carneiros, e a coberta de peles finas, e o véu da cortina;
verses.RVR09: Y la cubierta de pieles rojas de carneros, y la cubierta de pieles de tejones, y el velo del pabellón;

verses.KJV: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
verses.WEB: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,
verses.ASV: the ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy-seat;
verses.ALMEIDA: A arca do testemunho, e suas varas, e o propiciatório;
verses.RVR09: El arca del testimonio, y sus varas, y la cubierta;

verses.KJV: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
verses.WEB: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,
verses.ASV: the table, all the vessels thereof, and the showbread;
verses.ALMEIDA: A mesa, todos os seus utensílios, e o pão da proposição;
verses.RVR09: La mesa, todos sus vasos, y el pan de la proposición;

verses.KJV: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
verses.WEB: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,
verses.ASV: the pure candlestick, the lamps thereof, even the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for the light;
verses.ALMEIDA: O candelabro limpo, suas lâmpadas, as lâmpadas que deviam manter-se em ordem, e todos os seus utensílios, e o azeite para a luminária;
verses.RVR09: El candelero limpio, sus candilejas, las lámparas que debían mantenerse en orden, y todos sus vasos, y el aceite para la luminaria;

verses.KJV: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
verses.WEB: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
verses.ASV: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door of the Tent;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o altar de ouro, e o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático, e a cortina para a porta do tabernáculo;
verses.RVR09: Y el altar de oro, y el aceite de la unción, y el perfume aromático, y el pabellón para la puerta del tabernáculo;

verses.KJV: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.WEB: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,
verses.ASV: the brazen altar, and its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;
verses.ALMEIDA: O altar de bronze, com sua grelha de bronze, suas varas, e todos os seus utensílios; e a pia, e sua base;
verses.RVR09: El altar de metal, con su enrejado de metal, sus varas, y todos sus vasos; y la fuente, y su basa;

verses.KJV: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
verses.WEB: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,
verses.ASV: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court, the cords thereof, and the pins thereof, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
verses.ALMEIDA: As cortinas do átrio, e suas colunas, e suas bases, e a cortina para a porta do átrio, e suas cordas, e suas estacas, e todos os vasos do serviço do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho;
verses.RVR09: Las cortinas del atrio, y sus columnas, y sus basas, y el pabellón para la puerta del atrio, y sus cuerdas, y sus estacas, y todos los vasos del servicio del tabernáculo, del tabernáculo del testimonio;

verses.KJV: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.WEB: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.ASV: the finely wrought garments for ministering in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.ALMEIDA: As vestimentas do serviço para ministrar no santuário, as sagradas vestiduras para Arão o sacerdote, e as vestiduras de seus filhos, para ministrar no sacerdócio.
verses.RVR09: Las vestimentas del servicio para ministrar en el santuario, las sagradas vestiduras para Aarón el sacerdote, y las vestiduras de sus hijos, para ministrar en el sacerdocio.

verses.KJV: According to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
verses.WEB: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
verses.ASV: According to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em conformidade a todas as coisas que o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés, assim fizeram os filhos de Israel toda a obra.
verses.RVR09: En conformidad á todas las cosas que Jehová había mandado á Moisés, así hicieron los hijos de Israel toda la obra.

verses.KJV: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the Lord had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.WEB: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
verses.ASV: And Moses saw all the work, and, behold, they had done it; as Jehovah had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu Moisés toda a obra, e eis que a fizeram como o SENHOR havia mandado; e abençoou-os.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Moisés toda la obra, y he aquí que la habían hecho como Jehová había mandado; y bendíjolos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.WEB: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: On the first day of the first month shalt thou rear up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: No primeiro dia do mês primeiro farás levantar o tabernáculo, o tabernáculo do testemunho:
verses.RVR09: En el primer día del mes primero harás levantar el tabernáculo, el tabernáculo del testimonio:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
verses.WEB: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and thou shalt screen the ark with the veil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás nele a arca do testemunho, e a cobrirás com o véu:
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás en él el arca del testimonio, y la cubrirás con el velo:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
verses.WEB: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meterás a mesa, e a porás em ordem: meterás também o candelabro e acenderás suas lâmpadas:
verses.RVR09: Y meterás la mesa, y la pondrás en orden: meterás también el candelero, y encenderás sus lámparas:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás o altar de ouro para o incenso diante da arca do testemunho, e porás a cortina diante da porta do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás el altar de oro para el perfume delante del arca del testimonio, y pondrás el pabellón delante de la puerta del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.WEB: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set the altar of burnt-offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois porás o altar do holocausto diante da porta do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Después pondrás el altar del holocausto delante de la puerta del tabernáculo, del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
verses.WEB: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo porás a pia entre o tabernáculo do testemunho e o altar; e porás água nela.
verses.RVR09: Luego pondrás la fuente entre el tabernáculo del testimonio y el altar; y pondrás agua en ella.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
verses.WEB: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
verses.ALMEIDA: Finalmente porás o átrio em derredor, e a cortina da porta do átrio.
verses.RVR09: Finalmente pondrás el atrio en derredor, y el pabellón de la puerta del atrio.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
verses.WEB: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the furniture thereof: and it shall be holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomarás o azeite da unção e ungirás o tabernáculo, e tudo o que está nele; e lhe santificarás com todos os seus utensílios, e será santo.
verses.RVR09: Y tomarás el aceite de la unción, y ungirás el tabernáculo, y todo lo que está en él; y le santificarás con todos sus vasos, y será santo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
verses.WEB: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt anoint the altar of burnt-offering, and all its vessels, and sanctify the altar: and the altar shall be most holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ungirás também o altar do holocausto e todos os seus utensílios: e santificarás o altar, e será um altar santíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Ungirás también el altar del holocausto y todos sus vasos: y santificarás el altar, y será un altar santísimo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
verses.WEB: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt anoint the laver and its base, and sanctify it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também ungirás a pia e sua base, e a santificarás.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo ungirás la fuente y su basa, y la santificarás.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
verses.WEB: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tent of meeting, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás chegar a Arão e a seus filhos à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, e os lavarás com água.
verses.RVR09: Y harás llegar á Aarón y á sus hijos á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, y los lavarás con agua.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.WEB: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments; and thou shalt anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás vestir a Arão as vestimentas sagradas, e o ungirás, e o consagrarás, para que seja meu sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Y harás vestir á Aarón las vestiduras sagradas, y lo ungirás, y lo consagrarás, para que sea mi sacerdote.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
verses.WEB: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois farás chegar seus filhos, e lhes vestirás as túnicas:
verses.RVR09: Después harás llegar sus hijos, y les vestirás las túnicas:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
verses.WEB: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
verses.ASV: and thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: and their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os ungirás como ungiste a seu pai, e serão meus sacerdotes: e será que sua unção lhes servirá por sacerdócio perpétuo por suas gerações.
verses.RVR09: Y los ungirás como ungiste á su padre, y serán mis sacerdotes: y será que su unción les servirá por sacerdocio perpetuo por sus generaciones.

verses.KJV: Thus did Moses: according to all that the Lord commanded him, so did he.
verses.WEB: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.
verses.ASV: Thus did Moses: according to all that Jehovah commanded him, so did he.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés fez conforme tudo o que o SENHOR lhe mandou; assim o fez.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés hizo conforme á todo lo que Jehová le mandó; así lo hizo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.WEB: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim no dia primeiro do primeiro mês, no segundo ano, o tabernáculo foi erigido.
verses.RVR09: Y así en el día primero del primer mes, en el segundo año, el tabernáculo fué erigido.

verses.KJV: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
verses.WEB: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
verses.ASV: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up its pillars.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés fez levantar o tabernáculo, e assentou suas bases, e colocou suas tábuas, e pôs suas barras, e fez erguer suas colunas.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés hizo levantar el tabernáculo, y asentó sus basas, y colocó sus tablas, y puso sus barras, é hizo alzar sus columnas.

verses.KJV: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estendeu a tenda sobre o tabernáculo, e pôs a cobertura encima do mesmo; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y extendió la tienda sobre el tabernáculo, y puso la sobrecubierta encima del mismo; como Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
verses.WEB: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
verses.ASV: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy-seat above upon the ark:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou e pôs o testemunho dentro da arca, e colocou as varas na arca, e encima o propiciatório sobre a arca:
verses.RVR09: Y tomó y puso el testimonio dentro del arca, y colocó las varas en el arca, y encima la cubierta sobre el arca:

verses.KJV: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: and he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meteu a arca no tabernáculo, e pôs o véu da tenda, e cobriu a arca do testemunho; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y metió el arca en el tabernáculo, y puso el velo de la tienda, y cubrió el arca del testimonio; como Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
verses.WEB: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.
verses.ASV: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the veil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs a mesa no tabernáculo do testemunho, ao lado norte da cortina, fora do véu:
verses.RVR09: Y puso la mesa en el tabernáculo del testimonio, al lado septentrional del pabellón, fuera del velo:

verses.KJV: And he set the bread in order upon it before the Lord; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And he set the bread in order upon it before Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sobre ela pôs por ordem os pães diante do SENHOR, como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre ella puso por orden los panes delante de Jehová, como Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.WEB: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: And he put the candlestick in the tent of meeting, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs o candelabro no tabernáculo do testemunho, em frente da mesa, ao lado sul da cortina.
verses.RVR09: Y puso el candelero en el tabernáculo del testimonio, enfrente de la mesa, al lado meridional del pabellón.

verses.KJV: And he lighted the lamps before the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And he lighted the lamps before Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acendeu as lâmpadas diante do SENHOR; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y encendió las lámparas delante de Jehová; como Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
verses.WEB: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;
verses.ASV: And he put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pôs também o altar de ouro no tabernáculo do testemunho, diante do véu:
verses.RVR09: Puso también el altar de oro en el tabernáculo del testimonio, delante del velo:

verses.KJV: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: and he burnt thereon incense of sweet spices; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acendeu sobre ele o incenso aromático; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y encendió sobre él el perfume aromático; como Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: And he put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pôs também a cortina da porta do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Puso asimismo la cortina de la puerta del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And he set the altar of burnt-offering at the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt-offering and the meal-offering; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E colocou o altar do holocausto à porta do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho; e ofereceu sobre ele holocausto e oferta de cereais; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y colocó el altar del holocausto á la puerta del tabernáculo, del tabernáculo del testimonio; y ofreció sobre él holocausto y presente; como Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
verses.WEB: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
verses.ASV: And he set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water therein, wherewith to wash.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs a pia entre o tabernáculo do testemunho e o altar; e pôs nela água para lavar.
verses.RVR09: Y puso la fuente entre el tabernáculo del testimonio y el altar; y puso en ella agua para lavar.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.WEB: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés e Arão e seus filhos lavavam nela suas mãos e seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés y Aarón y sus hijos lavaban en ella sus manos y sus pies.

verses.KJV: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: when they went into the tent of meeting, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando entravam no tabernáculo do testemunho, e quando se traziam ao altar, se lavavam; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Cuando entraban en el tabernáculo del testimonio, y cuando se llegaban al altar, se lavaban; como Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
verses.WEB: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
verses.ASV: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Finalmente erigiu o átrio em derredor do tabernáculo e do altar, e pôs a cortina da porta do átrio. E assim acabou Moisés a obra.
verses.RVR09: Finalmente erigió el atrio en derredor del tabernáculo y del altar, y puso la cortina de la puerta del atrio. Y así acabó Moisés la obra.

verses.KJV: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então uma nuvem cobriu o tabernáculo do testemunho, e a glória do SENHOR encheu o tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces una nube cubrió el tabernáculo del testimonio, y la gloria de Jehová hinchió el tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of meeting, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não podia Moisés entrar no tabernáculo do testemunho, porque a nuvem estava sobre ele, e a glória do SENHOR o tinha enchido.
verses.RVR09: Y no podía Moisés entrar en el tabernáculo del testimonio, porque la nube estaba sobre él, y la gloria de Jehová lo tenía lleno.

verses.KJV: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
verses.WEB: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
verses.ASV: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando a nuvem se erguia do tabernáculo, os filhos de Israel se moviam em todas suas jornadas:
verses.RVR09: Y cuando la nube se alzaba del tabernáculo, los hijos de Israel se movían en todas sus jornadas:

verses.KJV: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
verses.WEB: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.
verses.ASV: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se a nuvem não se erguia, não se partiam até o dia em que ela se erguia.
verses.RVR09: Pero si la nube no se alzaba, no se partían hasta el día en que ella se alzaba.

verses.KJV: For the cloud of the Lord was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.WEB: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.ASV: For the cloud of Jehovah was upon the tabernacle by day, and there was fire therein by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a nuvem do SENHOR estava de dia sobre o tabernáculo, e o fogo estava de noite nele, à vista de toda a casa de Israel, em todas as suas jornadas.
verses.RVR09: Porque la nube de Jehová estaba de día sobre el tabernáculo, y el fuego estaba de noche en él, á vista de toda la casa de Israel, en todas sus jornadas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tent of meeting, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou o SENHOR a Moisés, e falou com ele desde o tabernáculo do testemunho, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y LLAMÓ Jehová á Moisés, y habló con él desde el tabernáculo del testimonio, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the Lord, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man of you offereth an oblation unto Jehovah, ye shall offer your oblation of the cattle, [even] of the herd and of the flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando algum dentre vós oferecer oferta ao SENHOR, de gado vacum ou ovelha fareis vossa oferta.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando alguno de entre vosotros ofreciere ofrenda á Jehová, de ganado vacuno ú ovejuno haréis vuestra ofrenda.

verses.KJV: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.
verses.ASV: If his oblation be a burnt-offering of the herd, he shall offer it a male without blemish: he shall offer it at the door of the tent of meeting, that he may be accepted before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se sua oferta for holocausto de vacas, macho sem mácula o oferecerá: de sua vontade o oferecerá à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Si su ofrenda fuere holocausto de vacas, macho sin tacha lo ofrecerá: de su voluntad lo ofrecerá á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.WEB: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.ASV: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the burnt-offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porá sua mão sobre a cabeça do holocausto; e ele o aceitará para expiar-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrá su mano sobre la cabeza del holocausto; y él lo aceptará para expiarle.

verses.KJV: And he shall kill the bullock before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And he shall kill the bullock before Jehovah: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então degolará o bezerro na presença do SENHOR; e os sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, oferecerão o sangue, e o espargirão ao redor sobre o altar, o qual está à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces degollará el becerro en la presencia de Jehová; y los sacerdotes, hijos de Aarón, ofrecerán la sangre, y la rociarán alrededor sobre el altar, el cual está á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.WEB: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
verses.ASV: And he shall flay the burnt-offering, and cut it into its pieces.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirará a pele do holocausto, e o dividirá em suas peças.
verses.RVR09: Y desollará el holocausto, y lo dividirá en sus piezas.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.WEB: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;
verses.ASV: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay wood in order upon the fire;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Arão sacerdote porão fogo sobre o altar, e porão a lenha sobre o fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Aarón sacerdote pondrán fuego sobre el altar, y compondrán la leña sobre el fuego.

verses.KJV: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.WEB: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;
verses.ASV: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo os sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, acomodarão as peças, a cabeça e o redenho, sobre a lenha que está sobre o fogo, que haverá encima do altar:
verses.RVR09: Luego los sacerdotes, hijos de Aarón, acomodarán las piezas, la cabeza y el redaño, sobre la leña que está sobre el fuego, que habrá encima del altar:

verses.KJV: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: but its inwards and its legs shall he wash with water. And the priest shall burn the whole on the altar, for a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lavará com água seus intestinos e suas pernas: e o sacerdote fará arder tudo sobre o altar: holocausto é, oferta acesa de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y lavará con agua sus intestinos y sus piernas: y el sacerdote hará arder todo sobre el altar: holocausto es, ofrenda encendida de olor suave á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
verses.WEB: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.
verses.ASV: And if his oblation be of the flock, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt-offering; he shall offer it a male without blemish.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se sua oferta para holocausto for de ovelhas, dos cordeiros, ou das cabras, macho sem defeito o oferecerá.
verses.RVR09: Y si su ofrenda para holocausto fuere de ovejas, de los corderos, ó de las cabras, macho sin defecto lo ofrecerá.

verses.KJV: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.WEB: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
verses.ASV: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before Jehovah: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood upon the altar round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E há de degolá-lo ao lado norte do altar diante do SENHOR: e os sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, espargirão seu sangue sobre o altar ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y ha de degollarlo al lado septentrional del altar delante de Jehová: y los sacerdotes, hijos de Aarón, rociarán su sangre sobre el altar alrededor.

verses.KJV: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.WEB: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,
verses.ASV: And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat; and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o dividirá em suas peças, com sua cabeça e seu redenho; e o sacerdote as acomodará sobre a lenha que está sobre o fogo, que haverá encima do altar;
verses.RVR09: Y lo dividirá en sus piezas, con su cabeza y su redaño; y el sacerdote las acomodará sobre la leña que está sobre el fuego, que habrá encima del altar;

verses.KJV: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: but the inwards and the legs shall he wash with water. And the priest shall offer the whole, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lavará suas entranhas e suas pernas com água; e o sacerdote o oferecerá tudo, e o fará arder sobre o altar; holocausto é, oferta acesa de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y lavará sus entrañas y sus piernas con agua; y el sacerdote lo ofrecerá todo, y harálo arder sobre el altar; holocausto es, ofrenda encendida de olor suave á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the Lord be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.WEB: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.
verses.ASV: And if his oblation to Jehovah be a burnt-offering of birds, then he shall offer his oblation of turtle-doves, or of young pigeons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o holocausto se houver de oferecer ao SENHOR de aves, apresentará sua oferta de rolinhas, ou de pombinhos.
verses.RVR09: Y si el holocausto se hubiere de ofrecer á Jehová de aves, presentará su ofrenda de tórtolas, ó de palominos.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
verses.WEB: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;
verses.ASV: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be drained out on the side of the altar;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote a oferecerá sobre o altar, e há de tirar-lhe a cabeça, e fará que arda no altar; e seu sangue será espremido sobre a parede do altar.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote la ofrecerá sobre el altar, y ha de quitarle la cabeza, y hará que arda en el altar; y su sangre será exprimida sobre la pared del altar.

verses.KJV: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
verses.WEB: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.
verses.ASV: and he shall take away its crop with the filth thereof, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes:
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe há de tirar o papo e as penas, o qual lançará junto ao altar, até o oriente, no lugar das cinzas.
verses.RVR09: Y le ha de quitar el buche y las plumas, lo cual echará junto al altar, hacia el oriente, en el lugar de las cenizas.

verses.KJV: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: and he shall rend it by the wings thereof, [but] shall not divide it asunder. And the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a fenderá por suas asas, mas não a dividirá em dois: e o sacerdote a fará arder sobre o altar, sobre a lenha que estará no fogo; holocausto é, oferta acesa de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y la henderá por sus alas, mas no la dividirá en dos: y el sacerdote la hará arder sobre el altar, sobre la leña que estará en el fuego; holocausto es, ofrenda encendida de olor suave á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
verses.WEB: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.
verses.ASV: And when any one offereth an oblation of a meal-offering unto Jehovah, his oblation shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando alguma pessoa oferecer uma oferta de alimentos ao SENHOR, sua oferta será boa farinha, sobre a qual lançará azeite, e porá sobre ela incenso;
verses.RVR09: Y CUANDO alguna persona ofreciere oblación de presente á Jehová, su ofrenda será flor de harina, sobre la cual echará aceite, y pondrá sobre ella incienso:

verses.KJV: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord:
verses.WEB: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: and he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests; and he shall take thereout his handful of the fine flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof. And the priest shall burn [it as] the memorial thereof upon the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: e a trará aos sacerdotes, filhos de Arão; e disso tomará o sacerdote seu punho cheio de sua boa farinha e de seu azeite, com todo seu incenso, e o fará arder sobre o altar: oferta acesa para memorial, de aroma suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y la traerá á los sacerdotes, hijos de Aarón; y de ello tomará el sacerdote su puño lleno de su flor de harina y de su aceite, con todo su incienso, y lo hará arder sobre el altar: ofrenda encendida para recuerdo, de olor suave á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.
verses.WEB: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.ASV: and that which is left of the meal-offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a sobra da oferta será de Arão e de seus filhos: é coisa santíssima das ofertas que se queimam ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y la sobra del presente será de Aarón y de sus hijos: es cosa santísima de las ofrendas que se queman á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.WEB: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.ASV: And when thou offerest an oblation of a meal-offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ofereceres oferta de alimentos, cozida no forno, será de tortas de boa farinha sem levedura, amassadas com azeite, e massas sem levedura untadas com azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando ofrecieres ofrenda de presente cocida en horno, será de tortas de flor de harina sin levadura, amasadas con aceite, y hojaldres sin levadura untadas con aceite.

verses.KJV: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.WEB: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.
verses.ASV: And if thy oblation be a meal-offering of the baking-pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se a tua oferta for oferta de alimentos [preparados] em panelas, será de boa farinha sem levedura, amassada com azeite,
verses.RVR09: Mas si tu presente fuere ofrenda de sartén, será de flor de harina sin levadura, amasada con aceite,

verses.KJV: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.WEB: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meal-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: a qual partirás em peças, e espalharás azeite sobre ela; é oferta de alimentos.
verses.RVR09: La cual partirás en piezas, y echarás sobre ella aceite: es presente.

verses.KJV: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.WEB: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.ASV: And if thy oblation be a meal-offering of the frying-pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se a tua oferta de alimentos for oferta [preparada] em frigideira, ela será feita de boa farinha com azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y si tu presente fuere ofrenda cocida en cazuela, haráse de flor de harina con aceite.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the Lord: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.WEB: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to the LORD. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt bring the meal-offering that is made of these things unto Jehovah: and it shall be presented unto the priest, and he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trarás ao SENHOR a oferta que se fará destas coisas, e a apresentarás ao sacerdote, o qual a chegará ao altar.
verses.RVR09: Y traerás á Jehová la ofrenda que se hará de estas cosas, y la presentarás al sacerdote, el cual la llegará al altar.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall take up from the meal-offering the memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomará o sacerdote daquela oferta de alimentos em sua memória, e a fará arder sobre o altar; oferta acesa, de suave aroma ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y tomará el sacerdote de aquel presente, en memoria del mismo, y harálo arder sobre el altar; ofrenda encendida, de suave olor á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.
verses.WEB: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.ASV: And that which is left of the meal-offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o restante da oferta será de Arão e de seus filhos; é coisa santíssima das ofertas que se queimam ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y lo restante del presente será de Aarón y de sus hijos: es cosa santísima de las ofrendas que se queman á Jehová.

verses.KJV: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the Lord, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the Lord made by fire.
verses.WEB: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.ASV: No meal-offering, which ye shall offer unto Jehovah, shall be made with leaven; for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhuma oferta que oferecerdes ao SENHOR será com levedura; porque de nenhuma coisa levedada, nem de nenhum mel, se deverá queimar oferta ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ningún presente que ofreciereis á Jehová, será con levadura: porque de ninguna cosa leuda, ni de ninguna miel, se ha de quemar ofrenda á Jehová.

verses.KJV: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the Lord: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
verses.WEB: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.
verses.ASV: As an oblation of first-[fruits] ye shall offer them unto Jehovah: but they shall not come up for a sweet savor on the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na oferta das primícias as oferecereis ao SENHOR: mas não subirão sobre o altar em cheiro suave.
verses.RVR09: En la ofrenda de las primicias las ofreceréis á Jehová: mas no subirán sobre el altar en olor de suavidad.

verses.KJV: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.WEB: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.
verses.ASV: And every oblation of thy meal-offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meal-offering: with all thine oblations thou shalt offer salt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E temperarás toda oferta de teu presente com sal; e não farás que falte jamais da tua oferta de alimentos o sal da aliança de teu Deus; em toda oferta tua oferecerás sal.
verses.RVR09: Y sazonarás toda ofrenda de tu presente con sal; y no harás que falte jamás de tu presente la sal de la alianza de tu Dios: en toda ofrenda tuya ofrecerás sal.

verses.KJV: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the Lord, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
verses.WEB: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.
