verses.ALMEIDA: Em panela se preparará com azeite; bem misturada a trarás, e os pedaços cozidos da oferta oferecerás ao SENHOR em cheiro suave.
verses.RVR09: En sartén se aderezará con aceite; frita la traerás, y los pedazos cocidos del presente ofrecerás á Jehová en olor de suavidad.

verses.KJV: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the Lord; it shall be wholly burnt.
verses.WEB: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the anointed priest that shall be in his stead from among his sons shall offer it: by a statute for ever it shall be wholly burnt unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote que em lugar de Arão for ungido dentre seus filhos, fará a oferta; estatuto perpétuo do SENHOR: toda ela será queimada.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote que en lugar de Aarón fuere ungido de entre sus hijos, hará la ofrenda; estatuto perpetuo de Jehová: toda ella será quemada.

verses.KJV: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.WEB: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”
verses.ASV: And every meal-offering of the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a oferta de cereais de sacerdote será inteiramente queimado; não se comerá.
verses.RVR09: Y todo presente de sacerdote será enteramente quemado; no se comerá.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the Lord: it is most holy.
verses.WEB: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before the LORD. It is most holy.
verses.ASV: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin-offering: in the place where the burnt-offering is killed shall the sin-offering be killed before Jehovah: it is most holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a Arão e a seus filhos, dizendo: Esta é a lei da expiação: no lugar de onde será degolado o holocausto, será degolada a expiação pelo pecado diante do SENHOR: é coisa santíssima.
verses.RVR09: Habla á Aarón y á sus hijos, diciendo: Esta es la ley de la expiación: en el lugar donde será degollado el holocausto, será degollada la expiación por el pecado delante de Jehová: es cosa santísima.

verses.KJV: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in a holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sacerdote que a oferecer por expiação, a comerá: no lugar santo será comida, no átrio do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: El sacerdote que la ofreciere por expiación, la comerá: en el lugar santo será comida, en el atrio del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
verses.WEB: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.
verses.ASV: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy; and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in a holy place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo o que em sua carne tocar, será santificado; e se cair de seu sangue sobre a roupa, lavarás aquilo sobre que cair, no lugar santo.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que en su carne tocare, será santificado; y si cayere de su sangre sobre el vestido, lavarás aquello sobre que cayere, en el lugar santo.

verses.KJV: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.WEB: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.ASV: But the earthen vessel wherein it is boiled shall be broken; and if it be boiled in a brazen vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a vasilha de barro em que for cozida, será quebrada: e se for cozida em vasilha de metal, será esfregada e lavada com água.
verses.RVR09: Y la vasija de barro en que fuere cocida, será quebrada: y si fuere cocida en vasija de metal, será fregada y lavada con agua.

verses.KJV: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
verses.WEB: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.
verses.ASV: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo homem dentre os sacerdotes a comerá: é coisa santíssima.
verses.RVR09: Todo varón de entre los sacerdotes la comerá: es cosa santísima.

verses.KJV: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.WEB: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.
verses.ASV: And no sin-offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não se comerá de expiação alguma, de cujo sangue se meter no tabernáculo do testemunho para reconciliar no santuário: ao fogo será queimada.
verses.RVR09: Mas no se comerá de expiación alguna, de cuya sangre se metiere en el tabernáculo del testimonio para reconciliar en el santuario: al fuego será quemada.

verses.KJV: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
verses.WEB: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.
verses.ASV: And this is the law of the trespass-offering: it is most holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim esta é a lei da expiação da culpa: é coisa muito santa.
verses.RVR09: ASIMISMO esta es la ley de la expiación de la culpa: es cosa muy santa.

verses.KJV: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.WEB: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.
verses.ASV: In the place where they kill the burnt-offering shall they kill the trespass-offering; and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle upon the altar round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: No lugar onde degolarem o holocausto, degolarão o sacrifício pela culpa; e espargirá seu sangue em derredor sobre o altar:
verses.RVR09: En el lugar donde degollaren el holocausto, degollarán la víctima por la culpa; y rociará su sangre en derredor sobre el altar:

verses.KJV: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.WEB: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,
verses.ASV: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof: the fat tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.ALMEIDA: E dela oferecerá toda a sua gordura, a cauda, e a gordura que cobre os intestinos.
verses.RVR09: Y de ella ofrecerá todo su sebo, la cola, y el sebo que cubre los intestinos.

verses.KJV: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.WEB: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;
verses.ASV: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os dois rins, e a gordura que está sobre eles, e o que está sobre os lombos; e com os rins tirará o redenho de sobre o fígado.
verses.RVR09: Y los dos riñones, y el sebo que está sobre ellos, y el que está sobre los ijares; y con los riñones quitará el redaño de sobre el hígado.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a trespass offering.
verses.WEB: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: it is a trespass-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote o fará arder sobre o altar; oferta acesa ao SENHOR: é expiação da culpa.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote lo hará arder sobre el altar; ofrenda encendida á Jehová: es expiación de la culpa.

verses.KJV: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
verses.WEB: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
verses.ASV: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in a holy place: it is most holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo homem dentre os sacerdotes a comerá: será comida no lugar santo: é coisa muito santa.
verses.RVR09: Todo varón de entre los sacerdotes la comerá: será comida en el lugar santo: es cosa muy santa.

verses.KJV: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
verses.WEB: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.
verses.ASV: As is the sin-offering, so is the trespass-offering; there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith, he shall have it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como a expiação pelo pecado, assim é a expiação da culpa: uma mesma lei terão: será do sacerdote que haverá feito a reconciliação com ela.
verses.RVR09: Como la expiación por el pecado, así es la expiación de la culpa: una misma ley tendrán: será del sacerdote que habrá hecho la reconciliación con ella.

verses.KJV: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.WEB: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
verses.ASV: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt-offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt-offering which he hath offered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote que oferecer holocausto de alguém, o couro do holocausto que oferecer, será para ele.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote que ofreciere holocausto de alguno, el cuero del holocausto que ofreciere, será para él.

verses.KJV: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
verses.WEB: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.
verses.ASV: And every meal-offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the frying-pan, and on the baking-pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também toda oferta de cereais que se cozer em forno, e tudo o que for preparado em panela, ou em frigideira, será do sacerdote que o oferecer.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo todo presente que se cociere en horno, y todo el que fuere aderezado en sartén, ó en cazuela, será del sacerdote que lo ofreciere.

verses.KJV: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
verses.WEB: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.
verses.ASV: And every meal-offering, mingled with oil, or dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as well as another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda oferta de cereais amassada com azeite, e seca, será de todos os filhos de Arão, tanto ao um como ao outro.
verses.RVR09: Y todo presente amasado con aceite, y seco, será de todos los hijos de Aarón, tanto al uno como al otro.

verses.KJV: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to the LORD:
verses.ASV: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which one shall offer unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a lei do sacrifício pacífico, que se oferecerá ao SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Y esta es la ley del sacrificio de las paces, que se ofrecerá á Jehová:

verses.KJV: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.WEB: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.
verses.ASV: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour soaked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se se oferecer em ação de graças, oferecerá por sacrifício de ação de graças tortas sem levedura amassadas com azeite, e massas sem levedura untadas com azeite, e boa farinha frita em tortas amassadas com azeite.
verses.RVR09: Si se ofreciere en hacimiento de gracias, ofrecerá por sacrificio de hacimiento de gracias tortas sin levadura amasadas con aceite, y hojaldres sin levadura untadas con aceite, y flor de harina frita en tortas amasadas con aceite.

verses.KJV: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.WEB: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.
verses.ASV: With cakes of leavened bread he shall offer his oblation with the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com tortas de pão levedado oferecerá sua oferta no seu sacrifício pacífico de ação de graças.
verses.RVR09: Con tortas de pan leudo ofrecerá su ofrenda en el sacrificio de hacimientos de gracias de sus paces.

verses.KJV: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the Lord, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.WEB: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.ASV: And of it he shall offer one out of each oblation for a heave-offering unto Jehovah; it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace-offerings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de toda a oferta apresentará uma parte para oferta elevada ao SENHOR, e será do sacerdote que espargir o sangue das ofertas pacíficas.
verses.RVR09: Y de toda la ofrenda presentará una parte por ofrenda elevada á Jehová, y será del sacerdote que rociare la sangre de los pacíficos.

verses.KJV: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.WEB: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.ASV: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his oblation; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a carne do sacrifício de suas ofertas pacíficas em ação de graças, se comerá no dia que for oferecida: não deixarão dela nada para outro dia.
verses.RVR09: Y la carne del sacrificio de sus pacíficos en hacimiento de gracias, se comerá en el día que fuere ofrecida: no dejarán de ella nada para otro día.

verses.KJV: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.WEB: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,
verses.ASV: But if the sacrifice of his oblation be a vow, or a freewill-offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offereth his sacrifice; and on the morrow that which remaineth of it shall be eaten:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se o sacrifício de sua oferta for voto, ou voluntário, no dia que oferecer seu sacrifício será comido; e o que dele restar, será comido no dia seguinte:
verses.RVR09: Mas si el sacrificio de su ofrenda fuere voto, ó voluntario, el día que ofreciere su sacrificio será comido; y lo que de él quedare, comerse ha el día siguiente:

verses.KJV: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.WEB: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
verses.ASV: but that which remaineth of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que restar para o terceiro dia da carne do sacrifício, será queimado no fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y lo que quedare para el tercer día de la carne del sacrificio, será quemado en el fuego.

verses.KJV: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.WEB: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.
verses.ASV: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings be eaten on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se se comer da carne do sacrifício de suas pazes no terceiro dia, o que o oferecer não será aceito, nem lhe será imputado; abominação será, e a pessoa que dele comer levará seu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Y si se comiere de la carne del sacrificio de sus paces el tercer día, el que lo ofreciere no será acepto, ni le será imputado; abominación será, y la persona que de él comiere llevará su pecado.

verses.KJV: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.WEB: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;
verses.ASV: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire. And as for the flesh, every one that is clean shall eat thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: E a carne que tocar a alguma coisa impura, não se comerá; ao fogo será queimada; mas qualquer limpo comerá desta carne.
verses.RVR09: Y la carne que tocare á alguna cosa inmunda, no se comerá; al fuego será quemada; mas cualquiera limpio comerá de aquesta carne.

verses.KJV: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.WEB: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ASV: but the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, that pertain unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a pessoa que comer a carne do sacrifício pacífico, o qual é do SENHOR, estando impura, aquela pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.
verses.RVR09: Y la persona que comiere la carne del sacrificio de paces, el cual es de Jehová, estando inmunda, aquella persona será cortada de sus pueblos.

verses.KJV: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the Lord, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.WEB: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
verses.ASV: And when any one shall touch any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean beast, or any unclean abomination, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which pertain unto Jehovah, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, a pessoa que tocar alguma coisa impura, em impureza de homem, ou em animal impuro, ou em qualquer abominação impura, e comer a carne do sacrifício pacífico, o qual é do SENHOR, aquela pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.
verses.RVR09: Además, la persona que tocare alguna cosa inmunda, en inmundicia de hombre, ó en animal inmundo, ó en cualquiera abominación inmunda, y comiere la carne del sacrificio de las paces, el cual es de Jehová, aquella persona será cortada de sus pueblos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Falou ainda o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Habló aún Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no fat, of ox, or sheep, or goat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Nenhuma gordura de boi, nem de cordeiro, nem de cabra, comereis.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, diciendo: Ningún sebo de buey, ni de cordero, ni de cabra, comeréis.

verses.KJV: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.WEB: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.
verses.ASV: And the fat of that which dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of beasts, may be used for any other service; but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: A gordura de animal morto naturalmente, e a gordura do que foi arrebatado de feras, se preparará para qualquer outro uso, mas não o comereis.
verses.RVR09: El sebo de animal mortecino, y el sebo del que fué arrebatado de fieras, se aparejará para cualquiera otro uso, mas no lo comeréis.

verses.KJV: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.WEB: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ASV: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque qualquer um que comer gordura de animal, do qual se oferece ao SENHOR oferta acesa, a pessoa que o comer, será cortada de seus povos.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquiera que comiere sebo de animal, del cual se ofrece á Jehová ofrenda encendida, la persona que lo comiere, será cortada de sus pueblos.

verses.KJV: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.WEB: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
verses.ASV: And ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of bird or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, nenhum sangue comereis em todas as vossas habitações, tanto de aves como de animais.
verses.RVR09: Además, ninguna sangre comeréis en todas vuestras habitaciones, así de aves como de bestias.

verses.KJV: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.WEB: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
verses.ASV: Whosoever it be that eateth any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um pessoa que comer algum sangue, a tal pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera persona que comiere alguna sangre, la tal persona será cortada de sus pueblos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Habló más Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the Lord shall bring his oblation unto the Lord of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace-offerings unto Jehovah shall bring his oblation unto Jehovah out of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings:
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: O que oferecer sacrifício de suas pazes ao SENHOR, trará sua oferta do sacrifício de suas pazes ao SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, diciendo: El que ofreciere sacrificio de sus paces á Jehová, traerá su ofrenda del sacrificio de sus paces á Jehová;

verses.KJV: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the Lord made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.WEB: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.ASV: his own hands shall bring the offerings of Jehovah made by fire; the fat with the breast shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas mãos trarão as ofertas que se hão de queimar ao SENHOR: trará a gordura com o peito: o peito para que este seja movido, como sacrifício movido diante do SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Sus manos traerán las ofrendas que se han de quemar á Jehová: traerá el sebo con el pecho: el pecho para que éste sea agitado, como sacrificio agitado delante de Jehová;

verses.KJV: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
verses.WEB: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar; but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a gordura a fará arder o sacerdote no altar, mas o peito será de Arão e de seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y el sebo lo hará arder el sacerdote en el altar; mas el pecho será de Aarón y de sus hijos.

verses.KJV: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.WEB: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.ASV: And the right thigh shall ye give unto the priest for a heave-offering out of the sacrifices of your peace-offerings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dareis ao sacerdote para ser elevada em oferta, a coxa direita dos sacrifícios de vossas pazes.
verses.RVR09: Y daréis al sacerdote para ser elevada en ofrenda, la espaldilla derecha de los sacrificios de vuestras paces.

verses.KJV: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
verses.WEB: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
verses.ASV: He among the sons of Aaron that offereth the blood of the peace-offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que dos filhos de Arão oferecer o sangue das ofertas pacíficas, e a gordura, dele será em porção a coxa direita;
verses.RVR09: El que de los hijos de Aarón ofreciere la sangre de las paces, y el sebo, de él será en porción la espaldilla derecha;

verses.KJV: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”
verses.ASV: For the wave-breast and the heave-thigh have I taken of the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace-offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons as [their] portion for ever from the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tomei dos filhos de Israel, dos sacrifícios de suas ofertas pacíficas, o peito que é movido, e a coxa elevada em oferta, e o dei a Arão o sacerdote e a seus filhos, por estatuto perpétuo dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Porque he tomado de los hijos de Israel, de los sacrificios de sus paces, el pecho que se agita, y la espaldilla elevada en ofrenda, y lo he dado á Aarón el sacerdote y á sus hijos, por estatuto perpetuo de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the Lord in the priest's office;
verses.WEB: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest’s office;
verses.ASV: This is the anointing-portion of Aaron, and the anointing-portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto Jehovah in the priest’s office;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é pela unção de Arão e a unção de seus filhos, a parte deles nas ofertas acendidas ao SENHOR, desde o dia que ele os apresentou para serem sacerdotes do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Esta es por la unción de Aarón y la unción de sus hijos, la parte de ellos en las ofrendas encendidas á Jehová, desde el día que él los allegó para ser sacerdotes de Jehová:

verses.KJV: Which the Lord commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
verses.WEB: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.
verses.ASV: which Jehovah commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is [their] portion for ever throughout their generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual mandou o SENHOR que lhes dessem, desde o dia que ele os ungiu dentre os filhos de Israel, por estatuto perpétuo em suas gerações.
verses.RVR09: Lo cual mandó Jehová que les diesen, desde el día que él los ungió de entre los hijos de Israel, por estatuto perpetuo en sus generaciones.

verses.KJV: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.WEB: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings
verses.ASV: This is the law of the burnt-offering, of the meal-offering, and of the sin-offering, and of the trespass-offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of peace-offerings;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a lei do holocausto, da oferta, da expiação pelo pecado, e da culpa, e das consagrações, e do sacrifício pacífico:
verses.RVR09: Esta es la ley del holocausto, del presente, de la expiación por el pecado, y de la culpa, y de las consagraciones, y del sacrificio de las paces:

verses.KJV: Which the Lord commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.WEB: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.ASV: which Jehovah commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual intimou o SENHOR a Moisés, no monte Sinai, no dia que mandou aos filhos de Israel que oferecessem suas ofertas ao SENHOR no deserto de Sinai.
verses.RVR09: La cual intimó Jehová á Moisés, en el monte de Sinaí, el día que mandó á los hijos de Israel que ofreciesen sus ofrendas á Jehová en el desierto de Sinaí.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.WEB: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
verses.ASV: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bullock of the sin-offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma a Arão e a seus filhos com ele, e as vestimentas, e o azeite da unção, e o bezerro da expiação, e os dois carneiros, e o cesto dos pães ázimos;
verses.RVR09: Toma á Aarón y á sus hijos con él, y las vestimentas, y el aceite de la unción, y el becerro de la expiación, y los dos carneros, y el canastillo de los ázimos;

verses.KJV: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”
verses.ASV: and assemble thou all the congregation at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reúne toda a congregação à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y reune toda la congregación á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez, pois, Moisés como o SENHOR lhe mandou, e juntou-se a congregação à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Hizo, pues, Moisés como Jehová le mandó, y juntóse la congregación á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the Lord commanded to be done.
verses.WEB: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded to be done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés à congregação: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á la congregación: Esto es lo que Jehová ha mandado hacer.

verses.KJV: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.WEB: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.ASV: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés fez chegar a Arão e a seus filhos, e lavou-os com água.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés hizo llegar á Aarón y á sus hijos, y lavólos con agua.

verses.KJV: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
verses.WEB: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.
verses.ASV: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs sobre ele a túnica, e cingiu-o com o cinto; vestiu-lhe depois o manto, e pôs sobre ele o éfode, e cingiu-o com o cinto do éfode, e ajustou-o com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y puso sobre él la túnica, y ciñólo con el cinto; vistióle después el manto, y puso sobre él el ephod, y ciñólo con el cinto del ephod, y ajustólo con él.

verses.KJV: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.WEB: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.
verses.ASV: And he placed the breastplate upon him: and in the breastplate he put the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pôs-lhe logo encima o peitoral, e nele pôs o Urim e Tumim.
verses.RVR09: Púsole luego encima el racional, y en él puso el Urim y Thummim.

verses.KJV: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And he set the mitre upon his head; and upon the mitre, in front, did he set the golden plate, the holy crown; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois pôs a mitra sobre sua cabeça; e sobre a mitra em sua frente dianteira pôs a placa de ouro, a coroa santa; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Después puso la mitra sobre su cabeza; y sobre la mitra en su frente delantero puso la plancha de oro, la diadema santa; como Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
verses.WEB: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.
verses.ASV: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Moisés o azeite da unção, e ungiu o tabernáculo, e todas as coisas que estavam nele, e santificou-as.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Moisés el aceite de la unción, y ungió el tabernáculo, y todas las cosas que estaban en él, y santificólas.

verses.KJV: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
verses.WEB: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.
verses.ASV: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the laver and its base, to sanctify them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E espargiu dele sobre o altar sete vezes, e ungiu o altar e todos os seus utensílios, e a pia e sua base, para santificá-los.
verses.RVR09: Y roció de él sobre el altar siete veces, y ungió el altar y todos sus vasos, y la fuente y su basa, para santificarlos.

verses.KJV: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.WEB: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.ASV: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E derramou do azeite da unção sobre a cabeça de Arão, e ungiu-o para santificá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y derramó del aceite de la unción sobre la cabeza de Aarón, y ungiólo para santificarlo.

verses.KJV: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with coats, and girded them with girdles, and bound head-tires upon them; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois Moisés fez chegar os filhos de Arão, e vestiu-lhes as túnicas, e cingiu-os com cintos, e ajustou-lhes as tiaras), como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Después Moisés hizo llegar los hijos de Aarón, y vistióles las túnicas, y ciñólos con cintos, y ajustóles los chapeos (tiaras), como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
verses.WEB: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
verses.ASV: And he brought the bullock of the sin-offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock of the sin-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez logo chegar o bezerro da expiação, e Arão e seus filhos puseram suas mãos sobre a cabeça do bezerro da expiação.
verses.RVR09: Hizo luego llegar el becerro de la expiación, y Aarón y sus hijos pusieron sus manos sobre la cabeza del becerro de la expiación.

verses.KJV: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
verses.WEB: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.
verses.ASV: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E degolou-o; e Moisés tomou o sangue, e pôs com seu dedo sobre as pontas do altar ao redor, e purificou o altar; e lançou o resto do sangue ao pé do altar, e santificou-o para fazer reconciliação sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y degollólo; y Moisés tomó la sangre, y puso con su dedo sobre los cuernos del altar alrededor, y purificó el altar; y echó la demás sangre al pie del altar, y santificólo para reconciliar sobre él.

verses.KJV: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
verses.WEB: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.
verses.ASV: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it upon the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois tomou toda a gordura que estava sobre os intestinos, e o redenho do fígado, e os dois rins, e a gordura deles, e o fez Moisés arder sobre o altar.
verses.RVR09: Después tomó todo el sebo que estaba sobre los intestinos, y el redaño del hígado, y los dos riñones, y el sebo de ellos, é hízolo Moisés arder sobre el altar.

verses.KJV: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: But the bullock, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o bezerro, e seu couro, e sua carne, e seu excremento, queimou-o ao fogo fora do acampamento; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Mas el becerro, y su cuero, y su carne, y su estiércol, quemólo al fuego fuera del real; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.WEB: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.ASV: And he presented the ram of the burnt-offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois fez chegar o carneiro do holocausto, e Arão e seus filhos puseram suas mãos sobre a cabeça do carneiro:
verses.RVR09: Después hizo llegar el carnero del holocausto, y Aarón y sus hijos pusieron sus manos sobre la cabeza del carnero:

verses.KJV: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.WEB: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
verses.ASV: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E degolou-o; e espargiu Moisés o sangue sobre o altar em derredor.
verses.RVR09: Y degollólo; y roció Moisés la sangre sobre el altar en derredor.

verses.KJV: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.WEB: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.ASV: And he cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cortou o carneiro em pedaços; e Moisés fez arder a cabeça, e os pedaços, e a gordura.
verses.RVR09: Y cortó el carnero en trozos; y Moisés hizo arder la cabeza, y los trozos, y el sebo.

verses.KJV: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And he washed the inwards and the legs with water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt-offering for a sweet savor: it was an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lavou logo com água os intestinos e pernas, e queimou Moisés todo o carneiro sobre o altar: holocausto em cheiro suave, oferta acesa ao SENHOR; como o havia o SENHOR mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Lavó luego con agua los intestinos y piernas, y quemó Moisés todo el carnero sobre el altar: holocausto en olor de suavidad, ofrenda encendida á Jehová; como lo había Jehová mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.WEB: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.ASV: And he presented the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois fez chegar o outro carneiro, o carneiro das consagrações, e Arão e seus filhos puseram suas mãos sobre a cabeça do carneiro:
verses.RVR09: Después hizo llegar el otro carnero, el carnero de las consagraciones, y Aarón y sus hijos pusieron sus manos sobre la cabeza del carnero:

verses.KJV: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.WEB: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
verses.ASV: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood thereof, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.ALMEIDA: E degolou-o; e tomou Moisés de seu sangue, e pôs sobre a ponta da orelha direita de Arão, e sobre o dedo polegar de sua mão direita, e sobre o dedo polegar de seu pé direito.
verses.RVR09: Y degollólo; y tomó Moisés de su sangre, y puso sobre la ternilla de la oreja derecha de Aarón, y sobre el dedo pulgar de su mano derecha, y sobre el dedo pulgar de su pie derecho.

verses.KJV: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.WEB: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
verses.ASV: And he brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez chegar logo os filhos de Arão, e pôs Moisés do sangue sobre a ponta de suas orelhas direitas, e sobre os polegares de suas mãos direitas, e sobre os polegares de seus pés direitos: e espargiu Moisés o sangue sobre o altar em derredor;
verses.RVR09: Hizo llegar luego los hijos de Aarón, y puso Moisés de la sangre sobre la ternilla de sus orejas derechas, y sobre los pulgares de sus manos derechas, y sobre los pulgares de sus pies derechos: y roció Moisés la sangre sobre el altar en derredor;

verses.KJV: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
verses.WEB: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;
verses.ASV: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right thigh:
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois tomou a gordura, e a cauda, e toda a gordura que estava sobre os intestinos, e o redenho do fígado, e os dois rins, e a gordura deles, e a coxa direita;
verses.RVR09: Y después tomó el sebo, y la cola, y todo el sebo que estaba sobre los intestinos, y el redaño del hígado, y los dos riñones, y el sebo de ellos, y la espaldilla derecha;

verses.KJV: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the Lord, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
verses.WEB: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.
verses.ASV: and out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before Jehovah, he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat, and upon the right thigh:
verses.ALMEIDA: E do cesto dos pães ázimos, que estava diante do SENHOR, tomou uma torta sem levedura, e uma torta de pão de azeite, e um bolo, e o pôs com a gordura e com a coxa direita;
verses.RVR09: Y del canastillo de los ázimos, que estaba delante de Jehová, tomó una torta sin levadura, y una torta de pan de aceite, y una lasaña, y púsolo con el sebo y con la espaldilla derecha;

verses.KJV: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.WEB: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.ASV: and he put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and waved them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o pôs tudo nas mãos de Arão, e nas mãos de seus filhos, e o fez mover: oferta agitada diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y púsolo todo en las manos de Aarón, y en las manos de sus hijos, é hízolo mecer: ofrenda agitada delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt-offering: they were a consecration for a sweet savor: it was an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois tomou aquelas coisas Moisés das mãos deles, e as fez arder no altar sobre o holocausto: as consagrações em cheiro suave, oferta acesa ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Después tomó aquellas cosas Moisés de las manos de ellos, é hízolas arder en el altar sobre el holocausto: las consagraciones en olor de suavidad, ofrenda encendida á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the Lord: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: it was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Moisés o peito, e moveu-o, oferta movida diante do SENHOR: do carneiro das consagrações aquela foi a parte de Moisés; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Moisés el pecho, y meciólo, ofrenda agitada delante de Jehová: del carnero de las consagraciones aquélla fué la parte de Moisés; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.WEB: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.ASV: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo tomou Moisés do azeite da unção, e do sangue que estava sobre o altar, e espargiu sobre Arão, e sobre suas vestiduras, sobre seus filhos, e sobre as vestiduras de seus filhos com ele; e santificou a Arão, e suas vestiduras, e a seus filhos, e as vestiduras de seus filhos com ele.
verses.RVR09: Luego tomó Moisés del aceite de la unción, y de la sangre que estaba sobre el altar, y roció sobre Aarón, y sobre sus vestiduras, sobre sus hijos, y sobre las vestiduras de sus hijos con él; y santificó á Aarón, y sus vestiduras, y á sus hijos, y las vestiduras de sus hijos con él.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.WEB: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tent of meeting: and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés a Arão e a seus filhos: Comei a carne à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho; e comei-a ali com o pão que está no cesto das consagrações, segundo eu mandei, dizendo: Arão e seus filhos a comerão.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Aarón y á sus hijos: Comed la carne á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio; y comedla allí con el pan que está en el canastillo de las consagraciones, según yo he mandado, diciendo: Aarón y sus hijos la comerán.

verses.KJV: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.WEB: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
verses.ASV: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que sobrar da carne e do pão, queimareis ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y lo que sobrare de la carne y del pan, habéis de quemarlo al fuego.

verses.KJV: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
verses.WEB: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.
verses.ASV: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting seven days, until the days of your consecration be fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho não saireis em sete dias, até o dia que se cumprirem os dias de vossas consagrações: porque por sete dias sereis consagrados.
verses.RVR09: De la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio no saldréis en siete días, hasta el día que se cumplieren los días de vuestras consagraciones: porque por siete días seréis consagrados.

verses.KJV: As he hath done this day, so the Lord hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
verses.WEB: What has been done today, so the LORD has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
verses.ASV: As hath been done this day, so Jehovah hath commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da maneira que hoje se fez, mandou fazer o SENHOR para expiar-vos.
verses.RVR09: De la manera que hoy se ha hecho, mandó hacer Jehová para expiaros.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the Lord, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.WEB: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep the LORD’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”
verses.ASV: And at the door of the tent of meeting shall ye abide day and night seven days, and keep the charge of Jehovah, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: À porta, pois, do tabernáculo do testemunho estareis dia e noite por sete dias, e guardareis a ordenança diante do SENHOR, para que não morrais; porque assim me foi mandado.
verses.RVR09: A la puerta, pues, del tabernáculo del testimonio estaréis día y noche por siete días, y guardaréis la ordenanza delante de Jehová, para que no muráis; porque así me ha sido mandado.

verses.KJV: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by Moses.
verses.ASV: And Aaron and his sons did all the things which Jehovah commanded by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Arão e seus filhos fizeram todas as coisas que mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y Aarón y sus hijos hicieron todas las cosas que mandó Jehová por medio de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
verses.WEB: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi no dia oitavo, que Moisés chamou a Arão e a seus filhos, e aos anciãos de Israel;
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ en el día octavo, que Moisés llamó á Aarón y á sus hijos, y á los ancianos de Israel;

verses.KJV: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the Lord.
verses.WEB: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before the LORD.
verses.ASV: and he said unto Aaron, Take thee a calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering, without blemish, and offer them before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a Arão: Toma das vacas um bezerro para expiação, e um carneiro para holocausto, sem defeito, e oferece-os diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á Aarón: Toma de la vacada un becerro para expiación, y un carnero para holocausto, sin defecto, y ofrécelos delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
verses.WEB: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;
verses.ASV: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a he-goat for a sin-offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt-offering;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos filhos de Israel falarás, dizendo: Tomai um bode macho para expiação, e um bezerro e um cordeiro de ano, sem mácula, para holocausto;
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de Israel hablarás, diciendo: Tomad un macho cabrío para expiación, y un becerro y un cordero de un año, sin tacha, para holocausto;

verses.KJV: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the Lord will appear unto you.
verses.WEB: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today the LORD appears to you.’”
verses.ASV: and an ox and a ram for peace-offerings, to sacrifice before Jehovah; and a meal-offering mingled with oil: for to-day Jehovah appeareth unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também um boi e um carneiro para sacrifício pacífico, que imoleis diante do SENHOR; e uma oferta de cereais amassada com azeite: porque o SENHOR se aparecerá hoje a vós.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo un buey y un carnero para sacrificio de paces, que inmoléis delante de Jehová; y un presente amasado con aceite: porque Jehová se aparecerá hoy á vosotros.

verses.KJV: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the Lord.
verses.WEB: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tent of meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levaram o que mandou Moisés diante do tabernáculo do testemunho, e chegou-se toda a congregação, e puseram-se diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y llevaron lo que mandó Moisés delante del tabernáculo del testimonio, y llegóse toda la congregación, y pusiéronse delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the Lord shall appear unto you.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do; and the LORD’s glory shall appear to you.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded that ye should do: and the glory of Jehovah shall appear unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés disse: Isto é o que mandou o SENHOR; fazei-o, e a glória do SENHOR se vos aparecerá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés dijo: Esto es lo que mandó Jehová; hacedlo, y la gloria de Jehová se os aparecerá.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the Lord commanded.
verses.WEB: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Draw near unto the altar, and offer thy sin-offering, and thy burnt-offering, and make atonement for thyself, and for the people; and offer the oblation of the people, and make atonement for them; as Jehovah commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés a Arão: Achega-te ao altar, e faze tua expiação, e teu holocausto, e faze a reconciliação por ti e pelo povo: faze também a oferta do povo, e faze a reconciliação por eles; como mandou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Aarón: Llégate al altar, y haz tu expiación, y tu holocausto, y haz la reconciliación por ti y por el pueblo: haz también la ofrenda del pueblo, y haz la reconciliación por ellos; como ha mandado Jehová.

verses.KJV: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
verses.WEB: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
verses.ASV: So Aaron drew near unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin-offering, which was for himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então chegou-se Arão ao altar; e degolou seu bezerro da expiação que era por ele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces llegóse Aarón al altar; y degolló su becerro de la expiación que era por él.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
verses.WEB: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;
verses.ASV: And the sons of Aaron presented the blood unto him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Arão lhe trouxeram o sangue; e ele molhou seu dedo no sangue, e pôs sobre as pontas do altar, e derramou o resto do sangue ao pé do altar;
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Aarón le trajeron la sangre; y él mojó su dedo en la sangre, y puso sobre los cuernos del altar, y derramó la demás sangre al pie del altar;

verses.KJV: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul from the liver of the sin-offering, he burnt upon the altar; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a gordura e rins e redenho do fígado, da expiação, os fez arder sobre o altar; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y el sebo y riñones y redaño del hígado, de la expiación, hízolos arder sobre el altar; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.WEB: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
verses.ASV: And the flesh and the skin he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a carne e o couro os queimou ao fogo fora do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Mas la carne y el cuero los quemó al fuego fuera del real.

verses.KJV: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
verses.WEB: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
verses.ASV: And he slew the burnt-offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered unto him the blood, and he sprinkled it upon the altar round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Degolou também o holocausto, e os filhos de Arão lhe apresentaram o sangue, a qual espargiu ele ao redor sobre o altar.
verses.RVR09: Degolló asimismo el holocausto, y los hijos de Aarón le presentaron la sangre, la cual roció él alrededor sobre el altar.

verses.KJV: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
verses.WEB: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.
verses.ASV: And they delivered the burnt-offering unto him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apresentaram-lhe depois o holocausto, em pedaços, e a cabeça; e os fez queimar sobre o altar.
verses.RVR09: Presentáronle después el holocausto, á trozos, y la cabeza; é hízolos quemar sobre el altar.

verses.KJV: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.WEB: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.ASV: And he washed the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt-offering on the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo lavou os intestinos e as pernas, e queimou-os sobre o holocausto no altar.
verses.RVR09: Luego lavó los intestinos y las piernas, y quemólos sobre el holocausto en el altar.

verses.KJV: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.WEB: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.
verses.ASV: And he presented the people’s oblation, and took the goat of the sin-offering which was for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ofereceu também a oferta do povo, e tomou o bode macho que era para a expiação do povo, e degolou-o, e o ofereceu pelo pecado como o primeiro.
verses.RVR09: Ofreció también la ofrenda del pueblo, y tomó el macho cabrío que era para la expiación del pueblo, y degollólo, y lo ofreció por el pecado como el primero.

verses.KJV: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
verses.WEB: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
verses.ASV: And he presented the burnt-offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ofereceu o holocausto, e fez segundo o rito.
verses.RVR09: Y ofreció el holocausto, é hizo según el rito.

verses.KJV: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.WEB: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.
verses.ASV: And he presented the meal-offering, and filled his hand therefrom, and burnt it upon the altar, besides the burnt-offering of the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ofereceu também a oferta de cereais, e encheu dela sua mão, e o fez queimar sobre o altar, também do holocausto da manhã.
verses.RVR09: Ofreció asimismo el presente, é hinchió de él su mano, y lo hizo quemar sobre el altar, además del holocausto de la mañana.

verses.KJV: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
verses.WEB: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;
verses.ASV: He slew also the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
verses.ALMEIDA: Degolou também o boi e o carneiro em sacrifício pacífico, que era do povo: e os filhos de Arão lhe apresentaram o sangue (o qual espargiu ele sobre o altar ao redor),
verses.RVR09: Degolló también el buey y el carnero en sacrificio de paces, que era del pueblo: y los hijos de Aarón le presentaron la sangre (la cual roció él sobre el altar alrededor),

verses.KJV: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
verses.WEB: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;
verses.ASV: and the fat of the ox and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covereth [the inwards], and the kidneys, and the caul of the liver:
verses.ALMEIDA: E a gordura do boi; e do carneiro a cauda com o que cobre as entranhas, e os rins, e o redenho do fígado:
verses.RVR09: Y los sebos del buey; y del carnero la cola con lo que cubre las entrañas, y los riñones, y el redaño del hígado:

verses.KJV: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.WEB: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.
verses.ASV: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram a gordura sobre os peitos, e ele queimou a gordura sobre o altar:
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron los sebos sobre los pechos, y él quemó los sebos sobre el altar:

verses.KJV: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the Lord; as Moses commanded.
verses.WEB: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.
verses.ASV: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave-offering before Jehovah; as Moses commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os peitos, com a coxa direita, moveu-os Arão por oferta movida diante do SENHOR; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Empero los pechos, con la espaldilla derecha, meciólos Aarón por ofrenda agitada delante de Jehová; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
verses.WEB: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
verses.ASV: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin-offering, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offerings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois levantou Arão suas mãos até o povo e abençoou-os: e desceu de fazer a expiação, e o holocausto, e o sacrifício pacífico.
verses.RVR09: Después alzó Aarón sus manos hacia el pueblo y bendíjolos: y descendió de hacer la expiación, y el holocausto, y el sacrificio de las paces.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the people.
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and the LORD’s glory appeared to all the people.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entraram Moisés e Arão no tabernáculo do testemunho; e saíram, e bendisseram ao povo: e a glória do SENHOR se apareceu a todo o povo.
verses.RVR09: Y entraron Moisés y Aarón en el tabernáculo del testimonio; y salieron, y bendijeron al pueblo: y la gloria de Jehová se apareció á todo el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And there came a fire out from before the Lord, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.WEB: Fire came out from before the LORD, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.ASV: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and consumed upon the altar the burnt-offering and the fat: and when all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu fogo de diante do SENHOR, e consumiu o holocausto e a gordura sobre o altar; e vendo-o todo o povo, louvaram, e caíram sobre seus rostos.
verses.RVR09: Y salió fuego de delante de Jehová, y consumió el holocausto y los sebos sobre el altar; y viéndolo todo el pueblo, alabaron, y cayeron sobre sus rostros.

verses.KJV: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not.
verses.WEB: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he had not commanded them.
verses.ASV: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took each of them his censer, and put fire therein, and laid incense thereon, and offered strange fire before Jehovah, which he had not commanded them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Arão, Nadabe e Abiú, tomaram cada um seu incensário, e puseram fogo neles, sobre o qual puseram incenso, e ofereceram diante do SENHOR fogo estranho, que ele nunca lhes mandou.
verses.RVR09: Y LOS hijos de Aarón, Nadab y Abiú, tomaron cada uno su incensario, y pusieron fuego en ellos, sobre el cual pusieron perfume, y ofrecieron delante de Jehová fuego extraño, que él nunca les mandó.
