verses.KJV: And there went out fire from the Lord, and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Fire came out from before the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and devoured them, and they died before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu fogo de diante do SENHOR que os queimou, e morreram diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y salió fuego de delante de Jehová que los quemó, y murieron delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the Lord spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
verses.WEB: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.
verses.ASV: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that Jehovah spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Moisés a Arão: Isto é o que falou o SENHOR, dizendo: Em meus achegados me santificarei, e em presença de todo o povo serei glorificado. E Arão calou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Moisés á Aarón: Esto es lo que habló Jehová, diciendo: En mis allegados me santificaré, y en presencia de todo el pueblo seré glorificado. Y Aarón calló.

verses.KJV: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
verses.WEB: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”
verses.ASV: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Draw near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Moisés a Misael, e a Elzafã, filhos de Uziel, tio de Arão, e disse-lhes: Achegai-vos e tirai a vossos irmãos de diante do santuário fora do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Moisés á Misael, y á Elzaphán, hijos de Uzziel, tío de Aarón, y díjoles: Llegaos y sacad á vuestros hermanos de delante del santuario fuera del campo.

verses.KJV: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
verses.WEB: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.
verses.ASV: So they drew near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles chegaram, e tiraram-nos com suas túnicas fora do acampamento, como disse Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos llegaron, y sacáronlos con sus túnicas fuera del campo, como dijo Moisés.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord hath kindled.
verses.WEB: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled.
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Let not the hair of your heads go loose, neither rend your clothes; that ye die not, and that he be not wroth with all the congregation: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Jehovah hath kindled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés disse a Arão, e a Eleazar e a Itamar, seus filhos: Não descubrais vossas cabeças, nem rasgueis vossas roupas, para que não morrais, nem se levante a ira sobre toda a congregação: porém vossos irmãos, toda a casa de Israel, lamentarão o incêndio que o SENHOR fez.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés dijo á Aarón, y á Eleazar y á Ithamar, sus hijos: No descubráis vuestras cabezas, ni rasguéis vuestros vestidos, porque no muráis, ni se levante la ira sobre toda la congregación: empero vuestros hermanos, toda la casa de Israel, lamentarán el incendio que Jehová ha hecho.

verses.KJV: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.WEB: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of the LORD is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.
verses.ASV: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting, lest ye die; for the anointing oil of Jehovah is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem saireis da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, porque morrereis; porquanto o azeite da unção do SENHOR está sobre vós. E eles fizeram conforme o dito de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Ni saldréis de la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, porque moriréis; por cuanto el aceite de la unción de Jehová está sobre vosotros. Y ellos hicieron conforme al dicho de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD said to Aaron,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Aaron, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Arão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Aarón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
verses.WEB: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
verses.ASV: Drink no wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tent of meeting, that ye die not: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, e teus filhos contigo, não bebereis vinho nem bebida forte, quando houverdes de entrar no tabernáculo do testemunho, para que não morrais: estatuto perpétuo por vossas gerações;
verses.RVR09: Tú, y tus hijos contigo, no beberéis vino ni sidra, cuando hubiereis de entrar en el tabernáculo del testimonio, porque no muráis: estatuto perpetuo por vuestras generaciones;

verses.KJV: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
verses.WEB: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.
verses.ASV: and that ye may make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean;
verses.ALMEIDA: E para poder discernir entre o santo e o profano, e entre o impuro e o limpo;
verses.RVR09: Y para poder discernir entre lo santo y lo profano, y entre lo inmundo y lo limpio;

verses.KJV: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the Lord hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by Moses.”
verses.ASV: and that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Jehovah hath spoken unto them by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para ensinar aos filhos de Israel todos os estatutos que o SENHOR lhes disse por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y para enseñar á los hijos de Israel todos los estatutos que Jehová les ha dicho por medio de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
verses.WEB: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;
verses.ASV: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meal-offering that remaineth of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar; for it is most holy;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés disse a Arão, e a Eleazar e a Itamar, seus filhos que haviam restado: Tomai a oferta de cereais que resta das ofertas acendidas ao SENHOR, e comei-a sem levedura junto ao altar, porque é coisa muito santa.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés dijo á Aarón, y á Eleazar y á Ithamar, sus hijos que habían quedado: Tomad el presente que queda de las ofrendas encendidas á Jehová, y comedlo sin levadura junto al altar, porque es cosa muy santa.

verses.KJV: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the Lord made by fire: for so I am commanded.
verses.WEB: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of the LORD made by fire; for so I am commanded.
verses.ASV: and ye shall eat it in a holy place, because it is thy portion, and thy sons’ portion, of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: for so I am commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haveis, pois, de comê-la no lugar santo: porque isto é estatuto para ti, e estatuto para teus filhos, das ofertas acendidas ao SENHOR, pois que assim me foi mandado.
verses.RVR09: Habéis, pues, de comerlo en el lugar santo: porque esto es fuero para ti, y fuero para tus hijos, de las ofrendas encendidas á Jehová, pues que así me ha sido mandado.

verses.KJV: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And the wave-breast and the heave-thigh shall ye eat in a clean place, thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they are given as thy portion, and thy sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace-offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Comereis também em lugar limpo, tu e teus filhos e tuas filhas contigo, o peito da oferta movida, e a coxa elevada, porque por estatuto para ti, e estatuto para teus filhos, são dados dos sacrifícios das ofertas pacíficas dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Comeréis asimismo en lugar limpio, tú y tus hijos y tus hijas contigo, el pecho de la mecida, y la espaldilla elevada, porque por fuero para ti, y fuero para tus hijos, son dados de los sacrificios de las paces de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the Lord; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the Lord hath commanded.
verses.WEB: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as the LORD has commanded.”
verses.ASV: The heave-thigh and the wave-breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, as a portion for ever; as Jehovah hath commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com as ofertas das gorduras que se hão de acender, trarão a coxa que se há de elevar, e o peito que será movido, para que o movas por oferta movida diante do SENHOR: e será por estatuto perpétuo teu, e de teus filhos contigo, como o SENHOR o mandou.
verses.RVR09: Con las ofrendas de los sebos que se han de encender, traerán la espaldilla que se ha de elevar, y el pecho que será mecido, para que lo mezas por ofrenda agitada delante de Jehová: y será por fuero perpetuo tuyo, y de tus hijos contigo, como Jehová lo ha mandado.

verses.KJV: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
verses.WEB: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,
verses.ASV: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin-offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron that were left, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés mandou o bode macho da expiação, e achou-se que era queimado: e irou-se contra Eleazar e Itamar, os filhos de Arão que haviam restado, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés demandó el macho cabrío de la expiación, y hallóse que era quemado: y enojóse contra Eleazar é Ithamar, los hijos de Aarón que habían quedado, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord?
verses.WEB: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
verses.ASV: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin-offering in the place of the sanctuary, seeing it is most holy, and he hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que não comestes a expiação no lugar santo? Porque é muito santa, e deu-a ele a vós para levar a iniquidade da congregação, para que sejam reconciliados diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué no comisteis la expiación en el lugar santo? porque es muy santa, y dióla él á vosotros para llevar la iniquidad de la congregación, para que sean reconciliados delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
verses.WEB: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”
verses.ASV: Behold, the blood of it was not brought into the sanctuary within: ye should certainly have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vedes que seu sangue não foi metido dentro do santuário: havíeis de comê-la no lugar santo, como eu mandei.
verses.RVR09: Veis que su sangre no fué metida dentro del santuario: habíais de comerla en el lugar santo, como yo mandé.

verses.KJV: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the Lord?
verses.WEB: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the LORD’s sight?”
verses.ASV: And Aaron spake unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin-offering and their burnt-offering before Jehovah; and there have befallen me such things as these: and if I had eaten the sin-offering to-day, would it have been well-pleasing in the sight of Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Arão a Moisés: Eis que hoje ofereceram sua expiação e seu holocausto diante do SENHOR: mas me aconteceram estas coisas: pois se comesse eu hoje da expiação, Teria sido aceito ao SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Aarón á Moisés: He aquí hoy han ofrecido su expiación y su holocausto delante de Jehová: pero me han acontecido estas cosas: pues si comiera yo hoy de la expiación, ¿hubiera sido acepto á Jehová?

verses.KJV: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
verses.WEB: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.
verses.ASV: And when Moses heard [that], it was well-pleasing in his sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Moisés ouviu isto, deu-se por satisfeito.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Moisés oyó esto, dióse por satisfecho.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo-lhes:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés y á Aarón, diciéndoles:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the living things which ye may eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Falai aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Estes são os animais que comereis de todos os animais que estão sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Hablad á los hijos de Israel, diciendo: Estos son los animales que comeréis de todos los animales que están sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
verses.WEB: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.
verses.ASV: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, [and] cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that may ye eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: De entre os animais, todo o de casco, e que tem as unhas fendidas, e que rumina, este comereis.
verses.RVR09: De entre los animales, todo el de pezuña, y que tiene las pezuñas hendidas, y que rumia, éste comeréis.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.WEB: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that part the hoof: the camel, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, porém, não comereis dos que ruminam e dos que têm casco: o camelo, porque rumina mas não tem casco fendido, haveis de tê-lo por impuro;
verses.RVR09: Estos empero no comeréis de los que rumian, y de los que tienen pezuña: el camello, porque rumia mas no tiene pezuña hendida, habéis de tenerlo por inmundo;

verses.KJV: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.WEB: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
verses.ASV: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o coelho, porque rumina, mas não tem unha fendida, o tereis por impuro;
verses.RVR09: También el conejo, porque rumia, mas no tiene pezuña, tendréislo por inmundo;

verses.KJV: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.WEB: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
verses.ASV: And the hare, because she cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, she is unclean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim a lebre, porque rumina, mas não tem unha fendida, a tereis por impura;
verses.RVR09: Asimismo la liebre, porque rumia, mas no tiene pezuña, tendréisla por inmunda;

verses.KJV: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
verses.WEB: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.
verses.ASV: And the swine, because he parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, but cheweth not the cud, he is unclean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o porco, porque tem unhas, e é de unhas fendidas, mas não rumina, o tereis por impuro.
verses.RVR09: También el puerco, porque tiene pezuñas, y es de pezuñas hendidas, mas no rumia, tendréislo por inmundo.

verses.KJV: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
verses.WEB: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.
verses.ASV: Of their flesh ye shall not eat, and their carcasses ye shall not touch; they are unclean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da carne deles não comereis, nem tocareis seu corpo morto: os tereis por impuros.
verses.RVR09: De la carne de ellos no comeréis, ni tocaréis su cuerpo muerto: tendréislos por inmundos.

verses.KJV: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
verses.WEB: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.
verses.ASV: These may ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that may ye eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto comereis de todas as coisas que estão nas águas: todas as coisas que têm barbatanas e escamas nas águas do mar, e nos rios, aquelas comereis;
verses.RVR09: Esto comeréis de todas las cosas que están en las aguas: todas las cosas que tienen aletas y escamas en las aguas de la mar, y en los ríos, aquellas comeréis;

verses.KJV: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
verses.WEB: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,
verses.ASV: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination unto you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas todas as coisas que não têm barbatanas nem escamas no mar e nos rios, tanto de todo réptil de água como de toda coisa vivente que está nas águas, as tereis em abominação.
verses.RVR09: Mas todas las cosas que no tienen aletas ni escamas en la mar y en los ríos, así de todo reptil de agua como de toda cosa viviente que está en las aguas, las tendréis en abominación.

verses.KJV: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
verses.WEB: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.
verses.ASV: and they shall be an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, and their carcasses ye shall have in abomination.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vos serão, pois, em abominação: de sua carne não comereis, e abominareis seus corpos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Os serán, pues, en abominación: de su carne no comeréis, y abominaréis sus cuerpos muertos.

verses.KJV: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.WEB: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.
verses.ASV: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that is an abomination unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo o que não tiver barbatanas e escamas nas águas, o tereis em abominação.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que no tuviere aletas y escamas en las aguas, tendréislo en abominación.

verses.KJV: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.WEB: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,
verses.ASV: And these ye shall have in abomination among the birds; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the gier-eagle, and the ospray,
verses.ALMEIDA: E das aves, estas tereis em abominação; não se comerão, serão abominação: a água, o quebra-ossos, o esmerilhão,
verses.RVR09: Y de las aves, éstas tendréis en abominación; no se comerán, serán abominación: el águila, el quebrantahuesos, el esmerejón,

verses.KJV: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
verses.WEB: the red kite, any kind of black kite,
verses.ASV: and the kite, and the falcon after its kind,
verses.ALMEIDA: O milhafre, e o falcão a segundo sua espécie;
verses.RVR09: El milano, y el buitre según su especie;

verses.KJV: Every raven after his kind;
verses.WEB: any kind of raven,
verses.ASV: every raven after its kind,
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo corvo segundo sua espécie;
verses.RVR09: Todo cuervo según su especie;

verses.KJV: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.WEB: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
verses.ASV: and the ostrich, and the night-hawk, and the sea-mew, and the hawk after its kind,
verses.ALMEIDA: O avestruz, e a coruja, e a gaivota, e o gavião segundo sua espécie;
verses.RVR09: El avestruz, y la lechuza, y el laro, y el gavilán según su especie,

verses.KJV: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
verses.WEB: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
verses.ASV: and the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o mocho, e o corvo-marinho, e o íbis,
verses.RVR09: Y el buho, y el somormujo, y el ibis,

verses.KJV: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
verses.WEB: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,
verses.ASV: and the horned owl, and the pelican, and the vulture,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a galinha-d'água, e o cisne, e o pelicano,
verses.RVR09: Y el calamón, y el cisne, y el onocrótalo,

verses.KJV: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.WEB: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.ASV: and the stork, the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cegonha, e a garça, segundo sua espécie, e a poupa, e o morcego.
verses.RVR09: Y el herodión, y el caradrión, según su especie, y la abubilla, y el murciélago.

verses.KJV: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.WEB: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
verses.ASV: All winged creeping things that go upon all fours are an abomination unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo inseto de asas que andar sobre quatro pés, tereis em abominação.
verses.RVR09: Todo reptil alado que anduviere sobre cuatro pies, tendréis en abominación.

verses.KJV: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
verses.WEB: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.
verses.ASV: Yet these may ye eat of all winged creeping things that go upon all fours, which have legs above their feet, wherewith to leap upon the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém isto comereis de todo inseto de asas que anda sobre quatro patas, que tiver pernas além de suas patas para saltar com elas sobre a terra;
verses.RVR09: Empero esto comeréis de todo reptil alado que anda sobre cuatro pies, que tuviere piernas además de sus pies para saltar con ellas sobre la tierra;

verses.KJV: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
verses.WEB: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.
verses.ASV: even these of them ye may eat: the locust after its kind, and the bald locust after its kind, and the cricket after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes comereis deles: o gafanhoto migrador segundo sua espécie, e a esperança segundo sua espécie, e o grilo segundo sua espécie, e o gafanhoto comum segundo sua espécie.
verses.RVR09: Estos comeréis de ellos: la langosta según su especie, y el langostín según su especie, y el aregol según su especie, y el haghab según su especie.

verses.KJV: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.WEB: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.
verses.ASV: But all winged creeping things, which have four feet, are an abomination unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo réptil de asas que tenha quatro pés, tereis em abominação.
verses.RVR09: Todo reptil alado que tenga cuatro pies, tendréis en abominación.

verses.KJV: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And by these ye shall become unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcass of them shall be unclean until the even;
verses.ALMEIDA: E por estas coisas sereis impuros: qualquer um que tocar a seus corpos mortos, será impuro até à tarde:
verses.RVR09: Y por estas cosas seréis inmundos: cualquiera que tocare á sus cuerpos muertos, será inmundo hasta la tarde:

verses.KJV: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: and whosoever beareth [aught] of the carcass of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer um que levar de seus corpos mortos, lavará suas roupas, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que llevare de sus cuerpos muertos, lavará sus vestidos, y será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
verses.WEB: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.
verses.ASV: Every beast which parteth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, is unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo animal de casco, mas que não tem unha fendida, nem rumina, tereis por impuro: qualquer um que os tocar será impuro.
verses.RVR09: Todo animal de pezuña, pero que no tiene pezuña hendida, ni rumia, tendréis por inmundo: cualquiera que los tocare será inmundo.

verses.KJV: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And whatsoever goeth upon its paws, among all beasts that go on all fours, they are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcass shall be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de todos os animais que andam a quatro patas, tereis por impuro qualquer um que ande sobre suas garras: qualquer um que tocar seus corpos mortos, será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y de todos los animales que andan á cuatro pies, tendréis por inmundo cualquiera que ande sobre sus garras: cualquiera que tocare sus cuerpos muertos, será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
verses.WEB: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.
verses.ASV: And he that beareth the carcass of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que levar seus corpos mortos, lavará suas roupas, e será impuro até à tarde: haveis de tê-los por impuros.
verses.RVR09: Y el que llevare sus cuerpos muertos, lavará sus vestidos, y será inmundo hasta la tarde: habéis de tenerlos por inmundos.

verses.KJV: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
verses.WEB: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,
verses.ASV: And these are they which are unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth: the weasel, and the mouse, and the great lizard after its kind,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes tereis por impuros dos répteis que vão arrastando sobre a terra: a doninha, e o rato, e o lagarto segundo sua espécie,
verses.RVR09: Y estos tendréis por inmundos de los reptiles que van arrastrando sobre la tierra: la comadreja, y el ratón, y la rana según su especie,

verses.KJV: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
verses.WEB: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.
verses.ASV: and the gecko, and the land-crocodile, and the lizard, and the sand-lizard, and the chameleon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a lagartixa, e o lagarto pintado, e a lagartixa de parede, e a salamandra, e o camaleão.
verses.RVR09: Y el erizo, y el lagarto, y el caracol, y la babosa, y el topo.

verses.KJV: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they are dead, shall be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes tereis por impuros de todos os répteis: qualquer um que os tocar, quando estiverem mortos, será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Estos tendréis por inmundos de todos los reptiles: cualquiera que los tocare, cuando estuvieren muertos, será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
verses.WEB: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.
verses.ASV: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherewith any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; then shall it be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo aquilo sobre que cair algum deles depois de mortos, será impuro; tanto vaso de madeira, como roupa, ou pele, ou saco, qualquer instrumento com que se faz obra, será posto em água, e será impuro até à tarde, e assim será limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y todo aquello sobre que cayere alguno de ellos después de muertos, será inmundo; así vaso de madera, como vestido, ó piel, ó saco, cualquier instrumento con que se hace obra, será metido en agua, y será inmundo hasta la tarde, y así será limpio.

verses.KJV: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
verses.WEB: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.
verses.ASV: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean, and it ye shall break.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda vasilha de barro dentro da qual cair algum deles, tudo o que estiver nela será impuro, e quebrareis a vasilha:
verses.RVR09: Y toda vasija de barro dentro de la cual cayere alguno de ellos, todo lo que estuviere en ella será inmundo, y quebraréis la vasija:

verses.KJV: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
verses.WEB: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
verses.ASV: All food [therein] which may be eaten, that on which water cometh, shall be unclean; and all drink that may be drunk in every [such] vessel shall be unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda comida que se come, sobre a qual vier a água de tais vasilhas, será imunda: e toda bebida que se beber, será em todas essas vasilhas impura:
verses.RVR09: Toda vianda que se come, sobre la cual viniere el agua de tales vasijas, será inmunda: y toda bebida que se bebiere, será en todas esas vasijas inmunda:

verses.KJV: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean and shall be unclean unto you.
verses.WEB: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.
verses.ASV: And every thing whereupon [any part] of their carcass falleth shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces: they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo aquilo sobre que cair algo do corpo morto deles, será impuro: o forno ou aquecedores se derrubarão; são impuros, e por impuros os tereis.
verses.RVR09: Y todo aquello sobre que cayere algo del cuerpo muerto de ellos, será inmundo: el horno ú hornillos se derribarán; son inmundos, y por inmundos los tendréis.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless a fountain or a pit wherein is a gathering of water shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcass shall be unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo, a fonte e a cisterna onde se recolhem águas, serão limpas: mas o que houver tocado em seus corpos mortos será impuro.
verses.RVR09: Con todo, la fuente y la cisterna donde se recogen aguas, serán limpias: mas lo que hubiere tocado en sus cuerpos muertos será inmundo.

verses.KJV: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
verses.WEB: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
verses.ASV: And if [aught] of their carcass fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se cair de seus corpos mortos sobre alguma semente que se haja de semear, será limpa.
verses.RVR09: Y si cayere de sus cuerpos muertos sobre alguna simiente que se haya de sembrar, será limpia.

verses.KJV: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
verses.WEB: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.
verses.ASV: But if water be put upon the seed, and [aught] of their carcass fall thereon, it is unclean unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se se houver posto água na semente, e cair de seus corpos mortos sobre ela, a tereis por impura.
verses.RVR09: Mas si se hubiere puesto agua en la simiente, y cayere de sus cuerpos muertos sobre ella, tendréisla por inmunda.

verses.KJV: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcass thereof shall be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se algum animal que tiverdes para comer se morrer, o que tocar seu corpo morto será impuro até à tarde:
verses.RVR09: Y si algún animal que tuviereis para comer se muriere, el que tocare su cuerpo muerto será inmundo hasta la tarde:

verses.KJV: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And he that eateth of the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que comer de seu corpo morto, lavará suas roupas, e será impuro até à tarde: também o que tirar seu corpo morto, lavará suas roupas, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y el que comiere de su cuerpo muerto, lavará sus vestidos, y será inmundo hasta la tarde: asimismo el que sacare su cuerpo muerto, lavará sus vestidos, y será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
verses.WEB: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
verses.ASV: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth is an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo réptil que vai arrastando sobre a terra, é abominação; não se comerá.
verses.RVR09: Y todo reptil que va arrastrando sobre la tierra, es abominación; no se comerá.

verses.KJV: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
verses.WEB: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
verses.ASV: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all fours, or whatsoever hath many feet, even all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo o que anda sobre o peito, e tudo o que anda sobre quatro ou mais patas, de todo réptil que anda arrastando sobre a terra, não o comereis, porque é abominação.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que anda sobre el pecho, y todo lo que anda sobre cuatro ó más pies, de todo reptil que anda arrastrando sobre la tierra, no lo comeréis, porque es abominación.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
verses.WEB: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não torneis abomináveis vossas pessoas com nenhum réptil que anda arrastando, nem vos contamineis com eles, nem sejais impuros por eles.
verses.RVR09: No ensuciéis vuestras personas con ningún reptil que anda arrastrando, ni os contaminéis con ellos, ni seáis inmundos por ellos.

verses.KJV: For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.WEB: For I am the LORD your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.
verses.ASV: For I am Jehovah your God: sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, vós portanto vos santificareis, e sereis santos, porque eu sou santo: assim que não torneis abomináveis vossas pessoas com nenhum réptil que andar arrastando sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Pues que yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios, vosotros por tanto os santificaréis, y seréis santos, porque yo soy santo: así que no ensuciéis vuestras personas con ningún reptil que anduviere arrastrando sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: For I am the Lord that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
verses.WEB: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
verses.ASV: For I am Jehovah that brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sou o SENHOR, que vos faço subir da terra do Egito para vos ser por Deus: sereis pois santos, porque eu sou santo.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo soy Jehová, que os hago subir de la tierra de Egipto para seros por Dios: seréis pues santos, porque yo soy santo.

verses.KJV: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
verses.WEB: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,
verses.ASV: This is the law of the beast, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a lei dos animais e das aves, e de todo ser vivente que se move nas águas, e de todo animal que anda arrastando sobre a terra;
verses.RVR09: Esta es la ley de los animales y de las aves, y de todo ser viviente que se mueve en las aguas, y de todo animal que anda arrastrando sobre la tierra;

verses.KJV: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
verses.WEB: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”
verses.ASV: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para fazer diferença entre impuro e limpo, e entre os animais que se podem comer e os animais que não se podem comer.
verses.RVR09: Para hacer diferencia entre inmundo y limpio, y entre los animales que se pueden comer y los animales que no se pueden comer.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman conceive seed, and bear a man-child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of the impurity of her sickness shall she be unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: A mulher quando conceber e der à luz macho, será impura sete dias; conforme os dias que está separada por sua menstruação, será impura.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, diciendo: La mujer cuando concibiere y pariere varón, será inmunda siete días; conforme á los días que está separada por su menstruo, será inmunda.

verses.KJV: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.WEB: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.ASV: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao oitavo dia circuncidará a carne de seu prepúcio.
verses.RVR09: Y al octavo día circuncidará la carne de su prepucio.

verses.KJV: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
verses.WEB: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.
verses.ASV: And she shall continue in the blood of [her] purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ela permanecerá trinta e três dias no sangue de sua purificação: nenhuma coisa santa tocará, nem virá ao santuário, até que sejam cumpridos os dias de sua purificação.
verses.RVR09: Mas ella permanecerá treinta y tres días en la sangre de su purgación: ninguna cosa santa tocará, ni vendrá al santuario, hasta que sean cumplidos los días de su purgación.

verses.KJV: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
verses.WEB: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.
verses.ASV: But if she bear a maid-child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her impurity; and she shall continue in the blood of [her] purifying threescore and six days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se der à luz fêmea será impura duas semanas, conforme sua separação, e sessenta e seis dias estará purificando-se de seu sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y si pariere hembra será inmunda dos semanas, conforme á su separación, y sesenta y seis días estará purificándose de su sangre.

verses.KJV: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
verses.WEB: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.
verses.ASV: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb a year old for a burnt-offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtle-dove, for a sin-offering, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os dias de sua purificação forem cumpridos, por filho ou por filha, trará um cordeiro de ano para holocausto, e um pombinho ou uma rolinha para expiação, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, ao sacerdote:
verses.RVR09: Y cuando los días de su purgación fueren cumplidos, por hijo ó por hija, traerá un cordero de un año para holocausto, y un palomino ó una tórtola para expiación, á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, al sacerdote:

verses.KJV: Who shall offer it before the Lord, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
verses.WEB: He shall offer it before the LORD, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.
verses.ASV: and he shall offer it before Jehovah, and make atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. This is the law for her that beareth, whether a male or a female.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele oferecerá diante do SENHOR, e fará expiação por ela, e será limpa do fluxo de seu sangue. Esta é a lei da que der à luz macho ou fêmea.
verses.RVR09: Y él ofrecerá delante de Jehová, y hará expiación por ella, y será limpia del flujo de su sangre. Esta es la ley de la que pariere varón ó hembra.

verses.KJV: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.WEB: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”
verses.ASV: And if her means suffice not for a lamb, then she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons; the one for a burnt-offering, and the other for a sin-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não alcançar sua mão o suficiente para um cordeiro, tomará então duas rolinhas ou dois pombinhos, um para holocausto, e outro para expiação: e o sacerdote fará expiação por ela, e será limpa.
verses.RVR09: Y si no alcanzare su mano lo suficiente para un cordero, tomará entonces dos tórtolas ó dos palominos, uno para holocausto, y otro para expiación: y el sacerdote hará expiación por ella, y será limpia.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés y á Aarón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.WEB: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.
verses.ASV: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it become in the skin of his flesh the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o homem tiver na pele de sua carne inchaço, ou pústula, ou mancha branca, e houver na pele de sua carne como chaga de lepra, será trazido a Arão o sacerdote, ou a um dos sacerdotes seus filhos:
verses.RVR09: Cuando el hombre tuviere en la piel de su carne hinchazón, ó postilla, ó mancha blanca, y hubiere en la piel de su carne como llaga de lepra, será traído á Aarón el sacerdote, ó á uno de los sacerdotes sus hijos:

verses.KJV: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and if the hair in the plague be turned white, and the appearance of the plague be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is the plague of leprosy; and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote olhará a chaga na pele da carne: se o pelo na chaga se tornou branco, e parecer a chaga mais profunda que a pele da carne, chaga de lepra é; e o sacerdote lhe reconhecerá, e lhe dará por impuro.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote mirará la llaga en la piel de la carne: si el pelo en la llaga se ha vuelto blanco, y pareciere la llaga más hundida que la tez de la carne, llaga de lepra es; y el sacerdote le reconocerá, y le dará por inmundo.

verses.KJV: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
verses.WEB: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.
verses.ASV: And if the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white, then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague seven days:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se na pele de sua carne houver mancha branca, mas não parecer mais profunda que a pele, nem seu pelo se houver tornado branco, então o sacerdote encerrará ao que tem chagas por sete dias;
verses.RVR09: Y si en la piel de su carne hubiere mancha blanca, pero no pareciere más hundida que la tez, ni su pelo se hubiere vuelto blanco, entonces el sacerdote encerrará al llagado por siete días;

verses.KJV: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if in his eyes the plague be at a stay, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao sétimo dia o sacerdote o olhará; e se a chaga a seu parecer se houver parado, não havendo-se estendido na pele, então o sacerdote lhe voltará a encerrar por outros sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Y al séptimo día el sacerdote lo mirará; y si la llaga á su parecer se hubiere estancado, no habiéndose extendido en la piel, entonces el sacerdote le volverá á encerrar por otros siete días.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look on him again the seventh day; and, behold, if the plague be dim, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao sétimo dia o sacerdote lhe reconhecerá de novo; e se parece haver-se escurecido a chaga, e que não estendeu na pele, então o sacerdote o dará por limpo: era pústula; e lavará suas roupas, e será limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y al séptimo día el sacerdote le reconocerá de nuevo; y si parece haberse oscurecido la llaga, y que no ha cundido en la piel, entonces el sacerdote lo dará por limpio: era postilla; y lavará sus vestidos, y será limpio.

verses.KJV: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again.
verses.WEB: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.
verses.ASV: But if the scab spread abroad in the skin, after that he hath showed himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se houver ido crescendo a pústula na pele, depois que foi mostrado ao sacerdote para ser limpo, será visto outra vez pelo sacerdote:
verses.RVR09: Mas si hubiere ido creciendo la postilla en la piel, después que fué mostrado al sacerdote para ser limpio, será visto otra vez del sacerdote:

verses.KJV: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the scab be spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is leprosy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se reconhecendo-o o sacerdote, vê que a pústula cresceu na pele, o sacerdote o dará por impuro: é lepra.
verses.RVR09: Y si reconociéndolo el sacerdote, ve que la postilla ha crecido en la piel, el sacerdote lo dará por inmundo: es lepra.

verses.KJV: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.WEB: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;
verses.ASV: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando houver chaga de lepra no homem, será trazido ao sacerdote;
verses.RVR09: Cuando hubiere llaga de lepra en el hombre, será traído al sacerdote;

verses.KJV: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.WEB: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if there be a white rising in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote olhará, e se parecer inchaço branco na pele, o qual tenha mudado a cor do pelo, e se descobre também a carne viva,
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote mirará, y si pareciere tumor blanco en la piel, el cual haya mudado el color del pelo, y se descubre asimismo la carne viva,

verses.KJV: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
verses.WEB: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.
verses.ASV: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: he shall not shut him up; for he is unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lepra é envelhecida na pele de sua carne; e lhe dará por impuro o sacerdote, e não lhe encerrará, porque é impuro.
verses.RVR09: Lepra es envejecida en la piel de su carne; y le dará por inmundo el sacerdote, y no le encerrará, porque es inmundo.

verses.KJV: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
verses.WEB: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest,
verses.ASV: And if the leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of [him that hath] the plague from his head even to his feet, as far as appeareth to the priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se brotar a lepra estendendo pela pele, e ela cobrir toda a pele do que tem chagas desde sua cabeça até seus pés, a toda vista de olhos do sacerdote;
verses.RVR09: Mas si brotare la lepra cundiendo por el cutis, y ella cubriere toda la piel del llagado desde su cabeza hasta sus pies, á toda vista de ojos del sacerdote;

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
verses.WEB: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.
verses.ASV: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sacerdote lhe reconhecerá; e se a lepra houver coberto toda sua carne, dará por limpo ao que tem chagas: tornou-se toda ela branca; e ele é limpo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el sacerdote le reconocerá; y si la lepra hubiere cubierto toda su carne, dará por limpio al llagado: hase vuelto toda ella blanca; y él es limpio.

verses.KJV: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.WEB: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.ASV: But whensoever raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o dia que parecer nele a carne viva, será impuro.
verses.RVR09: Mas el día que apareciere en él la carne viva, será inmundo.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean: it is leprosy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote olhará a carne viva, e o dará por impuro. É impura a carne viva: é lepra.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote mirará la carne viva, y lo dará por inmundo. Es inmunda la carne viva: es lepra.

verses.KJV: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
verses.WEB: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.
verses.ASV: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, then he shall come unto the priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando a carne viva se mudar e tornar branca, então virá ao sacerdote;
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando la carne viva se mudare y volviere blanca, entonces vendrá al sacerdote;

verses.KJV: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the plague be turned into white, then the priest shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: he is clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote olhará, e se a chaga se houver tornado branca, o sacerdote dará por limpo ao que tinha a chaga, e será limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote mirará, y si la llaga se hubiere vuelto blanca, el sacerdote dará por limpio al que tenía la llaga, y será limpio.

verses.KJV: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
verses.WEB: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,
verses.ASV: And when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a boil, and it is healed,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando na carne, em sua pele, houver úlcera, e se sarar,
verses.RVR09: Y cuando en la carne, en su piel, hubiere apostema, y se sanare,

verses.KJV: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
verses.WEB: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.
verses.ASV: and in the place of the boil there is a white rising, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be showed to the priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: E suceder no lugar da úlcera inchaço branco, ou mancha branca avermelhada, será mostrado ao sacerdote:
verses.RVR09: Y sucediere en el lugar de la apostema tumor blanco, ó mancha blanca embermejecida, será mostrado al sacerdote:

verses.KJV: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy, it hath broken out in the boil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote olhará; e se parecer estar mais baixa que sua pele, e seu pelo se houver tornado branco, o dará o sacerdote por impuro: é chaga de lepra que se originou na úlcera.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote mirará; y si pareciere estar más baja que su piel, y su pelo se hubiere vuelto blanco, darálo el sacerdote por inmundo: es llaga de lepra que se originó en la apostema.

verses.KJV: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.WEB: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.
verses.ASV: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and it be not lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o sacerdote a considerar, e não parecer nela pelo branco, nem estiver mais baixa que a pele, mas sim escura, então o sacerdote o encerrará por sete dias:
verses.RVR09: Y si el sacerdote la considerare, y no pareciere en ella pelo blanco, ni estuviere más baja que la piel, sino oscura, entonces el sacerdote lo encerrará por siete días:

verses.KJV: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
verses.WEB: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.
verses.ASV: and if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se se for estendendo pela pele, então o sacerdote o dará por impuro: é chaga.
verses.RVR09: Y si se fuere extendiendo por la piel, entonces el sacerdote lo dará por inmundo: es llaga.

verses.KJV: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.WEB: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.ASV: But if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se a mancha branca estiver em seu lugar, que não tenha estendido, é a cicatriz da úlcera; e o sacerdote o dará por limpo.
verses.RVR09: Empero si la mancha blanca se estuviere en su lugar, que no haya cundido, es la costra de la apostema; y el sacerdote lo dará por limpio.

verses.KJV: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
verses.WEB: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,
verses.ASV: Or when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a burning by fire, and the quick [flesh] of the burning become a bright spot, reddish-white, or white;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim quando a carne tiver em sua pele queimadura de fogo, e houver no sarado do fogo mancha esbranquiçada, avermelhada ou branca,
verses.RVR09: Asimismo cuando la carne tuviere en su piel quemadura de fuego, y hubiere en lo sanado del fuego mancha blanquecina, bermejiza ó blanca,

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.WEB: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.
verses.ASV: then the priest shall look upon it; and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin; it is leprosy, it hath broken out in the burning: and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sacerdote a olhará; e se o pelo se houver tornado branco na mancha, e parecer estar mais profunda que a pele, é lepra que saiu na queimadura; e o sacerdote declarará ao sujeito impuro, por ser chaga de lepra.
verses.RVR09: El sacerdote la mirará; y si el pelo se hubiere vuelto blanco en la mancha, y pareciere estar más hundida que la piel, es lepra que salió en la quemadura; y el sacerdote declarará al sujeto inmundo, por ser llaga de lepra.

verses.KJV: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.WEB: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.
verses.ASV: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se o sacerdote a olhar, e não parecer na mancha pelo branco, nem estiver mais baixa que a pele, mas sim que está escura, lhe encerrará o sacerdote por sete dias;
verses.RVR09: Mas si el sacerdote la mirare, y no pareciere en la mancha pelo blanco, ni estuviere más baja que la tez, sino que está oscura, le encerrará el sacerdote por siete días;

verses.KJV: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao sétimo dia o sacerdote a reconhecerá: se se houver ido estendendo pela pele, o sacerdote o dará por impuro: é chaga de lepra.
verses.RVR09: Y al séptimo día el sacerdote la reconocerá: si se hubiere ido extendiendo por la piel, el sacerdote lo dará por inmundo: es llaga de lepra.

verses.KJV: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
verses.WEB: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.
verses.ASV: And if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread in the skin, but be dim; it is the rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is the scar of the burning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se a mancha estiver em seu lugar, e não se houver estendido na pele, a não ser que está escura, inchaço é da queimadura: o dará o sacerdote por limpo; que sinal da queimadura é.
verses.RVR09: Empero si la mancha se estuviere en su lugar, y no se hubiere extendido en la piel, sino que está oscura, hinchazón es de la quemadura: darálo el sacerdote por limpio; que señal de la quemadura es.

verses.KJV: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
verses.WEB: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,
verses.ASV: And when a man or woman hath a plague upon the head or upon the beard,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao homem ou mulher que lhe sair chaga na cabeça, ou no queixo,
verses.RVR09: Y al hombre ó mujer que le saliere llaga en la cabeza, ó en la barba,

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.
verses.WEB: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
verses.ASV: then the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin, and there be in it yellow thin hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a scall, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sacerdote olhará a chaga; e se parecer estar mais profunda que a pele, e o pelo nela fora ruivo e fino, então o sacerdote o dará por impuro: é tinha, é lepra da cabeça ou do queixo.
verses.RVR09: El sacerdote mirará la llaga; y si pareciere estar más profunda que la tez, y el pelo en ella fuera rubio y adelgazado, entonces el sacerdote lo dará por inmundo: es tiña, es lepra de la cabeza ó de la barba.

verses.KJV: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.WEB: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.
verses.ASV: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and there be no black hair in it, then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando o sacerdote houver olhado a chaga da tinha, e não parecer estar mais profunda que a pele, nem for nela pelo negro, o sacerdote encerrará ao que tem chagas da tinha por sete dias:
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando el sacerdote hubiere mirado la llaga de la tiña, y no pareciere estar más profunda que la tez, ni fuere en ella pelo negro, el sacerdote encerrará al llagado de la tiña por siete días:
