verses.KJV: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
verses.WEB: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,
verses.ASV: and in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the scall be not spread, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the appearance of the scall be not deeper than the skin,

verses.RVR09: Y al séptimo día el sacerdote mirará la llaga: y si la tiña no pareciere haberse extendido, ni hubiere en ella pelo rubio, ni pareciere la tiña más profunda que la tez,

verses.KJV: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
verses.WEB: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.
verses.ASV: then he shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the scall seven days more:

verses.RVR09: Entonces lo trasquilarán, mas no trasquilarán el lugar de la tiña: y encerrará el sacerdote al que tiene la tiña por otros siete días.

verses.KJV: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.WEB: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.
verses.ASV: and in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall; and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao sétimo dia olhará o sacerdote a tinha; e se a tinha não houver estendido na pele, nem parecer estar mais profunda que a pele, o sacerdote o dará por limpo; e lavará suas roupas, e será limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y al séptimo día mirará el sacerdote la tiña; y si la tiña no hubiere cundido en la piel, ni pareciere estar más profunda que la tez, el sacerdote lo dará por limpio; y lavará sus vestidos, y será limpio.

verses.KJV: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.WEB: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,
verses.ASV: But if the scall spread abroad in the skin after his cleansing,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se a tinha se houver ido estendendo na pele depois de sua purificação,
verses.RVR09: Empero si la tiña se hubiere ido extendiendo en la piel después de su purificación,

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.WEB: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.ASV: then the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for the yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sacerdote a olhará; e se a tinha houver estendido na pele, não busque o sacerdote o pelo ruivo, é impuro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el sacerdote la mirará; y si la tiña hubiere cundido en la piel, no busque el sacerdote el pelo rubio, es inmundo.

verses.KJV: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.WEB: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.ASV: But if in his eyes the scall be at a stay, and black hair be grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se lhe parecer que a tinha está detida, e que saiu nela o pelo negro, a tinha está sarada; ele está limpo, e por limpo o dará o sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Mas si le pareciere que la tiña está detenida, y que ha salido en ella el pelo negro, la tiña está sanada; él está limpio, y por limpio lo dará el sacerdote.

verses.KJV: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
verses.WEB: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,
verses.ASV: And when a man or a woman hath in the skin of the flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o homem ou mulher, quando na pele de sua carne tiver machas, machas brancas,
verses.RVR09: Asimismo el hombre ó mujer, cuando en la piel de su carne tuviere manchas, manchas blancas,

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
verses.WEB: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.
verses.ASV: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be of a dull white, it is a tetter, it hath broken out in the skin; he is clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sacerdote olhará: e se na pele de sua carne parecerem machas brancas algo escurecidas, é impigem que brotou na pele, está limpa a pessoa.
verses.RVR09: El sacerdote mirará: y si en la piel de su carne parecieren manchas blancas algo oscurecidas, es empeine que brotó en la piel, está limpia la persona.

verses.KJV: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
verses.WEB: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.
verses.ASV: And if a man’s hair be fallen off his head, he is bald; [yet] is he clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem, quando se lhe cair os cabelos da cabeça, é calvo, mas limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y el hombre, cuando se le pelare la cabeza, es calvo, mas limpio.

verses.KJV: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
verses.WEB: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.
verses.ASV: And if his hair be fallen off from the front part of his head, he is forehead bald; [yet] is he clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se à parte de seu rosto se lhe cair os cabelos da cabeça, é calvo pela frente, mas limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y si á la parte de su rostro se le pelare la cabeza, es calvo por delante, pero limpio.

verses.KJV: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.WEB: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.
verses.ASV: But if there be in the bald head, or the bald forehead, a reddish-white plague; it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando na calva ou na calva da frente houver chaga branca avermelhada, lepra é que brota em sua calva ou em sua calva da frente.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando en la calva ó en la antecalva hubiere llaga blanca rojiza, lepra es que brota en su calva ó en su antecalva.

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.WEB: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,
verses.ASV: Then the priest shall look upon him; and, behold, if the rising of the plague be reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sacerdote o olhará, e se parecer a inchaço da chaga branca avermelhada em sua calva ou em sua calva da frente, como o parecer da lepra da pele da carne,
verses.RVR09: Entonces el sacerdote lo mirará, y si pareciere la hinchazón de la llaga blanca rojiza en su calva ó en su antecalva, como el parecer de la lepra de la tez de la carne,

verses.KJV: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
verses.WEB: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.
verses.ASV: he is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his plague is in his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Leproso é, é impuro; o sacerdote o dará logo por impuro; em sua cabeça tem sua chaga.
verses.RVR09: Leproso es, es inmundo; el sacerdote lo dará luego por inmundo; en su cabeza tiene su llaga.

verses.KJV: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.WEB: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
verses.ASV: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and the hair of his head shall go loose, and he shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o leproso em quem houver chaga, suas roupas serão derrotados e sua cabeça descoberta, e com o lábio superior coberto proclamará: -Imundo! -Imundo!
verses.RVR09: Y el leproso en quien hubiere llaga, sus vestidos serán deshechos y su cabeza descubierta, y embozado pregonará: ¡Inmundo! ¡inmundo!

verses.KJV: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
verses.WEB: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.
verses.ASV: All the days wherein the plague is in him he shall be unclean; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his dwelling be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Durante todo o tempo que a chaga estiver nele será imundo; estará impuro: habitará sozinho; fora do acampamento será sua morada.
verses.RVR09: Todo el tiempo que la llaga estuviere en él, será inmundo; estará impuro: habitará solo; fuera del real será su morada.

verses.KJV: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.WEB: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.ASV: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando na roupa houver praga de lepra, em vestido de lã, ou em vestido de linho;
verses.RVR09: Y cuando en el vestido hubiere plaga de lepra, en vestido de lana, ó en vestido de lino;

verses.KJV: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
verses.WEB: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;
verses.ASV: whether it be in warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in anything made of skin;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou na urdidura ou em trama, de linho ou de lã, ou em pele, ou em qualquer obra de pele;
verses.RVR09: O en estambre ó en trama, de lino ó de lana, ó en piel, ó en cualquiera obra de piel;

verses.KJV: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
verses.WEB: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.
verses.ASV: if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be showed unto the priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que a praga seja verde, ou vermelha, em roupa ou em pele, ou na urdidura, ou em trama, ou em qualquer obra de pele; praga é de lepra, e se há de mostrar ao sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Y que la plaga sea verde, ó bermeja, en vestido ó en piel, ó en estambre ó en trama, ó en cualquiera obra de piel; plaga es de lepra, y se ha de mostrar al sacerdote.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
verses.WEB: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up [that which hath] the plague seven days:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote olhará a praga, e encerrará a coisa que tem praga por sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote mirará la plaga, y encerrará la cosa plagada por siete días.

verses.KJV: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.WEB: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.
verses.ASV: and he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever service skin is used for; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao sétimo dia olhará a praga: e se houver estendido a praga na roupa, ou urdidura, ou na trama, ou em pele, ou em qualquer obra que se faz de peles, lepra roedora é a praga; impura será.
verses.RVR09: Y al séptimo día mirará la plaga: y si hubiere cundido la plaga en el vestido, ó estambre, ó en la trama, ó en piel, ó en cualquiera obra que se hace de pieles, lepra roedora es la plaga; inmunda será.

verses.KJV: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.WEB: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.
verses.ASV: And he shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in woollen or in linen, or anything of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será queimada a roupa, ou urdidura ou trama, de lã ou de linho, ou qualquer obra de peles em que houver tal praga; porque lepra roedora é; ao fogo será queimada.
verses.RVR09: Será quemado el vestido, ó estambre ó trama, de lana ó de lino, ó cualquiera obra de pieles en que hubiere tal plaga; porque lepra roedora es: al fuego será quemada.

verses.KJV: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.WEB: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;
verses.ASV: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o sacerdote olhar, e não parecer que a praga se tenha estendido na roupa, ou urdidura, ou na trama, ou em qualquer obra de peles;
verses.RVR09: Y si el sacerdote mirare, y no pareciere que la plaga se haya extendido en el vestido, ó estambre, ó en la trama, ó en cualquiera obra de pieles;

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.WEB: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.
verses.ASV: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sacerdote mandará que lavem onde está a praga, e o encerrará outra vez por sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el sacerdote mandará que laven donde está la plaga, y lo encerrará otra vez por siete días.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
verses.WEB: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall look, after that the plague is washed; and, behold, if the plague have not changed its color, and the plague be not spread, it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire: it is a fret, whether the bareness be within or without.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote olhará depois que a praga for lavada; e se parecer que a praga não mudou seu aspecto, ainda que não tenha estendido a praga, impura é; a queimarás ao fogo; corrosão é penetrante, esteja o estragado na face ou no verso daquela coisa.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote mirará después que la plaga fuere lavada; y si pareciere que la plaga no ha mudado su aspecto, bien que no haya cundido la plaga, inmunda es; la quemarás al fuego; corrosión es penetrante, esté lo raído en la haz ó en el revés de aquella cosa.

verses.KJV: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.WEB: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;
verses.ASV: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be dim after the washing thereof, then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se o sacerdote a vir, e parecer que a praga se escureceu depois que foi lavada, a cortará da roupa, ou da pele, ou da urdidura, ou da trama.
verses.RVR09: Mas si el sacerdote la viere, y pareciere que la plaga se ha oscurecido después que fué lavada, la cortará del vestido, ó de la piel, ó del estambre, ó de la trama.

verses.KJV: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
verses.WEB: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.
verses.ASV: and if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is breaking out: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se parecer mais no vestido, ou urdidura, ou trama, ou em qualquer coisa de peles, esverdeando nela, queimarás ao fogo aquilo onde estiver a praga.
verses.RVR09: Y si apareciere más en el vestido, ó estambre, ó trama, ó en cualquiera cosa de pieles, reverdeciendo en ella, quemarás al fuego aquello donde estuviere la plaga.

verses.KJV: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.WEB: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”
verses.ASV: And the garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a roupa, ou urdidura, ou trama, ou qualquer coisa de pele que lavares, e que se lhe tirar a praga, se lavará segunda vez, e então será limpa.
verses.RVR09: Empero el vestido, ó estambre, ó trama, ó cualquiera cosa de piel que lavares, y que se le quitare la plaga, lavarse ha segunda vez, y entonces será limpia.

verses.KJV: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.WEB: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.ASV: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a lei da praga da lepra da roupa de lã ou de linho, ou da urdidura, ou da trama, ou de qualquer coisa de pele, para que seja dada por limpa ou por impura.
verses.RVR09: Esta es la ley de la plaga de la lepra del vestido de lana ó de lino, ó del estambre, ó de la trama, ó de cualquiera cosa de piel, para que sea dada por limpia ó por inmunda.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
verses.WEB: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,
verses.ASV: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought unto the priest:
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta será a lei do leproso quando se limpar: Será trazido ao sacerdote:
verses.RVR09: Esta será la ley del leproso cuando se limpiare: Será traído al sacerdote:

verses.KJV: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
verses.WEB: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,
verses.ASV: and the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote sairá fora do acampamento; e olhará o sacerdote, e vendo que está sã a praga da lepra do leproso,
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote saldrá fuera del real; y mirará el sacerdote, y viendo que está sana la plaga de la lepra del leproso,

verses.KJV: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.WEB: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.
verses.ASV: then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.ALMEIDA: O sacerdote mandará logo que se tomem para o que se purifica duas aves vivas, limpas, e pau de cedro, e carmesim, e hissopo;
verses.RVR09: El sacerdote mandará luego que se tomen para el que se purifica dos avecillas vivas, limpias, y palo de cedro, y grana, é hisopo;

verses.KJV: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.WEB: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall command to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandará o sacerdote matar uma ave em um vaso de barro sobre águas vivas;
verses.RVR09: Y mandará el sacerdote matar la una avecilla en un vaso de barro sobre aguas vivas;

verses.KJV: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
verses.WEB: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.
verses.ASV: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois tomará a ave viva, e o pau de cedro, e o carmesim, e o hissopo, e o molhará com a ave viva no sangue da ave morta sobre as águas vivas:
verses.RVR09: Después tomará la avecilla viva, y el palo de cedro, y la grana, y el hisopo, y lo mojará con la avecilla viva en la sangre de la avecilla muerta sobre las aguas vivas:

verses.KJV: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
verses.WEB: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.
verses.ASV: and he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let go the living bird into the open field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E espargirá sete vezes sobre o que se purifica da lepra, e lhe dará por limpo; e soltará a ave viva sobre a face do campo.
verses.RVR09: Y rociará siete veces sobre el que se purifica de la lepra, y le dará por limpio; y soltará la avecilla viva sobre la haz del campo.

verses.KJV: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
verses.WEB: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.
verses.ASV: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que se purifica lavará suas roupas, e rapará todos os seus pelos, e se há de lavar com água, e será limpo: e depois entrará no acampamento, e morará fora de sua tenda sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Y el que se purifica lavará sus vestidos, y raerá todos sus pelos, y se ha de lavar con agua, y será limpio: y después entrará en el real, y morará fuera de su tienda siete días.

verses.KJV: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.WEB: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.
verses.ASV: And it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será, que ao sétimo dia rapará todos os seus pelos, sua cabeça, e sua barba, e as sobrancelhas de seus olhos; finalmente, rapará todo seu pelo, e lavará suas roupas, e lavará sua carne em águas, e será limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y será, que al séptimo día raerá todos sus pelos, su cabeza, y su barba, y las cejas de sus ojos; finalmente, raerá todo su pelo, y lavará sus vestidos, y lavará su carne en aguas, y será limpio.

verses.KJV: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.WEB: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.ASV: And on the eighth day he shall take two he-lambs without blemish, and one ewe-lamb a year old without blemish, and three tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no oitavo dia tomará dois cordeiros sem defeito, e uma cordeira de ano sem mácula; e três décimos [de efa] de boa farinha para oferta amassada com azeite, e um logue de azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y el día octavo tomará dos corderos sin defecto, y una cordera de un año sin tacha; y tres décimas de flor de harina para presente, amasada con aceite, y un log de aceite.

verses.KJV: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.WEB: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And the priest that cleanseth him shall set the man that is to be cleansed, and those things, before Jehovah, at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote que lhe purifica apresentará com aquelas coisas ao que se há de limpar diante do SENHOR, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho:
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote que le purifica presentará con aquellas cosas al que se ha de limpiar delante de Jehová, á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio:

verses.KJV: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:
verses.WEB: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall take one of the he-lambs, and offer him for a trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomará o sacerdote um cordeiro, e o oferecerá pela culpa, com o logue de azeite, e o moverá como oferta movida diante do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Y tomará el sacerdote el un cordero, y ofrecerálo por la culpa, con el log de aceite, y lo mecerá como ofrenda agitada delante de Jehová:

verses.KJV: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:
verses.WEB: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.
verses.ASV: and he shall kill the he-lamb in the place where they kill the sin-offering and the burnt-offering, in the place of the sanctuary: for as the sin-offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass-offering: it is most holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E degolará o cordeiro no lugar onde degolam o sacrifício pelo pecado e o holocausto, no lugar do santuário: porque como o sacrifício pelo pecado, assim também o sacrifício pela culpa é do sacerdote: é coisa muito sagrada.
verses.RVR09: Y degollará el cordero en el lugar donde degüellan la víctima por el pecado y el holocausto, en el lugar del santuario: porque como la víctima por el pecado, así también la víctima por la culpa es del sacerdote: es cosa muy sagrada.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.WEB: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomará o sacerdote do sangue do animal sacrificado pela culpa, e porá o sacerdote sobre a ponta da orelha direita do que se purifica, e sobre o polegar de sua mão direita, e sobre o polegar de seu pé direito.
verses.RVR09: Y tomará el sacerdote de la sangre de la víctima por la culpa, y pondrá el sacerdote sobre la ternilla de la oreja derecha del que se purifica, y sobre el pulgar de su mano derecha, y sobre el pulgar de su pie derecho.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.WEB: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall take of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também tomará o sacerdote do logue de azeite, e lançará sobre a palma de sua mão esquerda:
verses.RVR09: Asimismo tomará el sacerdote del log de aceite, y echará sobre la palma de su mano izquierda:

verses.KJV: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord:
verses.WEB: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E molhará seu dedo direito no azeite que tem em sua mão esquerda, e espargirá do azeite com seu dedo sete vezes diante do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Y mojará su dedo derecho en el aceite que tiene en su mano izquierda, y esparcirá del aceite con su dedo siete veces delante de Jehová:

verses.KJV: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.WEB: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.
verses.ASV: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass-offering:
verses.ALMEIDA: E do que restar do azeite que tem em sua mão, porá o sacerdote sobre a ponta da orelha direita do que se purifica, e sobre o polegar de sua mão direita, e sobre o polegar de seu pé direito, sobre o sangue da expiação pela culpa:
verses.RVR09: Y de lo que quedare del aceite que tiene en su mano, pondrá el sacerdote sobre la ternilla de la oreja derecha del que se purifica, y sobre el pulgar de su mano derecha, y sobre el pulgar de su pie derecho, sobre la sangre de la expiación por la culpa:

verses.KJV: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.WEB: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.ASV: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que restar do azeite que tem em sua mão, porá sobre a cabeça do que se purifica: e fará o sacerdote expiação por ele diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y lo que quedare del aceite que tiene en su mano, pondrá sobre la cabeza del que se purifica: y hará el sacerdote expiación por él delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
verses.WEB: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;
verses.ASV: And the priest shall offer the sin-offering, and make atonement for him that is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness: and afterward he shall kill the burnt-offering;
verses.ALMEIDA: Oferecerá logo o sacerdote o sacrifício pelo pecado, e fará expiação pelo que se há de purificar de sua impureza, e depois degolará o holocausto:
verses.RVR09: Ofrecerá luego el sacerdote el sacrificio por el pecado, y hará expiación por el que se ha de purificar de su inmundicia, y después degollará el holocausto:

verses.KJV: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.WEB: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall offer the burnt-offering and the meal-offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará subir o sacerdote o holocausto e a oferta de cereais sobre o altar. Assim fará o sacerdote expiação por ele, e será limpo.
verses.RVR09: Y hará subir el sacerdote el holocausto y el presente sobre el altar. Así hará el sacerdote expiación por él, y será limpio.

verses.KJV: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
verses.WEB: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;
verses.ASV: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much, then he shall take one he-lamb for a trespass-offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth part [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering, and a log of oil;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se for pobre, que não alcançar sua mão a tanto, então tomará um cordeiro para ser oferecido como oferta movida pela culpa, para reconciliar-se, e um décimo [de efa] de boa farinha amassada com azeite para oferta de cereais, e um logue de azeite;
verses.RVR09: Mas si fuere pobre, que no alcanzare su mano á tanto, entonces tomará un cordero para ser ofrecido como ofrenda agitada por la culpa, para reconciliarse, y una décima de flor de harina amasada con aceite para presente, y un log de aceite;

verses.KJV: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.WEB: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.ASV: and two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin-offering, and the other a burnt-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E duas rolinhas, ou dois pombinhos, o que alcançar sua mão: e um será para expiação pelo pecado, e o outro para holocausto;
verses.RVR09: Y dos tórtolas, ó dos palominos, lo que alcanzare su mano: y el uno será para expiación por el pecado, y el otro para holocausto;

verses.KJV: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the Lord.
verses.WEB: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And on the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tent of meeting, before Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: As quais coisas trará ao oitavo dia de sua purificação ao sacerdote, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales cosas traerá al octavo día de su purificación al sacerdote, á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:
verses.WEB: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote tomará o cordeiro da expiação pela culpa, e o logue de azeite, e o moverá o sacerdote como oferta movida diante do SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote tomará el cordero de la expiación por la culpa, y el log de aceite, y mecerálo el sacerdote como ofrenda agitada delante de Jehová;

verses.KJV: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.WEB: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.ASV: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass-offering; and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo degolará o cordeiro da culpa, e tomará o sacerdote do sangue da culpa, e porá sobre a ponta da orelha direita do que se purifica, e sobre o polegar de sua mão direita, e sobre o polegar de seu pé direito.
verses.RVR09: Luego degollará el cordero de la culpa, y tomará el sacerdote de la sangre de la culpa, y pondrá sobre la ternilla de la oreja derecha del que se purifica, y sobre el pulgar de su mano derecha, y sobre el pulgar de su pie derecho.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.WEB: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;
verses.ASV: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote lançará do azeite sobre a palma de sua mão esquerda;
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote echará del aceite sobre la palma de su mano izquierda;

verses.KJV: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord:
verses.WEB: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E com seu dedo direito espargirá o sacerdote do azeite que tem em sua mão esquerda, sete vezes diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y con su dedo derecho rociará el sacerdote del aceite que tiene en su mano izquierda, siete veces delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.WEB: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass-offering:
verses.ALMEIDA: Também porá o sacerdote do azeite que tem em sua mão sobre a ponta da orelha direita do que se purifica, e sobre o polegar de sua mão direita, e sobre o polegar de seu pé direito, no lugar do sangue da culpa.
verses.RVR09: También pondrá el sacerdote del aceite que tiene en su mano sobre la ternilla de la oreja derecha del que se purifica, y sobre el pulgar de su mano derecha, y sobre el pulgar de su pie derecho, en el lugar de la sangre de la culpa.

verses.KJV: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.WEB: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.ASV: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que sobrar do azeite que o sacerdote tem em sua mão, o porá sobre a cabeça do que se purifica, para reconciliá-lo diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y lo que sobrare del aceite que el sacerdote tiene en su mano, pondrálo sobre la cabeza del que se purifica, para reconciliarlo delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
verses.WEB: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,
verses.ASV: And he shall offer one of the turtle-doves, or of the young pigeons, such as he is able to get,
verses.ALMEIDA: Também oferecerá uma das rolinhas, ou dos pombinhos, o que alcançar sua mão:
verses.RVR09: Asimismo ofrecerá la una de las tórtolas, ó de los palominos, lo que alcanzare su mano:

verses.KJV: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the Lord.
verses.WEB: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD.”
verses.ASV: even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, with the meal-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for him that is to be cleansed before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O um do que alcançar sua mão, em expiação pelo pecado, e o outro em holocausto, ademais da oferta: e fará o sacerdote expiação pelo que se há de purificar, diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El uno de lo que alcanzare su mano, en expiación por el pecado, y el otro en holocausto, además del presente: y hará el sacerdote expiación por el que se ha de purificar, delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
verses.WEB: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.
verses.ASV: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to get [that which pertaineth] to his cleansing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a lei do que houver tido praga de lepra, cuja mão não alcançar o prescrito para purificar-se.
verses.RVR09: Esta es la ley del que hubiere tenido plaga de lepra, cuya mano no alcanzare lo prescrito para purificarse.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés y á Aarón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.WEB: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,
verses.ASV: When ye are come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando houveres entrado na terra de Canaã, a qual eu vos dou em possessão, e puser eu praga de lepra em alguma casa da terra de vossa possessão,
verses.RVR09: Cuando hubieres entrado en la tierra de Canaán, la cual yo os doy en posesión, y pusiere yo plaga de lepra en alguna casa de la tierra de vuestra posesión,

verses.KJV: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
verses.WEB: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’
verses.ASV: then he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, There seemeth to me to be as it were a plague in the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Virá aquele cuja for a casa, e dará aviso ao sacerdote, dizendo: Como praga apareceu em minha casa.
verses.RVR09: Vendrá aquél cuya fuere la casa, y dará aviso al sacerdote, diciendo: Como plaga ha aparecido en mi casa.

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
verses.WEB: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goeth in to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então mandará o sacerdote, e despejarão a casa antes que o sacerdote entre a olhar a praga, para que não seja contaminado tudo o que estiver na casa: e depois o sacerdote entrará a reconhecer a casa:
verses.RVR09: Entonces mandará el sacerdote, y despejarán la casa antes que el sacerdote entre á mirar la plaga, porque no sea contaminado todo lo que estuviere en la casa: y después el sacerdote entrará á reconocer la casa:

verses.KJV: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
verses.WEB: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,
verses.ASV: and he shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and the appearance thereof be lower than the wall;
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhará a praga: e se se virem machas nas paredes da casa, cavidades esverdeadas ou vermelhas, as quais parecerem mais profundas que a parede,
verses.RVR09: Y mirará la plaga: y si se vieren manchas en las paredes de la casa, cavernillas verdosas ó rojas, las cuales parecieren más hundidas que la pared,

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

verses.RVR09: Y toda vestimenta, ó toda piel sobre la cual hubiere el derramamiento del semen, lavaráse con agua, y será inmunda hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: The woman also with whom a man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher com quem o homem tiver ajuntamento seminal, ambos se lavarão com água, e serão impuros até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer con quien el varón tuviera ayuntamiento de semen, ambos se lavarán con agua, y serán inmundos hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And if a woman have an issue, [and] her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando a mulher tiver fluxo de sangue, e seu fluxo for em sua carne, sete dias estará separada; e qualquer um que tocar nela, será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando la mujer tuviere flujo de sangre, y su flujo fuere en su carne, siete días estará apartada; y cualquiera que tocare en ella, será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.WEB: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.
verses.ASV: And everything that she lieth upon in her impurity shall be unclean: everything also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo aquilo sobre que ela se deitar durante sua separação, será impuro: também tudo aquilo sobre que se sentar, será impuro.
verses.RVR09: Y todo aquello sobre que ella se acostare mientras su separación, será inmundo: también todo aquello sobre que se sentare, será inmundo.

verses.KJV: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer um que tocar a sua cama, lavará suas roupas, e depois de lavar-se com água, será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que tocare á su cama, lavará sus vestidos, y después de lavarse con agua, será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And whosoever toucheth anything that she sitteth upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também qualquer um que tocar qualquer móvel sobre que ela se houver sentado, lavará suas roupas; lavará logo a si mesmo com água, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: También cualquiera que tocare cualquier mueble sobre que ella se hubiere sentado, lavará sus vestidos; lavaráse luego á sí mismo con agua, y será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And if it be on the bed, or on anything whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se estiver sobre a cama, ou sobre a cadeira em que ela se houver sentado, o que tocar nela será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y si estuviere sobre la cama, ó sobre la silla en que ella se hubiere sentado, el que tocare en ella será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.WEB: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.
verses.ASV: And if any man lie with her, and her impurity be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém dormir com ela, e sua menstruação for sobre ele, será impuro por sete dias; e toda cama sobre que dormir, será impura.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno durmiere con ella, y su menstruo fuere sobre él, será inmundo por siete días; y toda cama sobre que durmiere, será inmunda.

verses.KJV: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
verses.WEB: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.
verses.ASV: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days not in the time of her impurity, or if she have an issue beyond the time of her impurity; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her impurity: she is unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher, quando seguir o fluxo de seu sangue por muitos dias fora do tempo de seu costume, ou quando tiver fluxo de sangue mais de seu costume; todo o tempo do fluxo de seu imundícia, será impura como nos dias de seu costume.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer, cuando siguiere el flujo de su sangre por muchos días fuera del tiempo de su costumbre, ó cuando tuviere flujo de sangre más de su costumbre; todo el tiempo del flujo de su inmundicia, será inmunda como en los días de su costumbre.

verses.KJV: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.WEB: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.
verses.ASV: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her impurity: and everything whereon she sitteth shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda cama em que dormir todo o tempo de seu fluxo, lhe será como a cama de seu costume; e todo móvel sobre que se sentar, será impuro, como a impureza de seu costume.
verses.RVR09: Toda cama en que durmiere todo el tiempo de su flujo, le será como la cama de su costumbre; y todo mueble sobre que se sentare, será inmundo, como la inmundicia de su costumbre.

verses.KJV: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.WEB: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
verses.ASV: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que tocar em essas coisas será impuro; e lavará suas roupas, e a si mesmo se lavará com água, e será impuro até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que tocare en esas cosas será inmundo; y lavará sus vestidos, y á sí mismo se lavará con agua, y será inmundo hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.WEB: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.ASV: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando for livre de seu fluxo, se há de contar sete dias, e depois será limpa.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando fuere libre de su flujo, se ha de contar siete días, y después será limpia.

verses.KJV: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o oitavo dia tomará consigo duas rolinhas, ou dois pombinhos, e os trará ao sacerdote, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho:
verses.RVR09: Y el octavo día tomará consigo dos tórtolas, ó dos palominos, y los traerá al sacerdote, á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio:

verses.KJV: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the Lord for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.WEB: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Jehovah for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote fará um oferta pelo pecado, e o outro holocausto; e a purificará o sacerdote diante do SENHOR do fluxo de sua impureza.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote hará el uno ofrenda por el pecado, y el otro holocausto; y la purificará el sacerdote delante de Jehová del flujo de su inmundicia.

verses.KJV: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
verses.WEB: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”
verses.ASV: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in the midst of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim separareis os filhos de Israel de suas imundícias, a fim de que não morram por suas imundícias, contaminando meu tabernáculo que está entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Así apartaréis los hijos de Israel de sus inmundicias, á fin de que no mueran por sus inmundicias, ensuciando mi tabernáculo que está entre ellos.

verses.KJV: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.WEB: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;
verses.ASV: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed of copulation goeth from him, so that he is unclean thereby;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a lei do que tem fluxo, e do que sai derramamento seminal, vindo a ser impuro por causa disso;
verses.RVR09: Esta es la ley del que tiene flujo, y del que sale derramamiento de semen, viniendo á ser inmundo á causa de ello;

verses.KJV: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.WEB: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
verses.ASV: and of her that is sick with her impurity, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da que padece seu costume, e acerca do que tiver fluxo, seja homem ou fêmea, e do homem que dormir com mulher impura.
verses.RVR09: Y de la que padece su costumbre, y acerca del que tuviere flujo, sea varón ó hembra, y del hombre que durmiere con mujer inmunda.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the Lord, and died;
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before the LORD, and died;
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before Jehovah, and died;
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, depois que morreram os dois filhos de Arão, quando se chegaram diante do SENHOR, e morreram;
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, después que murieron los dos hijos de Aarón, cuando se llegaron delante de Jehová, y murieron;

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.WEB: and the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.
verses.ASV: and Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the mercy-seat which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy-seat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Dize a Arão teu irmão, que não em todo tempo entre no santuário do véu dentro, diante do propiciatório que está sobre a arca, para que não morra: porque eu aparecerei na nuvem sobre o propiciatório.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Di á Aarón tu hermano, que no en todo tiempo entre en el santuario del velo adentro, delante de la cubierta que está sobre el arca, para que no muera: porque yo apareceré en la nube sobre la cubierta.

verses.KJV: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.WEB: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.ASV: Herewith shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com isto entrará Arão no santuário: com um bezerro por expiação, e um carneiro em holocausto.
verses.RVR09: Con esto entrará Aarón en el santuario: con un becerro por expiación, y un carnero en holocausto.

verses.KJV: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
verses.WEB: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.
verses.ASV: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with the linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: they are the holy garments; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.
verses.ALMEIDA: A túnica santa de linho se vestirá, e sobre sua carne terá calções de linho, e se cingirá o cinto de linho; e com a mitra de linho se cobrirá: são as santas vestiduras: com elas, depois de lavar sua carne com água, se há de vestir.
verses.RVR09: La túnica santa de lino se vestirá, y sobre su carne tendrá pañetes de lino, y ceñiráse el cinto de lino; y con la mitra de lino se cubrirá: son las santas vestiduras: con ellas, después de lavar su carne con agua, se ha de vestir.

verses.KJV: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.WEB: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.ASV: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering, and one ram for a burnt-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da congregação dos filhos de Israel tomará dois machos de bode para expiação, e um carneiro para holocausto.
verses.RVR09: Y de la congregación de los hijos de Israel tomará dos machos de cabrío para expiación, y un carnero para holocausto.

verses.KJV: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.WEB: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
verses.ASV: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará achegar Arão o bezerro da expiação, que é seu, e fará a reconciliação por si e por sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y hará allegar Aarón el becerro de la expiación, que es suyo, y hará la reconciliación por sí y por su casa.

verses.KJV: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And he shall take the two goats, and set them before Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois tomará os dois machos de bode, e os apresentará diante do SENHOR à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Después tomará los dos machos de cabrío, y los presentará delante de Jehová á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the Lord, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.WEB: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.ASV: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Jehovah, and the other lot for Azazel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançará sortes Arão sobre os dois machos de bode; uma sorte pelo SENHOR, e a outra sorte por Azazel.
verses.RVR09: Y echará suertes Aarón sobre los dos machos de cabrío; la una suerte por Jehová, y la otra suerte por Azazel.

verses.KJV: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the Lord's lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
verses.WEB: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.
verses.ASV: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for Jehovah, and offer him for a sin-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará achegar Arão o bode macho sobre o qual cair a sorte pelo SENHOR, e o oferecerá em expiação.
verses.RVR09: Y hará allegar Aarón el macho cabrío sobre el cual cayere la suerte por Jehová, y ofrecerálo en expiación.

verses.KJV: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the Lord, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.WEB: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.ASV: But the goat, on which the lot fell for Azazel, shall be set alive before Jehovah, to make atonement for him, to send him away for Azazel into the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o bode macho, sobre o qual cair a sorte por Azazel, o apresentará vivo diante do SENHOR, para fazer a reconciliação sobre ele, para enviá-lo a Azazel ao deserto.
verses.RVR09: Mas el macho cabrío, sobre el cual cayere la suerte por Azazel, lo presentará vivo delante de Jehová, para hacer la reconciliación sobre él, para enviarlo á Azazel al desierto.

verses.KJV: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
verses.WEB: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.
verses.ASV: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin-offering which is for himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará chegar Arão o bezerro que era seu para expiação, e fará a reconciliação por si e por sua casa, e degolará em expiação o bezerro que é seu.
verses.RVR09: Y hará llegar Aarón el becerro que era suyo para expiación, y hará la reconciliación por sí y por su casa, y degollará en expiación el becerro que es suyo.

verses.KJV: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the Lord, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
verses.WEB: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.
verses.ASV: And he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Jehovah, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil:
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois tomará o incensário cheio de brasas de fogo, do altar de diante do SENHOR, e seus punhos cheios do incenso aromático prensado, e o meterá do véu dentro:
verses.RVR09: Después tomará el incensario lleno de brasas de fuego, del altar de delante de Jehová, y sus puños llenos del perfume aromático molido, y meterálo del velo adentro:

verses.KJV: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.WEB: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.
verses.ASV: and he shall put the incense upon the fire before Jehovah, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy-seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.ALMEIDA: E porá o incenso sobre o fogo diante do SENHOR, e a nuvem do incenso cobrirá o propiciatório que está sobre o testemunho, e não morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrá el perfume sobre el fuego delante de Jehová, y la nube del perfume cubrirá la cubierta que está sobre el testimonio, y no morirá.

verses.KJV: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.WEB: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.ASV: and he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy-seat on the east; and before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomará logo do sangue do bezerro, e espargirá com seu dedo até o propiciatório ao lado oriental: até o propiciatório espargirá sete vezes daquele sangue com seu dedo.
verses.RVR09: Tomará luego de la sangre del becerro, y rociará con su dedo hacia la cubierta al lado oriental: hacia la cubierta esparcirá siete veces de aquella sangre con su dedo.

verses.KJV: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.WEB: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.
verses.ASV: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin-offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy-seat, and before the mercy-seat:
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois degolará em expiação o bode macho, que era do povo, e meterá o sangue dele do véu dentro; e fará de seu sangue como fez do sangue do bezerro, e espargirá sobre o propiciatório e diante do propiciatório:
verses.RVR09: Después degollará en expiación el macho cabrío, que era del pueblo, y meterá la sangre de él del velo adentro; y hará de su sangre como hizo de la sangre del becerro, y esparcirá sobre la cubierta y delante de la cubierta:

verses.KJV: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.WEB: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.
verses.ASV: and he shall make atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins: and so shall he do for the tent of meeting, that dwelleth with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E limpará o santuário, das imundícias dos filhos de Israel, e de suas rebeliões, e de todos os seus pecados: da mesma maneira fará também ao tabernáculo do testemunho, o qual reside entre eles em meio de suas imundícias.
verses.RVR09: Y limpiará el santuario, de las inmundicias de los hijos de Israel, y de sus rebeliones, y de todos sus pecados: de la misma manera hará también al tabernáculo del testimonio, el cual reside entre ellos en medio de sus inmundicias.
