verses.KJV: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
verses.WEB: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
verses.ASV: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nenhum homem estará no tabernáculo do testemunho quando ele entrar a fazer a reconciliação no santuário, até que ele saia, e haja feito a reconciliação por si, e por sua casa, e por toda a congregação de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y ningún hombre estará en el tabernáculo del testimonio cuando él entrare á hacer la reconciliación en el santuario, hasta que él salga, y haya hecho la reconciliación por sí, y por su casa, y por toda la congregación de Israel.

verses.KJV: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the Lord, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.WEB: “He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.
verses.ASV: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before Jehovah, and make atonement for it, and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sairá ao altar que está diante do SENHOR, e o expiará; e tomará do sangue do bezerro, e do sangue do bode macho, e porá sobre as pontas do altar ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y saldrá al altar que está delante de Jehová, y lo expiará; y tomará de la sangre del becerro, y de la sangre del macho cabrío, y pondrá sobre los cuernos del altar alrededor.

verses.KJV: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E espargirá sobre ele do sangue com seu dedo sete vezes, e o limpará, e o santificará das imundícias dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y esparcirá sobre él de la sangre con su dedo siete veces, y lo limpiará, y lo santificará de las inmundicias de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.WEB: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
verses.ASV: And when he hath made an end of atoning for the holy place, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando houver acabado de expiar o santuário, e o tabernáculo do testemunho, e o altar, fará chegar o bode macho vivo:
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubiere acabado de expiar el santuario, y el tabernáculo del testimonio, y el altar, hará llegar el macho cabrío vivo:

verses.KJV: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
verses.WEB: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.
verses.ASV: and Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a man that is in readiness into the wilderness:
verses.ALMEIDA: E porá Arão ambas as mãos suas sobre a cabeça do bode macho vivo, e confessará sobre ele todas as iniquidades dos filhos de Israel, e todas suas rebeliões, e todos os seus pecados, pondo-os assim sobre a cabeça do bode macho, e o enviará ao deserto por meio de um homem destinado para isto.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrá Aarón ambas manos suyas sobre la cabeza del macho cabrío vivo, y confesará sobre él todas las iniquidades de los hijos de Israel, y todas sus rebeliones, y todos sus pecados, poniéndolos así sobre la cabeza del macho cabrío, y lo enviará al desierto por mano de un hombre destinado para esto.

verses.KJV: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: and the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a solitary land: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele bode macho levará sobre si todas as iniquidades deles a terra inabitada: e deixará ir o bode macho pelo deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel macho cabrío llevará sobre sí todas las iniquidades de ellos á tierra inhabitada: y dejará ir el macho cabrío por el desierto.

verses.KJV: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
verses.WEB: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.
verses.ASV: And Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois virá Arão ao tabernáculo do testemunho, e se desnudará as vestimentas de linho, que havia vestido para entrar no santuário, e as porá ali.
verses.RVR09: Después vendrá Aarón al tabernáculo del testimonio, y se desnudará las vestimentas de lino, que había vestido para entrar en el santuario, y pondrálas allí.

verses.KJV: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.WEB: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.ASV: and he shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt-offering and the burnt-offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lavará logo sua carne com água no lugar do santuário, e depois de se pôr suas roupas sairá, e fará seu holocausto, e o holocausto do povo, e fará a reconciliação por si e pelo povo.
verses.RVR09: Lavará luego su carne con agua en el lugar del santuario, y después de ponerse sus vestidos saldrá, y hará su holocausto, y el holocausto del pueblo, y hará la reconciliación por sí y por el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.WEB: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.
verses.ASV: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E queimará a gordura da expiação sobre o altar.
verses.RVR09: Y quemará el sebo de la expiación sobre el altar.

verses.KJV: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.WEB: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.ASV: And he that letteth go the goat for Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que houver levado o bode macho a Azazel, lavará suas roupas, lavará também com água sua carne, e depois entrará no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y el que hubiere llevado el macho cabrío á Azazel, lavará sus vestidos, lavará también con agua su carne, y después entrará en el real.

verses.KJV: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.WEB: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.
verses.ASV: And the bullock of the sin-offering, and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be carried forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirará fora do acampamento o bezerro do pecado, e o bode macho da culpa, o sangue dos quais foi metido para fazer a expiação no santuário; e queimarão no fogo suas peles, e suas carnes, e seu excremento.
verses.RVR09: Y sacará fuera del real el becerro del pecado, y el macho cabrío de la culpa, la sangre de los cuales fué metida para hacer la expiación en el santuario; y quemarán en el fuego sus pellejos, y sus carnes, y su estiércol.

verses.KJV: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.WEB: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.ASV: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que os queimar, lavará suas roupas, lavará também sua carne com água, e depois entrará no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y el que los quemare, lavará sus vestidos, lavará también su carne con agua, y después entrará en el real.

verses.KJV: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.WEB: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;
verses.ASV: And it shall be a statute for ever unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and shall do no manner of work, the home-born, or the stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto tereis por estatuto perpétuo: No mês sétimo, aos dez do mês, afligireis vossas almas, e nenhuma obra fareis, nem o natural nem o estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós:
verses.RVR09: Y esto tendréis por estatuto perpetuo: En el mes séptimo, á los diez del mes, afligiréis vuestras almas, y ninguna obra haréis, ni el natural ni el extranjero que peregrina entre vosotros:

verses.KJV: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the Lord.
verses.WEB: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
verses.ASV: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins shall ye be clean before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque neste dia se vos reconciliará para limpar-vos; e sereis limpos de todos vossos pecados diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque en este día se os reconciliará para limpiaros; y seréis limpios de todos vuestros pecados delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.WEB: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
verses.ASV: It is a sabbath of solemn rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; it is a statute for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sábado de repouso é para vós, e afligireis vossas almas, por estatuto perpétuo.
verses.RVR09: Sábado de reposo es para vosotros, y afligiréis vuestras almas, por estatuto perpetuo.

verses.KJV: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
verses.WEB: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.
verses.ASV: And the priest, who shall be anointed and who shall be consecrated to be priest in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments:
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará a reconciliação o sacerdote que for ungido, e cuja mão houver sido cheia para ser sacerdote em lugar de seu pai; e se vestirá as vestimentas de linho, as vestiduras sagradas:
verses.RVR09: Y hará la reconciliación el sacerdote que fuere ungido, y cuya mano hubiere sido llena para ser sacerdote en lugar de su padre; y se vestirá las vestimentas de lino, las vestiduras sagradas:

verses.KJV: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.WEB: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
verses.ASV: and he shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E expiará o santuário santo, e o tabernáculo do testemunho; expiará também o altar, e aos sacerdotes, e a todo o povo da congregação.
verses.RVR09: Y expiará el santuario santo, y el tabernáculo del testimonio; expiará también el altar, y á los sacerdotes, y á todo el pueblo de la congregación.

verses.KJV: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel because of all their sins once in the year. And he did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto tereis por estatuto perpétuo, para expiar aos filhos de Israel de todos os seus pecados uma vez no ano. E Moisés o fez como o SENHOR lhe mandou.
verses.RVR09: Y esto tendréis por estatuto perpetuo, para expiar á los hijos de Israel de todos sus pecados una vez en el año. Y Moisés lo hizo como Jehová le mandó.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, saying,
verses.WEB: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:
verses.ASV: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a Arão e a seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Isto é o que mandou o SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Habla á Aarón y á sus hijos, y á todos los hijos de Israel, y diles: Esto es lo que ha mandado Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
verses.WEB: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,
verses.ASV: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it without the camp,
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer homem da casa de Israel que degolar boi, ou cordeiro, ou cabra, no acampamento, ou fora do acampamento,
verses.RVR09: Cualquier varón de la casa de Israel que degollare buey, ó cordero, ó cabra, en el real, ó fuera del real,

verses.KJV: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the Lord before the tabernacle of the Lord; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.WEB: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to the LORD before the LORD’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.ASV: and hath not brought it unto the door of the tent of meeting, to offer it as an oblation unto Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah: blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.ALMEIDA: E não o trouxer à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, para oferecer oferta ao SENHOR diante do tabernáculo do SENHOR, sangue será imputado ao tal homem: sangue derramou; eliminado será o tal homem dentre seu povo:
verses.RVR09: Y no lo trajere á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, para ofrecer ofrenda á Jehová delante del tabernáculo de Jehová, sangre será imputada al tal varón: sangre derramó; cortado será el tal varón de entre su pueblo:

verses.KJV: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.
verses.ASV: to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace-offerings unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: A fim de que tragam os filhos de Israel seus sacrifícios, os que sacrificam sobre a face do campo, para que os tragam ao SENHOR à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho ao sacerdote, e sacrifiquem eles sacrifícios pacíficos ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: A fin de que traigan los hijos de Israel sus sacrificios, los que sacrifican sobre la haz del campo, para que los traigan á Jehová á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio al sacerdote, y sacrifiquen ellos sacrificios de paces á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote espargirá o sangue sobre o altar do SENHOR, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, e queimará a gordura em cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote esparcirá la sangre sobre el altar de Jehová, á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, y quemará el sebo en olor de suavidad á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.WEB: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’
verses.ASV: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto the he-goats, after which they play the harlot. This shall be a statute forever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nunca mais sacrificarão seus sacrifícios aos demônios, atrás dos quais se prostituíram: terão isto por estatuto perpétuo por suas gerações.
verses.RVR09: Y nunca más sacrificarán sus sacrificios á los demonios, tras de los cuales han fornicado: tendrán esto por estatuto perpetuo por sus edades.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.WEB: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.ASV: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that offereth a burnt-offering or sacrifice,
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu Lhes dirás também: Qualquer homem da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinam entre vós, que oferecer holocausto ou sacrifício,
verses.RVR09: Les dirás también: Cualquier varón de la casa de Israel, ó de los extranjeros que peregrinan entre vosotros, que ofreciere holocausto ó sacrificio,

verses.KJV: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the Lord; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.WEB: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ASV: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tent of meeting, to sacrifice it unto Jehovah; that man shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não o trouxer à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, para fazê-lo ao SENHOR, o tal homem será igualmente eliminado de seus povos.
verses.RVR09: Y no lo trajere á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, para hacerlo á Jehová, el tal varón será igualmente cortado de sus pueblos.

verses.KJV: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.WEB: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.ASV: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, I will set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer homem da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinam entre eles, que comer algum sangue, eu porei meu rosto contra a pessoa que comer sangue, e lhe cortarei dentre seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquier varón de la casa de Israel, ó de los extranjeros que peregrinan entre ellos, que comiere alguna sangre, yo pondré mi rostro contra la persona que comiere sangre, y le cortaré de entre su pueblo.

verses.KJV: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
verses.WEB: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.
verses.ASV: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh atonement by reason of the life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a vida da carne no sangue está: e eu vos a dei para expiar vossas pessoas sobre o altar: pelo qual o mesmo sangue expiará a pessoa.
verses.RVR09: Porque la vida de la carne en la sangre está: y yo os la he dado para expiar vuestras personas sobre el altar: por lo cual la misma sangre expiará la persona.

verses.KJV: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.WEB: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”
verses.ASV: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, disse aos filhos de Israel: Nenhuma pessoa de vós comerá sangue, nem o estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós comerá sangue.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he dicho á los hijos de Israel: Ninguna persona de vosotros comerá sangre, ni el extranjero que peregrina entre vosotros comerá sangre.

verses.KJV: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.WEB: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.
verses.ASV: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, who taketh in hunting any beast or bird that may be eaten; he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer homem dos filhos de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinam entre eles, que recolher caça de animal ou de ave que seja de comer, derramará seu sangue e o cobrirá com terra:
verses.RVR09: Y cualquier varón de los hijos de Israel, ó de los extranjeros que peregrinan entre ellos, que cogiere caza de animal ó de ave que sea de comer, derramará su sangre y cubrirála con tierra:

verses.KJV: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.WEB: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”
verses.ASV: For as to the life of all flesh, the blood thereof is [all one] with the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh; for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a alma de toda carne, sua vida, está em seu sangue: portanto disse aos filhos de Israel: Não comereis o sangue de nenhuma carne, porque a vida de toda carne é seu sangue; qualquer um que a comer será eliminado.
verses.RVR09: Porque el alma de toda carne, su vida, está en su sangre: por tanto he dicho á los hijos de Israel: No comeréis la sangre de ninguna carne, porque la vida de toda carne es su sangre: cualquiera que la comiere será cortado.

verses.KJV: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
verses.WEB: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.
verses.ASV: And every soul that eateth that which dieth of itself, or that which is torn of beasts, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer um pessoa que comer coisa morta ou despedaçada por fera, tanto dos naturais como dos estrangeiros, lavará suas roupas e a si mesmo se lavará com água, e será impuro até à tarde; e se limpará.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera persona que comiere cosa mortecina, ó despedazada por fiera, así de los naturales como de los extranjeros, lavará sus vestidos y á sí mismo se lavará con agua, y será inmundo hasta la tarde; y se limpiará.

verses.KJV: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.WEB: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”
verses.ASV: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não os lavar, nem lavar sua carne, levará sua iniquidade.
verses.RVR09: Y si no los lavare, ni lavare su carne, llevará su iniquidad.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.WEB: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.
verses.ASV: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não fareis como fazem na terra do Egito, na qual morastes; nem fareis como fazem na terra de Canaã, à qual eu vos conduzo; nem andareis em seus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: No haréis como hacen en la tierra de Egipto, en la cual morasteis; ni haréis como hacen en la tierra de Canaán, á la cual yo os conduzco; ni andaréis en sus estatutos.

verses.KJV: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and my statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus regulamentos poreis por obra, e meus estatutos guardareis, andando neles: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mis derechos pondréis por obra, y mis estatutos guardaréis, andando en ellos: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and mine ordinances; which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto meus estatutos e meus regulamentos guardareis, os quais fazendo o homem, viverá neles: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto mis estatutos y mis derechos guardaréis, los cuales haciendo el hombre, vivirá en ellos: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: None of you shall approach to any that are near of kin to him, to uncover [their] nakedness: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhum homem se achegue a nenhuma próxima de sua carne, para descobrir sua nudez: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ningún varón se allegue á ninguna cercana de su carne, para descubrir su desnudez: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.ASV: The nakedness of thy father, even the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez de teu pai, ou a nudez de tua mãe, não descobrirás: tua mãe é, não descobrirá sua nudez.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de tu padre, ó la desnudez de tu madre, no descubrirás: tu madre es, no descubrirás su desnudez.

verses.KJV: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.
verses.ASV: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover; it is thy father’s nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez da mulher de teu pai não descobrirás; é a nudez de teu pai.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de la mujer de tu padre no descubrirás; es la desnudez de tu padre.

verses.KJV: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.
verses.ASV: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or the daughter of thy mother, whether born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez de tua irmã, filha de teu pai, ou filha de tua mãe, nascida em casa ou nascida fora, sua nudez não descobrirás.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de tu hermana, hija de tu padre, ó hija de tu madre, nacida en casa ó nacida fuera, su desnudez no descubrirás.

verses.KJV: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.
verses.ASV: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez da filha de teu filho, ou da filha de tua filha, seu nudez não descobrirás, porque é a nudez tua.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de la hija de tu hijo, ó de la hija de tu hija, su desnudez no descubrirás, porque es la desnudez tuya.

verses.KJV: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.
verses.ASV: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez da filha da mulher de teu pai, gerada de teu pai, tua irmã é, sua nudez não descobrirás.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de la hija de la mujer de tu padre, engendrada de tu padre, tu hermana es, su desnudez no descubrirás.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez da irmã de teu pai não descobrirás: é parente de teu pai.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de la hermana de tu padre no descubrirás: es parienta de tu padre.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez da irmã de tua mãe não descobrirás: porque parente de tua mãe é.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de la hermana de tu madre no descubrirás: porque parienta de tu madre es.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez do irmão de teu pai não descobrirás: não chegarás à sua mulher: é mulher do irmão de teu pai.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez del hermano de tu padre no descubrirás: no llegarás á su mujer: es mujer del hermano de tu padre.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez de tua nora não descobrirás: mulher é de teu filho, não descobrirás sua nudez.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de tu nuera no descubrirás: mujer es de tu hijo; no descubrirás su desnudez.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez da mulher de teu irmão não descobrirás: é a nudez de teu irmão.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de la mujer de tu hermano no descubrirás: es la desnudez de tu hermano.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; thou shalt not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez da mulher e de sua filha não descobrirás: não tomarás a filha de seu filho, nem a filha de sua filha, para descobrir sua nudez: são parentes, é maldade.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de la mujer y de su hija no descubrirás: no tomarás la hija de su hijo, ni la hija de su hija, para descubrir su desnudez: son parientas, es maldad.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival [to her], to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tomarás mulher juntamente com sua irmã, para fazê-la sua rival, descobrindo sua nudez diante dela em sua vida.
verses.RVR09: No tomarás mujer juntamente con su hermana, para hacerla su rival, descubriendo su desnudez delante de ella en su vida.

verses.KJV: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não chegarás à mulher na separação de sua impureza, para descobrir sua nudez.
verses.RVR09: Y no llegarás á la mujer en el apartamiento de su inmundicia, para descubrir su desnudez.

verses.KJV: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbor’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, não terás ato carnal com a mulher de teu próximo, contaminando-te nela.
verses.RVR09: Además, no tendrás acto carnal con la mujer de tu prójimo, contaminándote en ella.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not give any of thy seed to make them pass through [the fire] to Molech; neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não dês de tua descendência para fazê-la passar pelo fogo a Moloque; não contamines o nome de teu Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y no des de tu simiente para hacerla pasar por el fuego á Moloch; no contamines el nombre de tu Dios: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te deitarás com homem como com mulher: é abominação.
verses.RVR09: No te echarás con varón como con mujer: es abominación.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem com nenhum animal terás ajuntamento contaminando-te com ele; nem mulher alguma se porá diante de animal para ajuntar-se com ele: é confusão.
verses.RVR09: Ni con ningún animal tendrás ayuntamiento amancillándote con él; ni mujer alguna se pondrá delante de animal para ayuntarse con él: es confusión.

verses.KJV: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.WEB: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.
verses.ASV: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out from before you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Em nenhuma destas coisas vos contaminareis; porque em todas estas coisas se poluíram as nações que eu expulso de diante de vós:
verses.RVR09: En ninguna de estas cosas os amancillaréis; porque en todas estas cosas se han ensuciado las gentes que yo echo de delante de vosotros:

verses.KJV: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.WEB: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
verses.ASV: and the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra foi contaminada; e eu visitei sua maldade sobre ela, e a terra vomitou seus moradores.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra fué contaminada; y yo visité su maldad sobre ella, y la tierra vomitó sus moradores.

verses.KJV: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.WEB: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you
verses.ASV: Ye therefore shall keep my statutes and mine ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the home-born, nor the stranger that sojourneth among you
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai, pois, vós meus estatutos e meus regulamentos, e não façais nenhuma de todas estas abominações: nem o natural nem o estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Guardad, pues, vosotros mis estatutos y mis derechos, y no hagáis ninguna de todas estas abominaciones: ni el natural ni el extranjero que peregrina entre vosotros.

verses.KJV: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.WEB: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),
verses.ASV: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land is defiled);
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque todas estas abominações fizeram os homens da terra, que foram antes de vós, e a terra foi contaminada:)
verses.RVR09: (Porque todas estas abominaciones hicieron los hombres de la tierra, que fueron antes de vosotros, y la tierra fué contaminada:)

verses.KJV: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
verses.WEB: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
verses.ASV: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra não vos vomitará, por havê-la contaminado, como vomitou à gente que foi antes de vós.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra no os vomitará, por haberla contaminado, como vomitó á la gente que fué antes de vosotros.

verses.KJV: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.WEB: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.ASV: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque qualquer um que fizer alguma de todas estas abominações, as pessoas que as fizerem, serão eliminadas dentre seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquiera que hiciere alguna de todas estas abominaciones, las personas que las hicieren, serán cortadas de entre su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”
verses.ASV: Therefore shall ye keep my charge, that ye practise not any of these abominable customs, which were practised before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai, pois, minha ordenança, não fazendo das práticas abomináveis que tiveram lugar antes de vós, e não vos torneis abomináveis nelas: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Guardad, pues, mi ordenanza, no haciendo de las prácticas abominables que tuvieron lugar antes de vosotros, y no os ensuciéis en ellas: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy.
verses.WEB: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.
verses.ASV: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy; for I Jehovah your God am holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Santos sereis, porque santo sou eu o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Habla á toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, y diles: Santos seréis, porque santo soy yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father; and ye shall keep my sabbaths: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um temerá a sua mãe e a seu pai, e meus sábados guardareis: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno temerá á su madre y á su padre, y mis sábados guardaréis: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos voltareis aos ídolos, nem fareis para vós deuses de fundição: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: No os volveréis á los ídolos, ni haréis para vosotros dioses de fundición: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.WEB: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
verses.ASV: And when ye offer a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, ye shall offer it that ye may be accepted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando sacrificardes sacrifício pacífico ao SENHOR, de vossa vontade o sacrificareis.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando sacrificareis sacrificio de paces á Jehová, de vuestra voluntad lo sacrificaréis.

verses.KJV: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.WEB: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
verses.ASV: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será comido o dia que o sacrificardes, e o dia seguinte: e o que restar para o terceiro dia, será queimado no fogo.
verses.RVR09: Será comido el día que lo sacrificareis, y el siguiente día: y lo que quedare para el tercer día, será quemado en el fuego.

verses.KJV: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.WEB: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;
verses.ASV: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it shall not be accepted:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se se comer no dia terceiro, será abominação; não será aceito:
verses.RVR09: Y si se comiere el día tercero, será abominación; no será acepto:

verses.KJV: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.WEB: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ASV: but every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the holy thing of Jehovah: and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que o comer, levará seu delito, porquanto profanou o santo do SENHOR; e a tal pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.
verses.RVR09: Y el que lo comiere, llevará su delito, por cuanto profanó lo santo de Jehová; y la tal persona será cortada de sus pueblos.

verses.KJV: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.WEB: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
verses.ASV: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ceifardes na colheita de vossa terra, não acabarás de ceifar o canto de tua plantação, nem espigarás tua terra ceifada.
verses.RVR09: Cuando segareis la mies de vuestra tierra, no acabarás de segar el rincón de tu haza, ni espigarás tu tierra segada.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the fallen fruit of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não coletarás os restos de tua vinha, nem recolherás as uvas caídas de tua vinha; para o pobre e para o estrangeiro os deixarás: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y no rebuscarás tu viña, ni recogerás los granos caídos de tu viña; para el pobre y para el extranjero los dejarás: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not steal; neither shall ye deal falsely, nor lie one to another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não furtareis, e não enganareis, nem mentireis ninguém a seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: No hurtaréis, y no engañaréis, ni mentiréis ninguno á su prójimo.

verses.KJV: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não jurareis em meu nome com mentira, nem profanarás o nome de teu Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y no juraréis en mi nombre con mentira, ni profanarás el nombre de tu Dios: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbor, nor rob him: the wages of a hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não oprimirás a teu próximo, nem lhe roubarás. Não se deterá o trabalho do assalariado em tua casa até a manhã.
verses.RVR09: No oprimirás á tu prójimo, ni le robarás. No se detendrá el trabajo del jornalero en tu casa hasta la mañana.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind; but thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não amaldiçoes ao surdo, e diante do cego não ponhas tropeço, mas terás temor de teu Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No maldigas al sordo, y delante del ciego no pongas tropiezo, mas tendrás temor de tu Dios: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.
verses.ASV: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty; but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não farás injustiça no juízo: não favorecerás deslealmente ao pobre, nem honrarás a face do poderoso: com justiça julgarás a teu próximo.
verses.RVR09: No harás agravio en el juicio: no tendrás respeto al pobre, ni honrarás la cara del grande: con justicia juzgarás á tu prójimo.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour; I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbor: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não andarás propagando boatos em teus povos. Não te porás contra o sangue de teu próximo: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No andarás chismeando en tus pueblos. No te pondrás contra la sangre de tu prójimo: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart: thou shalt surely rebuke thy neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não aborrecerás a teu irmão em teu coração: francamente repreenderás a teu próximo, e não consentirás sobre ele pecado.
verses.RVR09: No aborrecerás á tu hermano en tu corazón: ingenuamente reprenderás á tu prójimo, y no consentirás sobre él pecado.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te vingarás, nem guardarás rancor aos filhos de teu povo: mas amarás a teu próximo como a ti mesmo: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No te vengarás, ni guardarás rencor á los hijos de tu pueblo: mas amarás á tu prójimo como á ti mismo: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.
verses.ASV: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with two kinds of seed: neither shall there come upon thee a garment of two kinds of stuff mingled together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus estatutos guardareis. A teu animal não farás ajuntar para espécies misturadas; tua plantação não semearás com mistura de sementes, e não te porás roupas com mistura de diversos materiais.
verses.RVR09: Mis estatutos guardaréis. A tu animal no harás ayuntar para misturas; tu haza no sembrarás con mistura de semillas, y no te pondrás vestidos con mezcla de diversas cosas.

verses.KJV: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.ASV: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to a husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; they shall be punished; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando um homem tiver relação sexual com mulher, e ela for serva desposada com alguém, e não estiver resgatada, nem lhe houver sido dada liberdade, ambos serão açoitados: não morrerão, porquanto ela não é livre.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando un hombre tuviere cópula con mujer, y ella fuere sierva desposada con alguno, y no estuviere rescatada, ni le hubiere sido dada libertad, ambos serán azotados: no morirán, por cuanto ella no es libre.

verses.KJV: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.WEB: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.ASV: And he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, even a ram for a trespass-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele trará ao SENHOR, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, um carneiro em expiação por sua culpa.
verses.RVR09: Y él traerá á Jehová, á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, un carnero en expiación por su culpa.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.WEB: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering before Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned: and the sin which he hath sinned shall be forgiven him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com o carneiro da expiação o reconciliará o sacerdote diante do SENHOR, por seu pecado que cometeu: e se lhe perdoará seu pecado que cometeu.
verses.RVR09: Y con el carnero de la expiación lo reconciliará el sacerdote delante de Jehová, por su pecado que cometió: y se le perdonará su pecado que ha cometido.

verses.KJV: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.WEB: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.
verses.ASV: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as their uncircumcision: three years shall they be as uncircumcised unto you; it shall not be eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando houverdes entrado na terra, e plantardes toda árvore de comer, tirareis seu prepúcio, o primeiro de seu fruto: três anos vos será incircunciso: seu fruto não se comerá.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubiereis entrado en la tierra, y plantareis todo árbol de comer, quitaréis su prepucio, lo primero de su fruto: tres años os será incircunciso: su fruto no se comerá.

verses.KJV: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the Lord withal.
verses.WEB: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.
verses.ASV: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy, for giving praise unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o quarto ano todo seu fruto será santidade de louvores ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el cuarto año todo su fruto será santidad de loores á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao quinto ano comereis o fruto dele, para que vos faça crescer seu fruto: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas al quinto año comeréis el fruto de él, para que os haga crecer su fruto: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not eat anything with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantments, nor practise augury.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não comereis coisa alguma com sangue. Não sereis encantadores, nem fareis adivinhações.
verses.RVR09: No comeréis cosa alguna con sangre. No seréis agoreros, ni adivinaréis.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não cortareis em redondo as extremidades de vossas cabeças, nem danificarás a ponta de tua barba.
verses.RVR09: No cortaréis en redondo las extremidades de vuestras cabezas, ni dañarás la punta de tu barba.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não fareis cortes em vossa carne por um morto, nem imprimireis em vós sinal alguma: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y no haréis rasguños en vuestra carne por un muerto, ni imprimiréis en vosotros señal alguna: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.WEB: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.ASV: Profane not thy daughter, to make her a harlot; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não contaminarás tua filha fazendo-a se prostituir: para não se prostitua a terra, e se encha de maldade.
verses.RVR09: No contaminarás tu hija haciéndola fornicar: porque no se prostituya la tierra, y se hincha de maldad.

verses.KJV: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus sábados guardareis, e meu santuário tereis em reverência: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mis sábados guardaréis, y mi santuario tendréis en reverencia: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Turn ye not unto them that have familiar spirits, nor unto the wizards; seek them not out, to be defiled by them: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos volteis aos encantadores e aos adivinhos: não os consulteis contaminando-vos com eles: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: No os volváis á los encantadores y á los adivinos: no los consultéis ensuciándoos con ellos: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante das cãs te levantarás, e honrarás o rosto do ancião, e de teu Deus terás temor: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Delante de las canas te levantarás, y honrarás el rostro del anciano, y de tu Dios tendrás temor: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
verses.WEB: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
verses.ASV: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not do him wrong.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o estrangeiro morar contigo em vossa terra, não o oprimireis.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando el extranjero morare contigo en vuestra tierra, no le oprimiréis.

verses.KJV: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: The stranger that sojourneth with you shall be unto you as the home-born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como a um natural de vós tereis ao estrangeiro que peregrinar entre vós; e ama-o como a ti mesmo; porque peregrinos fostes na terra do Egito: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Como á un natural de vosotros tendréis al extranjero que peregrinare entre vosotros; y ámalo como á ti mismo; porque peregrinos fuisteis en la tierra de Egipto: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
verses.ASV: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não façais injustiça no juízo, na medida da terra, nem no peso, nem em outra medida.
verses.RVR09: No hagáis agravio en juicio, en medida de tierra, ni en peso, ni en otra medida.

verses.KJV: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Balanças justas, pesos justos, efa justo, e him justo tereis. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Balanzas justas, pesas justas, epha justo, é hin justo tendréis: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios, que os saqué de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai, pois, todos os meus estatutos, e todos os meus regulamentos, e os praticai. Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Guardad pues todos mis estatutos, y todos mis derechos, y ponedlos por obra: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés diciendo:

verses.KJV: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.WEB: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.
verses.ASV: Moreover, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dirás também aos filhos de Israel: Qualquer homem dos filhos de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinam em Israel, que oferecer de sua descendência a Moloque, certamente morrerá; o povo da terra o apedrejará.
verses.RVR09: Dirás asimismo á los hijos de Israel: Cualquier varón de los hijos de Israel, ó de los extranjeros que peregrinan en Israel, que diere de su simiente á Moloch, de seguro morirá: el pueblo de la tierra lo apedreará con piedras.

verses.KJV: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.WEB: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.ASV: I also will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu porei o meu rosto contra esse homem, e o eliminarei do meio do seu povo; porque deu de sua descendência a Moloque, contaminando o meu santuário, e profanando o meu santo nome.
verses.RVR09: Y yo pondré mi rostro contra el tal varón, y lo cortaré de entre su pueblo; por cuanto dió de su simiente á Moloch, contaminando mi santuario, y amancillando mi santo nombre.

verses.KJV: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
verses.WEB: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,
verses.ASV: And if the people of the land do at all hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and put him not to death;
verses.ALMEIDA: E, se o povo daquela terra esconder os seus olhos daquele homem que houver dado de sua descendência a Moloque, para não o matar,
verses.RVR09: Que si escondiere el pueblo de la tierra sus ojos de aquel varón que hubiere dado de su simiente á Moloch, para no matarle,

verses.KJV: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.WEB: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.
verses.ASV: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that play the harlot after him, to play the harlot with Molech, from among their people.
verses.ALMEIDA: então eu porei o meu rosto contra aquele homem, e contra a sua família, e o eliminarei do meio do seu povo, com todos os que se prostituem seguindo-o, prostituindo-se com Moloque.
verses.RVR09: Entonces yo pondré mi rostro contra aquel varón, y contra su familia, y le cortaré de entre su pueblo, con todos los que fornicaron en pos de él, prostituyéndose con Moloch.

verses.KJV: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.WEB: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.ASV: And the soul that turneth unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto the wizards, to play the harlot after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se uma pessoa se voltar aos que consultam os mortos ou aos adivinhos, para se prostituir seguindo-os, eu porei o meu rosto contra aquela pessoa, e a eliminarei do meio do seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y la persona que atendiere á encantadores ó adivinos, para prostituirse tras de ellos, yo pondré mi rostro contra la tal persona, y cortaréla de entre su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.
