verses.ASV: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Santificai-vos, pois, e sede santos, porque eu o SENHOR sou vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Santificaos, pues, y sed santos, porque yo Jehová soy vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the Lord which sanctify you.
verses.WEB: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
verses.ASV: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E guardai meus estatutos, e os praticai. Eu sou o SENHOR que vos santifico.
verses.RVR09: Y guardad mis estatutos, y ponedlos por obra: Yo Jehová que os santifico.

verses.KJV: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.WEB: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.
verses.ASV: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que amaldiçoar seu pai ou sua mãe certamente morrerá; a seu pai ou a sua mãe amaldiçoou; seu sangue será sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Porque varón que maldijere á su padre ó á su madre, de cierto morirá: á su padre ó á su madre maldijo; su sangre será sobre él.

verses.KJV: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem que adulterar com a mulher de outro, o que cometer adultério com a mulher de seu próximo, certamente se condenará à morte o adúltero e a adúltera.
verses.RVR09: Y el hombre que adulterare con la mujer de otro, el que cometiere adulterio con la mujer de su prójimo, indefectiblemente se hará morir al adúltero y á la adúltera.

verses.KJV: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.WEB: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
verses.ASV: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que se deitar com a mulher de seu pai terá revelou a nudez de seu pai; ambos serão mortos; seu sangue será sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que se echare con la mujer de su padre, la desnudez de su padre descubrió: ambos han de ser muertos; su sangre será sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
verses.ASV: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que se deitar com a sua nora, ambos terão de morrer; fizeram abominação; seu sangue será sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que durmiere con su nuera, ambos han de morir: hicieron confusión; su sangre será sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
verses.ASV: And if a man lie with mankind, as with womankind, both of them have committed abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que se deitar com homem como se fosse com mulher, fizeram abominação entre ambos; terão de ser mortos; seu sangue será sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que tuviere ayuntamiento con varón como con mujer, abominación hicieron: entrambos han de ser muertos; sobre ellos será su sangre.

verses.KJV: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.
verses.ASV: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que tomar para si uma mulher e a mãe dela comete depravação; queimarão com fogo ele e elas, para que não haja depravação no meio de vós.
verses.RVR09: Y el que tomare mujer y á la madre de ella, comete vileza: quemarán en fuego á él y á ellas, porque no haya vileza entre vosotros.

verses.KJV: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
verses.ASV: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que tiver relação sexual com animal será morto; e matareis ao animal.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que tuviere cópula con bestia, ha de ser muerto; y mataréis á la bestia.

verses.KJV: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.WEB: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.
verses.ASV: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher que se aproximar de algum animal, para ter relação sexual com ele, à mulher e ao animal matarás; certamente morrerão; seu sangue será sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer que se allegare á algún animal, para tener ayuntamiento con él, á la mujer y al animal matarás: morirán infaliblemente; será su sangre sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.
verses.ASV: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que tomar a sua irmã, filha de seu pai ou filha de sua mãe, e vir sua nudez, e ela vir a sua, coisa é execrável; portanto serão mortos à vista dos filhos de seu povo; revelou a nudez de sua irmã; levará consigo o seu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que tomare á su hermana, hija de su padre ó hija de su madre, y viere su desnudez, y ella viere la suya, cosa es execrable; por tanto serán muertos á ojos de los hijos de su pueblo: descubrió la desnudez de su hermana; su pecado llevará.

verses.KJV: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.ASV: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath made naked her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que se deitar com mulher menstruada, e descobrir sua nudez, descobriu a sua fonte, e ela descobriu a fonte de seu sangue; ambos serão eliminados do meio do seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que durmiere con mujer menstruosa, y descubriere su desnudez, su fuente descubrió, y ella descubrió la fuente de su sangre: ambos serán cortados de entre su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister; for he hath made naked his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nudez da irmã de tua mãe, ou da irmã de teu pai, não descobrirás; uma vez que descobriu sua parente, levarão sobresi a sua perversidade.
verses.RVR09: La desnudez de la hermana de tu madre, ó de la hermana de tu padre, no descubrirás: por cuanto descubrió su parienta, su iniquidad llevarán.

verses.KJV: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.WEB: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.
verses.ASV: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer um que dormir com a mulher do irmão de seu pai, a nudez do irmão de seu pai descobriu; seu pecado levarão; morrerão sem filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera que durmiere con la mujer del hermano de su padre, la desnudez del hermano de su padre descubrió; su pecado llevarán; morirán sin hijos.

verses.KJV: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.
verses.ASV: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is impurity: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que tomar a mulher de seu irmão, é imundícia; a nudez de seu irmão descobriu; sem filhos serão.
verses.RVR09: Y el que tomare la mujer de su hermano, es suciedad; la desnudez de su hermano descubrió; sin hijos serán.

verses.KJV: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.
verses.ASV: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them; that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, vomit you not out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai, pois, todos meus estatutos e todos meus regulamentos, e ponde-os por obra: e não vos vomitará a terra, na qual eu vos introduzo para que habiteis nela.
verses.RVR09: Guardad, pues, todos mis estatutos y todos mis derechos, y ponedlos por obra: y no os vomitará la tierra, en la cual yo os introduzco para que habitéis en ella.

verses.KJV: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.WEB: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.ASV: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não andeis nas práticas da gente que eu lançarei de diante de vós: porque eles fizeram todas estas coisas, e os tive em abominação.
verses.RVR09: Y no andéis en las prácticas de la gente que yo echaré de delante de vosotros: porque ellos hicieron todas estas cosas, y los tuve en abominación.

verses.KJV: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God, which have separated you from other people.
verses.WEB: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.
verses.ASV: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am Jehovah your God, who hath separated you from the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a vós vos disse: Vós possuireis a terra deles, e eu a darei a vós para que a possuais por herança, terra que flui leite e mel: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos separei dos povos.
verses.RVR09: Empero á vosotros os he dicho: Vosotros poseeréis la tierra de ellos, y yo os la daré para que la poseáis por heredad, tierra que fluye leche y miel: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios, que os he apartado de los pueblos.

verses.KJV: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.
verses.ASV: Ye shall therefore make a distinction between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by bird, or by anything wherewith the ground teemeth, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, vós fareis diferença entre animal limpo e impuro, e entre ave impura e limpa: e não torneis abomináveis vossas pessoas nos animais, nem nas aves, nem em nenhuma coisa que vai arrastando pela terra, as quais vos separei por impuras.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, vosotros haréis diferencia entre animal limpio é inmundo, y entre ave inmunda y limpia: y no ensuciéis vuestras personas en los animales, ni en las aves, ni en ninguna cosa que va arrastrando por la tierra, las cuales os he apartado por inmundas.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.
verses.WEB: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.
verses.ASV: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I, Jehovah, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that ye should be mine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haveis, pois, de ser para mim santos, porque eu o SENHOR sou santo, e vos separei dos povos, para que sejais meus.
verses.RVR09: Habéis, pues, de serme santos, porque yo Jehová soy santo, y os he apartado de los pueblos, para que seáis míos.

verses.KJV: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
verses.WEB: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”
verses.ASV: A man also or a woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem ou a mulher em que houver espírito mediúnico ou de adivinhação, terão de ser mortos; os apedrejarão com pedras; seu próprio sangue [será] sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y el hombre ó la mujer en quienes hubiere espíritu pithónico ó de adivinación, han de ser muertos: los apedrearán con piedras; su sangre sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none defile himself for the dead among his people;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Fala aos sacerdotes filhos de Arão, e dize-lhes que não se contaminem por um morto em seus povos.
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ dijo á Moisés: Habla á los sacerdotes hijos de Aarón, y diles que no se contaminen por un muerto en sus pueblos.

verses.KJV: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother.
verses.WEB: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,
verses.ASV: except for his kin, that is near unto him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
verses.ALMEIDA: A não ser por seu parente próximo a si, por sua mãe, ou por seu pai, ou por seu filho, ou por seu irmão,
verses.RVR09: Mas por su pariente cercano á sí, por su madre, ó por su padre, ó por su hijo, ó por su hermano,

verses.KJV: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
verses.WEB: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.
verses.ASV: and for his sister a virgin, that is near unto him, that hath had no husband; for her may he defile himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: ou por sua irmã virgem, a ele próxima, a qual não tenha tido marido, por ela se contaminará.
verses.RVR09: O por su hermana virgen, á él cercana, la cual no haya tenido marido, por ella se contaminará.

verses.KJV: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.WEB: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.ASV: He shall not defile himself, [being] a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque é líder em seu povo, não se contaminará, fazendo-se impuro.
verses.RVR09: No se contaminará, porque es príncipe en sus pueblos, haciéndose inmundo.

verses.KJV: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.WEB: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.ASV: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não farão calva em sua cabeça, nem raparão a ponta de sua barba, nem em sua carne farão cortes.
verses.RVR09: No harán calva en su cabeza, ni raerán la punta de su barba, ni en su carne harán rasguños.

verses.KJV: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
verses.WEB: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.
verses.ASV: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Santos serão a seu Deus, e não profanarão o nome de seu Deus; porque oferecem os fogos do SENHOR e o pão de seu Deus; portanto, serão santos.
verses.RVR09: Santos serán á su Dios, y no profanarán el nombre de su Dios; porque los fuegos de Jehová y el pan de su Dios ofrecen: por tanto serán santos.

verses.KJV: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
verses.WEB: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.
verses.ASV: They shall not take a woman that is a harlot, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mulher prostituta ou infame não tomarão: nem tomarão mulher repudiada de seu marido: porque é santo a seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mujer ramera ó infame no tomarán: ni tomarán mujer repudiada de su marido: porque es santo á su Dios.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the Lord, which sanctify you, am holy.
verses.WEB: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee; for I Jehovah, who sanctify you, am holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: O santificarás portanto, pois o pão de teu Deus oferece: santo será para ti, porque santo sou eu o SENHOR vosso santificador.
verses.RVR09: Lo santificarás por tanto, pues el pan de tu Dios ofrece: santo será para ti, porque santo soy yo Jehová vuestro santificador.

verses.KJV: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
verses.WEB: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.
verses.ASV: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the harlot, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a filha do homem sacerdote, se começar a se prostituir, a seu pai profana: queimada será ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y la hija del varón sacerdote, si comenzare á fornicar, á su padre amancilla: quemada será al fuego.

verses.KJV: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
verses.WEB: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.
verses.ASV: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head go loose, nor rend his clothes;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele que é o sumo sacerdote entre seus irmãos, sobre cuja cabeça foi derramado o azeite da unção, e que foi consagrado para usar as vestimentas, não descobrirá sua cabeça, nem rasgará as suas vestes;
verses.RVR09: Y el sumo sacerdote entre sus hermanos, sobre cuya cabeza fué derramado el aceite de la unción, y que hinchió su mano para vestir las vestimentas, no descubrirá su cabeza, ni romperá sus vestidos:

verses.KJV: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
verses.WEB: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.
verses.ASV: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
verses.ALMEIDA: nem entrará onde haja alguma pessoa morta, nem por seu pai, ou por sua mãe se contaminará.
verses.RVR09: Ni entrará donde haya alguna persona muerta, ni por su padre, ó por su madre se contaminará.

verses.KJV: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: nem sairá do santuário, nem contaminará o santuário de seu Deus; porque a coroa do azeite da unção de seu Deus está sobre ele: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ni saldrá del santuario, ni contaminará el santuario de su Dios; porque la corona del aceite de la unción de su Dios está sobre él: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.WEB: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.ASV: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomará ele mulher com sua virgindade.
verses.RVR09: Y tomará él mujer con su virginidad.

verses.KJV: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
verses.WEB: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.
verses.ASV: A widow, or one divorced, or a profane woman, a harlot, these shall he not take: but a virgin of his own people shall he take to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Viúva, ou repudiada, ou infame, ou prostituta, estas não tomará: mas tomará virgem de seus povos por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Viuda, ó repudiada, ó infame, ó ramera, éstas no tomará: mas tomará virgen de sus pueblos por mujer.

verses.KJV: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the Lord do sanctify him.
verses.WEB: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”
verses.ASV: And he shall not profane his seed among his people: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não profanará sua descendência em seus povos; porque eu o SENHOR sou o que os santifico.
verses.RVR09: Y no amancillará su simiente en sus pueblos; porque yo Jehová soy el que los santifico.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.WEB: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.ASV: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed throughout their generations that hath a blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a Arão, e dize-lhe: O homem de tua semente em suas gerações, no qual houver falta, não se achegará para oferecer o pão de seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Habla á Aarón, y dile: El varón de tu simiente en sus generaciones, en el cual hubiere falta, no se allegará para ofrecer el pan de su Dios.

verses.KJV: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
verses.WEB: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
verses.ASV: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or anything superfluous,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nenhum homem no qual houver falta, se achegará: homem cego, ou coxo, ou rosto mutilado, ou membro deformado,
verses.RVR09: Porque ningún varón en el cual hubiere falta, se allegará: varón ciego, ó cojo, ó falto, ó sobrado,

verses.KJV: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
verses.WEB: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,
verses.ASV: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou homem no qual houver fratura de pé ou rotura da mão,
verses.RVR09: O varón en el cual hubiere quebradura de pie ó rotura de mano,

verses.KJV: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
verses.WEB: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
verses.ASV: or crook-backed, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or is scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou corcunda, ou anão, ou que tiver visão embaçada, ou que tenha sarna, ou impigem, ou testículo mutilado;
verses.RVR09: O corcovado, ó lagañoso, ó que tuviere nube en el ojo, ó que tenga sarna, ó empeine, ó compañón relajado;

verses.KJV: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the Lord made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
verses.WEB: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
verses.ASV: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest, that hath a blemish, shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhum homem da descendência de Arão sacerdote, no qual houver falta, se achegará para oferecer as ofertas acendidas do SENHOR. Há falta nele; não se achegará a oferecer o pão de seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Ningún varón de la simiente de Aarón sacerdote, en el cual hubiere falta, se allegará para ofrecer las ofrendas encendidas de Jehová. Hay falta en él; no se allegará á ofrecer el pan de su Dios.

verses.KJV: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
verses.WEB: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
verses.ASV: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy:
verses.ALMEIDA: O pão de seu Deus, do muito santo e as coisas santificadas, comerá.
verses.RVR09: El pan de su Dios, de lo muy santo y las cosas santificadas, comerá.

verses.KJV: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the Lord do sanctify them.
verses.WEB: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
verses.ASV: only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não entrará do véu dentro, nem se achegará ao altar, porquanto há falta nele: e não profanará meu santuário, porque eu o SENHOR sou o que os santifico.
verses.RVR09: Empero no entrará del velo adentro, ni se allegará al altar, por cuanto hay falta en él: y no profanará mi santuario, porque yo Jehová soy el que los santifico.

verses.KJV: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: So Moses spake unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés falou isto a Arão, e a seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés habló esto á Aarón, y á sus hijos, y á todos los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they hallow unto me, and that they profane not my holy name: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize a Arão e a seus filhos, que se abstenham das coisas santas dos filhos de Israel, e que não profanem meu santo nome no que eles me santificam: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Di á Aarón y á sus hijos, que se abstengan de las santificaciones de los hijos de Israel, y que no profanen mi santo nombre en lo que ellos me santifican: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed throughout your generations, that approacheth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize-lhes: Todo homem de toda vossa descendência em vossas gerações que chegar às coisas sagradas, que os filhos de Israel consagram ao SENHOR, tendo imundícia sobre si, de diante de mim será eliminada sua alma: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Diles: Todo varón de toda vuestra simiente en vuestras generaciones que llegare á las cosas sagradas, que los hijos de Israel consagran á Jehová, teniendo inmundicia sobre sí, de delante de mí será cortada su alma: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
verses.WEB: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,
verses.ASV: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer homem da semente de Arão que for leproso, ou padecer fluxo, não comerá das coisas sagradas até que esteja limpo: e o que tocar qualquer coisa impura de cadáver, ou o homem do qual houver saído derramamento de sêmen;
verses.RVR09: Cualquier varón de la simiente de Aarón que fuere leproso, ó padeciere flujo, no comerá de las cosas sagradas hasta que esté limpio: y el que tocare cualquiera cosa inmunda de mortecino, ó el varón del cual hubiere salido derramamiento de semen;

verses.KJV: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
verses.WEB: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—
verses.ASV: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou o homem que houver tocado qualquer réptil ou inseto, pelo qual será impuro, ou homem pelo qual venha a ser impuro, conforme qualquer imundícia sua;
verses.RVR09: O el varón que hubiere tocado cualquier reptil, por el cual será inmundo, ú hombre por el cual venga á ser inmundo, conforme á cualquiera inmundicia suya;

verses.KJV: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
verses.WEB: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.
verses.ASV: the soul that toucheth any such shall be unclean until the even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his flesh in water.
verses.ALMEIDA: A pessoa que o tocar, será impura até à tarde, e não comerá das coisas sagradas antes que tenha lavado sua carne com água.
verses.RVR09: La persona que lo tocare, será inmunda hasta la tarde, y no comerá de las cosas sagradas antes que haya lavado su carne con agua.

verses.KJV: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
verses.WEB: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
verses.ASV: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o sol se puser, será limpo; e depois comerá as coisas sagradas, porque seu pão é.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando el sol se pusiere, será limpio; y después comerá las cosas sagradas, porque su pan es.

verses.KJV: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith; I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat, to defile himself therewith: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O morto naturalmente nem despedaçado por fera não comerá, para contaminar-se em ele: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mortecino ni despedazado por fiera no comerá, para contaminarse en ello: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the Lord do sanctify them.
verses.WEB: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
verses.ASV: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardem, pois, minha ordenança, e não levem pecado por ele, não seja que assim morram quando a profanarem: Eu sou o SENHOR que os santifico.
verses.RVR09: Guarden, pues, mi ordenanza, y no lleven pecado por ello, no sea que así mueran cuando la profanaren: Yo Jehová que los santifico.

verses.KJV: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.WEB: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.ASV: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest’s, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhum estranho comerá coisa sagrada; o hóspede do sacerdote, nem o empregado, não comerá coisa sagrada.
verses.RVR09: Ningún extraño comerá cosa sagrada; el huésped del sacerdote, ni el jornalero, no comerá cosa sagrada.

verses.KJV: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
verses.WEB: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.
verses.ASV: But if a priest buy any soul, the purchase of his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o sacerdote, quando comprar pessoa de seu dinheiro, esta comerá dela, e o nascido em sua casa: estes comerão de seu pão.
verses.RVR09: Mas el sacerdote, cuando comprare persona de su dinero, ésta comerá de ella, y el nacido en su casa: éstos comerán de su pan.

verses.KJV: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
verses.WEB: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
verses.ASV: And if a priest’s daughter be married unto a stranger, she shall not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a filha do sacerdote, quando se casar com homem estranho, ela não comerá da oferta das coisas sagradas.
verses.RVR09: Empero la hija del sacerdote, cuando se casare con varón extraño, ella no comerá de la ofrenda de las cosas sagradas.

verses.KJV: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall be no stranger eat thereof.
verses.WEB: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.
verses.ASV: But if a priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and be returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s bread: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se a filha do sacerdote for viúva, ou repudiada, e não tiver descendência, e se houver voltado à casa de seu pai, como em sua juventude, comerá do pão de seu pai; mas nenhum estranho coma dele.
verses.RVR09: Pero si la hija del sacerdote fuere viuda, ó repudiada, y no tuviere prole, y se hubiere vuelto á la casa de su padre, como en su mocedad, comerá del pan de su padre; mas ningún extraño coma de él.

verses.KJV: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
verses.ASV: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest the holy thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que por acidente comer coisa sagrada, acrescentará a ela seu quinto, e o dará ao sacerdote com a coisa sagrada.
verses.RVR09: Y el que por yerro comiere cosa sagrada, añadirá á ella su quinto, y darálo al sacerdote con la cosa sagrada.

verses.KJV: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the Lord;
verses.WEB: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,
verses.ASV: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não profanarão, pois, as coisas santas dos filhos de Israel, as quais separam para o SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: No profanarán, pues, las cosas santas de los hijos de Israel, las cuales apartan para Jehová:

verses.KJV: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the Lord do sanctify them.
verses.WEB: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
verses.ASV: and [so] cause them to bear the iniquity that bringeth guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não lhes farão levar a iniquidade do pecado, comendo as coisas santas deles: porque eu o SENHOR sou o que os santifico.
verses.RVR09: Y no les harán llevar la iniquidad del pecado, comiendo las cosas santas de ellos: porque yo Jehová soy el que los santifico.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the Lord for a burnt offering;
verses.WEB: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:
verses.ASV: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whosoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that offereth his oblation, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill-offerings, which they offer unto Jehovah for a burnt-offering;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a Arão e a seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Qualquer homem da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros em Israel, que oferecer sua oferta por todos os seus votos, e por todas seus ofertas voluntárias que oferecerem ao SENHOR em holocausto.
verses.RVR09: Habla á Aarón y á sus hijos, y á todos los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cualquier varón de la casa de Israel, ó de los extranjeros en Israel, que ofreciere su ofrenda por todos sus votos, y por todas sus voluntarias oblaciones que ofrecieren á Jehová en holocausto;

verses.KJV: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.WEB: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.ASV: that ye may be accepted, [ye shall offer] a male without blemish, of the bullocks, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.ALMEIDA: De vossa vontade oferecereis macho sem defeito dentre as vacas, dentre os cordeiros, ou dentre as cabras.
verses.RVR09: De vuestra voluntad ofreceréis macho sin defecto de entre las vacas, de entre los corderos, ó de entre las cabras.

verses.KJV: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.WEB: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.ASV: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhuma coisa em que tenha falta oferecereis, porque não será aceito por vós.
verses.RVR09: Ninguna cosa en que haya falta ofreceréis, porque no será acepto por vosotros.

verses.KJV: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
verses.WEB: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
verses.ASV: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também, quando alguém oferecer sacrifício pacífico ao SENHOR para presentear voto, ou oferecendo voluntariamente, seja de vacas ou de ovelhas, sem mácula será aceito; não há de haver nele falta.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo, cuando alguno ofreciere sacrificio de paces á Jehová para presentar voto, ú ofreciendo voluntariamente, sea de vacas ó de ovejas, sin tacha será acepto; no ha de haber en él falta.

verses.KJV: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the Lord, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cego, ou aleijado, ou mutilado, ou com verruga, ou sarnento ou com impingens, não oferecereis estes ao SENHOR, nem deles poreis oferta acesa sobre o altar do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ciego, ó perniquebrado, ó mutilado, ó verrugoso, ó sarnoso, ó roñoso, no ofreceréis éstos á Jehová, ni de ellos pondréis ofrenda encendida sobre el altar de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.WEB: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.ASV: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath anything superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill-offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Boi ou carneiro que tenha de mais ou de menos, poderás oferecer por oferta voluntária; mas por voto não será aceito.
verses.RVR09: Buey ó carnero que tenga de más ó de menos, podrás ofrecer por ofrenda voluntaria; mas por voto no será acepto.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not offer unto the Lord that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.
verses.WEB: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.
verses.ASV: That which hath its stones bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut, ye shall not offer unto Jehovah; neither shall ye do [thus] in your land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ferido ou golpeado, rompido ou cortado, não oferecereis ao SENHOR, nem em vossa terra o fareis.
verses.RVR09: Herido ó magullado, rompido ó cortado, no ofreceréis á Jehová, ni en vuestra tierra lo haréis.

verses.KJV: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.WEB: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
verses.ASV: Neither from the hand of a foreigner shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, there is a blemish in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem da mão de filho de estrangeiro oferecereis o alimento do vosso Deus de todas estas coisas; porque sua deformidade está nelas; falta há nelas, não serão aceitas por vós.
verses.RVR09: Y de mano de hijo de extranjero no ofreceréis el pan de vuestro Dios de todas estas cosas; porque su corrupción está en ellas: hay en ellas falta, no se os aceptarán.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.ASV: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the oblation of an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O boi, ou o cordeiro, ou a cabra, quando nascer, sete dias estará mamando de sua mãe: mas desde o oitavo dia em adiante será aceito para oferta de sacrifício acendido ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El buey, ó el cordero, ó la cabra, cuando naciere, siete días estará mamando de su madre: mas desde el octavo día en adelante será acepto para ofrenda de sacrificio encendido á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And whether it be cow, or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
verses.WEB: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
verses.ASV: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seja boi ou carneiro, não degolareis em um dia a o e a seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y sea buey ó carnero, no degollaréis en un día á él y á su hijo.

verses.KJV: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the Lord, offer it at your own will.
verses.WEB: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
verses.ASV: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando sacrificardes sacrifício de ação de graças ao SENHOR, de vossa vontade o sacrificareis.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando sacrificareis sacrificio de hacimiento de gracias á Jehová, de vuestra voluntad lo sacrificaréis.

verses.KJV: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: No mesmo dia se comerá; não deixareis dele para outro dia: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: En el mismo día se comerá; no dejaréis de él para otro día: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai pois meus mandamentos, e executai-os: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Guardad pues mis mandamientos, y ejecutadlos: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the Lord which hallow you,
verses.WEB: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,
verses.ASV: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who halloweth you,
verses.ALMEIDA: E não profaneis meu santo nome, e eu me santificarei em meio dos filhos de Israel: Eu sou o SENHOR que vos santifico;
verses.RVR09: Y no amancilléis mi santo nombre, y yo me santificaré en medio de los hijos de Israel: Yo Jehová que os santifico;

verses.KJV: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para ser vosso Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Que os saqué de la tierra de Egipto, para ser vuestro Dios: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, The set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: As solenidades do SENHOR, as quais proclamareis santas convocações, aquelas serão minhas solenidades.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Las solemnidades de Jehová, las cuales proclamaréis santas convocaciones, aquestas serán mis solemnidades.

verses.KJV: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the Lord in all your dwellings.
verses.WEB: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.
verses.ASV: Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of work: it is a sabbath unto Jehovah in all your dwellings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis dias se trabalhará, e no sétimo dia sábado de repouso será, convocação santa: nenhuma obra fareis; sábado é do SENHOR em todas as vossas habitações.
verses.RVR09: Seis días se trabajará, y el séptimo día sábado de reposo será, convocación santa: ninguna obra haréis; sábado es de Jehová en todas vuestras habitaciones.

verses.KJV: These are the feasts of the Lord, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
verses.WEB: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
verses.ASV: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their appointed season.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as solenidades do SENHOR, as convocações santas, às quais convocareis em seus tempos.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las solemnidades de Jehová, las convocaciones santas, á las cuales convocaréis en sus tiempos.

verses.KJV: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the Lord's passover.
verses.WEB: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.
verses.ASV: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, is Jehovah’s passover.
verses.ALMEIDA: No mês primeiro, aos catorze do mês, entre as duas tardes, páscoa é do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: En el mes primero, á los catorce del mes, entre las dos tardes, pascua es de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the Lord: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
verses.WEB: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
verses.ASV: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Jehovah: seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos quinze dias deste mês é a solenidade dos pães ázimos ao SENHOR: sete dias comereis pães ázimos.
verses.RVR09: Y á los quince días de este mes es la solemnidad de los ázimos á Jehová: siete días comeréis ázimos.

verses.KJV: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.WEB: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
verses.ASV: In the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.
verses.ALMEIDA: O primeiro dia tereis santa convocação: nenhuma obra servil fareis.
verses.RVR09: El primer día tendréis santa convocación: ninguna obra servil haréis.

verses.KJV: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.WEB: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”
verses.ASV: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah seven days: in the seventh day is a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E oferecereis ao SENHOR sete dias oferta acesa: no sétimo dia será santa convocação; nenhuma obra servil fareis.
verses.RVR09: Y ofreceréis á Jehová siete días ofrenda encendida: el séptimo día será santa convocación; ninguna obra servil haréis.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring the sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra que eu vos dou, e ceifardes seu colheita, trareis ao sacerdote um ômer por primícia dos primeiros frutos de vossa colheita;
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando hubiereis entrado en la tierra que yo os doy, y segareis su mies, traeréis al sacerdote un omer por primicia de los primeros frutos de vuestra siega;

verses.KJV: And he shall wave the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.WEB: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.ASV: and he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual moverá o ômer diante do SENHOR, para que sejais aceitos: o dia seguinte do sábado o moverá o sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: El cual mecerá el omer delante de Jehová, para que seáis aceptos: el siguiente día del sábado lo mecerá el sacerdote.

verses.KJV: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And in the day when ye wave the sheaf, ye shall offer a he-lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia que oferecerdes o ômer, oferecereis um cordeiro de ano, sem defeito, em holocausto ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el día que ofrezcáis el omer, ofreceréis un cordero de un año, sin defecto, en holocausto á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the Lord for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
verses.WEB: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
verses.ASV: And the meal-offering thereof shall be two tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah for a sweet savor; and the drink-offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua oferta de cereais será dois décimos [de efa] de boa farinha amassada com azeite, oferta acesa ao SENHOR em aroma suavíssimo; e sua libação de vinho, a quarta parte de um him.
verses.RVR09: Y su presente será dos décimas de flor de harina amasada con aceite, ofrenda encendida á Jehová en olor suavísimo; y su libación de vino, la cuarta parte de un hin.

verses.KJV: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.WEB: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.ASV: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor fresh ears, until this selfsame day, until ye have brought the oblation of your God: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não comereis pão, nem grão tostado, nem espiga fresca, até este mesmo dia, até que tenhais oferecido a oferta de vosso Deus; estatuto perpétuo é por vossas gerações em todas as vossas habitações.
verses.RVR09: Y no comeréis pan, ni grano tostado, ni espiga fresca, hasta este mismo día, hasta que hayáis ofrecido la ofrenda de vuestro Dios; estatuto perpetuo es por vuestras edades en todas vuestras habitaciones.

verses.KJV: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
verses.WEB: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.
verses.ASV: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave-offering; seven sabbaths shall there be complete:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos haveis de contar desde o dia seguinte do sábado, desde o dia em que oferecestes o ômer da oferta movida; sete semanas completas serão:
verses.RVR09: Y os habéis de contar desde el siguiente día del sábado, desde el día en que ofrecisteis el omer de la ofrenda mecida; siete semanas cumplidas serán:

verses.KJV: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.
verses.ASV: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até o dia seguinte do sábado sétimo contareis cinquenta dias; então oferecereis nova oferta de cereais ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Hasta el siguiente día del sábado séptimo contaréis cincuenta días; entonces ofreceréis nuevo presente á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals; they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave-loaves of two tenth parts [of an ephah]: they shall be of fine flour, they shall be baken with leaven, for first-fruits unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: De vossas habitações trareis dois pães para oferta movida, que serão de dois décimos [de efa] de boa farinha, cozidos com levedura, por primícias ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: De vuestras habitaciones traeréis dos panes para ofrenda mecida, que serán de dos décimas de flor de harina, cocidos con levadura, por primicias á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the Lord, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And ye shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish a year old, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt-offering unto Jehovah, with their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E oferecereis com o pão sete cordeiros de ano sem defeito, e um bezerro das vacas e dois carneiros: serão holocausto ao SENHOR, com sua oferta de cereais e suas libações; oferta acesa de suave cheiro ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y ofreceréis con el pan siete corderos de un año sin defecto, y un becerro de la vacada y dos carneros: serán holocausto á Jehová, con su presente y sus libaciones; ofrenda encendida de suave olor á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.WEB: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.ASV: And ye shall offer one he-goat for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace-offerings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Oferecereis também um macho de bode por expiação; e dois cordeiros de ano em sacrifício pacífico.
verses.RVR09: Ofreceréis además un macho de cabrío por expiación; y dos corderos de un año en sacrificio de paces.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the Lord, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.
verses.WEB: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits for a wave-offering before Jehovah, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Jehovah for the priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote os moverá em oferta movida diante do SENHOR, com o pão das primícias, e os dois cordeiros: serão coisa sagrada do SENHOR para o sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote los mecerá en ofrenda agitada delante de Jehová, con el pan de las primicias, y los dos corderos: serán cosa sagrada de Jehová para el sacerdote.

verses.KJV: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.WEB: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.ASV: And ye shall make proclamation on the selfsame day; there shall be a holy convocation unto you; ye shall do no servile work: it is a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E convocareis neste mesmo dia; vos será santa convocação: nenhuma obra servil fareis: estatuto perpétuo em todas as vossas habitações por vossas gerações.
verses.RVR09: Y convocaréis en este mismo día; os será santa convocación: ninguna obra servil haréis: estatuto perpetuo en todas vuestras habitaciones por vuestras edades.

verses.KJV: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”
verses.ASV: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them for the poor, and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ceifardes a colheita de vossa terra, não acabarás de ceifar o canto de tua plantação, nem espigarás tua colheita; para o pobre, e para o estrangeiro a deixarás: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando segareis la mies de vuestra tierra, no acabarás de segar el rincón de tu haza, ni espigarás tu siega; para el pobre, y para el extranjero la dejarás: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest unto you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: No mês sétimo, ao primeiro do mês tereis sábado, uma comemoração ao são de trombetas, e uma santa convocação.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: En el mes séptimo, al primero del mes tendréis sábado, una conmemoración al son de trompetas, y una santa convocación.

verses.KJV: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: Ye shall do no servile work; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhuma obra servil fareis; e oferecereis oferta acesa ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ninguna obra servil haréis; y ofreceréis ofrenda encendida á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Howbeit on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém aos dez deste mês sétimo será o dia das expiações: tereis santa convocação, e afligireis vossas almas, e oferecereis oferta acesa ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Empero á los diez de este mes séptimo será el día de las expiaciones: tendréis santa convocación, y afligiréis vuestras almas, y ofreceréis ofrenda encendida á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: And ye shall do no manner of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhuma obra fareis neste mesmo dia; porque é dia de expiações, para reconciliar-vos diante do SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Ninguna obra haréis en este mismo día; porque es día de expiaciones, para reconciliaros delante de Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.WEB: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ASV: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day; he shall be cut off from his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque toda pessoa que não se afligir neste mesmo dia, será eliminada de seus povos.
verses.RVR09: Porque toda persona que no se afligiere en este mismo día, será cortada de sus pueblos.

verses.KJV: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.WEB: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
verses.ASV: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any manner of work in that same day, that soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer pessoa que fizer obra alguma neste mesmo dia, eu destruirei a tal pessoa dentre seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera persona que hiciere obra alguna en este mismo día, yo destruiré la tal persona de entre su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.WEB: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.ASV: Ye shall do no manner of work: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhuma obra fareis: estatuto perpétuo é por vossas gerações em todas as vossas habitações.
verses.RVR09: Ninguna obra haréis: estatuto perpetuo es por vuestras edades en todas vuestras habitaciones.

verses.KJV: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
verses.WEB: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
