verses.ASV: It shall be unto you a sabbath of solemn rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye keep your sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sábado de repouso será a vós, e afligireis vossas almas, começando aos nove do mês na tarde: de tarde a tarde descansareis vosso sábado.
verses.RVR09: Sábado de reposo será á vosotros, y afligiréis vuestras almas, comenzando á los nueve del mes en la tarde: de tarde á tarde holgaréis vuestro sábado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Aos quinze dias deste mês sétimo será a solenidade das cabanas ao SENHOR por sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: A los quince días de este mes séptimo será la solemnidad de las cabañas á Jehová por siete días.

verses.KJV: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.WEB: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
verses.ASV: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.
verses.ALMEIDA: O primeiro dia haverá santa convocação: nenhuma obra servil fareis.
verses.RVR09: El primer día habrá santa convocación: ninguna obra servil haréis.

verses.KJV: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.WEB: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
verses.ASV: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: it is a solemn assembly; ye shall do no servile work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sete dias oferecereis oferta acesa ao SENHOR: o oitavo dia tereis santa convocação, e oferecereis oferta acesa ao SENHOR: é festa: nenhuma obra servil fareis.
verses.RVR09: Siete días ofreceréis ofrenda encendida á Jehová: el octavo día tendréis santa convocación, y ofreceréis ofrenda encendida á Jehová: es fiesta: ninguna obra servil haréis.

verses.KJV: These are the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
verses.WEB: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—
verses.ASV: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, and a meal-offering, a sacrifice, and drink-offerings, each on its own day;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as solenidades do SENHOR, às que convocareis santas reuniões, para oferecer oferta acesa ao SENHOR, holocausto e oferta de cereais, sacrifício e libações, cada coisa em seu tempo:
verses.RVR09: Estas son las solemnidades de Jehová, á las que convocaréis santas reuniones, para ofrecer ofrenda encendida á Jehová, holocausto y presente, sacrificio y libaciones, cada cosa en su tiempo:

verses.KJV: Beside the sabbaths of the Lord, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.
verses.ASV: besides the sabbaths of Jehovah, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill-offerings, which ye give unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso dos sábados do SENHOR e além de vossos presentes, e a mais de todos vossos votos, e além de todas as vossas ofertas voluntárias, que dareis ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Además de los sábados de Jehová y además de vuestros dones, y á más de todos vuestros votos, y además de todas vuestras ofrendas voluntarias, que daréis á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
verses.WEB: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
verses.ASV: Howbeit on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruits of the land, ye shall keep the feast of Jehovah seven days: on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém aos quinze do mês sétimo, quando houverdes recolhido o fruto da terra, fareis festa ao SENHOR por sete dias: o primeiro dia será sábado; sábado será também o oitavo dia.
verses.RVR09: Empero á los quince del mes séptimo, cuando hubiereis allegado el fruto de la tierra, haréis fiesta á Jehová por siete días: el primer día será sábado; sábado será también el octavo día.

verses.KJV: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God seven days.
verses.WEB: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
verses.ASV: And ye shall take you on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm-trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God seven days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomareis o primeiro dia galhos das mais belas árvores, ramos de palmeiras, e ramos de árvores frondosas, e salgueiros dos ribeiros; e vos regozijareis diante do SENHOR vosso Deus por sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaréis el primer día gajos con fruto de árbol hermoso, ramos de palmas, y ramas de árboles espesos, y sauces de los arroyos; y os regocijaréis delante de Jehová vuestro Dios por siete días.

verses.KJV: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the Lord seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.WEB: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.
verses.ASV: And ye shall keep it a feast unto Jehovah seven days in the year: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations; ye shall keep it in the seventh month.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe fareis festa ao SENHOR por sete dias cada ano; será estatuto perpétuo por vossas gerações; no mês sétimo a fareis.
verses.RVR09: Y le haréis fiesta á Jehová por siete días cada un año; será estatuto perpetuo por vuestras edades; en el mes séptimo la haréis.

verses.KJV: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
verses.WEB: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,
verses.ASV: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are home-born in Israel shall dwell in booths;
verses.ALMEIDA: Em cabanas habitareis sete dias: todo natural de Israel habitará em cabanas;
verses.RVR09: En cabañas habitaréis siete días: todo natural de Israel habitará en cabañas;

verses.KJV: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”
verses.ASV: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que saibam vossos descendentes que em cabanas fiz eu habitar aos filhos de Israel, quando os tirei da terra do Egito: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Para que sepan vuestros descendientes que en cabañas hice yo habitar á los hijos de Israel, cuando los saqué de la tierra de Egipto: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the Lord.
verses.WEB: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the set feasts of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel sobre as solenidades do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Así habló Moisés á los hijos de Israel sobre las solemnidades de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
verses.WEB: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.ASV: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite de olivas claro, prensado, para a luminária, para fazer arder as lâmpadas continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Manda á los hijos de Israel que te traigan aceite de olivas claro, molido, para la luminaria, para hacer arder las lámparas de continuo.

verses.KJV: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
verses.WEB: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
verses.ASV: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah continually: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fora do véu do testemunho, no tabernáculo do testemunho, as preparará Arão desde a tarde até a manhã diante do SENHOR, continuamente: estatuto perpétuo por vossas gerações.
verses.RVR09: Fuera del velo del testimonio, en el tabernáculo del testimonio, las aderezará Aarón desde la tarde hasta la mañana delante de Jehová, de continuo: estatuto perpetuo por vuestras edades.

verses.KJV: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the Lord continually.
verses.WEB: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.
verses.ASV: He shall keep in order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Jehovah continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre o candelabro limpo porá sempre em ordem as lâmpadas diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Sobre el candelero limpio pondrá siempre en orden las lámparas delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
verses.WEB: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth parts [of an ephah] shall be in one cake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomarás boa farinha, e cozerás dela doze tortas; cada torta será de dois décimos [de efa] .
verses.RVR09: Y tomarás flor de harina, y cocerás de ella doce tortas: cada torta será de dos décimas.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the Lord.
verses.WEB: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as porás em duas fileiras, seis em cada fileira, sobre a mesa limpa diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y has de ponerlas en dos órdenes, seis en cada orden, sobre la mesa limpia delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porás também sobre cada fileira incenso limpo, e será para o pão por incenso, oferta acesa ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Pondrás también sobre cada orden incienso limpio, y será para el pan por perfume, ofrenda encendida á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
verses.WEB: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: Every sabbath day he shall set it in order before Jehovah continually; it is on the behalf of the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada dia de sábado o porá continuamente em ordem diante do SENHOR, dos filhos de Israel por pacto perpétuo.
verses.RVR09: Cada día de sábado lo pondrá de continuo en orden delante de Jehová, de los hijos de Israel por pacto sempiterno.

verses.KJV: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire by a perpetual statute.
verses.WEB: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
verses.ASV: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire by a perpetual statute.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será de Arão e de seus filhos, os quais o comerão no lugar santo; porque é coisa muito santa para ele, das ofertas acendidas ao SENHOR, por estatuto perpétuo.
verses.RVR09: Y será de Aarón y de sus hijos, los cuales lo comerán en el lugar santo; porque es cosa muy santa para él, de las ofrendas encendidas á Jehová, por fuero perpetuo.

verses.KJV: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
verses.WEB: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
verses.ASV: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp:
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquela muita o filho de uma mulher israelita, o qual era filho de um egípcio, saiu entre os filhos de Israel; e o filho da israelita e um homem de Israel brigaram no acampamento:
verses.RVR09: En aquella sazón el hijo de una mujer Israelita, el cual era hijo de un Egipcio, salió entre los hijos de Israel; y el hijo de la Israelita y un hombre de Israel riñeron en el real:

verses.KJV: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
verses.WEB: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.ASV: and the son of the Israelitish woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him unto Moses. And his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filho da mulher israelita pronunciou o Nome, e amaldiçoou; então o levaram a Moisés. E sua mãe se chamava Selomite, filha de Dribi, da tribo de Dã.
verses.RVR09: Y el hijo de la mujer Israelita pronunció el Nombre, y maldijo: entonces le llevaron á Moisés. Y su madre se llamaba Selomith, hija de Dribi, de la tribu de Dan.

verses.KJV: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the Lord might be shewed them.
verses.WEB: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.
verses.ASV: And they put him in ward, that it might be declared unto them at the mouth of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram-no no cárcere, até que lhes fosse sentenciado pela palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y pusiéronlo en la cárcel, hasta que les fuese declarado por palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.WEB: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.ASV: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Traz o blasfemador para fora do acampamento, e todos os que o ouviram ponham suas mãos sobre a cabeça dele, e toda a congregação o apedreje.
verses.RVR09: Saca al blasfemo fuera del real, y todos los que le oyeron pongan sus manos sobre la cabeza de él, y apedréelo toda la congregación.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
verses.WEB: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falarás aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Qualquer um que amaldiçoar ao seu Deus, levará sobre si a sua iniquidade.
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de Israel hablarás, diciendo: Cualquiera que maldijere á su Dios, llevará su iniquidad.

verses.KJV: And he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.
verses.WEB: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
verses.ASV: And he that blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the sojourner, as the home-born, when he blasphemeth the name [of Jehovah], shall be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que blasfemar o nome do SENHOR será morto; toda a congregação o apedrejará; tanto o estrangeiro como o natural, se blasfemar o Nome, que morra.
verses.RVR09: Y el que blasfemare el nombre de Jehová, ha de ser muerto: toda la congregación lo apedreará: así el extranjero como el natural, si blasfemare el Nombre, que muera.

verses.KJV: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: And he that smiteth any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o homem que fere de morte a qualquer pessoa será punido à morte.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo el hombre que hiere de muerte á cualquiera persona, que sufra la muerte.

verses.KJV: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
verses.WEB: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
verses.ASV: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o que fere algum animal deverá restituí-lo; animal por animal.
verses.RVR09: Y el que hiere á algún animal, ha de restituirlo: animal por animal.

verses.KJV: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
verses.WEB: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
verses.ASV: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbor; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém que causar lesão em seu próximo, segundo fez, assim lhe seja feito:
verses.RVR09: Y el que causare lesión en su prójimo, según hizo, así le sea hecho:

verses.KJV: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
verses.WEB: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
verses.ASV: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be rendered unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fratura por fratura, olho por olho, dente por dente: segundo a lesão que houver feito a outro, assim se fará a ele.
verses.RVR09: Rotura por rotura, ojo por ojo, diente por diente: según la lesión que habrá hecho á otro, tal se hará á él.

verses.KJV: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
verses.WEB: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
verses.ASV: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good: and he that killeth a man shall be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que fere algum animal deverá restituí-lo; mas o que fere de morte a um homem será punido à morte.
verses.RVR09: El que hiere algún animal, ha de restituirlo; mas el que hiere de muerte á un hombre, que muera.

verses.KJV: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”
verses.ASV: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the sojourner, as for the home-born: for I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um mesmo regulamento tereis; como o estrangeiro, assim será o natural; porque eu sou o SENHOR, vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Un mismo derecho tendréis: como el extranjero, así será el natural: porque yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And Moses spake to the children of Israel; and they brought forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel, e eles trouxeram o blasfemador para fora do acampamento, e o apedrejaram. E os filhos de Israel fizeram segundo o que o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y habló Moisés á los hijos de Israel, y ellos sacaron al blasfemo fuera del real, y apedreáronlo con piedras. Y los hijos de Israel hicieron según que Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés no monte Sinai, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ habló á Moisés en el monte de Sinaí, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra que eu vos dou, a terra guardará um sábado ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando hubiereis entrado en la tierra que yo os doy, la tierra hará sábado á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
verses.WEB: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;
verses.ASV: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruits thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis anos semearás a tua terra, e seis anos podarás a tua vinha, e colherás os seus frutos;
verses.RVR09: Seis años sembrarás tu tierra, y seis años podarás tu viña, y cogerás sus frutos;

verses.KJV: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
verses.WEB: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
verses.ASV: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath unto Jehovah: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas no sétimo ano a terra terá um sábado de descanso, sábado ao SENHOR; não semearás a tua terra, nem podarás a tua vinha.
verses.RVR09: Y el séptimo año la tierra tendrá sábado de holganza, sábado á Jehová: no sembrarás tu tierra, ni podarás tu viña.

verses.KJV: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
verses.WEB: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
verses.ASV: That which groweth of itself of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, and the grapes of thy undressed vine thou shalt not gather: it shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que nascer de si mesmo na tua terra ceifada não ceifarás; e as uvas do teu vinhedo não vindimarás; será um ano de descanso para a terra.
verses.RVR09: Lo que de suyo se naciere en tu tierra segada, no lo segarás; y las uvas de tu viñedo no vendimiarás: año de holganza será á la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee.
verses.WEB: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
verses.ASV: And the sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for thee, and for thy servant and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant and for thy stranger, who sojourn with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o sábado da terra vos será para comer a ti, e a teu servo, e a tua serva, e a tua criado, e a tua estrangeiro que morar contigo:
verses.RVR09: Mas el sábado de la tierra os será para comer á ti, y á tu siervo, y á tu sierva, y á tu criado, y á tu extranjero que morare contigo:

verses.KJV: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
verses.WEB: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
verses.ASV: And for thy cattle, and for the beasts that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be for food.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a teu animal, e à animal que houver em tua terra, será todo o fruto dela para comer.
verses.RVR09: Y á tu animal, y á la bestia que hubiere en tu tierra, será todo el fruto de ella para comer.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and there shall be unto thee the days of seven sabbaths of years, even forty and nine years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te hás de contar sete semanas de anos, sete vezes sete anos; de modo que os dias das sete semanas de anos virão a ser para ti quarenta e nove anos.
verses.RVR09: Y te has de contar siete semanas de años, siete veces siete años; de modo que los días de las siete semanas de años vendrán á serte cuarenta y nueve años.

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
verses.WEB: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou send abroad the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month; in the day of atonement shall ye send abroad the trumpet throughout all your land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então farás passar a trombeta de júbilo no mês sétimo aos dez do mês; o dia da expiação fareis passar a trombeta por toda vossa terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces harás pasar la trompeta de jubilación en el mes séptimo á los diez del mes; el día de la expiación haréis pasar la trompeta por toda vuestra tierra.

verses.KJV: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.WEB: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
verses.ASV: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.ALMEIDA: E santificareis o ano cinquenta, e apregoareis liberdade na terra a todos os seus moradores: este vos será jubileu; e voltareis cada um à sua possessão, e cada qual voltará à sua família.
verses.RVR09: Y santificaréis el año cincuenta, y pregonaréis libertad en la tierra á todos sus moradores: éste os será jubileo; y volveréis cada uno á su posesión, y cada cual volverá á su familia.

verses.KJV: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
verses.WEB: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.
verses.ASV: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather [the grapes] in it of the undressed vines.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ano dos cinquenta anos vos será jubileu: não semeareis, nem colhereis o que nascer de seu na terra, nem vindimareis seus vinhedos:
verses.RVR09: El año de los cincuenta años os será jubileo: no sembraréis, ni segaréis lo que naciere de suyo en la tierra, ni vendimiaréis sus viñedos:

verses.KJV: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.WEB: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
verses.ASV: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque é jubileu: santo será a vós; o produto da terra comereis.
verses.RVR09: Porque es jubileo: santo será á vosotros; el producto de la tierra comeréis.

verses.KJV: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.WEB: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
verses.ASV: In this year of jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em este ano de jubileu voltareis cada um à sua possessão.
verses.RVR09: En este año de jubileo volveréis cada uno á su posesión.

verses.KJV: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
verses.WEB: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.
verses.ASV: And if thou sell aught unto thy neighbor, or buy of thy neighbor’s hand, ye shall not wrong one another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando venderdes algo a vosso próximo, ou comprardes da mão de vosso próximo, não engane ninguém a seu irmão:
verses.RVR09: Y cuando vendiereis algo á vuestro prójimo, ó comprareis de mano de vuestro prójimo, no engañe ninguno á su hermano:

verses.KJV: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
verses.WEB: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.
verses.ASV: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbor, [and] according unto the number of years of the crops he shall sell unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme o número dos anos depois do jubileu comprarás de teu próximo; conforme o número dos anos dos frutos te venderá ele a ti.
verses.RVR09: Conforme al número de los años después del jubileo comprarás de tu prójimo; conforme al número de los años de los frutos te venderá él á ti.

verses.KJV: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
verses.WEB: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.
verses.ASV: According to the multitude of the years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of the years thou shalt diminish the price of it; for the number of the crops doth he sell unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme a abundância dos anos aumentarás o preço, e conforme a diminuição dos anos diminuirás o preço; porque segundo o número dos rendimentos te há de vender ele.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á la multitud de los años aumentarás el precio, y conforme á la disminución de los años disminuirás el precio; porque según el número de los rendimientos te ha de vender él.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God:for I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: And ye shall not wrong one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não engane ninguém a seu próximo; mas terás temor de teu Deus: porque eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y no engañe ninguno á su prójimo; mas tendrás temor de tu Dios: porque yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.WEB: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.ASV: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep mine ordinances and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Executai, pois, meus estatutos, e guardai meus regulamentos, e ponde-os por obra, e habitareis na terra seguros;
verses.RVR09: Ejecutad, pues, mis estatutos, y guardad mis derechos, y ponedlos por obra, y habitaréis en la tierra seguros;

verses.KJV: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.WEB: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.ASV: And the land shall yield its fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra dará seu fruto, e comereis até fartura, e habitareis nela com segurança.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra dará su fruto, y comeréis hasta hartura, y habitaréis en ella con seguridad.

verses.KJV: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
verses.WEB: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”
verses.ASV: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se disserdes: Que comeremos no sétimo ano? eis que não temos de semear, nem temos de colher nossos frutos:
verses.RVR09: Y si dijereis: ¿Qué comeremos el séptimo año? he aquí no hemos de sembrar, ni hemos de coger nuestros frutos:

verses.KJV: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
verses.WEB: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.
verses.ASV: then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for the three years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu vos enviarei minha bênção no sexto ano, e fará fruto por três anos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces yo os enviaré mi bendición el sexto año, y hará fruto por tres años.

verses.KJV: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
verses.WEB: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.
verses.ASV: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, ye shall eat the old store.
verses.ALMEIDA: E semeareis no ano oitavo, e comereis do fruto alheio; até o ano nono, até que venha seu fruto comereis do alheio.
verses.RVR09: Y sembraréis el año octavo, y comeréis del fruto añejo; hasta el año noveno, hasta que venga su fruto comeréis del añejo.

verses.KJV: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine, for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.WEB: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.
verses.ASV: And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity; for the land is mine: for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra não se venderá definitivamente, porque a terra minha é; que vós peregrinos e estrangeiros sois para comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra no se venderá rematadamente, porque la tierra mía es; que vosotros peregrinos y extranjeros sois para conmigo.

verses.KJV: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.WEB: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.ASV: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, em toda a terra de vossa possessão, outorgareis remissão à terra.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, en toda la tierra de vuestra posesión, otorgaréis redención á la tierra.

verses.KJV: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
verses.WEB: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.
verses.ASV: If thy brother be waxed poor, and sell some of his possession, then shall his kinsman that is next unto him come, and shall redeem that which his brother hath sold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando teu irmão empobrecer, e vender algo de sua possessão, virá o resgatador, seu próximo, e resgatará o que seu irmão houver vendido.
verses.RVR09: Cuando tu hermano empobreciere, y vendiere algo de su posesión, vendrá el rescatador, su cercano, y rescatará lo que su hermano hubiere vendido.

verses.KJV: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
verses.WEB: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,
verses.ASV: And if a man have no one to redeem it, and he be waxed rich and find sufficient to redeem it;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o homem não tiver resgatador, se alcançar sua mão, e achar o que basta para seu resgate;
verses.RVR09: Y cuando el hombre no tuviere rescatador, si alcanzare su mano, y hallare lo que basta para su rescate;

verses.KJV: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
verses.WEB: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.
verses.ASV: then let him reckon the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então contará os anos de sua venda, e pagará o que restar ao homem a quem vendeu, e voltará à sua possessão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces contará los años de su venta, y pagará lo que quedare al varón á quien vendió, y volverá á su posesión.

verses.KJV: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.WEB: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.
verses.ASV: But if he be not able to get it back for himself, then that which he hath sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee: and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se não alcançar sua mão o que basta para que volte a ele, o que vendeu estará em poder do que o comprou até o ano do jubileu; e ao jubileu sairá, e ele voltará à sua possessão.
verses.RVR09: Mas si no alcanzare su mano lo que basta para que vuelva á él, lo que vendió estará en poder del que lo compró hasta el año del jubileo; y al jubileo saldrá, y él volverá á su posesión.

verses.KJV: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.
verses.ASV: And if a man sell a dwelling-house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; for a full year shall he have the right of redemption.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem que vender casa de morada em cidade cercado, poderá resgatá-la até acabar-se o ano de sua venda: ano será o termo de se poder resgatar.
verses.RVR09: Y el varón que vendiere casa de morada en ciudad cercada, tendrá facultad de redimirla hasta acabarse el año de su venta: un año será el término de poderse redimir.

verses.KJV: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
verses.WEB: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.
verses.ASV: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him that bought it, throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não for resgatada dentro de ano inteiro, a casa que estiver na cidade murada ficará para sempre por daquele que a comprou, e para seus descendentes: não sairá no jubileu.
verses.RVR09: Y si no fuere redimida dentro de un año entero, la casa que estuviere en la ciudad murada quedará para siempre por de aquel que la compró, y para sus descendientes: no saldrá en el jubileo.

verses.KJV: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
verses.WEB: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
verses.ASV: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be reckoned with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas as casas das aldeias que não têm muro ao redor, serão estimadas como uma plantação da terra: terão remissão, e sairão no jubileu.
verses.RVR09: Mas las casas de las aldeas que no tienen muro alrededor, serán estimadas como una haza de tierra: tendrán redención, y saldrán en el jubileo.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
verses.WEB: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém em quanto às cidades dos levitas, sempre poderão resgatar os levitas as casas das cidades que possuírem.
verses.RVR09: Pero en cuanto á las ciudades de los Levitas, siempre podrán redimir los Levitas las casas de las ciudades que poseyeren.

verses.KJV: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And if one of the Levites redeem, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que comprar dos levitas, sairá da casa vendida, ou da cidade de sua possessão, no jubileu: porquanto as casas das cidades dos levitas é a possessão deles entre os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y el que comprare de los Levitas, saldrá de la casa vendida, ó de la ciudad de su posesión, en el jubileo: por cuanto las casas de las ciudades de los Levitas es la posesión de ellos entre los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.WEB: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.ASV: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a terra dos arredores de suas cidades não se venderá, porque é perpétua possessão deles.
verses.RVR09: Mas la tierra del ejido de sus ciudades no se venderá, porque es perpetua posesión de ellos.

verses.KJV: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
verses.WEB: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.
verses.ASV: And if thy brother be waxed poor, and his hand fail with thee; then thou shalt uphold him: [as] a stranger and a sojourner shall he live with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando teu irmão empobrecer, e se refugiar a ti, tu o ampararás: como peregrino e estrangeiro viverá contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando tu hermano empobreciere, y se acogiere á ti, tú lo ampararás: como peregrino y extranjero vivirá contigo.

verses.KJV: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
verses.WEB: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.
verses.ASV: Take thou no interest of him or increase, but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tomarás juros dele, nem lucro; mas terás temor de teu Deus, e teu irmão viverá contigo.
verses.RVR09: No tomarás usura de él, ni aumento; mas tendrás temor de tu Dios, y tu hermano vivirá contigo.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
verses.WEB: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon interest, nor give him thy victuals for increase.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não lhe darás teu dinheiro a juros, nem tua comida a ganho:
verses.RVR09: No le darás tu dinero á usura, ni tu vitualla á ganancia:

verses.KJV: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
verses.WEB: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, [and] to be your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para vos dar a terra de Canaã, para ser vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios, que os saqué de la tierra de Egipto, para daros la tierra de Canaán, para ser vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
verses.WEB: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
verses.ASV: And if thy brother be waxed poor with thee, and sell himself unto thee; thou shalt not make him to serve as a bondservant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando teu irmão empobrecer, estando contigo, e se vender a ti, não lhe farás servir como servo:
verses.RVR09: Y cuando tu hermano empobreciere, estando contigo, y se vendiere á ti, no le harás servir como siervo:

verses.KJV: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile.
verses.WEB: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.
verses.ASV: As a hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee; he shall serve with thee unto the year of jubilee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Como criado, como estrangeiro estará contigo; até o ano do jubileu te servirá.
verses.RVR09: Como criado, como extranjero estará contigo; hasta el año del jubileo te servirá.

verses.KJV: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.WEB: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.
verses.ASV: then shall he go out from thee, he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então sairá de tua presença, ele e seus filhos consigo, e voltará à sua família, e à possessão de seus pais se restituirá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces saldrá de contigo, él y sus hijos consigo, y volverá á su familia, y á la posesión de sus padres se restituirá.

verses.KJV: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.WEB: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
verses.ASV: For they are my servants, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque são meus servos, os quais tirei eu da terra do Egito: não serão vendidos à maneira de servos.
verses.RVR09: Porque son mis siervos, los cuales saqué yo de la tierra de Egipto: no serán vendidos á manera de siervos.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
verses.WEB: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigor, but shalt fear thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não serás senhor dele com dureza, mas terás temor de teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: No te enseñorearás de él con dureza, mas tendrás temor de tu Dios.

verses.KJV: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.WEB: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.
verses.ASV: And as for thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, whom thou shalt have; of the nations that are round about you, of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim teu servo como tua serva que tiveres, serão das nações que estão em vosso ao redor: deles comprareis servos e servas.
verses.RVR09: Así tu siervo como tu sierva que tuvieres, serán de las gentes que están en vuestro alrededor: de ellos compraréis siervos y siervas.

verses.KJV: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
verses.WEB: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.
verses.ASV: Moreover of the children of the strangers that sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they have begotten in your land: and they shall be your possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também comprareis dos filhos dos forasteiros que vivem entre vós, e dos que da linhagem deles são nascidos em vossa terra, que estão convosco; os quais tereis por possessão:
verses.RVR09: También compraréis de los hijos de los forasteros que viven entre vosotros, y de los que del linaje de ellos son nacidos en vuestra tierra, que están con vosotros; los cuales tendréis por posesión:

verses.KJV: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
verses.WEB: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.
verses.ASV: And ye shall make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them shall ye take your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel ye shall not rule, one over another, with rigor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os possuireis por herança para vossos filhos depois de vós, como possessão hereditária; para sempre vos servireis deles; porém em vossos irmãos os filhos de Israel, não vos dominareis cada um sobre seu irmão com dureza.
verses.RVR09: Y los poseeréis por juro de heredad para vuestros hijos después de vosotros, como posesión hereditaria; para siempre os serviréis de ellos; empero en vuestros hermanos los hijos de Israel, no os enseñorearéis cada uno sobre su hermano con dureza.

verses.KJV: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
verses.WEB: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,
verses.ASV: And if a stranger or sojourner with thee be waxed rich, and thy brother be waxed poor beside him, and sell himself unto the stranger [or] sojourner with thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o peregrino ou estrangeiro que está contigo, adquirisse meios, e teu irmão que está com ele empobrecer, e se vender ao peregrino ou estrangeiro que está contigo, ou à raça da família do estrangeiro;
verses.RVR09: Y si el peregrino ó extranjero que está contigo, adquiriese medios, y tu hermano que está con él empobreciere, y se vendiere al peregrino ó extranjero que está contigo, ó á la raza de la familia del extranjero;

verses.KJV: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
verses.WEB: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;
verses.ASV: after that he is sold he may be redeemed: one of his brethren may redeem him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois que se houver vendido, poderá ser resgatado: um de seus irmãos o resgatará;
verses.RVR09: Después que se hubiere vendido, podrá ser rescatado: uno de sus hermanos lo rescatará;

verses.KJV: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
verses.WEB: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.
verses.ASV: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be waxed rich, he may redeem himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou seu tio, ou o filho de seu tio o resgatará, ou o próximo de sua carne, de sua linhagem, o resgatará; ou se seus meios alcançarem, ele mesmo se resgatará.
verses.RVR09: O su tío, ó el hijo de su tío lo rescatará, ó el cercano de su carne, de su linaje, lo rescatará; ó si sus medios alcanzaren, él mismo se redimirá.

verses.KJV: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
verses.WEB: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.
verses.ASV: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he sold himself to him unto the year of jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years; according to the time of a hired servant shall he be with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E contará com o que o comprou, desde o ano que se vendeu a ele até o ano do jubileu: e há de estabelecer preço o dinheiro de sua venda conforme o número dos anos, e se fará com ele conforme o tempo de um criado assalariado.
verses.RVR09: Y contará con el que lo compró, desde el año que se vendió á él hasta el año del jubileo: y ha de apreciarse el dinero de su venta conforme al número de los años, y se hará con él conforme al tiempo de un criado asalariado.

verses.KJV: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.WEB: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.ASV: If there be yet many years, according unto them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ainda forem muitos anos, conforme eles voltará para seu resgate do dinheiro pelo qual se vendeu.
verses.RVR09: Si aun fueren muchos años, conforme á ellos volverá para su rescate del dinero por el cual se vendió.

verses.KJV: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
verses.WEB: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.
verses.ASV: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according unto his years shall he give back the price of his redemption.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se restar pouco tempo até o ano do jubileu, então contará com ele, e devolverá seu resgate conforme seus anos.
verses.RVR09: Y si quedare poco tiempo hasta el año del jubileo, entonces contará con él, y devolverá su rescate conforme á sus años.

verses.KJV: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
verses.WEB: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.
verses.ASV: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him: he shall not rule with rigor over him in thy sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como com tomado a salário anualmente fará com ele: não será senhor dele com aspereza diante de teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Como con tomado á salario anualmente hará con él: no se enseñoreará en él con aspereza delante de tus ojos.

verses.KJV: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
verses.WEB: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.
verses.ASV: And if he be not redeemed by these [means], then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, he, and his children with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se não se resgatar em esses anos, no ano do jubileu sairá, ele, e seus filhos com ele.
verses.RVR09: Mas si no se redimiere en esos años, en el año del jubileo saldrá, él, y sus hijos con él.

verses.KJV: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque meus servos são os filhos de Israel; são servos meus, aos quais tirei da terra do Egito: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque mis siervos son los hijos de Israel; son siervos míos, á los cuales saqué de la tierra de Egipto: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Ye shall make you no idols, neither shall ye rear you up a graven image, or a pillar, neither shall ye place any figured stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não fareis para vós ídolos, nem escultura, nem levantareis para vós estátua, nem poreis em vossa terra pedra pintada para inclinar-vos a ela: porque eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: NO haréis para vosotros ídolos, ni escultura, ni os levantaréis estatua, ni pondréis en vuestra tierra piedra pintada para inclinaros á ella: porque yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai meus sábados, e tende em reverência meu santuário: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Guardad mis sábados, y tened en reverencia mi santuario: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
verses.WEB: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,
verses.ASV: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se andardes em meus decretos, e guardardes meus mandamentos, e os puserdes por obra;
verses.RVR09: Si anduviereis en mis decretos, y guardareis mis mandamientos, y los pusiereis por obra;

verses.KJV: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.WEB: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.ASV: then I will give your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu darei vossa chuva em seu tempo, e a terra produzirá, e a árvore do campo dará seu fruto;
verses.RVR09: Yo daré vuestra lluvia en su tiempo, y la tierra rendirá sus producciones, y el árbol del campo dará su fruto;

verses.KJV: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.WEB: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.ASV: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time; and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a debulha vos alcançará à vindima, e a vindima alcançará à sementeira, e comereis vosso pão em fartura e habitareis seguros em vossa terra:
verses.RVR09: Y la trilla os alcanzará á la vendimia, y la vendimia alcanzará á la sementera, y comeréis vuestro pan en hartura, y habitaréis seguros en vuestra tierra:

verses.KJV: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.WEB: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.ASV: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu darei paz na terra, e dormireis, e não haverá quem vos espante; e farei tirar os animais ferozes de vossa terra, e a espada não passará por vossa terra;
verses.RVR09: Y yo daré paz en la tierra, y dormiréis, y no habrá quien os espante: y haré quitar las malas bestias de vuestra tierra, y no pasará por vuestro país la espada:

verses.KJV: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.WEB: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.ASV: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perseguireis aos vossos inimigos, e cairão à espada diante de vós;
verses.RVR09: Y perseguiréis á vuestros enemigos, y caerán á cuchillo delante de vosotros:

verses.KJV: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.WEB: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.ASV: And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cinco de vós perseguirão a cem, e cem de vós perseguirão a dez mil, e vossos inimigos cairão à espada diante de vós.
verses.RVR09: Y cinco de vosotros perseguirán á ciento, y ciento de vosotros perseguirán á diez mil, y vuestros enemigos caerán á cuchillo delante de vosotros.

verses.KJV: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
verses.WEB: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
verses.ASV: And I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu me voltarei a vós, e vos farei crescer, e vos multiplicarei, e afirmarei meu pacto convosco:
verses.RVR09: Porque yo me volveré á vosotros, y os haré crecer, y os multiplicaré, y afirmaré mi pacto con vosotros:

verses.KJV: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
verses.WEB: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.
verses.ASV: And ye shall eat old store long kept, and ye shall bring forth the old because of the new.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comereis o antigo de muito tempo, e tirareis fora o antigo por causa do novo:
verses.RVR09: Y comeréis lo añejo de mucho tiempo, y sacaréis fuera lo añejo á causa de lo nuevo:

verses.KJV: And I set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.WEB: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.
verses.ASV: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei minha morada em meio de vós, e minha alma não vos abominará:
verses.RVR09: Y pondré mi morada en medio de vosotros, y mi alma no os abominará:

verses.KJV: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verses.WEB: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.
verses.ASV: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E andarei entre vós, e eu serei vosso Deus, e vós sereis meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y andaré entre vosotros, y yo seré vuestro Dios, y vosotros seréis mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.WEB: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para que não fôsseis seus servos; e rompi as barras de vosso jugo, e vos fiz andar com o rosto alto.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios, que os saqué de la tierra de Egipto, para que no fueseis sus siervos; y rompí las coyundas de vuestro yugo, y os he hecho andar el rostro alto.

verses.KJV: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.WEB: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,
verses.ASV: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se não me ouvirdes, nem fizerdes todos estes meus mandamentos,
verses.RVR09: Empero si no me oyereis, ni hiciereis todos estos mis mandamientos,

verses.KJV: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
verses.WEB: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,
verses.ASV: and if ye shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhor mine ordinances, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se abominardes meus decretos, e vossa alma menosprezar meus regulamentos, não executando todos meus mandamentos, e invalidando meu pacto;
verses.RVR09: Y si abominareis mis decretos, y vuestra alma menospreciare mis derechos, no ejecutando todos mis mandamientos, é invalidando mi pacto;

verses.KJV: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.WEB: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.
verses.ASV: I also will do this unto you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away; and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu também farei convosco isto: enviarei sobre vós terror, enfermidade e febre, que consumam os olhos e atormentem a alma: e semeareis em vão vossa semente, porque vossos inimigos a comerão:
verses.RVR09: Yo también haré con vosotros esto: enviaré sobre vosotros terror, extenuación y calentura, que consuman los ojos y atormenten el alma: y sembraréis en balde vuestra simiente, porque vuestros enemigos la comerán:

verses.KJV: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.WEB: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
verses.ASV: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be smitten before your enemies: they that hate you shall rule over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei minha ira sobre vós, e sereis feridos diante de vossos inimigos; e os que vos aborrecem vos dominarão, e fugireis sem que haja quem vos persiga.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré mi ira sobre vosotros, y seréis heridos delante de vuestros enemigos; y los que os aborrecen se enseñorearán de vosotros, y huiréis sin que haya quien os persiga.

verses.KJV: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.WEB: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
verses.ASV: And if ye will not yet for these things hearken unto me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se ainda com estas coisas não me ouvirdes, eu voltarei a castigar-vos sete vezes mais por vossos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y si aun con esas cosas no me oyereis, yo tornaré á castigaros siete veces más por vuestros pecados.

verses.KJV: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
verses.WEB: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.
verses.ASV: And I will break the pride of your power: and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quebrarei a soberba de vossa força, e voltarei vosso céu como ferro, e vossa terra como bronze:
verses.RVR09: Y quebrantaré la soberbia de vuestra fortaleza, y tornaré vuestro cielo como hierro, y vuestra tierra como metal:

verses.KJV: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
verses.WEB: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.
verses.ASV: and your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield its increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vossa força se consumirá em vão; que vossa terra não dará seu produto, e as árvores da terra não darão seu fruto.
verses.RVR09: Y vuestra fuerza se consumirá en vano; que vuestra tierra no dará su esquilmo, y los árboles de la tierra no darán su fruto.

verses.KJV: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.WEB: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.
verses.ASV: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me, I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se andardes comigo em oposição, e não me quiserdes ouvir, eu acrescentarei sobre vós sete vezes mais pragas segundo vossos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y si anduviereis conmigo en oposición, y no me quisiereis oir, yo añadiré sobre vosotros siete veces más plagas según vuestros pecados.

verses.KJV: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
verses.WEB: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.
