verses.ASV: And I will send the beast of the field among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your ways shall become desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviarei também contra vós animais feras que vos arrebatem os filhos, e destruam vossos animais, e vos reduzam a poucos, e vossos caminhos sejam desertos.
verses.RVR09: Enviaré también contra vosotros bestias fieras que os arrebaten los hijos, y destruyan vuestros animales, y os apoquen, y vuestros caminos sean desiertos.

verses.KJV: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
verses.WEB: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,
verses.ASV: And if by these things ye will not be reformed unto me, but will walk contrary unto me;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se com estas coisas não fordes corrigidos, mas que andardes comigo em oposição,
verses.RVR09: Y si con estas cosas no fuereis corregidos, sino que anduviereis conmigo en oposición,

verses.KJV: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
verses.WEB: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
verses.ASV: then will I also walk contrary unto you; and I will smite you, even I, seven times for your sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu também procederei convosco, em oposição e vos ferirei ainda sete vezes por vossos pecados:
verses.RVR09: Yo también procederé con vosotros en oposición, y os heriré aun siete veces por vuestros pecados:

verses.KJV: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.WEB: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.ASV: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall execute the vengeance of the covenant; and ye shall be gathered together within your cities: and I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trarei sobre vós espada vingadora, em castigo do pacto; e vos recolhereis a vossas cidades; mas eu enviarei pestilência entre vós, e sereis entregues em mão do inimigo.
verses.RVR09: Y traeré sobre vosotros espada vengadora, en vindicación del pacto; y os recogeréis á vuestras ciudades; mas yo enviaré pestilencia entre vosotros, y seréis entregados en mano del enemigo.

verses.KJV: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.WEB: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.ASV: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu vos quebrantar o sustento de pão, cozerão dez mulheres vosso pão em um forno, e vos devolverão vosso pão por peso; e comereis, e não vos fartareis.
verses.RVR09: Cuando yo os quebrantare el arrimo del pan, cocerán diez mujeres vuestro pan en un horno, y os devolverán vuestro pan por peso; y comeréis, y no os hartaréis.

verses.KJV: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
verses.WEB: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,
verses.ASV: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se com isto não me ouvirdes, mas procederdes comigo em oposição,
verses.RVR09: Y si con esto no me oyereis, mas procediereis conmigo en oposición,

verses.KJV: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.WEB: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.ASV: then I will walk contrary unto you in wrath; and I also will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu procederei convosco em contra e com ira, e vos castigarei ainda sete vezes por vossos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Yo procederé con vosotros en contra y con ira, y os castigaré aun siete veces por vuestros pecados.

verses.KJV: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
verses.WEB: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
verses.ASV: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comereis as carnes de vossos filhos, e comereis as carnes de vossas filhas:
verses.RVR09: Y comeréis las carnes de vuestros hijos, y comeréis las carnes de vuestras hijas:

verses.KJV: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
verses.WEB: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.
verses.ASV: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your sun-images, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul shall abhor you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E destruirei vossos altos, e exterminarei vossas imagens, e porei vossos corpos mortos sobre os corpos mortos de vossos ídolos, e meu alma vos abominará:
verses.RVR09: Y destruiré vuestros altos, y talaré vuestras imágenes, y pondré vuestros cuerpos muertos sobre los cuerpos muertos de vuestros ídolos, y mi alma os abominará:

verses.KJV: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
verses.WEB: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.
verses.ASV: And I will make your cities a waste, and will bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savor of your sweet odors.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei vossas cidades em deserto, e assolarei vossos santuários, e não cheirarei a fragrância de vosso suave incenso.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré vuestras ciudades en desierto, y asolaré vuestros santuarios, y no oleré la fragancia de vuestro suave perfume.

verses.KJV: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.WEB: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.
verses.ASV: And I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu assolarei também a terra, e se pasmarão dela vossos inimigos que nela moram:
verses.RVR09: Yo asolaré también la tierra, y se pasmarán de ella vuestros enemigos que en ella moran:

verses.KJV: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
verses.WEB: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
verses.ASV: And you will I scatter among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you: and your land shall be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a vós vos espalharei pelas nações, e desembainharei espada atrás de vós: e vossa terra estará assolada, e desertas vossas cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y á vosotros os esparciré por las gentes, y desenvainaré espada en pos de vosotros: y vuestra tierra estará asolada, y yermas vuestras ciudades.

verses.KJV: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
verses.WEB: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
verses.ASV: Then shall the land enjoy its sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye are in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy its sabbaths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a terra folgará seus sábados todos os dias que estiver assolada, e vós na terra de vossos inimigos: a terra descansará então e desfrutará seus sábados.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la tierra holgará sus sábados todos los días que estuviere asolada, y vosotros en la tierra de vuestros enemigos: la tierra descansará entonces y gozará sus sábados.

verses.KJV: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
verses.WEB: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.
verses.ASV: As long as it lieth desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it had not in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o tempo que estará assolada, folgará o que não folgou em vossos sábados enquanto habitáveis nela.
verses.RVR09: Todo el tiempo que estará asolada, holgará lo que no holgó en vuestros sábados mientras habitabais en ella.

verses.KJV: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.WEB: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.
verses.ASV: And as for them that are left of you, I will send a faintness into their heart in the lands of their enemies: and the sound of a driven leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as one fleeth from the sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos que restarem de vós porei em seus corações tal covardia, na terra de seus inimigos, que o som de uma folha movida os perseguirá, e fugirão como de espada, e cairão sem que ninguém os persiga:
verses.RVR09: Y á los que quedaren de vosotros infundiré en sus corazones tal cobardía, en la tierra de sus enemigos, que el sonido de una hoja movida los perseguirá, y huirán como de cuchillo, y caerán sin que nadie los persiga:

verses.KJV: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.WEB: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.ASV: And they shall stumble one upon another, as it were before the sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tropeçarão uns nos outros, como se fugissem diante de espada, ainda que ninguém os persiga; e não podereis resistir diante de vossos inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Y tropezarán los unos en los otros, como si huyeran delante de cuchillo, aunque nadie los persiga; y no podréis resistir delante de vuestros enemigos.

verses.KJV: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.WEB: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.
verses.ASV: And ye shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perecereis entre as nações, e a terra de vossos inimigos vos consumirá.
verses.RVR09: Y pereceréis entre las gentes, y la tierra de vuestros enemigos os consumirá.

verses.KJV: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.WEB: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
verses.ASV: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que restarem de vós perecerão nas terras de vossos inimigos por sua iniquidade; e pela iniquidade de seus pais perecerão com eles:
verses.RVR09: Y los que quedaren de vosotros decaerán en las tierras de vuestros enemigos por su iniquidad; y por la iniquidad de sus padres decaerán con ellos:

verses.KJV: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
verses.WEB: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,
verses.ASV: And they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary unto me,
verses.ALMEIDA: E confessarão sua iniquidade, e a iniquidade de seus pais, por sua transgressão com que transgrediram contra mim: e também porque andaram comigo em oposição,
verses.RVR09: Y confesarán su iniquidad, y la iniquidad de sus padres, por su prevaricación con que prevaricaron contra mí: y también porque anduvieron conmigo en oposición,

verses.KJV: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
verses.WEB: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,
verses.ASV: I also walked contrary unto them, and brought them into the land of their enemies: if then their uncircumcised heart be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu também houver andado contrário a eles, e os houver metido na terra de seus inimigos: e então se humilhará seu coração incircunciso, e reconhecerão seu pecado;
verses.RVR09: Yo también habré andado con ellos en contra, y los habré metido en la tierra de sus enemigos: y entonces se humillará su corazón incircunciso, y reconocerán su pecado;

verses.KJV: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.WEB: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.
verses.ASV: then will I remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu me lembrarei de meu pacto com Jacó, e também de meu pacto com Isaque, e também de meu pacto com Abraão me lembrarei; e farei memória da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y yo me acordaré de mi pacto con Jacob, y asimismo de mi pacto con Isaac, y también de mi pacto con Abraham me acordaré; y haré memoria de la tierra.

verses.KJV: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.WEB: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.ASV: The land also shall be left by them, and shall enjoy its sabbaths, while it lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected mine ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que a terra estará desamparada deles, e folgará seus sábados, estando deserta por causa deles; mas entretanto se submeterão ao castigo de suas iniquidades: porquanto menosprezaram meus regulamentos, e teve a alma deles ódio de meus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Que la tierra estará desamparada de ellos, y holgará sus sábados, estando yerma á causa de ellos; mas entretanto se someterán al castigo de sus iniquidades: por cuanto menospreciaron mis derechos, y tuvo el alma de ellos fastidio de mis estatutos.

verses.KJV: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the Lord their God.
verses.WEB: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
verses.ASV: And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Jehovah their God;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda com tudo isto, estando eles em terra de seus inimigos, eu não os rejeitarei, nem os abominarei para consumi-los, invalidando meu pacto com eles: porque eu o SENHOR sou seu Deus:
verses.RVR09: Y aun con todo esto, estando ellos en tierra de sus enemigos, yo no los desecharé, ni los abominaré para consumirlos, invalidando mi pacto con ellos: porque yo Jehová soy su Dios:

verses.KJV: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: but I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes me lembrarei deles pelo pacto antigo, quando os tirei da terra do Egito aos olhos das nações, para ser seu Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Antes me acordaré de ellos por el pacto antiguo, cuando los saqué de la tierra de Egipto á los ojos de las gentes, para ser su Dios: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the Lord made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
verses.ASV: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws, which Jehovah made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os decretos, regulamentos e leis que estabeleceu o SENHOR entre si e os filhos de Israel no monte Sinai por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los decretos, derechos y leyes que estableció Jehová entre sí y los hijos de Israel en el monte de Sinaí por mano de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the Lord by thy estimation.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall accomplish a vow, the persons shall be for Jehovah by thy estimation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando alguém fizer especial voto ao SENHOR, segundo a avaliação das pessoas que se hajam de resgatar, assim será tua avaliação:
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando alguno hiciere especial voto á Jehová, según la estimación de las personas que se hayan de redimir, así será tu estimación:

verses.KJV: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.WEB: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.ASV: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em quanto ao homem de vinte anos até sessenta, tua avaliação será cinquenta siclos de prata, segundo o siclo do santuário.
verses.RVR09: En cuanto al varón de veinte años hasta sesenta, tu estimación será cincuenta siclos de plata, según el siclo del santuario.

verses.KJV: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.WEB: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.ASV: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se for fêmea, a avaliação será trinta siclos.
verses.RVR09: Y si fuere hembra, la estimación será treinta siclos.

verses.KJV: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.WEB: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
verses.ASV: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se for de cinco anos até vinte, tua avaliação será respeito ao homem vinte siclos, e à fêmea dez siclos.
verses.RVR09: Y si fuere de cinco años hasta veinte, tu estimación será respecto al varón veinte siclos, y á la hembra diez siclos.

verses.KJV: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.WEB: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.ASV: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se for de um mês até cinco anos, tua avaliação será em ordem ao homem, cinco siclos de prata; e pela fêmea será tua avaliação três siclos de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y si fuere de un mes hasta cinco años, tu estimación será en orden al varón, cinco siclos de plata; y por la hembra será tu estimación tres siclos de plata.

verses.KJV: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.WEB: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
verses.ASV: And if it be from sixty years old and upward; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se for de sessenta anos acima, pelo homem tua avaliação será quinze siclos, e pela fêmea dez siclos.
verses.RVR09: Mas si fuere de sesenta años arriba, por el varón tu estimación será quince siclos, y por la hembra diez siclos.

verses.KJV: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.WEB: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.
verses.ASV: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to the ability of him that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se for mais pobre que tua avaliação, então comparecerá ante o sacerdote, e o sacerdote lhe porá valor: conforme a capacidade do votante lhe imporá valor o sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Pero si fuere más pobre que tu estimación, entonces comparecerá ante el sacerdote, y el sacerdote le pondrá tasa: conforme á la facultad del votante le impondrá tasa el sacerdote.

verses.KJV: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the Lord, all that any man giveth of such unto the Lord shall be holy.
verses.WEB: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.
verses.ASV: And if it be a beast, whereof men offer an oblation unto Jehovah, all that any man giveth of such unto Jehovah shall be holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se for animal de que se oferece oferta ao SENHOR, tudo o que se der dele ao SENHOR será santo.
verses.RVR09: Y si fuere animal de que se ofrece ofrenda á Jehová, todo lo que se diere de él á Jehová será santo.

verses.KJV: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
verses.WEB: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.
verses.ASV: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não será mudado nem trocado, bom por mau, nem mau por bom; e se se permutar um animal por outro, ele e o dado por ele em troca serão sagrados.
verses.RVR09: No será mudado ni trocado, bueno por malo, ni malo por bueno: y si se permutare un animal por otro, él y el dado por él en cambio serán sagrados.

verses.KJV: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the Lord, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
verses.WEB: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD, then he shall set the animal before the priest;
verses.ASV: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer an oblation unto Jehovah, then he shall set the beast before the priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se for algum animal impuro, de que não se oferece oferta ao SENHOR, então o animal será posto diante do sacerdote:
verses.RVR09: Y si fuere algún animal inmundo, de que no se ofrece ofrenda á Jehová, entonces el animal será puesto delante del sacerdote:

verses.KJV: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
verses.WEB: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou the priest valuest it, so shall it be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote o avaliará preço, seja bom ou seja mau; conforme a avaliação do sacerdote, assim será.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote lo apreciará, sea bueno ó sea malo; conforme á la estimación del sacerdote, así será.

verses.KJV: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
verses.WEB: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.
verses.ASV: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o houverem de resgatar, acrescentarão seu quinto sobre tua avaliação.
verses.RVR09: Y si lo hubieren de redimir, añadirán su quinto sobre tu valuación.

verses.KJV: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the Lord, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.WEB: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.
verses.ASV: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto Jehovah, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando alguém santificar sua casa consagrando-a ao SENHOR, a avaliará preço o sacerdote, seja boa ou seja má: segundo a avaliar o sacerdote, assim ficará.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando alguno santificare su casa consagrándola á Jehová, la apreciará el sacerdote, sea buena ó sea mala: según la apreciare el sacerdote, así quedará.

verses.KJV: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.WEB: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
verses.ASV: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se o que a santificar resgatar sua casa, acrescentará à tua avaliação o quinto do dinheiro dela, e será sua.
verses.RVR09: Mas si el santificante redimiere su casa, añadirá á tu valuación el quinto del dinero de ella, y será suya.

verses.KJV: And if a man shall sanctify unto the Lord some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.WEB: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.ASV: And if a man shall sanctify unto Jehovah part of the field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the sowing thereof: the sowing of a homer of barley [shall be valued] at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém santificar da terra de sua possessão ao SENHOR, tua avaliação será conforme sua semeadura: um ômer de semeadura de cevada se avaliará preço em cinquenta siclos de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno santificare de la tierra de su posesión á Jehová, tu estimación será conforme á su sembradura: un omer de sembradura de cebada se apreciará en cincuenta siclos de plata.

verses.KJV: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
verses.WEB: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.
verses.ASV: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se santificar sua terra desde o ano do jubileu, conforme tua avaliação ficará.
verses.RVR09: Y si santificare su tierra desde el año del jubileo, conforme á tu estimación quedará.

verses.KJV: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
verses.WEB: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.
verses.ASV: But if he sanctify his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain unto the year of jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from thy estimation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se depois do jubileu santificar sua terra, então o sacerdote fará a conta do dinheiro conforme os anos que restarem até o ano do jubileu, e se diminuirá de tua avaliação.
verses.RVR09: Mas si después del jubileo santificare su tierra, entonces el sacerdote hará la cuenta del dinero conforme á los años que quedaren hasta el año del jubileo, y se rebajará de tu estimación.

verses.KJV: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.WEB: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.
verses.ASV: And if he that sanctified the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o que santificou a terra quiser resgatá-la, acrescentará à tua avaliação o quinto do dinheiro dela, e ficará para ele.
verses.RVR09: Y si el que santificó la tierra quisiere redimirla, añadirá á tu estimación el quinto del dinero de ella, y quedaráse para él.

verses.KJV: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.WEB: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;
verses.ASV: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se ele não resgatar a terra, e a terra se vender a outro, não a resgatará mais;
verses.RVR09: Mas si él no redimiere la tierra, y la tierra se vendiere á otro, no la redimirá más;

verses.KJV: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the Lord, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
verses.WEB: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.
verses.ASV: but the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy unto Jehovah, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso quando sair no jubileu, a terra será santa ao SENHOR, como terra consagrada: a possessão dela será do sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Sino que cuando saliere en el jubileo, la tierra será santa á Jehová, como tierra consagrada: la posesión de ella será del sacerdote.

verses.KJV: And if a man sanctify unto the Lord a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
verses.WEB: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,
verses.ASV: And if he sanctify unto Jehovah a field which he hath bought, which is not of the field of his possession;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se santificar alguém ao SENHOR a terra que ele comprou, que não era da terra de sua herança,
verses.RVR09: Y si santificare alguno á Jehová la tierra que él compró, que no era de la tierra de su herencia,

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.
verses.ASV: then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation unto the year of jubilee: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o sacerdote calculará com ele a soma de tua avaliação até o ano do jubileu, e aquele dia dará teu assinalado preço, coisa consagrada ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el sacerdote calculará con él la suma de tu estimación hasta el año del jubileo, y aquel día dará tu señalado precio, cosa consagrada á Jehová.

verses.KJV: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
verses.WEB: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.
verses.ASV: In the year of jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano do jubileu, voltará a terra a aquele de quem ele a comprou, cuja é a herança da terra.
verses.RVR09: En el año del jubileo, volverá la tierra á aquél de quien él la compró, cuya es la herencia de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.WEB: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.
verses.ASV: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo o que avaliares o preço será conforme o siclo do santuário: o siclo tem vinte óbolos.
verses.RVR09: Y todo lo que apreciares será conforme al siclo del santuario: el siclo tiene veinte óbolos.

verses.KJV: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the Lord's.
verses.WEB: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to the LORD as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is the LORD’s.
verses.ASV: Only the firstling among beasts, which is made a firstling to Jehovah, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox or sheep, it is Jehovah’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o primogênito dos animais, que pela primogenitura é do SENHOR, ninguém o santificará; seja boi ou ovelha, do SENHOR é.
verses.RVR09: Empero el primogénito de los animales, que por la primogenitura es de Jehová, nadie lo santificará; sea buey ú oveja, de Jehová es.

verses.KJV: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
verses.WEB: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.
verses.ASV: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall ransom it according to thine estimation, and shall add unto it the fifth part thereof: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se for dos animais impuros, o resgatarão conforme tua avaliação, e acrescentarão sobre ela seu quinto: e se não o resgatarem, se venderá conforme tua avaliação.
verses.RVR09: Mas si fuere de los animales inmundos, lo redimirán conforme á tu estimación, y añadirán sobre ella su quinto: y si no lo redimieren, se venderá conforme á tu estimación.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the Lord of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto Jehovah of all that he hath, whether of man or beast, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nenhuma coisa consagrada, que alguém houver santificado ao SENHOR de tudo o que tiver, de homens e animais, e das terras de sua possessão, não se venderá, nem se resgatará: todo o consagrado será coisa santíssima ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Pero ninguna cosa consagrada, que alguno hubiere santificado á Jehová de todo lo que tuviere, de hombres y animales, y de las tierras de su posesión, no se venderá, ni se redimirá: todo lo consagrado será cosa santísima á Jehová.

verses.KJV: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: No one devoted, that shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que for consagrado dentre o homens que for separado para a condenação não será resgatado; inevitavelmente será morto.
verses.RVR09: Cualquier anatema (cosa consagrada) de hombres que se consagrare, no será redimido: indefectiblemente ha de ser muerto.

verses.KJV: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord's: it is holy unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD’s. It is holy to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is Jehovah’s: it is holy unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os dízimos da terra, tanto das sementes da terra como dos frutos das árvores, pertencem ao SENHOR; são coisas consagradas ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las décimas de la tierra, así de la simiente de la tierra como del fruto de los árboles, de Jehová son: es cosa consagrada á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
verses.WEB: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.
verses.ASV: And if a man will redeem aught of his tithe, he shall add unto it the fifth part thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém quiser resgatar algo de seus dízimos, acrescentará seu quinto a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno quisiere redimir algo de sus décimas, añadirá su quinto á ello.

verses.ALMEIDA: E seu exército, com os contados deles, trinta e dois mil e duzentos:
verses.RVR09: Y su hueste, con los contados de ellos, treinta y dos mil y doscientos:

verses.KJV: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.WEB: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.ASV: And the tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a tribo de Benjamim: e o chefe dos filhos de Benjamim, Abidã filho de Gideoni;
verses.RVR09: Y la tribu de Benjamín: y el jefe de los hijos de Benjamín, Abidán hijo de Gedeón;

verses.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.WEB: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu exército, com os contados deles, trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.
verses.RVR09: Y su hueste, con los contados de ellos, treinta y cinco mil y cuatrocientos.

verses.KJV: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.WEB: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.
verses.ASV: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth third.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os contados no exército de Efraim, cento e oito mil e cem, por seus esquadrões, irão na terceira posição.
verses.RVR09: Todos los contados en el ejército de Ephraim, ciento ocho mil y ciento, por sus escuadrones, irán los terceros.

verses.KJV: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.WEB: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.ASV: On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.ALMEIDA: A bandeira do exército de Dã estará ao norte, por seus esquadrões: e o chefe dos filhos de Dã, Aiezer filho de Amisadai;
verses.RVR09: La bandera del ejército de Dan estará al aquilón, por sus escuadrones: y el jefe de los hijos de Dan, Ahiezer hijo de Amisaddai;

verses.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.WEB: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu exército, com os contados deles, sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.
verses.RVR09: Y su hueste, con los contados de ellos, sesenta y dos mil y setecientos.

verses.KJV: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.WEB: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.ASV: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto a ele acamparão os da tribo de Aser: e o chefe dos filhos de Aser, Pagiel filho de Ocrã;
verses.RVR09: Junto á él acamparán los de la tribu de Aser: y el jefe de los hijos de Aser, Phegiel hijo de Ocrán;

verses.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.WEB: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.ASV: And his hosts, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu exército, com os contados deles, quarenta e um mil e quinhentos:
verses.RVR09: Y su hueste, con los contados de ellos, cuarenta y un mil y quinientos:

verses.KJV: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.WEB: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.ASV: And the tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a tribo de Naftali: e o chefe dos filhos de Naftali, Aira filho de Enã;
verses.RVR09: Y la tribu de Nephtalí: y el jefe de los hijos de Nephtalí, Ahira hijo de Enán;

verses.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.WEB: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu exército, com os contados deles, cinquenta e três mil e quatrocentos.
verses.RVR09: Y su hueste, con los contados de ellos, cincuenta y tres mil y cuatrocientos.

verses.KJV: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.WEB: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”
verses.ASV: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan were a hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall set forth hindmost by their standards.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os contados no exército de Dã, cento cinquenta e sete mil e seiscentos: irão os últimos atrás de suas bandeiras.
verses.RVR09: Todos los contados en el ejército de Dan, ciento cincuenta y siete mil y seiscientos: irán los postreros tras sus banderas.

verses.KJV: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.WEB: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses: all that were numbered of the camps according to their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os contados dos filhos de Israel, pelas casas de seus pais: todos os contados por exércitos, por seus esquadrões, seiscentos três mil quinhentos e cinquenta.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los contados de los hijos de Israel, por las casas de sus padres: todos los contados por ejércitos, por sus escuadrones, seiscientos tres mil quinientos y cincuenta.

verses.KJV: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os levitas não foram contados entre os filhos de Israel; como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Mas los Levitas no fueron contados entre los hijos de Israel; como Jehová lo mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
verses.WEB: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.ASV: Thus did the children of Israel; according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set forward, every one by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram os filhos de Israel conforme todas as coisas que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés; assim assentaram o acampamento por suas bandeiras, e assim marcharam cada um por suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: E hicieron los hijos de Israel conforme á todas las cosas que Jehová mandó á Moisés; así asentaron el campo por sus banderas, y así marcharon cada uno por sus familias, según las casas de sus padres.

verses.KJV: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.
verses.ASV: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Jehovah spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as gerações de Arão e de Moisés, desde que o SENHOR falou a Moisés no monte Sinai.
verses.RVR09: Y ESTAS son las generaciones de Aarón y de Moisés, desde que Jehová habló á Moisés en el monte de Sinaí.

verses.KJV: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.ASV: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the first-born, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão: Nadabe o primogênito, e Abiú, Eleazar, e Itamar.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los nombres de los hijos de Aarón: Nadab el primogénito, y Abiú, Eleazar, é Ithamar.

verses.KJV: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.ASV: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests that were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão, sacerdotes ungidos; cujas mãos ele encheu para administrar o sacerdócio.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los nombres de los hijos de Aarón, sacerdotes ungidos; cuyas manos él hinchió para administrar el sacerdocio.

verses.KJV: And Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord, when they offered strange fire before the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
verses.WEB: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
verses.ASV: And Nadab and Abihu died before Jehovah, when they offered strange fire before Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram diante do SENHOR, quando ofereceram fogo estranho diante do SENHOR, no deserto de Sinai: e não tiveram filhos: e Eleazar e Itamar exerceram o sacerdócio diante de Arão seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Mas Nadab y Abiú murieron delante de Jehová, cuando ofrecieron fuego extraño delante de Jehová, en el desierto de Sinaí: y no tuvieron hijos: y Eleazar é Ithamar ejercieron el sacerdocio delante de Aarón su padre.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.WEB: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
verses.ASV: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze chegar à tribo de Levi, e faze-a estar diante do sacerdote Arão, para que lhe ministrem;
verses.RVR09: Haz llegar á la tribu de Leví, y hazla estar delante del sacerdote Aarón, para que le ministren;

verses.KJV: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desempenhem seu cargo, e o cargo de toda a congregação diante do tabernáculo do testemunho, para servir no ministério do tabernáculo;
verses.RVR09: Y desempeñen su cargo, y el cargo de toda la congregación delante del tabernáculo del testimonio, para servir en el ministerio del tabernáculo;

verses.KJV: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: And they shall keep all the furniture of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E guardem todos os móveis do tabernáculo do testemunho, e o encarregado a eles dos filhos de Israel, e ministrem no serviço do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Y guarden todas las alhajas del tabernáculo del testimonio, y lo encargado á ellos de los hijos de Israel, y ministren en el servicio del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E darás os levitas a Arão e a seus filhos: são inteiramente dados a eles dentre os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y darás los Levitas á Aarón y á sus hijos: le son enteramente dados de entre los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.WEB: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
verses.ASV: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E constituirás a Arão e a seus filhos, para que exerçam seu sacerdócio: e o estranho que se chegar, morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y constituirás á Aarón y á sus hijos, para que ejerzan su sacerdocio: y el extraño que se llegare, morirá.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
verses.WEB: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,
verses.ASV: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the first-born that openeth the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que eu tomei os levitas dentre os filhos de Israel em lugar de todos os primogênitos que abrem a madre entre os filhos de Israel; serão, pois, meus os levitas:
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí yo he tomado los Levitas de entre los hijos de Israel en lugar de todos los primogénitos que abren la matriz entre los hijos de Israel; serán pues míos los Levitas:

verses.KJV: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: for all the first-born are mine; on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the first-born in Israel, both man and beast; mine they shall be: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque meu é todo primogênito; desde o dia que eu matei todos os primogênitos na terra do Egito, eu santifiquei a mim todos os primogênitos em Israel, tanto de homens como de animais; meus serão; Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque mío es todo primogénito; desde el día que yo maté todos los primogénitos en la tierra de Egipto, yo santifiqué á mí todos los primogénitos en Israel, así de hombres como de animales: míos serán: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés no deserto de Sinai, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés en el desierto de Sinaí, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.WEB: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”
verses.ASV: Number the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conta os filhos de Levi pelas casas de seus pais, por suas famílias: contarás todos os homens de um mês acima.
verses.RVR09: Cuenta los hijos de Leví por las casas de sus padres, por sus familias: contarás todos los varones de un mes arriba.

verses.KJV: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.
verses.WEB: Moses counted them according to the LORD’s word, as he was commanded.
verses.ASV: And Moses numbered them according to the word of Jehovah, as he was commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés os contou conforme a palavra do SENHOR, como lhe foi mandado.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés los contó conforme á la palabra de Jehová, como le fué mandado.

verses.KJV: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.WEB: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ASV: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Levi foram estes por seus nomes: Gérson, e Coate, e Merari.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Leví fueron estos por sus nombres: Gersón, y Coath, y Merari.

verses.KJV: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
verses.ASV: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os nomes dos filhos de Gérson, por suas famílias, estes: Libni, e Simei.
verses.RVR09: Y los nombres de los hijos de Gersón, por sus familias, estos: Libni, y Simei.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.WEB: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Coate, por suas famílias: Anrão, e Izar, e Hebrom, e Uziel.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Coath, por sus familias: Amram, é Izhar, y Hebrón, y Uzziel.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
verses.WEB: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Merari, por suas famílias: Mali, e Musi. Estas, as famílias de Levi, pelas casas de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Merari, por sus familias: Mahali, y Musi. Estas, las familias de Leví, por las casas de sus padres.

verses.KJV: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
verses.WEB: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.
verses.ASV: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
verses.ALMEIDA: De Gérson, a família de Libni e a de Simei: estas são as famílias de Gérson.
verses.RVR09: De Gersón, la familia de Libni y la de Simei: estas son las familias de Gersón.

verses.KJV: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.WEB: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.
verses.ASV: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os contados deles conforme a conta de todos os homens de um mês acima, os contados deles, sete mil e quinhentos.
verses.RVR09: Los contados de ellos conforme á la cuenta de todos los varones de un mes arriba, los contados de ellos, siete mil y quinientos.

verses.KJV: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.WEB: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.ASV: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.ALMEIDA: As famílias de Gérson assentarão suas tendas à retaguarda do tabernáculo, ao ocidente;
verses.RVR09: Las familias de Gersón asentarán sus tiendas á espaldas del tabernáculo, al occidente;

verses.KJV: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.WEB: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.
verses.ASV: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o chefe da casa do pai dos gersonitas, Eliasafe filho de Lael.
verses.RVR09: Y el jefe de la casa del padre de los Gersonitas, Eliasaph hijo de Lael.

verses.KJV: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.WEB: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
verses.ASV: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the Tent, the covering thereof, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,
verses.ALMEIDA: A cargo dos filhos de Gérson, no tabernáculo do testemunho, estará o tabernáculo, e a tenda, e sua cobertura, e a cortina da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho,
verses.RVR09: A cargo de los hijos de Gersón, en el tabernáculo del testimonio, estará el tabernáculo, y la tienda, y su cubierta, y el pabellón de la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio,

verses.KJV: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.WEB: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.
verses.ASV: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as cortinas do átrio, e a cortina da porta do átrio, que está junto ao tabernáculo e junto ao altar ao redor; também suas cordas para todo seu serviço.
verses.RVR09: Y las cortinas del atrio, y el pabellón de la puerta del atrio, que está junto al tabernáculo y junto al altar alrededor; asimismo sus cuerdas para todo su servicio.

verses.KJV: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.WEB: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.ASV: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Coate, a família dos anramitas, e a família dos izaritas, e a família dos hebronitas, e a família dos uzielitas: estas são as famílias coatitas.
verses.RVR09: Y de Coath, la familia Amramítica, y la familia Izeharítica, y la familia Hebronítica, y la familia Ozielítica: estas son las familias Coathitas.

verses.KJV: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.WEB: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
verses.ASV: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela conta de todos os homens de um mês acima, eram oito mil e seiscentos, que tinham a guarda do santuário.
verses.RVR09: Por la cuenta de todos los varones de un mes arriba, eran ocho mil y seiscientos, que tenían la guarda del santuario.

verses.KJV: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.WEB: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.ALMEIDA: As famílias dos filhos de Coate acamparão ao lado do tabernáculo, ao sul;
verses.RVR09: Las familias de los hijos de Coath acamparán al lado del tabernáculo, al mediodía;

verses.KJV: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.WEB: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.ASV: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o chefe da casa do pai das famílias de Coate, Elisafã filho de Uziel.
verses.RVR09: Y el jefe de la casa del padre de las familias de Coath, Elisaphán hijo de Uzziel.

verses.KJV: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
verses.WEB: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.
verses.ASV: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the screen, and all the service thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cargo deles estará a arca, e a mesa, e o candelabro, e os altares, e os utensílios do santuário com que ministram, e o véu, com todo seu serviço.
verses.RVR09: Y á cargo de ellos estará el arca, y la mesa, y el candelero, y los altares, y los vasos del santuario con que ministran, y el velo, con todo su servicio.

verses.KJV: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.WEB: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.
verses.ASV: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, [and have] the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o principal dos chefes dos levitas será Eleazar, filho de Arão o sacerdote, supervisor dos que têm a guarda do santuário.
verses.RVR09: Y el principal de los jefes de los Levitas será Eleazar, hijo de Aarón el sacerdote, prepósito de los que tienen la guarda del santuario.

verses.KJV: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
verses.WEB: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
verses.ASV: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
verses.ALMEIDA: De Merari, a família dos malitas e a família dos musitas: estas são as famílias de Merari.
verses.RVR09: De Merari, la familia Mahalítica, y la familia Musítica: estas son las familias de Merari.

verses.KJV: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
verses.WEB: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
verses.ASV: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os contados deles conforme a conta de todos os homens de um mês acima, foram seis mil e duzentos.
verses.RVR09: Y los contados de ellos conforme á la cuenta de todos los varones de un mes arriba, fueron seis mil y doscientos.

verses.KJV: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.WEB: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
verses.ASV: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: they shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o chefe da casa do pai das famílias de Merari, Zuriel filho de Abiail: acamparão ao lado do tabernáculo, ao norte.
verses.RVR09: Y el jefe de la casa del padre de las familias de Merari, Suriel hijo de Abihail: acamparán al lado del tabernáculo, al aquilón.

verses.KJV: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
verses.WEB: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
verses.ASV: And the appointed charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the instruments thereof, and all the service thereof,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cargo dos filhos de Merari estará a custódia das tábuas do tabernáculo, e suas barras, e suas colunas, e suas bases, e todos os seus utensílios, com todo seu serviço:
verses.RVR09: Y á cargo de los hijos de Merari estará la custodia de las tablas del tabernáculo, y sus barras, y sus columnas, y sus basas, y todos sus enseres, con todo su servicio:

verses.KJV: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.WEB: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
verses.ASV: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as colunas em derredor do átrio, e suas bases, e suas estacas, e suas cordas.
verses.RVR09: Y las columnas en derredor del atrio, y sus basas, y sus estacas, y sus cuerdas.

verses.KJV: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.WEB: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
verses.ASV: And those that encamp before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que acamparão diante do tabernáculo ao oriente, diante do tabernáculo do testemunho ao levante, serão Moisés, e Arão e seus filhos, tendo a guarda do santuário em lugar dos filhos de Israel: e o estranho que se aproximar, morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y los que acamparán delante del tabernáculo al oriente, delante del tabernáculo del testimonio al levante, serán Moisés, y Aarón y sus hijos, teniendo la guarda del santuario en lugar de los hijos de Israel: y el extraño que se acercare, morirá.

verses.KJV: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
verses.WEB: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
verses.ASV: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Jehovah, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os contados dos levitas, que Moisés e Arão conforme a palavra do SENHOR contaram por suas famílias, todos os homens de um mês acima, foram vinte e dois mil.
verses.RVR09: Todos los contados de los Levitas, que Moisés y Aarón conforme á la palabra de Jehová contaron por sus familias, todos los varones de un mes arriba, fueron veinte y dos mil.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Number all the first-born males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Conta todos os primogênitos homens dos filhos de Israel de um mês acima, e toma a conta dos nomes deles.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Cuenta todos los primogénitos varones de los hijos de Israel de un mes arriba, y toma la cuenta de los nombres de ellos.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the Lord) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”
