verses.ASV: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am Jehovah) instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomarás os levitas para mim, eu o SENHOR, em lugar de todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel: e os animais dos levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos dos animais dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y tomarás los Levitas para mí, yo Jehová, en lugar de todos los primogénitos de los hijos de Israel: y los animales de los Levitas en lugar de todos los primogénitos de los animales de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses numbered, as the Lord commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Moses numbered, as Jehovah commanded him, all the first-born among the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E contou Moisés, como o SENHOR lhe mandou, todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y contó Moisés, como Jehová le mandó, todos los primogénitos de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.WEB: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
verses.ASV: And all the first-born males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os primogênitos homens, conforme a conta dos nomes, de um mês acima, os contados deles foram vinte e dois mil duzentos setenta e três.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los primogénitos varones, conforme á la cuenta de los nombres, de un mes arriba, los contados de ellos fueron veinte y dos mil doscientos setenta y tres.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Take the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma os levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel, e os animais dos levitas em lugar de seus animais; e os levitas serão meus: Eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Toma los Levitas en lugar de todos los primogénitos de los hijos de Israel, y los animales de los Levitas en lugar de sus animales; y los Levitas serán míos: Yo Jehová.

verses.KJV: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
verses.WEB: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,
verses.ASV: And for the redemption of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the first-born of the children of Israel, that are over and above [the number of] the Levites,
verses.ALMEIDA: E pelos resgates dos duzentos e setenta e três, que excedem aos levitas os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel;
verses.RVR09: Y por los rescates de los doscientos y setenta y tres, que sobrepujan á los Levitas los primogénitos de los hijos de Israel,

verses.KJV: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
verses.WEB: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);
verses.ASV: thou shalt take five shekels apiece by the poll; after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomarás cinco siclos por cabeça; conforme o siclo do santuário tomarás: o siclo tem vinte óbolos:
verses.RVR09: Tomarás cinco siclos por cabeza; conforme al siclo del santuario tomarás: el siclo tiene veinte óbolos:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.WEB: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”
verses.ASV: and thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E darás a Arão e a seus filhos o dinheiro pelos resgates dos que deles sobram.
verses.RVR09: Y darás á Aarón y á sus hijos el dinero por los rescates de los que de ellos sobran.

verses.KJV: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.WEB: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;
verses.ASV: And Moses took the redemption-money from them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou, pois, Moisés o dinheiro do resgate dos que resultaram a mais dos resgatados pelos levitas:
verses.RVR09: Tomó, pues, Moisés el dinero del rescate de los que resultaron de más de los redimidos por los Levitas:

verses.KJV: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.WEB: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
verses.ASV: from the first-born of the children of Israel took he the money, a thousand three hundred and threescore and five [shekels], after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.ALMEIDA: E recebeu dos primogênitos dos filhos de Israel em dinheiro, mil trezentos sessenta e cinco siclos, conforme o siclo do santuário.
verses.RVR09: Y recibió de los primogénitos de los hijos de Israel en dinero, mil trescientos sesenta y cinco siclos, conforme al siclo del santuario.

verses.KJV: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: and Moses gave the redemption-money unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Jehovah, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés deu o dinheiro dos resgates a Arão e a seus filhos, conforme o dito do SENHOR, segundo que o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés dió el dinero de los rescates á Aarón y á sus hijos, conforme al dicho de Jehová, según que Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés y á Aarón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.WEB: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ASV: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma a conta dos filhos de Coate dentre os filhos de Levi, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.RVR09: Toma la cuenta de los hijos de Coath de entre los hijos de Leví, por sus familias, por las casas de sus padres,

verses.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: De idade de trinta anos acima até cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: De edad de treinta años arriba hasta cincuenta años, todos los que entran en compañía, para hacer servicio en el tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
verses.WEB: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
verses.ASV: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting, [about] the most holy things:
verses.ALMEIDA: Este será o ofício dos filhos de Coate no tabernáculo do testemunho, no lugar santíssimo:
verses.RVR09: Este será el oficio de los hijos de Coath en el tabernáculo del testimonio, en el lugar santísimo:

verses.KJV: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.WEB: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,
verses.ASV: when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the testimony with it,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando se houver de mudar o acampamento, virão Arão e seus filhos, e desarmarão o véu da tenda, e cobrirão com ele a arca do testemunho:
verses.RVR09: Cuando se hubiere de mudar el campo, vendrán Aarón y sus hijos, y desarmarán el velo de la tienda, y cubrirán con él el arca del testimonio:

verses.KJV: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.WEB: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.
verses.ASV: and shall put thereon a covering of sealskin, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porão sobre ela a coberta de peles finas, e estenderão encima o pano todo de azul, e lhe porão suas varas.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrán sobre ella la cubierta de pieles de tejones, y extenderán encima el paño todo de cárdeno, y le pondrán sus varas.

verses.KJV: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
verses.WEB: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
verses.ASV: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls and the cups wherewith to pour out; and the continual bread shall be thereon:
verses.ALMEIDA: E sobre a mesa da proposição estenderão o pano azul, e porão sobre ela os pratos, e as colheres, e os copos, e as taças para fazer libações: e o pão contínuo estará sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre la mesa de la proposición extenderán el paño cárdeno, y pondrán sobre ella las escudillas, y las cucharas, y las copas, y los tazones para libar: y el pan continuo estará sobre ella.

verses.KJV: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.WEB: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
verses.ASV: and they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estenderão sobre ela o pano de carmesim colorido, e o cobrirão com a coberta de peles finas; e lhe porão suas varas.
verses.RVR09: Y extenderán sobre ella el paño de carmesí colorado, y lo cubrirán con la cubierta de pieles de tejones; y le pondrán sus varas.

verses.KJV: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.WEB: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.
verses.ASV: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomarão um pano azul, e cobrirão o candelabro da luminária; e suas lâmpadas, e suas tenazes, e seus apagadores, e todos os seus vasos do azeite com que se serve;
verses.RVR09: Y tomarán un paño cárdeno, y cubrirán el candelero de la luminaria; y sus candilejas, y sus despabiladeras, y sus platillos, y todos sus vasos del aceite con que se sirve;

verses.KJV: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
verses.WEB: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
verses.ASV: and they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it upon the frame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o porão com todos os seus utensílios em uma coberta de peles finos, e o colocarão sobre umas armações.
verses.RVR09: Y lo pondrán con todos sus vasos en una cubierta de pieles de tejones, y lo colocarán sobre unas parihuelas.

verses.KJV: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
verses.WEB: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
verses.ASV: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: E sobre o altar de ouro estenderão o pano azul, e lhe cobrirão com a coberta de peles finas, e lhe porão suas varas.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre el altar de oro extenderán el paño cárdeno, y le cubrirán con la cubierta de pieles de tejones, y le pondrán sus varales.

verses.KJV: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:
verses.WEB: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
verses.ASV: and they shall take all the vessels of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomarão todos os vasos do serviço, de que fazem uso no santuário, e os porão em um pano azul, e os cobrirão com uma coberta de peles finas, e os colocarão sobre umas armações.
verses.RVR09: Y tomarán todos los vasos del servicio, de que hacen uso en el santuario, y los pondrán en un paño cárdeno, y los cubrirán con una cubierta de pieles de tejones, y los colocarán sobre unas parihuelas.

verses.KJV: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.WEB: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.
verses.ASV: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirarão a cinza do altar, e estenderão sobre ele um pano de púrpura:
verses.RVR09: Y quitarán la ceniza del altar, y extenderán sobre él un paño de púrpura:

verses.KJV: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
verses.WEB: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
verses.ASV: and they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, the firepans, the flesh-hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of sealskin, and put in the staves thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porão sobre ele todos os seus instrumentos de que se serve: as pás, os garfos, os braseiros, e as taças, todos os utensílios do altar; e estenderão sobre ele o propiciatório de peles finas, e lhe porão também as varas.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrán sobre él todos sus instrumentos de que se sirve: las paletas, los garfios, los braseros, y los tazones, todos los vasos del altar; y extenderán sobre él la cubierta de pieles de tejones, y le pondrán además las varas.

verses.KJV: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp is set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em acabando Arão e seus filhos de cobrir o santuário e todos os vasos do santuário, quando o acampamento se houver de mudar, virão depois disso os filhos de Coate para conduzir: mas não tocarão coisa santa, que morrerão. Estas serão as cargas dos filhos de Coate no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y en acabando Aarón y sus hijos de cubrir el santuario y todos los vasos del santuario, cuando el campo se hubiere de mudar, vendrán después de ello los hijos de Coath para conducir: mas no tocarán cosa santa, que morirán. Estas serán las cargas de los hijos de Coath en el tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
verses.WEB: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
verses.ASV: And the charge of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the continual meal-offering, and the anointing oil, the charge of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, the sanctuary, and the furniture thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ao cargo de Eleazar, filho de Arão o sacerdote, estará o azeite da luminária, e o incenso aromático, e a oferta de cereais contínua, e o azeite da unção; o cargo de todo o tabernáculo, e de tudo o que está nele, no santuário, e em seus utensílios.
verses.RVR09: Empero al cargo de Eleazar, hijo de Aarón el sacerdote, estará el aceite de la luminaria, y el perfume aromático, y el presente continuo, y el aceite de la unción; el cargo de todo el tabernáculo, y de todo lo que está en él, en el santuario, y en sus vasos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés y á Aarón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.WEB: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
verses.ASV: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não cortareis a tribo das famílias de Coate dentre os levitas;
verses.RVR09: No cortaréis la tribu de las familias de Coath de entre los Levitas;

verses.KJV: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.WEB: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;
verses.ASV: but thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas isto fareis com eles, para que vivam, e não morram quando achegarem ao lugar santíssimo: Arão e seus filhos virão e os porão a cada um em seu ofício, e em seu cargo.
verses.RVR09: Mas esto haréis con ellos, para que vivan, y no mueran cuando llegaren al lugar santísimo: Aarón y sus hijos vendrán y los pondrán á cada uno en su oficio, y en su cargo.

verses.KJV: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.WEB: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
verses.ASV: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não entrarão para ver, quando cobrirem as coisas santas; que morrerão.
verses.RVR09: No entrarán para ver, cuando cubrieren las cosas santas; que morirán.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés diciendo:

verses.KJV: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.WEB: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;
verses.ASV: Take the sum of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma também a conta dos filhos de Gérson pelas casas de seus pais, por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Toma también la cuenta de los hijos de Gersón por las casas de sus padres, por sus familias.

verses.KJV: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to wait upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: De idade de trinta anos acima até cinquenta anos os contarás; todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: De edad de treinta años arriba hasta cincuenta años los contarás; todos los que entran en compañía, para hacer servicio en el tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
verses.WEB: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
verses.ASV: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
verses.ALMEIDA: Este será o ofício das famílias de Gérson, para ministrar e para levar:
verses.RVR09: Este será el oficio de las familias de Gersón, para ministrar y para llevar:

verses.KJV: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.WEB: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
verses.ASV: they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above upon it, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,
verses.ALMEIDA: Levarão as cortinas do tabernáculo, e o tabernáculo do testemunho, sua coberta, e a coberta de peles finas que está sobre ele encima, e a cortina da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho,
verses.RVR09: Llevarán las cortinas del tabernáculo, y el tabernáculo del testimonio, su cubierta, y la cubierta de pieles de tejones que está sobre él encima, y el pabellón de la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio,

verses.KJV: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.WEB: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.
verses.ASV: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatsoever shall be done with them: therein shall they serve.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as cortinas do átrio, e a cortina da porta do átrio, que está próxima do tabernáculo e próxima do altar ao redor, e suas cordas, e todos os instrumentos de seu serviço, e tudo o que será feito para eles: assim servirão.
verses.RVR09: Y las cortinas del atrio, y el pabellón de la puerta del atrio, que está cerca del tabernáculo y cerca del altar alrededor, y sus cuerdas, y todos los instrumentos de su servicio, y todo lo que será hecho para ellos: así servirán.

verses.KJV: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
verses.WEB: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
verses.ASV: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burden.
verses.ALMEIDA: Segundo a ordem de Arão e de seus filhos será todo o ministério dos filhos de Gérson em todos os seus cargas, e em todo o seu serviço: e lhes atribuireis em responsabilidade todas as suas cargas.
verses.RVR09: Según la orden de Aarón y de sus hijos será todo el ministerio de los hijos de Gersón en todos sus cargos, y en todo su servicio: y les encomendaréis en guarda todos sus cargos.

verses.KJV: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.WEB: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.ASV: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o serviço das famílias dos filhos de Gérson no tabernáculo do testemunho: e a responsabilidade deles estará sob a mão de Itamar, filho de Arão o sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Este es el servicio de las familias de los hijos de Gersón en el tabernáculo del testimonio: y el cargo de ellos estará bajo la mano de Ithamar, hijo de Aarón el sacerdote.

verses.KJV: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.WEB: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
verses.ASV: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
verses.ALMEIDA: Contarás os filhos de Merari por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Contarás los hijos de Merari por sus familias, por las casas de sus padres.

verses.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth upon the service, to do the work of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de cinquenta anos, os contarás; todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Desde el de edad de treinta años arriba hasta el de cincuenta años, los contarás; todos los que entran en compañía, para hacer servicio en el tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
verses.WEB: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
verses.ASV: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof,
verses.ALMEIDA: E este será o dever de seu cargo para todo seu serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho: as tábuas do tabernáculo, e suas barras, e suas colunas, e suas bases,
verses.RVR09: Y este será el deber de su cargo para todo su servicio en el tabernáculo del testimonio: las tablas del tabernáculo, y sus barras, y sus columnas, y sus basas,

verses.KJV: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.WEB: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.
verses.ASV: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall appoint the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as colunas do átrio ao redor, e suas bases, e suas estacas, e suas cordas com todos os seus instrumentos, e todo seu serviço; e contareis por seus nomes todos os vasos da guarda de seu cargo.
verses.RVR09: Y las columnas del atrio alrededor, y sus basas, y sus estacas, y sus cuerdas con todos sus instrumentos, y todo su servicio; y contaréis por sus nombres todos los vasos de la guarda de su cargo.

verses.KJV: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.WEB: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”
verses.ASV: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este será o serviço das famílias dos filhos de Merari para todo seu ministério no tabernáculo do testemunho, sob a mão de Itamar, filho de Arão o sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Este será el servicio de las familias de los hijos de Merari para todo su ministerio en el tabernáculo del testimonio, bajo la mano de Ithamar, hijo de Aarón el sacerdote.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ALMEIDA: Moisés, pois, e Arão, e os chefes da congregação, contaram os filhos de Coate por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.RVR09: Moisés, pues, y Aarón, y los jefes de la congregación, contaron los hijos de Coath por sus familias, y por las casas de sus padres,

verses.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting:
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos; todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Desde el de edad de treinta años arriba hasta el de edad de cincuenta años; todos los que entran en compañía, para ministrar en el tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.WEB: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
verses.ASV: and those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram os contados deles por suas famílias, dois mil setecentos e cinquenta.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron los contados de ellos por sus familias, dos mil setecientos y cincuenta.

verses.KJV: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
verses.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os contados das famílias de Coate, todos os que ministram no tabernáculo do testemunho, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão, como o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los contados de las familias de Coath, todos los que ministran en el tabernáculo del testimonio, los cuales contaron Moisés y Aarón, como lo mandó Jehová por mano de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
verses.WEB: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ASV: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os contados dos filhos de Gérson, por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.RVR09: Y los contados de los hijos de Gersón, por sus familias, y por las casas de sus padres,

verses.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho;
verses.RVR09: Desde el de edad de treinta años arriba hasta el de edad de cincuenta años, todos los que entran en compañía, para ministrar en el tabernáculo del testimonio;

verses.KJV: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.WEB: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.
verses.ASV: even those that were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os contados deles por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, foram dois mil seiscentos e trinta.
verses.RVR09: Los contados de ellos por sus familias, por las casas de sus padres, fueron dos mil seiscientos y treinta.

verses.KJV: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.
verses.WEB: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD.
verses.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os contados das famílias dos filhos de Gérson, todos os que ministram no tabernáculo do testemunho, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão por ordem do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los contados de las familias de los hijos de Gersón, todos los que ministran en el tabernáculo del testimonio, los cuales contaron Moisés y Aarón por mandato de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.WEB: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ASV: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os contados das famílias dos filhos de Merari, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.RVR09: Y los contados de las familias de los hijos de Merari, por sus familias, por las casas de sus padres,

verses.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho;
verses.RVR09: Desde el de edad de treinta años arriba hasta el de edad de cincuenta años, todos los que entran en compañía, para ministrar en el tabernáculo del testimonio:

verses.KJV: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.WEB: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.
verses.ASV: even those that were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os contados deles, por suas famílias, foram três mil e duzentos.
verses.RVR09: Los contados de ellos, por sus familias, fueron tres mil y doscientos.

verses.KJV: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
verses.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os contados das famílias dos filhos de Merari, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão, segundo o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los contados de las familias de los hijos de Merari, los cuales contaron Moisés y Aarón, según lo mandó Jehová por mano de Moisés.

verses.KJV: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.WEB: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ASV: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os contados dos levitas, que Moisés e Arão e os chefes de Israel contaram por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.RVR09: Todos los contados de los Levitas, que Moisés y Aarón y los jefes de Israel contaron por sus familias, y por las casas de sus padres,

verses.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the tent of meeting,
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entravam para ministrar no serviço, e ter cargo de obra no tabernáculo do testemunho;
verses.RVR09: Desde el de edad de treinta años arriba hasta el de edad de cincuenta años, todos los que entraban para ministrar en el servicio, y tener cargo de obra en el tabernáculo del testimonio;

verses.KJV: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore,
verses.WEB: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
verses.ASV: even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os contados deles foram oito mil quinhentos e oitenta,
verses.RVR09: Los contados de ellos fueron ocho mil quinientos y ochenta,

verses.KJV: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: According to the commandment of the LORD they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: According to the commandment of Jehovah they were numbered by Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés foram contados, cada um segundo seu ofício, e segundo seu cargo; os quais contou ele, como lhe foi mandado.
verses.RVR09: Como lo mandó Jehová por mano de Moisés fueron contados, cada uno según su oficio, y según su cargo; los cuales contó él, como le fué mandado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.WEB: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.
verses.ASV: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is unclean by the dead:
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda aos filhos de Israel que expulsem do acampamento a todo leproso, e a todos os que sofrem de corrimento, e a todo contaminado sobre morto:
verses.RVR09: Manda á los hijos de Israel que echen del campo á todo leproso, y á todos los que padecen flujo de semen, y á todo contaminado sobre muerto:

verses.KJV: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.WEB: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”
verses.ASV: both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camp, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tanto homens como mulheres lançareis, fora do acampamento os expulsareis; para que não contaminem o acampamento daqueles entre os quais eu habito.
verses.RVR09: Así hombres como mujeres echaréis, fuera del campo los echaréis; porque no contaminen el campo de aquellos entre los cuales yo habito.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the Lord spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp; as Jehovah spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram-no assim os filhos de Israel, que os lançaram fora do acampamento: como o SENHOR disse a Moisés, assim o fizeram os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: E hiciéronlo así los hijos de Israel, que los echaron fuera del campo: como Jehová dijo á Moisés, así lo hicieron los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Também falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Además habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against the LORD, and that soul is guilty,
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Jehovah, and that soul shall be guilty;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel: O homem ou a mulher que cometer algum de todos os pecados dos homens, fazendo transgressão contra o SENHOR, e transgredir aquela pessoa;
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel: El hombre ó la mujer que cometiere alguno de todos los pecados de los hombres, haciendo prevaricación contra Jehová, y delinquiere aquella persona;

verses.KJV: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
verses.WEB: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.
verses.ASV: then he shall confess his sin which he hath done: and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him in respect of whom he hath been guilty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confessarão seu pecado que cometeram, e compensarão sua ofensa inteiramente, e acrescentarão seu quinto sobre ele, e o darão a aquele contra quem pecaram.
verses.RVR09: Confesarán su pecado que cometieron, y compensarán su ofensa enteramente, y añadirán su quinto sobre ello, y lo darán á aquel contra quien pecaron.

verses.KJV: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the Lord, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
verses.WEB: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.
verses.ASV: But if the man have no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made unto Jehovah shall be the priest’s; besides the ram of the atonement, whereby atonement shall be made for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se aquele homem não tiver parente ao qual seja ressarcida a ofensa, se dará a indenização da injustiça ao SENHOR, ao sacerdote, a mais do carneiro das expiações, com o qual fará expiação por ele.
verses.RVR09: Y si aquel hombre no tuviere pariente al cual sea resarcida la ofensa, daráse la indemnización del agravio á Jehová, al sacerdote, á más del carnero de las expiaciones, con el cual hará expiación por él.

verses.KJV: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.WEB: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.
verses.ASV: And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda oferta de todas as coisas santas que os filhos de Israel apresentarem ao sacerdote, sua será.
verses.RVR09: Y toda ofrenda de todas las cosas santas que los hijos de Israel presentaren al sacerdote, suya será.

verses.KJV: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.WEB: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”
verses.ASV: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o santificado de qualquer um será seu: também o que qualquer um der ao sacerdote, seu será.
verses.RVR09: Y lo santificado de cualquiera será suyo: asimismo lo que cualquiera diere al sacerdote, suyo será.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando a mulher de alguém se desviar, e fizer traição contra ele,
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando la mujer de alguno se desmandare, é hiciere traición contra él,

verses.KJV: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
verses.WEB: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;
verses.ASV: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, and she be not taken in the act;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que alguém se houver deitado com ela em carnal ajuntamento, e seu marido não o houvesse visto por haver-se ela contaminado ocultamente, nem houver testemunha contra ela, nem ela houver sido pega no ato;
verses.RVR09: Que alguno se hubiere echado con ella en carnal ayuntamiento, y su marido no lo hubiese visto por haberse ella contaminado ocultamente, ni hubiere testigo contra ella, ni ella hubiere sido cogida en el acto;

verses.KJV: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.WEB: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;
verses.ASV: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vier sobre ele espírito de ciúme, e tiver ciúme de sua mulher, havendo-se ela contaminado; ou vier sobre ele espírito de ciúme, e tiver ciúmes de sua mulher, não havendo ela se contaminado;
verses.RVR09: Si viniere sobre él espíritu de celo, y tuviere celos de su mujer, habiéndose ella contaminado; ó viniere sobre él espíritu de celo, y tuviere celos de su mujer, no habiéndose ella contaminado;

verses.KJV: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.WEB: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.
verses.ASV: then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and shall bring her oblation for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is a meal-offering of jealousy, a meal-offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o marido trará sua mulher ao sacerdote, e trará sua oferta com ela, um décimo de um efa de farinha de cevada; não lançará sobre ela azeite, nem porá sobre ela incenso; porque é oferta de ciúme, oferta de recordação, que traz o pecado em memória.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el marido traerá su mujer al sacerdote, y traerá su ofrenda con ella, la décima de un epha de harina de cebada; no echará sobre ella aceite, ni pondrá sobre ella incienso: porque es presente de celos, presente de recordación, que trae en memoria pecado.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord:
verses.WEB: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote a fará aproximar, e a porá diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote la hará acercar, y la hará poner delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
verses.WEB: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo tomará o sacerdote da água santa em um vaso de barro: tomará também o sacerdote do pó que houver no chão do tabernáculo, e o lançará na água.
verses.RVR09: Luego tomará el sacerdote del agua santa en un vaso de barro: tomará también el sacerdote del polvo que hubiere en el suelo del tabernáculo, y echarálo en el agua.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall set the woman before the Lord, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.WEB: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall set the woman before Jehovah, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal-offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal-offering of jealousy: and the priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that causeth the curse.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará o sacerdote estar em pé à mulher diante do SENHOR, e descobrirá a cabeça da mulher, e porá sobre suas mãos a oferta da recordação, que é a oferta de ciúme; e o sacerdote terá na mão as águas amargas que trazem maldição.
verses.RVR09: Y hará el sacerdote estar en pie á la mujer delante de Jehová, y descubrirá la cabeza de la mujer, y pondrá sobre sus manos el presente de la recordación, que es el presente de celos: y el sacerdote tendrá en la mano las aguas amargas que acarrean maldición.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.WEB: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall cause her to swear, and shall say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou have not gone aside to uncleanness, being under thy husband, be thou free from this water of bitterness that causeth the curse.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote a fará jurar, e lhe dirá: Se ninguém houver dormido contigo, e se não te afastaste de teu marido à imundícia, livre sejas destas águas amargas que trazem maldição:
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote la conjurará, y le dirá: Si ninguno hubiere dormido contigo, y si no te has apartado de tu marido á inmundicia, libre seas de estas aguas amargas que traen maldición:

verses.KJV: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
verses.WEB: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”
verses.ASV: But if thou have gone aside, being under thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee besides thy husband:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se te desviaste de teu marido, e te contaminaste, e alguém houver tido relação contigo, fora de teu marido:
verses.RVR09: Mas si te has descarriado de tu marido, y te has amancillado, y alguno hubiere tenido coito contigo, fuera de tu marido:

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The Lord make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the Lord doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
verses.WEB: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the LORD allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;
verses.ASV: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, Jehovah make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when Jehovah doth make thy thigh to fall away, and thy body to swell;
verses.ALMEIDA: (O sacerdote fará jurar à mulher com juramento de maldição, e dirá à mulher): O SENHOR te dê em maldição e em conspiração em meio de teu povo, fazendo o SENHOR a tua coxa que caia, e a teu ventre que se te inche;
verses.RVR09: (El sacerdote conjurará á la mujer con juramento de maldición, y dirá á la mujer): Jehová te dé en maldición y en conjuración en medio de tu pueblo, haciendo Jehová á tu muslo que caiga, y á tu vientre que se te hinche;

verses.KJV: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.WEB: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”
verses.ASV: and this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, and make thy body to swell, and thy thigh to fall away. And the woman shall say, Amen, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas águas que dão maldição entrem em tuas entranhas, e façam inchar teu ventre, e cair tua coxa. E a mulher dirá: Amém, Amém.
verses.RVR09: Y estas aguas que dan maldición entren en tus entrañas, y hagan hinchar tu vientre y caer tu muslo. Y la mujer dirá: Amén, amén.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
verses.WEB: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote escreverá estas maldições em um livro, e as apagará com as águas amargas:
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote escribirá estas maldiciones en un libro, y las borrará con las aguas amargas:

verses.KJV: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
verses.WEB: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.
verses.ASV: and he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causeth the curse; and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her [and become] bitter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dará a beber à mulher as águas amargas que trazem maldição; e as águas que operam maldição entrarão nela por amargas.
verses.RVR09: Y dará á beber á la mujer las aguas amargas que traen maldición; y las aguas que obran maldición entrarán en ella por amargas.

verses.KJV: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the Lord, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.WEB: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall take the meal-offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal-offering before Jehovah, and bring it unto the altar:
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois tomará o sacerdote da mão da mulher a oferta de ciúme, e a moverá diante do SENHOR, e a oferecerá diante do altar;
verses.RVR09: Después tomará el sacerdote de la mano de la mujer el presente de los celos, y mecerálo delante de Jehová, y lo ofrecerá delante del altar:

verses.KJV: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.WEB: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall take a handful of the meal-offering, as the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
verses.ALMEIDA: e o sacerdote tomará um punhado da oferta em sua memória, e o queimará sobre o altar, e depois dará a beber as águas à mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y tomará el sacerdote un puñado del presente, en memoria de ella, y lo quemará sobre el altar, y después dará á beber las aguas á la mujer.

verses.KJV: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.WEB: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.
verses.ASV: And when he hath made her drink the water, then it shall come to pass, if she be defiled, and have committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her [and become] bitter, and her body shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dará a ela pois a beber as águas; e será, que se for imunda e houver feito traição contra seu marido, as águas que operam maldição entrarão nela em amargura, e seu ventre se inchará, e cairá sua coxa; e a mulher será por maldição em meio de seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Darále pues á beber las aguas; y será, que si fuere inmunda y hubiere hecho traición contra su marido, las aguas que obran maldición entrarán en ella en amargura, y su vientre se hinchará, y caerá su muslo; y la mujer será por maldición en medio de su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.WEB: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.
verses.ASV: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se a mulher não for imunda, mas sim que estiver limpa, ela será livre, e será fértil.
verses.RVR09: Mas si la mujer no fuere inmunda, sino que estuviere limpia, ella será libre, y será fecunda.

verses.KJV: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
verses.WEB: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,
verses.ASV: This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goeth aside, and is defiled;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a lei do ciúme, quando a mulher fizer traição a seu marido, e se contaminar;
verses.RVR09: Esta es la ley de los celos, cuando la mujer hiciere traición á su marido, y se amancillare;

verses.KJV: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.WEB: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.
verses.ASV: or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then shall he set the woman before Jehovah, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou do marido, sobre o qual passar espírito de ciúme, e tiver ciúme de sua mulher: ele a apresentará então diante do SENHOR, e o sacerdote executará nela toda esta lei.
verses.RVR09: O del marido, sobre el cual pasare espíritu de celo, y tuviere celos de su mujer: presentarála entonces delante de Jehová, y el sacerdote ejecutará en ella toda esta ley.

verses.KJV: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.WEB: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”
verses.ASV: And the man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele homem será livre de iniquidade, e a mulher levará seu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel varón será libre de iniquidad, y la mujer llevará su pecado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the Lord:
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself unto Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: O homem, ou a mulher, quando se separar fazendo voto de nazireu, para dedicar-se ao SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: El hombre, ó la mujer, cuando se apartare haciendo voto de Nazareo, para dedicarse á Jehová,

verses.KJV: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
verses.WEB: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
verses.ASV: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink; he shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se absterá de vinho e de bebida forte; vinagre de vinho, nem vinagre de bebida forte não beberá, nem beberá algum licor de uvas, nem tampouco comerá uvas frescas nem secas.
verses.RVR09: Se abstendrá de vino y de sidra; vinagre de vino, ni vinagre de sidra no beberá, ni beberá algún licor de uvas, ni tampoco comerá uvas frescas ni secas.

verses.KJV: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
verses.WEB: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.
verses.ASV: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the grape-vine, from the kernels even to the husk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o tempo de seu nazireado, de tudo o que se faz de vide de vinho, desde os caroços até a casca, não comerá.
verses.RVR09: Todo el tiempo de su nazareato, de todo lo que se hace de vid de vino, desde los granillos hasta el hollejo, no comerá.

verses.KJV: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.WEB: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
verses.ASV: All the days of his vow of separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in which he separateth himself unto Jehovah, he shall be holy; he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o tempo do voto de seu nazireado não passará navalha sobre sua cabeça, até que sejam cumpridos os dias de sua separação ao SENHOR: santo será; deixará crescer as pontas do cabelo de sua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Todo el tiempo del voto de su nazareato no pasará navaja sobre su cabeza, hasta que sean cumplidos los días de su apartamiento á Jehová: santo será; dejará crecer las guedejas del cabello de su cabeza.

verses.KJV: All the days that he separateth himself unto the Lord he shall come at no dead body.
verses.WEB: “‘All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.
verses.ASV: All the days that he separateth himself unto Jehovah he shall not come near to a dead body.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o tempo que se separar ao SENHOR, não entrará a pessoa morta.
verses.RVR09: Todo el tiempo que se apartare á Jehová, no entrará á persona muerta.

verses.KJV: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
verses.WEB: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.
verses.ASV: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his separation unto God is upon his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por seu pai, nem por sua mãe, por seu irmão, nem por sua irmã, não se contaminará com eles quando morrerem; porque consagração de seu Deus tem sobre sua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Por su padre, ni por su madre, por su hermano, ni por su hermana, no se contaminará con ellos cuando murieren; porque consagración de su Dios tiene sobre su cabeza.

verses.KJV: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.
verses.ASV: All the days of his separation he is holy unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o tempo de seu nazireado, será santo ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Todo el tiempo de su nazareato, será santo á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.WEB: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.
verses.ASV: And if any man die very suddenly beside him, and he defile the head of his separation; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém morrer muito de repente junto a ele, contaminará a cabeça de seu nazireado; portanto o dia de sua purificação rapará sua cabeça; ao sétimo dia a rapará.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno muriere muy de repente junto á él, contaminará la cabeza de su nazareato; por tanto el día de su purificación raerá su cabeza; al séptimo día la raerá.

verses.KJV: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.WEB: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o dia oitavo trará duas rolinhas ou dois pombinhos ao sacerdote, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho;
verses.RVR09: Y el día octavo traerá dos tórtolas ó dos palominos al sacerdote, á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio;

verses.KJV: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.WEB: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.
verses.ASV: and the priest shall offer one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, and make atonement for him, for that he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote fará um em expiação, e o outro em holocausto: e o expiará do que pecou sobre o morto, e santificará sua cabeça naquele dia.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote hará el uno en expiación, y el otro en holocausto: y expiarálo de lo que pecó sobre el muerto, y santificará su cabeza en aquel día.

verses.KJV: And he shall consecrate unto the Lord the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
verses.WEB: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.
verses.ASV: And he shall separate unto Jehovah the days of his separation, and shall bring a he-lamb a year old for a trespass-offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E consagrará ao SENHOR os dias de seu nazireado, e trará um cordeiro de ano em expiação pela culpa; e os dias primeiros serão anulados, porquanto foi contaminado seu nazireado.
verses.RVR09: Y consagrará á Jehová los días de su nazareato, y traerá un cordero de un año en expiación por la culpa; y los días primeros serán anulados, por cuanto fué contaminado su nazareato.

verses.KJV: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
