verses.KJV: And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.WEB: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
verses.ASV: And the cloud of Jehovah was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a nuvem do SENHOR ia sobre eles de dia, desde que partiram do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y la nube de Jehová iba sobre ellos de día, desde que partieron del campo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Lord, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verses.WEB: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, O Jehovah, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi, que em movendo a arca, Moisés dizia: Levanta-te, o SENHOR, e sejam dissipados teus inimigos, e fujam de tua presença os que te aborrecem.
verses.RVR09: Y fué, que en moviendo el arca, Moisés decía: Levántate, Jehová, y sean disipados tus enemigos, y huyan de tu presencia los que te aborrecen.

verses.KJV: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Lord, unto the many thousands of Israel.
verses.WEB: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
verses.ASV: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Jehovah, unto the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ela assentava, dizia: Volta, SENHOR, aos milhares de milhares de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando ella asentaba, decía: Vuelve, Jehová, á los millares de millares de Israel.

verses.KJV: And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.WEB: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
verses.ASV: And the people were as murmurers, [speaking] evil in the ears of Jehovah: and when Jehovah heard it, his anger was kindled; and the fire of Jehovah burnt among them, and devoured in the uttermost part of the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que o povo se queixou aos ouvidos do SENHOR: e ouviu-o o SENHOR, e ardeu seu furor, e acendeu-se neles fogo do SENHOR e consumiu a extremidade do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que el pueblo se quejó á oídos de Jehová: y oyólo Jehová, y enardecióse su furor, y encendióse en ellos fuego de Jehová y consumió el un cabo del campo.

verses.KJV: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the Lord, the fire was quenched.
verses.WEB: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.
verses.ASV: And the people cried unto Moses; and Moses prayed unto Jehovah, and the fire abated.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o povo clamou a Moisés, e Moisés orou ao SENHOR, e o fogo se apagou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pueblo dió voces á Moisés, y Moisés oró á Jehová, y soterróse el fuego.

verses.KJV: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burnt among them.
verses.WEB: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.
verses.ASV: And the name of that place was called Taberah, because the fire of Jehovah burnt among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou a aquele lugar Taberá; porque o fogo do SENHOR se acendeu neles.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó á aquel lugar Taberah; porque el fuego de Jehová se encendió en ellos.

verses.KJV: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.WEB: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
verses.ASV: And the mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo misturado que havia no meio deles teve um intenso desejo; então os filhos de Israel voltaram-se, choraram, e disseram: Quem nos dera comer carne!
verses.RVR09: Y el vulgo que había en medio tuvo un vivo deseo, y volvieron, y aun lloraron los hijos de Israel, y dijeron: ¡Quién nos diera á comer carne!

verses.KJV: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verses.WEB: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
verses.ASV: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt for nought; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic:
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós nos lembramos do peixe que comíamos no Egito de graça, dos pepinos, dos melões, dos alhos-porós, das cebolas, e dos alhos;
verses.RVR09: Nos acordamos del pescado que comíamos en Egipto de balde, de los cohombros, y de los melones, y de los puerros, y de las cebollas, y de los ajos:

verses.KJV: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
verses.WEB: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
verses.ASV: but now our soul is dried away; there is nothing at all save this manna to look upon.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas agora a nossa alma se seca; nada há, a não ser maná, [diante dos] nossos olhos.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora nuestra alma se seca; que nada sino maná ven nuestros ojos.

verses.KJV: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verses.WEB: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
verses.ASV: And the manna was like coriander seed, and the appearance thereof as the appearance of bdellium.
verses.ALMEIDA: O maná era como semente de coentro, e sua cor como cor de bdélio.
verses.RVR09: Y era el maná como semilla de culantro, y su color como color de bdelio.

verses.KJV: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.WEB: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.
verses.ASV: The people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: O povo se espalhava, e recolhia, e moía em moinhos, ou malhava em pilões, e o cozia em panelas, ou fazia dele bolos; e o seu sabor era como sabor de azeite fresco.
verses.RVR09: Derramábase el pueblo, y recogían, y molían en molinos, ó majaban en morteros, y lo cocían en caldera, ó hacían de él tortas: y su sabor era como sabor de aceite nuevo.

verses.KJV: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.WEB: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
verses.ASV: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o orvalho descia sobre o acampamento de noite, o maná descia sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando descendía el rocío sobre el real de noche, el maná descendía de sobre él.

verses.KJV: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the Lord was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
verses.WEB: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.
verses.ASV: And Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent: and the anger of Jehovah was kindled greatly; and Moses was displeased.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés ouviu o povo chorar por suas famílias, cada um à porta de sua tenda; e o furor do SENHOR se acendeu grandemente; também pareceu mal a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Moisés al pueblo, que lloraba por sus familias, cada uno á la puerta de su tienda: y el furor de Jehová se encendió en gran manera; también pareció mal á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the Lord, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.WEB: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Wherefore hast thou dealt ill with thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favor in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés disse ao SENHOR: Por que fizeste mal a teu servo? E por que não achei favor aos teus olhos, que puseste sobremim a carga de todo este povo?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Jehová: ¿Por qué has hecho mal á tu siervo? ¿y por qué no he hallado gracia en tus ojos, que has puesto la carga de todo este pueblo sobre mí?

verses.KJV: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
verses.WEB: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?
verses.ASV: Have I conceived all this people? have I brought them forth, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing-father carrieth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso fui eu que concebi todo este povo? Fui o que o dei à luz, para que me digas: Leva-o em teu colo, como uma ama leva um bebê de peito, à terra da qual juraste a seus pais?
verses.RVR09: ¿Concebí yo á todo este pueblo? ¿engendrélo yo, para que me digas: Llévalo en tu seno, como lleva la que cría al que mama, á la tierra de la cual juraste á sus padres?

verses.KJV: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.WEB: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
verses.ASV: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: De onde eu teria carne para dar a todo este povo? Porque choram a mim, dizendo: Dá-nos carne para comer.
verses.RVR09: ¿De dónde tengo yo carne para dar á todo este pueblo? porque lloran á mí, diciendo: Danos carne que comamos.

verses.KJV: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.WEB: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.ASV: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não posso suportar sozinho todo este povo, porque é pesado demais para mim.
verses.RVR09: No puedo yo solo soportar á todo este pueblo, que me es pesado en demasía.

verses.KJV: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.WEB: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
verses.ASV: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favor in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se assim fazes tu comigo, eu te rogo que me mates, se achei favor aos teus olhos; e que não me deixes ver a minha calamidade.
verses.RVR09: Y si así lo haces tú conmigo, yo te ruego que me des muerte, si he hallado gracia en tus ojos; y que yo no vea mi mal.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Ajunta-me setenta homens dos anciãos de Israel, de quem sabes que são anciãos do povo, e seus oficiais; e traze-os à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, e esperem ali contigo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Moisés: Júntame setenta varones de los ancianos de Israel, que tú sabes que son ancianos del pueblo y sus principales; y tráelos á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, y esperen allí contigo.

verses.KJV: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
verses.WEB: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.
verses.ASV: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the Spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu descerei e falarei ali contigo; e tomarei do espírito que está sobre ti, e [o] porei neles; e contigo levarão a carga do povo, para que tu não [a] leves sozinho.
verses.RVR09: Y yo descenderé y hablaré allí contigo; y tomaré del espíritu que está en ti, y pondré en ellos; y llevarán contigo la carga del pueblo, y no la llevarás tú solo.

verses.KJV: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the Lord will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.WEB: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
verses.ASV: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to-morrow, and ye shall eat flesh; for ye have wept in the ears of Jehovah, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore Jehovah will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém dirás ao povo: Santificai-vos para amanhã, e comereis carne; porque chorastes em ouvidos do SENHOR, dizendo: Quem nos dera comer carne! Certamente estávamos bem no Egito! O SENHOR, pois, vos dará carne, e comereis.
verses.RVR09: Empero dirás al pueblo: Santificaos para mañana, y comeréis carne: pues que habéis llorado en oídos de Jehová, diciendo: ¡Quién nos diera á comer carne! ¡cierto mejor nos iba en Egipto! Jehová, pues, os dará carne, y comeréis.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.WEB: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
verses.ASV: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não comereis um dia, nem dois dias, nem cinco dias, nem dez dias, nem vinte dias;
verses.RVR09: No comeréis un día, ni dos días, ni cinco días, ni diez días, ni veinte días;

verses.KJV: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
verses.WEB: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”
verses.ASV: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you; because that ye have rejected Jehovah who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
verses.ALMEIDA: mas sim, um mês inteiro, até que vos saia pelas narinas, e sintais repulsa dela, porque rejeitastes o SENHOR que está no meio de vós, e chorastes diante dele, dizendo: Para que saímos do Egito?
verses.RVR09: Sino hasta un mes de tiempo, hasta que os salga por las narices, y os sea en aborrecimiento: por cuanto menospreciasteis á Jehová que está en medio de vosotros, y llorasteis delante de él, diciendo: ¿Para qué salimos acá de Egipto?

verses.KJV: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’
verses.ASV: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Moisés: Seiscentos mil a pé é este povo no meio do qual estou; e tu dizes: Eu lhes darei carne, e comerão um mês inteiro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Moisés: Seiscientos mil de á pie es el pueblo en medio del cual yo estoy; y tú dices: Les daré carne, y comerán el tiempo de un mes.

verses.KJV: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.WEB: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”
verses.ASV: Shall flocks and herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso serão degoladas para eles ovelhas e bois que lhes bastem? Ou se ajuntarão para eles todos os peixes do mar para que lhes sejam suficientes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Se han de degollar para ellos ovejas y bueyes que les basten? ¿ó se juntarán para ellos todos los peces de la mar para que tengan abasto?

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Is the Lord'S hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Is Jehovah’s hand waxed short? now shalt thou see whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o SENHOR respondeu a Moisés: Por acaso o poder do SENHOR é curto? Agora verás se a minha palavra te acontecerá ou não.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová respondió á Moisés: ¿Hase acortado la mano de Jehová? ahora verás si te sucede mi dicho, ó no.

verses.KJV: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the Lord, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.
verses.ASV: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of Jehovah: and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the Tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés saiu, e disse ao povo as palavras do SENHOR; e ajuntou setenta homens dos anciãos do povo, e os pôs ao redor da tenda.
verses.RVR09: Y salió Moisés, y dijo al pueblo las palabras de Jehová: y juntó los setenta varones de los ancianos del pueblo, é hízolos estar alrededor del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
verses.WEB: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah came down in the cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the Spirit that was upon him, and put it upon the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR desceu na nuvem, e lhe falou; e tomou do espírito que estava sobre ele, e o pôs sobre aqueles setenta anciãos; e aconteceu que, quando o espírito repousou sobre eles, profetizaram, mas depois nunca mais.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová descendió en la nube, y hablóle; y tomó del espíritu que estaba en él, y púsolo en los setenta varones ancianos; y fué que, cuando posó sobre ellos el espíritu, profetizaron, y no cesaron.

verses.KJV: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.WEB: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.ASV: But there remained two men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but had not gone out unto the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ficaram no acampamento dois homens, um chamado Eldade e o outro Medade, sobre os quais o espírito também repousou (porque estavam entre os inscritos, mas não haviam saído à tenda); e profetizaram no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y habían quedado en el campo dos varones, llamado el uno Eldad y el otro Medad, sobre los cuales también reposó el espíritu: estaban estos entre los escritos, mas no habían salido al tabernáculo; y profetizaron en el campo.

verses.KJV: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.WEB: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
verses.ASV: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então um jovem correu, e avisou a Moisés, e disse: Eldade e Medade estão profetizando no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y corrió un mozo, y dió aviso á Moisés, y dijo: Eldad y Medad profetizan en el campo.

verses.KJV: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
verses.WEB: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
verses.ASV: And Joshua the son of Nun, the minister of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Josué, filho de Num, assistente de Moisés desde a sua juventude, respondeu, e disse: Meu senhor Moisés, impede-os.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió Josué hijo de Nun, ministro de Moisés, uno de sus mancebos, y dijo: Señor mío Moisés, impídelos.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the Lord'S people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit upon them!
verses.WEB: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto him, Art thou jealous for my sake? would that all Jehovah’s people were prophets, that Jehovah would put his Spirit upon them!
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés lhe respondeu: Tens tu ciúmes por mim? Bom seria se todos do povo do SENHOR fossem profetas, que o SENHOR pusesse seu Espírito sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés le respondió: ¿Tienes tú celos por mí? mas ojalá que todo el pueblo de Jehová fuesen profetas, que Jehová pusiera su espíritu sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.WEB: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés recolheu-se ao acampamento, ele e os anciãos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y recogióse Moisés al campo, él y los ancianos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And there went forth a wind from the Lord, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.
verses.ASV: And there went forth a wind from Jehovah, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and about two cubits above the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu um vento do SENHOR, que trouxe codornizes do mar, e deixou-as sobre o acampamento, de um dia de caminho de um lado e do outro, ao redor do acampamento, e quase dois côvados sobre a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y salió un viento de Jehová, y trajo codornices de la mar, y dejólas sobre el real, un día de camino de la una parte, y un día de camino de la otra, en derredor del campo, y casi dos codos sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.WEB: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.
verses.ASV: And the people rose up all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o povo se levantou e recolheu para si codornizes durante todo aquele dia, e toda a noite, e todo o dia seguinte.O que recolheu menos recolheu dez ômeres; e as estenderam para si ao redor do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pueblo estuvo levantado todo aquel día, y toda la noche, y todo el día siguiente, y recogiéronse codornices: el que menos, recogió diez montones; y las tendieron para sí á lo largo en derredor del campo.

verses.KJV: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.WEB: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.
verses.ASV: While the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the anger of Jehovah was kindled against the people, and Jehovah smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.ALMEIDA: A carne ainda estava entre os dentes deles, antes que fosse mastigada, quando o furor do SENHOR se acendeu no povo, e o SENHOR feriu o povo com uma praga muito grande.
verses.RVR09: Aun estaba la carne entre los dientes de ellos, antes que fuese mascada, cuando el furor de Jehová se encendió en el pueblo, é hirió Jehová al pueblo con una muy grande plaga.

verses.KJV: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.WEB: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
verses.ASV: And the name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso aquele lugar recebeu o nome de Quibrote-Hataavá, porque ali sepultaram o povo que teve o desejo.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Kibroth-hattaavah, por cuanto allí sepultaron al pueblo codicioso.

verses.KJV: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
verses.WEB: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
verses.ASV: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people journeyed unto Hazeroth; and they abode at Hazeroth.
verses.ALMEIDA: De Quibrote-Hataavá o povo partiu para Hazerote, e ficaram em Hazerote.
verses.RVR09: De Kibroth-hattaavah movió el pueblo á Haseroth, y pararon en Haseroth.

verses.KJV: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
verses.WEB: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
verses.ASV: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Miriã e Arão falaram contra Moisés por causa da mulher cuxita que havia tomado; porque ele havia tomado uma cuxita por esposa.
verses.RVR09: Y HABLARON María y Aarón contra Moisés á causa de la mujer Ethiope que había tomado: porque él había tomado mujer Ethiope.

verses.KJV: And they said, Hath the Lord indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the Lord heard it.
verses.WEB: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.
verses.ASV: And they said, Hath Jehovah indeed spoken only with Moses? hath he not spoken also with us? And Jehovah heard it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram: Por acaso o SENHOR falou somente por Moisés? Não falou também por nós? E o SENHOR ouviu isso.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron: ¿Solamente por Moisés ha hablado Jehová? ¿no ha hablado también por nosotros? Y oyólo Jehová.

verses.KJV: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
verses.WEB: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
verses.ASV: Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men that were upon the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele homem Moisés era muito manso, mais que todos os homens que havia sobre a terra,
verses.RVR09: Y aquel varón Moisés era muy manso, más que todos los hombres que había sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tent of meeting. And they three came out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo disse o SENHOR a Moisés, a Arão, e a Miriã: Saí vós três à tenda do encontro. E saíram eles três.
verses.RVR09: Y luego dijo Jehová á Moisés, y á Aarón, y á María: Salid vosotros tres al tabernáculo del testimonio. Y salieron ellos tres.

verses.KJV: And the Lord came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
verses.WEB: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR desceu na coluna da nuvem, e pôs-se à entrada da tenda, e chamou a Arão e a Miriã; e saíram eles ambos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová descendió en la columna de la nube, y púsose á la puerta del tabernáculo, y llamó á Aarón y á María; y salieron ellos ambos.

verses.KJV: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
verses.WEB: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
verses.ASV: And he said, Hear now my words: if there be a prophet among you, I Jehovah will make myself known unto him in a vision, I will speak with him in a dream.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Ouvi agora minhas palavras: se tiverdes profeta do SENHOR, lhe aparecerei em visão, em sonhos falarei com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Oid ahora mis palabras: si tuviereis profeta de Jehová, le apareceré en visión, en sueños hablaré con él.

verses.KJV: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
verses.WEB: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
verses.ASV: My servant Moses is not so; he is faithful in all my house:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não assim a meu servo Moisés, que é fiel em toda minha casa:
verses.RVR09: No así á mi siervo Moisés, que es fiel en toda mi casa:

verses.KJV: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
verses.WEB: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
verses.ASV: with him will I speak mouth to mouth, even manifestly, and not in dark speeches; and the form of Jehovah shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?
verses.ALMEIDA: Face a face falarei com ele, e às claras, e não por figuras; e verá a aparência do SENHOR: por que pois não tivestes temor de falar contra meu servo Moisés?
verses.RVR09: Boca á boca hablaré con él, y á las claras, y no por figuras; y verá la apariencia de Jehová: ¿por qué pues no tuvisteis temor de hablar contra mi siervo Moisés?

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
verses.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o furor do SENHOR se acendeu neles; e ele se foi.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el furor de Jehová se encendió en ellos; y fuése.

verses.KJV: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
verses.WEB: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
verses.ASV: And the cloud removed from over the Tent; and, behold, Miriam was leprous, as [white as] snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a nuvem se afastou da tenda; e eis que Miriã era leprosa como a neve; e Arão olhou para Miriã, e eis que estava leprosa.
verses.RVR09: Y la nube se apartó del tabernáculo: y he aquí que María era leprosa como la nieve; y miró Aarón á María, y he aquí que estaba leprosa.

verses.KJV: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
verses.WEB: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
verses.ASV: And Aaron said unto Moses, Oh, my lord, lay not, I pray thee, sin upon us, for that we have done foolishly, and for that we have sinned.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Arão a Moisés: Ah! Senhor meu, não ponhas sobre nós este pecado; porque loucamente o fizemos, e pecamos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Aarón á Moisés: ¡Ah! señor mío, no pongas ahora sobre nosotros pecado; porque locamente lo hemos hecho, y hemos pecado.

verses.KJV: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
verses.WEB: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
verses.ASV: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo que ela não seja como um que sai morto do ventre de sua mãe, com a metade de sua carne já consumida.
verses.RVR09: No sea ella ahora como el que sale muerto del vientre de su madre, consumida la mitad de su carne.

verses.KJV: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
verses.WEB: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
verses.ASV: And Moses cried unto Jehovah, saying, Heal her, O God, I beseech thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés clamou ao SENHOR, dizendo: Rogo-te, ó Deus, que a sares agora.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés clamó á Jehová, diciendo: Ruégote, oh Dios, que la sanes ahora.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut up without the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Respondeu o SENHOR a Moisés: Se o seu pai houvesse cuspido em sua face, não seria envergonhada por sete dias? Que ela esteja fora do acampamento durante sete dias, e depois seja trazida de volta.
verses.RVR09: Respondió Jehová á Moisés: Pues si su padre hubiera escupido en su cara, ¿no se avergonzaría por siete días?: sea echada fuera del real por siete días, y después se reunirá.

verses.KJV: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.WEB: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
verses.ASV: And Miriam was shut up without the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Miriã foi expulsa do acampamento por sete dias; e o povo não partiu até que Miriã voltasse.
verses.RVR09: Así María fué echada del real siete días; y el pueblo no pasó adelante hasta que se le reunió María.

verses.KJV: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.WEB: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.ASV: And afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois o povo partiu de Hazerote, e assentaram o acampamento no deserto de Parã.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y DESPUÉS movió el pueblo de Haseroth, y asentaron el campo en el desierto de Parán.

verses.KJV: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.WEB: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
verses.ASV: Send thou men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a prince among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Envia homens que reconheçam a terra de Canaã, a qual eu dou aos filhos de Israel; de cada tribo de seus pais enviareis um homem, cada um líder entre eles.”
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Jehovah: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés os enviou desde o deserto de Parã, conforme a palavra do SENHOR; e todos aqueles homens eram líderes dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Envía tú hombres que reconozcan la tierra de Canaán, la cual yo doy á los hijos de Israel: de cada tribu de sus padres enviaréis un varón, cada uno príncipe entre ellos.

verses.KJV: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.WEB: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.ASV: And these were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os nomes dos quais são estes: da tribo de Rúben, Samua, filho de Zacur.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés los envió desde el desierto de Parán, conforme á la palabra de Jehová: y todos aquellos varones eran príncipes de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Simeão, Safate, filho de Hori.
verses.RVR09: Los nombres de los cuales son éstos: De la tribu de Rubén, Sammua hijo de Zaccur.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Judá, Calebe, filho de Jefoné.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Simeón, Saphat hijo de Hurí.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Issacar, Jigeal, filho de José.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Judá, Caleb hijo de Jephone.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Efraim, Oseias, filho de Num.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Issachâr, Igal hijo de Joseph.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Benjamim, Palti, filho de Rafu.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Ephraim, Oseas hijo de Nun.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Zebulom, Gadiel, filho de Sodi.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Benjamín, Palti hijo de Raphu.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Joseph, [namely], of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de José: pela tribo de Manassés, Gadi, filho de Susi.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Zabulón, Gaddiel hijo de Sodi.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Dã, Amiel, filho de Gemali.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de José, de la tribu de Manasés, Gaddi hijo de Susi.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Aser, Setur, filho de Micael.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Dan, Ammiel hijo de Gemalli.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Naftali, Nabi, filho de Vofsi.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Aser, Sethur hijo de Michâel.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Gade, Guel, filho de Maqui.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Nephtalí, Nahabí hijo de Vapsi.

verses.KJV: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
verses.ASV: These are the names of the men that Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os nomes dos homens que Moisés enviou para reconhecer a terra; e a Oseias, filho de Num, Moisés lhe pôs o nome de Josué.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Gad, Geuel hijo de Machî.

verses.KJV: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.WEB: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
verses.ASV: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way by the South, and go up into the hill-country:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés os enviou para reconhecer a terra de Canaã, dizendo-lhes: “Subi por aqui, pelo sul, e subi ao monte:
verses.RVR09: Estos son los nombres de los varones que Moisés envió á reconocer la tierra: y á Oseas hijo de Nun, le puso Moisés el nombre de Josué.

verses.KJV: And see the land, what it is, and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
verses.WEB: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
verses.ASV: and see the land, what it is; and the people that dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
verses.ALMEIDA: e observai a terra que tal é; e o povo que a habita, se é forte ou débil, se pouco ou numeroso;
verses.RVR09: Enviólos, pues, Moisés á reconocer la tierra de Canaán, diciéndoles: Subid por aquí, por el mediodía, y subid al monte:

verses.KJV: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.WEB: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
verses.ASV: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
verses.ALMEIDA: qual é a terra habitada, se é boa ou má; e quais são as cidades habitadas, se de tendas ou de fortalezas;
verses.RVR09: Y observad la tierra qué tal es; y el pueblo que la habita, si es fuerte ó débil, si poco ó numeroso;

verses.KJV: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.WEB: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
verses.ASV: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
verses.ALMEIDA: e qual é o terreno, se é fértil ou fraco, se nele há ou não árvores; esforçai-vos, e colhei do fruto daquela terra.” E o tempo era o tempo das primeiras uvas.
verses.RVR09: Qué tal la tierra habitada, si es buena ó mala; y qué tales son las ciudades habitadas, si de tiendas ó de fortalezas;

verses.KJV: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.WEB: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
verses.ASV: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles subiram, e reconheceram a terra desde o deserto de Zim até Reobe, entrando em Hamate.
verses.RVR09: Y cuál sea el terreno, si es pingüe ó flaco, si en él hay ó no árboles: y esforzaos, y coged del fruto del país. Y el tiempo era el tiempo de las primeras uvas.

verses.KJV: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.WEB: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.ASV: And they went up by the South, and came unto Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiram pelo sul, e vieram até Hebrom: e ali estavam Aimã, e Sesai, e Talmai, filhos de Anaque. Hebrom foi edificada sete anos antes de Zoã, a do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos subieron, y reconocieron la tierra desde el desierto de Zin hasta Rehob, entrando en Emath.

verses.KJV: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.WEB: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
verses.ASV: And they came unto the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it upon a staff between two; [they brought] also of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram até o ribeiro de Escol, e dali cortaram um ramo com um cacho de uvas, o qual trouxeram dois em uma vara, e das romãs e dos figos.
verses.RVR09: Y subieron por el mediodía, y vinieron hasta Hebrón: y allí estaban Aimán, y Sesai, y Talmai, hijos de Anac. Hebrón fué edificada siete años antes de Zoán, la de Egipto.

verses.KJV: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
verses.WEB: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
verses.ASV: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou-se aquele lugar vale de Escol pelo cacho que cortaram dali os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y llegaron hasta el arroyo de Escol, y de allí cortaron un sarmiento con un racimo de uvas, el cual trajeron dos en un palo, y de las granadas y de los higos.

verses.KJV: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.WEB: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
verses.ASV: And they returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltaram de reconhecer a terra ao fim de quarenta dias.
verses.RVR09: Y llamóse aquel lugar Nahal-escol, por el racimo que cortaron de allí los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.WEB: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.ASV: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E andaram e vieram a Moisés e a Arão, e a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, no deserto de Parã, em Cades, e deram-lhes a resposta, e a toda a congregação, e lhes mostraram o fruto da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y volvieron de reconocer la tierra al cabo de cuarenta días.

verses.KJV: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.WEB: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
verses.ASV: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us; and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe contaram, e disseram: Nós chegamos à terra à qual nos enviaste, a que certamente flui leite e mel; e este é o fruto dela.
verses.RVR09: Y anduvieron y vinieron á Moisés y á Aarón, y á toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, en el desierto de Parán, en Cades, y diéronles la respuesta, y á toda la congregación, y les mostraron el fruto de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.WEB: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.ASV: Howbeit the people that dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified, [and] very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o povo que habita aquela terra é forte, e as cidades muito grandes e fortes; e também vimos ali os filhos de Anaque.
verses.RVR09: Y le contaron, y dijeron: Nosotros llegamos á la tierra á la cual nos enviaste, la que ciertamente fluye leche y miel; y este es el fruto de ella.

verses.KJV: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.WEB: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
verses.ASV: Amalek dwelleth in the land of the South: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the hill-country; and the Canaanite dwelleth by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amaleque habita a terra do sul; e os heteus, e os jebuseus, e os amorreus, habitam no monte; e os cananeus habitam junto ao mar, e à beira do Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Mas el pueblo que habita aquella tierra es fuerte, y las ciudades muy grandes y fuertes; y también vimos allí los hijos de Anac.

verses.KJV: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.WEB: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
verses.ASV: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Calebe fez calar o povo diante de Moisés, e disse: Subamos logo, e passemos a ela; que mais poderemos que ela.
verses.RVR09: Amalec habita la tierra del mediodía; y el Hetheo, y el Jebuseo, y el Amorrheo, habitan en el monte; y el Cananeo habita junto á la mar, y á la ribera del Jordán.

verses.KJV: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.WEB: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
verses.ASV: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os homens que subiram com ele, disseram: Não poderemos subir contra aquele povo; porque é mais forte que nós.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Caleb hizo callar el pueblo delante de Moisés, y dijo: Subamos luego, y poseámosla; que más podremos que ella.

verses.KJV: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
verses.WEB: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
verses.ASV: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of great stature.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falaram mal entre os filhos de Israel da terra que haviam reconhecido, dizendo: A terra por de onde passamos para reconhecê-la, é terra que consome a seus moradores; e todo o povo que vimos em meio dela, são homens de grande estatura.
verses.RVR09: Mas los varones que subieron con él, dijeron: No podremos subir contra aquel pueblo; porque es más fuerte que nosotros.

verses.KJV: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
verses.WEB: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
verses.ASV: And there we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também vimos ali gigantes, filhos de Anaque, raça dos gigantes: e éramos nós, à nossa aparência, como gafanhotos; e assim lhes parecíamos a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y vituperaron entre los hijos de Israel la tierra que habían reconocido, diciendo: La tierra por donde pasamos para reconocerla, es tierra que traga á sus moradores; y todo el pueblo que vimos en medio de ella, son hombres de grande estatura. También vimos allí gigantes, hijos de Anac, raza de los gigantes: y éramos nosotros, á nuestro parecer, como langostas; y así les parecíamos á ellos.

verses.KJV: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.WEB: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.ASV: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então toda a congregação levantaram grito, e deram vozes: e o povo chorou aquela noite.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES toda la congregación alzaron grita, y dieron voces: y el pueblo lloró aquella noche.

verses.KJV: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
verses.WEB: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
verses.ASV: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would that we had died in this wilderness!
verses.ALMEIDA: E queixaram-se contra Moisés e contra Arão todos os filhos de Israel; e disse-lhes toda a multidão: Melhor seria se tivéssemos morrido na terra do Egito; ou melhor seria se tivéssemos morrido neste deserto!
verses.RVR09: Y quejáronse contra Moisés y contra Aarón todos los hijos de Israel; y díjoles toda la multitud: ¡Ojalá muriéramos en la tierra de Egipto; ó en este desierto ojalá muriéramos!

verses.KJV: And wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.WEB: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
verses.ASV: And wherefore doth Jehovah bring us unto this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be a prey: were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que nos traze o SENHOR a esta terra para cair à espada e que nossas mulheres e nossos meninos sejam por presa? não nos seria melhor voltarmos ao Egito?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y por qué nos trae Jehová á esta tierra para caer á cuchillo, y que nuestras mujeres y nuestros chiquitos sean por presa? ¿no nos sería mejor volvernos á Egipto?

verses.KJV: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.WEB: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”
verses.ASV: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E diziam um ao outro: Façamos um capitão, e voltemos ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y decían el uno al otro: Hagamos un capitán, y volvámonos á Egipto.

verses.KJV: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés e Arão caíram sobre seus rostos diante de toda a multidão da congregação dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés y Aarón cayeron sobre sus rostros delante de toda la multitud de la congregación de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.WEB: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
verses.ASV: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of them that spied out the land, rent their clothes:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué filho de Num, e Calebe filho de Jefoné, que eram dos que haviam reconhecido a terra, rasgaram suas roupas;
verses.RVR09: Y Josué hijo de Nun, y Caleb hijo de Jephone, que eran de los que habían reconocido la tierra, rompieron sus vestidos;

verses.KJV: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
verses.WEB: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
verses.ASV: and they spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falaram a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: A terra por de onde passamos para reconhecê-la, é terra em grande maneira boa.
verses.RVR09: Y hablaron á toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, diciendo: La tierra por donde pasamos para reconocerla, es tierra en gran manera buena.

verses.KJV: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.WEB: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
verses.ASV: If Jehovah delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it unto us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o SENHOR se agradar de nós, ele nos porá nesta terra, e a entregará a nós; terra que flui leite e mel.
verses.RVR09: Si Jehová se agradare de nosotros, él nos meterá en esta tierra, y nos la entregará; tierra que fluye leche y miel.

verses.KJV: Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.
verses.WEB: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”
verses.ASV: Only rebel not against Jehovah, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is removed from over them, and Jehovah is with us: fear them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, não sejais rebeldes contra o SENHOR, nem temais ao povo desta terra, porque nosso pão são: seu amparo se afastou deles, e conosco está o SENHOR: não os temais.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, no seáis rebeldes contra Jehová, ni temáis al pueblo de aquesta tierra, porque nuestro pan son: su amparo se ha apartado de ellos, y con nosotros está Jehová: no los temáis.

verses.KJV: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The LORD’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of Jehovah appeared in the tent of meeting unto all the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então toda a multidão falou de apedrejá-los com pedras. Mas a glória do SENHOR se mostrou no tabernáculo do testemunho a todos os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Entonces toda la multitud habló de apedrearlos con piedras. Mas la gloria de Jehová se mostró en el tabernáculo del testimonio á todos los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have wrought among them?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Até quando me há de irritar este povo? até quando não me há de crer com todos os sinais que fiz em meio deles?.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: ¿Hasta cuándo me ha de irritar este pueblo? ¿hasta cuándo no me ha de creer con todas las señales que he hecho en medio de ellos?

verses.KJV: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.WEB: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
verses.ASV: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a nation greater and mightier than they.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu lhe ferirei de mortandade, e o destruirei, e a ti te porei sobre gente grande e mais forte que eles.
verses.RVR09: Yo le heriré de mortandad, y lo destruiré, y á ti te pondré sobre gente grande y más fuerte que ellos.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the Lord, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.WEB: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Then the Egyptians will hear it; for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés respondeu ao SENHOR: Logo os egípcios o ouvirão, porque do meio deles tiraste a este povo com tua força:
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés respondió á Jehová: Oiránlo luego los Egipcios, porque de en medio de ellos sacaste á este pueblo con tu fortaleza:

verses.KJV: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.WEB: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you LORD are among this people; for you LORD are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.ASV: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that thou Jehovah art in the midst of this people; for thou Jehovah art seen face to face, and thy cloud standeth over them, and thou goest before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o dirão aos habitantes desta terra; os quais ouviram que tu, ó SENHOR, estavas em meio deste povo, que olho a olho aparecias tu, ó SENHOR, e que tua nuvem estava sobre eles, e que de dia ias diante deles em coluna de nuvem, e de noite em coluna de fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y lo dirán á los habitadores de esta tierra; los cuales han oído que tú, oh Jehová, estabas en medio de este pueblo, que ojo á ojo aparecías tú, oh Jehová, y que tu nube estaba sobre ellos, y que de día ibas delante de ellos en columna de nube, y de noche en columna de fuego:

verses.KJV: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.WEB: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
verses.ASV: Now if thou shalt kill this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E que fizeste morrer a este povo como a um homem: e as nações que houverem ouvido tua fama falarão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y que has hecho morir á este pueblo como á un hombre: y las gentes que hubieren oído tu fama hablarán, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
verses.ASV: Because Jehovah was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não pôde o SENHOR meter este povo na terra da qual lhes havia jurado, os matou no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Porque no pudo Jehová meter este pueblo en la tierra de la cual les había jurado, los mató en el desierto.

verses.KJV: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.WEB: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
verses.ASV: And now, I pray thee, let the power of the Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, eu te rogo que seja engrandecida a força do Senhor, como o falaste, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Ahora, pues, yo te ruego que sea magnificada la fortaleza del Señor, como lo hablaste, diciendo:

verses.KJV: The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.WEB: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
verses.ASV: Jehovah is slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, forgiving iniquity and transgression; and that will by no means clear [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR, tardio de ira e grande em misericórdia, que perdoa a iniquidade e a rebelião, e deixa impune o culpado; que visita a maldade dos pais sobre os filhos até a terceira geração e até a quarta.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, tardo de ira y grande en misericordia, que perdona la iniquidad y la rebelión, y absolviendo no absolverá al culpado; que visita la maldad de los padres sobre los hijos hasta los terceros y hasta los cuartos.

verses.KJV: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.WEB: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
verses.ASV: Pardon, I pray thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy lovingkindness, and according as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perdoa agora a iniquidade deste povo segundo a grandeza de tua misericórdia, e como perdoaste a este povo desde Egito até aqui.
verses.RVR09: Perdona ahora la iniquidad de este pueblo según la grandeza de tu misericordia, y como has perdonado á este pueblo desde Egipto hasta aquí.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “I have pardoned according to your word;
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse: Eu o perdoei conforme tu dito:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo: yo lo he perdonado conforme á tu dicho:

verses.KJV: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord.
verses.WEB: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD’s glory—
verses.ASV: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, certamente vivo eu e minha glória inche toda a terra,
verses.RVR09: Mas, ciertamente vivo yo y mi gloria hinche toda la tierra,

verses.KJV: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.WEB: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;
verses.ASV: because all those men that have seen my glory, and my signs, which I wrought in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que todos os que viram minha glória e meus sinais que fiz no Egito e no deserto, e me tentaram já dez vezes, e não ouviram minha voz,
verses.RVR09: Que todos los que vieron mi gloria y mis señales que he hecho en Egipto y en el desierto, y me han tentado ya diez veces, y no han oído mi voz,

verses.KJV: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.WEB: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.
verses.ASV: surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that despised me see it:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não verão a terra da qual jurei a seus pais: não, nenhum dos que me irritaram a verá.
verses.RVR09: No verán la tierra de la cual juré á sus padres: no, ninguno de los que me han irritado la verá.

verses.KJV: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.WEB: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.
verses.ASV: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém meu servo Calebe, porquanto houve nele outro espírito, e cumpriu de ir após mim, eu o porei na terra onde entrou e sua descendência a receberá em herança.
verses.RVR09: Empero mi siervo Caleb, por cuanto hubo en él otro espíritu, y cumplió de ir en pos de mí, yo le meteré en la tierra donde entró, y su simiente la recibirá en heredad.

verses.KJV: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.WEB: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
verses.ASV: Now the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley: to-morrow turn ye, and get you into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora bem, os amalequitas e os cananeus habitam no vale; voltai-vos amanhã, e parti-vos ao deserto, caminho do mar Vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Ahora bien, el Amalecita y el Cananeo habitan en el valle; volveos mañana, y partíos al desierto, camino del mar Bermejo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés y á Aarón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.WEB: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.
