verses.ASV: How long [shall I bear] with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando ouvirei esta depravada multidão que murmura contra mim, as queixas dos filhos de Israel, que de mim se queixam?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo oiré esta depravada multitud que murmura contra mí, las querellas de los hijos de Israel, que de mí se quejan?

verses.KJV: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.WEB: Tell them, ‘As I live, says the LORD, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
verses.ASV: Say unto them, As I live, saith Jehovah, surely as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize-lhes: Vivo eu, diz o SENHOR, que segundo falastes a meus ouvidos, assim farei eu convosco:
verses.RVR09: Diles: Vivo yo, dice Jehová, que según habéis hablado á mis oídos, así haré yo con vosotros:

verses.KJV: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward which have murmured against me.
verses.WEB: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,
verses.ASV: your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, that have murmured against me,
verses.ALMEIDA: Neste deserto cairão vossos corpos; todos vossos contados segundo toda vossa contagem, de vinte anos acima, os quais murmurastes contra mim;
verses.RVR09: En este desierto caerán vuestros cuerpos; todos vuestros contados según toda vuestra cuenta, de veinte años arriba, los cuales habéis murmurado contra mí;

verses.KJV: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.WEB: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.ASV: surely ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware that I would make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós à verdade não entrareis na terra, pela qual levantei minha mão de fazer-vos habitar nela; exceto a Calebe filho de Jefoné, e a Josué filho de Num.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros á la verdad no entraréis en la tierra, por la cual alcé mi mano de haceros habitar en ella; exceptuando á Caleb hijo de Jephone, y á Josué hijo de Nun.

verses.KJV: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.WEB: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.
verses.ASV: But your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have rejected.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vossos meninos, dos quais dissestes que seriam por presa, eu os introduzirei, e eles conhecerão a terra que vós desprezastes.
verses.RVR09: Mas vuestros chiquitos, de los cuales dijisteis que serían por presa, yo los introduciré, y ellos conocerán la tierra que vosotros despreciasteis.

verses.KJV: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.WEB: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.ASV: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto a vós, vossos corpos cairão neste deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y en cuanto á vosotros, vuestros cuerpos caerán en este desierto.

verses.KJV: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: And your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your whoredoms, until your dead bodies be consumed in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vossos filhos andarão pastoreando no deserto quarenta anos, e eles levarão vossas prostituições, até que vossos corpos sejam consumidos no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y vuestros hijos andarán pastoreando en el desierto cuarenta años, y ellos llevarán vuestras fornicaciones, hasta que vuestros cuerpos sean consumidos en el desierto.

verses.KJV: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.WEB: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
verses.ASV: After the number of the days in which ye spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my alienation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme o número dos dias, dos quarenta dias em que reconhecestes a terra, levareis vossas iniquidades quarenta anos, ano por cada dia; e conhecereis meu castigo.
verses.RVR09: Conforme al número de los días, de los cuarenta días en que reconocisteis la tierra, llevaréis vuestras iniquidades cuarenta años, un año por cada día; y conoceréis mi castigo.

verses.KJV: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.WEB: I, the LORD, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
verses.ASV: I, Jehovah, have spoken, surely this will I do unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR falei; assim farei a toda esta multidão perversa que se juntou contra mim; neste deserto serão consumidos, e ali morrerão.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová he hablado; así haré á toda esta multitud perversa que se ha juntado contra mí; en este desierto serán consumidos, y ahí morirán.

verses.KJV: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.WEB: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,
verses.ASV: And the men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os homens que Moisés enviou para reconhecer a terra, e depois de voltarem, fizeram toda a congregação murmurar contra ele, trazendo um mau relato daquela terra,
verses.RVR09: Y los varones que Moisés envió á reconocer la tierra, y vueltos habían hecho murmurar contra él á toda la congregación, desacreditando aquel país,

verses.KJV: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.
verses.WEB: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
verses.ASV: even those men that did bring up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: aqueles homens que haviam falado mal da terra, morreram de praga diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Aquellos varones que habían hablado mal de la tierra, murieron de plaga delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
verses.WEB: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
verses.ASV: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men that went to spy out the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Josué filho de Num, e Calebe filho de Jefoné, restaram com vida dentre aqueles homens que haviam ido a reconhecer a terra.
verses.RVR09: Mas Josué hijo de Nun, y Caleb hijo de Jephone, quedaron con vida de entre aquellos hombres que habían ido á reconocer la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.WEB: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
verses.ASV: And Moses told these words unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés disse estas coisas a todos os filhos de Israel, e o povo ficou em muito luto.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés dijo estas cosas á todos los hijos de Israel, y el pueblo se enlutó mucho.

verses.KJV: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.WEB: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised; for we have sinned.”
verses.ASV: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up to the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we are here, and will go up unto the place which Jehovah hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantaram-se pela manhã, e subiram ao cume do monte, dizendo: Eis-nos aqui para subir ao lugar do qual falou o SENHOR; porque pecamos.
verses.RVR09: Y levantáronse por la mañana, y subieron á la cumbre del monte, diciendo: Henos aquí para subir al lugar del cual ha hablado Jehová; porque hemos pecado.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of the LORD, since it shall not prosper?
verses.ASV: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of Jehovah, seeing it shall not prosper?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés: Por que quebrantais o dito do SENHOR? Isto tampouco vos sucederá bem.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés: ¿Por qué quebrantáis el dicho de Jehová? Esto tampoco os sucederá bien.

verses.KJV: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.WEB: Don’t go up, for the LORD isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.
verses.ASV: Go not up, for Jehovah is not among you; that ye be not smitten down before your enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não subais, porque o SENHOR não está em meio de vós, não sejais feridos diante de vossos inimigos.
verses.RVR09: No subáis, porque Jehová no está en medio de vosotros, no seáis heridos delante de vuestros enemigos.

verses.KJV: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.
verses.WEB: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you.”
verses.ASV: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned back from following Jehovah, therefore Jehovah will not be with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os amalequitas e os cananeus estão ali diante de vós, e caireis à espada: pois porquanto vos desviastes de seguir ao SENHOR, por isso não será o SENHOR convosco.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Amalecita y el Cananeo están allí delante de vosotros, y caeréis á cuchillo: pues por cuanto os habéis retraído de seguir á Jehová, por eso no será Jehová con vosotros.

verses.KJV: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.WEB: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
verses.ASV: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia, se insistiram em subir por cima do monte: mas a arca da aliança do SENHOR, e Moisés, não se apartaram do meio do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Sin embargo, se obstinaron en subir á la cima del monte: mas el arca de la alianza de Jehová, y Moisés, no se apartaron de en medio del campo.

verses.KJV: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
verses.WEB: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
verses.ASV: Then the Amalekite came down, and the Canaanite who dwelt in that mountain, and smote them and beat them down, even unto Hormah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desceram os amalequitas e os cananeus, que habitavam naquele monte, e os feriram e os derrotaram, perseguindo-os até Hormá.
verses.RVR09: Y descendieron el Amalecita y el Cananeo, que habitaban en aquel monte, é hiriéronlos y derrotáronlos, persiguiéndolos hasta Horma.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra de vossas habitações, que eu vos dou,
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando hubiereis entrado en la tierra de vuestras habitaciones, que yo os doy,

verses.KJV: And will make an offering by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the Lord, of the herd or of the flock:
verses.WEB: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock—
verses.ASV: and will make an offering by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill-offering, or in your set feasts, to make a sweet savor unto Jehovah, of the herd, or of the flock;
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizerdes oferta queimada ao SENHOR, holocausto, ou sacrifício, por especial voto, ou de vossa vontade, ou para fazer em vossas solenidades cheiro suave ao SENHOR, de vacas ou de ovelhas;
verses.RVR09: E hiciereis ofrenda encendida á Jehová, holocausto, ó sacrificio, por especial voto, ó de vuestra voluntad, ó para hacer en vuestras solemnidades olor suave á Jehová, de vacas ó de ovejas;

verses.KJV: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the Lord bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
verses.WEB: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.
verses.ASV: then shall he that offereth his oblation offer unto Jehovah a meal-offering of a tenth part [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of oil:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o que oferecer sua oferta ao SENHOR, trará por oferta de cereais um décimo de um efa de boa farinha, amassada com a quarta parte de um him de azeite;
verses.RVR09: Entonces el que ofreciere su ofrenda á Jehová, traerá por presente una décima de un epha de flor de harina, amasada con la cuarta parte de un hin de aceite;

verses.KJV: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.WEB: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.ASV: and wine for the drink-offering, the fourth part of a hin, shalt thou prepare with the burnt-offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de veio para a libação oferecerás a quarta parte de um him, além do holocausto ou do sacrifício, por cada cordeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y de vino para la libación ofrecerás la cuarta parte de un hin, además del holocausto ó del sacrificio, por cada un cordero.

verses.KJV: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
verses.WEB: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
verses.ASV: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meal-offering two tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil:
verses.ALMEIDA: E para cada carneiro farás oferta de cereais de dois décimos [de efa] de boa farinha, amassada com o terço de um him de azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y por cada carnero harás presente de dos décimas de flor de harina, amasada con el tercio de un hin de aceite:

verses.KJV: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: and for the drink-offering thou shalt offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: e de vinho para a libação oferecerás o terço de um him, em cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y de vino para la libación ofrecerás el tercio de un hin, en olor suave á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the Lord:
verses.WEB: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to the LORD,
verses.ASV: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt-offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace-offerings unto Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando oferecerdes novilho em holocausto ou sacrifício, por especial voto, ou pacífico ao SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Y cuando ofreciereis novillo en holocausto ó sacrificio, por especial voto, ó de paces á Jehová,

verses.KJV: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.WEB: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
verses.ASV: then shall he offer with the bullock a meal-offering of three tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with half a hin of oil:
verses.ALMEIDA: Oferecerás com o novilho uma oferta de cereais de três décimos [de efa] de boa farinha, amassada com a metade de um him de azeite:
verses.RVR09: Ofrecerás con el novillo un presente de tres décimas de flor de harina, amasada con la mitad de un hin de aceite:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt offer for the drink-offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de vinho para a libação oferecerás a metade de um him, em oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y de vino para la libación ofrecerás la mitad de un hin, en ofrenda encendida de olor suave á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.WEB: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
verses.ASV: Thus shall it be done for each bullock, or for each ram, or for each of the he-lambs, or of the kids.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se fará com cada um boi, ou carneiro, ou cordeiro, o mesmo de ovelhas que de cabras.
verses.RVR09: Así se hará con cada un buey, ó carnero, ó cordero, lo mismo de ovejas que de cabras.

verses.KJV: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.WEB: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
verses.ASV: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme o número assim fareis com cada um segundo o número deles.
verses.RVR09: Conforme al número así haréis con cada uno según el número de ellos.

verses.KJV: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: All that are home-born shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo natural fará estas coisas assim, para apresentar oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Todo natural hará estas cosas así, para ofrecer ofrenda encendida de olor suave á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.WEB: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD, as you do, so he shall do.
verses.ASV: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando habitar convosco estrangeiro, ou qualquer um que estiver entre vós nas vossas gerações, se apresentar uma oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao SENHOR, como vós fizerdes, assim fará ele.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando habitare con vosotros extranjero, ó cualquiera que estuviere entre vosotros por vuestras edades, si hiciere ofrenda encendida de olor suave á Jehová, como vosotros hiciereis, así hará él.

verses.KJV: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.
verses.WEB: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD.
verses.ASV: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth [with you], a statute for ever throughout your generations: as ye are, so shall the sojourner be before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um mesmo estatuto tereis, vós da congregação e o estrangeiro que convosco mora; estatuto que será perpétuo por vossas gerações: como vós, assim será o peregrino diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Un mismo estatuto tendréis, vosotros de la congregación y el extranjero que con vosotros mora; estatuto que será perpetuo por vuestras edades: como vosotros, así será el peregrino delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.WEB: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”
verses.ASV: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma mesma lei e um mesmo regulamento tereis, vós e o peregrino que convosco mora.
verses.RVR09: Una misma ley y un mismo derecho tendréis, vosotros y el peregrino que con vosotros mora.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra à qual eu vos levo,
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando hubiereis entrado en la tierra á la cual yo os llevo,

verses.KJV: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD.
verses.ASV: then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up a heave-offering unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será que quando começardes a comer o pão da terra, oferecereis oferta ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Será que cuando comenzareis á comer del pan de la tierra, ofreceréis ofrenda á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.WEB: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
verses.ASV: Of the first of your dough ye shall offer up a cake for a heave-offering: as the heave-offering of the threshing-floor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da primeira parte que amassardes, oferecereis um bolo como oferta; como a oferta da eira, assim o oferecereis.
verses.RVR09: De lo primero que amasareis, ofreceréis una torta en ofrenda; como la ofrenda de la era, así la ofreceréis.

verses.KJV: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the Lord an heave offering in your generations.
verses.WEB: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.
verses.ASV: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto Jehovah a heave-offering throughout your generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Das primícias de vossas massas dareis ao SENHOR oferta por vossas gerações.
verses.RVR09: De las primicias de vuestras masas daréis á Jehová ofrenda por vuestras generaciones.

verses.KJV: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.WEB: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—
verses.ASV: And when ye shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando errardes, e não fizerdes todos estes mandamentos que o SENHOR disse a Moisés,
verses.RVR09: Y cuando errareis, y no hiciereis todos estos mandamientos que Jehová ha dicho á Moisés,

verses.KJV: Even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
verses.WEB: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
verses.ASV: even all that Jehovah hath commanded you by Moses, from the day that Jehovah gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as coisas que o SENHOR vos mandou pela mão de Moisés, desde o dia que o SENHOR o mandou, e daí em diante por vossas gerações,
verses.RVR09: Todas las cosas que Jehová os ha mandado por la mano de Moisés, desde el día que Jehová lo mandó, y en adelante por vuestras edades,

verses.KJV: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the Lord, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.WEB: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
verses.ASV: then it shall be, if it be done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt-offering, for a sweet savor unto Jehovah, with the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof, according to the ordinance, and one he-goat for a sin-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será que, se o pecado foi feito involuntariamente por ignorância da congregação, toda a congregação oferecerá um novilho por holocausto, em cheiro suave ao SENHOR, com sua oferta de cereais e sua libação, conforme a lei; e um bode macho por expiação.
verses.RVR09: Será que, si el pecado fué hecho por yerro con ignorancia de la congregación, toda la congregación ofrecerá un novillo por holocausto, en olor suave á Jehová, con su presente y su libación, conforme á la ley; y un macho cabrío en expiación.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance:
verses.WEB: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their error.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their oblation, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, and their sin-offering before Jehovah, for their error:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote fará expiação por toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel; e lhes será perdoado, porque foi erro por ignorância; eles trarão sua oferta, oferta queimada ao SENHOR, e sua expiação diante do SENHOR, por causa do seu erro;
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote hará expiación por toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel; y les será perdonado, porque yerro es: y ellos traerán sus ofrendas, ofrenda encendida á Jehová, y sus expiaciones delante de Jehová, por sus yerros:

verses.KJV: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
verses.WEB: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.
verses.ASV: and all the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; for in respect of all the people it was done unwittingly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será perdoado a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e ao estrangeiro que peregrina entre eles, porque foi erro por ignorância de todo o povo.
verses.RVR09: Y será perdonado á toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, y al extranjero que peregrina entre ellos, por cuanto es yerro de todo el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.WEB: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
verses.ASV: And if one person sin unwittingly, then he shall offer a she-goat a year old for a sin-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se uma pessoa pecar por ignorância, oferecerá uma cabra de um ano por expiação.
verses.RVR09: Y si una persona pecare por yerro, ofrecerá una cabra de un año por expiación.

verses.KJV: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the Lord, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.WEB: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
verses.ASV: And the priest shall make atonement for the soul that erreth, when he sinneth unwittingly, before Jehovah, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote fará expiação pela pessoa que houver pecado, quando pecar por ignorância diante do SENHOR, e a reconciliará, e lhe será perdoado.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote hará expiación por la persona que habrá pecado por yerro, cuando pecare por yerro delante de Jehová, la reconciliará, y le será perdonado.

verses.KJV: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.WEB: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.
verses.ASV: Ye shall have one law for him that doeth aught unwittingly, for him that is home-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: O natural entre os filhos de Israel, e o peregrino que habitar entre eles, uma mesma lei tereis para o que fizer algo por acidente.
verses.RVR09: El natural entre los hijos de Israel, y el peregrino que habitare entre ellos, una misma ley tendréis para el que hiciere algo por yerro.

verses.KJV: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.WEB: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.ASV: But the soul that doeth aught with a high hand, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, the same blasphemeth Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a pessoa que fizer algo com mão soberba, tanto o natural como o estrangeiro, ao SENHOR blasfemou; e a tal pessoa será eliminada do meio de seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Mas la persona que hiciere algo con altiva mano, así el natural como el extranjero, á Jehová injurió; y la tal persona será cortada de en medio de su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Because he hath despised the word of the Lord, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.WEB: Because he has despised the LORD’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”
verses.ASV: Because he hath despised the word of Jehovah, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porquanto teve em pouco a palavra do SENHOR, e deu por nulo seu mandamento, inteiramente será eliminada a tal pessoa: sua iniquidade será sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto tuvo en poco la palabra de Jehová, y dió por nulo su mandamiento, enteramente será cortada la tal persona: su iniquidad será sobre ella.

verses.KJV: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.WEB: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
verses.ASV: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando os filhos de Israel no deserto, acharam um homem que recolhia lenha em dia de sábado.
verses.RVR09: Y estando los hijos de Israel en el desierto, hallaron un hombre que recogía leña en día de sábado.

verses.KJV: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.WEB: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
verses.ASV: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que lhe acharam recolhendo lenha trouxeram-lhe a Moisés e a Arão, e a toda a congregação:
verses.RVR09: Y los que le hallaron recogiendo leña trajéronle á Moisés y á Aarón, y á toda la congregación:

verses.KJV: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.WEB: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
verses.ASV: And they put him in ward, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram-no no cárcere, porque não estava declarado que lhe haviam de fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y pusiéronlo en la cárcel, por que no estaba declarado qué le habían de hacer.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Invariavelmente morra aquele homem; apedreje-o com pedras toda a congregação fora do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Irremisiblemente muera aquel hombre; apedréelo con piedras toda la congregación fuera del campo.

verses.KJV: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him to death with stones; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o tirou a congregação fora do acampamento, e apedrejaram-no com pedras, e morreu; como o SENHOR mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Entonces lo sacó la congregación fuera del campo, y apedreáronlo con piedras, y murió; como Jehová mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of each border a cord of blue:
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes que se façam franjas) nos arremates de suas roupas, por suas gerações; e ponham em cada franja dos arremates um cordão de azul:
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles que se hagan pezuelos (franjas) en los remates de sus vestidos, por sus generaciones; y pongan en cada pezuelo de los remates un cordón de cárdeno:

verses.KJV: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
verses.WEB: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all the LORD’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;
verses.ASV: and it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of Jehovah, and do them; and that ye follow not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to play the harlot;
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos servirá de franja, para que quando o virdes, vos lembreis de todos os mandamentos do SENHOR, para praticá-los; e não olheis segundo vosso coração e vossos olhos, atrás dos quais prostituís:
verses.RVR09: Y serviros ha de pezuelo, para que cuando lo viereis, os acordéis de todos los mandamientos de Jehová, para ponerlos por obra; y no miréis en pos de vuestro corazón y de vuestros ojos, en pos de los cuales fornicáis:

verses.KJV: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.WEB: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
verses.ASV: that ye may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que vos lembreis, e façais todos meus mandamentos, e sejais santos a vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Para que os acordéis, y hagáis todos mis mandamientos, y seáis santos á vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.”
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para ser vosso Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios, que os saqué de la tierra de Egipto, para ser vuestro Dios: Yo Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
verses.WEB: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
verses.ASV: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took [men]:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Coré, filho de Izar, filho de Coate, filho de Levi; e Datã e Abirão, filhos de Eliabe; e Om, filho de Pelete, dos filhos de Rúben, tomaram gente,
verses.RVR09: Y CORÉ, hijo de Ishar, hijo de Coath, hijo de Leví; y Dathán y Abiram, hijos de Eliab; y Hon, hijo de Peleth, de los hijos de Rubén, tomaron gente,

verses.KJV: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
verses.WEB: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
verses.ASV: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown;
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantaram-se contra Moisés com duzentos e cinquenta homens dos filhos de Israel, príncipes da congregação, dos do conselho, homens de renome;
verses.RVR09: Y levantáronse contra Moisés con doscientos y cincuenta varones de los hijos de Israel, príncipes de la congregación, de los del consejo, varones de nombre;

verses.KJV: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?
verses.WEB: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and the LORD is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above the LORD’s assembly?”
verses.ASV: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and Jehovah is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the assembly of Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: E se juntaram contra Moisés e Arão, e lhes disseram: Basta-vos, porque toda a congregação, todos eles são santos, e em meio deles está o SENHOR: por que, pois, vos levantais vós sobre a congregação do SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Y se juntaron contra Moisés y Aarón, y les dijeron: Básteos, porque toda la congregación, todos ellos son santos, y en medio de ellos está Jehová: ¿por qué, pues, os levantáis vosotros sobre la congregación de Jehová?

verses.KJV: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
verses.WEB: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.
verses.ASV: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o ouviu Moisés, lançou-se sobre seu rosto;
verses.RVR09: Y como lo oyó Moisés, echóse sobre su rostro;

verses.KJV: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.WEB: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, the LORD will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
verses.ASV: and he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, In the morning Jehovah will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he shall choose will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou a Coré e a todo o seu grupo, dizendo: Amanhã mostrará o SENHOR quem é seu, e ao santo o fará chegar a si; e ao que ele escolher, ele o achegará a si.
verses.RVR09: Y habló á Coré y á todo su séquito, diciendo: Mañana mostrará Jehová quién es suyo, y al santo harálo llegar á sí; y al que él escogiere, él lo allegará á sí.

verses.KJV: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.WEB: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,
verses.ASV: This do: take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fazei isto: tomai incensários, Coré e todo o seu grupo:
verses.RVR09: Haced esto: tomaos incensarios, Coré y todo su séquito:

verses.KJV: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the Lord to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.WEB: put fire in them, and put incense on them before the LORD tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”
verses.ASV: and put fire in them, and put incense upon them before Jehovah to-morrow: and it shall be that the man whom Jehovah doth choose, he [shall be] holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ponde fogo neles, e ponde neles incenso diante do SENHOR amanhã; e será que o homem a quem o SENHOR escolher, aquele será o santo: basta-vos isto, filhos de Levi.
verses.RVR09: Y poned fuego en ellos, y poned en ellos sahumerio delante de Jehová mañana; y será que el varón á quien Jehová escogiere, aquél será el santo: básteos esto, hijos de Leví.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
verses.WEB: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear now, ye sons of Levi:
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais Moisés a Coré: Ouvi agora, filhos de Levi:
verses.RVR09: Dijo más Moisés á Coré: Oid ahora, hijos de Leví:

verses.KJV: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.WEB: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;
verses.ASV: [seemeth it but] a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the tabernacle of Jehovah, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vos é pouco que o Deus de Israel vos haja apartado da congregação de Israel, fazendo-vos achegar a si para que ministrasses no serviço do tabernáculo do SENHOR, e estivésseis diante da congregação para ministrar-lhes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Os es poco que el Dios de Israel os haya apartado de la congregación de Israel, haciéndoos allegar á sí para que ministraseis en el servicio del tabernáculo de Jehová, y estuvieseis delante de la congregación para ministrarles?

verses.KJV: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.WEB: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
verses.ASV: and that he hath brought thee near, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee? and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.ALMEIDA: E que te fez aproximar a ti, e a todos os teus irmãos os filhos de Levi contigo; para que procureis também o sacerdócio?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y que te hizo acercar á ti, y á todos tus hermanos los hijos de Leví contigo; para que procuréis también el sacerdocio?

verses.KJV: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the Lord: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
verses.WEB: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against the LORD! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”
verses.ASV: Therefore thou and all thy company are gathered together against Jehovah: and Aaron, what is he that ye murmur against him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, tu e todo o teu grupo sois os que vos juntais contra o SENHOR: pois Arão, que é para que contra ele murmureis?
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, tú y todo tu séquito sois los que os juntáis contra Jehová: pues Aarón, ¿qué es para que contra él murmuréis?

verses.KJV: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.WEB: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!
verses.ASV: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, We will not come up:
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Moisés a chamar a Datã e Abirão, filhos de Eliabe; mas eles responderam: Não iremos lá:
verses.RVR09: Y envió Moisés á llamar á Dathán y Abiram, hijos de Eliab; mas ellos respondieron: No iremos allá:

verses.KJV: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.WEB: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?
verses.ASV: is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but thou must needs make thyself also a prince over us?
verses.ALMEIDA: É pouco que nos tenhas feito vir de uma terra que destila leite e mel, para fazer-nos morrer no deserto, mas que também te faças senhor de nós autoritariamente?
verses.RVR09: ¿Es poco que nos hayas hecho venir de una tierra que destila leche y miel, para hacernos morir en el desierto, sino que también te enseñorees de nosotros imperiosamente?

verses.KJV: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.WEB: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
verses.ASV: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem tampouco nos puseste tu em terra que flua leite e mel, nem nos deste propriedades de terras e vinhas: hás de arrancar os olhos destes homens? Não subiremos.
verses.RVR09: Ni tampoco nos has metido tú en tierra que fluya leche y miel, ni nos has dado heredades de tierras y viñas: ¿has de arrancar los ojos de estos hombres? No subiremos.

verses.KJV: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the Lord, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.WEB: Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”
verses.ASV: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto Jehovah, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés se irou em grande maneira, e disse ao SENHOR: Não olhes a sua oferta: nem ainda um asno tomei deles, nem a nenhum deles fiz mal.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés se enojó en gran manera, y dijo á Jehová: No mires á su presente: ni aun un asno he tomado de ellos, ni á ninguno de ellos he hecho mal.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the Lord, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.WEB: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before the LORD, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before Jehovah, thou, and they, and Aaron, to-morrow:
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disse Moisés a Coré: Tu e todo o teu grupo, ponde-vos amanhã diante do SENHOR; tu, e eles, e Arão:
verses.RVR09: Después dijo Moisés á Coré: Tú y todo tu séquito, poneos mañana delante de Jehová; tú, y ellos, y Aarón:

verses.KJV: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the Lord every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
verses.WEB: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before the LORD his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”
verses.ASV: and take ye every man his censer, and put incense upon them, and bring ye before Jehovah every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each his censer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomai cada um seu incensário, e ponde incenso neles, e achegai diante do SENHOR cada um seu incensário: duzentos e cinquenta incensários: tu também, e Arão, cada um com seu incensário.
verses.RVR09: Y tomad cada uno su incensario, y poned sahumerio en ellos, y allegad delante de Jehová cada uno su incensario: doscientos y cincuenta incensarios: tú también, y Aarón, cada uno con su incensario.

verses.KJV: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
verses.WEB: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
verses.ASV: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood at the door of the tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram cada um seu incensário, e puseram neles fogo, e lançaram neles incenso, e puseram-se à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho com Moisés e Arão.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron cada uno su incensario, y pusieron en ellos fuego, y echaron en ellos sahumerio, y pusiéronse á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio con Moisés y Aarón.

verses.KJV: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.WEB: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. The LORD’s glory appeared to all the congregation.
verses.ASV: And Korah assembled all the congregation against them unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já Coré havia feito juntar contra eles toda a congregação à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho: então a glória do SENHOR apareceu a toda a congregação.
verses.RVR09: Ya Coré había hecho juntar contra ellos toda la congregación á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio: entonces la gloria de Jehová apareció á toda la congregación.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés y á Aarón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.WEB: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
verses.ASV: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apartai-vos dentre esta congregação, e os consumirei em um momento.
verses.RVR09: Apartaos de entre esta congregación, y consumirlos he en un momento.

verses.KJV: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.WEB: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”
verses.ASV: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles se lançaram sobre seus rostos, e disseram: Deus, Deus dos espíritos de toda carne, não é um homem o que pecou? E te irarás tu contra toda a congregação?
verses.RVR09: Y ellos se echaron sobre sus rostros, y dijeron: Dios, Dios de los espíritus de toda carne, ¿no es un hombre el que pecó? ¿y airarte has tú contra toda la congregación?

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.WEB: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”
verses.ASV: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala à congregação, dizendo: Apartai-vos de em derredor da tenda de Coré, Datã, e Abirão.
verses.RVR09: Habla á la congregación, diciendo: Apartaos de en derredor de la tienda de Coré, Dathán, y Abiram.

verses.KJV: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.WEB: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.ASV: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés se levantou, e foi a Datã e Abirão; e os anciãos de Israel foram atrás dele.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés se levantó, y fué á Dathán y á Abiram; y los ancianos de Israel fueron en pos de él.

verses.KJV: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of their's, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.WEB: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”
verses.ASV: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele falou à congregação, dizendo: Apartai-vos agora das tendas destes ímpios homens, e não toqueis nenhuma coisa sua, porque não pereçais em todos os seus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Y él habló á la congregación, diciendo: Apartaos ahora de las tiendas de estos impíos hombres, y no toquéis ninguna cosa suya, por que no perezcáis en todos sus pecados.

verses.KJV: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.WEB: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
verses.ASV: So they gat them up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apartaram-se das tendas de Coré, de Datã, e de Abirão em derredor: e Datã e Abirão saíram e puseram-se às portas de suas tendas, com suas mulheres, e seus filhos, e suas crianças.
verses.RVR09: Y apartáronse de las tiendas de Coré, de Dathán, y de Abiram en derredor: y Dathán y Abiram salieron y pusiéronse á las puertas de sus tiendas, con sus mujeres, y sus hijos, y sus chiquitos.

verses.KJV: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the Lord hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
verses.WEB: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.
verses.ASV: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that Jehovah hath sent me to do all these works; for [I have] not [done them] of mine own mind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés: Em isto conhecereis que o SENHOR me enviou para que fizesse todas estas coisas: que não de meu coração as fiz.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés: En esto conoceréis que Jehová me ha enviado para que hiciese todas estas cosas; que no de mi corazón las hice.

verses.KJV: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord hath not sent me.
verses.WEB: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then the LORD hasn’t sent me.
verses.ASV: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Jehovah hath not sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se como morrem todos os homens morrerem estes, ou se forem eles visitados à maneira de todos os homens, o SENHOR não me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Si como mueren todos los hombres murieren éstos, ó si fueren ellos visitados á la manera de todos los hombres, Jehová no me envió.

verses.KJV: But if the Lord make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the Lord.
verses.WEB: But if the LORD makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised the LORD.”
verses.ASV: But if Jehovah make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then ye shall understand that these men have despised Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se o SENHOR fizer uma nova coisa, e a terra abrir sua boca, e os tragar com todas suas coisas, e descerem vivos ao Xeol, então conhecereis que estes homens irritaram ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas si Jehová hiciere una nueva cosa, y la tierra abriere su boca, y los tragare con todas sus cosas, y descendieren vivos al abismo, entonces conoceréis que estos hombres irritaron á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
verses.WEB: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, que em acabando ele de falar todas estas palavras, rompeu-se a terra que estava debaixo deles:
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que en acabando él de hablar todas estas palabras, rompióse la tierra que estaba debajo de ellos:

verses.KJV: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
verses.WEB: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
verses.ASV: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abriu a terra sua boca, e tragou-os a eles, e a suas casas, e a todos os homens de Coré, e a todos os seus pertences.
verses.RVR09: Y abrió la tierra su boca, y tragólos á ellos, y á sus casas, y á todos los hombres de Coré, y á toda su hacienda.

verses.KJV: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.WEB: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
verses.ASV: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol: and the earth closed upon them, and they perished from among the assembly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles, com tudo o que tinham, desceram vivos ao Xeol, a a terra os cobriu, e pereceram do meio da congregação.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos, con todo lo que tenían, descendieron vivos al abismo, y cubriólos la tierra, y perecieron de en medio de la congregación.

verses.KJV: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
verses.WEB: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
verses.ASV: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them; for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo Israel, os que estavam em derredor deles, fugiram ao grito deles; porque diziam: Não nos trague também a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y todo Israel, los que estaban en derredor de ellos, huyeron al grito de ellos; porque decían: No nos trague también la tierra.

verses.KJV: And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.WEB: Fire came out from the LORD, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
verses.ASV: And fire came forth from Jehovah, and devoured the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu fogo do SENHOR, e consumiu os duzentos e cinquenta homens que ofereciam o incenso.
verses.RVR09: Y salió fuego de Jehová, y consumió los doscientos y cincuenta hombres que ofrecían el sahumerio.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.WEB: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,
verses.ASV: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are holy,
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize a Eleazar, filho de Arão sacerdote, que tome os incensários do meio do incêndio, e derrame mais ali o fogo; porque são santificados:
verses.RVR09: Di á Eleazar, hijo de Aarón sacerdote, que tome los incensarios de en medio del incendio, y derrame más allá el fuego; porque son santificados:

verses.KJV: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the Lord, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before the LORD. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”
verses.ASV: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives; and let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Jehovah; therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os incensários destes pecadores contra suas almas: e farão deles placas estendidas para cobrir o altar: porquanto ofereceram com eles diante do SENHOR, são santificados; e serão por sinal aos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Los incensarios de estos pecadores contra sus almas: y harán de ellos planchas extendidas para cubrir el altar: por cuanto ofrecieron con ellos delante de Jehová, son santificados; y serán por señal á los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
verses.WEB: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,
verses.ASV: And Eleazar the priest took the brazen censers, which they that were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote Eleazar tomou os incensários de bronze com que os queimados haviam oferecido; e estenderam-nos para cobrir o altar,
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote Eleazar tomó los incensarios de metal con que los quemados habían ofrecido; y extendiéronlos para cubrir el altar,

verses.KJV: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the Lord said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before the LORD, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as the LORD spoke to him by Moses.
verses.ASV: to be a memorial unto the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, that is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to burn incense before Jehovah; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as Jehovah spake unto him by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em memorial aos filhos de Israel que nenhum estranho que não seja da descendência de Arão, chegue a oferecer incenso diante do SENHOR, para que não seja como Coré, e como seu grupo; segundo se o disse o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: En recuerdo á los hijos de Israel que ningún extraño que no sea de la simiente de Aarón, llegue á ofrecer sahumerio delante de Jehová, porque no sea como Coré, y como su séquito; según se lo dijo Jehová por mano de Moisés.

verses.KJV: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the Lord.
verses.WEB: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed the LORD’s people!”
verses.ASV: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia seguinte toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel murmurou contra Moisés e Arão, dizendo: Vós haveis matado ao povo do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El día siguiente toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel murmuró contra Moisés y Aarón, diciendo: Vosotros habéis muerto al pueblo de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.WEB: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and the LORD’s glory appeared.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tent of meeting: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Jehovah appeared.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando se juntou a congregação contra Moisés e Arão, olharam até o tabernáculo do testemunho, e eis que a nuvem o havia coberto, e apareceu a glória do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, como se juntó la congregación contra Moisés y Aarón, miraron hacia el tabernáculo del testimonio, y he aquí la nube lo había cubierto, y apareció la gloria de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram Moisés e Arão diante do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron Moisés y Aarón delante del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.WEB: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
verses.ASV: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apartai-vos do meio desta congregação, e os consumirei em um momento. E eles se lançaram sobre seus rostos.
verses.RVR09: Apartaos de en medio de esta congregación, y consumirélos en un momento. Y ellos se echaron sobre sus rostros.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the Lord; the plague is begun.
verses.WEB: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from the LORD! The plague has begun.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take thy censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and lay incense thereon, and carry it quickly unto the congregation, and make atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from Jehovah; the plague is begun.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moisés A Arão: Toma o incensário, e põe nele fogo do altar, e sobre ele põe incenso, e vai logo à congregação, e faze expiação por eles; porque o furor saiu de diante da face do SENHOR: a mortandade começou.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moisés á Aarón: Toma el incensario, y pon en él fuego del altar, y sobre él pon perfume, y ve presto á la congregación, y haz expiación por ellos; porque el furor ha salido de delante de la faz de Jehová: la mortandad ha comenzado.

verses.KJV: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.WEB: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.
verses.ASV: And Aaron took as Moses spake, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomou Arão o incensário, como Moisés disse, e correu em meio da congregação: e eis que a mortandade havia começado no povo: e ele pôs incenso, e fez expiação pelo povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces tomó Aarón el incensario, como Moisés dijo, y corrió en medio de la congregación: y he aquí que la mortandad había comenzado en el pueblo: y él puso perfume, é hizo expiación por el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.WEB: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.ASV: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs-se entre os mortos e os vivos, e cessou a mortandade.
verses.RVR09: Y púsose entre los muertos y los vivos; y cesó la mortandad.

verses.KJV: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.WEB: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.
verses.ASV: Now they that died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que morreram naquela mortandade foram catorze mil e setecentos, sem os mortos pelo negócio de Coré.
verses.RVR09: Y los que murieron en aquella mortandad fueron catorce mil y setecientos, sin los muertos por el negocio de Coré.

verses.KJV: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
verses.WEB: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.
verses.ASV: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the plague was stayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois se voltou Arão a Moisés à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, quando a mortandade havia cessado.
verses.RVR09: Después se volvió Aarón á Moisés á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, cuando la mortandad había cesado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
