verses.WEB: Israel vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”
verses.ASV: And Israel vowed a vow unto Jehovah, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Israel fez voto ao SENHOR, e disse: Se com efeito entregares a este povo em minha mão, eu destruirei suas cidades.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Israel hizo voto á Jehová, y dijo: Si en efecto entregares á este pueblo en mi mano, yo destruiré sus ciudades.

verses.KJV: And the Lord hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.WEB: The LORD listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and the name of the place was called Hormah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR escutou a voz de Israel, e entregou aos cananeus, e destruiu-os a eles e a suas cidades; e chamou o nome daquele lugar Hormá.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová escuchó la voz de Israel, y entregó al Cananeo, y destruyólos á ellos y á sus ciudades; y llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Horma.

verses.KJV: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiram do monte de Hor, caminho do mar Vermelho, para rodear a terra de Edom; e abateu-se o ânimo do povo pelo caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y partieron del monte de Hor, camino del mar Bermejo, para rodear la tierra de Edom; y abatióse el ánimo del pueblo por el camino.

verses.KJV: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.WEB: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”
verses.ASV: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, and there is no water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o povo contra Deus e Moisés: Por que nos fizeste subir do Egito para que morrêssemos neste deserto? que nem há pão, nem água, e nossa alma tem ódio deste pão tão miserável.
verses.RVR09: Y habló el pueblo contra Dios y Moisés: ¿Por qué nos hiciste subir de Egipto para que muramos en este desierto? que ni hay pan, ni agua, y nuestra alma tiene fastidio de este pan tan liviano.

verses.KJV: And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verses.WEB: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR enviou entre o povo serpentes ardentes, que mordiam ao povo: e morreu muito povo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová envió entre el pueblo serpientes ardientes, que mordían al pueblo: y murió mucho pueblo de Israel.

verses.KJV: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord, and against thee; pray unto the Lord, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.WEB: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.
verses.ASV: And the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, because we have spoken against Jehovah, and against thee; pray unto Jehovah, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o povo veio a Moisés, e disseram: Pecado temos por haver falado contra o SENHOR, e contra ti: roga ao SENHOR que tire de nós estas serpentes. E Moisés orou pelo povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pueblo vino á Moisés, y dijeron: Pecado hemos por haber hablado contra Jehová, y contra ti: ruega á Jehová que quite de nosotros estas serpientes. Y Moisés oró por el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a standard: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he seeth it, shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Faze-te uma serpente ardente, e põe-a sobre a haste: e será que qualquer um que for mordido e olhar a ela, viverá.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Hazte una serpiente ardiente, y ponla sobre la bandera: y será que cualquiera que fuere mordido y mirare á ella, vivirá.

verses.KJV: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.WEB: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.
verses.ASV: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and set it upon the standard: and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked unto the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés fez uma serpente de bronze, e a pôs sobre a haste, e foi, que quando alguma serpente mordia a algum, olhava à serpente de bronze, e vivia.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés hizo una serpiente de metal, y púsola sobre la bandera: y fué, que cuando alguna serpiente mordía á alguno, miraba á la serpiente de metal, y vivía.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in Oboth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiram os filhos de Israel, e assentaram acampamento em Obote.
verses.RVR09: Y partieron los hijos de Israel, y asentaron campo en Oboth.

verses.KJV: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped at Iye-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Obote, assentaram em Ijé-Abarim, no deserto que está diante de Moabe, ao oriente.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Oboth, asentaron en Ije-abarim, en el desierto que está delante de Moab, al nacimiento del sol.

verses.KJV: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
verses.WEB: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
verses.ASV: From thence they journeyed, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Partidos dali, assentaram no vale de Zerede.
verses.RVR09: Partidos de allí, asentaron en la arroyada de Zared.

verses.KJV: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.WEB: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.ASV: From thence they journeyed, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness, that cometh out of the border of the Amorites: for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.ALMEIDA: De ali moveram, e assentaram da outra parte de Arnom, que está no deserto, e que sai do termo dos amorreus; porque Arnom é termo de Moabe, entre Moabe e os amorreus.
verses.RVR09: De allí movieron, y asentaron de la otra parte de Arnón, que está en el desierto, y que sale del término del Amorrheo; porque Arnón es término de Moab, entre Moab y el Amorrheo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
verses.WEB: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of the LORD, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,
verses.ASV: Wherefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Jehovah, Vaheb in Suphah, And the valleys of the Arnon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso se diz no livro das batalhas do SENHOR: Vaebe em Sufa, e nos ribeiros de Arnom:
verses.RVR09: Por tanto se dice en el libro de las batallas de Jehová: Lo que hizo en el mar Bermejo, y en los arroyos de Arnón:

verses.KJV: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
verses.WEB: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”
verses.ASV: And the slope of the valleys That inclineth toward the dwelling of Ar, And leaneth upon the border of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à corrente dos ribeiros que vai a parar em Ar, e descansa no termo de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Y á la corriente de los arroyos que va á parar en Ar, y descansa en el término de Moab.

verses.KJV: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the Lord spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.WEB: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
verses.ASV: And from thence [they journeyed] to Beer: that is the well whereof Jehovah said unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali vieram a Beer: este é o poço do qual o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Junta ao povo, e lhes darei água.
verses.RVR09: Y de allí vinieron á Beer: este es el pozo del cual Jehová dijo á Moisés: Junta el pueblo, y les daré agua.

verses.KJV: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
verses.WEB: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,
verses.ASV: Then sang Israel this song: Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então cantou Israel esta canção: Sobe, ó poço; a ele cantai:
verses.RVR09: Entonces cantó Israel esta canción: Sube, oh pozo; á él cantad:

verses.KJV: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
verses.WEB: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;
verses.ASV: The well, which the princes digged, Which the nobles of the people delved, With the sceptre, [and] with their staves. And from the wilderness [they journeyed] to Mattanah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Poço, o qual cavaram os senhores; Cavaram-no os príncipes do povo, E o legislador, com seus bordões. E do deserto [partiram] para Matana.
verses.RVR09: Pozo, el cual cavaron los señores; caváronlo los príncipes del pueblo, y el legislador, con sus bordones. Y del desierto vinieron á Mathana:

verses.KJV: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
verses.WEB: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;
verses.ASV: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Mataná a Naaliel: e de Naaliel a Bamote:
verses.RVR09: Y de Mathana á Nahaliel: y de Nahaliel á Bamoth:

verses.KJV: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.WEB: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.
verses.ASV: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh down upon the desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Bamote ao vale que está nos campos de Moabe, e ao cume de Pisga, que está voltado a Jesimom.
verses.RVR09: Y de Bamoth al valle que está en los campos de Moab, y á la cumbre de Pisga, que mira á Jesimón.

verses.KJV: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.WEB: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.ASV: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Israel embaixadores a Seom, rei dos amorreus, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y envió Israel embajadores á Sehón, rey de los Amorrheos, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.
verses.WEB: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”
verses.ASV: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn aside into field, or into vineyard; we will not drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed thy border.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deixa-me passar por tua terra: não nos desviaremos pelos campos, nem pelas vinhas; não beberemos as águas dos poços; pelo caminho real iremos, até que passemos os teus termos.
verses.RVR09: Pasaré por tu tierra: no nos apartaremos por los labrados, ni por las viñas; no beberemos las aguas de los pozos: por el camino real iremos, hasta que pasemos tu término.

verses.KJV: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.WEB: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.
verses.ASV: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz; and he fought against Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Seom não deixou passar a Israel por seus termos: antes juntou Seom todo seu povo, e saiu contra Israel no deserto: e veio a Jaza, e lutou contra Israel.
verses.RVR09: Mas Sehón no dejó pasar á Israel por su término: antes juntó Sehón todo su pueblo, y salió contra Israel en el desierto: y vino á Jahaz, y peleó contra Israel.

verses.KJV: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.WEB: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.
verses.ASV: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon unto the Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Israel o feriu a fio de espada, e tomou sua terra desde Arnom até Jaboque, até os filhos de Amom: porque o termo dos filhos de Amom era forte.
verses.RVR09: E hirióle Israel á filo de espada, y tomó su tierra desde Arnón hasta Jaboc, hasta los hijos de Ammón: porque el término de los hijos de Ammón era fuerte.

verses.KJV: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
verses.WEB: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
verses.ASV: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the towns thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Israel todas estas cidades: e habitou Israel em todas as cidades dos amorreus, em Hesbom e em todas suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Israel todas estas ciudades: y habitó Israel en todas las ciudades del Amorrheo, en Hesbón y en todas sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
verses.WEB: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.
verses.ASV: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto the Arnon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Hesbom era a cidade de Seom, rei dos amorreus; o qual havia tido guerra antes com o rei de Moabe, e tomado de seu poder toda a sua terra até Arnom.
verses.RVR09: Porque Hesbón era la ciudad de Sehón, rey de los Amorrheos; el cual había tenido guerra antes con el rey de Moab, y tomado de su poder toda su tierra hasta Arnón.

verses.KJV: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
verses.WEB: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;
verses.ASV: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come ye to Heshbon; Let the city of Sihon be built and established:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, dizem os proverbistas: Vinde a Hesbom, Edifique-se e repare-se a cidade de Seom:
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, dicen los proverbistas: Venid á Hesbón, edifíquese y repárese la ciudad de Sehón:

verses.KJV: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.WEB: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
verses.ASV: For a fire is gone out of Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon: It hath devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que fogo saiu de Hesbom, E chama da cidade de Seom, E consumiu a Ar de Moabe, aos senhores dos altos de Arnom.
verses.RVR09: Que fuego salió de Hesbón, y llama de la ciudad de Sehón, y consumió á Ar de Moab, á los señores de los altos de Arnón.

verses.KJV: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.WEB: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.ASV: Woe to thee, Moab! Thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: He hath given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, Unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de ti, Moabe! Pereceste, povo de Camos: Pôs seus filhos em fuga, E suas filhas em cativeiro, por Seom rei dos amorreus.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de ti, Moab! Perecido has, pueblo de Chêmos: puso sus hijos en huída, y sus hijas en cautividad, por Sehón rey de los Amorrheos.

verses.KJV: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
verses.WEB: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”
verses.ASV: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, And we have laid waste even unto Nophah, Which [reacheth] unto Medeba.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas devastamos o reino deles; pereceu Hesbom até Dibom, E destruímos até Nofá e Medeba.
verses.RVR09: Mas devastamos el reino de ellos; pereció Hesbón hasta Dibón, y destruimos hasta Nopha y Medeba.

verses.KJV: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.WEB: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
verses.ASV: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim habitou Israel na terra dos amorreus.
verses.RVR09: Así habitó Israel en la tierra del Amorrheo.

verses.KJV: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
verses.WEB: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
verses.ASV: And Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they took the towns thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Moisés a reconhecer a Jazer; e tomaram suas aldeias, e expulsaram aos amorreus que estavam ali.
verses.RVR09: Y envió Moisés á reconocer á Jazer; y tomaron sus aldeas, y echaron al Amorrheo que estaba allí.

verses.KJV: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and og the king of bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at edrei.
verses.WEB: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.ASV: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltaram, e subiram caminho de Basã. E Ogue, rei de Basã, ele e todo o seu povo, saíram contra eles, para lutar em Edrei.
verses.RVR09: Y volvieron, y subieron camino de Basán, y salió contra ellos Og rey de Basán, él y todo su pueblo, para pelear en Edrei.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Não tenhas medo dele, que em tua mão o dei, a o e a todo seu povo, e a sua terra; e farás dele como fizeste de Seom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Moisés: No le tengas miedo, que en tu mano lo he dado, á él y á todo su pueblo, y á su tierra; y harás de él como hiciste de Sehón, rey de los Amorrheos, que habitaba en Hesbón.

verses.KJV: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
verses.WEB: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.
verses.ASV: So they smote him, and his sons and all his people, until there was none left him remaining: and they possessed his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E feriram a ele, e a seus filhos, e a toda sua gente, sem que lhe restasse um, e possuíram sua terra.
verses.RVR09: E hirieron á él, y á sus hijos, y á toda su gente, sin que le quedara uno, y poseyeron su tierra.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois os filhos de Israel partiram, e se assentaram nos campos de Moabe, desta parte do Jordão de Jericó.
verses.RVR09: Y MOVIERON los hijos de Israel, y asentaron en los campos de Moab, de esta parte del Jordán de Jericó.

verses.KJV: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.WEB: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.ASV: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu Balaque, filho de Zipor, tudo o que Israel havia feito aos amorreus.
verses.RVR09: Y vió Balac, hijo de Zippor, todo lo que Israel había hecho al Amorrheo.

verses.KJV: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moabe temeu muito por causa do povo que era muito; e angustiou-se Moabe por causa dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Moab temió mucho á causa del pueblo que era mucho; y angustióse Moab á causa de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.WEB: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
verses.ASV: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now will this multitude lick up all that is round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Moabe aos anciãos de Midiã: Agora lamberá esta gente todos nossos entornos, como lambe o boi a grama do campo. E Balaque, filho de Zipor, era então rei de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Moab á los ancianos de Madián: Ahora lamerá esta gente todos nuestros contornos, como lame el buey la grama del campo. Y Balac, hijo de Zippor, era entonces rey de Moab.

verses.KJV: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
verses.WEB: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
verses.ASV: And he sent messengers unto Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto enviou mensageiros a Balaão filho de Beor, a Petor, que está junto ao rio na terra dos filhos de seu povo, para que o chamassem, dizendo: Um povo saiu do Egito, e eis que cobre a face da terra, e habita diante de mim:
verses.RVR09: Por tanto envió mensajeros á Balaam hijo de Beor, á Pethor, que está junto al río en la tierra de los hijos de su pueblo, para que lo llamasen, diciendo: Un pueblo ha salido de Egipto, y he aquí cubre la haz de la tierra, y habita delante de mí:

verses.KJV: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.WEB: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”
verses.ASV: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vem pois agora, te rogo, amaldiçoa para mim este povo, porque é mais forte que eu: talvez poderei eu feri-lo, e lançá-lo da terra: que eu sei que o que tu abençoares, será bendito, e o que tu amaldiçoares, será maldito.
verses.RVR09: Ven pues ahora, te ruego, maldíceme este pueblo, porque es más fuerte que yo: quizá podré yo herirlo, y echarlo de la tierra: que yo sé que el que tú bendijeres, será bendito, y el que tú maldijeres, será maldito.

verses.KJV: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.WEB: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.
verses.ASV: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram os anciãos de Moabe e os anciãos de Midiã, com o [pagamento pela] adivinhação em sua mão, e chegaram a Balaão, e lhe disseram as palavras de Balaque.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron los ancianos de Moab, y los ancianos de Madián, con las dádivas de adivinación en su mano, y llegaron á Balaam, y le dijeron las palabras de Balac.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the Lord shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Jehovah shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Repousai aqui esta noite, e eu vos referirei as palavras, como o SENHOR me falar. Assim os príncipes de Moabe se restaram com Balaão.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Reposad aquí esta noche, y yo os referiré las palabras, como Jehová me hablare. Así los príncipes de Moab se quedaron con Balaam.

verses.KJV: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
verses.WEB: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”
verses.ASV: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Deus a Balaão, e disse-lhe: Que homens são estes que estão contigo?
verses.RVR09: Y vino Dios á Balaam, y díjole: ¿Qué varones son estos que están contigo?

verses.KJV: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,
verses.ASV: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, [saying],
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaão respondeu a Deus: Balaque filho de Zipor, rei de Moabe, enviou a mim dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Balaam respondió á Dios: Balac hijo de Zippor, rey de Moab, ha enviado á mí diciendo:

verses.KJV: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.WEB: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”
verses.ASV: Behold, the people that is come out of Egypt, it covereth the face of the earth: now, come curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que este povo que saiu do Egito, cobre a face da terra: vem pois agora, e amaldiçoa-o para mim; talvez poderei lutar com ele, e expulsá-lo.
verses.RVR09: He aquí este pueblo que ha salido de Egipto, cubre la haz de la tierra: ven pues ahora, y maldícemelo; quizá podré pelear con él, y echarlo.

verses.KJV: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
verses.WEB: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”
verses.ASV: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people; for they are blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Deus a Balaão: Não vás com eles, nem amaldiçoes ao povo; porque é bendito.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Dios á Balaam: No vayas con ellos, ni maldigas al pueblo; porque es bendito.

verses.KJV: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the Lord refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.WEB: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for the LORD refuses to permit me to go with you.”
verses.ASV: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land; for Jehovah refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Balaão se levantou pela manhã, e disse aos príncipes de Balaque: Voltai-vos à vossa terra, porque o SENHOR não me quer deixar ir convosco.
verses.RVR09: Así Balaam se levantó por la mañana, y dijo á los príncipes de Balac: Volveos á vuestra tierra, porque Jehová no me quiere dejar ir con vosotros.

verses.KJV: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.WEB: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”
verses.ASV: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os príncipes de Moabe se levantaram, e vieram a Balaque, e disseram: Balaão não quis vir conosco.
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes de Moab se levantaron, y vinieron á Balac, y dijeron: Balaam no quiso venir con nosotros.

verses.KJV: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
verses.WEB: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.
verses.ASV: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honorable than they.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou Balaque a enviar outra vez mais príncipes, e mais nobres que os outros.
verses.RVR09: Y tornó Balac á enviar otra vez más príncipes, y más honorables que los otros.

verses.KJV: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
verses.WEB: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
verses.ASV: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais vieram a Balaão, e disseram-lhe: Assim diz Balaque, filho de Zipor: Rogo-te que não deixes de vir a mim:
verses.RVR09: Los cuales vinieron á Balaam, y dijéronle: Así dice Balac, hijo de Zippor: Ruégote que no dejes de venir á mí:

verses.KJV: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.WEB: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”
verses.ASV: for I will promote thee unto very great honor, and whatsoever thou sayest unto me I will do: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sem dúvida te honrarei muito, e farei tudo o que me disseres: vem pois agora, almaldiçoa para mim a este povo.
verses.RVR09: Porque sin duda te honraré mucho, y haré todo lo que me dijeres: ven pues ahora, maldíceme á este pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more.
verses.WEB: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
verses.ASV: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Jehovah my God, to do less or more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaão respondeu, e disse aos servos de Balaque: Ainda que Balaque me desse sua casa cheia de prata e ouro, não posso transgredir a palavra do SENHOR meu Deus, para fazer coisa pequena nem grande.
verses.RVR09: Y Balaam respondió, y dijo á los siervos de Balac: Aunque Balac me diese su casa llena de plata y oro, no puedo traspasar la palabra de Jehová mi Dios, para hacer cosa chica ni grande.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will say unto me more.
verses.WEB: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what Jehovah will speak unto me more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo-vos, portanto, agora, que repouseis aqui esta noite, para que eu saiba que me volta a dizer o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ruégoos por tanto ahora, que reposéis aquí esta noche, para que yo sepa qué me vuelve á decir Jehová.

verses.KJV: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.WEB: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”
verses.ASV: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men are come to call thee, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Deus a Balaão de noite, e disse-lhe: Se homens vierem a te chamar, levanta-te e vai com eles: porém farás o que eu te disser.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Dios á Balaam de noche, y díjole: Si vinieren á llamarte hombres, levántate y ve con ellos: empero harás lo que yo te dijere.

verses.KJV: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.WEB: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.ASV: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Balaão se levantou pela manhã, e preparou sua jumenta, e foi com os príncipes de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Así Balaam se levantó por la mañana, y cinchó su asna, y fué con los príncipes de Moab.

verses.KJV: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the Lord stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
verses.WEB: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
verses.ASV: And God’s anger was kindled because he went; and the angel of Jehovah placed himself in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o furor de Deus se acendeu porque ele ia; e o anjo do SENHOR se pôs no caminho por adversário seu. Ia, pois, ele montado sobre sua jumenta, e com ele dois servos seus.
verses.RVR09: Y el furor de Dios se encendió porque él iba; y el ángel de Jehová se puso en el camino por adversario suyo. Iba, pues, él montado sobre su asna, y con él dos mozos suyos.

verses.KJV: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.WEB: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.
verses.ASV: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a jumenta viu o anjo do SENHOR, que estava no caminho com sua espada exposta em sua mão; então a jumenta desviou-se do caminho, e foi pelo campo. Em seguida, Balaão espancou a jumenta para fazê-la voltar ao caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y el asna vió al ángel de Jehová, que estaba en el camino con su espada desnuda en su mano; y apartóse el asna del camino, é iba por el campo. Entonces hirió Balaam al asna para hacerla volver al camino.

verses.KJV: But the angel of the Lord stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.ASV: Then the angel of Jehovah stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o anjo do SENHOR se pôs em uma vereda de vinhas que tinha parede de uma parte e parede de outra.
verses.RVR09: Mas el ángel de Jehová se puso en una senda de viñas que tenía pared de una parte y pared de otra.

verses.KJV: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.WEB: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.
verses.ASV: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah, and she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando a jumenta viu o anjo do SENHOR, apegou-se à parede, e apertou contra a parede o pé de Balaão: e ele voltou a espancá-la.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo el asna al ángel de Jehová, pegóse á la pared, y apretó contra la pared el pie de Balaam: y él volvió á herirla.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo do SENHOR passou mais ali, e pôs-se em um lugar estreito, onde não havia caminho para desviar-se nem à direita nem à esquerda.
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel de Jehová pasó más allá, y púsose en una angostura, donde no había camino para apartarse ni á diestra ni á siniestra.

verses.KJV: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.WEB: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
verses.ASV: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah, and she lay down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with his staff.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo a jumenta ao anjo do SENHOR, lançou-se debaixo de Balaão: e irou-se Balaão, e feriu à jumenta com um bordão.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo el asna al ángel de Jehová, echóse debajo de Balaam: y enojóse Balaam, é hirió al asna con el palo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.WEB: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR abriu a boca da jumenta, a qual disse a Balaão: Que te fiz, que me feriste estas três vezes?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová abrió la boca al asna, la cual dijo á Balaam: ¿Qué te he hecho, que me has herido estas tres veces?

verses.KJV: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
verses.WEB: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”
verses.ASV: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in my hand, for now I had killed thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaão respondeu à jumenta: Porque te zombaste de mim: bom seria se eu tivesse espada em minha mão, que agora te mataria!
verses.RVR09: Y Balaam respondió al asna: Porque te has burlado de mí: ¡ojalá tuviera espada en mi mano, que ahora te mataría!

verses.KJV: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? and he said, Nay.
verses.WEB: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”
verses.ASV: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden all thy life long unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? and he said, Nay.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a jumenta disse a Balaão: Não sou eu tua jumenta? Sobre mim montaste desde que tu me tens até hoje; costumei a fazê-lo assim contigo? E ele respondeu: Não.
verses.RVR09: Y el asna dijo á Balaam: ¿No soy yo tu asna? sobre mí has cabalgado desde que tú me tienes hasta este día; ¿he acostumbrado á hacerlo así contigo? Y él respondió: No.

verses.KJV: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.
verses.ASV: Then Jehovah opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Jehovah standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR abriu os olhos a Balaão, e viu ao anjo do SENHOR que estava no caminho, e tinha sua espada nua em sua mão. E Balaão fez reverência, e inclinou-se sobre seu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová abrió los ojos á Balaam, y vió al ángel de Jehová que estaba en el camino, y tenía su espada desnuda en su mano. Y Balaam hizo reverencia, é inclinóse sobre su rostro.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I am come forth for an adversary, because thy way is perverse before me:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo do SENHOR lhe disse: Por que feriste tua jumenta estas três vezes? eis que eu saí para me opor a ti, porque teu caminho é perverso diante de mim:
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel de Jehová le dijo: ¿Por qué has herido tu asna estas tres veces? he aquí yo he salido para contrarrestarte, porque tu camino es perverso delante de mí:

verses.KJV: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.WEB: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”
verses.ASV: and the ass saw me, and turned aside before me these three times: unless she had turned aside from me, surely now I had even slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: A jumenta me viu, e afastou-se logo de diante de mim estas três vezes: e se de mim não se houvesse afastado, eu também agora mataria a ti, e a ela deixaria viva.
verses.RVR09: El asna me ha visto, y hase apartado luego de delante de mí estas tres veces: y si de mí no se hubiera apartado, yo también ahora te mataría á ti, y á ella dejaría viva.

verses.KJV: And Balaam said unto the angel of the Lord, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.WEB: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”
verses.ASV: And Balaam said unto the angel of Jehovah, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Balaão disse ao anjo do SENHOR: Pequei, que não sabia que tu te punhas diante de mim no caminho: mas agora, se te parece mal, eu me voltarei.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Balaam dijo al ángel de Jehová: He pecado, que no sabía que tú te ponías delante de mí en el camino: mas ahora, si te parece mal, yo me volveré.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto Balaam, Go with the men; but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo do SENHOR disse a Balaão: Vai com esses homens: porém a palavra que eu te disser, essa falarás. Assim Balaão foi com os príncipes de Balaque.
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel de Jehová dijo á Balaam: Ve con esos hombres: empero la palabra que yo te dijere, esa hablarás. Así Balaam fué con los príncipes de Balac.

verses.KJV: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
verses.WEB: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.
verses.ASV: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo Balaque que Balaão vinha, saiu a recebê-lo à cidade de Moabe, que está junto ao termo de Arnom, que é a extremidade das fronteiras.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo Balac que Balaam venía, salió á recibirlo á la ciudad de Moab, que está junto al término de Arnón, que es el cabo de los confines.

verses.KJV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.WEB: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”
verses.ASV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honor?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaque disse a Balaão: Não enviei eu a ti a chamar-te? por que não vieste a mim? não posso eu te honrar?
verses.RVR09: Y Balac dijo á Balaam: ¿No envié yo á ti á llamarte? ¿por qué no has venido á mí? ¿no puedo yo honrarte?

verses.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”
verses.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to speak anything? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaão respondeu a Balaque: Eis que eu vim a ti: mas poderei agora falar alguma coisa? A palavra que Deus puser em minha boca, essa falarei.
verses.RVR09: Y Balaam respondió á Balac: He aquí yo he venido á ti: mas ¿podré ahora hablar alguna cosa? La palabra que Dios pusiere en mi boca, esa hablaré.

verses.KJV: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
verses.WEB: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.
verses.ASV: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kiriath-huzoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi Balaão com Balaque, e vieram à Quiriate-Huzote.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Balaam con Balac, y vinieron á la ciudad de Husoth.

verses.KJV: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
verses.WEB: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.
verses.ASV: And Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaque fez matar bois e ovelhas, e enviou a Balaão, e aos príncipes que estavam com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Balac hizo matar bueyes y ovejas, y envió á Balaam, y á los príncipes que estaban con él.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
verses.WEB: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from thence the utmost part of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia seguinte Balaque tomou a Balaão, e o fez subir aos lugares altos de Baal, e desde ali viu a extremidade do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y el día siguiente Balac tomó á Balaam, é hízolo subir á los altos de Baal, y desde allí vió la extremidad del pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
verses.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaão disse a Balaque: Edifica para mim aqui sete altares, e prepara-me aqui sete bezerros e sete carneiros.
verses.RVR09: Y BALAAM dijo á Balac: Edifícame aquí siete altares, y prepárame aquí siete becerros y siete carneros.

verses.KJV: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.WEB: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.
verses.ASV: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaque fez como lhe disse Balaão: e ofereceram Balaque e Balaão um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.
verses.RVR09: Y Balac hizo como le dijo Balaam: y ofrecieron Balac y Balaam un becerro y un carnero en cada altar.

verses.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the Lord will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
verses.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.
verses.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt-offering, and I will go: peradventure Jehovah will come to meet me; and whatsoever he showeth me I will tell thee. And he went to a bare height.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaão disse a Balaque: Põe-te junto a teu holocausto, e eu irei: talvez o SENHOR me virá ao encontro, e qualquer um coisa que me mostrar, eu a contarei a ti. E assim se foi só.
verses.RVR09: Y Balaam dijo á Balac: Ponte junto á tu holocausto, y yo iré: quizá Jehová me vendrá al encuentro, y cualquiera cosa que me mostrare, te la noticiaré. Y así se fué solo.

verses.KJV: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.WEB: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”
verses.ASV: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Deus ao encontro de Balaão, e este lhe disse: Sete altares ordenei, e em cada altar ofereci um bezerro e um carneiro.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Dios al encuentro de Balaam, y éste le dijo: Siete altares he ordenado, y en cada altar he ofrecido un becerro y un carnero.

verses.KJV: And the Lord put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.WEB: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR pôs palavra na boca de Balaão, e disse-lhe: Volta a Balaque, e hás de falar assim.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová puso palabra en la boca de Balaam, y díjole: Vuelve á Balac, y has de hablar así.

verses.KJV: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.WEB: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.ASV: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he was standing by his burnt-offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a ele, e eis que estava ele junto a seu holocausto, ele e todos os príncipes de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á él, y he aquí estaba él junto á su holocausto, él y todos los príncipes de Moab.

verses.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
verses.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.
verses.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, From Aram hath Balak brought me, The king of Moab from the mountains of the East: Come, curse me Jacob, And come, defy Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele tomou sua parábola, e disse: De Arã me trouxe Balaque, rei de Moabe, dos montes do oriente: Vem, amaldiçoa para mim a Jacó; E vem, condena a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y él tomó su parábola, y dijo: De Aram me trajo Balac, rey de Moab, de los montes del oriente: ven, maldíceme á Jacob; y ven, execra á Israel.

verses.KJV: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the Lord hath not defied?
verses.WEB: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?
verses.ASV: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? And how shall I defy, whom Jehovah hath not defied?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que amaldiçoarei eu ao que Deus não amaldiçoou? E por que condenarei ao que o SENHOR não condenou?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué maldeciré yo al que Dios no maldijo? ¿y por qué he de execrar al que Jehová no ha execrado?

verses.KJV: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.WEB: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.
verses.ASV: For from the top of the rocks I see him, And from the hills I behold him: Lo, it is a people that dwelleth alone, And shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque do cume das penhas o verei, E desde as colinas o olharei: Eis aqui um povo que habitará confiante, e não será contado entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Porque de la cumbre de las peñas lo veré, y desde los collados lo miraré: he aquí un pueblo que habitará confiado, y no será contado entre las gentes.

verses.KJV: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.WEB: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”
verses.ASV: Who can count the dust of Jacob, Or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, And let my last end be like his!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem contará o pó de Jacó, Ou o número da quarta parte de Israel? Morra minha pessoa da morte dos corretos, E meu fim seja como o seu.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién contará el polvo de Jacob, o el número de la cuarta parte de Israel? Muera mi persona de la muerte de los rectos, y mi postrimería sea como la suya.

verses.KJV: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
verses.WEB: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”
verses.ASV: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Balaque disse a Balaão: Que me fizeste? Tomei-te para que amaldiçoes a meus inimigos, e eis que proferiste bênçãos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Balac dijo á Balaam: ¿Qué me has hecho? hete tomado para que maldigas á mis enemigos, y he aquí has proferido bendiciones.

verses.KJV: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord hath put in my mouth?
verses.WEB: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”
verses.ASV: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Jehovah putteth in my mouth?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu, e disse: Não observarei eu o que o SENHOR puser em minha boca para dizê-lo?
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió, y dijo: ¿No observaré yo lo que Jehová pusiere en mi boca para decirlo?

verses.KJV: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.WEB: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”
verses.ASV: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them; thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Balaque: Rogo-te que venhas comigo a outro lugar desde o qual o vejas; sua extremidade somente verás, que não o verás todo; e desde ali me o amaldiçoarás.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Balac: Ruégote que vengas conmigo á otro lugar desde el cual lo veas; su extremidad solamente verás, que no lo verás todo; y desde allí me lo maldecirás.

verses.KJV: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.WEB: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
verses.ASV: And he took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levou-o ao campo de Zofim, ao cume de Pisga, e edificou sete altares, e ofereceu um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.
verses.RVR09: Y llevólo al campo de Sophim, á la cumbre de Pisga, y edificó siete altares, y ofreció un becerro y un carnero en cada altar.

verses.KJV: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the Lord yonder.
verses.WEB: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt-offering, while I meet [Jehovah] yonder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele disse a Balaque: Põe-te aqui junto a teu holocausto, e eu irei a encontrar a Deus ali.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él dijo á Balac: Ponte aquí junto á tu holocausto, y yo iré á encontrar á Dios allí.

verses.KJV: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.WEB: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus shalt thou speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR saiu ao encontro de Balaão, e pôs palavra em sua boca, e disse-lhe: Volta a Balaque, e assim dirás.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová salió al encuentro de Balaam, y puso palabra en su boca, y díjole: Vuelve á Balac, y así has de decir.

verses.KJV: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the Lord spoken?
verses.WEB: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”
verses.ASV: And he came to him, and, lo, he was standing by his burnt-offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath Jehovah spoken?
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a ele, e eis que ele estava junto a seu holocausto, e com ele os príncipes de Moabe: e disse-lhe Balaque: Que disse o SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Y vino á él, y he aquí que él estaba junto á su holocausto, y con él los príncipes de Moab: y díjole Balac: ¿Qué ha dicho Jehová?

verses.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
verses.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; Hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele tomou sua parábola, e disse: Balaque, levanta-te e ouve; Escuta minhas palavras, filho de Zipor:
verses.RVR09: Entonces él tomó su parábola, y dijo: Balac, levántate y oye; escucha mis palabras, hijo de Zippor:

verses.KJV: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.WEB: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?
verses.ASV: God is not a man, that he should lie, Neither the son of man, that he should repent: Hath he said, and will he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and will he not make it good?
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus não é homem, para que minta; nem filho de homem para que se arrependa: ele disse, e não fará?; Falou, e não o executará?
verses.RVR09: Dios no es hombre, para que mienta; ni hijo de hombre para que se arrepienta: el dijo, ¿y no hará?; habló, ¿y no lo ejecutará?

verses.KJV: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have received [commandment] to bless: And he hath blessed, and I cannot reverse it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que, eu tomei bênção: E ele abençoou, e não poderei revogá-la.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo he tomado bendición: y él bendijo, y no podré revocarla.

verses.KJV: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
verses.WEB: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
verses.ASV: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob; Neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: Jehovah his God is with him, And the shout of a king is among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não notou iniquidade em Jacó, nem viu perversidade em Israel: o SENHOR seu Deus é com ele, E júbilo de rei nele.
verses.RVR09: No ha notado iniquidad en Jacob, ni ha visto perversidad en Israel: Jehová su Dios es con él, y júbilo de rey en él.

verses.KJV: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.WEB: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
verses.ASV: God bringeth them forth out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of the wild-ox.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus os tirou do Egito; Tem forças como de boi selvagem.
verses.RVR09: Dios los ha sacado de Egipto; tiene fuerzas como de unicornio.

verses.KJV: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
verses.WEB: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’
verses.ASV: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel: Now shall it be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em Jacó não há agouro, nem adivinhação em Israel: Como agora, será dito de Jacó e de Israel: O que fez Deus!
verses.RVR09: Porque en Jacob no hay agüero, ni adivinación en Israel: como ahora, será dicho de Jacob y de Israel: ¡Lo que ha hecho Dios!

verses.KJV: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.WEB: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”
verses.ASV: Behold, the people riseth up as a lioness, And as a lion doth he lift himself up: He shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, And drink the blood of the slain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o povo, que como leão se levantará, E como leão se erguerá: Não se deitará até que coma a presa, E beba o sangue dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí el pueblo, que como león se levantará, y como león se erguirá: no se echará hasta que coma la presa, y beba la sangre de los muertos.

verses.KJV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.WEB: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”
verses.ASV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Balaque disse a Balaão: Já que não o amaldiçoas, nem tampouco o abençoes.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Balac dijo á Balaam: Ya que no lo maldices, ni tampoco lo bendigas.

verses.KJV: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the Lord speaketh, that I must do?
verses.WEB: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”
verses.ASV: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that Jehovah speaketh, that I must do?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaão respondeu, e disse a Balaque: Não te disse que tudo o que o SENHOR me disser, aquilo tenho de fazer?
verses.RVR09: Y Balaam respondió, y dijo á Balac: ¿No te he dicho que todo lo que Jehová me dijere, aquello tengo de hacer?

verses.KJV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.WEB: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
verses.ASV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come now, I will take thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Balaque a Balaão: Rogo-te que venhas, te levarei a outro lugar; porventura comparecerá bem a Deus que desde ali me o amaldiçoes.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Balac á Balaam: Ruégote que vengas, te llevaré á otro lugar; por ventura parecerá bien á Dios que desde allí me lo maldigas.

verses.KJV: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward jeshimon.
verses.WEB: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
verses.ASV: And Balak took Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh down upon the desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaque levou a Balaão ao cume de Peor, que está voltado até Jesimom.
verses.RVR09: Y Balac llevó á Balaam á la cumbre de Peor, que mira hacia Jesimón.

verses.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
verses.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Balaão disse a Balaque: Edifica para mim aqui sete altares, e prepara-me aqui sete bezerros e sete carneiros.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Balaam dijo á Balac: Edifícame aquí siete altares, y prepárame aquí siete becerros y siete carneros.

verses.KJV: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.WEB: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
verses.ASV: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaque fez como Balaão lhe disse; e ofereceu um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.
verses.RVR09: Y Balac hizo como Balaam le dijo; y ofreció un becerro y un carnero en cada altar.

verses.KJV: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.WEB: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.ASV: And when Balaam saw that it pleased Jehovah to bless Israel, he went not, as at the other times, to meet with enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando viu Balaão que parecia bem ao SENHOR que o abençoasse a Israel, não foi, como a primeira e segunda vez, a encontro de agouros, mas sim que pôs seu rosto até o deserto;
verses.RVR09: Y COMO vió Balaam que parecía bien á Jehová que él bendijese á Israel, no fué, como la primera y segunda vez, á encuentro de agüeros, sino que puso su rostro hacia el desierto;

verses.KJV: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.WEB: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
verses.ASV: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando seus olhos, viu a Israel alojado por suas tribos; e o espírito de Deus veio sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y alzando sus ojos, vió á Israel alojado por sus tribus; y el espíritu de Dios vino sobre él.

verses.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
verses.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, And the man whose eye was closed saith;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomou sua parábola, e disse: Disse Balaão filho de Beor, E disse o homem de olhos abertos:
verses.RVR09: Entonces tomó su parábola, y dijo: Dijo Balaam hijo de Beor, y dijo el varón de ojos abiertos:

verses.KJV: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.WEB: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
verses.ASV: He saith, who heareth the words of God, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse o que ouviu os ditos de Deus, O que viu a visão do Todo-Poderoso; caído, mas abertos os olhos:
verses.RVR09: Dijo el que oyó los dichos de Dios, el que vió la visión del Omnipotente; caído, mas abiertos los ojos:

verses.KJV: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.WEB: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
verses.ASV: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, Thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quão belas são tuas tendas, ó Jacó, Tuas habitações, ó Israel!
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuán hermosas son tus tiendas, oh Jacob, tus habitaciones, oh Israel!

verses.KJV: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the Lord hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.WEB: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.ASV: As valleys are they spread forth, As gardens by the river-side, As lign-aloes which Jehovah hath planted, As cedar-trees beside the waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como ribeiros estão estendidas, Como jardins junto ao rio, Como aloés plantados pelo SENHOR, Como cedros junto às águas.
verses.RVR09: Como arroyos están extendidas, como huertos junto al río, como lináloes plantados por Jehová, como cedros junto á las aguas.

verses.KJV: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.WEB: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.ASV: Water shall flow from his buckets, And his seed shall be in many waters, And his king shall be higher than Agag, And his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: De suas mãos destilarão águas, E sua descendência será em muitas águas: E se levantará seu rei mais que Agague, E seu reino será exaltado.
verses.RVR09: De sus manos destilarán aguas, y su simiente será en muchas aguas: y ensalzarse ha su rey más que Agag, y su reino será ensalzado.
