verses.KJV: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
verses.WEB: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
verses.ASV: God bringeth him forth out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of the wild-ox: He shall eat up the nations his adversaries, And shall break their bones in pieces, And smite [them] through with his arrows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus o tirou do Egito; Tem forças como de boi selvagem: Comerá às nações suas inimigas, E esmiuçará seus ossos, E perfurará com suas flechas.
verses.RVR09: Dios lo sacó de Egipto; tiene fuerzas como de unicornio: comerá á las gentes sus enemigas, y desmenuzará sus huesos, y asaeteará con sus saetas.

verses.KJV: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
verses.WEB: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
verses.ASV: He couched, he lay down as a lion, And as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Blessed be every one that blesseth thee, And cursed be every one that curseth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se encurvará para deitar-se como leão, E como leoa; quem o despertará? Benditos os que te abençoarem, E malditos os que te amaldiçoarem.
verses.RVR09: Se encorvará para echarse como león, y como leona; ¿quién lo despertará? Benditos los que te bendijeren, y malditos los que te maldijeren.

verses.KJV: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
verses.WEB: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
verses.ASV: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together; and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se acendeu a ira de Balaque contra Balaão, e batendo suas palmas lhe disse: Para amaldiçoar a meus inimigos te chamei, e eis que os abençoaste insistentemente já três vezes.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se encendió la ira de Balac contra Balaam, y batiendo sus palmas le dijo: Para maldecir á mis enemigos te he llamado, y he aquí los has resueltamente bendecido ya tres veces.

verses.KJV: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the Lord hath kept thee back from honour.
verses.WEB: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”
verses.ASV: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honor; but, lo, Jehovah hath kept thee back from honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foge-te, portanto, agora a teu lugar: eu disse que te honraria, mas eis que o SENHOR te privou de honra.
verses.RVR09: Húyete, por tanto, ahora á tu lugar: yo dije que te honraría, mas he aquí que Jehová te ha privado de honra.

verses.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers that thou sentest unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Balaão lhe respondeu: Não o declarei eu também a teus mensageiros que me enviaste, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Balaam le respondió: ¿No lo declaré yo también á tus mensajeros que me enviaste, diciendo:

verses.KJV: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the Lord, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the Lord saith, that will I speak?
verses.WEB: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?
verses.ASV: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Jehovah, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; what Jehovah speaketh, that will I speak?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se Balaque me desse sua casa cheia de prata e ouro, eu não poderei transgredir o dito do SENHOR para fazer coisa boa nem má de minha vontade; mas o que o SENHOR falar, isso direi eu?
verses.RVR09: Si Balac me diese su casa llena de plata y oro, yo no podré traspasar el dicho de Jehová para hacer cosa buena ni mala de mi arbitrio; mas lo que Jehová hablare, eso diré yo?

verses.KJV: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.WEB: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”
verses.ASV: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come, [and] I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu me vou agora a meu povo: portanto, vem, te indicarei o que este povo há de fazer a teu povo nos últimos dias.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo me voy ahora á mi pueblo: por tanto, ven, te indicaré lo que este pueblo ha de hacer á tu pueblo en los postrimeros días.

verses.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
verses.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, And the man whose eye was closed saith;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou sua parábola, e disse: Disse Balaão filho de Beor, Disse o homem de olhos abertos:
verses.RVR09: Y tomó su parábola, y dijo: Dijo Balaam hijo de Beor, dijo el varón de ojos abiertos:

verses.KJV: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.WEB: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
verses.ASV: He saith, who heareth the words of God, And knoweth the knowledge of the Most High, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse o que ouviu os ditos do SENHOR, E o que sabe o conhecimento do Altíssimo, o que viu a visão do Todo-Poderoso; caído, mas abertos os olhos:
verses.RVR09: Dijo el que oyó los dichos de Jehová, y el que sabe la ciencia del Altísimo, el que vió la visión del Omnipotente; caído, mas abiertos los ojos:

verses.KJV: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
verses.WEB: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.
verses.ASV: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not nigh: There shall come forth a star out of Jacob, And a sceptre shall rise out of Israel, And shall smite through the corners of Moab, And break down all the sons of tumult.
verses.ALMEIDA: Verei, mas não agora: O olharei, mas não de perto: Sairá estrela de Jacó, E se levantará cetro de Israel, E ferirá os cantos de Moabe, E destruirá a todos os filhos de Sete.
verses.RVR09: Verélo, mas no ahora: lo miraré, mas no de cerca: saldrá ESTRELLA de Jacob, y levantaráse cetro de Israel, y herirá los cantones de Moab, y destruirá á todos los hijos de Seth.

verses.KJV: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.WEB: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
verses.ASV: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession, [who were] his enemies; While Israel doeth valiantly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será tomada Edom, Será também tomada Seir por seus inimigos, E Israel se portará corajosamente.
verses.RVR09: Y será tomada Edom, será también tomada Seir por sus enemigos, e Israel se portará varonilmente.

verses.KJV: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
verses.WEB: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
verses.ASV: And out of Jacob shall one have dominion, And shall destroy the remnant from the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o de Jacó será dominador, E destruirá da cidade o que restar.
verses.RVR09: Y el de Jacob se enseñoreará, y destruirá de la ciudad lo que quedare.

verses.KJV: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
verses.WEB: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”
verses.ASV: And he looked on Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; But his latter end shall come to destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo a Amaleque, tomou sua parábola, e disse: Amaleque, cabeça de nações; Mas seu fim perecerá para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo á Amalec, tomó su parábola, y dijo: Amalec, cabeza de gentes; mas su postrimería perecerá para siempre.

verses.KJV: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.WEB: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.
verses.ASV: And he looked on the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwelling-place, And thy nest is set in the rock.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo aos queneus, tomou sua parábola, e disse: Forte é tua habitação, Põe na rocha tua ninho:
verses.RVR09: Y viendo al Cineo, tomó su parábola, y dijo: Fuerte es tu habitación, pon en la peña tu nido:

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
verses.ASV: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, Until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que os queneus serão expulsos, Quando Assur te levará cativo.
verses.RVR09: Que el Cineo será echado, cuando Assur te llevará cautivo.

verses.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
verses.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
verses.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this?
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia tomou sua parábola, e disse: Ai! quem viverá quando fizer Deus estas coisas?
verses.RVR09: Todavía tomó su parábola, y dijo: ¡Ay! ¿quién vivirá cuando hiciere Dios estas cosas?

verses.KJV: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.WEB: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
verses.ASV: But ships [shall come] from the coast of Kittim, And they shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber; And he also shall come to destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: E virão navios da costa de Quitim, E afligirão a Assur, afligirão também a Éber: Mas ele também perecerá para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán navíos de la costa de Cittim, y afligirán á Assur, afligirán también á Eber: mas él también perecerá para siempre.

verses.KJV: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
verses.WEB: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
verses.ASV: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se levantou Balaão, e se foi, e voltou-se a seu lugar: e também Balaque se foi por seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se levantó Balaam, y se fué, y volvióse á su lugar: y también Balac se fué por su camino.

verses.KJV: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
verses.WEB: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;
verses.ASV: And Israel abode in Shittim; and the people began to play the harlot with the daughters of Moab:
verses.ALMEIDA: E repousou Israel em Sitim, e o povo começou a se prostituir com as filhas de Moabe:
verses.RVR09: Y REPOSÓ Israel en Sittim, y el pueblo empezó á fornicar con las hijas de Moab:

verses.KJV: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.WEB: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.
verses.ASV: for they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods; and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: As quais chamaram ao povo aos sacrifícios de seus deuses: e o povo comeu, e inclinou-se a seus deuses.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales llamaron al pueblo á los sacrificios de sus dioses: y el pueblo comió, é inclinóse á sus dioses.

verses.KJV: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.
verses.WEB: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.
verses.ASV: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E achegou-se o povo a Baal-Peor; e o furor do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y allegóse el pueblo á Baal-peor; y el furor de Jehová se encendió contra Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up unto Jehovah before the sun, that the fierce anger of Jehovah may turn away from Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Toma todos os príncipes do povo, e enforca-os ao SENHOR diante do sol; e a ira do furor do SENHOR se apartará de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Toma todos los príncipes del pueblo, y ahórcalos á Jehová delante del sol; y la ira del furor de Jehová se apartará de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
verses.WEB: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that have joined themselves unto Baal-peor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés disse aos juízes de Israel: Matai cada um àqueles dos seus que se recolheram a Baal-Peor.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés dijo á los jueces de Israel: Matad cada uno á aquellos de los suyos que se han allegado á Baal-peor.

verses.KJV: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um homem dos filhos de Israel veio e trouxe uma midianita a seus irmãos, à vista de Moisés e de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, chorando eles à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí un varón de los hijos de Israel vino y trajo una Madianita á sus hermanos, á ojos de Moisés y de toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, llorando ellos á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.WEB: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.
verses.ASV: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the midst of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: E viu-o Fineias, filho de Eleazar, filho de Arão o sacerdote, e levantou-se do meio da congregação, e tomou uma lança em sua mão:
verses.RVR09: Y viólo Phinees, hijo de Eleazar, hijo de Aarón el sacerdote, y levantóse de en medio de la congregación, y tomó una lanza en su mano:

verses.KJV: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: and he went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi atrás do homem de Israel à tenda, e perfurou com a lança a ambos, ao homem de Israel, e à mulher por seu ventre. E cessou a mortandade dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y fué tras el varón de Israel á la tienda, y alanceólos á ambos, al varón de Israel, y á la mujer por su vientre. Y cesó la mortandad de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: And those that died by the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreram daquela mortandade vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: Y murieron de aquella mortandad veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.WEB: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.ASV: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fineias, filho de Eleazar, filho de Arão o sacerdote, fez afastar meu furor dos filhos de Israel, levado de zelo entre eles: pelo qual eu não consumi em meu zelo aos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Phinees, hijo de Eleazar, hijo de Aarón el sacerdote, ha hecho tornar mi furor de los hijos de Israel, llevado de celo entre ellos: por lo cual yo no he consumido en mi celo á los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.WEB: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.
verses.ASV: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto dize lhes: Eis que eu estabeleço meu pacto de paz com ele;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto diles: He aquí yo establezco mi pacto de paz con él;

verses.KJV: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”
verses.ASV: and it shall be unto him, and to his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E terá ele, e sua descendência depois dele, o pacto do sacerdócio perpétuo; porquanto teve zelo por seu Deus, e fez expiação pelos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y tendrá él, y su simiente después de él, el pacto del sacerdocio perpetuo; por cuanto tuvo celo por su Dios, é hizo expiación por los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
verses.WEB: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
verses.ASV: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nome do homem morto, que foi morto com a midianita, era Zinri filho de Salu, chefe de uma família da tribo de Simeão.
verses.RVR09: Y el nombre del varón muerto, que fué muerto con la Madianita, era Zimri hijo de Salu, jefe de una familia de la tribu de Simeón.

verses.KJV: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
verses.WEB: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
verses.ASV: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nome da mulher midianita morta, era Cosbi, filha de Zur, príncipe de povos, pai de família em Midiã.
verses.RVR09: Y el nombre de la mujer Madianita muerta, era Cozbi, hija de Zur, príncipe de pueblos, padre de familia en Madián.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

verses.KJV: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.

verses.ALMEIDA: Porquanto eles vos afligiram com suas astúcias, com que vos enganaram no negócio de Peor, e no negócio de Cosbi, filha do príncipe de Midiã, sua irmã, a qual foi morta no dia da mortandade por causa de Peor.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto ellos os afligieron á vosotros con sus ardides, con que os han engañado en el negocio de Peor, y en el negocio de Cozbi, hija del príncipe de Madián, su hermana, la cual fué muerta el día de la mortandad por causa de Peor.

verses.RVR09: Tomad la suma de toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel, de veinte años arriba, por las casas de sus padres, todos los que puedan salir á la guerra en Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Benjamín por sus familias: de Bela, la familia de los Belaitas; de Asbel, la familia de los Asbelitas; de Achîram, la familia de los Achîramitas;

verses.KJV: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.WEB: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

verses.RVR09: De Supham, la familia de los Suphamitas; de Hupham, la familia de los Huphamitas.

verses.WEB: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Bela fueron Ard y Naamán: de Ard, la familia de los Arditas; de Naamán, la familia de los Naamanitas.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os filhos de Benjamim por suas famílias; e seus contados, quarenta e cinco mil e seiscentos.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los hijos de Benjamín por sus familias; y sus contados, cuarenta y cinco mil y seiscientos.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os filhos de Dã por suas famílias: de Suã, a família dos suamitas. Estas são as famílias de Dã por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los hijos de Dan por sus familias: de Suham, la familia de los Suhamitas. Estas son las familias de Dan por sus familias.

verses.KJV: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.WEB: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.ASV: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as famílias dos suamitas, por seus contados, sessenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.
verses.RVR09: Todas las familias de los Suhamitas, por sus contados, sesenta y cuatro mil y cuatrocientos.

verses.KJV: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.WEB: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
verses.ASV: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Aser por suas famílias: de Imna, a família dos imnaítas; de Isvi, a família dos isvitas; de Berias, a família dos beriitas.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Aser por sus familias: de Imna, la familia de los Imnaitas; de Issui, la familia de los Issuitas; de Beria, la familia de los Beriaitas.

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.WEB: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.ASV: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Berias: de Héber, a família dos heberitas; de Malquiel, a família dos malquielitas.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Beria: de Heber, la familia de los Heberitas; de Malchîel, la familia de los Malchîelitas.

verses.KJV: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
verses.WEB: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.ASV: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nome da filha de Aser foi Sera.
verses.RVR09: Y el nombre de la hija de Aser fué Sera.

verses.KJV: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.WEB: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.ASV: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them, fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Aser, por seus contados, cinquenta e três mil e quatrocentos.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las familias de los hijos de Aser, por sus contados, cincuenta y tres mil y cuatrocientos.

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
verses.WEB: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
verses.ASV: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Naftali por suas famílias: de Jazeel, a família dos jazeelitas; de Guni, a família dos gunitas;
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Nephtalí por sus familias: de Jahzeel, la familia de los Jahzeelitas; de Guni, la familia de los Gunitas;

verses.KJV: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.WEB: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.ASV: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.ALMEIDA: De Jezer, a família dos jezeritas; de Silém, a família dos silemitas.
verses.RVR09: De Jeser, la familia de los Jeseritas; de Sillem, la familia de los Sillemitas.

verses.KJV: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.WEB: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.ASV: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as famílias de Naftali por suas famílias; e seus contados, quarenta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las familias de Nephtalí por sus familias; y sus contados, cuarenta y cinco mil y cuatrocientos.

verses.KJV: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.WEB: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os contados dos filhos de Israel, seiscentos e um mil setecentos e trinta.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los contados de los hijos de Israel, seiscientos y un mil setecientos y treinta.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.WEB: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.ASV: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.ALMEIDA: A estes se repartirá a terra em herança, pela conta dos nomes.
verses.RVR09: A estos se repartirá la tierra en heredad, por la cuenta de los nombres.

verses.KJV: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
verses.WEB: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
verses.ASV: To the more thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one according to those that were numbered of him shall his inheritance be given.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos mais darás maior herança, e aos menos menor; e a cada um se lhe dará sua herança conforme seus contados.
verses.RVR09: A los más darás mayor heredad, y á los menos menor; y á cada uno se le dará su heredad conforme á sus contados.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.WEB: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.ASV: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a terra será repartida por sorteio; e pelos nomes das tribos de seus pais herdarão.
verses.RVR09: Empero la tierra será repartida por suerte; y por los nombres de las tribus de sus padres heredarán.

verses.KJV: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
verses.WEB: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
verses.ASV: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme a sorte será repartida sua herança entre o grande e o pequeno.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á la suerte será repartida su heredad entre el grande y el pequeño.

verses.KJV: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.WEB: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.ASV: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os contados dos levitas por suas famílias são estes: de Gérson, a família dos gersonitas; de Coate, a família dos coatitas; de Merari, a família dos meraritas.
verses.RVR09: Y los contados de los Levitas por sus familias son estos: de Gersón, la familia de los Gersonitas; de Coath, la familia de los Coathitas; de Merari, la familia de los Meraritas.

verses.KJV: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
verses.WEB: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
verses.ASV: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. And Kohath begat Amram.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as famílias dos levitas: a família dos libnitas, a família dos hebronitas, a família dos malitas, a família dos musitas, a família dos coraítas. E Coate gerou a Anrão.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las familias de los Levitas: la familia de los Libnitas, la familia de los Hebronitas, la familia de los Mahalitas, la familia de los Musitas, la familia de los Coritas. Y Coath engendró á Amram.

verses.KJV: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.WEB: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.ASV: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher de Anrão se chamou Joquebede, filha de Levi, a qual nasceu a Levi no Egito: esta deu à luz de Anrão a Arão e a Moisés, e a Miriã sua irmã.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer de Amram se llamó Jochâbed, hija de Leví, la cual nació á Leví en Egipto: ésta parió de Amram á Aarón y á Moisés, y á María su hermana.

verses.KJV: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.WEB: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.ASV: And unto Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Arão nasceram Nadabe e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
verses.RVR09: Y á Aarón nacieron Nadab y Abiú, Eleazar é Ithamar.

verses.KJV: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram, quando ofereceram fogo estranho diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas Nadab y Abiú murieron, cuando ofrecieron fuego extraño delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And they that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, every male from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os contados dos levitas foram vinte e três mil, todos homens de um mês acima: porque não foram contados entre os filhos de Israel, porquanto não lhes havia de ser dada herança entre os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y los contados de los Levitas fueron veinte y tres mil, todos varones de un mes arriba: porque no fueron contados entre los hijos de Israel, por cuanto no les había de ser dada heredad entre los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.WEB: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ASV: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os contados por Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote, os quais contaram os filhos de Israel nos campos de Moabe, junto ao Jordão de Jericó.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los contados por Moisés y Eleazar el sacerdote, los cuales contaron los hijos de Israel en los campos de Moab, junto al Jordán de Jericó.

verses.KJV: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.WEB: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.ASV: But among these there was not a man of them that were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entre estes ninguém havia dos contados por Moisés e Arão o sacerdote, os quais contaram aos filhos de Israel no deserto de Sinai.
verses.RVR09: Y entre estos ninguno hubo de los contados por Moisés y Aarón el sacerdote, los cuales contaron á los hijos de Israel en el desierto de Sinaí.

verses.KJV: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.WEB: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR lhes disse: Hão de morrer no deserto: e não restou homem deles, a não ser Calebe filho de Jefoné, e Josué filho de Num.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová les dijo: Han de morir en el desierto: y no quedó varón de ellos, sino Caleb hijo de Jephone, y Josué hijo de Nun.

verses.KJV: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.WEB: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.ASV: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as filhas de Zelofeade, filho de Héfer, filho de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, das famílias de Manassés, filho de José, os nomes das quais eram Maalá, e Noa, e Hogla, e Milca, e Tirza, chegaram;
verses.RVR09: Y LAS hijas de Salphaad, hijo de Hepher, hijo de Galaad, hijo de Machîr, hijo de Manasés, de las familias de Manasés, hijo de José, los nombres de las cuales eran Maala, y Noa, y Hogla, y Milca, y Tirsa, llegaron;

verses.KJV: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.WEB: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,
verses.ASV: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the tent of meeting, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E apresentaram-se diante de Moisés, e diante do sacerdote Eleazar, e diante dos príncipes, e de toda a congregação, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, e disseram:
verses.RVR09: Y presentáronse delante de Moisés, y delante del sacerdote Eleazar, y delante de los príncipes, y de toda la congregación, á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio, y dijeron:

verses.KJV: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
verses.WEB: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.
verses.ASV: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among the company of them that gathered themselves together against Jehovah in the company of Korah: but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nosso pai morreu no deserto, o qual não esteve na junta que se reuniu contra o SENHOR na companhia de Coré: mas sim que em seu pecado morreu, e não teve filhos.
verses.RVR09: Nuestro padre murió en el desierto, el cual no estuvo en la junta que se reunió contra Jehová en la compañía de Coré: sino que en su pecado murió, y no tuvo hijos.

verses.KJV: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
verses.WEB: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
verses.ASV: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give unto us a possession among the brethren of our father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que será tirado o nome de nosso pai dentre sua família, por não haver tido filho? Dá-nos herança entre os irmãos de nosso pai.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué será quitado el nombre de nuestro padre de entre su familia, por no haber tenido hijo? Danos heredad entre los hermanos de nuestro padre.

verses.KJV: And Moses brought their cause before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Moses brought their cause before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés levou sua causa diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés llevó su causa delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR respondeu a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová respondió á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.WEB: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
verses.ASV: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem dizem as filhas de Zelofeade: hás de dar-lhes possessão de herança entre os irmãos de seu pai; e passarás a herança de seu pai a elas.
verses.RVR09: Bien dicen las hijas de Salphaad: has de darles posesión de heredad entre los hermanos de su padre; y traspasarás la heredad de su padre á ellas.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.WEB: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos filhos de Israel falarás, dizendo: Quando alguém morrer sem filhos, passareis sua herança à sua filha:
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de Israel hablarás, diciendo: Cuando alguno muriere sin hijos, traspasaréis su herencia á su hija:

verses.KJV: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.WEB: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.ASV: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não tiver filha, dareis sua herança a seus irmãos:
verses.RVR09: Y si no tuviere hija, daréis su herencia á sus hermanos:

verses.KJV: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
verses.WEB: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
verses.ASV: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não tiver irmãos, dareis sua herança aos irmãos de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y si no tuviere hermanos, daréis su herencia á los hermanos de su padre.

verses.KJV: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.’”
verses.ASV: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute [and] ordinance, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se seu pai não tiver irmãos, dareis sua herança a seu parente mais próximo de sua linhagem, o qual a possuirá: e será aos filhos de Israel por estatuto de regulamento, como o SENHOR mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y si su padre no tuviere hermanos, daréis su herencia á su pariente más cercano de su linaje, el cual la poseerá: y será á los hijos de Israel por estatuto de derecho, como Jehová mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, and behold the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Sobe a este monte Abarim, e verás a terra que dei aos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Sube á este monte Abarim, y verás la tierra que he dado á los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
verses.WEB: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
verses.ASV: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered;
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que a houverdes visto, tu também serás recolhido ao teus povo, como foi reunido o teu irmão Arão;
verses.RVR09: Y después que la habrás visto, tú también serás reunido á tus pueblos, como fué reunido tu hermano Aarón:

verses.KJV: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.WEB: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
verses.ASV: because ye rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the waters before their eyes. (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
verses.ALMEIDA: pois fostes rebeldes no deserto de Zim, no conflito da congregação, ao meu mandado de me santificar nas águas à vista deles. Essas são as águas do conflito de Cades no deserto de Zim.
verses.RVR09: Pues fuisteis rebeldes á mi dicho en el desierto de Zin, en la rencilla de la congregación, para santificarme en las aguas á ojos de ellos. Estas son las aguas de la rencilla de Cades en el desierto de Zin.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake unto the Lord, saying,
verses.WEB: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
verses.ASV: And Moses spake unto Jehovah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés respondeu ao SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió Moisés á Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
verses.WEB: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
verses.ASV: Let Jehovah, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
verses.ALMEIDA: Que o SENHOR, Deus dos espíritos de toda carne, ponha um homem sobre a congregação,
verses.RVR09: Ponga Jehová, Dios de los espíritus de toda carne, varón sobre la congregación,

verses.KJV: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
verses.WEB: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”
verses.ASV: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Jehovah be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
verses.ALMEIDA: que saia diante deles, que entre diante deles, que os faça sair e os faça entrar; para que a congregação do SENHOR não seja como ovelhas sem pastor.
verses.RVR09: Que salga delante de ellos, y que entre delante de ellos, que los saque y los introduzca; porque la congregación de Jehová no sea como ovejas sin pastor.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay thy hand upon him;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Toma a Josué filho de Num, homem no qual há espírito, e porás tua mão sobre ele;
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: Toma á Josué hijo de Nun, varón en el cual hay espíritu, y pondrás tu mano sobre él;

verses.KJV: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.WEB: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
verses.ASV: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o porás diante de Eleazar o sacerdote, e diante de toda a congregação; e lhe darás ordens em presença deles.
verses.RVR09: Y ponerlo has delante de Eleazar el sacerdote, y delante de toda la congregación; y le darás órdenes en presencia de ellos.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.WEB: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt put of thine honor upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porás de tua dignidade sobre ele, para que toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel lhe obedeçam.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrás de tu dignidad sobre él, para que toda la congregación de los hijos de Israel le obedezcan.

verses.KJV: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
verses.WEB: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
verses.ASV: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Jehovah: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele estará diante de Eleazar o sacerdote, e a ele perguntará pelo juízo do Urim diante do SENHOR: pelo dito dele sairão, e pelo dito dele entrarão, ele, e todos os filhos de Israel com ele, e toda a congregação.
verses.RVR09: Y él estará delante de Eleazar el sacerdote, y á él preguntará por el juicio del Urim delante de Jehová: por el dicho de él saldrán, y por el dicho de él entrarán, él, y todos los hijos de Israel con él, y toda la congregación.

verses.KJV: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.WEB: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
verses.ASV: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him; and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés fez como o SENHOR lhe havia mandado; que tomou a Josué, e lhe pôs diante de Eleazar o sacerdote, e de toda a congregação:
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés hizo como Jehová le había mandado; que tomó á Josué, y le puso delante de Eleazar el sacerdote, y de toda la congregación:

verses.KJV: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.
verses.ASV: and he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as Jehovah spake by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs sobre ele suas mãos, e deu-lhe ordens, como o SENHOR havia mandado por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y puso sobre él sus manos, y dióle órdenes, como Jehová había mandado por mano de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
verses.WEB: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
verses.ASV: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My oblation, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a sweet savor unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Da minha oferta, do meu pão com os meus holocaustos em aroma agradável para mim, tereis cuidado de as oferecer a mim no tempo devido.
verses.RVR09: Manda á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Mi ofrenda, mi pan con mis ofrendas encendidas en olor á mí agradable, guardaréis, ofreciéndomelo á su tiempo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.WEB: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto Jehovah: he-lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes dirás: Esta é a oferta queimada que apresentareis ao SENHOR: dois cordeiros sem mácula de ano, cada dia, será o holocausto contínuo.
verses.RVR09: Y les dirás: Esta es la ofrenda encendida que ofreceréis á Jehová: dos corderos sin tacha de un año, cada un día, será el holocausto continuo.

verses.KJV: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
verses.WEB: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,
verses.ASV: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
verses.ALMEIDA: Um cordeiro oferecerás pela manhã, e o outro cordeiro oferecerás entre as duas tardes:
verses.RVR09: El un cordero ofrecerás por la mañana, y el otro cordero ofrecerás entre las dos tardes:

verses.KJV: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
verses.WEB: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.ASV: and the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a décima de um efa de boa farinha, amassada com uma quarta parte de um him de azeite prensado, em oferta de cereais.
verses.RVR09: Y la décima de un epha de flor de harina, amasada con una cuarta de un hin de aceite molido, en presente.

verses.KJV: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.ASV: It is a continual burnt-offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: É holocausto contínuo, que foi feito no monte Sinai em cheiro suave, oferta queimada ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Es holocausto continuo, que fué hecho en el monte de Sinaí en olor de suavidad, ofrenda encendida á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the Lord for a drink offering.
verses.WEB: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.
verses.ASV: And the drink-offering thereof shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou pour out a drink-offering of strong drink unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua libação, a quarta parte de um him com cada cordeiro: derramarás libação de superior vinho ao SENHOR no santuário.
verses.RVR09: Y su libación, la cuarta de un hin con cada cordero: derramarás libación de superior vino á Jehová en el santuario.

verses.KJV: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meal-offering of the morning, and as the drink-offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E oferecerás o segundo cordeiro entre as duas tardes: conforme a oferta da manhã, e conforme sua libação oferecerás, oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y ofrecerás el segundo cordero entre las dos tardes: conforme á la ofrenda de la mañana, y conforme á su libación ofrecerás, ofrenda encendida en olor de suavidad á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
verses.WEB: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
verses.ASV: And on the sabbath day two he-lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and the drink-offering thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas no dia do sábado dois cordeiros de ano sem defeito, e dois décimos [de efa] de flor de farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais, com sua libação:
verses.RVR09: Mas el día del sábado dos corderos de un año sin defecto, y dos décimas de flor de harina amasada con aceite, por presente, con su libación:

verses.KJV: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.WEB: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.ASV: this is the burnt-offering of every sabbath, besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: É o holocausto do sábado em cada sábado, além do holocausto contínuo e sua libação.
verses.RVR09: Es el holocausto del sábado en cada sábado, además del holocausto continuo, y su libación.

verses.KJV: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
verses.WEB: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,
verses.ASV: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt-offering unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;
verses.ALMEIDA: E nos princípios de vossos meses oferecereis em holocausto ao SENHOR dois bezerros das vacas, e um carneiro, e sete cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.RVR09: Y en los principios de vuestros meses ofreceréis en holocausto á Jehová dos becerros de la vacada, y un carnero, y siete corderos de un año sin defecto;

verses.KJV: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
verses.WEB: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;
verses.ASV: and three tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for each bullock; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for the one ram;
verses.ALMEIDA: E três décimos [de efa] de boa farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais com cada bezerro; e dois décimos [de efa] de boa farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais com cada carneiro;
verses.RVR09: Y tres décimas de flor de harina amasada con aceite, por presente con cada becerro; y dos décimas de flor de harina amasada con aceite, por presente con cada carnero;

verses.KJV: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.ASV: and a tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering unto every lamb; for a burnt-offering of a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um décimo [de efa] de boa farinha amassada com azeite, em oferta de cereais com cada cordeiro; holocausto de aroma suave, oferta queimada ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y una décima de flor de harina amasada con aceite, en ofrenda por presente con cada cordero: holocausto de olor suave, ofrenda encendida á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.WEB: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.ASV: And their drink-offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt-offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas libações de vinho, meio him com cada bezerro, e o terço de um him com cada carneiro, e a quarta parte de um him com cada cordeiro. Este é o holocausto de cada mês por todos os meses do ano.
verses.RVR09: Y sus libaciones de vino, medio hin con cada becerro, y el tercio de un hin con cada carnero, y la cuarta de un hin con cada cordero. Este es el holocausto de cada mes por todos los meses del año.

verses.KJV: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.WEB: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.ASV: And one he-goat for a sin-offering unto Jehovah; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um bode macho em expiação se oferecerá ao SENHOR, além do holocausto contínuo com sua libação.
verses.RVR09: Y un macho cabrío en expiación se ofrecerá á Jehová, además del holocausto continuo con su libación.

verses.KJV: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.
verses.WEB: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.
verses.ASV: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Jehovah’s passover.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas no mês primeiro, aos catorze do mês será a páscoa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas en el mes primero, á los catorce del mes será la pascua de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.WEB: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
verses.ASV: And on the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos quinze dias deste mês, a solenidade: por sete dias se comerão pães ázimos.
verses.RVR09: Y á los quince días de aqueste mes, la solemnidad: por siete días se comerán ázimos.

verses.KJV: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
verses.WEB: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,
verses.ASV: In the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work;
verses.ALMEIDA: No primeiro dia, santa convocação; nenhuma obra servil fareis:
verses.RVR09: El primer día, santa convocación; ninguna obra servil haréis:

verses.KJV: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.WEB: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,
verses.ASV: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt-offering unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven he-lambs a year old; they shall be unto you without blemish;
verses.ALMEIDA: E oferecereis por oferta queimada em holocausto ao SENHOR dois bezerros das vacas, e um carneiro, e sete cordeiros de um ano; sem defeito os tomareis;
verses.RVR09: Y ofreceréis por ofrenda encendida en holocausto á Jehová dos becerros de la vacada, y un carnero, y siete corderos de un año: sin defecto los tomaréis:

verses.KJV: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
verses.WEB: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.
verses.ASV: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil: three tenth parts shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth parts for the ram;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua oferta de cereais de farinha amassada com azeite: três décimos [de efa] com cada bezerro, e dois décimos com cada carneiro oferecereis;
verses.RVR09: Y su presente de harina amasada con aceite: tres décimas con cada becerro, y dos décimas con cada carnero ofreceréis;

verses.KJV: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.WEB: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.ASV: a tenth part shalt thou offer for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.ALMEIDA: Com cada um dos sete cordeiros oferecereis um décimo;
verses.RVR09: Con cada uno de los siete corderos ofreceréis una décima;

verses.KJV: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
verses.WEB: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.ASV: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.

verses.ASV: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.RVR09: Y sus presentes y sus libaciones con los becerros, con los carneros, y con los corderos, según el número de ellos, conforme á la ley;

verses.KJV: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.WEB: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.
verses.ASV: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offerings thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e suas libações.
verses.RVR09: Y un macho cabrío por expiación: además del holocausto continuo, su presente y sus libaciones.

verses.KJV: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.WEB: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.ASV: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs a year old without blemish;
verses.ALMEIDA: E no sétimo dia, sete bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.RVR09: Y el séptimo día, siete becerros, dos carneros, catorce corderos de un año sin defecto;

verses.KJV: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.WEB: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,
verses.ASV: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.RVR09: Y sus presentes y sus libaciones con los becerros, con los carneros, y con los corderos, según el número de ellos, conforme á la ley;

verses.KJV: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.WEB: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.ASV: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, com sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.
verses.RVR09: Y un macho cabrío por expiación: además del holocausto continuo, con su presente y su libación.

verses.KJV: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:
verses.WEB: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;
verses.ASV: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work;
verses.ALMEIDA: No oitavo dia tereis solenidade; nenhuma obra servil fareis;
verses.RVR09: El octavo día tendréis solemnidad: ninguna obra servil haréis:

verses.KJV: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.WEB: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.ASV: but ye shall offer a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah: one bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;
verses.ALMEIDA: E oferecereis em holocausto, em oferta de queima de cheiro suave ao SENHOR, um novilho, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;
verses.RVR09: Y ofreceréis en holocausto, en ofrenda encendida de olor suave á Jehová, un novillo, un carnero, siete corderos de un año sin defecto;

verses.KJV: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.WEB: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,
verses.ASV: their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com o novilho, com o carneiro, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.RVR09: Sus presentes y sus libaciones con el novillo, con el carnero, y con los corderos, según el número de ellos, conforme á la ley;

verses.KJV: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.WEB: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.ASV: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, com sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.
verses.RVR09: Y un macho cabrío por expiación: además del holocausto continuo, con su presente y su libación.
