verses.KJV: These things ye shall do unto the Lord in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”
verses.ASV: These ye shall offer unto Jehovah in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill-offerings, for your burnt-offerings, and for your meal-offerings, and for your drink-offerings, and for your peace-offerings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas oferecereis ao SENHOR em vossas solenidades, além de vossos votos, e de vossas ofertas livres, para vossos holocaustos, e para vossas ofertas de cereais, e para vossas libações e para vossas ofertas pacíficas.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas ofreceréis á Jehová en vuestras solemnidades, además de vuestros votos, y de vuestras ofrendas libres, para vuestros holocaustos, y para vuestros presentes, y para vuestras libaciones, y para vuestras paces.

verses.KJV: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés disse aos filhos de Israel, conforme tudo o que o SENHOR lhe havia mandado.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded.
verses.WEB: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.
verses.ASV: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Moisés aos príncipes das tribos dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou.
verses.RVR09: Y MOISÉS dijo á los hijos de Israel, conforme á todo lo que Jehová le había mandado.

verses.KJV: If a man vow a vow unto the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
verses.WEB: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
verses.ASV: When a man voweth a vow unto Jehovah, or sweareth an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando alguém fizer voto ao SENHOR, ou fizer juramento ligando sua alma com obrigação, não violará sua palavra: fará conforme tudo o que saiu de sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Y habló Moisés á los príncipes de las tribus de los hijos de Israel, diciendo: Esto es lo que Jehová ha mandado.

verses.KJV: If a woman also vow a vow unto the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
verses.WEB: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
verses.ASV: Also when a woman voweth a vow unto Jehovah, and bindeth herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a mulher, quando fizer voto ao SENHOR, e se ligar com obrigação em casa de seu pai, em sua juventude;
verses.RVR09: Cuando alguno hiciere voto á Jehová, ó hiciere juramento ligando su alma con obligación, no violará su palabra: hará conforme á todo lo que salió de su boca.

verses.KJV: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.WEB: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
verses.ASV: and her father heareth her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father holdeth his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se seu pai ouvir seu voto, e a obrigação com que ligou sua alma, e seu pai calar a isso, todos os votos dela serão firmes, e toda obrigação com que houver ligado sua alma, firme será.
verses.RVR09: Mas la mujer, cuando hiciere voto á Jehová, y se ligare con obligación en casa de su padre, en su mocedad;

verses.KJV: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.WEB: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.
verses.ASV: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth, none of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and Jehovah will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se seu pai lhe vedar no dia que ouvir todos os seus votos e suas obrigações, com que ela houver ligado sua alma, não serão firmes; e o SENHOR a perdoará, porquanto seu pai lhe vedou.
verses.RVR09: Si su padre oyere su voto, y la obligación con que ligó su alma, y su padre callare á ello, todos los votos de ella serán firmes, y toda obligación con que hubiere ligado su alma, firme será.

verses.KJV: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
verses.WEB: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
verses.ASV: And if she be [married] to a husband, while her vows are upon her, or the rash utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se for casada, e fizer votos, ou pronunciar de seus lábios coisa com que obriga sua alma;
verses.RVR09: Mas si su padre le vedare el día que oyere todos sus votos y sus obligaciones, con que ella hubiere ligado su alma, no serán firmes; y Jehová la perdonará, por cuanto su padre le vedó.

verses.KJV: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.WEB: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
verses.ASV: and her husband hear it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he heareth it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se seu marido o ouvir, e quando o ouvir calar a isso, os votos dela serão firmes, e a obrigação com que ligou sua alma, firme será.
verses.RVR09: Empero si fuere casada, é hiciere votos, ó pronunciare de sus labios cosa con que obligue su alma;

verses.KJV: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the Lord shall forgive her.
verses.WEB: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.
verses.ASV: But if her husband disallow her in the day that he heareth it, then he shall make void her vow which is upon her, and the rash utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul: and Jehovah will forgive her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se quando seu marido o ouviu, lhe vedou, então o voto que ela fez, e o que pronunciou de seus lábios com que ligou sua alma, será nulo; e o SENHOR o perdoará.
verses.RVR09: Si su marido lo oyere, y cuando lo oyere callare á ello, los votos de ella serán firmes, y la obligación con que ligó su alma, firme será.

verses.KJV: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
verses.WEB: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.
verses.ASV: But the vow of a widow, or of her that is divorced, [even] everything wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand against her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas todo voto de viúva, ou repudiada, com que ligar sua alma, será firme.
verses.RVR09: Pero si cuando su marido lo oyó, le vedó, entonces el voto que ella hizo, y lo que pronunció de sus labios con que ligó su alma, será nulo; y Jehová lo perdonará.

verses.KJV: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
verses.WEB: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
verses.ASV: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
verses.ALMEIDA: E se houver feito voto em casa de seu marido, e houver ligado sua alma com obrigação de juramento,
verses.RVR09: Mas todo voto de viuda, ó repudiada, con que ligare su alma, será firme.

verses.KJV: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.WEB: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.ASV: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se seu marido ouviu, e calou a isso, e não lhe vedou; então todos os seus votos serão firmes, e toda obrigação com que houver ligado sua alma, firme será.
verses.RVR09: Y si hubiere hecho voto en casa de su marido, y hubiere ligado su alma con obligación de juramento,

verses.KJV: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the Lord shall forgive her.
verses.WEB: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.
verses.ASV: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and Jehovah will forgive her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se seu marido os anulou no dia que os ouviu; tudo o que saiu de seus lábios quanto a seus votos, e quanto à obrigação de sua alma, será nulo; seu marido os anulou, e o SENHOR a perdoará.
verses.RVR09: Si su marido oyó, y calló á ello, y no le vedó; entonces todos sus votos serán firmes, y toda obligación con que hubiere ligado su alma, firme será.

verses.KJV: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.WEB: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.ASV: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo voto, ou todo juramento obrigando-se a afligir a alma, seu marido o confirmará, ou seu marido o anulará.
verses.RVR09: Mas si su marido los anuló el día que los oyó; todo lo que salió de sus labios cuanto á sus votos, y cuanto á la obligación de su alma, será nulo; su marido los anuló, y Jehová la perdonará.

verses.KJV: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.WEB: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.
verses.ASV: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he hath established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se seu marido calar a isso de dia em dia, então confirmou todos os seus votos, e todas as obrigações que estão sobre ela: confirmou-as, porquanto calou a isso o dia que o ouviu.
verses.RVR09: Todo voto, ó todo juramento obligándose á afligir el alma, su marido lo confirmará, ó su marido lo anulará.

verses.KJV: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.WEB: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
verses.ASV: But if he shall make them null and void after that he hath heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se as anular depois de havê-las ouvido, então ele levará o pecado dela.
verses.RVR09: Empero si su marido callare á ello de día en día, entonces confirmó todos sus votos, y todas las obligaciones que están sobre ella: confirmólas, por cuanto calló á ello el día que lo oyó.

verses.KJV: These are the statutes, which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
verses.WEB: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
verses.ASV: These are the statutes, which Jehovah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as ordenanças que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés entre o homem e sua mulher, entre o pai e sua filha, durante sua juventude em casa de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Mas si las anulare después de haberlas oído, entonces él llevará el pecado de ella. Estas son las ordenanzas que Jehová mandó á Moisés entre el varón y su mujer, entre el padre y su hija, durante su mocedad en casa de su padre.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.WEB: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
verses.ASV: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze a vingança dos filhos de Israel sobre os midianitas; depois serás recolhido a teus povos.
verses.RVR09: Haz la venganza de los hijos de Israel sobre los Madianitas; después serás recogido á tus pueblos.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the Lord of Midian.
verses.WEB: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.
verses.ASV: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm ye men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Jehovah’s vengeance on Midian.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés falou ao povo, dizendo: Armai-vos alguns de vós para a guerra, e irão contra Midiã, e farão a vingança do SENHOR em Midiã.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés habló al pueblo, diciendo: Armaos algunos de vosotros para la guerra, é irán contra Madián, y harán la venganza de Jehová en Madián.

verses.KJV: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
verses.WEB: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”
verses.ASV: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mil de cada tribo de todas as tribos dos filhos de Israel, enviareis à guerra.
verses.RVR09: Mil de cada tribu de todas las tribus de los hijos de Israel, enviaréis á la guerra.

verses.KJV: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.WEB: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.ASV: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim foram dados dos milhares de Israel, mil cada tribo, doze mil a ponto de guerra.
verses.RVR09: Así fueron dados de los millares de Israel, mil por cada tribu, doce mil á punto de guerra.

verses.KJV: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.WEB: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
verses.ASV: And Moses sent them, a thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés os enviou à guerra: mil cada tribo enviou: e Fineias, filho de Eleazar sacerdote, foi à guerra com os santos instrumentos, com as trombetas em sua mão para tocar.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés los envió á la guerra: mil de cada tribu envió: y Phinees, hijo de Eleazar sacerdote, fué á la guerra con los santos instrumentos, con las trompetas en su mano para tocar.

verses.KJV: And they warred against the Midianites, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
verses.WEB: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.
verses.ASV: And they warred against Midian, as Jehovah commanded Moses; and they slew every male.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lutaram contra Midiã, como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés, e mataram a todo homem.
verses.RVR09: Y pelearon contra Madián, como Jehová lo mandó á Moisés, y mataron á todo varón.

verses.KJV: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.WEB: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
verses.ASV: And they slew the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mataram também, entre os mortos deles, aos reis de Midiã: Evi, e Requém, e Zur, e Hur, e Reba, cinco reis de Midiã; a Balaão também, filho de Beor, mataram à espada.
verses.RVR09: Mataron también, entre los muertos de ellos, á los reyes de Madián: Evi, y Recem, y Zur, y Hur, y Reba, cinco reyes de Madián: á Balaam también, hijo de Beor, mataron á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods, they took for a prey.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levaram cativas os filhos de Israel as mulheres dos midianitas, e suas crianças e todos suas animais, e todos os seus gados; e arrebataram todos os seus pertences.
verses.RVR09: Y llevaron cautivas los hijos de Israel las mujeres de los Madianitas, y sus chiquitos y todas sus bestias, y todos sus ganados; y arrebataron toda su hacienda.

verses.KJV: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.WEB: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
verses.ASV: And all their cities in the places wherein they dwelt, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abrasaram com fogo todas suas cidades, aldeias e castelos.
verses.RVR09: Y abrasaron con fuego todas sus ciudades, aldeas y castillos.

verses.KJV: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
verses.WEB: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
verses.ASV: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of man and of beast.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram todo o despojo, e toda a presa, tanto de homens como de animais.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron todo el despojo, y toda la presa, así de hombres como de bestias.

verses.KJV: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.WEB: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ASV: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and unto Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trouxeram a Moisés, e a Eleazar o sacerdote, e à congregação dos filhos de Israel, os cativos e a presa e os despojos, ao acampamento nas planícies de Moabe, que estão junto ao Jordão de Jericó.
verses.RVR09: Y trajeron á Moisés, y á Eleazar el sacerdote, y á la congregación de los hijos de Israel, los cautivos y la presa y los despojos, al campo en los llanos de Moab, que están junto al Jordán de Jericó.

verses.KJV: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.WEB: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
verses.ASV: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saíram Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote, e todos os príncipes da congregação, a recebê-los fora do acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y salieron Moisés y Eleazar el sacerdote, y todos los príncipes de la congregación, á recibirlos fuera del campo.

verses.KJV: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
verses.WEB: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
verses.ASV: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
verses.ALMEIDA: E irou-se Moisés contra os capitães do exército, contra os comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem que voltavam da guerra;
verses.RVR09: Y enojóse Moisés contra los capitanes del ejército, contra los tribunos y centuriones que volvían de la guerra;

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.WEB: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes Moisés: Todas as mulheres preservastes?
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Moisés: ¿Todas las mujeres habéis reservado?

verses.KJV: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.
verses.ASV: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Jehovah in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que elas foram aos filhos de Israel, por conselho de Balaão, para causar transgressão contra o SENHOR no negócio de Peor; pelo que houve mortandade na congregação do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: He aquí ellas fueron á los hijos de Israel, por consejo de Balaam, para causar prevaricación contra Jehová en el negocio de Peor; por lo que hubo mortandad en la congregación de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.WEB: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
verses.ASV: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Matai, pois, agora todos os machos entre as crianças: matai também toda mulher que tenha conhecido homem carnalmente.
verses.RVR09: Matad pues ahora todos los varones entre los niños: matad también toda mujer que haya conocido varón carnalmente.

verses.KJV: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.WEB: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.ASV: But all the women-children, that have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as meninas entre as mulheres, que não tenham conhecido ajuntamento de homem, vos preservareis vivas.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las niñas entre las mujeres, que no hayan conocido ayuntamiento de varón, os reservaréis vivas.

verses.KJV: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.WEB: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
verses.ASV: And encamp ye without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, ye and your captives.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós ficai fora do acampamento sete dias: e todos os que houverem matado pessoa, e qualquer um que houver tocado morto, vos purificareis ao terceiro e ao sétimo dia, vós e vossos cativos.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros quedaos fuera del campo siete días: y todos los que hubieren matado persona, y cualquiera que hubiere tocado muerto, os purificaréis al tercero y al séptimo día, vosotros y vuestros cautivos.

verses.KJV: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
verses.WEB: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”
verses.ASV: And as to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ [hair], and all things made of wood, ye shall purify yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também purificareis toda roupa, e todo artigo de peles, e toda obra de pelos de cabra, e todo vaso de madeira.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo purificaréis todo vestido, y toda prenda de pieles, y toda obra de pelos de cabra, y todo vaso de madera.

verses.KJV: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses;
verses.WEB: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war that went to the battle, This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded Moses:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eleazar o sacerdote disse aos homens de guerra que vinham da guerra: Esta é a ordenança da lei que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés:
verses.RVR09: Y Eleazar el sacerdote dijo á los hombres de guerra que venían de la guerra: Esta es la ordenanza de la ley que Jehová ha mandado á Moisés:

verses.KJV: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.WEB: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.ASV: howbeit the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente o ouro, e a prata, bronze, ferro, estanho, e chumbo,
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente el oro, y la plata, metal, hierro, estaño, y plomo,

verses.KJV: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
verses.WEB: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
verses.ASV: everything that may abide the fire, ye shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make to go through the water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo o que resiste ao fogo, por fogo o fareis passar, e será limpo, ainda que nas águas de purificação haverá de purificar-se: mas fareis passar por água tudo o que não aguenta o fogo.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que resiste el fuego, por fuego lo haréis pasar, y será limpio, bien que en las aguas de purificación habrá de purificarse: mas haréis pasar por agua todo lo que no aguanta el fuego.

verses.KJV: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.WEB: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
verses.ASV: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean; and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso lavareis vossas roupas no sétimo dia, e assim sereis limpos; e depois entrareis no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Además lavaréis vuestros vestidos el séptimo día, y así seréis limpios; y después entraréis en el campo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.WEB: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
verses.ASV: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the congregation;
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma a contagem da presa que se fez, tanto das pessoas como dos animais, tu e o sacerdote Eleazar, e os chefes dos pais da congregação:
verses.RVR09: Toma la cuenta de la presa que se ha hecho, así de las personas como de las bestias, tú y el sacerdote Eleazar, y las cabezas de los padres de la congregación:

verses.KJV: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.WEB: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
verses.ASV: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, that went out to battle, and all the congregation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partirás pela metade a presa entre os que lutaram, os que saíram à guerra, e toda a congregação.
verses.RVR09: Y partirás por mitad la presa entre los que pelearon, los que salieron á la guerra, y toda la congregación.

verses.KJV: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.WEB: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
verses.ASV: And levy a tribute unto Jehovah of the men of war that went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, [both] of the persons, and of the oxen, and of the asses, and of the flocks:
verses.ALMEIDA: E separarás para o SENHOR o tributo dos homens de guerra, que saíram à guerra: de quinhentos um, tanto das pessoas como dos bois, dos asnos, e das ovelhas:
verses.RVR09: Y apartarás para Jehová el tributo de los hombres de guerra, que salieron á la guerra: de quinientos uno, así de las personas como de los bueyes, de los asnos, y de las ovejas:

verses.KJV: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.
verses.ASV: take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for Jehovah’s heave-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da metade deles o tomarás; e darás a Eleazar o sacerdote a oferta do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: De la mitad de ellos lo tomarás; y darás á Eleazar el sacerdote la ofrenda de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”
verses.ASV: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the oxen, of the asses, and of the flocks, [even] of all the cattle, and give them unto the Levites, that keep the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da metade pertencente aos filhos de Israel tomarás um de cinquenta, das pessoas, dos bois, dos asnos, e das ovelhas, de todo animal; e os darás aos levitas, que têm a guarda do tabernáculo do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y de la mitad perteneciente á los hijos de Israel tomarás uno de cincuenta, de las personas, de los bueyes, de los asnos, y de las ovejas, de todo animal; y los darás á los Levitas, que tienen la guarda del tabernáculo de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote como o SENHOR mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: E hicieron Moisés y Eleazar el sacerdote como Jehová mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.WEB: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
verses.ASV: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a presa, o resto da presa que tomaram os homens de guerra, seiscentas e setenta e cinco mil ovelhas,
verses.RVR09: Y fué la presa, el resto de la presa que tomaron los hombres de guerra, seiscientas y setenta y cinco mil ovejas,

verses.KJV: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.WEB: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
verses.ASV: and threescore and twelve thousand oxen,
verses.ALMEIDA: E setenta e dois mil bois,
verses.RVR09: Y setenta y dos mil bueyes,

verses.KJV: And threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.WEB: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
verses.ASV: and threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.ALMEIDA: E setenta e um mil asnos;
verses.RVR09: Y setenta y un mil asnos;

verses.KJV: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.WEB: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
verses.ASV: and thirty and two thousand persons in all, of the women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto às pessoas, de mulheres que não conheciam ajuntamento de homem, ao todo trinta e duas mil.
verses.RVR09: Y en cuanto á personas, de mujeres que no habían conocido ayuntamiento de varón, en todas treinta y dos mil.

verses.KJV: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.WEB: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;
verses.ASV: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.ALMEIDA: E a metade, a parte dos que haviam saído à guerra, foi o número de trezentas trinta e sete mil e quinhentas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y la mitad, la parte de los que habían salido á la guerra, fué el número de trescientas treinta y siete mil y quinientas ovejas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.WEB: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
verses.ASV: and Jehovah’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o tributo para o SENHOR das ovelhas foi seiscentas e setenta e cinco.
verses.RVR09: Y el tributo para Jehová de las ovejas, fué seiscientas setenta y cinco.

verses.KJV: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the Lord'S tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.WEB: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.
verses.ASV: And the oxen were thirty and six thousand; of which Jehovah’s tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos bois, trinta e seis mil: e deles o tributo para o SENHOR, setenta e dois.
verses.RVR09: Y de los bueyes, treinta y seis mil: y de ellos el tributo para Jehová, setenta y dos.

verses.KJV: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the Lord'S tribute was threescore and one.
verses.WEB: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.
verses.ASV: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which Jehovah’s tribute was threescore and one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos asnos, trinta mil e quinhentos: e deles o tributo para o SENHOR, setenta e um.
verses.RVR09: Y de los asnos, treinta mil y quinientos: y de ellos el tributo para Jehová, setenta y uno.

verses.KJV: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the Lord'S tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.WEB: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
verses.ASV: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Jehovah’s tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E das pessoas, dezesseis mil: e delas o tributo para o SENHOR, trinta e duas pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Y de las personas, diez y seis mil: y de ellas el tributo para Jehová, treinta y dos personas.

verses.KJV: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the Lord'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: And Moses gave the tribute, which was Jehovah’s heave-offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu Moisés o tributo, por elevada oferta ao SENHOR, a Eleazar o sacerdote, como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Y dió Moisés el tributo, por elevada ofrenda á Jehová, á Eleazar el sacerdote, como Jehová lo mandó á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
verses.WEB: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
verses.ASV: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men that warred
verses.ALMEIDA: E da metade para os filhos de Israel, que separou Moisés dos homens que haviam ido à guerra;
verses.RVR09: Y de la mitad para los hijos de Israel, que apartó Moisés de los hombres que habían ido á la guerra;

verses.KJV: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.WEB: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
verses.ASV: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand, seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.ALMEIDA: (A metade para a congregação foi: das ovelhas, trezentas e trinta e sete mil e quinhentas;
verses.RVR09: (La mitad para la congregación fué: de las ovejas, trescientas treinta y siete mil y quinientas;

verses.KJV: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.WEB: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
verses.ASV: and thirty and six thousand oxen,
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos bois, trinta e seis mil;
verses.RVR09: Y de los bueyes, treinta y seis mil;

verses.KJV: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
verses.WEB: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
verses.ASV: and thirty thousand and five hundred asses,
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos asnos, trinta mil e quinhentos;
verses.RVR09: Y de los asnos, treinta mil y quinientos;

verses.KJV: And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.WEB: and sixteen thousand persons),
verses.ASV: and sixteen thousand persons),
verses.ALMEIDA: E das pessoas, dezesseis mil:)
verses.RVR09: Y de las personas, diez y seis mil:)

verses.KJV: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, that kept the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da metade, pois, para os filhos de Israel tomou Moisés um de cada cinquenta, tanto das pessoas como dos animais, e deu-os aos levitas, que tinham a guarda do tabernáculo do SENHOR; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: De la mitad, pues, para los hijos de Israel tomó Moisés uno de cada cincuenta, así de las personas como de los animales, y diólos á los Levitas, que tenían la guarda del tabernáculo de Jehová; como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
verses.WEB: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
verses.ASV: And the officers that were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses;
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram a Moisés os chefes dos milhares daquele exército, os comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem;
verses.RVR09: Y llegaron á Moisés los jefes de los millares de aquel ejército, los tribunos y centuriones;

verses.KJV: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.WEB: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
verses.ASV: and they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war that are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram a Moisés: Teus servos tomaram a soma dos homens de guerra que estão em nosso poder, e nenhum faltou de nós.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron á Moisés: Tus siervos han tomado razón de los hombres de guerra que están en nuestro poder, y ninguno ha faltado de nosotros.

verses.KJV: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.
verses.WEB: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And we have brought Jehovah’s oblation, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, ankle-chains, and bracelets, signet-rings, ear-rings, and armlets, to make atonement for our souls before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo qual temos oferecido ao SENHOR oferta, cada um do que achou, objetos de ouro, braceletes, pulseiras, anéis, pendentes, e correntes, para fazer expiação por nossas almas diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual hemos ofrecido á Jehová ofrenda, cada uno de lo que ha hallado, vasos de oro, brazaletes, manillas, anillos, zarcillos, y cadenas, para hacer expiación por nuestras almas delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.WEB: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar receberam o ouro deles, joias, todas elaboradas.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés y el sacerdote Eleazar recibieron el oro de ellos, alhajas, todas elaboradas.

verses.KJV: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.WEB: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
verses.ASV: And all the gold of the heave-offering that they offered up to Jehovah, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o ouro da oferta que ofereceram ao SENHOR dos comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem, foi dezesseis mil setecentos e cinquenta siclos.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el oro de la ofrenda que ofrecieron á Jehová de los tribunos y centuriones, fué diez y seis mil setecientos y cincuenta siclos.

verses.KJV: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.WEB: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
verses.ASV: ([For] the men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.)
verses.ALMEIDA: Os homens do exército haviam despojado cada um para si.
verses.RVR09: Los hombres del ejército habían pillado cada uno para sí.

verses.KJV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Receberam, pois, Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar, o ouro dos comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem, e trouxeram-no ao tabernáculo do testemunho, por memória dos filhos de Israel diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Recibieron, pues, Moisés y el sacerdote Eleazar, el oro de los tribunos y centuriones, y trajéronlo al tabernáculo del testimonio, por memoria de los hijos de Israel delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
verses.WEB: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.
verses.ASV: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Rúben e os filhos de Gade tinham uma muito grande abundância de gado; os quais vendo a terra de Jazer e de Gileade, pareceu-lhes a terra lugar de gado.
verses.RVR09: Y LOS hijos de Rubén y los hijos de Gad tenían una muy grande muchedumbre de ganado; los cuales viendo la tierra de Jazer y de Galaad, parecióles el país lugar de ganado.

verses.KJV: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.ASV: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben, e falaram a Moisés, e a Eleazar o sacerdote, e aos príncipes da congregação, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron los hijos de Gad y los hijos de Rubén, y hablaron á Moisés, y á Eleazar el sacerdote, y á los príncipes de la congregación, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.WEB: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
verses.ASV: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Atarote, e Dibom, e Jazer, e Ninra, e Hesbom, e Eleale, e Sebã, e Nebo, e Beom,
verses.RVR09: Ataroth, y Dibón, y Jazer, y Nimra, y Hesbón, y Eleale, y Sabán, y Nebo, y Beón,

verses.KJV: Even the country which the Lord smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.WEB: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
verses.ASV: the land which Jehovah smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle; and thy servants have cattle.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra que o SENHOR feriu diante da congregação de Israel, é terra de gado, e teus servos têm gado.
verses.RVR09: La tierra que Jehová hirió delante de la congregación de Israel, es tierra de ganado, y tus siervos tienen ganado.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
verses.WEB: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
verses.ASV: And they said, If we have found favor in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession; bring us not over the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, disseram, se achamos favor em teus olhos, seja dada esta terra a teus servos em herança, e não nos faças passar o Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, dijeron, si hallamos gracia en tus ojos, dése esta tierra á tus siervos en heredad, y no nos hagas pasar el Jordán.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.WEB: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to the war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Moisés aos filhos de Gade e aos filhos de Rúben: Virão vossos irmãos à guerra, e vós ficareis aqui?
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Moisés á los hijos de Gad y á los hijos de Rubén: ¿Vendrán vuestros hermanos á la guerra, y vosotros os quedaréis aquí?

verses.KJV: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord hath given them?
verses.WEB: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?
verses.ASV: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Jehovah hath given them?
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que desencorajais o ânimo dos filhos de Israel, para que não passem à terra que lhes deu o SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y por qué prevenís el ánimo de los hijos de Israel, para que no pasen á la tierra que les ha dado Jehová?

verses.KJV: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
verses.WEB: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
verses.ASV: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim fizeram vossos pais, quando os enviei desde Cades-Barneia para que vissem a terra.
verses.RVR09: Así hicieron vuestros padres, cuando los envié desde Cades-barnea para que viesen la tierra.

verses.KJV: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the Lord had given them.
verses.WEB: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
verses.ASV: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Jehovah had given them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que subiram até o vale de Escol, e depois que viram a terra, preocuparam o ânimo dos filhos de Israel, para que não viessem à terra que o SENHOR lhes havia dado.
verses.RVR09: Que subieron hasta la arroyada de Escol, y después que vieron la tierra, preocuparon el ánimo de los hijos de Israel, para que no viniesen á la tierra que Jehová les había dado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord'S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah’s anger was kindled in that day, and he sware, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o furor do SENHOR se acendeu então, e jurou dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y el furor de Jehová se encendió entonces, y juró diciendo:

verses.KJV: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.WEB: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
verses.ASV: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Os homens que subiram do Egito de vinte anos acima não verão a terra pela qual jurei a Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, pois não me seguiram por completo;
verses.RVR09: Que no verán los varones que subieron de Egipto de veinte años arriba, la tierra por la cual juré á Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob, por cuanto no fueron perfectos en pos de mí;

verses.KJV: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the Lord.
verses.WEB: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’
verses.ASV: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have wholly followed Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: exceto Calebe, filho do quenezeu Jefoné, e Josué filho de Num, que seguiram por completo ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Excepto Caleb, hijo de Jephone Cenezeo, y Josué hijo de Nun, que fueron perfectos en pos de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander to and fro in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of Jehovah, was consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o furor do SENHOR se acendeu em Israel, e os fez andar errantes quarenta anos pelo deserto, até que foi acabada toda aquela geração, que havia feito mal diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el furor de Jehová se encendió en Israel, é hízolos andar errantes cuarenta años por el desierto, hasta que fué acabada toda aquella generación, que había hecho mal delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord toward Israel.
verses.WEB: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
verses.ASV: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Jehovah toward Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que vós sucedestes em lugar de vossos pais, descendência de homens pecadores, para acrescentar ainda à ira do SENHOR contra Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí vosotros habéis sucedido en lugar de vuestros padres, prole de hombres pecadores, para añadir aún á la ira de Jehová contra Israel.

verses.KJV: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
verses.WEB: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
verses.ASV: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye will destroy all this people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vos deixardes de segui-lo, ele voltará outra vez a deixar-vos no deserto, e destruireis a todo este povo.
verses.RVR09: Si os volviereis de en pos de él, él volverá otra vez á dejaros en el desierto, y destruiréis á todo este pueblo.

verses.KJV: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.WEB: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
verses.ASV: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles se achegaram a ele e disseram: Edificaremos aqui currais para nosso gado, e cidades para nossas crianças;
verses.RVR09: Entonces ellos se llegaron á él y dijeron: Edificaremos aquí majadas para nuestro ganado, y ciudades para nuestros niños;

verses.KJV: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.WEB: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.ASV: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós nos armaremos, e iremos com empenho diante dos filhos de Israel, até que os ponhamos em seu lugar; e nossas crianças ficarão em cidades fortes por causa dos moradores da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros nos armaremos, é iremos con diligencia delante de los hijos de Israel, hasta que los metamos en su lugar: y nuestros niños quedarán en ciudades fuertes á causa de los moradores del país.

verses.KJV: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.WEB: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.
verses.ASV: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não voltaremos a nossas casas até que os filhos de Israel possuam cada um sua herança.
verses.RVR09: No volveremos á nuestras casas hasta que los hijos de Israel posean cada uno su heredad.

verses.KJV: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
verses.WEB: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
verses.ASV: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não tomaremos herança com eles ao outro lado do Jordão nem adiante, porquanto teremos já nossa herança da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente.
verses.RVR09: Porque no tomaremos heredad con ellos al otro lado del Jordán ni adelante, por cuanto tendremos ya nuestra heredad de estotra parte del Jordán al oriente.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the Lord to war,
verses.WEB: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will arm yourselves to go before Jehovah to the war,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhes respondeu Moisés: Se o fizerdes assim, se vos preparardes para ir diante do SENHOR à guerra,
verses.RVR09: Entonces les respondió Moisés: Si lo hiciereis así, si os apercibiereis para ir delante de Jehová á la guerra,

verses.KJV: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the Lord, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.WEB: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.ASV: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E passardes todos vós armados o Jordão diante do SENHOR, até que tenha expulsado a seus inimigos de diante de si,
verses.RVR09: Y pasareis todos vosotros armados el Jordán delante de Jehová, hasta que haya echado á sus enemigos de delante de sí,

verses.KJV: And the land be subdued before the Lord: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.
verses.WEB: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
verses.ASV: and the land is subdued before Jehovah; then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless towards Jehovah, and towards Israel; and this land shall be unto you for a possession before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seja aquela terra subjugada diante do SENHOR; logo voltareis, e sereis livres de culpa para com o SENHOR, e para com Israel; e esta terra será vossa em herança diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y sea el país sojuzgado delante de Jehová; luego volveréis, y seréis libres de culpa para con Jehová, y para con Israel; y esta tierra será vuestra en heredad delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the Lord: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.WEB: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.ASV: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against Jehovah; and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se assim não o fizerdes, eis que havereis pecado ao SENHOR; e sabei que vos alcançará vosso pecado.
verses.RVR09: Mas si así no lo hiciereis, he aquí habréis pecado á Jehová; y sabed que os alcanzará vuestro pecado.

verses.KJV: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.WEB: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
verses.ASV: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Edificai-vos cidades para vossas crianças, e currais para vossas ovelhas, e fazei o que saiu de vossa boca.
verses.RVR09: Edificaos ciudades para vuestros niños, y majadas para vuestras ovejas, y haced lo que ha salido de vuestra boca.

verses.KJV: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.WEB: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.ASV: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falaram os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben a Moisés, dizendo: Teus servos farão como meu senhor mandou.
verses.RVR09: Y hablaron los hijos de Gad y los hijos de Rubén á Moisés, diciendo: Tus siervos harán como mi señor ha mandado.

verses.KJV: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.WEB: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
verses.ASV: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossas crianças, nossas mulheres, nossos gados, e todos nossos animais, estarão aí nas cidades de Gileade;
verses.RVR09: Nuestros niños, nuestras mujeres, nuestros ganados, y todas nuestras bestias, estarán ahí en las ciudades de Galaad;

verses.KJV: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.WEB: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”
verses.ASV: but thy servants will pass over, every man that is armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teus servos, armados todos de guerra, passarão diante do SENHOR à guerra, da maneira que meu senhor disse.
verses.RVR09: Y tus siervos, armados todos de guerra, pasarán delante de Jehová á la guerra, de la manera que mi señor dice.

verses.KJV: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.WEB: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: So Moses gave charge concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os encomendou Moisés a Eleazar o sacerdote, e a Josué filho de Num, e aos príncipes dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los encomendó Moisés á Eleazar el sacerdote, y á Josué hijo de Nun, y á los príncipes de los padres de las tribus de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.WEB: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
verses.ASV: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man that is armed to battle, before Jehovah, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes Moisés: Se os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben, passarem convosco o Jordão, todos armados para a guerra diante do SENHOR, logo que aquela terra for subjugada diante de vós, lhes dareis a terra de Gileade como propriedade;
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Moisés: Si los hijos de Gad y los hijos de Rubén, pasaren con vosotros el Jordán, armados todos de guerra delante de Jehová, luego que el país fuere sojuzgado delante de vosotros, les daréis la tierra de Galaad en posesión:

verses.KJV: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
verses.ASV: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se não passarem armados convosco, então terão propriedade entre vós na terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Mas si no pasaren armados con vosotros, entonces tendrán posesión entre vosotros en la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the Lord hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.WEB: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.
verses.ASV: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben responderam, dizendo: Faremos o que o SENHOR disse a teus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Gad y los hijos de Rubén respondieron, diciendo: Haremos lo que Jehová ha dicho á tus siervos.

verses.KJV: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be our's.
verses.WEB: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
verses.ASV: We will pass over armed before Jehovah into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance [shall remain] with us beyond the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós passaremos armados diante do SENHOR à terra de Canaã, e a propriedade de nossa herança será desta parte do Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros pasaremos armados delante de Jehová á la tierra de Canaán, y la posesión de nuestra heredad será de esta parte del Jordán.

verses.KJV: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
verses.WEB: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
verses.ASV: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to the cities thereof with [their] borders, even the cities of the land round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim lhes deu Moisés aos filhos de Gade e aos filhos de Rúben, e à meia tribo de Manassés filho de José, o reino de Seom, rei amorreu, e o reino de Ogue, rei de Basã, a terra com suas cidades e termos, as cidades da terra em redor.
verses.RVR09: Así les dió Moisés á los hijos de Gad y á los hijos de Rubén, y á la media tribu de Manasés hijo de José, el reino de Sehón rey Amorrheo, y el reino de Og rey de Basán, la tierra con sus ciudades y términos, las ciudades del país alrededor.

verses.KJV: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.WEB: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
verses.ASV: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Gade edificaram a Dibom, e a Atarote, e a Aroer,
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Gad edificaron á Dibón, y á Ataroth, y á Aroer,

verses.KJV: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.WEB: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
verses.ASV: and Atroth-shophan, and Jazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Atarote-Sofã, e a Jazer, e a Jogbeá,
verses.RVR09: Y á Atroth-sophan, y á Jazer, y á Jogbaa,

verses.KJV: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
verses.WEB: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.
verses.ASV: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Bete-Ninra, e a Bete-Harã: cidades fortificadas, e também currais para ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y á Beth-nimra, y á Betharán: ciudades fuertes, y también majadas para ovejas.

verses.KJV: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
verses.WEB: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
verses.ASV: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kiriathaim,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Rúben edificaram a Hesbom, e a Eleale, e a Quiriataim,
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Rubén edificaron á Hesbón, y á Eleale, y á Kiriathaim,

verses.KJV: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.WEB: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
verses.ASV: and Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Sibmah: and they gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Nebo, e a Baal-Meom, (mudados os nomes), e a Sibma: e puseram nomes às cidades que edificaram.
verses.RVR09: Y á Nebo, y á Baal-meón, (mudados los nombres), y á Sibma: y pusieron nombres á las ciudades que edificaron.

verses.KJV: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
verses.WEB: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
verses.ASV: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites that were therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Maquir filho de Manassés foram a Gileade, e tomaram-na, e expulsaram aos amorreus que estavam nela.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Machîr hijo de Manasés fueron á Galaad, y tomáronla, y echaron al Amorrheo que estaba en ella.

verses.KJV: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.WEB: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
verses.ASV: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés deu Gileade a Maquir filho de Manassés, o qual habitou nela.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés dió Galaad á Machîr hijo de Manasés, el cual habitó en ella.

verses.KJV: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
verses.WEB: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
verses.ASV: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the towns thereof, and called them Havvoth-jair.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Jair filho de Manassés foi e tomou suas aldeias, e pôs-lhes por nome Havote-Jair.
verses.RVR09: También Jair hijo de Manasés fué y tomó sus aldeas, y púsoles por nombre Havoth-jair.

verses.KJV: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.WEB: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.ASV: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Noba foi e tomou a Quenate e suas aldeias, e chamou-lhe Noba, conforme seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo Noba fué y tomó á Kenath y sus aldeas, y llamóle Noba, conforme á su nombre.

verses.KJV: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.WEB: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.ASV: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went forth out of the land of Egypt by their hosts under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as jornadas dos filhos de Israel, os quais saíram da terra do Egito por seus esquadrões, sob a condução de Moisés e Arão.
verses.RVR09: ESTAS son las estancias de los hijos de Israel, los cuales salieron de la tierra de Egipto por sus escuadrones, bajo la conducta de Moisés y Aarón.

verses.KJV: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.WEB: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.
