verses.ASV: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Jehovah: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés escreveu suas saídas conforme suas jornadas por ordem do SENHOR. Estas, pois, são suas jornadas conforme suas partidas.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés escribió sus salidas conforme á sus jornadas por mandato de Jehová. Estas, pues, son sus estancias con arreglo á sus partidas.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
verses.ALMEIDA: De Ramessés partiram no mês primeiro, aos quinze dias do mês primeiro: no segundo dia da páscoa saíram os filhos de Israel com mão alta, à vista de todos os egípcios.
verses.RVR09: De Rameses partieron en el mes primero, á los quince días del mes primero: el segundo día de la pascua salieron los hijos de Israel con mano alta, á ojos de todos los Egipcios.

verses.KJV: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.
verses.WEB: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.
verses.ASV: while the Egyptians were burying all their first-born, whom Jehovah had smitten among them: upon their gods also Jehovah executed judgments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estavam enterrando os egípcios os que o SENHOR havia matado deles, a todo primogênito; havendo o SENHOR feito também juízos em seus deuses.
verses.RVR09: Estaban enterrando los Egipcios los que Jehová había muerto de ellos, á todo primogénito; habiendo Jehová hecho también juicios en sus dioses.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Partiram, pois, os filhos de Israel de Ramessés, e assentaram acampamento em Sucote.
verses.RVR09: Partieron, pues, los hijos de Israel de Rameses, y asentaron campo en Succoth.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partindo de Sucote, assentaram em Etã, que está ao extremo do deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y partiendo de Succoth, asentaron en Etham, que está al cabo del desierto.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Etham, and turned back unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partindo de Etã, voltaram sobre Pi-Hairote, que está diante de Baal-Zefom, e assentaram diante de Migdol.
verses.RVR09: Y partiendo de Etham, volvieron sobre Pi-hahiroth, que está delante de Baalsephon, y asentaron delante de Migdol.

verses.KJV: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days'journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness: and they went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partindo de Pi-Hairote, passaram por meio do mar ao deserto, e andaram caminho de três dias pelo deserto de Etã, e assentaram em Mara.
verses.RVR09: Y partiendo de Pi-hahiroth, pasaron por medio de la mar al desierto, y anduvieron camino de tres días por el desierto de Etham, y asentaron en Mara.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and threescore and ten palm-trees; and they encamped there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partindo de Mara, vieram a Elim, de onde havia doze fontes de águas, e setenta palmeiras; e assentaram ali.
verses.RVR09: Y partiendo de Mara, vinieron á Elim, donde había doce fuentes de aguas, y setenta palmeras; y asentaron allí.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Elim, assentaram junto ao mar Vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Elim, asentaron junto al mar Bermejo.

verses.KJV: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.WEB: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos do mar Vermelho, assentaram no deserto de Sim.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos del mar Bermejo, asentaron en el desierto de Sin.

verses.KJV: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos do deserto de Sim, assentaram em Dofca.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos del desierto de Sin, asentaron en Dophca.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Dofca, assentaram em Alus.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Dophca, asentaron en Alús.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Alus, assentaram em Refidim, onde o povo não teve águas para beber.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Alús, asentaron en Rephidim, donde el pueblo no tuvo aguas para beber.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Refidim, assentaram no deserto de Sinai.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Rephidim, asentaron en el desierto de Sinaí.

verses.KJV: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos do deserto de Sinai, assentaram em Quibrote-Taavá.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos del desierto de Sinaí, asentaron en Kibroth-hataava.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Quibrote-Taavá, assentaram em Hazerote.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Kibroth-hataava, asentaron en Haseroth.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Hazerote, assentaram em Ritmá.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Haseroth, asentaron en Ritma.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon-perez.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Ritmá, assentaram em Rimom-Perez.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Ritma, asentaron en Rimmón-peres.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Rimmon-perez, and encamped in Libnah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Rimom-Perez, assentaram em Libna.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Rimmón-peres, asentaron en Libna.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Libna, assentaram em Rissa.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Libna, asentaron en Rissa.

verses.KJV: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Rissa, assentaram em Queelata,
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Rissa, asentaron en Ceelatha.

verses.KJV: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Kehelathah, and encamped in mount Shepher.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Queelata, assentaram no monte de Séfer.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Ceelatha, asentaron en el monte de Sepher.

verses.KJV: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos do monte de Séfer, assentaram em Harada.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos del monte de Sepher, asentaron en Harada.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Harada, assentaram em Maquelote.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Harada, asentaron en Maceloth.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Maquelote, assentaram em Taate.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Maceloth, asentaron en Tahath.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Taate, assentaram em Tera.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Tahath, asentaron en Tara.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Tera, assentaram em Mitca.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Tara, asentaron en Mithca.

verses.KJV: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Mitca, assentaram em Hasmona.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Mithca, asentaron en Hasmona.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Hasmona, assentaram em Moserote.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Hasmona, asentaron en Moseroth.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene-jaakan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Moserote, assentaram em Bene-Jaacã.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Moseroth, asentaron en Bene-jaacán.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped in Hor-haggidgad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Bene-Jaacã, assentaram em Hor-Gidgade.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Bene-jaacán, asentaron en el monte de Gidgad.

verses.KJV: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Hor-haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Hor-Gidgade, assentaram em Jotbatá.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos del monte de Gidgad, asentaron en Jotbatha.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Jotbatá, assentaram em Abrona.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Jotbatha, asentaron en Abrona.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion-geber.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Abrona, assentaram em Eziom-Geber.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Abrona, asentaron en Esion-geber.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Ezion-geber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin (the same is Kadesh).
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Eziom-Geber, assentaram no deserto de Zim, que é Cades.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Esion-geber, asentaron en el desierto de Zin, que es Cades.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Cades, assentaram no monte de Hor, na extremidade da terra de Edom.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Cades, asentaron en el monte de Hor, en la extremidad del país de Edom.

verses.KJV: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
verses.WEB: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
verses.ASV: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of Jehovah, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu Arão o sacerdote ao monte de Hor, conforme o dito do SENHOR, e ali morreu aos quarenta anos da saída dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, no mês quinto, no primeiro dia do mês.
verses.RVR09: Y subió Aarón el sacerdote al monte de Hor, conforme al dicho de Jehová, y allí murió á los cuarenta años de la salida de los hijos de Israel de la tierra de Egipto, en el mes quinto, en el primero del mes.

verses.KJV: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.WEB: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
verses.ASV: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era Arão de idade de cento e vinte e três anos, quando morreu no monte de Hor.
verses.RVR09: Y era Aarón de edad de ciento y veinte y tres años, cuando murió en el monte de Hor.

verses.KJV: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o cananeu, rei de Arade, que habitava ao sul na terra de Canaã, ouviu como haviam vindo os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y el Cananeo, rey de Arad, que habitaba al mediodía en la tierra de Canaán, oyó como habían venido los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos do monte de Hor, assentaram em Zalmona.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos del monte de Hor, asentaron en Salmona.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Zalmona, assentaram em Punom.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Salmona, asentaron en Phunón.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Punom, assentaram em Obote.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Phunón, asentaron en Oboth.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped in Iye-abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Obote, assentaram em Ijé-Abarim; no termo de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Oboth, asentaron en Ije-abarim; en el término de Moab.

verses.KJV: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon-gad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Ijé-Abarim, assentaram em Dibom-Gade.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Ije-abarim, asentaron en Dibon-gad.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Dibom-Gade, assentaram em Almom-Diblataim.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Dibon-gad, asentaron en Almon-diblathaim.

verses.KJV: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.WEB: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from Almon-diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos de Almom-Diblataim, assentaram nos montes de Abarim, diante de Nebo.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Almon-diblathaim, asentaron en los montes de Abarim, delante de Nebo.

verses.KJV: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.WEB: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ASV: And they journeyed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partidos dos montes de Abarim, assentaram nos campos de Moabe, junto ao Jordão de Jericó.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de los montes de Abarim, asentaron en los campos de Moab, junto al Jordán de Jericó.

verses.KJV: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.WEB: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.ASV: And they encamped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Finalmente assentaram junto ao Jordão, desde Bete-Jesimote até Abel-Sitim, nos campos de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Finalmente asentaron junto al Jordán, desde Beth-jesimoth hasta Abel-sitim, en los campos de Moab.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés nos campos de Moabe junto ao Jordão de Jericó, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés en los campos de Moab junto al Jordán de Jericó, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.WEB: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes passado o Jordão à terra de Canaã,
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando hubiereis pasado el Jordán á la tierra de Canaán,

verses.KJV: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.WEB: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
verses.ASV: then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their figured [stones], and destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places:
verses.ALMEIDA: Expulsareis a todos os moradores daquela terra de diante de vós, e destruireis todas suas imagens esculpidas, e todas as suas imagens de fundição, e arruinareis todos os seus altares pagãos;
verses.RVR09: Echaréis á todos los moradores del país de delante de vosotros, y destruiréis todas sus pinturas, y todas sus imágenes de fundición, y arruinaréis todos sus altos;

verses.KJV: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.WEB: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
verses.ASV: and ye shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for unto you have I given the land to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E expulsareis os moradores da terra, e habitareis nela; porque eu a dei a vós para que a possuais.
verses.RVR09: Y echaréis los moradores de la tierra, y habitaréis en ella; porque yo os la he dado para que la poseáis.

verses.KJV: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
verses.WEB: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
verses.ASV: And ye shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance: wheresoever the lot falleth to any man, that shall be his; according to the tribes of your fathers shall ye inherit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E herdareis a terra por sortes por vossas famílias: aos muitos dareis muito por sua herança, e aos poucos dareis menos por herança sua: onde lhe sair a sorte, ali a terá cada um: pelas tribos de vossos pais herdareis.
verses.RVR09: Y heredaréis la tierra por suertes por vuestras familias: á los muchos daréis mucho por su heredad, y á los pocos daréis menos por heredad suya: donde le saliere la suerte, allí la tendrá cada uno: por las tribus de vuestros padres heredaréis.

verses.KJV: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.WEB: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
verses.ASV: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then shall those that ye let remain of them be as pricks in your eyes, and as thorns in your sides, and they shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não expulsardes os moradores daquela terra de diante de vós, sucederá que os que deixardes deles serão por aguilhões em vossos olhos, e por espinhos em vossos lados, e vos afligirão sobre a terra em que vós habitardes.
verses.RVR09: Y si no echareis los moradores del país de delante de vosotros, sucederá que los que dejareis de ellos serán por aguijones en vuestros ojos, y por espinas en vuestros costados, y afligiros han sobre la tierra en que vosotros habitareis.

verses.KJV: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.WEB: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that, as I thought to do unto them, so will I do unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será também, que farei a vós como eu pensei fazer a eles.
verses.RVR09: Será además, que haré á vosotros como yo pensé hacerles á ellos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y JEHOVÁ habló á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.WEB: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
verses.ASV: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to the borders thereof),
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra de Canaã, a saber, a terra que vos há de cair em herança, a terra de Canaã segundo seus termos;
verses.RVR09: Manda á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando hubiereis entrado en la tierra de Canaán, es á saber, la tierra que os ha de caer en heredad, la tierra de Canaán según sus términos;

verses.KJV: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.WEB: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
verses.ASV: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tereis o lado do sul desde o deserto de Zim até os termos de Edom; e vos será o termo do sul ao extremo do mar salgado até o oriente:
verses.RVR09: Tendréis el lado del mediodía desde el desierto de Zin hasta los términos de Edom; y os será el término del mediodía al extremo del mar salado hacia el oriente:

verses.KJV: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.WEB: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
verses.ASV: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out thereof shall be southward of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar-addar, and pass along to Azmon;
verses.ALMEIDA: E este termo vos irá rodeando desde o sul até a subida de Acrabim, e passará até Zim; e suas saídas serão do sul a Cades-Barneia; e sairá a Hazar-Adar, e passará até Azmom;
verses.RVR09: Y este término os irá rodeando desde el mediodía hasta la subida de Acrabbim, y pasará hasta Zin; y sus salidas serán del mediodía á Cades-barnea; y saldrá á Hasar-addar, y pasará hasta Asmón;

verses.KJV: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.WEB: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
verses.ASV: and the border shall turn about from Azmon unto the brook of Egypt, and the goings out thereof shall be at the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E rodeará este termo, desde Azmom até o ribeiro do Egito, e seus limites serão ao ocidente.
verses.RVR09: Y rodeará este término, desde Asmón hasta el torrente de Egipto, y sus remates serán al occidente.

verses.KJV: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.WEB: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
verses.ASV: And for the western border, ye shall have the great sea and the border [thereof]: this shall be your west border.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o termo ocidental vos será o grande mar: este termo vos será o termo ocidental.
verses.RVR09: Y el término occidental os será la gran mar: este término os será el término occidental.

verses.KJV: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.WEB: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
verses.ASV: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall mark out for you mount Hor;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o termo do norte será este: desde o grande mar vos assinalareis o monte de Hor;
verses.RVR09: Y el término del norte será este: desde la gran mar os señalaréis el monte de Hor;

verses.KJV: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.WEB: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
verses.ASV: from mount Hor ye shall mark out unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;
verses.ALMEIDA: Do monte de Hor assinalareis à entrada de Hamate, e serão as saídas daquele termo a Zedade;
verses.RVR09: Del monte de Hor señalaréis á la entrada de Hamath, y serán las salidas de aquel término á Sedad;

verses.KJV: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
verses.WEB: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
verses.ASV: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out thereof shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sairá este termo a Zifrom, e serão seus limites em Hazar-Enã: este vos será o termo do norte.
verses.RVR09: Y saldrá este término á Ziphón, y serán sus remates en Hasar-enán: este os será el término del norte.

verses.KJV: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
verses.WEB: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
verses.ASV: And ye shall mark out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham;
verses.ALMEIDA: E por termo ao oriente vos assinalareis desde Hazar-Enã até Sefã;
verses.RVR09: Y por término al oriente os señalaréis desde Hasar-enán hasta Sepham;

verses.KJV: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
verses.WEB: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
verses.ASV: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;
verses.ALMEIDA: E baixará este termo desde Sefã a Ribla, ao oriente de Aim: e descerá o termo, e chegará à costa do mar de Quinerete ao oriente;
verses.RVR09: Y bajará este término desde Sepham á Ribla, al oriente de Ain: y descenderá el término, y llegará á la costa de la mar de Cinnereth al oriente;

verses.KJV: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.WEB: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
verses.ASV: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and the goings out thereof shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to the borders thereof round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois descerá este termo ao Jordão, e serão suas saídas ao mar Salgado: esta será vossa terra: por seus termos ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Después descenderá este término al Jordán, y serán sus salidas al mar Salado: esta será vuestra tierra: por sus términos alrededor.

verses.KJV: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the Lord commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.WEB: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
verses.ASV: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which Jehovah hath commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou Moisés aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Esta é a terra que herdareis por sorte, a qual mandou o SENHOR que desse às nove tribos, e à meia tribo:
verses.RVR09: Y mandó Moisés á los hijos de Israel, diciendo: Esta es la tierra que heredaréis por suerte, la cual mandó Jehová que diese á las nueve tribus, y á la media tribu:

verses.KJV: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.WEB: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
verses.ASV: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a tribo dos filhos de Rúben segundo as casas de seus pais, e a tribo dos filhos de Gade segundo as casas de seus pais, e a meia tribo de Manassés, tomaram sua herança:
verses.RVR09: Porque la tribu de los hijos de Rubén según las casas de sus padres, y la tribu de los hijos de Gad según las casas de sus padres, y la media tribu de Manasés, han tomado su herencia:

verses.KJV: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.WEB: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
verses.ASV: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.ALMEIDA: Duas tribos e meia tomaram sua herança desta parte do Jordão de Jericó ao oriente, ao oriente.
verses.RVR09: Dos tribus y media tomaron su heredad de esta parte del Jordán de Jericó al oriente, al nacimiento del sol.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.WEB: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.ASV: These are the names of the men that shall divide the land unto you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os nomes dos homens que vos possuirão a terra: Eleazar o sacerdote, e Josué filho de Num.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los nombres de los varones que os aposesionarán la tierra: Eleazar el sacerdote, y Josué hijo de Nun.

verses.KJV: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.WEB: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
verses.ASV: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomareis também de cada tribo um príncipe, para dar a possessão da terra.
verses.RVR09: Tomaréis también de cada tribu un príncipe, para dar la posesión de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.ASV: And these are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os nomes dos homens: Da tribo de Judá, Calebe filho de Jefoné.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los nombres de los varones: De la tribu de Judá, Caleb hijo de Jephone.

verses.KJV: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, Samuel filho de Amiúde.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de los hijos de Simeón, Samuel hijo de Ammiud.

verses.KJV: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.ASV: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da tribo de Benjamim; Elidade filho de Quislom.
verses.RVR09: De la tribu de Benjamín, Elidad hijo de Chislón.

verses.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo dos filhos de Dã, o príncipe Buqui filho de Jogli.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de los hijos de Dan, el príncipe Bucci hijo de Jogli.

verses.KJV: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.WEB: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.ASV: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de José: da tribo dos filhos de Manassés, o príncipe Haniel filho de Éfode.
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de José: de la tribu de los hijos de Manasés, el príncipe Haniel hijo de Ephod.

verses.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo dos filhos de Efraim, o príncipe Quemuel filho de Siftã.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de los hijos de Ephraim, el príncipe Chêmuel hijo de Siphtán.

verses.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo dos filhos de Zebulom, o príncipe Elizafã filho de Parnaque.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de los hijos de Zabulón, el príncipe Elisaphán hijo de Pharnach.

verses.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo dos filhos de Issacar, o príncipe Paltiel filho de Azã.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de los hijos de Issachâr, el príncipe Paltiel hijo de Azan.

verses.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo dos filhos de Aser, o príncipe Aiúde filho de Selomi.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de los hijos de Aser, el príncipe Ahiud hijo de Selomi.

verses.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
verses.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo dos filhos de Naftali, o príncipe Pedael filho de Amiúde.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de los hijos de Nephtalí, el príncipe Pedael hijo de Ammiud.

verses.KJV: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.WEB: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.ASV: These are they whom Jehovah commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são aos que mandou o SENHOR que fizessem a partição da herança aos filhos de Israel na terra de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: Estos son á los que mandó Jehová que hiciesen la partición de la herencia á los hijos de Israel en la tierra de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés nos campos de Moabe, junto ao Jordão de Jericó, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Jehová á Moisés en los campos de Moab, junto al Jordán de Jericó, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
verses.WEB: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.
verses.ASV: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and suburbs for the cities round about them shall ye give unto the Levites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda aos filhos de Israel, que deem aos levitas da possessão de sua herança cidades em que habitem: Também dareis aos levitas campos de essas cidades ao redor delas.
verses.RVR09: Manda á los hijos de Israel, que den á los Levitas de la posesión de su heredad ciudades en que habiten: también daréis á los Levitas los ejidos de esas ciudades alrededor de ellas.

verses.KJV: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.WEB: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.
verses.ASV: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and their suburbs shall be for their cattle, and for their substance, and for all their beasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E terão eles as cidades para habitar, e os campos delas serão para seus animais, e para seus gados, e para todos seus animais.
verses.RVR09: Y tendrán ellos las ciudades para habitar, y los ejidos de ellas serán para sus animales, y para sus ganados, y para todas sus bestias.

verses.KJV: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.WEB: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.
verses.ASV: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os campos das cidades que dareis aos levitas, serão mil côvados ao redor, desde o muro da cidade para fora.
verses.RVR09: Y los ejidos de las ciudades que daréis á los Levitas, serán mil codos alrededor, desde el muro de la ciudad para afuera.

verses.KJV: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
verses.WEB: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.
verses.ASV: And ye shall measure without the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the midst. This shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo medireis fora da cidade à parte do oriente dois mil côvados, e à parte do sul dois mil côvados, e à parte do ocidente dois mil côvados, e à parte do norte dois mil côvados, e a cidade em meio: isto terão pelos campos das cidades.
verses.RVR09: Luego mediréis fuera de la ciudad á la parte del oriente dos mil codos, y á la parte del mediodía dos mil codos, y á la parte del occidente dos mil codos, y á la parte del norte dos mil codos, y la ciudad en medio: esto tendrán por los ejidos de las ciudades.

verses.KJV: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
verses.WEB: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.
verses.ASV: And the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which ye shall give for the manslayer to flee unto: and besides them ye shall give forty and two cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E das cidades que dareis aos levitas, seis cidades serão de refúgio, as quais dareis para que o homicida se acolha ali: e também destas dareis quarenta e duas cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y de las ciudades que daréis á los Levitas, seis ciudades serán de acogimiento, las cuales daréis para que el homicida se acoja allá: y además de éstas daréis cuarenta y dos ciudades.

verses.KJV: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
verses.WEB: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.
verses.ASV: All the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities; them [shall ye give] with their suburbs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as cidades que dareis aos levitas serão quarenta e oito cidades; elas com seus campos.
verses.RVR09: Todas las ciudades que daréis á los Levitas serán cuarenta y ocho ciudades; ellas con sus ejidos.

verses.KJV: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
verses.WEB: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”
verses.ASV: And concerning the cities which ye shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many ye shall take many; and from the few ye shall take few: every one according to his inheritance which he inheriteth shall give of his cities unto the Levites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as cidades que deres da herança dos filhos de Israel, do que muito tomareis muito, e do que pouco tomareis pouco: cada um dará de suas cidades aos levitas segundo a possessão que herdará.
verses.RVR09: Y las ciudades que diereis de la heredad de los hijos de Israel, del que mucho tomaréis mucho, y del que poco tomaréis poco: cada uno dará de sus ciudades á los Levitas según la posesión que heredará.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Moisés, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes passado o Jordão à terra de Canaã,
verses.RVR09: Habla á los hijos de Israel, y diles: Cuando hubiereis pasado el Jordán á la tierra de Canaán,

verses.KJV: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
verses.WEB: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
verses.ASV: then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer that killeth any person unwittingly may flee thither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assinalareis para vós cidades, tereis cidades de refúgio, para onde fuja o homicida que ferir a algum de morte por acidente.
verses.RVR09: Os señalaréis ciudades, ciudades de acogimiento tendréis, donde huya el homicida que hiriere á alguno de muerte por yerro.

verses.KJV: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
verses.WEB: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
verses.ASV: And the cities shall be unto you for refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation for judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos serão aquelas cidades por refúgio do parente, e não morrerá o homicida até que esteja a juízo diante da congregação.
verses.RVR09: Y os serán aquellas ciudades por acogimiento del pariente, y no morirá el homicida hasta que esté á juicio delante de la congregación.

verses.KJV: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
verses.WEB: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
verses.ASV: And the cities which ye shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Das cidades, pois, que dareis, tereis seis cidades de refúgio.
verses.RVR09: De las ciudades, pues, que daréis, tendréis seis ciudades de acogimiento.

verses.KJV: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
verses.WEB: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.
verses.ASV: Ye shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Três cidades dareis desta parte do Jordão, e três cidades dareis na terra de Canaã; as quais serão cidades de refúgio.
verses.RVR09: Tres ciudades daréis de esta parte del Jordán, y tres ciudades daréis en la tierra de Canaán; las cuales serán ciudades de acogimiento.

verses.KJV: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.WEB: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
verses.ASV: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the sojourner among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that every one that killeth any person unwittingly may flee thither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas seis cidades serão para refúgio aos filhos de Israel, e ao peregrino, e ao que morar entre eles, para que fuja ali qualquer um que ferir de morte a outro por acidente.
verses.RVR09: Estas seis ciudades serán para acogimiento á los hijos de Israel, y al peregrino, y al que morare entre ellos, para que huya allá cualquiera que hiriere de muerte á otro por yerro.

verses.KJV: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: But if he smote him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se com instrumento de ferro o ferir e morrer, homicida é; o homicida morrerá:
verses.RVR09: Y si con instrumento de hierro lo hiriere y muriere, homicida es; el homicida morirá:

verses.KJV: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: And if he smote him with a stone in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se com pedra da mão, de que podia morrer, o ferir, e morrer, homicida é; o homicida morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y si con piedra de mano, de que pueda morir, lo hiriere, y muriere, homicida es; el homicida morirá.

verses.KJV: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.WEB: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: Or if he smote him with a weapon of wood in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se com instrumento de madeira da mão, de que podia morrer, o ferir, e morrer, homicida é; o homicida morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y si con instrumento de palo de mano, de que pueda morir, lo hiriere, y muriere, homicida es; el homicida morirá.

verses.KJV: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
verses.WEB: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.
verses.ASV: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death: when he meeteth him, he shall put him to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: O parente do morto, ele matará ao homicida: quando o encontrar, ele lhe matará.
verses.RVR09: El pariente del muerto, él matará al homicida: cuando lo encontrare, él le matará.

verses.KJV: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
verses.WEB: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,
verses.ASV: And if he thrust him of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,
verses.ALMEIDA: E se por ódio o empurrou, ou lançou sobre ele alguma coisa por ciladas, e morre;
verses.RVR09: Y si por odio lo empujó, ó echó sobre él alguna cosa por asechanzas, y muere;

verses.KJV: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
verses.WEB: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.
verses.ASV: or in enmity smote him with his hand, so that he died; he that smote him shall surely be put to death; he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meeteth him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou por inimizade o feriu com sua mão, e morreu: o feridor morrerá; é homicida; o parente do morto matará ao homicida, quando o encontrar.
verses.RVR09: O por enemistad lo hirió con su mano, y murió: el heridor morirá; es homicida; el pariente del muerto matará al homicida, cuando lo encontrare.

verses.KJV: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
verses.WEB: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,
verses.ASV: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or hurled upon him anything without lying in wait,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se casualmente o empurrou sem inimizades, ou lançou sobre ele qualquer instrumento sem más intenções,
verses.RVR09: Mas si casualmente lo empujó sin enemistades, ó echó sobre él cualquier instrumento sin asechanzas,

verses.KJV: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
verses.WEB: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,
verses.ASV: or with any stone, whereby a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou bem, sem vê-lo, fez cair sobre ele alguma pedra, de que possa morrer, e morrer, e ele não era seu inimigo, nem procurava seu mal;
verses.RVR09: O bien, sin verlo, hizo caer sobre él alguna piedra, de que pudo morir, y muriere, y él no era su enemigo, ni procuraba su mal;

verses.KJV: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.WEB: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
verses.ASV: then the congregation shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a congregação julgará entre o feridor e o parente do morto conforme estas leis:
verses.RVR09: Entonces la congregación juzgará entre el heridor y el pariente del muerto conforme á estas leyes:

verses.KJV: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.WEB: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.ASV: and the congregation shall deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a congregação livrará ao homicida da mão do parente do morto, e a congregação o fará voltar à seu cidade de refúgio, à qual se havia acolhido; e morará nela até que morra o sumo sacerdote, o qual foi ungido com o azeite santo.
verses.RVR09: Y la congregación librará al homicida de mano del pariente del muerto, y la congregación lo hará volver á su ciudad de acogimiento, á la cual se había acogido; y morará en ella hasta que muera el gran sacerdote, el cual fué ungido con el aceite santo.

verses.KJV: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.WEB: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,
verses.ASV: But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, whither he fleeth,
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o homicida sair fora do termo de sua cidade de refúgio, à qual se refugiou,
verses.RVR09: Y si el homicida saliere fuera del término de su ciudad de refugio, á la cual se acogió,

verses.KJV: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
verses.WEB: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,
verses.ASV: and the avenger of blood find him without the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood slay the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o parente do morto lhe achar fora do termo da cidade de sua acolhida, e o parente do morto ao homicida matar, não se lhe culpará por isso:
verses.RVR09: Y el pariente del muerto le hallare fuera del término de la ciudad de su acogida, y el pariente del muerto al homicida matare, no se le culpará por ello:

verses.KJV: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.WEB: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.ASV: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the manslayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois em sua cidade de refúgio deverá aquele habitar até que morra o sumo sacerdote: e depois que morrer o sumo sacerdote, o homicida voltará à terra de sua possessão.
verses.RVR09: Pues en su ciudad de refugio deberá aquél habitar hasta que muera el gran sacerdote: y después que muriere el gran sacerdote, el homicida volverá á la tierra de su posesión.

verses.KJV: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.WEB: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.ASV: And these things shall be for a statute [and] ordinance unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas coisas vos serão por ordenança de regulamento por vossas gerações, em todas as vossas habitações.
verses.RVR09: Y estas cosas os serán por ordenanza de derecho por vuestras edades, en todas vuestras habitaciones.

verses.KJV: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
verses.WEB: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.
verses.ASV: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que ferir a alguém, por dito de testemunhas, morrerá o homicida: mas uma só testemunha não fará fé contra alguma pessoa para que morra.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que hiriere á alguno, por dicho de testigos, morirá el homicida: mas un solo testigo no hará fe contra alguna persona para que muera.

verses.KJV: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
verses.WEB: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
verses.ASV: Moreover ye shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer, that is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não tomareis preço pela vida do homicida; porque está condenado a morte: mas inevitavelmente morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y no tomaréis precio por la vida del homicida; porque está condenado á muerte: mas indefectiblemente morirá.

verses.KJV: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.WEB: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.
verses.ASV: And ye shall take no ransom for him that is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem tampouco tomareis preço do que fugiu à sua cidade de refúgio, para que volte a viver em sua terra, até que morra o sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Ni tampoco tomaréis precio del que huyó á su ciudad de refugio, para que vuelva á vivir en su tierra, hasta que muera el sacerdote.

verses.KJV: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.WEB: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.
verses.ASV: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood, it polluteth the land; and no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não contaminareis a terra onde estiverdes: porque este sangue profanará a terra: e a terra não será expiada do sangue que foi derramado nela, a não ser pelo sangue do que a derramou.
verses.RVR09: Y no contaminaréis la tierra donde estuviereis: porque esta sangre amancillará la tierra: y la tierra no será expiada de la sangre que fué derramada en ella, sino por la sangre del que la derramó.

verses.KJV: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the Lord dwell among the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not defile the land which ye inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell: for I, Jehovah, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não contamineis, pois, a terra onde habitais, em meio da qual eu habito; porque eu o SENHOR habito em meio dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: No contaminéis, pues, la tierra donde habitáis, en medio de la cual yo habito; porque yo Jehová habito en medio de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
verses.WEB: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the children of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram os príncipes dos pais da família de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, das famílias dos filhos de José; e falaram diante de Moisés, e dos príncipes, cabeças de pais dos filhos de Israel,
verses.RVR09: Y LLEGARON los príncipes de los padres de la familia de Galaad, hijo de Machîr, hijo de Manasés, de las familias de los hijos de José; y hablaron delante de Moisés, y de los príncipes, cabezas de padres de los hijos de Israel,

verses.KJV: And they said, The Lord commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.WEB: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
verses.ASV: and they said, Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram: o SENHOR mandou a meu senhor que por sorte desse a terra aos filhos de Israel em possessão: também mandou o SENHOR a meu senhor, que dê a possessão de Zelofeade nosso irmão a suas filhas;
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron: Jehová mandó á mi señor que por suerte diese la tierra á los hijos de Israel en posesión: también ha mandado Jehová á mi señor, que dé la posesión de Salphaad nuestro hermano á sus hijas;

verses.KJV: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.WEB: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.ASV: And if they be married to any of the sons of the [other] tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: As quais, se se casarem com alguns dos filhos das outras tribos dos filhos de Israel, a herança delas será assim tirada da herança de nossos pais, e será acrescentada à herança da tribo a que serão unidas: e será removida da porção de nossa herança.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales, si se casaren con algunos de los hijos de las otras tribus de los hijos de Israel, la herencia de ellas será así desfalcada de la herencia de nuestros padres, y será añadida á la herencia de la tribu á que serán unidas: y será quitada de la suerte de nuestra heredad.

verses.KJV: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
verses.WEB: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
verses.ASV: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vier o jubileu dos filhos de Israel, a herança delas será acrescentada à herança da tribo de seus maridos; e assim a herança delas será removida da herança da tribo de nossos pais.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando viniere el jubileo de los hijos de Israel, la heredad de ellas será añadida á la heredad de la tribu de sus maridos; y así la heredad de ellas será quitada de la heredad de la tribu de nuestros padres.

verses.KJV: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the Lord, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
verses.WEB: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.
verses.ASV: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Jehovah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaketh right.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés mandou aos filhos de Israel por dito do SENHOR, dizendo: A tribo dos filhos de José fala corretamente.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés mandó á los hijos de Israel por dicho de Jehová, diciendo: La tribu de los hijos de José habla rectamente.

verses.KJV: This is the thing which the Lord doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
verses.WEB: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.
verses.ASV: This is the thing which Jehovah doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them be married to whom they think best; only into the family of the tribe of their father shall they be married.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto é o que mandou o SENHOR acerca das filhas de Zelofeade, dizendo: Casem-se como a elas lhes satisfizer, porém na família da tribo de seu pai se casarão;
verses.RVR09: Esto es lo que ha mandado Jehová acerca de las hijas de Salphaad, diciendo: Cásense como á ellas les pluguiere, empero en la familia de la tribu de su padre se casarán;

verses.KJV: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.WEB: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.ASV: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall cleave every one to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que a herança dos filhos de Israel não seja passada de tribo em tribo; porque cada um dos filhos de Israel se achegará à herança da tribo de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Para que la heredad de los hijos de Israel no sea traspasada de tribu en tribu; porque cada uno de los hijos de Israel se allegará á la heredad de la tribu de sus padres.

verses.KJV: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.WEB: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.ASV: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E qualquer filha que possuir herança das tribos dos filhos de Israel, com algum da família da tribo de seu pai se casará, para que os filhos de Israel possuam cada um a herança de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y cualquiera hija que poseyere heredad de las tribus de los hijos de Israel, con alguno de la familia de la tribu de su padre se casará, para que los hijos de Israel posean cada uno la heredad de sus padres,

verses.KJV: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.WEB: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”
