verses.ASV: So shall no inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall cleave every one to his own inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não ande a herança rodando de uma tribo a outra: mas cada uma das tribos dos filhos de Israel se chegue à sua herança.
verses.RVR09: Y no ande la heredad rodando de una tribu á otra: mas cada una de las tribus de los hijos de Israel se llegue á su heredad.

verses.KJV: Even as the Lord commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.WEB: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:
verses.ASV: Even as Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o SENHOR mandou a Moisés, assim fizeram as filhas de Zelofeade.
verses.RVR09: Como Jehová mandó á Moisés, así hicieron las hijas de Salphaad.

verses.KJV: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their fathers brothers' sons:
verses.WEB: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
verses.ASV: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim Maalá, e Tirsa, e Hogla, e Milca, e Noa, filhas de Zelofeade, se casaram com filhos de seus tios:
verses.RVR09: Y así Maala, y Tirsa, y Hogla, y Milchâ, y Noa, hijas de Salphaad, se casaron con hijos de sus tíos:

verses.KJV: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.WEB: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.ASV: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da família dos filhos de Manassés, filho de José, foram mulheres; e a herança delas ficou na tribo da família de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: De la familia de los hijos de Manasés, hijo de José, fueron mujeres; y la heredad de ellas quedó en la tribu de la familia de su padre.

verses.KJV: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.WEB: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ASV: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Jehovah commanded by Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os mandamentos e os estatutos que mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés aos filhos de Israel nos campos de Moabe, junto ao Jordão de Jericó.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los mandamientos y los estatutos que mandó Jehová por mano de Moisés á los hijos de Israel en los campos de Moab, junto al Jordán de Jericó.

verses.KJV: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.WEB: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.ASV: These are the words which Moses spake unto all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah over against Suph, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Di-zahab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as palavras que falou Moisés a todo Israel desta parte do Jordão no deserto, na planície diante do mar Vermelho, entre Parã, e Tofel, e Labã, e Hazerote, e Di-Zaabe.
verses.RVR09: ESTAS son las palabras que habló Moisés á todo Israel de esta parte del Jordán en el desierto, en el llano delante del mar Bermejo, entre Parán, y Thopel, y Labán, y Haseroth, y Dizahab.

verses.KJV: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
verses.WEB: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.ASV: It is eleven days’ [journey] from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onze jornadas há desde Horebe, caminho do monte de Seir, até Cades-Barneia.
verses.RVR09: Once jornadas hay desde Horeb, camino del monte de Seir, hasta Cades-barnea.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the Lord had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.WEB: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that Jehovah had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi, que aos quarenta anos, no mês décimo primeiro, ao primeiro dia do mês, Moisés falou aos filhos de Israel conforme todas as coisas que o SENHOR lhe havia mandado acerca deles;
verses.RVR09: Y fué, que á los cuarenta años, en el mes undécimo, al primero del mes, Moisés habló á los hijos de Israel conforme á todas las cosas que Jehová le había mandado acerca de ellos;

verses.KJV: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.WEB: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
verses.ASV: after he had smitten Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois que feriu a Seom rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, e a Ogue rei de Basã, que habitava em Astarote em Edrei:
verses.RVR09: Después que hirió á Sehón rey de los Amorrheos, que habitaba en Hesbón, y á Og rey de Basán, que habitaba en Astarot en Edrei:

verses.KJV: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.WEB: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,
verses.ASV: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Desta parte do Jordão, em terra de Moabe, resolveu Moisés declarar esta lei, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: De esta parte del Jordán, en tierra de Moab, resolvió Moisés declarar esta ley, diciendo:

verses.KJV: The Lord our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.WEB: “The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.
verses.ASV: Jehovah our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mountain:
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR nosso Deus nos falou em Horebe, dizendo: Demais haveis estado neste monte;
verses.RVR09: Jehová nuestro Dios nos habló en Horeb, diciendo: Harto habéis estado en este monte;

verses.KJV: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.WEB: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.ASV: turn you, and take your journey, and go to the hill-country of the Amorites, and unto all [the places] nigh thereunto, in the Arabah, in the hill-country, and in the lowland, and in the South, and by the sea-shore, the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltai-vos, parti-vos e ide ao monte dos amorreus, e a todos seus vizinhos, na planície, no monte, e nos vales, e ao sul, e à costa do mar, à terra dos cananeus, e o Líbano, até o grande rio, o rio Eufrates.
verses.RVR09: Volveos, partíos é id al monte del Amorrheo, y á todas sus comarcas, en el llano, en el monte, y en los valles, y al mediodía, y á la costa de la mar, á la tierra del Cananeo, y el Líbano, hasta el gran río, el río Eufrates.

verses.KJV: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”
verses.ASV: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which Jehovah sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai, eu dei a terra em vossa presença; entrai e possuí a terra que o SENHOR jurou a vossos pais Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, que lhes daria a eles e à sua descendência depois deles.
verses.RVR09: Mirad, yo he dado la tierra en vuestra presencia; entrad y poseed la tierra que Jehová juró á vuestros padres Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob, que les daría á ellos y á su simiente después de ellos.

verses.KJV: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.WEB: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
verses.ASV: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos falei então, dizendo: Eu não posso vos levar só:
verses.RVR09: Y yo os hablé entonces, diciendo: Yo no puedo llevaros solo:

verses.KJV: The Lord your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.WEB: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.
verses.ASV: Jehovah your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR vosso Deus vos multiplicou, e eis que sois hoje vós como as estrelas do céu em abundância.
verses.RVR09: Jehová vuestro Dios os ha multiplicado, y he aquí sois hoy vosotros como las estrellas del cielo en multitud.

verses.KJV: (The Lord God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
verses.WEB: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!
verses.ASV: Jehovah, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR Deus de vossos pais acrescente sobre vós como sois mil vezes, e vos abençoe, como vos prometeu!
verses.RVR09: ¡Jehová Dios de vuestros padres añada sobre vosotros como sois mil veces, y os bendiga, como os ha prometido!

verses.KJV: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.WEB: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
verses.ASV: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como levarei eu só vossos problemas, vossas cargas, e vossos pleitos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo llevaré yo solo vuestras molestias, vuestras cargas, y vuestros pleitos?

verses.KJV: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.WEB: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
verses.ASV: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known, according to your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai-me dentre vós, de vossas tribos, homens sábios e entendidos e experientes, para que eu os ponha por vossos chefes.
verses.RVR09: Dadme de entre vosotros, de vuestras tribus, varones sabios y entendidos y expertos, para que yo los ponga por vuestros jefes.

verses.KJV: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
verses.WEB: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”
verses.ASV: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good [for us] to do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me respondestes, e dissestes: Bom é fazer o que disseste.
verses.RVR09: Y me respondisteis, y dijisteis: Bueno es hacer lo que has dicho.

verses.KJV: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.WEB: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
verses.ASV: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomei os principais de vossas tribos, homens sábios e experientes, e os pus por chefes sobre vós, chefes de milhares, e chefes de centenas, e chefes de cinquenta, e líderes de dez, e governadores a vossas tribos.
verses.RVR09: Y tomé los principales de vuestras tribus, varones sabios y expertos, y púselos por jefes sobre vosotros, jefes de millares, y jefes de cientos, y jefes de cincuenta, y cabos de diez, y gobernadores á vuestras tribus.

verses.KJV: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.WEB: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.
verses.ASV: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear [the causes] between your brethren, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the sojourner that is with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E então mandei a vossos juízes, dizendo: Ouvi entre vossos irmãos, e julgai justamente entre o homem e seu irmão, e o que lhe é estrangeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces mandé á vuestros jueces, diciendo: Oid entre vuestros hermanos, y juzgad justamente entre el hombre y su hermano, y el que le es extranjero.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.WEB: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”
verses.ASV: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; ye shall hear the small and the great alike; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you ye shall bring unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tenhais acepção de pessoas no juízo: tanto ao pequeno como ao grande ouvireis: não tereis temor de ninguém, porque o juízo é de Deus: e a causa que vos for difícil, a trareis a mim, e eu a ouvirei.
verses.RVR09: No tengáis respeto de personas en el juicio: así al pequeño como al grande oiréis: no tendréis temor de ninguno, porque el juicio es de Dios: y la causa que os fuere difícil, la traeréis á mí, y yo la oiré.

verses.KJV: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.WEB: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
verses.ASV: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos mandei, pois, naquele tempo tudo o que havíeis de fazer.
verses.RVR09: Os mandé, pues, en aquel tiempo todo lo que habíais de hacer.

verses.KJV: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the Lord our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
verses.WEB: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.ASV: And we journeyed from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which ye saw, by the way to the hill-country of the Amorites, as Jehovah our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então partimos de Horebe, e andamos por todo aquele grande e temível deserto que vistes, pelo caminho montanhoso dos amorreus, como o SENHOR, nosso Deus, havia nos mandado; e chegamos a Cades-Barneia.
verses.RVR09: Y partidos de Horeb, anduvimos todo aquel grande y terrible desierto que habéis visto, por el camino del monte del Amorrheo, como Jehová nuestro Dios nos lo mandó; y llegamos hasta Cades-barnea.

verses.KJV: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the Lord our God doth give unto us.
verses.WEB: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.
verses.ASV: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the hill-country of the Amorites, which Jehovah our God giveth unto us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu vos disse: ‘Chegastes à região montanhosa dos amorreus, a qual o SENHOR, nosso Deus, nos dá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces os dije: Llegado habéis al monte del Amorrheo, el cual Jehová nuestro Dios nos da.

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the LORD the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”
verses.ASV: Behold, Jehovah thy God hath set the land before thee: go up, take possession, as Jehovah, the God of thy fathers, hath spoken unto thee; fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o SENHOR, teu Deus, deu diante de ti esta terra; sobe e tomai posse dela, como o SENHOR, o Deus dos teus pais, te disse; não temas nem te apavores.’
verses.RVR09: Mira, Jehová tu Dios ha dado delante de ti la tierra: sube y poséela, como Jehová el Dios de tus padres te ha dicho; no temas ni desmayes.

verses.KJV: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.WEB: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”
verses.ASV: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, Let us send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up, and the cities unto which we shall come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todos vós vos aproximastes de mim, e dissestes: ‘Enviemos homens adiante de nós, que nos reconheçam a terra, e nos tragam de volta relato de qual caminho por onde devemos subir, e das cidades aonde devemos ir.’
verses.RVR09: Y llegasteis á mí todos vosotros, y dijisteis: Enviemos varones delante de nosotros, que nos reconozcan la tierra y nos traigan de vuelta razón del camino por donde hemos de subir, y de las ciudades adonde hemos de llegar.

verses.KJV: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.WEB: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.
verses.ASV: And the thing pleased me well; and I took twelve men of you, one man for every tribe:
verses.ALMEIDA: E isso me pareceu bem. Então tomei doze homens de vós, um homem de cada tribo.
verses.RVR09: Y el dicho me pareció bien: y tomé doce varones de vosotros, un varón por tribu:

verses.KJV: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.WEB: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
verses.ASV: and they turned and went up into the hill-country, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se foram, subiram às montanhas, chegaram ao vale de Escol, e o reconheceram.
verses.RVR09: Y se encaminaron, y subieron al monte, y llegaron hasta la arroyada de Escol, y reconocieron la tierra.

verses.KJV: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the Lord our God doth give us.
verses.WEB: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which the LORD our God gives to us.”
verses.ASV: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which Jehovah our God giveth unto us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram em suas mãos do fruto daquela terra, e o trouxeram a nós, e nos contaram, e disseram: ‘A terra que o SENHOR, nosso Deus, nos dá, é boa.’
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron en sus manos del fruto del país, y nos lo trajeron, y diéronnos cuenta, y dijeron: Es buena la tierra que Jehová nuestro Dios nos da.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God:
verses.WEB: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Yet ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah your God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não quisestes subir, mas fostes rebeldes à ordem do SENHOR, vosso Deus;
verses.RVR09: Empero no quisisteis subir, antes fuisteis rebeldes al dicho de Jehová vuestro Dios;

verses.KJV: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the Lord hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.WEB: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.
verses.ASV: and ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because Jehovah hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E murmurastes em vossas tendas, dizendo: ‘É porque o SENHOR nos odeia que ele nos tirou da terra do Egito, para nos entregar nas mãos dos amorreus, para nos destruir.
verses.RVR09: Y murmurasteis en vuestras tiendas, diciendo: Porque Jehová nos aborrecía, nos ha sacado de tierra de Egipto, para entregarnos en mano del Amorrheo para destruirnos.

verses.KJV: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.WEB: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”
verses.ASV: Whither are we going up? our brethren have made our heart to melt, saying, The people are greater and taller than we; the cities are great and fortified up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para onde subiremos? Nossos irmãos fizeram derreter o nosso coração, dizendo: Este povo é maior e mais alto que nós, as cidades são grandes e muradas até o céu; e também vimos ali filhos de gigantes.’
verses.RVR09: ¿A dónde subimos? Nuestros hermanos han hecho desfallecer nuestro corazón, diciendo: Este pueblo es mayor y más alto que nosotros, las ciudades grandes y muradas hasta el cielo; y también vimos allí hijos de gigantes.

verses.KJV: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.WEB: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.
verses.ASV: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vos disse: Não temais, nem tenhais medo deles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces os dije: No temáis, ni tengáis miedo de ellos.

verses.KJV: The Lord your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.WEB: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
verses.ASV: Jehovah your God who goeth before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR vosso Deus, o qual vai diante de vós, ele lutará por vós, conforme todas as coisas que fez por vós no Egito diante vossos olhos;
verses.RVR09: Jehová vuestro Dios, el cual va delante de vosotros, él peleará por vosotros, conforme á todas las cosas que hizo por vosotros en Egipto delante de vuestros ojos;

verses.KJV: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the Lord thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verses.WEB: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
verses.ASV: and in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that Jehovah thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came unto this place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no deserto viste que o SENHOR teu Deus te trouxe, como traz o homem a seu filho, por todo o caminho que andastes, até que viestes a este lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y en el desierto has visto que Jehová tu Dios te ha traído, como trae el hombre á su hijo, por todo el camino que habéis andado, hasta que habéis venido á este lugar.

verses.KJV: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the Lord your God,
verses.WEB: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe the LORD your God,
verses.ASV: Yet in this thing ye did not believe Jehovah your God,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda com isto não crestes no SENHOR vosso Deus,
verses.RVR09: Y aun con esto no creisteis en Jehová vuestro Dios,

verses.KJV: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.WEB: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.
verses.ASV: who went before you in the way, to seek you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to show you by what way ye should go, and in the cloud by day.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual ia diante de vós pelo caminho, para reconhecer-vos o lugar onde havíeis de assentar o acampamento, com fogo de noite para vos mostrar o caminho por onde andásseis, e com nuvem de dia.
verses.RVR09: El cual iba delante de vosotros por el camino, para reconoceros el lugar donde habíais de asentar el campo, con fuego de noche para mostraros el camino por donde anduvieseis, y con nube de día.

verses.KJV: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu o SENHOR a voz de vossas palavras, e irou-se, e jurou dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Jehová la voz de vuestras palabras, y enojóse, y juró diciendo:

verses.KJV: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers.
verses.WEB: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,
verses.ASV: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see the good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não verá homem algum destes desta má geração, a boa terra que jurei havia de dar a vossos pais,
verses.RVR09: No verá hombre alguno de estos de esta mala generación, la buena tierra que juré había de dar á vuestros padres,

verses.KJV: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the Lord.
verses.WEB: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed the LORD.”
verses.ASV: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it; and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exceto Calebe filho de Jefoné: ele a verá, e a ele lhe darei a terra que pisou, e a seus filhos; porque cumpriu em seguir ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Excepto Caleb hijo de Jephone: él la verá, y á él le daré la tierra que pisó, y á sus hijos; porque cumplió en pos de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Also the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
verses.WEB: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
verses.ASV: Also Jehovah was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither:
verses.ALMEIDA: E também contra mim se irou o SENHOR por vós, dizendo: Tampouco tu entrarás ali:
verses.RVR09: Y también contra mí se airó Jehová por vosotros, diciendo: Tampoco tú entrarás allá:

verses.KJV: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.WEB: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.ASV: Joshua the son of Nun, who standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage thou him; for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Josué filho de Num, que está diante de ti, ele entrará ali: anima-o; porque ele a fará herdar a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Josué hijo de Nun, que está delante de ti, él entrará allá: anímale; porque él la hará heredar á Israel.

verses.KJV: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.WEB: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.
verses.ASV: Moreover your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, and your children, that this day have no knowledge of good or evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vossas crianças, das quais dissestes serão por presa, e vossos filhos que não sabem hoje bem nem mal, eles entrarão ali, e a eles a darei, e eles a herdarão.
verses.RVR09: Y vuestros chiquitos, de los cuales dijisteis serán por presa, y vuestros hijos que no saben hoy bueno ni malo, ellos entrarán allá, y á ellos la daré, y ellos la heredarán.

verses.KJV: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.WEB: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
verses.ASV: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós voltai-vos, e parti-vos ao deserto caminho do mar Vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros volveos, y partíos al desierto camino del mar Bermejo.

verses.KJV: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the Lord, we will go up and fight, according to all that the Lord our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
verses.WEB: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.
verses.ASV: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against Jehovah, we will go up and fight, according to all that Jehovah our God commanded us. And ye girded on every man his weapons of war, and were forward to go up into the hill-country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então respondestes e me dissestes: Pecado temos contra o SENHOR; nós subiremos e lutaremos, conforme tudo o que o SENHOR nosso Deus nos mandou. E vos armastes cada um de suas armas de guerra, e vos preparastes para subir ao monte.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondisteis y me dijisteis: Pecado hemos contra Jehová; nosotros subiremos y pelearemos, conforme á todo lo que Jehová nuestro Dios nos ha mandado. Y os armasteis cada uno de sus armas de guerra, y os apercibisteis para subir al monte.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto me, Say unto them. Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR me disse: Dize-lhes: Não subais, nem luteis, pois não estou entre vós; para que não sejais feridos diante de vossos inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová me dijo: Diles: No subáis, ni peleéis, pues no estoy entre vosotros; porque no seáis heridos delante de vuestros enemigos.

verses.KJV: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
verses.WEB: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.
verses.ASV: So I spake unto you, and ye hearkened not; but ye rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill-country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos falei, e não destes ouvido; antes fostes rebeldes ao dito do SENHOR, e persistindo com altivez, subistes ao monte.
verses.RVR09: Y os hablé, y no disteis oído; antes fuisteis rebeldes al dicho de Jehová, y persistiendo con altivez, subisteis al monte.

verses.KJV: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.WEB: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.
verses.ASV: And the Amorites, that dwelt in that hill-country, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saíram os amorreus, que habitavam naquele monte, a vosso encontro, e vos perseguiram, como fazem as vespas, e vos derrotaram em Seir, perseguindo-vos até Hormá.
verses.RVR09: Y salió el Amorrheo, que habitaba en aquel monte, á vuestro encuentro, y os persiguieron, como hacen las avispas, y os derrotaron en Seir, persiguiéndoos hasta Horma.

verses.KJV: And ye returned and wept before the Lord; but the Lord would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
verses.WEB: You returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.
verses.ASV: And ye returned and wept before Jehovah; but Jehovah hearkened not to your voice, nor gave ear unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltastes, e chorastes diante do SENHOR; mas o SENHOR não escutou vossa voz, nem vos prestou ouvido.
verses.RVR09: Y volvisteis, y llorasteis delante de Jehová; pero Jehová no escuchó vuestra voz, ni os prestó oído.

verses.KJV: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
verses.WEB: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.
verses.ASV: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode [there].
verses.ALMEIDA: E estivestes em Cades por muitos dias, como nos dias que estivestes.
verses.RVR09: Y estuvisteis en Cades por muchos días, como en los días que habéis estado.

verses.KJV: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the Lord spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.WEB: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.
verses.ASV: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Jehovah spake unto me; and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltamos, e partimo-nos ao deserto caminho do mar Vermelho, como o SENHOR me havia dito; e rodeamos o monte de Seir por muitos dias.
verses.RVR09: Y VOLVIMOS, y partímonos al desierto camino del mar Bermejo, como Jehová me había dicho; y rodeamos el monte de Seir por muchos días.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR me falou, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová me habló, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
verses.WEB: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.
verses.ASV: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Demais rodeastes este monte; voltai-vos ao norte.
verses.RVR09: Harto habéis rodeado este monte; volveos al aquilón.

verses.KJV: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
verses.WEB: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.
verses.ASV: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the border of your brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore;
verses.ALMEIDA: E manda ao povo, dizendo: Passando vós pelo termo de vossos irmãos os filhos de Esaú, que habitam em Seir, eles terão medo de vós; mas vós guardai-vos muito:
verses.RVR09: Y manda al pueblo, diciendo: Pasando vosotros por el término de vuestros hermanos los hijos de Esaú, que habitan en Seir, ellos tendrán miedo de vosotros; mas vosotros guardaos mucho:

verses.KJV: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
verses.WEB: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.
verses.ASV: contend not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos metais com eles; que não vos darei de sua terra nem ainda a pisadura da planta de um pé; porque eu dei por herança a Esaú o monte de Seir.
verses.RVR09: No os metáis con ellos; que no os daré de su tierra ni aun la holladura de la planta de un pie; porque yo he dado por heredad á Esaú el monte de Seir.

verses.KJV: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
verses.WEB: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”
verses.ASV: Ye shall purchase food of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Comprareis deles por dinheiro os alimentos, e comereis; e também comprareis deles a água, e bebereis:
verses.RVR09: Compraréis de ellos por dinero las viandas, y comeréis; y también compraréis de ellos el agua, y beberéis:

verses.KJV: For the Lord thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the Lord thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
verses.WEB: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, the LORD your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee in all the work of thy hand; he hath known thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years Jehovah thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o SENHOR teu Deus te abençoou em toda obra de tuas mãos: ele sabe que andas por este grande deserto: estes quarenta anos o SENHOR teu Deus foi contigo; e nenhuma coisa te faltou.
verses.RVR09: Pues Jehová tu Dios te ha bendecido en toda obra de tus manos: él sabe que andas por este gran desierto: estos cuarenta años Jehová tu Dios fué contigo; y ninguna cosa te ha faltado.

verses.KJV: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.WEB: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.ASV: So we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion-geber. And we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passamos por nossos irmãos os filhos de Esaú, que habitavam em Seir, pelo caminho da planície de Elate e de Eziom-Geber. E voltamos, e passamos caminho do deserto de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Y pasamos de nuestros hermanos los hijos de Esaú, que habitaban en Seir, por el camino de la llanura de Elath y de Esiongeber. Y volvimos, y pasamos camino del desierto de Moab.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Vex not Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give thee of his land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR me disse: Não perturbeis a Moabe, nem te empenhes com eles em guerra, que não te darei possessão de sua terra; porque eu dei a Ar por herança aos filhos de Ló.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová me dijo: No molestes á Moab, ni te empeñes con ellos en guerra, que no te daré posesión de su tierra; porque yo he dado á Ar por heredad á los hijos de Lot.

verses.KJV: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
verses.WEB: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.
verses.ASV: (The Emim dwelt therein aforetime, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim:
verses.ALMEIDA: (Os emins habitaram nela antes, povo grande, e numeroso, e alto como gigantes:
verses.RVR09: (Los Emimeos habitaron en ella antes, pueblo grande, y numeroso, y alto como gigantes:

verses.KJV: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites called them Emims.
verses.WEB: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.ASV: these also are accounted Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por gigantes eram eles também contados, como os anaquins; e os moabitas os chamam emins.
verses.RVR09: Por gigantes eran ellos también contados, como los Anaceos; y los Moabitas los llaman Emimeos.

verses.KJV: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the Lord gave unto them.
verses.WEB: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.)
verses.ASV: The Horites also dwelt in Seir aforetime, but the children of Esau succeeded them; and they destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which Jehovah gave unto them).
verses.ALMEIDA: E em Seir habitaram antes os horeus, aos quais os filhos de Esaú expulsaram; e os destruíram de diante de si, e moraram em lugar deles; como fez Israel na terra de sua possessão que lhes deu o SENHOR.)
verses.RVR09: Y en Seir habitaron antes los Horeos, á los cuales echaron los hijos de Esaú; y los destruyeron de delante de sí, y moraron en lugar de ellos; como hizo Israel en la tierra de su posesión que les dió Jehová.)

verses.KJV: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.WEB: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.
verses.ASV: Now rise up, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai-vos agora, e passai o ribeiro de Zerede. E passamos o ribeiro de Zerede.
verses.RVR09: Levantaos ahora, y pasad el arroyo de Zered. Y pasamos el arroyo de Zered.

verses.KJV: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the Lord sware unto them.
verses.WEB: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as the LORD swore to them.
verses.ASV: And the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, were thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the midst of the camp, as Jehovah sware unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os dias que andamos de Cades-Barneia até que passamos o ribeiro de Zerede, foram trinta e oito anos; até que se acabou toda a geração dos homens de guerra do meio do acampamento, como o SENHOR lhes havia jurado.
verses.RVR09: Y los días que anduvimos de Cades-barnea hasta que pasamos el arroyo de Zered, fueron treinta y ocho años; hasta que se acabó toda la generación de los hombres de guerra de en medio del campo, como Jehová les había jurado.

verses.KJV: For indeed the hand of the Lord was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.
verses.ASV: Moreover the hand of Jehovah was against them, to destroy them from the midst of the camp, until they were consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também a mão do SENHOR foi sobre eles para destruí-los do meio do campo, até acabá-los.
verses.RVR09: Y también la mano de Jehová fué sobre ellos para destruirlos de en medio del campo, hasta acabarlos.

verses.KJV: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.WEB: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.ASV: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando se acabaram de morrer todos os homens de guerra dentre o povo,
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que cuando se hubieron acabado de morir todos los hombres de guerra de entre el pueblo,

verses.KJV: That the Lord spake unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: the LORD spoke to me, saying,
verses.ASV: that Jehovah spake unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR me falou, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Jehová me habló, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
verses.WEB: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.
verses.ASV: Thou art this day to pass over Ar, the border of Moab:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu passarás hoje o termo de Moabe, a Ar,
verses.RVR09: Tú pasarás hoy el término de Moab, á Ar,

verses.KJV: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.WEB: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”
verses.ASV: and when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, vex them not, nor contend with them; for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te aproximarás diante dos filhos de Amom: não os perturbeis, nem te metas com eles; porque não te tenho de dar possessão da terra dos filhos de Amom; que aos filhos de Ló a dei por herança.
verses.RVR09: Y te acercarás delante de los hijos de Ammón: no los molestes, ni te metas con ellos; porque no te tengo de dar posesión de la tierra de los hijos de Ammón; que á los hijos de Lot la he dado por heredad.

verses.KJV: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
verses.WEB: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
verses.ASV: (That also is accounted a land of Rephaim: Rephaim dwelt therein aforetime; but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
verses.ALMEIDA: (Por terra de gigantes foi também ela tida: habitaram nela gigantes em outro tempo, aos quais os amonitas chamavam zanzumins;
verses.RVR09: (Por tierra de gigantes fué también ella tenida: habitaron en ella gigantes en otro tiempo, á los cuales los Ammonitas llamaban Zomzommeos;

verses.KJV: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the Lord destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
verses.WEB: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,
verses.ASV: a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Jehovah destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead;
verses.ALMEIDA: Povo grande, e numeroso, e alto, como os anaquins; aos quais o SENHOR destruiu de diante dos amonitas, os quais lhes sucederam, e habitaram em seu lugar:
verses.RVR09: Pueblo grande, y numeroso, y alto, como los Anaceos; á los cuales Jehová destruyó de delante de los Ammonitas, quienes les sucedieron, y habitaron en su lugar:

verses.KJV: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
verses.WEB: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.
verses.ASV: as he did for the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como fez com os filhos de Esaú, que habitavam em Seir, de diante dos quais destruiu aos horeus; e eles lhes sucederam, e habitaram em seu lugar até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Como hizo con los hijos de Esaú, que habitaban en Seir, de delante de los cuales destruyó á los Horeos; y ellos les sucedieron, y habitaron en su lugar hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.WEB: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)
verses.ASV: And the Avvim, that dwelt in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, that came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos aveus que habitavam em vilas até Gaza, os caftoreus que saíram de Caftor os destruíram, e habitaram em seu lugar.)
verses.RVR09: Y á los Heveos que habitaban en Haserin hasta Gaza, los Caftoreos que salieron de Caftor los destruyeron, y habitaron en su lugar.)

verses.KJV: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.WEB: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.ASV: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon: behold, I have given into thy hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai-vos, parti, e passai o ribeiro de Arnom: eis que dei em tua mão a Seom rei de Hesbom, amorreu, e a sua terra: começa a tomar possessão, e empenha-te com ele em guerra.
verses.RVR09: Levantaos, partid, y pasad el arroyo de Arnón: he aquí he dado en tu mano á Sehón rey de Hesbón, Amorrheo, y á su tierra: comienza á tomar posesión, y empéñate con él en guerra.

verses.KJV: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
verses.WEB: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”
verses.ASV: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the peoples that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear the report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Hoje começarei a pôr teu medo e teu espanto sobre os povos debaixo de todo o céu, os quais ouvirão tua fama, e tremerão, e se angustiarão diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Hoy comenzaré á poner tu miedo y tu espanto sobre los pueblos debajo de todo el cielo; los cuales oirán tu fama, y temblarán, y angustiarse han delante de ti.

verses.KJV: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.WEB: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.ASV: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviei mensageiros desde o deserto de Quedemote a Seom rei de Hesbom, com palavras de paz, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y envié mensajeros desde el desierto de Cademoth á Sehón rey de Hesbón, con palabras de paz, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.WEB: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.
verses.ASV: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the highway, I will turn neither unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passarei por tua terra pelo caminho: pelo caminho irei, sem apartar-me à direita nem à esquerda:
verses.RVR09: Pasaré por tu tierra por el camino: por el camino iré, sin apartarme á diestra ni á siniestra:

verses.KJV: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
verses.WEB: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,
verses.ASV: Thou shalt sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only let me pass through on my feet;
verses.ALMEIDA: A comida me venderás por dinheiro e comerei: a água também me darás por dinheiro, e beberei: somente passarei a pé;
verses.RVR09: La comida me venderás por dinero, y comeré: el agua también me darás por dinero, y beberé: solamente pasaré á pie;

verses.KJV: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the Lord our God giveth us.
verses.WEB: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.”
verses.ASV: as the children of Esau that dwell in Seir, and the Moabites that dwell in Ar, did unto me; until I shall pass over the Jordan into the land which Jehovah our God giveth us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o fizeram comigo os filhos de Esaú que habitavam em Seir, e os moabitas que habitavam em Ar; até que passe o Jordão à terra que nos dá o SENHOR nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Como lo hicieron conmigo los hijos de Esaú que habitaban en Seir, y los Moabitas que habitaban en Ar; hasta que pase el Jordán á la tierra que nos da Jehová nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the Lord thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
verses.WEB: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.
verses.ASV: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Jehovah thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as at this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Seom rei de Hesbom não quis que passássemos pelo território seu; porque o SENHOR teu Deus havia endurecido seu espírito, e obstinado seu coração para entregá-lo em tua mão, como hoje.
verses.RVR09: Mas Sehón rey de Hesbón no quiso que pasásemos por el territorio suyo; porque Jehová tu Dios había endurecido su espíritu, y obstinado su corazón para entregarlo en tu mano, como hoy.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-me o SENHOR: Eis que eu comecei a dar diante de ti a Seom e a sua terra; começa a tomar possessão, para que herdes sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome Jehová: He aquí yo he comenzado á dar delante de ti á Sehón y á su tierra; comienza á tomar posesión, para que heredes su tierra.

verses.KJV: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
verses.WEB: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
verses.ASV: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, unto battle at Jahaz.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu-nos Seom ao encontro, ele e todo seu povo, para lutar em Jaza.
verses.RVR09: Y saliónos Sehón al encuentro, él y todo su pueblo, para pelear en Jaas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.WEB: The LORD our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah our God delivered him up before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR nosso Deus o entregou diante de nós; e ferimos a ele e a seus filhos, e a todo seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová nuestro Dios lo entregó delante de nosotros; y herimos á él y á sus hijos, y á todo su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
verses.WEB: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.
verses.ASV: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones; we left none remaining:
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomamos então todas suas cidades, e destruímos todas as cidades, homens, e mulheres, e crianças; não deixamos ninguém:
verses.RVR09: Y tomamos entonces todas sus ciudades, y destruimos todas las ciudades, hombres, y mujeres, y niños; no dejamos ninguno:

verses.KJV: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
verses.WEB: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
verses.ASV: only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, with the spoil of the cities which we had taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente tomamos para nós os animais, e os despojos das cidades que havíamos tomado.
verses.RVR09: Solamente tomamos para nosotros las bestias, y los despojos de las ciudades que habíamos tomado.

verses.KJV: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the Lord our God delivered all unto us:
verses.WEB: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The LORD our God delivered up all before us.
verses.ASV: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and [from] the city that is in the valley, even unto Gilead, there was not a city too high for us; Jehovah our God delivered up all before us:
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde Aroer, que está junto à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está no ribeiro, até Gileade, não houve cidade que escapasse de nós: todas as entregou o SENHOR nosso Deus em nosso poder.
verses.RVR09: Desde Aroer, que está junto á la ribera del arroyo de Arnón, y la ciudad que está en el arroyo, hasta Galaad, no hubo ciudad que escapase de nosotros: todas las entregó Jehová nuestro Dios en nuestro poder.

verses.KJV: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the Lord our God forbad us.
verses.WEB: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever the LORD our God forbade us.
verses.ASV: only to the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not near; all the side of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill-country, and wheresoever Jehovah our God forbade us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente à terra dos filhos de Amom não chegaste, nem a tudo o que está à beira do ribeiro de Jaboque nem às cidades do monte, nem a lugar algum que o SENHOR nosso Deus havia proibido.
verses.RVR09: Solamente á la tierra de los hijos de Ammón no llegaste, ni á todo lo que está á la orilla del arroyo de Jaboc ni á las ciudades del monte, ni á lugar alguno que Jehová nuestro Dios había prohibido.

verses.KJV: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.WEB: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.ASV: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, unto battle at Edrei.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltamos, e subimos caminho de Basã, e saiu-nos ao encontro Ogue rei de Basã para lutar, ele e todo seu povo, em Edrei.
verses.RVR09: Y VOLVIMOS, y subimos camino de Basán, y saliónos al encuentro Og rey de Basán para pelear, él y todo su pueblo, en Edrei.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Fear him not; for I have delivered him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-me o SENHOR: Não tenhas medo dele, porque em tua mão entreguei a ele e a todo seu povo, e sua terra: e farás com ele como fizeste com Seom rei amorreu, que habitava em Hesbom.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome Jehová: No tengas temor de él, porque en tu mano he entregado á él y á todo su pueblo, y su tierra: y harás con él como hiciste con Sehón rey Amorrheo, que habitaba en Hesbón.

verses.KJV: So the Lord our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.WEB: So the LORD our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.
verses.ASV: So Jehovah our God delivered into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR nosso Deus entregou também em nossa mão a Ogue rei de Basã, e a todo seu povo, ao qual ferimos até não restar dele ninguém.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová nuestro Dios entregó también en nuestra mano á Og rey de Basán, y á todo su pueblo, al cual herimos hasta no quedar de él ninguno.

verses.KJV: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.WEB: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.ASV: And we took all his cities at that time; there was not a city which we took not from them; threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomamos então todas suas cidades; não restou cidade que não lhes tomássemos: sessenta cidades, toda a terra de Argobe, do reino de Ogue em Basã.
verses.RVR09: Y tomamos entonces todas sus ciudades; no quedó ciudad que no les tomásemos: sesenta ciudades, toda la tierra de Argob, del reino de Og en Basán.

verses.KJV: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
verses.WEB: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.
verses.ASV: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides the unwalled towns a great many.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas estas eram cidades fortificadas com alto muro, com portas e barras; sem outras muito muitas cidades sem muro.
verses.RVR09: Todas éstas eran ciudades fortalecidas con alto muro, con puertas y barras; sin otras muy muchas ciudades sin muro.

verses.KJV: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
verses.WEB: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.
verses.ASV: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as destruímos, como fizemos a Seom rei de Hesbom, destruindo em toda cidade homens, mulheres, e crianças.
verses.RVR09: Y destruímoslas, como hicimos á Sehón rey de Hesbón, destruyendo en toda ciudad hombres, mujeres, y niños.

verses.KJV: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
verses.WEB: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.
verses.ASV: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey unto ourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomamos para nós todos os animais, e os despojos das cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y tomamos para nosotros todas las bestias, y los despojos de las ciudades.

verses.KJV: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
verses.WEB: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
verses.ASV: And we took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites that were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon unto mount Hermon
verses.ALMEIDA: Também tomamos naquele tempo da mão de dois reis amorreus que estavam desta parte do Jordão, a terra desde o ribeiro de Arnom até o monte de Hermom:
verses.RVR09: También tomamos en aquel tiempo de mano de dos reyes Amorrheos que estaban de esta parte del Jordán, la tierra desde el arroyo de Arnón hasta el monte de Hermón:

verses.KJV: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
verses.WEB: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
verses.ASV: ([which] Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir);
verses.ALMEIDA: (Os sidônios chamam a Hermom Siriom; e os amorreus, Senir:)
verses.RVR09: (Los Sidonios llaman á Hermón Sirión; y los Amorrheos, Senir:)

verses.KJV: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.WEB: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.ASV: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as cidades da planície, e todo Gileade, e todo Basã até Salcá e Edrei, cidades do reino de Ogue em Basã.
verses.RVR09: Todas las ciudades de la llanura, y todo Galaad, y todo Basán hasta Salchâ y Edrei, ciudades del reino de Og en Basán.

verses.KJV: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
verses.WEB: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
verses.ASV: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.)
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque somente Ogue rei de Basã havia restado dos gigantes que restaram. Eis que sua cama, uma cama de ferro, não está em Rabá dos filhos de Amom?; o comprimento dela de nove côvados, e sua largura de quatro côvados, ao côvado de um homem.
verses.RVR09: Porque sólo Og rey de Basán había quedado de los gigantes que quedaron. He aquí su cama, una cama de hierro, ¿no está en Rabbath de los hijos de Ammón?; la longitud de ella de nueve codos, y su anchura de cuatro codos, al codo de un hombre.

verses.KJV: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.WEB: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;
verses.ASV: And this land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill-country of Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites:
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta terra que herdamos então desde Aroer, que está ao ribeiro de Arnom, e a metade do monte de Gileade com suas cidades, dei aos rubenitas e aos gaditas:
verses.RVR09: Y esta tierra que heredamos entonces desde Aroer, que está al arroyo de Arnón, y la mitad del monte de Galaad con sus ciudades, dí á los Rubenitas y á los Gaditas:

verses.KJV: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
verses.WEB: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
verses.ASV: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half-tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o resto de Gileade, e todo Basã, do reino de Ogue, dei o à meia tribo de Manassés; toda a terra de Argobe, todo Basã, que se chamava a terra dos gigantes.
verses.RVR09: Y el resto de Galaad, y todo Basán, del reino de Og, dílo á la media tribu de Manasés; toda la tierra de Argob, todo Basán, que se llamaba la tierra de los gigantes.

verses.KJV: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.
verses.WEB: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
verses.ASV: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth-jair, unto this day.)
verses.ALMEIDA: Jair filho de Manassés tomou toda a terra de Argobe até o termo dos gessuritas e dos maacatitas; e chamou-a de seu nome Basã-Havote-Jair, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Jair hijo de Manasés tomó toda la tierra de Argob hasta el término de Gessuri y Machâti; y llamóla de su nombre Basán-havoth-jair, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.WEB: I gave Gilead to Machir.
verses.ASV: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Maquir dei a Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Y á Machîr dí á Galaad.

verses.KJV: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.WEB: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.ASV: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and the border [thereof], even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos rubenitas e gaditas dei de Gileade até o ribeiro de Arnom, o meio do ribeiro por termo; até o ribeiro de Jaboque, termo dos filhos de Amom:
verses.RVR09: Y á los Rubenitas y Gaditas dí de Galaad hasta el arroyo de Arnón, el medio del arroyo por término; hasta el arroyo de Jaboc, término de los hijos de Ammón:

verses.KJV: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.
verses.WEB: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
verses.ASV: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and the border [thereof], from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como a campina, e o Jordão, e o termo, desde Quinerete até o mar da planície, o mar Salgado, as encostas abaixo do Pisga ao oriente.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo la campiña, y el Jordán, y el término, desde Cinereth hasta la mar del llano, el mar Salado, las vertientes abajo del Pisga al oriente.

verses.KJV: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The Lord your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.
verses.WEB: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And I commanded you at that time, saying, Jehovah your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all the men of valor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos mandei então, dizendo: O SENHOR vosso Deus vos deu esta terra para que a possuais: passareis armados diante de vossos irmãos os filhos de Israel todos os valentes.
verses.RVR09: Y os mandé entonces, diciendo: Jehová vuestro Dios os ha dado esta tierra para que la poseáis: pasaréis armados delante de vuestros hermanos los hijos de Israel todos los valientes.

verses.KJV: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.WEB: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
verses.ASV: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle (I know that ye have much cattle), shall abide in your cities which I have given you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente vossas mulheres, vossas crianças, e vossos gados, (eu sei que tendes muito gado,) ficarão em vossas cidades que vos dei,
verses.RVR09: Solamente vuestras mujeres, vuestros niños, y vuestros ganados, (yo sé que tenéis mucho ganado,) quedarán en vuestras ciudades que os he dado,
