verses.KJV: Until the Lord have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the Lord your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
verses.WEB: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
verses.ASV: until Jehovah give rest unto your brethren, as unto you, and they also possess the land which Jehovah your God giveth them beyond the Jordan: then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que o SENHOR dê repouso a vossos irmãos, assim como a vós, e herdem também eles a terra que o SENHOR vosso Deus lhes dá à outra parte do Jordão: então vos voltareis cada um a sua herança que eu vos dei.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que Jehová dé reposo á vuestros hermanos, así como á vosotros, y hereden también ellos la tierra que Jehová vuestro Dios les da á la otra parte del Jordán: entonces os volveréis cada uno á su heredad que yo os he dado.

verses.KJV: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the Lord do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
verses.WEB: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
verses.ASV: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that Jehovah your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall Jehovah do unto all the kingdoms whither thou goest over.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mandei também a Josué então, dizendo: Teus olhos viram tudo o que o SENHOR vosso Deus fez àqueles dois reis: assim fará o SENHOR a todos os reinos aos quais passarás tu.
verses.RVR09: Mandé también á Josué entonces, diciendo: Tus ojos vieron todo lo que Jehová vuestro Dios ha hecho á aquellos dos reyes: así hará Jehová á todos los reinos á los cuales pasarás tú.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not fear them: for the Lord your God he shall fight for you.
verses.WEB: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”
verses.ASV: Ye shall not fear them; for Jehovah your God, he it is that fighteth for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não os temais; que o SENHOR vosso Deus, ele é o que luta por vós.
verses.RVR09: No los temáis; que Jehová vuestro Dios, él es el que pelea por vosotros.

verses.KJV: And I besought the Lord at that time, saying,
verses.WEB: I begged GOD at that time, saying,
verses.ASV: And I besought Jehovah at that time, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E orei ao SENHOR naquele tempo, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y oré á Jehová en aquel tiempo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: O Lord God, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
verses.WEB: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
verses.ASV: O Lord Jehovah, thou hast begun to show thy servant thy greatness, and thy strong hand: for what god is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy mighty acts?
verses.ALMEIDA: Senhor DEUS, tu começaste a mostrar a teu servo tua grandeza, e tua mão forte: porque que deus há no céu nem na terra que faça segundo tuas obras, e segundo tuas valentias?
verses.RVR09: Señor Jehová, tú has comenzado á mostrar á tu siervo tu grandeza, y tu mano fuerte: porque ¿qué dios hay en el cielo ni en la tierra que haga según tus obras, y según tus valentías?

verses.KJV: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
verses.WEB: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
verses.ASV: Let me go over, I pray thee, and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passe eu, rogo-te, e veja aquela terra boa, que está à parte ali do Jordão, aquele bom monte, e o Líbano.
verses.RVR09: Pase yo, ruégote, y vea aquella tierra buena, que está á la parte allá del Jordán, aquel buen monte, y el Líbano.

verses.KJV: But the Lord was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the Lord said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
verses.WEB: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah was wroth with me for your sakes, and hearkened not unto me; and Jehovah said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR se havia irado contra mim por causa de vós, pelo qual não me ouviu: e disse-me o SENHOR: Basta-te, não me fales mais deste negócio.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová se había enojado contra mí por causa de vosotros, por lo cual no me oyó: y díjome Jehová: Bástate, no me hables más de este negocio.

verses.KJV: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.WEB: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.
verses.ASV: Get thee up unto the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobe ao cume do Pisga, e ergue teus olhos ao ocidente, e ao norte, e ao sul, e ao oriente, e vê por teus olhos: porque não passarás este Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Sube á la cumbre del Pisga, y alza tus ojos al occidente, y al aquilón, y al mediodía, y al oriente, y ve por tus ojos: porque no pasarás este Jordán.

verses.KJV: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
verses.WEB: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
verses.ASV: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
verses.ALMEIDA: E manda a Josué, e anima-o, e conforta-o; porque ele há de passar diante deste povo, e ele lhes fará herdar a terra que verás.
verses.RVR09: Y manda á Josué, y anímalo, y confórtalo; porque él ha de pasar delante de este pueblo, y él les hará heredar la tierra que verás.

verses.KJV: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
verses.WEB: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
verses.ASV: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E paramos no vale diante de Bete-Peor.
verses.RVR09: Y paramos en el valle delante de Beth-peor.

verses.KJV: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.WEB: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.
verses.ASV: And now, O Israel, hearken unto the statutes and unto the ordinances, which I teach you, to do them; that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah, the God of your fathers, giveth you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, ó Israel, ouve os estatutos e regulamentos que eu vos ensino, para que os executeis, e vivais, e entreis, e possuais a terra que o SENHOR o Deus de vossos pais te dá.
verses.RVR09: AHORA pues, oh Israel, oye los estatutos y derechos que yo os enseño, para que los ejecutéis, y viváis, y entréis, y poseáis la tierra que Jehová el Dios de vuestros padres te da.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.
verses.WEB: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish from it, that ye may keep the commandments of Jehovah your God which I command you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não acrescentareis à palavra que eu vos mando, nem diminuireis dela, para que guardeis os mandamentos do SENHOR vosso Deus que eu vos ordeno.
verses.RVR09: No añadiréis á la palabra que yo os mando, ni disminuiréis de ella, para que guardéis los mandamientos de Jehová vuestro Dios que yo os ordeno.

verses.KJV: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the Lord thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.WEB: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.
verses.ASV: Your eyes have seen what Jehovah did because of Baal-peor; for all the men that followed Baal-peor, Jehovah thy God hath destroyed them from the midst of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vossos olhos viram o que fez o SENHOR por motivo de Baal-Peor; que a todo homem que foi atrás de Baal-Peor destruiu o SENHOR teu Deus do meio de ti.
verses.RVR09: Vuestros ojos vieron lo que hizo Jehová con motivo de Baal-peor; que á todo hombre que fué en pos de Baal-peor destruyó Jehová tu Dios de en medio de ti.

verses.KJV: But ye that did cleave unto the Lord your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.WEB: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.
verses.ASV: But ye that did cleave unto Jehovah your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós que vos achegastes ao SENHOR vosso Deus, todos estais vivos hoje.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros que os allegasteis á Jehová vuestro Dios, todos estáis vivos hoy.

verses.KJV: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the Lord my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Jehovah my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the midst of the land whither ye go in to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai, eu vos ensinei estatutos e regulamentos, como o SENHOR meu Deus me mandou, para que façais assim em meio da terra na qual entrais para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: Mirad, yo os he enseñado estatutos y derechos, como Jehová mi Dios me mandó, para que hagáis así en medio de la tierra en la cual entráis para poseerla.

verses.KJV: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.WEB: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
verses.ASV: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples, that shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai-os, pois, e ponde-os por obra: porque esta é vossa sabedoria e vossa inteligência aos olhos dos povos, os quais ouvirão todos estes estatutos, e dirão: Certamente povo sábio e entendido, gente grande é esta.
verses.RVR09: Guardadlos, pues, y ponedlos por obra: porque esta es vuestra sabiduría y vuestra inteligencia en ojos de los pueblos, los cuales oirán todos estos estatutos, y dirán: Ciertamente pueblo sabio y entendido, gente grande es ésta.

verses.KJV: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
verses.WEB: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?
verses.ASV: For what great nation is there, that hath a god so nigh unto them, as Jehovah our God is whensoever we call upon him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque que gente grande há que tenha os deuses próximo a si, como o está o SENHOR nosso Deus em tudo quanto lhe pedimos?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué gente grande hay que tenga los dioses cercanos á sí, como lo está Jehová nuestro Dios en todo cuanto le pedimos?

verses.KJV: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.WEB: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
verses.ASV: And what great nation is there, that hath statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.ALMEIDA: E que gente grande há que tenha estatutos e regulamentos justos, como é toda esta lei que eu ponho hoje diante de vós?
verses.RVR09: Y ¿qué gente grande hay que tenga estatutos y derechos justos, como es toda esta ley que yo pongo hoy delante de vosotros?

verses.KJV: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;
verses.WEB: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—
verses.ASV: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes saw, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life; but make them known unto thy children and thy children’s children;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, guarda-te, e guarda tua alma com empenho, que não te esqueças das coisas que teus olhos viram, nem se apartem de teu coração todos os dias de tua vida: e as ensinarás a teus filhos, e aos filhos de teus filhos;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, guárdate, y guarda tu alma con diligencia, que no te olvides de las cosas que tus ojos han visto, ni se aparten de tu corazón todos los días de tu vida: y enseñarlas has á tus hijos, y á los hijos de tus hijos;

verses.KJV: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the Lord thy God in Horeb, when the Lord said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.WEB: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
verses.ASV: the day that thou stoodest before Jehovah thy God in Horeb, when Jehovah said unto me, Assemble me the people, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia que estiveste diante do SENHOR teu Deus em Horebe, quando o SENHOR me disse: Junta-me o povo, para que eu lhes faça ouvir minhas palavras, as quais aprenderão, para temer-me todos os dias que viverem sobre a terra: e as ensinarão a seus filhos;
verses.RVR09: El día que estuviste delante de Jehová tu Dios en Horeb, cuando Jehová me dijo: Júntame el pueblo, para que yo les haga oir mis palabras, las cuales aprenderán, para temerme todos los días que vivieren sobre la tierra: y las enseñarán á sus hijos;

verses.KJV: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.WEB: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
verses.ASV: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the heart of heaven, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos aproximastes, e vos pusestes ao pé do monte; e o monte ardia em fogo até em meio dos céus com trevas, nuvem, e escuridão.
verses.RVR09: Y os llegasteis, y os pusisteis al pie del monte; y el monte ardía en fuego hasta en medio de los cielos con tinieblas, nube, y oscuridad.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of words, but ye saw no form; only [ye heard] a voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR convosco do meio do fogo: ouvistes a voz de suas palavras, mas a exceção de ouvir a voz, nenhuma forma vistes:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová con vosotros de en medio del fuego: oisteis la voz de sus palabras, mas á excepción de oir la voz, ninguna figura visteis:

verses.KJV: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.WEB: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
verses.ASV: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele vos anunciou seu pacto, o qual vos mandou pôr por obra, os dez mandamentos; e escreveu-os em duas tábuas de pedra.
verses.RVR09: Y él os anunció su pacto, el cual os mandó poner por obra, las diez palabras; y escribiólas en dos tablas de piedra.

verses.KJV: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.WEB: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mim também me mandou o SENHOR então ensinar-vos os estatutos e regulamentos, para que os pusestes por obra na terra à qual passais para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: A mí también me mandó Jehová entonces enseñaros los estatutos y derechos, para que los pusieseis por obra en la tierra á la cual pasáis para poseerla.

verses.KJV: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the Lord spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.WEB: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
verses.ASV: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of form on the day that Jehovah spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire;
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai pois muito vossas almas: pois nenhuma forma vistes no dia que o SENHOR falou convosco do meio do fogo:
verses.RVR09: Guardad pues mucho vuestras almas: pues ninguna figura visteis el día que Jehová habló con vosotros de en medio del fuego:

verses.KJV: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.WEB: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.ASV: lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não vos corrompais, e façais para vós escultura, imagem de forma alguma, efígie de macho ou fêmea,
verses.RVR09: Porque no os corrompáis, y hagáis para vosotros escultura, imagen de figura alguna, efigie de varón ó hembra,

verses.KJV: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.WEB: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
verses.ASV: the likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flieth in the heavens,
verses.ALMEIDA: Figura de algum animal que seja na terra, forma de ave alguma de asas que voe pelo ar,
verses.RVR09: Figura de algún animal que sea en la tierra, figura de ave alguna alada que vuele por el aire,

verses.KJV: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.WEB: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
verses.ASV: the likeness of anything that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Figura de nenhum animal que vá arrastando pela terra, forma de peixe algum que haja na água debaixo da terra:
verses.RVR09: Figura de ningún animal que vaya arrastrando por la tierra, figura de pez alguno que haya en el agua debajo de la tierra:

verses.KJV: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the Lord thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.WEB: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
verses.ASV: and lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the host of heaven, thou be drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Jehovah thy God hath allotted unto all the peoples under the whole heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para que levantando teus olhos ao céu, e vendo o sol e a lua e as estrelas, e todo o exército do céu, não sejas incitado, e te inclines a eles, e lhes sirvas; que o SENHOR teu Deus os concedeu a todos os povos debaixo de todos os céus.
verses.RVR09: Y porque alzando tus ojos al cielo, y viendo el sol y la luna y las estrellas, y todo el ejército del cielo, no seas incitado, y te inclines á ellos, y les sirvas; que Jehová tu Dios los ha concedido á todos los pueblos debajo de todos los cielos.

verses.KJV: But the Lord hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
verses.WEB: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as at this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a vós o SENHOR vos tomou, e vos tirou do forno de ferro, do Egito, para que lhe sejais por povo de herança como neste dia.
verses.RVR09: Empero á vosotros Jehová os tomó, y os ha sacado del horno de hierro, de Egipto, para que le seáis por pueblo de heredad como en este día.

verses.KJV: Furthermore the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
verses.WEB: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance;
verses.ASV: Furthermore Jehovah was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR se irou contra mim sobre vossos negócios, e jurou que eu não passaria o Jordão, nem entraria na boa terra, que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá por herança.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová se enojó contra mí sobre vuestros negocios, y juró que yo no pasaría el Jordán, ni entraría en la buena tierra, que Jehová tu Dios te da por heredad.

verses.KJV: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.WEB: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
verses.ASV: but I must die in this land, I must not go over the Jordan; but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim eu vou a morrer nesta terra; e não passo o Jordão: mas vós passareis, e possuireis aquela boa terra.
verses.RVR09: Así que yo voy á morir en esta tierra; y no paso el Jordán: mas vosotros pasaréis, y poseeréis aquella buena tierra.

verses.KJV: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the Lord thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.WEB: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.
verses.ASV: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of Jehovah your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image in the form of anything which Jehovah thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai-vos que não vos esqueçais do pacto do SENHOR vosso Deus, que ele estabeleceu convosco, e vos façais escultura ou imagem de qualquer coisa, que o SENHOR teu Deus te proibiu.
verses.RVR09: Guardaos no os olvidéis del pacto de Jehová vuestro Dios, que él estableció con vosotros, y os hagáis escultura ó imagen de cualquier cosa, que Jehová tu Dios te ha vedado.

verses.KJV: For the Lord thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
verses.WEB: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah thy God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR teu Deus é fogo que consome, Deus zeloso.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová tu Dios es fuego que consume, Dios celoso.

verses.KJV: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the Lord thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.WEB: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,
verses.ASV: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is evil in the sight of Jehovah thy God, to provoke him to anger;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando houverdes gerado filhos e netos, e houverdes envelhecido na terra, e vos corromperdes, e fizerdes escultura ou imagem de qualquer coisa, e fizerdes mal aos olhos do SENHOR vosso Deus, para irá-lo;
verses.RVR09: Cuando hubiereis engendrado hijos y nietos, y hubiereis envejecido en la tierra, y os corrompiereis, é hiciereis escultura ó imagen de cualquier cosa, é hiciereis mal en ojos de Jehová vuestro Dios, para enojarlo;

verses.KJV: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.WEB: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
verses.ASV: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over the Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu ponho hoje por testemunhas ao céu e à terra, que logo perecereis totalmente da terra até a qual passais o Jordão para possuí-la: não estareis nela longos dias sem que sejais destruídos.
verses.RVR09: Yo pongo hoy por testigos al cielo y á la tierra, que presto pereceréis totalmente de la tierra hacia la cual pasáis el Jordán para poseerla: no estaréis en ella largos días sin que seáis destruídos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you.
verses.WEB: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will scatter you among the peoples, and ye shall be left few in number among the nations, whither Jehovah shall lead you away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR vos espalhará entre os povos, e restareis poucos em número entre as nações às quais vos levará o SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová os esparcirá entre los pueblos, y quedaréis pocos en número entre las gentes á las cuales os llevará Jehová:

verses.KJV: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.WEB: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.ASV: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.ALMEIDA: E servireis ali a deuses feitos das mãos de homens, a madeira e a pedra, que não vem, nem ouvem, nem comem, nem cheiram.
verses.RVR09: Y serviréis allí á dioses hechos de manos de hombres, á madera y á piedra, que no ven, ni oyen, ni comen, ni huelen.

verses.KJV: But if from thence thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.WEB: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.ASV: But from thence ye shall seek Jehovah thy God, and thou shalt find him, when thou searchest after him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se desde ali buscares ao SENHOR teu Deus, o acharás, se o buscares de todo teu coração e de toda tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Mas si desde allí buscares á Jehová tu Dios, lo hallarás, si lo buscares de todo tu corazón y de toda tu alma.

verses.KJV: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the Lord thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.WEB: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.
verses.ASV: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, in the latter days thou shalt return to Jehovah thy God, and hearken unto his voice:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando estiveres em angústia, e te alcançarem todas estas coisas, se nos últimos dias te voltares ao SENHOR teu Deus, e ouvires sua voz;
verses.RVR09: Cuando estuviereis en angustia, y te alcanzaren todas estas cosas, si en los postreros días te volvieres á Jehová tu Dios, y oyeres su voz;

verses.KJV: (For the Lord thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.WEB: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
verses.ASV: for Jehovah thy God is a merciful God; he will not fail thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus misericordioso é o SENHOR teu Deus; não te deixará, nem te destruirá, nem se esquecerá do pacto de teus pais que lhes jurou.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios misericordioso es Jehová tu Dios; no te dejará, ni te destruirá, ni se olvidará del pacto de tus padres que les juró.

verses.KJV: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
verses.WEB: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?
verses.ASV: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one end of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been [any such thing] as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pergunta agora dos tempos passados, que foram antes de ti, desde o dia que criou Deus ao homem sobre a terra, e desde um fim do céu ao outro, se se fez coisa semelhante a esta grande coisa, ou se tenha ouvido outra como ela.
verses.RVR09: Porque pregunta ahora de los tiempos pasados, que han sido antes de ti, desde el día que crió Dios al hombre sobre la tierra, y desde el un cabo del cielo al otro, si se ha hecho cosa semejante á esta gran cosa, ó se haya oído otra como ella.

verses.KJV: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.WEB: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
verses.ASV: Did ever a people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouviu povo a voz de Deus, que falasse do meio do fogo, como tu a ouviste, e viveste?
verses.RVR09: ¿Ha oído pueblo la voz de Dios, que hablase de en medio del fuego, como tú la has oído, y vivido?

verses.KJV: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.WEB: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.ASV: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of [another] nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Jehovah your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou experimentou Deus a vir a tomar para si nação do meio de outra nação, com provas, com sinais, com milagres, e com guerra, e mão forte, e braço estendido, e grandes espantos, segundo todas as coisas que fez convosco o SENHOR vosso Deus no Egito diante de teus olhos?
verses.RVR09: ¿O ha Dios probado á venir á tomar para sí gente de en medio de otra gente, con pruebas, con señales, con milagros, y con guerra, y mano fuerte, y brazo extendido, y grandes espantos, según todas las cosas que hizo con vosotros Jehová vuestro Dios en Egipto ante tus ojos?

verses.KJV: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the Lord he is God; there is none else beside him.
verses.WEB: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.
verses.ASV: Unto thee it was showed, that thou mightest know that Jehovah he is God; there is none else besides him.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ti te foi mostrado, para que soubesses que o SENHOR ele é Deus; não há mais além dele.
verses.RVR09: A ti te fué mostrado, para que supieses que Jehová él es Dios; no hay más fuera de él.

verses.KJV: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.WEB: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
verses.ASV: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he made thee to see his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos céus te fez ouvir sua voz, para ensinar-te: e sobre a terra te mostrou seu grande fogo: e ouviste suas palavras do meio do fogo.
verses.RVR09: De los cielos te hizo oir su voz, para enseñarte: y sobre la tierra te mostró su gran fuego: y has oído sus palabras de en medio del fuego.

verses.KJV: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.WEB: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
verses.ASV: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: E porquanto ele amou a teus pais, escolheu sua descendência depois deles, e te tirou diante de si do Egito com seu grande poder;
verses.RVR09: Y por cuanto él amó á tus padres, escogió su simiente después de ellos, y sacóte delante de sí de Egipto con su gran poder;

verses.KJV: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.WEB: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
verses.ASV: to drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as at this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para lançar de diante de ti nações grandes e mais fortes que tu, e para te introduzir, e dar-te sua terra por herança, como hoje.
verses.RVR09: Para echar de delante de ti gentes grandes y más fuertes que tú, y para introducirte, y darte su tierra por heredad, como hoy.

verses.KJV: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the Lord he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
verses.WEB: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
verses.ASV: Know therefore this day, and lay it to thy heart, that Jehovah he is God in heaven above and upon the earth beneath; there is none else.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aprende pois hoje, e medita em teu coração que o SENHOR ele é o Deus acima no céu, e abaixo sobre a terra; não há outro.
verses.RVR09: Aprende pues hoy, y reduce á tu corazón que Jehová él es el Dios arriba en el cielo, y abajo sobre la tierra; no hay otro.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the Lord thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.WEB: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt keep his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days in the land, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E guarda seus estatutos e seus mandamentos, que eu te mando hoje, para que te vá bem a ti e a teus filhos depois de ti, e prolongues teus dias sobre a terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y guarda sus estatutos y sus mandamientos, que yo te mando hoy, para que te vaya bien á ti y á tus hijos después de ti, y prolongues tus días sobre la tierra que Jehová tu Dios te da para siempre.

verses.KJV: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.WEB: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
verses.ASV: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então separou Moisés três cidades desta parte do Jordão ao oriente,
verses.RVR09: Entonces apartó Moisés tres ciudades de esta parte del Jordán al nacimiento del sol,

verses.KJV: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.WEB: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
verses.ASV: that the manslayer might flee thither, that slayeth his neighbor unawares, and hated him not in time past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que fugisse ali o homicida que matasse a seu próximo por acidente, sem haver tido inimizade com ele desde ontem nem antes de ontem; e que fugindo de uma vez destas cidades salvara a vida:
verses.RVR09: Para que huyese allí el homicida que matase á su prójimo por yerro, sin haber tenido enemistad con él desde ayer ni antes de ayer; y que huyendo á una de estas ciudades salvara la vida:

verses.KJV: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.WEB: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
verses.ASV: [namely], Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
verses.ALMEIDA: A Bezer no deserto, em terra da planície, dos rubenitas; e a Ramote em Gileade, dos gaditas; e a Golã em Basã, dos de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: A Beser en el desierto, en tierra de la llanura, de los Rubenitas; y á Ramoth en Galaad, de los Gaditas; y á Golán en Basán, de los de Manasés.

verses.KJV: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.WEB: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta, pois, é a lei que Moisés propôs diante dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Esta, pues, es la ley que Moisés propuso delante de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt.
verses.WEB: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
verses.ASV: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, when they came forth out of Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os testemunhos, e os estatutos, e os regulamentos, que Moisés notificou aos filhos de Israel, quando houveram saído do Egito;
verses.RVR09: Estos son los testimonios, y los estatutos, y los derechos, que Moisés notificó á los hijos de Israel, cuando hubieron salido de Egipto;

verses.KJV: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.WEB: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.
verses.ASV: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, when they came forth out of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desta parte do Jordão, no vale diante de Bete-Peor, na terra de Seom rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, ao qual feriu Moisés com os filhos de Israel, quando saíram do Egito:
verses.RVR09: De esta parte del Jordán, en el valle delante de Beth-peor, en la tierra de Sehón rey de los Amorrheos, que habitaba en Hesbón, al cual hirió Moisés con los hijos de Israel, cuando hubieron salido de Egipto:

verses.KJV: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.WEB: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
verses.ASV: And they took his land in possession, and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.ALMEIDA: E possuíram sua terra, e a terra de Ogue rei de Basã; dois reis dos amorreus que estavam desta parte do Jordão, ao oriente:
verses.RVR09: Y poseyeron su tierra, y la tierra de Og rey de Basán; dos reyes de los Amorrheos que estaban de esta parte del Jordán, al nacimiento del sol:

verses.KJV: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
verses.WEB: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),
verses.ASV: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even unto mount Sion (the same is Hermon),
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde Aroer, que está junto à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, até o monte de Sião, que é Hermom;
verses.RVR09: Desde Aroer, que está junto á la ribera del arroyo de Arnón, hasta el monte de Sión, que es Hermón;

verses.KJV: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
verses.WEB: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.ASV: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a planície desta parte do Jordão, ao oriente, até o mar da planície, as encostas das águas abaixo do Pisga.
verses.RVR09: Y toda la llanura de esta parte del Jordán, al oriente, hasta la mar del llano, las vertientes de las aguas abajo del Pisga.

verses.KJV: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.WEB: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
verses.ASV: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and observe to do them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Moisés a todo Israel, e disse-lhes: Ouve, Israel, os estatutos e regulamentos que eu pronuncio hoje em vossos ouvidos: e aprendei-os, e guardai-os, para praticá-los.
verses.RVR09: Y LLAMÓ Moisés á todo Israel, y díjoles: Oye, Israel, los estatutos y derechos que yo pronuncio hoy en vuestros oídos: y aprendedlos, y guardadlos, para ponerlos por obra.

verses.KJV: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.WEB: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.ASV: Jehovah our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR nosso Deus fez pacto conosco em Horebe.
verses.RVR09: Jehová nuestro Dios hizo pacto con nosotros en Horeb.

verses.KJV: The Lord made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.WEB: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
verses.ASV: Jehovah made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não com nossos pais fez o SENHOR este pacto, a não ser conosco todos os que estamos aqui hoje vivos.
verses.RVR09: No con nuestros padres hizo Jehová este pacto, sino con nosotros todos los que estamos aquí hoy vivos.

verses.KJV: The Lord talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
verses.ASV: Jehovah spake with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire
verses.ALMEIDA: Face a face falou o SENHOR convosco no monte do meio do fogo,
verses.RVR09: Cara á cara habló Jehová con vosotros en el monte de en medio del fuego,

verses.KJV: (I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to shew you the word of the Lord: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
verses.WEB: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,
verses.ASV: (I stood between Jehovah and you at that time, to show you the word of Jehovah: for ye were afraid because of the fire, and went not up into the mount), saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: (Eu estava então entre o SENHOR e vós, para vos anunciar a palavra do SENHOR; porque vós tivestes temor do fogo, e não subistes ao monte;) dizendo:
verses.RVR09: (Yo estaba entonces entre Jehová y vosotros, para denunciaros la palabra de Jehová; porque vosotros tuvisteis temor del fuego, y no subisteis al monte;) diciendo:

verses.KJV: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.WEB: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, de casa de servos.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy Jehová tu Dios, que te saqué de tierra de Egipto, de casa de siervos.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
verses.WEB: “You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não terás deuses estranhos diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: No tendrás dioses extraños delante de mí.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.WEB: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not make unto thee a graven image, [nor] any likeness [of anything] that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não farás para ti escultura, nem imagem alguma de coisa que está acima nos céus, ou abaixo na terra, ou nas águas debaixo da terra:
verses.RVR09: No harás para ti escultura, ni imagen alguna de cosa que está arriba en los cielos, ó abajo en la tierra, ó en las aguas debajo de la tierra:

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
verses.WEB: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me
verses.ASV: thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them; for I, Jehovah, thy God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the third and upon the fourth generation of them that hate me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te inclinarás a elas nem lhes servirás: porque eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, forte, zeloso, que visito a iniquidade dos pais sobre os filhos, e sobre a terceira geração, e sobre a quarta, aos que me aborrecem,
verses.RVR09: No te inclinarás á ellas ni les servirás: porque yo soy Jehová tu Dios, fuerte, celoso, que visito la iniquidad de los padres sobre los hijos, y sobre los terceros, y sobre los cuartos, á los que me aborrecen,

verses.KJV: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.WEB: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.ASV: and showing lovingkindness unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que faço misericórdia a milhares aos que me amam, e guardam meus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Y que hago misericordia á millares á los que me aman, y guardan mis mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.WEB: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not take the name of Jehovah thy God in vain: for Jehovah will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tomarás em vão o nome do SENHOR teu Deus; porque o SENHOR não dará por inocente ao que tomar em vão seu nome.
verses.RVR09: No tomarás en vano el nombre de Jehová tu Dios; porque Jehová no dará por inocente al que tomare en vano su nombre.

verses.KJV: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee.
verses.WEB: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.
verses.ASV: Observe the sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Jehovah thy God commanded thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardarás o dia do repouso para santificá-lo, como o SENHOR teu Deus te mandou.
verses.RVR09: Guardarás el día del reposo para santificarlo, como Jehová tu Dios te ha mandado.

verses.KJV: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
verses.WEB: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
verses.ASV: Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work;
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis dias trabalharás e farás toda tua obra:
verses.RVR09: Seis días trabajarás y harás toda tu obra:

verses.KJV: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
verses.WEB: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
verses.ASV: but the seventh day is a sabbath unto Jehovah thy God: [in it] thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy man-servant, nor thy maid-servant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy man-servant and thy maid-servant may rest as well as thou.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas no sétimo é repouso ao SENHOR teu Deus: nenhuma obra farás tu, nem teu filho, nem tua filha, nem teu servo, nem tua serva, nem tua boi, nem tua asno, nem nenhum animal teu, nem tua peregrino que está dentro de tuas portas: para que descanse teu servo e tua serva como
verses.RVR09: Mas el séptimo es reposo á Jehová tu Dios: ninguna obra harás tú, ni tu hijo, ni tu hija, ni tu siervo, ni tu sierva, ni tu buey, ni tu asno, ni ningún animal tuyo, ni tu peregrino que está dentro de tus puertas: porque descanse tu siervo y tu sierva como tú.

verses.KJV: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.WEB: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and Jehovah thy God brought thee out thence by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm: therefore Jehovah thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lembra-te que foste servo em terra do Egito, e que o SENHOR teu Deus te tirou dali com mão forte e braço estendido: pelo qual o SENHOR teu Deus te mandou que guardes no dia do repouso.
verses.RVR09: Y acuérdate que fuiste siervo en tierra de Egipto, y que Jehová tu Dios te sacó de allá con mano fuerte y brazo extendido: por lo cual Jehová tu Dios te ha mandado que guardes el día del reposo.

verses.KJV: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
verses.WEB: “Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
verses.ASV: Honor thy father and thy mother, as Jehovah thy God commanded thee; that thy days may be long, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, como o SENHOR teu Deus te mandou, para que sejam prolongados teus dias, e para que te vá bem sobre a terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá.
verses.RVR09: Honra á tu padre y á tu madre, como Jehová tu Dios te ha mandado, para que sean prolongados tus días, y para que te vaya bien sobre la tierra que Jehová tu Dios te da.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.WEB: “You shall not murder.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não cometerás homicídio.
verses.RVR09: No matarás.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
verses.WEB: “You shall not commit adultery.
verses.ASV: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não adulterarás.
verses.RVR09: No adulterarás.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou steal.
verses.WEB: “You shall not steal.
verses.ASV: Neither shalt thou steal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não furtarás.
verses.RVR09: No hurtarás.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.WEB: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.ASV: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não dirás falso testemunho contra teu próximo.
verses.RVR09: No dirás falso testimonio contra tu prójimo.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.
verses.WEB: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
verses.ASV: Neither shalt thou covet thy neighbor’s wife; neither shalt thou desire thy neighbor’s house, his field, or his man-servant, or his maid-servant, his ox, or his ass, or anything that is thy neighbor’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não cobiçarás a mulher de teu próximo, nem desejarás a casa de teu próximo, nem sua terra, nem seu servo, nem sua serva, nem seu boi, nem seu asno, nem nenhuma coisa que seja de teu próximo.
verses.RVR09: No codiciarás la mujer de tu prójimo, ni desearás la casa de tu prójimo, ni su tierra, ni su siervo, ni su sierva, ni su buey, ni su asno, ni ninguna cosa que sea de tu prójimo.

verses.KJV: These words the Lord spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
verses.ASV: These words Jehovah spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them upon two tables of stone, and gave them unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas palavras falou o SENHOR a toda vossa congregação no monte, do meio do fogo, da nuvem e da escuridão, a grande voz: e não acrescentou mais. E escreveu-os em duas tábuas de pedra, as quais deu a mim.
verses.RVR09: Estas palabras habló Jehová á toda vuestra congregación en el monte, de en medio del fuego, de la nube y de la oscuridad, á gran voz: y no añadió más. Y escribiólas en dos tablas de piedra, las cuales me dió á mí.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.WEB: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, que como vós ouvistes a voz do meio das trevas, e vistes ao monte que ardia em fogo, aproximastes a mim todos os príncipes de vossas tribos, e vossos anciãos;
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que como vosotros oisteis la voz de en medio de las tinieblas, y visteis al monte que ardía en fuego, llegasteis á mí todos los príncipes de vuestras tribus, y vuestros ancianos;

verses.KJV: And ye said, Behold, the Lord our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
verses.WEB: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
verses.ASV: and ye said, Behold, Jehovah our God hath showed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth speak with man, and he liveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dissestes: Eis que, o SENHOR nosso Deus nos mostrou sua glória e sua grandeza, e ouvimos sua voz do meio do fogo: hoje vimos que o SENHOR fala ao homem, e este vive.
verses.RVR09: Y dijisteis: He aquí, Jehová nuestro Dios nos ha mostrado su gloria y su grandeza, y hemos oído su voz de en medio del fuego: hoy hemos visto que Jehová habla al hombre, y éste vive.

verses.KJV: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
verses.ASV: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of Jehovah our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora pois, por que morreremos? Que este grande fogo nos consumirá: se voltarmos a ouvir a voz do SENHOR nosso Deus, morreremos.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, ¿por qué moriremos? que este gran fuego nos consumirá: si tornáremos á oir la voz de Jehová nuestro Dios, moriremos.

verses.KJV: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.WEB: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.ASV: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, que é toda carne, para que ouça a voz do Deus vivente que fala do meio do fogo, como nós a ouvimos, e viva?
verses.RVR09: Porque, ¿qué es toda carne, para que oiga la voz del Dios viviente que habla de en medio del fuego, como nosotros la oímos, y viva?

verses.KJV: Go thou near, and hear all that the Lord our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the Lord our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
verses.WEB: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
verses.ASV: Go thou near, and hear all that Jehovah our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that Jehovah our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chega tu, e ouve todas as coisas que disser o SENHOR nosso Deus; e tu nos dirás todo o que o SENHOR nosso Deus te disser, e nós ouviremos e faremos.
verses.RVR09: Llega tú, y oye todas las cosas que dijere Jehová nuestro Dios; y tú nos dirás todo lo que Jehová nuestro Dios te dijere, y nosotros oiremos y haremos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the Lord said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.WEB: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and Jehovah said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu o SENHOR a voz de vossas palavras, quando me faláveis; e disse-me o SENHOR: Ouvi a voz das palavras deste povo, que eles te falaram: bem está tudo o que disseram.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Jehová la voz de vuestras palabras, cuando me hablabais; y díjome Jehová: He oído la voz de las palabras de este pueblo, que ellos te han hablado: bien está todo lo que han dicho.

verses.KJV: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.WEB: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!
verses.ASV: Oh that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem dera que tivessem tal coração, que me temessem, e guardassem todos os dias todos meus mandamentos, para que a eles e a seus filhos lhes fosse bem para sempre!
verses.RVR09: ¡Quién diera que tuviesen tal corazón, que me temiesen, y guardasen todos los días todos mis mandamientos, para que á ellos y á sus hijos les fuese bien para siempre!

verses.KJV: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
verses.WEB: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
verses.ASV: Go say to them, Return ye to your tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, dize-lhes: Voltai-vos a vossas tendas.
verses.RVR09: Ve, diles: Volveos á vuestras tiendas.

verses.KJV: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.WEB: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”
verses.ASV: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu fica aqui comigo, e te direi todos os mandamentos, e estatutos, e regulamentos que lhes hás de ensinar, a fim que os ponham agora por obra na terra que eu lhes dou para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: Y tú estáte aquí conmigo, y te diré todos los mandamientos, y estatutos, y derechos, que les has de enseñar, á fin que los pongan ahora por obra en la tierra que yo les doy para poseerla.

verses.KJV: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the Lord your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.WEB: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
verses.ASV: Ye shall observe to do therefore as Jehovah your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai, pois, que façais como o SENHOR vosso Deus vos mandou: não vos desvieis à direita nem à esquerda;
verses.RVR09: Mirad, pues, que hagáis como Jehová vuestro Dios os ha mandado: no os apartéis á diestra ni á siniestra;

verses.KJV: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the Lord your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
verses.WEB: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
verses.ASV: Ye shall walk in all the way which Jehovah your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
verses.ALMEIDA: Andai em todo caminho que o SENHOR vosso Deus vos mandou, para que vivais, e vos vá bem, e tenhais longos dias na terra que haveis de possuir.
verses.RVR09: Andad en todo camino que Jehová vuestro Dios os ha mandado, para que viváis, y os vaya bien, y tengáis largos días en la tierra que habéis de poseer.

verses.KJV: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
verses.WEB: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;
verses.ASV: Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Jehovah your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois são os mandamentos, estatutos, e regulamentos que o SENHOR vosso Deus mandou que vos ensinasse, para que os ponhais por obra na terra à qual passais vós para possuí-la:
verses.RVR09: ESTOS pues son los mandamientos, estatutos, y derechos que Jehová vuestro Dios mandó que os enseñase, para que los pongáis por obra en la tierra á la cual pasáis vosotros para poseerla:

verses.KJV: That thou mightest fear the Lord thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.WEB: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
verses.ASV: that thou mightest fear Jehovah thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que temas ao SENHOR teu Deus, guardando todos os seus estatutos e seus mandamentos que eu te mando, tu, e teu filho, e o filho de teu filho, todos os dias de tua vida, e que teus dias sejam prolongados.
verses.RVR09: Para que temas á Jehová tu Dios, guardando todos sus estatutos y sus mandamientos que yo te mando, tú, y tu hijo, y el hijo de tu hijo, todos los días de tu vida, y que tus días sean prolongados.

verses.KJV: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.WEB: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.ASV: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as Jehovah, the God of thy fathers, hath promised unto thee, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, pois, ó Israel, e cuida de praticá-los, para que te vá bem, e sejais multiplicados, como te disse o SENHOR o Deus de teus pais, na terra que destila leite e mel.
verses.RVR09: Oye pues, oh Israel, y cuida de ponerlos por obra, para que te vaya bien, y seáis multiplicados, como te ha dicho Jehová el Dios de tus padres, en la tierra que destila leche y miel.

verses.KJV: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.WEB: Hear, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is one.
verses.ASV: Hear, O Israel: Jehovah our God is one Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, Israel: o SENHOR nosso Deus, o SENHOR um é:
verses.RVR09: Oye, Israel: Jehová nuestro Dios, Jehová uno es:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.WEB: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Amarás ao SENHOR teu Deus de todo teu coração, e de toda tua alma, e com todo tua poder.
verses.RVR09: Y amarás á Jehová tu Dios de todo tu corazón, y de toda tu alma, y con todo tu poder.

verses.KJV: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
verses.WEB: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
verses.ASV: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be upon thy heart;
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas palavras que eu te mando hoje, estarão sobre teu coração:
verses.RVR09: Y estas palabras que yo te mando hoy, estarán sobre tu corazón:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.WEB: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as repetirás a teus filhos, e falarás delas estando em tua casa, e andando pelo caminho, e ao deitar-te, e quando te levantes:
verses.RVR09: Y las repetirás á tus hijos, y hablarás de ellas estando en tu casa, y andando por el camino, y al acostarte, y cuando te levantes:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.WEB: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thy hand, and they shall be for frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E hás de atá-las por sinal em tua mão, e estarão por frontais entre teus olhos:
verses.RVR09: Y has de atarlas por señal en tu mano, y estarán por frontales entre tus ojos:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
verses.WEB: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as escreverás nos umbrais de tua casa, e em tuas entradas.
verses.RVR09: Y las escribirás en los postes de tu casa, y en tus portadas.

verses.KJV: And it shall be, when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
verses.WEB: It shall be, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,
verses.ASV: And it shall be, when Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee, great and goodly cities, which thou buildest not,
verses.ALMEIDA: E será, quando o SENHOR teu Deus te houver introduzido na terra que jurou a teus pais Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, que te daria; em cidades grandes e boas que tu não edificaste,
verses.RVR09: Y será, cuando Jehová tu Dios te hubiere introducido en la tierra que juró á tus padres Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob, que te daría; en ciudades grandes y buenas que tú no edificaste,

verses.KJV: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
verses.WEB: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
verses.ASV: and houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and cisterns hewn out, which thou hewedst not, vineyards and olive-trees, which thou plantedst not, and thou shalt eat and be full;
verses.ALMEIDA: E casas cheias de todo ainda que tu não encheste, e cisternas cavadas, que tu não cavaste, vinhas e olivais que não plantaste: logo que comeres e te fartares,
verses.RVR09: Y casas llenas de todo bien, que tú no henchiste, y cisternas cavadas, que tú no cavaste, viñas y olivares que no plantaste: luego que comieres y te hartares,
