verses.KJV: Then beware lest thou forget the Lord, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.WEB: then beware lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.ASV: then beware lest thou forget Jehovah, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda-te que não te esqueças do SENHOR, que te tirou da terra do Egito, de casa de servos.
verses.RVR09: Guárdate que no te olvides de Jehová, que te sacó de tierra de Egipto, de casa de siervos.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.WEB: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt fear Jehovah thy God; and him shalt thou serve, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao SENHOR teu Deus temerás, e a ele servirás, e por seu nome jurarás.
verses.RVR09: A Jehová tu Dios temerás, y á él servirás, y por su nombre jurarás.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
verses.WEB: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,
verses.ASV: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples that are round about you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não andareis após deuses alheios, dos deuses dos povos que estão em vossos entornos:
verses.RVR09: No andaréis en pos de dioses ajenos, de los dioses de los pueblos que están en vuestros contornos:

verses.KJV: (For the Lord thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the Lord thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
verses.ASV: for Jehovah thy God in the midst of thee is a jealous God; lest the anger of Jehovah thy God be kindled against thee, and he destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Deus zeloso, o SENHOR teu Deus, em meio de ti está; para que não se inflame o furor do SENHOR teu Deus contra ti, e te destrua de sobre a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Dios celoso, Jehová tu Dios, en medio de ti está; porque no se inflame el furor de Jehová tu Dios contra ti, y te destruya de sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Ye shall not tempt the Lord your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
verses.WEB: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
verses.ASV: Ye shall not tempt Jehovah your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tentareis ao SENHOR vosso Deus, como o tentastes em Massá.
verses.RVR09: No tentaréis á Jehová vuestro Dios, como lo tentasteis en Massa.

verses.KJV: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
verses.WEB: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
verses.ASV: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of Jehovah your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardai cuidadosamente os mandamentos do SENHOR vosso Deus, e seus testemunhos, e seus estatutos, que te mandou.
verses.RVR09: Guardad cuidadosamente los mandamientos de Jehová vuestro Dios, y sus testimonios, y sus estatutos, que te ha mandado.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the Lord: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers.
verses.WEB: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,
verses.ASV: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of Jehovah; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers,
verses.ALMEIDA: E farás o correto e bom aos olhos do SENHOR, para que te vá bem, e entres e possuas a boa terra que o SENHOR jurou a teus pais;
verses.RVR09: Y harás lo recto y bueno en ojos de Jehová, para que te vaya bien, y entres y poseas la buena tierra que Jehová juró á tus padres;

verses.KJV: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the Lord hath spoken.
verses.WEB: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.
verses.ASV: to thrust out all thine enemies from before thee, as Jehovah hath spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que ele expulse a todos os seus inimigos de diante de ti, como o SENHOR disse.
verses.RVR09: Para que él eche á todos tus enemigos de delante de ti, como Jehová ha dicho.

verses.KJV: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord our God hath commanded you?
verses.WEB: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God has commanded you mean?”
verses.ASV: When thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Jehovah our God hath commanded you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando amanhã te perguntar teu filho, dizendo: Que significam os testemunhos, e estatutos, e regulamentos, que o SENHOR nosso Deus vos mandou?
verses.RVR09: Cuando mañana te preguntare tu hijo, diciendo: ¿Qué significan los testimonios, y estatutos, y derechos, que Jehová nuestro Dios os mandó?

verses.KJV: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.WEB: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
verses.ASV: then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt: and Jehovah brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então dirás a teu filho: Nós éramos servos de Faraó no Egito, e o SENHOR tirou do Egito com mão forte;
verses.RVR09: Entonces dirás á tu hijo: Nosotros éramos siervos de Faraón en Egipto, y Jehová nos sacó de Egipto con mano fuerte;

verses.KJV: And the Lord shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.WEB: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
verses.ASV: and Jehovah showed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his house, before our eyes;
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu o SENHOR sinais e milagres grandes e nocivos no Egito, sobre Faraó e sobre toda sua casa, diante de nossos olhos;
verses.RVR09: Y dió Jehová señales y milagros grandes y nocivos en Egipto, sobre Faraón y sobre toda su casa, delante de nuestros ojos;

verses.KJV: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.WEB: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
verses.ASV: and he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirou-nos dali, para trazer-nos e dar-nos a terra que jurou a nossos pais;
verses.RVR09: Y sacónos de allá, para traernos y darnos la tierra que juró á nuestros padres;

verses.KJV: And the Lord commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
verses.WEB: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Jehovah our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as at this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou-nos o SENHOR que executássemos todos estes estatutos, e que temamos ao SENHOR nosso Deus, para que nos vá bem todos os dias, e para que nos dê vida, como hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y mandónos Jehová que ejecutásemos todos estos estatutos, y que temamos á Jehová nuestro Dios, porque nos vaya bien todos los días, y para que nos dé vida, como hoy.

verses.KJV: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us.
verses.WEB: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us.”
verses.ASV: And it shall be righteousness unto us, if we observe to do all this commandment before Jehovah our God, as he hath commanded us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teremos justiça quando cuidarmos de pôr por obra todos estes mandamentos diante do SENHOR nosso Deus, como ele nos mandou.
verses.RVR09: Y tendremos justicia cuando cuidáremos de poner por obra todos estos mandamientos delante de Jehová nuestro Dios, como él nos ha mandado.

verses.KJV: When the Lord thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.WEB: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;
verses.ASV: When Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and shall cast out many nations before thee, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o SENHOR teu Deus te houver introduzido na terra na qual tu hás de entrar para possuí-la, e houver expulsado de diante de ti muitas nações, aos heteus, aos gergeseus, e aos amorreus, e aos cananeus, e aos perizeus, e aos heveus, e aos jebuseus, sete nações maiores e mais fortes que tu;
verses.RVR09: CUANDO Jehová tu Dios te hubiere introducido en la tierra en la cual tú has de entrar para poseerla, y hubiere echado de delante de ti muchas gentes, al Hetheo, al Gergeseo, y al Amorrheo, y al Cananeo, y al Pherezeo, y al Heveo, y al Jebuseo, siete naciones mayores y más fuertes que tú;

verses.KJV: And when the Lord thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
verses.WEB: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
verses.ASV: and when Jehovah thy God shall deliver them up before thee, and thou shalt smite them; then thou shalt utterly destroy them: thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor show mercy unto them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR teu Deus as houver entregue diante de ti, e as ferires, por completo as destruirás: não farás com eles aliança, nem as pouparás.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová tu Dios las hubiere entregado delante de ti, y las hirieres, del todo las destruirás: no harás con ellos alianza, ni las tomarás á merced.

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
verses.WEB: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
verses.ASV: neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não aparentarás com eles: não darás tua filha a seu filho, nem tomarás a sua filha para teu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y no emparentarás con ellos: no darás tu hija á su hijo, ni tomarás á su hija para tu hijo.

verses.KJV: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
verses.WEB: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So the LORD’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
verses.ASV: For he will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of Jehovah be kindled against you, and he will destroy thee quickly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque desviará a teu filho de me seguir, e servirão a deuses alheios; e o furor do SENHOR se acenderá sobre vós, e te destruirá logo.
verses.RVR09: Porque desviará á tu hijo de en pos de mí, y servirán á dioses ajenos; y el furor de Jehová se encenderá sobre vosotros, y te destruirá presto.

verses.KJV: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.WEB: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.
verses.ASV: But thus shall ye deal with them: ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and hew down their Asherim, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas assim haveis de fazer com eles: destruireis seus altares, e quebrareis suas colunas sagradas, cortareis seus mastros de idolatria, e queimareis suas esculturas a fogo.
verses.RVR09: Mas así habéis de hacer con ellos: sus altares destruiréis, y quebraréis sus estatuas, y cortaréis sus bosques, y quemaréis sus esculturas en el fuego.

verses.KJV: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
verses.ASV: For thou art a holy people unto Jehovah thy God: Jehovah thy God hath chosen thee to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu és povo santo ao SENHOR teu Deus: o SENHOR teu Deus te escolheu para ser-lhe um povo especial, mais que todos os povos que estão sobre a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú eres pueblo santo á Jehová tu Dios: Jehová tu Dios te ha escogido para serle un pueblo especial, más que todos los pueblos que están sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: The Lord did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
verses.WEB: The LORD didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;
verses.ASV: Jehovah did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all peoples:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não por ser vós mais que todos os povos vos quis o SENHOR, e vos escolheu; porque vós éreis os menores de todos os povos:
verses.RVR09: No por ser vosotros más que todos los pueblos os ha querido Jehová, y os ha escogido; porque vosotros erais los más pocos de todos los pueblos:

verses.KJV: But because the Lord loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the Lord brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.WEB: but because the LORD loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.ASV: but because Jehovah loveth you, and because he would keep the oath which he sware unto your fathers, hath Jehovah brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sim porque o SENHOR vos amou, e quis guardar o juramento que jurou a vossos pais, vos tirou o SENHOR com mão forte, e vos resgatou de casa de servos, da mão de Faraó, rei do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Sino porque Jehová os amó, y quiso guardar el juramento que juró á vuestros padres, os ha sacado Jehová con mano fuerte, y os ha rescatado de casa de siervos, de la mano de Faraón, rey de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Know therefore that the Lord thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.WEB: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,
verses.ASV: Know therefore that Jehovah thy God, he is God, the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and lovingkindness with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
verses.ALMEIDA: Conhece, pois, que o SENHOR teu Deus é Deus, Deus fiel, que guarda o pacto e a misericórdia aos que lhe amam e guardam seus mandamentos, até as mil gerações;
verses.RVR09: Conoce, pues, que Jehová tu Dios es Dios, Dios fiel, que guarda el pacto y la misericordia á los que le aman y guardan sus mandamientos, hasta las mil generaciones;

verses.KJV: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
verses.WEB: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
verses.ASV: and repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que retribui em sua face ao que lhe aborrece, destruindo-o: nem o dilatará ao que lhe odeia, em sua face lhe retribuirá.
verses.RVR09: Y que da el pago en su cara al que le aborrece, destruyéndolo: ni lo dilatará al que le odia, en su cara le dará el pago.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
verses.WEB: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command thee this day, to do them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda portanto os mandamentos, e estatutos, e regulamentos que eu te mando hoje que cumpras.
verses.RVR09: Guarda por tanto los mandamientos, y estatutos, y derechos que yo te mando hoy que cumplas.

verses.KJV: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the Lord thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
verses.WEB: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, because ye hearken to these ordinances, and keep and do them, that Jehovah thy God will keep with thee the covenant and the lovingkindness which he sware unto thy fathers:
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, por haver ouvido estes regulamentos, e guardado e os praticado, o SENHOR teu Deus guardará contigo o pacto e a misericórdia que jurou a teus pais;
verses.RVR09: Y será que, por haber oído estos derechos, y guardado y puéstolos por obra, Jehová tu Dios guardará contigo el pacto y la misericordia que juró á tus padres;

verses.KJV: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.WEB: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.ASV: and he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee; he will also bless the fruit of thy body and the fruit of thy ground, thy grain and thy new wine and thine oil, the increase of thy cattle and the young of thy flock, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te amará, e te abençoará, e te multiplicará, e abençoará o fruto de teu ventre, e o fruto de tua terra, e teu grão, e teu mosto, e teu azeite, a cria de tuas vacas, e os rebanhos de tuas ovelhas, na terra que jurou a teus pais que te daria.
verses.RVR09: Y te amará, y te bendecirá, y te multiplicará, y bendecirá el fruto de tu vientre, y el fruto de tu tierra, y tu grano, y tu mosto, y tu aceite, la cría de tus vacas, y los rebaños de tus ovejas, en la tierra que juró á tus padres que te daría.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.WEB: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt be blessed above all peoples: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito serás mais que todos os povos: não haverá em ti homem nem mulher estéril, nem em teus animais.
verses.RVR09: Bendito serás más que todos los pueblos: no habrá en ti varón ni hembra estéril, ni en tus bestias.

verses.KJV: And the Lord will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will take away from thee all sickness; and none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, will he put upon thee, but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirará o SENHOR de ti toda enfermidade; e todas as más pragas do Egito, que tu sabes, não as porá sobre ti, antes as porá sobre todos os que te odiarem.
verses.RVR09: Y quitará Jehová de ti toda enfermedad; y todas las malas plagas de Egipto, que tú sabes, no las pondrá sobre ti, antes las pondrá sobre todos los que te aborrecieren.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt consume all the people which the Lord thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.
verses.WEB: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt consume all the peoples that Jehovah thy God shall deliver unto thee; thine eye shall not pity them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E consumirás a todos os povos que te dá o SENHOR teu Deus: não os perdoará teu olho; nem servirás a seus deuses, que te será tropeço.
verses.RVR09: Y consumirás á todos los pueblos que te da Jehová tu Dios: no los perdonará tu ojo; ni servirás á sus dioses, que te será tropiezo.

verses.KJV: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
verses.WEB: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”
verses.ASV: If thou shalt say in thy heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando disseres em teu coração: Estas nações são muitas mais que eu, como as poderei desarraigar?;
verses.RVR09: Cuando dijeres en tu corazón: Estas gentes son muchas más que yo, ¿cómo las podré desarraigar?;

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the Lord thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
verses.WEB: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
verses.ASV: thou shalt not be afraid of them: thou shalt well remember what Jehovah thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tenhas medo deles: lembra-te bem do que fez o SENHOR teu Deus com Faraó e com todo o Egito;
verses.RVR09: No tengas temor de ellos: acuérdate bien de lo que hizo Jehová tu Dios con Faraón y con todo Egipto;

verses.KJV: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the Lord thy God brought thee out: so shall the Lord thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
verses.WEB: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
verses.ASV: the great trials which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, whereby Jehovah thy God brought thee out: so shall Jehovah thy God do unto all the peoples of whom thou art afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Das grandes provas que viram teus olhos, e dos sinais e milagres, e da mão forte e braço estendido com que o SENHOR teu Deus te tirou: assim fará o SENHOR teu Deus com todos os povos de cuja presença tu temerdes.
verses.RVR09: De las grandes pruebas que vieron tus ojos, y de las señales y milagros, y de la mano fuerte y brazo extendido con que Jehová tu Dios te sacó: así hará Jehová tu Dios con todos los pueblos de cuya presencia tú temieres.

verses.KJV: Moreover the Lord thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
verses.ASV: Moreover Jehovah thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves, perish from before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também enviará o SENHOR teu Deus sobre eles vespas, até que pereçam os que restarem, e os que se houverem escondido de diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Y también enviará Jehová tu Dios sobre ellos avispas, hasta que perezcan los que quedaren, y los que se hubieren escondido de delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the Lord thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
verses.WEB: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them; for Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a great God and a terrible.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não desmaies diante deles, que o SENHOR teu Deus está em meio de ti, Deus grande e terrível.
verses.RVR09: No desmayes delante de ellos, que Jehová tu Dios está en medio de ti, Dios grande y terrible.

verses.KJV: And the Lord thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah thy God will cast out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR teu Deus expulsará a estas nações de diante de ti pouco a pouco: não as poderás acabar logo, para que os animais do campo não se aumentem contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová tu Dios echará á estas gentes de delante de ti poco á poco: no las podrás acabar luego, porque las bestias del campo no se aumenten contra ti.

verses.KJV: But the Lord thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
verses.WEB: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah thy God will deliver them up before thee, and will discomfit them with a great discomfiture, until they be destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR teu Deus as entregará diante de ti, e ele as quebrantará com grande destroço, até que sejam destruídos.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová tu Dios las entregará delante de ti, y él las quebrantará con grande destrozo, hasta que sean destruídos.

verses.KJV: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
verses.WEB: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.
verses.ASV: And he will deliver their kings into thy hand, and thou shalt make their name to perish from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele entregará seus reis em tua mão, e tu destruirás o nome deles de debaixo do céu: ninguém te fará testa até que os destruas.
verses.RVR09: Y él entregará sus reyes en tu mano, y tú destruirás el nombre de ellos de debajo del cielo: nadie te hará frente hasta que los destruyas.

verses.KJV: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therin: for it is an abomination to the Lord thy God.
verses.WEB: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein; for it is an abomination to Jehovah thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: As esculturas de seus deuses queimarás no fogo: não cobiçarás prata nem ouro de sobre elas para tomá-lo para ti, para que não tropeces nisso, pois é abominação ao SENHOR teu Deus;
verses.RVR09: Las esculturas de sus dioses quemarás en el fuego: no codiciarás plata ni oro de sobre ellas para tomarlo para ti, porque no tropieces en ello, pues es abominación á Jehová tu Dios;

verses.KJV: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
verses.WEB: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not bring an abomination into thy house, and become a devoted thing like unto it: thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não meterás abominação em tua casa, para que não sejas anátema como isso; por completo o aborrecerás e o abominarás; porque é anátema.
verses.RVR09: Y no meterás abominación en tu casa, porque no seas anatema como ello; del todo lo aborrecerás y lo abominarás; porque es anatema.

verses.KJV: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers.
verses.WEB: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.
verses.ASV: All the commandment which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah sware unto your fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cuidareis de pôr por obra todo mandamento que eu vos ordeno hoje, para que vivais, e sejais multiplicados, e entreis, e possuais a terra, da qual jurou o SENHOR a vossos pais.
verses.RVR09: CUIDARÉIS de poner por obra todo mandamiento que yo os ordeno hoy, porque viváis, y seáis multiplicados, y entréis, y poseáis la tierra, de la cual juró Jehová á vuestros padres.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
verses.WEB: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt remember all the way which Jehovah thy God hath led thee these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble thee, to prove thee, to know what was in thy heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te lembrarás de todo o caminho por onde te trouxe o SENHOR teu Deus estes quarenta anos no deserto, para afligir-te, para provar-te, para saber o que estava em teu coração, se havias de guardar ou não seus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Y acordarte has de todo el camino por donde te ha traído Jehová tu Dios estos cuarenta años en el desierto, para afligirte, por probarte, para saber lo que estaba en tu corazón, si habías de guardar ó no sus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the Lord doth man live.
verses.WEB: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.
verses.ASV: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by everything that proceedeth out of the mouth of Jehovah doth man live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te afligiu, e te fez ter fome, e te sustentou com maná, comida que não conhecias tu, nem teus pais a conheciam; para fazer-te saber que o homem não viverá de só pão, mas de tudo o que sai da boca do SENHOR viverá o homem.
verses.RVR09: Y te afligió, é hízote tener hambre, y te sustentó con maná, comida que no conocías tú, ni tus padres la habían conocido; para hacerte saber que el hombre no vivirá de solo pan, mas de todo lo que sale de la boca de Jehová vivirá el hombre.

verses.KJV: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
verses.WEB: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
verses.ASV: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua roupa nunca se envelheceu sobre ti, nem o pé se te inchou por estes quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Tu vestido nunca se envejeció sobre ti, ni el pie se te ha hinchado por estos cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the Lord thy God chasteneth thee.
verses.WEB: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt consider in thy heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so Jehovah thy God chasteneth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reconhece assim em teu coração, que como castiga o homem a seu filho, assim o SENHOR teu Deus te castiga.
verses.RVR09: Reconoce asimismo en tu corazón, que como castiga el hombre á su hijo, así Jehová tu Dios te castiga.

verses.KJV: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.WEB: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt keep the commandments of Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardarás, pois, os mandamentos do SENHOR teu Deus, andando em seus caminhos, e temendo-o.
verses.RVR09: Guardarás, pues, los mandamientos de Jehová tu Dios, andando en sus caminos, y temiéndolo.

verses.KJV: For the Lord thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
verses.WEB: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
verses.ASV: For Jehovah thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and springs, flowing forth in valleys and hills;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR teu Deus te introduz na boa terra, terra de ribeiros, de águas, de fontes, de mananciais que brotam por planícies e montes;
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová tu Dios te introduce en la buena tierra, tierra de arroyos, de aguas, de fuentes, de abismos que brotan por vegas y montes;

verses.KJV: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
verses.WEB: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;
verses.ASV: a land of wheat and barley, and vines and fig-trees and pomegranates; a land of olive-trees and honey;
verses.ALMEIDA: Terra de trigo e cevada, e de videiras, e figueiras, e romeiras; terra de olivas, de azeite, e de mel;
verses.RVR09: Tierra de trigo y cebada, y de vides, é higueras, y granados; tierra de olivas, de aceite, y de miel;

verses.KJV: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
verses.WEB: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
verses.ASV: a land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig copper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Terra na qual não comerás o pão com escassez, não te faltará nada nela; terra que suas pedras são ferro, e de seus montes cortarás bronze.
verses.RVR09: Tierra en la cual no comerás el pan con escasez, no te faltará nada en ella; tierra que sus piedras son hierro, y de sus montes cortarás metal.

verses.KJV: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
verses.WEB: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt eat and be full, and thou shalt bless Jehovah thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comerás e te fartarás, e bendirás ao SENHOR teu Deus pela boa terra que te haverá dado.
verses.RVR09: Y comerás y te hartarás, y bendecirás á Jehová tu Dios por la buena tierra que te habrá dado.

verses.KJV: Beware that thou forget not the Lord thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
verses.WEB: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;
verses.ASV: Beware lest thou forget Jehovah thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda-te, que não te esqueças do SENHOR teu Deus, para não observar seus mandamentos, e seus regulamentos, e seus estatutos, que eu te ordeno hoje:
verses.RVR09: Guárdate, que no te olvides de Jehová tu Dios, para no observar sus mandamientos, y sus derechos, y sus estatutos, que yo te ordeno hoy:

verses.KJV: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
verses.WEB: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;
verses.ASV: lest, when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não aconteça talvez que comas e te fartes, e edifiques boas casas em que mores,
verses.RVR09: Que quizá no comas y te hartes, y edifiques buenas casas en que mores,

verses.KJV: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
verses.WEB: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
verses.ASV: and when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tuas vacas e tuas ovelhas se aumentem, e a prata e o ouro se te multiplique, e tudo o que tiveres se te aumente,
verses.RVR09: Y tus vacas y tus ovejas se aumenten, y la plata y el oro se te multiplique, y todo lo que tuvieres se te aumente,

verses.KJV: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the Lord thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
verses.WEB: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
verses.ASV: then thy heart be lifted up, and thou forget Jehovah thy God, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se eleve logo teu coração, e te esqueças do SENHOR teu Deus, que te tirou da terra do Egito, de casa de servos;
verses.RVR09: Y se eleve luego tu corazón, y te olvides de Jehová tu Dios, que te sacó de tierra de Egipto, de casa de siervos;

verses.KJV: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.WEB: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;
verses.ASV: who led thee through the great and terrible wilderness, [wherein were] fiery serpents and scorpions, and thirsty ground where was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que te fez caminhar por um deserto grande e espantoso, de serpentes ardentes, e de escorpiões, e de sede, onde nenhuma água havia, e ele te tirou água da rocha de pederneiras;
verses.RVR09: Que te hizo caminar por un desierto grande y espantoso, de serpientes ardientes, y de escorpiones, y de sed, donde ningún agua había, y él te sacó agua de la roca del pedernal;

verses.KJV: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
verses.WEB: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
verses.ASV: who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not; that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end:
verses.ALMEIDA: Que te sustentou com maná no deserto, comida que teus pais não conheciam, afligindo-te e provando-te, para ao fim fazer-te bem;
verses.RVR09: Que te sustentó con maná en el desierto, comida que tus padres no habían conocido, afligiéndote y probándote, para á la postre hacerte bien;

verses.KJV: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
verses.WEB: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”
verses.ASV: and [lest] thou say in thy heart, My power and the might of my hand hath gotten me this wealth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E digas em teu coração: Meu poder e a força de minha mão me trouxeram esta riqueza.
verses.RVR09: Y digas en tu corazón: Mi poder y la fortaleza de mi mano me han traído esta riqueza.

verses.KJV: But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
verses.WEB: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.
verses.ASV: But thou shalt remember Jehovah thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth; that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as at this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes lembra-te do SENHOR teu Deus: porque ele te dá o poder para fazer as riquezas, a fim de confirmar seu pacto que jurou a teus pais, como neste dia.
verses.RVR09: Antes acuérdate de Jehová tu Dios: porque él te da el poder para hacer las riquezas, á fin de confirmar su pacto que juró á tus padres, como en este día.

verses.KJV: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
verses.WEB: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.
verses.ASV: And it shall be, if thou shalt forget Jehovah thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas será, se chegares a esquecer-te do SENHOR teu Deus, e andares atrás de deuses alheios, e lhes servires, e a eles te encurvares, atesto-o hoje contra vós, que certamente perecereis.
verses.RVR09: Mas será, si llegares á olvidarte de Jehová tu Dios, y anduvieres en pos de dioses ajenos, y les sirvieres, y á ellos te encorvares, protéstolo hoy contra vosotros, que de cierto pereceréis.

verses.KJV: As the nations which the Lord destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
verses.ASV: As the nations that Jehovah maketh to perish before you, so shall ye perish; because ye would not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como as nações que o SENHOR destruirá diante de vós, assim perecereis; porquanto não havereis atendido à voz do SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Como las gentes que Jehová destruirá delante de vosotros, así pereceréis; por cuanto no habréis atendido á la voz de Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
verses.WEB: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,
verses.ASV: Hear, O Israel: thou art to pass over the Jordan this day, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fortified up to heaven,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, Israel: tu estás hoje para passar o Jordão, para entrar a possuir nações mais numerosas e mais fortes que tu, cidades grandes e fortificadas até o céu,
verses.RVR09: OYE, Israel: tú estás hoy para pasar el Jordán, para entrar á poseer gentes más numerosas y más fuertes que tú, ciudades grandes y encastilladas hasta el cielo,

verses.KJV: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
verses.WEB: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”
verses.ASV: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the sons of Anak?
verses.ALMEIDA: Um povo grande e alto, filhos de gigantes, dos quais tens tu conhecimento, e ouviste dizer: Quem resistirá diante dos filhos do gigante?
verses.RVR09: Un pueblo grande y alto, hijos de gigantes, de los cuales tienes tú conocimiento, y has oído decir: ¿Quién se sostendrá delante de los hijos del gigante?

verses.KJV: Understand therefore this day, that the Lord thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the Lord hath said unto thee.
verses.WEB: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as the LORD has spoken to you.
verses.ASV: Know therefore this day, that Jehovah thy God is he who goeth over before thee as a devouring fire; he will destroy them, and he will bring them down before thee: so shalt thou drive them out, and make them to perish quickly, as Jehovah hath spoken unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabe, pois, hoje que o SENHOR teu Deus é o que passa diante de ti, fogo consumidor, que os destruirá e humilhará diante de ti: e tu os expulsarás, e os destruirás logo, como o SENHOR te disse.
verses.RVR09: Sabe, pues, hoy que Jehová tu Dios es el que pasa delante de ti, fuego consumidor, que los destruirá y humillará delante de ti: y tú los echarás, y los destruirás luego, como Jehová te ha dicho.

verses.KJV: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the Lord thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the Lord hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the Lord doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.WEB: Don’t say in your heart, after the LORD your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land;” because the LORD drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.
verses.ASV: Speak not thou in thy heart, after that Jehovah thy God hath thrust them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness Jehovah hath brought me in to possess this land; whereas for the wickedness of these nations Jehovah doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não digas em teu coração quando o SENHOR teu Deus os haverá expulsado de diante de ti, dizendo: Por minha justiça me pôs o SENHOR a possuir esta terra; pois pela impiedade destas nações o SENHOR as expulsa de diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: No discurras en tu corazón cuando Jehová tu Dios los habrá echado de delante de ti, diciendo: Por mi justicia me ha metido Jehová á poseer esta tierra; pues por la impiedad de estas gentes Jehová las echa de delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the Lord thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.WEB: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.ASV: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thy heart, dost thou go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Jehovah thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may establish the word which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não por tua justiça, nem pela retidão de teu coração entras a possuir a terra deles; mas pela impiedade destas nações o SENHOR teu Deus as expulsa de diante de ti, e para confirmar a palavra que o SENHOR jurou a teus pais Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó.
verses.RVR09: No por tu justicia, ni por la rectitud de tu corazón entras á poseer la tierra de ellos; mas por la impiedad de estas gentes Jehová tu Dios las echa de delante de ti, y por confirmar la palabra que Jehová juró á tus padres Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob.

verses.KJV: Understand therefore, that the Lord thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
verses.WEB: Know therefore that the LORD your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.
verses.ASV: Know therefore, that Jehovah thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, sabe que não por tua justiça o SENHOR teu Deus te dá esta boa terra para possuí-la; que povo duro de cerviz és tu.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, sabe que no por tu justicia Jehová tu Dios te da esta buena tierra para poseerla; que pueblo duro de cerviz eres tú.

verses.KJV: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the Lord thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the Lord.
verses.WEB: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.
verses.ASV: Remember, forget thou not, how thou provokedst Jehovah thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou wentest forth out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te, não te esqueças que provocaste a ira ao SENHOR teu Deus no deserto: desde o dia que saíste da terra do Egito, até que entrastes neste lugar, fostes rebeldes ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate, no te olvides que has provocado á ira á Jehová tu Dios en el desierto: desde el día que saliste de la tierra de Egipto, hasta que entrasteis en este lugar, habéis sido rebeldes á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Also in Horeb ye provoked the Lord to wrath, so that the Lord was angry with you to have destroyed you.
verses.WEB: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you.
verses.ASV: Also in Horeb ye provoked Jehovah to wrath, and Jehovah was angry with you to destroy you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em Horebe provocastes à ira ao SENHOR, e irou-se o SENHOR contra vós para destruir-vos.
verses.RVR09: Y en Horeb provocasteis á ira á Jehová, y enojóse Jehová contra vosotros para destruiros.

verses.KJV: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the Lord made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
verses.WEB: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.
verses.ASV: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which Jehovah made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu subi ao monte para receber as tábuas de pedra, as tábuas do pacto que o SENHOR fez convosco, estive então no monte quarenta dias e quarenta noites, sem comer pão nem beber água:
verses.RVR09: Cuando yo subí al monte para recibir las tablas de piedra, las tablas del pacto que Jehová hizo con vosotros, estuve entonces en el monte cuarenta días y cuarenta noches, sin comer pan ni beber agua:

verses.KJV: And the Lord delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the Lord spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.WEB: The LORD delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah delivered unto me the two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them [was written] according to all the words, which Jehovah spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu-me o SENHOR as duas tábuas de pedra escritas com o dedo de Deus; e nelas estava escrito conforme todas as palavras que vos falou o SENHOR no monte do meio do fogo, no dia da assembleia.
verses.RVR09: Y dióme Jehová las dos tablas de piedra escritas con el dedo de Dios; y en ellas estaba escrito conforme á todas las palabras que os habló Jehová en el monte de en medio del fuego, el día de la asamblea.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the Lord gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
verses.WEB: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Jehovah gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi ao fim dos quarenta dias e quarenta noites, que o SENHOR me deu as duas tábuas de pedra, as tábuas do pacto.
verses.RVR09: Y fué al cabo de los cuarenta días y cuarenta noches, que Jehová me dió las dos tablas de piedra, las tablas del pacto.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people that thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-me o SENHOR: Levanta-te, desce logo daqui; que teu povo que tiraste do Egito se corrompeu: logo se apartaram do caminho que eu lhes mandei: fizeram para si uma efígie de fundição.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome Jehová: Levántate, desciende presto de aquí; que tu pueblo que sacaste de Egipto se ha corrompido: pronto se han apartado del camino que yo les mandé: hanse hecho una efigie de fundición.

verses.KJV: Furthermore the Lord spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.WEB: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
verses.ASV: Furthermore Jehovah spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou-me o SENHOR, dizendo: Vi esse povo, e eis que ele é povo duro de cerviz:
verses.RVR09: Y hablóme Jehová, diciendo: He visto ese pueblo, y he aquí, que él es pueblo duro de cerviz:

verses.KJV: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
verses.WEB: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”
verses.ASV: let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven; and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deixa-me que os destrua, e apague seu nome de debaixo do céu; que eu te porei sobre gente forte e muito mais que eles.
verses.RVR09: Déjame que los destruya, y raiga su nombre de debajo del cielo; que yo te pondré sobre gente fuerte y mucha más que ellos.

verses.KJV: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.WEB: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.ASV: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount was burning with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltei e desci do monte, o qual ardia em fogo, com as tábuas do pacto em minhas duas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y volví y descendí del monte, el cual ardía en fuego, con las tablas del pacto en mis dos manos.

verses.KJV: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the Lord your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the Lord had commanded you.
verses.WEB: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the LORD your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which the LORD had commanded you.
verses.ASV: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against Jehovah your God; ye had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which Jehovah had commanded you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhei, e eis que havíeis pecado contra o SENHOR vosso Deus: Havíeis feito para vós um bezerro de fundição, desviando-vos logo do caminho que o SENHOR vos havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: Y miré, y he aquí habíais pecado contra Jehová vuestro Dios: os habíais hecho un becerro de fundición, apartándoos presto del camino que Jehová os había mandado.

verses.KJV: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
verses.WEB: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.
verses.ASV: And I took hold of the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomei as duas tábuas, e lancei-as de minhas duas mãos, e quebrei-as diante vossos olhos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces tomé las dos tablas, y arrojélas de mis dos manos, y quebrélas delante de vuestros ojos.

verses.KJV: And I fell down before the Lord, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.
verses.WEB: I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
verses.ASV: And I fell down before Jehovah, as at the first, forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water; because of all your sin which ye sinned, in doing that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: E prostrei-me diante do SENHOR, como antes, quarenta dias e quarenta noites: não comi pão nem bebi água, por causa de todo vosso pecado que havíeis cometido fazendo mal aos olhos do SENHOR para irá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y postréme delante de Jehová, como antes, cuarenta días y cuarenta noches: no comí pan ni bebí agua, á causa de todo vuestro pecado que habíais cometido haciendo mal en ojos de Jehová para enojarlo.

verses.KJV: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the Lord was wroth against you to destroy you. But the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also.
verses.WEB: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me that time also.
verses.ASV: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith Jehovah was wroth against you to destroy you. But Jehovah hearkened unto me that time also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque temi por causa do furor e da ira com que o SENHOR estava irritado contra vós para destruir-vos. Porém o SENHOR me ouviu ainda esta vez.
verses.RVR09: Porque temí á causa del furor y de la ira con que Jehová estaba enojado contra vosotros para destruiros. Pero Jehová me oyó aún esta vez.

verses.KJV: And the Lord was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
verses.WEB: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah was very angry with Aaron to destroy him: and I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contra Arão também se irou o SENHOR em grande maneira para destruí-lo: e também orei por Arão então.
verses.RVR09: Contra Aarón también se enojó Jehová en gran manera para destruirlo: y también oré por Aarón entonces.

verses.KJV: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
verses.WEB: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.
verses.ASV: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomei vosso pecado, o bezerro que havíeis feito, e queimei no fogo, e o esmigalhei moendo-o muito bem, até que foi reduzido a pó: e lancei o pó dele no ribeiro que descia do monte.
verses.RVR09: Y tomé vuestro pecado, el becerro que habíais hecho, y quemélo en el fuego, y lo desmenucé moliéndole muy bien, hasta que fué reducido á polvo: y eché el polvo de él en el arroyo que descendía del monte.

verses.KJV: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the Lord to wrath.
verses.WEB: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the LORD to wrath.
verses.ASV: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked Jehovah to wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também em Taberá, e em Massá, e em Quibrote-Hataavá, irritastes ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: También en Tabera, y en Massa, y en Kibroth-hataavah, enojasteis á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Likewise when the Lord sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
verses.WEB: When the LORD sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.
verses.ASV: And when Jehovah sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o SENHOR vos enviou desde Cades-Barneia, dizendo: Subi e possuí a terra que eu vos dei; também fostes rebeldes ao dito do SENHOR vosso Deus, e não o crestes, nem obedecestes à sua voz.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Jehová os envió desde Cades-barnea, diciendo, Subid y poseed la tierra que yo os he dado; también fuisteis rebeldes al dicho de Jehová vuestro Dios, y no lo creisteis, ni obedecisteis á su voz.

verses.KJV: Ye have been rebellious against the Lord from the day that I knew you.
verses.WEB: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
verses.ASV: Ye have been rebellious against Jehovah from the day that I knew you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rebeldes fostes ao SENHOR desde o dia que eu vos conheço.
verses.RVR09: Rebeldes habéis sido á Jehová desde el día que yo os conozco.

verses.KJV: Thus I fell down before the Lord forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the Lord had said he would destroy you.
verses.WEB: So I fell down before the LORD the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
verses.ASV: So I fell down before Jehovah the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Jehovah had said he would destroy you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Prostrei-me, pois, diante do SENHOR quarenta dias e quarenta noites que estive prostrado; porque o SENHOR disse que vos havia de destruir.
verses.RVR09: Postréme, pues, delante de Jehová cuarenta días y cuarenta noches que estuve postrado; porque Jehová dijo que os había de destruir.

verses.KJV: I prayed therefore unto the Lord, and said, O Lord God, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.WEB: I prayed to the LORD, and said, “Lord GOD, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.ASV: And I prayed unto Jehovah, and said, O Lord Jehovah, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, that thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, that thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E orei ao SENHOR, dizendo: Ó Senhor DEUS, não destruas teu povo e tua herança que resgataste com tua grandeza, ao qual tiraste do Egito com mão forte.
verses.RVR09: Y oré á Jehová, diciendo: Oh Señor Jehová, no destruyas tu pueblo y tu heredad que has redimido con tu grandeza, al cual sacaste de Egipto con mano fuerte.

verses.KJV: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
verses.WEB: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,
verses.ASV: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin,
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te de teus servos Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó; não olhes à dureza deste povo, nem a sua impiedade, nem a seu pecado:
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de tus siervos Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob; no mires á la dureza de este pueblo, ni á su impiedad, ni á su pecado:

verses.KJV: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’
verses.ASV: lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because Jehovah was not able to bring them into the land which he promised unto them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não digam os da terra de onde nos tiraste: Porquanto não pôde o SENHOR introduzi-los na terra que lhes havia dito, ou porque os aborrecia, os tirou para matá-los no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Porque no digan los de la tierra de donde nos sacaste: Por cuanto no pudo Jehová introducirlos en la tierra que les había dicho, ó porque los aborrecía, los sacó para matarlos en el desierto.

verses.KJV: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
verses.WEB: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”
verses.ASV: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy great power and by thine outstretched arm.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles são teu povo e tua herança, que tiraste com tua grande força e com teu braço estendido.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos son tu pueblo y tu heredad, que sacaste con tu gran fortaleza y con tu brazo extendido.

verses.KJV: At that time the Lord said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.WEB: At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
verses.ASV: At that time Jehovah said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo o SENHOR me disse: Lavra para ti duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras, e sobe a mim ao monte, e faze para ti uma arca de madeira:
verses.RVR09: EN aquel tiempo Jehová me dijo: Lábrate dos tablas de piedra como las primeras, y sube á mí al monte, y hazte un arca de madera:

verses.KJV: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
verses.WEB: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”
verses.ASV: And I will write on the tables the words that were on the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E escreverei naquelas tábuas palavras que estavam nas tábuas primeiras que quebraste; e as porás na arca.
verses.RVR09: Y escribiré en aquellas tablas las palabras que estaban en las tablas primeras que quebraste; y las pondrás en el arca.

verses.KJV: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
verses.WEB: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.
verses.ASV: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in my hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fiz uma arca de madeira de acácia, e lavrei duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras, e subi ao monte com as duas tábuas em minha mão.
verses.RVR09: E hice un arca de madera de Sittim, y labré dos tablas de piedra como las primeras, y subí al monte con las dos tablas en mi mano.

verses.KJV: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the Lord spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the Lord gave them unto me.
verses.WEB: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.
verses.ASV: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Jehovah spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and Jehovah gave them unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E escreveu nas tábuas conforme a primeira escritura, os dez mandamentos que o SENHOR vos havia falado no monte do meio do fogo, no dia da assembleia; e as deu a mim o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y escribió en las tablas conforme á la primera escritura, las diez palabras que Jehová os había hablado en el monte de en medio del fuego, el día de la asamblea; y diómelas Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the Lord commanded me.
verses.WEB: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.
verses.ASV: And I turned and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Jehovah commanded me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltei e desci do monte, e pus as tábuas na arca que havia feito; e ali estão, como o SENHOR me mandou.
verses.RVR09: Y volví y descendí del monte, y puse las tablas en el arca que había hecho; y allí están, como Jehová me mandó.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
verses.WEB: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.
verses.ASV: (And the children of Israel journeyed from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Depois partiram os filhos de Israel de Beerote-Bene-Jacacã a Moserá: ali morreu Arão, e ali foi sepultado; e em lugar seu teve o sacerdócio seu filho Eleazar.
verses.RVR09: (Después partieron los hijos de Israel de Beerot-bene-jacaam á Moserá: allí murió Aarón, y allí fué sepultado; y en lugar suyo tuvo el sacerdocio su hijo Eleazar.

verses.KJV: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
verses.WEB: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
verses.ASV: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
verses.ALMEIDA: De ali partiram a Gudgodá, e de Gudgodá a Jotbatá, terra de ribeiros de águas.
verses.RVR09: De allí partieron á Gudgod, y de Gudgod á Jotbath, tierra de arroyos de aguas.

verses.KJV: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
verses.WEB: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.
verses.ASV: At that time Jehovah set apart the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, to stand before Jehovah to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo separou o SENHOR a tribo de Levi, para que levasse a arca do pacto do SENHOR, para que estivesse diante do SENHOR para servir-lhe, e para abençoar em seu nome, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo apartó Jehová la tribu de Leví, para que llevase el arca del pacto de Jehová, para que estuviese delante de Jehová para servirle, y para bendecir en su nombre, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the Lord is his inheritance, according as the Lord thy God promised him.
verses.WEB: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)
verses.ASV: Wherefore Levi hath no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; Jehovah is his inheritance, according as Jehovah thy God spake unto him.)
