verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvirás, pois, a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, e cumprirás seus mandamentos e seus estatutos, que eu te ordeno hoje.
verses.RVR09: Oirás pues la voz de Jehová tu Dios, y cumplirás sus mandamientos y sus estatutos, que yo te ordeno hoy.

verses.KJV: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
verses.WEB: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,
verses.ASV: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou Moisés ao povo naquele dia, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y mandó Moisés al pueblo en aquel día, diciendo:

verses.KJV: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
verses.WEB: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.ASV: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are passed over the Jordan: Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes estarão sobre o monte de Gerizim para abençoar ao povo, quando houverdes passado o Jordão: Simeão, e Levi, e Judá, e Issacar, e José e Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Estos estarán sobre el monte de Gerizim para bendecir al pueblo, cuando hubiereis pasado el Jordán: Simeón, y Leví, y Judá, é Issachâr, y José, y Benjamín.

verses.KJV: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.WEB: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.ASV: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes estarão para pronunciar a maldição no de Ebal: Rúben, Gade, e Aser, e Zebulom, Dã, e Naftali.
verses.RVR09: Y estos estarán para pronunciar la maldición en el de Ebal: Rubén, Gad, y Aser, y Zabulón, Dan, y Nephtalí.

verses.KJV: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
verses.WEB: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
verses.ASV: And the Levites shall answer, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falarão os levitas, e dirão a todo homem de Israel em alta voz:
verses.RVR09: Y hablarán los Levitas, y dirán á todo varón de Israel en alta voz:

verses.KJV: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the Lord, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be the man that maketh a graven or molten image, an abomination unto Jehovah, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and setteth it up in secret. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o homem que fizer escultura ou imagem de fundição, abominação ao SENHOR, obra da mão de artífice, e a puser em oculto. E todo o povo responderá e dirá: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el hombre que hiciere escultura ó imagen de fundición, abominación á Jehová, obra de mano de artífice, y la pusiere en oculto. Y todo el pueblo responderá y dirá: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que desonrar a seu pai ou a sua mãe. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que deshonrare á su padre ó á su madre. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbor’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que reduzir o termo de seu próximo. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que redujere el término de su prójimo. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que fizer errar ao cego no caminho. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que hiciere errar al ciego en el camino. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that wresteth the justice [due] to the sojourner, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que distorcer o direito do estrangeiro, do órfão, e da viúva. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que torciere el derecho del extranjero, del huérfano, y de la viuda. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that lieth with his father’s wife, because he hath uncovered his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que se deitar com a mulher de seu pai; porquanto revelou o colo de seu pai. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que se echare con la mujer de su padre; por cuanto descubrió el regazo de su padre. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que tiver parte com qualquer animal. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que tuviere parte con cualquiera bestia. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que se deitar com sua irmã, filha de seu pai, ou filha de sua mãe. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que se echare con su hermana, hija de su padre, ó hija de su madre. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que se deitar com sua sogra. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que se echare con su suegra. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbor in secret. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que ferir a seu próximo ocultamente. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que hiriere á su prójimo ocultamente. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that taketh a bribe to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que receber um presente para ferir de morte ao inocente. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que recibiere don para herir de muerte al inocente. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.WEB: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that confirmeth not the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o que não confirmar as palavras desta lei para as cumprir. E dirá todo o povo: Amém.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que no confirmare las palabras de esta ley para cumplirlas. Y dirá todo el pueblo: Amén.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
verses.WEB: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to observe to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that Jehovah thy God will set thee on high above all the nations of the earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, se ouvires com empenho a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, para guardar, para praticar todos os seus mandamentos que eu te prescrevo hoje, também o SENHOR teu Deus te porá alto sobre todas as nações da terra;
verses.RVR09: Y SERÁ que, si oyeres diligente la voz de Jehová tu Dios, para guardar, para poner por obra todos sus mandamientos que yo te prescribo hoy, también Jehová tu Dios te pondrá alto sobre todas las gentes de la tierra;

verses.KJV: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God.
verses.WEB: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
verses.ASV: and all these blessings shall come upon thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E virão sobre ti todas estas bênçãos, e te alcançarão, quando ouvires a voz do SENHOR teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán sobre ti todas estas bendiciones, y te alcanzarán, cuando oyeres la voz de Jehová tu Dios.

verses.KJV: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.WEB: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
verses.ASV: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito serás tu na cidade, e bendito tu no campo.
verses.RVR09: Bendito serás tú en la ciudad, y bendito tú en el campo.

verses.KJV: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.WEB: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
verses.ASV: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy beasts, the increase of thy cattle, and the young of thy flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito o fruto de teu ventre, e o fruto de teu animal, a cria de tuas vacas, e os rebanhos de tuas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Bendito el fruto de tu vientre, y el fruto de tu bestia, la cría de tus vacas, y los rebaños de tus ovejas.

verses.KJV: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
verses.WEB: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.
verses.ASV: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy kneading-trough.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito teu cesto e tua amassadeira.
verses.RVR09: Bendito tu canastillo y tus sobras.

verses.KJV: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.WEB: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
verses.ASV: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito serás em teu entrar, e bendito em teu sair.
verses.RVR09: Bendito serás en tu entrar, y bendito en tu salir.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
verses.WEB: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thee: they shall come out against thee one way, and shall flee before thee seven ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Causará o SENHOR a teus inimigos que se levantarem contra ti, que sejam derrotados diante de ti: por um caminho sairão a ti, por sete caminhos fugirão diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Pondrá Jehová á tus enemigos que se levantaren contra ti, de rota batida delante de ti: por un camino saldrán á ti, por siete caminos huirán delante de ti.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will command the blessing upon thee in thy barns, and in all that thou puttest thy hand unto; and he will bless thee in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviará o SENHOR contigo a bênção em teus granários, e em tudo aquilo em que puseres tua mão; e te abençoará na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá.
verses.RVR09: Enviará Jehová contigo la bendición en tus graneros, y en todo aquello en que pusieres tu mano; y te bendecirá en la tierra que Jehová tu Dios te da.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, and walk in his ways.
verses.WEB: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will establish thee for a holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee; if thou shalt keep the commandments of Jehovah thy God, and walk in his ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te confirmará por povo seu santo, como te jurou, quando guardares os mandamentos do SENHOR teu Deus, e andares em seus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Confirmarte ha Jehová por pueblo suyo santo, como te ha jurado, cuando guardares los mandamientos de Jehová tu Dios, y anduvieres en sus caminos.

verses.KJV: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the Lord; and they shall be afraid of thee.
verses.WEB: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
verses.ASV: And all the peoples of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of Jehovah; and they shall be afraid of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E verão todos os povos da terra que o nome do SENHOR é chamado sobre ti, e te temerão.
verses.RVR09: Y verán todos los pueblos de la tierra que el nombre de Jehová es llamado sobre ti, y te temerán.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will make thee plenteous for good, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te fará o SENHOR superabundar em bens, no fruto de teu ventre, e no fruto de teu animal, e no fruto de tua terra, na terra que o SENHOR jurou aos teus pais que te havia de dar.
verses.RVR09: Y te hará Jehová sobreabundar en bienes, en el fruto de tu vientre, y en el fruto de tu bestia, y en el fruto de tu tierra, en el país que juró Jehová á tus padres que te había de dar.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
verses.WEB: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will open unto thee his good treasure the heavens, to give the rain of thy land in its season, and to bless all the work of thy hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te abrirá seu bom depósito, o céu, para dar chuva à tua terra em seu tempo, e para abençoar toda obra de tuas mãos. E emprestarás a muitas nações, e tu não tomarás emprestado.
verses.RVR09: Abrirte ha Jehová su buen depósito, el cielo, para dar lluvia á tu tierra en su tiempo, y para bendecir toda obra de tus manos. Y prestarás á muchas gentes, y tú no tomarás emprestado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the Lord thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
verses.WEB: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if thou shalt hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do [them],
verses.ALMEIDA: E te porá o SENHOR por cabeça, e não por cauda: e estarás encima somente, e não estarás debaixo; quando obedeceres aos mandamentos do SENHOR teu Deus, que eu te ordeno hoje, para que os guardes e cumpras.
verses.RVR09: Y te pondrá Jehová por cabeza, y no por cola: y estarás encima solamente, y no estarás debajo; cuando obedecieres á los mandamientos de Jehová tu Dios, que yo te ordeno hoy, para que los guardes y cumplas.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.WEB: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.ASV: and shalt not turn aside from any of the words which I command you this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não te desvies de todas as palavras que eu vos mando hoje, nem à direita nem à esquerda, para ir atrás de deuses alheios para servir-lhes.
verses.RVR09: Y no te apartes de todas las palabras que yo os mando hoy, ni á diestra ni á siniestra, para ir tras dioses ajenos para servirles.

verses.KJV: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
verses.WEB: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.
verses.ASV: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day, that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será, se não ouvires a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, para cuidar de praticar todos os seus mandamentos e seus estatutos, que eu te intimo hoje, que virão sobre ti todas estas maldições, e te alcançarão.
verses.RVR09: Y será, si no oyeres la voz de Jehová tu Dios, para cuidar de poner por obra todos sus mandamientos y sus estatutos, que yo te intimo hoy, que vendrán sobre ti todas estas maldiciones, y te alcanzarán.

verses.KJV: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.WEB: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
verses.ASV: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito serás tu na cidade, e maldito no campo.
verses.RVR09: Maldito serás tu en la ciudad, y maldito en el campo.

verses.KJV: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.
verses.WEB: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
verses.ASV: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy kneading-trough.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito teu cesto, e tua amassadeira.
verses.RVR09: Maldito tu canastillo, y tus sobras.

verses.KJV: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.WEB: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
verses.ASV: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, the increase of thy cattle, and the young of thy flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito o fruto de teu ventre, e o fruto de tua terra, e a cria de tuas vacas, e os rebanhos de tuas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el fruto de tu vientre, y el fruto de tu tierra, y la cría de tus vacas, y los rebaños de tus ovejas.

verses.KJV: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.WEB: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
verses.ASV: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito serás em teu entrar, e maldito em teu sair.
verses.RVR09: Maldito serás en tu entrar, y maldito en tu salir.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
verses.WEB: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will send upon thee cursing, discomfiture, and rebuke, in all that thou puttest thy hand unto to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the evil of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR enviará contra ti a maldição, confusão e oposição em tudo quanto puseres mão e fizeres, até que sejas destruído, e pereças logo por causa da maldade de tuas obras, pelas quais me houverdes deixado.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová enviará contra ti la maldición, quebranto y asombro en todo cuanto pusieres mano é hicieres, hasta que seas destruído, y perezcas presto á causa de la maldad de tus obras, por las cuales me habrás dejado.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.WEB: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest in to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR fará que se te pegue mortandade, até que te consuma da terra à qual entras para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: Jehová hará que se te pegue mortandad, hasta que te consuma de la tierra á la cual entras para poseerla.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.WEB: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will smite thee with consumption, and with fever, and with inflammation, and with fiery heat, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te ferirá de tísica, e de febre, e de ardor, e de calor, e de espada, e de calamidade repentina, e com mofo; e te perseguirão até que pereças.
verses.RVR09: Jehová te herirá de tisis, y de fiebre, y de ardor, y de calor, y de cuchillo, y de calamidad repentina, y con añublo; y perseguirte han hasta que perezcas.

verses.KJV: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
verses.WEB: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
verses.ASV: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teus céus que estão sobre tua cabeça, serão de bronze; e a terra que está debaixo de ti, de ferro.
verses.RVR09: Y tus cielos que están sobre tu cabeza, serán de metal; y la tierra que está debajo de ti, de hierro.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.WEB: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dará o SENHOR por chuva à tua terra pó e cinza: dos céus descerão sobre ti até que pereças.
verses.RVR09: Dará Jehová por lluvia á tu tierra polvo y ceniza: de los cielos descenderán sobre ti hasta que perezcas.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.WEB: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies; thou shalt go out one way against them, and shalt flee seven ways before them: and thou shalt be tossed to and from among all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te entregará ferido diante de teus inimigos: por um caminho sairás a eles, e por sete caminhos fugirás diante deles: e serás sacudido a todos os reinos da terra.
verses.RVR09: Jehová te entregará herido delante de tus enemigos: por un camino saldrás á ellos, y por siete caminos huirás delante de ellos: y serás sacudido á todos los reinos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
verses.WEB: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
verses.ASV: And thy dead body shall be food unto all birds of the heavens, and unto the beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to frighten them away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será teu corpo morto por comida a toda ave do céu, e animal da terra, e não haverá quem as espante.
verses.RVR09: Y será tu cuerpo muerto por comida á toda ave del cielo y bestia de la tierra, y no habrá quien las espante.

verses.KJV: The Lord will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.WEB: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will smite thee with the boil of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scurvy, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te ferirá da praga do Egito, e com tumores, e com sarna, e com coceira, de que não possas ser curado.
verses.RVR09: Jehová te herirá de la plaga de Egipto, y con almorranas, y con sarna, y con comezón, de que no puedas ser curado.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
verses.WEB: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will smite thee with madness, and with blindness, and with astonishment of heart;
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te ferirá com loucura, e com cegueira, e com confusão de coração.
verses.RVR09: Jehová te herirá con locura, y con ceguedad, y con pasmo de corazón.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.
verses.WEB: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and robbed alway, and there shall be none to save thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apalparás ao meio-dia, como apalpa o cego na escuridão, e não serás próspero em teus caminhos: e nunca serás a não ser somente oprimido e roubado todos os dias, e não haverá quem te salve.
verses.RVR09: Y palparás al mediodía, como palpa el ciego en la oscuridad, y no serás prosperado en tus caminos: y nunca serás sino oprimido y robado todos los días, y no habrá quien te salve.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
verses.WEB: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not use the fruit thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te casarás com mulher, e outro homem dormirá com ela; edificarás casa, e não habitarás nela; plantarás vinha, e não a vindimarás.
verses.RVR09: Te desposarás con mujer, y otro varón dormirá con ella; edificarás casa, y no habitarás en ella; plantarás viña, y no la vendimiarás.

verses.KJV: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.
verses.WEB: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
verses.ASV: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to save thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu boi será matado diante de teus olhos, e tu não comerás dele; teu asno será arrebatado de diante de ti, e não se te voltará; tuas ovelhas serão dadas a teus inimigos, e não terás quem te as resgate.
verses.RVR09: Tu buey será matado delante de tus ojos, y tú no comerás de él; tu asno será arrebatado de delante de ti, y no se te volverá; tus ovejas serán dadas á tus enemigos, y no tendrás quien te las rescate.

verses.KJV: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long; and there shall be no might in thine hand.
verses.WEB: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.
verses.ASV: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people; and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day: and there shall be nought in the power of thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus filhos e tuas filhas serão entregues a outro povo, e teus olhos o verão, e desfalecerão por eles todo o dia: e não haverá força em tua mão.
verses.RVR09: Tus hijos y tus hijas serán entregados á otro pueblo, y tus ojos lo verán, y desfallecerán por ellos todo el día: y no habrá fuerza en tu mano.

verses.KJV: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
verses.WEB: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
verses.ASV: The fruit of thy ground, and all thy labors, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway;
verses.ALMEIDA: O fruto de tua terra e todo teu trabalho comerá povo que não conheceste; e nunca serás a não ser somente oprimido e quebrantado todos os dias.
verses.RVR09: El fruto de tu tierra y todo tu trabajo comerá pueblo que no conociste; y nunca serás sino oprimido y quebrantado todos los días.

verses.KJV: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.WEB: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
verses.ASV: so that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enlouquecerás por causa do que verás com teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Y enloquecerás á causa de lo que verás con tus ojos.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
verses.WEB: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore boil, whereof thou canst not be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the crown of thy head.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te ferirá com maligna úlcera nos joelhos e nas pernas, sem que possas ser curado: ainda desde a planta de teu pé até o topo de tua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Herirte ha Jehová con maligna pústula en las rodillas y en las piernas, sin que puedas ser curado: aun desde la planta de tu pie hasta tu mollera.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.WEB: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will bring thee, and thy king whom thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation that thou hast not known, thou nor thy fathers; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR levará a ti, e a teu rei que houveres posto sobre ti, a nação que não conheceste tu nem teus pais; e ali servirás a deuses alheios, à madeira e à pedra.
verses.RVR09: Jehová llevará á ti, y á tu rey que hubieres puesto sobre ti, á gente que no conociste tú ni tus padres; y allá servirás á dioses ajenos, al palo y á la piedra.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.
verses.WEB: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all the peoples whither Jehovah shall lead thee away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serás por confusão, por exemplo e por fábula, a todos os povos aos quais te levará o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y serás por pasmo, por ejemplo y por fábula, á todos los pueblos á los cuales te llevará Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.WEB: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tirarás muito semente ao campo, e colherás pouco; porque os gafanhotos o consumirão.
verses.RVR09: Sacarás mucha simiente al campo, y cogerás poco; porque la langosta lo consumirá.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.WEB: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt plant vineyards and dress them, but thou shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather [the grapes]; for the worm shall eat them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Plantarás vinhas e lavrarás, mas não beberás vinho, nem colherás uvas; porque o bicho as comerá.
verses.RVR09: Plantarás viñas y labrarás, mas no beberás vino, ni cogerás uvas; porque el gusano las comerá.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.
verses.WEB: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt have olive-trees throughout all thy borders, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast [its fruit].
verses.ALMEIDA: Terás olivas em todo teu termo, mas não te ungirás com o azeite; porque tua azeitona cairá.
verses.RVR09: Tendrás olivas en todo tu término, mas no te ungirás con el aceite; porque tu aceituna se caerá.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.WEB: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but they shall not be thine; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhos e filhas gerarás, e não serão para ti; porque irão em cativeiro.
verses.RVR09: Hijos é hijas engendrarás, y no serán para ti; porque irán en cautiverio.

verses.KJV: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
verses.WEB: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
verses.ASV: All thy trees and the fruit of thy ground shall the locust possess.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o teu arvoredo e o fruto de tua terra os gafanhotos consumirão.
verses.RVR09: Toda tu arboleda y el fruto de tu tierra consumirá la langosta.

verses.KJV: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
verses.WEB: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.
verses.ASV: The sojourner that is in the midst of thee shall mount up above thee higher and higher; and thou shalt come down lower and lower.
verses.ALMEIDA: O estrangeiro que estará em meio de ti subirá sobre ti muito alto, e tu serás posto muito abaixo.
verses.RVR09: El extranjero que estará en medio de ti subirá sobre ti muy alto, y tú serás puesto muy bajo.

verses.KJV: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.WEB: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
verses.ASV: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele emprestará a ti, e tu não emprestarás a ele: ele será por cabeça, e tu serás por cauda.
verses.RVR09: El te prestará á ti, y tú no prestarás á él: él será por cabeza, y tú serás por cola.

verses.KJV: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.WEB: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.
verses.ASV: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: E virão sobre ti todas estas maldições, e te perseguirão, e te alcançarão até que pereças; porquanto não houverdes atendido à voz do SENHOR teu Deus, para guardar seus mandamentos e seus estatutos, que ele te mandou:
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán sobre ti todas estas maldiciones, y te perseguirán, y te alcanzarán hasta que perezcas; por cuanto no habrás atendido á la voz de Jehová tu Dios, para guardar sus mandamientos y sus estatutos, que él te mandó:

verses.KJV: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.WEB: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
verses.ASV: and they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serão em ti por sinal e por maravilha, e em tua descendência para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y serán en ti por señal y por maravilla, y en tu simiente para siempre.

verses.KJV: Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
verses.WEB: Because you didn’t serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
verses.ASV: Because thou servedst not Jehovah thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porquanto não serviste ao SENHOR teu Deus com alegria e com alegria de coração, pela abundância de todas as coisas;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto no serviste á Jehová tu Dios con alegría y con gozo de corazón, por la abundancia de todas las cosas;

verses.KJV: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.WEB: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
verses.ASV: therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies that Jehovah shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Servirás, portanto, a teus inimigos que enviar o SENHOR contra ti, com fome e com sede e com nudez, e com falta de todas as coisas; e ele porá jugo de ferro sobre teu pescoço, até destruir-te.
verses.RVR09: Servirás por tanto á tus enemigos que enviare Jehová contra ti, con hambre y con sed y con desnudez, y con falta de todas las cosas; y él pondrá yugo de hierro sobre tu cuello, hasta destruirte.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.WEB: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,
verses.ASV: Jehovah will bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR trará sobre ti nação de longe, do extremo da terra, que voe como água, nação cuja língua não entendas;
verses.RVR09: Jehová traerá sobre ti gente de lejos, del cabo de la tierra, que vuele como águila, gente cuya lengua no entiendas;

verses.KJV: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.WEB: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.
verses.ASV: a nation of fierce countenance, that shall not regard the person of the old, nor show favor to the young,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nação feroz de rosto, que não terá respeito ao ancião, nem perdoará à criança:
verses.RVR09: Gente fiera de rostro, que no tendrá respeto al anciano, ni perdonará al niño:

verses.KJV: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.WEB: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
verses.ASV: and shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy ground, until thou be destroyed; that also shall not leave thee grain, new wine, or oil, the increase of thy cattle, or the young of thy flock, until they have caused thee to perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comerá o fruto de teu animal e o fruto de tua terra, até que pereças: e não te deixará grão, nem mosto, nem azeite, nem a cria de tuas vacas, nem os rebanhos de tuas ovelhas, até destruir-te.
verses.RVR09: Y comerá el fruto de tu bestia y el fruto de tu tierra, hasta que perezcas: y no te dejará grano, ni mosto, ni aceite, ni la cría de tus vacas, ni los rebaños de tus ovejas, hasta destruirte.

verses.KJV: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the Lord thy God hath given thee.
verses.WEB: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.
verses.ASV: And they shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fortified walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land; and they shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which Jehovah thy God hath given thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te porá cerco em todas as tuas cidades, até que caiam teus muros altos e fortificados em que tu confias, em toda tua terra: te cercará, pois, em todas tuas cidades e em toda tua terra, que o SENHOR teu Deus te houver dado.
verses.RVR09: Y te pondrá cerco en todas tus ciudades, hasta que caigan tus muros altos y encastillados en que tú confías, en toda tu tierra: te cercará, pues, en todas tus ciudades y en toda tu tierra, que Jehová tu Dios te habrá dado.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the Lord thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
verses.WEB: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, whom Jehovah thy God hath given thee, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comerás o fruto de teu ventre, a carne de teus filhos e de tuas filhas que o SENHOR teu Deus te deu, no cerco e nos apuros com que te angustiará teu inimigo.
verses.RVR09: Y comerás el fruto de tu vientre, la carne de tus hijos y de tus hijas que Jehová tu Dios te dió, en el cerco y en el apuro con que te angustiará tu enemigo.

verses.KJV: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.WEB: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,
verses.ASV: The man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children whom he hath remaining;
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem tenro em ti, e o muito delicado, seu olho será maligno para com seu irmão, e para com a mulher de seu seio, e para com o resto de seus filhos que lhe restarem;
verses.RVR09: El hombre tierno en ti, y el muy delicado, su ojo será maligno para con su hermano, y para con la mujer de su seno, y para con el resto de sus hijos que le quedaren;

verses.KJV: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.WEB: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.
verses.ASV: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat, because he hath nothing left him, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para não dar a algum deles da carne de seus filhos, que ele comerá, porque nada lhe haverá restado, no cerco e nos apuros com que teu inimigo te oprimirá em todas tuas cidades.
verses.RVR09: Para no dar á alguno de ellos de la carne de sus hijos, que él comerá, porque nada le habrá quedado, en el cerco y en el apuro con que tu enemigo te oprimirá en todas tus ciudades.

verses.KJV: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.WEB: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,
verses.ASV: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.ALMEIDA: A tenra e a delicada entre vós, que nunca a planta de seu pé provou a sentar sobre a terra, de ternura e delicadeza, seu olho será maligno para com o marido de seu seio, e para com seu filho, e para com sua filha,
verses.RVR09: La tierna y la delicada entre vosotros, que nunca la planta de su pie probó á sentar sobre la tierra, de ternura y delicadeza, su ojo será maligno para con el marido de su seno, y para con su hijo, y para con su hija,

verses.KJV: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.WEB: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.
verses.ASV: and toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she shall bear; for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para com sua criança que sai dentre seus pés, e para com seus filhos que der à luz; pois os comerá ocultamente, a falta de tudo, no cerco e em apuros com que teu inimigo te oprimirá em tuas cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y para con su chiquita que sale de entre sus pies, y para con sus hijos que pariere; pues los comerá escondidamente, á falta de todo, en el cerco y en el apuro con que tu enemigo te oprimirá en tus ciudades.

verses.KJV: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, The Lord Thy God;
verses.WEB: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD your God,
verses.ASV: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, JEHOVAH THY GOD;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se não cuidares de praticar todas as palavras desta lei que estão escritas neste livro, temendo este nome glorioso e terrível, O SENHOR TEU DEUS,
verses.RVR09: Si no cuidares de poner por obra todas las palabras de aquesta ley que están escritas en este libro, temiendo este nombre glorioso y terrible, JEHOVÁ TU DIOS,

verses.KJV: Then the Lord will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.WEB: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.
verses.ASV: then Jehovah will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR aumentará maravilhosamente tuas pragas e as pragas de tua descendência, pragas grandes e duradouras, e enfermidades malignas e duradouras;
verses.RVR09: Jehová aumentará maravillosamente tus plagas y las plagas de tu simiente, plagas grandes y estables, y enfermedades malignas y duraderas;

verses.KJV: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.WEB: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
verses.ASV: And he will bring upon thee again all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará voltar sobre ti todos os males do Egito, diante dos quais temeste, e se te pegarão.
verses.RVR09: Y hará volver sobre ti todos los males de Egipto, delante de los cuales temiste, y se te pegarán.

verses.KJV: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the Lord bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.WEB: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.
verses.ASV: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will Jehovah bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como toda enfermidade e toda praga que não está escrita no livro desta lei, o SENHOR a enviará sobre ti, até que tu sejas destruído.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo toda enfermedad y toda plaga que no está escrita en el libro de esta ley, Jehová la enviará sobre ti, hasta que tú seas destruído.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the Lord thy God.
verses.WEB: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
verses.ASV: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou didst not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E restareis em pouca gente, em lugar de haver sido como as estrelas do céu em multidão; porquanto não obedeceste à voz do SENHOR teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y quedaréis en poca gente, en lugar de haber sido como las estrellas del cielo en multitud; por cuanto no obedeciste á la voz de Jehová tu Dios.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.WEB: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that, as Jehovah rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Jehovah will rejoice over you to cause you to perish, and to destroy you; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest in to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que como o SENHOR se alegrou sobre vós para fazer-vos bem, e para multiplicar-vos, assim se alegrará o SENHOR sobre vós para vos arruinar, e para destruir-vos; e sereis tirados de sobre a terra, à qual entrais para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: Y será que como Jehová se gozó sobre vosotros para haceros bien, y para multiplicaros, así se gozará Jehová sobre vosotros para arruinaros, y para destruiros; y seréis arrancados de sobre la tierra, á la cual entráis para poseerla.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
verses.WEB: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will scatter thee among all peoples, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou nor thy fathers, even wood and stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR te espalhará por todos os povos, desde um extremo da terra até o outro extremo dela; e ali servirás a deuses alheios que não conheceste tu nem teus pais, à madeira e à pedra.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová te esparcirá por todos los pueblos, desde el un cabo de la tierra hasta el otro cabo de ella; y allí servirás á dioses ajenos que no conociste tú ni tus padres, al leño y á la piedra.

verses.KJV: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.WEB: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.
verses.ASV: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, and there shall be no rest for the sole of thy foot: but Jehovah will give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and pining of soul;
verses.ALMEIDA: E nem ainda entre as mesmas nações descansarás, nem a planta de teu pé terá repouso; que ali te dará o SENHOR coração temeroso, e caimento de olhos, e tristeza de alma:
verses.RVR09: Y ni aun entre las mismas gentes descansarás, ni la planta de tu pie tendrá reposo; que allí te dará Jehová corazón temeroso, y caimiento de ojos, y tristeza de alma:

verses.KJV: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.WEB: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
verses.ASV: and thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear night and day, and shalt have no assurance of thy life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E terás tua vida como suspensa diante de ti, e estarás temeroso de noite e de dia, e não confiarás de tua vida.
verses.RVR09: Y tendrás tu vida como colgada delante de ti, y estarás temeroso de noche y de día, y no confiarás de tu vida.

verses.KJV: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.WEB: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.
verses.ASV: In the morning thou shalt say, Would it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would it were morning! for the fear of thy heart which thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela manhã dirás: Quem dera fosse a tarde! E à tarde dirás: Quem dera fosse a manhã! pelo medo de teu coração com que estarás amedrontado, e pelo que verão teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Por la mañana dirás: ¡Quién diera fuese la tarde! y á la tarde dirás: ¡Quién diera fuese la mañana! por el miedo de tu corazón con que estarás amedrentado, y por lo que verán tus ojos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
verses.WEB: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I said unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall sell yourselves unto your enemies for bondmen and for bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR te fará voltar ao Egito em navios pelo caminho do qual te disse: Nunca mais voltareis: e ali sereis vendidos a vossos inimigos por escravos e por escravas, e não haverá quem vos compre.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová te hará tornar á Egipto en navíos por el camino del cual te ha dicho: Nunca más volveréis: y allí seréis vendidos á vuestros enemigos por esclavos y por esclavas, y no habrá quien os compre.

verses.KJV: These are the words of the covenant, which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.WEB: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.ASV: These are the words of the covenant which Jehovah commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as palavras do pacto que o SENHOR mandou que Moisés fizesse com os filhos de Israel na terra de Moabe, além do pacto que estabeleceu com eles em Horebe.
verses.RVR09: ESTAS son las palabras del pacto que Jehová mandó á Moisés concertara con los hijos de Israel en la tierra de Moab, además del pacto que concertó con ellos en Horeb.

verses.KJV: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.WEB: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;
verses.ASV: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that Jehovah did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.ALMEIDA: Moisés, pois, chamou a todo Israel, e disse-lhes: Vós vistes tudo o que o SENHOR fez diante vossos olhos na terra do Egito a Faraó e a todos os seus servos, e a toda sua terra:
verses.RVR09: Moisés pues llamó á todo Israel, y díjoles: Vosotros habéis visto todo lo que Jehová ha hecho delante de vuestros ojos en la tierra de Egipto á Faraón y á todos sus siervos, y á toda su tierra:

verses.KJV: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.WEB: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.
verses.ASV: the great trials which thine eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders:
verses.ALMEIDA: As provas grandes que viram teus olhos, o sinais, e as grandes maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Las pruebas grandes que vieron tus ojos, las señales, y las grandes maravillas.

verses.KJV: Yet the Lord hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.WEB: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
verses.ASV: but Jehovah hath not given you a heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR não vos deu coração para entender, nem olhos para ver, nem ouvidos para ouvir, até o dia de hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová no os dió corazón para entender, ni ojos para ver, ni oídos para oir, hasta el día de hoy.

verses.KJV: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verses.WEB: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.
verses.ASV: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxed old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxed old upon thy foot.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos trouxe quarenta anos pelo deserto: vossas roupas não se hão envelhecido sobre vós, nem teu sapato se envelheceu sobre teu pé.
verses.RVR09: Y yo os he traído cuarenta años por el desierto: vuestros vestidos no se han envejecido sobre vosotros, ni tu zapato se ha envejecido sobre tu pie.

verses.KJV: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink; that ye may know that I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não comestes pão, nem bebestes vinho nem bebida forte: para que soubestes que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: No habéis comido pan, ni bebisteis vino ni sidra: para que supieseis que yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.WEB: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.
verses.ASV: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegastes a este lugar, e saiu Seom rei de Hesbom, e Ogue rei de Basã, diante de nós para lutar, e os ferimos;
verses.RVR09: Y llegasteis á este lugar, y salió Sehón rey de Hesbón, y Og rey de Basán, delante de nosotros para pelear, y herímoslos;

verses.KJV: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.WEB: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
verses.ASV: and we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomamos sua terra, e a demos por herança a Rúben e a Gade, e à meia tribo de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: Y tomamos su tierra, y dímosla por heredad á Rubén y á Gad, y á la media tribu de Manasés.

verses.KJV: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.WEB: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
verses.ASV: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardareis, pois, as palavras deste pacto, e as poreis por obra, para que prospereis em tudo o que fizerdes.
verses.RVR09: Guardaréis, pues, las palabras de este pacto, y las pondréis por obra, para que prosperéis en todo lo que hiciereis.

verses.KJV: Ye stand this day all of you before the Lord your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,
verses.WEB: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
verses.ASV: Ye stand this day all of you before Jehovah your God; your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós todos estais hoje diante do SENHOR vosso Deus; vossos príncipes de vossas tribos, vossos anciãos, e vossos oficiais, todos os homens de Israel,
verses.RVR09: Vosotros todos estáis hoy delante de Jehová vuestro Dios; vuestros príncipes de vuestras tribus, vuestros ancianos, y vuestros oficiales, todos los varones de Israel,

verses.KJV: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
verses.WEB: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,
verses.ASV: your little ones, your wives, and thy sojourner that is in the midst of thy camps, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vossas crianças, vossas mulheres, e teus estrangeiros que habitam em meio de teu campo, desde o que corta tua lenha até o que tira tuas águas:
verses.RVR09: Vuestros niños, vuestras mujeres, y tus extranjeros que habitan en medio de tu campo, desde el que corta tu leña hasta el que saca tus aguas:

verses.KJV: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the Lord thy God, and into his oath, which the Lord thy God maketh with thee this day:
verses.WEB: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God makes with you today,
verses.ASV: that thou mayest enter into the covenant of Jehovah thy God, and into his oath, which Jehovah thy God maketh with thee this day;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que entres no pacto do SENHOR teu Deus, e em seu juramento, que o SENHOR teu Deus estabelece hoje contigo:
verses.RVR09: Para que entres en el pacto de Jehová tu Dios, y en su juramento, que Jehová tu Dios acuerda hoy contigo:

verses.KJV: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.WEB: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.ASV: that he may establish thee this day unto himself for a people, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he spake unto thee, and as he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para te confirmar hoje por seu povo, e que ele seja a ti por Deus, da maneira que ele te disse, e como ele jurou a teus pais Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Para confirmarte hoy por su pueblo, y que él te sea á ti por Dios, de la manera que él te ha dicho, y como él juró á tus padres Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob.

verses.KJV: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.WEB: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,
verses.ASV: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath,
verses.ALMEIDA: E não somente convosco estabeleço eu este pacto e este juramento,
verses.RVR09: Y no con vosotros solos acuerdo yo este pacto y este juramento,

verses.KJV: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the Lord our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
verses.WEB: but with those who stand here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with those who are not here with us today
verses.ASV: but with him that standeth here with us this day before Jehovah our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, sim, com os que estão aqui presentes hoje conosco diante do SENHOR nosso Deus, e com os que não estão aqui hoje conosco.
verses.RVR09: Sino con los que están aquí presentes hoy con nosotros delante de Jehová nuestro Dios, y con los que no están aquí hoy con nosotros.

verses.KJV: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
verses.WEB: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;
verses.ASV: (for ye know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the midst of the nations through which ye passed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vós sabeis como habitamos na terra do Egito, e como passamos por meio das nações que passastes;
verses.RVR09: Porque vosotros sabéis cómo habitamos en la tierra de Egipto, y cómo hemos pasado por medio de las gentes que habéis pasado;

verses.KJV: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
verses.WEB: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);
verses.ASV: and ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them);
verses.ALMEIDA: E vistes suas abominações e seus ídolos, madeira e pedra, prata e ouro, que têm consigo.
verses.RVR09: Y habéis visto sus abominaciones, y sus ídolos, madera y piedra, plata y oro, que tienen consigo.

verses.KJV: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the Lord our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.WEB: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;
verses.ASV: lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from Jehovah our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não haja entre vós homem, ou mulher, ou família, ou tribo, cujo coração se volte hoje de com o SENHOR nosso Deus, por andar a servir aos deuses daquelas nações; que não haja em vós raiz que lance veneno e amargura;
verses.RVR09: Quizá habrá entre vosotros varón, ó mujer, ó familia, ó tribu, cuyo corazón se vuelva hoy de con Jehová nuestro Dios, por andar á servir á los dioses de aquellas gentes; quizá habrá en vosotros raíz que eche veneno y ajenjo;

verses.KJV: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
verses.WEB: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.
verses.ASV: and it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart, to destroy the moist with the dry.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seja que, quando o tal ouvir as palavras desta maldição, ele se abençoe em seu coração, dizendo: Terei paz, ainda que ande segundo o pensamento de meu coração, para acrescentar a embriaguez à sede:
verses.RVR09: Y sea que, cuando el tal oyere las palabras de esta maldición, él se bendiga en su corazón, diciendo: Tendré paz, aunque ande según el pensamiento de mi corazón, para añadir la embriaguez á la sed:

verses.KJV: The Lord will not spare him, but then the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.WEB: The LORD will not pardon him, but then the LORD’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under the sky.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will not pardon him, but then the anger of Jehovah and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book shall lie upon him, and Jehovah will blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR se recusará a lhe perdoar; antes fumegará logo o furor do SENHOR e seu zelo sobre o tal homem, e se assentará sobre ele toda maldição escrita neste livro, e o SENHOR apagará seu nome de debaixo do céu:
verses.RVR09: Jehová no querrá perdonarle; antes humeará luego el furor de Jehová y su celo sobre el tal hombre, y asentaráse sobre él toda maldición escrita en este libro, y Jehová raerá su nombre de debajo del cielo:

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
verses.WEB: The LORD will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.
