verses.ASV: And Jehovah will set him apart unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that is written in this book of the law.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR o separará de todas as tribos de Israel para o mal, conforme todas as maldições do pacto escrito neste livro da lei.
verses.RVR09: Y apartarálo Jehová de todas las tribus de Israel para mal, conforme á todas las maldiciones del pacto escrito en este libro de la ley.

verses.KJV: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the Lord hath laid upon it;
verses.WEB: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick,
verses.ASV: And the generation to come, your children that shall rise up after you, and the foreigner that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses wherewith Jehovah hath made it sick;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dirá a geração vindoura, vossos filhos que virão depois de vós, e o estrangeiro que virá de distantes terras, quando virem as pragas desta terra, e suas enfermidades de que o SENHOR a fez enfermar,
verses.RVR09: Y dirá la generación venidera, vuestros hijos que vendrán después de vosotros, y el extranjero que vendrá de lejanas tierras, cuando vieren las plagas de aquesta tierra, y sus enfermedades de que Jehová la hizo enfermar,

verses.KJV: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the Lord overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.WEB: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.
verses.ASV: [and that] the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, [and] a burning, [that] it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which Jehovah overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.ALMEIDA: (Enxofre e sal, abrasada toda sua terra: não será semeada, nem produzirá, nem crescerá nela erva nenhuma, como na destruição de Sodoma e de Gomorra, de Admá e de Zeboim, que o SENHOR destruiu em seu furor e em sua ira:)
verses.RVR09: (Azufre y sal, abrasada toda su tierra: no será sembrada, ni producirá, ni crecerá en ella hierba ninguna, como en la subversión de Sodoma y de Gomorra, de Adma y de Seboim, que Jehová subvirtió en su furor y en su ira:)

verses.KJV: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
verses.WEB: Even all the nations will say, “Why has the LORD done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”
verses.ASV: even all the nations shall say, Wherefore hath Jehovah done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
verses.ALMEIDA: Dirão, pois, todas as nações: Por que fez o SENHOR isto a esta terra? Que ira é esta de tão grande furor?
verses.RVR09: Dirán, pues, todas las gentes: ¿Por qué hizo Jehová esto á esta tierra? ¿qué ira es ésta de tan gran furor?

verses.KJV: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.WEB: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,
verses.ASV: Then men shall say, Because they forsook the covenant of Jehovah, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: E responderão. Porquanto deixaram o pacto do SENHOR o Deus de seus pais, que ele estabeleceu com eles quando os tirou da terra do Egito,
verses.RVR09: Y responderán: Por cuanto dejaron el pacto de Jehová el Dios de sus padres, que él concertó con ellos cuando los sacó de la tierra de Egipto,

verses.KJV: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
verses.WEB: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.
verses.ASV: and went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods that they knew not, and that he had not given unto them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram e serviram a deuses alheios, e inclinaram-se a eles, deuses que não conheciam, e que nenhuma coisa lhes haviam dado:
verses.RVR09: Y fueron y sirvieron á dioses ajenos, é inclináronse á ellos, dioses que no conocían, y que ninguna cosa les habían dado:

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.
verses.ASV: therefore the anger of Jehovah was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curse that is written in this book;
verses.ALMEIDA: Acendeu-se portanto, o furor do SENHOR contra esta terra, para trazer sobre ela todas as maldições escritas nesta livro;
verses.RVR09: Encendióse por tanto, el furor de Jehová contra esta tierra, para traer sobre ella todas las maldiciones escritas en este libro;

verses.KJV: And the Lord rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
verses.WEB: The LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”
verses.ASV: and Jehovah rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as at this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR os desarraigou de sua terra com ira, e com indignação, e com furor grande, e os expulsou a outra terra, como hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová los desarraigó de su tierra con enojo, y con saña, y con furor grande, y los echó á otra tierra, como hoy.

verses.KJV: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.WEB: The secret things belong to the LORD our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.ASV: The secret things belong unto Jehovah our God; but the things that are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.ALMEIDA: As coisas secretas pertencem ao SENHOR nosso Deus: mas as reveladas são para nós e para nossos filhos para sempre, para que cumpramos todas as palavras desta lei.
verses.RVR09: Las cosas secretas pertenecen á Jehová nuestro Dios: mas las reveladas son para nosotros y para nuestros hijos por siempre, para que cumplamos todas las palabras de esta ley.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath driven thee,
verses.WEB: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither Jehovah thy God hath driven thee,
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, quando te sobrevierem todas estas coisas, a bênção e a maldição que pus diante de ti, e te conscientizares em teu coração em meio de todas as nações às quais o SENHOR teu Deus te houver expulsado,
verses.RVR09: Y SERÁ que, cuando te sobrevinieren todas estas cosas, la bendición y la maldición que he puesto delante de ti, y volvieres á tu corazón en medio de todas las gentes á las cuales Jehová tu Dios te hubiere echado,

verses.KJV: And shalt return unto the Lord thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.WEB: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.ASV: and shalt return unto Jehovah thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thy heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.ALMEIDA: E te converteres ao SENHOR teu Deus, e obedeceres à sua voz conforme tudo o que eu te mando hoje, tu e teus filhos, com todo teu coração e com toda tua alma,
verses.RVR09: Y te convirtieres á Jehová tu Dios, y obedecieres á su voz conforme á todo lo que yo te mando hoy, tú y tus hijos, con todo tu corazón y con toda tu alma,

verses.KJV: That then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.WEB: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.
verses.ASV: that then Jehovah thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the peoples, whither Jehovah thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te restaurará de teu infortúnio, terá misericórdia de ti, e voltará a recolher-te de todos os povos aos quais o SENHOR, teu Deus, te houver disperso.
verses.RVR09: Jehová también volverá tus cautivos, y tendrá misericordia de ti, y tornará á recogerte de todos los pueblos á los cuales te hubiere esparcido Jehová tu Dios.

verses.KJV: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.WEB: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.
verses.ASV: If [any of] thine outcasts be in the uttermost parts of heaven, from thence will Jehovah thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se houveres sido lançado até a extremidade dos céus, dali te recolherá o SENHOR teu Deus, e dali te tomará:
verses.RVR09: Si hubieres sido arrojado hasta el cabo de los cielos, de allí te recogerá Jehová tu Dios, y de allá te tomará:

verses.KJV: And the Lord thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.WEB: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.
verses.ASV: and Jehovah thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te fará voltar o SENHOR teu Deus à terra que herdaram teus pais, e a possuirás; e te fará bem, e te multiplicará mais que a teus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y volverte ha Jehová tu Dios á la tierra que heredaron tus padres, y la poseerás; y te hará bien, y te multiplicará más que á tus padres.

verses.KJV: And the Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.WEB: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah thy God will circumcise thy heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E circuncidará o SENHOR teu Deus teu coração, e o coração de tua descendência, para que ames ao SENHOR teu Deus com todo teu coração e com toda tua alma, a fim de que tu vivas.
verses.RVR09: Y circuncidará Jehová tu Dios tu corazón, y el corazón de tu simiente, para que ames á Jehová tu Dios con todo tu corazón y con toda tu alma, á fin de que tú vivas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, that persecuted thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porá o SENHOR teu Deus todas estas maldições sobre teus inimigos, e sobre teus aborrecedores que te perseguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrá Jehová tu Dios todas estas maldiciones sobre tus enemigos, y sobre tus aborrecedores que te persiguieron.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the Lord, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.WEB: You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of Jehovah, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu voltarás, e ouvirás a voz do SENHOR, e porás por obra todos os seus mandamentos, que eu te intimo hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y tú volverás, y oirás la voz de Jehová, y pondrás por obra todos sus mandamientos, que yo te intimo hoy.

verses.KJV: And the Lord thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the Lord will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
verses.WEB: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah thy God will make thee plenteous in all the work of thy hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, for good: for Jehovah will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers;
verses.ALMEIDA: E te fará o SENHOR teu Deus abundar em toda obra de tuas mãos, no fruto de teu ventre, no fruto de teu animal, e no fruto de tua terra, para o bem: porque o SENHOR voltará a se alegrar sobre ti para o bem, da maneira que se alegrou sobre teus pais;
verses.RVR09: Y hacerte ha Jehová tu Dios abundar en toda obra de tus manos, en el fruto de tu vientre, en el fruto de tu bestia, y en el fruto de tu tierra, para bien: porque Jehová volverá á gozarse sobre ti para bien, de la manera que se gozó sobre tus padres;

verses.KJV: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.WEB: if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.ASV: if thou shalt obey the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law; if thou turn unto Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ouvires a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, para guardar seus mandamentos e seus estatutos escritos neste livro da lei; quando te converteres ao SENHOR teu Deus com todo teu coração e com toda tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Cuando oyeres la voz de Jehová tu Dios, para guardar sus mandamientos y sus estatutos escritos en este libro de la ley; cuando te convirtieres á Jehová tu Dios con todo tu corazón y con toda tu alma.

verses.KJV: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.
verses.WEB: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.
verses.ASV: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not too hard for thee, neither is it far off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque este mandamento que eu te intimo hoje, não te é encoberto, nem está longe:
verses.RVR09: Porque este mandamiento que yo te intimo hoy, no te es encubierto, ni está lejos:

verses.KJV: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.WEB: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
verses.ASV: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, and make us to hear it, that we may do it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não está no céu, para que digas: Quem subirá por nós ao céu, e nos o trará e o apresentará para nós, para que o cumpramos?
verses.RVR09: No está en el cielo, para que digas: ¿Quién subirá por nosotros al cielo, y nos lo traerá y nos lo representará, para que lo cumplamos?

verses.KJV: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.WEB: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
verses.ASV: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, and make us to hear it, that we may do it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem está da outra parte do mar, para que digas: Quem passará por nós o mar, para que o traga até nós e a nós o apresente, a fim de que o cumpramos?
verses.RVR09: Ni está de la otra parte de la mar, para que digas: ¿Quién pasará por nosotros la mar, para que nos lo traiga y nos lo represente, á fin de que lo cumplamos?

verses.KJV: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.WEB: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
verses.ASV: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque muito próxima de ti está a palavra, em tua boca e em teu coração, para que a cumpras.
verses.RVR09: Porque muy cerca de ti está la palabra, en tu boca y en tu corazón, para que la cumplas.

verses.KJV: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.WEB: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.
verses.ASV: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha, eu pus diante de ti hoje a vida e o bem, a morte e o mal:
verses.RVR09: Mira, yo he puesto delante de ti hoy la vida y el bien, la muerte y el mal:

verses.KJV: In that I command thee this day to love the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.WEB: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.
verses.ASV: in that I command thee this day to love Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his ordinances, that thou mayest live and multiply, and that Jehovah thy God may bless thee in the land whither thou goest in to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu te mando hoje que ames ao SENHOR teu Deus, que andes em seus caminhos, e guardes seus mandamentos e seus estatutos e seus regulamentos, para que vivas e sejas multiplicado, e o SENHOR teu Deus te abençoe na terra à qual entras para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo te mando hoy que ames á Jehová tu Dios, que andes en sus caminos, y guardes sus mandamientos y sus estatutos y sus derechos, para que vivas y seas multiplicado, y Jehová tu Dios te bendiga en la tierra á la cual entras para poseerla.

verses.KJV: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.WEB: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,
verses.ASV: But if thy heart turn away, and thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se teu coração se desviar, e não ouvires, e fores incitado, e te inclinares a deuses alheios, e os servires;
verses.RVR09: Mas si tu corazón se apartare, y no oyeres, y fueres incitado, y te inclinares á dioses ajenos, y los sirvieres;

verses.KJV: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.WEB: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
verses.ASV: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish; ye shall not prolong your days in the land, whither thou passest over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Declaro-vos hoje que certamente perecereis: não tereis longos dias sobre a terra, para ir à qual passas o Jordão para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: Protéstoos hoy que de cierto pereceréis: no tendréis largos días sobre la tierra, para ir á la cual pasas el Jordán para poseerla.

verses.KJV: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.WEB: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,
verses.ASV: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that I have set before thee life and death, the blessing and the curse: therefore choose life, that thou mayest live, thou and thy seed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos céus e a terra chamo por testemunhas hoje contra vós, que pus diante de vós a vida e a morte, a bênção e a maldição: escolhe, pois, a vida, para que vivas tu e tua descendência:
verses.RVR09: A los cielos y la tierra llamo por testigos hoy contra vosotros, que os he puesto delante la vida y la muerte, la bendición y la maldición: escoge pues la vida, porque vivas tú y tu simiente:

verses.KJV: That thou mayest love the Lord thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.WEB: to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.ASV: to love Jehovah thy God, to obey his voice, and to cleave unto him; for he is thy life, and the length of thy days; that thou mayest dwell in the land which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que ames ao SENHOR teu Deus, que ouças sua voz, e te achegues a ele; porque ele é tua vida, e o comprimento de teus dias; a fim de que habites sobre a terra que jurou o SENHOR a teus pais Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, que lhes havia de dar.
verses.RVR09: Que ames á Jehová tu Dios, que oigas su voz, y te allegues á él; porque él es tu vida, y la longitud de tus días; á fin de que habites sobre la tierra que juró Jehová á tus padres Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob, que les había de dar.

verses.KJV: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
verses.WEB: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
verses.ASV: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi Moisés, e falou estas palavras a todo Israel,
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ Moisés, y habló estas palabras á todo Israel,

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the Lord hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. The LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, I am a hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: and Jehovah hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: De idade de cento e vinte anos sou hoje dia; não posso mais sair nem entrar: a mais disto o SENHOR me disse: Não passarás este Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: De edad de ciento y veinte años soy hoy día; no puedo más salir ni entrar: á más de esto Jehová me ha dicho: No pasarás este Jordán.

verses.KJV: The Lord thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the Lord hath said.
verses.WEB: The LORD your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as the LORD has spoken.
verses.ASV: Jehovah thy God, he will go over before thee; he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt dispossess them: [and] Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as Jehovah hath spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR teu Deus, ele passa diante de ti; ele destruirá estas nações de diante de ti, e as herdarás: Josué será o que passará diante de ti, como o SENHOR disse.
verses.RVR09: Jehová tu Dios, él pasa delante de ti; él destruirá estas gentes de delante de ti, y las heredarás: Josué será el que pasará delante de ti, como Jehová ha dicho.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
verses.WEB: The LORD will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and unto their land; whom he destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará o SENHOR com eles como fez com Seom e com Ogue, reis dos amorreus, e com sua terra, que os destruiu.
verses.RVR09: Y hará Jehová con ellos como hizo con Sehón y con Og, reyes de los Amorrheos, y con su tierra, que los destruyó.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.WEB: The LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will deliver them up before you, and ye shall do unto them according unto all the commandment which I have commanded you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os entregará o SENHOR diante de vós, e fareis com eles conforme tudo o que vos mandei.
verses.RVR09: Y los entregará Jehová delante de vosotros, y haréis con ellos conforme á todo lo que os he mandado.

verses.KJV: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.WEB: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
verses.ASV: Be strong and of good courage, fear not, nor be affrighted at them: for Jehovah thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esforçai-vos e tende ânimo; não temais, nem tenhais medo deles: que o SENHOR teu Deus é o que vai contigo: não te deixará nem te desamparará.
verses.RVR09: Esforzaos y cobrad ánimo; no temáis, ni tengáis miedo de ellos: que Jehová tu Dios es el que va contigo: no te dejará ni te desamparará.

verses.KJV: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the Lord hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.WEB: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.
verses.ASV: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of good courage: for thou shalt go with this people into the land which Jehovah hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Moisés a Josué, e disse-lhe à vista de todo Israel: Esforça-te e anima-te; porque tu entrarás com este povo à terra que jurou o SENHOR a seus pais que lhes havia de dar, e tu a farás herdar.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Moisés á Josué, y díjole á vista de todo Israel: Esfuérzate y anímate; porque tú entrarás con este pueblo á la tierra que juró Jehová á sus padres que les había de dar, y tú se la harás heredar.

verses.KJV: And the Lord, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.WEB: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR é o que vai diante de ti; ele será contigo, não te deixará, nem te desamparará; não temas, nem te intimides.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová es el que va delante de ti; él será contigo, no te dejará, ni te desamparará; no temas, ni te intimides.

verses.KJV: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.WEB: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, that bare the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E escreveu Moisés esta lei, e deu-a aos sacerdotes, filhos de Levi, que levavam a arca do pacto do SENHOR, e a todos os anciãos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y escribió Moisés esta ley, y dióla á los sacerdotes, hijos de Leví, que llevaban el arca del pacto de Jehová, y á todos los ancianos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.WEB: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,
verses.ASV: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of [every] seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou-lhes Moisés, dizendo: Ao fim do sétimo ano, no ano da remissão, na festa das cabanas,
verses.RVR09: Y mandóles Moisés, diciendo: Al cabo del séptimo año, en el año de la remisión, en la fiesta de las Cabañas,

verses.KJV: When all Israel is come to appear before the Lord thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.WEB: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.ASV: when all Israel is come to appear before Jehovah thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando vier todo Israel a apresentar-se diante do SENHOR teu Deus no lugar que ele escolher, lerás esta lei diante de todo Israel aos ouvidos deles.
verses.RVR09: Cuando viniere todo Israel á presentarse delante de Jehová tu Dios en el lugar que él escogiere, leerás esta ley delante de todo Israel á oídos de ellos.

verses.KJV: Gather the people together, men and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the Lord your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
verses.WEB: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,
verses.ASV: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and thy sojourner that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Jehovah your God, and observe to do all the words of this law;
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás congregar o povo, homens e mulheres e crianças, e teus estrangeiros que estiverem em tuas cidades, para que ouçam e aprendam, e temam ao SENHOR vosso Deus, e cuidem de praticar todas as palavras desta lei:
verses.RVR09: Harás congregar el pueblo, varones y mujeres y niños, y tus extranjeros que estuvieren en tus ciudades, para que oigan y aprendan, y teman á Jehová vuestro Dios, y cuiden de poner por obra todas las palabras de esta ley:

verses.KJV: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the Lord your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.WEB: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
verses.ASV: and that their children, who have not known, may hear, and learn to fear Jehovah your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over the Jordan to possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos deles que não souberem ouçam, e aprendam a temer ao SENHOR vosso Deus todos os dias que viverdes sobre a terra, para ir à qual passais o Jordão para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de ellos que no supieron oigan, y aprendan á temer á Jehová vuestro Dios todos los días que viviereis sobre la tierra, para ir á la cual pasáis el Jordán para poseerla.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tent of meeting, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Eis que se aproximam teus dias para que morras: chama a Josué, e esperai no tabernáculo do testemunho, e lhe mandarei. Foram pois Moisés e Josué, e esperaram no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: He aquí se han acercado tus días para que mueras: llama á Josué, y esperad en el tabernáculo del testimonio, y le mandaré. Fueron pues Moisés y Josué, y esperaron en el tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And the Lord appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
verses.WEB: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud: and the pillar of cloud stood over the door of the Tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apareceu-se o SENHOR no tabernáculo, na coluna de nuvem; e a coluna de nuvem se pôs sobre a porta do tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Y aparecióse Jehová en el tabernáculo, en la columna de nube; y la columna de nube se puso sobre la puerta del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and play the harlot after the strange gods of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Eis que tu vais descansar com teus pais, e este povo se levantará e se prostituirá atrás dos deuses alheios da terra aonde vai, em estando em meio dela; e me deixará, e invalidará meu pacto que estabeleci com ele:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Moisés: He aquí tú vas á dormir con tus padres, y este pueblo se levantará y fornicará tras los dioses ajenos de la tierra adonde va, en estando en medio de ella; y me dejará, é invalidará mi pacto que he concertado con él:

verses.KJV: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
verses.WEB: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’
verses.ASV: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come upon them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us because our God is not among us?
verses.ALMEIDA: E meu furor se acenderá contra ele naquele dia; e os abandonarei, e esconderei deles meu rosto, e serão consumidos; e o acharão muitos males e angústias, e dirá naquele dia: Não me acharam estes males porque não está meu Deus em meio de mim?
verses.RVR09: Y mi furor se encenderá contra él en aquel día; y los abandonaré, y esconderé de ellos mi rostro, y serán consumidos; y le hallarán muchos males y angustias, y dirá en aquel día: ¿No me han hallado estos males porque no está mi Dios en medio de mí?

verses.KJV: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.WEB: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.
verses.ASV: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu esconderei certamente meu rosto naquele dia, por todo o mal que eles houverem feito, por haver-se voltado a deuses alheios.
verses.RVR09: Empero yo esconderé ciertamente mi rostro en aquel día, por todo el mal que ellos habrán hecho, por haberse vuelto á dioses ajenos.

verses.KJV: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach thou it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, escrevei-vos este cântico, e ensina-o aos filhos de Israel: põe-o em boca deles, para que este cântico me seja por testemunha contra os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, escribíos este cántico, y enséñalo á los hijos de Israel: ponlo en boca de ellos, para que este cántico me sea por testigo contra los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
verses.WEB: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.
verses.ASV: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxed fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu lhe introduzirei na terra que jurei a seus pais, a qual flui leite e mel; e comerá, e se fartará, e se engordará: e se voltarão a deuses alheios, e lhes servirão, e me provocarão à ira, e invalidarão meu pacto.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo le introduciré en la tierra que juré á sus padres, la cual fluye leche y miel; y comerá, y se hartará, y se engordará: y volveránse á dioses ajenos, y les servirán, y me enojarán, é invalidarán mi pacto.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
verses.WEB: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are come upon them, that this song shall testify before them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they frame this day, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que quando lhe vierem muitos males e angústias, então responderá em sua face este cântico como testemunha, pois não cairá em esquecimento da boca de sua linhagem: porque eu conheço seu intento, e o que faz hoje antes que lhe introduza na terra que jurei.
verses.RVR09: Y será que cuando le vinieren muchos males y angustias, entonces responderá en su cara este cántico como testigo, pues no caerá en olvido de la boca de su linaje: porque yo conozco su ingenio, y lo que hace hoy antes que le introduzca en la tierra que juré.

verses.KJV: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moisés escreveu este cântico aquele dia, e ensinou-o aos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Moisés escribió este cántico aquel día, y enseñólo á los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
verses.WEB: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”
verses.ASV: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of good courage; for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu ordem a Josué filho de Num, e disse: Esforça-te e anima-te, que tu porás os filhos de Israel na terra que lhes jurei, e eu serei contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y dió orden á Josué hijo de Nun, y dijo: Esfuérzate y anímate, que tú meterás los hijos de Israel en la tierra que les juré, y yo seré contigo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.WEB: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando acabou Moisés de escrever as palavras desta lei em um livro até concluir,
verses.RVR09: Y como acabó Moisés de escribir las palabras de esta ley en un libro hasta concluirse,

verses.KJV: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,
verses.WEB: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, saying,
verses.ASV: that Moses commanded the Levites, that bare the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mandou Moisés aos levitas que levavam a arca do pacto do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Mandó Moisés á los Levitas que llevaban el arca del pacto de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.WEB: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.
verses.ASV: Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the covenant of Jehovah your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomai este livro da lei, e ponde-o ao lado da arca do pacto do SENHOR vosso Deus, e esteja ali por testemunha contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Tomad este libro de la ley, y ponedlo al lado del arca del pacto de Jehová vuestro Dios, y esté allí por testigo contra ti.

verses.KJV: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the Lord; and how much more after my death?
verses.WEB: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. How much more after my death?
verses.ASV: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against Jehovah; and how much more after my death?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu conheço tua rebelião, e tua dura cerviz: eis que ainda vivendo eu hoje convosco, sois rebeldes ao SENHOR; e quanto mais depois que eu morrer?
verses.RVR09: Porque yo conozco tu rebelión, y tu cerviz dura: he aquí que aun viviendo yo hoy con vosotros, sois rebeldes á Jehová; y ¿cuánto más después que yo fuere muerto?

verses.KJV: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
verses.WEB: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.ASV: Assemble unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Congregai a mim todos os anciãos de vossas tribos, e a vossos oficiais, e falarei em seus ouvidos estas palavras, e chamarei por testemunhas contra eles os céus e a terra.
verses.RVR09: Congregad á mí todos los ancianos de vuestras tribus, y á vuestros oficiales, y hablaré en sus oídos estas palabras, y llamaré por testigos contra ellos los cielos y la tierra.

verses.KJV: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.WEB: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”
verses.ASV: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do that which is evil in the sight of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sei que depois de minha morte, certamente vos corrompereis e vos desviareis do caminho que vos mandei; e que vos há de vir mal nos últimos dias, por haver feito mal aos olhos do SENHOR, provocando-lhe à ira com a obra de vossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo sé que después de mi muerte, ciertamente os corromperéis y os aparteréis del camino que os he mandado; y que os ha de venir mal en los postreros días, por haber hecho mal en ojos de Jehová, enojándole con la obra de vuestras manos.

verses.KJV: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
verses.WEB: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.
verses.ASV: And Moses spake in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então falou Moisés aos ouvidos de toda a congregação de Israel as palavras deste cântico até acabá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces habló Moisés en oídos de toda la congregación de Israel las palabras de este cántico hasta acabarlo.

verses.KJV: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.WEB: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
verses.ASV: Give ear, ye heavens, and I will speak; And let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Escutai, céus, e falarei; E ouça a terra os ditos de minha boca.
verses.RVR09: ESCUCHAD, cielos, y hablaré; y oiga la tierra los dichos de mi boca.

verses.KJV: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.WEB: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.
verses.ASV: My doctrine shall drop as the rain; My speech shall distil as the dew, As the small rain upon the tender grass, And as the showers upon the herb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gotejará como a chuva minha doutrina; Destilará como o orvalho meu discurso; Como o chuvisco sobre a grama, E como as gotas sobre a erva:
verses.RVR09: Goteará como la lluvia mi doctrina; destilará como el rocío mi razonamiento; como la llovizna sobre la grama, y como las gotas sobre la hierba:

verses.KJV: Because I will publish the name of the Lord: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.WEB: For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
verses.ASV: For I will proclaim the name of Jehovah: Ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque invocarei o nome do SENHOR; Engrandecei ao nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque el nombre de Jehová invocaré: engrandeced á nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
verses.WEB: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
verses.ASV: The Rock, his work is perfect; For all his ways are justice: A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, Just and right is he.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ele é] a Rocha, sua obra é perfeita, pois todos os seus caminhos são justos. Deus fiel, e sem imoralidade; justo e correto ele é.
verses.RVR09: El es la Roca, cuya obra es perfecta, porque todos sus caminos son rectitud: Dios de verdad, y ninguna iniquidad en él: es justo y recto.

verses.KJV: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.WEB: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.ASV: They have dealt corruptly with him, [they are] not his children, [it is] their blemish; [They are] a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Corromperam-se contra ele; não são seus filhos, a falha é deles. São uma geração perversa e distorcida.
verses.RVR09: La corrupción no es suya: á sus hijos la mancha de ellos, generación torcida y perversa.

verses.KJV: Do ye thus requite the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.WEB: Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
verses.ASV: Do ye thus requite Jehovah, O foolish people and unwise? Is not he thy father that hath bought thee? He hath made thee, and established thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: É assim que pagais ao SENHOR, ó povo tolo e insensato? Não é ele teu pai que te adquiriu, te fez, e te estabeleceu?
verses.RVR09: ¿Así pagáis á Jehová, pueblo loco é ignorante? ¿no es él tu padre que te poseyó? él te hizo y te ha organizado.

verses.KJV: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.WEB: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.ASV: Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations: Ask thy father, and he will show thee; Thine elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te dos tempos antigos; Considerai os anos de geração e geração: Pergunta a teu pai, que ele te declarará; A teus anciãos, e eles te dirão.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de los tiempos antiguos; considerad los años de generación y generación: pregunta á tu padre, que él te declarará; á tus viejos, y ellos te dirán.

verses.KJV: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, When he separated the children of men, He set the bounds of the peoples According to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o Altíssimo fez herdar às nações, Quando fez dividir os filhos dos homens, Estabeleceu os termos dos povos Segundo o número dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Cuando el Altísimo hizo heredar á las gentes, cuando hizo dividir los hijos de los hombres, estableció los términos de los pueblos según el número de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: For the Lord's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.WEB: For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a parte do SENHOR é seu povo; Jacó a medida de sua herança.
verses.RVR09: Porque la parte de Jehová es su pueblo; Jacob la cuerda de su heredad.

verses.KJV: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.WEB: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.ASV: He found him in a desert land, And in the waste howling wilderness; He compassed him about, he cared for him, He kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.ALMEIDA: Achou-o em terra de deserto, E em deserto horrível e ermo; Cercou-o, instruiu-o, Guardou-o como a menina de seu olho.
verses.RVR09: Hallólo en tierra de desierto, y en desierto horrible y yermo; trájolo alrededor, instruyólo, guardólo como la niña de su ojo.

verses.KJV: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.WEB: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.
verses.ASV: As an eagle that stirreth up her nest, That fluttereth over her young, He spread abroad his wings, he took them, He bare them on his pinions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como a água desperta sua ninhada, paira sobre seus passarinhos, estende suas asas, os toma, os leva sobre suas penas;
verses.RVR09: Como el águila despierta su nidada, revolotea sobre sus pollos, extiende sus alas, los toma, los lleva sobre sus plumas:

verses.KJV: So the Lord alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
verses.WEB: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
verses.ASV: Jehovah alone did lead him, And there was no foreign god with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: o SENHOR sozinho o guiou, e nenhum deus estrangeiro esteve com ele.
verses.RVR09: Jehová solo le guió, que no hubo con él dios ajeno.

verses.KJV: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.WEB: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.ASV: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, And he did eat the increase of the field; And he made him to suck honey out of the rock, And oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele o fez cavalgar sobre os lugares altos da terra; alimentou-o com os frutos do campo, e o fez sugar mel da rocha e azeite da dura pederneira;
verses.RVR09: Hízolo subir sobre las alturas de la tierra, y comió los frutos del campo, é hizo que chupase miel de la peña, y aceite del duro pedernal;

verses.KJV: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.WEB: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
verses.ASV: Butter of the herd, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs, And rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the finest of the wheat; And of the blood of the grape thou drankest wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: manteiga de vacas e leite de ovelhas, com gordura de cordeiros, e carneiros de Basã; também machos de bode, com o melhor do trigo; e bebeste o sangue das uvas, o vinho puro.
verses.RVR09: Manteca de vacas y leche de ovejas, con grosura de corderos, y carneros de Basán; también machos de cabrío, con grosura de riñones de trigo: y sangre de uva bebiste, vino puro.

verses.KJV: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.WEB: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.
verses.ASV: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: Thou art waxed fat, thou art grown thick, thou art become sleek; Then he forsook God who made him, And lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E engordou Jesurum, e deu coices: engordaste-te, engrossaste-te, cobriste-te: e deixou ao Deus que lhe fez, e menosprezou a Rocha de sua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Y engrosó Jeshurun, y tiró coces: engordástete, engrosástete, cubrístete: y dejó al Dios que le hizo, y menospreció la Roca de su salud.

verses.KJV: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.WEB: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
verses.ASV: They moved him to jealousy with strange [gods]; With abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Provocaram-lhe ciúmes com os deuses alheios; irritaram-lhe com abominações.
verses.RVR09: Despertáronle á celos con los dioses ajenos; ensañáronle con abominaciones.

verses.KJV: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.WEB: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
verses.ASV: They sacrificed unto demons, [which were] no God, To gods that they knew not, To new [gods] that came up of late, Which your fathers dreaded not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sacrificaram aos demônios, não a Deus; a deuses que não conheciam, a novos deuses vindos de perto, Que não haviam temido vossos pais.
verses.RVR09: Sacrificaron á los diablos, no á Dios; á dioses que no habían conocido, á nuevos dioses venidos de cerca, que no habían temido vuestros padres.

verses.KJV: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.WEB: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
verses.ASV: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, And hast forgotten God that gave thee birth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abandonaste a Rocha que te gerou; e te esqueceste do Deus que te criou.
verses.RVR09: De la Roca que te crió te olvidaste: te has olvidado del Dios tu criador.

verses.KJV: And when the Lord saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.WEB: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah saw [it], and abhorred [them], Because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR o viu, e acendeu-se em ira, pelo menosprezo de seus filhos e de suas filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y viólo Jehová, y encendióse en ira, por el menosprecio de sus hijos y de sus hijas.

verses.KJV: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
verses.WEB: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
verses.ASV: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: For they are a very perverse generation, Children in whom is no faithfulness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: esconderei deles meu rosto, verei qual será seu fim; pois são geração de perversidades, filhos sem fidelidade.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Esconderé de ellos mi rostro, veré cuál será su postrimería: que son generación de perversidades, hijos sin fe.

verses.KJV: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.WEB: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.ASV: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; They have provoked me to anger with their vanities: And I will move them to jealousy with those that are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles me provocaram ciúmes com o que não é Deus; com suas vaidades provocaram-me à ira; eu também provocarei os ciúmes com aqueles que não são povo, e com uma nação insensata eu os provocarei à ira.
verses.RVR09: Ellos me movieron á celos con lo que no es Dios; hiciéronme ensañar con sus vanidades: yo también los moveré á celos con un pueblo que no es pueblo, con gente insensata los haré ensañar.

verses.KJV: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.WEB: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.
verses.ASV: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, And burneth unto the lowest Sheol, And devoureth the earth with its increase, And setteth on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque um fogo se acendeu em meu furor, e arderá até as profundezas do Xeol; e consumirá a terra e seus frutos, e abrasará os fundamentos dos montes.
verses.RVR09: Porque fuego se encenderá en mi furor, y arderá hasta el profundo; y devorará la tierra y sus frutos, y abrasará los fundamentos de los montes.

verses.KJV: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.WEB: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
verses.ASV: I will heap evils upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu trarei males sobre eles; gastarei neles minhas flechas.
verses.RVR09: Yo allegaré males sobre ellos; emplearé en ellos mis saetas.

verses.KJV: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.WEB: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
verses.ASV: [They shall be] wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat And bitter destruction; And the teeth of beasts will I send upon them, With the poison of crawling things of the dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Consumidos serão de fome, e comidos de febre ardente E de amarga pestilência; Dente de animais enviarei também sobre eles, Com veneno de serpente da terra.
verses.RVR09: Consumidos serán de hambre, y comidos de fiebre ardiente y de amarga pestilencia; diente de bestias enviaré también sobre ellos, con veneno de serpiente de la tierra.

verses.KJV: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
verses.WEB: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
verses.ASV: Without shall the sword bereave, And in the chambers terror; [It shall destroy] both young man and virgin, The suckling with the man of gray hairs.
verses.ALMEIDA: De fora desolará a espada, E dentro das câmaras o espanto: Tanto ao rapaz como à virgem, Ao que mama como o homem grisalho.
verses.RVR09: De fuera desolará la espada, y dentro de las cámaras el espanto; así al mancebo como á la doncella, al que mama como el hombre cano.

verses.KJV: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.WEB: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
verses.ASV: I said, I would scatter them afar, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men;
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse: Eu os dispersaria do mundo, Faria cessar dentre os homens a memória deles,
verses.RVR09: Dije: Echaríalos yo del mundo, haría cesar de entre los hombres la memoria de ellos,

verses.KJV: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the Lord hath not done all this.
verses.WEB: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”
verses.ASV: Were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, Lest their adversaries should judge amiss, Lest they should say, Our hand is exalted, And Jehovah hath not done all this.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se não temesse a ira do inimigo, Não seja que se envaideçam seus adversários, Não seja que digam: Nossa mão alta fez tudo isto, não o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Si no temiese la ira del enemigo, no sea que se envanezcan sus adversarios, no sea que digan: Nuestra mano alta ha hecho todo esto, no Jehová.

verses.KJV: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
verses.WEB: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.
verses.ASV: For they are a nation void of counsel, And there is no understanding in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque são gente de perdidos conselhos, E não há neles entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Porque son gente de perdidos consejos, y no hay en ellos entendimiento.

verses.KJV: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.WEB: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.ASV: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, That they would consider their latter end!
verses.ALMEIDA: Bom seria se fossem sábios, que compreendessem isto, E entendessem seu fim!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ojalá fueran sabios, que comprendieran esto, y entendieran su postrimería!

verses.KJV: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?
verses.WEB: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?
verses.ASV: How should one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Except their Rock had sold them, And Jehovah had delivered them up?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como poderia perseguir um a mil, E dois fariam fugir a dez mil, Se sua Rocha não os houvesse vendido, E o SENHOR não os houvesse entregue?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo podría perseguir uno á mil, y dos harían huir á diez mil, si su Roca no los hubiese vendido, y Jehová no los hubiera entregado?

verses.KJV: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.WEB: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
verses.ASV: For their rock is not as our Rock, Even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que a rocha deles não é como nossa Rocha: E nossos inimigos sejam disso juízes.
verses.RVR09: Que la roca de ellos no es como nuestra Roca: y nuestros enemigos sean de ello jueces.

verses.KJV: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
verses.WEB: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
verses.ASV: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, And of the fields of Gomorrah: Their grapes are grapes of gall, Their clusters are bitter:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque da vide de Sodoma é a vide deles, E dos sarmentos de Gomorra: As uvas deles são uvas venenosas, cachos muito amargos têm.
verses.RVR09: Porque de la vid de Sodoma es la vid de ellos, y de los sarmientos de Gomorra: las uvas de ellos son uvas ponzoñosas, racimos muy amargos tienen.

verses.KJV: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.WEB: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
verses.ASV: Their wine is the poison of serpents, And the cruel venom of asps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veneno de serpentes é seu vinho, e peçonha cruel de áspides.
verses.RVR09: Veneno de dragones es su vino, y ponzoña cruel de áspides.

verses.KJV: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
verses.WEB: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
verses.ASV: Is not this laid up in store with me, Sealed up among my treasures?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tenho eu isto guardado, Selado em meus tesouros?
verses.RVR09: ¿No tengo yo esto guardado, sellado en mis tesoros?

verses.KJV: To me belongeth vengeance and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.WEB: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
verses.ASV: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, At the time when their foot shall slide: For the day of their calamity is at hand, And the things that are to come upon them shall make haste.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha é a vingança e o pagamento, Ao tempo que seu pé vacilará; Porque o dia de sua aflição está próximo, E o que lhes está preparado se apressa.
verses.RVR09: Mía es la venganza y el pago, al tiempo que su pie vacilará; porque el día de su aflicción está cercano, y lo que les está preparado se apresura.

verses.KJV: For the Lord shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
verses.WEB: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself for his servants; When he seeth that [their] power is gone, And there is none [remaining], shut up or left at large.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR julgará a seu povo, E por causa de seus servos se arrependerá, Quando vir que a força pereceu, E que não há prisioneiro nem livre.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová juzgará á su pueblo, y por amor de sus siervos se arrepentirá, cuando viere que la fuerza pereció, y que no hay guardado, mas desamparado.

verses.KJV: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
verses.WEB: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
verses.ASV: And he will say, Where are their gods, The rock in which they took refuge;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dirá: Onde estão seus deuses, A rocha em que se refugiavam;
verses.RVR09: Y dirá: ¿Dónde están sus dioses, la roca en que se guarecían;

verses.KJV: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
verses.WEB: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
verses.ASV: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, [And] drank the wine of their drink-offering? Let them rise up and help you, Let them be your protection.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que comiam a gordura de seus sacrifícios, Bebiam o veio de suas libações? Levante-se, que vos ajudem E vos defendam.
verses.RVR09: Que comían el sebo de sus sacrificios, bebían el vino de sus libaciones? Levántense, que os ayuden y os defiendan.

verses.KJV: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.WEB: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
verses.ASV: See now that I, even I, am he, And there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal; And there is none that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vede agora que Eu, Eu Sou, e não há deus além de mim; eu trago a morte, e eu faço viver; eu firo, e eu curo; e não há quem possa escapar da minha mão.
verses.RVR09: Ved ahora que yo, yo soy, y no hay dioses conmigo: yo hago morir, y yo hago vivir: yo hiero, y yo curo: y no hay quien pueda librar de mi mano.

verses.KJV: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.WEB: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
verses.ASV: For I lift up my hand to heaven, And say, As I live for ever,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu erguer aos céus minha mão, e disser: “Tão certo como eu vivo para sempre”,
verses.RVR09: Cuando yo alzaré á los cielos mi mano, y diré: Vivo yo para siempre,

verses.KJV: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.WEB: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
verses.ASV: If I whet my glittering sword, And my hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine adversaries, And will recompense them that hate me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu afiar minha espada reluzente, e minha mão agarrar o juízo, devolverei a vingança sobre os meus adversários, e retribuirei aos que me odeiam.
verses.RVR09: Si afilare mi reluciente espada, y mi mano arrebatare el juicio, yo volveré la venganza á mis enemigos, y daré el pago á los que me aborrecen.

verses.KJV: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.WEB: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
verses.ASV: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, And my sword shall devour flesh; With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the head of the leaders of the enemy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Embriagarei de sangue minhas flechas, e minha espada devorará carne, no sangue dos mortos e dos cativos, das cabeças dos líderes inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Embriagaré de sangre mis saetas, y mi espada devorará carne: en la sangre de los muertos y de los cautivos de las cabezas, con venganzas de enemigo.

verses.KJV: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
