verses.ASV: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dito a Josué que os cinco reis haviam sido achados em uma cova em Maquedá.
verses.RVR09: Y fué dicho á Josué que los cinco reyes habían sido hallados en una cueva en Maceda.

verses.KJV: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
verses.WEB: Joshua said, “Roll large stones to cover the cave’s entrance, and set men by it to guard them;
verses.ASV: And Joshua said, Roll great stones unto the mouth of the cave, and set men by it to keep them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Josué disse: Rolai grandes pedras à boca da cova, e ponde homens junto a ela que os guardem;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Josué dijo: Rodad grandes piedras á la boca de la cueva, y poned hombres junto á ella que los guarden;

verses.KJV: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the Lord your God hath delivered them into your hand.
verses.WEB: but don’t stay there. Pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Don’t allow them to enter into their cities; for the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand.”
verses.ASV: but stay not ye; pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for Jehovah your God hath delivered them into your hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós não vos pareis, mas sim segui a vossos inimigos, e feri-lhes a retaguarda, sem deixar-lhes entrar em suas cidades; porque o SENHOR vosso Deus os entregou em vossa mão.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros no os paréis, sino seguid á vuestros enemigos, y heridles la retaguardia, sin dejarles entrar en sus ciudades; porque Jehová vuestro Dios los ha entregado en vuestra mano.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
verses.WEB: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando Josué e os filhos de Israel acabaram de feri-los com mortandade muito grande, até destruí-los, os que restaram deles se meteram nas cidades fortes.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que como Josué y los hijos de Israel hubieron acabado de herirlos con mortandad muy grande, hasta destruirlos, los que quedaron de ellos se metieron en las ciudades fuertes.

verses.KJV: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: that all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo aquele povo se voltou salvo ao acampamento a Josué em Maquedá; que não houve quem movesse sua língua contra os filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el pueblo se volvió salvo al campo á Josué en Maceda; que no hubo quien moviese su lengua contra los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
verses.WEB: Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”
verses.ASV: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring forth those five kings unto me out of the cave.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Josué: Abri a boca da cova, e tirai-me dela a estes cinco reis.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Josué: Abrid la boca de la cueva, y sacadme de ella á estos cinco reyes.

verses.KJV: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.WEB: They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.ASV: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram-no assim, e tiraram-lhe da cova aqueles cinco reis: ao rei de Jerusalém, ao rei de Hebrom, ao rei de Jeremote, ao rei de Laquis, ao rei de Eglom.
verses.RVR09: E hiciéronlo así, y sacáronle de la cueva aquellos cinco reyes: al rey de Jerusalem, al rey de Hebrón, al rey de Jerimoth, al rey de Lachîs, al rey de Eglón.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
verses.WEB: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, “Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings.” They came near, and put their feet on their necks.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when they brought forth those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the chiefs of the men of war that went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando tiraram estes reis a Josué, chamou Josué a todos os homens de Israel, e disse aos principais da gente de guerra que haviam vindo com ele: Chegai e ponde vossos pés sobre os pescoços destes reis. E eles se aproximaram, e puseram seus pés sobre os pescoços deles.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubieron sacado estos reyes á Josué, llamó Josué á todos los varones de Israel, y dijo á los principales de la gente de guerra que habían venido con él: Llegad y poned vuestros pies sobre los pescuezos de aquestos reyes. Y ellos se llegaron, y pusieron sus pies sobre los pescuezos de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.
verses.WEB: Joshua said to them, “Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight.”
verses.ASV: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed; be strong and of good courage: for thus shall Jehovah do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué lhes disse: Não temais, nem vos atemorizeis; sede fortes e valentes: porque assim fará o SENHOR a todos vossos inimigos contra os quais lutai.
verses.RVR09: Y Josué les dijo: No temáis, ni os atemoricéis; sed fuertes y valientes: porque así hará Jehová á todos vuestros enemigos contra los cuales peleáis.

verses.KJV: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
verses.WEB: Afterward Joshua struck them, put them to death, and hanged them on five trees. They were hanging on the trees until the evening.
verses.ASV: And afterward Joshua smote them, and put them to death, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois disto Josué os feriu e os matou, e os fez enforcar em cinco madeiros: e restaram enforcados nos madeiros até à tarde.
verses.RVR09: Y después de esto Josué los hirió y los mató, é hízolos colgar en cinco maderos: y quedaron colgados en los maderos hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.
verses.WEB: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, unto this very day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o sol se ia a pôr, mandou Josué que os tirassem dos madeiros, e os lançassem na cova de onde se haviam escondido: e puseram grandes pedras à boca da cova, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando el sol se iba á poner, mandó Josué que los quitasen de los maderos, y los echasen en la cueva donde se habían escondido: y pusieron grandes piedras á la boca de la cueva, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.WEB: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.ASV: And Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof: he utterly destroyed them and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining; and he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done unto the king of Jericho.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele mesmo dia tomou Josué a Maquedá, e a pôs à espada, e matou a seu rei; a eles e a tudo o que nela tinha vida, sem restar nada: mas ao rei de Maquedá fez como havia feito ao rei de Jericó.
verses.RVR09: En aquel mismo día tomó Josué á Maceda, y la puso á cuchillo, y mató á su rey; á ellos y á todo lo que en ella tenía vida, sin quedar nada: mas al rey de Maceda hizo como había hecho al rey de Jericó.

verses.KJV: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
verses.WEB: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.
verses.ASV: And Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Maquedá passou Josué, e todo Israel com ele, a Libna; e lutou contra Libna:
verses.RVR09: Y de Maceda pasó Josué, y todo Israel con él, á Libna; y peleó contra Libna:

verses.KJV: And the Lord delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.WEB: The LORD delivered it also, with its king, into the hand of Israel. He struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining in it. He did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.ASV: and Jehovah delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining in it; and he did unto the king thereof as he had done unto the king of Jericho.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR a entregou também a ela, e a seu rei, em mãos de Israel; e feriu-a a fio de espada, com tudo o que nela havia vivo, sem restar nada: mas a seu rei fez da maneira que havia feito ao rei de Jericó.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová la entregó también á ella, y á su rey, en manos de Israel; y metióla á filo de espada, con todo lo que en ella había vivo, sin quedar nada: mas á su rey hizo de la manera que había hecho al rey de Jericó.

verses.KJV: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.WEB: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.
verses.ASV: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué, e todo Israel com ele, passou de Libna a Laquis, e pôs acampamento contra ela, e combateu-a:
verses.RVR09: Y Josué, y todo Israel con él, pasó de Libna á Lachîs, y puso campo contra ella, y combatióla:

verses.KJV: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.WEB: The LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.ASV: and Jehovah delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel; and he took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR entregou a Laquis em mão de Israel, e tomou-a ao dia seguinte, e feriu-a à espada, com tudo o que nela havia vivo, como havia feito em Libna.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová entregó á Lachîs en mano de Israel, y tomóla al día siguiente, y metióla á cuchillo, con todo lo que en ella había vivo, como había hecho en Libna.

verses.KJV: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.WEB: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.
verses.ASV: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Horão, rei de Gezer, subiu em ajuda de Laquis; mas a ele e a seu povo feriu Josué, até não restar nenhum deles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Horam, rey de Gezer, subió en ayuda de Lachîs; mas á él y á su pueblo hirió Josué, hasta no quedar ninguno de ellos.

verses.KJV: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.WEB: Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, to Eglon; and they encamped against it and fought against it.
verses.ASV: And Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, unto Eglon; and they encamped against it, and fought against it;
verses.ALMEIDA: De Laquis passou Josué, e todo Israel com ele, a Eglom: e puseram acampamento contra ela, e combateram-na:
verses.RVR09: De Lachîs pasó Josué, y todo Israel con él, á Eglón: y pusieron campo contra ella, y combatiéronla:

verses.KJV: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.WEB: They took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.ASV: and they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword; and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a tomaram no mesmo dia, e meteram-na à espada; e aquele dia matou a todo o que nela havia vivo, como havia feito em Laquis.
verses.RVR09: Y la tomaron el mismo día, y metiéronla á cuchillo; y aquel día mató á todo lo que en ella había vivo, como había hecho en Lachîs.

verses.KJV: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
verses.WEB: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.
verses.ASV: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
verses.ALMEIDA: Subiu logo Josué, e todo Israel com ele, de Eglom a Hebrom, e combateram-na;
verses.RVR09: Subió luego Josué, y todo Israel con él, de Eglón á Hebrón, y combatiéronla;

verses.KJV: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
verses.WEB: They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls who were in it.
verses.ASV: and they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls that were therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando-a, feriram-na à espada, a seu rei e a todas as suas cidades, com tudo o que nela havia vivo, sem restar nada: como fizeram a Eglom, assim a destruíram com tudo o que nela havia vivo.
verses.RVR09: Y tomándola, la metieron á cuchillo, á su rey y á todas sus ciudades, con todo lo que en ella había vivo, sin quedar nada: como habían hecho á Eglón, así la destruyeron con todo lo que en ella había vivo.

verses.KJV: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
verses.WEB: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.
verses.ASV: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it:
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltando-se Josué, e todo Israel com ele, sobre Debir, combateu-a;
verses.RVR09: Y volviéndose Josué, y todo Israel con él, sobre Debir, combatióla;

verses.KJV: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
verses.WEB: He took it, with its king and all its cities. They struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king; as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.
verses.ASV: and he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to the king thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou-a, e a seu rei, e a todas as suas vilas; e feriram-nos à espada, e destruíram tudo o que ali dentro havia vivo, sem restar nada; como havia feito a Hebrom, assim fez a Debir e a seu rei; e como havia feito a Libna e a seu rei.
verses.RVR09: Y tomóla, y á su rey, y á todas sus villas; y metiéronlos á cuchillo, y destruyeron todo lo que allí dentro había vivo, sin quedar nada: como había hecho á Hebrón, así hizo á Debir y á su rey; y como había hecho á Libna y á su rey.

verses.KJV: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.
verses.WEB: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded.
verses.ASV: So Joshua smote all the land, the hill-country, and the South, and the lowland, and the slopes, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Jehovah, the God of Israel, commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Feriu pois Josué toda a região das montanhas, e do sul, e das planícies, e das costas, e a todos os seus reis, sem restar nada; tudo o que tinha vida matou, ao modo que o SENHOR Deus de Israel o havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: Hirió pues Josué toda la región de las montañas, y del mediodía, y de los llanos, y de las cuestas, y á todos sus reyes, sin quedar nada; todo lo que tenía vida mató, al modo que Jehová Dios de Israel lo había mandado.

verses.KJV: And Joshua smote them from Kadeshbarnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
verses.WEB: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.
verses.ASV: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E feriu-os Josué desde Cades-Barneia até Gaza, e toda a terra de Gósen até Gibeão.
verses.RVR09: E hiriólos Josué desde Cades-barnea hasta Gaza, y toda la tierra de Gosén hasta Gabaón.

verses.KJV: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.
verses.WEB: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
verses.ASV: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because Jehovah, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes reis e suas terras tomou Josué de uma vez; porque o SENHOR o Deus de Israel lutava por Israel.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos reyes y sus tierras tomó Josué de una vez; porque Jehová el Dios de Israel peleaba por Israel.

verses.KJV: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.WEB: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.
verses.ASV: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou Josué, e todo Israel com ele, ao acampamento em Gilgal.
verses.RVR09: Y tornóse Josué, y todo Israel con él, al campo en Gilgal.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.WEB: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor heard thereof, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvindo isto Jabim rei de Hazor, enviou mensagem a Jobabe rei de Madom, e ao rei de Sinrom, e ao rei de Acsafe,
verses.RVR09: OYENDO esto Jabín rey de Hasor, envió mensaje á Jobab rey de Madón, y al rey de Simrom, y al rey de Achsaph,

verses.KJV: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
verses.WEB: and to the kings who were on the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,
verses.ASV: and to the kings that were on the north, in the hill-country, and in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, and in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos reis que estavam à parte do norte nas montanhas, e na planície ao sul de Quinerete, e nas planícies, e nas regiões de Dor ao ocidente;
verses.RVR09: Y á los reyes que estaban á la parte del norte en las montañas, y en el llano al mediodía de Cinneroth, y en los llanos, y en las regiones de Dor al occidente;

verses.KJV: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
verses.WEB: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
verses.ASV: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the hill-country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos cananeus que estava ao oriente e ao ocidente, e aos amorreus, e ao Heteu, e aos perizeus, e aos jebuseus nas montanhas, e aos heveus debaixo de Hermom em terra de Mispá.
verses.RVR09: Y al Cananeo que estaba al oriente y al occidente, y al Amorrheo, y al Hetheo, y al Pherezeo, y al Jebuseo en las montañas, y al Heveo debajo de Hermón en tierra de Mizpa.

verses.KJV: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
verses.WEB: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.
verses.ASV: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea-shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes saíram, e com eles todos os seus exércitos, povo muito em grande maneira, como a areia que está à beira do mar, com grande multidão de cavalos e carros.
verses.RVR09: Estos salieron, y con ellos todos sus ejércitos, pueblo mucho en gran manera, como la arena que está á la orilla del mar, con gran muchedumbre de caballos y carros.

verses.KJV: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
verses.WEB: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.
verses.ASV: And all these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes reis se juntaram, e vindo reuniram os acampamentos junto às águas de Merom, para lutar contra Israel.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos reyes se juntaron, y viniendo reunieron los campos junto á las aguas de Merom, para pelear contra Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them; for to-morrow at this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hock their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR disse a Josué: Não tenhas medo deles, que amanhã a esta hora eu entregarei a todos estes, mortos diante de Israel: a seus cavalos aleijarás, e seus carros queimarás ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová dijo á Josué: No tengas temor de ellos, que mañana á esta hora yo entregaré á todos éstos, muertos delante de Israel: á sus caballos desjarretarás, y sus carros quemarás al fuego.

verses.KJV: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
verses.WEB: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.
verses.ASV: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly, and fell upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Josué, e com ele todo aquele povo de guerra, contra eles, e deu de repente sobre eles junto às águas de Merom.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Josué, y con él todo el pueblo de guerra, contra ellos, y dió de repente sobre ellos junto á las aguas de Merom.

verses.KJV: And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
verses.WEB: The LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they smote them, and chased them unto great Sidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entregou-os o SENHOR em mãos de Israel, os quais os feriram e seguiram até a grande Sidom, e até as águas quentes, e até a planície de Mispá ao oriente, ferindo-os até que não lhes deixaram ninguém.
verses.RVR09: Y entrególos Jehová en manos de Israel, los cuales los hirieron y siguieron hasta Sidón la grande, y hasta las aguas calientes, y hasta el llano de Mizpa al oriente, hiriéndolos hasta que no les dejaron ninguno.

verses.KJV: And Joshua did unto them as the Lord bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
verses.WEB: Joshua did to them as the LORD told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
verses.ASV: And Joshua did unto them as Jehovah bade him: he hocked their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué fez com eles como o SENHOR lhe havia mandado: aleijou seus cavalos, e seus carros queimou ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y Josué hizo con ellos como Jehová le había mandado: desjarretó sus caballos, y sus carros quemó al fuego.

verses.KJV: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.WEB: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.ASV: And Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltando-se Josué, tomou no mesmo tempo a Hazor, e feriu à espada a seu rei: a qual Hazor havia sido antes cabeça de todos estes reinos.
verses.RVR09: Y tornándose Josué, tomó en el mismo tiempo á Hasor, é hirió á cuchillo á su rey: la cual Hasor había sido antes cabeza de todos estos reinos.

verses.KJV: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
verses.WEB: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.
verses.ASV: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them; there was none left that breathed: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E feriram à espada todo quanto nela havia vivo, destruindo e não deixando coisa com vida; e a Hazor puseram a fogo.
verses.RVR09: E hirieron á cuchillo todo cuanto en ella había vivo, destruyendo y no dejando cosa con vida; y á Asor pusieron á fuego.

verses.KJV: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.
verses.WEB: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
verses.ASV: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and he smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them; as Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também tomou Josué todas as cidades destes reis, e a todos os reis delas, e os meteu à espada, e os destruiu, como Moisés servo do SENHOR o havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo tomó Josué todas las ciudades de aquestos reyes, y á todos los reyes de ellas, y los metió á cuchillo, y los destruyó, como Moisés siervo de Jehová lo había mandado.

verses.KJV: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
verses.WEB: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.
verses.ASV: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém todas as cidades que estavam em suas colinas, não as queimou Israel, tirando a só Hazor, a qual queimou Josué.
verses.RVR09: Empero todas las ciudades que estaban en sus cabezos, no las quemó Israel, sacando á sola Asor, la cual quemó Josué.

verses.KJV: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.
verses.ASV: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any that breathed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel tomaram para si todos os despojos e animais daquelas cidades: mas a todos os homens feriram à espada até destruí-los, sem deixar alguém com vida.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Israel tomaron para sí todos los despojos y bestias de aquestas ciudades: pero á todos los hombres metieron á cuchillo hasta destruirlos, sin dejar alguno con vida.

verses.KJV: As the Lord commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: As Jehovah commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua: and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da maneira que o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés seu servo, assim Moisés o mandou a Josué: e assim Josué o fez, sem tirar palavra de tudo o que o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: De la manera que Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés su siervo, así Moisés lo mandó á Josué: y así Josué lo hizo, sin quitar palabra de todo lo que Jehová había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
verses.WEB: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,
verses.ASV: So Joshua took all that land, the hill-country, and all the South, and all the land of Goshen, and the lowland, and the Arabah, and the hill-country of Israel, and the lowland of the same;

verses.RVR09: Tomó pues Josué toda aquella tierra, las montañas, y toda la región del mediodía, y toda la tierra de Gosén, y los bajos y los llanos, y la montaña de Israel y sus valles.

verses.KJV: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
verses.WEB: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o monte de Halaque, que sobe até Seir, até Baal-Gade na planície do Líbano, às raízes do monte Hermom: tomou também todos os seus reis, os quais feriu e matou.
verses.RVR09: Desde el monte de Halac, que sube hasta Seir, hasta Baal-gad en la llanura del Líbano, á las raíces del monte Hermón: tomó asimismo todos sus reyes, los cuales hirió y mató.

verses.KJV: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.WEB: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.ASV: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por muitos dias teve guerra Josué com estes reis.
verses.RVR09: Por muchos días tuvo guerra Josué con estos reyes.

verses.KJV: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
verses.WEB: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.
verses.ASV: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: they took all in battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não houve cidade que fizesse paz com os filhos de Israel, a não ser os heveus, que moravam em Gibeão: tudo o tomaram por guerra.
verses.RVR09: No hubo ciudad que hiciese paz con los hijos de Israel, sacados los Heveos, que moraban en Gabaón: todo lo tomaron por guerra.

verses.KJV: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.WEB: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.ASV: For it was of Jehovah to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque isto veio do SENHOR, que endurecia o coração deles para que resistissem com guerra a Israel, para destruí-los, e que não lhes fosse feita misericórdia, antes fossem desarraigados, como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Porque esto vino de Jehová, que endurecía el corazón de ellos para que resistiesen con guerra á Israel, para destruirlos, y que no les fuese hecha misericordia, antes fuesen desarraigados, como Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés.

verses.KJV: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
verses.WEB: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
verses.ASV: And Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill-country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill-country of Judah, and from all the hill-country of Israel: Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também no mesmo tempo veio Josué e destruiu os anaquins dos montes, de Hebrom, de Debir, e de Anabe, e de todos os montes de Judá, e de todos os montes de Israel: Josué os destruiu a eles e a suas cidades.
verses.RVR09: También en el mismo tiempo vino Josué y destruyó los Anaceos de los montes, de Hebrón, de Debir, y de Anab, y de todos los montes de Judá, y de todos los montes de Israel: Josué los destruyó á ellos y á sus ciudades.

verses.KJV: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
verses.WEB: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.
verses.ASV: There was none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhum dos anaquins restou na terra dos filhos de Israel; somente restaram em Gaza, em Gate, e em Asdode.
verses.RVR09: Ninguno de los Anaceos quedó en la tierra de los hijos de Israel; solamente quedaron en Gaza, en Gath, y en Asdod.

verses.KJV: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
verses.WEB: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
verses.ASV: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Jehovah spake unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land had rest from war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou, pois, Josué toda a terra, conforme todo o que o SENHOR havia dito a Moisés; e entregou-a Josué aos israelitas por herança, conforme suas repartições de suas tribos: e a terra repousou de guerra.
verses.RVR09: Tomó, pues, Josué toda la tierra, conforme á todo lo que Jehová había dicho á Moisés; y entrególa Josué á los Israelitas por herencia, conforme á sus repartimientos de sus tribus: y la tierra reposó de guerra.

verses.KJV: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

verses.KJV: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.WEB: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.ASV: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and [the city that is in] the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.KJV: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

verses.ALMEIDA: Ao sul toda a terra dos cananeus, e Meara que é dos sidônios, até Afeque, até o termo dos amorreus;
verses.RVR09: Al mediodía toda la tierra de los Cananeos, y Mehara que es de los Sidonios, hasta Aphec, hasta el término del Amorrheo;

verses.KJV: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baalgad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
verses.WEB: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;
verses.ASV: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entrance of Hamath;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra dos gebalitas, e todo o Líbano até o oriente, desde Baal-Gade o pdo monte Hermom, até entrar em Hamate;
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra de los Gibleos, y todo el Líbano hacia donde sale el sol, desde Baal-gad á las raíces del monte Hermón, hasta entrar en Hamath;

verses.KJV: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.WEB: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
verses.ASV: all the inhabitants of the hill-country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, even all the Sidonians; them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only allot thou it unto Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que habitam nas montanhas desde o Líbano até as águas quentes, todos os sidônios; eu os desarraigarei diante dos filhos de Israel:;somente repartirás tu por sorte aquela terra aos israelitas por herança, como te mandei.
verses.RVR09: Todos los que habitan en las montañas desde el Líbano hasta las aguas calientes, todos los Sidonios; yo los desarraigaré delante de lo hijos de Israel: solamente repartirás tú por suerte el país á los Israelitas por heredad, como te he mandado.

verses.KJV: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.WEB: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reparte, pois, tu agora esta terra em herança às nove tribos, e à meia tribo de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: Parte, pues, tú ahora esta tierra en heredad á las nueve tribus, y á la media tribu de Manasés.

verses.KJV: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them;
verses.WEB: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:
verses.ASV: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Jehovah gave them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a outra meia recebeu sua herança com os rubenitas e gaditas, a qual lhes deu Moisés da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente, segundo que se a deu Moisés servo do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Porque la otra media recibió su heredad con los Rubenitas y Gaditas, la cual les dió Moisés de la otra parte del Jordán al oriente, según que se la dió Moisés siervo de Jehová:

verses.KJV: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.WEB: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
verses.ASV: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está em meio do ribeiro, e toda a campina de Medeba, até Dibom;
verses.RVR09: Desde Aroer, que está á la orilla del arroyo de Arnón, y la ciudad que está en medio del arroyo, y toda la campiña de Medeba, hasta Dibón;

verses.KJV: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.WEB: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.ASV: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as cidades de Seom rei dos amorreus, o qual reinou em Hesbom, até os termos dos filhos de Amom;
verses.RVR09: Y todas las ciudades de Sehón rey de los Amorrheos, el cual reinó en Hesbón, hasta los términos de los hijos de Ammón;

verses.KJV: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
verses.WEB: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
verses.ASV: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salecah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gileade, e os termos dos gessuritas, e dos maacatitas, e todo o monte de Hermom, e toda a terra de Basã até Salcá:
verses.RVR09: Y Galaad, y los términos de Gessuri y de Maachâti, y todo el monte de Hermón, y toda la tierra de Basán hasta Salchâ:

verses.KJV: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
verses.WEB: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.
verses.ASV: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (the same was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for these did Moses smite, and drove them out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o reino de Ogue em Basã, o qual reinou em Astarote e Edrei, o qual havia ficados do resto dos refains; pois Moisés os feriu, e expulsou.
verses.RVR09: Todo el reino de Og en Basán, el cual reinó en Astaroth y Edrei, el cual había quedado del residuo de los Rapheos; pues Moisés los hirió, y echó.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless the children of Israel drove not out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath dwell in the midst of Israel unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos dos gessuritas e dos maacatitas não expulsaram os filhos de Israel; antes Gessur e Maacate habitaram entre os israelitas até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Mas á los de Gessuri y Maachâti no echaron los hijos de Israel; antes Gessur y Maachât habitaron entre los Israelitas hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: Only unto the tribes of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.WEB: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
verses.ASV: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance; the offerings of Jehovah, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spake unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém à tribo de Levi não deu herança: os sacrifícios do SENHOR Deus de Israel são sua herança, como ele lhes havia dito.
verses.RVR09: Empero á la tribu de Leví no dió heredad: los sacrificios de Jehová Dios de Israel son su heredad, como él les había dicho.

verses.KJV: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
verses.WEB: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
verses.ASV: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deu, pois, Moisés à tribo dos filhos de Rúben conforme suas famílias:
verses.RVR09: Dió, pues, Moisés á la tribu de los hijos de Rubén conforme á sus familias:

verses.KJV: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.WEB: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.ASV: And their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o termo deles desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está em meio do ribeiro, e toda a campina, até Medeba;
verses.RVR09: Y fué el término de ellos desde Aroer, que está á la orilla del arroyo de Arnón, y la ciudad que está en medio del arroyo, y toda la campiña, hasta Medeba;

verses.KJV: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon,
verses.WEB: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
verses.ASV: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hesbom, com todas as suas vilas que estão na planície; Dibom, e Bamote-Baal, e Bete-Baal-Meom;
verses.RVR09: Hesbón, con todas sus villas que están en la llanura; Dibón, y Bamoth-baal, y Beth-baal-meón;

verses.KJV: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.WEB: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
verses.ASV: and Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jaza, e Quedemote, e Mefaate,
verses.RVR09: Y Jaas, y Keddemoth, y Mephaath,

verses.KJV: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.WEB: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.ASV: and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Quiriataim, e Sibma, e Zerete-Saar no monte do vale;
verses.RVR09: Y Chîriataim, y Sibma, y Zerethshahar en el monte del valle;

verses.KJV: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,
verses.WEB: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,
verses.ASV: and Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Bete-Peor, e as encostas de Pisga, e Bete-Jesimote;
verses.RVR09: Y Beth-peor, y Asdoth-pisga, y Beth-jesimoth;

verses.KJV: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.WEB: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.
verses.ASV: and all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, that dwelt in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as cidades da campina, e todo o reino de Seom rei dos amorreus, que reinou em Hesbom, ao qual feriu Moisés, e aos príncipes de Midiã, Evi, Requém, e Sur, e Hur, e Reba, príncipes de Seom que habitavam naquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las ciudades de la campiña, y todo el reino de Sehón rey de los Amorrheos, que reinó en Hesbón, al cual hirió Moisés, y á los príncipes de Madián, Hevi, Recem, y Sur, y Hur, y Reba, príncipes de Sehón que habitaban en aquella tierra.

verses.KJV: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.
verses.ASV: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among the rest of their slain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também mataram à espada os filhos de Israel a Balaão adivinho, filho de Beor, com os demais que mataram.
verses.RVR09: También mataron á cuchillo los hijos de Israel á Balaam adivino, hijo de Beor, con los demás que mataron.

verses.KJV: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.WEB: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.
verses.ASV: And the border of the children of Reuben was the Jordan, and the border [thereof]. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram os termos dos filhos de Rúben o Jordão com seu termo. Esta foi a herança dos filhos de Rúben conforme suas famílias, estas cidades com suas vilas.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron los términos de los hijos de Rubén el Jordán con su término. Esta fué la herencia de los hijos de Rubén conforme á sus familias, estas ciudades con sus villas.

verses.KJV: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.WEB: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.
verses.ASV: And Moses gave unto the tribe of Gad, unto the children of Gad, according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deu também Moisés à tribo de Gade, aos filhos de Gade, conforme suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Dió asimismo Moisés á la tribu de Gad, á los hijos de Gad, conforme á sus familias.

verses.KJV: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.WEB: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;
verses.ASV: And their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o termo deles foi Jazer, e todas as cidades de Gileade, e a metade da terra dos filhos de Amom até Aroer, que está diante de Rabá.
verses.RVR09: Y el término de ellos fué Jacer, y todas las ciudades de Galaad, y la mitad de la tierra de los hijos de Ammón hasta Aroer, que está delante de Rabba.

verses.KJV: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.WEB: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
verses.ASV: and from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.ALMEIDA: E desde Hesbom até Ramate-Mispa, e Betonim; e desde Maanaim até o termo de Debir:
verses.RVR09: Y desde Hesbón hasta Ramathmispe, y Betonim; y desde Mahanaim hasta el término de Debir:

verses.KJV: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
verses.WEB: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
verses.ASV: and in the valley, Beth-haram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan and the border [thereof], unto the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a campina de Bete-Arã, e Bete-Ninra, e Sucote, e Zafom, resto do reino de Seom, rei em Hesbom: o Jordão e seu termo até a extremidade do mar de Quinerete da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente.
verses.RVR09: Y la campiña de Beth-aram, y Beth-nimra, y Sucoth, y Saphón, resto del reino de Sehón, rey en Hesbón: el Jordán y su término hasta el cabo de la mar de Cinnereth de la otra parte del Jordán al oriente.

verses.KJV: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.WEB: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
verses.ASV: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a herança dos filhos de Gade, por suas famílias, estas cidades com suas vilas.
verses.RVR09: Esta es la herencia de los hijos de Gad, por sus familias, estas ciudades con sus villas.

verses.KJV: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.WEB: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
verses.ASV: And Moses gave [inheritance] unto the half-tribe of Manasseh: and it was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também deu Moisés herança à meia tribo de Manassés: e foi da meia tribo dos filhos de Manassés, conforme suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: También dió Moisés herencia á la media tribu de Manasés: y fué de la media tribu de los hijos de Manasés, conforme á sus familias.

verses.KJV: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.WEB: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
verses.ASV: And their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.ALMEIDA: O termo deles foi desde Maanaim, todo Basã, todo o reino de Ogue rei de Basã, e todas as aldeias de Jair que estão em Basã, sessenta povoações.
verses.RVR09: El término de ellos fué desde Mahanaim, todo Basán, todo el reino de Og rey de Basán, y todas las aldeas de Jair que están en Basán, sesenta poblaciones.

verses.KJV: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.WEB: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
verses.ASV: and half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deram-se também a metade de Gileade, e Astarote, e Edrei, cidades do reino de Ogue em Basã, aos filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, à metade dos filhos de Maquir conforme suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Dióse además la mitad de Galaad, y Astaroth, y Edrei, ciudades del reino de Og en Basán, á los hijos de Machîr, hijo de Manasés, á la mitad de los hijos de Machîr conforme á sus familias.

verses.KJV: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.WEB: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
verses.ASV: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto é o que Moisés repartiu em herança nas planícies de Moabe, da outra parte do Jordão de Jericó, ao oriente.
verses.RVR09: Esto es lo que Moisés repartió en heredad en los llanos de Moab, de la otra parte del Jordán de Jericó, al oriente.

verses.KJV: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.WEB: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
verses.ASV: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance: Jehovah, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spake unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas à tribo de Levi não deu Moisés herança: o SENHOR Deus de Israel é a herança deles como ele lhes havia dito.
verses.RVR09: Mas á la tribu de Leví no dió Moisés heredad: Jehová Dios de Israel es la heredad de ellos como él les había dicho.

verses.KJV: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
verses.WEB: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,
verses.ASV: And these are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed unto them,
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto, pois, é o que os filhos de Israel tomaram por herança na terra de Canaã, o qual lhes repartiram Eleazar sacerdote, e Josué filho de Num, e os principais dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: ESTO pues es lo que los hijos de Israel tomaron por heredad en la tierra de Canaán, lo cual les repartieron Eleazar sacerdote, y Josué hijo de Nun, y los principales de los padres de las tribus de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: By lot was their inheritance, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
verses.WEB: by the lot of their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
verses.ASV: by the lot of their inheritance, as Jehovah commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por sorte deu-se a eles sua herança, como o SENHOR o havia mandado por Moisés, que desse às nove tribos e à meia tribo.
verses.RVR09: Por suerte dióseles su heredad, como Jehová lo había mandado por Moisés, que diese á las nueve tribus, y á la media tribu.

verses.KJV: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
verses.WEB: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
verses.ASV: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque às duas tribos, e à meia tribo, lhes havia Moisés dado herança da outra parte do Jordão: mas aos levitas não deu herança entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Porque á las dos tribus, y á la media tribu, les había Moisés dado heredad de la otra parte del Jordán: mas á los Levitas no dió heredad entre ellos.

verses.KJV: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
verses.WEB: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.
verses.ASV: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: and they gave no portion unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for their cattle and for their substance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os filhos de José foram duas tribos, Manassés e Efraim: e não deram parte aos levitas na terra, mas sim cidades em que morassem, com seus campos para seus gados e rebanhos.
verses.RVR09: Porque los hijos de José fueron dos tribus, Manasés y Ephraim: y no dieron parte á los Levitas en la tierra, sino ciudades en que morasen, con sus ejidos para sus ganados y rebaños.

verses.KJV: As the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
verses.ASV: As Jehovah commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did; and they divided the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da maneira que o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés, assim o fizeram os filhos de Israel na repartição da terra.
verses.RVR09: De la manera que Jehová lo había mandado á Moisés, así lo hicieron los hijos de Israel en el repartimiento de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the Lord said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
verses.WEB: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.
verses.ASV: Then the children of Judah drew nigh unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that Jehovah spake unto Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning thee in Kadesh-barnea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Judá vieram a Josué em Gilgal; e Calebe, filho de Jefoné quenezeu, lhe disse: Tu sabes o que o SENHOR disse a Moisés, homem de Deus, em Cades-Barneia, tocante a mim e a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Judá vinieron á Josué en Gilgal; y Caleb, hijo de Jephone Cenezeo, le dijo: Tú sabes lo que Jehová dijo á Moisés, varón de Dios, en Cades-barnea, tocante á mí y á ti.

verses.KJV: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
verses.WEB: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
verses.ASV: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of Jehovah sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu era de idade de quarenta anos, quando Moisés servo do SENHOR me enviou de Cades-Barneia a reconhecer a terra; e eu lhe mencionei o negócio como o tinha em meu coração:
verses.RVR09: Yo era de edad de cuarenta años, cuando Moisés siervo de Jehová me envió de Cades-barnea á reconocer la tierra; y yo le referí el negocio como lo tenía en mi corazón:

verses.KJV: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Jehovah my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas meus irmãos, os que haviam subido comigo, minguaram o coração do povo; porém eu cumpri seguindo ao SENHOR meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas mis hermanos, los que habían subido conmigo, menguaron el corazón del pueblo; empero yo cumplí siguiendo á Jehová mi Dios.

verses.KJV: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.WEB: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’
verses.ASV: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy foot hath trodden shall be an inheritance to thee and to thy children for ever, because thou hast wholly followed Jehovah my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Moisés jurou, dizendo: Se a terra que pisou teu pé não for para ti, e para teus filhos em herança perpétua: porquanto cumpriste seguindo ao SENHOR meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Moisés juró, diciendo: Si la tierra que holló tu pie no fuere para ti, y para tus hijos en herencia perpetua: por cuanto cumpliste siguiendo á Jehová mi Dios.

verses.KJV: And now, behold, the Lord hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the Lord spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
verses.WEB: “Now, behold, the LORD has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.
verses.ASV: And now, behold, Jehovah hath kept me alive, as he spake, these forty and five years, from the time that Jehovah spake this word unto Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora bem, o SENHOR me fez viver, como ele disse, estes quarenta e cinco anos, desde o tempo que o SENHOR falou estas palavras a Moisés, quando Israel andava pelo deserto: e agora, eis que sou hoje dia de oitenta e cinco anos:
verses.RVR09: Ahora bien, Jehová me ha hecho vivir, como él dijo, estos cuarenta y cinco años, desde el tiempo que Jehová habló estas palabras á Moisés, cuando Israel andaba por el desierto: y ahora, he aquí, soy hoy día de ochenta y cinco años:

verses.KJV: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
verses.WEB: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.
verses.ASV: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, and to go out and to come in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ainda hoje estou tão forte como o dia que Moisés me enviou: qual era então minha força, tal é agora, para a guerra, e para sair e para entrar.
verses.RVR09: Pero aun hoy estoy tan fuerte como el día que Moisés me envió: cual era entonces mi fuerza, tal es ahora, para la guerra, y para salir y para entrar.

verses.KJV: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the Lord spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the Lord will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the Lord said.
verses.WEB: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which the LORD spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that the LORD will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as the LORD said.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore give me this hill-country, whereof Jehovah spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakim were there, and cities great and fortified: it may be that Jehovah will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Jehovah spake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-me, pois, agora este monte, do qual falou o SENHOR aquele dia; porque tu ouviste naquele dia que os anaquins estão ali, e grandes e fortes cidades. Talvez o SENHOR seja comigo, e os expulsarei como o SENHOR disse.
verses.RVR09: Dame, pues, ahora este monte, del cual habló Jehová aquel día; porque tú oiste en aquel día que los Anaceos están allí, y grandes y fuertes ciudades. Quizá Jehová será conmigo, y los echaré como Jehová ha dicho.

verses.KJV: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
verses.WEB: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
verses.ASV: And Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Josué então lhe abençoou, e deu a Calebe filho de Jefoné a Hebrom por herança.
verses.RVR09: Josué entonces le bendijo, y dió á Caleb hijo de Jephone á Hebrón por heredad.

verses.KJV: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.
verses.WEB: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.
verses.ASV: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite unto this day; because that he wholly followed Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto Hebrom foi de Calebe, filho de Jefoné quenezeu, em herança até hoje; porque cumpriu seguindo ao SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto Hebrón fué de Caleb, hijo de Jephone Cenezeo, en heredad hasta hoy; porque cumplió siguiendo á Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
verses.WEB: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.
verses.ASV: Now the name of Hebron beforetime was Kiriath-arba; [which Arba was] the greatest man among the Anakim. And the land had rest from war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Hebrom foi antes chamada Quiriate-Arba; foi Arba um homem grande entre os anaquins. E a terra teve repouso das guerras.
verses.RVR09: Mas Hebrón fué antes llamada Chîriath-arba; fué Arba un hombre grande entre los Anaceos. Y la tierra tuvo reposo de las guerras.

verses.KJV: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
verses.WEB: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
verses.ASV: And the lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was unto the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a sorte da tribo dos filhos de Judá, por suas famílias, junto ao termo de Edom, do deserto de Zim ao sul, ao lado do sul.
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ la suerte de la tribu de los hijos de Judá, por sus familias, junto al término de Edom, del desierto de Zin al mediodía, al lado del sur.

verses.KJV: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
verses.WEB: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;
verses.ASV: And their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looketh southward;
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu termo da parte do sul foi desde a costa do mar Salgado, desde a baía que está voltada ao sul;
verses.RVR09: Y su término de la parte del mediodía fué desde la costa del mar Salado, desde la lengua que mira hacia el mediodía;

verses.KJV: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
verses.WEB: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;
verses.ASV: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh-barnea, and passed along by Hezron, and went up to Addar, and turned about to Karka;
verses.ALMEIDA: E saía até o sul à subida de Acrabim, passando até Zim; e subindo pelo sul até Cades-Barneia, passava a Hebrom, e subindo por Adar dava volta a Carca;
