verses.RVR09: Y salía hacia el mediodía á la subida de Acrabim, pasando hasta Zin; y subiendo por el mediodía hasta Cades-barnea, pasaba á Hebrón, y subiendo por Addar daba vuelta á Carca;

verses.KJV: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
verses.WEB: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.
verses.ASV: and it passed along to Azmon, and went out at the brook of Egypt; and the goings out of the border were at the sea: this shall be your south border.
verses.ALMEIDA: De ali passava a Azmom, e saía ao ribeiro do Egito; e sai este termo ao ocidente. Este pois vos será o termo do sul.
verses.RVR09: De allí pasaba á Azmón, y salía al arroyo de Egipto; y sale este término al occidente. Este pues os será el término del mediodía.

verses.KJV: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
verses.WEB: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And the east border was the Salt Sea, even unto the end of the Jordan. And the border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan;
verses.ALMEIDA: O termo do oriente é o mar Salgado até o fim do Jordão. E o termo da parte do norte, desde a baía do mar, desde o fim do Jordão:
verses.RVR09: El término del oriente es el mar Salado hasta el fin del Jordán. Y el término de la parte del norte, desde la lengua del mar, desde el fin del Jordán:

verses.KJV: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
verses.WEB: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.ASV: and the border went up to Beth-hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sobe este termo por Bete-Hogla, e passa do norte a Bete-Arabá, e daqui sobe este termo à pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben.
verses.RVR09: Y sube este término por Beth-hogla, y pasa del norte á Beth-araba, y de aquí sube este término á la piedra de Bohán, hijo de Rubén.

verses.KJV: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:
verses.WEB: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
verses.ASV: and the border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is over against the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river; and the border passed along to the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel;
verses.ALMEIDA: E torna a subir este termo a Debir desde o vale de Acor: e ao norte olha sobre Gilgal, que está diante da subida de Adumim, a qual está ao sul do ribeiro: e passa este termo às águas de En-Semes, e sai à fonte de Rogel:
verses.RVR09: Y torna á subir este término á Debir desde el valle de Achôr: y al norte mira sobre Gilgal, que está delante de la subida de Adumin, la cual está al mediodía del arroyo: y pasa este término á las aguas de En-semes, y sale á la fuente de Rogel:

verses.KJV: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
verses.WEB: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.
verses.ASV: and the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the side of the Jebusite southward (the same is Jerusalem); and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the uttermost part of the vale of Rephaim northward;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sobe este termo pelo vale do filho de Hinom ao lado dos jebuseus ao sul: esta é Jerusalém. Logo sobe este termo pelo cume do monte que está diante do vale de Hinom até o ocidente, o qual está ao fim do vale dos gigantes ao norte;
verses.RVR09: Y sube este término por el valle del hijo de Hinnom al lado del Jebuseo al mediodía: esta es Jerusalem. Luego sube este término por la cumbre del monte que está delante del valle de Hinnom hacia el occidente, el cual está al cabo del valle de los gigantes al norte:

verses.KJV: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:
verses.WEB: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);
verses.ASV: and the border extended from the top of the mountain unto the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (the same is Kiriath-jearim);
verses.ALMEIDA: E rodeia este termo desde o cume do monte até a fonte das águas de Neftoa, e sai às cidades do monte de Efrom, rodeando logo o mesmo termo a Baalá, a qual é Quriate-Jearim.
verses.RVR09: Y rodea este término desde la cumbre del monte hasta la fuente de las aguas de Nephtoa, y sale á la ciudades del monte de Ephrón, rodeando luego el mismo término á Baala, la cual es Chîriath-jearim.

verses.KJV: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
verses.WEB: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;
verses.ASV: and the border turned about from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim on the north (the same is Chesalon), and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois torna este termo desde Baalá até o ocidente ao monte de Seir: e passa ao lado do monte de Jearim até o norte, esta é Quesalom, e desce a Bete-Semes, e passa a Timna.
verses.RVR09: Después torna este término desde Baala hacia el occidente al monte de Seir: y pasa al lado del monte de Jearim hacia el norte, esta es Chesalón, y desciende á Beth-semes, y pasa á Timna.

verses.KJV: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.WEB: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.ASV: and the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sai logo este termo ao lado de Ecrom até o norte; e rodeia o mesmo termo a Sicrom, e passa pelo monte de Baalá, e sai a Jabneel: e sai este termo ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Sale luego este término al lado de Ecrón hacia el norte; y rodea el mismo término á Sichêron, y pasa por el monte de Baala, y sale á Jabneel: y sale este término á la mar.

verses.KJV: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.WEB: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.ASV: And the west border was to the great sea, and the border [thereof]. This is the border of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: O termo do ocidente é o mar grande. Este, pois, é o termo dos filhos de Judá em derredor, por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: El término del occidente es la mar grande. Este pues, es el término de los hijos de Judá en derredor, por sus familias.

verses.KJV: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
verses.WEB: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).
verses.ASV: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Jehovah to Joshua, even Kiriath-arba, [which Arba was] the father of Anak (the same is Hebron).
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, deu parte entre os filhos de Judá, conforme o mandamento do SENHOR a Josué: isto é, a Quiriate-Arba, do pai de Anaque, que é Hebrom.
verses.RVR09: Mas á Caleb, hijo de Jephone, dió parte entre los hijos de Judá, conforme al mandamiento de Jehová á Josué: esto es, á Chîriath-arba, del padre de Anac, que es Hebrón.

verses.KJV: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.WEB: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.ASV: And Caleb drove out thence the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Calebe expulsou dali três filhos de Anaque, a Sesai, Aimã, e Talmai, filhos de Anaque.
verses.RVR09: Y Caleb echó de allí tres hijos de Anac, á Sesai, Aiman, y Talmai, hijos de Anac.

verses.KJV: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
verses.WEB: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.
verses.ASV: And he went up thence against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir beforetime was Kiriath-sepher.
verses.ALMEIDA: De aqui subiu aos que moravam em Debir: e o nome de Debir era antes Quiriate-Sefer.
verses.RVR09: De aquí subió á los que moraban en Debir: y el nombre de Debir era antes Chîriath-sepher.

verses.KJV: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.WEB: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”
verses.ASV: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kiriath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Calebe: Ao que ferir a Quiriate-Sefer, e a tomar, eu lhe darei a minha filha Acsa por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Caleb: Al que hiriere á Chîriath-sepher, y la tomare, yo le daré á mi hija Axa por mujer.

verses.KJV: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.WEB: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
verses.ASV: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou-a Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão de Calebe; e ele lhe deu por mulher a sua filha Acsa.
verses.RVR09: Y tomóla Othoniel, hijo de Cenez, hermano de Caleb; y él le dió por mujer á su hija Axa.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
verses.WEB: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when she came [unto him], that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she alighted from off her ass; and Caleb said, What wouldest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando a levava, ele a persuadiu que pedisse a seu pai terras para lavrar. Ela então desceu do asno. E Calebe lhe disse: Que tens?
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que cuando la llevaba, él la persuadió que pidiese á su padre tierras para labrar. Ella entonces se apeó del asno. Y Caleb le dijo: ¿Qué tienes?

verses.KJV: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
verses.WEB: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.ASV: And she said, Give me a blessing; for that thou hast set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela respondeu: Dá-me bênção; pois me deste terra de secura, dá-me também fontes de águas. Ele então lhe deu as fontes de acima, e as de abaixo.
verses.RVR09: Y ella respondió: Dame bendición: pues que me has dado tierra de secadal, dame también fuentes de aguas. El entonces le dió las fuentes de arriba, y las de abajo.

verses.KJV: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.WEB: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.ASV: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta, pois é a herança das tribos dos filhos de Judá por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Esta pues es la herencia de la tribu de los hijos de Judá por sus familias.

verses.KJV: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.WEB: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
verses.ASV: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram as cidades do termo da tribo dos filhos de Judá até o termo de Edom ao sul: Cabzeel, e Éder, e Jagur,
verses.RVR09: Y fueron las ciudades del término de la tribu de los hijos de Judá hacia el término de Edom al mediodía: Cabseel, y Eder, y Jagur,

verses.KJV: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.WEB: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
verses.ASV: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Quiná, e Dimona, e Adada,
verses.RVR09: Y Cina, y Dimona, y Adada,

verses.KJV: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.WEB: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
verses.ASV: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Quedes, e Hazor, e Itnã,
verses.RVR09: Y Cedes, y Asor, é Itnán,

verses.KJV: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
verses.WEB: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
verses.ASV: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Zife, e Telém, Bealote,
verses.RVR09: Ziph, y Telem, y Bealoth,

verses.KJV: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
verses.WEB: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),
verses.ASV: and Hazor-hadattah, and Kerioth-hezron (the same is Hazor),
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hazor-Hadata, e Queriote-Hezrom, que é Hazor,
verses.RVR09: Y Asor-hadatta, y Chêrioth-hesron, que es Asor,

verses.KJV: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
verses.WEB: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
verses.ASV: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Amã, e Sema, e Moladá,
verses.RVR09: Amam, y Sema, y Molada,

verses.KJV: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
verses.WEB: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
verses.ASV: and Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-pelet,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hazar-Gada, e Hesmom, e Bete-Pelete,
verses.RVR09: Y Asar-gadda, y Hesmón, y Beth-pelet,

verses.KJV: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
verses.WEB: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
verses.ASV: and Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Biziothiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hazar-Sual, Berseba, e Biziotiá,
verses.RVR09: Y Hasar-sual, Beersebah, y Bizotia,

verses.KJV: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
verses.WEB: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
verses.ASV: Baalah, and Iim, and Ezem,
verses.ALMEIDA: Baalá, e Iim, e Azém,
verses.RVR09: Baala, é Iim, y Esem,

verses.KJV: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.WEB: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
verses.ASV: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eltolade, e Quesil, e Hormá,
verses.RVR09: Y Eltolad, y Cesil, y Horma,

verses.KJV: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.WEB: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
verses.ASV: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ziclague, e Madmana, Sansana,
verses.RVR09: Y Siclag, y Madmanna, Sansana,

verses.KJV: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
verses.WEB: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Lebaote, Silim, e Aim, e Rimom; em todas vinte e nove cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y Lebaoth, Silim, y Aín, y Rimmón; en todas veintinueve ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
verses.WEB: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
verses.ASV: In the lowland, Eshtaol, and Zorah, and Ashnah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nas planícies, Estaol, e Zorá, e Asná,
verses.RVR09: En las llanuras, Estaol, y Sorea, y Asena,

verses.KJV: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.WEB: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
verses.ASV: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zanoa, e En-Ganim, Tapua, e Enã,
verses.RVR09: Y Zanoa, y Engannim, Tappua, y Enam,

verses.KJV: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.WEB: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
verses.ASV: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Jeremote, e Adulão, Socó, e Azeca,
verses.RVR09: Jerimoth, y Adullam, Sochô, y Aceca,

verses.KJV: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saaraim, e Aditaim, e Gederá, e Gederotaim; catorze cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y Saraim, y Adithaim, y Gedera, y Gederothaim; catorce ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
verses.WEB: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,
verses.ASV: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,
verses.ALMEIDA: Zenã, e Hadasa, e Migdal-Gade,
verses.RVR09: Senán, y Hadasa, y Migdalgad,

verses.KJV: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.WEB: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
verses.ASV: and Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Dileã, e Mispá, e Jocteel,
verses.RVR09: Y Dilán, y Mizpa, y Jocteel,

verses.KJV: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
verses.WEB: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
verses.ASV: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Laquis, e Bozcate, e Eglom,
verses.RVR09: Lachîs, y Boscath, y Eglón,

verses.KJV: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
verses.WEB: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,
verses.ASV: and Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Chitlish,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Cabom, e Laamás, e Quitilis,
verses.RVR09: Y Cabón, y Lamas, y Chîtlis,

verses.KJV: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gederote, Bete-Dagom, e Naamá, e Maquedá; dezesseis cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y Gederoh, Beth-dagón, y Naama, y Maceda; dieciséis ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
verses.WEB: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
verses.ASV: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Libna, e Eter, e Asã,
verses.RVR09: Libna, y Ether, y Asán,

verses.KJV: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.WEB: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
verses.ASV: and Iphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Iftá, e Asná, e Nezibe,
verses.RVR09: Y Jiphta, y Asna, y Nesib,

verses.KJV: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Queila, e Aczibe, e Maressa; nove cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y Ceila, y Achzib, y Maresa; nueve ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
verses.WEB: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;
verses.ASV: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ecrom com suas vilas e suas aldeias:
verses.RVR09: Ecrón con sus villas y sus aldeas:

verses.KJV: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
verses.WEB: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.
verses.ASV: from Ekron even unto the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde Ecrom até o mar, todas as que estão à costa de Asdode com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Desde Ecrón hasta la mar, todas las que están á la costa de Asdod con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
verses.WEB: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.
verses.ASV: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; unto the brook of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border [thereof].
verses.ALMEIDA: Asdode com suas vilas e suas aldeias: Gaza com suas vilas e suas aldeias até o rio do Egito, e o grande mar com seus termos.
verses.RVR09: Asdod con sus villas y sus aldeas: Gaza con sus villas y sus aldeas hasta el río de Egipto, y la gran mar con sus términos.

verses.KJV: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.WEB: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
verses.ASV: And in the hill-country, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.ALMEIDA: E nas montanhas, Samir, e Jatir, e Sucote,
verses.RVR09: Y en las montañas, Samir, y Jattir, y Succoth,

verses.KJV: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
verses.WEB: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),
verses.ASV: and Dannah, and Kiriath-sannah (the same is Debir),
verses.ALMEIDA: E Dana, e Quiriate-Saná, que é Debir,
verses.RVR09: Y Danna, y Chîriath-sanna, que es Debir,

verses.KJV: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.WEB: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
verses.ASV: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Anabe, e Estemo, e Anim,
verses.RVR09: Y Anab, y Estemo, y Anim,

verses.KJV: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gósen, e Holom, e Gilo; onze cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y Gosén, y Olón, y Gilo; once ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
verses.WEB: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
verses.ASV: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Arabe, e Dumá, e Esã,
verses.RVR09: Arab, y Dumah, y Esán,

verses.KJV: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,
verses.WEB: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
verses.ASV: and Janim, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Janim, e Bete-Tapua, e Afeca,
verses.RVR09: Y Janum, y Beth-tappua, y Apheca,

verses.KJV: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Humtah, and Kiriath-arba (the same is Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hunta, e Quiriate-Arba, que é Hebrom, e Zior; nove cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y Humta, y Chîriath-arba, que es Hebrón, y Sior; nueve ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
verses.WEB: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,
verses.ASV: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Jutah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Maom, Carmelo, e Zife, e Jutá,
verses.RVR09: Maón, Carmel, y Ziph, y Juta,

verses.KJV: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
verses.WEB: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
verses.ASV: and Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jezreel, Jocdeão, e Zanoa,
verses.RVR09: E Izreel, Jocdeam, y Zanoa,

verses.KJV: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caim, Gibeá, e Timna; dez cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Caín, Gibea, y Timna; diez ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
verses.WEB: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
verses.ASV: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,
verses.ALMEIDA: Halul, e Bete-Zur, e Gedor,
verses.RVR09: Halhul, y Bethfur, y Gedor,

verses.KJV: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Maarate, e Bete-Anote, e Eltecom; seis cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y Maarath, y Beth-anoth, y Eltecón; seis ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: Kiriath-baal (the same is Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quriate-Baal, que é Quriate-Jearim, e Rabá; duas cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Chîriath-baal, que es Chîriath-jearim, y Rabba; dos ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.WEB: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,
verses.ASV: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.ALMEIDA: No deserto, Bete-Arabá, Midim, e Secacá,
verses.RVR09: En el desierto, Beth-araba, Middín, y Sechâchâ,

verses.KJV: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.WEB: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Nibshan, and the City of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Nibsã, e a cidade do sal, e En-Gedi; seis cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y Nibsan, y la ciudad de la sal, y Engedi; seis ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.WEB: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
verses.ASV: And as for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos jebuseus que habitavam em Jerusalém, os filhos de Judá não os puderam desarraigar; antes restaram os jebuseus em Jerusalém com os filhos de Judá, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Mas á los Jebuseos que habitaban en Jerusalem, los hijos de Judá no los pudieron desarraigar; antes quedó el Jebuseo en Jerusalem con los hijos de Judá, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,
verses.WEB: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.
verses.ASV: And the lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill-country to Beth-el;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a porção dos filhos de José saiu desde o Jordão de Jericó até as águas de Jericó até o oriente, ao deserto que sobe de Jericó ao monte de Betel:
verses.RVR09: Y LA suerte del los hijos de José salió desde el Jordán de Jericó hasta las aguas de Jericó hacia el oriente, al desierto que sube de Jericó al monte de Beth-el:

verses.KJV: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
verses.WEB: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
verses.ASV: and it went out from Beth-el to Luz, and passed along unto the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Betel sai a Luz, e passa ao termo dos arquitas em Atarote;
verses.RVR09: Y de Beth-el sale á Luz, y pasa al término de Archi en Ataroth;

verses.KJV: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer; and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
verses.WEB: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.
verses.ASV: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, unto the border of Beth-horon the nether, even unto Gezer; and the goings out thereof were at the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E torna a descer até o mar ao termo dos jafletitas, até o termo de Bete-Horom a de abaixo, e até Gezer; e sai ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Y torna á descender hacia la mar al término de Japhlet, hasta el término de Beth-oron la de abajo, y hasta Gezer; y sale á la mar.

verses.KJV: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.WEB: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.ASV: And the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Receberam, pois, herança os filhos de José, Manassés e Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Recibieron pues heredad los hijos de José, Manasés y Ephraim.

verses.KJV: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
verses.WEB: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.
verses.ASV: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was [thus]: the border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o termo dos filhos de Efraim por suas famílias, foi o termo de sua herança à parte oriental, desde Atarote-Adar até Bete-Horom a de acima:
verses.RVR09: Y fué el término de los hijos de Ephraim por sus familias, fué el término de su herencia á la parte oriental, desde Ataroth-addar hasta Beth-oron la de arriba:

verses.KJV: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
verses.WEB: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.
verses.ASV: and the border went out westward at Michmethath on the north; and the border turned about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sai este termo ao mar, e a Micmetá ao norte, e dá volta este termo até o oriente a Taanate-Siló, e daqui passa ao oriente a Janoa:
verses.RVR09: Y sale este término á la mar, y á Michmetat al norte, y da vuelta este término hacia el oriente á Tanath-silo, y de aquí pasa del oriente á Janoa:

verses.KJV: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
verses.WEB: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
verses.ASV: and it went down from Janoah to Ataroth, and to Naarah, and reached unto Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Janoa desce a Atarote, e a Naarate, e cabe em Jericó, e sai ao Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Y de Janoa desciende á Ataroth, y á Naaratha, y toca en Jericó, y sale al Jordán.

verses.KJV: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
verses.WEB: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
verses.ASV: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Tapua torna este termo até o mar ao ribeiro de Caná, e sai ao mar. Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Efraim por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Y de Tappua torna este término hacia la mar al arroyo de Cana, y sale á la mar. Esta es la heredad de la tribu de los hijos de Ephraim por sus familias.

verses.KJV: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.WEB: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: houve também cidades que se apartaram para os filhos de Efraim em meio da herança dos filhos de Manassés, todas cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Hubo también ciudades que se apartaron para los hijos de Ephraim en medio de la herencia de los hijos de Manasés, todas ciudades con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
verses.WEB: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.
verses.ASV: And they drove not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell in the midst of Ephraim unto this day, and are become servants to do taskwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não expulsaram aos cananeus que habitavam em Gezer; antes restaram os cananeus em meio de Efraim, até hoje, e foram tributários.
verses.RVR09: Y no echaron al Cananeo que habitaba en Gezer; antes quedó el Cananeo en medio de Ephraim, hasta hoy, y fué tributario.

verses.KJV: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.WEB: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.ASV: And [this] was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the first-born of Joseph. As for Machir the first-born of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teve também porção a tribo de Manassés, porque foi primogênito de José. Maquir, primogênito de Manassés, e pai de Gileade, o qual foi homem de guerra, teve a Gileade e a Basã.
verses.RVR09: Y TUVO también suerte la tribu de Manasés, porque fué primogénito de José. Machîr, primogénito de Manasés, y padre de Galaad, el cual fué hombre de guerra, tuvo á Galaad y á Basán.

verses.KJV: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
verses.WEB: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
verses.ASV: So [the lot] was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tiveram também porção os outros filhos de Manassés conforme suas famílias: os filhos de Abiezer, e os filhos de Helebe, e os filhos de Asriel, e os filhos de Siquém, e os filhos de Héfer, e os filhos de Semida; estes foram os filhos homens de Manassés, filho de José, por suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Tuvieron también suerte los otros hijos de Manasés conforme á sus familias: los hijos de Abiezer, y los hijos de Helec, y los hijos de Esriel, y los hijos de Sichêm, y los hijos de Hepher, y los hijos de Semida; estos fueron los hijos varones de Manasés hijo de José, por sus familias.

verses.KJV: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.WEB: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.ASV: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Zelofeade, filho de Héfer, filho de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, não teve filhos, somente filhas, os nomes das quais são estes: Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca, e Tirza.
verses.RVR09: Pero Salphaad, hijo de Hepher, hijo de Galaad, hijo de Machîr, hijo de Manasés, no tuvo hijos, sino hijas, los nombres de las cuales son estos: Maala, Noa, Hogla, Milchâ, y Tirsa.

verses.KJV: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.WEB: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
verses.ASV: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, Jehovah commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren: therefore according to the commandment of Jehovah he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas vieram diante de Eleazar sacerdote, e de Josué filho de Num, e dos príncipes, e disseram: O SENHOR mandou a Moisés que nos desse herança entre nossos irmãos. E ele lhes deu herança entre os irmãos do pai delas, conforme o dito do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Estas vinieron delante de Eleazar sacerdote, y de Josué hijo de Nun, y de los príncipes, y dijeron: Jehová mandó á Moisés que nos diese herencia entre nuestros hermanos. Y él les dió herencia entre los hermanos del padre de ellas, conforme al dicho de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
verses.WEB: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
verses.ASV: And there fell ten parts to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
verses.ALMEIDA: E caíram a Manassés dez porções a mais da terra de Gileade e de Basã, que está da outra parte do Jordão:
verses.RVR09: Y cayeron á Manasés diez suertes á más de la tierra de Galaad y de Basán, que está de la otra parte del Jordán:

verses.KJV: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
verses.WEB: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
verses.ASV: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged unto the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque as filhas de Manassés possuíram herança entre seus filhos: e a terra de Gileade foi dos outros filhos de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: Porque las hijas de Manasés poseyeron herencia entre sus hijos: y la tierra de Galaad fué de los otros hijos de Manasés.

verses.KJV: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
verses.WEB: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
verses.ASV: And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem; and the border went along to the right hand, unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o termo de Manassés desde Aser até Micmetá, a qual está diante de Siquém; e vai este termo à direita, aos que habitam em Tapua.
verses.RVR09: Y fué el término de Manasés desde Aser hasta Michmetat, la cual está delante de Sichêm; y va este término á la mano derecha, á los que habitan en Tappua.

verses.KJV: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
verses.WEB: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
verses.ASV: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra de Tapua foi de Manassés; mas Tapua, que está junto ao termo de Manassés, é dos filhos de Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra de Tappua fué de Manasés; pero Tappua, que está junto al término de Manasés, es de los hijos de Ephraim.

verses.KJV: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
verses.WEB: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.
verses.ASV: And the border went down unto the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook: these cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh: and the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and the goings out thereof were at the sea:
verses.ALMEIDA: E desce este termo ao ribeiro de Caná, até o sul do ribeiro. Estas cidades de Efraim estão entre as cidades de Manassés: e o termo de Manassés é desde o norte do mesmo ribeiro, e suas saídas são ao mar.
verses.RVR09: Y desciende este término al arroyo de Cana, hacia el mediodía del arroyo. Estas ciudades de Ephraim están entre las ciudades de Manasés: y el término de Manasés es desde el norte del mismo arroyo, y sus salidas son á la mar.

verses.KJV: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
verses.WEB: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
verses.ASV: southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border; and they reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
verses.ALMEIDA: Efraim ao sul, e Manassés ao norte, e o mar é seu termo: e encontram-se com Aser à parte do norte, e com Issacar ao oriente.
verses.RVR09: Ephraim al mediodía, y Manasés al norte, y la mar es su término: y encuéntranse con Aser á la parte del norte, y con Issachâr al oriente.

verses.KJV: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
verses.WEB: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.
verses.ASV: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns, even the three heights.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teve também Manassés em Issacar e em Aser a Bete-Seã e suas aldeias, e Ibleão e suas aldeias, e os moradores de Dor e suas aldeias, e os moradores de En-Dor e suas aldeias, e os moradores de Taanaque e suas aldeias, e os moradores de Megido e suas aldeias: três províncias.
verses.RVR09: Tuvo también Manasés en Issachâr y en Aser á Beth-san y sus aldeas, é Ibleam y sus aldeas, y los moradores de Dor y sus aldeas, y los moradores de Endor y sus aldeas, y los moradores de Taanach y sus aldeas, y los moradores de Megiddo y sus aldeas: tres provincias.

verses.KJV: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.WEB: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.ASV: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out [the inhabitants of] those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os filhos de Manassés não puderam lançar aos daquelas cidades; antes os cananeus quis habitar na terra.
verses.RVR09: Mas los hijos de Manasés no pudieron echar á los de aquellas ciudades; antes el Cananeo quiso habitar en la tierra.

verses.KJV: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.WEB: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxed strong, that they put the Canaanites to taskwork, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando os filhos de Israel tomaram forças, fizeram tributários aos cananeus, mas não o expulsaram.
verses.RVR09: Empero cuando los hijos de Israel tomaron fuerzas, hicieron tributario al Cananeo, mas no lo echaron.

verses.KJV: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the Lord hath blessed me hitherto?
verses.WEB: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”
verses.ASV: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one part for an inheritance, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as hitherto Jehovah hath blessed me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de José falaram a Josué, dizendo: Por que me deste por herança uma só porção e uma só parte, sendo eu um povo tão grande e que o SENHOR me abençoou assim até agora?
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de José hablaron á Josué, diciendo: ¿Por qué me has dado por heredad una sola suerte y una sola parte, siendo yo un pueblo tan grande y que Jehová me ha así bendecido hasta ahora?

verses.KJV: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
verses.WEB: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”
verses.ASV: And Joshua said unto them, If thou be a great people, get thee up to the forest, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim; since the hill-country of Ephraim is too narrow for thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué lhes respondeu: Se és povo tão grande, sobe tu ao monte, e corta para ti ali na terra do ferezeus e dos gigantes, pois que o monte de Efraim é estreito para ti.
verses.RVR09: Y Josué les respondió: Si eres pueblo tan grande, sube tú al monte, y corta para ti allí en la tierra del Pherezeo y de los gigantes, pues que el monte de Ephraim es angosto para ti.

verses.KJV: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
verses.WEB: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”
verses.ASV: And the children of Joseph said, The hill-country is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are in Beth-shean and its towns, and they who are in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de José disseram: Não nos bastará a nós este monte: e todos os cananeus que habitam a terra da campina, têm carros de ferro; os que estão em Bete-Seã e em suas aldeias, e os que estão no vale de Jezreel.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de José dijeron: No nos bastará á nosotros este monte: y todos los Cananeos que habitan la tierra de la campiña, tienen carros herrados; los que están en Beth-san y en sus aldeas, y los que están en el valle de Jezreel.

verses.KJV: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
verses.WEB: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;
verses.ASV: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power; thou shalt not have one lot only:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Josué respondeu à casa de José, a Efraim e Manassés, dizendo: Tu és grande povo, e tens grande força; não terás uma só porção;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Josué respondió á la casa de José, á Ephraim y Manasés, diciendo: Tú eres gran pueblo, y tienes gran fuerza; no tendrás una sola suerte;

verses.KJV: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
verses.WEB: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”
verses.ASV: but the hill-country shall be thine; for though it is a forest, thou shalt cut it down, and the goings out thereof shall be thine; for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele monte será teu; porque é bosque, e tu o cortarás, e serão teus seus termos: porque tu expulsarás aos cananeus, ainda que tenham carros de ferro, e ainda que sejam fortes.
verses.RVR09: Mas aquel monte será tuyo; que bosque es, y tú lo cortarás, y serán tuyos sus términos: porque tú echarás al Cananeo, aunque tenga carros herrados, y aunque sea fuerte.

verses.KJV: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
verses.WEB: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
verses.ASV: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the tent of meeting there: and the land was subdued before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel se juntou em Siló, e assentaram ali o tabernáculo do testemunho, depois que a terra lhes foi sujeita.
verses.RVR09: Y TODA la congregación de los hijos de Israel se juntó en Silo, y asentaron allí el tabernáculo del testimonio, después que la tierra les fué sujeta.

verses.KJV: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.WEB: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
verses.ASV: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas haviam restado nos filhos de Israel sete tribos, às quais ainda não haviam repartido sua possessão.
verses.RVR09: Mas habían quedado en los hijos de Israel siete tribus, á las cuales aun no habían repartido su posesión.

verses.KJV: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?
verses.WEB: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
verses.ASV: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go in to possess the land, which Jehovah, the God of your fathers, hath given you?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué disse aos filhos de Israel: Até quando sereis negligentes para vir a possuir a terra que vos deu o SENHOR o Deus de vossos pais?
verses.RVR09: Y Josué dijo á los hijos de Israel: ¿Hasta cuándo seréis negligentes para venir á poseer la tierra que os ha dado Jehová el Dios de vuestros padres?

verses.KJV: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
verses.WEB: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.
verses.ASV: Appoint for you three men of each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall arise, and walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; and they shall come unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assinalai três homens de cada tribo, para que eu os envie, e que eles se levantem, e percorram a terra, e a descrevam conforme suas propriedades, e se voltem a mim.
verses.RVR09: Señalad tres varones de cada tribu, para que yo los envíe, y que ellos se levanten, y recorran la tierra, y la describan conforme á sus heredades, y se tornen á mí.

verses.KJV: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
verses.WEB: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
verses.ASV: And they shall divide it into seven portions: Judah shall abide in his border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their border on the north.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a dividirão em sete partes: e Judá estará em seu termo ao sul, e os da casa de José estarão no seu ao norte.
verses.RVR09: Y la dividirán en siete partes: y Judá estará en su término al mediodía, y los de la casa de José estarán en el suyo al norte.

verses.KJV: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.
verses.WEB: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
verses.ASV: And ye shall describe the land into seven portions, and bring [the description] hither to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, pois, demarcareis a terra em sete partes, e me trareis a descrição aqui, e eu vos lançarei as sortes aqui diante do SENHOR nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros, pues, delinearéis la tierra en siete partes, y me traeréis la descripción aquí, y yo os echaré las suertes aquí delante de Jehová nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
verses.WEB: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”
verses.ASV: For the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Jehovah is their inheritance: and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan eastward, which Moses the servant of Jehovah gave them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os levitas nenhuma parte têm entre vós; porque o sacerdócio do SENHOR é a herança deles: Gade também e Rúben, e a meia tribo de Manassés, já receberam sua herança da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente, a qual lhes deu Moisés servo do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Empero los Levitas ninguna parte tienen entre vosotros; porque el sacerdocio de Jehová es la heredad de ellos: Gad también y Rubén, y la media tribu de Manasés, ya han recibido su heredad de la otra parte del Jordán al oriente, la cual les dió Moisés siervo de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.
verses.WEB: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”
verses.ASV: And the men arose, and went: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah in Shiloh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então aqueles homens se levantaram e se foram; e Josué deu ordem aos que iam demarcar a terra, dizendo-lhes: Ide, percorrei a terra, e demarcai-a, e voltai a mim, para que eu vos lance as sortes aqui diante do SENHOR em Siló.
verses.RVR09: Levantándose pues aquellos varones, fueron: y mandó Josué á los que iban para delinear la tierra, diciéndoles: Id, recorred la tierra, y delineadla, y tornad á mí, para que yo os eche las suertes aquí delante de Jehová en Silo.

verses.KJV: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
verses.WEB: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
verses.ASV: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven portions in a book; and they came to Joshua unto the camp at Shiloh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foram, pois, aqueles homens e passaram pela terra, demarcando-a por cidades em sete partes em um livro, e voltaram a Josué ao acampamento em Siló.
verses.RVR09: Fueron pues aquellos varones y pasearon la tierra, delineándola por ciudades en siete partes en un libro, y tornaron á Josué al campo en Silo.

verses.KJV: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.WEB: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.ASV: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Jehovah: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué lhes lançou as sortes diante do SENHOR em Siló; e ali repartiu Josué a terra aos filhos de Israel por suas porções.
verses.RVR09: Y Josué les echó las suertes delante de Jehová en Silo; y allí repartió Josué la tierra á los hijos de Israel por sus porciones.

verses.KJV: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.WEB: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.ASV: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirou-se a sorte da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim por suas famílias: e saiu o termo de sua porção entre os filhos de Judá e os filhos de José.
verses.RVR09: Y sacóse la suerte de la tribu de los hijos de Benjamín por sus familias: y salió el término de su suerte entre los hijos de Judá y los hijos de José.

verses.KJV: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
verses.WEB: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
verses.ASV: And their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill-country westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o termo deles ao lado do norte desde o Jordão: e sobe aquele termo ao lado de Jericó ao norte; sobe depois ao monte até o ocidente, e vem a sair ao deserto de Bete-Áven:
verses.RVR09: Y fué el término de ellos al lado del norte desde el Jordán: y sube aquel término al lado de Jericó al norte; sube después al monte hacia el occidente, y viene á salir al desierto de Beth-aven:

verses.KJV: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
verses.WEB: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.
verses.ASV: And the border passed along from thence to Luz, to the side of Luz (the same is Beth-el), southward; and the border went down to Ataroth-addar, by the mountain that lieth on the south of Beth-horon the nether.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali passa aquele termo a Luz, pelo lado de Luz (esta é Betel) até o sul. E desce este termo de Atarote-Adar ao monte que está ao sul de Bete-Horom a de abaixo.
verses.RVR09: Y de allí pasa aquel término á Luz, por el lado de Luz (esta es Beth-el) hacia el mediodía. Y desciende este término de Ataroth-addar al monte que está al mediodía de Beth-oron la de abajo.

verses.KJV: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
verses.WEB: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.
verses.ASV: And the border extended [thence], and turned about on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kiriath-baal (the same is Kiriath-jearim), a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
verses.ALMEIDA: E torna este termo, e dá volta ao lado do mar, ao sul até o monte que está diante de Bete-Horom ao sul; e vem a sair a Quriate-Baal, que é Quriate-Jearim, cidade dos filhos de Judá. Este é o lado do ocidente.
verses.RVR09: Y torna este término, y da vuelta al lado de la mar, al mediodía hasta el monte que está delante de Beth-oron al mediodía; y viene á salir á Chîriath-baal, que es Chîriath-jearim, ciudad de los hijos de Judá. Este es el lado del occidente.

verses.KJV: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
verses.WEB: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
verses.ASV: And the south quarter was from the uttermost part of Kiriath-jearim; and the border went out westward, and went out to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o lado do sul é desde a extremidade de Quriate-Jearim, e sai o termo ao ocidente, e sai à fonte das águas de Neftoa:
verses.RVR09: Y el lado del mediodía es desde el cabo de Chîriath-jearim, y sale el término al occidente, y sale á la fuente de las aguas de Nephtoa:

verses.KJV: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,
verses.WEB: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.
verses.ASV: and the border went down to the uttermost part of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the vale of Rephaim northward; and it went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En-rogel;
verses.ALMEIDA: E desce este termo ao fim do monte que está diante do vale do filho de Hinom, que está na campina dos gigantes até o norte: desce logo ao vale de Hinom, ao lado dos jebuseus ao sul, e dali desce à fonte de Rogel;
verses.RVR09: Y desciende aqueste término al cabo del monte que está delante del valle del hijo de Hinnom, que está en la campiña de los gigantes hacia el norte: desciende luego al valle de Hinnom, al lado del Jebuseo al mediodía, y de allí desciende á la fuente de Rogel:

verses.KJV: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.WEB: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.ASV: and it extended northward, and went out at En-shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is over against the ascent of Adummim; and it went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;
verses.ALMEIDA: E do norte torna e sai a En-Semes, e dali sai a Gelilote, que está diante da subida de Adumim, e descia à pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben:
verses.RVR09: Y del norte torna y sale á Ensemes, y de allí sale á Geliloth, que está delante de la subida de Adummim, y descendía á la piedra de Bohan, hijo de Rubén:

verses.KJV: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
verses.WEB: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
verses.ASV: and it passed along to the side over against the Arabah northward, and went down unto the Arabah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E passa ao lado que está diante da campina do norte, e desce às planícies:
verses.RVR09: Y pasa al lado que está delante de la campiña del norte, y desciende á los llanos:

verses.KJV: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
verses.WEB: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
verses.ASV: and the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward; and the goings out of the border were at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan: this was the south border.
verses.ALMEIDA: E torna a passar este termo pelo lado de Bete-Hogla até o norte, e vem a sair o termo à baía do mar Salgado ao norte, ao fim do Jordão ao sul. Este é o termo do sul.
verses.RVR09: Y torna á pasar este término por el lado de Beth-hogla hacia el norte, y viene á salir el término á la lengua del mar Salado al norte, al cabo del Jordán al mediodía. Este es el término de hacia el mediodía.

verses.KJV: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.WEB: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.
verses.ASV: And the Jordan was the border of it on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o Jordão acaba este termo ao lado do oriente. Esta é a herança dos filhos de Benjamim por seus termos ao redor, conforme suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Y el Jordán acaba aqueste término al lado del oriente. Esta es la heredad de los hijos de Benjamín por sus términos alrededor, conforme á sus familias.

verses.KJV: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
verses.WEB: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
verses.ASV: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and Emek-keziz,
verses.ALMEIDA: As cidades da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, por suas famílias, foram Jericó, Bete-Hogla, e Emeque-Queziz,
verses.RVR09: Las ciudades de la tribu de los hijos de Benjamín, por sus familias, fueron Jericó, Beth-hogla, y el valle de Casis,

verses.KJV: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
verses.WEB: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
verses.ASV: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,
verses.ALMEIDA: Bete-Arabá, Zemaraim, e Betel;
verses.RVR09: Beth-araba, Samaraim, y Beth-el;

verses.KJV: And Avim, and Pharah, and Ophrah,
verses.WEB: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
verses.ASV: and Avvim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Avim, e Pará, e Ofra,
verses.RVR09: Y Avim, y Para, y Ophra,

verses.KJV: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.WEB: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.
verses.ASV: and Chephar-ammoni, and Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Quefar-Amonai, Ofni, e Geba; doze cidades com suas aldeias:
verses.RVR09: Y Cephar-hammonai, Ophni, y Gaba; doce ciudades con sus aldeas:

verses.KJV: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
verses.WEB: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
verses.ASV: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Gibeão, Ramá, Beerote,
verses.RVR09: Gabaón, Rama, Beeroth,

verses.KJV: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
verses.WEB: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
verses.ASV: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Mispá, Quefira, e Moza,
verses.RVR09: Y Mizpa, Chephira, y Moza,

verses.KJV: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
verses.WEB: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
verses.ASV: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Requém, Irpeel e Tarala,
verses.RVR09: Recom, Irpeel y Tarala,

verses.KJV: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.WEB: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.ASV: and Zelah, Eleph, and the Jebusite (the same is Jerusalem), Gibeath, [and] Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zela, Elefe, Jebus, que é Jerusalém, Gibeá, e Quiriate; catorze cidades com suas aldeias. Esta é a herança dos filhos de Benjamim, conforme suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Y Sela, Eleph, Jebus, que es Jerusalem, Gibeath, y Chîriath; catorce ciudades con sus aldeas. Esta es la heredad de los hijos de Benjamín, conforme á sus familias.

verses.KJV: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.WEB: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.ASV: And the second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: A segunda porção saiu para Simeão, pela tribo dos filhos de Simeão conforme suas famílias; e sua herança foi entre a herança dos filhos de Judá.
verses.RVR09: LA SEGUNDA suerte salió por Simeón, por la tribu de los hijos de Simeón conforme á sus familias; y su heredad fué entre la heredad de los hijos de Judá.

verses.KJV: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.WEB: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
verses.ASV: And they had for their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tiveram em sua herdade a Berseba, Seba, e Moladá,
verses.RVR09: Y tuvieron en su heredad á Beer-seba, Seba, y Molada,

verses.KJV: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,
verses.WEB: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
verses.ASV: and Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Ezem,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hazar-Sual, Balá, e Azem,
verses.RVR09: Hasar-sual, Bala, y Esem,

verses.KJV: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.WEB: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
verses.ASV: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eltolade, Betul, e Hormá,
verses.RVR09: Heltolad, Betul, y Horma,

verses.KJV: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
verses.WEB: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
verses.ASV: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ziclague, Bete-Marcabote, e Hazar-Susa,
verses.RVR09: Siclag, Beth-marchâboth, y Hasar-susa,

verses.KJV: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
verses.WEB: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;
verses.ASV: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages:
verses.ALMEIDA: Bete-Lebaote, e Saruém; treze cidades com suas aldeias:
verses.RVR09: Beth-lebaoth, y Saruhén; trece ciudades con sus aldeas:

verses.KJV: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
verses.WEB: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;
verses.ASV: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages:
verses.ALMEIDA: Aim, Rimom, Eter, e Asã; quatro cidades com suas aldeias:
verses.RVR09: Aín, Rimmón, Eter, y Asán; cuatro ciudades con sus aldeas:

verses.KJV: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.WEB: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.ASV: and all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as aldeias que estavam ao redor destas cidades até Baalate-Beer, que é Ramá do sul. Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, segundo suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las aldeas que estaban alrededor de estas ciudades hasta Baalath-beer, que es Ramat del mediodía. Esta es la heredad de la tribu de los hijos de Simeón, según sus familias.
