verses.ASV: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spake no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and the children of Gad dwelt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o negócio pareceu bem aos filhos de Israel, e os filhos de Israel bendisseram a Deus; e não falaram mais de subir contra eles em guerra, para destruir a terra em que habitavam os filhos de Rúben e os filhos de Gade.
verses.RVR09: Y el negocio plugo á los hijos de Israel, y bendijeron á Dios los hijos de Israel; y no hablaron más de subir contra ellos en guerra, para destruir la tierra en que habitaban los hijos de Rubén y los hijos de Gad.

verses.KJV: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the Lord is God.
verses.WEB: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that the LORD is God.”
verses.ASV: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar [Ed]: For, [said they], it is a witness between us that Jehovah is God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Rúben e os filhos de Gade puseram por nome ao altar Ede; porque é testemunho entre nós que o SENHOR é Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Rubén y los hijos de Gad pusieron por nombre al altar Ed; porque es testimonio entre nosotros que Jehová es Dios.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass a long time after that the Lord had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.
verses.WEB: After many days, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after many days, when Jehovah had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, and Joshua was old and well stricken in years;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, passados muitos dias depois que o SENHOR deu repouso a Israel de todos os seus inimigos ao redor, que Josué, sendo velho, e cheio de dias,
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ, pasados muchos días después que Jehová dió reposo á Israel de todos sus enemigos al contorno, que Josué, siendo viejo, y entrado en días,

verses.KJV: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
verses.WEB: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.
verses.ASV: that Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and well stricken in years:
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamou a todo Israel, a seus anciãos, a seus príncipes, a seus juízes e a seus oficiais, e disse-lhes: Eu sou já velho e cheio de dias:
verses.RVR09: Llamó á todo Israel, á sus ancianos, á sus príncipes, á sus jueces y á sus oficiales, y díjoles: Yo soy ya viejo y entrado en días:

verses.KJV: And ye have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the Lord your God is he that hath fought for you.
verses.WEB: You have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is the LORD your God who has fought for you.
verses.ASV: and ye have seen all that Jehovah your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for Jehovah your God, he it is that hath fought for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós vistes tudo o que o SENHOR vosso Deus fez com todas estas nações em vossa presença; porque o SENHOR vosso Deus lutou por vós.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros habéis visto todo lo que Jehová vuestro Dios ha hecho con todas estas gentes en vuestra presencia; porque Jehová vuestro Dios ha peleado por vosotros.

verses.KJV: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have allotted unto you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vos reparti por sorteio, em herança para vossas tribos, estas nações, tanto as destruídas como as que ficam, desde o Jordão até o grande mar até onde o sol se põe.
verses.RVR09: He aquí os he repartido por suerte, en herencia para vuestras tribus, estas gentes, así las destruídas como las que quedan, desde el Jordán hasta la gran mar hacia donde el sol se pone.

verses.KJV: And the Lord your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the Lord your God hath promised unto you.
verses.WEB: The LORD your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as the LORD your God spoke to you.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah your God, he will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as Jehovah your God spake unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR vosso Deus as expulsará de diante de vós, e as lançará de vossa presença: e vós possuireis suas terras, como o SENHOR vosso Deus vos disse.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová vuestro Dios las echará de delante de vosotros, y las lanzará de vuestra presencia: y vosotros poseeréis sus tierras, como Jehová vuestro Dios os ha dicho.

verses.KJV: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
verses.WEB: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;
verses.ASV: Therefore be ye very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esforçai-vos, pois, muito a guardar e fazer tudo o que está escrito no livro da lei de Moisés, sem apartar-vos dele nem à direita nem à esquerda;
verses.RVR09: Esforzaos pues mucho á guardar y hacer todo lo que está escrito en el libro de la ley de Moisés, sin apartaros de ello ni á la diestra ni á la siniestra;

verses.KJV: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
verses.WEB: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;
verses.ASV: that ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear [by them], neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves unto them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que quando entrardes a estas nações que restaram convosco, não façais menção nem jureis pelo nome de seus deuses, nem os sirvais, nem vos inclineis a eles:
verses.RVR09: Que cuando entrareis á estas gentes que han quedado con vosotros, no hagáis mención ni juréis por el nombre de sus dioses, ni los sirváis, ni os inclinéis á ellos:

verses.KJV: But cleave unto the Lord your God, as ye have done unto this day.
verses.WEB: but hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.
verses.ASV: but cleave unto Jehovah your God, as ye have done unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao SENHOR vosso Deus vos achegareis, como fizestes até hoje;
verses.RVR09: Mas á Jehová vuestro Dios os allegaréis, como habéis hecho hasta hoy;

verses.KJV: For the Lord hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.
verses.WEB: “For the LORD has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath stood before you unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o SENHOR expulsou diante de vós grandes e fortes nações, e até hoje ninguém há podido resistir diante de vosso rosto.
verses.RVR09: Pues ha echado Jehová delante de vosotros grandes y fuertes naciones, y hasta hoy nadie ha podido parar delante de vuestro rostro.

verses.KJV: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the Lord your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
verses.WEB: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is the LORD your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.
verses.ASV: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for Jehovah your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he spake unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um homem de vós perseguirá a mil: porque o SENHOR vosso Deus luta por vós, como ele vos disse.
verses.RVR09: Un varón de vosotros perseguirá á mil: porque Jehová vuestro Dios pelea por vosotros, como él os dijo.

verses.KJV: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, cuidai muito por vossas almas, que ameis ao SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, cuidad mucho por vuestras almas, que améis á Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
verses.WEB: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;
verses.ASV: Else if ye do at all go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se vos apartardes, e vos achegardes ao que resta daquelas nações que restaram convosco, e se estabelecerdes com elas matrimônios, e entrardes a elas, e elas a vós;
verses.RVR09: Porque si os apartareis, y os allegareis á lo que resta de aquestas gentes que han quedado con vosotros, y si concertareis con ellas matrimonios, y entrareis á ellas, y ellas á vosotros;

verses.KJV: Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.
verses.WEB: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
verses.ASV: know for a certainty that Jehovah your God will no more drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap unto you, and a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which Jehovah your God hath given you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabei que o SENHOR vosso Deus não expulsará mais estas nações diante de vós; antes vos serão por laço, e por tropeço, e por açoite para vossos lados, e por espinhos para vossos olhos, até que pereçais desta boa terra que o SENHOR vosso Deus vos deu.
verses.RVR09: Sabed que Jehová vuestro Dios no echará más estas gentes delante de vosotros; antes os serán por lazo, y por tropiezo, y por azote para vuestros costados, y por espinas para vuestros ojos, hasta tanto que perezcáis de aquesta buena tierra que Jehová vuestro Dios os ha dado.

verses.KJV: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the Lord your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.
verses.WEB: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.
verses.ASV: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which Jehovah your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, not one thing hath failed thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que eu estou para entrar hoje pelo caminho de toda a terra: reconhecei, pois, com todo o vosso coração e com toda vossa alma, que não se perdeu uma palavra de todas a boas palavras que o SENHOR vosso Deus disse de vós; todas vieram até vós, nenhuma delas se perdeu.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí que yo estoy para entrar hoy por el camino de toda la tierra: reconoced, pues, con todo vuestro corazón y con toda vuestra alma, que no se ha perdido una palabra de todas la buenas palabras que Jehová vuestro Dios había dicho de vosotros: todas os han venido, no se ha perdido de ellas ni una.

verses.KJV: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the Lord your God promised you; so shall the Lord bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.
verses.WEB: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which the LORD your God spoke to you, so the LORD will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you,
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that as all the good things are come upon you of which Jehovah your God spake unto you, so will Jehovah bring upon you all the evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which Jehovah your God hath given you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas será, que quando veio sobre vós toda palavra boa que o SENHOR vosso Deus vos havia dito, assim também o SENHOR trará sobre vós toda palavra má, até destruir-vos de sobre a boa terra que o SENHOR vosso Deus vos deu;
verses.RVR09: Mas será, que como ha venido sobre vosotros toda palabra buena que Jehová vuestro Dios os había dicho, así también traerá Jehová sobre vosotros toda palabra mala, hasta destruiros de sobre la buena tierra que Jehová vuestro Dios os ha dado;

verses.KJV: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
verses.WEB: when you disobey the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then the LORD’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”
verses.ASV: When ye transgress the covenant of Jehovah your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them; then will the anger of Jehovah be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando transgredirdes o pacto do SENHOR vosso Deus que ele vos mandou, indo e honrando deuses alheios, e inclinando-vos a eles. E o furor do SENHOR se inflamará contra vós, e logo perecereis desta boa terra que ele vos deu.
verses.RVR09: Cuando traspasareis el pacto de Jehová vuestro Dios que él os ha mandado, yendo y honrando dioses ajenos, é inclinándoos á ellos. Y el furor de Jehová se inflamará contra vosotros, y luego pereceréis de aquesta buena tierra que él os ha dado.

verses.KJV: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
verses.WEB: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
verses.ASV: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntando Josué todas as tribos de Israel em Siquém, chamou aos anciãos de Israel, e a seus príncipes, a seus juízes, e a seus oficiais; e apresentaram-se diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y JUNTANDO Josué todas las tribus de Israel en Sichêm, llamó á los ancianos de Israel, y á sus príncipes, á sus jueces, y á sus oficiales; y presentáronse delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.
verses.WEB: Joshua said to all the people, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.
verses.ASV: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor: and they served other gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Josué a todo o povo: Assim diz o SENHOR, Deus de Israel: Vossos pais habitaram antigamente da outra parte do rio, a saber, Terá, pai de Abraão e de Naor; e serviam a deuses estranhos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Josué á todo el pueblo: Así dice Jehová, Dios de Israel: Vuestros padres habitaron antiguamente de esotra parte del río, es á saber, Tharé, padre de Abraham y de Nachôr; y servían á dioses extraños.

verses.KJV: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
verses.WEB: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.
verses.ASV: And I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu tomei a vosso pai Abraão da outra parte do rio, e trouxe-o por toda a terra de Canaã, e aumentei sua geração, e dei-lhe a Isaque.
verses.RVR09: Y yo tomé á vuestro padre Abraham de la otra parte del río, y trájelo por toda la tierra de Canaán, y aumenté su generación, y díle á Isaac.

verses.KJV: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
verses.WEB: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
verses.ASV: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; and Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Isaque dei a Jacó e a Esaú: e a Esaú dei o monte de Seir, que o possuísse: mas Jacó e seus filhos desceram ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y á Isaac dí á Jacob y á Esaú: y á Esaú dí el monte de Seir, que lo poseyese: mas Jacob y sus hijos descendieron á Egipto.

verses.KJV: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
verses.WEB: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
verses.ASV: And I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did in the midst thereof: and afterward I brought you out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu enviei a Moisés e a Arão, e feri ao Egito, ao modo que o fiz em meio dele, e depois vos tirei.
verses.RVR09: Y yo envié á Moisés y á Aarón, y herí á Egipto, al modo que lo hice en medio de él, y después os saqué.

verses.KJV: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
verses.WEB: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.
verses.ASV: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and with horsemen unto the Red Sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirei a vossos pais do Egito: e quando chegaram ao mar, os egípcios seguiram a vossos pais até o mar Vermelho com carros e cavalaria.
verses.RVR09: Y saqué á vuestros padres de Egipto: y como llegaron á la mar, los Egipcios siguieron á vuestros padres hasta el mar Bermejo con carros y caballería.

verses.KJV: And when they cried unto the Lord, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
verses.WEB: When they cried out to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.
verses.ASV: And when they cried out unto Jehovah, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness many days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eles clamaram ao SENHOR, ele pôs escuridão entre vós e os egípcios, e fez vir sobre eles o mar, a qual os cobriu: e vossos olhos viram o que fiz em Egito. Depois estivestes muitos dias no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y como ellos clamasen á Jehová, él puso oscuridad entre vosotros y los Egipcios, é hizo venir sobre ellos la mar, la cual los cubrió: y vuestros ojos vieron lo que hice en Egipto. Después estuvisteis muchos días en el desierto.

verses.KJV: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
verses.WEB: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.
verses.ASV: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that dwelt beyond the Jordan: and they fought with you; and I gave them into your hand, and ye possessed their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos introduzi na terra dos amorreus, que habitavam da outra parte do Jordão, os quais lutaram contra vós; mas eu os entreguei em vossas mãos, e possuístes sua terra, e os destruí de diante de vós.
verses.RVR09: Y os introduje en la tierra de los Amorrheos, que habitaban de la otra parte del Jordán, los cuales pelearon contra vosotros; mas yo los entregué en vuestras manos, y poseísteis su tierra, y los destruí de delante de vosotros.

verses.KJV: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
verses.WEB: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
verses.ASV: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel: and he sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you;
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se depois Balaque filho de Zipor, rei dos moabitas, e lutou contra Israel; e mandou chamar a Balaão filho de Beor, para que vos amaldiçoasse.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse después Balac hijo de Sephor, rey de los Moabitas, y peleó contra Israel; y envió á llamar á Balaam hijo de Beor, para que os maldijese.

verses.KJV: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
verses.WEB: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.
verses.ASV: but I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu não quis escutar a Balaão, antes vos abençoou repetidamente, e vos livre de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo no quise escuchar á Balaam, antes os bendijo repetidamente, y os libré de sus manos.

verses.KJV: And you went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
verses.WEB: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.
verses.ASV: And ye went over the Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passado o Jordão, viestes a Jericó; e os moradores de Jericó lutaram contra vós: os amorreus, perizeus, cananeus, heteus, girgaseus, heveus, e jebuseus: e eu os entreguei em vossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y pasado el Jordán, vinisteis á Jericó; y los moradores de Jericó pelearon contra vosotros: los Amorrheos, Pherezeos, Cananeos, Hetheos, Gergeseos, Heveos, y Jebuseos: y yo los entregué en vuestras manos.

verses.KJV: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
verses.WEB: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.
verses.ASV: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviei vespas diante de vós, os quais os expulsaram de diante de vós, a saber, aos dois reis dos amorreus; não com tua espada, nem com teu arco.
verses.RVR09: Y envié tábanos delante de vosotros, los cuales los echaron de delante de vosotros, á saber, á los dos reyes de los Amorrheos; no con tu espada, ni con tu arco.

verses.KJV: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
verses.WEB: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’
verses.ASV: And I gave you a land whereon thou hadst not labored, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell therein; of vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos dei a terra pela qual nada trabalhastes, e as cidades que não edificastes, nas quais morais; e das vinhas e olivais que não plantastes, comeis.
verses.RVR09: Y os dí la tierra por la cual nada trabajasteis, y las ciudades que no edificasteis, en las cuales moráis; y de las viñas y olivares que no plantasteis, coméis.

verses.KJV: Now therefore fear the Lord, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve the LORD.
verses.ASV: Now therefore fear Jehovah, and serve him in sincerity and in truth; and put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, and in Egypt; and serve ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, temei ao SENHOR, e servi-o com integridade e em verdade; e tirai do meio os deuses aos quais serviram vossos pais da outra parte do rio, e em Egito; e servi ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, temed á Jehová, y servidle con integridad y en verdad; y quitad de en medio los dioses á los cuales sirvieron vuestros padres de esotra parte del río, y en Egipto; y servid á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the Lord, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.
verses.WEB: If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And if it seem evil unto you to serve Jehovah, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se mal vos parece servir ao SENHOR, escolhei hoje a quem sirvais; se aos deuses a os quais serviram vossos pais, quando estiveram da outra parte do rio, ou aos deuses dos amorreus em cuja terra habitais: que eu e minha casa serviremos ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y si mal os parece servir á Jehová, escogeos hoy á quién sirváis; si á los dioses á quienes sirvieron vuestros padres, cuando estuvieron de esotra parte del río, ó á los dioses de los Amorrheos en cuya tierra habitáis: que yo y mi casa serviremos á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the Lord, to serve other gods;
verses.WEB: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
verses.ASV: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us that we should forsake Jehovah, to serve other gods;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o povo respondeu, e disse: Nunca tal aconteça que deixemos ao SENHOR para servir a outros deuses:
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pueblo respondió, y dijo: Nunca tal acontezca, que dejemos á Jehová por servir á otros dioses:

verses.KJV: For the Lord our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
verses.WEB: for it is the LORD our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.
verses.ASV: for Jehovah our God, he it is that brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and that did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the peoples through the midst of whom we passed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR nosso Deus é o que tirou a nós e a nossos pais da terra do Egito, da casa de escravidão; o qual diante de nossos olhos fez estas grandes sinais, e nos guardou por todo o caminho por onde andamos, e em todos os povos por entre os quais passamos.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová nuestro Dios es el que nos sacó á nosotros y á nuestros padres de la tierra de Egipto, de la casa de servidumbre; el cual delante de nuestros ojos ha hecho estas grandes señales, y nos ha guardado por todo el camino por donde hemos andado, y en todos los pueblos por entre los cuales pasamos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the Lord; for he is our God.
verses.WEB: The LORD drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve the LORD; for he is our God.”
verses.ASV: and Jehovah drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites that dwelt in the land: therefore we also will serve Jehovah; for he is our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR expulsou de diante de nós a todos os povos, e aos amorreus que habitavam na terra: nós, pois, também serviremos ao SENHOR, porque ele é nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová echó de delante de nosotros á todos los pueblos, y al Amorrheo que habitaba en la tierra: nosotros, pues, también serviremos á Jehová, porque él es nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the Lord: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
verses.WEB: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve the LORD, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.
verses.ASV: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve Jehovah; for he is a holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgression nor your sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Josué disse ao povo: Não podereis servir ao SENHOR, porque ele é Deus santo, e Deus zeloso; não tolerará vossas rebeliões e vossos pecados.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Josué dijo al pueblo: No podréis servir á Jehová, porque él es Dios santo, y Dios celoso; no sufrirá vuestras rebeliones y vuestros pecados.

verses.KJV: If ye forsake the Lord, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
verses.WEB: If you forsake the LORD, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”
verses.ASV: If ye forsake Jehovah, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se deixardes ao SENHOR e servirdes a deuses alheios, se voltará, e vos maltratará, e vos consumirá, depois que vos fez bem.
verses.RVR09: Si dejareis á Jehová y sirviereis á dioses ajenos, se volverá, y os maltratará, y os consumirá, después que os ha hecho bien.

verses.KJV: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the Lord.
verses.WEB: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O povo então disse a Josué: Não, antes ao SENHOR serviremos.
verses.RVR09: El pueblo entonces dijo á Josué: No, antes á Jehová serviremos.

verses.KJV: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the Lord, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
verses.WEB: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”
verses.ASV: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you Jehovah, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josué respondeu ao povo: Vós sois testemunhas contra vós mesmos, de que escolhestes para vós ao SENHOR para servir-lhe. E eles responderam: Testemunhas somos.
verses.RVR09: Y Josué respondió al pueblo: Vosotros sois testigos contra vosotros mismos, de que os habéis elegido á Jehová para servirle. Y ellos respondieron: Testigos somos.

verses.KJV: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the Lord God of Israel.
verses.WEB: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore put away, [said he], the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tirai, pois, agora os deuses alheios que estão entre vós, e inclinai vosso coração ao SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Quitad, pues, ahora los dioses ajenos que están entre vosotros, é inclinad vuestro corazón á Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the people said unto Joshua, The Lord our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
verses.WEB: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God, and we will listen to his voice.”
verses.ASV: And the people said unto Joshua, Jehovah our God will we serve, and unto his voice will we hearken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo respondeu a Josué: Ao SENHOR nosso Deus serviremos, e à sua voz obedeceremos.
verses.RVR09: Y el pueblo respondió á Josué: A Jehová nuestro Dios serviremos, y á su voz obedeceremos.

verses.KJV: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.WEB: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.ASV: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Josué fez aliança com o povo o mesmo dia, e pôs-lhe ordenanças e leis em Siquém.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Josué hizo alianza con el pueblo el mismo día, y púsole ordenanzas y leyes en Sichêm.

verses.KJV: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E escreveu Josué estas palavras no livro da lei de Deus; e tomando uma grande pedra, levantou-a ali debaixo de um carvalho que estava junto ao santuário do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y escribió Josué estas palabras en el libro de la ley de Dios; y tomando una grande piedra, levantóla allí debajo de un alcornoque que estaba junto al santuario de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the Lord which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.
verses.WEB: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all the LORD’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”
verses.ASV: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us; for it hath heard all the words of Jehovah which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness against you, lest ye deny your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Josué a todo o povo: Eis que esta pedra será entre nós por testemunha, a qual ouviu todas as palavras do SENHOR que ele falou conosco: será, pois, testemunha contra vós, para que não mintais contra vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Josué á todo el pueblo: He aquí esta piedra será entre nosotros por testigo, la cual ha oído todas las palabras de Jehová que él ha hablado con nosotros: será, pues, testigo contra vosotros, porque no mintáis contra vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
verses.WEB: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
verses.ASV: So Joshua sent the people away, every man unto his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Josué ao povo, cada um à sua herança.
verses.RVR09: Y envió Josué al pueblo, cada uno á su heredad.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.WEB: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Jehovah, died, being a hundred and ten years old.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois destas coisas morreu Josué, filho de Num, servo do SENHOR sendo de cento e dez anos.
verses.RVR09: Y después de estas cosas murió Josué, hijo de Nun, siervo de Jehová, siendo de ciento y diez años.

verses.KJV: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
verses.WEB: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
verses.ASV: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enterraram-no no termo de sua possessão em Timnate-Sera, que está no monte de Efraim, ao norte do monte de Gaás.
verses.RVR09: Y enterráronlo en el término de su posesión en Timnath-sera, que está en el monte de Ephraim, al norte del monte de Gaas.

verses.KJV: And Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the Lord, that he had done for Israel.
verses.WEB: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of the LORD, that he had worked for Israel.
verses.ASV: And Israel served Jehovah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Jehovah, that he had wrought for Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serviu Israel ao SENHOR todo o tempo de Josué, e todo o tempo dos anciãos que viveram depois de Josué, e que sabiam todas as obras do SENHOR, que havia feito por Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y sirvió Israel á Jehová todo el tiempo de Josué, y todo el tiempo de los ancianos que vivieron después de Josué, y que sabían todas las obras de Jehová, que había hecho por Israel.

verses.KJV: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
verses.WEB: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
verses.ASV: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of money: and they became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enterraram em Siquém os ossos de José que os filhos de Israel haviam trazido do Egito, na parte do campo que Jacó comprou dos filhos de Hamor, pai de Siquém, por cem peças de prata; e foi em possessão aos filhos de José.
verses.RVR09: Y enterraron en Sichêm los huesos de José que los hijos de Israel habían traído de Egipto, en la parte del campo que Jacob compró de los hijos de Hemor padre de Sichêm, por cien corderas; y fué en posesión á los hijos de José.

verses.KJV: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
verses.WEB: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.ASV: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill-country of Ephraim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também morreu Eleazar, filho de Arão; ao qual enterraram no morro de Fineias seu filho, que lhe foi dado no monte de Efraim.
verses.RVR09: También murió Eleazar, hijo de Aarón; al cual enterraron en el collado de Phinees su hijo, que le fué dado en el monte de Ephraim.

verses.KJV: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
verses.WEB: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after the death of Joshua, that the children of Israel asked of Jehovah, saying, Who shall go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu depois da morte de Josué, que os filhos de Israel consultaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Quem subirá por nós primeiro para lutar contra os cananeus?
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ después de la muerte de Josué, que los hijos de Israel consultaron á Jehová, diciendo: ¿Quién subirá por nosotros el primero á pelear contra los Cananeos?

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR respondeu: Judá subirá; eis que eu entreguei a terra em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová respondió: Judá subirá; he aquí que yo he entregado la tierra en sus manos.

verses.KJV: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
verses.WEB: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.
verses.ASV: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Judá disse a Simeão seu irmão: Sobe comigo à minha porção, e lutemos contra os cananeus, e eu também irei contigo à tua porção. E Simeão foi com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Judá dijo á Simeón su hermano: Sube conmigo á mi suerte, y peleemos contra el Cananeo, y yo también iré contigo á tu suerte. Y Simeón fué con él.

verses.KJV: And Judah went up; and the Lord delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
verses.WEB: Judah went up, and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
verses.ASV: And Judah went up; and Jehovah delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they smote of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu Judá, e o SENHOR entregou em suas mãos aos cananeus e aos perizeus; e deles feriram em Bezeque dez mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Y subió Judá, y Jehová entregó en sus manos al Cananeo y al Pherezeo; y de ellos hirieron en Bezec diez mil hombres.

verses.KJV: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.WEB: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.ASV: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek; and they fought against him, and they smote the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acharam a Adoni-Bezeque em Bezeque, e lutaram contra ele: e feriram aos cananeus e aos perizeus.
verses.RVR09: Y hallaron á Adoni-bezec en Bezec, y pelearon contra él: é hirieron al Cananeo y al Pherezeo.

verses.KJV: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
verses.WEB: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
verses.ASV: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Adoni-Bezeque fugiu; e seguiram-no, e prenderam-no, e cortaram-lhe os polegares das mãos e dos pés.
verses.RVR09: Mas Adoni-bezec huyó; y siguiéronle, y prendiéronle, y cortáronle los pulgares de las manos y de los pies.

verses.KJV: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
verses.WEB: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
verses.ASV: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered [their food] under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Adoni-Bezeque: Setenta reis, cortados os polegares de suas mãos e de seus pés, colhiam as migalhas debaixo de minha mesa: como eu fiz, assim Deus me pagou. E meteram-no em Jerusalém, de onde morreu.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Adoni-bezec: Setenta reyes, cortados los pulgares de sus manos y de sus pies, cogían las migajas debajo de mi mesa: como yo hice, así me ha pagado Dios. Y metiéronle en Jerusalem, donde murió.

verses.KJV: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.WEB: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.ASV: And the children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E combateram os filhos de Judá a Jerusalém, e a tomaram, e puseram à espada, e puseram a fogo a cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y habían combatido los hijos de Judá á Jerusalem, y la habían tomado, y metido á cuchillo, y puesto á fuego la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
verses.WEB: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
verses.ASV: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites that dwelt in the hill-country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois os filhos de Judá desceram para lutar contra os cananeus que habitavam nas montanhas, e ao sul, e nas planícies.
verses.RVR09: Después los hijos de Judá descendieron para pelear contra el Cananeo que habitaba en las montañas, y al mediodía, y en los llanos.

verses.KJV: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.WEB: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.ASV: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron (now the name of Hebron beforetime was Kiriath-arba); and they smote Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiu Judá contra os cananeus que habitavam em Hebrom, a qual se chamava antes Quiriate-Arba; e feriram a Sesai, e a Aimã, e a Talmai.
verses.RVR09: Y partió Judá contra el Cananeo que habitaba en Hebrón, la cual se llamaba antes Chîriath-arba; é hirieron á Sesai, y á Ahiman, y á Talmai.

verses.KJV: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:
verses.WEB: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)
verses.ASV: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (Now the name of Debir beforetime was Kiriath-sepher.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali foi aos que habitavam em Debir, que antes se chamava Quiriate-Sefer.
verses.RVR09: Y de allí fué á los que habitaban en Debir, que antes se llamaba Chîriath-sepher.

verses.KJV: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.WEB: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”
verses.ASV: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kiriath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Calebe: O que ferir a Quiriate-Sefer, e a tomar, eu lhe darei a Acsa minha filha por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Caleb: El que hiriere á Chîriath-sepher, y la tomare, yo le daré á Axa mi hija por mujer.

verses.KJV: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.WEB: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.
verses.ASV: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou-a Otniel filho de Quenaz, irmão menor de Calebe: e ele lhe deu a Acsa sua filha por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y tomóla Othoniel hijo de Cenez, hermano menor de Caleb: y él le dió á Axa su hija por mujer.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
verses.WEB: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when she came [unto him], that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she alighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando a levavam, persuadiu-lhe que pedisse a seu pai um campo. E ela desceu do asno, e Calebe lhe disse: Que tens?
verses.RVR09: Y cuando la llevaban, persuadióle que pidiese á su padre un campo. Y ella se apeó del asno, y Caleb le dijo: ¿Qué tienes?

verses.KJV: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
verses.WEB: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.ASV: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing; for that thou hast set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela então lhe respondeu: Dá-me uma bênção: pois me deste terra de secura, que me dês também fontes de águas. Então Calebe lhe deu as fontes de acima e as fontes de abaixo.
verses.RVR09: Ella entonces le respondió: Dame una bendición: que pues me has dado tierra de secadal, me des también fuentes de aguas. Entonces Caleb le dió las fuentes de arriba y las fuentes de abajo.

verses.KJV: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
verses.WEB: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
verses.ASV: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm-trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt with the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de queneu, sogro de Moisés, subiram da cidade das palmeiras com os filhos de Judá ao deserto de Judá, que está ao sul de Arade: e foram e habitaram com o povo.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Cineo, suegro de Moisés, subieron de la ciudad de las palmas con los hijos de Judá al desierto de Judá, que está al mediodía de Arad: y fueron y habitaron con el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.WEB: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.ASV: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they smote the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi Judá ao seu irmão Simeão, e feriram aos cananeus que habitavam em Zefate, e assolaram-na: e puseram por nome à cidade, Hormá.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Judá á su hermano Simeón, é hirieron al Cananeo que habitaba en Sephath, y asoláronla: y pusieron por nombre á la ciudad, Horma.

verses.KJV: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
verses.WEB: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.
verses.ASV: Also Judah took Gaza with the border thereof, and Ashkelon with the border thereof, and Ekron with the border thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou também Judá a Gaza com seu termo, e a Asquelom com seu termo, e a Ecrom com seu termo.
verses.RVR09: Tomó también Judá á Gaza con su término, y á Ascalón con su término, y á Ecrón con su término.

verses.KJV: And the Lord was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.WEB: The LORD was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah was with Judah; and drove out [the inhabitants of] the hill-country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR foi com Judá, e expulsaram os das montanhas; mas não puderam expulsar os que habitavam nas planícies, os quais tinham carros de ferro.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Jehová con Judá, y echó á los de las montañas; mas no pudo echar á los que habitaban en los llanos, los cuales tenían carros herrados.

verses.KJV: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
verses.WEB: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.
verses.ASV: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses had spoken: and he drove out thence the three sons of Anak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram Hebrom a Calebe, como Moisés havia dito: e ele expulsou dali três filhos de Anaque.
verses.RVR09: Y dieron Hebrón á Caleb, como Moisés había dicho: y él echó de allí tres hijos de Anac.

verses.KJV: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.WEB: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
verses.ASV: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos jebuseus que habitavam em Jerusalém, não expulsaram os filhos de Benjamim, e tanto os jebuseus habitaram com os filhos de Benjamim em Jerusalém até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Mas al Jebuseo que habitaba en Jerusalem, no echaron los hijos de Benjamín, y así el Jebuseo habitó con los hijos de Benjamín en Jerusalem hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the Lord was with them.
verses.WEB: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
verses.ASV: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth-el; and Jehovah was with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também os da casa de José subiram a Betel; e o SENHOR foi com eles.
verses.RVR09: También los de la casa de José subieron á Beth-el; y fué Jehová con ellos.

verses.KJV: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
verses.WEB: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
verses.ASV: And the house of Joseph sent to spy out Beth-el. (Now the name of the city beforetime was Luz.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E os da casa de José puseram espias em Betel, a qual cidade antes se chamava Luz.
verses.RVR09: Y los de la casa de José pusieron espías en Beth-el, la cual ciudad antes se llamaba Luz.

verses.KJV: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
verses.WEB: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”
verses.ASV: And the watchers saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Show us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que espiavam viram um homem que saía da cidade, e disseram-lhe: Mostra-nos agora a entrada da cidade, e faremos contigo misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: Y los que espiaban vieron un hombre que salía de la ciudad, y dijéronle: Muéstranos ahora la entrada de la ciudad, y haremos contigo misericordia.

verses.KJV: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
verses.WEB: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
verses.ASV: And he showed them the entrance into the city; and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man go and all his family.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes mostrou a entrada à cidade, e feriram-na a fio de espada; mas deixaram a aquele homem com toda sua família.
verses.RVR09: Y él les mostró la entrada á la ciudad, é hiriéronla á filo de espada; mas dejaron á aquel hombre con toda su familia.

verses.KJV: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
verses.WEB: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
verses.ASV: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz, which is the name thereof unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fosse o homem à terra dos heteus, e edificou uma cidade, à qual chamou Luz; e este é seu nome até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y fuese el hombre á la tierra de los Hetheos, y edificó una ciudad, á la cual llamó Luz: y este es su nombre hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.WEB: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.ASV: And Manasseh did not drive out [the inhabitants of] Beth-shean and its towns, nor [of] Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tampouco Manassés expulsou os de Bete-Seã, nem aos de suas aldeias, nem aos de Taanaque e suas aldeias, nem os de Dor e suas aldeias, nem os habitantes de Ibleão e suas aldeias, nem aos que habitavam em Megido e em suas aldeias; mas os cananeus quiseram habitar nessa terra.
verses.RVR09: Tampoco Manasés echó á los de Beth-sean, ni á los de sus aldeas, ni á los de Taanach y sus aldeas, ni á los de Dor y sus aldeas, ni á los habitantes de Ibleam y sus aldeas, ni á los que habitaban en Megiddo y en sus aldeas: mas el Cananeo quiso habitar en esta tierra.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.WEB: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Israel was waxed strong, that they put the Canaanites to taskwork, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando Israel tomou forças fez aos cananeus tributários, mas não o expulsou.
verses.RVR09: Empero cuando Israel tomó fuerzas hizo al Cananeo tributario, mas no lo echó.

verses.KJV: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
verses.WEB: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
verses.ASV: And Ephraim drove not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Efraim não expulsou os cananeus que habitavam em Gezer; antes habitaram os cananeus em meio deles em Gezer.
verses.RVR09: Tampoco Ephraim echó al Cananeo que habitaba en Gezer; antes habitó el Cananeo en medio de ellos en Gezer.

verses.KJV: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
verses.WEB: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
verses.ASV: Zebulun drove not out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became subject to taskwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Zebulom não expulsou aos que habitavam em Quitrom e aos que habitavam em Naalol; mas os cananeus habitaram no meio dele, e lhe foram tributários.
verses.RVR09: Tampoco Zabulón echó á los que habitaban en Chîtron y á los que habitaban en Naalol; mas el Cananeo habitó en medio de él, y le fueron tributarios.

verses.KJV: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
verses.WEB: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
verses.ASV: Asher drove not out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Aser não expulsou aos que habitavam em Aco, e aos que habitavam em Sidom, Alabe, Aczibe, Helba, Afeque, e em Reobe;
verses.RVR09: Tampoco Aser echó á los que habitaban en Achô, y á los que habitaban en Sidón, y en Ahlab, y en Achzib, y en Helba, y en Aphec, y en Rehod:

verses.KJV: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
verses.WEB: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.
verses.ASV: but the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.
verses.ALMEIDA: em vez disso, Aser morou entre os cananeus que habitavam na terra; pois não os expulsou.
verses.RVR09: Antes moró Aser entre los Cananeos que habitaban en la tierra; pues no los echó.

verses.KJV: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
verses.WEB: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.
verses.ASV: Naphtali drove not out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became subject to taskwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Naftali não expulsou os que habitavam em Bete-Semes e os que habitavam em Bete-Anate, mas morou entre os cananeus que habitavam na terra; todavia, os moradores de Bete-Semes e os moradores de Bete-Anate foram-lhe tributários.
verses.RVR09: Tampoco Nephtalí echó á los que habitaban en Beth-semes, y á los que habitaban en Beth-anath, sino que moró entre los Cananeos que habitaban en la tierra; mas fuéronle tributarios los moradores de Beth-semes, y los moradores de Beth-anath.

verses.KJV: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
verses.WEB: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
verses.ASV: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill-country; for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os amorreus pressionaram os filhos de Dã até as montanhas; pois não os permitiram descer ao vale.
verses.RVR09: Los Amorrheos apretaron á los hijos de Dan hasta el monte; que no los dejaron descender á la campiña.

verses.KJV: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
verses.WEB: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
verses.ASV: but the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to taskwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os amorreus quiseram habitar no monte de Heres, em Aijalom e em Saalbim; mas a mão da tribo de José foi mais forte, e os fizeram tributários.
verses.RVR09: Y quiso el Amorrheo habitar en el monte de Heres, en Ajalón y en Saalbín; mas como la mano de la casa de José tomó fuerzas, hiciéronlos tributarios.

verses.KJV: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.WEB: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.ASV: And the border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o limite dos amorreus foi desde a subida de Acrabim, desde a rocha, e daí acima.
verses.RVR09: Y el término del Amorrheo fué desde la subida de Acrabim, desde la piedra, y arriba.

verses.KJV: And an angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah came up from Gilgal to Bochim. And he said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you:
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo do SENHOR subiu de Gilgal a Boquim, e disse: “Eu vos tirei do Egito, e vos introduzi na terra da qual havia jurado a vossos pais; e disse: ‘Não invalidarei jamais meu pacto convosco;
verses.RVR09: Y El ángel de Jehová subió de Gilgal á Bochîm, y dijo: Yo os saqué de Egipto, y os introduje en la tierra de la cual había jurado á vuestros padres; y dije: No invalidaré jamás mi pacto con vosotros;

verses.KJV: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
verses.WEB: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?
verses.ASV: and ye shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall break down their altars. But ye have not hearkened unto my voice: why have ye done this?
verses.ALMEIDA: contanto que vós não façais aliança com os moradores desta terra, cujos altares deveis derrubar’; mas vós não atendestes à minha voz: por que fizestes isto?
verses.RVR09: Con tal que vosotros no hagáis alianza con los moradores de aquesta tierra, cuyos altares habéis de derribar: mas vosotros no habéis atendido á mi voz: ¿por qué habéis hecho esto?

verses.KJV: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
verses.WEB: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”
verses.ASV: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be [as thorns] in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu também disse: ‘Não os expulsarei de diante de vós, mas serão vossos inimigos, e seus deuses vos serão uma armadilha’”.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto yo también dije: No los echaré de delante de vosotros, sino que os serán por azote para vuestros costados, y sus dioses por tropiezo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the angel of the Lord spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.WEB: When the LORD’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the angel of Jehovah spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o anjo do SENHOR falou estas palavras a todos os filhos de Israel, o povo chorou em alta voz.
verses.RVR09: Y como el ángel de Jehová habló estas palabras á todos los hijos de Israel, el pueblo lloró en alta voz.

verses.KJV: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamaram por nome aquele lugar Boquim: e sacrificaram ali ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y llamaron por nombre aquel lugar Bochîm: y sacrificaron allí á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.WEB: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.ASV: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque já Josué havia despedido ao povo, e os filhos de Israel se haviam ido cada um à sua herança para possuí-la.
verses.RVR09: Porque ya Josué había despedido al pueblo, y los hijos de Israel se habían ido cada uno á su heredad para poseerla.

verses.KJV: And the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the Lord, that he did for Israel.
verses.WEB: The people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of the LORD that he had worked for Israel.
verses.ASV: And the people served Jehovah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Jehovah that he had wrought for Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo havia servido ao SENHOR todo aquele tempo de Josué, e todo aquele tempo dos anciãos que viveram longos dias depois de Josué, os quais viram todas as grandes obras do SENHOR, que o havia feito por Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y el pueblo había servido á Jehová todo el tiempo de Josué, y todo el tiempo de los ancianos que vivieron largos días después de Josué, los cuales habían visto todas las grandes obras de Jehová, que él había hecho por Israel.

verses.KJV: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.WEB: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.
verses.ASV: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Jehovah, died, being a hundred and ten years old.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Josué filho de Num, servo do SENHOR, sendo de cento e dez anos.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Josué hijo de Nun, siervo de Jehová, siendo de ciento y diez años.

verses.KJV: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
verses.WEB: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
verses.ASV: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the hill-country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enterraram-no no termo de sua herança em Timnate-Heres, no monte de Efraim, o norte do monte de Gaás.
verses.RVR09: Y enterráronlo en el término de su heredad en Timnath-sera, en el monte de Ephraim, al norte del monte de Gaas.

verses.KJV: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the Lord, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.
verses.WEB: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know the LORD, nor the work which he had done for Israel.
verses.ASV: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, that knew not Jehovah, nor yet the work which he had wrought for Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda aquela geração foi também recolhida com seus pais. E levantou-se depois dela outra geração, que não conhecia o SENHOR, nem a obra que ele havia feito por Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y toda aquella generación fué también recogida con sus padres. Y levantóse después de ellos otra generación, que no conocían á Jehová, ni la obra que él había hecho por Israel.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim:
verses.WEB: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and served the Baalim;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel fizeram o que era mal aos olhos do SENHOR, e serviram aos baalins;
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Israel hicieron lo malo en ojos de Jehová, y sirvieron á los Baales:
