verses.KJV: And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the Lord to anger.
verses.WEB: They abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked the LORD to anger.
verses.ASV: and they forsook Jehovah, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples that were round about them, and bowed themselves down unto them: and they provoked Jehovah to anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abandonaram o SENHOR, o Deus de seus pais, que os havia tirado da terra do Egito, e seguiram outros deuses, os deuses dos povos que estavam em seus arredores, aos quais adoraram, e provocaram à ira ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y dejaron á Jehová el Dios de sus padres, que los había sacado de la tierra de Egipto, y fuéronse tras otros dioses, los dioses de los pueblos que estaban en sus alrededores, á los cuales adoraron; y provocaron á ira á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
verses.WEB: They abandoned the LORD, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
verses.ASV: And they forsook Jehovah, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois abandonaram o SENHOR, e adoraram a Baal e a Astarote.
verses.RVR09: Y dejaron á Jehová, y adoraron á Baal y á Astaroth.

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
verses.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that despoiled them; and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a fúria do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel, e os entregou nas mãos de saqueadores que os despojaram, e os vendeu nas mãos de seus inimigos ao redor; e não puderam mais resistir diante dos seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Y el furor de Jehová se encendió contra Israel, el cual los entregó en manos de robadores que los despojaron, y los vendió en manos de sus enemigos de alrededor: y no pudieron parar más delante de sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord had said, and as the Lord had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
verses.WEB: Wherever they went out, the LORD’s hand was against them for evil, as the LORD had spoken, and as the LORD had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.
verses.ASV: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of Jehovah was against them for evil, as Jehovah had spoken, and as Jehovah had sworn unto them: and they were sore distressed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por de onde quer que saíssem, a mão do SENHOR era contra eles para o mal, como o SENHOR havia dito, e como o SENHOR lhes havia jurado; assim estiveram em grande aflição.
verses.RVR09: Por donde quiera que salían, la mano de Jehová era contra ellos para mal, como Jehová había dicho, y como Jehová se lo había jurado; así los afligió en gran manera.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the Lord raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
verses.WEB: The LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those that despoiled them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR suscitou juízes que os livrassem da mão dos que os despojavam.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová suscitó jueces que los librasen de mano de los que los despojaban.

verses.KJV: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the Lord; but they did not so.
verses.WEB: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying the LORD’s commandments. They didn’t do so.
verses.ASV: And yet they hearkened not unto their judges; for they played the harlot after other gods, and bowed themselves down unto them: they turned aside quickly out of the way wherein their fathers walked, obeying the commandments of Jehovah; [but] they did not so.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas também não ouviram aos seus juízes; em vez disso, prostituíram-se seguindo outros deuses, aos quais adoraram; desviaram-se depressa do caminho em que seus pais andaram, obedecendo aos mandamentos do SENHOR; porém eles não fizeram assim.
verses.RVR09: Y tampoco oyeron á sus jueces, sino que fornicaron tras dioses ajenos, á los cuales adoraron: apartáronse bien presto del camino en que anduvieron sus padres obedeciendo á los mandamientos de Jehová; mas ellos no hicieron así.

verses.KJV: And when the Lord raised them up judges, then the Lord was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the Lord because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
verses.WEB: When the LORD raised up judges for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved the LORD because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.
verses.ASV: And when Jehovah raised them up judges, then Jehovah was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented Jehovah because of their groaning by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o SENHOR lhes suscitava juízes, o SENHOR era com o juiz, e os livrava da mão dos inimigos todo aquele tempo daquele juiz, porque o SENHOR se arrependia pelo gemideles, por causa dos que os oprimiam e afligiam.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Jehová les suscitaba jueces, Jehová era con el juez, y librábalos de mano de los enemigos todo el tiempo de aquel juez: porque Jehová se arrepentía por sus gemidos á causa de los que los oprimían y afligían.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
verses.WEB: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.
verses.ASV: But it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their doings, nor from their stubborn way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas acontecia que, quando o juiz morria, eles se voltavam para trás, e se corrompiam mais que seus pais, seguindo outros deuses para os adorarem e se inclinarem diante deles; e nada cessavam de suas obras, nem de seu teimoso caminho.
verses.RVR09: Mas en muriendo el juez, ellos se tornaban, y se corrompían más que sus padres, siguiendo dioses ajenos para servirles, é inclinándose delante de ellos; y nada disminuían de sus obras, ni de su duro camino.

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,
verses.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel; and he said, Because this nation have transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel, e disse: “Visto que este povo transgride o meu pacto que ordenei aos seus pais, e não dá ouvidos à minha voz,
verses.RVR09: Y la ira de Jehová se encendió contra Israel, y dijo: Pues que esta gente traspasa mi pacto que ordené á sus padres, y no obedecen mi voz,

verses.KJV: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
verses.WEB: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;
verses.ASV: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations that Joshua left when he died;
verses.ALMEIDA: eu também não expulsarei mais de diante deles a nenhuma das nações que Josué deixou quando morreu;
verses.RVR09: Tampoco yo echaré más de delante de ellos á ninguna de aquestas gentes que dejó Josué cuando murió;

verses.KJV: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the Lord to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
verses.WEB: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep the LORD’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”
verses.ASV: that by them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of Jehovah to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que por elas eu provasse os israelitas, se guardariam o caminho do SENHOR andando por ele, como seus pais o guardaram, ou não.
verses.RVR09: Para que por ellas probara yo á Israel, si guardarían ellos el camino de Jehová andando por él, como sus padres lo guardaron, ó no.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
verses.WEB: So the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.
verses.ASV: So Jehovah left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o SENHOR deixou aquelas nações, e não as tirou logo, nem as entregou nas mãos de Josué.
verses.RVR09: Por esto dejó Jehová aquellas gentes, y no las desarraigó luego, ni las entregó en mano de Josué.

verses.KJV: Now these are the nations which the Lord left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
verses.WEB: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
verses.ASV: Now these are the nations which Jehovah left, to prove Israel by them, even as many [of Israel] as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas, pois, são as nações que o SENHOR deixou para provar com elas a Israel, a todos aqueles que não haviam conhecido todas as guerras de Canaã;
verses.RVR09: ESTAS, pues, son las gentes que dejó Jehová para probar con ellas á Israel, á todos aquellos que no habían conocido todas las guerras de Canaán;

verses.KJV: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
verses.WEB: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:
verses.ASV: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as beforetime knew nothing thereof:
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente para que a linhagem dos filhos de Israel conhecesse, para ensiná-los na guerra, pelo menos aos que antes não a conheciam:
verses.RVR09: Para que al menos el linaje de los hijos de Israel conociese, para enseñarlos en la guerra, siquiera fuese á los que antes no la habían conocido:

verses.KJV: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
verses.WEB: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
verses.ASV: [namely], the five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entrance of Hamath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cinco príncipes dos filisteus, e todos os cananeus, e os sidônios, e os heveus que habitavam no monte Líbano: desde o monte de Baal-Hermom até chegar a Hamate.
verses.RVR09: Cinco príncipes de los Philisteos, y todos los Cananeos, y los Sidonios, y los Heveos que habitaban en el monte Líbano: desde el monte de Baal-hermón hasta llegar á Hamath.

verses.KJV: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the Lord, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
verses.WEB: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the LORD’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.
verses.ASV: And they were [left], to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois, foram para provar por eles a Israel, para saber se obedeceriam aos mandamentos do SENHOR, que ele havia prescrito a seus pais por meio de Moisés.
verses.RVR09: Estos pues fueron para probar por ellos á Israel, para saber si obedecerían á los mandamientos de Jehová, que él había prescrito á sus padres por mano de Moisés.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
verses.WEB: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os filhos de Israel habitavam entre os cananeus, heteus, amorreus, perizeus, heveus, e jebuseus:
verses.RVR09: Así los hijos de Israel habitaban entre los Cananeos, Hetheos, Amorrheos, Pherezeos, Heveos, y Jebuseos:

verses.KJV: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
verses.WEB: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.
verses.ASV: and they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram de suas filhas por mulheres, e deram suas filhas aos filhos deles, e serviram a seus deuses.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron de sus hijas por mujeres, y dieron sus hijas á los hijos de ellos, y sirvieron á sus dioses.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and forgat the Lord their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and forgot the LORD their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and forgat Jehovah their God, and served the Baalim and the Asheroth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram, pois, os filhos de Israel o mal aos olhos do SENHOR: e esquecidos do SENHOR seu Deus, serviram aos baalins, e aos ídolos dos bosques.
verses.RVR09: Hicieron, pues, los hijos de Israel lo malo en ojos de Jehová: y olvidados de Jehová su Dios, sirvieron á los Baales, y á los ídolos de los bosques.

verses.KJV: Therefore the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
verses.ASV: Therefore the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Cushan-rishathaim eight years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel, e vendeu-os em mãos de Cusã-Risataim rei da Mesopotâmia; e serviram os filhos de Israel a Cusã-Risataim oito anos.
verses.RVR09: Y la saña de Jehová se encendió contra Israel, y vendiólos en manos de Chusan-risathaim, rey de Mesopotamia; y sirvieron los hijos de Israel á Chusan-risathaim ocho años.

verses.KJV: And when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
verses.WEB: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
verses.ASV: And when the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah, Jehovah raised up a saviour to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E clamaram os filhos de Israel ao SENHOR; e o SENHOR suscitou salvador aos filhos de Israel e livrou-os; é, a saber, a Otniel filho de Quenaz, irmão menor de Calebe.
verses.RVR09: Y clamaron los hijos de Israel á Jehová; y Jehová suscitó salvador á los hijos de Israel y librólos; es á saber, á Othoniel hijo de Cenez, hermano menor de Caleb.

verses.KJV: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the Lord delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
verses.ASV: And the Spirit of Jehovah came upon him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Jehovah delivered Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand: and his hand prevailed against Cushan-rishathaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o espírito do SENHOR foi sobre ele, e julgou a Israel, e saiu à batalha, e o SENHOR entregou em sua mão a Cusã-Risataim, rei da Síria, e prevaleceu sua mão contra Cusã-Risataim.
verses.RVR09: Y el espíritu de Jehová fué sobre él, y juzgó á Israel, y salió á batalla, y Jehová entregó en su mano á Chusan-risathaim, rey de Siria, y prevaleció su mano contra Chusan-risathaim.

verses.KJV: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.WEB: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.ASV: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E repousou a terra quarenta anos; e morreu Otniel, filho de Quenaz.
verses.RVR09: Y reposó la tierra cuarenta años; y murió Othoniel, hijo de Cenez.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and Jehovah strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltaram os filhos de Israel a fazer o mal ante os olhos do SENHOR; e o SENHOR esforçou a Eglom rei de Moabe contra Israel, porquanto fizeram o mal ante os olhos do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y tornaron los hijos de Israel á hacer lo malo ante los ojos de Jehová; y Jehová esforzó á Eglón rey de Moab contra Israel, por cuanto habían hecho lo malo ante los ojos de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
verses.WEB: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.
verses.ASV: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek; and he went and smote Israel, and they possessed the city of palm-trees.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Juntou consigo aos filhos de Amom e de Amaleque, e foi, e feriu a Israel, e tomou a cidade das palmeiras.
verses.RVR09: Y juntó consigo á los hijos de Ammón y de Amalec, y fué, é hirió á Israel, y tomó la ciudad de las palmas.

verses.KJV: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serviram os filhos de Israel a Eglom rei dos moabitas dezoito anos.
verses.RVR09: Y sirvieron los hijos de Israel á Eglón rey de los Moabitas diez y ocho años.

verses.KJV: But when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.WEB: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.ASV: But when the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah, Jehovah raised them up a saviour, Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a man left-handed. And the children of Israel sent tribute by him unto Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E clamaram os filhos de Israel ao SENHOR; e o SENHOR lhes suscitou salvador, a Eúde, filho de Gera, benjamita, o qual era canhoto. E os filhos de Israel enviaram com ele um presente a Eglom rei de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Y clamaron los hijos de Israel á Jehová; y Jehová les suscitó salvador, á Aod, hijo de Gera, Benjamita, el cual tenía cerrada la mano derecha. Y los hijos de Israel enviaron con él un presente á Eglón rey de Moab.

verses.KJV: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
verses.WEB: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.
verses.ASV: And Ehud made him a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he girded it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eúde se havia feito um punhal de dois fios, de um côvado de comprimento; e cingiu-se com ele debaixo de suas roupas à seu lado direito.
verses.RVR09: Y Aod se había hecho un puñal de dos filos, de un codo de largo; y ciñósele debajo de sus vestidos á su lado derecho.

verses.KJV: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
verses.WEB: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
verses.ASV: And he offered the tribute unto Eglon king of Moab: now Eglon was a very fat man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E apresentou o presente a Eglom rei de Moabe; e era Eglom homem muito gordo.
verses.RVR09: Y presentó el presente á Eglón rey de Moab; y era Eglón hombre muy grueso.

verses.KJV: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
verses.WEB: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.
verses.ASV: And when he had made an end of offering the tribute, he sent away the people that bare the tribute.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que apresentou o presente, despediu à gente que o havia trazido.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que hubo presentado el don, despidió á la gente que lo había traído.

verses.KJV: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
verses.WEB: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.
verses.ASV: But he himself turned back from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king. And he said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele se virou desde os ídolos que estão em Gilgal, e disse: Rei, uma palavra secreta tenho que dizer-te. Ele então disse: Cala. E sairam-se de com ele todos os que diante dele estavam.
verses.RVR09: Mas él se volvió desde los ídolos que están en Gilgal, y dijo: Rey, una palabra secreta tengo que decirte. El entonces dijo: Calla. Y saliéronse de con él todos los que delante de él estaban.

verses.KJV: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.
verses.WEB: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.
verses.ASV: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegou-se Eúde a ele, o qual estava sentado sozinho em uma sala de verão. E Eúde disse: Tenho palavra de Deus para ti. Ele então se levantou da cadeira.
verses.RVR09: Y llegóse Aod á él, el cual estaba sentado solo en una sala de verano. Y Aod dijo: Tengo palabra de Dios para ti. El entonces se levantó de la silla.

verses.KJV: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
verses.WEB: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.
verses.ASV: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Eúde meteu sua mão esquerda, e tomou o punhal de seu lado direito, e meteu-o pelo ventre;
verses.RVR09: Mas Aod metió su mano izquierda, y tomó el puñal de su lado derecho, y metióselo por el vientre;

verses.KJV: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
verses.WEB: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.
verses.ASV: and the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, for he drew not the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.
verses.ALMEIDA: De tal maneira que a empunhadura entrou também atrás a lâmina, e a gordura encerrou a lâmina, que ele não tirou o punhal de seu ventre: e saiu dele fezes.
verses.RVR09: De tal manera que la empuñadura entró también tras la hoja, y la grosura encerró la hoja, que él no sacó el puñal de su vientre: y salió el estiércol.

verses.KJV: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
verses.WEB: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.
verses.ASV: Then Ehud went forth into the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room upon him, and locked them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saindo Eúde ao pátio, fechou atrás si as portas da sala.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo Aod al patio, cerró tras sí las puertas de la sala.

verses.KJV: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
verses.WEB: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”
verses.ASV: Now when he was gone out, his servants came; and they saw, and, behold, the doors of the upper room were locked; and they said, Surely he is covering his feet in the upper chamber.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saído ele, vieram seus servos, os quais vendo as portas da sala fechadas, disseram: Sem dúvida ele está fazendo suas necessidades na sala de verão.
verses.RVR09: Y salido él, vinieron sus siervos, los cuales viendo las puertas de la sala cerradas, dijeron: Sin duda él cubre sus pies en la sala de verano.

verses.KJV: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
verses.WEB: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.
verses.ASV: And they tarried till they were ashamed; and, behold, he opened not the doors of the upper room: therefore they took the key, and opened [them]; and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo esperado até estar confusos, pois que ele não abria as portas da sala, tomaram a chave e abriram: e eis que seu senhor caído em terra morto.
verses.RVR09: Y habiendo esperado hasta estar confusos, pues que él no abría las puertas de la sala, tomaron la llave y abrieron: y he aquí su señor caído en tierra muerto.

verses.KJV: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
verses.WEB: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.
verses.ASV: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas enquanto que eles se demoravam, Eúde se escapou, e passando os ídolos, salvou-se em Seirá.
verses.RVR09: Mas entre tanto que ellos se detuvieron, Aod se escapó, y pasando los ídolos, salvóse en Seirath.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
verses.WEB: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the hill-country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill-country, and he before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando entrou, tocou a trombeta no monte de Efraim, e os filhos de Israel desceram com ele do monte, e ele ia adiante deles.
verses.RVR09: Y como hubo entrado, tocó el cuerno en el monte de Ephraim, y los hijos de Israel descendieron con él del monte, y él iba delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the Lord hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Follow after me; for Jehovah hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and suffered not a man to pass over.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lhes disse: Segui-me, porque o SENHOR entregou vossos inimigos os moabitas em vossas mãos. E desceram atrás dele, e tomaram os vaus do Jordão a Moabe, e não deixaram passar a ninguém.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él les dijo: Seguidme, porque Jehová ha entregado vuestros enemigos los Moabitas en vuestras manos. Y descendieron en pos de él, y tomaron los vados del Jordán á Moab, y no dejaron pasar á ninguno.

verses.KJV: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
verses.WEB: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.
verses.ASV: And they smote of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, every lusty man, and every man of valor; and there escaped not a man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele tempo feriram dos moabitas como dez mil homens, todos valentes e todos homens de guerra; não escapou homem.
verses.RVR09: Y en aquel tiempo hirieron de los Moabitas como diez mil hombres, todos valientes y todos hombres de guerra; no escapó hombre.

verses.KJV: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
verses.WEB: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.
verses.ASV: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim restou Moabe subjugado aquele dia sob a mão de Israel: e repousou a terra oitenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Así quedó Moab sojuzgado aquel día bajo la mano de Israel: y reposó la tierra ochenta años.

verses.KJV: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
verses.WEB: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.
verses.ASV: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who smote of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox-goad: and he also saved Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois deste foi Sangar filho de Anate, o qual feriu seiscentos homens dos filisteus com uma aguilhada de bois; e ele também salvou a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Después de éste fué Samgar hijo de Anat, el cual hirió seiscientos hombres de los Filisteos con una aguijada de bueyes; y él también salvó á Israel.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, when Ehud was dead.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, when Ehud was dead.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, when Ehud was dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os filhos de Israel voltaram a fazer o mal aos olhos do SENHOR, depois da morte de Eúde.
verses.RVR09: MAS los hijos de Israel tornaron á hacer lo malo en ojos de Jehová, después de la muerte de Aod.

verses.KJV: And the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: The LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, who dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR os vendeu em mão de Jabim rei de Canaã, o qual reinou em Hazor: e o capitão de seu exército se chamava Sísera, e ele habitava em Harosete das nações.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová los vendió en mano de Jabín rey de Canaán, el cual reinó en Asor: y el capitán de su ejército se llamaba Sísara, y él habitaba en Haroseth de las Gentes.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel cried unto the Lord: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel clamaram ao SENHOR, porque aquele tinha novecentos carros de ferro: e havia afligido em grande maneira aos filhos de Israel por vinte anos.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Israel clamaron á Jehová, porque aquél tenía nuevecientos carros herrados: y había afligido en gran manera á los hijos de Israel por veinte años.

verses.KJV: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
verses.WEB: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.
verses.ASV: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
verses.ALMEIDA: E governava naquele tempo a Israel uma mulher, Débora, profetisa, mulher de Lapidote:
verses.RVR09: Y gobernaba en aquel tiempo á Israel una mujer, Débora, profetisa, mujer de Lapidoth:

verses.KJV: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.WEB: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.ASV: And she dwelt under the palm-tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in the hill-country of Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual se sentava debaixo da palmeira de Débora entre Ramá e Betel, no monte de Efraim: e os filhos de Israel subiam a ela a juízo.
verses.RVR09: La cual Débora habitaba debajo de una palma entre Rama y Beth-el, en el monte de Ephraim: y los hijos de Israel subían á ella á juicio.

verses.KJV: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the Lord God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
verses.WEB: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
verses.ASV: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not Jehovah, the God of Israel, commanded, [saying], Go and draw unto mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela mandou chamar a Baraque filho de Abinoão, de Quedes de Naftali, e disse-lhe: Não te mandou o SENHOR Deus de Israel, dizendo: Vai, e ajunta gente no monte de Tabor, e toma contigo dez mil homens dos filhos de Naftali, e dos filhos de Zebulom:
verses.RVR09: Y ella envió á llamar á Barac hijo de Abinoam, de Cedes de Nephtalí, y díjole: ¿No te ha mandado Jehová Dios de Israel, diciendo: Ve, y haz gente en el monte de Tabor, y toma contigo diez mil hombres de los hijos de Nephtalí, y de los hijos de Zabulón:

verses.KJV: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.
verses.WEB: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”
verses.ASV: And I will draw unto thee, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu atrairei a ti ao ribeiro de Quisom a Sísera, capitão do exército de Jabim, com seus carros e seu exército, e o entregarei em tuas mãos?
verses.RVR09: Y yo atraeré á ti al arroyo de Cisón á Sísara, capitán del ejército de Jabín, con sus carros y su ejército, y entregarélo en tus manos?

verses.KJV: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.
verses.WEB: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”
verses.ASV: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go; but if thou wilt not go with me, I will not go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Baraque lhe respondeu: Se tu fores comigo, eu irei: mas se não fores comigo, não irei.
verses.RVR09: Y Barac le respondió: Si tú fueres conmigo, yo iré: pero si no fueres conmigo, no iré.

verses.KJV: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the Lord shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.WEB: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for the LORD will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.ASV: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding, the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honor; for Jehovah will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse: Irei contigo; mas não será tua honra no caminho que vais; porque por mão de mulher venderá o SENHOR a Sísera. E levantando-se Débora foi com Baraque a Quedes.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: Iré contigo; mas no será tu honra en el camino que vas; porque en mano de mujer venderá Jehová á Sísara. Y levantándose Débora fué con Barac á Cedes.

verses.KJV: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
verses.WEB: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.
verses.ASV: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh; and there went up ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntou Baraque a Zebulom e a Naftali em Quedes, e subiu com dez mil homens a seu mando, e Débora subiu com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y juntó Barac á Zabulón y á Nephtalí en Cedes, y subió con diez mil hombres á su mando, y Débora subió con él.

verses.KJV: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
verses.WEB: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.
verses.ASV: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab the brother-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Héber queneu, dos filhos de Hobabe sogro de Moisés, havia se afastado dos queneus, e posto sua tenda até o vale de Zaanim, que está junto a Quedes.
verses.RVR09: Y Heber Cineo, de los hijos de Hobab suegro de Moisés, se había apartado de los Cineos, y puesto su tienda hasta el valle de Zaananim, que está junto á Cedes.

verses.KJV: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
verses.WEB: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.
verses.ASV: And they told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vieram, pois, as notícias a Sísera como Baraque filho de Abinoão havia subido ao monte de Tabor.
verses.RVR09: Vinieron pues las nuevas á Sísara como Barac hijo de Abinoam había subido al monte de Tabor.

verses.KJV: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
verses.WEB: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.
verses.ASV: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, unto the river Kishon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reuniu Sísera todos os seus carros, novecentos carros de ferro, com todo o povo que com ele estava, desde Harosete das Nações até o ribeiro de Quisom.
verses.RVR09: Y reunió Sísara todos sus carros, nuevecientos carros herrados, con todo el pueblo que con él estaba, desde Haroseth de las Gentes hasta el arroyo de Cisón.

verses.KJV: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the Lord hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the Lord gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
verses.WEB: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t the LORD gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
verses.ASV: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which Jehovah hath delivered Sisera into thy hand; is not Jehovah gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Débora disse a Baraque: Levanta-te; porque este é o dia em que o SENHOR entregou a Sísera em tuas mãos: Não saiu o SENHOR diante de ti? E Baraque desceu do monte de Tabor, e dez mil homens atrás dele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Débora dijo á Barac: Levántate; porque este es el día en que Jehová ha entregado á Sísara en tus manos. ¿No ha salido Jehová delante de ti? Y Barac descendió del monte de Tabor, y diez mil hombres en pos de él.

verses.KJV: And the Lord discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
verses.WEB: The LORD confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; and Sisera alighted from his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR derrotou a Sísera, e a todos os seus carros e a todo seu exército, a fio de espada diante de Baraque: e Sísera desceu do carro, e fugiu a pé.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová desbarató á Sísara, y á todos sus carros y á todo su ejército, á filo de espada delante de Barac: y Sísara descendió del carro, y huyó á pie.

verses.KJV: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
verses.WEB: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.
verses.ASV: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword; there was not a man left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Baraque seguiu os carros e o exército até Harosete das Nações, e todo aquele exército de Sísera caiu a fio de espada até não restar nenhum.
verses.RVR09: Mas Barac siguió los carros y el ejército hasta Haroseth de las Gentes, y todo el ejército de Sísara cayó á filo de espada, hasta no quedar ni uno.

verses.KJV: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.WEB: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.ASV: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Sísera se refugiou a pé à tenda de Jael mulher de Héber queneu; porque havia paz entre Jabim rei de Hazor e a casa de Héber queneu.
verses.RVR09: Y Sísara se acogió á pie á la tienda de Jael mujer de Heber Cineo; porque había paz entre Jabín rey de Asor y la casa de Heber Cineo.

verses.KJV: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
verses.WEB: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.
verses.ASV: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And he turned in unto her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saindo Jael a receber a Sísera, disse-lhe: Vem, senhor meu, vem a mim, não tenhas medo. E ele veio a ela à tenda, e ela lhe cobriu com uma manta.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo Jael á recibir á Sísara, díjole: Ven, señor mío, ven á mí, no tengas temor. Y él vino á ella á la tienda, y ella le cubrió con una manta.

verses.KJV: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
verses.WEB: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Rogo-te me dês a beber um pouco de água, que tenho sede. E ela abriu um odre de leite e deu-lhe de beber, e voltou-lhe a cobrir.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Ruégote me des á beber una poca de agua, que tengo sed. Y ella abrió un odre de leche y dióle de beber, y tornóle á cubrir.

verses.KJV: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
verses.WEB: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and inquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Fica-te à porta da tenda, e se alguém vier, e te perguntar, dizendo: Há aqui alguém? Tu responderás que não.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Estáte á la puerta de la tienda, y si alguien viniere, y te preguntare, diciendo: ¿Hay aquí alguno? tú responderás que no.

verses.KJV: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
verses.WEB: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.
verses.ASV: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a tent-pin, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground; for he was in a deep sleep; so he swooned and died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jael, mulher de Héber, tomou uma estaca da tenda, e pondo uma marreta em sua mão, veio a ele caladamente, e meteu-lhe a estaca pela têmpora, e encravou-o na terra, pois ele estava carregado de sonho e cansado; e assim morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y Jael, mujer de Heber, tomó una estaca de la tienda, y poniendo un mazo en su mano, vino á él calladamente, y metióle la estaca por las sienes, y enclavólo en la tierra, pues él estaba cargado de sueño y cansado; y así murió.

verses.KJV: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.
verses.WEB: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.
verses.ASV: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will show thee the man whom thou seekest. And he came unto her; and, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent-pin was in his temples.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seguindo Baraque a Sísera, Jael saiu a recebê-lo, e disse-lhe: Vem, e te mostrarei ao homem que tu buscas. E ele entrou de onde ela estava, e eis que Sísera jazia morto com a estaca pela têmpora.
verses.RVR09: Y siguiendo Barac á Sísara, Jael salió á recibirlo, y díjole: Ven, y te mostraré al varón que tú buscas. Y él entró donde ella estaba, y he aquí Sísara yacía muerto con la estaca por la sien.

verses.KJV: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.
verses.ASV: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim abateu Deus aquele dia a Jabim, rei de Canaã, diante dos filhos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Así abatió Dios aquel día á Jabín, rey de Canaán, delante de los hijos de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.WEB: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.ASV: And the hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mão dos filhos de Israel começou a crescer e a fortificar-se contra Jabim rei de Canaã, até que o destruíram.
verses.RVR09: Y la mano de los hijos de Israel comenzó á crecer y á fortificarse contra Jabín rey de Canaán, hasta que lo destruyeron.

verses.KJV: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
verses.WEB: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
verses.ASV: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele dia cantou Débora, com Baraque, filho de Abinoão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y AQUEL día cantó Débora, con Barac, hijo de Abinoam, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
verses.WEB: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, LORD!
verses.ASV: For that the leaders took the lead in Israel, For that the people offered themselves willingly, Bless ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vingou as injúrias de Israel, Porque o povo se ofereceu de sua vontade, Louvai ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque ha vengado las injurias de Israel, porque el pueblo se ha ofrecido de su voluntad, load á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the Lord; I will sing praise to the Lord God of Israel.
verses.WEB: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to the LORD. I will sing praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, [even] I, will sing unto Jehovah; I will sing praise to Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi, reis; estai atentos, ó príncipes: Eu cantarei ao SENHOR, Cantarei salmos ao SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Oid, reyes; estad, oh príncipes, atentos: yo cantaré á Jehová, cantaré salmos á Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: Lord, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
verses.WEB: “LORD, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.
verses.ASV: Jehovah, when thou wentest forth out of Seir, When thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped, Yea, the clouds dropped water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando saíste de Seir, ó SENHOR, Quando te apartaste do campo de Edom, A terra tremeu, e os céus destilaram, E as nuvens gotejaram águas.
verses.RVR09: Cuando saliste de Seir, oh Jehová, cuando te apartaste del campo de Edom, la tierra tembló, y los cielos destilaron, y las nubes gotearon aguas.

verses.KJV: The mountains melted from before the Lord, even that Sinai from before the Lord God of Israel.
verses.WEB: The mountains quaked at the LORD’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: The mountains quaked at the presence of Jehovah, Even yon Sinai at the presence of Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes se derreteram diante do SENHOR, Até o Sinai, diante do SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Los montes se derritieron delante de Jehová, aqueste Sinaí, delante de Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
verses.WEB: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.
verses.ASV: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, In the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, And the travellers walked through byways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em os dias de Sangar filho de Anate, Em os dias de Jael, cessaram os caminhos, E os que andavam pelas sendas apartavam-se por veredas torcidas.
verses.RVR09: En los días de Samgar hijo de Anath, en los días de Jael, cesaron los caminos, y los que andaban por las sendas apartábanse por torcidos senderos.

verses.KJV: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
verses.WEB: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.
verses.ASV: The rulers ceased in Israel, they ceased, Until that I Deborah arose, That I arose a mother in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: As aldeias haviam cessado em Israel, haviam decaído; Até que eu Débora me levantei, Me levantei mãe em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Las aldeas habían cesado en Israel, habían decaído; hasta que yo Débora me levanté, me levanté madre en Israel.

verses.KJV: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.WEB: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.ASV: They chose new gods; Then was war in the gates: Was there a shield or spear seen Among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Em escolhendo novos deuses, A guerra estava às portas: Se via escudo ou lança Entre quarenta mil em Israel?
verses.RVR09: En escogiendo nuevos dioses, la guerra estaba á las puertas: ¿se veía escudo ó lanza entre cuarenta mil en Israel?

verses.KJV: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the LORD!
verses.ASV: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, That offered themselves willingly among the people: Bless ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu coração está pelos líderes de Israel, Os que com boa vontade se ofereceram entre o povo: Louvai ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mi corazón está por los príncipes de Israel, los que con buena voluntad se ofrecieron entre el pueblo: load á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
verses.WEB: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
verses.ASV: Tell [of it], ye that ride on white asses, Ye that sit on rich carpets, And ye that walk by the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós os que cavalgais em asnas brancas, Os que presidis em juízo, E vós os que viajais, falai.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros los que cabalgáis en asnas blancas, los que presidís en juicio, y vosotros los que viajáis, hablad.

verses.KJV: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the Lord, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the Lord go down to the gates.
verses.WEB: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse the LORD’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then the LORD’s people went down to the gates.
verses.ASV: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, There shall they rehearse the righteous acts of Jehovah, [Even] the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. Then the people of Jehovah went down to the gates.
verses.ALMEIDA: Longe do ruído dos arqueiros, nos bebedouros, Ali repetirão as justiças do SENHOR, As justiças de suas vilas em Israel; Então o povo do SENHOR desceu às portas.
verses.RVR09: Lejos del ruido de los archeros, en los abrevaderos, allí repetirán las justicias de Jehová, las justicias de sus villas en Israel; entonces bajará el pueblo de Jehová á las puertas.

verses.KJV: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
verses.WEB: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’
verses.ASV: Awake, awake, Deborah; Awake, awake, utter a song: Arise, Barak, and lead away thy captives, thou son of Abinoam.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desperta, desperta, Débora; Desperta, desperta, profere um cântico. Levanta-te, Baraque, e leva teus cativos, filho de Abinoão.
verses.RVR09: Despierta, despierta, Débora; despierta, despierta, profiere un cántico. Levántate, Barac, y lleva tus cautivos, hijo de Abinoam.

verses.KJV: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the Lord made me have dominion over the mighty.
verses.WEB: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. The LORD came down for me against the mighty.
verses.ASV: Then came down a remnant of the nobles [and] the people; Jehovah came down for me against the mighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então fez que o que restou do povo, senhoreie aos poderosos: o SENHOR me fez senhorear sobre os fortes.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ha hecho que el que quedó del pueblo, señoree á los magníficos: Jehová me hizo enseñorear sobre los fuertes.

verses.KJV: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
verses.WEB: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.
verses.ASV: Out of Ephraim [came down] they whose root is in Amalek; After thee, Benjamin, among thy peoples; Out of Machir came down governors, And out of Zebulun they that handle the marshal’s staff.
verses.ALMEIDA: De Efraim saiu sua raiz contra Amaleque, Depois ti, Benjamim, contra teus povos; De Maquir desceram príncipes, E de Zebulom os que costumavam manejar vara de oficial.
verses.RVR09: De Ephraim salió su raíz contra Amalec tras ti, Benjamín, contra tus pueblos; de Machîr descendieron príncipes, y de Zabulón los que solían manejar punzón de escribiente.

verses.KJV: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
verses.WEB: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.
verses.ASV: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; As was Issachar, so was Barak; Into the valley they rushed forth at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben There were great resolves of heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Príncipes também de Issacar foram com Débora; E como Issacar, também Baraque Se pôs a pé no vale. Das divisões de Rúben houve grandes impressões do coração.
verses.RVR09: Príncipes también de Issachâr fueron con Débora; y como Issachâr, también Barac se puso á pie en el valle. De las divisiones de Rubén hubo grandes impresiones del corazón.

verses.KJV: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
verses.WEB: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.
verses.ASV: Why sattest thou among the sheepfolds, To hear the pipings for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben There were great searchings of heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que te restaste entre os currais, Para ouvir os balidos dos rebanhos? Das divisões de Rúben Grandes foram os questionamentos do coração.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué te quedaste entre las majadas, para oir los balidos de los rebaños? De las divisiones de Rubén grandes fueron las disquisiciones del corazón.

verses.KJV: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
verses.WEB: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.
verses.ASV: Gilead abode beyond the Jordan: And Dan, why did he remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, And abode by his creeks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gileade se restou da outra parte do Jordão: E Dã por que se esteve junto aos navios? Manteve-se Aser à beira do mar, E ficou em seus portos.
verses.RVR09: Galaad se quedó de la otra parte del Jordán: y Dan ¿por qué se estuvo junto á los navíos? Mantúvose Aser á la ribera de la mar, y quedóse en sus puertos.

verses.KJV: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
verses.WEB: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
verses.ASV: Zebulun was a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death, And Naphtali, upon the high places of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: O povo de Zebulom expôs sua vida à morte, E Naftali nas alturas do campo.
verses.RVR09: El pueblo de Zabulón expuso su vida á la muerte, y Nephtalí en las alturas del campo.

verses.KJV: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
verses.WEB: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.
verses.ASV: The kings came and fought; Then fought the kings of Canaan, In Taanach by the waters of Megiddo: They took no gain of money.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vieram reis e lutaram: Então lutaram os reis de Canaã Em Taanaque, junto às águas de Megido, Mas não levaram despojo algum de dinheiro.
verses.RVR09: Vinieron reyes y pelearon: entonces pelearon los reyes de Canaán en Taanac, junto á las aguas de Megiddo, mas no llevaron ganancia alguna de dinero.

verses.KJV: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
verses.WEB: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.
verses.ASV: From heaven fought the stars, From their courses they fought against Sisera.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos céus lutaram: As estrelas desde suas órbitas lutaram contra Sísera.
verses.RVR09: De los cielos pelearon: las estrellas desde sus órbitas pelearon contra Sísara.

verses.KJV: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
verses.WEB: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.
verses.ASV: The river Kishon swept them away, That ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, march on with strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Varreu-os o ribeiro de Quisom, O antigo ribeiro, o ribeiro de Quisom. Pisaste, ó alma minha, com força.
verses.RVR09: Barriólos el torrente de Cisón, el antiguo torrente, el torrente de Cisón. Hollaste, oh alma mía, con fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
verses.WEB: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.
verses.ASV: Then did the horsehoofs stamp By reason of the prancings, the prancings of their strong ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Espancaram-se então os cascos dos cavalos pelas arremetidas, pelos galopes de seus fortes cavalos.
verses.RVR09: Despalmáronse entonces las uñas de los caballos por las arremetidas, por los brincos de sus valientes.

verses.KJV: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the Lord, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the Lord, to the help of the Lord against the mighty.
verses.WEB: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the LORD’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.’
verses.ASV: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of Jehovah. Curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof, Because they came not to the help of Jehovah, To the help of Jehovah against the mighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amaldiçoai a Meroz, disse o anjo do SENHOR: Amaldiçoai severamente a seus moradores, Porque não vieram em socorro ao SENHOR, Em socorro ao SENHOR contra os fortes.
verses.RVR09: Maldecid á Meroz, dijo el ángel de Jehová: maldecid severamente á sus moradores, porque no vinieron en socorro á Jehová, en socorro á Jehová contra los fuertes.

verses.KJV: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.WEB: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.ASV: Blessed above women shall Jael be, The wife of Heber the Kenite; Blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendita seja entre as mulheres Jael, Mulher de Héber queneu; Sobre as mulheres bendita seja na tenda.
verses.RVR09: Bendita sea entre las mujeres Jael, mujer de Heber Cineo; sobre las mujeres bendita sea en la tienda.

verses.KJV: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
verses.WEB: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
verses.ASV: He asked water, [and] she gave him milk; She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele pediu água, e deu-lhe ela leite; Em taça de nobres lhe apresentou manteiga.
verses.RVR09: El pidió agua, y dióle ella leche; en tazón de nobles le presentó manteca.

verses.KJV: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
verses.WEB: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.
verses.ASV: She put her hand to the tent-pin, And her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; And with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote through his head; Yea, she pierced and struck through his temples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua mão estendeu à estaca, E sua direita a marreta de trabalhadores; E golpeou a Sísera, feriu sua cabeça, esmagou e atravessou suas têmporas.
verses.RVR09: Su mano tendió á la estaca, y su diestra al mazo de trabajadores; y majó á Sísara, hirió su cabeza, llagó y atravesó sus sienes.

verses.KJV: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.WEB: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.ASV: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay; At her feet he bowed, he fell: Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caiu encurvado entre seus pés, ficou estendido: Entre seus pés caiu encurvado; Onde se encurvou, ali caiu morto.
verses.RVR09: Cayó encorvado entre sus pies, quedó tendido: entre sus pies cayó encorvado; donde se encorvó, allí cayó muerto.

verses.KJV: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
verses.WEB: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait?’
verses.ASV: Through the window she looked forth, and cried, The mother of Sisera [cried] through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
verses.ALMEIDA: A mãe de Sísera olha à janela, E por entre as grades a vozes disse: Por que se detém seu carro, que não vem? Por que as rodas de seus carros se tardam?
verses.RVR09: La madre de Sísara se asoma á la ventana, y por entre las celosías á voces dice: ¿Por qué se detiene su carro, que no viene? ¿por qué las ruedas de sus carros se tardan?

verses.KJV: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
verses.WEB: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,
verses.ASV: Her wise ladies answered her, Yea, she returned answer to herself,
verses.ALMEIDA: As mais avisadas de suas damas lhe respondiam; E ainda ela se respondia a si mesma.
verses.RVR09: Las más avisadas de sus damas le respondían; y aun ella se respondía á sí misma.

verses.KJV: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
verses.WEB: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’
verses.ASV: Have they not found, have they not divided the spoil? A damsel, two damsels to every man; To Sisera a spoil of dyed garments, A spoil of dyed garments embroidered, Of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the spoil?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não acharam despojos, e os estão repartindo? A cada um uma moça, ou duas: Os despojos de cores para Sísera, Os despojos bordados de cores: A roupa de cor bordada de ambos os lados, para os pescoços dos que tomaram os despojos.
verses.RVR09: ¿No han hallado despojos, y los están repartiendo? á cada uno una moza, ó dos: los despojos de colores para Sísara, los despojos bordados de colores: la ropa de color bordada de ambos lados, para los cuellos de los que han tomado los despojos.

verses.KJV: So let all thine enemies perish, O Lord: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verses.WEB: “So let all your enemies perish, LORD, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.
verses.ASV: So let all thine enemies perish, O Jehovah: But let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim pereçam todos os teus inimigos, ó SENHOR: Mas os que lhe amam, sejam como o sol quando nasce em sua força. E a terra repousou quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Así perezcan todos tus enemigos, oh Jehová: mas los que le aman, sean como el sol cuando nace en su fuerza. Y la tierra reposó cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, so the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and Jehovah delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os filhos de Israel fizeram o mal aos olhos do SENHOR; e o SENHOR os entregou nas mãos de Midiã por sete anos.
verses.RVR09: MAS los hijos de Israel hicieron lo malo en los ojos de Jehová; y Jehová los entregó en las manos de Madián por siete años.

verses.KJV: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
verses.WEB: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.
verses.ASV: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and the caves, and the strongholds.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mão de Midiã prevaleceu contra Israel. E os filhos de Israel, por causa dos midianitas, se fizeram covas nos montes, e cavernas, e lugares fortes.
verses.RVR09: Y la mano de Madián prevaleció contra Israel. Y los hijos de Israel, por causa de los Madianitas, se hicieron cuevas en los montes, y cavernas, y lugares fuertes.

verses.KJV: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
verses.WEB: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
verses.ASV: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east; they came up against them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quando os de Israel haviam semeado, subiam os midianitas, e amalequitas, e os orientais: subiam contra eles;
verses.RVR09: Pues como los de Israel habían sembrado, subían los Madianitas, y Amalecitas, y los orientales: subían contra ellos;

verses.KJV: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
verses.WEB: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.
verses.ASV: and they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance in Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assentando acampamento contra eles destruíam os frutos da terra, até chegar a Gaza; e não deixavam o que comer em Israel, nem ovelhas, nem bois, nem asnos.
verses.RVR09: Y asentando campo contra ellos destruían los frutos de la tierra, hasta llegar á Gaza; y no dejaban qué comer en Israel, ni ovejas, ni bueyes, ni asnos.

verses.KJV: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
