verses.WEB: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.
verses.ASV: For they came up with their cattle and their tents; they came in as locusts for multitude; both they and their camels were without number: and they came into the land to destroy it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque subiam eles e seus gados, e vinham com suas tendas em grande multidão como gafanhotos, que não havia número neles nem em seus camelos: assim vinham à terra para devastá-la.
verses.RVR09: Porque subían ellos y sus ganados, y venían con sus tiendas en grande multitud como langosta, que no había número en ellos ni en sus camellos: así venían á la tierra para devastarla.

verses.KJV: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Era, pois, Israel em grande maneira empobrecido pelos midianitas; e os filhos de Israel clamaram ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Era pues Israel en gran manera empobrecido por los Madianitas; y los hijos de Israel clamaron á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord because of the Midianites,
verses.WEB: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD because of Midian,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah because of Midian,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os filhos de Israel clamaram ao SENHOR, por causa dos midianitas,
verses.RVR09: Y cuando los hijos de Israel hubieron clamado á Jehová, á causa de los Madianitas,

verses.KJV: That the Lord sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
verses.WEB: The LORD sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.
verses.ASV: that Jehovah sent a prophet unto the children of Israel: and he said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR enviou um homem profeta aos filhos de Israel, o qual lhes disse: Assim disse o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Eu vos fiz sair do Egito, e vos tirei da casa de servidão:
verses.RVR09: Jehová envió un varón profeta á los hijos de Israel, el cual les dijo: Así ha dicho Jehová Dios de Israel: Yo os hice salir de Egipto, y os saqué de la casa de servidumbre:

verses.KJV: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
verses.WEB: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land.
verses.ASV: and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos livrei da mão dos egípcios, e da mão de todos os que vos afligiram, aos quais expulsei de diante de vós, e vos dei sua terra;
verses.RVR09: Yo os libré de mano de los Egipcios, y de mano de todos los que os afligieron, á los cuales eché de delante de vosotros, y os dí su tierra;

verses.KJV: And I said unto you, I am the Lord your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
verses.WEB: I said to you, “I am the LORD your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”
verses.ASV: and I said unto you, I am Jehovah your God; ye shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell. But ye have not hearkened unto my voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-vos: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus; não temais aos deuses dos amorreus, em cuja terra habitais; mas não obedecestes à minha voz.
verses.RVR09: Y díjeos: Yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios; no temáis á los dioses de los Amorrheos, en cuya tierra habitáis: mas no habéis obedecido á mi voz.

verses.KJV: And there came an angel of the Lord, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah came, and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon was beating out wheat in the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio o anjo do SENHOR, e sentou-se debaixo do carvalho que está em Ofra, o qual era de Joás abiezrita; e seu filho Gideão estava malhando o trigo na prensa de uvas, para fazê-lo esconder dos midianitas.
verses.RVR09: Y vino el ángel de Jehová, y sentóse debajo del alcornoque que está en Ophra, el cual era de Joas Abiezerita; y su hijo Gedeón estaba sacudiendo el trigo en el lagar, para hacerlo esconder de los Madianitas.

verses.KJV: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him, and said unto him, The Lord is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “The LORD is with you, you mighty man of valor!”
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah appeared unto him, and said unto him, Jehovah is with thee, thou mighty man of valor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo do SENHOR se lhe apareceu, e disse-lhe: O SENHOR é contigo, homem esforçado.
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel de Jehová se le apareció, y díjole: Jehová es contigo, varón esforzado.

verses.KJV: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the Lord be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the Lord bring us up from Egypt? but now the Lord hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
verses.WEB: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t the LORD bring us up from Egypt?’ But now the LORD has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”
verses.ASV: And Gideon said unto him, Oh, my lord, if Jehovah is with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not Jehovah bring us up from Egypt? but now Jehovah hath cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gideão lhe respondeu: Ah, Senhor meu, se o SENHOR é conosco, por que nos sobreveio tudo isto? E onde estão todas suas maravilhas, que nossos pais nos contaram, dizendo: Não nos tirou o SENHOR do Egito? E agora o SENHOR nos desamparou, e nos entregou nas mãos dos midianitas.
verses.RVR09: Y Gedeón le respondió: Ah, Señor mío, si Jehová es con nosotros, ¿por qué nos ha sobrevenido todo esto? ¿Y dónde están todas sus maravillas, que nuestros padres nos han contado, diciendo: ¿No nos sacó Jehová de Egipto? Y ahora Jehová nos ha desamparado, y nos ha entregado en mano de los Madianitas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
verses.WEB: The LORD looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian: have not I sent thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhando-lhe o SENHOR, disse-lhe: Vai com esta tua força, e salvarás a Israel da mão dos midianitas. Não te envio eu?
verses.RVR09: Y mirándole Jehová, díjole: Ve con esta tu fortaleza, y salvarás á Israel de la mano de los Madianitas. ¿No te envío yo?

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Oh, Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então lhe respondeu: Ah, Senhor meu, com que tenho de salvar a Israel? Eis que minha família é pobre em Manassés, e eu o menor na casa de meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Entonces le respondió: Ah, Señor mío, ¿con qué tengo de salvar á Israel? He aquí que mi familia es pobre en Manasés, y yo el menor en la casa de mi padre.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR lhe disse: Porque eu serei contigo, e ferirás aos midianitas como a um só homem.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová le dijo: Porque yo seré contigo, y herirás á los Madianitas como á un solo hombre.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, If now I have found favor in thy sight, then show me a sign that it is thou that talkest with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Eu te rogo que, se achei favor diante de ti, me dês sinal de que tu falaste comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Yo te ruego, que si he hallado gracia delante de ti, me des señal de que tú has hablado conmigo.

verses.KJV: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
verses.WEB: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”
verses.ASV: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and lay it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo-te que não te vás daqui, até que eu volte a ti, e traga a minha oferta, e a ponha diante de ti. E ele respondeu: Eu esperarei até que voltes.
verses.RVR09: Ruégote que no te vayas de aquí, hasta que á ti vuelva, y saque mi presente, y lo ponga delante de ti. Y él respondió: Yo esperaré hasta que vuelvas.

verses.KJV: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
verses.WEB: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.
verses.ASV: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrando-se Gideão preparou um cabrito, e pães sem levedura de um efa de farinha; e pôs a carne em um cesto, e o caldo em uma caçarola, e tirando-o apresentou-lhe debaixo daquele carvalho.
verses.RVR09: Y entrándose Gedeón aderezó un cabrito, y panes sin levadura de un epha de harina; y puso la carne en un canastillo, y el caldo en una olla, y sacándolo presentóselo debajo de aquel alcornoque.

verses.KJV: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
verses.WEB: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” He did so.
verses.ASV: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo de Deus lhe disse: Toma a carne, e os pães sem levedura, e põe-o sobre esta penha, e derrama o caldo. E ele o fez assim.
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel de Dios le dijo: Toma la carne, y los panes sin levadura, y ponlo sobre esta peña, y vierte el caldo. Y él lo hizo así.

verses.KJV: Then the angel of the Lord put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the Lord departed out of his sight.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then the LORD’s angel departed out of his sight.
verses.ASV: Then the angel of Jehovah put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there went up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and the angel of Jehovah departed out of his sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estendendo o anjo do SENHOR o bordão que tinha em sua mão, tocou com a ponta na carne e nos pães sem levedura; e subiu fogo da penha, o qual consumiu a carne e os pães sem levedura. E o anjo do SENHOR desapareceu de diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y extendiendo el ángel de Jehová el bordón que tenía en su mano, tocó con la punta en la carne y en los panes sin levadura; y subió fuego de la peña, el cual consumió la carne y los panes sin levadura. Y el ángel de Jehová desapareció de delante de él.

verses.KJV: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the Lord, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord God! for because I have seen an angel of the Lord face to face.
verses.WEB: Gideon saw that he was the LORD’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord GOD! Because I have seen the LORD’s angel face to face!”
verses.ASV: And Gideon saw that he was the angel of Jehovah; and Gideon said, Alas, O Lord Jehovah! forasmuch as I have seen the angel of Jehovah face to face.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Gideão que era o anjo do SENHOR, disse: Ah, Senhor DEUS, que vi o anjo do SENHOR face a face.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Gedeón que era el ángel de Jehová, dijo: Ah, Señor Jehová, que he visto el ángel de Jehová cara á cara.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR lhe disse: Paz seja contigo; não tenhas medo, não morrerás.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová le dijo: Paz á ti; no tengas temor, no morirás.

verses.KJV: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the Lord, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.WEB: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it “The LORD is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.ASV: Then Gideon built an altar there unto Jehovah, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou ali Gideão altar ao SENHOR, ao que chamou O SENHOR é paz: está até hoje em Ofra dos abiezritas.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó allí Gedeón altar á Jehová, al que llamó Jehová-salom: está hasta hoy en Ophra de los Abiezeritas.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass the same night, that the Lord said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:
verses.WEB: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Take your father’s bull, even the second bull seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the Asherah that is by it.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass the same night, that Jehovah said unto him, Take thy father’s bullock, even the second bullock seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the Asherah that is by it;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que a mesma noite lhe disse o SENHOR: Toma um touro do rebanho de teu pai, e outro touro de sete anos, e derruba o altar de Baal que teu pai tem, e corta também o bosque que está junto a ele:
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que la misma noche le dijo Jehová: Toma un toro del hato de tu padre, y otro toro de siete años, y derriba el altar de Baal que tu padre tiene, y corta también el bosque que está junto á él:

verses.KJV: And build an altar unto the Lord thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
verses.WEB: Then build an altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”
verses.ASV: and build an altar unto Jehovah thy God upon the top of this stronghold, in the orderly manner, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt-offering with the wood of the Asherah which thou shalt cut down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edifica altar ao SENHOR teu Deus no cume deste penhasco em lugar conveniente; e tomando o segundo touro, sacrifica-o em holocausto sobre a lenha do bosque que haverás cortado.
verses.RVR09: Y edifica altar á Jehová tu Dios en la cumbre de este peñasco en lugar conveniente; y tomando el segundo toro, sacrifícalo en holocausto sobre la leña del bosque que habrás cortado.

verses.KJV: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the Lord had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
verses.WEB: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.
verses.ASV: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Jehovah had spoken unto him: and it came to pass, because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, so that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Gideão tomou dez homens de seus servos, e fez como o SENHOR lhe disse. Mas temendo fazê-lo de dia, pela família de seu pai e pelos homens da cidade, o fez de noite.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Gedeón tomó diez hombres de sus siervos, é hizo como Jehová le dijo. Mas temiendo hacerlo de día, por la familia de su padre y por los hombres de la ciudad, hízolo de noche.

verses.KJV: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
verses.WEB: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.
verses.ASV: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à manhã, quando os da cidade se levantaram, eis que o altar de Baal estava derrubado, e cortado o bosque que junto a ele estava, e sacrificado aquele segundo touro em holocausto sobre o altar edificado.
verses.RVR09: Y á la mañana, cuando los de la ciudad se levantaron, he aquí que el altar de Baal estaba derribado, y cortado el bosque que junto á él estaba, y sacrificado aquel segundo toro en holocausto sobre el altar edificado.

verses.KJV: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
verses.WEB: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?” When they inquired and asked, they said, “Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.”
verses.ASV: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they inquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E diziam-se uns aos outros: Quem fez isto? E buscando e investigando, disseram-lhes: Gideão filho de Joás o fez. Então os homens da cidade disseram a Joás:
verses.RVR09: Y decíanse unos á otros: ¿Quién ha hecho esto? Y buscando é inquiriendo, dijéronles: Gedeón hijo de Joas lo ha hecho. Entonces los hombres de la ciudad dijeron á Joas:

verses.KJV: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.
verses.WEB: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”
verses.ASV: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die, because he hath broken down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the Asherah that was by it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tira fora teu filho para que morra, porquanto derrubou o altar de Baal e cortou o bosque que junto a ele estava.
verses.RVR09: Saca fuera tu hijo para que muera, por cuanto ha derribado el altar de Baal y ha cortado el bosque que junto á él estaba.

verses.KJV: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.
verses.WEB: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”
verses.ASV: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye contend for Baal? or will ye save him? he that will contend for him, let him be put to death whilst [it is yet] morning: if he be a god, let him contend for himself, because one hath broken down his altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joás respondeu a todos os que estavam junto a ele: Tomareis vós a demanda por Baal? Vós o salvareis? Qualquer um que tomar a demanda por ele, que morra amanhã. Se é Deus, contenda por si mesmo com o que derrubou seu altar.
verses.RVR09: Y Joas respondió á todos los que estaban junto á él: ¿Tomaréis vosotros la demanda por Baal? ¿le salvaréis vosotros? Cualquiera que tomare la demanda por él, que muera mañana. Si es Dios, contienda por sí mismo con el que derribó su altar.

verses.KJV: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
verses.WEB: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”
verses.ASV: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal contend against him, because he hath broken down his altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele dia ele chamou a Gideão Jerubaal; porque disse: Pleiteie Baal contra o que derrubou seu altar.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel día llamó él á Gedeón Jerobaal; porque dijo: Pleitee Baal contra el que derribó su altar.

verses.KJV: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.WEB: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.ASV: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os midianitas, e amalequitas, e orientais, se juntaram de uma vez, e passando assentaram acampamento no vale de Jezreel.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los Madianitas, y Amalecitas, y orientales, se juntaron á una, y pasando asentaron campo en el valle de Jezreel.

verses.KJV: But the Spirit of the Lord came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.
verses.WEB: But the LORD’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.
verses.ASV: But the Spirit of Jehovah came upon Gideon; and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o espírito do SENHOR se investiu em Gideão, e quando este tocou a a trombeta, Abiezer se juntou com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y el espíritu de Jehová se envistió en Gedeón, y como éste hubo tocado el cuerno, Abiezer se juntó con él.

verses.KJV: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
verses.WEB: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
verses.ASV: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; and they also were gathered together after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou mensageiros por todo Manassés, o qual também se juntou com ele: também enviou mensageiros a Aser, e a Zebulom, e a Naftali, os quais saíram a encontrar-lhes.
verses.RVR09: Y envió mensajeros por todo Manasés, el cual también se juntó con él: asimismo envió mensajeros á Aser, y á Zabulón, y á Nephtalí, los cuales salieron á encontrarles.

verses.KJV: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
verses.WEB: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,
verses.ASV: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by my hand, as thou hast spoken,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gideão disse a Deus: Se hás de salvar a Israel por minha mão, como disseste,
verses.RVR09: Y Gedeón dijo á Dios: Si has de salvar á Israel por mi mano, como has dicho,

verses.KJV: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
verses.WEB: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”
verses.ASV: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing-floor; if there be dew on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the ground, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by my hand, as thou hast spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu porei um velo de lã na era; e se o orvalho estiver no velo somente, restando seca toda a outra terra, então entenderei que hás de salvar a Israel por minha mão, como o disseste.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que yo pondré un vellón de lana en la era; y si el rocío estuviere en el vellón solamente, quedando seca toda la otra tierra, entonces entenderé que has de salvar á Israel por mi mano, como lo has dicho.

verses.KJV: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
verses.WEB: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
verses.ASV: And it was so; for he rose up early on the morrow, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowlful of water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu assim: porque quando se levantou de manhã, espremendo o velo tirou dele o orvalho, um vaso cheio de água.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció así: porque como se levantó de mañana, exprimiendo el vellón sacó de él el rocío, un vaso lleno de agua.

verses.KJV: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
verses.WEB: Gideon said to God, “Don’t let your anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once. Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only on the fleece, and on all the ground let there be dew.”
verses.ASV: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once: let me make trial, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Gideão disse a Deus: Não se acenda tua ira contra mim, se ainda falar esta vez: somente provarei agora outra vez com o velo. Rogo-te que a secura seja somente no velo, e o orvalho sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Mas Gedeón dijo á Dios: No se encienda tu ira contra mí, si aun hablare esta vez: solamente probaré ahora otra vez con el vellón. Ruégote que la sequedad sea sólo en el vellón, y el rocío sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
verses.WEB: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
verses.ASV: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquela noite o fez Deus assim: porque a secura foi somente no velo, e em toda a terra esteve o orvalho.
verses.RVR09: Y aquella noche lo hizo Dios así: porque la sequedad fué sólo en el vellón, y en toda la tierra estuvo el rocío.

verses.KJV: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
verses.WEB: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
verses.ASV: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and encamped beside the spring of Harod: and the camp of Midian was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantando-se, pois, de manhã Jerubaal, o qual é Gideão, e todo aquele povo que estava com ele, assentaram o acampamento junto à fonte de Harode: e tinha o acampamento dos midianitas ao norte, da outra parte do morro de Moré, no vale.
verses.RVR09: LEVANTÁNDOSE pues de mañana Jerobaal, el cual es Gedeón, y todo el pueblo que estaba con él, asentaron el campo junto á la fuente de Harod: y tenía el campo de los Madianitas al norte, de la otra parte del collado de More, en el valle.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Gideão: O povo que está contigo é muito para que eu dê aos midianitas em sua mão: para que não se glorie Israel contra mim, dizendo: Minha mão me salvou.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Gedeón: El pueblo que está contigo es mucho para que yo dé á los Madianitas en su mano: porque no se alabe Israel contra mí, diciendo: Mi mano me ha salvado.

verses.KJV: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
verses.WEB: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.
verses.ASV: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, proclama aos ouvidos do povo, dizendo: Aquele que teme e se estremece, volte e retire-se do monte de Gileade. E do povo voltaram vinte e dois mil; e restaram dez mil.
verses.RVR09: Haz pues ahora pregonar, que lo oiga el pueblo, diciendo: El que teme y se estremece, madrugue y vuélvase desde el monte de Galaad. Y volviéronse de los del pueblo veintidós mil: y quedaron diez mil.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there. It shall be, that those whom I tell you, ‘This shall go with you,’ shall go with you; and whoever I tell you, ‘This shall not go with you,’ shall not go.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Gideão: Ainda é muito o povo; leva-os às águas, e ali eu te os provarei; e do que eu te disser: Vá este contigo, vá contigo: mas de qualquer um que eu te disser: Este não vá contigo, o tal não vá.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Gedeón: Aun es mucho el pueblo; llévalos á las aguas, y allí yo te los probaré; y del que yo te dijere: Vaya este contigo, vaya contigo: mas de cualquiera que yo te dijere: Este no vaya contigo, el tal no vaya.

verses.KJV: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the Lord said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
verses.WEB: So he brought down the people to the water; and the LORD said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”
verses.ASV: So he brought down the people unto the water: and Jehovah said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então levou o povo às águas: e o SENHOR disse a Gideão: Qualquer um que lamber as águas com sua língua como lambe o cão, aquele porás à parte; também qualquer um que se dobrar sobre seus joelhos para beber.
verses.RVR09: Entonces llevó el pueblo á las aguas: y Jehová dijo á Gedeón: Cualquiera que lamiere las aguas con su lengua como lame el perro, aquél pondrás aparte; asimismo cualquiera que se doblare sobre sus rodillas para beber.

verses.KJV: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
verses.WEB: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water.
verses.ASV: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o número dos que lamberam as águas, achegando-a com a mão à boca, trezentos homens: e todo aquele resto do povo se dobrou sobre seus joelhos para beber as águas.
verses.RVR09: Y fué el número de los que lamieron las aguas, llegándola con la mano á la boca, trescientos hombres: y todo el resto del pueblo se dobló sobre sus rodillas para beber las aguas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thy hand; and let all the people go every man unto his place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Gideão: Com estes trezentos homens que lamberam o água vos salvarei, e entregarei aos midianitas em tuas mãos; e vá-se todo o resto do povo cada um a seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jehová dijo á Gedeón: Con estos trescientos hombres que lamieron el agua os salvaré, y entregaré á los Madianitas en tus manos: y váyase toda la gente cada uno á su lugar.

verses.KJV: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
verses.WEB: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
verses.ASV: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the men of Israel every man unto his tent, but retained the three hundred men: and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de tomarem a provisão do povo e suas trombetas, ele enviou todos os israelitas cada um a sua tenda, mas manteve aqueles trezentos homens; e o campo de Midiã estava no vale abaixo dele.
verses.RVR09: Y tomada provisión para el pueblo en sus manos, y sus bocinas, envió á todos los Israelitas cada uno á su tienda, y retuvo á aquellos trescientos hombres: y tenía el campo de Madián abajo en el valle.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass the same night, that the Lord said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.
verses.WEB: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass the same night, that Jehovah said unto him, Arise, get thee down into the camp; for I have delivered it into thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que aquela noite o SENHOR lhe disse: Levanta-te, e desce ao acampamento; porque eu o entreguei em tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que aquella noche Jehová le dijo: Levántate, y desciende al campo; porque yo lo he entregado en tus manos.

verses.KJV: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:
verses.WEB: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp.
verses.ASV: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Purah thy servant down to the camp:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se temes descer para atacar, desce apenas tu e o teu servo Pura ao acampamento,
verses.RVR09: Y si tienes temor de descender, baja tú con Phara tu criado al campo,

verses.KJV: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.
verses.WEB: You will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp.” Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp.
verses.ASV: and thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thy hands be strengthened to go down into the camp. Then went he down with Purah his servant unto the outermost part of the armed men that were in the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: e ouvirás o que falam; e então tuas mãos se fortalecerão, e descerás para atacar o acampamento. E ele desceu com o seu servo Pura à extremidade dos homens armados que estavam no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y oirás lo que hablan; y entonces tus manos se esforzarán, y descenderás al campo. Y él descendió con Phara su criado al principio de la gente de armas que estaba en el campo.

verses.KJV: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.
verses.WEB: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.
verses.ASV: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is upon the sea-shore for multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Midiã, e Amaleque, e todos os orientais, estavam estendidos no vale como gafanhotos em multidão, e seus camelos eram inúmeros, como a areia que está à beira do mar em multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y Madián, y Amalec, y todos los orientales, estaban tendidos en el valle como langostas en muchedumbre, y sus camellos eran innumerables, como la arena que está á la ribera de la mar en multitud.

verses.KJV: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
verses.WEB: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”
verses.ASV: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man telling a dream unto his fellow; and he said, Behold, I dreamed a dream; and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, and came unto the tent, and smote it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que chegou Gideão, eis que um homem estava contando a seu companheiro um sonho, dizendo: Eis que eu sonhei um sonho: que via um pão de cevada que rodava até o acampamento de Midiã, e chegava às tendas, e as feria de tal maneira que caíam, e as virava de cima abaixo, e as tendas caíam.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que llegó Gedeón, he aquí que un hombre estaba contando á su compañero un sueño, diciendo: He aquí yo soñé un sueño: que veía un pan de cebada que rodaba hasta el campo de Madián, y llegaba á las tiendas, y las hería de tal manera que caían, y las trastornaba de arriba abajo, y las tiendas caían.

verses.KJV: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.
verses.WEB: His fellow answered, “This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. God has delivered Midian into his hand, with all the army.”
verses.ASV: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: into his hand God hath delivered Midian, and all the host.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu companheiro respondeu, e disse: Isto não é outra coisa a não ser a espada de Gideão filho de Joás, homem de Israel: Deus entregou em suas mãos aos midianitas com todo o acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y su compañero respondió, y dijo: Esto no es otra cosa sino la espada de Gedeón hijo de Joas, varón de Israel: Dios ha entregado en sus manos á los Madianitas con todo el campo.

verses.KJV: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the Lord hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
verses.WEB: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for the LORD has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”
verses.ASV: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped; and he returned into the camp of Israel, and said, Arise; for Jehovah hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Gideão ouviu a história do sonho e sua interpretação, adorou; e voltado ao acampamento de Israel, disse: Levantai-vos, que o SENHOR entregou o acampamento de Midiã em vossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y como Gedeón oyó la historia del sueño y su interpretación, adoró; y vuelto al campo de Israel, dijo: Levantaos, que Jehová ha entregado el campo de Madián en vuestras manos.

verses.KJV: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
verses.WEB: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.
verses.ASV: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets, and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E repartindo os trezentos homens em três esquadrões, deu a cada um deles trombetas em suas mãos, e cântaros vazios com tochas ardendo dentro dos cântaros.
verses.RVR09: Y repartiendo los trescientos hombres en tres escuadrones, dió á cada uno de ellos bocinas en sus manos, y cántaros vacíos con teas ardiendo dentro de los cántaros.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Olhai a mim, e fazei como eu fizer; eis que quando eu chegar ao princípio do acampamento, como eu fizer, assim fareis vós.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: Miradme á mí, y haced como yo hiciere; he aquí que cuando yo llegare al principio del campo, como yo hiciere, así haréis vosotros.

verses.KJV: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon.
verses.WEB: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon!’”
verses.ASV: When I blow the trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, For Jehovah and for Gideon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu tocarei a trombeta e todos os que estiverem comigo; e vós tocareis então as trombetas ao redor de todo aquele campo, e direis: Pelo SENHOR e Gideão!
verses.RVR09: Yo tocaré la bocina y todos los que estarán conmigo; y vosotros tocaréis entonces las bocinas alrededor de todo el campo, y diréis: ¡Por Jehová y Gedeón!

verses.KJV: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.
verses.WEB: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.
verses.ASV: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chegou, pois, Gideão, e os cem homens que levava consigo, ao princípio do acampamento, à entrada da vigília do meio, quando acabavam de renovar as sentinelas; e tocaram as trombetas, e quebraram os cântaros que levavam em suas mãos:
verses.RVR09: Llegó pues Gedeón, y los cien hombres que llevaba consigo, al principio del campo, á la entrada de la vela del medio, cuando acababan de renovar las centinelas; y tocaron las bocinas, y quebraron los cántaros que llevaban en sus manos:

verses.KJV: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon.
verses.WEB: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, “The sword of the LORD and of Gideon!”
verses.ASV: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands wherewith to blow; and they cried, The sword of Jehovah and of Gideon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os três esquadrões tocaram as trombetas, e quebrando os cântaros tomaram nas mãos esquerdas as tochas, e nas direitas as trombetas com que tocavam, e deram grito: A espada do SENHOR e de Gideão!
verses.RVR09: Y los tres escuadrones tocaron las bocinas, y quebrando los cántaros tomaron en las manos izquierdas las teas, y en las derechas los cuernos con que tañían, y dieron grita: ¡La espada de Jehová y de Gedeón!

verses.KJV: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.
verses.WEB: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.
verses.ASV: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran; and they shouted, and put [them] to flight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estiveram em seus lugares em derredor do acampamento: e todo aquele acampamento foi alvoroçado, e fugiram gritando.
verses.RVR09: Y estuviéronse en sus lugares en derredor del campo: y todo el campo fué alborotado, y huyeron gritando.

verses.KJV: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the Lord set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.
verses.WEB: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and the LORD set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.
verses.ASV: And they blew the three hundred trumpets, and Jehovah set every man’s sword against his fellow, and against all the host; and the host fled as far as Beth-shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel-meholah, by Tabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os trezentos tocavam as trombetas: e o SENHOR pôs a espada de cada um contra seu companheiro em todo aquele acampamento. E o exército fugiu até Bete-Sita, até Zererá, e até o termo de Abel-Meolá em Tabate.
verses.RVR09: Mas los trescientos tocaban las bocinas: y Jehová puso la espada de cada uno contra su compañero en todo el campo. Y el ejército huyó hasta Beth-sitta, hacia Cerera, y hasta el término de Abel-mehola en Tabbat.

verses.KJV: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
verses.WEB: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.
verses.ASV: And the men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after Midian.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntando-se os de Israel, de Naftali, e de Aser, e de todo Manassés, seguiram aos midianitas.
verses.RVR09: Y juntándose los de Israel, de Nephtalí, y de Aser, y de todo Manasés, siguieron á los Madianitas.

verses.KJV: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.
verses.WEB: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill-country of Ephraim, saying, Come down against Midian, and take before them the waters, as far as Beth-barah, even the Jordan. So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together, and took the waters as far as Beth-barah, even the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gideão também enviou mensageiros a todo aquele monte de Efraim, dizendo: Descei ao encontro dos midianitas, e tomai-lhes as águas até Bete-Bara e o Jordão. E juntos todos os homens de Efraim, tomaram as águas de Bete-Bara e o Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Gedeón también envió mensajeros á todo el monte de Ephraim, diciendo: Descended al encuentro de los Madianitas, y tomadles las aguas hasta Beth-bara y el Jordán. Y juntos todos los hombres de Ephraim, tomaron las aguas de Beth-bara y el Jordán.

verses.KJV: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.
verses.WEB: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And they took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian: and they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram dois príncipes dos midianitas, Orebe e Zeebe: e mataram a Orebe na penha de Orebe, e a Zeebe o mataram na prensa de uvas de Zeebe; e depois que seguiram aos midianitas, trouxeram as cabeças de Orebe e de Zeebe a Gideão da outra parte do Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron dos príncipes de los Madianitas, Oreb y Zeeb: y mataron á Oreb en la peña de Oreb, y á Zeeb lo mataron en el lagar de Zeeb: y después que siguieron á los Madianitas, trajeron las cabezas de Oreb y de Zeeb á Gedeón de la otra parte del Jordán.

verses.KJV: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
verses.WEB: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.
verses.ASV: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with Midian? And they did chide with him sharply.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os de Efraim lhe disseram: Que é isto que fizeste conosco, não chamando-nos quando ias à guerra contra Midiã? E reclamaram dele fortemente.
verses.RVR09: Y LOS de Ephraim le dijeron: ¿Qué es esto que has hecho con nosotros, no llamándonos cuando ibas á la guerra contra Madián? Y reconviniéronlo fuertemente.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, What have I now done in comparison with you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos quais ele respondeu: Que fiz eu agora como vós? Não são as sobras das uvas de Efraim melhor que a vindima de Abiezer?
verses.RVR09: A los cuales él respondió: ¿Qué he hecho yo ahora como vosotros? ¿No es el rebusco de Ephraim mejor que la vendimia de Abiezer?

verses.KJV: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
verses.WEB: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.
verses.ASV: God hath delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison with you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus entregou em vossas mãos a Orebe e a Zeebe, príncipes de Midiã: e que pude eu fazer como vós? Então a ira deles contra ele se aplacou, logo que ele falou esta palavra.
verses.RVR09: Dios ha entregado en vuestras manos á Oreb y á Zeeb, príncipes de Madián: ¿y qué pude yo hacer como vosotros? Entonces el enojo de ellos contra él se aplacó, luego que él habló esta palabra.

verses.KJV: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.
verses.WEB: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.
verses.ASV: And Gideon came to the Jordan, [and] passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Gideão ao Jordão para passar, ele e os trezentos homens que trazia consigo, cansados, mas ainda perseguindo.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Gedeón al Jordán para pasar, él y los trescientos hombres que traía consigo, cansados del alcance.

verses.KJV: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
verses.WEB: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse aos de Sucote: Eu vos rogo que deis à gente que me segue alguns bocados de pão; porque estão cansados, e eu persigo a Zeba e a Zalmuna, reis de Midiã.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á los de Succoth: Yo os ruego que deis á la gente que me sigue algunos bocados de pan; porque están cansados, y yo persigo á Zeba y á Zalmunna, reyes de Madián.

verses.KJV: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
verses.WEB: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”
verses.ASV: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thy hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os principais de Sucote responderam: Está já a mão de Zeba e Zalmuna em tua mão, para que havemos nós de dar pão a teu exército?
verses.RVR09: Y los principales de Succoth respondieron: ¿Está ya la mano de Zeba y Zalmunna en tu mano, para que hayamos nosotros de dar pan á tu ejército?

verses.KJV: And Gideon said, Therefore when the Lord hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
verses.WEB: Gideon said, “Therefore when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”
verses.ASV: And Gideon said, Therefore when Jehovah hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gideão disse: Pois quando o SENHOR entregar em minha mão a Zeba e a Zalmuna, eu trilharei vossa carne com espinhos e cardos do deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y Gedeón dijo: Pues cuando Jehová hubiere entregado en mi mano á Zeba y á Zalmunna, yo trillaré vuestra carne con espinas y abrojos del desierto.

verses.KJV: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.
verses.WEB: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
verses.ASV: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them in like manner; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dali subiu a Peniel, e falou-lhes as mesmas palavras. E os de Peniel lhe responderam como haviam respondido os de Sucote.
verses.RVR09: Y de allí subió á Penuel, y hablóles las mismas palabras. Y los de Penuel le respondieron como habían respondido los de Succoth.

verses.KJV: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
verses.WEB: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”
verses.ASV: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele falou também aos de Peniel, dizendo: Quando eu voltar em paz, derrubarei esta torre.
verses.RVR09: Y él habló también á los de Penuel, diciendo: Cuando yo tornare en paz, derribaré esta torre.

verses.KJV: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
verses.WEB: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.
verses.ASV: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the host of the children of the east; for there fell a hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zeba e Zalmuna estavam em Carcor, e com eles seu exército de como quinze mil homens, todos os que haviam restado de todo aquele acampamento dos orientais: e os mortos haviam sido cento vinte mil homens que tiravam espada.
verses.RVR09: Y Zeba y Zalmunna estaban en Carcor, y con ellos su ejército de como quince mil hombres, todos los que habían quedado de todo el campo de los orientales: y los muertos habían sido ciento veinte mil hombres que sacaban espada.

verses.KJV: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host; for the host was secure.
verses.WEB: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.
verses.ASV: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host; for the host was secure.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subindo Gideão até os que habitavam em tendas, à parte oriental de Noba e de Jogbeá, feriu o acampamento, porque estava o exército desprevenido.
verses.RVR09: Y subiendo Gedeón hacia los que habitaban en tiendas, á la parte oriental de Noba y de Jogbea, hirió el campo, porque estaba el ejército sin recelo.

verses.KJV: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
verses.WEB: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.
verses.ASV: And Zebah and Zalmunna fled; and he pursued after them; and he took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fugindo Zeba e Zalmuna, ele os seguiu; e tomados os dois reis de Midiã, Zeba e Zalmuna, espantou a todo aquele exército.
verses.RVR09: Y huyendo Zeba y Zalmunna, él los siguió; y tomados los dos reyes de Madián, Zeba y Zalmunna, espantó á todo el ejército.

verses.KJV: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,
verses.WEB: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.
verses.ASV: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gideão filho de Joás voltou da batalha antes que o sol subisse;
verses.RVR09: Y Gedeón hijo de Joas volvió de la batalla antes que el sol subiese;

verses.KJV: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.
verses.WEB: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.
verses.ASV: And he caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him: and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, seventy and seven men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou um jovem dos de Sucote, e perguntando-lhe, ele lhe deu por escrito os principais de Sucote e seus anciãos, setenta e sete homens.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó un mozo de los de Succoth, y preguntándole, él le dió por escrito los principales de Succoth y sus ancianos, setenta y siete varones.

verses.KJV: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
verses.WEB: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”
verses.ASV: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom ye did taunt me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thy hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrando aos de Sucote, disse: Eis aqui a Zeba e a Zalmuna, sobre os quais me escarnecestes, dizendo: Está já a mão de Zeba e de Zalmuna em tua mão, para que demos nós pão a teus homens cansados?
verses.RVR09: Y entrando á los de Succoth, dijo: He aquí á Zeba y á Zalmunna, sobre los cuales me zaheristeis, diciendo: ¿Está ya la mano de Zeba y de Zalmunna en tu mano, para que demos nosotros pan á tus hombres cansados?

verses.KJV: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
verses.WEB: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
verses.ASV: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou aos anciãos da cidade, e espinhos e cardos do deserto, e castigou com eles aos de Sucote.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó á los ancianos de la ciudad, y espinas y abrojos del desierto, y castigó con ellos á los de Succoth.

verses.KJV: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
verses.WEB: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.
verses.ASV: And he brake down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também derrubou a torre de Peniel, e matou aos da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo derribó la torre de Penuel, y mató á los de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
verses.WEB: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”
verses.ASV: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo disse a Zeba e a Zalmuna: Que maneira de homens tinham aqueles que matastes em Tabor? E eles responderam: Como tu, tais eram aqueles nem mais nem menos, que apareciam filhos de rei.
verses.RVR09: Luego dijo á Zeba y á Zalmunna: ¿Qué manera de hombres tenían aquellos que matasteis en Tabor? Y ellos respondieron: Como tú, tales eran aquellos ni más ni menos, que parecían hijos de rey.

verses.KJV: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the Lord liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
verses.WEB: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the LORD lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”
verses.ASV: And he said, They were my brethren, the sons of my mother: as Jehovah liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Meus irmãos eram, filhos de minha mãe: Vive o SENHOR, que se os tivésseis guardado em vida, eu não vos mataria!
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Mis hermanos eran, hijos de mi madre: ¡Vive Jehová, que si los hubierais guardado en vida, yo no os mataría!

verses.KJV: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.
verses.WEB: He said to Jether his firstborn, “Get up and kill them!” But the youth didn’t draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.
verses.ASV: And he said unto Jether his first-born, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword; for he feared, because he was yet a youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a Jéter seu primogênito: Levanta-te, e mata-os. Mas o jovem não desembainhou sua espada, porque tinha medo; que ainda era jovem.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á Jether su primogénito: Levántate, y mátalos. Mas el joven no desenvainó su espada, porque tenía temor; que aun era muchacho.

verses.KJV: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.
verses.WEB: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.
verses.ASV: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us; for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Zeba e Zalmuna: Levanta-te tu, e mata-nos; porque como é o homem, tal é sua valentia. E Gideão se levantou, e matou a Zeba e a Zalmuna; e tomou os adornos de crescentes que seus camelos traziam ao pescoço.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Zeba y Zalmunna: Levántate tú, y mátanos; porque como es el varón, tal es su valentía. Y Gedeón se levantó, y mató á Zeba y á Zalmunna; y tomó los adornos de lunetas que sus camellos traían al cuello.

verses.KJV: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
verses.WEB: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”
verses.ASV: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son also; for thou hast saved us out of the hand of Midian.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os israelitas disseram a Gideão: Sê nosso senhor, tu, e teu filho, e teu neto; pois que nos livraste da mão de Midiã.
verses.RVR09: Y los Israelitas dijeron á Gedeón: Sé nuestro señor, tú, y tu hijo, y tu nieto; pues que nos has librado de mano de Madián.

verses.KJV: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the Lord shall rule over you.
verses.WEB: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. The LORD shall rule over you.”
verses.ASV: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: Jehovah shall rule over you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Gideão respondeu: Não serei senhor sobre vós, nem meu filho vos dominará: o SENHOR será vosso Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Mas Gedeón respondió: No seré señor sobre vosotros, ni mi hijo os señoreará: Jehová será vuestro Señor.

verses.KJV: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
verses.WEB: Gideon said to them, “I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder.” (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
verses.ASV: And Gideon said unto them, I would make a request of you, that ye would give me every man the ear-rings of his spoil. (For they had golden ear-rings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes Gideão: Desejo fazer-vos uma petição, que cada um me dê os pendentes de seu despojo. (Porque traziam pendentes de ouro, que eram ismaelitas.)
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Gedeón: Deseo haceros una petición, que cada uno me dé los zarcillos de su despojo. (Porque traían zarcillos de oro, que eran Ismaelitas.)

verses.KJV: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
verses.WEB: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.
verses.ASV: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the ear-rings of his spoil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam: De boa vontade os daremos. E segurando uma roupa de vestir, lançou ali cada um os pendentes de seu despojo.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron: De buena gana los daremos. Y tendiendo una ropa de vestir, echó allí cada uno los zarcillos de su despojo.

verses.KJV: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.
verses.WEB: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels’ necks.
verses.ASV: And the weight of the golden ear-rings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred [shekels] of gold; besides the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and besides the chains that were about their camels’ necks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o peso dos pendentes de ouro que ele pediu mil e setecentos siclos de ouro; sem contar os ornamentos, e as joias, e vestidos de púrpura, que traziam os reis de Midiã, e sem os colares que traziam seus camelos ao pescoço.
verses.RVR09: Y fué el peso de los zarcillos de oro que él pidió, mil y setecientos siclos de oro; sin las planchas, y joyeles, y vestidos de púrpura, que traían los reyes de Madián, y sin los collares que traían sus camellos al cuello.

verses.KJV: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
verses.WEB: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.
verses.ASV: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel played the harlot after it there; and it became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gideão fez deles um éfode, o qual fez guardar em sua cidade de Ofra: e todo Israel prostituiu-se atrás desse éfode naquele lugar; e foi por tropeço a Gideão e a sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y Gedeón hizo de ellos un ephod, el cual hizo guardar en su ciudad de Ophra: y todo Israel fornicó tras de ese ephod en aquel lugar; y fué por tropiezo á Gedeón y á su casa.

verses.KJV: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.WEB: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.ASV: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. And the land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim foi humilhado Midiã diante dos filhos de Israel, e nunca mais levantaram sua cabeça. E repousou a terra quarenta anos nos dias de Gideão.
verses.RVR09: Así fué humillado Madián delante de los hijos de Israel, y nunca más levantaron su cabeza. Y reposó la tierra cuarenta años en los días de Gedeón.

verses.KJV: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
verses.WEB: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.
verses.ASV: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jerubaal filho de Joás foi, e habitou em sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y Jerobaal hijo de Joas fué, y habitó en su casa.

verses.KJV: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.
verses.WEB: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.
verses.ASV: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten; for he had many wives.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teve Gideão setenta filhos que saíram de sua coxa, porque teve muitas mulheres.
verses.RVR09: Y tuvo Gedeón setenta hijos que salieron de su muslo, porque tuvo muchas mujeres.

verses.KJV: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
