verses.WEB: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
verses.ASV: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, and he called his name Abimelech.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua concubina que estava em Siquém, também lhe deu um filho; e pôs-lhe por nome Abimeleque.
verses.RVR09: Y su concubina que estaba en Sichêm, también le parió un hijo; y púsole por nombre Abimelech.

verses.KJV: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.WEB: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.ASV: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Gideão filho de Joás em boa velhice, e foi sepultado no sepulcro de seu pai Joás, em Ofra dos abiezritas.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Gedeón hijo de Joas en buena vejez, y fué sepultado en el sepulcro de su padre Joas, en Ophra de los Abiezeritas.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.
verses.WEB: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and played the harlot after the Baalim, and made Baal-berith their god.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando morreu Gideão, os filhos de Israel voltaram, e se prostituíram atrás dos baalins, e se puseram por Deus a Baal-Berite.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que como murió Gedeón, los hijos de Israel tornaron, y fornicaron en pos de los Baales, y se pusieron por Dios á Baal-berith.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel remembered not the Lord their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
verses.WEB: The children of Israel didn’t remember the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel remembered not Jehovah their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel não se lembraram do SENHOR seu Deus, que os havia livrado de todos os seus inimigos ao redor;
verses.RVR09: Y no se acordaron los hijos de Israel de Jehová su Dios, que los había librado de todos sus enemigos alrededor:

verses.KJV: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
verses.WEB: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.
verses.ASV: neither showed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, [who is] Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had showed unto Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem fizeram misericórdia com a casa de Jerubaal Gideão conforme todo aquele bem que ele havia feito a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Ni hicieron misericordia con la casa de Jerobaal Gedeón, conforme á todo el bien que él había hecho á Israel.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
verses.WEB: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,
verses.ASV: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother’s brethren, and spake with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi-se Abimeleque filho de Jerubaal a Siquém, aos irmãos de sua mãe, e falou com eles, e com toda a família da casa do pai de sua mãe, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉSE Abimelech hijo de Jerobaal á Sichêm, á los hermanos de su madre, y habló con ellos, y con toda la familia de la casa del padre de su madre, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
verses.WEB: “Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are seventy persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.”
verses.ASV: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are threescore and ten persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos rogo que faleis a ouvidos de todos os de Siquém: Que tendes por melhor, que vos dominem setenta homens, todos os filhos de Jerubaal; ou que vos senhoreie um homem? Lembrai-vos que eu sou osso vosso, e carne vossa.
verses.RVR09: Yo os ruego que habléis á oídos de todos los de Sichêm: ¿Qué tenéis por mejor, que os señoreen setenta hombres, todos los hijos de Jerobaal; ó que os señoree un varón? Acordaos que yo soy hueso vuestro, y carne vuestra.

verses.KJV: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
verses.WEB: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”
verses.ASV: And his mother’s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falaram por ele os irmãos de sua mãe a ouvidos de todos os de Siquém todas estas palavras: e o coração deles se inclinou em favor de Abimeleque, porque diziam: Nosso irmão é.
verses.RVR09: Y hablaron por él los hermanos de su madre á oídos de todos los de Sichêm todas estas palabras: y el corazón de ellos se inclinó en favor de Abimelech, porque decían: Nuestro hermano es.

verses.KJV: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
verses.WEB: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.
verses.ASV: And they gave him threescore and ten [pieces] of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light fellows, who followed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram-lhe setenta siclos de prata do templo de Baal-Berite, com os quais Abimeleque contratou homens ociosos e vagabundos, que lhe seguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y diéronle setenta siclos de plata del templo de Baal-berith, con los cuales Abimelech alquiló hombres ociosos y vagabundos, que le siguieron.

verses.KJV: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.WEB: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.
verses.ASV: And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo à casa de seu pai em Ofra, matou a seus irmãos os filhos de Jerubaal, setenta homens, sobre uma pedra: mas restou Jotão, o menor filho de Jerubaal, que se escondeu.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo á la casa de su padre en Ophra, mató á sus hermanos los hijos de Jerobaal, setenta varones, sobre una piedra: mas quedó Jotham, el más pequeño hijo de Jerobaal, que se escondió.

verses.KJV: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.WEB: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.ASV: And all the men of Shechem assembled themselves together, and all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king, by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reunidos todos os de Siquém com toda a casa de Milo, foram e elegeram a Abimeleque por rei, próximo da planície do pilar que estava em Siquém.
verses.RVR09: Y reunidos todos los de Sichêm con toda la casa de Millo, fueron y eligieron á Abimelech por rey, cerca de la llanura del pilar que estaba en Sichêm.

verses.KJV: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
verses.WEB: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.
verses.ASV: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se o disseram a Jotão, foi e pôs-se no cume do monte de Gerizim, e levantando sua voz clamou, e disse-lhes: Ouvi-me, homens de Siquém; que Deus vos ouça.
verses.RVR09: Y como se lo dijesen á Jotham, fué y púsose en la cumbre del monte de Gerizim, y alzando su voz clamó, y díjoles: Oidme, varones de Sichêm; que Dios os oiga.

verses.KJV: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
verses.WEB: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
verses.ASV: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive-tree, Reign thou over us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foram as árvores a eleger rei sobre si, e disseram à oliva: Reina sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Fueron los árboles á elegir rey sobre sí, y dijeron á la oliva: Reina sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.WEB: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.ASV: But the olive-tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honor God and man, and go to wave to and fro over the trees?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a oliveira respondeu: Tenho de deixar meu azeite, com o que por minha causa Deus e os homens são honrados, para ir a ser grande sobre as árvores?
verses.RVR09: Mas la oliva respondió: ¿Tengo de dejar mi pingüe jugo, con el que por mi causa Dios y los hombres son honrados, por ir á ser grande sobre los árboles?

verses.KJV: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.WEB: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’
verses.ASV: And the trees said to the fig-tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram as árvores à figueira: Anda tu, reina sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron los árboles á la higuera: Anda tú, reina sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.WEB: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.ASV: But the fig-tree said unto them, Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave to and fro over the trees?
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu a figueira: Tenho de deixar minha doçura e meu bom fruto, para ir a ser grande sobre as árvores?
verses.RVR09: Y respondió la higuera: ¿Tengo de dejar mi dulzura y mi buen fruto, por ir á ser grande sobre los árboles?

verses.KJV: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.WEB: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’
verses.ASV: And the trees said unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram logo as árvores à vide: Pois vem tu, reina sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Dijeron luego los árboles á la vid: Pues ven tú, reina sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.WEB: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.ASV: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my new wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to wave to and fro over the trees?
verses.ALMEIDA: E a vide lhes respondeu: Tenho de deixar meu mosto, que alegra a Deus e aos homens, para ir a ser grande sobre as árvores?
verses.RVR09: Y la vid les respondió: ¿Tengo de dejar mi mosto, que alegra á Dios y á los hombres, por ir á ser grande sobre los árboles?

verses.KJV: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.WEB: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’
verses.ASV: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram então todas as árvores ao espinheiro: Vem tu, reina sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Dijeron entonces todos los árboles al escaramujo: Anda tú, reina sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.WEB: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’
verses.ASV: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o espinheiro respondeu às árvores: Se em verdade me elegeis por rei sobre vós, vinde, e assegurai-vos debaixo de minha sombra: e se não, fogo saia do espinheiro que devore os cedros do Líbano.
verses.RVR09: Y el escaramujo respondió á los árboles: Si en verdad me elegís por rey sobre vosotros, venid, y aseguraos debajo de mi sombra: y si no, fuego salga del escaramujo que devore los cedros del Líbano.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
verses.WEB: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands
verses.ASV: Now therefore, if ye have dealt truly and uprightly, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, se com verdade e com integridade tendes procedido em fazer rei a Abimeleque, e se o fizestes bem com Jerubaal e com sua casa, e se lhe haveis pagado conforme a obra de suas mãos;
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, si con verdad y con integridad habéis procedido en hacer rey á Abimelech, y si lo habéis hecho bien con Jerobaal y con su casa, y si le habéis pagado conforme á la obra de sus manos;

verses.KJV: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
verses.WEB: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;
verses.ASV: (for my father fought for you, and adventured his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois que meu pai lutou por vós, e expulsou longe sua vida para livrar-vos da mão de Midiã;
verses.RVR09: (Pues que mi padre peleó por vosotros, y echó lejos su vida por libraros de mano de Madián;

verses.KJV: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
verses.WEB: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);
verses.ASV: and ye are risen up against my father’s house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maid-servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós vos levantastes hoje contra a casa de meu pai, e matastes seus filhos, setenta homens, sobre uma pedra; e pusestes por rei sobre os de Siquém a Abimeleque, filho de sua criada, porquanto é vosso irmão);
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros os levantasteis hoy contra la casa de mi padre, y matasteis sus hijos, setenta varones, sobre una piedra; y habéis puesto por rey sobre los de Sichêm á Abimelech, hijo de su criada, por cuanto es vuestro hermano:)

verses.KJV: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
verses.WEB: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;
verses.ASV: if ye then have dealt truly and uprightly with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se com verdade e com integridade agistes hoje com Jerubaal e com sua casa, alegrai-vos de Abimeleque, e ele se alegre de vós.
verses.RVR09: Si con verdad y con integridad habéis obrado hoy con Jerobaal y con su casa, que gocéis de Abimelech, y él goce de vosotros.

verses.KJV: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
verses.WEB: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”
verses.ASV: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não, fogo saia de Abimeleque, que consuma aos de Siquém e à casa de Milo; e fogo saia dos de Siquém e da casa de Milo, que consuma a Abimeleque.
verses.RVR09: Y si no, fuego salga de Abimelech, que consuma á los de Sichêm y á la casa de Millo; y fuego salga de los de Sichêm y de la casa de Millo, que consuma á Abimelech.

verses.KJV: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.WEB: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.ASV: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fugiu Jotão, e se escapou, e foi-se a Beer, e ali se esteve por causa de Abimeleque seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y huyó Jotham, y se fugó, y fuése á Beer, y allí se estuvo por causa de Abimelech su hermano.

verses.KJV: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
verses.WEB: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que Abimeleque dominou sobre Israel três anos,
verses.RVR09: Y después que Abimelech hubo dominado sobre Israel tres años,

verses.KJV: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
verses.WEB: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
verses.ASV: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviou Deus um espírito mau entre Abimeleque e os homens de Siquém: que os de Siquém se levantaram contra Abimeleque:
verses.RVR09: Envió Dios un espíritu malo entre Abimelech y los hombres de Sichêm: que los de Sichêm se levantaron contra Abimelech:

verses.KJV: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
verses.WEB: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.
verses.ASV: that the violence done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid upon Abimelech their brother, who slew them, and upon the men of Shechem, who strengthened his hands to slay his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que o crime dos setenta filhos de Jerubaal, e o sangue deles, viesse a se pôr sobre Abimeleque seu irmão que os matou, e sobre os homens de Siquém que corroboraram as mãos dele para matar a seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Para que el agravio de los setenta hijos de Jerobaal, y la sangre de ellos, viniera á ponerse sobre Abimelech su hermano que los mató, y sobre los hombres de Sichêm que corroboraron las manos de él para matar á sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
verses.WEB: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.
verses.ASV: And the men of Shechem set liers-in-wait for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram-lhe os de Siquém emboscadores nos cumes dos montes, os quais assaltavam a todos os que passavam junto a eles pelo caminho; do que foi dado aviso a Abimeleque.
verses.RVR09: Y pusiéronle los de Sichêm asechadores en las cumbres de los montes, los cuales salteaban á todos los que pasaban junto á ellos por el camino; de lo que fué dado aviso á Abimelech.

verses.KJV: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
verses.WEB: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.
verses.ASV: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gaal filho de Ebede veio com seus irmãos, e passaram a Siquém: e os de Siquém se confiaram nele.
verses.RVR09: Y Gaal hijo de Ebed vino con sus hermanos, y pasáronse á Sichêm: y los de Sichêm se confiaron en él.

verses.KJV: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.WEB: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.ASV: And they went out into the field, and gathered their vineyards, and trod [the grapes], and held festival, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saindo ao campo, vindimaram suas vinhas, e pisaram a uva, e fizeram alegrias; e entrando no templo de seus deuses, comeram e beberam, e amaldiçoaram a Abimeleque.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo al campo, vendimiaron sus viñas, y pisaron la uva, é hicieron alegrías; y entrando en el templo de sus dioses, comieron y bebieron, y maldijeron á Abimelech.

verses.KJV: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
verses.WEB: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?
verses.ASV: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve ye the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: but why should we serve him?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gaal filho de Ebede disse: Quem é Abimeleque e que é Siquém, para que nós a ele sirvamos? não é filho de Jerubaal? e não é Zebul seu assistente? Servi aos homens de Hamor pai de Siquém: mas por que serviríamos a ele?
verses.RVR09: Y Gaal hijo de Ebed dijo: ¿Quién es Abimelech y qué es Sichêm, para que nosotros á él sirvamos? ¿no es hijo de Jerobaal? ¿y no es Zebul su asistente? Servid á los varones de Hemor padre de Sichêm: mas ¿por qué habíamos de servir á él?

verses.KJV: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
verses.WEB: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”
verses.ASV: And would that this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fosse-me dado este povo abaixo de minha mão, eu expulsaria logo a Abimeleque. E dizia a Abimeleque: Aumenta teus esquadrões, e sai.
verses.RVR09: Fuérame dado este pueblo bajo de mi mano, yo echaría luego á Abimelech. Y decía á Abimelech: Aumenta tus escuadrones, y sal.

verses.KJV: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.WEB: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.
verses.ASV: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zebul assistente da cidade, ouvindo as palavras de Gaal filho de Ebede, acendeu-se sua ira;
verses.RVR09: Y Zebul asistente de la ciudad, oyendo las palabras de Gaal hijo de Ebed, encendióse su ira;

verses.KJV: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
verses.WEB: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, “Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you.
verses.ASV: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech craftily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren are come to Shechem; and, behold, they constrain the city [to take part] against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou sagazmente mensageiros a Abimeleque, dizendo: Eis que Gaal filho de Ebede e seus irmãos vieram a Siquém, e eis que cercaram a cidade contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Y envió sagazmente mensajeros á Abimelech, diciendo: He aquí que Gaal hijo de Ebed y sus hermanos han venido á Sichêm, y he aquí, que han cercado la ciudad contra ti.

verses.KJV: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
verses.WEB: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, up by night, thou and the people that are with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, pois, agora de noite, tu e o povo que está contigo, e põe emboscada no campo:
verses.RVR09: Levántate pues ahora de noche, tú y el pueblo que está contigo, y pon emboscada en el campo:

verses.KJV: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
verses.WEB: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”
verses.ASV: and it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and rush upon the city; and, behold, when he and the people that are with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pela manhã ao sair do sol te levantarás e atacarás a cidade: e ele e o povo que está com ele sairão contra ti, e tu farás com ele segundo que se te oferecerá.
verses.RVR09: Y por la mañana al salir del sol te levantarás y acometerás la ciudad: y él y el pueblo que está con él saldrán contra ti, y tu harás con él según que se te ofrecerá.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.WEB: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantando-se, pois, de noite Abimeleque e todo aquele povo que com ele estava, puseram emboscada contra Siquém com quatro companhias.
verses.RVR09: Levantándose pues de noche Abimelech y todo el pueblo que con él estaba, pusieron emboscada contra Sichêm con cuatro compañías.

verses.KJV: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
verses.WEB: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.
verses.ASV: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from the ambushment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gaal filho de Ebede saiu, e pôs-se à entrada da porta da cidade: e Abimeleque e todo aquele povo que com ele estava, se levantaram da emboscada.
verses.RVR09: Y Gaal hijo de Ebed salió, y púsose á la entrada de la puerta de la ciudad: y Abimelech y todo el pueblo que con él estaba, se levantaron de la emboscada.

verses.KJV: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
verses.WEB: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains.” Zebul said to him, “You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were men.”
verses.ASV: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the tops of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Gaal o povo, disse a Zebul: Eis ali povo que desce dos cumes dos montes. E Zebul lhe respondeu: A sombra dos montes te parece homens.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Gaal el pueblo, dijo á Zebul: He allí pueblo que desciende de las cumbres de los montes. Y Zebul le respondió: La sombra de los montes te parece hombres.

verses.KJV: And Gaal spake again, and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
verses.WEB: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”
verses.ASV: And Gaal spake again and said, See, there come people down by the middle of the land, and one company cometh by the way of the oak of Meonenim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Gaal voltou a falar, e disse: Eis ali um povo que desce por meio da terra, e um esquadrão vem pelo caminho da campina de Meonenim.
verses.RVR09: Mas Gaal tornó á hablar, y dijo: He allí pueblo que desciende por medio de la tierra, y un escuadrón viene camino de la campiña de Meonenim.

verses.KJV: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
verses.WEB: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”
verses.ASV: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, that thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out now, I pray, and fight with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zebul lhe respondeu: Onde está agora aquele teu falar, dizendo; Quem é Abimeleque para que lhe sirvamos? Não é este o povo que menosprezavas? Sai, pois, agora, e luta com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Zebul le respondió: ¿Dónde está ahora aquel tu hablar, diciendo: Quién es Abimelech para que le sirvamos? ¿No es este el pueblo que tenías en poco? Sal pues ahora, y pelea con él.

verses.KJV: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.WEB: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.ASV: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gaal saiu diante dos de Siquém, e lutou contra Abimeleque.
verses.RVR09: Y Gaal salió delante de los de Sichêm, y peleó contra Abimelech.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.WEB: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and there fell many wounded, even unto the entrance of the gate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas perseguiu-o Abimeleque, diante do qual ele fugiu; e caíram feridos muitos até a entrada da porta.
verses.RVR09: Mas persiguiólo Abimelech, delante del cual él huyó; y cayeron heridos muchos hasta la entrada de la puerta.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.WEB: Abimelech lived at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abimeleque ficou em Aruma; e Zebul lançou fora a Gaal e a seus irmãos, para que não morassem em Siquém.
verses.RVR09: Y Abimelech se quedó en Aruma; y Zebul echó fuera á Gaal y á sus hermanos, para que no morasen en Sichêm.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.WEB: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu ao dia seguinte, que o povo saiu ao campo: e foi dado aviso a Abimeleque.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció al siguiente día, que el pueblo salió al campo: y fué dado aviso á Abimelech.

verses.KJV: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.WEB: He took the people and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. So, he rose up against them and struck them.
verses.ASV: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and, behold, the people came forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual, tomando gente, repartiu-a em três companhias, e pôs emboscadas no campo: e quando olhou, eis o povo que saía da cidade; e levantou-se contra eles, e feriu-os:
verses.RVR09: El cual, tomando gente, repartióla en tres compañías, y puso emboscadas en el campo: y como miró, he aquí el pueblo que salía de la ciudad; y levantóse contra ellos, é hiriólos:

verses.KJV: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
verses.WEB: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech, and the companies that were with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city: and the two companies rushed upon all that were in the field, and smote them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Abimeleque e o esquadrão que estava com ele, atacaram com ímpeto, e pararam à entrada da porta da cidade; e as duas companhias atacaram a todos os que estavam no campo, e os feriram.
verses.RVR09: Pues Abimelech y el escuadrón que estaba con él, acometieron con ímpetu, y pararon á la entrada de la puerta de la ciudad; y las dos compañías acometieron á todos los que estaban en el campo, y los hirieron.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.WEB: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that were therein: and he beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de combater Abimeleque a cidade todo aquele dia, tomou-a, e matou o povo que nela estava, e assolou a cidade, e semeou-a de sal.
verses.RVR09: Y después de combatir Abimelech la ciudad todo aquel día, tomóla, y mató el pueblo que en ella estaba, y asoló la ciudad, y sembróla de sal.

verses.KJV: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
verses.WEB: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.
verses.ASV: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard thereof, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ouviram isto todos os que estavam na torre de Siquém, entraram na fortaleza do templo do deus Berite.
verses.RVR09: Como oyeron esto todos los que estaban en la torre de Sichêm, entráronse en la fortaleza del templo del dios Berith.

verses.KJV: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.WEB: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.ASV: And it was told Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dito a Abimeleque como todos os da torre de Siquém estavam reunidos.
verses.RVR09: Y fué dicho á Abimelech como todos los de la torre de Sichêm estaban reunidos.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
verses.WEB: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”
verses.ASV: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder: and he said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então subiu Abimeleque ao monte de Salmom, ele e toda a gente que com ele estava; e tomou Abimeleque um machado em sua mão, e cortou um ramo das árvores, levantou-o, e o pôs sobre seus ombros, dizendo ao povo que estava com ele: O que vós vedes que estou fazendo, fazei imediatamente como eu.
verses.RVR09: Entonces subió Abimelech al monte de Salmón, él y toda la gente que con él estaba; y tomó Abimelech un hacha en su mano, y cortó una rama de los árboles, y levantándola púsosela sobre sus hombros, diciendo al pueblo que estaba con él: Lo que me veis á mí que hago, haced vosotros prestamente como yo.

verses.KJV: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.WEB: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.ASV: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim todo aquele povo cortou também cada um seu ramo, e seguiram a Abimeleque, e puseram-nas junto à fortaleza, e prenderam fogo com elas à fortaleza: por maneira que todos os da torre de Siquém morreram, como uns mil homens e mulheres.
verses.RVR09: Y así todo el pueblo cortó también cada uno su rama, y siguieron á Abimelech, y pusiéronlas junto á la fortaleza, y prendieron fuego con ellas á la fortaleza: por manera que todos los de la torre de Sichêm murieron, como unos mil hombres y mujeres.

verses.KJV: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.WEB: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.ASV: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois Abimeleque se foi a Tebes; e pôs cerco a Tebes, e tomou-a.
verses.RVR09: Después Abimelech se fué á Thebes; y puso cerco á Thebes, y tomóla.

verses.KJV: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
verses.WEB: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.
verses.ASV: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut themselves in, and gat them up to the roof of the tower.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em meio daquela cidade havia uma torre forte, à qual se retiraram todos os homens e mulheres, e todos os senhores da cidade; e fechando atrás de si as portas, subiram ao piso alto da torre.
verses.RVR09: En medio de aquella ciudad había una torre fuerte, á la cual se retiraron todos los hombres y mujeres, y todos los señores de la ciudad; y cerrando tras sí las puertas, subiéronse al piso alto de la torre.

verses.KJV: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.WEB: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.ASV: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and drew near unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Abimeleque à torre, e combatendo-a, chegou-se à porta da torre para pegar-lhe fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Abimelech á la torre, y combatiéndola, llegóse á la puerta de la torre para pegarle fuego.

verses.KJV: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
verses.WEB: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.
verses.ASV: And a certain woman cast an upper millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and brake his skull.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas uma mulher deixou cair um pedaço de uma roda de moinho sobre a cabeça de Abimeleque, e quebrou-lhe o crânio.
verses.RVR09: Mas una mujer dejó caer un pedazo de una rueda de molino sobre la cabeza de Abimelech, y quebróle los cascos.

verses.KJV: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A women slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.WEB: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ His young man thrust him through, and he died.”
verses.ASV: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armorbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and kill me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo ele chamou a seu escudeiro, e disse-lhe: Tira tua espada e mata-me, porque não se diga de mim: Uma mulher o matou. E seu escudeiro o atravessou, e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y luego llamó él á su escudero, y díjole: Saca tu espada y mátame, porque no se diga de mí: Una mujer lo mató. Y su escudero le atravesó, y murió.

verses.KJV: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.WEB: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place.
verses.ASV: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os israelitas viram morto a Abimeleque, foram-se cada um à sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y como los Israelitas vieron muerto á Abimelech, fuéronse cada uno á su casa.

verses.KJV: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
verses.WEB: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;
verses.ASV: Thus God requited the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim, pois, Deus pagou a Abimeleque o mal que fez contra seu pai matando a seus setenta irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Así pues pagó Dios á Abimelech el mal que hizo contra su padre matando á sus setenta hermanos.

verses.KJV: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.WEB: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.
verses.ASV: and all the wickedness of the men of Shechem did God requite upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda todo aquele mal dos homens de Siquém devolveu Deus sobre suas cabeças: e a maldição de Jotão, filho de Jerubaal, veio sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y aun todo el mal de los hombres de Sichêm tornó Dios sobre sus cabezas: y la maldición de Jotham, hijo de Jerobaal, vino sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
verses.WEB: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.ASV: And after Abimelech there arose to save Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in the hill-country of Ephraim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Depois de Abimeleque levantou-se para livrar a Israel, Tolá filho de Puá, filho de Dodô, homem de Issacar, o qual habitava em Samir, no monte de Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Y DESPUÉS de Abimelech levantóse para librar á Israel, Tola hijo de Púa, hijo de Dodo, varón de Issachâr, el cual habitaba en Samir, en el monte de Ephraim.

verses.KJV: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.WEB: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.ASV: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.ALMEIDA: E julgou a Israel vinte e três anos, e morreu, e foi sepultado em Samir.
verses.RVR09: Y juzgó á Israel veintitrés años, y murió, y fué sepultado en Samir.

verses.KJV: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.WEB: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.
verses.ASV: And after him arose Jair, the Gileadite; and he judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois dele se levantou Jair, gileadita, o qual julgou a Israel vinte e dois anos.
verses.RVR09: Tras él se levantó Jair, Galaadita, el cual juzgó á Israel veintidós años.

verses.KJV: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.WEB: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.ASV: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este teve trinta filhos que cavalgavam sobre trinta asnos, e tinham trinta vilas, que se chamaram as vilas de Jair até hoje, as quais estão na terra de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Este tuvo treinta hijos que cabalgaban sobre treinta asnos, y tenían treinta villas, que se llamaron las villas de Jair hasta hoy, las cuales están en la tierra de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
verses.WEB: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
verses.ASV: And Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Jair, e foi sepultado em Camom.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Jair, y fué sepultado en Camón.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the Lord, and served not him.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and served the Baalim, and the Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Sidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines; and they forsook Jehovah, and served him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os filhos de Israel voltaram a fazer o mal aos olhos do SENHOR, e serviram aos baalins e a Astarote, e aos deuses da Síria, e aos deuses de Sidom, e aos deuses de Moabe, e aos deuses dos filhos de Amom, e aos deuses dos filisteus:
verses.RVR09: Mas los hijos de Israel tornaron á hacer lo malo en los ojos de Jehová, y sirvieron á los Baales y á Astaroth, y á los dioses de Siria, y á los dioses de Sidón, y á los dioses de Moab, y á los dioses de los hijos de Ammón, y á los dioses de los Filisteos: y dejaron á Jehová, y no le sirvieron.

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
verses.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR se irou contra Israel, e vendeu-os por mão dos filisteus, e por mão dos filhos de Amom:
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová se airó contra Israel, y vendiólos en mano de los Filisteos, y en mano de los hijos de Ammón:

verses.KJV: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.WEB: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.ASV: And they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel that year: eighteen years [oppressed they] all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais moeram e quebrantaram aos filhos de Israel naquele tempo dezoito anos, a todos os filhos de Israel que estavam da outra parte do Jordão na terra dos amorreus, que é em Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales molieron y quebrantaron á los hijos de Israel en aquel tiempo dieciocho años, á todos los hijos de Israel que estaban de la otra parte del Jordán en la tierra del Amorrheo, que es en Galaad.

verses.KJV: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.WEB: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.
verses.ASV: And the children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Amom passaram o Jordão para fazer também guerra contra Judá, e contra Benjamim, e a casa de Efraim: e foi Israel em grande maneira afligido.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Ammón pasaron el Jordán para hacer también guerra contra Judá, y contra Benjamín, y la casa de Ephraim: y fué Israel en gran manera afligido.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah, saying, We have sinned against thee, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baalim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel clamaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Nós pecamos contra ti; porque deixamos a nosso Deus, e servido aos baalins.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Israel clamaron á Jehová, diciendo: Nosotros hemos pecado contra ti; porque hemos dejado á nuestro Dios, y servido á los Baales.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto the children of Israel, [Did] not [I save you] from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR respondeu aos filhos de Israel: Não fostes oprimidos pelo Egito, pelos amorreus, pelos amonitas, dos filisteus,
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová respondió á los hijos de Israel: ¿No habéis sido oprimidos de Egipto, de los Amorrheos, de los Ammonitas, de los Filisteos,

verses.KJV: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
verses.WEB: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.
verses.ASV: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried unto me, and I saved you out of their hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos de Sidom, de Amaleque, e de Maom, e clamando a mim vos livrei de suas mãos?
verses.RVR09: De los de Sidón, de Amalec, y de Maón, y clamando á mí os he librado de sus manos?

verses.KJV: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.WEB: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.
verses.ASV: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will save you no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós me deixastes, e servistes a deuses alheios: portanto, eu não vos livrarei mais.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros me habéis dejado, y habéis servido á dioses ajenos: por tanto, yo no os libraré más.

verses.KJV: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
verses.WEB: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”
verses.ASV: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them save you in the time of your distress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Andai, e clamai aos deuses que escolhestes para vós, que vos livrem no tempo de vossa aflição.
verses.RVR09: Andad, y clamad á los dioses que os habéis elegido, que os libren en el tiempo de vuestra aflicción.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel said unto the Lord, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel said to the LORD, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel said unto Jehovah, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; only deliver us, we pray thee, this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel responderam ao SENHOR: Pecamos; faze tu conosco como bem te parecer: somente que agora nos livres neste dia.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Israel respondieron á Jehová: Hemos pecado; haz tú con nosotros como bien te pareciere: solamente que ahora nos libres en este día.

verses.KJV: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the Lord: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.WEB: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.ASV: And they put away the foreign gods from among them, and served Jehovah; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tiraram dentre si os deuses alheios, e serviram ao SENHOR; e sua alma foi angustiada por causa do sofrimento de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y quitaron de entre sí los dioses ajenos, y sirvieron á Jehová: y su alma fué angustiada á causa del trabajo de Israel.

verses.KJV: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
verses.WEB: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.
verses.ASV: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntando-se os filhos de Amom, assentaram acampamento em Gileade; juntaram-se assim os filhos de Israel, e assentaram seu acampamento em Mispá.
verses.RVR09: Y juntándose los hijos de Ammón, asentaron campo en Galaad: juntáronse asimismo los hijos de Israel, y asentaron su campo en Mizpa.

verses.KJV: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.WEB: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”
verses.ASV: And the people, the princes of Gilead, said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os príncipes e o povo de Gileade disseram um ao outro: Quem será o que começará a batalha contra os filhos de Amom? Ele será cabeça sobre todos os que habitam em Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes y el pueblo de Galaad dijeron el uno al otro: ¿Quién será el que comenzará la batalla contra los hijos de Ammón? él será cabeza sobre todos los que habitan en Galaad.

verses.KJV: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
verses.WEB: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.
verses.ASV: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor, and he was the son of a harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Existia então Jefté, gileadita, homem valente, filho de uma prostituta, ao qual havia gerado Gileade.
verses.RVR09: EXISTÍA entonces Jephté, Galaadita, hombre valiente, hijo de una ramera, al cual había engendrado Galaad.

verses.KJV: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.
verses.WEB: Gilead’s wife bore him sons. When his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, “You will not inherit in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman.”
verses.ASV: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and when his wife’s sons grew up, they drove out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou art the son of another woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher de Gileade também lhe havia dado à luz filhos; os quais quando foram grandes, lançaram fora a Jefté, dizendo-lhe: Não herdarás na casa de nosso pai, porque és bastardo.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer de Galaad también le había parido hijos; los cuales cuando fueron grandes, echaron fuera á Jephté, diciéndole: No heredarás en la casa de nuestro padre, porque eres bastardo.

verses.KJV: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
verses.WEB: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.
verses.ASV: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain fellows to Jephthah, and they went out with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fugindo, pois, Jefté por causa de seus irmãos, habitou em terra de Tobe; e juntaram-se com ele homens ociosos, os quais com ele saíam.
verses.RVR09: Huyendo pues Jephté á causa de sus hermanos, habitó en tierra de Tob; y juntáronse con él hombres ociosos, los cuales con él salían.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.WEB: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after a while, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que depois de dias os filhos de Amom fizeram guerra contra Israel:
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que después de días los hijos de Ammón hicieron guerra contra Israel:

verses.KJV: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
verses.WEB: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.
verses.ASV: And it was so, that, when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os filhos de Amom tinham guerra contra Israel, os anciãos de Gileade foram para fazer voltar a Jefté da terra de Tobe;
verses.RVR09: Y como los hijos de Ammón tenían guerra contra Israel, los ancianos de Galaad fueron para volver á Jephté de tierra de Tob;

verses.KJV: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
verses.WEB: They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”
verses.ASV: and they said unto Jephthah, Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram a Jefté: Vem, e serás nosso capitão, para que lutemos com os filhos de Amom.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron á Jephté: Ven, y serás nuestro capitán, para que peleemos con los hijos de Ammón.

verses.KJV: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
verses.WEB: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “Didn’t you hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?”
verses.ASV: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jefté respondeu aos anciãos de Gileade: Não me odiastes, e me lançastes da casa de meu pai? por que pois vindes agora a mim quando estais em aflição?
verses.RVR09: Y Jephté respondió á los ancianos de Galaad: ¿No me habéis vosotros aborrecido, y me echasteis de la casa de mi padre? ¿por qué pues venís ahora á mí cuando estáis en aflicción?

verses.KJV: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.WEB: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Therefore we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon. You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”
verses.ASV: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore are we turned again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight with the children of Ammon; and thou shalt be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os anciãos de Gileade responderam a Jefté: Por esta mesma causa voltamos agora a ti, para que venhas conosco, e lutes contra os filhos de Amom, e nos sejas cabeça a todos os que moramos em Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Y los ancianos de Galaad respondieron á Jephté: Por esta misma causa tornamos ahora á ti, para que vengas con nosotros, y pelees contra los hijos de Ammón, y nos seas cabeza á todos los que moramos en Galaad.

verses.KJV: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the Lord deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
verses.WEB: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “If you bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivers them before me, will I be your head?”
verses.ASV: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon, and Jehovah deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
verses.ALMEIDA: Jefté então disse aos anciãos de Gileade: Se me fazeis voltar para que lute contra os filhos de Amom, e o SENHOR os entregar diante de mim, serei eu vossa cabeça?
verses.RVR09: Jephté entonces dijo á los ancianos de Galaad: Si me volvéis para que pelee contra los hijos de Ammón, y Jehová los entregare delante de mí, ¿seré yo vuestra cabeza?

verses.KJV: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The Lord be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
verses.WEB: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “The LORD will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”
verses.ASV: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Jehovah shall be witness between us; surely according to thy word so will we do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os anciãos de Gileade responderam a Jefté: O SENHOR ouça entre nós, se não fizermos como tu dizes.
verses.RVR09: Y los ancianos de Galaad respondieron á Jephté: Jehová oiga entre nosotros, si no hiciéremos como tú dices.

verses.KJV: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the Lord in Mizpeh.
verses.WEB: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD in Mizpah.
verses.ASV: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them: and Jephthah spake all his words before Jehovah in Mizpah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jefté veio com os anciãos de Gileade, e o povo o elegeu por seu cabeça e príncipe; e Jefté falou todas seus palavras diante do SENHOR em Mispá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Jephté vino con los ancianos de Galaad, y el pueblo lo eligió por su cabeza y príncipe; y Jephté habló todas sus palabras delante de Jehová en Mizpa.

verses.KJV: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
verses.WEB: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”
verses.ASV: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come unto me to fight against my land?
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Jefté embaixadores ao rei dos amonitas, dizendo: Que tens tu comigo que vieste a mim para fazer guerra em minha terra?
verses.RVR09: Y envió Jephté embajadores al rey de los Ammonitas, diciendo: ¿Qué tienes tú conmigo que has venido á mí para hacer guerra en mi tierra?

verses.KJV: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
verses.WEB: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”
verses.ASV: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even unto the Jabbok, and unto the Jordan: now therefore restore those [lands] again peaceably.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei dos amonitas respondeu aos embaixadores de Jefté: Porquanto Israel tomou minha terra, quando subiu do Egito, desde Arnom até Jaboque e o Jordão; portanto, devolve-as agora em paz.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey de los Ammonitas respondió á los embajadores de Jephté: Por cuanto Israel tomó mi tierra, cuando subió de Egipto, desde Arnón hasta Jaboc y el Jordán; por tanto, devuélvelas ahora en paz.

verses.KJV: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
verses.WEB: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;
verses.ASV: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jefté voltou a enviar outros embaixadores ao rei dos amonitas,
verses.RVR09: Y Jephté tornó á enviar otros embajadores al rey de los Ammonitas,

verses.KJV: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
verses.WEB: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;
verses.ASV: and he said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah: Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para dizer-lhe: Jefté disse assim: Israel não tomou terra de Moabe, nem terra dos filhos de Amom:
verses.RVR09: Para decirle: Jephté ha dicho así: Israel no tomó tierra de Moab, ni tierra de los hijos de Ammón:

verses.KJV: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.WEB: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,
verses.ASV: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness unto the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas subindo Israel do Egito, andou pelo deserto até o mar Vermelho, e chegou a Cades.
verses.RVR09: Mas subiendo Israel de Egipto, anduvo por el desierto hasta el mar Bermejo, y llegó á Cades.

verses.KJV: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
verses.WEB: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.
verses.ASV: then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land; but the king of Edom hearkened not. And in like manner he sent unto the king of Moab; but he would not: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Israel enviou embaixadores ao rei de Edom, dizendo: Eu te rogo que me deixes passar por tua terra. Mas o rei de Edom não os escutou. Enviou também ao rei de Moabe; o qual tampouco quis: ficou, portanto, Israel em Cades.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Israel envió embajadores al rey de Edom, diciendo: Yo te ruego que me dejes pasar por tu tierra. Mas el rey de Edom no los escuchó. Envió también al rey de Moab; el cual tampoco quiso: quedóse por tanto Israel en Cades.

verses.KJV: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.WEB: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they didn’t come within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.ASV: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they came not within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois, indo pelo deserto, rodeou a terra de Edom e a terra de Moabe, e vindo pelo lado oriental da terra de Moabe, assentou seu acampamento de outra parte de Arnom, e não entraram pelo termo de Moabe: porque Arnom é termo de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Después, yendo por el desierto, rodeó la tierra de Edom y la tierra de Moab, y viniendo por el lado oriental de la tierra de Moab, asentó su campo de estotra parte de Arnón, y no entraron por el término de Moab: porque Arnón término es de Moab.

verses.KJV: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
verses.WEB: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’
verses.ASV: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land unto my place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Israel embaixadores a Seom rei pelos amorreus, rei de Hesbom, dizendo-lhe: Rogo-te que me deixes passar por tua terra até meu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y envió Israel embajadores á Sehón rey de los Amorrheos, rey de Hesbón, diciéndole: Ruégote que me dejes pasar por tu tierra hasta mi lugar.

verses.KJV: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.WEB: But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.ASV: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Seom não confiou em Israel para dar-lhe passagem por seu termo; antes juntando Seom toda sua gente, pôs acampamento em Jaza, e lutou contra Israel.
verses.RVR09: Mas Sehón no se fió de Israel para darle paso por su término; antes juntando Sehón toda su gente, puso campo en Jaas, y peleó contra Israel.

verses.KJV: And the Lord God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.WEB: The LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel, entregou Seom e todo o seu povo na mão de Israel, e os derrotou; e Israel tomou posse de toda a terra dos amorreus que habitavam naquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Empero Jehová el Dios de Israel entregó á Sehón y á todo su pueblo en mano de Israel, y venciólos: y poseyó Israel toda la tierra del Amorrheo que habitaba en aquel país.

verses.KJV: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
verses.WEB: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And they possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even unto the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Possuíram também todo aquele termo dos amorreus desde Arnom até Jaboque, e desde o deserto até o Jordão.
