verses.RVR09: Y Booz le dijo á la hora de comer: Allégate aquí, y come del pan, y moja tu bocado en el vinagre. Y sentóse ella junto á los segadores, y él le dió del potaje, y comió hasta que se hartó y le sobró.

verses.KJV: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:
verses.WEB: When she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, “Let her glean even among the sheaves, and don’t reproach her.
verses.ASV: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantou-se logo para tirar espigas. E Boaz mandou a seus criados, dizendo: Colha também espigas entre os feixes, e não a envergonheis;
verses.RVR09: Levantóse luego para espigar. Y Booz mandó á sus criados, diciendo: Coja también espigas entre las gavillas, y no la avergoncéis;

verses.KJV: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
verses.WEB: Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don’t rebuke her.”
verses.ASV: And also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it, and let her glean, and rebuke her not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes lançareis de propósito dos feixes, e a deixareis que colha, e não a repreendais.
verses.RVR09: Antes echaréis á sabiendas de los manojos, y la dejaréis que coja, y no la reprendáis.

verses.KJV: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.
verses.WEB: So she gleaned in the field until evening; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
verses.ASV: So she gleaned in the field until even; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirou espigas no campo até à tarde, e debulhou o que havia colhido, e foi como um efa de cevada.
verses.RVR09: Y espigó en el campo hasta la tarde, y desgranó lo que había cogido, y fué como un epha de cebada.

verses.KJV: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.
verses.WEB: She took it up, and went into the city. Then her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought out and gave to her that which she had left after she had enough.
verses.ASV: And she took it up, and went into the city; and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth and gave to her that which she had left after she was sufficed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou-o, e veio à cidade; e sua sogra viu o que havia colhido. Tirou também logo o que lhe havia sobrado depois de farta, e deu-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Y tomólo, y vínose á la ciudad; y su suegra vió lo que había cogido. Sacó también luego lo que le había sobrado después de harta, y dióselo.

verses.KJV: And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man's name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.
verses.WEB: Her mother-in-law said to her, “Where have you gleaned today? Where have you worked? Blessed be he who noticed you.” She told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, “The man’s name with whom I worked today is Boaz.”
verses.ASV: And her mother-in-law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to-day? and where hast thou wrought? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she showed her mother-in-law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man’s name with whom I wrought to-day is Boaz.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe sua sogra: Onde tiraste espigas hoje? e onde trabalhaste? Bendito seja o que te reconheceu. E ela declarou à sua sogra o que lhe havia acontecido com aquele, e disse: O nome do homem com quem hoje trabalhei é Boaz.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole su suegra: ¿Dónde has espigado hoy? ¿y dónde has trabajado? bendito sea el que te ha reconocido. Y ella declaró á su suegra lo que le había acontecido con aquél, y dijo: El nombre del varón con quien hoy he trabajado es Booz.

verses.KJV: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of the Lord, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.
verses.WEB: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen.”
verses.ASV: And Naomi said unto her daughter-in-law, Blessed be he of Jehovah, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is nigh of kin unto us, one of our near kinsmen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Noemi à sua nora: Seja ele bendito do SENHOR, pois que não recusou aos vivos a benevolência que teve para com os finados. Disse-lhe depois Noemi: Nosso parente é aquele homem, e de nossos remidores é.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Noemi á su nuera: Sea él bendito de Jehová, pues que no ha rehusado á los vivos la benevolencia que tuvo para con los finados. Díjole después Noemi: Nuestro pariente es aquel varón, y de nuestros redentores es.

verses.KJV: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
verses.WEB: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”
verses.ASV: And Ruth the Moabitess said, Yea, he said unto me, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Rute moabita disse: a mais disto me disse: Junta-te com meus criados, até que tenham acabado toda minha colheita.
verses.RVR09: Y Ruth Moabita dijo: A más de esto me ha dicho: Júntate con mis criados, hasta que hayan acabado toda mi siega.

verses.KJV: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law, It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.
verses.WEB: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, and that they not harm you in any other field.”
verses.ASV: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter-in-law, It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, and that they meet thee not in any other field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Noemi respondeu a Rute sua nora: Melhor é, filha minha, que saias com suas criadas, que não que te encontrem em outro campo.
verses.RVR09: Y Noemi respondió á Ruth su nuera: Mejor es, hija mía, que salgas con sus criadas, que no que te encuentren en otro campo.

verses.KJV: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.
verses.WEB: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.
verses.ASV: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz, to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she dwelt with her mother-in-law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esteve, pois, junto com as moças de Boaz tirando espigas, até que a colheita das cevadas e a dos trigos foi acabada; mas com sua sogra habitou.
verses.RVR09: Estuvo pues junta con las mozas de Booz espigando, hasta que la siega de las cebadas y la de los trigos fué acabada; mas con su suegra habitó.

verses.KJV: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?
verses.WEB: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, “My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?
verses.ASV: And Naomi her mother-in-law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe sua sogra Noemi: Filha minha, não tenho de buscar descanso a ti, para que fiques bem?
verses.RVR09: Y DÍJOLE su suegra Noemi: Hija mía, ¿no te tengo de buscar descanso, que te sea bueno?

verses.KJV: And now is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.
verses.WEB: Now isn’t Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor.
verses.ASV: And now is not Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to-night in the threshing-floor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é Boaz nosso parente, com cujas moças tu tens estado? Eis que ele aventa esta noite a os grãos de cevada.
verses.RVR09: ¿No es Booz nuestro pariente, con cuyas mozas tú has estado? He aquí que él avienta esta noche la parva de las cebadas.

verses.KJV: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.
verses.WEB: Therefore wash yourself, anoint yourself, get dressed, and go down to the threshing floor; but don’t make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
verses.ASV: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the threshing-floor, but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te lavarás, pois, e te ungirás, e vestindo-te tuas vestes, passarás à eira; mas não te darás a conhecer ao homem até que ele tenha acabado de comer e de beber.
verses.RVR09: Te lavarás pues, y te ungirás, y vistiéndote tus vestidos, pasarás á la era; mas no te darás á conocer al varón hasta que él haya acabado de comer y de beber.

verses.KJV: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.
verses.WEB: It shall be, when he lies down, that you shall note the place where he is lying. Then you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down. Then he will tell you what to do.”
verses.ASV: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele se deitar, repara tu o lugar de onde ele se deitará, e irás, e descobrirás os pés, e te deitarás ali; e ele te dirá o que tenhas de fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando él se acostare, repara tú el lugar donde él se acostará, é irás, y descubrirás los pies, y te acostarás allí; y él te dirá lo que hayas de hacer.

verses.KJV: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.
verses.WEB: She said to her, “All that you say, I will do.”
verses.ASV: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest I will do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe respondeu: Farei tudo o que tu me mandares.
verses.RVR09: Y le respondió: Haré todo lo que tú me mandares.

verses.KJV: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.
verses.WEB: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her.
verses.ASV: And she went down unto the threshing-floor, and did according to all that her mother-in-law bade her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desceu, pois à eira, e fez tudo o que sua sogra lhe havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: Descendió pues á la era, é hizo todo lo que su suegra le había mandado.

verses.KJV: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.
verses.WEB: When Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. She came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.
verses.ASV: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Boaz havia comido e bebido, e seu coração esteve contente, retirou-se para dormir a um lado do amontoado. Então ela veio caladamente, e revelou os pés, e deitou-se.
verses.RVR09: Y como Booz hubo comido y bebido, y su corazón estuvo contento, retiróse á dormir á un lado del montón. Entonces ella vino calladamente, y descubrió los pies, y acostóse.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
verses.WEB: At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself; and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, que à meia noite se estremeceu aquele homem, e apalpou: e eis que, a mulher que estava deitada a seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que á la media noche se estremeció aquel hombre, y palpó: y he aquí, la mujer que estaba acostada á sus pies.

verses.KJV: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.
verses.WEB: He said, “Who are you?” She answered, “I am Ruth your servant. Therefore spread the corner of your garment over your servant; for you are a near kinsman.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thy handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thy handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele disse: Quem és? E ela respondeu: Eu sou Rute tua serva: estende a borda de tua capa sobre tua serva, porquanto és parente próximo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él dijo: ¿Quién eres? Y ella respondió: Yo soy Ruth tu sierva: extiende el borde de tu capa sobre tu sierva, por cuanto eres pariente cercano.

verses.KJV: And he said, Blessed be thou of the Lord, my daughter: for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.WEB: He said, “You are blessed by the LORD, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn’t follow young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.ASV: And he said, Blessed be thou of Jehovah, my daughter: thou hast showed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Bendita sejas tu do SENHOR, filha minha; que fizeste melhor tua última bondade que a primeira, não indo atrás dos rapazes, sejam pobres ou ricos.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Bendita seas tú de Jehová, hija mía; que has hecho mejor tu postrera gracia que la primera, no yendo tras los mancebos, sean pobres ó ricos.

verses.KJV: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.
verses.WEB: Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman.
verses.ASV: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou sayest; for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a worthy woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, não temas, filha minha: eu farei contigo o que tu disseres, pois que toda a porta de meu povo sabe que és mulher virtuosa.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, no temas, hija mía: yo haré contigo lo que tú dijeres, pues que toda la puerta de mi pueblo sabe que eres mujer virtuosa.

verses.KJV: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.
verses.WEB: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.
verses.ASV: And now it is true that I am a near kinsman; howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, ainda que seja certo que eu sou parente próximo, contudo isso há parente mais próximo que eu.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, aunque es cierto que yo soy pariente cercano, con todo eso hay pariente más cercano que yo.

verses.KJV: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman's part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as the Lord liveth: lie down until the morning.
verses.WEB: Stay this night, and in the morning, if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman, good. Let him do the kinsman’s duty. But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you, then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you, as the LORD lives. Lie down until the morning.”
verses.ASV: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman’s part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as Jehovah liveth: lie down until the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Repousa esta noite, e quando for de dia, se ele te redimir, bem, redima-te; mas se ele não te quiser redimir, eu te redimirei, vive o SENHOR. Descansa, pois, até a manhã.
verses.RVR09: Reposa esta noche, y cuando sea de día, si él te redimiere, bien, redímate; mas si él no te quisiere redimir, yo te redimiré, vive Jehová. Descansa pues hasta la mañana.

verses.KJV: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.
verses.WEB: She lay at his feet until the morning, then she rose up before one could discern another. For he said, “Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.”
verses.ASV: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could discern another. For he said, Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing-floor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que repousou a seus pés até a manhã, levantou-se, antes que ninguém pudesse conhecer a outro. E ele disse: Não se saiba que tenha vindo mulher à eira.
verses.RVR09: Y después que reposó á sus pies hasta la mañana, levantóse, antes que nadie pudiese conocer á otro. Y él dijo: No se sepa que haya venido mujer á la era.

verses.KJV: Also he said, Bring the vail that thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her: and she went into the city.
verses.WEB: He said, “Bring the mantle that is on you, and hold it.” She held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; then he went into the city.
verses.ASV: And he said, Bring the mantle that is upon thee, and hold it; and she held it; and he measured six [measures] of barley, and laid it on her: and he went into the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois lhe disse: Aproxima o lenço que trazes sobre ti, e segura-o. E enquanto ela o segurava, ele mediu seis medidas de cevada, e as pôs às costas: e veio ela à cidade.
verses.RVR09: Después le dijo: Llega el lienzo que traes sobre ti, y ten de él. Y teniéndolo ella, él midió seis medidas de cebada, y púsoselas á cuestas: y vínose ella á la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.
verses.WEB: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, “How did it go, my daughter?” She told her all that the man had done for her.
verses.ASV: And when she came to her mother-in-law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que veio à sua sogra, esta lhe disse: Que houve, minha filha? E ela lhe declarou ela tudo o que com aquele homem lhe havia acontecido.
verses.RVR09: Así que vino á su suegra, ésta le dijo: ¿Qué pues, hija mía? Y declaróle ella todo lo que con aquel varón le había acontecido.

verses.KJV: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.
verses.WEB: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don’t go empty to your mother-in-law.’”
verses.ASV: And she said, These six [measures] of barley gave he me; for he said, Go not empty unto thy mother-in-law.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Estas seis medidas de cevada me deu, dizendo-me: Porque não vás vazia à tua sogra.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Estas seis medidas de cebada me dió, diciéndome: Porque no vayas vacía á tu suegra.

verses.KJV: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.
verses.WEB: Then she said, “Wait, my daughter, until you know what will happen; for the man will not rest until he has settled this today.”
verses.ASV: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall; for the man will not rest, until he have finished the thing this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Noemi disse: Repousa, filha minha, até que saibas como a coisa se sucede; porque aquele homem não parará até que hoje conclua o negócio.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Noemi dijo: Reposa, hija mía, hasta que sepas cómo cae la cosa: porque aquel hombre no parará hasta que hoy concluya el negocio.

verses.KJV: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.
verses.WEB: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him, “Come over here, friend, and sit down!” He came over, and sat down.
verses.ASV: Now Boaz went up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Boaz subiu à porta da cidade e sentou-se ali: e eis que passava aquele parente do qual havia Boaz falado, e disse-lhe: Ei, fulano, vem aqui e senta-te. E ele veio, e sentou-se.
verses.RVR09: Y BOOZ subió á la puerta y sentóse allí: y he aquí pasaba aquel pariente del cual había Booz hablado, y díjole: Eh, fulano, ven acá y siéntate. Y él vino, y sentóse.

verses.KJV: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.
verses.WEB: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, “Sit down here,” and they sat down.
verses.ASV: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele tomou dez homens dos anciãos da cidade, e disse: Sentai-vos aqui. E eles se sentaram.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él tomó diez varones de los ancianos de la ciudad, y dijo: Sentaos aquí. Y ellos se sentaron.

verses.KJV: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's:
verses.WEB: He said to the near kinsman, “Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s.
verses.ASV: And he said unto the near kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s:
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo disse ao parente: Noemi, que voltou do campo de Moabe, vende uma parte das terras que teve nosso irmão Elimeleque;
verses.RVR09: Luego dijo al pariente: Noemi, que ha vuelto del campo de Moab, vende una parte de las tierras que tuvo nuestro hermano Elimelech;

verses.KJV: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it.
verses.WEB: I thought I should tell you, saying, ‘Buy it before those who sit here, and before the elders of my people.’ If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know. For there is no one to redeem it besides you; and I am after you.” He said, “I will redeem it.”
verses.ASV: and I thought to disclose it unto thee, saying, Buy it before them that sit here, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know; for there is none to redeem it besides thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu decidi fazê-lo saber a ti, e dizer-te que a tomes diante dos que estão aqui sentados, e diante dos anciãos de meu povo. Se houveres de redimir, redime; e se não quiseres redimir, declara-o a mim para que eu o saiba: porque não há outro que redima a não ser tu, e eu depois de ti. E ele respondeu: Eu redimirei.
verses.RVR09: Y yo decidí hacértelo saber, y decirte que la tomes delante de los que están aquí sentados, y delante de los ancianos de mi pueblo. Si hubieres de redimir, redime; y si no quisieres redimir, decláramelo para que yo lo sepa: porque no hay otro que redima sino tú, y yo después de ti. Y él respondió: Yo redimiré.

verses.KJV: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.
verses.WEB: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.”
verses.ASV: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então replicou Boaz: O mesmo dia que tomares as terras da mão de Noemi, hás de tomar também a Rute moabita, mulher do defunto, para que suscites o nome do morto sobre sua possessão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces replicó Booz: El mismo día que tomares las tierras de mano de Noemi, has de tomar también á Ruth Moabita, mujer del difunto, para que suscites el nombre del muerto sobre su posesión.

verses.KJV: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it.
verses.WEB: The near kinsman said, “I can’t redeem it for myself, lest I endanger my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption for yourself; for I can’t redeem it.”
verses.ASV: And the near kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: take thou my right of redemption on thee; for I cannot redeem it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu o parente: Não posso redimir por minha parte, porque lançaria a perder minha propriedade: redime tu usando de meu direito, porque eu não poderei redimir.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió el pariente: No puedo redimir por mi parte, porque echaría á perder mi heredad: redime tú usando de mi derecho, porque yo no podré redimir.

verses.KJV: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.
verses.WEB: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man took off his sandal, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.
verses.ASV: Now this was [the custom] in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man drew off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the [manner of] attestation in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia já de longo tempo este costume em Israel na remissão ou contrato, que para a confirmação de qualquer negócio, o um se tirava o sapato e o dava a seu companheiro: e este era o testemunho em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Había ya de largo tiempo esta costumbre en Israel en la redención ó contrato, que para la confirmación de cualquier negocio, el uno se quitaba el zapato y lo daba á su compañero: y este era el testimonio en Israel.

verses.KJV: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.
verses.WEB: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.
verses.ASV: So the near kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thyself. And he drew off his shoe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o parente disse a Boaz: Toma-o tu. E descalçou seu sapato.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pariente dijo á Booz: Tómalo tú. Y descalzó su zapato.

verses.KJV: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.
verses.WEB: Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “You are witnesses today, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.
verses.ASV: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, of the hand of Naomi.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Boaz disse aos anciãos e a todo aquele povo: Vós sois hoje testemunhas de que tomo todas as coisas que foram de Elimeleque, e tudo o que foi de Quiliom e de Malom, da mão de Noemi.
verses.RVR09: Y Booz dijo á los ancianos y á todo el pueblo: Vosotros sois hoy testigos de que tomo todas las cosas que fueron de Elimelech, y todo lo que fué de Chelión y de Mahalón, de mano de Noemi;

verses.KJV: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.
verses.WEB: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”
verses.ASV: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que também tomo por minha mulher a Rute moabita, mulher de Malom, para suscitar o nome do defunto sobre sua herança, para que o nome do morto não se apague dentre seus irmãos e da porta de seu lugar. Vós sois hoje testemunhas.
verses.RVR09: Y que también tomo por mi mujer á Ruth Moabita, mujer de Mahalón, para suscitar el nombre del difunto sobre su heredad, para que el nombre del muerto no se borre de entre sus hermanos y de la puerta de su lugar. Vosotros sois hoy testigos.

verses.KJV: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. The Lord make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem:
verses.WEB: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Bethlehem.
verses.ASV: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. Jehovah make the woman that is come into thy house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Beth-lehem:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram todos os do povo que estavam à porta com os anciãos: Testemunhas somos. O SENHOR faça à mulher que entra em tua casa como a Raquel e a Lia, as quais duas edificaram a casa de Israel; e tu sejas ilustre em Efrata, e tenhas renome em Belém.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron todos los del pueblo que estaban á la puerta con los ancianos: Testigos somos. Jehová haga á la mujer que entra en tu casa como á Rachêl y á Lea, las cuales dos edificaron la casa de Israel; y tú seas ilustre en Ephrata, y tengas nombradía en Beth-lehem;

verses.KJV: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the Lord shall give thee of this young woman.
verses.WEB: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which the LORD will give you by this young woman.”
verses.ASV: and let thy house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which Jehovah shall give thee of this young woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da semente que o SENHOR te der desta moça, seja tua casa como a casa de Perez, o que Tamar deu a Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y de la simiente que Jehová te diere de aquesta moza, sea tu casa como la casa de Phares, al que parió Thamar á Judá.

verses.KJV: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the Lord gave her conception, and she bare a son.
verses.WEB: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.
verses.ASV: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife; and he went in unto her, and Jehovah gave her conception, and she bare a son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Boaz tomou a Rute, e ela foi sua mulher; e logo que entrou a ela, o SENHOR lhe deu que concebesse e desse à luz um filho.
verses.RVR09: Booz pues tomó á Ruth, y ella fué su mujer; y luego que entró á ella, Jehová le dió que concibiese y pariese un hijo.

verses.KJV: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the Lord, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.
verses.WEB: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.
verses.ASV: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be Jehovah, who hath not left thee this day without a near kinsman; and let his name be famous in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as mulheres diziam a Noemi: Louvado seja o SENHOR, que fez que não te faltasse hoje parente, cujo nome será nomeado em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y las mujeres decían á Noemi: Loado sea Jehová, que hizo que no te faltase hoy pariente, cuyo nombre será nombrado en Israel.

verses.KJV: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.
verses.WEB: He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him.”
verses.ASV: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of life, and a nourisher of thine old age, for thy daughter-in-law, who loveth thee, who is better to thee than seven sons, hath borne him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual será restaurador de tua alma, e o que sustentará tua velhice; pois que tua nora, a qual te ama e te vale mais que sete filhos, o fez nascer.
verses.RVR09: El cual será restaurador de tu alma, y el que sustentará tu vejez; pues que tu nuera, la cual te ama y te vale más que siete hijos, le ha parido.

verses.KJV: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
verses.WEB: Naomi took the child, laid him in her bosom, and became nurse to him.
verses.ASV: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando Noemi o filho, o pôs em seu colo, e foi-lhe sua ama.
verses.RVR09: Y tomando Noemi el hijo, púsolo en su regazo, y fuéle su ama.

verses.KJV: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.WEB: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.ASV: And the women her neighbors gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as vizinhas dizendo, a Noemi nasceu um filho, lhe puseram nome; e chamaram-lhe Obede. Este é pai de Jessé, pai de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y las vecinas diciendo, A Noemi ha nacido un hijo, le pusieron nombre; y llamáronle Obed. Este es padre de Isaí, padre de David.

verses.KJV: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,
verses.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,
verses.ASV: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez begat Hezron,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as gerações de Perez: Perez gerou a Hezrom;
verses.RVR09: Y estas son las generaciones de Phares: Phares engendró á Hesrón;

verses.KJV: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,
verses.WEB: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,
verses.ASV: and Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hezrom gerou a Rão, e Rão gerou a Aminadabe;
verses.RVR09: Y Hesrón engendró á Ram, y Ram engendró á Aminadab;

verses.KJV: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
verses.WEB: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,
verses.ASV: and Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Aminadabe gerou a Naassom, e Naassom gerou a Salmom;
verses.RVR09: Y Aminadab engendró á Nahasón, y Nahasón engendró á Salmón;

verses.KJV: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,
verses.WEB: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed,
verses.ASV: and Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salmom gerou a Boaz, e Boaz gerou a Obede;
verses.RVR09: Y Salmón engendró á Booz, y Booz engendró á Obed;

verses.KJV: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
verses.WEB: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.
verses.ASV: and Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Obede gerou a Jessé, e Jessé gerou a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y Obed engendró á Isaí, é Isaí engendró á David.

verses.KJV: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaimzophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
verses.WEB: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
verses.ASV: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of the hill-country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite:
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve um homem de Ramataim de Zofim, do monte de Efraim, que se chamava Elcana, filho de Jeroão, filho de Eliú, filho de Toú, filho de Zufe, efraimita.
verses.RVR09: HUBO un varón de Ramathaim de Sophim, del monte de Ephraim, que se llamaba Elcana, hijo de Jeroham, hijo de Eliú, hijo de Thohu, hijo de Suph, Ephrateo.

verses.KJV: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.WEB: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.ASV: and he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinha ele duas mulheres; o nome da uma era Ana, e o nome da outra Penina. E Penina tinha filhos, mas Ana não os tinha.
verses.RVR09: Y tenía él dos mujeres; el nombre de la una era Anna, y el nombre de la otra Peninna. Y Peninna tenía hijos, mas Anna no los tenía.

verses.KJV: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the Lord of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were there.
verses.WEB: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to the LORD, were there.
verses.ASV: And this man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice unto Jehovah of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests unto Jehovah, were there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esse homem subia todos os anos de sua cidade, para adorar e sacrificar ao SENHOR dos exércitos em Siló. E ali estavam os dois filhos de Eli, Hofni e Fineias, sacerdotes do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y subía aquel varón todos los años de su ciudad, á adorar y sacrificar á Jehová de los ejércitos en Silo, donde estaban dos hijos de Eli, Ophni y Phinees, sacerdotes de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:
verses.WEB: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;
verses.ASV: And when the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vinha o dia, Elcana sacrificava, e dava à sua mulher Penina, e a todos os seus filhos e a todas as suas filhas, a cada um a sua porção.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando venía el día, Elcana sacrificaba, y daba á Peninna su mujer, y á todos sus hijos y á todas sus hijas, á cada uno su parte.

verses.KJV: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the Lord had shut up her womb.
verses.WEB: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but the LORD had shut up her womb.
verses.ASV: but unto Hannah he gave a double portion; for he loved Hannah, but Jehovah had shut up her womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a Ana ele dava uma porção selecionada; porque amava a Ana, ainda que o SENHOR houvesse fechado sua madre.
verses.RVR09: Mas á Anna daba una parte escogida; porque amaba á Anna, aunque Jehová había cerrado su matriz.

verses.KJV: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the Lord had shut up her womb.
verses.WEB: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because the LORD had shut up her womb.
verses.ASV: And her rival provoked her sore, to make her fret, because Jehovah had shut up her womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua concorrente a irritava, irando-a e entristecendo-a, porque o SENHOR havia fechado sua madre.
verses.RVR09: Y su competidora la irritaba, enojándola y entristeciéndola, porque Jehová había cerrado su matriz.

verses.KJV: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the Lord, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
verses.WEB: So year by year, when she went up to the LORD’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.
verses.ASV: And [as] he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of Jehovah, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim fazia cada ano: quando subia à casa do SENHOR, irritava assim à outra; pelo qual ela chorava, e não comia.
verses.RVR09: Y así hacía cada año: cuando subía á la casa de Jehová, enojaba así á la otra; por lo cual ella lloraba, y no comía.

verses.KJV: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?
verses.WEB: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”
verses.ASV: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Elcana seu marido lhe disse: Ana, por que choras? Por que não comes? E por que está afligido teu coração? Não te sou eu melhor que dez filhos?
verses.RVR09: Y Elcana su marido le dijo: Anna, ¿por qué lloras? ¿y por qué no comes? ¿y por qué está afligido tu corazón? ¿No te soy yo mejor que diez hijos?

verses.KJV: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the Lord.
verses.WEB: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of the LORD’s temple.
verses.ASV: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest was sitting upon his seat by the door-post of the temple of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se Ana depois que havia comido e bebido em Siló; e enquanto o sacerdote Eli estava sentado em uma cadeira junto a um pilar do templo do SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Anna después que hubo comido y bebido en Silo; y mientras el sacerdote Eli estaba sentado en una silla junto á un pilar del templo de Jehová,

verses.KJV: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the Lord, and wept sore.
verses.WEB: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, weeping bitterly.
verses.ASV: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto Jehovah, and wept sore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela com amargura de alma orou ao SENHOR, e chorou abundantemente.
verses.RVR09: Ella con amargura de alma oró á Jehová, y lloró abundantemente.

verses.KJV: And she vowed a vow, and said, O Lord of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the Lord all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.
verses.WEB: She vowed a vow, and said, “LORD of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”
verses.ASV: And she vowed a vow, and said, O Jehovah of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thy handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thy handmaid, but wilt give unto thy handmaid a man-child, then I will give him unto Jehovah all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez um voto, dizendo: “SENHOR dos exércitos, se olhares a aflição da tua serva, e te lembrares de mim, e não te esqueceres da tua serva, mas deres à tua serva um filho homem, eu o dedicarei ao SENHOR todos os dias da sua vida, e não subirá navalha sobre sua cabeça”.
verses.RVR09: E hizo voto, diciendo: Jehová de los ejércitos, si te dignares mirar la aflicción de tu sierva, y te acordares de mí, y no te olvidares de tu sierva, mas dieres á tu sierva un hijo varón, yo lo dedicaré á Jehová todos los días de su vida, y no subirá navaja sobre su cabeza.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the Lord, that Eli marked her mouth.
verses.WEB: As she continued praying before the LORD, Eli saw her mouth.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before Jehovah, that Eli marked her mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, enquanto ela continuava a orar diante do SENHOR, Eli observava a sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que como ella orase largamente delante de Jehová, Eli estaba observando la boca de ella.

verses.KJV: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
verses.WEB: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
verses.ASV: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Ana falava em seu coração, e somente se moviam seus lábios, e sua voz não se ouvia; e pensava Eli que ela estava embriagada.
verses.RVR09: Mas Anna hablaba en su corazón, y solamente se movían sus labios, y su voz no se oía; y túvola Eli por borracha.

verses.KJV: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.
verses.WEB: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”
verses.ASV: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, disse-lhe Eli: “Até quando estarás embriagada? Afasta-te do vinho”.
verses.RVR09: Entonces le dijo Eli: ¿Hasta cuándo estarás borracha?; digiere tu vino.

verses.KJV: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ana lhe respondeu: Não, meu senhor; eu sou uma mulher sofredora de espírito. Não bebi vinho nem bebida forte, mas tenho derramado minha alma diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Anna le respondió, diciendo: No, señor mío: mas yo soy una mujer trabajada de espíritu: no he bebido vino ni sidra, sino que he derramado mi alma delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.
verses.WEB: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”
verses.ASV: Count not thy handmaid for a wicked woman; for out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation have I spoken hitherto.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não consideres a tua serva como mulher ímpia, porque é da grandeza das minhas angústias e da minha aflição que tenho falado até agora.
verses.RVR09: No tengas á tu sierva por una mujer impía: porque por la magnitud de mis congojas y de mi aflicción he hablado hasta ahora.

verses.KJV: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.
verses.WEB: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”
verses.ASV: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace; and the God of Israel grant thy petition that thou hast asked of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eli respondeu: “Vai em paz, e o Deus de Israel te conceda o pedido que lhe fizeste”.
verses.RVR09: Y Eli respondió, y dijo: Ve en paz, y el Dios de Israel te otorgue la petición que le has hecho.

verses.KJV: And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.
verses.WEB: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.
verses.ASV: And she said, Let thy handmaid find favor in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat; and her countenance was no more [sad].
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse: “Que a tua serva ache favor diante de teus olhos”. E a mulher se foi seu caminho, e comeu, e não esteve mais triste.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: Halle tu sierva gracia delante de tus ojos. Y fuése la mujer su camino, y comió, y no estuvo más triste.

verses.KJV: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the Lord, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the Lord remembered her.
verses.WEB: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped the LORD, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.
verses.ASV: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before Jehovah, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah. And Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Jehovah remembered her;
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando-se de manhã, adoraram diante do SENHOR, e voltaram, e vieram a sua casa em Ramá. E Elcana se deitou com sua mulher Ana, e o SENHOR se lembrou dela.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose de mañana, adoraron delante de Jehová, y volviéronse, y vinieron á su casa en Ramatha. Y Elcana conoció á Anna su mujer, y Jehová se acordó de ella.

verses.KJV: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of the Lord.
verses.WEB: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of the LORD.”
verses.ASV: and it came to pass, when the time was come about, that Hannah conceived, and bare a son; and she called his name Samuel, [saying], Because I have asked him of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, corrido o tempo, depois de Ana haver concebido, deu à luz um filho, e pôs-lhe o nome de Samuel, dizendo: “Pois eu o pedi ao SENHOR”.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que corrido el tiempo, después de haber concebido Anna, parió un hijo, y púsole por nombre Samuel, diciendo: Por cuanto lo demandé á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the Lord the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
verses.WEB: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
verses.ASV: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto Jehovah the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois subiu o homem Elcana, com toda sua família, a sacrificar ao SENHOR o sacrifício costumeiro, e seu voto.
verses.RVR09: Después subió el varón Elcana, con toda su familia, á sacrificar á Jehová el sacrificio acostumbrado, y su voto.

verses.KJV: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before the Lord, and there abide for ever.
verses.WEB: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and stay there forever.”
verses.ASV: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, [I will not go up] until the child be weaned; and then I will bring him, that he may appear before Jehovah, and there abide for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Ana não subiu, mas sim disse a seu marido: Eu não subirei até que o menino seja desmamado; para que o leve e seja apresentado diante do SENHOR, e fique ali para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Mas Anna no subió, sino dijo á su marido: Yo no subiré hasta que el niño sea destetado; para que lo lleve y sea presentado delante de Jehová, y se quede allá para siempre.

verses.KJV: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the Lord establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.
verses.WEB: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may the LORD establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him.
verses.ASV: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only Jehovah establish his word. So the woman tarried and gave her son suck, until she weaned him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Elcana seu marido lhe respondeu: Faze o que bem te parecer; fica-te até que o desmames; somente o SENHOR cumpra sua palavra. E ficou a mulher, e creu seu filho até que o desmamou.
verses.RVR09: Y Elcana su marido le respondió: Haz lo que bien te pareciere; quédate hasta que lo destetes: solamente Jehová cumpla su palabra. Y quedóse la mujer, y crió su hijo hasta que lo destetó.

verses.KJV: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the Lord in Shiloh: and the child was young.
verses.WEB: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to the LORD’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.
verses.ASV: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of meal, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of Jehovah in Shiloh: and the child was young.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que o desmamou, levou-o consigo, com três bezerros, e um efa de farinha, e uma vasilha de vinho, e trouxe-o à casa do SENHOR em Siló: e o menino era pequeno.
verses.RVR09: Y después que lo hubo destetado, llevólo consigo, con tres becerros, y un epha de harina, y una vasija de vino, y trájolo á la casa de Jehová en Silo: y el niño era pequeño.

verses.KJV: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.
verses.WEB: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.
verses.ASV: And they slew the bullock, and brought the child to Eli.
verses.ALMEIDA: E matando o bezerro, trouxeram o menino a Eli.
verses.RVR09: Y matando el becerro, trajeron el niño á Eli.

verses.KJV: And she said, Oh my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And she said, Oh, my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse: Oh, senhor meu! Vive tua alma, senhor meu, eu sou aquela mulher que esteve aqui junto a ti orando ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: ¡Oh, señor mío! vive tu alma, señor mío, yo soy aquella mujer que estuvo aquí junto á ti orando á Jehová.

verses.KJV: For this child I prayed; and the Lord hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
verses.WEB: I prayed for this child, and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of him.
verses.ASV: For this child I prayed; and Jehovah hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por este menino orava, e o SENHOR me deu o que lhe pedi.
verses.RVR09: Por este niño oraba, y Jehová me dió lo que le pedí.

verses.KJV: Therefore also I have lent him to the Lord; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the Lord. And he worshipped the Lord there.
verses.WEB: Therefore I have also given him to the LORD. As long as he lives he is given to the LORD.” He worshiped the LORD there.
verses.ASV: therefore also I have granted him to Jehovah; as long as he liveth he is granted to Jehovah. And he worshipped Jehovah there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, pois, o devolvo também ao SENHOR: todos os dias que viver, será do SENHOR. E adorou ali ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Yo pues le vuelvo también á Jehová: todos los días que viviere, será de Jehová. Y adoró allí á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the Lord, mine horn is exalted in the Lord: my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.WEB: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in the LORD! My horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.
verses.ASV: And Hannah prayed, and said: My heart exulteth in Jehovah; My horn is exalted in Jehovah; My mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; Because I rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ana orou e disse: Meu coração se regozija no SENHOR, Meu poder é exaltado no SENHOR; Minha boca fala triunfante sobre meus inimigos, Porquanto me alegrei em tua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Y ANNA oró y dijo: mi corazón se regocija en Jehová, mi cuerno es ensalzado en Jehová; mi boca se ensanchó sobre mis enemigos, por cuanto me alegré en tu salud.

verses.KJV: There is none holy as the Lord: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
verses.WEB: There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
verses.ASV: There is none holy as Jehovah; For there is none besides thee, Neither is there any rock like our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há santo como o SENHOR: Porque não há ninguém além de ti; E não há refúgio como o nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: No hay santo como Jehová: porque no hay ninguno fuera de ti; y no hay refugio como el Dios nuestro.

verses.KJV: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the Lord is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
verses.WEB: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for the LORD is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.
verses.ASV: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; Let not arrogancy come out of your mouth; For Jehovah is a God of knowledge, And by him actions are weighed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não faleis tantas coisas soberbas; Cessem as palavras arrogantes de vossa boca; Porque o Deus de todo conhecimento é o SENHOR, E a ele cabe pesar as ações.
verses.RVR09: No multipliquéis hablando grandezas, altanerías; cesen las palabras arrogantes de vuestra boca; porque el Dios de todo saber es Jehová, y á él toca el pesar las acciones.

verses.KJV: The bows of the mighty men are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.
verses.WEB: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.
verses.ASV: The bows of the mighty men are broken; And they that stumbled are girded with strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os arcos dos fortes foram quebrados, E os fracos se cingiram de força.
verses.RVR09: Los arcos de los fuertes fueron quebrados, y los flacos se ciñeron de fortaleza.

verses.KJV: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.
verses.WEB: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.
verses.ASV: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; And they that were hungry have ceased [to hunger]: Yea, the barren hath borne seven; And she that hath many children languisheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os fartos se alugaram por pão: E cessaram os famintos; até a estéril deu à luz sete, e a que tinha muitos filhos se enfraqueceu.
verses.RVR09: Los hartos se alquilaron por pan: y cesaron los hambrientos: hasta parir siete la estéril, y la que tenía muchos hijos enfermó.

verses.KJV: The Lord killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.
verses.WEB: “The LORD kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.
verses.ASV: Jehovah killeth, and maketh alive: He bringeth down to Sheol, and bringeth up.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR mata e dá vida; ele faz descer ao Xeol, e faz [de lá] subir.
verses.RVR09: Jehová mata, y él da vida: él hace descender al sepulcro, y hace subir.

verses.KJV: The Lord maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.
verses.WEB: The LORD makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
verses.ASV: Jehovah maketh poor, and maketh rich: He bringeth low, he also lifteth up.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR empobrece e enriquece; abate e exalta.
verses.RVR09: Jehová empobrece, y él enriquece: abate, y ensalza.

verses.KJV: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the Lord's, and he hath set the world upon them.
verses.WEB: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are the LORD’s. He has set the world on them.
verses.ASV: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, He lifteth up the needy from the dunghill, To make them sit with princes, And inherit the throne of glory: For the pillars of the earth are Jehovah’s, And he hath set the world upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele levanta do pó ao pobre, e ao necessitado ergue do esterco, para assentá-lo com os príncipes; e faz que tenham por propriedade assento de honra; porque do SENHOR são os alicerces da terra, e assentou o mundo sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: El levanta del polvo al pobre, y al menesteroso ensalza del estiércol, para asentarlo con los príncipes; y hace que tengan por heredad asiento de honra: porque de Jehová son las columnas de la tierra, y él asentó sobre ellas el mundo.

verses.KJV: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.
verses.WEB: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.
verses.ASV: He will keep the feet of his holy ones; But the wicked shall be put to silence in darkness; For by strength shall no man prevail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele guarda os pés de seus santos, Mas os ímpios perecem em trevas; Porque ninguém será forte por sua força.
verses.RVR09: El guarda los pies de sus santos, mas los impíos perecen en tinieblas; porque nadie será fuerte por su fuerza.

verses.KJV: The adversaries of the Lord shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the Lord shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.
verses.WEB: Those who strive with the LORD shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. “The LORD will judge the ends of the earth. He will give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.”
verses.ASV: They that strive with Jehovah shall be broken to pieces; Against them will he thunder in heaven: Jehovah will judge the ends of the earth; And he will give strength unto his king, And exalt the horn of his anointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante do SENHOR serão quebrantados seus adversários, E sobre eles trovejará desde os céus: o SENHOR julgará os termos da terra, E dará força a seu Rei, E exaltará o poder de seu ungido.
verses.RVR09: Delante de Jehová serán quebrantados sus adversarios, y sobre ellos tronará desde los cielos: Jehová juzgará los términos de la tierra, y dará fortaleza á su Rey, y ensalzará el cuerno de su Mesías.

verses.KJV: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the Lord before Eli the priest.
verses.WEB: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served the LORD before Eli the priest.
verses.ASV: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto Jehovah before Eli the priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Elcana se voltou a sua casa em Ramá; e o menino ministrava ao SENHOR diante do sacerdote Eli.
verses.RVR09: Y Elcana se volvió á su casa en Ramatha; y el niño ministraba á Jehová delante del sacerdote Eli.

verses.KJV: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the Lord.
verses.WEB: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know the LORD.
verses.ASV: Now the sons of Eli were base men; they knew not Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os filhos de Eli eram homens ímpios, e não tinham conhecimento do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas los hijos de Eli eran hombres impíos, y no tenían conocimiento de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the priest's custom with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;
verses.WEB: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;
verses.ASV: And the custom of the priests with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant came, while the flesh was boiling, with a flesh-hook of three teeth in his hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o costume dos sacerdotes com o povo era que, quando alguém oferecia sacrifício, vinha o criado do sacerdote enquanto a carne estava a cozer, trazendo em sua mão um garfo de três ganchos;
verses.RVR09: Y la costumbre de los sacerdotes con el pueblo era que, cuando alguno ofrecía sacrificio, venía el criado del sacerdote mientras la carne estaba á cocer, trayendo en su mano un garfio de tres ganchos;

verses.KJV: And he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.
verses.WEB: and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.
verses.ASV: and he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the flesh-hook brought up the priest took therewith. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enfiava com ele na caldeira, ou na caçarola, ou no caldeirão, ou no pote; e tudo o que tirava o garfo, o sacerdote o tomava para si. Desta maneira faziam a todo israelita que vinha a Siló.
verses.RVR09: Y hería con él en la caldera, ó en la olla, ó en el caldero, ó en el pote; y todo lo que sacaba el garfio, el sacerdote lo tomaba para si. De esta manera hacían á todo Israelita que venía á Silo.

verses.KJV: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.
verses.WEB: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”
verses.ASV: Yea, before they burnt the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have boiled flesh of thee, but raw.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também, antes de queimar a gordura, vinha o criado do sacerdote, e dizia ao que sacrificava: Da carne que asse para o sacerdote; porque não tomará de ti carne cozida, mas sim crua.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo, antes de quemar el sebo, venía el criado del sacerdote, y decía al que sacrificaba: Da carne que ase para el sacerdote; porque no tomará de ti carne cocida, sino cruda.

verses.KJV: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, Nay; but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.
verses.WEB: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”
verses.ASV: And if the man said unto him, They will surely burn the fat first, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would say, Nay, but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se lhe respondia o homem, Queimem logo a gordura hoje, e depois toma tanta quanto quiseres; ele respondia: Não, mas sim agora a darás: de outra maneira eu a tomarei por força.
verses.RVR09: Y si le respondía el varón, Quemen luego el sebo hoy, y después toma tanta como quisieres; él respondía: No, sino ahora la has de dar: de otra manera yo la tomaré por fuerza.

verses.KJV: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the Lord: for men abhorred the offering of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The sin of the young men was very great before the LORD; for the men despised the LORD’s offering.
verses.ASV: And the sin of the young men was very great before Jehovah; for the men despised the offering of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Era, pois, o pecado dos moços muito grande diante do SENHOR; porque os homens menosprezavam os sacrifícios do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Era pues el pecado de los mozos muy grande delante de Jehová; porque los hombres menospreciaban los sacrificios de Jehová.

verses.KJV: But Samuel ministered before the Lord, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
verses.WEB: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.
verses.ASV: But Samuel ministered before Jehovah, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o jovem Samuel ministrava diante do SENHOR, vestido de um éfode de linho.
verses.RVR09: Y el joven Samuel ministraba delante de Jehová, vestido de un ephod de lino.

verses.KJV: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.WEB: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.ASV: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fazia-lhe sua mãe uma túnica pequena, e a trazia a ele a cada ano, quando subia com seu marido a oferecer o sacrifício costumeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y hacíale su madre una túnica pequeña, y traíasela cada año, cuando subía con su marido á ofrecer el sacrificio acostumbrado.

verses.KJV: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The Lord give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the Lord. And they went unto their own home.
verses.WEB: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May the LORD give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of the LORD.” Then they went to their own home.
verses.ASV: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, Jehovah give thee seed of this woman for the petition which was asked of Jehovah. And they went unto their own home.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eli abençoou Elcana e a sua mulher, dizendo: “O SENHOR te dê descendência desta mulher por causa dessa petição que ela fez ao SENHOR.” E voltaram para sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y Eli bendijo á Elcana y á su mujer, diciendo: Jehová te dé simiente de esta mujer en lugar de esta petición que hizo á Jehová. Y volviéronse á su casa.

verses.KJV: And the Lord visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah visited Hannah, and she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR visitou a Ana, e ela concebeu, e deu à luz três filhos e duas filhas. E o jovem Samuel crescia diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y visitó Jehová á Anna, y concibió, y parió tres hijos, y dos hijas. Y el joven Samuel crecía delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did unto all Israel, and how that they lay with the women that did service at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eli, porém, era muito velho, e ouviu tudo o que seus filhos faziam a todo Israel, e como se deitavam com as mulheres que serviam à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.RVR09: Eli empero era muy viejo, y oyó todo lo que sus hijos hacían á todo Israel, y como dormían con las mujeres que velaban á la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings from all this people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: “Por que fazeis essas coisas? Pois eu ouço de todo este povo os vossos maus atos.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: ¿Por qué hacéis cosas semejantes? Porque yo oigo de todo este pueblo vuestros malos procederes.

verses.KJV: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make the Lord's people to transgress.
verses.WEB: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make the LORD’s people disobey.
verses.ASV: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make Jehovah’s people to transgress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não, meus filhos; pois não é boa a fama que eu ouço, que fazeis pecar ao povo do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No, hijos míos; porque no es buena fama la que yo oigo: que hacéis pecar al pueblo de Jehová.

verses.KJV: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the Lord, who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the Lord would slay them.
verses.WEB: If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who will intercede for him?” Notwithstanding, they didn’t listen to the voice of their father, because the LORD intended to kill them.
verses.ASV: If one man sin against another, God shall judge him; but if a man sin against Jehovah, who shall entreat for him? Notwithstanding, they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because Jehovah was minded to slay them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o homem pecar contra o homem, os juízes o julgarão; mas, se alguém pecar contra o SENHOR, quem rogará por ele?” Porém eles não ouviram a voz de seu pai, porque o SENHOR queria matá-los.
verses.RVR09: Si pecare el hombre contra el hombre, los jueces le juzgarán; mas si alguno pecare contra Jehová, ¿quién rogará por él? Mas ellos no oyeron la voz de su padre, porque Jehová los quería matar.

verses.KJV: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the Lord, and also with men.
verses.WEB: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with the LORD and also with men.
verses.ASV: And the child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Jehovah, and also with men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o jovem Samuel ia crescendo e sendo bem estimando diante de Deus e diante das pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Y el joven Samuel iba creciendo, y adelantando delante de Dios y delante de los hombres.

verses.KJV: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh's house?
verses.WEB: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?
verses.ASV: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Did I reveal myself unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt [in bondage] to Pharaoh’s house?
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio um homem de Deus a Eli, e disse-lhe: “Assim diz o SENHOR: ‘Acaso não me manifestei à casa do teu pai, quando estavam no Egito, na casa de Faraó?
verses.RVR09: Y vino un varón de Dios á Eli, y díjole: Así ha dicho Jehová: ¿No me manifesté yo claramente á la casa de tu padre, cuando estaban en Egipto en casa de Faraón?

verses.KJV: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?
