verses.ASV: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo os filisteus que os filhos de Israel estavam reunidos em Mispá, subiram os príncipes dos filisteus contra Israel: o qual quando houveram ouvido os filhos de Israel, tiveram temor dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo los Filisteos que los hijos de Israel estaban reunidos en Mizpa, subieron los príncipes de los Filisteos contra Israel: lo cual como hubieron oído los hijos de Israel, tuvieron temor de los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry unto the Lord our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.”
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry unto Jehovah our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram os filhos de Israel a Samuel: Não cesses de clamar por nós ao SENHOR nosso Deus, que nos guarde da mão dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron los hijos de Israel á Samuel: No ceses de clamar por nosotros á Jehová nuestro Dios, que nos guarde de mano de los filisteos.

verses.KJV: And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered it for a burnt offering wholly unto the Lord: and Samuel cried unto the Lord for Israel; and the Lord heard him.
verses.WEB: Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt offering to the LORD. Samuel cried to the LORD for Israel, and the LORD answered him.
verses.ASV: And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt-offering unto Jehovah: and Samuel cried unto Jehovah for Israel; and Jehovah answered him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Samuel tomou um cordeiro que ainda amamentava, e sacrificou-o inteiro ao SENHOR em holocausto: e clamou Samuel ao SENHOR por Israel, e o SENHOR lhe ouviu.
verses.RVR09: Y Samuel tomó un cordero de leche, y sacrificólo entero á Jehová en holocausto: y clamó Samuel á Jehová por Israel, y Jehová le oyó.

verses.KJV: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel: but the Lord thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and discomfited them; and they were smitten before Israel.
verses.WEB: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines came near to battle against Israel; but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them; and they were struck down before Israel.
verses.ASV: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt-offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel; but Jehovah thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and discomfited them; and they were smitten down before Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que estando Samuel sacrificando o holocausto, os filisteus chegaram para lutar com os filhos de Israel. Mas o SENHOR trovejou aquele dia com grande estrondo sobre os filisteus, e desbaratou-os, e foram vencidos diante de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que estando Samuel sacrificando el holocausto, los Filisteos llegaron para pelear con los hijos de Israel. Mas Jehová tronó aquel día con grande estruendo sobre los Filisteos, y desbaratólos, y fueron vencidos delante de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until they came under Bethcar.
verses.WEB: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar.
verses.ASV: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpah, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until they came under Beth-car.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saindo os filhos de Israel de Mispá, seguiram aos filisteus, ferindo-os até abaixo de Bete-Car.
verses.RVR09: Y saliendo los hijos de Israel de Mizpa, siguieron á los Filisteos, hiriéndolos hasta abajo de Beth-car.

verses.KJV: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, Hitherto hath the Lord helped us.
verses.WEB: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “The LORD helped us until now.”
verses.ASV: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath Jehovah helped us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou logo Samuel uma pedra, e a pôs entre Mispá e Sem, e pôs-lhe por nome Ebenézer, dizendo: Até aqui nos ajudou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Tomó luego Samuel una piedra, y púsola entre Mizpa y Sen, y púsole por nombre Eben-ezer, diciendo: Hasta aquí nos ayudó Jehová.

verses.KJV: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more into the coast of Israel: and the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
verses.WEB: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped coming within the border of Israel. The LORD’s hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
verses.ASV: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more within the border of Israel: and the hand of Jehovah was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foram, pois, os filisteus humilhados, que não vieram mais ao termo de Israel; e a mão do SENHOR foi contra os filisteus todo o tempo de Samuel.
verses.RVR09: Fueron pues los Filisteos humillados, que no vinieron más al término de Israel; y la mano de Jehová fué contra los Filisteos todo el tiempo de Samuel.

verses.KJV: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even unto Gath; and the coasts thereof did Israel deliver out of the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
verses.WEB: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
verses.ASV: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even unto Gath; and the border thereof did Israel deliver out of the hand of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram restituídas aos filhos de Israel as cidades que os filisteus haviam tomado aos israelitas, desde Ecrom até Gate, com seus termos: e Israel as livrou da mão dos filisteus. E houve paz entre Israel e o amorreu.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron restituídas á los hijos de Israel las ciudades que los Filisteos habían tomado á los Israelitas, desde Ecrón hasta Gath, con sus términos: é Israel las libró de mano de los Filisteos. Y hubo paz entre Israel y el Amorrheo.

verses.KJV: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
verses.WEB: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
verses.ASV: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E julgou Samuel a Israel todo o tempo que viveu.
verses.RVR09: Y juzgó Samuel á Israel todo el tiempo que vivió.

verses.KJV: And he went from year to year in circuit to Bethel, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.
verses.WEB: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.
verses.ASV: And he went from year to year in circuit to Beth-el, and Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os anos ia e dava volta a Betel, e a Gilgal, e a Mispá, e julgava a Israel em todos estes lugares.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los años iba y daba vuelta á Beth-el, y á Gilgal, y á Mizpa, y juzgaba á Israel en todos estos lugares.

verses.KJV: And his return was to Ramah; for there was his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there, and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to the LORD there.
verses.ASV: And his return was to Ramah, for there was his house; and there he judged Israel: and he built there an altar unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltava-se depois a Ramá, porque ali estava sua casa, e ali julgava a Israel; e edificou ali altar ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Volvíase después á Rama, porque allí estaba su casa, y allí juzgaba á Israel; y edificó allí altar á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.
verses.WEB: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que havendo Samuel envelhecido, pôs seus filhos por juízes sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que habiendo Samuel envejecido, puso sus hijos por jueces sobre Israel.

verses.KJV: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abiah: they were judges in Beersheba.
verses.WEB: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
verses.ASV: Now the name of his first-born was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah: they were judges in Beer-sheba.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nome de seu filho primogênito foi Joel, e o nome do segundo, Abias: foram juízes em Berseba.
verses.RVR09: Y el nombre de su hijo primogénito fué Joel, y el nombre del segundo, Abia: fueron jueces en Beer-sebah.

verses.KJV: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted judgment.
verses.WEB: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
verses.ASV: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não andaram os filhos pelos caminhos de seu pai, antes se inclinaram atrás a ganância, recebendo suborno e pervertendo o direito.
verses.RVR09: Mas no anduvieron los hijos por los caminos de su padre, antes se ladearon tras la avaricia, recibiendo cohecho y pervirtiendo el derecho.

verses.KJV: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel unto Ramah,
verses.WEB: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.
verses.ASV: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel unto Ramah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todos os anciãos de Israel se juntaram, e vieram a Samuel em Ramá,
verses.RVR09: Entonces todos los ancianos de Israel se juntaron, y vinieron á Samuel en Rama,

verses.KJV: And said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
verses.WEB: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”
verses.ASV: and they said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram-lhe: Eis que tu envelheceste, e teus filhos não vão por teus caminhos: portanto, constitui-nos agora um rei que nos julgue, como todas as nações.
verses.RVR09: Y dijéronle: He aquí tú has envejecido, y tus hijos no van por tus caminos: por tanto, constitúyenos ahora un rey que nos juzgue, como todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the LORD.
verses.ASV: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descontentou a Samuel esta palavra que disseram: Dá-nos rei que nos julgue. E Samuel orou ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y descontentó á Samuel esta palabra que dijeron: Danos rey que nos juzgue. Y Samuel oró á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee: for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not reign over them.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee; for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not be king over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR a Samuel: Ouve a voz do povo em tudo o que te disserem: porque não rejeitaram a ti, mas sim a mim me rejeitaram, para que eu não reine sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová á Samuel: Oye la voz del pueblo en todo lo que te dijeren: porque no te han desechado á ti, sino á mí me han desechado, para que no reine sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day, wherewith they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also unto thee.
verses.WEB: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.
verses.ASV: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day, in that they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme todas as obras que fizeram desde o dia que os tirei do Egito até hoje, que me deixaram e serviram a deuses alheios, assim fazem também contigo.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á todas las obras que han hecho desde el día que los saqué de Egipto hasta hoy, que me han dejado y han servido á dioses ajenos, así hacen también contigo.

verses.KJV: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them, and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit thou shalt protest solemnly unto them, and shalt show them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, ouve sua voz: mas protesta contra eles declarando-lhes o direito do rei que há de reinar sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, oye su voz: mas protesta contra ellos declarándoles el derecho del rey que ha de reinar sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And Samuel told all the words of the Lord unto the people that asked of him a king.
verses.WEB: Samuel told all the LORD’s words to the people who asked him for a king.
verses.ASV: And Samuel told all the words of Jehovah unto the people that asked of him a king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Samuel todas as palavras do SENHOR ao povo que lhe havia pedido rei.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Samuel todas las palabras de Jehová al pueblo que le había pedido rey.

verses.KJV: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: He will take your sons, and appoint them for himself, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and some shall run before his chariots.
verses.WEB: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.
verses.ASV: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them unto him, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and they shall run before his chariots;
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse, pois: Este será o direito do rei que houver de reinar sobre vós: tomará vossos filhos, e os porá em seus carros, e em seus cavaleiros, para que corram diante de seu carro:
verses.RVR09: Dijo pues: Este será el derecho del rey que hubiere de reinar sobre vosotros: tomará vuestros hijos, y pondrálos en sus carros, y en su gente de á caballo, para que corran delante de su carro:

verses.KJV: And he will appoint him captains over thousands, and captains over fifties; and will set them to ear his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and instruments of his chariots.
verses.WEB: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.
verses.ASV: and he will appoint them unto him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and [he will set some] to plow his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and the instruments of his chariots.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se escolherá capitães de mil, e capitães de cinquenta: os porá também a que arem seus campos, e ceifem suas plantações, e a que façam suas armas de guerra, e os equipamentos de seus carros:
verses.RVR09: Y se elegirá capitanes de mil, y capitanes de cincuenta: pondrálos asimismo á que aren sus campos, y sieguen sus mieses, y á que hagan sus armas de guerra, y los pertrechos de sus carros:

verses.KJV: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.
verses.WEB: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.
verses.ASV: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomará também vossas filhas para que sejam perfumistas, cozinheiras, e padeiras.
verses.RVR09: Tomará también vuestras hijas para que sean perfumadoras, cocineras, y amasadoras.

verses.KJV: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.
verses.WEB: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.
verses.ASV: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também tomará vossas terras, vossas vinhas, e vossos bons olivais, e os dará a seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo tomará vuestras tierras, vuestras viñas, y vuestros buenos olivares, y los dará á sus siervos.

verses.KJV: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
verses.WEB: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.
verses.ASV: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tomará o dízimo de vossas sementes e vossas vinhas, para dar a seus eunucos e a seus servos.
verses.RVR09: El diezmará vuestras simientes y vuestras viñas, para dar á sus eunucos y á sus siervos.

verses.KJV: And he will take your menservants, and your maidservants, and your goodliest young men, and your asses, and put them to his work.
verses.WEB: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.
verses.ASV: And he will take your men-servants, and your maid-servants, and your goodliest young men, and your asses, and put them to his work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tomará vossos servos, e vossas servas, e vossos bons rapazes, e vossos asnos, e com eles fará suas obras.
verses.RVR09: El tomará vuestros siervos, y vuestras siervas, y vuestros buenos mancebos, y vuestros asnos, y con ellos hará sus obras.

verses.KJV: He will take the tenth of your sheep: and ye shall be his servants.
verses.WEB: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.
verses.ASV: He will take the tenth of your flocks: and ye shall be his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomará o dízimo também do vosso rebanho, e sereis seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Diezmará también vuestro rebaño, y seréis sus siervos.

verses.KJV: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you; and the Lord will not hear you in that day.
verses.WEB: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not answer you in that day.”
verses.ASV: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king whom ye shall have chosen you; and Jehovah will not answer you in that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E clamareis aquele dia por causa de vosso rei que vos havereis escolhido, mas o SENHOR não vos ouvirá naquele dia.
verses.RVR09: Y clamaréis aquel día á causa de vuestro rey que os habréis elegido, mas Jehová no os oirá en aquel día.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay; but we will have a king over us;
verses.WEB: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,
verses.ASV: But the people refused to hearken unto the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay: but we will have a king over us,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o povo não quis ouvir a voz de Samuel; antes disseram: Não, mas sim que haverá rei sobre nós:
verses.RVR09: Empero el pueblo no quiso oir la voz de Samuel; antes dijeron: No, sino que habrá rey sobre nosotros:

verses.KJV: That we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.
verses.WEB: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”
verses.ASV: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós seremos também como todas as nações, e nosso rei nos governará, e sairá diante de nós, e fará nossas guerras.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros seremos también como todas las gentes, y nuestro rey nos gobernará, y saldrá delante de nosotros, y hará nuestras guerras.

verses.KJV: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Samuel todas as palavras do povo, e referiu-as aos ouvidos do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Samuel todas las palabras del pueblo, y refiriólas en oídos de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Samuel: Ouve sua voz, e põe rei sobre eles. Então disse Samuel aos homens de Israel: Ide-vos cada um à sua cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Samuel: Oye su voz, y pon rey sobre ellos. Entonces dijo Samuel á los varones de Israel: Idos cada uno á su ciudad.

verses.KJV: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.
verses.WEB: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.
verses.ASV: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia um homem de Benjamim, homem valente, o qual se chamava Quis, filho de Abiel, filho de Zeror, filho de Becorate, filho de Afia, filho de um homem de Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Y HABÍA un varón de Benjamín, hombre valeroso, el cual se llamaba Cis, hijo de Abiel, hijo de Seor, hijo de Bechôra, hijo de Aphia, hijo de un hombre de Benjamín.

verses.KJV: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
verses.WEB: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.
verses.ASV: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a young man and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinha ele um filho que se chamava Saul, rapaz e belo, que entre os filhos de Israel não havia outro mais belo que ele; do ombro acima sobrepujava a qualquer um do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y tenía él un hijo que se llamaba Saúl, mancebo y hermoso, que entre los hijos de Israel no había otro más hermoso que él; del hombro arriba sobrepujaba á cualquiera del pueblo.

verses.KJV: And the asses of Kish Saul's father were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.
verses.WEB: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”
verses.ASV: And the asses of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E haviam-se perdido as asnas de Quis, pai de Saul; pelo que disse Quis a Saul seu filho: Toma agora contigo algum dos criados, e levanta-te, e vai a buscar as asnas.
verses.RVR09: Y habíanse perdido las asnas de Cis, padre de Saúl; por lo que dijo Cis á Saúl su hijo: Toma ahora contigo alguno de los criados, y levántate, y ve á buscar las asnas.

verses.KJV: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.
verses.WEB: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.
verses.ASV: And he passed through the hill-country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele passou ao monte de Efraim, e dali à terra de Salisa, e não as acharam. Passaram logo pela terra de Saalim, e tampouco. Depois passaram pela terra de Benjamim, e não as encontraram.
verses.RVR09: Y él pasó al monte de Ephraim, y de allí á la tierra de Salisa, y no las hallaron. Pasaron luego por la tierra de Saalim, y tampoco. Después pasaron por la tierra de Benjamín, y no las encontraron.

verses.KJV: And when they were come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant that was with him, Come, and let us return; lest my father leave caring for the asses, and take thought for us.
verses.WEB: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us.”
verses.ASV: When they were come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant that was with him, Come, and let us return, lest my father leave off caring for the asses, and be anxious for us.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vieram à terra de Zufe, Saul disse a seu criado que tinha consigo: Vem, voltemo-nos; porque talvez meu pai, deixado o cuidado das asnas, estará aflito por nós.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando vinieron á la tierra de Suph, Saúl dijo á su criado que tenía consigo: Ven, volvámonos; porque quizá mi padre, dejado el cuidado de las asnas, estará congojado por nosotros.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Behold now, there is in this city a man of God, and he is an honourable man; all that he saith cometh surely to pass: now let us go thither; peradventure he can shew us our way that we should go.
verses.WEB: The servant said to him, “Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let’s go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Behold now, there is in this city a man of God, and he is a man that is held in honor; all that he saith cometh surely to pass: now let us go thither; peradventure he can tell us concerning our journey whereon we go.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe respondeu: Eis que agora há nesta cidade um homem de Deus, que é homem ilustre: todas as coisas que ele disser, sem dúvida virão a suceder. Vamos pois ali; talvez nos ensinará nosso caminho por onde havemos de ir.
verses.RVR09: Y él le respondió: He aquí ahora hay en esta ciudad un hombre de Dios, que es varón insigne: todas las cosas que él dijere, sin duda vendrán. Vamos pues allá: quizá nos enseñará nuestro camino por donde hayamos de ir.

verses.KJV: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?
verses.WEB: Then Saul said to his servant, “But behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?”
verses.ASV: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul respondeu a seu criado: Vamos agora: mas que levaremos ao homem? Porque o pão de nossos alforjes se acabou, e não temos que presentear ao homem de Deus: que temos?
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl respondió á su criado: Vamos ahora: ¿mas qué llevaremos al varón? Porque el pan de nuestras alforjas se ha acabado, y no tenemos qué presentar al varón de Dios: ¿qué tenemos?

verses.KJV: And the servant answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have here at hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: that will I give to the man of God, to tell us our way.
verses.WEB: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”
verses.ASV: And the servant answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: that will I give to the man of God, to tell us our way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então voltou o criado a responder a Saul, dizendo: Eis que se acha em minha mão a quarta parte de um siclo de prata: isto darei ao homem de Deus, porque nos declare nosso caminho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces tornó el criado á responder á Saúl, diciendo: He aquí se halla en mi mano la cuarta parte de un siclo de plata: esto daré al varón de Dios, porque nos declare nuestro camino.

verses.KJV: (Beforetime in Israel, when a man went to enquire of God, thus he spake, Come, and let us go to the seer: for he that is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)
verses.WEB: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)
verses.ASV: (Beforetime in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, thus he said, Come, and let us go to the seer; for he that is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)
verses.ALMEIDA: (Antigamente em Israel qualquer um que ia a consultar a Deus, dizia assim: Vinde e vamos até o vidente: porque o que agora se chama profeta, antigamente era chamado vidente).
verses.RVR09: (Antiguamente en Israel cualquiera que iba á consultar á Dios, decía así: Venid y vamos hasta el vidente: porque el que ahora se llama profeta, antiguamente era llamado vidente).

verses.KJV: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was.
verses.WEB: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.
verses.ASV: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse então Saul a seu criado: Bem dizes; eia, pois, vamos. E foram à cidade de onde estava o homem de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Dijo entonces Saúl á su criado: Bien dices; ea pues, vamos. Y fueron á la ciudad donde estaba el varón de Dios.

verses.KJV: And as they went up the hill to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said unto them, Is the seer here?
verses.WEB: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”
verses.ASV: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said unto them, Is the seer here?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando subiam pela encosta da cidade, acharam umas moças que saíam por água, às quais disseram: Está neste lugar o vidente?
verses.RVR09: Y cuando subían por la cuesta de la ciudad, hallaron unas mozas que salían por agua, á las cuales dijeron: ¿Está en este lugar el vidente?

verses.KJV: And they answered them, and said, He is; behold, he is before you: make haste now, for he came to day to the city; for there is a sacrifice of the people to day in the high place:
verses.WEB: They answered them and said, “He is. Behold, he is before you. Hurry now, for he has come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place.
verses.ASV: And they answered them, and said, He is; behold, [he is] before thee: make haste now, for he is come to-day into the city; for the people have a sacrifice to-day in the high place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E elas respondendo-lhes, disseram: Sim; ei-lo aqui diante de ti: apressa-te, pois, porque hoje veio à cidade porque o povo tem hoje sacrifício no alto.
verses.RVR09: Y ellas respondiéndoles, dijeron: Sí; helo aquí delante de ti: date pues priesa, porque hoy ha venido á la ciudad en atención á que el pueblo tiene hoy sacrificio en el alto.

verses.KJV: As soon as ye be come into the city, ye shall straightway find him, before he go up to the high place to eat: for the people will not eat until he come, because he doth bless the sacrifice; and afterwards they eat that be bidden. Now therefore get you up; for about this time ye shall find him.
verses.WEB: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”
verses.ASV: As soon as ye are come into the city, ye shall straightway find him, before he goeth up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he come, because he doth bless the sacrifice; [and] afterwards they eat that are bidden. Now therefore get you up; for at this time ye shall find him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando entrardes na cidade, vós o encontrareis logo, antes que suba ao alto a comer; pois o povo não comerá até que ele tenha vindo, porquanto ele deve abençoar o sacrifício, e depois comerão os convidados. Subi, pois agora, porque agora o achareis.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando entrareis en la ciudad, le encontraréis luego, antes que suba al alto á comer; pues el pueblo no comerá hasta que él haya venido, por cuanto él haya de bendecir el sacrificio, y después comerán los convidados. Subid pues ahora, porque ahora le hallaréis.

verses.KJV: And they went up into the city: and when they were come into the city, behold, Samuel came out against them, for to go up to the high place.
verses.WEB: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place.
verses.ASV: And they went up to the city; [and] as they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them, to go up to the high place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles então subiram à cidade; e quando em meio da cidade estiveram, eis que Samuel que diante deles saía para subir ao alto.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces subieron á la ciudad; y cuando en medio de la ciudad estuvieron, he aquí Samuel que delante de ellos salía para subir al alto.

verses.KJV: Now the Lord had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,
verses.WEB: Now the LORD had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,
verses.ASV: Now Jehovah had revealed unto Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E um dia antes que Saul viesse, o SENHOR havia revelado ao ouvido de Samuel, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y un día antes que Saúl viniese, Jehová había revelado al oído de Samuel, diciendo:

verses.KJV: To morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be captain over my people Israel, that he may save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come unto me.
verses.WEB: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”
verses.ASV: To-morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be prince over my people Israel; and he shall save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amanhã a esta mesma hora eu enviarei a ti um homem da terra de Benjamim, ao qual ungirás por príncipe sobre meu povo Israel, e salvará meu povo da mão dos filisteus: pois eu olhei a meu povo, porque seu clamor há chegado até mim.
verses.RVR09: Mañana á esta misma hora yo enviaré á ti un varón de la tierra de Benjamín, al cual ungirás por príncipe sobre mi pueblo Israel, y salvará mi pueblo de mano de los Filisteos: pues yo he mirado á mi pueblo, porque su clamor ha llegado hasta mí.

verses.KJV: And when Samuel saw Saul, the Lord said unto him, Behold the man whom I spake to thee of! this same shall reign over my people.
verses.WEB: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”
verses.ASV: And when Samuel saw Saul, Jehovah said unto him, Behold, the man of whom I spake to thee! this same shall have authority over my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que Samuel viu a Saul, o SENHOR lhe disse: Eis que este é o homem do qual te falei; este dominará a meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que Samuel vió á Saúl, Jehová le dijo: He aquí éste es el varón del cual te hablé; éste señoreará á mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house is.
verses.WEB: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”
verses.ASV: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer’s house is.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando Saul a Samuel em meio da porta, disse-lhe: Rogo-te que me ensines onde está a casa do vidente.
verses.RVR09: Y llegando Saúl á Samuel en medio de la puerta, díjole: Ruégote que me enseñes dónde está la casa del vidente.

verses.KJV: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am the seer: go up before me unto the high place; for ye shall eat with me to day, and to morrow I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that is in thine heart.
verses.WEB: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.
verses.ASV: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am the seer; go up before me unto the high place, for ye shall eat with me to-day: and in the morning I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that is in thy heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Samuel respondeu a Saul, e disse: Eu sou o vidente: sobe diante de mim ao alto, e comei hoje comigo, e pela manhã te despacharei, e te revelarei tudo o que está em teu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y Samuel respondió á Saúl, y dijo: Yo soy el vidente: sube delante de mí al alto, y comed hoy conmigo, y por la mañana te despacharé, y te descubriré todo lo que está en tu corazón.

verses.KJV: And as for thine asses that were lost three days ago, set not thy mind on them; for they are found. And on whom is all the desire of Israel? Is it not on thee, and on all thy father's house?
verses.WEB: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don’t set your mind on them, for they have been found. For whom does all Israel desire? Is it not you and all your father’s house?”
verses.ASV: And as for thine asses that were lost three days ago, set not thy mind on them; for they are found. And for whom is all that is desirable in Israel? Is it not for thee, and for all thy father’s house?
verses.ALMEIDA: E das asnas que se te perderam hoje há três dias, deixa de se preocupar com elas, porque se acharam. Mas a quem é todo o desejo de Israel, se não a ti e a toda a casa de teu pai?
verses.RVR09: Y de las asnas que se te perdieron hoy ha tres días, pierde cuidado de ellas, porque se han hallado. Mas ¿por quién es todo el deseo de Israel, sino por ti y por toda la casa de tu padre?

verses.KJV: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou so to me?
verses.WEB: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”
verses.ASV: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou to me after this manner?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul respondeu, e disse: Não sou eu filho de Benjamim, das menores tribos de Israel? e minha família não é a mais pequena de todas as famílias da tribo de Benjamim? por que pois me disseste coisa semelhante?
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl respondió, y dijo: ¿No soy yo hijo de Benjamín, de las más pequeñas tribus de Israel? Y mi familia ¿no es la más pequeña de todas las familias de la tribu de Benjamín? ¿por qué pues me has dicho cosa semejante?

verses.KJV: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the parlour, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, which were about thirty persons.
verses.WEB: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.
verses.ASV: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the guest-chamber, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, who were about thirty persons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando Samuel a Saul e a seu criado, meteu-os na sala, e deu-lhes lugar à cabeceira dos convidados, que eram como uns trinta homens.
verses.RVR09: Y trabando Samuel de Saúl y de su criado, metiólos en la sala, y dióles lugar á la cabecera de los convidados, que eran como unos treinta hombres.

verses.KJV: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.
verses.WEB: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’”
verses.ASV: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Samuel ao cozinheiro: Traze aqui a porção que te dei, a qual te disse que guardasses à parte.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Samuel al cocinero: Trae acá la porción que te dí, la cual te dije que guardases aparte.

verses.KJV: And the cook took up the shoulder, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is left! set it before thee, and eat: for unto this time hath it been kept for thee since I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.
verses.WEB: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and eat; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time, for I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.
verses.ASV: And the cook took up the thigh, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And [Samuel] said, Behold, that which hath been reserved! set it before thee and eat; because unto the appointed time hath it been kept for thee, for I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então levantou o cozinheiro uma coxa, com o que estava sobre ela, e a pôs diante de Saul. E Samuel disse: Eis que o que estava reservado: põe-o diante de ti, e come; porque foi intencionalmente guardado para ti, quando disse: Eu convidei ao povo. E Saul comeu aquele dia com Samuel.
verses.RVR09: Entonces alzó el cocinero una espaldilla, con lo que estaba sobre ella, y púsola delante de Saúl. Y Samuel dijo: He aquí lo que estaba reservado: ponlo delante de ti, y come; porque de industria se guardó para ti, cuando dije: Yo he convidado al pueblo. Y Saúl comió aquel día con Samuel.

verses.KJV: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, Samuel communed with Saul upon the top of the house.
verses.WEB: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.
verses.ASV: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, he communed with Saul upon the housetop.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando houveram descido do alto à cidade, ele falou com Saul no terraço.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubieron descendido del alto á la ciudad, él habló con Saúl en el terrado.

verses.KJV: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.
verses.WEB: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.
verses.ASV: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao outro dia madrugaram: e quando ao raiar da alva, Samuel chamou a Saul, que estava no terraço; e disse: Levanta-te, para que te despache. Levantou-se logo Saul, e saíram fora ambos, ele e Samuel.
verses.RVR09: Y al otro día madrugaron: y como al apuntar del alba, Samuel llamó á Saúl, que estaba en el terrado; y dijo: Levántate, para que te despache. Levantóse luego Saúl, y salieron fuera ambos, él y Samuel.

verses.KJV: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on), but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.
verses.WEB: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”
verses.ASV: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us (and he passed on), but stand thou still first, that I may cause thee to hear the word of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descendo eles ao fim da cidade, disse Samuel a Saul: Dize ao jovem que vá diante, (e adiantou-se o jovem); mas espera tu um pouco para que te declare palavra de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y descendiendo ellos al cabo de la ciudad, dijo Samuel á Saúl: Di al mozo que vaya delante, (y adelantóse el mozo); mas espera tú un poco para que te declare palabra de Dios.

verses.KJV: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the Lord hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?
verses.WEB: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t the LORD anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?
verses.ASV: Then Samuel took the vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not that Jehovah hath anointed thee to be prince over his inheritance?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomando então Samuel um frasco de azeite, derramou-o sobre sua cabeça, e beijou-o, e disse-lhe: Não foi o SENHOR que te ungiu para que sejas líder sobre sua propriedade?
verses.RVR09: TOMANDO entonces Samuel una ampolla de aceite, derramóla sobre su cabeza, y besólo, y díjole: ¿No te ha ungido Jehová por capitán sobre su heredad?

verses.KJV: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel's sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
verses.WEB: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’
verses.ASV: When thou art departed from me to-day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel’s sepulchre, in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found; and, lo, thy father hath left off caring for the asses, and is anxious for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
verses.ALMEIDA: Hoje, depois que te tenhas apartado de mim, acharás dois homens junto ao sepulcro de Raquel, no termo de Benjamim, em Zelza, os quais te dirão: As asnas que havias ido a buscar, se acharam; teu pai pois há deixado já o negócio das asnas, porém está preocupado convosco, dizendo: Que farei acerca de meu filho?
verses.RVR09: Hoy, después que te hayas apartado de mí, hallarás dos hombres junto al sepulcro de Rachêl, en el término de Benjamín, en Selsah, los cuales te dirán: Las asnas que habías ido á buscar, se han hallado; tu padre pues ha dejado ya el negocio de las asnas, si bien está angustioso por vosotros, diciendo: ¿Qué haré acerca de mi hijo?

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
verses.WEB: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel: one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a container of wine.
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the oak of Tabor; and there shall meet thee there three men going up to God to Beth-el, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando dali te fores mais adiante, e chegares à campina de Tabor, te sairão ao encontro três homens que sobem a Deus em Betel, levando o um três cabritos, e o outro três tortas de pão, e o terceiro uma vasilha de vinho:
verses.RVR09: Y como de allí te fueres más adelante, y llegares á la campiña de Tabor, te saldrán al encuentro tres hombres que suben á Dios en Beth-el, llevando el uno tres cabritos, y el otro tres tortas de pan, y el tercero una vasija de vino:

verses.KJV: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.
verses.WEB: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.
verses.ASV: and they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread, which thou shalt receive of their hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais, logo que te tenham saudado, te darão dois pães, os quais tomarás das mãos deles.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales, luego que te hayan saludado, te darán dos panes, los que tomarás de manos de ellos.

verses.KJV: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:
verses.WEB: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.
verses.ASV: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a timbrel, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they will be prophesying:
verses.ALMEIDA: De ali virás ao morro de Deus de onde está a guarnição dos filisteus; e quando entrares ali na cidade encontrarás uma companhia de profetas que descem do alto, e diante deles saltério, e adufe, e flauta, e harpa, e eles profetizando:
verses.RVR09: De allí vendrás al collado de Dios donde está la guarnición de los Filisteos; y cuando entrares allá en la ciudad encontrarás una compañía de profetas que descienden del alto, y delante de ellos salterio, y adufe, y flauta, y arpa, y ellos profetizando:

verses.KJV: And the Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.
verses.ASV: and the Spirit of Jehovah will come mightily upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o espírito do SENHOR te arrebatará, e profetizarás com eles, e serás transformado em outro homem.
verses.RVR09: Y el espíritu de Jehová te arrebatará, y profetizarás con ellos, y serás mudado en otro hombre.

verses.KJV: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee.
verses.WEB: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.
verses.ASV: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion shall serve thee; for God is with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando te houverem sobrevindo estas sinais, faze o que te vier à mão, porque Deus é contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando te hubieren sobrevenido estas señales, haz lo que te viniere á la mano, porque Dios es contigo.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.
verses.WEB: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”
verses.ASV: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt-offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace-offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come unto thee, and show thee what thou shalt do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descerás antes de mim a Gilgal; e logo descerei eu a ti para sacrificar holocaustos, e imolar sacrifícios pacíficos. Espera sete dias, até que eu venha a ti, e te ensine o que hás de fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y bajarás delante de mí á Gilgal; y luego descenderé yo á ti para sacrificar holocaustos, é inmolar víctimas pacíficas. Espera siete días, hasta que yo venga á ti, y te enseñe lo que has de hacer.

verses.KJV: And it was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.
verses.WEB: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.
verses.ASV: And it was so, that, when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que assim quando virou ele seu ombro para partir-se de Samuel, mudou-lhe Deus seu coração; e todas estes sinais aconteceram naquele dia.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que así como tornó él su hombro para partirse de Samuel, mudóle Dios su corazón; y todas estas señales acaecieron en aquel día.

verses.KJV: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.
verses.WEB: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.
verses.ASV: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily upon him, and he prophesied among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegaram ali ao morro, eis que a companhia dos profetas que vinha a encontrar-se com ele, e o Espírito de Deus o arrebatou, e profetizou entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando llegaron allá al collado, he aquí la compañía de los profetas que venía á encontrarse con él, y el espíritu de Dios lo arrebató, y profetizó entre ellos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.WEB: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando todos os que o conheciam de antes viram como profetizava com os profetas, o povo dizia o um ao outro: Que sucedeu ao filho de Quis? Saul também entre os profetas?
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, cuando todos los que le conocían de ayer y de antes, vieron como profetizaba con los profetas, el pueblo decía el uno al otro: ¿Qué ha sucedido al hijo de Cis? ¿Saúl también entre los profetas?

verses.KJV: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.WEB: One from the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
verses.ASV: And one of the same place answered and said, And who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.ALMEIDA: E algum dali respondeu, e disse: E quem é o pai deles? Por esta causa se tornou em provérbio: Também Saul entre os profetas?
verses.RVR09: Y alguno de allí respondió, y dijo: ¿Y quién es el padre de ellos? Por esta causa se tornó en proverbio: ¿También Saúl entre los profetas?

verses.KJV: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
verses.WEB: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.
verses.ASV: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cessou de profetizar, e chegou ao alto.
verses.RVR09: Y cesó de profetizar, y llegó al alto.

verses.KJV: And Saul's uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that they were no where, we came to Samuel.
verses.WEB: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”
verses.ASV: And Saul’s uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses; and when we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um tio de Saul disse a ele e a seu criado: Aonde fostes? E ele respondeu: A buscar as asnas; e quando vimos que não apareciam, fomos a Samuel.
verses.RVR09: Y un tío de Saúl dijo á él y á su criado: ¿Dónde fuisteis? Y él respondió: A buscar las asnas; y como vimos que no parecían, fuimos á Samuel.

verses.KJV: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
verses.WEB: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”
verses.ASV: And Saul’s uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o tio de Saul: Eu te rogo me declares que vos disse Samuel.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el tío de Saúl: Yo te ruego me declares qué os dijo Samuel.

verses.KJV: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.
verses.WEB: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.
verses.ASV: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But concerning the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul respondeu a seu tio: Declarou-nos expressamente que as asnas haviam aparecido. Mas do negócio do reino, de que Samuel lhe havia falado, não lhe revelou nada.
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl respondió á su tío: Declarónos expresamente que las asnas habían parecido. Mas del negocio del reino, de que Samuel le había hablado, no le descubrió nada.

verses.KJV: And Samuel called the people together unto the Lord to Mizpeh;
verses.WEB: Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpah;
verses.ASV: And Samuel called the people together unto Jehovah to Mizpah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Samuel convocou o povo ao SENHOR em Mispá;
verses.RVR09: Y Samuel convocó el pueblo á Jehová en Mizpa;

verses.KJV: And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, and of them that oppressed you:
verses.WEB: and he said to the children of Israel, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
verses.ASV: and he said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse aos filhos de Israel: Assim disse o SENHOR o Deus de Israel: Eu tirei a Israel do Egito, e vos livre da mão dos egípcios, e da mão de todos os reinos que vos afligiram:
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á los hijos de Israel: Así ha dicho Jehová el Dios de Israel: Yo saqué á Israel de Egipto, y os libré de mano de los Egipcios, y de mano de todos los reinos que os afligieron:

verses.KJV: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the Lord by your tribes, and by your thousands.
verses.WEB: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your thousands.”
verses.ASV: but ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saveth you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and ye have said unto him, [Nay], but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before Jehovah by your tribes, and by your thousands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vós rejeitastes hoje a vosso Deus, que vos guarda de todas as vossas aflições e angústias, e dissestes: Não, mas sim põe rei sobre nós. Agora pois, ponde-vos diante do SENHOR por vossas tribos e por vossos milhares.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros habéis desechado hoy á vuestro Dios, que os guarda de todas vuestras aflicciones y angustias, y dijisteis: No, sino pon rey sobre nosotros. Ahora pues, poneos delante de Jehová por vuestras tribus y por vuestros millares.

verses.KJV: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
verses.WEB: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.
verses.ASV: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fazendo achegar Samuel todas as tribos de Israel, foi tomada a tribo de Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Y haciendo allegar Samuel todas las tribus de Israel, fué tomada la tribu de Benjamín.

verses.KJV: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.
verses.WEB: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.
verses.ASV: And he brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families; and the family of the Matrites was taken; and Saul the son of Kish was taken: but when they sought him, he could not be found.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez chegar a tribo de Benjamim por suas linhagens, e foi tomada a família de Matri; e dela foi tomado Saul filho de Quis. E lhe buscaram, mas não foi achado.
verses.RVR09: E hizo llegar la tribu de Benjamín por sus linajes, y fué tomada la familia de Matri; y de ella fué tomado Saúl hijo de Cis. Y le buscaron, mas no fué hallado.

verses.KJV: Therefore they enquired of the Lord further, if the man should yet come thither. And the Lord answered, Behold he hath hid himself among the stuff.
verses.WEB: Therefore they asked of the LORD further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” The LORD answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”
verses.ASV: Therefore they asked of Jehovah further, Is there yet a man to come hither? And Jehovah answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the baggage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perguntaram pois outra vez ao SENHOR, se havia ainda de vir ali aquele homem. E respondeu o SENHOR: Eis que ele está escondido entre a bagagem.
verses.RVR09: Preguntaron pues otra vez á Jehová, si había aún de venir allí aquel varón. Y respondió Jehová: He aquí que él está escondido entre el bagaje.

verses.KJV: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
verses.WEB: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
verses.ASV: And they ran and fetched him thence; and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então correram, e tomaram-no dali, e posto em meio do povo, desde o ombro acima era mais alto que todo o povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces corrieron, y tomáronlo de allí, y puesto en medio del pueblo, desde el hombro arriba era más alto que todo el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the Lord hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.
verses.WEB: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted and said, “Long live the king!”
verses.ASV: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom Jehovah hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, [Long] live the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Samuel disse a todo o povo: Vistes ao que o SENHOR escolheu, que não há semelhante a ele em todo o povo? Então o povo clamou com alegria, dizendo: Viva o rei!
verses.RVR09: Y Samuel dijo á todo el pueblo: ¿Habéis visto al que ha elegido Jehová, que no hay semejante á él en todo el pueblo? Entonces el pueblo clamó con alegría, diciendo: Viva el rey.

verses.KJV: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the Lord. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
verses.WEB: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before the LORD. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
verses.ASV: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before Jehovah. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Samuel recitou ao povo o direito do reino, e escreveu-o em um livro, o qual guardou diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Samuel recitó luego al pueblo el derecho del reino, y escribiólo en un libro, el cual guardó delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.
verses.WEB: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
verses.ASV: And Saul also went to his house to Gibeah; and there went with him the host, whose hearts God had touched.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Samuel a todo o povo cada um a sua casa. E Saul também se foi a sua casa em Gibeá, e foram com ele o exército, o coração dos quais Deus havia tocado.
verses.RVR09: Y envió Samuel á todo el pueblo cada uno á su casa. Y Saúl también se fué á su casa en Gabaa, y fueron con él el ejército, el corazón de los cuales Dios había tocado.

verses.KJV: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought no presents. But he held his peace.
verses.WEB: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.
verses.ASV: But certain worthless fellows said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no present. But he held his peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os ímpios disseram: Como nos há de salvar este? E tiveram-lhe em pouco, e não lhe trouxeram presente: mas ele dissimulou.
verses.RVR09: Pero los impíos dijeron: ¿Cómo nos ha de salvar éste? Y tuviéronle en poco, y no le trajeron presente: mas él disimuló.

verses.KJV: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabeshgilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
verses.WEB: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”
verses.ASV: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu Naás amonita, e assentou acampamento contra Jabes de Gileade. E todos os de Jabes disseram a Naás: Faze aliança conosco, e te serviremos.
verses.RVR09: Y SUBIÓ Naas Ammonita, y asentó campo contra Jabes de Galaad. Y todos los de Jabes dijeron á Naas: Haz alianza con nosotros, y te serviremos.

verses.KJV: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.
verses.WEB: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”
verses.ASV: And Nahash the Ammonite said unto them, On this condition will I make it with you, that all your right eyes be put out; and I will lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Naás amonita lhes respondeu: Com esta condição farei aliança convosco, que a cada um de todos vós tire o olho direito, e ponha esta afronta sobre todo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Naas Ammonita les respondió: Con esta condición haré alianza con vosotros, que á cada uno de todos vosotros saque el ojo derecho, y ponga esta afrenta sobre todo Israel.

verses.KJV: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days' respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.
verses.WEB: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”
verses.ASV: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days’ respite, that we may send messengers unto all the borders of Israel; and then, if there be none to save us, we will come out to thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os anciãos de Jabes lhe disseram: Dá-nos sete dias, para que enviemos mensageiros a todos os termos de Israel; e se ninguém houver que nos defenda, sairemos a ti.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los ancianos de Jabes le dijeron: Danos siete días, para que enviemos mensajeros á todos los términos de Israel; y si nadie hubiere que nos defienda, saldremos á ti.

verses.KJV: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.
verses.WEB: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.
verses.ASV: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and spake these words in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando os mensageiros a Gibeá de Saul, disseram estas palavras em ouvidos do povo; e todo o povo chorou a voz em grito.
verses.RVR09: Y llegando los mensajeros á Gabaa de Saúl, dijeron estas palabras en oídos del pueblo; y todo el pueblo lloró á voz en grito.

verses.KJV: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.
verses.WEB: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.
verses.ASV: And, behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the words of the men of Jabesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que Saul que vinha do campo, atrás os bois; e disse Saul: Que tem o povo, que choram? E contaram-lhe as palavras dos homens de Jabes.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí Saúl que venía del campo, tras los bueyes; y dijo Saúl: ¿Qué tiene el pueblo, que lloran? Y contáronle las palabras de los hombres de Jabes.

verses.KJV: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.
verses.WEB: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.
verses.ASV: And the Spirit of God came mightily upon Saul when he heard those words, and his anger was kindled greatly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o espírito de Deus arrebatou a Saul em ouvindo estas palavras, e acendeu-se em ira em grande maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y el espíritu de Dios arrebató á Saúl en oyendo estas palabras, y encendióse en ira en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the Lord fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.
verses.WEB: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, “Whoever doesn’t come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen.” The dread of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out as one man.
verses.ASV: And he took a yoke of oxen, and cut them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the dread of Jehovah fell on the people, and they came out as one man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando um par de bois, cortou-os em peças, e enviou-as por todos os termos de Israel por meio de mensageiros, dizendo: Qualquer um que não sair após Saul e após Samuel, assim será feito a seus bois. E caiu temor do SENHOR sobre o povo,
verses.RVR09: Y tomando un par de bueyes, cortólos en piezas, y enviólas por todos los términos de Israel por mano de mensajeros, diciendo: Cualquiera que no saliere en pos de Saúl y en pos de Samuel, así será hecho á sus bueyes. Y cayó temor de Jehová sobre el pueblo, y salieron como un solo hombre.

verses.KJV: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
verses.WEB: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
verses.ASV: And he numbered them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E contou-lhes em Bezeque; e foram os filhos de Israel trezentos mil, e trinta mil os homens de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y contólos en Bezec; y fueron los hijos de Israel trescientos mil, y treinta mil los hombres de Judá.

verses.KJV: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabeshgilead, To morrow, by that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
verses.WEB: They said to the messengers who came, “Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will be rescued.’” The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
verses.ASV: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, To-morrow, by the time the sun is hot, ye shall have deliverance. And the messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E responderam aos mensageiros que haviam vindo: Assim direis aos de Jabes de Gileade: Amanhã em aquecendo o sol, tereis salvamento. E vieram os mensageiros, e declararam-no aos de Jabes, os quais se alegraram.
verses.RVR09: Y respondieron á los mensajeros que habían venido: Así diréis á los de Jabes de Galaad: Mañana en calentando el sol, tendréis salvamento. Y vinieron los mensajeros, y declaráronlo á los de Jabes, los cuales se holgaron.
