verses.ASV: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Saul a Davi: Não poderás tu ir contra aquele filisteu, para lutar com ele; porque tu és jovem, e ele um homem de guerra desde sua juventude.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Saúl á David: No podrás tú ir contra aquel Filisteo, para pelear con él; porque tú eres mozo, y él un hombre de guerra desde su juventud.

verses.KJV: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:
verses.WEB: David said to Saul, “Your servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,
verses.ASV: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when there came a lion, or a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi respondeu a Saul: Teu servo era pastor das ovelhas de seu pai, e vinha um leão, ou um urso, e tomava algum cordeiro do rebanho,
verses.RVR09: Y David respondió á Saúl: Tu siervo era pastor en las ovejas de su padre, y venía un león, ó un oso, y tomaba algún cordero de la manada,

verses.KJV: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
verses.WEB: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.
verses.ASV: I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth; and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saía eu atrás dele, e feria-o, e livrava-lhe de sua boca: e se se levantava contra mim, eu o segurava pelo queixo, feria-o, e o matava.
verses.RVR09: Y salía yo tras él, y heríalo, y librábale de su boca: y si se levantaba contra mí, yo le echaba mano de la quijada, y lo hería y mataba.

verses.KJV: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.
verses.WEB: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.”
verses.ASV: Thy servant smote both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fosse leão, fosse urso, teu servo o matava; pois este filisteu incircunciso será como um deles, porque provocou ao exército do Deus vivente.
verses.RVR09: Fuese león, fuese oso, tu siervo lo mataba; pues este Filisteo incircunciso será como uno de ellos, porque ha provocado al ejército del Dios viviente.

verses.KJV: David said moreover, The Lord that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the Lord be with thee.
verses.WEB: David said, “The LORD, who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go! The LORD will be with you.”
verses.ASV: And David said, Jehovah that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and Jehovah shall be with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acrescentou Davi: o SENHOR que me livrou das garras do leão e das garras do urso, ele também me livrará da mão deste filisteu. E disse Saul a Davi: Vai, e o SENHOR seja contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y añadió David: Jehová que me ha librado de las garras del león y de las garras del oso, él también me librará de la mano de este Filisteo. Y dijo Saúl á David: Ve, y Jehová sea contigo.

verses.KJV: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
verses.WEB: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.
verses.ASV: And Saul clad David with his apparel, and he put a helmet of brass upon his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul revestiu a Davi de suas roupas, e pôs sobre sua cabeça um capacete de bronze, e armou-lhe de couraça.
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl vistió á David de sus ropas, y puso sobre su cabeza un almete de acero, y armóle de coraza.

verses.KJV: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
verses.WEB: David strapped his sword on his clothing and he tried to move, for he had not tested it. David said to Saul, “I can’t go with these, for I have not tested them.” Then David took them off.
verses.ASV: And David girded his sword upon his apparel, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cingiu Davi sua espada sobre suas roupas, e provou a andar, porque nunca havia provado. E disse Davi a Saul: Eu não posso andar com isto, porque nunca o pratiquei. E lançando de si Davi aquelas coisas,
verses.RVR09: Y ciñó David su espada sobre sus vestidos, y probó á andar, porque nunca había probado. Y dijo David á Saúl: Yo no puedo andar con esto, porque nunca lo practiqué. Y echando de sí David aquellas cosas,

verses.KJV: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
verses.WEB: He took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag which he had. His sling was in his hand; and he came near to the Philistine.
verses.ASV: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the shepherd’s bag which he had, even in his wallet; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou seu cajado em sua mão, e escolheu para si cinco pedras lisas do ribeiro, e as pôs no saco pastoril e na sacola que trazia, e com sua funda em sua mão foi até o filisteu.
verses.RVR09: Tomó su cayado en su mano, y escogióse cinco piedras lisas del arroyo, y púsolas en el saco pastoril y en el zurrón que traía, y con su honda en su mano vase hacia el Filisteo.

verses.KJV: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
verses.WEB: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.
verses.ASV: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filisteu vinha andando e aproximando-se a Davi, e seu escudeiro diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y el Filisteo venía andando y acercándose á David, y su escudero delante de él.

verses.KJV: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
verses.WEB: When the Philistine looked around and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.
verses.ASV: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and withal of a fair countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o filisteu olhou e viu a Davi, menosprezou-o; porque era rapaz, e ruivo, e de bela aparência.
verses.RVR09: Y como el Filisteo miró y vió á David túvole en poco; porque era mancebo, y rubio, y de hermoso parecer.

verses.KJV: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.WEB: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.ASV: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o filisteu a Davi: Sou eu cão para que venhas a mim com paus? E amaldiçoou a Davi por seus deuses.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el Filisteo á David: ¿Soy yo perro para que vengas á mí con palos? Y maldijo á David por sus dioses.

verses.KJV: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.
verses.WEB: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and to the animals of the field.”
verses.ASV: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the birds of the heavens, and to the beasts of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse logo o filisteu a Davi: Vem a mim, e darei tua carne às aves do céu, e aos animais do campo.
verses.RVR09: Dijo luego el Filisteo á David: Ven á mí, y daré tu carne á las aves del cielo, y á las bestias del campo.

verses.KJV: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
verses.WEB: Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of the LORD of Armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
verses.ASV: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a javelin: but I come to thee in the name of Jehovah of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Davi ao filisteu: Tu vens a mim com espada e lança e escudo; mas eu venho a ti no nome do SENHOR dos exércitos, o Deus dos esquadrões de Israel, que tu provocaste.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo David al Filisteo: Tú vienes á mí con espada y lanza y escudo; mas yo vengo á ti en el nombre de Jehová de los ejércitos, el Dios de los escuadrones de Israel, que tú has provocado.

verses.KJV: This day will the Lord deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
verses.WEB: Today, the LORD will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you and take your head from off you. I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky and to the wild animals of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,
verses.ASV: This day will Jehovah deliver thee into my hand; and I will smite thee, and take thy head from off thee; and I will give the dead bodies of the host of the Philistines this day unto the birds of the heavens, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,
verses.ALMEIDA: o SENHOR te entregará hoje em minha mão, e eu te vencerei, e tirarei tua cabeça de ti: e darei hoje os corpos dos filisteus às aves do céu e aos animais da terra: e saberá a terra toda que há Deus em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Jehová te entregará hoy en mi mano, y yo te venceré, y quitaré tu cabeza de ti: y daré hoy los cuerpos de los Filisteos á las aves del cielo y á las bestias de la tierra: y sabrá la tierra toda que hay Dios en Israel.

verses.KJV: And all this assembly shall know that the Lord saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the Lord's, and he will give you into our hands.
verses.WEB: and that all this assembly may know that the LORD doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hand.”
verses.ASV: and that all this assembly may know that Jehovah saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is Jehovah’s, and he will give you into our hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saberá toda esta congregação que o SENHOR não salva com espada e lança; porque do SENHOR é la guerra, e ele vos entregará em nossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrá toda esta congregación que Jehová no salva con espada y lanza; porque de Jehová es la guerra, y él os entregará en nuestras manos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came, and drew nigh to meet David, that David hastened, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
verses.WEB: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hastened, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando o filisteu se levantou para ir e chegar-se contra Davi, Davi se deu pressa, e correu ao combate contra o filisteu.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, como el Filisteo se levantó para ir y llegarse contra David, David se dió priesa, y corrió al combate contra el Filisteo.

verses.KJV: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
verses.WEB: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.
verses.ASV: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead; and the stone sank into his forehead, and he fell upon his face to the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E metendo Davi sua mão no saco, tomou dali uma pedra, e atirou-a com a funda, e feriu ao filisteu na testa: e a pedra ficou fincada na testa, e caiu em terra sobre seu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Y metiendo David su mano en el saco, tomó de allí una piedra, y tirósela con la honda, é hirió al Filisteo en la frente: y la piedra quedó hincada en la frente, y cayó en tierra sobre su rostro.

verses.KJV: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.
verses.WEB: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him; but there was no sword in David’s hand.
verses.ASV: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim venceu Davi ao filisteu com funda e pedra; e feriu ao filisteu e o matou, sem ter Davi espada em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Así venció David al Filisteo con honda y piedra; é hirió al Filisteo y matólo, sin tener David espada en su mano.

verses.KJV: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.
verses.WEB: Then David ran, stood over the Philistine, took his sword, drew it out of its sheath, killed him, and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.
verses.ASV: Then David ran, and stood over the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas correu Davi e pôs-se sobre o filisteu, e tomando a espada dele, tirando-a de sua bainha, o matou, e cortou-lhe com ela a cabeça. E quando os filisteus viram seu gigante morto, fugiram.
verses.RVR09: Mas corrió David y púsose sobre el Filisteo, y tomando la espada de él, sacándola de su vaina, matólo, y cortóle con ella la cabeza. Y como los Filisteos vieron su gigante muerto, huyeron.

verses.KJV: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.
verses.WEB: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.
verses.ASV: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou comest to Gai, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando-se os de Israel e de Judá, deram grito, e seguiram aos filisteus até chegar ao vale, e até as portas de Ecrom. E caíram feridos dos filisteus pelo caminho de Saaraim, até Gate e Ecrom.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose los de Israel y de Judá, dieron grita, y siguieron á los Filisteos hasta llegar al valle, y hasta las puertas de Ecrón. Y cayeron heridos de los Filisteos por el camino de Saraim, hasta Gath y Ecrón.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornando logo os filhos de Israel de perseguir os filisteus, despojaram seu acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Tornando luego los hijos de Israel de seguir los Filisteos, despojaron su campamento.

verses.KJV: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.
verses.WEB: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.
verses.ASV: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armor in his tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi tomou a cabeça do filisteu, e trouxe-a a Jerusalém, mas pôs suas armas em sua tenda.
verses.RVR09: Y David tomó la cabeza del Filisteo, y trájola á Jerusalem, mas puso sus armas en su tienda.

verses.KJV: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.
verses.WEB: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, “Abner, whose son is this youth?” Abner said, “As your soul lives, O king, I can’t tell.”
verses.ASV: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Saul viu a Davi que saía a encontrar-se com o filisteu, disse a Abner general do exército: Abner, de quem é filho aquele rapaz? E Abner respondeu:
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Saúl vió á David que salía á encontrarse con el Filisteo, dijo á Abner general del ejército: Abner, ¿de quién es hijo aquel mancebo? Y Abner respondió:

verses.KJV: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.
verses.WEB: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”
verses.ASV: And the king said, Inquire thou whose son the stripling is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vive tua alma, ó rei, que não o sei. E o rei disse: Pergunta, pois, de quem é filho aquele rapaz.
verses.RVR09: Vive tu alma, oh rey, que no lo sé. Y el rey dijo: Pregunta pues de quién es hijo aquel mancebo.

verses.KJV: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
verses.WEB: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
verses.ASV: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Davi voltava de matar ao filisteu, Abner o tomou, e levou-o diante de Saul, tendo a cabeça do filisteu em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando David volvía de matar al Filisteo, Abner lo tomó, y llevólo delante de Saúl, teniendo la cabeza del Filisteo en su mano.

verses.KJV: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.
verses.WEB: Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, you young man?” David answered, “I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”
verses.ASV: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth-lehemite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Saul: Rapaz, de quem és filho? E Davi respondeu: Eu sou filho de teu servo Jessé de Belém.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Saúl: Mancebo, ¿de quién eres hijo? Y David respondió: Yo soy hijo de tu siervo Isaí de Beth-lehem.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.WEB: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim que ele acabou de falar com Saul, a alma de Jônatas se apegou à de Davi, e Jônatas o amou como à sua alma.
verses.RVR09: Y ASÍ que él hubo acabado de hablar con Saúl, el alma de Jonathán fué ligada con la de David, y amólo Jonathán como á su alma.

verses.KJV: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.
verses.WEB: Saul took him that day, and wouldn’t let him go home to his father’s house any more.
verses.ASV: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul o tomou naquele dia, e não o deixou voltar à casa de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl le tomó aquel día, y no le dejó volver á casa de su padre.

verses.KJV: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.WEB: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.ASV: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram aliança Jônatas e Davi, porque ele lhe amava como a sua alma.
verses.RVR09: E hicieron alianza Jonathán y David, porque él le amaba como á su alma.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
verses.WEB: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his apparel, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas despiu a roupa que tinha sobre si, e deu-a a Davi, e outras roupas suas, até sua espada, e seu arco, e seu cinto.
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán se desnudó la ropa que tenía sobre sí, y dióla á David, y otras ropas suyas, hasta su espada, y su arco, y su talabarte.

verses.KJV: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.
verses.WEB: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
verses.ASV: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, [and] behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and it was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi saía para onde quer que Saul o enviasse, e portava-se prudentemente. Fê-lo, portanto, Saul capitão da gente de guerra, e era aceito aos olhos de todo o povo, e nos olhos dos criados de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Y salía David á donde quiera que Saúl le enviaba, y portábase prudentemente. Hízolo por tanto Saúl capitán de gente de guerra, y era acepto en los ojos de todo el pueblo, y en los ojos de los criados de Saúl.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.
verses.WEB: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass as they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with timbrels, with joy, and with instruments of music.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que quando voltavam eles, quando Davi voltou de matar ao filisteu, saíram as mulheres de todas as cidades de Israel cantando, e com danças, com tamboris, e com alegrias e adufes, a receber ao rei Saul.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que como volvían ellos, cuando David tornó de matar al Filisteo, salieron las mujeres de todas las ciudades de Israel cantando, y con danzas, con tamboriles, y con alegrías y sonajas, á recibir al rey Saúl.

verses.KJV: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
verses.WEB: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”
verses.ASV: And the women sang one to another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cantavam as mulheres que dançavam, e diziam: Saul feriu seus milhares, E Davi seus dez milhares.
verses.RVR09: Y cantaban las mujeres que danzaba, y decían: Saúl hirió sus miles, y David sus diez miles.

verses.KJV: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?
verses.WEB: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have credited David with ten thousands, and they have only credited me with thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?”
verses.ASV: And Saul was very wroth, and this saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?
verses.ALMEIDA: E irou-se Saul em grande maneira, e desagradou esta palavra em seus olhos, e disse: A Davi deram dez milhares, e a mim milhares; não lhe falta mais que o reino.
verses.RVR09: Y enojóse Saúl en gran manera, y desagradó esta palabra en sus ojos, y dijo: A David dieron diez miles, y á mí miles; no le falta más que el reino.

verses.KJV: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
verses.WEB: Saul watched David from that day and forward.
verses.ASV: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desde aquele dia Saul olhou com desconfiança a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y desde aquel día Saúl miró de través á David.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul's hand.
verses.WEB: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that an evil spirit from God came mightily upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as he did day by day. And Saul had his spear in his hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Outro dia aconteceu que o espírito mau da parte de Deus tomou a Saul, e mostrava-se em sua casa com trejeitos de profeta: e Davi tocava com sua mão como os outros dias; e estava uma lança à mão de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Otro día aconteció que el espíritu malo de parte de Dios tomó á Saúl, y mostrábase en su casa con trasportes de profeta: y David tañía con su mano como los otros días; y estaba una lanza á mano de Saúl.

verses.KJV: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
verses.WEB: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.
verses.ASV: and Saul cast the spear; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançou Saul a lança, dizendo: Encravarei a Davi na parede. E duas vezes se afastou dele Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y arrojó Saúl la lanza, diciendo: Enclavaré á David en la pared. Y dos veces se apartó de él David.

verses.KJV: And Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him, and was departed from Saul.
verses.WEB: Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and had departed from Saul.
verses.ASV: And Saul was afraid of David, because Jehovah was with him, and was departed from Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Saul se temia de Davi porquanto o SENHOR era com ele, e havia se afastado de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Mas Saúl se temía de David, por cuanto Jehová era con él, y se había apartado de Saúl.

verses.KJV: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.WEB: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.ASV: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afastou-o, pois, Saul de si, e fez-lhe capitão de mil; e saía e entrava diante do povo.
verses.RVR09: Apartólo pues Saúl de sí, é hízole capitán de mil; y salía y entraba delante del pueblo.

verses.KJV: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the Lord was with him.
verses.WEB: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
verses.ASV: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Jehovah was with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi se conduzia prudentemente em todos seus negócios, e o SENHOR era com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y David se conducía prudentemente en todos sus negocios, y Jehová era con él.

verses.KJV: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
verses.WEB: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.
verses.ASV: And when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Saul que se portava tão prudentemente, temia-se dele.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Saúl que se portaba tan prudentemente, temíase de él.

verses.KJV: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
verses.WEB: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.
verses.ASV: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas todos os de Israel e Judá amavam a Davi, porque ele saía e entrava diante deles.
verses.RVR09: Mas todo Israel y Judá amaba á David, porque él salía y entraba delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the Lord's battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.
verses.WEB: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight the LORD’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”
verses.ASV: And Saul said to David, Behold, my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight Jehovah’s battles. For Saul said, Let not my hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Saul a Davi: Eis que eu te darei a Merabe minha filha maior por mulher: somente que me sejas homem valente, e faças as guerras do SENHOR. Mas Saul dizia: Não será minha mão contra ele, mas a mão dos filisteus será contra ele.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Saúl á David: He aquí yo te daré á Merab mi hija mayor por mujer: solamente que me seas hombre valiente, y hagas las guerras de Jehová. Mas Saúl decía: No será mi mano contra él, mas la mano de los Filisteos será contra él.

verses.KJV: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?
verses.WEB: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”
verses.ASV: And David said unto Saul, Who am I, and what is my life, [or] my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi respondeu a Saul: Quem sou eu, ou que é minha vida, ou a família de meu pai em Israel, para ser genro do rei?
verses.RVR09: Y David respondió á Saúl: ¿Quién soy yo, ó qué es mi vida, ó la familia de mi padre en Israel, para ser yerno del rey?

verses.KJV: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
verses.WEB: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.
verses.ASV: But it came to pass at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo o tempo em que Merabe, filha de Saul, se havia de dar a Davi, foi dada por mulher a Adriel meolatita.
verses.RVR09: Y venido el tiempo en que Merab, hija de Saúl, se había de dar á David, fué dada por mujer á Adriel Meholatita.

verses.KJV: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.WEB: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.ASV: And Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Mical a outra filha de Saul amava a Davi; e foi dito a Saul, o qual foi conveniente em seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Mas Michâl la otra hija de Saúl amaba á David; y fué dicho á Saúl, lo cual plugo en sus ojos.

verses.KJV: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.
verses.WEB: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David a second time, “You shall today be my son-in-law.”
verses.ASV: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son-in-law a second time.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul disse: Eu a darei a ele, para que lhe seja por armadilha, e para que a mão dos filisteus seja contra ele. Disse, pois, Saul a Davi: Com a outra serás meu genro hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl dijo: Yo se la daré, para que le sea por lazo, y para que la mano de los Filisteos sea contra él. Dijo pues Saúl á David: Con la otra serás mi yerno hoy.

verses.KJV: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son in law.
verses.WEB: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”
verses.ASV: And Saul commanded his servants, [saying], Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou Saul a seus criados: Falai em secreto a Davi, dizendo-lhe: Eis que, o rei te ama, e todos seus criados te querem bem; sê, pois, genro do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó Saúl á sus criados: Hablad en secreto á David, diciéndole: He aquí, el rey te ama, y todos sus criados te quieren bien; sé pues yerno del rey.

verses.KJV: And Saul's servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king's son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?
verses.WEB: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and little known?”
verses.ASV: And Saul’s servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os criados de Saul falaram estas palavras aos ouvidos de Davi. E Davi disse: Parece-vos que é pouco ser genro do rei, sendo eu um homem pobre e de nenhuma estima?
verses.RVR09: Y los criados de Saúl hablaron estas palabras á los oídos de David. Y David dijo: ¿Paréceos á vosotros que es poco ser yerno del rey, siendo yo un hombre pobre y de ninguna estima?

verses.KJV: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.
verses.WEB: The servants of Saul told him, saying, “David spoke like this.”
verses.ASV: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os criados de Saul lhe deram a resposta dizendo: Tais palavras disse Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y los criados de Saúl le dieron la respuesta diciendo: Tales palabras ha dicho David.

verses.KJV: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.WEB: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.ASV: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but a hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies. Now Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul disse: Dizei assim a Davi: Não está o contentamento do rei no dote, mas sim em cem prepúcios de filisteus, para que seja tomada vingança dos inimigos do rei. Mas Saul pensava lançar a Davi em mãos dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl dijo: Decid así á David: No está el contentamiento del rey en el dote, sino en cien prepucios de Filisteos, para que sea tomada venganza de los enemigos del rey. Mas Saúl pensaba echar á David en manos de los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.
verses.WEB: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,
verses.ASV: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. And the days were not expired;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando seus criados declararam a Davi estas palavras, foi conveniente a coisa nos olhos de Davi, para ser genro do rei. E quando o prazo não era ainda cumprido,
verses.RVR09: Y como sus criados declararon á David estas palabras, plugo la cosa en los ojos de David, para ser yerno del rey. Y como el plazo no era aún cumplido,

verses.KJV: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.
verses.WEB: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.
verses.ASV: and David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantou-se Davi, e partiu-se com sua gente, e feriu duzentos homens dos filisteus; e trouxe Davi os prepúcios deles, e entregaram-nos todos ao rei, para que ele fosse feito genro do rei. E Saul lhe deu a sua filha Mical por mulher.
verses.RVR09: Levantóse David, y partióse con su gente, é hirió doscientos hombres de los Filisteos; y trajo David los prepucios de ellos, y entregáronlos todos al rey, para que él fuese hecho yerno del rey. Y Saúl le dió á su hija Michâl por mujer.

verses.KJV: And Saul saw and knew that the Lord was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.
verses.WEB: Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.
verses.ASV: And Saul saw and knew that Jehovah was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Saul, vendo e considerando que o SENHOR era com Davi, e que sua filha Mical o amava,
verses.RVR09: Pero Saúl, viendo y considerando que Jehová era con David, y que su hija Michâl lo amaba,

verses.KJV: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.
verses.WEB: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.
verses.ASV: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temeu-se mais de Davi; e foi Saul inimigo de Davi todos os dias.
verses.RVR09: Temióse más de David; y fué Saúl enemigo de David todos los días.

verses.KJV: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.
verses.WEB: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.
verses.ASV: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, as often as they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saíam os príncipes dos filisteus; e quando eles saíam, portava-se Davi mais prudentemente que todos os servos de Saul: e era seu nome muito ilustre.
verses.RVR09: Y salían los príncipes de los Filisteos; y como ellos salían, portábase David más prudentemente que todos los siervos de Saúl: y era su nombre muy ilustre.

verses.KJV: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
verses.WEB: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.
verses.ASV: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should slay David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, delighted much in David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Saul a Jônatas seu filho, e a todos os seus criados, para que matassem a Davi; mas Jônatas filho de Saul amava a Davi em grande maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ Saúl á Jonathán su hijo, y á todos sus criados, para que matasen á David; mas Jonathán hijo de Saúl amaba á David en gran manera.

verses.KJV: But Jonathan Saul's son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:
verses.WEB: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to slay thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself in the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu aviso a Davi, dizendo: Saul meu pai procura matar-te; portanto olha agora por ti até a manhã, e fica-te em lugar oculto, e esconde-te:
verses.RVR09: Y dió aviso á David, diciendo: Saúl mi padre procura matarte; por tanto mira ahora por ti hasta la mañana, y estáte en paraje oculto, y escóndete:

verses.KJV: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.
verses.WEB: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”
verses.ASV: and I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and if I see aught, I will tell thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu sairei e estarei junto a meu pai no campo de onde estiveres: e falarei de ti a meu pai, e te farei saber o que notar.
verses.RVR09: Y yo saldré y estaré junto á mi padre en el campo donde estuvieres: y hablaré de ti á mi padre, y te haré saber lo que notare.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:
verses.WEB: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;
verses.ASV: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas falou bem de Davi a Saul seu pai, e disse-lhe: Não peque o rei contra seu servo Davi, pois que nenhuma coisa cometeu contra ti: antes suas obras te foram muito boas;
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán habló bien de David á Saúl su padre, y díjole: No peque el rey contra su siervo David, pues que ninguna cosa ha cometido contra ti: antes sus obras te han sido muy buenas;

verses.KJV: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the Lord wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?
verses.WEB: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and the LORD worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”
verses.ASV: for he put his life in his hand, and smote the Philistine, and Jehovah wrought a great victory for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice; wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele pôs sua alma em sua palma, e feriu ao filisteu, e o SENHOR fez uma grande salvação a todo Israel. Tu o viste, e te alegraste: por que, pois, pecarás contra o sangue inocente, matando a Davi sem causa?
verses.RVR09: Porque él puso su alma en su palma, é hirió al Filisteo, y Jehová hizo una gran salud á todo Israel. Tú lo viste, y te holgaste: ¿por qué pues pecarás contra la sangre inocente, matando á David sin causa?

verses.KJV: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the Lord liveth, he shall not be slain.
verses.WEB: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As the LORD lives, he shall not be put to death.”
verses.ASV: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As Jehovah liveth, he shall not be put to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo Saul a voz de Jônatas, jurou: Vive o SENHOR, que não morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo Saúl la voz de Jonathán, juró: Vive Jehová, que no morirá.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.
verses.WEB: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as beforetime.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamando então Jônatas a Davi, declarou-lhe todas estas palavras; e ele mesmo apresentou Davi a Saul, e esteve diante dele como antes.
verses.RVR09: Llamando entonces Jonathán á David, declaróle todas estas palabras; y él mismo presentó á David á Saúl, y estuvo delante de él como antes.

verses.KJV: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.
verses.WEB: There was war again. David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.
verses.ASV: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a fazer-se guerra: e saiu Davi e lutou contra os filisteus, e feriu-os com grande estrago, e fugiram diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y tornó á hacerse guerra: y salió David y peleó contra los Filisteos, é hiriólos con grande estrago, y huyeron delante de él.

verses.KJV: And the evil spirit from the Lord was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.
verses.WEB: An evil spirit from the LORD was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand.
verses.ASV: And an evil spirit from Jehovah was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing with his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o espírito mau da parte do SENHOR foi sobre Saul: e estando sentado em sua casa tinha uma lança à mão, enquanto Davi estava tocando harpa com sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Y el espíritu malo de parte de Jehová fué sobre Saúl: y estando sentado en su casa tenía una lanza á mano, mientras David estaba tañendo con su mano.

verses.KJV: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin: but he slipped away out of Saul's presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.
verses.WEB: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence; and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.
verses.ASV: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the spear; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he smote the spear into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul procurou encravar a Davi com a lança na parede; mas ele se afastou de diante de Saul, o qual feriu com a lança na parede; e Davi fugiu, e escapou-se aquela noite.
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl procuró enclavar á David con la lanza en la pared; mas él se apartó de delante de Saúl, el cual hirió con la lanza en la pared; y David huyó, y escapóse aquella noche.

verses.KJV: Saul also sent messengers unto David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.
verses.WEB: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”
verses.ASV: And Saul sent messengers unto David’s house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to-night, to-morrow thou wilt be slain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saul enviou logo mensageiros à casa de Davi para que o guardassem, e o matassem à manhã. Mas Mical sua mulher o revelou a Davi, dizendo: Se não salvares tua vida esta noite, amanhã serás morto.
verses.RVR09: Saúl envió luego mensajeros á casa de David para que lo guardasen, y lo matasen á la mañana. Mas Michâl su mujer lo descubrió á David, diciendo: Si no salvares tu vida esta noche, mañana serás muerto.

verses.KJV: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.
verses.WEB: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.
verses.ASV: So Michal let David down through the window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.
verses.ALMEIDA: E baixou Mical a Davi por uma janela; e ele se foi, e fugiu, e escapou-se.
verses.RVR09: Y descolgó Michâl á David por una ventana; y él se fué, y huyó, y escapóse.

verses.KJV: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.
verses.WEB: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.
verses.ASV: And Michal took the teraphim, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ [hair] at the head thereof, and covered it with the clothes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou logo Mical uma estátua, e a pôs sobre a cama, e acomodou-lhe por cabeceira uma almofada de pelos de cabra, e cobriu-a com uma roupa.
verses.RVR09: Tomó luego Michâl una estatua, y púsola sobre la cama, y acomodóle por cabecera una almohada de pelos de cabra, y cubrióla con una ropa.

verses.KJV: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
verses.WEB: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”
verses.ASV: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Saul enviou mensageiros que tomassem a Davi, ela respondeu: Está enfermo.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando Saúl envió mensajeros que tomasen á David, ella respondió: Está enfermo.

verses.KJV: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
verses.WEB: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”
verses.ASV: And Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou Saul a enviar mensageiros para que vissem a Davi, dizendo: Trazei-o a mim na cama para que o mate.
verses.RVR09: Y tornó Saúl á enviar mensajeros para que viesen á David, diciendo: Traédmelo en la cama para que lo mate.

verses.KJV: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster.
verses.WEB: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.
verses.ASV: And when the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ [hair] at the head thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os mensageiros entraram, eis que a estátua estava na cama, e uma almofada de pelos de cabra por cabeceira.
verses.RVR09: Y como los mensajeros entraron, he aquí la estatua estaba en la cama, y una almohada de pelos de cabra por cabecera.

verses.KJV: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?
verses.WEB: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”
verses.ASV: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me thus, and let mine enemy go, so that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Saul disse a Mical: Por que me enganaste assim, e deixaste escapar a meu inimigo? E Mical respondeu a Saul: Porque ele me disse: Deixa-me ir; se não, eu te matarei.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Saúl dijo á Michâl: ¿Por qué me has así engañado, y has dejado escapar á mi enemigo? Y Michâl respondió á Saúl: Porque él me dijo: Déjame ir; si no, yo te mataré.

verses.KJV: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
verses.WEB: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.
verses.ASV: Now David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fugiu, pois, Davi, e escapou-se, e veio a Samuel em Ramá, e disse-lhe tudo o que Saul havia feito com ele. E foram-se ele e Samuel, e moraram em Naiote.
verses.RVR09: Huyó pues David, y escapóse, y vino á Samuel en Rama, y díjole todo lo que Saúl había hecho con él. Y fuéronse él y Samuel, y moraron en Najoth.

verses.KJV: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.WEB: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”
verses.ASV: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dado aviso a Saul, dizendo: Eis que Davi está em Naiote em Ramá.
verses.RVR09: Y fué dado aviso á Saúl, diciendo: He aquí que David está en Najoth en Rama.

verses.KJV: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
verses.WEB: Saul sent messengers to seize David; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.
verses.ASV: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Saul mensageiros que trouxessem a Davi, os quais viram uma companhia de profetas que profetizavam, e a Samuel que estava ali, e os presidia. E foi o espírito de Deus sobre os mensageiros de Saul, e eles também profetizaram.
verses.RVR09: Y envió Saúl mensajeros que trajesen á David, los cuales vieron una compañía de profetas que profetizaban, y á Samuel que estaba allí, y los presidía. Y fué el espíritu de Dios sobre los mensajeros de Saúl, y ellos también profetizaron.

verses.KJV: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
verses.WEB: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.
verses.ASV: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.
verses.ALMEIDA: E feito que foi saber a Saul, ele enviou outros mensageiros, os quais também profetizaram. E Saul voltou a enviar pela terceira vez mensageiros, e eles também profetizaram.
verses.RVR09: Y hecho que fué saber á Saúl, él envió otros mensajeros, los cuales también profetizaron. Y Saúl volvió á enviar por tercera vez mensajeros, y ellos también profetizaron.

verses.KJV: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.WEB: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”
verses.ASV: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele mesmo veio a Ramá; e chegando ao poço grande que está em Socó, perguntou dizendo: Onde estão Samuel e Davi? E foi-lhe respondido: Eis que estão em Naiote em Ramá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él mismo vino á Rama; y llegando al pozo grande que está en Sochô, preguntó diciendo: ¿Dónde están Samuel y David? Y fuéle respondido: He aquí están en Najoth en Rama.

verses.KJV: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.WEB: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then God’s Spirit came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.ASV: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God came upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi ali a Naiote em Ramá; e também veio sobre ele o espírito de Deus, e ia profetizando, até que chegou a Naiote em Ramá.
verses.RVR09: Y fué allá á Najoth en Rama; y también vino sobre él el espíritu de Dios, é iba profetizando, hasta que llegó á Najoth en Rama.

verses.KJV: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.WEB: He also stripped off his clothes. He also prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
verses.ASV: And he also stripped off his clothes, and he also prophesied before Samuel, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele também se desnudou suas roupas, e profetizou igualmente diante de Samuel, e caiu nu todo aquele dia e toda aquela noite. De aqui se disse: Também Saul entre os profetas?
verses.RVR09: Y él también se desnudó sus vestidos, y profetizó igualmente delante de Samuel, y cayó desnudo todo aquel día y toda aquella noche. De aquí se dijo: ¿También Saúl entre los profetas?

verses.KJV: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
verses.WEB: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”
verses.ASV: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi fugiu de Naiote que é em Ramá, e veio diante de Jônatas, e disse: Que fiz eu? qual é minha maldade, ou qual meu pecado contra teu pai, que ele busca minha vida?
verses.RVR09: Y DAVID huyó de Najoth que es en Rama, y vínose delante de Jonathán, y dijo: ¿Qué he hecho yo? ¿cuál es mi maldad, ó cuál mi pecado contra tu padre, que él busca mi vida?

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Far from it; thou shalt not die: behold, my father doeth nothing either great or small, but that he discloseth it unto me; and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Em nenhuma maneira; não morrerás. Eis que meu pai nenhuma coisa fará, grande nem pequena, que não a revele a mim; por que pois me encobrirá meu pai este negócio? Não será assim.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: En ninguna manera; no morirás. He aquí que mi padre ninguna cosa hará, grande ni pequeña, que no me la descubra: ¿por qué pues me encubrirá mi padre este negocio? No será así.

verses.KJV: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
verses.WEB: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”
verses.ASV: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father knoweth well that I have found favor in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as Jehovah liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi voltou a jurar, dizendo: Teu pai sabe claramente que eu achei favor diante de teus olhos, e dirá: Não saiba isto Jônatas, para que não tenha pesar: e certamente, vive o SENHOR e vive tua alma, que apenas há um passo entre mim e a morte.
verses.RVR09: Y David volvió á jurar, diciendo: Tu padre sabe claramente que yo he hallado gracia delante de tus ojos, y dirá: No sepa esto Jonathán, porque no tenga pesar: y ciertamente, vive Jehová y vive tu alma, que apenas hay un paso entre mí y la muerte.

verses.KJV: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
verses.WEB: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”
verses.ASV: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas disse a Davi: Que diga tua alma, e eu o farei por ti?
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán dijo á David: ¿Qué discurre tu alma, y harélo por ti?

verses.KJV: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.
verses.WEB: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.
verses.ASV: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to-morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi respondeu a Jônatas: Eis que amanhã será nova lua, e eu costumo sentar-me com o rei a comer: mas tu deixarás que me esconda no campo até à tarde do terceiro dia.
verses.RVR09: Y David respondió á Jonathán: He aquí que mañana será nueva luna, y yo acostumbro sentarme con el rey á comer: mas tú dejarás que me esconda en el campo hasta la tarde del tercer día.

verses.KJV: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
verses.WEB: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem, his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’
verses.ASV: If thy father miss me at all, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth-lehem his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se teu pai fizer menção de mim, dirás: Rogo-me muito que o deixasse ir logo a Belém sua cidade, porque todos os de sua linhagem têm ali sacrifício anual.
verses.RVR09: Si tu padre hiciere mención de mí, dirás: Rogóme mucho que lo dejase ir presto á Beth-lehem su ciudad, porque todos los de su linaje tienen allá sacrificio aniversario.

verses.KJV: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
verses.WEB: If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.
verses.ASV: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be wroth, then know that evil is determined by him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ele disser, Está bem, teu servo terá paz; mas se se irar, sabe que a malícia está nele completa.
verses.RVR09: Si él dijere, Bien está, paz tendrá tu siervo; mas si se enojare, sabe que la malicia es en él consumada.

verses.KJV: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the Lord with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
verses.WEB: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the LORD with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”
verses.ASV: Therefore deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of Jehovah with thee: but if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás, pois, misericórdia com teu servo, já que trouxeste teu servo a aliança do SENHOR contigo: e se maldade há em mim mata-me tu, que não há necessidade de levar-me até teu pai.
verses.RVR09: Harás pues misericordia con tu siervo, ya que has traído tu siervo á alianza de Jehová contigo: y si maldad hay en mí mátame tú, que no hay necesidad de llevarme hasta tu padre.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
verses.WEB: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”
verses.ASV: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas lhe disse: Nunca tal te suceda; antes bem, se eu entendesse ser completa a malícia de meu pai, para vir sobre ti, não havia eu de revelá-lo a ti?
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán le dijo: Nunca tal te suceda; antes bien, si yo entendiera ser consumada la malicia de mi padre, para venir sobre ti, ¿no había yo de descubrírtelo?

verses.KJV: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
verses.WEB: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”
verses.ASV: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me if perchance thy father answer thee roughly?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse então Davi a Jônatas: Quem me dará aviso? Ou que se teu pai te responder asperamente?
verses.RVR09: Dijo entonces David á Jonathán: ¿Quién me dará aviso? ó ¿qué si tu padre te respondiere ásperamente?

verses.KJV: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
verses.WEB: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas disse a Davi: Vem, saiamos ao campo. E saíram ambos ao campo.
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán dijo á David: Ven, salgamos al campo. Y salieron ambos al campo.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan said unto David, O Lord God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;
verses.WEB: Jonathan said to David, “By the LORD, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?
verses.ASV: And Jonathan said unto David, Jehovah, the God of Israel, [be witness]: when I have sounded my father about this time to-morrow, [or] the third day, behold, if there be good toward David, shall I not then send unto thee, and disclose it unto thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Jônatas a Davi: Ó SENHOR Deus de Israel, quando houver eu perguntado a meu pai amanhã a esta hora, ou depois de amanhã, e ele parecer bem para com Davi, se então não enviar a ti, e o revelar a ti,
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Jonathán á David: Oh Jehová Dios de Israel, cuando habré yo preguntado á mi padre mañana á esta hora, ó después de mañana, y él apareciere bien para con David, si entonces no enviare á ti, y te lo descubriere,

verses.KJV: The Lord do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the Lord be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
verses.WEB: The LORD do so to Jonathan and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in peace. May the LORD be with you as he has been with my father.
verses.ASV: Jehovah do so to Jonathan, and more also, should it please my father to do thee evil, if I disclose it not unto thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and Jehovah be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR faça assim a Jônatas, e isto acrescente. Mas se a meu pai parecer bem fazer-te mal, também te o revelarei, e te enviarei, e te irás em paz: e seja o SENHOR contigo, como foi com meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Jehová haga así á Jonathán, y esto añada. Mas si á mi padre pareciere bien hacerte mal, también te lo descubriré, y te enviaré, y te irás en paz: y sea Jehová contigo, como fué con mi padre.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the Lord, that I die not:
verses.WEB: You shall not only show me the loving kindness of the LORD while I still live, that I not die;
verses.ASV: And thou shalt not only while yet I live show me the lovingkindness of Jehovah, that I die not;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se eu viver, farás comigo misericórdia do SENHOR; mas se for morto,
verses.RVR09: Y si yo viviere, harás conmigo misericordia de Jehová; mas si fuere muerto,

verses.KJV: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the Lord hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when the LORD has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”
verses.ASV: but also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever; no, not when Jehovah hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tirarás perpetuamente tua misericórdia de minha casa, nem quando o SENHOR exterminar um por um os inimigos de Davi da face da terra.
verses.RVR09: No quitarás perpetuamente tu misericordia de mi casa. Cuando desarraigare Jehová uno por uno los enemigos de David de la tierra, aun á Jonathán quite de su casa, si te faltare.

verses.KJV: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the Lord even require it at the hand of David's enemies.
verses.WEB: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “The LORD will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”
verses.ASV: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, [saying], And Jehovah will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Jônatas fez aliança com a casa de Davi, dizendo: O SENHOR o exija da mão dos inimigos de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Así hizo Jonathán alianza con la casa de David, diciendo: Requiéralo Jehová de la mano de los enemigos de David.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.WEB: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had for him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had to him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou Jônatas a jurar a Davi, porque o amava, porque o amava como à sua alma.
verses.RVR09: Y tornó Jonathán á jurar á David, porque le amaba, porque le amaba como á su alma.

verses.KJV: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
verses.WEB: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
verses.ASV: Then Jonathan said unto him, To-morrow is the new moon: and thou wilt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe logo Jônatas: Amanhã é lua nova, e tua falta será percebida, porque teu assento estará vazio.
verses.RVR09: Díjole luego Jonathán: Mañana es nueva luna, y tú serás echado de menos, porque tu asiento estará vacío.

verses.KJV: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.WEB: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.ASV: And when thou hast stayed three days, thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estarás, pois, três dias, e logo descerás, e virás ao lugar de onde estavas escondido o dia do incidente, e esperarás junto à pedra de Ezel;
verses.RVR09: Estarás pues tres días, y luego descenderás, y vendrás al lugar donde estabas escondido el día de trabajo, y esperarás junto á la piedra de Ezel;

verses.KJV: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.WEB: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.ASV: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu atirarei três flechas até aquele lado, como que me exercitando ao alvo.
verses.RVR09: Y yo tiraré tres saetas hacia aquel lado, como ejercitándome al blanco.

verses.KJV: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the Lord liveth.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ If I tell the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you. Take them;’ then come, for there is peace to you and no danger, as the LORD lives.
verses.ASV: And, behold, I will send the lad, [saying], Go, find the arrows. If I say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee; take them, and come; for there is peace to thee and no hurt, as Jehovah liveth.
