verses.ALMEIDA: E logo enviarei o criado dizendo-lhe: Vai, busca as flechas. E se disser ao jovem: Eis ali as flechas mais aqui de ti, toma-as: tu virás, porque tens paz, e nada há de mal, vive o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y luego enviaré el criado diciéndole: Ve, busca las saetas. Y si dijere al mozo: He allí las saetas más acá de ti, tómalas: tú vendrás, porque paz tienes, y nada hay de mal, vive Jehová.

verses.KJV: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the Lord hath sent thee away.
verses.WEB: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for the LORD has sent you away.
verses.ASV: But if I say thus unto the boy, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way; for Jehovah hath sent thee away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se eu disser ao jovem assim: Eis ali as flechas mais ali de ti: vai-te, porque o SENHOR te enviou.
verses.RVR09: Mas si yo dijere al mozo así: He allí las saetas más allá de ti: vete, porque Jehová te ha enviado.

verses.KJV: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the Lord be between thee and me for ever.
verses.WEB: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD is between you and me forever.”
verses.ASV: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, Jehovah is between thee and me for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto às palavras que eu e tu falamos, seja o SENHOR entre mim e ti para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y cuanto á las palabras que yo y tú hemos hablado, sea Jehová entre mí y ti para siempre.

verses.KJV: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
verses.WEB: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.
verses.ASV: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat food.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi se escondeu no campo, e vinda que foi a lua nova, sentou-se o rei a comer pão.
verses.RVR09: David pues se escondió en el campo, y venida que fué la nueva luna, sentóse el rey á comer pan.

verses.KJV: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.
verses.WEB: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
verses.ASV: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side: but David’s place was empty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei se sentou em sua cadeira, como costumava, no assento junto à parede, e Jônatas se levantou, e sentou-se Abner ao lado de Saul, e o lugar de Davi estava vazio.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey se sentó en su silla, como solía, en el asiento junto á la pared, y Jonathán se levantó, y sentóse Abner al lado de Saúl, y el lugar de David estaba vacío.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless Saul didn’t say anything that day, for he thought, “Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean.”
verses.ASV: Nevertheless Saul spake not anything that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele dia Saul não disse nada, porque se dizia: Haverá lhe acontecido algo, e não está limpo; não estará purificado.
verses.RVR09: Mas aquel día Saúl no dijo nada, porque se decía: Habrále acontecido algo, y no está limpio; no estará purificado.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
verses.WEB: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow after the new moon, [which was] the second [day], that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to-day?
verses.ALMEIDA: O dia seguinte, o segundo dia da lua nova, aconteceu também que o assento de Davi estava vazio. E Saul disse a Jônatas seu filho: Por que não veio a comer o filho de Jessé hoje nem ontem?
verses.RVR09: El día siguiente, el segundo día de la nueva luna, aconteció también que el asiento de David estaba vacío. Y Saúl dijo á Jonathán su hijo: ¿Por qué no ha venido á comer el hijo de Isaí hoy ni ayer?

verses.KJV: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:
verses.WEB: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas respondeu a Saul: Davi me pediu encarecidamente lhe deixasse ir até Belém.
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán respondió á Saúl: David me pidió encarecidamente le dejase ir hasta Beth-lehem.

verses.KJV: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king's table.
verses.WEB: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”
verses.ASV: and he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me [to be there]: and now, if I have found favor in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he is not come unto the king’s table.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Rogo-te que me deixes ir, porque temos sacrifício os de nossa linhagem na cidade, e meu irmão mesmo me mandou; portanto, se achei graça em teus olhos, farei uma escapada agora, e visitarei a meus irmãos. Por isto, pois, não veio.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Ruégote que me dejes ir, porque tenemos sacrificio los de nuestro linaje en la ciudad, y mi hermano mismo me lo ha mandado; por tanto, si he hallado gracia en tus ojos, haré una escapada ahora, y visitaré á mis hermanos. Por esto pues no ha venido á la mesa del rey.

verses.KJV: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?
verses.WEB: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
verses.ASV: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of a perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own shame, and unto the shame of thy mother’s nakedness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Saul se acendeu contra Jônatas, e disse-lhe: Filho da pervertida e rebelde! Não sei eu que tu escolheste ao filho de Jessé para vergonha tua, e para vergonha da nudez de tua mãe?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Saúl se enardeció contra Jonathán, y díjole: Hijo de la perversa y rebelde, ¿no sé yo que tú has elegido al hijo de Isaí para confusión tuya, y para confusión de la vergüenza de tu madre?

verses.KJV: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
verses.WEB: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”
verses.ASV: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todo o tempo que o filho de Jessé viver sobre a terra, nem tu serás firme, nem teu reino. Envia, pois, agora, e traze-o a mim, porque morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Porque todo el tiempo que el hijo de Isaí viviere sobre la tierra, ni tú serás firme, ni tu reino. Envía pues ahora, y tráemelo, porque ha de morir.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
verses.WEB: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”
verses.ASV: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore should he be put to death? what hath he done?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas respondeu a seu pai Saul, e disse-lhe: Por que morrerá? O que ele fez?
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán respondió á su padre Saúl, y díjole: ¿Por qué morirá? ¿qué ha hecho?

verses.KJV: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
verses.WEB: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.
verses.ASV: And Saul cast his spear at him to smite him; whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to put David to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Saul lhe lançou uma lança para feri-lo: de onde entendeu Jônatas que seu pai estava determinado a matar a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Saúl le arrojó una lanza por herirlo: de donde entendió Jonathán que su padre estaba determinado á matar á David.

verses.KJV: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
verses.WEB: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.
verses.ASV: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se Jônatas da mesa com exaltada ira, e não comeu pão o segundo dia da lua nova: porque tinha dor por causa de Davi, porque seu pai lhe havia afrontado.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Jonathán de la mesa con exaltada ira, y no comió pan el segundo día de la nueva luna: porque tenía dolor á causa de David, porque su padre le había afrentado.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
verses.WEB: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao outro dia de manhã, saiu Jônatas ao campo, ao tempo marcado com Davi, e um jovem pequeno com ele.
verses.RVR09: Al otro día de mañana, salió Jonathán al campo, al tiempo aplazado con David, y un mozo pequeño con él.

verses.KJV: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.WEB: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.ASV: And he said unto his lad, Run, find now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a seu jovem: Corre e busca as flechas que eu atirar. E quando o jovem ia correndo, ele atirava a flecha que passava mais além dele.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á su mozo: Corre y busca las saetas que yo tirare. Y como el muchacho iba corriendo, él tiraba la saeta que pasara más allá de él.

verses.KJV: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?
verses.WEB: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the boy, and said, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”
verses.ASV: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegando o jovem onde estava a flecha que Jônatas havia atirado, Jônatas deu vozes atrás o jovem, dizendo: Não está a flecha mais além de ti?
verses.RVR09: Y llegando el muchacho adonde estaba la saeta que Jonathán había tirado, Jonathán dió voces tras el muchacho, diciendo: ¿No está la saeta más allá de ti?

verses.KJV: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.WEB: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a gritar Jônatas atrás o jovem: Apressa-te, corre, não pares. E o jovem de Jônatas agarrou as flechas, e veio a seu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y tornó á gritar Jonathán tras el muchacho: Date priesa, aligera, no te pares. Y el muchacho de Jonathán cogió las saetas, y vínose á su señor.

verses.KJV: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.WEB: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.ASV: But the lad knew not anything: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nenhuma coisa entendeu o jovem: somente Jônatas e Davi entendiam o negócio.
verses.RVR09: Empero ninguna cosa entendió el muchacho: solamente Jonathán y David entendían el negocio.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
verses.WEB: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”
verses.ASV: And Jonathan gave his weapons unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo deu Jônatas suas armas a seu jovem, e disse-lhe: Vai-te e leva-as à cidade.
verses.RVR09: Luego dió Jonathán sus armas á su muchacho, y díjole: Vete y llévalas á la ciudad.

verses.KJV: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
verses.WEB: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another and wept with one another, and David wept the most.
verses.ASV: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of [a place] toward the South, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que o jovem se havia ido, se levantou Davi da parte do sul, e inclinou-se três vezes prostrando-se até a terra: e beijando-se o um ao outro, choraram o um com o outro, ainda que Davi chorou mais.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que el muchacho se hubo ido, se levantó David de la parte del mediodía, é inclinóse tres veces postrándose hasta la tierra: y besándose el uno al otro, lloraron el uno con el otro, aunque David lloró más.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.WEB: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘The LORD is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of Jehovah, saying, Jehovah shall be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed, for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas disse a Davi: Vai-te em paz, que ambos juramos pelo nome do SENHOR, dizendo: o SENHOR seja entre mim e ti, entre minha descendência e a tua descendência para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán dijo á David: Vete en paz, que ambos hemos jurado por el nombre de Jehová, diciendo: Jehová sea entre mí y ti, entre mi simiente y la simiente tuya, para siempre. Y él se levantó y fuése: y Jonathán se entró en la ciudad.

verses.KJV: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
verses.WEB: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”
verses.ASV: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Davi a Nobe, a Aimeleque sacerdote: e surpreendeu-se Aimeleque de seu encontro, e disse-lhe: Como tu somente, e ninguém contigo?
verses.RVR09: Y VINO David á Nob, á Ahimelech sacerdote: y sorprendióse Ahimelech de su encuentro, y díjole: ¿Cómo tú solo, y nadie contigo?

verses.KJV: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.
verses.WEB: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’
verses.ASV: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know anything of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed the young men to such and such a place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Davi ao sacerdote Aimeleque: O rei me encomendou um negócio, e me disse: Ninguém saiba coisa alguma deste negócio a que eu te envio, e que eu te mandei; e eu assinalei aos criados certo lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió David al sacerdote Ahimelech: El rey me encomendó un negocio, y me dijo: Nadie sepa cosa alguna de este negocio á que yo te envío, y que yo te he mandado; y yo señalé á los criados un cierto lugar.

verses.KJV: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.
verses.WEB: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore what is under thy hand? give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatsoever there is present.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, o que tens à mão? Dá-me cinco pães, ou o que se achar.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, ¿qué tienes á mano? dame cinco panes, ó lo que se hallare.

verses.KJV: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.
verses.WEB: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”
verses.ASV: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under my hand, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote respondeu a Davi, e disse: Não tenho pão comum à mão; somente tenho pão sagrado: mas o darei se os criados se abstiveram de mulheres.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote respondió á David, y dijo: No tengo pan común á la mano; solamente tengo pan sagrado: mas lo daré si los criados se han guardado mayormente de mujeres.

verses.KJV: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.
verses.WEB: David answered the priest, and said to him, “Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?”
verses.ASV: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days; when I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was but a common journey; how much more then to-day shall their vessels be holy?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi respondeu ao sacerdote, e disse-lhe: Certamente as mulheres nos foram afastadas desde anteontem quando saí, e os instrumentos dos moços foram santos, ainda que a jornada seja comum; quanto mais que hoje haverá outro pão santificado nos vasos.
verses.RVR09: Y David respondió al sacerdote, y díjole: Cierto las mujeres nos han sido reservadas desde anteayer cuando salí, y los vasos de los mozos fueron santos, aunque el camino es profano: cuanto más que hoy habrá otro pan santificado en los vasos.

verses.KJV: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the Lord, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
verses.WEB: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before the LORD, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
verses.ASV: So the priest gave him holy [bread]; for there was no bread there but the showbread, that was taken from before Jehovah, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o sacerdote lhe deu o pão sagrado, porque ali não havia outro pão que os pães da proposição, os quais haviam sido tirados de diante do SENHOR, para que se pusessem pães quentes o dia que os outros foram tirados.
verses.RVR09: Así el sacerdote le dió el pan sagrado, porque allí no había otro pan que los panes de la proposición, los cuales habían sido quitados de delante de Jehová, para que se pusiesen panes calientes el día que los otros fueron quitados.

verses.KJV: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.
verses.WEB: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.
verses.ASV: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Jehovah; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chiefest of the herdsmen that belonged to Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele dia estava ali um dos servos de Saul detido diante do SENHOR, o nome do qual era Doegue, edomita, principal dos pastores de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Aquel día estaba allí uno de los siervos de Saúl detenido delante de Jehová, el nombre del cual era Doeg, Idumeo, principal de los pastores de Saúl.

verses.KJV: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste.
verses.WEB: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn’t there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven’t brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.”
verses.ASV: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thy hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi disse a Aimeleque: Não tens aqui à mão lança ou espada? Porque não tomei em minha mão minha espada nem minhas armas, porquanto o mandamento do rei era urgente.
verses.RVR09: Y David dijo á Ahimelech: ¿No tienes aquí á mano lanza ó espada? porque no tomé en mi mano mi espada ni mis armas, por cuanto el mandamiento del rey era apremiante.

verses.KJV: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.
verses.WEB: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you would like to take that, take it, for there is no other except that here.” David said, “There is none like that. Give it to me.”
verses.ASV: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the vale of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it; for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote respondeu: A espada de Golias o filisteu, que tu venceste no vale de Elá, está aqui embrulhada em um véu detrás do éfode: se tu queres tomá-la, toma-a: porque aqui não há outra a não ser essa. E disse Davi: Nenhuma como ela: dá-a a mim.
verses.RVR09: Y el sacerdote respondió: La espada de Goliath el Filisteo, que tú venciste en el valle del Alcornoque, está aquí envuelta en un velo detrás del ephod: si tú quieres tomarla, tómala: porque aquí no hay otra sino esa. Y dijo David: Ninguna como ella: dámela.

verses.KJV: And David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.WEB: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.ASV: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando-se Davi aquele dia, fugiu da presença de Saul, e veio a Aquis rei de Gate.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose David aquel día, huyó de la presencia de Saúl, y vínose á Achîs rey de Gath.

verses.KJV: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
verses.WEB: The servants of Achish said to him, “Isn’t this David the king of the land? Didn’t they sing to one another about him in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”
verses.ASV: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os servos de Aquis lhe disseram: Não é este Davi, o rei da terra? Não é este a quem cantavam em danças, dizendo: Feriu Saul seus milhares, E Davi seus dez milhares?
verses.RVR09: Y los siervos de Achîs le dijeron: ¿No es éste David, el rey de la tierra? ¿no es éste á quien cantaban en corros, diciendo: Hirió Saúl sus miles, y David sus diez miles?

verses.KJV: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.WEB: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.ASV: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi pôs em seu coração estas palavras, e teve grande temor de Aquis rei de Gate.
verses.RVR09: Y David puso en su corazón estas palabras, y tuvo gran temor de Achîs rey de Gath.

verses.KJV: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.
verses.WEB: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands, and scribbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.
verses.ASV: And he changed his behavior before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mudou sua fala diante deles, e fingiu-se de louco entre suas mãos, e riscava nas entradas das portas, deixando escorrer sua saliva por sua barba.
verses.RVR09: Y mudó su habla delante de ellos, y fingióse loco entre sus manos, y escribía en las portadas de las puertas, dejando correr su saliva por su barba.

verses.KJV: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?
verses.WEB: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?
verses.ASV: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad; wherefore then have ye brought him to me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Aquis a seus servos: Eis que estais vendo um homem demente; por que o trouxestes a mim?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Achîs á sus siervos: He aquí estáis viendo un hombre demente; ¿por qué lo habéis traído á mí?

verses.KJV: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
verses.WEB: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”
verses.ASV: Do I lack madmen, that ye have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
verses.ALMEIDA: Faltam a mim loucos, para que trouxésseis este que fizesse de louco diante de mim? havia de vir este à minha casa?
verses.RVR09: ¿Fáltanme á mí locos, para que hayáis traído éste que hiciese del loco delante de mí? ¿había de venir éste á mi casa?

verses.KJV: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.
verses.WEB: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.
verses.ASV: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave of Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father’s house heard it, they went down thither to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo-se Davi dali escapou-se à cova de Adulão; o qual quando ouviram seus irmãos e toda a casa de seu pai, vieram ali a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y YÉNDOSE David de allí escapóse á la cueva de Adullam; lo cual como oyeron sus hermanos y toda la casa de su padre, vinieron allí á él.

verses.KJV: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.
verses.WEB: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.
verses.ASV: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntaram-se com ele todos os afligidos, e todo aquele que estava endividado, e todos os que se achavam em amargura de espírito, e foi feito capitão deles: e teve consigo como quatrocentos homens.
verses.RVR09: Y juntáronse con él todos los afligidos, y todo el que estaba adeudado, y todos los que se hallaban en amargura de espíritu, y fué hecho capitán de ellos: y tuvo consigo como cuatrocientos hombres.

verses.KJV: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
verses.WEB: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out to you, until I know what God will do for me.”
verses.ASV: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, [and be] with you, till I know what God will do for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi-se Davi dali a Mispá de Moabe, e disse ao rei de Moabe: Eu te rogo que meu pai e minha mãe estejam convosco, até que saiba o que Deus fará de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y fuése David de allí á Mizpa de Moab, y dijo al rey de Moab: Yo te ruego que mi padre y mi madre estén con vosotros, hasta que sepa lo que Dios hará de mí.

verses.KJV: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.
verses.WEB: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
verses.ASV: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the stronghold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trouxe-os, pois, à presença do rei de Moabe, e habitaram com ele todo aquele tempo que Davi esteve na fortaleza.
verses.RVR09: Trájolos pues á la presencia del rey de Moab, y habitaron con él todo el tiempo que David estuvo en la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
verses.WEB: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.” Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.
verses.ASV: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the stronghold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gade profeta disse a Davi: Não fiques nesta fortaleza, parte-te, e vai-te à terra de Judá. E Davi se partiu, e veio ao bosque de Herete.
verses.RVR09: Y Gad profeta dijo á David: No te estés en esta fortaleza, pártete, y vete á tierra de Judá. Y David se partió, y vino al bosque de Hareth.

verses.KJV: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)
verses.WEB: Saul heard that David was discovered, with the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.
verses.ASV: And Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him: now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk-tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu Saul como havia aparecido Davi, e os que estavam com ele. Estava então Saul em Gibeá debaixo de uma árvore em Ramá, e tinha sua lança em sua mão, e todos os seus criados estavam em derredor dele.
verses.RVR09: Y oyó Saúl como había parecido David, y los que estaban con él. Estaba entonces Saúl en Gabaa debajo de un árbol en Rama, y tenía su lanza en su mano, y todos sus criados estaban en derredor de él.

verses.KJV: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;
verses.WEB: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?
verses.ASV: And Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds,
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Saul a seus criados que estavam em derredor dele: Ouvi agora, filhos de Benjamim: O filho de Jessé também dará a todos vós terras e vinhas, e vos fará a todos comandantes de mim e comandantes de cem,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Saúl á sus criados que estaban en derredor de él: Oid ahora, hijos de Benjamín: ¿Os dará también á todos vosotros el hijo de Isaí tierras y viñas, y os hará á todos tribunos y centuriones;

verses.KJV: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.WEB: Is that why all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”
verses.ASV: that all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that discloseth to me when my son maketh a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or discloseth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que todos vós conspirastes contra mim, e não há quem me revele ao ouvido como meu filho fez aliança com o filho de Jessé, nem alguém de vós que se condoa de mim, e me revele como meu filho levantou meu servo contra mim, para que me prepare ciladas, como ele hoje faz?
verses.RVR09: Que todos vosotros habéis conspirado contra mí, y no hay quien me descubra al oído como mi hijo ha hecho alianza con el hijo de Isaí, ni alguno de vosotros que se duela de mí, y me descubra como mi hijo ha levantado á mi siervo contra mí, para que me aceche, según hace hoy día?

verses.KJV: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.WEB: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.ASV: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Doegue edomita, que era superior entre os servos de Saul, respondeu e disse: Eu vi ao filho de Jessé que veio a Nobe, a Aimeleque filho de Aitube;
verses.RVR09: Entonces Doeg Idumeo, que era superior entre los siervos de Saúl, respondió y dijo: Yo vi al hijo de Isaí que vino á Nob, á Ahimelech hijo de Ahitob;

verses.KJV: And he enquired of the Lord for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
verses.WEB: He inquired of the LORD for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”
verses.ASV: And he inquired of Jehovah for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual consultou por ele ao SENHOR, e deu-lhe provisão, e também lhe deu a espada de Golias o filisteu.
verses.RVR09: El cual consultó por él á Jehová, y dióle provisión, y también le dió la espada de Goliath el Filisteo.

verses.KJV: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
verses.WEB: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.
verses.ASV: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei enviou pelo sacerdote Aimeleque filho de Aitube, e por toda a casa de seu pai, os sacerdotes que estavam em Nobe: e todos vieram ao rei.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey envió por el sacerdote Ahimelech hijo de Ahitob, y por toda la casa de su padre, los sacerdotes que estaban en Nob: y todos vinieron al rey.

verses.KJV: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
verses.WEB: Saul said, “Hear now, you son of Ahitub.” He answered, “Here I am, my lord.”
verses.ASV: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul lhe disse: Ouve agora, filho de Aitube. E ele disse: Eis-me aqui, senhor meu.
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl le dijo: Oye ahora, hijo de Ahitob. Y él dijo: Heme aquí, señor mío.

verses.KJV: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.WEB: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”
verses.ASV: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Saul: Por que conspirastes contra mim, tu e o filho de Jessé, quando tu lhe deste pão e espada, e consultaste por ele a Deus, para que se levantasse contra mim e me armasse cilada, como o faz hoje dia?
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Saúl: ¿Por qué habéis conspirado contra mí, tú y el hijo de Isaí, cuando tú le diste pan y espada, y consultaste por él á Dios, para que se levantase contra mí y me acechase, como lo hace hoy día?

verses.KJV: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king's son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?
verses.WEB: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, captain of your body guard, and honored in your house?
verses.ASV: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who among all thy servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, and is taken into thy council, and is honorable in thy house?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Aimeleque respondeu ao rei, e disse: E quem entre todos teus servos é tão fiel como Davi, genro também do rei, e que vai por teu mandado, e é ilustre em tua casa?
verses.RVR09: Entonces Ahimelech respondió al rey, y dijo: ¿Y quién entre todos tus siervos es tan fiel como David, yerno además del rey, y que va por tu mandado, y es ilustre en tu casa?

verses.KJV: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.
verses.WEB: Have I today begun to inquire of God for him? Be it far from me! Don’t let the king impute anything to his servant, nor to all the house of my father; for your servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.”
verses.ASV: Have I to-day begun to inquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute anything unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father; for thy servant knoweth nothing of all this, less or more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Comecei eu desde hoje a consultar por ele a Deus? Longe seja de mim: não impute o rei coisa alguma a seu servo, nem a toda a casa de meu pai; porque teu servo nenhuma coisa sabe deste negócio, grande nem pequena.
verses.RVR09: ¿He comenzado yo desde hoy á consultar por él á Dios? lejos sea de mí: no impute el rey cosa alguna á su siervo, ni á toda la casa de mi padre; porque tu siervo ninguna cosa sabe de este negocio, grande ni chica.

verses.KJV: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.
verses.WEB: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house.”
verses.ASV: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse: Sem dúvida morrerás, Aimeleque, tu e toda a casa de teu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey dijo: Sin duda morirás, Ahimelech, tú y toda la casa de tu padre.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the Lord: because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The king said to the guard who stood about him, “Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled and didn’t disclose it to me.” But the servants of the king wouldn’t put out their hand to fall on the priests of the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the king said unto the guard that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of Jehovah; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled, and did not disclose it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse o rei à gente de sua guarda que estava ao redor dele: Voltai-vos e matai aos sacerdotes do SENHOR; porque também a mão deles é com Davi, pois sabendo eles que fugia, não o revelaram a mim. Mas os servos do rei não quiseram estender suas mãos para matar os sacerdotes do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo el rey á la gente de su guardia que estaba alrededor de él: Cercad y matad á los sacerdotes de Jehová; porque también la mano de ellos es con David, pues sabiendo ellos que huía, no me lo descubrieron. Mas los siervos del rey no quisieron extender sus manos para matar á los sacerdotes de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
verses.WEB: The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.
verses.ASV: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and he slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse o rei a Doegue: Volta tu, e arremete contra os sacerdotes. E revolvendo-se Doegue edomita, arremeteu contra os sacerdotes, e matou naquele dia oitenta e cinco homens que vestiam éfode de linho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo el rey á Doeg: Vuelve tú, y arremete contra los sacerdotes. Y revolviéndose Doeg Idumeo, arremetió contra los sacerdotes, y mató en aquel día ochenta y cinco varones que vestían ephod de lino.

verses.KJV: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
verses.WEB: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword—both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle, donkeys, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
verses.ASV: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen and asses and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Nobe, cidade dos sacerdotes, pôs à espada: tanto a homens como a mulheres, meninos e mamantes, bois e asnos e ovelhas, tudo à espada.
verses.RVR09: Y á Nob, ciudad de los sacerdotes, puso á cuchillo: así á hombres como á mujeres, niños y mamantes, bueyes y asnos y ovejas, todo á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
verses.WEB: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
verses.ASV: And one of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas um dos filhos de Aimeleque filho de Aitube, que se chamava Abiatar, escapou, e fugiu-se a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Mas uno de los hijos de Ahimelech hijo de Ahitob, que se llamaba Abiathar, escapó, y huyóse á David.

verses.KJV: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the Lord's priests.
verses.WEB: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain the LORD’s priests.
verses.ASV: And Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Jehovah’s priests.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abiatar noticiou a Davi como Saul havia matado os sacerdotes do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Abiathar notició á David como Saúl había muerto los sacerdotes de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father's house.
verses.WEB: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father’s house.
verses.ASV: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned [the death] of all the persons of thy father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi a Abiatar: Eu sabia que estando ali aquele dia Doegue o edomita, ele o havia de fazer saber a Saul. Eu dei ocasião contra todas as pessoas da casa de teu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David á Abiathar: Yo sabía que estando allí aquel día Doeg el Idumeo, él lo había de hacer saber á Saúl. Yo he dado ocasión contra todas las personas de la casa de tu padre.

verses.KJV: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
verses.WEB: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. You will be safe with me.”
verses.ASV: Abide thou with me, fear not; for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: for with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fica-te comigo, não temas: quem buscar minha vida, buscará também a tua: bem que comigo tu estarás seguro.
verses.RVR09: Quédate conmigo, no temas: quien buscare mi vida, buscará también la tuya: bien que tú estarás conmigo guardado.

verses.KJV: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.
verses.WEB: David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”
verses.ASV: And they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing-floors.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram aviso a Davi, dizendo: Eis que os filisteus combatem a Queila, e roubam as eiras.
verses.RVR09: Y DIERON aviso á David, diciendo: He aquí que los Filisteos combaten á Keila, y roban las eras.

verses.KJV: Therefore David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the Lord said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.
verses.WEB: Therefore David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?” The LORD said to David, “Go strike the Philistines, and save Keilah.”
verses.ASV: Therefore David inquired of Jehovah, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And Jehovah said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi consultou ao SENHOR, dizendo: Irei a ferir a estes filisteus? E o SENHOR respondeu a Davi: Vai, fere aos filisteus, e livra a Queila.
verses.RVR09: Y David consultó á Jehová, diciendo: ¿Iré á herir á estos Filisteos? Y Jehová respondió á David: Ve, hiere á los Filisteos, y libra á Keila.

verses.KJV: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
verses.WEB: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”
verses.ASV: And David’s men said unto him, Behold, we are afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os que estavam com Davi lhe disseram: Eis que nós aqui em Judá estamos com medo; quanto mais se formos a Queila contra o exército dos filisteus?
verses.RVR09: Mas los que estaban con David le dijeron: He aquí que nosotros aquí en Judá estamos con miedo; ¿cuánto más si fuéremos á Keila contra el ejército de los Filisteos?

verses.KJV: Then David enquired of the Lord yet again. And the Lord answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.WEB: Then David inquired of the LORD yet again. The LORD answered him, and said, “Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
verses.ASV: Then David inquired of Jehovah yet again. And Jehovah answered him, and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi voltou a consultar ao SENHOR. E o SENHOR lhe respondeu, e disse: Levanta-te, desce a Queila, que eu entregarei em tuas mãos aos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David volvió á consultar á Jehová. Y Jehová le respondió, y dijo: Levántate, desciende á Keila, que yo entregaré en tus manos á los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.WEB: David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their livestock, and killed them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.ASV: And David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and slew them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Partiu-se, pois Davi com seus homens a Queila, e lutou contra os filisteus, e tomou seus gados, e feriu-os com grande estrago: e livrou Davi aos de Queila.
verses.RVR09: Partióse pues David con sus hombres á Keila, y peleó contra los Filisteos, y trajo antecogidos sus ganados, é hiriólos con grande estrago: y libró David á los de Keila.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.WEB: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, fugindo Abiatar filho de Aimeleque a Davi a Queila, veio também com ele o éfode.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, huyendo Abiathar hijo de Ahimelech á David á Keila, vino también con él el ephod.

verses.KJV: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.
verses.WEB: Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.”
verses.ASV: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into my hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dito a Saul que Davi havia vindo a Queila. Então disse Saul: Deus o trouxe a minhas mãos; porque ele está escondido, havendo-se posto em cidade com portas e fechaduras.
verses.RVR09: Y fué dicho á Saúl que David había venido á Keila. Entonces dijo Saúl: Dios lo ha traído á mis manos; porque él está encerrado, habiéndose metido en ciudad con puertas y cerraduras.

verses.KJV: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
verses.WEB: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.
verses.ASV: And Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E convocou Saul todo aquele povo à batalha, para descer a Queila, e pôr cerco a Davi e aos seus.
verses.RVR09: Y convocó Saúl todo el pueblo á la batalla, para descender á Keila, y poner cerco á David y á los suyos.

verses.KJV: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
verses.WEB: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him. He said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”
verses.ASV: And David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas entendendo Davi que Saul planejava o mal contra ele, disse a Abiatar sacerdote: Traze o éfode.
verses.RVR09: Mas entendiendo David que Saúl ideaba el mal contra él, dijo á Abiathar sacerdote: Trae el ephod.

verses.KJV: Then said David, O Lord God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.
verses.WEB: Then David said, “O LORD, the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.
verses.ASV: Then said David, O Jehovah, the God of Israel, thy servant hath surely heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi: o SENHOR Deus de Israel, teu servo tem entendido que Saul trata de vir contra Queila, a destruir a cidade por causa minha.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David: Jehová Dios de Israel, tu siervo tiene entendido que Saúl trata de venir contra Keila, á destruir la ciudad por causa mía.

verses.KJV: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O Lord God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the Lord said, He will come down.
verses.WEB: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? LORD, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.” The LORD said, “He will come down.”
verses.ASV: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O Jehovah, the God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And Jehovah said, He will come down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os vizinhos de Queila me entregarão em suas mãos? Descerá Saul, como teu servo tem ouvido? O SENHOR Deus de Israel, rogo-te que o declares a teu servo. E o SENHOR disse: Sim, descerá.
verses.RVR09: ¿Me entregarán los vecinos de Keila en sus manos? ¿descenderá Saúl, como tu siervo tiene oído? Jehová Dios de Israel, ruégote que lo declares á tu siervo. Y Jehová dijo: Sí, descenderá.

verses.KJV: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the Lord said, They will deliver thee up.
verses.WEB: Then David said, “Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?” The LORD said, “They will deliver you up.”
verses.ASV: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver up me and my men into the hand of Saul? And Jehovah said, They will deliver thee up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse logo Davi: Os vizinhos de Queila entregarão a mim e a meus homens em mãos de Saul? E o SENHOR respondeu: Eles te entregarão.
verses.RVR09: Dijo luego David: ¿Me entregarán los vecinos de Keila á mí y á mis hombres en manos de Saúl? Y Jehová respondió: Te entregarán.

verses.KJV: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.
verses.WEB: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go. Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah; and he gave up going there.
verses.ASV: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Davi então se levantou com seus homens, que eram como seiscentos, e sairam de Queila, e foram-se de uma parte à outra. E veio a nova a Saul de como Davi se havia escapado de Queila; e deixou de sair.
verses.RVR09: David entonces se levantó con sus hombres, que eran como seiscientos, y saliéronse de Keila, y fuéronse de una parte á otra. Y vino la nueva á Saúl de como David se había escapado de Keila; y dejó de salir.

verses.KJV: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.
verses.WEB: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.
verses.ASV: And David abode in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill-country in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi se estava no deserto em penhas, e habitava em um monte no deserto de Zife; e Saul o buscava todos os dias, mas Deus não o entregou em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y David se estaba en el desierto en peñas, y habitaba en un monte en el desierto de Ziph; y buscábalo Saúl todos los días, mas Dios no lo entregó en sus manos.

verses.KJV: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.
verses.WEB: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods.
verses.ASV: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vendo, pois, Davi que Saul havia saído em busca de sua alma, estava-se ele no bosque no deserto de Zife.
verses.RVR09: Viendo pues David que Saúl había salido en busca de su alma, estábase él en el bosque en el desierto de Ziph.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
verses.WEB: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se levantou Jônatas filho de Saul, e veio a Davi no bosque, e confortou sua mão em Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se levantó Jonathán hijo de Saúl, y vino á David en el bosque, y confortó su mano en Dios.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Fear not; for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe: Não temas, porque a mão de meu pai Saul não te achará, e tu reinarás sobre Israel, e eu serei segundo depois de ti; e ainda Saul meu pai assim o sabe.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole: No temas, que no te hallará la mano de Saúl mi padre, y tú reinarás sobre Israel, y yo seré segundo después de ti; y aun Saúl mi padre así lo sabe.

verses.KJV: And they two made a covenant before the Lord: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
verses.WEB: They both made a covenant before the LORD. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.
verses.ASV: And they two made a covenant before Jehovah: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entre ambos fizeram aliança diante do SENHOR: e Davi se ficou no bosque, e Jônatas se voltou à sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y entrambos hicieron alianza delante de Jehová: y David se quedó en el bosque, y Jonathán se volvió á su casa.

verses.KJV: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?
verses.WEB: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?
verses.ASV: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiram os de Zife a dizer a Saul em Gibeá: Não está Davi escondido em nossa terra nas penhas do bosque, no morro de Haquilá que está à direita do deserto?
verses.RVR09: Y subieron los de Ziph á decir á Saúl en Gabaa: ¿No está David escondido en nuestra tierra en las peñas del bosque, en el collado de Hachîla que está á la mano derecha del desierto?

verses.KJV: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king's hand.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king’s hand.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore, O king, come down, according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him up into the king’s hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, rei, desce agora logo, segundo todo aquele desejo de tua alma, e nós o entregaremos na mão do rei.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, rey, desciende ahora presto, según todo el deseo de tu alma, y nosotros lo entregaremos en la mano del rey.

verses.KJV: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the Lord; for ye have compassion on me.
verses.WEB: Saul said, “You are blessed by the LORD, for you have had compassion on me.
verses.ASV: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of Jehovah; for ye have had compassion on me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul disse: Benditos sejais vós do SENHOR, que haveis tido compaixão de mim:
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl dijo: Benditos seáis vosotros de Jehová, que habéis tenido compasión de mí:

verses.KJV: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.
verses.WEB: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there; for I have been told that he is very cunning.
verses.ASV: Go, I pray you, make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, [and] who hath seen him there; for it is told me that he dealeth very subtly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ide, pois, agora, preparai ainda, considerai e vede seu lugar por onde ele passa, e quem o tenha visto ali; porque se me disse que ele é em grande maneira astuto.
verses.RVR09: Id pues ahora, apercibid aún, considerad y ved su lugar donde tiene el pie, y quién lo haya visto allí; porque se me ha dicho que él es en gran manera astuto.

verses.KJV: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.
verses.WEB: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”
verses.ASV: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking-places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me of a certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Considerai, pois, e vede todos os esconderijos de onde se oculta, e voltai a mim com a certeza, e eu irei convosco: que se ele estiver na terra, eu lhe buscarei entre todos os milhares de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Considerad pues, y ved todos los escondrijos donde se oculta, y volved á mí con la certidumbre, y yo iré con vosotros: que si él estuviere en la tierra, yo le buscaré entre todos los millares de Judá.

verses.KJV: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
verses.WEB: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
verses.ASV: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles se levantaram, e se foram a Zife diante de Saul. Mas Davi e sua gente estavam no deserto de Maom, na planície que está à direita do deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos se levantaron, y se fueron á Ziph delante de Saúl. Mas David y su gente estaban en el desierto de Maón, en la llanura que está á la diestra del desierto.

verses.KJV: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David; wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.WEB: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.ASV: And Saul and his men went to seek him. And they told David: wherefore he came down to the rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard [that], he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiu-se Saul com sua gente a buscá-lo; mas foi dado aviso a Davi, e desceu à penha, e ficou no deserto de Maom. O qual quando Saul ouviu, seguiu a Davi ao deserto de Maom.
verses.RVR09: Y partióse Saúl con su gente á buscarlo; pero fué dado aviso á David, y descendió á la peña, y quedóse en el desierto de Maón. Lo cual como Saúl oyó, siguió á David al desierto de Maón.

verses.KJV: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.
verses.WEB: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul, for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.
verses.ASV: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul ia pelo um lado do monte, e Davi com os seus pelo outro lado do monte: e apressava-se Davi para ir adiante de Saul; mas Saul e os seus haviam cercado a Davi e à sua gente para tomá-los.
verses.RVR09: Y Saúl iba por el un lado del monte, y David con los suyos por el otro lado del monte: y dábase priesa David para ir delante de Saúl; mas Saúl y los suyos habían encerrado á David y á su gente para tomarlos.

verses.KJV: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
verses.WEB: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!”
verses.ASV: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have made a raid upon the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio um mensageiro a Saul, dizendo: Vem logo, porque os filisteus fizeram uma invasão na terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces vino un mensajero á Saúl, diciendo: Ven luego, porque los Filisteos han hecho una irrupción en el país.

verses.KJV: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.
verses.WEB: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.
verses.ASV: So Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltou-se, portanto, Saul de perseguir a Davi, e partiu contra os filisteus. Por esta causa puseram a aquele lugar por nome Selá-Hamalecote.
verses.RVR09: Volvióse por tanto Saúl de perseguir á David, y partió contra los Filisteos. Por esta causa pusieron á aquel lugar por nombre Sela-hammah-lecoth.

verses.KJV: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.
verses.WEB: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.
verses.ASV: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in the strongholds of En-gedi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi subiu dali, e habitou nos lugares fortes em En-Gedi.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.
verses.WEB: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Saul voltou dos filisteus, deram-lhe aviso dizendo: Eis que Davi está no deserto de En-Gedi.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES David subió de allí, y habitó en los parajes fuertes en Engaddi.

verses.KJV: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
verses.WEB: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.
verses.ASV: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando Saul três mil homens escolhidos de todo Israel, foi em busca de Davi e dos seus, pelos cumes dos penhascos das cabras montesas.
verses.RVR09: Y como Saúl volvió de los Filisteos, diéronle aviso diciendo: He aquí que David está en el desierto de Engaddi.

verses.KJV: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.
verses.WEB: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.
verses.ASV: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet. Now David and his men were abiding in the innermost parts of the cave.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegou a uma malhada de ovelhas no caminho, de onde havia uma cova, entrou Saul nela para fazer necessidade; e Davi e os seus estavam aos lados da cova.
verses.RVR09: Y tomando Saúl tres mil hombres escogidos de todo Israel, fué en busca de David y de los suyos, por las cumbres de los peñascos de las cabras monteses.

verses.KJV: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the Lord said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.
verses.WEB: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which the LORD said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.
verses.ASV: And the men of David said unto him, Behold, the day of which Jehovah said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thy hand, and thou shalt do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os de Davi lhe disseram: Eis que o dia que te disse o SENHOR: Eis que entregou tu inimigo em tuas mãos, e farás com ele como te parecer. E levantou-se Davi, e caladamente cortou a beira do manto de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Y como llegó á una majada de ovejas en el camino, donde había una cueva, entró Saúl en ella á cubrir sus pies: y David y los suyos estaban á los lados de la cueva.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.
verses.WEB: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois do qual o coração de Davi lhe golpeava, porque havia cortado a beira do manto de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los de David le dijeron: He aquí el día de que te ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que entrego tu enemigo en tus manos, y harás con él como te pareciere. Y levantóse David, y calladamente cortó la orilla del manto de Saúl.

verses.KJV: And he said unto his men, The Lord forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the Lord's anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord.
verses.WEB: He said to his men, “The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto his men, Jehovah forbid that I should do this thing unto my lord, Jehovah’s anointed, to put forth my hand against him, seeing he is Jehovah’s anointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse aos seus: o SENHOR me guarde de fazer tal coisa contra meu senhor, o ungido do SENHOR, que eu estenda minha mão contra ele; porque é o ungido do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Después de lo cual el corazón de David le golpeaba, porque había cortado la orilla del manto de Saúl.

verses.KJV: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
verses.WEB: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
verses.ASV: So David checked his men with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. And Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Davi conteve os seus com palavras, e não lhes permitiu que se levantassem contra Saul. E Saul, saindo da cova, foi-se seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á los suyos: Jehová me guarde de hacer tal cosa contra mi señor, el ungido de Jehová, que yo extienda mi mano contra él; porque es el ungido de Jehová.

verses.KJV: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.
verses.WEB: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.
verses.ASV: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and did obeisance.
