verses.KJV: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the Lord: and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.WEB: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.ASV: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Jehovah: and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vieram, pois, todos os anciãos de Israel ao rei em Hebrom, e o rei Davi fez com eles aliança em Hebrom diante do SENHOR; e ungiram a Davi por rei sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: Vinieron pues todos los ancianos de Israel al rey en Hebrón, y el rey David hizo con ellos alianza en Hebrón delante de Jehová; y ungieron á David por rey sobre Israel.

verses.KJV: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.WEB: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.ASV: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Era Davi de trinta anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Era David de treinta años cuando comenzó á reinar, y reinó cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.WEB: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.ASV: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months; and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em Hebrom reinou sobre Judá sete anos e seis meses: e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos sobre todo Israel e Judá.
verses.RVR09: En Hebrón reinó sobre Judá siete años y seis meses: y en Jerusalem reinó treinta y tres años sobre todo Israel y Judá.

verses.KJV: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
verses.WEB: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”
verses.ASV: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither; thinking, David cannot come in hither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei e os seus foram a Jerusalém aos jebuseus que habitavam na terra; os qual falaram a Davi, dizendo: Tu não entrarás aqui, a não ser que consigas expulsar aos cegos e aos coxos; e pensavam: Davi não entrará aqui.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey y los suyos fueron á Jerusalem al Jebuseo que habitaba en la tierra; el cual habló á David, diciendo: Tú no entrarás acá, si no echares los ciegos y los cojos; diciendo: No entrará acá David.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion; the same is the city of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Davi tomou a fortaleza de Sião, a qual é a cidade de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Empero David tomó la fortaleza de Sión, la cual es la ciudad de David.

verses.KJV: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
verses.WEB: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”
verses.ASV: And David said on that day, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites, let him get up to the watercourse, and [smite] the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul. Wherefore they say, There are the blind and the lame; he cannot come into the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi aquele dia: Quem chegará até os canais, e ferirá ao jebuseu, e aos coxos e cegos, aos quais a alma de Davi aborrece? Por isto se disse: Cego nem coxo não entrará em casa.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David aquel día: ¿Quién llegará hasta las canales, y herirá al Jebuseo, y á los cojos y ciegos, á los cuales el alma de David aborrece? Por esto se dijo: Ciego ni cojo no entrará en casa.

verses.KJV: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
verses.WEB: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.
verses.ASV: And David dwelt in the stronghold, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi morou na fortaleza e pôs-lhe por nome a Cidade de Davi: e edificou ao redor, desde Milo para dentro.
verses.RVR09: Y David moró en la fortaleza, y púsole por nombre la Ciudad de David: y edificó alrededor, desde Millo para adentro.

verses.KJV: And David went on, and grew great, and the Lord God of hosts was with him.
verses.WEB: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD, the God of Armies, was with him.
verses.ASV: And David waxed greater and greater; for Jehovah, the God of hosts, was with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi ia crescendo e aumentando-se, e o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos era com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y David iba creciendo y aumentándose, y Jehová Dios de los ejércitos era con él.

verses.KJV: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
verses.WEB: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.
verses.ASV: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar-trees, and carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hirão rei de Tiro enviou também embaixadores a Davi, e madeira de cedro, e carpinteiros, e pedreiros para os muros, os quais edificaram a casa de Davi.
verses.RVR09: E Hiram rey de Tiro envió también embajadores á David, y madera de cedro, y carpinteros, y canteros para los muros, los cuales edificaron la casa de David.

verses.KJV: And David perceived that the Lord had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.
verses.WEB: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
verses.ASV: And David perceived that Jehovah had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entendeu Davi que o SENHOR lhe havia confirmado por rei sobre Israel, e que havia exaltado seu reino por causa de seu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y entendió David que Jehová le había confirmado por rey sobre Israel, y que había ensalzado su reino por amor de su pueblo Israel.

verses.KJV: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
verses.WEB: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.
verses.ASV: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron; and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Davi mais concubinas e mulheres de Jerusalém depois que veio de Hebrom, e nasceram-lhe mais filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó David más concubinas y mujeres de Jerusalem después que vino de Hebrón, y naciéronle más hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.WEB: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.ASV: And these are the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os nomes dos que lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Samua, e Sobabe, e Natã, e Salomão,
verses.RVR09: Estos son los nombres de los que le nacieron en Jerusalem: Sammua, y Sobab, y Nathán, y Salomón,

verses.KJV: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.WEB: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.ASV: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ibar, e Elisua, e Nefegue,
verses.RVR09: E Ibhar, y Elisua, y Nepheg,

verses.KJV: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.WEB: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.ASV: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jafia, e Elisama, e Eliada, e Elifelete.
verses.RVR09: Y Japhia, y Elisama, y Eliada, y Eliphelet.

verses.KJV: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.
verses.WEB: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.
verses.ASV: And when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the stronghold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo os filisteus que haviam ungido a Davi por rei sobre Israel, todos os filisteus subiram a buscar a Davi: o qual quando Davi ouviu, veio à fortaleza.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo los Filisteos que habían ungido á David por rey sobre Israel, todos los Filisteos subieron á buscar á David: lo cual como David oyó, vino á la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.WEB: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ASV: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram os filisteus, e estenderam-se pelo vale de Refaim.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron los Filisteos, y extendiéronse por el valle de Raphaim.

verses.KJV: And David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.WEB: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
verses.ASV: And David inquired of Jehovah, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into my hand? And Jehovah said unto David, Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então consultou Davi ao SENHOR, dizendo: Irei contra os filisteus? os entregarás em minhas mãos? E o SENHOR respondeu a Davi: Vai, porque certamente entregarei os filisteus em tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces consultó David á Jehová, diciendo: ¿Iré contra los Filisteos? ¿los entregarás en mis manos? Y Jehová respondió á David: Ve, porque ciertamente entregaré los Filisteos en tus manos.

verses.KJV: And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and said, The Lord hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim.
verses.WEB: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “The LORD has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
verses.ASV: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there; and he said, Jehovah hath broken mine enemies before me, like the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Davi a Baal-Perazim, e ali os venceu Davi, e disse: O SENHOR rompeu meus inimigos diante de mim, como o romper das águas. E por isto chamou o nome daquele lugar Baal-Perazim.
verses.RVR09: Y vino David á Baal-perasim, y allí los venció David, y dijo: Rompió Jehová mis enemigos delante de mí, como quien rompe aguas. Y por esto llamó el nombre de aquel lugar Baal-perasim.

verses.KJV: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
verses.WEB: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.
verses.ASV: And they left their images there; and David and his men took them away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deixaram ali seus ídolos, os quais queimou Davi e os seus.
verses.RVR09: Y dejaron allí sus ídolos, los cuales quemó David y los suyos.

verses.KJV: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.WEB: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ASV: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filisteus voltaram a vir, e estenderam-se no vale de Refaim.
verses.RVR09: Y los Filisteos tornaron á venir, y extendiéronse en el valle de Raphaim.

verses.KJV: And when David enquired of the Lord, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.WEB: When David inquired of the LORD, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.
verses.ASV: And when David inquired of Jehovah, he said, Thou shalt not go up: make a circuit behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry-trees.
verses.ALMEIDA: E consultando Davi ao SENHOR, ele lhe respondeu: Não subas; mas rodeia-os, e virás a eles por diante das amoreiras:
verses.RVR09: Y consultando David á Jehová, él le respondió: No subas; mas rodéalos, y vendrás á ellos por delante de los morales:

verses.KJV: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the Lord go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.WEB: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then the LORD has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
verses.ASV: And it shall be, when thou hearest the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself; for then is Jehovah gone out before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ouvires um estrondo que irá pelas copas das amoreiras, então te moverás; porque o SENHOR sairá diante de ti a ferir o acampamento dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando oyeres un estruendo que irá por las copas de los morales, entonces te moverás; porque Jehová saldrá delante de ti á herir el campo de los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: And David did so, as the Lord had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
verses.WEB: David did so, as the LORD commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
verses.ASV: And David did so, as Jehovah commanded him, and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gezer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi o fez assim como o SENHOR havia lhe mandado; e feriu aos filisteus desde Gibeá até chegar a Gaza.
verses.RVR09: Y David lo hizo así, como Jehová se lo había mandado; é hirió á los Filisteos desde Gabaa hasta llegar á Gaza.

verses.KJV: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.WEB: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.ASV: And David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi voltou a juntar todos os escolhidos de Israel, trinta mil.
verses.RVR09: Y DAVID tornó á juntar todos los escogidos de Israel, treinta mil.

verses.KJV: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the Lord of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.
verses.WEB: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of the LORD of Armies who sits above the cherubim.
verses.ASV: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him, from Baale-judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, which is called by the Name, even the name of Jehovah of hosts that sitteth [above] the cherubim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se Davi, e foi com todo o povo que tinha consigo, de Baal de Judá, para fazer passar dali a arca de Deus, sobre a qual era invocado o nome do SENHOR dos exércitos, que mora nela entre os querubins.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse David, y fué con todo el pueblo que tenía consigo, de Baal de Judá, para hacer pasar de allí el arca de Dios, sobre la cual era invocado el nombre de Jehová de los ejércitos, que mora en ella entre los querubines.

verses.KJV: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
verses.WEB: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
verses.ASV: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in the hill: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram a arca de Deus sobre um carro novo, e levaram-na da casa de Abinadabe, que estava em Gibeá: e Uzá e Aiô, filhos de Abinadabe, guiavam o carro novo.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron el arca de Dios sobre un carro nuevo, y lleváronla de la casa de Abinadab, que estaba en Gabaa: y Uzza y Ahio, hijos de Abinadab, guiaban el carro nuevo.

verses.KJV: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.WEB: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.ASV: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was in the hill, with the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o levavam da casa de Abinadabe que estava em Gibeá, com a arca de Deus, Aiô ia diante da arca.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando lo llevaban de la casa de Abinadab que estaba en Gabaa, con el arca de Dios, Ahio iba delante del arca.

verses.KJV: And David and all the house of Israel played before the Lord on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.
verses.WEB: David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.
verses.ASV: And David and all the house of Israel played before Jehovah with all manner of [instruments made of] fir-wood, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with castanets, and with cymbals.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi e toda a casa de Israel dançavam diante do SENHOR com toda sorte de instrumentos de madeira de faia; com harpas, saltérios, adufes, flautas e címbalos.
verses.RVR09: Y David y toda la casa de Israel danzaban delante de Jehová con toda suerte de instrumentos de madera de haya; con arpas, salterios, adufes, flautas y címbalos.

verses.KJV: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.
verses.WEB: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.
verses.ASV: And when they came to the threshing-floor of Nacon, Uzzah put forth [his hand] to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegaram à eira de Nacom, Uzá estendeu a mão à arca de Deus, e segurou-a; porque os bois a sacudiam.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando llegaron á la era de Nachôn, Uzza extendió la mano al arca de Dios, y túvola; porque los bueyes daban sacudidas.

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.
verses.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o furor do SENHOR se acendeu contra Uzá, e feriu-o ali Deus por aquela imprudência, e caiu ali morto junto à arca de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y el furor de Jehová se encendió contra Uzza, é hiriólo allí Dios por aquella temeridad, y cayó allí muerto junto al arca de Dios.

verses.KJV: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.
verses.WEB: David was displeased because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.
verses.ASV: And David was displeased, because Jehovah had broken forth upon Uzzah; and he called that place Perez-uzzah, unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entristeceu-se Davi por o SENHOR ter ferido a Uzá: e foi chamado aquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y entristecióse David por haber herido Jehová á Uzza: y fué llamado aquel lugar Pérez-uzza, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And David was afraid of the Lord that day, and said, How shall the ark of the Lord come to me?
verses.WEB: David was afraid of the LORD that day; and he said, “How could the LORD’s ark come to me?”
verses.ASV: And David was afraid of Jehovah that day; and he said, How shall the ark of Jehovah come unto me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E temendo Davi ao SENHOR aquele dia, disse: Como há de vir a mim a arca do SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Y temiendo David á Jehová aquel día, dijo: ¿Cómo ha de venir á mí el arca de Jehová?

verses.KJV: So David would not remove the ark of the Lord unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
verses.WEB: So David would not move the LORD’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
verses.ASV: So David would not remove the ark of Jehovah unto him into the city of David; but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não quis, pois, Davi trazer a si a arca do SENHOR à cidade de Davi; mas levou-a Davi à casa de Obede-Edom geteu.
verses.RVR09: No quiso pues David traer á sí el arca de Jehová á la ciudad de David; mas llevóla David á casa de Obed-edom Getheo.

verses.KJV: And the ark of the Lord continued in the house of Obededom the Gittite three months: and the Lord blessed Obededom, and all his household.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.
verses.ASV: And the ark of Jehovah remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months: and Jehovah blessed Obed-edom, and all his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a arca do SENHOR esteve na casa de Obede-Edom geteu três meses: e abençoou o SENHOR a Obede-Edom e a toda sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y estuvo el arca de Jehová en casa de Obed-edom Getheo tres meses: y bendijo Jehová á Obed-edom y á toda su casa.

verses.KJV: And it was told king David, saying, The Lord hath blessed the house of Obededom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obededom into the city of David with gladness.
verses.WEB: King David was told, “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.
verses.ASV: And it was told king David, saying, Jehovah hath blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. And David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dado aviso ao rei Davi, dizendo: o SENHOR abençoou a casa de Obede-Edom, e tudo o que tem, por causa da arca de Deus. Então Davi foi, e trouxe a arca de Deus de casa de Obede-Edom à cidade de Davi com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Y fué dado aviso al rey David, diciendo: Jehová ha bendecido la casa de Obed-edom, y todo lo que tiene, á causa del arca de Dios. Entonces David fué, y trajo el arca de Dios de casa de Obed-edom á la ciudad de David con alegría.

verses.KJV: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the Lord had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
verses.WEB: When those who bore the LORD’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
verses.ASV: And it was so, that, when they that bare the ark of Jehovah had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os que levavam a arca de Deus haviam andado seis desfiladeiros, sacrificavam um boi e um carneiro gordo.
verses.RVR09: Y como los que llevaban el arca de Dios habían andado seis pasos, sacrificaban un buey y un carnero grueso.

verses.KJV: And David danced before the Lord with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.
verses.WEB: David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.
verses.ASV: And David danced before Jehovah with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi saltava com toda sua força diante do SENHOR; e tinha vestido Davi um éfode de linho.
verses.RVR09: Y David saltaba con toda su fuerza delante de Jehová; y tenía vestido David un ephod de lino.

verses.KJV: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.WEB: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the LORD’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.ASV: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of Jehovah with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Davi e toda a casa de Israel levavam a arca do SENHOR com júbilo e som de trombeta.
verses.RVR09: Así David y toda la casa de Israel llevaban el arca de Jehová con júbilo y sonido de trompeta.

verses.KJV: And as the ark of the Lord came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the Lord; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.WEB: As the LORD’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.ASV: And it was so, as the ark of Jehovah came into the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before Jehovah; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando a arca do SENHOR chegou à cidade de Davi, aconteceu que Mical filha de Saul olhou desde uma janela, e viu ao rei Davi que saltava com toda sua força diante do SENHOR: e menosprezou-lhe em seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y como el arca de Jehová llegó á la ciudad de David, aconteció que Michâl hija de Saúl miró desde una ventana, y vió al rey David que saltaba con toda su fuerza delante de Jehová: y menosprecióle en su corazón.

verses.KJV: And they brought in the ark of the Lord, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.
verses.WEB: They brought in the LORD’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And they brought in the ark of Jehovah, and set it in its place, in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meteram, pois, a arca do SENHOR, e puseram-na em seu lugar em meio de uma tenda que Davi lhe havia estendido: e sacrificou Davi holocaustos e pacíficos diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Metieron pues el arca de Jehová, y pusiéronla en su lugar en medio de una tienda que David le había tendido: y sacrificó David holocaustos y pacíficos delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Davi acabou de oferecer os holocaustos e pacíficos, abençoou ao povo no nome do SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Y como David hubo acabado de ofrecer los holocaustos y pacíficos, bendijo al pueblo en el nombre de Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.
verses.WEB: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.
verses.ASV: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to every one a cake of bread, and a portion [of flesh], and a cake of raisins. So all the people departed every one to his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E repartiu a todo aquele povo, e a toda a multidão de Israel, tanto a homens como a mulheres, a cada um uma torta de pão, e um pedaço de carne, e um frasco de vinho. E foi-se todo aquele povo, cada um à sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y repartió á todo el pueblo, y á toda la multitud de Israel, así á hombres como á mujeres, á cada uno una torta de pan, y un pedazo de carne, y un frasco de vino. Y fuése todo el pueblo, cada uno á su casa.

verses.KJV: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
verses.WEB: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”
verses.ASV: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to-day, who uncovered himself to-day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltou logo Davi para abençoar sua casa: e saindo Mical a receber a Davi, disse: Quão honrado foi hoje o rei de Israel, desnudando-se hoje diante das criadas de seus servos, como se desnudasse um vulgar!
verses.RVR09: Volvió luego David para bendecir su casa: y saliendo Michâl á recibir á David, dijo: ¡Cuán honrado ha sido hoy el rey de Israel, desnudándose hoy delante de las criadas de sus siervos, como se desnudara un juglar!

verses.KJV: And David said unto Michal, It was before the Lord, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the Lord, over Israel: therefore will I play before the Lord.
verses.WEB: David said to Michal, “It was before the LORD, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of the LORD, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And David said unto Michal, [It was] before Jehovah, who chose me above thy father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of Jehovah, over Israel: therefore will I play before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi respondeu a Mical: Diante do SENHOR, que me preferiu a teu pai e a toda sua casa, mandando-me que fosse príncipe sobre o povo do SENHOR, sobre Israel, dançarei diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David respondió á Michâl: Delante de Jehová, que me eligió más bien que á tu padre y á toda su casa, mandándome que fuese príncipe sobre el pueblo de Jehová, sobre Israel, danzaré delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
verses.WEB: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”
verses.ASV: And I will be yet more vile than this, and will be base in mine own sight: but of the handmaids of whom thou hast spoken, of them shall I be had in honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda me farei mais vil que esta vez, e serei baixo em meus próprios olhos; e diante das criadas que disseste, diante delas serei honrado.
verses.RVR09: Y aun me haré más vil que esta vez, y seré bajo á mis propios ojos; y delante de las criadas que dijiste, delante de ellas seré honrado.

verses.KJV: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.
verses.WEB: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.
verses.ASV: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Mical filha de Saul nunca teve filhos até o dia de sua morte.
verses.RVR09: Y Michâl hija de Saúl nunca tuvo hijos hasta el día de su muerte.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the Lord had given him rest round about from all his enemies;
verses.WEB: When the king lived in his house, and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies all around,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the king dwelt in his house, and Jehovah had given him rest from all his enemies round about,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, estando já o rei assentado em sua casa, depois que o SENHOR lhe havia dado repouso de todos os seus inimigos em derredor,
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que, estando ya el rey asentado en su casa, después que Jehová le había dado reposo de todos sus enemigos en derredor,

verses.KJV: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.
verses.WEB: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”
verses.ASV: that the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse o rei ao profeta Natã: Olha agora, eu moro em edifícios de cedro, e a arca de Deus está entre cortinas.
verses.RVR09: Dijo el rey al profeta Nathán: Mira ahora, yo moro en edificios de cedro, y el arca de Dios está entre cortinas.

verses.KJV: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the Lord is with thee.
verses.WEB: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.”
verses.ASV: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thy heart; for Jehovah is with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Natã disse ao rei: Anda, e faze tudo o que está em teu coração, que o SENHOR é contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y Nathán dijo al rey: Anda, y haz todo lo que está en tu corazón, que Jehová es contigo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the Lord came unto Nathan, saying,
verses.WEB: That same night, the LORD’s word came to Nathan, saying,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of Jehovah came unto Nathan, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu aquela noite, que veio a palavra do SENHOR a Natã, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció aquella noche, que fué palabra de Jehová á Nathán, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the Lord, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?
verses.WEB: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘The LORD says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?
verses.ASV: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith Jehovah, Shalt thou build me a house for me to dwell in?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai e dize a meu servo Davi: Assim disse o SENHOR: Tu me edificarás casa em que eu more?
verses.RVR09: Ve y di á mi siervo David: Así ha dicho Jehová: ¿Tú me has de edificar casa en que yo more?

verses.KJV: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.WEB: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.ASV: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente não habitei em casas desde o dia que tirei aos filhos de Israel do Egito até hoje, mas sim que andei em tenda e em tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente no he habitado en casas desde el día que saqué á los hijos de Israel de Egipto hasta hoy, sino que anduve en tienda y en tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?
verses.WEB: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
verses.ASV: In all places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel, spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, Why have ye not built me a house of cedar?
verses.ALMEIDA: E em tudo quanto andei com todos os filhos de Israel, falei palavra em alguma das tribos de Israel, a quem tenha mandado que apascente meu povo de Israel, para dizer: Por que não me edificastes casa de cedros?
verses.RVR09: Y en todo cuanto he andado con todos los hijos de Israel, ¿he hablado palabra en alguna de las tribus de Israel, á quien haya mandado que apaciente mi pueblo de Israel, para decir: ¿Por qué no me habéis edificado casa de cedros?

verses.KJV: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
verses.WEB: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.
verses.ASV: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be prince over my people, over Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, dirás assim a meu servo Davi: Assim disse o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eu te tomei da malhada, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses príncipe sobre meu povo, sobre Israel;
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, dirás así á mi siervo David: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Yo te tomé de la majada, de detrás de las ovejas, para que fueses príncipe sobre mi pueblo, sobre Israel;

verses.KJV: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.WEB: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
verses.ASV: and I have been with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee; and I will make thee a great name, like unto the name of the great ones that are in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fui contigo em tudo quanto andaste, e diante de ti exterminei todos teus inimigos, e te fiz nome grande, como o nome dos grandes que são na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y he sido contigo en todo cuanto has andado, y delante de ti he talado todos tus enemigos, y te he hecho nombre grande, como el nombre de los grandes que son en la tierra.

verses.KJV: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,
verses.WEB: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,
verses.ASV: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as at the first,
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, eu fixarei lugar a meu povo Israel; eu o plantarei, para que habite em seu lugar, e nunca mais seja removido, nem os iníquos lhe aflijam mais, como antes,
verses.RVR09: Además yo fijaré lugar á mi pueblo Israel, yo lo plantaré, para que habite en su lugar, y nunca más sea removido, ni los inicuos le aflijan más, como antes,

verses.KJV: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the Lord telleth thee that he will make thee an house.
verses.WEB: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover the LORD tells you that the LORD will make you a house.
verses.ASV: and [as] from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel; and I will cause thee to rest from all thine enemies. Moreover Jehovah telleth thee that Jehovah will make thee a house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o dia que pus juízes sobre meu povo Israel; e eu te darei descanso de todos teus inimigos. Também o SENHOR te faz saber, que ele te quer fazer casa.
verses.RVR09: Desde el día que puse jueces sobre mi pueblo Israel; y yo te daré descanso de todos tus enemigos. Asimismo Jehová te hace saber, que él te quiere hacer casa.

verses.KJV: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.WEB: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.ASV: When thy days are fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, that shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando teus dias forem cumpridos, e descansares com teus pais, eu establecerei tua semente depois de ti, a qual procederá de tuas entranhas, e assegurarei seu reino.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando tus días fueren cumplidos, y durmieres con tus padres, yo estableceré tu simiente después de ti, la cual procederá de tus entrañas, y aseguraré su reino.

verses.KJV: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
verses.WEB: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
verses.ASV: He shall build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele edificará casa a meu nome, e eu afirmarei para sempre o trono de seu reino.
verses.RVR09: El edificará casa á mi nombre, y yo afirmaré para siempre el trono de su reino.

verses.KJV: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
verses.WEB: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;
verses.ASV: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: if he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu serei a ele pai, e ele me será filho. E se ele fizer mal, eu lhe castigarei com vara de homens, e com açoites de filhos de homens;
verses.RVR09: Yo le seré á él padre, y él me será á mí hijo. Y si él hiciere mal, yo le castigaré con vara de hombres, y con azotes de hijos de hombres;

verses.KJV: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.
verses.WEB: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.
verses.ASV: but my lovingkindness shall not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não removerei minha misericórdia dele, como a removi de Saul, ao qual tirei de diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Empero mi misericordia no se apartará de él, como la aparté de Saúl, al cual quité de delante de ti.

verses.KJV: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
verses.WEB: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”
verses.ASV: And thy house and thy kingdom shall be made sure for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será firmada tua casa e teu reino para sempre diante de teu rosto; e teu trono será estável eternamente.
verses.RVR09: Y será afirmada tu casa y tu reino para siempre delante de tu rostro; y tu trono será estable eternalmente.

verses.KJV: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.WEB: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.
verses.ASV: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme todas estas palavras, e conforme toda esta visão, assim falou Natã a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á todas estas palabras, y conforme á toda esta visión, así habló Nathán á David.

verses.KJV: Then went king David in, and sat before the Lord, and he said, Who am I, O Lord God? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.WEB: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
verses.ASV: Then David the king went in, and sat before Jehovah; and he said, Who am I, O Lord Jehovah, and what is my house, that thou hast brought me thus far?
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrou o rei Davi, e pôs-se diante do SENHOR, e disse: Senhor DEUS, Quem sou eu, e que é minha casa, para que tu me tragas até aqui?
verses.RVR09: Y entró el rey David, y púsose delante de Jehová, y dijo: Señor Jehová, ¿quién soy yo, y qué es mi casa, para que tú me traigas hasta aquí?

verses.KJV: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord God; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord God?
verses.WEB: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord GOD, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord GOD!
verses.ASV: And this was yet a small thing in thine eyes, O Lord Jehovah; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant’s house for a great while to come; and this [too] after the manner of men, O Lord Jehovah!
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda te pareceu pouco isto, Senhor DEUS, pois que também falaste da casa de teu servo no porvir. É esse o modo de agir do homem, Senhor DEUS?
verses.RVR09: Y aun te ha parecido poco esto, Señor Jehová, pues que también has hablado de la casa de tu siervo en lo por venir. ¿Es ése el modo de obrar del hombre, Señor Jehová?

verses.KJV: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord God, knowest thy servant.
verses.WEB: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou knowest thy servant, O Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que mais pode acrescentar Davi falando contigo? Tu, pois, conheces teu servo, Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y qué más puede añadir David hablando contigo? Tú pues conoces tu siervo, Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.
verses.WEB: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.
verses.ASV: For thy word’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou wrought all this greatness, to make thy servant know it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas estas grandezas operaste por tua palavra e conforme teu coração, fazendo-as saber a teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Todas estas grandezas has obrado por tu palabra y conforme á tu corazón, haciéndolas saber á tu siervo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore thou art great, O Lord God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.WEB: Therefore you are great, LORD God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.ASV: Wherefore thou art great, O Jehovah God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God besides thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto tu te engrandeceste, SENHOR Deus: porquanto não há como tu, nem há Deus além de ti, conforme tudo o que ouvimos com nossos ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto tú te has engrandecido, Jehová Dios: por cuanto no hay como tú, ni hay Dios fuera de ti, conforme á todo lo que hemos oído con nuestros oídos.

verses.KJV: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
verses.WEB: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
verses.ASV: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem unto himself for a people, and to make him a name, and to do great things for you, and terrible things for thy land, before thy people, whom thou redeemedst to thee out of Egypt, [from] the nations and their gods?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quem como teu povo, como Israel, na terra? Uma gente por causa da qual Deus fosse a resgatá-la por povo, e lhe pusesse nome, e fizesse por vós, ó Israel, grandes e espantosas obras em tua terra, por causa de teu povo, ó Deus, que tu resgataste do Egito, das nações e de seus deuses?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y quién como tu pueblo, como Israel, en la tierra? una gente por amor de la cual Dios fuese á redimírsela por pueblo, y le pusiese nombre, é hiciese por vosotros, oh Israel, grandes y espantosas obras en tu tierra, por amor de tu pueblo, oh Dios, que tú redimiste de Egipto, de las gentes y de sus dioses?

verses.KJV: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, Lord, art become their God.
verses.WEB: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.
verses.ASV: And thou didst establish to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever; and thou, Jehovah, becamest their God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu confirmaste a ti teu povo Israel por povo teu para sempre: e tu, ó SENHOR, foste a eles por Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú te has confirmado á tu pueblo Israel por pueblo tuyo para siempre: y tú, oh Jehová, fuiste á ellos por Dios.

verses.KJV: And now, O Lord God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.WEB: “Now, LORD God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.
verses.ASV: And now, O Jehovah God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, confirm thou it for ever, and do as thou hast spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, SENHOR Deus, a palavra que falaste sobre teu servo e sobre sua casa, desperta-a para sempre, e faze conforme o que disseste.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Jehová Dios, la palabra que has hablado sobre tu siervo y sobre su casa, despiértala para siempre, y haz conforme á lo que has dicho.

verses.KJV: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.
verses.WEB: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’
verses.ASV: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, Jehovah of hosts is God over Israel; and the house of thy servant David shall be established before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que seja engrandecido teu nome para sempre, e diga-se: o SENHOR dos exércitos é Deus sobre Israel; e que a casa de teu servo Davi seja firme diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Que sea engrandecido tu nombre para siempre, y dígase: Jehová de los ejércitos es Dios sobre Israel; y que la casa de tu siervo David sea firme delante de ti.

verses.KJV: For thou, O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
verses.WEB: For you, LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.
verses.ASV: For thou, O Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee a house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu, SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, revelaste ao ouvido de teu servo, dizendo: Eu te edificarei casa. Por isto teu servo achou em seu coração para fazer diante de ti esta súplica.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, revelaste al oído de tu siervo, diciendo: Yo te edificaré casa. Por esto tu siervo ha hallado en su corazón para hacer delante de ti esta súplica.

verses.KJV: And now, O Lord God, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.WEB: “Now, O Lord GOD, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.
verses.ASV: And now, O Lord Jehovah, thou art God, and thy words are truth, and thou hast promised this good thing unto thy servant:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, SENHOR Deus, tu és Deus, e tuas palavras serão firmes, já que disseste a teu servo este bem.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Jehová Dios, tú eres Dios, y tus palabras serán firmes, ya que has dicho á tu siervo este bien.

verses.KJV: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord God, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord GOD, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”
verses.ASV: now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee; for thou, O Lord Jehovah, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agrada-te, pois, de abençoar a casa de teu servo, para que perpetuamente permaneça diante de ti: pois que tu, SENHOR Deus, o disseste, e com tua bênção será bendita a casa de teu servo para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Tenlo pues ahora á bien, y bendice la casa de tu siervo, para que perpetuamente permanezca delante de ti: pues que tú, Jehová Dios, lo has dicho, y con tu bendición será bendita la casa de tu siervo para siempre.

verses.KJV: And after this it came to pass that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.WEB: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.ASV: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto aconteceu, que Davi feriu aos filisteus, e os humilhou: e tomou Davi a Metegue-Ama da mão dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS de esto aconteció, que David hirió á los Filisteos, y los humilló: y tomó David á Methegamma de mano de los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
verses.WEB: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
verses.ASV: And he smote Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. And the Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
verses.ALMEIDA: Feriu também aos de Moabe, e mediu-os com cordel, fazendo-os lançar por terra; e mediu com dois cordéis para morte, e um cordel inteiro para vida; e foram os moabitas servos debaixo de tributo.
verses.RVR09: Hirió también á los de Moab, y midiólos con cordel, haciéndolos echar por tierra; y midió con dos cordeles para muerte, y un cordel entero para vida; y fueron los Moabitas siervos debajo de tributo.

verses.KJV: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
verses.WEB: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
verses.ASV: David smote also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também feriu Davi a Hadadezer filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá, indo ele a estender seu termo até o rio de Eufrates.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo hirió David á Hadad-ezer hijo de Rehob, rey de Soba, yendo él á extender su término hasta el río de Eufrates.

verses.KJV: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
verses.WEB: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.
verses.ASV: And David took from him a thousand and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David hocked all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for a hundred chariots.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Davi deles mil e setecentos cavaleiros, e vinte mil homens a pé; e aleijou Davi os cavalos de todos os carros, exceto cem carros deles que deixou.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó David de ellos mil y setecientos de á caballo, y veinte mil hombres de á pie; y desjarretó David los caballos de todos los carros, excepto cien carros de ellos que dejó.

verses.KJV: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.WEB: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.
verses.ASV: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succor Hadadezer king of Zobah, David smote of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram os sírios de Damasco a dar ajuda a Hadadezer rei de Zobá; e Davi feriu dos sírios vinte e dois mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron los Siros de Damasco á dar ayuda á Hadad-ezer rey de Soba; y David hirió de los Siros veinte y dos mil hombres.

verses.KJV: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.WEB: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.ASV: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. And Jehovah gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pôs logo Davi guarnição em Síria a de Damasco, e foram os sírios servos de Davi sujeitos a tributo. E o SENHOR guardou a Davi de onde quer que fosse.
verses.RVR09: Puso luego David guarnición en Siria la de Damasco, y fueron los Siros siervos de David sujetos á tributo. Y Jehová guardó á David donde quiera que fué.

verses.KJV: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Davi os escudos de ouro que traziam os servos de Hadadezer, e levou-os a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó David los escudos de oro que traían los siervos de Hadad-ezer, y llevólos á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
verses.WEB: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
verses.ASV: And from Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também de Betá e de Beerote, cidades de Hadadezer, tomou o rei Davi grande quantidade de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo de Beta y de Beeroth, ciudades de Hadad-ezer, tomó el rey David gran copia de metal.

verses.KJV: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
verses.WEB: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,
verses.ASV: And when Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ouvindo Toí, rei de Hamate, que Davi havia ferido todo aquele exército de Hadadezer,
verses.RVR09: Entonces oyendo Toi, rey de Hamath, que David había herido todo el ejército de Hadad-ezer,

verses.KJV: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
verses.WEB: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.
verses.ASV: then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And [Joram] brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviou Toí a Jorão seu filho ao rei Davi, a saudar-lhe pacificamente e a bendizer-lhe, porque havia lutado com Hadadezer e o havia vencido: porque Toí era inimigo de Hadadezer. E Jorão levava em sua mão vasos de prata, e vasos de ouro, e de bronze;
verses.RVR09: Envió Toi á Joram su hijo al rey David, á saludarle pacíficamente y á bendecirle, porque había peleado con Hadad-ezer y lo había vencido: porque Toi era enemigo de Hadad-ezer. Y Joram llevaba en su mano vasos de plata, y vasos de oro, y de metal;

verses.KJV: Which also king David did dedicate unto the Lord, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
verses.WEB: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—
verses.ASV: these also did king David dedicate unto Jehovah, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais o rei Davi dedicou ao SENHOR, com a prata e o ouro que tinha dedicado de todas as nações que havia submetido:
verses.RVR09: Los cuales el rey David dedicó á Jehová, con la plata y el oro que tenía dedicado de todas las naciones que había sometido:

verses.KJV: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.WEB: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.ASV: of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos sírios, dos moabitas, dos amonitas, dos filisteus, dos amalequitas, e do despojo de Hadadezer filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá.
verses.RVR09: De los Siros, de los Moabitas, de los Ammonitas, de los Filisteos, de los Amalecitas, y del despojo de Hadad-ezer hijo de Rehob, rey de Soba.

verses.KJV: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.
verses.WEB: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.
verses.ASV: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting the Syrians in the Valley of Salt, even eighteen thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ganhou Davi fama quando, voltando da derrota dos sírios, feriu dezoito mil homens no vale do sal.
verses.RVR09: Y ganó David fama cuando, volviendo de la rota de los Siros, hirió diez y ocho mil hombres en el valle de la sal.

verses.KJV: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.WEB: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.ASV: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And Jehovah gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs guarnição em Edom, por toda Edom pôs guarnição; e todos os edomitas foram servos de Davi. E o SENHOR guardou a Davi por de onde quer que fosse.
verses.RVR09: Y puso guarnición en Edom, por toda Edom puso guarnición; y todos los Idumeos fueron siervos de David. Y Jehová guardó á David por donde quiera que fué.

verses.KJV: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.
verses.WEB: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
verses.ASV: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness unto all his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reinou Davi sobre todo Israel; e fazia Davi direito e justiça a todo seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y reinó David sobre todo Israel; y hacía David derecho y justicia á todo su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.WEB: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
verses.ASV: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joabe filho de Zeruia era general de seu exército; e Josafá filho de Ailude, chanceler;
verses.RVR09: Y Joab hijo de Sarvia era general de su ejército; y Josaphat hijo de Ahilud, canciller;

verses.KJV: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
verses.WEB: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,
verses.ASV: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Seraiah was scribe;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zadoque filho de Aitube, e Aimeleque filho de Abiatar, eram sacerdotes; e Seraías era escriba;
verses.RVR09: Y Sadoc hijo de Ahitud, y Ahimelech hijo de Abiathar, eran sacerdotes; y Seraía era escriba;

verses.KJV: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.
verses.WEB: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
verses.ASV: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada [was over] the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Benaia filho de Joiada, era sobre os quereteus e peleteus; e os filhos de Davi eram os príncipes.
verses.RVR09: Y Benahía hijo de Joiada, era sobre los Ceretheos y Peletheos; y los hijos de David eran los príncipes.

verses.KJV: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?
verses.WEB: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”
verses.ASV: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi: Restou algum da casa de Saul, a quem faça eu misericórdia por causa de Jônatas?
verses.RVR09: Y DIJO David: ¿Ha quedado alguno de la casa de Saúl, á quien haga yo misericordia por amor de Jonathán?

verses.KJV: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.
verses.WEB: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”
verses.ASV: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him unto David; and the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia um servo da casa de Saul, que se chamava Ziba, ao qual quando chamaram que viesse a Davi, o rei lhe disse: És tu Ziba? E ele respondeu: Teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y había un siervo de la casa de Saúl, que se llamaba Siba, al cual como llamaron que viniese á David, el rey le dijo: ¿Eres tú Siba? Y él respondió: Tu siervo.

verses.KJV: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.
verses.WEB: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”
verses.ASV: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may show the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, who is lame of his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse: Não restou ninguém da casa de Saul, a quem faça eu misericórdia de Deus? E Ziba respondeu ao rei: Ainda restou um filho de Jônatas, aleijado dos pés.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey dijo: ¿No ha quedado nadie de la casa de Saúl, á quien haga yo misericordia de Dios? Y Siba respondió al rey: Aun ha quedado un hijo de Jonathán, lisiado de los pies.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.
verses.WEB: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”
verses.ASV: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei lhe disse: E esse onde está? E Ziba respondeu ao rei: Eis que, está em casa de Maquir filho de Amiel, em Lo-Debar.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey le dijo: ¿Y ése dónde está? Y Siba respondió al rey: He aquí, está en casa de Machîr hijo de Amiel, en Lodebar.

verses.KJV: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.
verses.WEB: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
verses.ASV: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo-debar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou o rei Davi, e tomou-o de casa de Maquir filho de Amiel, de Lo-Debar.
verses.RVR09: Y envió el rey David, y tomólo de casa de Machîr hijo de Amiel, de Lodebar.

verses.KJV: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!
verses.WEB: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”
verses.ASV: And Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came unto David, and fell on his face, and did obeisance. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold, thy servant!
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo Mefibosete, filho de Jônatas filho de Saul, a Davi, prostrou-se sobre seu rosto, e fez reverência. E disse Davi: Mefibosete. E ele respondeu: Eis aqui teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y venido Mephi-boseth, hijo de Jonathán hijo de Saúl, á David, postróse sobre su rostro, é hizo reverencia. Y dijo David: Mephi-boseth. Y él respondió: He aquí tu siervo.

verses.KJV: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
verses.WEB: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”
verses.ASV: And David said unto him, Fear not; for I will surely show thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Davi: Não tenhas temor, porque eu à verdade farei contigo misericórdia por causa de Jônatas teu pai, e te devolverei todas as terras de Saul teu pai; e tu comerás sempre pão à minha mesa.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole David: No tengas temor, porque yo á la verdad haré contigo misericordia por amor de Jonathán tu padre, y te haré volver todas las tierras de Saúl tu padre; y tú comerás siempre pan á mi mesa.

verses.KJV: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?
verses.WEB: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”
verses.ASV: And he did obeisance, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele inclinando-se, disse: Quem é teu servo, para que olhes a um cão morto como eu?
verses.RVR09: Y él inclinándose, dijo: ¿Quién es tu siervo, para que mires á un perro muerto como yo?

verses.KJV: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.
verses.WEB: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.
verses.ASV: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said unto him, All that pertained to Saul and to all his house have I given unto thy master’s son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei chamou a Ziba, servo de Saul, e disse-lhe: Tudo o que foi de Saul e de toda sua casa, eu o dei ao filho de teu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey llamó á Siba, siervo de Saúl, y díjole: Todo lo que fué de Saúl y de toda su casa, yo lo he dado al hijo de tu señor.

verses.KJV: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.WEB: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt till the land for him, thou, and thy sons, and thy servants; and thou shalt bring in [the fruits], that thy master’s son may have bread to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master’s son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu pois lhe lavrarás as terras, tu com teus filhos, e teus servos, e colherás os frutos, para que o filho de teu senhor tenha com que se manter; mas Mefibosete, o filho de teu senhor comerá sempre pão à minha mesa. E Ziba tinha quinze filhos e vinte servos.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues le labrarás las tierras, tú con tus hijos, y tus siervos, y encerrarás los frutos, para que el hijo de tu señor tenga con qué mantenerse; y Mephi-boseth el hijo de tu señor comerá siempre pan á mi mesa. Y tenía Siba quince hijos y veinte siervos.

verses.KJV: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.
verses.WEB: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.
verses.ASV: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king commandeth his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, [said the king], he shall eat at my table, as one of the king’s sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Ziba ao rei: Conforme tudo o que mandou meu senhor o rei a seu servo, assim teu servo o fará. Mefibosete, disse o rei, comerá à minha mesa, como um dos filhos do rei.
