verses.WEB: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.
verses.ASV: And she had a garment of divers colors upon her; for with such robes were the king’s daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinha ela sobre si uma roupa de cores, traje que as filhas virgens dos reis vestiam. Lançou-a, pois, fora seu criado, e fechou a porta atrás ela.
verses.RVR09: Y tenía ella sobre sí una ropa de colores, traje que las hijas vírgenes de los reyes vestían. Echóla pues fuera su criado, y cerró la puerta tras ella.

verses.KJV: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.
verses.WEB: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.
verses.ASV: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head, and went her way, crying aloud as she went.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Tamar tomou cinza, e espalhou-a sobre sua cabeça, e rasgou sua roupa de cores de que estava vestida, e postas suas mãos sobre sua cabeça, foi-se gritando.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Thamar tomó ceniza, y esparcióla sobre su cabeza, y rasgó la ropa de colores de que estaba vestida, y puestas sus manos sobre su cabeza, fuése gritando.

verses.KJV: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.
verses.WEB: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.
verses.ASV: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but now hold thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; take not this thing to heart. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe seu irmão Absalão: Esteve contigo teu irmão Amnom? Pois cala agora, irmã minha: teu irmão é; não ponhas teu coração neste negócio. E ficou Tamar desconsolada em casa de Absalão seu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole su hermano Absalom: ¿Ha estado contigo tu hermano Amnón? Pues calla ahora, hermana mía: tu hermano es; no pongas tu corazón en este negocio. Y quedóse Thamar desconsolada en casa de Absalom su hermano.

verses.KJV: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.
verses.WEB: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.
verses.ASV: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que o rei Davi ouviu tudo isto, foi muito irritado.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que el rey David oyó todo esto, fué muy enojado.

verses.KJV: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
verses.WEB: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
verses.ASV: And Absalom spake unto Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Absalão não falou com Amnom nem mal nem bem, ainda que Absalão aborrecesse a Amnom, porque havia forçado a Tamar sua irmã.
verses.RVR09: Mas Absalom no habló con Amnón ni malo ni bueno; bien que Absalom aborrecía á Amnón, porque había forzado á Thamar su hermana.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.
verses.WEB: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheep-shearers in Baal-hazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, passados dois anos, que Absalão tinha tosquiadores em Baal-Hazor, que está junto a Efraim; e convidou Absalão a todos os filhos do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció pasados dos años, que Absalom tenía esquiladores en Bala-hasor, que está junto á Ephraim; y convidó Absalom á todos los hijos del rey.

verses.KJV: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
verses.WEB: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”
verses.ASV: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheep-shearers; let the king, I pray thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Absalão ao rei, e disse-lhe: Eis que, teu servo tem agora tosquiadores: eu rogo que venha o rei e seus servos com teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Absalom al rey, y díjole: He aquí, tu siervo tiene ahora esquiladores: yo ruego que venga el rey y sus siervos con tu siervo.

verses.KJV: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.
verses.WEB: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.
verses.ASV: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all go, lest we be burdensome unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu o rei a Absalão: Não, filho meu, não vamos todos, para não sermos pesados a ti. E ainda que tenha insistido com ele, não quis ir, mas abençoou-o.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió el rey á Absalom: No, hijo mío, no vamos todos, porque no te hagamos costa. Y aunque porfió con él, no quiso ir, mas bendíjolo.

verses.KJV: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?
verses.WEB: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”
verses.ASV: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Absalão: Se não, rogo-te que venha conosco Amnom meu irmão. E o rei lhe respondeu: Para que há de ir contigo?
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Absalom: Si no, ruégote que venga con nosotros Amnón mi hermano. Y el rey le respondió: ¿Para qué ha de ir contigo?

verses.KJV: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.
verses.WEB: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
verses.ASV: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como Absalão o importunou, deixou ir com ele a Amnom e a todos os filhos do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y como Absalom lo importunase, dejó ir con él á Amnón y á todos los hijos del rey.

verses.KJV: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.
verses.WEB: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”
verses.ASV: And Absalom commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon, then kill him; fear not; have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia Absalão dado ordem a seus criados, dizendo: Agora bem, olhai quando o coração de Amnom estará alegre do vinho, e em dizendo-vos eu: Feri a Amnom, então matai-o, e não temais; que eu vos o mandei. Esforçai-vos, pois, e sede valentes.
verses.RVR09: Y había Absalom dado orden á sus criados, diciendo: Ahora bien, mirad cuándo el corazón de Amnón estará alegre del vino, y en diciéndoos yo, Herid á Amnón, entonces matadle, y no temáis; que yo os lo he mandado. Esforzaos pues, y sed valientes.

verses.KJV: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.
verses.WEB: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.
verses.ASV: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os criados de Absalão fizeram com Amnom como Absalão o havia mandado. Levantaram-se logo todos os filhos do rei, e subiram todos em seus mulos, e fugiram.
verses.RVR09: Y los criados de Absalom hicieron con Amnón como Absalom lo había mandado. Levantáronse luego todos los hijos del rey, y subieron todos en sus mulos, y huyeron.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.
verses.WEB: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that the tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando ainda eles no caminho, chegou a Davi o rumor que dizia: Absalão matou a todos os filhos do rei, que nenhum deles restou.
verses.RVR09: Y estando aún ellos en el camino, llegó á David el rumor que decía: Absalom ha muerto á todos los hijos del rey, que ninguno de ellos ha quedado.

verses.KJV: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
verses.WEB: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.
verses.ASV: Then the king arose, and rent his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então levantando-se Davi, rasgou suas roupas, e lançou-se em terra, e todos os seus criados, rasgados suas roupas, estavam adiante.
verses.RVR09: Entonces levantándose David, rasgó sus vestidos, y echóse en tierra, y todos sus criados, rasgados sus vestidos, estaban delante.

verses.KJV: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
verses.WEB: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
verses.ASV: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men the king’s sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jonadabe, filho de Simeia irmão de Davi, falou e disse: Não diga meu senhor que mataram a todos os jovens filhos do rei, que somente Amnom é morto: porque em boca de Absalão estava posto desde o dia que Amnom forçou a Tamar sua irmã.
verses.RVR09: Y Jonadab, hijo de Simea hermano de David, habló y dijo: No diga mi señor que han muerto á todos los jóvenes hijos del rey, que sólo Amnón es muerto: porque en boca de Absalom estaba puesto desde el día que Amnón forzó á Thamar su hermana.

verses.KJV: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
verses.WEB: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for Amnon only is dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, agora não ponha meu senhor o rei em seu coração essa voz que disse: Todos os filhos do rei foram mortos: porque somente Amnom é morto.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, ahora no ponga mi señor el rey en su corazón esa voz que dice: Todos los hijos del rey son muertos: porque sólo Amnón es muerto.

verses.KJV: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.
verses.WEB: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.
verses.ASV: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill-side behind him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Absalão fugiu logo. Entretanto, levantando seus olhos o jovem que estava de vigia olhou, e eis que muito povo vinha por detrás de si pelo caminho da lateral do monte.
verses.RVR09: Absalom huyó luego. Entre tanto, alzando sus ojos el mozo que estaba en atalaya, miró, y he aquí mucho pueblo que venía á sus espaldas por el camino de hacia el monte.

verses.KJV: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.
verses.WEB: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”
verses.ASV: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king’s sons are come: as thy servant said, so it is.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jonadabe ao rei: Eis ali os filhos do rei que vem: é assim como teu servo disse.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jonadab al rey: He allí los hijos del rey que vienen: es así como tu siervo ha dicho.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.
verses.WEB: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voice, and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele acabou de falar, eis que os filhos do rei que vieram, e levantando sua voz choraram. E também o mesmo rei e todos os seus servos choraram com muito grandes lamentos.
verses.RVR09: Y como él acabó de hablar, he aquí los hijos del rey que vinieron, y alzando su voz lloraron. Y también el mismo rey y todos sus siervos lloraron con muy grandes lamentos.

verses.KJV: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.
verses.WEB: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.
verses.ASV: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. And [David] mourned for his son every day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Absalão fugiu, e foi-se a Talmai filho de Amiur, rei de Gesur. E Davi chorava por seu filho todos os dias.
verses.RVR09: Mas Absalom huyó, y fuése á Talmai hijo de Amiud, rey de Gessur. Y David lloraba por su hijo todos los días.

verses.KJV: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
verses.WEB: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
verses.ASV: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que Absalão fugiu e se foi a Gesur, esteve ali três anos.
verses.RVR09: Y después que Absalom huyó y se fué á Gessur, estuvo allá tres años.

verses.KJV: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
verses.WEB: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.
verses.ASV: And [the soul of] king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Davi desejou ver a Absalão: porque já estava consolado acerca de Amnom que era morto.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey David deseó ver á Absalom: porque ya estaba consolado acerca de Amnón que era muerto.

verses.KJV: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.
verses.WEB: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.
verses.ASV: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E conhecendo Joabe, filho de Zeruia, que o coração do rei estava por Absalão,
verses.RVR09: Y CONOCIENDO Joab hijo de Sarvia, que el corazón del rey estaba por Absalom,

verses.KJV: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:
verses.WEB: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.
verses.ASV: And Joab sent to Tekoa, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on mourning apparel, I pray thee, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that hath a long time mourned for the dead:
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviou Joabe a Tecoa, e tomou dali uma mulher astuta, e disse-lhe: Eu te rogo que te enlutes, e te vistas de roupas de luto, e não te unjas com óleo, antes sê como mulher que há muito tempo que traze luto por algum morto;
verses.RVR09: Envió Joab á Tecoa, y tomó de allá una mujer astuta, y díjole: Yo te ruego que te enlutes, y te vistas de ropas de luto, y no te unjas con óleo, antes sé como mujer que ha mucho tiempo que trae luto por algún muerto;

verses.KJV: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.WEB: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.ASV: and go in to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrando ao rei, fala com ele desta maneira. E pôs Joabe as palavras em sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando al rey, habla con él de esta manera. Y puso Joab las palabras en su boca.

verses.KJV: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
verses.WEB: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”
verses.ASV: And when the woman of Tekoa spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entrou, pois, aquela mulher de Tecoa ao rei, e prostrando-se em terra sobre seu rosto fez reverência, e disse: Ó rei, socorre-me!
verses.RVR09: Entró pues aquella mujer de Tecoa al rey, y postrándose en tierra sobre su rostro hizo reverencia, y dijo: Oh rey, salva.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
verses.WEB: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
verses.ASV: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, Of a truth I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse: Que tens? E ela respondeu: Eu à verdade sou uma mulher viúva e meu marido é morto.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey le dijo: ¿Qué tienes? Y ella respondió: Yo á la verdad soy una mujer viuda y mi marido es muerto.

verses.KJV: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.
verses.WEB: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.
verses.ASV: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and killed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tua serva tinha dois filhos e os dois brigaram no campo; e não havendo quem os separasse, feriu o um à outra, e o matou.
verses.RVR09: Y tu sierva tenía dos hijos y los dos riñeron en el campo; y no habiendo quien los despartiese, hirió el uno al otro, y matólo.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.
verses.WEB: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”
verses.ASV: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thy handmaid, and they say, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he slew, and so destroy the heir also. Thus will they quench my coal which is left, and will leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que toda a parentela se levantou contra tua serva, dizendo: Entrega ao que matou a seu irmão, para que lhe façamos morrer pela vida de seu irmão a quem ele matou, e tiremos também o herdeiro. Assim apagarão a brasa que me restou, não deixaram a meu marido nome nem remanescente sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí toda la parentela se ha levantado contra tu sierva, diciendo: Entrega al que mató á su hermano, para que le hagamos morir por la vida de su hermano á quien él mató, y quitemos también el heredero. Así apagarán el ascua que me ha quedado, no dejando á mi marido nombre ni reliquia sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.
verses.WEB: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”
verses.ASV: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thy house, and I will give charge concerning thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei disse à mulher: Vai-te à tua casa, que eu mandarei acerca de ti.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey dijo á la mujer: Vete á tu casa, que yo mandaré acerca de ti.

verses.KJV: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.
verses.WEB: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
verses.ASV: And the woman of Tekoa said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and the king and his throne be guiltless.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher de Tecoa disse ao rei: Rei senhor meu, a maldade seja sobre mim e sobre a casa de meu pai; mas o rei e seu trono sem culpa.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer de Tecoa dijo al rey: Rey señor mío, la maldad sea sobre mí y sobre la casa de mi padre; mas el rey y su trono sin culpa.

verses.KJV: And the king said, Whoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
verses.WEB: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”
verses.ASV: And the king said, Whosoever saith aught unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse: Ao que falar contra ti, traze-o a mim, que não te tocará mais.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey dijo: Al que hablare contra ti, tráelo á mí, que no te tocará más.

verses.KJV: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the Lord thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the Lord liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.
verses.WEB: Then she said, “Please let the king remember the LORD your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As the LORD lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”
verses.ASV: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember Jehovah thy God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As Jehovah liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse ela então: Rogo-te, ó rei, que te lembres do SENHOR teu Deus, que não deixes ao vingador do sangue aumentar o dano em destruir meu filho. E ele respondeu: Vive o SENHOR, que não cairá nem um cabelo da cabeça de teu filho em terra.
verses.RVR09: Dijo ella entonces: Ruégote, oh rey, que te acuerdes de Jehová tu Dios, que no dejes á los cercanos de la sangre aumentar el daño con destruir á mi hijo. Y él respondió: Vive Jehová, que no caerá ni un cabello de la cabeza de tu hijo en tierra.

verses.KJV: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
verses.WEB: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”
verses.ASV: Then the woman said, Let thy handmaid, I pray thee, speak a word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher disse: Rogo-te que fale tua criada uma palavra a meu senhor o rei. E ele disse: Fala.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer dijo: Ruégote que hable tu criada una palabra á mi señor el rey. Y él dijo: Habla.

verses.KJV: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.
verses.WEB: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.
verses.ASV: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou devised such a thing against the people of God? for in speaking this word the king is as one that is guilty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a mulher disse: Por que pois pensas tu outro tanto contra o povo de Deus? que falando o rei esta palavra, é como culpado, porquanto o rei não faz voltar a seu fugitivo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la mujer dijo: ¿Por qué pues piensas tú otro tanto contra el pueblo de Dios? que hablando el rey esta palabra, es como culpado, por cuanto el rey no hace volver á su fugitivo.

verses.KJV: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.
verses.WEB: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.
verses.ASV: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God take away life, but deviseth means, that he that is banished be not an outcast from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque de certo morremos, e somos como águas derramadas por terra, que não podem voltar a recolher-se: nem Deus tira a vida, mas sim planeja meio para que seu desviado não seja dele excluído.
verses.RVR09: Porque de cierto morimos, y somos como aguas derramadas por tierra, que no pueden volver á recogerse: ni Dios quita la vida, sino que arbitra medio para que su desviado no sea de él excluído.

verses.KJV: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’
verses.ASV: Now therefore seeing that I am come to speak this word unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que eu vim agora para dizer isto ao rei meu senhor, é porque o povo me pôs medo. Mas tua serva disse: Falarei agora ao rei: talvez ele faça o que sua serva diga.
verses.RVR09: Y que yo he venido ahora para decir esto al rey mi señor, es porque el pueblo me ha puesto miedo. Mas tu sierva dijo: Hablaré ahora al rey: quizá él hará lo que su sierva diga.

verses.KJV: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
verses.WEB: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
verses.ASV: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o rei ouvirá, para livrar à sua serva da mão do homem que me quer exterminar a mim, e a meu filho juntamente, da propriedade de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Pues el rey oirá, para librar á su sierva de mano del hombre que me quiere raer á mí, y á mi hijo juntamente, de la heredad de Dios.

verses.KJV: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the Lord thy God will be with thee.
verses.WEB: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May the LORD, your God, be with you.’”
verses.ASV: Then thy handmaid said, Let, I pray thee, the word of my lord the king be comfortable; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: and Jehovah thy God be with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua serva, pois, disse: Que seja agora a resposta de meu senhor o rei para descanso; pois que meu senhor o rei é como um anjo de Deus para escutar o bem e o mal. Assim o SENHOR teu Deus seja contigo.
verses.RVR09: Tu sierva pues dice: Que sea ahora la respuesta de mi señor el rey para descanso; pues que mi señor el rey es como un ángel de Dios para escuchar lo bueno y lo malo. Así Jehová tu Dios sea contigo.

verses.KJV: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.
verses.WEB: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”
verses.ASV: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, aught that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele respondeu, e disse à mulher: Eu te rogo que não me encubras nada do que eu te perguntar. E a mulher disse: Fale meu senhor o rei.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él respondió, y dijo á la mujer: Yo te ruego que no me encubras nada de lo que yo te preguntare. Y la mujer dijo: Hable mi señor el rey.

verses.KJV: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:
verses.WEB: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.
verses.ASV: And the king said, Is the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from aught that my lord the king hath spoken; for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thy handmaid;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse: Não foi a mão de Joabe contigo em todas estas coisas? E a mulher respondeu e disse: Vive tua alma, rei senhor meu, que não há que desviar-se à direita nem à esquerda de tudo o que meu senhor o rei falou: porque teu servo Joabe, ele me mandou, e ele pôs na boca de tua serva todas estas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey dijo: ¿No ha sido la mano de Joab contigo en todas estas cosas? Y la mujer respondió y dijo: Vive tu alma, rey señor mío, que no hay que apartarse á derecha ni á izquierda de todo lo que mi señor el rey ha hablado: porque tu siervo Joab, él me mandó, y él puso en boca de tu sierva todas estas palabras;

verses.KJV: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.
verses.WEB: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.”
verses.ASV: to change the face of the matter hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joabe, teu servo o fez, modificando a aparência do assunto; mas meu senhor é sábio, conforme a sabedoria de um anjo de Deus, para conhecer o que há na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y que trocara la forma de las palabras, Joab tu siervo lo ha hecho: mas mi señor es sabio, conforme á la sabiduría de un ángel de Dios, para conocer lo que hay en la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.
verses.WEB: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”
verses.ASV: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom back.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei disse a Joabe: Eis que eu faço isto: vai, e faze voltar ao jovem Absalão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey dijo á Joab: He aquí yo hago esto: ve, y haz volver al mozo Absalom.

verses.KJV: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.
verses.WEB: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”
verses.ASV: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and did obeisance, and blessed the king; and Joab said, To-day thy servant knoweth that I have found favor in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath performed the request of his servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joabe se prostrou em terra sobre seu rosto, e fez reverência, e depois que abençoou ao rei, disse: Hoje há entendido teu servo que achei favor em teus olhos, rei senhor meu; pois que fez o rei o que seu servo disse.
verses.RVR09: Y Joab se postró en tierra sobre su rostro, é hizo reverencia, y después que bendijo al rey, dijo: Hoy ha entendido tu siervo que he hallado gracia en tus ojos, rey señor mío; pues que ha hecho el rey lo que su siervo ha dicho.

verses.KJV: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantou-se logo Joabe, e foi a Gesur, e voltou a Absalão a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Levantóse luego Joab, y fué á Gessur, y volvió á Absalom á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.
verses.WEB: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.
verses.ASV: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, but let him not see my face. So Absalom turned to his own house, and saw not the king’s face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o rei disse: Vá-se à sua casa, e não veja meu rosto. E voltou-se Absalão à sua casa, e não viu o rosto do rei.
verses.RVR09: Mas el rey dijo: Váyase á su casa, y no vea mi rostro. Y volvióse Absalom á su casa, y no vió el rostro del rey.

verses.KJV: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
verses.WEB: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.
verses.ASV: Now in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não havia em todo Israel homem tão elogiado por sua beleza como Absalão; desde a planta de seu pé até ao topo da cabeça não havia nele defeito.
verses.RVR09: Y no había en todo Israel hombre tan hermoso como Absalom, de alabar en gran manera: desde la planta de su pie hasta la mollera no había en él defecto.

verses.KJV: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.
verses.WEB: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.
verses.ASV: And when he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it); he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se cortava o cabelo, (o qual fazia ao fim de cada ano, pois lhe incomodava, e por isso se o cortava,) pesava o cabelo de sua cabeça duzentos siclos de peso real.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando se cortaba el cabello, (lo cual hacía al fin de cada año, pues le causaba molestia, y por eso se lo cortaba), pesaba el cabello de su cabeza doscientos siclos de peso real.

verses.KJV: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
verses.WEB: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.
verses.ASV: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nasceram-lhe a Absalão três filhos, e uma filha que se chamou Tamar, a qual era bela de ver.
verses.RVR09: Y Naciéronle á Absalom tres hijos, y una hija que se llamó Thamar, la cual era hermosa de ver.

verses.KJV: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.
verses.WEB: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.
verses.ASV: And Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem; and he saw not the king’s face.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esteve Absalão por espaço de dois anos em Jerusalém, e não viu a cara do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y estuvo Absalom por espacio de dos años en Jerusalem, y no vió la cara del rey.

verses.KJV: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.
verses.WEB: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.
verses.ASV: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king; but he would not come to him: and he sent again a second time, but he would not come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou Absalão por Joabe, para enviá-lo ao rei; mas não quis vir a ele; ele mandou mensagem ainda pela segunda vez, mas não quis vir.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó Absalom por Joab, para enviarlo al rey; mas no quiso venir á él; ni aunque envió por segunda vez, quiso él venir.

verses.KJV: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire.
verses.WEB: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.
verses.ASV: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab’s field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse a seus servos: Bem sabeis as terras de Joabe junto a meu lugar, de onde tem suas cevadas; ide, e pegai-lhes fogo; e os servos de Absalão pegaram fogo às terras.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo á sus siervos: Bien sabéis las tierras de Joab junto á mi lugar, donde tiene sus cebadas; id, y pegadles fuego; y los siervos de Absalom pegaron fuego á las tierras.

verses.KJV: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
verses.WEB: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”
verses.ASV: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantou-se, portanto, Joabe, e veio a Absalão à sua casa, e disse-lhe: Por que puseram fogo teus servos a minhas terras?
verses.RVR09: Levantóse por tanto Joab, y vino á Absalom á su casa, y díjole: ¿Por qué han puesto fuego tus siervos á mis tierras?

verses.KJV: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.
verses.WEB: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”
verses.ASV: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it were better for me to be there still. Now therefore let me see the king’s face; and if there be iniquity in me, let him kill me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Absalão respondeu a Joabe: Eis que, eu enviei por ti, dizendo que viesses aqui, a fim de enviar-te eu ao rei a que lhe dissesses: Para que vim de Gesur? Melhor me fora estar ainda lá. Veja eu agora a cara do rei; e se há em mim pecado, mate-me.
verses.RVR09: Y Absalom respondió á Joab: He aquí, yo he enviado por ti, diciendo que vinieses acá, á fin de enviarte yo al rey á que le dijeses: ¿Para qué vine de Gessur? mejor me fuera estar aún allá. Vea yo ahora la cara del rey; y si hay en mí pecado, máteme.

verses.KJV: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
verses.WEB: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.
verses.ASV: So Joab came to the king, and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio, pois, Joabe ao rei, e fê-lo saber. Então chamou a Absalão, o qual veio ao rei, e inclinou seu rosto em terra diante do rei: e o rei beijou a Absalão.
verses.RVR09: Vino pues Joab al rey, é hízoselo saber. Entonces llamó á Absalom, el cual vino al rey, é inclinó su rostro á tierra delante del rey: y el rey besó á Absalom.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.WEB: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him a chariot and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aconteceu depois disto, que Absalão se fez de carros e cavalos, e cinquenta que corressem diante dele.
verses.RVR09: ACONTECIÓ después de esto, que Absalom se hizo de carros y caballos, y cincuenta hombres que corriesen delante de él.

verses.KJV: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.WEB: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”
verses.ASV: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that, when any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantava-se Absalão de manhã, e punha-se a um lado do caminho da porta; e a qualquer um que tinha pleito e vinha ao rei a juízo, Absalão lhe chamava a si, e dizia-lhe: De que cidade és? E ele respondia: Teu servo é de uma das tribos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y levantábase Absalom de mañana, y poníase á un lado del camino de la puerta; y á cualquiera que tenía pleito y venía al rey á juicio, Absalom le llamaba á sí, y decíale: ¿De qué ciudad eres? Y él respondía: Tu siervo es de una de las tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.
verses.WEB: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”
verses.ASV: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Absalão lhe dizia: Olha que tuas palavras são boas e justas: mas não tens quem te ouça pelo rei.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Absalom le decía: Mira, tus palabras son buenas y justas: mas no tienes quien te oiga por el rey.

verses.KJV: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!
verses.WEB: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”
verses.ASV: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizia Absalão: Quem me dera se eu fosse constituído juiz na terra, para que viessem a mim todos os que têm pleito ou negócio, que eu lhes faria justiça!
verses.RVR09: Y decía Absalom: ¡Quién me pusiera por juez en la tierra, para que viniesen á mí todos los que tienen pleito ó negocio, que yo les haría justicia!

verses.KJV: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.
verses.WEB: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.
verses.ASV: And it was so, that, when any man came nigh to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took hold of him, and kissed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecia que, quando alguém se chegava para inclinar-se a ele, ele estendia sua mão, e o tomava, e o beijava.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecía que, cuando alguno se llegaba para inclinarse á él, él extendía la mano, y lo tomaba, y lo besaba.

verses.KJV: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
verses.WEB: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
verses.ASV: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desta maneira fazia com todo Israel que vinha ao rei a juízo: e assim roubava Absalão o coração dos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y de esta manera hacía con todo Israel que venía al rey á juicio: y así robaba Absalom el corazón de los de Israel.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the Lord, in Hebron.
verses.WEB: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to the LORD, in Hebron.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the end of forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto Jehovah, in Hebron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao fim de quarenta anos aconteceu que Absalão disse ao rei: Eu te rogo me permitas que vá a Hebrom, a pagar meu voto que ei prometido ao SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Y al cabo de cuarenta años aconteció que Absalom dijo al rey: Yo te ruego me permitas que vaya á Hebrón, á pagar mi voto que he prometido á Jehová:

verses.KJV: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the Lord shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the Lord.
verses.WEB: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If the LORD shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If Jehovah shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque teu servo fez voto quando estava em Gesur em Síria, dizendo: Se o SENHOR me voltar a Jerusalém, eu servirei ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque tu siervo hizo voto cuando estaba en Gessur en Siria, diciendo: Si Jehová me volviere á Jerusalem, yo serviré á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.
verses.WEB: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose and went to Hebron.
verses.ASV: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse: Vai em paz. E ele se levantou, e se foi a Hebrom.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey le dijo: Ve en paz. Y él se levantó, y se fué á Hebrón.

verses.KJV: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.
verses.WEB: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”
verses.ASV: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom is king in Hebron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém enviou Absalão espias por todas as tribos de Israel, dizendo: Quando ouvirdes o som da trombeta, direis: Absalão reina em Hebrom.
verses.RVR09: Empero envió Absalom espías por todas las tribus de Israel, diciendo: Cuando oyereis el sonido de la trompeta, diréis: Absalom reina en Hebrón.

verses.KJV: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.
verses.WEB: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.
verses.ASV: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they knew not anything.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram com Absalão duzentos homens de Jerusalém por ele convidados, os quais iam em sua ingenuidade, sem saber nada.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron con Absalom doscientos hombres de Jerusalem por él convidados, los cuales iban en su sencillez, sin saber nada.

verses.KJV: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
verses.WEB: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.
verses.ASV: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também enviou Absalão por Aitofel gilonita, do conselho de Davi, a Gilo sua cidade, enquanto fazia seus sacrifícios. E a conspiração veio a ser grande, pois se ia aumentando o povo com Absalão.
verses.RVR09: También envió Absalom por Achitophel Gilonita, del consejo de David, á Gilo su ciudad, mientras hacía sus sacrificios. Y la conjuración vino á ser grande, pues se iba aumentando el pueblo con Absalom.

verses.KJV: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.
verses.WEB: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”
verses.ASV: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio o aviso a Davi, dizendo: O coração de todo Israel segue Absalão.
verses.RVR09: Y vino el aviso á David, diciendo: El corazón de todo Israel va tras Absalom.

verses.KJV: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.WEB: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”
verses.ASV: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for else none of us shall escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us quickly, and bring down evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi disse a todos os seus servos que estavam com ele em Jerusalém: Levantai-vos, e fujamos, porque não poderemos escapar diante de Absalão; apressai-vos a partir, não seja que se apressando ele nos alcance, e lance o mal sobre nós, e fira a cidade a fio de espada.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David dijo á todos sus siervos que estaban con él en Jerusalem: Levantaos y huyamos, porque no podremos escapar delante de Absalom; daos priesa á partir, no sea que apresurándose él nos alcance, y arroje el mal sobre nosotros, y hiera la ciudad á filo de espada.

verses.KJV: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.
verses.WEB: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”
verses.ASV: And the king’s servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall choose.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os servos do rei disseram ao rei: Eis que, teus servos estão prontos a tudo que nosso senhor, o rei, decidir fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y los siervos del rey dijeron al rey: He aquí, tus siervos están prestos á todo lo que nuestro señor el rey eligiere.

verses.KJV: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.
verses.WEB: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.
verses.ASV: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, that were concubines, to keep the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei então saiu, com toda sua família depois dele. E deixou o rei dez mulheres concubinas para que guardassem a casa.
verses.RVR09: El rey entonces salió, con toda su familia en pos de él. Y dejó el rey diez mujeres concubinas para que guardasen la casa.

verses.KJV: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.
verses.WEB: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.
verses.ASV: And the king went forth, and all the people after him; and they tarried in Beth-merhak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saiu pois o rei com todo o povo que lhe seguia, e pararam-se em um lugar distante.
verses.RVR09: Salió pues el rey con todo el pueblo que le seguía, y paráronse en un lugar distante.

verses.KJV: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
verses.WEB: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
verses.ASV: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men that came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os seus servos passavam a seu lado, com todos os quereteus e peleteus; e todos os giteus, seiscentos homens que haviam vindo a pé desde Gate, iam diante do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y todos sus siervos pasaban á su lado, con todos los Ceretheos y Peletheos; y todos los Getheos, seiscientos hombres que habían venido á pie desde Gath, iban delante del rey.

verses.KJV: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.
verses.WEB: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.
verses.ASV: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return, and abide with the king: for thou art a foreigner, and also an exile; [return] to thine own place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o rei a Itai giteu: Para que vens tu também conosco? Volta, e fica com o rei; porque tu és estrangeiro, e desterrado também de teu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el rey á Ittai Getheo: ¿Para qué vienes tú también con nosotros? vuélvete y quédate con el rey; porque tú eres extranjero, y desterrado también de tu lugar.

verses.KJV: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.
verses.WEB: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”
verses.ASV: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us, seeing I go whither I may? return thou, and take back thy brethren; mercy and truth be with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ontem vieste, e tenho-te de fazer hoje que mudes lugar para ir conosco? Eu vou como vou: tu volta, e faze voltar a teus irmãos: em ti haja misericórdia e verdade.
verses.RVR09: ¿Ayer viniste, y téngote de hacer hoy que mudes lugar para ir con nosotros? Yo voy como voy: tú vuélvete, y haz volver á tus hermanos; en ti haya misericordia y verdad.

verses.KJV: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the Lord liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.
verses.WEB: Ittai answered the king and said, “As the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”
verses.ASV: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As Jehovah liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether for death or for life, even there also will thy servant be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu Itai ao rei, dizendo: Vive Deus, e vive meu senhor o rei, que, ou para morte ou para vida, de onde meu senhor o rei estiver, ali estará também teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Ittai al rey, diciendo: Vive Dios, y vive mi señor el rey, que, ó para muerte ó para vida, donde mi señor el rey estuviere, allí estará también tu siervo.

verses.KJV: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.
verses.WEB: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.
verses.ASV: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi disse a Itai: Vem, pois, e passa. E passou Itai giteu, e todos os seus homens, e toda sua família.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David dijo á Ittai: Ven pues, y pasa. Y pasó Ittai Getheo, y todos sus hombres, y toda su familia.

verses.KJV: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.
verses.WEB: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.
verses.ASV: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda aquela terra chorou em alta voz; passou, logo, toda a gente o ribeiro de Cedrom; também passou o rei, e todo aquele povo passou, ao caminho que vai ao deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el país lloró en alta voz; pasó luego toda la gente el torrente de Cedrón; asimismo pasó el rey, y todo el pueblo pasó, al camino que va al desierto.

verses.KJV: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.
verses.WEB: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.
verses.ASV: And, lo, Zadok also [came], and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que, também ia Zadoque, e com ele todos os levitas que levavam a arca do pacto de Deus; e assentaram a arca do pacto de Deus. E subiu Abiatar depois que acabou de sair da cidade todo aquele povo.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, también iba Sadoc, y con él todos los Levitas que llevaban el arca del pacto de Dios; y asentaron el arca del pacto de Dios. Y subió Abiathar después que hubo acabado de salir de la ciudad todo el pueblo.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the Lord, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:
verses.WEB: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in the LORD’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;
verses.ASV: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favor in the eyes of Jehovah, he will bring me again, and show me both it, and his habitation:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém disse o rei a Zadoque: Volta a arca de Deus à cidade; que se eu achar favor aos olhos do SENHOR, ele me voltará, e me fará ver a ela e a seu tabernáculo:
verses.RVR09: Pero dijo el rey á Sadoc: Vuelve el arca de Dios á la ciudad; que si yo hallare gracia en los ojos de Jehová, él me volverá, y me hará ver á ella y á su tabernáculo:

verses.KJV: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.
verses.WEB: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
verses.ASV: but if he say thus, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se disser: Não me agradas: aqui estou, faça de mim o que bem lhe parecer.
verses.RVR09: Y si dijere: No me agradas: aquí estoy, haga de mí lo que bien le pareciere.

verses.KJV: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
verses.WEB: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
verses.ASV: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art thou [not] a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse ainda o rei a Zadoque sacerdote: Não és tu vidente? Volta-te em paz à cidade; e convosco vossos dois filhos, teu filho Aimaás, e Jônatas filho de Abiatar.
verses.RVR09: Dijo aún el rey á Sadoc sacerdote: ¿No eres tú el vidente? Vuélvete en paz á la ciudad; y con vosotros vuestros dos hijos, tu hijo Ahimaas, y Jonathán hijo de Abiathar.

verses.KJV: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”
verses.ASV: See, I will tarry at the fords of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai que eu me deterei nos campos do deserto, até que venha resposta de vós que me dê aviso.
verses.RVR09: Mirad, yo me detendré en los campos del desierto, hasta que venga respuesta de vosotros que me dé aviso.

verses.KJV: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.
verses.WEB: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.
verses.ASV: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they abode there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Zadoque e Abiatar trouxeram de volta a arca de Deus a Jerusalém; e estiveram ali.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Sadoc y Abiathar volvieron el arca de Dios á Jerusalem; y estuviéronse allá.

verses.KJV: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.
verses.WEB: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.
verses.ASV: And David went up by the ascent of the [mount of] Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered, and went barefoot: and all the people that were with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi subiu o monte das Oliveiras; e subiu chorando, levando a cabeça coberta, e os pés descalços. Também todo aquele povo que tinha consigo cobriu cada um sua cabeça, e subiram chorando assim como subiam.
verses.RVR09: Y David subió la cuesta de las olivas; y subióla llorando, llevando la cabeza cubierta, y los pies descalzos. También todo el pueblo que tenía consigo cubrió cada uno su cabeza, y subieron llorando así como subían.

verses.KJV: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O Lord, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
verses.WEB: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.”
verses.ASV: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O Jehovah, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram aviso a Davi, dizendo: Aitofel está entre os que conspiraram com Absalão. Então disse Davi: Torna loucura agora, ó SENHOR, o conselho de Aitofel.
verses.RVR09: Y dieron aviso á David, diciendo: Achitophel está entre los que conspiraron con Absalom. Entonces dijo David: Entontece ahora, oh Jehová, el consejo de Achitophel.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:
verses.WEB: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that, when David was come to the top [of the ascent], where God was worshipped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Davi chegou ao cume do monte para adorar ali a Deus, eis que Husai arquita que lhe saiu ao encontro, trazendo rasgada sua roupa, e terra sobre sua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y como David llegó á la cumbre del monte para adorar allí á Dios, he aquí Husai Arachîta que le salió al encuentro, trayendo rota su ropa, y tierra sobre su cabeza.

verses.KJV: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:
verses.WEB: David said to him, “If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;
verses.ASV: And David said unto him, If thou passest on with me, then thou wilt be a burden unto me:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Davi: Se passares comigo, tu me serás prejudicial;
verses.RVR09: Y díjole David: Si pasares conmigo, serme has de carga;

verses.KJV: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.
verses.WEB: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’
verses.ASV: but if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father’s servant in time past, so will I now be thy servant; then wilt thou defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se voltares à cidade, e disseres a Absalão: Rei, eu serei teu servo; como até aqui fui servo de teu pai, assim serei agora servo teu, então tu me dissiparás o conselho de Aitofel.
verses.RVR09: Mas si volvieres á la ciudad, y dijeres á Absalom: Rey, yo seré tu siervo; como hasta aquí he sido siervo de tu padre, así seré ahora siervo tuyo, entonces tú me disiparás el consejo de Achitophel.

verses.KJV: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
verses.WEB: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
verses.ASV: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king’s house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não estarão ali contigo Zadoque e Abiatar sacerdotes? Portanto, tudo o que ouvires na casa do rei, darás aviso disso a Zadoque e a Abiatar sacerdotes.
verses.RVR09: ¿No estarán allí contigo Sadoc y Abiathar sacerdotes? Por tanto, todo lo que oyeres en la casa del rey, darás aviso de ello á Sadoc y á Abiathar sacerdotes.

verses.KJV: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, and Jonathan Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.
verses.WEB: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”
verses.ASV: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son; and by them ye shall send unto me everything that ye shall hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que estão com eles seus dois filhos, Aimaás o de Zadoque, e Jônatas o de Abiatar; por meio deles me enviareis aviso de tudo o que ouvirdes.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí que están con ellos sus dos hijos, Ahimaas el de Sadoc, y Jonathán el de Abiathar: por mano de ellos me enviaréis aviso de todo lo que oyereis.

verses.KJV: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se veio Husai amigo de Davi à cidade; e Absalão entrou em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Así se vino Husai amigo de David á la ciudad; y Absalom entró en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.
verses.WEB: When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred clusters of raisins, and one hundred summer fruits, and a container of wine.
verses.ASV: And when David was a little past the top [of the ascent], behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and a hundred clusters of raisins, and a hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Davi passou um pouco do cume do monte, eis que Ziba, o criado de Mefibosete, que o saía a receber com um par de asnos aprontados, e sobre eles duzentos pães, e cem cachos de passas, e cem pães de figos secos, e um odre de vinho.
verses.RVR09: Y COMO David pasó un poco de la cumbre del monte, he aquí Siba, el criado de Mephi-boseth, que lo salía á recibir con un par de asnos enalbardados, y sobre ellos doscientos panes, y cien hilos de pasas, y cien panes de higos secos, y un cuero de vino.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.
verses.WEB: The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?” Ziba said, “The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that those who are faint in the wilderness may drink.”
verses.ASV: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses are for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as are faint in the wilderness may drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o rei a Ziba: Que é isto? E Ziba respondeu: Os asnos são para a família do rei, em que s; os pães e a passa para os criados, que comam; e o vinho, para que bebam os que se cansarem no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el rey á Siba: ¿Qué es esto? Y Siba respondió: Los asnos son para la familia del rey, en que suban; los panes y la pasa para los criados, que coman; y el vino, para que beban los que se cansaren en el desierto.

verses.KJV: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.
verses.WEB: The king said, “Where is your master’s son?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is staying in Jerusalem; for he said, ‘Today the house of Israel will restore me the kingdom of my father.’”
verses.ASV: And the king said, And where is thy master’s son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem; for he said, To-day will the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o rei: Onde está o filho de teu senhor? E Ziba respondeu ao rei: Eis que ele ficou em Jerusalém, porque disse: Hoje me devolverá a casa de Israel o reino de meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el rey: ¿Dónde está el hijo de tu señor? Y Siba respondió al rey: He aquí él se ha quedado en Jerusalem, porque ha dicho: Hoy me devolverá la casa de Israel el reino de mi padre.

verses.KJV: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.
verses.WEB: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.” Ziba said, “I bow down. Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, O king.”
verses.ASV: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine is all that pertaineth unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I do obeisance; let me find favor in thy sight, my lord, O king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei disse a Ziba: Eis que, seja teu tudo o que tem Mefibosete. E respondeu Ziba inclinando-se: Rei senhor meu, ache eu favor diante de ti.
