verses.RVR09: Y Absalom, á quien habíamos ungido sobre nosotros, es muerto en la batalla. ¿Por qué pues os estáis ahora quedos en orden á hacer volver al rey?

verses.KJV: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.
verses.WEB: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?
verses.ASV: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, [to bring him] to his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E el rei Davi enviou a Zadoque e a Abiatar sacerdotes, dizendo: Falai aos anciãos de Judá e dizei-lhes: Por que sereis vós os últimos em voltar o rei à sua casa, já que a palavra de todo Israel veio ao rei de voltar-lhe à sua casa?
verses.RVR09: Y el rey David envió á Sadoc y á Abiathar sacerdotes, diciendo: Hablad á los ancianos de Judá y decidles: ¿Por qué seréis vosotros los postreros en volver el rey á su casa, ya que la palabra de todo Israel ha venido al rey de volverle á su casa?

verses.KJV: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?
verses.WEB: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’
verses.ASV: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bone and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois meus irmãos; sois meus ossos e minha carne; por que, pois sereis vós os últimos em voltar ao rei?
verses.RVR09: Vosotros sois mis hermanos; mis huesos y mi carne sois: ¿por qué pues seréis vosotros los postreros en volver al rey?

verses.KJV: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
verses.WEB: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”
verses.ASV: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também direis a Amasa: Não és tu também osso meu e carne minha? Assim me faça Deus, e assim me acrescente, se não fores general do exército diante de mim para sempre, em lugar de Joabe.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo diréis á Amasa: ¿No eres tú también hueso mío y carne mía? Así me haga Dios, y así me añada, si no fueres general del ejército delante de mí para siempre, en lugar de Joab.

verses.KJV: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.
verses.WEB: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”
verses.ASV: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as [the heart of] one man; so that they sent unto the king, [saying], Return thou, and all thy servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim inclinou o coração de todos os homens de Judá, como o de um só homem, para que enviassem a dizer ao rei: Volta, com todos os teus servos.
verses.RVR09: Así inclinó el corazón de todos los varones de Judá, como el de un solo hombre, para que enviasen á decir al rey: Vuelve tú, y todos tus siervos.

verses.KJV: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
verses.WEB: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.
verses.ASV: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltou, pois o rei, e veio até o Jordão. E Judá veio a Gilgal, a receber ao rei e fazê-lo passar o Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Volvió pues el rey, y vino hasta el Jordán. Y Judá vino á Gilgal, á recibir al rey y pasarlo el Jordán.

verses.KJV: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
verses.WEB: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.
verses.ASV: And Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Simei filho de Gera, filho de Benjamim, que era de Baurim, apressou-se a vir com os homens de Judá a receber ao rei Davi;
verses.RVR09: Y Semei hijo de Gera, hijo de Benjamín, que era de Bahurim, dióse priesa á venir con los hombres de Judá á recibir al rey David;

verses.KJV: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
verses.WEB: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.
verses.ASV: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com ele vinham mil homens de Benjamim; também Ziba criado da casa de Saul, com seus quinze filhos e seus vinte servos, os quais passaram o Jordão diante do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y con él venían mil hombres de Benjamín; asimismo Siba criado de la casa de Saúl, con sus quince hijos y sus veinte siervos, los cuales pasaron el Jordán delante del rey.

verses.KJV: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
verses.WEB: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And there went over a ferry-boat to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, when he was come over the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Atravessou depois o barco para passar a família do rei, e para fazer o que lhe agradasse. Então Simei filho de Gera se prostrou diante do rei quando ele havia passado o Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Atravesó después la barca para pasar la familia del rey, y para hacer lo que le pluguiera. Entonces Semei hijo de Gera se postró delante del rey cuando él había pasado el Jordán.

verses.KJV: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
verses.WEB: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
verses.ASV: And he said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ao rei: Não me impute meu senhor iniquidade, nem tenhas memória dos males que teu servo fez o dia que meu senhor o rei saiu de Jerusalém, para guardá-los o rei em seu coração;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo al rey: No me impute mi señor iniquidad, ni tengas memoria de los males que tu siervo hizo el día que mi señor el rey salió de Jerusalem, para guardarlos el rey en su corazón;

verses.KJV: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
verses.WEB: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”
verses.ASV: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come this day the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu teu servo conheço haver pecado, e vim hoje o primeiro de toda a casa de José, para descer a receber a meu senhor o rei.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo tu siervo conozco haber pecado, y he venido hoy el primero de toda la casa de José, para descender á recibir á mi señor el rey.

verses.KJV: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the Lord's anointed?
verses.WEB: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”
verses.ASV: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Jehovah’s anointed?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abisai filho de Zeruia respondeu e disse: Não morrerá por isto Simei, que amaldiçoou ao ungido do SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Y Abisai hijo de Sarvia respondió y dijo: ¿No ha de morir por esto Semei, que maldijo al ungido de Jehová?

verses.KJV: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?
verses.WEB: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”
verses.ASV: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Davi então disse: Que tendes vós comigo, filhos de Zeruia, que me haveis de ser hoje adversários? Morrerá hoje alguém em Israel? Não sei eu que hoje sou rei sobre Israel?
verses.RVR09: David entonces dijo: ¿Qué tenéis vosotros conmigo, hijos de Sarvia, que me habéis de ser hoy adversarios? ¿ha de morir hoy alguno en Israel? ¿no conozco yo que hoy soy rey sobre Israel?

verses.KJV: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
verses.WEB: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.
verses.ASV: And the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o rei a Simei: Não morrerás. E o rei jurou a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el rey á Semei: No morirás. Y el rey se lo juró.

verses.KJV: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.
verses.WEB: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.
verses.ASV: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Mefibosete filho de Saul desceu a receber ao rei: não havia lavado seus pés, nem havia cortado sua barba, nem tampouco havia lavado suas roupas, desde o dia que o rei saiu até o dia que veio em paz.
verses.RVR09: También Mephi-boseth hijo de Saúl descendió á recibir al rey: no había lavado sus pies, ni había cortado su barba, ni tampoco había lavado sus vestidos, desde el día que el rey salió hasta el día que vino en paz.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
verses.WEB: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que veio ele a Jerusalém a receber ao rei, o rei lhe disse: Mefibosete, Por que não foste comigo?
verses.RVR09: Y luego que vino él á Jerusalem á recibir al rey, el rey le dijo: Mephi-boseth, ¿por qué no fuiste conmigo?

verses.KJV: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.
verses.WEB: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.
verses.ASV: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go with the king; because thy servant is lame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Rei senhor meu, meu servo me enganou; pois havia teu servo dito: Prepararei um asno, e subirei nele, e irei ao rei; porque teu servo é coxo.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Rey señor mío, mi siervo me ha engañado; pues había tu siervo dicho: Enalbardaré un asno, y subiré en él, é iré al rey; porque tu siervo es cojo.

verses.KJV: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.
verses.WEB: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.
verses.ASV: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele caluniou a teu servo diante de meu senhor o rei; mas meu senhor o rei é como um anjo de Deus: faze, pois, o que bem te parecer.
verses.RVR09: Empero él revolvió á tu siervo delante de mi señor el rey; mas mi señor el rey es como un ángel de Dios: haz pues lo que bien te pareciere.

verses.KJV: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
verses.WEB: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”
verses.ASV: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should cry any more unto the king?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque toda a casa de meu pai era digna de morte diante de meu senhor o rei, e tu puseste a teu servo entre os convidados de tua mesa. Que direito, pois, tenho ainda para queixar-me mais contra o rei?
verses.RVR09: Porque toda la casa de mi padre era digna de muerte delante de mi señor el rey, y tú pusiste á tu siervo entre los convidados de tu mesa. ¿Qué derecho pues tengo aún para quejarme más contra el rey?

verses.KJV: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
verses.WEB: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”
verses.ASV: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I say, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei lhe disse: Para que falas mais palavras? Eu determinei que tu e Ziba repartais as terras.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey le dijo: ¿Para qué hablas más palabras? Yo he determinado que tú y Siba partáis las tierras.

verses.KJV: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
verses.WEB: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”
verses.ASV: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come in peace unto his own house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Mefibosete disse ao rei: E ainda tome-as ele todas, pois que meu senhor o rei voltou em paz à sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y Mephi-boseth dijo al rey: Y aun tómelas él todas, pues que mi señor el rey ha vuelto en paz á su casa.

verses.KJV: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
verses.WEB: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.
verses.ASV: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king, to conduct him over the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Barzilai gileadita desceu de Rogelim, e passou o Jordão com o rei, para acompanhar-lhe da outra parte do Jordão.
verses.RVR09: También Barzillai Galaadita descendió de Rogelim, y pasó el Jordán con el rey, para acompañarle de la otra parte del Jordán.

verses.KJV: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
verses.WEB: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.
verses.ASV: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king with sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E era Barzilai muito velho, de oitenta anos, o qual havia dado provisão ao rei quando estava em Maanaim, porque era homem muito rico.
verses.RVR09: Y era Barzillai muy viejo, de ochenta años, el cual había dado provisión al rey cuando estaba en Mahanaim, porque era hombre muy rico.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”
verses.ASV: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will sustain thee with me in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse a Barzilai: Passa comigo, e eu te darei de comer comigo em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey dijo á Barzillai: Pasa conmigo, y yo te daré de comer conmigo en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
verses.WEB: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
verses.ASV: And Barzillai said unto the king, How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Barzilai disse ao rei: Quantos são os dias do tempo de minha vida, para que eu suba com o rei a Jerusalém?
verses.RVR09: Mas Barzillai dijo al rey: ¿Cuántos son los días del tiempo de mi vida, para que yo suba con el rey á Jerusalem?

verses.KJV: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
verses.WEB: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?
verses.ASV: I am this day fourscore years old: can I discern between good and bad? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou hoje da idade de oitenta anos, que já não farei diferença entre o bem e o mal: tomará gosto agora teu servo no que comer ou beber? Ouvirei mais a voz dos cantores e das cantoras? Para que, pois, seria ainda teu servo incômodo ao meu senhor, o rei?
verses.RVR09: Yo soy hoy día de edad de ochenta años, que ya no haré diferencia entre lo bueno y lo malo: ¿tomará gusto ahora tu siervo en lo que comiere ó bebiere? ¿oiré más la voz de los cantores y de las cantoras? ¿para qué, pues, sería aún tu siervo molesto á mi señor el rey?

verses.KJV: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
verses.WEB: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?
verses.ASV: Thy servant would but just go over the Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
verses.ALMEIDA: Passará teu servo um pouco o Jordão com o rei: por que me há de dar o rei tão grande recompensa?
verses.RVR09: Pasará tu siervo un poco el Jordán con el rey: ¿por qué me ha de dar el rey tan grande recompensa?

verses.KJV: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.
verses.WEB: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”
verses.ASV: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te rogo que deixes voltar a teu servo, e que morra em minha cidade, junto ao sepulcro de meu pai e de minha mãe. Eis aqui teu servo Quimã; que passe ele com meu senhor o rei, e faze-lhe o que bem te parecer.
verses.RVR09: Yo te ruego que dejes volver á tu siervo, y que muera en mi ciudad, junto al sepulcro de mi padre y de mi madre. He aquí tu siervo Chimham; que pase él con mi señor el rey, y hazle lo que bien te pareciere.

verses.KJV: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.
verses.WEB: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”
verses.ASV: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse: Pois passe comigo Quimã, e eu farei com ele como bem te pareça: e tudo o que tu me pedires, eu o farei.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey dijo: Pues pase conmigo Chimham, y yo haré con él como bien te parezca: y todo lo que tú pidieres de mí, yo lo haré.

verses.KJV: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
verses.WEB: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.
verses.ASV: And all the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over: and the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo aquele povo passou o Jordão: e logo que o rei também passou, o rei beijou a Barzilai, e abençoou-o; e ele se voltou à sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el pueblo pasó el Jordán: y luego que el rey hubo también pasado, el rey besó á Barzillai, y bendíjolo; y él se volvió á su casa.

verses.KJV: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
verses.WEB: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.
verses.ASV: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him: and all the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei então passou a Gilgal, e com ele passou Quimã; e todo aquele povo de Judá, com a metade do povo de Israel, acompanharam o rei.
verses.RVR09: El rey entonces pasó á Gilgal, y con él pasó Chimham; y todo el pueblo de Judá, con la mitad del pueblo de Israel, pasaron al rey.

verses.KJV: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?
verses.WEB: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”
verses.ASV: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and brought the king, and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que todos os homens de Israel vieram ao rei, e lhe disseram: Por que os homens de Judá, nossos irmãos, te levaram, e fizeram passar o Jordão ao rei e à sua família, e a todos os homens de Davi com ele?
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí todos los varones de Israel vinieron al rey, y le dijeron: ¿Por qué los hombres de Judá, nuestros hermanos, te han llevado, y han hecho pasar el Jordán al rey y á su familia, y á todos los varones de David con él?

verses.KJV: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?
verses.WEB: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”
verses.ASV: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then are ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? or hath he given us any gift?
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os homens de Judá responderam a todos os de Israel: Porque o rei é nosso parente. Mas por que vos irais vós disso? Temos nós comido algo do rei? Temos recebido dele algum presente?
verses.RVR09: Y todos los varones de Judá respondieron á todos los de Israel: Porque el rey es nuestro pariente. Mas ¿por qué os enojáis vosotros de eso? ¿hemos nosotros comido algo del rey? ¿hemos recibido de él algún don?

verses.KJV: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
verses.WEB: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
verses.ASV: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more [right] in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então responderam os homens de Israel, e disseram aos de Judá: Nós temos no rei dez partes, e no mesmo Davi mais que vós: por que, pois, nos haveis tido em pouco? Não falamos nós primeiro em voltar a nosso rei? E o argumento dos homens de Judá prevaleceu ao dos homens de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondieron los varones de Israel, y dijeron á los de Judá: Nosotros tenemos en el rey diez partes, y en el mismo David más que vosotros: ¿por qué pues nos habéis tenido en poco? ¿no hablamos nosotros primero en volver á nuestro rey? Y el razonamiento de los varones de Judá fué más fuerte que el de los varones de Israel.

verses.KJV: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.
verses.WEB: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”
verses.ASV: And there happened to be there a base fellow, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew the trumpet, and said, We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu estar ali um homem perverso que se chamava Seba, filho de Bicri, homem de Benjamim, o qual tocou a trombeta, e disse: Não temos nós parte em Davi, nem herança no filho de Jessé: Israel, cada um a suas moradas!
verses.RVR09: Y ACAECIÓ estar allí un hombre perverso que se llamaba Seba, hijo de Bichri, hombre de Benjamín, el cual tocó la corneta, y dijo: No tenemos nosotros parte en David, ni heredad en el hijo de Isaí: Israel, ¡cada uno á sus estancias!

verses.KJV: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim deixaram de seguir Davi todos os homens de Israel, e seguiam a Seba filho de Bicri: mas os de Judá se aderiram a seu rei, desde o Jordão até Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Así se fueron de en pos de David todos los hombres de Israel, y seguían á Seba hijo de Bichri: mas los de Judá fueron adheridos á su rey, desde el Jordán hasta Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
verses.WEB: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.
verses.ASV: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and provided them with sustenance, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que chegou Davi a sua casa em Jerusalém, tomou o rei as dez mulheres concubinas que havia deixado para guardar a casa, e as pôs em uma casa em guarda, e deu-lhes de comer: mas nunca mais entrou a elas, mas sim que ficaram encerradas até que morressem como viúvas.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que llegó David á su casa en Jerusalem, tomó el rey las diez mujeres concubinas que había dejado para guardar la casa, y púsolas en una casa en guarda, y dióles de comer: pero nunca más entró á ellas, sino que quedaron encerradas hasta que murieron en viudez de por vida.

verses.KJV: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
verses.WEB: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”
verses.ASV: Then said the king to Amasa, Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be thou here present.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois o rei disse a Amasa: Convoca-me os homens de Judá para dentro de três dias, e apresenta-te aqui.
verses.RVR09: Después dijo el rey á Amasa: Júntame los varones de Judá para dentro de tres días, y hállate tú aquí presente.

verses.KJV: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
verses.WEB: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.
verses.ASV: So Amasa went to call [the men of] Judah together; but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi, pois, Amasa, convocar Judá; mas demorou-se além do tempo que lhe havia sido designado.
verses.RVR09: Fué pues Amasa á juntar á Judá; pero detúvose más del tiempo que le había sido señalado.

verses.KJV: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
verses.WEB: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”
verses.ASV: And David said to Abishai, Now will Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi a Abisai: Seba, filho de Bicri, nos fará agora mais mal que Absalão; toma, pois, tu, os servos do teu senhor, e vai atrás dele, para que ele não ache as cidades fortificadas, e escape de nós.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David á Abisai: Seba hijo de Bichri nos hará ahora más mal que Absalom: toma pues tú los siervos de tu señor, y ve tras él, no sea que halle las ciudades fortificadas, y se nos vaya de delante.

verses.KJV: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.WEB: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.ASV: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então saíram depois dele os homens de Joabe, e os quereteus e peleteus, e todos os valentes: saíram de Jerusalém para ir atrás de Seba filho de Bicri.
verses.RVR09: Entonces salieron en pos de él los hombres de Joab, y los Ceretheos y Peletheos, y todos los valientes: salieron de Jerusalem para ir tras Seba hijo de Bichri.

verses.KJV: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
verses.WEB: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.
verses.ASV: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. And Joab was girded with his apparel of war that he had put on, and thereon was a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estando eles próximo da grande penha que está em Gibeão, saiu-lhes Amasa ao encontro. Agora bem, a vestimenta que Joabe tinha sobreposta estava-lhe cingida, e sobre ela o cinto de um punhal apegado a seus lombos em sua bainha, da que assim quando ele avançou, o punhal caiu.
verses.RVR09: Y estando ellos cerca de la grande peña que está en Gabaón, salióles Amasa al encuentro. Ahora bien, la vestidura que Joab tenía sobrepuesta estábale ceñida, y sobre ella el cinto de una daga pegada á sus lomos en su vaina, de la que así como él avanzó, cayóse aquélla.

verses.KJV: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
verses.WEB: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
verses.ASV: And Joab said to Amasa, Is it well with thee, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Joabe disse a Amasa: Tens paz, irmão meu? E tomou Joabe com a direita a barba de Amasa, para beijá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Joab dijo á Amasa: ¿Tienes paz, hermano mío? Y tomó Joab con la diestra la barba de Amasa, para besarlo.

verses.KJV: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.WEB: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.ASV: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the body, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. And Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como Amasa não se cuidou do punhal que Joabe na mão tinha, feriu-lhe este com ela na quinta costela, e derramou suas entranhas por terra, e caiu morto sem dar-lhe segundo golpe. Depois Joabe e seu irmão Abisai perseguiram Seba filho de Bicri.
verses.RVR09: Y como Amasa no se cuidó de la daga que Joab en la mano tenía, hirióle éste con ella en la quinta costilla, y derramó sus entrañas por tierra, y cayó muerto sin darle segundo golpe. Después Joab y su hermano Abisai fueron en seguimiento de Seba hijo de Bichri.

verses.KJV: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.
verses.WEB: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”
verses.ASV: And there stood by him one of Joab’s young men, and said, He that favoreth Joab, and he that is for David, let him follow Joab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um dos criados de Joabe se parou junto a ele, dizendo: Qualquer um que amar a Joabe e a Davi vá atrás de Joabe.
verses.RVR09: Y uno de los criados de Joab se paró junto á él, diciendo: Cualquiera que amare á Joab y á David vaya en pos de Joab.

verses.KJV: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
verses.WEB: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.
verses.ASV: And Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Amasa se havia revolvido no sangue no meio do caminho: e vendo aquele homem que todo aquele povo se parava, separou a Amasa do caminho ao campo, e lançou sobre ele uma vestimenta, porque via que todos os que vinham se paravam junto a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Amasa se había revolcado en la sangre en mitad del camino: y viendo aquel hombre que todo el pueblo se paraba, apartó á Amasa del camino al campo, y echó sobre él una vestidura, porque veía que todos los que venían se paraban junto á él.

verses.KJV: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.WEB: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.ASV: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo, pois, que foi afastado do caminho, passaram todos os que seguiam a Joabe, para ir atrás de Seba filho de Bicri.
verses.RVR09: Luego, pues, que fué apartado del camino, pasaron todos los que seguían á Joab, para ir tras Seba hijo de Bichri.

verses.KJV: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.
verses.WEB: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.
verses.ASV: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maacah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele passou por todas as tribos de Israel até Abel e Bete-Maaca e toda a terra dos beritas: e juntaram-se, e seguiram-no também.
verses.RVR09: Y él pasó por todas las tribus de Israel hasta Abel y Beth-maachâ y todo Barim: y juntáronse, y siguiéronlo también.

verses.KJV: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
verses.WEB: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.
verses.ASV: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram e cercaram-no em Abel de Bete-Maaca, e puseram baluarte contra a cidade; e posto que foi ao muro, todo aquele povo que estava com Joabe trabalhava por derrubar a muralha.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron y cercáronlo en Abel de Beth-maachâ, y pusieron baluarte contra la ciudad; y puesto que fué al muro, todo el pueblo que estaba con Joab trabajaba por derribar la muralla.

verses.KJV: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
verses.WEB: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”
verses.ASV: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então uma mulher sábia deu vozes na cidade, dizendo: Ouvi, ouvi; rogo-vos que digais a Joabe se chegue a aqui, para que eu fale com ele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces una mujer sabia dió voces en la ciudad, diciendo: Oid, oid; ruégoos que digáis á Joab se llegue á acá, para que yo hable con él.

verses.KJV: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
verses.WEB: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”
verses.ASV: And he came near unto her; and the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thy handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele se aproximou a ela, disse a mulher: És tu Joabe? E ele respondeu: Eu sou. E ela lhe disse: Ouve as palavras de tua serva. E ele respondeu: Ouço.
verses.RVR09: Y como él se acercó á ella, dijo la mujer: ¿Eres tú Joab? Y él respondió: Yo soy. Y ella le dijo: Oye las palabras de tu sierva. Y él respondió: Oigo.

verses.KJV: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.
verses.WEB: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.
verses.ASV: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask [counsel] at Abel: and so they ended [the matter].
verses.ALMEIDA: Então voltou ela a falar, dizendo: Antigamente costumavam falar, dizendo: Quem perguntar, pergunte em Abel: e assim concluíam.
verses.RVR09: Entonces tornó ella á hablar, diciendo: Antiguamente solían hablar, diciendo: Quien preguntare, pregunte en Abel: y así concluían.

verses.KJV: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the Lord?
verses.WEB: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”
verses.ASV: I am of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou das pacíficas e fiéis de Israel: e tu procuras destruir uma cidade que é mãe de Israel: por que destróis a herança do SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Yo soy de las pacíficas y fieles de Israel: y tú procuras destruir una ciudad que es madre de Israel: ¿por qué destruyes la heredad de Jehová?

verses.KJV: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
verses.WEB: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
verses.ASV: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joabe respondeu, dizendo: Nunca tal, nunca tal me aconteça, que eu destrua nem desfaça.
verses.RVR09: Y Joab respondió, diciendo: Nunca tal, nunca tal me acontezca, que yo destruya ni deshaga.

verses.KJV: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.
verses.WEB: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”
verses.ASV: The matter is not so: but a man of the hill-country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David; deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.
verses.ALMEIDA: A coisa não é assim: mas um homem do monte de Efraim, que se chama Seba filho de Bicri, levantou sua mão contra o rei Davi: entregai a esse somente, e me irei da cidade. E a mulher disse a Joabe: Eis que sua cabeça te será lançada desde o muro.
verses.RVR09: La cosa no es así: mas un hombre del monte de Ephraim, que se llama Seba hijo de Bichri, ha levantado su mano contra el rey David: entregad á ése solamente, y me iré de la ciudad. Y la mujer dijo á Joab: He aquí su cabeza te será echada desde el muro.

verses.KJV: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.
verses.WEB: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
verses.ASV: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. And he blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher foi logo a todo aquele povo com sua sabedoria; e eles cortaram a cabeça a Seba filho de Bicri, e lançaram-na a Joabe. E ele tocou a trombeta, e dispersaram-se da cidade, cada um à sua morada. E Joabe se voltou ao rei a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: La mujer fué luego á todo el pueblo con su sabiduría; y ellos cortaron la cabeza á Seba hijo de Bichri, y echáronla á Joab. Y él tocó la corneta, y esparciéronse de la ciudad, cada uno á su estancia. Y Joab se volvió al rey á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
verses.WEB: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,
verses.ASV: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel; and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim ficou Joabe sobre todo aquele exército de Israel; e Benaia filho de Joiada sobre os quereteus e peleteus;
verses.RVR09: Así quedó Joab sobre todo el ejército de Israel; y Benaía hijo de Joiada sobre los Ceretheos y Peletheos;

verses.KJV: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
verses.WEB: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,
verses.ASV: and Adoram was over the men subject to taskwork; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Adorão sobre os tributos; e Josafá filho de Ailude, o cronista;
verses.RVR09: Y Adoram sobre los tributos; y Josaphat hijo de Ahillud, el canciller;

verses.KJV: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.WEB: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,
verses.ASV: and Sheva was scribe; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Seva, escriba; e Zadoque e Abiatar, sacerdotes;
verses.RVR09: Y Seba, escriba; y Sadoc y Abiathar, sacerdotes; é Ira Jaireo fué un jefe principal cerca de David.

verses.KJV: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.
verses.WEB: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.
verses.ASV: and also Ira the Jairite was chief minister unto David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ira jairita foi um chefe oficial de Davi.

verses.KJV: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the Lord. And the Lord answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
verses.WEB: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of the LORD. The LORD said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”
verses.ASV: And there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David sought the face of Jehovah. And Jehovah said, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put to death the Gibeonites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nos dias de Davi houve fome por três anos consecutivos. E Davi consultou ao SENHOR, e o SENHOR lhe disse: É por Saul, e por aquela casa de sangue; porque matou aos gibeonitas.
verses.RVR09: Y EN los días de David hubo hambre por tres años consecutivos. Y David consultó á Jehová, y Jehová le dijo: Es por Saúl, y por aquella casa de sangre; porque mató á los Gabaonitas.

verses.KJV: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)
verses.WEB: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);
verses.ASV: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei chamou aos gibeonitas, e falou-lhes. (Os gibeonitas não eram dos filhos de Israel, mas sim do resto dos amorreus, aos quais os filhos de Israel fizeram juramento; mas Saul havia procurado matá-los com motivo de zelo pelos filhos de Israel e de Judá).
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey llamó á los Gabaonitas, y hablóles. (Los Gabaonitas no eran de los hijos de Israel, sino del residuo de los Amorrheos, á los cuales los hijos de Israel habían hecho juramento: mas Saúl había procurado matarlos con motivo de celo por los hijos de Israel y de Judá.)

verses.KJV: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the Lord?
verses.WEB: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless the LORD’s inheritance?”
verses.ASV: and David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse, pois Davi aos gibeonitas: Que vos farei, e com que expiarei para que abençoeis à herança do SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Dijo pues David á los Gabaonitas: ¿Qué os haré, y con qué expiaré para que bendigáis á la heredad de Jehová?

verses.KJV: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
verses.WEB: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”
verses.ASV: And the Gibeonites said unto him, It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul, or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os gibeonitas lhe responderam: Não temos nós queixa sobre prata nem sobre ouro com Saul, e com sua casa: nem queremos que morra homem de Israel. E ele lhes disse: O que vós disserdes vos farei.
verses.RVR09: Y los Gabaonitas le respondieron: No tenemos nosotros querella sobre plata ni sobre oro con Saúl y con su casa: ni queremos que muera hombre de Israel. Y él les dijo: Lo que vosotros dijereis os haré.

verses.KJV: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,
verses.WEB: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,
verses.ASV: And they said unto the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us, [that] we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles responderam ao rei: Daquele homem que nos destruiu, e que tramou contra nós, para nos exterminar sem deixar nada de nós em todo aquele termo de Israel;
verses.RVR09: Y ellos respondieron al rey: De aquel hombre que nos destruyó, y que maquinó contra nosotros, para extirparnos sin dejar nada de nosotros en todo el término de Israel;

verses.KJV: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the Lord in Gibeah of Saul, whom the Lord did choose. And the king said, I will give them.
verses.WEB: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” The king said, “I will give them.”
verses.ASV: let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto Jehovah in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of Jehovah. And the king said, I will give them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deem-se a nós sete homens de seus filhos, para que os enforquemos ao SENHOR em Gibeá de Saul, o escolhido do SENHOR. E o rei disse: Eu os darei.
verses.RVR09: Dénsenos siete varones de sus hijos, para que los ahorquemos á Jehová en Gabaa de Saúl, el escogido de Jehová. Y el rey dijo: Yo los daré.

verses.KJV: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the Lord's oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.WEB: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.ASV: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Jehovah’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E perdoou o rei a Mefibosete, filho de Jônatas, filho de Saul, pelo juramento do SENHOR que havia entre eles, entre Davi e Jônatas filho de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Y perdonó el rey á Mephi-boseth, hijo de Jonathán, hijo de Saúl, por el juramento de Jehová que hubo entre ellos, entre David y Jonathán hijo de Saúl.

verses.KJV: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
verses.WEB: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
verses.ASV: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bare to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tomou o rei dois filhos de Rispa filha de Aiá, os quais ela havia dado à luz de Saul, a saber, a Armoni e a Mefibosete; e cinco filhos de Mical filha de Saul, os quais ela havia dado à luz de Adriel, filho de Barzilai meolatita;
verses.RVR09: Mas tomó el rey dos hijos de Rispa hija de Aja, los cuales ella había parido á Saúl, á saber, á Armoni y á Mephi-boseth; y cinco hijos de Michâl hija de Saúl, los cuales ella había parido á Adriel, hijo de Barzillai Molathita;

verses.KJV: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the Lord: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.WEB: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before the LORD, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.ASV: and he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the mountain before Jehovah, and they fell [all] seven together. And they were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entregou-os em mãos dos gibeonitas, e eles os enforcaram no monte diante do SENHOR: e morreram juntos aqueles sete, os quais foram mortos no tempo da colheita, nos primeiros dias, no princípio da colheita das cevadas.
verses.RVR09: Y entrególos en manos de los Gabaonitas, y ellos los ahorcaron en el monte delante de Jehová: y murieron juntos aquellos siete, los cuales fueron muertos en el tiempo de la siega, en los primeros días, en el principio de la siega de las cebadas.

verses.KJV: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.WEB: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.
verses.ASV: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water was poured upon them from heaven; and she suffered neither the birds of the heavens to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomando logo Rispa filha de Aiá um saco, estendeu-o sobre um penhasco, desde o princípio da colheita até que choveu sobre eles água do céu; e não deixou a nenhuma ave do céu assentar-se sobre eles de dia, nem animais do campo de noite.
verses.RVR09: Tomando luego Rispa hija de Aja un saco, tendióselo sobre un peñasco, desde el principio de la siega hasta que llovió sobre ellos agua del cielo; y no dejó á ninguna ave del cielo asentarse sobre ellos de día, ni bestias del campo de noche.

verses.KJV: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.WEB: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.ASV: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi dito a Davi o que fazia Rispa filha de Aiá, concubina de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Y fué dicho á David lo que hacía Rispa hija de Aja, concubina de Saúl.

verses.KJV: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
verses.WEB: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;
verses.ASV: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, in the day that the Philistines slew Saul in Gilboa;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi foi, e tomou os ossos de Saul e os ossos de Jônatas seu filho, dos homens de Jabes de Gileade, que os haviam furtado da praça de Bete-Seã, de onde os haviam pendurado os filisteus, quando os filisteus mataram a Saul em Gilboa:
verses.RVR09: Entonces David fué, y tomó los huesos de Saúl y los huesos de Jonathán su hijo, de los hombres de Jabes de Galaad, que los habían hurtado de la plaza de Beth-san, donde los habían colgado los Filisteos, cuando deshicieron los Filisteos á Saúl en Gilboa:

verses.KJV: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
verses.WEB: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.
verses.ASV: and he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son: and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez levar dali os ossos de Saul e os ossos de Jônatas seu filho; e juntaram também os ossos dos enforcados.
verses.RVR09: E hizo llevar de allí los huesos de Saúl y los huesos de Jonathán su hijo; y juntaron también los huesos de los ahorcados.

verses.KJV: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
verses.WEB: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.
verses.ASV: And they buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was entreated for the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sepultaram os ossos de Saul e os de seu filho Jônatas em terra de Benjamim, em Selá, no sepulcro de Quis seu pai; e fizeram tudo o que o rei havia mandado. Depois se aplacou Deus com a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y sepultaron los huesos de Saúl y los de su hijo Jonathán en tierra de Benjamín, en Sela, en el sepulcro de Cis su padre; é hicieron todo lo que el rey había mandado. Después se aplacó Dios con la tierra.

verses.KJV: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
verses.WEB: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;
verses.ASV: And the Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. And David waxed faint;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os filisteus voltaram a fazer guerra a Israel, Davi desceu com os seus servos, e lutaram contra os filisteus; e Davi se cansou.
verses.RVR09: Y como los Filisteos tornaron á hacer guerra á Israel, descendió David y sus siervos con él, y pelearon con los Filisteos: y David se cansó.

verses.KJV: And Ishbibenob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.
verses.WEB: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.
verses.ASV: and Ishbi-benob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred [shekels] of brass in weight, he being girded with a new [sword], thought to have slain David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nisso, Isbi-Benobe, que era dos filhos do gigante, e que cuja lança pesava trezentos siclos de bronze, estando ele cingido com uma espada nova, pretendeu ferir Davi.
verses.RVR09: En esto Isbi-benob, el cual era de los hijos del gigante, y el peso de cuya lanza era de trescientos siclos de metal, y tenía él ceñida una nueva espada, trató de herir á David:

verses.KJV: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.
verses.WEB: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”
verses.ASV: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succored him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the lamp of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Abisai, filho de Zeruia, o socorreu, feriu o filisteu, e o matou. Então os homens de Davi lhe juraram, dizendo: “Nunca mais sairás conosco à batalha, para que não apagues a lâmpada de Israel.”
verses.RVR09: Mas Abisai hijo de Sarvia le socorrió, é hirió al Filisteo, y matólo. Entonces los hombres de David le juraron, diciendo: Nunca más de aquí adelante saldrás con nosotros á batalla, porque no apagues la lámpara de Israel.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.
verses.WEB: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after this, that there was again war with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Outra segunda guerra houve depois em Gobe contra os filisteus; então Sibecai, husatita, feriu a Safe, que era dos filhos do gigante.
verses.RVR09: Otra segunda guerra hubo después en Gob contra los Filisteos: entonces Sibechâi Husathita hirió á Saph, que era de los hijos del gigante.

verses.KJV: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
verses.WEB: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.ASV: And there was again war with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim the Beth-lehemite slew Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.ALMEIDA: Outra guerra houve em Gobe contra os filisteus, na qual Elanã, filho de Jaaré-Oregim de Belém, feriu a Golias geteu, a haste de cuja lança era como um lançador de tear.
verses.RVR09: Otra guerra hubo en Gob contra los Filisteos, en la cual Elhanan, hijo de Jaare-oregim de Beth-lehem, hirió á Goliath Getheo, el asta de cuya lanza era como un enjullo de telar.

verses.KJV: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.WEB: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.
verses.ASV: And there was again war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois houve outra guerra em Gate, de onde houve um homem de grande altura, o qual tinha doze dedos nas mãos, e outros doze nos pés, vinte e quatro em todos: e também era dos filhos do gigante.
verses.RVR09: Después hubo otra guerra en Gath, donde hubo un hombre de grande altura, el cual tenía doce dedos en las manos, y otros doce en los pies, veinticuatro en todos: y también era de los hijos del gigante.

verses.KJV: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.
verses.WEB: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.
verses.ASV: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, slew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este desafiou a Israel, e foi morto por Jônatas, filho de Simeia irmão de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Este desafió á Israel, y matólo Jonathán, hijo de Sima hermano de David.

verses.KJV: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.WEB: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.ASV: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes quatro lhe haviam nascido ao gigante em Gate, os quais caíram pela mão de Davi e pela mão de seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Estos cuatro le habían nacido al gigante en Gath, los cuales cayeron por la mano de David, y por la mano de sus siervos.

verses.KJV: And David spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
verses.WEB: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,
verses.ASV: And David spake unto Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Davi ao SENHOR as palavras deste cântico, o dia que o SENHOR o livrou da mão de todos os seus inimigos e da mão de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Y HABLÓ David á Jehová las palabras de este cántico, el día que Jehová le había librado de la mano de todos sus enemigos, y de la mano de Saúl.

verses.KJV: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.WEB: and he said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
verses.ASV: and he said, Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: O SENHOR é minha rocha, e minha fortaleza, e meu libertador;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Jehová es mi roca, y mi fortaleza, y mi libertador;

verses.KJV: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
verses.WEB: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
verses.ASV: God, my rock, in him will I take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge; My saviour, thou savest me from violence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus de minha rocha, nele confiarei: Meu escudo, e o poder de minha salvação, minha fortaleza, e meu refúgio; Meu salvador, que me livrarás de violência.
verses.RVR09: Dios de mi roca, en él confiaré: mi escudo, y el cuerno de mi salud, mi fortaleza, y mi refugio; mi salvador, que me librarás de violencia.

verses.KJV: I will call on the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.WEB: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.ASV: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Invocarei ao SENHOR, digno de ser louvado. E serei salvo de meus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Invocaré á Jehová, digno de ser loado, y seré salvo de mis enemigos.

verses.KJV: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
verses.WEB: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.ASV: For the waves of death compassed me; The floods of ungodliness made me afraid:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando me cercaram ondas de morte, E ribeiros de iniquidade me assombraram,
verses.RVR09: Cuando me cercaron ondas de muerte, y arroyos de iniquidad me asombraron,

verses.KJV: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
verses.WEB: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.
verses.ASV: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: As cordas do Xeol me rodearam, e laços de morte me tomaram desprevenido.
verses.RVR09: Me rodearon los dolores del infierno, y me tomaron descuidado lazos de muerte.

verses.KJV: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
verses.WEB: In my distress, I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
verses.ASV: In my distress I called upon Jehovah; Yea, I called unto my God: And he heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry [came] into his ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tive angústia, invoquei ao SENHOR, E clamei a meu Deus: E ele ouviu minha voz desde seu templo; Chegou meu clamor a seus ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Tuve angustia, invoqué á Jehová, y clamé á mi Dios: y él oyó mi voz desde su templo; llegó mi clamor á sus oídos.

verses.KJV: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
verses.WEB: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
verses.ASV: Then the earth shook and trembled, The foundations of heaven quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra se moveu, e tremeu; Os fundamentos dos céus foram movidos, E se estremeceram, porque ele se irou.
verses.RVR09: La tierra se removió, y tembló; los fundamentos de los cielos fueron movidos, y se estremecieron, porque él se airó.

verses.KJV: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.WEB: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
verses.ASV: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subiu fumaça de suas narinas, E de sua boca fogo consumidor, Pelo qual se acenderam carvões.
verses.RVR09: Subió humo de sus narices, y de su boca fuego consumidor, por el cual se encendieron carbones.

verses.KJV: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
verses.WEB: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.ASV: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abaixo os céus, e desceu: Uma escuridão debaixo de seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Y abajó los cielos, y descendió: una oscuridad debajo de sus pies.

verses.KJV: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.WEB: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.
verses.ASV: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subiu sobre o querubim, e voou: Apareceu-se sobre as asas do vento.
verses.RVR09: Subió sobre el querubín, y voló: aparecióse sobre las alas del viento.

verses.KJV: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.WEB: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.ASV: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, Gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Armou tendas de escuridão ao redor de si; nuvens negras e espessas, carregadas de águas.
verses.RVR09: Puso tinieblas alrededor de sí á modo de pabellones; aguas negras y espesas nubes.

verses.KJV: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
verses.WEB: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
verses.ASV: At the brightness before him Coals of fire were kindled.
