verses.ALMEIDA: Do resplendor de sua presença Se acenderam brasas ardentes.
verses.RVR09: Del resplandor de su presencia se encendieron ascuas ardientes.

verses.KJV: The Lord thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
verses.WEB: The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
verses.ASV: Jehovah thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered his voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR trovejou desde os céus, E o Altíssimo deu sua voz;
verses.RVR09: Jehová tronó desde los cielos, y el Altísimo dió su voz;

verses.KJV: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.WEB: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.
verses.ASV: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; Lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lançou flechas, e desbaratou-os; Relampejou, e consumiu-os.
verses.RVR09: Arrojó saetas, y desbaratólos; relampagueó, y consumiólos.

verses.KJV: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.WEB: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.ASV: Then the channels of the sea appeared, The foundations of the world were laid bare, By the rebuke of Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então apareceram as profundezas do mar, E os fundamentos do mundo foram descobertos, À repreensão do SENHOR, Ao sopro do vento de seu nariz.
verses.RVR09: Entonces aparecieron los manantiales de la mar, y los fundamentos del mundo fueron descubiertos, á la reprensión de Jehová, al resoplido del aliento de su nariz.

verses.KJV: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
verses.WEB: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
verses.ASV: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estendeu sua mão do alto, e arrebatou-me, E tirou-me de copiosas águas.
verses.RVR09: Extendió su mano de lo alto, y arrebatóme, y sacóme de copiosas aguas.

verses.KJV: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.WEB: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.ASV: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From them that hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livrou-me de fortes inimigos, De aqueles que me aborreciam, os quais eram mais fortes que eu.
verses.RVR09: Libróme de fuertes enemigos, de aquellos que me aborrecían, los cuales eran más fuertes que yo.

verses.KJV: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.
verses.WEB: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
verses.ASV: They came upon me in the day of my calamity; But Jehovah was my stay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Atacaram-me no dia de minha calamidade; Mas o SENHOR foi meu apoio.
verses.RVR09: Asaltáronme en el día de mi calamidad; mas Jehová fué mi sostén.

verses.KJV: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.WEB: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.ASV: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tirou-me para um lugar amplo; Livrou-me, porque se agradou de mim.
verses.RVR09: Sacóme á anchura; libróme, porque puso su voluntad en mí.

verses.KJV: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.WEB: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
verses.ASV: Jehovah rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Remunerou-me o SENHOR conforme minha justiça: E conforme a limpeza de minhas mãos ele me pagou.
verses.RVR09: Remuneróme Jehová conforme á mi justicia; y conforme á la limpieza de mis manos, me dió la paga.

verses.KJV: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.WEB: For I have kept the LORD’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.ASV: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu guardei os caminhos do SENHOR; E não me apartei impiamente de meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo guardé los caminos de Jehová, y no me aparté impíamente de mi Dios.

verses.KJV: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.WEB: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.
verses.ASV: For all his ordinances were before me; And as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque diante de mim tenho todas suas ordenanças; E atento a seus estatutos, não me retirarei deles.
verses.RVR09: Porque delante de mí tengo todas sus ordenanzas; y atento á sus fueros, no me retiraré de ellos.

verses.KJV: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.WEB: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.ASV: I was also perfect toward him; And I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fui íntegro para com ele, E guardei-me de minha iniquidade.
verses.RVR09: Y fuí íntegro para con él, y guardéme de mi iniquidad.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
verses.ASV: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Remunerou-me, portanto, o SENHOR conforme minha justiça, E conforme minha limpeza diante de seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Remuneróme por tanto Jehová conforme á mi justicia, y conforme á mi limpieza delante de sus ojos.

verses.KJV: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
verses.WEB: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.
verses.ASV: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o bom és benigno, E com o íntegro te mostras íntegro;
verses.RVR09: Con el bueno eres benigno, y con el íntegro te muestras íntegro;

verses.KJV: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
verses.WEB: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
verses.ASV: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Limpo és para com o limpo, Mas com o perverso és rígido.
verses.RVR09: Limpio eres para con el limpio, mas con el perverso eres rígido.

verses.KJV: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
verses.WEB: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.
verses.ASV: And the afflicted people thou wilt save; But thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu salvas ao povo humilde; Mas teus olhos sobre os altivos, para abatê-los.
verses.RVR09: Y tú salvas al pueblo humilde; mas tus ojos sobre los altivos, para abatirlos.

verses.KJV: For thou art my lamp, O Lord: and the Lord will lighten my darkness.
verses.WEB: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.
verses.ASV: For thou art my lamp, O Jehovah; And Jehovah will lighten my darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu és minha lâmpada, ó SENHOR; o SENHOR dá luz às minhas trevas.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú eres mi lámpara, oh Jehová: Jehová da luz á mis tinieblas.

verses.KJV: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.WEB: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
verses.ASV: For by thee I run upon a troop; By my God do I leap over a wall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois contigo avançarei contra uma tropa, e com o meu Deus saltarei uma muralha.
verses.RVR09: Porque en ti romperé ejércitos, y con mi Dios saltaré las murallas.

verses.KJV: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.WEB: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
verses.ASV: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho de Deus [é] perfeito; a palavra do SENHOR [é] purificada, é escudo é de todos os que nele confiam.
verses.RVR09: Dios, perfecto su camino: la palabra de Jehová purificada, escudo es de todos los que en él esperan.

verses.KJV: For who is God, save the Lord? and who is a rock, save our God?
verses.WEB: For who is God, besides the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God?
verses.ASV: For who is God, save Jehovah? And who is a rock, save our God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque que Deus há a não ser o SENHOR? Ou quem é forte a não ser nosso Deus?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué Dios hay sino Jehová? ¿ó quién es fuerte sino nuestro Dios?

verses.KJV: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
verses.WEB: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
verses.ASV: God is my strong fortress; And he guideth the perfect in his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus é o que com virtude me corrobora, e o que tira os obstáculos do meu caminho;
verses.RVR09: Dios es el que con virtud me corrobora, y el que despeja mi camino;

verses.KJV: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.WEB: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.
verses.ASV: He maketh his feet like hinds’ [feet], And setteth me upon my high places.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que faz meus pés como de cervas, E o que me assenta em minhas alturas;
verses.RVR09: El que hace mis pies como de ciervas, y el que me asienta en mis alturas;

verses.KJV: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.WEB: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
verses.ASV: He teacheth my hands to war, So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que ensina minhas mãos para a luta, e proporciona que com meus braços quebre o arco de bronze.
verses.RVR09: El que enseña mis manos para la pelea, y da que con mis brazos quiebre el arco de acero.

verses.KJV: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.WEB: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.ASV: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation; And thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me deste também o escudo de tua salvação, E tua benignidade me acrescentou.
verses.RVR09: Tú me diste asimismo el escudo de tu salud, y tu benignidad me ha acrecentado.

verses.KJV: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
verses.WEB: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
verses.ASV: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; And my feet have not slipped.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu alargaste meus desfiladeiros debaixo de mim, Para que não titubeassem meus joelhos.
verses.RVR09: Tú ensanchaste mis pasos debajo de mí, para que no titubeasen mis rodillas.

verses.KJV: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
verses.WEB: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.
verses.ASV: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; Neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perseguirei a meus inimigos, e os quebrantarei; E não me voltarei até que os acabe.
verses.RVR09: Perseguiré á mis enemigos, y quebrantarélos; y no me volveré hasta que los acabe.

verses.KJV: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.WEB: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
verses.ASV: And I have consumed them, and smitten them through, so that they cannot arise: Yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os consumirei, e os ferirei, e não se levantarão; E cairão debaixo de meus pés.
verses.RVR09: Los consumiré, y los heriré, y no se levantarán; y caerán debajo de mis pies.

verses.KJV: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
verses.WEB: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.ASV: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cingiste-me de força para a batalha, E fizeste prostrar debaixo de mim os que contra mim se levantaram.
verses.RVR09: Ceñísteme de fortaleza para la batalla, y postraste debajo de mí los que contra mí se levantaron.

verses.KJV: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.WEB: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
verses.ASV: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me deste o pescoço de meus inimigos, De meus aborrecedores, que eu os destruísse.
verses.RVR09: Tú me diste la cerviz de mis enemigos, de mis aborrecedores, y que yo los destruyese.

verses.KJV: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.
verses.WEB: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
verses.ASV: They looked, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olharam, e não houve quem os livrasse; Ao SENHOR, mas não lhes respondeu.
verses.RVR09: Miraron, y no hubo quien los librase; á Jehová, mas no les respondió.

verses.KJV: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.
verses.WEB: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.
verses.ASV: Then did I beat them small as the dust of the earth, I did crush them as the mire of the streets, and did spread them abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu os esmiuçarei como pó da terra; Eu os pisarei como à lama das ruas, e os dissiparei.
verses.RVR09: Yo los desmenuzaré como polvo de la tierra; hollarélos como á lodo de las plazas, y los disiparé.

verses.KJV: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
verses.WEB: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.
verses.ASV: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people; Thou hast kept me to be the head of the nations: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me livraste das brigas dos povos; Tu me guardaste para eu que fosse cabeça de nações: Povos que eu não conhecia me serviram.
verses.RVR09: Tú me libraste de contiendas de pueblos: tú me guardaste para que fuese cabeza de gentes: pueblos que no conocía, me sirvieron.

verses.KJV: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
verses.WEB: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.
verses.ASV: The foreigners shall submit themselves unto me: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os estrangeiros se sujeitaram a mim; ao ouvirem, me obedeciam.
verses.RVR09: Los extraños titubeaban á mí: en oyendo, me obedecían.

verses.KJV: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
verses.WEB: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
verses.ASV: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os estrangeiros desfaleciam, E tremiam em seus esconderijos.
verses.RVR09: Los extraños desfallecían, y temblaban en sus escondrijos.

verses.KJV: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
verses.WEB: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
verses.ASV: Jehovah liveth; And blessed be my rock; And exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
verses.ALMEIDA: Viva o SENHOR, e seja bendita minha rocha; Seja exaltado o Deus, a rocha de meu salvamento:
verses.RVR09: Viva Jehová, y sea bendita mi roca; sea ensalzado el Dios, la roca de mi salvamento:

verses.KJV: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me.
verses.WEB: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,
verses.ASV: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And that bringeth down peoples under me,
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus que me vingou, E sujeita os povos debaixo de mim:
verses.RVR09: El Dios que me ha vengado, y sujeta los pueblos debajo de mí;

verses.KJV: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.WEB: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
verses.ASV: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: Yea, thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que me tira dentre meus inimigos: Tu me tiraste em alto dentre os que se levantaram contra mim: Livraste-me do homem de iniquidades.
verses.RVR09: Y que me saca de entre mis enemigos: tú me sacaste en alto de entre los que se levantaron contra mí: librásteme del varón de iniquidades.

verses.KJV: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
verses.ASV: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the nations, And will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu te confessarei entre as nações, ó SENHOR, E cantarei a teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto yo te confesaré entre las gentes, oh Jehová, y cantaré á tu nombre.

verses.KJV: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.WEB: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”
verses.ASV: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele que engrandece as saúdes de seu rei, E faz misericórdia a seu ungido, A Davi, e à sua semente, para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El que engrandece las saludes de su rey, y hace misericordia á su ungido, á David, y á su simiente, para siempre.

verses.KJV: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
verses.WEB: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
verses.ASV: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse saith, And the man who was raised on high saith, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet psalmist of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as últimas palavras de Davi. Disse Davi filho de Jessé, Disse aquele homem que foi levantado alto, O ungido do Deus de Jacó, O suave em cânticos de Israel:
verses.RVR09: ESTAS son las postreras palabras de David. Dijo David hijo de Isaí, dijo aquel varón que fué levantado alto, el ungido del Dios de Jacob, el suave en cánticos de Israel:

verses.KJV: The Spirit of the Lord spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
verses.WEB: “The LORD’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
verses.ASV: The Spirit of Jehovah spake by me, And his word was upon my tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: O espírito do SENHOR falou por mim, E sua palavra foi em minha língua.
verses.RVR09: El espíritu de Jehová ha hablado por mí, y su palabra ha sido en mi lengua.

verses.KJV: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.
verses.WEB: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,
verses.ASV: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spake to me: One that ruleth over men righteously, That ruleth in the fear of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus de Israel disse, Falou-me o Forte de Israel: O dominador dos homens será justo. Dominador em temor de Deus.
verses.RVR09: El Dios de Israel ha dicho, hablóme el Fuerte de Israel: El señoreador de los hombres será justo, señoreador en temor de Dios.

verses.KJV: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verses.WEB: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’
verses.ASV: [He shall be] as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, A morning without clouds, [When] the tender grass [springeth] out of the earth, Through clear shining after rain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será como a luz da manhã quando sai o sol, Da manhã sem nuvens; Quando a erva da terra brota Por meio do resplendor depois da chuva.
verses.RVR09: Será como la luz de la mañana cuando sale el sol, de la mañana sin nubes; cuando la hierba de la tierra brota por medio del resplandor después de la lluvia.

verses.KJV: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
verses.WEB: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?
verses.ASV: Verily my house is not so with God; Yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, Ordered in all things, and sure: For it is all my salvation, and all [my] desire, Although he maketh it not to grow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não está minha casa com Deus? Pois ele fez comigo um pacto perpétuo, Ordenado em todas as coisas, e será guardado; pois não é dele que brotará toda a minha salvação e todo o meu desejo?
verses.RVR09: No así mi casa para con Dios: sin embargo él ha hecho conmigo pacto perpetuo, ordenado en todas las cosas, y será guardado; bien que toda esta mi salud, y todo mi deseo no lo haga él florecer todavía.

verses.KJV: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
verses.WEB: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.
verses.ASV: But the ungodly shall be all of them as thorns to be thrust away, Because they cannot be taken with the hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os malignos serão todos eles como espinhos arrancados, os quais ninguém toma com a mão;
verses.RVR09: Mas los de Belial serán todos ellos como espinas arrancadas, las cuales nadie toma con la mano;

verses.KJV: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
verses.WEB: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”
verses.ASV: But the man that toucheth them Must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear: And they shall be utterly burned with fire in [their] place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso o que quer tocar neles, Arma-se de ferro e de haste de lança, e são queimados em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Sino que el que quiere tocar en ellas, ármase de hierro y de asta de lanza, y son quemadas en su lugar.

verses.KJV: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.
verses.ASV: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os nomes dos valentes que teve Davi: Josebe-Bassebete, o taquemonita, principal dos capitães: era este Adino o eznita, que matou em uma ocasião sobre oitocentos homens.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los nombres de los valientes que tuvo David: El Tachmonita, que se sentaba en cátedra, principal de los capitanes: era éste Adino el Eznita, que mató en una ocasión sobre ochocientos hombres.

verses.KJV: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
verses.WEB: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.
verses.ASV: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois deste, Eleazar, filho de Dodô de Aoí, foi dos três valentes que estavam com Davi, quando desafiaram aos filisteus que se haviam juntado ali à batalha, e subiram os de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Después de éste, Eleazar, hijo de Dodo de Ahohi, fué de los tres valientes que estaban con David, cuando desafiaron á los Filisteos que se habían juntado allí á la batalla, y subieron los de Israel.

verses.KJV: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the Lord wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
verses.WEB: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and the LORD worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.
verses.ASV: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword; and Jehovah wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take spoil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este, levantando-se, feriu aos filisteus, até que sua mão se cansou, e ficou grudada em sua espada. Aquele dia o SENHOR fez grande salvação; e voltou-se o povo depois dele somente para tomar o despojo.
verses.RVR09: Este, levantándose, hirió á los Filisteos hasta que su mano se cansó, y quedósele contraída á la espada. Aquel día Jehová hizo gran salud: y volvióse el pueblo en pos de él solamente á tomar el despojo.

verses.KJV: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.WEB: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.ASV: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois deste foi Samá, filho de Agé araíta: que havendo os filisteus se juntado em uma aldeia, havia ali um terreno cheio de lentilhas, e o povo havia fugido diante dos filisteus:
verses.RVR09: Después de éste fué Samma, hijo de Age Araita: que habiéndose juntado los Filisteos en una aldea, había allí una suerte de tierra llena de lentejas, y el pueblo había huído delante de los Filisteos:

verses.KJV: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the Lord wrought a great victory.
verses.WEB: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD worked a great victory.
verses.ASV: But he stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and slew the Philistines; and Jehovah wrought a great victory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele então se parou em meio do terreno e defendeu-o, e feriu aos filisteus; e o SENHOR fez uma grande salvação.
verses.RVR09: El entonces se paró en medio de la suerte de tierra, y defendióla, é hirió á los Filisteos; y Jehová hizo una gran salud.

verses.KJV: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.WEB: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ASV: And three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E três dos trinta principais desceram e vieram em tempo da colheita a Davi à cova de Adulão: e o acampamento dos filisteus estava no vale de Refaim.
verses.RVR09: Y tres de los treinta principales descendieron y vinieron en tiempo de la siega á David á la cueva de Adullam: y el campo de los Filisteos estaba en el valle de Raphaim.

verses.KJV: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.WEB: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.ASV: And David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Davi então estava na fortaleza, e a guarnição dos filisteus estava em Belém.
verses.RVR09: David entonces estaba en la fortaleza, y la guarnición de los Filisteos estaba en Beth-lehem.

verses.KJV: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!
verses.WEB: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
verses.ASV: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi teve desejo, e disse: Quem me dera a beber da água da cisterna de Belém, que está à porta!
verses.RVR09: Y David tuvo deseo, y dijo: ¡Quién me diera á beber del agua de la cisterna de Beth-lehem, que está á la puerta!

verses.KJV: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os três valentes irromperam pelo acampamento dos filisteus, e tiraram água da cisterna de Belém, que estava à porta; e tomaram, e trouxeram-na a Davi: mas ele não a quis beber, mas derramou-a ao SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces los tres valientes rompieron por el campo de los Filisteos, y sacaron agua de la cisterna de Beth-lehem, que estaba á la puerta; y tomaron, y trajéronla á David: mas él no la quiso beber, sino derramóla á Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: And he said, Be it far from me, O Lord, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verses.WEB: He said, “Be it far from me, LORD, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
verses.ASV: And he said, Be it far from me, O Jehovah, that I should do this: [shall I drink] the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Longe seja de mim, ó SENHOR, que eu faça isto. Eis de beber eu o sangue dos homens que foram com perigo de sua vida? E não quis bebê-la. Os três valentes fizeram isto.
verses.RVR09: Lejos sea de mí, oh Jehová, que yo haga esto. ¿He de beber yo la sangre de los varones que fueron con peligro de su vida? Y no quiso beberla. Los tres valientes hicieron esto.

verses.KJV: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.
verses.WEB: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
verses.ASV: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abisai irmão de Joabe, filho de Zeruia, foi o principal dos três; o qual levantou sua lança contra trezentos, que matou; e teve nome entre os três.
verses.RVR09: Y Abisai hermano de Joab, hijo de Sarvia, fué el principal de los tres; el cual alzó su lanza contra trescientos, que mató; y tuvo nombre entre los tres.

verses.KJV: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
verses.WEB: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.
verses.ASV: Was he not most honorable of the three? therefore he was made their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the [first] three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele era o mais preeminente dos três, e o primeiro deles; mas não chegou aos três primeiros.
verses.RVR09: El era el más aventajado de los tres, y el primero de ellos; mas no llegó á los tres primeros.

verses.KJV: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
verses.WEB: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.
verses.ASV: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he slew the two [sons of] Ariel of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois, Benaia filho de Joiada, filho de um homem esforçado, grande em feitos, de Cabzeel. Este feriu dois leões de Moabe: e ele mesmo desceu, e feriu um leão em meio de um fosso no tempo da neve:
verses.RVR09: Después, Benaía hijo de Joiada, hijo de un varón esforzado, grande en hechos, de Cabseel. Este hirió dos leones de Moab: y él mismo descendió, é hirió un león en medio de un foso en el tiempo de la nieve:

verses.KJV: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.WEB: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.ASV: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também feriu ele a um egípcio, homem de grande estatura; e tinha o egípcio uma lança em sua mão; mas desceu a ele com um cajado, e arrebatou ao egípcio a lança da mão, e o matou com sua própria lança.
verses.RVR09: También hirió él á un Egipcio, hombre de grande estatura: y tenía el Egipcio una lanza en su mano; mas descendió á él con un palo, y arrebató al Egipcio la lanza de la mano, y matólo con su propia lanza.

verses.KJV: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
verses.WEB: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.ASV: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto fez Benaia filho de Joiada, e teve nome entre os três valentes.
verses.RVR09: Esto hizo Benaía hijo de Joiada, y tuvo nombre entre los tres valientes.

verses.KJV: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.
verses.WEB: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.
verses.ASV: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he attained not to the [first] three. And David set him over his guard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos trinta foi o mais preeminente; mas não chegou aos três primeiros. E Davi o pôs em seu conselho.
verses.RVR09: De los treinta fué el más aventajado; pero no llegó á los tres primeros. Y púsolo David en su consejo.

verses.KJV: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.WEB: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.ASV: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
verses.ALMEIDA: Asael irmão de Joabe foi dos trinta; Elanã filho de Dodô de Belém;
verses.RVR09: Asael hermano de Joab fué de los treinta; Elhaanan hijo de Dodo de Beth-lehem;

verses.KJV: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.WEB: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.ASV: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Samá harodita, Elica harodita;
verses.RVR09: Samma de Harodi, Elica de Harodi;

verses.KJV: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.WEB: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.ASV: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Heles paltita, Ira, filho de Iques, de Tecoa;
verses.RVR09: Heles de Palti, Hira, hijo de Jecces, de Tecoa;

verses.KJV: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.WEB: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.ASV: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Abiezer de Anatote, Mebunai husatita;
verses.RVR09: Abiezer de Anathoth, Mebunnai de Husa;

verses.KJV: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.WEB: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.ASV: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Zalmom aoíta, Maarai de Netofate;
verses.RVR09: Selmo de Hahoh, Maharai de Netophath;

verses.KJV: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.WEB: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.ASV: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.ALMEIDA: Helebe filho de Baaná de Netofate, Itai filho de Ribai de Gibeá dos filhos de Benjamim;
verses.RVR09: Helec hijo de Baana de Netophath, Ittai hijo de Ribai de Gabaa de los hijos de Benjamín;

verses.KJV: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
verses.WEB: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.
verses.ASV: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benaia piratonita, Hidai do ribeiro de Gaás;
verses.RVR09: Benaía Pirathonita, Hiddai del arroyo de Gaas;

verses.KJV: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.WEB: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.ASV: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Abi-Albom de Arbate, Azmavete barumita;
verses.RVR09: Abi-albon de Arbath, Asmaveth de Barhum;

verses.KJV: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.WEB: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.ASV: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eleaba de Saalbom, Jônatas dos filhos de Jásen;
verses.RVR09: Elihaba de Saalbón, Jonathán de los hijos de Jassén;

verses.KJV: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
verses.WEB: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,
verses.ASV: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Samá de Harar, Aião filho de Sarar de Harar.
verses.RVR09: Samma de Arar, Ahiam hijo de Sarar de Arar.

verses.KJV: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.WEB: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.ASV: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Elifelete filho de Aasbai filho do maacatita; Eliã filho de Aitofel gilonita;
verses.RVR09: Elipheleth hijo de Asbai hijo de Maachâti; Eliam hijo de Achîtophel de Gelón;

verses.KJV: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.WEB: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.ASV: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hezrai do Carmelo, Paarai arbita;
verses.RVR09: Hesrai del Carmelo, Pharai de Arbi;

verses.KJV: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.WEB: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.ASV: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Igal filho de Natã de Zobá, Bani gadita;
verses.RVR09: Igheal hijo de Nathán de Soba, Bani de Gadi;

verses.KJV: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.WEB: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.ASV: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armorbearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Zeleque de Amom, Naarai de Beerote, escudeiro de Joabe filho de Zeruia;
verses.RVR09: Selec de Ammón, Naharai de Beeroth, escudero de Joab hijo de Sarvia;

verses.KJV: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
verses.WEB: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.ASV: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ira itrita, Garebe itrita;
verses.RVR09: Ira de Ithri, Gareb de Ithri;

verses.KJV: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
verses.WEB: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.
verses.ASV: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Urias, o heteu. Entre todos, trinta e sete.
verses.RVR09: Uría Hetheo. Entre todos treinta y siete.

verses.KJV: And again the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.
verses.WEB: Again the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”
verses.ASV: And again the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, Go, number Israel and Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou o furor do SENHOR a acender-se contra Israel, e incitou a Davi contra eles a que dissesse: Vai, conta a Israel e a Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y VOLVIÓ el furor de Jehová á encenderse contra Israel, é incitó á David contra ellos á que dijese: Ve, cuenta á Israel y á Judá.

verses.KJV: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.
verses.WEB: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”
verses.ASV: And the king said to Joab the captain of the host, who was with him, Go now to and fro through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the sum of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o rei a Joabe, general do exército que tinha consigo: Rodeia todas as tribos de Israel, desde Dã até Berseba, e contai o povo, para que eu saiba o número da gente.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el rey á Joab, general del ejército que tenía consigo: Rodea todas las tribus de Israel, desde Dan hasta Beer-seba, y contad el pueblo, para que yo sepa el número de la gente.

verses.KJV: And Joab said unto the king, Now the Lord thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?
verses.WEB: Joab said to the king, “Now may the LORD your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”
verses.ASV: And Joab said unto the king, Now Jehovah thy God add unto the people, how many soever they may be, a hundredfold; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joabe respondeu ao rei: Acrescente o SENHOR teu Deus ao povo cem vezes tanto quanto são, e que o veja meu senhor ao rei; mas para que quer isto meu senhor o rei?
verses.RVR09: Y Joab respondió al rey: Añada Jehová tu Dios al pueblo cien veces tanto como son, y que lo vea mi señor el rey; mas ¿para qué quiere esto mi señor el rey?

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
verses.WEB: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.
verses.ASV: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a palavra do rei pôde mais que Joabe, e que os capitães do exército. Saiu, pois, Joabe, com os capitães do exército, de diante do rei, para contar o povo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Empero la palabra del rey pudo más que Joab, y que los capitanes del ejército. Salió pues Joab, con los capitanes del ejército, de delante del rey, para contar el pueblo de Israel.

verses.KJV: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
verses.WEB: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;
verses.ASV: And they passed over the Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and unto Jazer:
verses.ALMEIDA: E passando o Jordão assentaram em Aroer, à direita da cidade que está em meio do ribeiro de Gade e junto a Jazer.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando el Jordán asentaron en Aroer, á la mano derecha de la ciudad que está en medio de la arroyada de Gad y junto á Jazer.

verses.KJV: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,
verses.WEB: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,
verses.ASV: then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and round about to Sidon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois vieram a Gileade, e à terra baixa de Hodsi: e dali vieram a Dã-Jaã e ao redor de Sídon.
verses.RVR09: Después vinieron á Galaad, y á la tierra baja de Absi: y de allí vinieron á Dan-jaán y alrededor de Sidón.

verses.KJV: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beersheba.
verses.WEB: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.
verses.ASV: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beer-sheba.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram logo à fortaleza de Tiro, e a todas as cidades dos heveus e dos cananeus; e saíram ao sul de Judá, a Berseba.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron luego á la fortaleza de Tiro, y á todas las ciudades de los Heveos y de los Cananeos; y salieron al mediodía de Judá, á Beer-seba.

verses.KJV: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.WEB: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.ASV: So when they had gone to and fro through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que andaram toda a terra, voltaram a Jerusalém ao fim de nove meses e vinte dias.
verses.RVR09: Y después que hubieron andado toda la tierra, volvieron á Jerusalem al cabo de nueve meses y veinte días.

verses.KJV: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
verses.WEB: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
verses.ASV: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joabe deu a conta do número do povo ao rei; e foram os de Israel oitocentos mil homens fortes que tiravam espada; e dos de Judá quinhentos mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Y Joab dió la cuenta del número del pueblo al rey; y fueron los de Israel ochocientos mil hombres fuertes que sacaban espada; y de los de Judá quinientos mil hombres.

verses.KJV: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the Lord, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O Lord, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.WEB: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, the LORD, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”
verses.ASV: And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto Jehovah, I have sinned greatly in that which I have done: but now, O Jehovah, put away, I beseech thee, the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que Davi contou o povo, sentiu-se atormentado em seu coração; e disse Davi ao SENHOR: Eu pequei gravemente por haver feito isto; mas agora, ó SENHOR, rogo-te que tires o pecado de teu servo, porque eu agi muito loucamente.
verses.RVR09: Y después que David hubo contado el pueblo, punzóle su corazón; y dijo David á Jehová: Yo he pecado gravemente por haber hecho esto; mas ahora, oh Jehová, ruégote que quites el pecado de tu siervo, porque yo he obrado muy neciamente.

verses.KJV: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the Lord came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.WEB: When David rose up in the morning, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.ASV: And when David rose up in the morning, the word of Jehovah came unto the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E pela manhã, quando Davi se levantou, veio a palavra do SENHOR a Gade profeta, vidente de Davi, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y por la mañana, cuando David se hubo levantado, fué palabra de Jehová á Gad profeta, vidente de David, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.WEB: “Go and speak to David, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
verses.ASV: Go and speak unto David, Thus saith Jehovah, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, e dize a Davi: Assim disse o SENHOR: Três coisas te ofereço: tu te escolherás uma delas, a qual eu faça.
verses.RVR09: Ve, y di á David: Así ha dicho Jehová: Tres cosas te ofrezco: tú te escogerás una de ellas, la cual yo haga.

verses.KJV: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
verses.WEB: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”
verses.ASV: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thy foes while they pursue thee? or shall there be three days’ pestilence in thy land? now advise thee, and consider what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio, pois, Gade a Davi, e notificou-lhe, e disse-lhe: Queres que te venham sete anos de fome em tua terra? Ou que fujas três meses diante de teus inimigos, e que eles te persigam? Ou que três dias haja pestilência em tua terra? Pensa agora, e olha o que responderei ao que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Vino pues Gad á David, é intimóle, y díjole: ¿Quieres que te vengan siete años de hambre en tu tierra? ¿ó que huyas tres meses delante de tus enemigos, y que ellos te persigan? ¿ó que tres días haya pestilencia en tu tierra? Piensa ahora, y mira qué responderé al que me ha enviado.

verses.KJV: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the Lord; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.WEB: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”
verses.ASV: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of Jehovah; for his mercies are great; and let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi disse a Gade: Em grande angústia estou: rogo que caia na mão do SENHOR, porque suas misericórdias são muitas, e que não caia eu em mãos de homens.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David dijo á Gad: En grande angustia estoy: ruego que caiga en la mano de Jehová, porque sus miseraciones son muchas, y que no caiga yo en manos de hombres.

verses.KJV: So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.
verses.WEB: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.
verses.ASV: So Jehovah sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed; and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou o SENHOR pestilência a Israel desde a manhã até o tempo assinalado: e morreram do povo, desde Dã até Berseba, setenta mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Y envió Jehová pestilencia á Israel desde la mañana hasta el tiempo señalado: y murieron del pueblo, desde Dan hasta Beer-seba, setenta mil hombres.

verses.KJV: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.WEB: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” The LORD’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.ASV: And when the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Jehovah repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough; now stay thy hand. And the angel of Jehovah was by the threshing-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o anjo estendeu sua mão sobre Jerusalém para destruí-la, o SENHOR se arrependeu daquele mal, e disse ao anjo que destruía o povo: Basta agora; detém tua mão. Então o anjo do SENHOR estava junto à eira de Araúna, o jebuseu.
verses.RVR09: Y como el ángel extendió su mano sobre Jerusalem para destruirla, Jehová se arrepintió de aquel mal, y dijo al ángel que destruía el pueblo: Basta ahora; detén tu mano. Entonces el ángel de Jehová estaba junto á la era de Arauna Jebuseo.

verses.KJV: And David spake unto the Lord when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.
verses.WEB: David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”
verses.ASV: And David spake unto Jehovah when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? let thy hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi disse ao SENHOR, quando viu ao anjo que feria ao povo: Eu pequei, eu fiz a maldade: que fizeram estas ovelhas? Rogo-te que tua mão se torne contra mim, e contra a casa de meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y David dijo á Jehová, cuando vió al ángel que hería al pueblo: Yo pequé, yo hice la maldad: ¿qué hicieron estas ovejas? Ruégote que tu mano se torne contra mí, y contra la casa de mi padre.

verses.KJV: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.WEB: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”
verses.ASV: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gade veio a Davi aquele dia, e disse-lhe: Sobe, e faze um altar ao SENHOR na era de Araúna jebuseu.
verses.RVR09: Y Gad vino á David aquel día, y díjole: Sube, y haz un altar á Jehová en la era de Arauna Jebuseo.

verses.KJV: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the Lord commanded.
verses.WEB: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as the LORD commanded.
verses.ASV: And David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Jehovah commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu Davi, conforme ao dito de Gade, que o SENHOR lhe havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: Y subió David, conforme al dicho de Gad, que Jehová le había mandado.

verses.KJV: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
verses.WEB: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.ASV: And Araunah looked forth, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhando Araúna, viu ao rei e a seus servos que passavam a ele. Saindo então Araúna, inclinou-se diante do rei até terra.
verses.RVR09: Y mirando Arauna, vió al rey y á sus siervos que pasaban á él. Saliendo entonces Arauna, inclinóse delante del rey hacia tierra.

verses.KJV: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the Lord, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.WEB: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
verses.ASV: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshing-floor of thee, to build an altar unto Jehovah, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Araúna disse: Por que vem meu senhor o rei a seu servo? E Davi respondeu: Para comprar de ti a eira, para edificar altar ao SENHOR, a fim de que a mortandade cesse do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y Arauna dijo: ¿Por qué viene mi señor el rey á su siervo? Y David respondió: Para comprar de ti la era, para edificar altar á Jehová, á fin de que la mortandad cese del pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.
verses.WEB: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.
verses.ASV: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, the oxen for the burnt-offering, and the threshing instruments and the yokes of the oxen for the wood:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Araúna disse a Davi: Tome e sacrifique meu senhor o rei o que bem lhe parecer; eis aqui bois para o holocausto; e trilhos e outros equipamentos de bois para lenha:
verses.RVR09: Y Arauna dijo á David: Tome y sacrifique mi señor el rey lo que bien le pareciere; he aquí bueyes para el holocausto; y trillos y otros pertrechos de bueyes para leña:

verses.KJV: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The Lord thy God accept thee.
verses.WEB: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”
verses.ASV: all this, O king, doth Araunah give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, Jehovah thy God accept thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo isto, ó rei, Araúna dá ao rei. Logo disse Araúna ao rei: o SENHOR teu Deus se agrade de ti.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo da como un rey Arauna al rey. Luego dijo Arauna al rey: Jehová tu Dios te sea propicio.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the Lord my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.WEB: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.ASV: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will verily buy it of thee at a price; neither will I offer burnt-offerings unto Jehovah my God which cost me nothing. So David bought the threshing-floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse a Araúna: Não, mas por preço o comprarei de ti; porque não oferecerei ao SENHOR meu Deus holocaustos gastando nada. Então Davi comprou a eira e os bois por cinquenta siclos de prata.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey dijo á Arauna: No, sino por precio te lo compraré; porque no ofreceré á Jehová mi Dios holocaustos por nada. Entonces David compró la era y los bueyes por cincuenta siclos de plata.

verses.KJV: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the Lord was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
verses.WEB: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.
verses.ASV: And David built there an altar unto Jehovah, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings. So Jehovah was entreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali Davi edificou um altar ao SENHOR, e sacrificou holocaustos e ofertas pacíficas; e o SENHOR se aplacou com a terra, e cessou a praga de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó allí David un altar á Jehová, y sacrificó holocaustos y pacíficos; y Jehová se aplacó con la tierra, y cesó la plaga de Israel.

verses.KJV: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.WEB: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.
verses.ASV: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o rei Davi era velho, e de idade avançada, cobriam-lhe de roupas, mas não se aquecia.
verses.RVR09: COMO el rey David era viejo, y entrado en días, cubríanle de vestidos, mas no se calentaba.

verses.KJV: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.WEB: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram-lhe portanto seus servos: Busquem a meu senhor o rei uma moça virgem, para que esteja diante do rei, e o abrigue, e durma a seu lado, e aquecerá a meu senhor o rei.
verses.RVR09: Dijéronle por tanto sus siervos: Busquen á mi señor el rey una moza virgen, para que esté delante del rey, y lo abrigue, y duerma á su lado, y calentará á mi señor el rey.

verses.KJV: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.WEB: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.ASV: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E buscaram uma moça formosa por todo o termo de Israel, e acharam a Abisague sunamita, e trouxeram-na ao rei.
verses.RVR09: Y buscaron una moza hermosa por todo el término de Israel, y hallaron á Abisag Sunamita, y trajéronla al rey.

verses.KJV: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.WEB: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.
verses.ASV: And the damsel was very fair; and she cherished the king, and ministered to him; but the king knew her not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a moça era formosa, a qual aquecia ao rei, e lhe servia: mas o rei nunca a conheceu.

verses.RVR09: Entonces Benaía hijo de Joiada respondió al rey, y dijo: Amén. Así lo diga Jehová, Dios de mi señor el rey.

verses.KJV: As the Lord hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.WEB: As the LORD has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”
verses.ASV: As Jehovah hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da maneira que o SENHOR foi com meu senhor o rei, assim seja com Salomão; e ele faça maior seu trono que o trono de meu senhor o rei Davi.
verses.RVR09: De la manera que Jehová ha sido con mi señor el rey, así sea con Salomón; y él haga mayor su trono que el trono de mi señor el rey David.

verses.KJV: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.WEB: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.ASV: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desceu Zadoque sacerdote, e Natã profeta, e Benaia filho de Joiada, e os quereteus e os peleteus, e fizeram subir a Salomão na mula do rei Davi, e levaram-no a Giom.
verses.RVR09: Y descendió Sadoc sacerdote, y Nathán profeta, y Benaía hijo de Joiada, y los Ceretheos y los Peletheos, é hicieron subir á Salomón en la mula del rey David, y lleváronlo á Gihón.

verses.KJV: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verses.WEB: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”
verses.ASV: And Zadok the priest took the horn of oil out of the Tent, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, [Long] live king Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando Zadoque sacerdote o chifre do azeite do tabernáculo, ungiu a Salomão: e tocaram trombeta, e disse todo o povo: Viva o rei Salomão!
verses.RVR09: Y tomando Sadoc sacerdote el cuerno del aceite del tabernáculo, ungió á Salomón: y tocaron trompeta, y dijo todo el pueblo: ¡Viva el rey Salomón!

verses.KJV: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.WEB: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.
verses.ASV: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois subiu todo o povo depois dele, e cantava a gente com flautas, e faziam grandes alegrias, que parecia que a terra se fendia com o barulho deles.
verses.RVR09: Después subió todo el pueblo en pos de él, y cantaba la gente con flautas, y hacían grandes alegrías, que parecía que la tierra se hundía con el clamor de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.WEB: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”
verses.ASV: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouviu-o Adonias, e todos os convidados que com ele estavam, quando já haviam acabado de comer. E ouvindo Joabe o som da trombeta, disse: Por que se alvoroça a cidade com estrondo?
verses.RVR09: Y oyólo Adonía, y todos los convidados que con él estaban, cuando ya habían acabado de comer. Y oyendo Joab el sonido de la trompeta, dijo: ¿Por qué se alborota la ciudad con estruendo?

verses.KJV: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.WEB: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”
verses.ASV: While he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said, Come in; for thou art a worthy man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estando ainda ele falando, eis que Jônatas, filho do sacerdote Abiatar, veio, ao qual Adonias disse: Entra, porque és homem digno, e trarás boas notícias.
verses.RVR09: Estando aún él hablando, he aquí Jonathán hijo de Abiathar sacerdote vino, al cual dijo Adonía: Entra, porque tú eres hombre de esfuerzo, y traerás buenas nuevas.

verses.KJV: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.WEB: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.
verses.ASV: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas respondeu, e disse a Adonias: Certamente nosso senhor, o rei Davi, constituiu rei a Salomão;
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán respondió, y dijo á Adonía: Ciertamente nuestro señor el rey David ha hecho rey á Salomón:

verses.KJV: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:
verses.WEB: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.
verses.ASV: and the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei enviou com ele o sacerdote Zadoque o profeta Natã, Benaia, filho de Joiada, e também os quereteus e os peleteus, os quais lhe fizeram subir na mula do rei;
verses.RVR09: Y el rey ha enviado con él á Sadoc sacerdote y á Nathán profeta, y á Benaía hijo de Joiada, y también á los Ceretheos y á los Peletheos, los cuales le hicieron subir en la mula del rey;

verses.KJV: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
verses.WEB: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
verses.ASV: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon; and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote Zadoque e o profeta Natã o ungiram em Giom como rei, e dali subiram alegres, e a cidade está cheia de alvoroço. Este é o barulho que ouvistes.
verses.RVR09: Y Sadoc sacerdote y Nathán profeta lo han ungido en Gihón por rey: y de allá han subido con alegrías, y la ciudad está llena de estruendo. Este es el alboroto que habéis oído.

verses.KJV: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.WEB: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.ASV: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também Salomão se assentou no trono do reino.
verses.RVR09: Y también Salomón se ha sentado en el trono del reino.

verses.KJV: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.WEB: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.
verses.ASV: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, Thy God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne: and the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda os servos do rei vieram a bendizer ao nosso senhor,o rei Davi, dizendo: Deus faça o nome de Salomão melhor que o teu nome, e faça o seu trono maior que o teu. E o rei se inclinou no leito.
verses.RVR09: Y aun los siervos del rey han venido á bendecir á nuestro señor el rey David, diciendo: Dios haga bueno el nombre de Salomón más que tu nombre, y haga mayor su trono que el tuyo. Y el rey adoró en la cama.

verses.KJV: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
verses.WEB: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”
verses.ASV: And also thus said the king, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também o rei falou assim: Bendito seja o SENHOR, Deus de Israel, que hoje deu quem se assente em meu trono, vendo-o meus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Y también el rey habló así: Bendito sea Jehová Dios de Israel, que ha dado hoy quien se siente en mi trono, viéndolo mis ojos.

verses.KJV: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.WEB: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.
verses.ASV: And all the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
