verses.ALMEIDA: Então se estremeceram, e levantaram-se todos os convidados que estavam com Adonias, e foi-se cada um por seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Ellos entonces se estremecieron, y levantáronse todos los convidados que estaban con Adonía, y fuése cada uno por su camino.

verses.KJV: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.WEB: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.
verses.ASV: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Adonias, temendo da presença de Salomão, levantou-se e foi-se, e agarrou as pontas do altar.
verses.RVR09: Mas Adonía, temiendo de la presencia de Salomón, levantóse y fuése, y cogió los cornijales del altar.

verses.KJV: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me today that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.WEB: Solomon was told, “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.’”
verses.ASV: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon; for, lo, he hath laid hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me first that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi feito saber a Salomão, dizendo: Eis que que Adonias tem medo do rei Salomão: pois agarrou as pontas do altar, dizendo: Jure-me hoje o rei Salomão que não matará à espada a seu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y fué hecho saber á Salomón, diciendo: He aquí que Adonía tiene miedo del rey Salomón: pues ha cogido los cornijales del altar, diciendo: Júreme hoy el rey Salomón que no matará á cuchillo á su siervo.

verses.KJV: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.WEB: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”
verses.ASV: And Solomon said, If he shall show himself a worthy man, there shall not a hair of him fall to the earth; but if wickedness be found in him, he shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão disse: Se ele for virtuoso, nenhum de seus cabelos cairá em terra: mas se se achar mal nele, morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Y Salomón dijo: Si él fuere virtuoso, ni uno de sus cabellos caerá en tierra: mas si se hallare mal en él, morirá.

verses.KJV: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
verses.WEB: So King Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”
verses.ASV: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and did obeisance to king Solomon; and Solomon said unto him, Go to thy house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou o rei Salomão, e trouxeram-no do altar; e ele veio, e inclinou-se ao rei Salomão. E Salomão lhe disse: Vai-te à tua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y envió el rey Salomón, y trajéronlo del altar; y él vino, é inclinóse al rey Salomón. Y Salomón le dijo: Vete á tu casa.

verses.KJV: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.WEB: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,
verses.ASV: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E achegaram-se os dias de Davi para morrer, e mandou a Salomão seu filho, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y LLEGÁRONSE los días de David para morir, y mandó á Salomón su hijo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verses.WEB: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;
verses.ASV: I am going the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and show thyself a man;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vou pelo caminho de toda a terra: esforça-te, e sê homem.
verses.RVR09: Yo voy el camino de toda la tierra: esfuérzate, y sé varón.

verses.KJV: And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
verses.WEB: and keep the instruction of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself.
verses.ASV: and keep the charge of Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, [and] his commandments, and his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself;
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda a ordenança do SENHOR teu Deus, andando em seus caminhos, e observando seus estatutos e mandamentos, e seus direitos e seus testemunhos, da maneira que está escrito na lei de Moisés, para que sejas bem-sucedido em tudo o que fizeres, e em tudo aquilo a que te voltares.
verses.RVR09: Guarda la ordenanza de Jehová tu Dios, andando en sus caminos, y observando sus estatutos y mandamientos, y sus derechos y sus testimonios, de la manera que está escrito en la ley de Moisés, para que seas dichoso en todo lo que hicieres, y en todo aquello á que te tornares;

verses.KJV: That the Lord may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you,’ he said, ‘a man on the throne of Israel.’
verses.ASV: that Jehovah may establish his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que confirme o SENHOR a palavra que me falou, dizendo: Se teus filhos guardarem seu caminho, andando diante de mim com verdade, de todo seu coração, e de toda sua alma, jamais, disse, faltará a ti homem do trono de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Para que confirme Jehová la palabra que me habló, diciendo: Si tus hijos guardaren su camino, andando delante de mí con verdad, de todo su corazón, y de toda su alma, jamás, dice, faltará á ti varón del trono de Israel.

verses.KJV: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
verses.WEB: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.
verses.ASV: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did unto me, even what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E já sabes tu o que me fez Joabe filho de Zeruia, o que fez a dois generais do exército de Israel, a Abner filho de Ner, e a Amasa filho de Jéter, os quais ele matou, derramando em paz o sangue de guerra, e pondo o sangue de guerra em seu cinto que tinha em sua cintura, e nos sapatos que tinha em seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Y ya sabes tú lo que me ha hecho Joab hijo de Sarvia, lo que hizo á dos generales del ejército de Israel, á Abner hijo de Ner, y á Amasa hijo de Jether, los cuales él mató, derramando en paz la sangre de guerra, y poniendo la sangre de guerra en su talabarte que tenía sobre sus lomos, y en sus zapatos que tenía en sus pies.

verses.KJV: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.WEB: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
verses.ASV: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to Sheol in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, pois, farás conforme a tua sabedoria; não o deixarás descer ao Xeol na velhice em paz.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues harás conforme á tu sabiduría; no dejarás descender sus canas á la huesa en paz.

verses.KJV: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
verses.WEB: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.
verses.ASV: But show kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom thy brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos filhos de Barzilai gileadita farás misericórdia, que sejam dos convidados a tua mesa; porque eles vieram assim a mim, quando ia fugindo de Absalão teu irmão.
verses.RVR09: Mas á los hijos de Barzillai Galaadita harás misericordia, que sean de los convidados á tu mesa; porque ellos vinieron así á mí, cuando iba huyendo de Absalom tu hermano.

verses.KJV: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the Lord, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
verses.WEB: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the LORD, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’
verses.ASV: And, behold, there is with thee Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I sware to him by Jehovah, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também tens contigo Simei, filho de Gera, filho de Benjamim, de Baurim, o qual me amaldiçoou com uma severa maldição no dia em que eu ia a Maanaim. Mas ele mesmo desceu para me receber junto ao Jordão, e eu lhe jurei pelo SENHOR, dizendo: Eu não te matarei à espada
verses.RVR09: También tienes contigo á Semei hijo de Gera, hijo de Benjamín, de Bahurim, el cual me maldijo con una maldición fuerte el día que yo iba á Mahanaim. Mas él mismo descendió á recibirme al Jordán, y yo le juré por Jehová, diciendo: Yo no te mataré á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
verses.WEB: Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore hold him not guiltless, for thou art a wise man; and thou wilt know what thou oughtest to do unto him, and thou shalt bring his hoar head down to Sheol with blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém agora não o absolverás; porque és homem sábio, e sabes como agirás para com ele; e farás seus cabelos grisalhos descerem com sangue ao Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Empero ahora no lo absolverás: que hombre sabio eres, y sabes cómo te has de haber con él: y harás descender sus canas con sangre á la sepultura.

verses.KJV: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.WEB: David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city.
verses.ASV: And David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi descansou com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y David durmió con sus padres, y fué sepultado en la ciudad de David.

verses.KJV: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os dias que reinou Davi sobre Israel foram quarenta anos: sete anos reinou em Hebrom, e trinta e três anos reinou em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Los días que reinó David sobre Israel fueron cuarenta años: siete años reinó en Hebrón, y treinta y tres años reinó en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.WEB: Solomon sat on David his father’s throne; and his kingdom was firmly established.
verses.ASV: And Solomon sat upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se sentou Salomão no trono de Davi seu pai, e foi seu reino firme em grande maneira.
verses.RVR09: Y se sentó Salomón en el trono de David su padre, y fué su reino firme en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.WEB: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. She said, “Do you come peaceably?” He said, “Peaceably.
verses.ASV: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Adonias filho de Hagite veio a Bate-Seba mãe de Salomão; e ela disse: É tua vinda de paz? E ele respondeu: Sim, de paz.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Adonía hijo de Haggith vino á Bath-sheba madre de Salomón; y ella dijo: ¿Es tu venida de paz? Y él respondió: Sí, de paz.

verses.KJV: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
verses.WEB: He said moreover, I have something to tell you.” She said, “Say on.”
verses.ASV: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seguida disse: Uma palavra tenho que te dizer. E ela disse: Dize.
verses.RVR09: En seguida dijo: Una palabra tengo que decirte. Y ella dijo: Di.

verses.KJV: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the Lord.
verses.WEB: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from the LORD.
verses.ASV: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s; for it was his from Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Tu sabes que o reino era meu, e que todo Israel havia posto em mim seu rosto, para que eu reinasse: mas o reino foi traspassado, e veio a meu irmão; porque pelo SENHOR era seu.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Tú sabes que el reino era mío, y que todo Israel había puesto en mí su rostro, para que yo reinara: mas el reino fué traspasado, y vino á mi hermano; porque por Jehová era suyo.

verses.KJV: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
verses.WEB: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”
verses.ASV: And now I ask one petition of thee; deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora eu te faço uma petição: não a negues a mim. E ela lhe disse: Fala.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora yo te hago una petición: no me hagas volver mi rostro. Y ella le dijo: Habla.

verses.KJV: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.WEB: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king (for he will not say thee nay), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele então disse: Eu te rogo que fales ao rei Salomão (porque ele não negará a ti), para que me dê a Abisague, a sunamita, por mulher.
verses.RVR09: El entonces dijo: Yo te ruego que hables al rey Salomón, (porque él no te hará volver tu rostro,) para que me dé á Abisag Sunamita por mujer.

verses.KJV: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
verses.WEB: Bathsheba said, “All right. I will speak for you to the king.”
verses.ASV: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Bate-Seba disse: Está bem; eu falarei por ti ao rei.
verses.RVR09: Y Bath-sheba dijo: Bien; yo hablaré por ti al rey.

verses.KJV: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.WEB: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.ASV: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Bate-Seba ao rei Salomão para falar-lhe por Adonias. E o rei se levantou a recebê-la, e inclinou-se a ela, e voltou a sentar-se em seu trono, e fez pôr uma cadeira à mãe do rei, a qual se sentou à sua direita.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Bath-sheba al rey Salomón para hablarle por Adonía. Y el rey se levantó á recibirla, é inclinóse á ella, y volvió á sentarse en su trono, é hizo poner una silla á la madre del rey, la cual se sentó á su diestra.

verses.KJV: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
verses.WEB: Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother, for I will not deny you.”
verses.ASV: Then she said, I ask one small petition of thee; deny me not. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother; for I will not deny thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse: Uma pequena petição pretendo de ti; não me negues. E o rei lhe disse: Pede, minha mãe, que eu não te negarei.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: Una pequeña petición pretendo de ti; no me hagas volver mi rostro. Y el rey le dijo: Pide, madre mía, que yo no te haré volver el rostro.

verses.KJV: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
verses.WEB: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”
verses.ASV: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse: Dê-se Abisague, a sunamita, por mulher a teu irmão Adonias.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: Dése Abisag Sunamita por mujer á tu hermano Adonía.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.WEB: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”
verses.ASV: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Salomão respondeu, e disse a sua mãe: Por que pedes a Abisague sunamita para Adonias? Pede também para ele o reino, porque ele é meu irmão maior; e tem também a Abiatar sacerdote, e a Joabe filho de Zeruia.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey Salomón respondió, y dijo á su madre: ¿Por qué pides á Abisag Sunamita para Adonía? Demanda también para él el reino, porque él es mi hermano mayor; y tiene también á Abiathar sacerdote, y á Joab hijo de Sarvia.

verses.KJV: Then king Solomon sware by the Lord, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.WEB: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.ASV: Then king Solomon sware by Jehovah, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah hath not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Salomão jurou pelo SENHOR, dizendo: Assim me faça Deus e assim me acrescente, que contra sua vida falou Adonias esta palavra.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey Salomón juró por Jehová, diciendo: Así me haga Dios y así me añada, que contra su vida ha hablado Adonía esta palabra.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, as the Lord liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.WEB: Now therefore as the LORD lives, who has established me and set me on my father David’s throne, and who has made me a house as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death today.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore as Jehovah liveth, who hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me a house, as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, vive o SENHOR, que me confirmou e me pôs sobre o trono de Davi meu pai, e que me fez casa, como me havia dito, que Adonias morrerá hoje.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, vive Jehová, que me ha confirmado y me ha puesto sobre el trono de David mi padre, y que me ha hecho casa, como me había dicho, que Adonía morirá hoy.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
verses.WEB: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.
verses.ASV: And king Solomon sent by Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him, so that he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei Salomão enviou por meio de Benaia filho de Joiada, o qual o golpeou de maneira que ele morreu.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey Salomón envió por mano de Benaía hijo de Joiada, el cual dió sobre él, y murió.

verses.KJV: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord God before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
verses.WEB: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord GOD’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”
verses.ASV: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord Jehovah before David my father, and because thou wast afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Abiatar sacerdote disse o rei: Vai-te a Anatote a tuas propriedades, que tu és digno de morte; mas não te matarei hoje, porquanto levaste a arca do Senhor DEUS diante de Davi meu pai, e, além disso, foste aflito em todas as coisas em que meu pai foi aflito.
verses.RVR09: Y á Abiathar sacerdote dijo el rey: Vete á Anathoth á tus heredades, que tú eres digno de muerte; mas no te mataré hoy, por cuanto has llevado el arca del Señor Jehová delante de David mi padre, y además has sido trabajado en todas las cosas en que fué trabajado mi padre.

verses.KJV: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the Lord; that he might fulfil the word of the Lord, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.WEB: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to the LORD, that he might fulfill the LORD’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.ASV: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto Jehovah, that he might fulfil the word of Jehovah, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim expulsou Salomão a Abiatar do sacerdócio do SENHOR, para que se cumprisse a palavra do SENHOR que havia dito sobre a casa de Eli em Siló.
verses.RVR09: Así echó Salomón á Abiathar del sacerdocio de Jehová, para que se cumpliese la palabra de Jehová que había dicho sobre la casa de Eli en Silo.

verses.KJV: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.WEB: This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to the LORD’s Tent, and held onto the horns of the altar.
verses.ASV: And the tidings came to Joab; for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the Tent of Jehovah, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a notícia até Joabe: porque também Joabe se havia aderido a Adonias, se bem não se havia aderido a Absalão. E fugiu Joabe ao tabernáculo do SENHOR, e agarrou-se às pontas do altar.
verses.RVR09: Y vino la noticia hasta Joab: porque también Joab se había adherido á Adonía, si bien no se había adherido á Absalom. Y huyó Joab al tabernáculo de Jehová, y asióse á los cornijales del altar.

verses.KJV: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.WEB: King Solomon was told, “Joab has fled to the LORD’s Tent; and behold, he is by the altar.” Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, fall on him.”
verses.ASV: And it was told king Solomon, Joab is fled unto the Tent of Jehovah, and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi feito saber a Salomão que Joabe havia fugido ao tabernáculo do SENHOR, e que estava junto ao altar. Então enviou Salomão a Benaia filho de Joiada, dizendo: Vai, e golpeia-o.
verses.RVR09: Y fué hecho saber á Salomón que Joab había huído al tabernáculo de Jehová, y que estaba junto al altar. Entonces envió Salomón á Benaía hijo de Joiada, diciendo: Ve, y da sobre él.

verses.KJV: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the Lord, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.WEB: Benaiah came to the LORD’s Tent, and said to him, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” He said, “No; but I will die here.” Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, “This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.”
verses.ASV: And Benaiah came to the Tent of Jehovah, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrou Benaia ao tabernáculo do SENHOR, e disse-lhe: O rei disse que saias. E ele disse: Não, mas sim aqui morrerei. E Benaia voltou com esta resposta ao rei, dizendo: Assim falou Joabe, e assim me respondeu.
verses.RVR09: Y entró Benaía al tabernáculo de Jehová, y díjole: El rey ha dicho que salgas. Y él dijo: No, sino aquí moriré. Y Benaía volvió con esta respuesta al rey, diciendo: Así habló Joab, y así me respondió.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
verses.WEB: The king said to him, “Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him, that you may take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father’s house.
verses.ASV: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei lhe disse: Faze como ele disse; mata-lhe e enterra-o, e tira de mim e da casa de meu pai o sangue que Joabe derramou injustamente.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey le dijo: Haz como él ha dicho; mátale y entiérralo, y quita de mí y de la casa de mi padre la sangre que Joab ha derramado injustamente.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
verses.WEB: The LORD will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will return his blood upon his own head, because he fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, and my father David knew it not, [to wit], Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR fará voltar seu sangue sobre sua cabeça; porque ele matou dois homens mais justos e melhores que ele, aos quais matou à espada sem que meu pai, Davi, soubesse nada: a Abner filho de Ner, general do exército de Israel, e a Amasa filho de Jéter, general do exército de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová hará tornar su sangre sobre su cabeza: que él ha muerto dos varones más justos y mejores que él, á los cuales mató á cuchillo sin que mi padre David supiese nada: á Abner hijo de Ner, general del ejército de Israel, y á Amasa hijo de Jether, general de ejército de Judá.

verses.KJV: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the Lord.
verses.WEB: So their blood will return on the head of Joab and on the head of his offspring forever. But for David, for his offspring, for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace forever from the LORD.”
verses.ASV: So shall their blood return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but unto David, and unto his seed, and unto his house, and unto his throne, shall there be peace for ever from Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sangue deles, pois, recairá sobre a cabeça de Joabe, e sobre a cabeça de sua descendência para sempre; mas sobre Davi e sobre sua descendência, e sobre sua casa e sobre seu trono, haverá perpetuamente paz da parte do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: La sangre pues de ellos recaerá sobre la cabeza de Joab, y sobre la cabeza de su simiente para siempre: mas sobre David y sobre su simiente, y sobre su casa y sobre su trono, habrá perpetuamente paz de parte de Jehová.

verses.KJV: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Benaia, filho de Joiada, subiu, e o golpeou, e o matou; e foi sepultado em sua casa no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Benaía hijo de Joiada subió, y dió sobre él, y matólo; y fué sepultado en su casa en el desierto.

verses.KJV: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.WEB: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.
verses.ASV: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host; and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei pôs em seu lugar a Benaia, filho de Joiada, sobre o exército; e o rei pôs por sacerdote a Zadoque em lugar de Abiatar.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey puso en su lugar á Benaía hijo de Joiada sobre el ejército: y á Sadoc puso el rey por sacerdote en lugar de Abiathar.

verses.KJV: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.WEB: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t go anywhere else.
verses.ASV: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee a house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois o rei mandou convocar Simei, e disse-lhe: Edifica para ti uma casa em Jerusalém, e mora ali, e não saias de lá à uma parte nem à outra;
verses.RVR09: Después envió el rey, é hizo venir á Semei, y díjole: Edifícate una casa en Jerusalem, y mora ahí, y no salgas de allá á una parte ni á otra;

verses.KJV: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
verses.WEB: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”
verses.ASV: For on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, know thou for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque sabe com certeza que no dia que saíres, e passares o ribeiro de Cedrom, sem dúvida morrerás, e teu sangue será sobre a tua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Porque sabe de cierto que el día que salieres, y pasares el torrente de Cedrón, sin duda morirás, y tu sangre será sobre tu cabeza.

verses.KJV: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.WEB: Shimei said to the king, “What you say is good. As my lord the king has said, so will your servant do.” Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.
verses.ASV: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Simei disse ao rei: A palavra é boa; como o rei, meu senhor, disse, assim teu servo o fará. E Simei morou em Jerusalém por muitos dias.
verses.RVR09: Y Semei dijo al rey: La palabra es buena; como el rey mi señor ha dicho, así lo hará tu siervo. Y habitó Semei en Jerusalem muchos días.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
verses.WEB: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants are in Gath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém passados três anos, aconteceu que se lhe fugiram a Simei dois servos a Aquis, filho de Maaca, rei de Gate. E avisaram a Simei, dizendo: Eis que teus servos estão em Gate.
verses.RVR09: Pero pasados tres años, aconteció que se le huyeron á Semei dos siervos á Achîs, hijo de Maachâ, rey de Gath. Y dieron aviso á Semei, diciendo: He aquí que tus siervos están en Gath.

verses.KJV: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.WEB: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.
verses.ASV: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish, to seek his servants; and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Simei se levantou, preparou seu asno, e foi a Gate, a Aquis, para procurar seus servos. Assim Simei foi, e trouxe os seus servos de Gate.
verses.RVR09: Levantóse entonces Semei, y enalbardó su asno, y fué á Gath, á Achîs, á procurar sus siervos. Fué pues Semei, y volvió sus siervos de Gath.

verses.KJV: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.WEB: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.
verses.ASV: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram a Salomão como Simei havia ido de Jerusalém a Gate, e que havia voltado.
verses.RVR09: Díjose luego á Salomón como Semei había ido de Jerusalem hasta Gath, y que había vuelto.

verses.KJV: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the Lord, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
verses.WEB: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Didn’t I adjure you by the LORD and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere else, you shall surely die’? You said to me, ‘The saying that I have heard is good.’
verses.ASV: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not adjure thee by Jehovah, and protest unto thee, saying, Know for certain, that on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The saying that I have heard is good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei mandou que convocassem a Simei, e disse-lhe: Não te fiz jurar pelo SENHOR, e te adverti, dizendo: No dia que saíres, e fores para qualquer outro lugar, sabe que com certeza morrerás? E tu me disseste: A palavra é boa, eu a obedecerei.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey envió, é hizo venir á Semei, y díjole: ¿No te conjuré yo por Jehová, y te protesté, diciendo: El día que salieres, y fueres acá ó acullá, sabe de cierto que has de morir? Y tú me dijiste: La palabra es buena, yo la obedezco.

verses.KJV: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the Lord, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
verses.WEB: Why then have you not kept the oath of the LORD and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”
verses.ASV: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of Jehovah, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que, pois, não guardaste o juramento do SENHOR, nem o mandamento que te impus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué pues no guardaste el juramento de Jehová, y el mandamiento que yo te impuse?

verses.KJV: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the Lord shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
verses.WEB: The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore the LORD will return your wickedness on your own head.
verses.ASV: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thy heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore Jehovah shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais o rei a Simei: Tu sabes toda a maldade, a qual teu coração conhece que cometeste contra meu pai, Davi; por isso o SENHOR retribuiu a tua maldade sobre a tua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Dijo además el rey á Semei: Tú sabes todo el mal, el cual tu corazón bien sabe, que cometiste contra mi padre David; Jehová pues, ha tornado el mal sobre tu cabeza.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord for ever.
verses.WEB: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will be established before the LORD forever.”
verses.ASV: But king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before Jehovah for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o rei Salomão será abençoado, e o trono de Davi será confirmado diante do SENHOR para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey Salomón será bendito, y el trono de David será firme perpetuamente delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.WEB: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell on him, so that he died. The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.ASV: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell upon him, so that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei mandou a Benaia, filho de Joiada, o qual saiu para ferir-lhe; e ele morreu. Assim o reino foi confirmado na mão de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey mandó á Benaía hijo de Joiada, el cual salió é hirióle; y murió. Y el reino fué confirmado en la mano de Salomón.

verses.KJV: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the Lord, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.WEB: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into David’s city until he had finished building his own house, the LORD’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of Jehovah, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão fez parentesco com Faraó, rei do Egito, porque se casou com a filha de Faraó, e a trouxe à cidade de Davi, até que acabasse de edificar a sua própria casa, e a casa do SENHOR, e os muros de Jerusalém em redor.
verses.RVR09: Y SALOMÓN hizo parentesco con Faraón rey de Egipto, porque tomó la hija de Faraón, y trájola á la ciudad de David, entre tanto que acababa de edificar su casa, y la casa de Jehová, y los muros de Jerusalem alrededor.

verses.KJV: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the Lord, until those days.
verses.WEB: However, the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: Only the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was no house built for the name of Jehovah until those days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia o povo sacrificava nos altares dos lugares altos, porque não havia casa edificada ao nome do SENHOR até aqueles tempos.
verses.RVR09: Hasta entonces el pueblo sacrificaba en los altos; porque no había casa edificada al nombre de Jehová hasta aquellos tiempos.

verses.KJV: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
verses.WEB: Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
verses.ASV: And Solomon loved Jehovah, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Salomão amava ao SENHOR, andando nos estatutos de seu pai Davi, exceto que sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altares dos lugares altos.
verses.RVR09: Mas Salomón amó á Jehová, andando en los estatutos de su padre David: solamente sacrificaba y quemaba perfumes en los altos.

verses.KJV: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.WEB: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
verses.ASV: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt-offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei foi a Gibeão, porque aquele era o principal lugar alto, e Salomão sacrificou ali mil holocaustos sobre aquele altar.
verses.RVR09: E iba el rey á Gabaón, porque aquél era el alto principal, y sacrificaba allí: mil holocaustos sacrificaba Salomón sobre aquel altar.

verses.KJV: In Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.WEB: In Gibeon, the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
verses.ASV: In Gibeon Jehovah appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em uma noite, o SENHOR apareceu a Salomão em sonhos. E Deus lhe disse: Pede o que [queres que] eu te dê.
verses.RVR09: Y aparecióse Jehová á Salomón en Gabaón una noche en sueños, y díjole Dios: Pide lo que quisieres que yo te dé.

verses.KJV: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
verses.WEB: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.
verses.ASV: And Solomon said, Thou hast showed unto thy servant David my father great lovingkindness, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great lovingkindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão disse: Tu concedeste grande misericórdia a teu servo Davi, meu pai, como também ele andou perante ti em verdade, em justiça, e com um coração correto para contigo; e guardaste-lhe este teu grande benefício, que lhe deste um filho que se assentasse no seu trono, como acontece hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y Salomón dijo: Tú hiciste gran misericordia á tu siervo David mi padre, según que él anduvo delante de ti en verdad, en justicia, y con rectitud de corazón para contigo: y tú le has guardado esta tu grande misericordia, que le diste hijo que se sentase en su trono, como sucede en este día.

verses.KJV: And now, O Lord my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
verses.WEB: Now, LORD my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.
verses.ASV: And now, O Jehovah my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child; I know not how to go out or come in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, ó SENHOR meu Deus, constituíste a mim, teu servo, rei em lugar de Davi, meu pai; porém sou um tenro jovem, que não sei como entrar nem sair.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Jehová Dios mío, tú has puesto á mí tu siervo por rey en lugar de David mi padre: y yo soy mozo pequeño, que no sé cómo entrar ni salir.

verses.KJV: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.WEB: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.
verses.ASV: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teu servo está no meio do teu povo que escolheste; um povo grande, que não se pode contar nem numerar por causa de sua multidão.
verses.RVR09: Y tu siervo está en medio de tu pueblo al cual tú escogiste; un pueblo grande, que no se puede contar ni numerar por su multitud.

verses.KJV: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
verses.WEB: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
verses.ASV: Give thy servant therefore an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this thy great people?
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá, pois, a teu servo um coração com entendimento para julgar ao teu povo, para discernir entre o bem e o mal; pois quem poderá governar este teu tão grande povo?
verses.RVR09: Da pues á tu siervo corazón dócil para juzgar á tu pueblo, para discernir entre lo bueno y lo malo: porque ¿quién podrá gobernar este tu pueblo tan grande?

verses.KJV: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.WEB: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.ASV: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi do agrado do Senhor que Salomão pedisse isso.
verses.RVR09: Y agradó delante de Adonai que Salomón pidiese esto.

verses.KJV: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
verses.WEB: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,
verses.ASV: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life, neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies, but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern justice;
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus disse-lhe: Porque pediste isto, e não pediste para ti longa vida, nem pediste para ti riquezas, nem pediste a morte de teus inimigos, mas pediste para ti entendimento para compreender a justiça;
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Dios: Porque has demandado esto, y no pediste para ti muchos días, ni pediste para ti riquezas, ni pediste la vida de tus enemigos, mas demandaste para ti inteligencia para oir juicio;

verses.KJV: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
verses.WEB: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.
verses.ASV: behold, I have done according to thy word: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there hath been none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o fiz conforme as tuas palavras: eis que te dei um coração sábio e com entendimento, tanto que não houve antes de ti outro como tu, nem depois de ti se levantará outro como tu.
verses.RVR09: He aquí lo he hecho conforme á tus palabras: he aquí que te he dado corazón sabio y entendido, tanto que no haya habido antes de ti otro como tú, ni después de ti se levantará otro como tú.

verses.KJV: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
verses.WEB: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.
verses.ASV: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches and honor, so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee, all thy days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também te dei as coisas que não pediste: riquezas e honra; de maneira que, entre os reis, ninguém haverá semelhante a ti em todos os teus dias.
verses.RVR09: Y aun también te he dado las cosas que no pediste, riquezas y gloria: tal, que entre los reyes ninguno haya como tú en todos tus días.

verses.KJV: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
verses.WEB: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”
verses.ASV: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se andares em meus caminhos, guardando meus estatutos e meus mandamentos, como andou Davi, teu pai, prolongarei teus dias.
verses.RVR09: Y si anduvieres en mis caminos, guardando mis estatutos y mis mandamientos, como anduvo David tu padre, yo alargaré tus días.

verses.KJV: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.WEB: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.
verses.ASV: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream: and he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and offered up burnt-offerings, and offered peace-offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Salomão despertou, viu que era sonho: e veio a Jerusalém, e apresentou-se diante da arca do pacto do SENHOR, e sacrificou holocaustos, e fez ofertas pacíficas; fez também banquete a todos seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y como Salomón despertó, vió que era sueño: y vino á Jerusalem, y presentóse delante del arca del pacto de Jehová, y sacrificó holocaustos, é hizo pacíficos; hizo también banquete á todos sus siervos.

verses.KJV: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.WEB: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him.
verses.ASV: Then there came two women that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquela muita vieram duas mulheres prostitutas ao rei, e apresentaram-se diante dele.
verses.RVR09: En aquella sazón vinieron dos mujeres rameras al rey, y presentáronse delante de él.

verses.KJV: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.WEB: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.
verses.ASV: And the one woman said, Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a uma mulher: Ah, senhor meu! Eu e esta mulher morávamos em uma mesma casa, e eu pari estando com ela na casa.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo la una mujer: ¡Ah, señor mío! yo y esta mujer morábamos en una misma casa, y yo parí estando con ella en la casa.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.WEB: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass the third day after I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also; and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu ao terceiro dia depois que eu dei à luz, que esta deu à luz também, e morávamos nós juntas; ninguém de fora estava em casa, a não ser nós duas na casa.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció al tercer día después que yo parí, que ésta parió también, y morábamos nosotras juntas; ninguno de fuera estaba en casa, sino nosotras dos en la casa.

verses.KJV: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
verses.WEB: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.
verses.ASV: And this woman’s child died in the night, because she lay upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E uma noite o filho desta mulher morreu, porque ela se deitou sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y una noche el hijo de esta mujer murió, porque ella se acostó sobre él.

verses.KJV: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.WEB: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.ASV: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thy handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se à meia noite, e tomou a meu filho de junto a mim, estando eu tua serva dormindo, e o pôs a seu lado, e pôs a meu lado seu filho morto.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse á media noche, y tomó á mi hijo de junto á mí, estando yo tu sierva durmiendo, y púsolo á su lado, y púsome á mi lado su hijo muerto.

verses.KJV: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
verses.WEB: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead; but when I had looked at him in the morning, behold, it was not my son whom I bore.”
verses.ASV: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead; but when I had looked at it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, whom I did bear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando eu me levantei pela manhã para dar o peito a meu filho, eis que que estava morto: mas observei-lhe pela manhã, e vi que não era meu filho, que eu havia dado à luz.
verses.RVR09: Y como yo me levanté por la mañana para dar el pecho á mi hijo, he aquí que estaba muerto: mas observéle por la mañana, y vi que no era mi hijo, que yo había parido.

verses.KJV: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.WEB: The other woman said, “No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” The first one said, “No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” They argued like this before the king.
verses.ASV: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a outra mulher disse: Não; meu filho é o que vive, e teu filho é o morto. E a outra voltou a dizer: Não; teu filho é o morto, e meu filho é o que vive. Assim falavam diante do rei.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la otra mujer dijo: No; mi hijo es el que vive, y tu hijo es el muerto. Y la otra volvió á decir: No; tu hijo es el muerto, y mi hijo es el que vive. Así hablaban delante del rey.

verses.KJV: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
verses.WEB: Then the king said, “One says, ‘This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead one;’ and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’”
verses.ASV: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei então disse: Esta disse: Meu filho é o que vive, e teu filho é o morto: e a outra disse: Não, mas o teu é o morto, e meu filho é o que vive.
verses.RVR09: El rey entonces dijo: Esta dice: Mi hijo es el que vive, y tu hijo es el muerto: y la otra dice, No, mas el tuyo es el muerto, y mi hijo es el que vive.

verses.KJV: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.WEB: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.
verses.ASV: And the king said, Fetch me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o rei: Trazei-me uma espada. E trouxeram ao rei uma espada.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo el rey: Traedme un cuchillo. Y trajeron al rey un cuchillo.

verses.KJV: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.WEB: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”
verses.ASV: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seguida o rei disse: Parti por meio o menino vivo, e dai a metade à uma, e a outra metade à outra.
verses.RVR09: En seguida el rey dijo: Partid por medio el niño vivo, y dad la mitad á la una, y la otra mitad á la otra.

verses.KJV: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
verses.WEB: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”
verses.ASV: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, It shall be neither mine nor thine; divide it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a mulher cujo era o filho vivo, falou ao rei (porque suas entranhas se lhe comoveram por seu filho), e disse: Ah, senhor meu! Dai a esta o menino vivo, e não o mateis. Mas a outra disse: nem a mim nem a ti; parti-o.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la mujer cuyo era el hijo vivo, habló al rey (porque sus entrañas se le conmovieron por su hijo), y dijo: ¡Ah, señor mío! dad á ésta el niño vivo, y no lo matéis. Mas la otra dijo: Ni á mí ni á ti; partidlo.

verses.KJV: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
verses.WEB: Then the king answered, “Give the first woman the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”
verses.ASV: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei respondeu, e disse: Dai a aquela o filho vivo, e não o mateis: ela é sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey respondió, y dijo: Dad á aquélla el hijo vivo, y no lo matéis: ella es su madre.

verses.KJV: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.
verses.WEB: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.
verses.ASV: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo Israel ouviu aquele juízo que havia dado o rei: e temeram ao rei, porque viram que havia nele sabedoria de Deus para julgar.
verses.RVR09: Y todo Israel oyó aquel juicio que había dado el rey: y temieron al rey, porque vieron que había en él sabiduría de Dios para juzgar.

verses.KJV: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.WEB: King Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.ASV: And king Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi, pois, o rei Salomão rei sobre todo Israel.
verses.RVR09: FUÉ pues el rey Salomón rey sobre todo Israel.

verses.KJV: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
verses.WEB: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;
verses.ASV: And these were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os príncipes que teve: Azarias filho de Zadoque, sacerdote;
verses.RVR09: Y estos fueron los príncipes que tuvo: Azarías hijo de Sadoc, sacerdote;

verses.KJV: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
verses.WEB: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
verses.ASV: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eliorefe e Aías, filhos de Sisa, escribas; Josafá filho de Ailude, chanceler;
verses.RVR09: Elioreph y Ahía, hijos de Sisa, escribas; Josaphat hijo de Ahilud, canciller;

verses.KJV: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.WEB: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
verses.ASV: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
verses.ALMEIDA: Benaia filho de Joiada era sobre o exército; e Zadoque e Abiatar eram os sacerdotes;
verses.RVR09: Benaía hijo de Joiada era sobre el ejército; y Sadoc y Abiathar eran los sacerdotes;

verses.KJV: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:
verses.WEB: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;
verses.ASV: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; and Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, [and] the king’s friend;
verses.ALMEIDA: Azarias filho de Natã era sobre os governadores; Zabude filho de Natã era principal oficial, amigo do rei;
verses.RVR09: Azaría hijo de Nathán era sobre los gobernadores; Zabud hijo de Nathán era principal oficial, amigo del rey;

verses.KJV: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
verses.WEB: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.
verses.ASV: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to taskwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Aisar era mordomo; e Adonirão filho de Abda era sobre o tributo.
verses.RVR09: Y Ahisar era mayordomo; y Adoniram hijo de Abda era sobre el tributo.

verses.KJV: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
verses.WEB: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for a month in the year.
verses.ASV: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided victuals for the king and his household: each man had to make provision for a month in the year.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinha Salomão doze governadores sobre todo Israel, os quais mantinham ao rei e à sua casa. Cada um deles estava obrigado a abastecer por um mês no ano.
verses.RVR09: Y tenía Salomón doce gobernadores sobre todo Israel, los cuales mantenían al rey y á su casa. Cada uno de ellos estaba obligado á abastecer por un mes en el año.

verses.KJV: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
verses.WEB: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;
verses.ASV: And these are their names: Ben-hur, in the hill-country of Ephraim;
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os nomes deles: Ben-Hur no monte de Efraim;
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los nombres de ellos: el hijo de Hur en el monte de Ephraim;

verses.KJV: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
verses.WEB: Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
verses.ASV: Ben-deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ben-Dequer, em Macaz, e em Saalbim, e em Bete-Semes, e em Elom-Bete-Hanã;
verses.RVR09: El hijo de Decar, en Maccas, y en Saalbim, y en Beth-semes, y en Elón, y en Beth-hanan;

verses.KJV: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
verses.WEB: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);
verses.ASV: Ben-hesed, in Arubboth (to him [pertained] Socoh, and all the land of Hepher);
verses.ALMEIDA: Ben-Hesede, em Arubote; este tinha também a Socó e toda a terra de Hefer.
verses.RVR09: El hijo de Hesed, en Aruboth; éste tenía también á Sochô y toda la tierra de Ephet.

verses.KJV: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.WEB: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon’s daughter, as wife);
verses.ASV: Ben-abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife);
verses.ALMEIDA: Ben-Abinadabe, em toda a região de Dor: este tinha por mulher a Tafate filha de Salomão;
verses.RVR09: El hijo de Abinadab, en todos los términos de Dor: éste tenía por mujer á Thaphat hija de Salomón;

verses.KJV: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
verses.WEB: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
verses.ASV: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
verses.ALMEIDA: Baana filho de Ailude, em Taanaque e Megido, e em toda Bete-Seã, que é próxima de Zaretã, por abaixo de Jezreel, desde Bete-Seã até Abel-Meolá, e até a outra parte de Jocmeão;
verses.RVR09: Baana hijo de Ahilud, en Taanach y Megiddo, y en toda Beth-san, que es cerca de Zaretán, por bajo de Jezreel, desde Beth-san hasta Abel-mehola, y hasta la otra parte de Jocmeam;

verses.KJV: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
verses.WEB: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; and the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars, belonged to him);
verses.ASV: Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead (to him [pertained] the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; [even] to him [pertained] the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brazen bars);
verses.ALMEIDA: Ben-Geber, em Ramote de Gileade; este tinha também as cidades de Jair filho de Manassés, as quais estavam em Gileade; tinha também a província de Argobe, que era em Basã, sessenta grandes cidades com muro e fechaduras de bronze;
verses.RVR09: El hijo de Geber, en Ramoth de Galaad; éste tenía también las ciudades de Jair hijo de Manasés, las cuales estaban en Galaad; tenía también la provincia de Argob, que era en Basán, sesenta grandes ciudades con muro y cerraduras de bronce;

verses.KJV: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
verses.WEB: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
verses.ASV: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainadabe filho de Ido, em Maanaim;
verses.RVR09: Ahinadab hijo de Iddo, en Mahanaim;

verses.KJV: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.WEB: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);
verses.ASV: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon to wife);
verses.ALMEIDA: Aimaás em Naftali; este tomou também por mulher a Basemate filha de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Ahimaas en Nephtalí; éste tomó también por mujer á Basemath hija de Salomón.

verses.KJV: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
verses.WEB: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;
verses.ASV: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Baaná filho de Husai, em Aser e em Alote;
verses.RVR09: Baana hijo de Husai, en Aser y en Aloth;

verses.KJV: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
verses.WEB: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
verses.ASV: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
verses.ALMEIDA: Josafá filho de Parua, em Issacar;
verses.RVR09: Josaphat hijo de Pharua, en Issachâr;

verses.KJV: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
verses.WEB: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
verses.ASV: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
verses.ALMEIDA: Simei filho de Elá, em Benjamim;
verses.RVR09: Semei hijo de Ela, en Benjamín;

verses.KJV: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
verses.WEB: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.
verses.ASV: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and [he was] the only officer that was in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Geber filho de Uri, na terra de Gileade, a terra de Seom rei dos amorreus, e de Ogue rei de Basã; este era o único governador naquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Geber hijo de Uri, en la tierra de Galaad, la tierra de Sehón rey de los Amorrheos, y de Og rey de Basán; éste era el único gobernador en aquella tierra.

verses.KJV: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
verses.WEB: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.
verses.ASV: Judah and Israel were many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Judá e Israel eram muitos, como a areia que está junto ao mar em multidão, comendo e bebendo e alegrando-se.
verses.RVR09: Judá é Israel eran muchos, como la arena que está junto á la mar en multitud, comiendo y bebiendo y alegrándose.

verses.KJV: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.WEB: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.ASV: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought tribute, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão dominava sobre todos os reinos, desde o rio até a terra dos filisteus, e até o termo do Egito; e traziam tributos, e serviram a Salomão todos os dias em que viveu.
verses.RVR09: Y Salomón señoreaba sobre todos los reinos, desde el río de la tierra de los Filisteos hasta el término de Egipto: y traían presentes, y sirvieron á Salomón todos los días que vivió.

verses.KJV: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
verses.WEB: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,
verses.ASV: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a provisão de Salomão era, cada dia, trinta coros de farinha refinada, e sessenta coros de farinha comum;
verses.RVR09: Y la despensa de Salomón era cada día treinta coros de flor de harina, y sesenta coros de harina.

verses.KJV: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.WEB: ten head of fat cattle, twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, in addition to deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened fowl.
verses.ASV: ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and a hundred sheep, besides harts, and gazelles, and roebucks, and fatted fowl.
verses.ALMEIDA: dez bois engordados, e vinte bois de pasto, e cem ovelhas; sem os cervos, cabras, búfalos, e aves engordadas.
verses.RVR09: Diez bueyes engordados, y veinte bueyes de pasto, y cien ovejas; sin los ciervos, cabras, búfalos, y aves engordadas.

verses.KJV: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.WEB: For he had dominion over all on this side of the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on all sides around him.
verses.ASV: For he had dominion over all [the region] on this side the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side the River: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
