verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele dominava em toda a região que estava da outra parte do rio, desde Tifsa até Gaza, sobre todos os reis da outra parte do rio; e teve paz por todos os lados em derredor seu.
verses.RVR09: Porque él señoreaba en toda la región que estaba de la otra parte del río, desde Tiphsa hasta Gaza, sobre todos los reyes de la otra parte del río; y tuvo paz por todos lados en derredor suyo.

verses.KJV: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.WEB: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.ASV: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig-tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Judá e Israel viviam seguros, cada um debaixo de sua parreira e debaixo de sua figueira, desde Dã até Berseba, todos os dias de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y Judá é Israel vivían seguros, cada uno debajo de su parra y debajo de su higuera, desde Dan hasta Beer-seba, todos los días de Salomón.

verses.KJV: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.WEB: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.ASV: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, Salomão tinha quarenta mil cavalos em seus estábulos para suas carruagens, e doze mil cavaleiros.
verses.RVR09: Tenía además de esto Salomón cuarenta mil caballos en sus caballerizas para sus carros, y doce mil jinetes.

verses.KJV: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
verses.WEB: Those officers provided food for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon’s table, every man in his month. They let nothing be lacking.
verses.ASV: And those officers provided victuals for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month; they let nothing be lacking.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes governadores mantinham ao rei Salomão, e a todos os que vinham à mesa do rei Salomão, a cada mês; e faziam que nada faltasse.
verses.RVR09: Y estos gobernadores mantenían al rey Salomón, y á todos los que á la mesa del rey Salomón venían, cada uno un mes; y hacían que nada faltase.

verses.KJV: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
verses.WEB: They also brought barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were, each man according to his duty.
verses.ASV: Barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds brought they unto the place where [the officers] were, every man according to his charge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faziam também trazer cevada e palha para os cavalos e para os animais de carga, ao lugar de onde ele estava, cada um conforme ao cargo que tinha.
verses.RVR09: Hacían también traer cebada y paja para los caballos y para las bestias de carga, al lugar donde él estaba, cada uno conforme al cargo que tenía.

verses.KJV: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
verses.WEB: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.
verses.ASV: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea-shore.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu Deus a Salomão sabedoria, e prudência muito grande, e largura de coração como a areia que está à beira do mar.
verses.RVR09: Y dió Dios á Salomón sabiduría, y prudencia muy grande, y anchura de corazón como la arena que está á la orilla del mar.

verses.KJV: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que foi maior a sabedoria de Salomão que a de todos os orientais, e que toda a sabedoria dos egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Que fué mayor la sabiduría de Salomón que la de todos los orientales, y que toda la sabiduría de los Egipcios.

verses.KJV: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.WEB: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.
verses.ASV: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda foi mais sábio que todos os homens; mais que Etã ezraíta, e que Hemã e Calcol e Darda, filhos de Maol: e foi nomeado entre todas as nações de ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Y aun fué más sabio que todos los hombres; más que Ethán Ezrahita, y que Emán y Calchôl y Darda, hijos de Mahol: y fué nombrado entre todas las naciones de alrededor.

verses.KJV: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.WEB: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.
verses.ASV: And he spake three thousand proverbs; and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.ALMEIDA: E propôs três mil parábolas; e seus versos foram mil e cinco.
verses.RVR09: Y propuso tres mil parábolas; y sus versos fueron mil y cinco.

verses.KJV: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.WEB: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.
verses.ASV: And he spake of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall; he spake also of beasts, and of birds, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também descreveu as árvores, desde o cedro do Líbano até o hissopo que nasce na parede. Também descreveu os animais, as aves, os répteis, e os peixes.
verses.RVR09: También disertó de los árboles, desde el cedro del Líbano hasta el hisopo que nace en la pared. Asimismo disertó de los animales, de las aves, de los reptiles, y de los peces.

verses.KJV: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
verses.WEB: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.
verses.ASV: And there came of all peoples to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vinham de todos os povos a ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão, e de todos os reis da terra, de onde havia chegado a fama de sua sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Y venían de todos los pueblos á oir la sabiduría de Salomón, y de todos los reyes de la tierra, donde había llegado la fama de su sabiduría.

verses.KJV: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
verses.WEB: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.
verses.ASV: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Hirão, rei de Tiro, enviou seus servos a Salomão, quando ouviu que tinham ungido por rei em lugar de seu pai; porque Hirão sempre havia amado a Davi.
verses.RVR09: HIRAM rey de Tiro envió también sus siervos á Salomón, luego que oyó que lo habían ungido por rey en lugar de su padre: porque Hiram había siempre amado á David.

verses.KJV: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.WEB: Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.ASV: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Salomão enviou a dizer a Hirão:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Salomón envió á decir á Hiram:

verses.KJV: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the Lord his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.WEB: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until the LORD put his enemies under the soles of his feet.
verses.ASV: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build a house for the name of Jehovah his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until Jehovah put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu sabes como meu pai Davi não pôde edificar uma casa ao nome do SENHOR, seu Deus, por causa das guerras que o cercaram, até que o SENHOR pôs os seus inimigos debaixo das plantas de seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Tú sabes como mi padre David no pudo edificar casa al nombre de Jehová su Dios, por las guerras que le cercaron, hasta que Jehová puso sus enemigos bajo las plantas de sus pies.

verses.KJV: But now the Lord my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
verses.WEB: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.
verses.ASV: But now Jehovah my God hath given me rest on every side; there is neither adversary, nor evil occurrence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém agora o SENHOR, meu Deus, me deu repouso por todos os lados; nem há adversários, nem encontro mal algum.
verses.RVR09: Ahora Jehová mi Dios me ha dado reposo por todas partes; que ni hay adversarios, ni mal encuentro.

verses.KJV: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
verses.WEB: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’
verses.ASV: And, behold, I purpose to build a house for the name of Jehovah my God, as Jehovah spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build the house for my name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, portanto, decidi edificar uma casa ao nome do SENHOR, meu Deus, como o SENHOR o falou ao meu pai Davi, dizendo: Teu filho, que eu porei em teu lugar no teu trono, ele edificará uma casa ao meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Yo por tanto he determinado ahora edificar casa al nombre de Jehová mi Dios, como Jehová lo habló á David mi padre, diciendo: Tu hijo, que yo pondré en lugar tuyo en tu trono, él edificará casa á mi nombre.

verses.KJV: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
verses.WEB: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore command thou that they cut me cedar-trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants; and I will give thee hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt say: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that knoweth how to cut timber like unto the Sidonians.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda, pois, agora, que me cortem cedros do Líbano; e meus servos estarão com os teus servos, e eu te darei o salário dos teus servos conforme a tudo o que disseres; porque tu sabes que ninguém há entre nós que saiba cortar a madeira como os sidônios.
verses.RVR09: Manda pues ahora que me corten cedros del Líbano; y mis siervos estarán con los tuyos, y yo te daré por tus siervos el salario que tú dijeres: porque tú sabes bien que ninguno hay entre nosotros que sepa labrar la madera como los Sidonios.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the Lord this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.WEB: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is the LORD today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be Jehovah this day, who hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Hirão ouviu as palavras de Salomão, alegrou-se em grande maneira, e disse: Bendito seja hoje o SENHOR, que deu filho sábio a Davi sobre este povo tão grande.
verses.RVR09: Y como Hiram oyó las palabras de Salomón, holgóse en gran manera, y dijo: Bendito sea hoy Jehová, que dió hijo sabio á David sobre este pueblo tan grande.

verses.KJV: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
verses.WEB: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.
verses.ASV: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have heard [the message] which thou hast sent unto me: I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Hirão a dizer a Salomão: Ouvi o que me mandaste a dizer: eu farei tudo o que te satisfizer acerca da madeira de cedro, e a madeira de faia.
verses.RVR09: Y envió Hiram á decir á Salomón: He oído lo que me mandaste á decir: yo haré todo lo que te pluguiere acerca de la madera de cedro, y la madera de haya.

verses.KJV: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
verses.WEB: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”
verses.ASV: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea; and I will make them into rafts to go by sea unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and thou shalt receive them; and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus servos a levarão desde o Líbano à mar; e eu a porei em balsas pelo mar até o lugar que tu me assinalares, e ali se desatará, e tu a tomarás: e tu farás minha vontade em dar de comer à minha família.
verses.RVR09: Mis siervos la llevarán desde el Líbano á la mar; y yo la pondré en balsas por la mar hasta el lugar que tú me señalares, y allí se desatará, y tú la tomarás: y tú harás mi voluntad en dar de comer á mi familia.

verses.KJV: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
verses.WEB: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.
verses.ASV: So Hiram gave Solomon timber of cedar and timber of fir according to all his desire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deu, pois, Hirão a Salomão madeira de cedro e madeira de faia tudo o que quis.
verses.RVR09: Dió pues Hiram á Salomón madera de cedro y madera de haya todo lo que quiso.

verses.KJV: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
verses.WEB: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.
verses.ASV: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão dava a Hirão vinte mil coros de trigo para o sustento de sua família, e vinte coros de azeite puro; isto dava Salomão a Hirão cada um ano.
verses.RVR09: Y Salomón daba á Hiram veinte mil coros de trigo para el sustento de su familia, y veinte coros de aceite limpio: esto daba Salomón á Hiram cada un año.

verses.KJV: And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.WEB: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deu, pois, o SENHOR a Salomão sabedoria como lhe havia dito: e havia paz entre Hirão e Salomão, e fizeram aliança entre ambos.
verses.RVR09: Dió pues Jehová á Salomón sabiduría como le había dicho: y hubo paz entre Hiram y Salomón, é hicieron alianza entre ambos.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.WEB: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.ASV: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Salomão impôs tributo a todo Israel, e o tributo foi de trinta mil homens:
verses.RVR09: Y el rey Salomón impuso tributo á todo Israel, y el tributo fué de treinta mil hombres:

verses.KJV: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
verses.WEB: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.
verses.ASV: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses; a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the men subject to taskwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais enviava ao Líbano de dez mil em dez mil, cada mês por seu turno, vindo assim a estar um mês no Líbano, e dois meses em suas casas: e Adonirão estava sobre aquele tributo.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales enviaba al Líbano de diez mil en diez mil, cada mes por su turno, viniendo así á estar un mes en el Líbano, y dos meses en sus casas: y Adoniram estaba sobre aquel tributo.

verses.KJV: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
verses.WEB: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,
verses.ASV: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand that were hewers in the mountains;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tinha também Salomão setenta mil que levavam as cargas, e oitenta mil cortadores no monte;
verses.RVR09: Tenía también Salomón setenta mil que llevaban las cargas, y ochenta mil cortadores en el monte;

verses.KJV: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.WEB: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.
verses.ASV: besides Solomon’s chief officers that were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sem os principais oficiais de Salomão que estavam sobre a obra, três mil e trezentos, os quais tinham cargo do povo que fazia a obra.
verses.RVR09: Sin los principales oficiales de Salomón que estaban sobre la obra, tres mil y trescientos, los cuales tenían cargo del pueblo que hacía la obra.

verses.KJV: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
verses.WEB: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.
verses.ASV: And the king commanded, and they hewed out great stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with wrought stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou o rei que trouxessem grandes pedras, pedras de grande valor, para os alicerces da casa, e pedras lavradas.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó el rey que trajesen grandes piedras, piedras de precio, para los cimientos de la casa, y piedras labradas.

verses.KJV: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
verses.WEB: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.
verses.ASV: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites did fashion them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os pedreiros de Salomão e os de Hirão, e os preparadores, cortaram e prepararam a madeira e pedras para lavrar a casa.
verses.RVR09: Y los albañiles de Salomón y los de Hiram, y los aparejadores, cortaron y aparejaron la madera y la cantería para labrar la casa.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi no ano quatrocentos oitenta depois que os filhos de Israel saíram do Egito, no quarto ano do princípio do reino de Salomão sobre Israel, no mês de Zife, que é o mês segundo, que ele começou a edificar a casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ en el año cuatrocientos ochenta después que los hijos de Israel salieron de Egipto, en el cuarto año del principio del reino de Salomón sobre Israel, en el mes de Ziph, que es el mes segundo, que él comenzó á edificar la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the house which king Solomon built for the Lord, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.WEB: The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.
verses.ASV: And the house which king Solomon built for Jehovah, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty [cubits], and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: A casa que o rei Salomão edificou ao SENHOR, teve sessenta côvados de comprimento e vinte de largura, e trinta côvados de altura.
verses.RVR09: La casa que el rey Salomón edificó á Jehová, tuvo sesenta codos de largo y veinte de ancho, y treinta codos de alto.

verses.KJV: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.WEB: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.
verses.ASV: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; [and] ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o pórtico diante do templo da casa, de vinte côvados de comprimento, segundo a largura da casa, e sua largura era de dez côvados diante da casa.
verses.RVR09: Y el pórtico delante del templo de la casa, de veinte codos de largo, según la anchura de la casa, y su ancho era de diez codos delante de la casa.

verses.KJV: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
verses.WEB: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.
verses.ASV: And for the house he made windows of fixed lattice-work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez à casa janelas largas por de dentro, e estreitas por de fora.
verses.RVR09: E hizo á la casa ventanas anchas por de dentro, y estrechas por de fuera.

verses.KJV: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
verses.WEB: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.
verses.ASV: And against the wall of the house he built stories round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle; and he made side-chambers round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Edificou também junto ao muro da casa aposentos ao redor, contra as paredes da casa em derredor do templo e do compartimento interno: e fez câmaras ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Edificó también junto al muro de la casa aposentos alrededor, contra las paredes de la casa en derredor del templo y del oráculo: é hizo cámaras alrededor.

verses.KJV: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
verses.WEB: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.
verses.ASV: The nethermost story was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad; for on the outside he made offsets [in the wall] of the house round about, that [the beams] should not have hold in the walls of the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: O aposento de abaixo era de cinco côvados de largura, e o de em meio de seis côvados de largura, e o terceiro de sete côvados de largura: porque por de fora havia feito apoios à casa em derredor, para não introduzir as vigas nas paredes da casa.
verses.RVR09: El aposento de abajo era de cinco codos de ancho, y el de en medio de seis codos de ancho, y el tercero de siete codos de ancho: porque por de fuera había hecho disminuciones á la casa en derredor, para no trabar las vigas de las paredes de la casa.

verses.KJV: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.WEB: The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.
verses.ASV: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready at the quarry; and there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a casa quando se edificou, fabricaram-na de pedras que traziam já acabadas; de tal maneira que quando a edificavam, nem martelos nem machados se ouviram na casa, nem nenhum outro instrumento de ferro.
verses.RVR09: Y la casa cuando se edificó, fabricáronla de piedras que traían ya acabadas; de tal manera que cuando la edificaban, ni martillos ni hachas se oyeron en la casa, ni ningún otro instrumento de hierro.

verses.KJV: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
verses.WEB: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.
verses.ASV: The door for the middle side-chambers was in the right side of the house: and they went up by winding stairs into the middle [story], and out of the middle into the third.
verses.ALMEIDA: A porta do aposento de em meio estava ao lado direito da casa: e subia-se por um caracol ao de em meio, e do aposento de em meio ao terceiro.
verses.RVR09: La puerta del aposento de en medio estaba al lado derecho de la casa: y subíase por un caracol al de en medio, y del aposento de en medio al tercero.

verses.KJV: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
verses.WEB: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
verses.ASV: So he built the house, and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lavrou, pois, a casa, e acabou-a; e cobriu a casa com artesanatos de cedro.
verses.RVR09: Labró pues la casa, y acabóla; y cubrió la casa con artesonados de cedro.

verses.KJV: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
verses.WEB: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.
verses.ASV: And he built the stories against all the house, each five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou também o aposento em derredor de toda a casa, de altura de cinco côvados, o qual se apoiava na casa com madeiras de cedro.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó asimismo el aposento en derredor de toda la casa, de altura de cinco codos, el cual se apoyaba en la casa con maderas de cedro.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to Solomon, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came to Solomon, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a palavra do SENHOR a Salomão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué palabra de Jehová á Salomón, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
verses.WEB: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.
verses.ASV: Concerning this house which thou art building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute mine ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I establish my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta casa que tu edificas, se andares em meus estatutos, e fizeres meus direitos, e guardares todos meus mandamentos andando neles, eu terei firme contigo minha palavra que falei a Davi teu pai;
verses.RVR09: Esta casa que tú edificas, si anduvieres en mis estatutos, é hicieres mis derechos, y guardares todos mis mandamientos andando en ellos, yo tendré firme contigo mi palabra que hablé á David tu padre;

verses.KJV: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
verses.WEB: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”
verses.ASV: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitarei em meio dos filhos de Israel, e não deixarei a meu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y habitaré en medio de los hijos de Israel, y no dejaré á mi pueblo Israel.

verses.KJV: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.WEB: So Solomon built the house and finished it.
verses.ASV: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que, Salomão preparou a casa, e acabou-a.
verses.RVR09: Así que, Salomón labró la casa, y acabóla.

verses.KJV: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
verses.WEB: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.
verses.ASV: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar: from the floor of the house unto the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood; and he covered the floor of the house with boards of fir.
verses.ALMEIDA: E preparou as paredes da casa por de dentro com tábuas de cedro, revestindo-a de madeira por dentro, desde o piso da casa até as paredes do teto: cobriu também o pavimento com madeira de faia.
verses.RVR09: Y aparejó las paredes de la casa por de dentro con tablas de cedro, vistiéndola de madera por dentro, desde el solado de la casa hasta las paredes de la techumbre: cubrió también el pavimento con madera de haya.

verses.KJV: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
verses.WEB: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.
verses.ASV: And he built twenty cubits on the hinder part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor unto the walls [of the ceiling]: he built [them] for it within, for an oracle, even for the most holy place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também fez ao fim da casa um edifício de vinte côvados de tábuas de cedro, desde o piso até o mais alto; e fabricou-se na casa um compartimento interno, que é o lugar santíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo hizo al cabo de la casa un edificio de veinte codos de tablas de cedro, desde el solado hasta lo más alto; y fabricóse en la casa un oráculo, que es el lugar santísimo.

verses.KJV: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
verses.WEB: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.
verses.ASV: And the house, that is, the temple before [the oracle], was forty cubits [long].
verses.ALMEIDA: E a casa, a saber, o templo de dentro, tinha quarenta côvados.
verses.RVR09: Y la casa, á saber, el templo de dentro, tenía cuarenta codos.

verses.KJV: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
verses.WEB: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
verses.ASV: And there was cedar on the house within, carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a casa estava coberta de cedro por de dentro, e tinha entalhaduras de frutos silvestres e de botões de flores. Todo era cedro; nenhuma pedra se via.
verses.RVR09: Y la casa estaba cubierta de cedro por de dentro, y tenía entalladuras de calabazas silvestres y de botones de flores. Todo era cedro; ninguna piedra se veía.

verses.KJV: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.WEB: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.
verses.ASV: And he prepared an oracle in the midst of the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E adornou o compartimento interno por de dentro no meio da casa, para pôr ali a arca do pacto do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y adornó el oráculo por de dentro en medio de la casa, para poner allí el arca del pacto de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
verses.WEB: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.
verses.ASV: And within the oracle was [a space of] twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof; and he overlaid it with pure gold: and he covered the altar with cedar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o compartimento interno estava na parte de dentro, o qual tinha vinte côvados de comprimento, e outros vinte de largura, e outros vinte de altura; e revestiu-o de ouro puríssimo: também cobriu o altar de cedro.
verses.RVR09: Y el oráculo estaba en la parte de adentro, el cual tenía veinte codos de largo, y otros veinte de ancho, y otros veinte de altura; y vistiólo de oro purísimo: asimismo cubrió el altar de cedro.

verses.KJV: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.WEB: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.ASV: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he drew chains of gold across before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: De sorte que revestiu Salomão de ouro puro a casa por de dentro, e fechou a entrada do compartimento interno com correntes de ouro, e revestiu-o de ouro.
verses.RVR09: De suerte que vistió Salomón de oro puro la casa por de dentro, y cerró la entrada del oráculo con cadenas de oro, y vistiólo de oro.

verses.KJV: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
verses.WEB: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.
verses.ASV: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until all the house was finished: also the whole altar that belonged to the oracle he overlaid with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cobriu, pois, de ouro toda a casa até o fim; e também revestiu de ouro todo o altar que estava diante do compartimento interno.
verses.RVR09: Cubrió pues de oro toda la casa hasta el cabo; y asimismo vistió de oro todo el altar que estaba delante del oráculo.

verses.KJV: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
verses.WEB: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
verses.ASV: And in the oracle he made two cherubim of olive-wood, each ten cubits high.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também no compartimento interno dois querubins de madeira de oliva, cada um de altura de dez côvados.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también en el oráculo dos querubines de madera de oliva, cada uno de altura de diez codos.

verses.KJV: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
verses.WEB: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.
verses.ASV: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: A uma asa do querubim tinha cinco côvados, e a outra asa do querubim outros cinco côvados: assim que havia dez côvados desde a ponta da uma asa até a ponta da outra.
verses.RVR09: La una ala del querubín tenía cinco codos, y la otra ala del querubín otros cinco codos: así que había diez codos desde la punta de la una ala hasta la punta de la otra.

verses.KJV: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
verses.WEB: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.
verses.ASV: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o outro querubim tinha dez côvados; porque ambos os querubins eram de um tamanho e de uma feitura.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo el otro querubín tenía diez codos; porque ambos querubines eran de un tamaño y de una hechura.

verses.KJV: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
verses.WEB: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.
verses.ASV: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
verses.ALMEIDA: A altura do um era de dez côvados, e também o outro.
verses.RVR09: La altura del uno era de diez codos, y asimismo el otro.

verses.KJV: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
verses.WEB: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.
verses.ASV: And he set the cherubim within the inner house; and the wings of the cherubim were stretched forth, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs estes querubins dentro da casa de dentro: os quais querubins estendiam suas asas, de modo que a asa do um tocava à parede, e a asa do outro querubim tocava à outra parede, e as outras duas asas se tocavam a uma à outra na metade da casa.
verses.RVR09: Y puso estos querubines dentro de la casa de adentro: los cuales querubines extendían sus alas, de modo que el ala del uno tocaba á la pared, y el ala del otro querubín tocaba á la otra pared, y las otras dos alas se tocaban la una á la otra en la mitad de la casa.

verses.KJV: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
verses.WEB: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.ASV: And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E revestiu de ouro os querubins.
verses.RVR09: Y vistió de oro los querubines.

verses.KJV: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
verses.WEB: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.
verses.ASV: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers, within and without.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esculpiu todas as paredes da casa ao redor de diversas figuras, de querubins, de palmas, e de botões de flores, por de dentro e por de fora.
verses.RVR09: Y esculpió todas las paredes de la casa alrededor de diversas figuras, de querubines, de palmas, y de botones de flores, por de dentro y por de fuera.

verses.KJV: And the floors of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.WEB: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.
verses.ASV: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cobriu de ouro o piso da casa, de dentro e de fora.
verses.RVR09: Y cubrió de oro el piso de la casa, de dentro y de fuera.

verses.KJV: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
verses.WEB: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.
verses.ASV: And for the entrance of the oracle he made doors of olive-wood: the lintel [and] door-posts were a fifth part [of the wall].
verses.ALMEIDA: E à entrada do compartimento interno fez portas de madeira de oliva; e o umbral e os postes eram de cinco esquinas.
verses.RVR09: Y á la entrada del oráculo hizo puertas de madera de oliva; y el umbral y los postes eran de cinco esquinas.

verses.KJV: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
verses.WEB: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.
verses.ASV: So [he made] two doors of olive-wood; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he spread the gold upon the cherubim, and upon the palm-trees.
verses.ALMEIDA: As duas portas eram de madeira de oliva; e entalhou nelas figuras de querubins e de palmas e de botões de flores, e cobriu-as de ouro: cobriu também de ouro os querubins e as palmas.
verses.RVR09: Las dos puertas eran de madera de oliva; y entalló en ellas figuras de querubines y de palmas y de botones de flores, y cubriólas de oro: cubrió también de oro los querubines y las palmas.

verses.KJV: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
verses.WEB: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,
verses.ASV: So also made he for the entrance of the temple door-posts of olive-wood, out of a fourth part [of the wall];
verses.ALMEIDA: Igualmente fez à porta do templo postes de madeira de oliva quadrados.
verses.RVR09: Igualmente hizo á la puerta del templo postes de madera de oliva cuadrados.

verses.KJV: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.WEB: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.ASV: and two doors of fir-wood: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém as duas portas eram de madeira de faia; e os dois lados da uma porta eram redondos, e os outros dois lados da outra porta também redondos.
verses.RVR09: Pero las dos puertas eran de madera de haya; y los dos lados de la una puerta eran redondos, y los otros dos lados de la otra puerta también redondos.

verses.KJV: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
verses.WEB: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.
verses.ASV: And he carved [thereon] cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted upon the graven work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entalhou nelas querubins e palmas e botões de flores, e cobriu-as de ouro ajustado às entalhaduras.
verses.RVR09: Y entalló en ellas querubines y palmas y botones de flores, y cubriólas de oro ajustado á las entalladuras.

verses.KJV: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.WEB: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
verses.ASV: And he built the inner court with three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou o átrio interior de três ordens de pedras lavradas, e de uma ordem de vigas de cedro.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó el atrio interior de tres órdenes de piedras labradas, y de un orden de vigas de cedro.

verses.KJV: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the Lord laid, in the month Zif:
verses.WEB: The foundation of the LORD’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.
verses.ASV: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of Jehovah laid, in the month Ziv.
verses.ALMEIDA: No quarto ano, no mês de Zife, se lançaram os alicerces da casa do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: En el cuarto año, en el mes de Ziph, se echaron los cimientos de la casa de Jehová:

verses.KJV: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.WEB: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.
verses.ASV: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no décimo primeiro ano, no mês de Bul, que é o mês oitavo, foi acabada a casa com todas seus partes, e com todo o necessário. Edificou-a, pois, em sete anos.
verses.RVR09: Y en el undécimo año, en el mes de Bul, que es el mes octavo, fué acabada la casa con todas sus pertenencias, y con todo lo necesario. Edificóla pues, en siete años.

verses.KJV: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.WEB: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.ASV: And Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois edificou Salomão sua própria casa em treze anos, e acabou de construí-la toda.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS edificó Salomón su propia casa en trece años, y acabóla toda.

verses.KJV: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.WEB: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.
verses.ASV: For he built the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was a hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também edificou a casa do bosque do Líbano, a qual tinha cinco côvados de comprimento, e cinquenta côvados de largura, e trinta côvados de altura, sobre quatro ordens de colunas de cedro, com vigas de cedro sobre as colunas.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo edificó la casa del bosque del Líbano, la cual tenía cien codos de longitud, y cincuenta codos de anchura, y treinta codos de altura, sobre cuatro órdenes de columnas de cedro, con vigas de cedro sobre las columnas.

verses.KJV: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
verses.WEB: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.
verses.ASV: And it was covered with cedar above over the forty and five beams, that were upon the pillars; fifteen in a row.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava coberta de tábuas de cedro acima sobre as vigas, que se apoiavam em quarenta e cinco colunas: cada fileira tinha quinze colunas.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba cubierta de tablas de cedro arriba sobre las vigas, que se apoyaban en cuarenta y cinco columnas: cada hilera tenía quince columnas.

verses.KJV: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.WEB: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.
verses.ASV: And there were beams in three rows, and window was over against window in three ranks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia três ordens de janelas, uma janela contra a outra em três ordens.
verses.RVR09: Y había tres órdenes de ventanas, una ventana contra la otra en tres órdenes.

verses.KJV: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.WEB: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.
verses.ASV: And all the doors and posts were made square with beams: and window was over against window in three ranks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as portas e postes eram quadrados: e as umas janelas estavam de frente às outras em três ordens.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las puertas y postes eran cuadrados: y las unas ventanas estaban frente á las otras en tres órdenes.

verses.KJV: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
verses.WEB: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.
verses.ASV: And he made the porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits; and a porch before them; and pillars and a threshold before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também fez um pórtico de colunas, que tinha de comprimento cinquenta côvados, e trinta côvados de largura; e este pórtico estava diante daquelas outras, com suas colunas e vigas correspondentes.
verses.RVR09: También hizo un pórtico de columnas, que tenía de largo cincuenta codos, y treinta codos de ancho; y aqueste pórtico estaba delante de aquellas otras, con sus columnas y maderos correspondientes.

verses.KJV: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
verses.WEB: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
verses.ASV: And he made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o pórtico do trono em que havia de julgar, o pórtico do juízo, e revestiu-o de cedro do chão ao teto.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo el pórtico del trono en que había de juzgar, el pórtico del juicio, y vistiólo de cedro de suelo á suelo.

verses.KJV: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
verses.WEB: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.
verses.ASV: And his house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the like work. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken to wife), like unto this porch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E na casa em que ele morava, havia outro átrio dentro do pórtico, de obra semelhante a esta. Edificou também Salomão uma casa para a filha de Faraó, que havia tomado por mulher, da mesma obra daquele pórtico.
verses.RVR09: Y en la casa en que él moraba, había otro atrio dentro del pórtico, de obra semejante á esta. Edificó también Salomón una casa para la hija de Faraón, que había tomado por mujer, de la misma obra de aquel pórtico.

verses.KJV: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
verses.WEB: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.
verses.ASV: All these were of costly stones, even of hewn stone, according to measure, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside unto the great court.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas aquelas obras foram de pedras de grande valor, cortadas e serradas com serras segundo as medidas, assim por de dentro como por de fora, desde o alicerce até os topos das paredes, e também por de fora até o grande átrio.
verses.RVR09: Todas aquellas obras fueron de piedras de precio, cortadas y aserradas con sierras según las medidas, así por de dentro como por de fuera, desde el cimiento hasta los remates, y asimismo por de fuera hasta el gran atrio.

verses.KJV: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.WEB: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.
verses.ASV: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: O alicerce era de pedras de grande valor, de pedras grandes, de pedras de dez côvados, e de pedras de oito côvados.
verses.RVR09: El cimiento era de piedras de precio, de piedras grandes, de piedras de diez codos, y de piedras de ocho codos.

verses.KJV: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
verses.WEB: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.
verses.ASV: And above were costly stones, even hewn stone, according to measure, and cedar-wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dali acima eram também pedras de grande valor, lavradas conforme a suas medidas, e obra de cedro.
verses.RVR09: De allí arriba eran también piedras de precio, labradas conforme á sus medidas, y obra de cedro.

verses.KJV: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the Lord, and for the porch of the house.
verses.WEB: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of the LORD’s house and the porch of the house.
verses.ASV: And the great court round about had three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams; like as the inner court of the house of Jehovah, and the porch of the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no grande átrio ao redor havia três ordens de pedras lavradas, e uma ordem de vigas de cedro: e assim o átrio interior da casa do SENHOR, e o átrio da casa.
verses.RVR09: Y en el gran atrio alrededor había tres órdenes de piedras labradas, y un orden de vigas de cedro: y así el atrio interior de la casa de Jehová, y el atrio de la casa.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.WEB: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.ASV: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou o rei Salomão, e fez vir de Tiro a Hirão,
verses.RVR09: Y envió el rey Salomón, é hizo venir de Tiro á Hiram,

verses.KJV: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.WEB: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.
verses.ASV: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill, to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de uma viúva da tribo de Naftali, e seu pai havia sido de Tiro: trabalhava ele em bronze, cheio de sabedoria e de inteligência e saber em toda obra de bronze. Este pois veio ao rei Salomão, e fez toda sua obra.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de una viuda de la tribu de Nephtalí, y su padre había sido de Tiro: trabajaba él en bronce, lleno de sabiduría y de inteligencia y saber en toda obra de metal. Este pues vino al rey Salomón, é hizo toda su obra.

verses.KJV: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
verses.WEB: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.
verses.ASV: For he fashioned the two pillars of brass, eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits compassed either of them about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fundiu duas colunas de bronze, a altura de cada qual era de dezoito côvados: e rodeava a uma e a outra coluna um fio de doze côvados.
verses.RVR09: Y vació dos columnas de bronce, la altura de cada cual era de diez y ocho codos: y rodeaba á una y á otra columna un hilo de doce codos.

verses.KJV: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
verses.WEB: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
verses.ASV: And he made two capitals of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também dois capitéis de fundição de bronze, para que fossem postos sobre as cabeças das colunas: a altura de um capitel era de cinco côvados, e a do outro capitel de cinco côvados.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también dos capiteles de fundición de bronce, para que fuesen puestos sobre las cabezas de las columnas: la altura de un capitel era de cinco codos, y la del otro capitel de cinco codos.

verses.KJV: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
verses.WEB: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.
verses.ASV: There were nets of checker-work, and wreaths of chain-work, for the capitals which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia trançados à maneira de redes, e grinaldas à maneira de correntes, para os capitéis que se haviam de pôr sobre as cabeças das colunas: sete para cada capitel.
verses.RVR09: Había trenzas á manera de red, y unas cintas á manera de cadenas, para los capiteles que se habían de poner sobre las cabezas de las columnas: siete para cada capitel.

verses.KJV: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
verses.WEB: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.
verses.ASV: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars: and so did he for the other capital.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando havia feito as colunas, fez também duas ordens de romãs ao redor no um enredado, para cobrir os capitéis que estavam nas cabeças das colunas com as romãs: e da mesma forma fez no outro capitel.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando hubo hecho las columnas, hizo también dos órdenes de granadas alrededor en el un enredado, para cubrir los capiteles que estaban en las cabezas de las columnas con las granadas: y de la misma forma hizo en el otro capitel.

verses.KJV: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
verses.WEB: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.
verses.ASV: And the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily-work, four cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os capitéis que estavam sobre as colunas no pórtico, tinham trabalho de flores por quatro côvados.
verses.RVR09: Los capiteles que estaban sobre las columnas en el pórtico, tenían labor de flores por cuatro codos.

verses.KJV: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
verses.WEB: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.
verses.ASV: And there were capitals above also upon the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred, in rows round about upon the other capital.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tinham também os capitéis de sobre as duas colunas, duzentas romãs em duas ordens ao redor em cada capitel, encima da parte arredondada do capitel, o qual estava diante do trançado.
verses.RVR09: Tenían también los capiteles de sobre las dos columnas, doscientas granadas en dos órdenes alrededor en cada capitel, encima del vientre del capitel, el cual vientre estaba delante del enredado.

verses.KJV: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.WEB: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.
verses.ASV: And he set up the pillars at the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin; and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas colunas ele erigiu no pórtico do templo: e quando havia levantado a coluna da direita, pôs-lhe por nome Jaquim: e levantando a coluna da esquerda, chamou seu nome Boaz.
verses.RVR09: Estas columnas erigió en el pórtico del templo: y cuando hubo alzado la columna de la mano derecha, púsole por nombre Jachîn: y alzando la columna de la mano izquierda, llamó su nombre Boaz.

verses.KJV: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.WEB: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.
verses.ASV: And upon the top of the pillars was lily-work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs nas cabeças das colunas trabalho em forma de açucenas; e assim se acabou a obra das colunas.
verses.RVR09: Y puso en las cabezas de las columnas labor en forma de azucenas; y así se acabó la obra de las columnas.

verses.KJV: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.WEB: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.
verses.ASV: And he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and the height thereof was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também um mar de fundição, de dez côvados do um lado ao outro, redondo; sua altura era de cinco côvados, e cingia-o ao redor um cordão de trinta côvados.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo un mar de fundición, de diez codos del un lado al otro, perfectamente redondo: su altura era de cinco codos, y ceñíalo alrededor un cordón de treinta codos.

verses.KJV: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.WEB: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
verses.ASV: And under the brim of it round about there were knops which did compass it, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about: the knops were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cercavam aquele mar por debaixo de sua borda em derredor umas bolas como frutos, dez em cada côvado, que cingiam o mar ao redor em duas ordens, as quais haviam sido fundidas quando ele foi fundido.
verses.RVR09: Y cercaban aquel mar por debajo de su labio en derredor unas bolas como calabazas, diez en cada codo, que ceñían el mar alrededor en dos órdenes, las cuales habían sido fundidas cuando él fué fundido.

verses.KJV: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.WEB: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.
verses.ASV: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set upon them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava assentado sobre doze bois: três estavam voltados ao norte, e três estavam voltados ao ocidente, e três estavam voltados ao sul, e três estavam voltados ao oriente; sobre estes se apoiava o mar, e as traseiras deles estavam até a parte de dentro.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba asentado sobre doce bueyes: tres miraban al norte, y tres miraban al poniente, y tres miraban al mediodía, y tres miraban al oriente; sobre éstos se apoyaba el mar, y las traseras de ellos estaban hacia la parte de adentro.

verses.KJV: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
verses.WEB: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.
verses.ASV: And it was a handbreadth thick: and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it held two thousand baths.
verses.ALMEIDA: A espessura do mar era de um palmo, e sua borda era lavrada como a borda de um cálice, ou de flor de lírio: e cabiam nele dois mil batos.
verses.RVR09: El grueso del mar era de un palmo, y su labio era labrado como el labio de un cáliz, ó de flor de lis: y cabían en él dos mil batos.

verses.KJV: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.WEB: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.
verses.ASV: And he made the ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também dez bases de bronze, sendo o comprimento de cada base de quatro côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados, e de três côvados a altura.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también diez basas de bronce, siendo la longitud de cada basa de cuatro codos, y la anchura de cuatro codos, y de tres codos la altura.

verses.KJV: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
verses.WEB: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;
verses.ASV: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;
verses.ALMEIDA: A obra das bases era esta: tinham uns painéis, as quais estavam entre molduras:
verses.RVR09: La obra de las basas era esta: tenían unas cintas, las cuales estaban entre molduras:

verses.KJV: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
verses.WEB: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.
verses.ASV: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and upon the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sobre aqueles painéis que estavam entre as molduras, figuras de leões, e de bois, e de querubins; e sobre as molduras da base, assim encima como debaixo dos leões e dos bois, havia uns acréscimos de baixo-relevo.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre aquellas cintas que estaban entre las molduras, figuras de leones, y de bueyes, y de querubines; y sobre las molduras de la basa, así encima como debajo de los leones y de los bueyes, había unas añadiduras de bajo relieve.

verses.KJV: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
verses.WEB: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.
verses.ASV: And every base had four brazen wheels, and axles of brass; and the four feet thereof had undersetters: beneath the laver were the undersetters molten, with wreaths at the side of each.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada base tinha quatro rodas de bronze com mesas de bronze; e em seus quatro eixos havia uns apoios, os quais haviam sido fundidos a cada lado com grinaldas, para estarem debaixo da fonte.
verses.RVR09: Cada basa tenía cuatro ruedas de bronce con mesas de bronce; y en sus cuatro esquinas había unos hombrillos, los cuales nacían de fundición á cada un lado de aquellas añadiduras, para estar debajo de la fuente.

verses.KJV: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
verses.WEB: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.
verses.ASV: And the mouth of it within the capital and above was a cubit: and the mouth thereof was round after the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also upon the mouth of it were gravings, and their panels were foursquare, not round.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a abertura da bacia era de um côvado no suporte que saía para acima da base; e era sua abertura redonda, da feitura do mesmo suporte, e este de côvado e meio. Havia também sobre a abertura entalhes em seus painéis, que eram quadrados, não redondas.
verses.RVR09: Y la boca del pie de la fuente entraba un codo en el remate que salía para arriba de la basa; y era su boca redonda, de la hechura del mismo remate, y éste de codo y medio. Había también sobre la boca entalladuras con sus cintas, las cuales eran cuadradas, no redondas.

verses.KJV: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.WEB: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.ASV: And the four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axletrees of the wheels were in the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.ALMEIDA: As quatro rodas estavam debaixo dos painéis, e os eixos das rodas estavam na mesma base. A altura de cada roda era de um côvado e meio.
verses.RVR09: Las cuatro ruedas estaban debajo de las cintas, y los ejes de las ruedas nacían en la misma basa. La altura de cada rueda era de un codo y medio.

verses.KJV: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
verses.WEB: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.
verses.ASV: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their felloes, and their spokes, and their naves, were all molten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a feitura das rodas era como a feitura das rodas de um carro: seus eixos, seus raios, e seus cubos, e seus aros, tudo era de fundição.
verses.RVR09: Y la hechura de las ruedas era como la hechura de las ruedas de un carro: sus ejes, sus rayos, y sus cubos, y sus cinchos, todo era de fundición.

verses.KJV: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
verses.WEB: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.
verses.ASV: And there were four undersetters at the four corners of each base: the undersetters thereof were of the base itself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também os quatro apoios às quatro esquinas de cada base: e os apoios eram da mesma base.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo los cuatro hombrillos á las cuatro esquinas de cada basa: y los hombrillos eran de la misma basa.

verses.KJV: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
verses.WEB: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.
verses.ASV: And in the top of the base was there a round compass half a cubit high; and on the top of the base the stays thereof and the panels thereof were of the same.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no alto da base havia meio côvado de altura redondo por todas partes: e encima da base suas molduras e painéis, as quais eram dela mesma.
verses.RVR09: Y en lo alto de la basa había medio codo de altura redondo por todas partes: y encima de la basa sus molduras y cintas, las cuales eran de ella misma.

verses.KJV: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
verses.WEB: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.
