verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the two houses, the house of Jehovah and the king’s house
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu ao fim de vinte anos, em que Salomão havia edificado as duas casas, a casa do SENHOR e a casa real,
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció al cabo de veinte años, en que Salomón había edificado las dos casas, la casa de Jehová y la casa real,

verses.KJV: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.WEB: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.ASV: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar-trees and fir-trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Para as quais Hirão rei de Tiro, havia trazido a Salomão madeira de cedro e de faia, e quanto ouro ele quis), que o rei Salomão deu a Hirão vinte cidades em terra de Galileia.
verses.RVR09: (Para las cuales Hiram rey de Tiro, había traído á Salomón madera de cedro y de haya, y cuanto oro él quiso), que el rey Salomón dió á Hiram veinte ciudades en tierra de Galilea.

verses.KJV: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
verses.WEB: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.
verses.ASV: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu Hirão de Tiro para ver as cidades que Salomão lhe havia dado, e não lhe contentaram.
verses.RVR09: Y salió Hiram de Tiro para ver las ciudades que Salomón le había dado, y no le contentaron.

verses.KJV: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
verses.WEB: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.
verses.ASV: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Que cidades são estas que me deste, irmão? E pôs-lhes por nome, a terra de Cabul, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: ¿Qué ciudades son estas que me has dado, hermano? Y púsoles por nombre, la tierra de Cabul, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
verses.WEB: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.
verses.ASV: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia Hirão enviado ao rei cento e vinte talentos de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y había Hiram enviado al rey ciento y veinte talentos de oro.

verses.KJV: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the Lord, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.WEB: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build the LORD’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.ASV: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised, to build the house of Jehovah, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E esta é a razão do tributo que o rei Salomão impôs para edificar a casa do SENHOR, e sua casa, e a Milo, e o muro de Jerusalém, e a Hazor, e Megido, e Gezer.
verses.RVR09: Y esta es la razón del tributo que el rey Salomón impuso para edificar la casa de Jehová, y su casa, y á Millo, y el muro de Jerusalem, y á Hasor, y Megiddo, y Gezer.

verses.KJV: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.
verses.WEB: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
verses.ASV: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a portion unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faraó, o rei do Egito, havia subido e tomado a Gezer, e a queimado, e havia matado os cananeus que habitavam a cidade, e dado-a em presente à sua filha, a mulher de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Faraón el rey de Egipto había subido y tomado á Gezer, y quemádola, y había muerto los Cananeos que habitaban la ciudad, y dádola en don á su hija la mujer de Salomón.

verses.KJV: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
verses.WEB: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,
verses.ASV: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,
verses.ALMEIDA: Restaurou, pois Salomão a Gezer, e à baixa Bete-Horom,
verses.RVR09: Restauró pues Salomón á Gezer, y á la baja Beth-oron,

verses.KJV: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
verses.WEB: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,
verses.ASV: and Baalath, and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Baalate, e a Tadmor em terra do deserto;
verses.RVR09: Y á Baalath, y á Tadmor en tierra del desierto;

verses.KJV: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.WEB: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.ASV: and all the store-cities that Solomon had, and the cities for his chariots, and the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também todas as cidades de onde Salomão tinha armazéns, e as cidades dos carros, e as cidades de cavaleiros, e tudo o que Salomão desejou edificar em Jerusalém, no Líbano, e em toda a terra de seu senhorio.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo todas las ciudades donde Salomón tenía municiones, y las ciudades de los carros, y las ciudades de la gente de á caballo, y todo lo que Salomón deseó edificar en Jerusalem, en el Líbano, y en toda la tierra de su señorío.

verses.KJV: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,
verses.WEB: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—
verses.ASV: As for all the people that were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: A todos os povos que restaram dos amorreus, heteus, perizeus, heveus, jebuseus, que não foram dos filhos de Israel;
verses.RVR09: A todos los pueblos que quedaron de los Amorrheos, Hetheos, Pherezeos, Heveos, Jebuseos, que no fueron de los hijos de Israel;

verses.KJV: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
verses.WEB: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.
verses.ASV: their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy, of them did Solomon raise a levy of bondservants unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: A seus filhos que restaram na terra depois deles, que os filhos de Israel não puderam acabar, fez Salomão que servissem com tributo até hoje.
verses.RVR09: A sus hijos que quedaron en la tierra después de ellos, que los hijos de Israel no pudieron acabar, hizo Salomón que sirviesen con tributo hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.WEB: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
verses.ASV: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondservants; but they were the men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a ninguém dos filhos de Israel impôs Salomão serviço, mas sim que eram homens de guerra, ou seus criados, ou seus príncipes, ou seus capitães, ou comandantes de seus carros, ou sua cavaleiros.
verses.RVR09: Mas á ninguno de los hijos de Israel impuso Salomón servicio, sino que eran hombres de guerra, ó sus criados, ó sus príncipes, ó sus capitanes, ó comandantes de sus carros, ó su gente de á caballo.

verses.KJV: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.WEB: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.
verses.ASV: These were the chief officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, who bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que Salomão havia feito chefes e líderes sobre as obras, eram quinhentos e cinquenta, os quais estavam sobre o povo que trabalhava naquela obra.
verses.RVR09: Y los que Salomón había hecho jefes y prepósitos sobre las obras, eran quinientos y cincuenta, los cuales estaban sobre el pueblo que trabajaba en aquella obra.

verses.KJV: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
verses.WEB: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.
verses.ASV: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which [Solomon] had built for her: then did he build Millo.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu a filha de Faraó da cidade de Davi a sua casa que Salomão lhe havia edificado: então edificou ele a Milo.
verses.RVR09: Y subió la hija de Faraón de la ciudad de David á su casa que Salomón le había edificado: entonces edificó él á Millo.

verses.KJV: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the Lord, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the Lord. So he finished the house.
verses.WEB: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to the LORD three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
verses.ASV: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt-offerings and peace-offerings upon the altar which he built unto Jehovah, burning incense therewith, [upon the altar] that was before Jehovah. So he finished the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E oferecia Salomão três vezes cada um ano holocaustos e pacíficos sobre o altar que ele edificou ao SENHOR, e queimava incenso sobre o que estava diante do SENHOR, depois que a casa foi acabada.
verses.RVR09: Y ofrecía Salomón tres veces cada un año holocaustos y pacíficos sobre el altar que él edificó á Jehová, y quemaba perfumes sobre el que estaba delante de Jehová, después que la casa fué acabada.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.WEB: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.ASV: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o rei Salomão navios em Eziom-Geber, que é junto a Elate na beira do mar Vermelho, na terra de Edom.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el rey Salomón navíos en Ezión-geber, que es junto á Elath en la ribera del mar Bermejo, en la tierra de Edom.

verses.KJV: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.WEB: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.ASV: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou Hirão neles a seus servos, marinheiros e destros no mar, com os servos de Salomão:
verses.RVR09: Y envió Hiram en ellos á sus siervos, marineros y diestros en la mar, con los siervos de Salomón:

verses.KJV: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
verses.WEB: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.
verses.ASV: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais foram a Ofir, e tomaram dali ouro, quatrocentos e vinte talentos, e trouxeram-no ao rei Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales fueron á Ophir, y tomaron de allí oro, cuatrocientos y veinte talentos, y trajéronlo al rey Salomón.

verses.KJV: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the Lord, she came to prove him with hard questions.
verses.WEB: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
verses.ASV: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of Jehovah, she came to prove him with hard questions.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo a rainha de Sabá a fama de Salomão no nome do SENHOR, veio a provar-lhe com perguntas.
verses.RVR09: Y OYENDO la reina de Seba la fama de Salomón en el nombre de Jehová, vino á probarle con preguntas.

verses.KJV: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.WEB: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
verses.ASV: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones; and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a Jerusalém com muito grande comitiva, com camelos carregados de especiarias, e ouro em grande abundância, e pedras preciosas: e quando veio a Salomão, propôs-lhe todo o que em seu coração tinha.
verses.RVR09: Y vino á Jerusalem con muy grande comitiva, con camellos cargados de especias, y oro en grande abundancia, y piedras preciosas: y como vino á Salomón, propúsole todo lo que en su corazón tenía.

verses.KJV: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
verses.WEB: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.
verses.ASV: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not anything hid from the king which he told her not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão lhe declarou todas suas palavras: nenhuma coisa se lhe escondeu ao rei, que não lhe declarasse.
verses.RVR09: Y Salomón le declaró todas sus palabras: ninguna cosa se le escondió al rey, que no le declarase.

verses.KJV: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,
verses.WEB: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
verses.ASV: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando a rainha de Sabá viu toda a sabedoria de Salomão, e a casa que havia edificado,
verses.RVR09: Y cuando la reina de Seba vió toda la sabiduría de Salomón, y la casa que había edificado,

verses.KJV: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.WEB: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.
verses.ASV: and the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of Jehovah; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também a comida de sua mesa, o assento de seus servos, o estado e roupas dos que lhe serviam, seus mestres-salas, e seus holocaustos que sacrificava na casa do SENHOR, ficou pasma.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo la comida de su mesa, el asiento de sus siervos, el estado y vestidos de los que le servían, sus maestresalas, y sus holocaustos que sacrificaba en la casa de Jehová, quedóse enajenada.

verses.KJV: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.
verses.WEB: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
verses.ASV: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ao rei: Verdade é o que ouvi em minha terra de tuas coisas e de tua sabedoria;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo al rey: Verdad es lo que oí en mi tierra de tus cosas y de tu sabiduría;

verses.KJV: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
verses.WEB: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.
verses.ASV: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me; thy wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu não o cria, até que vim, e meus olhos viram, que nem ainda a metade foi o que se me disse: é maior tua sabedoria e bem que a fama que eu havia ouvido.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo no lo creía, hasta que he venido, y mis ojos han visto, que ni aun la mitad fué lo que se me dijo: es mayor tu sabiduría y bien que la fama que yo había oído.

verses.KJV: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.
verses.WEB: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.
verses.ASV: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, that stand continually before thee, [and] that hear thy wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurados teus homens, ditosos estes teus servos, que estão continuamente diante de ti, e ouvem tua sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados tus varones, dichosos estos tus siervos, que están continuamente delante de ti, y oyen tu sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the Lord loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah thy God, who delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because Jehovah loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do justice and righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: o SENHOR teu Deus seja bendito, que se agradou de ti para te pôr no trono de Israel; porque o SENHOR amou sempre a Israel, e te pôs por rei, para que faças direito e justiça.
verses.RVR09: Jehová tu Dios sea bendito, que se agradó de ti para ponerte en el trono de Israel; porque Jehová ha amado siempre á Israel, y te ha puesto por rey, para que hagas derecho y justicia.

verses.KJV: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.WEB: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.ASV: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu ela ao rei cento e vinte talentos de ouro, e muita especiaria, e pedras preciosas: nunca veio tão grande quantidade de especiarias, como a rainha de Sabá deu ao rei Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y dió ella al rey ciento y veinte talentos de oro, y muy mucha especiería, y piedras preciosas: nunca vino tan grande copia de especias, como la reina de Seba dió al rey Salomón.

verses.KJV: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
verses.WEB: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.
verses.ASV: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug-trees and precious stones.
verses.ALMEIDA: A frota de Hirão que havia trazido o ouro de Ofir, trazia também de Ofir muita madeira de sândalo, e pedras preciosas.
verses.RVR09: La flota de Hiram que había traído el oro de Ophir, traía también de Ophir muy mucha madera de brasil, y piedras preciosas.

verses.KJV: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the Lord, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
verses.WEB: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.
verses.ASV: And the king made of the almug-trees pillars for the house of Jehovah, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for the singers: there came no such almug-trees, nor were seen, unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da madeira de sândalo fez o rei balaústres para a casa do SENHOR, e para as casas reais, harpas também e saltérios para os cantores: nunca veio tanta madeira de sândalo, nem se há visto até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y de la madera de brasil hizo el rey balaustres para la casa de Jehová, y para las casas reales, arpas también y salterios para los cantores: nunca vino tanta madera de brasil, ni se ha visto hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
verses.WEB: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.ASV: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, besides that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned, and went to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Salomão deu à rainha de Sabá tudo o que quis, e tudo o que pediu, ademais do que Salomão lhe deu como da mão do rei Salomão. E ela se voltou, e se foi a sua terra com seus criados.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey Salomón dió á la reina de Seba todo lo que quiso, y todo lo que pidió, además de lo que Salomón le dió como de mano del rey Salomón. Y ella se volvió, y se fué á su tierra con sus criados.

verses.KJV: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
verses.WEB: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
verses.ASV: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
verses.ALMEIDA: O peso do ouro que Salomão tinha de renda cada um ano era seiscentos sessenta e seis talentos de ouro;
verses.RVR09: El peso del oro que Salomón tenía de renta cada un año, era seiscientos sesenta y seis talentos de oro;

verses.KJV: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
verses.WEB: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.
verses.ASV: besides [that which] the traders [brought], and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mingled people, and of the governors of the country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sem o dos mercadores, e da contratação de especiarias, e de todos os reis de Arábia, e dos principais da terra.
verses.RVR09: Sin lo de los mercaderes, y de la contratación de especias, y de todos los reyes de Arabia, y de los principales de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
verses.WEB: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.
verses.ASV: And king Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred [shekels] of gold went to one buckler.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o rei Salomão duzentos paveses de ouro estendido: seiscentos siclos de ouro gastou em cada pavês.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el rey Salomón doscientos paveses de oro extendido: seiscientos siclos de oro gastó en cada pavés.

verses.KJV: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.WEB: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.ASV: And [he made] three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pounds of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também trezentos escudos de ouro estendido, em cada um dos quais gastou três libras de ouro: e os pôs o rei na casa do bosque do Líbano.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo trescientos escudos de oro extendido, en cada uno de los cuales gastó tres libras de oro: y púsolos el rey en la casa del bosque del Líbano.

verses.KJV: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verses.WEB: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.
verses.ASV: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o rei um grande trono de marfim, o qual cobriu de ouro puríssimo.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el rey un gran trono de marfil, el cual cubrió de oro purísimo.

verses.KJV: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
verses.WEB: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.
verses.ASV: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were stays on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the stays.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seis degraus tinha o trono, e o alto dele era redondo pelo recosto: e da uma parte e da outra tinha apoios próximo do assento, junto aos quais estavam colocados dois leões.
verses.RVR09: Seis gradas tenía el trono, y lo alto de él era redondo por el respaldo: y de la una parte y de la otra tenía apoyos cerca del asiento, junto á los cuales estaban colocados dos leones.

verses.KJV: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.WEB: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.
verses.ASV: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estavam também doze leões postos ali sobre os seis degraus, da uma parte e da outra: em nenhum outro reino se havia feito trono semelhante.
verses.RVR09: Estaban también doce leones puestos allí sobre las seis gradas, de la una parte y de la otra: en ningún otro reino se había hecho trono semejante.

verses.KJV: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.WEB: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.
verses.ASV: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os vasos de beber do rei Salomão eram de ouro, e também toda a vasilha da casa do bosque do Líbano era de ouro fino: não havia prata; em tempo de Salomão não era de valor.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los vasos de beber del rey Salomón eran de oro, y asimismo toda la vajilla de la casa del bosque del Líbano era de oro fino: no había plata; en tiempo de Salomón no era de estima.

verses.KJV: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.WEB: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.ASV: For the king had at sea a navy of Tarshish with the navy of Hiram: once every three years came the navy of Tarshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o rei tinha a frota que saía à mar, a Társis, com a frota de Hirão: uma vez em cada três anos vinha a frota de Társis, e trazia ouro, prata, marfim, macacos e pavões.
verses.RVR09: Porque el rey tenía la flota que salía á la mar, á Tharsis, con la flota de Hiram: una vez en cada tres años venía la flota de Tharsis, y traía oro, plata, marfil, simios y pavos.

verses.KJV: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
verses.WEB: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.
verses.ASV: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim excedia o rei Salomão a todos os reis da terra em riquezas e em sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Así excedía el rey Salomón á todos los reyes de la tierra en riquezas y en sabiduría.

verses.KJV: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.WEB: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.
verses.ASV: And all the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda a terra procurava ver a cara de Salomão, para ouvir sua sabedoria, a qual Deus havia posto em seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Toda la tierra procuraba ver la cara de Salomón, para oir su sabiduría, la cual Dios había puesto en su corazón.

verses.KJV: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.WEB: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.
verses.ASV: And they brought every man his tribute, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, and armor, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos lhe levavam cada ano seus tributos: utensílios de ouro, utensílios de prata, roupas, armas, aromas, cavalos e mulas.
verses.RVR09: Y todos le llevaban cada año sus presentes: vasos de oro, vasos de plata, vestidos, armas, aromas, caballos y acémilas.

verses.KJV: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntou Salomão carros e cavaleiros; e tinha mil quatrocentos carros, e doze mil cavaleiros, os quais pôs nas cidades dos carros, e com o rei em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y juntó Salomón carros y gente de á caballo; y tenía mil cuatrocientos carros, y doce mil jinetes, los cuales puso en las ciudades de los carros, y con el rey en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
verses.WEB: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
verses.ASV: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore-trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs o rei em Jerusalém prata como pedras, e cedros como os sicômoros que estão pelos campos em abundância.
verses.RVR09: Y puso el rey en Jerusalem plata como piedras, y cedros como los cabrahigos que están por los campos en abundancia.

verses.KJV: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.WEB: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.
verses.ASV: And the horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt; and the king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.
verses.ALMEIDA: E traziam cavalos a Salomão do Egito e de Coa: porque os mercadores do rei compravam cavalos de Coa.
verses.RVR09: Y sacaban caballos y lienzos á Salomón de Egipto: porque la compañía de los mercaderes del rey compraban caballos y lienzos.

verses.KJV: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
verses.WEB: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.
verses.ASV: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred [shekels] of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty; and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vinha e saía do Egito, o carro por seiscentas peças de prata, e o cavalo por cento e cinquenta; e assim os traziam por meio deles, todos os reis dos heteus, e da Síria.
verses.RVR09: Y venía y salía de Egipto, el carro por seiscientas piezas de plata, y el caballo por ciento y cincuenta; y así los sacaban por mano de ellos todos los reyes de los Hetheos, y de Siria.

verses.KJV: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites:
verses.WEB: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,
verses.ASV: Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o rei Salomão amou, além da filha de Faraó, muitas mulheres estrangeiras: às de Moabe, às de Amom, às de Edom, às de Sidom, e às heteias;
verses.RVR09: EMPERO el rey Salomón amó, á más de la hija de Faraón, muchas mujeres extranjeras: á las de Moab, á las de Ammón, á las de Idumea, á las de Sidón, y á las Hetheas;

verses.KJV: Of the nations concerning which the Lord said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.WEB: of the nations concerning which the LORD said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.
verses.ASV: of the nations concerning which Jehovah said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you; for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nações das quais o SENHOR havia dito aos filhos de Israel: Não entrareis a elas, nem elas entrarão a vós; porque certamente farão inclinar vossos corações atrás seus deuses. A estas, pois, juntou-se Salomão com amor.
verses.RVR09: Gentes de las cuales Jehová había dicho á los hijos de Israel: No entraréis á ellas, ni ellas entrarán á vosotros; porque ciertamente harán inclinar vuestros corazones tras sus dioses. A éstas pues se juntó Salomón con amor.

verses.KJV: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.WEB: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.
verses.ASV: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines; and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teve setecentas esposas princesas, e trezentas concubinas; e suas mulheres desviaram o coração dele.
verses.RVR09: Y tuvo setecientas mujeres reinas, y trescientas concubinas; y sus mujeres torcieron su corazón.

verses.KJV: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father.
verses.WEB: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father was.
verses.ASV: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Jehovah his God, as was the heart of David his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, na velhice de Salomão, suas mulheres inclinaram o seu coração para seguir outros deuses; e o coração dele não era completo com o SENHOR seu Deus, como o coração do seu pai Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y ya que Salomón era viejo, sus mujeres inclinaron su corazón tras dioses ajenos; y su corazón no era perfecto con Jehová su Dios, como el corazón de su padre David.

verses.KJV: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.WEB: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.ASV: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Salomão seguiu Astarote, deusa dos sidônios, e a Milcom, abominação dos amonitas.
verses.RVR09: Porque Salomón siguió á Astaroth, diosa de los Sidonios, y á Milcom, abominación de los Ammonitas.

verses.KJV: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord, and went not fully after the Lord, as did David his father.
verses.WEB: Solomon did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and didn’t go fully after the LORD, as David his father did.
verses.ASV: And Solomon did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and went not fully after Jehovah, as did David his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Salomão o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e não seguiu completamente o SENHOR como o seu pai Davi.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Salomón lo malo en los ojos de Jehová, y no fué cumplidamente tras Jehová como David su padre.

verses.KJV: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.WEB: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.ASV: Then did Solomon build a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, in the mount that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então edificou Salomão um alto a Camos, abominação de Moabe, no monte que está à frente de Jerusalém; e a Moloque, abominação dos filhos de Amom.
verses.RVR09: Entonces edificó Salomón un alto á Chêmos, abominación de Moab, en el monte que está enfrente de Jerusalem; y á Moloch, abominación de los hijos de Ammón.

verses.KJV: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.WEB: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
verses.ASV: And so did he for all his foreign wives, who burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim fez para todas suas mulheres estrangeiras, as quais queimavam incenso, e sacrificavam aos seus deuses.
verses.RVR09: Y así hizo para todas sus mujeres extranjeras, las cuales quemaban perfumes, y sacrificaban á sus dioses.

verses.KJV: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the Lord God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
verses.WEB: The LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Jehovah, the God of Israel, who had appeared unto him twice,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR se irou contra Salomão, pois o seu coração estava desviado do SENHOR Deus de Israel, que lhe havia aparecido duas vezes,
verses.RVR09: Y enojóse Jehová contra Salomón, por cuanto estaba su corazón desviado de Jehová Dios de Israel, que le había aparecido dos veces,

verses.KJV: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the Lord commanded.
verses.WEB: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which the LORD commanded.
verses.ASV: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which Jehovah commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe havia mandado acerca disto, que não seguisse outros deuses; mas ele não guardou o que o SENHOR havia lhe mandado.
verses.RVR09: Y le había mandado acerca de esto, que no siguiese dioses ajenos: mas él no guardó lo que le mandó Jehová.

verses.KJV: Wherefore the Lord said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
verses.ASV: Wherefore Jehovah said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o SENHOR a Salomão: Como houve isso em ti, e não guardaste o meu pacto e os meus estatutos que eu te mandei, romperei o reino de ti, e o entregarei a teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová á Salomón: Por cuanto ha habido esto en ti, y no has guardado mi pacto y mis estatutos que yo te mandé, romperé el reino de ti, y lo entregaré á tu siervo.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.
verses.ASV: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it, for David thy father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não o farei em teus dias, por amor de Davi teu pai; eu o romperei da mão de teu filho.
verses.RVR09: Empero no lo haré en tus días, por amor de David tu padre: romperélo de la mano de tu hijo.

verses.KJV: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.
verses.WEB: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”
verses.ASV: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to thy son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todavia não romperei todo o reino, mas sim que darei uma tribo a teu filho, por amor de Davi meu servo, e por amor de Jerusalém que eu escolhi.
verses.RVR09: Sin embargo no romperé todo el reino, sino que daré una tribu á tu hijo, por amor de David mi siervo, y por amor de Jerusalem que yo he elegido.

verses.KJV: And the Lord stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.
verses.WEB: The LORD raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah raised up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR suscitou um adversário a Salomão, a Hadade, edomita, do sangue real, o qual estava em Edom.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová suscitó un adversario á Salomón, á Adad, Idumeo, de la sangre real, el cual estaba en Edom.

verses.KJV: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
verses.WEB: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom
verses.ASV: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, and had smitten every male in Edom
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quando Davi estava em Edom, e subiu Joabe o general do exército a enterrar os mortos, e matou a todos os homens de Edom,
verses.RVR09: Porque cuando David estaba en Edom, y subió Joab el general del ejército á enterrar los muertos, y mató á todos los varones de Edom,

verses.KJV: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
verses.WEB: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),
verses.ASV: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom);
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque seis meses habitou ali Joabe, e todo Israel, até que havia acabado a todo o sexo masculino em Edom;)
verses.RVR09: (Porque seis meses habitó allí Joab, y todo Israel, hasta que hubo acabado á todo el sexo masculino en Edom;)

verses.KJV: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
verses.WEB: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.
verses.ASV: that Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, Hadad being yet a little child.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então fugiu Hadade, e com ele alguns homens edomitas dos servos de seu pai, e foi-se ao Egito; era então Hadade jovem pequeno.
verses.RVR09: Entonces huyó Adad, y con él algunos varones Idumeos de los siervos de su padre, y fuése á Egipto; era entonces Adad muchacho pequeño.

verses.KJV: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.WEB: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.
verses.ASV: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantaram-se de Midiã, e vieram a Parã; e tomando consigo homens de Parã, vieram-se ao Egito, a Faraó rei do Egito, o qual lhe deu casa, e lhe assinalou alimentos, e ainda lhe deu terra.
verses.RVR09: Y levantáronse de Madián, y vinieron á Parán; y tomando consigo hombres de Parán, viniéronse á Egipto, á Faraón rey de Egipto, el cual le dió casa, y le señaló alimentos, y aun le dió tierra.

verses.KJV: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.WEB: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.ASV: And Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E achou Hadade grande graça diante de Faraó, o qual lhe deu por mulher à irmã de sua esposa, à irmã da rainha Tafnes.
verses.RVR09: Y halló Adad grande gracia delante de Faraón, el cual le dió por mujer á la hermana de su esposa, á la hermana de la reina Thaphnes.

verses.KJV: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.WEB: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.ASV: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a irmã de Tafnes lhe deu à luz seu filho Genubate, ao qual Tafnes desmamou dentro da casa de Faraó; e estava Genubate na casa de Faraó entre os filhos de Faraó.
verses.RVR09: Y la hermana de Thaphnes le parió á su hijo Genubath, al cual destetó Thaphnes dentro de la casa de Faraón; y estaba Genubath en casa de Faraón entre los hijos de Faraón.

verses.KJV: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
verses.WEB: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”
verses.ASV: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo Hadade em Egito que Davi havia dormido com seus pais, e que era morto Joabe general do exército, Hadade disse a Faraó: Deixa-me ir a minha terra.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo Adad en Egipto que David había dormido con sus padres, y que era muerto Joab general del ejército, Adad dijo á Faraón: Déjame ir á mi tierra.

verses.KJV: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
verses.WEB: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”
verses.ASV: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit only let me depart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhe Faraó: Por que? O que te falta comigo, que procuras ir-te a tua terra? E ele respondeu: Nada; contudo, rogo-te que me deixes ir.
verses.RVR09: Y respondióle Faraón: ¿Por qué? ¿qué te falta conmigo, que procuras irte á tu tierra? Y él respondió: Nada; con todo, ruégote que me dejes ir.

verses.KJV: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
verses.WEB: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
verses.ASV: And God raised up [another] adversary unto him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Despertou-lhe também Deus por adversário a Rezom, filho de Eliada, o qual havia fugído de seu amo Hadadezer, rei de Zobá.
verses.RVR09: Despertóle también Dios por adversario á Rezón, hijo de Eliada, el cual había huído de su amo Adad-ezer, rey de Soba.

verses.KJV: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.WEB: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.ASV: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a troop, when David slew them [of Zobah]: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia juntado gente contra ele, e havia-se feito capitão de uma companhia, quando Davi derrotou aos de Zobá. Depois se foram a Damasco, e habitaram ali e fizeram-lhe rei em Damasco.
verses.RVR09: Y había juntado gente contra él, y habíase hecho capitán de una compañía, cuando David deshizo á los de Soba. Después se fueron á Damasco, y habitaron allí, é hiciéronle rey en Damasco.

verses.KJV: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.WEB: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.ASV: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, besides the mischief that Hadad [did]: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi adversário a Israel todos os dias de Salomão; e foi outro mal com o de Hadade, porque aborreceu a Israel, e reinou sobre a Síria.
verses.RVR09: Y fué adversario á Israel todos los días de Salomón; y fué otro mal con el de Adad, porque aborreció á Israel, y reinó sobre la Siria.

verses.KJV: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.WEB: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.ASV: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, he also lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Jeroboão filho de Nebate, efrateu de Zeredá, servo de Salomão, (sua mãe se chamava Zerua, mulher viúva) levantou sua mão contra o rei.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, Ephrateo de Sereda, siervo de Salomón, (su madre se llamaba Serva, mujer viuda) alzó su mano contra el rey.

verses.KJV: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
verses.WEB: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.
verses.ASV: And this was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of the city of David his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a causa por que este levantou mão contra o rei, foi esta: Salomão edificando a Milo, fechou a abertura da cidade de Davi seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y la causa por qué éste alzó mano contra el rey, fué esta: Salomón edificando á Millo, cerró el portillo de la ciudad de David su padre.

verses.KJV: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
verses.WEB: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.
verses.ASV: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he gave him charge over all the labor of the house of Joseph.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o homem Jeroboão era valente e esforçado; e vendo Salomão ao rapaz que era homem ativo, encomendou-lhe todo o cargo da casa de José.
verses.RVR09: Y el varón Jeroboam era valiente y esforzado; y viendo Salomón al mancebo que era hombre activo, encomendóle todo el cargo de la casa de José.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
verses.WEB: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; now [Ahijah] had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aconteceu pois naquele tempo, que saindo Jeroboão de Jerusalém, encontrou-lhe no caminho o profeta Aías silonita; e ele estava coberto com uma capa nova; e estavam eles dois sós no campo.
verses.RVR09: Aconteció pues en aquel tiempo, que saliendo Jeroboam de Jerusalem, topóle en el camino el profeta Ahías Silonita; y él estaba cubierto con una capa nueva; y estaban ellos dos solos en el campo.

verses.KJV: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
verses.WEB: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.
verses.ASV: And Ahijah laid hold of the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces.
verses.ALMEIDA: E segurando Aías da capa nova que tinha sobre si, rompeu-a em doze pedaços,
verses.RVR09: Y trabando Ahías de la capa nueva que tenía sobre sí, rompióla en doce pedazos,

verses.KJV: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
verses.WEB: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
verses.ASV: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces; for thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a Jeroboão: Toma para ti os dez pedaços; porque assim disse o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Eis que que eu rompo o reino da mão de Salomão, e a ti darei dez tribos;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á Jeroboam: Toma para ti los diez pedazos; porque así dijo Jehová Dios de Israel: He aquí que yo rompo el reino de la mano de Salomón, y á ti daré diez tribus;

verses.KJV: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
verses.WEB: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),
verses.ASV: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel);
verses.ALMEIDA: (E ele terá uma tribo, por amor de Davi meu servo, e por amor de Jerusalém, cidade que eu escolhi de todas as tribos de Israel:)
verses.RVR09: (Y él tendrá una tribu, por amor de David mi siervo, y por amor de Jerusalem, ciudad que yo he elegido de todas las tribus de Israel:)

verses.KJV: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.
verses.WEB: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.
verses.ASV: because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon; and they have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and [to keep] my statutes and mine ordinances, as did David his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porquanto me deixaram, e adoraram a Astarote deusa dos sidônios, e a Camos deus de Moabe, e a Moloque deus dos filhos de Amom; e não andaram em meus caminhos, para fazer o reto diante de meus olhos, e meus estatutos, e meus direitos, como fez seu pai Davi.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto me han dejado, y han adorado á Astharoth diosa de los Sidonios, y á Chêmos dios de Moab, y á Moloch dios de los hijos de Ammón; y no han andado en mis caminos, para hacer lo recto delante de mis ojos, y mis estatutos, y mis derechos, como hizo David su padre.

verses.KJV: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
verses.WEB: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,
verses.ASV: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand; but I will make him prince all the days of his life, for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não tirarei nada de seu reino de suas mãos, mas sim que o manterei por chefe todos os dias de sua vida, por amor de Davi meu servo, ao qual eu escolhi, e ele guardou meus mandamentos e meus estatutos:
verses.RVR09: Empero no quitaré nada de su reino de sus manos, sino que lo retendré por caudillo todos los días de su vida, por amor de David mi siervo, al cual yo elegí, y él guardó mis mandamientos y mis estatutos:

verses.KJV: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.
verses.WEB: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.
verses.ASV: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu tirarei o reino da mão de seu filho, e o darei a ti, as dez tribos.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo quitaré el reino de la mano de su hijo, y darélo á ti, las diez tribus.

verses.KJV: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
verses.WEB: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.
verses.ASV: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a lamp alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a seu filho darei uma tribo, para que meu servo Davi tenha lâmpada todos os dias diante de mim em Jerusalém, cidade que eu me escolhi para pôr nela meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Y á su hijo daré una tribu, para que mi siervo David tenga lámpara todos los días delante de mí en Jerusalem, ciudad que yo me elegí para poner en ella mi nombre.

verses.KJV: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
verses.WEB: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.
verses.ASV: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu pois te tomarei a ti, e tu reinarás em todas as coisas que desejar tua alma, e serás rei sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: Yo pues te tomaré á ti, y tú reinarás en todas las cosas que deseare tu alma, y serás rey sobre Israel.

verses.KJV: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
verses.WEB: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.
verses.ASV: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that which is right in mine eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and will build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, se prestares ouvido a todas as coisas que te mandar, e andares em meus caminhos, e fizeres o reto diante de meus olhos, guardando meus estatutos e meus mandamentos, como fez Davi meu servo, eu serei contigo, e te edificarei casa firme, como a edifiquei a Davi, e eu te entregarei a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y será que, si prestares oído á todas las cosas que te mandare, y anduvieres en mis caminos, é hicieres lo recto delante de mis ojos, guardando mis estatutos y mis mandamientos, como hizo David mi siervo, yo seré contigo, y te edificaré casa firme, como la edifiqué á David, y yo te entregaré á Israel.

verses.KJV: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.WEB: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”
verses.ASV: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu afligirei a semente de Davi por causa disto, mas não para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y yo afligiré la simiente de David á causa de esto, mas no para siempre.

verses.KJV: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.WEB: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.ASV: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam; but Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Procurou, portanto, Salomão de matar a Jeroboão, mas levantando-se Jeroboão, fugiu ao Egito, a Sisaque rei do Egito, e esteve em Egito até a morte de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Procuró por tanto Salomón de matar á Jeroboam, pero levantándose Jeroboam, huyó á Egipto, á Sisac rey de Egipto, y estuvo en Egipto hasta la muerte de Salomón.

verses.KJV: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Salomão, e todas as coisas que fez, e sua sabedoria, não estão escritas no livro dos feitos de Salomão?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Salomón, y todas las cosas que hizo, y su sabiduría, ¿no están escritas en el libro de los hechos de Salomón?

verses.KJV: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.WEB: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.ASV: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os dias que Salomão reinou em Jerusalém sobre todo Israel foram quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Y los días que Salomón reinó en Jerusalem sobre todo Israel, fueron cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descansou Salomão com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de seu pai Davi: e reinou em seu lugar Roboão seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió Salomón con sus padres, y fué sepultado en la ciudad de su padre David: y reinó en su lugar Roboam su hijo.

verses.KJV: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.WEB: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.ASV: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi Roboão a Siquém; porque todo Israel havia vindo a Siquém para fazê-lo rei.
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ Roboam á Sichêm; porque todo Israel había venido á Sichêm para hacerlo rey.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
verses.WEB: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, que quando o ouviu Jeroboão filho de Nebate, que estava em Egito, porque havia fugido de diante do rei Salomão, e habitava em Egito;
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que como lo oyó Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, que estaba en Egipto, porque había huído de delante del rey Salomón, y habitaba en Egipto;

verses.KJV: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
verses.WEB: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.ASV: and they sent and called him), that Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviaram e chamaram-lhe. Veio pois Jeroboão e toda a congregação de Israel, e falaram a Roboão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Enviaron y llamáronle. Vino pues Jeroboam y toda la congregación de Israel, y hablaron á Roboam, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
verses.WEB: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”
verses.ASV: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu pai agravou nosso jugo, mas agora tu diminui algo da dura servidão de teu pai, e do jugo pesado que ele pôs sobre nós, e te serviremos.
verses.RVR09: Tu padre agravó nuestro yugo, mas ahora tú disminuye algo de la dura servidumbre de tu padre, y del yugo pesado que puso sobre nosotros, y te serviremos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Ide, e daqui a três dias voltai a mim. E o povo se foi.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Idos, y de aquí á tres días volved á mí. Y el pueblo se fué.

verses.KJV: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
verses.WEB: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”
verses.ASV: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei Roboão tomou conselho com os anciãos que haviam estado diante de Salomão seu pai quando vivia, e disse: Como aconselhais vós que responda a este povo?
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey Roboam tomó consejo con los ancianos que habían estado delante de Salomón su padre cuando vivía, y dijo: ¿Cómo aconsejáis vosotros que responda á este pueblo?

verses.KJV: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.WEB: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”
verses.ASV: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe falaram, dizendo: Se tu fores hoje servo deste povo, e o servires, e respondendo-lhe boas palavras lhes falares, eles te servirão para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le hablaron, diciendo: Si tú fueres hoy siervo de este pueblo, y lo sirvieres, y respondiéndole buenas palabras les hablares, ellos te servirán para siempre.

verses.KJV: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
verses.WEB: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
verses.ASV: But he forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men that were grown up with him, that stood before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele, deixado o conselho dos anciãos que eles lhe haviam dado, tomou conselho com os rapazes que se haviam criado com ele, e estavam diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Mas él, dejado el consejo de los viejos que ellos le habían dado, tomó consejo con los mancebos que se habían criado con él, y estaban delante de él.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye, that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke that thy father did put upon us lighter?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Como aconselhais vós que respondamos a este povo, que me falou, dizendo: Diminui algo do jugo que teu pai pôs sobre nós?
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: ¿Cómo aconsejáis vosotros que respondamos á este pueblo, que me ha hablado, diciendo: Disminuye algo del yugo que tu padre puso sobre nosotros?

verses.KJV: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
verses.WEB: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
verses.ASV: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou say unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou speak unto them, My little finger is thicker than my father’s loins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os rapazes que se haviam criado com ele lhe responderam, dizendo: Assim falarás a este povo que te disse estas palavras: Teu pai agravou nosso jugo; mas tu diminui-nos algo: assim lhes falarás: O menor dedo dos meus é mais espesso que os lombos de meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los mancebos que se habían criado con él, le respondieron, diciendo: Así hablarás á este pueblo que te ha dicho estas palabras: Tu padre agravó nuestro yugo; mas tú disminúyenos algo: así les hablarás: El menor dedo de los míos es más grueso que los lomos de mi padre.
