verses.KJV: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.WEB: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”
verses.ASV: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, meu pai vos impôs carga de pesado jugo, mas eu acrescentarei a vosso jugo; meu pai vos feriu com açoites, mas eu vos ferirei com escorpiões.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, mi padre os cargó de pesado yugo, mas yo añadiré á vuestro yugo; mi padre os hirió con azotes, mas yo os heriré con escorpiones.

verses.KJV: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
verses.WEB: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
verses.ASV: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come to me again the third day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao terceiro dia veio Jeroboão com todo o povo a Roboão; segundo o rei o havia mandado, dizendo: Voltai a mim ao terceiro dia.
verses.RVR09: Y al tercer día vino Jeroboam con todo el pueblo á Roboam; según el rey lo había mandado, diciendo: Volved á mí al tercer día.

verses.KJV: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;
verses.WEB: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,
verses.ASV: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei respondeu ao povo duramente, deixado o conselho dos anciãos que eles lhe haviam dado;
verses.RVR09: Y el rey respondió al pueblo duramente, dejado el consejo de los ancianos que ellos le habían dado;

verses.KJV: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.WEB: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”
verses.ASV: and spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou-lhes conforme ao conselho dos rapazes, dizendo: Meu pai agravou vosso jugo, mas eu acrescentarei a vosso jugo; meu pai vos feriu com açoites, mas eu vos ferirei com escorpiões.
verses.RVR09: Y hablóles conforme al consejo de los mancebos, diciendo: Mi padre agravó vuestro yugo, pero yo añadiré á vuestro yugo; mi padre os hirió con azotes, mas yo os heriré con escorpiones.

verses.KJV: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the Lord, that he might perform his saying, which the Lord spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.WEB: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD, that he might establish his word, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.ASV: So the king hearkened not unto the people; for it was a thing brought about of Jehovah, that he might establish his word, which Jehovah spake by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não ouviu o rei ao povo; porque era ordenação do SENHOR, para confirmar sua palavra, que o SENHOR havia falado por meio de Aías silonita a Jeroboão filho de Nebate.
verses.RVR09: Y no oyó el rey al pueblo; porque era ordenación de Jehová, para confirmar su palabra, que Jehová había hablado por medio de Ahías Silonita á Jeroboam hijo de Nabat.

verses.KJV: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
verses.WEB: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.
verses.ASV: And when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando todo o povo viu que o rei não lhes havia ouvido, respondeu-lhe estas palavras, dizendo: Que parte temos nós com Davi? Não temos propriedade no filho de Jessé. Israel, a tuas moradas! Provê agora em tua casa, Davi! Então Israel se foi a suas moradas.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando todo el pueblo vió que el rey no les había oído, respondióle estas palabras, diciendo: ¿Qué parte tenemos nosotros con David? No tenemos heredad en el hijo de Isaí. ¡Israel, á tus estancias! ¡Provee ahora en tu casa, David! Entonces Israel se fué á sus estancias.

verses.KJV: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.WEB: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.ASV: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas reinou Roboão sobre os filhos de Israel que moravam nas cidades de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Mas reinó Roboam sobre los hijos de Israel que moraban en las ciudades de Judá.

verses.KJV: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to taskwork; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. And king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Roboão enviou a Adorão, que estava sobre os tributos; mas apedrejou-lhe todo Israel, e morreu. Então o rei Roboão se esforçou a subir em um carro, e fugir a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey Roboam envió á Adoram, que estaba sobre los tributos; pero apedreóle todo Israel, y murió. Entonces el rey Roboam se esforzó á subir en un carro, y huir á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.WEB: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
verses.ASV: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se separou Israel da casa de Davi até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Así se apartó Israel de la casa de David hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.WEB: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was returned, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, ouvindo todo Israel que Jeroboão havia voltado, enviaram e chamaram-lhe à congregação, e fizeram-lhe rei sobre todo Israel, sem restar tribo alguma que seguisse a casa de Davi, a não ser somente a tribo de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, que oyendo todo Israel que Jeroboam había vuelto, enviaron y llamáronle á la congregación, é hiciéronle rey sobre todo Israel, sin quedar tribu alguna que siguiese la casa de David, sino sólo la tribu de Judá.

verses.KJV: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.WEB: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.ASV: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, that were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Roboão veio a Jerusalém, juntou toda a casa de Judá e a tribo de Benjamim, cento e oitenta mil homens escolhidos de guerra, para fazer guerra à casa de Israel, e restituir o reino a Roboão filho de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y como Roboam vino á Jerusalem, juntó toda la casa de Judá y la tribu de Benjamín, ciento y ochenta mil hombres escogidos de guerra, para hacer guerra á la casa de Israel, y reducir el reino á Roboam hijo de Salomón.

verses.KJV: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.WEB: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.ASV: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas foi palavra do SENHOR a Semaías homem de Deus, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Mas fué palabra de Jehová á Semeías varón de Dios, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.WEB: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
verses.ASV: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a Roboão filho de Salomão, rei de Judá, e a toda a casa de Judá e de Benjamim, e aos demais do povo, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Habla á Roboam hijo de Salomón, rey de Judá, y á toda la casa de Judá y de Benjamín, y á los demás del pueblo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the Lord, and returned to depart, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.WEB: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s word, and returned and went their way, according to the LORD’s word.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is of me. So they hearkened unto the word of Jehovah, and returned and went their way, according to the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim disse o SENHOR: Não vades, nem luteis contra vossos irmãos os filhos de Israel; voltai-vos cada um à sua casa; porque este negócio eu o fiz. E eles ouviram a palavra de Deus, e voltaram, e foram-se, conforme à palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: No vayáis, ni peleéis contra vuestros hermanos los hijos de Israel; volveos cada uno á su casa; porque este negocio yo lo he hecho. Y ellos oyeron la palabra de Dios, y volviéronse, y fuéronse, conforme á la palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
verses.WEB: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.
verses.ASV: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and he went out from thence, and built Penuel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reedificou Jeroboão a Siquém no monte de Efraim, e habitou nela; e saindo dali, reedificou a Peniel.
verses.RVR09: Y reedificó Jeroboam á Sichêm en el monte de Ephraim, y habitó en ella; y saliendo de allí, reedificó á Penuel.

verses.KJV: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
verses.WEB: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.
verses.ASV: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now will the kingdom return to the house of David:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jeroboão em seu coração: Agora se voltará o reino à casa de Davi,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jeroboam en su corazón: Ahora se volverá el reino á la casa de David,

verses.KJV: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.
verses.WEB: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”
verses.ASV: if this people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of Jehovah at Jerusalem, then will the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se este povo subir a sacrificar à casa do SENHOR em Jerusalém: porque o coração deste povo se converterá a seu senhor Roboão rei de Judá, e me matarão a mim, e se tornarão a Roboão rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Si este pueblo subiere á sacrificar á la casa de Jehová en Jerusalem: porque el corazón de este pueblo se convertirá á su señor Roboam rey de Judá, y me matarán á mí, y se tornarán á Roboam rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”
verses.ASV: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havido conselho, fez o rei dois bezerros de ouro, e disse ao povo: Demais subistes a Jerusalém: eis que teus deuses, ó Israel, que te fizeram subir da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y habido consejo, hizo el rey dos becerros de oro, y dijo al pueblo: Harto habéis subido á Jerusalem: he aquí tus dioses, oh Israel, que te hicieron subir de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.
verses.WEB: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
verses.ASV: And he set the one in Beth-el, and the other put he in Dan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs o um em Betel, e o outro pôs em Dã.
verses.RVR09: Y puso el uno en Beth-el, y el otro puso en Dan.

verses.KJV: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
verses.WEB: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.
verses.ASV: And this thing became a sin; for the people went [to worship] before the one, even unto Dan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto foi ocasião de pecado; porque o povo ia a adorar diante do um, até Dã.
verses.RVR09: Y esto fué ocasión de pecado; porque el pueblo iba á adorar delante del uno, hasta Dan.

verses.KJV: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.WEB: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.ASV: And he made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, that were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também casa de altos, e fez sacerdotes da classe do povo, que não eram dos filhos de Levi.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también casa de altos, é hizo sacerdotes de la clase del pueblo, que no eran de los hijos de Leví.

verses.KJV: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.
verses.WEB: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.
verses.ASV: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he went up unto the altar; so did he in Beth-el, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places that he had made.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então instituiu Jeroboão solenidade no mês oitavo, aos quinze do mês, conforme à solenidade que se celebrava em Judá; e sacrificou sobre altar. Assim fez em Betel, sacrificando aos bezerros que havia feito. Ordenou também em Betel sacerdote
verses.RVR09: Entonces instituyó Jeroboam solemnidad en el mes octavo, á los quince del mes, conforme á la solemnidad que se celebraba en Judá; y sacrificó sobre altar. Así hizo en Beth-el, sacrificando á los becerros que había hecho. Ordenó también en Beth-el sacerdotes de los altos que él había fabricado.

verses.KJV: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
verses.WEB: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.
verses.ASV: And he went up unto the altar which he had made in Beth-el on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart: and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up unto the altar, to burn incense.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sacrificou pois sobre o altar que ele havia feito em Betel, aos quinze do mês oitavo, o mês que ele havia inventado de seu coração; e fez festa aos filhos de Israel, e subiu ao altar para queimar incenso.
verses.RVR09: Sacrificó pues sobre el altar que él había hecho en Beth-el, á los quince del mes octavo, el mes que él había inventado de su corazón; é hizo fiesta á los hijos de Israel, y subió al altar para quemar perfumes.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the Lord unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
verses.WEB: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.
verses.ASV: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of Jehovah unto Beth-el: and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que um homem de Deus por palavra do SENHOR veio de Judá a Betel; e estando Jeroboão ao altar para queimar incenso,
verses.RVR09: Y HE aquí que un varón de Dios por palabra de Jehová vino de Judá á Beth-el; y estando Jeroboam al altar para quemar perfumes,

verses.KJV: And he cried against the altar in the word of the Lord, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the Lord; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.
verses.WEB: He cried against the altar by the LORD’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! The LORD says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”
verses.ASV: And he cried against the altar by the word of Jehovah, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith Jehovah: Behold, a son shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he sacrifice the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall they burn upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele clamou contra o altar por palavra do SENHOR, e disse: Altar, altar, assim disse o SENHOR: Eis que à casa de Davi nascerá um filho, chamado Josias, o qual sacrificará sobre ti aos sacerdotes dos altos que queimam sobre ti incenso; e sobre ti queimarão ossos humanos.
verses.RVR09: El clamó contra el altar por palabra de Jehová, y dijo: Altar, altar, así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que á la casa de David nacerá un hijo, llamado Josías, el cual sacrificará sobre ti á los sacerdotes de los altos que queman sobre ti perfumes; y sobre ti quemarán huesos de hombres.

verses.KJV: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the Lord hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
verses.WEB: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which the LORD has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”
verses.ASV: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which Jehovah hath spoken: Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquele mesmo dia deu um sinal, dizendo: Esta é o sinal de que o SENHOR falou: eis que que o altar se quebrará, e a cinza que sobre ele está se derramará.
verses.RVR09: Y aquel mismo día dió una señal, diciendo: Esta es la señal de que Jehová ha hablado: he aquí que el altar se quebrará, y la ceniza que sobre él está se derramará.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
verses.WEB: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Beth-el, that Jeroboam put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o rei Jeroboão ouviu a palavra do homem de Deus, que havia clamado contra o altar de Betel, estendendo sua mão desde o altar, disse: Prendei-lhe! Mas a mão que havia estendido contra ele, se lhe secou, que não a pôde voltar a si.
verses.RVR09: Y como el rey Jeroboam oyó la palabra del varón de Dios, que había clamado contra el altar de Beth-el, extendiendo su mano desde el altar, dijo: ¡Prendedle! Mas la mano que había extendido contra él, se le secó, que no la pudo tornar á sí.

verses.KJV: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the LORD’s word.
verses.ASV: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o altar se rompeu, e derramou-se a cinza do altar, conforme o sinal que o homem de Deus havia dado por palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el altar se rompió, y derramóse la ceniza del altar, conforme á la señal que el varón de Dios había dado por palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the Lord thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the Lord, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
verses.WEB: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of the LORD your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me.” The man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and became as it was before.
verses.ASV: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Entreat now the favor of Jehovah thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God entreated Jehovah, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então respondendo o rei, disse ao homem de Deus: Peço-te que rogues à face do SENHOR teu Deus, e ora por mim, que minha mão me seja restituída. E o homem de Deus orou à face do SENHOR, e a mão do rei se lhe recuperou e tornou-se como antes.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondiendo el rey, dijo al varón de Dios: Te pido que ruegues á la faz de Jehová tu Dios, y ora por mí, que mi mano me sea restituída. Y el varón de Dios oró á la faz de Jehová, y la mano del rey se le recuperó, y tornóse como antes.

verses.KJV: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
verses.WEB: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”
verses.ASV: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei disse ao homem de Deus: Vem comigo à casa, e comerás, e eu te darei um presente.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey dijo al varón de Dios: Ven conmigo á casa, y comerás, y yo te daré un presente.

verses.KJV: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
verses.WEB: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;
verses.ASV: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thy house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o homem de Deus disse ao rei: Se me desses a metade de tua casa, não iria contigo, nem comeria pão nem beberia água neste lugar;
verses.RVR09: Mas el varón de Dios dijo al rey: Si me dieses la mitad de tu casa, no iría contigo, ni comería pan ni bebería agua en este lugar;

verses.KJV: For so was it charged me by the word of the Lord, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
verses.WEB: for so was it commanded me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”
verses.ASV: for so was it charged me by the word of Jehovah, saying, Thou shalt eat no bread, nor drink water, neither return by the way that thou camest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim me está mandado por palavra do SENHOR, dizendo: Não comas pão, nem bebas água, nem voltes pelo caminho que fordes.
verses.RVR09: Porque así me está mandado por palabra de Jehová, diciendo: No comas pan, ni bebas agua, ni vuelvas por el camino que fueres.

verses.KJV: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
verses.WEB: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.
verses.ASV: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi-se, pois, por outro caminho, e não voltou pelo caminho por de onde havia vindo a Betel.
verses.RVR09: Fuése pues por otro camino, y no volvió por el camino por donde había venido á Beth-el.

verses.KJV: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
verses.WEB: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.
verses.ASV: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth-el; and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth-el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them also they told unto their father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Morava naquele tempo em Betel um velho profeta, ao qual veio seu filho, e contou-lhe tudo o que o homem de Deus havia feito aquele dia em Betel: contaram-lhe também a seu pai as palavras que havia falado ao rei.
verses.RVR09: Moraba á la sazón en Beth-el un viejo profeta, al cual vino su hijo, y contóle todo lo que el varón de Dios había hecho aquel día en Beth-el: contáronle también á su padre las palabras que había hablado al rey.

verses.KJV: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
verses.WEB: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.
verses.ASV: And their father said unto them, What way went he? Now his sons had seen what way the man of God went, that came from Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu pai lhes disse: Por que caminho foi? E seus filhos lhe mostraram o caminho por de onde se havia voltado o homem de Deus, que havia vindo de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y su padre les dijo: ¿Por qué camino fué? Y sus hijos le mostraron el camino por donde se había tornado el varón de Dios, que había venido de Judá.

verses.KJV: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
verses.WEB: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.
verses.ASV: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass; and he rode thereon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse a seus filhos: Preparai-me o asno. E eles lhe prepararam o asno, e subiu nele.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo á sus hijos: Enalbardadme el asno. Y ellos le enalbardaron el asno, y subió en él.

verses.KJV: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
verses.WEB: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”
verses.ASV: And he went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak; and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo atrás o homem de Deus, achou-lhe que estava sentado debaixo de um carvalho: e disse-lhe: És tu o homem de Deus que vieste de Judá? E ele disse: Eu sou.
verses.RVR09: Y yendo tras el varón de Dios, hallóle que estaba sentado debajo de un alcornoque: y díjole: ¿Eres tú el varón de Dios que viniste de Judá? Y él dijo: Yo soy.

verses.KJV: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.WEB: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”
verses.ASV: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-lhe então: Vem comigo à casa, e come do pão.
verses.RVR09: Díjole entonces: Ven conmigo á casa, y come del pan.

verses.KJV: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
verses.WEB: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
verses.ASV: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee; neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele respondeu: Não poderei voltar contigo, nem irei contigo; nem tampouco comerei pão nem beberei água contigo neste lugar;
verses.RVR09: Mas él respondió: No podré volver contigo, ni iré contigo; ni tampoco comeré pan ni beberé agua contigo en este lugar;

verses.KJV: For it was said to me by the word of the Lord, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
verses.WEB: For it was said to me by the LORD’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”
verses.ASV: for it was said to me by the word of Jehovah, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque por palavra de Deus me foi dito: Não comas pão nem bebas água ali, nem voltes pelo caminho que fores.
verses.RVR09: Porque por palabra de Dios me ha sido dicho: No comas pan ni bebas agua allí, ni vuelvas por el camino que fueres.

verses.KJV: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the Lord, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, I also am a prophet as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of Jehovah, saying, Bring him back with thee into thy house, that he may eat bread and drink water. [But] he lied unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o outro lhe disse: Eu também sou profeta como tu, e um anjo me falou pela palavra do SENHOR, dizendo: Faze-o voltar contigo à tua casa, para que coma pão e beba água. Porém mentiu-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Y el otro le dijo: Yo también soy profeta como tú, y un ángel me ha hablado por palabra de Jehová, diciendo: Vuélvele contigo á tu casa, para que coma pan y beba agua. Empero mintióle.

verses.KJV: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.WEB: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.ASV: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então voltou com ele, e comeu do pão em sua casa, e bebeu da água.
verses.RVR09: Entonces volvió con él, y comió del pan en su casa, y bebió del agua.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the Lord came unto the prophet that brought him back:
verses.WEB: As they sat at the table, the LORD’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of Jehovah came unto the prophet that brought him back;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, estando eles à mesa, veio a palavra do SENHOR ao profeta que lhe havia feito voltar;
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que, estando ellos á la mesa, fué palabra de Jehová al profeta que le había hecho volver;

verses.KJV: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the Lord, and hast not kept the commandment which the Lord thy God commanded thee,
verses.WEB: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to the LORD’s word, and have not kept the commandment which the LORD your God commanded you,
verses.ASV: and he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith Jehovah, Forasmuch as thou hast been disobedient unto the mouth of Jehovah, and hast not kept the commandment which Jehovah thy God commanded thee,
verses.ALMEIDA: E clamou ao homem de Deus que havia vindo de Judá, dizendo: Assim disse o SENHOR: Porquanto foste rebelde ao dito do SENHOR, e não guardaste o mandamento que o SENHOR teu Deus te havia prescrito,
verses.RVR09: Y clamó al varón de Dios que había venido de Judá, diciendo: Así dijo Jehová: Por cuanto has sido rebelde al dicho de Jehová, y no guardaste el mandamiento que Jehová tu Dios te había prescrito,

verses.KJV: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
verses.WEB: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”
verses.ASV: but camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place of which he said to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy body shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso voltaste, e comeste do pão e bebeste da água no lugar de onde o SENHOR te havia dito não comesses pão nem bebesses água, não entrará teu corpo no sepulcro de teus pais.
verses.RVR09: Sino que volviste, y comiste del pan y bebiste del agua en el lugar donde Jehová te había dicho no comieses pan ni bebieses agua, no entrará tu cuerpo en el sepulcro de tus padres.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.WEB: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, [to wit], for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando havia comido do pão e bebido, o profeta que lhe havia feito voltar lhe preparou um asno;
verses.RVR09: Y como hubo comido del pan y bebido, el profeta que le había hecho volver le enalbardó un asno;

verses.KJV: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
verses.WEB: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.
verses.ASV: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his body was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it; the lion also stood by the body.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo-se, encontrou-lhe um leão no caminho, e matou-lhe; e seu corpo estava lançado no caminho, e o asno estava junto a ele, e o leão também estava junto ao corpo.
verses.RVR09: Y yéndose, topóle un león en el camino, y matóle; y su cuerpo estaba echado en el camino, y el asno estaba junto á él, y el león también estaba junto al cuerpo.

verses.KJV: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.WEB: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.
verses.ASV: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the body cast in the way, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que uns que passavam, e viram o corpo que estava lançado no caminho, e o leão que estava junto ao corpo: e vieram, e disseram-no na cidade de onde o velho profeta habitava.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí unos que pasaban, y vieron el cuerpo que estaba echado en el camino, y el león que estaba junto al cuerpo: y vinieron, y dijéronlo en la ciudad donde el viejo profeta habitaba.

verses.KJV: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the Lord: therefore the Lord hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake unto him.
verses.WEB: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to the LORD’s word. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to him.”
verses.ASV: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the mouth of Jehovah: therefore Jehovah hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo-o o profeta que lhe havia voltado do caminho, disse: O homem de Deus é, que foi rebelde ao dito do SENHOR: portanto o SENHOR lhe entregou ao leão, que lhe quebrantou e matou, conforme à palavra do SENHOR que ele lhe disse.
verses.RVR09: Y oyéndolo el profeta que le había vuelto del camino, dijo: El varón de Dios es, que fué rebelde al dicho de Jehová: por tanto Jehová le ha entregado al león, que le ha quebrantado y muerto, conforme á la palabra de Jehová que él le dijo.

verses.KJV: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
verses.WEB: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.
verses.ASV: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou a seus filhos, e disse-lhes: Preparai-me um asno. E eles se o prepararam.
verses.RVR09: Y habló á sus hijos, y díjoles: Enalbardadme un asno. Y ellos se lo enalbardaron.

verses.KJV: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
verses.WEB: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.
verses.ASV: And he went and found his body cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the body: the lion had not eaten the body, nor torn the ass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele foi, e achou seu corpo estendido no caminho, e o asno e o leão estavam junto ao corpo: o leão não havia comido o corpo, nem danificado ao asno.
verses.RVR09: Y él fué, y halló su cuerpo tendido en el camino, y el asno y el león estaban junto al cuerpo: el león no había comido el cuerpo, ni dañado al asno.

verses.KJV: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
verses.WEB: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.
verses.ASV: And the prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back; and he came to the city of the old prophet, to mourn, and to bury him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando o profeta o corpo do homem de Deus, o pôs sobre o asno, e o levou. E o profeta velho veio à cidade, para lamentar-lhe e enterrar-lhe.
verses.RVR09: Y tomando el profeta el cuerpo del varón de Dios, púsolo sobre el asno, y llevóselo. Y el profeta viejo vino á la ciudad, para endecharle y enterrarle.

verses.KJV: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
verses.WEB: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”
verses.ASV: And he laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, [saying], Alas, my brother!
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs seu corpo em seu sepulcro; e lamentaram-lhe, dizendo: Ai, irmão meu!
verses.RVR09: Y puso su cuerpo en su sepulcro; y endecháronle, diciendo: ¡Ay, hermano mío!

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
verses.WEB: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois que lhe houveram enterrado, falou a seus filhos, dizendo: Quando eu morrer, enterrai-me no sepulcro em que está sepultado o homem de Deus; ponde meus ossos junto aos seus.
verses.RVR09: Y después que le hubieron enterrado, habló á sus hijos, diciendo: Cuando yo muriere, enterradme en el sepulcro en que está sepultado el varón de Dios; poned mis huesos junto á los suyos.

verses.KJV: For the saying which he cried by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.WEB: For the saying which he cried by the LORD’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”
verses.ASV: For the saying which he cried by the word of Jehovah against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sem dúvida virá o que ele disse a vozes por palavra do SENHOR contra o altar que está em Betel, e contra todas as casas dos altos que estão nas cidades de Samaria.
verses.RVR09: Porque sin duda vendrá lo que él dijo á voces por palabra de Jehová contra el altar que está en Beth-el, y contra todas las casas de los altos que están en las ciudades de Samaria.

verses.KJV: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.WEB: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
verses.ASV: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again from among all the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto não se converteu Jeroboão de seu mau caminho: antes voltou a fazer sacerdotes dos altos da classe do povo, e quem queria se consagrava, e era dos sacerdotes dos altos.
verses.RVR09: Después de esto no se tornó Jeroboam de su mal camino: antes volvió á hacer sacerdotes de los altos de la clase del pueblo, y quien quería se consagraba, y era de los sacerdotes de los altos.

verses.KJV: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
verses.ASV: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto foi causa de pecado à casa de Jeroboão; pelo qual foi cortada e desraigada de sobre a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y esto fué causa de pecado á la casa de Jeroboam; por lo cual fué cortada y raída de sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
verses.WEB: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.
verses.ASV: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo Abias filho de Jeroboão caiu enfermo,
verses.RVR09: EN aquel tiempo Abías hijo de Jeroboam cayó enfermo.

verses.KJV: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
verses.WEB: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.
verses.ASV: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, who spake concerning me that I should be king over this people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Jeroboão à sua mulher: Levanta-te agora, disfarça-te, porque não te conheçam que és a mulher de Jeroboão, e vai a Siló; que ali está Aías profeta, o que me disse que eu havia de ser rei sobre este povo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jeroboam á su mujer: Levántate ahora, disfrázate, porque no te conozcan que eres la mujer de Jeroboam, y ve á Silo; que allá está Ahías profeta, el que me dijo que yo había de ser rey sobre este pueblo.

verses.KJV: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.
verses.WEB: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”
verses.ASV: And take with thee ten loaves, and cakes, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he will tell thee what shall become of the child.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toma em tua mão dez pães, e bolos, e uma botija de mel, e vai a ele; que te declare o que será deste jovem.
verses.RVR09: Y toma en tu mano diez panes, y turrones, y una botija de miel, y ve á él; que te declare lo que ha de ser de este mozo.

verses.KJV: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
verses.WEB: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
verses.ASV: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mulher de Jeroboão o fez assim; e levantou-se, e foi a Siló, e veio à casa de Aías. E não podia já ver Aías, que seus olhos se haviam escurecido à causa de sua velhice.
verses.RVR09: Y la mujer de Jeroboam hízolo así; y levantóse, y fué á Silo, y vino á casa de Ahías. Y no podía ya ver Ahías, que sus ojos se habían oscurecido á causa de su vejez.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to inquire of thee concerning her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her; for it will be, when she cometh in, that she will feign herself to be another woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR havia dito a Aías: Eis que a mulher de Jeroboão virá a consultar-te por seu filho, que está enfermo: assim e assim lhe responderás; pois será que quando ela vier, virá dissimulada.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová había dicho á Ahías: He aquí que la mujer de Jeroboam vendrá á consultarte por su hijo, que está enfermo: así y así le has de responder; pues será que cuando ella viniere, vendrá disimulada.

verses.KJV: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
verses.WEB: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.
verses.ASV: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Aías ouviu o som de seus pés quando entrava pela porta, disse: Entra, mulher de Jeroboão; por que te finges outra? Porém eu sou enviado a ti com revelação dura.
verses.RVR09: Y como Ahías oyó el sonido de sus pies cuando entraba por la puerta, dijo: Entra, mujer de Jeroboam; ¿por qué te finges otra? empero yo soy enviado á ti con revelación dura.

verses.KJV: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
verses.WEB: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,
verses.ASV: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, e dize a Jeroboão: Assim disse o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Porquanto eu te levantei de em meio do povo, e te fiz príncipe sobre meu povo Israel,
verses.RVR09: Ve, y di á Jeroboam: Así dijo Jehová Dios de Israel: Por cuanto yo te levanté de en medio del pueblo, y te hice príncipe sobre mi pueblo Israel,

verses.KJV: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;
verses.WEB: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,
verses.ASV: and rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee; and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes,
verses.ALMEIDA: E rompi o reino da casa de Davi, e o entreguei a ti; e tu não foste como Davi meu servo, que guardou meus mandamentos e andou após o mim com todo seu coração, fazendo somente o direito diante de meus olhos;
verses.RVR09: Y rompí el reino de la casa de David, y te lo entregué á ti; y tú no has sido como David mi siervo, que guardó mis mandamientos y anduvo en pos de mí con todo su corazón, haciendo solamente lo derecho delante de mis ojos;

verses.KJV: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
verses.WEB: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,
verses.ASV: but hast done evil above all that were before thee, and hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes fizeste o mau sobre todos os que foram antes de ti: que foste e te fizeste deuses alheios e de fundição para irar-me, e a mim me lançaste atrás tuas costas:
verses.RVR09: Antes hiciste lo malo sobre todos los que han sido antes de ti: que fuiste y te hiciste dioses ajenos y de fundición para enojarme, y á mí me echaste tras tus espaldas:

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
verses.WEB: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.
verses.ASV: therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam every man-child, him that is shut up and him that is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweepeth away dung, till it be all gone.

verses.KJV: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

verses.ASV: And all Israel buried him, and mourned for him, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enterraram-no, e lamentaram-no todo Israel, conforme à palavra do SENHOR, que ele havia falado por mão de seu servo Aías profeta.
verses.RVR09: Y enterráronlo, y endechólo todo Israel, conforme á la palabra de Jehová, que él había hablado por mano de su siervo Ahías profeta.

verses.RVR09: Los otros hechos de Jeroboam, qué guerras hizo, y cómo reinó, todo está escrito en el libro de las historias de los reyes de Israel.

verses.WEB: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.
verses.ASV: And also Maacah his mother he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; and Asa cut down her image, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também tirou de sua avó Maaca a posição de rainha-mãe, porque havia feito um ídolo num bosque. Além disso, Asa destruiu o ídolo dela, e o queimou junto ao ribeiro de Cedrom.
verses.RVR09: Y también privó á su madre Maachâ de ser princesa, porque había hecho un ídolo en un bosque. Además deshizo Asa el ídolo de su madre, y quemólo junto al torrente de Cedrón.

verses.KJV: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the Lord all his days.
verses.WEB: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with the LORD all his days.
verses.ASV: But the high places were not taken away: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with Jehovah all his days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os altos não foram tirados. Contudo, o coração de Asa foi completo com o SENHOR durante toda a sua vida.
verses.RVR09: Empero los altos no se quitaron: con todo, el corazón de Asa fué perfecto para con Jehová toda su vida.

verses.KJV: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the Lord, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.WEB: He brought into the LORD’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.
verses.ASV: And he brought into the house of Jehovah the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também trouxe à casa do SENHOR o que o seu pai havia dedicado, e o que ele dedicou: ouro, e prata, e utensílios.
verses.RVR09: También metió en la casa de Jehová lo que su padre había dedicado, y lo que él dedicó: oro, y plata, y vasos.

verses.KJV: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.WEB: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.ASV: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia guerra entre Asa e Baasa, rei de Israel, durante todo o tempo deles.
verses.RVR09: Y hubo guerra entre Asa y Baasa rey de Israel, todo el tiempo de ambos.

verses.KJV: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.WEB: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.ASV: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Baasa, rei de Israel, subiu contra Judá, e edificou Ramá, para não deixar sair nem entrar a ninguém de Asa, rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y subió Baasa rey de Israel contra Judá, y edificó á Rama, para no dejar salir ni entrar á ninguno de Asa, rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.WEB: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
verses.ASV: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants; and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Asa tomou toda a prata e ouro que havia restado nos tesouros da casa do SENHOR, e os tesouros da casa real, entregou-os nas mãos de seus servos, e o rei Asa os enviou a Ben-Hadade, filho de Tabrimom, filho de Heziom, rei da Síria, o qual residia em Damasco, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces tomando Asa toda la plata y oro que había quedado en los tesoros de la casa de Jehová, y los tesoros de la casa real, entrególos en las manos de sus siervos, y enviólos el rey Asa á Ben-adad, hijo de Tabrimón, hijo de Hezión, rey de Siria, el cual residía en Damasco, diciendo:

verses.KJV: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.WEB: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
verses.ASV: [There is] a league between me and thee, between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Haja] uma aliança entre mim e ti, entre meu pai e o teu pai; eis que eu te envio um presente de prata e ouro. Vai, e rompe a tua aliança com Baasa, rei de Israel, para que me deixe.
verses.RVR09: Alianza hay entre mí y ti, y entre mi padre y el tuyo: he aquí yo te envío un presente de plata y oro: ve, y rompe tu alianza con Baasa rey de Israel, para que me deje.

verses.KJV: So Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.WEB: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.ASV: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ben-Hadade consentiu com o rei Asa, e enviou os príncipes dos exércitos que tinha contra as cidades de Israel, e feriu a Ijom, e a Dã, e a Abel-Bete-Maaca, e a toda Quinerete, com toda a terra de Naftali.
verses.RVR09: Y Ben-adad consintió con el rey Asa, y envió los príncipes de los ejércitos que tenía contra las ciudades de Israel, é hirió á Ahión, y á Dan, y á Abel-beth-maachâ, y á toda Cinneroth, con toda la tierra de Nephtalí.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
verses.WEB: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo isto Baasa, deixou de edificar a Ramá, e ficou em Tirsa.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo esto Baasa, dejó de edificar á Rama, y estúvose en Thirsa.

verses.KJV: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.WEB: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.ASV: Then king Asa made a proclamation unto all Judah; none was exempted: and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built therewith Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei Asa convocou a todo Judá, sem excetuar ninguém; e tiraram de Ramá a pedra e a madeira com que Baasa edificava, e edificou o rei Asa com ele a Gibeá de Benjamim, e a Mispá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey Asa convocó á todo Judá, sin exceptuar ninguno; y quitaron de Rama la piedra y la madera con que Baasa edificaba, y edificó el rey Asa con ello á Gabaa de Benjamín, y á Mizpa.

verses.KJV: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.WEB: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.ASV: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais de todos os feitos de Asa, e toda sua fortaleza, e todas as coisas que fez, e as cidades que edificou, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá? Mas no tempo de sua velhice enfermou de seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de todos los hechos de Asa, y toda su fortaleza, y todas las cosas que hizo, y las ciudades que edificó, ¿no está todo escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Judá? Mas en el tiempo de su vejez enfermó de sus pies.

verses.KJV: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descansou Asa com seus pais, e foi sepultado com seus pais na cidade de Davi seu pai: e reinou em seu lugar Josafá seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió Asa con sus padres, y fué sepultado con sus padres en la ciudad de David su padre: y reinó en su lugar Josaphat su hijo.

verses.KJV: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
verses.WEB: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.
verses.ASV: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Nadabe, filho de Jeroboão, começou a reinar sobre Israel no segundo ano de Asa rei de Judá; e reinou sobre Israel dois anos.
verses.RVR09: Y Nadab, hijo de Jeroboam, comenzó á reinar sobre Israel en el segundo año de Asa rey de Judá; y reinó sobre Israel dos años.

verses.KJV: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.WEB: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o que era mau diante dos olhos do SENHOR, andando no caminho de seu pai, e em seus pecados com que fez pecar a Israel.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo ante los ojos de Jehová, andando en el camino de su padre, y en sus pecados con que hizo pecar á Israel.

verses.KJV: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
verses.WEB: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.
verses.ASV: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to Gibbethon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Baasa filho de Aías, o qual era da casa de Issacar, fez conspiração contra ele: e feriu-o Baasa em Gibetom, que era dos filisteus: porque Nadabe e todo Israel tinham cercado a Gibetom.
verses.RVR09: Y Baasa hijo de Ahía, el cual era de la casa de Issachâr, hizo conspiración contra él: é hiriólo Baasa en Gibbethón, que era de los Filisteos: porque Nadab y todo Israel tenían cercado á Gibbethón.

verses.KJV: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Matou-o, pois, Baasa no terceiro ano de Asa rei de Judá, e reinou em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Matólo pues Baasa en el tercer año de Asa rey de Judá, y reinó en lugar suyo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
verses.WEB: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;
verses.ASV: And it came to pass that, as soon as he was king, he smote all the house of Jeroboam: he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him; according unto the saying of Jehovah, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele veio ao reino, feriu toda a casa de Jeroboão, sem deixar alma vivente dos de Jeroboão, até exterminá-lo, conforme à palavra do SENHOR que ele falou por seu servo Aías silonita;
verses.RVR09: Y como él vino al reino, hirió toda la casa de Jeroboam, sin dejar alma viviente de los de Jeroboam, hasta raerlo, conforme á la palabra de Jehová que él habló por su siervo Ahías Silonita;

verses.KJV: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger.
verses.WEB: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
verses.ASV: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and wherewith he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation wherewith he provoked Jehovah, the God of Israel, to anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa dos pecados de Jeroboão que ele havia cometido, e com os quais fez pecar a Israel; e por sua provocação com que provocou à ira ao SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Por los pecados de Jeroboam que él había cometido, y con los cuales hizo pecar á Israel; y por su provocación con que provocó á enojo á Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Nadabe, e todas as coisas que fez, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Nadab, y todas las cosas que hizo, ¿no está todo escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Israel?

verses.KJV: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.WEB: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.ASV: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia guerra entre Asa e Baasa, rei de Israel, durante todo o tempo deles.
verses.RVR09: Y hubo guerra entre Asa y Baasa rey de Israel, todo el tiempo de ambos.

verses.KJV: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
verses.WEB: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.
verses.ASV: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, [and reigned] twenty and four years.
verses.ALMEIDA: No terceiro ano de Asa, rei de Judá, começou a reinar Baasa, filho de Aías, sobre todo Israel em Tirsa; e reinou vinte e quatro anos.
verses.RVR09: En el tercer año de Asa rey de Judá, comenzó á reinar Baasa hijo de Ahía sobre todo Israel en Thirsa; y reinó veinticuatro años.

verses.KJV: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.WEB: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e andou no caminho de Jeroboão, e em seu pecado com que fez pecar a Israel.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo á los ojos de Jehová, y anduvo en el camino de Jeroboam, y en su pecado con que hizo pecar á Israel.

verses.KJV: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi palavra do SENHOR a Jeú, filho de Hanani, contra Baasa, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ palabra de Jehová á Jehú hijo de Hanani contra Baasa, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
verses.WEB: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,
verses.ASV: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel, and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
verses.ALMEIDA: Posto que te levantei do pó, e te pus por príncipe sobre meu povo Israel, e andaste no caminho de Jeroboão, e fizeste pecar a meu povo Israel, provocando-me à ira com os seus pecados;
verses.RVR09: Pues que yo te levanté del polvo, y te puse por príncipe sobre mi pueblo Israel, y tú has andado en el camino de Jeroboam, y has hecho pecar á mi pueblo Israel, provocándome á ira con sus pecados;

verses.KJV: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.WEB: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.ASV: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que varrerei a posteridade de Baasa, e a posteridade de sua casa; e tornarei a tua casa como a casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo barreré la posteridad de Baasa, y la posteridad de su casa: y pondré tu casa como la casa de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat.

verses.KJV: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.WEB: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”
verses.ASV: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the field shall the birds of the heavens eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que de Baasa for morto na cidade, os cães lhe comerão; e o que dele for morto no campo, as aves do céu o comerão.
verses.RVR09: El que de Baasa fuere muerto en la ciudad, le comerán los perros; y el que de él fuere muerto en el campo, comerlo han las aves del cielo.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
