verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Baasa, e as coisas que fez, e sua fortaleza, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Baasa, y las cosas que hizo, y su fortaleza, ¿no está todo escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Israel?

verses.KJV: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descansou Baasa com seus pais, e foi sepultado em Tirsa; e reinou em seu lugar Elá, seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió Baasa con sus padres, y fué sepultado en Thirsa; y reinó en su lugar Ela su hijo.

verses.KJV: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the Lord against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.
verses.ASV: And moreover by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of Jehovah against Baasha, and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the sight of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he smote him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a palavra do SENHOR por meio de Jeú profeta, filho de Hanani, havia sido contra Baasa e também contra sua casa, com motivo de todo o mal que fez aos olhos do SENHOR, provocando-lhe à ira com as obras de suas mãos, para que fosse feita como a casa de Jeroboão; e porque o havia ferido.
verses.RVR09: Empero la palabra de Jehová por mano de Jehú profeta, hijo de Hanani, había sido contra Baasa y también contra su casa, con motivo de todo lo malo que hizo á los ojos de Jehová, provocándole á ira con las obras de sus manos, para que fuese hecha como la casa de Jeroboam; y porque lo había herido.

verses.KJV: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
verses.WEB: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.
verses.ASV: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, [and reigned] two years.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano vinte e seis de Asa rei de Judá, começou a reinar Elá filho de Baasa sobre Israel em Tirsa; e reinou dois anos.
verses.RVR09: En el año veintiséis de Asa rey de Judá, comenzó á reinar Ela hijo de Baasa sobre Israel en Thirsa; y reinó dos años.

verses.KJV: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.
verses.WEB: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;
verses.ASV: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez conspiração contra ele seu servo Zinri, comandante da metade dos carros. E estando ele em Tirsa, bebendo e embriagado em casa de Arsa seu mordomo em Tirsa,
verses.RVR09: E hizo conjuración contra él su siervo Zimri, comandante de la mitad de los carros. Y estando él en Thirsa, bebiendo y embriagado en casa de Arsa su mayordomo en Thirsa,

verses.KJV: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: and Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio Zinri, e o feriu e matou, no ano vinte e sete de Asa rei de Judá; e reinou em lugar seu.
verses.RVR09: Vino Zimri, y lo hirió y mató, en el año veintisiete de Asa rey de Judá; y reinó en lugar suyo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
verses.WEB: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he smote all the house of Baasha: he left him not a single man-child, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que chegou a reinar e esteve sentado em seu trono, feriu toda a casa de Baasa, sem deixar nela macho, nem seus parentes nem amigos.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que llegó á reinar y estuvo sentado en su trono, hirió toda la casa de Baasa, sin dejar en ella meante á la pared, ni sus parientes ni amigos.

verses.KJV: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet.
verses.WEB: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
verses.ASV: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim exterminou Zinri toda a casa de Baasa, conforme à palavra do SENHOR, que havia proferido contra Baasa por meio do profeta Jeú;
verses.RVR09: Así rayó Zimri toda la casa de Baasa, conforme á la palabra de Jehová, que había proferido contra Baasa por medio del profeta Jehú;

verses.KJV: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.WEB: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
verses.ASV: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned, and wherewith they made Israel to sin, to provoke Jehovah, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por todos os pecados de Baasa, e os pecados de Elá seu filho, com que eles pecaram e fizeram pecar a Israel, provocando à ira ao SENHOR Deus de Israel com suas vaidades.
verses.RVR09: Por todos los pecados de Baasa, y los pecados de Ela su hijo, con que ellos pecaron é hicieron pecar á Israel, provocando á enojo á Jehová Dios de Israel con sus vanidades.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais feitos de Elá, e todas as coisas que fez, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Los demás hechos de Ela, y todas las cosas que hizo, ¿no está todo escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Israel?

verses.KJV: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.WEB: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.ASV: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano vinte e sete de Asa rei de Judá, começou a reinar Zinri, e reinou sete dias em Tirsa; e o povo havia assentado campo sobre Gibetom, cidade dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: En el año veintisiete de Asa rey de Judá, comenzó á reinar Zimri, y reinó siete días en Thirsa; y el pueblo había asentado campo sobre Gibbethón, ciudad de los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.WEB: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.ASV: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also smitten the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo que estava no campo ouviu dizer: Zinri fez conspiração, e matou ao rei. Então todo Israel levantou o mesmo dia por rei sobre Israel a Onri, general do exército, no campo.
verses.RVR09: Y el pueblo que estaba en el campo oyó decir: Zimri ha hecho conjuración, y ha muerto al rey. Entonces todo Israel levantó el mismo día por rey sobre Israel á Omri, general del ejército, en el campo.

verses.KJV: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.WEB: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.ASV: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiu Onri de Gibetom, e com ele todo Israel, e cercaram a Tirsa.
verses.RVR09: Y subió Omri de Gibbethón, y con él todo Israel, y cercaron á Thirsa.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died.
verses.WEB: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the castle of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas vendo Zinri tomado a cidade, entrou no palácio da casa real, e pegou fogo à casa consigo: assim morreu.
verses.RVR09: Mas viendo Zimri tomada la ciudad, metióse en el palacio de la casa real, y pegó fuego á la casa consigo: así murió,

verses.KJV: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the Lord, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
verses.WEB: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.
verses.ASV: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por seus pecados que ele havia cometido, fazendo o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e andando nos caminhos de Jeroboão, e em seu pecado que cometeu, fazendo pecar a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Por sus pecados que él había cometido, haciendo lo malo á los ojos de Jehová, y andando en los caminos de Jeroboam, y en su pecado que cometió, haciendo pecar á Israel.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais feitos de Zinri, e sua conspiração que formou, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Los demás hechos de Zimri, y su conspiración que formó, ¿no está todo escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Israel?

verses.KJV: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
verses.WEB: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
verses.ASV: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o povo de Israel foi dividido em duas partes: a metade do povo seguia a Tibni filho de Ginate, para fazê-lo rei: e a outra metade seguia a Onri.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el pueblo de Israel fué dividido en dos partes: la mitad del pueblo seguía á Thibni hijo de Gineth, para hacerlo rey: y la otra mitad seguía á Omri.

verses.KJV: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
verses.WEB: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
verses.ASV: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o povo que seguia a Onri pôde mais que o que seguia a Tibni filho de Ginate; e Tibni morreu, e Onri foi rei.
verses.RVR09: Mas el pueblo que seguía á Omri, pudo más que el que seguía á Thibni hijo de Gineth; y Thibni murió, y Omri fué rey.

verses.KJV: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
verses.WEB: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.
verses.ASV: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, [and reigned] twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano trinta e um de Asa rei de Judá, começou a reinar Onri sobre Israel, e reinou doze anos: em Tirsa reinou seis anos.
verses.RVR09: En el año treinta y uno de Asa rey de Judá, comenzó á reinar Omri sobre Israel, y reinó doce años: en Thirsa reinó seis años.

verses.KJV: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
verses.WEB: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.
verses.ASV: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill, Samaria.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele comprou de Semer o monte de Samaria por dois talentos de prata, e edificou no monte: e chamou o nome da cidade que edificou Samaria, do nome de Semer, senhor que foi daquele monte.
verses.RVR09: Y compró él de Semer el monte de Samaria por dos talentos de plata, y edificó en el monte: y llamó el nombre de la ciudad que edificó, Samaria, del nombre de Semer, señor que fué de aquel monte.

verses.KJV: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did worse than all that were before him.
verses.WEB: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.
verses.ASV: And Omri did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and dealt wickedly above all that were before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Onri fez o mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e fez pior que todos os que haviam sido antes dele:
verses.RVR09: Y Omri hizo lo malo á los ojos de Jehová, é hizo peor que todos los que habían sido antes de él:

verses.KJV: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.WEB: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
verses.ASV: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke Jehovah, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois andou em todos os caminhos de Jeroboão filho de Nebate, e em seu pecado com que fez pecar a Israel, provocando à ira ao SENHOR Deus de Israel com seus ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Pues anduvo en todos los caminos de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, y en su pecado con que hizo pecar á Israel, provocando á ira á Jehová Dios de Israel con sus ídolos.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Onri, e todas as coisas que fez, e suas valentias que executou, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Omri, y todas las cosas que hizo, y sus valentías que ejecutó, ¿no está todo escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Israel?

verses.KJV: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Onri descansou com seus pais, e foi sepultado em Samaria; e reinou em lugar seu Acabe, seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y Omri durmió con sus padres, y fué sepultado en Samaria; y reinó en lugar suyo Achâb, su hijo.

verses.KJV: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
verses.WEB: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
verses.ASV: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E começou a reinar Acabe filho de Onri sobre Israel o ano trinta e oito de Asa rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzó á reinar Achâb hijo de Omri sobre Israel el año treinta y ocho de Asa rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord above all that were before him.
verses.WEB: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight above all that were before him.
verses.ASV: And Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah above all that were before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reinou Acabe filho de Onri sobre Israel em Samaria vinte e dois anos. E Acabe filho de Onri fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR além de todos os que foram antes dele;
verses.RVR09: Y reinó Achâb hijo de Omri sobre Israel en Samaria veintidós años. Y Achâb hijo de Omri hizo lo malo á los ojos de Jehová sobre todos los que fueron antes de él;

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
verses.WEB: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque lhe foi pouca coisa andar nos pecados de Jeroboão filho de Nebate, e tomou por mulher a Jezabel filha de Etbaal rei dos sidônios, e foi e serviu a Baal, e o adorou.
verses.RVR09: Porque le fué ligera cosa andar en los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, y tomó por mujer á Jezabel hija de Ethbaal rey de los Sidonios, y fué y sirvió á Baal, y lo adoró.

verses.KJV: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.WEB: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.ASV: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez altar a Baal, no templo de Baal que ele edificou em Samaria.
verses.RVR09: E hizo altar á Baal, en el templo de Baal que él edificó en Samaria.

verses.KJV: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.WEB: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
verses.ASV: And Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did yet more to provoke Jehovah, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também Acabe um bosque; e acrescentou Acabe fazendo provocar à ira ao SENHOR Deus de Israel, mais que todos os reis de Israel que antes dele haviam sido.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también Achâb un bosque; y añadió Achâb haciendo provocar á ira á Jehová Dios de Israel, más que todos los reyes de Israel que antes de él habían sido.

verses.KJV: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.WEB: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.ASV: In his days did Hiel the Beth-elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof with the loss of Abiram his first-born, and set up the gates thereof with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seu tempo Hiel de Betel reedificou a Jericó. À custa de Abirão seu primogênito lançou o alicerce, e à custa de Segube seu filho posterior pôs suas portas, conforme à palavra do SENHOR que havia falado por Josué filho de Num.
verses.RVR09: En su tiempo Hiel de Beth-el reedificó á Jericó. En Abiram su primogénito echó el cimiento, y en Segub su hijo postrero puso sus puertas; conforme á la palabra de Jehová que había hablado por Josué hijo de Nun.

verses.KJV: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the Lord God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
verses.WEB: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”
verses.ASV: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the sojourners of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As Jehovah, the God of Israel, liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Elias Tisbita, que era dos moradores de Gileade, disse a Acabe: Vive o SENHOR Deus de Israel, diante do qual estou, que não haverá chuva nem orvalho nestes anos, a não ser por minha palavra.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES Elías Thisbita, que era de los moradores de Galaad, dijo á Achâb: Vive Jehová Dios de Israel, delante del cual estoy, que no habrá lluvia ni rocío en estos años, sino por mi palabra.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s word came to him, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto him, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a ele palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á él palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.WEB: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
verses.ASV: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aparta-te daqui, e volta-te ao oriente, e esconde-te no ribeiro de Querite, que está diante do Jordão;
verses.RVR09: Apártate de aquí, y vuélvete al oriente, y escóndete en el arroyo de Cherith, que está delante del Jordán;

verses.KJV: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
verses.WEB: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
verses.ASV: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E beberás do ribeiro; e eu ei mandado aos corvos que te deem ali de comer.
verses.RVR09: Y beberás del arroyo; y yo he mandado á los cuervos que te den allí de comer.

verses.KJV: So he went and did according unto the word of the Lord: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.WEB: So he went and did according to the LORD’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.
verses.ASV: So he went and did according unto the word of Jehovah; for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele foi, e fez conforme à palavra do SENHOR; pois se foi e assentou junto ao ribeiro de Querite, que está antes do Jordão.
verses.RVR09: Y él fué, é hizo conforme á la palabra de Jehová; pues se fué y asentó junto al arroyo de Cherith, que está antes del Jordán.

verses.KJV: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verses.WEB: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
verses.ASV: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os corvos lhe traziam pão e carne pela manhã, e pão e carne à tarde; e bebia do ribeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y los cuervos le traían pan y carne por la mañana, y pan y carne á la tarde; y bebía del arroyo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.WEB: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passados alguns dias, secou-se o ribeiro; porque não havia chovido sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Pasados algunos días, secóse el arroyo; porque no había llovido sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to him, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto him, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi a ele palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á él palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
verses.WEB: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
verses.ASV: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Sidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, vai-te a Sarepta de Sidom, e ali morarás: eis que eu mandei ali a uma mulher viúva que te sustente.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, vete á Sarepta de Sidón, y allí morarás: he aquí yo he mandado allí á una mujer viuda que te sustente.

verses.KJV: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verses.WEB: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”
verses.ASV: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele se levantou, e se foi a Sarepta. E quando chegou à porta da cidade, eis que uma mulher viúva que estava ali colhendo gravetos; e ele a chamou, e disse-lhe: Rogo-te que me tragas um pouco de água em um vaso, para que beba.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él se levantó, y se fué á Sarepta. Y como llegó á la puerta de la ciudad, he aquí una mujer viuda que estaba allí cogiendo serojas; y él la llamó, y díjole: Ruégote que me traigas una poca de agua en un vaso, para que beba.

verses.KJV: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
verses.WEB: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”
verses.ASV: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo ela para trazê-la, ele a voltou a chamar, e disse-lhe: Rogo-te que me tragas também um bocado de pão em tua mão.
verses.RVR09: Y yendo ella para traérsela, él la volvió á llamar, y díjole: Ruégote que me traigas también un bocado de pan en tu mano.

verses.KJV: And she said, As the Lord thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verses.WEB: She said, “As the LORD your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
verses.ASV: And she said, As Jehovah thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but a handful of meal in the jar, and a little oil in the cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela respondeu: Vive o SENHOR Deus teu, que não tenho pão cozido; que somente um punhado de farinha tenho no jarro, e um pouco de azeite em uma botija: e agora cozia dois gravetos, para entrar-me e prepará-lo para mim e para meu filho, e que o comamos, e morramos.
verses.RVR09: Y ella respondió: Vive Jehová Dios tuyo, que no tengo pan cocido; que solamente un puñado de harina tengo en la tinaja, y un poco de aceite en una botija: y ahora cogía dos serojas, para entrarme y aderezarlo para mí y para mi hijo, y que lo comamos, y nos muramos.

verses.KJV: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
verses.WEB: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
verses.ASV: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said; but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it forth unto me, and afterward make for thee and for thy son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Elias lhe disse: Não tenhas temor; vai, face como disseste: porém faze-me a mim primeiro disso uma pequena torta cozida debaixo da cinza, e traze-a a mim; e depois farás para ti e para teu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y Elías le dijo: No hayas temor; ve, haz como has dicho: empero hazme á mí primero de ello una pequeña torta cocida debajo de la ceniza, y tráemela; y después harás para ti y para tu hijo.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the Lord sendeth rain upon the earth.
verses.WEB: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth.’”
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, The jar of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that Jehovah sendeth rain upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR Deus de Israel disse assim: O jarro da farinha não esvaziará, nem se diminuirá a botija do azeite, até aquele dia que o SENHOR dará chuva sobre a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová Dios de Israel ha dicho así: La tinaja de la harina no escaseará, ni se disminuirá la botija del aceite, hasta aquel día que Jehová dará lluvia sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
verses.WEB: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.
verses.ASV: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat [many] days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ela foi, e fez como lhe disse Elias; e comeu ele, e ela e sua casa, muitos dias.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ella fué, é hizo como le dijo Elías; y comió él, y ella y su casa, muchos días.

verses.KJV: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Elijah.
verses.WEB: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.
verses.ASV: The jar of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake by Elijah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o jarro da farinha não esvaziou, nem minguou a botija do azeite, conforme à palavra do SENHOR que havia dito por Elias.
verses.RVR09: Y la tinaja de la harina no escaseó, ni menguó la botija del aceite, conforme á la palabra de Jehová que había dicho por Elías.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
verses.WEB: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois destas coisas aconteceu que caiu enfermo o filho da ama da casa, e a enfermidade foi tão grave, que não restou nele respiração.
verses.RVR09: Después de estas cosas aconteció que cayó enfermo el hijo del ama de la casa, y la enfermedad fué tan grave, que no quedó en él resuello.

verses.KJV: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
verses.WEB: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
verses.ASV: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? thou art come unto me to bring my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son!
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse a Elias: Que tenho eu contigo, homem de Deus? Vieste a mim para trazer em memória minhas iniquidades, e para fazer-me morrer meu filho?
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo á Elías: ¿Qué tengo yo contigo, varón de Dios? ¿has venido á mí para traer en memoria mis iniquidades, y para hacerme morir mi hijo?

verses.KJV: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
verses.WEB: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.
verses.ASV: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the chamber, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Dá-me aqui teu filho. Então ele o tomou de seu colo, e levou-o à câmara de onde ele estava, e pôs-lhe sobre sua cama;
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Dame acá tu hijo. Entonces él lo tomó de su regazo, y llevólo á la cámara donde él estaba, y púsole sobre su cama;

verses.KJV: And he cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
verses.WEB: He cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”
verses.ASV: And he cried unto Jehovah, and said, O Jehovah my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
verses.ALMEIDA: E clamando ao SENHOR, disse: SENHOR Deus meu, ainda à viúva em cuja casa eu estou hospedado afligiste, matando-lhe seu filho?
verses.RVR09: Y clamando á Jehová, dijo: Jehová Dios mío, ¿aun á la viuda en cuya casa yo estoy hospedado has afligido, matándole su hijo?

verses.KJV: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.
verses.WEB: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”
verses.ASV: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto Jehovah, and said, O Jehovah my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele se estendeu sobre o menino três vezes, e clamou ao SENHOR, e disse: SENHOR Deus meu, rogo-te que volte a alma deste menino a suas entranhas.
verses.RVR09: Y midióse sobre el niño tres veces, y clamó á Jehová, y dijo: Jehová Dios mío, ruégote que vuelva el alma de este niño á sus entrañas.

verses.KJV: And the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.WEB: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah hearkened unto the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR ouviu a voz de Elias, e a alma do menino voltou a suas entranhas, e reviveu.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová oyó la voz de Elías, y el alma del niño volvió á sus entrañas, y revivió.

verses.KJV: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
verses.WEB: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”
verses.ASV: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother; and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomando logo Elias ao menino, trouxe-o da câmara à casa, e deu-o à sua mãe, e disse-lhe Elias: Olha, teu filho vive.
verses.RVR09: Tomando luego Elías al niño, trájolo de la cámara á la casa, y diólo á su madre, y díjole Elías: Mira, tu hijo vive.

verses.KJV: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in thy mouth is truth.
verses.WEB: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the LORD’s word in your mouth is truth.”
verses.ASV: And the woman said to Elijah, Now I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of Jehovah in thy mouth is truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a mulher disse a Elias: Agora conheço que tu és homem de Deus, e que a palavra do SENHOR é verdade em tua boca.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la mujer dijo á Elías: Ahora conozco que tú eres varón de Dios, y que la palabra de Jehová es verdad en tu boca.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the Lord came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
verses.WEB: After many days, the LORD’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of Jehovah came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, Go, show thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passados muitos dias, veio a palavra do SENHOR a Elias no terceiro ano, dizendo: Vai, mostra-te a Acabe, e eu darei chuva sobre a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: PASADOS muchos días, fué palabra de Jehová á Elías en el tercer año, diciendo: Ve, muéstrate á Achâb, y yo daré lluvia sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
verses.WEB: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
verses.ASV: And Elijah went to show himself unto Ahab. And the famine was sore in Samaria.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi, pois, Elias a mostrar-se a Acabe. Havia naquele tempo grande fome em Samaria.
verses.RVR09: Fué pues Elías á mostrarse á Achâb. Había á la sazón grande hambre en Samaria.

verses.KJV: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly:
verses.WEB: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly;
verses.ASV: And Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared Jehovah greatly:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Acabe chamou a Obadias seu mordomo, o qual Obadias era em grande maneira temeroso do SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Y Achâb llamó á Abdías su mayordomo, el cual Abdías era en grande manera temeroso de Jehová;

verses.KJV: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the Lord, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.WEB: for when Jezebel cut off the LORD’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.ASV: for it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of Jehovah, that Obadiah took a hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quando Jezabel destruía aos profetas do SENHOR, Obadias tomou cem profetas, os quais escondeu de cinquenta em cinquenta por covas, e sustentou-os a pão e água.
verses.RVR09: Porque cuando Jezabel destruía á los profetas de Jehová, Abdías tomó cien profetas, los cuales escondió de cincuenta en cincuenta por cuevas, y sustentólos á pan y agua.

verses.KJV: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
verses.WEB: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”
verses.ASV: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go through the land, unto all the fountains of water, and unto all the brooks: peradventure we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Acabe a Obadias: Vai pela terra a todas as fontes de águas, e a todos os ribeiros; que acaso acharemos grama com que conservemos a vida aos cavalos e às mulas, para que não nos fiquemos sem animais.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Achâb á Abdías: Ve por el país á todas las fuentes de aguas, y á todos los arroyos; que acaso hallaremos grama con que conservemos la vida á los caballos y á las acémilas, para que no nos quedemos sin bestias.

verses.KJV: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.WEB: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.ASV: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E repartiram entre si a terra para percorrerem-na; Acabe foi por si só por um caminho, e Obadias foi separadamente por outro.
verses.RVR09: Y partieron entre sí el país para recorrerlo: Achâb fué de por sí por un camino, y Abdías fué separadamente por otro.

verses.KJV: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?
verses.WEB: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”
verses.ASV: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Is it thou, my lord Elijah?
verses.ALMEIDA: E indo Obadias pelo caminho, encontrou-se com Elias; e como lhe conheceu, prostrou-se sobre seu rosto, e disse: Não és tu meu senhor Elias?
verses.RVR09: Y yendo Abdías por el camino, topóse con Elías; y como le conoció, postróse sobre su rostro, y dijo: ¿No eres tú mi señor Elías?

verses.KJV: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.WEB: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”
verses.ASV: And he answered him, It is I: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah [is here].
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Eu sou; vai, dize a teu amo: Eis que Elias.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Yo soy; ve, di á tu amo: He aquí Elías.

verses.KJV: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
verses.WEB: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?
verses.ASV: And he said, Wherein have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele disse: Em que ei pecado, para que tu entregues teu servo em mão de Acabe para que me mate?
verses.RVR09: Pero él dijo: ¿En qué he pecado, para que tú entregues tu siervo en mano de Achâb para que me mate?

verses.KJV: As the Lord thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
verses.WEB: As the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.
verses.ASV: As Jehovah thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not here, he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vive o SENHOR teu Deus, que não houve nação nem reino de onde meu senhor não haja enviado a buscar-te; e respondendo eles: Não está aqui, ele conjurou a reinos e nações se não te acharam.
verses.RVR09: Vive Jehová tu Dios, que no ha habido nación ni reino donde mi señor no haya enviado á buscarte; y respondiendo ellos, No está aquí, él ha conjurado á reinos y naciones si no te han hallado.

verses.KJV: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.WEB: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’
verses.ASV: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah [is here].
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora tu dizes: Vai, dize a teu amo: Aqui está Elias?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y ahora tú dices: Ve, di á tu amo: Aquí está Elías?

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the Lord shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the Lord from my youth.
verses.WEB: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that the LORD’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.
verses.ASV: And it will come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of Jehovah will carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he will slay me: but I thy servant fear Jehovah from my youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecerá que, logo que eu me haja partido de ti, o espírito do SENHOR te levará de onde eu não saiba; e vindo eu, e dando as novas a Acabe, e se ele não te achar, me matará; e teu servo teme ao SENHOR desde sua juventude.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá que, luego que yo me haya partido de ti, el espíritu de Jehová te llevará donde yo no sepa; y viniendo yo, y dando las nuevas á Achâb, y no hallándote él, me matará; y tu siervo teme á Jehová desde su mocedad.

verses.KJV: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the Lord, how I hid an hundred men of the Lord's prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.WEB: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the LORD’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of the LORD’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.ASV: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of Jehovah, how I hid a hundred men of Jehovah’s prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não foi dito a meu senhor o que fiz, quando Jezabel matava aos profetas do SENHOR: que escondi cem homens dos profetas do SENHOR de cinquenta em cinquenta em covas, e os mantive a pão e água?
verses.RVR09: ¿No ha sido dicho á mi señor lo que hice, cuando Jezabel mataba á los profetas de Jehová: que escondí cien varones de los profetas de Jehová de cincuenta en cincuenta en cuevas, y los mantuve á pan y agua?

verses.KJV: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
verses.WEB: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”
verses.ASV: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah [is here]; and he will slay me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora dizes tu: Vai, dize a teu amo: Aqui está Elias: para que ele me mate?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y ahora dices tú: Ve, di á tu amo: Aquí está Elías: para que él me mate?

verses.KJV: And Elijah said, As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
verses.WEB: Elijah said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”
verses.ASV: And Elijah said, As Jehovah of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself unto him to-day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Elias: Vive o SENHOR dos exércitos, diante do qual estou, que hoje me mostrarei a ele.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Elías: Vive Jehová de los ejércitos, delante del cual estoy, que hoy me mostraré á él.

verses.KJV: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.WEB: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.ASV: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Obadias foi a encontrar-se com Acabe, e deu-lhe o aviso; e Acabe veio a encontrar-se com Elias.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Abdías fué á encontrarse con Achâb, y dióle el aviso; y Achâb vino á encontrarse con Elías.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
verses.WEB: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Is it thou, thou troubler of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Acabe viu a Elias, disse-lhe Acabe: És tu o que perturbas a Israel?
verses.RVR09: Y como Achâb vió á Elías, díjole Achâb: ¿Eres tú el que alborotas á Israel?

verses.KJV: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the Lord, and thou hast followed Baalim.
verses.WEB: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the LORD’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.
verses.ASV: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of Jehovah, and thou hast followed the Baalim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele respondeu: Eu não perturbei a Israel, mas sim tu e a casa de teu pai, deixando os mandamentos do SENHOR, e seguindo aos baalins.
verses.RVR09: Y él respondió: Yo no he alborotado á Israel, sino tú y la casa de tu padre, dejando los mandamientos de Jehová, y siguiendo á los Baales.

verses.KJV: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.
verses.WEB: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the Asherah four hundred, that eat at Jezebel’s table.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envia, pois, agora e juntai-me a todo Israel no monte de Carmelo, e os quatrocentos e cinquenta profetas de Baal, e os quatrocentos profetas dos bosques, que comem da mesa de Jezabel.
verses.RVR09: Envía pues ahora y júntame á todo Israel en el monte de Carmelo, y los cuatrocientos y cincuenta profetas de Baal, y los cuatrocientos profetas de los bosques, que comen de la mesa de Jezabel.

verses.KJV: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
verses.WEB: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.
verses.ASV: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Acabe enviou a todos os filhos de Israel, e juntou os profetas no monte de Carmelo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Achâb envió á todos los hijos de Israel, y juntó los profetas en el monte de Carmelo.

verses.KJV: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the Lord be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
verses.WEB: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.
verses.ASV: And Elijah came near unto all the people, and said, How long go ye limping between the two sides? if Jehovah be God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aproximando-se Elias a todo o povo, disse: Até quando hesitareis vós entre dois pensamentos? Se o SENHOR é Deus, segui-lhe; e se Baal, ide depois dele. E o povo não respondeu palavra.
verses.RVR09: Y acercándose Elías á todo el pueblo, dijo: ¿Hasta cuándo claudicaréis vosotros entre dos pensamientos? Si Jehová es Dios, seguidle; y si Baal, id en pos de él. Y el pueblo no respondió palabra.

verses.KJV: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the Lord; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.WEB: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.
verses.ASV: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, am left a prophet of Jehovah; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Elias converteu a dizer ao povo: Só eu restei profeta do SENHOR; mas dos profetas de Baal há quatrocentos e cinquenta homens.
verses.RVR09: Y Elías tornó á decir al pueblo: Sólo yo he quedado profeta de Jehová; mas de los profetas de Baal hay cuatrocientos y cincuenta hombres.

verses.KJV: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
verses.WEB: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.
verses.ASV: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deem-se a nós, pois, dois bois, e escolham-se eles o um, e cortem-no em pedaços, e ponham-no sobre lenha, mas não ponham fogo debaixo; e eu prepararei o outro boi, e o porei sobre lenha, e nenhum fogo porei debaixo.
verses.RVR09: Dénsenos pues dos bueyes, y escójanse ellos el uno, y córtenlo en pedazos, y pónganlo sobre leña, mas no pongan fuego debajo; y yo aprestaré el otro buey, y pondrélo sobre leña, y ningún fuego pondré debajo.

verses.KJV: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the Lord: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
verses.WEB: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on the LORD’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”
verses.ASV: And call ye on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of Jehovah; and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Invocai logo vós no nome de vossos deuses, e eu invocarei no nome do SENHOR: e o Deus que responder por fogo, esse seja Deus. E todo o povo respondeu, dizendo: Bem dito.
verses.RVR09: Invocad luego vosotros en el nombre de vuestros dioses, y yo invocaré en el nombre de Jehová: y el Dios que respondiere por fuego, ése sea Dios. Y todo el pueblo respondió, diciendo: Bien dicho.

verses.KJV: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
verses.WEB: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”
verses.ASV: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Elias disse aos profetas de Baal: Escolhei-vos o um boi, e fazei primeiro, pois que vós sois os mais: e invocai no nome de vossos deuses, mas não ponhais fogo debaixo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Elías dijo á los profetas de Baal: Escogeos el un buey, y haced primero, pues que vosotros sois los más: é invocad en el nombre de vuestros dioses, mas no pongáis fuego debajo.

verses.KJV: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
verses.WEB: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.
verses.ASV: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped about the altar which was made.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles tomaram o boi que lhes foi dado, e prepararam-no, e invocaram no nome de Baal desde a manhã até o meio dia, dizendo: Baal, responde-nos! Mas não havia voz, nem quem respondesse; entretanto, eles andavam saltando próximo do altar que haviam feito.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos tomaron el buey que les fué dado, y aprestáronlo, é invocaron en el nombre de Baal desde la mañana hasta el medio día, diciendo: ¡Baal, respóndenos! Mas no había voz, ni quien respondiese; entre tanto, ellos andaban saltando cerca del altar que habían hecho.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
verses.WEB: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud; for he is a god: either he is musing, or he is gone aside, or he is on a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth and must be awaked.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu ao meio dia, que Elias se ridicularizava deles, dizendo: Gritai em alta voz, que deus é: talvez esteja conversando, ou tem alguma ocupação, ou está caminhando; acaso dorme, e despertará.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció al medio día, que Elías se burlaba de ellos, diciendo: Gritad en alta voz, que dios es: quizá está conversando, ó tiene algún empeño, ó va de camino; acaso duerme, y despertará.

verses.KJV: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.WEB: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.
verses.ASV: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lances, till the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles clamavam a grandes vozes, e cortavam-se com espadas e com lancetas conforme a seu costume, até jorrar o sangue sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos clamaban á grandes voces, y sajábanse con cuchillos y con lancetas conforme á su costumbre, hasta chorrear la sangre sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
verses.WEB: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.
verses.ASV: And it was so, when midday was past, that they prophesied until the time of the offering of the [evening] oblation; but there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando passou o meio dia, e eles profetizaram até o tempo do sacrifício da oferta, e não havia voz, nem quem respondesse nem escutasse;
verses.RVR09: Y como pasó el medio día, y ellos profetizaran hasta el tiempo del sacrificio del presente, y no había voz, ni quien respondiese ni escuchase;

verses.KJV: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the Lord that was broken down.
verses.WEB: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired the LORD’s altar that had been thrown down.
verses.ASV: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me; and all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of Jehovah that was thrown down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elias disse então a todo o povo: Aproximai-vos a mim. E todo o povo se chegou a ele: e ele reparou o altar do SENHOR que estava arruinado.
verses.RVR09: Elías dijo entonces á todo el pueblo: Acercaos á mí. Y todo el pueblo se llegó á él: y él reparó el altar de Jehová que estaba arruinado.

verses.KJV: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the Lord came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
verses.WEB: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”
verses.ASV: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of Jehovah came, saying, Israel shall be thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando Elias doze pedras, conforme ao número das tribos dos filhos de Jacó, ao qual havia sido palavra do SENHOR, dizendo: Israel será teu nome;
verses.RVR09: Y tomando Elías doce piedras, conforme al número de las tribus de los hijos de Jacob, al cual había sido palabra de Jehová, diciendo, Israel será tu nombre;

verses.KJV: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
verses.WEB: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.
verses.ASV: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of Jehovah; and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Edificou com as pedras um altar no nome do SENHOR: depois fez uma sulco ao redor do altar, quanto cabiam duas medidas de semente.
verses.RVR09: Edificó con las piedras un altar en el nombre de Jehová: después hizo una reguera alrededor del altar, cuanto cupieran dos satos de simiente.

verses.KJV: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
verses.WEB: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”
verses.ASV: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid it on the wood. And he said, Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt-offering, and on the wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pôs logo a lenha, e cortou o boi em pedaços, e o pôs sobre a lenha.
verses.RVR09: Compuso luego la leña, y cortó el buey en pedazos, y púsolo sobre la leña.

verses.KJV: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
verses.WEB: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.
verses.ASV: And he said, Do it the second time; and they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time; and they did it the third time.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Enchei quatro cântaros de água, e derramai-a sobre o holocausto e sobre a lenha. E disse: Fazei-o outra vez; e outra vez o fizeram. Disse ainda: Fazei-o a terceira vez; e fizeram-no a terceira vez.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Henchid cuatro cántaros de agua, y derramadla sobre el holocausto y sobre la leña. Y dijo: Hacedlo otra vez; y otra vez lo hicieron. Dijo aún: Hacedlo la tercera vez; é hiciéronlo la tercera vez.

verses.KJV: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
verses.WEB: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.
verses.ASV: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que as águas corriam ao redor do altar; e havia também enchido de água o sulco.
verses.RVR09: De manera que las aguas corrían alrededor del altar; y había también henchido de agua la reguera.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.
verses.WEB: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the [evening] oblation, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, O Jehovah, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegou a hora de oferecer-se o holocausto, chegou-se o profeta Elias, e disse: SENHOR Deus de Abraão, de Isaque, e de Israel, seja hoje manifesto que tu és Deus em Israel, e que eu sou teu servo, e que por mandado teu fiz todas estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Y como llegó la hora de ofrecerse el holocausto, llegóse el profeta Elías, y dijo: Jehová Dios de Abraham, de Isaac, y de Israel, sea hoy manifiesto que tú eres Dios en Israel, y que yo soy tu siervo, y que por mandato tuyo he hecho todas estas cosas.

verses.KJV: Hear me, O Lord, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the Lord God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.
verses.WEB: Hear me, LORD, hear me, that this people may know that you, LORD, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”
verses.ASV: Hear me, O Jehovah, hear me, that this people may know that thou, Jehovah, art God, and [that] thou hast turned their heart back again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responde-me, SENHOR, responde-me; para que conheça este povo que tu, ó SENHOR, és o Deus, e que tu voltaste atrás o coração deles.
verses.RVR09: Respóndeme, Jehová, respóndeme; para que conozca este pueblo que tú, oh Jehová, eres el Dios, y que tú volviste atrás el corazón de ellos.

verses.KJV: Then the fire of the Lord fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.ASV: Then the fire of Jehovah fell, and consumed the burnt-offering, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então caiu fogo do SENHOR, o qual consumiu o holocausto, e a lenha, e as pedras, e o pó, e ainda sugou as águas que estavam no sulco.
verses.RVR09: Entonces cayó fuego de Jehová, el cual consumió el holocausto, y la leña, y las piedras, y el polvo, y aun lamió las aguas que estaban en la reguera.

verses.KJV: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The Lord, he is the God; the Lord, he is the God.
verses.WEB: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “The LORD, he is God! The LORD, he is God!”
verses.ASV: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, Jehovah, he is God; Jehovah, he is God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo-o todo o povo, caíram sobre seus rostos, e disseram: o SENHOR é o Deus! o SENHOR é o Deus!
verses.RVR09: Y viéndolo todo el pueblo, cayeron sobre sus rostros, y dijeron: ¡Jehová es el Dios! ¡Jehová es el Dios!

verses.KJV: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
verses.WEB: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.
verses.ASV: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes Elias: Prendei aos profetas de Baal, que não escape ninguém. E eles os prenderam; e levou-os Elias ao ribeiro de Quisom, e ali os degolou.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Elías: Prended á los profetas de Baal, que no escape ninguno. Y ellos los prendieron; y llevólos Elías al arroyo de Cisón, y allí los degolló.

verses.KJV: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
verses.WEB: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”
verses.ASV: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E então Elias disse a Acabe: Sobe, come e bebe; porque uma grande chuva faz ruído.
verses.RVR09: Y entonces Elías dijo á Achâb: Sube, come y bebe; porque una grande lluvia suena.

verses.KJV: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
verses.WEB: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.
verses.ASV: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Acabe subiu a comer e a beber. E Elias subiu ao cume do Carmelo; e prostrando-se em terra, pôs seu rosto entre os joelhos.
verses.RVR09: Y Achâb subió á comer y á beber. Y Elías subió á la cumbre del Carmelo; y postrándose en tierra, puso su rostro entre las rodillas.

verses.KJV: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
verses.WEB: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.
verses.ASV: And he said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a seu criado: Sobe agora, e olha até o mar. E ele subiu, e olhou, e disse: Não há nada. E ele lhe voltou a dizer: Volta sete vezes.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á su criado: Sube ahora, y mira hacia la mar. Y él subió, y miró, y dijo: No hay nada. Y él le volvió á decir: Vuelve siete veces.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down that the rain stop thee not.
verses.WEB: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a cloud out of the sea, as small as a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Make ready [thy chariot], and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E à sétima vez disse: Eu vejo uma pequena nuvem como a palma da mão de um homem, que sobe do mar. E ele disse: Vai, e dize a Acabe: Unge e desce, porque a chuva não te interrompa.
verses.RVR09: Y á la séptima vez dijo: Yo veo una pequeña nube como la palma de la mano de un hombre, que sube de la mar. Y él dijo: Ve, y di á Achâb: Unce y desciende, porque la lluvia no te ataje.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verses.WEB: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in a little while, that the heavens grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu, estando em isto, que os céus se escureceram com nuvens e vento; e houve uma grande chuva. E subindo Acabe, veio a Jezreel.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció, estando en esto, que los cielos se oscurecieron con nubes y viento; y hubo una gran lluvia. Y subiendo Achâb, vino á Jezreel.

verses.KJV: And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.ASV: and the hand of Jehovah was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a mão do SENHOR foi sobre Elias, o qual cingiu seus lombos, e veio correndo diante de Acabe até chegar a Jezreel.
verses.RVR09: Y la mano de Jehová fué sobre Elías, el cual ciñó sus lomos, y vino corriendo delante de Achâb hasta llegar á Jezreel.

verses.KJV: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
verses.WEB: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
verses.ASV: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Acabe deu a notícia a Jezabel de tudo o que Elias havia feito, de como havia matado à espada a todos os profetas.
verses.RVR09: Y ACHAB dió la nueva á Jezabel de todo lo que Elías había hecho, de como había muerto á cuchillo á todos los profetas.

verses.KJV: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
verses.WEB: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”
verses.ASV: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to-morrow about this time.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então enviou Jezabel a Elias um mensageiro, dizendo: Assim me façam os deuses, e assim me acrescentem, se amanhã a estas horas eu não haja posto tua pessoa como a de um deles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces envió Jezabel á Elías un mensajero, diciendo: Así me hagan los dioses, y así me añadan, si mañana á estas horas yo no haya puesto tu persona como la de uno de ellos.

verses.KJV: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
