verses.ALMEIDA: E Jorão, filho de Acabe, começou a reinar em Samaria sobre Israel o ano dezoito de Josafá rei de Judá; e reinou doze anos.
verses.RVR09: Y JORAM hijo de Achâb comenzó á reinar en Samaria sobre Israel el año dieciocho de Josaphat rey de Judá; y reinó doce años.

verses.KJV: And he wrought evil in the sight of the Lord; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
verses.WEB: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, but not like his father, and like his mother; for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, ainda que não como seu pai e sua mãe; porque tirou as estátuas de Baal que seu pai havia feito.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo en ojos de Jehová, aunque no como su padre y su madre; porque quitó las estatuas de Baal que su padre había hecho.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherewith he made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas achegou-se aos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, que fez pecar a Israel; e não se separou deles.
verses.RVR09: Mas allegóse á los pecados de Jeroboam, hijo de Nabat, que hizo pecar á Israel; y no se apartó de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
verses.WEB: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.
verses.ASV: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep-master; and he rendered unto the king of Israel the wool of a hundred thousand lambs, and of a hundred thousand rams.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Messa rei de Moabe era proprietário de gados, e pagava ao rei de Israel cem mil cordeiros e cem mil carneiros com suas lãs.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Mesa rey de Moab era propietario de ganados, y pagaba al rey de Israel cien mil corderos y cien mil carneros con sus vellones.

verses.KJV: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.WEB: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.ASV: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas morto Acabe, o rei de Moabe se rebelou contra o rei de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Mas muerto Achâb, el rey de Moab se rebeló contra el rey de Israel.

verses.KJV: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.
verses.WEB: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
verses.ASV: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu então de Samaria o rei Jorão, e inspecionou a todo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y salió entonces de Samaria el rey Joram, é inspeccionó á todo Israel.

verses.KJV: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.
verses.WEB: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
verses.ASV: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi e enviou a dizer a Josafá rei de Judá: O rei de Moabe se há rebelado contra mim: irás tu comigo à guerra contra Moabe? E ele respondeu: Irei, porque como eu, assim tu; como meu povo, assim teu povo; como meus cavalos, assim também teus cavalos.
verses.RVR09: Y fué y envió á decir á Josaphat rey de Judá: El rey de Moab se ha rebelado contra mí: ¿irás tú conmigo á la guerra contra Moab? Y él respondió: Iré, porque como yo, así tú; como mi pueblo, así tu pueblo; como mis caballos, así también tus caballos.

verses.KJV: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.
verses.WEB: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way of the wilderness of Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Por qual caminho iremos? E ele respondeu: Pelo caminho do deserto de Edom.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: ¿Por qué camino iremos? Y él respondió: Por el camino del desierto de Idumea.

verses.KJV: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.
verses.WEB: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.
verses.ASV: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom; and they made a circuit of seven days’ journey: and there was no water for the host, nor for the beasts that followed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Partiram, pois, o rei de Israel, e o rei de Judá, e o rei de Edom; e quando andaram rodeando pelo deserto sete dias de caminho, faltou-lhes a água para o exército, e para os animais que os seguiam.
verses.RVR09: Partieron pues el rey de Israel, y el rey de Judá, y el rey de Idumea; y como anduvieron rodeando por el desierto siete días de camino, faltóles el agua para el ejército, y para las bestias que los seguían.

verses.KJV: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the Lord hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!
verses.WEB: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
verses.ASV: And the king of Israel said, Alas! for Jehovah hath called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei de Israel disse: Ah! Que o SENHOR chamou estes três reis para entregá-los em mãos dos moabitas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey de Israel dijo: ¡Ah! que ha llamado Jehová estos tres reyes para entregarlos en manos de los Moabitas.

verses.KJV: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, that we may enquire of the Lord by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.
verses.WEB: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”
verses.ASV: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Jehovah, that we may inquire of Jehovah by him? And one of the king of Israel’s servants answered and said, Elisha the son of Shaphat is here, who poured water on the hands of Elijah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Josafá disse: Não há aqui profeta do SENHOR, para que consultemos ao SENHOR por ele? E um dos servos do rei de Israel respondeu e disse: Aqui está Eliseu filho de Safate, que dava água a mãos a Elias.
verses.RVR09: Mas Josaphat dijo: ¿No hay aquí profeta de Jehová, para que consultemos á Jehová por él? Y uno de los siervos del rey de Israel respondió y dijo: Aquí está Eliseo hijo de Saphat, que daba agua á manos á Elías.

verses.KJV: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the Lord is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.WEB: Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.ASV: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of Jehovah is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Josafá disse: Este terá palavra do SENHOR. E desceram a ele o rei de Israel, e Josafá, e o rei de Edom.
verses.RVR09: Y Josaphat dijo: Este tendrá palabra de Jehová. Y descendieron á él el rey de Israel, y Josaphat, y el rey de Idumea.

verses.KJV: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the Lord hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
verses.WEB: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
verses.ASV: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay; for Jehovah hath called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Eliseu disse ao rei de Israel: Que tenho eu contigo? Vai aos profetas de teu pai, e aos profetas de tua mãe. E o rei de Israel lhe respondeu: Não; porque juntou o SENHOR estes três reis para entregá-los em mãos dos moabitas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Eliseo dijo al rey de Israel: ¿Qué tengo yo contigo? Ve á los profetas de tu padre, y á los profetas de tu madre. Y el rey de Israel le respondió: No: porque ha juntado Jehová estos tres reyes para entregarlos en manos de los Moabitas.

verses.KJV: And Elisha said, As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
verses.WEB: Elisha said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.
verses.ASV: And Elisha said, As Jehovah of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eliseu disse: Vive o SENHOR dos exércitos, em cuja presença estou, que se não tivesse respeito ao rosto de Josafá rei de Judá, não olharia a ti, nem te veria.
verses.RVR09: Y Eliseo dijo: Vive Jehová de los ejércitos, en cuya presencia estoy, que si no tuviese respeto al rostro de Josaphat rey de Judá, no mirara á ti, ni te viera.

verses.KJV: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.
verses.WEB: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, the LORD’s hand came on him.
verses.ASV: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of Jehovah came upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora trazei-me um músico. E enquanto o músico tocava, a mão do SENHOR foi sobre Eliseu.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora traedme un tañedor. Y mientras el tañedor tocaba, la mano de Jehová fué sobre Eliseo.

verses.KJV: And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Make this valley full of ditches.
verses.WEB: He said, “The LORD says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’
verses.ASV: And he said, Thus saith Jehovah, Make this valley full of trenches.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Assim disse o SENHOR: Fazei neste vale muitas covas.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Así ha dicho Jehová: Haced en este valle muchas acequias.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, and ye shall drink, both ye and your cattle and your beasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR disse assim: Não vereis vento, nem vereis chuva, e este vale será cheio de água, e bebereis vós, e vossos animais, e vossos gados.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová ha dicho así: No veréis viento, ni veréis lluvia, y este valle será lleno de agua, y beberéis vosotros, y vuestras bestias, y vuestros ganados.

verses.KJV: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the Lord: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.
verses.WEB: This is an easy thing in the LORD’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
verses.ASV: And this is but a light thing in the sight of Jehovah: he will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto é coisa pouca aos olhos do SENHOR; dará também aos moabitas em vossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y esto es cosa ligera en los ojos de Jehová; dará también á los Moabitas en vuestras manos.

verses.KJV: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
verses.WEB: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”
verses.ASV: And ye shall smite every fortified city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all fountains of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós ferireis a toda cidade fortalecida e a toda vila bela, e cortareis toda boa árvore, e cegareis todas as fontes de águas, e destruireis com pedras toda terra fértil.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros heriréis á toda ciudad fortalecida y á toda villa hermosa, y talaréis todo buen árbol, y cegaréis todas las fuentes de aguas, y destruiréis con piedras toda tierra fértil.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
verses.WEB: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning, about the time of offering the oblation, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que pela manhã, quando se oferece o sacrifício, eis que vieram águas pelo caminho de Edom, e a terra foi cheia de águas.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que por la mañana, cuando se ofrece el sacrificio, he aquí vinieron aguas por el camino de Idumea, y la tierra fué llena de aguas.

verses.KJV: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.
verses.WEB: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.
verses.ASV: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all that were able to put on armor, and upward, and stood on the border.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os de Moabe, quando ouviram que os reis subiam a lutar contra eles, juntaram-se desde todos os que cingiam armas de guerra acima, e puseram-se na fronteira.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los de Moab, como oyeron que los reyes subían á pelear contra ellos, juntáronse desde todos los que ceñían talabarte arriba, y pusiéronse en la frontera.

verses.KJV: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:
verses.WEB: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.
verses.ASV: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water over against them as red as blood:
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se levantaram pela manhã, e luziu o sol sobre as águas, viram os de Moabe desde longe as águas vermelhas como sangue;
verses.RVR09: Y como se levantaron por la mañana, y lució el sol sobre las aguas, vieron los de Moab desde lejos las aguas rojas como sangre;

verses.KJV: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
verses.WEB: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”
verses.ASV: and they said, This is blood; the kings are surely destroyed, and they have smitten each man his fellow: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disseram: Sangue é este de espada! Os reis se revoltaram, e cada um matou a seu companheiro. Agora, pois, Moabe, à presa!
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron: ¡Sangre es esta de espada! Los reyes se han revuelto, y cada uno ha muerto á su compañero. Ahora pues, ¡Moab, á la presa!

verses.KJV: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.
verses.WEB: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.
verses.ASV: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land smiting the Moabites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando chegaram ao campo de Israel, levantaram-se os israelitas e feriram aos de Moabe, os quais fugiram diante deles; seguiram, porém, ferindo aos de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando llegaron al campo de Israel, levantáronse los Israelitas é hirieron á los de Moab, los cuales huyeron delante de ellos: siguieron empero hiriendo todavía á los de Moab.

verses.KJV: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.
verses.WEB: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.
verses.ASV: And they beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land they cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the fountains of water, and felled all the good trees, until in Kir-hareseth [only] they left the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assolaram as cidades, e em todas as propriedades férteis lançou cada um sua pedra, e as encheram; fecharam também todas as fontes das águas, e derrubaram todas as boas árvores; até que em Quir-Haresete somente deixaram suas pedras; porque os atiradores de funda a cercaram e a feriram.
verses.RVR09: Y asolaron las ciudades, y en todas las heredades fértiles echó cada uno su piedra, y las llenaron; cegaron también todas las fuentes de las aguas, y derribaron todos los buenos árboles; hasta que en Kir-hareseth solamente dejaron sus piedras; porque los honderos la cercaron, y la hirieron.

verses.KJV: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.
verses.WEB: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.
verses.ASV: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew sword, to break through unto the king of Edom; but they could not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o rei de Moabe viu que a batalha o vencia, tomou consigo setecentos homens que tiravam espada, para romper contra o rei de Edom, mas não conseguiram.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando el rey de Moab vió que la batalla lo vencía, tomó consigo setecientos hombres que sacaban espada, para romper contra el rey de Idumea: mas no pudieron.

verses.KJV: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
verses.WEB: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
verses.ASV: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt-offering upon the wall. And there was great wrath against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então arrebatou a seu primogênito que havia de reinar em seu lugar, e sacrificou-lhe em holocausto sobre o muro. E havia grande ira em Israel; e retiraram-se dele, e voltaram a sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces arrebató á su primogénito que había de reinar en su lugar, y sacrificóle en holocausto sobre el muro. Y hubo grande enojo en Israel; y retiráronse de él, y volviéronse á su tierra.

verses.KJV: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the Lord: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
verses.WEB: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared the LORD. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”
verses.ASV: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear Jehovah: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two children to be bondmen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma mulher, das mulheres dos filhos dos profetas, clamou a Eliseu, dizendo: Teu servo, meu marido, é morto; e tu sabes que teu servo era temeroso ao SENHOR; e veio o credor para tomar-se dois filhos meus por servos.
verses.RVR09: UNA mujer, de las mujeres de los hijos de los profetas, clamó á Eliseo, diciendo: Tu siervo mi marido es muerto; y tú sabes que tu siervo era temeroso de Jehová: y ha venido el acreedor para tomarse dos hijos míos por siervos.

verses.KJV: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
verses.WEB: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”
verses.ASV: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me; what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thy handmaid hath not anything in the house, save a pot of oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eliseu lhe disse: que te farei eu? Declara-me o que tens em casa. E ela disse: Tua serva nenhuma coisa tem em casa, a não ser uma botija de azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y Eliseo le dijo: ¿Qué te haré yo? Declárame qué tienes en casa. Y ella dijo: Tu sierva ninguna cosa tiene en casa, sino una botija de aceite.

verses.KJV: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
verses.WEB: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.
verses.ASV: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbors, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Vai, e pede para ti vasos emprestados de todos teus vizinhos, vasos vazios, não poucos.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Ve, y pide para ti vasos prestados de todos tus vecinos, vasos vacíos, no pocos.

verses.KJV: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
verses.WEB: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”
verses.ASV: And thou shalt go in, and shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and pour out into all those vessels; and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entra logo, e fecha a porta atrás de ti e atrás teus filhos; e deita em todos os vasos, e em estando um cheio, põe-o à parte.
verses.RVR09: Entra luego, y cierra la puerta tras ti y tras tus hijos; y echa en todos los vasos, y en estando uno lleno, ponlo aparte.

verses.KJV: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
verses.WEB: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.
verses.ASV: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons; they brought [the vessels] to her, and she poured out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E partiu-se a mulher dele, e fechou a porta atrás si e atrás seus filhos; e eles lhe traziam os vasos, e ela deitava do azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y partióse la mujer de él, y cerró la puerta tras sí y tras sus hijos; y ellos le llegaban los vasos, y ella echaba del aceite.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
verses.WEB: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os vasos foram cheios, disse a um filho seu: Traze-me ainda outro vaso. E ele disse: Não há mais vasos. Então cessou o azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y como los vasos fueron llenos, dijo á un hijo suyo: Tráeme aún otro vaso. Y él dijo: No hay más vasos. Entonces cesó el aceite.

verses.KJV: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
verses.WEB: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”
verses.ASV: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy sons of the rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio ela logo, e contou-o ao homem de Deus, o qual disse: Vai, e vende o azeite, e paga a teus credores; e tu e teus filhos vivei do que restar.
verses.RVR09: Vino ella luego, y contólo al varón de Dios, el cual dijo: Ve, y vende el aceite, y paga á tus acreedores; y tú y tus hijos vivid de lo que quedare.

verses.KJV: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
verses.WEB: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.
verses.ASV: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu também que um dia passava Eliseu por Suném; e havia ali uma mulher rica, a qual lhe constrangeu a que comesse do pão; e quando por ali passava, vinha-se à sua casa a comer do pão.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció también que un día pasaba Eliseo por Sunem; y había allí una mujer principal, la cual le constriñó á que comiese del pan: y cuando por allí pasaba, veníase á su casa á comer del pan.

verses.KJV: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.
verses.WEB: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.
verses.ASV: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God, that passeth by us continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse a seu marido: Eis que agora, eu entendo que este que sempre passa por nossa casa, é homem de Deus santo.
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo á su marido: He aquí ahora, yo entiendo que éste que siempre pasa por nuestra casa, es varón de Dios santo.

verses.KJV: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verses.WEB: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”
verses.ASV: Let us make, I pray thee, a little chamber on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a seat, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te rogo que faças uma pequena câmara de paredes, e ponhamos nela cama, e mesa, e cadeira, e candelabro, para que quando vier a nós, se recolha nela.
verses.RVR09: Yo te ruego que hagas una pequeña cámara de paredes, y pongamos en ella cama, y mesa, y silla, y candelero, para que cuando viniere á nosotros, se recoja en ella.

verses.KJV: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
verses.WEB: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.
verses.ASV: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber and lay there.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que um dia veio ele por ali, e recolheu-se naquela câmara, e dormiu nela.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que un día vino él por allí, y recogióse en aquella cámara, y durmió en ella.

verses.KJV: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.WEB: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.ASV: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse a Geazi seu criado: Chama a esta sunamita. E quando ele a chamou, ela se apresentou diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo á Giezi su criado: Llama á esta Sunamita. Y como él la llamó, pareció ella delante de él.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ele a Geazi: Dize-lhe: Eis que tu tens sido prestativa por nós com todo este esmero: que queres que eu faça por ti? Tens necessidade que fale por ti ao rei, ou ao general do exército? E ela respondeu: Eu habito em meio de meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo él á Giezi: Dile: He aquí tú has estado solícita por nosotros con todo este esmero: ¿qué quieres que haga por ti? ¿has menester que hable por ti al rey, ó al general del ejército? Y ella respondió: Yo habito en medio de mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
verses.WEB: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”
verses.ASV: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no son, and her husband is old.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Que, pois, faremos por ela? E Geazi respondeu: Eis que ela não tem filho, e seu marido é velho.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: ¿Qué pues haremos por ella? Y Giezi respondió: He aquí ella no tiene hijo, y su marido es viejo.

verses.KJV: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.WEB: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.ASV: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse então: Chama-a. E ele a chamou, e ela se parou à porta.
verses.RVR09: Dijo entonces: Llámala. Y él la llamó, y ella se paró á la puerta.

verses.KJV: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
verses.WEB: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”
verses.ASV: And he said, At this season, when the time cometh round, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thy handmaid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: A este tempo segundo o tempo da vida, abraçarás um filho. E ela disse: Não, senhor meu, homem de Deus, não mintas para tua serva.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: A este tiempo según el tiempo de la vida, abrazarás un hijo. Y ella dijo: No, señor mío, varón de Dios, no hagas burla de tu sierva.

verses.KJV: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
verses.WEB: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.
verses.ASV: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season, when the time came round, as Elisha had said unto her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a mulher concebeu, e pariu um filho a aquele tempo que Eliseu lhe havia dito, segundo o tempo da vida.
verses.RVR09: Mas la mujer concibió, y parió un hijo á aquel tiempo que Eliseo le había dicho, según el tiempo de la vida.

verses.KJV: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.WEB: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.ASV: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o menino foi grande, aconteceu que um dia saiu a seu pai, aos ceifeiros.
verses.RVR09: Y como el niño fué grande, aconteció que un día salió á su padre, á los segadores.

verses.KJV: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
verses.WEB: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to his servant, Carry him to his mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a seu pai: Minha cabeça, minha cabeça! E ele disse a um criado: Leva-o a sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo á su padre: ¡Mi cabeza, mi cabeza! Y él dijo á un criado: Llévalo á su madre.

verses.KJV: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
verses.WEB: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.
verses.ASV: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havendo-lhe ele tomado, e trazido-o a sua mãe, esteve sentado sobre seus joelhos até meio dia, e morreu-se.
verses.RVR09: Y habiéndole él tomado, y traídolo á su madre, estuvo sentado sobre sus rodillas hasta medio día, y murióse.

verses.KJV: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
verses.WEB: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.
verses.ASV: And she went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut [the door] upon him, and went out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela então subiu, e o pôs sobre a cama do homem de Deus, e fechando-lhe a porta, saiu-se.
verses.RVR09: Ella entonces subió, y púsolo sobre la cama del varón de Dios, y cerrándole la puerta, salióse.

verses.KJV: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
verses.WEB: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”
verses.ASV: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the servants, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamando logo a seu marido, disse-lhe: Rogo-te que envies comigo a algum dos criados e uma das asnas, para que eu vá correndo ao homem de Deus, e volte.
verses.RVR09: Llamando luego á su marido, díjole: Ruégote que envíes conmigo á alguno de los criados y una de las asnas, para que yo vaya corriendo al varón de Dios, y vuelva.

verses.KJV: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
verses.WEB: He said, “Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath.” She said, “It’s all right.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to-day? it is neither new moon nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Para que hás de ir a ele hoje? Não é nova lua, nem sábado. E ela respondeu: Paz.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: ¿Para qué has de ir á él hoy? No es nueva luna, ni sábado. Y ella respondió: Paz.

verses.KJV: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
verses.WEB: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”
verses.ASV: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slacken me not the riding, except I bid thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois fez preparar uma jumenta, e disse ao jovem: Guia e anda; e não me faças deter para que suba, a não ser quando eu te disser.
verses.RVR09: Después hizo enalbardar una borrica, y dijo al mozo: Guía y anda; y no me hagas detener para que suba, sino cuando yo te lo dijere.

verses.KJV: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
verses.WEB: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.
verses.ASV: So she went, and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is the Shunammite:
verses.ALMEIDA: Partiu-se, pois, e veio ao homem de Deus ao monte do Carmelo. E quando o homem de Deus a viu de longe, disse a seu criado Geazi: Eis que a sunamita:
verses.RVR09: Partióse pues, y vino al varón de Dios al monte del Carmelo. Y cuando el varón de Dios la vió de lejos, dijo á su criado Giezi: He aquí la Sunamita:

verses.KJV: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well:
verses.WEB: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”
verses.ASV: run, I pray thee, now to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rogo-te que vás agora correndo a recebê-la, e dize-lhe: Há paz contigo, com teu marido, e com teu filho? E ela disse: Paz.
verses.RVR09: Ruégote que vayas ahora corriendo á recibirla, y dile: ¿Tienes paz? ¿y tu marido, y tu hijo? Y ella dijo: Paz.

verses.KJV: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the Lord hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
verses.WEB: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and the LORD has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”
verses.ASV: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. And Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, Let her alone: for her soul is vexed within her; and Jehovah hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que chegou ao homem de Deus no monte, pegou seus pés. E chegou-se Geazi para tirá-la; mas o homem de Deus lhe disse: Deixa-a, porque sua alma está em amargura, e o SENHOR me encobriu o motivo, e não me revelou.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que llegó al varón de Dios en el monte, asió de sus pies. Y llegóse Giezi para quitarla; mas el varón de Dios le dijo: Déjala, porque su alma está en amargura, y Jehová me ha encubierto el motivo, y no me lo ha revelado.

verses.KJV: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
verses.WEB: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”
verses.ASV: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela disse: Pedi eu filho a meu senhor? Não disse eu, que não me enganasses?
verses.RVR09: Y ella dijo: ¿Pedí yo hijo á mi señor? ¿No dije yo, que no me burlases?

verses.KJV: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
verses.WEB: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”
verses.ASV: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thy hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse ele a Geazi: Cinge teus lombos, e toma meu bordão em tua mão, e vai; e se alguém te encontrar, não o saúdes; e se alguém te saudar, não lhe respondas: e porás meu bordão sobre o rosto do menino.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo él á Giezi: Ciñe tus lomos, y toma mi bordón en tu mano, y ve; y si alguno te encontrare, no lo saludes; y si alguno te saludare, no le respondas: y pondrás mi bordón sobre el rostro del niño.

verses.KJV: And the mother of the child said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
verses.WEB: The child’s mother said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.
verses.ASV: And the mother of the child said, As Jehovah liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse a mãe do menino: Vive o SENHOR, e vive tua alma, que não te deixarei.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo la madre del niño: Vive Jehová, y vive tu alma, que no te dejaré.

verses.KJV: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
verses.WEB: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”
verses.ASV: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he returned to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele então se levantou, e seguiu-a. E Geazi havia ido diante deles, e havia posto o bordão sobre o rosto do menino, mas nem tinha voz nem sentido; e assim se havia voltado para encontrar a Eliseu; e declarou-o a ele, dizendo: O jovem não desperta.
verses.RVR09: El entonces se levantó, y siguióla. Y Giezi había ido delante de ellos, y había puesto el bordón sobre el rostro del niño, mas ni tenía voz ni sentido; y así se había vuelto para encontrar á Eliseo; y declaróselo, diciendo: El mozo no despierta.

verses.KJV: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
verses.WEB: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.
verses.ASV: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo Eliseu à casa, eis que o menino que estava estendido morto sobre sua cama.
verses.RVR09: Y venido Eliseo á la casa, he aquí el niño que estaba tendido muerto sobre su cama.

verses.KJV: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to the LORD.
verses.ASV: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entrando ele então, fechou a porta sobre ambos, e orou ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entrando él entonces, cerró la puerta sobre ambos, y oró á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
verses.WEB: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.
verses.ASV: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon him; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois subiu, e lançou-se sobre o menino, pondo sua boca sobre a boca dele, e seus olhos sobre seus olhos, e suas mãos sobre as mãos suas; assim se estendeu sobre ele, e aqueceu a carne do jovem.
verses.RVR09: Después subió, y echóse sobre el niño, poniendo su boca sobre la boca de él, y sus ojos sobre sus ojos, y sus manos sobre las manos suyas; así se tendió sobre él, y calentóse la carne del joven.

verses.KJV: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.WEB: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.ASV: Then he returned, and walked in the house once to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltando-se logo, andou pela casa a uma parte e a outra, e depois subiu, e estendeu-se sobre ele; e o jovem espirrou sete vezes, e abriu seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Volviéndose luego, paseóse por la casa á una parte y á otra, y después subió, y tendióse sobre él; y el joven estornudó siete veces, y abrió sus ojos.

verses.KJV: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
verses.WEB: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”
verses.ASV: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele chamou a Geazi, e disse-lhe: Chama a esta sunamita. E ele a chamou. E entrando ela, ele lhe disse: Toma teu filho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces llamó él á Giezi, y díjole: Llama á esta Sunamita. Y él la llamó. Y entrando ella, él le dijo: Toma tu hijo.

verses.KJV: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
verses.WEB: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.
verses.ASV: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; and she took up her son, and went out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim que ela entrou, lançou-se a seus pés, e inclinou-se a terra: depois tomou seu filho, e saiu-se.
verses.RVR09: Y así que ella entró, echóse á sus pies, é inclinóse á tierra: después tomó su hijo, y salióse.

verses.KJV: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
verses.WEB: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”
verses.ASV: And Elisha came again to Gilgal. And there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and boil pottage for the sons of the prophets.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eliseu se voltou a Gilgal. Havia então grande fome na terra. E os filhos dos profetas estavam com ele, pelo que disse a seu criado: Põe uma grande caçarola, e faze sopa para os filhos dos profetas.
verses.RVR09: Y Eliseo se volvió á Gilgal. Había entonces grande hambre en la tierra. Y los hijos de los profetas estaban con él, por lo que dijo á su criado: Pon una grande olla, y haz potaje para los hijos de los profetas.

verses.KJV: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
verses.WEB: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.
verses.ASV: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage; for they knew them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu um ao campo a colher ervas, e achou uma como parreira selvagem, e agarrou dela uma capa de frutos silvestres; e voltou, e cortou-as na caçarola da sopa: porque não sabia o que era.
verses.RVR09: Y salió uno al campo á coger hierbas, y halló una como parra montés, y cogió de ella una faldada de calabazas silvestres: y volvió, y cortólas en la olla del potaje: porque no sabía lo que era.

verses.KJV: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
verses.WEB: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.
verses.ASV: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Serviu depois para que comessem os homens; mas sucedeu que comendo eles daquele guisado, deram vozes, dizendo: Homem de Deus, há morte na caçarola! E não o puderam comer.
verses.RVR09: Echóse después para que comieran los hombres; pero sucedió que comiendo ellos de aquel guisado, dieron voces, diciendo: ¡Varón de Dios, la muerte en la olla! Y no lo pudieron comer.

verses.KJV: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.WEB: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
verses.ASV: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele então disse: Trazei farinha. E espalhou-a na caçarola, e disse: Dá de comer à gente. E não houve mais mal na caçarola.
verses.RVR09: El entonces dijo: Traed harina. Y esparcióla en la olla, y dijo: Echa de comer á la gente. Y no hubo más mal en la olla.

verses.KJV: And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
verses.WEB: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”
verses.ASV: And there came a man from Baal-shalishah, and brought the man of God bread of the first-fruits, twenty loaves of barley, and fresh ears of grain in his sack. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio então um homem de Baal-Salisa, o qual trouxe ao homem de Deus pães de primícias, vinte pães de cevada, e trigo novo em sua espiga. E ele disse: Da ao povo, para que comam.
verses.RVR09: Vino entonces un hombre de Baal-salisa, el cual trajo al varón de Dios panes de primicias, veinte panes de cebada, y trigo nuevo en su espiga. Y él dijo: Da á la gente para que coman.

verses.KJV: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the Lord, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
verses.WEB: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for the LORD says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”
verses.ASV: And his servant said, What, should I set this before a hundred men? But he said, Give the people, that they may eat; for thus saith Jehovah, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu seu servente: Como porei isto diante de cem homens? Mas ele voltou a dizer: Da ao povo para que comam, porque assim disse o SENHOR: Comerão, e sobrará.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió su sirviente: ¿Cómo he de poner esto delante de cien hombres? Mas él tornó á decir: Da á la gente para que coman, porque así ha dicho Jehová: Comerán, y sobrará.

verses.KJV: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.WEB: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to the LORD’s word.
verses.ASV: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele o pôs diante deles, e comeram, e sobrou-lhes, conforme a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él lo puso delante de ellos, y comieron, y sobróles, conforme á la palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the Lord had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
verses.WEB: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him the LORD had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.
verses.ASV: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him Jehovah had given victory unto Syria: he was also a mighty man of valor, [but he was] a leper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naamã, general do exército do rei da Síria, era grande homem diante de seu senhor, e em alta estima, porque por meio dele o SENHOR havia dado salvamento à Síria. Era este homem valente em extremo, mas leproso.
verses.RVR09: NAAMÁN, general del ejército del rey de Siria, era gran varón delante de su señor, y en alta estima, porque por medio de él había dado Jehová salvamento á la Siria. Era este hombre valeroso en extremo, pero leproso.

verses.KJV: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.
verses.WEB: The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl, and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
verses.ASV: And the Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maiden; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da Síria haviam saído tropas, e haviam levado cativa da terra de Israel uma menina; a qual servindo à mulher de Naamã,
verses.RVR09: Y de Siria habían salido cuadrillas, y habían llevado cautiva de la tierra de Israel una muchacha; la cual sirviendo á la mujer de Naamán,

verses.KJV: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
verses.WEB: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”
verses.ASV: And she said unto her mistress, Would that my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! then would he recover him of his leprosy.
verses.ALMEIDA: disse à sua senhora: Se meu senhor rogasse ao profeta que está em Samaria, ele o sararia de sua lepra.
verses.RVR09: Dijo á su señora: Si rogase mi señor al profeta que está en Samaria, él lo sanaría de su lepra.

verses.KJV: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.
verses.WEB: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, “The girl who is from the land of Israel said this.”
verses.ASV: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maiden that is of the land of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Naamã, vindo a seu senhor, declarou-o a ele, dizendo: Assim e assim disse uma menina que é da terra de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y entrando Naamán á su señor, declaróselo, diciendo: Así y así ha dicho una muchacha que es de la tierra de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
verses.WEB: The king of Syria said, “Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” He departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.
verses.ASV: And the king of Syria said, Go now, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand [pieces] of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe o rei da Síria: Anda, vai, e eu enviarei cartas ao rei de Israel. Partiu, pois, ele, levando consigo dez talentos de prata, e seis mil peças de ouro, e dez mudas de roupas.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole el rey de Siria: Anda, ve, y yo enviaré letras al rey de Israel. Partió pues él, llevando consigo diez talentos de plata, y seis mil piezas de oro, y diez mudas de vestidos.

verses.KJV: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
verses.WEB: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”
verses.ASV: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, And now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou também cartas para o rei de Israel, que diziam assim: Logo em chegando a ti estas cartas, sabe por elas que eu envio a ti meu servo Naamã, para que o sares de sua lepra.
verses.RVR09: Tomó también letras para el rey de Israel, que decían así: Luego en llegando á ti estas letras, sabe por ellas que yo envío á ti mi siervo Naamán, para que lo sanes de su lepra.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.
verses.WEB: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? but consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que o rei de Israel leu as cartas, rasgou suas roupas, e disse: Sou eu Deus, que mate e dê vida, para que este envie a mim a que sare um homem de sua lepra? Considerai agora, e vede como busca ocasião contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que el rey de Israel leyó las cartas, rasgó sus vestidos, y dijo: ¿Soy yo Dios, que mate y dé vida, para que éste envíe á mí á que sane un hombre de su lepra? Considerad ahora, y ved cómo busca ocasión contra mí.

verses.KJV: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
verses.WEB: It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, “Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.”
verses.ASV: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Eliseu, homem de Deus ouviu que o rei de Israel havia rasgado suas roupas, enviou a dizer ao rei: Por que rasgaste tuas vestes? Venha agora a mim, e saberá que há profeta em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y como Eliseo, varón de Dios oyó que el rey de Israel había rasgado sus vestidos, envió á decir al rey: ¿Por qué has rasgado tus vestidos? Venga ahora á mí, y sabrá que hay profeta en Israel.

verses.KJV: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
verses.WEB: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
verses.ASV: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio Naamã com seus cavalos e com seu carro, e parou-se às portas da casa de Eliseu.
verses.RVR09: Y vino Naamán con sus caballos y con su carro, y paróse á las puertas de la casa de Eliseo.

verses.KJV: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
verses.WEB: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.”
verses.ASV: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Eliseu lhe enviou um mensageiro, dizendo: Vai, e lava-te sete vezes no Jordão, e tua carne se te restaurará, e serás limpo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Eliseo le envió un mensajero, diciendo: Ve, y lávate siete veces en el Jordán, y tu carne se te restaurará, y serás limpio.

verses.KJV: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the Lord his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
verses.WEB: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’
verses.ASV: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of Jehovah his God, and wave his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Naamã se foi irritado, dizendo: Eis que eu dizia para mim: Sairá ele logo, e estando em pé invocará o nome do SENHOR seu Deus, e levantará sua mão, e tocará o lugar, e sarará a lepra.
verses.RVR09: Y Naamán se fué enojado, diciendo: He aquí yo decía para mí: Saldrá él luego, y estando en pie invocará el nombre de Jehová su Dios, y alzará su mano, y tocará el lugar, y sanará la lepra.

verses.KJV: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.WEB: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.ASV: Are not Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abana e Farpar, rios de Damasco, não são melhores que todas as águas de Israel? Se me lavar neles, não serei também limpo? E voltou-se, e foi-se irritado.
verses.RVR09: Abana y Pharphar, ríos de Damasco, ¿no son mejores que todas las aguas de Israel? Si me lavare en ellos, ¿no seré también limpio? Y volvióse, y fuése enojado.

verses.KJV: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
verses.WEB: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”
verses.ASV: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas seus criados se chegaram a ele, e falaram-lhe, dizendo: Pai meu, se o profeta te mandasse alguma grande coisa, não a farias? Quanto mais, dizendo-te: Lava-te, e serás limpo?
verses.RVR09: Mas sus criados se llegaron á él, y habláronle, diciendo: Padre mío, si el profeta te mandara alguna gran cosa, ¿no la hicieras? ¿cuánto más, diciéndote: Lávate, y serás limpio?

verses.KJV: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.WEB: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.ASV: Then went he down, and dipped [himself] seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele então desceu, e mergulhou sete vezes no Jordão, conforme a palavra do homem de Deus; e sua carne se restaurou como a carne de um menino, e foi limpo.
verses.RVR09: El entonces descendió, y zambullóse siete veces en el Jordán, conforme á la palabra del varón de Dios: y su carne se volvió como la carne de un niño, y fué limpio.

verses.KJV: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.
verses.WEB: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”
verses.ASV: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, Behold now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a present of thy servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou ao homem de Deus, ele e toda sua companhia, e pôs-se diante dele, e disse: Eis que agora conheço que não há Deus em toda a terra, a não ser em Israel. Rogo-te que recebas algum presente do teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió al varón de Dios, él y toda su compañía, y púsose delante de él, y dijo: He aquí ahora conozco que no hay Dios en toda la tierra, sino en Israel. Ruégote que recibas algún presente de tu siervo.

verses.KJV: But he said, As the Lord liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
verses.WEB: But he said, “As the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.
verses.ASV: But he said, As Jehovah liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele disse: Vive o SENHOR, diante do qual estou, que não o tomarei. E insistindo-lhe que tomasse, ele não quis.
verses.RVR09: Mas él dijo: Vive Jehová, delante del cual estoy, que no lo tomaré. E importunándole que tomase, él nunca quiso.

verses.KJV: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Naaman said, If not, yet, I pray thee, let there be given to thy servant two mules’ burden of earth; for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt-offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Naamã disse: Rogo-te, pois, não se dará a teu servo uma carga de um par de mulas desta terra? Porque de agora em diante teu servo não sacrificará holocausto nem sacrifício a outros deuses, a não ser ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Naamán dijo: Ruégote pues, ¿no se dará á tu siervo una carga de un par de acémilas de aquesta tierra? porque de aquí adelante tu siervo no sacrificará holocausto ni sacrificio á otros dioses, sino á Jehová.

verses.KJV: In this thing the Lord pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the Lord pardon thy servant in this thing.
verses.WEB: In this thing may the LORD pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may the LORD pardon your servant in this thing.”
verses.ASV: In this thing Jehovah pardon thy servant: when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, when I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, Jehovah pardon thy servant in this thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em isto perdoe o SENHOR a teu servo: que quando meu senhor entrar no templo de Rimom, e para adorar nele se apoiar sobre minha mão, se eu também me inclinar no templo de Rimom, se no templo de Rimom me inclino, o SENHOR perdoe nisto a teu servo.
verses.RVR09: En esto perdone Jehová á tu siervo: que cuando mi señor entrare en el templo de Rimmón, y para adorar en él se apoyare sobre mi mano, si yo también me inclinare en el templo de Rimmón, si en el templo de Rimmón me inclino, Jehová perdone en esto á tu siervo.

verses.KJV: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
verses.WEB: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.
verses.ASV: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: Vai em paz. Partiu-se, pois, dele, e caminhou como o espaço de uma milha.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Vete en paz. Partióse pues de él, y caminó como el espacio de una milla.

verses.KJV: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the Lord liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
verses.WEB: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought. As the LORD lives, I will run after him, and take something from him.”
verses.ASV: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: as Jehovah liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Geazi, criado de Eliseu o homem de Deus, disse entre si: Eis que meu senhor poupou a este sírio Naamã, não tomando de sua mão as coisas que havia trazido. Vive o SENHOR, que correrei eu atrás dele, e tomarei dele alguma coisa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Giezi, criado de Eliseo el varón de Dios, dijo entre sí: He aquí mi señor estorbó á este Siro Naamán, no tomando de su mano las cosas que había traído. Vive Jehová, que correré yo tras él, y tomaré de él alguna cosa.

verses.KJV: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
verses.WEB: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”
verses.ASV: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw one running after him, he alighted from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Geazi seguiu Naamã; e quando Naamã lhe viu que vinha correndo atrás dele, desceu do carro para receber-lhe, e disse: Vai bem?
verses.RVR09: Y siguió Giezi á Naamán: y como le vió Naamán que venía corriendo tras él, apeóse del carro para recibirle, y dijo: ¿Va bien?

verses.KJV: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
verses.WEB: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”
verses.ASV: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there are come to me from the hill-country of Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets; give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of raiment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele disse: Bem. Meu senhor me envia a dizer: Eis que vieram a mim nesta hora do monte de Efraim dois rapazes dos filhos dos profetas: rogo-te que lhes dês um talento de prata, e duas mudas de roupas.
verses.RVR09: Y él dijo: Bien. Mi señor me envía á decir: He aquí vinieron á mí en esta hora del monte de Ephraim dos mancebos de los hijos de los profetas: ruégote que les des un talento de plata, y sendas mudas de vestidos.

verses.KJV: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
verses.WEB: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.
verses.ASV: And Naaman said, Be pleased to take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of raiment, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Naamã disse: Rogo-te que tomes dois talentos. E ele lhe constrangeu, e atou dois talentos de prata em dois sacos, e duas mudas de roupas, e o pôs às costas a dois de seus criados, que o levassem diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Y Naamán dijo: Ruégote que tomes dos talentos. Y él le constriñó, y ató dos talentos de plata en dos sacos, y dos mudas de vestidos, y púsolo á cuestas á dos de sus criados, que lo llevasen delante de él.

verses.KJV: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.WEB: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.ASV: And when he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house; and he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegado que houve a um lugar secreto, ele o tomou da mão deles, e guardou-o em casa: logo mandou aos homens que se fossem.
verses.RVR09: Y llegado que hubo á un lugar secreto, él lo tomó de mano de ellos, y guardólo en casa: luego mandó á los hombres que se fuesen.

verses.KJV: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.
verses.WEB: But he went in, and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He said, “Your servant went nowhere.”
verses.ASV: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.
