verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo isso os altos não se tiraram; que ainda sacrificava e queimava o povo incenso nos altos.
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso los altos no se quitaron; que aun sacrificaba y quemaba el pueblo perfumes en los altos.

verses.KJV: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the Lord, even the money of every one that passeth the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man's heart to bring into the house of the Lord,
verses.WEB: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into the LORD’s house,
verses.ASV: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the hallowed things that is brought into the house of Jehovah, in current money, the money of the persons for whom each man is rated, and all the money that it cometh into any man’s heart to bring into the house of Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joás disse aos sacerdotes: Todo o dinheiro das santificações que se costuma trazer à casa do SENHOR, o dinheiro dos que passam no censo, o dinheiro pelas pessoas, cada qual segundo seu valor, e todo o dinheiro que cada um de sua própria vontade põe na casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Joas dijo á los sacerdotes: Todo el dinero de las santificaciones que se suele traer á la casa de Jehová, el dinero de los que pasan en cuenta, el dinero por las personas, cada cual según su tasa, y todo el dinero que cada uno de su propia voluntad mete en la casa de Jehová,

verses.KJV: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.
verses.WEB: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”
verses.ASV: let the priests take it to them, every man from his acquaintance; and they shall repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.
verses.ALMEIDA: Recebam-no os sacerdotes, cada um de seus familiares, e reparem as fendas do templo de onde quer que se achar abertura.
verses.RVR09: Recíbanlo los sacerdotes, cada uno de sus familiares, y reparen los portillos del templo donde quiera que se hallare abertura.

verses.KJV: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
verses.WEB: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.
verses.ASV: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o ano vinte e três do rei Joás, não haviam ainda reparado os sacerdotes as aberturas do templo.
verses.RVR09: Pero el año veintitrés del rey Joas, no habían aún reparado los sacerdotes las aberturas del templo.

verses.KJV: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
verses.WEB: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”
verses.ASV: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the [other] priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore take no [more] money from your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamando então o rei Joás ao sacerdote Joiada e aos sacerdotes, disse-lhes: Por que não reparais as aberturas do templo? Agora, pois, não tomeis mais o dinheiro de vossos familiares, mas sim dai-o para reparar as fendas do templo.
verses.RVR09: Llamando entonces el rey Joas al pontífice Joiada y á los sacerdotes, díjoles: ¿Por qué no reparáis las aberturas del templo? Ahora pues, no toméis más el dinero de vuestros familiares, sino dadlo para reparar las roturas del templo.

verses.KJV: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.
verses.WEB: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.
verses.ASV: And the priests consented that they should take no [more] money from the people, neither repair the breaches of the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os sacerdotes consentiram em não tomar mais dinheiro do povo, nem ter cargo de reparar as aberturas do templo.
verses.RVR09: Y los sacerdotes consintieron en no tomar más dinero del pueblo, ni tener cargo de reparar las aberturas del templo.

verses.KJV: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the Lord: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the LORD’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD’s house into it.
verses.ASV: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of Jehovah: and the priests that kept the threshold put therein all the money that was brought into the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o sacerdote Joiada tomou uma arca, e fez-lhe na tampa um furo, e a pôs junto ao altar, à direita quando se entra no templo do SENHOR; e os sacerdotes que guardavam a porta, punham ali todo o dinheiro que se metia na casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas el pontífice Joiada tomó un arca, é hízole en la tapa un agujero, y púsola junto al altar, á la mano derecha como se entra en el templo de Jehová; y los sacerdotes que guardaban la puerta, ponían allí todo el dinero que se metía en la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags and counted the money that was found in the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando viam que havia muito dinheiro no arca, vinha o notário do rei e o grande sacerdote, e contavam o dinheiro que achavam no templo do SENHOR, e guardavam-no.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando veían que había mucho dinero en el arca, venía el notario del rey y el gran sacerdote, y contaban el dinero que hallaban en el templo de Jehová, y guardábanlo.

verses.KJV: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the Lord: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the Lord,
verses.WEB: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the LORD’s house,
verses.ASV: And they gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of Jehovah: and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders, that wrought upon the house of Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E davam o dinheiro suficiente em mão dos que faziam a obra, e dos que tinham o cargo da casa do SENHOR; e eles o gastavam em pagar os carpinteiros e mestres que reparavam a casa do SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Y daban el dinero suficiente en mano de los que hacían la obra, y de los que tenían el cargo de la casa de Jehová; y ellos lo expendían en pagar los carpinteros y maestros que reparaban la casa de Jehová,

verses.KJV: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the Lord, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
verses.WEB: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the LORD’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
verses.ASV: and to the masons and the hewers of stone, and for buying timber and hewn stone to repair the breaches of the house of Jehovah, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os pedreiros e cortadores de pedras; e em comprar a madeira e pedra lavrada para reparar as aberturas da casa do SENHOR; e em tudo o que se gastava na casa para repará-la.
verses.RVR09: Y los albañiles y canteros; y en comprar la madera y piedra de cantería para reparar las aberturas de la casa de Jehová; y en todo lo que se gastaba en la casa para repararla.

verses.KJV: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the Lord bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the Lord:
verses.WEB: But there were not made for the LORD’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the LORD’s house;
verses.ASV: But there were not made for the house of Jehovah cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas daquele dinheiro que se trazia à casa do SENHOR, não se faziam bacias de prata, nem saltérios, nem bacias, nem trombetas; nem nenhum outro vaso de ouro nem de prata se fazia para o templo do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Mas de aquel dinero que se traía á la casa de Jehová, no se hacían tazas de plata, ni salterios, ni jofainas, ni trompetas; ni ningún otro vaso de oro ni de plata se hacía para el templo de Jehová:

verses.KJV: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired the LORD’s house with it.
verses.ASV: for they gave that to them that did the work, and repaired therewith the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o davam aos que faziam a obra, e com ele reparavam a casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque lo daban á los que hacían la obra, y con él reparaban la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
verses.WEB: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.
verses.ASV: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to give to them that did the work; for they dealt faithfully.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não se tomava em conta aos homens em cujas mãos o dinheiro era entregue, para que eles o dessem aos que faziam a obra: porque o faziam eles fielmente.
verses.RVR09: Y no se tomaba cuenta á los hombres en cuyas manos el dinero era entregado, para que ellos lo diesen á los que hacían la obra: porque lo hacían ellos fielmente.

verses.KJV: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the Lord: it was the priests'.
verses.WEB: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into the LORD’s house. It was the priests’.
verses.ASV: The money for the trespass-offerings, and the money for the sin-offerings, was not brought into the house of Jehovah: it was the priests’.
verses.ALMEIDA: O dinheiro pelo delito, e o dinheiro pelos pecados, não se metia na casa do SENHOR; porque era dos sacerdotes.
verses.RVR09: El dinero por el delito, y el dinero por los pecados, no se metía en la casa de Jehová; porque era de los sacerdotes.

verses.KJV: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então subiu Hazael rei da Síria, e lutou contra Gate, e tomou-a; e Hazael decidiu subir contra Jerusalém;
verses.RVR09: Entonces subió Hazael rey de Siria, y peleó contra Gath, y tomóla: y puso Hazael su rostro para subir contra Jerusalem;

verses.KJV: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and in the king's house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo que tomou Joás rei de Judá todas as ofertas que havia dedicado Josafá, e Jorão e Acazias seus pais, reis de Judá, e as que ele havia dedicado, e todo o ouro que se achou nos tesouros da casa do SENHOR, e na casa do rei, e enviou-o a Hazael, rei da Síria; e ele se partiu de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Por lo que tomó Joas rey de Judá todas las ofrendas que había dedicado Josaphat, y Joram y Ochôzías sus padres, reyes de Judá, y las que él había dedicado, y todo el oro que se halló en los tesoros de la casa de Jehová, y en la casa del rey, y enviólo á Hazael rey de Siria: y él se partió de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Joás, e todas as coisas que fez, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Joas, y todas las cosas que hizo, ¿no está escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Judá?

verses.KJV: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.
verses.WEB: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.
verses.ASV: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and smote Joash at the house of Millo, [on the way] that goeth down to Silla.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus servos se levantaram, fizeram uma conspiração, e mataram a Joás na casa de Milo, quando ele estava descendo a Sila;
verses.RVR09: Y levantáronse sus siervos, y conspiraron en conjuración, y mataron á Joas en la casa de Millo, descendiendo él á Silla;

verses.KJV: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Jozacar filho de Simeate, e Jozabade filho de Somer, seus servos, feriram-lhe, e ele morreu. E sepultaram-lhe com seus pais na cidade de Davi, e reinou em seu lugar Amasias seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Pues Josachâr hijo de Simaath, y Jozabad hijo de Somer, sus siervos, hiriéronle, y murió. Y sepultáronlo con sus padres en la ciudad de David, y reinó en su lugar Amasías su hijo.

verses.KJV: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.
verses.WEB: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.
verses.ASV: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, [and reigned] seventeen years.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano vinte e três de Joás filho de Acazias, rei de Judá, começou a reinar Jeoacaz filho de Jeú sobre Israel em Samaria; e reinou dezessete anos.
verses.RVR09: EN el año veintitrés de Joas hijo de Ochôzías, rey de Judá, comenzó á reinar Joachâz hijo de Jehú sobre Israel en Samaria; y reinó diecisiete años.

verses.KJV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.WEB: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherewith he made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e seguiu os pecados de Jeroboão filho de Nebate, o que fez pecar a Israel; e não se separou deles.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo en ojos de Jehová, y siguió los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, el que hizo pecar á Israel; y no se apartó de ellos.

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.
verses.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acendeu-se o furor do SENHOR contra Israel, e entregou-os em mão de Hazael rei da Síria, e em mão de Ben-Hadade filho de Hazael, por longo tempo.
verses.RVR09: Y encendióse el furor de Jehová contra Israel, y entrególos en mano de Hazael rey de Siria, y en mano de Ben-adad hijo de Hazael, por largo tiempo.

verses.KJV: And Jehoahaz besought the Lord, and the Lord hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
verses.WEB: Jehoahaz begged the LORD, and the LORD listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.
verses.ASV: And Jehoahaz besought Jehovah, and Jehovah hearkened unto him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how that the king of Syria oppressed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jeoacaz orou à face do SENHOR, e o SENHOR o ouviu: porque olhou a aflição de Israel, pois o rei da Síria os afligia.
verses.RVR09: Mas Joachâz oró á la faz de Jehová, y Jehová lo oyó: porque miró la aflicción de Israel, pues el rey de Siria los afligía.

verses.KJV: (And the Lord gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.
verses.WEB: (The LORD gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.
verses.ASV: (And Jehovah gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents as beforetime.
verses.ALMEIDA: (E deu o SENHOR salvador a Israel, e saíram de sob a mão dos sírios; e habitaram os filhos de Israel em suas moradas, como antes.
verses.RVR09: (Y dió Jehová salvador á Israel, y salieron de bajo la mano de los Siros; y habitaron los hijos de Israel en sus estancias, como antes.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)
verses.WEB: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)
verses.ASV: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, wherewith he made Israel to sin, but walked therein: and there remained the Asherah also in Samaria.)
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo isso não se apartaram dos pecados da casa de Jeroboão, o que fez pecar a Israel: neles andaram; e também o bosque permaneceu em Samaria.)
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso no se apartaron de los pecados de la casa de Jeroboam, el que hizo pecar á Israel: en ellos anduvieron; y también el bosque permaneció en Samaria.)

verses.KJV: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.
verses.WEB: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.
verses.ASV: For he left not to Jehoahaz of the people save fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them, and made them like the dust in threshing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não lhe havia restado gente a Jeoacaz, a não ser cinquenta cavaleiros, e dez carros, e dez mil homens a pé; pois o rei da Síria os havia destruído, e os havia posto como pó para pisar.
verses.RVR09: Porque no le había quedado gente á Joachâz, sino cincuenta hombres de á caballo, y diez carros, y diez mil hombres de á pié; pues el rey de Siria los había destruído, y los había puesto como polvo para hollar.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Jeoacaz, e tudo o que fez, e suas valentias, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Joachâz, y todo lo que hizo, y sus valentías, ¿no está escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Israel?

verses.KJV: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descansou Jeoacaz com seus pais, e sepultaram-no em Samaria: e reinou em seu lugar Joás seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió Joachâz con sus padres, y sepultáronlo en Samaria: y reinó en su lugar Joas su hijo.

verses.KJV: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.
verses.WEB: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.
verses.ASV: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, [and reigned] sixteen years.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ano trinta e sete de Joás rei de Judá, começou a reinar Joás filho de Jeoacaz sobre Israel em Samaria; e reinou dezesseis anos.
verses.RVR09: El año treinta y siete de Joas rey de Judá, comenzó á reinar Joas hijo de Joachâz sobre Israel en Samaria; y reinó dieciséis años.

verses.KJV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.
verses.WEB: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherewith he made Israel to sin; but he walked therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR: não se separou de todos os pecados de Jeroboão filho de Nebate, o que fez pecar a Israel; neles andou.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo en ojos de Jehová: no se apartó de todos los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, el que hizo pecar á Israel; en ellos anduvo.

verses.KJV: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Joás, e todas as coisas que fez, e seu esforço com que guerreou contra Amasias rei de Judá, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Joas, y todas las cosas que hizo, y su esfuerzo con que guerreó contra Amasías rey de Judá, ¿no está escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Israel?

verses.KJV: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.WEB: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dormiu Joás com seus pais, e sentou-se Jeroboão sobre seu trono: e Joás foi sepultado em Samaria com os reis de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió Joas con sus padres, y sentóse Jeroboam sobre su trono: y Joas fué sepultado en Samaria con los reyes de Israel.

verses.KJV: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.
verses.WEB: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”
verses.ASV: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died: and Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over him, and said, My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and the horsemen thereof!
verses.ALMEIDA: Estava Eliseu enfermo daquela sua enfermidade de que morreu. E desceu a ele Joás rei de Israel, e chorando diante dele, disse: Meu pai, meu pai, carro de Israel e seus cavaleiros!
verses.RVR09: Estaba Eliseo enfermo de aquella su enfermedad de que murió. Y descendió á él Joas rey de Israel, y llorando delante de él, dijo: ¡Padre mío, padre mío, carro de Israel y su gente de á caballo!

verses.KJV: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
verses.WEB: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.
verses.ASV: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows; and he took unto him bow and arrows.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhe Eliseu: Toma um arco e umas flechas. Tomou ele então um arco e umas flechas.
verses.RVR09: Y díjole Eliseo: Toma un arco y unas saetas. Tomóse él entonces un arco y unas saetas.

verses.KJV: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king's hands.
verses.WEB: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.
verses.ASV: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thy hand upon the bow; and he put his hand [upon it]. And Elisha laid his hands upon the king’s hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Eliseu ao rei de Israel: Põe tua mão sobre o arco. E pôs ele sua mão sobre o arco. Então pôs Eliseu suas mãos sobre as mãos do rei,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Eliseo al rey de Israel: Pon tu mano sobre el arco. Y puso él su mano sobre el arco. Entonces puso Eliseo sus manos sobre las manos del rey,

verses.KJV: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the Lord's deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
verses.WEB: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “The LORD’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Open the window eastward; and he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot; and he shot. And he said, Jehovah’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Abre a janela de até o oriente. E quando ele a abriu disse Eliseu: Atira. E atirando ele, disse Eliseu: Flecha de salvação do SENHOR, e flecha de salvação contra Síria: porque ferirás aos sírios em Afeque, até consumi-los.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Abre la ventana de hacia el oriente. Y como él la abrió dijo Eliseo: Tira. Y tirando él, dijo Eliseo: Saeta de salud de Jehová, y saeta de salud contra Siria: porque herirás á los Siros en Aphec, hasta consumirlos.

verses.KJV: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.
verses.WEB: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.
verses.ASV: And he said, Take the arrows; and he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground; and he smote thrice, and stayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou-lhe a dizer: Toma as flechas. E logo que o rei de Israel as tomou, disse-lhe: Fere a terra. E ele feriu três vezes, e cessou.
verses.RVR09: Y tornóle á decir: Toma las saetas. Y luego que el rey de Israel las hubo tomado, díjole: Hiere la tierra. Y él hirió tres veces, y cesó.

verses.KJV: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.
verses.WEB: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”
verses.ASV: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times: then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it; whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o homem de Deus, irou-se com ele, lhe disse: A ferir cinco ou seis vezes, feririas a Síria, até não restar ninguém: porém agora três vezes ferirás a Síria.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el varón de Dios, enojado con él, le dijo: A herir cinco ó seis veces, herirías á Siria, hasta no quedar ninguno: empero ahora tres veces herirás á Siria.

verses.KJV: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
verses.WEB: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
verses.ASV: And Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Eliseu, e sepultaram-no. Entrado o ano vieram tropas de moabitas à terra.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Eliseo, y sepultáronlo. Entrado el año vinieron partidas de Moabitas á la tierra.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
verses.WEB: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and as soon as the man touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que ao sepultar uns um homem, subitamente viram uma tropa, e lançaram ao homem no sepulcro de Eliseu: e quando o morto chegou a tocar os ossos de Eliseu, reviveu, e levantou-se sobre seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que al sepultar unos un hombre, súbitamente vieron una partida, y arrojaron al hombre en el sepulcro de Eliseo: y cuando llegó á tocar el muerto los huesos de Eliseo, revivió, y levantóse sobre sus pies.

verses.KJV: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.WEB: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.ASV: And Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.ALMEIDA: Hazael, pois, rei da Síria, afligiu a Israel todo o tempo de Jeoacaz.
verses.RVR09: Hazael pues, rey de Siria, afligió á Israel todo el tiempo de Joachâz.

verses.KJV: And the Lord was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
verses.WEB: But the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR teve misericórdia deles, e compadeceu-se deles, e olhou-os, por amor de seu pacto com Abraão, Isaque e Jacó; e não quis destruí-los nem lançá-los de diante de si até agora.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová tuvo misericordia de ellos, y compadecióse de ellos, y mirólos, por amor de su pacto con Abraham, Isaac y Jacob; y no quiso destruirlos ni echarlos de delante de sí hasta ahora.

verses.KJV: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Hazael rei da Síria, e reinou em seu lugar Ben-Hadade seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Hazael rey de Siria, y reinó en su lugar Ben-adad su hijo.

verses.KJV: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
verses.WEB: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash smite him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou Joás filho de Jeoacaz, e tomou da mão de Ben-Hadade filho de Hazael, as cidades que ele havia tomado da mão de Jeoacaz seu pai em guerra. Três vezes o bateu Joás, e restituiu as cidades a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió Joas hijo de Joachâz, y tomó de mano de Ben-adad hijo de Hazael, las ciudades que él había tomado de mano de Joachâz su padre en guerra. Tres veces lo batió Joas, y restituyó las ciudades á Israel.

verses.KJV: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
verses.WEB: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.
verses.ASV: In the second year of Joash son of Joahaz king of Israel began Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah to reign.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano segundo de Joás filho de Jeoacaz rei de Israel, começou a reinar Amazias filho de Joás rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: EN el año segundo de Joas hijo de Joachâz rey de Israel, comenzó á reinar Amasías hijo de Joas rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando começou a reinar era de vinte e cinco anos, e reinou vinte e nove anos em Jerusalém: o nome de sua mãe foi Jeoadã, de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Cuando comenzó á reinar era de veinticinco años, y veintinueve años reinó en Jerusalem: el nombre de su madre fué Joaddan, de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
verses.WEB: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, yet not like David his father: he did according to all that Joash his father had done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele fez o que era correto aos olhos do SENHOR, ainda que não como Davi seu pai: fez conforme a todas as coisas que havia feito Joás seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y él hizo lo recto en ojos de Jehová, aunque no como David su padre: hizo conforme á todas las cosas que había hecho Joas su padre.

verses.KJV: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.
verses.WEB: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
verses.ASV: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo isso os altos não foram tirados; que o povo ainda sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altos.
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso los altos no fueron quitados; que el pueblo aun sacrificaba y quemaba perfumes en los altos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.
verses.WEB: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, that he slew his servants who had slain the king his father:
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que o reino foi confirmado em sua mão, feriu a seus servos, os que haviam matado ao rei seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que el reino fué confirmado en su mano, hirió á sus siervos, los que habían muerto al rey su padre.

verses.KJV: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
verses.WEB: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”
verses.ASV: but the children of the murderers he put not to death; according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as Jehovah commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não matou aos filhos dos que lhe mataram, conforme o que está escrito no livro da lei de Moisés, de onde o SENHOR mandou, dizendo: Não matarão aos pais pelos filhos, nem aos filhos pelos pais: mas cada um morrerá por seu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Mas no mató á los hijos de los que le mataron, conforme á lo que está escrito en el libro de la ley de Moisés, donde Jehová mandó, diciendo: No matarán á los padres por los hijos, ni á los hijos por los padres: mas cada uno morirá por su pecado.

verses.KJV: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
verses.WEB: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.
verses.ASV: He slew of Edom in the Valley of Salt ten thousand, and took Sela by war, and called the name of it Joktheel, unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este feriu também dez mil edomitas no vale das salinas, e tomou a Selá por guerra, e chamou-a Jocteel, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Este hirió asimismo diez mil Idumeos en el valle de las Salinas, y tomó á Sela por guerra, y llamóla Jocteel, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
verses.WEB: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”
verses.ASV: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Amazias enviou embaixadores a Joás, filho de Jeoacaz filho de Jeú, rei de Israel, dizendo: Vem, e vejamo-nos face a face.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Amasías envió embajadores á Joas, hijo de Joachâz hijo de Jehú, rey de Israel, diciendo: Ven, y veámonos de rostro.

verses.KJV: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.WEB: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.
verses.ASV: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trod down the thistle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joás rei de Israel enviou a Amazias rei de Judá esta resposta: O cardo que está no Líbano enviou a dizer ao cedro que está no Líbano: Da tua filha por mulher a meu filho. E passaram os animais selvagens que estão no Líbano, e pisaram o cardo.
verses.RVR09: Y Joas rey de Israel envió á Amasías rey de Judá esta respuesta: El cardillo que está en el Líbano envió á decir al cedro que está en el Líbano: Da tu hija por mujer á mi hijo. Y pasaron las bestias fieras que están en el Líbano, y hollaron el cardillo.

verses.KJV: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
verses.WEB: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”
verses.ASV: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thy heart hath lifted thee up: glory thereof, and abide at home; for why shouldest thou meddle to [thy] hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente feriste a Edom, e teu coração te envaideceu: gloria-te, pois, mas fica-te em tua casa. E por que te intrometerás em um mal, para que caias tu, e Judá contigo?

verses.RVR09: Mas Amasías no dió oídos; por lo que subió Joas rey de Israel, y viéronse de rostro él y Amasías rey de Judá, en Beth-semes, que es de Judá.

verses.RVR09: Y Judá cayó delante de Israel, y huyeron cada uno á sus estancias.

verses.KJV: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Bethshemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

verses.KJV: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou todo o ouro e a prata, e todos os vasos que foram achados na casa do SENHOR, e nos tesouros da casa do rei, e os filhos em reféns, e voltou-se a Samaria.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó todo el oro y la plata, y todos los vasos que fueron hallados en la casa de Jehová, y en los tesoros de la casa del rey, y los hijos en rehenes, y volvióse á Samaria.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Joás que executou, e suas façanhas, e como lutou contra Amasias rei de Judá, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?

verses.WEB: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.WEB: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.
verses.ASV: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Amazias, filho de Joás, rei de Judá, viveu depois da morte de Joás filho de Jeoacaz rei de Israel, quinze anos.
verses.RVR09: Y Amasías hijo de Joas rey de Judá, vivió después de la muerte de Joas hijo de Joachâz rey de Israel, quince años.

verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Amasías, ¿no está escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Judá?

verses.KJV: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.
verses.WEB: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

verses.RVR09: E hicieron conspiración contra él en Jerusalem, y él huyó á Lachîs; mas enviaron tras él á Lachîs, y allá lo mataron.

verses.KJV: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.WEB: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

verses.KJV: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
verses.WEB: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.
verses.ASV: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todo o povo de Judá tomou a Azarias, que era de dezesseis anos, e fizeram-no rei em lugar de Amasias seu pai.
verses.RVR09: Entonces todo el pueblo de Judá tomó á Azarías, que era de diez y seis años, é hiciéronlo rey en lugar de Amasías su padre.

verses.KJV: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.WEB: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.ASV: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele edificou Elate, e a restituiu a Judá, depois que o rei descansou com seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Edificó él á Elath, y la restituyó á Judá, después que el rey durmió con sus padres.

verses.KJV: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.
verses.WEB: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.
verses.ASV: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, [and reigned] forty and one years.

verses.RVR09: El año quince de Amasías hijo de Joas rey de Judá, comenzó á reinar Jeroboam hijo de Joas sobre Israel en Samaria; y reinó cuarenta y un años.

verses.KJV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.WEB: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherewith he made Israel to sin.

verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo en ojos de Jehová, y no se apartó de todos los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, el que hizo pecar á Israel.

verses.KJV: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gathhepher.
verses.WEB: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the LORD, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.
verses.ASV: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath unto the sea of the Arabah, according to the word of Jehovah, the God of Israel, which he spake by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was of Gath-hepher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele restituiu os termos de Israel desde a entrada de Hamate até o mar da planície, conforme à palavra do SENHOR Deus de Israel, a qual havia ele falado por seu servo Jonas filho de Amitai, profeta que foi de Gate-Hefer.
verses.RVR09: El restituyó los términos de Israel desde la entrada de Amath hasta la mar de la llanura, conforme á la palabra de Jehová Dios de Israel, la cual había él hablado por su siervo Jonás hijo de Amittai, profeta que fué de Gath-hepher.

verses.KJV: For the Lord saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.
verses.WEB: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter; for there was none shut up nor left at large, neither was there any helper for Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porquanto o SENHOR olhou a muito amarga aflição de Israel; que não havia escravo nem livre, nem quem desse ajuda a Israel;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto Jehová miró la muy amarga aflicción de Israel; que no había guardado ni desamparado, ni quien diese ayuda á Israel;

verses.KJV: And the Lord said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.WEB: The LORD didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR não havia determinado apagar o nome de Israel de debaixo do céu: portanto, os salvou por mão de Jeroboão filho de Joás.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová no había determinado raer el nombre de Israel de debajo del cielo: por tanto, los salvó por mano de Jeroboam hijo de Joas.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, [which had belonged] to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o demais dos feitos de Jeroboão, e todas as coisas que fez, e sua valentia, e todas as guerras que fez, e como restituiu a Judá em Israel a Damasco e a Hamate, não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Y lo demás de los hechos de Jeroboam, y todas las cosas que hizo, y su valentía, y todas las guerras que hizo, y cómo restituyó á Judá en Israel á Damasco y á Hamath, ¿no está escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Israel?

verses.KJV: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.ASV: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano vinte e sete de Jeroboão, rei de Israel, começou a reinar Azarias, filho de Amazias, rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: EN el año veintisiete de Jeroboam, rey de Israel, comenzó á reinar Azarías hijo de Amasías rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

verses.ASV: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando começou a reinar tinha dezesseis anos, e reinou cinquenta e dois anos em Jerusalém; o nome de sua mãe foi Jecolias, de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Cuando comenzó á reinar era de dieciséis años, y cincuenta y dos años reinó en Jerusalem; el nombre de su madre fué Jecolía, de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;
verses.WEB: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o que era correto aos olhos do SENHOR, conforme todas as coisas que seu pai Amazias havia feito.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo recto en ojos de Jehová, conforme á todas las cosas que su padre Amasías había hecho.

verses.KJV: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
verses.WEB: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
verses.ASV: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo, os altos não foram tirados; pois o povo ainda sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altos.
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso los altos no se quitaron; que el pueblo sacrificaba aún y quemaba perfumes en los altos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king's son was over the house, judging the people of the land.
verses.WEB: The LORD struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.

verses.ASV: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

verses.RVR09: En el año treinta y ocho de Azarías rey de Judá, reinó Zachârías hijo de Jeroboam sobre Israel seis meses.

verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, como seus ancestrais haviam feito; ele não se afastou dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, o que fez pecar a Israel.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo en ojos de Jehová, como habían hecho sus padres: no se apartó de los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, el que hizo pecar á Israel.

verses.KJV: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.
verses.WEB: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.

verses.WEB: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.
verses.ASV: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.

verses.RVR09: En el segundo año de Peka hijo de Remalías rey de Israel, comenzó á reinar Jotham hijo de Uzzía rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.WEB: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
verses.ASV: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

verses.RVR09: Cuando comenzó á reinar era de veinticinco años, y reinó dieciséis años en Jerusalem. El nombre de su madre fué Jerusa hija de Sadoc.

verses.KJV: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.WEB: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah; he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele fez o que era correto aos olhos do SENHOR; fez conforme todas as coisas que havia feito seu pai Uzias.

verses.KJV: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the Lord.

verses.ASV: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com tudo isso os altos não foram tirados; que o povo sacrificava ainda, e queimava incenso nos altos. Edificou ele a porta mais alta da casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso los altos no fueron quitados; que el pueblo sacrificaba aún, y quemaba perfumes en los altos. Edificó él la puerta más alta de la casa de Jehová.

verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.RVR09: Y durmió Jotham con sus padres, y fué sepultado con sus padres en la ciudad de David su padre: y reinó en su lugar Achâz su hijo.

verses.KJV: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

verses.KJV: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

verses.RVR09: Antes anduvo en el camino de los reyes de Israel, y aun hizo pasar por el fuego á su hijo, según las abominaciones de las gentes que Jehová echó de delante de los hijos de Israel.

verses.WEB: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”
verses.ASV: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Acaz enviou embaixadores a Tiglate-Pileser rei da Assíria, dizendo: Eu sou teu servo e teu filho: sobe, e defende-me da mão do rei da Síria, e da mão do rei de Israel, que se levantaram contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Achâz envió embajadores á Tiglath-pileser rey de Asiria, diciendo: Yo soy tu siervo y tu hijo: sube, y defiéndeme de mano del rey de Siria, y de mano del rey de Israel, que se han levantado contra mí.

verses.KJV: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
verses.WEB: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
verses.ASV: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of Jehovah, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomando Acaz a prata e o ouro que se achou na casa do SENHOR, e nos tesouros da casa real, enviou um presente ao rei da Assíria.
verses.RVR09: Y tomando Achâz la plata y el oro que se halló en la casa de Jehová, y en los tesoros de la casa real, envió al rey de Asiria un presente.

verses.KJV: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
verses.WEB: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.
verses.ASV: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried [the people of] it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E atendeu-lhe o rei da Assíria; pois subiu o rei da Assíria contra Damasco, e tomou-a, e transportou os moradores a Quir, e matou a Resim.
verses.RVR09: Y atendióle el rey de Asiria; pues subió el rey de Asiria contra Damasco, y tomóla, y trasportó los moradores á Kir, y mató á Resín.

verses.KJV: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
verses.WEB: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.
verses.ASV: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o rei Acaz a encontrar a Tiglate-Pileser rei da Assíria em Damasco; e visto que havia o rei Acaz o altar que estava em Damasco, enviou a Urias sacerdote o desenho e a descrição do altar, conforme a toda sua feitura.
verses.RVR09: Y fué el rey Achâz á encontrar á Tiglath-pileser rey de Asiria en Damasco; y visto que hubo el rey Achâz el altar que estaba en Damasco, envió á Urías sacerdote el diseño y la descripción del altar, conforme á toda su hechura.

verses.KJV: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
verses.WEB: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.
verses.ASV: And Urijah the priest built an altar: according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so did Urijah the priest make it against the coming of king Ahaz from Damascus.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Urias o sacerdote edificou o altar; conforme a tudo o que o rei Acaz havia enviado de Damasco, assim o fez o sacerdote Urias, antes que o rei Acaz viesse de Damasco.
verses.RVR09: Y Urías el sacerdote edificó el altar; conforme á todo lo que el rey Achâz había enviado de Damasco, así lo hizo el sacerdote Urías, entre tanto que el rey Achâz venía de Damasco.

verses.KJV: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
verses.WEB: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.
verses.ASV: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king drew near unto the altar, and offered thereon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E logo que veio o rei de Damasco, e viu o altar, aproximou-se o rei a ele, e sacrificou nele;
verses.RVR09: Y luego que vino el rey de Damasco, y hubo visto el altar, acercóse el rey á él, y sacrificó en él;

verses.KJV: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.
verses.WEB: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
verses.ASV: And he burnt his burnt-offering and his meal-offering, and poured his drink-offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace-offerings, upon the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acendeu seu holocausto, e sua oferta de alimentos, e derramou suas libações, e espalhou o sangue de seus sacrifícios pacíficos sobre o altar.
verses.RVR09: Y encendió su holocausto, y su presente, y derramó sus libaciones, y esparció la sangre de sus pacíficos junto al altar.

verses.KJV: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the Lord, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the Lord, and put it on the north side of the altar.
verses.WEB: The bronze altar, which was before the LORD, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and the LORD’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.
verses.ASV: And the brazen altar, which was before Jehovah, he brought from the forefront of the house, from between his altar and the house of Jehovah, and put it on the north side of his altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o altar de bronze que estava diante do SENHOR, ele o moveu de diante da parte frontal da casa, entre o altar e o templo do SENHOR, e o pôs ao lado do altar até o norte.
verses.RVR09: Y el altar de bronce que estaba delante de Jehová, hízolo acercar delante de la frontera de la casa, entre el altar y el templo de Jehová, y púsolo al lado del altar hacia el aquilón.

verses.KJV: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by.
verses.WEB: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”
verses.ASV: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt-offering, and the evening meal-offering, and the king’s burnt-offering, and his meal-offering, with the burnt-offering of all the people of the land, and their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt-offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: but the brazen altar shall be for me to inquire by.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Acaz mandou ao sacerdote Urias, dizendo: No grande altar acenderás o holocausto da manhã e a oferta de alimentos da noite, e o holocausto do rei e sua oferta de alimentos, e também o holocausto de todo o povo da terra e suas ofertas de alimentos e suas libações; e espargirás sobre ele todo o sangue do holocausto, e todo o sangue do sacrifício; e o altar de bronze será meu para nele consultar.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó el rey Achâz al sacerdote Urías, diciendo: En el gran altar encenderás el holocausto de la mañana y el presente de la tarde, y el holocausto del rey y su presente, y asimismo el holocausto de todo el pueblo de la tierra y su presente y sus libaciones: y esparcirás sobre él toda la sangre de holocausto, y toda la sangre de sacrificio: y el altar de bronce será mío para preguntar en él.

verses.KJV: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
verses.WEB: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.
verses.ASV: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote Urias fez conforme a todas as coisas que o rei Acaz lhe havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: E hizo el sacerdote Urías conforme á todas las cosas que el rey Achâz le mandó.

verses.KJV: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon the pavement of stones.
verses.WEB: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.
verses.ASV: And king Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the laver from off them, and took down the sea from off the brazen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cortou o rei Acaz as cintas das bases, e tirou-lhes as fontes; tirou também o mar de sobre os bois de bronze que estavam debaixo dele, e o pôs sobre o piso de pedra.
verses.RVR09: Y cortó el rey Achâz las cintas de las basas, y quitóles las fuentes; quitó también el mar de sobre los bueyes de bronce que estaban debajo de él, y púsolo sobre el solado de piedra.

verses.KJV: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entry without, turned he from the house of the Lord for the king of Assyria.
verses.WEB: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to the LORD’s house, because of the king of Assyria.
verses.ASV: And the covered way for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he unto the house of Jehovah, because of the king of Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também a tenda do sábado que haviam edificado na casa, e a entrada de fora do rei, ele os moveu do templo do SENHOR, por causa do rei da Assíria.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo la tienda del sábado que habían edificado en la casa, y el pasadizo de afuera del rey, mudólos del templo de Jehová, por causa del rey de Asiria.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais dos feitos de Acaz que pôs por obra, não estão todos escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Achâz que puso por obra, ¿no está todo escrito en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Judá?

verses.KJV: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descansou o rei Acaz com seus pais e foi sepultado com seus pais na cidade de Davi: e reinou em seu lugar Ezequias seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió el rey Achâz con sus padres y fué sepultado con sus padres en la ciudad de David: y reinó en su lugar Ezechîas su hijo.

verses.KJV: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
verses.WEB: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.
verses.ASV: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel, [and reigned] nine years.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano décimo segundo de Acaz rei de Judá, começou a reinar Oseias filho de Elá em Samaria sobre Israel; e reinou nove anos.
verses.RVR09: EN el año duodécimo de Achâz rey de Judá, comenzó á reinar Oseas hijo de Ela en Samaria sobre Israel; y reinó nueve años.

verses.KJV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.WEB: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, yet not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, ainda que não como os reis de Israel que antes dele haviam sido.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo en ojos de Jehová, aunque no como los reyes de Israel que antes de él habían sido.

verses.KJV: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
verses.WEB: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.
verses.ASV: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contra este subiu Salmaneser rei dos assírios; e Oseias foi feito seu servo, e pagava-lhe tributo.
verses.RVR09: Contra éste subió Salmanasar rey de los Asirios; y Oseas fué hecho su siervo, y pagábale tributo.

verses.KJV: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.WEB: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.
verses.ASV: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o rei da Assíria achou que Oseias fazia conspiração: porque havia enviado embaixadores a Sô, rei do Egito, e não pagava tributo ao rei da Assíria, como cada ano: pelo que o rei da Assíria lhe deteve, e lhe aprisionou na casa do cárcere.
verses.RVR09: Mas el rey de Asiria halló que Oseas hacía conjuración: porque había enviado embajadores á So, rey de Egipto, y no pagaba tributo al rey de Asiria, como cada año: por lo que el rey de Asiria le detuvo, y le aprisionó en la casa de la cárcel.

verses.KJV: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.WEB: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.ASV: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei da Assíria partiu contra todo aquela terra, e subiu contra Samaria, e a cercou por três anos.
