verses.WEB: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.ASV: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Héber nasceram dois filhos: o nome do um foi Pelegue, pois em seus dias a terra foi dividida; e o nome de seu irmão foi Joctã.
verses.RVR09: Y á Heber nacieron dos hijos: el nombre del uno fué Peleg, por cuanto en sus días fué dividida la tierra; y el nombre de su hermano fué Joctán.

verses.KJV: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.WEB: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.ASV: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joctã gerou a Almodá, Salefe, Hazarmavé, e Jerá,
verses.RVR09: Y Joctán engendró á Elmodad, Seleph, Asarmaveth, y Jera,

verses.KJV: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.WEB: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.ASV: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Adorão, Uzal, Dicla,
verses.RVR09: A Adoram también, á Uzal, Dicla,

verses.KJV: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.WEB: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.ASV: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ebal, Abimael, Sebá,
verses.RVR09: Hebal, Abimael, Seba,

verses.KJV: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.WEB: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.ASV: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ofir, Havilá, e a Jobabe: todos filhos de Joctã.
verses.RVR09: Ophir, Havila, y Jobab: todos hijos de Joctán.

verses.KJV: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.WEB: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
verses.ASV: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Sem, Arfaxade, Selá,
verses.RVR09: Sem, Arphaxad, Sela,

verses.KJV: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.WEB: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.ASV: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.ALMEIDA: Héber, Pelegue, Reú,
verses.RVR09: Heber, Peleg, Reu,

verses.KJV: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.WEB: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.ASV: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Serugue, Naor, Terá,
verses.RVR09: Serug, Nachôr, Thare,

verses.KJV: Abram; the same is Abraham.
verses.WEB: Abram (also called Abraham).
verses.ASV: Abram (the same is Abraham).
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abrão, o qual é Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Y Abram, el cual es Abraham.

verses.KJV: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.WEB: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.ASV: The sons of Abraham: Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Abraão foram: Isaque e Ismael.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Abraham: Isaac é Ismael.

verses.KJV: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.WEB: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.ASV: These are their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são suas gerações: o primogênito de Ismael foi Nebaiote; [depois] Quedar, Adbeel, Mibsão,
verses.RVR09: Y estas son sus descendencias: el primogénito de Ismael, Nabajoth; después Cedar, Adbeel, Misam,

verses.KJV: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.WEB: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
verses.ASV: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.ALMEIDA: Misma, Dumá, Massá, Hadade, Temá,
verses.RVR09: Misma, Duma, Maasa, Hadad, Thema, Jetur, Naphis, y Cedma. Estos son los hijos de Ismael.

verses.KJV: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.WEB: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.ASV: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jetur, Nafis, e Quedemá. Estes foram os filhos de Ismael.
verses.RVR09: Y Cethura, concubina de Abraham, parió á Zimram, Jocsán, Medán, Madián, Isbac, y á Súa.

verses.KJV: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.WEB: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto aos filhos de Quetura, concubina de Abraão, esta deu à luz Zinrã, Jocsã, Medã, Midiã, Isbaque, e a Suá. Os filhos de Jobsã: Sebá e Dedã.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Jobsán: Seba y Dedán.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Midiã: Efá, Efer, Enoque, Abida, e Elda; todos estes foram filhos de Quetura.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Madián: Epha, Epher, Henoch, Abida, y Eldaa; todos estos fueron hijos de Cethura.

verses.KJV: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
verses.WEB: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
verses.ASV: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau, and Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abraão gerou a Isaque: e os filhos de Isaque foram Esaú e Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Abraham engendró á Isaac: y los hijos de Isaac fueron Esaú é Israel.

verses.KJV: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.ASV: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, Reuel, Jeús, Jalão, e Corá.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Esaú: Eliphas, Rehuel, Jeus, Jalam, y Cora.

verses.KJV: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
verses.WEB: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
verses.ASV: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Elifaz: Temã, Omar, Zefi, Gatã, Quenaz, Timna, e Amaleque.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Eliphas: Themán, Omar, Sephi, Hatham, Chênas, Timna, y Amalec.

verses.KJV: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.ASV: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Reuel: Naate, Zerá, Samá, e Mizá.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Rehuel: Nahath, Zera, Samma, y Mizza.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
verses.WEB: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Seir: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Ana, Disom, Eser, e Disã.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Seir: Lotán, Sobal, Sibeón, Ana, Disón, Eser, y Disán.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.
verses.WEB: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Lotan: Hori, and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Lotã: Hori, e Homã: e Timna foi irmã de Lotã.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Lotán: Hori, y Homam: y Timna fué hermana de Lotán.

verses.KJV: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. and the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
verses.ASV: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah, and Anah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Sobal: Aliã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefi e Onã. Os filhos de Zibeão foram: Aiá, e Aná.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Sobal: Alian, Manahach, Ebal, Sephi y Oman. Los hijos de Sibehom: Aia y Ana.

verses.KJV: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.WEB: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.ASV: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disom foi filho de Aná: e os filhos de Disom foram Hanrão, Esbã, Itrã e Querã.
verses.RVR09: Disón fué hijo de Ana: y los hijos de Disón; Hamrán, Hesbán, Ithran y Chêrán.

verses.KJV: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.ASV: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Eser foram: Bilã, Zaavã, e Jaacã. Os filhos de Disã: Uz e Arã.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Eser: Bilham, Zaaván, y Jaacán. Los hijos de Disán: Hus y Arán.

verses.KJV: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.WEB: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.ASV: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse [algum] rei sobre os filhos de Israel: Belá, filho de Beor; e o nome de sua cidade era Dinabá.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los reyes que reinaron en la tierra de Edom, antes que reinase rey sobre los hijos de Israel: Belah, hijo de Beor; y el nombre de su ciudad fué Dinaba.

verses.KJV: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Belá morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra.
verses.RVR09: Y muerto Belah, reinó en su lugar Jobab hijo de Zera, de Bosra.

verses.KJV: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jobabe morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Husão, da terra dos Temanitas.
verses.RVR09: Y muerto Jobab, reinó en su lugar Husam, de la tierra de los Themanos.

verses.KJV: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.WEB: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.ASV: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Husão morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Hadade, filho de Bedade, o qual feriu aos midianitas no campo de Moabe; e o nome de sua cidade era Avite.
verses.RVR09: Muerto Husam, reinó en su lugar Adad hijo de Bedad, el cual hirió á Madián en la campaña de Moab: y el nombre de su ciudad fué Avith.

verses.KJV: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Hadade morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Sanlá, de Masreca.
verses.RVR09: Muerto Adad, reinó en su lugar Samla, de Masreca.

verses.KJV: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sanlá morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Saul de Reobote, que está junto ao rio.
verses.RVR09: Muerto también Samla, reinó en su lugar Saúl de Rehoboth, que está junto al río.

verses.KJV: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saul morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor.
verses.RVR09: Y muerto Saúl, reinó en su lugar Baal-hanán hijo de Achbor.

verses.KJV: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.WEB: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.ASV: And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Baal-Hanã morreu, e reinou em seu lugar Hadade, cuja cidade tinha por nome Paí; e o nome de sua mulher era Meetabel, filha de Matrede, a filha de Mezaabe.
verses.RVR09: Y muerto Baal-hanán, reinó en su lugar Adad, el nombre de cuya ciudad fué Pai; y el nombre de su mujer Meetabel, hija de Matred, y ésta de Mezaab.

verses.KJV: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
verses.WEB: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
verses.ASV: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hadade morreu. E os príncipes em Edom foram: o príncipe Timna, o príncipe Aliá, o príncipe Jetete,
verses.RVR09: Muerto Adad, sucedieron los duques en Edom: el duque Timna, el duque Alia, el duque Jetheth,

verses.KJV: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.WEB: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.ASV: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.ALMEIDA: O príncipe Oolibama, o príncipe Elá, o príncipe Pinom,
verses.RVR09: El duque Oholibama, el duque Ela, el duque Phinón,

verses.KJV: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.WEB: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.ASV: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.ALMEIDA: O príncipe Quenaz, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Mibzar,
verses.RVR09: El duque Chênaz, el duque Themán, el duque Mibzar,

verses.KJV: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
verses.WEB: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
verses.ASV: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: O príncipe Magdiel, o príncipe Irã. Estes foram os príncipe de Edom.
verses.RVR09: El duque Magdiel, el duque Iram. Estos fueron los duques de Edom.

verses.KJV: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
verses.ASV: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os filhos de Israel: Rúben, Simeão, Levi, Judá, Issacar, Zebulom,
verses.RVR09: ESTOS son los hijos de Israel: Rubén, Simeón, Leví, Judá, Issachâr, Zabulón,

verses.KJV: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.WEB: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.ASV: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dã, José, Benjamim, Naftali, Gade, e Aser.
verses.RVR09: Dan, José, Benjamín, Nephtalí, Gad, y Aser.

verses.KJV: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.
verses.WEB: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.
verses.ASV: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah; which three were born unto him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. And Er, Judah’s first-born, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and he slew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Judá foram: Er, Onã, e Selá. [Estes] três lhe nasceram de Bete-Suá, Cananeia. E Er, primogênito, de Judá, foi mau diante do Senhor, que o matou.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Judá: Er, Onán, y Sela. Estos tres le nacieron de la hija de Sua, Cananea. Y Er, primogénito de Judá, fué malo delante de Jehová; y matólo.

verses.KJV: And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.WEB: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.ASV: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bare him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Tamar, sua nora, lhe deu à luz Perez e a Zerá. Todos os filhos de Judá foram cinco.
verses.RVR09: Y Thamar su nuera le parió á Phares y á Zara. Todos los hijos de Judá fueron cinco.

verses.KJV: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.WEB: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
verses.ASV: The sons of Perez: Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Perez: Hezrom e Hamul.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Phares: Hesrón y Hamul.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
verses.WEB: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Zerá: Zinri, Etã, Hemã, e Calcol, e Darda; cinco ao todo.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Zara: Zimri, Ethán, Hemán, y Calcol, y Darda; en todos cinco.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
verses.WEB: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: O filho de Carmi foi Acar, o perturbador de Israel, porque transgrediu naquilo que estava separado por maldiçãos.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Chârmi fué Achâr, el que alborotó á Israel, porque prevaricó en el anatema.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.WEB: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O filho de Etã foi Azarias.
verses.RVR09: Azaría fué hijo de Ethán.

verses.KJV: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.WEB: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.ASV: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos que nasceram a Hezrom foram: Jerameel, Rão, e Quelubai.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos que nacieron á Hesrón: Jerameel, Ram, y Chêlubai.

verses.KJV: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.WEB: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.ASV: And Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Rão gerou a Aminadabe; e Aminadabe gerou a Naasom, príncipe dos filhos de Judá;
verses.RVR09: Y Ram engendró á Aminadab; y Aminadab engendró á Nahasón, príncipe de los hijos de Judá;

verses.KJV: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
verses.WEB: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
verses.ASV: and Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Naasom gerou a Salmom, e Salmom gerou a Boaz;
verses.RVR09: Y Nahasón engendró á Salma, y Salma engendró á Booz;

verses.KJV: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
verses.WEB: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;
verses.ASV: and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Boaz gerou a Obede, e Obede gerou a Jessé;
verses.RVR09: Y Booz engendró á Obed, y Obed engendró á Isaí;

verses.KJV: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
verses.WEB: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
verses.ASV: and Jesse begat his first-born Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jessé gerou a Eliabe, seu primogênito, e o segundo Abinadabe, o terceiro Simeia;
verses.RVR09: E Isaí engendró á Eliab, su primogénito, y el segundo Abinadab, y Sima el tercero;

verses.KJV: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.WEB: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.ASV: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.ALMEIDA: O quarto Natanael, o quinto Radai;
verses.RVR09: El cuarto Nathanael, el quinto Radai;

verses.KJV: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
verses.WEB: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;
verses.ASV: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;
verses.ALMEIDA: O sexto Ozém, o sétimo Davi;
verses.RVR09: El sexto Osem, el séptimo David:

verses.KJV: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.WEB: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.ASV: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.ALMEIDA: As irmãs dos quais foram Zeruia e Abigail. Os filhos de Zeruia foram três: Abisai, Joabe, e Asael.
verses.RVR09: De los cuales Sarvia y Abigail fueron hermanas. Los hijos de Sarvia fueron tres: Abisai, Joab, y Asael.

verses.KJV: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
verses.WEB: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.ASV: And Abigail bare Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abigail deu à luz Amasa, cujo pai foi Jéter, o Ismaelita.
verses.RVR09: Abigail engendró á Amasa, cuyo padre fué Jether Ismaelita.

verses.KJV: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.WEB: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.ASV: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat [children] of Azubah [his] wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Calebe filho de Hezrom gerou de sua mulher Azuba, e de Jeriote. E os filhos dela foram: Jeser, Sobabe, e Ardom.
verses.RVR09: Caleb hijo de Hesrón engendró á Jerioth de su mujer Azuba. Y los hijos de ella fueron Jeser, Sobad, y Ardón.

verses.KJV: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
verses.WEB: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
verses.ASV: And Azubah died, and Caleb took unto him Ephrath, who bare him Hur.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Azuba morreu, e Calebe tmou por mulher a Efrate, a qual lhe gerou a Hur.
verses.RVR09: Y muerta Azuba, tomó Caleb por mujer á Ephrata, la cual le parió á Hur.

verses.KJV: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
verses.WEB: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
verses.ASV: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezalel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hur gerou a Uri, e Uri gerou a Bezalel.
verses.RVR09: Y Hur engendró á Uri, y Uri engendró á Bezaleel.

verses.KJV: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
verses.WEB: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
verses.ASV: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took [to wife] when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois Hezrom se deitou com a filha de Maquir, pai de Gileade, a qual ele tomou por esposa quando ele tinha sessenta anos, e ela lhe gerou a Segube.
verses.RVR09: Después entró Hesrón á la hija de Machîr padre de Galaad, la cual tomó siendo él de sesenta años, y ella le parió á Segub.

verses.KJV: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.WEB: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.ASV: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Segube gerou a Jair, que teve vinte e três cidades na terra de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Y Segub engendró á Jair, el cual tuvo veintitrés ciudades en la tierra de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.WEB: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.ASV: And Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and the villages thereof, even threescore cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Gesur e Arã tomaram deles as cidades de Jair, e a Quenate com suas aldeias, sessenta cidades. Todos estes foram filhos de Maquir, pai de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Y Gesur y Aram tomaron las ciudades de Jair de ellos, y á Cenath con sus aldeas, sesenta lugares. Todos estos fueron de los hijos de Machîr padre de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
verses.WEB: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
verses.ASV: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephrathah, then Abijah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois da morte de Hezrom, em Calebe de Efrata, Abia mulher de Hezrom, lhe gerou a Asur, pai de Tecoa.
verses.RVR09: Y muerto Hesrón en Caleb de Ephrata, Abia mujer de Hesrón le parió á Ashur padre de Tecoa.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jerahmeel the first-born of Hezron were Ram the first-born, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Jerameel primogênito de Hezrom foram: Rão (seu primogênito), Buna, Orém, Ozém, e Aías.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Jerameel primogénito de Hesrón fueron Ram su primogénito, Buna, Orem, Osem, y Achîa.

verses.KJV: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.WEB: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
verses.ASV: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jerameel também teve outra mulher chamada Atara, que foi mãe de Onã.
verses.RVR09: Y tuvo Jerameel otra mujer llamada Atara, que fué madre de Onam.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Ram the first-born of Jerahmeel were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Rão, primogênito de Jerameel, foram: Maaz, Jamim, e Equer.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Ram primogénito de Jerameel fueron Maas, Jamín, y Acar.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab and Abishur.
verses.WEB: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Onam were Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Onã foram: Samai, e Jada. E os filhos de Samai: Nadabe, e Abisur.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Onam fueron Sammai, y Jada. Los hijos de Sammai: Nadab, y Abisur.

verses.KJV: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.WEB: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
verses.ASV: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o nome da mulher de Abisur era Abiail, a qual lhe gerou a Abã e a Molide.
verses.RVR09: Y el nombre de la mujer de Abisur fué Abihail, la cual le parió á Abán, y á Molib.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
verses.WEB: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Nadabe foram: Selede e Apaim. E Selede morreu sem filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Nadab: Seled y Aphaim. Y Seled murió sin hijos.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.WEB: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filho de Apaim foi Isi; o filho de Isi foi Sesã; e o filho de Sesã foi Alai.
verses.RVR09: E Isi fué hijo de Aphaim; y Sesam, hijo de Isi; é hijo de Sesam, Alai.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether, and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Jada, irmão de Simmai, foram: Jéter e Jônatas. E Jéter morreu sem filhos.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Jada hermano de Simmai: Jether y Jonathán. Y murió Jether sin hijos.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Jônatas foram: Pelete, e Zaza. Estes foram os filhos de Jerameel.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Jonathán: Peleth, y Zaza. Estos fueron los hijos de Jerameel.

verses.KJV: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.WEB: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.ASV: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Sesã não teve filhos, mas somente filhas. E Sesã tinha um servo egípcio, cujo nome era Jará.
verses.RVR09: Y Sesán no tuvo hijos, sino hijas.

verses.KJV: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.WEB: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
verses.ASV: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sesã deu sua filha a seu servo Jará, e ela lhe gerou a Atai.
verses.RVR09: Y tuvo Sesán un siervo Egipcio, llamado Jarha, al cual dió Sesán por mujer á su hija; y ella le parió á Athai.

verses.KJV: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.WEB: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
verses.ASV: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Atai gerou a Natã, e Natã gerou a Zabade;
verses.RVR09: Y Athai engendró á Nathán, y Nathán engendró á Zabad:

verses.KJV: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.WEB: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
verses.ASV: and Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zabade gerou a Eflal, e Eflal gerou a Obede;
verses.RVR09: Y Zabad engendró á Ephlal, y Ephlal engendró á Obed;

verses.KJV: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.WEB: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,
verses.ASV: and Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Obede gerou a Jeú, e Jeú gerou a Azarias;
verses.RVR09: Y Obed engendró á Jehú, y Jehú engendró á Azarías;

verses.KJV: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.WEB: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
verses.ASV: and Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Azarias gerou a Helez, Helez gerou a Eleasá;
verses.RVR09: Y Azarías engendró á Heles, y Heles engedró á Elasa;

verses.KJV: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
verses.WEB: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
verses.ASV: and Eleasah begat Sismai, and Sismai begat Shallum,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eleasá gerou a Sismai, e Sismai gerou a Salum;
verses.RVR09: Elasa engendró á Sismai, y Sismai engendró á Sallum;

verses.KJV: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.WEB: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
verses.ASV: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salum gerou a Jecamias, e Jecamias gerou a Elisama.
verses.RVR09: Y Sallum engendró á Jecamía, y Jecamía engendró á Elisama.

verses.KJV: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.WEB: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his first-born, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Calebe, irmão de Jerameel, foram: Messa seu primogênito, que foi o pai de Zife; e os filhos de Maressa, pai de Hebrom.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Caleb hermano de Jerameel fueron Mesa su primogénito, que fué el padre de Ziph; y los hijos de Maresa padre de Hebrón.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.WEB: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Hebrom foram: Corá, Tapua, Requém, e Sema.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Hebrón: Core, y Thaphua, y Recem, y Sema.

verses.KJV: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.WEB: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
verses.ASV: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Sema gerou a Raão, pai de Jorqueão; e Requém gerou a Samai.
verses.RVR09: Y Sema engendró á Raham, padre de Jorcaam; y Recem engendró á Sammai.

verses.KJV: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
verses.WEB: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
verses.ASV: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filho de Samai foi Maom, e Maom foi pai de Bete-Zur.
verses.RVR09: Maón fué hijo de Sammai, y Maón padre de Beth-zur.

verses.KJV: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.WEB: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
verses.ASV: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Efá, a concubina de Calebe, lhe gerou a Harã, Moza, e a Gazez. E Harã gerou a Gazez.
verses.RVR09: Y Epha, concubina de Caleb, le parió á Harán, y á Mosa, y á Gazez. Y Harán engendró á Gazez.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jothan, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Jadai foram: Regém, Jotão, Gesã, Pelete, Efá, e Saafe.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Joddai: Regem, Jotham, Gesán, Pelet, Epho, y Saaph.

verses.KJV: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.WEB: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
verses.ASV: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber and Tirhanah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maaca, concubina de Calebe, lhe gerou a Seber, e a Tiraná.
verses.RVR09: Maachâ, concubina de Caleb, le parió á Sebet, y á Thirana.

verses.KJV: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
verses.WEB: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.ASV: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena, and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela também deu à luz a Saafe, pai de Madmana, e a Seva, pai de Macbena e pai de Gibeá. E a filha de Calebe foi Acsa.
verses.RVR09: Y también le parió á Saaph padre de Madmannah, y á Seva padre de Macbena, y padre de Ghiba. Y Achsa fué hija de Caleb.

verses.KJV: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim.
verses.WEB: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
verses.ASV: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Calebe, filho de Hur, primogênito de Efrata: Sobal, pai de Quiriate-Jearim;
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Caleb, hijo de Hur, primogénito de Ephrata: Sobal, padre de Chîriath-jearim;

verses.KJV: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
verses.WEB: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
verses.ASV: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salma, pai dos belemitas; e Harefe, pai de Bete-Gader.
verses.RVR09: Salma, padre de Beth-lehem; Hareph, padre de Beth-gader.

verses.KJV: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
verses.WEB: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
verses.ASV: And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Sobal, pai de Quiriate-Jearim foram: Haroé, a metade dos Manaatitas.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Sobal padre de Chîriath-jearim fueron Haroeh, la mitad de los Manahethitas.

verses.KJV: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites,
verses.WEB: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
verses.ASV: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: The Ithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as famílias de Quiriate-Jearim foram os itreus, os puteus, os sumateus, e os misraeus; destes saíram os zorateus e os estaoleus.
verses.RVR09: Y las familias de Chîriath-jearim fueron los Ithreos, y los Phuteos, y los Samatheos, y los Misraiteos; de los cuales salieron los Soratitas, y los Estaolitas.

verses.KJV: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
verses.WEB: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
verses.ASV: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Salma foram: Belém, e os netofatitas, Atarote, Bete-Joabe; e da metade dos manaatitas, [e] os zoritas.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Salma: Beth-lehem, y los Nethophatitas, los cuales son las coronas de la casa de Joab, y de la mitad de los Manahethitas, los Soraitas.

verses.KJV: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.WEB: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.ASV: And the families of scribes that dwelt at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as famílias dos escribas, que habitavam em Jabez, foram os tiratitas, os simeatitas, [e] os sucatitas; estes foram os queneus que vieram de Hamate, pai da casa de Recabe.
verses.RVR09: Y las familias de los escribas, que moraban en Jabes, fueron los Thiratheos, Simatheos, Sucatheos; los cuales son los Cineos que vinieron de Hamath, padre de la casa de Rechâb.

verses.KJV: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
verses.WEB: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
verses.ASV: Now these were the sons of David, that were born unto him in Hebron: the first-born, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os filhos de Davi, que lhe nasceram em Hebrom: Amnom, o primogênito, de Ainoã Jezreelita; o segundo Daniel, de Abigail de Carmelo;
verses.RVR09: ESTOS son los hijos de David, que le nacieron en Hebrón: Amnón el primogénito, de Achînoam Jezreelita; el segundo, Daniel, de Abigail de Carmelo;

verses.KJV: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.WEB: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.ASV: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.ALMEIDA: O terceiro, Absalão, filho de Maaca, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur; o quarto, Adonias, filho de Hagite;
verses.RVR09: El tercero, Absalom, hijo de Maachâ hija de Talmai rey de Gesur; el cuarto, Adonías hijo de Aggith;

verses.KJV: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.WEB: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
verses.ASV: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
verses.ALMEIDA: O quinto, Sefatias, de Abital; o sexto, Itreão, de sua mulher Eglá.
verses.RVR09: El quinto, Sephatías, de Abithal; el sexto, Itream, de Egla su mujer.

verses.KJV: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.WEB: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;
verses.ASV: six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes seis lhe nasceram em Hebrom, de onde reinou sete anos e seis meses; e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos.
verses.RVR09: Estos seis le nacieron en Hebrón, donde reinó siete años y seis meses: y en Jerusalem reinó treinta y tres años.

verses.KJV: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
verses.WEB: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.ASV: and these were born unto him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Simeia, Sobabe, Natã, e Salomão, [estes] quatro de Bate-Sua, filha de Amiel.
verses.RVR09: Estos cuatro le nacieron en Jerusalem: Simma, Sobab, Nathán, y Salomón, de Beth-sua hija de Ammiel.

verses.KJV: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.WEB: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
verses.ASV: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Nasceram-lhe] mais: Ibar, Elisama, Elifelete,
verses.RVR09: Y otros nueve: Ibaar, Elisama, y Eliphelet,

verses.KJV: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.WEB: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.ASV: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nogá, Nefegue, Jafia.
verses.RVR09: Noga, Nepheg, y Japhia,

verses.KJV: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.WEB: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.ASV: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elisama, Eliada, e Elifelete, nove.
verses.RVR09: Elisama, Eliada, y Eliphelet.

verses.KJV: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.WEB: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.ASV: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes foram os filhos de Davi, exceto os filhos das concubinas. E Tamar foi irmã deles.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos fueron los hijos de David, sin los hijos de las concubinas. Y Thamar fué hermana de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.WEB: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.ASV: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filho de Salomão foi Roboão, cujo filho foi Abias, cujo filho foi Asa, cujo filho foi Jeosafá;
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Salomón fué Roboam, cuyo hijo fué Abía, del cual fué hijo Asa, cuyo hijo fué Josaphat;

verses.KJV: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.WEB: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.ASV: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Cujo filho foi Jorão, cujo filho foi Acazias, cujo filho foi Joás;
verses.RVR09: De quien fué hijo Joram, cuyo hijo fué Ochôzías, hijo del cual fué Joas;

verses.KJV: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.WEB: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.ASV: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Cujo filho foi Amazias, cujo filho foi Azarias, cujo filho foi Jotão;
verses.RVR09: Del cual fué hijo Amasías, cuyo hijo fué Azarías, é hijo de éste Jotham;

verses.KJV: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.WEB: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.ASV: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Cujo filho foi Acaz, cujo filho foi Ezequias, cujo filho foi Manassés;
verses.RVR09: E hijo del cual fué Achâz, del que fué hijo Ezechîas, cuyo hijo fué Manasés;

verses.KJV: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.WEB: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
verses.ASV: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cujo filho foi Amom, cujo filho foi Josias.
verses.RVR09: Del cual fué hijo Amón, cuyo hijo fué Josías.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.WEB: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Josiah: the first-born Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Josias foram: Joanã seu primogênito, o segundo Jeoaquim, o terceiro Zedequias, o quarto Salum.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Josías: Johanán su primogénito, el segundo Joacim, el tercero Sedecías, el cuarto Sallum.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Jeoaquim foram: seu filho Jeconias, e seu filho Zedequias.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Joacim: Jechônías su hijo, hijo del cual fué Sedecías.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
verses.WEB: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Jeconias, o cativo, foram: seu filho Sealtiel,
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Jechônías: Asir, Salathiel,

verses.KJV: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.WEB: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.ASV: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Malquirão, Pedaías, Senazar, Jecamias, Hosama, e Nedabias.
verses.RVR09: Mechiram, Pedaía, Seneaser, y Jecamía, Hosama, y Nedabía.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
verses.WEB: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.ASV: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Pedaías foram: Zorobabel, e Simei. E os filhos de Zorobabel foram: Mesulão, Hananias, e sua irmã Selomite.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Pedaía: Zorobabel, y Simi. Y los hijos de Zorobabel: Mesullam, Hananías, y Selomith su hermana.

verses.KJV: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
verses.WEB: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
verses.ASV: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os cinco outros: Hasubá, Oel, Berequias, Hasadias, e Jusabe-Hesede.
verses.RVR09: Y de Mesullam: Hasuba, Ohel, y Berechîas, Hasadía, y Jusabhesed; cinco en todos.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Hananias: Pelatias, e Jesaías, os filhos de Refaías, os filhos de Arnã, os filhos de Obadias, e os filhos de Secanias.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Hananías: Pelatías, y Jesaías, hijo de Rephaías, hijo de Arnán, hijo de Obdías, hijo de Sechânías.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.WEB: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filho de Secanias foi Semaías; e os filhos de Samaías foram seis: Hatus, Igal, Bariá, Nearias, e Safate.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Sechânías fué Semaías; y los hijos de Semaías: Hattus, Igheal, Barias, Nearías, y Saphat; seis.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.WEB: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Nearias foram três: Elioenai, Ezequias, e Azricão.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Nearías fueron estos tres: Elioenai, Ezechîas, y Azricam.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.WEB: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Elioenai foram sete: Hodavias, Eliasibe, Pelaías, Acube, Joanã, Delaías, e Anani.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Elioenai fueron estos siete: Odavias, Eliasib, Palaías, Accub, Johanán, Dalaías, y Anani.

verses.KJV: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.WEB: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.ASV: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Judá foram: Perez, Hezrom, Carmi, Hur, e Sobal.
verses.RVR09: LOS hijos de Judá: Phares, Hesrón, Carmi, Hur, y Sobal.

verses.KJV: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.WEB: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.ASV: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Reaías, filho de Sobal, gerou a Jaate; e Jaate gerou a Aumai e a Laade. Estas são as famílias dos Zoratitas.
verses.RVR09: Y Reaias hijo de Sobal, engendró á Jahath; y Jahath engendró á Ahumai y á Laad. Estas son las familias de los Sorathitas.

verses.KJV: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
verses.WEB: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
verses.ASV: And these were [the sons of] the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as do pai de Etã: Jezreel, Isma, e Idbás. E o nome da irmã deles era Hazelelponi.
verses.RVR09: Y estas son las del padre de Etham: Jezreel, Isma, é Ibdas. Y el nombre de su hermana fué Haslelponi.

verses.KJV: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.WEB: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.ASV: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Penuel foi pai de Gedor, e Ézer pai de Husá. Estes foram os filhos de Hur, primogênito de Efrata, pai de Belém.
verses.RVR09: Y Penuel fué padre de Gedor, y Ezer padre de Husa. Estos fueron los hijos de Hur, primogénito de Ephrata, padre de Beth-lehem.

verses.KJV: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.WEB: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.ASV: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Asur, pai de Tecoa, teve duas mulheres: Helá, e Naará.
verses.RVR09: Y Asur padre de Tecoa tuvo dos mujeres, á saber, Helea, y Naara.

verses.KJV: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.WEB: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.ASV: And Naarah bare him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Naará lhe gerou a Auzão, Héfer, Temeni, e a Haastari. Estes foram os filhos de Naará.
verses.RVR09: Y Naara le parió á Auzam, y á Hepher, á Themeni, y á Ahastari. Estos fueron los hijos de Naara.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
verses.WEB: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Helá foram: Zerete, Zoar, e Etnã.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Helea: Sereth, Jesohar, Ethnán.

verses.KJV: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.WEB: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.ASV: And Hakkoz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Coz gerou a Anube, e a Zobeba, e as famílias de Aarel, filho de Harum.
verses.RVR09: Y Cos engendró á Anob, y á Sobeba, y la familia de Aharhel hijo de Arum.

verses.KJV: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verses.WEB: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
verses.ASV: And Jabez was more honorable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jabez foi mais honrado que seus irmãos; sua mãe o chamara de Jabez, dizendo: Pois com dores eu o dei à luz.
verses.RVR09: Y Jabes fué más ilustre que sus hermanos, al cual su madre llamó Jabes, diciendo: Por cuanto le parí en dolor.

verses.KJV: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.WEB: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
verses.ASV: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it be not to my sorrow! And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jabez invocou ao Deus de Israel, dizendo: Ah, se tu me abençoares muito, e ampliares os meus limites, e se tua mão for comigo, e me protegeres do mal, para que eu não sofra! E Deus fez suceder o que ele havia pedido.
verses.RVR09: E invocó Jabes al Dios de Israel, diciendo: ¡Oh si me dieras bendición, y ensancharas mi término, y si tu mano fuera conmigo, y me libraras de mal, que no me dañe! E hizo Dios que le viniese lo que pidió.

verses.KJV: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
verses.WEB: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.ASV: And Chelub the brother of Shuhah begat Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Quelube, irmão de Suá gerou a Maquir, que foi o pai de Estom.
verses.RVR09: Y Caleb hermano de Sua engendró á Machîr, el cual fué padre de Esthón.

verses.KJV: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
verses.WEB: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
verses.ASV: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Estom gerou a Bete-Rafa, Paseia, e a Teína, pai da cidade de Naás; estes foram os homens de Reca.
verses.RVR09: Y Esthón engendró á Beth-rapha, á Phasea, y á Tehinna, padre de la ciudad de Naas: estos son los varones de Rechâ.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
verses.WEB: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Quenaz foram: Otniel e Seraías. Os filhos de Otniel: Hatate [e Meonotai] .
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Cenes: Othniel, y Seraiah. Los hijos de Othniel: Hathath,

verses.KJV: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.WEB: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.
verses.ASV: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab the father of Ge-harashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Meonotai gerou a Ofra; e Seraías gerou a Joabe, pai [dos moradores] do Vale dos Artesãos, porque foram artesãos.
verses.RVR09: Y Maonathi, el cual engendró á Ophra: y Seraiah engendró á Joab, padre de los habitantes en el valle llamado de Carisim, porque fueron artífices.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
verses.WEB: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah; and Kenaz.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Calebe, filho de Jefoné foram: Iru, Elá, e Naã; e filho de Elá foi Quenaz.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Caleb hijo de Jephone: Iru, Ela, y Naham; é hijo de Ela, fué Cenez.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Jealelel foram: Zife, Zifa, Tíria, e Asareel.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Jaleleel: Zip, Ziphas, Tirias, y Asareel.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon; and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Ezra foram: Jéter, Merede, Efer, e Jalom. E [sua mulher] também deu à luz a Miriã, Samai, e a Isbá, pai de Estemoa.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Ezra: Jeter, Mered, Epher, y Jalón: también engendró á Mariam, y Sammai, y á Isba, padre de Esthemoa.

verses.KJV: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
verses.WEB: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
verses.ASV: And his wife the Jewess bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua mulher Judia lhe deu à luz a Jerede pai de Gedor, a Héber pai de Socó, e a Jecutiel pai de Zanoa. Estes foram os filhos de Bitias, filha de Faraó, a qual Merede teve por esposa.
verses.RVR09: Y su mujer Judaía le parió á Jered padre de Gedor, y á Heber padre de Sochô, y á Icuthiel padre de Zanoa. Estos fueron los hijos de Bethia hija de Faraón, con la cual casó Mered.

verses.KJV: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.WEB: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.ASV: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos da mulher de Hodias, irmã de Naã, foram: o pai de Queila o garmita, e Estemoa o maacatita.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de la mujer de Odías, hermana de Naham, fueron el padre de Keila de Garmi, y Esthemoa de Maachâti.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
verses.WEB: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Simeão foram: Amnom, Rina, Ben-Hanã, e Tilom. E os filhos de Isi foram: Zoete, e Ben-Zoete.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Simón: Amnón, y Rinna, hijo de Hanán, y Tilón. Y los hijos de Isi: Zoheth, y Benzoheth.

verses.KJV: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.WEB: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
verses.ASV: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Selá, filho de Judá foram: Er, pai de Leca, e Lada, pai de Maressa, e as famílias da casa dos [trabalhadores] do linho em Bete-Asbeia;
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Sela, hijo de Judá: Er, padre de Lechâ, y Laada, padre de Maresa, y de la familia de la casa del oficio del lino en la casa de Asbea;

verses.KJV: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.
verses.WEB: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
verses.ASV: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And the records are ancient.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como também Joquim, os homens de Cozeba, Joás, e Sarafe (os quais dominaram sobre os moabitas), e Jasubi-Leem. Estes registros, porém, são antigos.
verses.RVR09: Y Joacim, y los varones de Chôzeba, y Joas, y Saraph, los cuales moraron en Moab, y Jasubi-lehem, que son palabras antiguas.

verses.KJV: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.WEB: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.
verses.ASV: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram oleiros, e habitavam em Netaim e Gedera; eles ficaram ali com o rei em sua obra.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron alfareros y se hallaban en medio de plantíos y cercados, los cuales moraron allá con el rey en su obra.

verses.KJV: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
verses.WEB: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
verses.ASV: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Simeão foram: Nemuel, Jamim, Jaribe, Zerá, Saul;
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Simeón: Nemuel, Jamín, Jarib, Zera, Saúl;

verses.KJV: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.WEB: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
verses.ASV: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cujo filho foi Salum, cujo filho foi Mibsão, cujo filho foi e Misma.
verses.RVR09: También Sallum su hijo, Mibsam su hijo, y Misma su hijo.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.WEB: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Misma foram: seu filho Hamuel, cujo filho foi Zacur, cujo filho foi Simei.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Misma: Hamuel su hijo, Zachûr su hijo, y Simi su hijo.

verses.KJV: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters: but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
verses.WEB: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.
verses.ASV: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply like to the children of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Simei teve dezesseis filhos e seis filhas, porém seus irmãos não tiveram muitos filhos, e toda a sua família não se multiplicou tanto como a dos filhos de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Simi fueron diez y seis, y seis hijas: mas sus hermanos no tuvieron muchos hijos, ni multiplicaron toda su familia como los hijos de Judá.

verses.KJV: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
verses.WEB: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
verses.ASV: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitaram em Berseba, Moladá, Hazar-Sual,
verses.RVR09: Y habitaron en Beer-seba, y en Molada, y en Hasar-sual,

verses.KJV: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.WEB: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
verses.ASV: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.ALMEIDA: E em Bila, Ezém, Tolade,
verses.RVR09: Y en Bala, y en Esem, y en Tholad,

verses.KJV: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.WEB: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
verses.ASV: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.ALMEIDA: Betuel, Hormá, Ziclague.
verses.RVR09: Y en Bethuel, y en Horma, y en Siclag,

verses.KJV: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.WEB: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
verses.ASV: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bete-Marcabote, Hazar-Susim, Bete-Birai, e em Saaraim. Estas foram suas cidades até quando Davi começou a reinar.
verses.RVR09: Y en Beth-marchâboth, y en Hasasusim, y en Beth-birai, y en Saaraim. Estas fueron sus ciudades hasta el reino de David.

verses.KJV: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
verses.WEB: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
verses.ASV: And their villages were Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas aldeias foram: Etã, Aim, Rimom, e Toquém, e Asã, cinco cidades;
verses.RVR09: Y sus aldeas fueron Etam, Ain, Rimmón, y Tochên, y Asán, cinco pueblos;

verses.KJV: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
verses.WEB: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.
verses.ASV: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and they have their genealogy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as suas aldeias que estavam ao redor destas cidades, até Baal. Estas foram suas habitações, e suas genealogias.
verses.RVR09: Y todos su villajes que estaban en contorno de estas ciudades hasta Baal. Esta fué su habitación, y esta su descendencia.

verses.KJV: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,
verses.WEB: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.ASV: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Mesobabe, Janleque, Josias filho de Amazias;
verses.RVR09: Y Mesobab, y Jamlech, y Josías hijo de Amasías;

verses.KJV: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.WEB: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.ASV: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.ALMEIDA: Joel, Jeú filho de Josibias, filho de Seraías, filho de Asiel;
verses.RVR09: Joel, y Jehú hijo de Josibias, hijo de Seraíah, hijo de Aziel;

verses.KJV: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.WEB: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
verses.ASV: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Elioenai, Jaacobá, Jesoaías, Asaias, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaia;
verses.RVR09: Y Elioenai, Jacoba, Jesohaía, Asaías, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaías;

verses.KJV: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.WEB: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
verses.ASV: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ziza filho de Sifi, filho de Alom, filho de Jedaías, filho de Sinri, filho de Semaías.
verses.RVR09: Y Ziza hijo de Siphi, hijo de Allón, hijo de Jedaía, hijo de Simri, hijo de Semaías.

verses.KJV: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
verses.WEB: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
verses.ASV: these mentioned by name were princes in their families: and their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes registrados por [seus] nomes foram os líderes de suas famílias, e que foram multiplicados muito nas casas de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Estos por sus nombres son los principales que vinieron en sus familias, y que fueron multiplicados muy mucho en las casas de sus padres.

verses.KJV: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.WEB: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.ASV: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chegaram até a entrada de Gedor, até o oriente do vale, buscando pastos para suas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y llegaron hasta la entrada de Gador hasta el oriente del valle, buscando pastos para sus ganados.

verses.KJV: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.WEB: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.
verses.ASV: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they that dwelt there aforetime were of Ham.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acharam pastos férteis e bons, e a terra era espaçosa, quieta, e descansada, porque os de Cam tinham habitado ali antes.
verses.RVR09: Y hallaron gruesos y buenos pastos, y tierra ancha y espaciosa, y quieta y reposada, porque los de Châm la habitaban de antes.

verses.KJV: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.WEB: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.ASV: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the Meunim that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their stead; because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois, que foram escritos por seus nomes, vieram nos dias de Ezequias rei de Judá, e derrubaram as tendas e habitações dos que se acharam ali, e os destruíram até hoje; e habitaram ali em seu lugar, porque ali havia pastos para suas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y estos que han sido escritos por sus nombres, vinieron en días de Ezechîas rey de Judá, y desbarataron sus tiendas y estancias que allí hallaron, y destruyéronlos, hasta hoy, y habitaron allí en lugar de ellos; por cuanto había allí pastos para sus ganados.

verses.KJV: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.WEB: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.ASV: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também [alguns] deles, quinhentos homens dos filhos de Simeão, se foram ao monte de Seir, levando como capitães a Pelatias, Nearias, Refaías, e a Uziel, filhos de Isi;
verses.RVR09: Y asimismo quinientos hombres de ellos, de los hijos de Simeón, se fueron al monte de Seir, llevando por capitanes á Pelatía, y á Nearías, y á Rephaías, y á Uzziel, hijos de Isi;

verses.KJV: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.WEB: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.
verses.ASV: And they smote the remnant of the Amalekites that escaped, and have dwelt there unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mataram os que haviam restado dos amalequitas, e habitaram ali até hoje.
verses.RVR09: E hirieron á las reliquias que habían quedado de Amalec, y habitaron allí hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
verses.WEB: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.
