verses.ASV: And the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel (for he was the first-born; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto aos filhos de Rúben, primogênito de Israel (porque ele era o primogênito, mas como profanou a cama de de seu pai, seu direito de primogenitura foi dado aos filhos de José, filho de Israel; e não foi contado por primogênito.
verses.RVR09: Y LOS hijos de Rubén, primogénito de Israel, (porque él era el primogénito, mas como violó el lecho de su padre, sus derechos de primogenitura fueron dados á los hijos de José, hijo de Israel; y no fué contado por primogénito.

verses.KJV: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)
verses.WEB: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—
verses.ASV: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s),
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Judá foi o mais poderoso sobre seus irmãos, e o líder veio dele; mas o direito de primogenitura pertenceu a José).
verses.RVR09: Porque Judá fué el mayorazgo sobre sus hermanos, y el príncipe de ellos: mas el derecho de primogenitura fué de José.)

verses.KJV: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.WEB: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.ASV: the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Rúben, primogênito de Israel, foram, pois: Enoque, Palu, Hezrom e Carmi.
verses.RVR09: Fueron pues los hijos de Rubén, primogénito de Israel: Enoch, Phallu, Esrón y Charmi.

verses.KJV: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.WEB: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.ASV: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Joel foram: seu filho Semaías, seu filho Gogue, seu filho Simei;
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Joel: Semaías su hijo, Gog su hijo, Simi su hijo;

verses.KJV: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
verses.WEB: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
verses.ASV: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Mica, seu filho Reaías, seu filho Baal;
verses.RVR09: Michâ su hijo, Recaía su hijo, Baal su hijo;

verses.KJV: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.WEB: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.ASV: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Beera, o qual foi transportado por Tiglate-Pilneser, rei dos Assírios. Este era um líder dos Rubenitas.
verses.RVR09: Beera su hijo, el cual fué trasportado por Thiglath-pilneser rey de los Asirios. Este era principal de los Rubenitas.

verses.KJV: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.WEB: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.ASV: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos por suas famílias, quando foram registrados em suas descendências, tinham por líderes a Jeiel, Zacarias.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos por sus familias, cuando eran contados en sus descendencias, tenían por príncipes á Jeiel y á Zachârías.

verses.KJV: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
verses.WEB: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
verses.ASV: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Belá, filho de Azaz, filho de Sema, filho de Joel. Eles habitaram em Aroer até Nebo e Baal-Meom.
verses.RVR09: Y Bela hijo de Azaz, hijo de Sema, hijo de Joel, habitó en Aroer hasta Nebo y Baal-meón.

verses.KJV: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.WEB: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.ASV: and eastward he dwelt even unto the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Habitaram também desde o oriente até a entrada do deserto desde o rio Eufrates; porque seu gado tinha se multiplicado na terra de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Habitó también desde el oriente hasta la entrada del desierto desde el río Eufrates: porque tenía muchos ganados en la tierra de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
verses.WEB: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
verses.ASV: And in the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the [land] east of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nos dias de Saul fizeram guerra contra os hagarenos, que caíram em suas mãos; e eles habitaram em suas tendas sobre toda a região oriental de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Y en los días de Saúl trajeron guerra contra los Agarenos, los cuales cayeron en su mano; y ellos habitaron en sus tiendas sobre toda la haz oriental de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salcah:
verses.WEB: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
verses.ASV: And the sons of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salecah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Gade habitaram na vizinhança deles na terra de Basã até Salca.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Gad habitaron enfrente de ellos en la tierra de Basán hasta Salca.

verses.KJV: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.WEB: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.ASV: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joel foi o líder em Basã, o segundo Safã, em seguida Janai, e Safate.
verses.RVR09: Y Joel fué el principal en Basán, el segundo Sephán, luego Janai, después Saphat.

verses.KJV: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
verses.WEB: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
verses.ASV: And their brethren of their fathers’ houses: Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos, segundo as famílias de seus pais, foram sete: Micael, Mesulão, Sebá, Jorai, Jacã, Zia, e Héber.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos, según las familias de sus padres, fueron Michâel, Mesullam, Seba, Jorai, Jachân, Zia, y Heber; en todos siete.

verses.KJV: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.WEB: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.ASV: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os filhos de Abiail filho de Huri, filho de Jaroa, filho de Gileade, filho de Micael, filho de Jesisai, filho de Jado, filho de Buz.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron los hijos de Abihail hijo de Huri, hijo de Jaroa, hijo de Galaad, hijo de Michâel, hijo de Jesiaí, hijo de Jaddo, hijo de Buz.

verses.KJV: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
verses.WEB: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
verses.ASV: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aí, filho de Abdiel, filho de Guni, foi chefe da casa de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: También Ahí, hijo de Abdiel, hijo de Guni, fué principal en la casa de sus padres.

verses.KJV: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
verses.WEB: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.
verses.ASV: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, as far as their borders.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles habitaram em Gileade, em Basã, e em suas aldeias, e em todos os campos de Sarom até os seus extremos.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales habitaron en Galaad, en Basán, y en sus aldeas, y en todos los ejidos de Sarón hasta salir de ellos.

verses.KJV: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.WEB: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.ASV: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes foram contados segundo suas genealogias nos dias de Jotão, rei de Judá, e no dias de Jeroboão, rei de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos fueron contados por sus generaciones en días de Jothán rey de Judá, y en días de Jeroboam rey de Israel.

verses.KJV: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
verses.WEB: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.
verses.ASV: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were forty and four thousand seven hundred and threescore, that were able to go forth to war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Rúben, e de Gade, e da meia tribo de Manassés, homens guerreiros, homens que traziam escudo e espada, que entesavam arco, e habilidosos em guerra, havia quarenta e quatro mil setecentos e sessenta capazes de ir para a batalha.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Rubén, y de Gad, y la media tribu de Manasés, hombres valientes, hombres que traían escudo y espada, que entesaban arco, y diestros en guerra, eran cuarenta y cuatro mil setecientos y sesenta que salían á batalla.

verses.KJV: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
verses.WEB: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.ASV: And they made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fizeram guerra contra os Hagarenos, como também a Jetur, Nafis, e Nodabe.
verses.RVR09: Y tuvieron guerra con los Agarenos, y Jethur, y Naphis, y Nodab.

verses.KJV: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
verses.WEB: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.
verses.ASV: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he was entreated of them, because they put their trust in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram ajudados contra ele; assim os hagarenos, e todos quantos estavam com eles, foram enregues em suas mãos, porque clamaram a Deus na batalha, e ele lhes atendeu, pois confiaram nele.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron ayudados contra ellos, y los Agarenos se dieron en sus manos, y todos los que con ellos estaban; porque clamaron á Dios en la guerra, y fuéles favorable, porque esperaron en él.

verses.KJV: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
verses.WEB: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.
verses.ASV: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men a hundred thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaram seu gado, cinquenta mil de seus camelos, duzentas e cinquenta mil ovelhas, dois mil asnos, e cem mil pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron sus ganados, cincuenta mil camellos, y doscientas cincuenta mil ovejas, dos mil asnos, y cien mil personas.

verses.KJV: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
verses.WEB: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
verses.ASV: For there fell many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their stead until the captivity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos caíram mortos, porque a guerra era de Deus; e habitaram em seus lugares até o cativeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y cayeron muchos heridos, porque la guerra era de Dios; y habitaron en sus lugares hasta la transmigración.

verses.KJV: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
verses.WEB: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
verses.ASV: And the children of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir and mount Hermon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos da meia tribo de Manassés habitaram naquela terra, e eles se multiplicaram desde Basã até Baal-Hermom, e Senir e o monte de Hermom.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de la media tribu de Manasés habitaron en la tierra, desde Basán hasta Baal-Hermón, y Senir y el monte de Hermón, multiplicados en gran manera.

verses.KJV: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
verses.WEB: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
verses.ASV: And these were the heads of their fathers’ houses: even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os cabeças das casas de seus pais: Efer, Isi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremias, Hodavias, e Jadiel, homens valentes e fortes, homens renomados, e cabeças das casas de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y estas fueron las cabezas de las casas de sus padres: Epher, Isi, y Eliel, Azriel, y Jeremías, y Odavia, y Jadiel, hombres valientes y de esfuerzo, varones de nombre y cabeceras de las casas de sus padres.

verses.KJV: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.WEB: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.
verses.ASV: And they trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the harlot after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles transgrediram contra o Deus de seus pais, e se prostituíram seguindo os deuses dos povos da terra, aos quais o SENHOR havia destruído de diante deles.
verses.RVR09: Mas se rebelaron contra el Dios de sus padres, y fornicaron siguiendo los dioses de los pueblos de la tierra, á los cuales había Jehová quitado de delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
verses.WEB: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
verses.ASV: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river of Gozan, unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o Deus de Israel despertou ao espírito de Pul, rei da Assíria, e ao espírito de Tiglate-Pilneser, rei da Assíria, o qual levou presos os rubenitas, os gaditas e à meia tribo de Manassés, e os trouxe até Hala, Habor, Hara, e ao rio Gozã, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual el Dios de Israel excitó el espíritu de Phul rey de los Asirios, y el espíritu de Thiglath-pilneser rey de los Asirios, el cual trasportó á los Rubenitas y Gaditas y á la media tribu de Manasés, y llevólos á Halad, y á Habor y á Ara, y al río de Gozán, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.WEB: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ASV: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Levi foram: Gérson, Coate, e Merari.
verses.RVR09: LOS hijos de Leví: Gersón, Coath, y Merari.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.WEB: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Coath: Amram, Ishar, Hebrón y Uzziel.

verses.KJV: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.WEB: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.ASV: And the children of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Anrão: Arão, Moisés, e Miriã. E os filhos de Arão foram: Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar, e Itamar.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Amram: Aarón, Moisés, y Mariam. Los hijos de Aarón: Nadab, Abiú, Eleazar, é Ithamar.

verses.KJV: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.WEB: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
verses.ASV: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eleazar gerou a Fineias, Fineias gerou a Abisua;
verses.RVR09: Eleazar engendró á Phinees, y Phinees engendró á Abisua:

verses.KJV: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.WEB: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
verses.ASV: and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.ALMEIDA: Abisua gerou a Buqui, Buqui gerou a Uzi;
verses.RVR09: Y Abisua engendró á Bucci, y Bucci engendró á Uzzi;

verses.KJV: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.WEB: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.
verses.ASV: and Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Uzi gerou a Zeraías, Zeraías gerou a Meraiote;
verses.RVR09: Y Uzzi engendró á Zeraías, y Zeraías engendró á Meraioth;

verses.KJV: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.WEB: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
verses.ASV: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.ALMEIDA: Meraiote gerou a Amarias, Amarias gerou a Aitube;
verses.RVR09: Y Meraioth engendró á Amarías, y Amarías engendró á Achîtob;

verses.KJV: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.WEB: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
verses.ASV: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aitube gerou a Zadoque, Zadoque gerou a Aimaaz;
verses.RVR09: Y Achîtob engendró á Sadoc, y Sadoc engendró á Achîmaas;

verses.KJV: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.WEB: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
verses.ASV: and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aimaaz gerou a Azarias, Azarias gerou a Joanã;
verses.RVR09: Y Achîmaas engendró á Azarías, y Azarías engendró á Johanan;

verses.KJV: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
verses.WEB: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: and Johanan begat Azariah (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem),
verses.ALMEIDA: Joanã gerou a Azarias (este é o que administrou o sacerdócio na casa que Salomão edificou em Jerusalém);
verses.RVR09: Y Johanan engendró á Azarías, el que tuvo el sacerdocio en la casa que Salomón edificó en Jerusalem;

verses.KJV: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.WEB: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
verses.ASV: and Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.ALMEIDA: Azarias gerou a Amarias, Amarias gerou a Aitube;
verses.RVR09: Y Azarías engendró á Amarías, y Amarías engendró á Achîtob;

verses.KJV: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
verses.WEB: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.
verses.ASV: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aitube gerou a Zadoque, Zadoque gerou a Salum;
verses.RVR09: Y Achîtob engendró á Sadoc, y Sadoc engendró á Sallum;

verses.KJV: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.WEB: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.
verses.ASV: and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Salum gerou a Hilquias, Hilquias gerou a Azarias;
verses.RVR09: Y Sallum engendró á Hilcías, é Hilcías engendró á Azarías;

verses.KJV: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
verses.WEB: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.
verses.ASV: and Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak;
verses.ALMEIDA: Azarias gerou a Seraías, Seraías, gerou a Jeozadaque.
verses.RVR09: Y Azarías engendró á Seraíah, y Seraíah engendró á Josadec.

verses.KJV: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.WEB: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.ASV: And Jehozadak went [into captivity], when Jehovah carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jeozadaque foi [levado cativo] quando O SENHOR levou Judá e a Jerusalém como prisioneiros, pela mão de Nabucodonosor.
verses.RVR09: Y Josadec fué cautivo cuando Jehová trasportó á Judá y á Jerusalem por mano de Nabucodonosor.

verses.KJV: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.WEB: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ASV: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Levi foram: Gérson, Coate, e Merari.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Leví: Gersón, Coath, y Merari.

verses.KJV: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
verses.ASV: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Gérson: Libni, e Simei.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los nombres de los hijos de Gersón: Libni, y Simi.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.WEB: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, e Uziel.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Coath: Amram, Ishar, Hebrón, y Uzziel.

verses.KJV: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.WEB: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
verses.ASV: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ [houses].
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Merari: Mali, e Musi. Estas são as famílias de Levi, segundo seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Merari: Mahali, y Musi. Estas son las familias de Leví, según sus descendencias.

verses.KJV: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.WEB: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.ASV: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: De Gérson: seu filho Libni, seu filho Jaate, seu filho Zima.
verses.RVR09: Gersón: Libni su hijo, Joath su hijo, Zimma su hijo,

verses.KJV: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
verses.WEB: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
verses.ASV: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Joabe, seu filho Ido, seu filho Zerá, e seu filho Jeaterai.
verses.RVR09: Joab su hijo, Iddo su hijo, Zera su hijo, Jeothrai su hijo.

verses.KJV: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.WEB: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.ASV: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Coate foram: seu filho Aminadabe, seu filho Corá, seu filho Assir,
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Coath: Aminadab su hijo, Coré su hijo, Asir su hijo,

verses.KJV: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.WEB: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
verses.ASV: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Elcana, seu filho Ebiasafe, seu filho Assir,
verses.RVR09: Elcana su hijo, Abiasaph su hijo, Asir su hijo,

verses.KJV: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.WEB: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.ASV: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Taate, seu filho Uriel, seu filho Uzias, e seu filho Saul.
verses.RVR09: Thahath su hijo, Uriel su hijo, Uzzia su hijo, y Saúl su hijo.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.WEB: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos Elcana foram: Amasai e Aimote.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Elcana: Amasai, Achîmoth, y Elcana.

verses.KJV: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.WEB: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.ASV: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Quanto] a Elcana, os filhos de Elcana foram: seu filho Zofai, seu filho Naate,
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Elcana: Sophai su hijo, Nahath su hijo,

verses.KJV: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.WEB: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
verses.ASV: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Eliabe, seu filho Jeroão, e seu filho Elcana.
verses.RVR09: Eliab su hijo, Jeroham su hijo, Elcana su hijo.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Samuel: the first-born, [Joel], and the second Abijah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Samuel foram: o primogênito Vasni, e Abias.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Samuel: el primogénito Vasni, y Abías.

verses.KJV: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.WEB: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.ASV: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Merari: Mali, seu filho Libni, seu filho Simei, seu filho Uzá,
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Merari: Mahali, Libni su hijo, Simi su hijo, Uzza su hijo,

verses.KJV: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.WEB: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.ASV: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Simeia, seu filho Hagias, e seu filho Asaías.
verses.RVR09: Sima su hijo, Haggía su hijo, Assía su hijo.

verses.KJV: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.
verses.WEB: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.
verses.ASV: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of Jehovah, after that the ark had rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois, são os que Davi constituiu para o ofício da música da casa do Senhor, depois que a arca teve repouso.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son á los que David dió cargo de las cosas de la música de la casa de Jehová, después que el arca tuvo reposo:

verses.KJV: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.WEB: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.
verses.ASV: And they ministered with song before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, until Solomon had built the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem: and they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles serviam diante da tenda do tabernáculo da congregação com cânticos, até que Salomão edificou a casa do SENHOR em Jerusalém; e estiveram segundo seu costume em seu serviço.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales servían delante de la tienda del tabernáculo del testimonio en cantares, hasta que Salomón edificó la casa de Jehová en Jerusalem: después estuvieron en su ministerio según su costumbre.

verses.KJV: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
verses.WEB: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
verses.ASV: And these are they that waited, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois, foram os que ali estavam com seus filhos: dos filhos dos coatitas, Hemã, o cantor, filho de Joel, filho de Samuel,
verses.RVR09: Estos pues con sus hijos asistían: de los hijos de Coath, Hemán cantor, hijo de Joel, hijo de Samuel;

verses.KJV: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.WEB: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.ASV: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Elcana, filho de Jeroão, filho de Eliel, filho de Toá,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Elcana, hijo de Jeroham, hijo de Eliel, hijo de Thoa;

verses.KJV: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.WEB: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.ASV: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Zufe, filho de Elcana, filho Maate, filho de Amasai,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Suph, hijo de Elcana, hijo Mahath, hijo de Amasai;

verses.KJV: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.WEB: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.ASV: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Elcana, filho de Joel, filho de Azarias, filho de Sofonias,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Elcana, hijo de Joel, hijo de Azarías, hijo de Sophonías;

verses.KJV: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.WEB: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.ASV: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Taate, filho de Assir, filho de Ebiasafe, filho de Corá,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Thahat, hijo de Asir, hijo de Abiasaph, hijo de Core;

verses.KJV: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.WEB: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.ASV: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Izar, filho de Coate, filho de Levi, filho de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Ishar, hijo de Coath, hijo de Leví, hijo de Israel.

verses.KJV: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.WEB: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.ASV: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu irmão Asafe estava à sua direita; Asafe era, filho de Berequias, filho de Simeia,
verses.RVR09: Y su hermano Asaph, el cual estaba á su mano derecha: Asaph, hijo de Berachîas, hijo de Sima;

verses.KJV: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
verses.WEB: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
verses.ASV: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Micael, filho de Baaseias, filho de Malquias,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Michâel, hijo de Baasías, hijo de Malchîas;

verses.KJV: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.WEB: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.ASV: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Etni, filho de Zerá, filho de Adaías,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Athanai, hijo de Zera, hijo de Adaia;

verses.KJV: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.WEB: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.ASV: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Etã, filho de Zima, filho de Simei;
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Ethán, hijo de Zimma, hijo de Simi;

verses.KJV: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.WEB: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.ASV: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Jaate, filho de Gérson, filho de Levi.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Jahat, hijo de Gersón, hijo de Leví.

verses.KJV: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.WEB: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.ASV: And on the left hand their brethren the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos, os filhos de Merari, estavam à esquerda; [eram eles] : Etã, filho de Quisi, filho de Abdi, filho de Maluque,
verses.RVR09: Mas los hijos de Merari sus hermanos estaban á la mano siniestra, es á saber, Ethán hijo de Chîsi, hijo de Abdi, hijo de Maluch;

verses.KJV: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.WEB: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.ASV: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Hasabias, filho de Amazias, filho de Hilquias,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Hasabías, hijo de Amasías, hijo de Hilcías;

verses.KJV: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
verses.WEB: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
verses.ASV: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Anzi, filho de Bani, filho de Semer,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Amasai, hijo de Bani, hijo de Semer;

verses.KJV: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.WEB: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.ASV: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Mali, filho de Musi, filho de Merari, filho de Levi.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Mahali, hijo de Musi, hijo de Merari, hijo de Leví.

verses.KJV: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.WEB: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
verses.ASV: And their brethren the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos, os Levitas, foram postos para todo o serviço do tabernáculo da casa de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos los Levitas fueron puestos sobre todo el ministerio del tabernáculo de la casa de Dios.

verses.KJV: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.WEB: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.ASV: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of burnt-offering, and upon the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Arão e seus filhos ofereciam incenso sobre o altar do holocausto e sobre o altar do incenso, para toda a obra do lugar santíssimo, e para fazer expiação sobre Israel, conforme tudo quanto Moisés, servo de Deus, havia mandado.
verses.RVR09: Mas Aarón y sus hijos ofrecían perfume sobre el altar del holocausto, y sobre el altar del perfume, en toda la obra del lugar santísimo, y para hacer las expiaciones sobre Israel, conforme á todo lo que Moisés siervo de Dios había mandado.

verses.KJV: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.ASV: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os filhos de Arão: seu filho Eleazar, seu filho Fineias, seu filho Abisua,
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Aarón son estos: Eleazar su hijo, Phinees su hijo, Abisua su hijo;

verses.KJV: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.WEB: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.ASV: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Buqui, seu filho Uzi, seu filho Zeraías,
verses.RVR09: Bucci su hijo, Uzzi su hijo, Zeraías su hijo;

verses.KJV: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.WEB: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.ASV: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Meraiote, seu filho Amarias, seu filho Aitube,
verses.RVR09: Meraioth su hijo, Amarías su hijo, Achîtob su hijo;

verses.KJV: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.WEB: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
verses.ASV: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Zadoque, e seu filho Aimaaz.
verses.RVR09: Sadoc su hijo, Achîmaas su hijo.

verses.KJV: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
verses.WEB: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
verses.ASV: Now these are their dwelling-places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the [first] lot),
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas foram suas habitações, conforme seus acampamentos e seus termos, dos filhos de Arão da família dos coatitas, porque eles foram sorteados.
verses.RVR09: Y estas son sus habitaciones, conforme á sus domicilios y sus términos, las de los hijos de Aarón por las familias de los Coathitas, porque de ellos fué la suerte:

verses.KJV: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.WEB: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;
verses.ASV: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it;
verses.ALMEIDA: Deram-lhes, pois, a Hebrom na terra de Judá, e seus campos ao redor dela.
verses.RVR09: Les dieron pues á Hebrón en tierra de Judá, y sus ejidos alrededor de ella.

verses.KJV: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.WEB: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.ASV: but the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o território da cidade e suas aldeias foram dadas a Calebe, filho de Jefoné.
verses.RVR09: Mas el territorio de la ciudad y sus aldeas se dieron á Caleb, hijo de Jephone.

verses.KJV: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
verses.WEB: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
verses.ASV: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its suburbs,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos filhos de Arão deram as [seguintes] cidades de refúgio: Hebrom, e Libna com seus campos; Jathir e Estemoa com seus campos;
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de Aarón dieron las ciudades de Judá de acogimiento, es á saber, á Hebrón, y á Libna con sus ejidos;

verses.KJV: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
verses.WEB: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
verses.ASV: and Hilen with its suburbs, Debir with its suburbs,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hilém com seus campos; Debir com seus campos;
verses.RVR09: A Jathir, y Esthemoa con sus ejidos, y á Hilem con sus ejidos, y á Debir con sus ejidos;

verses.KJV: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:
verses.WEB: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;
verses.ASV: and Ashan with its suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with its suburbs;
verses.ALMEIDA: Asã com seus campos; e a Bete-Semes com seus campos;
verses.RVR09: A Asán con sus ejidos, y á Beth-semes con sus ejidos:

verses.KJV: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.WEB: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.ASV: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its suburbs, and Allemeth with its suburbs, and Anathoth with its suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo de Benjamim, a Geba com seus campos; Alemete com seus campos; e Anatote com seus campos. Todas as suas cidades, [repartidas] por suas famílias, foram treze cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de Benjamín, á Geba con sus ejidos, y á Alemeth con sus ejidos, y á Anathoth con sus ejidos. Todas sus ciudades fueron trece ciudades, repartidas por sus linajes.

verses.KJV: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
verses.WEB: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.ASV: And unto the rest of the sons of Kohath [were given] by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos filhos de Coate, que restaram da família daquela tribo, [deram] por sorteio dez cidades da meia tribo de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: A los hijos de Coath, que quedaron de su parentela, dieron diez ciudades de la media tribu de Manasés por suerte.

verses.KJV: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.WEB: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.ASV: And to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos filhos de Gérson, segundo suas famílias, [deram] treze cidades da tribo de Issacar, da tribo de Aser, da tribo de Naftali, e da tribo de Manassés, em Basã.
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de Gersón, por sus linajes, dieron de la tribu de Issachâr, y de la tribu de Aser, y de la tribu de Nephtalí, y de la tribu de Manasés en Basán, trece ciudades.

verses.KJV: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.WEB: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.ASV: Unto the sons of Merari [were given] by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos filhos de Merari, segundo suas famílias, [deram] por sorteio doze cidades da tribo de Rúben, da tribo de Gade, e da tribo de Zebulom.
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de Merari, por sus linajes, de la tribu de Rubén, y de la tribu de Gad, y de la tribu de Zabulón, se dieron por suerte doce ciudades.

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their suburbs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os filhos de Israel deram aos Levitas estas cidades com seus campos.
verses.RVR09: Y dieron los hijos de Israel á los Levitas ciudades con sus ejidos.

verses.KJV: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
verses.WEB: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
verses.ASV: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram-lhes por sorteio, da tribo dos filhos de Judá, da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, e da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, estas cidades, as quais mencionaram por seus nomes.
verses.RVR09: Y dieron por suerte de la tribu de los hijos de Judá, y de la tribu de los hijos de Simeón, y de la tribu de los hijos de Benjamín, las ciudades que nombraron por sus nombres.

verses.KJV: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.WEB: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.ASV: And some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto ao [resto] das famílias dos filhos de Coate deram-lhes cidades com seus termos da tribo de Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Y á los linajes de los hijos de Coath dieron ciudades con sus términos de la tribu de Ephraim.

verses.KJV: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.WEB: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,
verses.ASV: And they gave unto them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim with its suburbs; Gezer also with its suburbs,
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram-lhes das cidades de refúgio, a Siquém e seus campos nas montanhas de Efraim, e a Gezer com seus campos,
verses.RVR09: Y diéronles las ciudades de acogimiento, á Sichêm con sus ejidos en el monte de Ephraim, y á Gezer con sus ejidos,

verses.KJV: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
verses.WEB: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,
verses.ASV: and Jokmeam with its suburbs, and Beth-horon with its suburbs,
verses.ALMEIDA: A Jocmeão com seus campos, a Bete-Horom com seus campos,
verses.RVR09: Y á Jocmeam con sus ejidos, y á Beth-oron con sus ejidos,

verses.KJV: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
verses.WEB: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;
verses.ASV: and Aijalon with its suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with its suburbs;
verses.ALMEIDA: A Aijalom com seus campos, e a Gate-Rimom com seus campos;
verses.RVR09: Y á Ajalón con sus ejidos, y á Gath-rimmón con sus ejidos.

verses.KJV: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.WEB: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
verses.ASV: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its suburbs, and Bileam with its suburbs, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da meia tribo de Manassés, a Aner com seus campos, e a Bileã com seus campos, para os que restaram da família dos filhos de Coate.
verses.RVR09: De la media tribu de Manasés, á Aner con sus ejidos, y á Bilam con sus ejidos, para los del linaje de los hijos de Coath que habían quedado.

verses.KJV: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
verses.WEB: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;
verses.ASV: Unto the sons of Gershom [were given], out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, and Ashtaroth with its suburbs;
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos filhos de Gérson [deram] da família da meia tribo de Manassés, a Golã em Basã com seus campos e a Astarote com seus campos;
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de Gersón dieron de la familia de la media tribu de Manasés, á Golan en Basán con sus ejidos y á Astharoth con sus ejidos;

verses.KJV: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
verses.WEB: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
verses.ASV: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its suburbs, Daberath with its suburbs,
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo de Issacar, a Quedes com seus campos, a Daberate com seus campos,
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de Issachâr, á Cedes con sus ejidos, á Dobrath con sus ejidos,

verses.KJV: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
verses.WEB: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;
verses.ASV: and Ramoth with its suburbs, and Anem with its suburbs;
verses.ALMEIDA: A Ramote com seus campos, e a Aném com seus campos;
verses.RVR09: Y á Ramoth con sus ejidos, y á Anem con sus ejidos;

verses.KJV: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.WEB: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
verses.ASV: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its suburbs, and Abdon with its suburbs,
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo de Aser a Masal com seus campos, a Abdom com seus campos,
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de Aser, á Masal con sus ejidos, y á Abdón con sus ejidos,

verses.KJV: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
verses.WEB: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;
verses.ASV: and Hukok with its suburbs, and Rehob with its suburbs;
verses.ALMEIDA: A Hucoque com seus campos, e a Reobe com seus campos.
verses.RVR09: Y á Ucoc con sus ejidos, y á Rehob con sus ejidos;

verses.KJV: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
verses.WEB: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.
verses.ASV: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its suburbs, and Hammon with its suburbs, and Kiriathaim with its suburbs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo de Naftali, a Quedes na Galileia com seus campos, a Hamom com seus campos, e a Quiriataim com seus campos.
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de Nephtalí, á Cedes en Galilea con sus ejidos, y á Ammón con sus ejidos, á Chîriath-jearim con sus ejidos.

verses.KJV: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
verses.WEB: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;
verses.ASV: Unto the rest of [the Levites], the sons of Merari, [were given], out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its suburbs, Tabor with its suburbs;
verses.ALMEIDA: E aos que restaram dos filhos de Merari, [deram] da tribo de Zebulom, a Rimono com seus campos, e a Tabor com seus campos;
verses.RVR09: Y á los hijos de Merari que habían quedado, dieron de la tribu de Zabulón á Rimmono con sus ejidos, y á Thabor con sus ejidos;

verses.KJV: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
verses.WEB: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,
verses.ASV: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, [were given them], out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its suburbs, and Jahzah with its suburbs,
verses.ALMEIDA: E dalém do Jordão de Jericó, ao oriente do Jordão, [deram] da tribo de Rúben, a Bezer no deserto com seus campos; a Jaza com seus campos.
verses.RVR09: Y de la otra parte del Jordán de Jericó, al oriente del Jordán, dieron, de la tribu de Rubén, á Beser en el desierto con sus ejidos; y á Jasa con sus ejidos,

verses.KJV: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
verses.WEB: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
verses.ASV: and Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs;
verses.ALMEIDA: A Quedemote com seus campos, e a Mefaate com seus campos;
verses.RVR09: Y á Chêdemoth con sus ejidos, y á Mephaath con sus ejidos;

verses.KJV: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.WEB: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
verses.ASV: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its suburbs, and Mahanaim with its suburbs,
verses.ALMEIDA: E da tribo de Gade, a Ramote em Gileade com seus campos, a Maanaim com seus campos,
verses.RVR09: Y de la tribu de Gad, á Ramot en Galaad con sus ejidos, y á Mahanaim con sus ejidos,

verses.KJV: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
verses.WEB: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.
verses.ASV: and Heshbon with its suburbs, and Jazer with its suburbs.
verses.ALMEIDA: A Hesbom com seus campos, e a Jazer com seus campos.
verses.RVR09: Y á Hesbón con sus ejidos, y á Jacer con sus ejidos.

verses.KJV: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.
verses.WEB: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.ASV: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Issacar foram quatro: Tolá, Pua, Jasube, e Sinrom.
verses.RVR09: LOS hijos de Issachâr, cuatro: Thola, Phúa, Jabsub, y Simrón.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
verses.WEB: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, [to wit], of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations: their number in the days of David was two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Tolá foram: Uzi, Refaías, Jeriel, Jamai, Ibsão e Samuel, cabeças das famílias de seus pais. De Tolá foram contados por suas genealogias no tempo de Davi vinte e dois mil seiscentos homens guerreiros.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Thola: Uzzi, Rephaías, Jeriel, Jamai, Jibsam y Samuel, cabezas en las familias de sus padres. De Thola fueron contados por sus linajes en el tiempo de David, veintidós mil seiscientos hombres muy valerosos.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
verses.WEB: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
verses.ALMEIDA: O filho de Uzi foi Izraías; e os filhos de Izraías foram: Micael, Obadias, Joel, e Issias; todos estes cinco foram líderes.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Uzzi fué Izrahías; y los hijos de Izrahías: Michâel, Obadías, Joel, é Isías: todos, cinco príncipes.

verses.KJV: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
verses.WEB: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
verses.ASV: And with them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the host for war, six and thirty thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia com eles em suas genealogias, segundo as famílias de seus pais, trinta e seis mil homens de guerra, porque tiveram muitas mulheres e filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y había con ellos en sus linajes, por las familias de sus padres, treinta y seis mil hombres de guerra: porque tuvieron muchas mujeres é hijos.

verses.KJV: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.WEB: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.
verses.ASV: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, reckoned in all by genealogy, were fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos em todas as famílias de Issacar, todos contados por suas genealogias, foram oitenta e sete mil guerreiros valentes.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos por todas las familias de Issachâr, contados todos por sus genealogías, eran ochenta y siete mil hombres valientes en extremo.

verses.KJV: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.WEB: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.ASV: [The sons of] Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os [filhos] de Benjamim foram três: Belá, Bequer, e Jediael.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Benjamín fueron tres: Bela, Bechêr, y Jediael.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.WEB: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were reckoned by genealogy twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Belá foram: Esbom, Uzi, Uziel, Jerimote, e Iri; cinco cabeças de famílias paternas, guerreiros valentes, dos quais foram contados por suas genealogias vinte e dois mil e trinta e quatro.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Bela: Esbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, é Iri; cinco cabezas de casas de linajes, hombres de gran valor, y de cuya descendencia fueron contados veintidós mil treinta y cuatro.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
verses.WEB: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Bequer: Zemira, Joás, Eliézer, Elioenai, Onri, Jerimote, Abias, Anatote e Alemete; todos estes foram filhos de Bequer.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Bechêr: Zemira, Joas, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jerimoth, Abías, Anathoth y Alemeth; todos estos fueron hijos de Bechêr.

verses.KJV: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.WEB: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.
verses.ASV: And they were reckoned by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram contados por suas genealogias, segundo suas descendências, e os cabeças de suas famílias, vinte mil e duzentos guerreiros valentes.
verses.RVR09: Y contados por sus descendencias, por sus linajes, los que eran cabezas de sus familias, resultaron veinte mil y doscientos hombres de grande esfuerzo.

verses.KJV: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.WEB: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filho de Jediael foi Bilã; e os filhos de Bilã foram: Jeús, Benjamim, Eúde, Quenaaná, Zetã, Társis, e Aisaar.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Jediael fué Bilhán; y los hijos de Bilhán: Jebús, Benjamín, Aod, Chênaana, Zethán, Tharsis, y Ahisahar.

verses.KJV: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
verses.WEB: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
verses.ASV: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ [houses], mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand and two hundred, that were able to go forth in the host for war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes filhos de Jediael foram cabeças de famílias, guerreiros valentes, dezessete mil e duzentos que saíam com o exército para a guerra.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos fueron hijos de Jediael, cabezas de familias, hombres muy valerosos, diecisiete mil y doscientos que salían á combatir en la guerra.

verses.KJV: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.WEB: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
verses.ASV: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Supim e Hupim foram filhos de Ir; e Husim foi filho de Aer.
verses.RVR09: Y Suppim y Huppim fueron hijos de Hir: y Husim, hijo de Aher.

verses.KJV: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
verses.ASV: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Naftali foram: Jaziel, Guni, Jezer, e Salum, filhos de Bila.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Nephtalí: Jaoel, Guni, Jezer, y Sallum, hijos de Bilha.

verses.KJV: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
verses.WEB: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.ASV: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bare; she bare Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Manassés foram: Asriel, o qual foi nascido de sua concubina, a síria, a qual também lhe deu à luz Maquir, pai de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Manasés: Asriel, el cual le parió su concubina la Sira: (la cual también le parió á Machîr, padre de Galaad:

verses.KJV: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.WEB: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.ASV: And Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Maquir tomou por mulher a irmã de Hupim e Supim, cuja irmã teve por nome Maaca. O nome do segundo foi Zelofeade. E Zelofeade teve [somente] filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y Machîr tomó por mujer la hermana de Huppim y Suppim, cuya hermana tuvo por nombre Maachâ:) y el nombre del segundo fué Salphaad. Y Salphaad tuvo hijas.

verses.KJV: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.WEB: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.ASV: And Maacah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Maaca mulher de Maquir lhe gerou um filho, e chamou seu nome Perez; e o nome de seu irmão foi Seres, cujos filhos foram Ulão e Requém.
verses.RVR09: Y Maachâ mujer de Machîr le parió un hijo, y llamóle Peres; y el nombre de su hermano fué Seres, cuyos hijos fueron Ulam y Recem.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o filho de Ulão foi Bedã. Estes foram os filhos de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Ulam fué Bedán. Estos fueron los hijos de Galaad, hijo de Machîr, hijo de Manasés.

verses.KJV: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
verses.WEB: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.ASV: And his sister Hammolecheth bare Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua irmã Hamolequete deu à luz Isode, Abiezer, e Maalá.
verses.RVR09: Y su hermana Molechêt parió á Ischôd, y á Abiezer, y Mahala.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.WEB: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Semida foram Aiã, Siquém, Liqui, e Anião.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Semida fueron Ahián, Sechêm, Licci, y Aniam.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.WEB: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.ASV: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Efraim: Sutela, seu filho Berede, seu filho Taate, seu filho Eleada, seu filho Taate,
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Ephraim: Suthela, Bered su hijo, su hijo Thahath, Elada su hijo, Thahath su hijo,

verses.KJV: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.WEB: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
verses.ASV: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in the land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Zabade, seu filho Sutela, seu filho, Ézer, e Eleade. Mas os homens de Gate, naturais daquela terra, os mataram, porque desceram para tomar seus gados.
verses.RVR09: Zabad su hijo, y Suthela su hijo, Ezer, y Elad. Mas los hijos de Gath, naturales de aquella tierra, los mataron, porque vinieron á tomarles sus ganados.

verses.KJV: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.WEB: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
verses.ASV: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso seu pai Efraim esteve de luto por muitos dias, e seus irmãos vieram consolá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Y Ephraim su padre hizo duelo por muchos días, y vinieron sus hermanos á consolarlo.

verses.KJV: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.WEB: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
verses.ASV: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois ele se deitou com sua mulher, ela concebeu, e deu à luz um filho, ao qual chamou por nome Berias, pois o desastre havia ocorrido em sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Entrando él después á su mujer ella concibió, y parió un hijo, al cual puso por nombre Bería; por cuanto había estado en aflicción en su casa.

verses.KJV: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
verses.WEB: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
verses.ASV: And his daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua filha foi Seerá, a qual edificou a Bete-Horom, a baixa e a alta, como também a Uzém-Seerá.
verses.RVR09: Y su hija fué Seera, la cual edificó á Beth-oron la baja y la alta, y á Uzzen-seera.

verses.KJV: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son.
verses.WEB: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
verses.ASV: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu filho foi Refa, seu filho Resefe, seu filho Telá, seu filho Taã,
verses.RVR09: Hijo de este Bería fué Repha, y Reseph, y Thela su hijo, y Taán su hijo,

verses.KJV: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son.
verses.WEB: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.ASV: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Laadã, seu filho Amiúde, seu filho Elisama,
verses.RVR09: Laadán su hijo, Ammiud su hijo, Elisama su hijo,

verses.KJV: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.
verses.WEB: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
verses.ASV: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu filho Num, e seu filho Josué.
verses.RVR09: Nun su hijo, Josué su hijo.

verses.KJV: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
verses.WEB: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
verses.ASV: And their possessions and habitations were Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Azzah and the towns thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a propriedade e habitação deles foi Betel com suas aldeias, e ao oriente Naarã, e ao ocidente Gezer e suas aldeias, como também Siquém com suas aldeias, até Aia e suas aldeias;
verses.RVR09: Y la heredad y habitación de ellos fué Beth-el con sus aldeas: y hacia el oriente Naarán, y á la parte del occidente Gezer y sus aldeas: asimismo Sichêm con sus aldeas, hasta Asa y sus aldeas;

verses.KJV: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.WEB: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
verses.ASV: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E da parte dos filhos de Manassés, Bete-Seã com suas aldeias, Taanaque com suas aldeias, Megido com suas aldeias, e Dor com suas aldeias. Nestes [lugares] habitaram os filhos de José, filho de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y á la parte de los hijos de Manasés, Beth-seán con sus aldeas, Thanach con sus aldeas, Megiddo con sus aldeas, Dor con sus aldeas. En estos lugares habitaron los hijos de José, hijo de Israel.

verses.KJV: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.WEB: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.
verses.ASV: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Aser foram: Imná, Isvá, Isvi, Berias, e sua irmã Sera.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Aser: Imna, Isua, Isui, Bería, y su hermana Sera.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
verses.WEB: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Berias foram: Héber, e Malquiel, o qual foi pai de Bizarvite.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Bería: Heber, y Machîel, el cual fué padre de Birzabith.

verses.KJV: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.WEB: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.ASV: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Héber gerou a Jaflete, Semer, Hotão, e sua irmã Suá.
verses.RVR09: Y Heber engendró á Japhlet, Semer, Hotham, y Sua hermana de ellos.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.WEB: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Jaflete foram: Pasaque, Bimal, e Asvate. Estes foram os filhos de Jaflete.
