verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Japhlet: Pasac, Bimhal, y Asvath. Aquestos los hijos de Japhlet.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.WEB: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Semer foram: Aí, Roga, Jeubá, e Arã.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Semer: Ahi, Roega, Jehubba, y Aram.

verses.KJV: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.WEB: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de seu irmão Helém foram: Zofa, Imná, Seles, e Amal.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Helem su hermano: Sopha, Imna, Selles, y Amal.

verses.KJV: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.WEB: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
verses.ASV: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Zofa foram: Suá, Harnefer, Sual, Beri, Inra,
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Sopha: Sua, Harnapher, Sual, Beri, Imra,

verses.KJV: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.WEB: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
verses.ASV: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bezer, Hode, Samá, Silsa, Iltrã e Beera.
verses.RVR09: Beser, Hod, Samma, Silsa, Ithrán y Beera.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispa, and Ara.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Jéter foram: Jefoné, Pispa, e Ara.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Jether: Jephone, Pispa, y Ara.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Ula foram; Ara, Haniel, e Rizia.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Ulla; Ara, y Haniel, y Resia.

verses.KJV: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
verses.WEB: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
verses.ASV: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. And the number of them reckoned by genealogy for service in war was twenty and six thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes foram filhos de Aser, cabeças de famílias paternas, escolhidos guerreiros valentes, chefes de príncipes; e foram contados em suas genealogias no exército para a guerra, em número de vinte e seis mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Y todos estos fueron hijos de Aser, cabezas de familias paternas, escogidos, esforzados, cabezas de príncipes: y contados que fueron por sus linajes entre los de armas tomar, el número de ellos fué veintiséis mil hombres.

verses.KJV: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.WEB: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
verses.ASV: And Benjamin begat Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.ALMEIDA: Benjamim gerou a Belá seu primogênito, Asbel o segundo, Aará o terceiro,
verses.RVR09: BENJAMÍN engendró á Bela su primogénito, Asbel el segundo, Ara el tercero,

verses.KJV: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.WEB: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.ASV: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Noá o quarto, e Rafa o quinto.
verses.RVR09: Noha el cuarto, y Rapha el quinto.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.WEB: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
verses.ASV: And Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Belá foram: Adar, Gera, Abiúde,
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Bela fueron Addar, Gera, Abiud,

verses.KJV: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.WEB: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
verses.ASV: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Abisua, Naamã, Aoá,
verses.RVR09: Abisua, Naamán, Ahoa,

verses.KJV: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.WEB: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.ASV: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gera, Sefufá, e Hurão.
verses.RVR09: Y Gera, Sephuphim, y Huram.

verses.KJV: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:
verses.ASV: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers’ [houses] of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them captive to Manahath:
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes foram os filhos de Eúde, os quais foram os cabeças das famílias dos moradores em Geba, que foram levados cativos a Manaate:
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los hijos de Ehud, estos las cabezas de padres que habitaron en Gabaa, y fueron trasportados á Manahath:

verses.KJV: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.WEB: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.ASV: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, he carried them captive; and he begat Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naamã, Aías, e Gera; este os levou cativos, e gerou a Uzá e a Aiúde.
verses.RVR09: Es á saber: Naamán, Achîas, y Gera: éste los trasportó, y engendró á Uzza, y á Ahihud.

verses.KJV: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.WEB: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.ASV: And Shaharaim begat children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Saaraim gerou filhos na terra de Moabe, depois que deixou a suas mulheres Husim e Baara.
verses.RVR09: Y Saharaim engendró hijos en la provincia de Moab, después que dejó á Husim y á Baara que eran sus mujeres.

verses.KJV: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.WEB: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
verses.ASV: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,
verses.ALMEIDA: De sua mulher Hodes ele gerou a Jobabe, Zíbia, Messa, Malcã,
verses.RVR09: Engendró pues de Chôdes su mujer, á Jobab, Sibias, Mesa, Malchâm,

verses.KJV: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.WEB: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
verses.ASV: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ [houses].
verses.ALMEIDA: Jeús, Saquias, e Mirma. Estes foram seus filhos, cabeças de famílias.
verses.RVR09: Jeus, Sochîas, y Mirma. Estos son sus hijos, cabezas de familias.

verses.KJV: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.WEB: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
verses.ASV: And of Hushim he begat Abitub and Elpaal.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Husim ele gerou a Abitube, e a Elpaal.
verses.RVR09: Mas de Husim engendró á Abitob, y á Elphaal.

verses.KJV: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.WEB: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
verses.ASV: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with the towns thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Elpaal foram: Héber, Misã, Semede (o qual edificou a Ono e a Lode com suas aldeias),
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Elphaal: Heber, Misam, y Semeb, (el cual edificó á Ono, y á Loth con sus aldeas,)

verses.KJV: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.WEB: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
verses.ASV: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ [houses] of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como Berias, e Sema, que foram cabeças das famílias dos moradores de Aijalom, os quais afugentaram aos moradores de Gate.
verses.RVR09: Berías también, y Sema, que fueron las cabezas de las familias de los moradores de Ajalón, los cuales echaron á los moradores de Gath;

verses.KJV: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.WEB: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
verses.ASV: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Aiô, Sasaque, Jeremote,
verses.RVR09: Y Ahío, Sasac, Jeremoth;

verses.KJV: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
verses.WEB: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
verses.ASV: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,
verses.ALMEIDA: Zebadias, Arade, Eder;
verses.RVR09: Zebadías, Arad, Heder;

verses.KJV: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.WEB: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,
verses.ASV: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Micael, Ispa, e Joá, foram filhos de Berias.
verses.RVR09: Michâel, Ispha, y Joa, hijos de Berías;

verses.KJV: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.WEB: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
verses.ASV: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zebadias, Mesulão, Hizqui, Héber,
verses.RVR09: Y Zebadías, Mesullam, Hizchî, Heber;

verses.KJV: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.WEB: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
verses.ASV: and Ishmerai, and Izliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ismerai, Izlias, e Jobabe, foram filhos de Elpaal.
verses.RVR09: Ismari, Izlia, y Jobab, hijos de Elphaal.

verses.KJV: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.WEB: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
verses.ASV: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jaquim, Zicri, Zabdi,
verses.RVR09: Y Jacim, Zichri, Zabdi;

verses.KJV: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.WEB: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
verses.ASV: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,
verses.ALMEIDA: Elioenai, Ziletai, Eliel,
verses.RVR09: Elioenai, Silithai, Eliel;

verses.KJV: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
verses.WEB: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
verses.ASV: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
verses.ALMEIDA: Adaías, Beraías, e Sinrate, foram filhos de Simei.
verses.RVR09: Adaías, Baraías, y Simrath, hijos de Simi;

verses.KJV: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.WEB: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
verses.ASV: and Ishpan, and Eber, and Eliel,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ispã, Héber, Eliel,
verses.RVR09: E Isphán, Heber, Eliel;

verses.KJV: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.WEB: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
verses.ASV: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Abdom, Zicri, Hanã,
verses.RVR09: Adón, Zichri, Hanán;

verses.KJV: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.WEB: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
verses.ASV: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Anthothijah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hananias, Elão, Antotias,
verses.RVR09: Hananía, Belam, Anathothías;

verses.KJV: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.WEB: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
verses.ASV: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ifdeias, e Penuel, foram filhos de Sasaque.
verses.RVR09: Iphdaías, y Peniel, hijos de Sasac;

verses.KJV: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.WEB: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
verses.ASV: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Sanserai, Searias, Atalias;
verses.RVR09: Y Samseri, Seharías, Atalía;

verses.KJV: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.WEB: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.
verses.ASV: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jaaresias, Elias, e Zicri, foram filhos de Jeroão.
verses.RVR09: Jaarsías, Elías, Zichri, hijos de Jeroham.

verses.KJV: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: These were heads of fathers’ [houses] throughout their generations, chief men: these dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram cabeças de famílias, chefes segundo suas gerações; estes habitaram em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron jefes principales de familias por sus linajes, y habitaron en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.WEB: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon
verses.ASV: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon, [Jeiel], whose wife’s name was Maacah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E em Gibeão habitou o pai de Gibeão; e o nome de sua mulher era Maaca;
verses.RVR09: Y en Gabaón habitaron Abiga-baón, la mujer del cual se llamó Maachâ:

verses.KJV: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.WEB: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
verses.ASV: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu filho primogênito foi Abdom; depois Zur, Quis, Baal, Nadabe,
verses.RVR09: Y su hijo primogénito, Abdón, luego Sur, Chîs, Baal, Nadab,

verses.KJV: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.WEB: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
verses.ASV: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gedor, Aiô, Zequer,
verses.RVR09: Gedor, Ahíe, y Zechêr.

verses.KJV: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
verses.WEB: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
verses.ASV: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Miclote, que gerou a Simeia. Estes também habitaram perto de irmãos em Jerusalém, vizinhos a eles.
verses.RVR09: Y Micloth engendró á Simea. Estos también habitaron con sus hermanos en Jerusalem, enfrente de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.WEB: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.ASV: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ner gerou a Quis; Quis gerou a Saul, e Saul gerou a Jônatas, Malquisua, Abinadabe, e a Esbaal.
verses.RVR09: Y Ner engendró á Cis, y Cis engendró á Saúl, y Saúl engendró á Jonathán, Malchî-súa, Abinadab, y Esbaal.

verses.KJV: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.WEB: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
verses.ASV: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal, e Meribe-Baal gerou a Mica.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Jonathán fué Merib-baal, y Merib-baal engendró á Michâ.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.WEB: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Mica foram: Pitom, Meleque, Tareia e Acaz.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Michâ: Phitón, Melech, Thaarea y Ahaz.

verses.KJV: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
verses.WEB: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
verses.ASV: And Ahaz begat Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Acaz gerou a Jeoada; e Jeoada gerou a Alemete, a Azmavete, e a Zinri; e Zinri gerou a Moza.
verses.RVR09: Y Ahaz engendró á Joadda; y Joadda engendró á Elemeth, y á Azmaveth, y á Zimri; y Zimri engendró á Mosa;

verses.KJV: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.WEB: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
verses.ASV: And Moza begat Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moza gerou a Bineá, cujo filho foi Rafa, cujo filho foi Eleasá, cujo filho foi Azel.
verses.RVR09: Y Mosa engendró á Bina, hijo del cual fué Rapha, hijo del cual fué Elasa, cuyo hijo fué Asel.

verses.KJV: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.WEB: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.ASV: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Azel teve seis filhos, cujos nomes foram: Azricão, Bocru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias, e Hanã; todos estes foram filhos de Azel.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Asel fueron seis, cuyos nombres son Azricam, Bochru, Ismael, Searías, Obadías, y Hanán: todos estos fueron hijos de Asel.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.WEB: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Eseque, seu irmão, foram: Ulão seu primogênito, Jeús o segundo, e Elifelete o terceiro.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Esec su hermano: Ulam su primogénito, Jehus el segundo, Elipheleth el tercero.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Ulão foram guerreiros valentes, hábeis flecheiros; e tiveram muitos filhos e netos, cento e cinquenta. Todos estes foram dos filhos de Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: Y fueron los hijos de Ulam hombres valientes y vigorosos, flecheros diestros, los cuales tuvieron muchos hijos y nietos, ciento y cincuenta. Todos estos fueron de los hijos de Benjamín.

verses.KJV: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.WEB: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.
verses.ASV: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo Israel foi contado por genealogias, e eis que foram escritos no livro dos Reis de Israel e de Judá, que foram transportados para a Babilônia por causa de sua transgressão.
verses.RVR09: Y CONTADO todo Israel por el orden de los linajes, fueron escritos en el libro de los reyes de Israel y de Judá, que fueron trasportados á Babilonia por su rebelión.

verses.KJV: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
verses.WEB: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
verses.ASV: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os primeiros habitantes que vieram a suas propriedades em suas cidades, foram os israelitas, os sacerdotes, os levitas, e os servos do templo.
verses.RVR09: Los primeros moradores que entraron en sus posesiones en sus ciudades, fueron así de Israel, como de los sacerdotes, Levitas, y Nethineos.

verses.KJV: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
verses.WEB: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
verses.ASV: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém em Jerusalém habitaram [alguns] dos filhos de Judá, dos filhos de Benjamim, dos filhos de Efraim e de Manassés;
verses.RVR09: Y habitaron en Jerusalem de los hijos de Judá, de los hijos de Benjamín, de los hijos de Ephraim y Manasés:

verses.KJV: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
verses.WEB: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
verses.ASV: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Utai, filho de Amiúde, filho de Onri, filho de Inri, filho de Bani, dos filhos de Perez filho de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Urai hijo de Amiud, hijo de Omri, hijo de Imrai, hijo de Bani, de los hijos de Phares hijo de Judá.

verses.KJV: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.WEB: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
verses.ASV: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the first-born, and his sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos silonitas: Asaías o primogênito, e seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y de Siloni, Asaías el primogénito, y sus hijos.

verses.KJV: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.WEB: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
verses.ASV: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos filhos de Zerá, Jeuel e seus irmãos, seiscentos e noventa.
verses.RVR09: Y de los hijos de Zara, Jehuel y sus hermanos, seiscientos noventa.

verses.KJV: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
verses.WEB: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
verses.ASV: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos filhos de Benjamim: Salu, filho de Mesulão, filho de Hodavias, filho de Hassenua;
verses.RVR09: Y de los hijos de Benjamín: Sallu hijo de Mesullam, hijo de Odavía, hijo de Asenua;

verses.KJV: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.WEB: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.ASV: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ibneias, filho de Jeroão; e Elá filho de Uzi, filho de Micri; e Mesulão filho de Sefatias, filho de Reuel, filho de Ibneias.
verses.RVR09: E Ibnías hijo de Jeroham, y Ela hijo de Uzzi, hijo de Michri; y Mesullam hijo de Sephatías, hijo de Rehuel, hijo de Ibnías.

verses.KJV: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
verses.WEB: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.
verses.ASV: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were heads of fathers’ [houses] by their fathers’ houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos, segundo suas genealogias, foram novecentos e cinquenta e seis; todos estes homens foram cabeças das famílias de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos por sus linajes fueron nuevecientos cincuenta y seis. Todos estos hombres fueron cabezas de familia en las casas de sus padres.

verses.KJV: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.WEB: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
verses.ASV: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, Jachin,
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos sacerdotes: Jedaías, Jeoiaribe, Jaquim;
verses.RVR09: Y de los sacerdotes: Jedaía, Joiarib, Joachîm;

verses.KJV: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.WEB: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;
verses.ASV: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Azarias filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Aitube, príncipe da casa de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y Azarías hijo de Hilcías, hijo de Mesullam, hijo de Sadoc, hijo de Meraioth, hijo de Achîtob, príncipe de la casa de Dios;

verses.KJV: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.WEB: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.ASV: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Adaías filho de Jeroão, filho de Pasur, filho de Malquias; e Masai filho de Adiel, filho de Jazera, filho de Mesulão, filho de Mesilemite, filho de Imer;
verses.RVR09: Y Adaías hijo de Jeroham, hijo de Phasur, hijo de Machîas; y Masai hijo de Adiel, hijo de Jazera, hijo de Mesullam, hijo de Mesillemith, hijo de Immer;

verses.KJV: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.WEB: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.
verses.ASV: and their brethren, heads of their fathers’ houses, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como também seus irmãos, cabeças das famílias de seus pais, mil setecentos e sessenta, homens valentes e hábeis para a obra do serviço da casa de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos, cabezas de las casas de sus padres, en número de mil setecientos sesenta, hombres de grande eficacia en la obra del ministerio en la casa de Dios.

verses.KJV: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.WEB: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.ASV: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos Levitas: Semaías, filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, dos filhos de Merari;
verses.RVR09: Y de los Levitas: Semeías, hijo de Hassub, hijo de Azricam, hijo de Hasabías, de los hijos de Merari;

verses.KJV: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.WEB: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
verses.ASV: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Baquebacar, Heres, Galal, e Matanias filho de Mica, filho de Zicri, filho de Asafe;
verses.RVR09: Y Bacbaccar, Heres, y Galal, y Mattanía hijo de Michâs, hijo de Zichri, hijo de Asaph;

verses.KJV: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.WEB: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.ASV: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Obadias filho de Semaías, filho de Galal, filho de Jedutum; e Berequias filho de Asa, filho de Elcana, que habitou nas aldeias de Netofate.
verses.RVR09: Y Obadías hijo de Semeías, hijo de Galal, hijo de Iduthum: y Berachîas hijo de Asa, hijo de Elcana, el cual habitó en las aldeas de Nethophati.

verses.KJV: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
verses.WEB: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),
verses.ASV: And the porters: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren (Shallum was the chief),
verses.ALMEIDA: E os porteiros foram: Salum, Acube, Talmom, Aimã, e seus irmãos cujo líder era Salum,
verses.RVR09: Y los porteros: Sallum, Accub, Talmon, Ahiman, y sus hermanos. Sallum era el jefe.

verses.KJV: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
verses.WEB: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.
verses.ASV: who hitherto [waited] in the king’s gate eastward: they were the porters for the camp of the children of Levi.
verses.ALMEIDA: (O qual até agora fica junto à porta do rei ao oriente). Estes foram os porteiros do acampamento dos filhos de Levi.
verses.RVR09: Y hasta ahora entre las cuadrillas de los hijos de Leví han sido estos los porteros en la puerta del rey que está al oriente.

verses.KJV: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.
verses.WEB: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.
verses.ASV: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent: and their fathers had been over the camp of Jehovah, keepers of the entry.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salum, filho de Coré, filho de Ebiasafe, filho de Corá, e seus irmãos da família de seu pai, os coraítas, foram encarregados da obra do serviço, guardando os umbrais do tabernáculo; assim como seus pais foram capitães do acampamento do SENHOR, que guardavam a entrada.
verses.RVR09: Y Sallum hijo de Core, hijo de Abiasath, hijo de Corah, y sus hermanos los Coraitas por la casa de su padre, tuvieron cargo de la obra del ministerio, guardando las puertas del tabernáculo; y sus padres fueron sobre la cuadrilla de Jehová guardas de la entrada.

verses.KJV: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.
verses.WEB: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
verses.ASV: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, [and] Jehovah was with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Fineias, filho de Eleazar, havia sido antes comandante sobre eles, e o SENHOR era com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Phinees hijo de Eleazar fué antes capitán sobre ellos, siendo Jehová con él.

verses.KJV: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.WEB: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.ASV: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zacarias, filho de Meselemias, era porteiro da porta da tenda do ajuntamento.
verses.RVR09: Y Zacarías hijo de Meselemia era portero de la puerta del tabernáculo del testimonio.

verses.KJV: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
verses.WEB: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
verses.ASV: All these that were chosen to be porters in the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their office of trust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes, escolhidos para porteiros dos umbrais, foram duzentos e doze; e estes foram registrados em suas genealogias, segundo suas aldeias; e Davi e o vidente Samuel os constituíram em seu ofício.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos, escogidos para guardas en las puertas, eran doscientos doce cuando fueron contados por el orden de sus linajes en sus villas, á los cuales constituyó en su oficio David y Samuel el vidente.

verses.KJV: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
verses.WEB: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.
verses.ASV: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of Jehovah, even the house of the tent, by wards.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim eles e seus filhos estiveram junto às portas da casa do SENHOR, a casa do Tabernáculo, como guardas.
verses.RVR09: Así ellos y sus hijos eran porteros por sus turnos á las puertas de la casa de Jehová, y de la casa del tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.WEB: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.ASV: On the four sides were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os porteiros estavam aos quatro ventos: ao oriente, ao ocidente, ao norte, e ao sul.
verses.RVR09: Y estaban los porteros á los cuatro vientos, al oriente, al occidente, al septentrión, y al mediodía.

verses.KJV: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.WEB: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,
verses.ASV: And their brethren, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos que estavam em suas aldeias vinham de tempos em tempos para durante sete dias [servirem] com eles.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos que estaban en sus aldeas, venían cada siete días por sus tiempos con ellos.

verses.KJV: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
verses.WEB: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
verses.ASV: for the four chief porters, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the chambers and over the treasuries in the house of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois havia naquele ofício chefes dos porteiros, que eram levitas; e eles eram encarregados das câmaras e dos tesouros da casa de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque cuatro principales de los porteros Levitas estaban en el oficio, y tenían cargo de las cámaras, y de los tesoros de la casa de Dios.

verses.KJV: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
verses.WEB: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.
verses.ASV: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge [thereof] was upon them; and to them pertained the opening thereof morning by morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passavam a noite ao redor da casa de Deus, porque eram responsáveis pela guarda, e por abri-la a cada manhã.
verses.RVR09: Estos moraban alrededor de la casa de Dios, porque tenían cargo de la guardia, y el de abrir aquélla todas las mañanas.

verses.KJV: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
verses.WEB: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.
verses.ASV: And certain of them had charge of the vessels of service; for by count were these brought in and by count were these taken out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alguns destes eram encarregados dos utensílios do serviço, pois os colocavam contados, e contados os tiravam.
verses.RVR09: Algunos de estos tenían cargo de los vasos del ministerio, los cuales se metían por cuenta, y por cuenta se sacaban.

verses.KJV: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.WEB: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.ASV: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.ALMEIDA: E outros deles eram encarregados da mobília, e de todos os utensílios do santuário, como também da farinha, do vinho, do azeite, do incenso, e das especiarias.
verses.RVR09: Y otros de ellos tenían cargo de la vajilla, y de todos los vasos del santuario, y de la harina, y del vino, y del aceite, y del incienso, y de los aromas.

verses.KJV: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.WEB: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.
verses.ASV: And some of the sons of the priests prepared the confection of the spices.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns dos filhos dos sacerdotes faziam o perfume das especiarias.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos de los hijos de los sacerdotes hacían los ungüentos aromáticos.

verses.KJV: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
verses.WEB: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
verses.ASV: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the first-born of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Matitias, um dos Levitas, primogênito de Salum o coraíta, era encarregados das coisas que se faziam em assadeiras.
verses.RVR09: Y Mathathías, uno de los Levitas, primogénito de Sallum Coraita, tenía cargo de las cosas que se hacían en sartén.

verses.KJV: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.WEB: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
verses.ASV: And some of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the showbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alguns de seus irmãos, dos filhos dos coatitas, eram encarregados dos pães da proposição, para os prepararem para todos os sábados.
verses.RVR09: Y algunos de los hijos de Coath, y de sus hermanos, tenían el cargo de los panes de la proposición, los cuales ponían por orden cada sábado.

verses.KJV: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
verses.WEB: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.
verses.ASV: And these are the singers, heads of fathers’ [houses] of the Levites, [who dwelt] in the chambers [and were] free [from other service]; for they were employed in their work day and night.
verses.ALMEIDA: E destes também havia os cantores, cabeças das famílias dos levitas, os quais estavam isentos [de outros serviços] em suas câmaras, porque de dia e de noite estavam encarregados naquela obra.
verses.RVR09: Y de estos había cantores, principales de familias de los Levitas, los cuales estaban en sus cámaras exentos; porque de día y de noche estaban en aquella obra.

verses.KJV: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: These were heads of fathers’ [houses] of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men: these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os cabeças das famílias dos levitas, cabeças em suas genealogias, os quais habitaram em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Estos eran jefes de familias de los Levitas por sus linajes, jefes que habitaban en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.WEB: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.
verses.ASV: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife’s name was Maacah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E em Gibeão habitaram: Jeiel, pai de Gibeão (e o nome de sua mulher era Maaca);
verses.RVR09: Y en Gabaón habitaban Jehiel padre de Gabaón, el nombre de cuya mujer era Maachâ;

verses.KJV: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab.
verses.WEB: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.ASV: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu filho primogênito Abdom, depois Zur, Quis, Baal, Ner, Nadabe,
verses.RVR09: Y su hijo primogénito Abdón, luego Sur, Chîs, Baal, Ner, Nadab;

verses.KJV: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.WEB: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.ASV: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gedor, Aiô, Zacarias, e Miclote.
verses.RVR09: Gedor, Ahio, Zachârías, y Micloth.

verses.KJV: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.WEB: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
verses.ASV: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Miclote gerou a Simeia. E também estes habitaram em Jerusalém junto de seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y Micloth engendró á Samaán. Y estos habitaban también en Jerusalem con sus hermanos enfrente de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.WEB: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.ASV: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ner gerou a Quis, Quis gerou a Saul, e Saul gerou a Jônatas, a Malquisua, a Abinadabe, e a Esbaal.
verses.RVR09: Y Ner engendró á Cis, y Cis engendró á Saúl, y Saúl engendró á Jonathán, Malchîsua, Abinadab, y Esbaal.

verses.KJV: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.WEB: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
verses.ASV: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal; e Meribe-Baal gerou a Mica.
verses.RVR09: E hijo de Jonathán fué Merib-baal, y Merib-baal engendró á Michâ.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.WEB: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, [and Ahaz].
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Mica foram: Pitom, Meleque, Tareia,
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Michâ: Phitón, Melech, Tharea, y Ahaz.

verses.KJV: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.WEB: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
verses.ASV: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.ALMEIDA: [E] Acaz, [que] gerou a Jará, Jará gerou a Alemete, a Azmavete, e a Zinri; e Zinri gerou a Moza;
verses.RVR09: Ahaz engendró á Jara, y Jara engendró á Alemeth, Azmaveth, y Zimri: y Zimri engendró á Mosa;

verses.KJV: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.WEB: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
verses.ASV: and Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moza gerou a Bineá, cujo filho foi Refaías, cujo filho foi Eleasá, cujo filho foi Azel.
verses.RVR09: Y Mosa engendró á Bina, cuyo hijo fué Rephaía, del que fué hijo Elasa, cuyo hijo fué Asel.

verses.KJV: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.WEB: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
verses.ASV: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Azel teve seis filhos, cujos nomes foram: Azricão, Bocru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias, e Hanã; estes foram os filhos de Azel.
verses.RVR09: Y Asel tuvo seis hijos, los nombres de los cuales son: Azricam, Bochru, Ismael, Seraía, Obadías, y Hanán: estos fueron los hijos de Asel.

verses.KJV: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.WEB: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
verses.ASV: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filisteus guerrearam contra Israel; e os homens de Israel fugiram diante deles, e caíram feridos no monte de Gilboa.
verses.RVR09: LOS Filisteos pelearon con Israel; y huyeron delante de ellos los Israelitas, y cayeron heridos en el monte de Gilboa.

verses.KJV: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.WEB: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.ASV: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filisteus perseguiram a Saul e a seus filhos; e os filisteus mataram Jônatas, Abinadabe, e Malquisua, filhos de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Y los Filisteos siguieron á Saúl y á sus hijos; y mataron los Filisteos á Jonathán, y á Abinadab, y á Malchîsua, hijos de Saúl.

verses.KJV: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
verses.WEB: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
verses.ASV: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a batalha se dificultou sobre Saul; os flecheiros o alcançaram, e ele foi ferido pelos flecheiros.
verses.RVR09: Y agravóse la batalla sobre Saúl, y le alcanzaron los flecheros, y fué de los flecheros herido.

verses.KJV: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.WEB: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.
verses.ASV: Then said Saul unto his armor-bearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armor-bearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took his sword, and fell upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Saul disse a seu escudeiro: Tira a tua espada, e atravessa-me com ela, para que não aconteça que estes incircuncisos venham, e escarneçam de mim.Porém seu escudeiro não quis, porque tinha muito medo. Então Saul tomou a espada, e se lançou sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Saúl á su escudero: Saca tu espada, y pásame con ella, porque no vengan estos incircuncisos, y hagan escarnio de mí; mas su escudero no quiso, porque tenía gran miedo. Entonces Saúl tomó la espada, y echóse sobre ella.

verses.KJV: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.WEB: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.
verses.ASV: And when his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell upon his sword, and died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando seu escudeiro viu que Saul estava morto, ele também se lançou sobre sua espada, e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y como su escudero vió á Saúl muerto, él también se echó sobre su espada, y matóse.

verses.KJV: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.WEB: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.
verses.ASV: So Saul died, and his three sons; and all his house died together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Saul e seus três filhos morreram; e toda a sua casa morreu juntamente com ele.
verses.RVR09: Así murió Saúl, y sus tres hijos; y toda su casa murió juntamente con él.

verses.KJV: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.WEB: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
verses.ASV: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando todos os homens de Israel que estavam no vale viram que [o exército] havia fugido, e que Saul e seus filhos estavam mortos, deixaram suas cidades, e fugiram; então os filisteus vieram, e habitaram nelas.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo todos los de Israel que habitaban en el valle, que habían huído, y que Saúl y sus hijos eran muertos, dejaron sus ciudades, y huyeron: y vinieron los Filisteos, y habitaron en ellas.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.WEB: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.ALMEIDA: E no dia seguinte, quando os Filisteus vieram para despojar os mortos, acharam Saul e seus filhos estendidos no monte de Gilboa.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que viniendo el día siguiente los Filisteos á despojar los muertos, hallaron á Saúl y á sus hijos tendidos en el monte de Gilboa.

verses.KJV: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.WEB: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.
verses.ASV: And they stripped him, and took his head, and his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry the tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o despiram, tomaram sua cabeça e suas armas, e as enviaram por toda a terra dos filisteus para anunciarem a seus ídolos e ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Y luego que le hubieron desnudado, tomaron su cabeza y sus armas, y enviáronlo todo á la tierra de los Filisteos por todas partes, para que fuese denunciado á sus ídolos y al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.WEB: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
verses.ASV: And they put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E puseram suas armas no templo de seu deus, e colocaram sua cabeça no templo de Dagom.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron sus armas en el templo de su dios, y colgaron la cabeza en el templo de Dagón.

verses.KJV: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.WEB: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.ASV: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando todos os de Jabes-Gileade ouviram tudo quanto filisteus haviam feito a Saul,
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo todos los de Jabes de Galaad lo que los Filisteos habían hecho de Saúl,

verses.KJV: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.WEB: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.ASV: all the valiant men arose, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os homens valentes se levantaram, tomaram o corpo de Saul e os corpos de seus filhos, e os trouxeram a Jabes; e sepultaram seus ossos debaixo de um carvalho em Jabes, e jejuaram durante sete dias.
verses.RVR09: Levantáronse todos los hombres valientes, y tomaron el cuerpo de Saúl, y los cuerpos de sus hijos, y trajéronlos á Jabes; y enterraron sus huesos debajo del alcornoque en Jabes, y ayunaron siete días.

verses.KJV: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
verses.WEB: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,
verses.ASV: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Jehovah, because of the word of Jehovah, which he kept not; and also for that he asked counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to inquire [thereby],
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Saul morreu por sua transgressão com que havia transgredido contra o SENHOR, por causa da palavra do SENHOR, a qual ele não obedeceu; e por ter buscado à médium para lhe consultar,
verses.RVR09: Así murió Saúl por su rebelión con que prevaricó contra Jehová, contra la palabra de Jehová, la cual no guardó; y porque consultó al pythón, preguntándole,

verses.KJV: And enquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.WEB: and didn’t inquire of the LORD. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
verses.ASV: and inquired not of Jehovah: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não ter buscado ao SENHOR. Por isso ele o matou, e passou o reino a Davi, filho de Jessé.
verses.RVR09: Y no consultó á Jehová: por esta causa lo mató, y traspasó el reino á David, hijo de Isaí.

verses.KJV: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.WEB: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.ASV: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todo o Israel se ajuntou a Davi em Hebrom, dizendo: Eis que nós somos teu osso e tua carne.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES todo Israel se juntó á David en Hebrón, diciendo: He aquí nosotros somos tu hueso y tu carne.

verses.KJV: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.WEB: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
verses.ASV: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was thou that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and Jehovah thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt be shepherd of my people Israel, and thou shalt be prince over my people Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mesmo antes, quando Saul ainda era rei, tu conduzias as tropas de Israel. Também o SENHOR teu Deus te disse: Tu apascentarás o meu povo Israel, e tu serás líder do meu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y además antes de ahora, aun mientras Saúl reinaba, tú sacabas y metías á Israel. También Jehová tu Dios te ha dicho: Tú apacentarás mi pueblo Israel, y tú serás príncipe sobre Israel mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
verses.WEB: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.
verses.ASV: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Jehovah; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of Jehovah by Samuel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também vieram todos os anciãos de Israel ao rei em Hebrom, e Davi fez aliança com eles diante do SENHOR; e ungiram a Davi como rei sobre Israel, conforme a palavra do SENHOR por meio de Samuel.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron todos los ancianos de Israel al rey en Hebrón, y David hizo con ellos alianza delante de Jehová; y ungieron á David por rey sobre Israel, conforme á la palabra de Jehová por mano de Samuel.

verses.KJV: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.WEB: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
verses.ASV: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (the same is Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi e todo Israel foram a Jerusalém, a qual era Jebus, pois ali os jebuseus eram os moradores daquela terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se fué David con todo Israel á Jerusalem, la cual es Jebus; y allí era el Jebuseo habitador de aquella tierra.

verses.KJV: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.WEB: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
verses.ASV: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come in hither. Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion; the same is the city of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os moradores de Jebus disseram a Davi: Tu não entrarás aqui.Porém Davi conquistou a fortaleza de Sião, que é a cidade de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y los moradores de Jebus dijeron á David: No entrarás acá. Mas David tomó la fortaleza de Sión, que es la ciudad de David.

verses.KJV: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.WEB: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
verses.ASV: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois Davi havia dito: O primeiro a derrotar aos jebuseus será chefe e comandante.Então Joabe, filho de Zeruia, subiu primeiro, e foi feito comandante.)
verses.RVR09: Y David había dicho: El que primero hiriere al Jebuseo, será cabeza y jefe. Entonces Joab hijo de Sarvia subió el primero, y fué hecho jefe.

verses.KJV: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.WEB: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
verses.ASV: And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi habitou na fortaleza; por isso que foi chamada de cidade de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y David habitó en la fortaleza, y por esto le llamaron la ciudad de David.

verses.KJV: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.WEB: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.ASV: And he built the city round about, from Millo even round about; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele edificou a cidade ao redor, desde as fundações do aterro ao redor; e Joabe reparou o resto da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó la ciudad alrededor, desde Millo hasta la cerca: y Joab reparó el resto de la ciudad.

verses.KJV: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.
verses.WEB: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.
verses.ASV: And David waxed greater and greater; for Jehovah of hosts was with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi ia cada vez mais crescendo em poder, pois o SENHOR dos exércitos era com ele.
verses.RVR09: Y David iba adelantando y creciendo, y Jehová de los ejércitos era con él.

verses.KJV: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.WEB: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.
verses.ASV: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of Jehovah concerning Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os líderes dos guerreiros que Davi teve, os que lhe deram forte apoio em seu reinado, com todo Israel, para o fazerem rei sobre Israel, conforme a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los principales de los valientes que David tuvo, y los que le ayudaron en su reino, con todo Israel, para hacerle rey sobre Israel, conforme á la palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
verses.WEB: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
verses.ASV: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them at one time.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este é o número dos guerreiros que Davi teve: Jasobeão, filho de Hacmoni, chefe de capitães, o qual, fazendo uso de sua lança, matou trezentos de um vez.
verses.RVR09: Y este es el número de los valientes que David tuvo: Jasobam hijo de Hachmoni, caudillo de los treinta, el cual blandió su lanza una vez contra trescientos, á los cuales mató.

verses.KJV: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
verses.WEB: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
verses.ASV: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois dele Eleazar, filho de Dodô, o aoíta; ele era um dos três principais guerreiros.
verses.RVR09: Tras de éste fué Eleazar hijo de Dodo, Ahohita, el cual era de los tres valientes.

verses.KJV: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.WEB: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.ASV: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este esteve com Davi em Pas-Damim, quando os filisteus se ajuntaram para a batalha; e havia ali uma plantação cheia de cevada. Enquanto o povo fugia dos filisteus,
verses.RVR09: Este estuvo con David en Pasdammin, estando allí juntos en batalla los Filisteos: y había allí una suerte de tierra llena de cebada, y huyendo el pueblo delante de los Filisteos,

verses.KJV: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.WEB: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.
verses.ASV: And they stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and slew the Philistines; and Jehovah saved them by a great victory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se puseram no meio da plantação, defenderam-na, e derrotaram os Filisteus; e o SENHOR lhes deu uma grande vitória.
verses.RVR09: Pusiéronse ellos en medio de la haza, y la defendieron, y vencieron á los Filisteos; y favoreciólos Jehová con grande salvamento.

verses.KJV: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.WEB: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ASV: And three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E três dos trinta comandantes desceram a Davi, na rocha junto à caverna de Adulão, enquanto o acampamento dos filisteus estava no vale de Refaim.
verses.RVR09: Y tres de los treinta principales descendieron á la peña á David, á la cueva de Adullam, estando el campo de los Filisteos en el valle de Raphaim.

verses.KJV: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
verses.WEB: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.
verses.ASV: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi estava então na fortaleza, enquanto havia uma tropa de filisteus em Belém.
verses.RVR09: Y David estaba entonces en la fortaleza, y había á la sazón guarnición de Filisteos en Beth-lehem.

verses.KJV: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
verses.WEB: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
verses.ASV: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!
verses.ALMEIDA: Davi teve um desejo, e disse: Quem me dera beber da água do poço de Belém, que está junto à porta!
verses.RVR09: David deseó entonces, y dijo: ¡Quién me diera á beber de las aguas del pozo de Beth-lehem, que está á la puerta!

verses.KJV: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord.
verses.WEB: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
verses.ASV: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aqueles três irromperam pelo acampamento dos filisteus, e tiraram água do poço de Belém, que está junto à porta, tomaram dela, e a trouxeram a Davi. Davi, porém não a quis beber; em vez disso, derramou-a ao SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Y aquellos tres rompieron por el campo de los Filisteos, y sacaron agua del pozo de Beth-lehem, que está á la puerta, y tomaron y trajéronla á David: mas él no la quiso beber, sino que la derramó á Jehová, y dijo:

verses.KJV: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.WEB: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
verses.ASV: and said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with [the jeopardy of] their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Deus me proíba de fazer isto! Beberia eu o sangue destes homens com suas vidas? Pois eles arriscaram suas vidas para a trazerem.Por isso ele não a quis beber. Isto fizeram aqueles três guerreiros.
verses.RVR09: Guárdeme mi Dios de hacer esto: ¿había yo de beber la sangre de estos varones con sus vidas, que con peligro de sus vidas la han traído? Y no la quiso beber. Esto hicieron aquellos tres valientes.

verses.KJV: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.WEB: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
verses.ASV: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também Abisai, irmão de Joabe, foi o cabeça de três, o qual usando sua lança sobre trezentos, ele os matou; e foi famoso entre os três.
verses.RVR09: Y Abisai, hermano de Joab, era cabeza de los tres, el cual blandió su lanza sobre trescientos, á los cuales hirió; y fué entre los tres nombrado.

verses.KJV: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.WEB: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.
verses.ASV: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain: howbeit he attained not to the [first] three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos três ele foi mais ilustre que os outros dois, por isso foi seu cabeça; porém não alcançou os três [primeiros] .
verses.RVR09: De los tres fué más ilustre que los otros dos, y fué el principal de ellos: mas no llegó á los tres primeros.

verses.KJV: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
verses.WEB: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
verses.ASV: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he slew the two [sons of] Ariel of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Também] Benaia, filho de Joiada, filho de homem valente, de grandes feitos, de Cabzeel; ele matou dois dos poderosos guerreiros de Moabe; ele também desceu, e matou um leão dentro de uma cova no tempo da neve.
verses.RVR09: Benaías hijo de Joiada, hijo de varón de esfuerzo, de grandes hechos, de Cabseel: él venció los dos leones de Moab: también descendió, é hirió un león en mitad de un foso en tiempo de nieve.

verses.KJV: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.WEB: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.ASV: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele também matou um homem egípcio alto, de cinco côvados; o egípcio trazia na mão uma lança como um lançador de tecelão; porém [Benaia] desceu a ele com um bastão; e arrancou a lança da mão do egípcio, e o matou com sua própria lança.
verses.RVR09: El mismo venció á un Egipcio, hombre de cinco codos de estatura: y el Egipcio traía una lanza como un enjullo de tejedor; mas él descendió á él con un bastón, y arrebató al Egipcio la lanza de la mano, y matólo con su misma lanza.

verses.KJV: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.WEB: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.ASV: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas coisas fez Benaia, filho de Joiada, e por isso foi famoso entre aqueles três guerreiros.
verses.RVR09: Esto hizo Benaías hijo de Joiada, y fué nombrado entre los tres valientes.

verses.KJV: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.WEB: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.
verses.ASV: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he attained not to the [first] three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que ele foi o mais ilustre dos trinta, mas não alcançou os três [primeiros] . E Davi o pôs sobre sua guarda pessoal.
verses.RVR09: Y fué el más honrado de los treinta, mas no llegó á los tres primeros. A éste puso David en su consejo.

verses.KJV: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.WEB: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.ASV: Also the mighty men of the armies: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os guerreiros dos exército foram: Asael, irmão de Joabe; Elanã filho de Dodô de Belém;
verses.RVR09: Y los valientes de los ejércitos: Asael hermano de Joab, y Elchânan hijo de Dodo de Beth-lehem;

verses.KJV: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.WEB: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.ASV: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Samote o harodita; Helez o pelonita;
verses.RVR09: Samoth de Arori, Helles Pelonita;

verses.KJV: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
verses.WEB: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
verses.ASV: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ira, filho de Iques, o tecoíta; Abiezer o anatotita;
verses.RVR09: Ira hijo de Acces Tecoita, Abiezer Anathothita;

verses.KJV: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.WEB: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.ASV: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Sibecai o husatita; Ilai o aoíta;
