verses.RVR09: Sibbecai Husatita, Ilai Ahohita;

verses.KJV: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.WEB: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.ASV: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Maarai o netofatita; Helede, filho de Baaná, o netofatita;
verses.RVR09: Maharai Nethophathita, Heled hijo de Baana Nethophathita;

verses.KJV: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.WEB: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.ASV: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Itai, filho de Ribai, de Gibeá dos filhos de Benjamim; Benaia o piratonita;
verses.RVR09: Ithai hijo de Ribai de Gabaath de los hijos de Benjamín, Benaías Phirathita;

verses.KJV: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.WEB: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.ASV: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hurai do ribeiro de Gaás; Abiel, o arbatita;
verses.RVR09: Hurai del río Gaas, Abiel Arbathonita;

verses.KJV: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.WEB: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.ASV: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Azmavete, o baarumita; Eliaba, o saalbonita;
verses.RVR09: Azmaveth Baharumita, Eliaba Saalbonita;

verses.KJV: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.WEB: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
verses.ASV: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Hasém, o gizonita; Jônatas, filho de Sage, o hararita;
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Asem Gizonita, Jonathán hijo de Sajé Hararita;

verses.KJV: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.WEB: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.ASV: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aião filho de Sacar, o hararita; Elifal filho de Ur;
verses.RVR09: Ahiam hijo de Sachâr Ararita, Eliphal hijo de Ur;

verses.KJV: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.WEB: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.ASV: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Héfer, o mequeratita; Aías, o pelonita;
verses.RVR09: Hepher Mechêrathita, Ahía Phelonita;

verses.KJV: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.WEB: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.ASV: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hezro, o carmelita; Naarai, filho de Ezbai;
verses.RVR09: Hesro Carmelita, Nahari hijo de Ezbai;

verses.KJV: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
verses.WEB: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
verses.ASV: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
verses.ALMEIDA: Joel, irmão de Natã; Mibar, filho de Hagri;
verses.RVR09: Joel hermano de Nathán, Mibhar hijo de Agrai;

verses.KJV: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.WEB: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),
verses.ASV: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armorbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Zeleque, o amonita; Naarai, o berotita, escudeiro de Joabe filho de Zeruia;
verses.RVR09: Selec Ammonita, Naarai Berothita, escudero de Joab hijo de Sarvia;

verses.KJV: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.WEB: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.ASV: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ira, o itrita; Garebe, o itrita;
verses.RVR09: Ira Ithreo, Yared Ithreo;

verses.KJV: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.WEB: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.ASV: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.ALMEIDA: Urias, o heteu; Zabade, filho de Alai;
verses.RVR09: Uría Hetheo, Zabad hijo de Ahli;

verses.KJV: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.WEB: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,
verses.ASV: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Adina, filho de Siza, o rubenita, [o qual era] chefe dos rubenitas, e com ele trinta;
verses.RVR09: Adina hijo de Siza Rubenita, príncipe de los Rubenitas, y con él treinta;

verses.KJV: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.WEB: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.ASV: Hanan the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Hanã, filho de Maaca; Josafá o mitenita;
verses.RVR09: Hanán hijo de Maachâ, y Josaphat Mithnita;

verses.KJV: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
verses.WEB: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
verses.ASV: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Uzia, o asteratia; Sama e Jeiel, filhos de Hotão, o aroerita;
verses.RVR09: Uzzías Astarothita, Samma y Jehiel hijos de Hotham Arorita;

verses.KJV: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.WEB: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.ASV: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Jedaiel, filho de Sinri, e seu irmão Joá, o tizita;
verses.RVR09: Jediael hijo de Simri, y Joha su hermano, Thisaita;

verses.KJV: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.WEB: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.ASV: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eliel, o maavita; Jeribai e Josavias, filhos de Elnaão; Itma, o moabita;
verses.RVR09: Eliel de Mahaví, Jeribai y Josabia hijos de Elnaam, é Ithma Moabita;

verses.KJV: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
verses.WEB: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
verses.ASV: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eliel; Obede; e Jaasiel, o mezobaíta.
verses.RVR09: Eliel, y Obed, y Jaasiel de Mesobia.

verses.KJV: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
verses.WEB: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
verses.ASV: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes, pois, foram os que vieram a Davi a Ziclague, enquanto ele ainda estava escondido por causa de Saul filho de Quis; e eles estiveram entre os guerreiros que o ajudaram na guerra.
verses.RVR09: ESTOS son los que vinieron á David á Siclag, estando él aún encerrado por causa de Saúl hijo de Cis, y eran de los valientes ayudadores de la guerra.

verses.KJV: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
verses.WEB: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.ASV: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow: they were of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles estavam armados de arcos, e podiam tanto com a mão direita como a esquerda atirar pedras com funda, e setas com arco. Estes eram dentre os irmãos de Saul, os benjamitas.
verses.RVR09: Estaban armados de arcos, y usaban de ambas manos en tirar piedras con honda, y saetas con arco. De los hermanos de Saúl de Benjamín:

verses.KJV: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite.
verses.WEB: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
verses.ASV: The chief was Ahiezer; then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite, and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, and Beracah, and Jehu the Anathothite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aiezer, o cabeça; e Joás, filhos de Semaá o gibeatita; e Jeziel, e Pelete, filhos de Azmavete; e Beraca, e Jeú o anatotita;
verses.RVR09: El principal Ahiezer, después Joas, hijos de Semaa Gabaathita; y Jeziel, y Pheleth, hijos de Azmaveth, y Beracah, y Jehú Anathothita;

verses.KJV: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
verses.WEB: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;
verses.ASV: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty, and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ismaías, o gibeonita, valente entre os trinta, e capitão dos trinta; e Jeremias, Jaaziel, Joanã, Jozabade o gederatita;
verses.RVR09: E Ismaías Gabaonita, valiente entre los treinta, y más que los treinta; y Jeremías, Jahaziel, Joanán, Jozabad Gederathita,

verses.KJV: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.WEB: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;
verses.ASV: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eluzai, Jeremote, Bealias, Semarias, e Sefatias o harufita;
verses.RVR09: Eluzai, y Jeremoth, Bealías, Semarías, y Sephatías Haruphita;

verses.KJV: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
verses.WEB: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
verses.ASV: Elkanah, and Isshiah, and Azarel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites,
verses.ALMEIDA: Elcana, Issias, Azareel, Joezer, e Jasobeão, os coraítas;
verses.RVR09: Elcana, é Isías, y Azareel, y Joezer, y Jasobam, de Coré;

verses.KJV: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.WEB: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.ASV: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joela e Zebadias, filhos de Jeroão de Gedor.
verses.RVR09: Y Joela, y Zebadías, hijos de Jeroham de Gedor.

verses.KJV: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
verses.WEB: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:
verses.ASV: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David to the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, that could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the roes upon the mountains:
verses.ALMEIDA: E [alguns] dos gaditas passaram a Davi, à fortaleza no deserto, guerreiros valentes, homens de guerra para lutar, armados com escudo e lança; seus rostos eram como rostos de leões, e velozes como as corças sobre os montes.
verses.RVR09: También de los de Gad se huyeron á David, estando en la fortaleza en el desierto, muy valientes hombres de guerra para pelear, dispuestos á hacerlo con escudo y pavés: sus rostros como rostros de leones, y ligeros como las cabras monteses.

verses.KJV: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.WEB: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.ASV: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ézer o cabeça, Obadias o segundo, Eliabe o terceiro,
verses.RVR09: Eser el primero, Obadías el segundo, Eliab el tercero,

verses.KJV: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.WEB: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.ASV: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mismana o quarto, Jeremias o quinto,
verses.RVR09: Mismana el cuarto, Jeremías el quinto,

verses.KJV: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.WEB: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.ASV: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.ALMEIDA: Atai o sexto, Eliel o sétimo,
verses.RVR09: Attai el sexto, Eliel el séptimo,

verses.KJV: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.WEB: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.ASV: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Joanã o oitavo, Elzabade o nono,
verses.RVR09: Johanán el octavo, Elzabad el nono,

verses.KJV: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
verses.WEB: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.
verses.ASV: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jeremias o décimo, Macbanai o décimo primeiro.
verses.RVR09: Jeremías el décimo, Machbani el undécimo.

verses.KJV: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.WEB: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
verses.ASV: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the host: he that was least was equal to a hundred, and the greatest to a thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os capitães do exército dos filhos de Gade. O menor tinha autoridade sobre cem homens, e o maior sobre mil.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron capitanes del ejército de los hijos de Gad. El menor tenía cargo de cien hombres, y el mayor de mil.

verses.KJV: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
verses.WEB: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.
verses.ASV: These are they that went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram os que passaram o Jordão no mês primeiro, quando ele estava transbordando sobre todas as suas margens; e fizeram fugir a todos os dos vales ao oriente e ao ocidente.
verses.RVR09: Estos pasaron el Jordán en el mes primero, cuando había salido sobre todas sus riberas; é hicieron huir á todos los de los valles al oriente y al poniente.

verses.KJV: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
verses.WEB: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
verses.ASV: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the stronghold unto David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também alguns dos filhos de Benjamim e de Judá vieram a Davi à fortaleza.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo algunos de los hijos de Benjamín y de Judá vinieron á David á la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
verses.WEB: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”
verses.ASV: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, my heart shall be knit unto you; but if [ye be come] to betray me to mine adversaries, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi saiu ao encontro deles, e lhes falou, dizendo: Se viestes a mim para paz e para me ajudar, meu coração será unido convosco; mas se é para me entregar a meus inimigos, mesmo sendo meus mãos sem crime, o Deus de nossos pais o veja, e o repreenda.
verses.RVR09: Y David salió á ellos, y hablóles diciendo: Si habéis venido á mí para paz y para ayudarme, mi corazón será unido con vosotros; mas si para engañarme en pro de mis enemigos, siendo mis manos sin iniquidad, véalo el Dios de nuestros padres, y demándelo.

verses.KJV: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.WEB: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.
verses.ASV: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, [and he said], Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thy helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o Espírito revestiu a Amasai, chefe de trinta, e disse: Teus somos, ó Davi! E contigo estamos, ó filho de Jessé! Paz, paz seja contigo, e paz com os teus ajudadores; pois o teu Deus te ajuda.E Davi os recebeu, e os constituiu entre os capitães das tropas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se envistió el espíritu en Amasai, príncipe de treinta, y dijo: Por ti, oh David, y contigo, oh hijo de Isaí. Paz, paz contigo, y paz con tus ayudadores; pues que también tu Dios te ayuda. Y David los recibió, y púsolos entre los capitanes de la cuadrilla.

verses.KJV: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
verses.WEB: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
verses.ASV: Of Manasseh also there fell away some to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not; for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall away to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também alguns de Manassés passaram a Davi, quando ele veio com os filisteus à batalha contra Saul, ainda que não os ajudaram; porque os líderes dos filisteus, [depois de terem feito] conselho, o despediram, dizendo: Com nossas cabeças ele passará a seu senhor Saul.
verses.RVR09: También se pasaron á David algunos de Manasés, cuando vino con los Filisteos á la batalla contra Saúl, aunque no les ayudaron; porque los sátrapas de los Filisteos, habido consejo, lo despidieron, diciendo: Con nuestras cabezas se pasará á su señor Saúl.

verses.KJV: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
verses.WEB: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
verses.ASV: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands that were of Manasseh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, pois, ele veio a Ziclague, passaram-se a ele dos de Manassés: Adna, Jozabade, Jediaiel, Micael, Jozabade, Eliú, e Ziletai, chefes de milhares dos de Manassés.
verses.RVR09: Así que viniendo él á Siclag, se pasaron á él de los de Manasés, Adnas, Jozabad, Jediaiel, Michâel, Jozabad, Eliú, y Sillethai, príncipes de millares de los de Manasés.

verses.KJV: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
verses.WEB: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.
verses.ASV: And they helped David against the band of rovers: for they were all mighty men of valor, and were captains in the host.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes ajudaram a Davi contra aquela tropa; porque todos eles eram guerreiros valentes, e foram capitães no exército.
verses.RVR09: Estos ayudaron á David contra aquella compañía; porque todos ellos eran hombres valientes, y fueron capitanes en el ejército.

verses.KJV: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
verses.WEB: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.
verses.ASV: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great host, like the host of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois naquele tempo todos os dias, eles vinham a Davi para o ajudar, até que se fez um grande exército, como um exército de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque entonces todos los días venía ayuda á David, hasta hacerse un grande ejército, como ejército de Dios.

verses.KJV: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.WEB: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.
verses.ASV: And these are the numbers of the heads of them that were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E este são os números dos chefes armados para a batalha, que vieram a Davi em Hebrom, para passar a ele o reino de Saul, conforme a palavra do SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Y este es el número de los principales que estaban á punto de guerra, y vinieron á David en Hebrón, para traspasarle el reino de Saúl, conforme á la palabra de Jehová:

verses.KJV: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
verses.WEB: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.
verses.ASV: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, armed for war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Judá que traziam escudo e lança, seis mil e oitocentos, armados para a batalha.
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Judá que traían escudo y lanza, seis mil y ochocientos, á punto de guerra.

verses.KJV: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.WEB: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.
verses.ASV: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Simeão, guerreiros valentes para batalhar, sete mil e cem.
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Simeón, valientes y esforzados hombres para la guerra, siete mil y ciento.

verses.KJV: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.WEB: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.
verses.ASV: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Levi, quatro mil e seiscentos;
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Leví, cuatro mil y seiscientos;

verses.KJV: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
verses.WEB: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,
verses.ASV: And Jehoiada was the leader of [the house of] Aaron; and with him were three thousand and seven hundred,
verses.ALMEIDA: Joiada, porém, era o comandante dos [descendentes] de Arão, e com ele três mil e setecentos;
verses.RVR09: Asimismo Joiada, príncipe de los del linaje de Aarón, y con él tres mil y setecientos;

verses.KJV: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
verses.WEB: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.
verses.ASV: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zadoque, era um jovem guerreiro valente, e da família de seu pai vinte e dois líderes.
verses.RVR09: Y Sadoc, mancebo valiente y esforzado, con veinte y dos de los principales de la casa de su padre.

verses.KJV: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
verses.WEB: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.
verses.ASV: And of the children of Benjamin, the brethren of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Benjamim, irmãos de Saul, três mil; porque até então ainda havia muitos deles que ainda trabalhavam pela casa de Saul.
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Benjamín hermanos de Saúl, tres mil; porque aun en aquel tiempo muchos de ellos tenían la parte de la casa de Saúl.

verses.KJV: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
verses.WEB: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
verses.ASV: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Efraim, vinte mil e oitocentos, guerreiros valentes, homens ilustres nas casas de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y de los hijos de Ephraim, veinte mil y ochocientos, muy valientes, varones ilustres en las casas de sus padres.

verses.KJV: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
verses.WEB: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
verses.ASV: And of the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da meia tribo de Manassés, dezoito mil, que foram convocados por nome para virem a tornar Davi rei.
verses.RVR09: De la media tribu de Manasés, diez y ocho mil, los cuales fueron tomados por lista para venir á poner á David por rey.

verses.KJV: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verses.WEB: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.
verses.ASV: And of the children of Issachar, men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Issacar, conhecedores dos tempos, para saberem o que Israel devia fazer, duzentos de seus líderes; e todos os seus irmãos seguiam suas ordens.
verses.RVR09: Y de los hijos de Issachâr, doscientos principales, entendidos en los tiempos, y que sabían lo que Israel debía hacer, cuyo dicho seguían todos sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
verses.WEB: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.
verses.ASV: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the host, that could set the battle in array, with all manner of instruments of war, fifty thousand, and that could order [the battle array, and were] not of double heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Zebulom, cinquenta mil, que saíam como exército preparados para a batalha, com todas as armas de guerra; capazes de batalhar com firmeza de coração.
verses.RVR09: Y de Zabulón cincuenta mil, que salían á campaña á punto de guerra, con todas armas de guerra, dispuestos á pelear sin doblez de corazón.

verses.KJV: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.WEB: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.
verses.ASV: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Naftali mil capitães, e com eles trinta e sete mil com escudo e lança.
verses.RVR09: Y de Nephtalí mil capitanes, y con ellos treinta y siete mil con escudo y lanza.

verses.KJV: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.WEB: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
verses.ASV: And of the Danites that could set the battle in array, twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos danitas, preparados para a batalha, vinte e oito mil e seiscentos.
verses.RVR09: De los de Dan, dispuestos á pelear, veinte y ocho mil y seiscientos.

verses.KJV: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
verses.WEB: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.
verses.ASV: And of Asher, such as were able to go out in the host, that could set the battle in array, forty thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Aser, dos que saíam como exército, prontos para a batalha, quarenta mil.
verses.RVR09: Y de Aser, á punto de guerra y aparejados á pelear, cuarenta mil.

verses.KJV: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.WEB: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.
verses.ASV: And on the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, a hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dalém do Jordão, dos rubenitas, dos gaditas, e da meia tribo de Manassés, como toda variedade de armas de guerra para batalhar, cento e vinte mil.
verses.RVR09: Y de la otra parte del Jordán, de los Rubenitas y de los de Gad y de la media tribu de Manasés, ciento y veinte mil con toda suerte de armas de guerra.

verses.KJV: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.WEB: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.ASV: All these, being men of war, that could order the battle array, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes homens de guerra, postos em posição de batalha, com coração íntegro, vieram a Hebrom, para constituir Davi rei sobre todo Israel; e também todos os demais de Israel tinham a mesma intenção de constituir Davi o rei.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos hombres de guerra, dispuestos para guerrear, vinieron con corazón perfecto á Hebrón, para poner á David por rey sobre todo Israel; asimismo todos los demás de Israel estaban de un mismo ánimo para poner á David por rey.

verses.KJV: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.WEB: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.
verses.ASV: And they were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brethren had made preparation for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estiveram ali com Davi três dias, comendo e bebendo, porque seus irmãos haviam lhes feito preparativos.
verses.RVR09: Y estuvieron allí con David tres días comiendo y bebiendo, porque sus hermanos habían prevenido para ellos.

verses.KJV: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
verses.WEB: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.
verses.ASV: Moreover they that were nigh unto them, [even] as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, victuals of meal, cakes of figs, and clusters of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep in abundance: for there was joy in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também os seus vizinhos, até de Issacar, Zebulom, e Naftali, trouxeram pão sobre asnos, camelos, mulos, e bois; e alimento de farinha, bolos de figos e passas, vinho e azeite, bois e ovelhas em abundância, porque havia alegria em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y también los que les eran vecinos, hasta Issachâr y Zabulón y Nephtalí, trajeron pan en asnos, y camellos, y mulos, y bueyes; y provisión de harina, masas de higos, y pasas, vino y aceite, bueyes y ovejas en abundancia, porque en Israel había alegría.

verses.KJV: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.WEB: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
verses.ASV: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi teve conselho com os capitães de milhares e de centenas, [e] com todos os chefes.
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES David tomó consejo con los capitanes de millares y de cientos, y con todos los jefes.

verses.KJV: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
verses.WEB: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.
verses.ASV: And David said unto all the assembly of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and if it be of Jehovah our God, let us send abroad every where unto our brethren that are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi disse a todo a congregação de Israel: Se bem vos parece, e se vem do SENHOR nosso Deus, enviemos depressa [mensageiros] aos nossos irmãos que restaram em todas as terras de Israel, aos sacerdotes e aos levitas que estão com eles em suas cidades e em seus arredores, para que se ajuntem conosco.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David á todo el congreso de Israel: Si os parece bien y de Jehová nuestro Dios, enviaremos á todas partes á llamar nuestros hermanos que han quedado en todas las tierras de Israel, y á los sacerdotes y Levitas que están con ellos en sus ciudades y ejidos que se junten con nosotros;

verses.KJV: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
verses.WEB: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
verses.ASV: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we sought not unto it in the days of Saul.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tragamos de volta a nós a arca de nosso Deus, porque não a buscamos desde o tempo de Saul.
verses.RVR09: Y traigamos el arca de nuestro Dios á nosotros, porque desde el tiempo de Saúl no hemos hecho caso de ella.

verses.KJV: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.WEB: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.ASV: And all the assembly said that they would do so; for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então toda a congregação disse que assim se fizesse, porque isso pareceu correto aos olhos de todo o povo.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo todo el congreso que se hiciese así, porque la cosa parecía bien á todo el pueblo.

verses.KJV: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
verses.WEB: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
verses.ASV: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor [the brook] of Egypt even unto the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Davi ajuntou a todo Israel, desde Sior do Egito, até chegar a Hamate, para que trouxessem a arca de Deus de Quriate-Jearim.
verses.RVR09: Entonces juntó David á todo Israel, desde Sihor de Egipto hasta entrar en Hamath, para que trajesen el arca de Dios de Chîriath-jearim.

verses.KJV: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjathjearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the Lord, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
verses.WEB: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
verses.ASV: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, [that is], to Kiriath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God Jehovah that sitteth [above] the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi subiu com todo Israel a Baalá, [que é] Quriate-Jearim, em Judá, para dali trazerem acima a arca de Deus, o SENHOR, que habita entre os querubins, a qual é chamada pelo seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Y subió David con todo Israel á Baala de Chîriath-jearim, que es en Judá, para pasar de allí el arca de Jehová Dios que habita entre los querubines, sobre la cual su nombre es invocado.

verses.KJV: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
verses.WEB: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
verses.ASV: And they carried the ark of God upon a new cart, [and brought it] out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levaram a arca de Deus da casa de Abinadabe sobre uma carruagem nova, e Uzá e seu irmão guiavam o carro.
verses.RVR09: Y lleváronse el arca de Dios de la casa de Abinadab en un carro nuevo; y Uzza y su hermano guiaban el carro.

verses.KJV: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.WEB: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.ASV: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi e todo Israel celebravam diante de Deus com toda força; e com canções, harpas, saltérios, tamboris, címbalos e com trombetas.
verses.RVR09: Y David y todo Israel hacían alegrías delante de Dios con todas sus fuerzas, con canciones, arpas, salterios, tamboriles, címbalos y trompetas.

verses.KJV: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.WEB: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
verses.ASV: And when they came unto the threshing-floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando chegaram à eira de Quidom, Uzá estendeu sua mão para segurar a arca, pois os bois tropeçaram.
verses.RVR09: Y como llegaron á la era de Chidón, Uzza extendió su mano al arca para tenerla, porque los bueyes se desmandaban.

verses.KJV: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
verses.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put forth his hand to the ark; and there he died before God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Uzá, e o feriu, por ele ter estendido sua mão à arca; e morreu ali diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y el furor de Jehová se encendió contra Uzza, é hiriólo, porque había extendido su mano al arca: y murió allí delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.
verses.WEB: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
verses.ASV: And David was displeased, because Jehovah had broken forth upon Uzza: and he called that place Perez-uzza, unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi teve desgosto, porque o SENHOR havia atingido Uzá; por isso ele chamou aquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y David tuvo pesar, porque Jehová había hecho rotura en Uzza; por lo que llamó aquel lugar Pérez-uzza, hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
verses.WEB: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
verses.ASV: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi temeu a Deus naquele dia, dizendo: Como trarei a mim a arca de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Y David temió á Dios aquel día, y dijo: ¿Cómo he de traer á mi casa el arca de Dios?

verses.KJV: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
verses.WEB: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
verses.ASV: So David removed not the ark unto him into the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso Davi não trouxe a arca a si, à cidade de Davi; em vez disso ele a trouxe à casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu.
verses.RVR09: Y no trajo David el arca á su casa en la ciudad de David, sino llevóla á casa de Obed-edom Getheo.

verses.KJV: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
verses.WEB: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.
verses.ASV: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months: and Jehovah blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim a arca de Deus ficou na casa de Obede-Edom, em sua casa, por três meses; e o SENHOR abençoou a casa de Obede-Edom, e tudo quanto ele tinha.
verses.RVR09: Y el arca de Dios estuvo en casa de Obed-edom, en su casa, tres meses: y bendijo Jehová la casa de Obed-edom, y todas las cosas que tenía.

verses.KJV: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
verses.WEB: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
verses.ASV: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar-trees, and masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Hirão, rei de Tiro, enviou mensageiros a Davi, e também madeira de cedro, pedreiros e carpinteiros, para lhe edificarem uma casa.
verses.RVR09: E HIRAM rey de Tiro envió embajadores á David, y madera de cedro, y albañiles y carpinteros, que le edificasen una casa.

verses.KJV: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
verses.WEB: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.
verses.ASV: And David perceived that Jehovah had established him king over Israel; for his kingdom was exalted on high, for his people Israel’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi entendeu que o SENHOR o tinha confirmado por rei sobre Israel, pois seu reino tinha sido exaltado, por causa de seu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y entendió David que Jehová lo había confirmado por rey sobre Israel, y que había ensalzado su reino sobre su pueblo Israel.

verses.KJV: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
verses.WEB: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.ASV: And David took more wives at Jerusalem; and David begat more sons and daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi teve mais esposas em Jerusalém, e Davi ainda gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David tomó también mujeres en Jerusalem y aun engendró David hijos é hijas.

verses.KJV: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.WEB: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.ASV: And these are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os nomes dos filhos que teve em Jerusalém: Samua, Sobabe, Natã, Salomão,
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los nombres de los que le nacieron en Jerusalem: Samua, Sobab, Nathán, Salomón,

verses.KJV: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.WEB: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
verses.ASV: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpelet,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ibar, Elisua, Elpelete,
verses.RVR09: Ibhar, Elisua, Eliphelet,

verses.KJV: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.WEB: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.ASV: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nogá, Nefegue, Jafia,
verses.RVR09: Noga, Nepheg, Japhías,

verses.KJV: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.WEB: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.ASV: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elisama, Beeliada e Elifelete.
verses.RVR09: Elisama, Beel-iada y Eliphelet.

verses.KJV: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.WEB: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.ASV: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David: and David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando, pois, os filisteus ouviram que Davi havia sido ungido rei sobre todo Israel, todos os filisteus subiram em busca de Davi. E quando Davi ouviu falar disso, logo saiu contra eles.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo los Filisteos que David había sido ungido por rey sobre todo Israel, subieron todos los Filisteos en busca de David. Y como David lo oyó, salió contra ellos.

verses.KJV: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.WEB: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ASV: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filisteus vieram e ocuparam o vale de Refaim.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron los Filisteos, y extendiéronse por el valle de Raphaim.

verses.KJV: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
verses.WEB: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
verses.ASV: And David inquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into my hand? And Jehovah said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi consultou a Deus, dizendo: Subirei contra os filisteus? E tu os entregarás em minhas mãos?E o SENHOR lhe disse: Sobe, porque eu os entregarei em teus mãos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David consultó á Dios, diciendo: ¿Subiré contra los Filisteos? ¿los entregarás en mi mano? Y Jehová le dijo: Sube, que yo los entregaré en tus manos.

verses.KJV: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.
verses.WEB: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
verses.ASV: So they came up to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there; and David said, God hath broken mine enemies by my hand, like the breach of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Davi subiu, pois, Baal-Perazim, e ali os derrotou. Então Davi disse: Por minha mão Deus rompeu meus inimigos, como se rompem as águas.Por isso chamaram o nome daquele lugar Baal-Perazim.
verses.RVR09: Subieron pues á Baal-perasim, y allí los hirió David. Dijo luego David: Dios rompió mis enemigos por mi mano, como se rompen las aguas. Por esto llamaron el nombre de aquel lugar Baal-perasim.

verses.KJV: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.WEB: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.
verses.ASV: And they left their gods there; and David gave commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali deixaram seus deuses, e Davi mandou que fossem queimados a fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y dejaron allí sus dioses, y David dijo que los quemasen al fuego.

verses.KJV: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.WEB: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.
verses.ASV: And the Philistines yet again made a raid in the valley.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os filisteus voltaram a ocupar o vale.
verses.RVR09: Y volviendo los Filisteos á extenderse por el valle,

verses.KJV: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.WEB: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.
verses.ASV: And David inquired again of God; and God said unto him, Thou shalt not go up after them: turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry-trees.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi voltou a consultar a Deus, e Deus lhe disse: Não subas por trás deles; em vez disso rodeia-os, e vem contra eles em frente das amoreiras;
verses.RVR09: David volvió á consultar á Dios, y Dios le dijo: No subas tras ellos, sino rodéalos, para venir á ellos por delante de los morales;

verses.KJV: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.WEB: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
verses.ASV: And it shall be, when thou hearest the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle; for God is gone out before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que ouvires, quando tu ouvires o ruído do marchar [das tropas] pelas copas das amoreiras, então sai à batalha; porque Deus sairá adiante de ti para derrotar o acampamento dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: Y así que oyeres venir un estruendo por las copas de los morales, sal luego á la batalla: porque Dios saldrá delante de ti, y herirá el campo de los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
verses.WEB: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
verses.ASV: And David did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi fez como Deus lhe mandara, e feriram o acampamento dos filisteus desde Gibeão até Gezer.
verses.RVR09: Hizo pues David como Dios le mandó, é hirieron el campo de los Filisteos desde Gabaón hasta Gezer.

verses.KJV: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.WEB: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.
verses.ASV: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and Jehovah brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a fama de Davi se espalhou por todas aquelas terras; e o SENHOR fez todas aquelas nações temerem a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y la fama de David fué divulgada por todas aquellas tierras: y puso Jehová temor de David sobre todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.WEB: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.
verses.ASV: And [David] made him houses in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Davi também fez casas para si em sua cidade, e preparou um lugar para a arca de Deus, e lhe armou uma tenda.
verses.RVR09: HIZO también casas para sí en la ciudad de David, y labró un lugar para el arca de Dios, y tendióle una tienda.

verses.KJV: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the Lord chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.WEB: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”
verses.ASV: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath Jehovah chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi disse: Ninguém pode trazer a arca de Deus, a não ser os levitas; porque o SENHOR os escolheu para que transportassem a arca do SENHOR, e para lhe servirem eternamente.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo David: El arca de Dios no debe ser traída sino por los Levitas; porque á ellos ha elegido Jehová para que lleven el arca de Jehová, y le sirvan perpetuamente.

verses.KJV: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.WEB: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.ASV: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Jehovah unto its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi ajuntou a todo Israel em Jerusalém, para fazerem subir a arca do SENHOR a seu lugar, que ele tinha lhe preparado.
verses.RVR09: Y juntó David á todo Israel en Jerusalem, para que pasasen el arca de Jehová á su lugar, el cual le había él preparado.

verses.KJV: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.WEB: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.ASV: And David gathered together the sons of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.ALMEIDA: Davi também ajuntou aos filhos de Arão e aos levitas:
verses.RVR09: Juntó también David á los hijos de Aarón y á los Levitas:

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
verses.WEB: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
verses.ASV: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twenty;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Coate, Uriel o principal, e seus irmãos, cento e vinte;
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Coath, Uriel el principal, y sus hermanos, ciento y veinte;

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.WEB: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
verses.ASV: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Merari, Asaías o principal, e seus irmãos, duzentos e vinte;
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Merari, Asaías el principal, y sus hermanos, doscientos y veinte;

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.WEB: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;
verses.ASV: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and thirty;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Gérson, Joel o principal, e seus irmãos, cento e trinta;
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Gersón, Joel el principal, y sus hermanos, ciento y treinta;

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.WEB: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;
verses.ASV: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Elisafã, Semaías o principal, e seus irmãos, duzentos;
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Elisaphán, Semeías el principal, y sus hermanos, doscientos;

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.WEB: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;
verses.ASV: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Hebrom, Eliel o principal, e seus irmãos, oitenta;
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Hebrón, Eliel el principal, y sus hermanos, ochenta;

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.WEB: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
verses.ASV: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twelve.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Uziel, Amidadabe o principal, e seus irmãos, cento e doze.
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Uzziel, Aminadab el principal, y sus hermanos, ciento y doce.

verses.KJV: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.WEB: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.ASV: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi chamou aos sacerdotes Zadoque e Abiatar, e a os levitas Uriel, Asaías, Joel, Semaías, Eliel, e Aminadabe;
verses.RVR09: Y llamó David á Sadoc y á Abiathar, sacerdotes, y á los Levitas, Uriel, Asaías, Joel, Semeías, Eliel, y Aminadab;

verses.KJV: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.WEB: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.ASV: and said unto them, Ye are the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of Jehovah, the God of Israel, unto [the place] that I have prepared for it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Vós que sois os chefes das famílias entre os levitas, santificai-vos, vós e vossos irmãos, e fazei subir a arca do SENHOR, Deus de Israel, ao lugar que eu lhe preparei;
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: Vosotros que sois los principales de padres entre los Levitas, santificaos, vosotros y vuestros hermanos, y pasad el arca de Jehová Dios de Israel al lugar que le he preparado;

verses.KJV: For because ye did it not at the first, the Lord our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.WEB: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
verses.ASV: For because ye [bare it] not at the first, Jehovah our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not according to the ordinance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois por não terdes feito assim vós da primeira vez, o SENHOR nosso Deus fez nos atingiu, porque não o buscamos conforme o mandamento.
verses.RVR09: Pues por no haberlo hecho así vosotros la primera vez, Jehová nuestro Dios hizo en nosotros rotura, por cuanto no le buscamos según la ordenanza.

verses.KJV: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.WEB: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os sacerdotes e os levitas se santificaram para trazerem a arca do SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Así los sacerdotes y los Levitas se santificaron para traer el arca de Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.
verses.ASV: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos dos levitas trouxeram a arca de Deus com as barras sobre seus ombros, assim como Moisés tinha mandado conforme a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de los Levitas trajeron el arca de Dios puesta sobre sus hombros en las barras, como lo había mandado Moisés conforme á la palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.WEB: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.
verses.ASV: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren the singers, with instruments of music, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi disse aos chefes dos levitas que constituíssem de seus irmãos cantores com instrumentos musicais, com saltérios, e harpas, e címbalos; para que fizessem sons e levantassem a voz com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo dijo David á los principales de los Levitas, que constituyesen de sus hermanos cantores, con instrumentos de música, con salterios, y arpas, y címbalos, que resonasen, y alzasen la voz con alegría.

verses.KJV: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.WEB: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.ASV: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os levitas constituíram a Hemã, filho de Joel; e de seus irmãos, a Asafe filho de Berequias; e dos filhos de Merari e de seus irmãos, a Etã filho de Cusaías;
verses.RVR09: Y los Levitas constituyeron á Hemán hijo de Joel; y de sus hermanos, á Asaph hijo de Berechîas; y de los hijos de Merari y de sus hermanos, á Ethán hijo de Cusaías;

verses.KJV: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.WEB: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
verses.ASV: and with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com eles a seus irmãos da segundo ordem, a Zacarias, Bene e Jaaziel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Uni, Eliabe, Benaia, Maaseias, Matitias, Elifeleu, Micneias, Obede-Edom, e Jeiel, os porteiros.
verses.RVR09: Y con ellos á sus hermanos del segundo orden, á Zachârías, Ben y Jaaziel, Semiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaías, Maasías, y Mathithías, Eliphelehu, Micnías, Obed-edom, y Jehiel, los porteros.

verses.KJV: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.WEB: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
verses.ASV: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, [were appointed], with cymbals of brass to sound aloud;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os cantores: Hemã, Asafe, e Etã, fizeram sons com címbalos de metal.
verses.RVR09: Así Hemán, Asaph, y Ethán, que eran cantores, sonaban con címbalos de metal.

verses.KJV: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.WEB: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;
verses.ASV: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries set to Alamoth;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zacarias, Aziel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Uni, Eliabe, Maaseias, e Benaia, com saltérios sobre Alamote.
verses.RVR09: Y Zachârías, Jaaziel, Semiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maasías, y Benaías, con salterios sobre Alamoth.

verses.KJV: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
verses.WEB: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
verses.ASV: and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps set to the Sheminith, to lead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Matitias, Elifeleu, Micneias, Obede-Edom, Jeiel, e Azazias, tocavam ao modo de Seminite.
verses.RVR09: Y Mathithías, Eliphelehu, Micnías, Obed-edom, Jehiel, y Azazías, cantaban con arpas en la octava sobresaliendo.

verses.KJV: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
verses.WEB: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.
verses.ASV: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Quenanias, chefe dos levitas, estava encarregado de conduzir o cântico; ele ensinava o cântico porque era entendido.
verses.RVR09: Y Chênanías, principal de los Levitas, estaba para la entonación; pues él presidía en el canto, porque era entendido.

verses.KJV: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.WEB: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.ASV: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Berequias e Elcana eram porteiros da arca.
verses.RVR09: Y Berechîas y Elcana eran porteros del arca.

verses.KJV: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.WEB: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.ASV: And Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethanel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os sacerdotes Sebanias, Josafá, Natanael, Amasai, Zacarias, Benaia, e Eliézer, tocavam as trombetas diante da arca de Deus; e Obede-Edom e Jeías eram porteiros da arca.
verses.RVR09: Y Sebanías, Josaphat, Nathanael, Amasai, Zachârías, Benaías, y Eliezer, sacerdotes, tocaban las trompetas delante del arca de Dios: Obed-edom y Jehías eran también porteros del arca.

verses.KJV: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obededom with joy.
verses.WEB: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
verses.ASV: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sucedeu, pois, que Davi, os anciãos de Israel, e os capitães de milhares, foram fazer subir a arca do pacto do SENHOR, de casa de Obede-Edom, com alegria.
verses.RVR09: David pues y los ancianos de Israel, y los capitanes de millares, fueron á traer el arca del pacto de Jehová, de casa de Obed-edom, con alegría.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.WEB: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, that they sacrificed seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que, por Deus estar ajudando os levitas que levavam a arca do pacto do SENHOR, eles sacrificaram sete novilhos e sete carneiros.
verses.RVR09: Y ayudando Dios á los Levitas que llevaban el arca del pacto de Jehová, sacrificaban siete novillos y siete carneros.

verses.KJV: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.WEB: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
verses.ASV: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song [with] the singers: and David had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi ia vestido de um roupão de linho fino, como também todos os levitas que levavam a arca, e os cantores; e Quenanias era o chefe da música e dos cantores. Davi também levava sobre si um éfode de linho.
verses.RVR09: Y David iba vestido de lino fino y también todos los Levitas que llevaban el arca, y asimismo los cantores; y Chênanías era maestro de canto entre los cantores. Llevaba también David sobre sí un ephod de lino.

verses.KJV: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.WEB: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
verses.ASV: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with psalteries and harps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim todo Israel fez subir a arca do pacto do SENHOR, com júbilo, som de cornetas e trombetas, e címbalos, e ao som de saltérios e harpas.
verses.RVR09: De esta manera llevaba todo Israel el arca del pacto de Jehová, con júbilo y sonido de bocinas, y trompetas, y címbalos, y al son de salterios y arpas.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal, the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.WEB: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of Jehovah came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que, quando a arca do pacto do SENHOR chegou à cidade de Davi, Mical, filha de Saul, olhou por uma janela, e viu o rei Davi dançando e saltando; e ela o desprezou em seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y como el arca del pacto de Jehová llegó á la ciudad de David, Michâl, hija de Saúl, mirando por una ventana, vió al rey David que saltaba y bailaba; y menospreciólo en su corazón.

verses.KJV: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
verses.WEB: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.ASV: And they brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trouxeram, pois, a arca de Deus, e a puseram no meio da tenda que Davi havia lhe armado; e apresentaram holocaustos e sacrifícios de gratidão diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ trajeron el arca de Dios, y asentáronla en medio de la tienda que David había tendido para ella: y ofrecieron holocaustos y pacíficos delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi, quando terminou de apresentar os holocaustos e os sacrifícios de gratidão, abençoou ao povo em nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y como David hubo acabado de ofrecer el holocausto y los pacíficos, bendijo al pueblo en el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
verses.WEB: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
verses.ASV: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a portion [of flesh], and a cake of raisins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E repartiu a todos em Israel, tanto homens como mulheres, a cada um um bolo de pão, uma boa porção de carne, e um bolo de passas.
verses.RVR09: Y repartió á todo Israel, así á hombres como á mujeres, á cada uno una torta de pan, y una pieza de carne, y un frasco de vino.

verses.KJV: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:
verses.WEB: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:
verses.ASV: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of Jehovah, and to celebrate and to thank and praise Jehovah, the God of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs diante do arca do SENHOR a [alguns] dos levitas como servidores, para que celebrassem, agradecessem, e louvassem ao SENHOR Deus de Israel:
verses.RVR09: Y puso delante del arca de Jehová ministros de los Levitas, para que recordasen, y confesasen, y loasen á Jehová Dios de Israel:

verses.KJV: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
verses.WEB: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
