verses.ASV: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, with psalteries and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
verses.ALMEIDA: Asafe era o cabeça, e Zacarias era o segundo depois; Jeiel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Matitias, Eliabe, Benaia, Obede-Edom, e Jeiel, estavam com seus instrumentos de saltérios e harpas, mas Asafe fazia som com címbalos;
verses.RVR09: Asaph el primero, el segundo después de él Zachârías, Jeiel, Semiramoth, Jehiel, Mathithías, Eliab, Benaías, Obed-edom, y Jehiel, con sus instrumentos de salterios y arpas; mas Asaph hacía sonido con címbalos:

verses.KJV: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.WEB: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.ASV: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os sacerdotes Benaia e Jaaziel estavam continuamente com trombetas diante do arca do pacto de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Benaías también y Jahaziel, sacerdotes, continuamente con trompetas delante del arca del pacto de Dios.

verses.KJV: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.WEB: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
verses.ASV: Then on that day did David first ordain to give thanks unto Jehovah, by the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então naquele mesmo dia Davi pela primeira vez mandou celebrarem ao SENHOR por meio de Asafe e de seus irmãos:
verses.RVR09: Entonces, en aquel día, dió David principio á celebrar á Jehová por mano de Asaph y de sus hermanos:

verses.KJV: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verses.WEB: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
verses.ASV: O give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known his doings among the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai ao SENHOR, invocai o seu nome, notificai entre os povos os seus feitos.
verses.RVR09: Confesad á Jehová, invocad su nombre, haced notorias en los pueblos sus obras.

verses.KJV: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.WEB: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
verses.ASV: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvellous works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai a ele, cantai-lhe salmos; falai de todas as suas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á él, cantadle salmos; hablad de todas sus maravillas.

verses.KJV: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
verses.WEB: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
verses.ASV: Glory ye in his holy name; Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gloriai-vos em seu santo nome; alegre-se o coração dos que buscam ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Gloriaos en su santo nombre; alégrese el corazón de los que buscan á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.WEB: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
verses.ASV: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Procurai ao SENHOR e à sua força; buscai a sua face continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Buscad á Jehová y su fortaleza; buscad su rostro continuamente.

verses.KJV: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.WEB: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.ASV: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos de suas maravilhas que ele fez, de seus prodígios, e dos juízos de sua boca,
verses.RVR09: Haced memoria de sus maravillas que ha obrado, de sus prodigios, y de los juicios de su boca,

verses.KJV: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.WEB: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.ASV: O ye seed of Israel his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, descendentes de seu servo Israel, vós filhos de Jacó, seus escolhidos.
verses.RVR09: Oh vosotros, simiente de Israel su siervo, hijos de Jacob, sus escogidos.

verses.KJV: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.WEB: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.ASV: He is Jehovah our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o SENHOR, o nosso Deus; seus juízos estão em toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, él es nuestro Dios; sus juicios en toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.WEB: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.ASV: Remember his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos perpetuamente de seu pacto, [e] da palavra que ele mandou até mil gerações;
verses.RVR09: Haced memoria de su alianza perpetuamente, y de la palabra que él mandó en mil generaciones;

verses.KJV: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
verses.WEB: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
verses.ASV: [The covenant] which he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,
verses.ALMEIDA: Do pacto que estabeleceu com Abraão, e do seu juramento a Isaque;
verses.RVR09: Del pacto que concertó con Abraham, y de su juramento á Isaac;

verses.KJV: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.WEB: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.ASV: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual confirmou a Jacó por estatuto, a Israel por pacto eterno,
verses.RVR09: El cual confirmó á Jacob por estatuto, y á Israel por pacto sempiterno,

verses.KJV: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
verses.WEB: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
verses.ASV: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: A ti darei a terra de Canaã, a porção de vossa herança;
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: A ti daré la tierra de Canaán, suerte de vuestra herencia;

verses.KJV: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
verses.WEB: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
verses.ASV: When ye were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando vós éreis poucos em número, poucos, e estrangeiros nela;
verses.RVR09: Cuando erais pocos en número, pocos y peregrinos en ella;

verses.KJV: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
verses.WEB: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
verses.ASV: And they went about from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que andavam de nação em nação, de um reino a outro povo.
verses.RVR09: Y andaban de nación en nación, y de un reino á otro pueblo.

verses.KJV: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.WEB: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.ASV: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.ALMEIDA: A ninguém ele permitiu que os oprimisse; por causa deles repreendeu a reis,
verses.RVR09: No permitió que nadie los oprimiese: antes por amor de ellos castigó á los reyes.

verses.KJV: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.WEB: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
verses.ASV: [Saying], Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dizendo] : Não toqueis em meus ungidos, nem façais mal a meus profetas.
verses.RVR09: No toquéis, dijo, á mis ungidos, ni hagáis mal á mis profetas.

verses.KJV: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.WEB: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
verses.ASV: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth; Show forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR, toda a terra, anunciai de dia em dia sua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Jehová, toda la tierra, anunciad de día en día su salud.

verses.KJV: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
verses.WEB: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
verses.ASV: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai entre as nações sua glória, e entre todos os povos suas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Cantad entre las gentes su gloria, y en todos los pueblos sus maravillas.

verses.KJV: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.WEB: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.ASV: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR é grande, e muito digno de ser louvado; ele é mais temível que todos os deuses.
verses.RVR09: Porque grande es Jehová, y digno de ser grandemente loado, y de ser temido sobre todos los dioses.

verses.KJV: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.WEB: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.ASV: For all the gods of the peoples are idols: But Jehovah made the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois todos os deuses dos povos nada são; porém o SENHOR fez os céus.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos los dioses de los pueblos son nada: mas Jehová hizo los cielos.

verses.KJV: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.WEB: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.ASV: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Majestade e esplendor há diante de ele; força e alegria em sua morada.
verses.RVR09: Poderío y hermosura delante de él; fortaleza y alegría en su morada.

verses.KJV: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
verses.WEB: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!
verses.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength;
verses.ALMEIDA: Reconhecei ao SENHOR, ó famílias das nações, reconhecei ao SENHOR a glória e o poder.
verses.RVR09: Atribuid á Jehová, oh familias de los pueblos, atribuid á Jehová gloria y potencia.

verses.KJV: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
verses.WEB: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.
verses.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come before him; Worship Jehovah in holy array.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai ao SENHOR a glória de seu nome; trazei ofertas, e vinde diante dele; adorai ao SENHOR na glória de sua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Tributad á Jehová la gloria debida á su nombre: traed ofrenda, y venid delante de él; postraos delante de Jehová en la hermosura de su santidad.

verses.KJV: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
verses.WEB: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
verses.ASV: Tremble before him, all the earth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assombrai-vos diante dele, vós, toda a terra; o mundo [por ele] foi estabelecido, para que não se movesse.
verses.RVR09: Temed en su presencia, toda la tierra: el mundo será aún establecido, para que no se conmueva.

verses.KJV: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.
verses.WEB: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”
verses.ASV: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; And let them say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrem-se os céus, e goze-se a terra, e digam nas nações: Reina o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Alégrense los cielos, y gócese la tierra, y digan en las naciones: Reina Jehová.

verses.KJV: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
verses.WEB: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!
verses.ASV: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; Let the field exult, and all that is therein;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ressoe o mar, e a plenitude dela: Alegre-se o campo, e todo o que contém.
verses.RVR09: Resuene la mar, y la plenitud de ella: alégrese el campo, y todo lo que contiene.

verses.KJV: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.
verses.WEB: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.
verses.ASV: Then shall the trees of the wood sing for joy before Jehovah; For he cometh to judge the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então cantarão as árvores dos bosques diante do SENHOR, Porque vem a julgar a terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces cantarán los árboles de los bosques delante de Jehová, porque viene á juzgar la tierra.

verses.KJV: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Celebrai a o SENHOR, porque é bom; Porque sua misericórdia é eterna.
verses.RVR09: Celebrad á Jehová, porque es bueno; porque su misericordia es eterna.

verses.KJV: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
verses.WEB: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
verses.ASV: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us together and deliver us from the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizei: Salva-nos, ó Deus, saúde nossa: Junta-nos, e livra-nos das nações, Para que confessemos tua santo nome, e nos gloriemos em teus louvores.
verses.RVR09: Y decid: Sálvanos, oh Dios, salud nuestra: júntanos, y líbranos de las gentes, para que confesemos tu santo nombre, y nos gloriemos en tus alabanzas.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And all the people said, Amen, and praised Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito seja o SENHOR Deus de Israel, De eternidade a eternidade.
verses.RVR09: Bendito sea Jehová Dios de Israel, de eternidad á eternidad. Y dijo todo el pueblo, Amén: y alabó á Jehová.

verses.KJV: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
verses.WEB: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
verses.ASV: So he left there, before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
verses.ALMEIDA: E deixou ali, diante do arca do pacto do SENHOR, a Asafe e a seus irmãos, para que ministrassem de contínuo diante da arca, cada coisa em seu dia:
verses.RVR09: Y dejó allí, delante del arca del pacto de Jehová, á Asaph y á sus hermanos, para que ministrasen de continuo delante del arca, cada cosa en su día:

verses.KJV: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
verses.WEB: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
verses.ASV: and Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Obede-Edom e a seus irmãos, sessenta e oito; e a Obede-Edom filho de Jedutum, e a Hosa, por porteiros:
verses.RVR09: Y á Obed-edom y á sus hermanos, sesenta y ocho; y á Obed-edom hijo de Jeduthún, y á Asa, por porteros:

verses.KJV: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.WEB: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.ASV: and Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of Jehovah in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim a Zadoque o sacerdote, e a seus irmãos os sacerdotes, diante do tabernáculo do SENHOR no alto que estava em Gibeão,
verses.RVR09: Asimismo á Sadoc el sacerdote, y á sus hermanos los sacerdotes, delante del tabernáculo de Jehová en el alto que estaba en Gabaón,

verses.KJV: To offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;
verses.WEB: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
verses.ASV: to offer burnt-offerings unto Jehovah upon the altar of burnt-offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the law of Jehovah, which he commanded unto Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que sacrificassem continuamente, a manhã e tarde, holocaustos a o SENHOR no altar do holocausto, conforme a todo o que está escrito na lei do SENHOR, que ele prescreveu a Israel;
verses.RVR09: Para que sacrificasen continuamente, á mañana y tarde, holocaustos á Jehová en el altar del holocausto, conforme á todo lo que está escrito en la ley de Jehová, que él prescribió á Israel;

verses.KJV: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.WEB: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Jehovah, because his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: E com eles a Hemã e a Jedutum, e os outros escolhidos declarados por seus nomes, para glorificar a o SENHOR, porque é eterna sua misericórdia;
verses.RVR09: Y con ellos á Hemán y á Jeduthún, y los otros escogidos declarados por sus nombres, para glorificar á Jehová, porque es eterna su misericordia;

verses.KJV: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
verses.WEB: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
verses.ASV: and with them Heman and Jeduthun [with] trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and [with] instruments for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com eles a Hemã e a Jedutum com trombetas e címbalos para tanger, e com outros instrumentos de música de Deus; e a os filhos de Jedutum, por porteiros.
verses.RVR09: Con ellos á Hemán y á Jeduthún con trompetas y címbalos para tañer, y con otros instrumentos de música de Dios; y á los hijos de Jeduthún, por porteros.

verses.KJV: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.WEB: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
verses.ASV: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o povo se foi cada um a sua casa; e Davi se voltou para abençoar sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el pueblo se fué cada uno á su casa; y David se volvió para bendecir su casa.

verses.KJV: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.
verses.WEB: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of Jehovah [dwelleth] under curtains.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que morando Davi em sua casa, disse Davi ao profeta Natã: Eis aqui eu habito em casa de cedro, e a arca do pacto do SENHOR debaixo de cortinas.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ que morando David en su casa, dijo David al profeta Nathán: He aquí yo habito en casa de cedro, y el arca del pacto de Jehová debajo de cortinas.

verses.KJV: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
verses.WEB: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
verses.ASV: And Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thy heart; for God is with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Natã disse a Davi: Faze tudo o que está em tua coração, porque Deus é contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y Nathán dijo á David: Haz todo lo que está en tu corazón, porque Dios es contigo.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.WEB: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquela mesma noite foi palavra de Deus a Natã, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: En aquella misma noche fué palabra de Dios á Nathán, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
verses.WEB: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;
verses.ASV: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith Jehovah, Thou shalt not build me a house to dwell in:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai e dize a Davi meu servo: Assim disse o SENHOR: Tu não me edificarás casa em que habite:
verses.RVR09: Ve y di á David mi siervo: Así ha dicho Jehová: Tú no me edificarás casa en que habite:

verses.KJV: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
verses.WEB: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.
verses.ASV: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel, unto this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from [one] tabernacle [to another].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não habitei em casa alguma desde o dia que tirei a os filhos de Israel até hoje; antes estive de tenda em tenda, e de tabernáculo em tabernáculo.
verses.RVR09: Porque no he habitado en casa alguna desde el día que saqué á los hijos de Israel hasta hoy; antes estuve de tienda en tienda, y de tabernáculo en tabernáculo.

verses.KJV: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
verses.WEB: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
verses.ASV: In all places wherein I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, Why have ye not built me a house of cedar?
verses.ALMEIDA: Em todo quanto andei com todo Israel falei uma palavra a algum dos juízes de Israel, a os quais mandei que apascentassem meu povo, para dizer-lhes: Por que não me edificais uma casa de cedro?
verses.RVR09: En todo cuanto anduve con todo Israel ¿hablé una palabra á alguno de los jueces de Israel, á los cuales mandé que apacentasen mi pueblo, para decirles: Por qué no me edificáis una casa de cedro?

verses.KJV: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
verses.WEB: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.
verses.ASV: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be prince over my people Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, agora dirás a meu servo Davi: Assim disse o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eu te tomei da malhada, de detrás do gado, para que fosses príncipe sobre meu povo Israel;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, ahora dirás á mi siervo David: Así dijo Jehová de los ejércitos: Yo te tomé de la majada, de detrás del ganado, para que fueses príncipe sobre mi pueblo Israel;

verses.KJV: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.WEB: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
verses.ASV: and I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast gone, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee; and I will make thee a name, like unto the name of the great ones that are in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fui contigo em tudo quanto andaste, e arranquei a todos teus inimigos de diante de ti, e te fiz grande nome, como o nome dos grandes que são na terra.
verses.RVR09: Y he sido contigo en todo cuanto has andado, y he talado á todos tus enemigos de delante de ti, y hete hecho grande nombre, como el nombre de los grandes que son en la tierra.

verses.KJV: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
verses.WEB: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,
verses.ASV: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the first,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim dispus lugar a meu povo Israel, e o plantei para que habite por si, e que não seja mais comovido: nem os filhos de iniquidade o consumirão mais, como antes,
verses.RVR09: Asimismo he dispuesto lugar á mi pueblo Israel, y lo he plantado para que habite por sí, y que no sea más conmovido: ni los hijos de iniquidad lo consumirán más, como antes,

verses.KJV: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the Lord will build thee an house.
verses.WEB: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.
verses.ASV: and [as] from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel; and I will subdue all thine enemies. Moreover I tell thee that Jehovah will build thee a house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desde o tempo que pus os juízes sobre meu povo Israel; mas humilharei a todos teus inimigos. Faço-te ademais saber que o SENHOR te há de edificar casa.
verses.RVR09: Y desde el tiempo que puse los jueces sobre mi pueblo Israel; mas humillaré á todos tus enemigos. Hágote además saber que Jehová te ha de edificar casa.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.WEB: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when thy days are fulfilled that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will set up thy seed after thee, who shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, quando teus dias forem cumpridos para ir-te com teus pais, levantarei a tua descendência depois de ti, a qual será de teus filhos, e afirmarei seu reino.
verses.RVR09: Y será que, cuando tus días fueren cumplidos para irte con tus padres, levantaré tu simiente después de ti, la cual será de tus hijos, y afirmaré su reino.

verses.KJV: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
verses.WEB: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.ASV: He shall build me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me edificará casa, e eu confirmarei seu trono eternamente.
verses.RVR09: El me edificará casa, y yo confirmaré su trono eternalmente.

verses.KJV: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:
verses.WEB: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;
verses.ASV: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my lovingkindness away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu lhe serei por pai, e ele me será por filho: e não tirarei dele minha misericórdia, como a tirei daquele que foi antes de ti;
verses.RVR09: Yo le seré por padre, y él me será por hijo: y no quitaré de él mi misericordia, como la quité de aquel que fué antes de ti;

verses.KJV: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.WEB: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”
verses.ASV: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom for ever; and his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu o confirmarei em minha casa e em meu reino eternamente; e seu trono será firme para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo lo confirmaré en mi casa y en mi reino eternalmente; y su trono será firme para siempre.

verses.KJV: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.WEB: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.ASV: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme a todas estas palavras, e conforme a toda esta visão, assim falou Natã a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á todas estas palabras, y conforme á toda esta visión, así habló Nathán á David.

verses.KJV: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.WEB: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
verses.ASV: Then David the king went in, and sat before Jehovah; and he said, Who am I, O Jehovah God, and what is my house, that thou hast brought me thus far?
verses.ALMEIDA: E entrou o rei Davi, e esteve diante do SENHOR, e disse: ó SENHOR Deus, quem sou eu, e qual é minha casa, que me trouxeste até este lugar?
verses.RVR09: Y entró el rey David, y estuvo delante de Jehová, y dijo: Jehová Dios, ¿quién soy yo, y cuál es mi casa, que me has traído hasta este lugar?

verses.KJV: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.
verses.WEB: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.
verses.ASV: And this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; but thou hast spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Jehovah God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda isto, ó Deus, te pareceu pouco, pois que falaste da casa de teu servo para mais longe, e me olhaste como a um homem excelente, ó o SENHOR Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y aun esto, oh Dios, te ha parecido poco, pues que has hablado de la casa de tu siervo para más lejos, y me has mirado como á un hombre excelente, oh Jehová Dios.

verses.KJV: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
verses.WEB: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
verses.ASV: What can David [say] yet more unto thee concerning the honor which is done to thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que mais pode dizer Davi pedindo de ti para glorificar a tua servo? Porém tu conheces a teu servo.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué más puede añadir David pidiendo de ti para glorificar á tu siervo? mas tú conoces á tu siervo.

verses.KJV: O Lord, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.WEB: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou wrought all this greatness, to make known all [these] great things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, por amor de teu servo e segundo teu coração, fizeste toda esta grandeza, para fazer notórias todas as tuas grandezas.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, por amor de tu siervo y según tu corazón, has hecho toda esta grandeza, para hacer notorias todas tus grandezas.

verses.KJV: O Lord, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.WEB: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, there is none like thee, neither is there any God besides thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, não há semelhante a ti, nem há Deus a não ser tu, segundo todas as coisas que ouvimos com nossos ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, no hay semejante á ti, ni hay Dios sino tú, según todas las cosas que hemos oído con nuestros oídos.

verses.KJV: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.WEB: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.ASV: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem unto himself for a people, to make thee a name by great and terrible things, in driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou redeemedst out of Egypt?
verses.ALMEIDA: E que gente há na terra como teu povo Israel, cujo Deus fosse e se redimisse um povo, para fazer-te nome com grandezas e maravilhas, expulsando as nações de diante de teu povo, que tu resgataste do Egito?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y qué gente hay en la tierra como tu pueblo Israel, cuyo Dios fuese y se redimiera un pueblo, para hacerte nombre con grandezas y maravillas, echando las gentes de delante de tu pueblo, que tú rescataste de Egipto?

verses.KJV: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Lord, becamest their God.
verses.WEB: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.
verses.ASV: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Jehovah, becamest their God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu constituíste a teu povo Israel por povo teu para sempre; e tu, o SENHOR, vieste a ser seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Tú has constituído á tu pueblo Israel por pueblo tuyo para siempre; y tú, Jehová, has venido á ser su Dios.

verses.KJV: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.WEB: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.
verses.ASV: And now, O Jehovah, let the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, be established for ever, and do as thou hast spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, SENHOR, a palavra que falaste acerca de teu servo e de sua casa, seja firme para sempre, e faze como disseste.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Jehová, la palabra que has hablado acerca de tu siervo y de su casa, sea firme para siempre, y haz como has dicho.

verses.KJV: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
verses.WEB: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’
verses.ASV: And let thy name be established and magnified for ever, saying, Jehovah of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and the house of David thy servant is established before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Permaneça, pois, e seja engrandecido teu nome para sempre, a fim de que se diga: o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, é Deus para Israel. E seja a casa de teu servo Davi firme diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Permanezca pues, y sea engrandecido tu nombre para siempre, á fin de que se diga: Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, es Dios para Israel. Y sea la casa de tu siervo David firme delante de ti.

verses.KJV: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
verses.WEB: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
verses.ASV: For thou, O my God, hast revealed to thy servant that thou wilt build him a house: therefore hath thy servant found [in his heart] to pray before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu, Deus meu, revelaste ao ouvido a teu servo que lhe edificarás casa; por isso achou teu servo motivo de orar diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, Dios mío, revelaste al oído á tu siervo que le has de edificar casa; por eso ha hallado tu siervo motivo de orar delante de ti.

verses.KJV: And now, Lord, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.WEB: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.
verses.ASV: And now, O Jehovah, thou art God, and hast promised this good thing unto thy servant:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, o SENHOR, tu és o Deus que falaste de teu servo este bem;
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Jehová, tú eres el Dios que has hablado de tu siervo este bien;

verses.KJV: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O Lord, and it shall be blessed for ever.
verses.WEB: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”
verses.ASV: and now it hath pleased thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Jehovah, hast blessed, and it is blessed for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora quiseste abençoar a casa de teu servo, para que permaneça perpetuamente diante de ti: porque tu, o SENHOR, a abençoaste, e será bendita para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora has querido bendecir la casa de tu siervo, para que permanezca perpetuamente delante de ti: porque tú, Jehová, la has bendecido, y será bendita para siempre.

verses.KJV: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.WEB: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.ASV: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois destas coisas aconteceu que Davi feriu aos filisteus, e os humilhou; e tomou Gate e suas vilas das mãos dos filisteus.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS de estas cosas aconteció que David hirió á los Filisteos, y los humilló; y tomó á Gath y sus villas de mano de los Filisteos.

verses.KJV: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
verses.WEB: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
verses.ASV: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também feriu a Moabe; e os moabitas foram servos de Davi, trazendo-lhe tributos.
verses.RVR09: También hirió á Moab; y los Moabitas fueron siervos de David trayéndole presentes.

verses.KJV: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.WEB: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.ASV: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim feriu Davi a Hadadezer, rei de Zobá, em Hamate, quando ele foi assegurar seu domínio até o rio Eufrates.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo hirió David á Adarezer rey de Soba, en Hamath, yendo él á asegurar su dominio al río de Eufrates.

verses.KJV: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.WEB: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.
verses.ASV: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hocked all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for a hundred chariots.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou-lhes Davi mil carros, e sete mil a cavalo, e vinte mil homens a pé; e Davi aleijou os cavalos de todos os carros, exceto os de cem carros que deixou.
verses.RVR09: Y tomóles David mil carros, y siete mil de á caballo, y veinte mil hombres de á pie: y desjarretó David los caballos de todos los carros, excepto los de cien carros que dejó.

verses.KJV: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.WEB: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
verses.ASV: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succor Hadarezer king of Zobah, David smote of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo os sírios de Damasco em ajuda de Hadadezer, rei de Zobá, Davi feriu dos sírios vinte e dois mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo los Siros de Damasco en ayuda de Adarezer rey de Soba, David hirió de los Siros veintidós mil hombres.

verses.KJV: Then David put garrisons in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.WEB: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.ASV: Then David put [garrisons] in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. And Jehovah gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi pôs guarnições na Síria de Damasco, e os sírios foram feitos servos de Davi, trazendo-lhe tributos; porque o SENHOR dava vitória a Davi por onde quer que fosse.
verses.RVR09: Y puso David guarnición en Siria la de Damasco, y los Siros fueron hechos siervos de David, trayéndole presentes: porque Jehová salvaba á David donde quiera que iba.

verses.KJV: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomou também Davi os escudos de ouro que levavam os servos de Hadadezer, e trouxe-os a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Tomó también David los escudos de oro que llevaban los siervos de Adarezer, y trájolos á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.WEB: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
verses.ASV: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadarezer, David took very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim de Tibate e de Cum, cidades de Hadadezer, Davi tomou muito bronze, de que Salomão fez o mar de bronze, as colunas, e vasos de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo de Thibath y de Chûn ciudades de Adarezer, tomó David muy mucho metal, de que Salomón hizo el mar de bronce, las columnas, y vasos de bronce.

verses.KJV: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.WEB: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
verses.ASV: And when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo Toú, rei de Hamate, que Davi havia defeito todo o exército de Hadadezer, rei de Zobá,
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo Tou rey de Hamath, que David había deshecho todo el ejército de Adarezer, rey de Soba,

verses.KJV: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.WEB: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
verses.ASV: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadarezer and smitten him (for Hadarezer had wars with Tou); and [he had with him] all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviou seu filho Hdorão ao rei Davi para saudar-lhe e para bendizer-lhe por haver guerreado com Hadadezer, e haver lhe vencido; porque Toú tinha guerra com Hadadezer. Enviou-lhe também toda sorte de artigos de ouro, de prata e de metal;
verses.RVR09: Envió á Adoram su hijo al rey David, á saludarle y á bendecirle por haber peleado con Adarezer, y haberle vencido; porque Tou tenía guerra con Adarezer. Envióle también toda suerte de vasos de oro, de plata y de metal;

verses.KJV: Them also king David dedicated unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.WEB: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.ASV: These also did king David dedicate unto Jehovah, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.ALMEIDA: os quais o rei Davi dedicou a o SENHOR, com a prata e ouro que havia tomado de todas as nações, de Edom, de Moabe, dos filhos de Amom, dos filisteus, e de Amaleque.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales el rey David dedicó á Jehová, con la plata y oro que había tomado de todas las naciones, de Edom, de Moab, de los hijos de Ammón, de los Filisteos, y de Amalec.

verses.KJV: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.WEB: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.ASV: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah smote of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt eighteen thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso Abisai, filho de Zeruia, feriu no vale do sal dezoito mil edomitas.
verses.RVR09: A más de esto Abisai hijo de Sarvia hirió en el valle de la Sal dieciocho mil Idumeos.

verses.KJV: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.WEB: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.ASV: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. And Jehovah gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs guarnições em Edom, e todos os edomitas foram servos de Davi; porque o SENHOR guardava a Davi por onde quer que fosse.
verses.RVR09: Y puso guarnición en Edom, y todos los Idumeos fueron siervos de David: porque Jehová guardaba á David donde quiera que iba.

verses.KJV: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.WEB: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
verses.ASV: And David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness unto all his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reinou Davi sobre todo Israel, e fazia juízo e justiça a todo seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y reinó David sobre todo Israel, y hacía juicio y justicia á todo su pueblo.

verses.KJV: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
verses.WEB: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.ASV: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joabe, filho de Zeruia, era general do exército; e Josafá filho de Ailude, cronista;
verses.RVR09: Y Joab hijo de Sarvia era general del ejército; y Josaphat hijo de Ahilud, canciller;

verses.KJV: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.WEB: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;
verses.ASV: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zadoque, filho de Aitube, e Abimeleque filho de Abiatar, eram sacerdotes; e Sausa, secretário;
verses.RVR09: Y Sadoc hijo de Achîtob, y Abimelec hijo de Abiathar, eran sacerdotes; y Sausa, secretario;

verses.KJV: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.WEB: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
verses.ASV: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Benaia, filho de Joiada, era sobre os quereteus e peleteus; e os filhos de Davi eram os principais próximos do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y Benaías hijo de Joiada era sobre los Ceretheos y Peletheos; y los hijos de David eran los príncipes cerca del rey.

verses.KJV: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois destas coisas, aconteceu que morreu Naás, rei dos filhos de Amom, e seu filho reinou em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS de estas cosas aconteció que murió Naas rey de los hijos de Ammón, y reinó en su lugar su hijo.

verses.KJV: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.WEB: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.
verses.ASV: And David said, I will show kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me. So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi: Farei misericórdia com Hanã filho de Naás, porque também seu pai fez comigo misericórdia. Assim Davi enviou embaixadores que o consolassem da morte de seu pai. Mas vindos os servos de Davi na terra dos filhos de Amom a Hanã,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David: Haré misericordia con Hanán hijo de Naas, porque también su padre hizo conmigo misericordia. Así David envió embajadores que lo consolasen de la muerte de su padre. Mas venidos los siervos de David en la tierra de los hijos de Ammón á Hanán, para consolarle,

verses.KJV: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
verses.WEB: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”
verses.ASV: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honor thy father, in that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
verses.ALMEIDA: os príncipes dos filhos de Amom disseram a Hanã: Pensas que Davi está honrando o teu pai, de maneira que te enviou consoladores? Acaso não é que os servos dele vêm a ti para espionar, e investigar, e reconhecer a terra?
verses.RVR09: Los príncipes de los hijos de Ammón dijeron á Hanán: ¿A tu parecer honra David á tu padre, que te ha enviado consoladores? ¿no vienen antes sus siervos á ti para escudriñar, é inquirir, y reconocer la tierra?

verses.KJV: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.WEB: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.ASV: So Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Hanã tomou os servos de Davi, rapou-os, e cortou-lhes as vestes ao meio, até as nádegas, e despachou-os.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Hanán tomó los siervos de David, y rapólos, y cortóles los vestidos por medio, hasta las nalgas, y despachólos.

verses.KJV: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
verses.WEB: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
verses.ASV: Then there went certain persons, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them; for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foram-se, pois, e quando foi dada a Davi a notícia acerca daqueles homens, ele mandou que fossem ao encontro deles, porque estavam muito afrontados. E o rei mandou-lhes dizer: Ficai em Jericó até que vos cresça a barba, e então voltareis.
verses.RVR09: Fuéronse pues, y dada que fué la nueva á David de aquellos varones, él envió á recibirlos, porque estaban muy afrentados. E hízoles decir el rey: Estaos en Jericó hasta que os crezca la barba, y entonces volveréis.

verses.KJV: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.
verses.WEB: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
verses.ASV: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os filhos de Amom viram que se haviam feito Davi ter ódio deles, Hanã e os filhos de Amom enviaram mil talentos de prata, para alugarem carruragens e cavaleiros da Mesopotâmia, da Síria de Maaca, e de Zobá.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo los hijos de Ammón que se habían hecho odiosos á David, Hanán y los hijos de Ammón enviaron mil talentos de plata, para tomar á sueldo carros y gente de á caballo de Siria de los ríos, y de la Siria de Maachâ, y de Soba.

verses.KJV: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.WEB: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.ASV: So they hired them thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people, who came and encamped before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alugaram trinta e dois mil carruagens, e ao rei de Maaca com o seu povo, os quais vieram e assentaram seu acampamento diante de Medeba. E juntaram-se também os filhos de Amom de suas cidades, e vieram à guerra.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaron á sueldo treinta y dos mil carros, y al rey de Maachâ y á su pueblo, los cuales vinieron y asentaron su campo delante de Medeba. Y juntáronse también los hijos de Ammón de sus ciudades, y vinieron á la guerra.

verses.KJV: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.WEB: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.
verses.ASV: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvindo-o Davi, enviou a Joabe com todo o exército dos homens valentes.
verses.RVR09: Oyéndolo David, envió á Joab con todo el ejército de los hombres valientes.

verses.KJV: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
verses.WEB: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
verses.ASV: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Amom saíram, e ordenaram sua tropa à entrada da cidade; e os reis que haviam vindo, estavam à parte no acampamento.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Ammón salieron, y ordenaron su tropa á la entrada de la ciudad; y los reyes que habían venido, estaban por sí en el campo.

verses.KJV: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
verses.WEB: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
verses.ASV: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo Joabe que a linha da batalha estava contra ele pela frente e por trás, escolheu de todos os mais capacitados que havia em Israel, e pôs seu esquadrão em formação contra os sírios.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo Joab que la haz de la batalla estaba contra él delante y á las espaldas, escogió de todos los más aventajados que había en Israel, y ordenó su escuadrón contra los Siros.

verses.KJV: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.WEB: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.ASV: And the rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois pôs os outros nas mãos de seu irmão Abisai, que os pôes em formação de batalha contra os amonitas.
verses.RVR09: Puso luego el resto de la gente en mano de Abisai su hermano, ordenándolos en batalla contra los Ammonitas.

verses.KJV: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.WEB: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
verses.ASV: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me; but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Se os sírios forem mais fortes que eu, tu me socorrerás; e se os amonitas forem mais fortes que tu, eu te socorrerei.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Si los Siros fueren más fuertes que yo, tú me salvarás; y si los Ammonitas fueren más fuertes que tú, yo te salvaré.

verses.KJV: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the Lord do that which is good in his sight.
verses.WEB: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”
verses.ASV: Be of good courage, and let us play the man for our people, and for the cities of our God: and Jehovah do that which seemeth him good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esforça-te, e sejamos corajosos por nosso povo, e pelas cidades de nosso Deus; e faça o SENHOR o que bem lhe parecer.
verses.RVR09: Esfuérzate, y esforcémonos por nuestro pueblo, y por las ciudades de nuestro Dios; y haga Jehová lo que bien le pareciere.

verses.KJV: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.WEB: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.ASV: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aproximou-se, então, Joabe e o povo que tinha consigo, para lutar contra os sírios; mas eles fugiram diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Acercóse luego Joab y el pueblo que tenía consigo, para pelear contra los Siros; mas ellos huyeron delante de él.

verses.KJV: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Amom, vendo que os sírios haviam fugido, fugiram também eles diante de Abisai seu irmão, e entraram-se na cidade. Então Joabe se voltou a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Ammón, viendo que los Siros habían huído, huyeron también ellos delante de Abisai su hermano, y entráronse en la ciudad. Entonces Joab se volvió á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
verses.WEB: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
verses.ASV: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer at their head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo os sírios que haviam caído diante de Israel, enviaram embaixadores, e trouxeram aos sírios que estavam da outra parte do rio, cujo capitão era Sofaque, general do exército de Hadadezer.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo los Siros que habían caído delante de Israel, enviaron embajadores, y trajeron á los Siros que estaban de la otra parte del río, cuyo capitán era Sophach, general del ejército de Adarezer.

verses.KJV: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.WEB: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.ASV: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel together, and passed over the Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Logo que foi dado aviso a Davi, juntou a todo Israel, e passando o Jordão veio a eles, e ordenou contra eles seu exército. E como Davi havia ordenado sua tropa contra eles, os sírios lutaram com ele.
verses.RVR09: Luego que fué dado aviso á David, juntó á todo Israel, y pasando el Jordán vino á ellos, y ordenó contra ellos su ejército. Y como David hubo ordenado su tropa contra ellos, pelearon con él los Siros.

verses.KJV: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.WEB: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.
verses.ASV: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians [the men of] seven thousand chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os sírios fugiram diante de Israel; e Davi matou dos sírios sete mil homens das carruagens, e quarenta mil homens a pé; assim matou Sofaque, general do exército.
verses.RVR09: Mas el Siro huyó delante de Israel; y mató David de los Siros siete mil hombres de los carros, y cuarenta mil hombres de á pie: asimismo mató á Sophach, general del ejército.

verses.KJV: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.WEB: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.ASV: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and served him: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo os sírios de Hadadezer que haviam caído diante de Israel, concordarem em fazer a paz com Davi, e foram seus servos; e nunca mais os sírios quiseram ajudar os filhos de Amom.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo los Siros de Adarezer que habían caído delante de Israel, concertaron paz con David, y fueron sus siervos; y nunca más quiso el Siro ayudar á los hijos de Ammón.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
verses.WEB: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, at the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out [to battle], that Joab led forth the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and overthrew it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu à volta do ano, no tempo que costumam os reis sair à guerra, que Joabe tirou as forças do exército, e destruiu a terra dos filhos de Amom, e veio e cercou a Rabá. Mas Davi estava em Jerusalém; e Joabe atacou Rabá, e a destruiu.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ á la vuelta del año, en el tiempo que suelen los reyes salir á la guerra, que Joab sacó las fuerzas del ejército, y destruyó la tierra de los hijos de Ammón, y vino y cercó á Rabba. Mas David estaba en Jerusalem: y Joab batió á Rabba, y destruyóla.

verses.KJV: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
verses.WEB: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.
verses.ASV: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought forth the spoil of the city, exceeding much.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou Davi a coroa de seu rei de encima de sua cabeça, e achou-a de peso de um talento de ouro, e havia nela pedras preciosas; e foi posta sobre a cabeça de Davi. E ademais de isto tirou da cidade um muito grande despojo.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó David la corona de su rey de encima de su cabeza, y hallóla de peso de un talento de oro, y había en ella piedras preciosas; y fué puesta sobre la cabeza de David. Y además de esto sacó de la ciudad un muy gran despojo.

verses.KJV: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and cut [them] with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. And thus did David unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tirou também ao povo que estava nela, e cortou-os com serras, e com trilhos de ferro, e machados. O mesmo fez Davi a todas as cidades dos filhos de Amom. E voltou-se Davi com todo o povo a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Sacó también al pueblo que estaba en ella, y cortólos con sierras, y con trillos de hierro, y segures. Lo mismo hizo David á todas las ciudades de los hijos de Ammón. Y volvióse David con todo el pueblo á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
verses.WEB: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines: then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de isto aconteceu que se levantou guerra em Gezer com os filisteus; e feriu Sibecai Husatita a Sipai, da linhagem dos gigantes; e foram humilhados.
verses.RVR09: Después de esto aconteció que se levantó guerra en Gezer con los Filisteos; é hirió Sibbecai Husathita á Sippai, del linaje de los gigantes; y fueron humillados.

verses.KJV: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.
verses.WEB: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.ASV: And there was again war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou-se a levantar guerra com os filisteus; e feriu Elanã filho de Jair a Lami, irmão de Golias geteu, a haste de cuja lança era como um lançador de tecedores.
verses.RVR09: Y volvióse á levantar guerra con los Filisteos; é hirió Elhanán hijo de Jair á Lahmi, hermano de Goliath Getheo, el asta de cuya lanza era como un enjullo de tejedores.

verses.KJV: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot and he also was the son of the giant.
verses.WEB: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.ASV: And there was again war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six [on each hand], and six [on each foot]; and he also was born unto the giant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou a haver guerra em Gate, de onde havia um homem de grande estatura, o qual tinha seis dedos em pés e mãos, em todos vinte e quatro: e também era filho de Rafa.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió á haber guerra en Gath, donde hubo un hombre de grande estatura, el cual tenía seis dedos en pies y manos, en todos veinticuatro: y también era hijo de Rapha.

verses.KJV: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.
verses.WEB: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
verses.ASV: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Insultou ele a Israel, mas feriu-o Jônatas, filho de Simeia irmão de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Denostó él á Israel, mas hiriólo Jonathán, hijo de Sima hermano de David.

verses.KJV: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.WEB: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.ASV: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram filhos de Rafa em Gate, os quais caíram por mão de Davi e de seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron hijos de Rapha en Gath, los cuales cayeron por mano de David y de sus siervos.

verses.KJV: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
verses.WEB: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.
verses.ASV: And Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Satanás se levantou contra Israel, e incitou a Davi a que contasse a Israel.
verses.RVR09: MAS Satanás se levantó contra Israel, é incitó á David á que contase á Israel.

verses.KJV: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
verses.WEB: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”
