verses.ASV: And David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know the sum of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi a Joabe e a os príncipes do povo: Ide, contai a Israel desde Berseba até Dã, e trazei-me o número deles para que eu o saiba.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David á Joab y á los príncipes del pueblo: Id, contad á Israel desde Beer-seba hasta Dan, y traedme el número de ellos para que yo lo sepa.

verses.KJV: And Joab answered, The Lord make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
verses.WEB: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”
verses.ASV: And Joab said, Jehovah make his people a hundred times as many as they are: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of guilt unto Israel?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Joabe: Acrescente o SENHOR a seu povo cem vezes outros tantos. Rei senhor meu, não são todos estes servos de meu senhor? Para que procura meu senhor isto, que será pernicioso a Israel?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Joab: Añada Jehová á su pueblo cien veces otros tantos. Rey señor mío, ¿no son todos estos siervos de mi señor? ¿para qué procura mi señor esto, que será pernicioso á Israel?

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o mandamento do rei pode mais que Joabe. Saiu por tanto Joabe, e foi por todo Israel; e voltou a Jerusalém, e deu a conta do número do povo a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Mas el mandamiento del rey pudo más que Joab. Salió por tanto Joab, y fué por todo Israel; y volvió á Jerusalem, y dió la cuenta del número del pueblo á David.

verses.KJV: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.WEB: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.
verses.ASV: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and a hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E achou-se em todo Israel que tiravam espada, onze vezes cem mil; e de Judá quatrocentos e setenta mil homens que tiravam espada.
verses.RVR09: Y hallóse en todo Israel que sacaban espada, once veces cien mil; y de Judá cuatrocientos y setenta mil hombres que sacaban espada.

verses.KJV: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
verses.WEB: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
verses.ASV: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them; for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entre estes não foram contados os levitas, nem os filhos de Benjamim, porque Joabe abominava o mandamento do rei.
verses.RVR09: Entre estos no fueron contados los Levitas, ni los hijos de Benjamín, porque Joab abominaba el mandamiento del rey.

verses.KJV: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
verses.WEB: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.
verses.ASV: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim desagradou este negócio a os olhos de Deus, e feriu a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo desagradó este negocio á los ojos de Dios, é hirió á Israel.

verses.KJV: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.WEB: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”
verses.ASV: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing: but now, put away, I beseech thee, the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi a Deus: Pequei gravemente em fazer isto: rogo-te que faças passar a iniquidade de teu servo, porque eu ei feito muito loucamente.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David á Dios: He pecado gravemente en hacer esto: ruégote que hagas pasar la iniquidad de tu siervo, porque yo he hecho muy locamente.

verses.KJV: And the Lord spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou o SENHOR a Gade, vidente de Davi, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jehová á Gad, vidente de David, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.WEB: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
verses.ASV: Go and speak unto David, saying, Thus saith Jehovah, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, e fala a Davi, e dize-lhe: Assim disse o SENHOR: Três coisas te proponho; escolhe de elas uma que eu faça contigo.
verses.RVR09: Ve, y habla á David, y dile: Así ha dicho Jehová: Tres cosas te propongo; escoge de ellas una que yo haga contigo.

verses.KJV: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose thee
verses.WEB: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:
verses.ASV: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Take which thou wilt:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo Gade a Davi, disse-lhe: Assim disse o SENHOR:
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo Gad á David, díjole: Así ha dicho Jehová:

verses.KJV: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the Lord, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
verses.WEB: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”
verses.ASV: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before thy foes, while the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of Jehovah, even pestilence in the land, and the angel of Jehovah destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Escolhe-te, ou três anos de fome; ou ser por três meses defeito diante de teus inimigos, e que a espada de teus adversários te alcance; ou por três dias a espada do SENHOR e pestilência na terra, e que o anjo do SENHOR destrua em todo o termo de Israel. Olha, pois, o que responderá ao que me enviou.
verses.RVR09: Escógete, ó tres años de hambre; ó ser por tres meses deshecho delante de tus enemigos, y que la espada de tus adversarios te alcance; ó por tres días la espada de Jehová y pestilencia en la tierra, y que el ángel de Jehová destruya en todo el término de Israel: mira pues qué he de responder al que me ha enviado.

verses.KJV: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the Lord; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.WEB: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”
verses.ASV: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall, I pray, into the hand of Jehovah; for very great are his mercies: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi disse a Gade: Estou em grande angústia: rogo que eu caia na mão do SENHOR; porque suas misericórdias são muitas em extremo, e que não caia eu em mãos de homens.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David dijo á Gad: Estoy en grande angustia: ruego que yo caiga en la mano de Jehová; porque sus misericordias son muchas en extremo, y que no caiga yo en manos de hombres.

verses.KJV: So the Lord sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.WEB: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
verses.ASV: So Jehovah sent a pestilence upon Israel; and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o SENHOR deu pestilência em Israel, e caíram de Israel setenta mil homens.
verses.RVR09: Así Jehová dió pestilencia en Israel, y cayeron de Israel setenta mil hombres.

verses.KJV: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.WEB: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.ASV: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was about to destroy, Jehovah beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the destroying angel, It is enough; now stay thy hand. And the angel of Jehovah was standing by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou o SENHOR o anjo a Jerusalém para destruí-la: mas estando ele destruindo, olhou o SENHOR, e arrependeu-se daquele mal,
verses.RVR09: Y envió Jehová el ángel á Jerusalem para destruirla: pero estando él destruyendo, miró Jehová, y arrepintióse de aquel mal,

verses.KJV: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.WEB: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
verses.ASV: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of Jehovah standing between earth and heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando Davi seus olhos, viu ao anjo do SENHOR, que estava entre o céu e a terra, tendo uma espada nua em sua mão, estendida contra Jerusalém. Então Davi e os anciãos se prostraram sobre seus rostos, cobertos de sacos.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo al ángel que destruía: Basta ya; detén tu mano. Y el ángel de Jehová estaba junto á la era de Ornán Jebuseo.

verses.KJV: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
verses.WEB: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”
verses.ASV: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? let thy hand, I pray thee, O Jehovah my God, be against me, and against my father’s house; but not against thy people, that they should be plagued.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi a Deus: Não sou eu o que fez contar o povo? Eu mesmo sou o que pequei, e certamente fiz mal; mas estas ovelhas, que fizeram? Ó SENHOR, Deus meu, seja agora tua mão contra mim, e contra a casa de meu pai, e não haja praga em teu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y alzando David sus ojos, vió al ángel de Jehová, que estaba entre el cielo y la tierra, teniendo un espada desnuda en su mano, extendida contra Jerusalem. Entonces David y los ancianos se postraron sobre sus rostros, cubiertos de sacos.

verses.KJV: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.ASV: Then the angel of Jehovah commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and rear an altar unto Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o anjo do SENHOR ordenou a Gade que dissesse a Davi, que subisse e construísse um altar a o SENHOR na era de Ornã jebuseu.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David á Dios: ¿No soy yo el que hizo contar el pueblo? Yo mismo soy el que pequé, y ciertamente he hecho mal; mas estas ovejas, ¿qué han hecho? Jehová Dios mío, sea ahora tu mano contra mí, y contra la casa de mi padre, y no haya plaga en tu pueblo.

verses.KJV: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Davi subiu, conforme a palavra de Gade que lhe havia dito em nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el ángel de Jehová ordenó á Gad que dijese á David, que subiese y construyese un altar á Jehová en la era de Ornán Jebuseo.

verses.KJV: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.WEB: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.ASV: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons that were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltando-se Ornã viu o anjo; pelo que se esconderam quatro filhos seus que com ele estavam. E Ornã trilhava o trigo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces David subió, conforme á la palabra de Gad que le había dicho en nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.WEB: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.ASV: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing-floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vindo Davi a Ornã, olhou este, e viu a Davi: e saindo da eira, prostrou-se em terra a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y volviéndose Ornán vió al ángel; por lo que se escondieron cuatro hijos suyos que con él estaban. Y Ornán trillaba el trigo.

verses.KJV: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the Lord: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.WEB: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
verses.ASV: Then David said to Ornan, Give me the place of this threshing-floor, that I may build thereon an altar unto Jehovah: for the full price shalt thou give it me, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disse Davi a Ornã: Dá-me este lugar da eira, em que edifique um altar a o SENHOR, e dá-o a mim por seu devido preço, para que cesse a praga do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y viniendo David á Ornán, miró éste, y vió á David: y saliendo de la era, postróse en tierra á David.

verses.KJV: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
verses.WEB: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”
verses.ASV: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give [thee] the oxen for burnt-offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal-offering; I give it all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ornã respondeu a Davi: Toma-o para ti, e faça meu senhor o rei o que bem lhe parecer; e ainda os bois darei para o holocausto, e os trilhos para lenha, e trigo para a oferta de alimentos; eu dou tudo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo David á Ornán: Dame este lugar de la era, en que edifique un altar á Jehová, y dámelo por su cabal precio, para que cese la plaga del pueblo.

verses.KJV: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
verses.WEB: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”
verses.ASV: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for Jehovah, nor offer a burnt-offering without cost.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei Davi disse a Ornã: Não, mas sim que efetivamente a comprarei por seu justo preço: porque não tomarei para o SENHOR o que é teu, nem sacrificarei holocausto que nada me custe.
verses.RVR09: Y Ornán respondió á David: Tómalo para ti, y haga mi señor el rey lo que bien le pareciere: y aun los bueyes daré para el holocausto, y los trillos para leña, y trigo para el presente: yo lo doy todo.

verses.KJV: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.WEB: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
verses.ASV: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu Davi a Ornã pelo lugar seiscentos siclos de ouro por peso.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey David dijo á Ornán: No, sino que efectivamente la compraré por su justo precio: porque no tomaré para Jehová lo que es tuyo, ni sacrificaré holocausto que nada me cueste.

verses.KJV: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.WEB: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.ASV: And David built there an altar unto Jehovah, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and called upon Jehovah; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou ali Davi um altar a o SENHOR, em o que ofereceu holocaustos e sacrifícios pacíficos, e invocou a o SENHOR, o qual lhe respondeu por fogo dos céus em o altar do holocausto.
verses.RVR09: Y dió David á Ornán por el lugar seiscientos siclos de oro por peso.

verses.KJV: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E como o SENHOR falou ao anjo, ele voltou sua espada à bainha.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó allí David un altar á Jehová, en el que ofreció holocaustos y sacrificios pacíficos, é invocó á Jehová, el cual le respondió por fuego de los cielos en el altar del holocausto.

verses.KJV: At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.WEB: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.ASV: At that time, when David saw that Jehovah had answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vendo Davi que o SENHOR lhe havia ouvido na eira de Ornã jebuseu, sacrificou ali.
verses.RVR09: Y como Jehová habló al ángel, él volvió su espada á la vaina.

verses.KJV: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.WEB: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.ASV: For the tabernacle of Jehovah, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt-offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o tabernáculo do SENHOR que Moisés havia feito no deserto, e o altar do holocausto, estavam então no alto de Gibeão:
verses.RVR09: Entonces viendo David que Jehová le había oído en la era de Ornán Jebuseo, sacrificó allí.

verses.KJV: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.
verses.WEB: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.
verses.ASV: But David could not go before it to inquire of God; for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Davi não pode ir ali a consultar a Deus, porque estava espantado por causa da espada do anjo do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el tabernáculo de Jehová que Moisés había hecho en el desierto, y el altar del holocausto, estaban entonces en el alto de Gabaón: Mas David no pudo ir allá á consultar á Dios, porque estaba espantado á causa de la espada del ángel de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
verses.WEB: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
verses.ASV: Then David said, This is the house of Jehovah God, and this is the altar of burnt-offering for Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi: Esta é a casa do SENHOR Deus, e este é o altar do holocausto para Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y DIJO David: Esta es la casa de Jehová Dios, y este es el altar del holocausto para Israel.

verses.KJV: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
verses.WEB: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.
verses.ASV: And David commanded to gather together the sojourners that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois mandou Davi que se juntassem os estrangeiros que estavam na terra de Israel, e assinalou deles pedreiros que lavrassem pedras para edificar a casa de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Después mandó David que se juntasen los extranjeros que estaban en la tierra de Israel, y señaló de ellos canteros que labrasen piedras para edificar la casa de Dios.

verses.KJV: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.WEB: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,
verses.ASV: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim preparou Davi muito ferro para os pregos das portas, e para as junturas; e muito metal sem peso, e madeira de cedro sem conta.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo aparejó David mucho hierro para la clavazón de las puertas, y para las junturas; y mucho metal sin peso, y madera de cedro sin cuenta.

verses.KJV: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.WEB: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.
verses.ASV: and cedar-trees without number: for the Sidonians and they of Tyre brought cedar-trees in abundance to David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os sidônios e tírios haviam trazido a Davi madeira de cedro inumerável.
verses.RVR09: Porque los Sidonios y Tirios habían traído á David madera de cedro innumerable.

verses.KJV: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.WEB: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.ASV: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for Jehovah must be exceeding magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi: Salomão meu filho é jovem e tenro, e a casa que se há de edificar a o SENHOR há de ser magnífica por excelência, para nome e honra em todas as terras; agora pois eu lhe prepararei o necessário. E preparou Davi antes de sua morte em grande abundância.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David: Salomón mi hijo es muchacho y tierno, y la casa que se ha de edificar á Jehová ha de ser magnífica por excelencia, para nombre y honra en todas las tierras; ahora pues yo le aparejaré lo necesario. Y preparó David antes de su muerte en grande abundancia.

verses.KJV: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the Lord God of Israel.
verses.WEB: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamou então Davi a Salomão seu filho, e mandou-lhe que edificasse casa a o SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Llamó entonces David á Salomón su hijo, y mandóle que edificase casa á Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God:
verses.WEB: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.
verses.ASV: And David said to Solomon his son, As for me, it was in my heart to build a house unto the name of Jehovah my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Davi a Salomão: Filho meu, em meu coração tive o edificar templo ao nome do SENHOR meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo David á Salomón: Hijo mío, en mi corazón tuve el edificar templo al nombre de Jehová mi Dios.

verses.KJV: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.WEB: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
verses.ASV: But the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build a house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo: Tu derramaste muito sangue, e trouxeste grandes guerras: não edificarás casa a meu nome, porque derramaste muito sangue na terra diante de mim:
verses.RVR09: Mas vino á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo: Tú has derramado mucha sangre, y has traído grandes guerras: no edificarás casa á mi nombre, porque has derramado mucha sangre en la tierra delante de mí:

verses.KJV: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
verses.WEB: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
verses.ASV: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui, um filho te nascerá, o qual será homem de repouso, porque eu lhe darei quietude de todos seus inimigos em derredor; por tanto seu nome será Salomão; e eu darei paz e repouso sobre Israel em seus dias:
verses.RVR09: He aquí, un hijo te nacerá, el cual será varón de reposo, porque yo le daré quietud de todos sus enemigos en derredor; por tanto su nombre será Salomón; y yo daré paz y reposo sobre Israel en sus días:

verses.KJV: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.WEB: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
verses.ASV: He shall build a house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele edificará casa a meu nome, e ele me será a mim por filho, e eu lhe serei por pai; e afirmarei o trono de seu reino sobre Israel para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El edificará casa á mi nombre, y él me será á mí por hijo, y yo le seré por padre; y afirmaré el trono de su reino sobre Israel para siempre.

verses.KJV: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.
verses.WEB: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
verses.ASV: Now, my son, Jehovah be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of Jehovah thy God, as he hath spoken concerning thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, filho meu, seja contigo o SENHOR, e sejas próspero, e edifiques casa a o SENHOR teu Deus, como ele disse de ti.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, hijo mío, sea contigo Jehová, y seas prosperado, y edifiques casa á Jehová tu Dios, como él ha dicho de ti.

verses.KJV: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.
verses.WEB: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.
verses.ASV: Only Jehovah give thee discretion and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel; that so thou mayest keep the law of Jehovah thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR te dê entendimento e prudência, e ele te dê mandamentos para Israel; e que tu guardes a lei do SENHOR teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová te dé entendimiento y prudencia, y él te dé mandamientos para Israel; y que tú guardes la ley de Jehová tu Dios.

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
verses.WEB: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Jehovah charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então serás próspero, se cuidares de pôr por obra os estatutos e direitos que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés para Israel. Esforça-te pois, e recobra ânimo; não temas, nem desmaies.
verses.RVR09: Entonces serás prosperado, si cuidares de poner por obra los estatutos y derechos que Jehová mandó á Moisés para Israel. Esfuérzate pues, y cobra ánimo; no temas, ni desmayes.

verses.KJV: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
verses.WEB: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.
verses.ASV: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the house of Jehovah a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver, and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui, eu em minha estreiteza preveni para a casa do SENHOR cem mil talentos de ouro, e um milhar de milhares de talentos de prata: não tem peso o metal nem o ferro, porque é muito. Assim aprontei madeira e pedra, a o qual tu acrescentarás.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo en mi estrechez he prevenido para la casa de Jehová cien mil talentos de oro, y un millar de millares de talentos de plata: no tiene peso el metal ni el hierro, porque es mucho. Asimismo he aprestado madera y piedra, á lo cual tú añadirás.

verses.KJV: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
verses.WEB: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;
verses.ASV: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all men that are skilful in every manner of work:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu tens contigo muitos oficiais, pedreiros, pedreiros, e carpinteiros, e todo homem especialista em toda obra.
verses.RVR09: Tú tienes contigo muchos oficiales, canteros, albañiles, y carpinteros, y todo hombre experto en toda obra.

verses.KJV: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.
verses.WEB: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”
verses.ASV: of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and Jehovah be with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do ouro, da prata, do metal, e do ferro, não há número. Levanta-te, pois, e à obra; que o SENHOR será contigo.
verses.RVR09: Del oro, de la plata, del metal, y del hierro, no hay número. Levántate pues, y á la obra; que Jehová será contigo.

verses.KJV: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
verses.WEB: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
verses.ASV: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, [saying],
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim mandou Davi a todos os principais de Israel que dessem ajuda a Salomão seu filho, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Asimismo mandó David á todos los principales de Israel que diesen ayuda á Salomón su hijo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.
verses.WEB: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.
verses.ASV: Is not Jehovah your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Jehovah, and before his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é convosco o SENHOR vosso Deus, o qual vos há dado quietude de todas as partes? Porque ele entregou em minha mão os moradores da terra, e a terra há sido sujeitada diante do SENHOR, e diante de seu povo.
verses.RVR09: ¿No es con vosotros Jehová vuestro Dios, el cual os ha dado quietud de todas partes? porque él ha entregado en mi mano los moradores de la tierra, y la tierra ha sido sujetada delante de Jehová, y delante de su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”
verses.ASV: Now set your heart and your soul to seek after Jehovah your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of Jehovah God, to bring the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ponde, pois, agora vossos corações e vossos ânimos em buscar a o SENHOR vosso Deus; e levantai-vos, e edificai o santuário do Deus o SENHOR, para trazer a arca do pacto do SENHOR, e o santos vasos de Deus, à casa edificada ao nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Poned, pues, ahora vuestros corazones y vuestros ánimos en buscar á Jehová vuestro Dios; y levantaos, y edificad el santuario del Dios Jehová, para traer el arca del pacto de Jehová, y lo santos vasos de Dios, á la casa edificada al nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.WEB: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.ASV: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sendo, pois, Davi já velho e farto de dias, fez a Salomão seu filho rei sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: SIENDO pues David ya viejo y harto de días, hizo á Salomón su hijo rey sobre Israel.

verses.KJV: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.WEB: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.ASV: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntando a todos os principais de Israel, e a os sacerdotes e levitas,
verses.RVR09: Y juntando á todos los principales de Israel, y á los sacerdotes y Levitas,

verses.KJV: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.WEB: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.ASV: And the Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foram contados os levitas de trinta anos acima; e foi o número deles por suas cabeças, contados um a um, trinta e oito mil.
verses.RVR09: Fueron contados los Levitas de treinta años arriba; y fué el número de ellos por sus cabezas, contados uno á uno, treinta y ocho mil.

verses.KJV: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges:
verses.WEB: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,
verses.ASV: Of these, twenty and four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of Jehovah; and six thousand were officers and judges;
verses.ALMEIDA: Destes, vinte e quatro mil para dar pressa à obra da casa do SENHOR; e governadores e juízes, seis mil;
verses.RVR09: De éstos, veinticuatro mil para dar prisa á la obra de la casa de Jehová; y gobernadores y jueces, seis mil;

verses.KJV: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
verses.WEB: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
verses.ASV: and four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised Jehovah with the instruments which I made, [said David], to praise therewith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ademais quatro mil porteiros; e quatro mil para louvar a o SENHOR, disse Davi, com os instrumentos que fiz para render louvores.
verses.RVR09: Además cuatro mil porteros; y cuatro mil para alabar á Jehová, dijo David, con los instrumentos que he hecho para rendir alabanzas.

verses.KJV: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.WEB: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ASV: And David divided them into courses according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.ALMEIDA: E repartiu-os Davi em ordens conforme a os filhos de Levi, Gérson e Coate e Merari.
verses.RVR09: Y repartiólos David en órdenes conforme á los hijos de Leví, Gersón y Coath y Merari.

verses.KJV: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
verses.WEB: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
verses.ASV: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Gérson: Ladã, e Simei.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Gersón: Ladán, y Simi.

verses.KJV: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.ASV: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Ladã, três: Jeiel o primeiro, depois Zetã e Joel.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Ladán, tres: Jehiel el primero, después Zetham y Joel.

verses.KJV: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
verses.WEB: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
verses.ASV: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of Ladan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Simei, três: Selomote, Haziel, e Harã. Estes foram os príncipes das famílias de Ladã.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Simi, tres: Selomith, Haziel, y Arán. Estos fueron los príncipes de las familias de Ladán.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.WEB: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Simei: Jaate, Zina, Jeus, e Berias. Estes quatro foram os filhos de Simei.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Simi: Jahath, Zinat, Jeus, y Berías. Estos cuatro fueron los hijos de Simi.

verses.KJV: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
verses.WEB: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
verses.ASV: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jaate era o primeiro, Zina o segundo; mas Jeus e Berias não multiplicaram em filhos, por o qual foram contados por uma família.
verses.RVR09: Jahath era el primero, Zinat el segundo; mas Jeus y Berías no multiplicaron en hijos, por lo cual fueron contados por una familia.

verses.KJV: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.WEB: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.ASV: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, e Uziel, eles quatro.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Coath: Amram, Ishar, Hebrón, y Uzziel, ellos cuatro.

verses.KJV: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
verses.WEB: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
verses.ASV: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons, for ever, to burn incense before Jehovah, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Anrão: Arão e Moisés. E Arão foi apartado para ser dedicado às mais santas coisas, ele e seus filhos para sempre, para que queimassem perfumes diante do SENHOR, e lhe ministrassem, e bendisessem em seu nome, para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Amram: Aarón y Moisés. Y Aarón fué apartado para ser dedicado á las más santas cosas, él y sus hijos para siempre, para que quemasen perfumes delante de Jehová, y le ministrasen, y bendijesen en su nombre, para siempre.

verses.KJV: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.WEB: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
verses.ASV: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Moisés, homem de Deus, foram contados na tribo de Levi.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Moisés, varón de Dios, fueron contados en la tribu de Leví.

verses.KJV: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.WEB: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.ASV: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Moisés foram Gérson e Eliézer.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Moisés fueron Gersón y Eliezer.

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
verses.WEB: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
verses.ASV: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Gérson foi Sebuel o primeiro.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Gersón fué Sebuel el primero.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.WEB: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.ALMEIDA: E filho de Eliézer foi Reabias o primeiro. E Eliézer não teve outros filhos; mas os filhos de Reabias foram muitos.
verses.RVR09: E hijo de Eliezer fué Rehabía el primero. Y Eliezer no tuvo otros hijos; mas los hijos de Rehabía fueron muchos.

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
verses.WEB: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
verses.ASV: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Izar foi Selomite o primeiro.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Ishar fué Selomith el primero.

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.WEB: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.ASV: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Hebrom: Jería o primeiro, Amarias o segundo, Jaaziel o terceiro, e Jecameão o quarto.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Hebrón: Jería el primero, Amarías el segundo, Jahaziel el tercero, y Jecamán el cuarto.

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first and Jesiah the second.
verses.WEB: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
verses.ASV: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Uziel: Mica o primeiro, e Issias o segundo.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Uzziel: Michâ el primero, é Isía el segundo.

verses.KJV: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.WEB: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
verses.ASV: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Merari: Mali e Musi. Os filhos de Mali: Eleazar e Quis.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Merari: Mahali y Musi. Los hijos de Mahali: Eleazar y Cis.

verses.KJV: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
verses.WEB: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
verses.ASV: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them [to wife].
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu Eleazar sem filhos, mas teve filhas; e os filhos de Quis, seus irmãos, as tomaram por mulheres.
verses.RVR09: Y murió Eleazar sin hijos, mas tuvo hijas; y los hijos de Cis, sus hermanos, las tomaron por mujeres.

verses.KJV: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.WEB: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.ASV: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Musi: Mali, Éder e Jeremote, eles três.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Musi: Mahali, Eder y Jerimoth, ellos tres.

verses.KJV: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.
verses.WEB: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.ASV: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of those of them that were counted, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the house of Jehovah, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os filhos de Levi nas famílias de seus pais, cabeceiras de famílias em suas linhagens, contados por seus nomes, por suas cabeças, os quais faziam obra no ministério da casa do SENHOR, de vinte anos acima.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los hijos de Leví en las familias de sus padres, cabeceras de familias en sus delineaciones, contados por sus nombres, por sus cabezas, los cuales hacían obra en el ministerio de la casa de Jehová, de veinte años arriba.

verses.KJV: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
verses.WEB: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
verses.ASV: For David said, Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath given rest unto his people; and he dwelleth in Jerusalem for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Davi disse: o SENHOR Deus de Israel há dado repouso a seu povo Israel, e o habitar em Jerusalém para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Porque David dijo: Jehová Dios de Israel ha dado reposo á su pueblo Israel, y el habitar en Jerusalem para siempre.

verses.KJV: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.WEB: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
verses.ASV: and also the Levites shall no more have need to carry the tabernacle and all the vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também os levitas não levarão mais o tabernáculo, e todos seus vasos para seu ministério.
verses.RVR09: Y también los Levitas no llevarán más el tabernáculo, y todos sus vasos para su ministerio.

verses.KJV: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
verses.WEB: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.ASV: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were numbered, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que, conforme as últimas palavras de Davi, foi a contagem dos filhos de Levi de vinte anos acima.
verses.RVR09: Así que, conforme á las postreras palabras de David, fué la cuenta de los hijos de Leví de veinte años arriba.

verses.KJV: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.WEB: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;
verses.ASV: For their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of Jehovah, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: E estavam sob a mão dos filhos de Arão, para ministrar na casa do SENHOR, nos átrios e nas câmaras, e na purificação de toda coisa santificada, e na demais obra do ministério da casa de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y estaban bajo la mano de los hijos de Aarón, para ministrar en la casa de Jehová, en los atrios y en las cámaras, y en la purificación de toda cosa santificada, y en la demás obra del ministerio de la casa de Dios;

verses.KJV: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.WEB: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;
verses.ASV: for the showbread also, and for the fine flour for a meal-offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim para os pães da proposição, e para a flor da farinha para o sacrifício, e para os pães sem levedura, e para as coisas postas em panelas, e para o tostado, e para toda medida e conta;
verses.RVR09: Asimismo para los panes de la proposición, y para la flor de la harina para el sacrificio, y para las hojuelas sin levadura, y para la fruta de sartén, y para lo tostado, y para toda medida y cuenta;

verses.KJV: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even:
verses.WEB: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;
verses.ASV: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Jehovah, and likewise at even;
verses.ALMEIDA: E para que assistissem cada manhã todos os dias a confessar e louvar a o SENHOR, e assim à tarde;
verses.RVR09: Y para que asistiesen cada mañana todos los días á confesar y alabar á Jehová, y asimismo á la tarde;

verses.KJV: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:
verses.WEB: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;
verses.ASV: and to offer all burnt-offerings unto Jehovah, on the sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E para oferecer todos os holocaustos a o SENHOR os sábados, novas luas, e solenidades, por a conta e forma que tinham, continuamente diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y para ofrecer todos los holocaustos á Jehová los sábados, nuevas lunas, y solemnidades, por la cuenta y forma que tenían, continuamente delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: and that they should keep the charge of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, for the service of the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E para que tivessem a guarda do tabernáculo do testemunho, e a guarda do santuário, e as ordens dos filhos de Arão seus irmãos, no ministério da casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y para que tuviesen la guarda del tabernáculo del testimonio, y la guarda del santuario, y las órdenes de los hijos de Aarón sus hermanos, en el ministerio de la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.WEB: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.ASV: And the courses of the sons of Aaron [were these]. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também os filhos de Arão tiveram suas repartições. Os filhos de Arão: Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
verses.RVR09: TAMBIÉN los hijos de Aarón tuvieron sus repartimientos. Los hijos de Aarón: Nadab, Abiú, Eleazar é Ithamar.

verses.KJV: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
verses.WEB: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
verses.ASV: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Nadabe, e Abiú morreram antes que seu pai, e não tiveram filhos: Eleazar e Itamar tiveram o sacerdócio.
verses.RVR09: Mas Nadab y Abiú murieron antes que su padre, y no tuvieron hijos: Eleazar é Ithamar tuvieron el sacerdocio.

verses.KJV: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.WEB: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
verses.ASV: And David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi os repartiu, sendo Zadoque dos filhos de Eleazar, e Aimeleque dos filhos de Itamar, por seus turnos em seu ministério.
verses.RVR09: Y David los repartió, siendo Sadoc de los hijos de Eleazar, y Ahimelech de los hijos de Ithamar, por sus turnos en su ministerio.

verses.KJV: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.WEB: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
verses.ASV: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and [thus] were they divided: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Eleazar foram achados, quanto a seus principais varões, muitos mais que os filhos de Itamar; e repartiram-nos assim: Dos filhos de Eleazar havia dezesseis cabeças de famílias paternas; e dos filhos de Itamar pelas famílias de seus pais, oito.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Eleazar fueron hallados, cuanto á sus principales varones, muchos más que los hijos de Ithamar; y repartiéronlos así: De los hijos de Eleazar había dieciséis cabezas de familias paternas; y de los hijos de Ithamar por las familias de sus padres, ocho.

verses.KJV: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.WEB: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.ASV: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Repartiram-nos, pois, por sorte os uns com os outros: porque dos filhos de Eleazar e dos filhos de Itamar havia príncipes do santuário, e príncipes da casa de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Repartiéronlos pues por suerte los unos con los otros: porque de los hijos de Eleazar y de los hijos de Ithamar hubo príncipes del santuario, y príncipes de la casa de Dios.

verses.KJV: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.WEB: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.ASV: And Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Semaías escriba, filho de Natanael, dos levitas, escreveu-os diante do rei e dos príncipes, e diante de Zadoque o sacerdote, e de Aimeleque filho de Abiatar, e dos príncipes das famílias dos sacerdotes e levitas; e inscreviam uma família a Eleazar, e a Itamar outra.
verses.RVR09: Y Semeías escriba, hijo de Nathanael, de los Levitas, escribiólos delante del rey y de los príncipes, y delante de Sadoc el sacerdote, y de Ahimelech hijo de Abiathar, y de los príncipes de las familias de los sacerdotes y Levitas: y adscribían una familia á Eleazar, y á Ithamar otra.

verses.KJV: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.WEB: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.ASV: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a primeira sorte saiu por Jeoiaribe, a segunda por Jedaías;
verses.RVR09: Y la primera suerte salió por Joiarib, la segunda por Jedaía;

verses.KJV: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.WEB: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.ASV: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.ALMEIDA: A terceira por Harim, a quarta por Seorim;
verses.RVR09: La tercera por Harim, la cuarta por Seorim;

verses.KJV: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.WEB: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.ASV: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.ALMEIDA: A quinta por Malquias, a sexta por Miamim;
verses.RVR09: La quinta por Malchîas, la sexta por Miamim;

verses.KJV: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.WEB: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.ASV: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.ALMEIDA: A sétiam por Coz, a oitava por Abias;
verses.RVR09: La séptima por Cos, la octava por Abías;

verses.KJV: The ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.WEB: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.ASV: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.ALMEIDA: A nona por Jesua, a décima por Secanias;
verses.RVR09: La nona por Jesua, la décima por Sechânía;

verses.KJV: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.WEB: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.ASV: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.ALMEIDA: A décima primeira por Eliasibe, a décima segunda por Jaquim;
verses.RVR09: La undécima por Eliasib, la duodécima por Jacim;

verses.KJV: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.WEB: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.ASV: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.ALMEIDA: A décima terceira por Hupá, a décima quarta por Jesebeabe;
verses.RVR09: La décimatercia por Uppa, la décimacuarta por Isebeab;

verses.KJV: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.WEB: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.ASV: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.ALMEIDA: A décima quinta por Bilga, a décima sexta por Imer;
verses.RVR09: La décimaquinta por Bilga, la décimasexta por Immer;

verses.KJV: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.WEB: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
verses.ASV: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
verses.ALMEIDA: A décima sétima por Hezir, a décima outiva por Hapises;
verses.RVR09: La décimaséptima por Hezir, la décimaoctava por Aphses;

verses.KJV: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
verses.WEB: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
verses.ASV: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
verses.ALMEIDA: A décima nona por Petaías, a vigésima por Jeezquel;
verses.RVR09: La décimanona por Pethaía, la vigésima por Hezeciel;

verses.KJV: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.WEB: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
verses.ASV: the one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.ALMEIDA: A vigésima primeira por Jaquim, a vigésima segunda por Gamul;
verses.RVR09: La vigésimaprima por Jachim, la vigésimasegunda por Hamul;

verses.KJV: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.WEB: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
verses.ASV: the three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.ALMEIDA: A vigésima terceira por Delaías, a vigésima quarta por Maazias.
verses.RVR09: La vigésimatercia por Delaía, la vigésimacuarta por Maazía.

verses.KJV: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.WEB: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
verses.ASV: This was the ordering of them in their service, to come into the house of Jehovah according to the ordinance [given] unto them by Aaron their father, as Jehovah, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram contados em seu ministério, para que entrassem na casa do SENHOR, conforme a sua ordenança, sob o mando de Arão seu pai, da maneira que lhe havia mandado o SENHOR o Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron contados en su ministerio, para que entrasen en la casa de Jehová, conforme á su ordenanza, bajo el mando de Aarón su padre, de la manera que le había mandado Jehová el Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
verses.WEB: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
verses.ASV: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos filhos de Levi que restaram: Subael, dos filhos de Anrão; e dos filhos de Subael, Jedias.
verses.RVR09: Y de los hijos de Leví que quedaron: Subael, de los hijos de Amram; y de los hijos de Subael, Jehedías.

verses.KJV: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
verses.WEB: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
verses.ASV: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos filhos de Reabias, Issias o principal.
verses.RVR09: Y de los hijos de Rehabía, Isias el principal.

verses.KJV: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
verses.WEB: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
verses.ASV: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos izaritas, Selomote; e filho de Selomote, Jaate.
verses.RVR09: De los Ishareos, Selemoth; é hijo de Selemoth, Jath.

verses.KJV: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.WEB: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.ASV: And the sons [of Hebron]: Jeriah [the chief], Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos filhos de Hebrom; Jerias o primeiro, o segundo Amarias, o terceiro Jaaziel, o quarto Jecameão.
verses.RVR09: Y de los hijos de Hebrón: Jeria el primero, el segundo Amarías, el tercero Jahaziel, el cuarto Jecamán.

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
verses.WEB: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
verses.ASV: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Uziel, Mica; e filho de Mica, Samir.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Uzziel, Michâ; é hijo de Michâ, Samir.

verses.KJV: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.WEB: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
verses.ASV: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irmão de Mica, Issias; e filho de Issias, Zacarias.
verses.RVR09: Hermano de Michâ, Isía; é hijo de Isía, Zachârías.

verses.KJV: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

verses.ASV: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah: Beno.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Merari: Mali e Musi; filho de Jaazias, Beno.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Merari: Mahali y Musi; hijo de Jaazia, Benno.

verses.KJV: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.WEB: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.ASV: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Merari por Jaazias: Beno, e Soão, Zacur e Ibri.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Merari por Jaazia: Benno, y Soam, Zachûr é Ibri.

verses.KJV: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.WEB: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.ASV: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Mali, Eleazar, o qual não teve filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y de Mahali, Eleazar, el cual no tuvo hijos.

verses.KJV: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
verses.WEB: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
verses.ASV: Of Kish; the sons of Kish: Jerahmeel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de Quis, Jerameel.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de Cis, Jerameel.

verses.KJV: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
verses.WEB: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
verses.ASV: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Musi: Mali, Éder e Jeremote. Estes foram os filhos dos levitas conforme às casas de suas famílias.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Musi: Maheli, Eder y Jerimoth. Estos fueron los hijos de los Levitas conforme á las casas de sus familias.

verses.KJV: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
verses.WEB: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
verses.ASV: These likewise cast lots even as their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ [houses] of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers’ [houses] of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes também lançaram sortes, como seus irmãos os filhos de Arão, diante do rei Davi, e de Zadoque e de Aimeleque, e dos príncipes das famílias dos sacerdotes e levitas: o principal dos pais igualmente que o menor de seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Estos también echaron suertes, como sus hermanos los hijos de Aarón, delante del rey David, y de Sadoc y de Ahimelech, y de los príncipes de las familias de los sacerdotes y Levitas: el principal de los padres igualmente que el menor de sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.WEB: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:
verses.ASV: Moreover David and the captains of the host set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of them that did the work according to their service was:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Davi e os príncipes do exército apartaram para o ministério a os filhos de Asafe, e de Hemã, e de Jedutum, os quais profetizassem com harpas, saltérios, e címbalos: e o número deles foi, de homens idôneos para a obra de seu ministério
verses.RVR09: ASIMISMO David y los príncipes del ejército apartaron para el ministerio á los hijos de Asaph, y de Hemán, y de Jeduthún, los cuales profetizasen con arpas, salterios, y címbalos: y el número de ellos fué, de hombres idóneos para la obra de su ministerio respectivo:

verses.KJV: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.WEB: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.
verses.ASV: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asharelah, the sons of Asaph, under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied after the order of the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Asafe: Zacur, José, Netanias, e Asarela, filhos de Asafe, sob a direção de Asafe, o qual profetizava à ordem do rei.
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Asaph: Zachûr, José, Methanías, y Asareela, hijos de Asaph, bajo la dirección de Asaph, el cual profetizaba á la orden del rey.

verses.KJV: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
verses.WEB: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.
verses.ASV: Of Jeduthun; the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun with the harp, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: De Jedutum: os filhos de Jedutum, Gedalias, Zeri, Jesaías, Hasabias, e Matitias, e Simei: seis, sob a mão de seu pai Jedutum, o qual profetizava com harpa, para celebrar e louvar a o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: De Jeduthún: los hijos de Jeduthún, Gedalías, Sesi, Jesaías, Hasabías, y Mathithías, y Simi: seis, bajo la mano de su padre Jeduthún, el cual profetizaba con arpa, para celebrar y alabar á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
