verses.ASV: Of Heman; the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.
verses.ALMEIDA: De Hemã: os filhos de Hemã, Buquias, Matanias, Uziel, Sebuel, Jeremote, Hananias, Hanani, Eliata, Gidalti, Romanti-Ezer, Josbecasa, Maloti, Hotir, e Maaziote.
verses.RVR09: De Hemán: los hijos de Hemán, Buccia, Mathanía, Uzziel, Sebuel, Jerimoth, Hananías, Hanani, Eliatha, Gidalthi, Romamti-ezer, Josbecasa, Mallothi, Othir, y Mahazioth.

verses.KJV: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.WEB: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.ASV: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes foram filhos de Hemã, vidente do rei em palavras de Deus, para exaltar o poder seu: e deu Deus a Hemã catorze filhos e três filhas.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos fueron hijos de Hemán, vidente del rey en palabras de Dios, para ensalzar el poder suyo: y dió Dios á Hemán catorce hijos y tres hijas.

verses.KJV: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.WEB: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
verses.ASV: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of Jehovah, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God; Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos estes estavam sob a direção de seu pai na música, na casa do SENHOR, com címbalos, saltérios e harpas, para o ministério do templo de Deus, por disposição do rei acerca de Asafe, de Jedutum, e de Hemã.
verses.RVR09: Y todos estos estaban bajo la dirección de su padre en la música, en la casa de Jehová, con címbalos, salterios y arpas, para el ministerio del templo de Dios, por disposición del rey acerca de Asaph, de Jeduthún, y de Hemán.

verses.KJV: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.WEB: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
verses.ASV: And the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in singing unto Jehovah, even all that were skilful, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o número deles com seus irmãos instruídos em música do SENHOR, todos os aptos, foi duzentos oitenta e oito.
verses.RVR09: Y el número de ellos con sus hermanos instruídos en música de Jehová, todos los aptos, fué doscientos ochenta y ocho.

verses.KJV: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.WEB: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
verses.ASV: And they cast lots for their offices, all alike, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançaram sortes para os turnos do serviço, entrando o pequeno com o grande, o mesmo o mestre que o discípulo.
verses.RVR09: Y echaron suertes para los turnos del servicio, entrando el pequeño con el grande, lo mismo el maestro que el discípulo.

verses.WEB: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.ASV: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the first-born, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Meselemias: Zacarias o primogênito, Jediael o segundo, Zebadias o terceiro, Jatniel o quarto;
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Meselemia: Zachârías el primogénito, Jediael el segundo, Zebadías el tercero, Jatnael el cuarto;

verses.KJV: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
verses.WEB: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
verses.ASV: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elão o quinto, Joanã o sexto, Elioenai o sétimo.
verses.RVR09: Elam el quinto, Johanam el sexto, Elioenai el séptimo.

verses.KJV: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth.
verses.WEB: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
verses.ASV: And Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the first-born, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Obede-Edom: Semaías o primogênito, Jozabade o segundo, Joabe o terceiro, o quarto Sacar, o quinto Natanael;
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Obed-edom: Semeías el primogénito, Jozabad el segundo, Joab el tercero, el cuarto Sachâr, el quinto Nathanael;

verses.KJV: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
verses.WEB: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
verses.ASV: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sexto Amiel, o sétimo Issacar, o oitavo Peuletai: porque Deus havia abençoado a Obede-Edom.
verses.RVR09: El sexto Anmiel, el séptimo Issachâr, el octavo Peullethai: porque Dios había bendecido á Obed-edom.

verses.KJV: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
verses.WEB: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
verses.ASV: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também de Semaías seu filho nasceram filhos que foram senhores sobre a casa de seus pais; porque eram varões muito valentes.
verses.RVR09: También de Semeías su hijo nacieron hijos que fueron señores sobre la casa de sus padres; porque eran varones muy valerosos.

verses.KJV: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.WEB: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.ASV: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Semaías: Otni, Rafael, Obede, Elzabade, e seus irmãos, homens esforçados; assim Eliú, e Semaquias.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Semeías: Othni, Raphael, Obed, Elzabad, y sus hermanos, hombres esforzados; asimismo Eliú, y Samachîas.

verses.KJV: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.
verses.WEB: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
verses.ASV: All these were of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men in strength for the service; threescore and two of Obed-edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos estes dos filhos de Obede-Edom: eles com seus filhos e seus irmãos, homens robustos e fortes para o ministério; sessenta e dois, de Obede-Edom.
verses.RVR09: Todos estos de los hijos de Obed-edom: ellos con sus hijos y sus hermanos, hombres robustos y fuertes para el ministerio; sesenta y dos, de Obed-edom.

verses.KJV: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
verses.WEB: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.
verses.ASV: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, valiant men, eighteen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Meselemias e seus irmãos, dezoito homens valentes.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de Meselemia y sus hermanos, dieciocho hombres valientes.

verses.KJV: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
verses.WEB: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
verses.ASV: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the first-born, yet his father made him chief),
verses.ALMEIDA: De Hosa, dos filhos de Merari: Sinri o principal, (ainda que não fosse o primogênito, mas seu pai o pôs para que fosse cabeça);
verses.RVR09: De Hosa, de los hijos de Merari: Simri el principal, (aunque no era el primogénito, mas su padre lo puso para que fuese cabeza;)

verses.KJV: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.WEB: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.ASV: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.ALMEIDA: O segundo Hilquias, o terceiro Tebalias, o quarto Zacarias: todos os filhos de Hosa e seus irmãos foram treze.
verses.RVR09: El segundo Hilcías, el tercero Tebelías, el cuarto Zachârías: todos los hijos de Hosa y sus hermanos fueron trece.

verses.KJV: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: Of these were the courses of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brethren, to minister in the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entre estes se fez a distribuição dos porteiros, alternando os principais dos varões na guarda com seus irmãos, para servir na casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entre estos se hizo la distribución de los porteros, alternando los principales de los varones en la guardia con sus hermanos, para servir en la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
verses.WEB: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
verses.ASV: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançaram sortes, o pequeno com o grande, pelas casas de seus pais, para cada porta.
verses.RVR09: Y echaron suertes, el pequeño con el grande, por las casas de sus padres, para cada puerta.

verses.KJV: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
verses.WEB: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
verses.ASV: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a discreet counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E caiu a sorte ao oriente a Selemias. E a Zacarias seu filho, conselheiro entendido, lançaram as sortes, e sua sorte foi para o norte.
verses.RVR09: Y cayó la suerte al oriente á Selemía. Y á Zachârías su hijo, consejero entendido, metieron en las suertes: y salió la suerte suya al norte.

verses.KJV: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
verses.WEB: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
verses.ASV: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the store-house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por Obede-Edom, ao sul; e por seus filhos, a casa dos depósitos.
verses.RVR09: Y por Obed-edom, al mediodía; y por sus hijos, la casa de la consulta.

verses.KJV: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
verses.WEB: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.
verses.ASV: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goeth up, watch against watch.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por Supim e Hosa ao ocidente, com a porta de Salequete ao caminho da subida, guarda contra guarda.
verses.RVR09: Por Suppim y Hosa al occidente, con la puerta de Sallechêt al camino de la subida, guardia contra guardia.

verses.KJV: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
verses.WEB: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
verses.ASV: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the store-house two and two.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao oriente seis levitas, ao norte quatro de dia; ao sul quatro de dia; e à casa dos depósitos, de dois em dois.
verses.RVR09: Al oriente seis Levitas, al norte cuatro de día; al mediodía cuatro de día; y á la casa de la consulta, de dos en dos.

verses.KJV: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
verses.WEB: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
verses.ASV: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em a câmara dos vasos ao ocidente, quatro ao caminho, e dois na câmara.
verses.RVR09: En la cámara de los vasos al occidente, cuatro al camino, y dos en la cámara.

verses.KJV: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
verses.WEB: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
verses.ASV: These were the courses of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são as repartições dos porteiros, filhos dos coraítas, e dos filhos de Merari.
verses.RVR09: Estos son los repartimientos de los porteros, hijos de los Coraitas, y de los hijos de Merari.

verses.KJV: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
verses.WEB: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
verses.ASV: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos levitas, Aías tinha cargo dos tesouros da casa de Deus, e dos tesouros das coisas santificadas.
verses.RVR09: Y de los Levitas, Achîas tenía cargo de los tesoros de la casa de Dios, y de los tesoros de las cosas santificadas.

verses.KJV: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
verses.WEB: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
verses.ASV: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ [houses] belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto a os filhos de Ladã, filhos de Gérson: de Ladã, os príncipes das famílias de Ladã foram Gérson, e Jeieli.
verses.RVR09: Cuanto á los hijos de Ladán, hijos de Gersón: de Ladán, los príncipes de las familias de Ladán fueron Gersón, y Jehieli.

verses.KJV: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Jeieli, Zetã e Joel seu irmão, tiveram cargo dos tesouros da casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Jehieli, Zethán y Joel su hermano, tuvieron cargo de los tesoros de la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
verses.WEB: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
verses.ASV: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
verses.ALMEIDA: Acerca dos anramitas, dos izaritas, dos hebronitas, e dos uzielitas,
verses.RVR09: Acerca de los Amramitas, de los Isharitas, de los Hebronitas, y de los Uzzielitas,

verses.KJV: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
verses.WEB: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.
verses.ASV: and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasures.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sebuel filho de Gérson, filho de Moisés, era principal sobre os tesouros.
verses.RVR09: Sebuel hijo de Gersón, hijo de Moisés, era principal sobre los tesoros.

verses.KJV: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
verses.WEB: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
verses.ASV: And his brethren: of Eliezer [came] Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em ordem a seu irmão Eliézer, filho deste era Reabias, filho deste Jesaías, filho deste Jorão, filho deste Zicri, do que foi filho Selomote.
verses.RVR09: En orden á su hermano Eliezer, hijo de éste era Rehabía, hijo de éste Isaías, hijo de éste Joram, hijo de éste Zichri, del que fué hijo Selomith.

verses.KJV: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
verses.WEB: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
verses.ASV: This Shelomoth and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ [houses], the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este Selomote e seus irmãos tinham cargo de todos os tesouros de todas as coisas santificadas, que havia consagrado o rei Davi, e os príncipes das famílias, e os capitães de milhares e de centenas, e os chefes do exército;
verses.RVR09: Este Selomith y sus hermanos tenían cargo de todos los tesoros de todas las cosas santificadas, que había consagrado el rey David, y los príncipes de las familias, y los capitanes de millares y de cientos, y los jefes del ejército;

verses.KJV: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: Out of the spoil won in battles did they dedicate to repair the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: De o que haviam consagrado das guerras e dos despojos, para reparar a casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: De lo que habían consagrado de las guerras y de los despojos, para reparar la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
verses.WEB: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.
verses.ASV: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated, whosoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth, and of his brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim todas as coisas que havia consagrado Samuel vidente, e Saul filho de Quis, e Abner filho de Ner, e Joabe filho de Zeruia: e todo o que qualquer um consagrava, estava sob a mão de Selomote e de seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo todas las cosas que había consagrado Samuel vidente, y Saúl hijo de Cis, y Abner hijo de Ner, y Joab hijo de Sarvia: y todo lo que cualquiera consagraba, estaba bajo la mano de Selomith y de sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.WEB: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.ASV: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos izaritas, Quenanias e seus filhos eram governadores e juízes sobre Israel nas obras de fora.
verses.RVR09: De los Isharitas, Chenanía y sus hijos eran gobernadores y jueces sobre Israel en las obras de fuera.

verses.KJV: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.
verses.WEB: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.
verses.ASV: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valor, a thousand and seven hundred, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Jehovah, and for the service of the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos hebronitas, Hasabias e seus irmãos, homens de vigor, mil e setecentos, governavam a Israel da outra parte do Jordão, ao ocidente, em toda a obra do SENHOR, e no serviço do rei.
verses.RVR09: De los Hebronitas, Hasabías y sus hermanos, hombres de vigor, mil y setecientos, gobernaban á Israel de la otra parte del Jordán, al occidente, en toda la obra de Jehová, y en el servicio del rey.

verses.KJV: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.WEB: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.ASV: Of the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ [houses]. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valor at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos hebronitas, Jerias era o principal entre os hebronitas repartidos em suas linhagens por suas famílias. No ano quarenta do reinado de Davi se registraram, e acharam-se entre eles fortes e vigorosos em Jazer de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: De los Hebronitas, Jerías era el principal entre los Hebronitas repartidos en sus linajes por sus familias. En el año cuarenta del reinado de David se registraron, y halláronse entre ellos fuertes y vigorosos en Jazer de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
verses.WEB: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
verses.ASV: And his brethren, men of valor, were two thousand and seven hundred, heads of fathers’ [houses], whom king David made overseers over the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God, and for the affairs of the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos, homens valentes, eram dois mil e setecentos, cabeças de famílias, os quais o rei Davi constituiu sobre os rubenitas, gaditas, e sobre a meia tribo de Manassés, para todas as coisas de Deus, e os negócios do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos, hombres valientes, eran dos mil y setecientos, cabezas de familias, los cuales el rey David constituyó sobre los Rubenitas, Gaditas, y sobre la media tribu de Manasés, para todas las cosas de Dios, y los negocios del rey.

verses.KJV: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: Now the children of Israel after their number, [to wit], the heads of fathers’ [houses] and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers that served the king, in any matter of the courses which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os filhos de Israel segundo seu número, a saber, príncipes de famílias, comandantes, centuriões e oficiais dos que serviam ao rei em todos os negócios das divisões que entravam e saíam cada mês em todos os meses do ano, eram em cada divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: Y LOS hijos de Israel según su número, á saber, príncipes de familias, tribunos, centuriones y oficiales de los que servían al rey en todos los negocios de las divisiones que entraban y salían cada mes en todos los meses del año, eran en cada división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre a primeira divisão do primeiro mês estava Jasobeão filho de Zabdiel; e havia em sua divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: Sobre la primera división del primer mes estaba Jasobam hijo de Zabdiel; y había en su división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.WEB: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
verses.ASV: [He was] of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Perez foi ele chefe de todos os capitães das companhias do primeiro mês.
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Phares fué él jefe de todos los capitanes de las compañías del primer mes.

verses.KJV: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: And over the course of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and his course; and Mikloth the ruler: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre a divisão do segundo mês estava Dodai aoíta: e Miclote era maior general em sua divisão, na que também havia vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: Sobre la división del segundo mes estaba Dodai Ahohita: y Micloth era mayor general en su división, en la que también había veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the priest, chief: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O chefe da terceira divisão para o terceiro mês era Benaia, filho de Joiada sumo sacerdote; e em sua divisão havia vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El jefe de la tercera división para el tercer mes era Benaías, hijo de Joiada sumo sacerdote; y en su división había veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
verses.WEB: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.
verses.ASV: This is that Benaiah, who was the mighty man of the thirty, and over the thirty: and [of] his course was Ammizabad his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este Benaia era valente entre os trinta e sobre os trinta; e em sua divisão estava Amizabade seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Este Benaías era valiente entre los treinta y sobre los treinta; y en su división estaba Amisabad su hijo.

verses.KJV: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The fourth [captain] for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O quarto chefe para o quarto mês era Asael irmão de Joabe, e depois dele Zebadias seu filho; e em sua divisão havia vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El cuarto jefe para el cuarto mes era Asael hermano de Joab, y después de él Zebadías su hijo; y en su división había veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O quinto chefe para o quinto mês era Samute izraíta: e em sua divisão havia vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El quinto jefe para el quinto mes era Sambuth Izrita: y en su división había veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The sixth [captain] for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sexto para o sexto mês era Ira filho de Iques, de Tecoa; e em sua divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El sexto para el sexto mes era Hira hijo de Icces, de Tecoa; y en su división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The seventh [captain] for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sétimo para o sétimo mês era Helez pelonita, dos filhos de Efraim; e em sua divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El séptimo para el séptimo mes era Helles Pelonita, de los hijos de Ephraim; y en su división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The eighth [captain] for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O oitavo para o oitavo mês era Sibecai husatita, de Zerá; e em sua divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El octavo para el octavo mes era Sibbecai Husatita, de Zarahi; y en su división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The ninth [captain] for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O nono para o nono mês era Abiezer anatotita, dos benjamitas; e em sua divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El noveno para el noveno mes era Abiezer Anathothita, de los Benjamitas; y en su división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The tenth [captain] for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O décimo para o décimo mês era Maarai netofatita, de Zerá; e em sua divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El décimo para el décimo mes era Maharai Nethophathita, de Zarahi; y en su división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The eleventh [captain] for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O décimo primeiro para o décimo primeiro mês era Benaia piratonita, dos filhos de Efraim; e em sua divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El undécimo para el undécimo mes era Benaías Piratonita, de los hijos de Ephraim; y en su división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.WEB: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
verses.ASV: The twelfth [captain] for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O décimo segundo para o décimo segundo mês era Heldai netofatita, de Otniel; e em sua divisão vinte e quatro mil.
verses.RVR09: El duodécimo para el duodécimo mes era Heldai Nethophathita, de Othniel; y en su división veinte y cuatro mil.

verses.KJV: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
verses.WEB: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;
verses.ASV: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri the ruler: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim sobre as tribos de Israel: o chefe dos rubenitas era Eliézer filho de Zicri; dos simeonitas, Sefatias, filho de Maaca:
verses.RVR09: Asimismo sobre las tribus de Israel: el jefe de los Rubenitas era Eliezer hijo de Zichri; de los Simeonitas, Sephatías, hijo de Maachâ:

verses.KJV: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
verses.WEB: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;
verses.ASV: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of Aaron, Zadok:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos levitas, Hasabias filho de Quemuel; dos aronitas, Zadoque;
verses.RVR09: De los Levitas, Hasabías hijo de Camuel; de los Aaronitas, Sadoc;

verses.KJV: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.WEB: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;
verses.ASV: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.ALMEIDA: De Judá, Eliú, um dos irmãos de Davi; dos de Issacar, Onri filho de Micael.
verses.RVR09: De Judá, Eliú, uno de los hermanos de David; de los de Issachâr, Omri hijo de Michâel;

verses.KJV: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
verses.WEB: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;
verses.ASV: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos de Zebulom, Ismaías filho de Obadias; dos de Naftali, Jeremote filho de Azriel;
verses.RVR09: De los de Zabulón, Ismaías hijo de Abdías; de los de Nephtalí, Jerimoth hijo de Azriel;

verses.KJV: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.WEB: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
verses.ASV: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos filhos de Efraim, Oseias filho de Azazias; da meia tribo de Manassés, Joel filho de Pedaías;
verses.RVR09: De los hijos de Ephraim, Oseas hijo de Azazía; de la media tribu de Manasés, Joel hijo de Pedaía;

verses.KJV: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.WEB: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;
verses.ASV: of the half-[tribe] of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.ALMEIDA: De a outra meia tribo de Manassés em Gileade, Ido filho de Zacarias; dos de Benjamim, Jaasiel filho de Abner;
verses.RVR09: De la otra media tribu de Manasés en Galaad, Iddo hijo de Zachârías; de los de Benjamín, Jaaciel hijo de Abner;

verses.KJV: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
verses.WEB: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
verses.ASV: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Dã, Azarel filho de Jeroão. Estes foram os chefes das tribos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y de Dan, Azarael hijo de Jeroam. Estos fueron los jefes de las tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the Lord had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
verses.WEB: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.
verses.ASV: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Jehovah had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não tomou Davi o número dos que eram de vinte anos abaixo, porquanto o SENHOR havia dito que ele havia de multiplicar a Israel como as estrelas do céu.
verses.RVR09: Y no tomó David el número de los que eran de veinte años abajo, por cuanto Jehová había dicho que él había de multiplicar á Israel como las estrellas del cielo.

verses.KJV: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
verses.WEB: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.
verses.ASV: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but finished not; and there came wrath for this upon Israel; neither was the number put into the account in the chronicles of king David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Joabe filho de Zeruia havia começado a contar, mas não acabou, pois por isto veio a ira sobre Israel: e assim o número não foi posto no registro das crônicas do rei Davi.
verses.RVR09: Joab hijo de Sarvia había comenzado á contar, mas no acabó, pues por esto vino la ira sobre Israel: y así el número no fué puesto en el registro de las crónicas del rey David.

verses.KJV: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.WEB: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;
verses.ASV: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Azmavete filho de Adiel tinha cargo dos tesouros do rei; e dos tesouros dos campos, e das cidades, e das aldeias e castelos, Jônatas filho de Uzia;
verses.RVR09: Y Azmaveth hijo de Adiel tenía cargo de los tesoros del rey; y de los tesoros de los campos, y de las ciudades, y de las aldeas y castillos, Jonathán hijo de Uzzías;

verses.KJV: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.WEB: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.
verses.ASV: and over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos que trabalhavam na lavoura das terras, Ezri filho de Quelube;
verses.RVR09: Y de los que trabajaban en la labranza de las tierras, Ezri hijo de Chêlud;

verses.KJV: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.WEB: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
verses.ASV: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: and over the increase of the vineyards for the wine-cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.ALMEIDA: E das vinhas Simei ramatita; e do fruto das vinhas para as adegas, Zabdias sifmita;
verses.RVR09: Y de las viñas Simi Ramathita; y del fruto de las viñas para las bodegas, Zabdías Siphmita;

verses.KJV: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
verses.WEB: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.
verses.ASV: and over the olive-trees and the sycomore-trees that were in the lowland was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos olivais e figueirais que havia nas campinas, Baal-Hanã gederita; e dos armazéns do azeite, Joás;
verses.RVR09: Y de los olivares é higuerales que había en las campiñas, Baal-hanan Gederita; y de los almacenes del aceite, Joas;

verses.KJV: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.WEB: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.
verses.ASV: and over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.ALMEIDA: Das vacas que pastavam em Sarom, Sitrai saronita; e das vacas que estavam nos vales, Safate filho de Adlai;
verses.RVR09: De las vacas que pastaban en Sarón, Sitrai Saronita; y de las vacas que estaban en los valles, Saphat hijo de Adlai;

verses.KJV: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
verses.WEB: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
verses.ASV: and over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite: and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos camelos, Obil ismaelita; e das asnas, Jedias meronotita;
verses.RVR09: Y de los camellos, Obil Ismaelita; y de las asnas, Jedías Meronothita;

verses.KJV: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
verses.WEB: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.
verses.ASV: All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: E das ovelhas, Jaziz hagareno. Todos estes eram superintendentes da riqueza do rei Davi.
verses.RVR09: Y de las ovejas, Jaziz Agareno. Todos estos eran superintendentes de la hacienda del rey David.

verses.KJV: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
verses.WEB: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.
verses.ASV: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counsellor, a man of understanding, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jônatas, tio de Davi, era conselheiro, homem prudente e escriba; e Jeiel filho de Hacmoni estava com os filhos do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y Jonathán, tío de David, era consejero, varón prudente y escriba; y Jehiel hijo de Hacmoni estaba con los hijos del rey.

verses.KJV: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
verses.WEB: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
verses.ASV: and Ahithophel was the king’s counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend:
verses.ALMEIDA: E também Aitofel era conselheiro do rei; e Husai arquita amigo do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y también Achitophel era consejero del rey; y Husai Arachîta amigo del rey.

verses.KJV: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
verses.WEB: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.
verses.ASV: and after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the captain of the king’s host was Joab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de Aitofel era Joiada filho de Benaia, e Abiatar. E Joabe era o general do exército do rei.
verses.RVR09: Después de Achitophel era Joiada hijo de Benaías, y Abiathar. Y Joab era el general del ejército del rey.

verses.KJV: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that served the king by course, and the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers, and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, unto Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntou Davi em Jerusalém a todos os principais de Israel, os príncipes das tribos, e os chefes das divisões que serviam ao rei, os comandantes e centuriões, com os superintendentes de toda a riqueza e possessão do rei, e seus filhos, com os eunucos, os poderosos, e todos os seus homens valentes.
verses.RVR09: Y JUNTÓ David en Jerusalem á todos los principales de Israel, los príncipes de las tribus, y los jefes de las divisiones que servían al rey, los tribunos y centuriones, con los superintendentes de toda la hacienda y posesión del rey, y sus hijos, con los eunucos, los poderosos, y todos sus hombres valientes.

verses.KJV: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
verses.WEB: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.
verses.ASV: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: as for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and for the footstool of our God; and I had made ready for the building.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantando-se o rei Davi, posto em pé disse: Ouvi-me, irmãos meus, e povo meu. Eu tinha em propósito edificar uma casa, para que nela repousasse a arca do pacto do SENHOR, e para o estrado dos pés de nosso Deus; e havia já aprontei tudo para edificar.
verses.RVR09: Y levantándose el rey David, puesto en pie dijo: Oidme, hermanos míos, y pueblo mío. Yo tenía en propósito edificar una casa, para que en ella reposara el arca del pacto de Jehová, y para el estrado de los pies de nuestro Dios; y había ya aprestado todo para edificar.

verses.KJV: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
verses.WEB: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’
verses.ASV: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build a house for my name, because thou art a man of war, and hast shed blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus me disse: Tu não edificarás casa a meu nome: porque és homem de guerra, e derramaste muito sangue.
verses.RVR09: Mas Dios me dijo: Tú no edificarás casa á mi nombre: porque eres hombre de guerra, y has derramado mucha sangre.

verses.KJV: Howbeit the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:
verses.WEB: However the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.
verses.ASV: Howbeit Jehovah, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o SENHOR o Deus de Israel me elegeu de toda a casa de meu pai, para que perpetuamente fosse rei sobre Israel: porque a Judá escolheu por chefe, e da casa de Judá a família de meu pai; e de entre os filhos de meu pai agradou-se de mim para me constituir rei sobre todo Israel;
verses.RVR09: Empero Jehová el Dios de Israel me eligió de toda la casa de mi padre, para que perpetuamente fuese rey sobre Israel: porque á Judá escogió por caudillo, y de la casa de Judá la familia de mi padre; y de entre los hijos de mi padre agradóse de mí para ponerme por rey sobre todo Israel;

verses.KJV: And of all my sons, (for the Lord hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.WEB: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.
verses.ASV: and of all my sons (for Jehovah hath given me many sons), he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of Jehovah over Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de todos meus filhos (porque o SENHOR me deu muitos filhos,) elegeu a meu filho Salomão para que se sente no trono do reino do SENHOR sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y de todos mis hijos (porque Jehová me ha dado muchos hijos,) eligió á mi hijo Salomón para que se siente en el trono del reino de Jehová sobre Israel.

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.WEB: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me disse: Salomão teu filho, ele edificará minha casa e meus átrios: porque a este me escolhi por filho, e eu lhe serei a ele por pai.
verses.RVR09: Y me ha dicho: Salomón tu hijo, él edificará mi casa y mis atrios: porque á éste me he escogido por hijo, y yo le seré á él por padre.

verses.KJV: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
verses.WEB: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’
verses.ASV: And I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and mine ordinances, as at this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim eu confirmarei seu reino para sempre, se ele se esforçar a executar meus mandamentos e meus juízos, como este dia.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo yo confirmaré su reino para siempre, si él se esforzare á poner por obra mis mandamientos y mis juicios, como aqueste día.

verses.KJV: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of Jehovah, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of Jehovah your God; that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, diante dos olhos de todo Israel, congregação do SENHOR, e em ouvidos de nosso Deus, guardai e inquiri todos os preceitos do SENHOR vosso Deus, para que possuais a boa terra, e a deixeis por herdade a vossos filhos depois de vós perpetuamente.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, delante de lo ojos de todo Israel, congregación de Jehová, y en oídos de nuestro Dios, guardad é inquirid todos los preceptos de Jehová vuestro Dios, para que poseáis la buena tierra, y la dejéis por heredad á vuestros hijos después de vosotros perpetuamente.

verses.KJV: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
verses.WEB: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
verses.ASV: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Jehovah searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts. If thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, Salomão, meu filho, conhece o Deus de teu pai, e serve-o com coração completo e ânimo voluntário; porque o SENHOR examina os corações de todos, e entende todas as intenções dos pensamentos. Se tu o buscares, o acharás; mas se o deixares, ele te rejeitará para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, Salomón, hijo mío, conoce al Dios de tu padre, y sírvele con corazón perfecto, y con ánimo voluntario; porque Jehová escudriña los corazones de todos, y entiende toda imaginación de los pensamientos. Si tú le buscares, lo hallarás; mas si lo dejares, él te desechará para siempre.

verses.KJV: Take heed now; for the Lord hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
verses.WEB: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
verses.ASV: Take heed now; for Jehovah hath chosen thee to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha, pois, agora que o SENHOR te escolheu para que edifiques casa para santuário: esforça-te, e faze-a.
verses.RVR09: Mira, pues, ahora que Jehová te ha elegido para que edifiques casa para santuario: esfuérzate, y hazla.

verses.KJV: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
verses.WEB: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;
verses.ASV: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch [of the temple], and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper rooms thereof, and of the inner chambers thereof, and of the place of the mercy-seat;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Davi deu a Salomão seu filho a planta do pórtico, e de suas casas, e de suas oficinas, e de suas salas, e de suas recâmaras, e da casa do propiciatório.
verses.RVR09: Y David dió á Salomón su hijo la traza del pórtico, y de sus casas, y de sus oficinas, y de sus salas, y de sus recámaras, y de la casa del propiciatorio.

verses.KJV: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
verses.WEB: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the LORD’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
verses.ASV: and the pattern of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the house of Jehovah, and for all the chambers round about, for the treasuries of the house of God, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim a planta de todas as coisas que tinha em sua vontade, para os átrios da casa do SENHOR, e para todas as câmaras em derredor, para os tesouros da casa de Deus, e para os tesouros das coisas santificadas:
verses.RVR09: Asimismo la traza de todas las cosas que tenía en su voluntad, para los atrios de la casa de Jehová, y para todas las cámaras en derredor, para los tesoros de la casa de Dios, y para los tesoros de las cosas santificadas:

verses.KJV: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the LORD’s house, and for all the vessels of service in the LORD’s house—
verses.ASV: also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, and for all the vessels of service in the house of Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também para as ordens dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, e para toda a obra do ministério da casa do SENHOR, e para todos os vasos do ministério da casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: También para los órdenes de los sacerdotes y de los Levitas, y para toda la obra del ministerio de la casa de Jehová, y para todos los vasos del ministerio de la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
verses.WEB: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
verses.ASV: of gold by weight for the [vessels of] gold, for all vessels of every kind of service; [of silver] for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu ouro por peso para o de ouro, para todos os vasos de cada serviço: e prata por peso para todos os vasos, para todos os vasos de cada serviço.
verses.RVR09: Y dió oro por peso para lo de oro, para todos los vasos de cada servicio: y plata por peso para todos los vasos, para todos los vasos de cada servicio.

verses.KJV: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
verses.WEB: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;
verses.ASV: by weight also for the candlesticks of gold, and for the lamps thereof, of gold, by weight for every candlestick and for the lamps thereof; and for the candlesticks of silver, [silver] by weight for [every] candlestick and for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouro por peso para os candelabros de ouro, e para suas lâmpadas; por peso o ouro para cada candelabro e suas lâmpadas: e para os candelabros de prata, prata por peso para o candelabro e suas lâmpadas, conforme ao serviço de cada candelabro.
verses.RVR09: Oro por peso para los candeleros de oro, y para sus candilejas; por peso el oro para cada candelero y sus candilejas: y para los candeleros de plata, plata por peso para el candelero y sus candilejas, conforme al servicio de cada candelero.

verses.KJV: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
verses.WEB: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
verses.ASV: and the gold by weight for the tables of showbread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim deu ouro por peso para as mesas da proposição, para cada mesa: do mesmo modo prata para as mesas de prata:
verses.RVR09: Asimismo dió oro por peso para las mesas de la proposición, para cada mesa: del mismo modo plata para las mesas de plata:

verses.KJV: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
verses.WEB: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
verses.ASV: and the flesh-hooks, and the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também ouro puro para os garfos e para as bacias, e para os incensários, e para as taças de ouro, para cada taça por peso; e para as taças de prata, por peso para cada taça:
verses.RVR09: También oro puro para los garfios y para las palanganas, y para los incensarios, y para los tazones de oro, para cada tazón por peso; y para los tazones de plata, por peso para cada tazón:

verses.KJV: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.WEB: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD’s covenant.
verses.ASV: and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot, [even] the cherubim, that spread out [their wings], and covered the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ademais, ouro puro por peso para o altar do incenso, e para ele a maneira de carro dos querubins de ouro, que com as asas estendidas cobriam a arca do pacto do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Además, oro puro por peso para el altar del perfume, y para el á manera de carro de los querubines de oro, que con las alas extendidas cubrían el arca del pacto de Jehová.

verses.KJV: All this, said David, the Lord made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
verses.WEB: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”
verses.ASV: All this, [said David], have I been made to understand in writing from the hand of Jehovah, even all the works of this pattern.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas estas coisas, disse Davi, se me representaram pela mão do SENHOR que me fez entender todas as obras do desenho.
verses.RVR09: Todas estas cosas, dijo David, se me han representado por la mano de Jehová que me hizo entender todas las obras del diseño.

verses.KJV: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the Lord God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.
verses.ASV: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed; for Jehovah God, even my God, is with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until all the work for the service of the house of Jehovah be finished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse mais Davi a Salomão seu filho: Anima-te e esforça-te, e efetua-o; não temas, nem desmaies, porque o Deus o SENHOR, meu Deus, será contigo: ele não te deixará, nem te desamparará, até que acabes toda a obra para o serviço da casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Dijo más David á Salomón su hijo: Anímate y esfuérzate, y ponlo por obra; no temas, ni desmayes, porque el Dios Jehová, mi Dios, será contigo: él no te dejará, ni te desamparará, hasta que acabes toda la obra para el servicio de la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
verses.WEB: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”
verses.ASV: And, behold, there are the courses of the priests and the Levites, for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee in all manner of work every willing man that hath skill, for any manner of service: also the captains and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui as ordens dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, para todo o ministério da casa de Deus, serão contigo em toda a obra: assim todos os voluntários e inteligentes para qualquer espécie de artifício; e os príncipes, e todo o povo para executar todas as tuas ordens.
verses.RVR09: He aquí los órdenes de los sacerdotes y de los Levitas, para todo el ministerio de la casa de Dios, serán contigo en toda la obra: asimismo todos los voluntarios é inteligentes para cualquiera especie de industria; y los príncipes, y todo el pueblo para ejecutar todas tus órdenes.

verses.KJV: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.
verses.WEB: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
verses.ASV: And David the king said unto all the assembly, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Jehovah God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disse o rei Davi a toda a assembleia: A só Salomão meu filho elegeu Deus; ele é jovem e tenro, e a obra grande; porque a casa não é para homem, mas sim para o SENHOR Deus.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS dijo el rey David á toda la asamblea: A solo Salomón mi hijo ha elegido Dios; él es joven y tierno, y la obra grande; porque la casa no es para hombre, sino para Jehová Dios.

verses.KJV: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.WEB: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.ASV: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the [things of] gold, and the silver for the [things of] silver, and the brass for the [things of] brass, the iron for the [things of] iron, and wood for the [things of] wood; onyx stones, and [stones] to be set, stones for inlaid work, and of divers colors, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, porém, com todas as minhas forças preparei, para a casa de meu Deus, ouro para as coisas de ouro, e prata para as coisas de prata, e bronze para as de bronze, e ferro para as de ferro, e madeira para as de madeira, e pedras de ônix, e pedras decorativas, e pedras negras, e pedras de diversas cores, e toda sorte de pedras preciosas, e pedras de mármore em abundância.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero con todas mis fuerzas he preparado para la casa de mi Dios, oro para las cosas de oro, y plata para las cosas de plata, y metal para las de metal, y hierro para las de hierro, y madera para las de madera, y piedras oniquinas, y piedras preciosas, y piedras negras, y piedras de diversos colores, y toda suerte de piedras preciosas, y piedras de mármol en abundancia.

verses.KJV: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house.
verses.WEB: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:
verses.ASV: Moreover also, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, seeing that I have a treasure of mine own of gold and silver, I give it unto the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
verses.ALMEIDA: A mais disto, porquanto tenho meu gosto na casa de meu Deus, eu guardo em meu tesouro particular ouro e prata que, ademais de todas as coisas que aprontei para a casa do santuário, ei dado para a casa de meu Deus;
verses.RVR09: A más de esto, por cuanto tengo mi gusto en la casa de mi Dios, yo guardo en mi tesoro particular oro y plata que, además de todas las cosas que he aprestado para la casa del santuario, he dado para la casa de mi Dios;

verses.KJV: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:
verses.WEB: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;
verses.ASV: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, wherewith to overlay the walls of the houses;
verses.ALMEIDA: A saber, três mil talentos de ouro, de ouro de Ofir, e sete mil talentos de prata refinada para cobrir as paredes das casas:
verses.RVR09: A saber, tres mil talentos de oro, de oro de Ophir, y siete mil talentos de plata afinada para cubrir las paredes de las casas:

verses.KJV: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the Lord?
verses.WEB: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”
verses.ASV: of gold for the [things of] gold, and of silver for the [things of] silver, and for all manner of work [to be made] by the hands of artificers. Who then offereth willingly to consecrate himself this day unto Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouro, pois, para as coisas de ouro, e prata para as coisas de prata, e para toda a obra de mãos dos oficiais. E quem quer fazer hoje oferta a o SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Oro pues para las cosas de oro, y plata para las cosas de plata, y para toda la obra de manos de los oficiales. ¿Y quién quiere hacer hoy ofrenda á Jehová?

verses.KJV: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,
verses.WEB: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;
verses.ASV: Then the princes of the fathers’ [houses], and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os príncipes das famílias, e os príncipes das tribos de Israel, comandantes e centuriões, com os superintendentes da riqueza do rei, ofereceram de sua vontade;
verses.RVR09: Entonces los príncipes de las familias, y los príncipes de las tribus de Israel, tribunos y centuriones, con los superintendentes de la hacienda del rey, ofrecieron de su voluntad;

verses.KJV: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.WEB: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.
verses.ASV: and they gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and of iron a hundred thousand talents.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deram para o serviço da casa de Deus cinco mil talentos de ouro e dez mil moedas, e dez mil talentos de prata, e dezoito mil talentos de bronze, e cinco mil talentos de ferro.
verses.RVR09: Y dieron para el servicio de la casa de Dios cinco mil talentos de oro y diez mil sueldos, y diez mil talentos de plata, y dieciocho mil talentos de metal, y cinco mil talentos de hierro.

verses.KJV: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the Lord, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.WEB: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.ASV: And they with whom [precious] stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of Jehovah, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o que se achou com pedras preciosas, deu-as para o tesouro da casa do SENHOR, em mão de Jeiel gersonita.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el que se halló con piedras preciosas, diólas para el tesoro de la casa de Jehová, en mano de Jehiel Gersonita.

verses.KJV: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the Lord: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
verses.WEB: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
verses.ASV: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to Jehovah: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
