verses.ALMEIDA: E folgou-se o povo de haver contribuído de sua vontade; porque com inteiro coração ofereceram a o SENHOR voluntariamente.
verses.RVR09: Y holgóse el pueblo de haber contribuído de su voluntad; porque con entero corazón ofrecieron á Jehová voluntariamente.

verses.KJV: Wherefore David blessed the Lord before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, Lord God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.
verses.ASV: Wherefore David blessed Jehovah before all the assembly; and David said, Blessed be thou, O Jehovah, the God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim folgou-se muito o rei Davi, e abençoou a o SENHOR diante de toda a congregação; e disse Davi: Bendito sejas tu, ó o SENHOR, Deus de Israel nosso pai, de um século a outro.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo holgóse mucho el rey David, y bendijo á Jehová delante de toda la congregación; y dijo David: Bendito seas tú, oh Jehová, Dios de Israel nuestro padre, de uno á otro siglo.

verses.KJV: Thine, O Lord is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.
verses.WEB: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.
verses.ASV: Thine, O Jehovah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth [is thine]; thine is the kingdom, O Jehovah, and thou art exalted as head above all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua é, ó o SENHOR, a magnificência, e o poder, e a glória, a vitória, e a honra; porque todas as coisas que estão nos céus e na terra são tuas. Teu, ó o SENHOR, é o reino, e a altura sobre todos os que estão por cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Tuya es, oh Jehová, la magnificencia, y el poder, y la gloria, la victoria, y el honor; porque todas las cosas que están en los cielos y en la tierra son tuyas. Tuyo, oh Jehová, es el reino, y la altura sobre todos los que están por cabeza.

verses.KJV: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verses.WEB: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!
verses.ASV: Both riches and honor come of thee, and thou rulest over all; and in thy hand is power and might; and in thy hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verses.ALMEIDA: As riquezas e a glória estão diante de ti, e tu senhoreias a todos: e em tua mão está a potência e a fortaleza, e em tua mão a grandeza e força de todas as coisas.
verses.RVR09: Las riquezas y la gloria están delante de ti, y tú señoreas á todos: y en tu mano está la potencia y la fortaleza, y en tu mano la grandeza y fuerza de todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, Deus nosso, nós te confessamos, e louvamos teu glorioso nome.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Dios nuestro, nosotros te confesamos, y loamos tu glorioso nombre.

verses.KJV: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
verses.WEB: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.
verses.ASV: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quem sou eu, e quem é meu povo, para que pudéssemos oferecer de nossa vontade coisas semelhantes? Porque tudo é teu, e o que recebemos de tua mão te damos.
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿quién soy yo, y quién es mi pueblo, para que pudiésemos ofrecer de nuestra voluntad cosas semejantes? porque todo es tuyo, y lo recibido de tu mano te damos.

verses.KJV: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.
verses.WEB: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.
verses.ASV: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers were: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no abiding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nós, estrangeiros e peregrinos somos diante de ti, como todos nossos pais; e nossos dias qual sombra sobre a terra, e não dão espera.
verses.RVR09: Porque nosotros, extranjeros y advenedizos somos delante de ti, como todos nuestros padres; y nuestros días cual sombra sobre la tierra, y no dan espera.

verses.KJV: O Lord our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.
verses.WEB: LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house for thy holy name cometh of thy hand, and is all thine own.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR Deus nosso, toda esta abundância que preparamos para edificar casa a teu santo nome, de tua mão é, e tudo é teu.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová Dios nuestro, toda esta abundancia que hemos aprestado para edificar casa á tu santo nombre, de tu mano es, y todo es tuyo.

verses.KJV: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
verses.WEB: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.
verses.ASV: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, that are present here, offer willingly unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sei, Deus meu, que tu esquadrinhas os corações, e que a retidão te agrada: por isso eu com retidão de meu coração voluntariamente te ei oferecido tudo isto, e agora vi com alegria que teu povo, que aqui se achou agora, deu para ti espontaneamente.
verses.RVR09: Yo sé, Dios mío, que tú escudriñas los corazones, y que la rectitud te agrada: por eso yo con rectitud de mi corazón voluntariamente te he ofrecido todo esto, y ahora he visto con alegría que tu pueblo, que aquí se ha hallado ahora, ha dado para ti espontáneamente.

verses.KJV: O Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:
verses.WEB: LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, Deus de Abraão, de Isaque, e de Israel, nossos pais, conserva perpetuamente esta vontade do coração de teu povo, e encaminha seu coração a ti.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, Dios de Abraham, de Isaac, y de Israel, nuestros padres, conserva perpetuamente esta voluntad del corazón de tu pueblo, y encamina su corazón á ti.

verses.KJV: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.
verses.WEB: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”
verses.ASV: and give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao meu filho Salomão dá um coração íntegro, para que guarde os teus mandamentos, os teus testemunhos e os teus estatutos, e para que faça todas as coisas, e te edifique a casa para a qual eu preparei.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo da á mi hijo Salomón corazón perfecto, para que guarde tus mandamientos, tus testimonios y tus estatutos, y para que haga todas las cosas, y te edifique la casa para la cual yo he hecho el apresto.

verses.KJV: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the Lord your God. And all the congregation blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the Lord, and the king.
verses.WEB: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God!” All the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before the LORD and the king.
verses.ASV: And David said to all the assembly, Now bless Jehovah your God. And all the assembly blessed Jehovah, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped Jehovah, and the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disse Davi a toda à congregação: Bendizei agora ao SENHOR vosso Deus. Então toda a congregação bendisse ao SENHOR Deus de seus pais, e inclinando-se, adoraram diante do SENHOR, e do rei.
verses.RVR09: Después dijo David á toda la congregación: Bendecid ahora á Jehová vuestro Dios. Entonces toda la congregación bendijo á Jehová Dios de sus padres, é inclinándose adoraron delante de Jehová, y del rey.

verses.KJV: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings unto the Lord, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:
verses.WEB: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
verses.ASV: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto Jehovah, and offered burnt-offerings unto Jehovah, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
verses.ALMEIDA: E sacrificaram animais ao SENHOR, e ofereceram ao SENHOR holocaustos no dia seguinte, mil bezerros, mil carneiros, mil cordeiros com as suas libações, e muitos sacrifícios por todo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y sacrificaron víctimas á Jehová, y ofrecieron á Jehová holocaustos el día siguiente, mil becerros, mil carneros, mil corderos con sus libaciones, y muchos sacrificios por todo Israel.

verses.KJV: And did eat and drink before the Lord on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the Lord to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.
verses.WEB: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
verses.ASV: and did eat and drink before Jehovah on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto Jehovah to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comeram e beberam diante do SENHOR aquele dia com grande alegria; e deram a segunda vez a investidura do reino a Salomão filho de Davi, e ungiram-no ao SENHOR por príncipe, e a Zadoque por sacerdote.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron y bebieron delante de Jehová aquel día con gran gozo; y dieron la segunda vez la investidura del reino á Salomón hijo de David, y ungiéronlo á Jehová por príncipe, y á Sadoc por sacerdote.

verses.KJV: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.WEB: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.ASV: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Jehovah as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sentou-se Salomão por rei no trono do SENHOR em lugar de Davi seu pai, e foi próspero; e obedeceu-lhe todo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y sentóse Salomón por rey en el trono de Jehová en lugar de David su padre, y fué prosperado; y obedecióle todo Israel.

verses.KJV: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
verses.WEB: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
verses.ASV: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os príncipes e poderosos, e todos os filhos do rei Davi, prestaram homenagem ao rei Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y todos los príncipes y poderosos, y todos los hijos del rey David, prestaron homenaje al rey Salomón.

verses.KJV: And the Lord magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.WEB: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR engrandeceu em extremo a Salomão a os olhos de todo Israel, e deu-lhe glória do reino, qual nenhum rei a teve antes dele em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová engrandeció en extremo á Salomón á los ojos de todo Israel, y dióle gloria del reino, cual ningún rey la tuvo antes de él en Israel.

verses.KJV: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.WEB: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.ASV: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim reinou Davi filho de Jessé sobre todo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Así reinó David hijo de Isaí sobre todo Israel.

verses.KJV: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three [years] reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o tempo que reinou sobre Israel foi quarenta anos. Sete anos reinou em Hebrom, e trinta e três reinou em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y el tiempo que reinó sobre Israel fué cuarenta años. Siete años reinó en Hebrón, y treinta y tres reinó en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu em boa velhice, cheio de dias, de riquezas, e de glória: e reinou em seu lugar Salomão seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y murió en buena vejez, lleno de días, de riquezas, y de gloria: y reinó en su lugar Salomón su hijo.

verses.KJV: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
verses.WEB: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,
verses.ASV: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,
verses.ALMEIDA: E os feitos do rei Davi, primeiros e últimos, estão escritos no livro das crônicas de Samuel vidente, e nas crônicas do profeta Natã, e nas crônicas de Gade vidente,
verses.RVR09: Y los hechos del rey David, primeros y postreros, están escritos en el libro de las crónicas de Samuel vidente, y en las crónicas del profeta Nathán, y en las crónicas de Gad vidente,

verses.KJV: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.WEB: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
verses.ASV: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com todo o relato de seu reinado, e seu poder, e os tempos que passaram sobre ele, e sobre Israel, e sobre todos os reinos daquelas aquelas terras.
verses.RVR09: Con todo lo relativo á su reinado, y su poder, y los tiempos que pasaron sobre él, y sobre Israel, y sobre todos los reinos de aquellas tierras.

verses.KJV: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.WEB: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.
verses.ASV: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and Jehovah his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão filho de Davi foi estabelecido em seu reino; e o SENHOR seu Deus foi com ele, e lhe engrandeceu muito.
verses.RVR09: Y SALOMÓN hijo de David fué afirmado en su reino; y Jehová su Dios fué con él, y le engrandeció sobremanera.

verses.KJV: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
verses.WEB: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.
verses.ASV: And Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ [houses].
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou Salomão a todo Israel, comandantes, líderes de centenas, e juízes, e a todos os príncipes de todo Israel, cabeças de famílias.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó Salomón á todo Israel, tribunos, centuriones, y jueces, y á todos los príncipes de todo Israel, cabezas de familias.

verses.KJV: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which the LORD’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: So Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tent of meeting of God, which Moses the servant of Jehovah had made in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi Salomão, e com ele toda esta congregação, ao alto que havia em Gibeão; porque ali estava o tabernáculo do testemunho de Deus, que Moisés servo do SENHOR havia feito no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y fué Salomón, y con él toda esta junta, al alto que había en Gabaón; porque allí estaba el tabernáculo del testimonio de Dios, que Moisés siervo de Jehová había hecho en el desierto.

verses.KJV: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kiriath-jearim to [the place] that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Davi havia trazido a arca de Deus de Quriate-Jearim ao lugar que ele lhe havia preparado; porque ele lhe havia estendido uma tenda em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Mas David había traído el arca de Dios de Chîriath-jearim al lugar que él le había preparado; porque él le había tendido una tienda en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the Lord: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
verses.WEB: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before the LORD’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.
verses.ASV: Moreover the brazen altar, that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, was there before the tabernacle of Jehovah: and Solomon and the assembly sought unto it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o altar de bronze que havia feito Bezalel filho de Uri filho de Hur, estava ali diante do tabernáculo do SENHOR, ao qual Salomão foi a consultar com aquela congregação.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo el altar de bronce que había hecho Bezaleel hijo de Uri hijo de Hur, estaba allí delante del tabernáculo de Jehová, al cual fué á consultar Salomón con aquella junta.

verses.KJV: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the Lord, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
verses.WEB: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.
verses.ASV: And Solomon went up thither to the brazen altar before Jehovah, which was at the tent of meeting, and offered a thousand burnt-offerings upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subiu, pois, Salomão ali diante do SENHOR, ao altar de bronze que estava no tabernáculo do testemunho, e ofereceu sobre ele mil holocaustos.
verses.RVR09: Subió pues Salomón allá delante de Jehová, al altar de bronce que estaba en el tabernáculo del testimonio, y ofreció sobre él mil holocaustos.

verses.KJV: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.WEB: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”
verses.ASV: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aquela noite apareceu Deus a Salomão, e disse-lhe: Pede o que queres que eu te dê.
verses.RVR09: Y aquella noche apareció Dios á Salomón, y díjole: Demanda lo que quisieres que yo te dé.

verses.KJV: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
verses.WEB: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.
verses.ASV: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast showed great lovingkindness unto David my father, and hast made me king in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão disse a Deus: Tu fizeste com Davi meu pai grande misericórdia, e a mim me puseste por rei em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y Salomón dijo á Dios: Tú has hecho con David mi padre grande misericordia, y á mí me has puesto por rey en lugar suyo.

verses.KJV: Now, O Lord God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.WEB: Now, LORD God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.ASV: Now, O Jehovah God, let thy promise unto David my father be established; for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confirme-se, pois, agora, ó SENHOR Deus, tua palavra dada a Davi meu pai; porque tu me puseste por rei sobre um povo em multidão como o pó da terra.
verses.RVR09: Confírmese pues ahora, oh Jehová Dios, tu palabra dada á David mi padre; porque tú me has puesto por rey sobre un pueblo en muchedumbre como el polvo de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
verses.WEB: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”
verses.ASV: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-me agora sabedoria e conhecimento, para sair e entrar diante deste povo: porque quem poderá julgar este teu povo tão grande?
verses.RVR09: Dame ahora sabiduría y ciencia, para salir y entrar delante de este pueblo: porque ¿quién podrá juzgar este tu pueblo tan grande?

verses.KJV: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
verses.WEB: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,
verses.ASV: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thy heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honor, nor the life of them that hate thee, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Deus a Salomão: Porquanto isto foi em teu coração, que não pediste riquezas, riqueza, ou glória, nem a alma dos que te querem mal, nem pediste muitos dias, mas sim que pediste para ti sabedoria e conhecimento para julgar meu povo, sobre o qual te constituí por rei.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Dios á Salomón: Por cuanto esto fué en tu corazón, que no pediste riquezas, hacienda, ó gloria, ni el alma de los que te quieren mal, ni pediste muchos días, sino que has pedido para ti sabiduría y ciencia para juzgar mi pueblo, sobre el cual te he puesto por rey,

verses.KJV: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
verses.WEB: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have.”
verses.ASV: wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee; neither shall there any after thee have the like.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabedoria e conhecimento te são dados; e também te darei riquezas, bens, e glória, que nunca houve nos reis que foram antes de ti, nem depois de ti haverá tais.
verses.RVR09: Sabiduría y ciencia te es dada; y también te daré riquezas, hacienda, y gloria, cual nunca hubo en los reyes que han sido antes de ti, ni después de ti habrá tal.

verses.KJV: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.
verses.WEB: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.
verses.ASV: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting, unto Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltou Salomão a Jerusalém do alto que estava em Gibeão, de ante o tabernáculo do testemunho; e reinou sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió Salomón á Jerusalem del alto que estaba en Gabaón, de ante el tabernáculo del testimonio; y reinó sobre Israel.

verses.KJV: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntou Salomão carros e cavaleiros; e teve mil e quatrocentos carros, e doze mil cavaleiros, os quais pôs nas cidades dos carros, e com o rei em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y juntó Salomón carros y gente de á caballo; y tuvo mil y cuatrocientos carros, y doce mil jinetes, los cuales puso en las ciudades de los carros, y con el rey en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
verses.WEB: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
verses.ASV: And the king made silver and gold to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore-trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs o rei prata e ouro em Jerusalém como pedras, e cedro como sicômoros que nascem nos campos em abundância.
verses.RVR09: Y puso el rey plata y oro en Jerusalem como piedras, y cedro como cabrahigos que nacen en los campos en abundancia.

verses.KJV: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.WEB: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.
verses.ASV: And the horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt; the king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.
verses.ALMEIDA: E traziam cavalos do Egito e de Coa para Salomão; pois os mercadores do rei [os] compravam de Coa por [um certo] preço.
verses.RVR09: Y sacaban caballos y lienzos finos de Egipto para Salomón; pues por contrato tomaban allí los mercaderes del rey caballos y lienzos.

verses.KJV: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
verses.WEB: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.
verses.ASV: And they fetched up and brought out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred [shekels] of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
verses.ALMEIDA: E subiam, e tiravam do Egito, um carro por seiscentas peças de prata, e um cavalo por cento e cinquenta: e assim se tiravam por meio deles para todos os reis dos Heteus, e para os reis da Síria.
verses.RVR09: Y subían, y sacaban de Egipto, un carro por seiscientas piezas de plata, y un caballo por ciento y cincuenta: y así se sacaban por medio de ellos para todos los reyes de los Hetheos, y para los reyes de Siria.

verses.KJV: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.WEB: Now Solomon decided to build a house for the LORD’s name, and a house for his kingdom.
verses.ASV: Now Solomon purposed to build a house for the name of Jehovah, and a house for his kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Determinou, pois, Salomão edificar casa ao nome do SENHOR, e outra casa para seu reino.
verses.RVR09: DETERMINÓ pues Salomón edificar casa al nombre de Jehová, y otra casa para su reino.

verses.KJV: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.WEB: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.
verses.ASV: And Solomon counted out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand men that were hewers in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E contou Salomão setenta mil homens que levassem cargas, e oitenta mil homens que cortassem no monte, e três mil e seiscentos que os governassem.
verses.RVR09: Y contó Salomón setenta mil hombres que llevasen cargas, y ochenta mil hombres que cortasen en el monte, y tres mil y seiscientos que los gobernasen.

verses.KJV: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
verses.WEB: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.
verses.ASV: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him a house to dwell therein, [even so deal with me].
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviou a dizer Salomão a Hirão rei de Tiro: Faze comigo como fizeste com Davi meu pai, enviando-lhe cedros para que edificasse para si casa em que morasse.
verses.RVR09: Y envió á decir Salomón á Hiram rey de Tiro: Haz conmigo como hiciste con David mi padre, enviándole cedros para que edificara para sí casa en que morase.

verses.KJV: Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
verses.WEB: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.
verses.ASV: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of Jehovah my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him incense of sweet spices, and for the continual showbread, and for the burnt-offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Jehovah our God. This is [an ordinance] for ever to Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui eu tenho que edificar casa ao nome do SENHOR meu Deus, para consagrá-la, para queimar perfumes aromáticos diante dele, e para a colocação contínua dos pães da proposição, e para holocaustos a manhã e tarde, e os sábados, e luas novas, e festividades do SENHOR nosso Deus; o qual será perpétuo em Israel.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo tengo que edificar casa al nombre de Jehová mi Dios, para consagrársela, para quemar perfumes aromáticos delante de él, y para la colocación continua de los panes de la proposición, y para holocaustos á mañana y tarde, y los sábados, y nuevas lunas, y festividades de Jehová nuestro Dios; lo cual ha de ser perpetuo en Israel.

verses.KJV: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.
verses.WEB: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
verses.ASV: And the house which I build is great; for great is our God above all gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a casa que tenho que edificar, há de ser grande: porque o Deus nosso é grande sobre todos os deuses.
verses.RVR09: Y la casa que tengo que edificar, ha de ser grande: porque el Dios nuestro es grande sobre todos los dioses.

verses.KJV: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
verses.WEB: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense before him?
verses.ASV: But who is able to build him a house, seeing heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him a house, save only to burn incense before him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quem será tão poderoso que lhe edifique casa? Os céus e os céus dos céus não lhe podem compreender; quem, pois, sou eu, que lhe edifique casa, a não ser para queimar perfumes diante dele?
verses.RVR09: Mas ¿quién será tan poderoso que le edifique casa? Los cielos y los cielos de los cielos no le pueden comprender; ¿quién pues soy yo, que le edifique casa, sino para quemar perfumes delante de él?

verses.KJV: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
verses.WEB: “Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.
verses.ASV: Now therefore send me a man skilful to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that knoweth how to grave [all manner of] gravings, [to be] with the skilful men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envia-me, pois, agora um homem hábil, que saiba trabalhar em ouro, e em prata, e em bronze, e em ferro, em púrpura, e em carmesim, e em azul, e que saiba esculpir com os mestres que estão comigo em Judá e em Jerusalém, os quais preparou meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Envíame pues ahora un hombre hábil, que sepa trabajar en oro, y en plata, y en metal, y en hierro, en púrpura, y en grana, y en cárdeno, y que sepa esculpir con los maestros que están conmigo en Judá y en Jerusalem, los cuales previno mi padre.

verses.KJV: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
verses.WEB: “Send me also cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. Behold, my servants will be with your servants,
verses.ASV: Send me also cedar-trees, fir-trees, and algum-trees, out of Lebanon; for I know that thy servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. And, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
verses.ALMEIDA: Envia-me também madeira de cedro, de faia, de pinho, do Líbano: porque eu sei que teus servos entendem de cortar madeira no Líbano; e eis que meus servos irão com os teus,
verses.RVR09: Envíame también madera de cedro, de haya, de pino, del Líbano: porque yo sé que tus siervos entienden de cortar madera en el Líbano; y he aquí, mis siervos irán con los tuyos,

verses.KJV: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
verses.WEB: even to prepare timber in abundance for me; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.
verses.ASV: even to prepare me timber in abundance; for the house which I am about to build shall be great and wonderful.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que me preparem muita madeira, porque a casa que tenho de edificar há de ser grande e imponente.
verses.RVR09: Para que me apresten mucha madera, porque la casa que tengo de edificar ha de ser grande y portentosa.

verses.KJV: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”
verses.ASV: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que para os operários teus servos, cortadores da madeira, ei dado vinte mil coros de trigo em grão, e vinte mil coros de cevada, e vinte mil batos de vinho, e vinte mil batos de azeite.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí para los operarios tus siervos, cortadores de la madera, he dado veinte mil coros de trigo en grano, y veinte mil coros de cebada, y veinte mil batos de vino, y veinte mil batos de aceite.

verses.KJV: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the Lord hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
verses.WEB: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you king over them.”
verses.ASV: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because Jehovah loveth his people, he hath made thee king over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Hirão rei de Tiro respondeu por carta, a qual enviou a Salomão: Porque o SENHOR amou a seu povo, te pôs por rei sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Hiram rey de Tiro respondió por letras, las que envió á Salomón: Porque Jehová amó á su pueblo, te ha puesto por rey sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.WEB: Huram continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.
verses.ASV: Huram said moreover, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with discretion and understanding, that should build a house for Jehovah, and a house for his kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ademais dizia Hirão: Bendito seja o SENHOR o Deus de Israel, que fez os céus e a terra, e que deu ao rei Davi filho sábio, entendido, de bom senso e prudente, que edifique casa ao SENHOR, e casa para seu reino.
verses.RVR09: Y además decía Hiram: Bendito sea Jehová el Dios de Israel, que hizo los cielos y la tierra, y que dió al rey David hijo sabio, entendido, cuerdo y prudente, que edifique casa á Jehová, y casa para su reino.

verses.KJV: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
verses.WEB: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,
verses.ASV: And now I have sent a skilful man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father’s,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, pois, te enviei um homem hábil e entendido, que foi de Hirão meu pai,
verses.RVR09: Yo pues te he enviado un hombre hábil y entendido, que fué de Hiram mi padre,

verses.KJV: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
verses.WEB: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.
verses.ASV: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson, also to grave any manner of graving, and to devise any device; that there may be [a place] appointed unto him with thy skilful men, and with the skilful men of my lord David thy father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho de uma mulher das filhas de Dã, mas seu pai foi de Tiro; o qual sabe trabalhar em ouro, e prata, e bronze, e ferro, em pedra e em madeira, em púrpura, e em azul, em linho e em carmesim; assim para esculpir todas as figuras, e tirar toda sorte de desenho que lhe for proposto, e [estar] com teus homens peritos, e com os do meu senhor Davi, teu pai.
verses.RVR09: Hijo de una mujer de las hijas de Dan, mas su padre fué de Tiro; el cual sabe trabajar en oro, y plata, y metal, y hierro, en piedra y en madera, en púrpura y en cárdeno, en lino y en carmesí; asimismo para esculpir todas figuras, y sacar toda suerte de diseño que se le propusiere, y estar con tus hombres peritos, y con los de mi señor David tu padre.

verses.KJV: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
verses.WEB: “Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;
verses.ASV: Now therefore the wheat and the barley, the oil and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, enviará meu senhor a seus servos o trigo e cevada, e azeite e vinho, que disse;
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, enviará mi señor á sus siervos el trigo y cebada, y aceite y vino, que ha dicho;

verses.KJV: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you need. We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.”
verses.ASV: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need; and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nós cortaremos no Líbano a madeira que houveres necessidade, e te a traremos em balsas pelo mar até Jope, e tu a farás levar até Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros cortaremos en el Líbano la madera que hubieres menester, y te la traeremos en balsas por la mar hasta Joppe, y tú la harás llevar hasta Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.WEB: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.
verses.ASV: And Solomon numbered all the sojourners that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found a hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: E contou Salomão todos os homens estrangeiros que estavam na terra de Israel, depois de havê-los já contado Davi seu pai, e foram achados cento cinquenta e três mil seiscentos.
verses.RVR09: Y contó Salomón todos los hombres extranjeros que estaban en la tierra de Israel, después de haberlos ya contado David su padre, y fueron hallados ciento cincuenta y tres mil seiscientos.

verses.KJV: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
verses.WEB: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work.
verses.ASV: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand that were hewers in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people at work.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assinalou deles setenta mil para levar cargas, e oitenta mil que cortassem no monte, e três mil e seiscentos por capatazes para fazer trabalhar ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Y señaló de ellos setenta mil para llevar cargas, y ochenta mil que cortasen en el monte, y tres mil y seiscientos por sobrestantes para hacer trabajar al pueblo.

verses.KJV: Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.WEB: Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.ASV: Then Solomon began to build the house of Jehovah at Jerusalem on mount Moriah, where [Jehovah] appeared unto David his father, which he made ready in the place that David had appointed, in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E começou Salomão a edificar a casa em Jerusalém, no monte Moriá que havia sido mostrado a Davi seu pai, no lugar que Davi havia preparado na eira de Ornã jebuseu.
verses.RVR09: Y COMENZÓ Salomón á edificar la casa en Jerusalem, en el monte Moria que había sido mostrado á David su padre, en el lugar que David había preparado en la era de Ornán Jebuseo.

verses.KJV: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.WEB: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.ASV: And he began to build in the second [day] of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.ALMEIDA: E começou a edificar no mês segundo, a dois do mês, no quarto ano de seu reinado.
verses.RVR09: Y comenzó á edificar en el mes segundo, á dos del mes, en el cuarto año de su reinado.

verses.KJV: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.WEB: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.
verses.ASV: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as medidas de que Salomão fundou o edifício da casa de Deus. A primeira medida foi do comprimento de sessenta côvados; e a largura de vinte côvados.
verses.RVR09: Estas son las medidas de que Salomón fundó el edificio de la casa de Dios. La primera medida fué, la longitud de sesenta codos; y la anchura de veinte codos.

verses.KJV: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.WEB: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.ASV: And the porch that was before [the house], the length of it, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height a hundred and twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pórtico que estava na dianteira do comprimento, era de vinte côvados à frente da largura da casa, e sua altura de cento e vinte: e cobriu-o por dentro de ouro puro.
verses.RVR09: El pórtico que estaba en la delantera de la longitud, era de veinte codos al frente del ancho de la casa, y su altura de ciento y veinte: y cubriólo por dentro de oro puro.

verses.KJV: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
verses.WEB: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
verses.ASV: And the greater house he ceiled with fir-wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and wrought thereon palm-trees and chains.
verses.ALMEIDA: E forrou a casa maior com madeira de faia, a qual cobriu de bom ouro, e fez ressaltar sobre ela palmas e correntes.
verses.RVR09: Y techó la casa mayor con madera de haya, la cual cubrió de buen oro, é hizo resaltar sobre ella palmas y cadenas.

verses.KJV: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.WEB: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.
verses.ASV: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cobriu também a casa de pedras preciosas por excelência: e o ouro era ouro de Parvaim.
verses.RVR09: Cubrió también la casa de piedras preciosas por excelencia: y el oro era oro de Parvaim.

verses.KJV: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.WEB: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.
verses.ASV: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the thresholds, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubim on the walls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim cobriu a casa, suas vigas, seus umbrais, suas paredes, e suas portas, com ouro; e esculpiu querubins pelas paredes.
verses.RVR09: Así cubrió la casa, sus vigas, sus umbrales, sus paredes, y sus puertas, con oro; y esculpió querubines por las paredes.

verses.KJV: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.WEB: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.ASV: And he made the most holy house: the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez assim a casa do lugar santíssimo, cujo comprimento era de vinte côvados segundo a largura da frente da casa, e sua largura de vinte côvados: e cobriu-a de bom ouro que pesava seiscentos talentos.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo la casa del lugar santísimo, cuya longitud era de veinte codos según el ancho del frente de la casa, y su anchura de veinte codos: y cubrióla de buen oro que ascendía á seiscientos talentos.

verses.KJV: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.WEB: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
verses.ASV: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o peso dos pregos teve cinquenta siclos de ouro. Cobriu também de ouro as salas.
verses.RVR09: Y el peso de los clavos tuvo cincuenta siclos de oro. Cubrió también de oro las salas.

verses.KJV: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.WEB: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.
verses.ASV: And in the most holy house he made two cherubim of image work; and they overlaid them with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dentro do lugar santíssimo fez dois querubins esculpidos, os quais cobriram de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y dentro del lugar santísimo hizo dos querubines de forma de niños, los cuales cubrieron de oro.

verses.KJV: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.WEB: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.ASV: And the wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one [cherub] was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was [likewise] five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.ALMEIDA: O comprimento das asas dos querubins era de vinte côvados: porque a uma asa era de cinco côvados: a qual chegava até a parede da casa; e a outra asa de cinco côvados, a qual chegava à asa do outro querubim.
verses.RVR09: El largo de las alas de los querubines era de veinte codos: porque la una ala era de cinco codos: la cual llegaba hasta la pared de la casa; y la otra ala de cinco codos, la cual llegaba al ala del otro querubín.

verses.KJV: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.WEB: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.ASV: And the wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits [also], joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da mesma maneira a uma asa do outro querubim era de cinco côvados: a qual chegava até a parede da casa; e a outra asa era de cinco côvados, que tocava a asa do outro querubim.
verses.RVR09: De la misma manera la una ala del otro querubín era de cinco codos: la cual llegaba hasta la pared de la casa; y la otra ala era de cinco codos, que tocaba al ala del otro querubín.

verses.KJV: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
verses.WEB: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
verses.ASV: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim as asas destes querubins estavam estendidas por vinte côvados: e eles estavam em pé com os rostos até a casa.
verses.RVR09: Así las alas de estos querubines estaban extendidas por veinte codos: y ellos estaban en pie con los rostros hacia la casa.

verses.KJV: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
verses.WEB: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.
verses.ASV: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubim thereon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o véu de azul, púrpura, carmesim e linho, e fez ressaltar em ele querubins.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el velo de cárdeno, púrpura, carmesí y lino, é hizo resaltar en él querubines.

verses.KJV: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.WEB: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.ASV: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante da casa fez duas colunas de trinta e cinco côvados de comprimento, com seus capitéis encima, de cinco côvados.
verses.RVR09: Delante de la casa hizo dos columnas de treinta y cinco codos de longitud, con sus capiteles encima, de cinco codos.

verses.KJV: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.WEB: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.ASV: And he made chains in the oracle, and put [them] on the tops of the pillars; and he made a hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também correntes, [como no] compartimento interno, e as pôs sobre os capitéis das colunas: e fez cem romãs, as quais pôs nas correntes.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo cadenas en el oratorio, y púsolas sobre los capiteles de las columnas: é hizo cien granadas, las cuales puso en las cadenas.

verses.KJV: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.WEB: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.ASV: And he set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assentou as colunas diante do templo, a uma à mão direita, e a outra à esquerda; e à da mão direita chamou Jaquim, e à da esquerda, Boaz.
verses.RVR09: Y asentó las columnas delante del templo, la una á la mano derecha, y la otra á la izquierda; y á la de la mano derecha llamó Jachîn, y á la de la izquierda, Boaz.

verses.KJV: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.WEB: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
verses.ASV: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez ademais um altar de bronze de vinte côvados de comprimento, e vinte côvados de largura, e dez côvados de altura.
verses.RVR09: HIZO además un altar de bronce de veinte codos de longitud, y veinte codos de anchura, y diez codos de altura.

verses.KJV: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.WEB: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.
verses.ASV: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass; and the height thereof was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também fez um mar de fundição, o qual tinha dez côvados do uma borda à outra, inteiramente redondo: sua altura era de cinco côvados, e uma linha de trinta côvados o contornava.
verses.RVR09: También hizo un mar de fundición, el cual tenía diez codos del un borde al otro, enteramente redondo: su altura era de cinco codos, y una línea de treinta codos lo ceñía alrededor.

verses.KJV: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
verses.WEB: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
verses.ASV: And under it was the likeness of oxen, which did compass it round about, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
verses.ALMEIDA: E debaixo dele havia figuras de bois que o circundavam, dez em cada côvado todo ao redor: eram duas ordens de bois fundidos juntamente com o mar.
verses.RVR09: Y debajo de él había figuras de bueyes que lo circundaban, diez en cada codo todo alrededor: eran dos órdenes de bueyes fundidos juntamente con el mar.

verses.KJV: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.WEB: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.
verses.ASV: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set upon them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estava assentado sobre doze bois, três dos quais estavam voltados ao norte, e três ao ocidente, e três ao sul, e três ao oriente: e o mar assentava sobre eles, e todas suas traseiras estavam à parte de dentro.
verses.RVR09: Y estaba asentado sobre doce bueyes, tres de los cuales miraban al septentrión, y tres al occidente, y tres al mediodía, y tres al oriente: y el mar asentaba sobre ellos, y todas sus traseras estaban á la parte de adentro.

verses.KJV: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.WEB: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.
verses.ASV: And it was a handbreadth thick; and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinha de espessura um palmo, e a borda era da feitura da borda de um cálice, ou flor de lírio. E fazia três mil batos.
verses.RVR09: Y tenía de grueso un palmo, y el borde era de la hechura del borde de un cáliz, ó flor de lis. Y hacía tres mil batos.

verses.KJV: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.WEB: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.ASV: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as belonged to the burnt-offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também dez fontes, e pôs cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda, para lavar e limpar nelas a obra do holocausto; mas o mar era para os sacerdotes se lavarem nele.
verses.RVR09: Hizo también diez fuentes, y puso cinco á la derecha y cinco á la izquierda, para lavar y limpiar en ellas la obra del holocausto; mas el mar era para lavarse los sacerdotes en él.

verses.KJV: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.WEB: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.
verses.ASV: And he made the ten candlesticks of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também dez candelabros de ouro segundo sua forma, os quais pôs no templo, cinco à direita, e cinco à esquerda.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo diez candeleros de oro según su forma, los cuales puso en el templo, cinco á la derecha, y cinco á la izquierda.

verses.KJV: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.WEB: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
verses.ASV: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made a hundred basins of gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também fez dez mesas e as pôs no templo, cinco à direita, e cinco à esquerda: igualmente fez cem bacias de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Además hizo diez mesas y púsolas en el templo, cinco á la derecha, y cinco á la izquierda: igualmente hizo cien tazones de oro.

verses.KJV: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.WEB: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.
verses.ASV: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mais disto fez o átrio dos sacerdotes, e o grande átrio, e as entradas do átrio, e cobriu as portas de elas de bronze.
verses.RVR09: A más de esto hizo el atrio de los sacerdotes, y el gran atrio, y las portadas del atrio, y cubrió las puertas de ellas de bronce.

verses.KJV: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.WEB: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.
verses.ASV: And he set the sea on the right side [of the house] eastward, toward the south.
verses.ALMEIDA: E assentou o mar ao lado direito até o oriente, em frente do sul.
verses.RVR09: Y asentó el mar al lado derecho hacia el oriente, enfrente del mediodía.

verses.KJV: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
verses.WEB: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:
verses.ASV: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. So Huram made an end of doing the work that he wrought for king Solomon in the house of God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também Hirão caldeiras, e pás, e bacias; e acabou Hirão a obra que fazia ao rei Salomão para a casa de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Hizo también Hiram calderos, y palas, y tazones; y acabó Hiram la obra que hacía al rey Salomón para la casa de Dios;

verses.KJV: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.WEB: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,
verses.ASV: the two pillars, and the bowls, and the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,
verses.ALMEIDA: Duas colunas, e os globos, os capitéis sobre as cabeças das duas colunas, e duas redes para cobrir as duas bolas dos capitéis que estavam encima das colunas;
verses.RVR09: Dos columnas, y los cordones, los capiteles sobre las cabezas de las dos columnas, y dos redes para cubrir las dos bolas de los capiteles que estaban encima de las columnas;

verses.KJV: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
verses.WEB: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.
verses.ASV: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were upon the pillars.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quatrocentas romãs nas duas redes, duas ordens de romãs em cada rede, para que cobrissem as duas bolas dos capitéis que estavam encima das colunas.
verses.RVR09: Cuatrocientas granadas en las dos redecillas, dos órdenes de granadas en cada redecilla, para que cubriesen las dos bolas de los capiteles que estaban encima de las columnas.

verses.KJV: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.WEB: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases—
verses.ASV: He made also the bases, and the lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também as bases, sobre as quais assentou as pias;
verses.RVR09: Hizo también las basas, sobre las cuales asentó las fuentes;

verses.KJV: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.WEB: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.
verses.ASV: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mar, e doze bois debaixo dele;
verses.RVR09: Un mar, y doce bueyes debajo de él;

verses.KJV: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the Lord of bright brass.
verses.WEB: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD’s house, of bright bronze.
verses.ASV: The pots also, and the shovels, and the flesh-hooks, and all the vessels thereof, did Huram his father make for king Solomon, for the house of Jehovah, of bright brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E caldeiras, e pás, e garfos; e todos seus utensílios fez Hirão seu pai ao rei Salomão para a casa do SENHOR, de bronze puríssimo.
verses.RVR09: Y calderos, y palas, y garfios; y todos sus enseres hizo Hiram su padre al rey Salomón para la casa de Jehová, de metal purísimo.

verses.KJV: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.WEB: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
verses.ASV: In the plain of the Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fundiu-os o rei nas planícies do Jordão, em terra argilosa, entre Sucote e Zeredá.
verses.RVR09: Y fundiólos el rey en los llanos del Jordán, en tierra arcillosa, entre Suchôt y Seredat.

verses.KJV: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.WEB: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
verses.ASV: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Salomão fez todos estes vasos em grande abundância, porque não pode ser achado o peso do bronze.
verses.RVR09: Y Salomón hizo todos estos vasos en grande abundancia, porque no pudo ser hallado el peso del metal.

verses.KJV: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
verses.WEB: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,
verses.ASV: And Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon was the showbread;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim fez Salomão todos os vasos para a casa de Deus, e o altar de ouro, e as mesas sobre as quais se punham os pães da proposição;
verses.RVR09: Así hizo Salomón todos los vasos para la casa de Dios, y el altar de oro, y las mesas sobre las cuales se ponían los panes de la proposición;

verses.KJV: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.WEB: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;
verses.ASV: and the candlesticks with their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os candelabros e suas lâmpadas, de ouro puro, para que as acendessem diante do compartimento interno conforme à costume.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo los candeleros y sus candilejas, de oro puro, para que las encendiesen delante del oratorio conforme á la costumbre.

verses.KJV: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.WEB: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was purest gold;
verses.ASV: and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.ALMEIDA: E as flores, e as lâmpadas, e as tenazes se fizeram completamente de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y las flores, y las lamparillas, y las despabiladeras se hicieron de oro, de oro perfecto;

verses.KJV: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
verses.WEB: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.
verses.ASV: and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the firepans, of pure gold. And as for the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house, [to wit], of the temple, were of gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também os apagadores, e as bacias, e as colheres, e os incensários, de ouro puro. Quanto à entrada da casa, suas portas interiores para o lugar santíssimo, e as portas da casa do templo, de ouro.
verses.RVR09: También los platillos, y las jofainas, y las cucharas, y los incensarios, de oro puro. Cuanto á la entrada de la casa, sus puertas interiores para el lugar santísimo, y las puertas de la casa del templo, de oro.
