verses.ALMEIDA: E passou Salomão à filha de Faraó, da cidade de Davi à casa que ele lhe havia edificado; porque disse: Minha mulher não morará na casa de Davi rei de Israel, porque aquelas habitações de onde entrou a arca do SENHOR, são sagradas.
verses.RVR09: Y pasó Salomón á la hija de Faraón, de la ciudad de David á la casa que él le había edificado; porque dijo: Mi mujer no morará en la casa de David rey de Israel, porque aquellas habitaciones donde ha entrado el arca de Jehová, son sagradas.

verses.KJV: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the Lord on the altar of the Lord, which he had built before the porch,
verses.WEB: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the LORD’s altar which he had built before the porch,
verses.ASV: Then Solomon offered burnt-offerings unto Jehovah on the altar of Jehovah, which he had built before the porch,

verses.KJV: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
verses.WEB: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.
verses.ASV: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times in the year, [even] in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que oferecessem cada coisa em seu dia, conforme ao mandamento de Moisés, nos sábados, nas novas luas, e nas solenidades, três vezes no ano, a saber, na festa dos pães ázimos, na festa das semanas, e na festa das cabanas.
verses.RVR09: Para que ofreciesen cada cosa en su día, conforme al mandamiento de Moisés, en los sábados, en las nuevas lunas, y en las solemnidades, tres veces en el año, á saber, en la fiesta de los panes ázimos, en la fiesta de las semanas, y en la fiesta de las cabañas.

verses.KJV: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
verses.WEB: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.
verses.ASV: And he appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise, and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required; the doorkeepers also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E constituiu as repartições dos sacerdotes em seus ofícios, conforme à ordenação de Davi seu pai; e os levitas por suas ordens, para que louvassem e ministrassem diante dos sacerdotes, casa coisa em seu dia; assim os porteiros por sua ordem
verses.RVR09: Y constituyó los repartimientos de los sacerdotes en sus oficios, conforme á la ordenación de David su padre; y los Levitas por sus órdenes, para que alabasen y ministrasen delante de los sacerdotes, cada cosa en su día; asimismo los porteros por su orden á cada puerta: porque así lo había mandado David, varón de Dios.

verses.KJV: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
verses.WEB: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.
verses.ASV: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não saíram do mandamento do rei, quanto aos sacerdotes e levitas, e os tesouros, e todo negócio:
verses.RVR09: Y no salieron del mandamiento del rey, cuanto á los sacerdotes y Levitas, y los tesoros, y todo negocio:

verses.KJV: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord, and until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was perfected.
verses.WEB: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of the LORD’s house until it was finished. So the LORD’s house was completed.
verses.ASV: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of Jehovah, and until it was finished. [So] the house of Jehovah was completed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque toda a obra de Salomão estava preparada desde o dia em que a casa do SENHOR foi fundada até que se acabou, até que a casa do SENHOR foi acabada do tudo.
verses.RVR09: Porque toda la obra de Salomón estaba preparada desde el día en que la casa de Jehová fué fundada hasta que se acabó, hasta que la casa de Jehová fué acabada del todo.

verses.KJV: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
verses.WEB: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.
verses.ASV: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, on the sea-shore in the land of Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Salomão foi a Eziom-Geber, e a Elote, à costa do mar na terra de Edom.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Salomón fué á Esion-geber, y á Eloth, á la costa de la mar en la tierra de Edom.

verses.KJV: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
verses.WEB: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.
verses.ASV: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and fetched from thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Hirão lhe havia enviado navios por mão de seus servos, e marinheiros destros no mar, os quais foram com os servos de Salomão a Ofir, e tomaram de ali quatrocentos e cinquenta talentos de ouro, e os trouxeram ao rei Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Porque Hiram le había enviado navíos por mano de sus siervos, y marineros diestros en la mar, los cuales fueron con los siervos de Salomón á Ophir, y tomaron de allá cuatrocientos y cincuenta talentos de oro, y los trajeron al rey Salomón.

verses.KJV: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.WEB: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
verses.ASV: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great train, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo a rainha de Sabá a fama de Salomão, veio a Jerusalém com uma comitiva muito grande, com camelos carregados de aroma, e ouro em abundância, e pedras preciosas, para tentar a Salomão com perguntas difíceis. E logo que veio a Salomão, falou com ele tudo o que havia em seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y OYENDO la reina de Seba la fama de Salomón, vino á Jerusalem con un muy grande séquito, con camellos cargados de aroma, y oro en abundancia, y piedras preciosas, para tentar á Salomón con preguntas difíciles. Y luego que vino á Salomón, habló con él todo lo que en su corazón tenía.

verses.KJV: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
verses.WEB: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.
verses.ASV: And Solomon told her all her questions; and there was not anything hid from Solomon which he told her not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Salomão lhe declarou todas suas palavras: nenhuma coisa restou que Salomão não lhe declarasse.
verses.RVR09: Pero Salomón le declaró todas sus palabras: ninguna cosa quedó que Salomón no le declarase.

verses.KJV: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.WEB: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
verses.ASV: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo a rainha de Sabá a sabedoria de Salomão, e a casa que havia edificado,
verses.RVR09: Y viendo la reina de Seba la sabiduría de Salomón, y la casa que había edificado,

verses.KJV: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.WEB: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.
verses.ASV: and the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, his cupbearers also, and their apparel, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of Jehovah; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as iguarias de sua mesa, e o assento de seus servos, e o estado de seus criados, e os vestidos deles, seus mestres-salas e seus vestidos, e sua subida por de onde subia à casa do SENHOR, não restou mais espírito nela.
verses.RVR09: Y las viandas de su mesa, y el asiento de sus siervos, y el estado de sus criados, y los vestidos de ellos, sus maestresalas y sus vestidos, y su subida por donde subía á la casa de Jehová, no quedó más espíritu en ella.

verses.KJV: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
verses.WEB: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
verses.ASV: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ao rei: Verdade é o que havia ouvido em minha terra de tuas coisas e de tua sabedoria;
verses.RVR09: Y dijo al rey: Verdad es lo que había oído en mi tierra de tus cosas y de tu sabiduría;

verses.KJV: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
verses.WEB: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!
verses.ASV: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it; and, behold, the half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu não cria as palavras deles, até que ei vindo, e meus olhos viram: e eis que que nem ainda a metade da grandeza de tua sabedoria me havia sido dita; porque tu excedes a fama que eu havia ouvido.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo no creía las palabras de ellos, hasta que he venido, y mis ojos han visto: y he aquí que ni aun la mitad de la grandeza de tu sabiduría me había sido dicha; porque tú sobrepujas la fama que yo había oído.

verses.KJV: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
verses.WEB: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.
verses.ASV: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, that stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurados teus homens, e ditosos estes teus servos, que estão sempre diante de ti, e ouvem tua sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados tus hombres, y dichosos estos tus siervos, que están siempre delante de ti, y oyen tu sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the Lord thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah thy God, who delighted in thee, to set thee on his throne, to be king for Jehovah thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do justice and righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: o SENHOR teu Deus seja bendito, o qual se agradou em ti para te pôr sobre seu trono por rei do SENHOR teu Deus: porquanto teu Deus amou a Israel para firmá-lo perpetuamente, por isso te pôs por rei sobre eles, para que faças juízo e justiça.
verses.RVR09: Jehová tu Dios sea bendito, el cual se ha agradado en ti para ponerte sobre su trono por rey de Jehová tu Dios: por cuanto tu Dios amó á Israel para afirmarlo perpetuamente, por eso te ha puesto por rey sobre ellos, para que hagas juicio y justicia.

verses.KJV: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
verses.WEB: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.ASV: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and spices in great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu ao rei cento e vinte talentos de ouro, e grande quantidade de aromas, e pedras preciosas: nunca havia tais aromas como os que deu a rainha de Sabá ao rei Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y dió al rey ciento y veinte talentos de oro, y gran copia de aromas, y piedras preciosas: nunca hubo tales aromas como los que dió la reina de Seba al rey Salomón.

verses.KJV: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
verses.WEB: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.
verses.ASV: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, that brought gold from Ophir, brought algum-trees and precious stones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também os servos de Hirão e os servos de Salomão, que haviam trazido o ouro de Ofir, trouxeram madeira de cipreste, e pedras preciosas.
verses.RVR09: También los siervos de Hiram y los siervos de Salomón, que habían traído el oro de Ophir, trajeron madera de Algummim, y piedras preciosas.

verses.KJV: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the Lord, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
verses.WEB: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.
verses.ASV: And the king made of the algum-trees terraces for the house of Jehovah, and for the king’s house, and harps and psalteries for the singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o rei da madeira de cipreste degraus na casa do SENHOR, e nas casas reais, e harpas e saltérios para os cantores: nunca em terra de Judá se havia visto madeira semelhante.
verses.RVR09: E hizo el rey de la madera de Algummim gradas en la casa de Jehová, y en las casas reales, y arpas y salterios para los cantores: nunca en tierra de Judá se había visto madera semejante.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.WEB: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.ASV: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, besides that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Salomão deu à rainha de Sabá tudo o que ela quis e lhe pediu, mais de o que havia trazido ao rei. Depois se voltou e foi-se a sua terra com seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey Salomón dió á la reina de Seba todo lo que ella quiso y le pidió, más de lo que había traído al rey. Después se volvió y fuése á su tierra con sus siervos.

verses.KJV: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
verses.WEB: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
verses.ASV: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o peso de ouro que vinha a Salomão cada um ano, era seiscentos sessenta e seis talentos de ouro,
verses.RVR09: Y el peso de oro que venía á Salomón cada un año, era seiscientos sesenta y seis talentos de oro,

verses.KJV: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

verses.ASV: besides that which the traders and merchants brought: and all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sem o que traziam os mercadores e negociantes; e também todos os reis da Arábia e os príncipes da terra traziam ouro e prata a Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Sin lo que traían los mercaderes y negociantes; y también todos los reyes de Arabia y los príncipes de la tierra traían oro y plata á Salomón.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

verses.ASV: And king Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred [shekels] of beaten gold went to one buckler.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez também o rei Salomão duzentos paveses de ouro de martelo, cada um dos quais tinha seiscentos siclos de ouro lavrado:
verses.RVR09: Hizo también el rey Salomón doscientos paveses de oro de martillo, cada uno de los cuales tenía seiscientos siclos de oro labrado:

verses.KJV: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.WEB: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.ASV: And [he made] three hundred shields of beaten gold; three hundred [shekels] of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim trezentos escudos de ouro batido, tendo cada escudo trezentos siclos de ouro: e os pôs o rei na casa do bosque do Líbano.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo trescientos escudos de oro batido, teniendo cada escudo trescientos siclos de oro: y púsolos el rey en la casa del bosque del Líbano.

verses.KJV: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.WEB: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.ASV: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez ademais o rei um grande trono de marfim, e cobriu-o de ouro puro.
verses.RVR09: Hizo además el rey un gran trono de marfil, y cubriólo de oro puro.

verses.KJV: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

verses.ASV: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the stays.
verses.ALMEIDA: E havia seis degraus ao trono, com um estrado de ouro ao mesmo, e braços da uma parte e da outra ao lugar do assento, e dois leões que estavam junto aos braços.
verses.RVR09: Y había seis gradas al trono, con un estrado de oro al mismo, y brazos de la una parte y de la otra al lugar del asiento, y dos leones que estaban junto á los brazos.

verses.KJV: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.WEB: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.
verses.ASV: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia também ali doze leões sobre os seis degraus da uma parte e da outra. Jamais foi feito outro semelhante em reino algum.

verses.ASV: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: silver was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os utensílios do rei Salomão eram de ouro, e todos os utensílios da casa do bosque do Líbano, de ouro puro. Nos dias de Salomão a prata não era de valiosa.
verses.RVR09: Toda la vajilla del rey Salomón era de oro, y toda la vajilla de la casa del bosque del Líbano, de oro puro. En los días de Salomón la plata no era de estima.

verses.KJV: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.WEB: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.ASV: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram; once every three years came the ships of Tarshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a frota do rei ia a Társis com os servos de Hirão, e cada três anos faziam vir os navios de Társis, e traziam ouro, prata, marfim, macacos, e pavões.
verses.RVR09: Porque la flota del rey iba á Tharsis con los siervos de Hiram, y cada tres años solían venir las naves de Tharsis, y traían oro, plata, marfil, simios, y pavos.

verses.KJV: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

verses.ASV: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E excedeu o rei Salomão a todos os reis da terra em riqueza e em sabedoria.

verses.KJV: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
verses.WEB: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.ASV: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os reis da terra procuravam ver o rosto de Salomão, por ouvir sua sabedoria, que Deus havia posto em seu coração:
verses.RVR09: Y todos los reyes de la tierra procuraban ver el rostro de Salomón, por oir su sabiduría, que Dios había puesto en su corazón:

verses.KJV: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.WEB: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.
verses.ASV: And they brought every man his tribute, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, armor, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.ALMEIDA: E destes, cada um trazia o seu presente, vasos de prata, vasos de ouro, vestidos, armas, aromas, cavalos e mulas, todos os anos.
verses.RVR09: Y de éstos, cada uno traía su presente, vasos de plata, vasos de oro, vestidos, armas, aromas, caballos y acémilas, todos los años.

verses.KJV: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teve também Salomão quatro mil estábulos para os cavalos e carros, e doze mil cavaleiros, os quais pôs nas cidades dos carros, e com o rei em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Tuvo también Salomón cuatro mil caballerizas para los caballos y carros, y doce mil jinetes, los cuales puso en las ciudades de los carros, y con el rey en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
verses.WEB: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And he ruled over all the kings from the River even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teve senhorio sobre todos os reis desde o rio até a terra dos filisteus, e até o termo do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y tuvo señorío sobre todos los reyes desde el río hasta la tierra de los Filisteos, y hasta el término de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
verses.WEB: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
verses.ASV: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore-trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs o rei prata em Jerusalém como pedras, e cedros como os sicômoros que nascem pelas campinas em abundância.
verses.RVR09: Y puso el rey plata en Jerusalem como piedras, y cedros como los cabrahigos que nacen por las campiñas en abundancia.

verses.KJV: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
verses.WEB: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.
verses.ASV: And they brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Traziam também cavalos para Salomão, do Egito e de todas as províncias.
verses.RVR09: Sacaban también caballos para Salomón, de Egipto y de todas las provincias.

verses.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.WEB: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.ASV: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais feitos de Salomão, primeiros e últimos, não está tudo escrito nos livros de Natã profeta, e na profecia de Aías silonita, e nas profecias do vidente Ido contra Jeroboão filho de Nebate?
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Salomón, primeros y postreros, ¿no está todo escrito en los libros de Nathán profeta, y en la profecía de Ahías Silonita, y en las profecías del vidente Iddo contra Jeroboam hijo de Nabat?

verses.KJV: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.WEB: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.ASV: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reinou Salomão em Jerusalém sobre todo Israel quarenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Y reinó Salomón en Jerusalem sobre todo Israel cuarenta años.

verses.KJV: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descansou Salomão com seus pais, e sepultaram-no na cidade de Davi seu pai: e reinou em seu lugar Roboão seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió Salomón con sus padres, y sepultáronlo en la ciudad de David su padre: y reinó en su lugar Roboam su hijo.

verses.KJV: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.
verses.WEB: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.ASV: And Rehoboam went to Shechem; for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Roboão foi a Siquém porque em Siquém se havia juntado todo Israel para fazê-lo rei.
verses.RVR09: Y ROBOAM fué á Sichêm porque en Sichêm se había juntado todo Israel para hacerlo rey.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
verses.WEB: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of king Solomon), that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o ouviu Jeroboão filho de Nebate, o qual estava em Egito, de onde havia fugido por causa do rei Salomão, voltou do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y como lo oyó Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, el cual estaba en Egipto, donde había huído á causa del rey Salomón, volvió de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.WEB: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.ASV: And they sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spake to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviaram e chamaram-lhe. Veio, pois, Jeroboão, e todo Israel, e falaram a Roboão, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y enviaron y llamáronle. Vino pues Jeroboam, y todo Israel, y hablaron á Roboam, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
verses.WEB: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”
verses.ASV: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu pai agravou nosso jugo: alivia tu, pois, agora algo da dura servidão, e do grave jugo com que teu pai nos pressionou, e te serviremos.
verses.RVR09: Tu padre agravó nuestro yugo: afloja tú, pues, ahora algo de la dura servidumbre, y del grave yugo con que tu padre nos apremió, y te serviremos.

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
verses.WEB: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhes disse: Voltai a mim daqui a três dias. E o povo se foi.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dijo: Volved á mí de aquí á tres días. Y el pueblo se fué.

verses.KJV: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
verses.WEB: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”
verses.ASV: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei Roboão tomou conselho com os anciãos, que haviam estado diante de Salomão seu pai quando vivia, e disse-lhes: Como aconselhais vós que responda a este povo?
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey Roboam tomó consejo con los viejos, que habían estado delante de Salomón su padre cuando vivía, y díjoles: ¿Cómo aconsejáis vosotros que responda á este pueblo?

verses.KJV: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.WEB: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”
verses.ASV: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles lhe falaram, dizendo: Se te conduzires humanamente com este povo, e os agradares, e lhes falares boas palavras, eles te servirão perpetuamente.
verses.RVR09: Y ellos le hablaron, diciendo: Si te condujeres humanamente con este pueblo, y los agradares, y les hablares buenas palabras, ellos te servirán perpetuamente.

verses.KJV: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
verses.WEB: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
verses.ASV: But he forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men that were grown up with him, that stood before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ele, deixando o conselho que lhe deram os anciãos, tomou conselho com os rapazes que se haviam criado com ele, e que diante dele assistiam;
verses.RVR09: Mas él, dejando el consejo que le dieron los viejos, tomó consejo con los mancebos que se habían criado con él, y que delante de él asistían;

verses.KJV: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
verses.WEB: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”
verses.ASV: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye, that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke that thy father did put upon us lighter?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-lhes: Que aconselhais vós que respondamos a este povo, que me falou, dizendo: Alivia algo do jugo que teu pai pôs sobre nós?
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles: ¿Qué aconsejáis vosotros que respondamos á este pueblo, que me ha hablado, diciendo: Alivia algo del yugo que tu padre puso sobre nosotros?

verses.KJV: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
verses.WEB: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
verses.ASV: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou say unto the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger is thicker than my father’s loins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os rapazes que se haviam criado com ele, lhe falaram, dizendo: Assim dirás ao povo que te falou dizendo, Teu pai agravou nosso jugo, mas tu livra-nos da carga: assim lhes dirás: O meu dedo mínimo é mais espesso que os lombos de meu pai.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los mancebos que se habían criado con él, le hablaron, diciendo: Así dirás al pueblo que te ha hablado diciendo, Tu padre agravó nuestro yugo, mas tú descárganos: así les dirás: Lo más menudo mío es más grueso que los lomos de mi padre.

verses.KJV: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.WEB: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”
verses.ASV: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I [will chastise you] with scorpions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim que, meu pai vos impôs carga de grave jugo, e eu acrescentarei a vosso jugo: meu pai vos castigou com açoites, e eu com escorpiões.
verses.RVR09: Así que, mi padre os cargó de grave yugo, y yo añadiré á vuestro yugo: mi padre os castigó con azotes, y yo con escorpiones.

verses.KJV: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
verses.WEB: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
verses.ASV: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come to me again the third day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio, pois, Jeroboão com todo o povo a Roboão ao terceiro dia: segundo o rei lhes havia mandado dizendo: Voltai a mim daqui a três dias.
verses.RVR09: Vino pues Jeroboam con todo el pueblo á Roboam al tercer día: según el rey les había mandado diciendo: Volved á mí de aquí á tres días.

verses.KJV: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
verses.WEB: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,
verses.ASV: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
verses.ALMEIDA: E respondeu-lhes o rei asperamente; pois deixou o rei Roboão o conselho dos anciãos,
verses.RVR09: Y respondióles el rey ásperamente; pues dejó el rey Roboam el consejo de los viejos,

verses.KJV: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.WEB: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”
verses.ASV: and spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I [will chastise you] with scorpions.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou-lhes conforme ao conselho dos rapazes, dizendo: Meu pai agravou vosso jugo, e eu acrescentarei a vosso jugo: meu pai vos castigou com açoites, e eu com escorpiões.
verses.RVR09: Y hablóles conforme al consejo de los mancebos, diciendo: Mi padre agravó vuestro yugo, y yo añadiré á vuestro yugo: mi padre os castigó con azotes, y yo con escorpiones.

verses.KJV: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the Lord might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.WEB: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.ASV: So the king hearkened not unto the people; for it was brought about of God, that Jehovah might establish his word, which he spake by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não escutou o rei ao povo; porque a causa era de Deus, para cumprir o SENHOR sua palavra que havia falado, por Aías silonita, a Jeroboão filho de Nebate.
verses.RVR09: Y no escuchó el rey al pueblo; porque la causa era de Dios, para cumplir Jehová su palabra que había hablado, por Ahías Silonita, á Jeroboam hijo de Nabat.

verses.KJV: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
verses.WEB: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.
verses.ASV: And when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So all Israel departed unto their tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo todo Israel que o rei não lhes havia ouvido, respondeu o povo ao rei, dizendo: Que parte temos nós com Davi, nem herança no filho de Jessé? Israel, cada um a suas moradas! Davi, olha agora por tua casa! Assim se foi todo Israel a suas casas.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo todo Israel que el rey no les había oído, respondió el pueblo al rey, diciendo: ¿Qué parte tenemos nosotros con David, ni herencia en el hijo de Isaí? ¡Israel, cada uno á sus estancias! ¡David, mira ahora por tu casa! Así se fué todo Israel á sus estancias.

verses.KJV: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.WEB: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.ASV: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas reinou Roboão sobre os filhos de Israel que habitavam nas cidades de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Mas reinó Roboam sobre los hijos de Israel que habitaban en las ciudades de Judá.

verses.KJV: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to taskwork; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. And king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviou logo o rei Roboão a Adorão, que tinha cargo dos tributos; mas lhe apedrejaram os filhos de Israel, e morreu. Então se esforçou o rei Roboão, e subindo em um carro fugiu a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Envió luego el rey Roboam á Adoram, que tenía cargo de los tributos; pero le apedrearon los hijos de Israel, y murió. Entonces se esforzó el rey Roboam, y subiendo en un carro huyó á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.WEB: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
verses.ASV: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se separou Israel da casa de Davi até hoje.
verses.RVR09: Así se apartó Israel de la casa de David hasta hoy.

verses.KJV: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.WEB: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.ASV: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, that were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando veio Roboão a Jerusalém, juntou da casa de Judá e de Benjamim cento e oitenta mil homens escolhidos de guerra, para lutar contra Israel e voltar o reino a Roboão.
verses.RVR09: Y COMO vino Roboam á Jerusalem, juntó la casa de Judá y de Benjamín, ciento y ochenta mil hombres escogidos de guerra, para pelear contra Israel y volver el reino á Roboam.

verses.KJV: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.WEB: But the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.ASV: But the word of Jehovah came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas foi palavra do SENHOR a Semaías homem de Deus, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Mas fué palabra de Jehová á Semeías varón de Dios, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.WEB: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.ASV: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Fala a Roboão filho de Salomão, rei de Judá, e a todos os israelitas em Judá e Benjamim, dizendo-lhes:
verses.RVR09: Habla á Roboam hijo de Salomón, rey de Judá, y á todos los Israelitas en Judá y Benjamín, diciéndoles:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the Lord, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.WEB: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house; for this thing is of me. So they hearkened unto the words of Jehovah, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim disse o SENHOR: Não subais nem luteis contra vossos irmãos; volte-se casa um a sua casa, porque eu fiz este negócio. E eles ouviram a palavra do SENHOR, e voltaram-se, e não foram contra Jeroboão.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: No subáis ni peleéis contra vuestros hermanos; vuélvase cada uno á su casa, porque yo he hecho este negocio. Y ellos oyeron la palabra de Jehová, y tornáronse, y no fueron contra Jeroboam.

verses.KJV: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
verses.WEB: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
verses.ASV: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitou Roboão em Jerusalém, e edificou cidades para fortificar a Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y habitó Roboam en Jerusalem, y edificó ciudades para fortificar á Judá.

verses.KJV: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.WEB: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
verses.ASV: He built Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou a Belém, e a Etã, e a Tecoa,
verses.RVR09: Y edificó á Beth-lehem, y á Etham, y á Tecoa,

verses.KJV: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
verses.WEB: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,
verses.ASV: And Beth-zur, and Soco, and Adullam,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Bete-Zur, e a Socó, e a Adulão,
verses.RVR09: Y á Beth-sur, y á Sochô, y á Adullam,

verses.KJV: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.WEB: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
verses.ASV: and Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Gate, e a Maressa, e a Zife,
verses.RVR09: Y á Gath, y á Maresa, y á Ziph,

verses.KJV: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.WEB: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
verses.ASV: and Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Adoraim, e a Laquis, e a Azeca,
verses.RVR09: Y á Adoraim, y á Lachîs, y á Acechâ,

verses.KJV: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
verses.WEB: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.
verses.ASV: and Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin, fortified cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Zorá, e a Aijalom, e a Hebrom, que eram em Judá e em Benjamim, cidades fortes.
verses.RVR09: Y á Sora, y á Ajalón, y á Hebrón, que eran en Judá y en Benjamín, ciudades fuertes.

verses.KJV: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
verses.WEB: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food, oil and wine.
verses.ASV: And he fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of victuals, and oil and wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fortificou também as fortalezas, e pôs nelas capitães, e alimentos, e vinho, e azeite;
verses.RVR09: Fortificó también las fortalezas, y puso en ellas capitanes, y vituallas, y vino, y aceite;

verses.KJV: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
verses.WEB: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
verses.ASV: And in every city [he put] shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong. And Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em todas as cidades, escudos e lanças. Fortificou-as pois em grande maneira, e Judá e Benjamim lhe estavam sujeitos.
verses.RVR09: Y en todas las ciudades, escudos y lanzas. Fortificólas pues en gran manera, y Judá y Benjamín le estaban sujetos.

verses.KJV: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
verses.WEB: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.
verses.ASV: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their border.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os sacerdotes e levitas que estavam em todo Israel, se juntaram a ele de todos seus termos.
verses.RVR09: Y los sacerdotes y Levitas que estaban en todo Israel, se juntaron á él de todos sus términos.

verses.KJV: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the Lord:
verses.WEB: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to the LORD.
verses.ASV: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office unto Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os levitas deixavam seus campos e suas possessões, e se vinham a Judá e a Jerusalém: pois Jeroboão e seus filhos os lançavam do ministério do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque los Levitas dejaban sus ejidos y sus posesiones, y se venían á Judá y á Jerusalem: pues Jeroboam y sus hijos los echaban del ministerio de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.WEB: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goat and calf idols which he had made.
verses.ASV: and he appointed him priests for the high places, and for the he-goats, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele se fez sacerdotes para os altos, e para os demônios, e para os bezerros que ele havia feito.
verses.RVR09: Y él se hizo sacerdotes para los altos, y para los demonios, y para los becerros que él había hecho.

verses.KJV: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the Lord God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.WEB: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
verses.ASV: And after them, out of all the tribes of Israel, such as set their hearts to seek Jehovah, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice unto Jehovah, the God of their fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além daqueles acudiram também de todas as tribos de Israel os que haviam posto seu coração em buscar ao SENHOR Deus de Israel; e vieram-se a Jerusalém para sacrificar ao SENHOR, o Deus de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Tras aquéllos acudieron también de todas las tribus de Israel los que habían puesto su corazón en buscar á Jehová Dios de Israel; y viniéronse á Jerusalem para sacrificar á Jehová, el Dios de sus padres.

verses.KJV: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.WEB: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.ASV: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years; for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim fortificaram o reino de Judá, e confirmaram a Roboão filho de Salomão, por três anos; porque três anos andaram no caminho de Davi e de Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Así fortificaron el reino de Judá, y confirmaron á Roboam hijo de Salomón, por tres años; porque tres años anduvieron en el camino de David y de Salomón.

verses.KJV: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.WEB: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.
verses.ASV: And Rehoboam took him a wife, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David, [and of] Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou-se Roboão por mulher a Maalate, filha de Jeremote filho de Davi, e a Abiail, filha de Eliabe filho de Jessé.
verses.RVR09: Y tomóse Roboam por mujer á Mahalath, hija de Jerimoth hijo de David, y á Abihail, hija de Eliab hijo de Esaí.

verses.KJV: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
verses.WEB: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
verses.ASV: and she bare him sons: Jeush, and Shemariah, and Zaham.
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual lhe gerou filhos: a Jeus, e a Samaria, e a Zaaão.
verses.RVR09: La cual le parió hijos: á Jeus, y á Samaria, y á Zaham.

verses.KJV: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.WEB: After her, he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.ASV: And after her he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom; and she bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois dela tomou a Maaca filha de Absalão, a qual lhe pariu a Abias, a Atai, Ziza, e Selomite.
verses.RVR09: Después de ella tomó á Maachâ hija de Absalom, la cual le parió á Abías, á Athai, Ziza, y Selomith.

verses.KJV: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
verses.WEB: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
verses.ASV: And Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines, and begat twenty and eight sons and threescore daughters).
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Roboão amou a Maaca filha de Absalão sobre todas suas mulheres e concubinas; porque tomou dezoito mulheres e sessenta concubinas, e gerou vinte e oito filhos e sessenta filhas.
verses.RVR09: Mas Roboam amó á Maachâ hija de Absalom sobre todas sus mujeres y concubinas; porque tomó diez y ocho mujeres y sesenta concubinas, y engendró veintiocho hijos y sesenta hijas.

verses.KJV: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
verses.WEB: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.
verses.ASV: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, [even] the prince among his brethren; for [he was minded] to make him king.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs Roboão a Abias filho de Maaca por cabeça e príncipe de seus irmãos, porque queria fazer-lhe rei.
verses.RVR09: Y puso Roboam á Abías hijo de Maachâ por cabeza y príncipe de sus hermanos, porque quería hacerle rey.

verses.KJV: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
verses.WEB: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance; and he sought many wives for them.
verses.ASV: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fortified city: and he gave them victuals in abundance. And he sought [for them] many wives.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez-lhe instruir, e dispersou todos os seus filhos por todas as terras de Judá e de Benjamim, e por todas as cidades fortes, e deu-lhes alimentos em abundância, e buscou para eles muitas mulheres.
verses.RVR09: E hízole instruir, y esparció todos sus hijos por todas las tierras de Judá y de Benjamín, y por todas las ciudades fuertes, y dióles vituallas en abundancia, y pidió muchas mujeres.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the Lord, and all Israel with him.
verses.WEB: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned the LORD’s law, and all Israel with him.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when the kingdom of Rehoboam was established, and he was strong, that he forsook the law of Jehovah, and all Israel with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando Roboão havia confirmado o reino, deixou a lei do SENHOR, e com ele todo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y COMO Roboam hubo confirmado el reino, dejó la ley de Jehová, y con él todo Israel.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the Lord,
verses.WEB: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against the LORD,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E no quinto ano do rei Roboão subiu Sisaque rei do Egito contra Jerusalém, (porquanto se haviam rebelado contra o SENHOR,)
verses.RVR09: Y en el quinto año del rey Roboam subió Sisac rey de Egipto contra Jerusalem, (por cuanto se habían rebelado contra Jehová,)

verses.KJV: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
verses.WEB: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.
verses.ASV: with twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen. And the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com mil e duzentos carros, e com sessenta mil cavaleiros: mas o povo que vinha com ele do Egito, não tinha número; a saber, de líbios, suquitas, e etíopes.
verses.RVR09: Con mil y doscientos carros, y con sesenta mil hombres de á caballo: mas el pueblo que venía con él de Egipto, no tenía número; á saber, de Libios, Sukienos, y Etiopes.

verses.KJV: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And he took the fortified cities which pertained to Judah, and came unto Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou as cidades fortes de Judá, e chegou até Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó las ciudades fuertes de Judá, y llegó hasta Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the Lord, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
verses.WEB: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “The LORD says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”
verses.ASV: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, Ye have forsaken me, therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio Semaías profeta a Roboão e aos príncipes de Judá, que estavam reunidos em Jerusalém por causa de Sisaque, e disse-lhes: Assim disse o SENHOR: Vós me deixastes, e eu também vos deixei em mãos de Sisaque.
verses.RVR09: Entonces vino Semeías profeta á Roboam y á los príncipes de Judá, que estaban reunidos en Jerusalem por causa de Sisac, y díjoles: Así ha dicho Jehová: Vosotros me habéis dejado, y yo también os he dejado en manos de Sisac.

verses.KJV: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The Lord is righteous.
verses.WEB: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “The LORD is righteous.”
verses.ASV: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, Jehovah is righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os príncipes de Israel e o rei se humilharam, e disseram: Justo é o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes de Israel y el rey se humillaron, y dijeron: Justo es Jehová.

verses.KJV: And when the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.WEB: When the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.ASV: And when Jehovah saw that they humbled themselves, the word of Jehovah came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves: I will not destroy them; but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando viu o SENHOR que se haviam humilhado, foi palavra do SENHOR a Semaías, dizendo: Humilharam-se; não os destruirei; antes os salvarei em breve, e não se derramará minha ira contra Jerusalém por mão de Sisaque.
verses.RVR09: Y como vió Jehová que se habían humillado, fué palabra de Jehová á Semeías, diciendo: Hanse humillado; no los destruiré; antes los salvaré en breve, y no se derramará mi ira contra Jerusalem por mano de Sisac.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”
verses.ASV: Nevertheless they shall be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém serão seus servos; para que saibam que é servir a mim, e servir aos reinos das nações.
verses.RVR09: Empero serán sus siervos; para que sepan qué es servirme á mí, y servir á los reinos de las naciones.

verses.KJV: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.WEB: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.ASV: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king’s house: he took all away: he took away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subiu, pois, Sisaque, rei do Egito a Jerusalém, e tomou os tesouros da casa do SENHOR, e os tesouros da casa do rei; tudo o levou: e tomou os paveses de ouro que Salomão havia feito.
verses.RVR09: Subió pues Sisac rey de Egipto á Jerusalem, y tomó los tesoros de la casa de Jehová, y los tesoros de la casa del rey; todo lo llevó: y tomó los paveses de oro que Salomón había hecho.

verses.KJV: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.
verses.WEB: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
verses.ASV: And king Rehoboam made in their stead shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, that kept the door of the king’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em lugar deles fez o rei Roboão paveses de bronze, e entregou-os em mãos dos chefes da guarda, os quais guardavam a entrada da casa do rei.
verses.RVR09: Y en lugar de ellos hizo el rey Roboam paveses de metal, y entrególos en manos de los jefes de la guardia, los cuales custodiaban la entrada de la casa del rey.

verses.KJV: And when the king entered into the house of the Lord, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
verses.WEB: As often as the king entered into the LORD’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.
verses.ASV: And it was so, that, as oft as the king entered into the house of Jehovah, the guard came and bare them, and brought them back into the guard-chamber.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando o rei ia à casa do SENHOR, vinham os da guarda, e traziam-nos, e depois os voltavam à câmara da guarda.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando el rey iba á la casa de Jehová, venían los de la guardia, y traíanlos, y después los volvían á la cámara de la guardia.

verses.KJV: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the Lord turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.
verses.WEB: When he humbled himself, the LORD’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good things found in Judah.
verses.ASV: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of Jehovah turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether: and moreover in Judah there were good things [found].
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ele se humilhou, a ira do SENHOR se separou dele, para não destruí-lo de todo: e também em Judá as coisas foram bem.
verses.RVR09: Y como él se humilló, la ira de Jehová se apartó de él, para no destruirlo del todo: y también en Judá las cosas fueron bien.

verses.KJV: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.WEB: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
verses.ASV: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Jehovah had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there: and his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fortificou-se, pois Roboão, e reinou em Jerusalém: e era Roboão de quarenta e um anos quando começou a reinar, e dezessete anos reinou em Jerusalém, cidade que escolheu o SENHOR de todas as tribos de Israel, para pôr nela seu nome. E o nome de sua mãe foi Naamá, amonita.
verses.RVR09: Fortificado pues Roboam, reinó en Jerusalem: y era Roboam de cuarenta y un años cuando comenzó á reinar, y diecisiete años reinó en Jerusalem, ciudad que escogió Jehová de todas las tribus de Israel, para poner en ella su nombre. Y el nombre de su madre fué Naama Ammonita.

verses.KJV: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the Lord.
verses.WEB: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek the LORD.
verses.ASV: And he did that which was evil, because he set not his heart to seek Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez o mal, porque não dispôs seu coração para buscar ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: E hizo lo malo, porque no apercibió su corazón para buscar á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.WEB: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.ASV: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, after the manner of genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as coisas de Roboão, primeiras e últimas, não estão escritas nos livros de Semaías profeta e de Ido vidente, no registro das linhagens? E entre Roboão e Jeroboão havia perpétua guerra.
verses.RVR09: Y las cosas de Roboam, primeras y postreras, ¿no están escritas en los libros de Semeías profeta y de Iddo vidente, en la cuenta de los linajes? Y entre Roboam y Jeroboam hubo perpetua guerra.

verses.KJV: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descansou Roboão com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de Davi: e reinou em seu lugar Abias seu filho.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió Roboam con sus padres, y fué sepultado en la ciudad de David: y reinó en su lugar Abías su hijo.

verses.KJV: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
verses.WEB: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.
verses.ASV: In the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos dezoito anos do rei Jeroboão, reinou Abias sobre Judá.
verses.RVR09: A LOS dieciocho años del rey Jeroboam, reinó Abías sobre Judá.

verses.KJV: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.WEB: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.ASV: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reinou três anos em Jerusalém. O nome de sua mãe foi Micaia filha de Uriel de Gibeá. E havia guerra entre Abias e Jeroboão.
verses.RVR09: Y reinó tres años en Jerusalem. El nombre de su madre fué Michâía hija de Uriel de Gabaa. Y hubo guerra entre Abías y Jeroboam.

verses.KJV: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.
verses.WEB: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.
verses.ASV: And Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ordenou Abias batalha com um exército de quatrocentos mil homens de guerra valentes e escolhidos: e Jeroboão ordenou batalha contra ele com oitocentos mil homens escolhidos, fortes e valentes.
verses.RVR09: Entonces ordenó Abías batalla con un ejército de cuatrocientos mil hombres de guerra valerosos y escogidos: y Jeroboam ordenó batalla contra él con ochocientos mil hombres escogidos, fuertes y valerosos.

verses.KJV: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;
verses.WEB: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:
verses.ASV: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, and said, Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantou-se Abias sobre o monte de Zemaraim, que é nos montes de Efraim, e disse: Ouvi-me, Jeroboão e todo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y levantóse Abías sobre el monte de Semaraim, que es en los montes de Ephraim, y dijo: Oidme, Jeroboam y todo Israel.

verses.KJV: Ought ye not to know that the Lord God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.WEB: Ought you not to know that the LORD, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.ASV: Ought ye not to know that Jehovah, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sabeis vós, que o SENHOR Deus de Israel deu o reino a Davi sobre Israel para sempre, a ele e a seus filhos em aliança de sal?
verses.RVR09: ¿No sabéis vosotros, que Jehová Dios de Israel dió el reino á David sobre Israel para siempre, á él y á sus hijos en alianza de sal?

verses.KJV: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
verses.WEB: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.
verses.ASV: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jeroboão filho de Nebate, servo de Salomão filho de Davi, se levantou e rebelou contra seu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Pero Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, siervo de Salomón hijo de David, se levantó y rebeló contra su señor.

verses.KJV: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
verses.WEB: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.
verses.ASV: And there were gathered unto him worthless men, base fellows, that strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender-hearted, and could not withstand them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se achegaram a ele homens vãos, filhos de iniquidade, e puderam mais que Roboão filho de Salomão, porque Roboão era jovem e tenro de coração, e não se defendeu deles.
verses.RVR09: Y se allegaron á él hombres vanos, hijos de iniquidad, y pudieron más que Roboam hijo de Salomón, porque Roboam era mozo y tierno de corazón, y no se defendió de ellos.

verses.KJV: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the Lord in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with your golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.
verses.WEB: “Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.
verses.ASV: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of Jehovah in the hand of the sons of David; and ye are a great multitude, and there are with you the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods.
