verses.ALMEIDA: E agora vós tratais de fortificar-vos contra o reino do SENHOR em mão dos filhos de Davi, porque sois muitos, e tendes convosco os bezerros de ouro que Jeroboão vos fez por deuses.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora vosotros tratáis de fortificaros contra el reino de Jehová en mano de los hijos de David, porque sois muchos, y tenéis con vosotros los becerros de oro que Jeroboam os hizo por dioses.

verses.KJV: Have ye not cast out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.
verses.WEB: Haven’t you driven out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.
verses.ASV: Have ye not driven out the priests of Jehovah, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made you priests after the manner of the peoples of [other] lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of [them that are] no gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não lançastes vós aos sacerdotes do SENHOR, aos filhos de Arão, e aos levitas, e vos haveis feito sacerdotes à maneira dos povos de outras terras, para que qualquer um venha a consagrar-se com um bezerro e sete carneiros, e assim seja sacerdote dos que não são Deuses?
verses.RVR09: ¿No echasteis vosotros á los sacerdotes de Jehová, á los hijos de Aarón, y á los Levitas, y os habéis hecho sacerdotes á la manera de los pueblos de otras tierras, para que cualquiera venga á consagrarse con un becerro y siete carneros, y así sea sacerdote de los que no son dioses?

verses.KJV: But as for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the Lord, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
verses.WEB: “But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.
verses.ASV: But as for us, Jehovah is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and [we have] priests ministering unto Jehovah, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas em quanto a nós, o SENHOR é nosso Deus, e não lhe deixamos: e os sacerdotes que ministram ao SENHOR são os filhos de Arão, e os levitas na obra;
verses.RVR09: Mas en cuanto á nosotros, Jehová es nuestro Dios, y no le hemos dejado: y los sacerdotes que ministran á Jehová son los hijos de Aarón, y los Levitas en la obra;

verses.KJV: And they burn unto the Lord every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the Lord our God; but ye have forsaken him.
verses.WEB: They burn to the LORD every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of the LORD our God, but you have forsaken him.
verses.ASV: and they burn unto Jehovah every morning and every evening burnt-offerings and sweet incense: the showbread also [set they] in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of Jehovah our God; but ye have forsaken him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais queimam ao SENHOR os holocaustos cada manhã e cada tarde, e os perfumes aromáticos; e põem os pães sobre a mesa limpa, e o candelabro de ouro com suas lâmpadas para que ardam cada tarde: porque nós guardamos a ordenança do SENHOR nosso Deus; mas vós o deixastes.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales queman á Jehová los holocaustos cada mañana y cada tarde, y los perfumes aromáticos; y ponen los panes sobre la mesa limpia, y el candelero de oro con sus candilejas para que ardan cada tarde: porque nosotros guardamos la ordenanza de Jehová nuestro Dios; mas vosotros le habéis dejado.

verses.KJV: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the Lord God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
verses.WEB: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”
verses.ASV: And, behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against Jehovah, the God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que Deus está conosco por cabeça, e seus sacerdotes com as trombetas do júbilo para que soem contra vós. Ó filhos de Israel, não luteis contra o SENHOR o Deus de vossos pais, porque não vos sucederá bem.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí Dios está con nosotros por cabeza, y sus sacerdotes con las trompetas del júbilo para que suenen contra vosotros. Oh hijos de Israel, no peleéis contra Jehová el Dios de vuestros padres, porque no os sucederá bien.

verses.KJV: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
verses.WEB: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.
verses.ASV: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jeroboão preparou uma emboscada para vir a eles pela retaguarda: e estando assim diante deles, a emboscada estava à retaguarda de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Pero Jeroboam hizo girar una emboscada para venir á ellos por la espalda: y estando así delante de ellos, la emboscada estaba á espaldas de Judá.

verses.KJV: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the Lord, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
verses.WEB: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
verses.ASV: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried unto Jehovah, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando olhou Judá, eis que tinha batalha diante e às costas; por isso que clamaram ao SENHOR, e os sacerdotes tocaram as trombetas.
verses.RVR09: Y como miró Judá, he aquí que tenía batalla delante y á las espaldas; por lo que clamaron á Jehová, y los sacerdotes tocaron las trompetas.

verses.KJV: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.WEB: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.ASV: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os de Judá levantaram grito; e assim que eles levantaram grito, Deus derrotou a Jeroboão e a todo Israel diante de Abias e de Judá:
verses.RVR09: Entonces los de Judá alzaron grita; y así que ellos alzaron grita, Dios desbarató á Jeroboam y á todo Israel delante de Abías y de Judá:

verses.KJV: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.
verses.WEB: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.
verses.ASV: And the children of Israel fled before Judah; and God delivered them into their hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fugiram os filhos de Israel diante de Judá, e Deus os entregou em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y huyeron los hijos de Israel delante de Judá, y Dios los entregó en sus manos.

verses.KJV: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
verses.WEB: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.
verses.ASV: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abias e sua gente faziam em eles grande mortandade; e caíram feridos de Israel quinhentos mil homens escolhidos.
verses.RVR09: Y Abías y su gente hacían en ellos gran mortandad; y cayeron heridos de Israel quinientos mil hombres escogidos.

verses.KJV: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.WEB: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.
verses.ASV: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon Jehovah, the God of their fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim foram humilhados os filhos de Israel naquele tempo: mas os filhos de Judá se fortificaram, porque se apoiavam no SENHOR o Deus de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Así fueron humillados los hijos de Israel en aquel tiempo: mas los hijos de Judá se fortificaron, porque se apoyaban en Jehová el Dios de sus padres.

verses.KJV: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephraim with the towns thereof.
verses.WEB: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.
verses.ASV: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephron with the towns thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seguiu Abias a Jeroboão, e tomou-lhe algumas cidades, a Betel com suas aldeias, a Jesana com suas aldeias, e a Efraim com suas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Y siguió Abías á Jeroboam, y tomóle algunas ciudades, á Beth-el con sus aldeas, á Jesana con sus aldeas, y á Ephraim con sus aldeas.

verses.KJV: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the Lord struck him, and he died.
verses.WEB: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. The LORD struck him, and he died.
verses.ASV: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and Jehovah smote him, and he died.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nunca mais teve Jeroboão poderio nos dias de Abias: e feriu-lhe o SENHOR, e morreu.
verses.RVR09: Y nunca más tuvo Jeroboam poderío en los días de Abías: é hirióle Jehová, y murió.

verses.KJV: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
verses.WEB: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
verses.ASV: But Abijah waxed mighty, and took unto himself fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se fortificou Abias; e tomou catorze mulheres, e gerou vinte e dois filhos, e dezesseis filhas.
verses.RVR09: Empero se fortificó Abías; y tomó catorce mujeres, y engendró veintidós hijos, y dieciséis hijas.

verses.KJV: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
verses.WEB: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
verses.ASV: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os demais feitos de Abias, seus caminhos e seus negócios, estão escritos na história do profeta Ido.
verses.RVR09: Lo demás de los hechos de Abías, sus caminos y sus negocios, está escrito en la historia de Iddo profeta.

verses.KJV: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
verses.WEB: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days, the land was quiet ten years.
verses.ASV: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David; and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Abias descansou com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de Davi. E reinou em seu lugar seu filho Asa, em cujos dias aquela terra teve paz por dez anos.
verses.RVR09: Y DURMIÓ Abías con sus padres, y fué sepultado en la ciudad de David. Y reinó en su lugar su hijo Asa, en cuyos días tuvo sosiego el país por diez años.

verses.KJV: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God:
verses.WEB: Asa did that which was good and right in the LORD his God’s eyes,
verses.ASV: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of Jehovah his God:
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Asa o que era bom e correto aos olhos do SENHOR seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: E hizo Asa lo bueno y lo recto en los ojos de Jehová su Dios.

verses.KJV: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
verses.WEB: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,
verses.ASV: for he took away the foreign altars, and the high places, and brake down the pillars, and hewed down the Asherim,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tirou os altares do culto alheio, e os altos; quebrou as imagens, e arrancou os bosques;
verses.RVR09: Porque quitó los altares del culto ajeno, y los altos; quebró las imágenes, y taló los bosques;

verses.KJV: And commanded Judah to seek the Lord God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
verses.WEB: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.
verses.ASV: and commanded Judah to seek Jehovah, the God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandou a Judá que buscassem ao SENHOR o Deus de seus pais, e praticassem a lei e seus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Y mandó á Judá que buscasen á Jehová el Dios de sus padres, y pusiesen por obra la ley y sus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
verses.WEB: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.
verses.ASV: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun-images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tirou também de todas as cidades de Judá os altos e as imagens, e esteve o reino quieto diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Quitó asimismo de todas las ciudades de Judá los altos y las imágenes, y estuvo el reino quieto delante de él.

verses.KJV: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the Lord had given him rest.
verses.WEB: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because the LORD had given him rest.
verses.ASV: And he built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Jehovah had given him rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou cidades fortes em Judá, porquanto havia paz na terra, e não havia guerra contra ele em aqueles tempos; porque o SENHOR lhe havia dado repouso.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó ciudades fuertes en Judá, por cuanto había paz en la tierra, y no había guerra contra él en aquellos tiempos; porque Jehová le había dado reposo.

verses.KJV: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the Lord our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
verses.WEB: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.
verses.ASV: For he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars; the land is yet before us, because we have sought Jehovah our God; we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse por tanto a Judá: Edifiquemos estas cidades, e as cerquemos de muros com torres, portas, e barras, já que a terra é nossa: porque buscamos ao SENHOR nosso Deus, temos o buscado, e ele nos deu repouso de todas as partes. Edificaram, pois, e foram prósperos.
verses.RVR09: Dijo por tanto á Judá: Edifiquemos estas ciudades, y cerquémoslas de muros con torres, puertas, y barras, ya que la tierra es nuestra: porque hemos buscado á Jehová nuestro Dios, hémosle buscado, y él nos ha dado reposo de todas partes. Edificaron pues, y fueron prosperados.

verses.KJV: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.
verses.WEB: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.
verses.ASV: And Asa had an army that bare bucklers and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teve também Asa exército que trazia escudos e lanças: de Judá trezentos mil, e de Benjamim duzentos e oitenta mil que traziam escudos e flechavam arcos; todos eram homens hábeis.
verses.RVR09: Tuvo también Asa ejército que traía escudos y lanzas: de Judá trescientos mil, y de Benjamín doscientos y ochenta mil que traían escudos y flechaban arcos; todos hombres diestros.

verses.KJV: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
verses.WEB: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.
verses.ASV: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an army of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and he came unto Mareshah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu contra eles Zerá etíope com um exército de mil milhares, e trezentos carros; e vinho até Maressa.
verses.RVR09: Y salió contra ellos Zera Etiope con un ejército de mil millares, y trescientos carros; y vino hasta Maresa.

verses.KJV: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.WEB: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.ASV: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então saiu Asa contra ele, e ordenaram a batalha no vale de Zefatá junto a Maressa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces salió Asa contra él, y ordenaron la batalla en el valle de Sephata junto á Maresa.

verses.KJV: And Asa cried unto the Lord his God, and said, Lord, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O Lord our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O Lord, thou art our God; let no man prevail against thee.
verses.WEB: Asa cried to the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, LORD our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. LORD, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”
verses.ASV: And Asa cried unto Jehovah his God, and said, Jehovah, there is none besides thee to help, between the mighty and him that hath no strength: help us, O Jehovah our God; for we rely on thee, and in thy name are we come against this multitude. O Jehovah, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E clamou Asa ao SENHOR seu Deus, e disse: SENHOR, ninguém há mais que a ti para dar ajuda entre o grande e o que nenhuma força tem. Ajuda-nos, ó SENHOR Deus nosso, porque em ti nos apoiamos, e em teu nome viemos contra este exército. Ó SENHOR, tu és nosso Deus; não prevaleça contra ti o homem.
verses.RVR09: Y clamó Asa á Jehová su Dios, y dijo: Jehová, no tienes tú más con el grande que con el que ninguna fuerza tiene, para dar ayuda. Ayúdanos, oh Jehová Dios nuestro, porque en ti nos apoyamos, y en tu nombre venimos contra este ejército. Oh Jehová, tú eres nuestro Dios: no prevalezca contra ti el hombre.

verses.KJV: So the Lord smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.WEB: So the LORD struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.ASV: So Jehovah smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR derrotou os etíopes diante de Asa e diante de Judá; e fugiram os etíopes.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová deshizo los Etiopes delante de Asa y delante de Judá; y huyeron los Etiopes.

verses.KJV: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the Lord, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
verses.WEB: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before the LORD and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.
verses.ASV: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and there fell of the Ethiopians so many that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before Jehovah, and before his host; and they carried away very much booty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Asa, e o povo que com ele estava, o seguiu até Gerar: e caíram os etíopes até não haver neles resistência alguma; porque foram derrotados diante do SENHOR e de seu exército. E lhes tomaram muito grande despojo.
verses.RVR09: Y Asa, y el pueblo que con él estaba, lo siguió hasta Gerar: y cayeron los Etiopes hasta no quedar en ellos aliento; porque fueron deshechos delante de Jehová y de su ejército. Y les tomaron muy grande despojo.

verses.KJV: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the Lord came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
verses.WEB: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the LORD came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.
verses.ASV: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of Jehovah came upon them: and they despoiled all the cities; for there was much spoil in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bateram também todas as cidades ao redor de Gerar, porque o terror do SENHOR foi sobre eles: e saquearam todas as cidades, porque havia nelas grande despojo.
verses.RVR09: Batieron también todas las ciudades alrededor de Gerar, porque el terror de Jehová fué sobre ellos: y saquearon todas las ciudades, porque había en ellas gran despojo.

verses.KJV: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: They also struck the tents of those who had livestock, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, then returned to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep in abundance, and camels, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim atacaram as cabanas onde havia gado, e trouxeram muitas ovelhas e camelos, e voltaram a Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo dieron sobre las cabañas de los ganados, y trajeron muchas ovejas y camellos, y volviéronse á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
verses.WEB: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.
verses.ASV: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o espírito de Deus sobre Azarias filho de Obede;
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ el espíritu de Dios sobre Azarías hijo de Obed;

verses.KJV: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The Lord is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.WEB: He went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! The LORD is with you while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.ASV: and he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: Jehovah is with you, while ye are with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu ao encontro a Asa, e disse-lhe: Ouvi-me, Asa, e todo Judá e Benjamim: o SENHOR é convosco, se vós fordes com ele: e se lhe buscardes, será achado de vós; mas se lhe deixardes, ele também vos deixará.
verses.RVR09: Y salió al encuentro á Asa, y díjole: Oidme, Asa, y todo Judá y Benjamín: Jehová es con vosotros, si vosotros fuereis con él: y si le buscareis, será hallado de vosotros; mas si le dejareis, él también os dejará.

verses.KJV: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.WEB: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.ASV: Now for a long season Israel was without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law:
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos dias esteve Israel sem verdadeiro Deus e sem sacerdote, e sem ensinador e sem lei:
verses.RVR09: Muchos días ha estado Israel sin verdadero Dios y sin sacerdote, y sin enseñador y sin ley:

verses.KJV: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the Lord God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
verses.WEB: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.
verses.ASV: but when in their distress they turned unto Jehovah, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando em sua tribulação se converteram ao SENHOR Deus de Israel, e lhe buscaram, ele foi achado deles.
verses.RVR09: Mas cuando en su tribulación se convirtieron á Jehová Dios de Israel, y le buscaron, él fué hallado de ellos.

verses.KJV: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
verses.WEB: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.
verses.ASV: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in; but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the lands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em aqueles tempos não havia paz, nem para o que entrava, nem para o que saía, mas sim muitas aflições sobre todos os habitantes das terras.
verses.RVR09: En aquellos tiempos no hubo paz, ni para el que entraba, ni para el que salía, sino muchas aflicciones sobre todos los habitadores de las tierras.

verses.KJV: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
verses.WEB: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.
verses.ASV: And they were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God did vex them with all adversity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a uma gente destruía à outra, e uma cidade a outra cidade: porque Deus os conturbou com todas as calamidades.
verses.RVR09: Y la una gente destruía á la otra, y una ciudad á otra ciudad: porque Dios los conturbó con todas calamidades.

verses.KJV: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.WEB: But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”
verses.ASV: But be ye strong, and let not your hands be slack; for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esforçai-vos, porém, vós, e não desfaleçam vossas mãos; que recompensa há para vossa obra.
verses.RVR09: Esforzaos empero vosotros, y no desfallezcan vuestras manos; que salario hay para vuestra obra.

verses.KJV: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the Lord, that was before the porch of the Lord.
verses.WEB: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed the LORD’s altar that was before the LORD’s porch.
verses.ASV: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill-country of Ephraim; and he renewed the altar of Jehovah, that was before the porch of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ouviu Asa as palavras e profecia de Obede profeta, foi confortado, e tirou as abominações de toda a terra de Judá e de Benjamim, e das cidades que ele havia tomado no monte de Efraim; e reparou o altar do SENHOR que estava diante do pórtico do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y como oyó Asa las palabras y profecía de Obed profeta, fué confortado, y quitó las abominaciones de toda la tierra de Judá y de Benjamín, y de las ciudades que él había tomado en el monte de Ephraim; y reparó el altar de Jehová que estaba delante del pórtico de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
verses.WEB: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
verses.ASV: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and them that sojourned with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that Jehovah his God was with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois fez juntar a todo Judá e Benjamim, e com eles os estrangeiros de Efraim, e de Manassés, e de Simeão: porque muitos de Israel se haviam passado a ele, vendo que o SENHOR seu Deus era com ele.
verses.RVR09: Después hizo juntar á todo Judá y Benjamín, y con ellos los extranjeros de Ephraim, y de Manasés, y de Simeón: porque muchos de Israel se habían pasado á él, viendo que Jehová su Dios era con él.

verses.KJV: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.WEB: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.ASV: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.ALMEIDA: Juntaram-se, pois, em Jerusalém no mês terceiro do ano décimo quinto do reinado de Asa.
verses.RVR09: Juntáronse pues en Jerusalem en el mes tercero del año décimoquinto del reinado de Asa.

verses.KJV: And they offered unto the Lord the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.WEB: They sacrificed to the LORD in that day, from the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.
verses.ASV: And they sacrificed unto Jehovah in that day, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele mesmo dia sacrificaram ao SENHOR, dos despojos que haviam trazido, setecentos bois e sete mil ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y en aquel mismo día sacrificaron á Jehová, de los despojos que habían traído, setecientos bueyes y siete mil ovejas.

verses.KJV: And they entered into a covenant to seek the Lord God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.WEB: They entered into the covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.ASV: And they entered into the covenant to seek Jehovah, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.ALMEIDA: E entraram em concerto de que buscariam ao SENHOR o Deus de seus pais, de todo seu coração e de toda sua alma;
verses.RVR09: Y entraron en concierto de que buscarían á Jehová el Dios de sus padres, de todo su corazón y de toda su alma;

verses.KJV: That whosoever would not seek the Lord God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.WEB: and that whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.ASV: and that whosoever would not seek Jehovah, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que qualquer um que não buscasse ao SENHOR o Deus de Israel, morresse, grande ou pequeno, homem ou mulher.
verses.RVR09: Y que cualquiera que no buscase á Jehová el Dios de Israel, muriese, grande ó pequeño, hombre ó mujer.

verses.KJV: And they sware unto the Lord with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.WEB: They swore to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.ASV: And they sware unto Jehovah with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juraram ao SENHOR com grande voz e júbilo, a som de trombetas e de buzinas:
verses.RVR09: Y juraron á Jehová con gran voz y júbilo, á son de trompetas y de bocinas:

verses.KJV: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the Lord gave them rest round about.
verses.WEB: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then the LORD gave them rest all around.
verses.ASV: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath; for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and Jehovah gave them rest round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do qual juramento todos os de Judá se alegraram; porque de todo o seu coração o juravam, e de toda sua vontade o buscavam: e foi achado deles; e deu-lhes o SENHOR repouso de todas partes.
verses.RVR09: Del cual juramento todos los de Judá se alegraron; porque de todo su corazón lo juraban, y de toda su voluntad lo buscaban: y fué hallado de ellos; y dióles Jehová reposo de todas partes.

verses.KJV: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.WEB: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.
verses.ASV: And also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; and Asa cut down her image, and made dust of it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda a Maaca mãe do rei Asa, ele mesmo a depôs de sua dignidade, porque havia feito um ídolo no bosque: e Asa destruiu seu ídolo, e o despedaçou, e queimou no ribeiro de Cedrom.
verses.RVR09: Y aun á Maachâ madre del rey Asa, él mismo la depuso de su dignidad, porque había hecho un ídolo en el bosque: y Asa deshizo su ídolo, y lo desmenuzó, y quemó en el torrente de Cedrón.

verses.KJV: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.WEB: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.ASV: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas com tudo isso os altos não foram tirados de Israel, ainda que o coração de Asa tenha sido íntegro enquanto viveu.
verses.RVR09: Mas con todo eso los altos no eran quitados de Israel, aunque el corazón de Asa fué perfecto mientras vivió.

verses.KJV: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.WEB: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.
verses.ASV: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meteu na casa de Deus o que seu pai havia dedicado, e o que ele havia consagrado, prata e ouro e vasos.
verses.RVR09: Y metió en la casa de Dios lo que su padre había dedicado, y lo que él había consagrado, plata y oro y vasos.

verses.KJV: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.WEB: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.ASV: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não havia guerra até os trinta e cinco anos do reinado de Asa.
verses.RVR09: Y no hubo guerra hasta los treinta y cinco años del reinado de Asa.

verses.KJV: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.WEB: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.ASV: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano trinta e seis do reinado de Asa, subiu Baasa rei de Israel contra Judá, e edificou a Ramá, para não deixar sair nem entrar a ninguém ao rei Asa, rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: EN el año treinta y seis del reinado de Asa, subió Baasa rey de Israel contra Judá, y edificó á Rama, para no dejar salir ni entrar á ninguno al rey Asa, rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the Lord and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.WEB: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the LORD’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
verses.ASV: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of Jehovah and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tirou Asa a prata e o ouro dos tesouros da casa do SENHOR e da casa real, e enviou a Ben-Hadade rei da Síria, que estava em Damasco, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces sacó Asa la plata y el oro de los tesoros de la casa de Jehová y de la casa real, y envió á Ben-adad rey de Siria, que estaba en Damasco, diciendo:

verses.KJV: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.WEB: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
verses.ASV: [There is] a league between me and thee, as [there was] between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haja aliança entre mim e ti, como a havia entre meu pai e teu pai; eis que eu te enviei prata e ouro, para que venhas e desfaças a aliança que tens com Baasa rei de Israel, a fim de que se retire de mim.
verses.RVR09: Haya alianza entre mí y ti, como la hubo entre mi padre y tu padre; he aquí yo te he enviado plata y oro, para que vengas y deshagas la alianza que tienes con Baasa rey de Israel, á fin de que se retire de mí.

verses.KJV: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
verses.WEB: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.
verses.ASV: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store-cities of Naphtali.
verses.ALMEIDA: E consentiu Ben-Hadade com o rei Asa, e enviou os capitães de seus exércitos à cidades de Israel: e atacaram a Ijom, Dã, e Abel-Maim, e as cidades fortes de Naftali.
verses.RVR09: Y consintió Ben-adad con el rey Asa, y envió los capitanes de sus ejércitos á la ciudades de Israel: y batieron á Ion, Dan, y Abel-maim, y las ciudades fuertes de Nephtalí.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
verses.WEB: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building Ramah, and let his work cease.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvindo isto Baasa, cessou de edificar a Ramá, e deixou sua obra.
verses.RVR09: Y oyendo esto Baasa, cesó de edificar á Rama, y dejó su obra.

verses.KJV: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
verses.WEB: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.
verses.ASV: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei Asa tomou a todo Judá, e levaram-se de Ramá a pedra e madeira com que Baasa edificava, e com ela edificou a Geba e Mispá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey Asa tomó á todo Judá, y lleváronse de Rama la piedra y madera con que Baasa edificaba, y con ella edificó á Gibaa y Mizpa.

verses.KJV: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the Lord thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.
verses.WEB: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the LORD your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.
verses.ASV: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and hast not relied on Jehovah thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo veio Hanani vidente a Asa rei de Judá, e disse-lhe: Por quanto te apoiaste no rei de Síria, e não te apoiaste no SENHOR teu Deus, por isso o exército do rei da Síria escapou de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo vino Hanani vidente á Asa rey de Judá, y díjole: Por cuanto te has apoyado en el rey de Siria, y no te apoyaste en Jehová tu Dios, por eso el ejército del rey de Siria ha escapado de tus manos.

verses.KJV: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the Lord, he delivered them into thine hand.
verses.WEB: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on the LORD, he delivered them into your hand.
verses.ASV: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge host, with chariots and horsemen exceeding many? yet, because thou didst rely on Jehovah, he delivered them into thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os etíopes e os líbios, não eram um exército numerosíssimo, com carros e muitos cavaleiros? Contudo, porque te apoiaste no SENHOR, ele os entregou em tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Los Etiopes y los Libios, ¿no eran un ejército numerosísimo, con carros y muy mucha gente de á caballo? con todo, porque te apoyaste en Jehová, él los entregó en tus manos.

verses.KJV: For the eyes of the Lord run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
verses.WEB: For the LORD’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”
verses.ASV: For the eyes of Jehovah run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly; for from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os olhos do SENHOR contemplam toda a terra, para corroborar aos que têm coração íntegro com ele. Loucamente fizeste nisso; porque de agora em diante haverá guerra contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Porque los ojos de Jehová contemplan toda la tierra, para corroborar á los que tienen corazón perfecto para con él. Locamente has hecho en esto; porque de aquí adelante habrá guerra contra ti.

verses.KJV: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
verses.WEB: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.
verses.ASV: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in the prison-house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.
verses.ALMEIDA: E irou-se Asa contra o vidente, lançou-o na casa do cárcere, porque foi em extremo incomodado por causa disto. E oprimiu Asa naquele tempo alguns do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y enojado Asa contra el vidente, echólo en la casa de la cárcel, porque fué en extremo conmovido á causa de esto. Y oprimió Asa en aquel tiempo algunos del pueblo.

verses.KJV: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.WEB: Behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.ASV: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eis que, os feitos de Asa, primeiros e últimos, estão escritos no livro dos reis de Judá e de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Mas he aquí, los hechos de Asa, primeros y postreros, están escritos en el libro de los reyes de Judá y de Israel.

verses.KJV: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the Lord, but to the physicians.
verses.WEB: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa was diseased in his feet. His disease was exceedingly great; yet in his disease he didn’t seek the LORD, but just the physicians.
verses.ASV: And in the thirty and ninth year of his reign Asa was diseased in his feet; his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to Jehovah, but to the physicians.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o ano trinta e nove de seu reinado enfermou Asa dos pés para acima, e em sua enfermidade não buscou ao SENHOR, mas sim aos médicos.
verses.RVR09: Y el año treinta y nueve de su reinado enfermó Asa de los pies para arriba, y en su enfermedad no buscó á Jehová, sino á los médicos.

verses.KJV: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
verses.WEB: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.
verses.ASV: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
verses.ALMEIDA: E descansou Asa com seus pais, e morreu no ano quarenta e um de seu reinado.
verses.RVR09: Y durmió Asa con sus padres, y murió en el año cuarenta y uno de su reinado.

verses.KJV: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.
verses.WEB: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.
verses.ASV: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had hewn out for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and divers kinds [of spices] prepared by the perfumers’ art: and they made a very great burning for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sepultaram-no em seus sepulcros que ele havia feito para si na cidade de Davi; e puseram-no em uma cama, a qual encheram de aromas e artefatos com fragrâncias, preparadas por perfumistas; e fizeram uma grande fogueira em sua homenagem.
verses.RVR09: Y sepultáronlo en sus sepulcros que él había hecho para sí en la ciudad de David; Y pusiéronlo en una litera, la cual hinchieron de aromas y diversas materias odoríferas, preparadas por obra de perfumadores; é hiciéronle una quema muy grande.

verses.KJV: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.WEB: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.ASV: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reinou em seu lugar Josafá seu filho, o qual prevaleceu contra Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y REINÓ en su lugar Josaphat su hijo, el cual prevaleció contra Israel.

verses.KJV: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.WEB: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.ASV: And he placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs exército em todas as cidades fortes de Judá, e colocou gente de guarnição, em terra de Judá, e também nas cidades de Efraim que seu pai Asa havia tomado.
verses.RVR09: Y puso ejército en todas las ciudades fuertes de Judá, y colocó gente de guarnición, en tierra de Judá, y asimismo en las ciudades de Ephraim que su padre Asa había tomado.

verses.KJV: And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;
verses.WEB: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto the Baalim,
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi o SENHOR com Josafá, porque andou nos primeiros caminhos de Davi seu pai, e não buscou aos baalins;
verses.RVR09: Y fué Jehová con Josaphat, porque anduvo en los primeros caminos de David su padre, y no buscó á los Baales;

verses.KJV: But sought to the Lord God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
verses.WEB: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.
verses.ASV: but sought to the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: mas buscou o Deus de seu pai, e andou em seus mandamentos, e não segundo as obras de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Sino que buscó al Dios de su padre, y anduvo en sus mandamientos, y no según las obras de Israel.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.
verses.ASV: Therefore Jehovah established the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat tribute; and he had riches and honor in abundance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o SENHOR confirmou o reino em sua mão, e todo Judá deu presentes a Josafá; e teve riquezas e glória em abundância.
verses.RVR09: Jehová por tanto confirmó el reino en su mano, y todo Judá dió á Josaphat presentes; y tuvo riquezas y gloria en abundancia.

verses.KJV: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
verses.WEB: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.
verses.ASV: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of Jehovah: and furthermore he took away the high places and the Asherim out of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E animou-se seu coração nos caminhos do SENHOR, e tirou os altos e os bosques de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y animóse su corazón en los caminos de Jehová, y quitó los altos y los bosques de Judá.

verses.KJV: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
verses.WEB: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
verses.ASV: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben-hail, and Obadiah, and Zechariah, and Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao terceiro ano de seu reinado enviou seus príncipes Bene-Hail, Obadias, Zacarias, Natanael e Micaías, para que ensinassem nas cidades de Judá;
verses.RVR09: Al tercer año de su reinado envió sus príncipes Ben-hail, Obdías, Zachârías, Nathaniel y Michêas, para que enseñasen en las ciudades de Judá;

verses.KJV: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
verses.WEB: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
verses.ASV: and with them the Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com eles aos levitas, Semaías, Netanias, Zebadias, e Asael, e Semiramote, e Jônatas, e Adonias, e Tobias, e Tobadonias, levitas; e com eles a Elisama e a Jorão, sacerdotes.
verses.RVR09: Y con ellos á los Levitas, Semeías, Nethanías, Zebadías, y Asael, y Semiramoth, y Jonathán, y Adonías, y Tobías, y Tobadonías, Levitas; y con ellos á Elisama y á Joram, sacerdotes.

verses.KJV: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the Lord with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
verses.WEB: They taught in Judah, having the book of the LORD’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.
verses.ASV: And they taught in Judah, having the book of the law of Jehovah with them; and they went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught among the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ensinaram em Judá, tendo consigo o livro da lei do SENHOR, e rodearam por todas as cidades de Judá ensinando ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Y enseñaron en Judá, teniendo consigo el libro de la ley de Jehová, y rodearon por todas las ciudades de Judá enseñando al pueblo.

verses.KJV: And the fear of the Lord fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.ASV: And the fear of Jehovah fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E caiu o pavor do SENHOR sobre todos os reinos das terras que estavam ao redor de Judá; que não ousaram fazer guerra contra Josafá.
verses.RVR09: Y cayó el pavor de Jehová sobre todos los reinos de las tierras que estaban alrededor de Judá; que no osaron hacer guerra contra Josaphat.

verses.KJV: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
verses.WEB: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.
verses.ASV: And some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and silver for tribute; the Arabians also brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he-goats.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos filisteus traziam presentes a Josafá, e tributos de prata. Os árabes também lhe trouxeram gado: sete mil e setecentos carneiros e sete mil e setecentos bodes.
verses.RVR09: Y traían de los Filisteos presentes á Josaphat, y tributos de plata. Los Arabes también le trajeron ganados, siete mil y setecientos carneros y siete mil y setecientos machos de cabrío.

verses.KJV: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
verses.WEB: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.
verses.ASV: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles and cities of store.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ia pois Josafá crescendo altamente: e edificou em Judá fortalezas e cidades de depósitos.
verses.RVR09: Iba pues Josaphat creciendo altamente: y edificó en Judá fortalezas y ciudades de depósitos.

verses.KJV: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And he had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teve ademais muitas obras nas cidades de Judá, e homens de guerra muito valentes em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Tuvo además muchas obras en las ciudades de Judá, y hombres de guerra muy valientes en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
verses.WEB: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;
verses.ASV: And this was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: Of Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him mighty men of valor three hundred thousand;
verses.ALMEIDA: E este é o número deles segundo as casas de seus pais: em Judá, chefes dos milhares: o general Adna, e com ele trezentos mil homens muito esforçados;
verses.RVR09: Y este es el número de ellos según las casas de sus padres: en Judá, jefes de los millares: el general Adna, y con él trescientos mil hombres muy esforzados;

verses.KJV: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
verses.WEB: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;
verses.ASV: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois dele, o chefe Joanã, e com ele duzentos e oitenta mil;
verses.RVR09: Después de él, el jefe Johanán, y con él doscientos y ochenta mil;

verses.KJV: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the Lord; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
verses.WEB: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
verses.ASV: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto Jehovah; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois este, Amasias filho de Zicri, o qual se havia oferecido voluntariamente ao SENHOR, e com ele duzentos mil homens valentes;
verses.RVR09: Tras éste, Amasías hijo de Zichri, el cual se había ofrecido voluntariamente á Jehová, y con él doscientos mil hombres valientes;

verses.KJV: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
verses.WEB: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;
verses.ASV: And of Benjamin: Eliada a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;
verses.ALMEIDA: De Benjamim, Eliada, homem muito valente, e com ele duzentos mil armados de arco e escudo;
verses.RVR09: De Benjamín, Eliada, hombre muy valeroso, y con él doscientos mil armados de arco y escudo;

verses.KJV: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
verses.WEB: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.
verses.ASV: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him a hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois este, Jozabade, e com ele cento e oitenta mil preparados para a guerra.
verses.RVR09: Tras éste, Jozabad, y con él ciento y ochenta mil apercibidos para la guerra.

verses.KJV: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
verses.WEB: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
verses.ASV: These were they that waited on the king, besides those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes eram servos do rei, sem os que havia o rei posto nas cidades de guarnição por toda Judá.
verses.RVR09: Estos eran siervos del rey, sin los que había el rey puesto en las ciudades de guarnición por toda Judea.

verses.KJV: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
verses.WEB: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab.
verses.ASV: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he joined affinity with Ahab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tinha, pois, Josafá riquezas e glória em abundância, e estabeleceu parentesco com Acabe.
verses.RVR09: TENÍA pues Josaphat riquezas y gloria en abundancia, y trabó parentesco con Achâb.

verses.KJV: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramothgilead.
verses.WEB: After some years, he went down to Ahab to Samaria. Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance, and for the people who were with him, and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead.
verses.ASV: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that were with him, and moved him to go up [with him] to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois de alguns anos desceu a Acabe a Samaria; por o que matou Acabe muitas ovelhas e bois para ele, e para a gente que com ele vinha: e persuadiu-lhe que fosse com ele a Ramote de Gileade.
verses.RVR09: Y después de algunos años descendió á Achâb á Samaria; por lo que mató Achâb muchas ovejas y bueyes para él, y para la gente que con él venía: y persuadióle que fuese con él á Ramoth de Galaad.

verses.KJV: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.
verses.WEB: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”
verses.ASV: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and [we will be] with thee in the war.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Acabe rei de Israel a Josafá rei de Judá: Queres vir comigo a Ramote de Gileade? E ele respondeu: Como eu, assim também tu; e como teu povo, assim também meu povo: iremos contigo à guerra.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Achâb rey de Israel á Josaphat rey de Judá: ¿Quieres venir conmigo á Ramoth de Galaad? Y él respondió: Como yo, así también tú; y como tu pueblo, así también mi pueblo: iremos contigo á la guerra.

verses.KJV: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the Lord to day.
verses.WEB: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”
verses.ASV: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Inquire first, I pray thee, for the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ademais disse Josafá ao rei de Israel: Rogo-te que consultes hoje a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Además dijo Josaphat al rey de Israel: Ruégote que consultes hoy la palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.
verses.WEB: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
verses.ASV: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei de Israel juntou quatrocentos profetas, e disse-lhes: Iremos à guerra contra Ramote de Gileade, ou ficarei eu quieto? E eles disseram: Sobe, que Deus os entregará em mão do rei.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey de Israel juntó cuatrocientos profetas, y díjoles: ¿Iremos á la guerra contra Ramoth de Galaad, ó estaréme yo quieto? Y ellos dijeron: Sube, que Dios los entregará en mano del rey.

verses.KJV: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.WEB: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we may inquire of him?”
verses.ASV: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Jehovah besides, that we may inquire of him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Josafá disse: Há ainda aqui algum profeta do SENHOR, para que por ele perguntemos?
verses.RVR09: Mas Josaphat dijo: ¿Hay aún aquí algún profeta de Jehová, para que por él preguntemos?

verses.KJV: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the Lord: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.WEB: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”
verses.ASV: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Jehovah: but I hate him; for he never prophesieth good concerning me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei de Israel respondeu a Josafá: Ainda há aqui um homem pelo qual podemos preguntar ao SENHOR: mas eu lhe aborreço, porque nunca me profetiza coisa boa, a não ser sempre mal. Este é Micaías, filho de Inlá. E respondeu Josafá: Não fale assim o rei.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey de Israel respondió á Josaphat: Aun hay aquí un hombre por el cual podemos preguntar á Jehová: mas yo le aborrezco, porque nunca me profetiza cosa buena, sino siempre mal. Este es Michêas, hijo de Imla. Y respondió Josaphat: No hable así el rey.

verses.KJV: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
verses.WEB: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”
verses.ASV: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei de Israel chamou um eunuco, e disse-lhe: Faze vir logo a Micaías filho de Inlá.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el rey de Israel llamó un eunuco, y díjole: Haz venir luego á Michêas hijo de Imla.

verses.KJV: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.WEB: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
verses.ASV: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei de Israel e Josafá rei de Judá, estavam sentados cada um em seu trono, vestidos de suas roupas; e estavam sentados na eira à entrada da porta de Samaria, e todos os profetas profetizavam diante deles.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey de Israel y Josaphat rey de Judá, estaban sentados cada uno en su trono, vestidos de sus ropas; y estaban sentados en la era á la entrada de la puerta de Samaria, y todos los profetas profetizaban delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the Lord, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
verses.WEB: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”
verses.ASV: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron and said, Thus saith Jehovah, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until they be consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zedequias filho de Quenaaná se havia feito chifres de ferro, e dizia: Assim disse o SENHOR: Com estes chifrarás aos sírios até destruí-los de todo.
verses.RVR09: Y Sedechîas hijo de Chênaana se había hecho cuernos de hierro, y decía: Así ha dicho Jehová: Con estos acornearás á los Siros hasta destruirlos del todo.

verses.KJV: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.WEB: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
verses.ASV: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper; for Jehovah will deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.ALMEIDA: De esta maneira profetizavam também todos os profetas, dizendo: Sobe a Ramote de Gileade, e sei próspero; porque o SENHOR a entregará em mão do rei.
verses.RVR09: De esta manera profetizaban también todos los profetas, diciendo: Sube á Ramoth de Galaad, y sé prosperado; porque Jehová la entregará en mano del rey.

verses.KJV: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of their's, and speak thou good.
verses.WEB: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”
verses.ASV: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets [declare] good to the king with one mouth: let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o mensageiro que havia ido a chamar a Micaías, lhe falou, dizendo: Eis aqui as palavras dos profetas a uma boca anunciam ao rei bens; eu, pois, te rogo que tua palavra seja como a de um deles, que fales bem.
verses.RVR09: Y el mensajero que había ido á llamar á Michêas, le habló, diciendo: He aquí las palabras de los profetas á una boca anuncian al rey bienes; yo pues te ruego que tu palabra sea como la de uno de ellos, que hables bien.

verses.KJV: And Micaiah said, As the Lord liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.
verses.WEB: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, I will say what my God says.”
verses.ASV: And Micaiah said, As Jehovah liveth, what my God saith, that will I speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse Micaías: Vive o SENHOR, que o que meu Deus me disser, isso falarei. E veio ao rei.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Michêas: Vive Jehová, que lo que mi Dios me dijere, eso hablaré. Y vino al rey.

verses.KJV: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
verses.WEB: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”
verses.ASV: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper; and they shall be delivered into your hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei lhe disse: Micaías, iremos a lutar contra Ramote de Gileade, ou ficarei eu quieto? E ele respondeu: Subi, que sereis prosperados, que serão entregues em vossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey le dijo: Michêas, ¿iremos á pelear contra Ramoth de Galaad, ó estaréme yo quieto? Y él respondió: Subid, que seréis prosperados, que serán entregados en vuestras manos.

verses.KJV: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the Lord?
verses.WEB: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”
verses.ASV: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou speak unto me nothing but the truth in the name of Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei lhe disse: Até quantas vezes te conjurarei pelo nome do SENHOR que não me fales a não ser a verdade?
verses.RVR09: Y el rey le dijo: ¿Hasta cuántas veces te conjuraré por el nombre de Jehová que no me hables sino la verdad?

verses.KJV: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the Lord said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
verses.WEB: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”
verses.ASV: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and Jehovah said, These have no master; let them return every man to his house in peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele disse: Eis visto a todo Israel derramado pelos montes como ovelhas sem pastor: e disse o SENHOR: Estes não têm senhor; volte-se cada um em paz em sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él dijo: He visto á todo Israel derramado por los montes como ovejas sin pastor: y dijo Jehová: Estos no tienen señor; vuélvase cada uno en paz á su casa.

verses.KJV: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
verses.WEB: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”
verses.ASV: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei de Israel disse a Josafá: Não te havia eu dito que não me profetizaria bem, mas sim mal?
verses.RVR09: Y el rey de Israel dijo á Josaphat: ¿No te había yo dicho que no me profetizaría bien, sino mal?

verses.KJV: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the Lord; I saw the Lord sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.WEB: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.ASV: And [Micaiah] said, Therefore hear ye the word of Jehovah: I saw Jehovah sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele disse: Ouvi, pois, a palavra do SENHOR: Eu vi ao SENHOR sentado em seu trono, e todo o exército dos céus estava a sua mão direita e a sua esquerda.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él dijo: Oid pues palabra de Jehová: Yo he visto á Jehová sentado en su trono, y todo el ejército de los cielos estaba á su mano derecha y á su izquierda.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
