verses.KJV: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;
verses.WEB: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—everyone who had knowledge and understanding—
verses.ASV: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinim, and all they that had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one that had knowledge, and understanding;
verses.ALMEIDA: E o resto do povo, os sacerdotes, os levitas, os porteiros, os cantores, os servos do templo, e todos os que se haviam se separado dos povos das terras para a lei de Deus, suas mulheres, seus filhos e suas filhas, e todo o que tinha compreensão [e] entendimento,
verses.RVR09: Y el resto del pueblo, los sacerdotes, Levitas, porteros, y cantores, Nethineos, y todos los que se habían apartado de los pueblos de las tierras á la ley de Dios, sus mujeres, sus hijos y sus hijas, y todo el que tenía comprensión y discernimiento,

verses.KJV: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;
verses.WEB: joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;
verses.ASV: they clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of Jehovah our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;
verses.ALMEIDA: Firmemente se juntaram a seus irmãos, os mais nobres dentre eles, e se comprometeram em um juramento sujeito a maldição, que andariam na lei de Deus, que foi dada por meio de Moisés, servo de Deus, e que guardariam e cumpririam todos os mandamentos do SENHOR nosso Senhor, e seus juízos e seus estatutos;
verses.RVR09: Adhiriéronse á sus hermanos, sus principales, y vinieron en la protestación y en el juramento de que andarían en la ley de Dios, que fué dada por mano de Moisés siervo de Dios, y que guardarían y cumplirían todos los mandamientos de Jehová nuestro Señor, y sus juicios y sus estatutos;

verses.KJV: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, not take their daughters for our sons:
verses.WEB: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;
verses.ASV: and that we would not give our daughters unto the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;
verses.ALMEIDA: E que não daríamos nossas filhas aos povos da região, nem tomaríamos suas filhas para nossos filhos.
verses.RVR09: Y que no daríamos nuestras hijas á los pueblos de la tierra, ni tomaríamos sus hijas para nuestros hijos.

verses.KJV: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
verses.WEB: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year crops and the exaction of every debt.
verses.ASV: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy of them on the sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que, se os povos da região trouxessem para vender mercadorias e comida no dia de sábado, nada tomaríamos deles no sábado, nem em dia santo; e deixaríamos livre o sétimo ano, inclusive toda e qualquer cobrança.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo, que si los pueblos de la tierra trajesen á vender mercaderías y comestibles en día de sábado, nada tomaríamos de ellos en sábado, ni en día santificado; y que dejaríamos el año séptimo, con remisión de toda deuda.

verses.KJV: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;
verses.WEB: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:
verses.ASV: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também pusemos preceitos sobre nós, impondo-nos a cada ano [dar] a terça parte de um siclo, para a obra da casa de nosso Deus;
verses.RVR09: Impusímonos además por ley el cargo de contribuir cada año con la tercera parte de un siclo, para la obra de la casa de nuestro Dios;

verses.KJV: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
verses.WEB: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
verses.ASV: for the showbread, and for the continual meal-offering, and for the continual burnt-offering, for the sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin-offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para os pães da proposição, para a oferta contínua de alimentos, e para o holocausto contínuo, dos sábados, das novas luas, e das festas solenes, e para as coisas sagradas, e para os sacrifícios pelo pecado para reconciliar a Israel, e [para] toda a obra da casa de nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Para el pan de la proposición, y para la ofrenda continua, y para el holocausto continuo, de los sábados, y de las nuevas lunas, y de las festividades, y para las santificaciones y sacrificios por el pecado para expiar á Israel, y para toda la obra de la casa de nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law:
verses.WEB: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed year by year, to burn on the LORD our God’s altar, as it is written in the law;
verses.ASV: And we cast lots, the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood-offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed, year by year, to burn upon the altar of Jehovah our God, as it is written in the law;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também lançamos as sortes entre os sacerdotes, os levitas, e o povo, acerca da oferta da lenha, que havia de se trazer à casa de nosso Deus, segundo as casas de nossos pais, em tempos determinados, a cada ano, para queimar sobre o altar do SENHOR nosso Deus, como está escrito na lei.
verses.RVR09: Echamos también las suertes, los sacerdotes, los Levitas, y el pueblo, acerca de la ofrenda de la leña, para traerla á la casa de nuestro Dios, según las casas de nuestros padres, en los tiempos determinados cada un año, para quemar sobre el altar de Jehová nuestro Dios, como está escrito en la ley.

verses.KJV: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the Lord:
verses.WEB: and to bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees, year by year, to the LORD’s house;
verses.ASV: and to bring the first-fruits of our ground, and the first-fruits of all fruit of all manner of trees, year by year, unto the house of Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E que a cada ano traríamos as primícias de nossa terra, e todos os primeiros frutos de toda árvore, para a casa de SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Y que cada año traeríamos las primicias de nuestra tierra, y las primicias de todo fruto de todo árbol, á la casa de Jehová:

verses.KJV: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:
verses.WEB: also the firstborn of our sons and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;
verses.ASV: also the first-born of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God;
verses.ALMEIDA: E também os primogênitos de nossos filhos e de nossas animais, como está escrito na lei; e que traríamos os primogênitos de nossas vacas e de nossas ovelhas à casa de nosso Deus, aos sacerdotes que ministram na casa de nosso Deus;
verses.RVR09: Asimismo los primogénitos de nuestros hijos y de nuestras bestias, como está escrito en la ley; y que traeríamos los primogénitos de nuestras vacas y de nuestras ovejas á la casa de nuestro Dios, á los sacerdotes que ministran en la casa de nuestro Dios:

verses.KJV: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.
verses.WEB: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough, our wave offerings, the fruit of all kinds of trees, and the new wine and the oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all our farming villages.
verses.ASV: and that we should bring the first-fruits of our dough, and our heave-offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, the new wine and the oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que traríamos as primícias de nossas massas, e nossas ofertas alçadas, e do fruto de toda árvore, do suco de uva e do azeite, aos sacerdotes, às câmaras da casa de nosso Deus, e os dízimos de nossa terra aos levitas; e que os levitas receberiam os dízimos em todas as cidades onde trabalhamos.
verses.RVR09: Que traeríamos también las primicias de nuestras masas, y nuestras ofrendas, y del fruto de todo árbol, del vino y del aceite, á los sacerdotes, á las cámaras de la casa de nuestro Dios, y el diezmo de nuestra tierra á los Levitas; y que los Levitas recibirían las décimas de nuestras labores en todas las ciudades:

verses.KJV: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.
verses.WEB: The priest, the descendent of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites take tithes. The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.
verses.ASV: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure-house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que um sacerdote, filho de Arão, estaria com os levitas, quando os levitas recebessem os dízimos; e que os levitas trariam o dízimo dos dízimos à casa de nosso Deus, às câmaras da casa do tesouro.
verses.RVR09: Y que estaría el sacerdote hijo de Aarón con los Levitas, cuando los Levitas recibirían el diezmo: y que los Levitas llevarían el diezmo del diezmo á la casa de nuestro Dios, á las cámaras en la casa del tesoro.

verses.KJV: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.
verses.WEB: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms where the vessels of the sanctuary are, and the priests who minister, with the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.
verses.ASV: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the heave-offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque para aquelas câmaras os filhos de Israel, e os filhos de Levi, devem trazer a oferta de grão, de suco de uva, e de azeite; e ali estarão os vasos do santuário, como também os sacerdotes que ministram, os porteiros, e os cantores; e assim não abandonaríamos a casa de nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque á las cámaras han de llevar los hijos de Israel y los hijos de Leví la ofrenda del grano, del vino, y del aceite; y allí estarán los vasos del santuario, y los sacerdotes que ministran, y los porteros, y los cantores; y no abandonaremos la casa de nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
verses.WEB: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
verses.ASV: And the princes of the people dwelt in Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the [other] cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os líderes do povo habitaram em Jerusalém; porém os demais do povo lançaram sortes para trazerem um de dez para habitar na santa cidade de Jerusalém, e as nove partes nas outras cidades.
verses.RVR09: Y HABITARON los príncipes del pueblo en Jerusalem; mas el resto del pueblo echó suertes para traer uno de diez que morase en Jerusalem, ciudad santa, y las nueve partes en las otras ciudades.

verses.KJV: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And the people blessed all the men that willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo abençoou a todos os homens que voluntariamente se ofereceram para habitarem em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y bendijo el pueblo á todos los varones que voluntariamente se ofrecieron á morar en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.
verses.WEB: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
verses.ASV: Now these are the chiefs of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, [to wit], Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os chefes da província que habitaram em Jerusalém (porém os israelitas, os sacerdotes e os levitas, os servos do templo, e os filhos dos servos de Salomão, nas cidades de Judá, habitaram cada um em sua possessão, em suas cidades).
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los principales de la provincia que moraron en Jerusalem; mas en las ciudades de Judá habitaron cada uno en su posesión en sus ciudades, de Israel, de los sacerdotes, y Levitas, y Nethineos, y de los hijos de los siervos de Salomón.

verses.KJV: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
verses.WEB: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
verses.ASV: And in Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
verses.ALMEIDA: Habitaram, pois, em Jerusalém , [alguns] dos filhos de Judá, e dos filhos de Benjamim. Dos filhos de Judá: Ataías, filho de Uzias, filho de Zacarias, filho de Amarias, filho de Sefatias, filho de Maalaleel, dos filhos de Perez;
verses.RVR09: En Jerusalem pues habitaron de los hijos de Judá, y de los hijos de Benjamín. De los hijos de Judá: Athaías hijo de Uzzías, hijo de Zacarías, hijo de Amarías, hijo de Sephatías, hijo de Mahalaleel, de los hijos de Phares;

verses.KJV: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
verses.WEB: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
verses.ASV: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Maaseias filho de Baruque, filho de Col-Hozé, filho de Hazaías, filho de Adaías, filho de Joiaribe, filho de Zacarias, filho de Siloni.
verses.RVR09: Y Maasías hijo de Baruch, hijo de Colhoze, hijo de Hazaías, hijo de Adaías, hijo de Joiarib, hijo de Zacarías, hijo de Siloni.

verses.KJV: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.WEB: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.
verses.ASV: All the sons of Perez that dwelt in Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os filhos de Perez que habitaram em Jerusalém foram quatrocentos setenta e oito homens valentes.
verses.RVR09: Todos los hijos de Phares que moraron en Jerusalem, fueron cuatrocientos setenta y ocho hombres fuertes.

verses.KJV: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
verses.WEB: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
verses.ASV: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estes são os filhos de Benjamim: Salu filho de Mesulão, filho de Joede, filho de Pedaías, filho de Colaías, filho de Maaseias, filho de Itiel, filho de Jesaías.
verses.RVR09: Y estos son los hijos de Benjamín: Salú hijo de Mesullam, hijo de Joed, hijo de Pedaías, hijo de Colaías, hijo de Maaseías, hijo de Ithiel, hijo de Jesaía.

verses.KJV: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.WEB: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
verses.ASV: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E após ele, Gabai, Salai, novecentos e vinte e oito.
verses.RVR09: Y tras él, Gabbai, Sallai, novecientos veinte y ocho.

verses.KJV: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
verses.WEB: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
verses.ASV: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joel, filho de Zicri, era o supervisor deles; e Judá filho de Senua, o segundo sobre a cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y Joel hijo de Zichri, era prefecto de ellos, y Jehudas hijo de Senua, el segundo en la ciudad.

verses.KJV: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
verses.WEB: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
verses.ASV: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos sacerdotes: Jedaías filho de Joiaribe, Jaquim,
verses.RVR09: De los sacerdotes: Jedaías hijo de Joiarib, Jachîn,

verses.KJV: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
verses.WEB: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,
verses.ASV: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Seraías filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Aitube, governador da casa de Deus,
verses.RVR09: Seraías hijo de Hilcías, hijo de Mesullam, hijo de Sadoc, hijo de Meraioth, hijo de Ahitub, príncipe de la casa de Dios,

verses.KJV: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah.
verses.WEB: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
verses.ASV: and their brethren that did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty and two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos, que faziam a obra da casa, oitocentos vinte e dois; e Adaías filho de Jeroão, filho de Pelalias, filho de Anzi, filho de Zacarias, filho de Pasur, filho de Malquias,
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos los que hacían la obra de la casa, ochocientos veintidós: y Adaías hijo de Jeroham, hijo de Pelalías, hijo de Amsi, hijo de Zacarías, hijo de Pashur, hijo de Malachías,

verses.KJV: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.WEB: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.ASV: and his brethren, chiefs of fathers’ [houses], two hundred forty and two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos, chefes de famílias, duzentos e quarenta e dois; e Amassai filho de Azareel, filho de Azai, filho de Mesilemote, filho de Imer,
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos, príncipes de familias, doscientos cuarenta y dos: y Amasai hijo de Azarael, hijo de Azai, hijo de Mesillemoth, hijo de Immer,

verses.KJV: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
verses.WEB: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
verses.ASV: and their brethren, mighty men of valor, a hundred twenty and eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos, homens valentes, cento e vinte e oito; e o supervisor sobre eles era Zabdiel, filho de Gedolim.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos, hombres de grande vigor, ciento veintiocho: jefe de los cuales era Zabdiel, hijo de Gedolim.

verses.KJV: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.WEB: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.ASV: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos Levitas: Semaías filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, filho de Buni;
verses.RVR09: Y de los Levitas: Semaías hijo de Hassub, hijo de Azricam, hijo de Hasabías, hijo de Buni;

verses.KJV: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
verses.WEB: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;
verses.ASV: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God;
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabetai e Jozabade, dos chefes dos Levitas, supervisores da obra de fora da casa de Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y Sabethai y Jozabad, de los principales de los Levitas, sobrestantes de la obra exterior de la casa de Dios;

verses.KJV: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.WEB: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.ASV: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brethren; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Matanias filho de Mica, filho de Zabdi, filho de Asafe, o chefe, o que começava a ação de graças na oração; e Baquebuquias o segundo de entre seus irmãos; e Abda filho de Samua, filho de Galal, filho de Jedutum.
verses.RVR09: Y Mattanías hijo de Michâ, hijo de Zabdi, hijo de Asaph, el principal, el que empezaba las alabanzas y acción de gracias al tiempo de la oración; y Bacbucías el segundo de entre sus hermanos; y Abda hijo de Samua, hijo de Galal, hijo de Jeduthún.

verses.KJV: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.WEB: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
verses.ASV: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os levitas na santa cidade foram duzentos e oitenta e quatro.
verses.RVR09: Todos los Levitas en la santa ciudad fueron doscientos ochenta y cuatro.

verses.KJV: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
verses.WEB: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
verses.ASV: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren, that kept watch at the gates, were a hundred seventy and two.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os porteiros, Acube, Talmom, com seus irmãos, os guardas das portas: cento e setenta e dois.
verses.RVR09: Y los porteros, Accub, Talmón, y sus hermanos, guardas en las puertas, ciento setenta y dos.

verses.KJV: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.WEB: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
verses.ASV: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o demais dos israelitas, dos sacerdotes, dos levitas, estevem em todas as cidades de Judá, cada um em sua propriedade.
verses.RVR09: Y el resto de Israel, de los sacerdotes, de los Levitas, en todas las ciudades de Judá, cada uno en su heredad.

verses.KJV: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
verses.WEB: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
verses.ASV: But the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os servos do templo habitavam em Ofel; e Zia e Gispa governavam sobre os servos do templo.
verses.RVR09: Y los Nethineos habitaban en Ophel; y Siha y Gispa eran sobre los Nethineos.

verses.KJV: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
verses.WEB: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.
verses.ASV: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of the house of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o supervisor dos levitas em Jerusalém foi Uzi, filho de Bani, filho de Hasabias, filho de Matanias, filho de Mica; dos filhos de Asafe estavam os cantores diante da obra da casa de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y el prepósito de los Levitas en Jerusalem era Uzzi hijo de Bani, hijo de Hasabías, hijo de Mattanías, hijo de Michâ de los cantores los hijos de Asaph, sobre la obra de la casa de Dios.

verses.KJV: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
verses.WEB: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
verses.ASV: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tinha mandamento do rei acerca deles, e determinação acerca dos cantores para cada dia.
verses.RVR09: Porque había mandamiento del rey acerca de ellos, y determinación acerca de los cantores para cada día.

verses.KJV: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.WEB: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.ASV: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Petaías filho de Mesezabel, dos filhos de Zerá, filho de Judá, estava à mão do rei em todo negócio do povo.
verses.RVR09: Y Pethahías hijo de Mesezabel, de los hijos de Zerah hijo de Judá, estaba á la mano del rey en todo negocio del pueblo.

verses.RVR09: Lod, y Ono, valle de los artífices.

verses.RVR09: Y algunos de los Levitas, en los repartimientos de Judá y de Benjamín.

verses.ASV: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes são os sacerdotes e Levitas que subiram com Zorobabel filho de Sealtiel, e com Jesua: Seraías, Jeremias, Esdras,
verses.RVR09: Y ESTOS son los sacerdotes y Levitas que subieron con Zorobabel hijo de Sealthiel, y con Jesuá: Seraías, Jeremías, Esdras,

verses.KJV: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
verses.WEB: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
verses.ASV: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

verses.ASV: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Secanias, Reum, Meremote,
verses.RVR09: Sechânías, Rehum, Meremoth,

verses.WEB: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
verses.ASV: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,

verses.KJV: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
verses.WEB: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
verses.ASV: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Miamim, Maadias, Bilga,
verses.RVR09: Miamin, Maadías, Bilga,

verses.WEB: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,

verses.WEB: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.
verses.ASV: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salu, Amoque, Hilquias, Jedaías. Estes eram os chefes dos sacerdotes e seus irmãos nos dias de Jesua.
verses.RVR09: Sallum, Amoc, Hilcías, Jedaías. Estos eran los príncipes de los sacerdotes y sus hermanos en los días de Jesuá.

verses.KJV: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
verses.WEB: Moreover the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving songs, he and his brothers.
verses.ASV: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, [and] Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

verses.RVR09: Y los Levitas: Jesuá, Binnui, Cadmiel, Serebías, Judá, y Mathanías, que con sus hermanos oficiaba en los himnos.

verses.WEB: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.
verses.ASV: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brethren, were over against them according to their offices.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Bacbuquias e Uni, seus irmãos, em frente deles em suas responsabilidades.
verses.RVR09: Y Bacbucías y Unni, sus hermanos, cada cual en su ministerio.

verses.RVR09: Y Jesuá engendró á Joiacim, y Joiacim engendró á Eliasib, y Eliasib engendró á Joiada,

verses.KJV: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
verses.WEB: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.
verses.ASV: and Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Joiada gerou a Jônatas, e Jônatas gerou a Jadua.
verses.RVR09: Y Joiada engendró á Jonathán, y Jonathán engendró á Jaddua.

verses.WEB: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
verses.ASV: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ [houses]: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E nos dias de Joiaquim os sacerdotes chefes das famílias foram: de Seraías, Meraías; de Jeremias, Hananias;
verses.RVR09: Y en los días de Joiacim los sacerdotes cabezas de familias fueron: de Seraías, Meraías; de Jeremías, Hananías;

verses.KJV: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
verses.WEB: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
verses.ASV: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
verses.ALMEIDA: De Esdras, Mesulão; de Amarias, Joanã;
verses.RVR09: De Esdras, Mesullam; de Amarías, Johanán;

verses.ASV: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
verses.ALMEIDA: De Maluqui, Jônatas; de Sebanias, José;
verses.RVR09: De Melichâ, Jonathán; de Sebanías, Joseph;

verses.KJV: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

verses.RVR09: De Iddo, Zacarías; de Ginnethón, Mesullam;

verses.RVR09: De Abías, Zichri; de Miniamín, de Moadías, Piltai;

verses.KJV: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.WEB: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.ASV: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.ALMEIDA: De Bilga, Samua; de Semaías, Jônatas;
verses.RVR09: De Bilga, Sammua; de Semaías, Jonathán;

verses.KJV: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.WEB: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.ASV: and of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.ALMEIDA: De Joiaribe, Matenai; de Jedaías, Uzi;
verses.RVR09: De Joiarib, Mathenai; de Jedaías, Uzzi;

verses.ALMEIDA: De Salai, Calai; de Amoque, Éber;
verses.RVR09: De Sallai, Callai; de Amoc, Eber;

verses.WEB: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

verses.ALMEIDA: De Hilquias, Hasabias; de Jedaías, Natanael.
verses.RVR09: De Hilcías, Hasabías; de Jedaías, Nathanael.

verses.KJV: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.WEB: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.ASV: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ [houses]; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os Levitas nos dias de Eliasibe, de Joiada, e de Joanã e Jadua, foram escritos por chefes de famílias; como também os sacerdotes, até o reinado de Dario o persa.
verses.RVR09: Los Levitas en días de Eliasib, de Joiada, y de Johanán y Jaddua, fueron escritos por cabezas de familias; también los sacerdotes, hasta el reinado de Darío el Persa.

verses.KJV: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.WEB: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.ASV: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ [houses], were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Levi, chefes de famílias, foram escritos no livro das crônicas até os dias de Joanã, filho de Eliasibe.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Leví, cabezas de familias, fueron escritos en el libro de las crónicas hasta los días de Johanán, hijo de Eliasib.

verses.KJV: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
verses.WEB: The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers close to them, to praise and give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God, section next to section.
verses.ASV: And the chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, watch next to watch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os chefes dos Levitas foram:Hasabias, Serebias, e Jesua filho de Cadmiel, e seus irmãos em frente deles, para louvarem [e] darem graças, conforme o mandamento de Davi, homem de Deus, cada um com sua responsabilidade.
verses.RVR09: Los cabezas de los Levitas: Hasabías, Serebías, y Jesuá hijo de Cadmiel, y sus hermanos delante de ellos, para alabar y para rendir gracias, conforme al estatuto de David varón de Dios, guardando su turno.

verses.KJV: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
verses.WEB: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.
verses.ASV: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the watch at the store-houses of the gates.
verses.ALMEIDA: Matanias, e Bacbuquias, Obadias, Mesulão, Talmom, Acube, eram porteiros que faziam guarda às entradas das portas.
verses.RVR09: Mathanías, y Bacbucías, Obadías, Mesullam, Talmón, Accub, guardas, eran porteros para la guardia á las entradas de las puertas.

verses.KJV: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
verses.WEB: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest and scribe.
verses.ASV: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest the scribe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes foram nos dias de Joiaquim, filho de Jesua, filho de Jozadaque, como também nos dias do governador Neemias, e do sacerdote Esdras, o escriba.
verses.RVR09: Estos fueron en los días de Joiacim, hijo de Jesuá, hijo de Josadac, y en los días del gobernador Nehemías, y del sacerdote Esdras, escriba.

verses.KJV: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
verses.WEB: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps.
verses.ASV: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
verses.ALMEIDA: E na dedicação dos muros de Jerusalém buscaram aos Levitas de todos os lugares, para os trazerem a Jerusalém, a fim de fazerem a dedicação com alegrias, com ações de graças, e com cânticos, com címbalos, liras e harpas.
verses.RVR09: Y á la dedicación del muro de Jerusalem buscaron á los Levitas de todos sus lugares, para traerlos á Jerusalem, para hacer la dedicación y la fiesta con alabanzas y con cánticos, con címbalos, salterios y cítaras.

verses.KJV: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
verses.WEB: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites;
verses.ASV: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of the Netophathites;
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim ajuntaram os filhos dos cantores, tanto da planície ao redor de Jerusalém como das aldeias de Netofati;
verses.RVR09: Y fueron reunidos los hijos de los cantores, así de la campiña alrededor de Jerusalem como de las aldeas de Netophati;

verses.KJV: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: also from Beth Gilgal and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: also from Beth-gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como também da casa de Gilgal, e dos campos de Geba, e de Azmavete; porque os cantores haviam edificado para si aldeias ao redor de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Y de la casa de Gilgal, y de los campos de Geba, y de Azmaveth; porque los cantores se habían edificado aldeas alrededor de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
verses.WEB: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
verses.ASV: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os sacerdotes e os levitas se purificaram, e depois purificaram ao povo, às portas, e ao muro.
verses.RVR09: Y se purificaron los sacerdotes y los Levitas; y purificaron al pueblo, y las puertas, y el muro.

verses.KJV: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
verses.WEB: Then I brought the princes of Judah up on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate;
verses.ASV: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies that gave thanks and went in procession; [whereof one went] on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu fiz subir aos príncipes de Judá sobre o muro, e ordenei dois coros grandes que foram em procissão: um à direita sobre o muro em direção à porta do Esterco.
verses.RVR09: Hice luego subir á los príncipes de Judá sobre el muro, y puse dos coros grandes que fueron en procesión: el uno á la mano derecha sobre el muro hacia la puerta del Muladar.

verses.KJV: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
verses.WEB: and after them went Hoshaiah, with half of the princes of Judah,
verses.ASV: and after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E após eles ia Hosaías, e a metade dos príncipes de Judá,
verses.RVR09: E iba tras de ellos Osaías, y la mitad de los príncipes de Judá,

verses.KJV: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
verses.WEB: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
verses.ASV: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Azarias, Esdras, Mesulão,
verses.RVR09: Y Azarías, Esdras y Mesullam,

verses.KJV: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
verses.WEB: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
verses.ASV: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Judá, Benjamim, Semaías, e Jeremias;
verses.RVR09: Judá y Benjamín, y Semaías, y Jeremías;

verses.KJV: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
verses.WEB: and some of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;
verses.ASV: and certain of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos filhos dos sacerdotes com trombetas, Zacarias filho de Jônatas, filho de Semaías, filho de Matanias, filho de Micaías, filho de Zacur, filho de Asafe;
verses.RVR09: Y de los hijos de los sacerdotes iban con trompetas, Zacarías hijo de Jonathán, hijo de Semaías, hijo de Mathanías, hijo de Michâías, hijo de Zachûr, hijo de Asaph;

verses.KJV: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.
verses.WEB: and his brothers, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.
verses.ASV: and his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus irmãos Semaías, e Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanael, Judá e Hanani, com os instrumentos musicais de Davi, homem de Deus; e o escriba Esdras [ia] diante deles.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hermanos Semaías, y Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nathanael, Judá y Hanani, con los instrumentos músicos de David varón de Dios; y Esdras escriba, delante de ellos.

verses.KJV: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
verses.WEB: By the spring gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of David’s city, at the ascent of the wall, above David’s house, even to the water gate eastward.
verses.ASV: And by the fountain gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Indo] assim para a porta da Fonte, e em frente deles, subiram pelas escadarias da cidade de Davi, pela subida do muro, desde acima da casa de Davi até a porta das Águas ao oriente.
verses.RVR09: Y á la puerta de la Fuente, en derecho delante de ellos, subieron por las gradas de la ciudad de David, por la subida del muro, desde la casa de David hasta la puerta de las Aguas al oriente.

verses.KJV: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;
verses.WEB: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people on the wall above the tower of the furnaces, even to the wide wall,
verses.ASV: And the other company of them that gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people, upon the wall, above the tower of the furnaces, even unto the broad wall,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o segundo coro ia do lado oposto, e eu atrás dele; e a metade do povo [ia] sobre o muro, desde a torre dos Fornos até a muralha larga;
verses.RVR09: Y el segundo coro iba del lado opuesto, y yo en pos de él, con la mitad del pueblo sobre el muro, desde la torre de los Hornos hasta el muro ancho;

verses.KJV: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
verses.WEB: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate; and they stood still in the gate of the guard.
verses.ASV: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, and the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the gate of the guard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E desde a porta de Efraim até a porta Velha, e à porta do Peixe, e a torre de Hananeel, e a torre dos Cem, até a porta das Ovelhas; e pararam na porta da Prisão.
verses.RVR09: Y desde la puerta de Ephraim hasta la puerta vieja, y á la puerta del Pescado, y la torre de Hananeel, y la torre de Hamath, hasta la puerta de las Ovejas: y pararon en la puerta de la Cárcel.

verses.KJV: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
verses.WEB: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house stood, and I and the half of the rulers with me;
verses.ASV: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ambos os coros pararam na casa de Deus; como também eu, e a metade dos oficiais comigo;
verses.RVR09: Pararon luego los dos coros en la casa de Dios; y yo, y la mitad de los magistrados conmigo;

verses.KJV: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.WEB: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.ASV: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os sacerdotes, Eliaquim, Maaseias, Miniamim, Micaías, Elioenai, Zacarias, e Hananias, com trombetas;
verses.RVR09: Y los sacerdotes, Eliacim, Maaseías, Miniamin, Michâías, Elioenai, Zacarías, y Hananías, con trompetas;

verses.KJV: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
verses.WEB: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
verses.ASV: and Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como também Maaseias, Semaías, Eleazar, e Uzi, Joanã, Malquias, Elão, e Ezer. E os cantores cantavam alto, juntamente com o supervisor Jezraías.
verses.RVR09: Y Maaseías, y Semeías, y Eleazar, y Uzzi, y Johanán, y Malchías, y Elam, y Ezer. Y los cantores cantaban alto, é Israhía era el prefecto.

verses.KJV: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
verses.WEB: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women and the children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away.
verses.ASV: And they offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced; for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sacrificaram naquele dia grandes sacrifícios, e alegraram-se; porque Deus os tinha alegrado muito; alegraram-se também a mulheres e as crianças; e o júbilo de Jerusalém foi ouvido até de longe.
verses.RVR09: Y sacrificaron aquel día grandes víctimas, é hicieron alegrías; porque Dios los había recreado con grande contentamiento: alegráronse también las mujeres y muchachos; y el alborozo de Jerusalem fué oído de lejos.

verses.KJV: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
verses.WEB: On that day, men were appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them according to the fields of the cities the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who served.
verses.ASV: And on that day were men appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the heave-offerings, for the first-fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them, according to the fields of the cities, the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também naquele dia foram postos homens sobre as câmaras para os tesouros, as ofertas alçadas, as primícias, e os dízimos, para juntarem nelas, dos campos das cidades, as porções da lei para os sacerdotes e os levitas; porque Judá estava alegre por causa dos sacerdotes e dos levitas que estavam servindo ali.
verses.RVR09: Y en aquel día fueron puestos varones sobre las cámaras de los tesoros, de las ofrendas, de las primicias, y de los diezmos, para juntar en ellas, de los campos de las ciudades, las porciones legales para los sacerdotes y Levitas: porque era grande el gozo de Judá con respecto á los sacerdotes y Levitas que asistían.

verses.KJV: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
verses.WEB: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son.
verses.ASV: And they kept the charge of their God, and the charge of the purification, and [so did] the singers and the porters, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
verses.ALMEIDA: E faziam a guarda de seu Deus, e a guarda da purificação, como também os cantores e os porteiros, conforme o mandamento de Davi e de seu filho Salomão.
verses.RVR09: Y habían guardado la observancia de su Dios, y la observancia de la expiación, como también los cantores y los porteros, conforme al estatuto de David y de Salomón su hijo.

verses.KJV: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
verses.WEB: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
verses.ASV: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nos dias de Davi e de Asafe, desde a antiguidade, havia chefes dos cantores, e cânticos de louvor e de ações de graças a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque desde el tiempo de David y de Asaph, ya de antiguo, había príncipes de cantores, y cántico y alabanza, y acción de gracias á Dios.

verses.KJV: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.
verses.WEB: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.
verses.ASV: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, as every day required: and they set apart [that which was] for the Levites; and the Levites set apart [that which was] for the sons of Aaron.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo Israel nos dias de Zorobabel, e nos dias de Neemias, dava as porções dos cantores e dos porteiros, cada uma em seu dia; e consagravam [porções] aos levitas, e os levitas [as] consagravam aos filhos de Arão.
verses.RVR09: Y todo Israel en días de Zorobabel, y en días de Nehemías, daba raciones á los cantores y á los porteros, cada cosa en su día: consagraban asimismo sus porciones á los Levitas, y los Levitas consagraban parte á los hijos de Aarón.

verses.KJV: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;
verses.WEB: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,
verses.ASV: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God for ever,
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia se leu no livro de Moisés perante os ouvidos do povo, e foi achado nele escrito que os amonitas e os moabitas eternamente não podiam entrar na congregação de Deus;
verses.RVR09: AQUEL día se leyó en el libro de Moisés oyéndolo el pueblo, y fué hallado en él escrito, que los Ammonitas y Moabitas no debían entrar jamás en la congregación de Dios;

verses.KJV: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.WEB: because they didn’t meet the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them; however, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.ASV: because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, to curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não saíram ao encontro dos filhos de Israel com pão e água; em vez disso, contrataram a Balaão contra eles, para os amaldiçoar; ainda que nosso Deus tornou a maldição em bênção.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto no salieron á recibir á los hijos de Israel con pan y agua, antes alquilaron á Balaam contra ellos, para que los maldijera: mas nuestro Dios volvió la maldición en bendición.

verses.KJV: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.
verses.WEB: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sucedeu, pois, que, quando eles ouviram esta lei, separaram de Israel toda mistura.
verses.RVR09: Y fué que, como oyeron la ley, apartaron de Israel toda mistura.

verses.KJV: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:
verses.WEB: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah,
verses.ASV: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the chambers of the house of our God, being allied unto Tobiah,
verses.ALMEIDA: E antes disto, Eliasibe, o sacerdote, sendo superintendente da câmara da casa de nosso Deus, tinha se aparentado com Tobias,
verses.RVR09: Y antes de esto, Eliasib sacerdote, siendo superintendente de la cámara de la casa de nuestro Dios, había emparentado con Tobías,

verses.KJV: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.
verses.WEB: had prepared for him a great room, where before they laid the meal offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers; and the wave offerings for the priests.
verses.ASV: had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meal-offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the heave-offerings for the priests.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tinha lhe preparado uma câmara grande, na qual antes se guardavam as ofertas de alimentos, o incenso, os vasos, os dízimos de grão, de vinho e de azeite, que estava ordenado [dar] aos levitas, aos cantores, e aos porteiros; como também a oferta alçada para os sacerdotes.
verses.RVR09: Y le había hecho una grande cámara, en la cual guardaban antes las ofrendas, y el perfume, y los vasos, y el diezmo del grano, y del vino y del aceite, que estaba mandado dar á los Levitas, á los cantores, y á los porteros; y la ofrenda de los sacerdotes.

verses.KJV: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
verses.WEB: But in all this, I was not at Jerusalem; for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king; and after some days I asked leave of the king,
verses.ASV: But in all this [time] I was not at Jerusalem; for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went unto the king: and after certain days asked I leave of the king,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém enquanto tudo isto [acontecia] ,eu não estava em Jerusalém; porque no ano trinta e dois de Artaxerxes rei da Babilônia, eu vim ao rei; mas ao fim de [alguns] dias obtive permissão para me ausentar do rei.
verses.RVR09: Mas á todo esto, yo no estaba en Jerusalem; porque el año treinta y dos de Artajerjes rey de Babilonia, vine al rey; y al cabo de días fuí enviado del rey.

verses.KJV: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
verses.WEB: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.
verses.ASV: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vim a Jerusalém, e entendi o mal que Eliasibe tinha feito por Tobias, preparando-lhe uma câmara nos pátios da casa de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y venido á Jerusalem, entendí el mal que había hecho Eliasib en atención á Tobías, haciendo para él cámara en los patios de la casa de Dios.

verses.KJV: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff to Tobiah out of the chamber.
verses.WEB: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.
verses.ASV: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isso me desagradou muito; por isso lancei todas as coisas da casa de Tobias para fora da câmara;
verses.RVR09: Y dolióme en gran manera; y eché todas las alhajas de la casa de Tobías fuera de la cámara;

verses.KJV: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
verses.WEB: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again.
verses.ASV: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meal-offerings and the frankincense.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mandei purificar as câmaras, e trouxe de volta os utensílios da casa de Deus, com as ofertas de alimento, e o incenso.
verses.RVR09: Y dije que limpiasen las cámaras, é hice volver allí las alhajas de la casa de Dios, las ofrendas y el perfume.

verses.KJV: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
verses.WEB: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field.
verses.ASV: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them; so that the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também entendi que as porções dos Levitas não estavam sendo dadas [a eles] ; e que os levitas e cantores que faziam o serviço haviam fugido cada um para seu campo.
verses.RVR09: Entendí asimismo que las partes de los Levitas no se les habían dado; y que los Levitas y cantores que hacían el servicio se habían huído cada uno á su heredad.

verses.KJV: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
verses.WEB: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
verses.ASV: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então repreendi aos oficiais, e disse: Por que a casa de Deus está abandonada? Porém eu os juntei, e os restaurei em seu posto.
verses.RVR09: Y reprendí á los magistrados, y dije: ¿Por qué está la casa de Dios abandonada? Y juntélos, y púselos en su lugar.

verses.KJV: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
verses.WEB: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.
verses.ASV: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todo Judá trouxe o dízimo do grão, do suco de uva e do azeite, aos depósitos.
verses.RVR09: Y todo Judá trajo el diezmo del grano, del vino y del aceite, á los almacenes.

verses.KJV: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
verses.WEB: I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.
verses.ASV: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute unto their brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pus por tesoureiros sobre os depósitos ao sacerdote Selemias e ao escriba Zadoque, e dos Levitas, a Pedaías; e próximo a eles Hanã filho de Zacur, filho de Matanias; pois eram considerados fiéis, e [assim] foram encarregados de distribuírem a seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y puse por sobrestantes de ellos á Selemías sacerdote, y á Sadoc escriba, y de los Levitas, á Pedaías; y á mano de ellos Hanán hijo de Zaccur, hijo de Mathanías: pues que eran tenidos por fieles, y de ellos era el repartir á sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
verses.WEB: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.
verses.ASV: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the observances thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isto, meu Deus, lembra-te de mim, ó Deus, e não risques minhas bondades que eu fiz na casa de meu Deus, e em seus serviços.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de mí, oh Dios, en orden á esto, y no raigas mis misericordias que hice en la casa de mi Dios, y en sus observancias.

verses.KJV: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
verses.WEB: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.
verses.ASV: In those days saw I in Judah some men treading winepresses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses [therewith]; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified [against them] in the day wherein they sold victuals.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naqueles dias vi em Judá [alguns] que pisavam nas presnas de uvas no sábado, e que traziam feixes, e carregavam asnos, como também vinho, uvas, figos, e todo tipo de carga, que traziam a Jerusalém no dia de sábado; e os adverti quanto ao dia em que vendiam alimentos.
verses.RVR09: En aquellos días ví en Judá algunos que pisaban en lagares el sábado, y que acarreaban haces, y cargaban asnos con vino, y también de uvas, de higos, y toda suerte de carga, y traían á Jerusalem en día de sábado; y protestéles acerca del día que vendían el mantenimiento.

verses.KJV: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, who brought in fish, and all manner of wares, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também tírios estavam nela que traziam peixe e toda mercadoria, e vendiam no sábado aos filhos de Judá, e em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: También estaban en ella Tirios que traían pescado y toda mercadería, y vendían en sábado á los hijos de Judá en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
verses.WEB: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?
verses.ASV: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim repreendi aos nobres de Judá, e disse-lhes: Que mal é este que fazeis, profanando o dia de sábado?
verses.RVR09: Y reprendí á los señores de Judá, y díjeles: ¿Qué mala cosa es esta que vosotros hacéis, profanando así el día del sábado?

verses.KJV: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
verses.WEB: Didn’t your fathers do this, and didn’t our God bring all this evil on us and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”
verses.ASV: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não fizeram assim vossos pais, e nosso Deus trouxe todo este mal sobre nós e sobre esta cidade? Porém vós acrescentais ainda mais ira sobre Israel profanando o sábado.
verses.RVR09: ¿No hicieron así vuestros padres, y trajo nuestro Dios sobre nosotros todo este mal, y sobre esta ciudad? ¿Y vosotros añadís ira sobre Israel profanando el sábado?

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
verses.WEB: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass that, when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I over the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sucedeu pois, que quando ia escurecendo às portas de Jerusalém antes do sábado, disse que eu mandei que se fechassem as portas, e mandei que não as abrissem até depois do sábado; e pus às portas alguns de meus servos, para que carga nenhuma entrasse no dia de sábado.
verses.RVR09: Sucedió pues, que cuando iba oscureciendo á las puertas de Jerusalem antes del sábado, dije que se cerrasen las puertas, y ordené que no las abriesen hasta después del sábado; y puse á las puertas algunos de mis criados, para que en día de sábado no entrasen carga.

verses.KJV: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.WEB: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.ASV: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of wares lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim os comerciantes e vendedores de toda mercadoria passaram a noite fora de Jerusalém uma ou duas vezes.
verses.RVR09: Y quedáronse fuera de Jerusalem una y dos veces los negociantes, y los que vendían toda especie de mercancía.

verses.KJV: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
verses.WEB: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.
verses.ASV: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu lhes adverti, dizendo: Por que vos passais a noite diante do muro? Se o fizerdes outra vez, agirei com violência contra vós. Desde então não vieram no sábado.
verses.RVR09: Y protestéles, y díjeles: ¿Por qué os quedáis vosotros delante del muro? Si lo hacéis otra vez, os echaré mano. Desde entonces no vinieron en sábado.

verses.KJV: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.
verses.WEB: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.
verses.ASV: And I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember unto me, O my God, this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy lovingkindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também disse aos levitas que se purificassem, e viessem a guardar as portas, para santificar o dia de sábado. Nisto também, meu Deus, lembra-te de mim, e perdoa-me segundo a grandeza de tua bondade.
verses.RVR09: Y dije á los Levitas que se purificasen, y viniesen á guardar las puertas, para santificar el día del sábado. También por esto acuérdate de mí, Dios mío, y perdóname según la muchedumbre de tu misericordia.

verses.KJV: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:
verses.WEB: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;
verses.ASV: In those days also saw I the Jews that had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, [and] of Moab:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi também naqueles dias judeus que tinham se casado com mulheres de asdoditas, amonitas, e moabitas,
verses.RVR09: Ví asimismo en aquellos días Judíos que habían tomado mujeres de Asdod, Ammonitas, y Moabitas:

verses.KJV: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.
