verses.RVR09: Para confirmar estos días de Purim en sus tiempos señalados, según les había constituído Mardochêo Judío y la reina Esther, y como habían ellos tomado sobre sí y sobre su simiente, para conmemorar el fin de los ayunos y de su clamor.

verses.KJV: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
verses.WEB: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
verses.ASV: And the commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o mandamento de Ester confirmou estas palavras dadas acerca de Purim, e escreveu-se em um livro.
verses.RVR09: Y el mandamiento de Esther confirmó estas palabras dadas acerca de Purim, y escribióse en el libro.

verses.KJV: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.
verses.WEB: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.
verses.ASV: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o rei Assuero impôs um tributo sobre a terra e [sobre] as ilhas do mar.
verses.RVR09: Y EL rey Assuero impuso tributo sobre la tierra y las islas de la mar.

verses.KJV: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
verses.WEB: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
verses.ASV: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as obras de seu poder e de seu valor, e a declaração da grandeza de Mardoqueu, a quem o rei engrandeceu, por acaso não estão escritas no livro das crônicas dos reis da Média e da Pérsia?
verses.RVR09: Y toda la obra de su fortaleza, y de su valor, y la declaración de la grandeza de Mardochêo, con que el rey le engrandeció, ¿no está escrito en el libro de los anales de los reyes de Media y de Persia?

verses.KJV: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
verses.WEB: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.
verses.ASV: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the good of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o judeu Mardoqueu foi o segundo depois do rei Assuero, e grande entre os judeus, e agradável à multidão de seus irmãos, procurando o bem de seu povo, e falando prosperidade para todo o seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Porque Mardochêo Judío fué segundo después del rey Assuero, y grande entre los Judíos, y acepto á la multitud de sus hermanos, procurando el bien de su pueblo, y hablando paz para toda su simiente.

verses.KJV: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
verses.WEB: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.
verses.ASV: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and turned away from evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia um homem na terra de Uz, cujo nome era Jó; e este homem era íntegro e correto, temente a Deus, e que se afastava do mal.
verses.RVR09: HUBO un varón en tierra de Hus, llamado Job; y era este hombre perfecto y recto, y temeroso de Dios, y apartado del mal.

verses.KJV: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.WEB: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.ASV: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nasceram-lhe sete filhos e três filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y naciéronle siete hijos y tres hijas.

verses.KJV: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
verses.WEB: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.
verses.ASV: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she-asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu patrimônio era sete mil ovelhas, três mil camelos, quinhentas juntas de bois, e quinhentas jumentas; ele também tinha muitíssimos servos, de maneira que este homem era o maior de todos do oriente.
verses.RVR09: Y su hacienda era siete mil ovejas, y tres mil camellos, y quinientas yuntas de bueyes, y quinientas asnas, y muchísimos criados: y era aquel varón grande más que todos los Orientales.

verses.KJV: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
verses.WEB: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
verses.ASV: And his sons went and held a feast in the house of each one upon his day; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus filhos iam nas casas uns dos outros para fazerem banquetes, cada um em seu dia; e mandavam convidar as suas três irmãs, para que comessem e bebessem com eles.
verses.RVR09: E iban sus hijos y hacían banquetes en sus casas, cada uno en su día; y enviaban á llamar sus tres hermanas, para que comiesen y bebiesen con ellos.

verses.KJV: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
verses.WEB: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.
verses.ASV: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt-offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecia que, acabando-se o revezamento dos dias de banquetes, Jó enviava e os santificava, e se levantava de madrugada para apresentar holocaustos[conforme] o número de todos eles. Pois Jó dizia: Talvez meus filhos tenham pecado, e tenham amaldiçoado a Deus em seus corações. Assim Jó fazia todos aqueles dias.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecía que, habiendo pasado en turno los días del convite, Job enviaba y santificábalos, y levantábase de mañana y ofrecía holocaustos conforme al número de todos ellos. Porque decía Job: Quizá habrán pecado mis hijos, y habrán blasfemado á Dios en sus corazones. De esta manera hacía todos los días.

verses.KJV: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.
verses.WEB: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.
verses.ASV: Now it came to pass on the day when the sons of God came to present themselves before Jehovah, that Satan also came among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em certo dia, os filhos de Deus vieram para se apresentarem diante do SENHOR, e Satanás também veio entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y un día vinieron los hijos de Dios á presentarse delante de Jehová, entre los cuales vino también Satán.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered Jehovah, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Satanás: De onde vens? E Satanás respondeu ao SENHOR, dizendo: De rodear a terra, e de passear por ela.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová á Satán: ¿De dónde vienes? Y respondiendo Satán á Jehová, dijo: De rodear la tierra, y de andar por ella.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job? for there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and turneth away from evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Satanás: Tendes visto meu servo Jó? Pois ninguém há na terra semelhante a ele, homem íntegro e correto, temente a Deus, e que se afasta de mal.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Satán: ¿No has considerado á mi siervo Job, que no hay otro como él en la tierra, varón perfecto y recto, temeroso de Dios, y apartado de mal?

verses.KJV: Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
verses.WEB: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?
verses.ASV: Then Satan answered Jehovah, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Satanás respondeu ao SENHOR, dizendo: Por acaso Jó teme a Deus em troca de nada?
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Satán á Jehová, dijo: ¿Teme Job á Dios de balde?

verses.KJV: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
verses.WEB: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
verses.ASV: Hast not thou made a hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath, on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso tu não puseste uma cerca ao redor dele, de sua casa, e de tudo quanto ele tem? Tu abençoaste o trabalho de suas mãos, e seu patrimônio tem crescido sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: ¿No le has tú cercado á él, y á su casa, y á todo lo que tiene en derredor? Al trabajo de sus manos has dado bendición; por tanto su hacienda ha crecido sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.WEB: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”
verses.ASV: But put forth thy hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will renounce thee to thy face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas estende agora tua mão, e toca em tudo quanto ele tem; e [verás] se ele não te amaldiçoa em tua face.
verses.RVR09: Mas extiende ahora tu mano, y toca á todo lo que tiene, y verás si no te blasfema en tu rostro.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thy hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Satanás: Eis que tudo quanto ele tem está em tua mão; somente não estendas tua mão contra ele. E Satanás saiu de diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová á Satán: He aquí, todo lo que tiene está en tu mano: solamente no pongas tu mano sobre él. Y salióse Satán de delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
verses.WEB: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.ASV: And it fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house,
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu um dia que seus filhos e filhas estavam comendo e bebendo vinho na casa de seu irmão primogênito,
verses.RVR09: Y un día aconteció que sus hijos é hijas comían y bebían vino en casa de su hermano el primogénito,

verses.KJV: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:
verses.WEB: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,
verses.ASV: that there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que veio um mensageiro a Jó, que disse: Enquanto os bois estavam arando, e as jumentas se alimentando perto deles,
verses.RVR09: Y vino un mensajero á Job, que le dijo: Estando arando los bueyes, y las asnas paciendo cerca de ellos,

verses.KJV: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.WEB: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
verses.ASV: and the Sabeans fell [upon them], and took them away: yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que os sabeus atacaram, e os tomaram, e feriram os servos a fio de espada; somente eu escapei para te trazer a notícia.
verses.RVR09: Acometieron los Sabeos, y tomáronlos, é hirieron á los mozos á filo de espada: solamente escapé yo para traerte las nuevas.

verses.KJV: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.WEB: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
verses.ASV: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto este ainda estava falando, veio outro que disse: Fogo de Deus caiu do céu, que incendiou as ovelhas entre os servos, e os consumiu; somente eu escapei para te trazer-te a notícia.
verses.RVR09: Aun estaba éste hablando, y vino otro que dijo: Fuego de Dios cayó del cielo, que quemó las ovejas y los mozos, y los consumió: solamente escapé yo solo para traerte las nuevas.

verses.KJV: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.WEB: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
verses.ASV: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have taken them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto este ainda estava falando, veio outro que disse: Os caldeus formaram três tropas, e atacaram os camelos, e os tomaram, e feriram os servos a fio de espada; somente eu escapei para te trazer a notícia.
verses.RVR09: Todavía estaba éste hablando, y vino otro que dijo: Los Caldeos hicieron tres escuadrones, y dieron sobre los camellos, y tomáronlos, é hirieron á los mozos á filo de espada; y solamente escapé yo solo para traerte las nuevas.

verses.KJV: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
verses.WEB: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.ASV: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house;
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto este ainda estava falando, veio outro que disse: Teus filhos e tuas filhas estavam comendo e bebendo vinho em casa de seu irmão primogênito,
verses.RVR09: Entre tanto que éste hablaba, vino otro que dijo: Tus hijos y tus hijas estaban comiendo y bebiendo vino en casa de su hermano el primogénito;

verses.KJV: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.WEB: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”
verses.ASV: and, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que veio um grande vento do deserto, e atingiu os quatro cantos da casa, que caiu sobre os jovens, e morreram; somente eu escapei para te trazer a notícia.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí un gran viento que vino del lado del desierto, é hirió las cuatro esquinas de la casa, y cayó sobre los mozos, y murieron; y solamente escapé yo solo para traerte las nuevas.

verses.KJV: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
verses.WEB: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.
verses.ASV: Then Job arose, and rent his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jó se levantou, rasgou sua capa, rapou sua cabeça, e caindo na terra, adorou,
verses.RVR09: Entonces Job se levantó, y rasgó su manto, y trasquiló su cabeza, y cayendo en tierra adoró;

verses.KJV: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”
verses.ASV: and he said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: Jehovah gave, and Jehovah hath taken away; blessed be the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Nu saí do ventre de minha mãe, e nu para lá voltarei. O SENHOR deu, e o SENHOR tomou; bendito seja o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Desnudo salí del vientre de mi madre, y desnudo tornaré allá. Jehová dió, y Jehová quitó: sea el nombre de Jehová bendito.

verses.KJV: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
verses.WEB: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.
verses.ASV: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tudo isto Jó não pecou, nem atribuiu a Deus falta alguma.
verses.RVR09: En todo esto no pecó Job, ni atribuyó á Dios despropósito alguno.

verses.KJV: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.
verses.ASV: Again it came to pass on the day when the sons of God came to present themselves before Jehovah, that Satan came also among them to present himself before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio outro dia em que os filhos de Deus vieram para se apresentarem diante do SENHOR, e e Satanás também veio entre eles para se apresentar diante do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y OTRO día aconteció que vinieron los hijos de Dios para presentarse delante de Jehová, y Satán vino también entre ellos pareciendo delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered Jehovah, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Satanás: De onde vens? E Satanás respondeu ao SENHOR, e dizendo: De rodear a terra, e de passear por ela.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová á Satán: ¿De dónde vienes? Respondió Satán á Jehová, y dijo: De rodear la tierra, y de andar por ella.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job? for there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and turneth away from evil: and he still holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Satanás: Tendes visto meu servo Jó? Pois ninguém há semelhante a ele na terra, homem íntegro e correto, temente a Deus e que se afasta do mal; e que ainda mantém sua integridade, mesmo depois de teres me incitado contra ele, para o arruinar sem causa.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Satán: ¿No has considerado á mi siervo Job, que no hay otro como él en la tierra, varón perfecto y recto, temeroso de Dios y apartado de mal, y que aun retiene su perfección, habiéndome tú incitado contra él, para que lo arruinara sin causa?

verses.KJV: And Satan answered the Lord, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
verses.WEB: Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
verses.ASV: And Satan answered Jehovah, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Satanás respondeu ao SENHOR, dizendo: Pele por pele, e tudo quanto o homem tem, dará por sua vida.
verses.RVR09: Y respondiendo Satán dijo á Jehová: Piel por piel, todo lo que el hombre tiene dará por su vida.

verses.KJV: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.WEB: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”
verses.ASV: But put forth thy hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce thee to thy face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas estende agora tua mão, e toca em seus ossos e sua carne, e [verás] se ele não te amaldiçoa em tua face.
verses.RVR09: Mas extiende ahora tu mano, y toca á su hueso y á su carne, y verás si no te blasfema en tu rostro.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thy hand; only spare his life.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR disse a Satanás: Eis que ele está em tua mão; mas preserva sua vida.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová dijo á Satán: He aquí, él está en tu mano; mas guarda su vida.

verses.KJV: So went Satan forth from the presence of the Lord, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
verses.WEB: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
verses.ASV: So Satan went forth from the presence of Jehovah, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Satanás saiu de diante do SENHOR, e feriu a Jó de chagas malignas desde a planta de seus pés até a topo de sua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y salió Satán de delante de Jehová, é hirió á Job de una maligna sarna desde la planta de su pie hasta la mollera de su cabeza.

verses.KJV: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
verses.WEB: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.
verses.ASV: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself therewith; and he sat among the ashes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [Jó] tomou um caco para se raspar com ele, e ficou sentado no meio da cinza.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaba una teja para rascarse con ella, y estaba sentado en medio de ceniza.

verses.KJV: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.
verses.WEB: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”
verses.ASV: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still hold fast thine integrity? renounce God, and die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então sua mulher lhe disse: Ainda manténs a tua integridade? Amaldiçoa a Deus, e morre.
verses.RVR09: Díjole entonces su mujer: ¿Aun retienes tú tu simplicidad? Bendice á Dios, y muérete.

verses.KJV: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
verses.WEB: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.
verses.ASV: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele lhe disse: Tu falas como uma tola. Receberíamos o bem de Deus, e o mal não receberíamos? Em tudo isto Jó não pecou com seus lábios.
verses.RVR09: Y él le dijo: Como suele hablar cualquiera de las mujeres fatuas, has hablado. También recibimos el bien de Dios, ¿y el mal no recibiremos? En todo esto no pecó Job con sus labios.

verses.KJV: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
verses.WEB: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.
verses.ASV: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to bemoan him and to comfort him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando três amigos de Jó, Elifaz temanita, Bildade suíta, e Zofar naamita, ouviram todo este mal que lhe tinha vindo sobre ele, vieram cada um de seu lugar; porque haviam combinado de juntamente virem para se condoerem dele, e o consolarem.
verses.RVR09: Y tres amigos de Job, Eliphaz Temanita, y Bildad Suhita, y Sophar Naamathita, luego que oyeron todo este mal que le había sobrevenido, vinieron cada uno de su lugar; porque habían concertado de venir juntos á condolecerse de él, y á consolarle.

verses.KJV: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
verses.WEB: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.
verses.ASV: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his robe, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, quando levantaram seus olhos de longe, não o reconheceram; e choraram em alta voz; e cada um deles rasgou sua capa, e espalharam pó ao ar sobre suas cabeças.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales alzando los ojos desde lejos, no lo conocieron, y lloraron á voz en grito; y cada uno de ellos rasgó su manto, y esparcieron polvo sobre sus cabezas hacia el cielo.

verses.KJV: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.
verses.WEB: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.
verses.ASV: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim se sentaram com ele na terra durante sete dias e sete noites, e nenhum lhe falava palavra alguma, pois viam que a dor era muito grande.
verses.RVR09: Así se sentaron con él en tierra por siete días y siete noches, y ninguno le hablaba palabra, porque veían que el dolor era muy grande.

verses.KJV: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.WEB: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
verses.ASV: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disto Jó abriu sua boca, e amaldiçoou seu dia.
verses.RVR09: DESPUÉS de esto abrió Job su boca, y maldijo su día.

verses.KJV: And Job spake, and said,
verses.WEB: Job answered:
verses.ASV: And Job answered and said:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Jó respondeu, e disse:
verses.RVR09: Y exclamó Job, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.
verses.WEB: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’
verses.ASV: Let the day perish wherein I was born, And the night which said, There is a man-child conceived.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pereça o dia em que nasci, e a noite [em que] se disse: Um homem foi concebido.
verses.RVR09: Perezca el día en que yo nací, y la noche que se dijo: Varón es concebido.

verses.KJV: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.WEB: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
verses.ASV: Let that day be darkness; Let not God from above seek for it, Neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Torne-se aquele dia em trevas; Deus não lhe dê atenção desde acima, nem claridade brilhe sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Sea aquel día sombrío, y Dios no cuide de él desde arriba, ni claridad sobre él resplandezca.

verses.KJV: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.WEB: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.
verses.ASV: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own; Let a cloud dwell upon it; Let all that maketh black the day terrify it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reivindiquem-no para si trevas e sombra de morte; nuvens habitem sobre ele; a escuridão do dia o espante.
verses.RVR09: Aféenlo tinieblas y sombra de muerte; repose sobre él nublado, que lo haga horrible como caliginoso día.

verses.KJV: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.WEB: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.ASV: As for that night, let thick darkness seize upon it: Let it not rejoice among the days of the year; Let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tome a escuridão aquela noite; não seja contada entre os dias do ano, nem faça parte do número dos meses.
verses.RVR09: Ocupe la oscuridad aquella noche; no sea contada entre los días del año, ni venga en el número de los meses.

verses.KJV: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.WEB: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.ASV: Lo, let that night be barren; Let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah se aquela noite fosse solitária, e música de alegria não viesse a ela!
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh si fuere aquella noche solitaria, que no viniera canción alguna en ella!

verses.KJV: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
verses.WEB: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
verses.ASV: Let them curse it that curse the day, Who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amaldiçoem-na os que amaldiçoam o dia, os que se preparam para levantar seu pranto.
verses.RVR09: Maldíganla los que maldicen al día, los que se aprestan para levantar su llanto.

verses.KJV: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
verses.WEB: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,
verses.ASV: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark: Let it look for light, but have none; Neither let it behold the eyelids of the morning:
verses.ALMEIDA: Escureçam-se as estrelas de sua manhã; espere a luz, e não venha, e as pálpebras não vejam o amanhecer;
verses.RVR09: Oscurézcanse las estrellas de su alba; espere la luz, y no venga, ni vea los párpados de la mañana:

verses.KJV: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
verses.WEB: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
verses.ASV: Because it shut not up the doors of my [mother’s] womb, Nor hid trouble from mine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não fechou as portas do ventre onde eu estava, nem escondeu de meus olhos o sofrimento.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto no cerró las puertas del vientre donde yo estaba, ni escondió de mis ojos la miseria.

verses.KJV: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
verses.WEB: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
verses.ASV: Why died I not from the womb? Why did I not give up the ghost when my mother bare me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que eu não morri desde a madre, ou perdi a vida ao sair do ventre?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué no morí yo desde la matriz, o fuí traspasado en saliendo del vientre?

verses.KJV: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
verses.WEB: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
verses.ASV: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breasts, that I should suck?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que joelhos me receberam? E por que seios me amamentaram?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué me previnieron las rodillas? ¿y para qué las tetas que mamase?

verses.KJV: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
verses.WEB: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,
verses.ASV: For now should I have lain down and been quiet; I should have slept; then had I been at rest,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois agora eu jazeria e repousaria; dormiria, e então haveria repouso para mim;
verses.RVR09: Pues que ahora yaciera yo, y reposara; durmiera, y entonces tuviera reposo,

verses.KJV: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which build desolate places for themselves;
verses.WEB: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;
verses.ASV: With kings and counsellors of the earth, Who built up waste places for themselves;
verses.ALMEIDA: Com os reis e os conselheiros da terra, que edificavam para si os desertos;
verses.RVR09: Con los reyes y con los consejeros de la tierra, que edifican para sí los desiertos;

verses.KJV: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
verses.WEB: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;
verses.ASV: Or with princes that had gold, Who filled their houses with silver:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou com os príncipes que tinham ouro, que enchiam suas casas de prata.
verses.RVR09: O con los príncipes que poseían el oro, que henchían sus casas de plata.

verses.KJV: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
verses.WEB: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
verses.ASV: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, As infants that never saw light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou [por que] não fui como um aborto oculto, como as crianças que nunca viram a luz?
verses.RVR09: O ¿por qué no fuí escondido como aborto, como los pequeñitos que nunca vieron luz?

verses.KJV: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
verses.WEB: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
verses.ASV: There the wicked cease from troubling; And there the weary are at rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali os maus deixam de perturbar, e ali repousam os cansados de forças.
verses.RVR09: Allí los impíos dejan el perturbar, y allí descansan los de cansadas fuerzas.

verses.KJV: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
verses.WEB: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
verses.ASV: There the prisoners are at ease together; They hear not the voice of the taskmaster.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali os prisioneiros juntamente repousam; [e] não ouvem a voz do opressor.
verses.RVR09: Allí asimismo reposan los cautivos; no oyen la voz del exactor.

verses.KJV: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
verses.WEB: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.
verses.ASV: The small and the great are there: And the servant is free from his master.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali estão o pequeno e o grande; e o servo livre [está] de seu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Allí están el chico y el grande; y el siervo libre de su señor.

verses.KJV: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
verses.WEB: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
verses.ASV: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, And life unto the bitter in soul;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que se dá luz ao sofredor, e vida aos amargos de alma,
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué se da luz al trabajado, y vida á los de ánimo en amargura,

verses.KJV: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.WEB: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
verses.ASV: Who long for death, but it cometh not, And dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que esperam a morte, e ela não chega, e que a buscam mais que tesouros;
verses.RVR09: Que esperan la muerte, y ella no llega, aunque la buscan más que tesoros;

verses.KJV: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.WEB: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.ASV: Who rejoice exceedingly, And are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que saltam de alegram e ficam contentes quando acham a sepultura?
verses.RVR09: Que se alegran sobremanera, y se gozan, cuando hallan el sepulcro?

verses.KJV: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
verses.WEB: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
verses.ASV: [Why is light given] to a man whose way is hid, And whom God hath hedged in?
verses.ALMEIDA: [E também] ao homem cujo caminho é oculto, e a quem Deus [o] encobriu?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué al hombre que no sabe por donde vaya, y al cual Dios ha encerrado?

verses.KJV: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
verses.WEB: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
verses.ASV: For my sighing cometh before I eat, And my groanings are poured out like water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois antes do meu pão vem meu suspiro; e meus gemidos correm como águas.
verses.RVR09: Pues antes que mi pan viene mi suspiro; y mis gemidos corren como aguas.

verses.KJV: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verses.WEB: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.
verses.ASV: For the thing which I fear cometh upon me, And that which I am afraid of cometh unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois aquilo eu temia tanto veio a mim, e aquilo que tinha medo me aconteceu.
verses.RVR09: Porque el temor que me espantaba me ha venido, y hame acontecido lo que temía.

verses.KJV: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
verses.WEB: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”
verses.ASV: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; But trouble cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tenho tido descanso, nem tranquilidade, nem repouso; mas perturbação veio sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: No he tenido paz, no me aseguré, ni me estuve reposado; vínome no obstante turbación.

verses.KJV: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
verses.ASV: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Elifaz o temanita respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Eliphaz el Temanita, y dijo:

verses.KJV: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.WEB: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.ASV: If one assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tentarmos falar contigo, ficarás incomodado? Mas quem poderia deter as palavras?
verses.RVR09: Si probáremos á hablarte, serte ha molesto; mas ¿quién podrá detener las palabras?

verses.KJV: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.WEB: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
verses.ASV: Behold, thou hast instructed many, And thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que tu ensinavas a muitos, e fortalecias as mãos fracas;
verses.RVR09: He aquí, tú enseñabas á muchos, y las manos flacas corroborabas;

verses.KJV: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.WEB: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.
verses.ASV: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, And thou hast made firm the feeble knees.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tuas palavras levantavam aos que tropeçavam, e fortificavas os joelhos que desfaleciam.
verses.RVR09: Al que vacilaba, enderezaban tus palabras, y esforzabas las rodillas que decaían.

verses.KJV: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.WEB: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
verses.ASV: But now it is come unto thee, and thou faintest; It toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora [isso] que aconteceu contigo, tu te cansas; e quando [isso] te tocou, te perturbas.
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora que el mal sobre ti ha venido, te es duro; y cuando ha llegado hasta ti, te turbas.

verses.KJV: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
verses.WEB: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
verses.ASV: Is not thy fear [of God] thy confidence, [And] the integrity of thy ways thy hope?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não era o teu temor [a Deus] a tua confiança, e a integridade dos teus caminhos tua esperança?
verses.RVR09: ¿Es este tu temor, tu confianza, tu esperanza, y la perfección de tus caminos?

verses.KJV: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.WEB: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
verses.ASV: Remember, I pray thee, who [ever] perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te agora, qual foi o inocente que pereceu? E onde os corretos foram destruídos?
verses.RVR09: Recapacita ahora, ¿quién que fuera inocente se perdiera? y ¿en dónde los rectos fueron cortados?

verses.KJV: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.WEB: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.
verses.ASV: According as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, And sow trouble, reap the same.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como eu tenho visto, os que lavram injustiça e semeiam opressão colhem o mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Como yo he visto, los que aran iniquidad y siembran injuria, la siegan.

verses.KJV: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.WEB: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
verses.ASV: By the breath of God they perish, And by the blast of his anger are they consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o sopro de Deus eles perecem, e pelo vento de sua ira são consumidos.
verses.RVR09: Perecen por el aliento de Dios, y por el espíritu de su furor son consumidos.

verses.KJV: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.WEB: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.ASV: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rugido do leão, a voz do leão feroz, e os dentes dos leões jovens são quebrantados.
verses.RVR09: El bramido del león, y la voz del león, y los dientes de los leoncillos son quebrantados.

verses.KJV: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.WEB: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
verses.ASV: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, And the whelps of the lioness are scattered abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: O leão velho perece por falta de presa, e os filhotes da leoa se dispersam.
verses.RVR09: El león viejo perece por falta de presa, y los hijos del león son esparcidos.

verses.KJV: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
verses.WEB: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
verses.ASV: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a whisper thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma palavra me foi dita em segredo, e meu ouvidos escutaram um sussurro dela.
verses.RVR09: El negocio también me era á mí oculto; mas mi oído ha percibido algo de ello.

verses.KJV: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.WEB: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
verses.ASV: In thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.ALMEIDA: Em imaginações de visões noturnas, quando o sono profundo cai sobre os homens,
verses.RVR09: En imaginaciones de visiones nocturnas, cuando el sueño cae sobre los hombres,

verses.KJV: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.WEB: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
verses.ASV: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones to shake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Espanto e tremor vieram sobre mim, que espantou todos os meus ossos.
verses.RVR09: Sobrevínome un espanto y un temblor, que estremeció todos mis huesos:

verses.KJV: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.WEB: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
verses.ASV: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair of my flesh stood up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então um vento passou por diante de mim, que fez arrepiar os pelos de minha carne.
verses.RVR09: Y un espíritu pasó por delante de mí, que hizo se erizara el pelo de mi carne.

verses.KJV: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
verses.WEB: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
verses.ASV: It stood still, but I could not discern the appearance thereof; A form was before mine eyes: [There was] silence, and I heard a voice, [saying],
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele parou, mas não reconheci sua feição; uma figura estava diante de meus olhos, e ouvi uma voz quieta, [que dizia] :
verses.RVR09: Paróse un fantasma delante de mis ojos, cuyo rostro yo no conocí, y quedo, oí que decía:

verses.KJV: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.WEB: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
verses.ASV: Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
verses.ALMEIDA: Seria o ser humano mais justo que Deus? Seria o homem mais puro que seu Criador?
verses.RVR09: ¿Si será el hombre más justo que Dios? ¿si será el varón más limpio que el que lo hizo?

verses.KJV: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.WEB: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
verses.ASV: Behold, he putteth no trust in his servants; And his angels he chargeth with folly:
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que ele não confia em seus servos, e considera seus anjos como loucos,
verses.RVR09: He aquí que en sus siervos no confía, y notó necedad en sus ángeles;

verses.KJV: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
verses.WEB: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
verses.ASV: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Who are crushed before the moth!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto mais naqueles que habitam em casas de lodo, cujo fundamento está no pó, e são esmagáveis como a traça!
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuánto más en los que habitan en casas de lodo, cuyo fundamento está en el polvo, y que serán quebrantados de la polilla!

verses.KJV: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.WEB: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
verses.ASV: Betwixt morning and evening they are destroyed: They perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde a manhã até a tarde são despedaçados, e perecem sempre, sem que ninguém perceba.
verses.RVR09: De la mañana á la tarde son quebrantados, y se pierden para siempre, sin haber quien lo considere.

verses.KJV: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.WEB: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
verses.ASV: Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso sua excelência não se perde com eles mesmos? Eles morrem sem sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: ¿Su hermosura, no se pierde con ellos mismos? Mueren, y sin sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
verses.WEB: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
verses.ASV: Call now; is there any that will answer thee? And to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?
verses.ALMEIDA: Clama agora! Haverá alguém que te responda? E a qual dos santos te voltarás?
verses.RVR09: AHORA pues da voces, si habrá quien te responda; ¿y á cuál de los santos te volverás?

verses.KJV: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.WEB: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
verses.ASV: For vexation killeth the foolish man, And jealousy slayeth the silly one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a ira acaba com o louco, e o zelo mata o tolo.
verses.RVR09: Es cierto que al necio la ira lo mata, y al codicioso consume la envidia.

verses.KJV: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.WEB: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.ASV: I have seen the foolish taking root: But suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vi ao louco lançar raízes, porém logo amaldiçoei sua habitação.
verses.RVR09: Yo he visto al necio que echaba raíces, y en la misma hora maldije su habitación.

verses.KJV: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
verses.WEB: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
verses.ASV: His children are far from safety, And they are crushed in the gate, Neither is there any to deliver them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus filhos estarão longe da salvação; na porta são despedaçados, e não há quem os livre.
verses.RVR09: Sus hijos estarán lejos de la salud, y en la puerta serán quebrantados, y no habrá quien los libre.

verses.KJV: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.WEB: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
verses.ASV: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, And taketh it even out of the thorns; And the snare gapeth for their substance.
verses.ALMEIDA: O faminto devora sua colheita, e a tira até dentre os espinhos; e o assaltante traga sua riqueza.
verses.RVR09: Su mies comerán los hambrientos, y sacaránla de entre las espinas, y los sedientos beberán su hacienda.

verses.KJV: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.WEB: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.ASV: For affliction cometh not forth from the dust, Neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a aflição não procede do pó da terra, nem a opressão brota do chão.
verses.RVR09: Porque la iniquidad no sale del polvo, ni la molestia brota de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.WEB: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.ASV: But man is born unto trouble, As the sparks fly upward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o ser humano nasce para a opressão, assim como as faíscas das brasas se levantam a voar.
verses.RVR09: Empero como las centellas se levantan para volar por el aire, así el hombre nace para la aflicción.

verses.KJV: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
verses.WEB: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
verses.ASV: But as for me, I would seek unto God, And unto God would I commit my cause;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu buscaria a Deus, e a ele confiaria minha causa;
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente yo buscaría á Dios, y depositaría en él mis negocios:

verses.KJV: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.WEB: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
verses.ASV: Who doeth great things and unsearchable, Marvellous things without number:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Pois] ele é o que faz coisas grandiosas e incompreensíveis, e inúmeras maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: El cual hace cosas grandes é inescrutables, y maravillas que no tienen cuento:

verses.KJV: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
verses.WEB: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;
verses.ASV: Who giveth rain upon the earth, And sendeth waters upon the fields;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o que dá a chuva sobre a face da terra, e envia águas sobre os campos.
verses.RVR09: Que da la lluvia sobre la haz de la tierra, y envía las aguas por los campos:

verses.KJV: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.WEB: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
verses.ASV: So that he setteth up on high those that are low, And those that mourn are exalted to safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele põe os humildes em lugares altos, para que os sofredores sejam postos em segurança.
verses.RVR09: Que pone los humildes en altura, y los enlutados son levantados á salud:

verses.KJV: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
verses.WEB: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
verses.ASV: He frustrateth the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele frustra os planos dos astutos, para que suas mãos nada consigam executar.
verses.RVR09: Que frustra los pensamientos de los astutos, para que sus manos no hagan nada:

verses.KJV: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.WEB: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
verses.ASV: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; And the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele prende aos sábios em sua própria astúcia; para que o conselho dos perversos seja derrubado.
verses.RVR09: Que prende á los sabios en la astucia de ellos, y el consejo de los perversos es entontecido;

verses.KJV: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.WEB: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
verses.ASV: They meet with darkness in the day-time, And grope at noonday as in the night.
verses.ALMEIDA: De dia eles se encontram com as trevas, e ao meio-dia andam apalpando como de noite.
verses.RVR09: De día se topan con tinieblas, y en mitad del día andan á tientas como de noche:

verses.KJV: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.WEB: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
verses.ASV: But he saveth from the sword of their mouth, Even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém livra ao necessitado da espada de suas bocas, e da mão do violento.
verses.RVR09: Y libra de la espada al pobre, de la boca de los impíos, y de la mano violenta;

verses.KJV: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.WEB: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
verses.ASV: So the poor hath hope, And iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele é esperança para o necessitado, e a injustiça tapa sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Pues es esperanza al menesteroso, y la iniquidad cerrará su boca.

verses.KJV: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.WEB: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
verses.ASV: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que bem-aventurado é o homem a quem Deus corrige; portanto não rejeites o castigo do Todo-Poderoso.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, bienaventurado es el hombre á quien Dios castiga: por tanto no menosprecies la corrección del Todopoderoso.

verses.KJV: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.WEB: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
verses.ASV: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up; He woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele faz a chaga, mas também põe o curativo; ele fere, mas suas mãos curam.
verses.RVR09: Porque él es el que hace la llaga, y él la vendará: él hiere, y sus manos curan.

verses.KJV: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.WEB: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
verses.ASV: He will deliver thee in six troubles; Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seis angústias ele te livrará, e em sete o mal não te tocará.
verses.RVR09: En seis tribulaciones te librará, y en la séptima no te tocará el mal.

verses.KJV: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.WEB: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
verses.ASV: In famine he will redeem thee from death; And in war from the power of the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na fome ele te livrará da morte, e na guerra [livrará] do poder da espada.
verses.RVR09: En el hambre te redimirá de la muerte, y en la guerra de las manos de la espada.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.WEB: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue; Neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do açoite da língua estarás encoberto; e não temerás a destruição quando ela vier.
verses.RVR09: Del azote de la lengua serás encubierto; ni temerás de la destrucción cuando viniere.

verses.KJV: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.WEB: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
verses.ASV: At destruction and dearth thou shalt laugh; Neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu rirás da destruição e da fome, e não temerás os animais da terra.
verses.RVR09: De la destrucción y del hambre te reirás, y no temerás de las bestias del campo:

verses.KJV: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.WEB: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.
verses.ASV: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field; And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois até com as pedras do campo terás teu pacto, e os animais do campo serão pacíficos contigo.
verses.RVR09: Pues aun con las piedras del campo tendrás tu concierto, y las bestias del campo te serán pacíficas.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
verses.WEB: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; And thou shalt visit thy fold, and shalt miss nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saberás que há paz em tua tenda; e visitarás tua habitação, e não falharás.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrás que hay paz en tu tienda; y visitarás tu morada, y no pecarás.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.WEB: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, And thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também saberás que tua semente se multiplicará, e teus descendentes serão como a erva da terra.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo echarás de ver que tu simiente es mucha, y tu prole como la hierba de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
verses.WEB: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, Like as a shock of grain cometh in in its season.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na velhice virás à sepultura, como o amontoado de trigo que se recolhe a seu tempo.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrás en la vejez á la sepultura, como el montón de trigo que se coge á su tiempo.

verses.KJV: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
verses.WEB: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
verses.ASV: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; Hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que é isto o que temos constatado, e assim é; ouve-o, e pensa nisso tu para teu [bem] .
verses.RVR09: He aquí lo que hemos inquirido, lo cual es así: óyelo, y juzga tú para contigo.

verses.KJV: But Job answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job y dijo:

verses.KJV: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
verses.WEB: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
verses.ASV: Oh that my vexation were but weighed, And all my calamity laid in the balances!
verses.ALMEIDA: Oh se pesassem justamente minha aflição, e meu tormento juntamente fosse posto em uma balança!
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh si pesasen al justo mi queja y mi tormento, y se alzasen igualmente en balanza!

verses.KJV: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.
verses.WEB: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.
verses.ASV: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas: Therefore have my words been rash.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois na verdade seria mais pesada que a areia dos mares; por isso minhas palavras têm sido impulsivas.
verses.RVR09: Porque pesaría aquél más que la arena del mar: y por tanto mis palabras son cortadas.

verses.KJV: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
verses.WEB: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.
verses.ASV: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, The poison whereof my spirit drinketh up: The terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque as flechas do Todo-Poderoso estão em mim, cujo veneno meu espírito bebe; e temores de Deus me atacam.
verses.RVR09: Porque las saetas del Todopoderoso están en mí, cuyo veneno bebe mi espíritu; y terrores de Dios me combaten.

verses.KJV: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
verses.WEB: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?
verses.ASV: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o asno selvagem zurra junto à erva, ou o boi berra junto a seu pasto?
verses.RVR09: ¿Acaso gime el asno montés junto á la hierba? ¿muge el buey junto á su pasto?

verses.KJV: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
verses.WEB: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
verses.ASV: Can that which hath no savor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso se come o insípido sem sal? Ou há gosto na clara do ovo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Comeráse lo desabrido sin sal? ¿ó habrá gusto en la clara del huevo?

verses.KJV: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
verses.WEB: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.
verses.ASV: My soul refuseth to touch [them]; They are as loathsome food to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma se recusa tocar [essas coisas] ,que são para mim como comida detestável.
verses.RVR09: Las cosas que mi alma no quería tocar, por los dolores son mi comida.

verses.KJV: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!
verses.WEB: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,
verses.ASV: Oh that I might have my request; And that God would grant [me] the thing that I long for!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah se meu pedido fosse realizado, e se Deus [me] desse o que espero!
verses.RVR09: ¡Quién me diera que viniese mi petición, y que Dios me otorgase lo que espero;

verses.KJV: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.WEB: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.ASV: Even that it would please God to crush me; That he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.ALMEIDA: Que Deus me destruísse; ele soltasse sua mão, e acabasse comigo!
verses.RVR09: Y que pluguiera á Dios quebrantarme; que soltara su mano, y me deshiciera!

verses.KJV: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
verses.WEB: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.ASV: And be it still my consolation, Yea, let me exult in pain that spareth not, That I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto ainda seria meu consolo, um alívio em meio ao tormento que não [me] poupa; pois eu não tenho escondido as palavras do Santo.
verses.RVR09: Y sería aún mi consuelo, si me asaltase con dolor sin dar más tregua, que yo no he escondido las palabras del Santo.

verses.KJV: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?
verses.WEB: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
verses.ASV: What is my strength, that I should wait? And what is mine end, that I should be patient?
verses.ALMEIDA: Qual é minha força para que eu espere? E qual meu fim, para que eu prolongue minha vida?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuál es mi fortaleza para esperar aún? ¿y cuál mi fin para dilatar mi vida?

verses.KJV: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?
verses.WEB: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?
verses.ASV: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of brass?
verses.ALMEIDA: É, por acaso, a minha força a força de pedras? Minha carne é de bronze?
verses.RVR09: ¿Es mi fortaleza la de las piedras? ¿ó mi carne, es de acero?

verses.KJV: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
verses.WEB: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?
verses.ASV: Is it not that I have no help in me, And that wisdom is driven quite from me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho eu como ajudar a mim mesmo, se todo auxílio me foi tirado?
verses.RVR09: ¿No me ayudo cuanto puedo, y el poder me falta del todo?

verses.KJV: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
verses.WEB: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
verses.ASV: To him that is ready to faint kindness [should be showed] from his friend; Even to him that forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao aflito, seus amigos deviam ser misericordiosos, mesmo se ele tivesse abandonado o temor ao Todo-Poderoso.
verses.RVR09: El atribulado es consolado de su compañero: mas hase abandonado el temor del Omnipotente.

verses.KJV: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;
verses.WEB: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
verses.ASV: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, As the channel of brooks that pass away;
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus irmãos foram traiçoeiros comigo, como ribeiro, como correntes de águas que transbordam,
verses.RVR09: Mis hermanos han mentido cual arroyo: pasáronse como corrientes impetuosas,

verses.KJV: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:
verses.WEB: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
verses.ASV: Which are black by reason of the ice, [And] wherein the snow hideth itself:
verses.ALMEIDA: Que estão escurecidas pelo gelo, e nelas se esconde a neve;
verses.RVR09: Que están escondidas por la helada, y encubiertas con nieve;

verses.KJV: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.WEB: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.ASV: What time they wax warm, they vanish; When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que no tempo do calor se secam e, ao se aquecerem, desaparecem de seu lugar;
verses.RVR09: Que al tiempo del calor son deshechas, y en calentándose, desaparecen de su lugar;

verses.KJV: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
verses.WEB: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.
verses.ASV: The caravans [that travel] by the way of them turn aside; They go up into the waste, and perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os cursos de seus caminhos se desviam; vão se minguando, e perecem.
verses.RVR09: Apártanse de la senda de su rumbo, van menguando y piérdense.

verses.KJV: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.WEB: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.ASV: The caravans of Tema looked, The companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: As caravanas de Temã as veem; os viajantes de Sabá esperam por elas.
verses.RVR09: Miraron los caminantes de Temán, los caminantes de Saba esperaron en ellas:

verses.KJV: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
verses.WEB: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.
verses.ASV: They were put to shame because they had hoped; They came thither, and were confounded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foram envergonhados por aquilo em que confiavam; e ao chegarem ali, ficaram desapontados.
verses.RVR09: Mas fueron avergonzados por su esperanza; porque vinieron hasta ellas, y halláronse confusos.

verses.KJV: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.
verses.WEB: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.
verses.ASV: For now ye are nothing; Ye see a terror, and are afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, vós vos tornastes semelhantes a elas; pois vistes o terror, e temestes.
verses.RVR09: Ahora ciertamente como ellas sois vosotros: que habéis visto el tormento, y teméis.

verses.KJV: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
verses.WEB: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?
verses.ASV: Did I say, Give unto me? Or, Offer a present for me of your substance?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eu disse: Trazei-me [algo] ? Ou: Dai presente a mim de vossa riqueza?
verses.RVR09: ¿Os he dicho yo: Traedme, y pagad por mí de vuestra hacienda;

verses.KJV: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
verses.WEB: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?
verses.ASV: Or, Deliver me from the adversary’s hand? Or, Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou: Livrai-me da mão do opressor? Ou: Resgatai-me das mãos dos violentos?
verses.RVR09: Y libradme de la mano del opresor, y redimidme del poder de los violentos?

verses.KJV: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.WEB: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.
verses.ASV: Teach me, and I will hold my peace; And cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensinai-me, e eu [me] calarei; e fazei-me entender em que errei.
verses.RVR09: Enseñadme, y yo callaré: y hacedme entender en qué he errado.

verses.KJV: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
verses.WEB: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
verses.ASV: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what doth it reprove?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como são fortes as palavras de boa razão! Mas o que vossa repreensão reprova?
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuán fuertes son las palabras de rectitud! Mas ¿qué reprende el que reprende de vosotros?

verses.KJV: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
verses.WEB: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?
verses.ASV: Do ye think to reprove words, Seeing that the speeches of one that is desperate are as wind?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pretendeis repreender palavras, sendo que os argumentos do desesperado são como o vento?
verses.RVR09: ¿Pensáis censurar palabras, y los discursos de un desesperado, que son como el viento?

verses.KJV: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.
verses.WEB: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.
