verses.ASV: Yea, ye would cast [lots] upon the fatherless, And make merchandise of your friend.
verses.ALMEIDA: De fato vós lançaríeis [sortes] sobre o órfão, e venderíeis vosso amigo.
verses.RVR09: También os arrojáis sobre el huérfano, y hacéis hoyo delante de vuestro amigo.

verses.KJV: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.
verses.WEB: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.
verses.ASV: Now therefore be pleased to look upon me; For surely I shall not lie to your face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, disponde-vos a olhar para mim; e [vede] se eu minto diante de vós.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, si queréis, mirad en mí, y ved si miento delante de vosotros.

verses.KJV: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
verses.WEB: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
verses.ASV: Return, I pray you, let there be no injustice; Yea, return again, my cause is righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mudai de opinião, pois, e não haja perversidade; mudai de opinião, pois minha justiça continua.
verses.RVR09: Tornad ahora, y no haya iniquidad; volved aún á considerar mi justicia en esto.

verses.KJV: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
verses.WEB: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
verses.ASV: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern mischievous things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Há perversidade em minha língua? Não poderia meu paladar discernir as coisas más?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hay iniquidad en mi lengua? ¿no puede mi paladar discernir las cosas depravadas?

verses.KJV: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?
verses.WEB: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?
verses.ASV: Is there not a warfare to man upon earth? And are not his days like the days of a hireling?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o ser humano não tem um trabalho duro sobre a terra, e não são seus dias como os dias de um assalariado?
verses.RVR09: CIERTAMENTE tiempo limitado tiene el hombre sobre la tierra, y sus días son como los días del jornalero.

verses.KJV: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
verses.WEB: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,
verses.ASV: As a servant that earnestly desireth the shadow, And as a hireling that looketh for his wages:
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o servo suspira pela sombra, e como o assalariado espera por seu pagamento,
verses.RVR09: Como el siervo anhela la sombra, y como el jornalero espera el reposo de su trabajo:

verses.KJV: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.WEB: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.ASV: So am I made to possess months of misery, And wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também me deram por herança meses inúteis, e me prepararam noites de sofrimento.
verses.RVR09: Así poseo yo meses de vanidad, y noches de trabajo me dieron por cuenta.

verses.KJV: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
verses.WEB: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.
verses.ASV: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? And I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu me deito, pergunto: Quando me levantarei? Mas a noite se prolonga, e me canso de me virar [na cama] até o amanhecer.
verses.RVR09: Cuando estoy acostado, digo: ¿Cuándo me levantaré? Y mide mi corazón la noche, y estoy harto de devaneos hasta el alba.

verses.KJV: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
verses.WEB: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
verses.ASV: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; My skin closeth up, and breaketh out afresh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha carne está coberta de vermes e de crostas de pó; meu pele está rachada e horrível.
verses.RVR09: Mi carne está vestida de gusanos, y de costras de polvo; mi piel hendida y abominable.

verses.KJV: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
verses.WEB: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
verses.ASV: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, And are spent without hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus dias são mais rápidos que a lançadeira do tecelão, e perecem sem esperança.
verses.RVR09: Y mis días fueron más ligeros que la lanzadera del tejedor, y fenecieron sin esperanza.

verses.KJV: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
verses.WEB: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
verses.ASV: Oh remember that my life is a breath: Mine eye shall no more see good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te que minha vida é um sopro; meus olhos não voltarão a ver o bem.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate que mi vida es viento, y que mis ojos no volverán á ver el bien.

verses.KJV: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
verses.WEB: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
verses.ASV: The eye of him that seeth me shall behold me no more; Thine eyes shall be upon me, but I shall not be.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos dos que me veem não me verão mais; teus olhos estarão sobre mim, porém deixarei de existir.
verses.RVR09: Los ojos de los que me ven, no me verán más: tus ojos sobre mí, y dejaré de ser.

verses.KJV: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
verses.WEB: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.
verses.ASV: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away, So he that goeth down to Sheol shall come up no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: A nuvem se esvaece, e passa; assim também quem desce ao Xeol nunca voltará a subir.
verses.RVR09: La nube se consume, y se va: así el que desciende al sepulcro no subirá;

verses.KJV: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
verses.WEB: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
verses.ASV: He shall return no more to his house, Neither shall his place know him any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca mais voltará à sua casa, nem seu lugar o conhecerá.
verses.RVR09: No tornará más á su casa, ni su lugar le conocerá más.

verses.KJV: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.WEB: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.ASV: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu não calarei minha boca; falarei na angústia do meu espírito, e me queixarei na amargura de minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto yo no reprimiré mi boca; hablaré en la angustia de mi espíritu, y quejaréme con la amargura de mi alma.

verses.KJV: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
verses.WEB: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
verses.ASV: Am I a sea, or a sea-monster, That thou settest a watch over me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso sou eu o mar, ou um monstro marinho, para que me ponhas guarda?
verses.RVR09: ¿Soy yo la mar, ó ballena, que me pongas guarda?

verses.KJV: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaints;
verses.WEB: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’
verses.ASV: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, My couch shall ease my complaint;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu digo: Minha cama me consolará; meu leito aliviará minhas queixa,
verses.RVR09: Cuando digo: Mi cama me consolará, mi cama atenuará mis quejas;

verses.KJV: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
verses.WEB: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,
verses.ASV: Then thou scarest me with dreams, And terrifiest me through visions:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tu me espantas com sonhos, e me assombras com visões.
verses.RVR09: Entonces me quebrantarás con sueños, y me turbarás con visiones.

verses.KJV: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
verses.WEB: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
verses.ASV: So that my soul chooseth strangling, And death rather than [these] my bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso minha alma preferia a asfixia [e] a morte, mais que meus ossos.
verses.RVR09: Y así mi alma tuvo por mejor el ahogamiento, y quiso la muerte más que mis huesos.

verses.KJV: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.
verses.WEB: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
verses.ASV: I loathe [my life]; I would not live alway: Let me alone; for my days are vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Odeio [a minha vida] ; não viverei para sempre; deixa-me, pois que meus dias são inúteis.
verses.RVR09: Aburríme: no he de vivir yo para siempre; déjame, pues que mis días son vanidad.

verses.KJV: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
verses.WEB: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
verses.ASV: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him, And that thou shouldest set thy mind upon him,
verses.ALMEIDA: O que é o ser humano, para que tanto o estimes, e ponhas sobre ele teu coração,
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué es el hombre, para que lo engrandezcas, y que pongas sobre él tu corazón,

verses.KJV: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
verses.WEB: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?
verses.ASV: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, And try him every moment?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o visites a cada manhã, e a cada momento o proves?
verses.RVR09: Y lo visites todas las mañanas, y todos los momentos lo pruebes?

verses.KJV: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
verses.WEB: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
verses.ASV: How long wilt thou not look away from me, Nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando não me deixarás, nem me liberarás até que eu engula minha saliva?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo no me dejarás, ni me soltarás hasta que trague mi saliva?

verses.KJV: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
verses.WEB: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?
verses.ASV: If I have sinned, what do I unto thee, O thou watcher of men? Why hast thou set me as a mark for thee, So that I am a burden to myself?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se pequei, o eu que te fiz, ó Guarda dos homens? Por que me fizeste de alvo de dardos, para que eu seja pesado para mim mesmo?
verses.RVR09: Pequé, ¿qué te haré, oh Guarda de los hombres? ¿por qué me has puesto contrario á ti, y que á mí mismo sea pesado?

verses.KJV: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away my iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
verses.WEB: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”
verses.ASV: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? For now shall I lie down in the dust; And thou wilt seek me diligently, but I shall not be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que não perdoas minha transgressão, e tiras minha maldade? Porque agora dormirei no pó, e me buscarás de manhã, porém não mais existirei.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y por qué no quitas mi rebelión, y perdonas mi iniquidad? porque ahora dormiré en el polvo, y si me buscares de mañana, ya no seré.

verses.KJV: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.WEB: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
verses.ASV: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Bildade, o suíta, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Bildad Suhita, y dijo:

verses.KJV: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
verses.WEB: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
verses.ASV: How long wilt thou speak these things? And [how long] shall the words of thy mouth be [like] a mighty wind?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando falarás tais coisas, e as palavras de tua boca serão como um vento impetuoso?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo hablarás tales cosas, y las palabras de tu boca serán como un viento fuerte?

verses.KJV: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.WEB: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
verses.ASV: Doth God pervert justice? Or doth the Almighty pervert righteousness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso Deus perverteria o direito, ou o Todo-Poderoso perverteria a justiça?
verses.RVR09: ¿Acaso pervertirá Dios el derecho, ó el Todopoderoso pervertirá la justicia?

verses.KJV: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
verses.WEB: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
verses.ASV: If thy children have sinned against him, And he hath delivered them into the hand of their transgression;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se teus filhos pecaram contra ele, ele também os entregou ao castigo por sua transgressão.
verses.RVR09: Si tus hijos pecaron contra él, él los echó en el lugar de su pecado.

verses.KJV: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.WEB: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
verses.ASV: If thou wouldest seek diligently unto God, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tu buscares a Deus com empenho, e pedires misericórdia ao Todo-Poderoso;
verses.RVR09: Si tú de mañana buscares á Dios, y rogares al Todopoderoso;

verses.KJV: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.WEB: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
verses.ASV: If thou wert pure and upright: Surely now he would awake for thee, And make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se fores puro e correto, certamente logo ele se levantará em teu favor, e restaurará a morada de tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Si fueres limpio y derecho, cierto luego se despertará sobre ti, y hará próspera la morada de tu justicia.

verses.KJV: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
verses.WEB: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
verses.ASV: And though thy beginning was small, Yet thy latter end would greatly increase.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que teu princípio seja pequeno, o teu fim será muito grandioso.
verses.RVR09: Y tu principio habrá sido pequeño, y tu postrimería acrecerá en gran manera.

verses.KJV: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
verses.WEB: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
verses.ASV: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, And apply thyself to that which their fathers have searched out
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois pergunta agora à geração passada, e considera o que seus pais descobriram.
verses.RVR09: Porque pregunta ahora á la edad pasada, y disponte para inquirir de sus padres de ellos;

verses.KJV: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
verses.WEB: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
verses.ASV: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days upon earth are a shadow);
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nós somos de ontem e nada sabemos, pois nossos dias sobre a terra são como a sombra.
verses.RVR09: Pues nosotros somos de ayer, y no sabemos, siendo nuestros días sobre la tierra como sombra.

verses.KJV: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.WEB: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.ASV: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, And utter words out of their heart?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eles não te ensinarão, e te dirão, e falarão palavras de seu coração?
verses.RVR09: ¿No te enseñarán ellos, te dirán, y de su corazón sacarán palabras?

verses.KJV: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
verses.WEB: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
verses.ASV: Can the rush grow up without mire? Can the flag grow without water?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pode o papiro crescer sem lodo? Ou pode o junco ficar maior sem água?
verses.RVR09: ¿Crece el junco sin lodo? ¿crece el prado sin agua?

verses.KJV: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
verses.WEB: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
verses.ASV: Whilst it is yet in its greenness, [and] not cut down, It withereth before any [other] herb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estando ele ainda verde, sem ter sido cortado, ainda assim se seca antes de toda erva.
verses.RVR09: Aun él en su verdor no será cortado, y antes de toda hierba se secará.

verses.KJV: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:
verses.WEB: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
verses.ASV: So are the paths of all that forget God; And the hope of the godless man shall perish:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim são os caminhos de todos os que esquecem de Deus; e a esperança do corrupto perecerá;
verses.RVR09: Tales son los caminos de todos los que olvidan á Dios: y la esperanza del impío perecerá:

verses.KJV: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.
verses.WEB: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.
verses.ASV: Whose confidence shall break in sunder, And whose trust is a spider’s web.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua esperança será frustrada, e sua confiança será como a teia de aranha.
verses.RVR09: Porque su esperanza será cortada, y su confianza es casa de araña.

verses.KJV: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.WEB: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
verses.ASV: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: He shall hold fast thereby, but it shall not endure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se apoiará em sua casa, mas ela não ficará firme; ele se apegará a ela, mas ela não ficará de pé.
verses.RVR09: Apoyaráse él sobre su casa, mas no permanecerá en pie; atendráse á ella, mas no se afirmará.

verses.KJV: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
verses.WEB: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
verses.ASV: He is green before the sun, And his shoots go forth over his garden.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele está bem regado diante do sol, e seus ramos brotam por cima de sua horta;
verses.RVR09: A manera de un árbol, está verde delante del sol, y sus renuevos salen sobre su huerto;

verses.KJV: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.
verses.WEB: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
verses.ASV: His roots are wrapped about the [stone]-heap, He beholdeth the place of stones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas raízes se entrelaçam junto à fonte, olhando para o pedregal.
verses.RVR09: Vanse entretejiendo sus raíces junto á una fuente, y enlazándose hasta un lugar pedregoso.

verses.KJV: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
verses.WEB: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
verses.ASV: If he be destroyed from his place, Then it shall deny him, [saying], I have not seen thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se lhe arrancarem de seu lugar, este o negará, [dizendo] : Nunca te vi.
verses.RVR09: Si le arrancaren de su lugar, éste negarále entonces, diciendo: Nunca te vi.

verses.KJV: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
verses.WEB: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.
verses.ASV: Behold, this is the joy of his way; And out of the earth shall others spring.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que este é o prazer de seu caminho; e do solo outros brotarão.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente éste será el gozo de su camino; y de la tierra de donde se traspusiere, nacerán otros.

verses.KJV: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
verses.WEB: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
verses.ASV: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, Neither will he uphold the evil-doers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que Deus não rejeita ao íntegro, nem segura pela mão aos malfeitores.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, Dios no aborrece al perfecto, ni toma la mano de los malignos.

verses.KJV: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verses.WEB: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
verses.ASV: He will yet fill thy mouth with laughter, And thy lips with shouting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda ele encherá tua boca de riso, e teus lábios de júbilo.
verses.RVR09: Aun henchirá tu boca de risa, y tus labios de júbilo.

verses.KJV: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.WEB: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
verses.ASV: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; And the tent of the wicked shall be no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que te odeiam se vestirão de vergonha, e nunca mais haverá tenda de perversos.
verses.RVR09: Los que te aborrecen, serán vestidos de confusión; y la habitación de los impíos perecerá.

verses.KJV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job, y dijo:

verses.KJV: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
verses.WEB: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
verses.ASV: Of a truth I know that it is so: But how can man be just with God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Na verdade sei que é assim; mas como pode o ser humano ser justo diante de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente yo conozco que es así: ¿y cómo se justificará el hombre con Dios?

verses.KJV: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
verses.WEB: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
verses.ASV: If he be pleased to contend with him, He cannot answer him one of a thousand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda se quisesse disputar com ele, não conseguiria lhe responder uma coisa sequer em mil.
verses.RVR09: Si quisiere contender con él, no le podrá responder á una cosa de mil.

verses.KJV: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
verses.WEB: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
verses.ASV: [He is] wise in heart, and mighty in strength: Who hath hardened himself against him, and prospered?—
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é sábio de coração, e poderoso em forças. Quem se endureceu contra ele, e teve paz?
verses.RVR09: El es sabio de corazón, y poderoso en fortaleza: ¿quién se endureció contra él, y quedó en paz?

verses.KJV: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
verses.WEB: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
verses.ASV: [Him] that removeth the mountains, and they know it not, When he overturneth them in his anger;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele transporta as montanhas sem que o saibam; e as transtorna em seu furor.
verses.RVR09: Que arranca los montes con su furor, y no conocen quién los trastornó:

verses.KJV: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
verses.WEB: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
verses.ASV: That shaketh the earth out of its place, And the pillars thereof tremble;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele remove a terra de seu lugar, e faz suas colunas tremerem.
verses.RVR09: Que remueve la tierra de su lugar, y hace temblar sus columnas:

verses.KJV: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
verses.WEB: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
verses.ASV: That commandeth the sun, and it riseth not, And sealeth up the stars;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele dá ordem ao sol, e ele não brilha; e sela as estrelas.
verses.RVR09: Que manda al sol, y no sale; y sella las estrellas:

verses.KJV: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
verses.WEB: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
verses.ASV: That alone stretcheth out the heavens, And treadeth upon the waves of the sea;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o que sozinho estende os céus, e anda sobre as alturas do mar.
verses.RVR09: El que extiende solo los cielos, y anda sobre las alturas de la mar:

verses.KJV: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
verses.WEB: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
verses.ASV: That maketh the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, And the chambers of the south;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o que fez a Usra, o Órion, as Plêiades, e as constelações do sul.
verses.RVR09: El que hizo el Arcturo, y el Orión, y las Pléyadas, y los lugares secretos del mediodía:

verses.KJV: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
verses.WEB: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
verses.ASV: That doeth great things past finding out, Yea, marvellous things without number.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o que faz coisas grandes e incompreensíveis, e inúmeras maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: El que hace cosas grandes é incomprensibles, y maravillosas, sin número.

verses.KJV: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
verses.WEB: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
verses.ASV: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: He passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que ele passa diante de mim, sem que eu não o veja; ele passará diante de mim, sem que eu saiba.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que él pasará delante de mí, y yo no lo veré; y pasará, y no lo entenderé.

verses.KJV: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.WEB: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.ASV: Behold, he seizeth [the prey], who can hinder him? Who will say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que, quando ele toma, quem pode lhe impedir? Quem poderá lhe dizer: O que estás fazendo?
verses.RVR09: He aquí, arrebatará; ¿quién le hará restituir? ¿Quién le dirá, Qué haces?

verses.KJV: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
verses.WEB: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
verses.ASV: God will not withdraw his anger; The helpers of Rahab do stoop under him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus não reverterá sua ira, e debaixo dele se encurvam os assistentes de Raabe.
verses.RVR09: Dios no tornará atrás su ira, y debajo de él se encorvan los que ayudan á los soberbios.

verses.KJV: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
verses.WEB: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?
verses.ASV: How much less shall I answer him, And choose out my words [to reason] with him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como poderia eu lhe responder, e escolher minhas palavras contra ele?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuánto menos le responderé yo, y hablaré con él palabras estudiadas?

verses.KJV: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.WEB: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.ASV: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer; I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ele, ainda que eu fosse justo, não lhe responderia; a meu juiz pediria misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: Que aunque fuese yo justo, no responderé; antes habré de rogar á mi juez.

verses.KJV: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
verses.WEB: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
verses.ASV: If I had called, and he had answered me, Yet would I not believe that he hearkened unto my voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que eu lhe chamasse, e ele respondesse, mesmo assim não creria que ele tivesse dado ouvidos à minha voz.
verses.RVR09: Que si yo le invocase, y él me respondiese, aun no creeré que haya escuchado mi voz.

verses.KJV: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
verses.WEB: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
verses.ASV: For he breaketh me with a tempest, And multiplieth my wounds without cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele tem me quebrantado com tempestade, e multiplicado minhas feridas sem causa.
verses.RVR09: Porque me ha quebrado con tempestad, y ha aumentado mis heridas sin causa.

verses.KJV: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
verses.WEB: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
verses.ASV: He will not suffer me to take my breath, But filleth me with bitterness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não me permite respirar; em vez disso, me farta de amarguras.
verses.RVR09: No me ha concedido que tome mi aliento; mas hame hartado de amarguras.

verses.KJV: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
verses.WEB: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
verses.ASV: If [we speak] of strength, lo, [he is] mighty! And if of justice, Who, [saith he], will summon me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto às forças, eis que ele é forte; e quanto ao juízo, [ele diria] : Quem me convocará?
verses.RVR09: Si habláremos de su potencia, fuerte por cierto es; si de juicio, ¿quién me emplazará?

verses.KJV: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
verses.WEB: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
verses.ASV: Though I be righteous, mine own mouth shall condemn me: Though I be perfect, it shall prove me perverse.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que eu seja justo, minha boca me condenaria; se eu fosse inocente, então ela me declararia perverso.
verses.RVR09: Si yo me justificare, me condenará mi boca; si me dijere perfecto, esto me hará inicuo.

verses.KJV: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
verses.WEB: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
verses.ASV: I am perfect; I regard not myself; I despise my life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mesmo se eu for inocente, não estimo minha alma; desprezo minha vida.
verses.RVR09: Bien que yo fuese íntegro, no conozco mi alma: reprocharé mi vida.

verses.KJV: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
verses.WEB: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
verses.ASV: It is all one; therefore I say, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: É tudo a mesma coisa; por isso digo: ele consome ao inocente e ao perverso.
verses.RVR09: Una cosa resta que yo diga: Al perfecto y al impío él los consume.

verses.KJV: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
verses.WEB: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
verses.ASV: If the scourge slay suddenly, He will mock at the trial of the innocent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o açoite mata de repente, ele ri do desespero dos inocentes.
verses.RVR09: Si azote mata de presto, ríese de la prueba de los inocentes.

verses.KJV: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
verses.WEB: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
verses.ASV: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He covereth the faces of the judges thereof: If [it be] not [he], who then is it?
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra está entregue nas mãos dos perversos. Ele cobre o rosto de seus juízes. Se não é ele, então quem é?
verses.RVR09: La tierra es entregada en manos de los impíos, y él cubre el rostro de sus jueces. Si no es él, ¿quién es? ¿dónde está?

verses.KJV: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
verses.WEB: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.
verses.ASV: Now my days are swifter than a post: They flee away, they see no good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus dias foram mais rápidos que um homem que corre; fugiram, e não viram o bem.
verses.RVR09: Mis días han sido más ligeros que un correo; huyeron, y no vieron el bien.

verses.KJV: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
verses.WEB: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
verses.ASV: They are passed away as the swift ships; As the eagle that swoopeth on the prey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passaram como barcos de papiro, como a águia que se lança à comida.
verses.RVR09: Pasaron cual navíos veloces: como el águila que se arroja á la comida.

verses.KJV: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
verses.WEB: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’
verses.ASV: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will put off my [sad] countenance, and be of good cheer;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se disser: Esquecerei minha queixa, mudarei o aspecto do meu rosto, e sorrirei,
verses.RVR09: Si digo: Olvidaré mi queja, dejaré mi aburrimiento, y esforzaréme:

verses.KJV: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
verses.WEB: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.
verses.ASV: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ainda] teria pavor de todas as minhas dores; [pois] sei que não me terás por inocente.
verses.RVR09: Contúrbanme todos mis trabajos; sé que no me darás por libre.

verses.KJV: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
verses.WEB: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
verses.ASV: I shall be condemned; Why then do I labor in vain?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu já estou condenado, então para que eu sofreria em vão?
verses.RVR09: Yo soy impío, ¿para qué trabajaré en vano?

verses.KJV: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
verses.WEB: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
verses.ASV: If I wash myself with snow water, And make my hands never so clean;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que me lave com água de neve, e limpe minhas mãos com sabão,
verses.RVR09: Aunque me lave con aguas de nieve, y limpie mis manos con la misma limpieza,

verses.KJV: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.WEB: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
verses.ASV: Yet wilt thou plunge me in the ditch, And mine own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então me submergirias no fosso, e minhas próprias vestes me abominariam.
verses.RVR09: Aun me hundirás en el hoyo, y mis propios vestidos me abominarán.

verses.KJV: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
verses.WEB: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
verses.ASV: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, That we should come together in judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele não é homem como eu, para que eu lhe responda, e venhamos juntamente a juízo.
verses.RVR09: Porque no es hombre como yo, para que yo le responda, y vengamos juntamente á juicio.

verses.KJV: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.WEB: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
verses.ASV: There is no umpire betwixt us, That might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há entre nós árbitro que ponha sua mão sobre nós ambos,
verses.RVR09: No hay entre nosotros árbitro que ponga su mano sobre nosotros ambos.

verses.KJV: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
verses.WEB: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
verses.ASV: Let him take his rod away from me, And let not his terror make me afraid:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tire de sobre mim sua vara, e seu terror não me espante.
verses.RVR09: Quite de sobre mí su vara, y su terror no me espante.

verses.KJV: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
verses.WEB: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
verses.ASV: Then would I speak, and not fear him; For I am not so in myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] eu falaria, e não teria medo dele. Pois não está sendo assim comigo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces hablaré, y no le temeré: porque así no estoy en mí mismo.

verses.KJV: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.WEB: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.ASV: My soul is weary of my life; I will give free course to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma está cansada de minha vida. Darei liberdade à minha queixa sobre mim; falarei com amargura de minha alma.
verses.RVR09: ESTÁ mi alma aburrida de mi vida: daré yo suelta á mi queja sobre mí, hablaré con amargura de mi alma.

verses.KJV: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
verses.WEB: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
verses.ASV: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; Show me wherefore thou contendest with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Direi a Deus: Não me condenes; faz-me saber por que brigas comigo.
verses.RVR09: Diré á Dios: no me condenes; hazme entender por qué pleiteas conmigo.

verses.KJV: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.WEB: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
verses.ASV: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, That thou shouldest despise the work of thy hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Parece] -te bem que [me] oprimas, que rejeites o trabalho de tuas mãos, e favoreças o conselho dos perversos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Parécete bien que oprimas, que deseches la obra de tus manos, y que resplandezcas sobre el consejo de los impíos?

verses.KJV: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
verses.WEB: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
verses.ASV: Hast thou eyes of flesh? Or seest thou as man seeth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tens tu olhos de carne? Vês tu como o ser humano vê?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tienes tú ojos de carne? ¿ves tú como ve el hombre?

verses.KJV: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,
verses.WEB: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
verses.ASV: Are thy days as the days of man, Or thy years as man’s days,
verses.ALMEIDA: São teus dias como os dias do ser humano, ou teus anos como os anos do homem,
verses.RVR09: ¿Son tus días como los días del hombre, ó tus años como los tiempos humanos,

verses.KJV: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?
verses.WEB: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
verses.ASV: That thou inquirest after mine iniquity, And searchest after my sin,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que investigues minha perversidade, e pesquises meu pecado?
verses.RVR09: Para que inquieras mi iniquidad, y busques mi pecado,

verses.KJV: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.
verses.WEB: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
verses.ASV: Although thou knowest that I am not wicked, And there is none that can deliver out of thy hand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu sabes que eu não sou mau; todavia ninguém há que [me] livre de tua mão.
verses.RVR09: Sobre saber tú que no soy impío, y que no hay quien de tu mano libre?

verses.KJV: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
verses.WEB: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
verses.ASV: Thy hands have framed me and fashioned me Together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tuas mãos me fizeram e me formaram por completo; porém agora tu me destróis.
verses.RVR09: Tus manos me formaron y me compusieron todo en contorno: ¿y así me deshaces?

verses.KJV: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
verses.WEB: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
verses.ASV: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast fashioned me as clay; And wilt thou bring me into dust again?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por favor, lembra-te que me preparaste como o barro; e me farás voltar ao pó da terra.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate ahora que como á lodo me diste forma: ¿y en polvo me has de tornar?

verses.KJV: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.WEB: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.ASV: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, And curdled me like cheese?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não me derramaste como o leite, e como o queijo me coalhaste?
verses.RVR09: ¿No me fundiste como leche, y como un queso me cuajaste?

verses.KJV: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
verses.WEB: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
verses.ASV: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews.
verses.ALMEIDA: De pele e carne tu me vestiste; e de ossos e nervos tu me teceste.
verses.RVR09: Vestísteme de piel y carne, y cubrísteme de huesos y nervios.

verses.KJV: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
verses.WEB: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
verses.ASV: Thou hast granted me life and lovingkindness; And thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vida e misericórdia me concedeste, e teu cuidado guardou meu espírito.
verses.RVR09: Vida y misericordia me concediste, y tu visitación guardó mi espíritu.

verses.KJV: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.
verses.WEB: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
verses.ASV: Yet these things thou didst hide in thy heart; I know that this is with thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém estas coisas escondeste em teu coração; eu sei que isto esteve contigo:
verses.RVR09: Y estas cosas tienes guardadas en tu corazón; yo sé que esto está cerca de ti.

verses.KJV: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
verses.WEB: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
verses.ASV: If I sin, then thou markest me, And thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu pecar, tu me observarás, e não absolverás minha culpa.
verses.RVR09: Si pequé, tú me has observado, y no me limpias de mi iniquidad.

verses.KJV: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
verses.WEB: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
verses.ASV: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head; Being filled with ignominy, And looking upon mine affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu for perverso, ai de mim! Mesmo se eu for justo, não levantarei minha cabeça; estou farto de desonra, e de ver minha aflição.
verses.RVR09: Si fuere malo, ¡ay de mí! y si fuere justo, no levantaré mi cabeza, estando harto de deshonra, y de verme afligido.

verses.KJV: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.WEB: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
verses.ASV: And if [my head] exalt itself, thou huntest me as a lion; And again thou showest thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se [minha cabeça] se exaltar, tu me caças como um leão feroz, e voltas a fazer em coisas extraordinárias contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Y subirá de punto, pues me cazas como á león, y tornas á hacer en mí maravillas.

verses.KJV: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.
verses.WEB: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
verses.ASV: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, And increasest thine indignation upon me: Changes and warfare are with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Renovas tuas testemunhas contra mim, e multiplicas tua ira sobre mim; combates vêm sucessivamente contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Renuevas contra mí tus plagas, y aumentas conmigo tu furor, remudándose sobre mí ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
verses.WEB: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
verses.ASV: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que me tiraste da madre? [Bom seria] se eu não tivesse respirado, e nenhum olho me visse!
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué me sacaste de la matriz? Habría yo espirado, y no me vieran ojos.

verses.KJV: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.WEB: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.ASV: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teria sido como se nunca tivesse existido, e desde o ventre [materno] seria levado à sepultura.
verses.RVR09: Fuera, como si nunca hubiera sido, llevado desde el vientre á la sepultura.

verses.KJV: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.WEB: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
verses.ASV: Are not my days few? cease then, And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não são poucos os meus dias? Cessa [pois] e deixa-me, para que eu tenha um pouco de alívio,
verses.RVR09: ¿No son mis días poca cosa? Cesa pues, y déjame, para que me conforte un poco.

verses.KJV: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
verses.WEB: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
verses.ASV: Before I go whence I shall not return, [Even] to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que eu me vá para não voltar, à terra da escuridão e da sombra de morte;
verses.RVR09: Antes que vaya para no volver, á la tierra de tinieblas y de sombra de muerte;

verses.KJV: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
verses.WEB: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
verses.ASV: The land dark as midnight, [The land] of the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as midnight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Terra escura ao extremo, tenebrosa, sombra de morte, sem ordem alguma, onde a luz é como a escuridão.
verses.RVR09: Tierra de oscuridad, lóbrega como sombra de muerte, sin orden, y que aparece como la oscuridad misma.

verses.KJV: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.WEB: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,
verses.ASV: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Zofar, o naamita, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Sophar Naamathita, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.WEB: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.ASV: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso a multidão de palavras não seria respondida? E o homem falador teria razão?
verses.RVR09: ¿Las muchas palabras no han de tener respuesta? ¿y el hombre parlero será justificado?

verses.KJV: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
verses.WEB: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
verses.ASV: Should thy boastings make men hold their peace? And when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso tuas palavras tolas faria as pessoas se calarem? E zombarias tu, e ninguém te envergonharia?
verses.RVR09: ¿Harán tus falacias callar á los hombres? ¿y harás escarnio, y no habrá quien te avergüence?

verses.KJV: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
verses.WEB: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
verses.ASV: For thou sayest, My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in thine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois disseste: Minha doutrina é pura, e eu sou limpo diante de teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Tú dices: Mi conversar es puro, y yo soy limpio delante de tus ojos.

verses.KJV: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;
verses.WEB: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
verses.ASV: But oh that God would speak, And open his lips against thee,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas na verdade, queria eu que Deus falasse, e abrisse seus lábios contra ti,
verses.RVR09: Mas ¡oh quién diera que Dios hablara, y abriera sus labios contigo,

verses.KJV: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
verses.WEB: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.
verses.ASV: And that he would show thee the secrets of wisdom! For he is manifold in understanding. Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te fizesse saber os segredos da sabedoria, porque o verdadeiro conhecimento tem dois lados; por isso sabe tu que Deus tem te castigado menos que [mereces] por tua perversidade.
verses.RVR09: Y que te declarara los arcanos de la sabiduría, que son de doble valor que la hacienda! Conocerías entonces que Dios te ha castigado menos que tu iniquidad merece.

verses.KJV: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
verses.WEB: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
verses.ASV: Canst thou by searching find out God? Canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
verses.ALMEIDA: Podes tu compreender os mistérios de Deus? Chegarás tu à perfeição do Todo-Poderoso?
verses.RVR09: ¿Alcanzarás tú el rastro de Dios? ¿llegarás tú á la perfección del Todopoderoso?

verses.KJV: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
verses.WEB: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
verses.ASV: It is high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than Sheol; what canst thou know?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Sua sabedoria] é mais alta que os céus; que tu poderás fazer? E mais profunda que o Xeol; que tu poderás conhecer?
verses.RVR09: Es más alto que los cielos: ¿qué harás? Es más profundo que el infierno: ¿cómo lo conocerás?

verses.KJV: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.WEB: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.ASV: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, And broader than the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua medida é mais comprida que a terra, e mais larga que o mar.
verses.RVR09: Su dimensión es más larga que la tierra, y más ancha que la mar.

verses.KJV: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
verses.WEB: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?
verses.ASV: If he pass through, and shut up, And call unto judgment, then who can hinder him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ele passar, e prender, ou se ajuntar [para o julgamento] ,quem poderá o impedir?
verses.RVR09: Si cortare, ó encerrare, ó juntare, ¿quién podrá contrarrestarle?

verses.KJV: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
verses.WEB: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
verses.ASV: For he knoweth false men: He seeth iniquity also, even though he consider it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele conhece as pessoas vãs, e vê a maldade; por acaso ele não a consideraria?
verses.RVR09: Porque él conoce á los hombres vanos: ve asimismo la iniquidad, ¿y no hará caso?

verses.KJV: For vain men would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.
verses.WEB: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
verses.ASV: But vain man is void of understanding, Yea, man is born [as] a wild ass’s colt.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem tolo se tornará entendido quando do asno selvagem nascer um humano.
verses.RVR09: El hombre vano se hará entendido, aunque nazca como el pollino del asno montés.

verses.KJV: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
verses.WEB: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
verses.ASV: If thou set thy heart aright, And stretch out thy hands toward him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tu preparares o teu coração, e estenderes a ele tuas mãos;
verses.RVR09: Si tú apercibieres tu corazón, y extendieres á él tus manos;

verses.KJV: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
verses.WEB: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
verses.ASV: If iniquity be in thy hand, put it far away, And let not unrighteousness dwell in thy tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguma maldade houver em tua mão, lança-a de ti, e não deixes a injustiça habitar em tuas tendas;
verses.RVR09: Si alguna iniquidad hubiere en tu mano, y la echares de ti, y no consintieres que more maldad en tus habitaciones;

verses.KJV: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
verses.WEB: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,
verses.ASV: Surely then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; Yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então levantarás teu rosto sem mácula; estarás firme, e não temerás;
verses.RVR09: Entonces levantarás tu rostro limpio de mancha, y serás fuerte y no temerás:

verses.KJV: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:
verses.WEB: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.
verses.ASV: For thou shalt forget thy misery; Thou shalt remember it as waters that are passed away,
verses.ALMEIDA: E esquecerás teu sofrimento, [ou] lembrarás dele como de águas que já passaram;
verses.RVR09: Y olvidarás tu trabajo, ó te acordarás de él como de aguas que pasaron:

verses.KJV: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday: thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
verses.WEB: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
verses.ASV: And [thy] life shall be clearer than the noonday; Though there be darkness, it shall be as the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [tua] vida será mais clara que o meio-dia; ainda que haja trevas, tu serás como o amanhecer.
verses.RVR09: Y en mitad de la siesta se levantará bonanza; resplandecerás, y serás como la mañana:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
verses.WEB: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; Yea, thou shalt search [about thee], and shalt take thy rest in safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serás confiante, porque haverá esperança; olharás em redor, [e] repousarás seguro.
verses.RVR09: Y confiarás, que habrá esperanza; y cavarás, y dormirás seguro:

verses.KJV: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
verses.WEB: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
verses.ASV: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; Yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te deitarás, e ninguém te causará medo; e muitos suplicarão a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y te acostarás, y no habrá quien te espante: y muchos te rogarán.

verses.KJV: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
verses.WEB: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
verses.ASV: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, And they shall have no way to flee; And their hope shall be the giving up of the ghost.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os olhos dos maus se enfraquecerão, e o refúgio deles perecerá; a esperança deles será a morte.
verses.RVR09: Mas los ojos de los malos se consumirán, y no tendrán refugio; y su esperanza será agonía del alma.

verses.KJV: And Job answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job, y dijo:

verses.KJV: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.WEB: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
verses.ASV: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Verdadeiramente vós sois o povo; e convosco morrerá a sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente que vosotros sois el pueblo; y con vosotros morirá la sabiduría.

verses.KJV: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.WEB: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
verses.ASV: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: Yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.ALMEIDA: Também eu tenho entendimento como vós; e não sou inferior a vós; e quem há que não saiba coisas como essas?
verses.RVR09: También tengo yo seso como vosotros; no soy yo menos que vosotros: ¿y quién habrá que no pueda decir otro tanto?

verses.KJV: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
verses.WEB: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
verses.ASV: I am as one that is a laughing-stock to his neighbor, I who called upon God, and he answered: The just, the perfect man is a laughing-stock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o motivo de riso de meus amigos, eu que invocava a Deus, e ele me respondia; o justo e íntegro serve de riso.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy uno de quien su amigo se mofa, que invoca á Dios, y él le responde: con todo, el justo y perfecto es escarnecido.

verses.KJV: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
verses.WEB: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
verses.ASV: In the thought of him that is at ease there is contempt for misfortune; It is ready for them whose foot slippeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na opinião de quem está descansado, a desgraça é desprezada, [como se] estivesse preparada aos que cujos pés escorregam.
verses.RVR09: Aquel cuyos pies van á resbalar, es como una lámpara despreciada de aquel que está á sus anchuras.

verses.KJV: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
verses.WEB: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
verses.ASV: The tents of robbers prosper, And they that provoke God are secure; Into whose hand God bringeth [abundantly].
verses.ALMEIDA: As tendas dos ladrões têm descanso, e os que irritam a Deus estão seguros; os que trazem [seu] deus em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Prosperan las tiendas de los ladrones, y los que provocan á Dios viven seguros; en cuyas manos él ha puesto cuanto tienen.

verses.KJV: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
verses.WEB: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
verses.ASV: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; And the birds of the heavens, and they shall tell thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Verdadeiramente pergunta agora aos animais, que eles te ensinarão; e às aves dos céus, que elas te explicarão;
verses.RVR09: Y en efecto, pregunta ahora á las bestias, que ellas te enseñarán; y á las aves de los cielos, que ellas te lo mostrarán:

verses.KJV: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
verses.WEB: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
verses.ASV: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou fala com a terra, que ela te ensinará; até os peixes do mar te contarão.
verses.RVR09: O habla á la tierra, que ella te enseñará; los peces de la mar te lo declararán también.

verses.KJV: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the Lord hath wrought this?
verses.WEB: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,
verses.ASV: Who knoweth not in all these, That the hand of Jehovah hath wrought this,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem entre todas estas coisas não entende que a mão do SENHOR faz isto?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué cosa de todas estas no entiende que la mano de Jehová la hizo?

verses.KJV: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verses.WEB: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
verses.ASV: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?
verses.ALMEIDA: Em sua mão está a alma de tudo quanto vive, e o espírito de toda carne humana.
verses.RVR09: En su mano está el alma de todo viviente, y el espíritu de toda carne humana.

verses.KJV: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
verses.WEB: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
verses.ASV: Doth not the ear try words, Even as the palate tasteth its food?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o ouvido não distingue as palavras, e o paladar prova as comidas?
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente el oído distingue las palabras, y el paladar gusta las viandas.

verses.KJV: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
verses.WEB: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
verses.ASV: With aged men is wisdom, And in length of days understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nos velhos está o conhecimento, e na longa idade o entendimento.
verses.RVR09: En los viejos está la ciencia, y en la larga edad la inteligencia.

verses.KJV: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
verses.WEB: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
verses.ASV: With [God] is wisdom and might; He hath counsel and understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com [Deus] está a sabedoria e a força; o conselho e o entendimento lhe pertencem.
verses.RVR09: Con Dios está la sabiduría y la fortaleza; suyo es el consejo y la inteligencia.

verses.KJV: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.WEB: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
verses.ASV: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again; He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o que ele derruba não pode ser reconstruído; e ninguém pode libertar o homem a quem ele aprisiona.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, él derribará, y no será edificado: encerrará al hombre, y no habrá quien le abra.

verses.KJV: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.WEB: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.ASV: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; Again, he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que, [quando] ele detém as águas, elas se secam; [quando] ele as deixa sair, elas transtornam a terra.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, él detendrá las aguas, y se secarán; él las enviará, y destruirán la tierra.

verses.KJV: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.WEB: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.ASV: With him is strength and wisdom; The deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com ele está a força e a sabedoria; Seu é o que erra, e o que faz errar.
verses.RVR09: Con él está la fortaleza y la existencia; suyo es el que yerra, y el que hace errar.

verses.KJV: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
verses.WEB: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
verses.ASV: He leadeth counsellors away stripped, And judges maketh he fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele leva os conselheiros despojados, e faz os juízes enlouquecerem.
verses.RVR09: El hace andar á los consejeros desnudos de consejo, y hace enloquecer á los jueces.

verses.KJV: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.WEB: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
verses.ASV: He looseth the bond of kings, And he bindeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele solta a atadura dos reis, e ata um cinto a seus lombos.
verses.RVR09: El suelta la atadura de los tiranos, y ata el cinto á sus lomos.

verses.KJV: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
verses.WEB: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
verses.ASV: He leadeth priests away stripped, And overthroweth the mighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele leva os sacerdotes despojados, e transtorna os poderosos.
verses.RVR09: El lleva despojados á los príncipes, y trastorna á los poderosos.

verses.KJV: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
verses.WEB: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
verses.ASV: He removeth the speech of the trusty, And taketh away the understanding of the elders.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tira a fala daqueles a quem os outros confiam, e tira o juízo dos anciãos.
verses.RVR09: El impide el labio á los que dicen verdad, y quita á los ancianos el consejo.

verses.KJV: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
verses.WEB: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
verses.ASV: He poureth contempt upon princes, And looseth the belt of the strong.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele derrama menosprezo sobre os príncipes, e afrouxa o cinto dos fortes.
verses.RVR09: El derrama menosprecio sobre los príncipes, y enflaquece la fuerza de los esforzados.

verses.KJV: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.WEB: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
verses.ASV: He uncovereth deep things out of darkness, And bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele revela as profundezas das trevas, e traz a sombra de morte à luz.
verses.RVR09: El descubre las profundidades de las tinieblas, y saca á luz la sombra de muerte.

verses.KJV: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
verses.WEB: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
verses.ASV: He increaseth the nations, and he destroyeth them: He enlargeth the nations, and he leadeth them captive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele multiplica as nações, e ele as destrói; ele dispersa as nações, e as reúne.
verses.RVR09: El multiplica las gentes, y él las destruye: él esparce las gentes, y las torna á recoger.

verses.KJV: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.WEB: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.ASV: He taketh away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tira o entendimento dos líderes do povo da terra, e os faz vaguear pelos desertos, sem caminho.
verses.RVR09: El quita el seso de las cabezas del pueblo de la tierra, y háceles que se pierdan vagueando sin camino:

verses.KJV: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
verses.WEB: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
verses.ASV: They grope in the dark without light; And he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nas trevas andam apalpando, sem terem luz; e os faz cambalear como a bêbados.
verses.RVR09: Van á tientas como en tinieblas y sin luz, y los hace errar como borrachos.

verses.KJV: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
verses.WEB: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
verses.ASV: Lo, mine eye hath seen all [this], Mine ear hath heard and understood it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que meus olhos têm visto tudo [isto] ; meus ouvidos o ouviram, e entenderam.
verses.RVR09: HE AQUÍ que todas estas cosas han visto mis ojos, y oído y entendido de por sí mis oídos.

verses.KJV: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
verses.WEB: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
verses.ASV: What ye know, [the same] do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como vós o sabeis, eu também o sei; não sou inferior a vós.
verses.RVR09: Como vosotros lo sabéis, lo sé yo; no soy menos que vosotros.

verses.KJV: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
verses.WEB: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
verses.ASV: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu falarei com o Todo-Poderoso, e quero me defender para com Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo hablaría con el Todopoderoso, y querría razonar con Dios.

verses.KJV: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
verses.WEB: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
verses.ASV: But ye are forgers of lies; Ye are all physicians of no value.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois na verdade vós sois inventores de mentiras; todos vós sois médicos inúteis.
verses.RVR09: Que ciertamente vosotros sois fraguadores de mentira; sois todos vosotros médicos nulos.

verses.KJV: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
verses.WEB: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
verses.ASV: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! And it would be your wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bom seria se vos calásseis por completo, pois seria sabedoria de vossa parte.
verses.RVR09: Ojalá callarais del todo, porque os fuera sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.WEB: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.ASV: Hear now my reasoning, And hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi agora meu argumento, e prestai atenção aos argumentos de meus lábios.
verses.RVR09: Oid ahora mi razonamiento, y estad atentos á los argumentos de mis labios.

verses.KJV: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.WEB: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.ASV: Will ye speak unrighteously for God, And talk deceitfully for him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso falareis perversidade por Deus, e por ele falareis engano?
verses.RVR09: ¿Habéis de hablar iniquidad por Dios? ¿habéis de hablar por él engaño?

verses.KJV: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
verses.WEB: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
verses.ASV: Will ye show partiality to him? Will ye contend for God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Fareis acepção de sua pessoa? Brigareis em defesa de Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Habéis de hacer acepción de su persona? ¿habéis de pleitear vosotros por Dios?

verses.KJV: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
verses.WEB: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
verses.ASV: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceiveth a man, will ye deceive him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Seria bom [para vós] se ele vos investigasse? Enganareis a ele como se engana a algum homem?
verses.RVR09: ¿Sería bueno que él os escudriñase? ¿os burlaréis de él como quien se burla de algún hombre?

verses.KJV: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
verses.WEB: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
verses.ASV: He will surely reprove you, If ye do secretly show partiality.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente ele vos repreenderá, se em oculto fizerdes acepção de pessoas.
verses.RVR09: El os reprochará de seguro, si solapadamente hacéis acepción de personas.

verses.KJV: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
verses.WEB: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?
verses.ASV: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, And his dread fall upon you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso a majestade dele não vos espantará? E o temor dele não cairá sobre sobre vós?
verses.RVR09: De cierto su alteza os había de espantar, y su pavor había de caer sobre vosotros.

verses.KJV: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
verses.WEB: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
verses.ASV: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defences are defences of clay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vossos conceitos são provérbios de cinzas; vossas defesas são como defesas de lama.
verses.RVR09: Vuestras memorias serán comparadas á la ceniza, y vuestros cuerpos como cuerpos de lodo.

verses.KJV: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
verses.WEB: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
verses.ASV: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak; And let come on me what will.
verses.ALMEIDA: Calai-vos diante de mim, e eu falarei; e venha sobre mim o que vier.
verses.RVR09: Escuchadme, y hablaré yo, y véngame después lo que viniere.

verses.KJV: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
verses.WEB: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
verses.ASV: Wherefore should I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que tiraria eu minha carne com meus dentes, e poria minha alma em minha mão?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué quitaré yo mi carne con mis dientes, y pondré mi alma en mi mano?

verses.KJV: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
verses.WEB: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
verses.ASV: Behold, he will slay me; I have no hope: Nevertheless I will maintain my ways before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que, ainda que ele me mate, nele esperarei; porém defenderei meus caminhos diante dele.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, aunque me matare, en él esperaré; empero defenderé delante de él mis caminos.

verses.KJV: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
verses.WEB: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
verses.ASV: This also shall be my salvation, That a godless man shall not come before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele mesmo será minha salvação; pois o hipócrita não virá perante ele.
verses.RVR09: Y él mismo me será salud, porque no entrará en su presencia el hipócrita.

verses.KJV: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
verses.WEB: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
verses.ASV: Hear diligently my speech, And let my declaration be in your ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi com atenção minhas palavras, e com vossos ouvidos minha declaração.
verses.RVR09: Oid con atención mi razonamiento, y mi denunciación con vuestros oídos.

verses.KJV: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.WEB: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
verses.ASV: Behold now, I have set my cause in order; I know that I am righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que já tenho preparado minha causa; sei que serei considerado justo.
