verses.RVR09: He aquí ahora, si yo me apercibiere á juicio, sé que seré justificado.

verses.KJV: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
verses.WEB: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.
verses.ASV: Who is he that will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the ghost.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é o que brigará comigo? Pois então eu me calaria e morreria.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es el que pleiteará conmigo? porque si ahora yo callara, fenecería.

verses.KJV: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
verses.WEB: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
verses.ASV: Only do not two things unto me; Then will I not hide myself from thy face:
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente duas coisas não faças comigo; então eu não me esconderei de teu rosto:
verses.RVR09: A lo menos dos cosas no hagas conmigo; entonces no me esconderé de tu rostro:

verses.KJV: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
verses.WEB: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
verses.ASV: Withdraw thy hand far from me; And let not thy terror make me afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afasta tua mão de sobre mim, e teu terror não me espante.
verses.RVR09: Aparta de mí tu mano, y no me asombre tu terror.

verses.KJV: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
verses.WEB: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
verses.ASV: Then call thou, and I will answer; Or let me speak, and answer thou me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chama, e eu responderei; ou eu falarei, e tu me responde.
verses.RVR09: Llama luego, y yo responderé; ó yo hablaré, y respóndeme tú.

verses.KJV: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.WEB: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
verses.ASV: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quantas culpas e pecados eu tenho? Faze-me saber minha transgressão e meu pecado.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuántas iniquidades y pecados tengo yo? hazme entender mi prevaricación y mi pecado.

verses.KJV: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
verses.WEB: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
verses.ASV: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And holdest me for thine enemy?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que escondes teu rosto, e me consideras teu inimigo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué escondes tu rostro, y me cuentas por tu enemigo?

verses.KJV: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.WEB: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
verses.ASV: Wilt thou harass a driven leaf? And wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso quebrarás a folha arrebatada [pelo vento] ? E perseguirás a palha seca?
verses.RVR09: ¿A la hoja arrebatada has de quebrantar? ¿y á una arista seca has de perseguir?

verses.KJV: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
verses.WEB: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
verses.ASV: For thou writest bitter things against me, And makest me to inherit the iniquities of my youth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que escreves contra mim amarguras, e me fazes herdar as transgressões de minha juventude?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué escribes contra mí amarguras, y me haces cargo de los pecados de mi mocedad?

verses.KJV: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
verses.WEB: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
verses.ASV: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, And markest all my paths; Thou settest a bound to the soles of my feet:
verses.ALMEIDA: Também pões meus pés no tronco, e observas todos os meus caminhos. Tu pões limites às solas dos meus pés.
verses.RVR09: Pones además mis pies en el cepo, y guardas todos mis caminos, imprimiéndolo á las raíces de mis pies.

verses.KJV: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
verses.WEB: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
verses.ASV: Though I am like a rotten thing that consumeth, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me consumo como a podridão, como uma roupa que a traça rói.
verses.RVR09: Y el cuerpo mío se va gastando como de carcoma, como vestido que se come de polilla.

verses.KJV: Man that is born of a woman is of few days and full of trouble.
verses.WEB: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.ASV: Man, that is born of a woman, Is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem, nascido de mulher, é curto de dias, e farto de inquietação;
verses.RVR09: EL HOMBRE nacido de mujer, corto de días, y harto de sinsabores:

verses.KJV: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.WEB: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
verses.ASV: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: He fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele sai como uma flor, e é cortado; foge como a sombra, e não permanece.
verses.RVR09: Que sale como una flor y es cortado; y huye como la sombra, y no permanece.

verses.KJV: And doth thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
verses.WEB: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
verses.ASV: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such a one, And bringest me into judgment with thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo sobre este abres teus olhos, e me trazes a juízo contigo.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y sobre éste abres tus ojos, y me traes á juicio contigo?

verses.KJV: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.WEB: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
verses.ASV: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tirará algo puro do imundo? Ninguém.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién hará limpio de inmundo? Nadie.

verses.KJV: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.WEB: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.
verses.ASV: Seeing his days are determined, The number of his months is with thee, And thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que seus dias já estão determinados, e contigo está o número de seus meses, tu lhe puseste limites, [dos quais] ele não passará.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente sus días están determinados, y el número de sus meses está cerca de ti: tú le pusiste términos, de los cuales no pasará.

verses.KJV: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
verses.WEB: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.
verses.ASV: Look away from him, that he may rest, Till he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desvia-te dele, para que ele tenha repouso; até que, como o empregado, complete seu dia.
verses.RVR09: Si tú lo dejares, él dejará de ser: entre tanto deseará, como el jornalero, su día.

verses.KJV: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.WEB: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
verses.ASV: For there is hope of a tree, If it be cut down, that it will sprout again, And that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque há [ainda] alguma esperança para a árvore que, se cortada, ainda se renove, e seus renovos não cessem.
verses.RVR09: Porque si el árbol fuere cortado, aun queda de él esperanza; retoñecerá aún, y sus renuevos no faltarán.

verses.KJV: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.WEB: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
verses.ASV: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, And the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que sua raiz se envelheça na terra, e seu tronco morra no solo,
verses.RVR09: Si se envejeciere en la tierra su raíz, y su tronco fuere muerto en el polvo,

verses.KJV: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
verses.WEB: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
verses.ASV: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, And put forth boughs like a plant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao cheiro das águas ela brotará, e dará ramos como uma planta nova.
verses.RVR09: Al percibir el agua reverdecerá, y hará copa como planta.

verses.KJV: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
verses.WEB: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
verses.ASV: But man dieth, and is laid low: Yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o homem morre, e se abate; depois de expirar, onde ele está?
verses.RVR09: Mas el hombre morirá, y será cortado; y perecerá el hombre, ¿y dónde estará él?

verses.KJV: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
verses.WEB: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
verses.ASV: [As] the waters fail from the sea, And the river wasteth and drieth up;
verses.ALMEIDA: As águas se vão do lago, e o rio se esgota, e se seca.
verses.RVR09: Las aguas de la mar se fueron, y agotóse el río, secóse.

verses.KJV: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
verses.WEB: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
verses.ASV: So man lieth down and riseth not: Till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, Nor be roused out of their sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o homem se deita, e não se levanta; até que não haja mais céus, eles não despertarão, nem se erguerão de seu sono.
verses.RVR09: Así el hombre yace, y no se tornará á levantar: hasta que no haya cielo no despertarán, ni se levantarán de su sueño.

verses.KJV: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.WEB: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
verses.ASV: Oh that thou wouldest hide me in Sheol, That thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, That thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, se tu me escondesses no Xeol, e me ocultasses até que a tua ira passasse, se me pusesses um limite de tempo, e te lembrasses de mim!
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh quién me diera que me escondieses en el sepulcro, que me encubrieras hasta apaciguarse tu ira, que me pusieses plazo, y de mí te acordaras!

verses.KJV: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
verses.WEB: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
verses.ASV: If a man die, shall he live [again]? All the days of my warfare would I wait, Till my release should come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o homem morrer, voltará a viver? Todos os dias de meu combate esperarei, até que venha minha dispensa.
verses.RVR09: Si el hombre muriere, ¿volverá á vivir? Todos los días de mi edad esperaré, hasta que venga mi mutación.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
verses.WEB: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
verses.ASV: Thou wouldest call, and I would answer thee: Thou wouldest have a desire to the work of thy hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu [me] chamarás, e eu te responderei; e te afeiçoarás à obra de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Aficionado á la obra de tus manos, llamarás, y yo te responderé.

verses.KJV: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
verses.WEB: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
verses.ASV: But now thou numberest my steps: Dost thou not watch over my sin?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois então tu contarias meus passos, e não ficarias vigiando meu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Pues ahora me cuentas los pasos, y no das tregua á mi pecado.

verses.KJV: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
verses.WEB: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
verses.ASV: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And thou fastenest up mine iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha transgressão estaria selada numa bolsa, e tu encobririas minhas perversidades.
verses.RVR09: Tienes sellada en saco mi prevaricación, y coacervas mi iniquidad.

verses.KJV: And surely the mountains falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
verses.WEB: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.
verses.ASV: But the mountain falling cometh to nought; And the rock is removed out of its place;
verses.ALMEIDA: E assim como a montanha cai e é destruída, e a rocha muda de seu lugar,
verses.RVR09: Y ciertamente el monte que cae se deshace, y las peñas son traspasadas de su lugar;

verses.KJV: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.WEB: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
verses.ASV: The waters wear the stones; The overflowings thereof wash away the dust of the earth: So thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a água desgasta as pedras, e as enxurradas levam o pó da terra, assim também tu fazes perecer a esperança do homem.
verses.RVR09: Las piedras son desgastadas con el agua impetuosa, que se lleva el polvo de la tierra: de tal manera haces tú perecer la esperanza del hombre.

verses.KJV: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.WEB: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
verses.ASV: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth; Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sempre prevaleces contra ele, e ele passa; tu mudas o aspecto de seu rosto, e o despedes.
verses.RVR09: Para siempre serás más fuerte que él, y él se va; demudarás su rostro, y enviaráslo.

verses.KJV: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
verses.WEB: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
verses.ASV: His sons come to honor, and he knoweth it not; And they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se seus filhos vierem a ter honra, ele não saberá; se forem humilhados, ele não perceberá.
verses.RVR09: Sus hijos serán honrados, y él no lo sabrá; ó serán humillados, y no entenderá de ellos.

verses.KJV: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
verses.WEB: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
verses.ASV: But his flesh upon him hath pain, And his soul within him mourneth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele apenas sente as dores em sua própria carne, e lamenta por sua própria alma.
verses.RVR09: Mas su carne sobre él se dolerá, y entristecerse ha en él su alma.

verses.KJV: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.WEB: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
verses.ASV: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Elifaz, o temanita, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Eliphaz Temanita, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.WEB: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
verses.ASV: Should a wise man make answer with vain knowledge, And fill himself with the east wind?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o sábio dará como resposta vão conhecimento, e encherá seu ventre de vento oriental?
verses.RVR09: ¿Si proferirá el sabio vana sabiduría, y henchirá su vientre de viento solano?

verses.KJV: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.WEB: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
verses.ASV: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, Or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.ALMEIDA: Repreenderá com palavras que nada servem, e com argumentos que de nada aproveitam?
verses.RVR09: ¿Disputará con palabras inútiles, y con razones sin provecho?

verses.KJV: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
verses.WEB: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
verses.ASV: Yea, thou doest away with fear, And hinderest devotion before God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu destróis o temor, e menosprezas a oração diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Tú también disipas el temor, y menoscabas la oración delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.WEB: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
verses.ASV: For thine iniquity teacheth thy mouth, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tua perversidade conduz tua boca, e tu escolheste a língua dos astutos.
verses.RVR09: Porque tu boca declaró tu iniquidad, pues has escogido el hablar de los astutos.

verses.KJV: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.WEB: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
verses.ASV: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua boca te condena, e não eu; e teus lábios dão testemunho contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Tu boca te condenará, y no yo; y tus labios testificarán contra ti.

verses.KJV: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
verses.WEB: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
verses.ASV: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou brought forth before the hills?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso foste tu o primeiro ser humano a nascer? Ou foste gerado antes dos morros?
verses.RVR09: ¿Naciste tú primero que Adam? ¿ó fuiste formado antes que los collados?

verses.KJV: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.WEB: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
verses.ASV: Hast thou heard the secret counsel of God? And dost thou limit wisdom to thyself?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouviste tu o segredo de Deus? Reténs tu [apenas] contigo a sabedoria?
verses.RVR09: ¿Oíste tú el secreto de Dios, que detienes en ti solo la sabiduría?

verses.KJV: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
verses.WEB: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
verses.ASV: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que tu sabes que nós não saibamos? [O que] tu entendes que não tenhamos [entendido] ?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué sabes tú que no sepamos? ¿qué entiendes que no se halle en nosotros?

verses.KJV: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
verses.WEB: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.
verses.ASV: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, Much elder than thy father.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entre nós também há os que tenham cabelos grisalhos, também há os que são muito mais idosos que teu pai.
verses.RVR09: Entre nosotros también hay cano, también hay viejo mucho mayor en días que tu padre.

verses.KJV: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
verses.WEB: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
verses.ASV: Are the consolations of God too small for thee, Even the word that is gentle toward thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso as consolações de Deus te são poucas? As mansas palavras voltadas a ti?
verses.RVR09: ¿En tan poco tienes las consolaciones de Dios? ¿tienes acaso alguna cosa oculta cerca de ti?

verses.KJV: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
verses.WEB: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
verses.ASV: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? And why do thine eyes flash,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que o teu coração te arrebata, e por que centelham teus olhos,
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué te enajena tu corazón, y por qué guiñan tus ojos,

verses.KJV: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
verses.WEB: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
verses.ASV: That against God thou turnest thy spirit, And lettest words go out of thy mouth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que vires teu espírito contra Deus, e deixes sair [tais] tais palavras de tua boca?
verses.RVR09: Pues haces frente á Dios con tu espíritu, y sacas tales palabras de tu boca?

verses.KJV: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.WEB: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.ASV: What is man, that he should be clean? And he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que é o homem, para que seja puro? E o nascido de mulher, para que seja justo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué cosa es el hombre para que sea limpio, y que se justifique el nacido de mujer?

verses.KJV: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.WEB: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
verses.ASV: Behold, he putteth no trust in his holy ones; Yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que [Deus] não confia em seus santos, nem os céus são puros diante de seus olhos;
verses.RVR09: He aquí que en sus santos no confía, y ni los cielos son limpios delante de sus ojos:

verses.KJV: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
verses.WEB: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
verses.ASV: How much less one that is abominable and corrupt, A man that drinketh iniquity like water!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto menos o homem, abominável e corrupto, que bebe a maldade como água?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuánto menos el hombre abominable y vil, que bebe la iniquidad como agua?

verses.KJV: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
verses.WEB: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
verses.ASV: I will show thee, hear thou me; And that which I have seen I will declare
verses.ALMEIDA: Escuta-me; eu te mostrarei; eu te contarei o que vi.
verses.RVR09: Escúchame; yo te mostraré y te contaré lo que he visto:

verses.KJV: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
verses.WEB: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
verses.ASV: (Which wise men have told From their fathers, and have not hid it;
verses.ALMEIDA: (O que os sábios contaram, o que não foi encoberto por seus pais,
verses.RVR09: (Lo que los sabios nos contaron de sus padres, y no lo encubrieron;

verses.KJV: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.WEB: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
verses.ASV: Unto whom alone the land was given, And no stranger passed among them):
verses.ALMEIDA: A somente os quais a terra foi dada, e estranho nenhum passou por meio deles):
verses.RVR09: A los cuales solos fué dada la tierra, y no pasó extraño por medio de ellos:)

verses.KJV: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.WEB: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
verses.ASV: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, Even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os dias do perverso são sofrimento para si, o número de anos reservados ao opressor.
verses.RVR09: Todos los días del impío, él es atormentado de dolor, y el número de años es escondido al violento.

verses.KJV: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.WEB: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
verses.ASV: A sound of terrors is in his ears; In prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ruídos de horrores estão em seus ouvidos; até na paz lhe sobrevém o assolador.
verses.RVR09: Estruendos espantosos hay en sus oídos; en la paz le vendrá quien lo asuele.

verses.KJV: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.WEB: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
verses.ASV: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não crê que voltará da escuridão; ao contrário, a espada o espera.
verses.RVR09: El no creerá que ha de volver de las tinieblas, y está mirando al cuchillo.

verses.KJV: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.WEB: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.ASV: He wandereth abroad for bread, [saying], Where is it? He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Anda vagueando por comida, onde quer que ela esteja. Ele sabe que o dia das trevas está prestes a acontecer.
verses.RVR09: Desasosegado á comer siempre, sabe que le está aparejado día de tinieblas.

verses.KJV: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.WEB: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.ASV: Distress and anguish make him afraid; They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Angústia e aflição o assombram, [e] prevalecem contra ele como um rei preparado para a batalha;
verses.RVR09: Tribulación y angustia le asombrarán, y esforzaránse contra él como un rey apercibido para la batalla.

verses.KJV: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.WEB: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
verses.ASV: Because he hath stretched out his hand against God, And behaveth himself proudly against the Almighty;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele estendeu sua mão contra Deus, e se embraveceu contra o Todo-Poderoso,
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto él extendió su mano contra Dios, y se esforzó contra el Todopoderoso,

verses.KJV: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.WEB: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
verses.ASV: He runneth upon him with a [stiff] neck, With the thick bosses of his bucklers;
verses.ALMEIDA: Corre contra ele com [dureza] de pescoço, e como seus escudos grossos e levantados.
verses.RVR09: El le acometerá en la cerviz, en lo grueso de las hombreras de sus escudos:

verses.KJV: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
verses.WEB: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
verses.ASV: Because he hath covered his face with his fatness, And gathered fat upon his loins;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque cobriu seu rosto com sua gordura, e engordou as laterais de seu corpo.
verses.RVR09: Porque cubrió su rostro con su gordura, é hizo pliegues sobre los ijares;

verses.KJV: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.WEB: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
verses.ASV: And he hath dwelt in desolate cities, In houses which no man inhabited, Which were ready to become heaps;
verses.ALMEIDA: E habitou em cidades desoladas cidades, em casas desabitadas; que estavam prestes a desmoronar.
verses.RVR09: Y habitó las ciudades asoladas, las casas inhabitadas, que estaban puestas en montones.

verses.KJV: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.WEB: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
verses.ASV: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não enriquecerá, nem seu patrimônio subsistirá, nem suas riquezas se estenderão pela terra.
verses.RVR09: No enriquecerá, ni será firme su potencia, ni extenderá por la tierra su hermosura.

verses.KJV: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.WEB: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
verses.ASV: He shall not depart out of darkness; The flame shall dry up his branches, And by the breath of [God’s] mouth shall he go away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não escapará das trevas; a chama secará seus ramos, e ao sopro de sua boca desparecerá.
verses.RVR09: No se escapará de las tinieblas: la llama secará sus ramos, y con el aliento de su boca perecerá.

verses.KJV: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.WEB: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.
verses.ASV: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself; For vanity shall be his recompense.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não confie ele na ilusão para ser enganado; pois a sua recompensa será nada.
verses.RVR09: No confíe el iluso en la vanidad; porque ella será su recompensa.

verses.KJV: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.WEB: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
verses.ASV: It shall be accomplished before his time, And his branch shall not be green.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sendo ainda seu tempo, ela se cumprirá; e seu ramo não florescerá.
verses.RVR09: El será cortado antes de su tiempo, y sus renuevos no reverdecerán.

verses.KJV: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.WEB: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
verses.ASV: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive-tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sacudirá suas uvas antes de amadurecerem como a vide, e derramará sua flor como a oliveira.
verses.RVR09: El perderá su agraz como la vid, y derramará su flor como la oliva.

verses.KJV: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.WEB: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
verses.ASV: For the company of the godless shall be barren, And fire shall consume the tents of bribery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a ajuntamento dos hipócritas será estéril, e fogo consumirá as tendas do suborno.
verses.RVR09: Porque la sociedad de los hipócritas será asolada, y fuego consumirá las tiendas de soborno.

verses.KJV: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
verses.WEB: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
verses.ASV: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, And their heart prepareth deceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles concebem a maldade, e dão à luz a perversidade; e o ventre deles prepara enganos.
verses.RVR09: Concibieron dolor, y parieron iniquidad; y las entrañas de ellos meditan engaño.

verses.KJV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job, y dijo:

verses.KJV: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
verses.WEB: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
verses.ASV: I have heard many such things: Miserable comforters are ye all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi muitas coisas como estas; todos vós sois consoladores miseráveis.
verses.RVR09: Muchas veces he oído cosas como estas: consoladores molestos sois todos vosotros.

verses.KJV: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
verses.WEB: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
verses.ASV: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provoketh thee that thou answerest?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso terão fim as palavras de vento? Ou o que é que te provoca a responderes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tendrán fin las palabras ventosas? ó ¿qué te animará á responder?

verses.KJV: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
verses.WEB: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,
verses.ASV: I also could speak as ye do; If your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could join words together against you, And shake my head at you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também eu poderia falar como vós, se vossa alma estivesse no lugar da minha alma; eu poderia amontoar palavras contra vós, e contra vós sacudir minha cabeça.
verses.RVR09: También yo hablaría como vosotros. Ojalá vuestra alma estuviera en lugar de la mía, que yo os tendría compañía en las palabras, y sobre vosotros movería mi cabeza.

verses.KJV: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
verses.WEB: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
verses.ASV: [But] I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the solace of my lips would assuage [your grief].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu vos confortaria com minha boca, e a consolação de meus lábios serviria para aliviar.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo os alentaría con mis palabras, y la consolación de mis labios apaciguaría el dolor vuestro.

verses.KJV: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.WEB: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.ASV: Though I speak, my grief is not assuaged; And though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que eu fale, minha dor não cessa; e se eu me calar, em que me alivio?
verses.RVR09: Si hablo, mi dolor no cesa; y si dejo de hablar, no se aparta de mí.

verses.KJV: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
verses.WEB: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
verses.ASV: But now he hath made me weary: Thou hast made desolate all my company.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na verdade agora ele me tornou exausto; tu assolaste toda a minha companhia.
verses.RVR09: Empero ahora me ha fatigado: has tú asolado toda mi compañía.

verses.KJV: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
verses.WEB: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
verses.ASV: And thou hast laid fast hold on me, [which] is a witness [against me]: And my leanness riseth up against me, It testifieth to my face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Testemunha [disto é] que já me enrugaste; e minha magreza já se levanta contra mim para em meu rosto dar testemunho [contra mim] .
verses.RVR09: Tú me has arrugado; testigo es mi flacura, que se levanta contra mí para testificar en mi rostro.

verses.KJV: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.WEB: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
verses.ASV: He hath torn me in his wrath, and persecuted me; He hath gnashed upon me with his teeth: Mine adversary sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua ira me despedaça, e ele me odeia; range seus dentes contra mim; meu adversário aguça seus olhos contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Su furor me destrizó, y me ha sido contrario: crujió sus dientes contra mí; contra mí aguzó sus ojos mi enemigo.

verses.KJV: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
verses.WEB: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.
verses.ASV: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; They have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully: They gather themselves together against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abrem sua boca contra mim; com desprezo esbofeteiam meu rosto, e todos se ajuntam contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Abrieron contra mí su boca; hirieron mis mejillas con afrenta; contra mí se juntaron todos.

verses.KJV: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
verses.WEB: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
verses.ASV: God delivereth me to the ungodly, And casteth me into the hands of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus me entregou ao perverso, e me fez cair nas mãos dos malignos.
verses.RVR09: Hame entregado Dios al mentiroso, y en las manos de los impíos me hizo estremecer

verses.KJV: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
verses.WEB: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.
verses.ASV: I was at ease, and he brake me asunder; Yea, he hath taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces: He hath also set me up for his mark.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tranquilo eu estava, porém ele me quebrantou; e pegou-me pelo pescoço, e me despedaçou; e fez de mim seu alvo de pontaria.
verses.RVR09: Próspero estaba, y desmenuzóme: y arrebatóme por la cerviz, y despedazóme, y púsome por blanco suyo.

verses.KJV: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.WEB: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
verses.ASV: His archers compass me round about; He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus flecheiros me cercaram-me, partiu meus rins, e não [me] poupou; meu fel derramou em terra.
verses.RVR09: Cercáronme sus flecheros, partió mis riñones, y no perdonó: mi hiel derramó por tierra.

verses.KJV: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.WEB: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
verses.ASV: He breaketh me with breach upon breach; He runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quebrantou-me de quebrantamento sobre quebrantamento; correu contra mim como um guerreiro.
verses.RVR09: Quebrantóme de quebranto sobre quebranto; corrió contra mí como un gigante.

verses.KJV: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
verses.WEB: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
verses.ASV: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, And have laid my horn in the dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Costurei saco sobre minha pele, e revolvi minha cabeça no pó.
verses.RVR09: Yo cosí saco sobre mi piel, y cargué mi cabeza de polvo.

verses.KJV: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.WEB: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,
verses.ASV: My face is red with weeping, And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu rosto está vermelho de choro, e minhas pálpebras estão escurecidas ao extremo;
verses.RVR09: Mi rostro está enlodado con lloro, y mis párpados entenebrecidos:

verses.KJV: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
verses.WEB: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
verses.ASV: Although there is no violence in my hands, And my prayer is pure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apesar de não haver injustiça em minhas mãos, e de minha oração ser pura.
verses.RVR09: A pesar de no haber iniquidad en mis manos, y de haber sido mi oración pura.

verses.KJV: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
verses.WEB: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
verses.ASV: O earth, cover not thou my blood, And let my cry have no [resting]-place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó terra! Não cubras o meu sangue, e não haja lugar para meu clamor!
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh tierra! no cubras mi sangre, y no haya lugar á mi clamor.

verses.KJV: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
verses.WEB: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
verses.ASV: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, And he that voucheth for me is on high.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que mesmo agora minha testemunha está nos céus, e meu defensor nas alturas.
verses.RVR09: Mas he aquí que en los cielos está mi testigo, y mi testimonio en las alturas.

verses.KJV: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
verses.WEB: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
verses.ASV: My friends scoff at me: [But] mine eye poureth out tears unto God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus amigos zombam de mim, [mas] meus olhos estão derramando para Deus.
verses.RVR09: Disputadores son mis amigos: mas á Dios destilarán mis ojos.

verses.KJV: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
verses.WEB: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
verses.ASV: That he would maintain the right of a man with God, And of a son of man with his neighbor!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, se [fosse possível] defender a causa com Deus em favor do homem, como o filho do homem em favor de seu amigo!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ojalá pudiese disputar el hombre con Dios, como con su prójimo!

verses.KJV: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
verses.WEB: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
verses.ASV: For when a few years are come, I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois poucos anos restam, e seguirei o caminho [por onde] não voltarei.
verses.RVR09: Mas los años contados vendrán, y yo iré el camino por donde no volveré.

verses.KJV: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
verses.WEB: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.
verses.ASV: My spirit is consumed, my days are extinct, The grave is [ready] for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu espírito está arruinado, meus dias vão se extinguindo, e a sepultura já etá pronta para mim.
verses.RVR09: MI ALIENTO está corrompido, acórtanse mis días, y me está aparejado el sepulcro.

verses.KJV: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
verses.WEB: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
verses.ASV: Surely there are mockers with me, And mine eye dwelleth upon their provocation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Comigo há ninguém além de zombadores, e meus olhos são obrigados a ficar diante de suas provocações.
verses.RVR09: No hay conmigo sino escarnecedores, en cuya acrimonia se detienen mis ojos.

verses.KJV: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
verses.WEB: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
verses.ASV: Give now a pledge, be surety for me with thyself; Who is there that will strike hands with me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Concede-me, por favor, uma garantia para comigo; quem [outro] há que me dê a mão?
verses.RVR09: Pon ahora, dame fianza para litigar contigo: ¿quién tocará ahora mi mano?

verses.KJV: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
verses.WEB: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.
verses.ASV: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: Therefore shalt thou not exalt [them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois aos corações deles tu encobriste do entendimento; portanto não os exaltarás.
verses.RVR09: Porque á éstos has tú escondido su corazón de inteligencia: por tanto, no los ensalzarás.

verses.KJV: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.WEB: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.
verses.ASV: He that denounceth his friends for a prey, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que denuncia a seus amigos em proveito próprio, também os olhos de seus filhos desfalecerão.
verses.RVR09: El que denuncia lisonjas á sus prójimos, los ojos de sus hijos desfallezcan.

verses.KJV: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.WEB: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
verses.ASV: But he hath made me a byword of the people; And they spit in my face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tem me posto por ditado de povos, e em meu rosto é onde eles cospem.
verses.RVR09: El me ha puesto por parábola de pueblos, y delante de ellos he sido como tamboril.

verses.KJV: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
verses.WEB: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
verses.ASV: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, And all my members are as a shadow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meus olhos se escureceram de mágoa, e todos os membros de meu corpo são como a sombra.
verses.RVR09: Y mis ojos se oscurecieron de desabrimiento, y mis pensamientos todos son como sombra.

verses.KJV: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.WEB: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
verses.ASV: Upright men shall be astonished at this, And the innocent shall stir up himself against the godless.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os íntegros pasmarão sobre isto, e o inocente se levantará contra o hipócrita.
verses.RVR09: Los rectos se maravillarán de esto, y el inocente se levantará contra el hipócrita.

verses.KJV: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.WEB: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
verses.ASV: Yet shall the righteous hold on his way, And he that hath clean hands shall wax stronger and stronger.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o justo prosseguirá seu caminho, e o puro de mãos crescerá em força.
verses.RVR09: No obstante, proseguirá el justo su camino, y el limpio de manos aumentará la fuerza.

verses.KJV: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
verses.WEB: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
verses.ASV: But as for you all, come on now again; And I shall not find a wise man among you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, na verdade, voltai-vos todos vós, e vinde agora, pois sábio nenhum acharei entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Mas volved todos vosotros, y venid ahora, que no hallaré entre vosotros sabio.

verses.KJV: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.WEB: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
verses.ASV: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, Even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus dias se passaram, meus pensamentos foram arrancados, os desejos do meu coração.
verses.RVR09: Pasáronse mis días, fueron arrancados mis pensamientos, los designios de mi corazón.

verses.KJV: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
verses.WEB: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
verses.ASV: They change the night into day: The light, [say they], is near unto the darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornaram a noite em dia; a luz se encurta por causa das trevas.
verses.RVR09: Pusieron la noche por día, y la luz se acorta delante de las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.WEB: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
verses.ASV: If I look for Sheol as my house; If I have spread my couch in the darkness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu esperar, o Xeol será minha casa; nas trevas estenderei minha cama.
verses.RVR09: Si yo espero, el sepulcro es mi casa: haré mi cama en las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
verses.WEB: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
verses.ASV: If I have said to corruption, Thou art my father; To the worm, [Thou art] my mother, and my sister;
verses.ALMEIDA: À cova chamo: Tu és meu pai; e aos vermes: [Sois] minha mãe e minha irmã.
verses.RVR09: A la huesa tengo dicho: Mi padre eres tú; á los gusanos: Mi madre y mi hermana.

verses.KJV: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.WEB: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?
verses.ASV: Where then is my hope? And as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde, pois, estaria agora minha esperança? Quanto à minha esperança, quem a poderá ver?
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde pues estará ahora mi esperanza? y mi esperanza ¿quién la verá?

verses.KJV: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
verses.WEB: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
verses.ASV: It shall go down to the bars of Sheol, When once there is rest in the dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será que ela descerá aos ferrolhos do Xeol? Descansaremos juntos no pó da terra?
verses.RVR09: A los rincones de la huesa descenderán, y juntamente descansarán en el polvo.

verses.KJV: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.WEB: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
verses.ASV: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Bildade, o suíta, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Bildad Suhita, y dijo:

verses.KJV: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.WEB: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.ASV: How long will ye hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando é que dareis fim às palavras? Prestai atenção, e então falaremos.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuándo pondréis fin á las palabras? Entended, y después hablemos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
verses.WEB: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
verses.ASV: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, [And] are become unclean in your sight?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que somos considerados animais, e tolos em vossos olhos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué somos tenidos por bestias, y en vuestros ojos somos viles?

verses.KJV: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.WEB: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
verses.ASV: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó tu, que despedaças tua alma com tua ira; será a terra abandonada por tua causa, e será movida a rocha de seu lugar?
verses.RVR09: Oh tú, que despedazas tu alma con tu furor, ¿será dejada la tierra por tu causa, y serán traspasadas de su lugar las peñas?

verses.KJV: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.WEB: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
verses.ASV: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, And the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na verdade, a luz dos perverso se apagará, e a faísca de seu fogo não brilhará.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente la luz de los impíos será apagada, y no resplandecerá la centella de su fuego.

verses.KJV: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.WEB: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
verses.ASV: The light shall be dark in his tent, And his lamp above him shall be put out.
verses.ALMEIDA: A luz se escurecerá em sua tenda, e sua lâmpada sobre ele se apagará.
verses.RVR09: La luz se oscurecerá en su tienda, y apagaráse sobre él su lámpara.

verses.KJV: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.WEB: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
verses.ASV: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, And his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os seus passos fortes serão encurtados, e seu [próprio] intento o derrubará.
verses.RVR09: Los pasos de su pujanza serán acortados, y precipitarálo su mismo consejo.

verses.KJV: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.WEB: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
verses.ASV: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walketh upon the toils.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois será lançado à rede pelos seus [próprios] pés, e sobre fios enredados andará.
verses.RVR09: Porque red será echada en sus pies, y sobre red andará.

verses.KJV: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.WEB: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
verses.ASV: A gin shall take [him] by the heel, [And] a snare shall lay hold on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Laço o pegará pelo calcanhar; a armadilha o prenderá.
verses.RVR09: Lazo prenderá su calcañar: afirmaráse la trampa contra él.

verses.KJV: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.WEB: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
verses.ASV: A noose is hid for him in the ground, And a trap for him in the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma corda lhe está escondida debaixo da terra, e uma armadilha para ele está no caminho.
verses.RVR09: Su cuerda está escondida en la tierra, y su torzuelo sobre la senda.

verses.KJV: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.WEB: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
verses.ASV: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, And shall chase him at his heels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assombros o espantarão ao redor, e o farão correr por onde seus passos forem.
verses.RVR09: De todas partes lo asombrarán temores, y haránle huir desconcertado.

verses.KJV: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
verses.WEB: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
verses.ASV: His strength shall be hunger-bitten, And calamity shall be ready at his side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua força se tornará em fome, e a perdição está pronta ao seu lado.
verses.RVR09: Su fuerza será hambrienta, y á su lado estará aparejado quebrantamiento.

verses.KJV: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.WEB: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
verses.ASV: The members of his body shall be devoured, [Yea], the first-born of death shall devour his members.
verses.ALMEIDA: Partes de sua pele serão consumidas; o primogênito da morte devorará os membros de seu corpo.
verses.RVR09: El primogénito de la muerte comerá los ramos de su piel, y devorará sus miembros.

verses.KJV: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.WEB: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
verses.ASV: He shall be rooted out of his tent wherein he trusteth; And he shall be brought to the king of terrors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será arrancado de sua tenda em que confiava, e será levado ao rei dos assombros.
verses.RVR09: Su confianza será arrancada de su tienda, y harále esto llevar al rey de los espantos.

verses.KJV: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.WEB: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
verses.ASV: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his: Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em sua tenda morará o que não é seu; enxofre se espalhará sobre a sua morada.
verses.RVR09: En su tienda morará como si no fuese suya: piedra azufre será esparcida sobre su morada.

verses.KJV: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.WEB: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
verses.ASV: His roots shall be dried up beneath, And above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por debaixo suas raízes se secarão, e por cima seus ramos serão cortados.
verses.RVR09: Abajo se secarán sus raíces, y arriba serán cortadas sus ramas.

verses.KJV: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.WEB: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
verses.ASV: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, And he shall have no name in the street.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua memória perecerá da terra, e não terá nome pelas ruas.
verses.RVR09: Su memoria perecerá de la tierra, y no tendrá nombre por las calles.

verses.KJV: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.WEB: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.ASV: He shall be driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será lançado da luz para as trevas, e expulso será do mundo.
verses.RVR09: De la luz será lanzado á las tinieblas, y echado fuera del mundo.

verses.KJV: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.WEB: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
verses.ASV: He shall have neither son nor son’s son among his people, Nor any remaining where he sojourned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não terá filho nem neto entre seu povo, nem sobrevivente em suas moradas.
verses.RVR09: No tendrá hijo ni nieto en su pueblo, ni quien le suceda en sus moradas.

verses.KJV: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.WEB: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
verses.ASV: They that come after shall be astonished at his day, As they that went before were affrighted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os do ocidente se espantarão com o seu dia, e os do oriente ficarão horrorizados.
verses.RVR09: Sobre su día se espantarán los por venir, como ocupó el pavor á los que fueron antes.

verses.KJV: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
verses.WEB: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
verses.ASV: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous, And this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim são as moradas do perverso, e este é o lugar [daquele que] não reconhece a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente tales son las moradas del impío, y este será el lugar del que no conoció á Dios.

verses.KJV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jó respondeu dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job, y dijo:

verses.KJV: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.WEB: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
verses.ASV: How long will ye vex my soul, And break me in pieces with words?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando atormentareis minha alma, e me quebrantareis com palavras?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo angustiaréis mi alma, y me moleréis con palabras?

verses.KJV: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
verses.WEB: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
verses.ASV: These ten times have ye reproached me: Ye are not ashamed that ye deal hardly with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já dez vezes me humilhastes; não tendes vergonha em me maltratar.
verses.RVR09: Ya me habéis vituperado diez veces: ¿no os avergonzáis de descomediros delante de mí?

verses.KJV: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.WEB: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
verses.ASV: And be it indeed that I have erred, Mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mesmo se eu tiver errado, meu erro cabe apenas a mim.
verses.RVR09: Sea así que realmente haya yo errado, conmigo se quedará mi yerro.

verses.KJV: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.WEB: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
verses.ASV: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, And plead against me my reproach;
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que vos exaltais contra mim, e contra mim usais minha desgraça,
verses.RVR09: Mas si vosotros os engrandeciereis contra mí, y adujereis contra mí mi oprobio,

verses.KJV: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
verses.WEB: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
verses.ASV: Know now that God hath subverted me [in my cause], And hath compassed me with his net.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabei, pois, que foi Deus que me transtornou, e [com] sua rede me cercou.
verses.RVR09: Sabed ahora que Dios me ha trastornado, y traído en derredor su red sobre mí.

verses.KJV: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
verses.ASV: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry for help, but there is no justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu clamo: Violência! Porém não sou respondido; grito, porém não há justiça.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo clamaré agravio, y no seré oído: daré voces, y no habrá juicio.

verses.KJV: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.WEB: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
verses.ASV: He hath walled up my way that I cannot pass, And hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele entrincheirou meu caminho, de modo que não consigo passar; e pôs trevas sobre minhas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Cercó de vallado mi camino, y no pasaré; y sobre mis veredas puso tinieblas.

verses.KJV: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
verses.WEB: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
verses.ASV: He hath stripped me of my glory, And taken the crown from my head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me despojou de minha honra, e tirou a coroa de minha cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Hame despojado de mi gloria, y quitado la corona de mi cabeza.

verses.KJV: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
verses.WEB: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
verses.ASV: He hath broken me down on every side, and I am gone; And my hope hath he plucked up like a tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me derrubou por todos os lados, e pereço; e arrancou minha esperança como a uma árvore.
verses.RVR09: Arruinóme por todos lados, y perezco; y ha hecho pasar mi esperanza como árbol arrancado.

verses.KJV: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
verses.WEB: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
verses.ASV: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, And he counteth me unto him as [one of] his adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez inflamar contra mim sua ira, e me considerou para consigo como a [um de] seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: E hizo inflamar contra mí su furor, y contóme para sí entre sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.WEB: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
verses.ASV: His troops come on together, And cast up their way against me, And encamp round about my tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Juntas vieram suas tropas; prepararam contra mim seu caminho, e se acamparam ao redor de minha tenda.
verses.RVR09: Vinieron sus ejércitos á una, y trillaron sobre mí su camino, y asentaron campo en derredor de mi tienda.

verses.KJV: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.WEB: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
verses.ASV: He hath put my brethren far from me, And mine acquaintance are wholly estranged from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele afastou meus irmãos para longe de mim; e os que me conheciam agora me estranham.
verses.RVR09: Hizo alejar de mí mis hermanos, y positivamente se extrañaron de mí mis conocidos.

verses.KJV: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.WEB: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.ASV: My kinsfolk have failed, And my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus parentes [me] deixaram, e meus conhecidos se esqueceram de mim.
verses.RVR09: Mis parientes se detuvieron, y mis conocidos se olvidaron de mí.

verses.KJV: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.WEB: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
verses.ASV: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os moradores de minha casa e minhas servas me tiveram por estranho; estrangeiro me tornei em seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Los moradores de mi casa y mis criadas me tuvieron por extraño: forastero fuí yo en sus ojos.

verses.KJV: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.WEB: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
verses.ASV: I call unto my servant, and he giveth me no answer, [Though] I entreat him with my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamei a meu servo, e ele não respondeu; de minha própria boca eu lhe suplicava.
verses.RVR09: Llamé á mi siervo, y no respondió; de mi propia boca le suplicaba.

verses.KJV: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.
verses.WEB: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
verses.ASV: My breath is strange to my wife, And my supplication to the children of mine own mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu hálito é estranho à minha mulher, e sou repugnante aos filhos de minha mãe.
verses.RVR09: Mi aliento vino á ser extraño á mi mujer, aunque por los hijos de mis entrañas le rogaba.

verses.KJV: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
verses.WEB: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
verses.ASV: Even young children despise me; If I arise, they speak against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até os meninos me desprezam; quando eu me levanto, falam contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Aun los muchachos me menospreciaron: en levantándome, hablaban contra mí.

verses.KJV: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.WEB: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
verses.ASV: All my familiar friends abhor me, And they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os meus amigos próximos me abominam; e [até] aqueles que eu amava se viraram contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Todos mis confidentes me aborrecieron; y los que yo amaba, se tornaron contra mí.

verses.KJV: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.WEB: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
verses.ASV: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, And I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus ossos se grudaram à minha pele e à minha carne; e escapei [só] com a pele de meus dentes.
verses.RVR09: Mi cuero y mi carne se pegaron á mis huesos; y he escapado con la piel de mis dientes.

verses.KJV: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.WEB: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.
verses.ASV: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; For the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Compadecei-vos de mim, meus amigos, compadecei-vos de mim; pois a mão de Deus me tocou.
verses.RVR09: Oh vosotros mis amigos, tened compasión de mí, tened compasión de mí; porque la mano de Dios me ha tocado.

verses.KJV: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.WEB: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.ASV: Why do ye persecute me as God, And are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que vós me perseguis como Deus, e não vos fartais de minhas carne?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué me perseguís como Dios, y no os hartáis de mis carnes?

verses.KJV: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
verses.WEB: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
verses.ASV: Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah se minhas palavras fossem escritas! Ah se fossem escritas em um livro!
verses.RVR09: ¡Quién diese ahora que mis palabras fuesen escritas! ¡quién diese que se escribieran en un libro!

verses.KJV: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.WEB: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
verses.ASV: That with an iron pen and lead They were graven in the rock for ever!
verses.ALMEIDA: Que com ponta de ferro e com chumbo fossem esculpidas em pedra para sempre!
verses.RVR09: ¡Que con cincel de hierro y con plomo fuesen en piedra esculpidas para siempre!

verses.KJV: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
verses.WEB: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
verses.ASV: But as for me I know that my Redeemer liveth, And at last he will stand up upon the earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu sei que meu Redentor vive, e ao fim se levantará sobre a terra;
verses.RVR09: Yo sé que mi Redentor vive, y al fin se levantará sobre el polvo:

verses.KJV: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
verses.WEB: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
verses.ASV: And after my skin, [even] this [body], is destroyed, Then without my flesh shall I see God;
verses.ALMEIDA: E mesmo depois de consumida minha pele, então em minha carne verei a Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y después de deshecha esta mi piel, aun he de ver en mi carne á Dios;

verses.KJV: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
verses.WEB: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
verses.ASV: Whom I, even I, shall see, on my side, And mine eyes shall behold, and not as a stranger. My heart is consumed within me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao qual eu verei para mim, e meus olhos [o] verão, e não outro. [Isto é o que] minhas entranhas anseiam dentro de mim.
verses.RVR09: Al cual yo tengo de ver por mí, y mis ojos lo verán, y no otro, aunque mis riñones se consuman dentro de mí.

verses.KJV: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
verses.WEB: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
verses.ASV: If ye say, How we will persecute him! And that the root of the matter is found in me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se disserdes: Como o perseguiremos? Pois a raiz do problema se acha em mim,
verses.RVR09: Mas debierais decir: ¿Por qué lo perseguimos? ya que la raíz del negocio en mí se halla.

verses.KJV: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
verses.WEB: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
verses.ASV: Be ye afraid of the sword: For wrath [bringeth] the punishments of the sword, That ye may know there is a judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temei vós mesmos a espada; pois furor [há nos] castigos pela espada; para que [assim] saibais que [haverá] julgamento.
verses.RVR09: Temed vosotros delante de la espada; porque sobreviene el furor de la espada á causa de las injusticias, para que sepáis que hay un juicio.

verses.KJV: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.WEB: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
verses.ASV: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Zofar, o naamita, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Sophar Naamathita, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
verses.WEB: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
verses.ASV: Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, Even by reason of my haste that is in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meus meus pensamentos me fazem responder; por causa da agitação dentro de mim.
verses.RVR09: Por cierto mis pensamientos me hacen responder, y por tanto me apresuro.

verses.KJV: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
verses.WEB: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
verses.ASV: I have heard the reproof which putteth me to shame; And the spirit of my understanding answereth me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu ouvi a repreensão que me envergonha; mas o espírito desde o meu entendimento responderá por mim.
verses.RVR09: La reprensión de mi censura he oído, y háceme responder el espíritu de mi inteligencia.

verses.KJV: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.WEB: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
verses.ASV: Knowest thou [not] this of old time, Since man was placed upon earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não sabes isto, [que foi] desde a antiguidade, desde que o ser humano foi posto no mundo?
verses.RVR09: ¿No sabes esto que fué siempre, desde el tiempo que fué puesto el hombre sobre la tierra,

verses.KJV: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
verses.WEB: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
verses.ASV: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the godless but for a moment?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que o júbilo dos perversos é breve, e a alegria do hipócrita [dura apenas] um momento?
verses.RVR09: Que la alegría de los impíos es breve, y el gozo del hipócrita por un momento?

verses.KJV: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.WEB: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
verses.ASV: Though his height mount up to the heavens, And his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que sua altura subisse até o céu, e sua cabeça chegasse até as nuvens,
verses.RVR09: Si subiere su altivez hasta el cielo, y su cabeza tocare en las nubes,

verses.KJV: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
verses.WEB: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
verses.ASV: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: They that have seen him shall say, Where is he?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mesmo assim] com o seu excremento perecerá para sempre; os que houverem o visto, dirão: Onde ele está?
verses.RVR09: Con su estiércol perecerá para siempre: los que le hubieren visto, dirán: ¿Qué es de él?

verses.KJV: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.WEB: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
verses.ASV: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como um sonho voará, e não será achado; e será afugentado como a visão noturna.
verses.RVR09: Como sueño volará, y no será hallado: y disiparáse como visión nocturna.

verses.KJV: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.WEB: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
verses.ASV: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O olho que já o viu nunca mais o verá; nem seu lugar olhará mais para ele.
verses.RVR09: El ojo que le habrá visto, nunca más le verá; ni su lugar le echará más de ver.

verses.KJV: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
verses.WEB: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
verses.ASV: His children shall seek the favor of the poor, And his hands shall give back his wealth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus filhos procurarão o favor dos pobres; e suas mãos devolverão a sua riqueza.
verses.RVR09: Sus hijos pobres andarán rogando; y sus manos tornarán lo que él robó.

verses.KJV: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.WEB: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
verses.ASV: His bones are full of his youth, But it shall lie down with him in the dust.
