verses.ALMEIDA: Seus ossos estão cheios de sua juventude, que juntamente com ele se deitará no pó.
verses.RVR09: Sus huesos están llenos de sus mocedades, y con él serán sepultados en el polvo.

verses.KJV: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
verses.WEB: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
verses.ASV: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, Though he hide it under his tongue,
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o mal é doce em sua boca, e o esconde debaixo de sua língua;
verses.RVR09: Si el mal se endulzó en su boca, si lo ocultaba debajo de su lengua;

verses.KJV: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
verses.WEB: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,
verses.ASV: Though he spare it, and will not let it go, But keep it still within his mouth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o guarda para si, e não o abandona; ao contrário, o retém em sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Si le parecía bien, y no lo dejaba, mas antes lo detenía entre su paladar;

verses.KJV: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
verses.WEB: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
verses.ASV: Yet his food in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua comida se mudará em suas entranhas, veneno de cobras será em seu interior.
verses.RVR09: Su comida se mudará en sus entrañas, hiel de áspides será dentro de él.

verses.KJV: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.WEB: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
verses.ASV: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again; God will cast them out of his belly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Engoliu riquezas, porém as vomitará; Deus as tirará de seu ventre.
verses.RVR09: Devoró riquezas, mas vomitarálas; de su vientre las sacará Dios.

verses.KJV: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
verses.WEB: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
verses.ASV: He shall suck the poison of asps: The viper’s tongue shall slay him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veneno de cobras subará; língua de víbora o matará.
verses.RVR09: Veneno de áspides chupará; matarálo lengua de víbora.

verses.KJV: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
verses.WEB: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
verses.ASV: He shall not look upon the rivers, The flowing streams of honey and butter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não verá correntes, rios, [e] ribeiros de mel e de manteiga.
verses.RVR09: No verá los arroyos, los ríos, los torrentes de miel y de manteca.

verses.KJV: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
verses.WEB: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.
verses.ASV: That which he labored for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down; According to the substance that he hath gotten, he shall not rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Restituirá o trabalho e não o engolirá; da riqueza de seu comério não desfrutará.
verses.RVR09: Restituirá el trabajo conforme á la hacienda que tomó; y no tragará, ni gozará.

verses.KJV: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
verses.WEB: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
verses.ASV: For he hath oppressed and forsaken the poor; He hath violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois oprimiu [e] desamparou aos pobres; roubou a casa que não edificou;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto quebrantó y desamparó á los pobres, robó casas, y no las edificó;

verses.KJV: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
verses.WEB: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.
verses.ASV: Because he knew no quietness within him, He shall not save aught of that wherein he delighteth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por não ter sentido sossego em seu ventre, nada preservará de sua tão desejada riqueza.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, no sentirá él sosiego en su vientre, ni salvará nada de lo que codiciaba.

verses.KJV: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
verses.WEB: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.
verses.ASV: There was nothing left that he devoured not; Therefore his prosperity shall not endure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nada [lhe] restou para que devorasse; por isso sua riqueza não será duradoura.
verses.RVR09: No quedó nada que no comiese: por tanto su bien no será durable.

verses.KJV: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
verses.WEB: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.
verses.ASV: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: The hand of every one that is in misery shall come upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estando cheio de sua fartura, [ainda] estará angustiado; todo o poder da miséria virá sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Cuando fuere lleno su bastimento, tendrá angustia: las manos todas de los malvados vendrán sobre él.

verses.KJV: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
verses.WEB: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
verses.ASV: When he is about to fill his belly, [God] will cast the fierceness of his wrath upon him, And will rain it upon him while he is eating.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele estiver enchendo seu vendre, Deus mandará sobre ele o ardor de sua ira, e [a] choverá sobre ele em sua comida.
verses.RVR09: Cuando se pusiere á henchir su vientre, Dios enviará sobre él el furor de su ira, y harála llover sobre él y sobre su comida.

verses.KJV: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.WEB: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
verses.ASV: He shall flee from the iron weapon, And the bow of brass shall strike him through.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ainda que] fuja das armas de ferro, o arco de bronze o atravessará.
verses.RVR09: Huirá de las armas de hierro, y el arco de acero le atravesará.

verses.KJV: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
verses.WEB: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
verses.ASV: He draweth it forth, and it cometh out of his body; Yea, the glittering point cometh out of his gall: Terrors are upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele a tirará de [seu] corpo, e a ponta brilhante atingirá seu fígado; haverá sobre ele assombros.
verses.RVR09: Desenvainará y sacará saeta de su aljaba, y relumbrante pasará por su hiel: sobre él vendrán terrores.

verses.KJV: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.WEB: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
verses.ASV: All darkness is laid up for his treasures: A fire not blown [by man] shall devour him; It shall consume that which is left in his tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as trevas estão reservadas para seus tesouros escondidos; um fogo não assoprado o consumirá; acabará com o que restar em sua tenda.
verses.RVR09: Todas tinieblas están guardadas para sus secretos: fuego no soplado lo devorará; su sucesor será quebrantado en su tienda.

verses.KJV: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.WEB: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.
verses.ASV: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, And the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os céus revelarão sua maldade, e a terra se levantará contra ele.
verses.RVR09: Los cielos descubrirán su iniquidad, y la tierra se levantará contra él.

verses.KJV: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.WEB: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
verses.ASV: The increase of his house shall depart; [His goods] shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: As riquezas de sua casa serão transportadas; nos dias de sua ira elas se derramarão.
verses.RVR09: Los renuevos de su casa serán trasportados; serán derramados en el día de su furor.

verses.KJV: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
verses.WEB: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
verses.ASV: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, And the heritage appointed unto him by God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a parte que Deus dá ao homem perverso, a herança que Deus lhe prepara.
verses.RVR09: Esta es la parte que Dios apareja al hombre impío, y la heredad que Dios le señala por su palabra.

verses.KJV: But Job answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
verses.WEB: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
verses.ASV: Hear diligently my speech; And let this be your consolations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi atentamente minhas palavras, e seja isto vossas consolações.
verses.RVR09: Oid atentamente mi palabra, y sea esto vuestros consuelos.

verses.KJV: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.WEB: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.
verses.ASV: Suffer me, and I also will speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suportai-me, e eu falarei; e depois de eu ter falado, [então] zombai.
verses.RVR09: Soportadme, y yo hablaré; y después que hubiere hablado, escarneced.

verses.KJV: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
verses.WEB: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
verses.ASV: As for me, is my complaint to man? And why should I not be impatient?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eu me queixo de algum ser humano? Porém ainda que [assim fosse] ,por que meu espírito não se angustiaria?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hablo yo á algún hombre? y ¿por qué no se ha de angustiar mi espíritu?

verses.KJV: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.WEB: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
verses.ASV: Mark me, and be astonished, And lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai-me, e espantai-vos; e ponde a mão sobre a boca.
verses.RVR09: Miradme, y espantaos, y poned la mano sobre la boca.

verses.KJV: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.WEB: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
verses.ASV: Even when I remember I am troubled, And horror taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quando eu me lembro [disto] ,me assombro, e minha carne é tomada de tremor.
verses.RVR09: Aun yo mismo, cuando me acuerdo, me asombro, y toma temblor mi carne.

verses.KJV: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
verses.WEB: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
verses.ASV: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, wax mighty in power?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que razão os perversos vivem, envelhecem, e ainda crescem em poder?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué viven los impíos, y se envejecen, y aun crecen en riquezas?

verses.KJV: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
verses.WEB: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
verses.ASV: Their seed is established with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus filhos progridem com eles diante de seus rostos; e seus descendentes diante de seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Su simiente con ellos, compuesta delante de ellos; y sus renuevos delante de sus ojos.

verses.KJV: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.WEB: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.ASV: Their houses are safe from fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas casas têm paz, sem temor, e a vara de Deus não está contra eles.
verses.RVR09: Sus casas seguras de temor, ni hay azote de Dios sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.WEB: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
verses.ASV: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus touros procriam, e não falham; suas vacas geram filhotes, e não abortam.
verses.RVR09: Sus vacas conciben, no abortan; paren sus vacas, y no malogran su cría.

verses.KJV: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.WEB: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
verses.ASV: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas crianças saem como um rebanho, e seus filhos saem dançando.
verses.RVR09: Salen sus chiquitos como manada, y sus hijos andan saltando.

verses.KJV: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
verses.WEB: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
verses.ASV: They sing to the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantam [a voz] ao [som] de tamboril e de harpa e se alegram ao som de flauta.
verses.RVR09: Al son de tamboril y de cítara saltan, y se huelgan al son del órgano.

verses.KJV: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
verses.WEB: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
verses.ASV: They spend their days in prosperity, And in a moment they go down to Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em prosperidade gastam seus dias, e em um momento descem ao Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Gastan sus días en bien, y en un momento descienden á la sepultura.

verses.KJV: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
verses.WEB: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
verses.ASV: And they say unto God, Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim dizem a Deus: Afasta-te de nós, porque não queremos conhecer teus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Dicen pues á Dios: Apártate de nosotros, que no queremos el conocimiento de tus caminos.

verses.KJV: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.WEB: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
verses.ASV: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é o Todo-Poderoso, para que o sirvamos? E de que nos aproveitará que oremos a ele?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es el Todopoderoso, para que le sirvamos? ¿y de qué nos aprovechará que oremos á él?

verses.KJV: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.WEB: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.ASV: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand: The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que sua prosperidade não se deve às mãos deles. Longe de mim esteja o conselho dos perversos!
verses.RVR09: He aquí que su bien no está en manos de ellos: el consejo de los impíos lejos esté de mí.

verses.KJV: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
verses.WEB: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
verses.ASV: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity cometh upon them? That [God] distributeth sorrows in his anger?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quantas vezes sucede que a lâmpada dos perversos se apaga, e sua perdição vem sobre eles, [e] Deus em sua ira [lhes] reparte dores?
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh cuántas veces la lámpara de los impíos es apagada, y viene sobre ellos su quebranto, y Dios en su ira les reparte dolores!

verses.KJV: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
verses.WEB: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
verses.ASV: That they are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm carrieth away?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles serão como palha diante do vento, como o restos de palha que o turbilhão arrebata.
verses.RVR09: Serán como la paja delante del viento, y como el tamo que arrebata el torbellino.

verses.KJV: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
verses.WEB: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
verses.ASV: [Ye say], God layeth up his iniquity for his children. Let him recompense it unto himself, that he may know it:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Vós dizeis] : Deus guarda sua violência para seus filhos. Que [Deus] pague ao próprio [perverso] ,para que o conheça.
verses.RVR09: Dios guardará para sus hijos su violencia; y le dará su pago, para que conozca.

verses.KJV: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.WEB: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.ASV: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus olhos vejam sua ruína, e beba da ira do Todo-Poderoso.
verses.RVR09: Verán sus ojos su quebranto, y beberá de la ira del Todopoderoso.

verses.KJV: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
verses.WEB: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
verses.ASV: For what careth he for his house after him, When the number of his months is cut off?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois que interesse teria ele em sua casa depois de si, quando o número for cortado o número de seus meses?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué deleite tendrá él de su casa después de sí, siendo cortado el número de sus meses?

verses.KJV: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
verses.WEB: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
verses.ASV: Shall any teach God knowledge, Seeing he judgeth those that are high?
verses.ALMEIDA: Poderia alguém ensinar conhecimento a Deus, que julga [até] os que estão no alto?
verses.RVR09: ¿Enseñará alguien á Dios sabiduría, juzgando él á los que están elevados?

verses.KJV: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.WEB: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.ASV: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet:
verses.ALMEIDA: Alguém morre na sua força plena, estando todo tranquilo e próspero,
verses.RVR09: Este morirá en el vigor de su hermosura, todo quieto y pacífico.

verses.KJV: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
verses.WEB: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
verses.ASV: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moistened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus baldes estando cheios de leite, e o tutano de seus ossos umedecido.
verses.RVR09: Sus colodras están llenas de leche, y sus huesos serán regados de tuétano.

verses.KJV: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
verses.WEB: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
verses.ASV: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, And never tasteth of good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém outro morre com amargura de alma, nunca tendo experimentado a prosperidade.
verses.RVR09: Y estotro morirá en amargura de ánimo, y no habiendo comido jamás con gusto.

verses.KJV: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
verses.WEB: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
verses.ASV: They lie down alike in the dust, And the worm covereth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Juntamente jazem no pó, e os vermes os cobrem.
verses.RVR09: Igualmente yacerán ellos en el polvo, y gusanos los cubrirán.

verses.KJV: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
verses.ASV: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices wherewith ye would wrong me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu sei vossos pensamentos, e os mais intentos que planejais contra mim.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo conozco vuestros pensamientos, y las imaginaciones que contra mí forjáis.

verses.KJV: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
verses.WEB: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
verses.ASV: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque dizeis: Onde está a casa do príncipe?, e: Onde está tenda das moradas dos perversos?
verses.RVR09: Porque decís: ¿Qué es de la casa del príncipe, y qué de la tienda de las moradas de los impíos?

verses.KJV: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
verses.WEB: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
verses.ASV: Have ye not asked wayfaring men? And do ye not know their evidences,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não perguntastes aos que passam pelo caminho, e não conheceis seus sinais?
verses.RVR09: ¿No habéis preguntado á los que pasan por los caminos, por cuyas señas no negaréis,

verses.KJV: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
verses.WEB: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?
verses.ASV: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity? That they are led forth to the day of wrath?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que os maus são preservados no dia da destruição, [e] são livrados no dia das fúrias?
verses.RVR09: Que el malo es reservado para el día de la destrucción? Presentados serán en el día de las iras.

verses.KJV: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?
verses.WEB: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?
verses.ASV: Who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem lhe denunciará seu caminho em sua face? E quem lhe pagará pelo que ele fez?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién le denunciará en su cara su camino? Y de lo que él hizo, ¿quién le dará el pago?

verses.KJV: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
verses.WEB: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
verses.ASV: Yet shall he be borne to the grave, And men shall keep watch over the tomb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Finalmente ele é levado à sepultura, e no túmulo fazem vigilância.
verses.RVR09: Porque llevado será él á los sepulcros, y en el montón permanecerá.

verses.KJV: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
verses.WEB: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
verses.ASV: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, And all men shall draw after him, As there were innumerable before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os torrões do vale lhe são doces; e todos o seguem; e adiante dele estão inúmeros.
verses.RVR09: Los terrones del valle le serán dulces; y tras de él será llevado todo hombre, y antes de él han ido innumerables.

verses.KJV: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
verses.WEB: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
verses.ASV: How then comfort ye me in vain, Seeing in your answers there remaineth [only] falsehood?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como, pois, me consolais em vão, já que vossas em vossas respostas [só] resta falsidade?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo pues me consoláis en vano, viniendo á parar vuestras respuestas en falacia?

verses.KJV: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
verses.ASV: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Elifaz, o temanita, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Eliphaz Temanita, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
verses.WEB: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
verses.ASV: Can a man be profitable unto God? Surely he that is wise is profitable unto himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o homem será de [algum] proveito a Deus? Pode ele se beneficiar de algum sábio?
verses.RVR09: ¿Traerá el hombre provecho á Dios, porque el sabio sea provechoso á sí mismo?

verses.KJV: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
verses.WEB: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
verses.ASV: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain [to him], that thou makest thy ways perfect?
verses.ALMEIDA: É útil ao Todo-Poderoso que sejas justo? Ganha ele algo se os teus caminhos forem íntegros?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tiene su contentamiento el Omnipotente en que tú seas justificado, ó provecho de que tú hagas perfectos tus caminos?

verses.KJV: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
verses.WEB: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
verses.ASV: Is it for thy fear [of him] that he reproveth thee, That he entereth with thee into judgment?
verses.ALMEIDA: Acaso ele te repreende [e] vem contigo a juízo por causa da tua reverência?
verses.RVR09: ¿Castigaráte acaso, ó vendrá contigo á juicio porque te teme?

verses.KJV: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
verses.WEB: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
verses.ASV: Is not thy wickedness great? Neither is there any end to thine iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ou] não será por causa de tua grande malícia, e de tuas maldades que não têm fim?
verses.RVR09: Por cierto tu malicia es grande, y tus maldades no tienen fin.

verses.KJV: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.WEB: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.ASV: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tomaste penhor a teus irmãos sem causa, e foste tu que tiraste as roupas dos nus.
verses.RVR09: Porque sacaste prenda á tus hermanos sin causa, é hiciste desnudar las ropas de los desnudos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.WEB: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
verses.ASV: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não deste de beber água ao cansado, e negaste o pão ao faminto.
verses.RVR09: No diste de beber agua al cansado, y detuviste el pan al hambriento.

verses.KJV: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
verses.WEB: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
verses.ASV: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; And the honorable man, he dwelt in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o homem poderoso teve a terra; e o homem influente habitava nela.
verses.RVR09: Empero el hombre pudiente tuvo la tierra; y habitó en ella el distinguido.

verses.KJV: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.WEB: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.ASV: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Às viúvas despediste vazias, e os braços dos órfãos foram quebrados.
verses.RVR09: Las viudas enviaste vacías, y los brazos de los huérfanos fueron quebrados.

verses.KJV: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
verses.WEB: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
verses.ASV: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden fear troubleth thee,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso que há laços ao redor de ti, e espanto repentino te perturbou;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto hay lazos alrededor de ti, y te turba espanto repentino;

verses.KJV: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.WEB: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
verses.ASV: Or darkness, so that thou canst not see, And abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou trevas, para que não vejas; e inundação de água te cobre.
verses.RVR09: O tinieblas, porque no veas; y abundancia de agua te cubre.

verses.KJV: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.WEB: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.ASV: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso Deus não está na altura dos céus? Olha, pois, para o cume das estrelas, como estão elevadas.
verses.RVR09: ¿No está Dios en la altura de los cielos? Mira lo encumbrado de las estrellas, cuán elevadas están.

verses.KJV: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
verses.WEB: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
verses.ASV: And thou sayest, What doth God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu dizes: O que Deus sabe? Como ele julgará por entre a escuridão?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y dirás tú: Qué sabe Dios? ¿cómo juzgará por medio de la oscuridad?

verses.KJV: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
verses.WEB: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
verses.ASV: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he seeth not; And he walketh on the vault of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: As nuvens são seu esconderijo, e ele não vê; ele passeia pela abóbada do céu.
verses.RVR09: Las nubes son su escondedero, y no ve; y por el circuito del cielo se pasea.

verses.KJV: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
verses.WEB: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
verses.ASV: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso deste atenção para o velho caminho que pisaram os homens injustos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quieres tú guardar la senda antigua, que pisaron los hombres perversos?

verses.KJV: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
verses.WEB: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
verses.ASV: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
verses.ALMEIDA: Tais foram cortados antes de tempo; [sobre] o fundamento deles foi derramada uma enchente.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales fueron cortados antes de tiempo, cuyo fundamento fué como un río derramado:

verses.KJV: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
verses.WEB: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
verses.ASV: Who said unto God, Depart from us; And, What can the Almighty do for us?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles diziam a Deus: Afasta-te de nós! O que o Todo-Poderoso pode fazer por nós?
verses.RVR09: Que decían á Dios: Apártate de nosotros. ¿Y qué les había hecho el Omnipotente?

verses.KJV: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.WEB: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.ASV: Yet he filled their houses with good things: But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sendo ele o que havia enchido suas casas de bens. Seja, porém, longe de mim o conselho dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Habíales él henchido sus casas de bienes. Sea empero el consejo de ellos lejos de mí.

verses.KJV: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
verses.WEB: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
verses.ASV: The righteous see it, and are glad; And the innocent laugh them to scorn,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os justos virão e se alegrarão; e o inocente os escarnecerá,
verses.RVR09: Verán los justos y se gozarán; y el inocente los escarnecerá, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
verses.WEB: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
verses.ASV: [Saying], Surely they that did rise up against us are cut off, And the remnant of them the fire hath consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dizendo] : Certamente nossos adversários foram destruídos, e o que sobrou deles o fogo consumiu.
verses.RVR09: Fué cortada nuestra sustancia, habiendo consumido el fuego el resto de ellos.

verses.KJV: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
verses.WEB: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
verses.ASV: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: Thereby good shall come unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reconcilia-te, pois, com [Deus] ,e terás paz; assim o bem virá a ti.
verses.RVR09: Amístate ahora con él, y tendrás paz; y por ello te vendrá bien.

verses.KJV: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
verses.WEB: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
verses.ASV: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, And lay up his words in thy heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aceita, pois, a instrução de sua boca, e põe suas palavras em teu coração.
verses.RVR09: Toma ahora la ley de su boca, y pon sus palabras en tu corazón.

verses.KJV: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
verses.WEB: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
verses.ASV: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, If thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se te converteres ao Todo-Poderoso, serás edificado; se afastares a maldade de tua tenda,
verses.RVR09: Si te tornares al Omnipotente, serás edificado; alejarás de tu tienda la aflicción;

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
verses.WEB: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
verses.ASV: And lay thou [thy] treasure in the dust, And [the gold of] Ophir among the stones of the brooks;
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançares [teu] ouro no pó, o [ouro] de Ofir junto às rochas dos ribeiros,
verses.RVR09: Y tendrás más oro que tierra, y como piedras de arroyos oro de Ophir;

verses.KJV: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
verses.WEB: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
verses.ASV: And the Almighty will be thy treasure, And precious silver unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o próprio Todo-Poderoso será teu ouro, e tua prata maciça.
verses.RVR09: Y el Todopoderoso será tu defensa, y tendrás plata á montones.

verses.KJV: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.WEB: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
verses.ASV: For then shalt thou delight thyself in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque então te deleitarás no Todo-Poderoso, e levantarás teu rosto a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque entonces te deleitarás en el Omnipotente, y alzarás á Dios tu rostro.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
verses.WEB: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he will hear thee; And thou shalt pay thy vows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Orarás a ele, e ele te ouvirá; e tu [lhe] pagarás teus votos.
verses.RVR09: Orarás á él, y él te oirá; y tú pagarás tus votos.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.WEB: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee; And light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquilo que tu determinares se cumprirá a ti, e em teus caminhos a luz brilhará.
verses.RVR09: Determinarás asimismo una cosa, y serte ha firme; y sobre tus caminos resplandecerá luz.

verses.KJV: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
verses.WEB: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
verses.ASV: When they cast [thee] down, thou shalt say, [There is] lifting up; And the humble person he will save.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando [alguém] for abatido, e tu disseres: Haja exaltação, Então [Deus] salvará ao humilde.
verses.RVR09: Cuando fueren abatidos, dirás tú: Ensalzamiento habrá: y Dios salvará al humilde de ojos.

verses.KJV: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
verses.WEB: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
verses.ASV: He will deliver [even] him that is not innocent: Yea, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of thy hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele libertará até ao que não é inocente, que será livrado pela pureza de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: El libertará la isla del inocente; y por la limpieza de tus manos será librada.

verses.KJV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
verses.WEB: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
verses.ASV: Even to-day is my complaint rebellious: My stroke is heavier than my groaning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até hoje minha queixa é uma amargura; a mão [de Deus] sobre mim é mais pesada que meu gemido.
verses.RVR09: Hoy también hablaré con amargura; que es más grave mi llaga que mi gemido.

verses.KJV: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
verses.WEB: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
verses.ASV: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah se eu soubesse como poderia achá-lo! [Então] eu me chegaria até seu trono.
verses.RVR09: ¡Quién me diera el saber dónde hallar á Dios! yo iría hasta su silla.

verses.KJV: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.WEB: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.ASV: I would set my cause in order before him, And fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apresentaria minha causa diante dele, e encheria minha boca de argumentos.
verses.RVR09: Ordenaría juicio delante de él, y henchiría mi boca de argumentos.

verses.KJV: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
verses.WEB: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
verses.ASV: I would know the words which he would answer me, And understand what he would say unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu saberia as palavras que ele me responderia, e entenderia o que me diria.
verses.RVR09: Yo sabría lo que él me respondería, y entendería lo que me dijese.

verses.KJV: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
verses.WEB: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
verses.ASV: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? Nay; but he would give heed unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso ele brigaria comigo com seu grande poder? Não, pelo contrário, ele me daria atenção.
verses.RVR09: ¿Pleitearía conmigo con grandeza de fuerza? No: antes él la pondría en mí.

verses.KJV: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.WEB: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
verses.ASV: There the upright might reason with him; So should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali o íntegro pleitearia com ele, e eu me livraria para sempre de meu Juiz.
verses.RVR09: Allí el justo razonaría con él: y escaparía para siempre de mi juez.

verses.KJV: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
verses.WEB: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.
verses.ASV: Behold, I go forward, but he is not [there]; And backward, but I cannot perceive him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que se eu for ao oriente, ele não está ali; [se for] ao ocidente, e não o percebo;
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo iré al oriente, y no lo hallaré; y al occidente, y no lo percibiré:

verses.KJV: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
verses.WEB: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
verses.ASV: On the left hand, when he doth work, but I cannot behold him; He hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ao norte ele opera, eu não [o] vejo; se ele se esconde ao sul, não [o] enxergo.
verses.RVR09: Si al norte él obrare, yo no lo veré; al mediodía se esconderá, y no lo veré.

verses.KJV: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.WEB: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
verses.ASV: But he knoweth the way that I take; When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele conhece meu caminho: Provar-me-á, e sairei como ouro.
verses.RVR09: Mas él conoció mi camino: probaráme, y saldré como oro.

verses.KJV: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
verses.WEB: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
verses.ASV: My foot hath held fast to his steps; His way have I kept, and turned not aside.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus pés seguiram seus passos; guardei seu caminho, e não me desviei.
verses.RVR09: Mis pies tomaron su rastro; guardé su camino, y no me aparté.

verses.KJV: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.WEB: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.ASV: I have not gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca retirei [de mim] o preceito de seus lábios, e guardei as palavras de sua boca mais que minha porção [de comida] .
verses.RVR09: Del mandamiento de sus labios nunca me separé; guardé las palabras de su boca más que mi comida.

verses.KJV: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
verses.WEB: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
verses.ASV: But he is in one [mind], and who can turn him? And what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se ele está decidido, quem poderá o desviar? O que sua alma quiser, isso fará.
verses.RVR09: Empero si él se determina en una cosa, ¿quién lo apartará? Su alma deseó, é hizo.

verses.KJV: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
verses.WEB: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
verses.ASV: For he performeth that which is appointed for me: And many such things are with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele cumprirá o que está determinado para mim; ele [ainda] tem muitas coisas como estas consigo.
verses.RVR09: El pues acabará lo que ha determinado de mí: y muchas cosas como estas hay en él.

verses.KJV: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.WEB: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.ASV: Therefore am I terrified at his presence; When I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu me perturbo em sua presença. Quando considero [isto] ,tenho medo dele.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual yo me espanto en su presencia: consideraré, y temerélo.

verses.KJV: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
verses.WEB: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
verses.ASV: For God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath terrified me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus enfraqueceu meu coração; o Todo-Poderoso tem me perturbado.
verses.RVR09: Dios ha enervado mi corazón, y hame turbado el Omnipotente.

verses.KJV: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
verses.WEB: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
verses.ASV: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não estou destruído por causa das trevas, nem por causa da escuridão que encobriu meu rosto.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué no fuí yo cortado delante de las tinieblas, y cubrió con oscuridad mi rostro?

verses.KJV: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
verses.WEB: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
verses.ASV: Why are times not laid up by the Almighty? And why do not they that know him see his days?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que os tempos não são marcados pelo Todo-Poderoso? Por que os que o conhecem não veem seus dias?
verses.RVR09: PUESTO que no son ocultos los tiempos al Todopoderoso, ¿por qué los que le conocen no ven sus días?

verses.KJV: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
verses.WEB: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
verses.ASV: There are that remove the landmarks; They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há os que mudam os limites de lugar, roubam rebanhos, e os apascentam.
verses.RVR09: Traspasan los términos, roban los ganados, y apaciéntanlos.

verses.KJV: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
verses.WEB: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.ASV: They drive away the ass of the fatherless; They take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levam o asno do órfão; penhoram o boi da viúva.
verses.RVR09: Llévanse el asno de los huérfanos; prenden el buey de la viuda.

verses.KJV: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.WEB: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
verses.ASV: They turn the needy out of the way: The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desviam do caminho aos necessitados; os pobres da terra juntos se escondem.
verses.RVR09: Hacen apartar del camino á los menesterosos: y todos los pobres de la tierra se esconden.

verses.KJV: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
verses.WEB: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.
verses.ASV: Behold, as wild asses in the desert They go forth to their work, seeking diligently for food; The wilderness [yieldeth] them bread for their children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que como asnos selvagens no deserto eles saem a seu trabalho buscando insistentemente por comida; o deserto dá alimento a ele [e a seus] filhos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, como asnos monteses en el desierto, salen á su obra madrugando para robar; el desierto es mantenimiento de sus hijos.

verses.KJV: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
verses.WEB: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
verses.ASV: They cut their provender in the field; And they glean the vintage of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: No campo colhem sua forragem, e vindimam a vinha do perverso.
verses.RVR09: En el campo siegan su pasto, y los impíos vendimian la viña ajena.

verses.KJV: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
verses.WEB: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
verses.ASV: They lie all night naked without clothing, And have no covering in the cold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passam a noite nus, por falta de roupa; sem terem coberta contra o frio.
verses.RVR09: Al desnudo hacen dormir sin ropa, y que en el frío no tenga cobertura.

verses.KJV: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.WEB: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.
verses.ASV: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelas correntes das montanhas são molhados e, não tendo abrigo, abraçam-se às rochas.
verses.RVR09: Con las avenidas de los montes se mojan, y abrazan las peñas sin tener abrigo.

verses.KJV: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
verses.WEB: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,
verses.ASV: There are that pluck the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge of the poor;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Há os que] arrancam ao órfão do peito, e do pobre tomam penhor.
verses.RVR09: Quitan el pecho á los huérfanos, y de sobre el pobre toman la prenda.

verses.KJV: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
verses.WEB: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
verses.ASV: [So that] they go about naked without clothing, And being hungry they carry the sheaves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao nus fazem andar sem vestes, e fazem os famintos carregarem feixes.
verses.RVR09: Al desnudo hacen andar sin vestido, y á los hambrientos quitan los hacecillos.

verses.KJV: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.WEB: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
verses.ASV: They make oil within the walls of these men; They tread [their] winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entre suas paredes espremem o azeite; pisam nas prensas de uvas, e [ainda] têm sede.
verses.RVR09: De dentro de sus paredes exprimen el aceite, pisan los lagares, y mueren de sed.

verses.KJV: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.
verses.WEB: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.
verses.ASV: From out of the populous city men groan, And the soul of the wounded crieth out: Yet God regardeth not the folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde a cidade as pessoas gemem, e as almas dos feridos clamam; Mas Deus não dá atenção ao erro.
verses.RVR09: De la ciudad gimen los hombres, y claman las almas de los heridos de muerte: mas Dios no puso estorbo.

verses.KJV: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.WEB: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
verses.ASV: These are of them that rebel against the light; They know not the ways thereof, Nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há os que se opõem à luz; não conhecem seus caminhos, nem permanecem em suas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Ellos son los que, rebeldes á la luz, nunca conocieron sus caminos, ni estuvieron en sus veredas.

verses.KJV: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
verses.WEB: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
verses.ASV: The murderer riseth with the light; He killeth the poor and needy; And in the night he is as a thief.
verses.ALMEIDA: De manhã o homicida se levanta, mata ao pobre e ao necessitado, e de noite ele age como ladrão.
verses.RVR09: A la luz se levanta el matador, mata al pobre y al necesitado, y de noche es como ladrón.

verses.KJV: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
verses.WEB: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.
verses.ASV: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, Saying, No eye shall see me: And he disguiseth his face.
verses.ALMEIDA: O olho do adúltero aguarda o crepúsculo, dizendo: Olho nenhum me verá; E esconde seu rosto.
verses.RVR09: El ojo del adúltero está aguardando la noche, diciendo: No me verá nadie: y esconde su rostro.

verses.KJV: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
verses.WEB: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
verses.ASV: In the dark they dig through houses: They shut themselves up in the day-time; They know not the light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nas trevas vasculham as casas, de dia eles se trancam; não conhecem a luz.
verses.RVR09: En las tinieblas minan las casas, que de día para sí señalaron; no conocen la luz.

verses.KJV: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.WEB: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
verses.ASV: For the morning is to all of them as thick darkness; For they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a manhã é para todos eles como sombra de morte; pois são conhecidos dos pavores de sombra de morte.
verses.RVR09: Porque la mañana es á todos ellos como sombra de muerte; si son conocidos, terrores de sombra de muerte los toman.

verses.KJV: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
verses.WEB: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.
verses.ASV: Swiftly they [pass away] upon the face of the waters; Their portion is cursed in the earth: They turn not into the way of the vineyards.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é ligeiro sobre a superfície das águas; maldita é sua porção sobre a terra; não se vira para o caminho das vinhas.
verses.RVR09: Son instables más que la superficie de las aguas; su porción es maldita en la tierra; no andarán por el camino de las viñas.

verses.KJV: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.
verses.WEB: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.
verses.ASV: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: [So doth] Sheol [those that] have sinned.
verses.ALMEIDA: A seca e o calor desfazem as águas da neve; assim [faz] o Xeol aos que pecaram.
verses.RVR09: La sequía y el calor arrebatan las aguas de la nieve; y el sepulcro á los pecadores.

verses.KJV: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.WEB: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.
verses.ASV: The womb shall forget him; The worm shall feed sweetly on him; He shall be no more remembered; And unrighteousness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mãe se esquecerá dele; doce será para os vermes; nunca mais haverá memória [dele] , e a perversidade será quebrada como um árvore.
verses.RVR09: Olvidaráse de ellos el seno materno; de ellos sentirán los gusanos dulzura; nunca más habrá de ellos memoria, y como un árbol serán los impíos quebrantados.

verses.KJV: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
verses.WEB: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
verses.ASV: He devoureth the barren that beareth not, And doeth not good to the widow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aflige à mulher estéril, [que] não dá à luz; e nenhum bem faz à viúva.
verses.RVR09: A la mujer estéril que no paría, afligió; y á la viuda nunca hizo bien.

verses.KJV: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
verses.WEB: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
verses.ASV: Yet [God] preserveth the mighty by his power: He riseth up that hath no assurance of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [Deus] arranca aos poderosos com seu poder; [quando] Deus se levanta, não há vida segura.
verses.RVR09: Mas á los fuertes adelantó con su poder: levantóse, y no se da por segura la vida.

verses.KJV: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
verses.WEB: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
verses.ASV: [God] giveth them to be in security, and they rest thereon; And his eyes are upon their ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ele lhes dá descanso, nisso confiam; [mas] os olhos de [Deus] estão [postos] nos caminhos deles.
verses.RVR09: Le dieron á crédito, y se afirmó: sus ojos están sobre los caminos de ellos.

verses.KJV: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
verses.WEB: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.
verses.ASV: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone; Yea, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, And are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.
verses.ALMEIDA: São exaltados por um pouco [de tempo] ,mas [logo] desaparecem; são abatidos, encerrados como todos, e cortados como cabeças das espigas.
verses.RVR09: Fueron ensalzados por un poco, mas desaparecen, y son abatidos como cada cual: serán encerrados, y cortados como cabezas de espigas.

verses.KJV: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
verses.WEB: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
verses.ASV: And if it be not so now, who will prove me a liar, And make my speech nothing worth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se não é assim, quem me desmentirá, ou anulará minhas palavras?
verses.RVR09: Y si no, ¿quién me desmentirá ahora, ó reducirá á nada mis palabras?

verses.KJV: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.WEB: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
verses.ASV: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Bildade, o suíta, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Bildad Suhita, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
verses.WEB: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
verses.ASV: Dominion and fear are with him; He maketh peace in his high places.
verses.ALMEIDA: O domínio e o temor estão com ele; ele faz paz em suas alturas.
verses.RVR09: El señorío y el temor están con él: él hace paz en sus alturas.

verses.KJV: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.WEB: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
verses.ASV: Is there any number of his armies? And upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso suas tropas têm número? E sobre quem não se levanta sua luz?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tienen sus ejércitos número? ¿y sobre quién no está su luz?

verses.KJV: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
verses.WEB: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
verses.ASV: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como, pois, o ser humano seria justo para com Deus? E como seria puro aquele que nasce de mulher?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo pues se justificará el hombre con Dios? ¿y cómo será limpio el que nace de mujer?

verses.KJV: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
verses.WEB: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
verses.ASV: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, And the stars are not pure in his sight:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que até a luz não tem brilho; nem as estrelas são puras diante de seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que ni aun la misma luna será resplandeciente, ni las estrellas son limpias delante de sus ojos:

verses.KJV: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
verses.WEB: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”
verses.ASV: How much less man, that is a worm! And the son of man, that is a worm!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto menos o ser humano, que é uma larva, e o filho de homem, que é um verme.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuánto menos el hombre que es un gusano, y el hijo de hombre, también gusano?

verses.KJV: But Job answered and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job, y dijo:

verses.KJV: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
verses.WEB: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
verses.ASV: How hast thou helped him that is without power! How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!
verses.ALMEIDA: Como tende ajudado ao que não tem força, [e] sustentado ao braço sem vigor!
verses.RVR09: ¿En qué ayudaste al que no tiene fuerza? ¿has amparado al brazo sin fortaleza?

verses.KJV: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.WEB: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
verses.ASV: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, And plentifully declared sound knowledge!
verses.ALMEIDA: Como tende aconselhado ao que não tem conhecimento, e [lhe] explicaste detalhadamente a verdadeira causa!
verses.RVR09: ¿En qué aconsejaste al que no tiene ciencia, y mostraste bien sabiduría?

verses.KJV: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
verses.WEB: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
verses.ASV: To whom hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came forth from thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem tens dito [tais] palavras? E de quem é o espírito que sai de ti?
verses.RVR09: ¿A quién has anunciado palabras, y cúyo es el espíritu que de ti sale?

verses.KJV: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.WEB: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
verses.ASV: They that are deceased tremble Beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os mortos tremem debaixo das águas com os seus moradores.
verses.RVR09: Cosas inanimadas son formadas debajo de las aguas, y los habitantes de ellas.

verses.KJV: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
verses.WEB: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
verses.ASV: Sheol is naked before [God], And Abaddon hath no covering.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Xeol está nu perante Deus , e não há cobertura para a perdição.
verses.RVR09: El sepulcro es descubierto delante de él, y el infierno no tiene cobertura.

verses.KJV: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.WEB: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
verses.ASV: He stretcheth out the north over empty space, And hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele estende o norte sobre o vazio, suspende a terra sobre o nada.
verses.RVR09: Extiende el aquilón sobre vacío, cuelga la tierra sobre nada.

verses.KJV: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.WEB: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
verses.ASV: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele amarra as águas em suas nuvens, todavia a nuvem não se rasga debaixo dela.
verses.RVR09: Ata las aguas en sus nubes, y las nubes no se rompen debajo de ellas.

verses.KJV: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
verses.WEB: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
verses.ASV: He incloseth the face of his throne, And spreadeth his cloud upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele encobre a face de seu trono, e sobre ele estende sua nuvem.
verses.RVR09: El restriñe la faz de su trono, y sobre él extiende su nube.

verses.KJV: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
verses.WEB: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
verses.ASV: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters, Unto the confines of light and darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele determinou limite à superfície das águas, até a fronteira entre a luz e as trevas.
verses.RVR09: El cercó con término la superficie de las aguas, hasta el fin de la luz y las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
verses.WEB: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
verses.ASV: The pillars of heaven tremble And are astonished at his rebuke.
verses.ALMEIDA: As colunas do céu tremem, e se espantam por sua repreensão.
verses.RVR09: Las columnas del cielo tiemblan, y se espantan de su reprensión.

verses.KJV: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
verses.WEB: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
verses.ASV: He stirreth up the sea with his power, And by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele agita o mar com seu poder, e com seu entendimento fere abate a Raabe.
verses.RVR09: El rompe la mar con su poder, y con su entendimiento hiere la hinchazón suya.

verses.KJV: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
verses.WEB: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
verses.ASV: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished; His hand hath pierced the swift serpent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por seu Espírito adornou os céus; sua mão perfurou a serpente veloz.
verses.RVR09: Su espíritu adornó los cielos; su mano crió la serpiente tortuosa.

verses.KJV: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.WEB: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
verses.ASV: Lo, these are but the outskirts of his ways: And how small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que estas são [somente] as bordas de seus caminhos; e quão pouco é o que temos ouvido dele! Quem, pois, entenderia o trovão de seu poder?
verses.RVR09: He aquí, estas son partes de sus caminos: ¡mas cuán poco hemos oído de él! Porque el estruendo de sus fortalezas, ¿quién lo detendrá?

verses.KJV: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.WEB: Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.ASV: And Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jó prosseguiu em falar seu discurso, e disse:
verses.RVR09: Y REASUMIÓ Job su discurso, y dijo:

verses.KJV: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
verses.WEB: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
verses.ASV: As God liveth, who hath taken away my right, And the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul
verses.ALMEIDA: Vive Deus, que tirou meu direito, o Todo-Poderoso, que amargou minha alma,
verses.RVR09: Vive Dios, el cual ha apartado mi causa, y el Omnipotente, que amargó el alma mía,

verses.KJV: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
verses.WEB: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
verses.ASV: (For my life is yet whole in me, And the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
verses.ALMEIDA: Que enquanto meu fôlego estiver em mim, e o sopro de Deus em minhas narinas,
verses.RVR09: Que todo el tiempo que mi alma estuviere en mí, y hubiere hálito de Dios en mis narices,

verses.KJV: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
verses.WEB: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
verses.ASV: Surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, Neither shall my tongue utter deceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus lábios não falarão injustiça, nem minha língua pronunciará engano.
verses.RVR09: Mis labios no hablarán iniquidad, ni mi lengua pronunciará engaño.

verses.KJV: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
verses.WEB: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
verses.ASV: Far be it from me that I should justify you: Till I die I will not put away mine integrity from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca aconteça que eu diga que vós estais certos; até eu morrer nunca tirarei de mim minha integridade.
verses.RVR09: Nunca tal acontezca que yo os justifique: hasta morir no quitaré de mí mi integridad.

verses.KJV: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.WEB: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.ASV: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: My heart shall not reproach [me] so long as I live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me apegarei à minha justiça, e não a deixarei ir; meu coração não terá de que me acusar enquanto eu viver.
verses.RVR09: Mi justicia tengo asida, y no la cederé: no me reprochará mi corazón en el tiempo de mi vida.

verses.KJV: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
verses.WEB: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
verses.ASV: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And let him that riseth up against me be as the unrighteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja meu inimigo como o perverso, e o que se levantar contra mim como o injusto.
verses.RVR09: Sea como el impío mi enemigo, y como el inicuo mi adversario.

verses.KJV: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
verses.WEB: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
verses.ASV: For what is the hope of the godless, though he get him gain, When God taketh away his soul?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois qual é a esperança do hipócrita quando ele for cortado, quando Deus arrancar sua alma?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿cuál es la esperanza del hipócrita, por mucho que hubiere robado, cuando Dios arrebatare su alma?

verses.KJV: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
verses.WEB: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
verses.ASV: Will God hear his cry, When trouble cometh upon him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso Deus ouvirá seu clamor quando a aflição vier sobre ele?
verses.RVR09: ¿Oirá Dios su clamor cuando la tribulación sobre él viniere?

verses.KJV: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
verses.WEB: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
verses.ASV: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, And call upon God at all times?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se deleitará no Todo-Poderoso? Invocará a Deus a todo tempo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Deleitaráse en el Omnipotente? ¿invocará á Dios en todo tiempo?

verses.KJV: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.WEB: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
verses.ASV: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos ensinarei acerca da mão de Deus; não esconderei o que há com o Todo-Poderoso.
verses.RVR09: Yo os enseñaré en orden á la mano de Dios: no esconderé lo que hay para con el Omnipotente.

verses.KJV: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
verses.WEB: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
verses.ASV: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye become altogether vain?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que todos vós tendes visto [isso] ; então por que vos deixais enganar por ilusão?
verses.RVR09: He aquí que todos vosotros lo habéis visto: ¿por qué pues os desvanecéis con fantasía?

verses.KJV: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
verses.WEB: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
verses.ASV: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty:
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a porção do homem perverso para com Deus, a herança que os violentos receberão do Todo-Poderoso:
verses.RVR09: Esta es para con Dios la suerte del hombre impío, y la herencia que los violentos han de recibir del Omnipotente.

verses.KJV: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.WEB: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
verses.ASV: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se seus filhos se multiplicarem, serão para a espada; e seus descendentes não se fartarão de pão;
verses.RVR09: Si sus hijos fueren multiplicados, serán para el cuchillo; y sus pequeños no se hartarán de pan;

verses.KJV: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
verses.WEB: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
verses.ASV: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death, And his widows shall make no lamentation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que lhe restarem, pela praga serão sepultados; e suas viúvas não chorarão.
verses.RVR09: Los que le quedaren, en muerte serán sepultados; y no llorarán sus viudas.

verses.KJV: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.WEB: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
verses.ASV: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ele amontoar prata como o pó da terra, e se preparar roupas como lama,
verses.RVR09: Si amontonare plata como polvo, y si preparare ropa como lodo;

verses.KJV: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.WEB: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
verses.ASV: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mesmo ele tendo preparado, é o justo que se vestirá, e o inocente repartirá a prata.
verses.RVR09: Habrála él preparado, mas el justo se vestirá, y el inocente repartirá la plata.

verses.KJV: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
verses.WEB: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
verses.ASV: He buildeth his house as the moth, And as a booth which the keeper maketh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele constrói sua casa como a traça, como uma barraca feita por um vigilante.
verses.RVR09: Edificó su casa como la polilla, y cual cabaña que el guarda hizo.

verses.KJV: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.
verses.WEB: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
verses.ASV: He lieth down rich, but he shall not be gathered [to his fathers]; He openeth his eyes, and he is not.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rico dormirá, mas não será recolhido; ele abrirá seus olhos, e nada mais há para si.
verses.RVR09: El rico dormirá, mas no será recogido: abrirá sus ojos, mas él no será.

verses.KJV: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.WEB: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
verses.ASV: Terrors overtake him like waters; A tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Medos o tomarão como águas; um turbilhão o arrebatará de noite.
verses.RVR09: Asirán de él terrores como aguas: torbellino lo arrebatará de noche.

verses.KJV: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
verses.WEB: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
verses.ASV: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth; And it sweepeth him out of his place.
