verses.ALMEIDA: O vento oriental o levará, e ele partirá; e toma-o de seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Lo antecogerá el solano, y partirá; y tempestad lo arrebatará del lugar suyo.

verses.KJV: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
verses.WEB: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
verses.ASV: For [God] shall hurl at him, and not spare: He would fain flee out of his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o atacará sem o poupar, [enquanto] ele tenta fugir de seu poder.
verses.RVR09: Dios pues descargará sobre él, y no perdonará: hará él por huir de su mano.

verses.KJV: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.WEB: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
verses.ASV: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Baterá palmas por causa dele, e desde seu lugar lhe assoviará.
verses.RVR09: Batirán sus manos sobre él, y desde su lugar le silbarán.

verses.KJV: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
verses.WEB: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
verses.ASV: Surely there is a mine for silver, And a place for gold which they refine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente há minas para a prata, e o ouro lugar onde o derretem.
verses.RVR09: CIERTAMENTE la plata tiene sus veneros, y el oro lugar donde se forma.

verses.KJV: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
verses.WEB: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
verses.ASV: Iron is taken out of the earth, And copper is molten out of the stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ferro é tirado do solo, e da pedra se funde o cobre.
verses.RVR09: El hierro se saca del polvo, y de la piedra es fundido el metal.

verses.KJV: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
verses.WEB: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
verses.ASV: [Man] setteth an end to darkness, And searcheth out, to the furthest bound, The stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: O [homem] põe fim às trevas, e investiga em toda extremidade, as pedras que estão na escuridão e nas mais sombrias trevas.
verses.RVR09: A las tinieblas puso término, y examina todo á la perfección, las piedras que hay en la oscuridad y en la sombra de muerte.

verses.KJV: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
verses.WEB: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
verses.ASV: He breaketh open a shaft away from where men sojourn; They are forgotten of the foot; They hang afar from men, they swing to and fro.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abre um poço onde não há morador, lugares esquecidos por quem passa a pé; pendurados longe da humanidade, vão de um lado para o outro.
verses.RVR09: Brota el torrente de junto al morador, aguas que el pie había olvidado: sécanse luego, vanse del hombre.

verses.KJV: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
verses.WEB: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
verses.ASV: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread; And underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da terra o pão procede, e por debaixo ela é transformada como que pelo fogo.
verses.RVR09: De la tierra nace el pan, y debajo de ella estará como convertida en fuego.

verses.KJV: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
verses.WEB: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
verses.ASV: The stones thereof are the place of sapphires, And it hath dust of gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas pedras são o lugar da safira, e contém pó de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Lugar hay cuyas piedras son zafiro, y sus polvos de oro.

verses.KJV: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:
verses.WEB: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
verses.ASV: That path no bird of prey knoweth, Neither hath the falcon’s eye seen it:
verses.ALMEIDA: A ave de rapina não conhece essa vereda; os olhos do falcão não a viram.
verses.RVR09: Senda que nunca la conoció ave, ni ojo de buitre la vió:

verses.KJV: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
verses.WEB: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
verses.ASV: The proud beasts have not trodden it, Nor hath the fierce lion passed thereby.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhotes de animais ferozes nunca a pisaram, nem o feroz leão passou por ela.
verses.RVR09: Nunca la pisaron animales fieros, ni león pasó por ella.

verses.KJV: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.WEB: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
verses.ASV: He putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.ALMEIDA: [O homem] põe sua mão no rochedo, e revolve os montes desde a raiz.
verses.RVR09: En el pedernal puso su mano, y trastornó los montes de raíz.

verses.KJV: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
verses.WEB: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
verses.ASV: He cutteth out channels among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cortou canais pelas rochas, e seus olhos veem tudo o que é precioso.
verses.RVR09: De los peñascos cortó ríos, y sus ojos vieron todo lo preciado.

verses.KJV: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
verses.WEB: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
verses.ASV: He bindeth the streams that they trickle not; And the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tapa os rios desde suas nascentes, e faz o oculto sair para a luz.
verses.RVR09: Detuvo los ríos en su nacimiento, é hizo salir á luz lo escondido.

verses.KJV: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.WEB: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
verses.ASV: But where shall wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém onde se achará a sabedoria? E onde está o lugar da inteligência?
verses.RVR09: Empero ¿dónde se hallará la sabiduría? ¿y dónde está el lugar de la prudencia?

verses.KJV: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.WEB: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.
verses.ASV: Man knoweth not the price thereof; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ser humano não conhece o valor dela, nem ela é achada na terra dos viventes.
verses.RVR09: No conoce su valor el hombre, ni se halla en la tierra de los vivientes.

verses.KJV: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
verses.WEB: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
verses.ASV: The deep saith, It is not in me; And the sea saith, It is not with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O abismo diz: Não está em mim; E o mar diz: Nem comigo.
verses.RVR09: El abismo dice: No está en mí: y la mar dijo: Ni conmigo.

verses.KJV: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
verses.WEB: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
verses.ASV: It cannot be gotten for gold, Neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem por ouro fino se pode comprar, nem se pesar em troca de prata.
verses.RVR09: No se dará por oro, ni su precio será á peso de plata.

verses.KJV: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.WEB: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.ASV: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, With the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não pode ser avaliada com ouro de Ofir, nem com ônix precioso, nem com safira.
verses.RVR09: No puede ser apreciada con oro de Ophir, ni con onique precioso, ni con zafiro.

verses.KJV: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
verses.WEB: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
verses.ASV: Gold and glass cannot equal it, Neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se pode comparar com ela o ouro, nem o cristal; nem se pode trocar por joia de ouro fino.
verses.RVR09: El oro no se le igualará, ni el diamante; ni se trocará por vaso de oro fino.

verses.KJV: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.WEB: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.ASV: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal: Yea, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.ALMEIDA: De coral nem de quartzo não se fará menção; porque o preço da sabedoria é melhor que o de rubis.
verses.RVR09: De coral ni de perlas no se hará mención: la sabiduría es mejor que piedras preciosas.

verses.KJV: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.WEB: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.
verses.ASV: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: O topázio de Cuxe não se pode comparar com ela; nem pode ser avaliada com o puro ouro fino.
verses.RVR09: No se igualará con ella esmeralda de Ethiopía; no se podrá apreciar con oro fino.

verses.KJV: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.WEB: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
verses.ASV: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?
verses.ALMEIDA: De onde, pois, vem a sabedoria? E onde está o lugar da inteligência?
verses.RVR09: ¿De dónde pues vendrá la sabiduría? ¿y dónde está el lugar de la inteligencia?

verses.KJV: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
verses.WEB: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
verses.ASV: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, And kept close from the birds of the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque encoberta está aos olhos de todo vivente, e é oculta a toda ave do céu.
verses.RVR09: Porque encubierta está á los ojos de todo viviente, y á toda ave del cielo es oculta.

verses.KJV: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
verses.WEB: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
verses.ASV: Destruction and Death say, We have heard a rumor thereof with our ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perdição e a morte dizem: Com nossos ouvidos ouvimos sua fama.
verses.RVR09: El infierno y la muerte dijeron: Su fama hemos oído con nuestros oídos.

verses.KJV: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
verses.WEB: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
verses.ASV: God understandeth the way thereof, And he knoweth the place thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus entende o caminho dela, e ele conhece seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Dios entiende el camino de ella, y él conoce su lugar.

verses.KJV: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.WEB: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
verses.ASV: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, And seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele enxerga até os confins da terra, e vê tudo [o que há] debaixo de céus.
verses.RVR09: Porque él mira hasta los fines de la tierra, y ve debajo de todo el cielo.

verses.KJV: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
verses.WEB: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
verses.ASV: To make a weight for the wind: Yea, he meteth out the waters by measure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele deu peso ao vento, e estabeleceu medida para as águas;
verses.RVR09: Al dar peso al viento, y poner las aguas por medida;

verses.KJV: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
verses.WEB: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
verses.ASV: When he made a decree for the rain, And a way for the lightning of the thunder;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele fez lei para a chuva, e caminho para o relâmpago dos trovões,
verses.RVR09: Cuando él hizo ley á la lluvia, y camino al relámpago de los truenos;

verses.KJV: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.WEB: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
verses.ASV: Then did he see it, and declare it; He established it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele a viu, e relatou; preparou-a, e também a examinou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la veía él, y la manifestaba; preparóla y descubrióla también.

verses.KJV: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
verses.WEB: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
verses.ASV: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to depart from evil is understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse ao homem: Eis que o temor ao Senhor é a sabedoria, e o desviar-se do mal [é] a inteligência.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo al hombre: He aquí que el temor del Señor es la sabiduría, y el apartarse del mal la inteligencia.

verses.KJV: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.WEB: Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.ASV: And Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jó continuou a falar seu discurso, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y VOLVIÓ Job á tomar su propósito, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;
verses.WEB: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
verses.ASV: Oh that I were as in the months of old, As in the days when God watched over me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah quem me dera que fosse como nos meses passados! Como nos dias em que Deus me guardava!
verses.RVR09: ¡Quién me tornase como en los meses pasados, como en los días que Dios me guardaba,

verses.KJV: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
verses.WEB: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
verses.ASV: When his lamp shined upon my head, And by his light I walked through darkness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele fazia brilhar sua lâmpada sobre minha cabeça, e eu com sua luz caminhava pelas trevas,
verses.RVR09: Cuando hacía resplandecer su candela sobre mi cabeza, á la luz de la cual yo caminaba en la oscuridad;

verses.KJV: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
verses.WEB: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
verses.ASV: As I was in the ripeness of my days, When the friendship of God was upon my tent;
verses.ALMEIDA: Como era nos dias de minha juventude, quando a amizade de Deus estava sobre minha tenda;
verses.RVR09: Como fué en los días de mi mocedad, cuando el secreto de Dios estaba en mi tienda;

verses.KJV: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
verses.WEB: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
verses.ASV: When the Almighty was yet with me, And my children were about me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o Todo-Poderoso ainda estava comigo, meus filhos ao redor de mim;
verses.RVR09: Cuando aun el Omnipotente estaba conmigo, y mis hijos alrededor de mí;

verses.KJV: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
verses.WEB: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
verses.ASV: When my steps were washed with butter, And the rock poured me out streams of oil!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu lavava meus passos com manteiga, e da rocha me corriam ribeiros de azeite!
verses.RVR09: Cuando lavaba yo mis caminos con manteca, y la piedra me derramaba ríos de aceite!

verses.KJV: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
verses.WEB: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
verses.ASV: When I went forth to the gate unto the city, When I prepared my seat in the street,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu saía para a porta da cidade, [e] na praça preparava minha cadeira,
verses.RVR09: Cuando salía á la puerta á juicio, y en la plaza hacía preparar mi asiento,

verses.KJV: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
verses.WEB: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
verses.ASV: The young men saw me and hid themselves, And the aged rose up and stood;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os rapazes me viam, e abriam caminho; e os idosos se levantavam, e ficavam em pé;
verses.RVR09: Los mozos me veían, y se escondían; y los viejos se levantaban, y estaban en pie;

verses.KJV: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
verses.WEB: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
verses.ASV: The princes refrained from talking, And laid their hand on their mouth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os príncipes se detinham de falar, e punham a mão sobre a sua boca;
verses.RVR09: Los príncipes detenían sus palabras, ponían la mano sobre su boca;

verses.KJV: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
verses.WEB: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
verses.ASV: The voice of the nobles was hushed, And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A voz dos líderes se calava, e suas línguas se apegavam a céu da boca;
verses.RVR09: La voz de los principales se ocultaba, y su lengua se pegaba á su paladar:

verses.KJV: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
verses.WEB: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,
verses.ASV: For when the ear heard [me], then it blessed me; And when the eye saw [me], it gave witness unto me:
verses.ALMEIDA: O ouvido que me ouvia me considerava bem-aventurado, e o olho que me via dava bom testemunho de mim.
verses.RVR09: Cuando los oídos que me oían, me llamaban bienaventurado, y los ojos que me veían, me daban testimonio:

verses.KJV: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
verses.WEB: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
verses.ASV: Because I delivered the poor that cried, The fatherless also, that had none to help him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu livrava ao pobre que clamava, e ao órfão que não tinha quem o ajudasse.
verses.RVR09: Porque libraba al pobre que gritaba, y al huérfano que carecía de ayudador.

verses.KJV: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.
verses.WEB: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.ASV: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me; And I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: A bênção do que estava a ponto de morrer vinha sobre mim; e eu fazia o coração da viúva ter grande alegria.
verses.RVR09: La bendición del que se iba á perder venía sobre mí; y al corazón de la viuda daba alegría.

verses.KJV: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.WEB: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.ASV: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vestia-me de justiça, e ela me envolvia; e meu juízo era como um manto e um turbante.
verses.RVR09: Vestíame de justicia, y ella me vestía como un manto; y mi toca era juicio.

verses.KJV: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
verses.WEB: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
verses.ASV: I was eyes to the blind, And feet was I to the lame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu era olhos para o cego, e pés para o manco.
verses.RVR09: Yo era ojos al ciego, y pies al cojo.

verses.KJV: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
verses.WEB: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.
verses.ASV: I was a father to the needy: And the cause of him that I knew not I searched out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos necessitados eu era pai; e a causa que eu não sabia, investigava com empenho.
verses.RVR09: A los menesterosos era padre; y de la causa que no entendía, me informaba con diligencia:

verses.KJV: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
verses.WEB: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
verses.ASV: And I brake the jaws of the unrighteous, And plucked the prey out of his teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quebrava os queixos do perverso, e de seus dentes tirava a presa.
verses.RVR09: Y quebraba los colmillos del inicuo, y de sus dientes hacía soltar la presa.

verses.KJV: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
verses.WEB: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
verses.ASV: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the sand:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu dizia: Em meu ninho expirarei, e multiplicarei [meus] dias como areia.
verses.RVR09: Y decía yo: En mi nido moriré, y como arena multiplicaré días.

verses.KJV: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
verses.WEB: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
verses.ASV: My root is spread out to the waters, And the dew lieth all night upon my branch:
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha raiz se estendia junto às águas, e o orvalho ficava de noite em meus ramos.
verses.RVR09: Mi raíz estaba abierta junto á las aguas, y en mis ramas permanecía el rocío.

verses.KJV: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
verses.WEB: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
verses.ASV: My glory is fresh in me, And my bow is renewed in my hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha honra se renovava em mim, e meu arco se revigorava em minha mão.
verses.RVR09: Mi honra se renovaba en mí, y mi arco se corroboraba en mi mano.

verses.KJV: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
verses.WEB: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
verses.ASV: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouviam-me, e esperavam; e se calavam ao meu conselho.
verses.RVR09: Oíanme, y esperaban; y callaban á mi consejo.

verses.KJV: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
verses.WEB: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
verses.ASV: After my words they spake not again; And my speech distilled upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois de minha palavra nada replicavam, e minhas razões gotejavam sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Tras mi palabra no replicaban, y mi razón destilaba sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
verses.WEB: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
verses.ASV: And they waited for me as for the rain; And they opened their mouth wide [as] for the latter rain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois esperavam por mim como pela chuva, e abriam sua boca como para a chuva tardia.
verses.RVR09: Y esperábanme como á la lluvia, y abrían su boca como á la lluvia tardía.

verses.KJV: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.WEB: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
verses.ASV: I smiled on them, when they had no confidence; And the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu me ria com eles, não acreditavam; e não desfaziam a luz de meu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Si me reía con ellos, no lo creían: y no abatían la luz de mi rostro.

verses.KJV: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
verses.WEB: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
verses.ASV: I chose out their way, and sat [as] chief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu escolhia o caminho para eles, e me sentava à cabeceira; e habitava como rei entre as tropas, como o consolador dos que choram.
verses.RVR09: Calificaba yo el camino de ellos, y sentábame en cabecera; y moraba como rey en el ejército, como el que consuela llorosos.

verses.KJV: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
verses.WEB: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
verses.ASV: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém agora riem de mim os mais jovens do que eu, cujos pais eu havia desdenhado até de os pôr com os cães de meu rebanho.
verses.RVR09: MAS ahora los más mozos de días que yo, se ríen de mí; cuyos padres yo desdeñara ponerlos con los perros de mi ganado.

verses.KJV: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
verses.WEB: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
verses.ASV: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? Men in whom ripe age is perished.
verses.ALMEIDA: De que também me serviria força de suas mãos, nos quais o vigor já pereceu?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿para qué yo habría menester la fuerza de sus manos, en los cuales había perecido con el tiempo?

verses.KJV: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
verses.WEB: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
verses.ASV: They are gaunt with want and famine; They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da pobreza e da fome andavam sós; roem na terra seca, no lugar desolado e deserto em trevas.
verses.RVR09: Por causa de la pobreza y del hambre andaban solos; huían á la soledad, á lugar tenebroso, asolado y desierto.

verses.KJV: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
verses.WEB: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
verses.ASV: They pluck salt-wort by the bushes; And the roots of the broom are their food.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que colhiam malvas entre os arbustos, e seu alimento eram as raízes dos zimbros.
verses.RVR09: Que cogían malvas entre los arbustos, y raíces de enebro para calentarse.

verses.KJV: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
verses.WEB: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,
verses.ASV: They are driven forth from the midst [of men]; They cry after them as after a thief;
verses.ALMEIDA: Do meio [das pessoas] eram expulsos, e gritavam contra eles, como a um ladrão.
verses.RVR09: Eran echados de entre las gentes, y todos les daban grita como al ladrón.

verses.KJV: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
verses.WEB: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
verses.ASV: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, In holes of the earth and of the rocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Habitavam nos barrancos dos ribeiros secos, nos buracos da terra, e nas rochas.
verses.RVR09: Habitaban en las barrancas de los arroyos, en las cavernas de la tierra, y en las rocas.

verses.KJV: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
verses.WEB: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.
verses.ASV: Among the bushes they bray; Under the nettles they are gathered together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bramavam entre os arbustos, e se ajuntavam debaixo das urtigas.
verses.RVR09: Bramaban entre las matas, y se reunían debajo de las espinas.

verses.KJV: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
verses.WEB: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
verses.ASV: [They are] children of fools, yea, children of base men; They were scourged out of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eram filhos de tolos, filhos sem nome, e expulsos de [sua] terra.
verses.RVR09: Hijos de viles, y hombres sin nombre, más bajos que la misma tierra.

verses.KJV: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
verses.WEB: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
verses.ASV: And now I am become their song, Yea, I am a byword unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém agora sirvo-lhes de chacota, e sou para eles um provérbio de escárnio.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora yo soy su canción, y he sido hecho su refrán.

verses.KJV: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
verses.WEB: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
verses.ASV: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, And spare not to spit in my face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles me abominam [e] se afastam de mim; porém não hesitam em cuspir no meu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Abomínanme, aléjanse de mí, y aun de mi rostro no detuvieron su saliva.

verses.KJV: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
verses.WEB: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
verses.ASV: For he hath loosed his cord, and afflicted me; And they have cast off the bridle before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois [Deus] desatou minha corda, e me oprimiu; por isso tiraram [de si] todo constrangimento perante meu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios desató mi cuerda, y me afligió, por eso se desenfrenaron delante de mi rostro.

verses.KJV: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
verses.WEB: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.
verses.ASV: Upon my right hand rise the rabble; They thrust aside my feet, And they cast up against me their ways of destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: À direita os jovens se levantam; empurram meus pés, e preparam contra mim seus caminhos de destruição.
verses.RVR09: A la mano derecha se levantaron los jóvenes; empujaron mis pies, y sentaron contra mí las vías de su ruina.

verses.KJV: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
verses.WEB: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
verses.ASV: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, [Even] men that have no helper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Destroem meu caminho, e promovem minha miséria, sem necessitarem que alguém os ajude.
verses.RVR09: Mi senda desbarataron, aprovecháronse de mi quebrantamiento, contra los cuales no hubo ayudador.

verses.KJV: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
verses.WEB: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
verses.ASV: As through a wide breach they come: In the midst of the ruin they roll themselves [upon me].
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles vêm [contra mim] como que por uma brecha larga, [e] revolvem-se entre a desolação.
verses.RVR09: Vinieron como por portillo ancho, revolviéronse á mi calamidad.

verses.KJV: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
verses.WEB: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
verses.ASV: Terrors are turned upon me; They chase mine honor as the wind; And my welfare is passed away as a cloud.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pavores se voltam contra mim; perseguem minha honra como o vento, e como nuvem passou minha prosperidade.
verses.RVR09: Hanse revuelto turbaciones sobre mí; combatieron como viento mi alma, y mi salud pasó como nube.

verses.KJV: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.WEB: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
verses.ASV: And now my soul is poured out within me; Days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso agora minha alma se derrama em mim; dias de aflição têm me tomado.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora mi alma está derramada en mí; días de aflicción me han aprehendido.

verses.KJV: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
verses.WEB: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
verses.ASV: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, And the [pains] that gnaw me take no rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: De noite meus ossos se furam em mim, e meus pulsos não descansam.
verses.RVR09: De noche taladra sobre mí mis huesos, y mis pulsos no reposan.

verses.KJV: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.WEB: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
verses.ASV: By [God’s] great force is my garment disfigured; It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por grande força [de Deus] minha roupa está estragada; ele me prendeu como a gola de minha roupa.
verses.RVR09: Con la grande copia de materia mi vestidura está demudada; cíñeme como el cuello de mi túnica.

verses.KJV: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.WEB: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
verses.ASV: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lançou-me na lama, e fiquei semelhante ao pó e à cinza.
verses.RVR09: Derribóme en el lodo, y soy semejante al polvo y á la ceniza.

verses.KJV: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.
verses.WEB: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
verses.ASV: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not answer me: I stand up, and thou gazest at me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Clamo a ti, porém tu não me respondes; eu fico de pé, porém tu ficas [apenas] olhando para mim.
verses.RVR09: Clamo á ti, y no me oyes; preséntome, y no me atiendes.

verses.KJV: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
verses.WEB: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
verses.ASV: Thou art turned to be cruel to me; With the might of thy hand thou persecutest me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te tornaste cruel para comigo; com a força de tua mão tu me atacas.
verses.RVR09: Haste tornado cruel para mí: con la fortaleza de tu mano me amenazas.

verses.KJV: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
verses.WEB: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
verses.ASV: Thou liftest me up to the wind, thou causest me to ride [upon it]; And thou dissolvest me in the storm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantas-me sobre o vento, [e] me fazes cavalgar [sobre ele] ; e dissolves o meu ser.
verses.RVR09: Levantásteme, é hicísteme cabalgar sobre el viento, y disolviste mi sustancia.

verses.KJV: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
verses.WEB: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.
verses.ASV: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sei que me levarás à morte; e à casa determinada a todos os viventes.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo conozco que me reduces á la muerte; y á la casa determinada á todo viviente.

verses.KJV: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
verses.WEB: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
verses.ASV: Howbeit doth not one stretch out the hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não se estende a mão para quem está em ruínas, quando clamam em sua opressão?
verses.RVR09: Mas él no extenderá la mano contra el sepulcro; ¿clamarán los sepultados cuando él los quebrantare?

verses.KJV: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
verses.WEB: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
verses.ASV: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? Was not my soul grieved for the needy?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eu não chorei pelo que estava em dificuldade, [e] minha alma não se angustiou pelo necessitado?
verses.RVR09: ¿No lloré yo al afligido? Y mi alma ¿no se entristeció sobre el menesteroso?

verses.KJV: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.WEB: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
verses.ASV: When I looked for good, then evil came; And when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu esperava o bem, então veio o mal; quando eu esperava a luz, veio a escuridão.
verses.RVR09: Cuando esperaba yo el bien, entonces vino el mal; y cuando esperaba luz, la oscuridad vino.

verses.KJV: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
verses.WEB: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
verses.ASV: My heart is troubled, and resteth not; Days of affliction are come upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minhas entranhas fervem, e não se aquietam; dias de aflição me confrontam.
verses.RVR09: Mis entrañas hierven, y no reposan; días de aflicción me han sobrecogido.

verses.KJV: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
verses.WEB: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
verses.ASV: I go mourning without the sun: I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ando escurecido, mas não pelo sol; levanto-me na congregação, e clamo por socorro.
verses.RVR09: Denegrido ando, y no por el sol: levantádome he en la congregación, y clamado.

verses.KJV: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
verses.WEB: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
verses.ASV: I am a brother to jackals, And a companion to ostriches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornei-me irmão dos chacais, e companheiro dos avestruzes.
verses.RVR09: He venido á ser hermano de los dragones, y compañero de los buhos.

verses.KJV: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
verses.WEB: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
verses.ASV: My skin is black, [and falleth] from me, And my bones are burned with heat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha pele se escureceu sobre mim, e meus ossos se inflamam de febre.
verses.RVR09: Mi piel está denegrida sobre mí, y mis huesos se secaron con ardentía.

verses.KJV: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
verses.WEB: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
verses.ASV: Therefore is my harp [turned] to mourning, And my pipe into the voice of them that weep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso minha harpa passou a ser para lamentação, e minha flauta para vozes dos que choram.
verses.RVR09: Y hase tornado mi arpa en luto, y mi órgano en voz de lamentadores.

verses.KJV: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verses.WEB: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
verses.ASV: I made a covenant with mine eyes; How then should I look upon a virgin?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu fiz um pacto com meus olhos; como, pois, eu olharia com cobiça para a virgem?
verses.RVR09: HICE pacto con mis ojos: ¿cómo pues había yo de pensar en virgen?

verses.KJV: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
verses.WEB: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
verses.ASV: For what is the portion from God above, And the heritage from the Almighty on high?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois qual é a porção [dada] por Deus acima, e a herança [dada] pelo Todo-Poderoso das alturas?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué galardón me daría de arriba Dios, y qué heredad el Omnipotente de las alturas?

verses.KJV: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
verses.WEB: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
verses.ASV: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, And disaster to the workers of iniquity?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso a calamidade não é para o perverso, e o desastre para os que praticam injustiça?
verses.RVR09: ¿No hay quebrantamiento para el impío, y extrañamiento para los que obran iniquidad?

verses.KJV: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.WEB: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.ASV: Doth not he see my ways, And number all my steps?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso ele não vê meus caminhos, e conta todos os meus passos?
verses.RVR09: ¿No ve él mis caminos, y cuenta todos mis pasos?

verses.KJV: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
verses.WEB: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
verses.ASV: If I have walked with falsehood, And my foot hath hasted to deceit
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu andei com falsidade, e se meu pé se apressou para o engano,
verses.RVR09: Si anduve con mentira, y si mi pie se apresuró á engaño,

verses.KJV: Let me be weighed in an even balance that God may know mine integrity.
verses.WEB: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);
verses.ASV: (Let me be weighed in an even balance, That God may know mine integrity);
verses.ALMEIDA: Pese-me ele em balanças justas, e Deus saberá minha integridade.
verses.RVR09: Péseme Dios en balanzas de justicia, y conocerá mi integridad.

verses.KJV: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
verses.WEB: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
verses.ASV: If my step hath turned out of the way, And my heart walked after mine eyes, And if any spot hath cleaved to my hands:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se meus passos se desviaram do caminho, e meu coração seguiu meus olhos, e se algo se apegou às minhas mãos,
verses.RVR09: Si mis pasos se apartaron del camino, y si mi corazón se fué tras mis ojos, y si algo se apegó á mis manos,

verses.KJV: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
verses.WEB: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
verses.ASV: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que eu semeie, e outro coma; e meus produtos sejam arrancados.
verses.RVR09: Siembre yo, y otro coma, y mis verduras sean arrancadas.

verses.KJV: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
verses.WEB: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
verses.ASV: If my heart hath been enticed unto a woman, And I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se foi meu coração se deixou seduzir por [alguma] mulher, ou se estive espreitei à porta de meu próximo,
verses.RVR09: Si fué mi corazón engañado acerca de mujer, y si estuve acechando á la puerta de mi prójimo:

verses.KJV: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
verses.WEB: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.
verses.ASV: Then let my wife grind unto another, And let others bow down upon her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que minha mulher moa para outro, e outros se encurvem sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Muela para otro mi mujer, y sobre ella otros se encorven.

verses.KJV: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
verses.WEB: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,
verses.ASV: For that were a heinous crime; Yea, it were an iniquity to be punished by the judges:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tal seria um crime vergonhoso, e delito [a ser sentenciado por] juízes.
verses.RVR09: Porque es maldad é iniquidad, que han de castigar los jueces.

verses.KJV: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
verses.WEB: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
verses.ASV: For it is a fire that consumeth unto Destruction, And would root out all mine increase.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois seria um fogo que consumiria até à perdição, e destruiria toda a minha renda.
verses.RVR09: Porque es fuego que devoraría hasta el sepulcro, y desarraigaría toda mi hacienda.

verses.KJV: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
verses.WEB: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
verses.ASV: If I have despised the cause of my man-servant or of my maid-servant, When they contended with me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se desprezei o direito de meu servo ou de minha serva quando eles reclamaram comigo,
verses.RVR09: Si hubiera tenido en poco el derecho de mi siervo y de mi sierva, cuando ellos pleitearan conmigo,

verses.KJV: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.WEB: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?
verses.ASV: What then shall I do when God riseth up? And when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que faria eu quando Deus se levantasse? E quando ele investigasse [a causa] ,o que eu lhe responderia?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué haría yo cuando Dios se levantase? y cuando él visitara, ¿qué le respondería yo?

verses.KJV: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
verses.WEB: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
verses.ASV: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? And did not one fashion us in the womb?
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que me fez no ventre [materno também] não fez a ele? E não nos preparou de um mesmo [modo] na madre?
verses.RVR09: El que en el vientre me hizo á mí, ¿no lo hizo á él? ¿y no nos dispuso uno mismo en la matriz?

verses.KJV: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.WEB: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
verses.ASV: If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu neguei aos pobres o que eles desejavam, ou fiz desfalecer os olhos da viúva;
verses.RVR09: Si estorbé el contento de los pobres, é hice desfallecer los ojos de la viuda;

verses.KJV: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
verses.WEB: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
verses.ASV: Or have eaten my morsel alone, And the fatherless hath not eaten thereof
verses.ALMEIDA: E se comi meu alimento sozinho, e o órfão não comeu dele
verses.RVR09: Y si comí mi bocado solo, y no comió de él el huérfano;

verses.KJV: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)
verses.WEB: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);
verses.ASV: (Nay, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, And her have I guided from my mother’s womb);
verses.ALMEIDA: (Porque desde a minha juventude cresceu comigo como [se eu fosse seu pai] ,e desde o ventre de minha mãe guiei [a viúva] );
verses.RVR09: (Porque desde mi mocedad creció conmigo como con padre, y desde el vientre de mi madre fuí guía de la viuda;)

verses.KJV: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
verses.WEB: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
verses.ASV: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, Or that the needy had no covering;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu vi alguém morrer por falta de roupa, e o necessitado sem algo que o cobrisse,
verses.RVR09: Si he visto que pereciera alguno sin vestido, y al menesteroso sin cobertura;

verses.KJV: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.WEB: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
verses.ASV: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he hath not been warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se sua cintura não me bendisse, quando ele se esquentava com as peles de meus cordeiros;
verses.RVR09: Si no me bendijeron sus lomos, y del vellón de mis ovejas se calentaron;

verses.KJV: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
verses.WEB: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;
verses.ASV: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, Because I saw my help in the gate:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se levantei minha mão contra o órfão, quando vi que seria favorecido na corte judicial,
verses.RVR09: Si alcé contra el huérfano mi mano, aunque viese que me ayudarían en la puerta;

verses.KJV: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
verses.WEB: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
verses.ASV: Then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, And mine arm be broken from the bone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que minha escápula caia do meu ombro, e meu braço se quebre de sua articulação.
verses.RVR09: Mi espalda se caiga de mi hombro, y mi brazo sea quebrado de mi canilla.

verses.KJV: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
verses.WEB: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
verses.ASV: For calamity from God is a terror to me, And by reason of his majesty I can do nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o castigo de Deus era um assombro para mim, e eu não teria poder contra sua majestade.
verses.RVR09: Porque temí el castigo de Dios, contra cuya alteza yo no tendría poder.

verses.KJV: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
verses.WEB: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
verses.ASV: If I have made gold my hope, And have said to the fine gold, [Thou art] my confidence;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu pus no ouro minha esperança, ou disse ao ouro fino: Tu és minha confiança;
verses.RVR09: Si puse en oro mi esperanza, y dije al oro: Mi confianza eres tú;

verses.KJV: If I rejoice because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
verses.WEB: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
verses.ASV: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because my hand had gotten much;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu me alegrei de que minha riqueza era muita, e de que minha mão havia obtido muito;
verses.RVR09: Si me alegré de que mi hacienda se multiplicase, y de que mi mano hallase mucho;

verses.KJV: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
verses.WEB: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
verses.ASV: If I have beheld the sun when it shined, Or the moon walking in brightness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Se olhei para o sol quando brilhava, e à lua quando estava bela,
verses.RVR09: Si he mirado al sol cuando resplandecía, y á la luna cuando iba hermosa,

verses.KJV: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
verses.WEB: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;
verses.ASV: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, And my mouth hath kissed my hand:
verses.ALMEIDA: E meu coração se deixou enganar em segredo, e minha boca beijou minha mão,
verses.RVR09: Y mi corazón se engañó en secreto, y mi boca besó mi mano:

verses.KJV: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
verses.WEB: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.
verses.ASV: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judges; For I should have denied the God that is above.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto também seria um delito [a ser sentenciado por] juiz; porque teria negado ao Deus de cima.
verses.RVR09: Esto también fuera maldad juzgada; porque habría negado al Dios soberano.

verses.KJV: If I rejoice at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
verses.WEB: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
verses.ASV: If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, Or lifted up myself when evil found him
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu me alegrei da desgraça daquele que me odiava, e me agradei quando o mal o encontrou,
verses.RVR09: Si me alegré en el quebrantamiento del que me aborrecía, y me regocijé cuando le halló el mal;

verses.KJV: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
verses.WEB: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
verses.ASV: (Yea, I have not suffered my mouth to sin By asking his life with a curse);
verses.ALMEIDA: Sendo que nem deixei minha boca pecar, desejando sua morte com maldição,
verses.RVR09: (Que ni aun entregué al pecado mi paladar, pidiendo maldición para su alma;)

verses.KJV: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
verses.WEB: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
verses.ASV: If the men of my tent have not said, Who can find one that hath not been filled with his meat?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se a gente da minha casa nunca tivesse dito: Quem não se satisfez da carne dada por ele?
verses.RVR09: Cuando mis domésticos decían: ¡Quién nos diese de su carne! nunca nos hartaríamos.

verses.KJV: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
verses.WEB: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
verses.ASV: (The sojourner hath not lodged in the street; But I have opened my doors to the traveller);
verses.ALMEIDA: O estrangeiro não passava a noite na rua; eu abria minhas portas ao viajante.
verses.RVR09: El extranjero no tenía fuera la noche; mis puertas abría al caminante.

verses.KJV: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
verses.WEB: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
verses.ASV: If like Adam I have covered my transgressions, By hiding mine iniquity in my bosom,
verses.ALMEIDA: Se encobri minhas transgressões como as pessoas [fazem] , escondendo meu delito em meu seio;
verses.RVR09: Si encubrí, como los hombres mis prevaricaciones, escondiendo en mi seno mi iniquidad;

verses.KJV: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
verses.WEB: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—
verses.ASV: Because I feared the great multitude, And the contempt of families terrified me, So that I kept silence, and went not out of the door—
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu tinha medo da grande multidão, e o desprezo das famílias me atemorizou; então me calei, e não saí da porta:
verses.RVR09: Porque quebrantaba á la gran multitud, y el menosprecio de las familias me atemorizó, y callé, y no salí de mi puerta:

verses.KJV: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
verses.WEB: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!
verses.ASV: Oh that I had one to hear me! (Lo, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me) And [that I had] the indictment which mine adversary hath written!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem me dera se alguém me ouvisse! Eis que minha vontade é que o Todo-Poderoso me responda, e meu adversário escrevesse um relato da acusação.
verses.RVR09: ¡Quién me diera quien me oyese! He aquí mi impresión es que el Omnipotente testificaría por mí, aunque mi adversario me hiciera el proceso.

verses.KJV: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
verses.WEB: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.
verses.ASV: Surely I would carry it upon my shoulder; I would bind it unto me as a crown:
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente eu o carregaria sobre meu ombro, e o poria em mim como uma coroa.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente yo lo llevaría sobre mi hombro, y me lo ataría en lugar de corona.

verses.KJV: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.WEB: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.
verses.ASV: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; As a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu lhe diria o número de meus passos, e como um príncipe eu me chegaria a ele.
verses.RVR09: Yo le contaría el número de mis pasos, y como príncipe me llegaría á él.

verses.KJV: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
verses.WEB: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
verses.ASV: If my land crieth out against me, And the furrows thereof weep together;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se minha terra clamar contra mim, e seus sulcos juntamente chorarem;
verses.RVR09: Si mi tierra clama contra mí, y lloran todos sus surcos;

verses.KJV: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
verses.WEB: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
verses.ASV: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, Or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se comi seus frutos sem [pagar] dinheiro, ou fiz expirar a alma de seus donos;
verses.RVR09: Si comí su sustancia sin dinero, ó afligí el alma de sus dueños;

verses.KJV: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.WEB: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
verses.ASV: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, And cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em lugar de trigo que [me] produza cardos, e ervas daninhas no lugar da cevada. [Aqui] terminam as palavras de Jó.
verses.RVR09: En lugar de trigo me nazcan abrojos, y espinas en lugar de cebada. Acábanse las palabras de Job.

verses.KJV: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.WEB: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.ASV: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então aqueles três homens cessaram de responder a Jó, porque ele era justo em seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Y CESARON estos tres varones de responder á Job, por cuanto él era justo en sus ojos.

verses.KJV: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.WEB: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.ASV: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se acendeu a ira de Eliú, filho de Baraquel, buzita, da família de Rão; contra Jó se acendeu sua ira, porque justificava mais a si mesmo que a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Eliú hijo de Barachêl, Bucita,, de la familia de Ram, se enojó con furor contra Job: enojóse con furor, por cuanto justificaba su vida más que á Dios.

verses.KJV: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.WEB: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.ASV: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também sua ira se acendeu contra seus três amigos, porque não achavam o que responder, ainda que tinham condenado a Jó.
verses.RVR09: Enojóse asimismo con furor contra sus tres amigos, porque no hallaban qué responder, aunque habían condenado á Job.

verses.KJV: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
verses.WEB: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.
verses.ASV: Now Elihu had waited to speak unto Job, because they were elder than he.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Eliú tinha esperado a Jó naquela discussão, porque tinham mais idade que ele.
verses.RVR09: Y Eliú había esperado á Job en la disputa, porque eran más viejos de días que él.

verses.KJV: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
verses.WEB: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
verses.ASV: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando Eliú viu que não havia resposta na boca daqueles três homens, sua ira se acendeu.
verses.RVR09: Empero viendo Eliú que no había respuesta en la boca de aquellos tres varones, su furor se encendió.

verses.KJV: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
verses.WEB: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
verses.ASV: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I held back, and durst not show you mine opinion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso Eliú, filho de Baraquel, buzita, respondeu, dizendo: Eu sou jovem e vós sois idosos; por isso fiquei receoso e tive medo de vos declarar minha opinião.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Eliú hijo de Barachêl, Bucita, y dijo: Yo soy menor de días, y vosotros viejos; he tenido por tanto miedo, y temido declararos mi opinión.

verses.KJV: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.WEB: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
verses.ASV: I said, Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu dizia: Os dias falem, e a multidão de anos ensine sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Yo decía: Los días hablarán, y la muchedumbre de años declarará sabiduría.

verses.KJV: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verses.WEB: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.
verses.ASV: But there is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente há espírito no ser humano, e a inspiração do Todo-Poderoso os faz entendedores.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente espíritu hay en el hombre, é inspiración del Omnipotente los hace que entiendan.

verses.KJV: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
verses.WEB: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
verses.ASV: It is not the great that are wise, Nor the aged that understand justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não são [somente] os grandes que são sábios, nem [somente] os velhos entendem o juízo.
verses.RVR09: No los grandes son los sabios, ni los viejos entienden el derecho.

verses.KJV: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.WEB: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
verses.ASV: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will show mine opinion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu digo: escutai-me; também eu declararei minha opinião.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto yo dije: Escuchadme; declararé yo también mi sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
verses.ASV: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your reasonings, Whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu aguardei vossas palavras, [e] dei ouvidos a vossas considerações, enquanto vós buscáveis argumentos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo he esperado á vuestras razones, he escuchado vuestros argumentos, en tanto que buscabais palabras.

verses.KJV: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
verses.WEB: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
verses.ASV: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none that convinced Job, Or that answered his words, among you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu prestei atenção a vós, porém eis que ninguém há de vós que possa convencer a Jó, [nem] que responda a suas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Os he pues prestado atención, y he aquí que no hay de vosotros quien redarguya á Job, y responda á sus razones.

verses.KJV: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
verses.WEB: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’
verses.ASV: Beware lest ye say, We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not man:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto não digais: Encontramos a sabedoria; que Deus o derrote, [e] não o homem.
verses.RVR09: Porque no digáis: Nosotros hemos hallado sabiduría: lanzólo Dios, no el hombre.

verses.KJV: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.WEB: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.ASV: For he hath not directed his words against me; Neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jó não dirigiu suas palavras a mim, nem eu lhe responderei com vossos dizeres.
verses.RVR09: Ahora bien, Job no enderezó á mí sus palabras, ni yo le responderé con vuestras razones.

verses.KJV: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
verses.WEB: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
verses.ASV: They are amazed, they answer no more: They have not a word to say.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estão pasmos, não respondem mais; faltam-lhes palavras.
verses.RVR09: Espantáronse, no respondieron más: fuéronseles los razonamientos.

verses.KJV: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
verses.WEB: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
verses.ASV: And shall I wait, because they speak not, Because they stand still, and answer no more?
verses.ALMEIDA: Esperei, pois, porém [agora] não falam; porque já pararam, [e] não respondem mais.
verses.RVR09: Yo pues he esperado, porque no hablaban, antes pararon, y no respondieron más.

verses.KJV: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.WEB: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
verses.ASV: I also will answer my part, I also will show mine opinion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também eu responderei minha parte; também eu declararei minha opinião.
verses.RVR09: Por eso yo también responderé mi parte, también yo declararé mi juicio.

verses.KJV: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.WEB: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
verses.ASV: For I am full of words; The spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estou cheio de palavras, e o espírito em meu ventre me obriga.
verses.RVR09: Porque lleno estoy de palabras, y el espíritu de mi vientre me constriñe.

verses.KJV: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
verses.WEB: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
verses.ASV: Behold, my breast is as wine which hath no vent; Like new wine-skins it is ready to burst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que meu ventre é como o vinho que não tem abertura; e que está a ponto de arrebentar como odres novos.
verses.RVR09: De cierto mi vientre está como el vino que no tiene respiradero, y se rompe como odres nuevos.

verses.KJV: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
verses.WEB: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
verses.ASV: I will speak, that I may be refreshed; I will open my lips and answer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Falarei, para que eu me alivie; abrirei meus lábios, e responderei.
verses.RVR09: Hablaré pues y respiraré; abriré mis labios, y responderé.

verses.KJV: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
verses.WEB: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
verses.ASV: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man’s person; Neither will I give flattering titles unto any man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não farei eu acepção de pessoas, nem usarei de títulos lisonjeiros para com o homem.
verses.RVR09: No haré ahora acepción de personas, ni usaré con hombre de lisonjeros títulos.

verses.KJV: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
verses.WEB: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
verses.ASV: For I know not to give flattering titles; [Else] would my Maker soon take me away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não sei lisonjear; [caso contrário] ,meu Criador logo me removeria.
verses.RVR09: Porque no sé hablar lisonjas: de otra manera en breve mi Hacedor me consuma.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
verses.WEB: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
verses.ASV: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, And hearken to all my words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, Jó, ouve, por favor, meus dizeres, e dá ouvidos a todas as minhas palavras.
verses.RVR09: POR tanto, Job, oye ahora mis razones, y escucha todas mis palabras.

verses.KJV: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
verses.WEB: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
verses.ASV: Behold now, I have opened my mouth; My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que já abri minha boca; minha língua já fala debaixo do meu céu da boca.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo abriré ahora mi boca, y mi lengua hablará en mi garganta.

verses.KJV: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
verses.WEB: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
verses.ASV: My words [shall utter] the uprightness of my heart; And that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus dizeres pronunciarão a integridade do meu coração, e o puro conhecimento dos meus lábios.
verses.RVR09: Mis razones declararán la rectitud de mi corazón, y mis labios proferirán pura sabiduría.

verses.KJV: The spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
verses.WEB: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
verses.ASV: The Spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty giveth me life.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Espírito de Deus me fez, e o sopro do Todo-Poderoso me deu vida.
verses.RVR09: El espíritu de Dios me hizo, y la inspiración del Omnipotente me dió vida.

verses.KJV: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
verses.WEB: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
verses.ASV: If thou canst, answer thou me; Set [thy words] in order before me, stand forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se puderes, responde-me; dispõe-te perante mim, e persiste.
verses.RVR09: Si pudieres, respóndeme; dispón tus palabras, está delante de mí.

verses.KJV: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
verses.WEB: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
verses.ASV: Behold, I am toward God even as thou art: I also am formed out of the clay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que para Deus eu sou como tu; do barro também eu fui formado.
verses.RVR09: Heme aquí á mí en lugar de Dios, conforme á tu dicho: de lodo soy yo también formado.

verses.KJV: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
verses.WEB: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
verses.ASV: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que meu terror não te espantará, nem minha mão será pesada sobre ti.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que mi terror no te espantará, ni mi mano se agravará sobre ti.

verses.KJV: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
verses.WEB: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
verses.ASV: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the voice of [thy] words, [saying],
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente tu disseste a meus ouvidos, e eu ouvi a voz de tuas palavras,
verses.RVR09: De cierto tú dijiste á oídos míos, y yo oí la voz de tus palabras que decían:

verses.KJV: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
verses.WEB: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
verses.ASV: I am clean, without transgression; I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Que diziam] : Eu sou limpo e sem transgressão; sou inocente, e não tenho culpa.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy limpio y sin defecto; y soy inocente, y no hay maldad en mí.

verses.KJV: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
verses.WEB: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
verses.ASV: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for his enemy;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que [Deus] buscou pretextos contra mim, [e] me tem por seu inimigo.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que él buscó achaques contra mí, y me tiene por su enemigo;

verses.KJV: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
verses.WEB: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
verses.ASV: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele pôs meus pés no tronco, e observa todas as minhas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Puso mis pies en el cepo, y guardó todas mis sendas.

verses.KJV: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will answer thee, in this thou art not just; For God is greater than man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que nisto não foste justo, eu te respondo; pois Deus é maior que o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: He aquí en esto no has hablado justamente: yo te responderé que mayor es Dios que el hombre.

verses.KJV: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
verses.WEB: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
verses.ASV: Why dost thou strive against him, For that he giveth not account of any of his matters?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que razão brigas contra ele por não dar resposta às palavras do ser humano?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué tomaste pleito contra él? Porque él no da cuenta de ninguna de sus razones.

verses.KJV: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
verses.WEB: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
verses.ASV: For God speaketh once, Yea twice, [though man] regardeth it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo Deus fala uma ou duas vezes, ainda que [o ser humano] não entenda.
verses.RVR09: Sin embargo, en una ó en dos maneras habla Dios; mas el hombre no entiende.

verses.KJV: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
verses.WEB: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,
verses.ASV: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;
verses.ALMEIDA: Em sonho [ou em] visão noturna, quando o sono profundo cai sobre as pessoas, [e] adormecem na cama.
verses.RVR09: Por sueño de visión nocturna, cuando el sueño cae sobre los hombres, cuando se adormecen sobre el lecho;

verses.KJV: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
verses.WEB: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
verses.ASV: Then he openeth the ears of men, And sealeth their instruction,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o revela ao ouvido das pessoas, e os sela com advertências;
verses.RVR09: Entonces revela al oído de los hombres, y les señala su consejo;

verses.KJV: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.WEB: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.ASV: That he may withdraw man [from his] purpose, And hide pride from man;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para desviar ao ser humano de sua obra, e do homem a soberba.
verses.RVR09: Para quitar al hombre de su obra, y apartar del varón la soberbia.

verses.KJV: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.WEB: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.ASV: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para desviar a sua alma da perdição, e sua vida de passar pela espada.
