verses.RVR09: Detendrá su alma de corrupción, y su vida de que pase á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
verses.WEB: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
verses.ASV: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And with continual strife in his bones;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também em sua cama é castigado com dores, com luta constante em seus ossos,
verses.RVR09: También sobre su cama es castigado con dolor fuerte en todos sus huesos,

verses.KJV: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
verses.WEB: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
verses.ASV: So that his life abhorreth bread, And his soul dainty food.
verses.ALMEIDA: De modo que sua vida detesta [até] o pão, e sua alma a comida deliciosa.
verses.RVR09: Que le hace que su vida aborrezca el pan, y su alma la comida suave.

verses.KJV: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.WEB: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.ASV: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua carne desaparece da vista, e seus ossos, que antes não se viam, aparecem.
verses.RVR09: Su carne desfallece sin verse, y sus huesos, que antes no se veían, aparecen.

verses.KJV: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.WEB: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.ASV: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, And his life to the destroyers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua alma se aproxima da cova, e sua vida dos que causam a morte.
verses.RVR09: Y su alma se acerca al sepulcro, y su vida á los que causan la muerte.

verses.KJV: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
verses.WEB: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,
verses.ASV: If there be with him an angel, An interpreter, one among a thousand, To show unto man what is right for him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se com ele, pois, houver algum anjo, algum intérprete; um dentre mil, para anunciar ao ser humano o que lhe é correto,
verses.RVR09: Si tuviera cerca de él algún elocuente anunciador muy escogido, que anuncie al hombre su deber;

verses.KJV: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
verses.WEB: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
verses.ASV: Then [God] is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [Deus] terá misericórdia dele, e [lhe] dirá: Livra-o, para que não desça à perdição; [já] achei o resgate.
verses.RVR09: Que le diga que Dios tuvo de él misericordia, que lo libró de descender al sepulcro, que halló redención:

verses.KJV: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:
verses.WEB: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
verses.ASV: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s; He returneth to the days of his youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua carne se rejuvenescerá mais do que era na infância, [e] voltará aos dias de sua juventude.
verses.RVR09: Enterneceráse su carne más que de niño, volverá á los días de su mocedad.

verses.KJV: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
verses.WEB: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
verses.ASV: He prayeth unto God, and he is favorable unto him, So that he seeth his face with joy: And he restoreth unto man his righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele orará a Deus, que se agradará dele; e verá sua face com júbilo, porque ele restituirá ao ser humano sua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Orará á Dios, y le amará, y verá su faz con júbilo: y él restituirá al hombre su justicia.

verses.KJV: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
verses.WEB: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
verses.ASV: He singeth before men, and saith, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele olhará para as pessoas, e dirá: Pequei, e perverti o [que era] correto, o que de nada me aproveitou.
verses.RVR09: El mira sobre los hombres; y el que dijere: Pequé, y pervertí lo recto, y no me ha aprovechado;

verses.KJV: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
verses.WEB: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
verses.ASV: He hath redeemed my soul from going into the pit, And my life shall behold the light.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém] Deus livrou minha alma para que eu não passasse à cova, e [agora] minha vida vê a luz!
verses.RVR09: Dios redimirá su alma, que no pase al sepulcro, y su vida se verá en luz.

verses.KJV: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
verses.WEB: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
verses.ASV: Lo, all these things doth God work, Twice, [yea] thrice, with a man,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que Deus faz tudo isto duas [ou] três vezes com o ser humano,
verses.RVR09: He aquí, todas estas cosas hace Dios dos y tres veces con el hombre;

verses.KJV: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.WEB: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.ASV: To bring back his soul from the pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para desviar sua alma da perdição, e o iluminar com a luz dos viventes.
verses.RVR09: Para apartar su alma del sepulcro, y para iluminarlo con la luz de los vivientes.

verses.KJV: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
verses.WEB: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
verses.ASV: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Presta atenção, Jó, e ouve-me; cala-te, e eu falarei.
verses.RVR09: Escucha, Job, y óyeme; calla, y yo hablaré.

verses.KJV: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
verses.WEB: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
verses.ASV: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: Speak, for I desire to justify thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tiveres o que dizer, responde-me; fala, porque eu quero te justificar.
verses.RVR09: Que si tuvieres razones, respóndeme: habla, porque yo te quiero justificar.

verses.KJV: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
verses.WEB: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
verses.ASV: If not, hearken thou unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se não, escuta-me; cala-te, e eu ensinarei sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Y si no, óyeme tú á mí; calla, y enseñarte he sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
verses.WEB: Moreover Elihu answered,
verses.ASV: Moreover Elihu answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eliú respondeu mais, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: ADEMÁS respondió Eliú, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
verses.WEB: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
verses.ASV: Hear my words, ye wise men; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi, vós sábios, minhas palavras; e vós, inteligentes, dai-me ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Oid, sabios, mis palabras; y vosotros, doctos, estadme atentos.

verses.KJV: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
verses.WEB: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
verses.ASV: For the ear trieth words, As the palate tasteth food.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o ouvido prova as palavras, assim como o paladar experimenta a comida.
verses.RVR09: Porque el oído prueba las palabras, como el paladar gusta para comer.

verses.KJV: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.WEB: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.ASV: Let us choose for us that which is right: Let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Escolhamos para nós o que é correto, [e] conheçamos entre nós o que é bom.
verses.RVR09: Escojamos para nosotros el juicio, conozcamos entre nosotros cuál sea lo bueno:

verses.KJV: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
verses.WEB: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.
verses.ASV: For Job hath said, I am righteous, And God hath taken away my right:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Jó disse: Eu sou justo, e Deus tem me tirado meu direito.
verses.RVR09: Porque Job ha dicho: Yo soy justo, y Dios me ha quitado mi derecho.

verses.KJV: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
verses.WEB: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
verses.ASV: Notwithstanding my right I am [accounted] a liar; My wound is incurable, [though I am] without transgression.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso devo eu mentir quanto ao meu direito? Minha ferida é dolorosa mesmo que eu não tenha transgressão.
verses.RVR09: ¿He de mentir yo contra mi razón? Mi saeta es gravosa sin haber yo prevaricado.

verses.KJV: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?
verses.WEB: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
verses.ASV: What man is like Job, Who drinketh up scoffing like water,
verses.ALMEIDA: Que homem há como Jó, que bebe o escárnio como água?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué hombre hay como Job, que bebe el escarnio como agua?

verses.KJV: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
verses.WEB: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
verses.ASV: Who goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men?
verses.ALMEIDA: E que caminha na companhia dos que praticam maldade, e anda com homens perversos?
verses.RVR09: Y va en compañía con los que obran iniquidad, y anda con los hombres maliciosos.

verses.KJV: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
verses.WEB: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
verses.ASV: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing That he should delight himself with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque disse: De nada aproveita ao homem agradar-se em Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque ha dicho: De nada servirá al hombre el conformar su voluntad con Dios.

verses.KJV: Therefore hearken unto me ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
verses.WEB: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
verses.ASV: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, And from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto vós, homens de bom-senso, escutai-me; longe de Deus esteja a maldade, e do Todo- Poderoso a perversidade!
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, varones de seso, oidme: Lejos esté de Dios la impiedad, y del Omnipotente la iniquidad.

verses.KJV: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
verses.WEB: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
verses.ASV: For the work of a man will he render unto him, And cause every man to find according to his ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele paga ao ser humano [conforme] sua obra, e faz a cada um conforme o seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Porque él pagará al hombre según su obra, y él le hará hallar conforme á su camino.

verses.KJV: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
verses.WEB: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
verses.ASV: Yea, of a surety, God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente Deus não faz injustiça, e o Todo-Poderoso não perverte o direito.
verses.RVR09: Sí, por cierto, Dios no hará injusticia, y el Omnipotente no pervertirá el derecho.

verses.KJV: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
verses.WEB: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?
verses.ASV: Who gave him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem o pôs para administrar a terra? E quem dispôs a todo o mundo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién visitó por él la tierra? ¿y quién puso en orden todo el mundo?

verses.KJV: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
verses.WEB: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
verses.ASV: If he set his heart upon himself, [If] he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ele tomasse a decisão, e recolhesse para si seu espírito e seu fôlego,
verses.RVR09: Si él pusiese sobre el hombre su corazón, y recogiese así su espíritu y su aliento,

verses.KJV: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
verses.WEB: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
verses.ASV: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall turn again unto dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda carne juntamente expiraria, e o ser humano se tornaria em pó.
verses.RVR09: Toda carne perecería juntamente, y el hombre se tornaría en polvo.

verses.KJV: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
verses.WEB: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
verses.ASV: If now [thou hast] understanding, hear this: Hearken to the voice of my words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se pois há [em ti] entendimento, ouve isto: dá ouvidos ao som de minhas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Si pues hay en ti entendimiento, oye esto: escucha la voz de mis palabras.

verses.KJV: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
verses.WEB: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,
verses.ASV: Shall even one that hateth justice govern? And wilt thou condemn him that is righteous [and] mighty?—
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso quem odeia a justiça poderá governar? E condenarás tu ao Poderoso Justo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Enseñorearáse el que aborrece juicio? ¿y condenarás tú al que es tan justo?

verses.KJV: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?
verses.WEB: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
verses.ASV: [Him] that saith to a king, [Thou art] vile, [Or] to nobles, [Ye are] wicked;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pode, por acaso, o rei ser chamado de vil, [e] os príncipes de perversos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hase de decir al rey: Perverso; y á los príncipes: Impíos?

verses.KJV: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
verses.WEB: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.
verses.ASV: That respecteth not the persons of princes, Nor regardeth the rich more than the poor; For they all are the work of his hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Quanto menos] a aquele que não faz acepção de pessoas de príncipes, nem valoriza mais o rico que o pobre! Pois todos são obras de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuánto menos á aquel que no hace acepción de personas de príncipes, ni el rico es de él más respetado que el pobre? porque todos son obras de sus manos.

verses.KJV: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
verses.WEB: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
verses.ASV: In a moment they die, even at midnight; The people are shaken and pass away, And the mighty are taken away without hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em um momento morrem; e à meia noite os povos são sacudidos, e passam; e o poderoso será tomado sem ação humana.
verses.RVR09: En un momento morirán, y á media noche se alborotarán los pueblos, y pasarán, y sin mano será quitado el poderoso.

verses.KJV: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.
verses.WEB: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
verses.ASV: For his eyes are upon the ways of a man, And he seeth all his goings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque seus olhos estão sobre os caminhos do homem, e ele vê todos os seus passos.
verses.RVR09: Porque sus ojos están sobre los caminos del hombre, y ve todos sus pasos.

verses.KJV: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.WEB: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.ASV: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há trevas nem sombra de morte em que os que praticam maldade possam se esconder.
verses.RVR09: No hay tinieblas ni sombra de muerte donde se encubran los que obran maldad.

verses.KJV: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.
verses.WEB: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
verses.ASV: For he needeth not further to consider a man, That he should go before God in judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele não precisa observar tanto ao homem para que este possa entrar em juízo com Deus.
verses.RVR09: No carga pues él al hombre más de lo justo, para que vaya con Dios á juicio.

verses.KJV: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
verses.WEB: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
verses.ASV: He breaketh in pieces mighty men [in ways] past finding out, And setteth others in their stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele quebranta aos fortes sem [precisar de] investigação, e põe outros em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: El quebrantará á los fuertes sin pesquisa, y hará estar otros en su lugar.

verses.KJV: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
verses.WEB: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
verses.ASV: Therefore he taketh knowledge of their works; And he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que ele conhece suas obras, de noite os trastorna, e ficam destroçados.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto él hará notorias las obras de ellos, cuando los trastornará en la noche, y serán quebrantados.

verses.KJV: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
verses.WEB: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
verses.ASV: He striketh them as wicked men In the open sight of others;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele os espanca à vista pública por serem maus.
verses.RVR09: Como á malos los herirá en lugar donde sean vistos:

verses.KJV: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
verses.WEB: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
verses.ASV: Because they turned aside from following him, And would not have regard in any of his ways:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eles se desviaram de segui-lo, e não deram atenção a nenhum de seus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto así se apartaron de él, y no consideraron todos sus caminos;

verses.KJV: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
verses.WEB: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
verses.ASV: So that they caused the cry of the poor to come unto him, And he heard the cry of the afflicted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim fizeram com que viesse a ele o clamor do pobre, e ele ouvisse o clamor dos aflitos.
verses.RVR09: Haciendo venir delante de él el clamor del pobre, y que oiga el clamor de los necesitados.

verses.KJV: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
verses.WEB: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,
verses.ASV: When he giveth quietness, who then can condemn? And when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? Alike whether [it be done] unto a nation, or unto a man:
verses.ALMEIDA: E se ele ficar quieto, quem [o] condenará? Se ele esconder o rosto, quem o olhará? [Ele está] quer sobre um povo, quer sobre um único ser humano,
verses.RVR09: Y si él diere reposo, ¿quién inquietará? si escondiere el rostro, ¿quién lo mirará? Esto sobre una nación, y lo mismo sobre un hombre;

verses.KJV: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
verses.WEB: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.
verses.ASV: That the godless man reign not, That there be none to ensnare the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que a pessoa hipócrita não reine, [e] não haja ciladas ao povo.
verses.RVR09: Haciendo que no reine el hombre hipócrita para vejaciones del pueblo.

verses.KJV: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
verses.WEB: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
verses.ASV: For hath any said unto God, I have borne [chastisement], I will not offend [any more]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que [não tão somente] se diz: Suportei [teu castigo] não farei mais o que é errado;
verses.RVR09: De seguro conviene se diga á Dios: Llevado he ya castigo, no más ofenderé:

verses.KJV: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
verses.WEB: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
verses.ASV: That which I see not teach thou me: If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensina-me o que não vejo; se fiz alguma maldade, nunca mais a farei?
verses.RVR09: Enséñame tú lo que yo no veo: que si hice mal, no lo haré más.

verses.KJV: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
verses.WEB: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
verses.ASV: Shall his recompense be as thou wilt, that thou refusest it? For thou must choose, and not I: Therefore speak what thou knowest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será a recompensa da parte dele como tu queres, para que a recuses? És tu que escolhes, e não eu; o que tu sabes, fala.
verses.RVR09: ¿Ha de ser eso según tu mente? El te retribuirá, ora rehuses, ora aceptes, y no yo: di si no, lo que tú sabes.

verses.KJV: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
verses.WEB: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
verses.ASV: Men of understanding will say unto me, Yea, every wise man that heareth me:
verses.ALMEIDA: As pessoas de entendimento dirão comigo, e o homem sábio me ouvirá;
verses.RVR09: Los hombres de seso dirán conmigo, y el hombre sabio me oirá:

verses.KJV: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.
verses.WEB: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
verses.ASV: Job speaketh without knowledge, And his words are without wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jó não fala com conhecimento, e a suas palavras falta prudência.
verses.RVR09: Que Job no habla con sabiduría, y que sus palabras no son con entendimiento.

verses.KJV: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.
verses.WEB: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
verses.ASV: Would that Job were tried unto the end, Because of his answering like wicked men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Queria eu que Jó fosse provado até o fim, por causa de suas respostas comparáveis a de homens malignos.
verses.RVR09: Deseo yo que Job sea probado ampliamente, á causa de sus respuestas por los hombres inicuos.

verses.KJV: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.
verses.WEB: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
verses.ASV: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin; He clappeth his hands among us, And multiplieth his words against God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ao seu pecado ele acrescentou rebeldia; ele bate as mãos [de forma desrespeitosa] entre nós, e multiplica suas palavras contra Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque á su pecado añadió impiedad: bate las manos entre nosotros, y contra Dios multiplica sus palabras.

verses.KJV: Elihu spake moreover, and said,
verses.WEB: Moreover Elihu answered,
verses.ASV: Moreover Elihu answered and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eliú respondeu mais, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y PROCEDIENDO Eliú en su razonamiento, dijo:

verses.KJV: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?
verses.WEB: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
verses.ASV: Thinkest thou this to be [thy] right, [Or] sayest thou, My righteousness is more than God’s,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pensas tu ser direito dizeres: Maior é a minha justiça do que a de Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Piensas ser conforme á derecho esto que dijiste: Más justo soy yo que Dios?

verses.KJV: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?
verses.WEB: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
verses.ASV: That thou sayest, What advantage will it be unto thee? [And], What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque disseste: Para que ela te serve? [Ou] : Que proveito terei dela mais que meu pecado?
verses.RVR09: Porque dijiste: ¿Qué ventaja sacarás tú de ello? ¿ó qué provecho tendré de mi pecado?

verses.KJV: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.
verses.WEB: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
verses.ASV: I will answer thee, And thy companions with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu darei reposta a ti, e a teus amigos contigo.
verses.RVR09: Yo te responderé razones, y á tus compañeros contigo.

verses.KJV: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.
verses.WEB: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
verses.ASV: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the skies, which are higher than thou.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha para os céus, e vê; e observa as nuvens, [que] são mais altas que tu.
verses.RVR09: Mira á los cielos, y ve, y considera que las nubes son más altas que tú.

verses.KJV: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?
verses.WEB: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
verses.ASV: If thou hast sinned, what effectest thou against him? And if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tu pecares, que [mal] farás contra ele? Se tuas transgressões se multiplicarem, que [mal] lhe farás?
verses.RVR09: Si pecares, ¿qué habrás hecho contra él? y si tus rebeliones se multiplicaren, ¿qué le harás tú?

verses.KJV: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?
verses.WEB: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
verses.ASV: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? Or what receiveth he of thy hand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se fores justo, que lhe darás? Ou o que ele receberá de tua mão?
verses.RVR09: Si fueres justo, ¿qué le darás á él? ¿ó qué recibirá de tu mano?

verses.KJV: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.
verses.WEB: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
verses.ASV: Thy wickedness [may hurt] a man as thou art; And thy righteousness [may profit] a son of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua perversidade [poderia afetar] a outro homem como tu; e tua justiça [poderia ser proveitosa] a [algum] filho do homem.
verses.RVR09: Al hombre como tú dañará tu impiedad, y al hijo del hombre aprovechará tu justicia.

verses.KJV: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.WEB: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.ASV: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Os aflitos] clamam por causa da grande opressão; eles gritam por causa do poder dos grandes.
verses.RVR09: A causa de la multitud de las violencias clamarán, y se lamentarán por el poderío de los grandes.

verses.KJV: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;
verses.WEB: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
verses.ASV: But none saith, Where is God my Maker, Who giveth songs in the night,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ninguém diz: Onde está Deus, meu Criador, que dá canções na noite,
verses.RVR09: Y ninguno dice: ¿Dónde está Dios mi Hacedor, que da canciones en la noche,

verses.KJV: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
verses.WEB: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
verses.ASV: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the birds of the heavens?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que nos ensina mais que aos animais da terra, e nos faz sábios mais que as aves do céu?
verses.RVR09: Que nos enseña más que á las bestias de la tierra, y nos hace sabios más que las aves del cielo?

verses.KJV: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.WEB: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.ASV: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali clamam, porém ele não responde, por causa da arrogância dos maus.
verses.RVR09: Allí clamarán, y él no oirá, por la soberbia de los malos.

verses.KJV: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.WEB: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.ASV: Surely God will not hear an empty [cry], Neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente Deus não ouvirá a súplica vazia, nem o Todo-Poderoso dará atenção a ela.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente Dios no oirá la vanidad, ni la mirará el Omnipotente.

verses.KJV: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.
verses.WEB: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
verses.ASV: How much less when thou sayest thou beholdest him not, The cause is before him, and thou waitest for him!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto menos ao que disseste: que tu não o vês! Porém o juízo está diante dele; portanto espera nele.
verses.RVR09: Aunque más digas, No lo mirará; haz juicio delante de él, y en él espera.

verses.KJV: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:
verses.WEB: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,
verses.ASV: But now, because he hath not visited in his anger, Neither doth he greatly regard arrogance;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora, já que a ira dele [ainda] não está castigando, e ele não deu completa atenção à arrogância,
verses.RVR09: Mas ahora, porque en su ira no visita, ni conoce con rigor, por eso Job abrió su boca vanamente, y multiplica palabras sin sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.
verses.WEB: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
verses.ASV: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vanity; He multiplieth words without knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso Jó abriu sua boca em vão, e multiplicou palavras sem conhecimento.

verses.KJV: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.WEB: Elihu also continued, and said,
verses.ASV: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Prosseguiu Eliú ainda, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y AÑADIÓ Eliú, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.
verses.WEB: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
verses.ASV: Suffer me a little, and I will show thee; For I have yet somewhat to say on God’s behalf.
verses.ALMEIDA: Espera-me um pouco, e eu te mostrarei que ainda há palavras a favor de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Espérame un poco, y enseñarte he; porque todavía tengo razones en orden á Dios.

verses.KJV: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.WEB: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.ASV: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde longe trarei meu conhecimento, e a meu Criador atribuirei a justiça.
verses.RVR09: Tomaré mi noticia de lejos, y atribuiré justicia á mi Hacedor.

verses.KJV: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
verses.WEB: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
verses.ASV: For truly my words are not false: One that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque verdadeiramente minhas palavras não serão falsas; contigo está um que tem completo conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Porque de cierto no son mentira mis palabras; contigo está el que es íntegro en sus conceptos.

verses.KJV: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
verses.WEB: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
verses.ASV: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: He is mighty in strength of understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que Deus é grande, porém despreza ninguém; grande ele é em poder de entendimento.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que Dios es grande, mas no desestima á nadie: es poderoso en fuerza de sabiduría.

verses.KJV: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
verses.WEB: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
verses.ASV: He preserveth not the life of the wicked, But giveth to the afflicted [their] right.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não permite o perverso viver, e faz justiça aos aflitos.
verses.RVR09: No otorgará vida al impío, y á los afligidos dará su derecho.

verses.KJV: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.WEB: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
verses.ASV: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não tira seus olhos do justo; ao contrário, ele os faz sentar com os reis no trono, e [assim] são exaltados.
verses.RVR09: No quitará sus ojos del justo; antes bien con los reyes los pondrá en solio para siempre, y serán ensalzados.

verses.KJV: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.WEB: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
verses.ASV: And if they be bound in fetters, And be taken in the cords of affliction;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se estiverem presos em grilhões, e detidos com cordas de aflição,
verses.RVR09: Y si estuvieren prendidos en grillos, y aprisionados en las cuerdas de aflicción,

verses.KJV: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
verses.WEB: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
verses.ASV: Then he showeth them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lhes faz saber as obras que fizeram, e suas transgressões, das quais se orgulharam.
verses.RVR09: El les dará á conocer la obra de ellos, y que prevalecieron sus rebeliones.

verses.KJV: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.WEB: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
verses.ASV: He openeth also their ear to instruction, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E revela a seus ouvidos, para que sejam disciplinados; e lhes diz, para que se convertam da maldade.
verses.RVR09: Despierta además el oído de ellos para la corrección, y díceles que se conviertan de la iniquidad.

verses.KJV: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.WEB: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.ASV: If they hearken and serve [him], They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ouvirem, e [o] servirem, acabarão seus dias em prosperidade, e seus anos em prazeres.
verses.RVR09: Si oyeren, y le sirvieren, acabarán sus días en bien, y sus años en deleites.

verses.KJV: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.WEB: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
verses.ASV: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se não ouvirem, perecerão pela espada, e morrerão sem conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Mas si no oyeren, serán pasados á cuchillo, y perecerán sin sabiduría.

verses.KJV: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
verses.WEB: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
verses.ASV: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger: They cry not for help when he bindeth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os hipócritas de coração acumulam a ira [divina] ; e quando ele os amarrar, mesmo assim não clamam.
verses.RVR09: Empero los hipócritas de corazón lo irritarán más, y no clamarán cuando él los atare.

verses.KJV: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
verses.WEB: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
verses.ASV: They die in youth, And their life [perisheth] among the unclean.
verses.ALMEIDA: A alma deles morrerá em sua juventude, e sua vida entre os pervertidos.
verses.RVR09: Fallecerá el alma de ellos en su mocedad, y su vida entre los sodomitas.

verses.KJV: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
verses.WEB: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
verses.ASV: He delivereth the afflicted by their affliction, And openeth their ear in oppression.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele livra o aflito de sua aflição, e na opressão ele revela a seus ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Al pobre librará de su pobreza, y en la aflicción despertará su oído.

verses.KJV: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
verses.WEB: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
verses.ASV: Yea, he would have allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table would be full of fatness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim também ele pode te desviar da boca da angústia [para] um lugar amplo, onde não haveria aperto; para o conforto de tua mesa, cheia dos melhores alimentos.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo te apartaría de la boca de la angustia á lugar espacioso, libre de todo apuro; y te asentará mesa llena de grosura.

verses.KJV: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
verses.WEB: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
verses.ASV: But thou art full of the judgment of the wicked: Judgment and justice take hold [on thee].
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tu estás cheio do julgamento do perverso; o julgamento e a justiça te tomam.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú has llenado el juicio del impío, en vez de sustentar el juicio y la justicia.

verses.KJV: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
verses.WEB: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
verses.ASV: For let not wrath stir thee up against chastisements; Neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da furor, [guarda-te] para que não sejas seduzido pela riqueza, nem que um grande suborno te faça desviar.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual teme que en su ira no te quite con golpe, el cual no puedas apartar de ti con gran rescate.

verses.KJV: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
verses.WEB: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
verses.ASV: Will thy cry avail, [that thou be] not in distress, Or all the forces of [thy] strength?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pode, por acaso, a tua riqueza te sustentar para que não tenhas aflição, mesmo com todos os esforços de [teu] poder?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hará él estima de tus riquezas, ni del oro, ni de todas las fuerzas del poder?

verses.KJV: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.WEB: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.ASV: Desire not the night, When peoples are cut off in their place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não anseies pela noite, em que os povos são tomados de seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: No anheles la noche, en que desaparecen los pueblos de su lugar.

verses.KJV: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.WEB: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
verses.ASV: Take heed, regard not iniquity: For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda-te, e não te voltes para a maldade; pois por isto que tens sido testado com miséria.
verses.RVR09: Guárdate, no tornes á la iniquidad; pues ésta escogiste más bien que la aflicción.

verses.KJV: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
verses.WEB: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
verses.ASV: Behold, God doeth loftily in his power: Who is a teacher like unto him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que Deus é exaltado em seu poder; que instrutor há como ele?
verses.RVR09: He aquí que Dios es excelso con su potencia: ¿qué enseñador semejante á él?

verses.KJV: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
verses.WEB: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?
verses.ASV: Who hath enjoined him his way? Or who can say, Thou hast wrought unrighteousness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem lhe indica o seu caminho? Quem poderá lhe dizer: Cometeste maldade?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién le ha prescrito su camino? ¿y quién le dirá: Iniquidad has hecho?

verses.KJV: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.WEB: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
verses.ASV: Remember that thou magnify his work, Whereof men have sung.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te de engrandeceres sua obra, a qual os seres humanos contemplam.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de engrandecer su obra, la cual contemplan los hombres.

verses.KJV: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
verses.WEB: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
verses.ASV: All men have looked thereon; Man beholdeth it afar off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as pessoas a veem; o ser humano a enxerga de longe.
verses.RVR09: Los hombres todos la ven; mírala el hombre de lejos.

verses.KJV: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.WEB: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
verses.ASV: Behold, God is great, and we know him not; The number of his years is unsearchable.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que Deus é grande, e nós não o compreendemos; não se pode descobrir o número de seus anos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, Dios es grande, y nosotros no le conocemos; ni se puede rastrear el número de sus años.

verses.KJV: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
verses.WEB: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
verses.ASV: For he draweth up the drops of water, Which distil in rain from his vapor,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele traz para cima as gotas das águas, que derramam a chuva de seu vapor;
verses.RVR09: El reduce las gotas de las aguas, al derramarse la lluvia según el vapor;

verses.KJV: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
verses.WEB: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
verses.ASV: Which the skies pour down And drop upon man abundantly.
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual as nuvens destilam, gotejando abundantemente sobre o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales destilan las nubes, goteando en abundancia sobre los hombres.

verses.KJV: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.WEB: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?
verses.ASV: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, The thunderings of his pavilion?
verses.ALMEIDA: Poderá alguém entender a extensão das nuvens, [e] os estrondos de seu pavilhão?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién podrá tampoco comprender la extensión de las nubes, y el sonido estrepitoso de su pabellón?

verses.KJV: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
verses.WEB: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
verses.ASV: Behold, he spreadeth his light around him; And he covereth the bottom of the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que estende sobre ele sua luz, e cobre as profundezas do mar.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que sobre él extiende su luz, y cobija con ella las raíces de la mar.

verses.KJV: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
verses.WEB: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
verses.ASV: For by these he judgeth the peoples; He giveth food in abundance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois por estas coisas ele julga aos povos, e dá alimento em abundância.
verses.RVR09: Bien que por esos medios castiga á los pueblos, á la multitud da comida.

verses.KJV: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
verses.WEB: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
verses.ASV: He covereth his hands with the lightning, And giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele cobre as mãos com o relâmpago, e dá ordens para que atinja o alvo.
verses.RVR09: Con las nubes encubre la luz, y mándale no brillar, interponiendo aquéllas.

verses.KJV: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
verses.WEB: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
verses.ASV: The noise thereof telleth concerning him, The cattle also concerning [the storm] that cometh up.
verses.ALMEIDA: O trovão anuncia sua presença; o gado também [prenuncia a tempestade] que se aproxima.
verses.RVR09: Tocante á ella anunciará el trueno, su compañero, que hay acumulación de ira sobre el que se eleva.

verses.KJV: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.
verses.WEB: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
verses.ASV: Yea, at this my heart trembleth, And is moved out of its place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disto também o meu coração treme, e salta de seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: A ESTO también se espanta mi corazón, y salta de su lugar.

verses.KJV: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.
verses.WEB: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
verses.ASV: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, And the sound that goeth out of his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi atentamente o estrondo de sua voz, e o som que sai de sua boca,
verses.RVR09: Oid atentamente su voz terrible, y el sonido que sale de su boca.

verses.KJV: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
verses.WEB: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
verses.ASV: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, And his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao qual envia por debaixo de todos os céus; e sua luz até os confins da terra.
verses.RVR09: Debajo de todos los cielos lo dirige, y su luz hasta los fines de la tierra.

verses.KJV: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
verses.WEB: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
verses.ASV: After it a voice roareth; He thundereth with the voice of his majesty; And he restraineth not [the lightnings] when his voice is heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disso brama com estrondo; troveja com sua majestosa voz; e ele não retém [seus relâmpagos] quando sua voz é ouvida.
verses.RVR09: Después de ella bramará el sonido, tronará él con la voz de su magnificencia; y aunque sea oída su voz, no los detiene.

verses.KJV: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.WEB: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
verses.ASV: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; Great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus troveja maravilhosamente com sua voz; ele faz coisas tão grandes que nós não compreendemos.
verses.RVR09: Tronará Dios maravillosamente con su voz; él hace grandes cosas, que nosotros no entendemos.

verses.KJV: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.
verses.WEB: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
verses.ASV: For he saith to the snow, Fall thou on the earth; Likewise to the shower of rain, And to the showers of his mighty rain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele diz à neve: Cai sobre à terra; Como também à chuva: Sê chuva forte.
verses.RVR09: Porque á la nieve dice: Desciende á la tierra; también á la llovizna, y á los aguaceros de su fortaleza.

verses.KJV: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
verses.WEB: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
verses.ASV: He sealeth up the hand of every man, That all men whom he hath made may know [it].
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele sela as mãos de todo ser humano, para que todas as pessoas conheçam sua obra.
verses.RVR09: Así hace retirarse á todo hombre, para que los hombres todos reconozcan su obra.

verses.KJV: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
verses.WEB: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
verses.ASV: Then the beasts go into coverts, And remain in their dens.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os animais selvagens entram nos esconderijos, e ficam em suas tocas.
verses.RVR09: La bestia se entrará en su escondrijo, y estaráse en sus moradas.

verses.KJV: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
verses.WEB: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
verses.ASV: Out of the chamber [of the south] cometh the storm, And cold out of the north.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da recâmara vem o redemoinho, e dos [ventos] que espalham [vem] o frio.
verses.RVR09: Del mediodía viene el torbellino, y el frío de los vientos del norte.

verses.KJV: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.WEB: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
verses.ASV: By the breath of God ice is given; And the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo sopro de Deus se dá o gelo, e as largas águas se congelam.
verses.RVR09: Por el soplo de Dios se da el hielo, y las anchas aguas son constreñidas.

verses.KJV: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
verses.WEB: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
verses.ASV: Yea, he ladeth the thick cloud with moisture; He spreadeth abroad the cloud of his lightning:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele também carrega de umidade as espessas nuvens, [e] por entre as nuvens ele espalha seu relâmpago.
verses.RVR09: Regando también llega á disipar la densa nube, y con su luz esparce la niebla.

verses.KJV: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
verses.WEB: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
verses.ASV: And it is turned round about by his guidance, That they may do whatsoever he commandeth them Upon the face of the habitable world,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então elas se movem ao redor segundo sua condução, para que façam quanto ele lhes manda sobre a superfície do mundo, na terra;
verses.RVR09: Asimismo por sus designios se revuelven las nubes en derredor, para hacer sobre la haz del mundo, en la tierra, lo que él les mandara.

verses.KJV: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.
verses.WEB: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
verses.ASV: Whether it be for correction, or for his land, Or for lovingkindness, that he cause it to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja que ou por vara de castigo, ou para sua terra, ou por bondade as faça vir.
verses.RVR09: Unas veces por azote, otras por causa de su tierra, otras por misericordia las hará parecer.

verses.KJV: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.WEB: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.ASV: Hearken unto this, O Job: Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Escuta isto, Jó; fica parado, e considera as maravilhas de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Escucha esto, Job; repósate, y considera las maravillas de Dios.

verses.KJV: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
verses.WEB: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
verses.ASV: Dost thou know how God layeth [his charge] upon them, And causeth the lightning of his cloud to shine?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso sabes tu quando Deus dá ordem a elas, e faz brilhar o relâmpago de sua nuvem?
verses.RVR09: ¿Supiste tú cuándo Dios las ponía en concierto, y hacía levantar la luz de su nube?

verses.KJV: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
verses.WEB: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
verses.ASV: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
verses.ALMEIDA: Conheces tu os equilíbrios das nuvens, as maravilhas daquele que é perfeito no conhecimento?
verses.RVR09: ¿Has tú conocido las diferencias de las nubes, las maravillas del Perfecto en sabiduría?

verses.KJV: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?
verses.WEB: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
verses.ASV: How thy garments are warm, When the earth is still by reason of the south [wind]?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, cujas vestes se aquecem quando a terra se aquieta por causa do [vento] sul,
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué están calientes tus vestidos cuando se fija el viento del mediodía sobre la tierra?

verses.KJV: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?
verses.WEB: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
verses.ASV: Canst thou with him spread out the sky, Which is strong as a molten mirror?
verses.ALMEIDA: acaso podes estender com ele os céus, que estão firmes como um espelho fundido?
verses.RVR09: ¿Extendiste tú con él los cielos, firmes como un espejo sólido?

verses.KJV: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
verses.WEB: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
verses.ASV: Teach us what we shall say unto him; [For] we cannot set [our speech] in order by reason of darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensina-nos o que devemos dizer a ele; [pois discurso] nenhum podemos propor, por causa das [nossas] trevas.
verses.RVR09: Muéstranos qué le hemos de decir; porque nosotros no podemos componer las ideas á causa de las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
verses.WEB: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
verses.ASV: Shall it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
verses.ALMEIDA: Seria contado a ele o que eu haveria de falar? Por acaso alguém falaria para ser devorado?
verses.RVR09: ¿Será preciso contarle cuando yo hablaré? Por más que el hombre razone, quedará como abismado.

verses.KJV: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
verses.WEB: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
verses.ASV: And now men see not the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind passeth, and cleareth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora não se pode olhar para o sol, quando brilha nos céus, quando o vento passa e os limpa.
verses.RVR09: He aquí aún: no se puede mirar la luz esplendente en los cielos, luego que pasa el viento y los limpia,

verses.KJV: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.
verses.WEB: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
verses.ASV: Out of the north cometh golden splendor: God hath upon him terrible majesty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do norte vem o esplendor dourado; em Deus há majestade temível.
verses.RVR09: Viniendo de la parte del norte la dorada claridad. En Dios hay una majestad terrible.

verses.KJV: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
verses.WEB: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
verses.ASV: [Touching] the Almighty, we cannot find him out: He is excellent in power; And in justice and plenteous righteousness he will not afflict.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não podemos alcançar ao Todo-Poderoso; ele é grande em poder; porém ele a ninguém oprime [em] juízo e grandeza de justiça.
verses.RVR09: El es Todopoderoso, al cual no alcanzamos, grande en potencia; y en juicio y en multitud de justicia no afligirá.

verses.KJV: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
verses.WEB: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
verses.ASV: Men do therefore fear him: He regardeth not any that are wise of heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso as pessoas o temem; ele não dá atenção aos que [se acham] sábios de coração.
verses.RVR09: Temerlo han por tanto los hombres: él no mira á los sabios de corazón.

verses.KJV: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,
verses.ASV: Then Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR respondeu a Jó desde um redemoinho, e disse:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Jehová á Job desde un torbellino, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.WEB: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.ASV: Who is this that darkeneth counsel By words without knowledge?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é esse que obscurece o conselho com palavras sem conhecimento?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es ése que oscurece el consejo con palabras sin sabiduría?

verses.KJV: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
verses.WEB: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
verses.ASV: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora cinge teus lombos como homem; e eu te perguntarei, e tu me explicarás.
verses.RVR09: Ahora ciñe como varón tus lomos; yo te preguntaré, y hazme saber tú.

verses.KJV: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.WEB: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
verses.ASV: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde estavas tu quando eu fundava a terra? Declara- [me] ,se tens inteligência.
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde estabas cuando yo fundaba la tierra? házmelo saber, si tienes inteligencia.

verses.KJV: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
verses.WEB: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
verses.ASV: Who determined the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who stretched the line upon it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem determinou suas medidas, se tu o sabes? Ou quem estendeu cordel sobre ela?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién ordenó sus medidas, si lo sabes? ¿ó quién extendió sobre ella cordel?

verses.KJV: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
verses.WEB: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
verses.ASV: Whereupon were the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner-stone thereof,
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre o que estão fundadas suas bases? Ou quem pôs sua pedra angular,
verses.RVR09: ¿Sobre qué están fundadas sus basas? ¿ó quién puso su piedra angular,

verses.KJV: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.WEB: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.ASV: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando as estrelas do amanhecer cantavam alegremente juntas, e todos os filhos de Deus jubilavam?
verses.RVR09: Cuando las estrellas todas del alba alababan, y se regocijaban todos los hijos de Dios?

verses.KJV: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
verses.WEB: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
verses.ASV: Or [who] shut up the sea with doors, When it brake forth, [as if] it had issued out of the womb;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou [quem] encerrou o mar com portas, quando transbordou, saindo da madre,
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién encerró con puertas la mar, cuando se derramaba por fuera como saliendo de madre;

verses.KJV: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.WEB: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
verses.ASV: When I made clouds the garment thereof, And thick darkness a swaddling-band for it,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu pus nuvens por sua vestidura, e a escuridão por sua faixa;
verses.RVR09: Cuando puse yo nubes por vestidura suya, y por su faja oscuridad.

verses.KJV: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,
verses.WEB: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
verses.ASV: And marked out for it my bound, And set bars and doors,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu passei sobre ele meu decreto, e [lhe] pus portas e ferrolhos,
verses.RVR09: Y establecí sobre ella mi decreto, y le puse puertas y cerrojo,

verses.KJV: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.WEB: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?
verses.ASV: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further; And here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Até aqui virás, e não passarás adiante, e aqui será o limite para a soberba de tuas ondas?
verses.RVR09: Y dije: Hasta aquí vendrás, y no pasarás adelante, y ahí parará la hinchazón de tus ondas?

verses.KJV: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
verses.WEB: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
verses.ASV: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days [began], [And] caused the dayspring to know its place;
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde os teus dias tens dado ordem à madrugada? [Ou] mostraste tu ao amanhecer o seu lugar,
verses.RVR09: ¿Has tú mandado á la mañana en tus días? ¿has mostrado al alba su lugar,

verses.KJV: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.WEB: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
verses.ASV: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que tomasse os confins da terra, e os perversos fossem sacudidos dela?
verses.RVR09: Para que ocupe los fines de la tierra, y que sean sacudidos de ella los impíos?

verses.KJV: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.WEB: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
verses.ASV: It is changed as clay under the seal; And [all things] stand forth as a garment:
verses.ALMEIDA: E [a terra] se transforma como barro [sob] o selo; [todas as coisas sobre ela] se apresentam como vestidos?
verses.RVR09: Trasmúdase como lodo bajo de sello, y viene á estar como con vestidura:

verses.KJV: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.WEB: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
verses.ASV: And from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm is broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dos perversos é desviada sua luz, e o braço erguido é quebrado.
verses.RVR09: Mas la luz de los impíos es quitada de ellos, y el brazo enaltecido es quebrantado.

verses.KJV: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
verses.WEB: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
verses.ASV: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso chegaste tu às fontes do mar, ou passeaste no mais profundo abismo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Has entrado tú hasta los profundos de la mar, y has andado escudriñando el abismo?

verses.KJV: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.WEB: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
verses.ASV: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? Or hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?
verses.ALMEIDA: Foram reveladas a ti as portas da morte, ou viste as portas da sombra de morte?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hante sido descubiertas las puertas de la muerte, y has visto las puertas de la sombra de muerte?

verses.KJV: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
verses.WEB: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
verses.ASV: Hast thou comprehended the earth in its breadth? Declare, if thou knowest it all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entendeste tu as larguras da terra? Declara, se sabes tudo isto.
verses.RVR09: ¿Has tú considerado hasta las anchuras de la tierra? Declara si sabes todo esto.

verses.KJV: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
verses.WEB: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
verses.ASV: Where is the way to the dwelling of light? And as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde está o caminho [por onde] mora a luz? E quanto às trevas, onde fica o seu lugar?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por dónde va el camino á la habitación de la luz, y dónde está el lugar de las tinieblas?

verses.KJV: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
verses.WEB: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
verses.ASV: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, And that thou shouldest discern the paths to the house thereof?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que as tragas a seus limites, e conheças os caminhos de sua casa.
verses.RVR09: ¿Si llevarás tú ambas cosas á sus términos, y entenderás las sendas de su casa?

verses.KJV: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
verses.WEB: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
verses.ASV: [Doubtless], thou knowest, for thou wast then born, And the number of thy days is great!
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente tu o sabes, pois já eras nascido, e teus dias são inúmeros!
verses.RVR09: ¿Sabíaslo tú porque hubieses ya nacido, ó porque es grande el número de tus días?

verses.KJV: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.WEB: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
verses.ASV: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow, Or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso entraste tu aos depósitos da neve, e viste os depósitos do granizo,
verses.RVR09: ¿Has tú entrado en los tesoros de la nieve, ó has visto los tesoros del granizo,

verses.KJV: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.WEB: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.ASV: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, Against the day of battle and war?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que eu retenho até o tempo da angústia, até o dia da batalha e da guerra?
verses.RVR09: Lo cual tengo yo reservado para el tiempo de angustia, para el día de la guerra y de la batalla?

verses.KJV: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
verses.WEB: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
verses.ASV: By what way is the light parted, Or the east wind scattered upon the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde está o caminho em que a luz se reparte, e o vento oriental se dispersa sobre a terra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué camino se reparte la luz, y se esparce el viento solano sobre la tierra?

verses.KJV: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.WEB: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,
verses.ASV: Who hath cleft a channel for the waterflood, Or the way for the lightning of the thunder;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem repartiu um canal às correntezas de águas, e caminho aos relâmpagos dos trovões,
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién repartió conducto al turbión, y camino á los relámpagos y truenos,

verses.KJV: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.WEB: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
verses.ASV: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para chover sobre a terra [onde] havia ninguém, [sobre] o deserto, onde não há gente,
verses.RVR09: Haciendo llover sobre la tierra deshabitada, sobre el desierto, donde no hay hombre,

verses.KJV: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.WEB: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
verses.ASV: To satisfy the waste and desolate [ground], And to cause the tender grass to spring forth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para fartar [a terra] deserta e desolada, e para fazer crescer aos renovos da erva.
verses.RVR09: Para hartar la tierra desierta é inculta, y para hacer brotar la tierna hierba?

verses.KJV: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.WEB: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
verses.ASV: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso a chuva tem pai? Ou quem gera as gotas do orvalho?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tiene la lluvia padre? ¿ó quién engendró las gotas del rocío?

verses.KJV: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.WEB: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
verses.ASV: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.ALMEIDA: De qual ventre procede o gelo? E quem gera a geada do céu?
verses.RVR09: ¿De qué vientre salió el hielo? y la escarcha del cielo, ¿quién la engendró?

verses.KJV: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.WEB: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
verses.ASV: The waters hide themselves [and become] like stone, And the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.ALMEIDA: As águas se tornam duras como pedra, e a superfície do abismo se congela.
verses.RVR09: Las aguas se endurecen á manera de piedra, y congélase la haz del abismo.

verses.KJV: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.WEB: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
verses.ASV: Canst thou bind the cluster of the Pleiades, Or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.ALMEIDA: Podes tu atar as cadeias das Plêiades, ou desatar as cordas do Órion?
verses.RVR09: ¿Podrás tú impedir las delicias de las Pléyades, ó desatarás las ligaduras del Orión?

verses.KJV: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
verses.WEB: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
verses.ASV: Canst thou lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season? Or canst thou guide the Bear with her train?
verses.ALMEIDA: Podes tu trazer as constelações a seu tempo, e guiar a Ursa com seus filhos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Sacarás tú á su tiempo los signos de los cielos, ó guiarás el Arcturo con sus hijos?

verses.KJV: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.WEB: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
verses.ASV: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? Canst thou establish the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabes tu as ordenanças dos céus? Ou podes tu dispor do domínio deles sobre a terra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Supiste tú las ordenanzas de los cielos? ¿dispondrás tú de su potestad en la tierra?

verses.KJV: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.WEB: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?
verses.ASV: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou podes levantar tua voz até às nuvens, para que a abundância das águas te cubra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Alzarás tú á las nubes tu voz, para que te cubra muchedumbre de aguas?

verses.KJV: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go and say unto thee, Here we are?
verses.WEB: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
verses.ASV: Canst thou send forth lightnings, that they may go, And say unto thee, Here we are?
verses.ALMEIDA: Podes tu mandar relâmpagos, para que saiam, e te digam: Eis-nos aqui?
verses.RVR09: ¿Enviarás tú los relámpagos, para que ellos vayan? ¿y diránte ellos: Henos aquí?

verses.KJV: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
verses.WEB: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
verses.ASV: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the mind?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem pôs a sabedoria no íntimo? Ou quem deu entendimento à mente?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién puso la sabiduría en el interior? ¿ó quién dió al entendimiento la inteligencia?

verses.KJV: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
verses.WEB: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
verses.ASV: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem pode enumerar as nuvens com sabedoria? E os odres dos céus, quem pode os despejar?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién puso por cuenta los cielos con sabiduría? y los odres de los cielos, ¿quién los hace parar,

verses.KJV: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
verses.WEB: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
verses.ASV: When the dust runneth into a mass, And the clods cleave fast together?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o pó se endurece, e os torrões se apegam uns aos outros?
verses.RVR09: Cuando el polvo se ha convertido en dureza, y los terrones se han pegado unos con otros?

verses.KJV: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
verses.WEB: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
verses.ASV: Canst thou hunt the prey for the lioness, Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
verses.ALMEIDA: Caçarás tu a presa para o leão? Ou saciarás a fome dos leões jovens,

verses.KJV: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.WEB: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
verses.ASV: When they couch in their dens, [And] abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando estão agachados nas covas, [ou] estão à espreita no matagal?
