verses.KJV: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
verses.WEB: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
verses.ASV: Who provideth for the raven his prey, When his young ones cry unto God, [And] wander for lack of food?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem prepara aos corvos seu alimento, quando seus filhotes clamam a Deus, andando de um lado para o outro por não terem o que comer?

verses.KJV: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.WEB: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
verses.ASV: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? [Or] canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabes tu o tempo em que as cabras montesas dão filhotes? Ou observaste tu as cervas quando em trabalho de parto?
verses.RVR09: ¿CAZARÁS tú la presa para el león? ¿y saciarás el hambre de los leoncillos,

verses.KJV: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
verses.WEB: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?
verses.ASV: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Contaste os meses que elas cumprem, e sabes o tempo de seu parto?
verses.RVR09: Cuando están echados en las cuevas, ó se están en sus guaridas para acechar?

verses.KJV: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
verses.WEB: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.
verses.ASV: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young, They cast out their pains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando se encurvam, produzem seus filhos, [e] lançam de si suas dores.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién preparó al cuervo su alimento, cuando sus pollos claman á Dios, bullendo de un lado á otro por carecer de comida?

verses.KJV: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
verses.WEB: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.
verses.ASV: Their young ones become strong, they grow up in the open field; They go forth, and return not again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus filhos se fortalecem, crescem como o trigo; saem, e nunca mais voltam a elas.
verses.RVR09: ¿Sabes tú el tiempo en que paren las cabras monteses? ¿ó miraste tú las ciervas cuando están pariendo?

verses.KJV: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
verses.WEB: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,
verses.ASV: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? Or who hath loosed the bonds of the swift ass,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem despediu livre ao asno montês? E quem ao asno selvagem soltou das ataduras?
verses.RVR09: ¿Contaste tú los meses de su preñez, y sabes el tiempo cuando han de parir?

verses.KJV: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
verses.WEB: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?
verses.ASV: Whose home I have made the wilderness, And the salt land his dwelling-place?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao qual eu dei a terra desabitada por casa, e a terra salgada por suas moradas.
verses.RVR09: Encórvanse, hacen salir sus hijos, pasan sus dolores.

verses.KJV: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
verses.WEB: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
verses.ASV: He scorneth the tumult of the city, Neither heareth he the shoutings of the driver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele zomba do tumulto da cidade; não ouve os gritos do condutor.
verses.RVR09: Sus hijos están sanos, crecen con el pasto: salen y no vuelven á ellas.

verses.KJV: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
verses.WEB: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.
verses.ASV: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searcheth after every green thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: A extensão dos montes é seu pasto; e busca tudo o que é verde.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién echó libre al asno montés, y quién soltó sus ataduras?

verses.KJV: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
verses.WEB: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?
verses.ASV: Will the wild-ox be content to serve thee? Or will he abide by thy crib?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o boi selvagem quererá te servir, ou ficará junto de tua manjedoura?
verses.RVR09: Al cual yo puse casa en la soledad, y sus moradas en lugares estériles.

verses.KJV: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
verses.WEB: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?
verses.ASV: Canst thou bind the wild-ox with his band in the furrow? Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou amarrarás ao boi selvagem com sua corda para o arado? Ou lavrará ele aos campos atrás de ti?
verses.RVR09: Búrlase de la multitud de la ciudad: no oye las voces del arriero.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
verses.WEB: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?
verses.ASV: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? Or wilt thou leave to him thy labor?
verses.ALMEIDA: Confiarás nele, por ser grande sua força, e deixarás que ele faça teu trabalho?
verses.RVR09: Lo oculto de los montes es su pasto, y anda buscando todo lo que está verde.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
verses.WEB: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?
verses.ASV: Wilt thou confide in him, that he will bring home thy seed, And gather [the grain] of thy threshing-floor?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porás tua confiança nele, para que ele colha tua semente, e a junte em tua eira?
verses.RVR09: ¿Querrá el unicornio servirte á ti, ni quedar á tu pesebre?

verses.KJV: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
verses.WEB: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?
verses.ASV: The wings of the ostrich wave proudly; [But] are they the pinions and plumage of love?
verses.ALMEIDA: As asas da avestruz batem alegremente, mas são suas asas e penas como as da cegonha?
verses.RVR09: ¿Atarás tú al unicornio con su coyunda para el surco? ¿labrará los valles en pos de ti?

verses.KJV: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
verses.WEB: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,
verses.ASV: For she leaveth her eggs on the earth, And warmeth them in the dust,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela deixa seus ovos na terra, e os esquenta no chão,
verses.RVR09: ¿Confiarás tú en él, por ser grande su fortaleza, y le fiarás tu labor?

verses.KJV: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
verses.WEB: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.
verses.ASV: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, Or that the wild beast may trample them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se esquece de que pés podem os pisar, e os animais do campo [podem] os esmagar.
verses.RVR09: ¿Fiarás de él que te tornará tu simiente, y que la allegará en tu era?

verses.KJV: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not her's: her labour is in vain without fear;
verses.WEB: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
verses.ASV: She dealeth hardly with her young ones, as if they were not hers: Though her labor be in vain, [she is] without fear;
verses.ALMEIDA: Age duramente para com seus filhos, como se não fossem seus, sem temer que seu trabalho tenha sido em vão.
verses.RVR09: ¿Diste tú hermosas alas al pavo real, ó alas y plumas al avestruz?

verses.KJV: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
verses.WEB: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
verses.ASV: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, Neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus a privou de sabedoria, e não lhe repartiu entendimento.
verses.RVR09: El cual desampara en la tierra sus huevos, y sobre el polvo los calienta,

verses.KJV: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
verses.WEB: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
verses.ASV: What time she lifteth up herself on high, She scorneth the horse and his rider.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém quando se levanta para correr, zomba do cavalo e do seu cavaleiro.
verses.RVR09: Y olvídase de que los pisará el pie, y que los quebrará bestia del campo.

verses.KJV: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
verses.WEB: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?
verses.ASV: Hast thou given the horse [his] might? Hast thou clothed his neck with the quivering mane?
verses.ALMEIDA: És tu que dás força ao cavalo, ou que vestes seu pescoço com crina?
verses.RVR09: Endurécese para con sus hijos, como si no fuesen suyos, no temiendo que su trabajo haya sido en vano:

verses.KJV: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
verses.WEB: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.
verses.ASV: Hast thou made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is terrible.
verses.ALMEIDA: Podes tu o espantar como a um gafanhoto? O sopro de suas narinas é terrível.
verses.RVR09: Porque le privó Dios de sabiduría, y no le dió inteligencia.

verses.KJV: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
verses.WEB: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.
verses.ASV: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: He goeth out to meet the armed men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele escarva a terra, alegra-se de sua força, [e] sai ao encontro das armas;
verses.RVR09: Luego que se levanta en alto, búrlase del caballo y de su jinete.

verses.KJV: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
verses.WEB: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.
verses.ASV: He mocketh at fear, and is not dismayed; Neither turneth he back from the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele zomba do medo, e não se espanta; nem volta para trás por causa da espada.
verses.RVR09: ¿Diste tú al caballo la fortaleza? ¿vestiste tú su cerviz de relincho?

verses.KJV: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
verses.WEB: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
verses.ASV: The quiver rattleth against him, The flashing spear and the javelin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contra ele rangem a aljava, o ferro brilhante da lança e do dardo;
verses.RVR09: ¿Le intimidarás tú como á alguna langosta? El resoplido de su nariz es formidable:

verses.KJV: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
verses.WEB: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.
verses.ASV: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage; Neither believeth he that it is the voice of the trumpet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sacudido-se com furor, ele escarva a terra; ele não fica parado ao som da trombeta.
verses.RVR09: Escarba la tierra, alégrase en su fuerza, sale al encuentro de las armas:

verses.KJV: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.WEB: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.ASV: As oft as the trumpet [soundeth] he saith, Aha! And he smelleth the battle afar off, The thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao som das trombetas diz: Eia! E desde longe cheira a batalha, o grito dos capitães, e o barulho.
verses.RVR09: Hace burla del espanto, y no teme, ni vuelve el rostro delante de la espada.

verses.KJV: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?
verses.WEB: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?
verses.ASV: Is it by thy wisdom that the hawk soareth, [And] stretcheth her wings toward the south?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso é por tua inteligência que o gavião voa, [e] estende suas asas para o sul?
verses.RVR09: Contra él suena la aljaba, el hierro de la lanza y de la pica:

verses.KJV: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
verses.WEB: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?
verses.ASV: Is it at thy command that the eagle mounteth up, And maketh her nest on high?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou é por tua ordem que a água voa alto e põe seu ninho na altura?
verses.RVR09: Y él con ímpetu y furor escarba la tierra, sin importarle el sonido de la bocina;

verses.KJV: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
verses.WEB: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.
verses.ASV: On the cliff she dwelleth, and maketh her home, Upon the point of the cliff, and the stronghold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nas penhas ela mora e habita; no cume das penhas, e em lugares seguros.
verses.RVR09: Antes como que dice entre los clarines: ¡Ea!, y desde lejos huele la batalla, el grito de los capitanes, y la vocería.

verses.KJV: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
verses.WEB: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.
verses.ASV: From thence she spieth out the prey; Her eyes behold it afar off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde ali espia a comida; seus olhos avistam de longe.
verses.RVR09: ¿Vuela el gavilán por tu industria, y extiende hacia el mediodía sus alas?

verses.KJV: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
verses.WEB: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
verses.ASV: Her young ones also suck up blood: And where the slain are, there is she.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus filhotes sugam sangue; e onde houver cadáveres, ali ela está.
verses.RVR09: ¿Se remonta el águila por tu mandamiento, y pone en alto su nido? Ella habita y está en la piedra, en la cumbre del peñasco y de la roca. Desde allí acecha la comida: sus ojos observan de muy lejos. Sus pollos chupan la sangre: y donde hubiere cadáveres, allí está. A más de eso respondió Jehová á Job, y dijo: ¿Es sabiduría contender con el Omnipotente? El que disputa con Dios, responda á esto. Y respondió Job á Jehová, y dijo: He aquí que yo soy vil, ¿qué te responderé? Mi mano pongo sobre mi boca. Una vez hablé, y no responderé: aun dos veces, mas no tornaré á hablar.

verses.KJV: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said,
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD answered Job,
verses.ASV: Moreover Jehovah answered Job, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR respondeu mais a Jó, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: ENTONCES respondió Jehová á Job desde la oscuridad, y dijo:

verses.KJV: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
verses.WEB: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
verses.ASV: Shall he that cavilleth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with God, let him answer it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso quem briga contra o Todo-Poderoso pode ensiná-lo? Quem quer repreender a Deus, responda a isto.
verses.RVR09: Cíñete ahora como varón tus lomos; yo te preguntaré, y explícame.

verses.KJV: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered the LORD,
verses.ASV: Then Job answered Jehovah, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jó respondeu ao SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: ¿Invalidarás tú también mi juicio? ¿me condenarás á mí, para justificarte á ti?

verses.KJV: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
verses.ASV: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu sou insignificante; o que eu te responderia? Ponho minha mão sobre minha boca.
verses.RVR09: ¿Tienes tú brazo como Dios? ¿y tronarás tú con voz como él?

verses.KJV: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
verses.WEB: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
verses.ASV: Once have I spoken, and I will not answer; Yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma vez falei, porém não responderei; até duas vezes, porém não prosseguirei.
verses.RVR09: Atavíate ahora de majestad y de alteza: y vístete de honra y de hermosura.

verses.KJV: Then answered the Lord unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:
verses.ASV: Then Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR respondeu a Jó desde o redemoinho, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Esparce furores de tu ira: y mira á todo soberbio, y abátelo.

verses.KJV: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.WEB: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
verses.ASV: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cinge-te agora os teus lombos como homem; eu te perguntarei, e tu me explica.
verses.RVR09: Mira á todo soberbio, y humíllalo, y quebranta á los impíos en su asiento.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
verses.WEB: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
verses.ASV: Wilt thou even annul my judgment? Wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be justified?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso tu anularias o meu juízo? Tu me condenarias, para te justificares?
verses.RVR09: Encúbrelos á todos en el polvo, venda sus rostros en la oscuridad;

verses.KJV: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
verses.WEB: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
verses.ASV: Or hast thou an arm like God? And canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tens tu braço como Deus? Ou podes tu trovejar com [tua] voz como ele?
verses.RVR09: Y yo también te confesaré que podrá salvarte tu diestra.

verses.KJV: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.WEB: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
verses.ASV: Deck thyself now with excellency and dignity; And array thyself with honor and majesty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Orna-te, pois, de excelência e alteza; e veste-te de majestade e glória.
verses.RVR09: He aquí ahora behemoth, al cual yo hice contigo; hierba come como buey.

verses.KJV: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
verses.WEB: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
verses.ASV: Pour forth the overflowings of thine anger; And look upon every one that is proud, and abase him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Espalha os furores de tua ira; olha a todo soberbo, e abate-o.
verses.RVR09: He aquí ahora que su fuerza está en sus lomos, y su fortaleza en el ombligo de su vientre.

verses.KJV: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.WEB: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
verses.ASV: Look on every one that is proud, [and] bring him low; And tread down the wicked where they stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha a todo soberbo, e humilha-o; e esmaga aos perversos em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Su cola mueve como un cedro, y los nervios de sus genitales son entretejidos.

verses.KJV: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
verses.WEB: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
verses.ASV: Hide them in the dust together; Bind their faces in the hidden [place].
verses.ALMEIDA: Esconde-os juntamente no pó; ata seus rostos no oculto.
verses.RVR09: Sus huesos son fuertes como bronce, y sus miembros como barras de hierro.

verses.KJV: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
verses.WEB: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
verses.ASV: Then will I also confess of thee That thine own right hand can save thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu também te reconhecerei; pois tua mão direita te terá livrado.
verses.RVR09: El es la cabeza de los caminos de Dios: el que lo hizo, puede hacer que su cuchillo á él se acerque.

verses.KJV: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
verses.WEB: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
verses.ASV: Behold now, behemoth, which I made as well as thee; He eateth grass as an ox.
verses.ALMEIDA: Observa o beemote, ao qual eu fiz contigo; ele come erva come como o boi.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente los montes producen hierba para él: y toda bestia del campo retoza allá.

verses.KJV: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
verses.WEB: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
verses.ASV: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the muscles of his belly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que sua força está em seus lombos, e seu poder na musculatura de seu ventre.
verses.RVR09: Echaráse debajo de las sombras, en lo oculto de las cañas, y de los lugares húmedos.

verses.KJV: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
verses.WEB: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
verses.ASV: He moveth his tail like a cedar: The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele torna sua cauda dura como o cedro, e os nervos de suas coxas são entretecidos.
verses.RVR09: Los árboles sombríos lo cubren con su sombra; los sauces del arroyo lo cercan.

verses.KJV: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
verses.WEB: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
verses.ASV: His bones are [as] tubes of brass; His limbs are like bars of iron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus ossos são [como] tubos de bronze; seus membros, como barras de ferro.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que él tomará el río sin inmutarse: y confíase que el Jordán pasará por su boca.

verses.KJV: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
verses.WEB: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
verses.ASV: He is the chief of the ways of God: He [only] that made him giveth him his sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é a obra-prima dos caminhos de Deus; aquele que o fez o proveu de sua espada.
verses.RVR09: ¿Tomarálo alguno por sus ojos en armadijos, y horadará su nariz?

verses.KJV: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
verses.WEB: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
verses.ASV: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, Where all the beasts of the field do play.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os montes lhe produzem pasto; por isso todos os animais do campo ali se alegram.

verses.KJV: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
verses.WEB: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
verses.ASV: He lieth under the lotus-trees, In the covert of the reed, and the fen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se deita debaixo das árvores sombrias; no esconderijo das canas e da lama.

verses.KJV: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.WEB: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
verses.ASV: The lotus-trees cover him with their shade; The willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.ALMEIDA: As árvores sombrias o cobrem, cada uma com sua sombra; os salgueiros do ribeiro o cercam.

verses.KJV: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
verses.WEB: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
verses.ASV: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; He is confident, though a Jordan swell even to his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que o rio se torne violento, ele não se apressa; confia ainda que o Jordão transborde até sua boca.

verses.KJV: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
verses.WEB: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
verses.ASV: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, Or pierce through his nose with a snare?
verses.ALMEIDA: Poderiam, por acaso, capturá-lo à vista de seus olhos, [ou] com laços furar suas narinas?

verses.KJV: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
verses.WEB: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
verses.ASV: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a fishhook? Or press down his tongue with a cord?
verses.ALMEIDA: Poderás tu pescar ao leviatã com anzol, ou abaixar sua língua com uma corda?
verses.RVR09: ¿SACARÁS tú al leviathán con el anzuelo, ó con la cuerda que le echares en su lengua?

verses.KJV: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
verses.WEB: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
verses.ASV: Canst thou put a rope into his nose? Or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
verses.ALMEIDA: Podes pôr um anzol em seu nariz, ou com um espinho furar sua queixada?
verses.RVR09: ¿Pondrás tú garfio en sus narices, y horadarás con espinas su quijada?

verses.KJV: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
verses.WEB: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
verses.ASV: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Or will he speak soft words unto thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Fará ele súplicas a ti, [ou] falará contigo suavemente?
verses.RVR09: ¿Multiplicará él ruegos para contigo? ¿hablaráte él lisonjas?

verses.KJV: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
verses.WEB: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
verses.ASV: Will he make a covenant with thee, That thou shouldest take him for a servant for ever?
verses.ALMEIDA: Fará ele pacto contigo, para que tu o tomes por escravo perpétuo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hará concierto contigo para que lo tomes por siervo perpetuo?

verses.KJV: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
verses.WEB: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
verses.ASV: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
verses.ALMEIDA: Brincarás tu com ele como com um passarinho, ou o atarás para tuas meninas?
verses.RVR09: ¿Jugarás tú con él como con pájaro, ó lo atarás para tus niñas?

verses.KJV: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.WEB: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
verses.ASV: Will the bands [of fishermen] make traffic of him? Will they part him among the merchants?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os companheiros farão banquete dele? Repartirão dele entre os mercadores?
verses.RVR09: ¿Harán de él banquete los compañeros? ¿partiránlo entre los mercaderes?

verses.KJV: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.WEB: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
verses.ASV: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons, Or his head with fish-spears?
verses.ALMEIDA: Poderás tu encher sua pele de espetos, ou sua cabeça com arpões de pescadores?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cortarás tú con cuchillo su cuero, ó con asta de pescadores su cabeza?

verses.KJV: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
verses.WEB: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
verses.ASV: Lay thy hand upon him; Remember the battle, and do so no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Põe tua mão sobre ele; te lembrarás da batalha, e nunca mais voltarás a fazer.
verses.RVR09: Pon tu mano sobre él; te acordarás de la batalla, y nunca más tornarás.

verses.KJV: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.WEB: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.ASV: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: Will not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que a esperança de alguém [de vencê-lo] falhará; pois, apenas ao vê-lo será derrubado.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que la esperanza acerca de él será burlada: porque aun á su sola vista se desmayarán.

verses.KJV: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.WEB: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
verses.ASV: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up; Who then is he that can stand before me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém há [tão] ousado que o desperte; quem pois, [ousa] se opor a mim?
verses.RVR09: Nadie hay tan osado que lo despierte: ¿quién pues podrá estar delante de mí?

verses.KJV: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.WEB: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
verses.ASV: Who hath first given unto me, that I should repay him? [Whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem me deu primeiro, para que eu [o] recompense? Tudo o que há debaixo dos céus é meu.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién me ha anticipado, para que yo restituya? Todo lo que hay debajo del cielo es mío.

verses.KJV: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
verses.WEB: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
verses.ASV: I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, Nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não me calarei a respeito de seus membros, nem de [suas] forças, e da graça de sua estatura.
verses.RVR09: Yo no callaré sus miembros, ni lo de sus fuerzas y la gracia de su disposición.

verses.KJV: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
verses.WEB: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?
verses.ASV: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who shall come within his jaws?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem descobrirá sua vestimenta superficial? Quem poderá penetrar sua couraça dupla?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién descubrirá la delantera de su vestidura? ¿quién se llegará á él con freno doble?

verses.KJV: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
verses.WEB: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
verses.ASV: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem poderia abrir as portas de seu rosto? Ao redor de seus dentes há espanto.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién abrirá las puertas de su rostro? Los órdenes de sus dientes espantan.

verses.KJV: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
verses.WEB: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
verses.ASV: [His] strong scales are [his] pride, Shut up together [as with] a close seal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus fortes escudos são excelentes; cada um fechado, como um selo apertado.
verses.RVR09: La gloria de su vestido son escudos fuertes, cerrados entre sí estrechamente.

verses.KJV: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.WEB: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.ASV: One is so near to another, That no air can come between them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um está tão próximo do outro, que vento não pode entrar entre eles.
verses.RVR09: El uno se junta con el otro, que viento no entra entre ellos.

verses.KJV: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.WEB: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
verses.ASV: They are joined one to another; They stick together, so that they cannot be sundered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estão grudados uns aos outros; estão tão travados entre si, que não se podem separar.
verses.RVR09: Pegado está el uno con el otro, están trabados entre sí, que no se pueden apartar.

verses.KJV: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.WEB: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.ASV: His sneezings flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um de seus roncos faz resplandecer a luz, e seus olhos são como os cílios do amanhecer.
verses.RVR09: Con sus estornudos encienden lumbre, y sus ojos son como los párpados del alba.

verses.KJV: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
verses.WEB: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
verses.ASV: Out of his mouth go burning torches, And sparks of fire leap forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: De sua boca saem tochas, faíscas de fogo saltam dela.
verses.RVR09: De su boca salen hachas de fuego; centellas de fuego proceden.

verses.KJV: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
verses.WEB: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
verses.ASV: Out of his nostrils a smoke goeth, As of a boiling pot and [burning] rushes.
verses.ALMEIDA: De suas narinas sai fumaça, como de uma panela fervente ou de um caldeirão.
verses.RVR09: De sus narices sale humo, como de una olla ó caldero que hierve.

verses.KJV: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
verses.WEB: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
verses.ASV: His breath kindleth coals, And a flame goeth forth from his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu fôlego acende carvões, e de sua boca sai chama.
verses.RVR09: Su aliento enciende los carbones, y de su boca sale llama.

verses.KJV: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
verses.WEB: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
verses.ASV: In his neck abideth strength, And terror danceth before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: A força habita em seu pescoço; diante dele salta-se de medo.
verses.RVR09: En su cerviz mora la fortaleza, y espárcese el desaliento delante de él.

verses.KJV: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
verses.WEB: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
verses.ASV: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: They are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: As dobras de sua carne estão apegadas [entre si] ; cada uma está firme nele, e não podem ser movidas.
verses.RVR09: Las partes momias de su carne están apretadas: están en él firmes, y no se mueven.

verses.KJV: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
verses.WEB: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
verses.ASV: His heart is as firm as a stone; Yea, firm as the nether millstone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu coração é rígido como uma pedra, rígido como a pedra de baixo de um moinho.
verses.RVR09: Su corazón es firme como una piedra, y fuerte como la muela de abajo.

verses.KJV: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
verses.WEB: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
verses.ASV: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid: By reason of consternation they are beside themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele se levanta, os fortes tremem; por [seus] abalos se recuam.
verses.RVR09: De su grandeza tienen temor los fuertes, y á causa de su desfallecimiento hacen por purificarse.

verses.KJV: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
verses.WEB: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
verses.ASV: If one lay at him with the sword, it cannot avail; Nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se alguém lhe tocar com a espada, não poderá prevalecer; nem arremessar dardo, ou lança.
verses.RVR09: Cuando alguno lo alcanzare, ni espada, ni lanza, ni dardo, ni coselete durará.

verses.KJV: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
verses.WEB: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.
verses.ASV: He counteth iron as straw, [And] brass as rotten wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele considera o ferro como palha, e o aço como madeira podre.
verses.RVR09: El hierro estima por pajas, y el acero por leño podrido.

verses.KJV: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.WEB: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.
verses.ASV: The arrow cannot make him flee: Sling-stones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.ALMEIDA: A flecha não o faz fugir; as pedras de funda são para ele como sobras de cascas.
verses.RVR09: Saeta no le hace huir; las piedras de honda se le tornan aristas.

verses.KJV: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
verses.WEB: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.
verses.ASV: Clubs are counted as stubble: He laugheth at the rushing of the javelin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Considera toda arma como sobras de cascas, e zomba do mover da lança.
verses.RVR09: Tiene toda arma por hojarascas, y del blandir de la pica se burla.

verses.KJV: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
verses.WEB: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
verses.ASV: His underparts are [like] sharp potsherds: He spreadeth [as it were] a threshing-wain upon the mire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por debaixo de si tem conchas pontiagudas; ele esmaga com suas pontas na lama.
verses.RVR09: Por debajo tiene agudas conchas; Imprime su agudez en el suelo.

verses.KJV: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.WEB: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.ASV: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: He maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele faz ferver as profundezas como a uma panela, e faz do mar como um pote de unguento.
verses.RVR09: Hace hervir como una olla la profunda mar, y tórnala como una olla de ungüento.

verses.KJV: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.WEB: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.
verses.ASV: He maketh a path to shine after him; One would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele faz brilhar o caminho atrás de si; faz parecer ao abismo com cabelos grisalhos.
verses.RVR09: En pos de sí hace resplandecer la senda, que parece que la mar es cana.

verses.KJV: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
verses.WEB: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.
verses.ASV: Upon earth there is not his like, That is made without fear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há sobre a terra algo que se possa comparar a ele. Ele foi feito para não temer.
verses.RVR09: No hay sobre la tierra su semejante, hecho para nada temer.

verses.KJV: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
verses.WEB: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
verses.ASV: He beholdeth everything that is high: He is king over all the sons of pride.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele vê tudo que é alto; ele é rei sobre todos os filhos dos animais soberbos.
verses.RVR09: Menosprecia toda cosa alta: es rey sobre todos los soberbios.

verses.KJV: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
verses.WEB: Then Job answered the LORD:
verses.ASV: Then Job answered Jehovah, and said,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jó respondeu ao SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y RESPONDIÓ Job á Jehová, y dijo:

verses.KJV: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
verses.WEB: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
verses.ASV: I know that thou canst do all things, And that no purpose of thine can be restrained.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sei que tudo podes, e nenhum de teus pensamentos pode ser impedido.
verses.RVR09: Yo conozco que todo lo puedes, y que no hay pensamiento que se esconda de ti.

verses.KJV: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.WEB: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.
verses.ASV: Who is this that hideth counsel without knowledge? Therefore have I uttered that which I understood not, Things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Tu dizes] : Quem é esse que obscurece o conselho sem conhecimento? Por isso eu falei do que não entendia; coisas que eram maravilhosas demais para mim, e eu não as conhecia.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es el que oscurece el consejo sin ciencia? por tanto yo denunciaba lo que no entendía; cosas que me eran ocultas, y que no las sabía.

verses.KJV: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.WEB: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’
verses.ASV: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak; I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Escuta-me, por favor, e eu falarei; eu te perguntarei, e tu me ensina.
verses.RVR09: Oye, te ruego, y hablaré: te preguntaré, y tú me enseñarás.

verses.KJV: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
verses.WEB: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
verses.ASV: I had heard of thee by the hearing of the ear; But now mine eye seeth thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: Com os ouvidos eu ouvira falar de ti; mas agora meus olhos te veem.
verses.RVR09: De oídas te había oído; mas ahora mis ojos te ven.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
verses.WEB: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore I abhor [myself], And repent in dust and ashes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso [me] abomino, e me arrependo no pó e na cinza.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto me aborrezco, y me arrepiento en el polvo y en la ceniza.

verses.KJV: And it was so, that after the Lord had spoken these words unto Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
verses.WEB: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.
verses.ASV: And it was so, that, after Jehovah had spoken these words unto Job, Jehovah said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends; for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, depois que o SENHOR acabou de falar essas palavras a Jó, o SENHOR disse a Elifaz, o temanita: Minha ira se acendeu contra ti e contra os teus dois amigos; porque não falastes de mim o que era correto, como o meu servo Jó.
verses.RVR09: Y aconteció que después que habló Jehová estas palabras á Job, Jehová dijo á Eliphaz Temanita: Mi ira se encendió contra ti y tus dos compañeros: porque no habéis hablado por mí lo recto, como mi siervo Job.

verses.KJV: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore, take unto you seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt-offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you; for him will I accept, that I deal not with you after your folly; for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso tomai sete bezerros e sete carneiros, ide ao meu servo Jó, e oferecei holocaustos em vosso favor, então meu servo Jó orará por vós; pois certamente atenderei a ele para eu não vos tratar conforme a vossa insensatez; pois não falastes de mim o que era correto, como o meu servo Jó.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, tomaos siete becerros y siete carneros, y andad á mi siervo Job, y ofreced holocausto por vosotros, y mi siervo Job orará por vosotros; porque de cierto á él atenderé para no trataros afrentosamente, por cuanto no habéis hablado por mí con rectitud, como mi siervo Job.

verses.KJV: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Job.
verses.WEB: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.
verses.ASV: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as Jehovah commanded them: and Jehovah accepted Job.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então foram Elifaz, o temanita, Bildade, o suíta, e Zofar, o naamita, e fizeram como o SENHOR havia lhes dito; e o SENHOR atendeu a Jó.
verses.RVR09: Fueron pues Eliphaz Temanita, y Bildad Suhita, y Sophar Naamatita, é hicieron como Jehová les dijo: y Jehová atendió á Job.

verses.KJV: And the Lord turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.WEB: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: and Jehovah gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR livrou Jó de seu infortúnio, enquanto ele orava pelos seus amigos; e o SENHOR acrescentou a Jó o dobro de tudo quanto ele[ antes] possuía.
verses.RVR09: Y mudó Jehová la aflicción de Job, orando él por sus amigos: y aumentó al doble todas las cosas que habían sido de Job.

verses.KJV: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
verses.WEB: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.
verses.ASV: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him concerning all the evil that Jehovah had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one a ring of gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vieram e ele todos os seus irmãos, e todas as suas irmãs, e todos os que o conheciam antes; e comeram com ele pão em sua casa, e condoeram-se dele, e o consolaram acerca de toda a calamidade que o SENHOR tinha trazido sobre ele; e cada um deles lhe deu uma peça de dinheiro, e uma argola de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Y vinieron á él todos sus hermanos, y todas sus hermanas, y todos los que antes le habían conocido, y comieron con él pan en su casa, y condoliéronse de él, y consoláronle de todo aquel mal que sobre él había Jehová traído; y cada uno de ellos le dió una pieza de moneda, y un zarcillo de oro.

verses.KJV: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
verses.WEB: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
verses.ASV: So Jehovah blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: and he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she-asses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [assim] o SENHOR abençoou o último estado de Jó mais que o seu primeiro; porque teve catorze mil ovelhas, seis mil camelos, mil juntas de bois, e mil asnas.
verses.RVR09: Y bendijo Jehová la postrimería de Job más que su principio; porque tuvo catorce mil ovejas, y seis mil camellos, y mil yuntas de bueyes, y mil asnas.

verses.KJV: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.WEB: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.ASV: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também teve sete filhos e três filhas.
verses.RVR09: Y tuvo siete hijos y tres hijas.

verses.KJV: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.
verses.WEB: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.
verses.ASV: And he called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou o nome da uma Jemima, e o nome da segunda Quézia, e o nome da terceira Quéren-Hapuque.
verses.RVR09: Y llamó el nombre de la una, Jemimah, y el nombre de la segunda, Cesiah, y el nombre de la tercera, Keren-happuch.

verses.KJV: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
verses.WEB: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
verses.ASV: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em toda a terra não se acharam mulheres tão belas como as filhas de Jó; e seu pai lhes deu herança entre seus irmãos.
verses.RVR09: Y no se hallaron mujeres tan hermosas como las hijas de Job en toda la tierra: y dióles su padre herencia entre sus hermanos.

verses.KJV: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.
verses.WEB: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
verses.ASV: And after this Job lived a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, [even] four generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois disto Jó viveu cento e quarenta anos; e viu seus filhos, e os filhos de seus filhos, até quatro gerações.
verses.RVR09: Y después de esto vivió Job ciento y cuarenta años, y vió á sus hijos, y á los hijos de sus hijos, hasta la cuarta generación.

verses.KJV: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.WEB: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.ASV: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Jó morreu, velho, e farto de dias.
verses.RVR09: Murió pues Job viejo, y lleno de días.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers:
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado o homem que não anda no conselho dos maus, nem fica parado no caminho dos pecadores, nem se senta junto dos escarnecedores.
verses.RVR09: BIENAVENTURADO el varón que no anduvo en consejo de malos, ni estuvo en camino de pecadores, ni en silla de escarnecedores se ha sentado;

verses.KJV: But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.WEB: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
verses.ASV: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sim, que tem seu prazer na Lei do SENHOR; e medita em sua Lei de dia e de noite.
verses.RVR09: Antes en la ley de Jehová está su delicia, y en su ley medita de día y de noche.

verses.KJV: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verses.WEB: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
verses.ASV: And he shall be like a tree planted by the streams of water, That bringeth forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also doth not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele será como uma árvore, plantada junto a ribeiros de águas, que dá fruto a seu [devido] tempo, e suas folhas não caem; e tudo quanto fizer prosperará.
verses.RVR09: Y será como el árbol plantado junto á arroyos de aguas, que da su fruto en su tiempo, y su hoja no cae; y todo lo que hace, prosperará.

verses.KJV: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.WEB: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
verses.ASV: The wicked are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os maus não são assim; mas são como a palha que o vento dispersa.
verses.RVR09: No así los malos: sino como el tamo que arrebata el viento.

verses.KJV: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.WEB: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.ASV: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso os maus não subsistirão no julgamento, nem os pecadores no ajuntamento dos justos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto no se levantarán los malos en el juicio, ni los pecadores en la congregación de los justos.

verses.KJV: For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.WEB: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous; But the way of the wicked shall perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR conhece o caminho dos justos; porém o caminho dos maus perecerá.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová conoce el camino de los justos; mas la senda de los malos perecerá.

verses.KJV: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.WEB: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
verses.ASV: Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que as nações se rebelam, e os povos planejam em vão?
verses.RVR09: ¿POR qué se amotinan las gentes, y los pueblos piensan vanidad?

verses.KJV: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,
verses.WEB: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,
verses.ASV: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, [saying],
verses.ALMEIDA: Os reis da terra se levantam, e os governantes tomam conselhos reunidos contra o SENHOR, e contra seu Ungido, [dizendo] :
verses.RVR09: Estarán los reyes de la tierra, y príncipes consultarán unidos contra Jehová, y contra su ungido, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.WEB: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
verses.ASV: Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rompamos as correntes deles, e lancemos fora de nós as cordas deles.
verses.RVR09: Rompamos sus coyundas, y echemos de nosotros sus cuerdas.

verses.KJV: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
verses.WEB: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
verses.ASV: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que está sentado nos céus rirá; o Senhor zombará deles.
verses.RVR09: El que mora en los cielos se reirá; el Señor se burlará de ellos.

verses.KJV: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.WEB: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
verses.ASV: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lhes falará em sua ira; em seu furor ele os assombrará, [dizendo] :
verses.RVR09: Entonces hablará á ellos en su furor, y turbarálos con su ira.

verses.KJV: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.WEB: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
verses.ASV: Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu ungi a meu Rei sobre Sião, o monte de minha santidade.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero he puesto mi rey sobre Sión, monte de mi santidad.

verses.KJV: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.WEB: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
verses.ASV: I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu declararei o decreto do SENHOR: Ele me disse: Tu és meu Filho; eu hoje te gerei.
verses.RVR09: Yo publicaré el decreto: Jehová me ha dicho: Mi hijo eres tú; yo te engendré hoy.

verses.KJV: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.WEB: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
verses.ASV: Ask of me, and I will give [thee] the nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pede-me, e eu te darei as nações [por] herança, e [por] tua propriedade os confins da terra.
verses.RVR09: Pídeme, y te daré por heredad las gentes, y por posesión tuya los términos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
verses.WEB: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
verses.ASV: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com cetro de ferro tu as quebrarás; como vaso de oleiro tu as despedaçarás;
verses.RVR09: Quebrantarlos has con vara de hierro: como vaso de alfarero los desmenuzarás.

verses.KJV: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.WEB: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
verses.ASV: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto agora, reis, sede prudentes; vós, juízes da terra, deixai serdes instruídos.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, reyes, entended: admitid corrección, jueces de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.WEB: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.ASV: Serve Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Servi ao SENHOR com temor; e alegrai-vos com tremor.
verses.RVR09: Servid á Jehová con temor, y alegraos con temblor.

verses.KJV: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verses.WEB: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
verses.ASV: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Beijai ao Filho, para que ele não se ire, e pereçais [no] caminho; porque em breve a ira dele se acenderá. Bem-aventurados [são] todos os que nele confiam.
verses.RVR09: Besad al Hijo, porque no se enoje, y perezcáis en el camino, cuando se encendiere un poco su furor. Bienaventurados todos los que en él confían.

verses.KJV: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased! Many are they that rise up against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, quando ele fugia da presença de seu filho Absalão: Ah SENHOR, como têm se multiplicado meus adversários! Muitos se levantam contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David, cuando huía de delante de Absalom su hijo. ¡OH Jehová, cuánto se han multiplicado mis enemigos! muchos se levantan contra mí.

verses.KJV: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
verses.WEB: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
verses.ASV: Many there are that say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos dizem de minha alma: Não há salvação para ele em Deus.(Selá)
verses.RVR09: Muchos dicen de mi vida: No hay para él salud en Dios. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: But thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
verses.WEB: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
verses.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me; My glory, and the lifter up of my head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, SENHOR, és escudo para mim; minha glória, e o que levanta minha cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Jehová, eres escudo alrededor de mí: mi gloria, y el que ensalza mi cabeza.

verses.KJV: I cried unto the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.WEB: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.ASV: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice, And he answereth me out of his holy hill. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Com minha voz eu clamei ao SENHOR; e ele me ouviu desde o monte de sua santidade. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Con mi voz clamé á Jehová, y él me respondió desde el monte de su santidad. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me.
verses.WEB: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
verses.ASV: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Jehovah sustaineth me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me deitei, e dormi; acordei, porque o SENHOR me sustentava.
verses.RVR09: Yo me acosté, y dormí, y desperté; porque Jehová me sostuvo.

verses.KJV: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.WEB: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
verses.ASV: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não temerei [ainda que sejam] dez mil pessoas que se ponham ao redor de mim.
verses.RVR09: No temeré de diez millares de pueblos, que pusieren cerco contra mí.

verses.KJV: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.WEB: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, SENHOR, salva-me, meu Deus; pois feriste os queixos de todos meus inimigos; [e] quebraste os dentes dos maus.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, Jehová; sálvame, Dios mío: porque tú heriste á todos mis enemigos en la quijada; los dientes de los malos quebrantaste.

verses.KJV: Salvation belongeth unto the Lord: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
verses.WEB: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
verses.ASV: Salvation belongeth unto Jehovah: Thy blessing be upon thy people. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: A salvação [vem] do SENHOR; sobre o teu povo seja tua bênção. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: De Jehová es la salud: sobre tu pueblo será tu bendición. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; Thou hast set me at large [when I was] in distress: Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi para o regente, com instrumentos de cordas: Quando eu clamar, ouve-me, ó Deus de minha justiça; na angústia tu me alivias; tem misericórdia de mim, e ouve a minha oração.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Neginoth: Salmo de David. RESPÓNDEME cuando clamo, oh Dios de mi justicia: estando en angustia, tú me hiciste ensanchar: ten misericordia de mí, y oye mi oración.

verses.KJV: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.WEB: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.
verses.ASV: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? [How long] will ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhos dos homens, até quando [tornareis] minha glória em infâmia, e amareis as coisas vãs? [Até quando] buscareis a mentira? (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Hijos de los hombres, ¿hasta cuándo volveréis mi honra en infamia, amaréis la vanidad, y buscaréis la mentira? (Selah.)

verses.KJV: But know that the Lord hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the Lord will hear when I call unto him.
verses.WEB: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.
verses.ASV: But know that Jehovah hath set apart for himself him that is godly: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabei pois, que o SENHOR separou para si aquele que é fiel; o SENHOR ouvirá, quando a ele eu clamar.
verses.RVR09: Sabed pues, que Jehová hizo apartar al pío para sí: Jehová oirá cuando yo á él clamare.

verses.KJV: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.WEB: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.ASV: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando estiverdes perturbados, não pequeis; meditai em vosso coração sobre a vossa cama, e fazei silêncio. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Temblad, y no pequéis: conversad en vuestro corazón sobre vuestra cama, y desistid. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
verses.ASV: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sacrificai sacrifícios de justiça, e confiai no SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ofreced sacrificios de justicia, y confiad en Jehová.

verses.KJV: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Lord, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.WEB: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
verses.ASV: Many there are that say, Who will show us [any] good? Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos dizem: Quem nos mostrará o bem?Levanta sobre nós, SENHOR, a luz de teu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Muchos dicen: ¿Quién nos mostrará el bien? Alza sobre nosotros, oh Jehová, la luz de tu rostro.

verses.KJV: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
verses.WEB: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
verses.ASV: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than [they have] when their grain and their new wine are increased.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me deste alegria em meu coração, maior do que quando o trigo e o vinho deles se multiplicaram.
verses.RVR09: Tú diste alegría en mi corazón, más que tienen ellos en el tiempo que se multiplicó su grano y su mosto.

verses.KJV: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.WEB: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
verses.ASV: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu deitarei, e dormirei em paz; porque só tu, SENHOR, me fazes descansar seguro.
verses.RVR09: En paz me acostaré, y asimismo dormiré; porque solo tú, Jehová, me harás estar confiado.

verses.KJV: Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; with the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi para o regente, com instrumentos de sopro: SENHOR, escuta as minhas palavras; entende aquilo que estou meditando;
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Nehiloth: Salmo de David. ESCUCHA, oh Jehová, mis palabras; considera la meditación mía.

verses.KJV: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.WEB: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
verses.ASV: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto thee do I pray.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve a voz do meu clamor, meu Rei e meu Deus; porque a ti eu oro.
verses.RVR09: Está atento á la voz de mi clamor, Rey mío y Dios mío, porque á ti oraré.

verses.KJV: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.WEB: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order [my prayer] unto thee, and will keep watch.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, pela manhã ouvirás minha voz; pela manhã apresentarei [meu clamor] a ti, e ficarei esperando.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, de mañana oirás mi voz; de mañana me presentaré á ti, y esperaré.

verses.KJV: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.WEB: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
verses.ASV: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Evil shall not sojourn with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu não [és] Deus que tens prazer na maldade; contigo não habitará o mau.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú no eres un Dios que ame la maldad: el malo no habitará junto á ti.

verses.KJV: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.WEB: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
verses.ASV: The arrogant shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os arrogantes não ficarão de pé diante dos teus olhos; tu odeias todas os praticantes de maldade.
verses.RVR09: No estarán los insensatos delante de tus ojos: aborreces á todos los que obran iniquidad.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.WEB: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth the blood-thirsty and deceitful man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu destruirás aos que falam mentiras; o SENHOR abomina ao homem sanguinário e enganador.
verses.RVR09: Destruirás á los que hablan mentira: al hombre de sangres y de engaño abominará Jehová.

verses.KJV: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.WEB: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
verses.ASV: But as for me, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness will I come into thy house: In thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu, pela grandeza de tua bondade, entrarei em tua casa; adorarei inclinado para o templo de tua santidade em temor a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y yo en la multitud de tu misericordia entraré en tu casa: adoraré hacia el templo de tu santidad en tu temor.

verses.KJV: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.WEB: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
verses.ASV: Lead me, O Jehovah, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, guia-me em tua justiça, por causa dos meus adversários; prepara diante de mim o teu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Guíame, Jehová, en tu justicia á causa de mis enemigos; endereza delante de mí tu camino.

verses.KJV: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.WEB: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
verses.ASV: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não há verdade na boca deles; seu interior são meras destruições; a garganta deles é uma sepultura aberta; com suas línguas elogiam falsamente.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hay en su boca rectitud: sus entrañas son pravedades; sepulcro abierto su garganta: con su lengua lisonjearán.

verses.KJV: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.WEB: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
verses.ASV: Hold them guilty, O God; Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Declara-os culpados, ó Deus, [e] que caiam de seus próprios conselhos; expulsa-os por causa da abundância de suas transgressões, porque eles se rebelaram contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Desbarátalos, oh Dios; caigan de sus consejos: por la multitud de sus rebeliones échalos, porque se rebelaron contra ti.

verses.KJV: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.WEB: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
verses.ASV: But let all those that take refuge in thee rejoice, Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se alegrem todos os que confiam em ti; clamai de alegria para sempre; porque tu os proteges; e fiquem contentes em ti aqueles que amam o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Y alegrarse han todos los que en ti confían; para siempre darán voces de júbilo, porque tú los defiendes: y en ti se regocijarán los que aman tu nombre.

verses.KJV: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
verses.WEB: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
verses.ASV: For thou wilt bless the righteous; O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu, SENHOR, abençoarás ao justo; como com um escudo tu o rodearás com tua bondade.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, oh Jehová, bendecirás al justo; lo cercarás de benevolencia como con un escudo.

verses.KJV: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi para o regente, com instrumentos de cordas, uma harpa de oito cordas: SENHOR, não me repreendas na tua ira; e não me castigues em teu furor.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: en Neginoth sobre Seminith: Salmo de David. JEHOVÁ, no me reprendas en tu furor, ni me castigues con tu ira.
