verses.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.WEB: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
verses.ASV: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tem misericórdia de mim, SENHOR; porque eu [estou] enfraquecido; cura-me, SENHOR, porque meus ossos estão afligidos.
verses.RVR09: Ten misericordia de mí, oh Jehová, porque yo estoy debilitado: sáname, oh Jehová, porque mis huesos están conmovidos.

verses.KJV: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?
verses.WEB: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?
verses.ASV: My soul also is sore troubled: And thou, O Jehovah, how long?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até minha alma está muito aflita; e tu, SENHOR, até quando?
verses.RVR09: Mi alma asimismo está muy conturbada: y tú, Jehová, ¿hasta cuándo?

verses.KJV: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.WEB: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
verses.ASV: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness’ sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Volta, SENHOR; livra minha alma; salva-me por tua bondade.
verses.RVR09: Vuelve, oh Jehová, libra mi alma; sálvame por tu misericordia.

verses.KJV: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.WEB: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
verses.ASV: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque na morte não há lembrança de ti; no Xeol quem te louvará?
verses.RVR09: Porque en la muerte no hay memoria de ti: ¿quién te loará en el sepulcro?

verses.KJV: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.WEB: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
verses.ASV: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já estou cansado do meu gemido; toda a noite eu inundo a minha cama; com minhas lágrimas molho meu leito.
verses.RVR09: Heme consumido á fuerza de gemir: todas las noches inundo mi lecho, riego mi estrado con mis lágrimas.

verses.KJV: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.WEB: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
verses.ASV: Mine eye wasteth away because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos estão desolados de mágoa, [e] têm se envelhecido por causa de todos os meus adversários.
verses.RVR09: Mis ojos están carcomidos de descontento; hanse envejecido á causa de todos mis angustiadores.

verses.KJV: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.WEB: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.ASV: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sai para longe de mim, todos vós praticantes de maldade; porque o SENHOR já ouviu a voz do meu choro.
verses.RVR09: Apartaos de mí, todos los obradores de iniquidad; porque Jehová ha oído la voz de mi lloro.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer.
verses.WEB: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR tem ouvido a minha súplica; o SENHOR aceitará a minha oração.
verses.RVR09: Jehová ha oído mi ruego; ha recibido Jehová mi oración.

verses.KJV: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.WEB: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
verses.ASV: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os meus inimigos se envergonharão e ficarão muito perturbados; voltarão para trás, [e] repentinamente se envergonharão.
verses.RVR09: Se avergonzarán, y turbaránse mucho todos mis enemigos; volveránse y serán avergonzados subitáneamente.

verses.KJV: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.WEB: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
verses.ASV: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto Jehovah, concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite. O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge: Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico de Davi, que cantou ao SENHOR, depois das palavras de Cuxe, descendente de Benjamim: SENHOR, meu Deus, em ti confio; salva-me de todos os que me perseguem, e livra-me.
verses.RVR09: Sigaión de David, que cantó á Jehová sobre las palabras de Cus, hijo de Benjamín. JEHOVÁ Dios mío, en ti he confiado: sálvame de todos los que me persiguen, y líbrame;

verses.KJV: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.WEB: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
verses.ASV: Lest they tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não rasguem minha alma como um leão, sendo despedaçada sem [haver] quem a livre.
verses.RVR09: No sea que arrebate mi alma, cual león que despedaza, sin que haya quien libre.

verses.KJV: O Lord my God, If I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.WEB: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
verses.ASV: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, meu Deus, se eu fiz isto: se há perversidade em minhas mãos;
verses.RVR09: Jehová Dios mío, si yo he hecho esto, si hay en mis manos iniquidad;

verses.KJV: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
verses.WEB: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),
verses.ASV: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause was mine adversary);
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu paguei [com] mal ao que tinha paz comigo (mas fiz escapar ao que me oprimia sem causa);
verses.RVR09: Si dí mal pago al pacífico conmigo, (hasta he libertado al que sin causa era mi enemigo;)

verses.KJV: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.WEB: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
verses.ASV: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; Yea, let him tread my life down to the earth, And lay my glory in the dust. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] que o inimigo persiga a minha alma, e a alcance; e pise em terra a minha vida; e faça habitar minha honra no pó. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Persiga el enemigo mi alma, y alcáncela; y pise en tierra mi vida, y mi honra ponga en el polvo. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
verses.WEB: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
verses.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah, in thine anger; Lift up thyself against the rage of mine adversaries, And awake for me; thou hast commanded judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, SENHOR, em tua ira; exalta-te pelos furores de meus opressores; e desperta para comigo; tu mandaste o juízo.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, oh Jehová, con tu furor; álzate á causa de las iras de mis angustiadores, y despierta en favor mío el juicio que mandaste.

verses.KJV: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
verses.WEB: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
verses.ASV: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about; And over them return thou on high.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o ajuntamento de povos te rodeará; portanto volta a te elevar [a ti mesmo] sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Y te rodeará concurso de pueblo; por cuyo amor vuélvete luego á levantar en alto.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall judge the people: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
verses.WEB: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
verses.ASV: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples: Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR julgará aos povos; julga-me, SENHOR, conforme a minha justiça, e conforme a sinceridade [que há] em mim.
verses.RVR09: Jehová juzgará los pueblos: júzgame, oh Jehová, conforme á mi justicia y conforme á mi integridad.

verses.KJV: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.WEB: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
verses.ASV: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous: For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que tenha fim a maldade dos maus; mas firma ao justo, tu, ó justo Deus, que provas os corações e os sentimentos.
verses.RVR09: Consúmase ahora la malicia de los inicuos, y establece al justo; pues el Dios justo prueba los corazones y los riñones.

verses.KJV: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
verses.WEB: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
verses.ASV: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu escudo [pertence] a Deus, que salva os corretos de coração.
verses.RVR09: Mi escudo está en Dios, que salva á los rectos de corazón.

verses.KJV: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
verses.WEB: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
verses.ASV: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus é um justo juiz; e um Deus que se ira todos os dias.
verses.RVR09: Dios es el que juzga al justo: y Dios está airado todos los días contra el impío.

verses.KJV: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.WEB: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
verses.ASV: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele afia a espada para aquele que não se arrepende; ele [já] armou e preparou seu arco.
verses.RVR09: Si no se convirtiere, él afilará su espada: armado tiene ya su arco, y lo ha preparado.

verses.KJV: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.WEB: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
verses.ASV: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He maketh his arrows fiery [shafts].
verses.ALMEIDA: E para ele [já] preparou armas mortais; suas flechas utilizará contra os perseguidores.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo ha aparejado para él armas de muerte; ha labrado sus saetas para los que persiguen.

verses.KJV: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.WEB: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
verses.ASV: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que [o injusto] está com dores de perversidade; e está em trabalho de parto, e gerará mentiras.
verses.RVR09: He aquí ha tenido parto de iniquidad: concibió trabajo, y parió mentira.

verses.KJV: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.WEB: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
verses.ASV: He hath made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele cavou um poço e o fez fundo; mas caiu na cova [que ele próprio] fez.
verses.RVR09: Pozo ha cavado, y ahondádolo; y en la fosa que hizo caerá.

verses.KJV: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.WEB: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
verses.ASV: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu trabalho se voltará contra sua [própria] cabeça; e sua violência descerá sobre o topo de sua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Su trabajo se tornará sobre su cabeza, y su agravio descenderá sobre su mollera.

verses.KJV: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.
verses.WEB: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
verses.ASV: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu louvarei ao SENHOR conforme sua justiça; cantarei ao nome do SENHOR, o Altíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Alabaré yo á Jehová conforme á su justicia, y cantaré al nombre de Jehová el Altísimo.

verses.KJV: O Lord, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth, Who hast set thy glory upon the heavens!
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi para o regente, com “Gitite”: Ah DEUS, nosso Senhor, quão glorioso é o teu nome sobre toda a terra! Pois tu puseste tua majestade acima dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Gittith: Salmo de David. OH Jehová, Señor nuestro, ¡cuán grande es tu nombre en toda la tierra, que has puesto tu gloria sobre los cielos!

verses.KJV: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.WEB: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
verses.ASV: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established strength, Because of thine adversaries, That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Da boca das crianças, e dos que mamam, tu fundaste força, por causa de teus adversários, para fazer cessar ao inimigo e ao vingador.
verses.RVR09: De la boca de los chiquitos y de los que maman, fundaste la fortaleza, á causa de tus enemigos, para hacer cesar al enemigo, y al que se venga.

verses.KJV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.WEB: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,
verses.ASV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu vejo teus céus, obra de teus dedos; a lua e as estrelas, que tu preparaste;
verses.RVR09: Cuando veo tus cielos, obra de tus dedos, la luna y las estrellas que tú formaste:

verses.KJV: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.WEB: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
verses.ASV: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que é o homem, para que tu te lembres dele? E [o que é] o filho do homem, para que o visites?
verses.RVR09: Digo: ¿Qué es el hombre, para que tengas de él memoria, y el hijo del hombre, que lo visites?

verses.KJV: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.WEB: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.ASV: For thou hast made him but little lower than God, And crownest him with glory and honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu o fizeste um pouco menor que os anjos; e com glória e honra tu o coroaste.
verses.RVR09: Pues le has hecho poco menor que los ángeles, y coronástelo de gloria y de lustre.

verses.KJV: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.WEB: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
verses.ASV: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu o fazes ter controle sobre as obras de tuas mãos; tudo puseste debaixo de seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Hicístelo enseñorear de las obras de tus manos; todo lo pusiste debajo de sus pies:

verses.KJV: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.WEB: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
verses.ASV: All sheep and oxen, Yea, and the beasts of the field,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ovelhas e bois, todos eles, e também os animais do campo;
verses.RVR09: Ovejas, y bueyes, todo ello; y asimismo las bestias del campo;

verses.KJV: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.WEB: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
verses.ASV: The birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.ALMEIDA: As aves dos céus, e os peixes do mar; [e] os que passam pelos caminhos dos mares.
verses.RVR09: Las aves de los cielos, y los peces de la mar; todo cuanto pasa por los senderos de la mar.

verses.KJV: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
verses.WEB: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó DEUS, nosso Senhor! Quão glorioso é o teu nome sobre toda a terra!
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, Señor nuestro, ¡cuán grande es tu nombre en toda la tierra!

verses.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to Muth-labben. A Psalm of David. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente, em “Mute-Laben”: Louvarei a [ti] , SENHOR com todo o meu coração; contarei todas as tuas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Muth-labben: Salmo de David. TE alabaré, oh Jehová, con todo mi corazón; contaré todas tus maravillas.

verses.KJV: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.WEB: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
verses.ASV: I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em ti eu ficarei contente e saltarei de alegria; cantarei a teu nome, ó Altíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Alegraréme y regocijaréme en ti: cantaré á tu nombre, oh Altísimo;

verses.KJV: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.WEB: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
verses.ASV: When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus inimigos voltaram para trás; eles caem e perecem diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Por haber sido mis enemigos vueltos atrás: caerán y perecerán delante de ti.

verses.KJV: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.WEB: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
verses.ASV: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu fizeste conforme meu direito e minha causa; tu te sentaste no teu tribunal e julgaste com justiça.
verses.RVR09: Porque has hecho mi juicio y mi causa: sentástete en silla juzgando justicia.

verses.KJV: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
verses.ASV: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Severamente repreendeste às nações, destruíste ao perverso; tu tiraste o nome dele para sempre e eternamente.
verses.RVR09: Reprendiste gentes, destruiste al malo, raíste el nombre de ellos para siempre jamás.

verses.KJV: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.WEB: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
verses.ASV: The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever; And the cities which thou hast overthrown, The very remembrance of them is perished.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ao] inimigo, as destruições já se acabaram para sempre. E tu arrasaste as cidades, [e] já pereceu sua memória [com] elas.
verses.RVR09: Oh enemigo, acabados son para siempre los asolamientos; y las ciudades que derribaste, su memoria pereció con ellas.

verses.KJV: But the Lord shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.WEB: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah sitteth [as king] for ever: He hath prepared his throne for judgment;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR se sentará [para governar] eternamente; ele já preparou seu trono para julgar.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová permanecerá para siempre: dispuesto ha su trono para juicio.

verses.KJV: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.WEB: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
verses.ASV: And he will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele mesmo julgará ao mundo com justiça; e corretamente fará justiça aos povos.
verses.RVR09: Y él juzgará el mundo con justicia; y juzgará los pueblos con rectitud.

verses.KJV: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.WEB: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
verses.ASV: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR será um refúgio para o aflito; um refúgio em tempos de angústia.
verses.RVR09: Y será Jehová refugio al pobre, refugio para el tiempo de angustia.

verses.KJV: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.WEB: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
verses.ASV: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E confiarão em ti os que conhecem o teu nome; porque tu, SENHOR, nunca desamparaste aos que te buscam.
verses.RVR09: Y en ti confiarán los que conocen tu nombre; por cuanto tú, oh Jehová, no desamparaste á los que te buscaron.

verses.KJV: Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.WEB: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
verses.ASV: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR, que habita em Sião! Contai entre os povos as obras dele.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Jehová, que habita en Sión: noticiad en los pueblos sus obras.

verses.KJV: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.WEB: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
verses.ASV: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them; He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele investiga os derramamentos de sangue, [e] lembra-se deles; não se esquece do clamor dos que sofrem.
verses.RVR09: Porque demandando la sangre se acordó de ellos: no se olvidó del clamor de los pobres.

verses.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.WEB: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
verses.ASV: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; Behold my affliction [which I suffer] of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tem misericórdia de mim, SENHOR; olha para o meu sofrimento, [causado] pelos que me odeiam; tu, que me levantas [para fora] das portas da morte.
verses.RVR09: Ten misericordia de mí, Jehová: mira mi aflicción que padezco de los que me aborrecen, tú que me levantas de las puertas de la muerte;

verses.KJV: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.WEB: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
verses.ASV: That I may show forth all thy praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que eu conte todos os teus louvores nas portas da filha de Sião, [e] me alegre em tua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Porque cuente yo todas tus alabanzas en las puertas de la hija de Sión, y me goce en tu salud.

verses.KJV: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.WEB: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
verses.ASV: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: As nações se afundaram na cova que elas fizeram; o pé delas ficou preso na rede que esconderam.
verses.RVR09: Hundiéronse las gentes en la fosa que hicieron; en la red que escondieron fué tomado su pie.

verses.KJV: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.WEB: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. [Higgaion. Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR foi conhecido [pelo] juízo que fez; o perverso foi enlaçado pelas obras de suas [próprias] mãos. (Higaiom, Selá)
verses.RVR09: Jehová fué conocido en el juicio que hizo; en la obra de sus manos fué enlazado el malo. (Higaion. Selah.)

verses.KJV: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
verses.WEB: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
verses.ASV: The wicked shall be turned back unto Sheol, Even all the nations that forget God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os perversos irão para o Xeol, e todas as nações que se esquecem de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Los malos serán trasladados al infierno, todas las gentes que se olvidan de Dios.

verses.KJV: For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.WEB: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
verses.ASV: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o necessitado não será esquecido para sempre; [nem a] esperança dos oprimidos perecerá eternamente.
verses.RVR09: Porque no para siempre será olvidado el pobre; ni la esperanza de los pobres perecerá perpetuamente.

verses.KJV: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.WEB: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
verses.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah; let not man prevail: Let the nations be judged in thy sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, SENHOR, não prevaleça o homem [contra ti] ; sejam julgadas as nações diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, oh Jehová; no se fortalezca el hombre; sean juzgadas las gentes delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
verses.WEB: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
verses.ASV: Put them in fear, O Jehovah: Let the nations know themselves to be but men. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Põe medo neles, SENHOR; saibam as nações que eles são meros mortais. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Pon, oh Jehová, temor en ellos: conozcan las gentes que son no más que hombres. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
verses.WEB: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
verses.ASV: Why standest thou afar off, O Jehovah? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que, SENHOR, tu estás longe? [Por que] tu te escondes em tempos de angústia?
verses.RVR09: ¿POR qué estás lejos, oh Jehová, y te escondes en el tiempo de la tribulación?

verses.KJV: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.WEB: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
verses.ASV: In the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued; Let them be taken in the devices that they have conceived.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com arrogância o perverso persegue furiosamente ao miserável; sejam presos nas ciladas que planejaram.
verses.RVR09: Con arrogancia el malo persigue al pobre: serán cogidos en los artificios que han ideado.

verses.KJV: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.
verses.WEB: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.
verses.ASV: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, And the covetous renounceth, [yea], contemneth Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o perverso se orgulha do desejo de sua alma; ele bendiz ao ganancioso, e blasfema do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto se alaba el malo del deseo de su alma, y bendice al codicioso, á quien Jehová aborrece.

verses.KJV: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
verses.WEB: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
verses.ASV: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance, [saith], He will not require [it]. All his thoughts are, There is no God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela arrogância de seu rosto o perverso não se importa; Deus não existe em todos as seus pensamentos.
verses.RVR09: El malo, por la altivez de su rostro, no busca á Dios: no hay Dios en todos sus pensamientos.

verses.KJV: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
verses.WEB: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
verses.ASV: His ways are firm at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em todo tempo seus caminhos atormentam; teus juízos [estão] longe do rosto dele, em grande altura; ele sopra furiosamente todos os seus adversários.
verses.RVR09: Sus caminos son viciosos en todo tiempo: tus juicios los tiene muy lejos de su vista: echa bocanadas en orden á todos sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
verses.WEB: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
verses.ASV: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; To all generations I shall not be in adversity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele diz em seu coração: Eu nunca serei abalado; porque de geração após geração nunca [sofrerei] mal algum.
verses.RVR09: Dice en su corazón: No seré movido en ningún tiempo, ni jamás me alcanzará el infortunio.

verses.KJV: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
verses.WEB: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
verses.ASV: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression: Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua boca está cheia de maldição, e de enganos, e de falsidade; debaixo de sua língua há sofrimento e maldade.
verses.RVR09: Llena está su boca de maldición, y de engaños y fraude: debajo de su lengua, vejación y maldad.

verses.KJV: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
verses.WEB: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
verses.ASV: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In the secret places doth he murder the innocent; His eyes are privily set against the helpless.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se sentam [postos] para as ciladas das aldeias; nos esconderijos ele mata ao inocente; seus olhos observam secretamente ao contra o pobre.
verses.RVR09: Está en las guaridas de las aldeas: en los escondrijos mata al inocente: sus ojos están acechando al pobre.

verses.KJV: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
verses.WEB: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
verses.ASV: He lurketh in secret as a lion in his covert; He lieth in wait to catch the poor: He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him in his net.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele arma ciladas no esconderijo, como o leão em seu covil; arma ciladas para roubar ao miserável; rouba ao miserável, trazendo-o em sua rede.
verses.RVR09: Acecha en oculto, como el león desde su cama: acecha para arrebatar al pobre: arrebata al pobre trayéndolo á su red.

verses.KJV: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
verses.WEB: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
verses.ASV: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall by his strong ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se encolhe, se agacha, [para que] os pobres caiam em suas armadilhas.
verses.RVR09: Encógese, agáchase, y caen en sus fuerzas muchos desdichados.

verses.KJV: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
verses.WEB: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
verses.ASV: He saith in his heart: God hath forgotten; He hideth his face, he will never see it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele diz em seu coração: Deus [já] se esqueceu; [já] escondeu o seu rosto, nunca mais [o] verá.
verses.RVR09: Dice en su corazón: Dios está olvidado, ha encubierto su rostro; nunca lo verá.

verses.KJV: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
verses.WEB: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
verses.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah; O God, lift up thy hand: Forget not the poor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, SENHOR Deus, ergue tua mão; não te esqueças dos miseráveis.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, oh Jehová Dios, alza tu mano, no te olvides de los pobres.

verses.KJV: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
verses.WEB: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
verses.ASV: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it]?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que o perverso blasfema de Deus? Ele diz eu seu coração que tu nada [lhe] exigirá.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué irrita el malo á Dios? En su corazón ha dicho que no lo inquirirás.

verses.KJV: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
verses.WEB: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
verses.ASV: Thou hast seen [it]; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: The helpless committeth [himself] unto thee; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu estás [o] vendo; porque tu olhas para o trabalho e o cansaço, para o entregar em tuas mãos; em ti o pobre põe confiança; tu és o que ajuda ao órfão.
verses.RVR09: Tú lo tienes visto: porque tú miras el trabajo, y la vejación, para vengarle por tu mano: á ti se acoge el pobre, tú eres el amparo del huérfano.

verses.KJV: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
verses.WEB: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
verses.ASV: Break thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quebra tu o braço do perverso e do maligno; faz cobrança da maldade dele, [até que] tu aches nada [mais dela] .
verses.RVR09: Quebranta el brazo del malo: del maligno buscarás su maldad, hasta que ninguna halles.

verses.KJV: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
verses.WEB: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: The nations are perished out of his land.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é Rei eterno e para todo o sempre; as nações perecerão de sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, Rey eterno y perpetuo; de su tierra fueron destruídas las gentes.

verses.KJV: Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
verses.WEB: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
verses.ASV: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek: Thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear;
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, tu ouviste o desejo dos humildes; tu fortalecerás os seus corações, e teus ouvidos [os] ouvirão;
verses.RVR09: El deseo de los humildes oíste, oh Jehová: tú dispones su corazón, y haces atento tu oído;

verses.KJV: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
verses.WEB: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
verses.ASV: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para fazer justiça ao órfão e ao afligido; para que o homem não mais continue a praticar o terror.
verses.RVR09: Para juzgar al huérfano y al pobre, á fin de que no vuelva más á hacer violencia el hombre de la tierra.

verses.KJV: In the Lord put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. By David. In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David. In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee [as] a bird to your mountain;
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: No SENHOR eu confio; como, pois, tu dizeis à minha alma: Fugi para vossa montanha, [como] um pássaro?
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. EN Jehová he confiado; ¿cómo decís á mi alma: Escapa al monte cual ave?

verses.KJV: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.WEB: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
verses.ASV: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que os maus estão armando o arco; eles estão pondo suas flechas na corda, para atirarem às escuras [com elas] aos corretos de coração.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, los malos flecharon el arco, apercibieron sus saetas sobre la cuerda, para asaetear en oculto á los rectos de corazón.

verses.KJV: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.WEB: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.ASV: If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se os fundamentos são destruídos, o que o justo pode fazer?
verses.RVR09: Si fueren destruídos los fundamentos, ¿qué ha de hacer el justo?

verses.KJV: The Lord is in his holy temple, the Lord's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.WEB: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, his throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR está em seu santo Templo, o trono do SENHOR está nos céus; seus olhos observam com atenção; suas pálpebras provam aos filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Jehová en el templo de su santidad: la silla de Jehová está en el cielo: sus ojos ven, sus párpados examinan á los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: The Lord trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.WEB: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
verses.ASV: Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR prova ao justo; mas sua alma odeia ao perverso e ao que ama a violência.
verses.RVR09: Jehová prueba al justo; empero al malo y al que ama la violencia, su alma aborrece.

verses.KJV: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.WEB: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.ASV: Upon the wicked he will rain snares; Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre os perversos choverá laços, fogo e enxofre; e o pagamento para seu cálice será vento tempestuoso.
verses.RVR09: Sobre los malos lloverá lazos; fuego y azufre, con vientos de torbellinos, será la porción del cáliz de ellos.

verses.KJV: For the righteous Lord loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
verses.WEB: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR [é] justo, [e] ama as justiças; seu rosto presta atenção ao [que é] correto.
verses.RVR09: Porque el justo Jehová ama la justicia: al recto mirará su rostro.

verses.KJV: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente, com harpa de oito cordas: Salva, SENHOR, porque os bons estão em falta; porque são poucos os fiéis dentre os filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Seminith: Salmo de David. SALVA, oh Jehová, porque se acabaron los misericordiosos: porque se han acabado los fieles de entre los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
verses.WEB: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
verses.ASV: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor: With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um fala falsidade ao seu próximo, [com] lábios elogiam falsamente; falam com duas intenções no coração.
verses.RVR09: Mentira habla cada uno con su prójimo; con labios lisonjeros, con corazón doble hablan.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.WEB: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
verses.ASV: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh great things;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que o SENHOR corte a todos os lábios que falam falsos elogios, [e toda] língua que fala grandes [mentiras] .
verses.RVR09: Destruirá Jehová todos los labios lisonjeros, la lengua que habla grandezas;

verses.KJV: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.WEB: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
verses.ASV: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois dizem: Com nossa língua prevaleceremos; nossos lábios [são] nossos; que é senhor sobre nós?
verses.RVR09: Que dijeron: Por nuestra lengua prevaleceremos; nuestros labios están con nosotros: ¿quién nos es señor?

verses.KJV: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
verses.WEB: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
verses.ASV: Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; I will set him in the safety he panteth for.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR diz: Pela opressão aos humildes, pelo gemido dos necessitados, eu agora me levantarei; porei em segurança àquele a quem ele sopra [desejando oprimir] .
verses.RVR09: Por la opresión de los pobres, por el gemido de los menesterosos, ahora me levantaré, dice Jehová: pondrélos en salvo del que contra ellos se engríe.

verses.KJV: The words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
verses.ASV: The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.
verses.ALMEIDA: As palavras do SENHOR são palavras puras, [como] prata refinada em forno de barro, purificada sete vezes.
verses.RVR09: Las palabras de Jehová, palabras limpias; plata refinada en horno de tierra, purificada siete veces.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.WEB: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, SENHOR, os guardarás; desta geração os livrarás para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Tú, Jehová, los guardarás; guárdalos para siempre de aquesta generación.

verses.KJV: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.WEB: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
verses.ASV: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os maus andam cercando, enquanto os mais vis dos filhos dos homens são exaltados.
verses.RVR09: Cercando andan los malos, mientras son exaltados los más viles de los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: How long wilt thou forget me, O Lord? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou forget me for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Até quando, SENHOR, te esquecerás de mim? Para sempre? Até quando tu esconderás de mim o teu rosto?
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. ¿HASTA cuándo, Jehová? ¿me olvidarás para siempre? ¿hasta cuándo esconderás tu rostro de mí?

verses.KJV: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.WEB: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
verses.ASV: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando refletirei em minha alma, [tendo] tristeza em meu coração o dia todo? Até quando o meu inimigo se levantará contra mim?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo pondré consejos en mi alma, con ansiedad en mi corazón cada día? ¿Hasta cuándo será enaltecido mi enemigo sobre mí?

verses.KJV: Consider and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.WEB: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
verses.ASV: Consider [and] answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha [para mim, e] ouve-me, SENHOR meu Deus; ilumina os meus olhos, para que eu não adormeça [na] morte.
verses.RVR09: Mira, óyeme, Jehová Dios mío: alumbra mis ojos, porque no duerma en muerte;

verses.KJV: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.WEB: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
verses.ASV: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; [Lest] mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que meu inimigo não diga: Eu o venci;e meus inimigos se alegrem, se eu vier a cair.
verses.RVR09: Porque no diga mi enemigo, Vencílo: mis enemigos se alegrarán, si yo resbalare.

verses.KJV: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.WEB: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
verses.ASV: But I have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu confio em tua bondade; em tua salvação meu coração se alegrará;
verses.RVR09: Mas yo en tu misericordia he confiado: alegraráse mi corazón en tu salud.

verses.KJV: I will sing unto the Lord, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.WEB: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
verses.ASV: I will sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantarei ao SENHOR, porque ele tem me feito muito bem.
verses.RVR09: Cantaré á Jehová, porque me ha hecho bien.

verses.KJV: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: O tolo diz em seu coração: Não há Deus.Eles têm se pervertido, fazem obras abomináveis; não há quem faça o bem.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. DIJO el necio en su corazón: No hay Dios. Corrompiéronse, hicieron obras abominables; no hay quien haga bien.

verses.KJV: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
verses.WEB: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
verses.ASV: Jehovah looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR olhou desde os céus para os filhos dos homens, para ver se havia alguém prudente, que buscasse a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Jehová miró desde los cielos sobre los hijos de los hombres, por ver si había algún entendido, que buscara á Dios.

verses.KJV: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.WEB: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
verses.ASV: They are all gone aside; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos se desviaram, juntamente se contaminaram; não há quem faça o bem, nem um sequer.
verses.RVR09: Todos declinaron, juntamente se han corrompido: no hay quien haga bien, no hay ni siquiera uno.

verses.KJV: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord.
verses.WEB: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?
verses.ASV: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people [as] they eat bread, And call not upon Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Será que não têm conhecimento todos os que praticam a maldade? Eles devoram a meu povo [como se] comessem pão, [e] não clamam ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ¿No tendrán conocimiento todos los que obran iniquidad, que devoran á mi pueblo como si pan comiesen, y á Jehová no invocaron?

verses.KJV: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.WEB: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.ASV: There were they in great fear; For God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali eles se encherão de medo, porque Deus está com a geração dos justos.
verses.RVR09: Allí temblaron de espanto; porque Dios está con la nación de los justos.

verses.KJV: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.
verses.WEB: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
verses.ASV: Ye put to shame the counsel of the poor, Because Jehovah is his refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós envergonhais os planos do humilde, mas o SENHOR é o refúgio dele.
verses.RVR09: El consejo del pobre habéis escarnecido, por cuanto Jehová es su esperanza.

verses.KJV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the Lord bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.WEB: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.ASV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, que de Sião venha a salvação de Israel! Quando o SENHOR restaurar o seu povo de seu infortúnio, Jacó jubilará, Israel se alegrará.
verses.RVR09: ¡Quién diese de Sión la salud de Israel! En tornando Jehová la cautividad de su pueblo, se gozará Jacob, y alegraráse Israel.

verses.KJV: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David. LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David. Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: SENHOR, quem morará em tua tenda? Quem habitará no monte de tua santidade?
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. JEHOVÁ, ¿quién habitará en tu tabernáculo? ¿quién residirá en el monte de tu santidad?

verses.KJV: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
verses.WEB: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
verses.ASV: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart;
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que anda sinceramente, e pratica a justiça; e com seu coração fala a verdade;
verses.RVR09: El que anda en integridad, y obra justicia, y habla verdad en su corazón.

verses.KJV: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.WEB: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
verses.ASV: He that slandereth not with his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his friend, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbor;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Aquele que] não murmura com sua língua; não faz mal ao seu companheiro, nem aceita insulto contra seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: El que no detrae con su lengua, ni hace mal á su prójimo, ni contra su prójimo acoge oprobio alguno.

verses.KJV: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the Lord. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
verses.WEB: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
verses.ASV: In whose eyes a reprobate is despised, But who honoreth them that fear Jehovah; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seus olhos despreza à pessoa que é digna de reprovação, mas honra aos que temem ao SENHOR; mantém seu juramento até sob [seu próprio] prejuízo, e não muda.
verses.RVR09: Aquel á cuyos ojos es menospreciado el vil; mas honra á los que temen á Jehová: y habiendo jurado en daño suyo, no por eso muda.

verses.KJV: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.WEB: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
verses.ASV: He that putteth not out his money to interest, Nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Tal pessoa] não empresta seu dinheiro com juros; nem aceita suborno contra o inocente; quem faz isto, nunca se abalará.
verses.RVR09: Quien su dinero no dió á usura, ni contra el inocente tomó cohecho. El que hace estas cosas, no resbalará para siempre.

verses.KJV: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
verses.WEB: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
verses.ASV: Michtam of David. Preserve me, O God; for in thee do I take refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico de Davi: Guarda-me, ó Deus; porque eu confio em ti.
verses.RVR09: Michtham de David. GUÁRDAME, oh Dios, porque en ti he confiado.

verses.KJV: O my soul, thou hast said unto the Lord, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
verses.WEB: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
verses.ASV: [O my soul], thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, [minha alma] , disseste ao SENHOR: Tu és meu Senhor; minha bondade não [chega] até ti.
verses.RVR09: Dijiste, oh alma mía, á Jehová: Tú eres el Señor: mi bien á ti no aprovecha;

verses.KJV: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
verses.WEB: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
verses.ASV: As for the saints that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] aos santos que [estão] na terra, e [a] os ilustres, nos quais está todo o meu prazer.
verses.RVR09: Sino á los santos que están en la tierra, y á los íntegros: toda mi afición en ellos.

verses.KJV: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
verses.WEB: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
verses.ASV: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another [god]: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: As dores se multiplicarão daqueles que se apressam [para servir] a outros [deuses] ; eu não oferecerei seus sacrifícios de derramamento de sangue, e não tomarei seus nomes em meus lábios.
verses.RVR09: Multiplicaránse los dolores de aquellos que sirven diligentes á otro dios: no ofreceré yo sus libaciones de sangre, ni en mis labios tomaré sus nombres.

verses.KJV: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
verses.WEB: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é a porção da minha herança e o meu cálice; tu sustentas a minha sorte.
verses.RVR09: Jehová es la porción de mi parte y de mi copa; tú sustentarás mi suerte.

verses.KJV: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.WEB: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
verses.ASV: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em lugares agradáveis foram postos os limites [do meu terreno] ; sim, eu recebo uma bela propriedade.
verses.RVR09: Las cuerdas me cayeron en lugares deleitosos, y es hermosa la heredad que me ha tocado.

verses.KJV: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
verses.WEB: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
verses.ASV: I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu louvarei ao SENHOR, que me aconselhou; até de noite meus sentimentos me ensinam.
verses.RVR09: Bendeciré á Jehová que me aconseja: aun en las noches me enseñan mis riñones.

verses.KJV: I have set the Lord always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.WEB: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.ASV: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ponho ao SENHOR continuamente diante de mim; porque [ele está] à minha direita; nunca serei abalado.
verses.RVR09: A Jehová he puesto siempre delante de mí: porque está á mi diestra no seré conmovido.

verses.KJV: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
verses.WEB: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
verses.ASV: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: My flesh also shall dwell in safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meu coração está contente, e minha glória se alegra; certamente minha carne habitará em segurança.
verses.RVR09: Alegróse por tanto mi corazón, y se gozó mi gloria: también mi carne reposará segura.

verses.KJV: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.WEB: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
verses.ASV: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol; Neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu não deixarás a minha alma no Xeol, nem permitirás que teu Santo veja a degradação.
verses.RVR09: Porque no dejarás mi alma en el sepulcro; ni permitirás que tu santo vea corrupción.

verses.KJV: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.WEB: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me farás conhecer o caminho da vida; fartura de alegrias [há] em tua presença; agrados estão em tua mão direita para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Me mostrarás la senda de la vida: hartura de alegrías hay con tu rostro; deleites en tu diestra para siempre.

verses.KJV: Hear the right, O Lord, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
verses.WEB: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
verses.ASV: A Prayer of David. Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Oração de Davi: Ouve, SENHOR, a [minha] justiça; presta atenção ao meu choro, dá ouvidos à minha oração de lábios que não enganam.
verses.RVR09: Oración de David. OYE, oh Jehová, justicia; está atento á mi clamor; escucha mi oración hecha sin labios de engaño.

verses.KJV: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
verses.WEB: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
verses.ASV: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; Let thine eyes look upon equity.
verses.ALMEIDA: De diante de teu rosto saia o meu julgamento; teus olhos observarão o que é justo.
verses.RVR09: De delante de tu rostro salga mi juicio; vean tus ojos la rectitud.

verses.KJV: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.WEB: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
verses.ASV: Thou hast proved my heart; thou hast visited me in the night; Thou hast tried me, and findest nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu [já] provaste o meu coração, tu [me] visitaste de noite; tu me investigaste, [e] nada achaste; decidi [que] minha boca não transgredirá.
verses.RVR09: Tú has probado mi corazón, hasme visitado de noche; me has apurado, y nada inicuo hallaste: heme propuesto que mi boca no ha de propasarse.

verses.KJV: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
verses.WEB: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
verses.ASV: As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto às obras dos homens, conforme a palavra de teus lábios eu me guardei dos caminhos do violento;
verses.RVR09: Para las obras humanas, por la palabra de tus labios yo me he guardado de las vías del destructor.

verses.KJV: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
verses.WEB: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
verses.ASV: My steps have held fast to thy paths, My feet have not slipped.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guiando meu andar em teus caminhos, para que meus passos não tropecem.
verses.RVR09: Sustenta mis pasos en tus caminos, porque mis pies no resbalen.

verses.KJV: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
verses.WEB: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
verses.ASV: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, [and] hear my speech.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu clamo a ti, ó Deus, porque tu me respondes; inclina teus ouvidos a mim, escuta a minha palavra.
verses.RVR09: Yo te he invocado, por cuanto tú me oirás, oh Dios: inclina á mí tu oído, escucha mi palabra.

verses.KJV: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
verses.WEB: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
verses.ASV: Show thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that take refuge [in thee] From those that rise up [against them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Revela maravilhosamente tuas misericórdias, tu salvas aos que confiam [em ti] com tua mão direita daqueles se se levantam contra [ti] .
verses.RVR09: Muestra tus estupendas misericordias, tú que salvas á los que en ti confían de los que se levantan contra tu diestra.

verses.KJV: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.WEB: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
verses.ASV: Keep me as the apple of the eye; Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda-me como a pupila do olho; esconde-me debaixo da sombra de tuas asas,
verses.RVR09: Guárdame como lo negro de la niñeta del ojo, escóndeme con la sombra de tus alas,

verses.KJV: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
verses.WEB: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
verses.ASV: From the wicked that oppress me, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.
verses.ALMEIDA: De diante dos perversos que me oprimem; dos meus mortais inimigos que me cercam.
verses.RVR09: De delante de los malos que me oprimen, de mis enemigos que me cercan por la vida.

verses.KJV: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.WEB: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.ASV: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se enchem de gordura; com sua boca falam arrogantemente.
verses.RVR09: Cerrados están con su grosura; con su boca hablan soberbiamente.

verses.KJV: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
verses.WEB: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
verses.ASV: They have now compassed us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast [us] down to the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora eles têm nos cercado em nossos passos; eles fixam seus olhos para [nos] derrubar ao chão.
verses.RVR09: Nuestros pasos nos han cercado ahora: puestos tienen sus ojos para echarnos por tierra.

verses.KJV: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.WEB: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.ASV: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Semelhantes ao leão, que deseja nos despedaçar, e ao leãozinho, que fica em esconderijos.
verses.RVR09: Parecen al león que desea hacer presa, y al leoncillo que está escondido.

verses.KJV: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
verses.WEB: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,
verses.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah, Confront him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked by thy sword;
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, SENHOR, confronta-o, derruba-o; livra minha alma d [as mãos] do perverso com tua espada.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, oh Jehová; prevén su encuentro, póstrale: libra mi alma del malo con tu espada;

verses.KJV: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
verses.WEB: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
verses.ASV: From men by thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, whose portion is in [this] life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy treasure: They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos homens com tua mão, SENHOR, dos homens que são do mundo, cuja parte está n [esta] vida, cujo ventre enches de teu secreto [tesouro] ; os filhos se fartam, e deixam sua sobra para suas crianças.
verses.RVR09: De los hombres con tu mano, oh Jehová, de los hombres de mundo, cuya parte es en esta vida, y cuyo vientre hinches de tu tesoro: hartan sus hijos, y dejan el resto á sus chiquitos.

verses.KJV: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
verses.WEB: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
verses.ASV: As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with [beholding] thy form.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] eu olharei para teu rosto em justiça; serei satisfeito de tua semelhança, quando eu despertar.
verses.RVR09: Yo en justicia veré tu rostro: seré saciado cuando despertare á tu semejanza.

verses.KJV: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, LORD, my strength.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David the servant of Jehovah, who spake unto Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: and he said, I love thee, O Jehovah, my strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para o regente. Do servo do SENHOR, chamado Davi, o qual falou as palavras deste cântico ao SENHOR, no dia em que o SENHOR o livrou das mãos de todos os seus inimigos, e das mãos de Saul. Ele disse: Eu te amarei, SENHOR, [tu és] minha força.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David, siervo de Jehová, el cual profirió á Jehová las palabras de este cántico el día que le libró Jehová de mano de todos sus enemigos, y de mano de Saúl. Entonces dijo: AMARTE he, oh Jehová, fortaleza mía.

verses.KJV: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.WEB: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in whom I will take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é minha rocha, e minha fortaleza, e meu libertador, meu Deus, meu rochedo, em quem confio; [é] meu escudo, e a força da minha salvação, meu alto refúgio.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, roca mía y castillo mío, y mi libertador; Dios mío, fuerte mío, en él confiaré; escudo mío, y el cuerno de mi salud, mi refugio.

verses.KJV: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.WEB: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
verses.ASV: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu clamei ao SENHOR digno de louvor; e fiquei livre de meus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Invocaré á Jehová, digno de ser alabado, y seré salvo de mis enemigos.

verses.KJV: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.WEB: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.ASV: The cords of death compassed me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cordas de morte me cercaram; e riachos de maldade me encheram de medo.
verses.RVR09: Cercáronme dolores de muerte, y torrentes de perversidad me atemorizaron.

verses.KJV: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.WEB: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
verses.ASV: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cordas do Xeol me envolveram; laços de morte me afrontaram.
verses.RVR09: Dolores del sepulcro me rodearon, previniéronme lazos de muerte.

verses.KJV: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
verses.WEB: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
verses.ASV: In my distress I called upon Jehovah, And cried unto my God: He heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry before him came into his ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em minha angústia, clamei ao SENHOR, e roguei a meu Deus; desde o seu Templo ele ouviu a minha voz; e o meu clamor diante de seu rosto chegou aos ouvidos dele.
verses.RVR09: En mi angustia invoqué á Jehová, y clamé á mi Dios: él oyó mi voz desde su templo, y mi clamor llegó delante de él, á sus oídos.

verses.KJV: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.WEB: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
verses.ASV: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the mountains quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a terra de abalou e tremeu; e os fundamentos dos montes de moveram e foram abalados, porque ele se irritou.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra fué conmovida y tembló; y moviéronse los fundamentos de los montes, y se estremecieron, porque se indignó él.

verses.KJV: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.WEB: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
verses.ASV: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fumaça subiu de seu nariz, e fogo consumidor saiu de sua boca; carvões foram acesos por ele.
