verses.RVR09: Humo subió de su nariz, y de su boca consumidor fuego; carbones fueron por él encendidos.

verses.KJV: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
verses.WEB: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.ASV: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele moveu os céus, e desceu; e as trevas [estavam] debaixo de seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Y bajó los cielos, y descendió; y oscuridad debajo de sus pies.

verses.KJV: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.WEB: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
verses.ASV: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he soared upon the wings of the wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele montou sobre um querubim, e fez seu voo; e voou veloz sobre as assas do vento.
verses.RVR09: Y cabalgó sobre un querubín, y voló: voló sobre las alas del viento.

verses.KJV: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.WEB: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
verses.ASV: He made darkness his hiding-place, his pavilion round about him, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele pôs as trevas como seu esconderijo; pôs a sua tenda ao redor dele; trevas das águas, nuvens dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Puso tinieblas por escondedero suyo, su pabellón en derredor de sí; oscuridad de aguas, nubes de los cielos.

verses.KJV: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.WEB: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.ASV: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, Hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do brilho de sua presença suas nuvens se espalharam, [e também] a saraiva, e as brasas de fogo.
verses.RVR09: Por el resplandor delante de él, sus nubes pasaron; granizo y carbones ardientes.

verses.KJV: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.WEB: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.ASV: Jehovah also thundered in the heavens, And the Most High uttered his voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR trovejou nos céus; e o Altíssimo soltou sua voz; saraiva e brasas de fogo [caíram] .
verses.RVR09: Y tronó en los cielos Jehová, y el Altísimo dió su voz; granizo y carbones de fuego.

verses.KJV: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.WEB: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.
verses.ASV: And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yea, lightnings manifold, and discomfited them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele mandou suas flechas, e os dispersou; e [lançou] muitos raios, e os perturbou.
verses.RVR09: Y envió sus saetas, y desbaratólos; y echó relámpagos, y los destruyó.

verses.KJV: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.WEB: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
verses.ASV: Then the channels of waters appeared, And the foundations of the world were laid bare, At thy rebuke, O Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as profundezas das águas foram vistas, e os fundamentos do mundo foram descobertos por tua repreensão, SENHOR, pelo sopro do vento do teu nariz.
verses.RVR09: Y aparecieron las honduras de las aguas, y descubriéronse los cimientos del mundo, á tu reprensión, oh Jehová, por el soplo del viento de tu nariz.

verses.KJV: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.WEB: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
verses.ASV: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o alto ele enviou, [e] me tomou; tirou-me de muitas águas.
verses.RVR09: Envió desde lo alto; tomóme, sacóme de las muchas aguas.

verses.KJV: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.WEB: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
verses.ASV: He delivered me from my strong enemy, And from them that hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me livrou do meu forte inimigo, e daqueles que me odeiam; porque eles eram mais poderosos do que eu.
verses.RVR09: Libróme de mi poderoso enemigo, y de los que me aborrecían, aunque eran ellos más fuertes que yo.

verses.KJV: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.
verses.WEB: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
verses.ASV: They came upon me in the day of my calamity; But Jehovah was my stay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles me confrontaram no dia de minha calamidade; mas o SENHOR ficou junto de mim.
verses.RVR09: Asaltáronme en el día de mi quebranto: mas Jehová fué mi apoyo.

verses.KJV: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.WEB: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.ASV: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me tirou para um lugar amplo; ele me libertou, porque se agradou de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y sacóme á anchura: libróme, porque se agradó de mí.

verses.KJV: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.WEB: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR me recompensou conforme a minha justiça; conforme a pureza das minhas mãos ele me retribuiu.
verses.RVR09: Hame pagado Jehová conforme á mi justicia: conforme á la limpieza de mis manos me ha vuelto.

verses.KJV: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.WEB: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.ASV: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu guardei os caminhos do SENHOR; nem me [afastei] do meu Deus praticando o mal.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo he guardado los caminos de Jehová, y no me aparté impíamente de mi Dios.

verses.KJV: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.WEB: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
verses.ASV: For all his ordinances were before me, And I put not away his statutes from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todos os juízos dele estavam diante de mim; e não rejeitei seus estatutos para mim.
verses.RVR09: Pues todos sus juicios estuvieron delante de mí, y no eché de mí sus estatutos.

verses.KJV: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.WEB: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.ASV: I was also perfect with him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu fui fiel com ele; e tomei cuidado contra minha maldade.
verses.RVR09: Y fuí íntegro para con él, y cauteléme de mi maldad.

verses.KJV: Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.ASV: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim o SENHOR me recompensou conforme a minha justiça; conforme a pureza de minhas mãos perante seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Pagóme pues Jehová conforme á mi justicia; conforme á la limpieza de mis manos delante de sus ojos.

verses.KJV: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
verses.WEB: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
verses.ASV: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o bondoso tu te mostras bondoso; [e] com o homem fiel tu te mostras fiel.
verses.RVR09: Con el misericordioso te mostrarás misericordioso, y recto para con el hombre íntegro.

verses.KJV: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
verses.WEB: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
verses.ASV: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o puro tu te mostras puro; mas com o perverso tu te mostras agressivo.
verses.RVR09: Limpio te mostrarás para con el limpio, y severo serás para con el perverso.

verses.KJV: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.WEB: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
verses.ASV: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; But the haughty eyes thou wilt bring down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu livras ao povo aflito, e humilhas aos olhos que se exaltam.
verses.RVR09: Y tú salvarás al pueblo humilde, y humillarás los ojos altivos.

verses.KJV: For thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.WEB: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.
verses.ASV: For thou wilt light my lamp: Jehovah my God will lighten my darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu acendes minha lâmpada; o SENHOR meu Deus ilumina as minhas trevas.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues alumbrarás mi lámpara: Jehová mi Dios alumbrará mis tinieblas.

verses.KJV: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.WEB: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
verses.ASV: For by thee I run upon a troop; And by my God do I leap over a wall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque contigo eu marcho [contra] um exército; e com meu Deus eu salto um muro.
verses.RVR09: Porque contigo desharé ejércitos; y con mi Dios asaltaré muros.

verses.KJV: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.WEB: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
verses.ASV: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho de Deus é perfeito; a palavra do SENHOR é refinada; ele [é] escudo para todos os que nele confiam.
verses.RVR09: Dios, perfecto su camino: es acendrada la palabra de Jehová: escudo es á todos los que en él esperan.

verses.KJV: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?
verses.WEB: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,
verses.ASV: For who is God, save Jehovah? And who is a rock, besides our God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quem é Deus, a não ser o SENHOR? E quem é rocha, a não ser o nosso Deus?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué Dios hay fuera de Jehová? ¿y qué fuerte fuera de nuestro Dios?

verses.KJV: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
verses.WEB: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
verses.ASV: The God that girdeth me with strength, And maketh my way perfect?
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus [é] o que me veste de força; e o que dá perfeição ao meu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Dios es el que me ciñe de fuerza, é hizo perfecto mi camino;

verses.KJV: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.WEB: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
verses.ASV: He maketh my feet like hinds’ [feet]: And setteth me upon my high places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele faz meus pés como o das cervas; e me põe em meus lugares altos.
verses.RVR09: Quien pone mis pies como pies de ciervas, é hízome estar sobre mis alturas;

verses.KJV: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.WEB: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
verses.ASV: He teacheth my hands to war; So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele ensina minhas mãos para a guerra, [de modo que] um arco de bronze se quebra em meus braços.
verses.RVR09: Quien enseña mis manos para la batalla, y será quebrado con mis brazos el arco de acero.

verses.KJV: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.WEB: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.ASV: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation; And thy right hand hath holden me up, And thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também tu me deste o escudo de tua salvação, e tua mão direita me sustentou; e tua mansidão me engrandeceu.
verses.RVR09: Dísteme asimismo el escudo de tu salud: y tu diestra me sustentó, y tu benignidad me ha acrecentado.

verses.KJV: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.WEB: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
verses.ASV: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu alargaste os meus passos abaixo de mim; e meus pés não vacilaram.
verses.RVR09: Ensanchaste mis pasos debajo de mí, y no titubearon mis rodillas.

verses.KJV: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.WEB: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
verses.ASV: I will pursue mine enemies, and overtake them; Neither will I turn again till they are consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Persegui a meus inimigos, e eu os alcancei; e não voltei até os exterminá-los.
verses.RVR09: Perseguido he mis enemigos, y alcancélos, y no volví hasta acabarlos.

verses.KJV: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.WEB: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
verses.ASV: I will smite them through, so that they shall not be able to rise: They shall fall under my feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu os perfurei, que não puderam mais se levantar; caíram debaixo dos meus pés.
verses.RVR09: Helos herido, y no podrán levantarse: cayeron debajo de mis pies.

verses.KJV: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.WEB: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.ASV: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu me preparaste com força para a batalha; fizeste se curvarem abaixo de mim aqueles que contra mim tinham se levantado.
verses.RVR09: Pues me ceñiste de fortaleza para la pelea; has agobiado mis enemigos debajo de mí.

verses.KJV: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.WEB: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
verses.ASV: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu me deste a nuca de meus inimigos; destruí aos que me odiavam.
verses.RVR09: Y dísteme la cerviz de mis enemigos, y destruí á los que me aborrecían.

verses.KJV: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.
verses.WEB: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
verses.ASV: They cried, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles clamaram, mas não havia quem os livrasse; [clamaram até] ao SENHOR, mas ele não lhes respondeu.
verses.RVR09: Clamaron, y no hubo quien salvase: aun á Jehová, mas no los oyó.

verses.KJV: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.WEB: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
verses.ASV: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu os reduzi a pó, como a poeira ao vento; eu os joguei fora como a lama das ruas.
verses.RVR09: Y molílos como polvo delante del viento; esparcílos como lodo de las calles.

verses.KJV: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.WEB: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.ASV: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; Thou hast made me the head of the nations: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me livraste das brigas do povo; tu me puseste como cabeça das nações; o povo que eu não conhecia me serviu.
verses.RVR09: Librásteme de contiendas de pueblo: pusísteme por cabecera de gentes: pueblo que yo no conocía, me sirvió.

verses.KJV: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.WEB: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
verses.ASV: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me; The foreigners shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao [me] ouvirem, [logo] me obedeceram; estrangeiros se sujeitaram a mim.
verses.RVR09: Así que hubo oído, me obedeció; los hijos de extraños me mintieron;

verses.KJV: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.WEB: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
verses.ASV: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estrangeiros se enfraqueceram; e tremeram de medo desde suas extremidades.
verses.RVR09: Los extraños flaquearon, y tuvieron miedo desde sus encerramientos.

verses.KJV: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.WEB: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
verses.ASV: Jehovah liveth; and blessed be my rock; And exalted be the God of my salvation,
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR vive, e bendito [seja] minha rocha; e exaltado [seja] o Deus de minha salvação;
verses.RVR09: Viva Jehová, y sea bendita mi roca; y ensalzado sea el Dios de mi salud:

verses.KJV: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.WEB: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
verses.ASV: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And subdueth peoples under me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus que dá minha vingança, e sujeita aos povos debaixo de mim;
verses.RVR09: El Dios que me da las venganzas, y sujetó pueblos á mí.

verses.KJV: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.WEB: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
verses.ASV: He rescueth me from mine enemies; Yea, thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que me livra dos meus inimigos; tu também me exaltas sobre aqueles que se levantam contra mim; tu me livras do homem violento.
verses.RVR09: Mi libertador de mis enemigos: hicísteme también superior de mis adversarios; librásteme de varón violento.

verses.KJV: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
verses.ASV: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the nations, And will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, SENHOR, eu te louvarei entre as nações, e cantarei ao teu Nome;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto yo te confesaré entre las gentes, oh Jehová, y cantaré á tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.WEB: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
verses.ASV: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que faz grandes as salvações de seu Rei, e pratica a bondade para com o seu ungido, com Davi, e sua semente, para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El cual engrandece las saludes de su rey, y hace misericordia á su ungido, á David y á su simiente, para siempre.

verses.KJV: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Os céus declaram a glória de Deus; e o firmamento anuncia a obra de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. LOS cielos cuentan la gloria de Dios, y la expansión denuncia la obra de sus manos.

verses.KJV: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.WEB: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
verses.ASV: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night showeth knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dia após dia ele fala; e noite após noite ele mostra sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: El un día emite palabra al otro día, y la una noche á la otra noche declara sabiduría.

verses.KJV: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.WEB: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
verses.ASV: There is no speech nor language; Their voice is not heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há língua, nem palavras, onde não se ouça a voz deles.
verses.RVR09: No hay dicho, ni palabras, ni es oída su voz.

verses.KJV: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.WEB: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
verses.ASV: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por toda a terra sai sua corda, e suas palavras até o fim do mundo; para o sol ele pôs uma tenda neles.
verses.RVR09: Por toda la tierra salió su hilo, y al cabo del mundo sus palabras. En ellos puso tabernáculo para el sol.

verses.KJV: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.WEB: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
verses.ASV: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele [é] como o noivo, que sai de sua câmara; [e] se alegra como um homem valente, para correr [seu] caminho.
verses.RVR09: Y él, como un novio que sale de su tálamo, alégrase cual gigante para correr el camino.

verses.KJV: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.WEB: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
verses.ASV: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde uma extremidade dos céus [é] sua saída, e seu curso até as [outras] extremidades deles; e nada se esconde de seu calor.
verses.RVR09: Del un cabo de los cielos es su salida, y su giro hasta la extremidad de ellos: y no hay quien se esconda de su calor.

verses.KJV: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.ASV: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.ALMEIDA: A lei do SENHOR é perfeita, [e] restaura a alma; o testemunho do SENHOR é fiel, [e] da sabedoria aos simples.
verses.RVR09: La ley de Jehová es perfecta, que vuelve el alma: el testimonio de Jehová, fiel, que hace sabio al pequeño.

verses.KJV: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.ASV: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os preceitos do SENHOR são corretos, [e] alegram ao coração; o mandamento do SENHOR é puro, [e] ilumina aos olhos.
verses.RVR09: Los mandamientos de Jehová son rectos, que alegran el corazón: el precepto de Jehová, puro, que alumbra los ojos.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever: The ordinances of Jehovah are true, [and] righteous altogether.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR é limpo, [e] permanece para sempre; os juízos do SENHOR são verdade; juntamente são justos.
verses.RVR09: El temor de Jehová, limpio, que permanece para siempre; los juicios de Jehová son verdad, todos justos.

verses.KJV: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.WEB: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
verses.ASV: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.
verses.ALMEIDA: [São] mais desejáveis que ouro, mais do que muito ouro fino; e mais doces que o mel, e o licor de seus favos.
verses.RVR09: Deseables son más que el oro, y más que mucho oro afinado; y dulces más que miel, y que la que destila del panal.

verses.KJV: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.WEB: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
verses.ASV: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: In keeping them there is great reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também por eles teu servo é advertido; por guardá-los, [há] muita recompensa.
verses.RVR09: Tu siervo es además amonestado con ellos: en guardarlos hay grande galardón.

verses.KJV: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verses.WEB: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
verses.ASV: Who can discern [his] errors? Clear thou me from hidden [faults].
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem pode entender [seus próprios] erros? Limpa-me dos que [me] são ocultos.
verses.RVR09: Los errores, ¿quién los entenderá? Líbrame de los que me son ocultos.

verses.KJV: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.WEB: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
verses.ASV: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins]; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be clear from great transgression.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também retém a teu servo de arrogâncias, para que elas não me controlem; então eu serei sincero, e ficarei limpo de grande transgressão.
verses.RVR09: Detén asimismo á tu siervo de las soberbias; que no se enseñoreen de mí: entonces seré íntegro, y estaré limpio de gran rebelión.

verses.KJV: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.WEB: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
verses.ASV: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam agradáveis as palavras de minha boca, e o pensamento do meu coração, diante de ti, ó SENHOR, minha rocha e meu Libertador.
verses.RVR09: Sean gratos los dichos de mi boca y la meditación de mi corazón delante de ti, oh Jehová, roca mía, y redentor mío.

verses.KJV: The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Que o SENHOR te responda no dia da angústia; o nome do Deus de Jacó te ponha em lugar seguro.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. OIGATE Jehová en el día de conflicto; defiéndate el nombre del Dios de Jacob.

verses.KJV: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.WEB: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
verses.ASV: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que ele envie a ti ajuda desde [seu] santuário; e desde Sião ele te sustenha.
verses.RVR09: Envíete ayuda desde el santuario, y desde Sión te sostenga.

verses.KJV: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.WEB: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
verses.ASV: Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt-sacrifice; [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Que ele se lembre de todas as tuas ofertas, e aceite os teus holocaustos. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Haga memoria de todos tus presentes, y reduzca á ceniza tu holocausto. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.WEB: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
verses.ASV: Grant thee thy heart’s desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que ele de a ti conforme o teu coração, e faça cumprir todo o teu propósito.
verses.RVR09: Déte conforme á tu corazón, y cumpla todo tu consejo.

verses.KJV: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.WEB: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.
verses.ASV: We will triumph in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós alegraremos muito por tua salvação, e no nome do nosso Deus levantaremos bandeiras; que o SENHOR cumpra todos os teus pedidos.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros nos alegraremos por tu salud, y alzaremos pendón en el nombre de nuestro Dios: cumpla Jehová todas tus peticiones.

verses.KJV: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.WEB: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.ASV: Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; He will answer him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora eu sei que o SENHOR salva a seu ungido; desde os céus de sua santidade ele lhe responderá, com o poder salvador de sua mão direita.
verses.RVR09: Ahora echo de ver que Jehová guarda á su ungido: oirálo desde los cielos de su santidad, con la fuerza de la salvación de su diestra.

verses.KJV: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the Lord our God.
verses.WEB: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
verses.ASV: Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Jehovah our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alguns confiam em carruagens, e outros em cavalos; mas nós nos lembraremos do nome do SENHOR nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Estos confían en carros, y aquéllos en caballos: mas nosotros del nombre de Jehová nuestro Dios tendremos memoria.

verses.KJV: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.WEB: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
verses.ASV: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se encurvam, e caem; mas nós nos levantamos, e ficamos em pé.
verses.RVR09: Ellos arrodillaron, y cayeron; mas nosotros nos levantamos, y nos enhestamos.

verses.KJV: Save, Lord: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.WEB: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!
verses.ASV: Save, Jehovah: Let the King answer us when we call.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salva [-nos] ,SENHOR! Que o Rei nos ouça no dia de nosso clamor.
verses.RVR09: Salva, Jehová: que el Rey nos oiga el día que lo invocáremos.

verses.KJV: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Lord; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi para o regente: SENHOR, em tua força o rei se alegra; e como ele fica contente com tua salvação!
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. ALEGRARÁSE el rey en tu fortaleza, oh Jehová; y en tu salud se gozará mucho.

verses.KJV: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.WEB: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.ASV: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu lhe deste o desejo de seu coração; e tu não negaste o pedido de seus lábios. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: El deseo de su corazón le diste, y no le negaste lo que sus labios pronunciaron. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.WEB: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
verses.ASV: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu foste até ele com bênçãos de bens; tu puseste na cabeça dele uma coroa de ouro fino.
verses.RVR09: Pues le has salido al encuentro con bendiciones de bien: corona de oro fino has puesto sobre su cabeza.

verses.KJV: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
verses.ASV: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele te pediu vida, [e] tu lhe deste; muitos dias, para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Vida te demandó, y dístele largura de días por siglos y siglos.

verses.KJV: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.WEB: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
verses.ASV: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Grande [é] a honra dele por tua salvação; honra e majestade tu lhe concedeste.
verses.RVR09: Grande es su gloria en tu salud: honra y majestad has puesto sobre él.

verses.KJV: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.WEB: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
verses.ASV: For thou makest him most blessed for ever: Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu o pões em bênçãos para sempre; tu fazes abundante a alegria dele com tua face.
verses.RVR09: Porque lo has bendecido para siempre; llenástelo de alegría con tu rostro.

verses.KJV: For the king trusteth in the Lord, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.WEB: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
verses.ASV: For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o rei confia no SENHOR; e ele nunca se abalará com a bondade do Altíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto el rey confía en Jehová, y en la misericordia del Altísimo, no será conmovido.

verses.KJV: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.WEB: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
verses.ASV: Thy hand will find out all thine enemies; Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua mão alcançará a todos o os teus inimigos; tua mão direita encontrará aos que te odeiam.
verses.RVR09: Alcanzará tu mano á todos tus enemigos; tu diestra alcanzará á los que te aborrecen.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.WEB: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger: Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath, And the fire shall devour them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu os porás como que [num] forno de fogo no tempo [em que se encontrarem] em tua presença; o SENHOR em sua ira os devorará; e fogo os consumirá.
verses.RVR09: Ponerlos has como horno de fuego en el tiempo de tu ira: Jehová los deshará en su furor, y fuego los consumirá.

verses.KJV: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.WEB: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
verses.ASV: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu destruirás o fruto deles de [sobre] a terra; e [também] a semente deles dos filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Su fruto destruirás de la tierra, y su simiente de entre los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.WEB: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
verses.ASV: For they intended evil against thee; They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles quiseram o mal contra ti; planejaram uma cilada, [mas] não tiveram sucesso.
verses.RVR09: Porque trazaron el mal contra ti: fraguaron maquinaciones, mas no prevalecerán.

verses.KJV: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.WEB: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
verses.ASV: For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu os porás em fuga; com [tuas flechas] nas cordas tu lhes apontarás no rosto.
verses.RVR09: Pues tú los pondrás en fuga, cuando aparejares en tus cuerdas las saetas contra sus rostros.

verses.KJV: Be thou exalted, Lord, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.WEB: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
verses.ASV: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exalta-te, SENHOR, em tua força; cantaremos e louvaremos o teu poder.
verses.RVR09: Ensálzate, oh Jehová, con tu fortaleza: cantaremos y alabaremos tu poderío.

verses.KJV: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to Aijeleth hash-Shahar. A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? [Why art thou so] far from helping me, [and from] the words of my groaning?
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi para o regente, como em “cerva da manhã”: Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste? Longe [estás] de meu livramento [e] das palavras de meu gemido.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal, sobre Ajeleth-sahar: Salmo de David. DIOS mío, Dios mío, ¿por qué me has dejado? ¿por qué estás lejos de mi salud, y de las palabras de mi clamor?

verses.KJV: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.WEB: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.ASV: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou answerest not; And in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus meu, eu clamo de dia, e tu não me respondes; também [clamo] de noite, e não tenho sossego.
verses.RVR09: Dios mío, clamo de día, y no oyes; y de noche, y no hay para mí silencio.

verses.KJV: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
verses.WEB: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
verses.ASV: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu és Santo, que habitas [nos] louvores de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Tú empero eres santo, tú que habitas entre las alabanzas de Israel.

verses.KJV: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.WEB: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
verses.ASV: Our fathers trusted in thee: They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos pais confiaram em ti; eles confiaram, e tu os livraste.
verses.RVR09: En ti esperaron nuestros padres: esperaron, y tú los libraste.

verses.KJV: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.WEB: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
verses.ASV: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles clamaram a ti, e escaparam [do perigo] ; eles confiaram em ti, e não foram envergonhados.
verses.RVR09: Clamaron á ti, y fueron librados: esperaron en ti, y no se avergonzaron.

verses.KJV: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.WEB: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
verses.ASV: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu sou um verme, e não um homem; [sou] humilhado pelos homens, e desprezado pelo povo.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo soy gusano, y no hombre; oprobio de los hombres, y desecho del pueblo.

verses.KJV: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
verses.WEB: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
verses.ASV: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying],
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que me veem zombam de mim; abrem os lábios [e] sacodem a cabeça, [dizendo] :
verses.RVR09: Todos los que me ven, escarnecen de mí; estiran los labios, menean la cabeza, diciendo:

verses.KJV: He trusted on the Lord that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.WEB: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
verses.ASV: Commit [thyself] unto Jehovah; let him deliver him: Let him rescue him, seeing he delighteth in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele confiou no “SENHOR”; [agora] que ele o salve e o liberte; pois se agrada nele.
verses.RVR09: Remítese á Jehová, líbrelo; sálvele, puesto que en él se complacía.

verses.KJV: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
verses.WEB: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
verses.ASV: But thou art he that took me out of the womb; Thou didst make me trust [when I was] upon my mother’s breasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu és o que me tiraste do ventre; [e] o que me deu segurança, [estando eu] junto aos seios de minha mãe.
verses.RVR09: Empero tú eres el que me sacó del vientre, el que me haces esperar desde que estaba á los pechos de mi madre.

verses.KJV: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
verses.WEB: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
verses.ASV: I was cast upon thee from the womb; Thou art my God since my mother bare me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu fui lançado sobre ti desde [que saí d] o útero; desde o ventre de minha mãe tu [és] meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Sobre ti fuí echado desde la matriz: desde el vientre de mi madre, tú eres mi Dios.

verses.KJV: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.WEB: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
verses.ASV: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; For there is none to help.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não fiques longe de mim, porque a minha angústia está perto; pois não há quem [me] ajude.
verses.RVR09: No te alejes de mí, porque la angustia está cerca; porque no hay quien ayude.

verses.KJV: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.WEB: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
verses.ASV: Many bulls have compassed me; Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos touros me cercaram; fortes de Basã me rodearam.
verses.RVR09: Hanme rodeado muchos toros; fuertes toros de Basán me han cercado.

verses.KJV: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.WEB: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
verses.ASV: They gape upon me with their mouth, [As] a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abriram contra mim suas bocas, [como] leão que despedaça e ruge.
verses.RVR09: Abrieron sobre mí su boca, como león rapante y rugiente.

verses.KJV: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.WEB: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
verses.ASV: I am poured out like water, And all my bones are out of joint: My heart is like wax; It is melted within me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me derramei como água, e todos os meus ossos se soltaram uns dos outros; meu coração é como cera, [e] se derreteu por entre meus órgãos.
verses.RVR09: Heme escurrido como aguas, y todos mis huesos se descoyuntaron: mi corazón fué como cera, desliéndose en medio de mis entrañas.

verses.KJV: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.WEB: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
verses.ASV: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha força se secou como um caco de barro, e minha língua está grudada no céu da boca; e tu me pões no pó da morte;
verses.RVR09: Secóse como un tiesto mi vigor, y mi lengua se pegó á mi paladar; y me has puesto en el polvo de la muerte.

verses.KJV: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.WEB: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
verses.ASV: For dogs have compassed me: A company of evil-doers have inclosed me; They pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque cães ficaram ao meu redor; uma multidão de malfeitores me cercou; perfuraram minhas mãos e meus pés.
verses.RVR09: Porque perros me han rodeado, hame cercado cuadrilla de malignos: horadaron mis manos y mis pies.

verses.KJV: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
verses.WEB: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
verses.ASV: I may count all my bones. They look and stare upon me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu poderia contar todos os meus ossos; eles estão [me] olhando, e prestando atenção em mim.
verses.RVR09: Contar puedo todos mis huesos; ellos miran, considéranme.

verses.KJV: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.WEB: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
verses.ASV: They part my garments among them, And upon my vesture do they cast lots.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles repartem entre si minhas roupas; e sobre minha vestimenta eles lançam sortes.
verses.RVR09: Partieron entre sí mis vestidos, y sobre mi ropa echaron suertes.

verses.KJV: But be not thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
verses.WEB: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
verses.ASV: But be not thou far off, O Jehovah: O thou my succor, haste thee to help me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, SENHOR, não fiques longe; força minha, apressa-te para me socorrer.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Jehová, no te alejes; fortaleza mía, apresúrate para mi ayuda.

verses.KJV: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.WEB: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
verses.ASV: Deliver my soul from the sword, My darling from the power of the dog.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra minha alma da espada; [e] minha vida da violência do cão.
verses.RVR09: Libra de la espada mi alma; del poder del perro mi única.

verses.KJV: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.WEB: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
verses.ASV: Save me from the lion’s mouth; Yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen thou hast answered me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salva-me da boca do leão; e responde-me dos chifres dos touros selvagens.
verses.RVR09: Sálvame de la boca del león, y óyeme librándome de los cuernos de los unicornios.

verses.KJV: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.WEB: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
verses.ASV: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: In the midst of the assembly will I praise thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] eu contarei teu nome a meus irmãos; no meio da congregação eu te louvarei.
verses.RVR09: Anunciaré tu nombre á mis hermanos: en medio de la congregación te alabaré.

verses.KJV: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
verses.WEB: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
verses.ASV: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; And stand in awe of him, all ye the seed of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós que temeis ao SENHOR, louvai a ele! E vós, de toda a semente de Jacó, glorificai a ele! Prestai culto a ele, vós de toda a semente de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Los que teméis á Jehová, alabadle; glorificadle, simiente toda de Jacob; y temed de él, vosotros, simiente toda de Israel.

verses.KJV: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.WEB: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
verses.ASV: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Neither hath he hid his face from him; But when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele não desprezou nem abominou a aflição do aflito, nem escondeu seu rosto dele; mas sim, quando [o aflito] clamou, ele [o] ouviu.
verses.RVR09: Porque no menospreció ni abominó la aflicción del pobre, ni de él escondió su rostro; sino que cuando clamó á él, oyóle.

verses.KJV: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.WEB: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
verses.ASV: Of thee cometh my praise in the great assembly: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu louvor será para ti na grande congregação; eu pagarei meus juramentos perante os que o temem.
verses.RVR09: De ti será mi alabanza en la grande congregación; mis votos pagaré delante de los que le temen.

verses.KJV: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the Lord that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.WEB: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
verses.ASV: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; They shall praise Jehovah that seek after him: Let your heart live for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os humilhados comerão, e ficarão fartos; louvarão ao SENHOR aqueles que o buscam; vosso coração viverá para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Comerán los pobres, y serán saciados: alabarán á Jehová los que le buscan: vivirá vuestro corazón para siempre.

verses.KJV: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the Lord: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.WEB: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
verses.ASV: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah; And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os extremos da terra se lembrarão [disso] , e se converterão ao SENHOR; e todas as gerações das nações adorarão diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Acordarse han, y volveránse á Jehová todos los términos de la tierra; y se humillarán delante de ti todas las familias de las gentes.

verses.KJV: For the kingdom is the Lord's: and he is the governor among the nations.
verses.WEB: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
verses.ASV: For the kingdom is Jehovah’s; And he is the ruler over the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o reino [pertence] ao SENHOR; e ele governa sobre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Porque de Jehová es el reino; y él se enseñoreará de las gentes.

verses.KJV: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.WEB: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
verses.ASV: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship: All they that go down to the dust shall bow before him, Even he that cannot keep his soul alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os ricos da terra comerão e adorarão, [e] perante o rosto dele se prostrarão todos os que descem ao pó, e [que] não podem manter viva sua alma.
verses.RVR09: Comerán y adorarán todos los poderosos de la tierra: postraránse delante de él todos los que descienden al polvo, si bien ninguno puede conservar la vida á su propia alma.

verses.KJV: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
verses.WEB: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
verses.ASV: A seed shall serve him; It shall be told of the Lord unto the [next] generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: A descendência o servirá; ela será contada ao Senhor, para a geração [seguinte] .
verses.RVR09: La posteridad le servirá; será ella contada por una generación de Jehová.

verses.KJV: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
verses.WEB: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
verses.ASV: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chegarão, e anunciarão a justiça dele ao povo que nascer, porque ele [assim] fez.
verses.RVR09: Vendrán, y anunciarán al pueblo que naciere, su justicia que él hizo.

verses.KJV: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David. Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: O SENHOR é meu pastor, nada me faltará.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. JEHOVÁ es mi pastor; nada me faltará.

verses.KJV: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.WEB: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
verses.ASV: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me faz deitar em pastos verdes, [e] me leva a águas quietas.
verses.RVR09: En lugares de delicados pastos me hará yacer: junto á aguas de reposo me pastoreará.

verses.KJV: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.WEB: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.ASV: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele restaura minha alma, [e] me guia pelos caminhos da justiça por seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Confortará mi alma; guiaráme por sendas de justicia por amor de su nombre.

verses.KJV: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.WEB: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.ASV: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que eu venha a andar pelo vale da sombra da morte, não temerei mal algum, porque tu estás comigo; tua vara e teu cajado me consolam.
verses.RVR09: Aunque ande en valle de sombra de muerte, no temeré mal alguno; porque tú estarás conmigo: tu vara y tu cayado me infundirán aliento.

verses.KJV: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.WEB: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
verses.ASV: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu preparas uma mesa diante de mim à vista de meus adversários; unges a minha cabeça com azeite, meu cálice transborda.
verses.RVR09: Aderezarás mesa delante de mí, en presencia de mis angustiadores: ungiste mi cabeza con aceite: mi copa está rebosando.

verses.KJV: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.
verses.WEB: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
verses.ASV: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente o bem e a bondade me seguirão todos os dias de minha vida; e habitarei na casa do SENHOR por muitos e muitos dias.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente el bien y la misericordia me seguirán todos los días de mi vida: y en la casa de Jehová moraré por largos días.

verses.KJV: The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David. The earth is Jehovah’s, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Ao SENHOR [pertence] a terra, e sua plenitude; o mundo, e os que nele habitam.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. DE Jehová es la tierra y su plenitud; el mundo, y los que en él habitan.

verses.KJV: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.WEB: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
verses.ASV: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele a fundou sobre os mares; e sobre os rios ele a firmou.
verses.RVR09: Porque él la fundó sobre los mares, y afirmóla sobre los ríos.

verses.KJV: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.WEB: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
verses.ASV: Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem subirá ao monte do SENHOR? E quem ficará de pé no lugar de sua santidade?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién subirá al monte de Jehová? ¿y quién estará en el lugar de su santidad?

verses.KJV: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.WEB: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
verses.ASV: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que é limpo de mãos, e puro de coração, que não entrega sua alma para as coisas vãs, nem jura enganosamente.
verses.RVR09: El limpio de manos, y puro de corazón: el que no ha elevado su alma á la vanidad, ni jurado con engaño.

verses.KJV: He shall receive the blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.WEB: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.ASV: He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este receberá a bênção do SENHOR, e a justiça do Deus de sua salvação.
verses.RVR09: El recibirá bendición de Jehová, y justicia del Dios de salud.

verses.KJV: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
verses.WEB: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
verses.ASV: This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, [even] Jacob. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a geração dos que o buscam, dos que procuram a tua face: [a geração de] Jacó. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Tal es la generación de los que le buscan, de los que buscan tu rostro, oh Dios de Jacob. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.WEB: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.ASV: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai, portas, vossas cabeças; e levantai-vos vós, entradas eternas; para que entre o Rei da Glória.
verses.RVR09: Alzad, oh puertas, vuestras cabezas, y alzaos vosotras, puertas eternas, y entrará el Rey de gloria.

verses.KJV: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.
verses.WEB: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.ASV: Who is the King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é o Rei da Glória? O SENHOR forte e poderoso, o SENHOR poderoso na guerra.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es este Rey de gloria? Jehová el fuerte y valiente, Jehová el poderoso en batalla.

verses.KJV: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.WEB: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.ASV: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai, portas, vossas cabeças; e levantai-vos vós, entradas eternas; para que entre o Rei da Glória.
verses.RVR09: Alzad, oh puertas, vuestras cabezas, y alzaos vosotras, puertas eternas, y entrará el Rey de gloria.

verses.KJV: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.WEB: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
verses.ASV: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, He is the King of glory. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é este Rei da Glória? O SENHOR dos exércitos; ele é o Rei da Glória! (Selá)
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es este Rey de gloria? Jehová de los ejércitos, él es el Rey de la gloria. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.WEB: By David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: A ti, SENHOR, levanto minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. A TI, oh Jehová, levantaré mi alma.

verses.KJV: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.WEB: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.ASV: O my God, in thee have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu Deus, eu confio em ti; não me deixes envergonhado, nem que meus inimigos se alegrem por me [vencerem] .
verses.RVR09: Dios mío, en ti confío; no sea yo avergonzado, no se alegren de mí mis enemigos.

verses.KJV: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.WEB: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
verses.ASV: Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame: They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente todos os que esperam em ti, nenhum será envergonhado; envergonhados serão os que traem sem motivo.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente ninguno de cuantos en ti esperan será confundido: serán avergonzados los que se rebelan sin causa.

verses.KJV: Shew me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.
verses.WEB: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
verses.ASV: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me fazes conhecer os teus caminhos; ensina-me teus lugares onde se deve andar.
verses.RVR09: Muéstrame, oh Jehová, tus caminos; enséñame tus sendas.

verses.KJV: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.WEB: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
verses.ASV: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guia-me em tua verdade, e ensina-me; porque tu és o Deus de minha salvação; eu espero por ti o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Encamíname en tu verdad, y enséñame; porque tú eres el Dios de mi salud: en ti he esperado todo el día.

verses.KJV: Remember, O Lord, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.WEB: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
verses.ASV: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te, SENHOR, de tuas misericórdias e de tuas bondades; porque elas são desde a eternidade.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate, oh Jehová, de tus conmiseraciones y de tus misericordias, que son perpetuas.

verses.KJV: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O Lord.
verses.WEB: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.
verses.ASV: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me, For thy goodness’ sake, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te lembres dos pecados de minha juventude e das minhas transgressões; [mas sim] , conforme tua misericórdia, lembra-te de mim por tua bondade, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: De los pecados de mi mocedad, y de mis rebeliones, no te acuerdes; conforme á tu misericordia acuérdate de mí, por tu bondad, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.WEB: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
verses.ASV: Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é bom e correto; por isso ele ensinará o caminho aos pecadores.
verses.RVR09: Bueno y recto es Jehová: por tanto él enseñará á los pecadores el camino.

verses.KJV: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.WEB: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
verses.ASV: The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele guiará os humildes ao [bom] juízo; e ensinará aos humildes seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Encaminará á los humildes por el juicio, y enseñará á los mansos su carrera.

verses.KJV: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.WEB: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.ASV: All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os caminhos do SENHOR são bondade e verdade, para aqueles que guardam seu pacto e seus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Todas las sendas de Jehová son misericordia y verdad, para los que guardan su pacto y sus testimonios.

verses.KJV: For thy name's sake, O Lord, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
verses.WEB: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.ASV: For thy name’s sake, O Jehovah, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo teu nome, SENHOR, perdoa a minha maldade, porque ela é grande.
verses.RVR09: Por amor de tu nombre, oh Jehová, perdonarás también mi pecado; porque es grande.

verses.KJV: What man is he that feareth the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.WEB: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
verses.ASV: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qual é o homem que teme ao SENHOR? Ele lhe ensinará o caminho [que] deve escolher.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es el hombre que teme á Jehová? El le enseñará el camino que ha de escoger.

verses.KJV: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.WEB: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
verses.ASV: His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua alma habitará no bem; e sua semente [isto é, sua descendência] possuirá a terra em herança.
verses.RVR09: Su alma reposará en el bien, y su simiente heredará la tierra.

verses.KJV: The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.WEB: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
verses.ASV: The friendship of Jehovah is with them that fear him; And he will show them his covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: O segredo do SENHOR é para os que o temem; e ele lhes faz conhecer seu pacto.
verses.RVR09: El secreto de Jehová es para los que le temen; y á ellos hará conocer su alianza.

verses.KJV: Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.WEB: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.ASV: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; For he will pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos [estão] continuamente [voltados] para o SENHOR, porque ele tirará meus pés da rede de caça.
verses.RVR09: Mis ojos están siempre hacia Jehová; porque él sacará mis pies de la red.

verses.KJV: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.WEB: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.ASV: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha para mim, e mim, e tem piedade de mim, porque eu estou solitário e miserável.
verses.RVR09: Mírame, y ten misericordia de mí; porque estoy solo y afligido.

verses.KJV: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.WEB: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
verses.ASV: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.ALMEIDA: As aflições de meu coração têm se multiplicado; tira-me de minhas angústias.
verses.RVR09: Las angustias de mi corazón se han aumentado: sácame de mis congojas.

verses.KJV: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.WEB: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
verses.ASV: Consider mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Presta atenção para minha miséria e meu cansativo trabalho; e tira todos os meus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Mira mi aflicción y mi trabajo: y perdona todos mis pecados.

verses.KJV: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.WEB: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.ASV: Consider mine enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Presta atenção a meus inimigos, porque eles estão se multiplicando; eles me odeiam com ódio violento.
verses.RVR09: Mira mis enemigos, que se han multiplicado, y con odio violento me aborrecen.

verses.KJV: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.WEB: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
verses.ASV: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda minha alma, e livra-me; não me deixes envergonhado, porque eu confio em ti.
verses.RVR09: Guarda mi alma, y líbrame: no sea yo avergonzado, porque en ti confié.

verses.KJV: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.WEB: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
verses.ASV: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Integridade e justiça me guardem, porque eu espero em ti.
verses.RVR09: Integridad y rectitud me guarden; porque en ti he esperado.

verses.KJV: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.WEB: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
verses.ASV: Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all his troubles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Deus, resgata Israel de todas as suas angústias.
verses.RVR09: Redime, oh Dios, á Israel de todas sus angustias.

verses.KJV: Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.
verses.WEB: By David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Faze-me justiça, SENHOR, pois eu ando em minha sinceridade; e eu confio no SENHOR, não me abalarei.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. JÚZGAME, oh Jehová, porque yo en mi integridad he andado: confiado he asimismo en Jehová, no vacilaré.

verses.KJV: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.WEB: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
verses.ASV: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me; Try my heart and my mind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Prova-me, SENHOR, e testa-me; examina meus sentimentos e meu coração.
verses.RVR09: Pruébame, oh Jehová, y sondéame: examina mis riñones y mi corazón.

verses.KJV: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.WEB: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
verses.ASV: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes; And I have walked in thy truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tua bondade está diante dos meus olhos; e eu ando em tua verdade.
verses.RVR09: Porque tu misericordia está delante de mis ojos, y en tu verdad ando.

verses.KJV: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.WEB: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
verses.ASV: I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me sento com homens vãos, nem converso com desonestos.
verses.RVR09: No me he sentado con hombres de falsedad; ni entré con los que andan encubiertamente.

verses.KJV: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.WEB: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.ASV: I hate the assembly of evil-doers, And will not sit with the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu odeio a reunião dos malfeitores; e não me sento com os perversos.
verses.RVR09: Aborrecí la reunión de los malignos, y con los impíos nunca me senté.

verses.KJV: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O Lord:
verses.WEB: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,
verses.ASV: I will wash my hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Lavo minhas mãos em inocência, e ando ao redor do teu altar, SENHOR;
