verses.RVR09: Lavaré en inocencia mis manos, y andaré alrededor de tu altar, oh Jehová:

verses.KJV: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.WEB: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
verses.ASV: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que eu declare com voz de louvores, e para contar todas as tuas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Para exclamar con voz de acción de gracias, y para contar todas tus maravillas.

verses.KJV: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.WEB: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
verses.ASV: Jehovah, I love the habitation of thy house, And the place where thy glory dwelleth.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, eu amo a morada de tua Casa, e o lugar onde habita a tua glória.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, la habitación de tu casa he amado, y el lugar del tabernáculo de tu gloria.

verses.KJV: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.WEB: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
verses.ASV: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não juntes minha alma com os pecadores, nem minha vida com homens sanguinários;
verses.RVR09: No juntes con los pecadores mi alma, ni con los hombres de sangres mi vida:

verses.KJV: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.WEB: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.ASV: In whose hands is wickedness, And their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nas mãos deles há más intenções; e sua mão direita é cheia de suborno.
verses.RVR09: En cuyas manos está el mal, y su diestra está llena de sobornos.

verses.KJV: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.WEB: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
verses.ASV: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu ando em minha sinceridade; livra-me e tem piedade de mim.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero andaré en mi integridad: redímeme, y ten misericordia de mí.

verses.KJV: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the Lord.
verses.WEB: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
verses.ASV: My foot standeth in an even place: In the congregations will I bless Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu pé está em um caminho plano; louvarei ao SENHOR nas congregações.
verses.RVR09: Mi pie ha estado en rectitud: en las congregaciones bendeciré á Jehová.

verses.KJV: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.WEB: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Jehovah is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: O SENHOR é minha luz e minha salvação; a quem temerei? O SENHOR é a força da minha vida; de quem terei medo?
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. JEHOVÁ es mi luz y mi salvación: ¿de quién temeré? Jehová es la fortaleza de mi vida: ¿de quién he de atemorizarme?

verses.KJV: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
verses.WEB: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
verses.ASV: When evil-doers came upon me to eat up my flesh, [Even] mine adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os maus chegaram perto de mim, meus adversários e meus inimigos contra mim, para devorarem minha carne; eles mesmos tropeçaram e caíram.
verses.RVR09: Cuando se allegaron contra mí los malignos, mis angustiadores y mis enemigos, para comer mis carnes, ellos tropezaron y cayeron.

verses.KJV: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
verses.WEB: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
verses.ASV: Though a host should encamp against me, My heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, Even then will I be confident.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que um exército me cercasse, eu não temeria; ainda que uma guerra se levantasse contra mim, nisto mantenho confiança.
verses.RVR09: Aunque se asiente campo contra mí, no temerá mi corazón: aunque contra mí se levante guerra, yo en esto confío.

verses.KJV: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to enquire in his temple.
verses.WEB: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
verses.ASV: One thing have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after: That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of Jehovah, And to inquire in his temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pedi uma coisa ao SENHOR, [e] a ela buscarei: que eu possa morar na casa do SENHOR todos os dias de minha vida, para ver a beleza do SENHOR, e consultá-lo em seu Templo.
verses.RVR09: Una cosa he demandado á Jehová, ésta buscaré: que esté yo en la casa de Jehová todos los días de mi vida, para contemplar la hermosura de Jehová, y para inquirir en su templo.

verses.KJV: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
verses.WEB: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
verses.ASV: For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion: In the covert of his tabernacle will he hide me; He will lift me up upon a rock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque no dia mal ele me esconderá em seu abrigo; ele me encobrirá no oculto de sua tenda; [e] me porá sobre as rochas.
verses.RVR09: Porque él me esconderá en su tabernáculo en el día del mal; ocultaráme en lo reservado de su pabellón; pondráme en alto sobre una roca.

verses.KJV: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.
verses.WEB: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.
verses.ASV: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me; And I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E minha cabeça será exaltada acima de meus inimigos, que estão ao redor de mim; e eu sacrificarei na tenda dele sacrifícios com alta voz; cantarei e louvarei ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y luego ensalzará mi cabeza sobre mis enemigos en derredor de mí: y yo sacrificaré en su tabernáculo sacrificios de júbilo: cantaré y salmearé á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.WEB: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
verses.ASV: Hear, O Jehovah, when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, SENHOR, minha voz, [quando] eu clamo; tem piedade de mim, e responde-me.
verses.RVR09: Oye, oh Jehová, mi voz con que á ti clamo; y ten misericordia de mí, respóndeme.

verses.KJV: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Lord, will I seek.
verses.WEB: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
verses.ASV: [When thou saidst], Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Jehovah, will I seek.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele diz a ti, meu coração: Buscai a minha face.Eu busco a tua face, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mi corazón ha dicho de ti: Buscad mi rostro. Tu rostro buscaré, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.WEB: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
verses.ASV: Hide not thy face from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não escondas de mim a tua face, nem rejeites a teu servo com ira; tu tens sido meu socorro; não me deixes, nem me desampares, ó Deus de minha salvação.
verses.RVR09: No escondas tu rostro de mí, no apartes con ira á tu siervo: mi ayuda has sido; no me dejes y no me desampares, Dios de mi salud.

verses.KJV: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up.
verses.WEB: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
verses.ASV: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then Jehovah will take me up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque meu pai e minha mãe me abandonaram, mas o SENHOR me recolherá.
verses.RVR09: Aunque mi padre y mi madre me dejaran, Jehová con todo me recogerá.

verses.KJV: Teach me thy way, O Lord, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
verses.WEB: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
verses.ASV: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; And lead me in a plain path, Because of mine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensina-me, SENHOR, o teu caminho; e guia-me pela via correta, por causa dos meus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Enséñame, oh Jehová, tu camino, y guíame por senda de rectitud, á causa de mis enemigos.

verses.KJV: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.WEB: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.ASV: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries: For false witnesses are risen up against me, And such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me entregues à vontade dos meus adversários, porque se levantaram contra mim falsas testemunhas, e também ao que sopra violência.
verses.RVR09: No me entregues á la voluntad de mis enemigos; porque se han levantado contra mí testigos falsos, y los que respiran crueldad.

verses.KJV: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.WEB: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.ASV: [I had fainted], unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu não tivesse crido que veria a bondade do SENHOR na terra dos viventes, [certamente já teria perecido] .
verses.RVR09: Hubiera yo desmayado, si no creyese que tengo de ver la bondad de Jehová en la tierra de los vivientes.

verses.KJV: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the Lord.
verses.WEB: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
verses.ASV: Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Espera no SENHOR, esforça-te, e ele fortalecerá o teu coração; espera pois ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Aguarda á Jehová; esfuérzate, y aliéntese tu corazón: sí, espera á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Unto thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.WEB: By David. To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: A ti, SENHOR, rocha minha, eu clamo; não te silencies para comigo; para que não [aconteça de, se] tu calares quanto a mim, eu não [me torne] semelhante aos que descem à cova.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. A TI clamaré, oh Jehová, fortaleza mía: no te desentiendas de mí; porque no sea yo, dejándome tú, semejante á los que descienden al sepulcro.

verses.KJV: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.WEB: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
verses.ASV: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve a voz de minhas súplicas, quando eu clamar a ti, ao levantar às minhas mãos ao templo de tua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Oye la voz de mis ruegos cuando clamo á ti, cuando alzo mis manos hacia el templo de tu santidad.

verses.KJV: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.WEB: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.ASV: Draw me not away with the wicked, And with the workers of iniquity; That speak peace with their neighbors, But mischief is in their hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me jogues fora com os perversos, nem com os praticantes da maldade, que falam de paz com sem próximo, porém [há] o mal no coração deles.
verses.RVR09: No me arrebates á una con los malos, y con los que hacen iniquidad: los cuales hablan paz con sus prójimos, y la maldad está en su corazón.

verses.KJV: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.WEB: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
verses.ASV: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings: Give them after the operation of their hands; Render to them their desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-lhes conforme as obras deles, e conforme a maldade de seus atos; dá-lhes conforme a obra das mãos deles, retribui-lhes como eles merecem.
verses.RVR09: Dales conforme á su obra, y conforme á la malicia de sus hechos: dales conforme á la obra de sus manos, dales su paga.

verses.KJV: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.WEB: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
verses.ASV: Because they regard not the works of Jehovah, Nor the operation of his hands, He will break them down and not build them up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles não dão atenção para os atos do SENHOR, nem para a obra de suas mãos; [então] ele os derrubará e não os edificará.
verses.RVR09: Porque no atendieron á las obras de Jehová, ni al hecho de sus manos, derribarálos, y no los edificará.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito [seja] o SENHOR, porque ele ouviu a voz de minhas súplicas.
verses.RVR09: Bendito Jehová, que oyó la voz de mis ruegos.

verses.KJV: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.WEB: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR [é] a minha força e meu escudo; meu coração confiou nele, e foi socorrido; por isso meu coração salta de alegria; e com meu canto eu o louvarei.
verses.RVR09: Jehová es mi fortaleza y mi escudo: en él esperó mi corazón, y fuí ayudado; por lo que se gozó mi corazón, y con mi canción le alabaré.

verses.KJV: The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.WEB: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is their strength, And he is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR [é] a força deles, e o poder das salvações de seu Ungido.
verses.RVR09: Jehová es su fuerza, y la fortaleza de las saludes de su ungido.

verses.KJV: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.WEB: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
verses.ASV: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salva a teu povo, e abençoa a tua herança; e apascenta-os, e levanta-os para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Salva á tu pueblo, y bendice á tu heredad; y pastoréalos y ensálzalos para siempre.

verses.KJV: Give unto the Lord, O ye mighty, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David. Ascribe unto Jehovah, O ye sons of the mighty, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Reconhecei ao SENHOR, vós filhos dos poderosos, reconhecei ao SENHOR [sua] glória e força.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. DAD á Jehová, oh hijos de fuertes, dad á Jehová la gloria y la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
verses.WEB: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.
verses.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name; Worship Jehovah in holy array.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reconhecei ao SENHOR a glória de seu nome; adorai ao SENHOR na honra da santidade.
verses.RVR09: Dad á Jehová la gloria debida á su nombre: humillaos á Jehová en el glorioso santuario.

verses.KJV: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord is upon many waters.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.
verses.ASV: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth, Even Jehovah upon many waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: A voz do SEHOR [percorre por] sobre as águas; o Deus da glória troveja; o SENHOR [está] sobre muitas águas.
verses.RVR09: Voz de Jehová sobre las aguas: hizo tronar el Dios de gloria: Jehová sobre las muchas aguas.

verses.KJV: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.
verses.ASV: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.
verses.ALMEIDA: A voz do SENHOR [é] poderosa; a voz do SENHOR [é] gloriosa.
verses.RVR09: Voz de Jehová con potencia; voz de Jehová con gloria.

verses.KJV: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.ASV: The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Yea, Jehovah breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: A voz do SENHOR quebra aos cedros; o SENHOR quebra aos cedros do Líbano.
verses.RVR09: Voz de Jehová que quebranta los cedros; y quebrantó Jehová los cedros del Líbano.

verses.KJV: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.WEB: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
verses.ASV: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele os faz saltar como bezerros; ao Líbano e a Sírion como a filhotes de bois selvagens.
verses.RVR09: E hízolos saltar como becerros; al Líbano y al Sirión como hijos de unicornios.

verses.KJV: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
verses.ASV: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: A voz do SENHOR faz chamas de fogo se separarem.
verses.RVR09: Voz de Jehová que derrama llamas de fuego.

verses.KJV: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.ASV: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: A voz do SENHOR faz tremer o deserto; o SENHOR faz tremer o deserto de Cades.
verses.RVR09: Voz de Jehová que hará temblar el desierto; hará temblar Jehová el desierto de Cades.

verses.KJV: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
verses.ASV: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare: And in his temple everything saith, Glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: A voz do SENHOR faz as cervas terem filhotes, e tira a cobertura das florestas; e em seu templo todos falam de [sua] glória.
verses.RVR09: Voz de Jehová que hará estar de parto á las ciervas, y desnudará las breñas: y en su templo todos los suyos le dicen gloria.

verses.KJV: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.
verses.WEB: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.
verses.ASV: Jehovah sat [as King] at the Flood; Yea, Jehovah sitteth as King for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR se sentou sobre as muitas águas [como dilúvio] ; e o SENHOR se sentará como rei para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Jehová preside en el diluvio, y asentóse Jehová por rey para siempre.

verses.KJV: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.
verses.WEB: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR dará força a seu povo; o SENHOR abençoará a seu povo com paz.
verses.RVR09: Jehová dará fortaleza á su pueblo: Jehová bendecirá á su pueblo en paz.

verses.KJV: I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.WEB: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.ASV: A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House. [A Psalm] of David. I will extol thee, O Jehovah; for thou hast raised me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo e canção de Davi para a dedicação da casa: Eu te exaltarei, SENHOR, porque tu me levantaste, e fizeste com que meus inimigos não se alegrassem por causa de mim.
verses.RVR09: Salmo cantado en la dedicación de la Casa: Salmo de David. GLORIFICARTE he, oh Jehová; porque me has ensalzado, y no hiciste á mis enemigos alegrarse de mí.

verses.KJV: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.WEB: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, meu Deus; eu clamei a ti, e tu me curaste.
verses.RVR09: Jehová Dios mío, á ti clamé, y me sanaste.

verses.KJV: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.WEB: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol; Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, tu levantaste minha alma do Xeol; preservaste-me a vida, para que eu não descesse à sepultura.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, hiciste subir mi alma del sepulcro, dísteme vida, para que no descendiese á la sepultura.

verses.KJV: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.WEB: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
verses.ASV: Sing praise unto Jehovah, O ye saints of his, And give thanks to his holy memorial [name].
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR, vós [que sois] santos dele, [e] celebrai a memória de sua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Jehová, vosotros sus santos, y celebrad la memoria de su santidad.

verses.KJV: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.WEB: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
verses.ASV: For his anger is but for a moment; His favor is for a life-time: Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy [cometh] in the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sua ira [dura por] um momento; mas seu favor [dura por toda a] vida; o choro fica pela noite, mas a alegria [vem] pela manhã.
verses.RVR09: Porque un momento será su furor; mas en su voluntad está la vida: por la tarde durará el lloro, y á la mañana vendrá la alegría.

verses.KJV: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.WEB: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
verses.ASV: As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse em minha boa situação: Nunca serei abalado.
verses.RVR09: Y dije yo en mi prosperidad: no seré jamás conmovido;

verses.KJV: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
verses.WEB: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
verses.ASV: Thou, Jehovah, of thy favor hadst made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, pelo teu favor, tu firmaste minha montanha; [mas quando] tu encobriste o teu rosto, fiquei perturbado.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, Jehová, por tu benevolencia has asentado mi monte con fortaleza. Escondiste tu rostro, fuí conturbado.

verses.KJV: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.
verses.WEB: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:
verses.ASV: I cried to thee, O Jehovah; And unto Jehovah I made supplication:
verses.ALMEIDA: A ti, DEUS, eu clamei; e supliquei ao SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: A ti, oh Jehová, clamaré; y al Señor suplicaré.

verses.KJV: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.WEB: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
verses.ASV: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dizendo] : Que proveito [há] em meu sangue, [ou] em minha descida a cova? Por acaso o pó da terra te louvará, ou anunciará tua fidelidade?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué provecho hay en mi muerte, cuando yo descienda al hoyo? ¿Te alabará el polvo? ¿anunciará tu verdad?

verses.KJV: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.
verses.WEB: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”
verses.ASV: Hear, O Jehovah, and have mercy upon me: Jehovah, be thou my helper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve [-me] , SENHOR, e tem piedade de mim; sê tu, SENHOR, o meu ajudador.
verses.RVR09: Oye, oh Jehová, y ten misericordia de mí: Jehová, sé tú mi ayudador.

verses.KJV: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.WEB: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
verses.ASV: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu tornaste meu pranto em dança; tu desamarraste o meu saco [de lamentação] , e me envolveste de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Has tornado mi endecha en baile; desataste mi saco, y ceñísteme de alegría.

verses.KJV: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.WEB: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
verses.ASV: To the end that [my] glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Jehovah my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso a [minha] glória cantará para ti, e não se calará; SENHOR, Deus meu, para sempre eu te louvarei.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto á ti cantaré, gloria mía, y no estaré callado. Jehová Dios mío, te alabaré para siempre.

verses.KJV: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge; Let me never be put to shame: Deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Eu confio em ti, SENHOR; não me deixes envergonhado para sempre; livra-me por tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. EN ti, oh Jehová, he esperado; no sea yo confundido para siempre: líbrame en tu justicia.

verses.KJV: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.WEB: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
verses.ASV: Bow down thine ear unto me; deliver me speedily: Be thou to me a strong rock, A house of defence to save me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Inclina a mim os teus ouvidos, faze-me escapar depressa [do perigo] ; sê tu por minha rocha firme, por casa fortíssima, para me salvar.
verses.RVR09: Inclina á mí tu oído, líbrame presto; séme por roca de fortaleza, por casa fuerte para salvarme.

verses.KJV: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.WEB: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
verses.ASV: For thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for thy name’s sake lead me and guide me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu [és] minha rocha e minha fortaleza; guia-me e conduz-me por causa do teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú eres mi roca y mi castillo; y por tu nombre me guiarás, y me encaminarás.

verses.KJV: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
verses.WEB: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
verses.ASV: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid privily for me; For thou art my stronghold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tira-me da rede que me prepararam em segredo, pois tu [és] minha força.
verses.RVR09: Me sacarás de la red que han escondido para mí; porque tú eres mi fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.
verses.WEB: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
verses.ASV: Into thy hand I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Jehovah, thou God of truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tuas mãos eu confio meu espírito; tu me resgataste, SENHOR, Deus da verdade.
verses.RVR09: En tu mano encomiendo mi espíritu: tú me has redimido, oh Jehová, Dios de verdad.

verses.KJV: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the Lord.
verses.WEB: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.
verses.ASV: I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Odeio os que dedicam sua atenção a coisas vãs [e] enganosas; porém eu confio no SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Aborrecí á los que esperan en vanidades ilusorias; mas yo en Jehová he esperado.

verses.KJV: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.WEB: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
verses.ASV: I will be glad and rejoice in thy lovingkindness; For thou hast seen my affliction: Thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tua bondade eu me alegrarei e ficarei cheio de alegria, porque tu viste minha situação miserável; tu reconheceste as angústias de minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Me gozaré y alegraré en tu misericordia; porque has visto mi aflicción; has conocido mi alma en las angustias.

verses.KJV: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.WEB: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
verses.ASV: And thou hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a large place.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu não me entregastes nas mãos do [meu] inimigo; tu puseste meus pés num lugar amplo.
verses.RVR09: Y no me encerraste en mano del enemigo; hiciste estar mis pies en anchura.

verses.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
verses.WEB: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
verses.ASV: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah, for I am in distress: Mine eye wasteth away with grief, [yea], my soul and my body.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tem misericórdia de mim, SENHOR, porque eu estou angustiado; meus olhos, minha alma e meu ventre foram consumidos pelo sofrimento.
verses.RVR09: Ten misericordia de mí, oh Jehová, que estoy en angustia: hanse consumido de pesar mis ojos, mi alma, y mis entrañas.

verses.KJV: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.WEB: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
verses.ASV: For my life is spent with sorrow, And my years with sighing: My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, And my bones are wasted away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque minha vida foi destruída pela aflição, e meus anos pelos suspiros; minha força descaiu por minha maldade; e meus ossos se enfraqueceram.
verses.RVR09: Porque mi vida se va gastando de dolor, y mis años de suspirar: hase enflaquecido mi fuerza á causa de mi iniquidad, y mis huesos se han consumido.

verses.KJV: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.WEB: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
verses.ASV: Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, Yea, unto my neighbors exceedingly, And a fear to mine acquaintance: They that did see me without fled from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa de todos os meus adversários eu fui humilhado até entre os meus próximos; e fui feito horrível entre os meus conhecidos; os que me veem na rua fogem de mim.
verses.RVR09: De todos mis enemigos he sido oprobio, y de mis vecinos en gran manera, y horror á mis conocidos: los que me veían fuera, huían de mí.

verses.KJV: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.WEB: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
verses.ASV: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.ALMEIDA: No coração [deles] eu fui esquecido, como se [estivesse] morto; me tornei como um vaso destruído.
verses.RVR09: He sido olvidado de su corazón como un muerto: he venido á ser como un vaso perdido.

verses.KJV: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.WEB: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
verses.ASV: For I have heard the defaming of many, Terror on every side: While they took counsel together against me, They devised to take away my life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ouvi a murmuração de muitos, temor [há] ao redor; juntamente tramam contra mim, planejam como matar minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Porque he oído afrenta de muchos; miedo por todas partes, cuando consultaban juntos contra mí, é ideaban quitarme la vida.

verses.KJV: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.WEB: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
verses.ASV: But I trusted in thee, O Jehovah: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu confio em ti, SENHOR, eu te chamo de meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo en ti confié, oh Jehová: yo dije: Dios mío eres tú.

verses.KJV: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.WEB: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
verses.ASV: My times are in thy hand: Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus tempos estão em tuas mãos; livra-me da mão dos meus inimigos e daqueles que me perseguem.
verses.RVR09: En tu mano están mis tiempos: líbrame de la mano de mis enemigos, y de mis perseguidores.

verses.KJV: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.WEB: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
verses.ASV: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: Save me in thy lovingkindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faz brilhar o teu rosto sobre teu servo; salva-me por tua bondade.
verses.RVR09: Haz resplandecer tu rostro sobre tu siervo: sálvame por tu misericordia.

verses.KJV: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.WEB: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
verses.ASV: Let me not be put to shame, O Jehovah; for I have called upon thee: Let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silent in Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, não me deixes envergonhado, pois eu clamo a ti; que os perversos se envergonhem e se calem no Xeol.
verses.RVR09: No sea yo confundido, oh Jehová, ya que te he invocado; sean corridos los impíos, estén mudos en el profundo.

verses.KJV: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.WEB: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
verses.ASV: Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak against the righteous insolently, With pride and contempt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Emudeçam os lábios mentirosos, que falam coisas duras contra o justo, com arrogância e desprezo.
verses.RVR09: Enmudezcan los labios mentirosos, que hablan contra el justo cosas duras, con soberbia y menosprecio.

verses.KJV: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.WEB: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
verses.ASV: Oh how great is thy goodness, Which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, Which thou hast wrought for them that take refuge in thee, Before the sons of men!
verses.ALMEIDA: Como [é] grade a tua bondade, que guardaste para aqueles que te temem! Tu trabalhaste para os que confiam em ti, na presença dos filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuán grande es tu bien, que has guardado para los que te temen, que has obrado para los que esperan en ti, delante de los hijos de los hombres!

verses.KJV: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.WEB: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
verses.ASV: In the covert of thy presence wilt thou hide them from the plottings of man: Thou wilt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.ALMEIDA: No esconderijo de tua presença tu os escondes das arrogâncias dos homens; em [tua] tenda tu os encobres da rivalidade das línguas.
verses.RVR09: Los esconderás en el secreto de tu rostro de las arrogancias del hombre: los pondrás en un tabernáculo á cubierto de contención de lenguas.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.WEB: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah; For he hath showed me his marvellous lovingkindness in a strong city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito [seja] o SENHOR, pois ele fez maravilhosa sua bondade para comigo, [como] uma cidade segura.
verses.RVR09: Bendito Jehová, porque ha hecho maravillosa su misericordia para conmigo en ciudad fuerte.

verses.KJV: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.WEB: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
verses.ASV: As for me, I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: Nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications, When I cried unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu dizia em minha aflição: Estou cortado de diante de teus olhos.Porém tu ouviste a voz de minhas súplicas quando clamei a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y decía yo en mi premura: Cortado soy de delante de tus ojos: tú empero oíste la voz de mis ruegos, cuando á ti clamaba.

verses.KJV: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.WEB: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
verses.ASV: Oh love Jehovah, all ye his saints: Jehovah preserveth the faithful, And plentifully rewardeth him that dealeth proudly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amai ao SENHOR, todos vós santos dele; o SENHOR guarda aos fiéis, e retribui abundantemente ao que usa de arrogância.
verses.RVR09: Amad á Jehová todos vosotros sus santos: á los fieles guarda Jehová, y paga abundantemente al que obra con soberbia.

verses.KJV: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
verses.ASV: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that hope in Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sede fortes, e ele fortalecerá vosso coração, todos vós que esperais no SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Esforzaos todos vosotros los que esperáis en Jehová, y tome vuestro corazón aliento.

verses.KJV: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.WEB: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Maschil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Davi: Bem-aventurado aquele cuja transgressão é perdoada, cujo pecado é encoberto.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David: Masquil. BIENAVENTURADO aquel cuyas iniquidades son perdonadas, y borrados sus pecados.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado o homem a quem o SENHOR não considera a maldade, e em cujo espírito não há engano.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el hombre á quien no imputa Jehová la iniquidad, y en cuyo espíritu no hay superchería.

verses.KJV: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.WEB: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
verses.ASV: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto fiquei calado, meus ossos ficaram cada vez mais fracos com meu gemido pelo dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Mientras callé, envejeciéronse mis huesos en mi gemir todo el día.

verses.KJV: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.WEB: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
verses.ASV: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed [as] with the drought of summer. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque de dia e de noite tua mão pesava sobre mim; meu humor ficou seco como no verão. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Porque de día y de noche se agravó sobre mí tu mano; volvióse mi verdor en sequedades de estío. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: I acknowledge my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.WEB: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.ASV: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity did I not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu reconheci meu pecado a ti, e não escondi minha maldade. Eu disse: Confessarei ao SENHOR minhas transgressões;E tu perdoaste a maldade do meu pecado. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Mi pecado te declaré, y no encubrí mi iniquidad. Confesaré, dije, contra mí mis rebeliones á Jehová; y tú perdonaste la maldad de mi pecado. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.WEB: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
verses.ASV: For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they shall not reach unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso cada santo deve orar a ti em [todo] tempo que achar; até no transbordar de muitas águas, elas não chegarão a ele.
verses.RVR09: Por esto orará á ti todo santo en el tiempo de poder hallarte: ciertamente en la inundación de muchas aguas no llegarán éstas á él.

verses.KJV: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.WEB: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.ASV: Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu [és] meu esconderijo, tu me guardas da angústia; tu me envolves de canções alegres de liberdade. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Tú eres mi refugio; me guardarás de angustia; con cánticos de liberación me rodearás. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.WEB: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
verses.ASV: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te instruirei, e de ensinarei o caminho que deves seguir; eu te aconselharei, e [porei] meus olhos em ti.
verses.RVR09: Te haré entender, y te enseñaré el camino en que debes andar: sobre ti fijaré mis ojos.

verses.KJV: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.WEB: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
verses.ASV: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose trappings must be bit and bridle to hold them in, [Else] they will not come near unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejais como o cavalo [ou] como a mula, que não têm entendimento; cuja boca é presa com o cabresto e o freio, para que não cheguem a ti.
verses.RVR09: No seáis como el caballo, ó como el mulo, sin entendimiento: con cabestro y con freno su boca ha de ser reprimida, para que no lleguen á ti.

verses.KJV: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.WEB: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.
verses.ASV: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked; But he that trusteth in Jehovah, lovingkindness shall compass him about.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso [terá] muitas dores, mas aquele que confia no SENHOR, a bondade o rodeará.
verses.RVR09: Muchos dolores para el impío; mas el que espera en Jehová, lo cercará misericordia.

verses.KJV: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.WEB: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
verses.ASV: Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrai-vos no SENHOR, e enchei de alegria vós justos, e cantai alegremente todos os corretos de coração.
verses.RVR09: Alegraos en Jehová, y gozaos, justos: y cantad todos vosotros los rectos de corazón.

verses.KJV: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
verses.WEB: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.ASV: Rejoice in Jehovah, O ye righteous: Praise is comely for the upright.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR, vós [que sois] justos; aos corretos convém louvar.
verses.RVR09: ALEGRAOS, justos, en Jehová: á los rectos es hermosa la alabanza.

verses.KJV: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
verses.WEB: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
verses.ASV: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp: Sing praises unto him with the psaltery of ten strings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai ao SENHOR com harpa; cantai a ele com alaúde [e] instrumento de dez cordas.
verses.RVR09: Celebrad á Jehová con arpa: cantadle con salterio y decacordio.

verses.KJV: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.WEB: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
verses.ASV: Sing unto him a new song; Play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai-lhe uma canção nova; tocai [instrumento] bem com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Cantadle canción nueva: hacedlo bien tañendo con júbilo.

verses.KJV: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are done in truth.
verses.WEB: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
verses.ASV: For the word of Jehovah is right; And all his work is [done] in faithfulness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a palavra do SENHOR é correta; e todas suas obras [são] fiéis.
verses.RVR09: Porque recta es la palabra de Jehová, y toda su obra con verdad hecha.

verses.KJV: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.
verses.WEB: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
verses.ASV: He loveth righteousness and justice: The earth is full of the lovingkindness of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele ama a justiça e o juízo; a terra está cheia da bondade do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El ama justicia y juicio: de la misericordia de Jehová está llena la tierra.

verses.KJV: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.WEB: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
verses.ASV: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, And all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pala palavra do SENHOR foram feitos os céus; e todo o seu exército [foi feito] pelo sopro de sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Por la palabra de Jehová fueron hechos los cielos, y todo el ejército de ellos por el espíritu de su boca.

verses.KJV: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.WEB: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.ASV: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap: He layeth up the deeps in store-houses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele junta as águas do mar como se estivessem empilhadas; aos abismos ele põe como depósitos de tesouros.
verses.RVR09: El junta como en un montón las aguas de la mar: él pone en depósitos los abismos.

verses.KJV: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.WEB: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.ASV: Let all the earth fear Jehovah: Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda a terra, tenha temor ao SENHOR; todos os moradores do mundo prestem reverência a ele.
verses.RVR09: Tema á Jehová toda la tierra: teman de él todos los habitadores del mundo.

verses.KJV: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.WEB: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.ASV: For he spake, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele falou, [e logo] se fez; ele mandou, [e logo] apareceu.
verses.RVR09: Porque él dijo, y fué hecho; él mandó, y existió.

verses.KJV: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.WEB: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.ASV: Jehovah bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR desfez a intenção das nações; ele destruiu os planos dos povos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová hace nulo el consejo de las gentes, y frustra las maquinaciones de los pueblos.

verses.KJV: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.WEB: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.ASV: The counsel of Jehovah standeth fast for ever, The thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: O conselho do SENHOR permanece para sempre; as intenções de seu coração [continuam] de geração após geração.
verses.RVR09: El consejo de Jehová permanecerá para siempre; los pensamientos de su corazón por todas las generaciones.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurada [é] a nação em que seu Deus é o SENHOR; o povo que ele escolheu para si por herança.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurada la gente de que Jehová es su Dios; el pueblo á quien escogió por heredad para sí.

verses.KJV: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.WEB: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
verses.ASV: Jehovah looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR olha desde os céus; ele vê a todos os filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Desde los cielos miró Jehová; vió á todos los hijos de los hombres:

verses.KJV: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.WEB: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.ASV: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth Upon all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde sua firme morada ele observa a todos os moradores da terra.
verses.RVR09: Desde la morada de su asiento miró sobre todos los moradores de la tierra.

verses.KJV: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.WEB: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
verses.ASV: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele forma o coração de todos eles; ele avalia todas as obras deles.
verses.RVR09: El formó el corazón de todos ellos; él considera todas sus obras.

verses.KJV: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.WEB: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.ASV: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei não se salva pela grandeza de [seu] exército, nem o valente escapa do perigo pela [sua] muita força.
verses.RVR09: El rey no es salvo con la multitud del ejército: no escapa el valiente por la mucha fuerza.

verses.KJV: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
verses.WEB: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
verses.ASV: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth he deliver any by his great power.
verses.ALMEIDA: O cavalo é falho como segurança, com sua grande força não livra do perigo.
verses.RVR09: Vanidad es el caballo para salvarse: por la grandeza de su fuerza no librará.

verses.KJV: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
verses.ASV: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, Upon them that hope in his lovingkindness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que os olhos do SENHOR [estão] sobre aqueles que o temem, sobre os que esperam pela sua bondade.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, el ojo de Jehová sobre los que le temen, sobre los que esperan en su misericordia;

verses.KJV: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.WEB: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
verses.ASV: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para livrar a alma deles da morte, e para os manter vivos durante a fome.
verses.RVR09: Para librar sus almas de la muerte, y para darles vida en el hambre.

verses.KJV: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.
verses.WEB: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
verses.ASV: Our soul hath waited for Jehovah: He is our help and our shield.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossa alma espera no SENHOR; ele [é] nossa socorro e nosso escudo.
verses.RVR09: Nuestra alma esperó á Jehová; nuestra ayuda y nuestro escudo es él.

verses.KJV: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.WEB: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.ASV: For our heart shall rejoice in him, Because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque nele nosso coração se alegra, porque confiamos no nome de sua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto en él se alegrará nuestro corazón, porque en su santo nombre hemos confiado.

verses.KJV: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.WEB: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
verses.ASV: Let thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, According as we have hoped in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que tua bondade, SENOR, esteja sobre nós, assim como nós esperamos em ti.
verses.RVR09: Sea tu misericordia, oh Jehová, sobre nosotros, como esperamos en ti.

verses.KJV: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.WEB: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David; when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless Jehovah at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, quando ele mudou seu comportamento perante Abimeleque, que o expulsou, e ele foi embora: Louvarei ao SENHOR em todo tempo; [haverá] louvor a ele continuamente em minha boca.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David, cuando mudó su semblante delante de Abimelech, y él lo echó, y fuése. BENDECIRÉ á Jehová en todo tiempo; su alabanza será siempre en mi boca.

verses.KJV: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.WEB: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
verses.ASV: My soul shall make her boast in Jehovah: The meek shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma se orgulhará no SENHOR; os humildes ouvirão, e se alegrarão.
verses.RVR09: En Jehová se gloriará mi alma: oiránlo los mansos, y se alegrarán.

verses.KJV: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.WEB: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
verses.ASV: Oh magnify Jehovah with me, And let us exalt his name together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Engrandecei ao SENHOR comigo, e juntos exaltemos o seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Engrandeced á Jehová conmigo, y ensalcemos su nombre á una.

verses.KJV: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.WEB: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.ASV: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Busquei ao SENHOR. Ele me respondeu, e me livrou de todos os meus temores.
verses.RVR09: Busqué á Jehová, y él me oyó, y libróme de todos mis temores.

verses.KJV: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.WEB: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
verses.ASV: They looked unto him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be confounded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que olham para ele ficam visivelmente alegres, e seus rostos não são envergonhados.
verses.RVR09: A él miraron y fueron alumbrados: y sus rostros no se avergonzaron.

verses.KJV: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.WEB: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.ASV: This poor man cried, and Jehovah heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este miserável clamou, e o SENHOR ouviu; e ele o salvou de todas as suas angústias.
verses.RVR09: Este pobre clamó, y oyóle Jehová, y librólo de todas sus angustias.

verses.KJV: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
verses.ASV: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, And delivereth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: O anjo do SENHOR fica ao redor daqueles que o temem, e os livra.
verses.RVR09: El ángel de Jehová acampa en derredor de los que le temen, y los defiende.

verses.KJV: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.WEB: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
verses.ASV: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Experimentai, e vede que o SENHOR é bom; bem-aventurado [é] o homem que confia nele.
verses.RVR09: Gustad, y ved que es bueno Jehová: dichoso el hombre que confiará en él.

verses.KJV: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.WEB: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
verses.ASV: Oh fear Jehovah, ye his saints; For there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temei ao SENHOR vós, os seus santos; porque nada falta para aqueles que o temem.
verses.RVR09: Temed á Jehová, vosotros sus santos; porque no hay falta para los que le temen.

verses.KJV: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.
verses.WEB: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
verses.ASV: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos dos leões passam necessidades e têm fome; mas os que buscam ao SENHOR não têm falta de bem algum.
verses.RVR09: Los leoncillos necesitaron, y tuvieron hambre; pero los que buscan á Jehová, no tendrán falta de ningún bien.

verses.KJV: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.ASV: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, filhos, ouvi a mim; eu vos ensinarei o temor ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Venid, hijos, oidme; el temor de Jehová os enseñaré.

verses.KJV: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
verses.WEB: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.ASV: What man is he that desireth life, And loveth [many] days, that he may see good?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é o homem que deseja vida, que ama [viver por muitos] dias, para ver o bem?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es el hombre que desea vida, que codicia días para ver bien?

verses.KJV: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.WEB: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
verses.ASV: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda a tua língua do mal, e os teus lábios de falar falsidade.
verses.RVR09: Guarda tu lengua de mal, y tus labios de hablar engaño.

verses.KJV: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.WEB: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.ASV: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desvia-te do mal, e faze o bem; busca a paz, e segue-a.
verses.RVR09: Apártate del mal, y haz el bien; busca la paz, y síguela.

verses.KJV: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
verses.ASV: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous, And his ears are [open] unto their cry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos do SENHOR estão sobre os justos, e seus ouvidos [atentos] ao seu clamor.
verses.RVR09: Los ojos de Jehová están sobre los justos, y atentos sus oídos al clamor de ellos.

verses.KJV: The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
verses.ASV: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A face do SENHOR está contra aqueles que fazem o mal, para tirar da terra a memória deles.
verses.RVR09: La ira de Jehová contra los que mal hacen, para cortar de la tierra la memoria de ellos.

verses.KJV: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.WEB: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.ASV: [The righteous] cried, and Jehovah heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os [justos] clamam, e o SENHOR os ouve. Ele os livra de todas as suas angústias.
verses.RVR09: Clamaron los justos, y Jehová oyó, y librólos de todas sus angustias.

verses.KJV: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.WEB: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR [está] perto daqueles que estão com o coração partido, e sava os aflitos de espírito.
verses.RVR09: Cercano está Jehová á los quebrantados de corazón; y salvará á los contritos de espíritu.

verses.KJV: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.
verses.WEB: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
verses.ASV: Many are the afflictions of the righteous; But Jehovah delivereth him out of them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitas são as adversidades do justo, mas o SENHOR o livra de todas elas.
verses.RVR09: Muchos son los males del justo; mas de todos ellos lo librará Jehová.

verses.KJV: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.WEB: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
verses.ASV: He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele guarda todos os seus ossos; nenhum deles é quebrado.
verses.RVR09: El guarda todos sus huesos; ni uno de ellos será quebrantado.

verses.KJV: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.WEB: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.ASV: Evil shall slay the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mal matará o perverso, e os que odeiam o justo serão condenados.
verses.RVR09: Matará al malo la maldad; y los que aborrecen al justo serán asolados.

verses.KJV: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.WEB: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
verses.ASV: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; And none of them that take refuge in him shall be condemned.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR resgata a alma de seus servos, e todos os que nele confiam não receberão condenação.
verses.RVR09: Jehová redime el alma de sus siervos; y no serán asolados cuantos en él confían.

verses.KJV: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.WEB: By David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Strive thou, O Jehovah, with them that strive with me: Fight thou against them that fight against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Disputa, SENHOR contra os meus adversários; luta contra os que lutam contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. DISPUTA, oh Jehová, con los que contra mí contienden; pelea con los que me combaten.

verses.KJV: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
verses.WEB: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
verses.ASV: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pega os [teus] pequeno e grande escudos, e levanta-te em meu socorro.
verses.RVR09: Echa mano al escudo y al pavés, y levántate en mi ayuda.

verses.KJV: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.WEB: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
verses.ASV: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that pursue me: Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tira a lança, e fecha [o caminho] ao encontro de meus perseguidores; dize à minha alma: Eu sou tua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Y saca la lanza, cierra contra mis perseguidores; di á mi alma: Yo soy tu salud.

verses.KJV: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.WEB: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
verses.ASV: Let them be put to shame and brought to dishonor that seek after my soul: Let them be turned back and confounded that devise my hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envergonhem-se, e sejam humilhados os que buscam [matar] a minha alma; tornem-se para trás, e sejam envergonhados os que planejam o mal contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Avergüéncense y confúndanse los que buscan mi alma: vuelvan atrás, y sean avergonzados los que mi mal intentan.

verses.KJV: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord chase them.
verses.WEB: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.
verses.ASV: Let them be as chaff before the wind, And the angel of Jehovah driving [them] on.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam como a palha perante o vento; e que o anjo do SENHOR os remova.
verses.RVR09: Sean como el tamo delante del viento; y el ángel de Jehová los acose.

verses.KJV: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.
verses.WEB: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.
verses.ASV: Let their way be dark and slippery, And the angel of Jehovah pursuing them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que o caminho deles seja escuro e escorregadio; e o anjo do SENHOR os persiga.
verses.RVR09: Sea su camino oscuridad y resbaladeros; y el ángel de Jehová los persiga.

verses.KJV: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.WEB: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
verses.ASV: For without cause have they hid for me their net [in] a pit; Without cause have they digged [a pit] for my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sem motivo eles esconderam de mim a cova de sua rede; sem motivo eles cavaram para minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Porque sin causa escondieron para mí su red en un hoyo; sin causa hicieron hoyo para mi alma.

verses.KJV: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.WEB: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
verses.ASV: Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself: With destruction let him fall therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Venha sobre ele a destruição sem que ele saiba [de antemão] ; e sua rede, que ele escondeu, que o prenda; que ele, assolado, caia nela.
verses.RVR09: Véngale el quebrantamiento que no sepa, y su red que escondió lo prenda: con quebrantamiento en ella caiga.

verses.KJV: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.WEB: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.ASV: And my soul shall be joyful in Jehovah: It shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E minha alma se alegrará no SENHOR; ela se encherá de alegria por sua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Y gócese mi alma en Jehová; y alégrese en su salud.

verses.KJV: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
verses.WEB: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
verses.ASV: All my bones shall say, Jehovah, who is like unto thee, Who deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that robbeth him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os meus ossos dirão: SENHOR, quem [é] como tu, que livras ao miserável daquele que é mais forte do que ele, e ao miserável e necessitado, daquele que o rouba?
verses.RVR09: Todos mis huesos dirán: Jehová, ¿quién como tú, que libras al afligido del más fuerte que él, y al pobre y menesteroso del que le despoja?

verses.KJV: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.WEB: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
verses.ASV: Unrighteous witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I know not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantam-se más testemunhas; exigem de mim [coisas] que não sei.
verses.RVR09: Levantáronse testigos falsos; demandáronme lo que no sabía;

verses.KJV: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
verses.WEB: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
verses.ASV: They reward me evil for good, [To] the bereaving of my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele retribuem o bem com o mal, desolando a minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Volviéronme mal por bien, para abatir á mi alma.

verses.KJV: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.WEB: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
verses.ASV: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I afflicted my soul with fasting; And my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu, quando ficavam doentes, minha roupa [era] de saco; eu afligia a minha alma com jejuns, e minha oração voltava ao meu seio.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo, cuando ellos enfermaron, me vestí de saco; afligí con ayuno mi alma, y mi oración se revolvía en mi seno.

verses.KJV: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.WEB: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
verses.ASV: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother: I bowed down mourning, as one that bewaileth his mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu agia [para com eles] como [para] um amigo [ou] irmão meu; eu andava encurvado, como que de luto pela mãe.
verses.RVR09: Como por mi compañero, como por mi hermano andaba; como el que trae luto por madre, enlutado me humillaba.

verses.KJV: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
