verses.WEB: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
verses.ASV: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: The abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew [it] not; They did tear me, and ceased not:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando eu vacilava, eles se alegravam e se reuniam; inimigos se reuniam sem que eu soubesse; eles me despedaçavam [em palavras] ,e não se calavam.
verses.RVR09: Pero ellos se alegraron en mi adversidad, y se juntaron; juntáronse contra mí gentes despreciables, y yo no lo entendía: despedazábanme, y no cesaban;

verses.KJV: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.WEB: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.ASV: Like the profane mockers in feasts, They gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entre os fingidos zombadores [em] festas, eles rangiam seus dentes por causa de mim.
verses.RVR09: Con los lisonjeros escarnecedores truhanes, crujiendo sobre mí sus dientes.

verses.KJV: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.WEB: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
verses.ASV: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, My darling from the lions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Senhor, até quando tu [somente] observarás? Resgata minha alma das assolações deles; minha única [vida] dos filhos dos leões.
verses.RVR09: Señor, ¿hasta cuándo verás esto? Recobra mi alma de sus quebrantamientos, mi única de los leones.

verses.KJV: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.WEB: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
verses.ASV: I will give thee thanks in the great assembly: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim eu te louvarei na grande congregação; numa grande multidão eu celebrarei a ti.
verses.RVR09: Te confesaré en grande congregación; te alabaré entre numeroso pueblo.

verses.KJV: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.WEB: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
verses.ASV: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se alegrem meus inimigos por causa de mim por um mau motivo, [nem] acenem com os olhos aquele que me odeiam sem motivo.
verses.RVR09: No se alegren de mí mis enemigos injustos: ni los que me aborrecen sin causa hagan del ojo.

verses.KJV: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.WEB: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
verses.ASV: For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful words against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles não falam de paz; mas sim, planejam falsidades contra os pacíficos da terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hablan paz; y contra los mansos de la tierra piensan palabras engañosas.

verses.KJV: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
verses.WEB: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
verses.ASV: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me; They said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E abrem suas bocas contra mim, dizendo: Ha-ha, nós vimos com nossos [próprios] olhos!
verses.RVR09: Y ensancharon sobre mí su boca; dijeron: ¡Ea, ea, nuestros ojos lo han visto!

verses.KJV: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.WEB: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
verses.ASV: Thou hast seen it, O Jehovah; keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, SENHOR, tens visto [isso] ; não fiques calado; SENHOR, não fiques longe de mim.
verses.RVR09: Tú lo has visto, oh Jehová; no calles: Señor, de mí no te alejes.

verses.KJV: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.WEB: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
verses.ASV: Stir up thyself, and awake to the justice [due] unto me, [Even] unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te e acorda para meu direito, Deus meu, e Senhor meu, para minha causa.
verses.RVR09: Muévete y despierta para mi juicio, para mi causa, Dios mío y Señor mío.

verses.KJV: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.WEB: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
verses.ASV: Judge me, O Jehovah my God, according to thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Julga-me conforme a tua justiça, SENHOR meu Deus; e não deixes eles se alegrarem de mim.
verses.RVR09: Júzgame conforme á tu justicia, Jehová Dios mío; y no se alegren de mí.

verses.KJV: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.WEB: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
verses.ASV: Let them not say in their heart, Aha, so would we have it: Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não digam eles em seus corações: Ahá, [vencemos] , alma nossa!nem digam: Nós já o devoramos!
verses.RVR09: No digan en su corazón: ¡Ea, alma nuestra! No digan: ¡Hémoslo devorado!

verses.KJV: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
verses.WEB: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
verses.ASV: Let them be put to shame and confounded together that rejoice at my hurt: Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor that magnify themselves against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que eles se envergonhem, e sejam juntamente humilhados os que se alegram pelo meu mal; vistam-se de vergonha e confusão os que se engrandecem contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Avergüéncense, y sean confundidos á una los que de mi mal se alegran: vístanse de vergüenza y de confusión los que se engrandecen contra mí.

verses.KJV: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.WEB: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
verses.ASV: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favor my righteous cause: Yea, let them say continually, Jehovah be magnified, Who hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantem de alegria e sejam muito contentes os que amam a minha justiça; e continuamente digam: Seja engrandecido o SENHOR, que ama o bem-estar de seu servo.
verses.RVR09: Canten y alégrense los que están á favor de mi justa causa, y digan siempre: Sea ensalzado Jehová, que ama la paz de su siervo.

verses.KJV: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
verses.WEB: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
verses.ASV: And my tongue shall talk of thy righteousness [And] of thy praise all the day long.
verses.ALMEIDA: E minha língua falará de tua justiça, louvando a ti o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Y mi lengua hablará de tu justicia, y de tu loor todo el día.

verses.KJV: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David the servant of Jehovah. The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, servo do SENHOR, para o regente: A transgressão do perverso diz ao meu coração [que] não há temor a Deus perante seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David, siervo del Señor. LA iniquidad del impío me dice al corazón: No hay temor de Dios delante de sus ojos.

verses.KJV: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.WEB: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
verses.ASV: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, That his iniquity will not be found out and be hated.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele é [tão] orgulhoso diante de seus olhos [que não] achar [nem] odiar sua própria maldade.
verses.RVR09: Lisonjéase, por tanto, en sus propios ojos, hasta que su iniquidad sea hallada aborrecible.

verses.KJV: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
verses.WEB: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
verses.ASV: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath ceased to be wise [and] to do good.
verses.ALMEIDA: As palavras da boca dele são malícia e falsidade; ele deixou de [fazer] o que é sábio e bom.
verses.RVR09: Las palabras de su boca son iniquidad y fraude; no quiso entender para bien hacer.

verses.KJV: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.WEB: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
verses.ASV: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele planeja maldade em sua cama; fica no caminho que não é bom; não rejeita o mal.
verses.RVR09: Iniquidad piensa sobre su cama; está en camino no bueno, el mal no aborrece.

verses.KJV: Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.WEB: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.ASV: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the skies.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, tua bondade [alcança] os céus, e tua fidelidade [chega] até as mais altas nuvens.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, hasta los cielos es tu misericordia; tu verdad hasta las nubes.

verses.KJV: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.WEB: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
verses.ASV: Thy righteousness is like the mountains of God; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Jehovah, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua justiça é como as montanhas de Deus, teus juízos [como] um grande abismo; tu, SENHOR, guardas [a vida] dos homens e dos animais.
verses.RVR09: Tu justicia como los montes de Dios, tus juicios abismo grande: oh Jehová, al hombre y al animal conservas.

verses.KJV: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.WEB: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
verses.ASV: How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como é preciosa, SENHOR, a tua bondade! Porque os filhos dos homens se abrigam à sombra de tuas asas.
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuán ilustre, oh Dios, es tu misericordia! Por eso los hijos de los hombres se amparan bajo la sombra de tus alas.

verses.KJV: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.WEB: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
verses.ASV: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se fartam da comida de tua casa, e tu lhes dás de beber [do] ribeiro de teus prazeres.
verses.RVR09: Embriagarse han de la grosura de tu casa; y tú los abrevarás del torrente de tus delicias.

verses.KJV: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.WEB: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
verses.ASV: For with thee is the fountain of life: In thy light shall we see light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque contigo está a fonte da vida; em tua luz vemos a luz [verdadeira] .
verses.RVR09: Porque contigo está el manantial de la vida: en tu luz veremos la luz.

verses.KJV: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.WEB: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.ASV: Oh continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee, And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estende tua bondade sobre os que te conhecem; e tua justiça sobre os corretos de coração.
verses.RVR09: Extiende tu misericordia á los que te conocen, y tu justicia á los rectos de corazón.

verses.KJV: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.WEB: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.ASV: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não venha sobre mim o pé dos arrogantes, e que a não dos perversos não me mova.
verses.RVR09: No venga contra mí pie de soberbia; y mano de impíos no me mueva.

verses.KJV: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.WEB: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.ASV: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali cairão os que praticam a maldade; eles foram lançados, e não podem se levantar.
verses.RVR09: Allí cayeron los obradores de iniquidad; fueron rempujados, y no pudieron levantarse.

verses.KJV: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.WEB: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, Neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Não te irrites com os malfeitores, nem tenhas inveja dos que praticam perversidade.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. NO te impacientes á causa de los malignos, ni tengas envidia de los que hacen iniquidad.

verses.KJV: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.WEB: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
verses.ASV: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim como a erva, eles logo serão cortados; e como a verdura eles cairão.
verses.RVR09: Porque como hierba serán presto cortados, y decaerán como verdor de renuevo.

verses.KJV: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.WEB: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
verses.ASV: Trust in Jehovah, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on [his] faithfulness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confia no SENHOR, e faze o bem; habita a terra, e te alimentarás em segurança.
verses.RVR09: Espera en Jehová, y haz bien; vivirás en la tierra, y en verdad serás alimentado.

verses.KJV: Delight thyself also in the Lord: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.WEB: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.ASV: Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agrada-te no SENHOR; e ele te dará os pedidos de teu coração.
verses.RVR09: Pon asimismo tu delicia en Jehová, y él te dará las peticiones de tu corazón.

verses.KJV: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.WEB: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
verses.ASV: Commit thy way unto Jehovah; Trust also in him, and he will bring it to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entrega o teu caminho ao SENHOR; confia nele, e ele agirá,
verses.RVR09: Encomienda á Jehová tu camino, y espera en él; y él hará.

verses.KJV: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.WEB: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
verses.ASV: And he will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, And thy justice as the noonday.
verses.ALMEIDA: e manifestará a tua justiça como a luz, e o teu direito como o sol do meio-dia.
verses.RVR09: Y exhibirá tu justicia como la luz, y tus derechos como el medio día.

verses.KJV: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.WEB: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
verses.ASV: Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, Because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Descansa no SENHOR, e espera nele; não te irrites contra aquele cujo caminho prospera, [nem] com o homem que planeja maldades.
verses.RVR09: Calla á Jehová, y espera en él: no te alteres con motivo del que prospera en su camino, por el hombre que hace maldades.

verses.KJV: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.WEB: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
verses.ASV: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: Fret not thyself, [it tendeth] only to evil-doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Detém a ira, abandona o furor; não te irrites de maneira alguma para fazer o mal.
verses.RVR09: Déjate de la ira, y depón el enojo: no te excites en manera alguna á hacer lo malo.

verses.KJV: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.WEB: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.
verses.ASV: For evil-doers shall be cut off; But those that wait for Jehovah, they shall inherit the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os malfeitores serão exterminados; mas os que esperam no SENHOR herdarão a terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque los malignos serán talados, mas los que esperan en Jehová, ellos heredarán la tierra.

verses.KJV: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.WEB: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
verses.ASV: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: Yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and he shall not be.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda um pouco, e o perverso não [mais existirá] ; e tu olharás para o lugar dele, e ele não [aparecerá] .
verses.RVR09: Pues de aquí á poco no será el malo: y contemplarás sobre su lugar, y no parecerá.

verses.KJV: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.WEB: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.ASV: But the meek shall inherit the land, And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os mansos herdarão a terra, e se agradarão com muita paz.
verses.RVR09: Pero los mansos heredarán la tierra, y se recrearán con abundancia de paz.

verses.KJV: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.WEB: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
verses.ASV: The wicked plotteth against the just, And gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso trama contra o justo, e range seus dentes contra ele.
verses.RVR09: Maquina el impío contra el justo, y cruje sobre él sus dientes.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.WEB: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
verses.ASV: The Lord will laugh at him; For he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor ri dele, porque vê que já vem o dia dele.
verses.RVR09: El Señor se reirá de él; porque ve que viene su día.

verses.KJV: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.WEB: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
verses.ASV: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay such as are upright in the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perversos pegarão a espada e armarão seu arco, para abaterem ao miserável e necessitado, para matarem os corretos no caminho.
verses.RVR09: Los impíos desenvainaron espada, y entesaron su arco, para derribar al pobre y al menesteroso, para matar á los de recto proceder.

verses.KJV: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.WEB: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
verses.ASV: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sua espada entrará em seus corações, e seus arcos serão quebrados.
verses.RVR09: La espada de ellos entrará en su mismo corazón, y su arco será quebrado.

verses.KJV: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.WEB: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
verses.ASV: Better is a little that the righteous hath Than the abundance of many wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pouco que o justo [tem] é melhor do que a riqueza de muitos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es lo poco del justo, que las riquezas de muchos pecadores.

verses.KJV: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.
verses.WEB: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
verses.ASV: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; But Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os braços dos perversos serão quebrados, mas o SENHOR sustenta os justos.
verses.RVR09: Porque los brazos de los impíos serán quebrados: mas el que sostiene á los justos es Jehová.

verses.KJV: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.WEB: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
verses.ASV: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; And their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR conhece os dias dos corretos, e a herança deles permanecerá para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Conoce Jehová los días de los perfectos: y la heredad de ellos será para siempre.

verses.KJV: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.WEB: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.ASV: They shall not be put to shame in the time of evil; And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles não serão envergonhados no tempo mau, e terão fartura nos dias de fome.
verses.RVR09: No serán avergonzados en el mal tiempo; y en los días de hambre serán hartos.

verses.KJV: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.WEB: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
verses.ASV: But the wicked shall perish, And the enemies of Jehovah shall be as the fat of lambs: They shall consume; in smoke shall they consume away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os perversos perecerão, e os inimigos do SENHOR desaparecerão tal como as melhores partes dos cordeiros; eles de desfarão na fumaça.
verses.RVR09: Mas los impíos perecerán, y los enemigos de Jehová como la grasa de los carneros serán consumidos: se disiparán como humo.

verses.KJV: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.WEB: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
verses.ASV: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again; But the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso toma emprestado, e paga de volta; mas o justo se compadece e dá.
verses.RVR09: El impío toma prestado, y no paga; mas el justo tiene misericordia, y da.

verses.KJV: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.WEB: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
verses.ASV: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the land; And they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os que são por ele abençoados herdarão a terra; mas os que são por ele amaldiçoados serão removidos.
verses.RVR09: Porque los benditos de él heredarán la tierra; y los malditos de él serán talados.

verses.KJV: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.WEB: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
verses.ASV: A man’s goings are established of Jehovah; And he delighteth in his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os passos do homem [justo] são preparados pelo SENHOR; e ele tem prazer em seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Por Jehová son ordenados los pasos del hombre, y aprueba su camino.

verses.KJV: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.WEB: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
verses.ASV: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For Jehovah upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando cai, ele não fica derrubado, pois o SENHOR sustenta a sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Cuando cayere, no quedará postrado; porque Jehová sostiene su mano.

verses.KJV: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.WEB: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
verses.ASV: I have been young, and now am old; Yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his seed begging bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu já fui jovem, e já envelheci; mas nunca vi o justo desamparado, nem a sua semente a pedir pão.
verses.RVR09: Mozo fuí, y he envejecido, y no he visto justo desamparado, ni su simiente que mendigue pan.

verses.KJV: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.WEB: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
verses.ASV: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: O dia todo ele se compadece, e empresta; e sua semente é abençoada.
verses.RVR09: En todo tiempo tiene misericordia, y presta; y su simiente es para bendición.

verses.KJV: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.WEB: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
verses.ASV: Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afasta-te do mal, e faze o bem; e faça sua habitação eterna.
verses.RVR09: Apártate del mal, y haz el bien, y vivirás para siempre.

verses.KJV: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.WEB: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah loveth justice, And forsaketh not his saints; They are preserved for ever: But the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR ama o juízo, e não desampara a seus santos: eles estão guardados para sempre; mas a semente dos perversos será removida.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová ama la rectitud, y no desampara sus santos: para siempre serán guardados; mas la simiente de los impíos será extirpada.

verses.KJV: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.WEB: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
verses.ASV: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os justos herdarão a terra, e para sempre nela habitarão.
verses.RVR09: Los justos heredarán la tierra, y vivirán para siempre sobre ella.

verses.KJV: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.WEB: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
verses.ASV: The mouth of the righteous talketh of wisdom, And his tongue speaketh justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: A boca do justo fala de sabedoria, e sua língua fala do [bom] juízo.
verses.RVR09: La boca del justo hablará sabiduría; y su lengua proferirá juicio.

verses.KJV: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.WEB: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
verses.ASV: The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.
verses.ALMEIDA: A Lei de seu Deus [está] em seu coração; seus passos não serão abalados.
verses.RVR09: La ley de su Dios está en su corazón; por tanto sus pasos no vacilarán.

verses.KJV: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.WEB: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
verses.ASV: The wicked watcheth the righteous, And seeketh to slay him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso espia ao justo, e procura matá-lo.
verses.RVR09: Acecha el impío al justo, y procura matarlo.

verses.KJV: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.WEB: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] o SENHOR não o deixa em suas mãos; nem também o condenará, quando for julgado.
verses.RVR09: Jehová no lo dejará en sus manos, ni lo condenará cuando le juzgaren.

verses.KJV: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.WEB: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
verses.ASV: Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, And he will exalt thee to inherit the land: When the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Espera no SENHOR, guarda o seu caminho, e ele te exaltará, para herdares a terra; tu verás que os perversos serão removidos.
verses.RVR09: Espera en Jehová, y guarda su camino, y él te ensalzará para heredar la tierra: cuando serán talados los pecadores, lo verás.

verses.KJV: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.WEB: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
verses.ASV: I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vi ao perverso violento crescer como a árvore verde, natural da terra.
verses.RVR09: Vi yo al impío sumamente ensalzado, y que se extendía como un laurel verde.

verses.KJV: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.WEB: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.ASV: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not: Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele já foi embora, e eis que ele não [existe mais] ; eu o procurei, e não foi achado.
verses.RVR09: Empero pasóse, y he aquí no parece; y busquélo, y no fué hallado.

verses.KJV: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.WEB: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
verses.ASV: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright; For there is a [happy] end to the man of peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha ao sincero, e vê o correto; porque o fim de [tal] homem é a paz.
verses.RVR09: Considera al íntegro, y mira al justo: que la postrimería de cada uno de ellos es paz.

verses.KJV: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.WEB: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.ASV: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together: The end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os transgressores serão juntamente destruídos; o fim dos perversos será eliminado.
verses.RVR09: Mas los transgresores fueron todos á una destruídos: la postrimería de los impíos fué talada.

verses.KJV: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.WEB: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
verses.ASV: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah: He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a salvação dos justos [vem] do SENHOR, [que é] a força deles no tempo de angústia.
verses.RVR09: Pero la salvación de los justos es de Jehová, y él es su fortaleza en el tiempo de angustia.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.WEB: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah helpeth them, and rescueth them: He rescueth them from the wicked, and saveth them, Because they have taken refuge in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR os socorrerá, e os livrará; ele os livrará dos perversos, e os salvará, porque nele confiam.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová los ayudará, y los librará: y libertarálos de los impíos, y los salvará, por cuanto en él esperaron.

verses.KJV: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para lembrança: SENHOR, não me repreendas em tua ira, e não me castigues em teu furor.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David, para recordar. JEHOVÁ, no me reprendas en tu furor, ni me castigues en tu ira.

verses.KJV: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.WEB: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
verses.ASV: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tuas flechas me atingiram, e tua mão pesou sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Porque tus saetas descendieron á mí, y sobre mí ha caído tu mano.

verses.KJV: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.WEB: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.ASV: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na minha carne nada [há que esteja] saudável, por causa de tua ira; não há paz em meus ossos por causa do meu pecado.
verses.RVR09: No hay sanidad en mi carne á causa de tu ira; ni hay paz en mis huesos á causa de mi pecado.

verses.KJV: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.WEB: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
verses.ASV: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque minhas maldades ultrapassam minha cabeça; elas [são] como carga pesada demais para mim.
verses.RVR09: Porque mis iniquidades han pasado mi cabeza: como carga pesada se han agravado sobre mí.

verses.KJV: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.WEB: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.ASV: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, Because of my foolishness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minhas feridas fedem, e estão apodrecidas, por eu ter sido tão tolo.
verses.RVR09: Pudriéronse, corrompiéronse mis llagas, á causa de mi locura.

verses.KJV: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.WEB: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
verses.ASV: I am pained and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu estou perturbado e abatido; ando o dia todo em sofrimento.
verses.RVR09: Estoy encorvado, estoy humillado en gran manera, ando enlutado todo el día.

verses.KJV: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.WEB: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.ASV: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque meus lombos ardem muito, e nada há que esteja saudável em minha carne.
verses.RVR09: Porque mis lomos están llenos de irritación, y no hay sanidad en mi carne.

verses.KJV: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.WEB: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
verses.ASV: I am faint and sore bruised: I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estou enfraquecido e despedaçado; eu gemo pelo sofrimento do meu coração.
verses.RVR09: Estoy debilitado y molido en gran manera; bramo á causa de la conmoción de mi corazón.

verses.KJV: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.WEB: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
verses.ASV: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, todo o meu sofrimento está diante de ti, e meu gemido não te é oculto.
verses.RVR09: Señor, delante de ti están todos mis deseos; y mi suspiro no te es oculto.

verses.KJV: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.WEB: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
verses.ASV: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu coração dá palpitações, e minha força me deixou; e a luz dos meus olhos já não [está] comigo.
verses.RVR09: Mi corazón está acongojado, hame dejado mi vigor; y aun la misma luz de mis ojos no está conmigo.

verses.KJV: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.WEB: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
verses.ASV: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus amigos e companheiros observam de longe minha calamidade; e os meus vizinhos ficam afastados.
verses.RVR09: Mis amigos y mis compañeros se quitaron de delante de mi plaga; y mis cercanos se pusieron lejos.

verses.KJV: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.WEB: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
verses.ASV: They also that seek after my life lay snares [for me]; And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And meditate deceits all the day long.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que procuram [matar] a minha alma [me] armam laços; e os que procuram o meu mal falam insultos e todo o dia planejam maldades.
verses.RVR09: Y los que buscaban mi alma armaron lazos; y los que procuraban mi mal hablaban iniquidades, y meditaban fraudes todo el día.

verses.KJV: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.WEB: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
verses.ASV: But I, as a deaf man, hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu [estou] como o surdo, não ouço; e como o mudo, [que] não abre sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo, como si fuera sordo, no oía; y estaba como un mudo, que no abre su boca.

verses.KJV: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.WEB: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.ASV: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu estou como um homem que não ouve, e cuja boca não [pode responder] com repreensões.
verses.RVR09: Fuí pues como un hombre que no oye, y que en su boca no tiene reprensiones.

verses.KJV: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.WEB: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
verses.ASV: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope: Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, SENHOR, eu espero em ti; Senhor, meu Deus, tu me ouvirás.
verses.RVR09: Porque á ti, oh Jehová, esperé yo: tú responderás, Jehová Dios mío.

verses.KJV: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.WEB: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
verses.ASV: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu dizia: Não se alegrem de mim!Quando meu pé vacilou, eles se engrandeceram contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Porque dije: Que no se alegren de mí: cuando mi pie resbalaba, sobre mí se engrandecían.

verses.KJV: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.WEB: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
verses.ASV: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu estou prestes a ficar como manco, e minha dor está continuamente perante mim.
verses.RVR09: Empero yo estoy á pique de claudicar, y mi dolor está delante de mí continuamente.

verses.KJV: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.WEB: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.ASV: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu [te] conto minha maldade; estou aflito por causa do meu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto denunciaré mi maldad; congojaréme por mi pecado.

verses.KJV: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.WEB: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
verses.ASV: But mine enemies are lively, [and] are strong; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém meus inimigos [estão] vivos, [e] se fortalecem; e os que me odeiam por maldade se multiplicam;
verses.RVR09: Porque mis enemigos están vivos y fuertes: y hanse aumentado los que me aborrecen sin causa:

verses.KJV: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.WEB: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
verses.ASV: They also that render evil for good Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como os que retribuem o bem com o mal, eles se opõem a mim, porque eu sigo o bem.
verses.RVR09: Y pagando mal por bien me son contrarios, por seguir yo lo bueno.

verses.KJV: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.WEB: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.
verses.ASV: Forsake me not, O Jehovah: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me desampares, SENHOR, meu Deus, não fiques longe de mim.
verses.RVR09: No me desampares, oh Jehová: Dios mío, no te alejes de mí.

verses.KJV: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
verses.WEB: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
verses.ASV: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apressa-te ao meu socorro, SENHOR, salvação minha.
verses.RVR09: Apresúrate á ayudarme, oh Señor, mi salud.

verses.KJV: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician, for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, I will take heed to my ways, That I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, While the wicked is before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente, conforme “Jedutum”: Eu dizia: Vigiarei os meus caminhos, para eu não pecar com minha língua; vigiarei minha boca com freio, enquanto o perverso ainda estiver em frente a mim.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal, á Jeduthún: Salmo de David. YO DIJE: Atenderé á mis caminos, para no pecar con mi lengua: guardaré mi boca con freno, en tanto que el impío fuere contra mí.

verses.KJV: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.WEB: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
verses.ASV: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; And my sorrow was stirred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu fiquei calado, nada falei de bom; e minha dor se agravou.
verses.RVR09: Enmudecí con silencio, calléme aun respecto de lo bueno: y excitóse mi dolor.

verses.KJV: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
verses.WEB: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
verses.ASV: My heart was hot within me; While I was musing the fire burned; [Then] spake I with my tongue:
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu coração se esquentou dentro de mim, fogo se acendeu em minha meditação; [então] eu disse com minha língua:
verses.RVR09: Enardecióse mi corazón dentro de mí; encendióse fuego en mi meditación, y así proferí con mi lengua:

verses.KJV: Lord, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.
verses.WEB: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
verses.ASV: Jehovah, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how frail I am.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conta-me, SENHOR, o meu fim, e a duração dos meus dias, para que eu saiba como eu sou frágil.
verses.RVR09: Hazme saber, Jehová, mi fin, y cuánta sea la medida de mis días; sepa yo cuánto tengo de ser del mundo.

verses.KJV: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
verses.WEB: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
verses.ASV: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] handbreadths; And my life-time is as nothing before thee: Surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que a palmos tu ordenaste os meus dias, e o tempo de minha vida [é] como nada diante de ti; pois todo homem que existe [é] um nada. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: He aquí diste á mis días término corto, y mi edad es como nada delante de ti: ciertamente es completa vanidad todo hombre que vive. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.WEB: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
verses.ASV: Surely every man walketh in a vain show; Surely they are disquieted in vain: He heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente o homem anda pela aparência, certamente se inquietam em vão; ajuntam [bens] , e não sabem que [os] levará.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente en tinieblas anda el hombre; ciertamente en vano se inquieta: junta, y no sabe quién lo allegará.

verses.KJV: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
verses.WEB: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
verses.ASV: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, SENHOR, o que eu espero? Minha esperança [está] em ti.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, Señor, ¿qué esperaré? Mi esperanza en ti está.

verses.KJV: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.WEB: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
verses.ASV: Deliver me from all my transgressions: Make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra-me de todas as minhas transgressões; não me ponhas como humilhado pelo tolo.
verses.RVR09: Líbrame de todas mis rebeliones; no me pongas por escarnio del insensato.

verses.KJV: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
verses.WEB: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
verses.ASV: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu estou calado, não abrirei a minha boca, porque tu fizeste [assim] .
verses.RVR09: Enmudecí, no abrí mi boca; porque tú lo hiciste.

verses.KJV: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
verses.WEB: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
verses.ASV: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tira teu tormento de sobre mim; estou consumido pelo golpe de tua mão.
verses.RVR09: Quita de sobre mí tu plaga; de la guerra de tu mano soy consumido.

verses.KJV: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
verses.WEB: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
verses.ASV: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: Surely every man is vanity. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao castigares alguém com repreensões pela maldade, logo tu desfaz o que lhe agrada como traça; certamente todo homem é um nada. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Con castigos sobre el pecado corriges al hombre, y haces consumirse como de polilla su grandeza: ciertamente vanidad es todo hombre. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.WEB: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
verses.ASV: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; Hold not thy peace at my tears: For I am a stranger with thee, A sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve a minha oração, SENHOR; e dá ouvidos ao meu clamor; não te cales de minhas lágrimas, porque eu sou [como] um peregrino para contigo; estrangeiro, como todos os meus pais.
verses.RVR09: Oye mi oración, oh Jehová, y escucha mi clamor: no calles á mis lágrimas; porque peregrino soy para contigo, y advenedizo, como todos mis padres.

verses.KJV: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.WEB: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
verses.ASV: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, Before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não prestes atenção em mim [em tua ira] , antes que eu vá, e pereça.
verses.RVR09: Déjame, y tomaré fuerzas, antes que vaya y perezca.

verses.KJV: I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for Jehovah; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Esperei com esperança no SENHOR, e ele se inclinou a mim, e ouviu o meu clamor.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. RESIGNADAMENTE esperé á Jehová, é inclinóse á mí, y oyó mi clamor.

verses.KJV: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.WEB: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
verses.ASV: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay; And he set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me tirou de uma cova de tormento, de um lamaceiro de barro; e pôs os meus pés sobre uma rocha; ele firmou meus passos.
verses.RVR09: E hízome sacar de un lago de miseria, del lodo cenagoso; y puso mis pies sobre peña, y enderezó mis pasos.

verses.KJV: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.
verses.WEB: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.ASV: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it, and fear, And shall trust in Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pôs em minha boca uma canção nova, um louvor para nosso Deus: muitos [o] verão, e temerão, e confiarão no SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Puso luego en mi boca canción nueva, alabanza á nuestro Dios. Verán esto muchos, y temerán, y esperarán en Jehová.

verses.KJV: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado [é] o homem que põe no SENHOR sua confiança; e não dá atenção aos arrogantes e aos que caminham em direção à mentira.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el hombre que puso á Jehová por su confianza, y no mira á los soberbios, ni á los que declinan á la mentira.

verses.KJV: Many, O Lord my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.WEB: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
verses.ASV: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward: They cannot be set in order unto thee; If I would declare and speak of them, They are more than can be numbered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, SENHOR meu Deus, multiplicaste para conosco tuas maravilhas e teus planos; eles não podem ser contados em ordem diante de ti; se eu [tentasse] contá-los e falá-los, eles são muito mais do que incontáveis.
verses.RVR09: Aumentado has tú, oh Jehová Dios mío, tus maravillas; y tus pensamientos para con nosotros, no te los podremos contar: si yo anunciare y hablare de ellos, no pueden ser enarrados.

verses.KJV: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
verses.WEB: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
verses.ASV: Sacrifice and offering thou hast no delight in; Mine ears hast thou opened: Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not required.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu não te agradaste de sacrifício e oferta; [porém] tu me furaste as orelhas; tu não pediste nem holocausto nem oferta de expiação do pecado.
verses.RVR09: Sacrificio y presente no te agrada; has abierto mis oídos; holocausto y expiación no has demandado.

verses.KJV: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
verses.WEB: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
verses.ASV: Then said I, Lo, I am come; In the roll of the book it is written of me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: Eis que venho; no rolo do livro está escrito sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dije: He aquí, vengo; en el envoltorio del libro está escrito de mí:

verses.KJV: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
verses.WEB: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
verses.ASV: I delight to do thy will, O my God; Yea, thy law is within my heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu Deus, eu desejo fazer a tua vontade; e tua Lei está no meio dos meus sentimentos.
verses.RVR09: El hacer tu voluntad, Dios mío, hame agradado; y tu ley está en medio de mis entrañas.

verses.KJV: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, thou knowest.
verses.WEB: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.
verses.ASV: I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness in the great assembly; Lo, I will not refrain my lips, O Jehovah, thou knowest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu anuncio a justiça na grande congregação; eis que não retenho meus lábios; tu, SENHOR sabes [disso] .
verses.RVR09: Anunciado he justicia en grande congregación: he aquí no detuve mis labios, Jehová, tú lo sabes.

verses.KJV: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.WEB: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
verses.ASV: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation; I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great assembly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não escondo tua justiça no meio de meu coração; eu declaro tua fidelidade e tua salvação; não escondo tua bondade e tua verdade na grande congregação.
verses.RVR09: No encubrí tu justicia dentro de mi corazón: tu verdad y tu salvación he dicho: no oculté tu misericordia y tu verdad en grande concurso.

verses.KJV: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.WEB: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
verses.ASV: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah; Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, SENHOR, não detenhas para comigo tuas misericórdias; tua bondade e tua fidelidade me guardem continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Tú, Jehová, no apartes de mí tus misericordias: tu misericordia y tu verdad me guarden siempre.

verses.KJV: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
verses.WEB: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
verses.ASV: For innumerable evils have compassed me about; Mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; And my heart hath failed me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque inúmeros males me cercaram; minhas maldades me prenderam, e eu não pude as ver; elas são muito mais do que os cabelos de minha cabeça, e meu coração me desamparou.
verses.RVR09: Porque me han cercado males hasta no haber cuento: hanme comprendido mis maldades, y no puedo levantar la vista: hanse aumentado más que los cabellos de mi cabeza, y mi corazón me falta.

verses.KJV: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.
verses.WEB: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.
verses.ASV: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me: Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja agradável para ti, SENHOR, tu me livrares; SENHOR, apressa-te ao meu socorro.
verses.RVR09: Quieras, oh Jehová, librarme; Jehová, apresúrate á socorrerme.

verses.KJV: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.WEB: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
verses.ASV: Let them be put to shame and confounded together That seek after my soul to destroy it: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envergonhem-se, e sejam juntamente humilhados os que buscam a minha alma para a destruírem; tornem-se para trás e sejam envergonhados os que querem o meu mal.
verses.RVR09: Sean avergonzados y confusos á una los que buscan mi vida para cortarla: vuelvan atrás y avergüéncense los que mi mal desean.

verses.KJV: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.WEB: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.ASV: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam eles assolados como pagamento de sua humilhação, os que dizem de mim: “Ha-ha!”
verses.RVR09: Sean asolados en pago de su afrenta los que me dicen: ¡Ea, ea!

verses.KJV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.
verses.WEB: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”
verses.ASV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: Let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fiquem contentes e se alegrem-se em ti todos aqueles que te buscam; digam continuamente os que amam tua salvação: Engrandecido seja o SENHOR!
verses.RVR09: Gócense y alégrense en ti todos los que te buscan; y digan siempre los que aman tu salud: Jehová sea ensalzado.

verses.KJV: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
verses.WEB: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
verses.ASV: But I am poor and needy; [Yet] the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; Make no tarrying, O my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu [estou] miserável e necessitado; [mas] o SENHOR cuida de mim; tu [és] meu socorro e meu libertador; Deus meu, não demores.
verses.RVR09: Aunque afligido yo y necesitado, Jehová pensará de mí: mi ayuda y mi libertador eres tú; Dios mío, no te tardes.

verses.KJV: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Bem-aventurado aquele que dá atenção ao miserável; o SENHOR o livrará no dia do mal.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. BIENAVENTURADO el que piensa en el pobre: en el día malo lo librará Jehová.

verses.KJV: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.WEB: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive, And he shall be blessed upon the earth; And deliver not thou him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR o guardará, e o manterá vivo; ele será bem-aventurado na terra; e tu não o entregarás à vontade de seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová lo guarde, y le dé vida: sea bienaventurado en la tierra, y no lo entregues á la voluntad de sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
verses.WEB: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing: Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR o sustentará no leito de enfermidade; na doença dele tu mudas toda a sua cama.
verses.RVR09: Jehová lo sustentará sobre el lecho del dolor: mullirás toda su cama en su enfermedad.

verses.KJV: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
verses.WEB: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
verses.ASV: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me: Heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse: SENHOR, tem piedade de mim, sara a minha alma, porque eu pequei contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Yo dije: Jehová, ten misericordia de mí; sana mi alma, porque contra ti he pecado.

verses.KJV: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.WEB: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
verses.ASV: Mine enemies speak evil against me, [saying], When will he die, and his name perish?
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus inimigos falam mal de mim, [dizendo] : Quando ele morrerá? [Quando] o nome dele perecerá?
verses.RVR09: Mis enemigos dicen mal de mí preguntando: ¿Cuándo morirá, y perecerá su nombre?

verses.KJV: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
verses.WEB: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
verses.ASV: And if he come to see [me], he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself: When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se [algum deles] vem me ver, fala coisas sem valor, [e] seu coração junta maldade; ele sai, [e] fala disso.
verses.RVR09: Y si venía á verme, hablaba mentira: su corazón se amontonaba iniquidad; y salido fuera, hablábala.

verses.KJV: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.WEB: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
verses.ASV: All that hate me whisper together against me; Against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que me odeiam murmuram juntamente de mim; contra mim eles planejam o mal para mim, [dizendo] :
verses.RVR09: Reunidos murmuraban contra mí todos los que me aborrecían: contra mí pensaban mal, diciendo de mí:

verses.KJV: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
verses.WEB: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
verses.ASV: An evil disease, [say they], cleaveth fast unto him; And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma doença maligna está posta sobre ele; e aquele que está deitado não se levantará mais.
verses.RVR09: Cosa pestilencial de él se ha apoderado; y el que cayó en cama, no volverá á levantarse.

verses.KJV: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.WEB: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.ASV: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até o homem [que era] meu amigo íntimo, em quem eu confiava, que comia do meu pão; grandemente levantou contra mim seu calcanhar.
verses.RVR09: Aun el hombre de mi paz, en quien yo confiaba, el que de mi pan comía, alzó contra mí el calcañar.

verses.KJV: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.WEB: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
verses.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, That I may requite them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, SENHOR, tem piedade de mim, e levanta-me; e eu lhes darei o pagamento [que merecem] .
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Jehová, ten misericordia de mí, y hazme levantar, y daréles el pago.

verses.KJV: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.WEB: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
verses.ASV: By this I know that thou delightest in me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isto eu sei que tu te agradas de mim: porque meu inimigo não se declara vencedor sobre mim;
verses.RVR09: En esto habré conocido que te he agradado, que mi enemigo no se holgará de mí.

verses.KJV: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
verses.WEB: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
verses.ASV: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto a mim, tu me sustentas em minha sinceridade; e tu me puseste diante de ti para sempre.
verses.RVR09: En cuanto á mí, en mi integridad me has sustentado, y me has hecho estar delante de ti para siempre.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito [seja] o SENHOR, Deus de Israel, para todo o sempre! Amém e Amém!
verses.RVR09: Bendito sea Jehová, el Dios de Israel, por siglos de siglos. Amén y Amén.

verses.KJV: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. Maschil of the sons of Korah. As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de instrução para o regente; dos filhos de Coré: Assim como a corça geme de desejo pelas correntes de águas, assim também minha alma geme de desejo por ti, Deus.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Masquil á los hijos de Coré. COMO el ciervo brama por las corrientes de las aguas, así clama por ti, oh Dios, el alma mía.

verses.KJV: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
verses.WEB: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
verses.ASV: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: When shall I come and appear before God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma tem sede de Deus, do Deus vivente: Quando entrarei, e me apresentarei diante de Deus?
verses.RVR09: Mi alma tiene sed de Dios, del Dios vivo: ¡cuándo vendré, y pareceré delante de Dios!

verses.KJV: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
verses.WEB: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
verses.ASV: My tears have been my food day and night, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Minhas lágrimas têm sido [meu] alimento dia e noite, porque o dia todo me dizem: Onde [está] o teu Deus?
verses.RVR09: Fueron mis lágrimas mi pan de día y de noche, mientras me dicen todos los días: ¿Dónde está tu Dios?

verses.KJV: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
verses.WEB: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
verses.ASV: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, How I went with the throng, and led them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping holyday.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disto eu me lembro, e derramo minha alma em mim [com choros] , porque eu ia entre a multidão, [e] com eles entrava na casa de Deus, com voz de alegria e louvor, na festa da multidão.
verses.RVR09: Acordaréme de estas cosas, y derramaré sobre mí mi alma: cuando pasaré en el número, iré con ellos hasta la casa de Dios, con voz de alegría y de alabanza, haciendo fiesta la multitud.

verses.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
verses.WEB: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
verses.ASV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And [why] art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him [For] the help of his countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma, por que tu estás abatida, e te inquietas em mim? Espera em Deus; pois eu o louvarei pelas suas salvações.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué te abates, oh alma mía, y te conturbas en mí? Espera á Dios; porque aun le tengo de alabar por las saludes de su presencia.

verses.KJV: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
verses.WEB: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
verses.ASV: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: Therefore do I remember thee from the land of the Jordan, And the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus meu, minha alma está abatida dentro de mim; por isso eu me lembro de ti desde a terra do Jordão, e dos hermonitas, desde o monte Mizar.
verses.RVR09: Dios mío, mi alma está en mí abatida: acordaréme por tanto de ti desde tierra del Jordán, y de los Hermonitas, desde el monte de Mizhar.

verses.KJV: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verses.WEB: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
verses.ASV: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterfalls: All thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um abismo chama [outro] abismo, ao ruído de suas cascatas; todos as tuas ondas e vagas têm passado sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Un abismo llama á otro á la voz de tus canales: todas tus ondas y tus olas han pasado sobre mí.

verses.KJV: Yet the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
verses.WEB: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.ASV: [Yet] Jehovah will command his lovingkindness in the day-time; And in the night his song shall be with me, [Even] a prayer unto the God of my life.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] de dia o SENHOR mandará sua misericórdia, e de noite a canção dele estará comigo; uma oração ao Deus de minha vida.
verses.RVR09: De día mandará Jehová su misericordia, y de noche su canción será conmigo, y oración al Dios de mi vida.

verses.KJV: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.WEB: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
verses.ASV: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.ALMEIDA: Direi a Deus, minha rocha: Por que tu te esqueces de mim? Por que eu ando em sofrimento pela opressão do inimigo?
verses.RVR09: Diré á Dios: Roca mía, ¿por qué te has olvidado de mí? ¿Por qué andaré yo enlutado por la opresión del enemigo?

verses.KJV: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
verses.WEB: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
verses.ASV: As with a sword in my bones, mine adversaries reproach me, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus adversários me afrontam com uma ferida mortal em meus ossos, ao me dizerem todo dia: Onde [está] o teu Deus?
verses.RVR09: Mientras se están quebrantando mis huesos, mis enemigos me afrentan, diciéndome cada día: ¿Dónde está tu Dios?

verses.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.WEB: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.ASV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, [Who is] the help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que estás abatida, minha alma? E por que te inquietas em mim? Espera em Deus; porque eu ainda o louvarei; ele é a minha salvação e o meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué te abates, oh alma mía, y por qué te conturbas en mí? Espera á Dios; porque aun le tengo de alabar; es él salvamento delante de mí, y el Dios mío.

verses.KJV: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.WEB: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
