verses.ASV: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze-me justiça, ó Deus, e defende minha causa contra a nação impiedosa; livra-me do homem enganador e perverso;
verses.RVR09: JÚZGAME, oh Dios, y aboga mi causa: líbrame de gente impía, del hombre de engaño é iniquidad.

verses.KJV: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.WEB: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.ASV: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu és o Deus de minha força. Por que tu me rejeitas? Por que ando em sofrimento pela opressão do inimigo?
verses.RVR09: Pues que tú eres el Dios de mi fortaleza, ¿por qué me has desechado? ¿por qué andaré enlutado por la opresión del enemigo?

verses.KJV: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
verses.WEB: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
verses.ASV: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envia tua luz e tua verdade, para que elas me guiem, para que me levem ao monte de tua santidade e a tuas habitações;
verses.RVR09: Envía tu luz y tu verdad: éstas me guiarán, me conducirán al monte de tu santidad, y á tus tabernáculos.

verses.KJV: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
verses.WEB: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
verses.ASV: Then will I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy; And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu entre ao altar de Deus, ao Deus da minha maior alegria, e eu te louve com harpa, ó Deus, meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y entraré al altar de Dios, al Dios alegría de mi gozo; y alabaréte con arpa, oh Dios, Dios mío.

verses.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.WEB: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
verses.ASV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, [Who is] the help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que estás abatida, minha alma? E por que te inquietas em mim? Espera em Deus, porque eu ainda o louvarei; ele é a minha salvação e o meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué te abates, oh alma mía, y por qué te conturbas en mí? Espera á Dios; porque aun le tengo de alabar; es él salvamento delante de mí, y el Dios mío.

verses.KJV: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil. We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução para o regente; dos filhos de Coré: Ó Deus, com nossos ouvidos ouvimos, nossos pais nos contaram a obra que tu fizeste nos seus dias, nos dias antigos.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: de los hijos de Coré: Masquil. OH Dios, con nuestros oídos hemos oído, nuestros padres nos han contado, la obra que hiciste en sus días, en los tiempos antiguos.

verses.KJV: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.WEB: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
verses.ASV: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand; But them thou didst plant: Thou didst afflict the peoples; But them thou didst spread abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para plantá-los, expulsaste as nações com a tua própria mão; para fazê-los crescer, afligiste os povos.
verses.RVR09: Tú con tu mano echaste las gentes, y los plantaste á ellos; afligiste los pueblos, y los arrojaste.

verses.KJV: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.WEB: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
verses.ASV: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them; But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não conquistaram a terra pelas espadas deles, nem o braço deles os salvou; mas sim tua mão direita e o teu braço, e a luz de teu rosto; porque tu os favoreceste.
verses.RVR09: Porque no se apoderaron de la tierra por su espada, ni su brazo los libró; sino tu diestra, y tu brazo, y la luz de tu rostro, porque te complaciste en ellos.

verses.KJV: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.WEB: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!
verses.ASV: Thou art my King, O God: Command deliverance for Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, tu és meu Rei; ordena salvações a Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Tú, oh Dios, eres mi rey: manda saludes á Jacob.

verses.KJV: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.WEB: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
verses.ASV: Through thee will we push down our adversaries: Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por ti venceremos nossos adversários; por teu nome passaremos por cima dos que se levantam contra nós.
verses.RVR09: Por medio de ti sacudiremos á nuestros enemigos: en tu nombre atropellaremos á nuestros adversarios.

verses.KJV: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.WEB: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.
verses.ASV: For I will not trust in my bow, Neither shall my sword save me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque minha confiança não está em meu arco; nem minha espada me salvará.
verses.RVR09: Porque no confiaré en mi arco, ni mi espada me salvará.

verses.KJV: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
verses.WEB: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
verses.ASV: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries, And hast put them to shame that hate us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu nos salvaste de nossos adversários, e envergonhaste aos que nos odeiam.
verses.RVR09: Pues tú nos has guardado de nuestros enemigos, y has avergonzado á los que nos aborrecían.

verses.KJV: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
verses.WEB: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
verses.ASV: In God have we made our boast all the day long, And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós exaltamos a Deus o dia todo; e louvaremos o teu nome para sempre. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: En Dios nos gloriaremos todo tiempo, y para siempre loaremos tu nombre. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.WEB: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
verses.ASV: But now thou hast cast [us] off, and brought us to dishonor, And goest not forth with our hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [agora] tu tens nos rejeitado e envergonhado; e tu não tens saído junto com nossos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Empero nos has desechado, y nos has hecho avergonzar; y no sales en nuestros ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.WEB: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
verses.ASV: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; And they that hate us take spoil for themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu nos fazes fugir do adversário, e aqueles que nos odeiam saqueiam [de nós] para si.
verses.RVR09: Nos hiciste retroceder del enemigo, y saqueáronnos para sí los que nos aborrecían.

verses.KJV: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
verses.WEB: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
verses.ASV: Thou hast made us like sheep [appointed] for food, And hast scattered us among the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu nos entregas como ovelhas para serem comidas, e nos espalhas entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Pusístenos como á ovejas para comida, y esparcístenos entre las gentes.

verses.KJV: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
verses.WEB: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
verses.ASV: Thou sellest thy people for nought, And hast not increased [thy wealth] by their price.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu vendes a teu povo ao preço de nada, e não aumentas o seu valor.
verses.RVR09: Has vendido tu pueblo de balde, y no pujaste en sus precios.

verses.KJV: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.WEB: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
verses.ASV: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu nos pões como humilhação por nossos vizinhos; como escárnio e zombaria pelos que estão ao redor de nós.
verses.RVR09: Pusístenos por vergüenza á nuestros vecinos, por escarnio y por burla á los que nos rodean.

verses.KJV: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.WEB: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.ASV: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu nos pões como provérbio de escárnio entre as nações; como balançar de cabeça entre os povos;
verses.RVR09: Pusístenos por proverbio entre las gentes, por movimiento de cabeza en los pueblos.

verses.KJV: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.WEB: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
verses.ASV: All the day long is my dishonor before me, And the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha humilhação está o dia todo diante de mim; e a vergonha cobre o meu rosto,
verses.RVR09: Cada día mi vergüenza está delante de mí, y cúbreme la confusión de mi rostro,

verses.KJV: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.WEB: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.ASV: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth, By reason of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela voz do adversário e do que insulta; por causa do inimigo e do vingador.
verses.RVR09: Por la voz del que me vitupera y deshonra, por razón del enemigo y del que se venga.

verses.KJV: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.WEB: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
verses.ASV: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo isto veio sobre nós; porém não nos esquecemos de ti, nem traímos o teu pacto.
verses.RVR09: Todo esto nos ha venido, y no nos hemos olvidado de ti; y no hemos faltado á tu pacto.

verses.KJV: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
verses.WEB: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
verses.ASV: Our heart is not turned back, Neither have our steps declined from thy way,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nosso coração não se voltou para trás, nem nossos passos de desviaram de teu caminho.
verses.RVR09: No se ha vuelto atrás nuestro corazón, ni tampoco se han apartado nuestros pasos de tus caminos.

verses.KJV: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.WEB: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.ASV: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu tens nos afligido num lugar de chacais, e nos cobriste com sobra de morte.
verses.RVR09: Cuando nos quebrantaste en el lugar de los dragones, y nos cubriste con sombra de muerte,

verses.KJV: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.WEB: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
verses.ASV: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or spread forth our hands to a strange god;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tivéssemos esquecido do nome do nosso Deus, e estendido nossas mãos a um outro deus,
verses.RVR09: Si nos hubiésemos olvidado del nombre de nuestro Dios, ó alzado nuestras manos á dios ajeno,

verses.KJV: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.WEB: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.ASV: Will not God search this out? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: por acaso Deus não o descobriria? Pois ele conhece os segredos do coração.
verses.RVR09: ¿No demandaría Dios esto? porque él conoce los secretos del corazón.

verses.KJV: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.WEB: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.ASV: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas por causa de ti somos mortos o dia todo; somos considerados como ovelhas para o matadouro.
verses.RVR09: Empero por tu causa nos matan cada día; somos tenidos como ovejas para el matadero.

verses.KJV: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
verses.WEB: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
verses.ASV: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Arise, cast [us] not off for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desperta; por que estás dormindo, Senhor? Acorda, não [nos] rejeites para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Despierta; ¿por qué duermes, Señor? Despierta, no te alejes para siempre.

verses.KJV: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.WEB: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
verses.ASV: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que escondes tua face, e te esqueces de nossa humilhação e de nossa opressão?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué escondes tu rostro, y te olvidas de nuestra aflicción, y de la opresión nuestra?

verses.KJV: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.WEB: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
verses.ASV: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our body cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nossa alma está abatida ao pó; nosso ventre está junto à terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque nuestra alma está agobiada hasta el polvo: nuestro vientre está pegado con la tierra.

verses.KJV: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
verses.WEB: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
verses.ASV: Rise up for our help, And redeem us for thy lovingkindness’ sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te para nosso socorro; e resgata-nos por tua bondade.
verses.RVR09: Levántate para ayudarnos, y redímenos por tu misericordia.

verses.KJV: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves. My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I speak the things which I have made touching the king: My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução e canção de amor, para o regente; dos filhos de Coré, conforme “os lírios”: Meu coração derrama palavras boas; digo meus versos sobre o Rei; minha língua é pena de um habilidoso escriba.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Sosannim: para los hijos de Coré: Masquil: Canción de amores. REBOSA mi corazón palabra buena: refiero yo al Rey mis obras: mi lengua es pluma de escribiente muy ligero.

verses.KJV: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.WEB: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
verses.ASV: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured into thy lips: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu és o mais belo dos filhos dos homens; graça foi derramada em teus lábios, por isso Deus te bendisse para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Haste hermoseado más que los hijos de los hombres; la gracia se derramó en tus labios: por tanto Dios te ha bendecido para siempre.

verses.KJV: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.WEB: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
verses.ASV: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, Thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Põe tua espada ao redor de tua coxa, ó valente; [com] tua glória e tua honra.
verses.RVR09: Cíñete tu espada sobre el muslo, oh valiente, con tu gloria y con tu majestad.

verses.KJV: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.WEB: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
verses.ASV: And in thy majesty ride on prosperously, Because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness: And thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [em] tua glória prosperamente cavalga, sobre a palavra da verdade e da justa mansidão; e tua mão direita ensinará coisas temíveis.
verses.RVR09: Y en tu gloria sé prosperado: cabalga sobre palabra de verdad, y de humildad, y de justicia; y tu diestra te enseñará cosas terribles.

verses.KJV: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
verses.WEB: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
verses.ASV: Thine arrows are sharp; The peoples fall under thee; [They are] in the heart of the king’s enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tuas flechas [são] afiadas no coração dos inimigos do Rei; povos cairão debaixo de ti.
verses.RVR09: Tus saetas agudas con que caerán pueblos debajo de ti, penetrarán en el corazón de los enemigos del Rey.

verses.KJV: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
verses.WEB: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
verses.ASV: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, teu trono é eterno e dura para sempre; o cetro de teu reino [é] cetro de equidade.
verses.RVR09: Tu trono, oh Dios, eterno y para siempre: vara de justicia la vara de tu reino.

verses.KJV: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.WEB: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
verses.ASV: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness: Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu amas a justiça e odeias a maldade; por isso Deus, o teu Deus te ungiu com azeite de alegria, mais que a teus companheiros.
verses.RVR09: Amaste la justicia y aborreciste la maldad: por tanto te ungió Dios, el Dios tuyo, con óleo de gozo sobre tus compañeros.

verses.KJV: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
verses.WEB: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
verses.ASV: All thy garments [smell of] myrrh, and aloes, [and] cassia; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos as tuas roupas [cheiram] a mirra, aloés e cássia; alegram-te desde os palácios de marfim.
verses.RVR09: Mirra, áloe, y casia exhalan todos tus vestidos: en estancias de marfil te han recreado.

verses.KJV: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.WEB: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
verses.ASV: Kings’ daughters are among thy honorable women: At thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filhas de reis estão entre tuas damas de honra; e a rainha está à tua direita, [ornada] com o valioso ouro de Ofir.
verses.RVR09: Hijas de reyes entre tus ilustres: está la reina á tu diestra con oro de Ophir.

verses.KJV: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
verses.WEB: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
verses.ASV: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, filha, e olha, e inclina os teus ouvidos; e esquece-te de teu povo, e da casa de teu pai.
verses.RVR09: Oye, hija, y mira, é inclina tu oído; y olvida tu pueblo, y la casa de tu padre;

verses.KJV: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
verses.WEB: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
verses.ASV: So will the king desire thy beauty; For he is thy lord; and reverence thou him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei desejará tua beleza; inclina-te a ele, pois ele é teu Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y deseará el rey tu hermosura: é inclínate á él, porque él es tu Señor.

verses.KJV: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
verses.WEB: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
verses.ASV: And the daughter of Tyre [shall be there] with a gift; The rich among the people shall entreat thy favor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a filha de Tiro, os ricos dentre o povo, suplicarão teu favor com presentes.
verses.RVR09: Y las hijas de Tiro vendrán con presente; implorarán tu favor los ricos del pueblo.

verses.KJV: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
verses.WEB: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
verses.ASV: The king’s daughter within [the palace] is all glorious: Her clothing is inwrought with gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gloriosa é a filha do Rei dentro [do palácio] ; de fios de ouro é a sua roupa.
verses.RVR09: Toda ilustre es de dentro la hija del rey: de brocado de oro es su vestido.

verses.KJV: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
verses.WEB: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
verses.ASV: She shall be led unto the king in broidered work: The virgins her companions that follow her Shall be brought unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com roupas bordadas a levarão ao Rei; as virgens atrás dela, suas companheiras, serão trazidas a ti.
verses.RVR09: Con vestidos bordados será llevada al rey; vírgenes en pos de ella: sus compañeras serán traídas á ti.

verses.KJV: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
verses.WEB: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.ASV: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led: They shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Serão trazidas com alegria e grande satisfação; entrarão no palácio do Rei.
verses.RVR09: Serán traídas con alegría y gozo: entrarán en el palacio del rey.

verses.KJV: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
verses.WEB: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
verses.ASV: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez de teus pais, serão teus filhos; tu os porás por príncipes sobre toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: En lugar de tus padres serán tus hijos, á quienes harás príncipes en toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
verses.ASV: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: Therefore shall the peoples give thee thanks for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farei memória de teu nome em toda geração após geração; por isso os povos te louvarão para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Haré perpetua la memoria de tu nombre en todas las generaciones: por lo cual te alabarán los pueblos eternamente y para siempre.

verses.KJV: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of the sons of Korah; set to Alamoth. A Song. God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico sobre “Alamote”; para o regente, dos filhos de Coré: Deus [é] nosso refúgio e força; socorro oportuno nas angústias.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: de los hijos de Coré: Salmo sobre Alamoth. DIOS es nuestro amparo y fortaleza, nuestro pronto auxilio en las tribulaciones.

verses.KJV: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.WEB: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
verses.ASV: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso não temeremos, ainda que a terra se mova, e ainda que as montanhas passem ao interior dos mares;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto no temeremos aunque la tierra sea removida; aunque se traspasen los montes al corazón de la mar.

verses.KJV: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.WEB: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
verses.ASV: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ainda que] suas águas rujam [e] se perturbem, [e] as montanhas tremam por sua braveza. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Bramarán, turbaránse sus aguas; temblarán los montes á causa de su braveza. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.WEB: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
verses.ASV: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Há] um rio cujos ribeiros alegram a cidade de Deus, o santuário das habitações do Altíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Del río sus conductos alegrarán la ciudad de Dios, el santuario de las tiendas del Altísimo.

verses.KJV: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
verses.WEB: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
verses.ASV: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God will help her, and that right early.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus [está] no meio dela; ela não será abalada; Deus a ajudará ao romper da manhã.
verses.RVR09: Dios está en medio de ella; no será conmovida: Dios la ayudará al clarear la mañana.

verses.KJV: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.WEB: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
verses.ASV: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.ALMEIDA: As nações gritarão, os reinos se abalarão; [quando] ele levantou a sua voz, a terra se dissolveu.
verses.RVR09: Bramaron las gentes, titubearon los reinos; dió él su voz, derritióse la tierra.

verses.KJV: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.ASV: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR dos exércitos [está] conosco; o Deus de Jacó [é] nosso alto refúgio. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos es con nosotros; nuestro refugio es el Dios de Jacob. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.WEB: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
verses.ASV: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, observai os feitos do SENHOR, que faz assolações na terra;
verses.RVR09: Venid, ved las obras de Jehová, que ha puesto asolamientos en la tierra.

verses.KJV: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
verses.WEB: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
verses.ASV: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que termina as guerras até o fim da terra; ele quebra o arco e corta a lança; ele queima os carros com fogo.
verses.RVR09: Que hace cesar las guerras hasta los fines de la tierra: que quiebra el arco, corta la lanza, y quema los carros en el fuego.

verses.KJV: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.WEB: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
verses.ASV: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ficai quietos, e sabei que eu sou Deus; eu serei exaltado entre as nações; serei exaltado sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Estad quietos, y conoced que yo soy Dios: ensalzado he de ser entre las gentes, ensalzado seré en la tierra.

verses.KJV: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.ASV: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR dos exércitos [está] conosco; o Deus de Jacó [é] nosso alto refúgio. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos es con nosotros; nuestro refugio es el Dios de Jacob. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo para o regente, dos filhos de Coré: Vós todos os povos, batei palmas; clamai a Deus com voz de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: de los hijos de Coré: Salmo. PUEBLOS todos, batid las manos; aclamad á Dios con voz de júbilo.

verses.KJV: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.WEB: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR Altíssimo [é] temível, o grande Rei sobre toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová el Altísimo es terrible; Rey grande sobre toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.WEB: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
verses.ASV: He subdueth peoples under us, And nations under our feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele subjugará aos povos debaixo de nós, e as nações debaixo de nossos pés.
verses.RVR09: El sujetará á los pueblos debajo de nosotros, y á las gentes debajo de nuestros pies.

verses.KJV: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.WEB: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.ASV: He chooseth our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele escolhe para nós nossa herança, a glória de Jacó, a quem ele amou. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: El nos elegirá nuestras heredades; la hermosura de Jacob, al cual amó. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.WEB: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.ASV: God is gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus sobe com gritos de alegria; o SENHOR, com voz de trombeta.
verses.RVR09: Subió Dios con júbilo, Jehová con sonido de trompeta.

verses.KJV: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.WEB: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
verses.ASV: Sing praises to God, sing praises: Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai louvores a Deus, cantai; cantai louvores ao nosso Rei, cantai.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Dios, cantad: cantad á nuestro Rey, cantad.

verses.KJV: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.WEB: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
verses.ASV: For God is the King of all the earth: Sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus é o Rei de toda a terra; cantai louvores com entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios es el Rey de toda la tierra: cantad con inteligencia.

verses.KJV: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.WEB: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
verses.ASV: God reigneth over the nations: God sitteth upon his holy throne.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus reina sobre as nações; Deus se senta sobre o trono de sua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Reinó Dios sobre las gentes: asentóse Dios sobre su santo trono.

verses.KJV: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
verses.WEB: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
verses.ASV: The princes of the peoples are gathered together [To be] the people of the God of Abraham; For the shields of the earth belong unto God: He is greatly exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os chefes dos povos se juntaram ao povo do Deus de Abraão, porque os escudos da terra pertencem a Deus, [e] ele é muito exaltado.
verses.RVR09: Los príncipes de los pueblos se juntaron al pueblo del Dios de Abraham: porque de Dios son los escudos de la tierra; él es muy ensalzado.

verses.KJV: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.WEB: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
verses.ASV: A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised, In the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico e salmo, dos filhos de Coré: O SENHOR [é] grande e muito louvável, na cidade de nosso Deus, [no] monte de sua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Canción: Salmo de los hijos de Coré. GRANDE es Jehová y digno de ser en gran manera alabado, en la ciudad de nuestro Dios, en el monte de su santuario.

verses.KJV: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.WEB: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
verses.ASV: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, The city of the great King.
verses.ALMEIDA: Belo de se ver e alegria de toda a terra [é] o monte de Sião, nas terras do norte; a cidade do grande Rei.
verses.RVR09: Hermosa provincia, el gozo de toda la tierra es el monte de Sión, á los lados del aquilón, la ciudad del gran Rey.

verses.KJV: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.WEB: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
verses.ASV: God hath made himself known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus [está] em seus palácios, [e] é conhecido como alto refúgio.
verses.RVR09: Dios en sus palacios es conocido por refugio.

verses.KJV: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.WEB: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
verses.ASV: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They passed by together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que os reis se reuniram; eles juntamente passaram
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí los reyes de la tierra se reunieron; pasaron todos.

verses.KJV: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
verses.WEB: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
verses.ASV: They saw it, then were they amazed; They were dismayed, they hasted away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, [quando] a viram, ficaram maravilhados; assombraram-se, fugiram apressadamente.
verses.RVR09: Y viéndola ellos así, maravilláronse, se turbaron, diéronse priesa á huir.

verses.KJV: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.WEB: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.ASV: Trembling took hold of them there, Pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali o temor os tomou, [e sentiram] dores como as de parto.
verses.RVR09: Tomólos allí temblor; dolor, como á mujer que pare.

verses.KJV: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.WEB: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
verses.ASV: With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o vento do oriente tu quebras os navios de Társis.
verses.RVR09: Con viento solano quiebras tú las naves de Tharsis.

verses.KJV: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.WEB: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
verses.ASV: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como nós ouvimos, também vimos na cidade do SENHOR dos exércitos, na cidade do nosso Deus; Deus a firmará para sempre. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Como lo oímos, así hemos visto en la ciudad de Jehová de los ejércitos, en la ciudad de nuestro Dios: afirmarála Dios para siempre. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.WEB: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
verses.ASV: We have thought on thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of thy temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, nós reconhecemos tua bondade no meio de teu templo.
verses.RVR09: Esperamos tu misericordia, oh Dios, en medio de tu templo.

verses.KJV: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.WEB: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.ASV: As is thy name, O God, So is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conforme o teu nome, ó Deus, assim é o louvor a ti, até os confins da terra; tua mão direita está cheia de justiça.
verses.RVR09: Conforme á tu nombre, oh Dios, así es tu loor hasta los fines de la tierra: de justicia está llena tu diestra.

verses.KJV: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.WEB: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
verses.ASV: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of thy judgments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegre-se o monte de Sião, fiquem contentes as filhas de Judá, por causa de teus juízos.
verses.RVR09: Alegraráse el monte de Sión; se gozarán las hijas de Judá por tus juicios.

verses.KJV: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.WEB: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
verses.ASV: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Number the towers thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: Andai ao redor de Sião, e a circundai; contai suas torres.
verses.RVR09: Andad alrededor de Sión, y rodeadla: contad sus torres.

verses.KJV: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.WEB: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
verses.ASV: Mark ye well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces: That ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ponde vosso coração em seus muros de defesa, prestai atenção em seus palácios, para que conteis deles à geração seguinte.
verses.RVR09: Poned vuestro corazón á su antemuro, mirad sus palacios; para que lo contéis á la generación venidera.

verses.KJV: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
verses.WEB: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
verses.ASV: For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide [even] unto death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque este Deus [é] nosso Deus para todo o sempre; ele nos acompanhará até a morte.
verses.RVR09: Porque este Dios es Dios nuestro eternalmente y para siempre: él nos capitaneará hasta la muerte.

verses.KJV: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo para o regente, dos filhos de Coré: Ouvi isto, vós todos os povos; dai ouvidos, todos os moradores do mundo;
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo para los hijos de Coré. OID esto, pueblos todos; escuchad, habitadores todos del mundo:

verses.KJV: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.WEB: both low and high, rich and poor together.
verses.ASV: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.
verses.ALMEIDA: vós, povo, filhos dos homens, tanto os ricos como os pobres.
verses.RVR09: Así los plebeyos como los nobles, el rico y el pobre juntamente.

verses.KJV: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
verses.WEB: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
verses.ASV: My mouth shall speak wisdom; And the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha boca falará da sabedoria; e o pensamento do meu coração [estará cheio de] entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Mi boca hablará sabiduría; y el pensamiento de mi corazón inteligencia.

verses.KJV: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.WEB: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
verses.ASV: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Inclinarei meus ouvidos a uma parábola; ao [som] da harpa declararei o meu enigma.
verses.RVR09: Acomodaré á ejemplos mi oído: declararé con el arpa mi enigma.

verses.KJV: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
verses.WEB: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
verses.ASV: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, When iniquity at my heels compasseth me about?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que temeria eu nos dias do mal, [quando] a maldade dos meus adversários me cercar?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué he de temer en los días de adversidad, cuando la iniquidad de mis insidiadores me cercare?

verses.KJV: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.WEB: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
verses.ASV: They that trust in their wealth, And boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles confiam em seus bens, e se orgulham da abundância de suas riquezas.
verses.RVR09: Los que confían en sus haciendas, y en la muchedumbre de sus riquezas se jactan,

verses.KJV: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
verses.WEB: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
verses.ASV: None [of them] can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ninguém pode livrar o seu irmão, nem pagar a Deus o seu resgate,
verses.RVR09: Ninguno de ellos podrá en manera alguna redimir al hermano, ni dar á Dios su rescate.

verses.KJV: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
verses.WEB: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
verses.ASV: (For the redemption of their life is costly, And it faileth for ever),
verses.ALMEIDA: porque a redenção da sua alma é caríssima, e sempre será insuficiente
verses.RVR09: (Porque la redención de su vida es de gran precio, y no se hará jamás;)

verses.KJV: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
verses.WEB: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
verses.ASV: That he should still live alway, That he should not see corruption.
verses.ALMEIDA: para viver eternamente, e jamais ver a cova.
verses.RVR09: Que viva adelante para siempre, y nunca vea la sepultura.

verses.KJV: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.WEB: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.ASV: For he shall see it. Wise men die; The fool and the brutish alike perish, And leave their wealth to others.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se vê que os sábios morrem, que o tolo e o bruto igualmente perecem; e deixam suas riquezas a outros.
verses.RVR09: Pues se ve que mueren los sabios, así como el insensato y el necio perecen, y dejan á otros sus riquezas.

verses.KJV: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
verses.WEB: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
verses.ASV: Their inward thought is, [that] their houses [shall continue] for ever, [And] their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu pensamento interior é que suas casas serão perpétuas, que suas moradas durarão de geração em geração;dão às terras os seus próprios nomes.
verses.RVR09: En su interior tienen que sus casas serán eternas, y sus habitaciones para generación y generación: llamaron sus tierras de sus nombres.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
verses.WEB: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
verses.ASV: But man [being] in honor abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o ser humano, ainda que em honra, não dura para sempre; semelhante é aos animais, que perecem.
verses.RVR09: Mas el hombre no permanecerá en honra: es semejante á las bestias que perecen.

verses.KJV: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.WEB: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.ASV: This their way is their folly: Yet after them men approve their sayings. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o caminho dos tolos e dos seus seguidores, que se agradam de suas palavras. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Este su camino es su locura: con todo, corren sus descendientes por el dicho de ellos. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
verses.WEB: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
verses.ASV: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd: And the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their beauty shall be for Sheol to consume, That there be no habitation for it.
verses.ALMEIDA: São como ovelhas levados ao Xeol; a morte se alimentará deles. Os corretos os dominarão pela manhã, e sua beleza será consumida no Xeol, longe de sua morada.
verses.RVR09: Como rebaños serán puestos en la sepultura; la muerte se cebará en ellos; y los rectos se enseñorearán de ellos por la mañana: y se consumirá su bien parecer en el sepulcro de su morada.

verses.KJV: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
verses.WEB: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
verses.ASV: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol; For he will receive me. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus resgatará a minha alma da violência do mundo dos mortos, pois ele me tomará [consigo] . (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Empero Dios redimirá mi vida del poder de la sepultura, cuando me tomará. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.ASV: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, When the glory of his house is increased:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas quando um homem enriquece, quando a glória de sua casa se engrandece.
verses.RVR09: No temas cuando se enriquece alguno, cuando aumenta la gloria de su casa;

verses.KJV: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.WEB: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
verses.ASV: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His glory shall not descend after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele, quando morrer, nada levará; nem sua glória o seguirá abaixo.
verses.RVR09: Porque en muriendo no llevará nada, ni descenderá tras él su gloria.

verses.KJV: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
verses.WEB: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
verses.ASV: Though while he lived he blessed his soul (And men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself),
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que, em vida, tenha pronunciado a si mesmo a bênção “Louvam-te ao fazeres o bem a ti”,
verses.RVR09: Si bien mientras viviere, dirá dichosa á su alma: y tú serás loado cuando bien te tratares.

verses.KJV: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.WEB: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
verses.ASV: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light.
verses.ALMEIDA: ele, porém, se juntará à geração de seus pais; nunca mais verão a luz.
verses.RVR09: Entrará á la generación de sus padres: no verán luz para siempre.

verses.KJV: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
verses.WEB: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
verses.ASV: Man that is in honor, and understandeth not, Is like the beasts that perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem em posição de honra que não tem entendimento é semelhante aos animais, que perecem.
verses.RVR09: El hombre en honra que no entiende, semejante es á las bestias que perecen.

verses.KJV: The mighty God, even the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, Jehovah, hath spoken, And called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Asafe: Deus, o SENHOR Deus fala e chama a terra, desde onde o sol nasce até onde ele se põe.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de Asaph. EL Dios de dioses, Jehová, ha hablado, y convocado la tierra desde el nacimiento del sol hasta donde se pone.

verses.KJV: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
verses.WEB: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
verses.ASV: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde Sião, a perfeição da beleza, Deus mostra seu imenso brilho.
verses.RVR09: De Sión, perfección de hermosura, ha Dios resplandecido.

verses.KJV: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
verses.WEB: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
verses.ASV: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence: A fire devoureth before him, And it is very tempestuous round about him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nosso Deus virá, e não ficará calado; fogo queimará adiante dele, e ao redor dele haverá grande tormenta.
verses.RVR09: Vendrá nuestro Dios, y no callará: fuego consumirá delante de él, y en derredor suyo habrá tempestad grande.

verses.KJV: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
verses.WEB: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
verses.ASV: He calleth to the heavens above, And to the earth, that he may judge his people:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele chamará aos céus do alto, e à terra, para julgar a seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Convocará á los cielos de arriba, y á la tierra, para juzgar á su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.WEB: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
verses.ASV: Gather my saints together unto me, Those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ajuntai-me meus santos, que confirmam meu pacto por meio de sacrifício.
verses.RVR09: Juntadme mis santos; los que hicieron conmigo pacto con sacrificio.

verses.KJV: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
verses.WEB: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
verses.ASV: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; For God is judge himself. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: E os céus anunciarão sua justiça, pois o próprio Deus é o juiz. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Y denunciarán los cielos su justicia; porque Dios es el juez. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
verses.WEB: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
verses.ASV: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, [even] thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, povo meu, e eu falarei; eu darei testemunho contra ti, Israel; eu sou Deus, o teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Oye, pueblo mío, y hablaré: escucha, Israel, y testificaré contra ti: yo soy Dios, el Dios tuyo.

verses.KJV: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
verses.WEB: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
verses.ASV: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; And thy burnt-offerings are continually before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não te repreenderei por causa de teus sacrifícios, porque teus holocaustos estão continuamente perante mim.
verses.RVR09: No te reprenderé sobre tus sacrificios, ni por tus holocaustos, que delante de mí están siempre.

verses.KJV: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
verses.WEB: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
verses.ASV: I will take no bullock out of thy house, Nor he-goats out of thy folds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tomarei bezerro de tua casa, [nem] bodes de teus currais;
verses.RVR09: No tomaré de tu casa becerros, ni machos cabríos de tus apriscos.

verses.KJV: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.WEB: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
verses.ASV: For every beast of the forest is mine, And the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todo animal das matas é meu, [e também] os milhares de animais selvagens das montanhas.
verses.RVR09: Porque mía es toda bestia del bosque, y los millares de animales en los collados.

verses.KJV: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
verses.WEB: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
verses.ASV: I know all the birds of the mountains; And the wild beasts of the field are mine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conheço todas as aves das montanhas, e as feras do campo [estão] comigo.
verses.RVR09: Conozco todas las aves de los montes, y en mi poder están las fieras del campo.

verses.KJV: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.WEB: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
verses.ASV: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; For the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu tivesse fome, não te diria, porque meu é o mundo, e tudo o que nele há.
verses.RVR09: Si yo tuviese hambre, no te lo diría á ti: porque mío es el mundo y su plenitud.

verses.KJV: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.WEB: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.ASV: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?
verses.ALMEIDA: Comeria eu carne de touros, ou beberia sangue de bodes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tengo de comer yo carne de toros, ó de beber sangre de machos cabríos?

verses.KJV: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
verses.WEB: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
verses.ASV: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving; And pay thy vows unto the Most High;
verses.ALMEIDA: Oferece a Deus sacrifício de louvor, e paga ao Altíssimo os teus votos.
verses.RVR09: Sacrifica á Dios alabanza, y paga tus votos al Altísimo.

verses.KJV: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
verses.WEB: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
verses.ASV: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E clama a mim no dia da angústia; e eu te farei livre, e tu me glorificarás.
verses.RVR09: E invócame en el día de la angustia: te libraré, y tú me honrarás.

verses.KJV: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
verses.WEB: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
verses.ASV: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, And that thou hast taken my covenant in thy mouth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus diz ao perverso: Para que tu recitas meus estatutos, e pões meu pacto em tua boca?
verses.RVR09: Pero al malo dijo Dios: ¿Qué tienes tú que enarrar mis leyes, y que tomar mi pacto en tu boca,

verses.KJV: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and casteth my words behind thee.
verses.WEB: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
verses.ASV: Seeing that thou hatest instruction, And castest my words behind thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu odeias a repreensão, e lança minhas palavras para detrás de ti.
verses.RVR09: Pues que tú aborreces el castigo, y echas á tu espalda mis palabras?

verses.KJV: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
verses.WEB: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
verses.ASV: When thou sawest a thief, thou consentedst with him, And hast been partaker with adulterers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vês ao ladrão, tu consentes com ele; e tens tua parte com os adúlteros.
verses.RVR09: Si veías al ladrón, tú corrías con él; y con los adúlteros era tu parte.

verses.KJV: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
verses.WEB: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
verses.ASV: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, And thy tongue frameth deceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com tua boca pronuncias o mal, e tua língua gera falsidades.
verses.RVR09: Tu boca metías en mal, y tu lengua componía engaño.

verses.KJV: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
verses.WEB: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
verses.ASV: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; Thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te sentas [e] falas contra teu irmão; contra o filho de tua mãe tu dizes ofensas.
verses.RVR09: Tomabas asiento, y hablabas contra tu hermano; contra el hijo de tu madre ponías infamia.

verses.KJV: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
verses.WEB: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
verses.ASV: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such a one as thyself: [But] I will reprove thee, and set [them] in order before thine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu fazes estas coisas, e eu fico calado; pensavas que eu seria como tu? Eu te condenarei, e mostrarei [teus males] diante de teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Estas cosas hiciste, y yo he callado: pensabas que de cierto sería yo como tú: yo te argüiré, y pondrélas delante de tus ojos.

verses.KJV: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
verses.WEB: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
verses.ASV: Now consider this, ye that forget God, Lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver:
verses.ALMEIDA: Entendei, pois, isto, vós que vos esqueceis de Deus; para que eu não [vos] faça em pedaços, e não haja quem [vos] livre.
verses.RVR09: Entended ahora esto, los que os olvidáis de Dios; no sea que arrebate, sin que nadie libre.

verses.KJV: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
verses.WEB: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
verses.ASV: Whoso offereth the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifieth me; And to him that ordereth his way [aright] Will I show the salvation of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem oferece sacrifício de louvor me glorificará, e ao que cuida de seu caminho, eu lhe mostrarei a salvação de Deus.
verses.RVR09: El que sacrifica alabanza me honrará: y al que ordenare su camino, le mostraré la salud de Dios.

verses.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David; when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba. Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente, quando o profeta Natã veio até ele, depois dele ter praticado adultério com Bate-Seba: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Deus, conforme a tua bondade; desfaz minhas transgressões conforme a abundância de tuas misericórdias.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David, cuando después que entró á Bathsebah, vino á él Nathán el profeta. TEN piedad de mí, oh Dios, conforme á tu misericordia: conforme á la multitud de tus piedades borra mis rebeliones.

verses.KJV: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.WEB: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
verses.ASV: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lava-me bem de minha perversidade, e purifica-me de meu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Lávame más y más de mi maldad, y límpiame de mi pecado.

verses.KJV: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
verses.WEB: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
verses.ASV: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu reconheço minhas transgressões, e meu pecado está continuamente diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo reconozco mis rebeliones; y mi pecado está siempre delante de mí.

verses.KJV: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
verses.WEB: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
verses.ASV: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in thy sight; That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, And be clear when thou judgest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contra ti, somente contra ti pequei, e fiz o mal segundo teus olhos; para que estejas justo no que dizeres, e puro no que julgares.
verses.RVR09: A ti, á ti solo he pecado, y he hecho lo malo delante de tus ojos: porque seas reconocido justo en tu palabra, y tenido por puro en tu juicio.

verses.KJV: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.WEB: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
verses.ASV: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity; And in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que em perversidade fui formado, e em pecado minha mãe me concebeu.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, en maldad he sido formado, y en pecado me concibió mi madre.

verses.KJV: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
verses.WEB: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
verses.ASV: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts; And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que tu te agradas da verdade interior, e no oculto tu me fazes conhecer sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, tú amas la verdad en lo íntimo: y en lo secreto me has hecho comprender sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.WEB: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
verses.ASV: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Limpa-me do pecado com hissopo, e ficarei limpo; lava-me, e eu serei mais branco que a neve.
verses.RVR09: Purifícame con hisopo, y seré limpio: lávame, y seré emblanquecido más que la nieve.

verses.KJV: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.WEB: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
verses.ASV: Make me to hear joy and gladness, That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faça-me ouvir alegria e contentamento, [e] meus ossos, que tu quebraste, se alegrarão.
verses.RVR09: Hazme oir gozo y alegría; y se recrearán los huesos que has abatido.

verses.KJV: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.WEB: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
verses.ASV: Hide thy face from my sins, And blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esconde tua face de meus pecados, e desfaz todas as minhas perversidades.
verses.RVR09: Esconde tu rostro de mis pecados, y borra todas mis maldades.

verses.KJV: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.WEB: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
verses.ASV: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cria em mim um coração puro, ó Deus; e renova um espírito firme em meu interior.
verses.RVR09: Crea en mí, oh Dios, un corazón limpio; y renueva un espíritu recto dentro de mí.

verses.KJV: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
verses.WEB: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.ASV: Cast me not away from thy presence; And take not thy holy Spirit from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me rejeites de tua face, e não tires teu Espírito Santo de mim.
verses.RVR09: No me eches de delante de ti; y no quites de mí tu santo espíritu.

verses.KJV: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
verses.WEB: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
verses.ASV: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Restaura a alegria de tua salvação, e que tu me sustentes com um espírito de boa vontade.
verses.RVR09: Vuélveme el gozo de tu salud; y el espíritu libre me sustente.

verses.KJV: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
verses.WEB: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
verses.ASV: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; And sinners shall be converted unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] eu ensinarei aos transgressores os teus caminhos, e os pecadores se converterão a ti.
verses.RVR09: Enseñaré á los prevaricadores tus caminos; y los pecadores se convertirán á ti.

verses.KJV: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
verses.WEB: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
verses.ASV: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation; [And] my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra-me das [transgressões] por derramamento de sangue, ó Deus, Deus de minha salvação; e minha língua louvará alegremente tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Líbrame de homicidios, oh Dios, Dios de mi salud: cantará mi lengua tu justicia.

verses.KJV: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
verses.WEB: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
verses.ASV: O Lord, open thou my lips; And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abre, Senhor, os meus lábios, e minha boca anunciará louvor a ti.
verses.RVR09: Señor, abre mis labios; y publicará mi boca tu alabanza.

verses.KJV: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
verses.WEB: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
verses.ASV: For thou delightest not in sacrifice; else would I give it: Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu não te agradas de sacrifícios, pois senão eu te daria; tu não te alegras de holocaustos.
verses.RVR09: Porque no quieres tú sacrificio, que yo daría; no quieres holocausto.

verses.KJV: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
verses.WEB: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
verses.ASV: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: A broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os sacrifícios a Deus são um espírito quebrado [em arrependimento] ; tu não desprezarás um coração quebrado e triste.
verses.RVR09: Los sacrificios de Dios son el espíritu quebrantado: al corazón contrito y humillado no despreciarás tú, oh Dios.

verses.KJV: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze bem a Sião conforme tua boa vontade; edifica os muros de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Haz bien con tu benevolencia á Sión: edifica los muros de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
verses.WEB: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
verses.ASV: Then wilt thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, In burnt-offering and whole burnt-offering: Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tu te agradarás dos sacrifícios de justiça, dos holocaustos, e das ofertas queimadas; então oferecerão bezerros sobre teu altar.
verses.RVR09: Entonces te agradarán los sacrificios de justicia, el holocausto ú ofrenda del todo quemada: entonces ofrecerán sobre tu altar becerros.

verses.KJV: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. Maschil of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech. Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? The lovingkindness of God [endureth] continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Davi, para o regente, quando Doegue, o edomita, veio, e contou a Saul, dizendo: Davi veio à casa de Aimeleque: Por que tu, homem poderoso, te orgulhas no mal? A bondade de Deus continua o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Masquil de David, cuando vino Doeg Idumeo y dió cuenta á Saúl, diciéndole: David ha venido á casa de Ahimelech. ¿POR qué te glorías de maldad, oh poderoso? La misericordia de Dios es continua.

verses.KJV: The tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.WEB: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.ASV: Thy tongue deviseth very wickedness, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua língua planeja maldades; [é] como navalha afiada, que gera falsidades.
verses.RVR09: Agravios maquina tu lengua: como navaja amolada hace engaño.

verses.KJV: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
verses.WEB: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
verses.ASV: Thou lovest evil more than good, And lying rather than to speak righteousness. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu amas mais o mal que o bem, [e] a mentira mais do que falar justiça. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Amaste el mal más que el bien; la mentira más que hablar justicia. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
verses.WEB: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
verses.ASV: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu amas todas as palavras de destruição, ó língua enganadora.
verses.RVR09: Has amado toda suerte de palabras perniciosas, engañosa lengua.

verses.KJV: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.WEB: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.ASV: God will likewise destroy thee for ever; He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Deus te derrubará para sempre; ele te tomará, e te arrancará para fora da tenda; e te eliminará de toda a terra dos viventes. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Por tanto Dios te derribará para siempre: te asolará y te arrancará de tu morada, y te desarraigará de la tierra de los vivientes. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
