verses.WEB: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
verses.ASV: The righteous also shall see [it], and fear, And shall laugh at him, [saying],
verses.ALMEIDA: E os justos [o] verão, e temerão; e rirão dele, [dizendo] :
verses.RVR09: Y verán los justos, y temerán; y reiránse de él, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.WEB: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
verses.ASV: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui o homem que não pôs sua força em Deus, mas [preferiu] confiar a abundância de suas riquezas, e fortaleceu em sua maldade.
verses.RVR09: He aquí el hombre que no puso á Dios por su fortaleza, sino que confió en la multitud de sus riquezas, y se mantuvo en su maldad.

verses.KJV: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
verses.ASV: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I trust in the lovingkindness of God for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu [serei] como a oliveira verde na casa de Deus; confio na bondade de Deus para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo estoy como oliva verde en la casa de Dios: en la misericordia de Dios confío perpetua y eternalmente.

verses.KJV: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
verses.WEB: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
verses.ASV: I will give thee thanks for ever, because thou hast done it; And I will hope in thy name, for it is good, in the presence of thy saints.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te louvarei para sempre, por causa do que fizeste; e terei esperança em teu nome, porque tu és bom perante teus santos.
verses.RVR09: Te alabaré para siempre por lo que has hecho: y esperaré en tu nombre, porque es bueno, delante de tus santos.

verses.KJV: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath. Maschil of David. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none that doeth good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Davi, para o regente, sobre “Maalate”: O tolo diz em seu coração: Não há Deus.Eles se corrompem, e cometem abominável perversidade, ninguém há que faça o bem.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Mahalath: Masquil de David. DIJO el necio en su corazón: No hay Dios. Corrompiéronse é hicieron abominable maldad: no hay quien haga bien.

verses.KJV: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
verses.WEB: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
verses.ASV: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus olhou desde os céus para os filhos dos homens, para ver se havia alguém prudente, que buscasse a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Dios desde los cielos miró sobre los hijos de los hombres, por ver si hay algún entendido que busque á Dios.

verses.KJV: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.WEB: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
verses.ASV: Every one of them is gone back; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos se desviaram, juntamente se fizeram detestáveis; ninguém há que faça o bem, nem um sequer.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno se había vuelto atrás; todos se habían corrompido: no hay quien haga bien, no hay ni aun uno.

verses.KJV: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
verses.WEB: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
verses.ASV: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people [as] they eat bread, And call not upon God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Será que não tem conhecimento os praticantes de maldade, que devoram a meu povo, [como se] comessem pão? Eles não clamam a Deus.
verses.RVR09: ¿No tienen conocimiento todos esos que obran iniquidad? que comen á mi pueblo como si comiesen pan: á Dios no han invocado.

verses.KJV: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
verses.WEB: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.
verses.ASV: There were they in great fear, where no fear was; For God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: Thou hast put them to shame, because God hath rejected them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali eles terão grande medo, [onde] não havia medo; porque Deus espalhou os ossos daquele que te cercava; tu os humilhaste, porque Deus os rejeitou.
verses.RVR09: Allí se sobresaltaron de pavor donde no había miedo: porque Dios ha esparcido los huesos del que asentó campo contra ti: los avergonzaste, porque Dios los desechó.

verses.KJV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.WEB: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.ASV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, que de Sião venha a salvação de Israel! Quando Deus restaurar seu povo de seu infortúnio, Jacó jubilará, Israel se alegrará.
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh quién diese de Sión saludes á Israel! En volviendo Dios la cautividad de su pueblo, gozarse ha Jacob, y alegraráse Israel.

verses.KJV: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David; when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us? Save me, O God, by thy name, And judge me in thy might.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Davi, para o regente, para instrumentos de cordas, quando os zifeus vieram, e disseram a Saul: “Não está Davi escondido entre nós?”: Deus, salva-me por teu nome; e faze-me justiça por teu poder.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: en Neginoth: Masquil de David, cuando vinieron los Zipheos y dijeron á Saúl: ¿No está David escondido en nuestra tierra? OH Dios, sálvame por tu nombre, y con tu poder defiéndeme.

verses.KJV: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.WEB: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
verses.ASV: Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, ouve minha oração; inclina teus ouvidos aos dizeres de minha boca;
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, oye mi oración; escucha las razones de mi boca.

verses.KJV: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
verses.WEB: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
verses.ASV: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul: They have not set God before them. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estranhos se levantam contra mim, e [homens] terríveis procuram [matar] a minha alma; não põem a Deus diante dos olhos deles. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Porque extraños se han levantado contra mí, y fuertes buscan mi alma: no han puesto á Dios delante de sí. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
verses.WEB: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
verses.ASV: Behold, God is my helper: The Lord is of them that uphold my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que Deus é o que me socorre; o Senhor [está] com aqueles que sustentam a minha alma.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, Dios es el que me ayuda; el Señor es con los que sostienen mi vida.

verses.KJV: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
verses.WEB: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
verses.ASV: He will requite the evil unto mine enemies: Destroy thou them in thy truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele retribuirá com o mal aos que me espiam [contra mim] ; tu os elimina por tua verdade.
verses.RVR09: El volverá el mal á mis enemigos: córtalos por tu verdad.

verses.KJV: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for it is good.
verses.WEB: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.
verses.ASV: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto thee: I will give thanks unto thy name, O Jehovah, for it is good.
verses.ALMEIDA: De boa vontade eu te oferecerei sacrifícios; louvarei o teu nome, SENHOR, porque é bom.
verses.RVR09: Voluntariamente sacrificaré á ti; alabaré tu nombre, oh Jehová, porque es bueno.

verses.KJV: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
verses.WEB: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
verses.ASV: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath seen [my desire] upon mine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu tens me livrado de toda angústia; e meus olhos verão [o fim] de meus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Porque me ha librado de toda angustia, y en mis enemigos vieron mis ojos mi deseo.

verses.KJV: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David. Give ear to my prayer, O God; And hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Davi, para o regente, com instrumento de cordas: Deus, inclina os teus ouvidos à minha oração; e não te escondas de minha súplica.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: en Neginoth: Masquil de David. ESCUCHA, oh Dios, mi oración, y no te escondas de mi súplica.

verses.KJV: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.WEB: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
verses.ASV: Attend unto me, and answer me: I am restless in my complaint, and moan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Presta atenção em mim, e responde-me; clamo por meu sofrimento, e grito,
verses.RVR09: Estáme atento, y respóndeme: clamo en mi oración, y levanto el grito,

verses.KJV: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.WEB: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
verses.ASV: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast iniquity upon me, And in anger they persecute me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da voz do inimigo, [e] pela opressão do perverso; porque me preparam [suas] maldades, e com furor eles me odeiam.
verses.RVR09: A causa de la voz del enemigo, por la opresión del impío; porque echaron sobre mí iniquidad, y con furor me han amenazado.

verses.KJV: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.WEB: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
verses.ASV: My heart is sore pained within me: And the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu coração sofre dores em meu interior, e terrores de morte caíram sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Mi corazón está doloroso dentro de mí, y terrores de muerte sobre mí han caído.

verses.KJV: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.WEB: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
verses.ASV: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, And horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temor e tremor vêm sobre mim, e o horror me toma por completo.
verses.RVR09: Temor y temblor vinieron sobre mí, y terror me ha cubierto.

verses.KJV: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.WEB: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
verses.ASV: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu digo: Ah, quem me dera se eu tivesse asas como uma pomba! Eu voaria, e pousaria.
verses.RVR09: Y dije: ¡Quién me diese alas como de paloma! volaría yo, y descansaría.

verses.KJV: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.WEB: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
verses.ASV: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu fugiria para longe, e ficaria no deserto. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente huiría lejos: moraría en el desierto. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
verses.WEB: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
verses.ASV: I would haste me to a shelter From the stormy wind and tempest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me apressaria para escapar do vento violento [e] da tempestade.
verses.RVR09: Apresuraríame á escapar del viento tempestuoso, de la tempestad.

verses.KJV: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.WEB: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.ASV: Destroy, O Lord, [and] divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Devora-os, Senhor, divide a língua deles; porque tenho visto violência e briga na cidade.
verses.RVR09: Deshace, oh Señor, divide la lengua de ellos; porque he visto violencia y rencilla en la ciudad.

verses.KJV: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
verses.WEB: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
verses.ASV: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: Iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dia e noite cercam sobre seus muros; perversidade e opressão há dentro dela.
verses.RVR09: Día y noche la rodean sobre sus muros; é iniquidad y trabajo hay en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.WEB: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
verses.ASV: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: Oppression and guile depart not from its streets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Coisas destrutivas [estão] dentro dela; e a falsidade e o engano não sai de suas praças.
verses.RVR09: Agravios hay en medio de ella, y el fraude y engaño no se apartan de sus plazas.

verses.KJV: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.WEB: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
verses.ASV: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; Then I could have borne it: Neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; Then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não [é] um inimigo o que me insulta, pois [se fosse] eu o suportaria; nem é alguém que me odeia o que se engrandece contra mim, pois [se fosse] eu me esconderia dele.
verses.RVR09: Porque no me afrentó un enemigo, lo cual habría soportado; ni se alzó contra mí el que me aborrecía, porque me hubiera ocultado de él:

verses.KJV: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
verses.WEB: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
verses.ASV: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas és tu, homem semelhante a mim; meu guia, e meu conhecido;
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, hombre, al parecer íntimo mío, mi guía, y mi familiar:

verses.KJV: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
verses.WEB: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
verses.ASV: We took sweet counsel together; We walked in the house of God with the throng.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que juntos agradavelmente dávamos conselhos [um ao outro] ; na casa de Deus andávamos entre a multidão.
verses.RVR09: Que juntos comunicábamos dulcemente los secretos, á la casa de Dios andábamos en compañía.

verses.KJV: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.WEB: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
verses.ASV: Let death come suddenly upon them, Let them go down alive into Sheol; For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que a morte os tome de surpresa, e desçam ao Xeol vivos; porque há maldades em suas moradas, e no meio deles.
verses.RVR09: Condenados sean á muerte, desciendan vivos al infierno: porque maldades hay en su compañía, entre ellos.

verses.KJV: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.
verses.WEB: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.
verses.ASV: As for me, I will call upon God; And Jehovah will save me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Clamarei a Deus, e o SENHOR me salvará.
verses.RVR09: Yo á Dios clamaré; y Jehová me salvará.

verses.KJV: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.WEB: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
verses.ASV: Evening, and morning, and at noonday, will I complain, and moan; And he will hear my voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: À tarde, e pela manhã, e ao meio dia, orarei e clamarei; e ele ouvirá a minha voz.
verses.RVR09: Tarde y mañana y á medio día oraré y clamaré; y él oirá mi voz.

verses.KJV: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
verses.WEB: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
verses.ASV: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me; For they were many [that strove] with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele resgatou em paz a minha alma da batalha [que havia] contra mim; porque muitos vieram para me [prejudicar] .
verses.RVR09: El ha redimido en paz mi alma de la guerra contra mí; pues fueron contra mí muchos.

verses.KJV: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
verses.WEB: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.
verses.ASV: God will hear, and answer them, Even he that abideth of old, [Selah [The men] who have no changes, And who fear not God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus ouvirá, e os humilhará, ele que governa desde os princípios dos tempos. (Selá)Porque eles não mudam [de comportamento] , nem temem a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Dios oirá, y los quebrantará luego, el que desde la antigüedad permanece (Selah); por cuanto no se mudan, ni temen á Dios.

verses.KJV: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
verses.WEB: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
verses.ASV: He hath put forth his hands against such as were at peace with him: He hath profaned his covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Meu antigo amigo] se voltou contra os que tinham paz com ele, e violou seu pacto.
verses.RVR09: Extendió sus manos contra sus pacíficos: violó su pacto.

verses.KJV: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
verses.WEB: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
verses.ASV: His mouth was smooth as butter, But his heart was war: His words were softer than oil, Yet were they drawn swords.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua boca é agradável como a manteiga, mas seu coração [deseja] a guerra; suas palavras [parecem] mais suaves que o azeite, mas são espadas prontas para o ataque.
verses.RVR09: Ablandan más que manteca su boca, pero guerra hay en su corazón: suavizan sus palabras más que el aceite, mas ellas son cuchillos.

verses.KJV: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.WEB: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
verses.ASV: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee: He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entrega [tuas preocupações] ao SENHOR, e ele te sustentará; ele não permitirá que o justo fique caído para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Echa sobre Jehová tu carga, y él te sustentará; no dejará para siempre caído al justo.

verses.KJV: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
verses.WEB: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
verses.ASV: But thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, SENHOR, farás com que eles desçam ao poço da perdição; os homens sanguinários e enganadores não viverão a metade de seus dias; e eu confiarei em ti.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, oh Dios, harás descender aquéllos al pozo de la sepultura: los hombres sanguinarios y engañadores no demediarán sus días: empero yo confiaré en ti.

verses.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to Jonath elem rehokim. [A Psalm] of David. Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo “Mictão” de Davi para o regente, conforme “pombas silenciosas ao longe”, quando os filisteus o prenderam em Gate: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Deus, porque o homem procura me devorar; todo o dia ele me oprime em lutas.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre La paloma silenciosa en paraje muy distante. Michtam de David, cuando los Filisteos le prendieron en Gath. TEN misericordia de mí, oh Dios, porque me devoraría el hombre: me oprime combatiéndome cada día.

verses.KJV: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
verses.WEB: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
verses.ASV: Mine enemies would swallow me up all the day long; For they are many that fight proudly against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os inimigos que me espiam querem [me] devorar todo dia; porque muitos lutam contra mim, ó Altíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Apúranme mis enemigos cada día; porque muchos son los que pelean contra mí, oh Altísimo.

verses.KJV: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.WEB: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
verses.ASV: What time I am afraid, I will put my trust in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia em que eu tiver medo, eu confiarei em ti.
verses.RVR09: En el día que temo, yo en ti confío.

verses.KJV: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.WEB: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
verses.ASV: In God (I will praise his word), In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa de Deus eu louvarei sua palavra; confio em Deus, não temerei; o que pode a mera carne fazer contra mim?
verses.RVR09: En Dios alabaré su palabra: en Dios he confiado, no temeré lo que la carne me hiciere.

verses.KJV: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.WEB: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.ASV: All the day long they wrest my words: All their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os dias eles distorcem minhas palavras; todos os pensamentos deles sobre mim são para o mal.
verses.RVR09: Todos los días me contristan mis negocios; contra mí son todos sus pensamientos para mal.

verses.KJV: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.WEB: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
verses.ASV: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps, Even as they have waited for my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se reúnem e se escondem; eles espiam os meus passos, como que esperando a [morte] de minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Reúnense, escóndense, miran ellos atentamente mis pasos, esperando mi vida.

verses.KJV: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
verses.WEB: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
verses.ASV: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eles escaparão em [suas] maldades? Derruba com ira aos povos, ó Deus.
verses.RVR09: ¿Escaparán ellos por la iniquidad? Oh Dios, derriba en tu furor los pueblos.

verses.KJV: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
verses.WEB: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
verses.ASV: Thou numberest my wanderings: Put thou my tears into thy bottle; Are they not in thy book?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu contaste as voltas que dei por causa de meu sofrimento; põe minhas lágrimas em teu odre; não estão elas em teu livro?
verses.RVR09: Mis huídas has tú contado: pon mis lágrimas en tu redoma: ¿no están ellas en tu libro?

verses.KJV: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
verses.WEB: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
verses.ASV: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call: This I know, that God is for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia em que eu clamar, então meus inimigos se voltarão para trás; isto eu sei, que Deus [está] comigo.
verses.RVR09: Serán luego vueltos atrás mis enemigos el día que yo clamare: en esto conozco que Dios es por mí.

verses.KJV: In God will I praise his word: in the Lord will I praise his word.
verses.WEB: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.
verses.ASV: In God (I will praise [his] word), In Jehovah (I will praise [his] word),
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa de Deus eu louvarei [sua] palavra; por causa do SENHOR eu louvarei [sua] palavra.
verses.RVR09: En Dios alabaré su palabra; en Jehová alabaré su palabra.

verses.KJV: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.WEB: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.ASV: In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Em Deus eu confio, não temerei; o que o homem pode me fazer?
verses.RVR09: En Dios he confiado: no temeré lo que me hará el hombre.

verses.KJV: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
verses.WEB: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
verses.ASV: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thank-offerings unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tuas promessas, SENHOR, estão sobre mim; oferecerei agradecimentos a ti;
verses.RVR09: Sobre mí, oh Dios, están tus votos: te tributaré alabanzas.

verses.KJV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
verses.WEB: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
verses.ASV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: [Hast thou] not [delivered] my feet from falling, That I may walk before God In the light of the living?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu resgataste minha alma da morte, e meus pés não [deixaste] tropeçar; para [eu] andar diante de Deus na luz dos viventes.
verses.RVR09: Porque has librado mi vida de la muerte, y mis pies de caída, para que ande delante de Dios en la luz de los que viven.

verses.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David. Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me; For my soul taketh refuge in thee: Yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I take refuge, Until [these] calamities be overpast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo “Mictão” para o regente, conforme “Altachete”; de Davi, quando fugia de diante de Saul, na caverna: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Deus, tem misericórdia de mim; porque minha alma confia em ti, e eu me refugio sob a sombra de tuas asas, até que os [meus] problemas passem de mim.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre No destruyas: Michtam de David, cuando huyó de delante de Saúl á la cueva. TEN misericordia de mí, oh Dios, ten misericordia de mí; porque en ti ha confiado mi alma, y en la sombra de tus alas me ampararé, hasta que pasen los quebrantos.

verses.KJV: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
verses.WEB: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
verses.ASV: I will cry unto God Most High, Unto God that performeth [all things] for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Clamarei ao Deus Altíssimo; a Deus, que cumprirá [sua obra] em mim.
verses.RVR09: Clamaré al Dios Altísimo, al Dios que me favorece.

verses.KJV: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.WEB: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
verses.ASV: He will send from heaven, and save me, [When] he that would swallow me up reproacheth; [Selah God will send forth his lovingkindness and his truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele enviará desde os céus e me livrará, humilhando ao que procura me demorar. (Selá)Deus enviará sua bondade e sua verdade.
verses.RVR09: El enviará desde los cielos, y me salvará de la infamia del que me apura (Selah); Dios enviará su misericordia y su verdad.

verses.KJV: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.WEB: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.ASV: My soul is among lions; I lie among them that are set on fire, Even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma está no meio dos leões, estou deitado [entre] brasas ardentes, filhos de homens, cujos dentes são lanças e flechas, e a língua deles são espada afiada.
verses.RVR09: Mi vida está entre leones; estoy echado entre hijos de hombres encendidos: sus dientes son lanzas y saetas, y su lengua cuchillo agudo.

verses.KJV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.WEB: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
verses.ASV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; [Let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exalta-te sobre os céus, ó Deus; [esteja] tua glória sobre toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Ensálzate sobre los cielos, oh Dios; sobre toda la tierra tu gloria.

verses.KJV: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
verses.WEB: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.
verses.ASV: They have prepared a net for my steps; My soul is bowed down: They have digged a pit before me; They are fallen into the midst thereof themselves. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Prepararam uma rede de armadilha para os meus passos, minha alma [estava] abatida; cavaram perante mim uma cova, [porém] eles mesmos caíram nela. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Red han armado á mis pasos; hase abatido mi alma: hoyo han cavado delante de mí; en medio de él han caído. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.WEB: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
verses.ASV: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.
verses.ALMEIDA: Firme está meu coração, ó Deus; meu coração está firme; eu cantarei, e louvarei com músicas.
verses.RVR09: Pronto está mi corazón, oh Dios, mi corazón está dispuesto: cantaré, y trovaré salmos.

verses.KJV: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.WEB: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
verses.ASV: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desperta-te, ó glória minha! Desperta, lira e harpa; despertarei ao amanhecer.
verses.RVR09: Despierta, oh gloria mía; despierta, salterio y arpa: levantaréme de mañana.

verses.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
verses.WEB: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
verses.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the peoples: I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te louvarei entre os povos, Senhor; cantarei louvores a ti entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Alabarte he en los pueblos, oh Señor; cantaré de ti en las naciones.

verses.KJV: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.WEB: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
verses.ASV: For thy lovingkindness is great unto the heavens, And thy truth unto the skies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tua bondade é grande, [alcança] até os céus; e a tua fidelidade até as nuvens mais altas.
verses.RVR09: Porque grande es hasta los cielos tu misericordia, y hasta las nubes tu verdad.

verses.KJV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.WEB: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.ASV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; [Let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exalta-te sobre os céus, ó Deus; [esteja] tua glória sobre toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Ensálzate sobre los cielos, oh Dios; sobre toda la tierra tu gloria.

verses.KJV: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David. Michtam. Do ye indeed in silence speak righteousness? Do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo “Mictão” de Davi, para o regente, conforme “Altachete”: Congregação, por acaso falais verdadeiramente o que é justo? Vós, Filhos dos homens, julgais corretamente?
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre No destruyas: Michtam de David. OH congregación, ¿pronunciáis en verdad justicia? ¿juzgáis rectamente, hijos de los hombres?

verses.KJV: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.WEB: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.ASV: Nay, in heart ye work wickedness; Ye weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na verdade vós praticais perversidades em [vosso] coração; sobre a terra pesais a violência de vossas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Antes con el corazón obráis iniquidades: hacéis pesar la violencia de vuestras manos en la tierra.

verses.KJV: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.WEB: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
verses.ASV: The wicked are estranged from the womb: They go astray as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os perversos se desviam desde o ventre da mãe; afastam-se desde o ventre os mentirosos.
verses.RVR09: Enajenáronse los impíos desde la matriz; descarriáronse desde el vientre, hablando mentira.

verses.KJV: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
verses.WEB: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
verses.ASV: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: [They are] like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear,
verses.ALMEIDA: O veneno deles [é] semelhante ao veneno de serpente; são como a cobra surda, que tapa seus ouvidos,
verses.RVR09: Veneno tienen semejante al veneno de la serpiente: son como áspide sordo que cierra su oído;

verses.KJV: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.WEB: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
verses.ASV: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers, Charming never so wisely.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para não ouvirem a voz dos encantadores, do encantador sábio em encantamentos.
verses.RVR09: Que no oye la voz de los que encantan, por más hábil que el encantador sea.

verses.KJV: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.
verses.WEB: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.
verses.ASV: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: Break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, quebra os dentes deles em suas bocas; arranca os queixos dos filhos dos leões, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, quiebra sus dientes en sus bocas: quiebra, oh Jehová, las muelas de los leoncillos.

verses.KJV: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.WEB: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
verses.ASV: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace: When he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que eles escorram como águas, que vão embora; quando ele armar sua flecha, sejam eles cortados em pedaços.
verses.RVR09: Córranse como aguas que se van de suyo: en entesando sus saetas, luego sean hechas pedazos.

verses.KJV: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.WEB: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
verses.ASV: [Let them be] as a snail which melteth and passeth away, [Like] the untimely birth of a woman, that hath not seen the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como a lesma, que se desmancha, que [assim] saiam embora; como o aborto de mulher, [assim também] nunca vejam o sol.
verses.RVR09: Pasen ellos como el caracol que se deslíe: como el abortivo de mujer, no vean el sol.

verses.KJV: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
verses.WEB: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
verses.ASV: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will take them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning alike.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que vossas panelas sintam os espinhos, tanto vivos, como aquecidos, ele os arrebatará furiosamente.
verses.RVR09: Antes que vuestras ollas sientan las espinas, así vivos, así airados, los arrebatará él con tempestad.

verses.KJV: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.WEB: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
verses.ASV: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo se alegrará ao ver a vingança; [e] lavará seus pés no sangue do perverso.
verses.RVR09: Alegraráse el justo cuando viere la venganza: sus pies lavará en la sangre del impío.

verses.KJV: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
verses.WEB: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
verses.ASV: So that men shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: Verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o homem dirá: Certamente há recompensa para o justo; certamente há Deus, que julga na terra.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dirá el hombre: Ciertamente hay fruto para el justo; ciertamente hay Dios que juzga en la tierra.

verses.KJV: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: Set me on high from them that rise up against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo “Mictão” de Davi, para o regente, conforme “Altachete”, quando Saul enviou pessoas para vigiarem sua casa e o matarem: Livra-me de meus inimigos, ó Deus meu; protege-me dos que se levantam contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre No destruyas: Michtam de David, cuando envió Saúl, y guardaron la casa para matarlo. LÍBRAME de mis enemigos, oh Dios mío: ponme en salvo de los que contra mí se levantan.

verses.KJV: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.WEB: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
verses.ASV: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from the bloodthirsty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra-me dos que praticam perversidade, e salva-me dos homens sanguinários;
verses.RVR09: Líbrame de los que obran iniquidad, y sálvame de hombres sanguinarios.

verses.KJV: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Lord.
verses.WEB: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.
verses.ASV: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; The mighty gather themselves together against me: Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que eles põem ciladas à minha alma; fortes se juntam contra mim; [ainda que] eu não tenha cometido transgressão nem pecado, ó SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí están acechando mi vida: hanse juntado contra mí fuertes, no por falta mía, ni pecado mío, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.WEB: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
verses.ASV: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: Awake thou to help me, and behold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles correm sem [eu ter] culpa; desperta para me encontrar, e olha.
verses.RVR09: Sin delito mío corren y se aperciben: despierta para venir á mi encuentro, y mira.

verses.KJV: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.WEB: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.
verses.ASV: Even thou, O Jehovah God of hosts, the God of Israel, Arise to visit all the nations: Be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, SENHOR, Deus dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, desperta para julgar a todas estas nações; não tenhas misericórdia de nenhum dos enganadores que praticam perversidade. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Y tú, Jehová Dios de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, despierta para visitar todas las gentes: no hayas misericordia de todos los que se rebelan con iniquidad. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.WEB: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
verses.ASV: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And go round about the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles voltam ao anoitecer, latem como cães, e rodeiam a cidade.
verses.RVR09: Volveránse á la tarde, ladrarán como perros, y rodearán la ciudad.

verses.KJV: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
verses.WEB: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
verses.ASV: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; Swords are in their lips: For who, [say they], doth hear?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vomitam com as bocas deles, seus lábios [são como] espadas; porque [dizem] : Quem ouve?
verses.RVR09: He aquí proferirán con su boca; cuchillos están en sus labios, porque dicen: ¿Quién oye?

verses.KJV: But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.WEB: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
verses.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; Thou wilt have all the nations in derision.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, SENHOR, rirás deles; zombarás de todas as nações.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Jehová, te reirás de ellos, te burlarás de todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
verses.WEB: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
verses.ASV: [Because of] his strength I will give heed unto thee; For God is my high tower.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Por causa] de sua força, eu te aguardarei; porque Deus é o meu refúgio.
verses.RVR09: De su fuerza esperaré yo en ti: porque Dios es mi defensa.

verses.KJV: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
verses.WEB: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
verses.ASV: My God with his lovingkindness will meet me: God will let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Deus que tem bondade para comigo me antecederá; Deus me fará ver [o fim] dos meus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: El Dios de mi misericordia me prevendrá: Dios me hará ver en mis enemigos mi deseo.

verses.KJV: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.WEB: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
verses.ASV: Slay them not, lest my people forget: Scatter them by thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não os mates, para que meu povo não se esqueça; faze-os fugir de um lado para o outro pelo teu poder, e abate-os; ó Senhor, escudo nosso;
verses.RVR09: No los matarás, porque mi pueblo no se olvide: hazlos vagar con tu fortaleza; y abátelos, oh Jehová, escudo nuestro,

verses.KJV: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.WEB: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
verses.ASV: [For] the sin of their mouth, [and] the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Por causa do] pecado da boca deles [e da] palavra de seus lábios; e sejam presos em sua arrogância pelas maldições e pelas mentiras que contam.
verses.RVR09: Por el pecado de su boca, por la palabra de sus labios; y sean presos por su soberbia, y por la maldición y mentira que profieren.

verses.KJV: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.WEB: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.ASV: Consume them in wrath, consume them, so that they shall be no more: And let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, Unto the ends of the earth. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Destrói [-os] em [tua] ira; destrói [-os] para que nunca mais existam; para que saibam que Deus governa em Jacó até os limites da terra. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Acábalos con furor, acábalos, y no sean: y sepan que Dios domina en Jacob hasta los fines de la tierra. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.WEB: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
verses.ASV: And at evening let them return, let them howl like a dog, And go round about the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles voltam ao anoitecer, latem como cães, e rodeiam a cidade.
verses.RVR09: Vuelvan pues á la tarde, y ladren como perros, y rodeen la ciudad.

verses.KJV: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.WEB: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
verses.ASV: They shall wander up and down for food, And tarry all night if they be not satisfied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Andam de um lado para o outro por comida, e rosnam se não estiverem saciados.
verses.RVR09: Anden ellos errantes para hallar qué comer: y si no se saciaren, murmuren.

verses.KJV: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.WEB: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.ASV: But I will sing of thy strength; Yea, I will sing aloud of thy lovingkindness in the morning: For thou hast been my high tower, And a refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu cantarei [sobre] tua força; e pela manhã com alegria louvarei tua bondade; porque tu tens sido meu alto refúgio e abrigo no dia da minha angústia.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero cantaré tu fortaleza, y loaré de mañana tu misericordia: porque has sido mi amparo y refugio en el día de mi angustia.

verses.KJV: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
verses.WEB: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
verses.ASV: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing praises: For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantarei louvores a ti, [que és] minha força; porque Deus é o meu refúgio, ó Deus de bondade para comigo.
verses.RVR09: Fortaleza mía, á ti cantaré; porque eres Dios de mi amparo, Dios de mi misericordia.

verses.KJV: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to Shushan Eduth. Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand. O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo “Mictão” de Davi, de ensinamento, para o regente, conforme “Susanedute”, quando lutou contra os de Arã-Naraim e Arã-Zobá, e Joabe voltou vitorioso, tendo ferido no Vale do Sal a doze mil dos de Edom: Deus, tu nos rejeitaste, e nos quebraste; tu te encheste de ira. [Por favor] , restaura-nos!
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Susan-Heduth: Michtam de David, para enseñar, cuando tuvo guerra contra Aram-Naharaim y contra Aram de Soba, y volvió Joab, é hirió de Edom en el valle de las Salinas doce mil. OH Dios, tú nos has desechado, nos disipaste; te has airado: vuélvete á nosotros.

verses.KJV: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.WEB: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
verses.ASV: Thou hast made the land to tremble; thou hast rent it: Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu fizeste a terra tremer, [e] a abriste; cura suas rachaduras, porque ela está abalada.
verses.RVR09: Hiciste temblar la tierra, abrístela: sana sus quiebras, porque titubea.

verses.KJV: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.WEB: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
verses.ASV: Thou hast showed thy people hard things: Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mostraste ao teu povo coisas duras; nos fizeste beber vinho perturbador.
verses.RVR09: Has hecho ver á tu pueblo duras cosas: hicístenos beber el vino de agitación.

verses.KJV: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.WEB: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.ASV: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Deste uma bandeira aos que te temem, para a erguerem por causa da verdade. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Has dado á los que te temen bandera que alcen por la verdad. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.WEB: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
verses.ASV: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que os teus amados sejam livrados; salva-nos com tua mão direita, e responde-nos.
verses.RVR09: Para que se libren tus amados, salva con tu diestra, y óyeme.

verses.KJV: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.WEB: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.ASV: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus falou em seu santuário: Eu me alegrarei; repartirei a Siquém e medirei o vale de Sucote.
verses.RVR09: Dios pronunció por su santuario; yo me alegraré; partiré á Sichêm, y mediré el valle de Succoth.

verses.KJV: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.WEB: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
verses.ASV: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu [é] Gileade, e meu [é] Manassés; e Efraim [é] a força de minha cabeça; Judá [é] meu legislador.
verses.RVR09: Mío es Galaad, y mío es Manasés; y Ephraim es la fortaleza de mi cabeza; Judá, mi legislador;

verses.KJV: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.WEB: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
verses.ASV: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe: Philistia, shout thou because of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Moabe [é] minha bacia de lavar; sobre Edom lançarei minha sandália; gritarei de alegria sobre a Filístia.
verses.RVR09: Moab, la vasija de mi lavatorio; sobre Edom echaré mi zapato: haz júbilo sobre mí, oh Palestina.

verses.KJV: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.WEB: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
verses.ASV: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem me levará a uma cidade fortificada? Quem me guiará até Edom?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién me llevará á la ciudad fortalecida? ¿quién me llevará hasta Idumea?

verses.KJV: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
verses.WEB: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
verses.ASV: Hast not thou, O God, cast us off? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não serás tu, ó Deus, que tinha nos rejeitado? Não saías tu, ó Deus, com nossos exércitos?
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente, tú, oh Dios, que nos habías desechado; y no salías, oh Dios, con nuestros ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.WEB: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
verses.ASV: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-nos socorro para a angústia; porque a salvação de [origem] humana é inútil.
verses.RVR09: Danos socorro contra el enemigo, que vana es la salud de los hombres.

verses.KJV: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.WEB: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
verses.ASV: Through God we shall do valiantly; For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com Deus faremos coisas grandiosas; e ele atropelará nossos adversários.
verses.RVR09: En Dios haremos proezas; y él hollará nuestros enemigos.

verses.KJV: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; on a stringed instrument. [A Psalm] of David. Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente, com instrumento de cordas: Ouve, ó Deus, o meu clamor; presta atenção à minha oração.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Neginoth: Salmo de David. OYE, oh Dios, mi clamor; á mi oración atiende.

verses.KJV: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.WEB: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.ASV: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o limite da terra eu clamo a ti, pelo sofrimento do meu coração; leva-me para uma rocha alta para mim.
verses.RVR09: Desde el cabo de la tierra clamaré á ti, cuando mi corazón desmayare: á la peña más alta que yo me conduzcas.

verses.KJV: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.WEB: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.ASV: For thou hast been a refuge for me, A strong tower from the enemy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu tens sido o meu refúgio [e] torre forte perante o inimigo.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú has sido mi refugio, y torre de fortaleza delante del enemigo.

verses.KJV: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.WEB: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
verses.ASV: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever: I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu habitarei em tua tenda para sempre; tomarei refúgio [me] escondendo sob tuas asas. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Yo habitaré en tu tabernáculo para siempre: estaré seguro bajo la cubierta de tus alas.

verses.KJV: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.WEB: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
verses.ASV: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast given [me] the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu, ó Deus, ouviste meus votos; tu tens [me] dado a herança dos que temem o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, oh Dios, has oído mis votos, has dado heredad á los que temen tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
verses.WEB: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life; His years shall be as many generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Acrescentarás dias e mais dias ao Rei; seus anos serão como de geração em geração.
verses.RVR09: Días sobre días añadirás al rey: sus años serán como generación y generación.

verses.KJV: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.WEB: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
verses.ASV: He shall abide before God for ever: Oh prepare lovingkindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele habitará para sempre diante de Deus; prepara que [tua] bondade e fidelidade o guardem.
verses.RVR09: Estará para siempre delante de Dios: misericordia y verdad prepara que lo conserven.

verses.KJV: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.WEB: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
verses.ASV: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim cantarei ao teu nome para sempre, para eu pagar meus votos dia após dia.
verses.RVR09: Así cantaré tu nombre para siempre, pagando mis votos cada día.

verses.KJV: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; after the manner of Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. My soul waiteth in silence for God only: From him [cometh] my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi para o regente, conforme “Jedutum”: Certamente minha alma se aquieta por causa de Deus; dele [vem] minha salvação.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: á Jeduthún: Salmo de David. EN Dios solamente está acallada mi alma: de él viene mi salud.

verses.KJV: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.WEB: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
verses.ASV: He only is my rock and my salvation: [He is] my high tower; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente ele [é] minha rocha, minha salvação e meu refúgio; não serei muito abalado.
verses.RVR09: El solamente es mi fuerte, y mi salud; es mi refugio, no resbalaré mucho.

verses.KJV: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
verses.WEB: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
verses.ASV: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay [him], all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando atacareis um homem? Todos vós sereis mortos; [sereis] como um parede tombada e uma cerca derrubada.
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo maquinaréis contra un hombre? Pereceréis todos vosotros, caeréis como pared acostada, como cerca ruinosa.

verses.KJV: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.WEB: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.ASV: They only consult to thrust him down from his dignity; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles somente tomam conselhos sobre como lançá-lo abaixo de sua alta posição; agradam-se de mentiras; falam bem com suas bocas, mas amaldiçoam em seus interiores. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Solamente consultan de arrojarle de su grandeza; aman la mentira, con su boca bendicen, pero maldicen en sus entrañas. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
verses.WEB: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
verses.ASV: My soul, wait thou in silence for God only; For my expectation is from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, porém, ó minha alma, aquieta-te em Deus; porque ele [é] minha esperança.
verses.RVR09: Alma mía, en Dios solamente reposa; porque de él es mi esperanza.

verses.KJV: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.WEB: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
verses.ASV: He only is my rock and my salvation: [He is] my high tower; I shall not be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente ele [é] minha rocha, minha salvação [e] meu refúgio; não me abalarei.
verses.RVR09: El solamente es mi fuerte y mí salud: es mi refugio, no resbalaré.

verses.KJV: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.WEB: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.ASV: With God is my salvation and my glory: The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em Deus [está] minha salvação e minha glória; em Deus [está] minha força e meu refúgio.
verses.RVR09: En Dios está mi salvación y mi gloria: en Dios está la roca de mi fortaleza, y mi refugio.

verses.KJV: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.WEB: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.ASV: Trust in him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Confiai, povo, nele em todo o tempo; derramai vosso coração diante dele; Deus [é] nosso refúgio. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Esperad en él en todo tiempo, oh pueblos; derramad delante de él vuestro corazón: Dios es nuestro amparo. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
verses.WEB: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
verses.ASV: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: In the balances they will go up; They are together lighter than vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os filhos dos seres humanos são nada; os filhos do homem são mentira; pesados juntos [são mais leves] que o vazio.
verses.RVR09: Por cierto, vanidad son los hijos de los hombres, mentira los hijos de varón: pesándolos á todos igualmente en la balanza, serán menos que la vanidad.

verses.KJV: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.WEB: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
verses.ASV: Trust not in oppression, And become not vain in robbery: If riches increase, set not your heart [thereon].
verses.ALMEIDA: Não confieis na opressão, nem no roubo; nem sejais inúteis; quando tiverdes bens, não ponhais [neles vosso] coração.
verses.RVR09: No confiéis en la violencia, ni en la rapiña; no os envanezcáis: si se aumentare la hacienda, no pongáis el corazón en ella.

verses.KJV: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
verses.WEB: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
verses.ASV: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this, That power belongeth unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus falou uma vez; eu ouvi duas vezes: que [de] Deus [vem] o poder.
verses.RVR09: Una vez habló Dios; dos veces he oído esto: Que de Dios es la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.WEB: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
verses.ASV: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth lovingkindness; For thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também é tua, Senhor, a bondade; pois tu pagarás a [cada] homem conforme sua obra.
verses.RVR09: Y de ti, oh Señor, es la misericordia: porque tú pagas á cada uno conforme á su obra.

verses.KJV: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, quando ele estava no deserto de Judá: Deus, tu [és] meu Deus. Eu te busco ao amanhecer; minha alma tem sede de ti, minha carne muito te deseja, em terra seca, cansativa, sem águas.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David, estando en el desierto de Judá. DIOS, Dios mío eres tú: levantaréme á ti de mañana: mi alma tiene sed de ti, mi carne te desea, en tierra de sequedad y transida sin aguas;

verses.KJV: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.WEB: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
verses.ASV: So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary, To see thy power and thy glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que eu te veja em teu santuário, para ver tua força e tua glória.
verses.RVR09: Para ver tu fortaleza y tu gloria, así como te he mirado en el santuario.

verses.KJV: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.WEB: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
verses.ASV: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tua bondade [é] melhor que a vida; meus lábios te louvarão.
verses.RVR09: Porque mejor es tu misericordia que la vida: mis labios te alabarán.

verses.KJV: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.WEB: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
verses.ASV: So will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim te bendirei em minha vida; por teu nome levantarei minhas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Así te bendeciré en mi vida: en tu nombre alzaré mis manos.

verses.KJV: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
verses.WEB: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
verses.ASV: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips;
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma será saciada, como que de gorduras e muita comida; e minha boca te louvará com lábios alegres,
verses.RVR09: Como de meollo y de grosura será saciada mi alma; y con labios de júbilo te alabará mi boca,

verses.KJV: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
verses.WEB: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
verses.ASV: When I remember thee upon my bed, [And] meditate on thee in the night-watches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu me lembrar de ti em minha cama; nas vigílias da noite meus pensamentos estarão em ti.
verses.RVR09: Cuando me acordaré de ti en mi lecho, cuando meditaré de ti en las velas de la noche.

verses.KJV: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.WEB: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
verses.ASV: For thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu tens sido meu socorro; e à sombra de tuas asas cantarei de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Porque has sido mi socorro; y así en la sombra de tus alas me regocijaré.

verses.KJV: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.WEB: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
verses.ASV: My soul followeth hard after thee: Thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma está apegada a ti; tua mão direita me sustenta.
verses.RVR09: Está mi alma apegada á ti: tu diestra me ha sostenido.

verses.KJV: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.WEB: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.ASV: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém aqueles que procuram assolar a minha alma irão para as profundezas da terra.
verses.RVR09: Mas los que para destrucción buscaron mi alma, caerán en los sitios bajos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.WEB: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
verses.ASV: They shall be given over to the power of the sword: They shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles serão derrubados pela força da espada; serão repartidos entre raposas.
verses.RVR09: Destruiránlos á filo de espada; serán porción de las zorras.

verses.KJV: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.WEB: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
verses.ASV: But the king shall rejoice in God: Every one that sweareth by him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o Rei se alegrará em Deus; todo o que por ele jurar se alegrará, porque a boca dos mentirosos será tapada.
verses.RVR09: Empero el rey se alegrará en Dios; será alabado cualquiera que por él jura: porque la boca de los que hablan mentira, será cerrada.

verses.KJV: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint: Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Ouve, Deus, minha voz, em minha meditação [de súplica] ; guarda minha vida do terror do inimigo.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. ESCUCHA, oh Dios, mi voz en mi oración: guarda mi vida del miedo del enemigo.

verses.KJV: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.WEB: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
verses.ASV: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers, From the tumult of the workers of iniquity;
verses.ALMEIDA: Esconde-me do grupo dos malignos, e do ajuntamento dos praticantes de maldade,
verses.RVR09: Escóndeme del secreto consejo de los malignos; de la conspiración de los que obran iniquidad:

verses.KJV: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.WEB: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
verses.ASV: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, And have aimed their arrows, even bitter words,
verses.ALMEIDA: Que afiam sua língua como [se fosse] espada; e armaram palavras amargas [como se fossem] flechas.
verses.RVR09: Que amolaron su lengua como cuchillo, y armaron por su saeta palabra amarga;

verses.KJV: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.WEB: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
verses.ASV: That they may shoot in secret places at the perfect: Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para atirarem no inocente às escondidas; disparam apressadamente contra ele, e não têm medo.
verses.RVR09: Para asaetear á escondidas al íntegro: de improviso lo asaetean, y no temen.
