verses.KJV: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.WEB: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
verses.ASV: They encourage themselves in an evil purpose; They commune of laying snares privily; They say, Who will see them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles são ousados para [fazerem] coisas más, comentam sobre como esconder armadilhas, [e] dizem: Quem as verá?
verses.RVR09: Obstinados en su inicuo designio, tratan de esconder los lazos, y dicen: ¿Quién los ha de ver?

verses.KJV: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.WEB: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
verses.ASV: They search out iniquities; We have accomplished, [say they], a diligent search: And the inward thought and the heart of every one is deep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles buscam por perversidades; procuram tudo o que pode ser procurado, até o interior de [cada] homem, e as profundezas do coração.
verses.RVR09: Inquieren iniquidades, hacen una investigación exacta; y el íntimo pensamiento de cada uno de ellos, así como el corazón, es profundo.

verses.KJV: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.WEB: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
verses.ASV: But God will shoot at them; With an arrow suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Deus os atingirá com flecha de repente; e [logo] serão feridos.
verses.RVR09: Mas Dios los herirá con saeta; de repente serán sus plagas.

verses.KJV: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.WEB: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
verses.ASV: So they shall be made to stumble, their own tongue being against them: All that see them shall wag the head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a língua deles fará com que tropecem em si mesmos; todo aquele que olhar para eles se afastará.
verses.RVR09: Y harán caer sobre sí sus mismas lenguas: se espantarán todos los que los vieren.

verses.KJV: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.WEB: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
verses.ASV: And all men shall fear; And they shall declare the work of God, And shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os homens terão medo, e anunciarão a obra de Deus, e observarão cuidadosamente o que ele fez.
verses.RVR09: Y temerán todos los hombres, y anunciarán la obra de Dios, y entenderán su hecho.

verses.KJV: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.WEB: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
verses.ASV: The righteous shall be glad in Jehovah, and shall take refuge in him; And all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo se alegará no SENHOR, e confiará nele; e todos os corretos de coração [o] glorificarão.
verses.RVR09: Alegraráse el justo en Jehová, y confiaráse en él; y se gloriarán todos los rectos de corazón.

verses.KJV: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm. A Song of David. Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion; And unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo e cântico de Davi, para o regente: A ti, Deus, [pertence] a tranquilidade [e] o louvor em Sião; e a ti será pago o voto.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo: Cántico de David. A TI es plácida la alabanza en Sión, oh Dios: y á ti se pagarán los votos.

verses.KJV: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.WEB: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
verses.ASV: O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, que ouves as orações; toda carne virá a ti.
verses.RVR09: Tú oyes la oración: á ti vendrá toda carne.

verses.KJV: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.WEB: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
verses.ASV: Iniquities prevail against me: As for our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perversidades têm me dominado, [porém] tu tiras a culpa de nossas transgressões.
verses.RVR09: Palabras de iniquidades me sobrepujaron: mas nuestras rebeliones tú las perdonarás.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach [unto thee], That he may dwell in thy courts: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, Thy holy temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado [é] aquele a quem tu escolhes, e [o] fazes aproximar, para que habite em teus cômodos; seremos fartos do bem de tua casa, [na] santidade de teu templo.
verses.RVR09: Dichoso el que tú escogieres, é hicieres llegar á ti, para que habite en tus atrios: seremos saciados del bien de tu casa, de tu santo templo.

verses.KJV: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.WEB: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.
verses.ASV: By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu nos responderá de forma justa [por meio de] coisas temíveis. O Deus de nossa salvação [é] a confiança de todos os limites da terra, e dos lugares mais distantes do mar.
verses.RVR09: Con tremendas cosas, en justicia, nos responderás tú, oh Dios de nuestra salud, esperanza de todos los términos de la tierra, y de los más remotos confines de la mar.

verses.KJV: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.WEB: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
verses.ASV: Who by his strength setteth fast the mountains, Being girded about with might;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele [é] o que firma os montes com sua força, revestido de poder.
verses.RVR09: Tú, el que afirma los montes con su potencia, ceñido de valentía:

verses.KJV: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.WEB: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
verses.ASV: Who stilleth the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o que amansa o ruído dos mares, o ruído de suas ondas, e o tumulto dos povos.
verses.RVR09: El que amansa el estruendo de los mares, el estruendo de sus ondas, y el alboroto de las gentes.

verses.KJV: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.WEB: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
verses.ASV: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Até] os que habitam nos lugares mais distantes temem teus sinais; tu fazes alegres o nascer e o pôr do sol.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto los habitadores de los fines de la tierra temen de tus maravillas. Tú haces alegrar las salidas de la mañana y de la tarde.

verses.KJV: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.WEB: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
verses.ASV: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it, Thou greatly enrichest it; The river of God is full of water: Thou providest them grain, when thou hast so prepared the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu visitas a terra, e a regas; tu a enriqueces; o rio de Deus [está] cheio de águas; tu preparas [a terra] , e lhes dá trigo.
verses.RVR09: Visitas la tierra, y la riegas: en gran manera la enriqueces con el río de Dios, lleno de aguas: preparas el grano de ellos, cuando así la dispones.

verses.KJV: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.WEB: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
verses.ASV: Thou waterest its furrows abundantly; Thou settlest the ridges thereof: Thou makest it soft with showers; Thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enche seus regos de [águas] ,fazendo-as descer em suas margens; com muita chuva a amoleces, [e] abençoas o que dela brota.
verses.RVR09: Haces se empapen sus surcos, haces descender sus canales: ablándasla con lluvias, bendices sus renuevos.

verses.KJV: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.WEB: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
verses.ASV: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; And thy paths drop fatness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Coroas o ano com tua bondade; e teus caminhos transbordam fartura.
verses.RVR09: Tú coronas el año de tus bienes; y tus nubes destilan grosura.

verses.KJV: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.WEB: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
verses.ASV: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness; And the hills are girded with joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles são derramados [sobre] os pastos do deserto; e os morros se revestem de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Destilan sobre las estancias del desierto; y los collados se ciñen de alegría.

verses.KJV: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.WEB: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
verses.ASV: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered over with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os campos se revestem de rebanhos, e os vales são cobertos de trigo; e por isso se alegram e cantam.
verses.RVR09: Vístense los llanos de manadas, y los valles se cubren de grano: dan voces de júbilo, y aun cantan.

verses.KJV: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Song, a Psalm. Make a joyful noise unto God, all the earth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico e salmo para o regente: Gritai de alegria a Deus toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Cántico: Salmo. ACLAMAD á Dios con alegría, toda la tierra:

verses.KJV: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.WEB: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
verses.ASV: Sing forth the glory of his name: Make his praise glorious.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai a glória do nome dele; reconhecei a glória de seu louvor.
verses.RVR09: Cantad la gloria de su nombre: poned gloria en su alabanza.

verses.KJV: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.WEB: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
verses.ASV: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizei a Deus: Tu [és] temível [em] tuas obras; pela grandeza de tua força os teus inimigos se sujeitarão a ti.
verses.RVR09: Decid á Dios: ¡Cuán terribles tus obras! Por lo grande de tu fortaleza te mentirán tus enemigos.

verses.KJV: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.WEB: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
verses.ASV: All the earth shall worship thee, And shall sing unto thee; They shall sing to thy name. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda a terra te adorará, e cantará a ti; cantarão ao teu nome. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Toda la tierra te adorará, y cantará á ti; cantarán á tu nombre. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.WEB: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
verses.ASV: Come, and see the works of God; [He is] terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, e vede os atos de Deus; a obra dele é temível aos filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Venid, y ved las obras de Dios, terrible en hechos sobre los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.WEB: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
verses.ASV: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot: There did we rejoice in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fez o mar ficar seco, passaram o rio a pé; ali nos alegramos nele.
verses.RVR09: Volvió la mar en seco; por el río pasaron á pie; allí en él nos alegramos.

verses.KJV: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.WEB: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
verses.ASV: He ruleth by his might for ever; His eyes observe the nations: Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele governa com seu poder para sempre; seus olhos vigiam as nações; não se exaltem os rebeldes. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: El se enseñorea con su fortaleza para siempre: sus ojos atalayan sobre las gentes: los rebeldes no serán ensalzados. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.WEB: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
verses.ASV: Oh bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of his praise to be heard;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós povos, bendizei a nosso Deus, e fazei ouvir a voz do louvor a ele,
verses.RVR09: Bendecid, pueblos, á nuestro Dios, y haced oir la voz de su alabanza.

verses.KJV: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.WEB: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
verses.ASV: Who holdeth our soul in life, And suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que conserva nossas almas em vida, e não permite que nossos pés se abalem.
verses.RVR09: El es el que puso nuestra alma en vida, y no permitió que nuestros pies resbalasen.

verses.KJV: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.WEB: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
verses.ASV: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu, Deus, tem nos provado; tu nos refinas como se refina a prata.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú nos probaste, oh Dios: ensayástenos como se afina la plata.

verses.KJV: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.WEB: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
verses.ASV: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou layedst a sore burden upon our loins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu nos levaste a uma rede; prendeste-nos em nossas cinturas.
verses.RVR09: Nos metiste en la red; pusiste apretura en nuestros lomos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.WEB: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
verses.ASV: Thou didst cause men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeste um homem cavalgar sobre nossas cabeças; passamos pelo fogo e pela água, porém tu nos tiraste para um [lugar] confortável.
verses.RVR09: Hombres hiciste subir sobre nuestra cabeza; entramos en fuego y en aguas, y sacástenos á hartura.

verses.KJV: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
verses.WEB: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
verses.ASV: I will come into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will pay thee my vows,
verses.ALMEIDA: Entrarei em tua casa com holocaustos; pagarei a ti os meus votos,
verses.RVR09: Entraré en tu casa con holocaustos: te pagaré mis votos,

verses.KJV: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.WEB: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
verses.ASV: Which my lips uttered, And my mouth spake, when I was in distress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que meus lábios pronunciaram, e minha boca falou, quando eu estava angustiado.
verses.RVR09: Que pronunciaron mis labios, y habló mi boca, cuando angustiado estaba.

verses.KJV: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.WEB: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
verses.ASV: I will offer unto thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te oferecerei holocaustos de animais gordos, com incenso de carneiros; prepararei bois com bodes. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Holocaustos de cebados te ofreceré, con perfume de carneros: sacrificaré bueyes y machos cabríos. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.WEB: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
verses.ASV: Come, and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, ouvi, todos vós que temeis a Deus, e eu contarei o que ele fez à minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Venid, oid todos los que teméis á Dios, y contaré lo que ha hecho á mi alma.

verses.KJV: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.WEB: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
verses.ASV: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Clamei a ele com minha boca, e ele foi exaltado pela minha língua.
verses.RVR09: A él clamé con mi boca, y ensalzado fué con mi lengua.

verses.KJV: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
verses.WEB: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
verses.ASV: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu tivesse dado valor para a maldade em meu coração, o Senhor não teria [me] ouvido.
verses.RVR09: Si en mi corazón hubiese yo mirado á la iniquidad, el Señor no me oyera.

verses.KJV: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.WEB: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
verses.ASV: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas certamente Deus [me] ouviu; ele prestou atenção à voz de minha oração.
verses.RVR09: Mas ciertamente me oyó Dios; antendió á la voz de mi súplica.

verses.KJV: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
verses.WEB: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
verses.ASV: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his lovingkindness from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito seja Deus, que não ignorou minha oração, nem sua bondade [se desviou] de mim.
verses.RVR09: Bendito Dios, que no echó de sí mi oración, ni de mí su misericordia.

verses.KJV: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm, a Song. God be merciful unto us, and bless us, [And] cause his face to shine upon us; [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo e cântico, para o regente, com instrumento de cordas: Que Deus tenha misericórdia de nós, e nos abençoe; que ele brilhe seu rosto sobre nós. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: en Neginoth: Salmo: Cántico. DIOS tenga misericordia de nosotros, y nos bendiga; haga resplandecer su rostro sobre nosotros (Selah);

verses.KJV: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.WEB: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
verses.ASV: That thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que o teu caminho seja conhecido na terra, [e] todos as nações [conheçam] tua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Para que sea conocido en la tierra tu camino, en todas las gentes tu salud.

verses.KJV: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.WEB: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.ASV: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvem os povos a ti, ó Deus, louvem a ti todos os povos.
verses.RVR09: Alábente los pueblos, oh Dios; alábente los pueblos todos.

verses.KJV: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.WEB: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
verses.ASV: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And govern the nations upon earth. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Que as nações se alegrem e cantem de alegria, pois tu julgarás aos povos com equidade, e guiarás as nações na terra. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Alégrense y gócense las gentes; porque juzgarás los pueblos con equidad, y pastorearás las naciones en la tierra. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.WEB: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.ASV: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvem os povos a ti, ó Deus, louvem a ti todos os povos.
verses.RVR09: Alábente los pueblos, oh Dios: todos los pueblos te alaben.

verses.KJV: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
verses.WEB: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
verses.ASV: The earth hath yielded its increase: God, even our own God, will bless us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que a terra dê seu fruto, [e] que Deus, nosso Deus, nos abençoe.
verses.RVR09: La tierra dará su fruto: nos bendecirá Dios, el Dios nuestro.

verses.KJV: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.WEB: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.ASV: God will bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus nos abençoará, e todos os limites da terra o temerão.
verses.RVR09: Bendíganos Dios, y témanlo todos los fines de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; A Psalm of David, a Song. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered; Let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo e canção de Davi, para o regente: Deus se levantará, [e] seus inimigos serão dispersos, e os que o odeiam fugirão de sua presença.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David: Canción. LEVÁNTESE Dios, sean esparcidos sus enemigos, y huyan de su presencia los que le aborrecen.

verses.KJV: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.WEB: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.ASV: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como a fumaça se espalha, tu os espalharás; assim como a cera que se derrete diante do fogo, [assim também] os perversos perecerão diante de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Como es lanzado el humo, los lanzarás: como se derrite la cera delante del fuego, así perecerán los impíos delante de Dios.

verses.KJV: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.WEB: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
verses.ASV: But let the righteous be glad; let them exult before God: Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os justos se alegrarão, [e] saltarão de prazer perante Deus, e se encherão de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Mas los justos se alegrarán: gozarse han delante de Dios, y saltarán de alegría.

verses.KJV: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.
verses.WEB: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!
verses.ASV: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: Cast up a highway for him that rideth through the deserts; His name is Jehovah; and exult ye before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai a Deus, cantai louvores ao seu nome; exaltai aquele que anda montado sobre as nuvens, pois EU-SOU é o seu nome; e alegrai [-vos] diante dele.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Dios, cantad salmos á su nombre: ensalzad al que sube sobre los cielos en JAH su nombre, y alegraos delante de él.

verses.KJV: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.WEB: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.ASV: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in his holy habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ele é] o pai dos órfãos, e juiz que defende as viúvas; Deus na habitação de sua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Padre de huérfanos y defensor de viudas, es Dios en la morada de su santuario:

verses.KJV: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verses.WEB: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
verses.ASV: God setteth the solitary in families: He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a parched land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus que faz os solitários viverem em uma família, e liberta os prisioneiros; mas os rebeldes habitam em terra seca.
verses.RVR09: El Dios que hace habitar en familia los solos; que saca á los aprisionados con grillos: mas los rebeldes habitan en sequedad.

verses.KJV: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.WEB: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
verses.ASV: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, When thou didst march through the wilderness; [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, quando tu saías perante teu povo, enquanto caminhavas pelo deserto (Selá),
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, cuando tú saliste delante de tu pueblo, cuando anduviste por el desierto, (Selah,)

verses.KJV: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.WEB: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: The earth trembled, The heavens also dropped [rain] at the presence of God: Yon Sinai [trembled] at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra se abalava, e os céus se derramavam perante a presença de Deus; neste Sinai, diante da presença de Deus, o Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: La tierra tembló; también destilaron los cielos á la presencia de Dios: aquel Sinaí tembló delante de Dios, del Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.WEB: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
verses.ASV: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, Thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu fizeste a chuva cair abundantemente, e firmaste tu herança, que estava cansada.
verses.RVR09: Abundante lluvia esparciste, oh Dios, á tu heredad; y cuando se cansó, tú la recreaste.

verses.KJV: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.WEB: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
verses.ASV: Thy congregation dwelt therein: Thou, O God, didst prepare of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nela o teu rebanho habitou; por tua bondade, Deus, sustentaste ao miserável.
verses.RVR09: Los que son de tu grey han morado en ella: por tu bondad, oh Dios, has provisto al pobre.

verses.KJV: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
verses.WEB: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
verses.ASV: The Lord giveth the word: The women that publish the tidings are a great host.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor falou; grande é o exército das que anunciam as boas novas.
verses.RVR09: El Señor daba palabra: de las evangelizantes había grande ejército.

verses.KJV: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.WEB: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
verses.ASV: Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reis de exércitos fugiam apressadamente; e aquela que ficava em casa repartia os despojos.
verses.RVR09: Huyeron, huyeron reyes de ejércitos; y las que se quedaban en casa partían los despojos.

verses.KJV: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.WEB: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
verses.ASV: When ye lie among the sheepfolds, [It is as] the wings of a dove covered with silver, And her pinions with yellow gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que estivésseis cercados por ambos os lados, [estais protegidos] como que por asas de pomba, cobertas de prata, e suas penas revestidas de ouro.
verses.RVR09: Bien que fuisteis echados entre los tiestos, seréis como las alas de la paloma cubierta de plata, y sus plumas con amarillez de oro.

verses.KJV: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
verses.WEB: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
verses.ASV: When the Almighty scattered kings therein, [It was as when] it snoweth in Zalmon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o Todo-Poderoso espalhou os reis, houve neve em Salmom.
verses.RVR09: Cuando esparció el Omnipotente los reyes en ella, emblanquecióse ésta como la nieve en Salmón.

verses.KJV: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
verses.WEB: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
verses.ASV: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A high mountain is the mountain of Bashan.
verses.ALMEIDA: O monte de Deus [é como] o monte de Basã; [é] um monte bem alto, [como] o monte de Basã.
verses.RVR09: Monte de Dios es el monte de Basán; monte alto el de Basán.

verses.KJV: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.
verses.WEB: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.
verses.ASV: Why look ye askance, ye high mountains, At the mountain which God hath desired for his abode? Yea, Jehovah will dwell [in it] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que olhais com inveja, ó montes altos? A este monte Deus desejou para ser sua habitação; e o SENHOR habitará [nele] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué os levantáis, oh montes altos? Este monte amó Dios para su asiento; ciertamente Jehová habitará en él para siempre.

verses.KJV: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.WEB: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
verses.ASV: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands upon thousands: The Lord is among them, [as in] Sinai, in the sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: As carruagens de Deus são várias dezenas de milhares; o Senhor está entre elas, [como] em Sinai, em [seu] santuário.
verses.RVR09: Los carros de Dios son veinte mil, y más millares de ángeles. El Señor entre ellos, como en Sinaí, así en el santuario.

verses.KJV: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell among them.
verses.WEB: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.
verses.ASV: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led away captives; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, [among] the rebellious also, that Jehovah God might dwell [with them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu subiste ao alto, levaste cativos, recebeste bens dos homens, até dos rebeldes, para que [ali] o SENHOR Deus habitasse.
verses.RVR09: Subiste á lo alto, cautivaste la cautividad, tomaste dones para los hombres, y también para los rebeldes, para que habite entre ellos JAH Dios.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
verses.ASV: Blessed be the Lord, who daily beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito seja o Senhor; dia após dia ele nos carrega; Deus [é] nossa salvação. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Bendito el Señor; cada día nos colma de beneficios el Dios de nuestra salud. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.
verses.WEB: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
verses.ASV: God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto Jehovah the Lord belongeth escape from death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nosso Deus [é] um Deus de salvação; e com o Senhor DEUS há livramento para a morte;
verses.RVR09: Dios, nuestro Dios ha de salvarnos; y de Dios Jehová es el librar de la muerte.

verses.KJV: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
verses.WEB: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
verses.ASV: But God will smite through the head of his enemies, The hairy scalp of such a one as goeth on still in his guiltiness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Deus ferirá a cabeça de seus inimigos, o topo da cabeça, onde ficam os cabelos, daquele que anda na prática de suas transgressões.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente Dios herirá la cabeza de sus enemigos, la cabelluda mollera del que camina en sus pecados.

verses.KJV: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
verses.WEB: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
verses.ASV: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring [them] again from the depths of the sea;
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor disse: Eu [os] farei voltar de Basã; eu [os] farei voltar das profundezas do mar.
verses.RVR09: El Señor dijo: De Basán haré volver, te haré volver de los profundos de la mar:

verses.KJV: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
verses.WEB: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
verses.ASV: That thou mayest crush [them], [dipping] thy foot in blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from [thine] enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que metas teu pé no sangue dos teus inimigos; e nele [também] terá uma parte a língua de cada um de teus cães.
verses.RVR09: Porque tu pie se enrojecerá de sangre de tus enemigos, y de ella la lengua de tus perros.

verses.KJV: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.WEB: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
verses.ASV: They have seen thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Viram teus caminhos, ó Deus; os caminhos de meu Deus, meu Rei, no santuário.
verses.RVR09: Vieron tus caminos, oh Dios; los caminos de mi Dios, de mi Rey, en el santuario.

verses.KJV: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.WEB: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
verses.ASV: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, In the midst of the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os cantores vieram adiante, depois os instrumentistas; entre eles as virgens tocadoras de tamborins.
verses.RVR09: Los cantores iban delante, los tañedores detrás; en medio, las doncellas con adufes.

verses.KJV: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.WEB: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
verses.ASV: Bless ye God in the congregations, Even the Lord, [ye that are] of the fountain of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendizei a Deus nas congregações; [bendizei] ao SENHOR, desde a fonte de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Bendecid á Dios en congregaciones: al Señor, vosotros de la estirpe de Israel.

verses.KJV: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.WEB: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.ASV: There is little Benjamin their ruler, The princes of Judah [and] their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali [está] o pequeno Benjamim, que domina sobre eles; os chefes de Judá e a congregação deles; os chefes de Zebulom, [e] os chefes de Nafitali.
verses.RVR09: Allí estaba el joven Benjamín señoreador de ellos, los príncipes de Judá en su congregación, los príncipes de Zabulón, los príncipes de Nephtalí.

verses.KJV: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.WEB: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
verses.ASV: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: Strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu Deus ordenou tua força; fortalece, ó Deus, o que já operaste por nós.
verses.RVR09: Tu Dios ha ordenado tu fuerza; confirma, oh Dios, lo que has obrado en nosotros.

verses.KJV: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
verses.WEB: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.
verses.ASV: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem Kings shall bring presents unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao teu templo, em Jerusalém, os Reis te trarão presentes.
verses.RVR09: Por razón de tu templo en Jerusalem los reyes te ofrecerán dones.

verses.KJV: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
verses.WEB: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
verses.ASV: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Trampling under foot the pieces of silver: He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Repreende a fera das canas, a multidão de touros, juntamente com as bezerras dos povos; aos que humilham a si mesmos em [troca] de peças e prata; dissipa aos povos que gostam da guerra.
verses.RVR09: Reprime la reunión de gentes armadas, la multitud de toros con los becerros de los pueblos, hasta que todos se sometan con sus piezas de plata: disipa los pueblos que se complacen en la guerra.

verses.KJV: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
verses.WEB: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
verses.ASV: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall haste to stretch out her hands unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Embaixadores virão do Egito; Cuxe correrá para [estender] suas mãos a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Vendrán príncipes de Egipto; Etiopía apresurará sus manos á Dios.

verses.KJV: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
verses.WEB: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—
verses.ASV: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; Oh sing praises unto the Lord; [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Reinos da terra, cantai a Deus; cantai louvores ao Senhor. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Reinos de la tierra, cantad á Dios, cantad al Señor (Selah);

verses.KJV: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
verses.WEB: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
verses.ASV: To him that rideth upon the heaven of heavens, which are of old; Lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele anda montado por entre os céus desde os tempos antigos; eis que sua voz fala poderosamente.
verses.RVR09: Al que cabalga sobre los cielos de los cielos que son de antiguo: he aquí á su voz dará voz de fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
verses.WEB: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
verses.ASV: Ascribe ye strength unto God: His excellency is over Israel, And his strength is in the skies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reconhecei o poder de Deus; sobre Israel [está] sua exaltação, e sua força [está] nas altas nuvens.
verses.RVR09: Atribuid fortaleza á Dios: sobre Israel es su magnificencia, y su poder está en los cielos.

verses.KJV: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
verses.WEB: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
verses.ASV: O God, [thou art] terrible out of thy holy places: The God of Israel, he giveth strength and power unto [his] people. Blessed be God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, tu és temível desde teus santuários; o Deus de Israel é o que dá força e poder ao povo. Bendito seja Deus!
verses.RVR09: Terrible eres, oh Dios, desde tus santuarios: el Dios de Israel, él da fortaleza y vigor á su pueblo. Bendito Dios.

verses.KJV: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of David. Save me, O God; For the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente, conforme “os lírios”: Salva-me, ó Deus, porque as águas têm entrado [e encoberto] a minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Sosannim: Salmo de David. SÁLVAME, oh Dios, porque las aguas han entrado hasta el alma.

verses.KJV: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.WEB: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.ASV: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afundei-me em um profundo lamaçal, onde não se pode ficar em pé; entrei nas profundezas das águas, e a corrente está me levando.
verses.RVR09: Estoy hundido en cieno profundo, donde no hay pie: he venido á abismos de aguas, y la corriente me ha anegado.

verses.KJV: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.WEB: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
verses.ASV: I am weary with my crying; my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já estou cansado de clamar, minha garganta enrouqueceu; meus olhos desfaleceram, enquanto espero pelo meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Cansado estoy de llamar; mi garganta se ha enronquecido; han desfallecido mis ojos esperando á mi Dios.

verses.KJV: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
verses.WEB: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
verses.ASV: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: That which I took not away I have to restore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que me odeiam sem motivo são mais numerosos que os cabelos de minha cabeça; são poderosos os que procuram me arruinar, os que por falsidades se fazem meus inimigos; tive que pagar de volta aquilo que não furtei.
verses.RVR09: Hanse aumentado más que los cabellos de mi cabeza los que me aborrecen sin causa; hanse fortalecido mis enemigos, los que me destruyen sin por qué: he venido pues á pagar lo que no he tomado.

verses.KJV: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.WEB: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
verses.ASV: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, Deus, sabes como sou tolo; e meus pecados não estão escondidos perante ti.
verses.RVR09: Dios, tú sabes mi locura; y mis delitos no te son ocultos.

verses.KJV: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
verses.WEB: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
verses.ASV: Let not them that wait for thee be put to shame through me, O Lord Jehovah of hosts: Let not those that seek thee be brought to dishonor through me, O God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejam envergonhados por minha causa aqueles que te esperam, ó Senhor DEUS dos exércitos; não sejam humilhados por minha causa os que te buscam, ó Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: No sean avergonzados por mi causa los que te esperan, oh Señor Jehová de los ejércitos; no sean confusos por mí los que te buscan, oh Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.WEB: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
verses.ASV: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; Shame hath covered my face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque por causa de ti aguentei ser insultado; a humilhação cobriu o meu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Porque por amor de ti he sufrido afrenta; confusión ha cubierto mi rostro.

verses.KJV: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
verses.WEB: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
verses.ASV: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother’s children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornei-me estranho aos meus irmãos; e desconhecido aos filhos de minha mãe;
verses.RVR09: He sido extrañado de mis hermanos, y extraño á los hijos de mi madre.

verses.KJV: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.WEB: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
verses.ASV: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up; And the reproaches of them that reproach thee are fallen upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o zelo por tua casa me devorou; e os insultos dos que te insultam caíram sobre mim;
verses.RVR09: Porque me consumió el celo de tu casa; y los denuestos de los que te vituperaban, cayeron sobre mí.

verses.KJV: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.WEB: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
verses.ASV: When I wept, [and chastened] my soul with fasting, That was to my reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma chorou e jejuou; porém [mais] insultos vieram sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Y lloré afligiendo con ayuno mi alma; y esto me ha sido por afrenta.

verses.KJV: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.WEB: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
verses.ASV: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vesti-me de saco, mas fui ridicularizado por eles num ditado.
verses.RVR09: Puse además saco por mi vestido; y vine á serles por proverbio.

verses.KJV: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
verses.WEB: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
verses.ASV: They that sit in the gate talk of me; And [I am] the song of the drunkards.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que se sentam à porta falam [mal] de mim; e os bebedores de álcool cantam [piadas] contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Hablaban contra mí los que se sentaban á la puerta, y me zaherían en las canciones de los bebedores de sidra.

verses.KJV: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.WEB: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
verses.ASV: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Jehovah, in an acceptable time: O God, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness, Answer me in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu oro a ti, SENHOR, [no] tempo aceitável. Pela grandeza de tua bondade, responde-me, ó Deus, pela fidelidade de tua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Empero yo enderezaba mi oración á ti, oh Jehová, al tiempo de tu buena voluntad: oh Dios, por la multitud de tu misericordia, por la verdad de tu salud, óyeme.

verses.KJV: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.WEB: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.ASV: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra-me do lamaçal, e não me deixes afundar; seja eu resgatado dos que me odeiam, e das profundezas das águas.
verses.RVR09: Sácame del lodo, y no sea yo sumergido: sea yo libertado de los que me aborrecen, y del profundo de las aguas.

verses.KJV: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.WEB: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
verses.ASV: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não permitas que as correntes de águas me cubram, e que a profundeza não me devore, nem o poço feche sua boca sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: No me anegue el ímpetu de las aguas, ni me suerba la hondura, ni el pozo cierre sobre mí su boca.

verses.KJV: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.WEB: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
verses.ASV: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy lovingkindness is good: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies turn thou unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responde-me, SENHOR; pois boa é tua bondade; olha para mim conforme tua piedade.
verses.RVR09: Oyeme, Jehová, porque apacible es tu misericordia; mírame conforme á la multitud de tus miseraciones.

verses.KJV: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.WEB: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
verses.ASV: And hide not thy face from thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não escondas teu rosto de teu servo; porque estou angustiado; ouve-me depressa.
verses.RVR09: Y no escondas tu rostro de tu siervo; porque estoy angustiado; apresúrate, óyeme.

verses.KJV: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
verses.WEB: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
verses.ASV: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: Ransom me because of mine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vem para perto de minha alma, [e] a liberta; resgata-me por causa de meus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Acércate á mi alma, redímela: líbrame á causa de mis enemigos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
verses.WEB: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
verses.ASV: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor: Mine adversaries are all before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu conheces como me insultam, me envergonham e me humilham; diante de ti estão todos os meus adversários.
verses.RVR09: Tú sabes mi afrenta, y mi confusión, y mi oprobio: delante de ti están todos mis enemigos.

verses.KJV: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.WEB: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
verses.ASV: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.
verses.ALMEIDA: Insultos têm quebrado meu coração, e estou fraquíssimo; e esperei compaixão, porém [houve] nenhuma; [também esperei] por pessoas que me consolassem, mas não os achei.
verses.RVR09: La afrenta ha quebrantado mi corazón, y estoy acongojado: y esperé quien se compadeciese de mí, y no lo hubo: y consoladores, y ninguno hallé.

verses.KJV: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.WEB: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.ASV: They gave me also gall for my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deram-me fel como alimento; e em minha sede me deram vinagre para beber.
verses.RVR09: Pusiéronme además hiel por comida, y en mi sed me dieron á beber vinagre.

verses.KJV: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
verses.WEB: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
verses.ASV: Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, [let it become] a trap.
verses.ALMEIDA: Torne-se a mesa diante deles como que um laço; e aquilo que [lhes] dá segurança [lhes] seja uma armadilha.
verses.RVR09: Sea su mesa delante de ellos por lazo, y lo que es para bien por tropiezo.

verses.KJV: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.WEB: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
verses.ASV: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see; And make their loins continually to shake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam escurecidos os olhos deles, para que não possam ver; e que seus quadris vacilem continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Sean oscurecidos sus ojos para ver, y haz siempre titubear sus lomos.

verses.KJV: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.WEB: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
verses.ASV: Pour out thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of thine anger overtake them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Derrama tua indignação sobre eles; e que sejam tomados pelo ardor de tua ira.
verses.RVR09: Derrama sobre ellos tu ira, y el furor de tu enojo los alcance.

verses.KJV: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
verses.WEB: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
verses.ASV: Let their habitation be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: A habitação deles seja desolada; e que não haja morador nas tendas deles;
verses.RVR09: Sea su palacio asolado: en sus tiendas no haya morador.

verses.KJV: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.WEB: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
verses.ASV: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; And they tell of the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque perseguem [aquele] a quem tu feriste, e contam histórias da dor daqueles a quem tu machucaste.
verses.RVR09: Porque persiguieron al que tú heriste; y cuentan del dolor de los que tú llagaste.

verses.KJV: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.WEB: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
verses.ASV: Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conta como maldade a maldade deles; e não sejam eles agraciados por tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Pon maldad sobre su maldad, y no entren en tu justicia.

verses.KJV: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.WEB: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.ASV: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, And not be written with the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam riscados dos livro da vida; e não estejam eles escritos junto com os justos.
verses.RVR09: Sean raídos del libro de los vivientes, y no sean escritos con los justos.

verses.KJV: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.WEB: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
verses.ASV: But I am poor and sorrowful: Let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu [estou] miserável e em dores; ó Deus, que tua salvação me proteja.
verses.RVR09: Y yo afligido y dolorido, tu salud, oh Dios, me defenderá.

verses.KJV: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.WEB: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.ASV: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvarei o nome de Deus com cântico; e o engrandecerei com agradecimentos.
verses.RVR09: Alabaré yo el nombre de Dios con cántico, ensalzarélo con alabanza.

verses.KJV: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.WEB: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
verses.ASV: And it will please Jehovah better than an ox, [Or] a bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto agradará ao SENHOR mais do que [o sacrifício] de um boi [ou] de um bezerro com chifres e unhas.
verses.RVR09: Y agradará á Jehová más que sacrificio de buey, ó becerro que echa cuernos y uñas.

verses.KJV: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
verses.WEB: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
verses.ASV: The meek have seen it, and are glad: Ye that seek after God, let your heart live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os mansos verão, e se alegrarão; vós que buscais a Deus, vosso coração viverá.
verses.RVR09: Veránlo los humildes, y se gozarán; buscad á Dios, y vivirá vuestro corazón.

verses.KJV: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.WEB: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah heareth the needy, And despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR ouve aos necessitados, e não despreza os prisioneiros que lhe pertencem.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová oye á los menesterosos, y no menosprecia á sus prisioneros.

verses.KJV: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.WEB: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
verses.ASV: Let heaven and earth praise him, The seas, and everything that moveth therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvem a ele os céus, a terra, os mares, e tudo que neles se move;
verses.RVR09: Alábenlo los cielos y la tierra, los mares, y todo lo que se mueve en ellos.

verses.KJV: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.WEB: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
verses.ASV: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Deus salvará a Sião, e construirá as cidades de Judá; e habitarão ali, e a terão como posse.
verses.RVR09: Porque Dios guardará á Sión, y reedificará las ciudades de Judá; y habitarán allí, y la poseerán.

verses.KJV: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.WEB: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.ASV: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it; And they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a semente de seus servos a herdará; e os que amam o nome dele habitarão nela.
verses.RVR09: Y la simiente de sus siervos la heredará, y los que aman su nombre habitarán en ella.

verses.KJV: Make haste, o God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David; to bring to remembrance. [Make haste], O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Memorial de Davi, para o regente: Livra-me Deus; apressa-te para me socorrer, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David, para conmemorar. OH Dios, acude á librarme; apresúrate, oh Dios, á socorrerme.

verses.KJV: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.WEB: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
verses.ASV: Let them be put to shame and confounded That seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envergonhem-se, e sejam confundidos os que procuram [matar] a minha alma; voltem-se para trás, e sejam humilhados os que gostam de me fazer o mal.
verses.RVR09: Sean avergonzados y confusos los que buscan mi vida; sean vueltos atrás y avergonzados los que mi mal desean.

verses.KJV: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.WEB: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.ASV: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say, Aha, aha.
verses.ALMEIDA: Virem-se para trás por causa de sua vergonha os que dizem: “Há, há!”
verses.RVR09: Sean vueltos, en pago de su afrenta hecha, los que dicen: ¡Ah! ¡ah!

verses.KJV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.WEB: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
verses.ASV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrem-se e fiquem contentes em ti todos aqueles que te buscam; aqueles que amam tua salvação digam continuamente: Engrandecido seja Deus!
verses.RVR09: Gócense y alégrense en ti todos los que te buscan; y digan siempre los que aman tu salud: Engrandecido sea Dios.

verses.KJV: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.
verses.WEB: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.
verses.ASV: But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, make no tarrying.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, porém, estou miserável e necessitado; ó Deus, apressa-te a mim; tu [és] meu socorro e meu libertador; não demores, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Yo estoy afligido y menesteroso; apresúrate á mí, oh Dios: ayuda mía y mi libertador eres tú; oh Jehová, no te detengas.

verses.KJV: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.WEB: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
verses.ASV: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge: Let me never be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em ti, SENHOR, confio; nunca me deixes ser envergonhado.
verses.RVR09: EN ti, oh Jehová, he esperado; no sea yo confuso para siempre.

verses.KJV: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.WEB: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
verses.ASV: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me: Bow down thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Resgata-me e livra-me por tua justiça; inclina a mim teus ouvidos, e salva-me.
verses.RVR09: Hazme escapar, y líbrame en tu justicia: inclina tu oído y sálvame.

verses.KJV: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.WEB: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
verses.ASV: Be thou to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sê tu minha rocha [e minha] habitação, para continuamente eu me abrigar nela; tu tens ordenado que eu seja salvo, porque tu [és] minha rocha forte e minha fortaleza.
verses.RVR09: Séme por peña de estancia, adonde recurra yo continuamente: mandado has que yo sea salvo; porque tú eres mi roca, y mi fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.WEB: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.ASV: Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu Deus, livra-me da dominação do perverso, das mãos do injusto e cruel;
verses.RVR09: Dios mío, líbrame de la mano del impío, de la mano del perverso y violento.

verses.KJV: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.
verses.WEB: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
verses.ASV: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah: [Thou art] my trust from my youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu és minha esperança, ó Senhor DEUS; [tu és] minha confiança desde minha juventude.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, oh Señor Jehová, eres mi esperanza: seguridad mía desde mi juventud.

verses.KJV: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
verses.WEB: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
verses.ASV: By thee have I been holden up from the womb; Thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho me apoiado em ti desde o ventre de minha mãe; das entranhas dela me tiraste; eu louvo continuamente a ti.
verses.RVR09: Por ti he sido sustentado desde el vientre: de las entrañas de mi madre tú fuiste el que me sacaste: de ti será siempre mi alabanza.

verses.KJV: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
verses.WEB: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
verses.ASV: I am as a wonder unto many; But thou art my strong refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para muitos fui como prodígio, porém tu és meu forte refúgio.
verses.RVR09: Como prodigio he sido á muchos; y tú mi refugio fuerte.

verses.KJV: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
verses.WEB: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
verses.ASV: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, And with thy honor all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha boca seja cheia de louvores a ti por tua glória o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Sea llena mi boca de tu alabanza, de tu gloria todo el día.

verses.KJV: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.WEB: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
verses.ASV: Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me rejeites no tempo da velhice; não me desampares quando minha força se acabar;
verses.RVR09: No me deseches en el tiempo de la vejez; cuando mi fuerza se acabare, no me desampares.

verses.KJV: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.WEB: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
verses.ASV: For mine enemies speak concerning me; And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque meus inimigos falam contra mim, e os que espiam minha alma tomam conselhos juntos uns com os outros;
verses.RVR09: Porque mis enemigos han tratado de mí; y los que acechan mi alma, consultaron juntamente,

verses.KJV: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
verses.WEB: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
verses.ASV: Saying, God hath forsaken him: Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: Deus o desamparou; persegui, e o tomai, pois já não há quem o livre.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: Dios lo ha dejado: perseguid y tomadle, porque no hay quien le libre.

verses.KJV: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
verses.WEB: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
verses.ASV: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, não fiques longe de mim; Deus meu, apressa-te para me socorrer.
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, no te alejes de mí: Dios mío, acude presto á mi socorro.

verses.KJV: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.WEB: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
verses.ASV: Let them be put to shame [and] consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor that seek my hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam envergonhados e pereçam os adversários de minha alma; cubram-se de humilhação e confusão aqueles que procuram [fazer] mal a mim.
verses.RVR09: Sean avergonzados, fallezcan los adversarios de mi alma; sean cubiertos de vergüenza y de confusión los que mi mal buscan.

verses.KJV: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.WEB: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
verses.ASV: But I will hope continually, And will praise thee yet more and more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu continuamente manterei a esperança, e darei todo o louvor a ti ainda mais.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo siempre esperaré, y añadiré sobre toda tu alabanza.

verses.KJV: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
verses.WEB: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
verses.ASV: My mouth shall tell of thy righteousness, [And] of thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers [thereof].
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha boca contará tua justiça, [e] tua salvação o dia todo, ainda que eu não saiba sua medida.
verses.RVR09: Mi boca publicará tu justicia y tu salud todo el día, aunque no sé el número de ellas.

verses.KJV: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
verses.WEB: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
verses.ASV: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Jehovah: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irei adiante pelos poderes do Senhor DEUS; anunciarei tua justiça, que é somente tua.
verses.RVR09: Vendré á las valentías del Señor Jehová: haré memoria de sola tu justicia.

verses.KJV: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.WEB: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
verses.ASV: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth; And hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, tu tens me ensinado desde minha juventude; e até agora conto tuas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, enseñásteme desde mi mocedad; y hasta ahora he manifestado tus maravillas.

verses.KJV: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
verses.WEB: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
verses.ASV: Yea, even when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not, Until I have declared thy strength unto [the next] generation, Thy might to every one that is to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, que estou velho e de cabelos grisalhos, não me desampares, Deus; enquanto eu não tiver anunciado a força de teu braço a [esta] geração, e teu poder a todos que vierem.
verses.RVR09: Y aun hasta la vejez y las canas; oh Dios, no me desampares, hasta que denuncie tu brazo á la posteridad, tus valentías á todos los que han de venir.

verses.KJV: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
verses.WEB: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?
verses.ASV: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: E tua justiça, Senhor, [alcança] as alturas; porque tu tens feito grandes coisas. Quem é como tu, ó Deus?
verses.RVR09: Y tu justicia, oh Dios, hasta lo excelso; porque has hecho grandes cosas: oh Dios, ¿quién como tú?

verses.KJV: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.WEB: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.ASV: Thou, who hast showed us many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken us again, And wilt bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, que me fizeste ver muitos males e aflições, voltarás a me dar vida; e voltarás a me tirar dos abismos da terra.
verses.RVR09: Tú, que me has hecho ver muchas angustias y males, volverás á darme vida, y de nuevo me levantarás de los abismos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.WEB: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
verses.ASV: Increase thou my greatness, And turn again and comfort me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu aumentarás minha honra e voltarás para me consolar.
verses.RVR09: Aumentarás mi grandeza, y volverás á consolarme.

verses.KJV: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, [Even] thy truth, O my God: Unto thee will I sing praises with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu também te louvarei com instrumento de cordas pela tua fidelidade, ó meu Deus; cantarei a ti com harpa, ó Santo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo yo te alabaré con instrumento de salterio, oh Dios mío: tu verdad cantaré yo á ti en el arpa, oh Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.WEB: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
