verses.ASV: My lips shall shout for joy when I sing praises unto thee; And my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus lábios terão muita alegria, porque cantarei a ti; e também [se alegrará] a minha alma, que tu tens resgatado.
verses.RVR09: Mis labios cantarán cuando á ti salmeare, y mi alma, á la cual redimiste.

verses.KJV: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.WEB: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
verses.ASV: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long; For they are put to shame, for they are confounded, that seek my hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha língua também falará de tua justiça o dia todo, pois já estão envergonhados e humilhados aqueles que procuram me [fazer] mal.
verses.RVR09: Mi lengua hablará también de tu justicia todo el día: por cuanto fueron avergonzados, porque fueron confusos los que mi mal procuraban.

verses.KJV: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
verses.WEB: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of Solomon. Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king’s son.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para Salomão Deus, dá teus juízos ao rei, e tua justiça ao filho do rei.
verses.RVR09: Para Salomón. OH Dios, da tus juicios al rey, y tu justicia al hijo del rey.

verses.KJV: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
verses.WEB: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
verses.ASV: He will judge thy people with righteousness, And thy poor with justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele julgará a teu povo com justiça, e a teus aflitos com juízo.
verses.RVR09: El juzgará tu pueblo con justicia, y tus afligidos con juicio.

verses.KJV: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.WEB: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
verses.ASV: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes trarão paz ao povo, e os morros [trarão] justiça.
verses.RVR09: Los montes llevarán paz al pueblo, y los collados justicia.

verses.KJV: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.WEB: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
verses.ASV: He will judge the poor of the people, He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele julgará os pobres do povo, livrará os filhos do necessitado, e quebrará o opressor.
verses.RVR09: Juzgará los afligidos del pueblo, salvará los hijos del menesteroso, y quebrantará al violento.

verses.KJV: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.WEB: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
verses.ASV: They shall fear thee while the sun endureth, And so long as the moon, throughout all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temerão a ti enquanto durarem o sol e a luz, geração após geração.
verses.RVR09: Temerte han mientras duren el sol y la luna, por generación de generaciones.

verses.KJV: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.WEB: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
verses.ASV: He will come down like rain upon the mown grass, As showers that water the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele descerá como chuva sobre a [erva] cortada, como as chuvas que regam a terra.
verses.RVR09: Descenderá como la lluvia sobre la hierba cortada; como el rocío que destila sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
verses.WEB: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
verses.ASV: In his days shall the righteous flourish, And abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seus dias o justo florescerá, e [haverá] abundância de paz, até que não [haja] mais a lua.
verses.RVR09: Florecerá en sus días justicia, y muchedumbre de paz, hasta que no haya luna.

verses.KJV: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.WEB: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.ASV: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River unto the ends of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele terá domínio de mar a mar; e desde o rio até os limites da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y dominará de mar á mar, y desde el río hasta los cabos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.WEB: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.ASV: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os moradores dos desertos se inclinarão perante sua presença, e seus inimigos lamberão o pó da terra.
verses.RVR09: Delante de él se postrarán los Etiopes; y sus enemigos lamerán la tierra.

verses.KJV: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.WEB: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.ASV: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os reis de Társis e das ilhas trarão presentes; os reis de Sabá e Seba apresentarão bens.
verses.RVR09: Los reyes de Tharsis y de las islas traerán presentes: los reyes de Sheba y de Seba ofrecerán dones.

verses.KJV: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.WEB: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
verses.ASV: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him; All nations shall serve him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os reis se inclinarão a ele; todas as nações o servirão;
verses.RVR09: Y arrodillarse han á él todos los reyes; le servirán todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
verses.WEB: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
verses.ASV: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth, And the poor, that hath no helper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele livrará ao necessitado que clamar, e também ao aflito que não tem quem o ajude.
verses.RVR09: Porque él librará al menesteroso que clamare, y al afligido que no tuviere quien le socorra.

verses.KJV: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.WEB: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
verses.ASV: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele será piedoso para o pobre e necessitado, e salvará as almas dos necessitados.
verses.RVR09: Tendrá misericordia del pobre y del menesteroso, y salvará las almas de los pobres.

verses.KJV: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.WEB: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
verses.ASV: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence; And precious will their blood be in his sight:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele livrará suas almas da falsidade e da violência, e o sangue deles lhe será precioso.
verses.RVR09: De engaño y de violencia redimirá sus almas; y la sangre de ellos será preciosa en sus ojos.

verses.KJV: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.WEB: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.
verses.ASV: And they shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: And men shall pray for him continually; They shall bless him all the day long.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele viverá; e lhe darão ouro de Sabá, e continuamente orarão por ele; o dia todo o bendirão.
verses.RVR09: Y vivirá, y darásele del oro de Seba; y oraráse por él continuamente; todo el día se le bendecirá.

verses.KJV: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.WEB: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
verses.ASV: There shall be abundance of grain in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haverá bastante trigo na terra sobre os cumes dos montes; seu fruto brotará como o Líbano; e desde a cidade florescerão como a erva da terra.
verses.RVR09: Será echado un puño de grano en tierra, en las cumbres de los montes; su fruto hará ruido como el Líbano, y los de la ciudad florecerán como la hierba de la tierra.

verses.KJV: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.WEB: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
verses.ASV: His name shall endure for ever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him; All nations shall call him happy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu nome permanecerá para sempre; enquanto o sol durar, seu nome continuará; e se bendirão nele; todas as nações o chamarão de bem-aventurado.
verses.RVR09: Será su nombre para siempre, perpetuaráse su nombre mientras el sol dure: y benditas serán en él todas las gentes: llamarlo han bienaventurado.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
verses.WEB: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things:
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito [seja] o SENHOR Deus, o Deus de Israel! Somente ele faz [tais] maravilhas!
verses.RVR09: Bendito Jehová Dios, el Dios de Israel, que solo hace maravillas.

verses.KJV: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.WEB: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
verses.ASV: And blessed be his glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen, and Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: E bendito seja seu glorioso nome eternamente; e que sua glória encha toda a terra! Amem, e amém!
verses.RVR09: Y bendito su nombre glorioso para siempre: y toda la tierra sea llena de su gloria. Amén y Amén.

verses.KJV: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.WEB: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
verses.ASV: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Aqui] terminam as orações de Davi, filho de Jessé.
verses.RVR09: Acábanse las oraciones de David, hijo de Isaí.

verses.KJV: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, [Even] to such as are pure in heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Asafe: Sim, certamente Deus [é] bom para Israel, para os limpos de coração.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de Asaph. CIERTAMENTE bueno es Dios á Israel, á los limpios de corazón.

verses.KJV: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.WEB: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
verses.ASV: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu porém, quase que meus pés se desviaram; quase nada [faltou] para meus passos escorregarem.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo, casi se deslizaron mis pies; por poco resbalaron mis pasos.

verses.KJV: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.WEB: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.ASV: For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu tinha inveja dos arrogantes, quando via a prosperidade dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Porque tuve envidia de los insensatos, viendo la prosperidad de los impíos.

verses.KJV: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
verses.WEB: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
verses.ASV: For there are no pangs in their death; But their strength is firm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não há problemas para eles até sua morte, e o vigor deles continua firme.
verses.RVR09: Porque no hay ataduras para su muerte; antes su fortaleza está entera.

verses.KJV: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.WEB: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.ASV: They are not in trouble as [other] men; Neither are they plagued like [other] men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não são tão oprimidos como o homem comum, nem são afligidos como os outros homens;
verses.RVR09: No están ellos en el trabajo humano; ni son azotados con los otros hombres.

verses.KJV: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
verses.WEB: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
verses.ASV: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; Violence covereth them as a garment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eles são rodeados de arrogância como um colar; estão cobertos de violência como [se fosse] um vestido.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto soberbia los corona: cúbrense de vestido de violencia.

verses.KJV: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.WEB: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
verses.ASV: Their eyes stand out with fatness: They have more than heart could wish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus olhos incham de gordura; são excessivos os desejos do coração deles.
verses.RVR09: Sus ojos están salidos de gruesos: logran con creces los antojos del corazón.

verses.KJV: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.WEB: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
verses.ASV: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression: They speak loftily.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles são escarnecedores e oprimem falando mal e falando arrogantemente.
verses.RVR09: Soltáronse, y hablan con maldad de hacer violencia; hablan con altanería.

verses.KJV: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.WEB: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
verses.ASV: They have set their mouth in the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elevam suas bocas ao céu, e suas línguas andam na terra.
verses.RVR09: Ponen en el cielo su boca, y su lengua pasea la tierra.

verses.KJV: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
verses.WEB: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
verses.ASV: Therefore his people return hither: And waters of a full [cup] are drained by them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso seu povo volta para cá, e as águas lhes são espremidas por completo.
verses.RVR09: Por eso su pueblo vuelve aquí, y aguas de lleno les son exprimidas.

verses.KJV: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.WEB: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
verses.ASV: And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizem: Como Deus saberia? Será que o Altíssimo tem conhecimento [disto] ?
verses.RVR09: Y dicen: ¿Cómo sabe Dios? ¿y hay conocimiento en lo alto?

verses.KJV: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
verses.WEB: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
verses.ASV: Behold, these are the wicked; And, being alway at ease, they increase in riches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que estes [são] perversos, sempre estão confortáveis e aumentam seus bens.
verses.RVR09: He aquí estos impíos, sin ser turbados del mundo, alcanzaron riquezas.

verses.KJV: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.WEB: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
verses.ASV: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Cheguei a pensar] : Certamente purifiquei meu coração e lavei minhas mãos na inocência inutilmente,
verses.RVR09: Verdaderamente en vano he limpiado mi corazón, y lavado mis manos en inocencia;

verses.KJV: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.WEB: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
verses.ASV: For all the day long have I been plagued, And chastened every morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sou afligido o dia todo, e castigado toda manhã.
verses.RVR09: Pues he sido azotado todo el día, y empezaba mi castigo por las mañanas.

verses.KJV: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
verses.WEB: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
verses.ASV: If I had said, I will speak thus; Behold, I had dealt treacherously with the generation of thy children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu tivesse dito [isto] , eu falaria dessa maneira; eis que teria decepcionado a geração de teus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Si dijera yo, Discurriré de esa suerte; he aquí habría negado la nación de tus hijos:

verses.KJV: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
verses.WEB: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—
verses.ASV: When I thought how I might know this, It was too painful for me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando tentei entender, isto me pareceu trabalhoso.
verses.RVR09: Pensaré pues para saber esto: es á mis ojos duro trabajo,

verses.KJV: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
verses.WEB: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
verses.ASV: Until I went into the sanctuary of God, And considered their latter end.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que entrei nos santuários de Deus, [e] entendi o fim de tais pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que venido al santuario de Dios, entenderé la postrimería de ellos.

verses.KJV: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
verses.WEB: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
verses.ASV: Surely thou settest them in slippery places: Thou castest them down to destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente tu os fazes escorregarem, [e] os lança em assolações.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente los has puesto en deslizaderos; en asolamientos los harás caer.

verses.KJV: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.WEB: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
verses.ASV: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como eles foram assolados tão repentinamente! Eles se acabaram, [e] se consumiram de medo.
verses.RVR09: ¡Cómo han sido asolados! ¡cuán en un punto! Acabáronse, fenecieron con turbaciones.

verses.KJV: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
verses.WEB: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
verses.ASV: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou wilt despise their image.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o sonho depois de acordar, ó Senhor, quando tu acordares desprezarás a aparência deles;
verses.RVR09: Como sueño del que despierta, así, Señor, cuando despertares, menospreciarás sus apariencias.

verses.KJV: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.WEB: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
verses.ASV: For my soul was grieved, And I was pricked in my heart:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque meu coração tem se amargurado, e meus rins têm sentido dolorosas picadas.
verses.RVR09: Desazonóse á la verdad mi corazón, y en mis riñones sentía punzadas.

verses.KJV: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
verses.WEB: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
verses.ASV: So brutish was I, and ignorant; I was [as] a beast before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então me comportei como tolo, e nada sabia; tornei-me como um animal para contigo.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo era ignorante, y no entendía: era como una bestia acerca de ti.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: Thou hast holden my right hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém [agora estarei] continuamente contigo; tu tens segurado minha mão direita.
verses.RVR09: Con todo, yo siempre estuve contigo: trabaste de mi mano derecha.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.WEB: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt guide me with thy counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me guiarás com teu conselho, e depois me receberás [em] glória.
verses.RVR09: Hasme guiado según tu consejo, y después me recibirás en gloria.

verses.KJV: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
verses.WEB: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
verses.ASV: Whom have I in heaven [but thee]? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem tenho no céu [além de ti] ? E [quando estou] contigo, nada há na terra que eu deseje.
verses.RVR09: ¿A quién tengo yo en los cielos? Y fuera de ti nada deseo en la tierra.

verses.KJV: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.WEB: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.ASV: My flesh and my heart faileth; [But] God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha carne e meu coração desfalecem; [porém] Deus [será] a rocha do meu coração e minha porção para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Mi carne y mi corazón desfallecen: mas la roca de mi corazón y mi porción es Dios para siempre.

verses.KJV: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
verses.WEB: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
verses.ASV: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all them that play the harlot, [departing] from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que os que ficaram longe de ti perecerão; tu destróis todo infiel a ti.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, los que se alejan de ti perecerán: tú cortarás á todo aquel que fornicando, de ti se aparta.

verses.KJV: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.
verses.WEB: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
verses.ASV: But it is good for me to draw near unto God: I have made the Lord Jehovah my refuge, That I may tell of all thy works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [quanto] a mim, bom me é me aproximar de Deus; ponho minha confiança no Senhor DEUS, para que eu conte todas as tuas obras.
verses.RVR09: Y en cuanto á mí, el acercarme á Dios es el bien: he puesto en el Señor Jehová mi esperanza, para contar todas tus obras.

verses.KJV: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.WEB: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
verses.ASV: Maschil of Asaph. O God, why hast thou cast [us] off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Asafe: Deus, por que nos rejeitaste para sempre? [Por que] tua ira fumega contra as ovelhas do teu pasto?
verses.RVR09: Masquil de Asaph. ¿POR qué, oh Dios, nos has desechado para siempre? ¿por qué ha humeado tu furor contra las ovejas de tu dehesa?

verses.KJV: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.WEB: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
verses.ASV: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast gotten of old, Which thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of thine inheritance; [And] mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te do teu povo, que tu compraste desde a antiguidade; a tribo de tua herança, que resgataste; o monte Sião, em que habitaste.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de tu congregación, que adquiriste de antiguo, cuando redimiste la vara de tu heredad; este monte de Sión, donde has habitado.

verses.KJV: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.WEB: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
verses.ASV: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual ruins, All the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Percorre as ruínas duradouras, tudo que o inimigo destruiu no santuário.
verses.RVR09: Levanta tus pies á los asolamientos eternos: á todo enemigo que ha hecho mal en el santuario.

verses.KJV: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.WEB: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
verses.ASV: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of thine assembly; They have set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os teus inimigos rugiram no meio de tuas assembleias; puseram por sinais de vitória os símbolos deles.
verses.RVR09: Tus enemigos han bramado en medio de tus sinagogas: han puesto sus divisas por señas.

verses.KJV: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.WEB: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
verses.ASV: They seemed as men that lifted up Axes upon a thicket of trees.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles eram como o que levantam machados contra os troncos das árvores.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera se hacía famoso según que había levantado el hacha sobre los gruesos maderos.

verses.KJV: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.WEB: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
verses.ASV: And now all the carved work thereof They break down with hatchet and hammers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, com machados e martelos, quebraram todas as obras entalhadas.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora con hachas y martillos han quebrado todas sus entalladuras.

verses.KJV: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
verses.WEB: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
verses.ASV: They have set thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of thy name [by casting it] to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Puseram fogo no teu santuário; profanaram [levando] ao chão o lugar onde o teu nome habita.
verses.RVR09: Han puesto á fuego tus santuarios, han profanado el tabernáculo de tu nombre echándolo á tierra.

verses.KJV: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
verses.WEB: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
verses.ASV: They said in their heart, Let us make havoc of them altogether: They have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disseram em seus corações: Nós os destruiremos por completo; serão queimadas todas as assembleias de Deus na terra.
verses.RVR09: Dijeron en su corazón: Destruyámoslos de una vez; han quemado todas las sinagogas de Dios en la tierra.

verses.KJV: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.WEB: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
verses.ASV: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já não vemos os nossos sinais; já não há mais profeta; e ninguém entre nós sabe até quando será assim.
verses.RVR09: No vemos ya nuestras señales: no hay más profeta; ni con nosotros hay quien sepa hasta cuándo.

verses.KJV: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.WEB: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
verses.ASV: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, até quando o adversário insultará? O inimigo blasfemará o teu nome para sempre?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo, oh Dios, el angustiador nos afrentará? ¿ha de blasfemar el enemigo perpetuamente tu nombre?

verses.KJV: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
verses.WEB: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
verses.ASV: Why drawest thou back thy hand, even thy right hand? [Pluck it] out of thy bosom [and] consume [them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que está afastada a tua mão direita? Tira-a do teu peito!
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué retraes tu mano, y tu diestra? ¿por qué la escondes dentro de tu seno?

verses.KJV: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.WEB: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
verses.ASV: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus é o meu Rei desde a antiguidade; ele opera salvação no meio da terra.
verses.RVR09: Empero Dios es mi rey ya de antiguo; el que obra saludes en medio de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.WEB: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
verses.ASV: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: Thou brakest the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu dividiste o mar com a tua força; quebraste as cabeças dos monstros nas águas.
verses.RVR09: Tú hendiste la mar con tu fortaleza: quebrantaste cabezas de ballenas en las aguas.

verses.KJV: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.WEB: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
verses.ASV: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces; Thou gavest him to be food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Despedaçaste as cabeças do leviatã; e o deste como alimento ao povo do deserto.
verses.RVR09: Tú magullaste las cabezas del leviathán; dístelo por comida al pueblo de los desiertos.

verses.KJV: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.WEB: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
verses.ASV: Thou didst cleave fountain and flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu dividiste a fonte e o ribeiro; tu secaste os rios perenes.
verses.RVR09: Tú abriste fuente y río; tú secaste ríos impetuosos.

verses.KJV: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.WEB: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
verses.ASV: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ti pertence o dia, a noite também é tua; tu preparaste a luz e o sol.
verses.RVR09: Tuyo es el día, tuya también es la noche: tú aparejaste la luna y el sol.

verses.KJV: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.WEB: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
verses.ASV: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu estabeleceste todos os limites da terra; tu formaste o verão e o inverno.
verses.RVR09: Tú estableciste todos los términos de la tierra: el verano y el invierno tú los formaste.

verses.KJV: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.WEB: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
verses.ASV: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Jehovah, And that a foolish people hath blasphemed thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te disto: que o inimigo insultou ao SENHOR; e um povo tolo blasfemou o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de esto: que el enemigo ha dicho afrentas á Jehová, y que el pueblo insensato ha blasfemado tu nombre.

verses.KJV: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.WEB: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
verses.ASV: Oh deliver not the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast: Forget not the life of thy poor for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não entregues a vida da tua pombinha para os animais selvagens; não te esqueças para sempre da vida dos teus pobres.
verses.RVR09: No entregues á las bestias el alma de tu tórtola: y no olvides para siempre la congregación de tus afligidos.

verses.KJV: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.WEB: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
verses.ASV: Have respect unto the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of violence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha para o [teu] pacto, porque os lugares escuros da terra estão cheios de habitações violentas.
verses.RVR09: Mira al pacto: porque las tenebrosidades de la tierra llenas están de habitaciones de violencia.

verses.KJV: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.WEB: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
verses.ASV: Oh let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não permitas que o oprimido volte humilhado; que o aflito e o necessitado louvem o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: No vuelva avergonzado el abatido: el afligido y el menesteroso alabarán tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.WEB: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
verses.ASV: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, Deus; luta em favor de tua causa; lembra-te do insulto que o tolo faz a ti o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, oh Dios, aboga tu causa: acuérdate de cómo el insensato te injuria cada día.

verses.KJV: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.WEB: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
verses.ASV: Forget not the voice of thine adversaries: The tumult of those that rise up against thee ascendeth continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te esqueças da voz dos teus adversários; o barulho dos que se levantam contra ti sobe cada vez mais.
verses.RVR09: No olvides las voces de tus enemigos: el alboroto de los que se levantan contra ti sube continuamente.

verses.KJV: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song. We give thanks unto thee, O God; We give thanks, for thy name is near: Men tell of thy wondrous works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para o regente, conforme “altachete”; salmo e cântico de Asafe: Louvamos a ti, ó Deus; louvamos, e perto [está] o teu nome; são anunciadas as tuas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre No destruyas: Salmo de Asaph: Cántico. ALABARÉMOSTE, oh Dios, alabaremos; que cercano está tu nombre: cuenten tus maravillas.

verses.KJV: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.WEB: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
verses.ASV: When I shall find the set time, I will judge uprightly.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que eu recebi, no [tempo] determinado, julgarei de forma justa.
verses.RVR09: Cuando yo tuviere tiempo, yo juzgaré rectamente.

verses.KJV: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.WEB: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
verses.ASV: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have set up the pillars of it. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra e todos os seus moradores [são] dissolvidos; [porém] eu fortifiquei suas colunas. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Arruinábase la tierra y sus moradores: yo sostengo sus columnas. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.WEB: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
verses.ASV: I said unto the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly; And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse aos orgulhosos: Não sejais orgulhosos!E aos perversos: Não exalteis o vosso poder!
verses.RVR09: Dije á los insensatos: No os infatuéis; y á los impíos: No levantéis el cuerno:

verses.KJV: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.WEB: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
verses.ASV: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não confieis em vosso poder, nem faleis com arrogância.
verses.RVR09: No levantéis en alto vuestro cuerno; no habléis con cerviz erguida.

verses.KJV: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.WEB: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
verses.ASV: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the south, [cometh] lifting up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a exaltação não vem do oriente, nem do ocidente, nem do deserto;
verses.RVR09: Porque ni de oriente, ni de occidente, ni del desierto viene el ensalzamiento.

verses.KJV: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.WEB: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
verses.ASV: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sim [de] Deus, que é o Juiz; ele abate a um, e exalta a outro.
verses.RVR09: Mas Dios es el juez: á éste abate, y á aquél ensalza.

verses.KJV: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.WEB: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
verses.ASV: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine foameth; It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same: Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR [tem] um copo na mão; com vinho espumado, cheio de mistura, e ele o derramará; e os perversos da terra o beberão e sugarão até seus restos.
verses.RVR09: Porque el cáliz está en la mano de Jehová, y el vino es tinto, lleno de mistura; y él derrama del mismo: ciertamente sus heces chuparán y beberán todos los impíos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.WEB: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.ASV: But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu [o] anunciarei para sempre; cantarei louvores ao Deus de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo anunciaré siempre, cantaré alabanzas al Dios de Jacob.

verses.KJV: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.WEB: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
verses.ASV: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cortarei todas as arrogâncias dos perversos; [mas] os rostos dos justos serão exaltados.
verses.RVR09: Y quebraré todos los cuernos de los pecadores: los cuernos del justo serán ensalzados.

verses.KJV: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song. In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo e cântico de Asafe, para o regente, com instrumentos de cordas: Deus é conhecido em Judá; grande é o seu nome em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Neginoth: Salmo de Asaph: Canción. DIOS es conocido en Judá: en Israel es grande su nombre.

verses.KJV: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.WEB: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.
verses.ASV: In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his dwelling-place in Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em Salém está seu tabernáculo, e sua morada em Sião.
verses.RVR09: Y en Salem está su tabernáculo, y su habitación en Sión.

verses.KJV: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.WEB: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
verses.ASV: There he brake the arrows of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali ele quebrou as flechas do arco; o escudo, a espada, e a guerra. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Allí quebró las saetas del arco, el escudo, y la espada, y tren de guerra. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.WEB: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
verses.ASV: Glorious art thou [and] excellent, From the mountains of prey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu és mais ilustre [e] glorioso que montes de presas.
verses.RVR09: Ilustre eres tú; fuerte, más que los montes de caza.

verses.KJV: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.WEB: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
verses.ASV: The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os ousados de coração foram despojados; dormiram seu sono; e dos homens valentes, nenhum encontrou [poder] em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Los fuertes de corazón fueron despojados, durmieron su sueño; y nada hallaron en sus manos todos los varones fuertes.

verses.KJV: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.WEB: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.ASV: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por tua repreensão, ó Deus de Jacó, carruagens e cavalos caíram no sono [da morte] .
verses.RVR09: A tu reprensión, oh Dios de Jacob, el carro y el caballo fueron entorpecidos.

verses.KJV: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.WEB: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
verses.ASV: Thou, even thou, art to be feared; And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, terrível és tu; e quem subsistirá perante ti com tua ira?
verses.RVR09: Tú, terrible eres tú: ¿y quién parará delante de ti, en comenzando tu ira?

verses.KJV: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.WEB: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
verses.ASV: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde os céus tu anunciaste o juízo; a terra tremeu, e se aquietou,
verses.RVR09: Desde los cielos hiciste oir juicio; la tierra tuvo temor y quedó suspensa,

verses.KJV: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.WEB: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
verses.ASV: When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Deus se levantou para o julgamento, para salvar a todos os mansos da terra. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Cuando te levantaste, oh Dios, al juicio, para salvar á todos los mansos de la tierra. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.WEB: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
verses.ASV: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: The residue of wrath shalt thou gird upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a ira humana serve para o teu louvor; com o restante da ira te cingirás.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente la ira del hombre te acarreará alabanza: tú reprimirás el resto de las iras.

verses.KJV: Vow, and pay unto the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.WEB: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
verses.ASV: Vow, and pay unto Jehovah your God: Let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fazei votos, e [os] pagai ao SENHOR vosso Deus; todos os que estão ao redor dele tragam presentes ao Temível.
verses.RVR09: Prometed, y pagad á Jehová vuestro Dios: todos los que están alrededor de él, traigan presentes al Terrible.

verses.KJV: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.WEB: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
verses.ASV: He will cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele cortará o espírito dos governantes; ele é temível aos reis da terra.
verses.RVR09: Cortará él el espíritu de los príncipes: terrible es á los reyes de la tierra.

verses.KJV: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; after the manner of Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I will cry unto God with my voice, Even unto God with my voice; and he will give ear unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Asafe, para o regente, conforme “Jedutum”: Clamo a Deus com minha voz, minha voz a Deus; e ele inclinará seus ouvidos a mim.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: para Jeduthún: Salmo de Asaph. CON mi voz clamé á Dios, á Dios clamé, y él me escuchará.

verses.KJV: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.WEB: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
verses.ASV: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: My hand was stretched out in the night, and slacked not; My soul refused to be comforted.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia da minha angústia busquei ao Senhor; minha mão estava continuamente estendida; minha alma não se deixava consolar.
verses.RVR09: Al Señor busqué en el día de mi angustia: mi mal corría de noche, y no cesaba: mi alma rehusaba consuelo.

verses.KJV: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.WEB: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.ASV: I remember God, and am disquieted: I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu ficava me lembrando de Deus, e gemendo; ficava pensativo, e meu espírito desfalecia. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Acordábame de Dios, y gritaba: quejábame, y desmayaba mi espíritu. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.WEB: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
verses.ASV: Thou holdest mine eyes watching: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu mantiveste abertas as pálpebras dos meus olhos; eu estava perturbado, e não conseguia falar.
verses.RVR09: Tenías los párpados de mis ojos: estaba yo quebrantado, y no hablaba.

verses.KJV: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.WEB: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.ASV: I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu ficava imaginando os dias antigos, e os anos passados.
verses.RVR09: Consideraba los días desde el principio, los años de los siglos.

verses.KJV: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.WEB: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
verses.ASV: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart; And my spirit maketh diligent search.
verses.ALMEIDA: De noite eu me lembrava de minha canção; meditava em meu coração; e meu espírito ficava procurando [entender] .
verses.RVR09: Acordábame de mis canciones de noche; meditaba con mi corazón, y mi espíritu inquiría.

verses.KJV: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.WEB: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
verses.ASV: Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will he be favorable no more?
verses.ALMEIDA: Será que o Senhor rejeitará para sempre? E nunca mais mostrará seu favor?
verses.RVR09: ¿Desechará el Señor para siempre, y no volverá más á amar?

verses.KJV: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.WEB: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
verses.ASV: Is his lovingkindness clean gone for ever? Doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.ALMEIDA: A sua bondade se acabou para sempre? Ele deu fim à [sua] promessa de geração em geração?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hase acabado para siempre su misericordia? ¿hase acabado la palabra suya para generación y generación?

verses.KJV: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.WEB: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
verses.ASV: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus se esqueceu de ter misericórdia? Ele encerrou suas compaixões por causa de sua ira? (Selá)
verses.RVR09: ¿Ha olvidado Dios el tener misericordia? ¿ha encerrado con ira sus piedades? (Selah.)

verses.KJV: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.WEB: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
verses.ASV: And I said, This is my infirmity; [But I will remember] the years of the right hand of the Most High.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: Esta é a minha dor: os anos em que a mão do Altíssimo [agia] .
verses.RVR09: Y dije: Enfermedad mía es esta; traeré pues á la memoria los años de la diestra del Altísimo.

verses.KJV: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.WEB: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
verses.ASV: I will make mention of the deeds of Jehovah; For I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me lembrarei das obras do SENHOR; porque me lembrarei de tuas antigas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Acordaréme de las obras de JAH: sí, haré yo memoria de tus maravillas antiguas.

verses.KJV: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.WEB: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
verses.ASV: I will meditate also upon all thy work, And muse on thy doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meditarei em todos as tuas obras, e falarei de teus feitos.
verses.RVR09: Y meditaré en todas tus obras, y hablaré de tus hechos.

verses.KJV: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
verses.WEB: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
verses.ASV: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: Who is a great god like unto God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus, santo [é] o teu caminho; quem é deus [tão] grande como [nosso] Deus?
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, en santidad es tu camino: ¿qué Dios grande como el Dios nuestro?

verses.KJV: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.WEB: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
verses.ASV: Thou art the God that doest wonders: Thou hast made known thy strength among the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu [és] o Deus que faz maravilhas; tu fizeste os povos conhecerem teu poder.
verses.RVR09: Tú eres el Dios que hace maravillas: tú hiciste notoria en los pueblos tu fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.WEB: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.ASV: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Com [teu] braço livraste teu povo, os filhos de Jacó e de José. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Con tu brazo redimiste á tu pueblo, á los hijos de Jacob y de José. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.WEB: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
verses.ASV: The waters saw thee, O God; The waters saw thee, they were afraid: The depths also trembled.
verses.ALMEIDA: As águas te viram, ó Deus; as águas te viram, [e] tremeram; também os abismos foram abalados.
verses.RVR09: Viéronte las aguas, oh Dios; viéronte las aguas, temieron; y temblaron los abismos.

verses.KJV: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.WEB: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
verses.ASV: The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound: Thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Grandes nuvens derramaram muitas águas; os céus fizeram barulho; e também tuas flechas correram de um lado ao outro.
verses.RVR09: Las nubes echaron inundaciones de aguas; tronaron los cielos, y discurrieron tus rayos.

verses.KJV: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.WEB: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
verses.ASV: The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lightened the world: The earth trembled and shook.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ruído de teus trovões [estava] nos ventos; relâmpagos iluminaram ao mundo; a terra se abalou e tremou.
verses.RVR09: Anduvo en derredor el sonido de tus truenos; los relámpagos alumbraron el mundo; estremecióse y tembló la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.WEB: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
verses.ASV: Thy way was in the sea, And thy paths in the great waters, And thy footsteps were not known.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo mar [foi] teu caminho; e tuas veredas por muitas águas; e tuas pegadas não foram conhecidas.
verses.RVR09: En la mar fué tu camino, y tus sendas en las muchas aguas; y tus pisadas no fueron conocidas.

verses.KJV: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.WEB: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.ASV: Thou leddest thy people like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guiaste a teu povo como a um rebanho, pela mão de Moisés e de Arão.
verses.RVR09: Condujiste á tu pueblo como ovejas, por mano de Moisés y de Aarón.

verses.KJV: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.WEB: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.ASV: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Asafe: Povo meu, escuta minha doutrina; inclinai vossos ouvidos às palavras de minha boca.
verses.RVR09: Masquil de Asaph. ESCUCHA, pueblo mío, mi ley: inclinad vuestro oído á las palabras de mi boca.

verses.KJV: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.WEB: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
verses.ASV: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,
verses.ALMEIDA: Abrirei minha boca em parábolas; falarei mistérios dos tempos antigos,
verses.RVR09: Abriré mi boca en parábola; hablaré cosas reservadas de antiguo:

verses.KJV: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.WEB: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.ASV: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais ouvimos e conhecemos, e nossos pais nos contaram.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales hemos oído y entendido; que nuestros padres nos las contaron.

verses.KJV: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.WEB: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
verses.ASV: We will not hide them from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, And his strength, and his wondrous works that he hath done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós não [os] encobriremos a seus filhos, contaremos à próxima geração sobre os louvores do SENHOR, o seu poder, e suas maravilhas que ele fez.
verses.RVR09: No las encubriremos á sus hijos, contando á la generación venidera las alabanzas de Jehová, y su fortaleza, y sus maravillas que hizo.

verses.KJV: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.WEB: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
verses.ASV: For he established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which he commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele firmou um testemunho em Jacó, e pôs a Lei em Israel, a qual ele instruiu aos nossos pais, para que eles ensinassem a seus filhos;
verses.RVR09: El estableció testimonio en Jacob, y pusó ley en Israel; la cual mandó á nuestros padres que la notificasen á sus hijos;

verses.KJV: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.WEB: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
verses.ASV: That the generation to come might know [them], even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell [them] to their children,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que a geração seguinte [dela] soubesse; [e] os filhos que nascessem contassem a seus filhos;
verses.RVR09: Para que lo sepa la generación venidera, y los hijos que nacerán; y los que se levantarán, lo cuenten á sus hijos;

verses.KJV: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.WEB: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
verses.ASV: That they might set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep his commandments,
verses.ALMEIDA: E [assim] pusessem sua esperança em Deus; e não se esquecessem dos feitos de Deus, mas sim, que guardassem os mandamentos dele;
verses.RVR09: A fin de que pongan en Dios su confianza, y no se olviden de las obras de Dios, y guarden sus mandamientos:

verses.KJV: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.WEB: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
verses.ASV: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não fossem como seus pais, [que foram] uma geração teimosa e rebelde; geração que não firmou seu coração, e cujo espírito não foi fiel a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y no sean como sus padres, generación contumaz y rebelde; generación que no apercibió su corazón, ni fué fiel para con Dios su espíritu.

verses.KJV: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.WEB: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.ASV: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de Efraim, mesmo tendo arcos e flechas, viraram-se para trás no dia da batalha;
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Ephraim armados, flecheros, volvieron las espaldas el día de la batalla.

verses.KJV: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.WEB: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
verses.ASV: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não guardaram o pacto de Deus, e recusaram a andar conforme sua Lei.
verses.RVR09: No guardaron el pacto de Dios, ni quisieron andar en su ley:

verses.KJV: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.WEB: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
verses.ASV: And they forgat his doings, And his wondrous works that he had showed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se esqueceram de seus feitos, e de suas maravilhas que ele tinha lhes feito ver.
verses.RVR09: Antes se olvidaron de sus obras, y de sus maravillas que les había mostrado.

verses.KJV: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.WEB: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.ASV: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fez maravilhas perante seus pais na terra do Egito, [no] campo de Zoã.
verses.RVR09: Delante de sus padres hizo maravillas en la tierra de Egipto, en el campo de Zoán.

verses.KJV: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.WEB: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
verses.ASV: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; And he made the waters to stand as a heap.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele dividiu o mar, e os fez passarem por ele; ele fez as águas ficarem paradas como [se estivessem] amontoadas.
verses.RVR09: Rompió la mar, é hízolos pasar; é hizo estar las aguas como en un montón.

verses.KJV: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.WEB: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
verses.ASV: In the day-time also he led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele os guiou com uma nuvem durante o dia, e por toda a noite com uma luz de fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y llevólos de día con nube, y toda la noche con resplandor de fuego.

verses.KJV: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.WEB: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
verses.ASV: He clave rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele partiu as rochas no deserto, e [lhes] deu de beber como que de abismos profundos.
verses.RVR09: Hendió las peñas en el desierto: y dióles á beber como de grandes abismos;

verses.KJV: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.WEB: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.ASV: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele tirou correntes da rocha, e fez as águas descerem como rios.
verses.RVR09: Pues sacó de la peña corrientes, é hizo descender aguas como ríos.

verses.KJV: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
verses.ASV: Yet went they on still to sin against him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [ainda] prosseguiram em pecar contra ele, irritando ao Altíssimo no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Empero aun tornaron á pecar contra él, enojando en la soledad al Altísimo.

verses.KJV: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.WEB: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
verses.ASV: And they tempted God in their heart By asking food according to their desire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tentaram a Deus nos seus corações, pedindo comida para o desejo de suas almas.
verses.RVR09: Pues tentaron á Dios en su corazón, pidiendo comida á su gusto.

verses.KJV: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.WEB: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.ASV: Yea, they spake against God; They said, Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.ALMEIDA: E falaram contra Deus, e disseram: Poderia Deus preparar uma mesa de comida no deserto?
verses.RVR09: Y hablaron contra Dios, diciendo: ¿Podrá poner mesa en el desierto?

verses.KJV: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.WEB: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
verses.ASV: Behold, he smote the rock, so that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que ele feriu a rocha, e águas correram [dela] e ribeiros fluíram em abundância; será que ele também poderia [nos] dar pão, ou preparar carne a seu povo?
verses.RVR09: He aquí ha herido la peña, y corrieron aguas, y arroyos salieron ondeando: ¿podrá también dar pan? ¿aparejará carne á su pueblo?

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
verses.ASV: Therefore Jehovah heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o SENHOR [os] ouviu, e se irritou; e fogo se acendeu contra Jacó, e furor também subiu contra Israel;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto oyó Jehová, é indignóse: y encendióse el fuego contra Jacob, y el furor subió también contra Israel;

verses.KJV: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.WEB: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
verses.ASV: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in his salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles não creram em Deus, nem confiaram na salvação que dele vem;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto no habían creído á Dios, ni habían confiado en su salud:

verses.KJV: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.WEB: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
verses.ASV: Yet he commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mesmo assim, ele deu ordens às altas nuvens, e abriu as portas dos céus;
verses.RVR09: A pesar de que mandó á las nubes de arriba, y abrió las puertas de los cielos,

verses.KJV: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.WEB: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
verses.ASV: And he rained down manna upon them to eat, And gave them food from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E choveu sobre eles o maná, para comerem; e lhes deu trigo dos céus.
verses.RVR09: E hizo llover sobre ellos maná para comer, y dióles trigo de los cielos.

verses.KJV: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.WEB: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
verses.ASV: Man did eat the bread of the mighty: He sent them food to the full.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada homem [daquele povo] comeu o pão dos anjos; ele lhes mandou comida para se fartarem.
verses.RVR09: Pan de nobles comió el hombre: envióles comida á hartura.

verses.KJV: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.WEB: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
verses.ASV: He caused the east wind to blow in the heavens; And by his power he guided the south wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fez soprar o vento do oriente nos céus, e trouxe o [vento] do sul com seu poder.
verses.RVR09: Movió el solano en el cielo, y trajo con su fortaleza el austro.

verses.KJV: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.WEB: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
verses.ASV: He rained flesh also upon them as the dust, And winged birds as the sand of the seas:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fez chover sobre eles carne como a poeira da terra; e aves de asas como a areia do mar;
verses.RVR09: E hizo llover sobre ellos carne como polvo, y aves de alas como arena de la mar.

verses.KJV: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.WEB: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
verses.ASV: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their habitations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [as] fez cair no meio de seu acampamento, ao redor de suas tendas.
verses.RVR09: E hízolas caer en medio de su campo, alrededor de sus tiendas.

verses.KJV: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.WEB: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
verses.ASV: So they did eat, and were well filled; And he gave them their own desire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então comeram, e fartaram-se abundantemente; e satisfez o desejo deles.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron, y hartáronse mucho: cumplióles pues su deseo.

verses.KJV: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.WEB: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
verses.ASV: They were not estranged from that which they desired, Their food was yet in their mouths,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porem, estando eles [ainda] não satisfeitos, enquanto a comida ainda estava em suas bocas,
verses.RVR09: No habían quitado de sí su deseo, aun estaba su vianda en su boca,

verses.KJV: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
verses.WEB: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
verses.ASV: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the fattest of them, And smote down the young men of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: a ira de Deus subiu contra eles; matou os mais robustos deles e abateu os jovens de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Cuando vino sobre ellos el furor de Dios, y mató los más robustos de ellos, y derribó los escogidos de Israel.

verses.KJV: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.WEB: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
verses.ASV: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in his wondrous works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com tudo isto ainda pecaram, e não creram nas maravilhas que ele fez.
verses.RVR09: Con todo esto pecaron aún, y no dieron crédito á sus maravillas.

verses.KJV: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.WEB: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
verses.ASV: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, And their years in terror.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso gastaram seus dias em futilidades, e seus anos em terrores.
verses.RVR09: Consumió por tanto en nada sus días, y sus años en la tribulación.

verses.KJV: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
verses.WEB: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
verses.ASV: When he slew them, then they inquired after him; And they returned and sought God earnestly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele matava [alguns dentre] eles, então buscavam por ele, e se convertiam, e buscavam a Deus de madrugada.
verses.RVR09: Si los mataba, entonces buscaban á Dios; entonces se volvían solícitos en busca suya.

verses.KJV: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.WEB: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
verses.ASV: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se lembravam de que Deus era sua rocha, e que o Deus Altíssimo [era] o seu libertador.
verses.RVR09: Y acordábanse que Dios era su refugio, y el Dios Alto su redentor.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.WEB: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
verses.ASV: But they flattered him with their mouth, And lied unto him with their tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém falavam bem dele da boca para fora, e mentiam com suas línguas.
verses.RVR09: Mas le lisonjeaban con su boca, y con su lengua le mentían:

verses.KJV: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.WEB: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
verses.ASV: For their heart was not right with him, Neither were they faithful in his covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o coração deles não era comprometido para com ele, e não foram fiéis ao pacto dele.
verses.RVR09: Pues sus corazones no eran rectos con él, ni estuvieron firmes en su pacto.

verses.KJV: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.WEB: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
verses.ASV: But he, being merciful, forgave [their] iniquity, and destroyed [them] not: Yea, many a time turned he his anger away, And did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele, sendo misericordioso, perdoava a maldade deles, e não os destruía; e muitas vezes desviou de mostrar sua ira, e não despertou todo o seu furor;
verses.RVR09: Empero él misericordioso, perdonaba la maldad, y no los destruía: y abundó para apartar su ira, y no despertó todo su enojo.

verses.KJV: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.WEB: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
verses.ASV: And he remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porque] se lembrou de que eles eram carne, e [como] o vento, que vai, e não volta mais.
verses.RVR09: Y acordóse que eran carne; soplo que va y no vuelve.

verses.KJV: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.WEB: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
verses.ASV: How oft did they rebel against him in the wilderness, And grieve him in the desert!
verses.ALMEIDA: Quantas vezes o provocaram no deserto, e o maltrataram na terra desabitada!
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuántas veces lo ensañaron en el desierto, lo enojaron en la soledad!

verses.KJV: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: And they turned again and tempted God, And provoked the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois voltavam a tentar a Deus, e perturbavam ao Santo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y volvían, y tentaban á Dios, y ponían límite al Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
