verses.WEB: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
verses.ASV: They remembered not his hand, Nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se lembraram de sua mão, [nem] do dia em que os livrou do adversário.
verses.RVR09: No se acordaron de su mano, del día que los redimió de angustia;

verses.KJV: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan.
verses.WEB: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
verses.ASV: How he set his signs in Egypt, And his wonders in the field of Zoan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Como quando ele fez seus sinais no Egito, e seus atos maravilhosos no campo de Zoã.
verses.RVR09: Cuando puso en Egipto sus señales, y sus maravillas en el campo de Zoán;

verses.KJV: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.WEB: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
verses.ASV: And turned their rivers into blood, And their streams, so that they could not drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E transformou seus rios e suas correntes em sangue, para que não bebessem.
verses.RVR09: Y volvió sus ríos en sangre, y sus corrientes, porque no bebiesen.

verses.KJV: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.WEB: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.ASV: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviou entre eles variedades de moscas, que os consumiu; e rãs, que os destruíram.
verses.RVR09: Envió entre ellos una mistura de moscas que los comían, y ranas que los destruyeron.

verses.KJV: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.WEB: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
verses.ASV: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labor unto the locust.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu suas colheitas ao pulgão, e o trabalho deles ao gafanhoto.
verses.RVR09: Dió también al pulgón sus frutos, y sus trabajos á la langosta.

verses.KJV: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.WEB: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
verses.ASV: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycomore-trees with frost.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com saraiva destruiu suas vinhas, e suas figueiras-bravas com granizo.
verses.RVR09: Sus viñas destruyó con granizo, y sus higuerales con piedra;

verses.KJV: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.WEB: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.ASV: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entregou seu gado à saraiva; e seus animais a brasas ardentes.
verses.RVR09: Y entregó al pedrisco sus bestias, y al fuego sus ganados.

verses.KJV: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.WEB: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
verses.ASV: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, A band of angels of evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mandou entre eles o ardor de sua ira: fúria, irritação e angústia, enviando mensageiros do mal.
verses.RVR09: Envió sobre ellos el furor de su saña, ira y enojo y angustia, con misión de malos ángeles.

verses.KJV: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.WEB: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
verses.ASV: He made a path for his anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele preparou o caminho de sua ira; não poupou suas almas da morte, e entregou seus animais à peste.
verses.RVR09: Dispuso el camino á su furor; no eximió la vida de ellos de la muerte, sino que entregó su vida á la mortandad.

verses.KJV: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.WEB: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
verses.ASV: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
verses.ALMEIDA: E feriu [mortalmente] a todo primogênito no Egito; as primícias nas forças nas tendas de Cam.
verses.RVR09: E hirió á todo primogénito en Egipto, las primicias de las fuerzas en las tiendas de Châm.

verses.KJV: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.WEB: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.ASV: But he led forth his own people like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levou a seu povo como a ovelhas; e os guiou pelo deserto como a um rebanho.
verses.RVR09: Empero hizo salir á su pueblo como ovejas, y llevólos por el desierto, como un rebaño.

verses.KJV: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.WEB: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.ASV: And he led them safely, so that they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele os conduziu em segurança, e não temeram. O mar encobriu seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Y guiólos con seguridad, que no tuvieron miedo; y la mar cubrió á sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.WEB: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
verses.ASV: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, To this mountain, which his right hand had gotten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os trouxe até os limites de sua [terra] santa, até este monte, que sua mão direita adquiriu.
verses.RVR09: Metiólos después en los términos de su santuario, en este monte que ganó su mano derecha.

verses.KJV: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.WEB: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.ASV: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.ALMEIDA: E expulsou as nações de diante deles, e fez com que eles repartissem as linhas de sua herança, e fez as tribos de Israel habitarem em suas tendas.
verses.RVR09: Y echó las gentes de delante de ellos, y repartióles una herencia con cuerdas; é hizo habitar en sus moradas á las tribus de Israel.

verses.KJV: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.WEB: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
verses.ASV: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, And kept not his testimonies;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles tentaram e provocaram ao Deus Altíssimo; e não guardaram os testemunhos dele.
verses.RVR09: Mas tentaron y enojaron al Dios Altísimo, y no guardaron sus testimonios;

verses.KJV: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.WEB: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
verses.ASV: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers: They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.ALMEIDA: E voltaram a ser [tão] infiéis como os seus pais; desviaram-se como um arco enganoso.
verses.RVR09: Sino que se volvieron, y se rebelaron como sus padres: volviéronse como arco engañoso.

verses.KJV: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.WEB: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
verses.ASV: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, And moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.ALMEIDA: E provocaram a ira dele com seus altares pagãos, e com suas imagens de escultura moveram-no de ciúmes.
verses.RVR09: Y enojáronlo con sus altos, y provocáronlo á celo con sus esculturas.

verses.KJV: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.WEB: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
verses.ASV: When God heard [this], he was wroth, And greatly abhorred Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus ouviu [isto] , e se indignou; e rejeitou gravemente a Israel.
verses.RVR09: Oyólo Dios, y enojóse, y en gran manera aborreció á Israel.

verses.KJV: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.WEB: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
verses.ASV: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which he placed among men;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso ele abandonou o tabernáculo em Siló, a tenda que ele havia estabelecido como habitação entre as pessoas.
verses.RVR09: Dejó por tanto el tabernáculo de Silo, la tienda en que habitó entre los hombres;

verses.KJV: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
verses.WEB: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
verses.ASV: And delivered his strength into captivity, And his glory into the adversary’s hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entregou o [símbolo] de seu poder em cativeiro, e sua glória na mão do adversário.
verses.RVR09: Y dió en cautividad su fortaleza, y su gloria en mano del enemigo.

verses.KJV: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.WEB: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
verses.ASV: He gave his people over also unto the sword, And was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entregou seu povo à espada, e enfureceu-se contra sua herança.
verses.RVR09: Entregó también su pueblo á cuchillo, y airóse contra su heredad.

verses.KJV: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.WEB: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
verses.ASV: Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.
verses.ALMEIDA: O fogo consumiu a seus rapazes, e suas virgens não tiveram músicas de casamento.
verses.RVR09: El fuego devoró sus mancebos, y sus vírgenes no fueron loadas en cantos nupciales.

verses.KJV: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.WEB: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
verses.ASV: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus sacerdotes caíram à espada, e suas viúvas não lamentaram.
verses.RVR09: Sus sacerdotes cayeron á cuchillo, y sus viudas no lamentaron.

verses.KJV: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.WEB: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
verses.ASV: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, Like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o Senhor despertou como que do sono, como um homem valente que se exalta com o vinho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces despertó el Señor á la manera del que ha dormido, como un valiente que grita excitado del vino:

verses.KJV: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.WEB: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.ASV: And he smote his adversaries backward: He put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: E feriu a seus adversários, para que recuassem, [e] lhes pôs como humilhação perpétua.
verses.RVR09: E hirió á sus enemigos en las partes posteriores: dióles perpetua afrenta.

verses.KJV: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.WEB: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
verses.ASV: Moreover he refused the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ele rejeitou a tenda de José, e não escolheu a tribo de Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Y desechó el tabernáculo de José, y no escogió la tribu de Ephraim;

verses.KJV: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.WEB: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
verses.ASV: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which he loved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas escolheu a tribo de Judá, o monte de Sião, a quem ele amava.
verses.RVR09: Sino que escogió la tribu de Judá, el monte de Sión, al cual amó.

verses.KJV: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.WEB: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
verses.ASV: And he built his sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificou seu santuário como alturas; como a terra, a qual ele fundou para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y edificó su santuario á manera de eminencia, como la tierra que cimentó para siempre.

verses.KJV: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.WEB: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
verses.ASV: He chose David also his servant, And took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele escolheu a seu servo Davi; e o tomou dos apriscos de ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y eligió á David su siervo, y tomólo de las majadas de las ovejas:

verses.KJV: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.WEB: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
verses.ASV: From following the ewes that have their young he brought him, To be the shepherd of Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele o tirou de cuidar das ovelhas geradoras de filhotes, para que ele apascentasse ao seu povo Jacó; e à sua herança Israel.
verses.RVR09: De tras las paridas lo trajo, para que apacentase á Jacob su pueblo, y á Israel su heredad.

verses.KJV: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.WEB: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
verses.ASV: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele os apascentou com um coração sincero, e os guiou com as habilidades de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y apacentólos con entereza de su corazón; y pastoreólos con la pericia de sus manos.

verses.KJV: O god, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Asafe: Ó Deus, as nações invadiram a tua herança; contaminaram ao teu santo Templo; tornaram Jerusalém em amontoados de ruínas.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de Asaph. OH Dios, vinieron las gentes á tu heredad; el templo de tu santidad han contaminado; pusieron á Jerusalem en montones.

verses.KJV: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.WEB: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
verses.ASV: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be food unto the birds of the heavens, The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deram os cadáveres dos teus servos por comida para as aves dos céus; a carne dos teus consagrados aos animais da terra.
verses.RVR09: Dieron los cuerpos de tus siervos por comida á las aves de los cielos; la carne de tus santos á las bestias de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
verses.WEB: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
verses.ASV: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; And there was none to bury them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Derramaram o sangue deles como água ao redor de Jerusalém, e não havia quem os enterrasse.
verses.RVR09: Derramaron su sangre como agua en los alrededores de Jerusalem; y no hubo quien los enterrase.

verses.KJV: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.WEB: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
verses.ASV: We are become a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Somos humilhados pelos nossos vizinhos; zombados e escarnecidos pelos que estão ao nosso redor.
verses.RVR09: Somos afrentados de nuestros vecinos, escarnecidos y burlados de los que están en nuestros alrededores.

verses.KJV: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.WEB: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.ASV: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando, SENHOR? Ficarás tu irado para sempre? Teus ciúmes arderão como o fogo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo, oh Jehová? ¿has de estar airado para siempre? ¿arderá como fuego tu celo?

verses.KJV: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
verses.WEB: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,
verses.ASV: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not, And upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Derrama o teu furor sobre as nações que não te conhecem, sobre os reinos que não clamam pelo teu nome;
verses.RVR09: Derrama tu ira sobre las gentes que no te conocen, y sobre los reinos que no invocan tu nombre.

verses.KJV: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.WEB: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
verses.ASV: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque devoraram Jacó, e arruinaram suas habitações.
verses.RVR09: Porque han consumido á Jacob, y su morada han asolado.

verses.KJV: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.WEB: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
verses.ASV: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers: Let thy tender mercies speedily meet us; For we are brought very low.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não nos castigue pelas perversidades do passado; apressa-te, que as tuas misericórdias venham até nós, porque estamos muito fracos.
verses.RVR09: No recuerdes contra nosotros las iniquidades antiguas: anticípennos presto tus misericordias, porque estamos muy abatidos.

verses.KJV: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
verses.WEB: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
verses.ASV: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Socorre-nos, ó Deus da nossa salvação, para glorificar o teu nome; livra-nos, e perdoa os nossos pecados por causa do teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Ayúdanos, oh Dios, salud nuestra, por la gloria de tu nombre: y líbranos, y aplácate sobre nuestros pecados por amor de tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
verses.WEB: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
verses.ASV: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed Be known among the nations in our sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qual é a finalidade de que as nações digam: Onde está o Deus deles?Que a vingança do sangue derramado dos teus servos seja conhecida entre as nações, diante dos nossos olhos.
verses.RVR09: Porque dirán las gentes: ¿Dónde está su Dios? Sea notoria en las gentes, delante de nuestros ojos, la venganza de la sangre de tus siervos, que fué derramada.

verses.KJV: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
verses.WEB: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
verses.ASV: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee: According to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to death;
verses.ALMEIDA: Chegue diante de ti o gemido dos prisioneiros; conforme o teu grande poder, salva a vida dos sentenciados à morte.
verses.RVR09: Entre ante tu acatamiento el gemido de los presos: conforme á la grandeza de tu brazo preserva á los sentenciados á muerte.

verses.KJV: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
verses.WEB: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
verses.ASV: And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
verses.ALMEIDA: E retribui a nossos vizinhos em seus corpos sete vezes tanto dos insultos que te insultaram, ó Senhor.
verses.RVR09: Y torna á nuestros vecinos en su seno siete tantos de su infamia, con que te han deshonrado, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.WEB: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
verses.ASV: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture Will give thee thanks for ever: We will show forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim nós, o teu povo, e as ovelhas de teu pasto, te louvaremos para sempre; de geração em geração cantaremos louvores a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y nosotros, pueblo tuyo, y ovejas de tu dehesa, te alabaremos para siempre: por generación y generación cantaremos tus alabanzas.

verses.KJV: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim Eduth. A Psalm of Asaph. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that sittest [above] the cherubim, shine forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para o regente, conforme “Susanedute”. Samo de Asafe: Ó Pastor de Israel, inclina teus ouvidos [a mim] ,tu que pastoreias a José como a ovelhas, que habitas entre os querubins, mostra teu brilho,
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Sosannim Eduth: Salmo de Asaph. OH Pastor de Israel, escucha: tú que pastoreas como á ovejas á José, que estás entre querubines, resplandece.

verses.KJV: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
verses.WEB: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
verses.ASV: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy might, And come to save us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perante Efraim, Benjamim e Manassés, desperta o teu poder, e vem para nos salvar.
verses.RVR09: Despierta tu valentía delante de Ephraim, y de Benjamín, y de Manasés, y ven á salvarnos.

verses.KJV: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.WEB: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.ASV: Turn us again, O God; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Restaura-nos, Deus, e faz brilhar o teu rosto; e [assim] seremos salvos.
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, haznos tornar; y haz resplandecer tu rostro, y seremos salvos.

verses.KJV: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.WEB: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
verses.ASV: O Jehovah God of hosts, How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, até quando ficarás irritado contra a oração de teu povo?
verses.RVR09: Jehová, Dios de los ejércitos, ¿hasta cuándo humearás tú contra la oración de tu pueblo?

verses.KJV: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.WEB: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
verses.ASV: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu os alimentas com pão de lágrimas, e lhes faz beber lágrimas com grande medida.
verses.RVR09: Dísteles á comer pan de lágrimas, y dísteles á beber lágrimas en gran abundancia.

verses.KJV: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.WEB: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.ASV: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbors; And our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Puseste-nos como a briga de nossos vizinhos, e nossos inimigos zombam [de nós] .
verses.RVR09: Pusístenos por contienda á nuestros vecinos: y nuestros enemigos se burlan entre sí.

verses.KJV: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.WEB: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.ASV: Turn us again, O God of hosts; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: Restaura-nos, ó Deus dos exércitos, e faz brilhar o teu rosto; e [assim] seremos salvos.
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios de los ejércitos, haznos tornar; y haz resplandecer tu rostro, y seremos salvos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.WEB: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
verses.ASV: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt: Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu transportaste [tua] vinha do Egito, tiraste as nações, e a plantaste.
verses.RVR09: Hiciste venir una vid de Egipto: echaste las gentes, y plantástela.

verses.KJV: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.WEB: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
verses.ASV: Thou preparedst [room] before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Preparaste [um lugar] para ela, e a fizeste estender suas raízes, e ela encheu a terra.
verses.RVR09: Limpiaste sitio delante de ella, é hiciste arraigar sus raíces, y llenó la tierra.

verses.KJV: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
verses.WEB: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
verses.ASV: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the boughs thereof were [like] cedars of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes foram cobertos pela sombra dela, e seus ramos [se tornaram] como o dos mais fortes cedros.
verses.RVR09: Los montes fueron cubiertos de su sombra; y sus sarmientos como cedros de Dios.

verses.KJV: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.WEB: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.
verses.ASV: It sent out its branches unto the sea, And its shoots unto the River.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela espalhou seus ramos até o mar, e seus brotos até o rio.
verses.RVR09: Extendió sus vástagos hasta la mar, y hasta el río sus mugrones.

verses.KJV: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.WEB: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
verses.ASV: Why hast thou broken down its walls, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que [pois] quebraste seus muros, de modo que os que passam arrancam seus frutos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué aportillaste sus vallados, y la vendimian todos los que pasan por el camino?

verses.KJV: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.WEB: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
verses.ASV: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, And the wild beasts of the field feed on it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O porco do campo a destruiu; os animais selvagens a devoraram.
verses.RVR09: Estropeóla el puerco montés, y pacióla la bestia del campo.

verses.KJV: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.WEB: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
verses.ASV: Turn again, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Deus dos exércitos, volta, te pedimos; olha desde os céus, e vê, e visita esta vinha;
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios de los ejércitos, vuelve ahora: mira desde el cielo, y considera, y visita esta viña,

verses.KJV: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.WEB: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
verses.ASV: And the stock which thy right hand planted, And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a videira que tua mão direita plantou; o ramo que fortificaste para ti.
verses.RVR09: Y la planta que plantó tu diestra, y el renuevo que para ti corroboraste.

verses.KJV: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.WEB: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
verses.ASV: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ela está] queimada pelo fogo, [e] cortada; perecem pela repreensão de tua face.
verses.RVR09: Quemada á fuego está, asolada: perezcan por la reprensión de tu rostro.

verses.KJV: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.WEB: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
verses.ASV: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja tua mão sobre o homem de tua mão direita, sobre o filho do homem a quem fortificaste para ti.
verses.RVR09: Sea tu mano sobre el varón de tu diestra, sobre el hijo del hombre que para ti corroboraste.

verses.KJV: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.WEB: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
verses.ASV: So shall we not go back from thee: Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim não desviaremos de ti; guarda-nos em vida, e chamaremos o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Así no nos volveremos de ti: vida nos darás, é invocaremos tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.WEB: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.ASV: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts; Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, restaura-nos; faz brilhar o teu rosto, e [assim] seremos salvos.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, Dios de los ejércitos, haznos tornar; haz resplandecer tu rostro, y seremos salvos.

verses.KJV: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph. Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Asafe, para o regente, conforme “Gitite”: Cantai de alegria a Deus, [que é] nossa força; mostrai alegria ao Deus de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Gittith: Salmo de Asaph. CANTAD á Dios, fortaleza nuestra: al Dios de Jacob celebrad con júbilo.

verses.KJV: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.WEB: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
verses.ASV: Raise a song, and bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai uma canção, e dai-nos o tamborim; a agradável harpa com a lira.
verses.RVR09: Tomad la canción, y tañed el adufe, el arpa deliciosa con el salterio.

verses.KJV: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.WEB: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
verses.ASV: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast-day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tocai trombeta na lua nova; e na lua cheia, no dia de nossa celebração.
verses.RVR09: Tocad la trompeta en la nueva luna, en el día señalado, en el día de nuestra solemnidad.

verses.KJV: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
verses.WEB: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.ASV: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque [isto] é um estatuto em Israel, e uma ordem do Deus de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Porque estatuto es de Israel, ordenanza del Dios de Jacob.

verses.KJV: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.WEB: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
verses.ASV: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out over the land of Egypt, [Where] I heard a language that I knew not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele o pôs como testemunho em José, quando tinha saído contra a terra do Egito, [onde] ouvi uma língua que eu não entendia:
verses.RVR09: Por testimonio en José lo ha constituído, cuando salió por la tierra de Egipto; donde oí lenguaje que no entendía.

verses.KJV: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.WEB: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
verses.ASV: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were freed from the basket.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tirei seus ombros de debaixo da carga; suas mãos foram livrados dos cestos.
verses.RVR09: Aparté su hombro de debajo de la carga; sus manos se quitaron de vasijas de barro.

verses.KJV: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.WEB: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
verses.ASV: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Na angústia clamaste, e livrei-te dela; te respondi no esconderijo dos trovões; provei a ti nas águas de Meribá. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: En la calamidad clamaste, y yo te libré: te respondí en el secreto del trueno; te probé sobre las aguas de Meriba. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.WEB: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
verses.ASV: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve [-me] , povo meu, e eu te darei testemunho; ó Israel, se tu me ouvisses!
verses.RVR09: Oye, pueblo mío, y te protestaré. Israel, si me oyeres,

verses.KJV: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.WEB: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
verses.ASV: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não haverá entre ti deus estranho, e não te prostrarás a um deus estrangeiro.
verses.RVR09: No habrá en ti dios ajeno, ni te encorvarás á dios extraño.

verses.KJV: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.WEB: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah thy God, Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, que te fiz subir da terra do Egito; abre tua boca por completo, e eu a encherei.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy Jehová tu Dios, que te hice subir de la tierra de Egipto: ensancha tu boca, y henchirla he.

verses.KJV: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
verses.WEB: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
verses.ASV: But my people hearkened not to my voice; And Israel would none of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas meu povo não ouviu minha voz, e Israel não me quis.
verses.RVR09: Mas mi pueblo no oyó mi voz, é Israel no me quiso á mí.

verses.KJV: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.WEB: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
verses.ASV: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu os entreguei ao desejo de seus próprios corações, e andaram conforme seus próprios conselhos.
verses.RVR09: Dejélos por tanto á la dureza de su corazón: caminaron en sus consejos.

verses.KJV: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
verses.WEB: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
verses.ASV: Oh that my people would hearken unto me, That Israel would walk in my ways!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, se meu povo me ouvisse, se Israel andasse em meus caminhos!
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh, si me hubiera oído mi pueblo, si en mis caminos hubiera Israel andado!

verses.KJV: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.WEB: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
verses.ASV: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn my hand against their adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em pouco tempo eu derrotaria seus inimigos, e viraria minha mão contra seus adversários.
verses.RVR09: En una nada habría yo derribado sus enemigos, y vuelto mi mano sobre sus adversarios.

verses.KJV: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.WEB: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
verses.ASV: The haters of Jehovah should submit themselves unto him: But their time should endure for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que odeiam ao SENHOR, a ele se submeteriam, e o tempo [da punição] deles seria eterno.
verses.RVR09: Los aborrecedores de Jehová se le hubieran sometido; y el tiempo de ellos fuera para siempre.

verses.KJV: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.WEB: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
verses.ASV: He would feed them also with the finest of the wheat; And with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele sustentaria [Israel] com a abundância de trigo; e eu te fartaria com o mel da rocha.
verses.RVR09: Y Dios lo hubiera mantenido de grosura de trigo: y de miel de la piedra te hubiera saciado.

verses.KJV: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of God; He judgeth among the gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Asafe: Deus está na congregação dos poderosos, e julga no meio dos deuses.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de Asaph. DIOS está en la reunión de los dioses; en medio de los dioses juzga.

verses.KJV: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.WEB: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
verses.ASV: How long will ye judge unjustly, And respect the persons of the wicked? [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando julgareis injustamente, e favoreceis a aparência dos perversos? (Selá)
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo juzgaréis injustamente, y aceptaréis las personas de los impíos? (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.WEB: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
verses.ASV: Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fazei justiça ao pobre e ao órfão; defendei o afligido e o pobre.
verses.RVR09: Defended al pobre y al huérfano: haced justicia al afligido y al menesteroso.

verses.KJV: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.WEB: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
verses.ASV: Rescue the poor and needy: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livrai ao pobre e necessitado, resgatai [-o] das mãos dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Librad al afligido y al necesitado: libradlo de mano de los impíos.

verses.KJV: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.WEB: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.ASV: They know not, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles nada conhecem, nem entendem; continuamente andam em trevas; abalam-se todos os fundamentos da terra.
verses.RVR09: No saben, no entienden, andan en tinieblas: vacilan todos los cimientos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
verses.WEB: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
verses.ASV: I said, Ye are gods, And all of you sons of the Most High.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse: Sois deuses; e todos vós sois filhos do Altíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Yo dije: Vosotros sois dioses, é hijos todos vosotros del Altísimo.

verses.KJV: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
verses.ASV: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém morrereis como homens, e caireis como qualquer um dos líderes.
verses.RVR09: Empero como hombres moriréis, y caeréis como cualquiera de los tiranos.

verses.KJV: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.WEB: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
verses.ASV: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For thou shalt inherit all the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, ó Deus; julga a terra, pois tu és o dono de todas as nações.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, oh Dios, juzga la tierra: porque tú heredarás en todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.WEB: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
verses.ASV: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph. O God, keep not thou silence: Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico e Salmo de Asafe: Deus, não fiques em silêncio; não estejas indiferente, nem fiques quieto, ó Deus.
verses.RVR09: Canción: Salmo de Asaph. OH Dios, no tengas silencio: no calles, oh Dios, ni te estés quieto.

verses.KJV: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.WEB: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
verses.ASV: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult; And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que teus inimigos fazem barulho, e aqueles que te odeiam levantam a cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí que braman tus enemigos; y tus aborrecedores han alzado cabeza.

verses.KJV: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.WEB: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
verses.ASV: They take crafty counsel against thy people, And consult together against thy hidden ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Planejam astutos conselhos contra teu povo, e se reúnem para tramar contra teus preciosos.
verses.RVR09: Sobre tu pueblo han consultado astuta y secretamente, y han entrado en consejo contra tus escondidos.

verses.KJV: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.WEB: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
verses.ASV: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles disseram: Vinde, e os destruamos, para que não sejam mais um povo, e nunca mais seja lembrado o nome de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Han dicho: Venid, y cortémoslos de ser pueblo, y no haya más memoria del nombre de Israel.

verses.KJV: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.WEB: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
verses.ASV: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against thee do they make a covenant:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tomaram conselhos com uma só intenção; fizeram aliança contra ti:
verses.RVR09: Por esto han conspirado de corazón á una, contra ti han hecho liga;

verses.KJV: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.WEB: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
verses.ASV: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.ALMEIDA: As tendas de Edom, e dos ismaelitas, de Moabe, e dos agarenos;
verses.RVR09: Los pabellones de los Idumeos y de los Ismaelitas, Moab y los Agarenos;

verses.KJV: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.WEB: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.ASV: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre:
verses.ALMEIDA: De Gebal, e de Amom, e de Amaleque; dos filisteus, com os moradores de Tiro.
verses.RVR09: Gebal, y Ammón, y Amalec; los Filisteos con los habitadores de Tiro.

verses.KJV: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.WEB: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.ASV: Assyria also is joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: A Assíria também se aliou a eles; eles foram a força dos filhos de Ló. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: También el Assur se ha juntado con ellos: son por brazo á los hijos de Lot. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.WEB: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
verses.ASV: Do thou unto them as unto Midian, As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze a eles como a Midiã, como a Sísera, como a Jabim no ribeiro de Quisom,
verses.RVR09: Hazles como á Madián; como á Sísara, como á Jabín en el arroyo de Cisón;

verses.KJV: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.WEB: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
verses.ASV: Who perished at Endor, Who became as dung for the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Que] pereceram em Endor; vieram a ser esterco da terra.
verses.RVR09: Que perecieron en Endor, fueron hechos muladar de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.WEB: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.ASV: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; Yea, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze a eles [e] a seus nobres como a Orebe, e como Zeebe; e a todos os seus príncipes como a Zebá, e como a Zalmuna,
verses.RVR09: Pon á ellos y á sus capitanes como á Oreb y como á Zeeb; y como á Zeba y como á Zalmunna, á todos sus príncipes;

verses.KJV: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.WEB: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
verses.ASV: Who said, Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que disseram: Tomemos posse para nós dos terrenos de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Que han dicho: Heredemos para nosotros las moradas de Dios.

verses.KJV: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.WEB: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
verses.ASV: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus meu, faze-os como a um redemoinho, como a palhas perante o vento;
verses.RVR09: Dios mío, ponlos como á torbellinos; como á hojarascas delante del viento.

verses.KJV: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.WEB: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
verses.ASV: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains on fire,
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o fogo, que queima uma floresta, e como a labareda que incendeia as montanhas.
verses.RVR09: Como fuego que quema el monte, como llama que abrasa las breñas.

verses.KJV: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.WEB: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
verses.ASV: So pursue them with thy tempest, And terrify them with thy storm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Persegue-os assim com tua tempestade, e assombra-os com o teu forte vento.
verses.RVR09: Persíguelos así con tu tempestad, y asómbralos con tu torbellino.

verses.KJV: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.
verses.WEB: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.
verses.ASV: Fill their faces with confusion, That they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enche os rostos deles de vergonha, para que busquem o teu nome, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Llena sus rostros de vergüenza; y busquen tu nombre, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.WEB: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
verses.ASV: Let them be put to shame and dismayed for ever; Yea, let them be confounded and perish;
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam envergonhados e assombrados para sempre, e sejam humilhados, e pereçam.
verses.RVR09: Sean afrentados y turbados para siempre; y sean deshonrados, y perezcan.

verses.KJV: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.WEB: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.ASV: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, Art the Most High over all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que saibam que tu, (e teu nome é EU-SOU), és o Altíssimo sobre toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y conozcan que tu nombre es JEHOVÁ; tú solo Altísimo sobre toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!
verses.ALMEIDA: Para o regente, com “Gitite”. Salmo dos filhos de Coré: Quão agradáveis são tuas moradas, SENHOR dos exércitos!
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: sobre Gittith: Salmo para los hijos de Coré. ¡CUÁN amables son tus moradas, oh Jehová de los ejércitos!

verses.KJV: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
verses.WEB: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
verses.ASV: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; My heart and my flesh cry out unto the living God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma está desejosa, ao ponto de desmaiar, pelos pátios do SENHOR; meu coração e minha carne clamam ao Deus vivente.
verses.RVR09: Codicia y aun ardientemente desea mi alma los atrios de Jehová: mi corazón y mi carne cantan al Dios vivo.

verses.KJV: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.
verses.WEB: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.
verses.ASV: Yea, the sparrow hath found her a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, Even thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, My King, and my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até o pardal acha casa, e a andorinha ninho para si, onde ponha filhotes perto de teus altares, ó SENHOR dos exércitos, Rei meu e Deus meu.
verses.RVR09: Aun el gorrión halla casa, y la golondrina nido para sí, donde ponga sus pollos en tus altares, oh Jehová de los ejércitos, rey mío, y Dios mío.

verses.KJV: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.WEB: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
verses.ASV: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: They will be still praising thee. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurados os que habitam em tua casa; eles louvam a ti continuamente. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los que habitan en tu casa: perpetuamente te alabarán. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
verses.WEB: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; In whose heart are the highways [to Zion].
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurados aqueles cuja força está em ti, em cujos corações estão os caminhos [corretos] .
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el hombre que tiene su fortaleza en ti; en cuyo corazón están tus caminos.

verses.KJV: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.WEB: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
verses.ASV: Passing through the valley of Weeping they make it a place of springs; Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, ao passarem pelo Vale de Baca, fazem dele uma fonte; e a chuva o cobre de bênçãos.
verses.RVR09: Atravesando el valle de Baca pónenle por fuente, cuando la lluvia llena los estanques.

verses.KJV: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
verses.WEB: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
verses.ASV: They go from strength to strength; Every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles vão de força em força; [cada um deles] comparece diante de Deus em Sião.
verses.RVR09: Irán de fortaleza en fortaleza, verán á Dios en Sión.

verses.KJV: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.WEB: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, escuta minha oração; inclina os teus ouvidos, ó Deus de Jacó. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Jehová Dios de los ejércitos, oye mi oración: escucha, oh Dios de Jacob. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.WEB: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
verses.ASV: Behold, O God our shield, And look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha o nosso escudo, ó Deus; e observa o rosto do teu ungido.
verses.RVR09: Mira, oh Dios, escudo nuestro, y pon los ojos en el rostro de tu ungido.

verses.KJV: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.WEB: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.ASV: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque melhor é um dia nos teus pátios, do que mil [fora] . Prefiro estar à porta da casa do meu Deus, a morar nas tendas dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Porque mejor es un día en tus atrios que mil fuera de ellos: escogería antes estar á la puerta de la casa de mi Dios, que habitar en las moradas de maldad.

verses.KJV: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.WEB: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR Deus é sol e escudo; o SENHOR concederá graça e honra; ele não negará o bem aos que andam em integridade.
verses.RVR09: Porque sol y escudo es Jehová Dios: gracia y gloria dará Jehová: no quitará el bien á los que en integridad andan.

verses.KJV: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.WEB: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR dos exércitos, bem-aventurado é o homem que confia em ti!
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos, dichoso el hombre que en ti confía.

verses.KJV: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Jehovah, thou hast been favorable unto thy land; Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo para o regente, dos filhos de Coré: Foste favorável, ó SENHOR, à tua terra; restauraste Jacó de seu infortúnio.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo para los hijos de Coré. FUISTE propicio á tu tierra, oh Jehová: volviste la cautividad de Jacob.

verses.KJV: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.WEB: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.ASV: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; Thou hast covered all their sin. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Perdoaste a perversidade de teu povo; encobriste todos os seus pecados. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Perdonaste la iniquidad de tu pueblo; todos los pecados de ellos cubriste. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.WEB: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
verses.ASV: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath; Thou hast turned [thyself] from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Removeste toda a tua indignação; do ardor de tua ira te desviaste.
verses.RVR09: Dejaste toda tu saña: te volviste de la ira de tu furor.

verses.KJV: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.WEB: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
verses.ASV: Turn us, O God of our salvation, And cause thine indignation toward us to cease.
verses.ALMEIDA: Restaura-nos, ó Deus de nossa salvação; e cessa tua ira de sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Vuélvenos, oh Dios, salud nuestra, y haz cesar tu ira de sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.WEB: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
verses.ASV: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.ALMEIDA: Acaso estarás irado contra nós para sempre? Estenderás a tua ira de geração em geração?
verses.RVR09: ¿Estarás enojado contra nosotros para siempre? ¿extenderás tu ira de generación en generación?

verses.KJV: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.WEB: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
verses.ASV: Wilt thou not quicken us again, That thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não voltará a dar-nos vida, para que o teu povo se alegre em ti?
verses.RVR09: ¿No volverás tú á darnos vida, y tu pueblo se alegrará en ti?

verses.KJV: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.WEB: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.
verses.ASV: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mostra-nos tua bondade, SENHOR, e dá para nós tua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Muéstranos, oh Jehová, tu misericordia, y danos tu salud.

verses.KJV: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.WEB: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.ASV: I will hear what God Jehovah will speak; For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Escutarei o que o Deus, o SENHOR, falar, pois ele falará de paz ao seu povo, e aos seus santos, contanto que não voltem à loucura.
verses.RVR09: Escucharé lo que hablará el Dios Jehová: porque hablará paz á su pueblo y á sus santos, para que no se conviertan á la locura.

verses.KJV: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.WEB: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.ASV: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, That glory may dwell in our land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente sua salvação está perto daqueles que o temem, para que a glória habite em nossa terra.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente cercana está su salud á los que le temen; para que habite la gloria en nuestra tierra.

verses.KJV: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.WEB: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.ASV: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.ALMEIDA: A bondade e a verdade se encontrarão; a justiça e a paz se beijarão.
verses.RVR09: La misericordia y la verdad se encontraron: la justicia y la paz se besaron.

verses.KJV: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.WEB: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
verses.ASV: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: A verdade brotará da terra, e a justiça olhará desde os céus.
verses.RVR09: La verdad brotará de la tierra; y la justicia mirará desde los cielos.

verses.KJV: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.WEB: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
verses.ASV: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good; And our land shall yield its increase.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR também dará o bem; e a nossa terra dará o seu fruto.
verses.RVR09: Jehová dará también el bien; y nuestra tierra dará su fruto.

verses.KJV: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.WEB: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
verses.ASV: Righteousness shall go before him, And shall make his footsteps a way [to walk in].
verses.ALMEIDA: A justiça irá adiante dele, e ele nos porá no caminho de seus passos.
verses.RVR09: La justicia irá delante de él; y sus pasos pondrá en camino.

verses.KJV: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.WEB: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
verses.ASV: A Prayer of David. Bow down thine ear, O Jehovah, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Oração de Davi: Inclina teus ouvidos, SENHOR, e ouve-me, porque estou aflito e necessitado.
verses.RVR09: Oración de David. INCLINA, oh Jehová, tu oído, y óyeme; porque estoy afligido y menesteroso.

verses.KJV: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.WEB: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
verses.ASV: Preserve my soul; for I am godly: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda minha alma, porque eu sou dedicado [a ti] ; ó Deus, salva o teu servo, que confia em ti.
verses.RVR09: Guarda mi alma, porque soy pío: salva tú, oh Dios mío, á tu siervo que en ti, confía.

verses.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.WEB: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
verses.ASV: Be merciful unto me, O Lord; For unto thee do I cry all the day long.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tem misericórdia de mim, SENHOR, porque clamo a ti o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Ten misericordia de mí, oh Jehová: porque á ti clamo todo el día.

verses.KJV: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.WEB: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.ASV: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegra a alma de teu servo; porque a ti, Senhor, levanto a minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Alegra el alma de tu siervo: porque á ti, oh Señor, levanto mi alma.

verses.KJV: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.WEB: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
verses.ASV: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in lovingkindness unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu, Senhor, és bom, perdoador, e grande em bondade para todos os que clamam a ti.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, Señor, eres bueno y perdonador, y grande en misericordia para con todos los que te invocan.

verses.KJV: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.WEB: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
verses.ASV: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer; And hearken unto the voice of my supplications.
verses.ALMEIDA: Inclina, SENHOR, teus ouvidos à minha oração; e presta atenção à voz de minhas súplicas.
verses.RVR09: Escucha, oh Jehová, mi oración, y está atento á la voz de mis ruegos.

verses.KJV: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.WEB: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
verses.ASV: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee; For thou wilt answer me.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia de minha angústia clamarei a ti, pois tu me responderás.
verses.RVR09: En el día de mi angustia te llamaré: porque tú me respondes.

verses.KJV: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
verses.WEB: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
verses.ASV: There is none like unto thee among the gods, O Lord; Neither [are there any works] like unto thy works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há semelhante a ti entre os deuses, ó Senhor; e nem obras como as tuas.
verses.RVR09: Oh Señor, ninguno hay como tú entre los dioses, ni obras que igualen tus obras.

verses.KJV: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.WEB: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
verses.ASV: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as nações que tu fizeste virão e se prostrarão diante de ti, Senhor; e elas glorificarão o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Todas las gentes que hiciste vendrán y se humillarán delante de ti, Señor; y glorificarán tu nombre.

verses.KJV: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
verses.WEB: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
verses.ASV: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu és grande, e fazes maravilhas; somente tu és Deus.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú eres grande, y hacedor de maravillas: tú solo eres Dios.

verses.KJV: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.WEB: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
verses.ASV: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: Unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensina-me, SENHOR, o teu caminho, [e] eu andarei em tua verdade; une meu coração com o temor ao teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Enséñame, oh Jehová, tu camino; caminaré yo en tu verdad: consolida mi corazón para que tema tu nombre.

verses.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.WEB: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
verses.ASV: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvarei a ti, ó Senhor meu Deus, com todo o meu coração; e glorificarei o teu nome para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Te alabaré, oh Jehová Dios mío, con todo mi corazón; y glorificaré tu nombre para siempre.

verses.KJV: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.WEB: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
verses.ASV: For great is thy lovingkindness toward me; And thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois grande é a tua misericórdia para comigo; e livraste minha alma das profundezas do Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Porque tu misericordia es grande para conmigo; y has librado mi alma del hoyo profundo.

verses.KJV: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.WEB: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
verses.ASV: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And a company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set thee before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Deus, pessoas arrogantes têm se levantado contra mim; e muitos violentos procuram [matar] a minha alma, e te desprezam.
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, soberbios se levantaron contra mí, y conspiración de fuertes ha buscado mi alma, y no te pusieron delante de sí.

verses.KJV: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.WEB: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
verses.ASV: But thou, O Lord, art a God merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, Senhor, és Deus misericordioso e piedoso; tardio para se irar, e abundante em bondade e verdade.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Señor, Dios misericordioso y clemente, lento para la ira, y grande en misericordia y verdad;

verses.KJV: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.WEB: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
verses.ASV: Oh turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; Give thy strength unto thy servant, And save the son of thy handmaid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Volta-te para mim, e tem piedade de mim; dá tua força a teu servo, e salva o filho de tua serva.
verses.RVR09: Mírame, y ten misericordia de mí: da tu fortaleza á tu siervo, y guarda al hijo de tu sierva.

verses.KJV: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.WEB: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.
verses.ASV: Show me a token for good, That they who hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because thou, Jehovah, hast helped me, and comforted me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze-me um sinal de bondade, para que os que me odeiam vejam, e se envergonhem; porque tu, SENHOR, tens me ajudado e consolado.
verses.RVR09: Haz conmigo señal para bien, y véanla los que me aborrecen, y sean avergonzados; porque tú, Jehová, me ayudaste, y me consolaste.

verses.KJV: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo e cântico, dos filhos de Coré: Seu fundamento está nos santos montes.
verses.RVR09: A los hijos de Coré: Salmo: Canción. SU cimiento es en montes de santidad.

verses.KJV: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.WEB: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.ASV: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR ama os portões de Sião mais que todas as habitações de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Ama Jehová las puertas de Sión más que todas las moradas de Jacob.

verses.KJV: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.WEB: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
verses.ASV: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Gloriosas coisas são faladas de ti, ó cidade de Deus. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Cosas ilustres son dichas de ti, ciudad de Dios. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.WEB: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
verses.ASV: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me: Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: This one was born there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farei menção de Raabe e Babilônia aos que me conhecem; eis que da Filístia, Tiro e Cuxe [se dirá] : Este é nascido ali.
verses.RVR09: Yo me acordaré de Rahab y de Babilonia entre los que me conocen: he aquí Palestina, y Tiro, con Etiopía: éste nació allá.

verses.KJV: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.WEB: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
verses.ASV: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E de Sião se dirá: Este e aquele outro nasceram ali. E o próprio Altíssimo a manterá firme.
verses.RVR09: Y de Sión se dirá: Este y aquél han nacido en ella; y fortificarála el mismo Altísimo.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.WEB: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples, This one was born there. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR contará, quando escrever dos povos: Este nasceu ali. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Jehová contará cuando se escribieren los pueblos: Este nació allí. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.WEB: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
verses.ASV: They that sing as well as they that dance [shall say], All my fountains are in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como os cantores e instrumentistas; todas as minhas fontes estão em ti.
verses.RVR09: Y cantores y tañedores en ella dirán: Todas mis fuentes estarán en ti.

verses.KJV: O lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
verses.WEB: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
verses.ASV: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite. O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee.
