verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico e Salmo dos filhos de Coré, para o regente, conforme “Maalate Leanote”. Instrução feita por Hemã, o Ezraíta: Ó SENHOR Deus de minha salvação, dia [e] noite clamo diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Canción: Salmo para los hijos de Coré: al Músico principal: para cantar sobre Mahalath: Masquil de Hemán Ezrahita. OH Jehová, Dios de mi salud, día y noche clamo delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.WEB: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
verses.ASV: Let my prayer enter into thy presence; Incline thine ear unto my cry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que minha oração chegue à tua presença; inclina os teus ouvidos ao meu clamor.
verses.RVR09: Entre mi oración en tu presencia: inclina tu oído á mi clamor.

verses.KJV: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.WEB: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
verses.ASV: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque minha alma está cheia de aflições, e minha vida se aproxima do Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Porque mi alma está harta de males, y mi vida cercana al sepulcro.

verses.KJV: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
verses.WEB: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
verses.ASV: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no help,
verses.ALMEIDA: Já estou contado entre os que descem à cova; tornei-me um homem sem forças.
verses.RVR09: Soy contado con los que descienden al hoyo, soy como hombre sin fuerza:

verses.KJV: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.WEB: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
verses.ASV: Cast off among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abandonado entre os mortos, como os feridos de morte que jazem na sepultura, aos quais tu já não te lembra mais, e já estão cortados [para fora do poder] de tua mão.
verses.RVR09: Libre entre los muertos, como los matados que yacen en el sepulcro, que no te acuerdas más de ellos, y que son cortados de tu mano.

verses.KJV: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.WEB: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
verses.ASV: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the deeps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Puseste-me na cova mais profunda, nas trevas [e] nas profundezas.
verses.RVR09: Hasme puesto en el hoyo profundo, en tinieblas, en honduras.

verses.KJV: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.WEB: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
verses.ASV: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: O teu furor pesa sobre mim, e [me] oprimiste com todas as tuas ondas. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Sobre mí se ha acostado tu ira, y me has afligido con todas tus ondas. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.WEB: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
verses.ASV: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afastaste de mim os meus conhecidos, fizeste-me abominável para com eles; estou preso, e não posso sair.
verses.RVR09: Has alejado de mí mis conocidos: hasme puesto por abominación á ellos: encerrado estoy, y no puedo salir.

verses.KJV: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.WEB: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.
verses.ASV: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction: I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah; I have spread forth my hands unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos estão fracos por causa da opressão; clamo a ti, SENHOR, o dia todo; a ti estendo minhas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Mis ojos enfermaron á causa de mi aflicción: hete llamado, oh Jehová, cada día; he extendido á ti mis manos.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
verses.WEB: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
verses.ASV: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? Shall they that are deceased arise and praise thee? [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Farás tu milagres aos mortos? Ou mortos se levantarão, e louvarão a ti? (Selá)
verses.RVR09: ¿Harás tú milagro á los muertos? ¿levantaránse los muertos para alabarte? (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.WEB: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
verses.ASV: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or thy faithfulness in Destruction?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua bondade será contada na sepultura? Tua fidelidade na perdição?
verses.RVR09: ¿Será contada en el sepulcro tu misericordia, ó tu verdad en la perdición?

verses.KJV: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.WEB: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.ASV: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Serão conhecidas tuas maravilhas nas trevas? E tua justiça na terra do esquecimento?
verses.RVR09: ¿Será conocida en las tinieblas tu maravilla, ni tu justicia en la tierra del olvido?

verses.KJV: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.WEB: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
verses.ASV: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried; And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu, SENHOR, clamo a ti; e minha oração vem ao teu encontro de madrugada.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo á ti he clamado, oh Jehová; y de mañana mi oración te previno.

verses.KJV: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.WEB: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
verses.ASV: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que tu, SENHOR, rejeitas minha alma, e escondes tua face de mim?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué, oh Jehová, desechas mi alma? ¿por qué escondes de mí tu rostro?

verses.KJV: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.WEB: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
verses.ASV: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho sido afligido e estou perto da morte desde a minha juventude; tenho sofrido teus temores, e estou desesperado.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy afligido y menesteroso: desde la mocedad he llevado tus terrores, he estado medroso.

verses.KJV: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.WEB: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
verses.ASV: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os ardores de tua ira têm passado por mim; teus terrores me destroem.
verses.RVR09: Sobre mí han pasado tus iras; tus espantos me han cortado.

verses.KJV: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.WEB: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
verses.ASV: They came round about me like water all the day long; They compassed me about together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rodeiam-me como águas o dia todo; cercam-me juntos.
verses.RVR09: Hanme rodeado como aguas de continuo; hanme cercado á una.

verses.KJV: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.WEB: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
verses.ASV: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afastaste de mim meu amigo e meu companheiro; meus conhecidos [estão em] trevas.
verses.RVR09: Has alejado de mí el amigo y el compañero; y mis conocidos se esconden en la tiniebla.

verses.KJV: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.WEB: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
verses.ASV: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Etã Ezraíta: Cantarei das bondades do SENHOR para sempre; de geração em geração com minha boca anunciarei tua fidelidade.
verses.RVR09: Masquil de Ethán Ezrahita. LAS misericordias de Jehová cantaré perpetuamente: en generación y generación haré notoria tu verdad con mi boca.

verses.KJV: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.WEB: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
verses.ASV: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever; Thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu disse: [Tua] bondade durará para sempre; confirmaste tua fidelidade até nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Porque dije: Para siempre será edificada misericordia; en los mismos cielos apoyarás tu verdad.

verses.KJV: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.WEB: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
verses.ASV: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Tu disseste] : Eu fiz um pacto com o meu escolhido, jurei a meu servo Davi. [Eu lhe disse] :
verses.RVR09: Hice alianza con mi escogido; juré á David mi siervo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.WEB: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
verses.ASV: Thy seed will I establish for ever, And build up thy throne to all generations. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Confirmarei tua semente para sempre, e farei teu trono continuar de geração em geração. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Para siempre confirmaré tu simiente, y edificaré tu trono por todas las generaciones. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.WEB: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.ASV: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que os céus louvem as tuas maravilhas, SENHOR; pois tua fidelidade [está] na congregação dos santos.
verses.RVR09: Y celebrarán los cielos tu maravilla, oh Jehová; tu verdad también en la congregación de los santos.

verses.KJV: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?
verses.WEB: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,
verses.ASV: For who in the skies can be compared unto Jehovah? Who among the sons of the mighty is like unto Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quem no céu pode se comparar ao SENHOR? E quem é semelhante ao SENHOR entre os filhos dos poderosos?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿quién en los cielos se igualará con Jehová? ¿quién será semejante á Jehová entre los hijos de los potentados?

verses.KJV: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.WEB: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
verses.ASV: A God very terrible in the council of the holy ones, And to be feared above all them that are round about him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus é terrível na assembleia dos santos, e mais temível do que todos os que estão ao seu redor.
verses.RVR09: Dios terrible en la grande congregación de los santos, y formidable sobre todos cuantos están alrededor suyo.

verses.KJV: O Lord God of hosts, who is a strong Lord like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.WEB: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto thee, O Jehovah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, quem é poderoso como tu, SENHOR? E tua fidelidade está ao redor de ti.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, Dios de los ejércitos, ¿quién como tú? Poderoso eres, Jehová, y tu verdad está en torno de ti.

verses.KJV: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.WEB: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
verses.ASV: Thou rulest the pride of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu dominas a arrogância do mar; quando suas ondas se levantam, tu as aquietas.
verses.RVR09: Tú tienes dominio sobre la bravura de la mar: cuando se levantan sus ondas, tú las sosiegas.

verses.KJV: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.WEB: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
verses.ASV: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quebraste a Raabe como que ferida de morte; com teu braço forte espalhaste os teus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Tú quebrantaste á Rahab como á un muerto: con el brazo de tu fortaleza esparciste á tus enemigos.

verses.KJV: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.WEB: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
verses.ASV: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: The world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus são os céus, também tua é a terra; o mundo e sua plenitude, tu os fundaste.
verses.RVR09: Tuyos los cielos, tuya también la tierra: el mundo y su plenitud, tú lo fundaste.

verses.KJV: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.WEB: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
verses.ASV: The north and the south, thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon rejoice in thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: O norte e o sul, tu os criaste; Tabor e Hermon têm muita alegria em teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Al aquilón y al austro tú los criaste: Tabor y Hermón cantarán en tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.WEB: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
verses.ASV: Thou hast a mighty arm; Strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu tens um braço poderoso; forte é tua mão, [e] alta está tua mão direita.
verses.RVR09: Tuyo el brazo con valentía; fuerte es tu mano, ensalzada tu diestra.

verses.KJV: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.WEB: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
verses.ASV: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of thy throne: Lovingkindness and truth go before thy face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Justiça e juízo são a base de teu trono; bondade e verdade vão adiante de teu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Justicia y juicio son el asiento de tu trono: misericordia y verdad van delante de tu rostro.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.WEB: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: They walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado é o povo que entende o grito de alegria; ó SENHOR, eles andarão na luz de tua face.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el pueblo que sabe aclamarte: andarán, oh Jehová, á la luz de tu rostro.

verses.KJV: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.WEB: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
verses.ASV: In thy name do they rejoice all the day; And in thy righteousness are they exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em teu nome se alegrarão o dia todo, e em tua justiça serão exaltados.
verses.RVR09: En tu nombre se alegrarán todo el día; y en tu justicia serán ensalzados.

verses.KJV: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.WEB: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
verses.ASV: For thou art the glory of their strength; And in thy favor our horn shall be exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu és a glória de sua força, e por tua boa vontade nosso poder é exaltado.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú eres la gloria de su fortaleza; y por tu buena voluntad ensalzarás nuestro cuerno.

verses.KJV: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
verses.WEB: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: For our shield belongeth unto Jehovah; And our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ao SENHOR pertence nosso escudo; e o Santo de Israel é nosso Rei.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová es nuestro escudo; y nuestro rey es el Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.WEB: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
verses.ASV: Then thou spakest in vision to thy saints, And saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então em visão falaste ao teu santo, e disseste: Pus o socorro sobre um valente; exaltei a um escolhido dentre o povo.
verses.RVR09: Entonces hablaste en visión á tu santo, y dijiste: Yo he puesto el socorro sobre valiente; he ensalzado un escogido de mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.WEB: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
verses.ASV: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Achei a Davi, meu servo; eu o ungi com meu óleo santo.
verses.RVR09: Hallé á David mi siervo; ungílo con el aceite de mi santidad.

verses.KJV: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.WEB: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
verses.ASV: With whom my hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com ele minha mão será firme; e também meu braço o fortalecerá.
verses.RVR09: Mi mano será firme con él, mi brazo también lo fortificará.

verses.KJV: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.WEB: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
verses.ASV: The enemy shall not exact from him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O inimigo não tomará suas riquezas, nem o filho da perversidade o afligirá.
verses.RVR09: No lo avasallará enemigo, ni hijo de iniquidad lo quebrantará.

verses.KJV: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.WEB: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
verses.ASV: And I will beat down his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu espancarei seus adversários, e ferirei aos que o odeiam.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo quebrantaré delante de él á sus enemigos, y heriré á sus aborrecedores.

verses.KJV: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.WEB: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
verses.ASV: But my faithfulness and my lovingkindness shall be with him; And in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E minha fidelidade e minha bondade serão com ele; e em meu nome seu poder será exaltado.
verses.RVR09: Y mi verdad y mi misericordia serán con él; y en mi nombre será ensalzado su cuerno.

verses.KJV: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.WEB: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
verses.ASV: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porei a mão dele no mar, e sua mão direita nos rios.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo pondré su mano en la mar, y en los ríos su diestra.

verses.KJV: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.WEB: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
verses.ASV: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me chamará: Tu és meu Pai, meu Deus, e a rocha da minha salvação.
verses.RVR09: El me llamará: Mi padre eres tú, mi Dios, y la roca de mi salud.

verses.KJV: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.WEB: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.ASV: I also will make him [my] first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu também o porei como primogênito, mais alto que todos os reis da terra.
verses.RVR09: Yo también le pondré por primogénito, alto sobre los reyes de la tierra.

verses.KJV: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.WEB: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
verses.ASV: My lovingkindness will I keep for him for evermore; And my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manterei minha bondade para com ele para sempre, e meu pacto com ele será firme.
verses.RVR09: Para siempre le conservaré mi misericordia; y mi alianza será firme con él.

verses.KJV: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.WEB: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.ASV: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conservarei sua semente para sempre, e o trono dele como os dias dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré su simiente para siempre, y su trono como los días de los cielos.

verses.KJV: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.WEB: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
verses.ASV: If his children forsake my law, And walk not in mine ordinances;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se seus filhos deixarem minha Lei, e não andarem em meus juízos,
verses.RVR09: Si dejaren sus hijos mi ley, y no anduvieren en mis juicios;

verses.KJV: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.WEB: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
verses.ASV: If they break my statutes, And keep not my commandments;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se profanarem os meus estatutos, e não guardarem os meus mandamentos,
verses.RVR09: Si profanaren mis estatutos, y no guardaren mis mandamientos;

verses.KJV: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.WEB: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.ASV: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então punirei a transgressão deles com vara, e a perversidade deles com açoite,
verses.RVR09: Entonces visitaré con vara su rebelión, y con azotes sus iniquidades.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.WEB: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
verses.ASV: But my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, Nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nunca tirarei minha bondade dele, nem falharei em minha fidelidade.
verses.RVR09: Mas no quitaré de él mi misericordia, ni falsearé mi verdad.

verses.KJV: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.WEB: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
verses.ASV: My covenant will I not break, Nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não quebrarei o meu pacto, e o que saiu dos meus lábios não mudarei.
verses.RVR09: No olvidaré mi pacto, ni mudaré lo que ha salido de mis labios.

verses.KJV: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.WEB: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
verses.ASV: Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David:
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma vez jurei por minha Santidade, [e] nunca mentirei a Davi.
verses.RVR09: Una vez he jurado por mi santidad, que no mentiré á David.

verses.KJV: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.WEB: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
verses.ASV: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: A semente dele durará para sempre, e o trono dele [será] como o sol perante mim.
verses.RVR09: Su simiente será para siempre, y su trono como el sol delante de mí.

verses.KJV: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.WEB: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
verses.ASV: It shall be established for ever as the moon, And [as] the faithful witness in the sky. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como a lua, ele será confirmado para sempre; e a testemunha no céu é fiel. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Como la luna será firme para siempre, y como un testigo fiel en el cielo. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.WEB: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
verses.ASV: But thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu te rebelaste, e [o] rejeitaste; ficaste irado contra o teu Ungido.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú desechaste y menospreciaste á tu ungido; y te has airado con él.

verses.KJV: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.WEB: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
verses.ASV: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown [by casting it] to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Anulaste o pacto do teu servo; desonraste a coroa dele [lançando-a] contra a terra.
verses.RVR09: Rompiste el pacto de tu siervo; has profanado su corona hasta la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.WEB: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.ASV: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Derrubaste todos os seus muros; quebraste suas fortificações.
verses.RVR09: Aportillaste todos sus vallados; has quebrantado sus fortalezas.

verses.KJV: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.WEB: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.ASV: All that pass by the way rob him: He is become a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que passam pelo caminho o despojaram; ele foi humilhado por seus vizinhos.
verses.RVR09: Menoscabáronle todos los que pasaron por el camino: es oprobio á sus vecinos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.WEB: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
verses.ASV: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantaste a mão direita de seus adversários; alegraste a todos os inimigos dele.
verses.RVR09: Has ensalzado la diestra de sus enemigos; has alegrado á todos sus adversarios.

verses.KJV: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.WEB: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
verses.ASV: Yea, thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também deixaste de afiar sua espada; e não o sustentaste na batalha.
verses.RVR09: Embotaste asimismo el filo de su espada, y no lo levantaste en la batalla.

verses.KJV: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.WEB: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
verses.ASV: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeste cessar sua formosura; e derrubaste seu trono à terra.
verses.RVR09: Hiciste cesar su brillo, y echaste su trono por tierra.

verses.KJV: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.WEB: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.ASV: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Encurtaste os dias de sua cidade; cobriste-o de vergonha. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Has acortado los días de su juventud; hasle cubierto de afrenta. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.WEB: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
verses.ASV: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? [How long] shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando, SENHOR? Tu te esconderás para sempre? Arderá teu furor como o fogo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo, oh Jehová? ¿te esconderás para siempre? ¿arderá tu ira como el fuego?

verses.KJV: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.WEB: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
verses.ASV: Oh remember how short my time is: For what vanity hast thou created all the children of men!
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te de que curta é minha vida; por que criarias em vão todos os filhos dos homens?
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de cuán corto sea mi tiempo: ¿por qué habrás criado en vano á todos los hijos del hombre?

verses.KJV: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.WEB: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
verses.ASV: What man is he that shall live and not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Que homem vive, que não experimente a morte? Livrará ele a sua alma do poder do Xeol? (Selá)
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué hombre vivirá y no verá muerte? ¿librarás su vida del poder del sepulcro? (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
verses.WEB: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
verses.ASV: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Senhor, onde estão as tuas bondades do passado, que juraste a Davi por tua fidelidade?
verses.RVR09: Señor, ¿dónde están tus antiguas misericordias, que juraste á David por tu verdad?

verses.KJV: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.WEB: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
verses.ASV: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the mighty peoples,
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te, Senhor, da humilhação de teus servos, que eu trago em meu peito, [causada] por todos e grandes povos.
verses.RVR09: Señor, acuérdate del oprobio de tus siervos; oprobio que llevo yo en mi seno de muchos pueblos.

verses.KJV: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.WEB: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
verses.ASV: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com [humilhação] os teus inimigos insultam, SENHOR, com a qual insultam os passos do teu ungido.
verses.RVR09: Porque tus enemigos, oh Jehová, han deshonrado, porque tus enemigos han deshonrado los pasos de tu ungido.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito [seja] o SENHOR para todo o sempre. Amém, e Amém.
verses.RVR09: Bendito Jehová para siempre. Amén, y Amén.

verses.KJV: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.WEB: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
verses.ASV: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Oração de Moisés, homem de Deus: Senhor, tu tens sido nossa habitação, de geração em geração.
verses.RVR09: Oración de Moisés varón de Dios. SEÑOR, tú nos has sido refugio en generación y en generación.

verses.KJV: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
verses.WEB: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
verses.ASV: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que os montes surgissem, e tu produzisses a terra e o mundo, desde à eternidade até a eternidade tu és Deus.
verses.RVR09: Antes que naciesen los montes, y formases la tierra y el mundo, y desde el siglo y hasta el siglo, tú eres Dios.

verses.KJV: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.WEB: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
verses.ASV: Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu fazes o homem voltar ao pó, e dizes: Retornai-vos, filhos dos homens!
verses.RVR09: Vuelves al hombre hasta ser quebrantado, y dices: Convertíos, hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
verses.WEB: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
verses.ASV: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque mil anos aos teus olhos são como o dia de ontem, que passou, e como a vigília da noite.
verses.RVR09: Porque mil años delante de tus ojos, son como el día de ayer, que pasó, y como una de las vigilias de la noche.

verses.KJV: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
verses.WEB: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
verses.ASV: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu os levas como correntes de águas; são como o sono; de madrugada são como a erva que brota:
verses.RVR09: Háceslos pasar como avenida de aguas; son como sueño; como la hierba que crece en la mañana:

verses.KJV: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.WEB: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
verses.ASV: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.ALMEIDA: De madrugada floresce, e brota; à tarde é cortada, e se seca.
verses.RVR09: En la mañana florece y crece; á la tarde es cortada, y se seca.

verses.KJV: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.WEB: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
verses.ASV: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque perecemos com tua ira, e nos assombramos com teu furor.
verses.RVR09: Porque con tu furor somos consumidos, y con tu ira somos conturbados.

verses.KJV: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
verses.WEB: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
verses.ASV: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu pões nossas perversidades perante ti, nosso [pecado] oculto [perante] a luz do teu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Pusiste nuestras maldades delante de ti, nuestros yerros á la luz de tu rostro.

verses.KJV: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
verses.WEB: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
verses.ASV: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todos os nossos dias se vão por causa de tua irritação; acabamos nossos anos como um suspiro.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos nuestros días declinan á causa de tu ira; acabamos nuestros años como un pensamiento.

verses.KJV: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.WEB: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
verses.ASV: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os dias de nossa vida [chegam até] os setenta anos; e os que são mais fortes, até os oitenta anos; e o melhor deles é canseira e opressão, porque logo é cortado, e saímos voando.
verses.RVR09: Los días de nuestra edad son setenta años; que si en los más robustos son ochenta años, con todo su fortaleza es molestia y trabajo; porque es cortado presto, y volamos.

verses.KJV: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
verses.WEB: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
verses.ASV: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem conhece a força de tua ira? O teu furor é conforme o temor a ti.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién conoce la fortaleza de tu ira, y tu indignación según que debes ser temido?

verses.KJV: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verses.WEB: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verses.ASV: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensina [-nos] a contar nossos dias de tal maneira que alcancemos um coração sábio.
verses.RVR09: Enséñanos de tal modo á contar nuestros días, que traigamos al corazón sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Return, O Lord, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.WEB: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
verses.ASV: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Retorna, SENHOR! Até quando? [Tem] compaixão para com teus servos.
verses.RVR09: Vuélvete, oh Jehová: ¿hasta cuándo? y aplácate para con tus siervos.

verses.KJV: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.WEB: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.ASV: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farta-nos de manhã com tua bondade; e nos alegraremos e seremos cheios de alegria por todos os nossos dias.
verses.RVR09: Sácianos presto de tu misericordia: y cantaremos y nos alegraremos todos nuestros días.

verses.KJV: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.WEB: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
verses.ASV: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegra-nos conforme os dias [em que] tu nos afligiste, os anos [em que] vimos o mal.
verses.RVR09: Alégranos conforme á los días que nos afligiste, y los años que vimos mal.

verses.KJV: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
verses.WEB: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
verses.ASV: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que tua obra apareça aos teus servos, e tua glória sobre seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Aparezca en tus siervos tu obra, y tu gloria sobre sus hijos.

verses.KJV: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.WEB: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
verses.ASV: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que o agrado do SENHOR nosso Deus seja sobre nós; e confirma as obras de nossas mãos sobre nós; sim, a obra de nossas mãos, confirma!
verses.RVR09: Y sea la luz de Jehová nuestro Dios sobre nosotros: y ordena en nosotros la obra de nuestras manos, la obra de nuestras manos confirma.

verses.KJV: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.WEB: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.ASV: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que mora no esconderijo do Altíssimo, à sombra do Todo-Poderoso habitará.
verses.RVR09: EL que habita al abrigo del Altísimo, morará bajo la sombra del Omnipotente.

verses.KJV: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.WEB: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
verses.ASV: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Direi ao SENHOR: [Tu és] meu refúgio e minha fortaleza; Deus meu, em quem confio.
verses.RVR09: Diré yo á Jehová: Esperanza mía, y castillo mío; mi Dios, en él confiaré.

verses.KJV: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.WEB: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
verses.ASV: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele te livrará do laço do caçador e da peste maligna.
verses.RVR09: Y él te librará del lazo del cazador: de la peste destruidora.

verses.KJV: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verses.WEB: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
verses.ASV: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com suas penas ele te cobrirá, e debaixo de suas asas estarás protegido; a verdade dele é escudo grande e protetor.
verses.RVR09: Con sus plumas te cubrirá, y debajo de sus alas estarás seguro: escudo y adarga es su verdad.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.WEB: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não terás medo do terror da noite, [nem] da flecha que voa de dia;
verses.RVR09: No tendrás temor de espanto nocturno, ni de saeta que vuele de día;

verses.KJV: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.WEB: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
verses.ASV: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Nem] da peste que anda às escuras, [nem] da mortandade que assola ao meio-dia.
verses.RVR09: Ni de pestilencia que ande en oscuridad, ni de mortandad que en medio del día destruya.

verses.KJV: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.WEB: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
verses.ASV: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; [But] it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cairão mil ao teu lado, e dez mil à tua direita, [mas] a ti nada alcançará.
verses.RVR09: Caerán á tu lado mil, y diez mil á tu diestra: mas á ti no llegará.

verses.KJV: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.WEB: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.ASV: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Somente verás com teus olhos, e observarás o pagamento dos perversos;
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente con tus ojos mirarás, y verás la recompensa de los impíos.

verses.KJV: Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
verses.WEB: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
verses.ASV: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu fizeste como morada ao SENHOR: o meu refúgio, o Altíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú has puesto á Jehová, que es mi esperanza, al Altísimo por tu habitación,

verses.KJV: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.WEB: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
verses.ASV: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mal nenhum te sucederá, nem praga alguma chegará à tua tenda;
verses.RVR09: No te sobrevendrá mal, ni plaga tocará tu morada.

verses.KJV: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.WEB: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
verses.ASV: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele ordenou aos anjos quanto a ti, para que guardem todos os teus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Pues que á sus ángeles mandará acerca de ti, que te guarden en todos tus caminos.

verses.KJV: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.WEB: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
verses.ASV: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelas mãos te levarão, para que não tropeces teu pé em alguma pedra.
verses.RVR09: En las manos te llevarán, porque tu pie no tropiece en piedra.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.WEB: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu pisarás sobre o leão e a cobra; passarás esmagando ao filho do leão e à serpente.
verses.RVR09: Sobre el león y el basilisco pisarás; hollarás al cachorro del león y al dragón.

verses.KJV: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.WEB: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
verses.ASV: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por ele ter me amado tanto, eu também o livrarei; em alto retiro eu o porei, porque ele conhece o meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto en mí ha puesto su voluntad, yo también lo libraré: pondrélo en alto, por cuanto ha conocido mi nombre.

verses.KJV: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.WEB: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
verses.ASV: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble: I will deliver him, and honor him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele me chamará, e eu o responderei; estarei com ele na angústia; [dela] eu o livrarei, e o honrarei.
verses.RVR09: Me invocará, y yo le responderé: con él estaré yo en la angustia: lo libraré, y le glorificaré.

verses.KJV: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.WEB: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
verses.ASV: With long life will I satisfy him, And show him my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu o satisfarei com uma longa vida , e lhe mostrarei a minha salvação.
verses.RVR09: Saciarélo de larga vida, y mostraréle mi salud.

verses.KJV: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High:
verses.WEB: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
verses.ASV: A Psalm, a Song for the sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah, And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo e cântico para o dia do Sábado: Bom é louvar ao SENHOR, e cantar louvores ao teu nome, ó Altíssimo;
verses.RVR09: Salmo: Canción para el día del Sábado. BUENO es alabar á Jehová, y cantar salmos á tu nombre, oh Altísimo;

verses.KJV: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.WEB: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
verses.ASV: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para anunciar tua bondade pela manhã, e tua fidelidade durante as noites.
verses.RVR09: Anunciar por la mañana tu misericordia, y tu verdad en las noches,

verses.KJV: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.WEB: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
verses.ASV: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o instrumento de dez cordas, com a lira, e com música de harpa.
verses.RVR09: En el decacordio y en el salterio, en tono suave con el arpa.

verses.KJV: For thou, Lord, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.WEB: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
verses.ASV: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu, SENHOR, tens me alegrado com teus feitos; cantarei de alegria pelas obras de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto me has alegrado, oh Jehová, con tus obras; en las obras de tus manos me gozo.

verses.KJV: O Lord, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.WEB: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.ASV: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, como são grandes tuas obras! Muito profundos são teus pensamentos!
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuán grandes son tus obras, oh Jehová! Muy profundos son tus pensamientos.

verses.KJV: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.WEB: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
verses.ASV: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this:
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem bruto não os conhece, nem o tolo entende isto.
verses.RVR09: El hombre necio no sabe, y el insensato no entiende esto:

verses.KJV: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.WEB: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
verses.ASV: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os perversos crescem como a erva, e florescem todos os praticantes de maldade, [assim então] serão destruídos para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Que brotan los impíos como la hierba, y florecen todos los que obran iniquidad, para ser destruídos para siempre.

verses.KJV: But thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.
verses.WEB: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.
verses.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tu és Altíssimo para sempre, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Jehová, para siempre eres Altísimo.

verses.KJV: For, lo, thine enemies, O Lord, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.WEB: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
verses.ASV: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que teus inimigos, SENHOR, porque eis que teus inimigos pereceram; serão dispersos todos os praticantes de maldade.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí tus enemigos, oh Jehová, porque he aquí, perecerán tus enemigos; serán disipados todos los que obran maldad.

verses.KJV: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.WEB: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.ASV: But my horn hast thou exalted like [the horn of] the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu exaltaste o meu poder, como que um chifre de touro selvagem; eu fui ungido com óleo fresco.
verses.RVR09: Empero tú ensalzarás mi cuerno como el de unicornio: seré ungido con aceite fresco.

verses.KJV: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.WEB: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
verses.ASV: Mine eye also hath seen [my desire] on mine enemies, Mine ears have heard [my desire] of the evil-doers that rise up against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meus olhos verão [o fim] dos meus inimigos; meus ouvidos ouvirão [o fim] dos malfeitores que se levantam contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Y mirarán mis ojos sobre mis enemigos: oirán mis oídos de los que se levantaron contra mí, de los malignos.

verses.KJV: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.WEB: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.ASV: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo florescerá como a palma; crescerá como o cedro do Líbano.
verses.RVR09: El justo florecerá como la palma: crecerá como cedro en el Líbano.

verses.KJV: Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.WEB: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
verses.ASV: They are planted in the house of Jehovah; They shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os [justos] estão plantados na casa do SENHOR, crescerão nos pátios do nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Plantados en la casa de Jehová, en los atrios de nuestro Dios florecerán.

verses.KJV: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.WEB: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
verses.ASV: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and green:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Até] na velhice ainda darão fruto; serão fortes e verdes;
verses.RVR09: Aun en la vejez fructificarán; estarán vigorosos y verdes;

verses.KJV: To shew that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.WEB: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.ASV: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para anunciarem que o SENHOR é correto; ele é minha rocha, e não há perversidade nele.
verses.RVR09: Para anunciar que Jehová mi fortaleza es recto, y que en él no hay injusticia.

verses.KJV: The Lord reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.WEB: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
verses.ASV: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR reina. Ele está vestido de majestade; o SENHOR está vestido de poder, [com o qual] se envolveu. O mundo está firmado, não se abalará.
verses.RVR09: JEHOVÁ reina, vistióse de magnificencia, vistióse Jehová, ciñóse de fortaleza; afirmó también el mundo, que no se moverá.

verses.KJV: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
verses.WEB: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
verses.ASV: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu trono está firme desde o passado; tu [és] desde a eternidade.
verses.RVR09: Firme es tu trono desde entonces: tú eres eternalmente.

verses.KJV: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.WEB: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
verses.ASV: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, os rios levantam; os rios levantam seus ruídos; os rios levantam suas ondas.
verses.RVR09: Alzaron los ríos, oh Jehová, alzaron los ríos su sonido; alzaron los ríos sus ondas.

verses.KJV: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.WEB: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
verses.ASV: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém] o SENHOR nas alturas é mais forte que os ruídos de muitas águas, [mais que] as fortes ondas do mar.
verses.RVR09: Jehová en las alturas es más poderoso que el estruendo de las muchas aguas, más que las recias ondas de la mar.

verses.KJV: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O Lord, for ever.
verses.WEB: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.
verses.ASV: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muito fiéis são teus testemunhos; a santidade embeleza tua casa, SENHOR, para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Tus testimonios son muy firmes: la santidad conviene á tu casa, oh Jehová, por los siglos y para siempre.

verses.KJV: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.WEB: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Deus das vinganças, SENHOR Deus das vinganças, mostra-te com teu brilho!
verses.RVR09: JEHOVÁ, Dios de las venganzas, Dios de las venganzas, muéstrate.

verses.KJV: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.WEB: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
verses.ASV: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud [their] desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exalta-te, ó Juiz da terra! Retribui com punição aos arrogantes.
verses.RVR09: Ensálzate, oh Juez de la tierra: da el pago á los soberbios.

verses.KJV: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.WEB: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
verses.ASV: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando os perversos, SENHOR, até quando os perversos se alegrarão?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo los impíos, hasta cuándo, oh Jehová, se gozarán los impíos?

verses.KJV: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.WEB: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
verses.ASV: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles falam [demais] , e dizem palavras soberbas; todos os que praticam a maldade se orgulham.
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo pronunciarán, hablarán cosas duras, y se vanagloriarán todos los que obran iniquidad?

verses.KJV: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.WEB: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.
verses.ASV: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles despedaçam ao teu povo, SENHOR, e humilham a tua herança.
verses.RVR09: A tu pueblo, oh Jehová, quebrantan, y á tu heredad afligen.

verses.KJV: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.WEB: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
verses.ASV: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles matam a viúva e o estrangeiro, e tiram a vida dos órfãos.
verses.RVR09: A la viuda y al extanjero matan, y á los huérfanos quitan la vida.

verses.KJV: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
verses.WEB: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
verses.ASV: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizem: O SENHOR não vê [isso] , e o Deus de Jacó não está prestando atenção.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron: No verá JAH, ni entenderá el Dios de Jacob.

verses.KJV: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.WEB: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
verses.ASV: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.ALMEIDA: Entendei, ó tolos dentre o povo; e vós [que sois] loucos, quando sereis sábios?
verses.RVR09: Entended, necios del pueblo; y vosotros fatuos, ¿cuándo seréis sabios?

verses.KJV: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.WEB: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
verses.ASV: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso aquele que criou os ouvidos não ouviria? Aquele que formou os olhos não veria?
verses.RVR09: El que plantó el oído, ¿no oirá? el que formó el ojo, ¿no verá?

verses.KJV: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.WEB: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
verses.ASV: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, [Even] he that teacheth man knowledge?
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que disciplina as nações não castigaria? É ele o que ensina o conhecimento ao homem.
verses.RVR09: El que castiga las gentes, ¿no reprenderá? ¿no sabrá el que enseña al hombre la ciencia?

verses.KJV: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.WEB: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
verses.ASV: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR conhece os pensamentos do homem, que são inúteis.
verses.RVR09: Jehová conoce los pensamientos de los hombres, que son vanidad.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.WEB: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado é o homem a quem tu disciplinas, SENHOR, e em tua Lei o ensinas;
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el hombre á quien tú, JAH, castigares, y en tu ley lo instruyeres;

verses.KJV: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.WEB: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.ASV: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para tu lhe dares descanso dos dias de aflição, até que seja cavada a cova para o perverso.
verses.RVR09: Para tranquilizarle en los días de aflicción, en tanto que para el impío se cava el hoyo.

verses.KJV: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.WEB: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o SENHOR não abandonará o seu povo, nem desamparará a sua herança.
verses.RVR09: Porque no dejará Jehová su pueblo, ni desamparará su heredad;

verses.KJV: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.WEB: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.ASV: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o juízo restaurará a justiça, e todos os corretos de coração o seguirão.
verses.RVR09: Sino que el juicio será vuelto á justicia, y en pos de ella irán todos los rectos de corazón.

verses.KJV: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.WEB: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
verses.ASV: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem se levantará em meu favor contra os malfeitores? Quem se porá em meu favor contra os praticantes de perversidade?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién se levantará por mí contra los malignos? ¿quién estará por mí contra los que obran iniquidad?

verses.KJV: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.WEB: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
verses.ASV: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o SENHOR não tivesse sido meu socorro, minha alma logo teria vindo a morar no silêncio [da morte] .
verses.RVR09: Si no me ayudara Jehová, presto morara mi alma en el silencio.

verses.KJV: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.
verses.WEB: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.
verses.ASV: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu dizia: Meu pé está escorregando;Tua bondade, ó SENHOR, me sustentava.
verses.RVR09: Cuando yo decía: Mi pie resbala: tu misericordia, oh Jehová, me sustentaba.

verses.KJV: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.WEB: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
verses.ASV: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando minhas preocupações se multiplicavam dentro de mim, teus consolos confortaram a minha alma.
verses.RVR09: En la multitud de mis pensamientos dentro de mí, tus consolaciones alegraban mi alma.

verses.KJV: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.WEB: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
verses.ASV: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso teria comunhão contigo o trono da maldade, que faz leis opressivas?
verses.RVR09: ¿Juntaráse contigo el trono de iniquidades, que forma agravio en el mandamiento?

verses.KJV: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.WEB: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.ASV: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos se juntam contra a alma do justo, e condenam o sangue inocente.
verses.RVR09: Pónense en corros contra la vida del justo, y condenan la sangre inocente.

verses.KJV: But the Lord is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
verses.WEB: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR é meu alto retiro, e meu Deus a rocha de meu refúgio.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová me ha sido por refugio; y mi Dios por roca de mi confianza.

verses.KJV: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.
verses.WEB: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.
verses.ASV: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele fará voltar sobre eles suas próprias perversidades, e por suas maldades ele os destruirá; o SENHOR nosso Deus os destruirá.
verses.RVR09: Y él hará tornar sobre ellos su iniquidad, y los destruirá por su propia maldad; los talará Jehová nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.WEB: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
verses.ASV: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, cantemos alegres ao SENHOR; gritemos [de alegria] à rocha de nossa salvação.
verses.RVR09: VENID, celebremos alegremente á Jehová: cantemos con júbilo á la roca de nuestra salud.

verses.KJV: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.WEB: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
verses.ASV: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cheguemos adiante de sua presença com agradecimentos; cantemos salmos a ele.
verses.RVR09: Lleguemos ante su acatamiento con alabanza; aclamémosle con cánticos.

verses.KJV: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.WEB: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Senhor é o grande Deus, e maior Rei do que todos os deuses.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová es Dios grande; y Rey grande sobre todos los dioses.

verses.KJV: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.WEB: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
verses.ASV: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na mão dele estão as profundezas da terra; e a ele pertencem os altos montes.
verses.RVR09: Porque en su mano están las profundidades de la tierra, y las alturas de los montes son suyas.

verses.KJV: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.WEB: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
verses.ASV: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dele [também] é o mar, pois ele o fez; e suas mãos formaram a [terra] seca.
verses.RVR09: Suya también la mar, pues él la hizo; y sus manos formaron la seca.

verses.KJV: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the Lord our maker.
verses.WEB: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,
verses.ASV: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, adoremos, e prostremo-nos; ajoelhemo-nos perante o SENHOR, que nos fez.
verses.RVR09: Venid, adoremos y postrémonos; arrodillémonos delante de Jehová nuestro hacedor.

verses.KJV: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.WEB: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
verses.ASV: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele é o nosso Deus, e nós [somos] o povo do seu pasto, e as ovelhas de sua mão. Se hoje ouvirdes a voz dele,
verses.RVR09: Porque él es nuestro Dios; nosotros el pueblo de su dehesa, y ovejas de su mano. Si hoy oyereis su voz,

verses.KJV: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.WEB: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
verses.ASV: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não endureçais vosso coração, como em Meribá, como no dia da tentação no deserto,
verses.RVR09: No endurezcáis vuestro corazón como en Meriba, como el día de Masa en el desierto;

verses.KJV: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.WEB: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
verses.ASV: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde vossos pais me tentaram; eles me provaram, mesmo já tendo visto minha obra.
verses.RVR09: Donde me tentaron vuestros padres, probáronme, y vieron mi obra.

verses.KJV: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.WEB: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
verses.ASV: Forty years long was I grieved with [that] generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por quarenta anos aguentei com desgosto d [esta] geração, e disse: Este povo se desvia em seus corações; e eles não conhecem meus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Cuarenta años estuve disgustado con la nación, y dije: Pueblo es que divaga de corazón, y no han conocido mis caminos.

verses.KJV: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.WEB: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
verses.ASV: Wherefore I sware in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso jurei em minha ira que eles não entrarão no meu [lugar] de descanso.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto juré en mi furor que no entrarían en mi reposo.

verses.KJV: O sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth.
verses.WEB: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
verses.ASV: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR uma nova canção; cantai ao SENHOR toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: CANTAD á Jehová canción nueva; cantad á Jehová, toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.WEB: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
verses.ASV: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR, bendizei ao seu nome; anunciai todos os dias sua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Jehová, bendecid su nombre: anunciad de día en día su salud.

verses.KJV: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.WEB: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
verses.ASV: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contai sua glória por entre as nações, [e] suas maravilhas por entre todos os povos.
verses.RVR09: Contad entre las gentes su gloria, en todos los pueblos sus maravillas.

verses.KJV: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.WEB: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.ASV: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.
