verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR é grande e muito digno de louvor; ele é mais temível que todos os deuses.
verses.RVR09: Porque grande es Jehová, y digno de suprema alabanza; terrible sobre todos los dioses.

verses.KJV: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.WEB: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.ASV: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todos os deuses dos povos são ídolos, porém o SENHOR fez os céus;
verses.RVR09: Porque todos los dioses de los pueblos son ídolos: mas Jehová hizo los cielos.

verses.KJV: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.WEB: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.ASV: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Majestade e glória há diante dele; força e beleza [há] em seu santuário.
verses.RVR09: Alabanza y magnificencia delante de él: fortaleza y gloria en su santuario.

verses.KJV: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
verses.WEB: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reconhecei ao SENHOR, ó famílias dos povos; reconhecei que ao SENHOR pertence a glória e a força.
verses.RVR09: Dad á Jehová, oh familias de los pueblos, dad á Jehová la gloria y la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.WEB: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reconhecei ao SENHOR a glória de seu nome; trazei ofertas, e entrai nos pátios dele.
verses.RVR09: Dad á Jehová la honra debida á su nombre: tomad presentes, y venid á sus atrios.

verses.KJV: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.WEB: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.ASV: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Adorai ao SENHOR na glória da santidade; temei perante sua presença toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Encorvaos á Jehová en la hermosura de su santuario: temed delante de él, toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.WEB: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
verses.ASV: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved: He will judge the peoples with equity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizei entre as nações: O SENHOR reina; o mundo está firme, e não se abalará; ele julgará aos povos de forma correta.
verses.RVR09: Decid en las gentes: Jehová reinó, también afirmó el mundo, no será conmovido: juzgará á los pueblos en justicia.

verses.KJV: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.WEB: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
verses.ASV: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrem-se os céus, e enchei de alegria a terra; faça barulho o mar e sua plenitude.
verses.RVR09: Alégrense los cielos, y gócese la tierra: brame la mar y su plenitud.

verses.KJV: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.WEB: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
verses.ASV: Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy
verses.ALMEIDA: Saltem contentes o campo e tudo que nele há, e que todas as árvores dos bosque cantem de alegria,
verses.RVR09: Regocíjese el campo, y todo lo que en él está: entonces todos los árboles del bosque rebosarán de contento,

verses.KJV: Before the Lord: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.WEB: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
verses.ASV: Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with his truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante do SENHOR; porque ele vem; porque ele vem para julgar a terra. Ele julgará ao mundo com justiça, e aos povos com sua verdade.
verses.RVR09: Delante de Jehová que vino: porque vino á juzgar la tierra. Juzgará al mundo con justicia, y á los pueblos con su verdad.

verses.KJV: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
verses.WEB: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
verses.ASV: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR reina; que a terra se encha de alegria; alegrem-se as muitas ilhas.
verses.RVR09: JEHOVÁ reinó: regocíjese la tierra: alégrense las muchas islas.

verses.KJV: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
verses.WEB: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.ASV: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nuvens e escuridão há ao redor dele; justiça e juízo são a base de seu trono.
verses.RVR09: Nube y oscuridad alrededor de él: justicia y juicio son el asiento de su trono.

verses.KJV: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.WEB: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
verses.ASV: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fogo vai adiante dele, que inflama seus adversários ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Fuego irá delante de él, y abrasará en derredor sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.WEB: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
verses.ASV: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus relâmpagos iluminam o mundo; a terra os vê, e treme.
verses.RVR09: Sus relámpagos alumbraron el mundo: la tierra vió, y estremecióse.

verses.KJV: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.WEB: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.ASV: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes se derretem como cera na presença do SENHOR, na presença do Senhor de toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Los montes se derritieron como cera delante de Jehová, delante del Señor de toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.WEB: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
verses.ASV: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os céus anunciam sua justiça, e todos os povos veem sua glória.
verses.RVR09: Los cielos denunciaron su justicia, y todos los pueblos vieron su gloria.

verses.KJV: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
verses.WEB: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
verses.ASV: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam envergonhados todos os que servem a imagens, e os que se orgulham de ídolos; prostrai-vos diante dele todos os deuses.
verses.RVR09: Avergüéncense todos los que sirven á las imágenes de talla, los que se alaban de los ídolos: los dioses todos á él se encorven.

verses.KJV: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O Lord.
verses.WEB: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.
verses.ASV: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sião ouviu, e se alegrou; e as filhas de Judá tiveram muita alegria, por causa de teus juízos, SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Oyó Sión, y alegróse; y las hijas de Judá, oh Jehová, se gozaron por tus juicios.

verses.KJV: For thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.WEB: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
verses.ASV: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu, SENHOR, és o Altíssimo sobre toda a terra; tu és muito mais elevado que todos os deuses.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú, Jehová, eres alto sobre toda la tierra: eres muy ensalzado sobre todos los dioses.

verses.KJV: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.WEB: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.ASV: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós que amais ao SENHOR: odiai o mal; ele guarda a alma de seus santos, [e] os resgata da mão dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Los que á Jehová amáis, aborreced el mal: guarda él las almas de sus santos; de mano de los impíos los libra.

verses.KJV: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.WEB: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.ASV: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: A luz é semeada para o justo, e a alegria para os corretos de coração.
verses.RVR09: Luz está sembrada para el justo, y alegría para los rectos de corazón.

verses.KJV: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.WEB: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
verses.ASV: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial [name].
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós justos, alegrai-vos no SENHOR; e agradecei em memória de sua santidade.
verses.RVR09: Alegraos, justos, en Jehová: y alabad la memoria de su santidad.

verses.KJV: O sing unto the Lord a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.WEB: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
verses.ASV: A Psalm. Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo: Cantai ao SENHOR uma canção nova, porque ele fez maravilhas; sua mão direita e seu santo braço lhe fez ter a salvação.
verses.RVR09: Salmo. CANTAD á Jehová canción nueva; porque ha hecho maravillas: su diestra lo ha salvado, y su santo brazo.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.WEB: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR fez ser conhecida sua salvação; perante os olhos das nações ele mostrou sua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Jehová ha hecho notoria su salud: en ojos de las gentes ha descubierto su justicia.

verses.KJV: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.WEB: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.ASV: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se lembrou de sua bondade e de sua fidelidade para com a casa de Israel; todos os confins da terra viram a salvação de nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Hase acordado de su misericordia y de su verdad para con la casa de Israel: todos los términos de la tierra han visto la salud de nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.WEB: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
verses.ASV: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gritai de alegria ao SENHOR, toda a terra; clamai, cantai alegres, e tocai salmos.
verses.RVR09: Cantad alegres á Jehová, toda la tierra; levantad la voz, y aplaudid, y salmead.

verses.KJV: Sing unto the Lord with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.WEB: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
verses.ASV: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tocai ao SENHOR com harpa; com harpa, e com a voz da música;
verses.RVR09: Salmead á Jehová con arpa; con arpa y voz de cántico.

verses.KJV: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.
verses.WEB: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
verses.ASV: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com trombetas, e som de cornetas, clamai alegremente diante do Rei SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Aclamad con trompetas y sonidos de bocina delante del rey Jehová.

verses.KJV: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.WEB: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
verses.ASV: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;
verses.ALMEIDA: Faça barulho o mar com sua plenitude; o mundo com os que nele habitam.
verses.RVR09: Brame la mar y su plenitud; el mundo y los que en él habitan;

verses.KJV: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.WEB: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
verses.ASV: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together
verses.ALMEIDA: Que os rios batam palmas, que as montanhas juntamente se alegrem,
verses.RVR09: Los ríos batan las manos; los montes todos hagan regocijo,

verses.KJV: Before the Lord; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.WEB: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
verses.ASV: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante do SENHOR, porque ele vem para julgar a terra; ele julgará ao mundo com justiça, e aos povos de forma correta.
verses.RVR09: Delante de Jehová; porque vino á juzgar la tierra: juzgará al mundo con justicia, y á los pueblos con rectitud.

verses.KJV: The Lord reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.WEB: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
verses.ASV: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth [above] the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR reina, tremam as nações; [ele é] o que se senta [entre] os querubins, mova-se a terra.
verses.RVR09: JEHOVÁ reinó, temblarán los pueblos: él está sentado sobre los querubines, conmoveráse la tierra.

verses.KJV: The Lord is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
verses.WEB: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é grande em Sião; ele é mais elevado que todos os povos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová en Sión es grande, y ensalzado sobre todos los pueblos.

verses.KJV: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.WEB: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
verses.ASV: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvem o teu grande e temível nome, [porque] ele é santo;
verses.RVR09: Alaben tu nombre grande y tremendo: él es santo.

verses.KJV: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.WEB: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.ASV: The king’s strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como também a fortaleza do Rei, que ama o juízo; tu firmaste as coisas corretas; tu fizeste juízo e justiça em Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y la gloria del rey ama el juicio: tú confirmas la rectitud; tú has hecho en Jacob juicio y justicia.

verses.KJV: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.WEB: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
verses.ASV: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exaltai ao SENHOR nosso Deus, e prostrai-vos perante o suporte dos seus pés, [porque] ele é santo.
verses.RVR09: Ensalzad á Jehová nuestro Dios, y encorvaos al estrado de sus pies: él es santo.

verses.KJV: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he answered them.
verses.WEB: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.ASV: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Moisés e Arão estavam entre seus sacerdotes, e Samuel entre os que chamavam o seu nome; eles clamavam ao SENHOR, e ele os respondia.
verses.RVR09: Moisés y Aarón entre sus sacerdotes, y Samuel entre los que invocaron su nombre; invocaban á Jehová, y él les respondía.

verses.KJV: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.WEB: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
verses.ASV: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na coluna da nuvem ele lhes falava; eles guardavam seus testemunhos e os estatutos que ele tinha lhes dado.
verses.RVR09: En columna de nube hablaba con ellos: guardaban sus testimonios, y el estatuto que les había dado.

verses.KJV: Thou answeredst them, O Lord our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.WEB: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
verses.ASV: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR nosso Deus, tu os respondia; tu lhes foste Deus perdoador, ainda que vingasse as coisas que eles praticavam.
verses.RVR09: Jehová Dios nuestro, tú les respondías: tú les fuiste un Dios perdonador, y vengador de sus obras.

verses.KJV: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.
verses.WEB: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!
verses.ASV: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exaltai ao SENHOR nosso Deus, e prostrai-vos perante seu santo monte; pois santo é o SENHOR nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Ensalzad á Jehová nuestro Dios, y encorvaos al monte de su santidad; porque Jehová nuestro Dios es santo.

verses.KJV: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands.
verses.WEB: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
verses.ASV: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de louvor: Gritai de alegria ao SENHOR toda a terra!
verses.RVR09: Salmo de alabanza. CANTAD alegres á Dios, habitantes de toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.WEB: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
verses.ASV: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Servi ao SENHOR com alegria; vinde com alegre canto perante sua presença.
verses.RVR09: Servid á Jehová con alegría: venid ante su acatamiento con regocijo.

verses.KJV: Know ye that the Lord he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.WEB: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.ASV: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sabei que o SENHOR é Deus; foi ele, e não nós, que nos fez seu povo, e ovelhas de seu pasto.
verses.RVR09: Reconoced que Jehová él es Dios: él nos hizo, y no nosotros á nosotros mismos; pueblo suyo somos, y ovejas de su prado.

verses.KJV: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verses.WEB: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
verses.ASV: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entrai pelas portas dele com agradecimento, por seus pátios com canto de louvor; agradecei a ele, [e] bendizei o seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Entrad por sus puertas con reconocimiento, por sus atrios con alabanza: alabadle, bendecid su nombre.

verses.KJV: For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
verses.WEB: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR é bom, sua bondade [dura] para sempre; e a fidelidade dele [continua] de geração após geração.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová es bueno: para siempre es su misericordia, y su verdad por todas las generaciones.

verses.KJV: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O Lord, will I sing.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David. I will sing of lovingkindness and justice: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I sing praises.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Cantarei sobre a bondade e o juízo; a ti, SENHOR, tocarei melodia.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. MISERICORDIA y juicio cantaré: á ti cantaré yo, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.WEB: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
verses.ASV: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way: Oh when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: No caminho correto eu meditarei; [mas] quando virás a mim? Em sinceridade de meu coração andarei dentro de minha casa.
verses.RVR09: Entenderé en el camino de la perfección cuando vinieres á mí: en integridad de mi corazón andaré en medio de mi casa.

verses.KJV: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.WEB: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
verses.ASV: I will set no base thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; It shall not cleave unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não porei perante meus olhos obra maligna; odeio as ações dos que desviam, [tais coisas] não me tomarão.
verses.RVR09: No pondré delante de mis ojos cosa injusta: aborrezco la obra de los que se desvían: ninguno de ellos se allegará á mí.

verses.KJV: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.WEB: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
verses.ASV: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração perverso se afastará de mim; não conhecerei ao mau.
verses.RVR09: Corazón perverso se apartará de mí; no conoceré al malvado.

verses.KJV: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.WEB: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
verses.ASV: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I destroy: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Destruirei ao que fala mal de seu próximo as escondidas, e não tolerarei ao que tem olhos cobiçosos e coração arrogante.
verses.RVR09: Al que solapadamente infama á su prójimo, yo le cortaré; no sufriré al de ojos altaneros, y de corazón vanidoso.

verses.KJV: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.WEB: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
verses.ASV: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: He that walketh in a perfect way, he shall minister unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos [estarão] sobre os fiéis da terra, para que se sentem comigo; aquele que anda no caminho correto, esse me servirá.
verses.RVR09: Mis ojos pondré en los fieles de la tierra, para que estén conmigo: el que anduviere en el camino de la perfección, éste me servirá.

verses.KJV: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.WEB: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
verses.ASV: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que usa de engano não habitará em minha casa; aquele que fala mentiras não conseguirá ficar firme perante meus olhos.
verses.RVR09: No habitará dentro de mi casa el que hace fraude: el que habla mentiras no se afirmará delante de mis ojos.

verses.KJV: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.
verses.ASV: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; To cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelas madrugadas destruirei a todos os perversos da terra, para tirar da cidade do SENHOR todos os que praticam maldade.
verses.RVR09: Por las mañanas cortaré á todos los impíos de la tierra; para extirpar de la ciudad de Jehová á todos los que obraren iniquidad.

verses.KJV: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.WEB: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.
verses.ASV: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah. Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Oração do aflito, quando ele se viu desfalecido, e derramou sua súplica diante do SENHOR: Ó SENHOR, ouve minha oração; e que meu clamor chegue a ti.
verses.RVR09: Oración del pobre, cuando estuviere angustiado, y delante de Jehová derramare su lamento. JEHOVÁ, oye mi oración, y venga mi clamor á ti.

verses.KJV: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.WEB: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
verses.ASV: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não escondas de mim o teu rosto no dia da minha angústia; inclina a mim teu ouvidos; no dia em que eu clamar, apressa-te para me responder.
verses.RVR09: No escondas de mí tu rostro: en el día de mi angustia inclina á mí tu oído; el día que te invocare, apresúrate á responderme.

verses.KJV: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.WEB: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
verses.ASV: For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os meus dias têm se desfeito como fumaça; e meus ossos se têm se queimado como [n] um forno.
verses.RVR09: Porque mis días se han consumido como humo; y mis huesos cual tizón están quemados.

verses.KJV: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.WEB: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
verses.ASV: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu coração, tal como a erva, está tão ferido e seco, que me esqueci de comer meu pão.
verses.RVR09: Mi corazón fué herido, y secóse como la hierba; por lo cual me olvidé de comer mi pan.

verses.KJV: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.WEB: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
verses.ASV: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da voz do meu gemido, meus ossos têm se grudado à minha carne.
verses.RVR09: Por la voz de mi gemido mis huesos se han pegado á mi carne.

verses.KJV: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.WEB: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
verses.ASV: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estou semelhante a uma ave no deserto, estou como uma coruja num lugar desabitado.
verses.RVR09: Soy semejante al pelícano del desierto; soy como el buho de las soledades.

verses.KJV: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.WEB: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
verses.ASV: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fico alerta e estou como um pardal solitário sobre o telhado.
verses.RVR09: Velo, y soy como el pájaro solitario sobre el tejado.

verses.KJV: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.WEB: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
verses.ASV: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os meus inimigos me insultam o dia todo; os que me odeiam juram [maldições] contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Cada día me afrentan mis enemigos; los que se enfurecen contra mí, hanse contra mí conjurado.

verses.KJV: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.
verses.WEB: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
verses.ASV: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estou comendo cinza como [se fosse] pão, e misturo minha bebida com lágrimas,
verses.RVR09: Por lo que como la ceniza á manera de pan, y mi bebida mezclo con lloro,

verses.KJV: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.WEB: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
verses.ASV: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa de tua irritação e tua ira; porque tu me levantaste e me derrubaste.
verses.RVR09: A causa de tu enojo y de tu ira; pues me alzaste, y me has arrojado.

verses.KJV: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.WEB: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
verses.ASV: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus dias [têm sido] como a sombra, que declina; e eu estou secando como a erva.
verses.RVR09: Mis días son como la sombra que se va; y heme secado como la hierba.

verses.KJV: But thou, O Lord, shall endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.WEB: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
verses.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial [name] unto all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, SENHOR, permaneces para sempre; e tua lembrança [continua] geração após geração.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Jehová, permanecerás para siempre, y tu memoria para generación y generación.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.WEB: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te levantarás, e terás piedade de Sião; porque chegou o tempo determinado para se apiedar dela.
verses.RVR09: Tú levantándote, tendrás misericordia de Sión; porque el tiempo de tener misericordia de ella, porque el plazo es llegado.

verses.KJV: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.WEB: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
verses.ASV: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os teus servos se agradam de suas pedras, e sentem compaixão do pó de suas [ruínas] .
verses.RVR09: Porque tus siervos aman sus piedras, y del polvo de ella tienen compasión.

verses.KJV: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.WEB: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.ASV: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então as nações temerão o nome do SENHOR; e todos os reis da terra [temerão] a tua glória;
verses.RVR09: Entonces temerán las gentes el nombre de Jehová, y todos los reyes de la tierra tu gloria;

verses.KJV: When the Lord shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.WEB: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o SENHOR edificar a Sião, [e] aparecer em sua glória;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto Jehová habrá edificado á Sión, y en su gloria será visto;

verses.KJV: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.WEB: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
verses.ASV: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E der atenção à oração do desamparado, e não desprezar sua oração.
verses.RVR09: Habrá mirado á la oración de los solitarios, y no habrá desechado el ruego de ellos.

verses.KJV: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.
verses.WEB: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,
verses.ASV: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto será escrito para a geração futura; e o povo que for criado louvará ao SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Escribirse ha esto para la generación venidera: y el pueblo que se criará, alabará á JAH.

verses.KJV: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;
verses.WEB: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,
verses.ASV: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele olhará desde o alto de seu santuário; o SENHOR olhará desde os céus para a terra,
verses.RVR09: Porque miró de lo alto de su santuario; Jehová miró de los cielos á la tierra,

verses.KJV: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.WEB: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
verses.ASV: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para ouvir o gemido dos prisioneiros; para soltar aos sentenciados à morte.
verses.RVR09: Para oir el gemido de los presos, para soltar á los sentenciados á muerte;

verses.KJV: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.WEB: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
verses.ASV: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para eles anunciarem o nome do SENHOR em Sião, e seu louvor em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Porque cuenten en Sión el nombre de Jehová, y su alabanza en Jerusalem,

verses.KJV: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
verses.WEB: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.ASV: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os povos se reunirem, e os reinos, para servirem ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Cuando los pueblos se congregaren en uno, y los reinos, para servir á Jehová.

verses.KJV: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.WEB: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
verses.ASV: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele abateu minha força no caminho; abreviou os meus dias.
verses.RVR09: El afligió mi fuerza en el camino; acortó mis días.

verses.KJV: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.WEB: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.ASV: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu dizia: Meu Deus, não me leves no meio dos meus dias; teus anos são [eternos] ,geração após geração.
verses.RVR09: Dije: Dios mío, no me cortes en el medio de mis días: por generación de generaciones son tus años.

verses.KJV: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.WEB: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.ASV: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde muito antes fundaste a terra; e os céus são obra de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Tú fundaste la tierra antiguamente, y los cielos son obra de tus manos.

verses.KJV: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.WEB: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
verses.ASV: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se destruirão, porém tu permanecerás; e todos eles como vestimentas se envelhecerão; como roupas tu os mudarás, e serão mudados.
verses.RVR09: Ellos perecerán, y tú permanecerás; y todos ellos como un vestido se envejecerán; como una ropa de vestir los mudarás, y serán mudados:

verses.KJV: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.WEB: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
verses.ASV: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu és o mesmo; e teus anos nunca se acabarão.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú eres el mismo, y tus años no se acabarán.

verses.KJV: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.WEB: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
verses.ASV: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos de teus servos habitarão [seguros] ,e a semente deles será firmada perante ti.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de tus siervos habitarán, y su simiente será afirmada delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.WEB: By David. Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, [bless] his holy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Louva ao SENHOR, ó minha alma; e que todo o meu interior [louve] ao seu santo nome.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. BENDICE, alma mía, á Jehová; y bendigan todas mis entrañas su santo nombre.

verses.KJV: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
verses.ASV: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
verses.ALMEIDA: Louva ao SENHOR, ó minha alma; e não te esqueças de nenhum dos benefícios dele;
verses.RVR09: Bendice, alma mía á Jehová, y no olvides ninguno de sus beneficios.

verses.KJV: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.WEB: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
verses.ASV: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que perdoa todas as tuas perversidades, e te sara de todas as tuas enfermidades.
verses.RVR09: El es quien perdona todas tus iniquidades, el que sana todas tus dolencias;

verses.KJV: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.WEB: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
verses.ASV: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que resgata tua vida da perdição; que te coroa com bondade e misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: El que rescata del hoyo tu vida, el que te corona de favores y misericordias;

verses.KJV: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
verses.WEB: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.ASV: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things, [So that] thy youth is renewed like the eagle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que farta tua boca de coisas boas, e tua juventude é renovada como a águia.
verses.RVR09: El que sacia de bien tu boca de modo que te rejuvenezcas como el águila.

verses.KJV: The Lord executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.WEB: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
verses.ASV: Jehovah executeth righteous acts, And judgments for all that are oppressed.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR faz justiça e juízos a todos os oprimidos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová el que hace justicia y derecho á todos los que padecen violencia.

verses.KJV: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
verses.WEB: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
verses.ASV: He made known his ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fez Moisés conhecer seus caminhos, e os filhos de Israel [conhecerem] as obras dele.
verses.RVR09: Sus caminos notificó á Moisés, y á los hijos de Israel sus obras.

verses.KJV: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.WEB: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Misericordioso e piedoso é o SENHOR, que demora para se irar, e é grande em bondade.
verses.RVR09: Misericordioso y clemente es Jehová; lento para la ira, y grande en misericordia.

verses.KJV: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.WEB: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
verses.ASV: He will not always chide; Neither will he keep [his anger] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não reclamará perpetuamente, nem manterá [sua ira] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: No contenderá para siempre, ni para siempre guardará el enojo.

verses.KJV: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.WEB: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
verses.ASV: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não nos trata conforme nossos pecados, nem nos retribui conforme nossas perversidades.
verses.RVR09: No ha hecho con nosotros conforme á nuestras iniquidades; ni nos ha pagado conforme á nuestros pecados.

verses.KJV: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.WEB: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
verses.ASV: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, assim como os céus estão bem mais elevados que a terra, assim também prevalece a bondade dele sobre aqueles que o temem.
verses.RVR09: Porque como la altura de los cielos sobre la tierra, engrandeció su misericordia sobre los que le temen.

verses.KJV: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.WEB: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.ASV: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como o oriente está longe do ocidente, assim também ele tira para longe de nós nossas transgressões.
verses.RVR09: Cuanto está lejos el oriente del occidente, hizo alejar de nosotros nuestras rebeliones.

verses.KJV: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the Lord pitieth them that fear him.
verses.WEB: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
verses.ASV: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como um pai se compadece dos filhos, assim também o SENHOR se compadece daqueles que o temem.
verses.RVR09: Como el padre se compadece de los hijos, se compadece Jehová de los que le temen.

verses.KJV: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
verses.WEB: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
verses.ASV: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele sabe como fomos formados; ele se lembra de que somos pó.
verses.RVR09: Porque él conoce nuestra condición; acuérdase que somos polvo.

verses.KJV: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.WEB: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
verses.ASV: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os dias do homem são como a erva, como a flor do campo, assim ele floresce.
verses.RVR09: El hombre, como la hierba son sus días: florece como la flor del campo.

verses.KJV: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.WEB: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
verses.ASV: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas quando o vento passa por ele, logo perece; e seu lugar deixa de ser conhecido.
verses.RVR09: Que pasó el viento por ella, y pereció: y su lugar no la conoce más.

verses.KJV: But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
verses.WEB: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
verses.ASV: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children’s children;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a bondade do SENHOR [continua] de eternidade em eternidade sobre os que o temem; e a justiça dele [está] sobre os filhos de [seus] filhos.
verses.RVR09: Mas la misericordia de Jehová desde el siglo y hasta el siglo sobre los que le temen, y su justicia sobre los hijos de los hijos;

verses.KJV: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.WEB: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
verses.ASV: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre os que guardam o seu pacto dele, e sobre os que se lembram de dos mandamentos dele, para os praticarem.
verses.RVR09: Sobre los que guardan su pacto, y los que se acuerdan de sus mandamientos para ponerlos por obra.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.WEB: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR firmou o seu trono nos céus, e seu reino domina sobre tudo.
verses.RVR09: Jehová afirmó en los cielos su trono; y su reino domina sobre todos.

verses.KJV: Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
verses.ASV: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendizei ao SENHOR, ó anjos dele; vós, fortes valentes, que guardais sua palavra, ao ouvirem a voz de sua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Bendecid á Jehová, vosotros sus ángeles, poderosos en fortaleza, que ejecutáis su palabra, obedeciendo á la voz de su precepto.

verses.KJV: Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
verses.ASV: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendizei ao SENHOR todos os seus exércitos; vós que servis a ele, que fazeis o que lhe agrada.
verses.RVR09: Bendecid á Jehová, vosotros todos sus ejércitos, ministros suyos, que hacéis su voluntad.

verses.KJV: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!
verses.ASV: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendizei ao SENHOR todas as suas obras, em todos os lugares de seu domínio; louva, minha alma, ao SENHOR!
verses.RVR09: Bendecid á Jehová, vosotras todas sus obras, en todos los lugares de su señorío. Bendice, alma mía, á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.WEB: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
verses.ASV: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:
verses.ALMEIDA: Louva, minha alma, ao SENHOR; ó SENHOR meu Deus, tu és grandioso; de majestade e de glória estás vestido.
verses.RVR09: BENDICE, alma mía, á Jehová. Jehová, Dios mío, mucho te has engrandecido; haste vestido de gloria y de magnificencia.

verses.KJV: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.WEB: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
verses.ASV: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu estás coberto de luz, como que uma roupa; estendes os céus como cortinas.
verses.RVR09: El que se cubre de luz como de vestidura, que extiende los cielos como una cortina;

verses.KJV: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.WEB: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
verses.ASV: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele, que fixou seus cômodos sobre as águas; que faz das nuvens sua carruagem; que se move sobre as asas do vento.
verses.RVR09: Que establece sus aposentos entre las aguas; el que pone las nubes por su carroza, el que anda sobre las alas del viento;

verses.KJV: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.WEB: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
verses.ASV: Who maketh winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que faz de seus anjos ventos, e de seus servos fogo flamejante.
verses.RVR09: El que hace á sus ángeles espíritus, sus ministros al fuego flameante.

verses.KJV: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
verses.WEB: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
verses.ASV: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fundou a terra sobre suas bases; ela jamais se abalará.
verses.RVR09: El fundó la tierra sobre sus basas; no será jamás removida.

verses.KJV: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.WEB: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
verses.ASV: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o abismo, como um vestido, tu a cobriste; sobre os montes estavam as águas.
verses.RVR09: Con el abismo, como con vestido, la cubriste; sobre los montes estaban las aguas.

verses.KJV: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.WEB: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
verses.ASV: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away
verses.ALMEIDA: Elas fugiram de tua repreensão; pela voz de teu trovão elas se recolheram apressadamente.
verses.RVR09: A tu reprensión huyeron; al sonido de tu trueno se apresuraron;

verses.KJV: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.WEB: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
verses.ASV: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes subiram [e] os vales desceram ao lugar que tu lhes tinha fundado.
verses.RVR09: Subieron los montes, descendieron los valles, al lugar que tú les fundaste.

verses.KJV: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.WEB: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
verses.ASV: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu [lhes] puseste um limite, que não ultrapassarão; não voltarão mais a cobrir a terra.
verses.RVR09: Pusísteles término, el cual no traspasarán; ni volverán á cubrir la tierra.

verses.KJV: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
verses.WEB: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
verses.ASV: He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele envia fontes aos vales, para que corram por entre os montes.
verses.RVR09: Tú eres el que envías las fuentes por los arroyos; van entre los montes.

verses.KJV: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.WEB: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.ASV: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elas dão de beber a todos os animais do campo; os asnos selvagens matam a sede [com elas] .
verses.RVR09: Abrevan á todas las bestias del campo: quebrantan su sed los asnos montaraces.

verses.KJV: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
verses.WEB: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
verses.ASV: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They sing among the branches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto a elas habitam as aves dos céus, que dão [sua] voz dentre os ramos.
verses.RVR09: Junto á aquellos habitarán las aves de los cielos; entre las ramas dan voces.

verses.KJV: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.WEB: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
verses.ASV: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele rega os montes desde seus cômodos; a terra se farta do fruto de tuas obras.
verses.RVR09: El que riega los montes desde sus aposentos: del fruto de sus obras se sacia la tierra.

verses.KJV: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.WEB: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
verses.ASV: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; That he may bring forth food out of the earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele faz brotar a erva para os animais, e as plantas para o trabalho do homem, fazendo da terra produzir o pão,
verses.RVR09: El que hace producir el heno para las bestias, y la hierba para el servicio del hombre; sacando el pan de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
verses.WEB: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
verses.ASV: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, [And] oil to make his face to shine, And bread that strengtheneth man’s heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o vinho, que alegra o coração do homem, [e] faz o rosto brilhar o rosto com o azeite; com o pão, que fortalece o coração do homem.
verses.RVR09: Y el vino que alegra el corazón del hombre, y el aceite que hace lucir el rostro, y el pan que sustenta el corazón del hombre.

verses.KJV: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.WEB: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
verses.ASV: The trees of Jehovah are filled [with moisture], The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.ALMEIDA: As árvores do SENHOR são fartamente [nutridas] ,os cedros do Líbano, que ele plantou.
verses.RVR09: Llénanse de jugo los árboles de Jehová, los cedros del Líbano que él plantó.

verses.KJV: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
verses.WEB: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
verses.ASV: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde as aves fazem ninhos, e os pinheiros são as casas para as cegonhas.
verses.RVR09: Allí anidan las aves; en las hayas hace su casa la cigüeña.

verses.KJV: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
verses.WEB: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.ASV: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os altos montes são para as cabras selvagens; as rochas, refúgio para os coelhos.
verses.RVR09: Los montes altos para las cabras monteses; las peñas, madrigueras para los conejos.

verses.KJV: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.WEB: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
verses.ASV: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fez a lua para [marcar] os tempos, e o sol sobre seu poente.
verses.RVR09: Hizo la luna para los tiempos: el sol conoce su ocaso.

verses.KJV: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.WEB: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
verses.ASV: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele dá ordens à escuridão, e faz haver noite, quando saem todos os animais do mato.
verses.RVR09: Pone las tinieblas, y es la noche: en ella corretean todas las bestias de la selva.

verses.KJV: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
verses.WEB: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
verses.ASV: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos dos leões, rugindo pela presa, e para buscar de Deus sua comida.
verses.RVR09: Los leoncillos braman á la presa, y para buscar de Dios su comida.

verses.KJV: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.WEB: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
verses.ASV: The sun ariseth, they get them away, And lay them down in their dens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o sol volta a brilhar, [logo] se recolhem, e vão se deitar em suas tocas.
verses.RVR09: Sale el sol, recógense, y échanse en sus cuevas.

verses.KJV: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.WEB: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
verses.ASV: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labor until the evening.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o homem sai para seu trabalho e sua obra até o entardecer.
verses.RVR09: Sale el hombre á su hacienda, y á su labranza hasta la tarde.

verses.KJV: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.WEB: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como são muitas as suas obras, SENHOR! Tu fizeste todas com sabedoria; a terra está cheia de teus bens.
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuán muchas son tus obras, oh Jehová! Hiciste todas ellas con sabiduría: la tierra está llena de tus beneficios.

verses.KJV: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.WEB: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
verses.ASV: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este grande e vasto mar, nele há inúmeros seres, animais pequenos e grandes.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo esta gran mar y ancha de términos: en ella pescados sin número, animales pequeños y grandes.

verses.KJV: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
verses.WEB: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
verses.ASV: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom thou hast formed to play therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por ali andam os navios e o Leviatã que formastes, para que te alegrasses nele.
verses.RVR09: Allí andan navíos; allí este leviathán que hiciste para que jugase en ella.

verses.KJV: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
verses.WEB: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
verses.ASV: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos eles aguardam por ti, que [lhes] dês seu alimento a seu tempo [devido] .
verses.RVR09: Todos ellos esperan en ti, para que les des su comida á su tiempo.

verses.KJV: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.WEB: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
verses.ASV: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que tu dás, eles recolhem; tu abres tua mão, [e] eles se fartam de coisas boas.
verses.RVR09: Les das, recogen; abres tu mano, hártanse de bien.

verses.KJV: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.WEB: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
verses.ASV: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Quando] tu escondes teu rosto, eles ficam perturbados; [quando] tu tiras o fôlego deles, [logo] eles morrem, e voltam ao seu pó.
verses.RVR09: Escondes tu rostro, túrbanse: les quitas el espíritu, dejan de ser, y tórnanse en su polvo.

verses.KJV: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
verses.ASV: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu envias o teu fôlego, e logo são criados; e [assim] tu renovas a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Envías tu espíritu, críanse: y renuevas la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: The glory of the Lord shall endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works.
verses.WEB: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.
verses.ASV: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:
verses.ALMEIDA: A glória do SENHOR será para sempre; alegre-se o SENHOR em suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Sea la gloria de Jehová para siempre; alégrese Jehová en sus obras;

verses.KJV: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.WEB: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.ASV: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Quando] ele olha para a terra, [logo] ela treme; [quando] ele toca nos montes, eles soltam fumaça.
verses.RVR09: El cual mira á la tierra, y ella tiembla; toca los montes, y humean.

verses.KJV: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.WEB: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
verses.ASV: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantarei ao SENHOR em [toda] a minha vida; tocarei música ao meu Deus enquanto eu existir.
verses.RVR09: A Jehová cantaré en mi vida: á mi Dios salmearé mientras viviere.

verses.KJV: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.
verses.WEB: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.
verses.ASV: Let my meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus pensamentos lhe serão agradáveis; eu me alegrarei no SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Serme ha suave hablar de él: yo me alegraré en Jehová.

verses.KJV: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os pecadores serão consumidos da terra, e os maus não existirão mais. Bendizei, ó minha alma, ao SENHOR! Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Sean consumidos de la tierra los pecadores, y los impíos dejen de ser. Bendice, alma mía, á Jehová. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.WEB: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
verses.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei ao SENHOR, chamai o seu nome; anunciai suas obras entre os povos.
verses.RVR09: ALABAD á Jehová, invocad su nombre: haced notorias sus obras en los pueblos.

verses.KJV: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.WEB: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
verses.ASV: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvellous works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai a ele, tocai músicas para ele; falai de todas as suas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Cantadle, cantadle salmos: hablad de todas sus maravillas.

verses.KJV: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
verses.WEB: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
verses.ASV: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tende orgulho de seu santo nome; alegre-se o coração dos que buscam ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Gloriaos en su santo nombre: alégrese el corazón de los que buscan á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.WEB: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
verses.ASV: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Buscai ao SENHOR e à sua força; buscai a presença dele continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Buscad á Jehová, y su fortaleza: buscad siempre su rostro.

verses.KJV: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.WEB: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.ASV: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos de suas maravilhas, que ele fez; de seus milagres, e dos juízos de sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Acordaos de sus maravillas que hizo, de sus prodigios y de los juicios de su boca,

verses.KJV: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.WEB: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.ASV: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, [que sois da] semente de seu servo Abraão; vós, filhos de Jacó, seus escolhidos.
verses.RVR09: Oh vosotros, simiente de Abraham su siervo, hijos de Jacob, sus escogidos.

verses.KJV: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.WEB: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.ASV: He is Jehovah our God: His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o SENHOR, nosso Deus; seus juízos [estão] em toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: El es Jehová nuestro Dios; en toda la tierra son sus juicios.

verses.KJV: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.WEB: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.ASV: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se lembra para sempre de seu pacto, da palavra que ele mandou até mil gerações;
verses.RVR09: Acordóse para siempre de su alianza; de la palabra que mandó para mil generaciones,

verses.KJV: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
verses.WEB: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
verses.ASV: [The covenant] which he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual ele firmou com Abraão, e de seu juramento a Isaque.
verses.RVR09: La cual concertó con Abraham; y de su juramento á Isaac.

verses.KJV: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
verses.WEB: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.ASV: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.ALMEIDA: O qual também confirmou a Jacó como estatuto, a Israel como pacto eterno.
verses.RVR09: Y establecióla á Jacob por decreto, á Israel por pacto sempiterno,

verses.KJV: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.WEB: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
verses.ASV: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizendo: A ti darei a terra de Canaã, a porção de vossa herança.
verses.RVR09: Diciendo: A ti daré la tierra de Canaán por cordel de vuestra heredad.

verses.KJV: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.WEB: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
verses.ASV: When they were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sendo eles poucos em número; [eram] poucos, e estrangeiros nela.
verses.RVR09: Esto siendo ellos pocos hombres en número, y extranjeros en ella.

verses.KJV: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.WEB: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
verses.ASV: And they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E andaram de nação em nação, de um reino a outro povo.
verses.RVR09: Y anduvieron de gente en gente, de un reino á otro pueblo.

verses.KJV: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.WEB: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.ASV: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não permitiu a ninguém que os oprimisse; e por causa deles repreendeu a reis,
verses.RVR09: No consintió que hombre los agraviase; y por causa de ellos castigó los reyes.

verses.KJV: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.WEB: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
verses.ASV: [Saying], Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dizendo] : Não toqueis nos meus ungidos, e não façais mal a meus profetas.
verses.RVR09: No toquéis, dijo, á mis ungidos, ni hagáis mal á mis profetas.

verses.KJV: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.WEB: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
verses.ASV: And he called for a famine upon the land; He brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: E chamou a fome sobre a terra; ele interrompeu toda fonte de alimento;
verses.RVR09: Y llamó al hambre sobre la tierra, y quebrantó todo mantenimiento de pan.

verses.KJV: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
verses.WEB: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
verses.ASV: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviou um homem adiante deles: José, [que] foi vendido como escravo.
verses.RVR09: Envió un varón delante de ellos, á José, que fué vendido por siervo.

verses.KJV: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.WEB: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
verses.ASV: His feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid in [chains of] iron,
verses.ALMEIDA: Amarraram seus pés em correntes; ele foi preso com ferros;
verses.RVR09: Afligieron sus pies con grillos; en hierro fué puesta su persona.

verses.KJV: Until the time that his word came: the word of the Lord tried him.
verses.WEB: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.
verses.ASV: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até o tempo que sua mensagem chegou, a palavra do SENHOR provou o valor que ele tinha.
verses.RVR09: Hasta la hora que llegó su palabra, el dicho de Jehová le probó.

verses.KJV: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.WEB: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
verses.ASV: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei mandou que ele fosse solto; o governante de povos o libertou.
verses.RVR09: Envió el rey, y soltóle; el señor de los pueblos, y desatóle.

verses.KJV: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.WEB: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
verses.ASV: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele o pôs como senhor de sua casa, e por chefe de todos os seus bens,
verses.RVR09: Púsolo por señor de su casa, y por enseñoreador en toda su posesión;

verses.KJV: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.WEB: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
verses.ASV: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para dar ordens a suas autoridades, e instruir a seus anciãos.
