verses.RVR09: Para que reprimiera á sus grandes como él quisiese, y á sus ancianos enseñara sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.WEB: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
verses.ASV: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Israel entrou no Egito; Jacó peregrinou na terra de Cam.
verses.RVR09: Después entró Israel en Egipto, y Jacob fué extranjero en la tierra de Châm.

verses.KJV: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.WEB: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
verses.ASV: And he increased his people greatly, And made them stronger than their adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez seu povo crescer muito, e o fez mais poderoso que seus adversários.
verses.RVR09: Y multiplicó su pueblo en gran manera, é hízolo fuerte más que sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.WEB: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
verses.ASV: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtly with his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mudou o coração [dos outros] ,para que odiassem ao seu povo, para que tratassem mal a seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Volvió el corazón de ellos para que aborreciesen á su pueblo, para que contra sus siervos pensasen mal.

verses.KJV: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.WEB: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
verses.ASV: He sent Moses his servant, [And] Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] enviou seu servo Moisés, e a Arão, a quem tinha escolhido;
verses.RVR09: Envió á su siervo Moisés, y á Aarón al cual escogió.

verses.KJV: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.WEB: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.ASV: They set among them his signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Que] fizeram entre eles os sinais anunciados, e coisas sobrenaturais na terra de Cam.
verses.RVR09: Pusieron en ellos las palabras de sus señales, y sus prodigios en la tierra de Châm.

verses.KJV: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.WEB: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
verses.ASV: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele mandou trevas, e fez escurecer; e não foram rebeldes a sua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Echó tinieblas, é hizo oscuridad; y no fueron rebeldes á su palabra.

verses.KJV: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.WEB: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
verses.ASV: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele transformou suas águas em sangue, e matou a seus peixes.
verses.RVR09: Volvió sus aguas en sangre, y mató sus pescados.

verses.KJV: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.WEB: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
verses.ASV: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra deles produziu rãs em abundância, [até] nos quartos de seus reis.
verses.RVR09: Produjo su tierra ranas, aun en las cámaras de sus reyes.

verses.KJV: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
verses.WEB: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
verses.ASV: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele falou, e vieram vários bichos [e] piolhos em todos os seus limites.
verses.RVR09: Dijo, y vinieron enjambres de moscas, y piojos en todo su término.

verses.KJV: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.WEB: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
verses.ASV: He gave them hail for rain, [And] flaming fire in their land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornou suas chuvas em saraiva; [pôs] fogo ardente em sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Volvió en su tierra sus lluvias en granizo, y en fuego de llamaradas.

verses.KJV: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.WEB: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
verses.ASV: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.
verses.ALMEIDA: E feriu suas vinhas e seus figueirais; e quebrou as árvores de seus territórios.
verses.RVR09: E hirió sus viñas y sus higueras, y quebró los árboles de su término.

verses.KJV: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.WEB: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
verses.ASV: He spake, and the locust came, And the grasshopper, and that without number,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele falou, e vieram gafanhotos, e incontáveis pulgões;
verses.RVR09: Dijo, y vinieron langostas, y pulgón sin número;

verses.KJV: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.WEB: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
verses.ASV: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comeram toda a erva de sua terra; e devoraram o fruto de seus campos.
verses.RVR09: Y comieron toda la hierba de su país, y devoraron el fruto de su tierra.

verses.KJV: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.WEB: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
verses.ASV: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The chief of all their strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também feriu a todos os primogênitos em sua terra; os primeiros de todas as suas forças.
verses.RVR09: Hirió además á todos los primogénitos en su tierra, el principio de toda su fuerza.

verses.KJV: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.WEB: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
verses.ASV: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was not one feeble person among his tribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os tirou [dali] com prata e ouro; e dentre suas tribos não houve quem tropeçasse.
verses.RVR09: Y sacólos con plata y oro; y no hubo en sus tribus enfermo.

verses.KJV: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.WEB: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
verses.ASV: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Até] o Egito se alegrou com a saída deles, porque seu temor tinha caído sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Egipto se alegró de que salieran; porque su terror había caído sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.WEB: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
verses.ASV: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele estendeu uma nuvem como cobertor, e um fogo para iluminar a noite.
verses.RVR09: Extendió una nube por cubierta, y fuego para alumbrar la noche.

verses.KJV: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.WEB: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
verses.ASV: They asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles pediram, e fez vir codornizes; e os fartou com pão do céu.
verses.RVR09: Pidieron, é hizo venir codornices; y saciólos de pan del cielo.

verses.KJV: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.WEB: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
verses.ASV: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places [like] a river.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele abriu uma rocha, e dela saíram águas; [e] correram [como] um rio pelos lugares secos;
verses.RVR09: Abrió la peña, y fluyeron aguas; corrieron por los secadales como un río.

verses.KJV: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
verses.WEB: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
verses.ASV: For he remembered his holy word, [And] Abraham his servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se lembrou de sua santa palavra, e de seu servo Abraão.
verses.RVR09: Porque se acordó de su santa palabra, dada á Abraham su siervo.

verses.KJV: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
verses.WEB: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
verses.ASV: And he brought forth his people with joy, [And] his chosen with singing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele tirou [dali] a seu povo com alegria; e seus eleitos com celebração.
verses.RVR09: Y sacó á su pueblo con gozo; con júbilo á sus escogidos.

verses.KJV: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.WEB: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
verses.ASV: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes deu as terras das nações; e do trabalho das nações tomaram posse;
verses.RVR09: Y dióles las tierras de las gentes; y las labores de las naciones heredaron:

verses.KJV: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: That they might keep his statutes, And observe his laws. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que guardassem seus estatutos, e obedecessem a leis dele. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Para que guardasen sus estatutos, y observasen sus leyes. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: ALELUYA. Alabad á Jehová, porque es bueno; porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can shew forth all his praise?
verses.WEB: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?
verses.ASV: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem falará das proezas do SENHOR? [Quem] dirá louvores a ele?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién expresará las valentías de Jehová? ¿quién contará sus alabanzas?

verses.KJV: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.WEB: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
verses.ASV: Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurados [são] os que guardam o juízo; [e] aquele que pratica justiça em todo tempo.
verses.RVR09: Dichosos los que guardan juicio, los que hacen justicia en todo tiempo.

verses.KJV: Remember me, O Lord, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
verses.WEB: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
verses.ASV: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te de mim, SENHOR, conforme [tua] boa vontade [para com] teu povo; concede-me tua salvação.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de mí, oh Jehová, según tu benevolencia para con tu pueblo: visítame con tu salud;

verses.KJV: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.WEB: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
verses.ASV: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para eu ver o bem de teus escolhidos; para eu me alegrar com a alegria de teu povo; para eu ter orgulho de tua herança.
verses.RVR09: Para que yo vea el bien de tus escogidos, para que me goce en la alegría de tu gente, y me gloríe con tu heredad.

verses.KJV: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.WEB: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
verses.ASV: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pecamos com nossos pais, fizemos o mal, agimos perversamente.
verses.RVR09: Pecamos con nuestros padres, hicimos iniquidad, hicimos impiedad.

verses.KJV: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
verses.WEB: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
verses.ASV: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos pais no Egito não deram atenção a tuas maravilhas, nem se lembraram da abundância de tuas bondades; mas ao invés disso se rebelaram junto ao mar, perto do mar Vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Nuestros padres en Egipto no entendieron tus maravillas; no se acordaron de la muchedumbre de tus misericordias; sino que se rebelaron junto á la mar, en el mar Bermejo.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apesar disso ele os livrou por causa de seu nome, para que seu poder fosse conhecido.
verses.RVR09: Salvólos empero por amor de su nombre, para hacer notoria su fortaleza.

verses.KJV: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.WEB: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
verses.ASV: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E repreendeu ao mar Vermelho, e [este] se secou; e os fez caminharem pelas profundezas [do mar] ,como que pelo deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y reprendió al mar Bermejo, y secólo; é hízoles ir por el abismo, como por un desierto.

verses.KJV: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.WEB: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.ASV: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os livrou das mãos daquele que os odiava, e os resgatou das mãos do inimigo.
verses.RVR09: Y salvólos de mano del enemigo, y rescatólos de mano del adversario.

verses.KJV: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.WEB: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
verses.ASV: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as águas cobriram seus adversários; não sobrou nem um sequer deles.
verses.RVR09: Y cubrieron las aguas á sus enemigos: no quedó uno de ellos.

verses.KJV: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
verses.WEB: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
verses.ASV: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então creram nas palavras dele, e cantaram louvores a ele.
verses.RVR09: Entonces creyeron á sus palabras, y cantaron su alabanza.

verses.KJV: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
verses.WEB: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
verses.ASV: They soon forgat his works; They waited not for his counsel,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém] logo se esqueceram das obras dele, e não esperaram pelo seu conselho.
verses.RVR09: Apresuráronse, olvidáronse de sus obras; no esperaron en su consejo.

verses.KJV: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
verses.WEB: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
verses.ASV: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas foram levados pelo mau desejo no deserto, e tentaram a Deus no lugar desabitado.
verses.RVR09: Y desearon con ansia en el desierto; y tentaron á Dios en la soledad.

verses.KJV: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.WEB: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.ASV: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele lhes concedeu o que pediam, porém enviou magreza a suas almas.
verses.RVR09: Y él les dió lo que pidieron; mas envió flaqueza en sus almas.

verses.KJV: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord.
verses.WEB: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.
verses.ASV: They envied Moses also in the camp, [And] Aaron the saint of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tiveram inveja de Moisés no acampamento; [e] de Arão, o santo do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Tomaron después celo contra Moisés en el campo, y contra Aarón el santo de Jehová.

verses.KJV: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.WEB: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.ASV: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra se abriu, e engoliu a Datã; e encobriu ao grupo de Abirão.
verses.RVR09: Abrióse la tierra, y tragó á Dathán, y cubrió la compañía de Abiram.

verses.KJV: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.WEB: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
verses.ASV: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o fogo consumiu o seu grupo; a chama queimou os perversos.
verses.RVR09: Y encendióse el fuego en su junta; la llama quemó los impíos.

verses.KJV: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
verses.WEB: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
verses.ASV: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram um bezerro em Horebe; e se inclinaram perante uma imagem de fundição.
verses.RVR09: Hicieron becerro en Horeb, y encorváronse á un vaciadizo.

verses.KJV: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.WEB: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
verses.ASV: Thus they changed their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mudaram sua glória na figura de um boi, que come erva.
verses.RVR09: Así trocaron su gloria por la imagen de un buey que come hierba.

verses.KJV: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
verses.WEB: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.ASV: They forgat God their Saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: Esqueceram-se de Deus, o salvador deles, que tinha feito coisas grandiosas no Egito,
verses.RVR09: Olvidaron al Dios de su salud, que había hecho grandezas en Egipto;

verses.KJV: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
verses.WEB: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
verses.ASV: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, [And] terrible things by the Red Sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maravilhas na terra de Cam, coisas temíveis no mar Vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Maravillas en la tierra de Châm, cosas formidables sobre el mar Bermejo.

verses.KJV: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.WEB: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
verses.ASV: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy [them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso ele disse que teria os destruído, se Moisés, seu escolhido, não tivesse se posto na fenda diante dele, para desviar sua ira, para não os destruir.
verses.RVR09: Y trató de destruirlos, á no haberse puesto Moisés su escogido al portillo delante de él, á fin de apartar su ira, para que no los destruyese.

verses.KJV: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.WEB: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
verses.ASV: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, They believed not his word,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles também desprezaram a terra desejável, [e] não creram na palavra dele.
verses.RVR09: Empero aborrecieron la tierra deseable: no creyeron á su palabra;

verses.KJV: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.
verses.WEB: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.
verses.ASV: But murmured in their tents, And hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ao invés disso murmuraram em suas tendas, [e] não deram ouvidos à voz do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Antes murmuraron en sus tiendas, y no oyeron la voz de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.WEB: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
verses.ASV: Therefore he sware unto them, That he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso ele levantou sua mão contra eles, [jurando] que os derrubaria no deserto;
verses.RVR09: Por lo que alzó su mano á ellos, en orden á postrarlos en el desierto,

verses.KJV: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.WEB: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
verses.ASV: And that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que derrubaria sua semente entre as nações; e os dispersaria pelas terras.
verses.RVR09: Y humillar su simiente entre las gentes, y esparcirlos por las tierras.

verses.KJV: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.WEB: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.ASV: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles também passaram a adorar Baal-Peor, e a comer sacrifícios dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: Allegáronse asimismo á Baal-peor, y comieron los sacrificios de los muertos.

verses.KJV: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
verses.WEB: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
verses.ASV: Thus they provoked him to anger with their doings; And the plague brake in upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o provocaram à ira com as obras deles; e [por isso] surgiu a praga entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y ensañaron á Dios con sus obras, y desarrollóse la mortandad en ellos.

verses.KJV: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
verses.WEB: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
verses.ASV: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment; And so the plague was stayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se levantou Fineias, e interveio, e cessou aquela praga.
verses.RVR09: Entonces se levantó Phinees, é hizo juicio; y se detuvo la plaga.

verses.KJV: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
verses.WEB: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
verses.ASV: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto lhe foi reconhecido como justiça, de geração em geração, para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y fuéle contado á justicia de generación en generación para siempre.

verses.KJV: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
verses.WEB: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
verses.ASV: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também o irritaram muito junto às águas de Meribá; e houve mal a Moisés por causa deles;
verses.RVR09: También le irritaron en las aguas de Meriba: é hizo mal á Moisés por causa de ellos;

verses.KJV: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.WEB: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.ASV: Because they were rebellious against his spirit, And he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque provocaram o seu espírito, de modo que ele falou imprudentemente com seus lábios.
verses.RVR09: Porque hicieron se rebelase su espíritu, como lo expresó con sus labios.

verses.KJV: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:
verses.WEB: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,
verses.ASV: They did not destroy the peoples, As Jehovah commanded them,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles não destruíram os povos que o SENHOR tinha lhes mandado;
verses.RVR09: No destruyeron los pueblos que Jehová les dijo;

verses.KJV: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
verses.WEB: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
verses.ASV: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao invés disso, se misturaram com as nações, e aprenderam as obras delas;
verses.RVR09: Antes se mezclaron con las gentes, y aprendieron sus obras,

verses.KJV: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
verses.WEB: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
verses.ASV: And served their idols, Which became a snare unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serviram a seus ídolos; e vieram a lhes ser por laço de armadilha.
verses.RVR09: Y sirvieron á sus ídolos; los cuales les fueron por ruina.

verses.KJV: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
verses.WEB: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
verses.ASV: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, sacrificaram seus filhos e suas filhas a demônios,
verses.RVR09: Y sacrificaron sus hijos y sus hijas á los demonios;

verses.KJV: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.WEB: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
verses.ASV: And shed innocent blood, Even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: E derramaram sangue inocente, o sangue de seus filhos e de suas filhas, os quais eles sacrificaram aos ídolos de Canaã; e a terra foi profanada com [este] sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y derramaron la sangre inocente, la sangre de sus hijos y de sus hijas, que sacrificaron á los ídolos de Canaán: y la tierra fué contaminada con sangre.

verses.KJV: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.WEB: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
verses.ASV: Thus were they defiled with their works, And played the harlot in their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E contaminaram-se com suas obras; e se prostituíram com suas ações.
verses.RVR09: Contamináronse así con sus obras, y fornicaron con sus hechos.

verses.KJV: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
verses.ASV: Therefore was the wrath of Jehovah kindled against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra seu povo; e ele odiou sua propriedade.
verses.RVR09: Encendióse por tanto el furor de Jehová sobre su pueblo, y abominó su heredad:

verses.KJV: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.WEB: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.ASV: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os entregou nas mãos das nações estrangeiras, e aqueles que os odiavam passaram a dominá-los.
verses.RVR09: Y entrególos en poder de las gentes, y enseñoreáronse de ellos los que los aborrecían.

verses.KJV: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.WEB: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.ASV: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus inimigos os oprimiram, e foram humilhados sob as mãos deles.
verses.RVR09: Y sus enemigos los oprimieron, y fueron quebrantados debajo de su mano.

verses.KJV: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.WEB: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
verses.ASV: Many times did he deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And were brought low in their iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitas vezes ele os livrou; mas eles [voltavam a] irritá-lo com seus pensamentos, e foram abatidos pela sua perversidade.
verses.RVR09: Muchas veces los libró; mas ellos se rebelaron á su consejo, y fueron humillados por su maldad.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.WEB: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, When he heard their cry:
verses.ALMEIDA: Apesar disso, ele observou a angústia deles, e ouviu quando eles clamaram.
verses.RVR09: El con todo, miraba cuando estaban en angustia, y oía su clamor:

verses.KJV: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.WEB: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
verses.ASV: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele se lembrou de seu pacto em [favor] deles, e sentiu pena conforme suas muitas bondades.
verses.RVR09: Y acordábase de su pacto con ellos, y arrepentíase conforme á la muchedumbre de sus miseraciones.

verses.KJV: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
verses.WEB: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
verses.ASV: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez com que todos os que os mantinham em cativeiro tivessem misericórdia deles.
verses.RVR09: Hizo asimismo tuviesen de ellos misericordia todos los que los tenían cautivos.

verses.KJV: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
verses.WEB: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
verses.ASV: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salva-nos, SENHOR nosso Deus, e ajunta-nos dentre as nações, para darmos graças ao teu santo nome, e termos orgulho em louvar a ti.
verses.RVR09: Sálvanos, Jehová Dios nuestro, y júntanos de entre las gentes, para que loemos tu santo nombre, para que nos gloriemos en tus alabanzas.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito [seja] o SENHOR, Deus de Israel, desde sempre e para sempre! E todo o povo diga Amém! Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Bendito Jehová Dios de Israel, desde el siglo y hasta el siglo: y diga todo el pueblo, Amén. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: ALABAD á Jehová, porque es bueno; porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.WEB: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
verses.ASV: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say [so], Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
verses.ALMEIDA: Digam [isso] os resgatados pelo SENHOR, os quais ele resgatou das mão do adversário.
verses.RVR09: Díganlo los redimidos de Jehová, los que ha redimido del poder del enemigo,

verses.KJV: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.WEB: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
verses.ASV: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que ele ajuntou de todas as terras, do oriente e do ocidente, do norte e do sul.
verses.RVR09: Y los ha congregado de las tierras, del oriente y del occidente, del aquilón y de la mar.

verses.KJV: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.WEB: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
verses.ASV: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que andaram sem rumo no deserto, por caminhos solitários; os que não acharam cidade para morarem.
verses.RVR09: Anduvieron perdidos por el desierto, por la soledad sin camino, no hallando ciudad de población.

verses.KJV: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.WEB: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.ASV: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Famintos e sedentos, suas almas neles desfaleciam.
verses.RVR09: Hambrientos y sedientos, su alma desfallecía en ellos.

verses.KJV: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.WEB: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.ASV: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.
verses.RVR09: Habiendo empero clamado á Jehová en su angustia, librólos de sus aflicciones:

verses.KJV: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.WEB: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
verses.ASV: He led them also by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os levou ao caminho correto, para irem a uma cidade de moradia.
verses.RVR09: Y dirigiólos por camino derecho, para que viniesen á ciudad de población.

verses.KJV: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.WEB: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.ASV: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Alaben la misericordia de Jehová, y sus maravillas para con los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.WEB: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
verses.ASV: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele fartou a alma sedenta, e encheu de bem a alma faminta;
verses.RVR09: Porque sació al alma menesterosa, y llenó de bien al alma hambrienta.

verses.KJV: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
verses.WEB: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
verses.ASV: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que estavam sentados em trevas e sombra de morte, presos com aflição e ferro,
verses.RVR09: Los que moraban en tinieblas y sombra de muerte, aprisionados en aflicción y en hierros;

verses.KJV: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.WEB: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.ASV: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se rebelaram contra os mandamentos de Deus, e rejeitaram o conselho do Altíssimo.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto fueron rebeldes á las palabras de Jehová, y aborrecieron el consejo del Altísimo,

verses.KJV: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.WEB: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
verses.ASV: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso ele abateu seus corações com trabalhos cansativos; eles tropeçaram, e não houve quem os socorresse.
verses.RVR09: Por lo que quebrantó él con trabajo sus corazones, cayeron y no hubo quien les ayudase;

verses.KJV: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.WEB: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.ASV: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.
verses.RVR09: Luego que clamaron á Jehová en su angustia, librólos de sus aflicciones.

verses.KJV: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.WEB: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
verses.ASV: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bonds in sunder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele os tirou das trevas e da sombra da morte, e quebrou suas correntes de prisão.
verses.RVR09: Sacólos de las tinieblas y de la sombra de muerte, y rompió sus prisiones.

verses.KJV: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.WEB: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.ASV: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradeçam ao SENHOR pela sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Alaben la misericordia de Jehová, y sus maravillas para con los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.WEB: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
verses.ASV: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele quebrou as portas de bronze, e despedaçou os ferrolhos de ferro.
verses.RVR09: Porque quebrantó las puertas de bronce, y desmenuzó los cerrojos de hierro.

verses.KJV: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.WEB: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
verses.ASV: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os tolos foram afligidos por causa de seu caminho de transgressões e por suas perversidades.
verses.RVR09: Los insensatos, á causa del camino de su rebelión y á causa de sus maldades, fueron afligidos.

verses.KJV: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.WEB: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
verses.ASV: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: A alma deles perdeu o interesse por todo tipo de comida, e chegaram até às portas da morte.
verses.RVR09: Su alma abominó toda vianda, y llegaron hasta las puertas de la muerte.

verses.KJV: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.WEB: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
verses.ASV: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.
verses.RVR09: Mas clamaron á Jehová en su angustia, y salvólos de sus aflicciones.

verses.KJV: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
verses.WEB: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
verses.ASV: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth [them] from their destructions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele enviou sua palavra, e os sarou; e ele os livrou de suas covas.
verses.RVR09: Envió su palabra, y curólos, y librólos de su ruina.

verses.KJV: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.WEB: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.ASV: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Alaben la misericordia de Jehová, y sus maravillas para con los hijos de los hombres:

verses.KJV: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.WEB: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
verses.ASV: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with singing.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sacrifiquem sacrifícios de gratidão; e anunciai as obras dele com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Y sacrifiquen sacrificios de alabanza, y publiquen sus obras con júbilo.

verses.KJV: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.WEB: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
verses.ASV: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que descem ao mar em navios, trabalhando em muitas águas,
verses.RVR09: Los que descienden á la mar en navíos, y hacen negocio en las muchas aguas,

verses.KJV: These see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.WEB: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.ASV: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esses veem as obras do SENHOR, e suas maravilhas nas profundezas.
verses.RVR09: Ellos han visto las obras de Jehová, y sus maravillas en el profundo.

verses.KJV: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.WEB: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
verses.ASV: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porque] quando ele fala, ele faz levantar tormentas de vento, que levanta suas ondas.
verses.RVR09: El dijo, é hizo saltar el viento de la tempestad, que levanta sus ondas.

verses.KJV: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.WEB: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
verses.ASV: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elas sobem aos céus, [e] descem aos abismos; a alma deles se derrete de angústia.
verses.RVR09: Suben á los cielos, descienden á los abismos: sus almas se derriten con el mal.

verses.KJV: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.
verses.WEB: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
verses.ASV: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits’ end.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles cambaleiam e vacilam como bêbados, e toda a sabedoria deles se acaba.
verses.RVR09: Tiemblan, y titubean como borrachos, y toda su ciencia es perdida.

verses.KJV: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.WEB: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
verses.ASV: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os tirou de suas aflições.
verses.RVR09: Claman empero á Jehová en su angustia, y líbralos de sus aflicciones.

verses.KJV: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.WEB: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
verses.ASV: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fez cessar as tormentas, e as ondas se calaram.
verses.RVR09: Hace parar la tempestad en sosiego, y se apaciguan sus ondas.

verses.KJV: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.WEB: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
verses.ASV: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então se alegraram, porque houve calmaria; e ele os levou ao porto que queriam [chegar] .
verses.RVR09: Alégranse luego porque se reposaron; y él los guía al puerto que deseaban.

verses.KJV: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.WEB: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
verses.ASV: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens;
verses.RVR09: Alaben la misericordia de Jehová, y sus maravillas para con los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.WEB: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
verses.ASV: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, And praise him in the seat of the elders.
verses.ALMEIDA: E exaltem a ele na assembleia do povo, e o glorifiquem na reunião dos anciãos.
verses.RVR09: Y ensálcenlo en la congregación del pueblo; y en consistorio de ancianos lo alaben.

verses.KJV: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.WEB: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
verses.ASV: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele torna os rios em deserto, e as saídas de águas em terra seca.
verses.RVR09: El vuelve los ríos en desierto, y los manantiales de las aguas en secadales;

verses.KJV: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.WEB: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.ASV: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra frutífera em salgada, pela maldade dos que nela habitam.
verses.RVR09: La tierra fructífera en salados, por la maldad de los que la habitan.

verses.KJV: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.WEB: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
verses.ASV: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele torna o deserto em lagoa, e a terra seca em nascentes de águas.
verses.RVR09: Vuelve el desierto en estanques de aguas, y la tierra seca en manantiales.

verses.KJV: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.WEB: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
verses.ASV: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city of habitation,
verses.ALMEIDA: E faz aos famintos habitarem ali; e eles edificam uma cidade para morarem;
verses.RVR09: Y allí aposenta á los hambrientos, y disponen ciudad para habitación;

verses.KJV: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.WEB: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
verses.ASV: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And get them fruits of increase.
verses.ALMEIDA: E semeiam campos, e plantam vinhas, que produzem fruto valioso.
verses.RVR09: Y siembran campos, y plantan viñas, y rinden crecido fruto.

verses.KJV: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.WEB: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
verses.ASV: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele os abençoa, e se multiplicam muito, e o gado dele não diminui.
verses.RVR09: Y los bendice, y se multiplican en gran manera; y no disminuye sus bestias.

verses.KJV: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.WEB: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
verses.ASV: Again, they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [quando] eles se diminuem e se abatem, por causa da opressão, mal e aflição;
verses.RVR09: Y luego son menoscabados y abatidos á causa de tiranía, de males y congojas.

verses.KJV: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
verses.WEB: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
verses.ASV: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele derrama desprezo sobre os governantes, e os faz andar sem rumo pelos desertos, sem [terem] caminho.
verses.RVR09: El derrama menosprecio sobre los príncipes, y les hace andar errados, vagabundos, sin camino:

verses.KJV: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
verses.WEB: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
verses.ASV: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh [him] families like a flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ao necessitado, ele levanta da opressão a um alto retiro, e faz famílias como a rebanhos.
verses.RVR09: Y levanta al pobre de la miseria, y hace multiplicar las familias como rebaños de ovejas.

verses.KJV: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.WEB: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
verses.ASV: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os corretos, ao verem, ficam alegres, e todo perverso se calará.
verses.RVR09: Vean los rectos, y alégrense; y toda maldad cierre su boca.

verses.KJV: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.
verses.ASV: Whoso is wise will give heed to these things; And they will consider the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é sábio, que preste atenção a estas coisas, e reflita nas bondades do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es sabio y guardará estas cosas, y entenderá las misericordias de Jehová?

verses.KJV: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.WEB: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
verses.ASV: A Song, a Psalm of David. My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico e Salmo de Davi: Preparado está meu coração, ó Deus; cantarei e tocarei música [com] minha glória.
verses.RVR09: Canción: Salmo de David. MI corazón está dispuesto, oh Dios; cantaré y salmearé todavía en mi gloria.

verses.KJV: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.WEB: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
verses.ASV: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desperta-te, lira e harpa; eu despertarei ao amanhecer.
verses.RVR09: Despiértate, salterio y arpa: despertaré al alba.

verses.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.WEB: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
verses.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvarei a ti entre os povos, SENHOR, e tocarei música a ti entre as nações;
verses.RVR09: Te alabaré, oh Jehová, entre los pueblos; á ti cantaré salmos entre las naciones.

verses.KJV: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.WEB: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.ASV: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth [reacheth] unto the skies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tua bondade é maior que os céus, e tua fidelidade mais alta que as nuvens.
verses.RVR09: Porque grande más que los cielos es tu misericordia, y hasta los cielos tu verdad.

verses.KJV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.WEB: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.ASV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exalta-te sobre os céus, ó Deus; e tua glória sobre toda a terra;
verses.RVR09: Ensálzate, oh Dios, sobre los cielos; y sobre toda la tierra tu gloria.

verses.KJV: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.WEB: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
verses.ASV: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que teus amados sejam libertados; salva [-nos] com tua mão direita, e responde-me.
verses.RVR09: Para que sean librados tus amados, salva con tu diestra y respóndeme.

verses.KJV: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.WEB: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.ASV: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deus falou em seu santuário: Eu me alegrarei; repartirei a Siquém, e medirei ao vale de Sucote.
verses.RVR09: Dios habló por su santuario: alegraréme, repartiré á Sichêm, y mediré el valle de Succoth.

verses.KJV: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.WEB: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
verses.ASV: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu é Gileade, meu é Manassés; e Efraim é a fortaleza de minha cabeça; Judá é meu legislador.
verses.RVR09: Mío es Galaad, mío es Manasés; y Ephraim es la fortaleza de mi cabeza; Judá es mi legislador;

verses.KJV: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.WEB: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
verses.ASV: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.
verses.ALMEIDA: Moabe é minha bacia de lavar; sobre Edom lançarei meu sapato; sobre a Filístia eu triunfarei.
verses.RVR09: Moab, la vasija de mi lavatorio: sobre Edom echaré mi calzado; regocijaréme sobre Palestina.

verses.KJV: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.WEB: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.ASV: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem me levará a uma cidade fortificada? Quem me guiará até Edom?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién me guiará á la ciudad fortalecida? ¿quién me guiará hasta Idumea?

verses.KJV: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.WEB: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
verses.ASV: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não serás tu, ó Deus? Tu que tinha nos rejeitado, e não saías [mais] com nossos exércitos?
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente tú, oh Dios, que nos habías desechado; y no salías, oh Dios, con nuestros ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.WEB: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
verses.ASV: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-nos ajuda [para livrarmos] da angústia, porque o socorro humano é inútil.
verses.RVR09: Danos socorro en la angustia: porque mentirosa es la salud del hombre.

verses.KJV: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.WEB: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
verses.ASV: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em Deus faremos proezas; e ele pisoteará nossos adversários.
verses.RVR09: En Dios haremos proezas: y él hollará nuestros enemigos.

verses.KJV: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Ó Deus a quem eu louvo, não fiques calado.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. OH Dios de mi alabanza, no calles;

verses.KJV: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.WEB: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
verses.ASV: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a boca do perverso, e a boca enganadora já se abriram contra mim; falaram de mim com língua falsa.
verses.RVR09: Porque boca de impío y boca de engañador se han abierto sobre mí: han hablado de mí con lengua mentirosa,

verses.KJV: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.WEB: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
verses.ASV: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me cercaram com palavras de ódio; e lutaram contra mim sem motivo.
verses.RVR09: Y con palabras de odio me rodearon; y pelearon contra mí sin causa.

verses.KJV: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.WEB: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
verses.ASV: For my love they are my adversaries: But I [give myself unto] prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeram-se contra mim por causa de meu amor; porém eu [me mantenho] em oração.
verses.RVR09: En pago de mi amor me han sido adversarios: mas yo oraba.

verses.KJV: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.WEB: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.ASV: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Retribuíram o bem com o mal, e o meu amor com ódio.
verses.RVR09: Y pusieron contra mí mal por bien, y odio por amor.

verses.KJV: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.WEB: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
verses.ASV: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Põe algum perverso contra ele, e que haja um acusador à sua direita.
verses.RVR09: Pon sobre él al impío: y Satán esté á su diestra.

verses.KJV: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.WEB: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
verses.ASV: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer be turned into sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando for julgado, que saia condenado; e que a oração dele seja [considerada] como pecado.
verses.RVR09: Cuando fuere juzgado, salga impío; y su oración sea para pecado.

verses.KJV: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.WEB: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
verses.ASV: Let his days be few; [And] let another take his office.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam os dias dele poucos, e que outro tome sua atividade.
verses.RVR09: Sean sus días pocos: tome otro su oficio.

verses.KJV: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.WEB: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.ASV: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam seus filhos órfãos, e sua mulher seja viúva.
verses.RVR09: Sean sus hijos huérfanos, y su mujer viuda.

verses.KJV: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.WEB: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
verses.ASV: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek [their bread] out of their desolate places.
verses.ALMEIDA: E que seus filhos andem sem rumo, e mendiguem; e busquem [para si longe] de suas ruínas.
verses.RVR09: Y anden sus hijos vagabundos, y mendiguen; y procuren su pan lejos de sus desolados hogares.

verses.KJV: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.WEB: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
verses.ASV: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que o credor tome tudo o que ele tem, e estranhos saqueiem seu trabalho.
verses.RVR09: Enrede el acreedor todo lo que tiene, y extraños saqueen su trabajo.

verses.KJV: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.WEB: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
verses.ASV: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haja ninguém que tenha piedade dele, e haja ninguém que se compadeça de seus órfãos.
verses.RVR09: No tenga quien le haga misericordia; ni haya quien tenga compasión de sus huérfanos.

verses.KJV: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.WEB: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.ASV: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam seus descendentes cortados de vez; [e] que o nome deles seja apagado da geração seguinte.
verses.RVR09: Su posteridad sea talada; en segunda generación sea raído su nombre.

verses.KJV: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.WEB: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.ASV: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que a perversidade de seus pais seja lembrada pelo SENHOR, e que o pecado de sua mãe não seja apagado.
verses.RVR09: Venga en memoria cerca de Jehová la maldad de sus padres, y el pecado de su madre no sea borrado.

verses.KJV: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.WEB: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
verses.ASV: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém que tais coisas] estejam sempre perante o SENHOR, e corte-se a lembrança deles da terra.
verses.RVR09: Estén siempre delante de Jehová, y él corte de la tierra su memoria.

verses.KJV: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.WEB: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
verses.ASV: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay [them].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele não se lembrou de fazer o bem; ao invés disso, perseguiu ao homem humilde e necessitado, e ao de coração quebrado, para [o] matar.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto no se acordó de hacer misericordia, y persiguió al hombre afligido y menesteroso y quebrantado de corazón, para matarlo.

verses.KJV: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.WEB: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
verses.ASV: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já que ele amou a maldição, então que ela lhe sobrevenha; e já que ele não quis a bênção, que esta se afaste dele.
verses.RVR09: Y amó la maldición, y vínole; y no quiso la bendición, y ella se alejó de él.

verses.KJV: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.WEB: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
verses.ASV: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele seja revestido de maldição, como se lhe fosse sua roupa, como água dentro do seu corpo, e como óleo em seus ossos.
verses.RVR09: Y vistióse de maldición como de su vestido, y entró como agua en sus entrañas, y como aceite en sus huesos.

verses.KJV: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.WEB: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
verses.ASV: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que ela seja como uma roupa com que ele se cubra, e como cinto com que ele sempre põe ao seu redor.
verses.RVR09: Séale como vestido con que se cubra, y en lugar de cinto con que se ciña siempre.

verses.KJV: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.WEB: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.
verses.ASV: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto seja o pagamento do SENHOR para os meus adversários, e para os que falam mal contra minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Este sea el pago de parte de Jehová de los que me calumnian, y de los que hablan mal contra mi alma.

verses.KJV: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
verses.WEB: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
verses.ASV: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name’s sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, Senhor DEUS, me trata [bem] por causa do teu nome; por ser boa a tua misericórdia, livra-me;
verses.RVR09: Y tú, Jehová Señor, haz conmigo por amor de tu nombre: líbrame, porque tu misericordia es buena.

verses.KJV: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.WEB: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
verses.ASV: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque estou aflito e necessitado; e meu coração está ferido dentro de mim.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo estoy afligido y necesitado; y mi corazón está herido dentro de mí.

verses.KJV: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.WEB: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.ASV: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vou como a sombra, que declina; estou sendo sacudido como um gafanhoto.
verses.RVR09: Voime como la sombra cuando declina; soy sacudido como langosta.

verses.KJV: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.WEB: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
verses.ASV: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus joelhos estão fracos de [tanto] jejuar; minha carne está magra, sem gordura alguma.
verses.RVR09: Mis rodillas están debilitadas á causa del ayuno, y mi carne desfallecida por falta de gordura.

verses.KJV: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.WEB: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
verses.ASV: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu por eles sou humilhado; quando me veem, sacodem suas cabeças.
verses.RVR09: Yo he sido para ellos objeto de oprobio; mirábanme, y meneaban su cabeza.

verses.KJV: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.WEB: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
verses.ASV: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:
verses.ALMEIDA: Socorre-me, SENHOR Deus meu; salva-me conforme a tua bondade;
verses.RVR09: Ayúdame, Jehová Dios mío: sálvame conforme á tu misericordia.

verses.KJV: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.
verses.WEB: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.
verses.ASV: That they may know that this is thy hand; [That] thou, Jehovah, hast done it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que saibam que esta é a tua mão; e que assim tu a fizeste.
verses.RVR09: Y entiendan que esta es tu mano; que tú, Jehová, has hecho esto.

verses.KJV: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.WEB: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
verses.ASV: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldigam eles, mas bendize tu; levantem-se eles, mas sejam envergonhados; e o teu servo se alegre.
verses.RVR09: Maldigan ellos, y bendice tú: levántense, mas sean avergonzados, y regocíjese tu siervo.

verses.KJV: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.WEB: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
verses.ASV: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que meus adversários se vistam de vergonha, e cubram-se com sua própria humilhação, como [se fosse] uma capa.
verses.RVR09: Sean vestidos de ignominia los que me calumnian; y sean cubiertos de su confusión como con manto.

verses.KJV: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.WEB: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.ASV: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecerei grandemente ao SENHOR com minha boca, e no meio de muitos eu o louvarei;
verses.RVR09: Yo alabaré á Jehová en gran manera con mi boca, y le loaré en medio de muchos.

verses.KJV: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.WEB: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
verses.ASV: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele se põe à direita do necessitado, para [o] livrar daqueles que atacam a sua alma.
verses.RVR09: Porque él se pondrá á la diestra del pobre, para librar su alma de los que le juzgan.

verses.KJV: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David. Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: O SENHOR disse a meu Senhor: Senta-te à minha direita, até que eu ponha teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. JEHOVÁ dijo á mi Señor: Siéntate á mi diestra, en tanto que pongo tus enemigos por estrado de tus pies.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.WEB: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR enviará o cetro de tua força desde Sião, [dizendo] : Domina tu no meio de teus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: La vara de tu fortaleza enviará Jehová desde Sión: domina en medio de tus enemigos.

verses.KJV: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.WEB: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
verses.ASV: Thy people offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu povo será voluntário no dia do teu poder; com santas honras, desde o ventre do amanhecer, tu [terás] o orvalho de tua juventude.
verses.RVR09: Tu pueblo serálo de buena voluntad en el día de tu poder, en la hermosura de la santidad: desde el seno de la aurora, tienes tú el rocío de tu juventud.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.WEB: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR jurou, e não se arrependerá: Tu és Sacerdote eterno, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.RVR09: Juró Jehová, y no se arrepentirá: Tú eres sacerdote para siempre según el orden de Melchîsedech.

verses.KJV: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.WEB: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.ASV: The Lord at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor está à tua direita; ele ferirá aos reis no dia de sua ira.
verses.RVR09: El Señor á tu diestra herirá á los reyes en el día de su furor.

verses.KJV: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.WEB: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
verses.ASV: He will judge among the nations, He will fill [the places] with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Julgará entre as nações; ele [as] encherá de corpos mortos; [e] ferirá a cabeça de uma grande terra.
verses.RVR09: Juzgará en las gentes, llenarálas de cadáveres: herirá las cabezas en muchas tierras.

verses.KJV: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.WEB: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
