verses.ASV: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele beberá do ribeiro no caminho, então levantará a cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Del arroyo beberá en el camino: por lo cual levantará cabeza.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart, In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Louvarei ao SENHOR com todo o coração, no conselho e na congregação dos corretos.
verses.RVR09: Aleluya. ALABARÉ á Jehová con todo el corazón, en la compañía y congregación de los rectos.

verses.KJV: The works of the Lord are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
verses.ASV: The works of Jehovah are great, Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Grandes são as obras do SENHOR; procuradas por todos os que nelas se agradam.
verses.RVR09: Grandes son las obras de Jehová; buscadas de todos los que las quieren.

verses.KJV: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.ASV: His work is honor and majesty; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Glória e majestade são o seu agir, e sua justiça permanece para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Gloria y hermosura es su obra; y su justicia permanece para siempre.

verses.KJV: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.WEB: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
verses.ASV: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fez memoráveis as suas maravilhas; piedoso é misericordioso é o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Hizo memorables sus maravillas: clemente y misericordioso es Jehová.

verses.KJV: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.WEB: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
verses.ASV: He hath given food unto them that fear him: He will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele deu alimento aos que o temem; ele se lembrará para sempre de seu pacto.
verses.RVR09: Dió mantenimiento á los que le temen; para siempre se acordará de su pacto.

verses.KJV: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.WEB: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.ASV: He hath showed his people the power of his works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele anunciou o poder se suas obras a seu povo, dando-lhes a herança de nações [estrangeiras] .
verses.RVR09: El poder de sus obras anunció á su pueblo, dándole la heredad de las gentes.

verses.KJV: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.WEB: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
verses.ASV: The works of his hands are truth and justice; All his precepts are sure.
verses.ALMEIDA: As obras de suas mãos são verdade e juízo, e todos os seus mandamentos são fiéis.
verses.RVR09: Las obras de sus manos son verdad y juicio: fieles son todos sus mandamientos;

verses.KJV: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.WEB: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.ASV: They are established for ever and ever; They are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles ficarão firmes para sempre, e são feitos em verdade e justiça.
verses.RVR09: Afirmados por siglo de siglo, hechos en verdad y en rectitud.

verses.KJV: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.WEB: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
verses.ASV: He hath sent redemption unto his people; He hath commanded his covenant for ever: Holy and reverend is his name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele enviou resgate a seu povo, ordenou seu pacto para sempre; santo e temível é o seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Redención ha enviado á su pueblo; para siempre ha ordenado su pacto: santo y terrible es su nombre.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do [his commandments]: His praise endureth for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR é o princípio da sabedoria; inteligentes são todos o que isto praticam. O louvor a ele dura para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El principio de la sabiduría es el temor de Jehová: buen entendimiento tienen cuantos ponen aquéllos por obra: su loor permanece para siempre.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Bem-aventurado é o homem que teme ao SENHOR, e que tem muito prazer em seus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Aleluya. BIENAVENTURADO el hombre que teme á Jehová, y en sus mandamientos se deleita en gran manera.

verses.KJV: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.WEB: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.ASV: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua descendência será poderosa na terra; a geração dos corretos será bendita.
verses.RVR09: Su simiente será poderosa en la tierra: la generación de los rectos será bendita.

verses.KJV: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em sua casa [haverá] bens e riquezas, e sua justiça permanece para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Hacienda y riquezas hay en su casa; y su justicia permanece para siempre.

verses.KJV: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.WEB: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
verses.ASV: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: [He is] gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: A luz brilha nas trevas para os corretos, [para quem é] piedoso, misericordioso e justo.
verses.RVR09: Resplandeció en las tinieblas luz á los rectos: es clemente, y misericordioso, y justo.

verses.KJV: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.WEB: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.ASV: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem bom é misericordioso, e empresta; ele administra suas coisas com prudência.
verses.RVR09: El hombre de bien tiene misericordia y presta; gobierna sus cosas con juicio.

verses.KJV: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.WEB: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
verses.ASV: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente ele nunca se abalará; o justo será lembrado para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual no resbalará para siempre: en memoria eterna será el justo.

verses.KJV: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.
verses.WEB: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
verses.ASV: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não temerá o mau rumor; o seu coração está firme, confiante no SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: De mala fama no tendrá temor: su corazón está apercibido, confiado en Jehová.

verses.KJV: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.WEB: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
verses.ASV: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see [his desire] upon his adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu firme coração não temerá, até que ele veja [o fim] de seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Asentado está su corazón, no temerá, hasta que vea en sus enemigos su deseo.

verses.KJV: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.WEB: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
verses.ASV: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele distribui, e dá aos necessitados; sua justiça permanece para sempre; seu poder será exaltado em glória.
verses.RVR09: Esparce, da á los pobres: su justicia permanece para siempre; su cuerno será ensalzado en gloria.

verses.KJV: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.WEB: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
verses.ASV: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso verá, e ficará incomodado; rangerá seus dentes, e se consumirá. O desejo dos perversos perecerá.
verses.RVR09: Verálo el impío, y se despechará; crujirá los dientes, y se repudrirá: perecerá el deseo de los impíos.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Louvai, vós servos do SENHOR, louvai o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Aleluya. ALABAD, siervos de Jehová, alabad el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.ASV: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja o nome do SENHOR bendito, desde agora para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Sea el nombre de Jehová bendito, desde ahora y para siempre.

verses.KJV: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord's name is to be praised.
verses.WEB: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.
verses.ASV: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah’s name is to be praised.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o nascer do sol até o poente, seja louvado o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Desde el nacimiento del sol hasta donde se pone, sea alabado el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.WEB: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR está elevado acima de todas as nações; [e] sua glória acima dos céus.
verses.RVR09: Alto sobre todas las naciones es Jehová; sobre los cielos su gloria.

verses.KJV: Who is like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,
verses.WEB: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,
verses.ASV: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é como o SENHOR nosso Deus? Ele que habita nas alturas,
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién como Jehová nuestro Dios, que ha enaltecido su habitación,

verses.KJV: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.WEB: who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
verses.ASV: That humbleth himself to behold [The things that are] in heaven and in the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que se abaixa para ver [o que há] nos céus e na terra;
verses.RVR09: Que se humilla á mirar en el cielo y en la tierra?

verses.KJV: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.WEB: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
verses.ASV: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que do levanta o pobre do pó da terra, e levanta o necessitado da sujeira;
verses.RVR09: El levanta del polvo al pobre, y al menesteroso alza del estiércol,

verses.KJV: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.WEB: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.ASV: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para fazê-lo sentar com os príncipes, com os príncipes de seu povo;
verses.RVR09: Para hacerlos sentar con los príncipes, con los príncipes de su pueblo.

verses.KJV: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [And to be] a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que faz a estéril habitar em família, como alegre mãe de filhos. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: El hace habitar en familia á la estéril, gozosa en ser madre de hijos. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.WEB: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
verses.ASV: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando Israel saiu do Egito, [quando] a casa de Jacó [saiu] de um povo estrangeiro,
verses.RVR09: CUANDO salió Israel de Egipto, la casa de Jacob del pueblo bárbaro,

verses.KJV: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
verses.WEB: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.ASV: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Judá se tornou seu santuário, [e] Israel os seus domínios.
verses.RVR09: Judá fué su consagrada heredad, Israel su señorío.

verses.KJV: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.WEB: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
verses.ASV: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mar viu, e fugiu; e o Jordão recuou.
verses.RVR09: La mar vió, y huyó; el Jordán se volvió atrás.

verses.KJV: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.WEB: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
verses.ASV: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes saltaram como carneiros, os morros como cordeiros.
verses.RVR09: Los montes saltaron como carneros: los collados como corderitos.

verses.KJV: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.WEB: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.ASV: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que houve, ó mar, que fugiste? Ó Jordão, que recuaste?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué tuviste, oh mar, que huiste? ¿y tú, oh Jordán, que te volviste atrás?

verses.KJV: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.WEB: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
verses.ASV: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó montes, que saltastes como carneiros? Ó morros, como cordeiros?
verses.RVR09: Oh montes, ¿por qué saltasteis como carneros, y vosotros, collados, como corderitos?

verses.KJV: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.WEB: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.ASV: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.ALMEIDA: Trema tu, ó terra, pela presença do Senhor, pela presença do Deus de Jacó,
verses.RVR09: A la presencia del Señor tiembla la tierra, á la presencia del Dios de Jacob;

verses.KJV: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.WEB: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
verses.ASV: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que tornou a rocha em lago de águas; ao pedregulho em fonte de águas.
verses.RVR09: El cual tornó la peña en estanque de aguas, y en fuente de aguas la roca.

verses.KJV: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
verses.WEB: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
verses.ASV: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não a nós, SENHOR; não a nós, mas a teu nome dá glória; por tua bondade, por tua fidelidade.
verses.RVR09: NO á nosotros, oh Jehová, no á nosotros, sino á tu nombre da gloria; por tu misericordia, por tu verdad.

verses.KJV: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
verses.WEB: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
verses.ASV: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque as nações dirão: Onde está o Deus deles?
verses.RVR09: Por qué dirán las gentes: ¿Dónde está ahora su Dios?

verses.KJV: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.WEB: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
verses.ASV: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nosso Deus está nos céus, ele faz tudo o que lhe agrada.
verses.RVR09: Y nuestro Dios está en los cielos: todo lo que quiso ha hecho.

verses.KJV: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.WEB: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.ASV: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os ídolos deles são prata e ouro, obras de mãos humanas.
verses.RVR09: Sus ídolos son plata y oro, obra de manos de hombres.

verses.KJV: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.WEB: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
verses.ASV: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.ALMEIDA: Têm boca, mas não falam; têm olhos, mas não veem;
verses.RVR09: Tienen boca, mas no hablarán; tienen ojos, mas no verán;

verses.KJV: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.WEB: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
verses.ASV: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;
verses.ALMEIDA: Têm ouvidos, mas não ouvem; tem nariz, mas não cheiram;
verses.RVR09: Orejas tienen, mas no oirán; tienen narices, mas no olerán;

verses.KJV: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.WEB: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
verses.ASV: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Têm mãos, mas não apalpam; têm pés, mas não andam; nem falam com suas gargantas.
verses.RVR09: Manos tienen, mas no palparán; tienen pies, mas no andarán; no hablarán con su garganta.

verses.KJV: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.WEB: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.ASV: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornem-se como eles os que os fazem, [e] todos os que neles confiam.
verses.RVR09: Como ellos son los que los hacen; cualquiera que en ellos confía.

verses.KJV: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.WEB: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.ASV: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Israel, confia no SENHOR; ele é sua ajuda e seu escudo.
verses.RVR09: Oh Israel, confía en Jehová: él es su ayuda y su escudo.

verses.KJV: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.WEB: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.ASV: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó casa de Arão, confiai no SENHOR; ele é sua ajuda e seu escudo.
verses.RVR09: Casa de Aarón, confiad en Jehová: él es su ayuda y su escudo.

verses.KJV: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.WEB: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.ASV: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós que temeis ao SENHOR, confiai no SENHOR; ele é sua ajuda e seu escudo.
verses.RVR09: Los que teméis á Jehová, confiad en Jehová: él es su ayuda y su escudo.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.WEB: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless [us]: He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR tem se lembrado de nós; ele há de abençoar; ele abençoará a casa de Israel; ele abençoará a casa de Arão.
verses.RVR09: Jehová se acordó de nosotros: nos bendecirá: bendecirá á la casa de Israel; bendecirá á la casa de Aarón.

verses.KJV: He will bless them that fear the Lord, both small and great.
verses.WEB: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.
verses.ASV: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele abençoará aos que temem ao SENHOR; tanto os pequenos como os grandes.
verses.RVR09: Bendecirá á los que temen á Jehová; á chicos y á grandes.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.WEB: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.ASV: Jehovah increase you more and more, You and your children.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR vos aumentará, vós e vossos filhos.
verses.RVR09: Acrecentará Jehová bendición sobre vosotros; sobre vosotros y sobre vuestros hijos.

verses.KJV: Ye are blessed of the Lord which made heaven and earth.
verses.WEB: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.ASV: Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Benditos sois vós [que pertenceis] ao SENHOR, que fez os céus e a terra.
verses.RVR09: Benditos vosotros de Jehová, que hizo los cielos y la tierra.

verses.KJV: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.WEB: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
verses.ASV: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Quanto] aos céus, os céus são do SENHOR; mas a terra ele deu aos filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Los cielos son los cielos de Jehová: y ha dado la tierra á los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: The dead praise not the Lord, neither any that go down into silence.
verses.WEB: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,
verses.ASV: The dead praise not Jehovah, Neither any that go down into silence;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os mortos não louvam ao SENHOR, nem os que descem ao silêncio.
verses.RVR09: No alabarán los muertos á JAH, ni cuantos descienden al silencio;

verses.KJV: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.
verses.WEB: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: But we will bless Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nós bendiremos ao SENHOR, desde agora e para sempre. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Mas nosotros bendeciremos á JAH, desde ahora para siempre. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
verses.WEB: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
verses.ASV: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amo o SENHOR, porque ele escuta minha voz [e] minhas súplicas.
verses.RVR09: AMO á Jehová, pues ha oído mi voz y mis súplicas.

verses.KJV: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.WEB: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
verses.ASV: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call [upon him] as long as I live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele tem inclinado a mim seus ouvidos; por isso eu clamarei a ele em [todos] os meus dias.
verses.RVR09: Porque ha inclinado á mí su oído, invocaréle por tanto en todos mis días.

verses.KJV: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.WEB: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.ASV: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cordas da morte me cercaram, e angústias do Xeol me afrontaram; encontrei opressão e aflição.
verses.RVR09: Rodeáronme los dolores de la muerte, me encontraron las angustias del sepulcro: angustia y dolor había yo hallado.

verses.KJV: Then called I upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.WEB: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
verses.ASV: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas clamei ao nome do SENHOR, [dizendo] : Ah SENHOR, livra minha alma!
verses.RVR09: Entonces invoqué el nombre de Jehová, diciendo: Libra ahora, oh Jehová, mi alma.

verses.KJV: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
verses.WEB: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
verses.ASV: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é piedoso e justo; e nosso Deus é misericordioso.
verses.RVR09: Clemente es Jehová y justo; sí, misericordioso es nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.WEB: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.ASV: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR protege os simples; eu estava com graves problemas, mas ele me livrou.
verses.RVR09: Jehová guarda á los sinceros: estaba yo postrado, y salvóme.

verses.KJV: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.WEB: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.ASV: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma, volta ao teu descanso, pois o SENHOR tem te tratado bem.
verses.RVR09: Vuelve, oh alma mía, á tu reposo; porque Jehová te ha hecho bien.

verses.KJV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.WEB: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.ASV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, [And] my feet from falling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu, [SENHOR] ,livraste minha alma da morte, meus olhos das lágrimas, e meu pé do tropeço.
verses.RVR09: Pues tú has librado mi alma de la muerte, mis ojos de lágrimas, y mis pies de desbarrar.

verses.KJV: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.WEB: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.ASV: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Andarei diante do SENHOR na terra dos viventes.
verses.RVR09: Andaré delante de Jehová en la tierra de los vivientes.

verses.KJV: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.WEB: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
verses.ASV: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu cri, por isso falei; estive muito aflito.
verses.RVR09: Creí; por tanto hablé, estando afligido en gran manera.

verses.KJV: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.WEB: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
verses.ASV: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu dizia em minha pressa: Todo homem é mentiroso.
verses.RVR09: Y dije en mi apresuramiento: Todo hombre es mentiroso.

verses.KJV: What shall I render unto the Lord for all his benefits toward me?
verses.WEB: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
verses.ASV: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que pagarei ao SENHOR por todos os benefícios dele para mim?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pagaré á Jehová por todos sus beneficios para conmigo?

verses.KJV: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomarei o copo da salvação, [e] chamarei o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Tomaré la copa de la salud, é invocaré el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.
verses.WEB: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
verses.ASV: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente pagarei meus votos ao SENHOR, na presença de todo o seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pagaré mis votos á Jehová delante de todo su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.
verses.WEB: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
verses.ASV: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.
verses.ALMEIDA: Preciosa é aos olhos do SENHOR a morte de seus santos.
verses.RVR09: Estimada es en los ojos de Jehová la muerte de sus santos.

verses.KJV: O Lord, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.WEB: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah SENHOR, verdadeiramente eu sou teu servo; sou teu servo, filho de tua serva; tu me soltaste das correntes que me prendiam.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, que yo soy tu siervo, yo tu siervo, hijo de tu sierva: rompiste mis prisiones.

verses.KJV: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sacrificarei a ti sacrifício de agradecimento, e chamarei o nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Te ofreceré sacrificio de alabanza, é invocaré el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.
verses.WEB: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
verses.ASV: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente pagarei meus votos ao SENHOR, na presença de todo o seu povo;
verses.RVR09: A Jehová pagaré ahora mis votos delante de todo su pueblo;

verses.KJV: In the courts of the Lord's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: In the courts of Jehovah’s house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nos pátios da casa do SENHOR, em meio de ti, ó Jerusalém. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: En los atrios de la casa de Jehová, en medio de ti, oh Jerusalem. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: O praise the Lord, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
verses.ASV: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai ao SENHOR, todas as nações; celebrai a ele, todos os povos.
verses.RVR09: ALABAD á Jehová, naciones todas; pueblos todos, alabadle.

verses.KJV: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the Lord endureth for ever. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: For his lovingkindness is great toward us; And the truth of Jehovah [endureth] for ever. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sua bondade prevaleceu sobre nós, e a fidelidade do SENHOR [dura] para sempre. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Porque ha engrandecido sobre nosotros su misericordia; y la verdad de Jehová es para siempre. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; pois sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: ALABAD á Jehová, porque es bueno; porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diga agora Israel, que sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Diga ahora Israel: Que para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diga agora casa de Arão, que sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Diga ahora la casa de Aarón: Que para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Let them now that fear the Lord say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Let them now that fear Jehovah say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Digam agora os que temem ao SENHOR, que sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Digan ahora los que temen á Jehová: Que para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: I called upon the Lord in distress: the Lord answered me, and set me in a large place.
verses.WEB: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.
verses.ASV: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah: Jehovah answered me [and set me] in a large place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na angústia clamei ao SENHOR; [e] o SENHOR me respondeu, e [me pôs] num lugar amplo.
verses.RVR09: Desde la angustia invoqué á JAH; y respondióme JAH, poniéndome en anchura.

verses.KJV: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.WEB: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.ASV: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR está comigo, não temerei; o que poderá me fazer o homem?
verses.RVR09: Jehová está por mí: no temeré lo que me pueda hacer el hombre.

verses.KJV: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
verses.WEB: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see [my desire] upon them that hate me.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR está comigo entre os que ajudam; por isso verei [o fim] daqueles que me odeiam.
verses.RVR09: Jehová está por mí entre los que me ayudan: por tanto yo veré mi deseo en los que me aborrecen.

verses.KJV: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.
verses.WEB: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
verses.ASV: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é buscar refúgio no SENHOR do que confiar no homem.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es esperar en Jehová que esperar en hombre.

verses.KJV: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.
verses.WEB: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.
verses.ASV: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é buscar refúgio no SENHOR do que confiar em príncipes.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es esperar en Jehová que esperar en príncipes.

verses.KJV: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.
verses.WEB: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
verses.ASV: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as nações me cercaram; [mas foi] no nome do SENHOR que eu as despedacei.
verses.RVR09: Todas las gentes me cercaron: en nombre de Jehová, que yo los romperé.

verses.KJV: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.WEB: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.
verses.ASV: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cercaram-me, cercaram-me mesmo; [mas foi] no nome do SENHOR que eu as despedacei.
verses.RVR09: Cercáronme y asediáronme: en nombre de Jehová, que yo los romperé.

verses.KJV: They compassed me about like bees: they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.WEB: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
verses.ASV: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cercaram-me como abelhas, mas se apagaram como fogo de espinhos; [porque] foi no nome do SENHOR que eu as despedacei.
verses.RVR09: Cercáronme como abejas; fueron apagados como fuegos de espinos: en nombre de Jehová, que yo los romperé.

verses.KJV: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.
verses.WEB: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
verses.ASV: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com força me empurraste para que eu caísse; mas o SENHOR me ajudou.
verses.RVR09: Empujásteme con violencia para que cayese: empero ayudóme Jehová.

verses.KJV: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.WEB: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is my strength and song; And he is become my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é minha força e [minha] canção, porque ele tem sido minha salvação.
verses.RVR09: Mi fortaleza y mi canción es JAH; y él me ha sido por salud.

verses.KJV: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.
verses.WEB: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
verses.ASV: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nas tendas dos justos há voz de alegria e salvação; a mão direita do SENHOR faz proezas.
verses.RVR09: Voz de júbilo y de salvación hay en las tiendas de los justos: la diestra de Jehová hace proezas.

verses.KJV: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.
verses.WEB: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
verses.ASV: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mão direita do SENHOR se levanta; a mão direita do SENHOR faz proezas.
verses.RVR09: La diestra de Jehová sublime: la diestra de Jehová hace valentías.

verses.KJV: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.
verses.ASV: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não morrerei, mas viverei; e contarei as obras do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No moriré, sino que viviré, y contaré las obras de JAH.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.WEB: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.ALMEIDA: É verdade que o SENHOR me castigou, porém ele não me entregou à morte.
verses.RVR09: Castigóme gravemente JAH: mas no me entregó á la muerte.

verses.KJV: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:
verses.WEB: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abri para mim as portas da justiça; entrarei por elas [e] louvarei ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Abridme las puertas de la justicia: entraré por ellas, alabaré á JAH.

verses.KJV: This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.WEB: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
verses.ASV: This is the gate of Jehovah; The righteous shall enter into it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a porta do SENHOR, pela qual os justos entrarão.
verses.RVR09: Esta puerta de Jehová, por ella entrarán los justos.

verses.KJV: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.WEB: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
verses.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te louvarei porque tu me respondeste e me salvaste.
verses.RVR09: Te alabaré, porque me has oído, y me fuiste por salud.

verses.KJV: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
verses.WEB: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.ASV: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head of the corner.
verses.ALMEIDA: A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram se tornou cabeça de esquina.
verses.RVR09: La piedra que desecharon los edificadores, ha venido á ser cabeza del ángulo.

verses.KJV: This is the Lord's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.WEB: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.ASV: This is Jehovah’s doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo SENHOR isto foi feito, [e] é maravilhoso aos nossos olhos.
verses.RVR09: De parte de Jehová es esto: es maravilla en nuestros ojos.

verses.KJV: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.WEB: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
verses.ASV: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o dia em que o SENHOR agiu; alegremos e enchamos de alegria nele.
verses.RVR09: Este es el día que hizo Jehová: nos gozaremos y alegraremos en él.

verses.KJV: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.WEB: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.
verses.ASV: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, SENHOR, salva-nos! Ah, SENHOR, faze [-nos] prosperar!
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, salva ahora, te ruego: oh Jehová, ruégote hagas prosperar ahora.

verses.KJV: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah: We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito aquele que vem no nome do SENHOR; nós vos bendizemos desde a casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Bendito el que viene en nombre de Jehová: desde la casa de Jehová os bendecimos.

verses.KJV: God is the Lord, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.WEB: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é o [verdadeiro] Deus, que nos deu luz; atai os [sacrifícios] da festa, para [levá-los] aos chifres do altar.
verses.RVR09: Dios es Jehová que nos ha resplandecido: atad víctimas con cuerdas á los cuernos del altar.

verses.KJV: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.WEB: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
verses.ASV: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu és meu Deus, por isso eu te louvarei. Eu te exaltarei, meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Mi Dios eres tú, y á ti alabaré: Dios mío, á ti ensalzaré.

verses.KJV: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; pois sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Alabad á Jehová porque es bueno; porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.
verses.WEB: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.
verses.ASV: Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Álefe] :Bem-aventurados são os puros em [seus] caminhos, os que andam na lei do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ALEPH. BIENAVENTURADOS los perfectos de camino; los que andan en la ley de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
verses.WEB: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
verses.ASV: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurados são os que guardam os testemunhos dele, [e] o buscam com todo o coração;
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurados los que guardan sus testimonios, y con todo el corazón le buscan:

verses.KJV: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.WEB: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
verses.ASV: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não praticam perversidade, [mas] andam nos caminhos dele.
verses.RVR09: Pues no hacen iniquidad los que andan en sus caminos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.WEB: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
verses.ASV: Thou hast commanded [us] thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu mandaste que teus mandamentos fossem cuidadosamente obedecidos.
verses.RVR09: Tú encargaste que sean muy guardados tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.WEB: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
verses.ASV: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah! Como gostaria que meus caminhos fossem dirigidos a guardar teus estatutos!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ojalá fuesen ordenados mis caminos á observar tus estatutos!

verses.KJV: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.WEB: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
verses.ASV: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então não me envergonharia, quando eu observasse todos os teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces no sería yo avergonzado, cuando atendiese á todos tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.WEB: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
verses.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvarei a ti com um coração correto, enquanto aprendo os juízos de tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Te alabaré con rectitud de corazón, cuando aprendiere los juicios de tu justicia.

verses.KJV: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.WEB: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH
verses.ASV: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu guardarei teus estatutos; não me abandones por completo.
verses.RVR09: Tus estatutos guardaré: no me dejes enteramente.

verses.KJV: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
verses.WEB: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
verses.ASV: Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed [thereto] according to thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Bete] : Com que um rapaz purificará o seu caminho? Sendo obediente conforme a tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: BETH ¿Con qué limpiará el joven su camino? Con guardar tu palabra.

verses.KJV: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.WEB: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
verses.ASV: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te busco como todo o meu coração; não me deixes desviar de teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Con todo mi corazón te he buscado: no me dejes divagar de tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.WEB: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.ASV: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guardei a tua palavra em meu coração, para eu não pecar contra ti.
verses.RVR09: En mi corazón he guardado tus dichos, para no pecar contra ti.

verses.KJV: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.
verses.WEB: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
verses.ASV: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito [és] tu, SENHOR; ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Bendito tú, oh Jehová: enséñame tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.WEB: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
verses.ASV: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com meus lábios contei todos os juízos de tua boca.
verses.RVR09: Con mis labios he contado todos los juicios de tu boca.

verses.KJV: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.WEB: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.ASV: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me alegro mais com o caminho de teus estatutos, do que com todas as riquezas.
verses.RVR09: Heme gozado en el camino de tus testimonios, como sobre toda riqueza.

verses.KJV: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.WEB: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
verses.ASV: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meditarei em teus mandamentos, e darei atenção aos teus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: En tus mandamientos meditaré, consideraré tus caminos.

verses.KJV: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.WEB: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL
verses.ASV: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Terei prazer em teus estatutos; não me esquecerei de tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Recrearéme en tus estatutos: no me olvidaré de tus palabras.

verses.KJV: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.WEB: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
verses.ASV: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Guímel] :Trata bem o teu servo, [para] que eu viva, e obedeça tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: GIMEL. Haz bien á tu siervo; que viva y guarde tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.WEB: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
verses.ASV: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold Wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abre meus olhos, para que eu veja as maravilhas de tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Abre mis ojos, y miraré las maravillas de tu ley.

verses.KJV: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.WEB: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
verses.ASV: I am a sojourner in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou peregrino na terra, não escondas de mim os teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Advenedizo soy yo en la tierra: no encubras de mí tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.WEB: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
verses.ASV: My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thine ordinances at all times.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma está despedaçada de tanto desejar os teus juízos em todo tempo.
verses.RVR09: Quebrantada está mi alma de desear tus juicios en todo tiempo.

verses.KJV: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.WEB: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
verses.ASV: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, That do wander from thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu repreendes aos malditos arrogantes, que se desviam de teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Destruiste á los soberbios malditos, que se desvían de tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.WEB: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
verses.ASV: Take away from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tira-me de minha humilhação e desprezo, pois eu guardei teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Aparta de mí oprobio y menosprecio; porque tus testimonios he guardado.

verses.KJV: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.WEB: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
verses.ASV: Princes also sat and talked against me; [But] thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até mesmo os príncipes se sentaram, e falaram contra mim; porém o teu servo estava meditando em teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Príncipes también se sentaron y hablaron contra mí: mas tu siervo meditaba en tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counselors.
verses.WEB: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
verses.ASV: Thy testimonies also are my delight [And] my counsellors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois teus testemunhos são meus prazeres [e] meus conselheiros.
verses.RVR09: Pues tus testimonios son mis deleites, y mis consejeros.

verses.KJV: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.WEB: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
verses.ASV: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dálete] :Minha alma está grudada ao pó; vivifica-me conforme tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: DALETH. Pegóse al polvo mi alma: vivifícame según tu palabra.

verses.KJV: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.WEB: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
verses.ASV: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu [te] contei os meus caminhos, e tu me respondeste; ensina-me conforme teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Mis caminos te conté, y me has respondido: enséñame tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.WEB: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.ASV: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze-me entender o caminho de teus preceitos, para eu falar de tuas maravilhas.
verses.RVR09: Hazme entender el camino de tus mandamientos, y hablaré de tus maravillas.

verses.KJV: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.WEB: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
verses.ASV: My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma se derrama de tristeza; levanta-me conforme tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Deshácese mi alma de ansiedad: corrobórame según tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.WEB: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
verses.ASV: Remove from me the way of falsehood; And grant me thy law graciously.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desvia de mim o caminho de falsidade; e sê piedoso dando-me tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Aparta de mí camino de mentira; y hazme la gracia de tu ley.

verses.KJV: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
verses.WEB: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
verses.ASV: I have chosen the way of faithfulness: Thine ordinances have I set [before me].
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu escolhi o caminho da fidelidade; e pus [diante de mim] os teus juízos.
verses.RVR09: Escogí el camino de la verdad; he puesto tus juicios delante de mí.

verses.KJV: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.
verses.WEB: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.
verses.ASV: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estou apegado a teus testemunhos; ó SENHOR, não me envergonhes.
verses.RVR09: Allegádome he á tus testimonios; oh Jehová, no me avergüences.

verses.KJV: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.WEB: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE
verses.ASV: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Correrei pelo caminho de teus mandamentos, porque tu alargaste o meu coração.
verses.RVR09: Por el camino de tus mandamientos correré, cuando ensanchares mi corazón.

verses.KJV: Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.WEB: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
verses.ASV: Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Hê] :Ensina-me, SENHOR, o caminho de teus estatutos, e eu o guardarei até o fim.
verses.RVR09: HE. Enséñame, oh Jehová, el camino de tus estatutos, y guardarélo hasta el fin.

verses.KJV: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.WEB: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
verses.ASV: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-me entendimento, e eu guardarei a tua lei, e a obedecerei de todo [o meu] coração.
verses.RVR09: Dame entendimiento, y guardaré tu ley; y la observaré de todo corazón.

verses.KJV: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.WEB: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
verses.ASV: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze-me andar na trilha de teus mandamentos, porque nela tenho prazer.
verses.RVR09: Guíame por la senda de tus mandamientos; porque en ella tengo mi voluntad.

verses.KJV: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.WEB: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
verses.ASV: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Inclina meu coração a teus testemunhos, e não à ganância.
verses.RVR09: Inclina mi corazón á tus testimonios, y no á la avaricia.

verses.KJV: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.WEB: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
verses.ASV: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desvia meus olhos para que não olhem para coisas inúteis; vivifica-me pelo teu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Aparta mis ojos, que no vean la vanidad; avívame en tu camino.

verses.KJV: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
verses.WEB: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
verses.ASV: Confirm unto thy servant thy word, Which [is in order] unto the fear of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confirma tua promessa a teu servo, que tem temor a ti.
verses.RVR09: Confirma tu palabra á tu siervo, que te teme.

verses.KJV: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
verses.WEB: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
verses.ASV: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desvia de mim a humilhação que eu tenho medo, pois teus juízos são bons.
verses.RVR09: Quita de mí el oprobio que he temido: porque buenos son tus juicios.

verses.KJV: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.WEB: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV
verses.ASV: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que amo os teus mandamentos; vivifica-me por tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo he codiciado tus mandamientos: vivifícame en tu justicia.

verses.KJV: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.WEB: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.
verses.ASV: Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Vau] :E venham sobre mim tuas bondades, SENHOR; [e também] a tua salvação, segundo tua promessa.
verses.RVR09: VAU. Y venga á mí tu misericordia, oh Jehová; tu salud, conforme á tu dicho.

verses.KJV: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.WEB: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
verses.ASV: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me; For I trust in thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que eu tenha resposta ao que me insulta; pois eu confio em tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Y daré por respuesta á mi avergonzador, que en tu palabra he confiado.

verses.KJV: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.WEB: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
verses.ASV: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nunca tires de minha boca a palavra da verdade, pois eu espero em teus juízos.
verses.RVR09: Y no quites de mi boca en ningún tiempo la palabra de verdad; porque á tu juicio espero.

verses.KJV: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
verses.ASV: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim obedecerei a tua lei continuamente, para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y guardaré tu ley siempre, por siglo de siglo.

verses.KJV: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.WEB: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.ASV: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E andarei [livremente] por longas distâncias, pois busquei teus preceitos.
verses.RVR09: Y andaré en anchura, porque busqué tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.WEB: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
verses.ASV: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings, And shall not be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também falarei de teus testemunhos perante reis, e não me envergonharei.
verses.RVR09: Y hablaré de tus testimonios delante de los reyes, y no me avergonzaré.

verses.KJV: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.WEB: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
verses.ASV: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E terei prazer em teus mandamentos, que eu amo.
verses.RVR09: Y deleitaréme en tus mandamientos, que he amado.

verses.KJV: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.WEB: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN
verses.ASV: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantarei as minhas mãos a teus mandamentos, que eu amo; e meditarei em teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Alzaré asimismo mis manos á tus mandamientos, que amé; y meditaré en tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.WEB: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
verses.ASV: Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Záin] :Lembra-te da palavra [dada] a teu servo, à qual mantenho esperança.
verses.RVR09: ZAIN. Acuérdate de la palabra dada á tu siervo, en la cual me has hecho esperar.

verses.KJV: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.WEB: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
verses.ASV: This is my comfort in my affliction; For thy word hath quickened me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto é meu consolo na minha aflição, porque tua promessa me vivifica.
verses.RVR09: Esta es mi consuelo en mi aflicción: porque tu dicho me ha vivificado.

verses.KJV: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
verses.WEB: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
verses.ASV: The proud have had me greatly in derision: [Yet] have I not swerved from thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os arrogantes têm zombado de mim demasiadamente; [porém] não me desviei de tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Los soberbios se burlaron mucho de mí: mas no me he apartado de tu ley.

verses.KJV: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.
verses.WEB: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.
verses.ASV: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah, And have comforted myself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me lembrei de teus juízos muito antigos, SENHOR; e [assim] me consolei.
verses.RVR09: Acordéme, oh Jehová, de tus juicios antiguos, y consoléme.

verses.KJV: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.WEB: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
verses.ASV: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me, Because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me enchi de ira por causa dos perversos, que abandonam tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Horror se apoderó de mí, á causa de los impíos que dejan tu ley.

verses.KJV: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.WEB: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
verses.ASV: Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus estatutos foram meus cânticos no lugar de minhas peregrinações.
verses.RVR09: Cánticos me fueron tus estatutos en la mansión de mis peregrinaciones.

verses.KJV: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.WEB: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.
verses.ASV: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, And have observed thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: De noite tenho me lembrado de teu nome, SENHOR; e tenho guardado tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Acordéme en la noche de tu nombre, oh Jehová, y guardé tu ley.

verses.KJV: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.WEB: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH
verses.ASV: This I have had, Because I have kept thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto eu tenho feito, porque guardo teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Esto tuve, porque guardaba tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.WEB: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Hete] :O SENHOR é minha porção; eu disse que guardaria tuas palavras.
verses.RVR09: CHETH. Mi porción, oh Jehová, dije, será guardar tus palabras.

verses.KJV: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.WEB: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
verses.ASV: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Busquei a tua face com todo o [meu] coração; tem piedade de mim segundo tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Tu presencia supliqué de todo corazón: ten misericordia de mí según tu palabra.

verses.KJV: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.WEB: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
verses.ASV: I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu dei atenção a meus caminhos, e dirigi meus pés a teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Consideré mis caminos, y torné mis pies á tus testimonios.

verses.KJV: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.WEB: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
verses.ASV: I made haste, and delayed not, To observe thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me apressei, e não demorei a guardar os teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Apresuréme, y no me retardé en guardar tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.WEB: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
verses.ASV: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; [But] I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bandos de perversos me roubaram; [porém] não me esqueci de tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Compañías de impíos me han robado: mas no me he olvidado de tu ley.

verses.KJV: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.WEB: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.ASV: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.
verses.ALMEIDA: No meio da noite eu me levanto para te louvar, por causa dos juízos de tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: A media noche me levantaba á alabarte sobre los juicios de tu justicia.

verses.KJV: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.WEB: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
verses.ASV: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sou companheiro de todos os que te temem, e dos que guardam os teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Compañero soy yo de todos los que te temieren y guardaren tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.WEB: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH
verses.ASV: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra está cheia de tua bondade, SENHOR; ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: De tu misericordia, oh Jehová, está llena la tierra: enséñame tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.
verses.WEB: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.
verses.ASV: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Tete] :Tu fizeste bem a teu servo, SENHOR, conforme tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: TETH. Bien has hecho con tu siervo, oh Jehová, conforme á tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.WEB: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
verses.ASV: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; For I have believed in thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensina-me bom senso e conhecimento, pois tenho crido em teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Enséñame bondad de sentido y sabiduría; porque tus mandamientos he creído.

verses.KJV: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.WEB: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
verses.ASV: Before I was afflicted I went astray; But now I observe thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes de ter sido afligido, eu andava errado; mas agora guardo tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Antes que fuera yo humillado, descarriado andaba; mas ahora guardo tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.WEB: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
verses.ASV: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu és bom, e fazes o bem; ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Bueno eres tú, y bienhechor: enséñame tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.WEB: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
verses.ASV: The proud have forged a lie against me: With my whole heart will I keep thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os arrogantes forjaram mentiras contra mim; [mas] eu com todo o [meu] coração guardo os teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Contra mí forjaron mentira los soberbios: mas yo guardaré de todo corazón tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
verses.WEB: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
verses.ASV: Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração deles se incha como gordura; [mas] eu tenho prazer em tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Engrasóse el corazón de ellos como sebo; mas yo en tu ley me he deleitado.

verses.KJV: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.WEB: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
verses.ASV: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; That I may learn thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi bom pra mim ter sido afligido, para assim eu aprender os teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Bueno me es haber sido humillado, para que aprenda tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.WEB: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
verses.ASV: The law of thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor para mim é a lei de tua boca, do que milhares de [peças] de ouro ou prata.
verses.RVR09: Mejor me es la ley de tu boca, que millares de oro y plata.

verses.KJV: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.WEB: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
verses.ASV: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Iode] :Tuas mãos me fizeram e me formaram; faze-me ter entendimento, para que eu aprenda teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: JOD. Tus manos me hicieron y me formaron: hazme entender, y aprenderé tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.WEB: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
verses.ASV: They that fear thee shall see me and be glad, Because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que te temem olham para mim e se alegram, porque eu mantive esperança em tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Los que te temen, me verán, y se alegrarán; porque en tu palabra he esperado.

verses.KJV: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.WEB: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.ASV: I know, O Jehovah, that thy judgments are righteous, And that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sei, SENHOR, que teus juízos são justos; e que tu me afligiste [por] tua fidelidade.
