verses.RVR09: Conozco, oh Jehová, que tus juicios son justicia, y que conforme á tu fidelidad me afligiste.

verses.KJV: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.WEB: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
verses.ASV: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja agora tua bondade para me consolar, segundo a promessa [que fizeste] a teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Sea ahora tu misericordia para consolarme, conforme á lo que has dicho á tu siervo.

verses.KJV: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
verses.WEB: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
verses.ASV: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; For thy law is my delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Venham tuas misericórdias sobre mim, para que eu viva; pois tua lei é o meu prazer.
verses.RVR09: Vengan á mí tus misericordias, y viva; porque tu ley es mi deleite.

verses.KJV: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.WEB: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.ASV: Let the proud be put to shame; for they have overthrown me wrongfully: [But] I will meditate on thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam envergonhados os arrogantes, porque eles me prejudicaram com mentiras; [porém] eu medito em teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Sean avergonzados los soberbios, porque sin causa me han calumniado: yo empero, meditaré en tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.WEB: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
verses.ASV: Let those that fear thee turn unto me; And they shall know thy testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Virem-se a mim os que te temem e conhecem os teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Tórnense á mí los que te temen y conocen tus testimonios.

verses.KJV: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.WEB: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
verses.ASV: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, That I be not put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja meu coração correto em teus estatutos, para eu não ser envergonhado.
verses.RVR09: Sea mi corazón íntegro en tus estatutos; porque no sea yo avergonzado.

verses.KJV: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
verses.WEB: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
verses.ASV: My soul fainteth for thy salvation; [But] I hope in thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Cafe] :Minha alma desfalece por tua salvação; em tua palavra mantenho esperança.
verses.RVR09: CAPH. Desfallece mi alma por tu salud, esperando en tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.WEB: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
verses.ASV: Mine eyes fail for thy word, While I say, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos desfaleceram por tua promessa, enquanto eu dizia: Quando tu me consolarás?
verses.RVR09: Desfallecieron mis ojos por tu palabra, diciendo: ¿Cuándo me consolarás?

verses.KJV: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.WEB: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
verses.ASV: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque fiquei como um odre na fumaça, [porém] não me esqueci teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Porque estoy como el odre al humo; mas no he olvidado tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.WEB: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.ASV: How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quantos serão os dias de teu servo? Quando farás julgamento aos meus perseguidores?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cuántos son los días de tu siervo? ¿cuándo harás juicio contra los que me persiguen?

verses.KJV: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
verses.WEB: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
verses.ASV: The proud have digged pits for me, Who are not according to thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os arrogantes me cavaram covas, aqueles que não são conforme a tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Los soberbios me han cavado hoyos; mas no obran según tu ley.

verses.KJV: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.WEB: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
verses.ASV: All thy commandments are faithful: They persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os teus mandamentos são verdade; com mentiras me perseguem; ajuda-me.
verses.RVR09: Todos tus mandamientos son verdad: sin causa me persiguen; ayúdame.

verses.KJV: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.WEB: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
verses.ASV: They had almost consumed me upon earth; But I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estou quase que destruído por completo sobre a terra; porém eu não deixei teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Casi me han echado por tierra: mas yo no he dejado tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.WEB: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH
verses.ASV: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivifica-me conforme tua bondade, então guardarei o testemunho de tua boca.
verses.RVR09: Vivifícame conforme á tu misericordia; y guardaré los testimonios de tu boca.

verses.KJV: For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.WEB: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.
verses.ASV: For ever, O Jehovah, Thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Lâmede] :Para sempre, SENHOR, tua palavra permanece nos céus.
verses.RVR09: LAMED. Para siempre, oh Jehová, permanece tu palabra en los cielos.

verses.KJV: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.WEB: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
verses.ASV: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua fidelidade [dura] de geração em geração; tu firmaste a terra, e [assim] ela permanece.
verses.RVR09: Por generación y generación es tu verdad: tú afirmaste la tierra, y persevera.

verses.KJV: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
verses.WEB: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
verses.ASV: They abide this day according to thine ordinances; For all things are thy servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elas continuam por tuas ordens até hoje, porque todos são teus servos.
verses.RVR09: Por tu ordenación perseveran hasta hoy las cosas criadas; porque todas ellas te sirven.

verses.KJV: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.WEB: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.ASV: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se a tua lei não fosse meu prazer, eu já teria perecido em minha aflição.
verses.RVR09: Si tu ley no hubiese sido mis delicias, ya en mi aflicción hubiera perecido.

verses.KJV: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.WEB: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
verses.ASV: I will never forget thy precepts; For with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca esquecerei de teus mandamentos, porque tu me vivificaste por eles.
verses.RVR09: Nunca jamás me olvidaré de tus mandamientos; porque con ellos me has vivificado.

verses.KJV: I am thine, save me: for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.WEB: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.ASV: I am thine, save me; For I have sought thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou teu, salva-me, porque busquei teus preceitos.
verses.RVR09: Tuyo soy yo, guárdame; porque he buscado tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.WEB: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
verses.ASV: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me; [But] I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os perversos me esperaram, para me destruírem; [porém] eu dou atenção a teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Los impíos me han aguardado para destruirme: mas yo entenderé en tus testimonios.

verses.KJV: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.WEB: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM
verses.ASV: I have seen an end of all perfection; [But] thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.ALMEIDA: A toda perfeição eu vi fim; [mas] teu mandamento é extremamente grande.
verses.RVR09: A toda perfección he visto fin: ancho sobremanera es tu mandamiento.

verses.KJV: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.WEB: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
verses.ASV: Oh how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mem] :Ah, como eu amo a tua lei! O dia todo eu medito nela.
verses.RVR09: MEM ¡Cuánto amo yo tu ley! todo el día es ella mi meditación.

verses.KJV: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.WEB: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
verses.ASV: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; For they are ever with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela me faz mais sábio do que meus inimigos [por meio de] teus mandamentos, porque ela está sempre comigo.
verses.RVR09: Me has hecho más sabio que mis enemigos con tus mandamientos; porque me son eternos.

verses.KJV: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.WEB: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.ASV: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sou mais inteligente que todos os meus instrutores, porque medito em teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Más que todos mis enseñadores he entendido: porque tus testimonios son mi meditación.

verses.KJV: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.WEB: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
verses.ASV: I understand more than the aged, Because I have kept thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sou mais prudente que os anciãos, porque guardei teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Más que los viejos he entendido, porque he guardado tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.WEB: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
verses.ASV: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might observe thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afastei meus pés de todo mau caminho, para guardar tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: De todo mal camino contuve mis pies, para guardar tu palabra.

verses.KJV: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.WEB: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
verses.ASV: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances; For thou hast taught me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me desviei de teus juízos, porque tu me ensinaste.
verses.RVR09: No me aparté de tus juicios; porque tú me enseñaste.

verses.KJV: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.WEB: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
verses.ASV: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! [Yea, sweeter] than honey to my mouth!
verses.ALMEIDA: Como são doces tuas palavras ao meu paladar! Mais que o mel em minha boca.
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuán dulces son á mi paladar tus palabras! más que la miel á mi boca.

verses.KJV: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.WEB: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
verses.ASV: Through thy precepts I get understanding: Therefore I hate every false way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Obtenho conhecimento por meio de teus preceitos; por isso odeio todo caminho de mentira.
verses.RVR09: De tus mandamientos he adquirido inteligencia: por tanto he aborrecido todo camino de mentira.

verses.KJV: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.WEB: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
verses.ASV: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Nun] :Tua palavra é lâmpada para meus pés e luz para meu caminho.
verses.RVR09: NUN. Lámpara es á mis pies tu palabra, y lumbrera á mi camino.

verses.KJV: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.WEB: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
verses.ASV: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, That I will observe thy righteous ordinances.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu jurei, e [assim] cumprirei, de guardar os juízos de tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Juré y ratifiqué el guardar los juicios de tu justicia.

verses.KJV: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.
verses.WEB: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.
verses.ASV: I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu estou muito aflito, SENHOR; vivifica-me conforme a tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Afligido estoy en gran manera: oh Jehová, vivifícame conforme á tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.WEB: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.
verses.ASV: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me thine ordinances.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agrada-te das ofertas voluntárias de minha boca, SENHOR; e ensina-me teus juízos.
verses.RVR09: Ruégote, oh Jehová, te sean agradables los sacrificios voluntarios de mi boca; y enséñame tus juicios.

verses.KJV: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.WEB: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
verses.ASV: My soul is continually in my hand; Yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Continuamente arrisco minha alma, porém não me esqueço de tua lei.
verses.RVR09: De continuo está mi alma en mi mano: mas no me he olvidado de tu ley.

verses.KJV: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.WEB: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
verses.ASV: The wicked have laid a snare for me; Yet have I not gone astray from thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os perversos me armaram um laço de armadilha, mas não me desviei de teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Pusiéronme lazo los impíos: empero yo no me desvié de tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.WEB: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.ASV: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; For they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomei teus testemunhos por herança para sempre, pois eles são a alegria de meu coração.
verses.RVR09: Por heredad he tomado tus testimonios para siempre; porque son el gozo de mi corazón.

verses.KJV: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
verses.WEB: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
verses.ASV: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes For ever, even unto the end.
verses.ALMEIDA: Inclinei meu coração para praticar os teus testemunhos para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Mi corazón incliné á poner por obra tus estatutos de continuo, hasta el fin.

verses.KJV: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.WEB: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
verses.ASV: I hate them that are of a double mind; But thy law do I love.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Sâmeque] :Odeio os inconstantes, mas amo a tua lei.
verses.RVR09: SAMECH. Los pensamientos vanos aborrezco; mas amo tu ley.

verses.KJV: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.WEB: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
verses.ASV: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu és meu refúgio e meu escudo; eu espero em tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Mi escondedero y mi escudo eres tú: en tu palabra he esperado.

verses.KJV: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.WEB: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.ASV: Depart from me, ye evil-doers, That I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afastai-vos de mim, malfeitores, para que eu guarde os mandamentos de meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Apartaos de mí, malignos; pues yo guardaré los mandamientos de mi Dios.

verses.KJV: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.WEB: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.ASV: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live; And let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sustenta-me conforme a tua promessa, para que eu viva; e não me faças ser humilhado em minha esperança.
verses.RVR09: Susténtame conforme á tu palabra, y viviré: y no me avergüences de mi esperanza.

verses.KJV: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.WEB: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
verses.ASV: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe, And shall have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.ALMEIDA: Segura-me, e estarei protegido; então continuamente pensarei em teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Sostenme, y seré salvo; y deleitaréme siempre en tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.WEB: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
verses.ASV: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes; For their deceit is falsehood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu atropelas a todos que se desviam de teus estatutos; pois o engano deles é mentira.
verses.RVR09: Hollaste á todos los que se desvían de tus estatutos: porque mentira es su engaño.

verses.KJV: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.WEB: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
verses.ASV: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: Therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu tiras a todos os perversos da terra como [se fossem] lixo; por isso eu amo teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Como escorias hiciste consumir á todos los impíos de la tierra: por tanto yo he amado tus testimonios.

verses.KJV: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.WEB: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN
verses.ASV: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; And I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu corpo se arrepia de medo de ti; e temo os teus juízos.
verses.RVR09: Mi carne se ha extremecido por temor de ti; y de tus juicios tengo miedo.

verses.KJV: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.WEB: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
verses.ASV: I have done justice and righteousness: Leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Áin] :Eu fiz juízo e justiça; não me abandones com os meus opressores.
verses.RVR09: AIN. Juicio y justicia he hecho; no me dejes á mis opresores.

verses.KJV: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.WEB: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
verses.ASV: Be surety for thy servant for good: Let not the proud oppress me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sê tu a garantia do bem de teu servo; não me deixes ser oprimido pelos arrogantes.
verses.RVR09: Responde por tu siervo para bien: no me hagan violencia los soberbios.

verses.KJV: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.WEB: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
verses.ASV: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for thy righteous word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos desfaleceram [de esperar] por tua salvação, e pela palavra de tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Mis ojos desfallecieron por tu salud, y por el dicho de tu justicia.

verses.KJV: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.WEB: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
verses.ASV: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness, And teach me thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Age para com teu servo segundo tua bondade, e ensina-me teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Haz con tu siervo según tu misericordia, y enséñame tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.WEB: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
verses.ASV: I am thy servant; give me understanding, That I may know thy testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou teu servo. Dá-me entendimento; então conhecerei teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Tu siervo soy yo, dame entendimiento; para que sepa tus testimonios.

verses.KJV: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.WEB: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.
verses.ASV: It is time for Jehovah to work; [For] they have made void thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: É tempo do SENHOR agir, porque estão violando tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Tiempo es de hacer, oh Jehová; disipado han tu ley.

verses.KJV: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.WEB: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
verses.ASV: Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu amo teus mandamentos mais que o ouro, o mais fino ouro.
verses.RVR09: Por eso he amado tus mandamientos más que el oro, y más que oro muy puro.

verses.KJV: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.WEB: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE
verses.ASV: Therefore I esteem all [thy] precepts concerning all [things] to be right; [And] I hate every false way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso considero corretos todos os [teus] mandamentos quanto a tudo, e odeio todo caminho de falsidade.
verses.RVR09: Por eso todos los mandamientos de todas las cosas estimé rectos: aborrecí todo camino de mentira.

verses.KJV: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.WEB: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.ASV: Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Pê] :Maravilhosos são teus testemunhos, por isso minha alma os guarda.
verses.RVR09: PE. Maravillosos son tus testimonios: por tanto los ha guardado mi alma.

verses.KJV: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.WEB: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.ASV: The opening of thy words giveth light; It giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.ALMEIDA: A entrada de tuas palavras dá luz, dando entendimento aos simples.
verses.RVR09: El principio de tus palabras alumbra; hace entender á los simples.

verses.KJV: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.WEB: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
verses.ASV: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abri minha boca, e respirei; porque desejei teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Mi boca abrí y suspiré; porque deseaba tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.WEB: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
verses.ASV: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me, As thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha-me, e tem piedade de mim; conforme [teu] costume para com os que amam o teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Mírame, y ten misericordia de mí, como acostumbras con los que aman tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.WEB: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.ASV: Establish my footsteps in thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Firma meus passos em tua palavra, e que nenhuma perversidade me domine.
verses.RVR09: Ordena mis pasos con tu palabra; y ninguna iniquidad se enseñoree de mí.

verses.KJV: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.WEB: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
verses.ASV: Redeem me from the oppression of man: So will I observe thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Resgata-me da opressão dos homens; então guardarei teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Redímeme de la violencia de los hombres; y guardaré tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.WEB: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
verses.ASV: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Brilha teu rosto sobre teu servo, e ensina-me teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Haz que tu rostro resplandezca sobre tu siervo; y enséñame tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.WEB: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE
verses.ASV: Streams of water run down mine eyes, Because they observe not thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ribeiros d'água descem de meus olhos, porque eles não guardam tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Ríos de agua descendieron de mis ojos, porque no guardaban tu ley.

verses.KJV: Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.WEB: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.
verses.ASV: Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, And upright are thy judgments.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Tsadê] :Tu és justo, SENHOR; e corretos são teus juízos.
verses.RVR09: TZADDI. Justo eres tú, oh Jehová, y rectos tus juicios.

verses.KJV: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.WEB: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
verses.ASV: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness And very faithfulness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu ensinaste teus testemunhos justos e muito fiéis.
verses.RVR09: Tus testimonios, que has recomendado, son rectos y muy fieles.

verses.KJV: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.WEB: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
verses.ASV: My zeal hath consumed me, Because mine adversaries have forgotten thy words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu zelo me consumiu, porque meus adversários se esqueceram de tuas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Mi celo me ha consumido; porque mis enemigos se olvidaron de tus palabras.

verses.KJV: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.WEB: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
verses.ASV: Thy word is very pure; Therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Refinada é a tua palavra, e teu servo a ama.
verses.RVR09: Sumamente acendrada es tu palabra; y la ama tu siervo.

verses.KJV: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.WEB: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
verses.ASV: I am small and despised; [Yet] do I not forget thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou pequeno e desprezado; [porém] não me esqueço de teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Pequeño soy yo y desechado; mas no me he olvidado de tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
verses.WEB: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
verses.ASV: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And thy law is truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua justiça é justa para sempre, e tua lei é verdade.
verses.RVR09: Tu justicia es justicia eterna, y tu ley la verdad.

verses.KJV: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
verses.WEB: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
verses.ASV: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; [Yet] thy commandments are my delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aperto e angústia me encontraram; [ainda assim] teus mandamentos são meus prazeres.
verses.RVR09: Aflicción y angustia me hallaron: mas tus mandamientos fueron mis deleites.

verses.KJV: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.WEB: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH
verses.ASV: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever: Give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: A justiça de teus testemunhos [dura] para sempre; dá-me entendimento, e então viverei.
verses.RVR09: Justicia eterna son tus testimonios; dame entendimiento, y viviré.

verses.KJV: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.WEB: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.
verses.ASV: I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Cofe] :Clamei com todo o [meu] coração; responde-me, SENHOR; guardarei teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: COPH. Clamé con todo mi corazón; respóndeme, Jehová, y guardaré tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.WEB: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
verses.ASV: I have called unto thee; save me, And I shall observe thy testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Clamei a ti; salva-me, e então guardarei os teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: A ti clamé; sálvame, y guardaré tus testimonios.

verses.KJV: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.WEB: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
verses.ASV: I anticipated the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me antecedi ao amanhecer, e gritei; [e] mantive esperança em tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Anticipéme al alba, y clamé: esperé en tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.WEB: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
verses.ASV: Mine eyes anticipated the night-watches, That I might meditate on thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos antecederam as vigílias da noite, para meditar em tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Previnieron mis ojos las vigilias de la noche, para meditar en tus dichos.

verses.KJV: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.WEB: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.
verses.ASV: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thine ordinances.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve minha voz, segundo tua bondade, SENHOR; vivifica-me conforme teu juízo.
verses.RVR09: Oye mi voz conforme á tu misericordia; oh Jehová, vivifícame conforme á tu juicio.

verses.KJV: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.WEB: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
verses.ASV: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; They are far from thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aproximam-se [de mim] os que praticam maldade; eles estão longe de tua lei.
verses.RVR09: Acercáronse á la maldad los que me persiguen; alejáronse de tu ley.

verses.KJV: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.
verses.WEB: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.
verses.ASV: Thou art nigh, O Jehovah; And all thy commandments are truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém] tu, SENHOR, estás perto [de mim] ; e todos os teus mandamentos são verdade.
verses.RVR09: Cercano estás tú, oh Jehová; y todos tus mandamientos son verdad.

verses.KJV: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.WEB: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH
verses.ASV: Of old have I known from thy testimonies, That thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde antigamente eu soube de teus testemunhos, que tu os fundaste para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Ya ha mucho que he entendido de tus mandamientos, que para siempre los fundaste.

verses.KJV: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.WEB: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
verses.ASV: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me; For I do not forget thy law.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Rexe] :Olha a minha aflição, e livra-me [dela] ; pois não me esqueci de tua lei.
verses.RVR09: RESH. Mira mi aflicción, y líbrame; porque de tu ley no me he olvidado.

verses.KJV: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.WEB: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
verses.ASV: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: Quicken me according to thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Defende minha causa, e resgata-me; vivifica-me conforme tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Aboga mi causa, y redímeme: vivifícame con tu dicho.

verses.KJV: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.WEB: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
verses.ASV: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: A salvação está longe dos perversos, porque eles não buscam teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Lejos está de los impíos la salud; porque no buscan tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.WEB: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.
verses.ASV: Great are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah: Quicken me according to thine ordinances.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitas são tuas misericórdias, SENHOR; vivifica-me conforme teus juízos.
verses.RVR09: Muchas son tus misericordias, oh Jehová: vivifícame conforme á tus juicios.

verses.KJV: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.WEB: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
verses.ASV: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; [Yet] have I not swerved from thy testimonies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos são meus perseguidores e meus adversários; [porém] eu não me desvio de teus testemunhos.
verses.RVR09: Muchos son mis perseguidores y mis enemigos; mas de tus testimonios no me he apartado.

verses.KJV: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.WEB: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
verses.ASV: I beheld the treacherous, and was grieved, Because they observe not thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vi aos enganadores e os detestei, porque eles não guardam tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Veía á los prevaricadores, y carcomíame; porque no guardaban tus palabras.

verses.KJV: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.WEB: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.
verses.ASV: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vê, SENHOR, que eu amo teus mandamentos; vivifica-me conforme a tua bondade.
verses.RVR09: Mira, oh Jehová, que amo tus mandamientos: vivifícame conforme á tu misericordia.

verses.KJV: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN
verses.ASV: The sum of thy word is truth; And every one of thy righteous ordinances [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: O princípio de tua palavra é fiel, e o juízo de tua justiça [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El principio de tu palabra es verdad; y eterno es todo juicio de tu justicia.

verses.KJV: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.WEB: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
verses.ASV: Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of thy words.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Xin] :Príncipes me perseguiram sem causa, mas meu coração temeu a tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: SIN. Príncipes me han perseguido sin causa; mas mi corazón tuvo temor de tus palabras.

verses.KJV: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.WEB: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
verses.ASV: I rejoice at thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me alegro em tua palavra, tal como alguém que encontra um grande tesouro.
verses.RVR09: Gózome yo en tu palabra, como el que halla muchos despojos.

verses.KJV: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.WEB: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
verses.ASV: I hate and abhor falsehood; [But] thy law do I love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Odeio e abomino a falsidade; [mas] amo a tua lei.
verses.RVR09: La mentira aborrezco y abomino: tu ley amo.

verses.KJV: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.WEB: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.ASV: Seven times a day do I praise thee, Because of thy righteous ordinances.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvo a ti sete vezes ao dia, por causa dos juízos de tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Siete veces al día te alabo sobre los juicios de tu justicia.

verses.KJV: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.WEB: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
verses.ASV: Great peace have they that love thy law; And they have no occasion of stumbling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muita paz têm aqueles que amam a tua lei; e para eles não há tropeço.
verses.RVR09: Mucha paz tienen los que aman tu ley; y no hay para ellos tropiezo.

verses.KJV: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.WEB: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.
verses.ASV: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, And have done thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Espero por tua salvação, SENHOR; e pratico teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Tu salud he esperado, oh Jehová; y tus mandamientos he puesto por obra.

verses.KJV: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.WEB: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
verses.ASV: My soul hath observed thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma guarda teus testemunhos, e eu os amo muito.
verses.RVR09: Mi alma ha guardado tus testimonios, y helos amado en gran manera.

verses.KJV: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.WEB: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV
verses.ASV: I have observed thy precepts and thy testimonies; For all my ways are before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu guardo teus preceitos e teus testemunhos, porque todos os meus caminhos estão diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Guardado he tus mandamientos y tus testimonios; porque todos mis caminos están delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.WEB: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.
verses.ASV: Let my cry come near before thee, O Jehovah: Give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Tau] :Chegue meu clamor perante teu rosto, SENHOR; dá-me entendimento conforme tua palavra.
verses.RVR09: TAU. Acérquese mi clamor delante de ti, oh Jehová: dame entendimiento conforme á tu palabra.

verses.KJV: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.WEB: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
verses.ASV: Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Venha minha súplica diante de ti; livra-me conforme tua promessa.
verses.RVR09: Venga mi oración delante de ti: líbrame conforme á tu dicho.

verses.KJV: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.WEB: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
verses.ASV: Let my lips utter praise; For thou teachest me thy statutes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus lábios falarão muitos louvores, pois tu me ensinas teus estatutos.
verses.RVR09: Mis labios rebosarán alabanza, cuando me enseñares tus estatutos.

verses.KJV: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.WEB: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
verses.ASV: Let my tongue sing of thy word; For all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha língua falará de tua palavra, porque todos os teus mandamentos são justiça.
verses.RVR09: Hablará mi lengua tus dichos; porque todos tus mandamientos son justicia.

verses.KJV: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.WEB: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.ASV: Let thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que tua mão me socorra, porque escolhi [seguir] teus preceitos.
verses.RVR09: Sea tu mano en mi socorro; porque tus mandamientos he escogido.

verses.KJV: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.
verses.WEB: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.
verses.ASV: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah; And thy law is my delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desejo tua salvação, SENHOR; e tua lei é o meu prazer.
verses.RVR09: Deseado he tu salud, oh Jehová; y tu ley es mi delicia.

verses.KJV: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.WEB: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
verses.ASV: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; And let thine ordinances help me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que minha alma viva e louve a ti; e que teus juízos me socorram.
verses.RVR09: Viva mi alma y alábete; y tus juicios me ayuden.

verses.KJV: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.WEB: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
verses.ASV: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho andado sem rumo, como uma ovelha perdida; busca a teu servo, pois eu não me esqueci de teus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: Yo anduve errante como oveja extraviada; busca á tu siervo; porque no me he olvidado de tus mandamientos.

verses.KJV: In my distress I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. In my distress I cried unto Jehovah, And he answered me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Em minha angústia clamei ao SENHOR, e ele me respondeu.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. A JEHOVÁ llamé estando en angustia, y él me respondió.

verses.KJV: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.WEB: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
verses.ASV: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips, [And] from a deceitful tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, livra minha alma dos lábios mentirosos, da língua enganadora.
verses.RVR09: Libra mi alma, oh Jehová, de labio mentiroso, de la lengua fraudulenta.

verses.KJV: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.WEB: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
verses.ASV: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que ele te dará, e o que ele fará contigo, ó língua enganadora?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué te dará, ó qué te aprovechará, oh lengua engañosa?

verses.KJV: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.WEB: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.ASV: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of juniper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Flechas afiadas de um guerreiro, com brasas de zimbro.
verses.RVR09: Agudas saetas de valiente, con brasas de enebro.

verses.KJV: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.WEB: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.ASV: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de mim, que peregrino em Meseque, [e] habito nas tendas de Quedar!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de mí, que peregrino en Mesech, y habito entre las tiendas de Kedar!

verses.KJV: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.WEB: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
verses.ASV: My soul hath long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma morou [tempo] demais com os que odeiam a paz.
verses.RVR09: Mucho se detiene mi alma con los que aborrecen la paz.

verses.KJV: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.WEB: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.ASV: I am [for] peace: But when I speak, they are for war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou da paz; mas quando falo, eles [entram] em guerra.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy pacífico: mas ellos, así que hablo, me hacen guerra.

verses.KJV: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Levanto meus olhos aos montes. De onde virá meu socorro?
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. ALZARÉ mis ojos á los montes, de donde vendrá mi socorro.

verses.KJV: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.
verses.WEB: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.ASV: My help [cometh] from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu socorro [vem] do SENHOR, que fez os céus e a terra.
verses.RVR09: Mi socorro viene de Jehová, que hizo los cielos y la tierra.

verses.KJV: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.WEB: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.ASV: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não deixará o teu pé se abalar, nem cochilará o teu guardião.
verses.RVR09: No dará tu pie al resbaladero; ni se dormirá el que te guarda.

verses.KJV: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.WEB: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.ASV: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que não cochilará nem dormirá o Guardião de Israel.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, no se adormecerá ni dormirá el que guarda á Israel.

verses.KJV: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.WEB: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é o teu guardião; o SENHOR é a sombra à tua direita.
verses.RVR09: Jehová es tu guardador: Jehová es tu sombra á tu mano derecha.

verses.KJV: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.WEB: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.ASV: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sol não te ferirá durante o dia, nem a lua durante a noite.
verses.RVR09: El sol no te fatigará de día, ni la luna de noche.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.WEB: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te guardará de todo mal; ele guardará a tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Jehová te guardará de todo mal: él guardará tu alma.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.WEB: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR guardará tua saída e tua entrada, desde agora e para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Jehová guardará tu salida y tu entrada, desde ahora y para siempre.

verses.KJV: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents; of David. I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus, de Davi: Alegro-me com os que me dizem: Vamos à casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual: de David. YO me alegré con los que me decían: A la casa de Jehová iremos.

verses.KJV: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
verses.ASV: Our feet are standing Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos pés estão [adentro] de tuas portas, ó Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Nuestros pies estuvieron en tus puertas, oh Jerusalem;

verses.KJV: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.WEB: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
verses.ASV: Jerusalem, that art builded As a city that is compact together;
verses.ALMEIDA: Jerusalém está edificada como uma cidade bem unida;
verses.RVR09: Jerusalem, que se ha edificado como una ciudad que está bien unida entre sí.

verses.KJV: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
verses.ASV: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, [For] an ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para onde as tribos sobem, as tribos do SENHOR, como testemunho de Israel, para agradecerem ao nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y allá subieron las tribus, las tribus de JAH, conforme al testimonio dado á Israel, para alabar el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.WEB: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
verses.ASV: For there are set thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ali estão as cadeiras do julgamento; as cadeiras da casa de Davi.
verses.RVR09: Porque allá están las sillas del juicio, las sillas de la casa de David.

verses.KJV: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.WEB: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
verses.ASV: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Orai pela paz de Jerusalém; prosperem os que te amam.
verses.RVR09: Pedid la paz de Jerusalem: sean prosperados los que te aman.

verses.KJV: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.WEB: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.ASV: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.ALMEIDA: Paz haja em teus muros, e prosperidade em tuas fortalezas.
verses.RVR09: Haya paz en tu antemuro, y descanso en tus palacios.

verses.KJV: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.WEB: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
verses.ASV: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por meus irmãos e amigos, assim falarei: Paz haja em ti.
verses.RVR09: Por amor de mis hermanos y mis compañeros hablaré ahora paz de ti.

verses.KJV: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.
verses.WEB: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
verses.ASV: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela Casa do SENHOR nosso Deus, buscarei o bem para ti.
verses.RVR09: A causa de la casa de Jehová nuestro Dios, buscaré bien para ti.

verses.KJV: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Levanto meus olhos a ti, que moras nos céus.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. A TI que habitas en los cielos, alcé mis ojos.

verses.KJV: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.WEB: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
verses.ASV: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes [look] unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que, assim como os olhos dos servos [olham] para a mão de seus senhores, e os olhos da serva para a mão de sua senhora, assim também nossos olhos [olharão] para o SENHOR nosso Deus, até que ele tenha piedade de nós.
verses.RVR09: He aquí como los ojos de los siervos miran á la mano de sus señores, y como los ojos de la sierva á la mano de su señora; así nuestros ojos miran á Jehová nuestro Dios, hasta que haya misericordia de nosotros.

verses.KJV: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.WEB: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
verses.ASV: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tem piedade de nós, SENHOR! Tem piedade de nós; pois temos sido humilhados em excesso.
verses.RVR09: Ten misericordia de nosotros, oh Jehová, ten misericordia de nosotros; porque estamos muy hartos de menosprecio.

verses.KJV: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.WEB: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
verses.ASV: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossa alma está cheia da zombaria dos insolentes, e da humilhação dos arrogantes.
verses.RVR09: Muy harta está nuestra alma del escarnio de los holgados, y del menosprecio de los soberbios.

verses.KJV: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents; of David. If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus, de Davi: Diga, Israel: O que [seria de nós] se o SENHOR não estivesse conosco?
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual: de David. A NO haber estado Jehová por nosotros, diga ahora Israel;

verses.KJV: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.WEB: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
verses.ASV: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o SENHOR não estivesse conosco, quando os homens se levantaram contra nós,
verses.RVR09: A no haber estado Jehová por nosotros, cuando se levantaron contra nosotros los hombres,

verses.KJV: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.WEB: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
verses.ASV: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles teriam nos devorado vivos, quando o furor deles se acendeu contra nós.
verses.RVR09: Vivos nos habrían entonces tragado, cuando se encendió su furor en nosotros.

verses.KJV: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.WEB: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
verses.ASV: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;
verses.ALMEIDA: As águas teriam nos coberto, [e] a corrente de águas teria passado por sobre nossas almas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces nos habrían inundado las aguas; sobre nuestra alma hubiera pasado el torrente:

verses.KJV: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.WEB: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
verses.ASV: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Águas violentas teriam passado por sobre nossas almas.
verses.RVR09: Hubieran entonces pasado sobre nuestra alma las aguas soberbias.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito seja o SENHOR, que não nos entregou como presa aos dentes deles.
verses.RVR09: Bendito Jehová, que no nos dió por presa á sus dientes.

verses.KJV: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.WEB: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.ASV: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossa alma escapou como um pássaro da armadilha dos caçadores; a cadeia se quebrou, e nós escapamos.
verses.RVR09: Nuestra alma escapó cual ave del lazo de los cazadores: quebróse el lazo, y escapamos nosotros.

verses.KJV: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.WEB: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
verses.ASV: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nosso socorro está no nome do SENHOR, que fez o céu e a terra.
verses.RVR09: Nuestro socorro es en el nombre de Jehová, que hizo el cielo y la tierra.

verses.KJV: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. They that trust in Jehovah Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que confiam no SENHOR são como o monte de Sião, que não se abala, [e] permanece para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. LOS que confían en Jehová son como el monte de Sión, que no deslizará: estará para siempre.

verses.KJV: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.WEB: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
verses.ASV: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como montanhas estão ao redor de Jerusalém, assim também o SENHOR está ao redor de seu povo, desde agora para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Como Jerusalem tiene montes alrededor de ella, así Jehová alrededor de su pueblo desde ahora y para siempre.

verses.KJV: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.WEB: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
verses.ASV: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o cetro da maldade não repousará sobre a sorte dos justos, para que os justos não estendam suas mãos à perversidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque no reposará la vara de la impiedad sobre la suerte de los justos; porque no extiendan los justos sus manos á la iniquidad.

verses.KJV: Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.WEB: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
verses.ASV: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: SENHOR, trata bem aos bons, e aos corretos em seus corações.
verses.RVR09: Haz bien, oh Jehová, á los buenos, y á los que son rectos en sus corazones.

verses.KJV: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
verses.WEB: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
verses.ASV: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aos que se dirigem a seus caminhos tortuosos, o SENHOR os mandará embora junto com os que praticam perversidade. Paz [seja] sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: Mas á los que se apartan tras sus perversidades, Jehová los llevará con los que obran iniquidad: y paz sea sobre Israel.

verses.KJV: When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Quando o SENHOR restaurou Sião de seu infortúnio, estivemos como os que sonham.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. CUANDO Jehová hiciere tornar la cautividad de Sión, seremos como los que sueñan.

verses.KJV: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.
verses.WEB: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
verses.ASV: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então nossa boca se encheu de riso, e nossa língua de alegria; então diziam entre as nações: O SENHOR fez grandes coisas para estes.
verses.RVR09: Entonces nuestra boca se henchirá de risa, y nuestra lengua de alabanza; entonces dirán entre las gentes: Grandes cosas ha hecho Jehová con éstos.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.WEB: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath done great things for us, [Whereof] we are glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Grandes coisas o SENHOR fez para nós; [por isso] estamos alegres.
verses.RVR09: Grandes cosas ha hecho Jehová con nosotros; estaremos alegres.

verses.KJV: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as the streams in the south.
verses.WEB: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
verses.ASV: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.
verses.ALMEIDA: Restaura-nos, ó SENHOR, como as correntes de águas no sul.
verses.RVR09: Haz volver nuestra cautividad, oh Jehová, como los arroyos en el austro.

verses.KJV: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.WEB: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
verses.ASV: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que semeiam em lágrimas colherão com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Los que sembraron con lágrimas, con regocijo segarán.

verses.KJV: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.WEB: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
verses.ASV: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves [with him].
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que sai chorando com semente para semear voltará com alegria, trazendo sua colheita.
verses.RVR09: Irá andando y llorando el que lleva la preciosa simiente; mas volverá á venir con regocijo, trayendo sus gavillas.

verses.KJV: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents; of Solomon. Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus, de Salomão: Se o SENHOR não estiver edificando a casa, em vão trabalham nela seus construtores; se o SENHOR não estiver guardando a cidade, em vão o guarda vigia.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual: para Salomón. SI Jehová no edificare la casa, en vano trabajan los que la edifican: si Jehová no guardare la ciudad, en vano vela la guarda.

verses.KJV: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
verses.WEB: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
verses.ASV: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; [For] so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Inutilmente levantais de madrugada [e] descansais tarde, para comerdes o pão de dores; [porque] assim ele dá sono a quem ele ama.
verses.RVR09: Por demás os es el madrugar á levantaros, el veniros tarde á reposar, el comer pan de dolores: pues que á su amado dará Dios el sueño.

verses.KJV: Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.WEB: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.ASV: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; [And] the fruit of the womb is [his] reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que os filhos são um presente do SENHOR; o fruto do ventre é uma recompensa.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, heredad de Jehová son los hijos: cosa de estima el fruto del vientre.

verses.KJV: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
verses.WEB: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
verses.ASV: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como flechas na mão do guerreiro, assim são os filhos da juventude.
verses.RVR09: Como saetas en mano del valiente, así son los hijos habidos en la juventud.

verses.KJV: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
verses.WEB: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.ASV: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado é o homem que enche deles seu porta-flechas; eles não serão envergonhados, quando falarem com os inimigos à porta.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el hombre que hinchió su aljaba de ellos: no será avergonzado cuando hablare con los enemigos en la puerta.

verses.KJV: Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Bem-aventurado todo aquele que teme ao SENHOR, [e] anda em seus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. BIENAVENTURADO todo aquel que teme á Jehová, que anda en sus caminos.

verses.KJV: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.WEB: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
verses.ASV: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque comerás do trabalho de tuas mãos; tu serás bem-aventurado, e bem lhe [sucederá] .
verses.RVR09: Cuando comieres el trabajo de tus manos, bienaventurado tú, y tendrás bien.

verses.KJV: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.WEB: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
verses.ASV: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua mulher será como a videira frutífera, ao lado de tua casa; [e] teus filhos como plantas de oliveira ao redor de tua mesa.
verses.RVR09: Tu mujer será como parra que lleva fruto á los lados de tu casa; tus hijos como plantas de olivas alrededor de tu mesa.

verses.KJV: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.
verses.WEB: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
verses.ASV: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que assim é bendito o homem que teme ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que así será bendito el hombre que teme á Jehová.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.WEB: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.ASV: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te abençoará desde Sião, e tu verás o bem de Jerusalém todos os dias de tua vida.
verses.RVR09: Bendígate Jehová desde Sión, y veas el bien de Jerusalem todos los días de tu vida.

verses.KJV: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
verses.WEB: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.ASV: Yea, see thou thy children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E verás os filhos de teus filhos, [e] a paz sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y veas los hijos de tus hijos, y la paz sobre Israel.

verses.KJV: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up, Let Israel now say,
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Diga Israel: Desde minha juventude muitas vezes me afligiram.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. MUCHO me han angustiado desde mi juventud, puede decir ahora Israel;

verses.KJV: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.WEB: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.ASV: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde minha juventude, muitas vezes me afligiram, porém não prevaleceram contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Mucho me han angustiado desde mi juventud; mas no prevalecieron contra mí.

verses.KJV: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.WEB: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
verses.ASV: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lavradores lavraram sobre minhas costas, fizeram compridos os seus sulcos.
verses.RVR09: Sobre mis espaldas araron los aradores: hicieron largos surcos.

verses.KJV: The Lord is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.WEB: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é justo; ele cortou as cordas dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová es justo; cortó las coyundas de los impíos.

verses.KJV: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.WEB: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
verses.ASV: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam envergonhados, e voltem para trás todos os que odeiam a Sião.
verses.RVR09: Serán avergonzados y vueltos atrás todos los que aborrecen á Sión.

verses.KJV: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.WEB: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
verses.ASV: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it groweth up;
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam como a erva dos telhados, que se seca antes que cresça.
verses.RVR09: Serán como la hierba de los tejados, que se seca antes que crezca:

verses.KJV: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.WEB: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
verses.ASV: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves, his bosom:
verses.ALMEIDA: Com que o ceifeiro não enche sua mão, nem o braço daquele que amarra os molhos.
verses.RVR09: De la cual no hinchió segador su mano, ni sus brazos el que hace gavillas.

verses.KJV: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
verses.ASV: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; We bless you in the name of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem também os que passam, dizem: A bênção do SENHOR seja sobre vós; nós vos bendizemos no nome do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ni dijeron los que pasaban: Bendición de Jehová sea sobre vosotros; os bendecimos en el nombre de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Das profundezas clamo a ti, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. DE los profundos, oh Jehová, á ti clamo.

verses.KJV: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.WEB: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
verses.ASV: Lord, hear my voice: Let thine ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, Senhor, a minha voz; sejam teus ouvidos atentos à voz de minhas súplicas.
verses.RVR09: Señor, oye mi voz; estén atentos tus oídos á la voz de mi súplica.

verses.KJV: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.WEB: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
verses.ASV: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tu, SENHOR, considerares todas as perversidades, quem resistirá, Senhor?
verses.RVR09: JAH, si mirares á los pecados, ¿quién, oh Señor, podrá mantenerse?

verses.KJV: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.WEB: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
verses.ASV: But there is forgiveness with thee, That thou mayest be feared.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas contigo está o perdão, para que tu sejas temido.
verses.RVR09: Empero hay perdón cerca de ti, para que seas temido.

verses.KJV: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.WEB: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
verses.ASV: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mantenho esperança no SENHOR, a minha alma espera; e persisto em sua palavra.
verses.RVR09: Esperé yo á Jehová, esperó mi alma; en su palabra he esperado.

verses.KJV: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.WEB: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.ASV: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord More than watchmen [wait] for the morning; [Yea, more than] watchmen for the morning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma [espera ansiosamente] pelo Senhor, mais que os guardas [esperam] pela manhã, [mais] que os vigilantes pelo alvorecer.
verses.RVR09: Mi alma espera á Jehová más que los centinelas á la mañana, más que los vigilantes á la mañana.

verses.KJV: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.WEB: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.
verses.ASV: O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.ALMEIDA: Espere, Israel, pelo SENHOR; porque com o SENHOR há bondade, e com ele muito resgate.
verses.RVR09: Espere Israel á Jehová; porque en Jehová hay misericordia, y abundante redención con él.

verses.KJV: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.WEB: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
verses.ASV: And he will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele resgatará Israel de todas as suas perversidades.
