verses.RVR09: Y él redimirá á Israel de todos sus pecados.

verses.KJV: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents; of David. Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in great matters, Or in things too wonderful for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus, de Davi: SENHOR, meu coração não se exaltou, nem meus olhos se levantaram; nem andei em grandezas, nem em coisas maravilhosas para mim.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual: de David. JEHOVÁ, no se ha envanecido mi corazón, ni mis ojos se enaltecieron; ni anduve en grandezas, ni en cosas para mí demasiado sublimes.

verses.KJV: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.WEB: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.ASV: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother, Like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao invés disso, eu me sosseguei e calei minha alma, tal como uma criança com sua mãe; como um bebê está minha alma comigo.
verses.RVR09: En verdad que me he comportado y he acallado mi alma, como un niño destetado de su madre: como un niño destetado está mi alma.

verses.KJV: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.
verses.WEB: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.ASV: O Israel, hope in Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Israel, espere no SENHOR, desde agora para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Espera, oh Israel, en Jehová desde ahora y para siempre.

verses.KJV: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction,
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. Jehovah, remember for David All his affliction;
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Lembra-te, SENHOR, de Davi, [e] de todas as aflições dele.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. ACUÉRDATE, oh Jehová, de David, y de toda su aflicción;

verses.KJV: How he sware unto the Lord, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
verses.WEB: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.ASV: How he sware unto Jehovah, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele, que jurou ao SENHOR, [e] fez um voto ao Poderoso de Jacó,
verses.RVR09: Que juró él á Jehová, prometió al Fuerte de Jacob:

verses.KJV: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.WEB: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.ASV: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;
verses.ALMEIDA: [dizendo] : Não entrarei na tenda de minha casa, nem subirei no leito de minha cama;
verses.RVR09: No entraré en la morada de mi casa, ni subiré sobre el lecho de mi estrado;

verses.KJV: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.WEB: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.ASV: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não darei sono aos meus olhos, [nem] cochilo às minhas pálpebras;
verses.RVR09: No daré sueño á mis ojos, ni á mis párpados adormecimiento,

verses.KJV: Until I find out a place for the Lord, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
verses.WEB: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
verses.ASV: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto eu não achar um lugar para o SENHOR, moradas para o Poderoso de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que halle lugar para Jehová, moradas para el Fuerte de Jacob.

verses.KJV: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.WEB: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
verses.ASV: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah: We found it in the field of the wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que ouvimos dela em Efrata, e [a] achamos nos campos de Jaar.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, en Ephrata oímos de ella: hallámosla en los campos del bosque.

verses.KJV: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.WEB: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”
verses.ASV: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entraremos em suas moradas, [e] nos prostraremos perante o escabelo de seus pés.
verses.RVR09: Entraremos en sus tiendas; encorvarnos hemos al estrado de sus pies.

verses.KJV: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.WEB: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
verses.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, SENHOR, a teu repouso; tu e a arca de teu poder.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, oh Jehová, á tu reposo; tú y el arca de tu fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.WEB: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
verses.ASV: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que teus sacerdotes se vistam de justiça, e teus santos gritem de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Tus sacerdotes se vistan de justicia, y regocíjense tus santos.

verses.KJV: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.WEB: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
verses.ASV: For thy servant David’s sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa de Davi teu servo, não rejeites o rosto de teu ungido.
verses.RVR09: Por amor de David tu siervo no vuelvas de tu ungido el rostro.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.WEB: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR jurou a Davi [com] fidelidade; dela não se desviará. [Ele disse] : Do fruto do teu ventre porei sobre o teu trono.
verses.RVR09: En verdad juró Jehová á David, no se apartará de ellos: Del fruto de tu vientre pondré sobre tu trono.

verses.KJV: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.WEB: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
verses.ASV: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se teus filhos guardarem meu pacto e meus testemunhos que eu lhes ensinar, também seus filhos se sentarão sobre teu trono para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Si tus hijos guardaren mi alianza, y mi testimonio que yo les enseñaré, sus hijos también se sentarán sobre tu trono para siempre.

verses.KJV: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.WEB: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR escolheu a Sião, desejou-a para sua habitação,
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová ha elegido á Sión; deseóla por habitación para sí.

verses.KJV: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.WEB: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
verses.ASV: This is my resting-place for ever: Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dizendo] : Este é o meu repouso para sempre; aqui habitarei, pois assim desejei.
verses.RVR09: Este es mi reposo para siempre: aquí habitaré, porque la he deseado.

verses.KJV: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.WEB: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.ASV: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abençoarei seu sustento abundantemente, [e] fartarei seus necessitados de pão.
verses.RVR09: A su mantenimiento daré bendición: sus pobres saciaré de pan.

verses.KJV: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.WEB: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
verses.ASV: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a seus sacerdotes vestirei de salvação; e seus santos gritarão de alegria abundantemente.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo vestiré á sus sacerdotes de salud, y sus santos darán voces de júbilo.

verses.KJV: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.WEB: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
verses.ASV: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali farei brotar o poder de Davi; e preparei uma lâmpada para o meu ungido.
verses.RVR09: Allí haré reverdecer el cuerno de David: he prevenido lámpara á mi ungido.

verses.KJV: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.WEB: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
verses.ASV: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.ALMEIDA: A seus inimigos vestirei de vergonha; mas sobre ele florescerá sua coroa.
verses.RVR09: A sus enemigos vestiré de confusión: mas sobre él florecerá su corona.

verses.KJV: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus, de Davi: Vede como é bom e agradável que irmãos convivam em união!
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual: de David. ¡MIRAD cuán bueno y cuán delicioso es habitar los hermanos igualmente en uno!

verses.KJV: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.WEB: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
verses.ASV: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron’s beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;
verses.ALMEIDA: É como o óleo precioso sobre a cabeça, que desce pela barba, a barba de Arão; que desce pelas bordas de suas roupas.
verses.RVR09: Es como el buen óleo sobre la cabeza, el cual desciende sobre la barba, la barba de Aarón, y que baja hasta el borde de sus vestiduras;

verses.KJV: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.WEB: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
verses.ASV: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: É como o orvalho de Hermom, que desce sobre os montes de Sião; porque ali o SENHOR ordenou a bênção [e] a vida para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Como el rocío de Hermón, que desciende sobre los montes de Sión: porque allí envía Jehová bendición, y vida eterna.

verses.KJV: Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord, which by night stand in the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!
verses.ASV: A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico dos degraus: Bendizei, pois, ao SENHOR, todos vós servos do SENHOR, que prestais serviço à casa do SENHOR durante as noites.
verses.RVR09: Cántico gradual. MIRAD, bendecid á Jehová, vosotros todos los siervos de Jehová, los que en la casa de Jehová estáis por las noches.

verses.KJV: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.
verses.WEB: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai vossas mãos ao Santuário, e bendizei ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Alzad vuestras manos al santuario, y bendecid á Jehová.

verses.KJV: The Lord that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.WEB: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
verses.ASV: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que o SENHOR, o criador do céu e da terra, te abençoe desde Sião.
verses.RVR09: Bendígate Jehová desde Sión, el cual ha hecho los cielos y la tierra.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise [him], O ye servants of Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Louvai o nome do SENHOR; louvai [-o] vós, servos do SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Aleluya. ALABAD el nombre de Jehová; alabadle, siervos de Jehová;

verses.KJV: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.WEB: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
verses.ASV: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que prestais serviço na Casa do SENHOR, nos pátios da Casa do nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Los que estáis en la casa de Jehová, en los atrios de la casa de nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good: Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai ao SENHOR, porque o SENHOR é bom; cantai louvores ao seu nome, porque é agradável;
verses.RVR09: Alabad á JAH, porque es bueno Jehová: cantad salmos á su nombre, porque es suave.

verses.KJV: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
verses.WEB: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, [And] Israel for his own possession.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR escolheu para si a Jacó, a Israel como propriedade sua;
verses.RVR09: Porque JAH ha escogido á Jacob para sí, á Israel por posesión suya.

verses.KJV: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.WEB: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.ASV: For I know that Jehovah is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sei que o SENHOR é grande, e nosso Senhor está acima de todos os deuses.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo se que Jehová es grande, y el Señor nuestro, mayor que todos los dioses.

verses.KJV: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.WEB: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
verses.ASV: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR faz tudo o que quer, nos céus, na terra, nos mares, e [em] todos os abismos.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que quiso Jehová, ha hecho en los cielos y en la tierra, en las mares y en todos los abismos.

verses.KJV: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.WEB: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.ASV: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; Who maketh lightnings for the rain; Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele faz as nuvens subirem desde os confins da terra, faz os relâmpagos com a chuva; ele produz os ventos de seus tesouros.
verses.RVR09: El hace subir las nubes del cabo de la tierra; él hizo los relámpagos para la lluvia; él saca los vientos de sus tesoros.

verses.KJV: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
verses.WEB: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
verses.ASV: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele feriu os primogênitos do Egito, desde os homens até os animais.
verses.RVR09: El es el que hirió los primogénitos de Egipto, desde el hombre hasta la bestia.

verses.KJV: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.WEB: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
verses.ASV: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele enviou sinais e prodígios no meio de ti, Egito; contra Faraó, e contra todos os seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Envió señales y prodigios en medio de ti, oh Egipto, sobre Faraón, y sobre todos sus siervos.

verses.KJV: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.WEB: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
verses.ASV: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele feriu muitas nações, e matou reis poderosos:
verses.RVR09: El que hirió muchas gentes, y mató reyes poderosos:

verses.KJV: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.WEB: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
verses.ASV: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan,
verses.ALMEIDA: Seom, rei dos amorreus, e Ogue, rei de Basã; e todos os reinos de Canaã.
verses.RVR09: A Sehón rey Amorrheo, y á Og rey de Basán, y á todos los reinos de Canaán.

verses.KJV: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.WEB: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
verses.ASV: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu a terra deles como herança; como herança a Israel, seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Y dió la tierra de ellos en heredad, en heredad á Israel su pueblo.

verses.KJV: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.
verses.WEB: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.
verses.ASV: Thy name, O Jehovah, [endureth] for ever; Thy memorial [name], O Jehovah, throughout all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, teu nome [dura] para sempre; [e] tua memória, SENHOR, de geração em geração.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, eterno es tu nombre; tu memoria, oh Jehová para generación y generación.

verses.KJV: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.WEB: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR julgará a seu povo; e terá compaixão de seus servos.
verses.RVR09: Porque juzgará Jehová su pueblo, y arrepentiráse sobre sus siervos.

verses.KJV: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.WEB: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.ASV: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os ídolos das nações [são] prata e ouro; [são] obra de mãos humanas.
verses.RVR09: Los ídolos de las gentes son plata y oro, obra de manos de hombres.

verses.KJV: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.WEB: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
verses.ASV: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.ALMEIDA: Têm boca, mas não falam; têm olhos, mas não veem.
verses.RVR09: Tienen boca, y no hablan; tienen ojos, y no ven;

verses.KJV: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.WEB: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.ASV: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Têm ouvidos, mas não ouvem; não têm respiração em sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Tienen orejas, y no oyen; tampoco hay espíritu en sus bocas.

verses.KJV: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.WEB: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.ASV: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tornem-se como eles os que os fazem, [e] todos os que confiam neles.
verses.RVR09: Como ellos son los que los hacen; todos los que en ellos confían.

verses.KJV: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:
verses.WEB: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Casa de Israel, bendizei ao SENHOR! Casa de Arão, bendizei ao SENHOR!
verses.RVR09: Casa de Israel, bendecid á Jehová: casa de Aarón, bendecid á Jehová:

verses.KJV: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
verses.WEB: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Casa de Levi, bendizei ao SENHOR! Vós que temeis ao SENHOR, bendizei ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Casa de Leví, bendecid á Jehová: los que teméis á Jehová, bendecid á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito seja o SENHOR desde Sião, ele que habita em Jerusalém. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Bendito de Sión Jehová, que mora en Jerusalem. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: ALABAD á Jehová, porque es bueno; porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Oh give thanks unto the God of gods; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei ao Deus dos deuses, porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Alabad al Dios de los dioses, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: Oh give thanks unto the Lord of lords; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei ao SENHOR dos senhores; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Alabad al Señor de los señores, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: To him who alone doeth great wonders; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que faz grandes maravilhas sozinho por si mesmo; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al solo que hace grandes maravillas, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: To him that by understanding made the heavens; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que fez os céus com entendimento; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al que hizo los cielos con entendimiento, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: To him that spread forth the earth above the waters; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que estendeu a terra sobre as águas; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al que tendió la tierra sobre las aguas, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: To him that made great lights; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que fez as grandes fontes de luz; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al que hizo las grandes luminarias, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: The sun to rule by day; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao sol, para governar o dia; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El sol para que dominase en el día, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: The moon and stars to rule by night; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: À lua e as estrelas, para governarem a noite; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: La luna y las estrellas para que dominasen en la noche, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: To him that smote Egypt in their first-born; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que feriu aos egípcios em seus primogênitos; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al que hirió á Egipto en sus primogénitos, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: And brought out Israel from among them; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tirou Israel do meio deles; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al que sacó á Israel de en medio de ellos, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Com mão forte, e com braço estendido; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Con mano fuerte, y brazo extendido, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: To him that divided the Red Sea in sunder; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que separou o mar Vermelho em [duas] partes; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al que dividió el mar Bermejo en partes, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez Israel passar por meio dele; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: E hizo pasar á Israel por medio de él, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: E derrubou a Faraó com seu exército no mar Vermelho; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y arrojó á Faraón y á su ejército en el mar Bermejo, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: To him that led his people through the wilderness; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que guiou seu povo pelo deserto; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al que pastoreó á su pueblo por el desierto, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: To him that smote great kings; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao que feriu grandes reis; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Al que hirió grandes reyes, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: And slew famous kings; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: E matou reis poderosos; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y mató reyes poderosos, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: Sihon king of the Amorites; For his lovingkindness [endureth] forever;
verses.ALMEIDA: Seom; rei amorreu; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: A Sehón rey Amorrheo, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: And Og king of Bashan; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ogue, rei de Basã; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y á Og rey de Basán, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: And gave their land for a heritage; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: E deu a terra deles como herança; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y dió la tierra de ellos en heredad, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: Even a heritage unto Israel his servant; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] herança a seu servo Israel; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: En heredad á Israel su siervo, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.WEB: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: Who remembered us in our low estate; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: O que em nossa humilhação se lembrou de nós; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El es el que en nuestro abatimiento se acordó de nosotros, porque para siempre es su misericordia;

verses.KJV: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.ASV: And hath delivered us from our adversaries; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:
verses.ALMEIDA: E nos tirou livres de nossos adversários; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y nos rescató de nuestros enemigos, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Who giveth food to all flesh; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que dá alimento a todo [ser vivo feito de] carne; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El da mantenimiento á toda carne, porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.WEB: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.ASV: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agradecei ao Deus dos céus; porque sua bondade [dura] para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Alabad al Dios de los cielos: porque para siempre es su misericordia.

verses.KJV: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.WEB: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.ASV: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Junto aos rios da Babilônia nos sentamos e choramos, enquanto nos lembramos de Sião.
verses.RVR09: JUNTO á los ríos de Babilonia, allí nos sentábamos, y aun llorábamos, acordándonos de Sión.

verses.KJV: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.WEB: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
verses.ASV: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre os salgueiros que há no meio dela penduramos nossas harpas.
verses.RVR09: Sobre los sauces en medio de ella colgamos nuestras arpas.

verses.KJV: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.WEB: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
verses.ASV: For there they that led us captive required of us songs, And they that wasted us [required of us] mirth, [saying], Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ali os que tinham nos capturado nos pediam letras de canções, e os que nos destruíram, que [os] alegrássemos, [dizendo] : Cantai para nós [algumas] das canções de Sião.
verses.RVR09: Y los que allí nos habían llevado cautivos nos pedían que cantásemos, y los que nos habían desolado nos pedían alegría, diciendo:

verses.KJV: How shall we sing the Lord's song in a strange land?
verses.WEB: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
verses.ASV: How shall we sing Jehovah’s song In a foreign land?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como cantaríamos canções do SENHOR em terra estrangeira?
verses.RVR09: Cantadnos algunos de los himnos de Sión. ¿Cómo cantaremos canción de Jehová en tierra de extraños?

verses.KJV: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.WEB: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
verses.ASV: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget [her skill].
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu me esquecer de ti, ó Jerusalém, que minha mão direita se esqueça [de sua habilidade] .
verses.RVR09: Si me olvidare de ti, oh Jerusalem, mi diestra sea olvidada.

verses.KJV: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.WEB: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.ASV: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I prefer not Jerusalem Above my chief joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que minha língua grude no céu da boca se eu não me lembrar de ti, se eu não pôr Jerusalém acima de todas as minhas alegrias.
verses.RVR09: Mi lengua se pegue á mi paladar, si de ti no me acordare; si no ensalzare á Jerusalem como preferente asunto de mi alegría.

verses.KJV: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.WEB: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
verses.ASV: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te, SENHOR, dos filhos de Edom no dia de Jerusalém, que diziam: Arruinai [-a] ,arruinai [-a] ,até ao seus fundamentos!
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate, oh Jehová, de los hijos de Edom en el día de Jerusalem; quienes decían: Arrasadla, arrasadla hasta los cimientos.

verses.KJV: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.WEB: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
verses.ASV: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah filha de Babilônia, que serás destruída! Bem-aventurado a quem te retribuir o que fizeste conosco.
verses.RVR09: Hija de Babilonia destruída, bienaventurado el que te diere el pago de lo que tú nos hiciste.

verses.KJV: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.WEB: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
verses.ASV: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado aquele que tomar dos teus filhos, e [lançá-los] contra as pedras.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el que tomará y estrellará tus niños contra las piedras.

verses.KJV: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.WEB: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. I will give thee thanks with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Louvarei a ti com todo o meu coração; na presença dos deuses cantarei louvores a ti.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. ALABARTE he con todo mi corazón: delante de los dioses te cantaré salmos.

verses.KJV: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.WEB: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
verses.ASV: I will worship toward thy holy temple, And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu me prostrarei ao teu santo templo, e louvarei o teu nome por tua bondade e por tua verdade; porque engrandeceste tua palavra [e] teu nome acima de tudo.
verses.RVR09: Encorvaréme al templo de tu santuario, y alabaré tu nombre por tu misericordia y tu verdad: porque has hecho magnífico tu nombre, y tu dicho sobre todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
verses.WEB: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
verses.ASV: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia [em que] clamei, tu me respondeste; [e] me fortaleceste [com] força em minha alma.
verses.RVR09: En el día que clamé, me respondiste; esforzásteme con fortaleza en mi alma.

verses.KJV: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.WEB: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
verses.ASV: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os reis da terra louvarão a ti, SENHOR, quando ouvirem as palavras de tua boca.
verses.RVR09: Confesarte han, oh Jehová, todos los reyes de la tierra, cuando habrán oído los dichos de tu boca.

verses.KJV: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!
verses.ASV: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah; For great is the glory of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cantarão sobre os caminhos do SENHOR, pois grande [é] a glória do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y cantarán de los caminos de Jehová: que la gloria de Jehová es grande.

verses.KJV: Though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.WEB: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
verses.ASV: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque [mesmo] sendo SENHOR elevado, ele presta atenção ao humilde; porém ele reconhece o arrogante de longe.
verses.RVR09: Porque el alto Jehová atiende al humilde; mas al altivo mira de lejos.

verses.KJV: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.WEB: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
verses.ASV: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand will save me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto ando no meio da angústia, tu me vivificas; tu estendes tua mão contra a ira de meus inimigos; e tua mão direita me salva.
verses.RVR09: Si anduviere yo en medio de la angustia, tú me vivificarás: contra la ira de mis enemigos extenderás tu mano, y salvaráme tu diestra.

verses.KJV: The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.WEB: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, [endureth] for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR fará por completo [o que ele tem] para mim; ó SENHOR, tua bondade [dura] para sempre; não abandones as obras de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová cumplirá por mí: tu misericordia, oh Jehová, es para siempre; no dejarás la obra de tus manos.

verses.KJV: O lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known [me].
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: SENHOR, tu me examinas e me conheces.
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. OH Jehová, tú me has examinado y conocido.

verses.KJV: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.WEB: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
verses.ASV: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu sabes o meu sentar e o meu caminhar; de longe entendes meus pensamentos.
verses.RVR09: Tú has conocido mi sentarme y mi levantarme, has entendido desde lejos mis pensamientos.

verses.KJV: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.WEB: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
verses.ASV: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu cercas o meu andar e meu deitar; conheces desde antes os meus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Mi senda y mi acostarme has rodeado, y estás impuesto en todos mis caminos.

verses.KJV: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.WEB: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.
verses.ASV: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mesmo não havendo [ainda] palavra [alguma] em minha língua, eis, SENHOR, que já sabes tudo.
verses.RVR09: Pues aun no está la palabra en mi lengua, y he aquí, oh Jehová, tú la sabes toda.

verses.KJV: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.WEB: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
verses.ASV: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu me envolves por detrás e pela frente, e pões tua mão sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Detrás y delante me guarneciste, y sobre mí pusiste tu mano.

verses.KJV: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.WEB: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
verses.ASV: [Such] knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Teu] conhecimento é maravilhoso demais para mim, tão alto que não posso [alcançá] -lo.
verses.RVR09: Más maravillosa es la ciencia que mi capacidad; alta es, no puedo comprenderla.

verses.KJV: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.WEB: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
verses.ASV: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para onde eu escaparia de teu Espírito? E para onde fugiria de tua presença?
verses.RVR09: ¿Adónde me iré de tu espíritu? ¿y adónde huiré de tu presencia?

verses.KJV: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
verses.WEB: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
verses.ASV: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu subisse até os céus, lá tu [estás] ; se eu fizer meu leito no Xeol, eis que tu [também ali estás] .
verses.RVR09: Si subiere á los cielos, allí estás tú: y si en abismo hiciere mi estrado, he aquí allí tú estás.

verses.KJV: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.WEB: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
verses.ASV: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu tomasse as asas do amanhecer, e morasse nas extremidades do mar,
verses.RVR09: Si tomare las alas del alba, y habitare en el extremo de la mar,

verses.KJV: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.WEB: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
verses.ASV: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até ali tua mão me guiaria, e tua mão direita me seguraria.
verses.RVR09: Aun allí me guiará tu mano, y me asirá tu diestra.

verses.KJV: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.WEB: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
verses.ASV: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu dissesse: Certamente as trevas me encobrirão; e a luz ao redor de mim [será como] a noite.
verses.RVR09: Si dijere: Ciertamente las tinieblas me encubrirán; aun la noche resplandecerá tocante á mí.

verses.KJV: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
verses.WEB: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
verses.ASV: Even the darkness hideth not from thee, But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both alike [to thee].
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém nem mesmo as trevas [me] esconderão de ti; ao invés disso, [pois] a noite é tão clara quanto o dia, [e aos teus olhos] as trevas são como a luz.
verses.RVR09: Aun las tinieblas no encubren de ti, y la noche resplandece como el día: lo mismo te son las tinieblas que la luz.

verses.KJV: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
verses.WEB: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
verses.ASV: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother’s womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tu és dono do meu ser, e me cobriste no ventre da minha mãe.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú poseiste mis riñones; cubrísteme en el vientre de mi madre.

verses.KJV: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.WEB: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
verses.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te louvarei porque de um [jeito] assombroso e maravilhoso eu fui feito; maravilhosas [são] tuas obras; e minha alma sabe muito bem.
verses.RVR09: Te alabaré; porque formidables, maravillosas son tus obras: estoy maravillado, y mi alma lo conoce mucho.

verses.KJV: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.WEB: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
verses.ASV: My frame was not hidden from thee, When I was made in secret, [And] curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus ossos não estavam escondidos de ti quando eu fui feito em oculto, e formado como tramas de tecido nas profundezas da terra.
verses.RVR09: No fué encubierto de ti mi cuerpo, bien que en oculto fuí formado, y compaginado en lo más bajo de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.WEB: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
verses.ASV: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, [Even] the days that were ordained [for me], When as yet there was none of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus olhos viram meu corpo [ainda] sem forma, e tudo estava escrito em teu livro; [até] os dias estavam determinados quando nenhum deles [ainda] havia.
verses.RVR09: Mi embrión vieron tus ojos, y en tu libro estaban escritas todas aquellas cosas que fueron luego formadas, sin faltar una de ellas.

verses.KJV: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
verses.WEB: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
verses.ASV: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!
verses.ALMEIDA: Como são preciosos para mim os teus pensamentos, Deus! Como é grande a quantidade deles!
verses.RVR09: Así que ¡cuán preciosos me son, oh Dios, tus pensamientos! ¡cuán multiplicadas son sus cuentas!

verses.KJV: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.WEB: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
verses.ASV: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se eu os contasse, seriam muito mais [numerosos] que a areia; [quando] acordo, ainda estou contigo.
verses.RVR09: Si los cuento, multiplícanse más que la arena: despierto, y aun estoy contigo.

verses.KJV: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.WEB: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
verses.ASV: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, Deus, tomara que mates ao perverso! E vós, homens sanguinários, afastai-vos de mim;
verses.RVR09: De cierto, oh Dios, matarás al impío; apartaos pues de mí, hombres sanguinarios.

verses.KJV: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
verses.WEB: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
verses.ASV: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take [thy name] in vain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eles falam de ti com maldade, [e] teus inimigos [se] exaltam em vão.
verses.RVR09: Porque blasfemias dicen ellos contra ti: tus enemigos toman en vano tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.WEB: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
verses.ASV: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso, SENHOR, eu não odiaria aos que te odeiam? E não detestaria os que se levantam contra ti?
verses.RVR09: ¿No tengo en odio, oh Jehová, á los que te aborrecen, y me conmuevo contra tus enemigos?

verses.KJV: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.WEB: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
verses.ASV: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu os odeio com ódio completo; eu os considero como inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Aborrézcolos con perfecto odio; téngolos por enemigos.

verses.KJV: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.WEB: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
verses.ASV: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;
verses.ALMEIDA: Examina-me, Deus, e conhece meu coração; prova-me, e conhece meus pensamentos.
verses.RVR09: Examíname, oh Dios, y conoce mi corazón: pruébame y reconoce mis pensamientos:

verses.KJV: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.WEB: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
verses.ASV: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vê se em mim [há algum] mau caminho; e guia-me pelo caminho eterno.
verses.RVR09: Y ve si hay en mí camino de perversidad, y guíame en el camino eterno.

verses.KJV: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.WEB: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:
verses.ASV: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man:
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi, para o regente: Livra-me do homem mau, SENHOR; guarda-me dos homens violentos,
verses.RVR09: Al Músico principal: Salmo de David. LÍBRAME, oh Jehová, de hombre malo: guárdame de hombre violento;

verses.KJV: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
verses.WEB: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
verses.ASV: Who devise mischiefs in their heart; Continually do they gather themselves together for war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que pensam maldades no coração; todo dia se reúnem para fazerem guerra.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales maquinan males en el corazón, cada día urden contiendas.

verses.KJV: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.WEB: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.ASV: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Adders’ poison is under their lips. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles afiam suas línguas como a cobra; veneno de serpentes [há] debaixo de seus lábios. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Aguzaron su lengua como la serpiente; veneno de áspid hay debajo de sus labios. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.WEB: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
verses.ASV: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda-me, SENHOR, das mãos do perverso; guarda-me do homens violentos, que pensam em empurrar os meus pés.
verses.RVR09: Guárdame, oh Jehová, de manos del impío, presérvame del hombre injurioso; que han pensado de trastornar mis pasos.

verses.KJV: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.WEB: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
verses.ASV: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Os arrogantes me armaram ciladas e cordas; estenderam uma rede de um lado do caminho; [e] puseram laços de armadilhas para mim. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: Hanme escondido lazo y cuerdas los soberbios; han tendido red junto á la senda; me han puesto lazos. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.
verses.WEB: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.
verses.ASV: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God: Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse ao SENHOR: Tu [és] meu Deus; inclina teus ouvidos à voz de minhas súplicas, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: He dicho á Jehová: Dios mío eres tú; escucha, oh Jehová, la voz de mis ruegos.

verses.KJV: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.WEB: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Senhor DEUS, força de minha salvação, cobriste minha cabeça no dia da batalha.
verses.RVR09: Jehová Señor, fortaleza de mi salud, tú pusiste á cubierto mi cabeza el día de las armas.

verses.KJV: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.WEB: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
verses.ASV: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, [lest] they exalt themselves. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Não concedas ao perverso os desejos dele, SENHOR; não permitas suceder seu plano maligno, [pois senão] se exaltariam. (Selá)
verses.RVR09: No des, oh Jehová, al impío sus deseos; no saques adelante su pensamiento, que no se ensoberbezca. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.WEB: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.ASV: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto à cabeça dos que me cercam, que a opressão de seus próprios lábios os cubra.
verses.RVR09: En cuanto á los que por todas partes me rodean, la maldad de sus propios labios cubrirá su cabeza.

verses.KJV: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.WEB: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
verses.ASV: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caiam sobre eles brasas vivas; faça-os cair no fogo [e] em covas profundas, [para que] não se levantem mais.
verses.RVR09: Caerán sobre ellos brasas; Dios los hará caer en el fuego, en profundos hoyos de donde no salgan.

verses.KJV: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.WEB: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.ASV: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem de língua maligna não se firmará na terra; o mal perseguirá o homem violento até o derrubar.
verses.RVR09: El hombre deslenguado no será firme en la tierra: el mal cazará al hombre injusto para derribarle.

verses.KJV: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.WEB: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
verses.ASV: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sei que o SENHOR cumprirá a causa do aflito, o direito dos necessitados.
verses.RVR09: Yo sé que hará Jehová el juicio del afligido, el juicio de los menesterosos.

verses.KJV: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.WEB: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
verses.ASV: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente os justos agradecerão ao teu nome; os corretos habitarão perante teu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente los justos alabarán tu nombre; los rectos morarán en tu presencia.

verses.KJV: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David. LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David. Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me: Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Ó SENHOR, eu clamo a ti; apressa-te a mim; ouve minha voz, quando eu clamar a ti.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. JEHOVÁ, á ti he clamado: apresúrate á mí; escucha mi voz, cuando te invocare.

verses.KJV: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.WEB: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
verses.ASV: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee; The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apresente-se minha oração [como] incenso diante de ti; [e] o levantar de minhas mãos [como] a oferta do anoitecer.
verses.RVR09: Sea enderezada mi oración delante de ti como un perfume, el don de mis manos como la ofrenda de la tarde.

verses.KJV: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.WEB: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
verses.ASV: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Põe, SENHOR, uma guarda em minha boca; vigia a abertura dos meus lábios.
verses.RVR09: Pon, oh Jehová, guarda á mi boca: guarda la puerta de mis labios.

verses.KJV: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.WEB: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
verses.ASV: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não inclines meu coração para as coisas más, para fazer o mal junto com homens que praticam maldade; e não coma eu das delícias deles.
verses.RVR09: No dejes se incline mi corazón á cosa mala, á hacer obras impías con los que obran iniquidad, y no coma yo de sus deleites.

verses.KJV: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
verses.WEB: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
verses.ASV: Let the righteous smite me, [it shall be] a kindness; And let him reprove me, [it shall be as] oil upon the head; Let not my head refuse it: For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que o justo me faça o favor de me espancar e me repreender; [isto me será] azeite sobre a cabeça; minha cabeça não rejeitará, porque ainda orarei contra as maldades deles.
verses.RVR09: Que el justo me castigue, será un favor, y que me reprenda será un excelente bálsamo que no me herirá la cabeza: así que aun mi oración tendrán en sus calamidades.

verses.KJV: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.WEB: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
verses.ASV: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Quando] seus juízes forem lançados contra a rocha, então ouvirão minhas palavras, porque [são] agradáveis.
verses.RVR09: Serán derribados en lugares peñascosos sus jueces, y oirán mis palabras, que son suaves.

verses.KJV: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
verses.WEB: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
verses.ASV: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como quem lavra e fende a terra, assim nossos ossos são espalhados à entrada do Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Como quien hiende y rompe la tierra, son esparcidos nuestros huesos á la boca de la sepultura.

verses.KJV: But mine eyes are unto thee, O God the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.WEB: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
verses.ASV: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém meus olhos [estão voltados] para ti, ó Senhor DEUS; em ti confio; não desampares minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto á ti, oh Jehová Señor, miran mis ojos: en ti he confiado, no desampares mi alma.

verses.KJV: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.WEB: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
verses.ASV: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda-me do perigo da armadilha que me prepararam; e dos laços da cilada dos que praticam maldade.
verses.RVR09: Guárdame de los lazos que me han tendido, y de los armadijos de los que obran iniquidad.

verses.KJV: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.WEB: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
verses.ASV: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caiam os perversos cada um em suas próprias redes, e eu passe adiante [em segurança] .
verses.RVR09: Caigan los impíos á una en sus redes, mientras yo pasaré adelante.

verses.KJV: I cried unto the Lord with my voice; with my voice unto the Lord did I make my supplication.
verses.WEB: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.
verses.ASV: Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer. I cry with my voice unto Jehovah; With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrução de Davi; oração quando ele estava na caverna: Com minha voz clamo ao SENHOR; com minha voz suplico ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Masquil de David: Oración que hizo cuando estaba en la cueva. CON mi voz clamaré á Jehová, con mi voz pediré á Jehová misericordia.

verses.KJV: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.WEB: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
verses.ASV: I pour out my complaint before him; I show before him my trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante dele derramo meu pedido; diante dele contei minha angústia.
verses.RVR09: Delante de él derramaré mi querella; delante de él denunciaré mi angustia.

verses.KJV: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.WEB: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
verses.ASV: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estando meu espírito angustiado em mim, tu conheceste meu percurso; no caminho em que eu andava esconderam um laço de armadilha para mim.
verses.RVR09: Cuando mi espíritu se angustiaba dentro de mí, tú conociste mi senda. En el camino en que andaba, me escondieron lazo.

verses.KJV: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.WEB: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
verses.ASV: Look on [my] right hand, and see; For there is no man that knoweth me: Refuge hath failed me; No man careth for my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu olho à direita, e eis que não há quem me conheça; não há nenhum refúgio para mim; nem ninguém se importava com minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Miraba á la mano derecha, y observaba; mas no había quien me conociese; no tuve refugio, no había quien volviese por mi vida.

verses.KJV: I cried unto thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.WEB: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
verses.ASV: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu clamo a ti, SENHOR, dizendo: Tu és meu refúgio, [e] minha porção na terra dos viventes.
verses.RVR09: Clamé á ti, oh Jehová, dije: Tú eres mi esperanza, y mi porción en la tierra de los vivientes.

verses.KJV: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.WEB: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
verses.ASV: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.
verses.ALMEIDA: Presta atenção aos meus gritos, porque estou muito oprimido; resgata-me daqueles que me perseguem, pois são mais fortes que eu.
verses.RVR09: Escucha mi clamor, que estoy muy afligido; líbrame de los que me persiguen, porque son más fuertes que yo.

verses.KJV: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.WEB: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
verses.ASV: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tira minha alma da prisão, para que eu louve o teu nome; os justos me rodearão, porque tu me tratarás bem.
verses.RVR09: Saca mi alma de la cárcel para que alabe tu nombre: Me rodearán los justos, porque tú me serás propicio.

verses.KJV: Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
verses.WEB: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
verses.ASV: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, [and] in thy righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Ó SENHOR, ouve minha oração; inclina teus ouvidos às minhas súplicas; responde-me segundo tua fidelidade [e] tua justiça.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. OH Jehová, oye mi oración, escucha mis ruegos: respóndeme por tu verdad, por tu justicia.

verses.KJV: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.WEB: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
verses.ASV: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; For in thy sight no man living is righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não entres em juízo com teu servo; porque nenhum ser vivo será justo diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Y no entres en juicio con tu siervo; porque no se justificará delante de ti ningún viviente.

verses.KJV: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.WEB: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
verses.ASV: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o inimigo persegue minha alma, atropela na terra a minha vida; [e] me obriga a viver na escuridão, como os que há muito [tempo] morreram.
verses.RVR09: Porque ha perseguido el enemigo mi alma; ha postrado en tierra mi vida; hame hecho habitar en tinieblas como los ya muertos.

verses.KJV: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.WEB: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
verses.ASV: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meu espírito se enche de angústia em mim, [e] meu coração está desesperado dentro de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y mi espíritu se angustió dentro de mí; pasmóse mi corazón.

verses.KJV: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.WEB: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
verses.ASV: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy doings; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembro-me dos dias antigos, eu considero todos os teus feitos; medito nas obras de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Acordéme de los días antiguos; meditaba en todas tus obras; reflexionaba en las obras de tus manos.

verses.KJV: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.WEB: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.
verses.ASV: I spread forth my hands unto thee: My soul [thirsteth] after thee, as a weary land. [Selah
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanto minhas mãos a ti; minha alma [tem sede] de ti como a terra seca.
verses.RVR09: Extendí mis manos á ti; mi alma á ti como la tierra sedienta. (Selah.)

verses.KJV: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.WEB: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.ASV: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responde-me depressa, SENHOR; porque meu espírito está muito fraco; não escondas tua face de mim, pois eu seria semelhante aos que descem à cova.
verses.RVR09: Respóndeme presto, oh Jehová que desmaya mi espíritu: no escondas de mí tu rostro, y venga yo á ser semejante á los que descienden á la sepultura.

verses.KJV: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.WEB: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
verses.ASV: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: De madrugada faze com que eu ouça tua bondade, porque em ti confio; faze-me saber o caminho que devo seguir, porque a ti levanto minha alma.
verses.RVR09: Hazme oir por la mañana tu misericordia, porque en ti he confiado: hazme saber el camino por donde ande, porque á ti he alzado mi alma.

verses.KJV: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.WEB: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
verses.ASV: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra-me de meus inimigos, SENHOR; [pois] em ti eu me escondo.
verses.RVR09: Líbrame de mis enemigos, oh Jehová: á ti me acojo.
