verses.KJV: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.WEB: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
verses.ASV: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensina-me a fazer a tua vontade, pois tu és meu Deus; teu bom Espírito me guie por terra plana.
verses.RVR09: Enséñame á hacer tu voluntad, porque tú eres mi Dios: tu buen espíritu me guíe á tierra de rectitud.

verses.KJV: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.WEB: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.ASV: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name’s sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivifica-me por teu nome, SENHOR; por tua justiça tira minha alma da angústia.
verses.RVR09: Por tu nombre, oh Jehová me vivificarás: por tu justicia, sacarás mi alma de angustia.

verses.KJV: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
verses.WEB: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
verses.ASV: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant.
verses.ALMEIDA: E por tua bondade extermina os meus inimigos; e destrói a todos os que afligem a minha alma; pois eu sou teu servo.
verses.RVR09: Y por tu misericordia disiparás mis enemigos, y destruirás todos los adversarios de mi alma: porque yo soy tu siervo.

verses.KJV: Blessed be the Lord my strength which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.WEB: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
verses.ASV: [A Psalm] of David. Blessed be Jehovah my rock, Who teacheth my hands to war, [And] my fingers to fight:
verses.ALMEIDA: Salmo de Davi: Bendito [seja] o SENHOR, rocha minha, que ensina minhas mãos para a batalha, [e] meus dedos para a guerra.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de David. BENDITO sea Jehová, mi roca, que enseña mis manos á la batalla, y mis dedos á la guerra:

verses.KJV: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.WEB: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
verses.ASV: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ele é] minha bondade e meu castelo; meu alto refúgio, e meu libertador; [ele é] meu escudo, em quem confio; [e] aquele que faz meu povo se submeter a mim.
verses.RVR09: Misericordia mía y mi castillo, altura mía y mi libertador, escudo mío, en quien he confiado; el que allana mi pueblo delante de mí.

verses.KJV: Lord, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.WEB: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
verses.ASV: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, o que é o homem para que lhe dês atenção? [E] o filho do homem, para que com ele te importes?
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, ¿qué es el hombre, para que de él conozcas? ¿ó el hijo del hombre, para que lo estimes?

verses.KJV: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.WEB: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
verses.ASV: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem é semelhante a um sopro; seus dias, como a sombra que passa.
verses.RVR09: El hombre es semejante á la vanidad: sus días son como la sombra que pasa.

verses.KJV: Bow thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.WEB: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
verses.ASV: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, abaixa teus céus, e desce; toca os montes, e fumeguem.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, inclina tus cielos y desciende: toca los montes, y humeen.

verses.KJV: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.WEB: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
verses.ASV: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out thine arrows, and discomfit them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lança relâmpagos, e os dispersa; envia tuas flechas, e os derrota.
verses.RVR09: Despide relámpagos, y disípalos; envía tus saetas, y contúrbalos.

verses.KJV: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
verses.WEB: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
verses.ASV: Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estende tuas mãos desde o alto; livra-me, e resgata-me das muitas águas, das mãos dos filhos de estrangeiros;
verses.RVR09: Envía tu mano desde lo alto; redímeme, y sácame de las muchas aguas, de la mano de los hijos extraños;

verses.KJV: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.WEB: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.ASV: Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cuja boca fala coisas inúteis, e sua mão direita é a mão direita da mentira.
verses.RVR09: Cuya boca habla vanidad, y su diestra es diestra de mentira.

verses.KJV: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.WEB: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
verses.ASV: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Deus, a ti cantarei uma canção nova; com harpa [e] instrumento de dez cordas tocarei música a ti.
verses.RVR09: Oh Dios, á ti cantaré canción nueva: con salterio, con decacordio cantaré á ti.

verses.KJV: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.WEB: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
verses.ASV: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings; Who rescueth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Tu és] o que dás vitória aos reis, [e] livras a Davi, teu servo, da espada maligna.
verses.RVR09: Tú, el que da salud á los reyes, el que redime á David su siervo de maligna espada.

verses.KJV: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
verses.WEB: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.ASV: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens, Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra-me e resgata-me das mãos dos filhos de estrangeiros; cuja boca fala mentiras, e sua mão direita é mão direita de falsidade.
verses.RVR09: Redímeme, y sálvame de mano de los hijos extraños, cuya boca habla vanidad, y su diestra es diestra de mentira.

verses.KJV: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
verses.WEB: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
verses.ASV: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth, And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que nossos filhos [sejam] como plantas, que crescem em sua juventude; [e] nossas filhas [sejam] como esquinas entalhadas ao modo do palácio.
verses.RVR09: Que nuestros hijos sean como plantas crecidas en su juventud; nuestras hijas como las esquinas labradas á manera de las de un palacio;

verses.KJV: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.WEB: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
verses.ASV: [When] our garners are full, affording all manner of store, [And] our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos celeiros sejam cheios de todos os tipos de mantimentos; nosso gado seja aos milhares, e dezenas de milhares em nossos campos.
verses.RVR09: Nuestros graneros llenos, provistos de toda suerte de grano; nuestros ganados, que paran á millares y diez millares en nuestras plazas:

verses.KJV: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
verses.WEB: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
verses.ASV: [When] our oxen are well laden; [When there is] no breaking in, and no going forth, And no outcry in our streets:
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos bois sejam vigorosos; não haja nem assalto, nem fugas, nem gritos em nossas ruas.
verses.RVR09: Que nuestros bueyes estén fuertes para el trabajo; que no tengamos asalto, ni que hacer salida, ni grito de alarma en nuestras plazas.

verses.KJV: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.
verses.WEB: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
verses.ASV: Happy is the people that is in such a case; [Yea], happy is the people whose God is Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado é o povo que assim lhe [acontece] ; bem-aventurado é o povo cujo Deus é o SENHOR!
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el pueblo que tiene esto: bienaventurado el pueblo cuyo Dios es Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
verses.ASV: [A Psalm of] praise; of David. I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cântico de Davi: Eu te exaltarei, meu Deus [e] Rei; e bendirei teu nome para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Salmo de alabanza: de David. ENSALZARTE he, mi Dios, mi Rey; y bendeciré tu nombre por siglo y para siempre.

verses.KJV: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
verses.ASV: Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo dia eu te bendirei, e louvarei teu nome para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Cada día te bendeciré, y alabaré tu nombre por siglo y para siempre.

verses.KJV: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.WEB: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
verses.ASV: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é grande e muito louvável; sua grandeza é incompreensível.
verses.RVR09: Grande es Jehová y digno de suprema alabanza: y su grandeza es inescrutable.

verses.KJV: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.WEB: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
verses.ASV: One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Geração após geração louvará tuas obras, e anunciarão tuas proezas.
verses.RVR09: Generación á generación narrará tus obras, y anunciarán tus valentías.

verses.KJV: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.WEB: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
verses.ASV: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu falarei da honra gloriosa de tua majestade, e de teus feitos maravilhosos.
verses.RVR09: La hermosura de la gloria de tu magnificencia, y tus hechos maravillosos, hablaré.

verses.KJV: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.WEB: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
verses.ASV: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts; And I will declare thy greatness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falarão do poder de teus assombrosos feitos; e eu contarei tua grandeza.
verses.RVR09: Y la terribilidad de tus valentías dirán los hombres; y yo recontaré tu grandeza.

verses.KJV: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.WEB: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
verses.ASV: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Declararão a lembrança de tua grande bondade; e anunciarão tua justiça alegremente.
verses.RVR09: Reproducirán la memoria de la muchedumbre de tu bondad, y cantarán tu justicia.

verses.KJV: The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.WEB: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Piedoso e misericordioso é o SENHOR; ele demora para se irar, e tem grande bondade.
verses.RVR09: Clemente y misericordioso es Jehová, lento para la ira, y grande en misericordia.

verses.KJV: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.WEB: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é bom para com todos; e suas misericórdias [estão] sobre todas as obras que ele fez.
verses.RVR09: Bueno es Jehová para con todos; y sus misericordias sobre todas sus obras.

verses.KJV: All thy works shall praise thee, O Lord; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.WEB: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
verses.ASV: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; And thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as tuas obras louvarão a ti, SENHOR; e teus santos te bendirão.
verses.RVR09: Alábente, oh Jehová, todas tus obras; y tus santos te bendigan.

verses.KJV: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.WEB: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
verses.ASV: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;
verses.ALMEIDA: Contarão a glória de teu reino, e falarão de teu poder.
verses.RVR09: La gloria de tu reino digan, y hablen de tu fortaleza;

verses.KJV: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.WEB: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
verses.ASV: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para anunciarem aos filhos dos homens suas proezas, e a honra gloriosa de seu reino.
verses.RVR09: Para notificar á los hijos de los hombres sus valentías, y la gloria de la magnificencia de su reino.

verses.KJV: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.WEB: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
verses.ASV: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion [endureth] throughout all generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu reino é um reino eterno, e teu domínio [dura] geração após geração.
verses.RVR09: Tu reino es reino de todos los siglos, y tu señorío en toda generación y generación.

verses.KJV: The Lord upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
verses.WEB: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
verses.ASV: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR segura todos os que caem, e levanta todos os abatidos.
verses.RVR09: Sostiene Jehová á todos los que caen, y levanta á todos los oprimidos.

verses.KJV: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.WEB: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
verses.ASV: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos de todos esperam por ti, e tu lhes dás seu alimento ao seu tempo.
verses.RVR09: Los ojos de todos esperan en ti, y tú les das su comida en su tiempo.

verses.KJV: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.WEB: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.ASV: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu abres tua mão, e sacias o desejo de todo ser vivo.
verses.RVR09: Abres tu mano, y colmas de bendición á todo viviente.

verses.KJV: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.WEB: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, And gracious in all his works.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR [é] justo em todos os seus caminhos, e bondoso em todas as suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Justo es Jehová en todos sus caminos, y misericordioso en todas sus obras.

verses.KJV: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.WEB: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR está perto de todos os que o chamam; de todos os que clamam a ele sinceramente.
verses.RVR09: Cercano está Jehová á todos los que le invocan, á todos los que le invocan de veras.

verses.KJV: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.WEB: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.ASV: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him; He also will hear their cry and will save them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele faz a vontade dos que o temem; e ouve o clamor deles, e os salva.
verses.RVR09: Cumplirá el deseo de los que le temen; oirá asimismo el clamor de ellos, y los salvará.

verses.KJV: The Lord preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.WEB: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
verses.ASV: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him; But all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR protege a todos os que o amam; porém destrói a todos os perversos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová guarda á todos los que le aman; empero destruirá á todos los impíos.

verses.KJV: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
verses.ASV: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha boca anunciará louvores ao SENHOR; e todo [ser feito de] carne louvará seu santo nome para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: La alabanza de Jehová hablará mi boca; y bendiga toda carne su santo nombre por siglo y para siempre.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. Praise the Lord, O my soul.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Louva ao SENHOR, ó minha alma!
verses.RVR09: Aleluya. ALABA, oh alma mía, á Jehová.

verses.KJV: While I live will I praise the Lord: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.WEB: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
verses.ASV: While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvarei ao SENHOR durante [toda] a minha vida; cantarei louvores a meu Deus enquanto eu [existir] .
verses.RVR09: Alabaré á Jehová en mi vida: cantaré salmos á mi Dios mientras viviere.

verses.KJV: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.WEB: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
verses.ASV: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não ponhas tua confiança em príncipes; em filhos de homens, em quem não há salvação.
verses.RVR09: No confiéis en los príncipes, ni en hijo de hombre, porque no hay en él salud.

verses.KJV: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.WEB: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
verses.ASV: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: O espírito dele [s] sai, e volta para sua terra; naquele mesmo dia seus pensamentos perecem.
verses.RVR09: Saldrá su espíritu, tornaráse en su tierra: en aquel día perecerán sus pensamientos.

verses.KJV: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:
verses.WEB: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
verses.ASV: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado aquele que [tem] o Deus de Jacó como sua ajuda, cuja esperança está no SENHOR seu Deus;
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado aquel en cuya ayuda es el Dios de Jacob, cuya esperanza es en Jehová su Dios:

verses.KJV: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.WEB: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
verses.ASV: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que fez os céus e a terra, o mar, e tudo o que neles [há] ; que guarda a fidelidade para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El cual hizo los cielos y la tierra, la mar, y todo lo que en ellos hay; que guarda verdad para siempre;

verses.KJV: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners:
verses.WEB: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
verses.ASV: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que faz juízo aos oprimidos, que dá pão aos famintos; o SENHOR solta aos presos.
verses.RVR09: Que hace derecho á los agraviados; que da pan á los hambrientos: Jehová suelta á los aprisionados;

verses.KJV: The Lord openeth the eyes of the blind: the Lord raiseth them that are bowed down: the Lord loveth the righteous:
verses.WEB: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
verses.ASV: Jehovah openeth [the eyes of] the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR abre [os olhos] dos cegos; o SENHOR levanta aos abatidos; o SENHOR ama aos justos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová abre los ojos á los ciegos; Jehová levanta á los caídos; Jehová ama á los justos.

verses.KJV: The Lord preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.WEB: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
verses.ASV: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR guarda os estrangeiros; sustenta o órfão e a viúva; mas põe dificuldades ao caminho dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová guarda á los extranjeros; al huérfano y á la viuda levanta; y el camino de los impíos trastorna.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR reinará eternamente. Ó Sião, o teu Deus [reinará] geração após geração. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Reinará Jehová para siempre; tu Dios, oh Sión, por generación y generación. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, [and] praise is comely.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai ao SENHOR, porque é bom cantar louvores ao nosso Deus; porque agradável e merecido [é] o louvor.
verses.RVR09: ALABAD á JAH, porque es bueno cantar salmos á nuestro Dios; porque suave y hermosa es la alabanza.

verses.KJV: The Lord doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.WEB: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.ASV: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR edifica a Jerusalém; [e] ajunta os dispersos de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Jehová edifica á Jerusalem; á los echados de Israel recogerá.

verses.KJV: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.WEB: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verses.ASV: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele sara aos de coração partido, e os cura de suas dores.
verses.RVR09: El sana á los quebrantados de corazón, y liga sus heridas.

verses.KJV: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
verses.WEB: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
verses.ASV: He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by [their] names.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele conta o número das estrelas; chama todas elas pelos seus nomes.
verses.RVR09: El cuenta el número de las estrellas; á todas ellas llama por sus nombres.

verses.KJV: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.WEB: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
verses.ASV: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.
verses.ALMEIDA: O nosso Senhor é grande e muito poderoso; seu entendimento é incomensurável.
verses.RVR09: Grande es el Señor nuestro, y de mucha potencia; y de su entendimiento no hay número.

verses.KJV: The Lord lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.WEB: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
verses.ASV: Jehovah upholdeth the meek: He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR levanta aos mansos; [e] abate aos perversos até a terra.
verses.RVR09: Jehová ensalza á los humildes; humilla los impíos hasta la tierra.

verses.KJV: Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
verses.WEB: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
verses.ASV: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; Sing praises upon the harp unto our God,
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR em agradecimento; cantai louvores ao nosso Deus com harpa.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Jehová con alabanza, cantad con arpa á nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.WEB: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
verses.ASV: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele que cobre o céu com nuvens, que prepara chuva para a terra, que faz os montes produzirem erva;
verses.RVR09: El es el que cubre los cielos de nubes, el que prepara la lluvia para la tierra, el que hace á los montes producir hierba.

verses.KJV: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.WEB: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
verses.ASV: He giveth to the beast his food, [And] to the young ravens which cry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que dá ao gado seu pasto; e [também] aos filhos dos corvos, quando clamam.
verses.RVR09: El da á la bestia su mantenimiento, y á los hijos de los cuervos que claman.

verses.KJV: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.WEB: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.ASV: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não se agrada da força do cavalo, nem se contenta com as pernas do homem.
verses.RVR09: No toma contentamiento en la fortaleza del caballo, ni se complace en las piernas del hombre.

verses.KJV: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.WEB: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
verses.ASV: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him, In those that hope in his lovingkindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR se agrada dos que o temem, daqueles que esperam por sua bondade.
verses.RVR09: Complácese Jehová en los que le temen, y en los que esperan en su misericordia.

verses.KJV: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
verses.ASV: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louva, Jerusalém, ao SENHOR; celebra ao teu Deus, ó Sião.
verses.RVR09: Alaba á Jehová, Jerusalem; alaba á tu Dios, Sión.

verses.KJV: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.WEB: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
verses.ASV: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele fortifica os ferrolhos de tuas portas; ele abençoa a teus filhos dentro de ti.
verses.RVR09: Porque fortificó los cerrojos de tus puertas; bendijo á tus hijos dentro de ti.

verses.KJV: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.WEB: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
verses.ASV: He maketh peace in thy borders; He filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ele é] o que dá paz às tuas fronteiras; e te farta com o melhor trigo;
verses.RVR09: El pone en tu término la paz; te hará saciar de grosura de trigo.

verses.KJV: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.WEB: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
verses.ASV: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que envia sua ordem à terra; sua palavra corre velozmente.
verses.RVR09: El envía su palabra á la tierra; muy presto corre su palabra.

verses.KJV: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.WEB: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
verses.ASV: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que dá a neve como a lã; espalha a geada como a cinza.
verses.RVR09: El da la nieve como lana, derrama la escarcha como ceniza.

verses.KJV: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.WEB: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
verses.ASV: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que lança seu gelo [em] pedaços; quem pode subsistir ao seu frio?
verses.RVR09: El echa su hielo como pedazos: delante de su frío ¿quién estará?

verses.KJV: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.WEB: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.ASV: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele manda sua palavra, e os faz derreter; faz soprar seu vento, [e] escorrem-se as águas.
verses.RVR09: Enviará su palabra, y los derretirá: soplará su viento, y fluirán las aguas.

verses.KJV: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
verses.WEB: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
verses.ASV: He showeth his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his ordinances unto Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele declara suas palavras a Jacó; e seus estatutos e seus juízos a Israel.
verses.RVR09: El denuncia sus palabras á Jacob, sus estatutos y sus juicios á Israel.

verses.KJV: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for his ordinances, they have not known them. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não fez assim a nenhuma [outra] nação; [e] não conhecem os juízos [dele] . Louvai ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No ha hecho esto con toda gente; y no conocieron sus juicios. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Louvai ao SENHOR desde os céus; louvai-o nas alturas.
verses.RVR09: Aleluya. ALABAD á Jehová desde los cielos: alabadle en las alturas.

verses.KJV: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.WEB: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
verses.ASV: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai-o todos os seus anjos; louvai-o todos os seus exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Alabadle, vosotros todos sus ángeles: alabadle, vosotros todos sus ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.WEB: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
verses.ASV: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai-o, sol e lua; louvai-o, todas as estrelas luminosas.
verses.RVR09: Alabadle, sol y luna: alabadle, vosotras todas, lucientes estrellas.

verses.KJV: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
verses.WEB: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
verses.ASV: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai-o, céus dos céus, e as águas que [estais] sobre os céus.
verses.RVR09: Alabadle, cielos de los cielos, y las aguas que están sobre los cielos.

verses.KJV: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.WEB: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.ASV: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvem ao nome do SENHOR; porque pela ordem dele foram criados.
verses.RVR09: Alaben el nombre de Jehová; porque él mandó, y fueron criadas.

verses.KJV: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.WEB: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
verses.ASV: He hath also established them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os firmou para todo o sempre; e deu [tal] decreto, que não será traspassado.
verses.RVR09: Y las hizo ser para siempre por los siglos; púsoles ley que no será quebrantada.

verses.KJV: Praise the Lord from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
verses.ASV: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai ao SENHOR [vós] da terra: os monstros marinhos, e todos os abismos;
verses.RVR09: Alabad á Jehová, de la tierra los dragones y todos los abismos;

verses.KJV: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.WEB: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,
verses.ASV: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
verses.ALMEIDA: O fogo e a saraiva, a neve e o vapor; o vento tempestuoso, que executa sua palavra.
verses.RVR09: El fuego y el granizo, la nieve y el vapor, el viento de tempestad que ejecuta su palabra;

verses.KJV: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.WEB: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
verses.ASV: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os montes e todos os morros; árvores frutíferas, e todos os cedros.
verses.RVR09: Los montes y todos los collados; el árbol de fruto, y todos los cedros;

verses.KJV: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.WEB: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
verses.ASV: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;
verses.ALMEIDA: As feras, e todo o gado; répteis, e aves que tem asas.
verses.RVR09: La bestia y todo animal; reptiles y volátiles;

verses.KJV: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.WEB: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
verses.ASV: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os reis da terra, e todos os povos; os príncipes, e todos os juízes da terra.
verses.RVR09: Los reyes de la tierra y todos los pueblos; los príncipes y todos los jueces de la tierra;

verses.KJV: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.WEB: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
verses.ASV: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:
verses.ALMEIDA: Os rapazes, e também as moças; os velhos com os jovens.
verses.RVR09: Los mancebos y también las doncellas; los viejos y los niños,

verses.KJV: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.WEB: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
verses.ASV: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvem ao nome do SENHOR; pois só o nome dele é exaltado; sua majestade [está] sobre a terra e o céu.
verses.RVR09: Alaben el nombre de Jehová, porque sólo su nombre es elevado; su gloria es sobre tierra y cielos.

verses.KJV: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele exaltou o poder de seu povo: o louvor de todos os seus santos, os filhos de Israel, o povo [que está] perto dele. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: El ensalzó el cuerno de su pueblo; alábenle todos sus santos, los hijos de Israel, el pueblo á él cercano. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Cantai ao SENHOR um cântico novo; [haja] louvor a ele na congregação dos santos.
verses.RVR09: Aleluya. CANTAD á Jehová canción nueva: su alabanza sea en la congregación de los santos.

verses.KJV: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.WEB: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.ASV: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegre-se Israel em seu Criador; os filhos de Sião se encham de alegria em seu Rei.
verses.RVR09: Alégrese Israel en su Hacedor: los hijos de Sión se gocen en su Rey.

verses.KJV: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.WEB: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
verses.ASV: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvem seu nome com danças; cantai louvores a ele com tamborim e harpa.
verses.RVR09: Alaben su nombre con corro: con adufe y arpa á él canten.

verses.KJV: For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.WEB: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR se agrada de seu povo; ele ornará os mansos com salvação.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová toma contentamiento con su pueblo: hermoseará á los humildes con salud.

verses.KJV: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.WEB: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
verses.ASV: Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saltem de prazer [seus] santos pela glória; fiquem contentes sobre suas camas.
verses.RVR09: Gozarse han los píos con gloria: cantarán sobre sus camas.

verses.KJV: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.WEB: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
verses.ASV: [Let] the high praises of God [be] in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Exaltações a Deus [estarão] em suas gargantas; e espada afiada [estará] em sua mão,
verses.RVR09: Ensalzamientos de Dios modularán en sus gargantas, y espadas de dos filos habrá en sus manos;

verses.KJV: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.WEB: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
verses.ASV: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para se vingarem das nações, e repreenderem aos povos.
verses.RVR09: Para hacer venganza de las gentes, y castigo en los pueblos;

verses.KJV: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.WEB: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.ASV: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para prenderem a seus reis com correntes, e seus nobres com grilhões de ferro;
verses.RVR09: Para aprisionar sus reyes en grillos, y sus nobles con cadenas de hierro;

verses.KJV: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: To execute upon them the judgment written: This honor have all his saints. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para executarem sobre eles a sentença escrita; esta [será] a glória de todos os seus santos. Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Para ejecutar en ellos el juicio escrito: gloria será esta para todos sus santos. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: Praise ye the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.WEB: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
verses.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aleluia! Louvai a Deus em seu santuário; louvai-o no firmamento de seu poder.
verses.RVR09: Aleluya. ALABAD á Dios en su santuario: alabadle en la extensión de su fortaleza.

verses.KJV: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.WEB: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
verses.ASV: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai-o por suas proezas; louvai-o conforme a imensidão de sua grandeza.
verses.RVR09: Alabadle por sus proezas: alabadle conforme á la muchedumbre de su grandeza.

verses.KJV: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.WEB: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
verses.ASV: Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai-o com com de trombeta; louvai-o com lira e harpa.
verses.RVR09: Alabadle á son de bocina: alabadle con salterio y arpa.

verses.KJV: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.WEB: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
verses.ASV: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai-o com tamborim e flauta; louvai-o com instrumentos de cordas e de sopro.
verses.RVR09: Alabadle con adufe y flauta: alabadle con cuerdas y órgano.

verses.KJV: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.WEB: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
verses.ASV: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.
verses.ALMEIDA: Louvai-o com címbalos bem sonoros; louvai-o com címbalos de sons de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Alabadle con címbalos resonantes: alabadle con címbalos de júbilo.

verses.KJV: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.WEB: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
verses.ASV: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo quanto tem fôlego, louve ao SENHOR! Aleluia!
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que respira alabe á JAH. Aleluya.

verses.KJV: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.WEB: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
verses.ASV: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:
verses.ALMEIDA: Provérbios de Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel.
verses.RVR09: LOS proverbios de Salomón, hijo de David, rey de Israel:

verses.KJV: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.WEB: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
verses.ASV: To know wisdom and instruction; To discern the words of understanding;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para conhecer a sabedoria e a instrução; para entender as palavras da prudência;
verses.RVR09: Para entender sabiduría y doctrina; para conocer las razones prudentes;

verses.KJV: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.WEB: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
verses.ASV: To receive instruction in wise dealing, In righteousness and justice and equity;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para obter a instrução do entendimento; justiça, juízo e equidades;
verses.RVR09: Para recibir el consejo de prudencia, justicia, y juicio y equidad;

verses.KJV: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.WEB: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
verses.ASV: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion:
verses.ALMEIDA: Para dar inteligência aos simples, conhecimento e bom senso aos jovens.
verses.RVR09: Para dar sagacidad á los simples, y á los jóvenes inteligencia y cordura.

verses.KJV: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.WEB: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
verses.ASV: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:
verses.ALMEIDA: O sábio ouvirá, e crescerá em conhecimento; o bom entendedor obterá sábios conselhos.
verses.RVR09: Oirá el sabio, y aumentará el saber; y el entendido adquirirá consejo;

verses.KJV: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.WEB: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
verses.ASV: To understand a proverb, and a figure, The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para entender provérbios e [sua] interpretação; as palavras dos sábios, e seus enigmas.
verses.RVR09: Para entender parábola y declaración; palabras de sabios, y sus dichos oscuros.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; [But] the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR [é] o principio do conhecimento; os tolos desprezam a sabedoria e a instrução.
verses.RVR09: El principio de la sabiduría es el temor de Jehová: los insensatos desprecian la sabiduría y la enseñanza.

verses.KJV: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.WEB: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
verses.ASV: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, ouve a instrução de teu pai; e não abandones a doutrina de tua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Oye, hijo mío, la doctrina de tu padre, y no desprecies la dirección de tu madre:

verses.KJV: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.WEB: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
verses.ASV: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque [serão] um ornamento gracioso para tua cabeça; e colares para teu pescoço.
verses.RVR09: Porque adorno de gracia serán á tu cabeza, y collares á tu cuello.

verses.KJV: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.WEB: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
verses.ASV: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, se os pecadores tentarem te convencer, não te deixes influenciar.
verses.RVR09: Hijo mío, si los pecadores te quisieren engañar, no consientas.

verses.KJV: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.WEB: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
verses.ASV: If they say, Come with us, Let us lay wait for blood; Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause;
verses.ALMEIDA: Se disserem: Vem conosco, vamos espiar [derramamento] de sangue; preparemos uma emboscada ao inocente sem razão.
verses.RVR09: Si dijeren: Ven con nosotros, pongamos asechanzas á la sangre, acechemos sin motivo al inocente;

verses.KJV: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.WEB: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
verses.ASV: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, And whole, as those that go down into the pit;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vamos tragá-los vivos, como o Xeol; e inteiros, como os que descem à cova.
verses.RVR09: Los tragaremos vivos como el sepulcro, y enteros, como los que caen en sima;

verses.KJV: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.WEB: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
verses.ASV: We shall find all precious substance; We shall fill our houses with spoil;
verses.ALMEIDA: Acharemos toda espécie de coisas valiosas, encheremos nossas casas de despojos.
verses.RVR09: Hallaremos riquezas de todas suertes, henchiremos nuestras casas de despojos;

verses.KJV: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.WEB: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—
verses.ASV: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us; We will all have one purse:
verses.ALMEIDA: Lança tua sorte entre nós, compartilharemos todos de uma [só] bolsa.
verses.RVR09: Echa tu suerte entre nosotros; tengamos todos una bolsa:

verses.KJV: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.WEB: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
verses.ASV: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, não sigas teu caminho com eles; desvia teu pé [para longe] de onde eles passarem;
verses.RVR09: Hijo mío, no andes en camino con ellos; aparta tu pie de sus veredas:

verses.KJV: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.WEB: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
verses.ASV: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os pés deles correm para o mal, e se apressam para derramar sangue.
verses.RVR09: Porque sus pies correrán al mal, é irán presurosos á derramar sangre.

verses.KJV: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.WEB: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
verses.ASV: For in vain is the net spread In the sight of any bird:
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente [é] inútil se estender a rede diante da vista de todas as aves;
verses.RVR09: Porque en vano se tenderá la red ante los ojos de toda ave;

verses.KJV: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.WEB: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
verses.ASV: And these lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém estes estão esperando [o derramamento] de seu [próprio] sangue; e preparam emboscada para suas [próprias] almas.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos á su propia sangre ponen asechanzas, y á sus almas tienden lazo.

verses.KJV: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.WEB: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
verses.ASV: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; It taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim [são] os caminhos de todo aquele que tem ganância pelo lucro desonesto; ela tomará a alma daqueles que a tem.
verses.RVR09: Tales son las sendas de todo el que es dado á la codicia, la cual prenderá el alma de sus poseedores.

verses.KJV: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
verses.WEB: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
verses.ASV: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street; She uttereth her voice in the broad places;
verses.ALMEIDA: A sabedoria grita pelas ruas; nas praças ela levanta sua voz.
verses.RVR09: La sabiduría clama de fuera, da su voz en las plazas:

verses.KJV: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
verses.WEB: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
verses.ASV: She crieth in the chief place of concourse; At the entrance of the gates, In the city, she uttereth her words:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela clama nas encruzilhadas, onde [passam] muita gente; às entradas das portas, nas cidades ela diz suas mensagens:
verses.RVR09: Clama en los principales lugares de concurso; en las entradas de las puertas de la ciudad dice sus razones:

verses.KJV: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.WEB: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.ASV: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And scoffers delight them in scoffing, And fools hate knowledge?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando, ó tolos, amareis a tolice? E vós zombadores, desejareis a zombaria? E [vós] loucos, odiareis o conhecimento?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo, oh simples, amaréis la simpleza, y los burladores desearán el burlar, y los insensatos aborrecerán la ciencia?

verses.KJV: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.WEB: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
verses.ASV: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you; I will make known my words unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Convertei-vos à minha repreensão; eis que vos derramarei meu espírito, [e] vos farei saber minhas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Volveos á mi reprensión: he aquí yo os derramaré mi espíritu, y os haré saber mis palabras.

verses.KJV: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.WEB: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
verses.ASV: Because I have called, and ye have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man hath regarded;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] porque eu clamei, e recusastes; estendi minha mão, e não houve quem desse atenção,
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto llamé, y no quisisteis; extendí mi mano, y no hubo quien escuchase;

verses.KJV: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.WEB: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
verses.ASV: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:
verses.ALMEIDA: E rejeitastes todo o meu conselho, e não quisestes minha repreensão,
verses.RVR09: Antes desechasteis todo consejo mío, y mi reprensión no quisisteis:

verses.KJV: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.WEB: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
verses.ASV: I also will laugh in [the day of] your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também eu rirei em vosso sofrimento, [e] zombarei, quando vier vosso medo.
verses.RVR09: También yo me reiré en vuestra calamidad, y me burlaré cuando os viniere lo que teméis;

verses.KJV: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.WEB: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
verses.ASV: When your fear cometh as a storm, And your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando vier vosso temor como tempestade, e a causa de vosso sofrimento como ventania, quando vier sobre vós a opressão e a angústia,
verses.RVR09: Cuando viniere como una destrucción lo que teméis, y vuestra calamidad llegare como un torbellino; cuando sobre vosotros viniere tribulación y angustia.

verses.KJV: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.WEB: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,
verses.ASV: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they shall not find me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então clamarão a mim; porém eu não responderei; de madrugada me buscarão, porém não me acharão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces me llamarán, y no responderé; buscarme han de mañana, y no me hallarán:

verses.KJV: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:
verses.WEB: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.
verses.ASV: For that they hated knowledge, And did not choose the fear of Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque odiaram o conhecimento; e escolheram não temer ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto aborrecieron la sabiduría, y no escogieron el temor de Jehová,

verses.KJV: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.WEB: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
verses.ASV: They would none of my counsel, They despised all my reproof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não concordaram com meu conselho, [e] desprezaram toda a minha repreensão.
verses.RVR09: Ni quisieron mi consejo, y menospreciaron toda reprensión mía:

verses.KJV: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.WEB: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own devices.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso comerão do fruto do seu [próprio] caminho, e se fartarão de seus [próprios] conselhos.
verses.RVR09: Comerán pues del fruto de su camino, y se hartarán de sus consejos.

verses.KJV: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.WEB: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
verses.ASV: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them, And the careless ease of fools shall destroy them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o desvio dos tolos os matará, e a confiança dos loucos os destruirá.
verses.RVR09: Porque el reposo de los ignorantes los matará, y la prosperidad de los necios los echará á perder.

verses.KJV: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.WEB: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
verses.ASV: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, And shall be quiet without fear of evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém aquele que me ouvir habitará em segurança, e estará tranquilo do temor do mal.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que me oyere, habitará confiadamente, y vivirá reposado, sin temor de mal.

verses.KJV: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.WEB: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
verses.ASV: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, And lay up my commandments with thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, se aceitares minhas palavras, e depositares em ti meus mandamentos,
verses.RVR09: HIJO mío, si tomares mis palabras, y mis mandamientos guardares dentro de ti,

verses.KJV: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.WEB: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
verses.ASV: So as to incline thine ear unto wisdom, And apply thy heart to understanding;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para fazeres teus ouvidos darem atenção à sabedoria, [e] inclinares teu coração à inteligência;
verses.RVR09: Haciendo estar atento tu oído á la sabiduría; si inclinares tu corazón á la prudencia;

verses.KJV: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.WEB: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
verses.ASV: Yea, if thou cry after discernment, And lift up thy voice for understanding;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se clamares à prudência, [e] à inteligência dirigires tua voz;
verses.RVR09: Si clamares á la inteligencia, y á la prudencia dieres tu voz;

verses.KJV: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
verses.WEB: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;
verses.ASV: If thou seek her as silver, And search for her as for hid treasures:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tu a buscares como a prata, e a procurares como que a tesouros escondidos,
verses.RVR09: Si como á la plata la buscares, y la escudriñares como á tesoros;

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.WEB: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah, And find the knowledge of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então entenderás o temor ao SENHOR, e acharás o conhecimento de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces entenderás el temor de Jehová, y hallarás el conocimiento de Dios.

verses.KJV: For the Lord giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
verses.WEB: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah giveth wisdom; Out of his mouth [cometh] knowledge and understanding:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR dá sabedoria; de sua boca [vem] o conhecimento e o entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová da la sabiduría, y de su boca viene el conocimiento y la inteligencia.

verses.KJV: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.WEB: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
verses.ASV: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright; [He is] a shield to them that walk in integrity;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele reserva a boa sabedoria para os corretos; [ele é] escudo para os que andam em sinceridade.
verses.RVR09: El provee de sólida sabiduría á los rectos: es escudo á los que caminan rectamente.

verses.KJV: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.WEB: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
verses.ASV: That he may guard the paths of justice, And preserve the way of his saints.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para guardar os caminhos do juízo; e conservar os passos de seus santos.
verses.RVR09: Es el que guarda las veredas del juicio, y preserva el camino de sus santos.

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
verses.WEB: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice, And equity, [yea], every good path.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então entenderás a justiça e o juízo, e a equidade; [e] todo bom caminho.
verses.RVR09: Entonces entenderás justicia, juicio, y equidad, y todo buen camino.

verses.KJV: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.WEB: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.ASV: For wisdom shall enter into thy heart, And knowledge shall be pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando a sabedoria entrar em teu coração, e o conhecimento for agradável à tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Cuando la sabiduría entrare en tu corazón, y la ciencia fuere dulce á tu alma,

verses.KJV: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.WEB: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
verses.ASV: Discretion shall watch over thee; Understanding shall keep thee:
verses.ALMEIDA: O bom senso te guardará, e o entendimento te preservará:
verses.RVR09: El consejo te guardará, te preservará la inteligencia:

verses.KJV: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.WEB: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
verses.ASV: To deliver thee from the way of evil, From the men that speak perverse things;
verses.ALMEIDA: - Para te livrar do mau caminho, e dos homens que falam perversidades;
verses.RVR09: Para librarte del mal camino, de los hombres que hablan perversidades;

verses.KJV: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.WEB: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
verses.ASV: Who forsake the paths of uprightness, To walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que deixam as veredas da justiça para andarem pelos caminhos das trevas;
verses.RVR09: Que dejan las veredas derechas, por andar en caminos tenebrosos;

verses.KJV: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.WEB: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
verses.ASV: Who rejoice to do evil, And delight in the perverseness of evil;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que se alegram em fazer o mal, e se enchem de alegria com as perversidades dos maus;
verses.RVR09: Que se alegran haciendo mal, que se huelgan en las perversidades del vicio;

verses.KJV: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
verses.WEB: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
verses.ASV: Who are crooked in their ways, And wayward in their paths:
verses.ALMEIDA: Cujas veredas são distorcidas, e desviadas em seus percursos.
verses.RVR09: Cuyas veredas son torcidas, y torcidos sus caminos.

verses.KJV: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
verses.WEB: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
verses.ASV: To deliver thee from the strange woman, Even from the foreigner that flattereth with her words;
verses.ALMEIDA: - Para te livrar da mulher estranha, e da pervertida, [que] lisonjeia com suas palavras;
verses.RVR09: Para librarte de la mujer extraña, de la ajena que halaga con sus palabras;

verses.KJV: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.WEB: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
verses.ASV: That forsaketh the friend of her youth, And forgetteth the covenant of her God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Que abandona o guia de sua juventude, e se esquece do pacto de seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Que desampara el príncipe de su mocedad, y se olvida del pacto de su Dios.

verses.KJV: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.WEB: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
verses.ASV: For her house inclineth unto death, And her paths unto the dead;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sua casa se inclina para a morte, e seus caminhos para os mortos.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual su casa está inclinada á la muerte, y sus veredas hacia los muertos:

verses.KJV: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.WEB: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
verses.ASV: None that go unto her return again, Neither do they attain unto the paths of life:
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que entrarem a ela, não voltarão mais; e não alcançarão os caminhos da vida.
verses.RVR09: Todos los que á ella entraren, no volverán, ni tomarán las veredas de la vida.

verses.KJV: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.WEB: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.ASV: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: - Para andares no caminho dos bons, e te guardares nas veredas dos justos.
verses.RVR09: Para que andes por el camino de los buenos, y guardes las veredas de los justos.

verses.KJV: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.WEB: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
verses.ASV: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os corretos habitarão a terra; e os íntegros nela permanecerão.
verses.RVR09: Porque los rectos habitarán la tierra, y los perfectos permanecerán en ella;

verses.KJV: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.WEB: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
verses.ASV: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land, And the treacherous shall be rooted out of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém os perversos serão cortados da terra, e os infiéis serão arrancados dela.
verses.RVR09: Mas los impíos serán cortados de la tierra, y los prevaricadores serán de ella desarraigados.

verses.KJV: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.WEB: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
verses.ASV: My son, forget not my law; But let thy heart keep my commandments:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, não te esqueças de minha lei; e que teu coração guarde meus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: HIJO mío, no te olvides de mi ley; y tu corazón guarde mis mandamientos:

verses.KJV: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.WEB: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
verses.ASV: For length of days, and years of life, And peace, will they add to thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque te acrescentarão extensão de dias, e anos de vida e paz.
verses.RVR09: Porque largura de días, y años de vida y paz te aumentarán.

verses.KJV: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.WEB: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.ASV: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee: Bind them about thy neck; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart:
verses.ALMEIDA: Que a bondade e a fidelidade não te desamparem; amarra-as junto ao teu pescoço; escreve-as na tábua de teu coração.
verses.RVR09: Misericordia y verdad no te desamparen; átalas á tu cuello, escríbelas en la tabla de tu corazón:

verses.KJV: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.WEB: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.ASV: So shalt thou find favor and good understanding In the sight of God and man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tu acharás graça e bom entendimento, aos olhos de Deus e dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Y hallarás gracia y buena opinión en los ojos de Dios y de los hombres.

verses.KJV: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.WEB: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
verses.ASV: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding:
verses.ALMEIDA: Confia no SENHOR com todo o teu coração; e não te apoies em teu [próprio] entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Fíate de Jehová de todo tu corazón, y no estribes en tu prudencia.

verses.KJV: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.WEB: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.ASV: In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he will direct thy paths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá reconhecimento a ele em todas os teus caminhos; e ele endireitará tuas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Reconócelo en todos tus caminos, y él enderezará tus veredas.

verses.KJV: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.
verses.WEB: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.ASV: Be not wise in thine own eyes; Fear Jehovah, and depart from evil:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejas sábio aos teus [próprios] olhos; teme ao SENHOR, e afasta-te do mal.
verses.RVR09: No seas sabio en tu opinión: teme á Jehová, y apártate del mal;

verses.KJV: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.WEB: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
verses.ASV: It will be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Isto será remédio para teu corpo, e alívio para teus ossos.
verses.RVR09: Porque será medicina á tu ombligo, y tuétano á tus huesos.

verses.KJV: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.WEB: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;
verses.ASV: Honor Jehovah with thy substance, And with the first-fruits of all thine increase:
verses.ALMEIDA: Honra ao SENHOR com teus bens, e com a primeira parte de toda a tua renda.
verses.RVR09: Honra á Jehová de tu sustancia, y de las primicias de todos tus frutos;

verses.KJV: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.WEB: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
verses.ASV: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy vats shall overflow with new wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E teus celeiros se encherão de fartura, e tuas prensas de uvas transbordarão de vinho novo.
verses.RVR09: Y serán llenas tus trojes con abundancia, y tus lagares rebosarán de mosto.

verses.KJV: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.WEB: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
verses.ASV: My son, despise not the chastening of Jehovah; Neither be weary of his reproof:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, não rejeites a correção do SENHOR, nem te desagrades de sua repreensão;
verses.RVR09: No deseches, hijo mío, el castigo de Jehová; ni te fatigues de su corrección:

verses.KJV: For whom the Lord loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.WEB: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
verses.ASV: For whom Jehovah loveth he reproveth, Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR repreende a quem ele ama, assim como o pai ao filho, [a quem] ele quer bem.
verses.RVR09: Porque al que ama castiga, como el padre al hijo á quien quiere.

verses.KJV: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
verses.WEB: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
verses.ASV: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, And the man that getteth understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado o homem que encontra sabedoria, e o homem que ganha conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el hombre que halla la sabiduría, y que obtiene la inteligencia:

verses.KJV: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.WEB: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
