verses.ASV: For the gaining of it is better than the gaining of silver, And the profit thereof than fine gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque seu produto é melhor que o produto da prata; e seu valor, mais do que o do ouro fino.
verses.RVR09: Porque su mercadería es mejor que la mercadería de la plata, y sus frutos más que el oro fino.

verses.KJV: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.WEB: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
verses.ASV: She is more precious than rubies: And none of the things thou canst desire are to be compared unto her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela é mais preciosa do que rubis; e tudo o que podes desejar não se pode comparar a ela.
verses.RVR09: Más preciosa es que las piedras preciosas; y todo lo que puedes desear, no se puede comparar á ella.

verses.KJV: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.WEB: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.ASV: Length of days is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Extensão de dias [há] em sua mão direita; em sua esquerda riquezas e honra.
verses.RVR09: Largura de días está en su mano derecha; en su izquierda riquezas y honra.

verses.KJV: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.WEB: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
verses.ASV: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus caminhos são caminhos agradáveis; e todas as suas veredas são paz.
verses.RVR09: Sus caminos son caminos deleitosos, y todas sus veredas paz.

verses.KJV: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.WEB: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
verses.ASV: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: And happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela é uma árvore de vida para os que dela pegam; e bem-aventurados são todos os que a retêm.
verses.RVR09: Ella es árbol de vida á los que de ella asen: y bienaventurados son los que la mantienen.

verses.KJV: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
verses.WEB: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
verses.ASV: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding he established the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR com sabedoria fundou a terra; ele preparou os céus com a inteligência.
verses.RVR09: Jehová con sabiduría fundó la tierra; afirmó los cielos con inteligencia.

verses.KJV: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.WEB: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
verses.ASV: By his knowledge the depths were broken up, And the skies drop down the dew.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com seu conhecimento se fenderam os abismos, e as nuvens gotejam orvalho.
verses.RVR09: Con su ciencia se partieron los abismos, y destilan el rocío los cielos.

verses.KJV: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.WEB: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
verses.ASV: My son, let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, que [estes] não se afastem de teus olhos; guarda a sabedoria e o bom-senso.
verses.RVR09: Hijo mío, no se aparten estas cosas de tus ojos; guarda la ley y el consejo;

verses.KJV: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.WEB: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
verses.ASV: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque serão vida para tua alma, e graça para teu pescoço.
verses.RVR09: Y serán vida á tu alma, y gracia á tu cuello.

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.WEB: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, And thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então andarás por teu caminho em segurança; e com teus pés não tropeçarás.
verses.RVR09: Entonces andarás por tu camino confiadamente, y tu pie no tropezará.

verses.KJV: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.WEB: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
verses.ASV: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando te deitares, não terás medo; tu deitarás, e teu sono será suave.
verses.RVR09: Cuando te acostares, no tendrás temor; antes te acostarás, y tu sueño será suave.

verses.KJV: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
verses.ASV: Be not afraid of sudden fear, Neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas o pavor repentino; nem da assolação dos perversos, quando vier.
verses.RVR09: No tendrás temor de pavor repentino, ni de la ruina de los impíos cuando viniere:

verses.KJV: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.WEB: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah will be thy confidence, And will keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR será tua esperança; e ele guardará teus pés para que não sejam presos.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová será tu confianza, y él preservará tu pie de ser preso.

verses.KJV: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
verses.WEB: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
verses.ASV: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não detenhas o bem daqueles que possuem o direito, se tiveres em tuas mãos poder para o fazeres.
verses.RVR09: No detengas el bien de sus dueños, cuando tuvieres poder para hacerlo.

verses.KJV: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.WEB: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
verses.ASV: Say not unto thy neighbor, Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give; When thou hast it by thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não digas a teu próximo: Vai, e volta [depois] , que amanhã te darei; se tu tiveres contigo [o que ele te pede] .
verses.RVR09: No digas á tu prójimo: Ve, y vuelve, y mañana te daré; cuando tienes contigo qué darle.

verses.KJV: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.WEB: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
verses.ASV: Devise not evil against thy neighbor, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não planejes o mal contra teu próximo, pois ele mora tendo confiança em ti.
verses.RVR09: No intentes mal contra tu prójimo, estando él confiado de ti.

verses.KJV: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.WEB: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
verses.ASV: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não brigues contra alguém sem motivo, se ele não fez mal contra ti.
verses.RVR09: No pleitees con alguno sin razón, si él no te ha hecho agravio.

verses.KJV: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.WEB: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
verses.ASV: Envy thou not the man of violence, And choose none of his ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tenhas inveja do homem violento, nem escolhas [seguir] algum dos caminhos dele.
verses.RVR09: No envidies al hombre injusto, ni escojas alguno de sus caminos.

verses.KJV: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.
verses.WEB: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.
verses.ASV: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah; But his friendship is with the upright.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR abomina os perversos; mas ele [guarda] o seu segredo com os justos.
verses.RVR09: Porque el perverso es abominado de Jehová: mas su secreto es con los rectos.

verses.KJV: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
verses.ASV: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked; But he blesseth the habitation of the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: A maldição do SENHOR [está] na casa do perverso; porém ele abençoa a morada dos justos.
verses.RVR09: La maldición de Jehová está en la casa del impío; mas él bendecirá la morada de los justos.

verses.KJV: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.WEB: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
verses.ASV: Surely he scoffeth at the scoffers; But he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente ele zombará dos zombadores; mas dará graça aos humildes.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente él escarnecerá á los escarnecedores, y á los humildes dará gracia.

verses.KJV: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.WEB: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
verses.ASV: The wise shall inherit glory; But shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os sábios herdarão honra; porém os loucos terão sobre si confusão.
verses.RVR09: Los sabios heredarán honra: mas los necios sostendrán ignominia.

verses.KJV: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.WEB: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
verses.ASV: Hear, [my] sons, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi, filhos, a correção do pai; e prestai atenção, para que conheçais o entendimento.
verses.RVR09: OID, hijos, la doctrina de un padre, y estad atentos para que conozcáis cordura.

verses.KJV: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
verses.WEB: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
verses.ASV: For I give you good doctrine; Forsake ye not my law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu vos dou boa doutrina; não deixeis a minha lei.
verses.RVR09: Porque os doy buena enseñanza; no desamparéis mi ley.

verses.KJV: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
verses.WEB: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
verses.ASV: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu era filho do meu pai; tenro, e único perante a face de minha mãe.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo fuí hijo de mi padre, delicado y único delante de mi madre.

verses.KJV: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.WEB: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
verses.ASV: And he taught me, and said unto me: Let thy heart retain my words; Keep my commandments, and live;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele me ensinava, e me dizia: Que teu coração retenha minhas palavras; guarda meus mandamentos, e vive.
verses.RVR09: Y él me enseñaba, y me decía: Mantenga tu corazón mis razones, guarda mis mandamientos, y vivirás:

verses.KJV: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.WEB: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
verses.ASV: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Adquire sabedoria, adquire entendimento; [e] não te esqueças nem te desvies das palavras de minha boca.
verses.RVR09: Adquiere sabiduría, adquiere inteligencia; no te olvides ni te apartes de las razones de mi boca;

verses.KJV: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
verses.WEB: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
verses.ASV: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não a abandones, e ela te guardará; ama-a, e ela te conservará.
verses.RVR09: No la dejes, y ella te guardará; ámala, y te conservará.

verses.KJV: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.WEB: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
verses.ASV: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [therefore] get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: O principal é a sabedoria; adquire sabedoria, e acima de tudo o que adquirires, adquire entendimento.
verses.RVR09: Sabiduría ante todo: adquiere sabiduría: y ante toda tu posesión adquiere inteligencia.

verses.KJV: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.WEB: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
verses.ASV: Exalt her, and she will promote thee; She will bring thee to honor, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exalta-a, e ela te exaltará; quando tu a abraçares, ela te honrará.
verses.RVR09: Engrandécela, y ella te engrandecerá: ella te honrará, cuando tú la hubieres abrazado.

verses.KJV: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
verses.WEB: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
verses.ASV: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of beauty will she deliver to thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela dará a tua cabeça um ornamento gracioso; ela te entregará uma bela coroa.
verses.RVR09: Adorno de gracia dará á tu cabeza: corona de hermosura te entregará.

verses.KJV: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.WEB: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
verses.ASV: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, filho meu, e recebe minhas palavras; e elas te acrescentarão anos de vida.
verses.RVR09: Oye, hijo mío, y recibe mis razones; y se te multiplicarán años de vida.

verses.KJV: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
verses.WEB: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
verses.ASV: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te ensino no caminho da sabedoria; [e] te faço andar pelos percursos direitos.
verses.RVR09: Por el camino de la sabiduría te he encaminado, y por veredas derechas te he hecho andar.

verses.KJV: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.WEB: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
verses.ASV: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando tu andares, teus passos não se estreitarão; e se tu correres, não tropeçarás.
verses.RVR09: Cuando anduvieres no se estrecharán tus pasos; y si corrieres, no tropezarás.

verses.KJV: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
verses.WEB: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
verses.ASV: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: Keep her; for she is thy life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma a correção para si, e não [a] largues; guarda-a, porque ela [é] tua vida.
verses.RVR09: Ten el consejo, no lo dejes; guárdalo, porque eso es tu vida.

verses.KJV: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
verses.WEB: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
verses.ASV: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não entres pela vereda dos perversos, nem andes pelo caminho dos maus.
verses.RVR09: No entres por la vereda de los impíos, ni vayas por el camino de los malos.

verses.KJV: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
verses.WEB: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
verses.ASV: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rejeita-o! Não passes por ele; desvia-te dele, e passa longe.
verses.RVR09: Desampárala, no pases por ella; apártate de ella, pasa.

verses.KJV: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.WEB: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
verses.ASV: For they sleep not, except they do evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eles não dormem se não fizerem o mal; e ficam sem sono, se não fizerem tropeçar [a alguém] .
verses.RVR09: Porque no duermen ellos, si no hicieren mal; y pierden su sueño, si no han hecho caer.

verses.KJV: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.WEB: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
verses.ASV: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque comem pão da maldade, e bebem vinho de violências.
verses.RVR09: Porque comen pan de maldad, y beben vino de robos.

verses.KJV: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.WEB: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
verses.ASV: But the path of the righteous is as the dawning light, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o caminho dos justos é como a luz brilhante, que vai, e ilumina até o dia [ficar claro] por completo.
verses.RVR09: Mas la senda de los justos es como la luz de la aurora, que va en aumento hasta que el día es perfecto.

verses.KJV: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.WEB: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
verses.ASV: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho dos perversos é como a escuridão; não sabem nem em que tropeçam.
verses.RVR09: El camino de los impíos es como la oscuridad: no saben en qué tropiezan.

verses.KJV: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.WEB: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
verses.ASV: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, presta atenção às minhas palavras; e ouve as minhas instruções.
verses.RVR09: Hijo mío, está atento á mis palabras; inclina tu oído á mis razones.

verses.KJV: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
verses.WEB: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
verses.ASV: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não as deixes ficarem longe de teus olhos; guarda-as no meio de teu coração.
verses.RVR09: No se aparten de tus ojos; guárdalas en medio de tu corazón.

verses.KJV: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.WEB: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
verses.ASV: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque são vida para aqueles que as encontram; e saúde para todo o seu corpo.
verses.RVR09: Porque son vida á los que las hallan, y medicina á toda su carne.

verses.KJV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.WEB: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
verses.ASV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Acima de tudo o que se deve guardar, guarda o teu coração; porque dele [procedem] as saídas da vida.
verses.RVR09: Sobre toda cosa guardada guarda tu corazón; porque de él mana la vida.

verses.KJV: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.WEB: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
verses.ASV: Put away from thee a wayward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afasta de ti a perversidade da boca; e põe longe de ti a corrupção dos lábios.
verses.RVR09: Aparta de ti la perversidad de la boca, y aleja de ti la iniquidad de labios.

verses.KJV: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.WEB: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
verses.ASV: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus olhos olhem direito; tuas pálpebras estejam corretas diante de ti.
verses.RVR09: Tus ojos miren lo recto, y tus párpados en derechura delante de ti.

verses.KJV: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
verses.WEB: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
verses.ASV: Make level the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pondera o curso de teus pés; e todos os teus caminhos sejam bem ordenados.
verses.RVR09: Examina la senda de tus pies, y todos tus caminos sean ordenados.

verses.KJV: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.WEB: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
verses.ASV: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: Remove thy foot from evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te desvies nem para a direita, nem para a esquerda; afasta teus pés do mal.
verses.RVR09: No te apartes á diestra, ni á siniestra: aparta tu pie del mal.

verses.KJV: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
verses.WEB: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
verses.ASV: My son, attend unto my wisdom; Incline thine ear to my understanding:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, presta atenção à minha sabedoria, inclina teus ouvidos ao meu entendimento.
verses.RVR09: HIJO mío, está atento á mi sabiduría, y á mi inteligencia inclina tu oído;

verses.KJV: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.WEB: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
verses.ASV: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que guardes o bom-senso; e teus lábios conservem o conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Para que guardes consejo, y tus labios conserven la ciencia.

verses.KJV: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
verses.WEB: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
verses.ASV: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os lábios da mulher pervertida gotejam mel; e sua boca é mais suave que o azeite.
verses.RVR09: Porque los labios de la extraña destilan miel, y su paladar es más blando que el aceite:

verses.KJV: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.WEB: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.ASV: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém seu fim é mais amargo que o absinto; é afiado como a espada de dois fios.
verses.RVR09: Mas su fin es amargo como el ajenjo, agudo como cuchillo de dos filos.

verses.KJV: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
verses.WEB: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
verses.ASV: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on Sheol;
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus pés descem à morte; seus passos conduzem ao Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Sus pies descienden á la muerte; sus pasos sustentan el sepulcro:

verses.KJV: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
verses.WEB: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
verses.ASV: So that she findeth not the level path of life: Her ways are unstable, [and] she knoweth [it] not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não ponderes a vereda da vida, os percursos delas são errantes, e tu não os conhecerás.
verses.RVR09: Sus caminos son instables; no los conocerás, si no considerares el camino de vida.

verses.KJV: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, filhos, escutai-me; e não vos desvieis das palavras de minha boca.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, hijos, oidme, y no os apartéis de las razones de mi boca.

verses.KJV: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
verses.WEB: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
verses.ASV: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mantenha teu caminho longe dela; e não te aproximes da porta da casa dela.
verses.RVR09: Aleja de ella tu camino, y no te acerques á la puerta de su casa;

verses.KJV: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
verses.WEB: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
verses.ASV: Lest thou give thine honor unto others, And thy years unto the cruel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não dês tua honra a outros, nem teus anos [de vida] aos cruéis.
verses.RVR09: Porque no des á los extraños tu honor, y tus años á cruel;

verses.KJV: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
verses.WEB: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
verses.ASV: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labors [be] in the house of an alien,
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que estranhos não se fartem de teu poder, e teus trabalhos [não sejam] aproveitados em casa alheia;
verses.RVR09: Porque no se harten los extraños de tu fuerza, y tus trabajos estén en casa del extraño;

verses.KJV: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.WEB: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
verses.ASV: And thou mourn at thy latter end, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.ALMEIDA: E gemas em teu fim, quando tua carne e teu corpo estiverem consumidos.
verses.RVR09: Y gimas en tus postrimerías, cuando se consumiere tu carne y tu cuerpo,

verses.KJV: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.WEB: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.
verses.ASV: And say, How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;
verses.ALMEIDA: E digas: Como eu odiei a correção, e meu coração desprezou a repreensão?
verses.RVR09: Y digas: ¡Cómo aborrecí el consejo, y mi corazón menospreció la reprensión;

verses.KJV: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.WEB: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
verses.ASV: Neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.ALMEIDA: E não escutei a voz de meus ensinadores, nem ouvi a meus mestres.
verses.RVR09: Y no oí la voz de los que me adoctrinaban, y á los que me enseñaban no incliné mi oído!

verses.KJV: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.WEB: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
verses.ASV: I was well-nigh in all evil In the midst of the assembly and congregation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quase me achei em todo mal, no meio da congregação e do ajuntamento.
verses.RVR09: Casi en todo mal he estado, en medio de la sociedad y de la congregación.

verses.KJV: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
verses.WEB: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
verses.ASV: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bebe água de tua [própria] cisterna, e das correntes de teu [próprio] poço.
verses.RVR09: Bebe el agua de tu cisterna, y los raudales de tu pozo.

verses.KJV: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
verses.WEB: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
verses.ASV: Should thy springs be dispersed abroad, And streams of water in the streets?
verses.ALMEIDA: Derramar-se-iam por fora tuas fontes, [e] pelas ruas os ribeiros de águas?
verses.RVR09: Derrámense por de fuera tus fuentes, en las plazas los ríos de aguas.

verses.KJV: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.
verses.WEB: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
verses.ASV: Let them be for thyself alone, And not for strangers with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sejam somente para ti, e não para os estranhos contigo.
verses.RVR09: Sean para ti solo, y no para los extraños contigo.

verses.KJV: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
verses.WEB: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
verses.ASV: Let thy fountain be blessed; And rejoice in the wife of thy youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja bendito o teu manancial, e alegra-te com a mulher de tua juventude.
verses.RVR09: Sea bendito tu manantial; y alégrate con la mujer de tu mocedad.

verses.KJV: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.WEB: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
verses.ASV: [As] a loving hind and a pleasant doe, Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; And be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Seja ela] uma cerva amorosa e gazela graciosa; que os seios dela te fartem em todo tempo; e anda pelo caminho do amor dela continuamente.
verses.RVR09: Como cierva amada y graciosa corza, sus pechos te satisfagan en todo tiempo; y en su amor recréate siempre.

verses.KJV: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
verses.WEB: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
verses.ASV: For why shouldest thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of a foreigner?
verses.ALMEIDA: E por que tu, filho meu, andarias perdido pela estranha, e abraçarias o peito da [mulher] alheia?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y por qué, hijo mío, andarás ciego con la ajena, y abrazarás el seno de la extraña?

verses.KJV: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he pondereth all his goings.
verses.WEB: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
verses.ASV: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah; And he maketh level all his paths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os caminhos do homem estão perante os olhos do SENHOR; e ele pondera todos os seus percursos.
verses.RVR09: Pues que los caminos del hombre están ante los ojos de Jehová, y él considera todas sus veredas.

verses.KJV: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
verses.WEB: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
verses.ASV: His own iniquities shall take the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso será preso pelas suas [próprias] perversidades; e será detido pelas cordas de seu [próprio] pecado.
verses.RVR09: Prenderán al impío sus propias iniquidades, y detenido será con las cuerdas de su pecado.

verses.KJV: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.WEB: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
verses.ASV: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele morrerá pela falta de correção; e andará sem rumo pela grandeza de sua loucura.
verses.RVR09: El morirá por falta de corrección; y errará por la grandeza de su locura.

verses.KJV: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
verses.WEB: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
verses.ASV: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbor, If thou hast stricken thy hands for a stranger;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, se ficaste fiador por teu próximo, [se] deste tua garantia ao estranho;
verses.RVR09: HIJO mío, si salieres fiador por tu amigo, si tocaste tu mano por el extraño,

verses.KJV: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.WEB: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
verses.ASV: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, Thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Se] tu foste capturado pelas palavras de tua [própria] boca, e te prendeste pelas palavras de tua boca,
verses.RVR09: Enlazado eres con las palabras de tu boca, y preso con las razones de tu boca.

verses.KJV: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
verses.WEB: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
verses.ASV: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, Seeing thou art come into the hand of thy neighbor: Go, humble thyself, and importune thy neighbor;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então faze isto agora, meu filho, e livra-te, pois caíste nas mãos de teu próximo; vai, humilha-te, e insiste exaustivamente ao teu próximo.
verses.RVR09: Haz esto ahora, hijo mío, y líbrate, ya que has caído en la mano de tu prójimo: ve, humíllate, y asegúrate de tu amigo.

verses.KJV: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.WEB: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
verses.ASV: Give not sleep to thine eyes, Nor slumber to thine eyelids;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não dês sono aos teus olhos, nem cochilo às tuas pálpebras.
verses.RVR09: No des sueño á tus ojos, ni á tus párpados adormecimiento.

verses.KJV: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.WEB: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
verses.ASV: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand [of the hunter], And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra-te, como a corça do caçador, como o pássaro do caçador de aves.
verses.RVR09: Escápate como el corzo de la mano del cazador, y como el ave de la mano del parancero.

verses.KJV: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.WEB: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
verses.ASV: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai até a formiga, preguiçoso; olha para os caminhos dela, e sê sábio.
verses.RVR09: Ve á la hormiga, oh perezoso, mira sus caminos, y sé sabio;

verses.KJV: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.WEB: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
verses.ASV: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela, [mesmo] não tendo chefe, nem fiscal, nem dominador,
verses.RVR09: La cual no teniendo capitán, ni gobernador, ni señor,

verses.KJV: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.WEB: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
verses.ASV: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Prepara seu alimento no verão, na ceifa ajunta seu mantimento.
verses.RVR09: Prepara en el verano su comida y allega en el tiempo de la siega su mantenimiento.

verses.KJV: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.WEB: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
verses.ASV: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó preguiçoso, até quando estarás deitado? Quando te levantarás de teu sono?
verses.RVR09: Perezoso, ¿hasta cuándo has de dormir? ¿cuándo te levantarás de tu sueño?

verses.KJV: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.WEB: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
verses.ASV: [Yet] a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.ALMEIDA: Um pouco de sono, um pouco de cochilo; um pouco de descanso com as mãos cruzadas;
verses.RVR09: Un poco de sueño, un poco de dormitar, y cruzar por un poco las manos para reposo:

verses.KJV: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
verses.WEB: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
verses.ASV: So shall thy poverty come as a robber, And thy want as an armed man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim a pobreza virá sobre ti como um assaltante; a necessidade [chegará] a ti como um homem armado.
verses.RVR09: Así vendrá tu necesidad como caminante, y tu pobreza como hombre de escudo.

verses.KJV: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
verses.WEB: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
verses.ASV: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, Is he that walketh with a perverse mouth;
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem mal, o homem injusto, anda com uma boca perversa.
verses.RVR09: El hombre malo, el hombre depravado, anda en perversidad de boca;

verses.KJV: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
verses.WEB: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
verses.ASV: That winketh with his eyes, that speaketh with his feet, That maketh signs with his fingers;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele acena com os olhos, fala com seus pés, aponta com seus dedos.
verses.RVR09: Guiña de sus ojos, habla con sus pies, indica con sus dedos;

verses.KJV: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
verses.WEB: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
verses.ASV: In whose heart is perverseness, Who deviseth evil continually, Who soweth discord.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perversidades há em seu coração; todo o tempo ele trama o mal; anda semeando brigas.
verses.RVR09: Perversidades hay en su corazón, anda pensando mal en todo tiempo; enciende rencillas.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.WEB: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso sua perdição virá repentinamente; subitamente ele será quebrado, e não haverá cura.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto su calamidad vendrá de repente; súbitamente será quebrantado, y no habrá remedio.

verses.KJV: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
verses.WEB: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
verses.ASV: There are six things which Jehovah hateth; Yea, seven which are an abomination unto him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas seis coisas o SENHOR odeia; e sete sua alma abomina:
verses.RVR09: Seis cosas aborrece Jehová, y aun siete abomina su alma:

verses.KJV: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.WEB: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.ASV: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood;
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhos arrogantes, língua mentirosa, e mãos que derramam sangue inocente;
verses.RVR09: Los ojos altivos, la lengua mentirosa, las manos derramadoras de sangre inocente,

verses.KJV: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.WEB: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
verses.ASV: A heart that deviseth wicked purposes, Feet that are swift in running to mischief,
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração que trama planos malignos, pés que se apressam a correr para o mal;
verses.RVR09: El corazón que maquina pensamientos inicuos, los pies presurosos para correr al mal,

verses.KJV: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.WEB: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
verses.ASV: A false witness that uttereth lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: A falsa testemunha, que sopra mentiras; e o que semeia brigas entre irmãos.
verses.RVR09: El testigo falso que habla mentiras, y el que enciende rencillas entre los hermanos.

verses.KJV: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.WEB: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
verses.ASV: My son, keep the commandment of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, guarda o mandamento de teu pai; e não abandones a lei de tua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Guarda, hijo mío, el mandamiento de tu padre, y no dejes la enseñanza de tu madre:

verses.KJV: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
verses.WEB: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
verses.ASV: Bind them continually upon thy heart; Tie them about thy neck.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amarra-os continuamente em teu coração; e pendura-os ao teu pescoço.
verses.RVR09: Atalos siempre en tu corazón, enlázalos á tu cuello.

verses.KJV: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.WEB: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
verses.ASV: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; When thou sleepest, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando caminhares, [isto] te guiará; quando deitares, [isto] te guardará; quando acordares, [isto] falará contigo.
verses.RVR09: Te guiarán cuando anduvieres; cuando durmieres te guardarán; hablarán contigo cuando despertares.

verses.KJV: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.WEB: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
verses.ASV: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; And reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o mandamento é uma lâmpada, e a lei é luz; e as repreensões para correção são o caminho da vida;
verses.RVR09: Porque el mandamiento es antorcha, y la enseñanza luz; y camino de vida las reprensiones de la enseñanza:

verses.KJV: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
verses.WEB: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
verses.ASV: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the flattery of the foreigner’s tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para te protegerem da mulher má, das lisonjas da língua da estranha.
verses.RVR09: Para que te guarden de la mala mujer, de la blandura de la lengua de la extraña.

verses.KJV: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.WEB: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
verses.ASV: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não cobices a formosura dela em teu coração; nem te prenda em seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: No codicies su hermosura en tu corazón, ni ella te prenda con sus ojos:

verses.KJV: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adultress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.WEB: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
verses.ASV: For on account of a harlot [a man is brought] to a piece of bread; And the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pela mulher prostituta [chega-se a pedir] um pedaço de pão; e a mulher de [outro] homem anda à caça de uma alma preciosa.
verses.RVR09: Porque á causa de la mujer ramera es reducido el hombre á un bocado de pan; y la mujer caza la preciosa alma del varón.

verses.KJV: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.WEB: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.ASV: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso pode alguém botar fogo em seu peito, sem que suas roupas se queimem?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tomará el hombre fuego en su seno, sin que sus vestidos se quemen?

verses.KJV: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.WEB: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
verses.ASV: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ou] alguém pode andar sobre as brasas, sem seus pés se arderem?
verses.RVR09: ¿Andará el hombre sobre las brasas, sin que sus pies se abrasen?

verses.KJV: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
verses.WEB: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
verses.ASV: So he that goeth in to his neighbor’s wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not be unpunished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim [será] aquele que se deitar com a mulher de seu próximo; não será considerado inocente todo aquele que a tocar.
verses.RVR09: Así el que entrare á la mujer de su prójimo; no será sin culpa cualquiera que la tocare.

verses.KJV: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.WEB: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,
verses.ASV: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy himself when he is hungry:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se despreza ao ladrão, quando furta para saciar sua alma, tendo fome;
verses.RVR09: No tienen en poco al ladrón, cuando hurtare para saciar su alma teniendo hambre:

verses.KJV: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.WEB: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
verses.ASV: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; He shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas, [se for] achado, ele pagará sete vezes mais; ele terá que dar todos os bens de sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Empero tomado, paga las setenas, da toda la sustancia de su casa.

verses.KJV: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
verses.WEB: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
verses.ASV: He that committeth adultery with a woman is void of understanding: He doeth it who would destroy his own soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém] aquele que adultera com mulher [alheia] tem falta de entendimento; quem faz [isso] destrói sua [própria] alma.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que comete adulterio con la mujer, es falto de entendimiento: corrompe su alma el que tal hace.

verses.KJV: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.WEB: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
verses.ASV: Wounds and dishonor shall he get; And his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele encontrará castigo e desgraça; e sua desonra nunca será apagada.
verses.RVR09: Plaga y vergüenza hallará; y su afrenta nunca será raída.

verses.KJV: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.WEB: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.ASV: For jealousy is the rage of a man; And he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ciúmes [são] a fúria do marido, e ele de maneira nenhuma terá misericórdia no dia da vingança.
verses.RVR09: Porque los celos son el furor del hombre, y no perdonará en el día de la venganza.

verses.KJV: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.WEB: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
verses.ASV: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não aceitará nenhum pagamento pela culpa; nem consentirá, ainda que aumentes os presentes.
verses.RVR09: No tendrá respeto á ninguna redención; ni querrá perdonar, aunque multipliques los dones.

verses.KJV: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.WEB: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
verses.ASV: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, guarda minhas palavras; e deposita em ti meus mandamentos.
verses.RVR09: HIJO mío, guarda mis razones, y encierra contigo mis mandamientos.

verses.KJV: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.WEB: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
verses.ASV: Keep my commandments and live; And my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda meus mandamentos, e vive; e minha lei, como as pupilas de teus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Guarda mis mandamientos, y vivirás; y mi ley como las niñas de tus ojos.

verses.KJV: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
verses.WEB: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.ASV: Bind them upon thy fingers; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ata-os aos teus dedos; escreve-os na tábua do teu coração.
verses.RVR09: Lígalos á tus dedos; escríbelos en la tabla de tu corazón.

verses.KJV: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
verses.WEB: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
verses.ASV: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; And call understanding [thy] kinswoman:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize à sabedoria: Tu és minha irmã; E à prudência chama de parente.
verses.RVR09: Di á la sabiduría: Tú eres mi hermana; y á la inteligencia llama parienta:

verses.KJV: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
verses.WEB: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
verses.ASV: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the foreigner that flattereth with her words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que te guardem da mulher alheia, da estranha, [que] lisonjeia com suas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Para que te guarden de la mujer ajena, y de la extraña que ablanda sus palabras.

verses.KJV: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
verses.WEB: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
verses.ASV: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque da janela de minha casa, pelas minhas grades eu olhei;
verses.RVR09: Porque mirando yo por la ventana de mi casa, por mi celosía,

verses.KJV: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
verses.WEB: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
verses.ASV: And I beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,
verses.ALMEIDA: E vi entre os simples, prestei atenção entre os jovens, um rapaz que tinha falta de juízo;
verses.RVR09: Vi entre los simples, consideré entre los jóvenes, un mancebo falto de entendimiento,

verses.KJV: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.WEB: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
verses.ASV: Passing through the street near her corner; And he went the way to her house,
verses.ALMEIDA: Que estava passando pela rua junto a sua esquina, e seguia o caminho da casa dela;
verses.RVR09: El cual pasaba por la calle, junto á la esquina de aquella, é iba camino de su casa,

verses.KJV: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
verses.WEB: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
verses.ASV: In the twilight, in the evening of the day, In the middle of the night and in the darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: No crepúsculo, ao entardecer do dia, no escurecer da noite e nas trevas.
verses.RVR09: A la tarde del día, ya que oscurecía, en la oscuridad y tiniebla de la noche.

verses.KJV: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
verses.WEB: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
verses.ASV: And, behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que uma mulher lhe [saiu] ao encontro, com roupas de prostituta, e astuta de coração.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, una mujer que le sale al encuentro con atavío de ramera, astuta de corazón,

verses.KJV: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
verses.WEB: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
verses.ASV: (She is clamorous and wilful; Her feet abide not in her house:
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta era barulhenta e insubordinada; os pés dela não paravam em sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Alborotadora y rencillosa, sus pies no pueden estar en casa;

verses.KJV: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.WEB: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
verses.ASV: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places, And lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.ALMEIDA: De tempos em tempos ela fica fora [de casa] ,nas ruas, espreitando em todos os cantos.
verses.RVR09: Unas veces de fuera, ó bien por las plazas, acechando por todas las esquinas.

verses.KJV: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
verses.WEB: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
verses.ASV: So she caught him, and kissed him, [And] with an impudent face she said unto him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ela o pegou, e o beijou; e com atrevimento em seu rosto, disse-lhe:
verses.RVR09: Y traba de él, y bésalo; desvergonzó su rostro, y díjole:

verses.KJV: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
verses.WEB: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
verses.ASV: Sacrifices of peace-offerings are with me; This day have I paid my vows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sacrifícios pacíficos tenho comigo; hoje paguei meus votos.
verses.RVR09: Sacrificios de paz había prometido, hoy he pagado mis votos;

verses.KJV: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.WEB: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
verses.ASV: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, Diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso saí para te encontrar; para buscar apressadamente a tua face, e te achei.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto he salido á encontrarte, buscando diligentemente tu rostro, y te he hallado.

verses.KJV: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
verses.WEB: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
verses.ASV: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já preparei minha cama com cobertas; com tecidos de linho fino do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Con paramentos he ataviado mi cama, recamados con cordoncillo de Egipto.

verses.KJV: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.WEB: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.ASV: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já perfumei meu leito com mirra, aloés e canela.
verses.RVR09: He sahumado mi cámara con mirra, áloes, y cinamomo.

verses.KJV: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.WEB: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
verses.ASV: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; Let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vem [comigo] ; iremos nos embebedar de paixões até a manhã, e nos alegraremos de amores.
verses.RVR09: Ven, embriaguémonos de amores hasta la mañana; alegrémonos en amores.

verses.KJV: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.WEB: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
verses.ASV: For the man is not at home; He is gone a long journey:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque [meu] marido não está em casa; ele viajou para longe.
verses.RVR09: Porque el marido no está en casa, hase ido á un largo viaje:

verses.KJV: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
verses.WEB: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
verses.ASV: He hath taken a bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele tomou uma bolsa de dinheiro em sua mão; [e só] volta para casa no dia determinado.
verses.RVR09: El saco de dinero llevó en su mano; el día señalado volverá á su casa.

verses.KJV: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
verses.WEB: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
verses.ASV: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield; With the flattering of her lips she forceth him along.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela o convenceu com suas muitas palavras sedutoras; com a lisonja de seus lábios ela o persuadiu.
verses.RVR09: Rindiólo con la mucha suavidad de sus palabras, obligóle con la blandura de sus labios.

verses.KJV: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
verses.WEB: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
verses.ASV: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox goeth to the slaughter, Or as [one in] fetters to the correction of the fool;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele foi logo após ela, como o boi vai ao matadouro; e como o louco ao castigo das prisões.
verses.RVR09: Vase en pos de ella luego, como va el buey al degolladero, y como el loco á las prisiones para ser castigado;

verses.KJV: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
verses.WEB: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
verses.ASV: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteth to the snare, And knoweth not that it is for his life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que uma flecha atravesse seu fígado; como a ave que se apressa para a armadilha, e não sabe que está [armada] contra sua vida.
verses.RVR09: Como el ave que se apresura al lazo, y no sabe que es contra su vida, hasta que la saeta traspasó su hígado.

verses.KJV: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora pois, filhos, escutai-me; e prestai atenção às palavras de minha boca.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, hijos, oidme, y estad atentos á las razones de mi boca.

verses.KJV: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
verses.WEB: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
verses.ASV: Let not thy heart decline to her ways; Go not astray in her paths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que teu coração não se desvie para os caminhos dela, e não andes perdido pelas veredas dela.
verses.RVR09: No se aparte á sus caminos tu corazón; no yerres en sus veredas.

verses.KJV: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
verses.WEB: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
verses.ASV: For she hath cast down many wounded: Yea, all her slain are a mighty host.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ela derrubou muitos feridos; e são muitíssimos os que por ela foram mortos.
verses.RVR09: Porque á muchos ha hecho caer heridos; y aun los más fuertes han sido muertos por ella.

verses.KJV: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.WEB: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
verses.ASV: Her house is the way to Sheol, Going down to the chambers of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: A sua casa é caminho para o Xeol, que desce para as câmaras da morte.
verses.RVR09: Caminos del sepulcro son su casa, que descienden á las cámaras de la muerte.

verses.KJV: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.WEB: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
verses.ASV: Doth not wisdom cry, And understanding put forth her voice?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso a sabedoria não clama, e a inteligência não solta sua voz?
verses.RVR09: ¿NO clama la sabiduría, y da su voz la inteligencia?

verses.KJV: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
verses.WEB: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
verses.ASV: On the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nos lugares mais altos, junto ao caminho, nas encruzilhadas das veredas, ela se põe.
verses.RVR09: En los altos cabezos, junto al camino, á las encrucijadas de las veredas se para;

verses.KJV: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
verses.WEB: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
verses.ASV: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao lado das portas, à entrada da cidade; na entrada dos portões, ela grita:
verses.RVR09: En el lugar de las puertas, á la entrada de la ciudad, á la entrada de las puertas da voces:

verses.KJV: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
verses.WEB: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
verses.ASV: Unto you, O men, I call; And my voice is to the sons of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Varões, eu vos clamo; [dirijo] minha voz aos filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Oh hombres, á vosotros clamo; y mi voz es á los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
verses.WEB: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
verses.ASV: O ye simple, understand prudence; And, ye fools, be of an understanding heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós que sois ingênuos, entendei a prudência; e vós que sois loucos, entendei [de] coração.
verses.RVR09: Entended, simples, discreción; y vosotros, locos, entrad en cordura.

verses.KJV: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
verses.WEB: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
verses.ASV: Hear, for I will speak excellent things; And the opening of my lips shall be right things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi, porque falarei coisas nobres; e abro meus lábios para a justiça.
verses.RVR09: Oid, porque hablaré cosas excelentes; y abriré mis labios para cosas rectas.

verses.KJV: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.WEB: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.ASV: For my mouth shall utter truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque minha boca declarará a verdade; e meus lábios abominam a maldade.
verses.RVR09: Porque mi boca hablará verdad, y la impiedad abominan mis labios.

verses.KJV: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
verses.WEB: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
verses.ASV: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as coisas que digo com minha boca são justas; não há nelas coisa alguma [que seja] distorcida ou perversa.
verses.RVR09: En justicia son todas las razones de mi boca; no hay en ellas cosa perversa ni torcida.

verses.KJV: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
verses.WEB: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
verses.ASV: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas elas são corretas para aquele que as entende; e justas para os que encontram conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Todas ellas son rectas al que entiende, y razonables á los que han hallado sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.WEB: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.ASV: Receive my instruction, and not silver; And knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aceitai minha correção, e não prata; e o conhecimento mais que o ouro fino escolhido.
verses.RVR09: Recibid mi enseñanza, y no plata; y ciencia antes que el oro escogido.

verses.KJV: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
verses.WEB: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
verses.ASV: For wisdom is better than rubies; And all the things that may be desired are not to be compared unto it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a sabedoria é melhor do que rubis; e todas as coisas desejáveis nem sequer podem ser comparadas a ela.
verses.RVR09: Porque mejor es la sabiduría que las piedras preciosas; y todas las cosas que se pueden desear, no son de comparar con ella.

verses.KJV: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
verses.WEB: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
verses.ASV: I wisdom have made prudence my dwelling, And find out knowledge [and] discretion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, a Sabedoria, moro com a Prudência; e tenho o conhecimento do conselho.
verses.RVR09: Yo, la sabiduría, habito con la discreción, y hallo la ciencia de los consejos.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil: Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the perverse mouth, do I hate.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR é odiar o mal: a soberba e a arrogância, o mal caminho e a boca perversa, eu [os] odeio.
verses.RVR09: El temor de Jehová es aborrecer el mal; la soberbia y la arrogancia, y el mal camino y la boca perversa, aborrezco.

verses.KJV: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
verses.WEB: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
verses.ASV: Counsel is mine, and sound knowledge: I am understanding; I have might.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mim pertence o conselho e a verdadeira sabedoria; eu [tenho] prudência e poder.
verses.RVR09: Conmigo está el consejo y el ser; yo soy la inteligencia; mía es la fortaleza.

verses.KJV: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.WEB: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.ASV: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por meio de mim os reis governam, e os príncipes decretam justiça.
verses.RVR09: Por mí reinan los reyes, y los príncipes determinan justicia.

verses.KJV: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
verses.WEB: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
verses.ASV: By me princes rule, And nobles, [even] all the judges of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por meio de mim os governantes dominam; e autoridades, todos os juízes justos.
verses.RVR09: Por mí dominan los príncipes, y todos los gobernadores juzgan la tierra.

verses.KJV: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
verses.WEB: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
verses.ASV: I love them that love me; And those that seek me diligently shall find me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu amo os que me amam; e os que me buscam intensamente me acharão.
verses.RVR09: Yo amo á los que me aman; y me hallan los que madrugando me buscan.

verses.KJV: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
verses.WEB: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
verses.ASV: Riches and honor are with me; [Yea], durable wealth and righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bens e honra estão comigo; [assim como] a riqueza duradoura e a justiça.
verses.RVR09: Las riquezas y la honra están conmigo; sólidas riquezas, y justicia.

verses.KJV: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
verses.WEB: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
verses.ASV: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my revenue than choice silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu fruto é melhor que o ouro, melhor que o ouro refinado; e meus produtos melhores que a prata escolhida.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es mi fruto que el oro, y que el oro refinado; y mi rédito mejor que la plata escogida.

verses.KJV: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
verses.WEB: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
verses.ASV: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu faço andar pelo caminho da justiça, no meio das veredas do juízo;
verses.RVR09: Por vereda de justicia guiaré, por en medio de sendas de juicio;

verses.KJV: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
verses.WEB: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
verses.ASV: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para eu dar herança aos que me amam, e encher seus tesouros.
verses.RVR09: Para hacer heredar á mis amigos el ser, y que yo hincha sus tesoros.

verses.KJV: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
verses.WEB: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
verses.ASV: Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, Before his works of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR me adquiriu no princípio de seu caminho; desde antes de suas obras antigas.
verses.RVR09: Jehová me poseía en el principio de su camino, ya de antiguo, antes de sus obras.

verses.KJV: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
verses.WEB: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
verses.ASV: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Before the earth was.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde a eternidade eu fui ungida; desde o princípio; desde antes do surgimento da terra.
verses.RVR09: Eternalmente tuve el principado, desde el principio, antes de la tierra.

verses.KJV: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
verses.WEB: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
verses.ASV: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ainda não havia abismos, eu fui gerada; quando ainda não havia fontes providas de muitas águas.
verses.RVR09: Antes de los abismos fuí engendrada; antes que fuesen las fuentes de las muchas aguas.

verses.KJV: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
verses.WEB: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
verses.ASV: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que os montes fossem firmados; antes dos morros, eu fui gerada.
verses.RVR09: Antes que los montes fuesen fundados, antes de los collados, era yo engendrada:

verses.KJV: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
verses.WEB: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
verses.ASV: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele ainda não tinha feito a terra, nem os campos; nem o princípio da poeira do mundo.
verses.RVR09: No había aún hecho la tierra, ni las campiñas, ni el principio del polvo del mundo.

verses.KJV: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
verses.WEB: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
verses.ASV: When he established the heavens, I was there: When he set a circle upon the face of the deep,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando preparava os céus, ali eu estava; quando ele desenhava ao redor da face do abismo.
verses.RVR09: Cuando formaba los cielos, allí estaba yo; cuando señalaba por compás la sobrefaz del abismo;

verses.KJV: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
verses.WEB: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
verses.ASV: When he made firm the skies above, When the fountains of the deep became strong,
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando firmava as nuvens de cima, quando fortificava as fontes do abismo.
verses.RVR09: Cuando afirmaba los cielos arriba, cuando afirmaba las fuentes del abismo;

verses.KJV: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
verses.WEB: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
verses.ASV: When he gave to the sea its bound, That the waters should not transgress his commandment, When he marked out the foundations of the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando colocava ao mar o seu limite, para que as águas não ultrapassassem seu mandado; quando estabelecia os fundamentos da terra.
verses.RVR09: Cuando ponía á la mar su estatuto, y á las aguas, que no pasasen su mandamiento; cuando establecía los fundamentos de la tierra;

verses.KJV: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
verses.WEB: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
verses.ASV: Then I was by him, [as] a master workman; And I was daily [his] delight, Rejoicing always before him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu estava com ele como um pupilo; e eu era seu agrado a cada dia, alegrando perante ele em todo tempo.
verses.RVR09: Con él estaba yo ordenándolo todo; y fuí su delicia todos los días, teniendo solaz delante de él en todo tiempo.

verses.KJV: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
verses.WEB: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
verses.ASV: Rejoicing in his habitable earth; And my delight was with the sons of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrando na habitação de sua terra; e [concedendo] meus agrados aos filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Huélgome en la parte habitable de su tierra; y mis delicias son con los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
verses.WEB: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me; For blessed are they that keep my ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto agora, filhos, ouvi-me; porque bem-aventurados serão [os que] guardarem meus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, hijos, oidme; y bienaventurados los que guardaren mis caminos.

verses.KJV: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
verses.WEB: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
verses.ASV: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi a correção, e sede sábios; e não a rejeiteis.
verses.RVR09: Atended el consejo, y sed sabios, y no lo menospreciéis.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man that heareth me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado [é] o homem que me ouve; que vigia em minhas portas diariamente, que guarda as ombreiras de minhas entradas.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el hombre que me oye, velando á mis puertas cada día, guardando los umbrales de mis entradas.

verses.KJV: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the Lord.
verses.WEB: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.
verses.ASV: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And shall obtain favor of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque aquele que me encontrar, encontrará a vida; e obterá o favor do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque el que me hallare, hallará la vida, y alcanzará el favor de Jehová.

verses.KJV: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
verses.WEB: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
verses.ASV: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: All they that hate me love death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas aquele que pecar contra mim fará violência à sua [própria] alma; todos os que me odeiam amam a morte.
verses.RVR09: Mas el que peca contra mí, defrauda su alma: todos los que me aborrecen, aman la muerte.

verses.KJV: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.WEB: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
