verses.ASV: Wisdom hath builded her house; She hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.ALMEIDA: A verdadeira sabedoria edificou sua casa; ela lavrou suas sete colunas.
verses.RVR09: LA sabiduría edificó su casa, labró sus siete columnas;

verses.KJV: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
verses.WEB: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
verses.ASV: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela sacrificou seu sacrifício, misturou seu vinho, e preparou sua mesa.
verses.RVR09: Mató sus víctimas, templó su vino, y puso su mesa.

verses.KJV: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
verses.WEB: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
verses.ASV: She hath sent forth her maidens; She crieth upon the highest places of the city:
verses.ALMEIDA: Mandou suas servas, [e] está convidando desde os pontos mais altos da cidade, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Envió sus criadas; sobre lo más alto de la ciudad clamó:

verses.KJV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.WEB: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
verses.ASV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: As for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que for ingênuo, venha aqui.Aos que têm falta de entendimento, ela diz:
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera simple, venga acá. A los faltos de cordura dijo:

verses.KJV: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
verses.WEB: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
verses.ASV: Come, eat ye of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, comei do meu pão; e bebei do vinho que misturei.
verses.RVR09: Venid, comed mi pan, y bebed del vino que yo he templado.

verses.KJV: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
verses.WEB: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
verses.ASV: Leave off, ye simple ones, and live; And walk in the way of understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abandonai a tolice; e vivei; e andai pelo caminho da prudência.
verses.RVR09: Dejad las simplezas, y vivid; y andad por el camino de la inteligencia.

verses.KJV: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
verses.WEB: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
verses.ASV: He that correcteth a scoffer getteth to himself reviling; And he that reproveth a wicked man [getteth] himself a blot.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que repreende ao zombador, toma desonra para si mesmo; e o que tenta corrigir ao perverso acaba sendo manchado.
verses.RVR09: El que corrige al escarnecedor, afrenta se acarrea: el que reprende al impío, se atrae mancha.

verses.KJV: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.WEB: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
verses.ASV: Reprove not a scoffer, lest he hate thee: Reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não repreendas ao zombador, para que ele não te odeie; repreende ao sábio, e ele te amará.
verses.RVR09: No reprendas al escarnecedor, porque no te aborrezca; corrige al sabio, y te amará.

verses.KJV: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.WEB: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
verses.ASV: Give [instruction] to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ensina ao sábio, e ele será mais sábio ainda; instrui ao justo, e ele aumentará seu conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Da al sabio, y será más sabio: enseña al justo, y acrecerá su saber.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR é o princípio da sabedoria; e o conhecimento dos santos [é] a prudência.
verses.RVR09: El temor de Jehová es el principio de la sabiduría; y la ciencia de los santos es inteligencia.

verses.KJV: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.WEB: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
verses.ASV: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque por mim teus dias serão multiplicados; e anos de vida a ti serão aumentados.
verses.RVR09: Porque por mí se aumentarán tus días, y años de vida se te añadirán.

verses.KJV: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
verses.WEB: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
verses.ASV: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scoffest, thou alone shalt bear it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se fores sábio, serás sábio para ti; e se fores zombador, somente tu aguentarás.
verses.RVR09: Si fueres sabio, para ti lo serás: mas si fueres escarnecedor, pagarás tú solo.

verses.KJV: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.WEB: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
verses.ASV: The foolish woman is clamorous; [She is] simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher louca é causadora de tumultos; [ela é] tola, e não sabe coisa alguma.
verses.RVR09: La mujer loca es alborotadora; es simple é ignorante.

verses.KJV: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.WEB: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.ASV: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.ALMEIDA: E se senta à porta de sua casa, sobre uma cadeira, nos lugares altos da cidade;
verses.RVR09: Siéntase en una silla á la puerta de su casa, en lo alto de la ciudad,

verses.KJV: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
verses.WEB: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
verses.ASV: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:
verses.ALMEIDA: Para chamar aos que passam pelo caminho, e passam por suas veredas, [dizendo] :
verses.RVR09: Para llamar á los que pasan por el camino, que van por sus caminos derechos.

verses.KJV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.WEB: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
verses.ASV: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither; And as for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que for ingênuo, venha aqui! E aos que tem falta de entendimento, ela diz:
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera simple, dice, venga acá. A los faltos de cordura dijo:

verses.KJV: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
verses.WEB: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
verses.ASV: Stolen waters are sweet, And bread [eaten] in secret is pleasant.
verses.ALMEIDA: As águas roubadas são doces; e o pão escondido é agradável.
verses.RVR09: Las aguas hurtadas son dulces, y el pan comido en oculto es suave.

verses.KJV: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
verses.WEB: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.ASV: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; That her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não sabem que ali estão os mortos; seus convidados estão nas profundezas do Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Y no saben que allí están los muertos; que sus convidados están en los profundos de la sepultura.

verses.KJV: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
verses.WEB: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
verses.ASV: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Provérbios de Salomão:O filho sábio alegra ao pai; mas o filho tolo é tristeza para sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: Las sentencias de Salomón. EL hijo sabio alegra al padre; y el hijo necio es tristeza de su madre.

verses.KJV: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.WEB: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.ASV: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; But righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tesouros da perversidade para nada aproveitam; porém a justiça livra da morte.
verses.RVR09: Los tesoros de maldad no serán de provecho: mas la justicia libra de muerte.

verses.KJV: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
verses.WEB: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; But he thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR não permite a alma do justo passar fome, porém arruína o interesse dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová no dejará hambrear el alma del justo: mas la iniquidad lanzará á los impíos.

verses.KJV: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.WEB: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
verses.ASV: He becometh poor that worketh with a slack hand; But the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que trabalha com mão preguiçosa empobrece; mas a mão de quem trabalha com empenho enriquece.
verses.RVR09: La mano negligente hace pobre: mas la mano de los diligentes enriquece.

verses.KJV: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
verses.WEB: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
verses.ASV: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son; [But] he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que ajunta no verão é filho prudente; [mas] o que dorme na ceifa é filho causador de vergonha.
verses.RVR09: El que recoge en el estío es hombre entendido: el que duerme en el tiempo de la siega es hombre afrentoso.

verses.KJV: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.WEB: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.ASV: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há bênçãos sobre a cabeça dos justos; mas a violência cobre a boca dos perversos.
verses.RVR09: Bendiciones sobre la cabeza del justo: mas violencia cubrirá la boca de los impíos.

verses.KJV: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.WEB: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.ASV: The memory of the righteous is blessed; But the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.ALMEIDA: A lembrança do justo [será] uma bênção; mas o nome dos perversos apodrecerá.
verses.RVR09: La memoria del justo será bendita: mas el nombre de los impíos se pudrirá.

verses.KJV: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.WEB: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
verses.ASV: The wise in heart will receive commandments; But a prating fool shall fall.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sábio de coração aceita os mandamentos; mas o louco de lábios será derrubado.
verses.RVR09: El sabio de corazón recibirá los mandamientos: mas el loco de labios caerá.

verses.KJV: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.WEB: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
verses.ASV: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely; But he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que anda em sinceridade anda seguro; mas o que perverte seus caminhos será conhecido.
verses.RVR09: El que camina en integridad, anda confiado: mas el que pervierte sus caminos, será quebrantado.

verses.KJV: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.WEB: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
verses.ASV: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow; But a prating fool shall fall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que pisca os olhos maliciosamente gera dores; e o louco de lábios será derrubado.
verses.RVR09: El que guiña del ojo acarrea tristeza; y el loco de labios será castigado.

verses.KJV: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.WEB: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.ASV: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: A boca do justo é um manancial de vida; mas a boca dos perversos está coberta de violência.
verses.RVR09: Vena de vida es la boca del justo: mas violencia cubrirá la boca de los impíos.

verses.KJV: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verses.WEB: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
verses.ASV: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ódio desperta brigas; mas o amor cobre todas as transgressões.
verses.RVR09: El odio despierta rencillas: mas la caridad cubrirá todas las faltas.

verses.KJV: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.WEB: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
verses.ASV: In the lips of him that hath discernment wisdom is found; But a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nos lábios do bom entendedor se acha sabedoria, mas uma vara está às costas daquele que não tem entendimento.
verses.RVR09: En los labios del prudente se halla sabiduría: y vara á las espaldas del falto de cordura.

verses.KJV: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
verses.WEB: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
verses.ASV: Wise men lay up knowledge; But the mouth of the foolish is a present destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os sábios guardam consigo sabedoria; mas a boca do tolo [está] perto da perturbação.
verses.RVR09: Los sabios guardan la sabiduría: mas la boca del loco es calamidad cercana.

verses.KJV: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.WEB: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.ASV: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.ALMEIDA: A prosperidade do rico é a sua cidade fortificada; a pobreza dos necessitados é sua perturbação.
verses.RVR09: Las riquezas del rico son su ciudad fuerte; y el desmayo de los pobres es su pobreza.

verses.KJV: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
verses.WEB: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
verses.ASV: The labor of the righteous [tendeth] to life; The increase of the wicked, to sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: A obra do justo é para a vida; os frutos do perverso, para o pecado.
verses.RVR09: La obra del justo es para vida; mas el fruto del impío es para pecado.

verses.KJV: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
verses.WEB: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
verses.ASV: He is in the way of life that heedeth correction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho para a vida [é d] aquele que guarda a correção; mas aquele que abandona a repreensão anda sem rumo.
verses.RVR09: Camino á la vida es guardar la corrección: mas el que deja la reprensión, yerra.

verses.KJV: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
verses.WEB: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
verses.ASV: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que esconde o ódio [tem] lábios mentirosos; e o que produz má fama é tolo.
verses.RVR09: El que encubre el odio es de labios mentirosos; y el que echa mala fama es necio.

verses.KJV: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
verses.WEB: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
verses.ASV: In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; But he that refraineth his lips doeth wisely.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na abundância de palavras não há falta de transgressão; mas aquele que refreia seus lábios é prudente.
verses.RVR09: En las muchas palabras no falta pecado: mas el que refrena sus labios es prudente.

verses.KJV: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
verses.WEB: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
verses.ASV: The tongue of the righteous is [as] choice silver: The heart of the wicked is little worth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A língua do justo [é como] prata escolhida; o coração dos perversos [vale] pouco.
verses.RVR09: Plata escogida es la lengua del justo: mas el entendimiento de los impíos es como nada.

verses.KJV: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
verses.WEB: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
verses.ASV: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for lack of understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os lábios dos justo apascentam a muitos; mas os tolos, por falta de entendimento, morrem.
verses.RVR09: Los labios del justo apacientan á muchos: mas los necios por falta de entendimiento mueren.

verses.KJV: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
verses.ASV: The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich; And he addeth no sorrow therewith.
verses.ALMEIDA: É a bênção do SENHOR que enriquece; e ele não lhe acrescenta dores.
verses.RVR09: La bendición de Jehová es la que enriquece, y no añade tristeza con ella.

verses.KJV: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
verses.WEB: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
verses.ASV: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness; And [so is] wisdom to a man of understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para o tolo, fazer o mal é uma diversão; mas para o homem bom entendedor, [divertida é] a sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Hacer abominación es como risa al insensato: mas el hombre entendido sabe.

verses.KJV: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.WEB: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.ASV: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor do perverso virá sobre ele, mas o desejo dos justos será concedido.
verses.RVR09: Lo que el impío teme, eso le vendrá: mas á los justos les será dado lo que desean.

verses.KJV: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.WEB: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
verses.ASV: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como o vento passa, assim também o perverso não [mais] existirá; mas o justo [tem] um alicerce eterno.
verses.RVR09: Como pasa el torbellino, así el malo no permanece: mas el justo, fundado para siempre.

verses.KJV: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.WEB: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
verses.ASV: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como vinagre para os dentes, e como fumaça para os olhos, assim também é o preguiçoso para aqueles que o mandam.
verses.RVR09: Como el vinagre á los dientes, y como el humo á los ojos, así es el perezoso á los que lo envían.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR faz aumentar os dias; mas os anos dos perversos serão encurtados.
verses.RVR09: El temor de Jehová aumentará los días: mas los años de los impíos serán acortados.

verses.KJV: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.WEB: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
verses.ASV: The hope of the righteous [shall be] gladness; But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: A esperança dos justos [é] alegria; mas a expectativa dos perversos perecerá.
verses.RVR09: La esperanza de los justos es alegría; mas la esperanza de los impíos perecerá.

verses.KJV: The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.WEB: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.ASV: The way of Jehovah is a stronghold to the upright; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho do SENHOR é fortaleza para os corretos, mas ruína para os que praticam maldade.
verses.RVR09: Fortaleza es al perfecto el camino de Jehová: mas espanto es á los que obran maldad.

verses.KJV: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
verses.WEB: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
verses.ASV: The righteous shall never be removed; But the wicked shall not dwell in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo nunca será removido, mas os perversos não habitarão a terra.
verses.RVR09: El justo eternalmente no será removido: mas los impíos no habitarán la tierra.

verses.KJV: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
verses.WEB: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
verses.ASV: The mouth of the righteous bringeth forth wisdom; But the perverse tongue shall be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: A boca do justo produz sabedoria, mas a língua perversa será cortada fora.
verses.RVR09: La boca del justo producirá sabiduría: mas la lengua perversa será cortada.

verses.KJV: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
verses.WEB: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
verses.ASV: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; But the mouth of the wicked [speaketh] perverseness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os lábios do justo sabem o que é agradável; mas a boca dos perversos [é cheia] de perversidades.
verses.RVR09: Los labios del justo conocerán lo que agrada: mas la boca de los impíos habla perversidades.

verses.KJV: A false balance is abomination to the Lord: but a just weight is his delight.
verses.WEB: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.
verses.ASV: A false balance is an abomination to Jehovah; But a just weight is his delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: A balança enganosa [é] abominação ao SENHOR; mas o peso justo [é] seu prazer.
verses.RVR09: EL peso falso abominación es á Jehová: mas la pesa cabal le agrada.

verses.KJV: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.WEB: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
verses.ASV: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando vem a arrogância, vem também a desonra; mas com os humildes [está] a sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Cuando viene la soberbia, viene también la deshonra: mas con los humildes es la sabiduría.

verses.KJV: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.WEB: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
verses.ASV: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; But the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
verses.ALMEIDA: A integridade dos corretos os guia; mas a perversidade dos enganadores os destruirá.
verses.RVR09: La integridad de los rectos los encaminará: mas destruirá á los pecadores la perversidad de ellos.

verses.KJV: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.WEB: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.ASV: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhum proveito terá a riqueza no dia da ira; mas a justiça livrará da morte.
verses.RVR09: No aprovecharán las riquezas en el día de la ira: mas la justicia librará de muerte.

verses.KJV: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.WEB: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.ASV: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way; But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A justiça do íntegro endireitará seu caminho; mas o perverso cairá por sua perversidade.
verses.RVR09: La justicia del perfecto enderezará su camino: mas el impío por su impiedad caerá.

verses.KJV: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
verses.WEB: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
verses.ASV: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them; But the treacherous shall be taken in their own iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: A justiça dos corretos os livrará; mas os transgressores serão presos em sua própria perversidade.
verses.RVR09: La justicia de los rectos los librará: mas los pecadores en su pecado serán presos.

verses.KJV: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
verses.WEB: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
verses.ASV: When a wicked man dieth, [his] expectation shall perish; And the hope of iniquity perisheth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o homem mau morre, sua expectativa morre; e a esperança de seu poder perece.
verses.RVR09: Cuando muere el hombre impío, perece su esperanza; y la espectativa de los malos perecerá.

verses.KJV: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.WEB: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
verses.ASV: The righteous is delivered out of trouble; And the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo é livrado da angústia; e o perverso vem em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: El justo es librado de la tribulación: mas el impío viene en lugar suyo.

verses.KJV: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.WEB: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
verses.ASV: With his mouth the godless man destroyeth his neighbor; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.
verses.ALMEIDA: O hipócrita com a boca prejudica ao seu próximo; mas os justos por meio do conhecimento são livrados.
verses.RVR09: El hipócrita con la boca daña á su prójimo: mas los justos son librados con la sabiduría.

verses.KJV: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.WEB: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.ASV: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.ALMEIDA: No bem dos justos, a cidade se alegra muito; e quando os perversos perecem, há alegria.
verses.RVR09: En el bien de los justos la ciudad se alegra: mas cuando los impíos perecen, hay fiestas.

verses.KJV: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.WEB: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.ASV: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo bênção dos sinceros a cidade se exalta; mas pela boca dos perversos ela se destrói.
verses.RVR09: Por la bendición de los rectos la ciudad será engrandecida: mas por la boca de los impíos ella será trastornada.

verses.KJV: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.WEB: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
verses.ASV: He that despiseth his neighbor is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que não tem entendimento despreza a seu próximo; mas o homem bom entendedor se mantêm calado.
verses.RVR09: El que carece de entendimiento, menosprecia á su prójimo: mas el hombre prudente calla.

verses.KJV: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.WEB: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
verses.ASV: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que conta fofocas revela o segredo; mas o fiel de espírito encobre o assunto.
verses.RVR09: El que anda en chismes, descubre el secreto: mas el de espíritu fiel encubre la cosa.

verses.KJV: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.WEB: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
verses.ASV: Where no wise guidance is, the people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando não há conselhos sábios, o povo cai; mas na abundância de bons conselheiros [consiste] o livramento.
verses.RVR09: Cuando faltaren las industrias, caerá el pueblo: mas en la multitud de consejeros hay salud.

verses.KJV: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
verses.WEB: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
verses.ASV: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth suretyship is secure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente aquele que se tornar fiador de algum estranho passará por sofrimento; mas aquele odeia firmar compromissos [ficará] seguro.
verses.RVR09: Con ansiedad será afligido el que fiare al extraño: mas el que aborreciere las fianzas vivirá confiado.

verses.KJV: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
verses.WEB: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
verses.ASV: A gracious woman obtaineth honor; And violent men obtain riches.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher graciosa guarda a honra, assim como os violentos guardam as riquezas.
verses.RVR09: La mujer graciosa tendrá honra: y los fuertes tendrán riquezas.

verses.KJV: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.WEB: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
verses.ASV: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem bondoso faz bem à sua alma; mas o cruel atormenta sua [própria] carne.
verses.RVR09: A su alma hace bien el hombre misericordioso: mas el cruel atormenta su carne.

verses.KJV: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
verses.WEB: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
verses.ASV: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness [hath] a sure reward.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso recebe falso pagamento; mas aquele que semeia justiça [terá] uma recompensa fiel.
verses.RVR09: El impío hace obra falsa: mas el que sembrare justicia, tendrá galardón firme.

verses.KJV: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
verses.WEB: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
verses.ASV: He that is stedfast in righteousness [shall attain] unto life; And he that pursueth evil [doeth it] to his own death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como a justiça [leva] para a vida; assim também aquele que segue o mal [é levado] para sua [própria] morte.
verses.RVR09: Como la justicia es para vida, así el que sigue el mal es para su muerte.

verses.KJV: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the Lord: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
verses.WEB: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
verses.ASV: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to Jehovah; But such as are perfect in [their] way are his delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR abomina os perversos de coração; porém ele se agrada que caminham com sinceridade.
verses.RVR09: Abominación son á Jehová los perversos de corazón: mas los perfectos de camino le son agradables.

verses.KJV: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.WEB: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
verses.ASV: [Though] hand [join] in hand, the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com certeza o mal não será absolvido; mas a semente dos justos escapará livre.
verses.RVR09: Aunque llegue la mano á la mano, el malo no quedará sin castigo: mas la simiente de los justos escapará.

verses.KJV: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.WEB: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
verses.ASV: [As] a ring of gold in a swine’s snout, [So is] a fair woman that is without discretion.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher bela mas sem discrição é como uma joia no focinho de uma porca.
verses.RVR09: Zarcillo de oro en la nariz del puerco, es la mujer hermosa y apartada de razón.

verses.KJV: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.WEB: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.ASV: The desire of the righteous is only good; [But] the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: O desejo dos justos é somente para o bem; mas a esperança dos perversos é a fúria.
verses.RVR09: El deseo de los justos es solamente bien: mas la esperanza de los impíos es enojo.

verses.KJV: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
verses.WEB: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
verses.ASV: There is that scattereth, and increaseth yet more; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but [it tendeth] only to want.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há quem dá generosamente e tem cada vez mais; e há quem retém mais do que é justo e empobrece.
verses.RVR09: Hay quienes reparten, y les es añadido más: y hay quienes son escasos más de lo que es justo, mas vienen á pobreza.

verses.KJV: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.WEB: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
verses.ASV: The liberal soul shall be made fat; And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: A alma generosa prosperará, e aquele que saciar também será saciado.
verses.RVR09: El alma liberal será engordada: y el que saciare, él también será saciado.

verses.KJV: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.WEB: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
verses.ASV: He that withholdeth grain, the people shall curse him; But blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O povo amaldiçoa ao que retém o trigo; mas bênção haverá sobre a cabeça daquele que [o] vende.
verses.RVR09: Al que retiene el grano, el pueblo lo maldecirá: mas bendición será sobre la cabeza del que vende.

verses.KJV: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.WEB: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
verses.ASV: He that diligently seeketh good seeketh favor; But he that searcheth after evil, it shall come unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que com empenho busca o bem, busca favor; porém o que procura o mal, sobre ele isso lhe virá.
verses.RVR09: El que madruga al bien, buscará favor: mas el que busca el mal, vendrále.

verses.KJV: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.WEB: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
verses.ASV: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; But the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que confia em suas riquezas cairá; mas os justos florescerão como as folhas.
verses.RVR09: El que confía en sus riquezas, caerá: mas los justos reverdecerán como ramos.

verses.KJV: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.WEB: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.ASV: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind; And the foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que perturba sua [própria] casa herdará vento; e o tolo será servo do sábio de coração.
verses.RVR09: El que turba su casa heredará viento; y el necio será siervo del sabio de corazón.

verses.KJV: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
verses.WEB: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
verses.ASV: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; And he that is wise winneth souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: O fruto do justo é uma árvore de vida; e o que ganha almas é sábio.
verses.RVR09: El fruto del justo es árbol de vida: y el que prende almas, es sabio.

verses.KJV: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.WEB: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.ASV: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth; How much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, se o justo recebe seu pagamento na terra, quanto mais o perverso e o pecador!
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente el justo será pagado en la tierra: ¡cuánto más el impío y el pecador!

verses.KJV: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.WEB: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
verses.ASV: Whoso loveth correction loveth knowledge; But he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que ama a correção ama o conhecimento; mas aquele que odeia a repreensão é um bruto.
verses.RVR09: EL que ama la corrección ama la sabiduría: mas el que aborrece la reprensión, es ignorante.

verses.KJV: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.WEB: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
verses.ASV: A good man shall obtain favor of Jehovah; But a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem de bem ganha o favor do SENHOR; mas ao homem de pensamentos perversos, ele o condenará.
verses.RVR09: El bueno alcanzará favor de Jehová: mas él condenará al hombre de malos pensamientos.

verses.KJV: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.WEB: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.ASV: A man shall not be established by wickedness; But the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem não prevalecerá pela perversidade; mas a raiz dos justos não será removida.
verses.RVR09: El hombre no se afirmará por medio de la impiedad: mas la raíz de los justos no será movida.

verses.KJV: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.WEB: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.ASV: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband; But she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher virtuosa é a coroa de seu marido; mas a causadora de vergonha é como uma podridão em seus ossos.
verses.RVR09: La mujer virtuosa corona es de su marido: mas la mala, como carcoma en sus huesos.

verses.KJV: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.WEB: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
verses.ASV: The thoughts of the righteous are just; [But] the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os pensamentos dos justos são de bom juízo; [mas] os conselhos dos perversos são enganosos.
verses.RVR09: Los pensamientos de los justos son rectitud; mas los consejos de los impíos, engaño.

verses.KJV: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.WEB: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
verses.ASV: The words of the wicked are of lying in wait for blood; But the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.ALMEIDA: As palavras dos perversos são para espreitar [o derramamento de] sangue [de inocentes] ; mas a boca dos corretos os livrará.
verses.RVR09: Las palabras de los impíos son para acechar la sangre: mas la boca de los rectos los librará.

verses.KJV: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.WEB: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.ASV: The wicked are overthrown, and are not; But the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os perversos serão transtornados, e não existirão [mais] ; porém a casa dos justos permanecerá.
verses.RVR09: Dios trastornará á los impíos, y no serán más: mas la casa de los justos permanecerá.

verses.KJV: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.WEB: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
verses.ASV: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom; But he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um será elogiado conforme seu entendimento; mas o perverso de coração será desprezado.
verses.RVR09: Según su sabiduría es alabado el hombre: mas el perverso de corazón será en menosprecio.

verses.KJV: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.WEB: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.
verses.ASV: Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, Than he that honoreth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o que estima pouco a si mesmo mas tem quem o sirva, do que aquele que elogia e si mesmo, mas nem sequer tem pão.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es el que es menospreciado y tiene servidores, que el que se precia, y carece de pan.

verses.KJV: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.WEB: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.ASV: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast; But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo dá atenção à vida de seus animais; mas [até] as misericórdias dos perversos são cruéis.
verses.RVR09: El justo atiende á la vida de su bestia: mas las entrañas de los impíos son crueles.

verses.KJV: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.WEB: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
verses.ASV: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain [persons] is void of understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que lavra sua terra se saciará de pão; mas o que segue [coisas] inúteis tem falta de juízo.
verses.RVR09: El que labra su tierra, se hartará de pan: mas el que sigue los vagabundos es falto de entendimiento.

verses.KJV: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.WEB: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
verses.ASV: The wicked desireth the net of evil men; But the root of the righteous yieldeth [fruit].
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso deseja armadilhas malignas; porém a raiz dos justos produzirá [seu fruto] .
verses.RVR09: Desea el impío la red de los malos: mas la raíz de los justos dará fruto.

verses.KJV: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.WEB: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
verses.ASV: In the transgression of the lips is a snare to the evil man; But the righteous shall come out of trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso é capturado pela transgressão de seus lábios, mas o justo sairá da angústia.
verses.RVR09: El impío es enredado en la prevaricación de sus labios: mas el justo saldrá de la tribulación.

verses.KJV: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.WEB: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
verses.ASV: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth; And the doings of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um se sacia do bem pelo fruto de sua [própria] boca; e a recompensa das mãos do homem lhe será entregue de volta.
verses.RVR09: El hombre será harto de bien del fruto de su boca: y la paga de las manos del hombre le será dada.

verses.KJV: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
verses.WEB: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
verses.ASV: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; But he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho do tolo é correto aos seus [próprios] olhos; mas aquele que ouve o [bom] conselho é sábio.
verses.RVR09: El camino del necio es derecho en su opinión: mas el que obedece al consejo es sabio.

verses.KJV: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
verses.WEB: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
verses.ASV: A fool’s vexation is presently known; But a prudent man concealeth shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ira do tolo é conhecida no mesmo dia, mas o prudente ignora o insulto.
verses.RVR09: El necio luego al punto da á conocer su ira: mas el que disimula la injuria es cuerdo.

verses.KJV: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.WEB: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
verses.ASV: He that uttereth truth showeth forth righteousness; But a false witness, deceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que fala a verdade conta a justiça; porém a testemunha falsa [conta] o engano.
verses.RVR09: El que habla verdad, declara justicia; mas el testigo mentiroso, engaño.

verses.KJV: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.WEB: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
verses.ASV: There is that speaketh rashly like the piercings of a sword; But the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há [alguns] que falam [palavras] como que golpes de espada; porém a língua do sábios é [como] um remédio.
verses.RVR09: Hay quienes hablan como dando estocadas de espada: mas la lengua de los sabios es medicina.

verses.KJV: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.WEB: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
verses.ASV: The lip of truth shall be established for ever; But a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.ALMEIDA: O lábio da verdade ficará para sempre, mas a língua da falsidade [dura] por [apenas] um momento.
verses.RVR09: El labio de verdad permanecerá para siempre: mas la lengua de mentira por un momento.

verses.KJV: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.WEB: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
verses.ASV: Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; But to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Há] engano no coração dos que tramam o mal; mas os que aconselham a paz [têm] alegria.
verses.RVR09: Engaño hay en el corazón de los que piensan mal: mas alegría en el de los que piensan bien.

verses.KJV: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.WEB: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
verses.ASV: There shall no mischief happen to the righteous; But the wicked shall be filled with evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nenhuma adversidade sobrevirá ao justos; mas os perversos se encherão de mal.
verses.RVR09: Ninguna adversidad acontecerá al justo: mas los impíos serán llenos de mal.

verses.KJV: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.WEB: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.
verses.ASV: Lying lips are an abomination to Jehovah; But they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os lábios mentirosos são abomináveis ao SENHOR, mas dos que falam a verdade são seu prazer.
verses.RVR09: Los labios mentirosos son abominación á Jehová: mas los obradores de verdad su contentamiento.

verses.KJV: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.WEB: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
verses.ASV: A prudent man concealeth knowledge; But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem prudente é discreto em conhecimento; mas o coração dos tolos proclama a loucura.
verses.RVR09: El hombre cuerdo encubre la ciencia: mas el corazón de los necios publica la necedad.

verses.KJV: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.WEB: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
verses.ASV: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; But the slothful shall be put under taskwork.
verses.ALMEIDA: A mão dos que trabalham com empenho dominará, e os preguiçosos se tornarão escravos.
verses.RVR09: La mano de los diligentes se enseñoreará: mas la negligencia será tributaria.

verses.KJV: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.WEB: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
verses.ASV: Heaviness in the heart of a man maketh it stoop; But a good word maketh it glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ansiedade no coração do homem o abate; [mas] uma boa palavra o alegra.
verses.RVR09: El cuidado congojoso en el corazón del hombre, lo abate; mas la buena palabra lo alegra.

verses.KJV: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.WEB: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.ASV: The righteous is a guide to his neighbor; But the way of the wicked causeth them to err.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo age cuidadosamente para com seu próximo, mas o caminho dos perversos os faz errar.
verses.RVR09: El justo hace ventaja á su prójimo: mas el camino de los impíos les hace errar.

verses.KJV: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
verses.WEB: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
verses.ASV: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting; But the precious substance of men [is to] the diligent.
verses.ALMEIDA: O preguiçoso não assa aquilo que caçou, mas a riqueza de quem trabalha com empenho [lhe é] preciosa.
verses.RVR09: El indolente no chamuscará su caza: mas el haber precioso del hombre es la diligencia.

verses.KJV: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.WEB: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
verses.ASV: In the way of righteousness is life; And in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na vereda da justiça está a vida; e [no] caminho de seu percurso não há morte.
verses.RVR09: En el camino de la justicia está la vida; y la senda de su vereda no es muerte.

verses.KJV: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.WEB: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
verses.ASV: A wise son [heareth] his father’s instruction; But a scoffer heareth not rebuke.
verses.ALMEIDA: O filho sábio [ouve] a correção do pai; mas o zombador não escuta a repreensão.
verses.RVR09: EL hijo sabio toma el consejo del padre: mas el burlador no escucha las reprensiones.

verses.KJV: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
verses.WEB: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
verses.ASV: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth; But the soul of the treacherous [shall eat] violence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um comerá do bem pelo fruto de sua boca, mas a alma dos infiéis [deseja] a violência.
verses.RVR09: Del fruto de su boca el hombre comerá bien: mas el alma de los prevaricadores hallará mal.

verses.KJV: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.WEB: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
verses.ASV: He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his life; [But] he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem toma cuidado com sua boca preserva sua alma; mas aquele que abre muito seus lábios será arruinado.
verses.RVR09: El que guarda su boca guarda su alma: mas el que mucho abre sus labios tendrá calamidad.

verses.KJV: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.WEB: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
verses.ASV: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.ALMEIDA: A alma do preguiçoso deseja, mas nada [consegue] ; porém a alma dos trabalham com empenho prosperará.
verses.RVR09: Desea, y nada alcanza el alma del perezoso: mas el alma de los diligentes será engordada.

verses.KJV: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.WEB: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
verses.ASV: A righteous man hateth lying; But a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo odeia a palavra mentirosa, mas o perverso age de forma repugnante e vergonhosa.
verses.RVR09: El justo aborrece la palabra de mentira: mas el impío se hace odioso é infame.

verses.KJV: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.WEB: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
verses.ASV: Righteousness guardeth him that is upright in the way; But wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.ALMEIDA: A justiça guarda aquele que tem um caminho íntegro; mas a perversidade transtornará ao pecador.
verses.RVR09: La justicia guarda al de perfecto camino: mas la impiedad trastornará al pecador.

verses.KJV: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
verses.WEB: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
verses.ASV: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: There is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great wealth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há [alguns] que fingem ser ricos, mesmo nada tendo; e [outros] que fingem ser pobres, mesmo tendo muitos bens.
verses.RVR09: Hay quienes se hacen ricos, y no tienen nada: y hay quienes se hacen pobres, y tienen muchas riquezas.

verses.KJV: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.WEB: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
verses.ASV: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches; But the poor heareth no threatening.
verses.ALMEIDA: O resgate da vida de cada um são suas riquezas; mas o pobre não ouve ameaças.
verses.RVR09: La redención de la vida del hombre son sus riquezas: pero el pobre no oye censuras.

verses.KJV: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.WEB: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
verses.ASV: The light of the righteous rejoiceth; But the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.ALMEIDA: A luz dos justos se alegra, mas a lâmpada dos perversos se apagará.
verses.RVR09: La luz de los justos se alegrará: mas apagaráse la lámpara de los impíos.

verses.KJV: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
verses.WEB: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
verses.ASV: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: A arrogância só produz brigas; mas com os que aceitam conselhos [está] a sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente la soberbia parirá contienda: mas con los avisados es la sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
verses.WEB: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
verses.ASV: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth by labor shall have increase.
verses.ALMEIDA: A riqueza [ganha] sem esforço será perdida; mas aquele que a obtém pelas próprias mãos terá cada vez mais.
verses.RVR09: Disminuiránse las riquezas de vanidad: empero multiplicará el que allega con su mano.

verses.KJV: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verses.WEB: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
verses.ASV: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verses.ALMEIDA: A esperança que demora enfraquece o coração, mas o desejo cumprido é [como] uma árvore de vida.
verses.RVR09: La esperanza que se prolonga, es tormento del corazón: mas árbol de vida es el deseo cumplido.

verses.KJV: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.WEB: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
verses.ASV: Whoso despiseth the word bringeth destruction on himself; But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem despreza a [boa] palavra perecerá; mas aquele que teme ao mandamento será recompensado.
verses.RVR09: El que menosprecia la palabra, perecerá por ello: mas el que teme el mandamiento, será recompensado.

verses.KJV: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.WEB: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
verses.ASV: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: A doutrina do sábio é manancial de vida, para se desviar das ciladas da morte.
verses.RVR09: La ley del sabio es manantial de vida, para apartarse de los lazos de la muerte.

verses.KJV: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
verses.WEB: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
verses.ASV: Good understanding giveth favor; But the way of the transgressor is hard.
verses.ALMEIDA: O bom entendimento alcança o favor, mas o caminho dos infiéis é áspero.
verses.RVR09: El buen entendimiento conciliará gracia: mas el camino de los prevaricadores es duro.

verses.KJV: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
verses.WEB: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
verses.ASV: Every prudent man worketh with knowledge; But a fool flaunteth [his] folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo prudente age com conhecimento, mas o tolo espalha sua loucura.
verses.RVR09: Todo hombre cuerdo obra con sabiduría: mas el necio manifestará necedad.

verses.KJV: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.WEB: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
verses.ASV: A wicked messenger falleth into evil; But a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mensageiro perverso cai no mal, mas o representante fiel é [como] um remédio.
verses.RVR09: El mal mensajero caerá en mal: mas el mensajero fiel es medicina.

verses.KJV: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.WEB: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
verses.ASV: Poverty and shame [shall be to] him that refuseth correction; But he that regardeth reproof shall be honored.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Haverá] pobreza e vergonha ao que rejeita a correção; mas aquele que atende à repreensão será honrado.
verses.RVR09: Pobreza y vergüenza tendrá el que menosprecia el consejo: mas el que guarda la corrección, será honrado.

verses.KJV: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.WEB: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
verses.ASV: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; But it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: O desejo realizado agrada a alma, mas os tolos abominam se afastar do mal.
verses.RVR09: El deseo cumplido deleita el alma: pero apartarse del mal es abominación á los necios.

verses.KJV: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.WEB: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
verses.ASV: Walk with wise men, and thou shalt be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem anda com os sábios se torna sábio; mas aquele que acompanha os tolos sofrerá.
verses.RVR09: El que anda con los sabios, sabio será; mas el que se allega á los necios, será quebrantado.

verses.KJV: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.WEB: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
verses.ASV: Evil pursueth sinners; But the righteous shall be recompensed with good.
verses.ALMEIDA: O mal perseguirá os pecadores, mas os justos serão recompensados com o bem.
verses.RVR09: Mal perseguirá á los pecadores: mas á los justos les será bien retribuído.

verses.KJV: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
verses.WEB: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
verses.ASV: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children; And the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem de bem deixará herança aos filhos de seus filhos; mas a riqueza do pecador está reservada para o justo.
verses.RVR09: El bueno dejará herederos á los hijos de los hijos; y el haber del pecador, para el justo está guardado.

verses.KJV: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.WEB: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
verses.ASV: Much food [is in] the tillage of the poor; But there is that is destroyed by reason of injustice.
verses.ALMEIDA: A lavoura dos pobres [gera] muita comida; mas há [alguns] que se destroem por falta de juízo.
verses.RVR09: En el barbecho de los pobres hay mucho pan: mas piérdese por falta de juicio.

verses.KJV: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.WEB: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
verses.ASV: He that spareth his rod hateth his son; But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que retém sua vara odeia a seu filho; porém aquele que o ama, desde cedo o castiga.
verses.RVR09: El que detiene el castigo, á su hijo aborrece: mas el que lo ama, madruga á castigarlo.

verses.KJV: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.WEB: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
verses.ASV: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul; But the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo come até sua alma estar saciada; mas o ventre dos perversos passará por necessidade.
verses.RVR09: El justo come hasta saciar su alma: mas el vientre de los impíos tendrá necesidad.

verses.KJV: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.WEB: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
verses.ASV: Every wise woman buildeth her house; But the foolish plucketh it down with her own hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda mulher sábia edifica sua casa; porém a tola a derruba com suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: LA mujer sabia edifica su casa: mas la necia con sus manos la derriba.

verses.KJV: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.WEB: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
verses.ASV: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth Jehovah; But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que anda corretamente teme ao SENHOR; mas o que se desvia de seus caminhos o despreza.
verses.RVR09: El que camina en su rectitud teme á Jehová: mas el pervertido en sus caminos lo menosprecia.

verses.KJV: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.WEB: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
verses.ASV: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod for [his] pride; But the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na boca do tolo está a vara da arrogância, porém os lábios dos sábios os protegem.
verses.RVR09: En la boca del necio está la vara de la soberbia: mas los labios de los sabios los guardarán.

verses.KJV: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.WEB: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.ASV: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; But much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não havendo bois, o celeiro fica limpo; mas pela força do boi há uma colheita abundante.
verses.RVR09: Sin bueyes el granero está limpio: mas por la fuerza del buey hay abundancia de pan.

verses.KJV: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.WEB: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
verses.ASV: A faithful witness will not lie; But a false witness uttereth lies.
verses.ALMEIDA: A testemunha verdadeira não mentirá, mas a testemunha falsa declara mentiras.
verses.RVR09: El testigo verdadero no mentirá: mas el testigo falso hablará mentiras.

verses.KJV: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.WEB: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
verses.ASV: A scoffer seeketh wisdom, and [findeth it] not; But knowledge is easy unto him that hath understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: O zombador busca sabedoria, mas não [acha] nenhuma; mas o conhecimento é fácil para o prudente.
verses.RVR09: Busca el escarnecedor la sabiduría, y no la halla: mas la sabiduría al hombre entendido es fácil.

verses.KJV: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
verses.WEB: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
verses.ASV: Go into the presence of a foolish man, And thou shalt not perceive [in him] the lips of knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afasta-te do homem tolo, porque [nele] não encontrarás lábios inteligentes.
verses.RVR09: Vete de delante del hombre necio, porque en él no advertirás labios de ciencia.

verses.KJV: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.WEB: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.ASV: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way; But the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: A sabedoria do prudente é entender seu caminho; mas a loucura dos tolos é engano.
verses.RVR09: La ciencia del cuerdo es entender su camino: mas la indiscreción de los necios es engaño.

verses.KJV: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
verses.WEB: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
verses.ASV: A trespass-offering mocketh fools; But among the upright there is good will.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os tolos zombam da culpa, mas entre os corretos está o favor.
verses.RVR09: Los necios se mofan del pecado: mas entre los rectos hay favor.

verses.KJV: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.WEB: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
verses.ASV: The heart knoweth its own bitterness; And a stranger doth not intermeddle with its joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração conhece sua [própria] amargura, e o estranho não pode partilhar sua alegria.
verses.RVR09: El corazón conoce la amargura de su alma; y extraño no se entrometerá en su alegría.

verses.KJV: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.WEB: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.ASV: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; But the tent of the upright shall flourish.
verses.ALMEIDA: A casa dos perversos será destruída, mas a tenda dos corretos florescerá.
verses.RVR09: La casa de los impíos será asolada: mas florecerá la tienda de los rectos.

verses.KJV: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.WEB: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.ASV: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man; But the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há um caminho que [parece] correto para o homem, porém o fim dele são caminhos de morte.
verses.RVR09: Hay camino que al hombre parece derecho; empero su fin son caminos de muerte.

verses.KJV: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
verses.WEB: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
verses.ASV: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; And the end of mirth is heaviness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até no riso o coração terá dor, e o fim da alegria é a tristeza.
verses.RVR09: Aun en la risa tendrá dolor el corazón; y el término de la alegría es congoja.

verses.KJV: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.WEB: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
verses.ASV: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways; And a good man [shall be satisfied] from himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem se desvia de coração será cheio de seus próprios caminhos, porém o homem de bem [será recompensado] pelos seus.
verses.RVR09: De sus caminos será harto el apartado de razón: y el hombre de bien estará contento del suyo.

verses.KJV: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.WEB: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
verses.ASV: The simple believeth every word; But the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ingênuo crê em toda palavra, mas o prudente pensa cuidadosamente sobre seus passos.
verses.RVR09: El simple cree á toda palabra: mas el avisado entiende sus pasos.

verses.KJV: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.WEB: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
verses.ASV: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil; But the fool beareth himself insolently, and is confident.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sábio teme, e se afasta do mal; porém o tolo se precipita e se acha seguro.
verses.RVR09: El sabio teme, y se aparta del mal: mas el necio se arrebata, y confía.

verses.KJV: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.WEB: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
verses.ASV: He that is soon angry will deal foolishly; And a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem se ira rapidamente faz loucuras, e o homem de maus pensamentos será odiado.
verses.RVR09: El que presto se enoja, hará locura: y el hombre malicioso será aborrecido.

verses.KJV: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.WEB: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.ASV: The simple inherit folly; But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os ingênuos herdarão a tolice, mas os prudentes serão coroados [com] o conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Los simples heredarán necedad: mas los cuerdos se coronarán de sabiduría.

verses.KJV: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.WEB: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.ASV: The evil bow down before the good; And the wicked, at the gates of the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os maus se inclinarão perante a face dos bons, e os perversos diante das portas do justo.
verses.RVR09: Los malos se inclinarán delante de los buenos, y los impíos á las puertas del justo.

verses.KJV: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
verses.WEB: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
verses.ASV: The poor is hated even of his own neighbor; But the rich hath many friends.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pobre é odiado até pelo seu próximo, porém os amigos dos ricos são muitos.
verses.RVR09: El pobre es odioso aun á su amigo: pero muchos son los que aman al rico.

verses.KJV: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
verses.WEB: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
verses.ASV: He that despiseth his neighbor sinneth; But he that hath pity on the poor, happy is he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem despreza a seu próximo, peca; mas aquele que demonstra misericórdia aos humildes [é] bem-aventurado.
verses.RVR09: Peca el que menosprecia á su prójimo: mas el que tiene misericordia de los pobres, es bienaventurado.

verses.KJV: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
verses.WEB: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
verses.ASV: Do they not err that devise evil? But mercy and truth [shall be to] them that devise good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não andam errados os que tramam o mal? Mas [há] bondade e fidelidade para os que planejam o bem.
verses.RVR09: ¿No yerran los que piensan mal? Misericordia empero y verdad alcanzarán los que piensan bien.

verses.KJV: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.WEB: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
verses.ASV: In all labor there is profit; But the talk of the lips [tendeth] only to penury.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em todo trabalho cansativo há proveito, mas o falar dos lábios só [leva] à pobreza.
verses.RVR09: En toda labor hay fruto: mas la palabra de los labios solamente empobrece.

verses.KJV: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
verses.WEB: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
verses.ASV: The crown of the wise is their riches; [But] the folly of fools is [only] folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: A coroa dos sábios é a sua riqueza; a loucura dos tolos é loucura.
verses.RVR09: Las riquezas de los sabios son su corona: mas es infatuación la insensatez de los necios.
