verses.KJV: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
verses.WEB: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
verses.ASV: A true witness delivereth souls; But he that uttereth lies [causeth] deceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: A testemunha verdadeira livra almas, mas aquele que declara mentiras é enganador.
verses.RVR09: El testigo verdadero libra las almas: mas el engañoso hablará mentiras.

verses.KJV: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.WEB: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
verses.ASV: In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: No temor ao SENHOR [há] forte confiança; e será refúgio para seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: En el temor de Jehová está la fuerte confianza; y esperanza tendrán sus hijos.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR é manancial de vida, para se desviar dos laços da morte.
verses.RVR09: El temor de Jehová es manantial de vida, para apartarse de los lazos de la muerte.

verses.KJV: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.WEB: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.ASV: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory; But in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na multidão do povo está a honra do rei, mas a falta de gente é a ruína do príncipe.
verses.RVR09: En la multitud de pueblo está la gloria del rey: y en la falta de pueblo la flaqueza del príncipe.

verses.KJV: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.WEB: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
verses.ASV: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem demora para se irar tem muito entendimento, mas aquele de espírito impetuoso exalta a loucura.
verses.RVR09: El que tarde se aira, es grande de entendimiento: mas el corto de espíritu engrandece el desatino.

verses.KJV: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.WEB: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
verses.ASV: A tranquil heart is the life of the flesh; But envy is the rottenness of the bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração em paz é vida para o corpo, mas a inveja é [como] podridão nos ossos.
verses.RVR09: El corazón apacible es vida de las carnes: mas la envidia, pudrimiento de huesos.

verses.KJV: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.WEB: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
verses.ASV: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker; But he that hath mercy on the needy honoreth him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem oprime ao pobre insulta ao seu Criador; mas aquele que mostra compaixão ao necessitado o honra.
verses.RVR09: El que oprime al pobre, afrenta á su Hacedor: mas el que tiene misericordia del pobre, lo honra.

verses.KJV: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.WEB: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
verses.ASV: The wicked is thrust down in his evil-doing; But the righteous hath a refuge in his death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por sua malícia, o perverso é excluído; porém o justo [até] em sua morte mantém a confiança.
verses.RVR09: Por su maldad será lanzado el impío: mas el justo en su muerte tiene esperanza.

verses.KJV: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.WEB: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
verses.ASV: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding; But [that which is] in the inward part of fools is made known.
verses.ALMEIDA: No coração do prudente repousa a sabedoria; mas ela será conhecida até entre os tolos.
verses.RVR09: En el corazón del cuerdo reposa la sabiduría; y es conocida en medio de los necios.

verses.KJV: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.WEB: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
verses.ASV: Righteousness exalteth a nation; But sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.ALMEIDA: A justiça exalta a nação, mas o pecado é a desgraça dos povos.
verses.RVR09: La justicia engrandece la nación: mas el pecado es afrenta de las naciones.

verses.KJV: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
verses.WEB: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
verses.ASV: The king’s favor is toward a servant that dealeth wisely; But his wrath will be [against] him that causeth shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei se agrada do seu servo prudente; porém ele mostrará seu furor ao causador de vergonha.
verses.RVR09: La benevolencia del rey es para con el ministro entendido: mas su enojo contra el que lo avergüenza.

verses.KJV: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.WEB: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.ASV: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: A resposta suave desvia o furor, mas a palavra pesada faz a ira aumentar.
verses.RVR09: LA blanda respuesta quita la ira: mas la palabra áspera hace subir el furor.

verses.KJV: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
verses.WEB: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
verses.ASV: The tongue of the wise uttereth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: A língua dos sábios faz bom uso da sabedoria, mas a boca dos tolos derrama loucura.
verses.RVR09: La lengua de los sabios adornará la sabiduría: mas la boca de los necios hablará sandeces.

verses.KJV: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
verses.ASV: The eyes of Jehovah are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos do SENHOR estão em todo lugar, observando os maus e os bons.
verses.RVR09: Los ojos de Jehová están en todo lugar, mirando á los malos y á los buenos.

verses.KJV: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
verses.WEB: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
verses.ASV: A gentle tongue is a tree of life; But perverseness therein is a breaking of the spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma língua sã é árvore de vida; mas a perversidade nela é faz o espírito em pedaços.
verses.RVR09: La sana lengua es árbol de vida: mas la perversidad en ella es quebrantamiento de espíritu.

verses.KJV: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.WEB: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
verses.ASV: A fool despiseth his father’s correction; But he that regardeth reproof getteth prudence.
verses.ALMEIDA: O tolo despreza a correção de seu pai; mas aquele que presta atenção à repreensão age com prudência.
verses.RVR09: El necio menosprecia el consejo de su padre: mas el que guarda la corrección, vendrá á ser cuerdo.

verses.KJV: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.WEB: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
verses.ASV: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Na] casa dos justo há um grande tesouro; mas na renda do perverso há perturbação.
verses.RVR09: En la casa del justo hay gran provisión; empero turbación en las ganancias del impío.

verses.KJV: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
verses.WEB: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
verses.ASV: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolish [doeth] not so.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os lábios dos sábios derramam conhecimento; mas o coração dos tolos não [age] assim.
verses.RVR09: Los labios de los sabios esparcen sabiduría: mas no así el corazón de los necios.

verses.KJV: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.WEB: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.ASV: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sacrifício dos perversos é abominável ao SENHOR, mas a oração dos justos é seu agrado.
verses.RVR09: El sacrificio de los impíos es abominación á Jehová: mas la oración de los rectos es su gozo.

verses.KJV: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.WEB: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
verses.ASV: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abominável ao SENHOR é o caminho do perverso; porém ele ama ao que segue a justiça.
verses.RVR09: Abominación es á Jehová el camino del impío: mas él ama al que sigue justicia.

verses.KJV: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.WEB: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.
verses.ASV: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; [And] he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: A correção é ruim para aquele que deixa o caminho; e quem odeia a repreensão morrerá.
verses.RVR09: La reconvención es molesta al que deja el camino: y el que aborreciere la corrección, morirá.

verses.KJV: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
verses.WEB: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
verses.ASV: Sheol and Abaddon are before Jehovah; How much more then the hearts of the children of men!
verses.ALMEIDA: O Xeol e a perdição estão perante o SENHOR; quanto mais os corações dos filhos dos homens!
verses.RVR09: El infierno y la perdición están delante de Jehová: ¡cuánto más los corazones de los hombres!

verses.KJV: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.WEB: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
verses.ASV: A scoffer loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.
verses.ALMEIDA: O zombador não ama quem o repreende, nem se aproximará dos sábios.
verses.RVR09: El escarnecedor no ama al que le reprende; ni se allega á los sabios.

verses.KJV: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.WEB: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
verses.ASV: A glad heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração alegre anima o rosto, mas pela dor do coração o espírito se abate.
verses.RVR09: El corazón alegre hermosea el rostro: mas por el dolor de corazón el espíritu se abate.

verses.KJV: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.WEB: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
verses.ASV: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração prudente buscará o conhecimento, mas a boca dos tolos se alimentará de loucura.
verses.RVR09: El corazón entendido busca la sabiduría: mas la boca de los necios pace necedad.

verses.KJV: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
verses.WEB: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
verses.ASV: All the days of the afflicted are evil; But he that is of a cheerful heart [hath] a continual feast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os dias do oprimido são maus, mas o coração alegre é [como] um banquete contínuo.
verses.RVR09: Todos los días del afligido son trabajosos: mas el de corazón contento tiene un convite continuo.

verses.KJV: Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.WEB: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.
verses.ASV: Better is little, with the fear of Jehovah, Than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o pouco tendo o temor ao SENHOR, do que um grande tesouro tendo em si inquietação.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es lo poco con el temor de Jehová, que el gran tesoro donde hay turbación.

verses.KJV: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.WEB: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
verses.ASV: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é a comida de hortaliças tendo amor, do que a de boi cevado tendo em si ódio.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es la comida de legumbres donde hay amor, que de buey engordado donde hay odio.

verses.KJV: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.WEB: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
verses.ASV: A wrathful man stirreth up contention; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem que fica irritado facilmente gera brigas; mas aquele que demora para se irar apaziguará o confronto.
verses.RVR09: El hombre iracundo mueve contiendas: mas el que tarde se enoja, apaciguará la rencilla.

verses.KJV: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
verses.WEB: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
verses.ASV: The way of the sluggard is as a hedge of thorns; But the path of the upright is made a highway.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho do preguiçoso é como uma cerca de espinhos; mas a vereda dos corretos é bem aplanada.
verses.RVR09: El camino del perezoso es como seto de espinos: mas la vereda de los rectos como una calzada.

verses.KJV: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.WEB: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.ASV: A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: O filho sábio alegra ao pai, mas o homem tolo despreza a sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: El hijo sabio alegra al padre: mas el hombre necio menosprecia á su madre.

verses.KJV: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
verses.WEB: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
verses.ASV: Folly is joy to him that is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding maketh straight his going.
verses.ALMEIDA: A loucura é alegria para aquele que tem falta de prudência; mas o homem de bom entendimento andará corretamente.
verses.RVR09: La necedad es alegría al falto de entendimiento: mas el hombre entendido enderezará su proceder.

verses.KJV: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.WEB: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
verses.ASV: Where there is no counsel, purposes are disappointed; But in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os planos fracassam quando não há [bom] conselho; mas com abundância de conselheiros eles se confirmam.
verses.RVR09: Los pensamientos son frustrados donde no hay consejo; mas en la multitud de consejeros se afirman.

verses.KJV: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
verses.WEB: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
verses.ASV: A man hath joy in the answer of his mouth; And a word in due season, how good is it!
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem se alegra com a resposta de sua boca; e como é boa a palavra a seu devido tempo!
verses.RVR09: Alégrase el hombre con la respuesta de su boca: y la palabra á su tiempo, ¡cuán buena es!

verses.KJV: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.WEB: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
verses.ASV: To the wise the way of life [goeth] upward, That he may depart from Sheol beneath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para o prudente, o caminho da vida [é] para cima, para que se afaste do Xeol, que é para baixo.
verses.RVR09: El camino de la vida es hacia arriba al entendido, para apartarse del infierno abajo.

verses.KJV: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.WEB: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will root up the house of the proud; But he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR destruirá a casa dos arrogantes, mas confirmará os limites do terreno da viúva.
verses.RVR09: Jehová asolará la casa de los soberbios: mas él afirmará el término de la viuda.

verses.KJV: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
verses.WEB: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
verses.ASV: Evil devices are an abomination to Jehovah; But pleasant words [are] pure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os pensamentos do mau são abomináveis ao SENHOR, mas ele se agrada das palavras dos puros.
verses.RVR09: Abominación son á Jehová los pensamientos del malo: mas las expresiones de los limpios son limpias.

verses.KJV: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.WEB: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
verses.ASV: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth bribes shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem pratica a ganância perturba sua [própria] casa; mas quem odeia subornos viverá.
verses.RVR09: Alborota su casa el codicioso: mas el que aborrece las dádivas vivirá.

verses.KJV: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.WEB: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
verses.ASV: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer; But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração do justo pensa bem naquilo que vai responder, mas a boca dos perversos derrama maldades em abundância.
verses.RVR09: El corazón del justo piensa para responder: mas la boca de los impíos derrama malas cosas.

verses.KJV: The Lord is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.WEB: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is far from the wicked; But he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Longe está o SENHOR dos perversos, mas ele escuta a oração dos justos.
verses.RVR09: Lejos está Jehová de los impíos: mas él oye la oración de los justos.

verses.KJV: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.WEB: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
verses.ASV: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart; [And] good tidings make the bones fat.
verses.ALMEIDA: A luz dos olhos alegra o coração; a boa notícia fortalece os ossos.
verses.RVR09: La luz de los ojos alegra el corazón; y la buena fama engorda los huesos.

verses.KJV: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.WEB: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
verses.ASV: The ear that hearkeneth to the reproof of life Shall abide among the wise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os ouvidos que escutam a repreensão da vida habitarão entre os sábios.
verses.RVR09: La oreja que escucha la corrección de vida, entre los sabios morará.

verses.KJV: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
verses.WEB: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
verses.ASV: He that refuseth correction despiseth his own soul; But he that hearkeneth to reproof getteth understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem rejeita correção menospreza sua [própria] alma; mas aquele que escuta a repreensão adquire entendimento.
verses.RVR09: El que tiene en poco la disciplina, menosprecia su alma: mas el que escucha la corrección, tiene entendimiento.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the instruction of wisdom; And before honor [goeth] humility.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR corrige sabiamente; e antes da honra [vem] a humildade.
verses.RVR09: El temor de Jehová es enseñanza de sabiduría: y delante de la honra está la humildad.

verses.KJV: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.
verses.WEB: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.
verses.ASV: The plans of the heart belong to man; But the answer of the tongue is from Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do homem são os planejamentos do coração, mas a reposta da boca [vem] do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: DEL hombre son las disposiciones del corazón: mas de Jehová la respuesta de la lengua.

verses.KJV: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.
verses.WEB: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.
verses.ASV: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the spirits.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os caminhos do homem são puros aos seus [próprios] olhos; mas o SENHOR pesa os espíritos.
verses.RVR09: Todos los caminos del hombre son limpios en su opinión: mas Jehová pesa los espíritus.

verses.KJV: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.WEB: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
verses.ASV: Commit thy works unto Jehovah, And thy purposes shall be established.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confia tuas obras ao SENHOR, e teus pensamentos serão firmados.
verses.RVR09: Encomienda á Jehová tus obras, y tus pensamientos serán afirmados.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.WEB: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath made everything for its own end; Yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR fez tudo para seu propósito; e até ao perverso para o dia do mal.
verses.RVR09: Todas las cosas ha hecho Jehová por sí mismo, y aun al impío para el día malo.

verses.KJV: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.WEB: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
verses.ASV: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Jehovah: [Though] hand [join] in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR abomina todo orgulhoso de coração; certamente não ficará impune.
verses.RVR09: Abominación es á Jehová todo altivo de corazón: aunque esté mano sobre mano, no será reputado inocente.

verses.KJV: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.
verses.WEB: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
verses.ASV: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for; And by the fear of Jehovah men depart from evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com misericórdia e fidelidade a perversidade é reconciliada; e com o temor ao SENHOR se desvia do mal.
verses.RVR09: Con misericordia y verdad se corrige el pecado: y con el temor de Jehová se apartan del mal los hombres.

verses.KJV: When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.WEB: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.ASV: When a man’s ways please Jehovah, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os caminhos do homem são agradáveis ao SENHOR, ele faz até seus inimigos terem paz com ele.
verses.RVR09: Cuando los caminos del hombre son agradables á Jehová, aun á sus enemigos pacificará con él.

verses.KJV: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.WEB: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
verses.ASV: Better is a little, with righteousness, Than great revenues with injustice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o pouco com justiça, do que a abundância de rendas com injustiça.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es lo poco con justicia, que la muchedumbre de frutos sin derecho.

verses.KJV: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.
verses.WEB: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
verses.ASV: A man’s heart deviseth his way; But Jehovah directeth his steps.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração do homem planeja seu caminho, mas é o SENHOR que dirige seus passos.
verses.RVR09: El corazón del hombre piensa su camino: mas Jehová endereza sus pasos.

verses.KJV: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.WEB: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
verses.ASV: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king; His mouth shall not transgress in judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nos lábios do rei estão palavras sublimes; sua boca não transgride quando julga.
verses.RVR09: Adivinación está en los labios del rey: en juicio no prevaricará su boca.

verses.KJV: A just weight and balance are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.WEB: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
verses.ASV: A just balance and scales are Jehovah’s; All the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.ALMEIDA: O peso e a balança justos pertencem ao SENHOR; a ele pertencem todos os pesos da bolsa.
verses.RVR09: Peso y balanzas justas son de Jehová: obra suya son todas las pesas de la bolsa.

verses.KJV: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.WEB: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.ASV: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness; For the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os reis abominam fazer perversidade, porque com justiça é que se confirma o trono.
verses.RVR09: Abominación es á los reyes hacer impiedad: porque con justicia será afirmado el trono.

verses.KJV: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.WEB: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
verses.ASV: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os lábios justos são do agrado dos reis, e eles amam ao que fala palavras direitas.
verses.RVR09: Los labios justos son el contentamiento de los reyes; y aman al que habla lo recto.

verses.KJV: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.WEB: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.ASV: The wrath of a king is [as] messengers of death; But a wise man will pacify it.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ira do rei é como mensageiros de morte; mas o homem sábio a apaziguará.
verses.RVR09: La ira del rey es mensajero de muerte: mas el hombre sabio la evitará.

verses.KJV: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.WEB: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
verses.ASV: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; And his favor is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.ALMEIDA: No brilho do rosto do rei há vida; e seu favor é como uma nuvem de chuva tardia.
verses.RVR09: En la alegría del rostro del rey está la vida; y su benevolencia es como nube de lluvia tardía.

verses.KJV: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.WEB: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
verses.ASV: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! Yea, to get understanding is rather to be chosen than silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Obter sabedoria é tão melhor do que o ouro! E obter sabedoria é mais excelente do que a prata.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es adquirir sabiduría que oro preciado; y adquirir inteligencia vale más que la plata.

verses.KJV: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.WEB: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
verses.ASV: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: A estrada dos corretos se afasta do mal; e guarda sua alma quem vigia seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: El camino de los rectos es apartarse del mal: su alma guarda el que guarda su camino.

verses.KJV: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.WEB: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
verses.ASV: Pride [goeth] before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes da destruição vem a arrogância, e antes da queda vem a soberba de espírito.
verses.RVR09: Antes del quebrantamiento es la soberbia; y antes de la caída la altivez de espíritu.

verses.KJV: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.WEB: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
verses.ASV: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.ALMEIDA: É melhor ser humilde de espírito com os mansos, do que repartir despojos com os arrogantes.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es humillar el espíritu con los humildes, que partir despojos con los soberbios.

verses.KJV: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.
verses.WEB: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.
verses.ASV: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; And whoso trusteth in Jehovah, happy is he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que pensa prudentemente na palavra encontrará o bem; e quem confia no SENHOR é bem-aventurado.
verses.RVR09: El entendido en la palabra, hallará el bien: y el que confía en Jehová, él es bienaventurado.

verses.KJV: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.WEB: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
verses.ASV: The wise in heart shall be called prudent; And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sábio de coração será chamado de prudente; e a doçura dos lábios aumentará a instrução.
verses.RVR09: El sabio de corazón es llamado entendido: y la dulzura de labios aumentará la doctrina.

verses.KJV: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.WEB: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
verses.ASV: Understanding is a well-spring of life unto him that hath it; But the correction of fools is [their] folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manancial de vida é o entendimento, para queles que o possuem; mas a instrução dos tolos é loucura.
verses.RVR09: Manantial de vida es el entendimiento al que lo posee: mas la erudición de los necios es necedad.

verses.KJV: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.WEB: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
verses.ASV: The heart of the wise instructeth his mouth, And addeth learning to his lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração do sábio dá prudência à sua boca; e sobre seus lábios aumentará a instrução.
verses.RVR09: El corazón del sabio hace prudente su boca; y con sus labios aumenta la doctrina.

verses.KJV: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.WEB: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.ASV: Pleasant words are [as] a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Favo de mel são as palavras suaves: doces para a alma, e remédio para os ossos.
verses.RVR09: Panal de miel son los dichos suaves: suavidad al alma y medicina á los huesos.

verses.KJV: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.WEB: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.ASV: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há um caminho que parece direito ao homem, porém seu fim são caminhos de morte.
verses.RVR09: Hay camino que parece derecho al hombre, mas su salida son caminos de muerte.

verses.KJV: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.WEB: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.
verses.ASV: The appetite of the laboring man laboreth for him; For his mouth urgeth him [thereto].
verses.ALMEIDA: A alma do trabalhador faz ele trabalhar para si, porque sua boca o obriga.
verses.RVR09: El alma del que trabaja, trabaja para sí; porque su boca le constriñe.

verses.KJV: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.WEB: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
verses.ASV: A worthless man deviseth mischief; And in his lips there is as a scorching fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem maligno cava o mal, e em seus lábios [há] como que um fogo ardente.
verses.RVR09: El hombre perverso cava el mal; y en sus labios hay como llama de fuego.

verses.KJV: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.WEB: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
verses.ASV: A perverse man scattereth abroad strife; And a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem perverso levanta contenda, e o difamador faz [até] grandes amigos se separarem.
verses.RVR09: El hombre perverso levanta contienda; y el chismoso aparta los mejores amigos.

verses.KJV: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
verses.WEB: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
verses.ASV: A man of violence enticeth his neighbor, And leadeth him in a way that is not good.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem violento ilude a seu próximo, e o guia por um caminho que não é bom.
verses.RVR09: El hombre malo lisonjea á su prójimo, y le hace andar por el camino no bueno:

verses.KJV: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.WEB: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
verses.ASV: He that shutteth his eyes, [it is] to devise perverse things: He that compresseth his lips bringeth evil to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fecha seus olhos para imaginar perversidades; ele aperta os lábios para praticar o mal.
verses.RVR09: Cierra sus ojos para pensar perversidades; mueve sus labios, efectúa el mal.

verses.KJV: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.WEB: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
verses.ASV: The hoary head is a crown of glory; It shall be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cabelos grisalhos são uma coroa de honra, [caso] se encontrem no caminho de justiça.
verses.RVR09: Corona de honra es la vejez, que se hallará en el camino de justicia.

verses.KJV: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.WEB: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
verses.ASV: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit, than he that taketh a city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o que demora para se irritar do que o valente; e [melhor é] aquele que domina seu espírito do que aquele que toma uma cidade.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es el que tarde se aira que el fuerte; y el que se enseñorea de su espíritu, que el que toma una ciudad.

verses.KJV: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
verses.ASV: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: A sorte é lançada no colo, mas toda decisão pertence ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: La suerte se echa en el seno: mas de Jehová es el juicio de ella.

verses.KJV: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
verses.WEB: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.ASV: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, Than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é um pedaço seco de comida com tranquilidade, do que uma casa cheia de carne com briga.
verses.RVR09: MEJOR es un bocado seco, y en paz, que la casa de contienda llena de víctimas.

verses.KJV: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.WEB: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
verses.ASV: A servant that dealeth wisely shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, And shall have part in the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.ALMEIDA: O servo prudente dominará o filho causador de vergonha, e receberá parte da herança entre os irmãos.
verses.RVR09: El siervo prudente se enseñoreará del hijo que deshonra, y entre los hermanos partirá la herencia.

verses.KJV: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts.
verses.WEB: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.
verses.ASV: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; But Jehovah trieth the hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: O crisol é para a prata, e o forno para o ouro; mas o SENHOR prova os corações.
verses.RVR09: El crisol para la plata, y la hornaza para el oro: mas Jehová prueba los corazones.

verses.KJV: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.WEB: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
verses.ASV: An evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; [And] a liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: O malfeitor presta atenção ao lábio injusto; o mentiroso inclina os ouvidos à língua maligna.
verses.RVR09: El malo está atento al labio inicuo; y el mentiroso escucha á la lengua detractora.

verses.KJV: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.WEB: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
verses.ASV: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker; [And] he that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem ridiculariza o pobre insulta o seu Criador; aquele que se alegra da calamidade não ficará impune.
verses.RVR09: El que escarnece al pobre, afrenta á su Hacedor: y el que se alegra en la calamidad, no quedará sin castigo.

verses.KJV: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.WEB: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.
verses.ASV: Children’s children are the crown of old men; And the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: A coroa dos idosos [são] os filhos de seus filhos; e a glória dos filhos são seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Corona de los viejos son los hijos de los hijos; y la honra de los hijos, sus padres.

verses.KJV: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.WEB: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
verses.ASV: Excellent speech becometh not a fool; Much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é adequado ao tolo falar com elegância; muito menos para o príncipe falar mentiras.
verses.RVR09: No conviene al necio la altilocuencia: ¡cuánto menos al príncipe el labio mentiroso!

verses.KJV: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.WEB: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
verses.ASV: A bribe is [as] a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it; Whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O presente é [como] uma pedra preciosa aos olhos de seus donos; para onde quer que se voltar, [tentará] ter algum proveito.
verses.RVR09: Piedra preciosa es el cohecho en ojos de sus dueños: á donde quiera que se vuelve, da prosperidad.

verses.KJV: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
verses.WEB: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
verses.ASV: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that harpeth on a matter separateth chief friends.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem perdoa a transgressão busca a amizade; mas quem repete o assunto afasta amigos íntimos.
verses.RVR09: El que cubre la prevaricación, busca amistad: mas el que reitera la palabra, aparta al amigo.

verses.KJV: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.WEB: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
verses.ASV: A rebuke entereth deeper into one that hath understanding Than a hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.ALMEIDA: A repreensão entra mais profundamente no prudente do que cem açoites no tolo.
verses.RVR09: Aprovecha la reprensión en el entendido, más que si cien veces hiriese en el necio.

verses.KJV: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.WEB: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.ASV: An evil man seeketh only rebellion; Therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na verdade quem é mal busca somente a rebeldia; mas o mensageiro cruel será enviado contra ele.
verses.RVR09: El rebelde no busca sino mal; y mensajero cruel será contra él enviado.

verses.KJV: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.WEB: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.ASV: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: [É melhor] ao homem encontrar uma ursa roubada [de seus filhotes] ,do que um tolo em sua loucura.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es se encuentre un hombre con una osa á la cual han robado sus cachorros, que con un fatuo en su necedad.

verses.KJV: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.WEB: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.ASV: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, Evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto ao que devolve o mal no lugar do bem, o mal nunca se afastará de sua casa.
verses.RVR09: El que da mal por bien, no se apartará el mal de su casa.

verses.KJV: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.WEB: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
verses.ASV: The beginning of strife is [as] when one letteth out water: Therefore leave off contention, before there is quarrelling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Começar uma briga é [como] deixar águas rolarem; por isso, abandona a discussão antes que haja irritação.
verses.RVR09: El que comienza la pendencia es como quien suelta las aguas: deja pues la porfía, antes que se enmarañe.

verses.KJV: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord.
verses.WEB: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
verses.ASV: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, Both of them alike are an abomination to Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem absolve ao perverso e quem condena ao justo, ambos são abomináveis ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El que justifica al impío, y el que condena al justo, ambos á dos son abominación á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
verses.WEB: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
verses.ASV: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, Seeing he hath no understanding?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que serve o dinheiro na mão do tolo, já que ele não tem interesse em obter sabedoria?
verses.RVR09: ¿De qué sirve el precio en la mano del necio para comprar sabiduría, no teniendo entendimiento?

verses.KJV: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.WEB: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.ASV: A friend loveth at all times; And a brother is born for adversity.
verses.ALMEIDA: O amigo ama em todo tempo, e o irmão nasce para [ajudar] na angústia.
verses.RVR09: En todo tiempo ama el amigo; y el hermano para la angustia es nacido.

verses.KJV: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
verses.WEB: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.ASV: A man void of understanding striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem imprudente assume compromisso, ficando como fiador de seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: El hombre falto de entendimiento toca la mano, fiando á otro delante de su amigo.

verses.KJV: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.WEB: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
verses.ASV: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: He that raiseth high his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem ama a briga, ama a transgressão; quem constrói alta sua porta busca ruína.
verses.RVR09: La prevaricación ama el que ama pleito; y el que alza su portada, quebrantamiento busca.

verses.KJV: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.WEB: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
verses.ASV: He that hath a wayward heart findeth no good; And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso de coração nunca encontrará o bem; e quem distorce [as palavras de] sua língua cairá no mal.
verses.RVR09: El perverso de corazón nunca hallará bien: y el que revuelve con su lengua, caerá en mal.

verses.KJV: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.WEB: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
verses.ASV: He that begetteth a fool [doeth it] to his sorrow; And the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem gera o louco [cria] sua própria tristeza; e o pai do imprudente não se alegrará.
verses.RVR09: El que engendra al necio, para su tristeza lo engendra: y el padre del fatuo no se alegrará.

verses.KJV: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verses.WEB: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
verses.ASV: A cheerful heart is a good medicine; But a broken spirit drieth up the bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração alegre é um bom remédio, mas o espírito abatido faz os ossos se secarem.
verses.RVR09: El corazón alegre produce buena disposición: mas el espíritu triste seca los huesos.

verses.KJV: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.WEB: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
verses.ASV: A wicked man receiveth a bribe out of the bosom, To pervert the ways of justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: O perverso toma o presente do seio, para perverter os caminhos da justiça.
verses.RVR09: El impío toma dádiva del seno, para pervertir las sendas del derecho.

verses.KJV: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.WEB: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
verses.ASV: Wisdom is before the face of him that hath understanding; But the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A sabedoria está diante do rosto do prudente; porém os olhos do tolo [estão voltados] para os confins da terra.
verses.RVR09: En el rostro del entendido aparece la sabiduría: mas los ojos del necio vagan hasta el cabo de la tierra.

verses.KJV: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.WEB: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
verses.ASV: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O filho tolo é tristeza para seu pai, e amargura para aquela que o gerou.
verses.RVR09: El hijo necio es enojo á su padre, y amargura á la que lo engendró.

verses.KJV: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
verses.WEB: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
verses.ASV: Also to punish the righteous is not good, [Nor] to smite the noble for [their] uprightness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também não é bom punir ao justo, nem bater nos príncipes por causa da justiça.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente no es bueno condenar al justo, ni herir á los príncipes que hacen lo recto.

verses.KJV: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
verses.WEB: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
verses.ASV: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; And he that is of a cool spirit is a man of understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem entende o conhecimento guarda suas palavras; [e] o homem de bom entendimento [é] de espírito calmo.
verses.RVR09: Detiene sus dichos el que tiene sabiduría: de prudente espíritu es el hombre entendido.

verses.KJV: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
verses.WEB: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
verses.ASV: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; When he shutteth his lips, he is [esteemed as] prudent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até o tolo, quando está calado, é considerado como sábio; [e] quem fecha seus lábios, como de bom senso.
verses.RVR09: Aun el necio cuando calla, es contado por sabio: el que cierra sus labios es entendido.

verses.KJV: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
verses.WEB: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
verses.ASV: He that separateth himself seeketh [his own] desire, And rageth against all sound wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem se isola busca seu [próprio] desejo; ele se volta contra toda sabedoria.
verses.RVR09: SEGÚN su antojo busca el que se desvía, y se entremete en todo negocio.

verses.KJV: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
verses.WEB: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
verses.ASV: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But only that his heart may reveal itself.
verses.ALMEIDA: O tolo não tem prazer no entendimento, mas sim em revelar sua [própria] opinião.
verses.RVR09: No toma placer el necio en la inteligencia, sino en lo que su corazón se descubre.

verses.KJV: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
verses.WEB: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
verses.ASV: When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, And with ignominy [cometh] reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na vinda do perverso, vem também o desprezo; e com a desonra [vem] a vergonha.
verses.RVR09: Cuando viene el impío, viene también el menosprecio, y con el deshonrador la afrenta.

verses.KJV: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
verses.WEB: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
verses.ASV: The words of a man’s mouth are [as] deep waters; The wellspring of wisdom is [as] a flowing brook.
verses.ALMEIDA: A boca do homem são [como] águas profundas; e o manancial de sabedoria [como] um ribeiro transbordante.
verses.RVR09: Aguas profundas son las palabras de la boca del hombre; y arroyo revertiente, la fuente de la sabiduría.

verses.KJV: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.WEB: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
verses.ASV: To respect the person of the wicked is not good, [Nor] to turn aside the righteous in judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é bom favorecer ao perverso para prejudicar ao justo num julgamento.
verses.RVR09: Tener respeto á la persona del impío, para hacer caer al justo de su derecho, no es bueno.

verses.KJV: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
verses.WEB: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
verses.ASV: A fool’s lips enter into contention, And his mouth calleth for stripes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os lábios do tolo entram em briga, e sua boca chama pancadas.
verses.RVR09: Los labios del necio vienen con pleito; y su boca á cuestiones llama.

verses.KJV: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.WEB: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
verses.ASV: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, And his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: A boca do tolo é sua [própria] destruição, e seus lábios [são] armadilha para sua alma.
verses.RVR09: La boca del necio es quebrantamiento para sí, y sus labios son lazos para su alma.

verses.KJV: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.WEB: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
verses.ASV: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.
verses.ALMEIDA: As palavras do fofoqueiro são como alimentos deliciosos, que descem até o interior do ventre.
verses.RVR09: Las palabras del chismoso parecen blandas, y descienden hasta lo íntimo del vientre.

verses.KJV: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
verses.WEB: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
verses.ASV: He also that is slack in his work Is brother to him that is a destroyer.
verses.ALMEIDA: O preguiçoso em fazer sua obra é irmão do causador de prejuízo.
verses.RVR09: También el que es negligente en su obra es hermano del hombre disipador.

verses.KJV: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
verses.ASV: The name of Jehovah is a strong tower; The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.ALMEIDA: O nome do SENHOR é uma torre forte; o justo correrá até ele, e ficará seguro.
verses.RVR09: Torre fuerte es el nombre de Jehová: á él correrá el justo, y será levantado.

verses.KJV: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
verses.WEB: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
verses.ASV: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own imagination.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os bens do rico são [como] uma cidade fortificada, e como um muro alto em sua imaginação.
verses.RVR09: Las riquezas del rico son la ciudad de su fortaleza, y como un muro alto en su imaginación.

verses.KJV: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
verses.WEB: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
verses.ASV: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty; And before honor [goeth] humility.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes da ruína o coração humano é orgulhoso; e antes da honra [vem] a humildade.
verses.RVR09: Antes del quebrantamiento se eleva el corazón del hombre, y antes de la honra es el abatimiento.

verses.KJV: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verses.WEB: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
verses.ASV: He that giveth answer before he heareth, It is folly and shame unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem responde antes de ouvir [age] como tolo e causa vergonha para si.
verses.RVR09: El que responde palabra antes de oir, le es fatuidad y oprobio.

verses.KJV: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
verses.WEB: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
verses.ASV: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a broken spirit who can bear?
verses.ALMEIDA: O espírito do homem o sustentará quando doente; mas o espírito abatido, quem o levantará?
verses.RVR09: El ánimo del hombre soportará su enfermedad: mas ¿quién soportará al ánimo angustiado?

verses.KJV: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.WEB: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.ASV: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração do prudente adquire conhecimento; e o ouvido dos sábios busca conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: El corazón del entendido adquiere sabiduría; y el oído de los sabios busca la ciencia.

verses.KJV: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
verses.WEB: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
verses.ASV: A man’s gift maketh room for him, And bringeth him before great men.
verses.ALMEIDA: O presente do homem alarga seu caminho, e o leva perante a face dos grandes.
verses.RVR09: El presente del hombre le ensancha el camino, y le lleva delante de los grandes.

verses.KJV: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
verses.WEB: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.
verses.ASV: He that pleadeth his cause first [seemeth] just; But his neighbor cometh and searcheth him out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que primeiro mostra sua causa [parece ser] justo; mas [somente até] que outro venha, e o investigue.
verses.RVR09: El primero en su propia causa parece justo; y su adversario viene, y le sondea.

verses.KJV: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
verses.WEB: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
verses.ASV: The lot causeth contentions to cease, And parteth between the mighty.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sorteio cessa disputas, e separa poderosos [de se confrontarem] .
verses.RVR09: La suerte pone fin á los pleitos, y desparte los fuertes.

verses.KJV: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.WEB: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
verses.ASV: A brother offended [is harder to be won] than a strong city; And [such] contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.ALMEIDA: O irmão ofendido [é mais difícil] que uma cidade fortificada; e as brigas são como ferrolhos de uma fortaleza.
verses.RVR09: El hermano ofendido es más tenaz que una ciudad fuerte: y las contiendas de los hermanos son como cerrojos de alcázar.

verses.KJV: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.WEB: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
verses.ASV: A man’s belly shall be filled with the fruit of his mouth; With the increase of his lips shall he be satisfied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Do fruto da boca do homem seu ventre se fartará; dos produtos de seus lábios se saciará.
verses.RVR09: Del fruto de la boca del hombre se hartará su vientre; hartaráse del producto de sus labios.

verses.KJV: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.WEB: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.ASV: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; And they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: A morte e a vida estão no poder da língua; e aquele que a ama comerá do fruto dela.
verses.RVR09: La muerte y la vida están en poder de la lengua; y el que la ama comerá de sus frutos.

verses.KJV: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.
verses.ASV: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, And obtaineth favor of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem encontrou esposa, encontrou o bem; e obteve o favor do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El que halló esposa halló el bien, y alcanzó la benevolencia de Jehová.

verses.KJV: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
verses.WEB: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
verses.ASV: The poor useth entreaties; But the rich answereth roughly.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pobre fala com súplicas; mas o rico responde com durezas.
verses.RVR09: El pobre habla con ruegos; mas el rico responde durezas.

verses.KJV: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.WEB: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
verses.ASV: He that maketh many friends [doeth it] to his own destruction; But there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem [que tem] amigos pode ser prejudicado [por eles] ; porém há um amigo mais chegado que um irmão.
verses.RVR09: El hombre que tiene amigos, ha de mostrarse amigo: y amigo hay más conjunto que el hermano.

verses.KJV: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.WEB: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
verses.ASV: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity Than he that is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o pobre que anda em sua honestidade do que o perverso de lábios e tolo.
verses.RVR09: MEJOR es el pobre que camina en su sencillez, que el de perversos labios y fatuo.

verses.KJV: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.WEB: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.
verses.ASV: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; And he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não é bom a alma sem conhecimento; e quem tem pés apressados comete erros.
verses.RVR09: El alma sin ciencia no es buena; y el presuroso de pies peca.

verses.KJV: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.
verses.WEB: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.
verses.ASV: The foolishness of man subverteth his way; And his heart fretteth against Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: A loucura do homem perverte seu caminho; e seu coração se ira contra o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: La insensatez del hombre tuerce su camino; y contra Jehová se aira su corazón.

verses.KJV: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.WEB: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
verses.ASV: Wealth addeth many friends; But the poor is separated from his friend.
verses.ALMEIDA: A riqueza faz ganhar muitos amigos; mas ao pobre, até seu amigo o abandona.
verses.RVR09: Las riquezas allegan muchos amigos: mas el pobre, de su amigo es apartado.

verses.KJV: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
verses.WEB: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
verses.ASV: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall not escape.
verses.ALMEIDA: A falsa testemunha não ficará impune; e quem fala mentiras não escapará.
verses.RVR09: El testigo falso no quedará sin castigo; y el que habla mentiras no escapará.

verses.KJV: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.WEB: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
verses.ASV: Many will entreat the favor of the liberal man; And every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos suplicam perante o príncipe; e todos querem ser amigos daquele que dá presentes.
verses.RVR09: Muchos rogarán al príncipe: mas cada uno es amigo del hombre que da.

verses.KJV: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.WEB: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
verses.ASV: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: How much more do his friends go far from him! He pursueth [them with] words, [but] they are gone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os irmãos do pobre o odeiam; ainda mais seus amigos se afastam dele; ele corre atrás deles com palavras, mas eles nada lhe [respondem] .
verses.RVR09: Todos los hermanos del pobre le aborrecen: ¡cuánto más sus amigos se alejarán de él! buscará la palabra y no la hallará.

verses.KJV: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.WEB: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
verses.ASV: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: He that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem adquire entendimento ama sua alma; quem guarda a prudência encontrará o bem.
verses.RVR09: El que posee entendimiento, ama su alma: el que guarda la inteligencia, hallará el bien.

verses.KJV: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.WEB: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
verses.ASV: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: A falsa testemunha não ficará impune; e quem fala mentiras perecerá.
verses.RVR09: El testigo falso no quedará sin castigo; y el que habla mentiras, perecerá.

verses.KJV: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.WEB: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.ASV: Delicate living is not seemly for a fool; Much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.ALMEIDA: O luxo não é adequado ao tolo; muito menos ao servo dominar sobre príncipes.
verses.RVR09: No conviene al necio el deleite: ¡cuánto menos al siervo ser señor de los príncipes!

verses.KJV: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.WEB: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
verses.ASV: The discretion of a man maketh him slow to anger; And it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.ALMEIDA: A prudência do homem retém sua ira; e sua glória é ignorar a ofensa.
verses.RVR09: La cordura del hombre detiene su furor; y su honra es disimular la ofensa.

verses.KJV: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.WEB: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.ASV: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; But his favor is as dew upon the grass.
verses.ALMEIDA: A fúria do rei é como o rugido de um leão; mas seu favor é como orvalho sobre a erva.
verses.RVR09: Como el bramido del cachorro de león es la ira del rey; y su favor como el rocío sobre la hierba.

verses.KJV: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.WEB: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
verses.ASV: A foolish son is the calamity of his father; And the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.ALMEIDA: O filho tolo é uma desgraça ao seu pai; e brigas da esposa são [como] uma goteira duradoura.
verses.RVR09: Dolor es para su padre el hijo necio; y gotera continua las contiendas de la mujer.

verses.KJV: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.
verses.WEB: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
verses.ASV: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers; But a prudent wife is from Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: A casa e as riquezas são a herança dos pais; porém a mulher prudente [vem] do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: La casa y las riquezas herencia son de los padres: mas de Jehová la mujer prudente.

verses.KJV: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.WEB: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.ASV: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; And the idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.ALMEIDA: A preguiça faz cair num sono profundo; e a alma desocupada passará fome.
verses.RVR09: La pereza hace caer en sueño; y el alma negligente hambreará.

verses.KJV: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.WEB: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
verses.ASV: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; [But] he that is careless of his ways shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem guarda o mandamento cuida de sua alma; e quem despreza seus caminhos morrerá.
verses.RVR09: El que guarda el mandamiento, guarda su alma: mas el que menospreciare sus caminos, morirá.

verses.KJV: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verses.WEB: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.
verses.ASV: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto Jehovah, And his good deed will he pay him again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem faz misericórdia ao pobre empresta ao SENHOR; e ele lhe pagará sua recompensa.
verses.RVR09: A Jehová empresta el que da al pobre, y él le dará su paga.

verses.KJV: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
verses.WEB: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
verses.ASV: Chasten thy son, seeing there is hope; And set not thy heart on his destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Castiga a teu filho enquanto há esperança; mas não levantes tua alma para o matar.
verses.RVR09: Castiga á tu hijo en tanto que hay esperanza; mas no se excite tu alma para destruirlo.

verses.KJV: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
verses.WEB: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
verses.ASV: A man of great wrath shall bear the penalty; For if thou deliver [him], thou must do it yet again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que tem grande irá será punido; porque se tu [o] livrares, terás de fazer o mesmo de novo.
verses.RVR09: El de grande ira llevará la pena: y si usa de violencias, añadirá nuevos males.

verses.KJV: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.WEB: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
verses.ASV: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, That thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve o conselho, e recebe a disciplina; para que sejas sábio nos teus últimos [dias] .
verses.RVR09: Escucha el consejo, y recibe la corrección, para que seas sabio en tu vejez.

verses.KJV: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.
verses.WEB: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
verses.ASV: There are many devices in a man’s heart; But the counsel of Jehovah, that shall stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há muitos pensamentos no coração do homem; porém o conselho do SENHOR prevalecerá.
verses.RVR09: Muchos pensamientos hay en el corazón del hombre; mas el consejo de Jehová permanecerá.

verses.KJV: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.WEB: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
verses.ASV: That which maketh a man to be desired is his kindness; And a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que se deseja do homem [é] sua bondade; porém o pobre é melhor do que o homem mentiroso.
verses.RVR09: Contentamiento es á los hombres hacer misericordia: pero mejor es el pobre que el mentiroso.

verses.KJV: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.WEB: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
verses.ASV: The fear of Jehovah [tendeth] to life; And he [that hath it] shall abide satisfied; He shall not be visited with evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao SENHOR [encaminha] para a vida; aquele que [o tem] habitará satisfeito, nem mal algum o visitará.
verses.RVR09: El temor de Jehová es para vida; y con él vivirá el hombre, lleno de reposo; no será visitado de mal.

verses.KJV: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.WEB: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.ASV: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.ALMEIDA: O preguiçoso põe sua mão no prato, e nem sequer a leva de volta à boca.
verses.RVR09: El perezoso esconde su mano en el seno: aun á su boca no la llevará.

verses.KJV: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.WEB: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
verses.ASV: Smite a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; And reprove one that hath understanding, [and] he will understand knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fere ao zombador, e o ingênuo será precavido; e repreende ao prudente, e ele aprenderá conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Hiere al escarnecedor, y el simple se hará avisado; y corrigiendo al entendido, entenderá ciencia.

verses.KJV: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.WEB: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
verses.ASV: He that doeth violence to his father, and chaseth away his mother, Is a son that causeth shame and bringeth reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que prejudica ao pai [ou] afugenta a mãe é filho causador de vergonha e de desgraça.
verses.RVR09: El que roba á su padre y ahuyenta á su madre, hijo es avergonzador y deshonrador.

verses.KJV: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.WEB: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
verses.ASV: Cease, my son, to hear instruction [Only] to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho meu, deixa de ouvir a instrução, [então] te desviarás das palavras de conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Cesa, hijo mío, de oir la enseñanza que induce á divagar de las razones de sabiduría.

verses.KJV: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.WEB: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
verses.ASV: A worthless witness mocketh at justice; And the mouth of the wicked swalloweth iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: A má testemunha escarnece do juízo; e a boca dos perversos engole injustiça.
verses.RVR09: El testigo perverso se burlará del juicio; y la boca de los impíos encubrirá la iniquidad.

verses.KJV: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.WEB: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
verses.ASV: Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And stripes for the back of fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: Julgamentos estão preparados para zombadores, e açoites para as costas dos tolos.
verses.RVR09: Aparejados están juicios para los escarnecedores, y azotes para los cuerpos de los insensatos.

verses.KJV: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.WEB: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
verses.ASV: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler; And whosoever erreth thereby is not wise.
