verses.ALMEIDA: O vinho é zombador, a bebida forte é causadora de alvoroços; e todo aquele que errar por causa deles não é sábio.
verses.RVR09: EL vino es escarnecedor, la cerveza alborotadora; y cualquiera que por ello errare, no será sabio.

verses.KJV: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
verses.WEB: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
verses.ASV: The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: He that provoketh him to anger sinneth [against] his own life.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor ao rei é como um rugido de leão; e quem se ira contra ele peca contra sua [própria] alma.
verses.RVR09: Como bramido de cachorro de león es el terror del rey: el que lo hace enfurecerse, peca contra su alma.

verses.KJV: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.WEB: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
verses.ASV: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; But every fool will be quarrelling.
verses.ALMEIDA: É honroso ao homem terminar a disputa; mas todo tolo nela se envolve.
verses.RVR09: Honra es del hombre dejarse de contienda: mas todo insensato se envolverá en ella.

verses.KJV: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.WEB: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.ASV: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; Therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: O preguiçoso não lavra no inverno; [por isso] ele mendigará durante a ceifa, pois nada terá.
verses.RVR09: El perezoso no ara á causa del invierno; pedirá pues en la siega, y no hallará.

verses.KJV: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.WEB: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.ASV: Counsel in the heart of man is [like] deep water; But a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.ALMEIDA: O conselho no coração do homem [é como] águas profundas; mas o homem prudente [consegue] tirá-lo para fora.
verses.RVR09: Como aguas profundas es el consejo en el corazón del hombre: mas el hombre entendido lo alcanzará.

verses.KJV: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.WEB: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
verses.ASV: Most men will proclaim every one his own kindness; But a faithful man who can find?
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos homens, cada um deles afirma ter bondade; porém o homem fiel, quem o encontrará?
verses.RVR09: Muchos hombres publican cada uno su liberalidad: mas hombre de verdad, ¿quién lo hallará?

verses.KJV: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.WEB: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
verses.ASV: A righteous man that walketh in his integrity, Blessed are his children after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo caminha em sua integridade; bem-aventurados [serão] seus filhos depois dele.
verses.RVR09: El justo que camina en su integridad, bienaventurados serán sus hijos después de él.

verses.KJV: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.WEB: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
verses.ASV: A king that sitteth on the throne of judgment Scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei, ao se sentar no trono do juízo, com seus olhos dissipa todo mal.
verses.RVR09: El rey que se sienta en el trono de juicio, con su mirar disipa todo mal.

verses.KJV: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.WEB: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?
verses.ASV: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem poderá dizer: “Purifiquei meu coração; estou limpo de meu pecado”?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién podrá decir: Yo he limpiado mi corazón, limpio estoy de mi pecado?

verses.KJV: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.
verses.WEB: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Diverse weights, and diverse measures, Both of them alike are an abomination to Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dois pesos e duas medidas, ambos são abominação ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Doble pesa y doble medida, abominación son á Jehová ambas cosas.

verses.KJV: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.WEB: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
verses.ASV: Even a child maketh himself known by his doings, Whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até o jovem é conhecido pelas suas ações, se sua obra for pura e correta.
verses.RVR09: Aun el muchacho es conocido por sus hechos, si su obra fuere limpia y recta.

verses.KJV: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the Lord hath made even both of them.
verses.WEB: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.
verses.ASV: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Jehovah hath made even both of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ouvido que ouve e o olho que vê, o SENHOR os fez ambos.
verses.RVR09: El oído que oye, y el ojo que ve, ambas cosas ha igualmente hecho Jehová.

verses.KJV: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.WEB: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
verses.ASV: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; Open thine eyes, [and] thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não ames ao sono, para que não empobreças; abre teus olhos, e te fartarás de pão.
verses.RVR09: No ames el sueño, porque no te empobrezcas; abre tus ojos, y te hartarás de pan.

verses.KJV: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.WEB: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
verses.ASV: It is bad, it is bad, saith the buyer; But when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Preço] ruim, [preço] ruim, diz o comprador; mas quando vai embora, então se gaba.
verses.RVR09: El que compra dice: malo es, malo es: mas en apartándose, se alaba.

verses.KJV: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.WEB: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
verses.ASV: There is gold, and abundance of rubies; But the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há ouro, e muitos rubis; mas os lábios do conhecimento são joia preciosa.
verses.RVR09: Hay oro y multitud de piedras preciosas: mas los labios sabios son vaso precioso.

verses.KJV: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.WEB: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
verses.ASV: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; And hold him in pledge [that is surety] for foreigners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma a roupa daquele que fica por fiador de estranho; toma como penhor daquele [que fica por fiador] da estranha.
verses.RVR09: Quítale su ropa al que salió por fiador del extraño; y tómale prenda al que fía la extraña.

verses.KJV: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.WEB: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
verses.ASV: Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man; But afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pão da mentira é agradável ao homem; mas depois sua boca se encherá de pedregulhos.
verses.RVR09: Sabroso es al hombre el pan de mentira; mas después su boca será llena de cascajo.

verses.KJV: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.WEB: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
verses.ASV: Every purpose is established by counsel; And by wise guidance make thou war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os planos são confirmados por meio do conselho; e com conselhos prudentes faze a guerra.
verses.RVR09: Los pensamientos con el consejo se ordenan: y con industria se hace la guerra.

verses.KJV: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.WEB: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
verses.ASV: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; Therefore company not with him that openeth wide his lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem anda fofocando revela segredos; por isso não te envolvas com aquele que fala demais com seus lábios.
verses.RVR09: El que descubre el secreto, en chismes anda: no te entrometas, pues, con el que lisonjea con sus labios.

verses.KJV: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.WEB: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
verses.ASV: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, His lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que amaldiçoar a seu pai ou a sua mãe terá sua lâmpada apagada em trevas profundas.
verses.RVR09: El que maldice á su padre ó á su madre, su lámpara será apagada en oscuridad tenebrosa.

verses.KJV: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.WEB: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.
verses.ASV: An inheritance [may be] gotten hastily at the beginning; But the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: A herança ganha apressadamente no princípio, seu fim não será abençoado.
verses.RVR09: La herencia adquirida de priesa al principio, aun su postrimería no será bendita.

verses.KJV: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee.
verses.WEB: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.
verses.ASV: Say not thou, I will recompense evil: Wait for Jehovah, and he will save thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não digas: Devolverei o mal; Espera pelo SENHOR, e ele te livrará.
verses.RVR09: No digas, yo me vengaré; espera á Jehová, y él te salvará.

verses.KJV: Divers weights are an abomination unto the Lord; and a false balance is not good.
verses.WEB: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
verses.ASV: Diverse weights are an abomination to Jehovah; And a false balance is not good.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR abomina pesos falsificados; e balanças enganosas não são boas.
verses.RVR09: Abominación son á Jehová las pesas dobles; y el peso falso no es bueno.

verses.KJV: Man's goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.WEB: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?
verses.ASV: A man’s goings are of Jehovah; How then can man understand his way?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os passos do homem pertencem ao SENHOR; como, pois, o homem entenderá seu caminho?
verses.RVR09: De Jehová son los pasos del hombre: ¿cómo pues entenderá el hombre su camino?

verses.KJV: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.WEB: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
verses.ASV: It is a snare to a man rashly to say, [It is] holy, And after vows to make inquiry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Armadilha ao homem é prometer precipitadamente algo como sagrado, e [somente] depois pensar na seriedade dos votos[ que fez] .
verses.RVR09: Lazo es al hombre el devorar lo santo, y andar pesquisando después de los votos.

verses.KJV: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.WEB: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
verses.ASV: A wise king winnoweth the wicked, And bringeth the [threshing]-wheel over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei sábio espalha os perversos, e os atropela.
verses.RVR09: El rey sabio esparce los impíos, y sobre ellos hace tornar la rueda.

verses.KJV: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.WEB: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
verses.ASV: The spirit of man is the lamp of Jehovah, Searching all his innermost parts.
verses.ALMEIDA: O espírito humano é uma lâmpada do SENHOR, que examina todo o interior do ventre.
verses.RVR09: Candela de Jehová es el alma del hombre, que escudriña lo secreto del vientre.

verses.KJV: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.WEB: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
verses.ASV: Kindness and truth preserve the king; And his throne is upholden by kindness.
verses.ALMEIDA: A bondade e a fidelidade protegem o rei; e com bondade seu trono é sustentado.
verses.RVR09: Misericordia y verdad guardan al rey; y con clemencia sustenta su trono.

verses.KJV: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
verses.WEB: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
verses.ASV: The glory of young men is their strength; And the beauty of old men is the hoary head.
verses.ALMEIDA: A beleza dos jovens é sua força; e a honra dos velhos é [seus] cabelos brancos.
verses.RVR09: La gloria de los jóvenes es su fortaleza, y la hermosura de los viejos la vejez.

verses.KJV: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.WEB: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
verses.ASV: Stripes that wound cleanse away evil; And strokes [reach] the innermost parts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os golpes das feridas purificam os maus; como também as pancadas no interior do corpo.
verses.RVR09: Las señales de las heridas son medicina para lo malo: y las llagas llegan á lo más secreto del vientre.

verses.KJV: The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.WEB: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
verses.ASV: The king’s heart is in the hand of Jehovah as the watercourses: He turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] ribeiros de águas é o coração do rei na mão do SENHOR, ele o conduz para onde quer.
verses.RVR09: COMO los repartimientos de las aguas, así está el corazón del rey en la mano de Jehová: á todo lo que quiere lo inclina.

verses.KJV: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.
verses.WEB: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.
verses.ASV: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the hearts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo caminho do homem é correto aos seus [próprios] olhos; mas o SENHOR pesa os corações.
verses.RVR09: Todo camino del hombre es recto en su opinión: mas Jehová pesa los corazones.

verses.KJV: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
verses.WEB: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.ASV: To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to Jehovah than sacrifice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Praticar justiça e juízo é mais aceitável ao SENHOR do que sacrifício.
verses.RVR09: Hacer justicia y juicio es á Jehová más agradable que sacrificio.

verses.KJV: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
verses.WEB: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
verses.ASV: A high look, and a proud heart, [Even] the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhos orgulhosos e coração arrogante: a lavoura dos perversos é pecado.
verses.RVR09: Altivez de ojos, y orgullo de corazón, y el brillo de los impíos, son pecado.

verses.KJV: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
verses.WEB: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
verses.ASV: The thoughts of the diligent [tend] only to plenteousness; But every one that is hasty [hasteth] only to want.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os planos de quem trabalha com empenho somente [levam] à abundância; mas [os de] todo apressado somente à pobreza.
verses.RVR09: Los pensamientos del solícito ciertamente van á abundancia; mas todo presuroso, indefectiblemente á pobreza.

verses.KJV: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.WEB: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
verses.ASV: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue Is a vapor driven to and fro by them that seek death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trabalhar [para obter] tesouros com língua mentirosa é algo inútil [e] fácil de se perder; os que [assim fazem] buscam a morte.
verses.RVR09: Allegar tesoros con lengua de mentira, es vanidad desatentada de aquellos que buscan la muerte.

verses.KJV: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.WEB: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
verses.ASV: The violence of the wicked shall sweep them away, Because they refuse to do justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: A violência [praticada] pelos perversos os destruirá, porque se negam a fazer o que é justo.
verses.RVR09: La rapiña de los impíos los destruirá; por cuanto no quisieron hacer juicio.

verses.KJV: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.WEB: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
verses.ASV: The way of him that is laden with guilt is exceeding crooked; But as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho do homem transgressor [é] problemático; porém a obra do puro é correta.
verses.RVR09: El camino del hombre perverso es torcido y extraño: mas la obra del limpio es recta.

verses.KJV: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.WEB: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
verses.ASV: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, Than with a contentious woman in a wide house.
verses.ALMEIDA: É melhor morar num canto do terraço do que numa casa espaçosa com uma mulher briguenta.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es vivir en un rincón de zaquizamí, que con la mujer rencillosa en espaciosa casa.

verses.KJV: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.WEB: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
verses.ASV: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: His neighbor findeth no favor in his eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: A alma do perverso deseja o mal; seu próximo não lhe agrada em seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: El alma del impío desea mal: su prójimo no le parece bien.

verses.KJV: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.WEB: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.ASV: When the scoffer is punished, the simple is made wise; And when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Castigando ao zombador, o ingênuo se torna sábio; e ensinando ao sábio, ele ganha conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Cuando el escarnecedor es castigado, el simple se hace sabio; y cuando se amonestare al sabio, aprenderá ciencia.

verses.KJV: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.WEB: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
verses.ASV: The righteous man considereth the house of the wicked, [How] the wicked are overthrown to [their] ruin.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo considera prudentemente a casa do perverso; ele transtorna os perversos para a ruína.
verses.RVR09: Considera el justo la casa del impío: cómo los impíos son trastornados por el mal.

verses.KJV: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.WEB: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
verses.ASV: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, He also shall cry, but shall not be heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tapa seu ouvido ao clamor do pobre, ele também clamará, mas não será ouvido.
verses.RVR09: El que cierra su oído al clamor del pobre, también él clamará, y no será oído.

verses.KJV: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.WEB: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
verses.ASV: A gift in secret pacifieth anger; And a present in the bosom, strong wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: O presente em segredo extingue a ira; e a dádiva no colo [acalma] o forte furor.
verses.RVR09: El presente en secreto amansa el furor, y el don en el seno, la fuerte ira.

verses.KJV: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.WEB: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.ASV: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegria para o justo é fazer justiça; mas [isso é] pavor para os que praticam maldade.
verses.RVR09: Alegría es al justo hacer juicio; mas quebrantamiento á los que hacen iniquidad.

verses.KJV: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.WEB: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
verses.ASV: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding Shall rest in the assembly of the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem que se afasta do caminho do entendimento repousará no ajuntamento dos mortos.
verses.RVR09: El hombre que se extravía del camino de la sabiduría, vendrá á parar en la compañía de los muertos.

verses.KJV: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.WEB: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
verses.ASV: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: He that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem ama o prazer sofrerá necessidade; aquele que ama o vinho e o azeite nunca enriquecerá.
verses.RVR09: Hombre necesitado será el que ama el deleite: y el que ama el vino y ungüentos no enriquecerá.

verses.KJV: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.WEB: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
verses.ASV: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; And the treacherous [cometh] in the stead of the upright.
verses.ALMEIDA: O resgate [em troca] do justo é o perverso; e no lugar do reto [fica] o transgressor.
verses.RVR09: El rescate del justo es el impío, y por los rectos el prevaricador.

verses.KJV: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.WEB: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
verses.ASV: It is better to dwell in a desert land, Than with a contentious and fretful woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: É melhor morar em terra deserta do que com uma mulher briguenta e que se irrita facilmente.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es morar en tierra del desierto, que con la mujer rencillosa é iracunda.

verses.KJV: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.WEB: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.
verses.ASV: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; But a foolish man swalloweth it up.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Há] tesouro desejável e azeite na casa do sábio; mas o homem tolo é devorador.
verses.RVR09: Tesoro codiciable y pingüe hay en la casa del sabio; mas el hombre insensato lo disipará.

verses.KJV: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.WEB: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.ASV: He that followeth after righteousness and kindness Findeth life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem segue a justiça e a bondade achará vida, justiça e honra.
verses.RVR09: El que sigue la justicia y la misericordia, hallará la vida, la justicia, y la honra.

verses.KJV: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.WEB: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
verses.ASV: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, And bringeth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sábio passa por cima da cidade dos fortes e derruba a fortaleza em que confiam.
verses.RVR09: La ciudad de los fuertes tomó el sabio, y derribó la fuerza en que ella confiaba.

verses.KJV: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.WEB: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
verses.ASV: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue Keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem guarda sua boca e sua língua guarda sua alma de angústias.
verses.RVR09: El que guarda su boca y su lengua, su alma guarda de angustias.

verses.KJV: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
verses.WEB: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
verses.ASV: The proud and haughty man, scoffer is his name; He worketh in the arrogance of pride.
verses.ALMEIDA: “Zombador” é o nome do arrogante e orgulhoso; ele trata [os outros] com uma arrogância irritante.
verses.RVR09: Soberbio y presuntuoso escarnecedor es el nombre del que obra con orgullosa saña.

verses.KJV: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.WEB: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
verses.ASV: The desire of the sluggard killeth him; For his hands refuse to labor.
verses.ALMEIDA: O desejo do preguiçoso o matará, porque suas mãos se recusam a trabalhar;
verses.RVR09: El deseo del perezoso le mata, porque sus manos no quieren trabajar.

verses.KJV: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.WEB: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
verses.ASV: There is that coveteth greedily all the day long; But the righteous giveth and withholdeth not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele fica desejando suas cobiças o dia todo; mas o justo dá, e não deixa de dar.
verses.RVR09: Hay quien todo el día codicia: mas el justo da, y no desperdicia.

verses.KJV: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
verses.WEB: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
verses.ASV: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; How much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind!
verses.ALMEIDA: O sacrifício dos perversos é abominável; quanto mais quando a oferta é feita com má intenção.
verses.RVR09: El sacrificio de los impíos es abominación: ¡cuánto más ofreciéndolo con maldad!

verses.KJV: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
verses.WEB: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
verses.ASV: A false witness shall perish; But the man that heareth shall speak so as to endure.
verses.ALMEIDA: A testemunha mentirosa perecerá; porém o homem que ouve [a verdade] falará com sucesso.
verses.RVR09: El testigo mentiroso perecerá: mas el hombre que oye, permanecerá en su dicho.

verses.KJV: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.WEB: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
verses.ASV: A wicked man hardeneth his face; But as for the upright, he establisheth his ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem perverso endurece seu rosto, mas o correto confirma o seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: El hombre impío afirma su rostro: mas el recto ordena sus caminos.

verses.KJV: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord.
verses.WEB: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.ASV: There is no wisdom nor understanding Nor counsel against Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há sabedoria, nem entendimento, nem conselho contra o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No hay sabiduría, ni inteligencia, ni consejo, contra Jehová.

verses.KJV: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.
verses.ASV: The horse is prepared against the day of battle; But victory is of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O cavalo é preparado para o dia da batalha, mas a vitória [vem] do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El caballo se apareja para el día de la batalla: mas de Jehová es el salvar.

verses.KJV: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.WEB: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
verses.ASV: A [good] name is rather to be chosen than great riches, [And] loving favor rather than silver and gold.
verses.ALMEIDA: É preferível ter um [bom] nome do que muitas riquezas; e ser favorecido é melhor que a prata e o o ouro.
verses.RVR09: DE más estima es la buena fama que las muchas riquezas; y la buena gracia más que la plata y el oro.

verses.KJV: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.
verses.WEB: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.
verses.ASV: The rich and the poor meet together: Jehovah is the maker of them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rico e o pobre se encontram; todos eles foram feitos pelo SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El rico y el pobre se encontraron: á todos ellos hizo Jehová.

verses.KJV: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.WEB: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.ASV: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; But the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O prudente vê o mal, e se esconde; mas os ingênuos passam e sofrem as consequências.
verses.RVR09: El avisado ve el mal, y escóndese: mas los simples pasan, y reciben el daño.

verses.KJV: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.
verses.WEB: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.
verses.ASV: The reward of humility [and] the fear of Jehovah [Is] riches, and honor, and life.
verses.ALMEIDA: A recompensa da humildade [e do] temor ao SENHOR são riquezas, honra, e vida.
verses.RVR09: Riquezas, y honra, y vida, son la remuneración de la humildad y del temor de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.WEB: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.
verses.ASV: Thorns [and] snares are in the way of the perverse: He that keepeth his soul shall be far from them.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Há] espinhos e ciladas no caminho do perverso; quem cuida de sua alma deve ficar longe de [tal caminho] .
verses.RVR09: Espinas y lazos hay en el camino del perverso: el que guarda su alma se alejará de ellos.

verses.KJV: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.WEB: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
verses.ASV: Train up a child in the way he should go, And even when he is old he will not depart from it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Instrui ao menino em seu caminho, e até quando envelhecer, não se desviará dele.
verses.RVR09: Instruye al niño en su carrera: aun cuando fuere viejo no se apartará de ella.

verses.KJV: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.WEB: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.ASV: The rich ruleth over the poor; And the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rico domina sobre os pobres, e quem toma emprestado é servo daquele que empresta.
verses.RVR09: El rico se enseñoreará de los pobres; y el que toma prestado, siervo es del que empresta.

verses.KJV: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.WEB: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
verses.ASV: He that soweth iniquity shall reap calamity; And the rod of his wrath shall fail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que semeia perversidade colherá sofrimento; e a vara de sua ira se acabará.
verses.RVR09: El que sembrare iniquidad, iniquidad segará: y consumiráse la vara de su ira.

verses.KJV: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.WEB: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
verses.ASV: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; For he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem olhos bondosos será abençoado, porque deu de seu pão ao pobre.
verses.RVR09: El ojo misericordioso será bendito, porque dió de su pan al indigente.

verses.KJV: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.WEB: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
verses.ASV: Cast out the scoffer, and contention will go out; Yea, strife and ignominy will cease.
verses.ALMEIDA: Expulsa ao zombador, e a briga terminará; cessará a disputa e a vergonha.
verses.RVR09: Echa fuera al escarnecedor, y saldrá la contienda, y cesará el pleito y la afrenta.

verses.KJV: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
verses.WEB: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
verses.ASV: He that loveth pureness of heart, [For] the grace of his lips the king will be his friend.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem ama a pureza do coração [fala] graciosamente com os lábios, [e] o rei [será] seu amigo.
verses.RVR09: El que ama la limpieza de corazón, por la gracia de sus labios su amigo será el rey.

verses.KJV: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
verses.ASV: The eyes of Jehovah preserve [him that hath] knowledge; But he overthroweth the words of the treacherous man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos do SENHOR protegem o conhecimento; porém ele transtornará as palavras do enganador.
verses.RVR09: Los ojos de Jehová miran por la ciencia; mas él trastorna las cosas de los prevaricadores.

verses.KJV: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.WEB: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
verses.ASV: The sluggard saith, There is a lion without; I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.ALMEIDA: O preguiçoso diz: Há um leão lá fora! Ele me matará nas ruas!
verses.RVR09: Dice el perezoso: El león está fuera; en mitad de las calles seré muerto.

verses.KJV: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.
verses.WEB: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.
verses.ASV: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit; He that is abhorred of Jehovah shall fall therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: A boca da mulher pervertida é uma cova profunda; aquele contra quem o SENHOR se irar cairá nela.
verses.RVR09: Sima profunda es la boca de las extrañas: aquel contra el cual estuviere Jehová airado, caerá en ella.

verses.KJV: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.WEB: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
verses.ASV: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; [But] the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: A tolice está amarrada ao coração do menino; [mas] a vara da correção a mandará para longe dele.
verses.RVR09: La necedad está ligada en el corazón del muchacho; mas la vara de la corrección la hará alejar de él.

verses.KJV: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
verses.WEB: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
verses.ASV: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his [gain], [And] he that giveth to the rich, [shall come] only to want.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que oprime ao pobre para proveito próprio e aquele que dá [suborno] ao rico certamente empobrecerão.
verses.RVR09: El que oprime al pobre para aumentarse él, y que da al rico, ciertamente será pobre.

verses.KJV: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
verses.WEB: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
verses.ASV: Incline thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, And apply thy heart unto my knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Inclina o teu ouvido e escuta as palavras dos sábios; dispõe teu coração ao meu conhecimento;
verses.RVR09: Inclina tu oído, y oye las palabras de los sabios, y pon tu corazón á mi sabiduría:

verses.KJV: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
verses.WEB: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
verses.ASV: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee, If they be established together upon thy lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque é agradável que as guardes dentro de ti, e estejam prontas para os teus lábios;
verses.RVR09: Porque es cosa deleitable, si las guardares en tus entrañas; y que juntamente sean ordenadas en tus labios.

verses.KJV: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.WEB: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.
verses.ASV: That thy trust may be in Jehovah, I have made [them] known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: para que tua confiança esteja no SENHOR, eu as ensino a ti hoje.
verses.RVR09: Para que tu confianza sea en Jehová, te las he hecho saber hoy á ti también.

verses.KJV: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.WEB: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
verses.ASV: Have not I written unto thee excellent things Of counsels and knowledge,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não te escrevi excelentes coisas sobre o conselho e o conhecimento,
verses.RVR09: ¿No te he escrito tres veces en consejos y ciencia,

verses.KJV: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
verses.WEB: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
verses.ASV: To make thee know the certainty of the words of truth, That thou mayest carry back words of truth to them that send thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: para te ensinar a certeza das palavras da verdade, para que possas responder palavras de verdade aos que te enviarem?
verses.RVR09: Para hacerte saber la certidumbre de las razones verdaderas, para que puedas responder razones de verdad á los que á ti enviaren?

verses.KJV: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.WEB: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
verses.ASV: Rob not the poor, because he is poor; Neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não roubes ao pobre, porque ele é pobre; nem oprimas ao aflito junto à porta do julgamento.
verses.RVR09: No robes al pobre, porque es pobre, ni quebrantes en la puerta al afligido:

verses.KJV: For the Lord will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.WEB: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah will plead their cause, And despoil of life those that despoil them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR defenderá a causa deles em juízo, e quanto aos que os roubam, ele lhes roubará a alma.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová juzgará la causa de ellos, y despojará el alma de aquellos que los despojaren.

verses.KJV: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
verses.WEB: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,
verses.ASV: Make no friendship with a man that is given to anger; And with a wrathful man thou shalt not go:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não seja companheiro de quem se irrita facilmente, nem andes com o homem furioso,
verses.RVR09: No te entrometas con el iracundo, ni te acompañes con el hombre de enojos;

verses.KJV: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
verses.WEB: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.
verses.ASV: Lest thou learn his ways, And get a snare to thy soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não aprendas o caminho dele, e te ponhas em armadilhas para tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Porque no aprendas sus maneras, y tomes lazo para tu alma.

verses.KJV: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.WEB: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
verses.ASV: Be thou not one of them that strike hands, [Or] of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não estejas entre os que se comprometem em acordos com as mãos, [ou] os que ficam por fiadores de dívidas.
verses.RVR09: No estés entre los que tocan la mano, entre los que fían por deudas.

verses.KJV: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.WEB: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
verses.ASV: If thou hast not wherewith to pay, Why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se não tens como pagar, por que razão tirariam tua cama debaixo de ti?
verses.RVR09: Si no tuvieres para pagar, ¿por qué han de quitar tu cama de debajo de ti?

verses.KJV: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
verses.WEB: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
verses.ASV: Remove not the ancient landmark, Which thy fathers have set.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não mudes os limites antigos que teus pais fizeram.
verses.RVR09: No traspases el término antiguo que pusieron tus padres.

verses.KJV: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
verses.WEB: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
verses.ASV: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; He shall not stand before mean men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Viste um homem habilidoso em sua obra? Perante a face dos reis ele será posto; ele não será posto diante de pessoas sem honra.
verses.RVR09: ¿Has visto hombre solícito en su obra? delante de los reyes estará; no estará delante de los de baja suerte.

verses.KJV: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
verses.WEB: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
verses.ASV: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, Consider diligently him that is before thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando te sentares para comer com algum dominador, presta muita atenção para o que estiver diante de ti;
verses.RVR09: CUANDO te sentares á comer con algún señor, considera bien lo que estuviere delante de ti;

verses.KJV: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.WEB: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.
verses.ASV: And put a knife to thy throat, If thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E põe uma faca à tua garganta, se tiveres muito apetite.
verses.RVR09: Y pon cuchillo á tu garganta, si tienes gran apetito.

verses.KJV: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
verses.WEB: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
verses.ASV: Be not desirous of his dainties; Seeing they are deceitful food.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não desejes as comidas gostosas dele, porque são pão de mentiras.
verses.RVR09: No codicies sus manjares delicados, porque es pan engañoso.

verses.KJV: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.WEB: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
verses.ASV: Weary not thyself to be rich; Cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não trabalhes exaustivamente para ser rico; modera-te por meio de tua prudência.
verses.RVR09: No trabajes por ser rico; pon coto á tu prudencia.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.WEB: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
verses.ASV: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? For [riches] certainly make themselves wings, Like an eagle that flieth toward heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porás teus olhos fixos sobre aquilo que é nada? Porque certamente se fará asas, e voará ao céu como uma águia.
verses.RVR09: ¿Has de poner tus ojos en las riquezas, siendo ningunas? porque hacerse han alas, como alas de águila, y volarán al cielo.

verses.KJV: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.WEB: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,
verses.ASV: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, Neither desire thou his dainties:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não comas o pão de quem tem olho maligno, nem cobices suas comidas gostosas.
verses.RVR09: No comas pan de hombre de mal ojo, ni codicies sus manjares:

verses.KJV: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verses.WEB: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
verses.ASV: For as he thinketh within himself, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; But his heart is not with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele calcula [seus gastos] consigo mesmo. Assim ele dirá: Come e bebe; Mas o coração dele não está contigo;
verses.RVR09: Porque cual es su pensamiento en su alma, tal es él. Come y bebe, te dirá; mas su corazón no está contigo.

verses.KJV: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.WEB: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
verses.ASV: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, And lose thy sweet words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vomitarias o pedaço que comeste, e perderias tuas palavras agradáveis.
verses.RVR09: Vomitarás la parte que tú comiste, y perderás tus suaves palabras.

verses.KJV: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.WEB: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
verses.ASV: Speak not in the hearing of a fool; For he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não fales aos ouvidos do tolo, porque ele desprezará a prudência de tuas palavras.
verses.RVR09: No hables á oídos del necio; porque menospreciará la prudencia de tus razones.

verses.KJV: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.WEB: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
verses.ASV: Remove not the ancient landmark; And enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não mudes os limites antigos, nem ultrapasses as propriedades dos órfãos;
verses.RVR09: No traspases el término antiguo, ni entres en la heredad de los huérfanos:

verses.KJV: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.WEB: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
verses.ASV: For their Redeemer is strong; He will plead their cause against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Defensor deles é poderoso; ele disputará a causa deles contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Porque el defensor de ellos es el Fuerte, el cual juzgará la causa de ellos contra ti.

verses.KJV: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.WEB: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.ASV: Apply thy heart unto instruction, And thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aplica teu coração à disciplina, e teus ouvidos às palavras de conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Aplica tu corazón á la enseñanza, y tus oídos á las palabras de sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.WEB: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
verses.ASV: Withhold not correction from the child; [For] if thou beat him with the rod, he will not die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não retires a disciplina do jovem; quando lhe bateres com a vara, nem [por isso] morrerá.
verses.RVR09: No rehuses la corrección del muchacho: porque si lo hirieres con vara, no morirá.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.WEB: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, And shalt deliver his soul from Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu lhe baterás com a vara, e livrarás a sua alma do Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Tú lo herirás con vara, y librarás su alma del infierno.

verses.KJV: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.WEB: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
verses.ASV: My son, if thy heart be wise, My heart will be glad, even mine:
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu filho, se teu coração for sábio, meu coração se alegrará, e eu também.
verses.RVR09: Hijo mío, si tu corazón fuere sabio, también á mí se me alegrará el corazón;

verses.KJV: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.WEB: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
verses.ASV: Yea, my heart will rejoice, When thy lips speak right things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu interior saltará de alegria quando teus lábios falarem coisas corretas.
verses.RVR09: Mis entrañas también se alegrarán, cuando tus labios hablaren cosas rectas.

verses.KJV: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day long.
verses.WEB: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.
verses.ASV: Let not thy heart envy sinners; But [be thou] in the fear of Jehovah all the day long:
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu coração não inveje aos pecadores; porém [permanece] no temor ao SENHOR o dia todo;
verses.RVR09: No tenga tu corazón envidia de los pecadores, antes persevera en el temor de Jehová todo tiempo:

verses.KJV: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.WEB: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.ASV: For surely there is a reward; And thy hope shall not be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque certamente há um [bom] futuro [para ti] , e tua expectativa não será cortada.
verses.RVR09: Porque ciertamente hay fin, y tu esperanza no será cortada.

verses.KJV: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.WEB: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
verses.ASV: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, And guide thy heart in the way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve, filho meu, e sê sábio; e conduz teu coração no caminho [correto] .
verses.RVR09: Oye tú, hijo mío, y sé sabio, y endereza tu corazón al camino.

verses.KJV: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.WEB: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;
verses.ASV: Be not among winebibbers, Among gluttonous eaters of flesh:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não esteja entre os beberrões de vinho, [nem] entre os comilões de carne.
verses.RVR09: No estés con los bebedores de vino, ni con los comedores de carne:

verses.KJV: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.WEB: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
verses.ASV: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty; And drowsiness will clothe [a man] with rags.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o beberrão e o comilão empobrecerão; e a sonolência os faz vestir trapos.
verses.RVR09: Porque el bebedor y el comilón empobrecerán: y el sueño hará vestir vestidos rotos.

verses.KJV: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.WEB: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
verses.ASV: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, And despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve a teu pai, que te gerou; e não desprezes a tua mãe, quando ela envelhecer.
verses.RVR09: Oye á tu padre, á aquel que te engendró; y cuando tu madre envejeciere, no la menosprecies.

verses.KJV: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.WEB: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
verses.ASV: Buy the truth, and sell it not; [Yea], wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Compra a verdade, e não a vendas; [faze o mesmo com] a sabedoria, a disciplina e a prudência.
verses.RVR09: Compra la verdad, y no la vendas; la sabiduría, la enseñanza, y la inteligencia.

verses.KJV: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
verses.WEB: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
verses.ASV: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice; And he that begetteth a wise child will have joy of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pai do justo muito se alegrará; aquele que gerar o sábio se encherá de alegria por causa dele.
verses.RVR09: Mucho se alegrará el padre del justo: y el que engendró sabio se gozará con él.

verses.KJV: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
verses.WEB: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
verses.ASV: Let thy father and thy mother be glad, And let her that bare thee rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu pai e tua mãe se alegrarão; aquela te te gerou se encherá de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Alégrense tu padre y tu madre, y gócese la que te engendró.

verses.KJV: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
verses.WEB: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
verses.ASV: My son, give me thy heart; And let thine eyes delight in my ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu filho, dá para mim teu coração, e que teus olhos prestem atenção em meus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Dame, hijo mío, tu corazón, y miren tus ojos por mis caminos.

verses.KJV: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
verses.WEB: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
verses.ASV: For a harlot is a deep ditch; And a foreign woman is a narrow pit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a prostituta é [como] uma cova profunda, e a estranha [como] um poço estreito.
verses.RVR09: Porque sima profunda es la ramera, y pozo angosto la extraña.

verses.KJV: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
verses.WEB: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
verses.ASV: Yea, she lieth in wait as a robber, And increaseth the treacherous among men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também ela fica espreitando como um ladrão, e acrescenta transgressores entre os homens.
verses.RVR09: También ella, como robador, acecha, y multiplica entre los hombres los prevaricadores.

verses.KJV: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
verses.WEB: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
verses.ASV: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? Who hath complaining? who hath wounds without cause? Who hath redness of eyes?
verses.ALMEIDA: De quem são os ais? De quem são os sofrimentos? De quem são as lutas? De quem são as queixas? De quem são as feridas desnecessárias? De quem são os olhos vermelhos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Para quién será el ay? ¿para quién el ay? ¿para quién las rencillas? ¿para quién las quejas? ¿para quién las heridas en balde? ¿para quién lo amoratado de los ojos?

verses.KJV: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.WEB: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
verses.ASV: They that tarry long at the wine; They that go to seek out mixed wine.
verses.ALMEIDA: São daqueles que gastam tempo junto ao vinho, daqueles que andam em busca da bebida misturada.
verses.RVR09: Para los que se detienen mucho en el vino, para los que van buscando la mistura.

verses.KJV: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
verses.WEB: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
verses.ASV: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, When it sparkleth in the cup, When it goeth down smoothly:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não prestes atenção ao vinho quando se mostra vermelho, quando brilha no copo e escorre suavemente,
verses.RVR09: No mires al vino cuando rojea, cuando resplandece su color en el vaso: éntrase suavemente;

verses.KJV: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.WEB: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
verses.ASV: At the last it biteth like a serpent, And stingeth like an adder.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Pois] seu fim é [como] mordida de cobra, e picará como uma víbora.
verses.RVR09: Mas al fin como serpiente morderá, y como basilisco dará dolor:

verses.KJV: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.WEB: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
verses.ASV: Thine eyes shall behold strange things, And thy heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus olhos verão [coisas] estranhas, e teu coração falará perversidades;
verses.RVR09: Tus ojos mirarán las extrañas, y tu corazón hablará perversidades.

verses.KJV: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.WEB: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
verses.ASV: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, Or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serás como o que dorme no meio do mar, e como o que dorme no topo do mastro.
verses.RVR09: Y serás como el que yace en medio de la mar, ó como el que está en la punta de un mastelero.

verses.KJV: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.WEB: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
verses.ASV: They have stricken me, [shalt thou say], and I was not hurt; They have beaten me, and I felt it not: When shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.ALMEIDA: [E dirás] : Espancaram-me, mas não senti dor; bateram em mim, mas não senti; quando virei a despertar? Vou buscar mais uma [bebida] .
verses.RVR09: Y dirás: Hiriéronme, mas no me dolió; azotáronme, mas no lo sentí; cuando despertare, aun lo tornaré á buscar.

verses.KJV: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
verses.WEB: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;
verses.ASV: Be not thou envious against evil men; Neither desire to be with them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tenhas inveja dos homens malignos, nem desejes estar com eles;
verses.RVR09: NO tengas envidia de los hombres malos, ni desees estar con ellos:

verses.KJV: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
verses.WEB: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.
verses.ASV: For their heart studieth oppression, And their lips talk of mischief.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o coração deles imagina destruição, e os lábios deles falam de opressão.
verses.RVR09: Porque su corazón piensa en robar, é iniquidad hablan sus labios.

verses.KJV: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
verses.WEB: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
verses.ASV: Through wisdom is a house builded; And by understanding it is established;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela sabedoria a casa é edificada, e pelo entendimento ela fica firme;
verses.RVR09: Con sabiduría se edificará la casa, y con prudencia se afirmará:

verses.KJV: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.WEB: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
verses.ASV: And by knowledge are the chambers filled With all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pelo conhecimento os cômodos se encherão de riquezas preciosas e agradáveis.
verses.RVR09: Y con ciencia se henchirán las cámaras de todo bien preciado y agradable.

verses.KJV: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
verses.WEB: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,
verses.ASV: A wise man is strong; Yea, a man of knowledge increaseth might.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem sábio é poderoso; e o homem que tem conhecimento aumenta [sua] força;
verses.RVR09: El hombre sabio es fuerte; y de pujante vigor el hombre docto.

verses.KJV: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.WEB: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.
verses.ASV: For by wise guidance thou shalt make thy war; And in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque com conselhos prudentes farás tua guerra; e a vitória [é alcançada] pela abundância de conselheiros.
verses.RVR09: Porque con ingenio harás la guerra: y la salud está en la multitud de consejeros.

verses.KJV: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
verses.WEB: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
verses.ASV: Wisdom is too high for a fool: He openeth not his mouth in the gate.
verses.ALMEIDA: A sabedoria é alta demais para o tolo; na porta [do julgamento] ele não abre sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Alta está para el insensato la sabiduría: en la puerta no abrirá él su boca.

verses.KJV: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
verses.WEB: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.
verses.ASV: He that deviseth to do evil, Men shall call him a mischief-maker.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem planeja fazer o mal será chamado de vilão.
verses.RVR09: Al que piensa mal hacer le llamarán hombre de malos pensamientos.

verses.KJV: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
verses.WEB: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
verses.ASV: The thought of foolishness is sin; And the scoffer is an abomination to men.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pensamento do tolo é pecado; e o zombador é abominável aos homens.
verses.RVR09: El pensamiento del necio es pecado: y abominación á los hombres el escarnecedor.

verses.KJV: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
verses.WEB: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
verses.ASV: If thou faint in the day of adversity, Thy strength is small.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Se] te mostrares fraco no dia da angústia, como é pouca tua força!
verses.RVR09: Si fueres flojo en el día de trabajo, tu fuerza será reducida.

verses.KJV: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
verses.WEB: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
verses.ASV: Deliver them that are carried away unto death, And those that are ready to be slain see that thou hold back.
verses.ALMEIDA: Livra os que estão tomados para a morte, os que estão sendo levados para serem mortos;
verses.RVR09: Si dejares de librar los que son tomados para la muerte, y los que son llevados al degolladero;

verses.KJV: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
verses.WEB: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?
verses.ASV: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew not this; Doth not he that weigheth the hearts consider it? And he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? And shall not he render to every man according to his work?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois se tu disseres: Eis que não sabíamos,Por acaso aquele que pesa os corações não saberá? Aquele que guarda tua alma não conhecerá? Ele retribuirá ao homem conforme sua obra.
verses.RVR09: Si dijeres: Ciertamente no lo supimos; ¿no lo entenderá el que pesa los corazones? El que mira por tu alma, él lo conocerá, y dará al hombre según sus obras.

verses.KJV: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
verses.WEB: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;
verses.ASV: My son, eat thou honey, for it is good; And the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to thy taste:
verses.ALMEIDA: Come mel, meu filho, porque é bom; e o favo de mel é doce ao teu paladar.
verses.RVR09: Come, hijo mío, de la miel, porque es buena, y del panal dulce á tu paladar:

verses.KJV: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.WEB: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.
verses.ASV: So shalt thou know wisdom to be unto thy soul; If thou hast found it, then shall there be a reward, And thy hope shall not be cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim será o conhecimento da sabedoria para tua alma; se a encontrares haverá recompensa [para ti] ; e tua esperança não será cortada.
verses.RVR09: Tal será el conocimiento de la sabiduría á tu alma: si la hallares tendrá recompensa, y al fin tu esperanza no será cortada.

verses.KJV: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
verses.WEB: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;
verses.ASV: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous; Destroy not his resting-place:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, perverso, não espies a habitação do justo, nem assoles seu quarto;
verses.RVR09: Oh impío, no aceches la tienda del justo, no saquees su cámara;

verses.KJV: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verses.WEB: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
verses.ASV: For a righteous man falleth seven times, and riseth up again; But the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o justo cai sete vezes, e se levanta; mas os perversos tropeçam no mal.
verses.RVR09: Porque siete veces cae el justo, y se torna á levantar; mas los impíos caerán en el mal.

verses.KJV: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
verses.WEB: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
verses.ASV: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, And let not thy heart be glad when he is overthrown;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando teu inimigo cair, não te alegres; nem teu coração fique contente quando ele tropeçar,
verses.RVR09: Cuando cayere tu enemigo, no te huelgues; y cuando tropezare, no se alegre tu corazón:

verses.KJV: Lest the Lord see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.WEB: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.ASV: Lest Jehovah see it, and it displease him, And he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não [aconteça] de o SENHOR veja, e o desagrade, e desvie dele sua ira.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová no lo mire, y le desagrade, y aparte de sobre él su enojo.

verses.KJV: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked:
verses.WEB: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;
verses.ASV: Fret not thyself because of evil-doers; Neither be thou envious at the wicked:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te irrites com os malfeitores, nem tenhas inveja dos perversos;
verses.RVR09: No te entrometas con los malignos, ni tengas envidia de los impíos;

verses.KJV: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.WEB: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
verses.ASV: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; The lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o maligno não terá um bom futuro; a lâmpada dos perversos se apagará.
verses.RVR09: Porque para el malo no habrá buen fin, y la candela de los impíos será apagada.

verses.KJV: My son, fear thou the Lord and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
verses.WEB: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,
verses.ASV: My son, fear thou Jehovah and the king; [And] company not with them that are given to change:
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu filho, teme ao SENHOR e ao rei; e não te envolvas com os rebeldes;
verses.RVR09: Teme á Jehová, hijo mío, y al rey; no te entrometas con los veleidosos:

verses.KJV: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
verses.WEB: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?
verses.ASV: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; And the destruction from them both, who knoweth it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a destruição deles se levantará de repente; e quem sabe que ruína eles terão?
verses.RVR09: Porque su quebrantamiento se levantará de repente; y el quebrantamiento de ambos, ¿quién lo comprende?

verses.KJV: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
verses.WEB: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
verses.ASV: These also are [sayings] of the wise. To have respect of persons in judgment is not good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes [provérbios] também são para os sábios: fazer acepção de pessoas num julgamento não é bom.
verses.RVR09: También estas cosas pertenecen á los sabios. Tener respeto á personas en el juicio no es bueno.

verses.KJV: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou are righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
verses.WEB: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—
verses.ASV: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous, Peoples shall curse him, nations shall abhor him;
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que disser ao ímpio: Tu és justo,Os povos o amaldiçoarão, as nações o detestarão.
verses.RVR09: El que dijere al malo, Justo eres, los pueblos lo maldecirán, y le detestarán las naciones:

verses.KJV: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.WEB: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.
verses.ASV: But to them that rebuke [him] shall be delight, And a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas para aqueles que [o] repreenderem, haverá coisas boas; e sobre eles virá uma boa bênção.
verses.RVR09: Mas los que lo reprenden, serán agradables, y sobre ellos vendrá bendición de bien.

verses.KJV: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
verses.WEB: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
verses.ASV: He kisseth the lips Who giveth a right answer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem responde palavras corretas é [como se] estivesse beijando com os lábios.
verses.RVR09: Besados serán los labios del que responde palabras rectas.

verses.KJV: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
verses.WEB: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
verses.ASV: Prepare thy work without, And make it ready for thee in the field; And afterwards build thy house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Prepara o teu trabalho de fora, e deixa pronto o teu campo; então depois, edifica a tua casa.
verses.RVR09: Apresta tu obra de afuera, y disponla en tu heredad; y después edificarás tu casa.

verses.KJV: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
verses.WEB: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.
verses.ASV: Be not a witness against thy neighbor without cause; And deceive not with thy lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejas testemunha contra o teu próximo sem causa; por que enganarias com teus lábios?
verses.RVR09: No seas sin causa testigo contra tu prójimo; y no lisonjees con tus labios.

verses.KJV: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
verses.WEB: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
verses.ASV: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me; I will render to the man according to his work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não digas: Assim como ele fez a mim, assim também farei a ele; pagarei a cada um conforme sua obra.
verses.RVR09: No digas: Como me hizo, así le haré; daré el pago al hombre según su obra.

verses.KJV: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.WEB: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.
verses.ASV: I went by the field of the sluggard, And by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.ALMEIDA: Passei junto ao campo do preguiçoso, e junto à vinha do homem sem juízo;
verses.RVR09: Pasé junto á la heredad del hombre perezoso, y junto á la viña del hombre falto de entendimiento;

verses.KJV: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.WEB: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
verses.ASV: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, The face thereof was covered with nettles, And the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.ALMEIDA: e eis que ela estava toda cheia de espinheiros, [e] sua superfície coberta de urtigas; e o seu muro de pedras estava derrubado.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí que por toda ella habían ya crecido espinas, ortigas habían ya cubierto su haz, y su cerca de piedra estaba ya destruída.

verses.KJV: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
verses.WEB: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:
verses.ASV: Then I beheld, and considered well; I saw, and received instruction:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eu vi [isso] , aprendi em meu coração, e, olhando, recebi instrução:
verses.RVR09: Y yo miré, y púselo en mi corazón: vilo, y tomé consejo.

verses.KJV: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.WEB: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,
verses.ASV: [Yet] a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep;
verses.ALMEIDA: um pouco de sono, cochilando um pouco, cruzando as mãos por um pouco de tempo, deitado,
verses.RVR09: Un poco de sueño, cabeceando otro poco, poniendo mano sobre mano otro poco para dormir;

verses.KJV: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
verses.WEB: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
verses.ASV: So shall thy poverty come as a robber, And thy want as an armed man.
verses.ALMEIDA: e assim a tua pobreza virá como um assaltante; a tua necessidade, como um homem armado.
verses.RVR09: Así vendrá como caminante tu necesidad, y tu pobreza como hombre de escudo.

verses.KJV: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
verses.WEB: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
verses.ASV: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes também são provérbios de Salomão, que foram copiados pelos homens de Ezequias, rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: TAMBIÉN estos son proverbios de Salomón, los cuales copiaron los varones de Ezechîas, rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.WEB: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.ASV: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing; But the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: É glória de Deus encobrir alguma coisa; mas a glória dos Reis é investigá-la.
verses.RVR09: Gloria de Dios es encubrir la palabra; mas honra del rey es escudriñar la palabra.

verses.KJV: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.WEB: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
verses.ASV: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, So the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para a altura dos céus, para a profundeza da terra, assim como para o coração dos reis, não há como serem investigados.
verses.RVR09: Para la altura de los cielos, y para la profundidad de la tierra, y para el corazón de los reyes, no hay investigación.

verses.KJV: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
verses.WEB: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.
