verses.ASV: Take away the dross from the silver, And there cometh forth a vessel for the refiner:
verses.ALMEIDA: Tira as escórias da prata, e sairá um vaso para o fundidor.
verses.RVR09: Quita las escorias de la plata, y saldrá vaso al fundidor.

verses.KJV: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
verses.WEB: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
verses.ASV: Take away the wicked [from] before the king, And his throne shall be established in righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tira o perverso de diante do rei, e seu trono se firmará com justiça.
verses.RVR09: Aparta al impío de la presencia del rey, y su trono se afirmará en justicia.

verses.KJV: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
verses.WEB: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;
verses.ASV: Put not thyself forward in the presence of the king, And stand not in the place of great men:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não honres a ti mesmo perante o rei, nem te ponhas no lugar dos grandes;
verses.RVR09: No te alabes delante del rey, ni estés en el lugar de los grandes:

verses.KJV: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
verses.WEB: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
verses.ASV: For better is it that it be said unto thee, Come up hither, Than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince, Whom thine eyes have seen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque é melhor que te digam: Sobe aqui;Do que te rebaixem perante a face do príncipe, a quem teus olhos viram.
verses.RVR09: Porque mejor es que se te diga, Sube acá, que no que seas humillado delante del príncipe que miraron tus ojos.

verses.KJV: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
verses.WEB: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
verses.ASV: Go not forth hastily to strive, Lest [thou know not] what to do in the end thereof, When thy neighbor hath put thee to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejas apressado para entrar numa disputa; senão, o que farás se no fim teu próximo te envergonhar?
verses.RVR09: No salgas á pleito presto, no sea que no sepas qué hacer al fin, después que tu prójimo te haya dejado confuso.

verses.KJV: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
verses.WEB: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,
verses.ASV: Debate thy cause with thy neighbor [himself], And disclose not the secret of another;
verses.ALMEIDA: Disputa tua causa com teu próximo, mas não reveles segredo de outra pessoa.
verses.RVR09: Trata tu causa con tu compañero y no descubras el secreto á otro.

verses.KJV: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
verses.WEB: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
verses.ASV: Lest he that heareth it revile thee, And thine infamy turn not away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não te envergonhe aquele que ouvir; pois tua má fama não pode ser desfeita.
verses.RVR09: No sea que te deshonre el que lo oyere, y tu infamia no pueda repararse.

verses.KJV: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
verses.WEB: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
verses.ASV: A word fitly spoken Is [like] apples of gold in network of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: A palavra dita em tempo apropriado é [como] maçãs de ouro em bandejas de prata.
verses.RVR09: Manzana de oro con figuras de plata es la palabra dicha como conviene.

verses.KJV: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
verses.WEB: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
verses.ASV: [As] an ear-ring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, [So is] a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sábio que repreende junto a um ouvido disposto a escutar é [como] pendentes de ouro e ornamentos de ouro refinado.
verses.RVR09: Como zarcillo de oro y joyel de oro fino, es el que reprende al sabio que tiene oído dócil.

verses.KJV: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
verses.WEB: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
verses.ASV: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, [So is] a faithful messenger to them that send him; For he refresheth the soul of his masters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como frio de neve no tempo da colheita, [assim] é o mensageiro fiel para aqueles que o enviam; porque ele refresca a alma de seus senhores.
verses.RVR09: Como frío de nieve en tiempo de la siega, así es el mensajero fiel á los que lo envían: pues al alma de su señor da refrigerio.

verses.KJV: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
verses.WEB: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
verses.ASV: [As] clouds and wind without rain, [So is] he that boasteth himself of his gifts falsely.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] nuvens e ventos que não trazem chuva, [assim] é o homem que se orgulha de falsos presentes.
verses.RVR09: Como nubes y vientos sin lluvia, así es el hombre que se jacta de vana liberalidad.

verses.KJV: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
verses.WEB: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
verses.ASV: By long forbearing is a ruler persuaded, And a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com paciência para não se irar é que se convence um líder; e a língua suave quebra ossos.
verses.RVR09: Con larga paciencia se aplaca el príncipe; y la lengua blanda quebranta los huesos.

verses.KJV: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
verses.WEB: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
verses.ASV: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, Lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Achaste mel? Come o que te for suficiente; para que não venhas a ficar cheio demais, e vomites.
verses.RVR09: ¿Hallaste la miel? come lo que te basta; no sea que te hartes de ella, y la vomites.

verses.KJV: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
verses.WEB: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
verses.ASV: Let thy foot be seldom in thy neighbor’s house, Lest he be weary of thee, and hate thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não exagere teus pés na casa de teu próximo, para que ele não se canse de ti, e te odeie.
verses.RVR09: Detén tu pie de la casa de tu vecino, porque harto de ti no te aborrezca.

verses.KJV: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
verses.WEB: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
verses.ASV: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbor Is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Martelo, espada e flecha afiada é o homem que fala falso testemunho contra seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: Martillo y cuchillo y saeta aguda, es el hombre que habla contra su prójimo falso testimonio.

verses.KJV: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.WEB: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.
verses.ASV: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble Is [like] a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confiar num infiel no tempo de angústia é [como] um dente quebrado ou um pé sem firmeza.
verses.RVR09: Diente quebrado y pie resbalador, es la confianza en el prevaricador en tiempo de angustia.

verses.KJV: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
verses.WEB: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
verses.ASV: [As] one that taketh off a garment in cold weather, [and as] vinegar upon soda, So is he that singeth songs to a heavy heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem canta canções ao coração aflito é como aquele que tira a roupa num dia frio, ou como vinagre sobre salitre.
verses.RVR09: El que canta canciones al corazón afligido, es como el que quita la ropa en tiempo de frío, ó el que sobre el jabón echa vinagre.

verses.KJV: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
verses.WEB: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
verses.ASV: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; And if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se aquele que te odeia tiver fome, dá-lhe pão para comer; e se tiver sede, dá-lhe água para beber;
verses.RVR09: Si el que te aborrece tuviere hambre, dale de comer pan; y si tuviere sed, dale de beber agua:

verses.KJV: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord shall reward thee.
verses.WEB: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
verses.ASV: For thou wilt heap coals of fire upon his head, And Jehovah will reward thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque [assim] amontoarás brasas sobre a cabeça dele, e o SENHOR te recompensará.
verses.RVR09: Porque ascuas allegas sobre su cabeza, y Jehová te lo pagará.

verses.KJV: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
verses.WEB: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
verses.ASV: The north wind bringeth forth rain; So doth a backbiting tongue an angry countenance.
verses.ALMEIDA: O vento norte traz a chuva; [assim como] a língua caluniadora [traz] a ira no rosto.
verses.RVR09: El viento del norte ahuyenta la lluvia, y el rostro airado la lengua detractora.

verses.KJV: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
verses.WEB: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
verses.ASV: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, Than with a contentious woman in a wide house.
verses.ALMEIDA: É melhor morar num canto do terraço do que com uma mulher briguenta numa casa espaçosa.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es estar en un rincón de casa, que con la mujer rencillosa en espaciosa casa.

verses.KJV: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.WEB: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.ASV: [As] cold waters to a thirsty soul, So is good news from a far country.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] água refrescante para a alma cansada, assim são boas notícias de uma terra distante.
verses.RVR09: Como el agua fría al alma sedienta, así son las buenas nuevas de lejanas tierras.

verses.KJV: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
verses.WEB: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
verses.ASV: [As] a troubled fountain, and a corrupted spring, [So is] a righteous man that giveth way before the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo que se deixa levar pelo perverso é [como] uma fonte turva e um manancial poluído.
verses.RVR09: Como fuente turbia y manantial corrompido, es el justo que cae delante del impío.

verses.KJV: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
verses.WEB: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
verses.ASV: It is not good to eat much honey; So [for men] to search out their own glory is grievous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Comer muito mel não é bom; assim como buscar muita glória para si.
verses.RVR09: Comer mucha miel no es bueno: ni el buscar la propia gloria es gloria.

verses.KJV: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
verses.WEB: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
verses.ASV: He whose spirit is without restraint Is [like] a city that is broken down and without walls.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem que não pode conter seu espírito é [como] uma cidade derrubada sem muro.
verses.RVR09: Como ciudad derribada y sin muro, es el hombre cuyo espíritu no tiene rienda.

verses.KJV: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
verses.WEB: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
verses.ASV: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, So honor is not seemly for a fool.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como a neve no verão, como a chuva na colheita, assim também não convém a honra para o tolo.
verses.RVR09: COMO la nieve en el verano, y la lluvia en la siega, así conviene al necio la honra.

verses.KJV: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
verses.WEB: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.
verses.ASV: As the sparrow in her wandering, as the swallow in her flying, So the curse that is causeless alighteth not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como um pássaro a vaguear, como a andorinha a voar, assim também a maldição não virá sem causa.
verses.RVR09: Como el gorrión en su vagar, y como la golondrina en su vuelo, así la maldición sin causa nunca vendrá.

verses.KJV: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.
verses.WEB: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
verses.ASV: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, And a rod for the back of fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: Açoite para o cavalo, cabresto para o asno; e vara para as costas dos tolos.
verses.RVR09: El látigo para el caballo, y el cabestro para el asno, y la vara para la espalda del necio.

verses.KJV: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
verses.WEB: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
verses.ASV: Answer not a fool according to his folly, Lest thou also be like unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não respondas ao tolo conforme sua loucura; para que não te faças semelhante a ele.
verses.RVR09: Nunca respondas al necio en conformidad á su necedad, para que no seas tú también como él.

verses.KJV: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
verses.WEB: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
verses.ASV: Answer a fool according to his folly, Lest he be wise in his own conceit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Responde ao tolo conforme sua loucura, para que ele não seja sábio aos seus próprios olhos.
verses.RVR09: Responde al necio según su necedad, porque no se estime sabio en su opinión.

verses.KJV: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
verses.WEB: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
verses.ASV: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool Cutteth off [his own] feet, [and] drinketh in damage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem manda mensagens pelas mãos do tolo é como quem corta os pés e bebe violência.
verses.RVR09: Como el que se corta los pies y bebe su daño, así es el que envía algo por mano de un necio.

verses.KJV: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.WEB: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.ASV: The legs of the lame hang loose; So is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Assim] como não funcionam as pernas do aleijado, assim também é o provérbio na boca dos tolos.
verses.RVR09: Alzar las piernas del cojo, así es el proverbio en la boca del necio.

verses.KJV: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
verses.WEB: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.
verses.ASV: As one that bindeth a stone in a sling, So is he that giveth honor to a fool.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dar honra ao tolo é como amarrar uma pedra numa funda.
verses.RVR09: Como quien liga la piedra en la honda, así hace el que al necio da honra.

verses.KJV: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouths of fools.
verses.WEB: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.ASV: [As] a thorn that goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, So is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como espinho na mão do bêbado, assim é o provérbio na boca dos tolos.
verses.RVR09: Espinas hincadas en mano del embriagado, tal es el proverbio en la boca de los necios.

verses.KJV: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
verses.WEB: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.
verses.ASV: [As] an archer that woundeth all, So is he that hireth a fool and he that hireth them that pass by.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] um flecheiro que atira para todo lado, [assim] é aquele que contrata um tolo [ou] que contrata alguém que vai passando.
verses.RVR09: El grande cría todas las cosas; y da la paga al insensato, y la da á los transgresores.

verses.KJV: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
verses.WEB: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
verses.ASV: As a dog that returneth to his vomit, [So is] a fool that repeateth his folly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como um cão que volta a seu vômito, [assim] é o tolo que repete sua loucura.
verses.RVR09: Como perro que vuelve á su vómito, así el necio que repite su necedad.

verses.KJV: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.WEB: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.ASV: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? There is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Viste algum homem sábio aos seus próprios olhos? Mais esperança há para o tolo do que para ele.
verses.RVR09: ¿Has visto hombre sabio en su opinión? más esperanza hay del necio que de él.

verses.KJV: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
verses.WEB: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
verses.ASV: The sluggard saith, There is a lion in the way; A lion is in the streets.
verses.ALMEIDA: O preguiçoso diz: Há uma fera no caminho; há um leão nas ruas.
verses.RVR09: Dice el perezoso: El león está en el camino; el león está en las calles.

verses.KJV: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
verses.WEB: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.
verses.ASV: [As] the door turneth upon its hinges, So doth the sluggard upon his bed.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] a porta se vira em torno de suas dobradiças, [assim] o preguiçoso [se vira] em sua cama.
verses.RVR09: Las puertas se revuelven en sus quicios: así el perezoso en su cama.

verses.KJV: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
verses.WEB: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
verses.ASV: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish; It wearieth him to bring it again to his mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O preguiçoso põe sua mão no prato, e acha cansativo demais trazê-la de volta a sua boca.
verses.RVR09: Esconde el perezoso su mano en el seno; cánsase de tornarla á su boca.

verses.KJV: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
verses.WEB: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.
verses.ASV: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit Than seven men that can render a reason.
verses.ALMEIDA: O preguiçoso se acha mais sábio aos próprios olhos do que sete que respondem com prudência.
verses.RVR09: A su ver es el perezoso más sabio que siete que le den consejo.

verses.KJV: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
verses.WEB: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.
verses.ASV: He that passeth by, [and] vexeth himself with strife belonging not to him, Is [like] one that taketh a dog by the ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que, enquanto está passando, [se envolve] em briga que não é sua, é [como] o que pega um cão pelas orelhas.
verses.RVR09: El que pasando se deja llevar de la ira en pleito ajeno, es como el que toma al perro por las orejas.

verses.KJV: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
verses.WEB: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,
verses.ASV: As a madman who casteth firebrands, Arrows, and death,
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o louco que lança faíscas, flechas e coisas mortíferas,
verses.RVR09: Como el que enloquece, y echa llamas y saetas y muerte,

verses.KJV: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
verses.WEB: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”
verses.ASV: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbor, And saith, Am not I in sport?
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim é o homem que engana a seu próximo, e diz: Não estava eu [só] brincando?
verses.RVR09: Tal es el hombre que daña á su amigo, y dice: Ciertamente me chanceaba.

verses.KJV: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
verses.WEB: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
verses.ASV: For lack of wood the fire goeth out; And where there is no whisperer, contention ceaseth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sem lenha, o fogo se apaga; e sem fofoqueiro, a briga termina.
verses.RVR09: Sin leña se apaga el fuego: y donde no hay chismoso, cesa la contienda.

verses.KJV: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
verses.WEB: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.
verses.ASV: [As] coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, So is a contentious man to inflame strife.
verses.ALMEIDA: O carvão é para as brasas, e a lenha para o fogo; e o homem difamador para acender brigas.
verses.RVR09: El carbón para brasas, y la leña para el fuego: y el hombre rencilloso para encender contienda.

verses.KJV: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.WEB: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.
verses.ASV: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.
verses.ALMEIDA: As palavras do fofoqueiro são como alimentos deliciosos, que descem ao interior do ventre.
verses.RVR09: Las palabras del chismoso parecen blandas; mas ellas entran hasta lo secreto del vientre.

verses.KJV: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
verses.WEB: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
verses.ASV: Fervent lips and a wicked heart Are [like] an earthen vessel overlaid with silver dross.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como um vaso de fundição coberto de restos de prata, [assim] são os lábios inflamados e o coração maligno.
verses.RVR09: Como escoria de plata echada sobre el tiesto, son los labios enardecidos y el corazón malo.

verses.KJV: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
verses.WEB: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
verses.ASV: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips; But he layeth up deceit within him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que odeia dissimula em seus lábios, mas seu interior abriga o engano;
verses.RVR09: Otro parece en los labios el que aborrece; mas en su interior pone engaño.

verses.KJV: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.WEB: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.ASV: When he speaketh fair, believe him not; For there are seven abominations in his heart:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ele [te] falar agradavelmente com sua voz, não acredites nele; porque há sete abominações em seu coração;
verses.RVR09: Cuando hablare amigablemente, no le creas; porque siete abominaciones hay en su corazón.

verses.KJV: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
verses.WEB: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
verses.ASV: Though [his] hatred cover itself with guile, His wickedness shall be openly showed before the assembly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cujo ódio está encoberto pelo engano; sua maldade será descoberta na congregação.
verses.RVR09: Encúbrese el odio con disimulo; mas su malicia será descubierta en la congregación.

verses.KJV: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
verses.WEB: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.
verses.ASV: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein; And he that rolleth a stone, it shall return upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem cava uma cova, nela cairá; e quem rola uma pedra, esta voltará sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: El que cavare sima, caerá en ella: y el que revuelva la piedra, á él volverá.

verses.KJV: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
verses.WEB: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.ASV: A lying tongue hateth those whom it hath wounded; And a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
verses.ALMEIDA: A língua falsa odeia aos que ela atormenta; e a boca lisonjeira opera ruína.
verses.RVR09: La falsa lengua atormenta al que aborrece: y la boca lisonjera hace resbaladero.

verses.KJV: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verses.WEB: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
verses.ASV: Boast not thyself of to-morrow; For thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te orgulhes do dia de amanhã; porque não sabes o que o dia trará.
verses.RVR09: NO te jactes del día de mañana; porque no sabes qué dará de sí el día.

verses.KJV: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
verses.WEB: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
verses.ASV: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; A stranger, and not thine own lips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que o estranho te louve, e não tua [própria] boca; o estrangeiro, e não teus [próprios] lábios.
verses.RVR09: Alábete el extraño, y no tu boca; el ajeno, y no tus labios.

verses.KJV: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
verses.WEB: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
verses.ASV: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; But a fool’s vexation is heavier than they both.
verses.ALMEIDA: A pedra é pesada, e a areia tem [seu] peso; mas a provocação do tolo é mais pesada do que estas ambas.
verses.RVR09: Pesada es la piedra, y la arena pesa; mas la ira del necio es más pesada que ambas cosas.

verses.KJV: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
verses.WEB: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
verses.ASV: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; But who is able to stand before jealousy?
verses.ALMEIDA: O furor é cruel, e a ira impetuosa; mas quem resistirá firme perante à inveja?
verses.RVR09: Cruel es la ira, é impetuoso el furor; mas ¿quién parará delante de la envidia?

verses.KJV: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
verses.WEB: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
verses.ASV: Better is open rebuke Than love that is hidden.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é a repreensão clara do que o amor escondido.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es reprensión manifiesta que amor oculto.

verses.KJV: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verses.WEB: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
verses.ASV: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; But the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fiéis são as feridas [feitas] por um amigo, mas os beijos de um inimigo são enganosos.
verses.RVR09: Fieles son las heridas del que ama; pero importunos los besos del que aborrece.

verses.KJV: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.WEB: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.ASV: The full soul loatheth a honeycomb; But to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.ALMEIDA: A alma saciada rejeita o favo de mel; mas para a alma faminta, toda coisa amarga é doce.
verses.RVR09: El alma harta huella el panal de miel; mas al alma hambrienta todo lo amargo es dulce.

verses.KJV: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.WEB: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
verses.ASV: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, So is a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como a ave, que vagueia de seu ninho, assim é o homem que anda vagueando de seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Cual ave que se va de su nido, tal es el hombre que se va de su lugar.

verses.KJV: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
verses.WEB: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
verses.ASV: Oil and perfume rejoice the heart; So doth the sweetness of a man’s friend [that cometh] of hearty counsel.
verses.ALMEIDA: O óleo e o perfume alegram ao coração; assim é a doçura de um amigo com um conselho sincero.
verses.RVR09: El ungüento y el perfume alegran el corazón: y el amigo al hombre con el cordial consejo.

verses.KJV: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
verses.WEB: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
verses.ASV: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; And go not to thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: Better is a neighbor that is near than a brother far off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não abandones o teu amigo, nem o amigo de teu pai; nem entres na casa de teu irmão no dia de tua adversidade; melhor é o vizinho que está perto do que o irmão que está longe.
verses.RVR09: No dejes á tu amigo, ni al amigo de tu padre; ni entres en casa de tu hermano el día de tu aflicción: mejor es el vecino cerca que el hermano lejano.

verses.KJV: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
verses.WEB: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
verses.ASV: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, That I may answer him that reproacheth me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sê sábio, meu filho, e alegra meu coração; para que eu tenha algo a responder para aquele que me desprezar.
verses.RVR09: Sé sabio, hijo mío, y alegra mi corazón, y tendré qué responder al que me deshonrare.

verses.KJV: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.WEB: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.ASV: A prudent man seeth the evil, [and] hideth himself; [But] the simple pass on, [and] suffer for it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O prudente vê o mal, [e] se esconde; [mas] os ingênuos passam adiante, e sofrem as consequências.
verses.RVR09: El avisado ve el mal, y escóndese; mas los simples pasan, y llevan el daño.

verses.KJV: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.WEB: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
verses.ASV: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; And hold him in pledge [that is surety] for a foreign woman.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma a roupa daquele que fica por fiador de estranho; toma penhor daquele [que fica por fiador] da estranha.
verses.RVR09: Quítale su ropa al que fió al extraño; y al que fió á la extraña, tómale prenda.

verses.KJV: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.WEB: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
verses.ASV: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, It shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que bendiz ao seu amigo em alta voz durante a madrugada lhe será considerado como maldição.
verses.RVR09: El que bendice á su amigo en alta voz, madrugando de mañana, por maldición se le contará.

verses.KJV: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
verses.WEB: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
verses.ASV: A continual dropping in a very rainy day And a contentious woman are alike:
verses.ALMEIDA: A mulher briguenta é semelhante a uma goteira contínua em tempo de grande chuva;
verses.RVR09: Gotera continua en tiempo de lluvia, y la mujer rencillosa, son semejantes:

verses.KJV: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
verses.WEB: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
verses.ASV: He that would restrain her restraineth the wind; And his right hand encountereth oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tentar contê-la é como tentar conter o vento, ou impedir que o óleo escorra de sua mão direita.
verses.RVR09: El que pretende contenerla, arresta el viento: ó el aceite en su mano derecha.

verses.KJV: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.WEB: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
verses.ASV: Iron sharpeneth iron; So a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ferro é afiado com ferro; assim também o homem afia o rosto de seu amigo.
verses.RVR09: Hierro con hierro se aguza; y el hombre aguza el rostro de su amigo.

verses.KJV: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
verses.WEB: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
verses.ASV: Whoso keepeth the fig-tree shall eat the fruit thereof; And he that regardeth his master shall be honored.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que guarda a figueira comerá de seu fruto; e o que dá atenção ao seu senhor será honrado.
verses.RVR09: El que guarda la higuera, comerá su fruto; y el que guarda á su señor, será honrado.

verses.KJV: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
verses.WEB: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
verses.ASV: As in water face [answereth] to face, So the heart of man to man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como a água reflete o rosto, assim também o coração reflete o ser humano.
verses.RVR09: Como un agua se parece á otra, así el corazón del hombre al otro.

verses.KJV: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.WEB: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
verses.ASV: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; And the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Xeol e a perdição nunca estão saciados; assim também os olhos do homem nunca estão satisfeitos.
verses.RVR09: El sepulcro y la perdición nunca se hartan: así los ojos del hombre nunca están satisfechos.

verses.KJV: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
verses.WEB: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
verses.ASV: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; And a man is [tried] by his praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] o crisol é para a prata, e o forno para o ouro, assim o homem [é provado] pelos louvores que lhe dizem.
verses.RVR09: El crisol prueba la plata, y la hornaza el oro: y al hombre la boca del que lo alaba.

verses.KJV: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.WEB: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
verses.ASV: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with bruised grain, Yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que esmagues ao tolo em um pilão junto com os grãos, ainda assim sua loucura não se separaria dele.
verses.RVR09: Aunque majes al necio en un mortero entre granos de trigo á pisón majados, no se quitará de él su necedad.

verses.KJV: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
verses.WEB: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,
verses.ASV: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, [And] look well to thy herds:
verses.ALMEIDA: Procura conhecer a condição de tuas ovelhas; põe teu coração sobre o gado;
verses.RVR09: Considera atentamente el aspecto de tus ovejas; pon tu corazón á tus rebaños:

verses.KJV: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
verses.WEB: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.
verses.ASV: For riches are not for ever; And doth the crown endure unto all generations?
verses.ALMEIDA: porque o tesouro não [dura] para sempre; nem uma coroa [dura] de geração em geração.
verses.RVR09: Porque las riquezas no son para siempre; ¿y será la corona para perpetuas generaciones?

verses.KJV: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
verses.WEB: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
verses.ASV: The hay is carried, and the tender grass showeth itself, And the herbs of the mountains are gathered in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando a erva aparecer, e surgirem a folhagem, e se juntarem as ervas dos montes,
verses.RVR09: Saldrá la grama, aparecerá la hierba, y segaránse las hierbas de los montes.

verses.KJV: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
verses.WEB: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
verses.ASV: The lambs are for thy clothing, And the goats are the price of the field;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os cordeiros serão para tuas roupas, e os bodes para o preço do campo;
verses.RVR09: Los corderos para tus vestidos, y los cabritos para el precio del campo:

verses.KJV: And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
verses.WEB: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
verses.ASV: And [there will be] goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, And maintenance for thy maidens.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o leite das cabras será o suficiente para tua alimentação, para a alimentação de tua casa, e para o sustento de tuas servas.
verses.RVR09: Y abundancia de leche de las cabras para tu mantenimiento, y para mantenimiento de tu casa, y para sustento de tus criadas.

verses.KJV: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.WEB: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
verses.ASV: The wicked flee when no man pursueth; But the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os perversos fogem [mesmo] quando não há quem os persiga, mas os justos são confiantes como um leão.
verses.RVR09: HUYE el impío sin que nadie lo persiga: mas el justo está confiado como un leoncillo.

verses.KJV: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
verses.WEB: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
verses.ASV: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof; But by men of understanding [and] knowledge the state [thereof] shall be prolonged.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela rebelião numa terra, seus governantes são muitos; mas por meio de um homem prudente e conhecedor [seu governo] permanecerá.
verses.RVR09: Por la rebelión de la tierra sus príncipes son muchos: mas por el hombre entendido y sabio permanecerá sin mutación.

verses.KJV: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.WEB: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
verses.ASV: A needy man that oppresseth the poor Is [like] a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem pobre que oprime aos necessitados é [como] uma chuva devastadora [que causa] falta de pão.
verses.RVR09: El hombre pobre y robador de los pobres, es lluvia de avenida y sin pan.

verses.KJV: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.WEB: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
verses.ASV: They that forsake the law praise the wicked; But such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que abandonam a lei louvam ao perverso; porém os que guardam a lei lutarão contra eles.
verses.RVR09: Los que dejan la ley, alaban á los impíos: mas los que la guardan, contenderán con ellos.

verses.KJV: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the Lord understand all things.
verses.WEB: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.
verses.ASV: Evil men understand not justice; But they that seek Jehovah understand all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os homens maus não entendem a justiça; mas os que buscam ao SENHOR entendem tudo.
verses.RVR09: Los hombres malos no entienden el juicio: mas los que buscan á Jehová, entienden todas las cosas.

verses.KJV: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.WEB: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
verses.ASV: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, Than he that is perverse in [his] ways, though he be rich.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o pobre que anda em sua honestidade do que o perverso de caminhos, ainda que seja rico.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es el pobre que camina en su integridad, que el de perversos caminos, y rico.

verses.KJV: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
verses.WEB: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
verses.ASV: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son; But he that is a companion of gluttons shameth his father.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que guarda a lei é um filho prudente, mas o companheiro de comilões envergonha a seu pai.
verses.RVR09: El que guarda la ley es hijo prudente: mas el que es compañero de glotones, avergüenza á su padre.

verses.KJV: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.WEB: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
verses.ASV: He that augmenteth his substance by interest and increase, Gathereth it for him that hath pity on the poor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que aumenta seus bens por meio de juros e lucros desonestos está juntando para o que se compadece dos pobres.
verses.RVR09: El que aumenta sus riquezas con usura y crecido interés, para que se dé á los pobres lo allega.

verses.KJV: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
verses.WEB: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.ASV: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, Even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que desvia seus ouvidos de ouvir a lei, até sua oração [será] abominável.
verses.RVR09: El que aparta su oído para no oir la ley, su oración también es abominable.

verses.KJV: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
verses.WEB: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
verses.ASV: Whoso causeth the upright to go astray in an evil way, He shall fall himself into his own pit; But the perfect shall inherit good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que faz as pessoas corretas errarem em direção a um mau caminho, ele mesmo cairá em sua cova; mas os que não tiverem pecado herdarão o bem.
verses.RVR09: El que hace errar á los rectos por el mal camino, él caerá en su misma sima: mas los perfectos heredarán el bien.

verses.KJV: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.WEB: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
verses.ASV: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; But the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem rico é sábio aos seus [próprios] olhos; mas o pobre prudente o examina.
verses.RVR09: El hombre rico es sabio en su opinión: mas el pobre entendido lo examinará.

verses.KJV: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.WEB: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
verses.ASV: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; But when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os justos estão contentes, muita é a alegria; mas quando os perversos se levantam, os homens se escondem.
verses.RVR09: Cuando los justos se alegran, grande es la gloria; mas cuando los impíos son levantados, es buscado el hombre.

verses.KJV: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verses.WEB: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
verses.ASV: He that covereth his transgressions shall not prosper; But whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall obtain mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem encobre suas transgressões nunca prosperará, mas aquele que as confessa e [as] abandona alcançará misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: El que encubre sus pecados, no prosperará: mas el que los confiesa y se aparta, alcanzará misericordia.

verses.KJV: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.WEB: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
verses.ASV: Happy is the man that feareth alway; But he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurado o homem que sempre mantém seu temor; mas aquele que endurece seu coração cairá no mal.
verses.RVR09: Bienaventurado el hombre que siempre está temeroso: mas el que endurece su corazón, caerá en mal.

verses.KJV: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.WEB: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
verses.ASV: [As] a roaring lion, and a ranging bear, [So is] a wicked ruler over a poor people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Leão rugidor e urso faminto é o governante perverso sobre um povo pobre.
verses.RVR09: León rugiente y oso hambriento, es el príncipe impío sobre el pueblo pobre.

verses.KJV: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.WEB: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
verses.ASV: The prince that lacketh understanding is also a great oppressor; [But] he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.ALMEIDA: O príncipe que tem falta de entendimento aumenta as opressões; mas aquele que odeia o lucro desonesto prolongará [seus] dias.
verses.RVR09: El príncipe falto de entendimiento multiplicará los agravios: mas el que aborrece la avaricia, prolongará sus días.

verses.KJV: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.WEB: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.
verses.ASV: A man that is laden with the blood of any person Shall flee unto the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem atormentado pelo sangue de alguma alma fugirá até a cova; ninguém o detenha.
verses.RVR09: El hombre que hace violencia con sangre de persona, huirá hasta el sepulcro, y nadie le detendrá.

verses.KJV: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.WEB: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
verses.ASV: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be delivered; But he that is perverse in [his] ways shall fall at once.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que anda sinceramente será salvo; mas o que se desvia em [seus] caminhos cairá de uma só vez.
verses.RVR09: El que en integridad camina, será salvo; mas el de perversos caminos caerá en alguno.

verses.KJV: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
verses.WEB: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
verses.ASV: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain [persons] shall have poverty enough.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que lavrar sua terra terá fartura de pão; mas o que segue coisas inúteis terá fartura de pobreza.
verses.RVR09: El que labra su tierra, se hartará de pan: mas el que sigue los ociosos, se hartará de pobreza.

verses.KJV: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.WEB: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
verses.ASV: A faithful man shall abound with blessings; But he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be unpunished.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem fiel [terá] muitas bênçãos; mas o que se apressa para enriquecer não ficará impune.
verses.RVR09: El hombre de verdad tendrá muchas bendiciones: mas el que se apresura á enriquecer, no será sin culpa.

verses.KJV: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
verses.WEB: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
verses.ASV: To have respect of persons is not good; Neither that a man should transgress for a piece of bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fazer acepção de pessoas não é bom; porque até por um pedaço de pão o homem pode transgredir.
verses.RVR09: Tener acepción de personas, no es bueno: hasta por un bocado de pan prevaricará el hombre.

verses.KJV: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.WEB: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
verses.ASV: He that hath an evil eye hasteth after riches, And knoweth not that want shall come upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem pressa para ter riquezas é um homem de olho mau; e ele não sabe que a miséria virá sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Apresúrase á ser rico el hombre de mal ojo; y no conoce que le ha de venir pobreza.

verses.KJV: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.WEB: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
verses.ASV: He that rebuketh a man shall afterward find more favor Than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que repreende ao homem obterá mais favor depois do que aquele que lisonjeia com a língua.
verses.RVR09: El que reprende al hombre, hallará después mayor gracia que el que lisonjea con la lengua.

verses.KJV: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.WEB: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.
verses.ASV: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression, The same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que furta seu pai ou sua mãe e diz: Não é pecado,É companheiro do homem destruidor.
verses.RVR09: El que roba á su padre ó á su madre, y dice que no es maldad, compañero es del hombre destruidor.

verses.KJV: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the Lord shall be made fat.
verses.WEB: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
verses.ASV: He that is of a greedy spirit stirreth up strife; But he that putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be made fat.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem alma orgulhosa levanta brigas; mas aquele que confia no SENHOR prosperará.
verses.RVR09: El altivo de ánimo suscita contiendas: mas el que en Jehová confía, medrará.

verses.KJV: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.WEB: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
verses.ASV: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool; But whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que confia em seu [próprio] coração é tolo; mas o que anda em sabedoria escapará [em segurança] .
verses.RVR09: El que confía en su corazón es necio; mas el que camina en sabiduría, será salvo.

verses.KJV: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.WEB: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
verses.ASV: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack; But he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem dá ao pobre não terá falta; mas o que esconde seus olhos [terá] muitas maldições.
verses.RVR09: El que da al pobre, no tendrá pobreza: mas el que aparta sus ojos, tendrá muchas maldiciones.

verses.KJV: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.WEB: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
verses.ASV: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os perversos ganham poder, os homens se escondem; mas quando perecem, os justos se multiplicam.
verses.RVR09: Cuando los impíos son levantados, esconderáse el hombre: mas cuando perecen, los justos se multiplican.

verses.KJV: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.WEB: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
verses.ASV: He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck Shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem que age com teimosia, mesmo depois de muitas repreensões, será tão destruído que não terá mais cura.
verses.RVR09: EL hombre que reprendido endurece la cerviz, de repente será quebrantado; ni habrá para él medicina.

verses.KJV: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
verses.WEB: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verses.ASV: When the righteous are increased, the people rejoice; But when a wicked man beareth rule, the people sigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os justos se engrandecem, o povo se alegra; mas quando o perverso domina, o povo geme.
verses.RVR09: Cuando los justos dominan, el pueblo se alegra: mas cuando domina el impío, el pueblo gime.

verses.KJV: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
verses.WEB: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
verses.ASV: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; But he that keepeth company with harlots wasteth [his] substance.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem que ama a sabedoria alegra a seu pai; mas o companheiro de prostitutas gasta os bens.
verses.RVR09: El hombre que ama la sabiduría, alegra á su padre: mas el que mantiene rameras, perderá la hacienda.

verses.KJV: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.WEB: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
verses.ASV: The king by justice establisheth the land; But he that exacteth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei por meio da justiça firma a terra; mas o amigo de subornos a transtorna.
verses.RVR09: El rey con el juicio afirma la tierra: mas el hombre de presentes la destruirá.

verses.KJV: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
verses.WEB: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
verses.ASV: A man that flattereth his neighbor Spreadeth a net for his steps.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem que lisonjeia a seu próximo arma uma rede para seus pés.
verses.RVR09: El hombre que lisonjea á su prójimo, red tiende delante de sus pasos.

verses.KJV: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.WEB: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
verses.ASV: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; But the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Na transgressão do homem mau há uma armadilha; mas o justo se alegra e se enche de alegria.
verses.RVR09: En la prevaricación del hombre malo hay lazo: mas el justo cantará y se alegrará.

verses.KJV: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
verses.WEB: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
verses.ASV: The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; The wicked hath not understanding to know [it].
verses.ALMEIDA: O justo considera a causa judicial dos pobres; [mas] o perverso não entende [este] conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Conoce el justo la causa de los pobres: mas el impío no entiende sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
verses.WEB: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
verses.ASV: Scoffers set a city in a flame; But wise men turn away wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Homens zombadores trazem confusão a cidade; mas os sábios desviam a ira.
verses.RVR09: Los hombres escarnecedores enlazan la ciudad: mas los sabios apartan la ira.

verses.KJV: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
verses.WEB: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
verses.ASV: If a wise man hath a controversy with a foolish man, Whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem sábio que disputa no julgamento contra um tolo, mesmo se perturbado ou rindo, não terá descanso.
verses.RVR09: Si el hombre sabio contendiere con el necio, que se enoje ó que se ría, no tendrá reposo.

verses.KJV: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
verses.WEB: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
verses.ASV: The bloodthirsty hate him that is perfect; And as for the upright, they seek his life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Homens sanguinários odeiam o honesto; mas os corretos procuram o seu bem.
verses.RVR09: Los hombres sanguinarios aborrecen al perfecto: mas los rectos buscan su contentamiento.

verses.KJV: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
verses.WEB: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
verses.ASV: A fool uttereth all his anger; But a wise man keepeth it back and stilleth it.
verses.ALMEIDA: O louco mostra todo o seu ímpeto; mas o sábio o mantém sob controle.
verses.RVR09: El necio da suelta á todo su espíritu; mas el sabio al fin le sosiega.

verses.KJV: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
verses.WEB: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
verses.ASV: If a ruler hearkeneth to falsehood, All his servants are wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: O governante que dá atenção a palavras mentirosas, todos os seus servos serão perversos.
verses.RVR09: Del señor que escucha la palabra mentirosa, todos sus ministros son impíos.

verses.KJV: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the Lord lighteneth both their eyes.
verses.WEB: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.
verses.ASV: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; Jehovah lighteneth the eyes of them both.
verses.ALMEIDA: O pobre e o enganador se encontram: o SENHOR ilumina aos olhos de ambos.
verses.RVR09: El pobre y el usurero se encontraron: Jehová alumbra los ojos de ambos.

verses.KJV: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.WEB: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
verses.ASV: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, His throne shall be established for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rei que julga aos pobres por meio da verdade, seu trono se firmará para sempre.
verses.RVR09: El rey que juzga con verdad á los pobres, su trono será firme para siempre.

verses.KJV: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
verses.WEB: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
verses.ASV: The rod and reproof give wisdom; But a child left to himself causeth shame to his mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: A vara e a repreensão dão sabedoria; mas o rapaz deixado solto envergonha a sua mãe.
verses.RVR09: La vara y la corrección dan sabiduría: mas el muchacho consentido avergonzará á su madre.

verses.KJV: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
verses.WEB: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
verses.ASV: When the wicked are increased, transgression increaseth; But the righteous shall look upon their fall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando os perversos se multiplicam, multiplicam-se as transgressões; mas os justos verão sua queda.
verses.RVR09: Cuando los impíos son muchos, mucha es la prevaricación; mas los justos verán la ruina de ellos.

verses.KJV: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
verses.WEB: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
verses.ASV: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; Yea, he will give delight unto thy soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Castiga a teu filho, e ele te fará descansar, e dará prazeres à tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Corrige á tu hijo, y te dará descanso, y dará deleite á tu alma.

verses.KJV: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.WEB: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
verses.ASV: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; But he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não havendo visão profética, o povo fica confuso; porém o que guarda a lei, ele é bem-aventurado.
verses.RVR09: Sin profecía el pueblo será disipado: mas el que guarda la ley, bienaventurado él.

verses.KJV: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
verses.WEB: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
verses.ASV: A servant will not be corrected by words; For though he understand, he will not give heed.
verses.ALMEIDA: O servo não será corrigido por meio de palavras; porque [ainda que] entenda, mesmo assim ele não responderá [corretamente] .
verses.RVR09: El siervo no se corregirá con palabras: porque entiende, mas no corresponde.

verses.KJV: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.WEB: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.ASV: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? There is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Viste um homem precipitado em suas palavras? Mais esperança há para um tolo do que para ele.
verses.RVR09: ¿Has visto hombre ligero en sus palabras? más esperanza hay del necio que de él.

verses.KJV: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
verses.WEB: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
verses.ASV: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child Shall have him become a son at the last.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que mima a seu servo desde a infância, por fim ele quererá ser [seu] filho.
verses.RVR09: El que regala á su siervo desde su niñez, á la postre será su hijo.

verses.KJV: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.WEB: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
verses.ASV: An angry man stirreth up strife, And a wrathful man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.ALMEIDA: O homem que se irrita facilmente levanta brigas; e o furioso multiplica as transgressões.
verses.RVR09: El hombre iracundo levanta contiendas; y el furioso muchas veces peca.

verses.KJV: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
verses.WEB: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
verses.ASV: A man’s pride shall bring him low; But he that is of a lowly spirit shall obtain honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: A arrogância do homem o abaterá; mas o humilde de espírito obterá honra.
verses.RVR09: La soberbia del hombre le abate; pero al humilde de espíritu sustenta la honra.

verses.KJV: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
verses.WEB: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
verses.ASV: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul; He heareth the adjuration and uttereth nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que reparte com o ladrão odeia sua [própria] alma; ele ouve maldições e não [o] denuncia.
verses.RVR09: El aparcero del ladrón aborrece su vida; oirá maldiciones, y no lo denunciará.

verses.KJV: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.
verses.WEB: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
verses.ASV: The fear of man bringeth a snare; But whoso putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be safe.
verses.ALMEIDA: O temor do homem arma ciladas; mas o que confia no senhor ficará em segurança.
verses.RVR09: El temor del hombre pondrá lazo: mas el que confía en Jehová será levantado.

verses.KJV: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the Lord.
verses.WEB: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.
verses.ASV: Many seek the ruler’s favor; But a man’s judgment [cometh] from Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitos buscam a face do governante; mas o julgamento de cada um [vem] do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Muchos buscan el favor del príncipe: mas de Jehová viene el juicio de cada uno.

verses.KJV: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
verses.WEB: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
verses.ASV: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; And he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: O justos odeiam ao homem perverso; e o injusto odeia aos que andam no caminho correto.
verses.RVR09: Abominación es á los justos el hombre inicuo; y abominación es al impío el de rectos caminos.

verses.KJV: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
verses.WEB: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
verses.ASV: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh; the oracle. The man saith unto Ithiel, unto Ithiel and Ucal:
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavras de Agur, filho de Jaque, o de fala solene; [Este] homem diz a Itiel; a Itiel e a Ucal:
verses.RVR09: PALABRAS de Agur, hijo de Jachê: La profecía que dijo el varón á Ithiel, á Ithiel y á Ucal.

verses.KJV: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
verses.WEB: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
verses.ASV: Surely I am more brutish than any man, And have not the understanding of a man;
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente eu sou o mais bruto dos homens, e não tenho entendimento humano.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente más rudo soy yo que ninguno, ni tengo entendimiento de hombre.

verses.KJV: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
verses.WEB: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.ASV: And I have not learned wisdom, Neither have I the knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não aprendi sabedoria, nem tenho conhecimento do Santo [Deus] .
verses.RVR09: Yo ni aprendí sabiduría, ni conozco la ciencia del Santo.

verses.KJV: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?
verses.WEB: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
verses.ASV: Who hath ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who hath gathered the wind in his fists? Who hath bound the waters in his garment? Who hath established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou knowest?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem subiu ao céu, e desceu? Quem juntou os ventos com suas mãos? Quem amarrou as águas numa capa? Quem estabeleceu todos os limites da terra? Qual é o seu nome? e qual é o nome de seu filho, se tu o sabes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién subió al cielo, y descendió? ¿quién encerró los vientos en sus puños? ¿quién ató las aguas en un paño? ¿quién afirmó todos los términos de la tierra? ¿cuál es su nombre, y el nombre de su hijo, si sabes?

verses.KJV: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
verses.WEB: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
verses.ASV: Every word of God is tried: He is a shield unto them that take refuge in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toda palavra de Deus é pura; é escudo para os que nele confiam.
verses.RVR09: Toda palabra de Dios es limpia; es escudo á los que en él esperan.

verses.KJV: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
verses.WEB: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
verses.ASV: Add thou not unto his words, Lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nada acrescentes às suas palavras, para que ele não te repreenda, e sejas mostrado como mentiroso.
verses.RVR09: No añadas á sus palabras, porque no te reprenda, y seas hallado mentiroso.

verses.KJV: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
verses.WEB: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.
verses.ASV: Two things have I asked of thee; Deny me [them] not before I die:
verses.ALMEIDA: Duas coisas eu te pedi; não [as] negues a mim antes que eu morra.
verses.RVR09: Dos cosas te he demandado; no me las niegues antes que muera.

verses.KJV: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
verses.WEB: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
verses.ASV: Remove far from me falsehood and lies; Give me neither poverty nor riches; Feed me with the food that is needful for me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Afasta de mim a inutilidade e palavra mentirosa; [e] não me dês nem pobreza nem riqueza, mantém-me com o pão que me for necessário.
verses.RVR09: Vanidad y palabra mentirosa aparta de mí. No me des pobreza ni riquezas; manténme del pan que he menester;

verses.KJV: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the Lord? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
verses.WEB: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
verses.ASV: Lest I be full, and deny [thee], and say, Who is Jehovah? Or lest I be poor, and steal, And use profanely the name of my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que não aconteça de eu ficar farto e [te] negar, dizendo: Quem é o SENHOR?Nem também que eu empobreça, e venha a furtar, e desonre o nome do meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: No sea que me harte, y te niegue, y diga, ¿Quién es Jehová? ó no sea que siendo pobre, hurte, y blasfeme el nombre de mi Dios.

verses.KJV: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
verses.WEB: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
verses.ASV: Slander not a servant unto his master, Lest he curse thee, and thou be held guilty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não difames do servo ao seu senhor, para que ele não te amaldiçoe e fiques culpado.
verses.RVR09: No acuses al siervo ante su señor, porque no te maldiga, y peques.

verses.KJV: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
verses.WEB: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
verses.ASV: There is a generation that curse their father, And bless not their mother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há gente que amaldiçoa a seu pai e não bendiz à sua mãe;
verses.RVR09: Hay generación que maldice á su padre, y á su madre no bendice.

verses.KJV: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
verses.WEB: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
verses.ASV: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, And [yet] are not washed from their filthiness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há gente que é pura aos seus [próprios] olhos, mas que não foi lavada de sua imundície;
verses.RVR09: Hay generación limpia en su opinión, si bien no se ha limpiado su inmundicia.

verses.KJV: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.WEB: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.ASV: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! And their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há gente cujos olhos são arrogantes, e cujas sobrancelhas são levantadas;
verses.RVR09: Hay generación cuyos ojos son altivos, y cuyos párpados son alzados.

verses.KJV: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.WEB: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.ASV: There is a generation whose teeth are [as] swords, and their jaw teeth [as] knives, To devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há gente cujos dentes são espadas, e cujos queixos são facas, para devorarem aos aflitos da terra aos aflitos, e aos necessitados dentre os homens.
verses.RVR09: Hay generación cuyos dientes son espadas, y sus muelas cuchillos, para devorar á los pobres de la tierra, y de entre los hombres á los menesterosos.

verses.KJV: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
verses.WEB: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:
verses.ASV: The horseleach hath two daughters, [crying], Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, [Yea], four that say not, Enough:
verses.ALMEIDA: A sanguessuga tem duas filhas: “Dá” e “Dá”; estas três coisas nunca se fartam, e quatro nunca dizem “É o suficiente”:
verses.RVR09: La sanguijuela tiene dos hijas que se llaman, Trae, trae. Tres cosas hay que nunca se hartan; aun la cuarta nunca dice, Basta:

verses.KJV: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
verses.WEB: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’
verses.ASV: Sheol; and the barren womb; The earth that is not satisfied with water; And the fire that saith not, Enough.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Xeol, o útero estéril, a terra que não se farta de água, e o fogo que nunca diz estar satisfeito.
verses.RVR09: El sepulcro, y la matriz estéril, la tierra no harta de aguas, y el fuego que jamás dice, Basta.

verses.KJV: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.WEB: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.ASV: The eye that mocketh at his father, And despiseth to obey his mother, The ravens of the valley shall pick it out, And the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos que zombam do pai ou desprezam obedecer à mãe, os corvos do riacho os arrancarão, e os filhotes de abutre os comerão.
verses.RVR09: El ojo que escarnece á su padre, y menosprecia la enseñanza de la madre, los cuervos lo saquen de la arroyada, y tráguenlo los hijos del águila.

verses.KJV: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
verses.WEB: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
verses.ASV: There are three things which are too wonderful for me, Yea, four which I know not:
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas três coisas me maravilham, e quatro que não entendo:
verses.RVR09: Tres cosas me son ocultas; aun tampoco sé la cuarta:
