verses.KJV: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
verses.WEB: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
verses.ASV: The way of an eagle in the air; The way of a serpent upon a rock; The way of a ship in the midst of the sea; And the way of a man with a maiden.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho da águia no céu, o caminho da serpente na rocha, o caminho do navio no meio do mar, e o caminho do homem com uma moça.
verses.RVR09: El rastro del águila en el aire; el rastro de la culebra sobre la peña; el rastro de la nave en medio de la mar; y el rastro del hombre en la moza.

verses.KJV: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
verses.WEB: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
verses.ASV: So is the way of an adulterous woman; She eateth, and wipeth her mouth, And saith, I have done no wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim é o caminho da mulher adúltera: ela come, limpa sua boca, e diz: Não fiz mal algum.
verses.RVR09: Tal es el rastro de la mujer adúltera: come, y limpia su boca, y dice: No he hecho maldad.

verses.KJV: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
verses.WEB: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:
verses.ASV: For three things the earth doth tremble, And for four, [which] it cannot bear:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por três coisas a terra se alvoroça, e por quatro que não pode suportar:
verses.RVR09: Por tres cosas se alborota la tierra, y la cuarta no puede sufrir:

verses.KJV: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
verses.WEB: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
verses.ASV: For a servant when he is king; And a fool when he is filled with food;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo servo que governa como rei; [pelo] tolo que se enche de comida;
verses.RVR09: Por el siervo cuando reinare; y por el necio cuando se hartare de pan;

verses.KJV: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
verses.WEB: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
verses.ASV: For an odious woman when she is married; And a handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela mulher odiada, quando se casa; e [pela] serva quando toma o lugar de sua senhora.
verses.RVR09: Por la aborrecida cuando se casare; y por la sierva cuando heredare á su señora.

verses.KJV: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
verses.WEB: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
verses.ASV: There are four things which are little upon the earth, But they are exceeding wise:
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas quatro coisas são pequenas sobre a terra, porém muito sábias:
verses.RVR09: Cuatro cosas son de las más pequeñas de la tierra, y las mismas son más sabias que los sabios:

verses.KJV: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
verses.WEB: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
verses.ASV: The ants are a people not strong, Yet they provide their food in the summer;
verses.ALMEIDA: As formigas não são criaturas fortes, mas no verão preparam sua comida;
verses.RVR09: Las hormigas, pueblo no fuerte, y en el verano preparan su comida;

verses.KJV: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
verses.WEB: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
verses.ASV: The conies are but a feeble folk, Yet make they their houses in the rocks;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os roedores são um “povo” fraco, mas fazem suas casas nas rochas;
verses.RVR09: Los conejos, pueblo nada esforzado, y ponen su casa en la piedra;

verses.KJV: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
verses.WEB: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
verses.ASV: The locusts have no king, Yet go they forth all of them by bands;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os gafanhotos não têm rei; mas todos saem em bandos;
verses.RVR09: Las langostas, no tienen rey, y salen todas acuadrilladas;

verses.KJV: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
verses.WEB: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
verses.ASV: The lizard taketh hold with her hands, Yet is she in kings’ palaces.
verses.ALMEIDA: As lagartixas podem ser pegas com as mãos, e mesmo assim estão nos palácios dos reis.
verses.RVR09: La araña, ase con las manos, y está en palacios de rey.

verses.KJV: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
verses.WEB: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
verses.ASV: There are three things which are stately in their march, Yea, four which are stately in going:
verses.ALMEIDA: Estes três tem um bom andar, e quatro que se movem muito bem:
verses.RVR09: Tres cosas hay de hermoso andar, y la cuarta pasea muy bien:

verses.KJV: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
verses.WEB: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;
verses.ASV: The lion, which is mightiest among beasts, And turneth not away for any;
verses.ALMEIDA: O leão, forte entre os animais, que não foge de ninguém;
verses.RVR09: El león, fuerte entre todos los animales, que no torna atrás por nadie;

verses.KJV: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
verses.WEB: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
verses.ASV: The greyhound; the he-goat also; And the king against whom there is no rising up.
verses.ALMEIDA: O galo, o bode, e o rei com seu exército.
verses.RVR09: El lebrel ceñido de lomos; asimismo el macho cabrío; y un rey contra el cual ninguno se levanta.

verses.KJV: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
verses.WEB: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
verses.ASV: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, Or if thou hast thought evil, [Lay] thy hand upon thy mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se agiste como tolo, exaltando-te, e se planejaste o mal, [põe tua] mão sobre a boca;
verses.RVR09: Si caiste, fué porque te enalteciste; y si mal pensaste, pon el dedo sobre la boca.

verses.KJV: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
verses.WEB: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
verses.ASV: For the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, And the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood; So the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque [como] o forçar do leite produz manteiga, e o forçar do nariz produz sangue, [assim também] o forçar da ira produz briga.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente el que exprime la leche, sacará manteca; y el que recio se suena las narices, sacará sangre: y el que provoca la ira, causará contienda.

verses.KJV: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.WEB: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
verses.ASV: The words of king Lemuel; the oracle which his mother taught him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavras do rei Lemuel, a profecia que sua mãe o ensinava.
verses.RVR09: PALABRAS del rey Lemuel; la profecía con que le enseñó su madre.

verses.KJV: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.WEB: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
verses.ASV: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? And what, O son of my vows?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que [posso te dizer] ,meu filho, ó filho do meu ventre? O que [te direi] ,filho de minhas promessas?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué, hijo mío? ¿y qué, hijo de mi vientre? ¿y qué, hijo de mis deseos?

verses.KJV: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.WEB: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
verses.ASV: Give not thy strength unto women, Nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não dês tua força às mulheres, nem teus caminhos para [coisas] que destroem reis.
verses.RVR09: No des á las mujeres tu fuerza, ni tus caminos á lo que es para destruir los reyes.

verses.KJV: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.WEB: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
verses.ASV: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; Nor for princes [to say], Where is strong drink?
verses.ALMEIDA: Lemuel, não convém aos reis beber vinho; nem aos príncipes [desejar] bebida alcoólica.
verses.RVR09: No es de los reyes, oh Lemuel, no es de los reyes beber vino, ni de los príncipes la cerveza.

verses.KJV: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.WEB: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
verses.ASV: Lest they drink, and forget the law, And pervert the justice [due] to any that is afflicted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para não acontecer de que bebam, e se esqueçam da lei, e pervertam o direito de todos os aflitos.
verses.RVR09: No sea que bebiendo olviden la ley, y perviertan el derecho de todos los hijos afligidos.

verses.KJV: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.WEB: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
verses.ASV: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, And wine unto the bitter in soul:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai bebida alcoólica aos que estão a ponto de morrer, e vinho que têm amargura na alma,
verses.RVR09: Dad la cerveza al desfallecido, y el vino á los de amargo ánimo:

verses.KJV: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.WEB: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.ASV: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, And remember his misery no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que bebam, e se esqueçam de sua pobreza, e não se lembrem mais de sua miséria.
verses.RVR09: Beban, y olvídense de su necesidad, y de su miseria no más se acuerden.

verses.KJV: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.WEB: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
verses.ASV: Open thy mouth for the dumb, In the cause of all such as are left desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abre tua boca no lugar do mudo pela causa judicial de todos os que estão morrendo.
verses.RVR09: Abre tu boca por el mudo, en el juicio de todos los hijos de muerte.

verses.KJV: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.WEB: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
verses.ASV: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, And minister justice to the poor and needy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abre tua boca, julga corretamente, e faze justiça aos oprimidos e necessitados.
verses.RVR09: Abre tu boca, juzga justicia, y el derecho del pobre y del menesteroso.

verses.KJV: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
verses.WEB: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.
verses.ASV: A worthy woman who can find? For her price is far above rubies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mulher virtuosa, quem a encontrará? Pois seu valor é muito maior que o de rubis.
verses.RVR09: Mujer fuerte, ¿quién la hallará? porque su estima sobrepuja largamente á la de piedras preciosas.

verses.KJV: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.WEB: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
verses.ASV: The heart of her husband trusteth in her, And he shall have no lack of gain.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração de seu marido confia nela, e ele não terá falta de bens.
verses.RVR09: El corazón de su marido está en ella confiado, y no tendrá necesidad de despojo.

verses.KJV: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.WEB: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
verses.ASV: She doeth him good and not evil All the days of her life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela lhe faz bem, e não o mal, todos os dias de sua vida.
verses.RVR09: Darále ella bien y no mal, todos los días de su vida.

verses.KJV: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.WEB: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
verses.ASV: She seeketh wool and flax, And worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela busca lã e linho, e com prazer trabalha com suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Buscó lana y lino, y con voluntad labró de sus manos.

verses.KJV: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.WEB: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
verses.ASV: She is like the merchant-ships; She bringeth her bread from afar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela é como um navio mercante; de longe traz a sua comida.
verses.RVR09: Fué como navío de mercader: trae su pan de lejos.

verses.KJV: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.WEB: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
verses.ASV: She riseth also while it is yet night, And giveth food to her household, And their task to her maidens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda de noite ela se levanta, e dá alimento a sua casa; e ordens às suas servas.
verses.RVR09: Levantóse aun de noche, y dió comida á su familia, y ración á sus criadas.

verses.KJV: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.WEB: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
verses.ASV: She considereth a field, and buyeth it; With the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela avalia um campo, e o compra; do fruto de suas mãos planta uma vinha.
verses.RVR09: Consideró la heredad, y compróla; y plantó viña del fruto de sus manos.

verses.KJV: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.WEB: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
verses.ASV: She girdeth her loins with strength, And maketh strong her arms.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela prepara seus lombos com vigor, e fortalece seus braços.
verses.RVR09: Ciñó sus lomos de fortaleza, y esforzó sus brazos.

verses.KJV: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
verses.WEB: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
verses.ASV: She perceiveth that her merchandise is profitable; Her lamp goeth not out by night.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela prova que suas mercadorias são boas, [e] sua lâmpada não se apaga de noite.
verses.RVR09: Gustó que era buena su granjería: su candela no se apagó de noche.

verses.KJV: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.WEB: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
verses.ASV: She layeth her hands to the distaff, And her hands hold the spindle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela estende suas mãos ao rolo de linha, e com suas mãos prepara os fios.
verses.RVR09: Aplicó sus manos al huso, y sus manos tomaron la rueca.

verses.KJV: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.WEB: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
verses.ASV: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; Yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela estende sua mão ao aflito, e estica os braços aos necessitados.
verses.RVR09: Alargó su mano al pobre, y extendió sus manos al menesteroso.

verses.KJV: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.WEB: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.ASV: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; For all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela não terá medo da neve por sua casa, pois todos os de sua casa estão agasalhados.
verses.RVR09: No tendrá temor de la nieve por su familia, porque toda su familia está vestida de ropas dobles.

verses.KJV: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
verses.WEB: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.ASV: She maketh for herself carpets of tapestry; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela faz cobertas para sua cama; de linho fino e de púrpura é o seu vestido.
verses.RVR09: Ella se hizo tapices; de lino fino y púrpura es su vestido.

verses.KJV: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.WEB: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.ASV: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu marido é famoso às portas [da cidade] ,quando ele se senta com os anciãos da terra.
verses.RVR09: Conocido es su marido en las puertas, cuando se sienta con los ancianos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.WEB: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
verses.ASV: She maketh linen garments and selleth them, And delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela faz panos de linho fino, e os vende; e fornece cintos aos comerciantes.
verses.RVR09: Hizo telas, y vendió; y dió cintas al mercader.

verses.KJV: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.WEB: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
verses.ASV: Strength and dignity are her clothing; And she laugheth at the time to come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Força e glória são suas roupas, e ela sorri pelo seu futuro.
verses.RVR09: Fortaleza y honor son su vestidura; y en el día postrero reirá.

verses.KJV: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.WEB: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
verses.ASV: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; And the law of kindness is on her tongue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela abre sua boca com sabedoria; e o ensinamento bondoso está em sua língua.
verses.RVR09: Abrió su boca con sabiduría: y la ley de clemencia está en su lengua.

verses.KJV: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.WEB: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
verses.ASV: She looketh well to the ways of her household, And eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ela presta atenção aos rumos de sua casa, e não come pão da preguiça.
verses.RVR09: Considera los caminos de su casa, y no come el pan de balde.

verses.KJV: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verses.WEB: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
verses.ASV: Her children rise up, and call her blessed; Her husband [also], and he praiseth her, [saying]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus filhos se levantam e a chamam de bem-aventurada; seu marido também a elogia, [dizendo] :
verses.RVR09: Levantáronse sus hijos, y llamáronla bienaventurada; y su marido también la alabó.

verses.KJV: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
verses.WEB: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
verses.ASV: Many daughters have done worthily, But thou excellest them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitas mulheres agem com virtude, mas tu és melhor que todas elas.
verses.RVR09: Muchas mujeres hicieron el bien; mas tú las sobrepujaste á todas.

verses.KJV: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.
verses.WEB: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.ASV: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; [But] a woman that feareth Jehovah, she shall be praised.
verses.ALMEIDA: A beleza é enganosa, e a formosura é passageira; [mas] a mulher que teme ao SENHOR, essa será louvada.
verses.RVR09: Engañosa es la gracia, y vana la hermosura: la mujer que teme á Jehová, ésa será alabada.

verses.KJV: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.WEB: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
verses.ASV: Give her of the fruit of her hands; And let her works praise her in the gates.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai a ela conforme o fruto de suas mãos, e que suas obras a louvem às portas [da cidade] .
verses.RVR09: Dadle el fruto de sus manos, y alábenla en las puertas sus hechos.

verses.KJV: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
verses.ASV: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavras do Pregador, filho de Davi, rei em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: PALABRAS del Predicador, hijo de David, rey en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
verses.WEB: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
verses.ASV: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher; vanity of vanities, all is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Futilidade das futilidades! - diz o Pregador - futilidade das futilidades! Tudo é fútil!
verses.RVR09: Vanidad de vanidades, dijo el Predicador; vanidad de vanidades, todo vanidad.

verses.KJV: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?
verses.WEB: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?
verses.ASV: What profit hath man of all his labor wherein he laboreth under the sun?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que proveito tem o homem de todo o seu trabalho que ele trabalha abaixo do sol?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué provecho tiene el hombre de todo su trabajo con que se afana debajo del sol?

verses.KJV: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.
verses.WEB: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.
verses.ASV: One generation goeth, and another generation cometh; but the earth abideth for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Geração vai, e geração vem; porém a terra permanece para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Generación va, y generación viene: mas la tierra siempre permanece.

verses.KJV: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
verses.WEB: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.
verses.ASV: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to its place where it ariseth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O sol nasce, e o sol se põe; e se apressa ao seu lugar onde nasceu.
verses.RVR09: Y sale el sol, y pónese el sol, y con deseo vuelve á su lugar donde torna á nacer.

verses.KJV: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
verses.WEB: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.
verses.ASV: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it turneth about continually in its course, and the wind returneth again to its circuits.
verses.ALMEIDA: O vento vai ao sul, e rodeia para o norte; continuamente o vento vai rodeando e voltando aos lugares onde circulou.
verses.RVR09: El viento tira hacia el mediodía, y rodea al norte; va girando de continuo, y á sus giros torna el viento de nuevo.

verses.KJV: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
verses.WEB: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.
verses.ASV: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full; unto the place whither the rivers go, thither they go again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os rios vão para o mar, e contudo o mar não se enche; ao lugar onde os ribeiros correm, para ali eles voltam a correr.
verses.RVR09: Los ríos todos van á la mar, y la mar no se hinche; al lugar de donde los ríos vinieron, allí tornan para correr de nuevo.

verses.KJV: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
verses.WEB: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
verses.ASV: All things are full of weariness; man cannot utter [it]: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas [estas] coisas são [tão] cansativas, que ninguém consegue descrever; os olhos não ficam satisfeitos de ver, nem os ouvidos se enchem de ouvir.
verses.RVR09: Todas las cosas andan en trabajo más que el hombre pueda decir: ni los ojos viendo se hartan de ver, ni los oídos se hinchen de oir.

verses.KJV: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
verses.WEB: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.
verses.ASV: That which hath been is that which shall be; and that which hath been done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que foi, isso será; e o que se fez, isso será feito; de modo que nada há de novo abaixo do sol.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué es lo que fué? Lo mismo que será. ¿Qué es lo que ha sido hecho? Lo mismo que se hará: y nada hay nuevo debajo del sol.

verses.KJV: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.
verses.WEB: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.
verses.ASV: Is there a thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been long ago, in the ages which were before us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Existe algo que se possa dizer: Vê isto, que é novo?Isso já existia nos tempos passados, que foram antes de nós.
verses.RVR09: ¿Hay algo de que se pueda decir: He aquí esto es nuevo? Ya fué en los siglos que nos han precedido.

verses.KJV: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
verses.WEB: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.
verses.ASV: There is no remembrance of the former [generations]; neither shall there be any remembrance of the latter [generations] that are to come, among those that shall come after.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há lembrança das coisas que já aconteceram; e das coisas que vão acontecer, também delas não haverá lembrança entre aqueles que vierem depois.
verses.RVR09: No hay memoria de lo que precedió, ni tampoco de lo que sucederá habrá memoria en los que serán después.

verses.KJV: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu o Pregador, me tornei rei sobre Israel em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Yo el Predicador fuí rey sobre Israel en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
verses.WEB: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
verses.ASV: And I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under heaven: it is a sore travail that God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dei meu coração a investigar e pesquisar com sabedoria sobre tudo o que acontece abaixo do céu; esta cansativa ocupação Deus deu aos filhos dos homens, para que nela fossem forçados.
verses.RVR09: Y dí mi corazón á inquirir y buscar con sabiduría sobre todo lo que se hace debajo del cielo: este penoso trabajo dió Dios á los hijos de los hombres, en que se ocupen.

verses.KJV: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
verses.ASV: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi todas as obras que são feitas abaixo do sol, e eis que tudo é futilidade e aflição de espírito.
verses.RVR09: Yo miré todas las obras que se hacen debajo del sol; y he aquí, todo ello es vanidad y aflicción de espíritu.

verses.KJV: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
verses.WEB: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.
verses.ASV: That which is crooked cannot be made straight; and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que é torto não pode ser endireitado; o que está em falta não pode ser contado.
verses.RVR09: Lo torcido no se puede enderezar; y lo falto no puede contarse.

verses.KJV: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.WEB: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”
verses.ASV: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I have gotten me great wisdom above all that were before me in Jerusalem; yea, my heart hath had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu falei ao meu coração, dizendo: Eis que eu me tornei grande, e aumentei em sabedoria, sobre todos os que tinham sido antes de mim em Jerusalém; e meu coração experimentou uma abundância de sabedoria e conhecimento.
verses.RVR09: Hablé yo con mi corazón, diciendo: He aquí hállome yo engrandecido, y he crecido en sabiduría sobre todos los que fueron antes de mí en Jerusalem; y mi corazón ha percibido muchedumbre de sabiduría y ciencia.

verses.KJV: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
verses.ASV: And I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also was a striving after wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dei meu coração para entender sabedoria, e para entender loucuras e tolices; e percebi que também isto era aflição.
verses.RVR09: Y dí mi corazón á conocer la sabiduría, y también á entender las locuras y los desvaríos: conocí que aun esto era aflicción de espíritu.

verses.KJV: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
verses.WEB: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
verses.ASV: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque na muita sabedoria há muito aborrecimento, e aquele que aumenta em conhecimento aumenta em angústia.
verses.RVR09: Porque en la mucha sabiduría hay mucha molestia; y quien añade ciencia, añade dolor.

verses.KJV: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
verses.WEB: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.
verses.ASV: I said in my heart, Come now, I will prove thee with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also was vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse eu em meu coração: Vamos! Eu te provarei com alegria, por isso dá atenção ao que é bom! Porém eis que isto também era futilidade.
verses.RVR09: DIJE yo en mi corazón: Ven ahora, te probaré con alegría, y gozarás de bienes. Mas he aquí esto también era vanidad.

verses.KJV: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
verses.WEB: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”
verses.ASV: I said of laughter, It is mad; and of mirth, What doeth it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse ao riso: Estás doido; e à alegria: De que esta serve?
verses.RVR09: A la risa dije: Enloqueces; y al placer: ¿De qué sirve esto?

verses.KJV: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
verses.WEB: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.
verses.ASV: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding [me] with wisdom, and how to lay hold on folly, till I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Decidi como experiência entregar minha carne ao vinho (guiando porém meu coração com sabedoria) e praticar a loucura, para eu ver o que era melhor aos filhos dos homens fazerem abaixo do céu durante os dias de suas vidas.
verses.RVR09: Propuse en mi corazón agasajar mi carne con vino, y que anduviese mi corazón en sabiduría, con retención de la necedad, hasta ver cuál fuese el bien de los hijos de los hombres, en el cual se ocuparan debajo del cielo todos los días de su vida.

verses.KJV: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
verses.WEB: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.
verses.ASV: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fiz para mim obras grandiosas; construí casas para mim; plantei vinhas para mim.
verses.RVR09: Engrandecí mis obras, edifiquéme casas, plantéme viñas;

verses.KJV: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
verses.WEB: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.
verses.ASV: I made me gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fiz para mim pomares e jardins; e plantei neles árvores de toda [espécie de] frutos.
verses.RVR09: Híceme huertos y jardines, y planté en ellos árboles de todos frutos;

verses.KJV: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
verses.WEB: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.
verses.ASV: I made me pools of water, to water therefrom the forest where trees were reared;
verses.ALMEIDA: Fiz para mim tanques de águas, para regar com eles o bosque em que se plantavam as árvores.
verses.RVR09: Híceme estanques de aguas, para regar de ellos el bosque donde los árboles crecían.

verses.KJV: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
verses.WEB: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: I bought men-servants and maid-servants, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all that were before me in Jerusalem;
verses.ALMEIDA: Adquiri escravos e escravas, e tive [escravos] nascidos em casa; também tive grande rebanho de vacas e ovelhas, mais do que todos os que houve antes de mim em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Poseí siervos y siervas, y tuve hijos de familia; también tuve posesión grande de vacas y ovejas, sobre todos los que fueron antes de mí en Jerusalem;

verses.KJV: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
verses.WEB: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.
verses.ASV: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces; I gat me men-singers and women-singers, and the delights of the sons of men, musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também juntei para mim prata, ouro, e tesouros de reis e de províncias; reservei para mim cantores e cantoras, e dos prazeres dos filhos dos homens: várias mulheres.
verses.RVR09: Alleguéme también plata y oro, y tesoro preciado de reyes y de provincias; híceme de cantores y cantoras, y los deleites de los hijos de los hombres, instrumentos músicos y de todas suertes.

verses.KJV: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
verses.WEB: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.
verses.ASV: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então me engrandeci e aumentei, mais do que todos quantos houve antes de mim em Jerusalém; além disto minha sabedoria ficou comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y fuí engrandecido, y aumentado más que todos los que fueron antes de mí en Jerusalem: á más de esto perseveró conmigo mi sabiduría.

verses.KJV: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
verses.WEB: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.
verses.ASV: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them; I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor; and this was my portion from all my labor.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tudo quanto meus olhos desejaram, eu não lhes neguei; nem privei meu coração de alegria alguma, pois meu coração se alegrou de todo o meu trabalho; e esta foi minha parte [que obtive] de todo o meu trabalho.
verses.RVR09: No negué á mis ojos ninguna cosa que desearan, ni aparté mi corazón de placer alguno, porque mi corazón gozó de todo mi trabajo: y ésta fué mi parte de toda mi faena.

verses.KJV: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.
verses.WEB: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.
verses.ASV: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labor that I had labored to do; and, behold, all was vanity and a striving after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu olhei para todas as obras que minhas mãos fizeram, como também para o trabalho ao qual me dispus a trabalhar; e eis que tudo era fútil [como] perseguir o vento, e que não havia proveito algum abaixo do sol.
verses.RVR09: Miré yo luego todas las obras que habían hecho mis manos, y el trabajo que tomé para hacerlas: y he aquí, todo vanidad y aflicción de espíritu, y no hay provecho debajo del sol.

verses.KJV: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
verses.WEB: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.
verses.ASV: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what [can] the man [do] that cometh after the king? [even] that which hath been done long ago.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então passei a observar a sabedoria, as loucuras e a tolice; porque o que o homem pode fazer depois do rei, que já não tenha sido feito?
verses.RVR09: Después torné yo á mirar para ver la sabiduría y los desvaríos y la necedad; (porque ¿qué hombre hay que pueda seguir al rey en lo que ya hicieron?)

verses.KJV: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
verses.WEB: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.
verses.ASV: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu vi que a sabedoria é melhor do que a tolice, assim como a luz é melhor do que as trevas.
verses.RVR09: Y he visto que la sabiduría sobrepuja á la necedad, como la luz á las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
verses.WEB: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.
verses.ASV: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walketh in darkness: and yet I perceived that one event happeneth to them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos do sábio estão em sua cabeça, mas o tolo anda em trevas; então eu também entendi que o mesmo futuro acontece a todos eles.
verses.RVR09: El sabio tiene sus ojos en su cabeza, mas el necio anda en tinieblas: empero también entendí yo que un mismo suceso acaecerá al uno que al otro.

verses.KJV: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
verses.WEB: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.
verses.ASV: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then said I in my heart, that this also is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu disse em meu coração: Assim como acontece ao tolo, também acontecerá a mim; por que então eu me tornei mais sábio? Então disse em meu coração que isto também era inútil.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dije yo en mi corazón: Como sucederá al necio me sucederá también á mí: ¿para qué pues he trabajado hasta ahora por hacerme más sabio? Y dije en mi corazón, que también esto era vanidad.

verses.KJV: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
verses.WEB: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!
verses.ASV: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no remembrance for ever; seeing that in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. And how doth the wise man die even as the fool!
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não haverá lembrança para sempre, nem do sábio, nem do tolo; porque de tudo quanto agora há, nos dias futuros será esquecido; e o sábio morre assim como o tolo.
verses.RVR09: Porque ni del sabio ni del necio habrá memoria para siempre; pues en los días venideros ya todo será olvidado, y también morirá el sabio como el necio.

verses.KJV: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
verses.ASV: So I hated life, because the work that is wrought under the sun was grievous unto me; for all is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso detestei a vida, porque a obra que é feita abaixo do sol me faz sofrer; pois tudo é fútil [como] perseguir o vento.
verses.RVR09: Aborrecí por tanto la vida; porque la obra que se hace debajo del sol me era fastidiosa; por cuanto todo es vanidad y aflicción de espíritu.

verses.KJV: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
verses.WEB: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
verses.ASV: And I hated all my labor wherein I labored under the sun, seeing that I must leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu também detestei todo o meu trabalho em que trabalhei abaixo do sol, porque o deixarei ao homem que virá depois de mim.
verses.RVR09: Yo asimismo aborrecí todo mi trabajo que había puesto por obra debajo del sol; el cual dejaré á otro que vendrá después de mí.

verses.KJV: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
verses.WEB: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.
verses.ASV: And who knoweth whether he will be a wise man or a fool? yet will he have rule over all my labor wherein I have labored, and wherein I have showed myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem sabe se ele será sábio ou tolo? Contudo ele terá controle de todo o meu trabalho em que trabalhei, e que sabiamente conduzi abaixo do sol; também isso é futilidade.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y quién sabe si será sabio, ó necio, el que se enseñoreará de todo mi trabajo en que yo me afané, y en que ocupé debajo del sol mi sabiduría? Esto también es vanidad.

verses.KJV: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
verses.WEB: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.
verses.ASV: Therefore I turned about to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor wherein I had labored under the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu fiz meu coração perder a esperança de todo o meu trabalho em que trabalhei abaixo do sol.
verses.RVR09: Tornéme por tanto á desesperanzar mi corazón acerca de todo el trabajo en que me afané, y en que había ocupado debajo del sol mi sabiduría.

verses.KJV: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
verses.WEB: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.
verses.ASV: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, and with knowledge, and with skilfulness; yet to a man that hath not labored therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque há [um tipo de] homem que trabalha com sabedoria, conhecimento e habilidade; porém deixará tudo como herança a um [outro] homem que não trabalhou naquilo; também isto é fútil e muito desagradável.
verses.RVR09: ¡Que el hombre trabaje con sabiduría, y con ciencia, y con rectitud, y que haya de dar su hacienda á hombre que nunca trabajó en ello! También es esto vanidad y mal grande.

verses.KJV: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
verses.WEB: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?
verses.ASV: For what hath a man of all his labor, and of the striving of his heart, wherein he laboreth under the sun?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois que [proveito] o homem tem por todo o seu trabalho e cansaço de seu coração em que ele trabalha abaixo do sol?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué tiene el hombre de todo su trabajo, y fatiga de su corazón, con que debajo del sol él se afanara?

verses.KJV: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
verses.WEB: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.
verses.ASV: For all his days are [but] sorrows, and his travail is grief; yea, even in the night his heart taketh no rest. This also is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque todos os seus dias são dores, e aflição [é] sua rotina; até de noite seu coração não descansa; também isto é futilidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque todos sus días no son sino dolores, y sus trabajos molestias: aun de noche su corazón no reposa. Esto también es vanidad.

verses.KJV: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
verses.WEB: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
verses.ASV: There is nothing better for a man [than] that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há nada melhor ao homem do que comer, beber, e fazer sua alma se alegrar de seu trabalho; eu também vi que isto vem da mão de Deus.
verses.RVR09: No hay cosa mejor para el hombre sino que coma y beba, y que su alma vea el bien de su trabajo. También tengo yo visto que esto es de la mano de Dios.

verses.KJV: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
verses.WEB: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?
verses.ASV: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?
verses.ALMEIDA: (Pois quem [melhor] comeria ou teria pressa, a não ser eu mesmo?)
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿quién comerá, y quién se cuidará, mejor que yo?

verses.KJV: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
verses.ASV: For to the man that pleaseth him [God] giveth wisdom, and knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that pleaseth God. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ao homem bom perante sua face, [Deus] dá sabedoria, conhecimento e alegria; porém ao pecador ele dá trabalho cansativo, para juntar e recolher, para o dar ao bom diante da sua face; também isto é fútil [como] perseguir o vento.
verses.RVR09: Porque al hombre que le agrada, Dios le da sabiduría y ciencia y gozo: mas al pecador da trabajo, el que allegue y amontone, para que dé al que agrada á Dios. También esto es vanidad y aflicción de espíritu.

verses.KJV: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
verses.WEB: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
verses.ASV: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
verses.ALMEIDA: Para todas as coisas há um tempo determinado, e todo propósito abaixo do céu [tem seu] tempo.
verses.RVR09: PARA todas las cosas hay sazón, y todo lo que se quiere debajo del cielo, tiene su tiempo:

verses.KJV: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.WEB: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.ASV: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tempo de nascer e tempo de morrer; tempo de plantar e tempo de arrancar o que foi plantado.
verses.RVR09: Tiempo de nacer, y tiempo de morir; tiempo de plantar, y tiempo de arrancar lo plantado;

verses.KJV: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.WEB: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.ASV: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tempo de matar e tempo de curar; tempo de derrubar e tempo de construir.
verses.RVR09: Tiempo de matar, y tiempo de curar; tiempo de destruir, y tiempo de edificar;

verses.KJV: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.WEB: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.ASV: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tempo de chorar e tempo de rir; tempo de lamentar, e tempo de saltar.
verses.RVR09: Tiempo de llorar, y tiempo de reir; tiempo de endechar, y tiempo de bailar;

verses.KJV: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.WEB: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.ASV: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tempo de espalhar pedras e tempo de juntar pedras; tempo de abraçar e tempo de evitar abraçar.
verses.RVR09: Tiempo de esparcir las piedras, y tiempo de allegar las piedras; tiempo de abrazar, y tiempo de alejarse de abrazar;

verses.KJV: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.WEB: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.ASV: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tempo de buscar e tempo de perder; tempo de guardar e tempo de jogar fora.
verses.RVR09: Tiempo de agenciar, y tiempo de perder; tiempo de guardar, y tiempo de arrojar;

verses.KJV: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.WEB: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.ASV: a time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tempo de rasgar e tempo de costurar; tempo de ficar calado e tempo de falar.
verses.RVR09: Tiempo de romper, y tiempo de coser; tiempo de callar, y tiempo de hablar;

verses.KJV: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
verses.WEB: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
verses.ASV: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tempo de amar e tempo de odiar; tempo de guerra e tempo de paz.
verses.RVR09: Tiempo de amar, y tiempo de aborrecer; tiempo de guerra, y tiempo de paz.

verses.KJV: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
verses.WEB: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
verses.ASV: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboreth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que proveito tem o trabalhador naquilo em que ele trabalha?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué provecho tiene el que trabaja en lo que trabaja?

verses.KJV: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
verses.WEB: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
verses.ASV: I have seen the travail which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho visto a ocupação que Deus deu aos filhos dos homens, para com ela os manter ocupados.
verses.RVR09: Yo he visto el trabajo que Dios ha dado á los hijos de los hombres para que en él se ocupasen.

verses.KJV: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
verses.WEB: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
verses.ASV: He hath made everything beautiful in its time: also he hath set eternity in their heart, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God hath done from the beginning even to the end.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo ele fez belo ao seu tempo; também pôs a sensação de eternidade no coração deles, sem que o homem consiga entender a obra que Deus fez, desde o princípio até o fim.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo hizo hermoso en su tiempo: y aun el mundo dió en su corazón, de tal manera que no alcance el hombre la obra de Dios desde el principio hasta el cabo.

verses.KJV: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
verses.WEB: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
verses.ASV: I know that there is nothing better for them, than to rejoice, and to do good so long as they live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho percebido que não há coisa melhor para eles do que se alegrarem e fazerem o bem em suas vidas;
verses.RVR09: Yo he conocido que no hay mejor para ellos, que alegrarse, y hacer bien en su vida:

verses.KJV: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
verses.WEB: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
verses.ASV: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também que todo homem coma, beba e fique contente com todo o seu trabalho; [isto] é um presente de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y también que es don de Dios que todo hombre coma y beba, y goce el bien de toda su labor.

verses.KJV: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
verses.WEB: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
verses.ASV: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor anything taken from it; and God hath done it, that men should fear before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sei que tudo quanto Deus faz durará para sempre; a isso nada será acrescentado e nada será diminuído; e Deus faz [assim] para que haja temor perante sua presença.
verses.RVR09: He entendido que todo lo que Dios hace, eso será perpetuo: sobre aquello no se añadirá, ni de ello se disminuirá; y hácelo Dios, para que delante de él teman los hombres.

verses.KJV: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
verses.WEB: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.
verses.ASV: That which is hath been long ago; and that which is to be hath long ago been: and God seeketh again that which is passed away.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que tem sido agora, já foi antes; e o que vier a ser [também] já foi; Deus busca [de volta] o que foi passado.
verses.RVR09: Aquello que fué, ya es: y lo que ha de ser, fué ya; y Dios restaura lo que pasó.

verses.KJV: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.
verses.WEB: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
verses.ASV: And moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi mais abaixo do sol: que no lugar do juízo havia ali perversidade; e que no lugar da justiça havia ali perversidade.
verses.RVR09: Vi más debajo del sol: en lugar del juicio, allí la impiedad; y en lugar de la justicia, allí la iniquidad.

verses.KJV: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
verses.WEB: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”
verses.ASV: I said in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse em meu coração: Deus julgará ao justo e ao perverso, porque ali há tempo para todo propósito e para toda obra.
verses.RVR09: Y dije yo en mi corazón: Al justo y al impío juzgará Dios; porque allí hay tiempo á todo lo que se quiere y sobre todo lo que se hace.

verses.KJV: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
verses.WEB: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
verses.ASV: I said in my heart, [It is] because of the sons of men, that God may prove them, and that they may see that they themselves are [but as] beasts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse em meu coração quanto aos filhos dos homens, que Deus lhes provaria, para lhes mostrar que eles são como animais.
verses.RVR09: Dije en mi corazón, en orden á la condición de los hijos de los hombres, que Dios los probaría, para que así echaran de ver ellos mismos que son semejantes á las bestias.

verses.KJV: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
verses.WEB: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.
verses.ASV: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; and man hath no preeminence above the beasts: for all is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o que acontece aos filhos dos homens, isso mesmo também acontece aos animais; o mesmo acontece a eles [todos] ; assim como um morre, assim também morre o outro; e todos tem uma mesma respiração; e a vantagem dos homens sobre os animais é nenhuma, pois todos são fúteis.
verses.RVR09: Porque el suceso de los hijos de los hombres, y el suceso del animal, el mismo suceso es: como mueren los unos, así mueren los otros; y una misma respiración tienen todos; ni tiene más el hombre que la bestia: porque todo es vanidad.

verses.KJV: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.WEB: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.ASV: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos vão a um [mesmo] lugar; todos vieram do pó [da terra] , e todos voltarão ao pó.
verses.RVR09: Todo va á un lugar: todo es hecho del polvo, y todo se tornará en el mismo polvo.

verses.KJV: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
verses.WEB: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
verses.ASV: Who knoweth the spirit of man, whether it goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast, whether it goeth downward to the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem tem certeza de que o fôlego de vida dos homens sobe para cima, e que o fôlego de vida dos animais desce para debaixo da terra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién sabe que el espíritu de los hijos de los hombres suba arriba, y que el espíritu del animal descienda debajo de la tierra?

verses.KJV: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
verses.WEB: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?
verses.ASV: Wherefore I saw that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him [back] to see what shall be after him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso tenho visto que não há coisa melhor do que o homem se alegrar de suas obras, porque essa é a parte que lhe pertence; pois quem pode levá-lo a ver o que será depois de sua [morte] ?
verses.RVR09: Así que he visto que no hay cosa mejor que alegrarse el hombre con lo que hiciere; porque esta es su parte: porque ¿quién lo llevará para que vea lo que ha de ser después de él?

verses.KJV: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
verses.WEB: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
verses.ASV: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and, behold, the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois me virei, e observei todas as opressões que são feitas abaixo do sol; e eis que [vi] as lágrimas dos oprimidos, que não tinham consolador; a força estava do lado dos seus opressores, porém eles não tinham quem os consolasse.
verses.RVR09: Y TORNÉME yo, y vi todas las violencias que se hacen debajo del sol: y he aquí las lágrimas de los oprimidos, y sin tener quien los consuele; y la fuerza estaba en la mano de sus opresores, y para ellos no había consolador.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
verses.WEB: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.
verses.ASV: Wherefore I praised the dead that have been long dead more than the living that are yet alive;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu considerei os mortos, que já morreram, serem mais merecedores de elogios do que os vivos, que ainda vivem.
verses.RVR09: Y alabé yo los finados que ya murieron, más que los vivientes que hasta ahora están vivos.

verses.KJV: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
verses.WEB: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
verses.ASV: yea, better than them both [did I esteem] him that hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: E melhor que estes ambos, é aquele que ainda não existe; que não viu as más obras, que são feitas abaixo do sol.
verses.RVR09: Y tuve por mejor que unos y otros al que no ha sido aún, que no ha visto las malas obras que debajo del sol se hacen.

verses.KJV: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.ASV: Then I saw all labor and every skilful work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também vi eu que todo o trabalho, e toda a habilidade em obras, [causa] ao homem a inveja de seu próximo; também isto é fútil [como] perseguir o vento.
verses.RVR09: Visto he asimismo que todo trabajo y toda excelencia de obras mueve la envidia del hombre contra su prójimo. También esto es vanidad y aflicción de espíritu.

verses.KJV: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
verses.WEB: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.
verses.ASV: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: O tolo junta suas mãos, e come sua [própria] carne.
verses.RVR09: El necio dobla sus manos y come su carne.

verses.KJV: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
verses.ASV: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and striving after wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: É melhor uma mão cheia [com] descanso, do que ambas as mãos cheias [com] trabalho e perseguição ao vento.
verses.RVR09: Mas vale el un puño lleno con descanso, que ambos puños llenos con trabajo y aflicción de espíritu.

verses.KJV: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
verses.WEB: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
verses.ASV: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu me voltei, e vi uma futilidade abaixo do sol:
verses.RVR09: Yo me torné otra vez, y vi vanidad debajo del sol.

verses.KJV: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
verses.WEB: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
verses.ASV: There is one that is alone, and he hath not a second; yea, he hath neither son nor brother; yet is there no end of all his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with riches. For whom then, [saith he], do I labor, and deprive my soul of good? This also is vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Havia um que era sozinho, sem filho, nem irmão; e seu trabalho não tem fim, nem seus olhos se fartam de riquezas; nem [diz] : Para quem estou trabalhando, e privando minha alma do que é bom? Também isso é futilidade e enfadonha ocupação.
verses.RVR09: Está un hombre solo y sin sucesor; que ni tiene hijo ni hermano; mas nunca cesa de trabajar, ni sus ojos se hartan de sus riquezas, ni se pregunta: ¿Para quién trabajo yo, y defraudo mi alma del bien? También esto es vanidad, y duro trabajo.

verses.KJV: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
verses.WEB: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
verses.ASV: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dois são melhores do que um, porque eles têm melhor recompensa por seu trabalho.
verses.RVR09: Mejores son dos que uno; porque tienen mejor paga de su trabajo.

verses.KJV: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
verses.WEB: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
verses.ASV: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him that is alone when he falleth, and hath not another to lift him up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se vierem a cair, um levanta ao seu companheiro; mas ai daquele que está só, pois caso caia, não há outro que o levante.
verses.RVR09: Porque si cayeren, el uno levantará á su compañero: mas ¡ay del solo! que cuando cayere, no habrá segundo que lo levante.

verses.KJV: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
verses.WEB: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
verses.ASV: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one be warm [alone]?
verses.ALMEIDA: Também, se dois se deitarem juntos, eles se aquecem; mas como alguém sozinho poderá se aquecer?
verses.RVR09: También si dos durmieren juntos, se calentarán; mas ¿cómo se calentará uno solo?

verses.KJV: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
verses.WEB: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
verses.ASV: And if a man prevail against him that is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se alguém prevalecer contra um, dois podem resistir contra ele; porque o cordão de três dobras não se rompe tão depressa.
verses.RVR09: Y si alguno prevaleciere contra el uno, dos estarán contra él; y cordón de tres dobleces no presto se rompe.

verses.KJV: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
verses.WEB: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.
verses.ASV: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king, who knoweth not how to receive admonition any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o jovem pobre e sábio do que o rei velho e tolo, que não sabe dar ouvidos aos conselhos,
verses.RVR09: Mejor es el muchacho pobre y sabio, que el rey viejo y fatuo que no sabe ser aconsejado.

verses.KJV: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
verses.WEB: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.
verses.ASV: For out of prison he came forth to be king; yea, even in his kingdom he was born poor.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque esse [jovem] pode sair até da prisão para se tornar rei, ainda que tenha nascido pobre em seu reino.
verses.RVR09: Porque de la cárcel salió para reinar; mientras el nacido en su reino se hizo pobre.

verses.KJV: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
verses.WEB: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.
verses.ASV: I saw all the living that walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the second, that stood up in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi todos os vivos, que andam abaixo do sol, estarem com o jovem, o sucessor, que ficaria em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Vi todos los vivientes debajo del sol caminando con el muchacho sucesor, que estará en lugar de aquél.

verses.KJV: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
verses.ASV: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was: yet they that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não havia fim todo o povo, todo o que houve antes deles; porém os que vêm depois não se alegrarão nele. Também isso é fútil [como] perseguir o vento.
verses.RVR09: No tiene fin todo el pueblo que fué antes de ellos: tampoco los que vendrán después estarán con él contentos. Y esto es también vanidad y aflicción de espíritu.

verses.KJV: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
verses.WEB: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.
verses.ASV: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God; for to draw nigh to hear is better than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they know not that they do evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guarda os teus passos quando entrares na casa de Deus, e te achegues a ouvir em vez de oferecer sacrifícios de tolos, pois não sabem que fazem mal.
verses.RVR09: CUANDO fueres á la casa de Dios, guarda tu pie; y acércate más para oir que para dar el sacrificio de los necios: porque no saben que hacen mal.

verses.KJV: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
verses.WEB: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.
verses.ASV: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thy heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te precipites com tua boca, nem te apresses com teu coração, a pronunciar palavra alguma perante a face de Deus; porque Deus está nos céus, e tu estás na terra; por isso, que tuas palavras sejam poucas.
verses.RVR09: No te des priesa con tu boca, ni tu corazón se apresure á proferir palabra delante de Dios; porque Dios está en el cielo, y tú sobre la tierra: por tanto, sean pocas tus palabras.

verses.KJV: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice is known by multitude of words.
verses.WEB: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
verses.ASV: For a dream cometh with a multitude of business, and a fool’s voice with a multitude of words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois, como os sonhos vêm das muitas ocupações, assim também o excesso de palavras vem da voz do tolo.
verses.RVR09: Porque de la mucha ocupación viene el sueño, y de la multitud de las palabras la voz del necio.

verses.KJV: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
verses.WEB: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.
