verses.ASV: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou vowest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando fizeres algum voto a Deus, não demores em pagá-lo; porque ele não se agrada de tolos. Paga o voto que fizeres.
verses.RVR09: Cuando á Dios hicieres promesa, no tardes en pagarla; porque no se agrada de los insensatos. Paga lo que prometieres.

verses.KJV: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
verses.WEB: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.
verses.ASV: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é que não faças voto, do que fazeres um voto, e não o pagares.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es que no prometas, que no que prometas y no pagues.

verses.KJV: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?
verses.WEB: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?
verses.ASV: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thy hands?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não permitas que a tua boca faça a tua carne pecar; nem digas perante o mensageiro que foi um mero erro; por que provocarias a ira de Deus com a tua voz, para que ele destrua a obra de tuas mãos?
verses.RVR09: No sueltes tu boca para hacer pecar á tu carne; ni digas delante del ángel, que fué ignorancia. ¿Por qué harás que Dios se aire á causa de tu voz, y que destruya la obra de tus manos?

verses.KJV: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.
verses.WEB: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.
verses.ASV: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, and in many words: but fear thou God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque, como na abundância de sonhos há futilidades, assim, também, há abundância de palavras; tu, porém, teme a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Donde los sueños son en multitud, también lo son las vanidades y muchas las palabras; mas tú teme á Dios.

verses.KJV: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.
verses.WEB: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.
verses.ASV: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a province, marvel not at the matter: for one higher than the high regardeth; and there are higher than they.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se vires em algum território a opressão dos pobres, e a violência contra o direito e a justiça, não te surpreendas de tal caso; porque o oficial tem uma autoridade maior que o supervisiona; e acima de ambos há outros que têmautoridade ainda maior.
verses.RVR09: Si violencias de pobres, y extorsión de derecho y de justicia vieres en la provincia, no te maravilles de esta licencia; porque alto está mirando sobre alto, y uno más alto está sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.
verses.WEB: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.
verses.ASV: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king [himself] is served by the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o proveito da terra é para todos; até o rei se serve do campo.
verses.RVR09: Además el provecho de la tierra es para todos: el rey mismo está sujeto á los campos.

verses.KJV: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
verses.WEB: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.
verses.ASV: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance, with increase: this also is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que amar o dinheiro nunca se saciará do dinheiro; e quem amar a riqueza, nunca [se saciará] do lucro; isso também é futilidade.
verses.RVR09: El que ama el dinero, no se hartará de dinero; y el que ama el mucho tener, no sacará fruto. También esto es vanidad.

verses.KJV: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?
verses.WEB: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?
verses.ASV: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them; and what advantage is there to the owner thereof, save the beholding [of them] with his eyes?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde os bens se multiplicam, ali se multiplicam também os que os cosomem; e que proveito pois tem seus donos, a não ser somente ver [as riquezas] com seus próprios olhos?
verses.RVR09: Cuando los bienes se aumentan, también se aumentan sus comedores. ¿Qué bien, pues, tendrá su dueño, sino verlos con sus ojos?

verses.KJV: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
verses.WEB: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.
verses.ASV: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much; but the fulness of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
verses.ALMEIDA: Doce é o sono do trabalhador, quer coma pouco, quer muito; porém a fartura do rico não o deixa dormir.
verses.RVR09: Dulce es el sueño del trabajador, ora coma mucho ó poco; mas al rico no le deja dormir la hartura.

verses.KJV: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
verses.WEB: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
verses.ASV: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun, [namely], riches kept by the owner thereof to his hurt:
verses.ALMEIDA: Há um mal causador de sofrimentos que vi abaixo do sol: as riquezas que seus donos guardam para seu próprio mal.
verses.RVR09: Hay una trabajosa enfermedad que he visto debajo del sol: las riquezas guardadas de sus dueños para su mal;

verses.KJV: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.
verses.WEB: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.
verses.ASV: and those riches perish by evil adventure; and if he hath begotten a son, there is nothing in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque as mesmas riquezas se perdem com negócios malsucedidos; e quando gera algum filho, nada lhe fica em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales se pierden en malas ocupaciones, y á los hijos que engendraron nada les queda en la mano.

verses.KJV: As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
verses.WEB: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
verses.ASV: As he came forth from his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como ele saiu do ventre de sua mãe, nu ele voltará, indo-se como veio; e nada tomará de seu trabalho, que possa levar em sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Como salió del vientre de su madre, desnudo, así se vuelve, tornando como vino; y nada tuvo de su trabajo para llevar en su mano.

verses.KJV: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?
verses.WEB: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?
verses.ASV: And this also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that he laboreth for the wind?
verses.ALMEIDA: De maneira que isto também é um mal causador de sofrimentos, que exatamente como veio, assim se vai; e que proveito ele teve em trabalhar para o vento?
verses.RVR09: Este también es un gran mal, que como vino, así haya de volver. ¿Y de qué le aprovechó trabajar al viento?

verses.KJV: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.
verses.WEB: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.
verses.ASV: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he is sore vexed, and hath sickness and wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, ele comeu em trevas todos os seus dias; sofreu muito, e teve enfermidades e irritações.
verses.RVR09: Demás de esto, todos los días de su vida comerá en tinieblas, con mucho enojo y dolor y miseria.

verses.KJV: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.
verses.WEB: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.
verses.ASV: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and to be comely is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, wherein he laboreth under the sun, all the days of his life which God hath given him: for this is his portion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis o que eu vi, algo bom e belo: comer, beber, e experimentar o que é bom de todo o seu trabalho em que trabalhou abaixo do sol, durante os dias de sua vida, que Deus lhe deu; porque isto é a parte que lhe pertence.
verses.RVR09: He aquí pues el bien que yo he visto: Que lo bueno es comer y beber, y gozar uno del bien de todo su trabajo con que se fatiga debajo del sol, todos los días de su vida que Dios le ha dado; porque esta es su parte.

verses.KJV: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
verses.WEB: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.
verses.ASV: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo homem a quem Deus deu riquezas e bens, e lhe deu poder para comer delas, e tomar sua parte, e se alegrar de seu trabalho; isto é presente de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo, á todo hombre á quien Dios dió riquezas y hacienda, y le dió también facultad para que coma de ellas, y tome su parte, y goce su trabajo; esto es don de Dios.

verses.KJV: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.
verses.WEB: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.
verses.ASV: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth [him] in the joy of his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele não se lembrará muito dos dias de sua vida, porque Deus lhe responde com alegria de seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Porque no se acordará mucho de los días de su vida; pues Dios le responderá con alegría de su corazón.

verses.KJV: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:
verses.WEB: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:
verses.ASV: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy upon men:
verses.ALMEIDA: Há um mal que vi abaixo do sol, e é muito frequente entre os homens:
verses.RVR09: HAY un mal que he visto debajo del cielo, y muy común entre los hombres:

verses.KJV: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
verses.WEB: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
verses.ASV: a man to whom God giveth riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacketh nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but an alien eateth it; this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um homem a quem Deus deu riquezas, bens, e honra; e nada lhe falta de tudo quanto a sua alma deseja; porém Deus não lhe dá poder para dessas coisas comer; em vez disso, um estranho as come; isso é futilidade e um mal causador de sofrimento.
verses.RVR09: Hombre á quien Dios dió riquezas, y hacienda, y honra, y nada le falta de todo lo que su alma desea; mas Dios no le dió facultad de comer de ello, sino que los extraños se lo comen. Esto vanidad es, y enfermedad trabajosa.

verses.KJV: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
verses.WEB: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;
verses.ASV: If a man beget a hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul be not filled with good, and moreover he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o homem gerar cem [filhos] , e viver muitos anos, e os dias de seus anos forem muitos, porém se sua alma não se saciar daquilo que é bom, nem tiver sepultamento, digo que ter sido abortado [teria sido] melhor para ele.
verses.RVR09: Si el hombre engendrare ciento, y viviere muchos años, y los días de su edad fueren numerosos; si su alma no se hartó del bien, y también careció de sepultura, yo digo que el abortivo es mejor que él.

verses.KJV: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.
verses.WEB: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.
verses.ASV: for it cometh in vanity, and departeth in darkness, and the name thereof is covered with darkness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois veio em futilidade, e se vai em trevas; e nas trevas seu nome é encoberto.
verses.RVR09: Porque en vano vino, y á tinieblas va, y con tinieblas será cubierto su nombre.

verses.KJV: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.
verses.WEB: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.
verses.ASV: moreover it hath not seen the sun nor known it; this hath rest rather than the other:
verses.ALMEIDA: [Alguém] que nunca tivesse visto o sol, nem [o] conhecido, teria mais descanso do que ele.
verses.RVR09: Aunque no haya visto el sol, ni conocido nada, más reposo tiene éste que aquél.

verses.KJV: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
verses.WEB: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?
verses.ASV: yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet enjoy no good, do not all go to one place?
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda que vivesse mil anos duas vezes, e não experimentasse o que é bom, por acaso não vão todos para o mesmo lugar?
verses.RVR09: Porque si viviere aquél mil años dos veces, si no ha gozado del bien, cierto todos van á un lugar.

verses.KJV: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
verses.WEB: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
verses.ASV: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo o trabalho do homem é para sua boca; porém sua alma nunca se satisfaz.
verses.RVR09: Todo el trabajo del hombre es para su boca, y con todo eso su alma no se harta.

verses.KJV: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
verses.WEB: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?
verses.ASV: For what advantage hath the wise more than the fool? [or] what hath the poor man, that knoweth how to walk before the living?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois que vantagem tem o sábio sobre o tolo? E que [mais] tem o pobre que sabe como se comportar diante dos vivos?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿qué más tiene el sabio que el necio? ¿qué más tiene el pobre que supo caminar entre los vivos?

verses.KJV: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
verses.ASV: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this also is vanity and a striving after wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é a vista dos olhos do que o vaguear da cobiça; também isto é fútil [como] perseguir o vento.
verses.RVR09: Más vale vista de ojos que deseo que pasa. Y también esto es vanidad y aflicción de espíritu.

verses.KJV: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
verses.WEB: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.
verses.ASV: Whatsoever hath been, the name thereof was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him that is mightier than he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seja o que for, seu nome já foi chamado; e [já] se sabe o que o homem é; e que não pode disputar contra aquele que é mais poderoso do que ele.
verses.RVR09: El que es, ya su nombre ha sido nombrado; y se sabe que es hombre, y que no podrá contender con el que es más fuerte que él.

verses.KJV: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
verses.WEB: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?
verses.ASV: Seeing there are many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quanto mais palavras há, maior é a futilidade; e que proveito há [nelas] para o homem?
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente las muchas palabras multiplican la vanidad. ¿Qué más tiene el hombre?

verses.KJV: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
verses.WEB: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?
verses.ASV: For who knoweth what is good for man in [his] life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem sabe o que é bom nesta vida para o homem, durante os dias de sua vida de futilidade, os quais ele gasta como sombra? Pois quem contará ao homem o que haverá depois dele abaixo do sol?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿quién sabe cuál es el bien del hombre en la vida, todos los días de la vida de su vanidad, los cuales él pasa como sombra? Porque ¿quién enseñará al hombre qué será después de él debajo del sol?

verses.KJV: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.
verses.WEB: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.
verses.ASV: A [good] name is better than precious oil; and the day of death, than the day of one’s birth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é uma boa reputação do que o bom óleo perfumado; e o dia da morte [é melhor] que o dia de seu nascimento
verses.RVR09: MEJOR es la buena fama que el buen ungüento; y el día de la muerte que el día del nacimiento.

verses.KJV: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.
verses.WEB: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.
verses.ASV: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é ir à casa do luto do que a casa do banquete, [porque] isto é o fim de todos os homens; e os vivos tomam isto em seus corações.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es ir á la casa del luto que á la casa del convite: porque aquello es el fin de todos los hombres; y el que vive parará mientes.

verses.KJV: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
verses.WEB: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.
verses.ASV: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o sofrimento do que o riso, porque com a tristeza do rosto o coração se aperfeiçoa.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es el enojo que la risa: porque con la tristeza del rostro se enmendará el corazón.

verses.KJV: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
verses.WEB: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
verses.ASV: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração dos sábios está na casa do luto, mas o coração dos tolos [está] na casa da alegria.
verses.RVR09: El corazón de los sabios, en la casa del luto; mas el corazón de los insensatos, en la casa del placer.

verses.KJV: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
verses.WEB: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.
verses.ASV: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é ouvir a repreensão do sábio do que alguém ouvir a canção dos tolos;
verses.RVR09: Mejor es oir la reprensión del sabio, que la canción de los necios.

verses.KJV: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.
verses.WEB: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.
verses.ASV: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o riso dos tolos é como o ruído de espinhos debaixo de uma panela; também isto é futilidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque la risa del necio es como el estrépito de las espinas debajo de la olla. Y también esto es vanidad.

verses.KJV: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
verses.WEB: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.
verses.ASV: Surely extortion maketh the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroyeth the understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Verdadeiramente a opressão faz até o sábio enlouquecer, e o suborno corrompe o coração.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente la opresión hace enloquecer al sabio: y el presente corrompe el corazón.

verses.KJV: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
verses.WEB: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
verses.ASV: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof; [and] the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é o fim das coisas do que o princípio delas; melhor é o paciente de espírito do que o arrogante de espírito.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es el fin del negocio que su principio: mejor es el sufrido de espíritu que el altivo de espíritu.

verses.KJV: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
verses.WEB: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.
verses.ASV: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry; for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te apresses em teu espírito para te irares, porque a ira repousa no colo dos tolos.
verses.RVR09: No te apresures en tu espíritu á enojarte: porque la ira en el seno de los necios reposa.

verses.KJV: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
verses.WEB: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.
verses.ASV: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not inquire wisely concerning this.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca digas: Por que os dias passados foram melhores que os atuais? Pois nunca com sabedoria perguntarias isso.
verses.RVR09: Nunca digas: ¿Qué es la causa que los tiempos pasados fueron mejores que éstos? Porque nunca de esto preguntarás con sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.
verses.WEB: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
verses.ASV: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance; yea, more excellent is it for them that see the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: A sabedoria é tão boa quanto uma herança; ela é um proveito para os que veem a luz do sol;
verses.RVR09: Buena es la ciencia con herencia; y más á los que ven el sol.

verses.KJV: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
verses.WEB: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.
verses.ASV: For wisdom is a defence, even as money is a defence; but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom preserveth the life of him that hath it.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque a sabedoria serve de proteção, assim como o dinheiro serve de proteção; mas a vantagem do conhecimento é que a sabedoria dá vida ao seu dono.
verses.RVR09: Porque escudo es la ciencia, y escudo es el dinero: mas la sabiduría excede en que da vida á sus poseedores.

verses.KJV: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?
verses.WEB: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?
verses.ASV: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?
verses.ALMEIDA: Observa a obra de Deus, pois quem poderá endireitar o que ele entortou?
verses.RVR09: Mira la obra de Dios; porque ¿quién podrá enderezar lo que él torció?

verses.KJV: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
verses.WEB: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.
verses.ASV: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yea, God hath made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything [that shall be] after him.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia da prosperidade, alegra-te; mas no dia da adversidade, considera; pois Deus faz um em contraposição ao outro, para que o homem não consiga descobrir o que haverá depois dele.
verses.RVR09: En el día del bien goza del bien; y en el día del mal considera. Dios también hizo esto delante de lo otro, porque el hombre no halle nada tras de él.

verses.KJV: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.
verses.WEB: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.
verses.ASV: All this have I seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth [his life] in his evil-doing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo [isto] vi nos meus dias de futilidade: há justo que perece em sua justiça, e há perverso que prolonga [sua vida] em sua maldade.
verses.RVR09: Todo esto he visto en los días de mi vanidad. Justo hay que perece por su justicia, y hay impío que por su maldad alarga sus días.

verses.KJV: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself ?
verses.WEB: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?
verses.ASV: Be not righteous overmuch; neither make thyself overwise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejas justo demais, nem sejas sábio demais; para que destruirias a ti mesmo?
verses.RVR09: No seas demasiado justo, ni seas sabio con exceso: ¿por qué te destruirás?

verses.KJV: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
verses.WEB: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?
verses.ASV: Be not overmuch wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejas perverso demais, nem sejas tolo; para que morrerias antes de teu tempo?
verses.RVR09: No hagas mal mucho, ni seas insensato: ¿por qué morirás antes de tu tiempo?

verses.KJV: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
verses.WEB: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.
verses.ASV: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from that withdraw not thy hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth from them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: É bom que retenhas isto, e também não retires tua mão disto, pois quem teme a Deus escapa de tudo isto.
verses.RVR09: Bueno es que tomes esto, y también de estotro no apartes tu mano; porque el que á Dios teme, saldrá con todo.

verses.KJV: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
verses.WEB: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
verses.ASV: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers that are in a city.
verses.ALMEIDA: A sabedoria fortalece ao sábio, mais do que dez homens de autoridade que estejam na cidade.
verses.RVR09: La sabiduría fortifica al sabio más que diez poderosos la ciudad en que fueron.

verses.KJV: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
verses.WEB: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
verses.ASV: Surely there is not a righteous man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Verdadeiramente não há homem justo sobre a terra, que faça o bem, e nunca peque.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente no hay hombre justo en la tierra, que haga bien y nunca peque.

verses.KJV: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
verses.WEB: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;
verses.ASV: Also take not heed unto all words that are spoken, lest thou hear thy servant curse thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso, não dês atenção a todas as palavras que forem ditas, para que não venhas a ouvir que teu servo te amaldiçoa;
verses.RVR09: Tampoco apliques tu corazón á todas las cosas que se hablaren, porque no oigas á tu siervo que dice mal de ti:

verses.KJV: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
verses.WEB: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.
verses.ASV: for oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois teu coração sabe que também tu já amaldiçoaste a outros.
verses.RVR09: Porque tu corazón sabe, como tú también dijiste mal de otros muchas veces.

verses.KJV: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
verses.WEB: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.
verses.ASV: All this have I proved in wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo isto investiguei com sabedoria. Eu disse: Terei para mim mais sabedoria;porém ela ficava [ainda] mais longe de mim.
verses.RVR09: Todas estas cosas probé con sabiduría, diciendo: Hacerme he sabio: mas ella se alejó de mí.

verses.KJV: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
verses.WEB: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?
verses.ASV: That which is, is far off and exceeding deep; who can find it out?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem pode encontrar o que está distante e tão profundo?
verses.RVR09: Lejos está lo que fué; y lo muy profundo ¿quién lo hallará?

verses.KJV: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:
verses.WEB: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.
verses.ASV: I turned about, and my heart [was set] to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the reason [of things], and to know that wickedness is folly, and that foolishness is madness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Decidi em meu coração conhecer, investigar e buscar a sabedoria e a razão; e saber o mal que há na tolice e na loucura das maluquices.
verses.RVR09: Yo he rodeado con mi corazón por saber, y examinar, é inquirir la sabiduría, y la razón; y por conocer la maldad de la insensatez, y el desvarío del error;

verses.KJV: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
verses.WEB: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.
verses.ASV: And I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and nets, [and] whose hands are bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu encontrei uma coisa mais amarga que a morte: a mulher cujo coração são redes e armadilhas, e suas mãos são amarras; quem for bom perante Deus escapará dela; mas o pecador ficará preso nela.
verses.RVR09: Y yo he hallado más amarga que la muerte la mujer, la cual es redes, y lazos su corazón; sus manos como ligaduras. El que agrada á Dios escapará de ella; mas el pecador será preso en ella.

verses.KJV: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:
verses.WEB: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation
verses.ASV: Behold, this have I found, saith the Preacher, [laying] one thing to another, to find out the account;
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha isto:(diz o pregador, enquanto ele procurava entender [as coisas] ,uma por uma)
verses.RVR09: He aquí, esto he hallado, dice el Predicador, pesando las cosas una por una para hallar la razón;

verses.KJV: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
verses.WEB: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.
verses.ASV: which my soul still seeketh, but I have not found: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquilo que minha alma tem buscado, ainda não achei; um homem entre mil eu achei; mas uma mulher entre todas estas não achei.
verses.RVR09: Lo que aun busca mi alma, y no encuentro: un hombre entre mil he hallado; mas mujer de todas éstas nunca hallé.

verses.KJV: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”
verses.ASV: Behold, this only have I found: that God made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que somente achei isto: que Deus fez os homens corretos, porém foram eles que buscaram muitos desejos ruins.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, solamente he hallado esto: que Dios hizo al hombre recto, mas ellos buscaron muchas cuentas.

verses.KJV: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
verses.WEB: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.
verses.ASV: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é semelhante ao sábio? E quem sabe a interpretação das coisas? A sabedoria do homem faz seu rosto brilhar, e a dureza de seu rosto é alterada.
verses.RVR09: ¿QUIÉN como el sabio? ¿y quién como el que sabe la declaración de las cosas? La sabiduría del hombre hará relucir su rostro, y mudaráse la tosquedad de su semblante.

verses.KJV: I counsel thee to keep the king's commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.
verses.WEB: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.
verses.ASV: I [counsel thee], Keep the king’s command, and that in regard of the oath of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu digo: obedece às ordens do rei, por causa do juramento [que fizeste] a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Yo te aviso que guardes el mandamiento del rey y la palabra del juramento de Dios.

verses.KJV: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
verses.WEB: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,
verses.ASV: Be not hasty to go out of his presence; persist not in an evil thing: for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te apresses de sair da presença dele, nem persistas em alguma coisa má; pois tudo que ele deseja, ele faz.
verses.RVR09: No te apresures á irte de delante de él, ni en cosa mala persistas; porque él hará todo lo que quisiere:

verses.KJV: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.WEB: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
verses.ASV: For the king’s word [hath] power; and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquilo que há a palavra do rei, ali há autoridade; e quem lhe dirá: O que estás fazendo?
verses.RVR09: Pues la palabra del rey es con potestad, ¿y quién le dirá, Qué haces?

verses.KJV: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.
verses.WEB: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.
verses.ASV: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall know no evil thing; and a wise man’s heart discerneth time and judgment:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem obedecer ao mandamento não experimentará mal algum; e o coração do sábio sabe a hora e a maneira [corretas] .
verses.RVR09: El que guarda el mandamiento no experimentará mal; y el tiempo y el juicio conoce el corazón del sabio.

verses.KJV: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
verses.WEB: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.
verses.ASV: for to every purpose there is a time and judgment; because the misery of man is great upon him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque para todo propósito há uma hora e uma maneira [correta] ; por isso o mal do homem é muito sobre ele:
verses.RVR09: Porque para todo lo que quisieres hay tiempo y juicio; mas el trabajo del hombre es grande sobre él;

verses.KJV: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
verses.WEB: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?
verses.ASV: for he knoweth not that which shall be; for who can tell him how it shall be?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele não sabe o que irá acontecer. Quem pode lhe avisar o que vai acontecer, e quando?
verses.RVR09: Porque no sabe lo que ha de ser; y el cuándo haya de ser, ¿quién se lo enseñará?

verses.KJV: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
verses.WEB: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.
verses.ASV: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power over the day of death; and there is no discharge in war: neither shall wickedness deliver him that is given to it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há homem nenhum que tenha domínio sobre o espírito, para reter ao espírito; nem [tem] domínio sobre dia da morte, nem meios de escapar d [esta] guerra; nem a perversidade livrará a seus donos.
verses.RVR09: No hay hombre que tenga potestad sobre el espíritu para retener el espíritu, ni potestad sobre el día de la muerte: y no valen armas en tal guerra; ni la impiedad librará al que la posee.

verses.KJV: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
verses.WEB: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.
verses.ASV: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: [there is] a time wherein one man hath power over another to his hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo isto vi quando fiz coração considerar toda obra que se faz abaixo do sol: há um tempo em que um homem passa a dominar [outro] homem, para sua [própria] ruína.
verses.RVR09: Todo esto he visto, y puesto he mi corazón en todo lo que debajo del sol se hace: hay tiempo en que el hombre se enseñorea del hombre para mal suyo.

verses.KJV: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
verses.WEB: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.
verses.ASV: So I saw the wicked buried, and they came [to the grave]; and they that had done right went away from the holy place, and were forgotten in the city: this also is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também assim vi os perversos sepultados, e vinham, e saíam do lugar santo; e eles foram esquecidos na cidade em que assim fizeram; isso também é futilidade.
verses.RVR09: Esto vi también: que los impíos sepultados vinieron aún en memoria; mas los que partieron del lugar santo, fueron luego puestos en olvido en la ciudad donde con rectitud habían obrado. Esto también es vanidad.

verses.KJV: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verses.WEB: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verses.ASV: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dado que o julgamento pela obra má não é feito imediatamente, por causa disso o coração dos filhos dos homens está cheio [de vontade] neles, para fazer o mal.
verses.RVR09: Porque no se ejecuta luego sentencia sobre la mala obra, el corazón de los hijos de los hombres está en ellos lleno para hacer mal.

verses.KJV: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
verses.WEB: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.
verses.ASV: Though a sinner do evil a hundred times, and prolong his [days], yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, that fear before him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que um pecador faça o mal cem vezes e [sua vida] se prolongue, mesmo assim eu sei, que as coisas boas acontecerão aos que temem a Deus, aos que temerem diante da sua face.
verses.RVR09: Bien que el pecador haga mal cien veces, y le sea dilatado el castigo, con todo yo también sé que los que á Dios temen tendrán bien, los que temieren ante su presencia;

verses.KJV: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
verses.WEB: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.
verses.ASV: but it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong [his] days, [which are] as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ao perverso não sucederá o bem, e não prolongará [seus] dias, [que serão] como uma sombra, pois ele não tem temor diane de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y que el impío no tendrá bien, ni le serán prolongados los días, que son como sombra; por cuanto no temió delante de la presencia de Dios.

verses.KJV: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
verses.WEB: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.
verses.ASV: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth, that there are righteous men unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there are wicked men to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há [outra] futilidade que é feita sobre a terra: que há justos a quem acontece conforme as obras dos perversos, e há perversos a quem acontece conforme as obras dos justos. Digo que isso também é futilidade.
verses.RVR09: Hay vanidad que se hace sobre la tierra: que hay justos á quienes sucede como si hicieran obras de impíos; y hay impíos á quienes acaece como si hicieran obras de justos. Digo que esto también es vanidad.

verses.KJV: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
verses.WEB: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.
verses.ASV: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be joyful: for that shall abide with him in his labor [all] the days of his life which God hath given him under the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim elogiei a alegria, pois o homem não tem nada melhor abaixo do sol do que comer, beber e se alegrar; que isso acompanhe seu trabalho nos dias de sua vida, que Deus lhe dá abaixo do sol.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto alabé yo la alegría; que no tiene el hombre bien debajo del sol, sino que coma y beba, y se alegre; y que esto se le quede de su trabajo los días de su vida que Dios le dió debajo del sol.

verses.KJV: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
verses.WEB: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),
verses.ASV: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes),
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto entregava meu coração a entender a sabedoria, e ver a ocupação que é feita abaixo do sol (ainda que nem de dia, nem de noite, [o homem] veja sono em seus olhos),
verses.RVR09: Yo pues dí mi corazón á conocer sabiduría, y á ver la faena que se hace sobre la tierra; (porque hay quien ni de noche ni de día ve sueño en su ojos;)

verses.KJV: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea farther; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
verses.WEB: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.
verses.ASV: then I beheld all the work of God, that man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because however much a man labor to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea moreover, though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então vi toda a obra de Deus, que o homem não pode compreender a obra que é feita abaixo do sol; mesmo que o homem trabalhe para a buscar, ele não a encontrará; ainda que o sábio diga que a conhece, ele não pode compreendê [-la] .
verses.RVR09: Y he visto todas las obras de Dios, que el hombre no puede alcanzar la obra que debajo del sol se hace; por mucho que trabaje el hombre buscándola, no la hallará: aunque diga el sabio que la sabe, no por eso podrá alcanzarla.

verses.KJV: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
verses.WEB: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.
verses.ASV: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it be love or hatred, man knoweth it not; all is before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso fiz meu coração considerar todas estas coisas, para entender com clareza tudo isto: que os justos, e os sábios, e suas obras, estão nas mãos de Deus; até o amor e o ódio, o homem nada sabe o que há à sua frente.
verses.RVR09: CIERTAMENTE dado he mi corazón á todas estas cosas, para declarar todo esto: que los justos y los sabios, y sus obras, están en la mano de Dios; y que no sabe el hombre ni el amor ni el odio por todo lo que pasa delante de él.

verses.KJV: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
verses.WEB: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.
verses.ASV: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth and to him that sacrificeth not; as is the good, so is the sinner; [and] he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo [acontece] de modo semelhante a todos; o mesmo acontece ao justo e ao perverso; ao bom e ao puro, assim como ao impuro; tanto ao que sacrifica, como ao que não sacrifica; tanto ao bom, como ao pecador; ao que jura, assim como ao que teme [fazer] juramento.
verses.RVR09: Todo acontece de la misma manera á todos: un mismo suceso ocurre al justo y al impío; al bueno y al limpio y al no limpio; al que sacrifica, y al que no sacrifica: como el bueno, así el que peca; el que jura, como el que teme el juramento.

verses.KJV: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
verses.WEB: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
verses.ASV: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that [they go] to the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta coisa má [existe] entre tudo o que é feito abaixo do sol, que a todos aconteça o mesmo; e que o coração dos filhos homens esteja cheio de maldade, e que haja loucuras em seus corações durante suas vidas, e depois [eles vão] para entre os mortos.
verses.RVR09: Este mal hay entre todo lo que se hace debajo del sol, que todos tengan un mismo suceso, y también que el corazón de los hijos de los hombres esté lleno de mal, y de enloquecimiento en su corazón durante su vida: y después, á los muertos.

verses.KJV: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
verses.WEB: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
verses.ASV: For to him that is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque para aquele que está junto a todos os vivos há esperança (pois melhor é um cão vivo do que um leão morto).
verses.RVR09: Aun hay esperanza para todo aquél que está entre los vivos; porque mejor es perro vivo que león muerto.

verses.KJV: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
verses.WEB: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.
verses.ASV: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not anything, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os vivos sabem que vão morrer; mas os mortos não sabem coisa alguma, nem também tem mais recompensa; pois a lembrança deles já foi esquecida.
verses.RVR09: Porque los que viven saben que han de morir: mas los muertos nada saben, ni tienen más paga; porque su memoria es puesta en olvido.

verses.KJV: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
verses.WEB: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.
verses.ASV: As well their love, as their hatred and their envy, is perished long ago; neither have they any more a portion for ever in anything that is done under the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até seu amor, até seu ódio, e até sua inveja já pereceu e nenhuma parte nunca mais lhes pertence, em tudo quanto se faz abaixo do sol.
verses.RVR09: También su amor, y su odio y su envidia, feneció ya: ni tiene ya más parte en el siglo, en todo lo que se hace debajo del sol.

verses.KJV: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
verses.WEB: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
verses.ASV: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God hath already accepted thy works.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, come com alegria teu pão, e bebe com bom coração o teu vinho; pois Deus se agrada de tuas obras.
verses.RVR09: Anda, y come tu pan con gozo, y bebe tu vino con alegre corazón: porque tus obras ya son agradables á Dios.

verses.KJV: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
verses.WEB: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
verses.ASV: Let thy garments be always white; and let not thy head lack oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em todo tempo sejam brancas as tuas roupas, e nunca falte óleo sobre tua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: En todo tiempo sean blancos tus vestidos, y nunca falte ungüento sobre tu cabeza.

verses.KJV: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
verses.WEB: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
verses.ASV: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of thy life of vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all thy days of vanity: for that is thy portion in life, and in thy labor wherein thou laborest under the sun.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aproveite a vida com a mulher que tu amas, todos os dias da tua fútil vida, que [Deus] te deu abaixo do sol, todos os teus fúteis dias; porque esta é a parte que te pertence nesta vida e em teu trabalho no qual trabalhaste abaixo do sol.
verses.RVR09: Goza de la vida con la mujer que amas, todos los días de la vida de tu vanidad, que te son dados debajo del sol, todos los días de tu vanidad; porque esta es tu parte en la vida, y en tu trabajo con que te afanas debajo del sol.

verses.KJV: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
verses.WEB: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
verses.ASV: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do [it] with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, whither thou goest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tudo quanto vier à tua mão para fazer, faze conforme as tuas forças; porque no Xeol, para onde vais, não há trabalho, nem planos, nem conhecimento, nem sabedoria alguma.
verses.RVR09: Todo lo que te viniere á la mano para hacer, hazlo según tus fuerzas; porque en el sepulcro, adonde tú vas, no hay obra, ni industria, ni ciencia, ni sabiduría.

verses.KJV: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
verses.WEB: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
verses.ASV: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voltei-me, e vi abaixo do sol, que a corrida não é dos velozes, nem dos guerreiros a batalha, nem dos sábios o pão, nem dos prudentes as riquezas, nem dos conhecedores o favor; mas que o tempo e a ocasião imprevista acontece a todos estes.
verses.RVR09: Tornéme, y vi debajo del sol, que ni es de los ligeros la carrera, ni la guerra de los fuertes, ni aun de los sabios el pan, ni de los prudentes las riquezas, ni de los elocuentes el favor; sino que tiempo y ocasión acontece á todos.

verses.KJV: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
verses.WEB: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
verses.ASV: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também o homem não sabe seu tempo, assim como os peixes que são capturados pela maligna rede; e como os passarinhos que são presos na armadilha; assim também os filhos dos homens são pegos pelo tempo mau, quando cai de repente sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Porque el hombre tampoco conoce su tiempo: como los peces que son presos en la mala red, y como las aves que se prenden en lazo, así son enlazados los hijos de los hombres en el tiempo malo, cuando cae de repente sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:
verses.WEB: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.
verses.ASV: I have also seen wisdom under the sun on this wise, and it seemed great unto me:
verses.ALMEIDA: Também vi esta sabedoria abaixo do sol, que considerei grande:
verses.RVR09: También vi esta sabiduría debajo del sol, la cual me parece grande:

verses.KJV: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
verses.WEB: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.
verses.ASV: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Havia] uma pequena cidade, em que havia poucas pessoas; e veio contra ela um grande rei, e a cercou, e levantou contra ela grandes barreiras.
verses.RVR09: Una pequeña ciudad, y pocos hombres en ella; y viene contra ella un gran rey, y cércala, y edifica contra ella grandes baluartes:

verses.KJV: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
verses.WEB: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
verses.ASV: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se achou nela um homem pobre sábio, que livrou aquela cidade com sua sabedoria; porém ninguém se lembrou daquele pobre homem.
verses.RVR09: Y hállase en ella un hombre pobre, sabio, el cual libra la ciudad con su sabiduría; y nadie se acordaba de aquel pobre hombre.

verses.KJV: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
verses.WEB: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
verses.ASV: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: Melhor é a sabedoria do que a força; ainda que a sabedoria do pobre tenha sido desprezada, e suas palavras não tenham sido ouvidas.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dije yo: Mejor es la sabiduría que la fortaleza; aunque la ciencia del pobre sea menospreciada, y no sean escuchadas sus palabras.

verses.KJV: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
verses.WEB: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
verses.ASV: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
verses.ALMEIDA: As palavras dos sábios devem ser ouvidas em quietude, mais do que o grito daquele que domina sobre os tolos.
verses.RVR09: Las palabras del sabio con reposo son oídas, más que el clamor del señor entre los necios.

verses.KJV: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
verses.WEB: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
verses.ASV: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroyeth much good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Melhor é a sabedoria do que as armas de guerra; porém um só pecador destrói muitas coisas boas.
verses.RVR09: Mejor es la sabiduría que las armas de guerra; mas un pecador destruye mucho bien.

verses.KJV: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
verses.WEB: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.
verses.ASV: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to send forth an evil odor; [so] doth a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Assim como] as moscas mortas fazem cheirar mal do óleo do perfumador, [assim também] um pouco de tolice se sobrepõe à sabedoria e honra.
verses.RVR09: LAS moscas muertas hacen heder y dar mal olor el perfume del perfumista: así una pequeña locura, al estimado por sabiduría y honra.

verses.KJV: A wise man's heart is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.
verses.WEB: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.
verses.ASV: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand; but a fool’s heart at his left.
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração do sábio [está] à sua direita; mas o coração do tolo [está] à sua esquerda.
verses.RVR09: El corazón del sabio está á su mano derecha; mas el corazón del necio á su mano izquierda.

verses.KJV: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
verses.WEB: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.
verses.ASV: Yea also, when the fool walketh by the way, his understanding faileth him, and he saith to every one [that] he is a fool.
verses.ALMEIDA: E até quando o tolo vai pelo caminho, falta-lhe [bom-senso em seu] coração, e diz a todos que é ele é tolo.
verses.RVR09: Y aun mientras va el necio por el camino, fáltale su cordura, y dice á todos, que es necio.

verses.KJV: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
verses.WEB: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
verses.ASV: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for gentleness allayeth great offences.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o espírito de um chefe se levantar contra ti, não deixes teu lugar, porque a calma aquieta grandes ofensas.
verses.RVR09: Si el espíritu del príncipe se exaltare contra ti, no dejes tu lugar; porque la lenidad hará cesar grandes ofensas.

verses.KJV: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:
verses.WEB: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.
verses.ASV: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as it were an error which proceedeth from the ruler:
verses.ALMEIDA: Há um mal que vi abaixo do sol, um [tipo de] erro que é proveniente dos que têm autoridade:
verses.RVR09: Hay un mal que debajo del sol he visto, á manera de error emanado del príncipe:

verses.KJV: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
verses.WEB: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.
verses.ASV: folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Põem o tolo em cargos elevados, mas os ricos sentam em lugares baixos.
verses.RVR09: La necedad está colocada en grandes alturas, y los ricos están sentados en lugar bajo.

verses.KJV: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.
verses.WEB: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.
verses.ASV: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking like servants upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vi servos a cavalo, e príncipes que andavam [a pé] como [se fossem] servos sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Vi siervos en caballos, y príncipes que andaban como siervos sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
verses.WEB: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
verses.ASV: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh through a wall, a serpent shall bite him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem cavar uma cova, nela cairá; e quem romper um muro, uma cobra o morderá.
verses.RVR09: El que hiciere el hoyo caerá en él; y el que aportillare el vallado, morderále la serpiente.

verses.KJV: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
verses.WEB: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.
verses.ASV: Whoso heweth out stones shall be hurt therewith; [and] he that cleaveth wood is endangered thereby.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem extrai pedras, por elas será ferido; e quem parte lenha, correrá perigo por ela.
verses.RVR09: El que mudare las piedras, trabajo tendrá en ellas: el que cortare la leña, en ella peligrará.

verses.KJV: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.
verses.WEB: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.
verses.ASV: If the iron be blunt, and one do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o ferro está embotado, e não afiar o corte, então deve se pôr mais forças; mas a sabedoria é proveitosa para se ter sucesso.
verses.RVR09: Si se embotare el hierro, y su filo no fuere amolado, hay que añadir entonces más fuerza: empero excede la bondad de la sabiduría.

verses.KJV: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.
verses.WEB: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.
verses.ASV: If the serpent bite before it is charmed, then is there no advantage in the charmer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se a cobra morder sem estar encantada, então proveito nenhum tem a fala do encantador.
verses.RVR09: Muerde la serpiente cuando no está encantada, y el lenguaraz no es mejor.

verses.KJV: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
verses.WEB: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.
verses.ASV: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
verses.ALMEIDA: As palavras da boca do sábio são agradáveis; porém os lábios do tolo o devoram.
verses.RVR09: Las palabras de la boca del sabio son gracia; mas los labios del necio causan su propia ruina.

verses.KJV: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
verses.WEB: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
verses.ASV: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
verses.ALMEIDA: O princípio das palavras de sua boca é tolice; e o fim de sua boca [é] uma loucura ruim.
verses.RVR09: El principio de las palabras de su boca es necedad; y el fin de su charla nocivo desvarío.

verses.KJV: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
verses.WEB: A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn’t know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him?
verses.ASV: A fool also multiplieth words: [yet] man knoweth not what shall be; and that which shall be after him, who can tell him?
verses.ALMEIDA: O tolo multiplica as palavras, [porém] ninguém sabe o que virá no futuro; e quem lhe fará saber o que será depois dele?
verses.RVR09: El necio multiplica palabras: no sabe hombre lo que ha de ser; ¿y quién le hará saber lo que después de él será?

verses.KJV: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.
verses.WEB: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.
verses.ASV: The labor of fools wearieth every one of them; for he knoweth not how to go to the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: O trabalho dos tolos lhes traz cansaço, porque não sabem ir à cidade.
verses.RVR09: El trabajo de los necios los fatiga; porque no saben por dónde ir á la ciudad.

verses.KJV: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!
verses.WEB: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!
verses.ASV: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de ti, ó terra cujo rei é um menino, e cujos príncipes comem pela madrugada!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de ti, tierra, cuando tu rey es muchacho, y tus príncipes comen de mañana!

verses.KJV: Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
verses.WEB: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
verses.ASV: Happy art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurada é tu, ó terra, cujo rei é filho de nobres, e cujos príncipes comem no tempo [devido] , para se fortalecerem, e não para se embebedarem!
verses.RVR09: ¡Bienaventurada, tú, tierra, cuando tu rey es hijo de nobles, y tus príncipes comen á su hora, por refección, y no por el beber!

verses.KJV: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.
verses.WEB: By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks.
verses.ASV: By slothfulness the roof sinketh in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaketh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela muita preguiça o teto se deteriora; e pala frouxidão das mãos a casa tem goteiras.
verses.RVR09: Por la pereza se cae la techumbre, y por flojedad de manos se llueve la casa.

verses.KJV: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.
verses.WEB: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.
verses.ASV: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh glad the life; and money answereth all things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para rir se fazem banquetes, e o vinho alegra aos vivos; mas o dinheiro responde por tudo.
verses.RVR09: Por el placer se hace el convite, y el vino alegra los vivos: y el dinero responde á todo.

verses.KJV: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
verses.WEB: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts; and don’t curse the rich in your bedroom, for a bird of the sky may carry your voice, and that which has wings may tell the matter.
verses.ASV: Revile not the king, no, not in thy thought; and revile not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the heavens shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem mesmo em pensamento amaldiçoes ao rei, nem também no interior de teu quarto amaldiçoes ao rico, porque as aves dos céus levam o que foi falado, e os que tem asas contam o que foi dito.
verses.RVR09: Ni aun en tu pensamiento digas mal del rey, ni en los secretos de tu cámara digas mal del rico; porque las aves del cielo llevarán la voz, y las que tienen alas harán saber la palabra.

verses.KJV: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
verses.WEB: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.
verses.ASV: Cast thy bread upon the waters; for thou shalt find it after many days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lança teu pão sobre as águas, porque depois de muitos dias tu o encontrarás.
verses.RVR09: ECHA tu pan sobre las aguas; que después de muchos días lo hallarás.

verses.KJV: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
verses.WEB: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.
verses.ASV: Give a portion to seven, yea, even unto eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá uma parte a sete, e até a oito; porque não sabes que mal haverá sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Reparte á siete, y aun á ocho: porque no sabes el mal que vendrá sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
verses.WEB: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.
verses.ASV: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth; and if a tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there shall it be.
