verses.WEB: Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.
verses.ASV: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; Let us lodge in the villages.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vem, amado meu! Saiamos ao campo, passemos as noites nas aldeias.
verses.RVR09: Ven, oh amado mío, salgamos al campo, moremos en las aldeas.

verses.KJV: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
verses.WEB: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.
verses.ASV: Let us get up early to the vineyards; Let us see whether the vine hath budded, [And] its blossom is open, [And] the pomegranates are in flower: There will I give thee my love.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saiamos de madrugada até às vinhas, vejamos se as videiras florescem, se suas flores estão se abrindo, se as romãzeiras já estão brotando; ali te darei os meus amores.
verses.RVR09: Levantémonos de mañana á las viñas; veamos si brotan las vides, si se abre el cierne, si han florecido los granados; allí te daré mis amores.

verses.KJV: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
verses.WEB: The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.
verses.ASV: The mandrakes give forth fragrance; And at our doors are all manner of precious fruits, new and old, Which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
verses.ALMEIDA: As mandrágoras espalham seu perfume, e junto a nossas portas há todo tipo de excelentes frutos, novos e velhos; eu os guardei para ti, meu amado.
verses.RVR09: Las mandrágoras han dado olor, y á nuestras puertas hay toda suerte de dulces frutas, nuevas y añejas, que para ti, oh amado mío, he guardado.

verses.KJV: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
verses.WEB: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.
verses.ASV: Oh that thou wert as my brother, That sucked the breasts of my mother! [When] I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; Yea, and none would despise me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como gostaria que tu fosses como meu irmão, que mamava os seios de minha mãe. Quando eu te achasse na rua, eu te beijaria, e não me desprezariam.
verses.RVR09: ¡OH quién te me diese como hermano que mamó los pechos de mi madre; de modo que te halle yo fuera, y te bese, y no me menosprecien!

verses.KJV: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.WEB: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.ASV: I would lead thee, [and] bring thee into my mother’s house, Who would instruct me; I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine, Of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te levaria e te traria à casa de minha mãe, aquela que me ensinou, e te daria a beber do vinho aromático, do suco de minhas romãs.
verses.RVR09: Yo te llevaría, te metiera en casa de mi madre: tú me enseñarías, y yo te hiciera beber vino adobado del mosto de mis granadas.

verses.KJV: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
verses.WEB: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.
verses.ASV: His left hand [should be] under my head, And his right hand should embrace me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esteja sua mão esquerda debaixo de minha cabeça, e sua direita me abrace.
verses.RVR09: Su izquierda esté debajo de mi cabeza, y su derecha me abrace.

verses.KJV: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
verses.WEB: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
verses.ASV: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, That ye stir not up, nor awake [my] love, Until he please.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos ordeno, filhas de Jerusalém: jurai que não acordeis, nem desperteis ao amor, até que ele queira.
verses.RVR09: Conjúroos, oh doncellas de Jerusalem, que no despertéis, ni hagáis velar al amor, hasta que quiera.

verses.KJV: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
verses.WEB: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.
verses.ASV: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, Leaning upon her beloved? Under the apple-tree I awakened thee: There thy mother was in travail with thee, There was she in travail that brought thee forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Outros] : Quem é esta, que sobe da terra desabitada, reclinada sobre seu amado? [Ela] : Debaixo de uma macieira te despertei; ali tua mãe te teve com dores; ali te deu à luz aquela que te gerou.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién es ésta que sube del desierto, recostada sobre su amado? Debajo de un manzano te desperté: allí tuvo tu madre dolores, allí tuvo dolores la que te parió.

verses.KJV: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
verses.WEB: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.
verses.ASV: Set me as a seal upon thy heart, As a seal upon thine arm: For love is strong as death; Jealousy is cruel as Sheol; The flashes thereof are flashes of fire, A very flame of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Põe-me como selo sobre o teu coração, como selo sobre o teu braço; porque o amor é forte como a morte, e o ciúme é severo como o Xeol; suas brasas são brasas de fogo, labaredas intensas.
verses.RVR09: Ponme como un sello sobre tu corazón, como una marca sobre tu brazo: porque fuerte es como la muerte el amor; duro como el sepulcro el celo: sus brasas, brasas de fuego, fuerte llama.

verses.KJV: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
verses.WEB: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
verses.ASV: Many waters cannot quench love, Neither can floods drown it: If a man would give all the substance of his house for love, He would utterly be contemned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Muitas águas não poderiam apagar este amor, nem os rios afogá-lo; ainda que alguém desse todos os bens de sua casa por este amor, certamente o desprezariam.
verses.RVR09: Las muchas aguas no podrán apagar el amor, ni lo ahogarán los ríos. Si diese el hombre toda la hacienda de su casa por este amor, de cierto lo menospreciaran.

verses.KJV: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
verses.WEB: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?
verses.ASV: We have a little sister, And she hath no breasts: What shall we do for our sister In the day when she shall be spoken for?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Irmãos dela] : Temos uma irmã pequena, que ainda não têm seios; que faremos a esta nossa irmã, no dia que dela falarem?
verses.RVR09: Tenemos una pequeña hermana, que no tiene pechos: ¿qué haremos á nuestra hermana cuando de ella se hablare?

verses.KJV: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.WEB: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.ASV: If she be a wall, We will build upon her a turret of silver: And if she be a door, We will inclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ela for um muro, edificaremos sobre ela um palácio de prata; e se ela for uma porta, então a cercaremos com tábuas de cedro.
verses.RVR09: Si ella es muro, edificaremos sobre él un palacio de plata: y si fuere puerta, la guarneceremos con tablas de cedro.

verses.KJV: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
verses.WEB: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.
verses.ASV: I am a wall, and my breasts like the towers [thereof]: Then was I in his eyes as one that found peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ela] : Eu sou um muro, e meus seios como torres; então eu era aos olhos dele, como aquela que encontra a paz.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy muro, y mis pechos como torres, desde que fuí en sus ojos como la que halla paz.

verses.KJV: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
verses.WEB: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
verses.ASV: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; He let out the vineyard unto keepers; Every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand [pieces] of silver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Salomão teve uma vinha em Baal-Hamom; ele entregou esta vinha a uns guardas, e cada um [lhe] trazia como [faturamento] de seus frutos mil [moedas] de prata.
verses.RVR09: Salomón tuvo una viña en Baal-hamón, la cual entregó á guardas, cada uno de los cuales debía traer mil monedas de plata por su fruto.

verses.KJV: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
verses.WEB: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
verses.ASV: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: Thou, O Solomon, shalt have the thousand, And those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha vinha, que me pertence, está à minha disposição; as mil [moedas] de prata são para ti, Salomão, e duzentas para os guardas de teu fruto.
verses.RVR09: Mi viña, que es mía, está delante de mí: las mil serán tuyas, oh Salomón, y doscientas, de los que guardan su fruto.

verses.KJV: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
verses.WEB: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!
verses.ASV: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, The companions hearken for thy voice: Cause me to hear it.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ele] : Ó tu que habitas nos jardins, teus colegas prestam atenção à tua voz: faze com que eu [também possa] ouvi-la.
verses.RVR09: Oh tú la que moras en los huertos, los compañeros escuchan tu voz: házmela oir.

verses.KJV: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
verses.WEB: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
verses.ASV: Make haste, my beloved, And be thou like to a roe or to a young hart Upon the mountains of spices.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ela] : Vem depressa, meu amado! E faze-te semelhante ao corço, ao filhote de cervos, nas montanhas de ervas aromáticas!
verses.RVR09: Huye, amado mío; y sé semejante al gamo, ó al cervatillo, sobre las montañas de los aromas.

verses.KJV: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.WEB: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.ASV: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Visão de Isaías, filho de Amoz, a qual ele viu sobre Judá e Jerusalém, nos dias de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz [e] Ezequias, reis de Judá.
verses.RVR09: VISIÓN de Isaías hijo de Amoz, la cual vió sobre Judá y Jerusalem, en días de Uzzías, Jotham, Achâz y Ezechîas, reyes de Judá.

verses.KJV: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the Lord hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.WEB: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for the LORD has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.
verses.ASV: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth; for Jehovah hath spoken: I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi, ó céus; e escutai tu, terra, porque o SENHOR está falando: Eu criei filhos, e os fiz crescerem; porém eles se rebelaram contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Oid, cielos, y escucha tú, tierra; porque habla Jehová: Crié hijos, y engrandecílos, y ellos se rebelaron contra mí.

verses.KJV: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verses.WEB: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”
verses.ASV: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib; [but] Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verses.ALMEIDA: O boi conhece a seu dono, e o jumento [sabe] a manjedoura de seu possuidor; [mas] Israel não conhece, meu povo não entende.
verses.RVR09: El buey conoce á su dueño, y el asno el pesebre de su señor: Israel no conoce, mi pueblo no tiene entendimiento.

verses.KJV: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
verses.WEB: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.
verses.ASV: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evil-doers, children that deal corruptly! they have forsaken Jehovah, they have despised the Holy One of Israel, they are estranged [and gone] backward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai da nação pecadora, do povo cheio de perversidade, semente de malfeitores, de filhos corruptos! Abandonaram ao SENHOR, provocaram a ira ao Santo de Israel, [dele] se afastaram.
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh gente pecadora, pueblo cargado de maldad, generación de malignos, hijos depravados! Dejaron á Jehová, provocaron á ira al Santo de Israel, tornáronse atrás.

verses.KJV: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.WEB: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.ASV: Why will ye be still stricken, that ye revolt more and more? the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que seríeis espancados ainda mais? Vós vos rebelaríeis mais ainda. Toda a cabeça está enferma, e todo o coração fraco.
verses.RVR09: ¿Para qué habéis de ser castigados aún? todavía os rebelaréis. Toda cabeza está enferma, y todo corazón doliente.

verses.KJV: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verses.WEB: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.
verses.ASV: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; [but] wounds, and bruises, and fresh stripes: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde a planta do pé até a cabeça, não há nele coisa sã. [Só há] feridas, inchaços e chagas podres, sem terem sido espremidas, feito curativos ou aliviadas com azeite.
verses.RVR09: Desde la planta del pie hasta la cabeza no hay en él cosa ilesa, sino herida, hinchazón y podrida llaga: no están curadas, ni vendadas, ni suavizadas con aceite.

verses.KJV: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.WEB: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.ASV: Your country is desolate; your cities are burned with fire; your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vossa terra é uma ruína; vossas cidades foram queimadas; vossa terra os estranhos devastaram diante de vossa presença, e está arruinada como que destruída por estranhos.
verses.RVR09: Vuestra tierra está destruída, vuestras ciudades puestas á fuego, vuestra tierra delante de vosotros comida de extranjeros, y asolada como asolamiento de extraños.

verses.KJV: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
verses.WEB: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.
verses.ASV: And the daughter of Zion is left as a booth in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a filha de Sião ficou como uma cabana na vinha, como um barraco no pepinal, como uma cidade cercada.
verses.RVR09: Y queda la hija de Sión como choza en viña, y como cabaña en melonar, como ciudad asolada.

verses.KJV: Except the Lord of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.WEB: Unless the LORD of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.
verses.ASV: Except Jehovah of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o SENHOR dos exércitos não tivesse nos deixado alguns sobreviventes, teríamos sido como Sodoma, seríamos semelhantes aos de Gomorra.
verses.RVR09: Si Jehová de los ejércitos no hubiera hecho que nos quedasen muy cortos residuos, como Sodoma fuéramos, y semejantes á Gomorra.

verses.KJV: Hear the word of the Lord, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
verses.WEB: Hear the LORD’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
verses.ASV: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, vós líderes de Sodoma! Ouvi a Lei do nosso Deus, vós povo de Gomorra!:
verses.RVR09: Príncipes de Sodoma, oid la palabra de Jehová; escuchad la ley de nuestro Dios, pueblo de Gomorra.

verses.KJV: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the Lord: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
verses.WEB: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says the LORD. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.
verses.ASV: What unto me is the multitude of your sacrifices? saith Jehovah: I have had enough of the burnt-offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he-goats.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que me [serve] tantos sacrifícios vossos?,diz o SENHOR; Já estou farto de sacrifícios de queima de carneiros, e da gordura de animais cevados. Não me alegro com o sangue de bezerros, nem com o de cordeiros ou bodes.
verses.RVR09: ¿Para qué á mí, dice Jehová, la multitud de vuestros sacrificios? Harto estoy de holocaustos de carneros, y de sebo de animales gruesos: no quiero sangre de bueyes, ni de ovejas, ni de machos cabríos.

verses.KJV: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
verses.WEB: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?
verses.ASV: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to trample my courts?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando vindes a aparecer perante minha face, quem vos pediu isso de vossas mãos, de pisardes em meus pátios?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién demandó esto de vuestras manos, cuando vinieseis á presentaros delante de mí, para hollar mis atrios?

verses.KJV: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
verses.WEB: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.
verses.ASV: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; new moon and sabbath, the calling of assemblies,—I cannot away with iniquity and the solemn meeting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não tragais mais ofertas inúteis; [vosso] incenso para mim é abominação; não aguento [mais] as luas novas, os sábados, e as chamadas para o povo se reunir; [todas estas] se tornaram reuniões malignas.
verses.RVR09: No me traigáis más vano presente: el perfume me es abominación: luna nueva y sábado, el convocar asambleas, no las puedo sufrir: son iniquidad vuestras solemnidades.

verses.KJV: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
verses.WEB: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.
verses.ASV: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth; they are a trouble unto me; I am weary of bearing them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vossas luas novas e vossas solenidades, minha alma as odeia e elas me perturbam; estou cansado de [as] suportar.
verses.RVR09: Vuestras lunas nuevas y vuestras solemnidades tiene aborrecidas mi alma: me son gravosas; cansado estoy de llevarlas.

verses.KJV: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
verses.WEB: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.
verses.ASV: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you; yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso quando estendeis vossas mãos, escondo meus olhos de vós; até quando fazeis muitas orações, eu não [vos] ouço; [porque] vossas mãos estão cheias de sangue.
verses.RVR09: Cuando extendiereis vuestras manos, yo esconderé de vosotros mis ojos: asimismo cuando multiplicareis la oración, yo no oiré: llenas están de sangre vuestras manos.

verses.KJV: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
verses.WEB: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
verses.ASV: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
verses.ALMEIDA: Lavai-vos! Purificai-vos! Tirai a maldade de vossas atitudes perante meus olhos; parai de fazer maldades.
verses.RVR09: Lavad, limpiaos; quitad la iniquidad de vuestras obras de ante mis ojos; dejad de hacer lo malo:

verses.KJV: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.WEB: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
verses.ASV: learn to do well; seek justice, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aprendei a fazer o bem; procurai o que é justo; ajudai ao oprimido; fazei justiça ao órfão; defendei a causa da viúva.
verses.RVR09: Aprended á hacer bien; buscad juicio, restituid al agraviado, oid en derecho al huérfano, amparad á la viuda.

verses.KJV: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.WEB: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.ASV: Come now, and let us reason together, saith Jehovah: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vinde, então, e façamos as contas,diz o SENHOR: ainda que vossos pecados sejam como a escarlate, eles ficarão brancos como a neve; ainda que sejam vermelhos como o carmesim, eles se tornarão como a lã.
verses.RVR09: Venid luego, dirá Jehová, y estemos á cuenta: si vuestros pecados fueren como la grana, como la nieve serán emblanquecidos: si fueren rojos como el carmesí, vendrán á ser como blanca lana.

verses.KJV: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
verses.WEB: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
verses.ASV: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se quiserdes e ouvirdes, comereis o que é bom da terra.
verses.RVR09: Si quisiereis y oyereis, comeréis el bien de la tierra:

verses.KJV: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.”
verses.ASV: but if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se recusardes e fordes rebeldes, sereis devorados pela espada;pois [foi assim que] a boca do SENHOR falou.
verses.RVR09: Si no quisiereis y fuereis rebeldes, seréis consumidos á espada: porque la boca de Jehová lo ha dicho.

verses.KJV: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
verses.WEB: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.
verses.ASV: How is the faithful city become a harlot! she that was full of justice! righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como a cidade fiel se tornou uma prostituta! Ela estava cheia de juízo, justiça habitava nela; porém agora homicidas.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo te has tornado ramera, oh ciudad fiel? Llena estuvo de juicio, en ella habitó equidad; mas ahora, homicidas.

verses.KJV: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
verses.WEB: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.
verses.ASV: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua prata se tornou em escórias; teu vinho se misturou com água.
verses.RVR09: Tu plata se ha tornado escorias, tu vino mezclado está con agua.

verses.KJV: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.WEB: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t defend the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.
verses.ASV: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves; every one loveth bribes, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus príncipes são rebeldes, e companheiros de ladrões; cada um deles ama os subornos, e perseguem recompensas; não fazem justiça ao órfão, e não chega perante eles a causa das viúvas.
verses.RVR09: Tus príncipes, prevaricadores y compañeros de ladrones: todos aman las dádivas, y van tras las recompensas: no oyen en juicio al huérfano, ni llega á ellos la causa de la viuda.

verses.KJV: Therefore saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies.
verses.ASV: Therefore saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso diz o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos, o Poderoso de Israel: Ah, tomarei satisfações quanto aos meus adversários, e me vingarei de meus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, dice el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos, el Fuerte de Israel: Ea, tomaré satisfacción de mis enemigos, vengaréme de mis adversarios:

verses.KJV: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
verses.WEB: I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.
verses.ASV: and I will turn my hand upon thee, and thoroughly purge away thy dross, and will take away all thy tin;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tornarei minha minha mão contra ti, e purificarei por completo tuas escórias; e tirarei toda a tua impureza.
verses.RVR09: Y volveré mi mano sobre ti, y limpiaré hasta lo más puro tus escorias, y quitaré todo tu estaño:

verses.KJV: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
verses.WEB: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’
verses.ASV: and I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called The city of righteousness, a faithful town.
verses.ALMEIDA: E restituirei a teus juízes, como da primeira vez, e a teus conselheiros, como no princípio; e depois disso te chamarão cidade da justiça, cidade fiel.
verses.RVR09: Y restituiré tus jueces como al principio, y tus consejeros como de primero: entonces te llamarán Ciudad de justicia, Ciudad fiel.

verses.KJV: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.WEB: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.ASV: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sião será resgatada por meio do juízo; e os que retornarem a ela, por meio da justiça.
verses.RVR09: Sión con juicio será rescatada, y los convertidos de ella con justicia.

verses.KJV: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the Lord shall be consumed.
verses.WEB: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
verses.ASV: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Jehovah shall be consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas para os transgressores e pecadores, serão juntamente quebrados; e os que deixarem ao SENHOR serão consumidos.
verses.RVR09: Mas los rebeldes y pecadores á una serán quebrantados, y los que dejan á Jehová serán consumidos.

verses.KJV: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
verses.WEB: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
verses.ASV: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pelos carvalhos que cobiçastes serão confundidos; e pelos bosques que escolhestes sereis envergonhados;
verses.RVR09: Entonces os avergonzarán los olmos que amasteis, y os afrentarán los bosques que escogisteis.

verses.KJV: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
verses.WEB: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.
verses.ASV: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque sereis como o carvalho ao qual suas folhas caem, e como o bosque que não tem água.
verses.RVR09: Porque seréis como el olmo que se le cae la hoja, y como huerto que le faltan las aguas.

verses.KJV: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
verses.WEB: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”
verses.ASV: And the strong shall be as tow, and his work as a spark; and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o forte se tornará em estopa, e sua obra, em faísca; e ambos serão juntamente queimados, e não haverá quem [os] apague.
verses.RVR09: Y el fuerte será como estopa, y lo que hizo como centella; y ambos serán encendidos juntamente, y no habrá quien apague.

verses.KJV: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra vista por Isaías, filho de Amoz, quanto a Judá e a Jerusalém:
verses.RVR09: LO que vió Isaías, hijo de Amoz, tocante á Judá y á Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.WEB: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in the latter days, that the mountain of Jehovah’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecerá no últimos dias, que o monte da cada do SENHOR se firmará no cume dos montes, e se levantará por cima dos morros; e correrão em direção a ele todas as nações.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá en lo postrero de los tiempos, que será confirmado el monte de la casa de Jehová por cabeza de los montes, y será ensalzado sobre los collados, y correrán á él todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And many peoples shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos povos irão, e dirão: Vinde, subamos ao monte do SENHOR, à casa do Deus de Jacó, para que ele nos ensine sobre seus caminhos, e andemos em suas veredas; Porque de Sião virá a Lei, e de Jerusalém a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán muchos pueblos, y dirán: Venid, y subamos al monte de Jehová, á la casa del Dios de Jacob; y nos enseñará en sus caminos, y caminaremos por sus sendas. Porque de Sión saldrá la ley, y de Jerusalem la palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.WEB: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.ASV: And he will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning-hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele julgará entre as nações, e repreenderá a muitos povos; e trocarão suas espadas em enxadas, e suas lanças em foices; não se levantará mais espada nação contra nação, nem aprenderão mais a fazer guerra.
verses.RVR09: Y juzgará entre las gentes, y reprenderá á muchos pueblos; y volverán sus espadas en rejas de arado, y sus lanzas en hoces: no alzará espada gente contra gente, ni se ensayarán más para la guerra.

verses.KJV: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.
verses.WEB: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of the LORD.
verses.ASV: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Casa de Jacó, vinde, e andemos à luz do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Venid, oh casa de Jacob, y caminemos á la luz de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
verses.WEB: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.
verses.ASV: For thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they are filled [with customs] from the east, and [are] soothsayers like the Philistines, and they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tu, [SENHOR] , desamparaste a teu povo, à casa de Jacó; porque se encheram [dos costumes] do oriente, e são místicos como os filisteus; e se associam a filhos de estrangeiros.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente tú has dejado tu pueblo, la casa de Jacob, porque son henchidos de oriente, y de agoreros, como los Filisteos; y en hijos ajenos descansan.

verses.KJV: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
verses.WEB: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
verses.ASV: And their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra deles está cheia de prata e de ouro, e os tesouros deles não têm fim; a terra deles está cheia de cavalos, e as carruagens deles não têm fim.
verses.RVR09: Su tierra está llena de plata y oro, sus tesoros no tienen fin. También está su tierra llena de caballos; ni sus carros tienen número.

verses.KJV: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
verses.WEB: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
verses.ASV: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra deles também está cheia de ídolos; eles se inclinam perante as obras de suas próprias mãos, perante o que seus próprios dedos fizeram.
verses.RVR09: Además está su tierra llena de ídolos, y á la obra de sus manos se han arrodillado, á lo que fabricaron sus dedos.

verses.KJV: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
verses.WEB: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.
verses.ASV: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is brought low: therefore forgive them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali as pessoas se abatem, e os homens se humilham; por isso tu não os perdoarás.
verses.RVR09: Y hase inclinado el hombre, y el varón se ha humillado: por tanto no los perdonarás.

verses.KJV: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.WEB: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty.
verses.ASV: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entra nas rochas, e esconde-te no pó, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e da glória de sua majestade.
verses.RVR09: Métete en la piedra, escóndete en el polvo, de la presencia espantosa de Jehová y del resplandor de su majestad.

verses.KJV: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.WEB: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
verses.ASV: The lofty looks of man shall be brought low, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os olhos arrogantes dos homens serão abatidos, e o orgulho dos homens será humilhado; e só o SENHOR será exaltado naquele dia.
verses.RVR09: La altivez de los ojos del hombre será abatida, y la soberbia de los hombres será humillada; y Jehová solo será ensalzado en aquel día.

verses.KJV: For the day of the Lord of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
verses.WEB: For there will be a day of the LORD of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—
verses.ASV: For there shall be a day of Jehovah of hosts upon all that is proud and haughty, and upon all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o dia do SENHOR dos exércitos será contra o soberbo e o arrogante; e contra todo de que [se acha] exaltado, para que seja abatido.
verses.RVR09: Porque día de Jehová de los ejércitos vendrá sobre todo soberbio y altivo, y sobre todo ensalzado; y será abatido:

verses.KJV: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.WEB: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.ASV: and upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.ALMEIDA: E contra todos os cedros do Líbano, altos e elevados; e contra todos os carvalhos de Basã.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre todos los cedros del Líbano altos y sublimes, y sobre todos los alcornoques de Basán;

verses.KJV: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.WEB: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.ASV: and upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.ALMEIDA: E contra todos os altos montes, e contra todos os morros elevados.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre todos los montes altos, y sobre todos los collados levantados;

verses.KJV: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
verses.WEB: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,
verses.ASV: and upon every lofty tower, and upon every fortified wall,
verses.ALMEIDA: E contra toda torre alta, e contra todo muro fortificado.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre toda torre alta, y sobre todo muro fuerte;

verses.KJV: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
verses.WEB: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.
verses.ASV: and upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant imagery.
verses.ALMEIDA: E contra todos os navios de Társis, e contra todas as pinturas desejadas.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre todas las naves de Tarsis, y sobre todas pinturas preciadas.

verses.KJV: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.WEB: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.ASV: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a soberba do homem será humilhada, e o orgulho dos homens será abatido; e só o SENHOR será exaltado naquele dia.
verses.RVR09: Y la altivez del hombre será abatida, y la soberbia de los hombres será humillada; y solo Jehová será ensalzado en aquel día.

verses.KJV: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
verses.WEB: The idols shall utterly pass away.
verses.ASV: And the idols shall utterly pass away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os ídolos serão eliminados por completo.
verses.RVR09: Y quitará totalmente los ídolos.

verses.KJV: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.WEB: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
verses.ASV: And men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então entrarão nas cavernas das rochas, e nos buracos da terra, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e por causa de sua majestade, quando ele se levantar, para espantar a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y meteránse en las cavernas de las peñas, y en las aberturas de la tierra, por la presencia espantosa de Jehová, y por el resplandor de su majestad, cuando se levantare él para herir la tierra.

verses.KJV: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.WEB: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,
verses.ASV: In that day men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for them to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, o homem lançará seus ídolos de prata, e seus ídolos de ouro, que fizeram para se prostrarem diante deles, às toupeiras e aos morcegos.
verses.RVR09: Aquel día arrojará el hombre, á los topos y murciélagos, sus ídolos de plata y sus ídolos de oro, que le hicieron para que adorase;

verses.KJV: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.WEB: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
verses.ASV: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se porão nas fendas das rochas, e nas cavernas das penhas, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e por causa da glória de sua majestade, quando ele se levantar para espantar a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y se entrarán en las hendiduras de las rocas y en las cavernas de las peñas, por la presencia formidable de Jehová, y por el resplandor de su majestad, cuando se levantare para herir la tierra.

verses.KJV: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
verses.WEB: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
verses.ASV: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for wherein is he to be accounted of?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Portanto,] cessai de [confiar no] homem, cujo fôlego está em suas narinas; pois o que há nele que mereça se dar algum valor?
verses.RVR09: Dejaos del hombre, cuyo hálito está en su nariz; porque ¿de qué es él estimado?

verses.KJV: For, behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water.
verses.WEB: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;
verses.ASV: For, behold, the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah stay and staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos tirará de Jerusalém e de Judá o apoio e o sustento: todas as fontes de comida e de água,
verses.RVR09: PORQUE he aquí que el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos quita de Jerusalem y de Judá el sustentador y el fuerte, todo sustento de pan y todo socorro de agua;

verses.KJV: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
verses.WEB: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,
verses.ASV: the mighty man, and the man of war; the judge, and the prophet, and the diviner, and the elder;
verses.ALMEIDA: O guerreiro, o soldado, o juiz, o profeta, o adivinho, e o ancião;
verses.RVR09: El valiente y el hombre de guerra, el juez y el profeta, el adivino y el anciano;

verses.KJV: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
verses.WEB: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.
verses.ASV: the captain of fifty, and the honorable man, and the counsellor, and the expert artificer, and the skilful enchanter.
verses.ALMEIDA: O chefe de cinquenta, o nobre, o conselheiro, o sábio entre os artífices, e o que tem habilidade de falar palavras.
verses.RVR09: El capitán de cincuenta, y el hombre de respeto, y el consejero, y el artífice excelente, y el hábil orador.

verses.KJV: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
verses.WEB: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.
verses.ASV: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [lhes] darei garotos como seus príncipes, e rapazes dominarão sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y pondréles mozos por príncipes, y muchachos serán sus señores.

verses.KJV: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
verses.WEB: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.
verses.ASV: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbor: the child shall behave himself proudly against the old man, and the base against the honorable.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo será oprimido; um será contra o outro, e cada um contra seu próximo; o jovem se atreverá contra o ancião, e o reles contra o nobre.
verses.RVR09: Y el pueblo hará violencia los unos á los otros, cada cual contra su vecino: el mozo se levantará contra el viejo, y el villano contra el noble.

verses.KJV: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
verses.WEB: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”
verses.ASV: When a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, [saying], Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque um homem tomará seu irmão da casa de seu pai, [e dirá] : Tu tens capa; sê nosso governante, e estejam estas ruínas debaixo de tua mão.
verses.RVR09: Cuando alguno trabare de su hermano, de la familia de su padre, y le dijere, Que vestir tienes, tú serás nuestro príncipe, y sea en tu mano esta ruina;

verses.KJV: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
verses.WEB: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”
verses.ASV: in that day shall he lift up [his voice], saying, I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: ye shall not make me ruler of the people.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Então] em tal dia ele levantará sua mão, dizendo: Não posso solucionar este problema; também em minha casa não há pão nem vestido algum; não me ponhais como governante do povo.
verses.RVR09: El jurará aquel día, diciendo: No tomaré ese cuidado; porque en mi casa ni hay pan, ni qué vestir: no me hagáis príncipe del pueblo.

verses.KJV: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the Lord, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
verses.WEB: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
verses.ASV: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Jehovah, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque Jerusalém tropeçou, e Judá está caído; pois sua língua e suas obras são contra o SENHOR, para irritar os seus gloriosos olhos.
verses.RVR09: Pues arruinada está Jerusalem, y Judá ha caído; porque la lengua de ellos y sus obras han sido contra Jehová, para irritar los ojos de su majestad.

verses.KJV: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
verses.WEB: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.
verses.ASV: The show of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have done evil unto themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: A aparência de seus rostos dão testemunho contra eles, e mostram abertamente seus pecados; assim como Sodoma, não os disfarçam. Ai da alma deles, porque estão fazendo mal a si mesmos.
verses.RVR09: La apariencia del rostro de ellos los convence: que como Sodoma predican su pecado, no lo disimulan. ¡Ay del alma de ellos! porque allegaron mal para sí.

verses.KJV: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.WEB: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.
verses.ASV: Say ye of the righteous, that [it shall be] well [with him]; for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizei a justo, que o bem [lhe sucederá] ,que comerão do fruto de suas obras.
verses.RVR09: Decid al justo que le irá bien: porque comerá de los frutos de sus manos.

verses.KJV: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
verses.WEB: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.
verses.ASV: Woe unto the wicked! [it shall be] ill [with him]; for what his hands have done shall be done unto him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai do perverso! O mal [lhe sucederá] ,porque lhe será feito conforme o trabalho de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del impío! mal le irá: porque según las obras de sus manos le será pagado.

verses.KJV: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
verses.WEB: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.
verses.ASV: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they that lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os dominadores de meu povo são garotos, e mulheres dominam sobre ele; ah, meu povo, os que te guiam te enganam e confundem o caminho de tuas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Los exactores de mi pueblo son muchachos, y mujeres se enseñorearon de él. Pueblo mío, los que te guían te engañan, y tuercen la carrera de tus caminos.

verses.KJV: The Lord standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
verses.WEB: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.
verses.ASV: Jehovah standeth up to contend, and standeth to judge the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR se apresenta para brigar a causa judicial, e se põe para julgar aos povos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová está en pie para litigar, y está para juzgar los pueblos.

verses.KJV: The Lord will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
verses.WEB: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will enter into judgment with the elders of his people, and the princes thereof: It is ye that have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses:
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR vem a juízo contra os anciãos de seu povo, e [contra] seus líderes: Pois vós consumistes a vinha, o despojo do pobre está em vossas casas.
verses.RVR09: Jehová vendrá á juicio contra los ancianos de su pueblo y contra sus príncipes; porque vosotros habéis devorado la viña, y el despojo del pobre está en vuestras casas.

verses.KJV: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord God of hosts.
verses.WEB: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
verses.ASV: what mean ye that ye crush my people, and grind the face of the poor? saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que vós esmagastes ao meu povo, e moestes o rosto dos pobres?,diz o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pensáis vosotros que majáis mi pueblo, y moléis las caras de los pobres? dice el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Moreover the Lord saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;
verses.ASV: Moreover Jehovah said, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet;
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disso o SENHOR diz: Dado que as filhas de Sião se exaltam, e andam com o pescoço levantado, e [procuram] seduzir com os olhos, e vão andando a passos curtos, fazendo ruídos com os ornamentos dos pés,
verses.RVR09: Asimismo dice Jehová: Por cuanto las hijas de Sión se ensoberbecen, y andan cuellierguidas y los ojos descompuestos; cuando andan van danzando, y haciendo son con los pies:

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will discover their secret parts.
verses.WEB: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”
verses.ASV: therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and Jehovah will lay bare their secret parts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o Senhor fará chagas no topo das cabeças das filhas de Sião, e descobrirá suas partes íntimas.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, pelará el Señor la mollera de las hijas de Sión, y Jehová descubrirá sus vergüenzas.

verses.KJV: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
verses.WEB: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,
verses.ASV: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, and the cauls, and the crescents;
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia o Senhor tirará [delas] os enfeites: tornozeleiras, testeiras, gargantilhas,
verses.RVR09: Aquel día quitará el Señor el atavío de los calzados, y las redecillas, y las lunetas;

verses.KJV: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
verses.WEB: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,
verses.ASV: the pendants, and the bracelets, and the mufflers;
verses.ALMEIDA: Brincos, pulseiras, véus,
verses.RVR09: Los collares, y los joyeles, y los brazaletes;

verses.KJV: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
verses.WEB: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,
verses.ASV: the headtires, and the ankle chains, and the sashes, and the perfume-boxes, and the amulets;
verses.ALMEIDA: Chapéus, braceletes, cintos, bolsinhas de perfume, amuletos,
verses.RVR09: Las escofietas, y los atavíos de las piernas, los partidores del pelo, los pomitos de olor, y los zarcillos;

verses.KJV: The rings, and nose jewels,
verses.WEB: the signet rings, the nose rings,
verses.ASV: the rings, and the nose-jewels;
verses.ALMEIDA: Anéis, pingentes de nariz,
verses.RVR09: Los anillos, y los joyeles de las narices;

verses.KJV: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
verses.WEB: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,
verses.ASV: the festival robes, and the mantles, and the shawls, and the satchels;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vestidos de festa, mantas, capas, bolsas,
verses.RVR09: Las ropas de remuda, los mantoncillos, los velos, y los alfileres;

verses.KJV: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
verses.WEB: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.
verses.ASV: the hand-mirrors, and the fine linen, and the turbans, and the veils.
verses.ALMEIDA: Transparências, saias de linho, toucas e túnicas.
verses.RVR09: Los espejos, los pañizuelos, las gasas, y los tocados.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
verses.WEB: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet spices there shall be rottenness; and instead of a girdle, a rope; and instead of well set hair, baldness; and instead of a robe, a girding of sackcloth; branding instead of beauty.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, no lugar de aromas haverá fedor; e no lugar de cinto [haverá] corda; e no lugar de cabelos cacheados [haverá] calvície, e no lugar de roupa luxuosa [haverá] roupa de saco; e queimadura no lugar de beleza.
verses.RVR09: Y será que en lugar de los perfumes aromáticos vendrá hediondez; y desgarrón en lugar de cinta; y calvez en lugar de la compostura del cabello; y en lugar de faja ceñimiento de saco; y quemadura en vez de hermosura.

verses.KJV: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
verses.WEB: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.
verses.ASV: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus homens cairão à espada; teus guerreiros na batalha.
verses.RVR09: Tus varones caerán á cuchillo, y tu fuerza en la guerra.

verses.KJV: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
verses.WEB: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.
verses.ASV: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall be desolate and sit upon the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as portas delas gemerão, e chorarão; e ela, ficando desolada, se sentará no chão.
verses.RVR09: Sus puertas se entristecerán y enlutarán, y ella, desamparada, sentaráse en tierra.

verses.KJV: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
verses.WEB: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”
verses.ASV: And seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name; take thou away our reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sete mulheres tomarão um [mesmo] homem naquele dia, dizendo: Nós comeremos de nosso pão, e nos vestiremos de nossas roupas; [queremos] somente que teu nome seja posto sobre nós; livra-nos de nossa vergonha!
verses.RVR09: Y ECHARÁN mano de un hombre siete mujeres en aquel tiempo, diciendo: Nosotras comeremos de nuestro pan, y nos vestiremos de nuestras ropas; solamente sea llamado tu nombre sobre nosotras, quita nuestro oprobio.

verses.KJV: In that day shall the branch of the Lord be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
verses.WEB: In that day, the LORD’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.
verses.ASV: In that day shall the branch of Jehovah be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia o Renovo do SENHOR será belo e glorioso; e o fruto da terra de excelente valor, para os de Israel que escaparem [do perigo] .
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo el renuevo de Jehová será para hermosura y gloria, y el fruto de la tierra para grandeza y honra, á los librados de Israel.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
verses.WEB: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem;
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que aquele que continuar em Sião e aquele que for deixado em Jerusalém será chamado santo; todo aquele que em Jerusalém está escrito para a vida;
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá que el que quedare en Sión, y el que fuere dejado en Jerusalem, será llamado santo; todos los que en Jerusalem están escritos entre los vivientes;

verses.KJV: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
verses.WEB: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.
verses.ASV: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof, by the spirit of justice, and by the spirit of burning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando o Senhor lavar a imundícia das filhas de Sião, e limpar o sangue de Jerusalém do meio dela, com o espírito de juízo, e com o espírito de queima.
verses.RVR09: Cuando el Señor lavare las inmundicias de las hijas de Sión, y limpiare las sangres de Jerusalem de en medio de ella, con espíritu de juicio y con espíritu de ardimiento.

verses.KJV: And the Lord will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
verses.WEB: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will create over the whole habitation of mount Zion, and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory [shall be spread] a covering.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR criará sobre toda moradia do monte de Sião, e sobre seus ajuntamentos, uma nuvem de dia, e uma fumaça, e um brilho de fogo inflamado de noite; porque sobre toda glória haverá proteção.
verses.RVR09: Y criará Jehová sobre toda la morada del monte de Sión, y sobre los lugares de sus convocaciones, nube y oscuridad de día, y de noche resplandor de fuego que eche llamas: porque sobre toda gloria habrá cobertura.

verses.KJV: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the day time from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
verses.WEB: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
verses.ASV: And there shall be a pavilion for a shade in the day-time from the heat, and for a refuge and for a covert from storm and from rain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E haverá uma tenda para sombra contra o calor do dia, e para refúgio e abrigo contra a tempestade e contra a chuva.
verses.RVR09: Y habrá sombrajo para sombra contra el calor del día, para acogida y escondedero contra el turbión y contra el aguacero.

verses.KJV: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.WEB: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.
verses.ASV: Let me sing for my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved had a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora cantarei a meu amado o cântico de meu querido de sua vinha: meu amado tem uma vinha, em um morro fértil;
verses.RVR09: AHORA cantaré por mi amado el cantar de mi amado á su viña. Tenía mi amado una viña en un recuesto, lugar fértil.

verses.KJV: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.WEB: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
verses.ASV: and he digged it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also hewed out a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cercou, e limpou das pedras, e a plantou de excelentes videiras, e edificou no meio dela uma torre; e também fundou nela uma prensa de uvas; e esperava que desse uvas boas, porém deu uvas imprestáveis.
verses.RVR09: Habíala cercado, y despedregádola, y plantádola de vides escogidas: había edificado en medio de ella una torre, y también asentado un lagar en ella: y esperaba que llevase uvas, y llevó uvas silvestres.

verses.KJV: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.WEB: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.
verses.ASV: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora, ó moradores de Jerusalém, e vós homens de Judá? Julgai, eu vos peço, entre mim e minha vinha.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, vecinos de Jerusalem y varones de Judá, juzgad ahora entre mí y mi viña.

verses.KJV: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.WEB: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?
verses.ASV: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que mais podia ser feito à minha vinha, que eu não tenha já feito? Se eu esperava uvas boas, como, pois, veio dar uvas imprestáveis?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué más se había de hacer á mi viña, que yo no haya hecho en ella? ¿Cómo, esperando yo que llevase uvas, ha llevado uvas silvestres?

verses.KJV: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.WEB: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.
verses.ASV: And now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; I will break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso agora eu vos farei saber o que farei à minha vinha: tirarei sua cerca, para que sirva de pastagem; derrubarei seu muro, para que seja pisada;
verses.RVR09: Os mostraré pues ahora lo que haré yo á mi viña: Quitaréle su vallado, y será para ser consumida; aportillaré su cerca, y será para ser hollada;

verses.KJV: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.WEB: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”
verses.ASV: and I will lay it waste; it shall not be pruned nor hoed; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu a tornarei uma [terra] abandonada; não será podada, nem cavada; mas crescerão [nela] cardos e espinhos; e darei ordens às nuvens, para que não chovam chuva sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Haré que quede desierta; no será podada ni cavada, y crecerá el cardo y las espinas: y aun á las nubes mandaré que no derramen lluvia sobre ella.

verses.KJV: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.WEB: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.
verses.ASV: For the vineyard of Jehovah of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for justice, but, behold, oppression; for righteousness, but, behold, a cry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque a vinha do SENHOR dos exércitos é a casa de Israel, e os homens de Judá são suas plantas agradáveis; porém ele esperava juízo, e eis aqui opressão; [ele esperava] justiça, e eis aqui clamor.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente la viña de Jehová de los ejércitos es la casa de Israel, y los hombres de Judá planta suya deleitosa. Esperaba juicio, y he aquí vileza; justicia, y he aquí clamor.

verses.KJV: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
verses.WEB: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!
verses.ASV: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no room, and ye be made to dwell alone in the midst of the land!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que juntam uma casas, [e] acumulam propriedades de terra, até que não tenha sobrado mais lugar, para que somente vós fiqueis como moradores no meio da terra.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de los que juntan casa con casa, y allegan heredad á heredad hasta acabar el término! ¿Habitaréis vosotros solos en medio de la tierra?

verses.KJV: In mine ears said the Lord of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.WEB: In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.
verses.ASV: In mine ears [saith] Jehovah of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR dos exércitos [disse] aos meus ouvidos: Verdadeiramente muitas casas se tornarão desertas, [até] as grandes e valiosas ficarão sem moradores!
verses.RVR09: Ha llegado á mis oídos de parte de Jehová de los ejércitos, que las muchas casas han de quedar asoladas, sin morador las grandes y hermosas.

verses.KJV: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.WEB: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”
verses.ASV: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield [but] an ephah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dez jeiras de vinha darão [apenas] um bato; e um ômer de semente dará [apenas] um efa.
verses.RVR09: Y diez huebras de viña producirán un zaque, y treinta modios de simiente darán tres modios.

verses.KJV: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
verses.WEB: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!
verses.ASV: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that tarry late into the night, till wine inflame them!
