verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que se levantam cedo pela manhã, para buscarem bebida alcoólica, e continuam até a noite, [até que] o vinho os esquente.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de los que se levantan de mañana para seguir la embriaguez; que se están hasta la noche, hasta que el vino los enciende!

verses.KJV: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the Lord, neither consider the operation of his hands.
verses.WEB: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.
verses.ASV: And the harp and the lute, the tabret and the pipe, and wine, are [in] their feasts; but they regard not the work of Jehovah, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E harpas, liras, tamborins, gaitas e vinho há em seus banquetes; porém não olham para a obra do SENHOR, nem veem a obra de suas próprias mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y en sus banquetes hay arpas, vihuelas, tamboriles, flautas, y vino; y no miran la obra de Jehová, ni consideran la obra de sus manos.

verses.KJV: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.WEB: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.
verses.ASV: Therefore my people are gone into captivity for lack of knowledge; and their honorable men are famished, and their multitude are parched with thirst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meu povo será levado cativo, porque não tem conhecimento; seus nobres terão fome, e sua multidão se secará de sede.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto mi pueblo fué llevado cautivo, porque no tuvo ciencia: y su gloria pereció de hambre, y su multitud se secó de sed.

verses.KJV: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
verses.WEB: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.
verses.ASV: Therefore Sheol hath enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth among them, descend [into it].
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o Xeol alargou seu avidez, e sua boca se abriu tanto que não se pode medir, e [ali] descerão a nobreza e também a multidão, em meio a barulhos e com os que festejam.
verses.RVR09: Por eso ensanchó su interior el sepulcro, y sin medida extendió su boca; y allá descenderá la gloria de ellos, y su multitud, y su fausto, y el que en él se holgaba.

verses.KJV: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
verses.WEB: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
verses.ASV: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is humbled, and the eyes of the lofty are humbled:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então as pessoas serão rebaixadas, e os homens serão humilhados; e os olhos dos arrogantes se humilharão.
verses.RVR09: Y el hombre será humillado, y el varón será abatido, y bajados serán los ojos de los altivos.

verses.KJV: But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.WEB: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.
verses.ASV: but Jehovah of hosts is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR dos exércitos será exaltado com juízo; e Deus, o Santo, será santificado com justiça.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová de los ejércitos será ensalzado en juicio, y el Dios Santo será santificado con justicia.

verses.KJV: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
verses.WEB: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.
verses.ASV: Then shall the lambs feed as in their pasture, and the waste places of the fat ones shall wanderers eat.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os cordeiros pastarão como se fosse seus próprios pastos, e os estranhos comerão [do alimento proveniente] dos lugares abandonados dos ricos.
verses.RVR09: Y los corderos serán apacentados según su costumbre; y extraños comerán las gruesas desamparadas.

verses.KJV: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
verses.WEB: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,
verses.ASV: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and sin as it were with a cart rope;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que puxam perversidade com cordas de futilidade, e pelo pecado como que [com] cordas de carruagens!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de los que traen la iniquidad con cuerdas de vanidad, y el pecado como con coyundas de carreta,

verses.KJV: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
verses.WEB: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”
verses.ASV: that say, Let him make speed, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizem: Que ele se apresse, acelere sua obra, para que a vejamos; e aproxime-se e venha o conselho do Santo de Israel, para que possamos saber.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales dicen: Venga ya, apresúrese su obra, y veamos: acérquese, y venga el consejo del Santo de Israel, para que lo sepamos!

verses.KJV: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.WEB: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.ASV: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que chamam o mal de bem, e o bem de mal; que trocam as trevas pela luz, e a luz pelas trevas; e trocam o amargo pelo doce, e o doce pelo amargo!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de los que á lo malo dicen bueno, y á lo bueno malo; que hacen de la luz tinieblas, y de las tinieblas luz; que ponen lo amargo por dulce, y lo dulce por amargo!

verses.KJV: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.WEB: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.ASV: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos [que se acham] sábios aos seus próprios olhos, e prudentes para si mesmos!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de los sabios en sus ojos, y de los que son prudentes delante de sí mismos!

verses.KJV: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
verses.WEB: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;
verses.ASV: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos [que se acham] corajosos para beberem vinho, e homens fortes para misturarem bebida alcoólica!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de los que son valientes para beber vino, y hombres fuertes para mezclar bebida;

verses.KJV: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.WEB: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!
verses.ASV: that justify the wicked for a bribe, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ai d] os que inocentam o perverso por causa de suborno, e se desviam da justiça dos justos!
verses.RVR09: Los que dan por justo al impío por cohechos, y al justo quitan su justicia!

verses.KJV: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the Lord of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of the LORD of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: Therefore as the tongue of fire devoureth the stubble, and as the dry grass sinketh down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust; because they have rejected the law of Jehovah of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, como a língua de fogo consome a estopa, e a chama queima a palha, [assim] sua raiz será como podridão, e sua flor se desfará como o pó; pois rejeitaram a Lei do SENHOR dos exércitos, e desprezaram a palavra do Santo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, como la lengua del fuego consume las aristas, y la llama devora la paja, así será su raíz como pudrimiento, y su flor se desvanecerá como polvo: porque desecharon la ley de Jehová de los ejércitos, y abominaron la palabra del Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: Therefore is the anger of the Lord kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.
verses.ASV: Therefore is the anger of Jehovah kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them; and the mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso se acendeu a ira do SENHOR contra seu povo, e estendeu sua mão contra ele, e o feriu; e as montanhas tremeram, e seus cadáveres foram como lixo no meio das ruas; com tudo isto ele não retrocedeu sua ira; ao contrário, sua mão ainda está estendida.
verses.RVR09: Por esta causa se encendió el furor de Jehová contra su pueblo, y extendió contra él su mano, é hirióle; y se estremecieron los montes, y sus cadáveres fueron arrojados en medio de las calles. Con todo esto no ha cesado su furor, antes está su mano todavía extendida.

verses.KJV: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
verses.WEB: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.
verses.ASV: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss for them from the end of the earth; and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele levantará uma bandeira para as nações distantes, e lhes assoviará desde os confins da terra; e eis que virão com rapidez apressadamente.
verses.RVR09: Y alzará pendón á gentes de lejos, y silbará al que está en el cabo de la tierra; y he aquí que vendrá pronto y velozmente.

verses.KJV: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.WEB: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,
verses.ASV: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.ALMEIDA: Não haverá entre eles cansado ou quem tropece; ninguém cochilará, nem dormirá; nem se desatará o cinto de seus lombos, nem será arrebentada a tira de seus calçados.
verses.RVR09: No habrá entre ellos cansado, ni que vacile; ninguno se dormirá ni le tomará sueño; á ninguno se le desatará el cinto de los lomos, ni se le romperá la correa de sus zapatos.

verses.KJV: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
verses.WEB: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.
verses.ASV: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent; their horses’ hoofs shall be accounted as flint, and their wheels as a whirlwind:
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas flechas estarão afiadas, e todos os seus arcos prontos para atirar; os cascos de seus cavalos serão comparáveis a rochas, e as rodas [de suas carruagens] como redemoinhos de vento.
verses.RVR09: Sus saetas amoladas, y todos sus arcos entesados; las uñas de sus caballos parecerán como de pedernal, y las ruedas de sus carros como torbellino.

verses.KJV: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
verses.WEB: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.
verses.ASV: their roaring shall be like a lioness, they shall roar like young lions; yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and carry it away safe, and there shall be none to deliver.
verses.ALMEIDA: O rugido deles será como o de um leão feroz, e bramarão como filhotes de leão; e rugirão, e tomarão a presa, e a levarão, e não haverá quem [a] resgate.
verses.RVR09: Su bramido como de león; rugirá á manera de leoncillos, rechinará los dientes, y arrebatará la presa; la apañara, y nadie se la quitará.

verses.KJV: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
verses.WEB: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.
verses.ASV: And they shall roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold, darkness [and] distress; and the light is darkened in the clouds thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E bramarão contra ela naquele dia como o bramido do mar; então olharão para a terra, e eis que há trevas [e] aflição; e a luz se escurecerá em suas nuvens.
verses.RVR09: Y bramará sobre él en aquel día como bramido de la mar: entonces mirará hacia la tierra, y he aquí tinieblas de tribulación, y en sus cielos se oscurecerá la luz.

verses.KJV: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
verses.WEB: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
verses.ASV: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano em que o rei Uzias morreu, eu vi o Senhor sentado sobre um alto e elevado trono; e as bordas de seu manto enchiam o templo.
verses.RVR09: EN el año que murió el rey Uzzías vi yo al Señor sentado sobre un trono alto y sublime, y sus faldas henchían el templo.

verses.KJV: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verses.WEB: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
verses.ASV: Above him stood the seraphim: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Serafins estavam por cima dele, cada um tinha seis asas; com duas cobriam seus rostos, com duas cobriam seus pés, e com duas voavam.
verses.RVR09: Y encima de él estaban serafines: cada uno tenía seis alas; con dos cubrían sus rostros, y con dos cubrían sus pies, y con dos volaban.

verses.KJV: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
verses.WEB: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
verses.ASV: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Jehovah of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: E clamavam uns aos outros, dizendo: Santo! Santo! Santo é o SENHOR dos exércitos! Toda a terra está cheia de sua glória!
verses.RVR09: Y el uno al otro daba voces, diciendo: Santo, santo, santo, Jehová de los ejércitos: toda la tierra está llena de su gloria.

verses.KJV: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.WEB: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.ASV: And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as molduras das portas se moviam com a voz do que clamava; e a casa se encheu de fumaça.
verses.RVR09: Y los quiciales de las puertas se estremecieron con la voz del que clamaba, y la casa se hinchió de humo.

verses.KJV: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”
verses.ASV: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: Ai de mim, que vou perecer! Pois sou homem de lábios impuros, e moro no meio de um povo de lábios impuros, e meus olhos viram ao Rei, o SENHOR dos exércitos!
verses.RVR09: Entonces dije: ¡Ay de mí! que soy muerto; que siendo hombre inmundo de labios, y habitando en medio de pueblo que tiene labios inmundos, han visto mis ojos al Rey, Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
verses.WEB: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
verses.ASV: Then flew one of the seraphim unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém um dos serafins voou até mim, trazendo em sua mão uma brasa viva, [a qual] ele tinha tirado do altar com uma tenaz.
verses.RVR09: Y voló hacia mí uno de los serafines, teniendo en su mano un carbón encendido, tomado del altar con unas tenazas:

verses.KJV: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
verses.WEB: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
verses.ASV: and he touched my mouth with it, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin forgiven.
verses.ALMEIDA: E com ela tocou em minha boca, e disse: Eis que isto tocou em teus lábios; assim já foi afastada [de ti] tua culpa, e purificado estás de teu pecado.
verses.RVR09: Y tocando con él sobre mi boca, dijo: He aquí que esto tocó tus labios, y es quitada tu culpa, y limpio tu pecado.

verses.KJV: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
verses.WEB: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
verses.ASV: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here am I; send me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois disso ouvi a voz do Senhor, que dizia: A quem enviarei? E quem irá por nós? Então eu disse: Eis-me aqui! Envia-me!
verses.RVR09: Después oí la voz del Señor, que decía: ¿A quién enviaré, y quién nos irá? Entonces respondí yo: Heme aquí, envíame á mí.

verses.KJV: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
verses.WEB: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
verses.ASV: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele me disse: Vai, e diz a este povo: certamente ouvireis, mas não entendereis; certamente vereis, mas não percebereis.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Anda, y di á este pueblo: Oid bien, y no entendáis; ved por cierto, mas no comprendáis.

verses.KJV: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
verses.WEB: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”
verses.ASV: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze o coração deste povo se encher de gordura, e os ouvidos deles ficarem pesados, para que não vejam com seus olhos, nem ouçam com seus ouvidos, nem entendam com seus corações, e [assim] não se convertam, nem eu os cure.
verses.RVR09: Engruesa el corazón de aqueste pueblo, y agrava sus oídos, y ciega sus ojos; porque no vea con sus ojos, ni oiga con sus oídos, ni su corazón entienda, ni se convierta, y haya para él sanidad.

verses.KJV: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
verses.WEB: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,
verses.ASV: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until cities be waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land become utterly waste,
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Até quando, Senhor?E ele respondeu: Até que as cidades sejam devastadas, [e] não fique morador algum, nem homem algum nas casas, e a terra seja devastada por completo.
verses.RVR09: Y yo dije: ¿Hasta cuándo, Señor? Y respondió él: Hasta que las ciudades estén asoladas, y sin morador, ni hombre en las casas, y la tierra sea tornada en desierto;

verses.KJV: And the Lord have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
verses.WEB: and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.
verses.ASV: and Jehovah have removed men far away, and the forsaken places be many in the midst of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR removerá as pessoas [dela] ,e no meio da terra será grande o abandono.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que Jehová hubiere echado lejos los hombres, y multiplicare en medio de la tierra la desamparada.

verses.KJV: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
verses.WEB: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”
verses.ASV: And if there be yet a tenth in it, it also shall in turn be eaten up: as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remaineth, when they are felled; so the holy seed is the stock thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ainda a décima parte ficará nela, e voltará a ser consumida; [e] como uma grande árvore ou como o carvalho, em que depois de serem derrubados, [ainda] fica a base do tronco, [assim] a santa semente será a base dela.
verses.RVR09: Pues aun quedará en ella una décima parte, y volverá, bien que habrá sido asolada: como el olmo y como el alcornoque, de los cuales en la tala queda el tronco, así será el tronco de ella la simiente santa.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.WEB: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sucedeu, pois, nos dias de Acaz, filho de Jotão, filho de Uzias, rei de Judá, que, Rezim, rei da Síria, e Peca, filho de Remalias, rei de Israel, subiram a Jerusalém para fazerem guerra contra ela; mas não conseguiram vencer a batalha contra ela.
verses.RVR09: ACONTECIÓ en los días de Achâz hijo de Jotham, hijo de Uzzías, rey de Judá, que Rezín rey de Siria, y Peca hijo de Remalías, rey de Israel, subieron á Jerusalem para combatirla; mas no la pudieron tomar.

verses.KJV: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
verses.WEB: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
verses.ASV: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E avisaram à casa de Davi, dizendo: Os sírios se aliaram aos de Efraim. Então o coração dele se agitou, e também o coração de seu povo, tal como as árvores do bosque que se agitam com o vento.
verses.RVR09: Y vino la nueva á la casa de David, diciendo: Siria se ha confederado con Ephraim. Y estremeciósele el corazón, y el corazón de su pueblo, como se estremecen los árboles del monte á causa del viento.

verses.KJV: Then said the Lord unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shearjashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;
verses.WEB: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.
verses.ASV: Then said Jehovah unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, in the highway of the fuller’s field;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse a Isaías: Agora tu e teu filho Sear-Jasube, saí ao encontro de Acaz, ao final do aqueduto do tanque superior, na estrada do campo do lavandeiro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Jehová á Isaías: Sal ahora al encuentro de Achâz, tú, y Sear-jasub tu hijo, al cabo del conducto de la Pesquera de arriba, en el camino de la heredad del Lavador,

verses.KJV: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.WEB: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.ASV: and say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither let thy heart be faint, because of these two tails of smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize-lhe: Tem cuidado, mas fica calmo; não temas, nem desanime teu coração por causa dessas duas pontas fumegantes de lenha, por causa do ardor da ira de Rezim, dos sírios, e do filho de Remalias.
verses.RVR09: Y dile: Guarda, y repósate; no temas, ni se enternezca tu corazón á causa de estos dos cabos de tizón que humean, por el furor de la ira de Rezín y del Siro, y del hijo de Remalías.

verses.KJV: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
verses.WEB: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
verses.ASV: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have purposed evil against thee, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o sírio teve maligno conselho contra ti, com Efraim e [com] o filho de Remalias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Por haber acordado maligno consejo contra ti el Siro, con Ephraim y con el hijo de Remalías, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
verses.WEB: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”
verses.ASV: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set up a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vamos subir contra Judá, e o aflijamos, e o repartamos entre nós; e façamos reinar como rei no meio dele ao filho de Tabeal.
verses.RVR09: Vamos contra Judá, y la despertaremos, y la partiremos entre nosotros, y pondremos en medio de ella por rey al hijo de Tabeel:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.WEB: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
verses.ASV: thus saith the Lord Jehovah, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Isso não subsistirá, nem sucederá.
verses.RVR09: El Señor Jehová dice así: No subsistirá, ni será.

verses.KJV: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
verses.WEB: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.
verses.ASV: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a cabeça da Síria é Damasco, e o cabeça de Damasco Rezim; e dentro de sessenta e cinco anos Efraim será quebrado, e não será [mais] povo.
verses.RVR09: Porque la cabeza de Siria es Damasco, y la cabeza de Damasco, Rezín: y dentro de sesenta y cinco años Ephraim será quebrantado hasta dejar de ser pueblo.

verses.KJV: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
verses.WEB: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”
verses.ASV: and the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a cabeça de Efraim é Samaria, e o cabeça de Samaria é o filho de Remalias. Se não crerdes, não ficareis firmes.
verses.RVR09: Entretanto la cabeza de Ephraim es Samaria, y la cabeza de Samaria el hijo de Remalías. Si vosotros no creyereis, de cierto no permaneceréis.

verses.KJV: Moreover the Lord spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR continuou a falar a Acaz, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y habló más Jehová á Achâz, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Ask thee a sign of the Lord thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
verses.WEB: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
verses.ASV: Ask thee a sign of Jehovah thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pede para ti um sinal do SENHOR teu Deus; pede ou de baixo, das profundezas, ou de cima, das alturas.
verses.RVR09: Pide para ti señal de Jehová tu Dios, demandándola en lo profundo, ó arriba en lo alto.

verses.KJV: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the Lord.
verses.WEB: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”
verses.ASV: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Acaz disse: Não pedirei, nem porei teste ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y respondió Achâz: No pediré, y no tentaré á Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
verses.WEB: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?
verses.ASV: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David: Is it a small thing for you to weary men, that ye will weary my God also?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [Isaías] disse: Ouvi agora, ó casa de Davi: Achais pouco cansardes aos homens, para cansardes também [a paciência] do meu Deus?
verses.RVR09: Dijo entonces Isaías: Oid ahora, casa de David. ¿Os es poco el ser molestos á los hombres, sino que también lo seáis á mi Dios?

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.ASV: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o Senhor, ele mesmo, vos dará um sinal: eis que a virgem conceberá, e fará nascer um filho, e ela chamará seu nome Emanuel.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto el mismo Señor os dará señal: He aquí que la virgen concebirá, y parirá hijo, y llamará su nombre Emmanuel.

verses.KJV: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.WEB: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
verses.ASV: Butter and honey shall he eat, when he knoweth to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manteiga e mal ele comerá, pois saberá como rejeitar o mal e escolher o bem.
verses.RVR09: Comerá manteca y miel, para que sepa desechar lo malo y escoger lo bueno.

verses.KJV: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
verses.WEB: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
verses.ASV: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings thou abhorrest shall be forsaken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas antes que este menino saiba rejeitar o mal e escolher o bem, a terra da qual tendes pavor será desamparada de seus dois reis.
verses.RVR09: Porque antes que el niño sepa desechar lo malo y escoger lo bueno, la tierra que tú aborreces será dejada de sus dos reyes.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
verses.WEB: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah—[even] the king of Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR fará vir sobre ti, sobre o teu povo, e sobre a casa de teu pai, dias que nunca vieram, desde o dia em que Efraim se desviou de Judá, [quando vier] o rei da Assíria.
verses.RVR09: Jehová hará venir sobre ti, y sobre tu pueblo, y sobre la casa de tu padre, días cuales nunca vinieron desde el día que Ephraim se apartó de Judá, es á saber, al rey de Asiria.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque acontecerá que naquele dia o SENHOR assoviará às moscas que estão na extremidade dos rios do Egito, e às abelhas que andam na terra da Assíria.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá que aquel día silbará Jehová á la mosca que está en el fin de los ríos de Egipto, y á la abeja que está en la tierra de Asiria.

verses.KJV: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
verses.WEB: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.
verses.ASV: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the clefts of the rocks, and upon all thorn-hedges, and upon all pastures.
verses.ALMEIDA: E virão, e todas elas pousarão nos vales desabitados, e nas fendas das rochas, e em todos os espinheiros, e em todos os arbustos.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán, y se asentarán todos en los valles desiertos, y en las cavernas de las piedras, y en todos los zarzales, y en todas las matas.

verses.KJV: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.WEB: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.ASV: In that day will the Lord shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, [even] with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia o Senhor raspará com uma navalha alugada dalém do rio, por meio do rei da Assíria, a cabeça e os pelos dos pés; e até a barba será tirada por completo.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día raerá el Señor con navaja alquilada, con los que habitan de la otra parte del río, á saber, con el rey de Asiria, cabeza y pelos de los pies; y aun la barba también quitará.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.WEB: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecerá naquele dia, que alguém estará criando uma vaca jovem e duas ovelhas.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá en aquel tiempo, que críe un hombre una vaca y dos ovejas;

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
verses.WEB: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.
verses.ASV: and it shall come to pass, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the midst of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, por causa da abundância de leite que lhe derem, ele comerá manteiga; e comerá manteiga e mel todo aquele que for deixado no meio da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y será que á causa de la abundancia de leche que darán, comerá manteca: cierto manteca y miel comerá el que quedare en medio de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, shall be for briers and thorns.
verses.ALMEIDA: Será também naquele dia, que todo lugar em que antes havia mil videiras [do valor] de dez mil moedas de prata, se tornará [lugar] para espinhos e para cardos.
verses.RVR09: Acontecerá también en aquel tiempo, que el lugar donde había mil vides que valían mil siclos de plata, será para los espinos y cardos.

verses.KJV: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
verses.WEB: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
verses.ASV: With arrows and with bow shall one come thither, because all the land shall be briers and thorns.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que com arco e flechas ali entrarão; porque toda a terra será espinhos e cardos.
verses.RVR09: Con saetas y arco irán allá; porque toda la tierra será espinos y cardos.

verses.KJV: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
verses.WEB: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”
verses.ASV: And all the hills that were digged with the mattock, thou shalt not come thither for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também todos os montes onde costumavam ser cavados com enxadas, não se irá a eles por medo dos espinhos e dos cardos; porém servirão para se enviar bois, e para que gado miúdo pise.
verses.RVR09: Y á todos los montes que se cavaban con azada, no llegará allá el temor de los espinos y de los cardos: mas serán para pasto de bueyes, y para ser hollados de los ganados.

verses.KJV: Moreover the Lord said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.
verses.WEB: The LORD said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said unto me, Take thee a great tablet, and write upon it with the pen of a man, For Maher-shalal-hash-baz;
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse-me também o SENHOR: Toma para ti um grande letreiro, e escreve nele com pena [para uso] humano: Maer-Salal- Has-Baz.
verses.RVR09: Y DÍJOME Jehová: Tómate un gran volumen, y escribe en él en estilo de hombre tocante á Maher-salal-hash-baz.

verses.KJV: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
verses.WEB: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”
verses.ASV: and I will take unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tomei comigo testemunhas fiéis: o sacerdote Urias, e Zacarias filho de Jeberequias.
verses.RVR09: Y junté conmigo por testigos fieles á Urías sacerdote, y á Zacarías hijo de Jeberechîas.

verses.KJV: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the Lord to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.
verses.WEB: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’
verses.ASV: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said Jehovah unto me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vim até a profetisa, que concebeu e teve um filho; e o SENHOR me disse: Chama o nome dele de Maer-Salal-Has-Baz,
verses.RVR09: Y juntéme con la profetisa, la cual concibió, y parió un hijo. Y díjome Jehová: Ponle por nombre Maher-salal-hash-baz.

verses.KJV: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
verses.WEB: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”
verses.ASV: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and, My mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be carried away before the king of Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque antes que o menino saiba falar “papai” ou “mamãe”, as riquezas de Damasco e os despojos de Samaria serão tomados pelo rei da Assíria.
verses.RVR09: Porque antes que el niño sepa decir, Padre mío, y Madre mía, será quitada la fuerza de Damasco y los despojos de Samaria, en la presencia del rey de Asiria.

verses.KJV: The Lord spake also unto me again, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD spoke to me yet again, saying,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto me yet again, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR continuou a a falar comigo, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Otra vez tornó Jehová á hablarme, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
verses.WEB: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
verses.ASV: Forasmuch as this people have refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
verses.ALMEIDA: Dado que este povo rejeitou as águas de Siloé, que correm calmamente, e se alegrou com Resim e com o filho de Remalias,
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto desechó este pueblo las aguas de Siloé, que corren mansamente, y holgóse con Rezín y con el hijo de Remalías;

verses.KJV: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
verses.WEB: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
verses.ASV: now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the River, strong and many, [even] the king of Assyria and all his glory: and it shall come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eis que o Senhor fará subir sobre eles as águas do rio fortes e impetuosas: [que é] o rei da Assíria com todo o sua glória; e subirá sobre todas as suas correntes de águas, e transbordará por todas as suas margens;
verses.RVR09: He aquí por tanto que el Señor hace subir sobre ellos aguas de ríos, impetuosas y muchas, á saber, al rey de Asiria con todo su poder; el cual subirá sobre todos sus ríos, y pasará sobre todas sus riberas:

verses.KJV: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
verses.WEB: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.
verses.ASV: and it shall sweep onward into Judah; it shall overflow and pass through; it shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of its wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E passará por Judá, e o inundará, chegando até o pescoço; e ao estender suas asas, encherá a largura de tua terra, ó Emanuel.
verses.RVR09: Y pasando hasta Judá, inundará, y sobrepujará, y llegará hasta la garganta; y extendiendo sus alas, llenará la anchura de tu tierra, oh Emmanuel.

verses.KJV: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
verses.WEB: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!
verses.ASV: Make an uproar, O ye peoples, and be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and be broken in pieces.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ajuntai-vos, povos, e sereis quebrados; e ouvi, todos vós que sois de terras distantes; vesti vossos cintos, e sereis quebrados; preparai vossos cintos [para a batalha] ,mas sereis quebrados.
verses.RVR09: Juntaos, pueblos, y seréis quebrantados; oid todos los que sois de lejanas tierras: poneos á punto, y seréis quebrantados; apercibíos, y seréis quebrantados.

verses.KJV: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
verses.WEB: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
verses.ASV: Take counsel together, and it shall be brought to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Reuni-vos para tomar conselho, mas ele será desfeito; falai [alguma] palavra, porém ela não se confirmará, porque Deus é conosco.
verses.RVR09: Tomad consejo, y será deshecho; proferid palabra, y no será firme: porque Dios con nosotros.

verses.KJV: For the Lord spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.WEB: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.ASV: For Jehovah spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim o SENHOR me disse com mão forte; e ele me ensinou a não andar pelo caminho deste povo, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová me dijo de esta manera con mano fuerte, y enseñóme que no caminase por el camino de este pueblo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
verses.WEB: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.
verses.ASV: Say ye not, A conspiracy, concerning all whereof this people shall say, A conspiracy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be in dread [thereof].
verses.ALMEIDA: Não chameis de conspiração a tudo quanto este povo chama de conspiração; e não temais o que eles temem, nem vos assombreis.
verses.RVR09: No digáis, Conjuración, á todas las cosas á que este pueblo dice, Conjuración; ni temáis lo que temen, ni tengáis miedo.

verses.KJV: Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
verses.ASV: Jehovah of hosts, him shall ye sanctify; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] ao SENHOR dos exércitos, a ele santificai; e ele seja ele vosso temor, e ele seja vosso assombro.
verses.RVR09: A Jehová de los ejércitos, á él santificad: sea él vuestro temor, y él sea vuestro miedo.

verses.KJV: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.
verses.ASV: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele será como santuário [para vós] ; porém como pedra de ofensa, e por pedra de tropeço para as duas casas de Israel; como laço e como rede para os moradores de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Entonces él será por santuario; mas á las dos casas de Israel por piedra para tropezar, y por tropezadero para caer, y por lazo y por red al morador de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
verses.WEB: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”
verses.ASV: And many shall stumble thereon, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitos dentre eles tropeçarão e cairão; e serão quebrados, enlaçados, e presos.
verses.RVR09: Y muchos tropezarán entre ellos, y caerán, y serán quebrantados: enredaránse, y serán presos.

verses.KJV: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
verses.WEB: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
verses.ASV: Bind thou up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Liga o testemunho; sela a Lei entre meus discípulos.
verses.RVR09: Ata el testimonio, sella la ley entre mis discípulos.

verses.KJV: And I will wait upon the Lord, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.WEB: I will wait for the LORD, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.ASV: And I will wait for Jehovah, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esperarei ao SENHOR, que esconde seus rosto da casa de Jacó; e a ele aguardarei.
verses.RVR09: Esperaré pues á Jehová, el cual escondió su rostro de la casa de Jacob, y á él aguardaré.

verses.KJV: Behold, I and the children whom the Lord hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
verses.WEB: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.
verses.ASV: Behold, I and the children whom Jehovah hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Jehovah of hosts, who dwelleth in mount Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui, eu e os filhos que o SENHOR me deu, [somos] como sinais e como maravilhas em Israel, pelo SENHOR dos exércitos, que habita no monte de Sião.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, yo y los hijos que me dió Jehová, por señales y prodigios en Israel, de parte de Jehová de los ejércitos que mora en el monte de Sión.

verses.KJV: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
verses.WEB: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?
verses.ASV: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits and unto the wizards, that chirp and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? on behalf of the living [should they seek] unto the dead?
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando vos disserem: Consultai aos que se comunicam com os mortos e aos encantadores que murmuram, sussurrando entre os dentes.Por acaso não deveria o povo consultar ao seu Deus? [Perguntarão] aos mortos por causa dos vivos?
verses.RVR09: Y si os dijeren: Preguntad á los pythones y á los adivinos, que susurran hablando, responded: ¿No consultará el pueblo á su Dios? ¿Apelará por los vivos á los muertos?

verses.KJV: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
verses.WEB: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
verses.ASV: To the law and to the testimony! if they speak not according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Respondei] : À Lei e ao testemunho!Se não falarem segundo esta palavra, não haverá amanhecer para eles.
verses.RVR09: ¡A la ley y al testimonio! Si no dijeren conforme á esto, es porque no les ha amanecido.

verses.KJV: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
verses.WEB: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,
verses.ASV: And they shall pass through it, sore distressed and hungry; and it shall come to pass that, when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse by their king and by their God, and turn their faces upward:
verses.ALMEIDA: E passarão pela [terra] ,duramente oprimidos e famintos; e será que, quando tiverem fome e ficarem enfurecidos, então amaldiçoarão ao seu rei e ao seu Deus, olhando para cima.
verses.RVR09: Y pasarán por él fatigados y hambrientos, y acontecerá que teniendo hambre, se enojarán y maldecirán á su rey y á su Dios, levantando el rostro en alto.

verses.KJV: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
verses.WEB: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
verses.ASV: and they shall look unto the earth, and, behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and into thick darkness [they shall be] driven away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhando para a terra, eis aflição e trevas; [haverá] angustiante escuridão, e para as trevas serão empurrados.
verses.RVR09: Y mirarán á la tierra, y he aquí tribulación y tiniebla, oscuridad y angustia; y serán sumidos en las tinieblas.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
verses.WEB: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
verses.ASV: But there shall be no gloom to her that was in anguish. In the former time he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time hath he made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas não [haverá] escuridão para aquela que foi angustiada tal como nos primeiros tempos, [quando] ele afligiu a terra de Zebulom e a terra de Naftali; mas depois ele [a] honrará junto ao caminho do mar, dalém do Jordão, a Galileia das nações.
verses.RVR09: AUNQUE no será esta oscuridad tal como la aflicción que le vino en el tiempo que livianamente tocaron la primera vez á la tierra de Zabulón, y á la tierra de Nephtalí; y después cuando agravaron por la vía de la mar, de esa parte del Jordán, en Galilea de las gentes.

verses.KJV: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verses.WEB: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.
verses.ASV: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwelt in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verses.ALMEIDA: O povo que andava em trevas viu uma grande luz; os que habitavam em terra de sombra de morte, uma luz brilhou sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: El pueblo que andaba en tinieblas vió gran luz: los que moraban en tierra de sombra de muerte, luz resplandeció sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.WEB: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
verses.ASV: Thou hast multiplied the nation, thou hast increased their joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu multiplicaste a este povo, aumentaste-lhe a alegria. Eles se alegraram diante de ti como a alegria da ceifa, como quando ficam contentes ao repartir despojos;
verses.RVR09: Aumentando la gente, no aumentaste la alegría. Alegraránse delante de ti como se alegran en la siega, como se gozan cuando reparten despojos.

verses.KJV: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
verses.WEB: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
verses.ASV: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, thou hast broken as in the day of Midian.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu quebraste o jugo de sua carga, e a vara de seus ombros, o bastão daquele que opressivamente o conduzia, como no dia dos midianitas.
verses.RVR09: Porque tú quebraste su pesado yugo, y la vara de su hombro, y el cetro de su exactor, como en el día de Madián.

verses.KJV: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
verses.WEB: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
verses.ASV: For all the armor of the armed man in the tumult, and the garments rolled in blood, shall be for burning, for fuel of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando toda a batalha daqueles que batalhavam era feita com ruído, e as roupas se revolviam em sangue, e eram queimadas [para servir] de combustível ao fogo.
verses.RVR09: Porque toda batalla de quien pelea es con estruendo, y con revolcamiento de vestidura en sangre: mas esto será para quema, y pábulo del fuego.

verses.KJV: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verses.WEB: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.ASV: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given; and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque um menino nos nasceu, um filho nos foi dado; e o governo está sobre seus ombros; e seu nome se chama Maravilhoso, Conselheiro, Deus Forte, Pai da Eternidade, Príncipe da Paz.
verses.RVR09: Porque un niño nos es nacido, hijo nos es dado; y el principado sobre su hombro: y llamaráse su nombre Admirable, Consejero, Dios fuerte, Padre eterno, Príncipe de paz.

verses.KJV: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.
verses.WEB: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.
verses.ASV: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of Jehovah of hosts will perform this.
verses.ALMEIDA: À grandeza de [seu] governo e à paz não haverá fim, sobre o trono de Davi, e sobre seu reino, para o firmar e fortalecer com juízo e justiça desde agora e para sempre; o zelo do SENHOR dos exércitos fará isto.
verses.RVR09: Lo dilatado de su imperio y la paz no tendrán término, sobre el trono de David, y sobre su reino, disponiéndolo y confirmándolo en juicio y en justicia desde ahora para siempre. El celo de Jehová de los ejércitos hará esto.

verses.KJV: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
verses.WEB: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.
verses.ASV: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor enviou uma palavra a Jacó, e ela caiu sobre Israel.
verses.RVR09: El Señor envió palabra á Jacob, y cayó en Israel.

verses.KJV: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
verses.WEB: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
verses.ASV: And all the people shall know, [even] Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in pride and in stoutness of heart,
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o povo [a] saberá: Efraim, e os moradores de Samaria, em soberba e arrogância de coração, dizem:
verses.RVR09: Y la sabrá el pueblo, todo él, Ephraim y los moradores de Samaria, que con soberbia y con altivez de corazón dicen:

verses.KJV: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
verses.WEB: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”
verses.ASV: The bricks are fallen, but we will build with hewn stone; the sycomores are cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os tijolos caíram, mas construiremos de novo com pedras talhadas; as figueiras bravas foram cortadas, mas as trocaremos por cedros.
verses.RVR09: Los ladrillos cayeron, mas edificaremos de cantería; cortaron los cabrahigos, mas cedros pondremos en su lugar.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,
verses.ASV: Therefore Jehovah will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o SENHOR levantará os adversários de Resim contra ele, e instigará seus inimigos:
verses.RVR09: Empero Jehová ensalzará los enemigos de Rezín contra él, y juntará sus enemigos;

verses.KJV: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.WEB: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ASV: the Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela frente [virão] os sírios, e por trás os filisteus; e devorarão a Israel com a boca aberta. Nem com tudo isto sua ira cessará, e ainda sua mão está estendida.
verses.RVR09: De oriente los Siros, y los Filisteos de poniente; y con toda la boca se tragarán á Israel. Ni con todo eso ha cesado su furor, antes todavía su mano extendida.

verses.KJV: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: Yet the people have not turned unto him that smote them, neither have they sought Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque este povo não se converteu àquele que o feriu, nem busca ao SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Mas el pueblo no se convirtió al que lo hería, ni buscaron á Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.
verses.ASV: Therefore Jehovah will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm-branch and rush, in one day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o SENHOR cortará de Israel a cabeça, a cauda, o ramo e o junco de Israel em um único dia.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová cortará de Israel cabeza y cola, ramo y caña en un mismo día.

verses.KJV: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
verses.WEB: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
verses.ASV: The elder and the honorable man, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ancião e o homem respeitado, este é a cabeça; e o profeta que ensina falsidade é a cauda.
verses.RVR09: El viejo y venerable de rostro es la cabeza: el profeta que enseña mentira, este es cola.

verses.KJV: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
verses.WEB: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.
verses.ASV: For they that lead this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os guias deste povo são enganadores; e os que por eles forem guiados estão a ponto de serem destruídos.
verses.RVR09: Porque los gobernadores de este pueblo son engañadores; y sus gobernados, perdidos.

verses.KJV: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ASV: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for every one is profane and an evil-doer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa disso o Senhor não terá alegria em seus rapazes, e não terá piedade de seus órfãos e de suas viúvas; porque todos eles são hipócritas e malfeitores, e toda boca fala tolices; nem com tudo isto sua ira cessará, e sua mão ainda está estendida.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, el Señor no tomará contentamiento en sus mancebos, ni de sus huérfanos y viudas tendrá misericordia: porque todos son falsos y malignos, y toda boca habla despropósitos. Con todo esto no ha cesado su furor, antes todavía su mano extendida.

verses.KJV: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
verses.WEB: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
verses.ASV: For wickedness burneth as the fire; it devoureth the briers and thorns; yea, it kindleth in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a perversidade queima como fogo, [que] consumirá cardos e espinhos, e incendiará aos emaranhados das árvores da floresta; e subirão como nuvens de fumaça.
verses.RVR09: Porque la maldad se encendió como fuego, cardos y espinas devorará; y encenderáse en lo espeso de la breña, y serán alzados como humo.

verses.KJV: Through the wrath of the Lord of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
verses.WEB: Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.
verses.ASV: Through the wrath of Jehovah of hosts is the land burnt up; and the people are as the fuel of fire: no man spareth his brother.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo furor do SENHOR dos exércitos a terra se inflamará, e o povo será como o combustível do fogo; cada um não terá piedade do outro.
verses.RVR09: Por la ira de Jehová de los ejércitos se oscureció la tierra, y será el pueblo como pábulo del fuego: el hombre no tendrá piedad de su hermano.

verses.KJV: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
verses.WEB: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:
verses.ASV: And one shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se cortar à direita, ainda terá fome; e se comer da esquerda, ainda não se saciará; cada um comerá a carne de seu [próprio] braço.
verses.RVR09: Cada uno hurtará á la mano derecha, y tendrá hambre; y comerá á la izquierda, y no se hartará: cada cual comerá la carne de su brazo:

verses.KJV: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.WEB: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ASV: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ALMEIDA: Manassés a Efraim, e Efraim a Manassés; e eles ambos serão contra Judá; e nem com tudo isto sua ira cessará, e sua mão ainda está estendida.
verses.RVR09: Manasés á Ephraim, y Ephraim á Manasés, y entrambos contra Judá. Ni con todo esto ha cesado su furor, antes todavía extendida su mano.

verses.KJV: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
verses.WEB: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees
verses.ASV: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers that write perverseness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos que decretam ordenanças injustas, e dos que escribas que escrevem coisas opressivas,
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de los que establecen leyes injustas, y determinando prescriben tiranía,

verses.KJV: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
verses.WEB: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
verses.ASV: to turn aside the needy from justice, and to rob the poor of my people of their right, that widows may be their spoil, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
verses.ALMEIDA: Para afastarem aos pobres de seu direito, e para tomarem o direito dos pobres de meu povo; para despojarem as viúvas, e para roubarem aos órfãos.
verses.RVR09: Por apartar del juicio á los pobres, y por quitar el derecho á los afligidos de mi pueblo; por despojar las viudas, y robar los huérfanos!

verses.KJV: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
verses.WEB: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
verses.ASV: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas que fareis no dia da visitação e da assolação, [que] virá de longe? A quem recorrereis por socorro? E onde deixareis vossa glória?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y qué haréis en el día de la visitación? ¿y á quién os acogeréis que os ayude, cuando viniere de lejos el asolamiento? ¿y en dónde dejaréis vuestra gloria?

verses.KJV: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.WEB: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ASV: They shall only bow down under the prisoners, and shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Nada podem fazer] ,a não ser se abaterem entre os presos, e caírem entre os mortos. Com tudo isto, sua ira não cessará, e sua mão ainda está estendida.
verses.RVR09: Sin mí se inclinarán entre los presos, y entre los muertos caerán. Ni con todo esto ha cesado su furor, antes todavía extendida su mano.

verses.KJV: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
verses.WEB: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
verses.ASV: Ho Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, the staff in whose hand is mine indignation!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai da Assíria, a vara de minha ira; porque minha indignação é pão em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Oh Assur, vara y bastón de mi furor: en su mano he puesto mi ira.
