verses.KJV: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.WEB: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.ASV: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu a enviarei contra um povo corrompido, e lhe darei ordem contra um povo do qual me enfureço; para que roube ao roubo, e despoje ao despojo, e para que o pisem como a lama das ruas;
verses.RVR09: Mandaréle contra una gente fementida, y sobre el pueblo de mi ira le enviaré, para que quite despojos, y arrebate presa, y que lo ponga á ser hollado como lodo de las calles.

verses.KJV: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
verses.WEB: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
verses.ASV: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off nations not a few.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que ela não pense assim, nem pretenda isso seu coração; em vez disso, [deseja] em seu coração destruir e eliminar não poucas nações.
verses.RVR09: Aunque él no lo pensará así, ni su corazón lo imaginará de esta manera; sino que su pensamiento será desarraigar y cortar gentes no pocas.

verses.KJV: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
verses.WEB: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
verses.ASV: For he saith, Are not my princes all of them kings?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois diz: Por acaso os meus generais, não são todos eles reis?
verses.RVR09: Porque él dice: Mis príncipes ¿no son todos reyes?

verses.KJV: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
verses.WEB: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
verses.ASV: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não é Calno como Carquemis? Não é Hamate como Arpade? Não é Samaria como Damasco?
verses.RVR09: ¿No es Calno como Carchêmis, Hamath como Arphad, y Samaria como Damasco?

verses.KJV: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.WEB: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,
verses.ASV: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim como minha mão tomou aos reinos dos ídolos, cujas imagens eram melhores que Jerusalém e as de Samaria,
verses.RVR09: Como halló mi mano los reinos de los ídolos, siendo sus imágenes más que Jerusalem y Samaria;

verses.KJV: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.WEB: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.ASV: shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não farei eu a Jerusalém e a seus ídolos da mesma maneira que fiz a Samaria e a seus ídolos?
verses.RVR09: Como hice á Samaria y á sus ídolos, ¿no haré también así á Jerusalem y á sus ídolos?

verses.KJV: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
verses.WEB: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.
verses.ASV: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that, when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque acontecerá que, quando o Senhor tiver acabado toda sua obra no monte de Sião em Jerusalém, então: Visitarei [para castigar] o fruto da arrogância da rei da Assíria e a pompa do orgulho de seus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Mas acontecerá que después que el Señor hubiere acabado toda su obra en el monte de Sión, y en Jerusalem, visitaré sobre el fruto de la soberbia del corazón del rey de Asiria, y sobre la gloria de la altivez de sus ojos.

verses.KJV: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
verses.WEB: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
verses.ASV: For he hath said, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding: and I have removed the bounds of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures, and like a valiant man I have brought down them that sit [on thrones]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele diz: Fiz [isso] com a força de minha mão e com minha sabedoria, pois sou esperto; e tirei as fronteiras dos povos, e roubei seus bens, e como guerreiro abati aos moradores.
verses.RVR09: Porque dijo: Con la fortaleza de mi mano lo he hecho, y con mi sabiduría; porque he sido prudente: y quité los términos de los pueblos, y saqueé sus tesoros, y derribé como valientes los que estaban sentados:

verses.KJV: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
verses.WEB: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
verses.ASV: and my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the peoples; and as one gathereth eggs that are forsaken, have I gathered all the earth: and there was none that moved the wing, or that opened the mouth, or chirped.
verses.ALMEIDA: E minha mão tomou as riquezas dos povos como a um ninho; e como se juntam ovos abandonados, assim eu juntei toda a terra; e não houve quem movesse asa, ou abrisse boca, ou fizesse ruído.
verses.RVR09: Y halló mi mano como nido las riquezas de los pueblos; y como se cogen los huevos dejados, así me apoderé yo de toda la tierra; y no hubo quien moviese ala, ó abriese boca y graznase.

verses.KJV: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
verses.WEB: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.
verses.ASV: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? shall the saw magnify itself against him that wieldeth it? as if a rod should wield them that lift it up, [or] as if a staff should lift up [him that is] not wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso o machado se glorificará contra aquele que com ele corta? Ou a serra se engrandecerá contra aquele que a manuseia? [Seria] como se fosse o bastão que movesse aos que o levantam, como se a vara fosse capaz de levantar, [como se ela] não [fosse apenas] madeira.
verses.RVR09: ¿Gloriaráse el hacha contra el que con ella corta? ¿se ensoberbecerá la sierra contra el que la mueve? como si el bordón se levantase contra los que lo levantan; como si se levantase la vara: ¿no es leño?

verses.KJV: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
verses.ASV: Therefore will the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory there shall be kindled a burning like the burning of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos enviará magreza entre seus gordos; e em lugar de sua glória ele inflamará um incêndio, como um incêndio de fogo.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos enviará flaqueza sobre sus gordos; y debajo de su gloria encenderá encendimiento, como ardor de fuego.

verses.KJV: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
verses.WEB: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
verses.ASV: And the light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Luz de Israel virá a ser fogo, e seu Santo, labareda, que queima e consome seus espinhos e seus cardos em um dia.
verses.RVR09: Y la luz de Israel será por fuego, y su Santo por llama que abrase y consuma en un día sus cardos y sus espinas.

verses.KJV: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standard-bearer fainteth.
verses.WEB: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
verses.ASV: And he will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and it shall be as when a standard-bearer fainteth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também consumirá a glória de sua floresta, e de seu campo fértil, desde a alma até a carne; e será como quando um doente se definha.
verses.RVR09: La gloria de su bosque y de su campo fértil consumirá, desde el alma hasta la carne: y vendrá á ser como abanderado en derrota.

verses.KJV: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
verses.WEB: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.
verses.ASV: And the remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child may write them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o resto das árvores de sua floresta será tão pouco em número, que um menino será capaz de contá-las.
verses.RVR09: Y los árboles que quedaren en su bosque, serán en número que un niño los pueda contar.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.WEB: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and they that are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again lean upon him that smote them, but shall lean upon Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecerá naquele dia, que os restantes de Israel e os que escaparam da casa de Jacó nunca mais confiarão naquele que os feriu; ao invés disso, confiarão verdadeiramente no SENHOR, o Santo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá en aquel tiempo, que los que hubieren quedado de Israel, y los que hubieren quedado de la casa de Jacob, nunca más estriben sobre el que los hirió; sino que se apoyarán con verdad en Jehová Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
verses.WEB: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
verses.ASV: A remnant shall return, [even] the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os restantes se converterão, os restantes de Jacó, ao Deus Forte.
verses.RVR09: Las reliquias se convertirán, las reliquias de Jacob, al Dios fuerte.

verses.KJV: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
verses.WEB: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
verses.ASV: For though thy people, Israel, be as the sand of the sea, [only] a remnant of them shall return: a destruction [is] determined, overflowing with righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ainda que teu povo, ó Israel, seja como a areia do mar, [apenas] o restante dele se converterá; a destruição já está decretada, transbordante em justiça.
verses.RVR09: Porque si tu pueblo, oh Israel, fuere como las arenas de la mar, las reliquias de él se convertirán: la destrucción acordada rebosará justicia.

verses.KJV: For the Lord God of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
verses.WEB: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.
verses.ASV: For a full end, and that determined, will the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, make in the midst of all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a destruição que foi decretada, o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos a executará no meio de toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Pues el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos hará consumación y fenecimiento en medio de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian, though he smite thee with the rod, and lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos: Não temas, povo meu, que habita em Sião, ao assírio, quando te ferir com vara, e contra ti levantar seu bastão da maneira dos egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos dice así: Pueblo mío, morador de Sión, no temas de Assur. Con vara te herirá, y contra ti alzará su palo, á la manera de Egipto:

verses.KJV: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
verses.WEB: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”
verses.ASV: For yet a very little while, and the indignation [against thee] shall be accomplished, and mine anger [shall be directed] to his destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois em breve se completará a indignação e a minha ira, para os consumir.
verses.RVR09: Mas de aquí á muy poco tiempo, se acabará el furor y mi enojo, para fenecimiento de ellos.

verses.KJV: And the Lord of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah of hosts will stir up against him a scourge, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and his rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o SENHOR dos exércitos levantará um açoite contra ele, como a matança de Midiã junto à rocha de Orebe; e sua vara [estará] sobre o mar, a qual ele levantará da maneira [que ele fez] aos egípcios.
verses.RVR09: Y levantará Jehová de los ejércitos azote contra él, cual la matanza de Madián en la peña de Oreb: y alzará su vara sobre la mar, según hizo por la vía de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall depart from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed by reason of fatness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecerá naquele dia, que sua carga será tirada de teu ombro, e seu jugo de teu pescoço; e o jugo será despedaçado por causa da unção.
verses.RVR09: Y acaecerá en aquel tiempo, que su carga será quitada de tu hombro, y su yugo de tu cerviz, y el yugo se empodrecerá por causa de la unción.

verses.KJV: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
verses.WEB: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
verses.ASV: He is come to Aiath, he is passed through Migron; at Michmash he layeth up his baggage;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles, [os assírios] ,chegaram a Aiate, passaram por Migrom, em Micmás puseram seus instrumentos.
verses.RVR09: Vino hasta Ajad, pasó hasta Migrón; en Michmas contará su ejército:

verses.KJV: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
verses.WEB: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.
verses.ASV: they are gone over the pass; they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah trembleth; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passaram o vau, se abrigaram em Geba. Ramá está tremendo, Gibeá de Saul está fugindo.
verses.RVR09: Pasaron el vado; alojaron en Geba: Ramá tembló; Gabaa de Saúl huyó.

verses.KJV: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
verses.WEB: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
verses.ASV: Cry aloud with thy voice, O daughter of Gallim! hearken, O Laishah! O thou poor Anathoth!
verses.ALMEIDA: Grita com tua voz, ó filha de Galim! Ouve, Laís! Pobre de ti, Anatote!
verses.RVR09: Grita en alta voz, hija de Galim; haz que se oiga hacia Lais, pobrecilla Anathoth.

verses.KJV: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
verses.WEB: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
verses.ASV: Madmenah is a fugitive; the inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Madmena foge; os moradores de Gebim procuram refúgios.
verses.RVR09: Madmena se alborotó: los moradores de Gebim se juntarán.

verses.KJV: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: This very day shall he halt at Nob: he shaketh his hand at the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda hoje parará em Nobe; moverá sua mão [contra] o monte da Filha de Sião, o morro de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Aún vendrá día cuando reposará en Nob: alzará su mano al monte de la hija de Sión, al collado de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
verses.WEB: Behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.
verses.ASV: Behold, the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, will lop the boughs with terror: and the high of stature shall be hewn down, and the lofty shall be brought low.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos cortará os galhos com violência; e os de alta estatura serão cortados, e os elevados serão abatidos.
verses.RVR09: He aquí el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos desgajará el ramo con fortaleza: y los de grande altura serán cortados, y los altos serán humillados.

verses.KJV: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
verses.WEB: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
verses.ASV: And he will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cortará os emaranhados da floresta com machado de ferro; e o Líbano cairá pelo Grandioso.
verses.RVR09: Y cortará con hierro la espesura del bosque, y el Líbano caerá con fortaleza.

verses.KJV: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
verses.WEB: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
verses.ASV: And there shall come forth a shoot out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots shall bear fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: E uma vara brotará do tronco cortado de Jessé; e um ramo crescerá de suas raízes.
verses.RVR09: Y SALDRÁ una vara del tronco de Isaí, y un vástago retoñará de sus raíces.

verses.KJV: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;
verses.WEB: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the Spirit of Jehovah shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E repousará sobre ele o Espírito do SENHOR: o Espírito de sabedoria e de entendimento, o Espírito de conselho e força, o Espírito de conhecimento e temor ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y reposará sobre él el espíritu de Jehová; espíritu de sabiduría y de inteligencia, espíritu de consejo y de fortaleza, espíritu de conocimiento y de temor de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
verses.WEB: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;
verses.ASV: And his delight shall be in the fear of Jehovah; and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither decide after the hearing of his ears;
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu prazer será no temor ao SENHOR; e não julgará segundo a vista de seus olhos, nem repreenderá segundo o ouvir de seus ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Y harále entender diligente en el temor de Jehová. No juzgará según la vista de sus ojos, ni argüirá por lo que oyeren sus oídos;

verses.KJV: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth: with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.WEB: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.
verses.ASV: but with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and decide with equity for the meek of the earth; and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas julgará com justiça aos pobres, e repreenderá com equidade aos humildes da terra; porém ferirá a terra com a vara de sua boca, e com o espírito de seus lábios matará ao perverso.
verses.RVR09: Sino que juzgará con justicia á los pobres, y argüirá con equidad por los mansos de la tierra: y herirá la tierra con la vara de su boca, y con el espíritu de sus labios matará al impío.

verses.KJV: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
verses.WEB: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.
verses.ASV: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his waist, and faithfulness the girdle of his loins.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a justiça será o cinto de sua cintura; a fidelidade o cinto de seus lombos.
verses.RVR09: Y será la justicia cinto de sus lomos, y la fidelidad ceñidor de sus riñones.

verses.KJV: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.WEB: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.
verses.ASV: And the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o lobo morará com o cordeiro, e o leopardo se deitará com o cabrito; e o bezerro, o filhote de leão, e o animal cevado [andarão] juntos, e um menino pequeno os guiará.
verses.RVR09: Morará el lobo con el cordero, y el tigre con el cabrito se acostará: el becerro y el león y la bestia doméstica andarán juntos, y un niño los pastoreará.

verses.KJV: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.WEB: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
verses.ASV: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.ALMEIDA: A vaca e a ursa se alimentarão juntas, seus filhos [juntos] se deitarão; e o leão comerá palha como o boi.
verses.RVR09: La vaca y la osa pacerán, sus crías se echarán juntas; y el león como el buey comerá paja.

verses.KJV: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
verses.WEB: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.
verses.ASV: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the adder’s den.
verses.ALMEIDA: A criança que ainda mama brincará sobre a toca da serpente, e a que for desmamada porá sua mão na cova da víbora.
verses.RVR09: Y el niño de teta se entretendrá sobre la cueva del áspid, y el recién destetado extenderá su mano sobre la caverna del basilisco.

verses.KJV: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.WEB: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.ASV: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Jehovah, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se fará mal nem dano algum em todo o meu santo monte, porque a terra se encherá do conhecimento do SENHOR, como as águas cobrem o mar.
verses.RVR09: No harán mal ni dañarán en todo mi santo monte; porque la tierra será llena del conocimiento de Jehová, como cubren la mar las aguas.

verses.KJV: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the root of Jesse, that standeth for an ensign of the peoples, unto him shall the nations seek; and his resting-place shall be glorious.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecerá naquele dia, que as nações buscarão a raiz de Jessé, posta como bandeira dos povos; e seu repouso será glorioso.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá en aquel tiempo que la raíz de Isaí, la cual estará puesta por pendón á los pueblos, será buscada de las gentes; y su holganza será gloria.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, that shall remain, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acontecerá naquele dia, que o Senhor voltará a pôr sua mão para adquirir de novo aos restantes de seus povo, que restarem da Assíria, do Egito, Patros, Cuxe, Elão, Sinear, Hamate, e das ilhas do mar.
verses.RVR09: Asimismo acontecerá en aquel tiempo, que Jehová tornará á poner otra vez su mano para poseer las reliquias de su pueblo que fueron dejadas de Assur, y de Egipto, y de Parthia, y de Etiopía, y de Persia, y de Caldea, y de Amath, y de las Islas de la mar.

verses.KJV: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.WEB: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.ASV: And he will set up an ensign for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantará uma bandeira entre as nações, e juntará aos desterrados de Israel, e reunirá aos dispersos de Judá desde os quatro confins da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y levantará pendón á las gentes, y juntará los desterrados de Israel, y reunirá los esparcidos de Judá de los cuatro cantones de la tierra.

verses.KJV: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.WEB: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.
verses.ASV: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and they that vex Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a inveja de Efraim terminará, e os adversários de Judá serão cortados; Efraim não invejará a Judá, e Judá não oprimirá a Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Y se disipará la envidia de Ephraim, y los enemigos de Judá serán talados. Ephraim no tendrá envidia contra Judá, ni Judá afligirá á Ephraim;

verses.KJV: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.WEB: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.
verses.ASV: And they shall fly down upon the shoulder of the Philistines on the west; together shall they despoil the children of the east: they shall put forth their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, voarão sobre os ombros dos filisteus ao ocidente, e juntos despojarão aos do oriente; porão suas mãos [sobre] Edom e Moabe, e os filhos de Amom lhes obedecerão.
verses.RVR09: Mas volarán sobre los hombros de los Filisteos al occidente, meterán también á saco á los de oriente: Edom y Moab les servirán, y los hijos de Ammón les darán obediencia.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
verses.WEB: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind will he wave his hand over the River, and will smite it into seven streams, and cause men to march over dryshod.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR dividirá a porção de mar do Egito, e moverá sua mão contra o rio com a força de seu vento; e o ferirá em sete correntes, e fará com que se possa atravessá-lo com sandálias.
verses.RVR09: Y secará Jehová la lengua de la mar de Egipto; y levantará su mano con fortaleza de su espíritu sobre el río, y herirálo en sus siete brazos, y hará que pasen por él con zapatos.

verses.KJV: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And there shall be a highway for the remnant of his people, that shall remain, from Assyria; like as there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E haverá um caminho para os restantes de seu povo, que restarem da Assíria, assim como aconteceu a Israel, no dia em que subiu da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y habrá camino para las reliquias de su pueblo, las que quedaron de Assur, de la manera que lo hubo para Israel el día que subió de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And in that day thou shalt say, O Lord, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
verses.WEB: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
verses.ASV: And in that day thou shalt say, I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; for though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away and thou comfortest me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu dirás naquele dia: Eu te agradeço, SENHOR, pois, ainda que tenhas te irado contra mim, tua ira foi removida, e tu me consolas!
verses.RVR09: Y DIRÁS en aquel día: Cantaré á ti, oh Jehová: pues aunque te enojaste contra mí, tu furor se apartó, y me has consolado.

verses.KJV: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.WEB: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
verses.ASV: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid: for Jehovah, [even] Jehovah, is my strength and song; and he is become my salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que Deus é minha salvação; [nele] confiarei, e não terei medo; porque minha força e minha canção é o SENHOR DEUS; e ele tem sido minha salvação.
verses.RVR09: He aquí Dios es salud mía; aseguraréme, y no temeré; porque mi fortaleza y mi canción es JAH Jehová, el cual ha sido salud para mí.

verses.KJV: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.WEB: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.ASV: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E alegremente tirareis águas das fontes da salvação.
verses.RVR09: Sacaréis aguas con gozo de las fuentes de la salud.

verses.KJV: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the Lord, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.WEB: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!
verses.ASV: And in that day shall ye say, Give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name, declare his doings among the peoples, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E direis naquele dia: Agradecei ao SENHOR, falai em alta voz ao seu nome; informai seus feitos entre os povos, anunciai quão exaltado é o seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Y diréis en aquel día: Cantad á Jehová, aclamad su nombre, haced célebres en los pueblos sus obras, recordad que su nombre es engrandecido.

verses.KJV: Sing unto the Lord; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
verses.WEB: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
verses.ASV: Sing unto Jehovah; for he hath done excellent things: let this be known in all the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR, porque ele fez coisas grandiosas; que isto seja conhecido em toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Cantad salmos á Jehová; porque ha hecho cosas magníficas: sea sabido esto por toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
verses.WEB: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
verses.ASV: Cry aloud and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion; for great in the midst of thee is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Grita e canta de alegria, ó moradora de Sião; porque o Santo de Israel é grande no meio de ti!
verses.RVR09: Regocíjate y canta, oh moradora de Sión: porque grande es en medio de ti el Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.WEB: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
verses.ASV: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre a Babilônia, vista por Isaías, filho de Amoz.
verses.RVR09: CARGA de Babilonia, que vió Isaías, hijo de Amoz.

verses.KJV: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.WEB: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.ASV: Set ye up an ensign upon the bare mountain, lift up the voice unto them, wave the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai uma bandeira sobre um alto monte, levantai a voz a eles; movei a mão ao alto, para que entrem pelas portas dos príncipes.
verses.RVR09: Levantad bandera sobre un alto monte; alzad la voz á ellos, alzad la mano, para que entren por puertas de príncipes.

verses.KJV: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.WEB: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.
verses.ASV: I have commanded my consecrated ones, yea, I have called my mighty men for mine anger, even my proudly exulting ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu dei ordens aos meus santificados; também chamei aos meus guerreiros para minha ira, aos que se alegram com minha glória.
verses.RVR09: Yo mandé á mis santificados, asimismo llamé á mis valientes para mi ira, á los que se alegran con mi gloria.

verses.KJV: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
verses.WEB: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.
verses.ASV: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, as of a great people! the noise of a tumult of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! Jehovah of hosts is mustering the host for the battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há um ruído de tumulto sobre os montes, como o de um imenso povo; ruído de multidões de reinos de nações reunidas; o SENHOR dos exércitos está revistando um exército para a guerra.
verses.RVR09: Murmullo de multitud en los montes, como de mucho pueblo; murmullo de ruido de reinos, de gentes reunidas: Jehová de los ejércitos ordena las tropas de la batalla.

verses.KJV: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.WEB: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.ASV: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Jehovah, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles vêm de uma terra distante, desde a extremidade do céu; o SENHOR e os instrumentos de seu furor, para destruir toda [aquela] terra.
verses.RVR09: Vienen de lejana tierra, de lo postrero de los cielos, Jehová y los instrumentos de su furor, para destruir toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.WEB: Wail, for the LORD’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.ASV: Wail ye; for the day of Jehovah is at hand; as destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gritai lamentando, pois o dia do SENHOR está perto; vem como assolação pelo Todo-Poderoso.
verses.RVR09: Aullad, porque cerca está el día de Jehová; vendrá como asolamiento del Todopoderoso.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
verses.WEB: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall all hands be feeble, and every heart of man shall melt:
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso todas as mãos ficarão fracas, e o coração de todos os homens se derreterá.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, se enervarán todas la manos, y desleiráse todo corazón de hombre:

verses.KJV: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
verses.WEB: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.
verses.ASV: and they shall be dismayed; pangs and sorrows shall take hold [of them]; they shall be in pain as a woman in travail: they shall look in amazement one at another; their faces [shall be] faces of flame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficarão aterrorizados; serão tomados por dores e angústias; sofrerão como mulher com dores de parto; cada um terá medo de seu próximo, seus rostos serão rostos em chamas.
verses.RVR09: Y se llenarán de terror; angustias y dolores los comprenderán; tendrán dolores como mujer de parto; pasmaráse cada cual al mirar á su compañero; sus rostros, rostros de llamas.

verses.KJV: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.WEB: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
verses.ASV: Behold, the day of Jehovah cometh, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o dia do SENHOR vem horrendo, com furor e ira ardente, para pôr a terra em assolação, e destruir os pecadores nela.
verses.RVR09: He aquí el día de Jehová viene, crudo, y de saña y ardor de ira, para tornar la tierra en soledad, y raer de ella sus pecadores.

verses.KJV: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.WEB: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.
verses.ASV: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light; the sun shall be darkened in its going forth, and the moon shall not cause its light to shine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque as estrelas dos céus e suas constelações não darão sua luz; o sol se escurecerá ao nascer, e a lua não brilhará com sua luz.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual las estrellas de los cielos y sus luceros no derramarán su lumbre; y el sol se oscurecerá en naciendo, y la luna no echará su resplandor.

verses.KJV: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.WEB: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.
verses.ASV: And I will punish the world for [their] evil, and the wicked for their iniquity: and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque visitarei para punir sobre o mundo a maldade, e sobre os maus sua perversidade; e porei fim à arrogância dos soberbos, e abaterei o orgulho dos tiranos.
verses.RVR09: Y visitaré la maldad sobre el mundo, y sobre los impíos su iniquidad; y haré que cese la arrogancia de los soberbios, y abatiré la altivez de los fuertes.

verses.KJV: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.WEB: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
verses.ASV: I will make a man more rare than fine gold, even a man than the pure gold of Ophir.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farei com que um varão seja mais raro que o ouro maciço, e um homem mais que o ouro fino de Ofir.
verses.RVR09: Haré más precioso que el oro fino al varón, y más que el oro de Ophir al hombre.

verses.KJV: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the Lord of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.ASV: Therefore I will make the heavens to tremble, and the earth shall be shaken out of its place, in the wrath of Jehovah of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso farei estremecer aos céus, e a terra se moverá de seu lugar, por causa do furor do SENHOR dos exércitos, e por causa de sua ardente ira.
verses.RVR09: Porque haré estremecer los cielos, y la tierra se moverá de su lugar, en la indignación de Jehová de los ejércitos, y en el día de la ira de su furor.

verses.KJV: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.WEB: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that as the chased roe, and as sheep that no man gathereth, they shall turn every man to his own people, and shall flee every man to his own land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, como uma corça em fuga, e como uma ovelha que ninguém recolhe, cada um se voltará para seu povo, e cada um fugirá para sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Y será que como corza amontada, y como oveja sin pastor, cada cual mirará hacia su pueblo, y cada uno huirá á su tierra.

verses.KJV: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
verses.WEB: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
verses.ASV: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is taken shall fall by the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Qualquer um que for achado, será traspassado; e qualquer um que se juntar a ele cairá pela espada.
verses.RVR09: Cualquiera que fuere hallado, será alanceado; y cualquiera que á ellos se juntare, caerá á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.WEB: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
verses.ASV: Their infants also shall be dashed in pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be rifled, and their wives ravished.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas crianças serão despedaçadas perante seus olhos; suas casas serão saqueadas, e suas mulheres estupradas.
verses.RVR09: Sus niños serán estrellados delante de ellos; sus casas serán saqueadas, y forzadas sus mujeres.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who shall not regard silver, and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que despertarei contra eles aos medos, que não se importarão com a prata, nem desejarão ouro.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que yo despierto contra ellos á los Medos, que no curarán de la plata, ni codiciarán oro.

verses.KJV: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eyes shall not spare children.
verses.WEB: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.
verses.ASV: And [their] bows shall dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [com seus] arcos despedaçarão aos rapazes, e não terão piedade do fruto do ventre; o olho deles não terá compaixão das crianças.
verses.RVR09: Y con arcos tirarán á los niños, y no tendrán misericordia de fruto de vientre, ni su ojo perdonará á hijos.

verses.KJV: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.WEB: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.ASV: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim será Babilônia, a joia dos reinos, a beleza e o orgulho dos caldeus, semelhante a Sodoma e Gomorra, quando Deus [as] arruinou.
verses.RVR09: Y Babilonia, hermosura de reinos y ornamento de la grandeza de los Caldeos, será como Sodoma y Gomorra, á las que trastornó Dios.

verses.KJV: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.WEB: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.
verses.ASV: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall shepherds make their flocks to lie down there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca mais será habitada, nem [nela] se morará, de geração em geração; nem o árabe armará ali sua tenda, nem os pastores farão descansar ali [seus] rebanhos.
verses.RVR09: Nunca más será habitada, ni se morará en ella de generación en generación; ni hincará allí tienda el Arabe, ni pastores tendrán allí majada:

verses.KJV: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
verses.WEB: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
verses.ASV: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and ostriches shall dwell there, and wild goats shall dance there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os animais selvagens do deserto ali descansarão, e suas casas se encherão de animais medonhos; e ali habitarão corujas, e bodes selvagens saltarão ali.
verses.RVR09: Sino que dormirán allí bestias fieras, y sus casas se llenarán de hurones, allí habitarán hijas del buho, y allí saltarán peludos.

verses.KJV: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.WEB: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.
verses.ASV: And wolves shall cry in their castles, and jackals in the pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as hienas uivarão em suas fortalezas, e chacais em seus confortáveis palácios. Pois está chegando bem perto o seu tempo, e os dias dela não se prolongarão.
verses.RVR09: Y en sus palacios gritarán gatos cervales, y chacales en sus casas de deleite: y abocado está á venir su tiempo, y sus días no se alargarán.

verses.KJV: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.WEB: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the sojourner shall join himself with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR terá piedade de Jacó, e ainda escolherá a Israel, e os porá em sua terra; e estrangeiros se juntarão a eles, e se apegarão à casa de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: PORQUE Jehová tendrá piedad de Jacob, y todavía escogerá á Israel, y les hará reposar en su tierra: y á ellos se unirán extranjeros, y allegaránse á la familia de Jacob.

verses.KJV: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.WEB: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.ASV: And the peoples shall take them, and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of Jehovah for servants and for handmaids: and they shall take them captive whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os povos os receberão, e os levarão a seus lugares, e a casa de Israel terá posse deles como servos e servas, na terra do SENHOR; e capturarão aos que tinham lhes capturado, e dominarão sobre seus opressores.
verses.RVR09: Y los tomarán los pueblos, y traeránlos á su lugar: y la casa de Israel los poseerá por siervos y criadas en la tierra de Jehová: y cautivarán á los que los cautivaron, y señorearán á los que los oprimieron.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.WEB: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in the day that Jehovah shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy trouble, and from the hard service wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, no dia em que o SENHOR te der descanso de teu trabalho e de teu tormento, e da dura escravidão que te escravizaram,
verses.RVR09: Y será en el día que Jehová te diere reposo de tu trabajo, y de tu temor, y de la dura servidumbre en que te hicieron servir,

verses.KJV: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
verses.WEB: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
verses.ASV: that thou shalt take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
verses.ALMEIDA: Então levantarás estas palavras de escárnio contra o rei da Babilônia, e dirás: [Vede] como foi o fim do opressor, como a cidade dourada se acabou!
verses.RVR09: Que levantarás esta parábola sobre el rey de Babilonia, y dirás: ¡Cómo paró el exactor, cómo cesó la ciudad codiciosa del oro!

verses.KJV: The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
verses.WEB: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath broken the staff of the wicked, the sceptre of the rulers;
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR quebrou o bastão dos perversos, o cetro dos que dominavam,
verses.RVR09: Quebrantó Jehová el bastón de los impíos, el cetro de los señores;

verses.KJV: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
verses.WEB: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
verses.ASV: that smote the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, that ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that none restrained.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que feria aos povos com furor com golpes sem fim, que com ira dominava as nações, perseguindo sem compaixão.
verses.RVR09: Al que con ira hería los pueblos de llaga permanente, el cual se enseñoreaba de las gentes con furor, y las perseguía con crueldad.

verses.KJV: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.WEB: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.
verses.ASV: The whole earth is at rest, [and] is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra descansa, já está sossegada; gritam de prazer com alegria.
verses.RVR09: Descansó, sosegó toda la tierra: cantaron alabanza.

verses.KJV: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
verses.WEB: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
verses.ASV: Yea, the fir-trees rejoice at thee, [and] the cedars of Lebanon, [saying], Since thou art laid low, no hewer is come up against us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até os pinheiros se alegram por causa de ti, e os cedros do Líbano, dizendo: Desde que caíste, ninguém mais sobe contra nós para nos cortar.
verses.RVR09: Aun las hayas se holgaron de ti, y los cedros del Líbano, diciendo: Desde que tú pereciste, no ha subido cortador contra nosotros.

verses.KJV: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.WEB: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.ASV: Sheol from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming; it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Xeol desde as profundezas se agitou por causa de ti, para sair ao teu encontro em tua chegada; por causa de ti ele despertou os mortos, todos os líderes da terra, e fez levantar de seus tronos todos os reis das nações.
verses.RVR09: El infierno abajo se espantó de ti; te despertó muertos que en tu venida saliesen á recibirte, hizo levantar de sus sillas á todos los príncipes de la tierra, á todos los reyes de las naciones.

verses.KJV: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
verses.WEB: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
verses.ASV: All they shall answer and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos eles responderão e te dirão: Tu te enfraqueceste como nós, e te tornaste semelhante a nós.
verses.RVR09: Todos ellos darán voces, y te dirán: ¿Tú también enfermaste como nosotros, y como nosotros fuiste?

verses.KJV: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
verses.WEB: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
verses.ASV: Thy pomp is brought down to Sheol, [and] the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and worms cover thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua soberba foi derrubada ao Xeol, assim como o som de tuas harpas; larvas se espalharão por debaixo de ti, e vermes te cobrirão.
verses.RVR09: Descendió al sepulcro tu soberbia, y el sonido de tus vihuelas: gusanos serán tu cama, y gusanos te cubrirán.

verses.KJV: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
verses.WEB: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
verses.ASV: How art thou fallen from heaven, O day-star, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, that didst lay low the nations!
verses.ALMEIDA: Como caíste do céu, ó “luminoso”, filho do amanhecer! Cortado foste até a terra, tu que enfraquecias as nações!
verses.RVR09: ¡Cómo caiste del cielo, oh Lucero, hijo de la mañana! Cortado fuiste por tierra, tú que debilitabas las gentes.

verses.KJV: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.WEB: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!
verses.ASV: And thou saidst in thy heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God; and I will sit upon the mount of congregation, in the uttermost parts of the north;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizias em teu coração: Subirei ao céu; levantarei o meu trono acima das estrelas de Deus, e me sentarei no monte da congregação, nas regiões distantes do norte.
verses.RVR09: Tú que decías en tu corazón: Subiré al cielo, en lo alto junto á las estrellas de Dios ensalzaré mi solio, y en el monte del testimonio me sentaré, á los lados del aquilón;

verses.KJV: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
verses.WEB: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”
verses.ASV: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subirei sobre as alturas das nuvens, e serei semelhante ao Altíssimo!
verses.RVR09: Sobre las alturas de las nubes subiré, y seré semejante al Altísimo.

verses.KJV: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
verses.WEB: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
verses.ASV: Yet thou shalt be brought down to Sheol, to the uttermost parts of the pit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu serás derrubado ao Xeol, às profundezas da cova.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú derribado eres en el sepulcro, á los lados de la huesa.

verses.KJV: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.WEB: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,
verses.ASV: They that see thee shall gaze at thee, they shall consider thee, [saying], Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que te olharem prestarão atenção em ti, pensarão, [e dirão] : É este o homem que abalava a terra, e fazia os reinos tremerem?
verses.RVR09: Inclinarse han hacia ti los que te vieren, te considerarán diciendo: ¿Es este aquel varón que hacía temblar la tierra, que trastornaba los reinos;

verses.KJV: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
verses.WEB: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
verses.ASV: that made the world as a wilderness, and overthrew the cities thereof; that let not loose his prisoners to their home?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que fazia do mundo como um deserto, e arruinava suas cidades? Que nunca soltava seus prisioneiros para [suas] casas?
verses.RVR09: Que puso el mundo como un desierto, que asoló sus ciudades; que á sus presos nunca abrió la cárcel?

verses.KJV: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.WEB: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
verses.ASV: All the kings of the nations, all of them, sleep in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os reis das nações, eles todos, jazem com honra, cada um em sua própria casa.
verses.RVR09: Todos los reyes de las gentes, todos ellos yacen con honra cada uno en su casa.

verses.KJV: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
verses.WEB: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
verses.ASV: But thou art cast forth away from thy sepulchre like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, that are thrust through with the sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a dead body trodden under foot.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu és lançado de tua sepultura, como um ramo repugnante, [como] as roupas dos que foram mortos, traspassados à espada; [como] os que descem às pedras da cova, como um corpo pisoteado.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú echado eres de tu sepulcro como tronco abominable, como vestido de muertos pasados á cuchillo, que descendieron al fondo de la sepultura; como cuerpo muerto hollado.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
verses.WEB: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, thou hast slain thy people; the seed of evil-doers shall not be named for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se juntará a eles na sepultura, porque destruíste tua terra, [e] mataste a teu povo; a semente dos malignos não será nomeada para sempre.
verses.RVR09: No serás contado con ellos en la sepultura: porque tú destruiste tu tierra, mataste tu pueblo. No será nombrada para siempre la simiente de los malignos.

verses.KJV: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.WEB: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
verses.ASV: Prepare ye slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers, that they rise not up, and possess the earth, and fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Preparai a matança para seus filhos por causa da maldade de seus pais; para que não se levantem, e tomem posse da terra, e encham a face do mundo de cidades.
verses.RVR09: Aparejad sus hijos para el matadero por la maldad de sus padres: no se levanten, ni posean la tierra, é hinchan la haz del mundo de ciudades.

verses.KJV: For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “I will rise up against them,” says the LORD of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And I will rise up against them, saith Jehovah of hosts, and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque me levantarei contra eles,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos; e cortarei para eliminar da Babilônia o nome e os restantes, o filho e o neto, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo me levantaré sobre ellos, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, y raeré de Babilonia el nombre y las reliquias, hijo y nieto, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu a porei como propriedade de corujas, e poças d´água; e a varrerei com a vassoura da destruição,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Y convertiréla en posesión de erizos, y en lagunas de agua; y la barreré con escobas de destrucción, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.ASV: Jehovah of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely, as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR dos exércitos jurou, dizendo: Com certeza acontecerá assim como pensei, e será comprido assim como determinei.
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos juró, diciendo: Ciertamente se hará de la manera que lo he pensado, y será confirmado como lo he determinado:

verses.KJV: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
verses.WEB: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
verses.ASV: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quebrarei a Assíria em minha terra, e em minhas montanhas eu a esmagarei; para que seu jugo se afaste deles, e sua carga seja tirada de seus ombros.
verses.RVR09: Que quebrantaré al Asirio en mi tierra, y en mis montes lo hollaré; y su yugo será apartado de ellos, y su carga será quitada de su hombro.

verses.KJV: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.WEB: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
verses.ASV: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este é o plano determinado para toda a terra; e esta é a mão que está estendida sobre todas as nações.
verses.RVR09: Este es el consejo que está acordado sobre toda la tierra; y ésta, la mano extendida sobre todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.WEB: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
verses.ASV: For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall annul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o SENHOR dos exércitos já determinou; quem invalidará? E sua mão já está estendida; quem [a] retrocederá?
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová de los ejércitos ha determinado: ¿y quién invalidará? Y su mano extendida, ¿quién la hará tornar?

verses.KJV: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.WEB: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.
verses.ASV: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano em que o rei Acaz morreu, houve esta revelação:
verses.RVR09: En el año que murió el rey Achâz fué esta carga:

verses.KJV: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.WEB: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.ASV: Rejoice not, O Philistia, all of thee, because the rod that smote thee is broken; for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth an adder, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te alegres, ó tu, Filisteia inteira, por ter sido quebrada a vara que te feria; porque da raiz da cobra sairá uma víbora, e seu fruto será uma venenosa serpente voadora.
verses.RVR09: No te alegres tú, Filistea toda, por haberse quebrado la vara del que te hería; porque de la raíz de la culebra saldrá basilisco, y su fruto, ceraste volador.

verses.KJV: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
verses.WEB: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
verses.ASV: And the first-born of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety; and I will kill thy root with famine, and thy remnant shall be slain.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os mais pobres serão apascentados, e os necessitados deitarão em segurança; porém farei tua raiz morrer de fome, e ela matará teus sobreviventes.
verses.RVR09: Y los primogénitos de los pobres serán apacentados, y los menesterosos se acostarán seguramente: mas yo haré morir de hambre tu raíz, y mataré tus reliquias.

verses.KJV: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
verses.WEB: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
verses.ASV: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou art melted away, O Philistia, all of thee; for there cometh a smoke out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uiva, ó porta! Grita, ó cidade! Tu, Filisteia inteira, estás a ser derretida; porque do norte vem fumaça, e não há solitário em seus batalhões.
verses.RVR09: Aulla, oh puerta; clama, oh ciudad; disuelta estás toda tú, Filistea: porque humo vendrá de aquilón, no quedará uno solo en sus asambleas.

verses.KJV: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
verses.WEB: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
verses.ASV: What then shall one answer the messengers of the nation? That Jehovah hath founded Zion, and in her shall the afflicted of his people take refuge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que, pois, se responderá aos mensageiros d [aquela] nação? Que o SENHOR fundou a Sião, e que nela os oprimidos de seu povo terão refúgio.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y qué se responderá á los mensajeros de la gentilidad? Que Jehová fundó á Sión, y que á ella se acogerán los afligidos de su pueblo.

verses.KJV: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
verses.WEB: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.
verses.ASV: The burden of Moab. For in a night Ar of Moab is laid waste, [and] brought to nought; for in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, [and] brought to nought.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre Moabe: Certamente em uma noite é destruída Ar-Moabe; [e] é devastada; certamente em uma noite é destruída Quir-Moabe, [e] é devastada.
verses.RVR09: CARGA de Moab. Cierto, de noche fué destruída Ar-moab, fué puesta en silencio. Cierto, de noche fué destruída Kir-moab, reducida á silencio.

verses.KJV: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
verses.WEB: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.
verses.ASV: They are gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep: Moab waileth over Nebo, and over Medeba; on all their heads is baldness, every beard is cut off.
