verses.ALMEIDA: [Os moradores] sobem ao templo, e a Dibom, aos lugares altos, para chorar; Moabe grita de lamento por Nebo e por Medeba; em todas as suas cabeças há calva, e toda barba está raspada.
verses.RVR09: Subió á Bayith y á Dibón, lugares altos, á llorar; sobre Nebo y sobre Medeba aullará Moab: toda cabeza de ella será raída, y toda barba se mesará.

verses.KJV: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
verses.WEB: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.
verses.ASV: In their streets they gird themselves with sackcloth; on their housetops, and in their broad places, every one waileth, weeping abundantly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se vestem de sacos em suas ruas; em seus terraços, e em suas praças todos andam gritando de lamento, e descem chorando.
verses.RVR09: Ceñiránse de sacos en sus plazas: en sus terrados y en sus calles aullarán todos, descendiendo en llanto.

verses.KJV: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
verses.WEB: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.
verses.ASV: And Heshbon crieth out, and Elealeh; their voice is heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud; his soul trembleth within him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tanto Hesbom como Eleale vão gritando, até Jaaz se ouve sua voz; por causa disso os soldados armados de Moabe gritam, a alma de cada um está abalada dentro de si.
verses.RVR09: Hesbón y Eleale gritarán, hasta Jahas se oirá su voz: por lo que aullarán los armados de Moab, lamentaráse el alma de cada uno de por sí.

verses.KJV: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.WEB: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.ASV: My heart crieth out for Moab; her nobles [flee] unto Zoar, to Eglath-shelishi-yah: for by the ascent of Luhith with weeping they go up; for in the way of Horonaim they raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu coração dá gritos por Moabe, seus fugitivos [foram] até Zoar [e] Eglate-Selisia; pois sobem com choro pela subida de Luíte, pois no caminho de Horonaim levantam um grito de desespero.
verses.RVR09: Mi corazón dará gritos por Moab; sus fugitivos huirán hasta Zoar, como novilla de tres años. Por la cuesta de Luhith subirán llorando, y levantarán grito de quebrantamiento por el camino de Horonaim.

verses.KJV: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
verses.WEB: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.
verses.ASV: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate; for the grass is withered away, the tender grass faileth, there is no green thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois as águas de Ninrim se acabaram; pois a grama se secou, as plantas pereceram, e não há mais vegetal verde.
verses.RVR09: Las aguas de Nimrim serán consumidas, y secaráse la hierba, marchitaránse los retoños, todo verdor perecerá.

verses.KJV: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
verses.WEB: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.
verses.ASV: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away over the brook of the willows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso levarão os bens que acumularam e seus pertences ao ribeiro dos salgueiros.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto las riquezas que habrán adquirido, y las que habrán reservado, llevaránlas al torrente de los sauces.

verses.KJV: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.
verses.WEB: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.
verses.ASV: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the wailing thereof unto Eglaim, and the wailing thereof unto Beer-elim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o pranto rodeia aos limites de Moabe; até Eglaim chega seu grito de lamento, e até Beer-Elim sua lamentação.
verses.RVR09: Porque el llanto rodeó los términos de Moab; hasta Eglaim llegó su alarido, y hasta Beer-elim su clamor.

verses.KJV: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
verses.WEB: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.
verses.ASV: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more upon Dimon, a lion upon them of Moab that escape, and upon the remnant of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois as águas de Dimom estão cheias de sangue, porém porei em Dimom ainda outros mais: um leão aos que escaparem de Moabe, e aos sobreviventes da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y las aguas de Dimón se henchirán de sangre: porque yo pondré sobre Dimón añadiduras, leones á los que escaparen de Moab, y á las reliquias de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.WEB: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
verses.ASV: Send ye the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enviai os cordeiros ao dominador da terra desde Sela pelo deserto, ao monte da filha de Sião.
verses.RVR09: ENVIAD cordero al enseñoreador de la tierra, desde la Piedra del desierto al monte de la hija de Sión.

verses.KJV: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
verses.WEB: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
verses.ASV: For it shall be that, as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so shall the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois será que, como o pássaro vagueante, lançado do ninho, assim serão as filhas de Moabe junto aos vaus de Arnom.
verses.RVR09: Y será que cual ave espantada que se huye de su nido, así serán las hijas de Moab en los vados de Arnón.

verses.KJV: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
verses.WEB: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!
verses.ASV: Give counsel, execute justice; make thy shade as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; betray not the fugitive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma conselho, faze juízo, põe tua sombra no pino do meio dia como a noite; esconde aos exilados, [e] não exponhas os fugitivos.
verses.RVR09: Reune consejo, haz juicio; pon tu sombra en medio del día como la noche: esconde los desterrados, no entregues á los que andan errantes.

verses.KJV: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.WEB: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.ASV: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee; as for Moab, be thou a covert to him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortioner is brought to nought, destruction ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Habitem entre ti teus prisioneiros, Moabe; sê tu refúgio para eles da presença do destruidor, porque o opressor terá fim, a destruição terminará, e os esmagadores serão consumidos de sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Moren contigo mis desterrados, oh Moab; séles escondedero de la presencia del destruidor: porque el atormentador fenecerá, el destruidor tendrá fin, el hollador será consumido de sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
verses.WEB: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
verses.ASV: And a throne shall be established in lovingkindness; and one shall sit thereon in truth, in the tent of David, judging, and seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o trono se firmará em bondade, e sobre ele no tabernáculo de Davi em verdade se sentará um que julgue, e busque o juízo, e se apresse para a justiça.
verses.RVR09: Y dispondráse trono en misericordia; y sobre él se sentará firmemente, en el tabernáculo de David, quien juzgue y busque el juicio, y apresure la justicia.

verses.KJV: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
verses.WEB: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
verses.ASV: We have heard of the pride of Moab, [that] he is very proud; even of his arrogancy, and his pride, and his wrath; his boastings are nought.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já ouvimos a soberba de Moabe, o arrogante ao extremo; sua arrogância, soberba e furor, [mas] seus orgulhos não são [firmes] .
verses.RVR09: Oído hemos la soberbia de Moab, por extremo soberbio; su soberbia y su arrogancia, y su altivez; mas sus mentiras no serán firmes.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
verses.WEB: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall Moab wail for Moab, every one shall wail: for the raisin-cakes of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn, utterly stricken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso Moabe gritará de lamento por Moabe; todos eles gritarão de lamento; gemereis pelos fundamentos de Quir-Haresete, pois estão quebrados.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto aullará Moab, todo él aullará: gemiréis por los fundamentos de Kir-hareseth, en gran manera heridos.

verses.KJV: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
verses.WEB: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.
verses.ASV: For the fields of Heshbon languish, [and] the vine of Sibmah; the lords of the nations have broken down the choice branches thereof, which reached even unto Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness; its shoots were spread abroad, they passed over the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os campos de Hesbom enfraqueceram, [e também] a vinha de Sibma, os senhores das nações esmagaram suas melhores plantas, que chegavam a Jezer, [e] alcançavam o deserto; seus ramos se estendiam, e passavam até o mar.
verses.RVR09: Porque los campos de Hesbón fueron talados, y las vides de Sibma; señores de gentes hollaron sus generosos sarmientos; habían llegado hasta Jazer, y extendídose por el desierto; extendiéronse sus plantas, pasaron la mar.

verses.KJV: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.
verses.ASV: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah; I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for upon thy summer fruits and upon thy harvest the [battle] shout is fallen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso lamentarei com pranto por Jezer, a vide de Sibma; eu te regarei com minhas lágrimas, ó Hesbom e Eleale; pois a alegria de teus frutos de verão e de tua colheita caiu.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual lamentaré con lloro de Jazer la viña de Sibma; embriagarte hé de mis lágrimas, oh Hesbón y Eleale: porque sobre tus cosechas y sobre tu siega caerá la algazara.

verses.KJV: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
verses.WEB: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
verses.ASV: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither joyful noise: no treader shall tread out wine in the presses; I have made the [vintage] shout to cease.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foram tirados a alegria e o prazer do campo frutífero; e nas vinhas não se canta, nem grito de alegria se faz; o pisador não pisará as uvas nas prensas; eu pus fim aos clamores de alegria.
verses.RVR09: Quitado es el gozo y la alegría del campo fértil; en las viñas no cantarán, ni se regocijarán; no pisará vino en los lagares el pisador: la canción he hecho cesar.

verses.KJV: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
verses.WEB: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.
verses.ASV: Wherefore my heart soundeth like a harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-heres.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meus órgãos fazem ruído por Moabe como um harpa; e meu interior por Quir- Heres.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto mis entrañas sonarán como arpa acerca de Moab, y mi interior en orden á Kir-hareseth.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
verses.WEB: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when Moab presenteth himself, when he wearieth himself upon the high place, and shall come to his sanctuary to pray, that he shall not prevail.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, quando [o povo de] Moabe se apresentar e se cansar nos lugares altos, e entrarem em seus templo para orar, nada conseguirão.
verses.RVR09: Y acaecerá, que cuando Moab pareciere que está cansado sobre los altos, entonces vendrá á su santuario á orar, y no le valdrá.

verses.KJV: This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.WEB: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.
verses.ASV: This is the word that Jehovah spake concerning Moab in time past.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a palavra que o SENHOR falou sobre Moabe desde então.
verses.RVR09: Esta es la palabra que pronunció Jehová sobre Moab desde aquel tiempo.

verses.KJV: But now the Lord hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
verses.WEB: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
verses.ASV: But now Jehovah hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of a hireling, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and of no account.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas agora [assim] fala o SENHOR, dizendo: Dentro de três anos, (tais como anos de empregado), então se tornará desprezível a glória de Moabe, com toda a sua grande multidão; e os restantes serão muito poucos e sem poder.
verses.RVR09: Empero ahora Jehová ha hablado, diciendo: Dentro de tres años, como años de mozo de soldada, será abatida la gloria de Moab, con toda su grande multitud: y los residuos serán pocos, pequeños, y no fuertes.

verses.KJV: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.WEB: The burden of Damascus. “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.
verses.ASV: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre Damasco: Eis que Damasco será tirada [de tal maneira] que não será mais uma cidade, mas sim, um amontoado de ruínas.
verses.RVR09: CARGA de Damasco. He aquí que Damasco dejó de ser ciudad, y será montón de ruina.

verses.KJV: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.WEB: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.
verses.ASV: The cities of Aroer are forsaken; they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: As cidades de Aroer serão abandonadas; serão para os rebanhos, e [ali] se deitarão, sem haver quem os espante.
verses.RVR09: Las ciudades de Aroer desamparadas, en majadas se tornarán; dormirán allí, y no habrá quien los espante.

verses.KJV: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: And the fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria; they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a fortaleza de Efraim se acabará, como também o reino de Damasco, e os restantes dos sírios; serão como a glória dos filhos de Israel,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Y cesará el socorro de Ephraim, y el reino de Damasco; y lo que quedare de Siria, será como la gloria de los hijos de Israel, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.WEB: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia, que a glória de Jacó se definhará, e a gordura de sua carne emagrecerá;
verses.RVR09: Y será que en aquel tiempo la gloria de Jacob se atenuará, y enflaqueceráse la grosura de su carne.

verses.KJV: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.WEB: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ASV: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the standing grain, and his arm reapeth the ears; yea, it shall be as when one gleaneth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois será como o ceifeiro, que colhe os grãos, e com seu braço ceifa as espigas; será também como o que colhe espigas no vale de Refaim.
verses.RVR09: Y será como cuando el segador coge la mies, y con su brazo siega las espigas: será también como el que coge espigas en el valle de Rephaim.

verses.KJV: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the Lord God of Israel.
verses.WEB: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: Yet there shall be left therein gleanings, as the shaking of an olive-tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost branches of a fruitful tree, saith Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ainda ficarão nele [algumas] sobras, como no sacudir da oliveira, dois [ou] três azeitonas [ficam] na ponta mais alta dos ramos, e quatro [ou] cinco em seus ramos frutíferos,diz o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y quedarán en él rebuscos, como cuando sacuden el aceituno, dos ó tres granos en la punta del ramo, cuatro ó cinco en sus ramas fructíferas, dice Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: In that day shall men look unto their Maker, and their eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia o homem dará atenção ao seu Criador, e seus olhos olharão ao Santo de Israel;
verses.RVR09: En aquel día mirará el hombre á su Hacedor, y sus ojos contemplarán al Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
verses.WEB: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.
verses.ASV: And they shall not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they have respect to that which their fingers have made, either the Asherim, or the sun-images.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não dará atenção aos altares, obra de suas [próprias] mãos, nem olharão para o que seus [próprios] dedos fizeram, nem para os mastros de Aserá, nem para os altares de incenso.
verses.RVR09: Y no mirará á los altares que hicieron sus manos, ni mirará á lo que hicieron sus dedos, ni á los bosques, ni á las imágenes del sol.

verses.KJV: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
verses.WEB: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.
verses.ASV: In that day shall their strong cities be as the forsaken places in the wood and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it shall be a desolation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia suas cidades fortificadas serão como plantas abandonadas e os mais altos ramos, os quais eles abandonaram por causa dos filhos de Israel. E haverá assolação,
verses.RVR09: En aquel día las ciudades de su fortaleza serán como los frutos que quedan en los pimpollos y en las ramas, las cuales fueron dejadas á causa de los hijos de Israel; y habrá asolamiento.

verses.KJV: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
verses.WEB: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.
verses.ASV: For thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength; therefore thou plantest pleasant plants, and settest it with strange slips.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois te esqueceste do Deus de tua salvação, e não te lembraste da rocha de tua fortaleza. Por isso, tu cultivarás belas plantas, e as cercarás de ramos estranhos.
verses.RVR09: Porque te olvidaste del Dios de tu salud, y no te acordaste de la roca de tu fortaleza; por tanto plantarás plantas hermosas, y sembrarás sarmiento extraño.

verses.KJV: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
verses.WEB: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
verses.ASV: In the day of thy planting thou hedgest it in, and in the morning thou makest thy seed to blossom; but the harvest fleeth away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: No dia que as plantares, tu as farás crescer, e pela manhã farás com que tua semente brote; porém a colheita será perdida no dia de sofrimento e de dores insuportáveis.
verses.RVR09: El día que las plantares, las harás crecer, y harás que tu simiente brote de mañana; mas la cosecha será arrebatada en el día del coger, y del dolor desesperado.

verses.KJV: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.WEB: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.ASV: Ah, the uproar of many peoples, that roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations, that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai da multidão dos muitos povos, que bramam como o bramido do mar; e do rugido das nações, que rugem como o rugido de águas impetuosas.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay! multitud de muchos pueblos que harán ruido como estruendo de la mar: y murmullo de naciones hará alboroto como murmurio de muchas aguas.

verses.KJV: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
verses.WEB: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.
verses.ASV: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but he shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.
verses.ALMEIDA: As nações rugirão, como o rugido de muitas águas, porém [Deus] as repreenderá, e elas fugirão para longe. Serão levadas a fugirem como restos de palhas nos montes diante do vento, como coisas que rolam perante um redemoinho.
verses.RVR09: Los pueblos harán estrépito á manera de ruido de grandes aguas: mas Dios le reprenderá, y huirá lejos; será ahuyentado como el tamo de los montes delante del viento, y como el polvo delante del torbellino.

verses.KJV: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
verses.WEB: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.
verses.ASV: At eventide, behold, terror; [and] before the morning they are not. This is the portion of them that despoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao tempo da tarde eis que há pavor; [mas] antes que amanheça não há mais: Esta é a parte daqueles que nos despojam, e o futuro reservado para aqueles que nos saqueiam.
verses.RVR09: Al tiempo de la tarde he aquí turbación; y antes de la mañana ya no es. Esta es la parte de los que nos huellan, y la suerte de los que nos saquean.

verses.KJV: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
verses.WEB: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;
verses.ASV: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai da terra dos zumbidos de asas, que está além dos rios de Cuxe,
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de la tierra que hace sombra con las alas, que está tras los ríos de Etiopía;

verses.KJV: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
verses.WEB: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”
verses.ASV: that sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus upon the waters, [saying], Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people terrible from their beginning onward, a nation that meteth out and treadeth down, whose land the rivers divide!
verses.ALMEIDA: Que envia embaixadores pelo mar, e em navios de junco sobre as águas, [com a ordem] : Ide, mensageiros velozes, a uma nação [de gente] alta e de pele lisa, a um povo temido desde seus territórios afora, uma nação dominadora e esmagadora, cuja terra os rios dividem.
verses.RVR09: Que envía mensajeros por la mar, y en navíos de junco sobre las aguas! Andad, ligeros mensajeros, á la gente tirada y repelada, al pueblo asombroso desde su principio y después; gente harta de esperar y hollada, cuya tierra destruyeron los ríos.

verses.KJV: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
verses.WEB: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!
verses.ASV: All ye inhabitants of the world, and ye dwellers on the earth, when an ensign is lifted up on the mountains, see ye; and when the trumpet is blown, hear ye.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós todos, habitantes do mundo, e vós, moradores da terra, vede quando for levantada a bandeira [nos] montes, e ouvi quando for tocada a trombeta.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros, todos los moradores del mundo y habitantes de la tierra, cuando levantará bandera en los montes, la veréis; y oiréis cuando tocará trompeta.

verses.KJV: For so the Lord said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.WEB: For the LORD said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
verses.ASV: For thus hath Jehovah said unto me, I will be still, and I will behold in my dwelling-place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim me disse o SENHOR: Estarei quieto olhando desde minha morada, como o calor ardente da luz do sol, como a nuvem de orvalho no calor da ceifa.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová me dijo así: Reposaréme, y miraré desde mi morada, como sol claro después de la lluvia, como nube de rocío en el calor de la tierra.

verses.KJV: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
verses.WEB: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.
verses.ASV: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becometh a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning-hooks, and the spreading branches will he take away [and] cut down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque antes da ceifa, quando a flor já se acabou, e as uvas brotam prestes a amadurecer, então ele podará as vides com a foice e, tendo cortado os ramos, ele os tirará [dali] .
verses.RVR09: Porque antes de la siega, cuando el fruto fuere perfecto, y pasada la flor fueren madurando los frutos, entonces podará con podaderas los ramitos, y cortará y quitará las ramas.

verses.KJV: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
verses.WEB: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.
verses.ASV: They shall be left together unto the ravenous birds of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth; and the ravenous birds shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles serão deixados juntos para as aves dos montes, e para os animais da terra; e sobre eles as aves passarão o verão, e todos os animais da terra passarão o inverno sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y serán dejados todos á las aves de los montes, y á las bestias de la tierra; sobre ellos tendrán el verano las aves, é invernarán todas las bestias de la tierra.

verses.KJV: In that time shall the present be brought unto the Lord of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the Lord of hosts, the mount Zion.
verses.WEB: In that time, a present will be brought to the LORD of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of the LORD of Armies, Mount Zion.
verses.ASV: In that time shall a present be brought unto Jehovah of hosts [from] a people tall and smooth, even from a people terrible from their beginning onward, a nation that meteth out and treadeth down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Jehovah of hosts, the mount Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo, será trazido um presente ao SENHOR dos exércitos por um povo alto e de pele lisa, e um povo temível desde seus territórios afora; uma nação dominadora e esmagadora, cuja terra rios dividem, ao lugar que pertence ao nome do SENHOR dos exércitos, ao monte de Sião.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo será traído presente á Jehová de los ejércitos, el pueblo tirado y repelado, pueblo asombroso desde su principio y después; gente harta de esperar y hollada, cuya tierra destruyeron los ríos; al lugar del nombre de Jehová de los ejércitos, al monte de Sión.

verses.KJV: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.WEB: The burden of Egypt. “Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.
verses.ASV: The burden of Egypt. Behold, Jehovah rideth upon a swift cloud, and cometh unto Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre o Egito: Eis que o SENHOR vem montado numa veloz nuvem, e ele virá ao Egito; e os ídolos do Egito tremerão perante sua presença; e o coração dos egípcios se derreterá dentro de si;
verses.RVR09: CARGA de Egipto. He aquí que Jehová monta sobre una ligera nube, y entrará en Egipto; y los ídolos de Egipto se moverán delante de él, y desleiráse el corazón de los Egipcios en medio de ellos.

verses.KJV: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.WEB: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.ASV: And I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbor; city against city, [and] kingdom against kingdom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque instigarei egípcios contra egípcios, e cada um lutará contra seu irmão, e cada um contra seu próximo; cidade contra cidade, reino contra reino.
verses.RVR09: Y revolveré Egipcios contra Egipcios, y cada uno peleará contra su hermano, cada uno contra su prójimo: ciudad contra ciudad, y reino contra reino.

verses.KJV: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
verses.WEB: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.
verses.ASV: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst of it; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek unto the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o espírito dos egípcios se esvaziará dentro de si, e destruirei seu conselho; então eles perguntarão ao ídolos, encantadores, adivinhos que consultam espíritos de mortos, e feiticeiros.
verses.RVR09: Y el espíritu de Egipto se desvanecerá en medio de él, y destruiré su consejo; y preguntarán á sus imágenes, á sus mágicos, á sus pythones y á sus adivinos.

verses.KJV: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
verses.ASV: And I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E entregarei os egípcios nas mãos de um duro senhor, e um rei rigoroso dominará sobre eles,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Y entregaré á Egipto en manos de señor duro; y rey violento se enseñoreará de ellos, dice el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
verses.WEB: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.
verses.ASV: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and become dry.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as águas do mar se acabarão; e o rio se esvaziará e se secará.
verses.RVR09: Y las aguas de la mar faltarán, y el río se agotará y secará.

verses.KJV: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.WEB: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
verses.ASV: And the rivers shall become foul; the streams of Egypt shall be diminished and dried up; the reeds and flags shall wither away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os rios terão mau cheiro; os canais do Egito serão esvaziados e se secarão; as canas e os juncos murcharão.
verses.RVR09: Y alejaránse los ríos, se agotarán y secarán las corrientes de los fosos: la caña y el carrizo serán cortados.

verses.KJV: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.WEB: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.ASV: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, shall become dry, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: A relva junto ao rio, junto às margens dos rio, e todas as plantações junto ao rio se secarão, serão removidas, e se perderão.
verses.RVR09: Las verduras de junto al río, de junto á la ribera del río, y toda sementera del río, se secarán, se perderán, y no serán.

verses.KJV: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.WEB: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.
verses.ASV: And the fishers shall lament, and all they that cast angle into the Nile shall mourn, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os pescadores gemerão e todos os que lançam anzol no rio lamentarão; e os que estendem rede sobre as águas perderão o ânimo.
verses.RVR09: Los pescadores también se entristecerán; y harán duelo todos los que echan anzuelo en el río, y desfallecerán los que extienden red sobre las aguas.

verses.KJV: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
verses.WEB: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.
verses.ASV: Moreover they that work in combed flax, and they that weave white cloth, shall be confounded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ficarão envergonhados os que trabalham com linho fino e os que tecem panos brancos.
verses.RVR09: Los que labran lino fino, y los que tejen redes, serán confundidos;

verses.KJV: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
verses.WEB: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.
verses.ASV: And the pillars [of Egypt] shall be broken in pieces; all they that work for hire [shall be] grieved in soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os fundamentos serão quebrados, e os empregados sentirão aflição na alma.
verses.RVR09: Porque todas sus redes serán rotas: y se entristecerán todos los que hacen viveros para peces.

verses.KJV: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.WEB: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?
verses.ASV: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish; the counsel of the wisest counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.ALMEIDA: Na verdade, os príncipes de Zoã são uns tolos; o conselho dos “sábios” de Faraó se tornou imprudente. Como é que dizeis a Faraó: Sou filho de sábios, sou descendente dos antigos reis?
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente son necios los príncipes de Zoán; el consejo de los prudentes consejeros de Faraón, se ha desvanecido. ¿Cómo diréis á Faraón: Yo soy hijo de los sabios, é hijo de los reyes antiguos?

verses.KJV: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the Lord of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
verses.WEB: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what the LORD of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.
verses.ASV: Where then are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now; and let them know what Jehovah of hosts hath purposed concerning Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde estão agora os teus sábios? Avisem-te, pois, e informem o que o SENHOR dos exércitos determinou contra o Egito.
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde están ahora aquellos tus prudentes? Dígante ahora, ó hágante saber qué es lo que Jehová de los ejércitos ha determinado sobre Egipto.

verses.KJV: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
verses.WEB: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.
verses.ASV: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Memphis are deceived; they have caused Egypt to go astray, that are the corner-stone of her tribes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os príncipes de Zoã se tornaram tolos, os príncipes de Nofe estão enganados; e o Egito será levado ao erro pelos [que são] pedra de esquina de suas tribos.
verses.RVR09: Hanse desvanecido los príncipes de Zoán, se han engañado los príncipes de Noph: engañaron á Egipto las esquinas de sus familias.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
verses.WEB: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath mingled a spirit of perverseness in the midst of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR derramou um espírito de confusão em seu interior, e levaram o Egito a errar em toda a sua obra, tal como o bêbado que se revolve em seu vômito.
verses.RVR09: Jehová mezcló espíritu de vahido en medio de él; é hicieron errar á Egipto en toda su obra, como desatina el borracho en su vómito.

verses.KJV: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
verses.WEB: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.
verses.ASV: Neither shall there be for Egypt any work, which head or tail, palm-branch or rush, may do.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não haverá obra alguma que a cabeça ou a cauda, o ramo ou o junco, possa fazer para proveito do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y no aprovechará á Egipto cosa que haga la cabeza ó la cola, el ramo ó el junco.

verses.KJV: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
verses.WEB: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the LORD of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.
verses.ASV: In that day shall the Egyptians be like unto women; and they shall tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Jehovah of hosts, which he shaketh over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia os egípcios serão como mulheres; e tremerão e temerão por causa do mover da mão do SENHOR dos exércitos, que moverá contra eles.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día serán los Egipcios como mujeres; porque se asombrarán y temerán, en la presencia de la mano alta de Jehová de los ejércitos, que él ha de levantar sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
verses.WEB: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of the LORD of Armies, which he determines against it.
verses.ASV: And the land of Judah shall become a terror unto Egypt; every one to whom mention is made thereof shall be afraid, because of the purpose of Jehovah of hosts, which he purposeth against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra de Judá será um assombro ao egípcios; todo aquele que dela lhe mencionarem, terá medo dentro de si, por causa da determinação do SENHOR dos exércitos, que determinou contra eles.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra de Judá será de espanto á Egipto; todo hombre que de ella se acordare se asombrará, por causa del consejo que Jehová de los ejércitos acordó sobre aquél.

verses.KJV: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the Lord of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
verses.WEB: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”
verses.ASV: In that day there shall be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Jehovah of hosts; one shall be called The city of destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia haverá cinco cidades na terra do Egito que falem a língua de Canaã e prestem juramento ao SENHOR dos exércitos; uma delas será chamada Cidade da Destruição.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo habrá cinco ciudades en la tierra de Egipto que hablen la lengua de Canaán, y que juren por Jehová de los ejércitos: una será llamada la ciudad Herez.

verses.KJV: In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord.
verses.WEB: In that day, there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.
verses.ASV: In that day shall there be an altar to Jehovah in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia haverá um altar ao SENHOR no meio do Egito, e uma coluna ao SENHOR junto a sua fronteira.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo habrá altar para Jehová en medio de la tierra de Egipto, y el trofeo de Jehová junto á su término.

verses.KJV: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
verses.WEB: It will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.
verses.ASV: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto Jehovah of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they shall cry unto Jehovah because of oppressors, and he will send them a saviour, and a defender, and he will deliver them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isso servirá como sinal e como testemunho ao SENHOR dos exércitos na terra do Egito; pois clamarão ao SENHOR por causa de seus opressores, e ele lhes mandará um salvador e defensor que os livre.
verses.RVR09: Y será por señal y por testimonio á Jehová de los ejércitos en la tierra de Egipto: porque á Jehová clamarán á causa de sus opresores, y él les enviará salvador y príncipe que los libre.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the Lord in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the Lord, and perform it.
verses.WEB: The LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to the LORD, and will perform it.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know Jehovah in that day; yea, they shall worship with sacrifice and oblation, and shall vow a vow unto Jehovah, and shall perform it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR se fará conhecido no Egito, e os egípcios conhecerão ao SENHOR naquele dia; e eles o servirão [com] sacrifícios e ofertas, e farão votos ao SENHOR, e [os] cumprirão.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová será conocido de Egipto, y los de Egipto conocerán á Jehová en aquel día; y harán sacrificio y oblación; y harán votos á Jehová, y los cumplirán.

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the Lord, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
verses.WEB: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah will smite Egypt, smiting and healing; and they shall return unto Jehovah, and he will be entreated of them, and will heal them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR ferirá aos egípcios: ferirá mas [os] curará; e eles se converterão ao SENHOR, e ele aceitará suas orações, e os curará.
verses.RVR09: Y herirá Jehová á Egipto, herirá y sanará; y se convertirán á Jehová, y les será clemente, y los sanará.

verses.KJV: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
verses.WEB: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
verses.ASV: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians shall worship with the Assyrians.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia haverá uma estrada do Egito à Assíria; e os assírios virão ao Egito, e os egípcios à Assíria; e os egípcios prestarão culto junto com os assírios.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo habrá una calzada de Egipto á Asiria, y Asirios entrarán en Egipto, y Egipcios en Asiria; y los Egipcios servirán con los Asirios á Jehová.

verses.KJV: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
verses.WEB: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;
verses.ASV: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia Israel será o terceiro entre o Egito e a Assíria, uma bênção no meio da terra;
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo, Israel será tercero con Egipto y con Asiria; será bendición en medio de la tierra;

verses.KJV: Whom the Lord of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
verses.WEB: because the LORD of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”
verses.ASV: for that Jehovah of hosts hath blessed them, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o SENHOR dos exércitos os abençoará, dizendo: Bendito seja o meu povo do Egito, e a Assíria, obra de minhas mãos, e Israel, minha herança.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová de los ejércitos los bendecirá, diciendo: Bendito el pueblo mío Egipto, y el Asirio obra de mis manos, é Israel mi heredad.

verses.KJV: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
verses.WEB: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;
verses.ASV: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;
verses.ALMEIDA: No ano em que o general enviado por Sargom, rei da Assíria, veio a Asdode, guerreou contra Asdode, e a tomou,
verses.RVR09: EN el año que vino Thartán á Asdod, cuando le envió Sargón rey de Asiria, y peleó contra Asdod y la tomó;

verses.KJV: At the same time spake the Lord by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.WEB: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.ASV: at that time Jehovah spake by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go, and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put thy shoe from off thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo o SENHOR falou por meio de Isaías, filho de Amoz, dizendo: Vai, tira a roupa de saco de teus lombos, e descalça a sandália de teus pés.E assim ele fez, andando nu e descalço.
verses.RVR09: En aquel tiempo habló Jehová por Isaías hijo de Amoz, diciendo: Ve, y quita el saco de tus lomos, y descalza los zapatos de tus pies. E hízolo así, andando desnudo y descalzo.

verses.KJV: And the Lord said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,
verses.ASV: And Jehovah said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR disse: Assim como meu servo Isaías anda nu e descalço, [como] sinal e presságio relativo ao Egito e a Cuxe,
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jehová: De la manera que anduvo mi siervo Isaías desnudo y descalzo tres años, señal y pronóstico sobre Egipto y sobre Etiopía;

verses.KJV: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.WEB: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.ASV: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the captives of Egypt, and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: assim o rei da Assíria levará em cativeiro a prisioneiros do Egito e a prisioneiros de Cuxe, tanto jovens, como velhos, nus e descalços, e descobertas as nádegas, para envergonhar ao Egito.
verses.RVR09: Así llevará el rey de Asiria la cautividad de Egipto y la transmigración de Etiopía, de mozos y de viejos, desnuda y descalza, y descubiertas las nalgas para vergüenza de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.WEB: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.ASV: And they shall be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: E terão medo e vergonha por causa de Cuxe, em quem esperavam, e por causa do Egito, no qual se orgulhavam.
verses.RVR09: Y se turbarán y avergonzarán de Etiopía su esperanza, y de Egipto su gloria.

verses.KJV: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
verses.WEB: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”
verses.ASV: And the inhabitant of this coast-land shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and we, how shall we escape?
verses.ALMEIDA: E os moradores do litoral dirão naquele dia: Vede [o que houve com] aqueles em quem esperávamos, a quem buscávamos socorro, para nos livrarmos da presença do rei da Assíria! E [agora] ,como escaparemos?
verses.RVR09: Y dirá en aquel día el morador de esta isla: Mirad qué tal fué nuestra esperanza, donde nos acogimos por socorro para ser libres de la presencia del rey de Asiria: ¿y cómo escaparemos?

verses.KJV: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.WEB: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.
verses.ASV: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it cometh from the wilderness, from a terrible land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre o deserto do mar:Assim como os turbilhões de vento passam pelo Negueve, assim algo vem do deserto, de uma terra temível.
verses.RVR09: CARGA del desierto de la mar. Como los torbellinos que pasan por el desierto en la región del mediodía, así vienen de la tierra horrenda.

verses.KJV: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
verses.WEB: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.
verses.ASV: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous man dealeth treacherously, and the destroyer destroyeth. Go up, O Elam; besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma visão terrível me foi informada: o enganador engana, e o destruidor destrói. Levanta-te, Elão! Faze o cerco, Média! [Pois] estou pondo fim em todos os gemidos que ela [causou] .
verses.RVR09: Visión dura me ha sido mostrada. El prevaricador prevarica, y el destructor destruye. Sube, Persa; cerca, Medo. Todo su gemido hice cesar.

verses.KJV: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
verses.WEB: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.
verses.ASV: Therefore are my loins filled with anguish; pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman in travail: I am pained so that I cannot hear; I am dismayed so that I cannot see.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso meus lombos estão cheios de sofrimento; fui tomado por dores, tais como as dores de parto; fiquei perturbado ao ouvir, e estou horrorizado de ver.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto mis lomos se han llenado de dolor; angustias se apoderaron de mí, como angustias de mujer de parto: agobiéme oyendo, y al ver heme espantado.

verses.KJV: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
verses.WEB: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
verses.ASV: My heart fluttereth, horror hath affrighted me; the twilight that I desired hath been turned into trembling unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meu coração se estremece, o terror me apavora; o anoitecer, que eu desejava, [agora] me causa medo.
verses.RVR09: Pasmóse mi corazón, el horror me ha intimidado; la noche de mi deseo se me tornó en espanto.

verses.KJV: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
verses.WEB: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
verses.ASV: They prepare the table, they set the watch, they eat, they drink: rise up, ye princes, anoint the shield.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles preparam a mesa, estendem tapetes, comem e bebem. Levantai-vos, príncipes! Passai óleo nos escudos!
verses.RVR09: Pon la mesa, mira del atalaya, come, bebe: levantaos, príncipes, ungid el escudo.

verses.KJV: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
verses.WEB: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
verses.ASV: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman; let him declare what he seeth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim me disse o Senhor: Vai, põe um vigilante, [e] ele diga o que estiver vendo.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Señor me dijo así: Ve, pon centinela que haga saber lo que viere.

verses.KJV: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
verses.WEB: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
verses.ASV: and when he seeth a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of asses, a troop of camels, he shall hearken diligently with much heed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caso ele veja uma carruagem, um par de cavaleiros, pessoas montadas em asnos, [ou] pessoas montadas em camelos, ele deve prestar atenção, muita atenção.
verses.RVR09: Y vió un carro de un par de caballeros, un carro de asno, y un carro de camello. Luego miró muy más atentamente.

verses.KJV: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
verses.WEB: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.
verses.ASV: And he cried as a lion: O Lord, I stand continually upon the watch-tower in the day-time, and am set in my ward whole nights;
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele gritou [como] um leão: Senhor, na torre de vigia estou continuamente de dia; e em minha guarda me ponho durante noites inteiras.
verses.RVR09: Y gritó como un león: Señor, sobre la atalaya estoy yo continuamente de día, y las noches enteras sobre mi guarda:

verses.KJV: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
verses.WEB: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.
verses.ASV: and, behold, here cometh a troop of men, horsemen in pairs. And he answered and said, Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the graven images of her gods are broken unto the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que está vindo uma carruagem de homens, um par de cavaleiros.Então ele respondeu: Caiu! Caiu a Babilônia, e todas as imagens esculpidas de seus deuses foram quebradas contra a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí este carro de hombres viene, un par de caballeros. Después habló, y dijo: Cayó, cayó Babilonia; y todos los ídolos de sus dioses quebrantó en tierra.

verses.KJV: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
verses.WEB: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.
verses.ASV: O thou my threshing, and the grain of my floor! that which I have heard from Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó meu [povo] debulhado por batidas, e trigo de minha eira! O que ouvi do SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, isso eu vos disse.
verses.RVR09: Trilla mía, y paja de mi era: os he dicho lo que oí de Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.WEB: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
verses.ASV: The burden of Dumah. One calleth unto me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre Dumá: Alguém está gritando de Seir. Guarda, o que houve de noite? Guarda, o que houve de noite?
verses.RVR09: Carga de Duma. Danme voces de Seir: Guarda, ¿qué de la noche? Guarda, ¿qué de la noche?

verses.KJV: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
verses.WEB: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
verses.ASV: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire ye: turn ye, come.
verses.ALMEIDA: O guarda disse: Vem a manhã, e também a noite; se quereis perguntar, perguntai; voltai-vos, e vinde.
verses.RVR09: El guarda respondió: La mañana viene, y después la noche: si preguntareis, preguntad; volved, venid.

verses.KJV: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
verses.WEB: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.
verses.ASV: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye caravans of Dedanites.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre a Arábia:Nos matos da Arábia passareis a noite, ó caravanas de dedanitas.
verses.RVR09: Carga sobre Arabia. En el monte tendréis la noche en Arabia, oh caminantes de Dedanim.

verses.KJV: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
verses.WEB: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.
verses.ASV: Unto him that was thirsty they brought water; the inhabitants of the land of Tema did meet the fugitives with their bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saí ao encontro dos sedentos com água; os moradores da terra de Temá com seu pão encontram aos que estavam fugindo;
verses.RVR09: Salid á encontrar al sediento; llevadle aguas, moradores de tierra de Tema, socorred con su pan al que huye.

verses.KJV: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.WEB: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.
verses.ASV: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois fogem de diante de espadas, de diante da espada desembainhada, e diante do arco armado, e de diante do peso da guerra.
verses.RVR09: Porque de la presencia de las espadas huyen, de la presencia de la espada desnuda, de la presencia del arco entesado, de la presencia del peso de la batalla.

verses.KJV: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
verses.WEB: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
verses.ASV: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Kedar shall fail;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim me disse o Senhor: Dentro de um ano (tal como ano de empregado), será arruinada toda a glória de Quedar.
verses.RVR09: Porque así me ha dicho Jehová: De aquí á un año, semejante á años de mozo de soldada, toda la gloria de Cedar será deshecha;

verses.KJV: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
verses.ASV: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be few; for Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que restarem do número de flecheiros, os guerreiros dos filhos de Quedar, serão reduzidos a poucos.Pois assim disse o SENHOR, Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y las reliquias del número de los valientes flecheros, hijos de Cedar, serán apocadas: porque Jehová Dios de Israel lo ha dicho.

verses.KJV: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.WEB: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?
verses.ASV: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre o vale da visão:O que há contigo, agora, para que tenhas subido toda aos terraços?
verses.RVR09: CARGA del valle de la visión. ¿Qué tienes ahora, que toda tú te has subido sobre los terrados?

verses.KJV: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.WEB: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
verses.ASV: O thou that art full of shoutings, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; thy slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu cheia de barulhos, cidade tumultuada, cidade alegre! Teus mortos não morreram pela espada, nem morreram na guerra.
verses.RVR09: Tú, llena de alborotos, ciudad turbulenta, ciudad alegre; tus muertos no son muertos á cuchillo, ni muertos en guerra.

verses.KJV: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
verses.WEB: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.
verses.ASV: All thy rulers fled away together, they were bound by the archers; all that were found of thee were bound together; they fled afar off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os teus líderes juntamente fugiram; foram presos sem [nem usarem] o arco; todos os teus que foram achados juntamente foram amarrados, [ainda que] tenham fugido para longe.
verses.RVR09: Todos tus príncipes juntos huyeron del arco, fueron atados: todos los que en ti se hallaron, fueron atados juntamente, aunque lejos se habían huído.

verses.KJV: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
verses.WEB: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.ASV: Therefore said I, Look away from me, I will weep bitterly; labor not to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu disse: Desviai vossa vista de mim, [pois] chorarei amargamente; não insistais em me consolar pela destruição da filha do meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Por esto dije: Dejadme, lloraré amargamente; no os afanéis por consolarme de la destrucción de la hija de mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord God of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
verses.WEB: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, GOD of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
verses.ASV: For it is a day of discomfiture, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois foi dia de alvoroço, de atropelamento, e de confusão, proveniente do Senhor DEUS dos exércitos, no vale da visão; [dia] de muros serem derrubados, e de gritarem ao monte.
verses.RVR09: Porque día es de alboroto, y de huella, y de fatiga por el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos en el valle de la visión, para derribar el muro, y dar grita al monte.

verses.KJV: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.WEB: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.ASV: And Elam bare the quiver, with chariots of men [and] horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Elão tomou a aljava, [e] houve homens em carruagens, e cavaleiros. Quir descobriu os escudos.
verses.RVR09: Y Elam tomó aljaba en carro de hombres y de caballeros; y Chîr descubrió escudo.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.WEB: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, that thy choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi que teus melhores vales se encheram de carruagens de guerra; e cavaleiros se puseram em posição de ataque junto ao portão.
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció que tus hermosos valles fueron llenos de carros, y los de á caballo acamparon á la puerta.

verses.KJV: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
verses.WEB: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
verses.ASV: And he took away the covering of Judah; and thou didst look in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tiraram a cobertura de Judá; e naquele dia olhastes para as armas da casa do bosque.
verses.RVR09: Y desnudó la cobertura de Judá; y miraste en aquel día hacia la casa de armas del bosque.

verses.KJV: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.WEB: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.ASV: And ye saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool;
verses.ALMEIDA: E vistes as brechas [dos muros] da cidade de Davi, que eram muitas; e ajuntastes águas no tanque de baixo.
verses.RVR09: Y visteis las roturas de la ciudad de David, que se multiplicaron; y recogisteis las aguas de la pesquera de abajo.

verses.KJV: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
verses.WEB: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
verses.ASV: and ye numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and ye brake down the houses to fortify the wall;
verses.ALMEIDA: Também contastes as casas de Jerusalém; e derrubastes casas para fortalecer os muros.
verses.RVR09: Y contasteis las casas de Jerusalem, y derribasteis casas para fortificar el muro.

verses.KJV: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.WEB: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.
