verses.ASV: ye made also a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But ye looked not unto him that had done this, neither had ye respect unto him that purposed it long ago.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizestes também um reservatório entre os dois muros para as águas do tanque velho; porém não destes atenção para aquele que fez estas coisas, nem olhastes para aquele que as formou desde a antiguidade.
verses.RVR09: E hicisteis foso entre los dos muros con las aguas de la pesquera vieja: y no tuvisteis respeto al que la hizo, ni mirasteis de lejos al que la labró.

verses.KJV: And in that day did the Lord God of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.WEB: In that day, the Lord, GOD of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
verses.ASV: And in that day did the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele dia o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos chamou ao choro, ao lamento, ao raspar de cabelos, e ao vestir de saco.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos llamó en este día á llanto y á endechas, á mesar y á vestir saco.

verses.KJV: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
verses.WEB: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”
verses.ASV: and, behold, joy and gladness, slaying oxen and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: Let us eat and drink, for to-morrow we shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis aqui alegria e festejo, matando vacas e degolando ovelhas, comendo carne, bebendo vinho, [e dizendo] : Comamos e bebamos, porque amanhã morreremos!
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí gozo y alegría, matando vacas y degollando ovejas, comer carne y beber vino, diciendo: Comamos y bebamos, que mañana moriremos.

verses.KJV: And it was revealed in mine ears by the Lord of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord God of hosts.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
verses.ASV: And Jehovah of hosts revealed himself in mine ears, Surely this iniquity shall not be forgiven you till ye die, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR dos exércitos se revelou a meus ouvidos, [dizendo] : Certamente esta maldade não vos será perdoada até que morrais, diz o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Esto fué revelado á mis oídos de parte de Jehová de los ejércitos: Que este pecado no os será perdonado hasta que muráis, dice el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
verses.WEB: The Lord, GOD of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, who is over the house, [and say],
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim disse o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos: Vai, visita este mordomo, Sebna, que administra a casa [real] ,
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos dice así: Ve, entra á este tesorero, á Sebna el mayordomo, y dile:

verses.KJV: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
verses.WEB: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”
verses.ASV: What doest thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out here a sepulchre? hewing him out a sepulchre on high, graving a habitation for himself in the rock!
verses.ALMEIDA: [E dize-lhe] : O que é que tens aqui? Ou quem tu tens aqui, [que te dá direito] a cavares aqui tua sepultura, [como] quem cava em lugar alto sua sepultura, e talha na rocha morada para si?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué tienes tú aquí, ó á quién tienes tú aquí, que labraste aquí sepulcro para ti, como el que en lugar alto labra su sepultura, ó el que esculpe para sí morada en una peña?

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.
verses.ASV: Behold, Jehovah, like a [strong] man, will hurl thee away violently; yea, he will wrap thee up closely.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o SENHOR te lançará fora, ó homem, e te agarrará!
verses.RVR09: He aquí que Jehová te trasportará en duro cautiverio, y de cierto te cubrirá el rostro.

verses.KJV: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's house.
verses.WEB: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.
verses.ASV: He will surely wind thee round and round, [and toss thee] like a ball into a large country; there shalt thou die, and there shall be the chariots of thy glory, thou shame of thy lord’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Certamente ele te lançará rodando, como uma bola numa terra larga e espaçosa. Ali morrerás, e ali [estarão] tuas gloriosas carruagens, [para] desonra da casa do teu senhor.
verses.RVR09: Te echará á rodar con ímpetu, como á bola por tierra larga de términos: allá morirás, y allá estarán los carros de tu gloria, oh vergüenza de la casa de tu señor.

verses.KJV: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
verses.WEB: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
verses.ASV: And I will thrust thee from thine office; and from thy station shalt thou be pulled down.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te removerei de tua posição, e te arrancarei de teu assento.
verses.RVR09: Y arrojarte he de tu lugar, y de tu puesto te empujaré.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia, que chamarei a meu servo Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias.
verses.RVR09: Y será que, en aquel día, llamaré á mi siervo Eliacim, hijo de Hilcías;

verses.KJV: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.WEB: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.ASV: and I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand; and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu o vestirei com tua túnica, e porei nele o teu cinto, e entregarei teu governo nas mãos dele, e ele será como um pai aos moradores de Jerusalém e à casa de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y vestirélo de tus vestiduras, y le fortaleceré con tu talabarte, y entregaré en sus manos tu potestad; y será padre al morador de Jerusalem, y á la casa de Judá.

verses.KJV: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.WEB: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
verses.ASV: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; and he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei a chave da casa de Davi sobre seu ombro; quando ele abrir, e ninguém fechará; e quando ele fechar, ninguém abrirá.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré la llave de la casa de David sobre su hombro; y abrirá, y nadie cerrará; cerrará, y nadie abrirá.

verses.KJV: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
verses.WEB: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
verses.ASV: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu o fincarei [como] a um prego em um lugar firme; e ele será um trono de honra à casa de seu pai.
verses.RVR09: E hincarélo como clavo en lugar firme; y será por asiento de honra á la casa de su padre.

verses.KJV: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
verses.WEB: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.
verses.ASV: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the flagons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nele pendurarão toda a honra da casa de seu pai, dos renovos e dos descendentes, todos as vasilhas menores; desde as vasilhas de taças, até todas as vasilhas de jarros.
verses.RVR09: Y colgarán de él toda la honra de la casa de su padre, los hijos y los nietos, todos los vasos menores, desde los vasos de beber hasta todos los instrumentos de música.

verses.KJV: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: “In that day,” says the LORD of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for the LORD has spoken it.”
verses.ASV: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall the nail that was fastened in a sure place give way; and it shall be hewn down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off; for Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, - diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, - o prego fincado em lugar firme será tirado; e será cortado, e cairá; e a carga que nele está será cortada; porque [assim] o SENHOR disse.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, el clavo hincado en lugar firme será quitado, y será quebrado y caerá; y la carga que sobre él se puso, se echará á perder; porque Jehová habló.

verses.KJV: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
verses.WEB: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.
verses.ASV: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Revelação sobre Tiro:Uivai, navios de Társis, pois ela está arruinada, sem sobrar casa alguma, nem entrada [nela] . Desde a terra do Chipre isto [lhes] foi informado.
verses.RVR09: CARGA de Tiro. Aullad, naves de Tarsis, porque destruída es hasta no quedar casa, ni entrada: de la tierra de Chîttim les es revelado.

verses.KJV: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.WEB: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.
verses.ASV: Be still, ye inhabitants of the coast, thou whom the merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Calai-vos, moradores do litoral; vós mercadores de Sidom, que vos enchíeis [pelos] que atravessavam o mar.
verses.RVR09: Callad, moradores de la isla, mercader de Sidón, que pasando la mar te henchían.

verses.KJV: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
verses.WEB: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.
verses.ASV: And on great waters the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; and she was the mart of nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua renda era os grãos de Sior, a colheita do Nilo, [que vinha] por muitas águas. Ela era o centro de comércio das nações.
verses.RVR09: Su provisión era de las sementeras que crecen con las muchas aguas del Nilo, de la mies del río. Fué también feria de gentes.

verses.KJV: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
verses.WEB: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”
verses.ASV: Be thou ashamed, O Sidon; for the sea hath spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, I have not travailed, nor brought forth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envergonha-te, Sidom; pois o mar falou, a fortaleza do mar disse: Eu não tive dores de parto, nem de mim nasceu criança; nunca criei meninos nem eduquei virgens.
verses.RVR09: Avergüénzate, Sidón, porque la mar, la fortaleza de la mar habló, diciendo: Nunca estuve de parto, ni parí, ni crié mancebos, ni levanté vírgenes.

verses.KJV: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.WEB: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
verses.ASV: When the report cometh to Egypt, they shall be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando as notícias [chegarem] ao Egito, eles se angustiarão com as informações de Tiro.
verses.RVR09: En llegando la fama á Egipto, tendrán dolor de las nuevas de Tiro.

verses.KJV: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
verses.WEB: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!
verses.ASV: Pass ye over to Tarshish; wail, ye inhabitants of the coast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passai-vos a Társis; uivai, moradores do litoral!
verses.RVR09: Pasaos á Tarsis; aullad, moradores de la isla.

verses.KJV: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
verses.WEB: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?
verses.ASV: Is this your joyous [city], whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her afar off to sojourn?
verses.ALMEIDA: É esta a vossa alegre cidade? A que existia desde os tempos antigos? Eram os pés dela que a levavam para alcançar lugares distantes?
verses.RVR09: ¿No era ésta vuestra ciudad alegre, su antigüedad de muchos días? Sus pies la llevarán á peregrinar lejos.

verses.KJV: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
verses.WEB: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?
verses.ASV: Who hath purposed this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honorable of the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem foi, pois, que determinou isto contra Tiro, a que dava coroas, que cujos mercadores eram príncipes, e cujos comerciantes eram os mais ilustres da terra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién decretó esto sobre Tiro la coronada, cuyos negociantes eran príncipes, cuyos mercaderes eran los nobles de la tierra?

verses.KJV: The Lord of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
verses.ASV: Jehovah of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi o SENHOR dos exércitos que determinou isto, para envergonhar o orgulho de sua beleza, e humilhar a todos os ilustres da terra.
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos lo decretó, para envilecer la soberbia de toda gloria; y para abatir todos los ilustres de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
verses.WEB: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
verses.ASV: Pass through thy land as the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no restraint any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passa-te como o rio à tua terra, ó filha de Társis, [pois] já não há mais fortaleza.
verses.RVR09: Pasa cual río de tu tierra, oh hija de Tarsis; porque no tendrás ya más fortaleza.

verses.KJV: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the Lord hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
verses.WEB: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. The LORD has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.
verses.ASV: He hath stretched out his hand over the sea, he hath shaken the kingdoms: Jehovah hath given commandment concerning Canaan, to destroy the strongholds thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele estendeu sua mão sobre o mar, [e] abalou aos reinos; o SENHOR deu uma ordem contra Canaã, para destruir suas fortalezas.
verses.RVR09: Extendió su mano sobre la mar, hizo temblar los reinos: Jehová mandó sobre Canaán que sus fuerzas sean debilitadas.

verses.KJV: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
verses.WEB: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”
verses.ASV: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon: arise, pass over to Kittim; even there shalt thou have no rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Nunca mais te encherás de alegria, ó oprimida virgem, filha de Sidom; levanta-te, passa ao Chipre; e alinda ali não terás descanso.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: No te alegrarás más, oh tú, oprimida virgen hija de Sidón. Levántate para pasar á Chîttim; y aun allí no tendrás reposo.

verses.KJV: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
verses.WEB: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
verses.ASV: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans: this people was not; the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness; they set up their towers; they overthrew the palaces thereof; they made it a ruin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai para a terra dos Caldeus, este que deixou de ser povo. A Assíria a fundou para os que moravam no deserto; levantaram suas fortalezas, e derrubaram seus palácios; transformou-a em ruínas.
verses.RVR09: Mira la tierra de los Caldeos; este pueblo no era; Assur la fundó para los que habitaban en el desierto: levantaron sus fortalezas, edificaron sus palacios; él la convirtió en ruinas.

verses.KJV: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
verses.WEB: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!
verses.ASV: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for your stronghold is laid waste.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uivai, navios de Társis; porque destruída está vossa fortaleza.
verses.RVR09: Aullad, naves de Tarsis; porque destruída es vuestra fortaleza.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
verses.WEB: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years it shall be unto Tyre as in the song of the harlot.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia, que Tiro será esquecida por setenta anos, como dias de um rei; [mas] ao fim de setenta anos, haverá em Tiro [algo] como a canção da prostituta:
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá en aquel día, que Tiro será puesta en olvido por setenta años, como días de un rey. Después de los setenta años, cantará Tiro canción como de ramera.

verses.KJV: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
verses.WEB: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.
verses.ASV: Take a harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma uma harpa, rodeia a cidade, ó prostituta esquecida; toca boa música, [e] canta várias canções, para que tu sejas lembrada.
verses.RVR09: Toma arpa, y rodea la ciudad, oh ramera olvidada: haz buena melodía, reitera la canción, porque tornes en memoria.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: It will happen after the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that Jehovah will visit Tyre, and she shall return to her hire, and shall play the harlot with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois será que, ao fim de setenta anos, o SENHOR visitará a Tiro, e voltará à sua atividade, prostituindo-se com todos os reinos do mundo que há sobre a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá, que al fin de los setenta años visitará Jehová á Tiro: y tornaráse á su ganancia, y otra vez fornicará con todos los reinos de la tierra sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the Lord, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.WEB: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to the LORD. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.ASV: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to Jehovah: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before Jehovah, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas seu comércio e seus ganhos como prostituta serão consagrados ao SENHOR; não serão guardados nem depositados; mas seu comércio será para os que habitam perante o SENHOR, para que comam até se saciarem, e tenham roupas de boa qualidade.
verses.RVR09: Mas su negociación y su ganancia será consagrada á Jehová: no se guardará ni se atesorará, porque su negociación será para los que estuvieren delante de Jehová, para que coman hasta hartarse, y vistan honradamente.

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
verses.ASV: Behold, Jehovah maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o SENHOR esvazia a terra, e a assola; e transtorna sua superfície, e espalha seus moradores.
verses.RVR09: HE aquí que Jehová vacía la tierra, y la desnuda, y trastorna su haz, y hace esparcir sus moradores.

verses.KJV: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
verses.WEB: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
verses.ASV: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest to him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [isso] acontecerá, tanto ao povo, como ao sacerdote; tanto ao servo, como a seu senhor; tanto à serva, como a sua senhora; tanto ao comprador, como ao vendedor; tanto a quem empresta, como ao que toma emprestado; tanto ao credor, como ao devedor.
verses.RVR09: Y será como el pueblo, tal el sacerdote; como el siervo, tal su señor; como la criada, tal su señora; tal el que compra, como el que vende; tal el que da emprestado, como el que toma prestado; tal el que da á logro, como el que lo recibe.

verses.KJV: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the Lord hath spoken this word.
verses.WEB: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.
verses.ASV: The earth shall be utterly emptied, and utterly laid waste; for Jehovah hath spoken this word.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra será esvaziada por completo, e será saqueada por completo; pois o SENHOR pronunciou esta palavra.
verses.RVR09: Del todo será vaciada la tierra, y enteramente saqueada; porque Jehová ha pronunciado esta palabra.

verses.KJV: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
verses.WEB: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
verses.ASV: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the lofty people of the earth do languish.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra chora [e] se murcha; o mundo enfraquece [e] se murcha; estão enfraquecidos os mais elevados do povo da terra;
verses.RVR09: Destruyóse, cayó la tierra; enfermó, cayó el mundo; enfermaron los altos pueblos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.WEB: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.ASV: The earth also is polluted under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a terra está contaminada por causa de seus moradores; pois transgridem as leis, mudam os estatutos, [e] anulam o pacto eterno.
verses.RVR09: Y la tierra se inficionó bajo sus moradores; porque traspasaron las leyes, falsearon el derecho, rompieron el pacto sempiterno.

verses.KJV: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.WEB: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
verses.ASV: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are found guilty: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois isso, a maldição consome a terra; e os que nela habitam pagam por sua culpa; por isso serão queimados os moradores da terra, e poucos homens restarão.
verses.RVR09: Por esta causa la maldición consumió la tierra, y sus moradores fueron asolados; por esta causa fueron consumidos los habitantes de la tierra, y se disminuyeron los hombres.

verses.KJV: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
verses.WEB: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
verses.ASV: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merry-hearted do sigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: O suco de uva chora, a vinha se enfraquece; todos os alegres de coração [agora] suspiram.
verses.RVR09: Perdióse el vino, enfermó la vid, gimieron todos los que eran alegres de corazón.

verses.KJV: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
verses.WEB: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
verses.ASV: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A alegria dos tamborins parou, acabou o ruído dos que saltavam de prazer; a alegria da harpa parou.
verses.RVR09: Cesó el regocijo de los panderos, acabóse el estruendo de los que se huelgan, paró la alegría del arpa.

verses.KJV: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
verses.WEB: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
verses.ASV: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não beberão vinho com canções; a bebida alcoólica será amarga aos que a beberem.
verses.RVR09: No beberán vino con cantar: la bebida será amarga á los que la bebieren.

verses.KJV: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.WEB: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.ASV: The waste city is broken down; every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.ALMEIDA: A cidade da confusão está quebrada; todas as casas estão fechadas; ninguém pode entrar.
verses.RVR09: Quebrantada está la ciudad de la vanidad; toda casa se ha cerrado, porque no entre nadie.

verses.KJV: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
verses.WEB: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
verses.ASV: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um clamor de lamento por causa do vinho [se ouve] nas ruas; toda a alegria se escureceu; o prazer da terra sumiu.
verses.RVR09: Voces sobre el vino en las plazas; todo gozo se oscureció, desterróse la alegría de la tierra.

verses.KJV: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
verses.WEB: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
verses.ASV: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Só] restou assolação na cidade; o portão foi feito em ruínas.
verses.RVR09: En la ciudad quedó soledad, y con asolamiento fué herida la puerta.

verses.KJV: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
verses.WEB: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
verses.ASV: For thus shall it be in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive-tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim será por entre a terra, e no meio destes povos; como quando se sacode a oliveira, [e] como as uvas que sobram depois de terminada a vindima.
verses.RVR09: Porque así será en medio de la tierra, en medio de los pueblos, como aceituno sacudido, como rebuscos acabada la vendimia.

verses.KJV: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the Lord, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
verses.WEB: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.
verses.ASV: These shall lift up their voice, they shall shout; for the majesty of Jehovah they cry aloud from the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles levantarão sua voz, e cantarão com alegria; por causa da glória do SENHOR, gritarão de alegria desde o mar.
verses.RVR09: Estos alzarán su voz, cantarán gozosos en la grandeza de Jehová, desde la mar darán voces.

verses.KJV: Wherefore glorify ye the Lord in the fires, even the name of the Lord God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
verses.WEB: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
verses.ASV: Wherefore glorify ye Jehovah in the east, even the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel, in the isles of the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso glorificai ao SENHOR no oriente; [e] no litoral ao nome do SENHOR, o Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Glorificad por esto á Jehová en los valles: en islas de la mar sea nombrado Jehová Dios de Israel.

verses.KJV: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
verses.WEB: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
verses.ASV: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs: Glory to the righteous. But I said, I pine away, I pine away, woe is me! the treacherous have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dos confins da terra ouvimos canções [para] a glória do Justo; mas eu digo: Fraqueza minha, fraqueza minha; ai de mim! Os enganadores enganam, e com enganação os enganadores agem enganosamente.
verses.RVR09: De lo postrero de la tierra oímos salmos: Gloria al justo. Y yo dije: ¡Mi flaqueza, mi flaqueza, ay de mí! Prevaricadores han prevaricado; y han prevaricado con prevaricación de desleales.

verses.KJV: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.WEB: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.
verses.ASV: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temor, cova e laço [vem] sobre ti, ó morador da terra.
verses.RVR09: Terror y sima y lazo sobre ti, oh morador de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
verses.WEB: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, aquele que fugir do som de temor cairá na cova; e aquele que subir da cova, o laço o prenderá; pois as janelas do alto se abrem; e os fundamentos da terra tremerão.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá que el que huirá de la voz del terror, caerá en la sima; y el que saliere de en medio de la sima, será preso del lazo: porque de lo alto se abrieron ventanas, y temblarán los fundamentos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
verses.WEB: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
verses.ASV: The earth is utterly broken, the earth is rent asunder, the earth is shaken violently.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra será quebrada por completo; a terra será totalmente partida, e será muito abalada.
verses.RVR09: Quebrantaráse del todo la tierra, enteramente desmenuzada será la tierra, en gran manera será la tierra conmovida.

verses.KJV: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.WEB: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
verses.ASV: The earth shall stagger like a drunken man, and shall sway to and fro like a hammock; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it, and it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra balançará como um bêbado; e será abalada como uma choupana; e sua transgressão pesará sobre ela; cairá, e nunca mais se levantará.
verses.RVR09: Temblará la tierra vacilando como un borracho, y será removida como una choza; y agravaráse sobre ella su pecado, y caerá, y nunca más se levantará.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will punish the host of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que naquele dia o SENHOR visitará [para punir] aos exércitos do alto na altura, e aos reis da terra sobre a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá en aquel día, que Jehová visitará sobre el ejército sublime en lo alto, y sobre los reyes de la tierra que hay sobre la tierra.

verses.KJV: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
verses.WEB: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.
verses.ASV: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.
verses.ALMEIDA: E juntamente serão amontoados [como] presos numa masmorra; e serão encarcerados num cárcere; e muitos dias depois serão visitados.
verses.RVR09: Y serán amontonados como se amontonan encarcelados en mazmorra, y en prisión quedarán encerrados, y serán visitados después de muchos días.

verses.KJV: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
verses.WEB: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
verses.ASV: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Jehovah of hosts will reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders shall be glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a lua será envergonhada, e o sol humilhado, quando o SENHOR dos exércitos reinar no monte de Sião, e em Jerusalém; e então perante seus anciãos [haverá] glória.
verses.RVR09: La luna se avergonzará, y el sol se confundirá, cuando Jehová de los ejércitos reinare en el monte de Sión, y en Jerusalem, y delante de sus ancianos fuere glorioso.

verses.KJV: O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
verses.WEB: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things, [even] counsels of old, in faithfulness [and] truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, tu és meu Deus; eu te exaltarei, [e] louvarei o teu nome, pois tu tens feito maravilhas, [teus] conselhos antigos, [com] fidelidade e verdade.
verses.RVR09: JEHOVÁ, tú eres mi Dios: te ensalzaré, alabaré tu nombre; porque has hecho maravillas, los consejos antiguos, la verdad firme.

verses.KJV: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
verses.WEB: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
verses.ASV: For thou hast made of a city a heap, of a fortified city a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu fizeste da cidade um amontoado de pedras; da cidade fortificada uma ruína; [fizeste com que] os edifícios dos estrangeiros deixassem de ser cidade, e nunca mais voltem a ser construídos.
verses.RVR09: Que tornaste la ciudad en montón, la ciudad fuerte en ruina: el alcázar de los extraños que no sea ciudad, ni nunca jamás sea reedeficada.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
verses.WEB: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall a strong people glorify thee; a city of terrible nations shall fear thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, um poderoso povo te glorificará, a cidade de nações terríveis te temerá.
verses.RVR09: Por esto te dará gloria el pueblo fuerte, te temerá la ciudad de gentes robustas.

verses.KJV: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
verses.WEB: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
verses.ASV: For thou hast been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu foste a fortaleza do pobre, a fortaleza do necessitado, em sua angústia; refúgio contra a tempestade, [e] sombra contra o calor; porque o sopro dos violentos é como uma tempestade contra o muro.
verses.RVR09: Porque fuiste fortaleza al pobre, fortaleza al menesteroso en su aflicción, amparo contra el turbión, sombra contra el calor: porque el ímpetu de los violentos es como turbión contra frontispicio.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
verses.WEB: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
verses.ASV: As the heat in a dry place wilt thou bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como o calor em lugar seco, assim tu abaterás o ímpeto dos estrangeiros; tal como uma espessa nuvem [diminui] o calor, assim será humilhada a canção dos violentos.
verses.RVR09: Como el calor en lugar seco, así humillarás el orgullo de los extraños; y como calor debajo de nube, harás marchitar el pimpollo de los robustos.

verses.KJV: And in this mountain shall the Lord of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.WEB: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
verses.ASV: And in this mountain will Jehovah of hosts make unto all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.ALMEIDA: E neste monte o SENHOR dos exércitos fará para todos os povos um banquete de animais cevados, um banquete de vinhos finos; de gorduras de tutanos, e de vinhos finos, bem purificados.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová de los ejércitos hará en este monte á todos los pueblos convite de engordados, convite de purificados, de gruesos tuétanos, de purificados líquidos.

verses.KJV: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
verses.WEB: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
verses.ASV: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering that covereth all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E neste monte devorará o véu funerário que está sobre todos os povos, e a coberta com que todas as nações se cobrem.
verses.RVR09: Y deshará en este monte la máscara de la cobertura con que están cubiertos todos los pueblos, y la cubierta que está extendida sobre todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.
verses.ASV: He hath swallowed up death for ever; and the Lord Jehovah will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the reproach of his people will he take away from off all the earth: for Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele devorará a morte para sempre, e o Senhor DEUS enxugará as lágrimas de todos os rostos; e tirará a humilhação de seu povo de toda a terra; pois o SENHOR [assim] disse.
verses.RVR09: Destruirá á la muerte para siempre; y enjugará el Señor toda lágrima de todos los rostros: y quitará la afrenta de su pueblo de toda la tierra: porque Jehová lo ha dicho.

verses.KJV: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the Lord; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
verses.WEB: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
verses.ASV: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is Jehovah; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E naquele dia se dirá: Eis que este é o nosso Deus, em quem temos posto nossa esperança para nos salvar; este é o SENHOR, em quem esperamos; em sua salvação teremos prazer e nos alegraremos.
verses.RVR09: Y se dirá en aquel día: He aquí éste es nuestro Dios, le hemos esperado, y nos salvará: éste es Jehová á quien hemos esperado, nos gozaremos y nos alegraremos en su salud.

verses.KJV: For in this mountain shall the hand of the Lord rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
verses.WEB: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
verses.ASV: For in this mountain will the hand of Jehovah rest; and Moab shall be trodden down in his place, even as straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a mão do SENHOR descansará neste monte; Moabe, porém, será esmagado debaixo dele, tal como se esmaga a palha no amontoado de esterco.
verses.RVR09: Porque la mano de Jehová reposará en este monte, y Moab será trillado debajo de él, como es trillada la paja en el muladar.

verses.KJV: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
verses.WEB: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.
verses.ASV: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst thereof, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth [his hands] to swim; but [Jehovah] will lay low his pride together with the craft of his hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estenderão suas mãos no meio dela, tal como um nadador estende para nadar; e [o SENHOR] abaterá a arrogância deles com a habilidade de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Y extenderá su mano por en medio de él, como la extiende el nadador para nadar: y abatirá su soberbia con los miembros de sus manos:

verses.KJV: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.WEB: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.ASV: And the high fortress of thy walls hath he brought down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançará abaixo as fortalezas de teus muros; ele [as] abaterá e derrubará até o chão, ao pó.
verses.RVR09: Y allanará la fortaleza de tus altos muros: la humillará y echará á tierra, hasta el polvo.

verses.KJV: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
verses.WEB: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
verses.ASV: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation will he appoint for walls and bulwarks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, se cantará este cântico na terra de Judá: Temos uma cidade forte! [Deus lhe] pôs a salvação por muros e antemuros.
verses.RVR09: EN aquel día cantarán este cantar en tierra de Judá: Fuerte ciudad tenemos: salud puso Dios por muros y antemuro.

verses.KJV: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
verses.WEB: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
verses.ASV: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth faith may enter in.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abri as portas, para que por elas entre a nação justa, que guarda fidelidades.
verses.RVR09: Abrid las puertas, y entrará la gente justa, guardadora de verdades.

verses.KJV: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verses.WEB: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt keep [him] in perfect peace, [whose] mind [is] stayed [on thee]; because he trusteth in thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu guardarás em completa paz aquele que tem firme entendimento, pois ele confia em ti.
verses.RVR09: Tú le guardarás en completa paz, cuyo pensamiento en ti persevera; porque en ti se ha confiado.

verses.KJV: Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength:
verses.WEB: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.
verses.ASV: Trust ye in Jehovah for ever; for in Jehovah, [even] Jehovah, is an everlasting rock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Confiai no SENHOR para sempre, pois no SENHOR DEUS está a rocha eterna.
verses.RVR09: Confiad en Jehová perpetuamente: porque en el Señor Jehová está la fortaleza de los siglos.

verses.KJV: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
verses.WEB: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
verses.ASV: For he hath brought down them that dwell on high, the lofty city: he layeth it low, he layeth it low even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele abate aos que habitam em lugares altos, a cidade elevada; certamente ele a abaixará até o chão, e a derrubará até o pó.
verses.RVR09: Porque derribó los que moraban en lugar sublime: humilló la ciudad ensalzada, humillóla hasta la tierra, derribóla hasta el polvo.

verses.KJV: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
verses.WEB: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”
verses.ASV: The foot shall tread it down; even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pés a pisotearão; os pés dos afligidos, os passos dos pobres.
verses.RVR09: Hollarála pie, los pies del afligido, los pasos de los menesterosos.

verses.KJV: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
verses.WEB: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
verses.ASV: The way of the just is uprightness: thou that art upright dost direct the path of the just.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho do justo é todo plano; tu [que és] reto nivelas o andar do justo.
verses.RVR09: El camino del justo es rectitud: Tú, Recto, pesas el camino del justo.

verses.KJV: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Lord, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
verses.WEB: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
verses.ASV: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Jehovah, have we waited for thee; to thy name, even to thy memorial [name], is the desire of our soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também no caminho dos teus juízos esperamos em ti; em teu nome e em tua lembrança está o desejo de [nossa] alma.
verses.RVR09: También en el camino de tus juicios, oh Jehová, te hemos esperado: á tu nombre y á tu memoria es el deseo del alma.

verses.KJV: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.WEB: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.ASV: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee earnestly: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com minha alma te desejei de noite, e [com] meu espírito dentro de mim te busquei de madrugada; pois quando teus juízos [estão] sobre a terra, os moradores do mundo aprendem a justiça.
verses.RVR09: Con mi alma te he deseado en la noche; y en tanto que me durare el espíritu en medio de mí, madrugaré á buscarte: porque luego que hay juicios tuyos en la tierra, los moradores del mundo aprenden justicia.

verses.KJV: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD’s majesty.
verses.ASV: Let favor be showed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness will he deal wrongfully, and will not behold the majesty of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ainda] que se faça favor ao perverso, nem assim ele aprende a justiça; [até] na terra dos corretos ele pratica maldade, e não dá atenção à majestade do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Alcanzará piedad el impío, y no aprenderá justicia; en tierra de rectitud hará iniquidad, y no mirará á la majestad de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
verses.WEB: LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
verses.ASV: Jehovah, thy hand is lifted up, yet they see not: but they shall see [thy] zeal for the people, and be put to shame; yea, fire shall devour thine adversaries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, tua mão está levantada, mas eles não [a] veem; [porém] eles verão e serão envergonhados pelo zelo [que tens] do [teu] povo; e o fogo consumirá a teus adversários.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, bien que se levante tu mano, no ven: verán al cabo, y se avergonzarán los que envidian á tu pueblo; y á tus enemigos fuego los consumirá.

verses.KJV: Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
verses.WEB: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
verses.ASV: Jehovah, thou wilt ordain peace for us; for thou hast also wrought all our works for us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, tu nos fornecerá paz; pois todos os nossos feitos tu fizeste por nós.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, tú nos depararás paz; porque también obraste en nosotros todas nuestras obras.

verses.KJV: O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.WEB: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah our God, other lords besides thee have had dominion over us; but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR nosso Deus, outros senhores fora de ti nos dominaram; mas somente em ti, em teu nome, mantínhamos nossos pensamentos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová Dios nuestro, señores se han enseñoreado de nosotros fuera de ti; mas en ti solamente nos acordaremos de tu nombre.

verses.KJV: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.WEB: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
verses.ASV: [They are] dead, they shall not live; [they are] deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all remembrance of them to perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles estão mortos, não [voltarão] a viver; fantasmas não ressuscitarão; por isso tu os visitaste e os destruíste, e eliminaste toda a memória deles.
verses.RVR09: Muertos son, no vivirán: han fallecido, no resucitarán: porque los visitaste, y destruiste, y deshiciste toda su memoria.

verses.KJV: Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
verses.WEB: You have increased the nation, O LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
verses.ASV: Thou hast increased the nation, O Jehovah, thou hast increased the nation; thou art glorified; thou hast enlarged all the borders of the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, SENHOR, engrandeceste esta nação; engrandeceste esta nação, [e] te fizeste glorioso; alargaste os limites da terra.
verses.RVR09: Añadiste al pueblo, oh Jehová, añadiste al pueblo: hicístete glorioso: extendístelo hasta todos los términos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
verses.WEB: LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
verses.ASV: Jehovah, in trouble have they visited thee; they poured out a prayer [when] thy chastening was upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, na aflição eles te buscaram; [quando] tu os castigaste, uma oração eles sussurraram.
verses.RVR09: Jehová, en la tribulación te buscaron: derramaron oración cuando los castigaste.

verses.KJV: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O Lord.
verses.WEB: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, LORD.
verses.ASV: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain and crieth out in her pangs; so we have been before thee, O Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como a grávida quando chega a hora do parto, sofre e dá gritos por suas dores, assim fomos nós diante de tua presença, SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Como la preñada cuando se acerca el parto gime, y da gritos con sus dolores, así hemos sido delante de ti, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.WEB: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.ASV: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Concebemos e tivemos dores, porém geramos [nada além] de vento. Não trouxemos libertação à terra, nem os moradores do mundo caíram.
verses.RVR09: Concebimos, tuvimos dolores de parto, parimos como viento: salud ninguna hicimos en la tierra, ni cayeron los moradores del mundo.

verses.KJV: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.WEB: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
verses.ASV: Thy dead shall live; my dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in the dust; for thy dew is [as] the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast forth the dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os teus mortos viverão, [junto com] meu cadáver, [assim] ressuscitarão; festejai e sede alegres, vós que habitais no pó! Pois o teu orvalho [é] orvalho de luz, e a terra gerará de si [seus] mortos.
verses.RVR09: Tus muertos vivirán; junto con mi cuerpo muerto resucitarán. ¡Despertad y cantad, moradores del polvo! porque tu rocío, cual rocío de hortalizas; y la tierra echará los muertos.

verses.KJV: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.WEB: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
verses.ASV: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, ó povo meu; entra em teus quartos, e fecha tuas portas ao redor de ti; esconde-te por um momento, até que a ira tenha passado.
verses.RVR09: Anda, pueblo mío, éntrate en tus aposentos, cierra tras ti tus puertas; escóndete un poquito, por un momento, en tanto que pasa la ira.

verses.KJV: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.WEB: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
verses.ASV: For, behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que o SENHOR sairá de seu lugar para punir a maldade dos moradores da terra sobre eles; e a terra mostrará seus sangues, e não mais cobrirá seus mortos.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí que Jehová sale de su lugar, para visitar la maldad del morador de la tierra contra él; y la tierra descubrirá sus sangres, y no más encubrirá sus muertos.

verses.KJV: In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.WEB: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.ASV: In that day Jehovah with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan the swift serpent, and leviathan the crooked serpent; and he will slay the monster that is in the sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, o SENHOR punirá, com sua dura, grande e forte espada, ao Leviatã, a ágil serpente; ao Leviatã, a serpente tortuosa; e matará o dragão que está no mar.
verses.RVR09: EN aquel día Jehová visitará con su espada dura, grande y fuerte, sobre leviathán, serpiente rolliza, y sobre leviathán serpiente retuerta; y matará al dragón que está en la mar.

verses.KJV: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
verses.WEB: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
verses.ASV: In that day: A vineyard of wine, sing ye unto it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia, cantai à preciosa vinha:
verses.RVR09: En aquel día cantad de la viña del vino rojo.

verses.KJV: I the Lord do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.WEB: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.ASV: I Jehovah am its keeper; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, o SENHOR, a vigio, e a rego a cada momento; para que ninguém a invada, eu a vigiarei de noite e de dia.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová la guardo, cada momento la regaré; guardaréla de noche y de día, porque nadie la visite.

verses.KJV: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
verses.WEB: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
verses.ASV: Wrath is not in me: would that the briers and thorns were against me in battle! I would march upon them, I would burn them together.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Já] não há furor em mim. Caso alguém ponha contra mim espinhos e cardos, eu lutarei contra eles em batalha, e juntos os queimarei.
verses.RVR09: No hay en mí enojo. ¿Quién pondrá contra mí en batalla espinas y cardos? Yo los hollaré, quemarélos juntamente.

verses.KJV: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
verses.WEB: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”
verses.ASV: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; [yea], let him make peace with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou, se quiserem depender de minha força, então façam as pazes comigo, e sejam comigo feitas as pazes.
verses.RVR09: ¿O forzará alguien mi fortaleza? Haga conmigo paz, sí, haga paz conmigo.

verses.KJV: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.WEB: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
verses.ASV: In days to come shall Jacob take root; Israel shall blossom and bud; and they shall fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dias] virão em que Jacó lançará raízes, florescerá, e brotará Israel; e encherão superfície do mundo de frutos.
verses.RVR09: Días vendrán cuando Jacob echará raíces, florecerá y echará renuevos Israel, y la haz del mundo se henchirá de fruto.

verses.KJV: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
verses.WEB: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?
verses.ASV: Hath he smitten them as he smote those that smote them? or are they slain according to the slaughter of them that were slain by them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso ele o feriu, como feriu aos que o feriram? Ou ele o matou, como morreram os que o por ele foram mortos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Acaso ha sido herido como quien lo hirió? ¿ó ha sido muerto como los que lo mataron?

verses.KJV: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
verses.WEB: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
verses.ASV: In measure, when thou sendest them away, thou dost contend with them; he hath removed [them] with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com moderação brigaste contra ela, quando a rejeitaste; [quando] a tirou com seu vento forte, no dia do vento do Oriente.
verses.RVR09: Con medida la castigarás en sus vástagos. El reprime su recio viento en el día del aire solano.

verses.KJV: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
verses.WEB: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.
verses.ASV: Therefore by this shall the iniquity of Jacob be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, [so that] the Asherim and the sun-images shall rise no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim será perdoada a maldade de Jacó, e este será o fruto completo da remoção de seu pecado: quando tornar todas as pedras dos altares como pedras de cal despedaçadas, [e] os mastros de Aserá e os altares de incenso não ficarem mais de pé.
verses.RVR09: De esta manera pues será purgada la iniquidad de Jacob; y éste será todo el fruto, la remoción de su pecado, cuando tornare todas las piedras del altar como piedras de cal desmenuzadas, y no se levantarán los bosques, ni las imágenes del sol.

verses.KJV: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
verses.WEB: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
verses.ASV: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a cidade fortificada [será] abandonada, o lugar de habitação deixado e desabitado como o deserto; ali os bezerros pastarão, e ali se deitarão e comerão seus ramos.
verses.RVR09: Porque la ciudad fortalecida será asolada, la morada será desamparada y dejada como un desierto: allí se apacentará el becerro, allí tendrá su majada, y acabará sus ramas.

verses.KJV: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
verses.WEB: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.
verses.ASV: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off; the women shall come, and set them on fire; for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have compassion upon them, and he that formed them will show them no favor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando seus ramos se secarem, serão quebrados; mulheres virão, e os queimarão; pois este povo não tem entendimento. Por isso, aquele que o criou não terá compaixão dele; aquele que o formou não lhe concederá graça.
verses.RVR09: Cuando sus ramas se secaren, serán quebradas; mujeres vendrán á encenderlas: porque aquél no es pueblo de entendimiento; por tanto su Hacedor no tendrá de él misericordia, ni se compadecerá de él el que lo formó.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will beat off [his fruit] from the flood of the River unto the brook of Egypt; and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia, que o SENHOR debulhará o trigo, desde o rio [Eufrates] até o ribeiro do Egito; porém vós, filhos de Israel, sereis colhidos um a um.
verses.RVR09: Y acontecerá en aquel día, que herirá Jehová desde el álveo del río hasta el torrente de Egipto, y vosotros, hijos de Israel, seréis reunidos uno á uno.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the Lord in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great trumpet shall be blown; and they shall come that were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and they that were outcasts in the land of Egypt; and they shall worship Jehovah in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será naquele dia, que uma grande trombeta será tocada; então os que estiverem perdidos na terra da Assíria e os que tiverem sido lançados à terra do Egito voltarão, e adorarão ao SENHOR no monte santo em Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Acontecerá también en aquel día, que se tañerá con gran trompeta, y vendrán los que habían sido esparcidos en la tierra de Asiria, y los que habían sido echados en tierra de Egipto, y adorarán á Jehová en el monte santo, en Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
verses.WEB: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!
verses.ASV: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley of them that are overcome with wine!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai da coroa de arrogância dos bêbados de Efraim, cujo belo ornamento é [como] uma flor que murcha, que está sobre a cabeça do vale fértil dos derrotados pelo vinho.
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de la corona de soberbia, de los ebrios de Ephraim, y de la flor caduca de la hermosura de su gloria, que está sobre la cabeza del valle fértil de los aturdidos del vino!

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
verses.WEB: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
verses.ASV: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one; as a tempest of hail, a destroying storm, as a tempest of mighty waters overflowing, will he cast down to the earth with the hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o Senhor tem um valente e poderoso, [que vem] como tempestade de granizo, tormenta destruidora; e como tempestade de impetuosas águas que inundam; com [sua] mão ele [os] derrubará em terra.
verses.RVR09: He aquí Jehová tiene un fuerte y poderoso: como turbión de granizo y como torbellino trastornador; como ímpetu de recias aguas que inundan, con fuerza derriba á tierra.

verses.KJV: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
verses.WEB: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.
verses.ASV: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim shall be trodden under foot:
verses.ALMEIDA: A coroa de arrogância dos bêbados de Efraim será pisada sob os pés.
verses.RVR09: Con los pies será hollada la corona de soberbia de los borrachos de Ephraim;

verses.KJV: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
verses.WEB: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.
verses.ASV: and the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be as the first-ripe fig before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o seu belo ornamento, que está sobre a cabeça do vale fértil, será como a flor que murcha; como o primeiro fruto antes do verão, que, quando alguém o vê, pega e o come.
