verses.KJV: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.WEB: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.ASV: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise profaneness, and to utter error against Jehovah, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o tolo fala tolices, e seu coração opera maldade, para praticar perversidade e falar enganos contra o SENHOR, para deixar vazia a alma do faminto, e fazer com que o sedento não tenha o que beber.
verses.RVR09: Porque el mezquino hablará mezquindades, y su corazón fabricará iniquidad, para hacer la impiedad y para hablar escarnio contra Jehová, dejando vacía el alma hambrienta, y quitando la bebida al sediento.

verses.KJV: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
verses.WEB: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
verses.ASV: And the instruments of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the meek with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os instrumentos do avarento são maléficos; ele trama planos malignos para destruir aos aflitos com palavras falsas, mesmo quando o pobre fala com justiça.
verses.RVR09: Cierto los avaros malas medidas tienen: él maquina pensamientos para enredar á los simples con palabras cautelosas, y para hablar en juicio contra el pobre.

verses.KJV: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.WEB: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things.
verses.ASV: But the noble deviseth noble things; and in noble things shall he continue.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o nobre pensa em coisas nobres, e em coisas nobres ele permanece.
verses.RVR09: Mas el liberal pensará liberalidades, y por liberalidades subirá.

verses.KJV: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.WEB: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
verses.ASV: Rise up, ye women that are at ease, [and] hear my voice; ye careless daughters, give ear unto my speech.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai-vos, mulheres que estais em repouso, e ouvi a minha voz; ó filhas, que estais tão confiantes, dai ouvidos às minhas palavras:
verses.RVR09: Mujeres reposadas, levantaos, oid mi voz; confiadas, escuchad mi razón.

verses.KJV: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
verses.WEB: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won’t come.
verses.ASV: For days beyond a year shall ye be troubled, ye careless women; for the vintage shall fail, the ingathering shall not come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Daqui a um ano e alguns dias, sereis perturbadas, vós, que estais tão confiantes; porque a produção de uvas não terá sucesso, e a colheita não virá.
verses.RVR09: Días y años tendréis espanto, oh confiadas; porque la vendimia faltará, y la cosecha no acudirá.

verses.KJV: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
verses.WEB: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.
verses.ASV: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones; strip you, and make you bare, and gird [sackcloth] upon your loins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tremei vós que estais em repouso, e sede perturbadas, vós que estais tão confiantes; despi-vos, e ficai nuas, e vesti vossos lombos [com roupa de saco] .
verses.RVR09: Temblad, oh reposadas; turbaos, oh confiadas: despojaos, desnudaos, ceñid los lomos con saco.

verses.KJV: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.WEB: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.ASV: They shall smite upon the breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lamentai-vos batendo em vossos peitos por causa dos campos agradáveis e das vides frutíferas;
verses.RVR09: Sobre los pechos lamentarán por los campos deleitosos, por la vid fértil.

verses.KJV: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
verses.WEB: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
verses.ASV: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da terra do meu povo, [na qual] espinhos e cardos crescerão; e por causa das casas de alegria [na] cidade alegre.
verses.RVR09: Sobre la tierra de mi pueblo subirán espinas y cardos; y aun sobre todas las casas de placer en la ciudad de alegría.

verses.KJV: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.WEB: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks,
verses.ASV: For the palace shall be forsaken; the populous city shall be deserted; the hill and the watch-tower shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o palácio será abandonado, a cidade ruidosa ficará deserta; a colina e as torres de guarda serão esvaziadas para sempre, para alegria dos jumentos selvagens, e [servirão] de pasto para o gado;
verses.RVR09: Porque los palacios serán desiertos, la multitud de la ciudad cesará: las torres y fortalezas se tornarán cuevas para siempre, donde huelguen asnos monteses, y ganados hagan majada:

verses.KJV: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.WEB: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.
verses.ASV: until the Spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness become a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be esteemed as a forest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que seja derramado sobre nós o Espírito do alto; então o deserto se tornará um lugar fértil, e o lugar fértil será considerado uma floresta.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que sobre nosotros sea derramado espíritu de lo alto, y el desierto se torne en campo labrado, y el campo labrado sea estimado por bosque.

verses.KJV: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.WEB: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
verses.ASV: Then justice shall dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness shall abide in the fruitful field.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o juízo habitará no deserto, e a justiça morará no campo fértil.
verses.RVR09: Y habitará el juicio en el desierto, y en el campo labrado asentará la justicia.

verses.KJV: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.WEB: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
verses.ASV: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a consequência da justiça será paz; e o produto da justiça, repouso e segurança para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y el efecto de la justicia será paz; y la labor de justicia, reposo y seguridad para siempre.

verses.KJV: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.WEB: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,
verses.ASV: And my people shall abide in a peaceable habitation, and in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting-places.
verses.ALMEIDA: E meu povo habitará na morada da paz, em moradias bem seguras, em tranquilos lugares de descanso.
verses.RVR09: Y mi pueblo habitará en morada de paz, y en habitaciones seguras, y en recreos de reposo.

verses.KJV: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
verses.WEB: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.
verses.ASV: But it shall hail in the downfall of the forest; and the city shall be utterly laid low.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Granizo, porém, derrubará a floresta, e a cidade será abatida).
verses.RVR09: Y el granizo, cuando descendiere, será en los montes; y la ciudad será del todo abatida.

verses.KJV: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.WEB: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
verses.ASV: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bem-aventurados sois vós, os que semeais sobre todas as águas; [e] deixais livres os pés do boi e do jumento.
verses.RVR09: Dichosos vosotros los que sembráis sobre todas aguas, y metéis en ellas el pie de buey y de asno.

verses.KJV: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.WEB: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.
verses.ASV: Woe to thee that destroyest, and thou wast not destroyed; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! When thou hast ceased to destroy, thou shalt be destroyed; and when thou hast made an end of dealing treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de ti, assolador, que não foste assolado, e que enganas sem ter sido enganado! Quando terminares de assolar, tu é que serás assolado; quando terminares de enganar, então te enganarão.
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de ti, el que saqueas, y nunca fuiste saqueado; el que haces deslealtad, bien que nadie contra ti la hizo! Cuando acabares de saquear, serás tú saqueado; y cuando acabares de hacer deslealtad, haráse contra ti.

verses.KJV: O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.WEB: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou our arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, tem misericórdia de nós! Em ti temos esperança. Que tu sejas nossa força nas madrugadas, e nossa salvação no tempo de aflição.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, ten misericordia de nosotros, á ti hemos esperado: tú, brazo de ellos en la mañana, sé también nuestra salud en tiempo de la tribulación.

verses.KJV: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.WEB: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
verses.ASV: At the noise of the tumult the peoples are fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations are scattered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao som do ruído estrondoso, fugirão; quando tu te levantas, as nações se dispersam.
verses.RVR09: Los pueblos huyeron á la voz del estruendo; las gentes fueron esparcidas por tus levantamientos.

verses.KJV: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.WEB: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
verses.ASV: And your spoil shall be gathered as the caterpillar gathereth: as locusts leap shall men leap upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então, [nações] ,vossos despojos serão colhidos tal como os insetos colhem; tal como os gafanhotos saltam, assim saltarão.
verses.RVR09: Mas vuestra presa será cogida como cuando cogen las orugas: correrá sobre ellos como de una á otra parte corren las langostas.

verses.KJV: The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.WEB: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Exaltado é o SENHOR, pois habita nas alturas; ele encheu a Sião de juízo e justiça.
verses.RVR09: Será ensalzado Jehová, el cual mora en las alturas: llenó á Sión de juicio y de justicia.

verses.KJV: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord is his treasure.
verses.WEB: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.
verses.ASV: And there shall be stability in thy times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge: the fear of Jehovah is thy treasure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é a segurança de teus tempos, e a fonte de tua salvação, sabedoria e conhecimento; o temor ao SENHOR é seu tesouro.
verses.RVR09: Y reinarán en tus tiempos la sabiduría y la ciencia, y la fuerza de la salvación: el temor de Jehová será su tesoro.

verses.KJV: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.WEB: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
verses.ASV: Behold, their valiant ones cry without; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que os embaixadores deles estão gritando de fora; os mensageiros de paz estão chorando amargamente.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que sus embajadores darán voces afuera; los mensajeros de paz llorarán amargamente.

verses.KJV: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
verses.WEB: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
verses.ASV: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: [the enemy] hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth not man.
verses.ALMEIDA: As estradas estão vazias, não há quem passe pelos caminhos; o pacto foi desfeito, cidades foram desprezadas, ninguém é considerado importante.
verses.RVR09: Las calzadas están deshechas, cesaron los caminantes: anulado ha la alianza, aborreció las ciudades, tuvo en nada los hombres.

verses.KJV: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
verses.WEB: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.
verses.ASV: The land mourneth and languisheth; Lebanon is confounded and withereth away; Sharon is like a desert; and Bashan and Carmel shake off [their leaves].
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra lamenta e se definha; o Líbano se envergonha e se seca; Sarom se tornou com um deserto; e Basã e Carmelo foram sacudidos, [tiradas suas folhas] .
verses.RVR09: Enlutóse, enfermó la tierra: el Líbano se avergonzó, y fué cortado: hase tornado Sarón como desierto; y Basán y Carmel fueron sacudidos.

verses.KJV: Now will I rise, saith the Lord; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.WEB: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
verses.ASV: Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; now will I lift up myself; now will I be exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora eu me levantarei,diz o SENHOR; agora me elevarei; agora serei exaltado.
verses.RVR09: Ahora me levantaré, dice Jehová; ahora seré ensalzado, ahora seré engrandecido.

verses.KJV: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
verses.WEB: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
verses.ASV: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath is a fire that shall devour you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Concebestes palha, gerais restos de cascas; vosso sopro vos consumirá [como] o fogo.
verses.RVR09: Concebisteis hojarascas, aristas pariréis: el soplo de vuestro fuego os consumirá.

verses.KJV: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.WEB: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
verses.ASV: And the peoples shall be as the burnings of lime, as thorns cut down, that are burned in the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os povos serão [como] incêndios de cal; tal como espinhos cortados, eles se queimarão no fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y los pueblos serán como cal quemada: como espinas cortadas serán quemados con fuego.

verses.KJV: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.WEB: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
verses.ASV: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós que estais longe, ouvi o que eu tenho feito; e vós que estais perto, conhecei o meu poder.
verses.RVR09: Oid, los que estáis lejos, lo que he hecho; y vosotros los cercanos, conoced mi potencia.

verses.KJV: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.WEB: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
verses.ASV: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling hath seized the godless ones: Who among us can dwell with the devouring fire? who among us can dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os pecadores em Sião estão assombrados; o tremor tomou os perversos; [eles dizem] : Quem dentre nós pode conviver com o fogo consumidor? Quem dentre nós pode conviver com as labaredas eternas?
verses.RVR09: Los pecadores se asombraron en Sión, espanto sobrecogió á los hipócritas. ¿Quién de nosotros morará con el fuego consumidor? ¿quién de nosotros habitará con las llamas eternas?

verses.KJV: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
verses.WEB: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—
verses.ASV: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from taking a bribe, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from looking upon evil:
verses.ALMEIDA: O que anda em justiça, e que fala o que é correto; que rejeita o ganho [proveniente] de opressões, que com suas mãos faz o gesto de “não” aos subornos, que tapa seus ouvidos para não ouvir sobre [crimes de] sangue, e fecha seus olhos para não ver o mal.
verses.RVR09: El que camina en justicia, y habla lo recto; el que aborrece la ganancia de violencias, el que sacude sus manos por no recibir cohecho, el que tapa su oreja por no oir sangres, el que cierra sus ojos por no ver cosa mala:

verses.KJV: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
verses.WEB: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
verses.ASV: He shall dwell on high; his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks; his bread shall be given [him]; his waters shall be sure.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este morará nas alturas; fortalezas de rochas serão seu abrigo; ele será provido de pão, [e] suas águas serão garantidas.
verses.RVR09: Este habitará en las alturas: fortalezas de rocas serán su lugar de acogimiento; se le dará su pan, y sus aguas serán ciertas.

verses.KJV: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
verses.WEB: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.
verses.ASV: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold a land that reacheth afar.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus olhos verão o rei em sua formosura; [e] verão uma terra que [se estende] até longe.
verses.RVR09: Tus ojos verán al Rey en su hermosura; verán la tierra que está lejos.

verses.KJV: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
verses.WEB: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?
verses.ASV: Thy heart shall muse on the terror: Where is he that counted, where is he that weighed [the tribute]? where is he that counted the towers?
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu coração pensará sobre o assombro, dizendo: Onde está o escriba? Onde está o tesoureiro? Onde está o que contava as torres?
verses.RVR09: Tu corazón imaginará el espanto, y dirá: ¿Qué es del escriba? ¿qué del pesador? ¿qué del que pone en lista las casas más insignes?

verses.KJV: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
verses.WEB: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt not see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that thou canst not comprehend, of a strange tongue that thou canst not understand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não verás [mais] aquele povo atrevido, povo de fala tão profunda, que não se pode compreender, de língua tão estranha, que não se pode entender.
verses.RVR09: No verás á aquel pueblo espantable, pueblo de lengua oscura de entender, de lengua tartamuda que no comprendas.

verses.KJV: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.WEB: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
verses.ASV: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tent that shall not be removed, the stakes whereof shall never be plucked up, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olhai para Sião, a cidade de nossas solenidades; teus olhos verão Jerusalém, morada tranquila, tenda que não será derrubada, cujas estacas nunca serão arrancadas, e nenhuma de suas cordas se arrebentará.
verses.RVR09: Mira á Sión, ciudad de nuestras solemnidades: tus ojos verán á Jerusalem, morada de quietud, tienda que no será desarmada, ni serán arrancadas sus estacas, ni ninguna de sus cuerdas será rota.

verses.KJV: But there the glorious Lord will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.WEB: But there the LORD will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.
verses.ASV: But there Jehovah will be with us in majesty, a place of broad rivers and streams, wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas ali o SENHOR será grandioso para nós: ele será um lugar de rios [e] correntes largas; nenhum barco a remo passará por eles, nem navio grande navegará por eles.
verses.RVR09: Porque ciertamente allí será Jehová para con nosotros fuerte, lugar de ríos, de arroyos muy anchos, por el cual no andará galera, ni por él pasará grande navío.

verses.KJV: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.
verses.WEB: For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah is our judge, Jehovah is our lawgiver, Jehovah is our king; he will save us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o SENHOR é nosso juiz; o SENHOR é nosso legislador; o SENHOR é nosso Rei, ele nos salvará.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová es nuestro juez, Jehová es nuestro legislador, Jehová es nuestro Rey, él mismo nos salvará.

verses.KJV: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
verses.WEB: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.
verses.ASV: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not strengthen the foot of their mast, they could not spread the sail: then was the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame took the prey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tuas cordas se afrouxaram; não puderam manter firme o seu mastro, nem estenderam a vela; então uma grande quantidade de despojos será repartida; [até] os aleijados tomarão despojos.
verses.RVR09: Tus cuerdas se aflojaron; no afirmaron su mástil, ni entesaron la vela: repartiráse entonces presa de muchos despojos: los cojos arrebatarán presa.

verses.KJV: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.WEB: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.ASV: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nenhum morador dirá: Estou enfermo; [porque] o povo que nela habitar será perdoado de [sua] perversidade.
verses.RVR09: No dirá el morador: Estoy enfermo: el pueblo que morare en ella será absuelto de pecado.

verses.KJV: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
verses.WEB: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it.
verses.ASV: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye peoples: let the earth hear, and the fulness thereof; the world, and all things that come forth from it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós nações, achegai-vos para ouvir; e vós povos, escutai; que a terra ouça, e tudo quanto ela contém; o mundo, e tudo quanto ele produz.
verses.RVR09: GENTES, allegaos á oir; y escuchad, pueblos. Oiga la tierra y lo que la hinche, el mundo y todo lo que él produce.

verses.KJV: For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.WEB: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah hath indignation against all the nations, and wrath against all their host: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a ira do SENHOR [está] sobre todas as nações, e [seu] furor sobre todo os exércitos delas; ele as destruirá, e as entregará à matança.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová está airado sobre todas las gentes, é irritado sobre todo el ejército de ellas: destruirálas y entregarálas al matadero.

verses.KJV: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.WEB: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up. The mountains will melt in their blood.
verses.ASV: Their slain also shall be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies shall come up; and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus mortos serão lançados fora, e de seus corpos sairá seu fedor; e os montes se derreterão com seu sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y los muertos de ellas serán arrojados, y de sus cadáveres se levantará hedor; y los montes se desleirán por la sangre de ellos.

verses.KJV: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
verses.WEB: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.
verses.ASV: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll; and all their host shall fade away, as the leaf fadeth from off the vine, and as a fading [leaf] from the fig-tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todo o exército do céu se desfará, e os céus se enrolarão como um rolo de pergaminho; e todo o seu exército cairá, como cai a folha da vide, como cai [o figo] da figueira.
verses.RVR09: Y todo el ejército de los cielos se corromperá, y plegarse han los cielos como un libro: y caerá todo su ejército, como se cae la hoja de la parra, y como se cae la de la higuera.

verses.KJV: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.WEB: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.
verses.ASV: For my sword hath drunk its fill in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Edom, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois minha espada se embebedou no céu; eis que descerá sobre Edom, sobre o povo a quem condenei à destruição, para o julgamento.
verses.RVR09: Porque en los cielos se embriagará mi espada: he aquí que descenderá sobre Edom en juicio, y sobre el pueblo de mi anatema.

verses.KJV: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.ASV: The sword of Jehovah is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Jehovah hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.ALMEIDA: A espada do SENHOR está cheia de sangue, está untada de gordura de sangue de cordeiros e de bodes, da gordura de rins de carneiros; porque o SENHOR tem sacrifício em Bozra, e grande matança na terra dos edomitas.
verses.RVR09: Llena está de sangre la espada de Jehová, engrasada está de grosura, de sangre de corderos y de cabritos, de grosura de riñones de carneros: porque Jehová tiene sacrificios en Bosra, y grande matanza en tierra de Edom.

verses.KJV: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.WEB: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.
verses.ASV: And the wild-oxen shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls: and their land shall be drunken with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os bois selvagens descerão com eles, e os bezerros com os touros; e a terra deles beberá sangue até se fartar, e seu pó da terra de gordura será untado;
verses.RVR09: Y con ellos vendrán abajo unicornios, y toros con becerros; y su tierra se embriagará de sangre, y su polvo se engrasará de grosura.

verses.KJV: For it is the day of the Lord's vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
verses.WEB: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah hath a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque será o dia da vingança do SENHOR, ano de pagamentos pela briga contra Sião.
verses.RVR09: Porque es día de venganza de Jehová, año de retribuciones en el pleito de Sión.

verses.KJV: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.WEB: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.
verses.ASV: And the streams of [Edom] shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus ribeiros se tornarão em piche, e seu solo em enxofre; e sua terra em piche ardente.
verses.RVR09: Y sus arroyos se tornarán en pez, y su polvo en azufre, y su tierra en pez ardiente.

verses.KJV: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: It won’t be quenched night or day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.
verses.ASV: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever; from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem de noite, nem de dia se apagará, para sempre sua fumaça subirá; de geração em geração será assolada; para todo o sempre ninguém passará por ela.
verses.RVR09: No se apagará de noche ni de día, perpetuamente subirá su humo: de generación en generación será asolada, nunca jamás pasará nadie por ella.

verses.KJV: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
verses.WEB: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.
verses.ASV: But the pelican and the porcupine shall possess it; and the owl and the raven shall dwell therein: and he will stretch over it the line of confusion, and the plummet of emptiness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o pelicano e a coruja tomarão posse dela, a ave selvagem e o corvo nela habitarão; pois[o SENHOR] estenderá sobre ela o cordel da assolação e o prumo da ruína.
verses.RVR09: Y la poseerán el pelícano y el mochuelo, la lechuza y el cuervo morarán en ella: y extenderáse sobre ella cordel de destrucción, y niveles de asolamiento.

verses.KJV: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.WEB: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.
verses.ASV: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chamarão ao seus nobres ao reino, porém nenhum haverá ali; e todos os seus príncipes se tornarão coisa nenhuma.
verses.RVR09: Llamarán á sus príncipes, príncipes sin reino: y todos sus grandes serán nada.

verses.KJV: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
verses.WEB: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.
verses.ASV: And thorns shall come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in the fortresses thereof; and it shall be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em seus palácios crescerão espinhos; urtigas e cardos em suas fortalezas; e será habitação de chacais [e] habitação de avestruzes.
verses.RVR09: En sus alcázares crecerán espinas, y ortigas y cardos en sus fortalezas; y serán morada de chacales, patio para los pollos de los avestruces.

verses.KJV: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
verses.WEB: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.
verses.ASV: And the wild beasts of the desert shall meet with the wolves, and the wild goat shall cry to his fellow; yea, the night-monster shall settle there, and shall find her a place of rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os animais do deserto se encontrarão com os lobos, e o bode berrará ao seu companheiro; os animais noturnos ali pousarão, e acharão lugar de descanso para si.
verses.RVR09: Y las bestias monteses se encontrarán con los gatos cervales, y el peludo gritará á su compañero: la lamia también tendrá allí asiento, y hallará para sí reposo.

verses.KJV: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.WEB: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.
verses.ASV: There shall the dart-snake make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shade; yea, there shall the kites be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali a coruja fará seu ninho e porá [ovos] ,e tirará seus filhotes, e os recolherá debaixo de sua sombra; também ali os abutres se ajuntarão uns com os outros.
verses.RVR09: Allí anidará el cuclillo, conservará sus huevos, y sacará sus pollos, y juntarálos debajo de sus alas: también se ayuntarán allí buitres, cada uno con su compañera.

verses.KJV: Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
verses.WEB: Search in the book of the LORD, and read: not one of these will be missing. None will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.
verses.ASV: Seek ye out of the book of Jehovah, and read: no one of these shall be missing, none shall want her mate; for my mouth, it hath commanded, and his Spirit, it hath gathered them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Buscai no livro do SENHOR, e lede; nenhuma destas [criaturas] falhará, nenhuma destas faltará com sua companheira; pois de minha própria boca ele mandou, e seu próprio Espírito as ajuntará.
verses.RVR09: Inquirid en el libro de Jehová, y leed si faltó alguno de ellos: ninguno faltó con su compañera; porque su boca mandó, y reuniólos su mismo espíritu.

verses.KJV: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.WEB: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.
verses.ASV: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever; from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele mesmo lhes deu terreno, e sua mão repartiu para elas com o cordel; para sempre terão posse dela, geração após geração nela habitarão.
verses.RVR09: Y él les echó las suertes, y su mano les repartió con cordel: para siempre la tendrán por heredad, de generación en generación morarán allí.

verses.KJV: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.WEB: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
verses.ASV: The wilderness and the dry land shall be glad; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.ALMEIDA: O deserto e o lugar seco terão prazer disto; e o lugar desabitado se alegrará e florescerá como a rosa.
verses.RVR09: ALEGRARSE han el desierto y la soledad: el yermo se gozará, y florecerá como la rosa.

verses.KJV: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the Lord, and the excellency of our God.
verses.WEB: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the LORD’s glory, the excellence of our God.
verses.ASV: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing; the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon: they shall see the glory of Jehovah, the excellency of our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abundantemente florescerá, e também se encherá de alegria e júbilo; a glória do Líbano lhe será dada, a honra do Carmelo e de Sarom; eles verão a glória do SENHOR, a honra de nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Florecerá profusamente, y también se alegrará y cantará con júbilo: la gloria del Líbano le será dada, la hermosura de Carmel y de Sarón. Ellos verán la gloria de Jehová, la hermosura del Dios nuestro.

verses.KJV: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.WEB: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.
verses.ASV: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fortalecei as mãos fracas, e firmai os joelhos que tremem.
verses.RVR09: Confortad á las manos cansadas, roborad las vacilantes rodillas.

verses.KJV: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
verses.WEB: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.
verses.ASV: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come [with] vengeance, [with] the recompense of God; he will come and save you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizei aos perturbados de coração: Fortalecei-vos! Não temais! Eis que nosso Deus virá para a vingança, aos pagamentos de Deus; ele virá e vos salvará.
verses.RVR09: Decid á los de corazón apocado: Confortaos, no temáis: he aquí que vuestro Dios viene con venganza, con pago; el mismo Dios vendrá, y os salvará.

verses.KJV: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.WEB: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.
verses.ASV: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os olhos dos cegos serão abertos, e os ouvidos dos surdos se abrirão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces los ojos de los ciegos serán abiertos, y los oídos de los sordos se abrirán.

verses.KJV: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.WEB: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
verses.ASV: Then shall the lame man leap as a hart, and the tongue of the dumb shall sing; for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os aleijados saltarão como cervos, e a língua dos mudos falará alegremente; porque águas arrebentarão no deserto, e ribeiros no lugar desabitado.
verses.RVR09: Entonces el cojo saltará como un ciervo, y cantará la lengua del mudo; porque aguas serán cavadas en el desierto, y torrentes en la soledad.

verses.KJV: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.WEB: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.
verses.ASV: And the glowing sand shall become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water: in the habitation of jackals, where they lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a terra seca se tornará em lagoas, e a terra sedenta em mananciais de águas; nas habitações em que repousavam os chacais, haverá erva com canas e juncos.
verses.RVR09: El lugar seco será tornado en estanque, y el secadal en manaderos de aguas; en la habitación de chacales, en su cama, será lugar de cañas y de juncos.

verses.KJV: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
verses.WEB: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.
verses.ASV: And a highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for [the redeemed]: the wayfaring men, yea fools, shall not err [therein].
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali haverá uma estrada, e um caminho que se chamará caminho da santidade; o impuro não passará por ele, mas será para os [que podem] andar pelo caminho; até mesmo os tolos [que por ele passarem] não errarão.
verses.RVR09: Y habrá allí calzada y camino, y será llamado Camino de Santidad; no pasará por él inmundo; y habrá para ellos en él quien los acompañe, de tal manera que los insensatos no yerren.

verses.KJV: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
verses.WEB: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.
verses.ASV: No lion shall be there, nor shall any ravenous beast go up thereon; they shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk [there]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ali não haverá leão, nem animal selvagem subirá a ele, nem se achará nele; porém os redimidos [por ele] andarão.
verses.RVR09: No habrá allí león, ni bestia fiera subirá por él, ni allí se hallará, para que caminen los redimidos.

verses.KJV: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
verses.ASV: and the ransomed of Jehovah shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their heads: they shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os resgatados do SENHOR voltarão, e virão a Sião com júbilo, e alegria eterna haverá sobre suas cabeças; eles terão prazer e alegria, e a tristeza e o gemido [deles] fugirão.
verses.RVR09: Y los redimidos de Jehová volverán, y vendrán á Sión con alegría; y gozo perpetuo será sobre sus cabezas: y retendrán el gozo y alegría, y huirá la tristeza y el gemido.

verses.KJV: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.WEB: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
verses.ASV: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu no décimo quarto ano do rei Ezequias, que Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, subiu contra todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá, e as tomou.
verses.RVR09: ACONTECIÓ en el año catorce del rey Ezechîas, que Sennachêrib rey de Asiria subió contra todas las ciudades fuertes de Judá, y tomólas.

verses.KJV: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
verses.WEB: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.
verses.ASV: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o rei da Assíria enviou a Rabsaqué, de Laquis a Jerusalém, ao rei Ezequias, com um grande exército; e ele parou junto ao duto do tanque superior, junto ao caminho do campo do lavandeiro.
verses.RVR09: Y el rey de Asiria envió á Rabsaces con grande ejército desde Lachîs á Jerusalem al rey Ezechîas: y asentó el campo á los caños de la pesquera de arriba, en el camino de la heredad del Lavador.

verses.KJV: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.
verses.WEB: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him.
verses.ASV: Then came forth unto him Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então saíram ao encontro dele Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, o administrador da casa real; Sebna, o escriba, e Joá, filho de Asafe, o cronista.
verses.RVR09: Y salió á él Eliacim hijo de Hilcías mayordomo, y Sebna, escriba, y Joah hijo de Asaph, canciller.

verses.KJV: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.WEB: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?
verses.ASV: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.ALMEIDA: E [Rabsaqué] lhes disse: Dizei, pois, a Ezequias: Assim diz o grande rei, o rei da Assíria: Que confiança é essa, em que confias?
verses.RVR09: A los cuales dijo Rabsaces: Ahora pues, diréis á Ezechîas: El gran rey, el rey de Asiria, dice así: ¿Qué confianza es ésta en que confías?

verses.KJV: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.WEB: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?
verses.ASV: I say, [thy] counsel and strength for the war are but vain words: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou hast rebelled against me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, de fato, digo, que [teus] conselhos e poder de guerra são apenas palavras vazias. Em quem, pois, confias, para te rebelares contra mim?
verses.RVR09: Digo, alegas tú, (empero palabras vanas) que tengo consejo y fortaleza para la guerra. Ahora bien, ¿en quién confías que te rebelas contra mí?

verses.KJV: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
verses.WEB: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
verses.ASV: Behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que confias no Egito, aquele bastão de cana quebrada, em quem se alguém se apoiar, entrará pela mão e a perfurará; assim é Faraó, rei do Egito, para com todos os que nele confiam.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que confías en este bordón de caña frágil, en Egipto, sobre el cual si alguien se apoyare, entrarásele por la mano, y se la atravesará. Tal es Faraón rey de Egipto para con todos los que en él confían.

verses.KJV: But if thou say to me, We trust in the Lord our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
verses.WEB: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?”
verses.ASV: But if thou say unto me, We trust in Jehovah our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém, se me disseres: Confiamos no SENHOR, nosso Deus; Por acaso não é este aquele cujos altos e cujos altares Ezequias tirou, e disse a Judá e a Jerusalém: Perante este altar adorareis?
verses.RVR09: Y si me dijeres, En Jehová nuestro Dios confiamos; ¿no es éste aquel cuyos altos y cuyos altares hizo quitar Ezechîas, y dijo á Judá y á Jerusalem: Delante de este altar adoraréis?

verses.KJV: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.
verses.ASV: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, submeta-te à proposta do meu senhor, o rei da Assíria; e eu te darei dois mil cavalos, se tu podes dar dois mil cavaleiros para eles.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues yo te ruego que des rehenes al rey de Asiria mi señor, y yo te daré dos mil caballos, si pudieres tú dar caballeros que cabalguen sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.WEB: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.ASV: How then canst thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como, pois, te oporias a um chefe dentre os menores servos do meu senhor, [apenas] confiando nas carruagens e cavaleiros do Egito?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo pues harás volver el rostro de un capitán de los más pequeños siervos de mi señor, aunque estés confiado en Egipto por sus carros y hombres de á caballo?

verses.KJV: And am I now come up without the Lord against this land to destroy it? the Lord said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.WEB: Have I come up now without the LORD against this land to destroy it? The LORD said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”
verses.ASV: And am I now come up without Jehovah against this land to destroy it? Jehovah said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ora, subi eu sem o SENHOR contra esta terra, para destruí-la? O [próprio] SENHOR me disse: Sobe contra esta terra, e destrói-a.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y por ventura vine yo ahora á esta tierra para destruirla sin Jehová? Jehová me dijo: Sube á esta tierra para destruirla.

verses.KJV: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.WEB: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”
verses.ASV: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews’ language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Eliaquim, Sebna e Joá disseram a Rabsaqué: Pedimos que fale a teus servos em aramaico, porque nós o entendemos; e não nos fale na língua judaica, aos ouvidos do povo, que está sobre o muro.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Eliacim, y Sebna y Joah á Rabsaces: Rogámoste que hables á tus siervos en lengua siriaca, porque nosotros la entendemos: y no hables con nosotros en lengua judáica, oyéndolo el pueblo que está sobre el muro.

verses.KJV: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.WEB: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”
verses.ASV: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? [hath he] not [sent me] to the men that sit upon the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own water with you?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém Rabsaqué disse: Por acaso meu senhor me mandou falar estas palavras [só] a teu senhor e a ti, e não [também] aos homens que estão sentados sobre o muro, que juntamente convosco comerão suas próprias fezes, e beberão sua própria urina?
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Rabsaces: ¿Envióme mi señor á ti y á tu señor, á que dijese estas palabras, y no á los hombres que están sobre el muro, para comer su estiércol y beber su orina con vosotros?

verses.KJV: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.WEB: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.ASV: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Rabsaqué se pôs de pé, clamou em alta voz na língua judaica, e disse: Ouvi as palavras do grande rei, o rei da Assíria!
verses.RVR09: Púsose luego en pie Rabsaces, y gritó á grande voz en lengua judáica, diciendo: Oid las palabras del gran rey, el rey de Asiria.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
verses.WEB: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o rei: Que Ezequias não vos engane, pois ele não poderá vos livrar.
verses.RVR09: El rey dice así: No os engañe Ezechîas, porque no os podrá librar.

verses.KJV: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.WEB: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, “The LORD will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’
verses.ASV: neither let Hezekiah make you trust in Jehovah, saying, Jehovah will surely deliver us; this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem deixeis que Ezequias vos faça confiar no SENHOR, dizendo: Com certeza o SENHOR nos livrará; esta cidade não será entregue nas mãos do rei da Assíria.
verses.RVR09: Ni os haga Ezechîas confiar en Jehová, diciendo: Ciertamente Jehová nos librará: no será entregada esta ciudad en manos del rey de Asiria.

verses.KJV: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
verses.WEB: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;
verses.ASV: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig-tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não escuteis a Ezequias; porque assim diz o rei da Assíria: fazei as pazes comigo, e saí até mim; e cada um com de sua vide, e de sua figueira, e cada um beba a água de sua [própria] cisterna;
verses.RVR09: No escuchéis á Ezechîas: porque el rey de Asiria dice así: Haced conmigo paz, y salid á mí; y coma cada uno de su viña, y cada uno de su higuera, y beba cada cual las aguas de su pozo;

verses.KJV: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.WEB: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.ASV: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que eu venha, e vos leve a uma terra como a vossa, terra de trigo e de suco de uva, terra de pão e de vinhas.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que yo venga y os lleve á una tierra como la vuestra, tierra de grano y de vino, tierra de pan y de viñas.

verses.KJV: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, the Lord will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.WEB: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “The LORD will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.ASV: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, Jehovah will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que Ezequias não vos engane, dizendo: O SENHOR nos livrará; por acaso os deuses das nações livraram cada um sua terra das mãos do rei da Assíria?
verses.RVR09: Mirad no os engañe Ezechîas diciendo: Jehová nos librará. ¿Libraron los dioses de las gentes cada uno á su tierra de la mano del rey de Asiria?

verses.KJV: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.WEB: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
verses.ASV: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde estão os deuses de Hamate e de Arpade? Onde estão os deuses de Sefarvaim? Por acaso eles livraram a Samaria das minhas mãos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde está el dios de Hamath y de Arphad? ¿dónde está el dios de Sepharvaim? ¿libraron á Samaria de mi mano?

verses.KJV: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.WEB: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”
verses.ASV: Who are they among all the gods of these countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Jehovah should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem são dentre todos os deuses destas terras, que livraram sua terra das minhas mãos? Como, pois, o SENHOR livrará a Jerusalém das minhas mãos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué dios hay entre los dioses de estas tierras, que haya librado su tierra de mi mano, para que Jehová libre de mi mano á Jerusalem?

verses.KJV: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.WEB: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”
verses.ASV: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles ficaram calados, e nenhuma palavra lhe responderam; porque tinham ordem do rei, dizendo: Não lhe respondereis.
verses.RVR09: Mas callaron, y no le respondieron palabra; porque el rey así lo había mandado, diciendo: No le respondáis.

verses.KJV: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.WEB: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.ASV: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias, o administrador da casa real, e Sebna, o escriba, e Joá filho de Asafe, o cronista, vieram a Ezequias com as roupas rasgadas, e lhe contaram as palavras de Rabsaqué.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Eliacim hijo de Hilcías mayordomo, y Sebna escriba, y Joah hijo de Asaph canciller, vinieron á Ezechîas rotos sus vestidos, y contáronle las palabras de Rabsaces.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu que, quando o rei Ezequias ouviu [isso] ,ele rasgou suas roupas, cobriu-se de saco, e entrou na casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ACONTECIÓ pues, que el rey Ezechîas, oído esto, rasgó sus vestidos, y cubierto de saco vino á la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.WEB: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
verses.ASV: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então ele enviou Eliaquim o administrador da casa real, Sebna o escriba, e os anciãos dos sacerdotes, cobertos de sacos, ao profeta Isaías, filho de Amoz.
verses.RVR09: Y envió á Eliacim mayordomo, y á Sebna escriba, y á los ancianos de los sacerdotes, cubiertos de sacos, á Isaías profeta, hijo de Amoz.

verses.KJV: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.WEB: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.
verses.ASV: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of contumely; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhe disseram: Assim diz Ezequias: Este dia é um dia de angústia, de repreensão, e de blasfêmia; pois os filhos chegaram ao parto, porém não há força para que possam nascer.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales le dijeron: Ezechîas dice así: Día de angustia, de reprensión y de blasfemia, es este día: porque los hijos han llegado hasta la rotura, y no hay fuerza en la que pare.

verses.KJV: It may be the Lord thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
verses.WEB: It may be the LORD your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”
verses.ASV: It may be Jehovah thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Jehovah thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
verses.ALMEIDA: Talvez o SENHOR venha a ouvir as palavras de Rabsaqué, a quem seu senhor, o rei da Assíria, enviou, para afrontar ao Deus vivente; e repreenda as palavras que o SENHOR teu Deus tem ouvido. Faze, pois, oração pelos restantes, que [ainda] se encontram.
verses.RVR09: Quizá oirá Jehová tu Dios las palabras de Rabsaces, al cual envió el rey de Asiria su señor á blasfemar al Dios vivo, y á reprender con las palabras que oyó Jehová tu Dios: alza pues oración tú por las reliquias que aun han quedado.

verses.KJV: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.WEB: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.ASV: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os servos do rei vieram até Isaías,
verses.RVR09: Vinieron pues los siervos de Ezechîas á Isaías.

verses.KJV: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.WEB: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘The LORD says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.ASV: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith Jehovah, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Isaías lhes disse: Assim direis a vosso senhor: Assim diz o SENHOR: Não temas das palavras que ouviste, com as quais os servos do rei da Assíria me blasfemaram.
verses.RVR09: Y díjoles Isaías: Diréis así á vuestro señor: Así dice Jehová: No temas por las palabras que has oído, con las cuales me han blasfemado los siervos del rey de Asiria.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”
verses.ASV: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he shall hear tidings, and shall return unto his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que porei nele um espírito de tal maneira que, quando ouvir um rumor, ele voltará à sua terra; e eu o derrubarei pela espada em sua [própria] terra.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que yo doy en él un espíritu, y oirá un rumor, y volveráse á su tierra: y yo haré que en su tierra caiga á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.WEB: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.
verses.ASV: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Rabsaqué voltou, e achou ao rei da Assíria lutando contra Libna, pois tinha ouvido que ele [já] tinha saído de Laquis.
verses.RVR09: Vuelto pues Rabsaces, halló al rey de Asiria que batía á Libna; porque ya había oído que se había apartado de Lachîs.

verses.KJV: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.WEB: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.ASV: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come out to fight against thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele, ao ouvir dizer que Tiraca, rei de Cuxe, tinha saído para fazer guerra contra ele, então, após ouvir, enviou mensageiros a Ezequias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Mas oyendo decir de Tirhakah rey de Etiopía: He aquí que ha salido para hacerte guerra: en oyéndolo, envió mensajeros á Ezechîas, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.WEB: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”
verses.ASV: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim falareis a Ezequias, rei de Judá, dizendo: Que teu Deus, em quem confias, não te engane, dizendo: Jerusalém não será entregue nas mãos do rei da Assíria.
verses.RVR09: Diréis así á Ezechîas rey de Judá: No te engañe tu Dios en quien tú confías, diciendo: Jerusalem no será entregada en mano del rey de Asiria.

verses.KJV: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.WEB: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?
verses.ASV: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que tens ouvido o que os reis da Assíria fizeram a todas as terras, destruindo-as por completo. E tu, escaparias?
verses.RVR09: He aquí que tú oiste lo que hicieron los reyes de Asiria á todas las tierras, que las destruyeron; ¿y escaparás tú?

verses.KJV: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
verses.WEB: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.ASV: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden that were in Telassar?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso as livraram os deuses das nações as quais meus pais destruíram, tal como Gozã, Harã e Rezefe, e os filhos de Éden que estavam em Telassar?
verses.RVR09: ¿Libraron los dioses de las gentes á los que destruyeron mis antepasados, á Gozán, y Harán, Rezeph, y á los hijos de Edén que moraban en Thelasar?

verses.KJV: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
verses.WEB: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”
verses.ASV: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Onde está o rei da Hamate, o rei de Arpade, o rei de Sefarvaim, ou Hena e Iva?
verses.RVR09: ¿Dónde está el rey de Amath, y el rey de Arphad, el rey de la ciudad de Sepharvaim, de Henah, y de Hivah?

verses.KJV: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.
verses.WEB: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD’s house, and spread it before the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up unto the house of Jehovah, and spread it before Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ezequias, recebendo as cartas das mãos dos mensageiros, e tendo as lido, subiu à casa do SENHOR, e Ezequias as estendeu perante o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y tomó Ezechîas las cartas de mano de los mensajeros, y leyólas; y subió á la casa de Jehová, y las extendió delante de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Hezekiah prayed unto the Lord, saying,
verses.WEB: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,
verses.ASV: And Hezekiah prayed unto Jehovah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Ezequias orou ao SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces Ezechîas oró á Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.WEB: “LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, that sittest [above] the cherubim, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, que habitas entre os querubins; tu, só tu, és Deus de todos os reinos da terra; tu fizeste os céus e a terra.
