verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, que moras entre los querubines, sólo tú eres Dios sobre todos los reinos de la tierra; tú hiciste los cielos y la tierra.

verses.KJV: Incline thine ear, O Lord, and hear; open thine eyes, O Lord, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
verses.WEB: Turn your ear, LORD, and hear. Open your eyes, LORD, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.
verses.ASV: Incline thine ear, O Jehovah, and hear; open thine eyes, O Jehovah, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, who hath sent to defy the living God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Inclina teu ouvido, ó SENHOR, e ouve; abre os teus olhos, SENHOR, e olha; e ouve todas as palavras de Senaqueribe que ele enviou para afrontar o Deus vivente.
verses.RVR09: Inclina, oh Jehová, tu oído, y oye; abre, oh Jehová, tus ojos, y mira: y oye todas las palabras de Sennachêrib, el cual ha enviado á blasfemar al Dios viviente.

verses.KJV: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
verses.WEB: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,
verses.ASV: Of a truth, Jehovah, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the countries, and their land,
verses.ALMEIDA: É verdade, SENHOR, que os reis da Assíria assolaram a todas as terras e seus territórios,
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente, oh Jehová, los reyes de Asiria destruyeron todas las tierras y sus comarcas,

verses.KJV: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.WEB: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.ASV: and have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançaram seus deuses ao fogo, porque não eram deuses, mas sim obras de mãos humanas, madeira e pedra; por isso os destruíram.
verses.RVR09: Y entregaron los dioses de ellos al fuego: porque no eran dioses, sino obra de manos de hombre, leño y piedra: por eso los deshicieron.

verses.KJV: Now therefore, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord, even thou only.
verses.WEB: Now therefore, LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are the LORD, even you only.”
verses.ASV: Now therefore, O Jehovah our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art Jehovah, even thou only.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, SENHOR nosso Deus, livra-nos das mãos dele, [e] assim todos os reinos da terra saberão que tu, só tu, és o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Jehová Dios nuestro, líbranos de su mano, para que todos los reinos de la tierra conozcan que sólo tú eres Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
verses.WEB: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “The LORD, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,
verses.ASV: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Isaías, filho de Amós, mandou dizer a Ezequias: Assim diz o SENHOR, Deus de Israel: Quanto ao que me pediste sobre Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria,
verses.RVR09: Entonces Isaías hijo de Amoz, envió á decir á Ezechîas: Jehová Dios de Israel dice así: Acerca de lo que me rogaste sobre Sennachêrib rey de Asiria,

verses.KJV: This is the word which the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.WEB: this is the word which the LORD has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
verses.ASV: this is the word which Jehovah hath spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion hath despised thee and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Esta é a palavra que o SENHOR falou sobre ele: A virgem, a filha de Sião, te despreza, zomba de ti; a filha de Jerusalém balança a cabeça após ti.
verses.RVR09: Esto es lo que Jehová habló de él: Hate menospreciado, y ha hecho escarnio de ti la virgen hija de Sión: meneó su cabeza á tus espaldas la hija de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: Whom hast thou defied and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice and lifted up thine eyes on high? [even] against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem afrontaste? [De quem] blasfemaste? E contra quem levantaste a voz, e levantaste aos olhos arrogantemente? Contra o Santo de Israel!
verses.RVR09: ¿A quién injuriaste y á quién blasfemaste? ¿contra quién has alzado tu voz, y levantado tus ojos en alto? Contra el Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
verses.WEB: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.
verses.ASV: By thy servants hast thou defied the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir-trees thereof; and I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por meio de teus servos afrontaste ao Senhor, e disseste: Com a minha multidão de carruagens eu subi aos cumes dos montes, aos lugares remotos do Líbano; e cortarei seus altos cedros, e seus melhores ciprestes, e virei a seu extremo cume, ao bosque de seu campo fértil.
verses.RVR09: Por mano de tus siervos denostaste al Señor, y dijiste: Yo con la multitud de mis carros subiré á las alturas de los montes, á las laderas del Líbano; cortaré sus altos cedros, sus hayas escogidas; vendré después á lo alto de su límite, al monte de su Carmel.

verses.KJV: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
verses.WEB: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”
verses.ASV: I have digged and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet will I dry up all the rivers of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu cavei, e bebi as águas; e com as plantas dos meus pés secarei todos os rios do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Yo cavé, y bebí las aguas; y con las pisadas de mis pies secaré todos los ríos de lugares atrincherados.

verses.KJV: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
verses.WEB: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.
verses.ASV: Hast thou not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? now have I brought it to pass, that it should be thine to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não ouviste que desde muito antes eu fiz isto, e deste os dias antigos o tinha planejado? Agora eu fiz isto acontecer, para que tu fosses o que destruirias as cidades fortificadas, [reduzindo-as] a amontoados de ruínas.
verses.RVR09: ¿No has oído decir que de mucho tiempo ha yo lo hice, que de días antiguos lo he formado? Helo hecho venir ahora, y será para destrucción de ciudades fuertes en montones de ruinas.

verses.KJV: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
verses.WEB: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.
verses.ASV: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as a field [of grain] before it is grown up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso os moradores delas, com as mãos impotentes, ficaram atemorizados e envergonhados; eram [como] a erva do campo, e a grama verde, o capim dos telhados e o trigo queimado antes de crescer.
verses.RVR09: Y sus moradores, cortos de manos, quebrantados y confusos, serán como grama del campo y hortaliza verde, como hierba de los tejados, que antes de sazón se seca.

verses.KJV: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
verses.WEB: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.
verses.ASV: But I know thy sitting down, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy raging against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu sei o teu sentar, o teu sair, o teu entrar, e o teu furor contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Conocido he tu estado, tu salida y tu entrada, y tu furor contra mí.

verses.KJV: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.WEB: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
verses.ASV: Because of thy raging against me, and because thine arrogancy is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa de teu furor contra mim, e teu tumulto que subiu aos meus ouvidos, por isso porei meu anzol em teu nariz, e meu freio em tua boca; e te farei voltar pelo caminho em que vieste.
verses.RVR09: Porque contra mí te airaste, y tu estruendo ha subido á mis oídos: pondré pues mi anzuelo en tu nariz, y mi freno en tus labios, y haréte tornar por el camino por donde viniste.

verses.KJV: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
verses.WEB: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
verses.ASV: And this shall be the sign unto thee: ye shall eat this year that which groweth of itself, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto será por sinal para ti, [Ezequias] : este ano se comerá daquilo que nascer de si mesmo, e no segundo ano do que daí proceder; porém no terceiro ano semeai e colhei; e plantai vinhas, e comei seus frutos.
verses.RVR09: Y esto te será por señal: Comerás este año lo que nace de suyo, y el año segundo lo que nace de suyo: y el año tercero sembraréis y segaréis, y plantaréis viñas, y comeréis su fruto.

verses.KJV: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
verses.WEB: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
verses.ASV: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois os sobreviventes da casa de Judá, o remanescente, voltará a formar raízes abaixo, e dará fruto acima.
verses.RVR09: Y el residuo de la casa de Judá que hubiere escapado, tornará á echar raíz abajo, y hará fruto arriba.

verses.KJV: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.
verses.WEB: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.’
verses.ASV: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and out of mount Zion they that shall escape. The zeal of Jehovah of hosts will perform this.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque de Jerusalém sairá o remanescente, e do monte de Sião os que sobreviverem; o zelo do SENHOR dos exércitos fará isto.
verses.RVR09: Porque de Jerusalem saldrán reliquias, y del monte de Sión salvamento: el celo de Jehová de los ejércitos hará esto.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.WEB: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come unto this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither shall he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR quanto ao rei da Assíria: Ele não entrará nesta cidade, nem lançará flecha nela; nem também virá diante dela com escudo, nem levantará cerco contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así dice Jehová acerca del rey de Asiria: No entrará en esta ciudad, ni echará saeta en ella: no vendrá delante de ella escudo, ni será echado contra ella baluarte.

verses.KJV: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says the LORD.
verses.ASV: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and he shall not come unto this city, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pelo mesmo caminho que veio, nele voltará; mas nesta cidade ele não entrará, diz o SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Por el camino que vino se tornará, y no entrará en esta ciudad, dice Jehová:

verses.KJV: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
verses.WEB: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”
verses.ASV: For I will defend this city to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu defenderei esta cidade para a livrar, por causa de mim e por causa do meu servo Davi.
verses.RVR09: Pues yo ampararé á esta ciudad para salvarla por amor de mí, y por amor de David mi siervo.

verses.KJV: Then the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.
verses.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand; and when men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o anjo do SENHOR saiu, e feriu no acampamento dos assírios cento e oitenta mil [deles] ; e levantando-se pela manhã cedo, eis que todos eram cadáveres.
verses.RVR09: Y salió el ángel de Jehová, é hirió ciento ochenta y cinco mil en el campo de los Asirios: y cuando se levantaron por la mañana, he aquí que todo era cuerpos de muertos.

verses.KJV: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.WEB: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.
verses.ASV: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, partiu-se, e foi embora, voltou, e ficou em Nínive.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Sennachêrib rey de Asiria partiéndose se fué, y volvióse, é hizo su morada en Nínive.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.WEB: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, enquanto ele estava prostrado na casa de seu deus Nisroque, seus filhos Adrameleque e Sarezer o feriram a espada; então eles escaparam para a terra de Ararate; e Esar-Hadom, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y acaeció, que estando orando en el templo de Nisroch su dios, Adremelech y Sarezer, sus hijos, le hirieron á cuchillo, y huyeron á la tierra de Ararat; y reinó en su lugar Esar-hadón su hijo.

verses.KJV: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.WEB: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”
verses.ASV: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Set thy house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naqueles dias Ezequias ficou doente, perto de morrer. E veio até ele Isaías, filho de Amoz, e lhe disse: Assim diz o SENHOR: Põe em ordem a tua casa, porque morrerás, e não viverás.
verses.RVR09: EN aquellos días cayó Ezechîas enfermo para morir. Y vino á él Isaías profeta, hijo de Amoz, y díjole: Jehová dice así: Ordena tu casa, porque tú morirás, y no vivirás.

verses.KJV: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the Lord,
verses.WEB: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,
verses.ASV: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Ezequias virou o seu rosto para a parede, e orou ao SENHOR,
verses.RVR09: Entonces volvió Ezechîas su rostro á la pared, é hizo oración á Jehová,

verses.KJV: And said, Remember now, O Lord, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.WEB: and said, “Remember now, LORD, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.ASV: and said, Remember now, O Jehovah, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse: Ó SENHOR, lembra-te, eu te peço, de que andei diante de ti com fidelidade e com coração íntegro, e fiz o que era agradável aos teus olhos! E Ezequias chorou com muito lamento.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Oh Jehová, ruégote te acuerdes ahora que he andado delante de ti en verdad y con íntegro corazón, y que he hecho lo que ha sido agradable delante de tus ojos. Y lloró Ezechîas con gran lloro.

verses.KJV: Then came the word of the Lord to Isaiah, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s word came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.ASV: Then came the word of Jehovah to Isaiah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Isaías, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces fué palabra de Jehová á Isaías, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
verses.WEB: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘The LORD, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
verses.ASV: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, e diz a Ezequias: Assim diz o SENHOR, o Deus de teu pai Davi: Eu ouvi tua oração, [e] vi tuas lágrimas. Eis que acrescento quinze anos aos teus dias [de vida] .
verses.RVR09: Ve, y di á Ezechîas: Jehová Dios de David tu padre dice así: Tu oración he oído, y visto tus lágrimas: he aquí que yo añado á tus días quince años.

verses.KJV: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
verses.WEB: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.
verses.ASV: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E das mãos do rei da Assíria eu livrarei a ti, e a esta cidade; e defenderei esta cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y te libraré, y á esta ciudad, de mano del rey de Asiria; y á esta ciudad ampararé.

verses.KJV: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing that he hath spoken;
verses.WEB: This shall be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he has spoken.
verses.ASV: And this shall be the sign unto thee from Jehovah, that Jehovah will do this thing that he hath spoken:
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto te será por sinal da parte do SENHOR, de que o SENHOR cumprirá esta palavra que falou:
verses.RVR09: Y esto te será señal de parte de Jehová, que Jehová hará esto que ha dicho:

verses.KJV: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.
verses.ASV: behold, I will cause the shadow on the steps, which is gone down on the dial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps. So the sun returned ten steps on the dial whereon it was gone down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que voltarei voltar a sombra dos degraus nos quais o sol desceu na escadaria de Acaz; dez degraus atrás.Assim voltou o sol dez degraus, pelos degraus que já tinha descido.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que yo vuelvo atrás la sombra de los grados, que ha descendido en el reloj de Achâz por el sol, diez grados. Y el sol fué tornado diez grados atrás, por los cuales había ya descendido.

verses.KJV: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
verses.WEB: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness:
verses.ASV: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Escritura de Ezequias, rei de Judá, quando ficou doente, e se sarou de sua enfermidade:
verses.RVR09: Escritura de Ezechîas rey de Judá, de cuando enfermó y sanó de su enfermedad.

verses.KJV: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
verses.WEB: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”
verses.ASV: I said, In the noontide of my days I shall go into the gates of Sheol: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse eu: No meio da minha vida, irei às portas do Xeol; privado estou do resto dos meus anos.
verses.RVR09: Yo dije: En el medio de mis días iré á las puertas del sepulcro: privado soy del resto de mis años.

verses.KJV: I said, I shall not see the Lord, even the Lord, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.WEB: I said, “I won’t see the LORD, the LORD in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.ASV: I said, I shall not see Jehovah, [even] Jehovah in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu disse: Não verei [mais] ao SENHOR, o SENHOR na terra dos viventes; não mais olharei aos homens com os que habitam o mundo.
verses.RVR09: Dije: No veré á JAH, á JAH en la tierra de los que viven: ya no veré más hombre con los moradores del mundo.

verses.KJV: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.WEB: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
verses.ASV: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have rolled up, like a weaver, my life; he will cut me off from the loom: From day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha morada foi removida e tirada de mim, como uma tenda de pastor; enrolei minha vida como um tecelão; ele me cortará fora do tear; desde o dia até a noite tu me acabarás.
verses.RVR09: Mi morada ha sido movida y traspasada de mí, como tienda de pastor. Como el tejedor corté mi vida; cortaráme con la enfermedad; me consumirás entre el día y la noche.

verses.KJV: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.WEB: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
verses.ASV: I quieted [myself] until morning; as a lion, so he breaketh all my bones: From day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fiquei esperando até a manhã; como um leão ele quebrou todos os meus ossos; desde o dia até a noite tu me acabarás.
verses.RVR09: Contaba yo hasta la mañana. Como un león molió todos mis huesos: de la mañana á la noche me acabarás.

verses.KJV: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O Lord, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
verses.WEB: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”
verses.ASV: Like a swallow [or] a crane, so did I chatter; I did moan as a dove; mine eyes fail [with looking] upward: O Lord, I am oppressed, be thou my surety.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como o grou, [ou] a andorinha, assim eu fazia barulho; [e] gemia como uma pomba; ao alto eu levantava meus olhos. Ó SENHOR, estou oprimido! Sê tu minha segurança!
verses.RVR09: Como la grulla y como la golondrina me quejaba; gemía como la paloma: alzaba en alto mis ojos: Jehová, violencia padezco; confórtame.

verses.KJV: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.WEB: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
verses.ASV: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que direi? Tal como ele me falou, assim fez; passarei lentamente por todos os meus anos, por causa da amargura de minha alma.
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué diré? El que me lo dijo, él mismo lo ha hecho. Andaré recapacitando en la amargura de mi alma todos los años de mi vida.

verses.KJV: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
verses.WEB: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.
verses.ASV: O Lord, by these things men live; And wholly therein is the life of my spirit: Wherefore recover thou me, and make me to live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Senhor, por estas coisas é que se vive, e em todas elas está a vida de meu espírito. Então cura-me, e deixa-me viver.
verses.RVR09: Oh Señor, sobre ellos vivirán tus piedades, y á todos diré consistir en ellas la vida de mi espíritu; pues tú me restablecerás, y me harás que viva.

verses.KJV: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
verses.WEB: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
verses.ASV: Behold, [it was] for [my] peace [that] I had great bitterness: But thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; For thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que para meu [próprio] bem tive grande amargura; tu, porém, com amor livraste minha alma da cova do perecimento; porque lançaste para trás de ti todos os meus pecados.
verses.RVR09: He aquí amargura grande me sobrevino en la paz: mas á ti plugo librar mi vida del hoyo de corrupción: porque echaste tras tus espaldas todos mis pecados.

verses.KJV: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
verses.WEB: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.
verses.ASV: For Sheol cannot praise thee, death cannot celebrate thee: They that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Xeol não te louvará, [nem] a morte te glorificará; nem esperarão em tua fidelidade os que descem a cova.
verses.RVR09: Porque el sepulcro no te celebrará, ni te alabará la muerte; ni los que descienden al hoyo esperarán tu verdad.

verses.KJV: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
verses.WEB: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
verses.ASV: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: The father to the children shall make known thy truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: O vivente, o vivente, esse é o que te louvará, tal como hoje eu faço; o pai ensinará aos filhos tua fidelidade.
verses.RVR09: El que vive, el que vive, éste te confesará, como yo hoy: el padre hará notoria tu verdad á los hijos.

verses.KJV: The Lord was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is [ready] to save me: Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments All the days of our life in the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR tem me salvado! Por isso tocaremos canções com instrumentos de cordas todos os dias de nossa vida na casa do SENHOR!
verses.RVR09: Jehová para salvarme; por tanto cantaremos nuestros salmos en la casa de Jehová todos los días de nuestra vida.

verses.KJV: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
verses.WEB: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”
verses.ASV: Now Isaiah had said, Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a plaster upon the boil, and he shall recover.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois Isaías havia dito: Tomem uma pasta de figos, e passem-na sobre a inflamação, que ele sarará.
verses.RVR09: Y había dicho Isaías: Tomen masa de higos, y pónganla en la llaga, y sanará.

verses.KJV: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord?
verses.WEB: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to the LORD’s house?”
verses.ASV: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ezequias também tinha dito: Qual será o sinal de que subirei à casa do SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: Había asimismo dicho Ezechîas: ¿Qué señal tendré de que he de subir á la casa de Jehová?

verses.KJV: At that time Merodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
verses.WEB: At that time, Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.
verses.ASV: At that time Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah; for he heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo, Merodaque-Baladã, filho de Baladã, rei da Babilônia, enviou [mensageiros com] cartas e um presente a Ezequias, porque tinha ouvido que ele havia ficado doente e já tinha se curado.
verses.RVR09: EN aquel tiempo Merodach-baladán, hijo de Baladán, rey de Babilonia, envió cartas y presentes á Ezechîas; porque había oído que había estado enfermo, y que había convalecido.

verses.KJV: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.WEB: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.
verses.ASV: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah showed them not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Ezequias se alegrou com eles, e lhes mostrou a casa de teu tesouro, a prata, o ouro, as especiarias, os melhores óleos, e toda a sua casa de armas, e tudo quanto se achou em seus tesouros; coisa nenhuma houve, nem em sua casa, nem em todo o seu domínio, que Ezequias não lhes mostrasse.
verses.RVR09: Y holgóse con ellos Ezechîas, y enseñóles la casa de su tesoro, plata y oro, y especierías, y ungüentos preciosos, y toda su casa de armas, y todo lo que se pudo hallar en sus tesoros: no hubo cosa en su casa y en todo su señorío, que Ezechîas no les mostrase.

verses.KJV: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
verses.WEB: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”
verses.ASV: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o profeta Isaías veio ao rei Ezequias, e lhe disse: O que aqueles homens disseram? E de onde eles vieram a ti?E Ezequias disse: Eles vieram a mim de uma terra distante, da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Entonces Isaías profeta vino al rey Ezechîas, y díjole: ¿Qué dicen estos hombres, y de dónde han venido á ti? Y Ezechîas respondió: De tierra muy lejos han venido á mí, de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.WEB: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”
verses.ASV: Then said he, What have they seen in thy house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not showed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele lhe disse: O que viram em tua casa?E Ezequias disse: Eles viram tudo quanto há em minha casa; coisa nenhuma há em meus tesouros que eu não tenha lhes mostrado.
verses.RVR09: Dijo entonces: ¿Qué han visto en tu casa? Y dijo Ezechîas: Todo lo que hay en mi casa han visto, y ninguna cosa hay en mis tesoros que no les haya mostrado.

verses.KJV: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:
verses.WEB: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of Armies:
verses.ASV: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of Jehovah of hosts:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Isaías disse a Ezequias: Ouve a palavra do SENHOR dos exércitos:
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo Isaías á Ezechîas: Oye palabra de Jehová de los ejércitos:

verses.KJV: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Behold, the days are coming, when all that is in thy house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vem dias em que tudo quanto houver em tua casa, e que teus pais acumularam até o dia de hoje, será levado à Babilônia; nada restará, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, vienen días en que será llevado á Babilonia todo lo que hay en tu casa, y lo que tus padres han atesorado hasta hoy: ninguna cosa quedará, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.WEB: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”
verses.ASV: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, whom thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [até] de teus filhos, que procederem de ti, e tu gerares, tomarão; e eles serão eunucos no palácio do rei da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: De tus hijos que hubieren salido de ti, y que engendraste, tomarán, y serán eunucos en el palacio del rey de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
verses.WEB: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The LORD’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”
verses.ASV: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of Jehovah which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Ezequias disse a Isaías: Boa é a palavra do SENHOR que falaste.Disse também: Pois haverá paz e segurança em meus dias.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Ezechîas á Isaías: La palabra de Jehová que has hablado, es buena. Y añadió: A lo menos, haya paz y verdad en mis días.

verses.KJV: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
verses.WEB: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
verses.ASV: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Consolai, consolai a meu povo, diz vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: CONSOLAOS, consolaos, pueblo mío, dice vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the Lord's hand double for all her sins.
verses.WEB: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”
verses.ASV: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem; and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she hath received of Jehovah’s hand double for all her sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Falai ao coração de Jerusalém, e proclamai a ela, que seu esforço de guerra está terminado, que sua perversidade está perdoada; porque já recebeu [punição] em dobro da mão do SENHOR por todo os seus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Hablad al corazón de Jerusalem: decidle á voces que su tiempo es ya cumplido, que su pecado es perdonado; que doble ha recibido de la mano de Jehová por todos sus pecados.

verses.KJV: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.WEB: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
verses.ASV: The voice of one that crieth, Prepare ye in the wilderness the way of Jehovah; make level in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do SENHOR; endireitai na terra estéril vereda ao nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Voz que clama en el desierto: Barred camino á Jehová: enderezad calzada en la soledad á nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
verses.WEB: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.
verses.ASV: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low; and the uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain:
verses.ALMEIDA: Todo vale será levantado, e todo monte e morro serão abaixados; e o torto se endireitará, e o [terreno] acidentado se tornará plano.
verses.RVR09: Todo valle sea alzado, y bájese todo monte y collado; y lo torcido se enderece, y lo áspero se allane.

verses.KJV: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”
verses.ASV: and the glory of Jehovah shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a glória do SENHOR se manifestará; e toda carne juntamente verá; pois [assim] falou a boca do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y manifestaráse la gloria de Jehová, y toda carne juntamente la verá; que la boca de Jehová habló.

verses.KJV: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
verses.WEB: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.
verses.ASV: The voice of one saying, Cry. And one said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma voz: Clama!E ele disse: O que clamarei? Que toda carne é erva, e toda a sua bondade como as flores do campo.
verses.RVR09: Voz que decía: Da voces. Y yo respondí: ¿Qué tengo de decir á voces? Toda carne es hierba, y toda su gloria como flor del campo:

verses.KJV: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the Lord bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
verses.WEB: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the LORD’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
verses.ASV: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth, because the breath of Jehovah bloweth upon it; surely the people is grass.
verses.ALMEIDA: A erva se seca, as flores caem, porque o Espírito do SENHOR nelas sopra; verdadeiramente o povo é erva.
verses.RVR09: La hierba se seca, y la flor se cae; porque el viento de Jehová sopló en ella: ciertamente hierba es el pueblo.

verses.KJV: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verses.WEB: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
verses.ASV: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; but the word of our God shall stand forever.
verses.ALMEIDA: A erva se seca, as flores caem; porém a palavra do nosso Deus continua firme para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Sécase la hierba, cáese la flor: mas la palabra del Dios nuestro permanece para siempre.

verses.KJV: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
verses.WEB: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”
verses.ASV: O thou that tellest good tidings to Zion, get thee up on a high mountain; O thou that tellest good tidings to Jerusalem, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold, your God!
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó Sião, que anuncias boas novas, sobe até um monte alto! Ó Jerusalém, que anuncias boas novas, levanta tua voz com força; levanta-a, não temas; dize as cidades de Judá: Eis [aqui] o vosso Deus!
verses.RVR09: Súbete sobre un monte alto, anunciadora de Sión; levanta fuertemente tu voz, anunciadora de Jerusalem; levántala, no temas; di á las ciudades de Judá: ¡Veis aquí el Dios vuestro!

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord God will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.WEB: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
verses.ASV: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him: Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o Senhor DEUS virá com poder; e seu braço governará por ele; eis que sua retribuição [virá] com ele, e seu pagamento diante de si.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que el Señor Jehová vendrá con fortaleza, y su brazo se enseñoreará: he aquí que su salario viene con él, y su obra delante de su rostro.

verses.KJV: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
verses.WEB: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
verses.ASV: He will feed his flock like a shepherd, he will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom, [and] will gently lead those that have their young.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como pastor ele apascentará seu rebanho; em seus braços recolherá aos cordeirinhos, e os levará em seu colo; ele guiará mansamente as que tiveram filhotes.
verses.RVR09: Como pastor apacentará su rebaño; en su brazo cogerá los corderos, y en su seno los llevará; pastoreará suavemente las paridas.

verses.KJV: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.WEB: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.ASV: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem mediu com seu punho as águas, e tomou a medida dos céus aos palmos? E [quem] recolheu numa caixa de medida o pó da terra, e pesou os montes com pesos, e os morros com balanças?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién midió las aguas con su puño, y aderezó los cielos con su palmo, y con tres dedos allegó el polvo de la tierra, y pesó los montes con balanza, y con peso los collados?

verses.KJV: Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
verses.WEB: Who has directed the LORD’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
verses.ASV: Who hath directed the Spirit of Jehovah, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem guiou o Espírito do SENHOR? E que conselheiro o ensinou?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién enseñó al espíritu de Jehová, ó le aconsejo enseñándole?

verses.KJV: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
verses.WEB: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?
verses.ASV: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed to him the way of understanding?
verses.ALMEIDA: Com quem ele tomou conselho? [Quem] lhe deu entendimento, e lhe ensinou o caminho do juízo, e lhe ensinou conhecimento, e lhe mostrou o caminho do entendimento?
verses.RVR09: ¿A quién demandó consejo para ser avisado? ¿Quién le enseñó el camino del juicio, ó le enseñó ciencia, ó le mostró la senda de la prudencia?

verses.KJV: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
verses.WEB: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.
verses.ASV: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are accounted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que as nações [lhe] são consideradas como uma gota de balde, e como o pó miúdo das balanças; eis que ele levanta as ilhas como poeira.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que las naciones son reputadas como la gota de un acetre, y como el orín del peso: he aquí que hace desaparecer las islas como polvo.

verses.KJV: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.WEB: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.ASV: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt-offering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem [todo] o Líbano seria suficiente para o fogo, nem seus animais bastam para um holocausto.
verses.RVR09: Ni el Líbano bastará para el fuego, ni todos sus animales para el sacrificio.

verses.KJV: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.WEB: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.ASV: All the nations are as nothing before him; they are accounted by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as nações são como nada perante ele; menos que nada e vazio ele as considera.
verses.RVR09: Como nada son todas las gentes delante de él; y en su comparación serán estimadas en menos que nada, y que lo que no es.

verses.KJV: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
verses.WEB: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
verses.ASV: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem, pois, comparareis a Deus? Ou que semelhança atribuireis a ele?
verses.RVR09: ¿A qué pues haréis semejante á Dios, ó qué imagen le compondréis?

verses.KJV: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
verses.WEB: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
verses.ASV: The image, a workman hath cast [it], and the goldsmith overlayeth it with gold, and casteth [for it] silver chains.
verses.ALMEIDA: O artífice funde a imagem, e o ourives a cobre de ouro, e cadeias de prata [lhe] funde.
verses.RVR09: El artífice apareja la imagen de talla, el platero le extiende el oro, y le funde cadenas de plata.

verses.KJV: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
verses.WEB: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.
verses.ASV: He that is too impoverished for [such] an oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a skilful workman to set up a graven image, that shall not be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: O empobrecido, que não tem o que oferecer, escolhe madeira que não se estraga, [e] busca um artífice habilidoso, para preparar uma imagem que não se mova.
verses.RVR09: El pobre escoge, para ofrecerle, madera que no se corrompa; búscase un maestro sabio, que le haga una imagen de talla que no se mueva.

verses.KJV: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.WEB: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.ASV: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não sabeis? Por acaso não ouvis? Ou desde o princípio não vos disseram? Por acaso não tendes entendido desde os fundamentos da terra?
verses.RVR09: ¿No sabéis? ¿no habéis oído? ¿nunca os lo han dicho desde el principio? ¿no habéis sido enseñados desde que la tierra se fundó?

verses.KJV: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
verses.WEB: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,
verses.ASV: [It is] he that sitteth above the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o que está sentado sobre o globo da terra, cujos moradores são [para ele] como gafanhotos; ele é o que estende os céus como uma cortina, e os estica como uma tenda, para [neles] habitar.
verses.RVR09: El está asentado sobre el globo de la tierra, cuyos moradores son como langostas: él extiende los cielos como una cortina, tiéndelos como una tienda para morar:

verses.KJV: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
verses.WEB: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.
verses.ASV: that bringeth princes to nothing; that maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele é o que torna os príncipes em nada, [e] faz juízes da terra serem como o vazio.
verses.RVR09: El torna en nada los poderosos, y á los que gobiernan la tierra hace como cosa vana.

verses.KJV: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
verses.WEB: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.
verses.ASV: Yea, they have not been planted; yea, they have not been sown; yea, their stock hath not taken root in the earth: moreover he bloweth upon them, and they wither, and the whirlwind taketh them away as stubble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mal foram plantados, mal foram semeados, mal seu caule forma raízes na terra; e [logo] ele sopra neles, e se secam, e um vento forte os leva como palha fina.
verses.RVR09: Como si nunca fueran plantados, como si nunca fueran sembrados, como si nunca su tronco hubiera tenido raíz en la tierra; así que sopla en ellos se secan, y el torbellino los lleva como hojarascas.

verses.KJV: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
verses.WEB: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
verses.ASV: To whom then will ye liken me, that I should be equal [to him]? saith the Holy One.
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem, pois, me comparareis, que eu lhe seja semelhante?,diz o Santo.
verses.RVR09: ¿A qué pues me haréis semejante, ó seré asimilado? dice el Santo.

verses.KJV: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
verses.WEB: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.
verses.ASV: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who hath created these, that bringeth out their host by number; he calleth them all by name; by the greatness of his might, and for that he is strong in power, not one is lacking.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai vossos olhos ao alto, e vede quem criou estas coisas, que faz sair numerado seu exército; e chama a todos eles pelos nomes, pela grandeza de [suas] forças, e por ser forte em poder, nenhuma [delas] faltará.
verses.RVR09: Levantad en alto vuestros ojos, y mirad quién crió estas cosas: él saca por cuenta su ejército: á todas llama por sus nombres; ninguna faltará: tal es la grandeza de su fuerza, y su poder y virtud.

verses.KJV: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the Lord, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
verses.WEB: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?
verses.ASV: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from Jehovah, and the justice [due] to me is passed away from my God?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que dizes, ó Jacó, e falas, ó Israel: Meu caminho está escondido do SENHOR, e meu juízo passa longe de meu Deus?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué dices, oh Jacob, y hablas tú, Israel: Mi camino es escondido de Jehová, y de mi Dios pasó mi juicio?

verses.KJV: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
verses.WEB: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
verses.ASV: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard? The everlasting God, Jehovah, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary; there is no searching of his understanding.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não sabes, nem ouviste, que o eterno Deus, o SENHOR, o criador dos confins da terra, não se cansa, nem se fatiga, e que seu entendimento é incompreensível?
verses.RVR09: ¿No has sabido, no has oído que el Dios del siglo es Jehová, el cual crió los términos de la tierra? No se trabaja, ni se fatiga con cansancio, y su entendimiento no hay quien lo alcance.

verses.KJV: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
verses.WEB: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
verses.ASV: He giveth power to the faint; and to him that hath no might he increaseth strength.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele dá força ao cansado, e multiplica as forças daquele que não tem vigor.
verses.RVR09: El da esfuerzo al cansado, y multiplica las fuerzas al que no tiene ningunas.

verses.KJV: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
verses.WEB: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
verses.ASV: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
verses.ALMEIDA: Até os jovens se cansam e se fatigam; e os rapazes caem;
verses.RVR09: Los mancebos se fatigan y se cansan, los mozos flaquean y caen:

verses.KJV: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.WEB: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
verses.ASV: but they that wait for Jehovah shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os que confiam no SENHOR renovarão as forças, subirão com asas como águias; correrão, e não se cansarão; caminharão, e não se fatigarão.
verses.RVR09: Mas los que esperan á Jehová tendrán nuevas fuerzas; levantarán las alas como águilas; correrán, y no se cansarán; caminarán, y no se fatigarán.

verses.KJV: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
verses.WEB: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.
verses.ASV: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the peoples renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak; let us come near together to judgment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Calai-vos perante mim, ó litorais; e os povos renovem as forças; aproximem-se, [e] então falem; juntamente nos aproximemos ao juízo.
verses.RVR09: ESCUCHADME, islas, y esfuércense los pueblos; alléguense, y entonces hablen: estemos juntamente á juicio.

verses.KJV: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
verses.WEB: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.
verses.ASV: Who hath raised up one from the east, whom he calleth in righteousness to his foot? he giveth nations before him, and maketh him rule over kings; he giveth them as the dust to his sword, as the driven stubble to his bow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem o chamou desde o oriente, [e com] justiça o chamou ao seu pé? Ele [lhe] deu as nações perante sua face, e o fez dominar sobre reis, [e] os entregou à sua espada como o pó, como a palha fina levada por seu arco.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién despertó del oriente al justo, lo llamó para que le siguiese, entregó delante de él naciones, é hízolo enseñorear de reyes; entrególos á su espada como polvo, y á su arco como hojarascas arrebatadas?

verses.KJV: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
verses.WEB: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.
verses.ASV: He pursueth them, and passeth on safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele os persegue, [e] passa em segurança; por um caminho [onde] com seus pés nunca tinha ido.
verses.RVR09: Siguiólos, pasó en paz por camino por donde sus pies nunca habían entrado.

verses.KJV: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord, the first, and with the last; I am he.
verses.WEB: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD, the first, and with the last, I am he.”
verses.ASV: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Jehovah, the first, and with the last, I am he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem operou e fez [isto] ,chamando as gerações desde o princípio? Eu, o SENHOR, do princípio aos últimos, eu mesmo.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién obró é hizo esto? ¿Quién llama las generaciones desde el principio? Yo Jehová, el primero, y yo mismo con los postreros.

verses.KJV: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
verses.WEB: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.
verses.ASV: The isles have seen, and fear; the ends of the earth tremble; they draw near, and come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os litorais viram, e tremeram; os confins da terra tremeram; eles se aproximaram, e chegaram.
verses.RVR09: Las islas vieron, y tuvieron temor; los términos de la tierra se espantaron: congregáronse, y vinieron.

verses.KJV: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.WEB: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”
verses.ASV: They help every one his neighbor; and [every one] saith to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cada um ajudou ao outro, e a seu companheiro disse: Sê forte.
verses.RVR09: Cada cual ayudó á su cercano; y á su hermano dijo: Esfuérzate.

verses.KJV: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
verses.WEB: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good;” and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.
verses.ASV: So the carpenter encourageth the goldsmith, [and] he that smootheth with the hammer him that smiteth the anvil, saying of the soldering, It is good; and he fasteneth it with nails, that it should not be moved.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o artífice encorajou ao ourives, o que alisa com o martelo ao que bate na bigorna, dizendo da soldagem: Boa é. Então com pregos o firmou, para que não se mova.
verses.RVR09: El carpintero animó al platero, y el que alisa con martillo al que batía en el yunque, diciendo, Buena está la soldadura; y afirmólo con clavos, porque no se moviese.

verses.KJV: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
verses.WEB: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,
verses.ASV: But thou, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, ó Israel, servo meu; tu, Jacó, a quem escolhi, semente de Abraão, meu amigo;
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Israel, siervo mío eres; tú, Jacob, á quien yo escogí, simiente de Abraham mi amigo.

verses.KJV: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
verses.WEB: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’
verses.ASV: thou whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from the corners thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant, I have chosen thee and not cast thee away;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, a quem tomei desde os confins da terra, e te chamei desde seus mais extremos, e te disse: Tu és meu servo; a ti escolhi, e não te rejeitei.
verses.RVR09: Porque te tomé de los extremos de la tierra, y de sus principales te llamé, y te dije: Mi siervo eres tú; te escogí, y no te deseché.

verses.KJV: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.WEB: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.ASV: fear thou not, for I am with thee; be not dismayed, for I am thy God; I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas, porque eu estou contigo; não te assombres, porque eu sou teu Deus. Eu te fortaleço, te ajudo, e te sustento com a minha mão direita de justiça.
verses.RVR09: No temas, que yo soy contigo; no desmayes, que yo soy tu Dios que te esfuerzo: siempre te ayudaré, siempre te sustentaré con la diestra de mi justicia.

verses.KJV: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
verses.WEB: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.
verses.ASV: Behold, all they that are incensed against thee shall be put to shame and confounded: they that strive with thee shall be as nothing, and shall perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que serão envergonhados e humilhados todos os que se indignaram contra ti; eles se tornarão como o nada; e os que brigarem contigo perecerão.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que todos los que se airan contra ti, serán avergonzados y confundidos: serán como nada y perecerán, los que contienden contigo.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
verses.WEB: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contend with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ainda que] os procures, tu não os acharás; os que lutarem contra ti se tornarão como o nada; e os que guerrearem contra ti, como coisa nenhuma.
verses.RVR09: Los buscarás, y no los hallarás, los que tienen contienda contigo; serán como nada, y como cosa que no es, aquellos que te hacen guerra.

verses.KJV: For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verses.WEB: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
verses.ASV: For I, Jehovah thy God, will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu, o SENHOR teu Deus, te seguro pela tua mão direita, [e] te digo: Não temas; eu te ajudo.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo Jehová soy tu Dios, que te ase de tu mano derecha, y te dice: No temas, yo te ayudé.

verses.KJV: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith Jehovah, and thy Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas, ó verme de Jacó, povinho de Israel; eu te ajudo,diz o SENHOR e teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: No temas, gusano de Jacob, oh vosotros los pocos de Israel; yo te socorrí, dice Jehová, y tu Redentor el Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have made thee [to be] a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth; thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu te pus como debulhador afiado, novo, que tem dentes pontiagudos. Aos montes debulharás, e moerás; e aos morros tornarás como a palhas.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que yo te he puesto por trillo, trillo nuevo, lleno de dientes: trillarás montes y los molerás, y collados tornarás en tamo.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in the LORD. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them; and thou shalt rejoice in Jehovah, thou shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu os padejarás, e o vento os levará; e o redemoinho os espalhará; porém tu te alegrarás no SENHOR, [e] te orgulharás no Santo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Los aventarás, y los llevará el viento, y esparcirálos el torbellino. Tú empero te regocijarás en Jehová, te gloriarás en el Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the Lord will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
verses.WEB: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.ASV: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst; I, Jehovah, will answer them, I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os pobres e necessitados buscam águas, mas nada [acham] ; sua língua se seca de sede. Eu, o SENHOR, os ouvirei; eu, o Deus de Israel, não os desampararei.
verses.RVR09: Los afligidos y menesterosos buscan las aguas, que no hay; secóse de sed su lengua; yo Jehová los oiré, yo el Dios de Israel no los desampararé.

verses.KJV: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.WEB: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.ASV: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and fountains in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abrirei rios em lugares altos, e fontes no meio dos vales; tornarei o deserto em tanques de águas, e a terra seca em mananciais de águas.
verses.RVR09: En los altos abriré ríos, y fuentes en mitad de los llanos: tornaré el desierto en estanques de aguas, y en manaderos de aguas la tierra seca.

verses.KJV: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
verses.WEB: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;
verses.ASV: I will put in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, and the myrtle, and the oil-tree; I will set in the desert the fir-tree, the pine, and the box-tree together:
verses.ALMEIDA: Plantarei no deserto o cedro, a acácia, a murta, e a oliveira; juntamente porei na terra vazia a faia, o olmeiro e o cipreste;
verses.RVR09: Daré en el desierto cedros, espinos, arrayanes, y olivas; pondré en la soledad hayas, olmos, y álamos juntamente;

verses.KJV: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
verses.WEB: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the LORD’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.ASV: that they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of Jehovah hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que vejam, saibam, reflitam, e juntamente entendam que a mão do SENHOR fez isto; e o Santo de Israel isto criou.
verses.RVR09: Porque vean y conozcan, y adviertan y entiendan todos, que la mano de Jehová hace esto, y que el Santo de Israel lo crió.

verses.KJV: Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
verses.WEB: Produce your cause,” says the LORD. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.
verses.ASV: Produce your cause, saith Jehovah; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apresentai vossa demanda!,diz o SENHOR. Trazei vossos argumentos!, diz o Rei de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Alegad por vuestra causa, dice Jehová: exhibid vuestros fundamentos, dice el Rey de Jacob.

verses.KJV: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
verses.WEB: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.
verses.ASV: Let them bring forth, and declare unto us what shall happen: declare ye the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.
