verses.ALMEIDA: Tragam e anunciem-nos as coisas que irão acontecer; anunciai quais foram as coisas passadas, para que possamos dar atenção a elas, e saibamos o fim delas; ou dizei-nos as coisas futuras.
verses.RVR09: Traigan, y anúnciennos lo que ha de venir: dígannos lo que ha pasado desde el principio, y pondremos nuestro corazón en ello: sepamos también su postrimería, y hacednos entender lo que ha de venir.

verses.KJV: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
verses.WEB: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.
verses.ASV: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Anunciai as coisas que ainda virão, para que saibamos que vós sois deuses; ou fazei o bem ou o mal, para que nos assombremos, e juntamente vejamos.
verses.RVR09: Dadnos nuevas de lo que ha de ser después, para que sepamos que vosotros sois dioses; ó á lo menos haced bien, ó mal, para que tengamos qué contar, y juntamente nos maravillemos.

verses.KJV: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
verses.WEB: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.
verses.ASV: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work is of nought; an abomination is he that chooseth you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vós sois nada, e vossa obra não tem valor algum; abominação é quem vos escolhe.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que vosotros sois de nada, y vuestras obras de vanidad; abominación el que os escogió.

verses.KJV: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
verses.WEB: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.
verses.ASV: I have raised up one from the north, and he is come; from the rising of the sun one that calleth upon my name: and he shall come upon rulers as upon mortar, and as the potter treadeth clay.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu suscitei [a um] do norte, que virá oriente, [e] invocará meu nome; e virá sobre os príncipes como [se fossem] lama, e como o oleiro pisa o barro.
verses.RVR09: Del norte desperté uno, y vendrá; del nacimiento del sol llamará en mi nombre: y hollará príncipes como lodo, y como pisa el barro el alfarero.

verses.KJV: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
verses.WEB: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and before, that we may say, ‘He is right’? Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.
verses.ASV: Who hath declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, [He is] right? yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that showeth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem anunciou [coisa alguma] desde o princípio, para que o possamos saber, ou desde antes, para que digamos “correto é”? Porém não há quem anuncie [tal coisa] nem quem diga [coisa alguma] , nem quem ouça vossas palavras.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién lo anunció desde el principio, para que sepamos; ó de tiempo atrás, y diremos: Es justo? Cierto, no hay quien anuncie, sí, no hay quien enseñe, ciertamente no hay quien oiga vuestras palabras.

verses.KJV: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
verses.WEB: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: [I am the] first [that saith] unto Zion, Behold, behold them; and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Eu sou] o primeiro [que digo] a Sião: Eis que ali estão! E a Jerusalém darei um anunciador de boas novas.
verses.RVR09: Yo soy el primero que he enseñado estas cosas á Sión, y á Jerusalem daré un portador de alegres nuevas.

verses.KJV: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
verses.WEB: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word.
verses.ASV: And when I look, there is no man: even among them there is no counsellor, that, when I ask of them, can answer a word.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhei, porém ninguém havia. Até entre estes nenhum conselheiro havia a quem eu perguntasse, e ele me respondesse algo.
verses.RVR09: Miré, y no había ninguno; y pregunté de estas cosas, y ningún consejero hubo: preguntéles, y no respondieron palabra.

verses.KJV: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.WEB: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.ASV: Behold, all of them, their works are vanity [and] nought; their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que todos são falsidade, suas obras são nada. Suas obras de fundição são vento e sem valor algum.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, todos iniquidad, y las obras de ellos nada: viento y vanidad son sus vaciadizos.

verses.KJV: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.
verses.ASV: Behold, my servant, whom I uphold; my chosen, in whom my soul delighteth: I have put my Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the Gentiles.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis aqui meu servo, a quem sustento; meu escolhido, [em quem] minha alma se agrada. Sobre ele eu pus o meu Espírito; ele trará justiça às nações.
verses.RVR09: HE aquí mi siervo, yo le sostendré; mi escogido, en quien mi alma toma contentamiento: he puesto sobre él mi espíritu, dará juicio á las gentes.

verses.KJV: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.WEB: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.
verses.ASV: He will not cry, nor lift up his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não gritará, nem levantará [seu clamor] ; ele não fará ouvir sua voz nas ruas.
verses.RVR09: No clamará, ni alzará, ni hará oir su voz en las plazas.

verses.KJV: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
verses.WEB: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
verses.ASV: A bruised reed will he not break, and a dimly burning wick will he not quench: he will bring forth justice in truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: A cana rachada ele não quebrará, nem apagará o pavio que fumega; com a verdade ele trará justiça.
verses.RVR09: No quebrará la caña cascada, ni apagará el pábilo que humeare: sacará el juicio á verdad.

verses.KJV: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
verses.WEB: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice in the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”
verses.ASV: He will not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set justice in the earth; and the isles shall wait for his law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele não fraquejará, nem será esmagado, até que ponha a justiça na terra; e os litorais esperarão a sua doutrina.
verses.RVR09: No se cansará, ni desmayará, hasta que ponga en la tierra juicio; y las islas esperarán su ley.

verses.KJV: Thus saith God the Lord, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.WEB: God the LORD, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:
verses.ASV: Thus saith God Jehovah, he that created the heavens, and stretched them forth; he that spread abroad the earth and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz Deus, o SENHOR, que criou os céus, e os esticou; estendeu a terra, e a tudo quanto ela produz; que dá respiração ao povo que nela [habita] ,e espírito aos que nela andam.
verses.RVR09: Así dice el Dios Jehová, el Criador de los cielos, y el que los extiende; el que extiende la tierra y sus verduras; el que da respiración al pueblo que mora sobre ella, y espíritu á los que por ella andan:

verses.KJV: I the Lord have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
verses.WEB: “I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,
verses.ASV: I, Jehovah, have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thy hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, o SENHOR, te chamei em justiça, e te tomarei pela mão. E eu te guardarei, e te darei como pacto para o povo e luz para as nações;
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová te he llamado en justicia, y te tendré por la mano; te guardaré y te pondré por alianza del pueblo, por luz de las gentes;

verses.KJV: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
verses.WEB: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.
verses.ASV: to open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the dungeon, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison-house.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para abrir os olhos cegos, para tirar da prisão os presos, [tirar] do cárcere os que habitam em trevas.
verses.RVR09: Para que abras ojos de ciegos, para que saques de la cárcel á los presos, y de casas de prisión á los que están de asiento en tinieblas.

verses.KJV: I am the Lord: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
verses.WEB: “I am the LORD. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah, that is my name; and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise unto graven images.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, EU-SOU; este é o meu nome! Não darei a minha glória a outro, nem o meu louvor às imagens de escultura.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová: este es mi nombre; y á otro no daré mi gloria, ni mi alabanza á esculturas.

verses.KJV: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.WEB: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”
verses.ASV: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare; before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que as coisas anteriores já aconteceram; e as novas eu [vos] anuncio; e antes que surjam, [delas] eu vos informo.
verses.RVR09: Las cosas primeras he aquí vinieron, y yo anuncio nuevas cosas: antes que salgan á luz, yo os las haré notorias.

verses.KJV: Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.WEB: Sing to the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
verses.ASV: Sing unto Jehovah a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth; ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR um cântico novo, um louvor a ele desde o limite da terra; vós que navegais pelo mar, e tudo quanto nele há; vós terras do litoral e seus moradores.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Jehová un nuevo cántico, su alabanza desde el fin de la tierra; los que descendéis á la mar, y lo que la hinche, las islas y los moradores de ellas.

verses.KJV: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.WEB: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!
verses.ASV: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up [their voice], the villages that Kedar doth inhabit; let the inhabitants of Sela sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantem [a voz] o deserto e suas cidades, com as aldeias que Quedar habita; cantem os que habitam nas rochas, [e] gritem de alegria do cume dos montes.
verses.RVR09: Alcen la voz el desierto y sus ciudades, las aldeas donde habita Cedar: canten los moradores de la Piedra, y desde la cumbre de los montes den voces de júbilo.

verses.KJV: Let them give glory unto the Lord, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.WEB: Let them give glory to the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.ASV: Let them give glory unto Jehovah, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deem glória ao SENHOR, e anunciem louvor a ele nas terras do litoral.
verses.RVR09: Den gloria á Jehová, y prediquen sus loores en las islas.

verses.KJV: The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
verses.WEB: The LORD will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.
verses.ASV: Jehovah will go forth as a mighty man; he will stir up [his] zeal like a man of war: he will cry, yea, he will shout aloud; he will do mightily against his enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR sairá como guerreiro, como homem de guerra despertará o [seu] zelo; ele gritará, e fará grade ruído; e dominará a seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Jehová saldrá como gigante, y como hombre de guerra despertará celo: gritará, voceará, esforzaráse sobre sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
verses.WEB: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.
verses.ASV: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: [now] will I cry out like a travailing woman; I will gasp and pant together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por muito tempo fiquei calado, quieto estive, [e] me retive; [mas agora] darei gritos como a que está de parto, suspirando e juntamente ofegando.
verses.RVR09: Desde el siglo he callado, tenido he silencio, y heme detenido: daré voces como la que está de parto; asolaré y devoraré juntamente.

verses.KJV: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
verses.WEB: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
verses.ASV: I will lay waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos montes e morros tornarei em deserto, e toda sua erva farei secar; e tornarei aos rios em ilhas, e as lagoas secarei.
verses.RVR09: Tornaré en soledad montes y collados, haré secar toda su hierba; los ríos tornaré en islas, y secaré los estanques.

verses.KJV: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
verses.WEB: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.
verses.ASV: And I will bring the blind by a way that they know not; in paths that they know not will I lead them; I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. These things will I do, and I will not forsake them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E guiarei aos cegos por um caminho que nunca conheceram; eu os farei caminhar pelas veredas que não conheciam; tornarei as trevas em luz perante eles, e as coisas tortas [farei] direitas; estas coisas lhes farei, e nunca os desampararei.
verses.RVR09: Y guiaré los ciegos por camino que no sabían, haréles pisar por las sendas que no habían conocido; delante de ellos tornaré las tinieblas en luz, y los rodeos en llanura. Estas cosas les haré, y no los desampararé.

verses.KJV: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
verses.WEB: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.
verses.ASV: They shall be turned back, they shall be utterly put to shame, that trust in graven images, that say unto molten images, Ye are our gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] serão conduzidos para trás e se envergonharão os que confiam em imagens de escultura, [e] dizem às imagens de fundição: Vós sois nossos deuses.
verses.RVR09: Serán vueltos atrás, y en extremo confundidos, los que confían en las esculturas, y dicen á las estatuas de fundición: Vosotros sois nuestros dioses.

verses.KJV: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
verses.WEB: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.
verses.ASV: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
verses.ALMEIDA: Surdos, ouvi; e vós cegos, olhai para que possais ver.
verses.RVR09: Sordos, oid; y vosotros ciegos, mirad para ver.

verses.KJV: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the Lord's servant?
verses.WEB: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as the LORD’s servant?
verses.ASV: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I send? who is blind as he that is at peace [with me], and blind as Jehovah’s servant?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é cego, senão o meu servo? Ou surdo, como o meu mensageiro, a quem envio? Quem é cego como o aliançado, e cego como o servo do SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién ciego, sino mi siervo? ¿quién sordo, como mi mensajero que envié? ¿quién ciego como el perfecto, y ciego como el siervo de Jehová,

verses.KJV: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
verses.WEB: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.
verses.ASV: Thou seest many things, but thou observest not; his ears are open, but he heareth not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu vês muitas coisas, porém não as guardas; mesmo abrindo os ouvidos, contudo nada ouve.
verses.RVR09: Que ve muchas cosas y no advierte, que abre los oídos y no oye?

verses.KJV: The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
verses.WEB: It pleased the LORD, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.
verses.ASV: It pleased Jehovah, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law, and make it honorable.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR se agradou, por causa de sua justiça, em engrandecer [sua] lei, e em fazê [-la] gloriosa.
verses.RVR09: Jehová se complació por amor de su justicia en magnificar la ley y engrandecerla.

verses.KJV: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
verses.WEB: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’
verses.ASV: But this is a people robbed and plundered; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison-houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas [este] é um povo roubado e saqueado; todos estão enlaçados em covas, e escondidos em cárceres; são postos como despojos, e ninguém há que os resgate; estão como [objetos] de roubo, e ninguém diz “Restitui [-os] ”.
verses.RVR09: Mas este es pueblo saqueado y hollado, todos ellos enlazados en cavernas y escondidos en cárceles: son puestos á saco, y no hay quien libre; hollados, y no hay quien diga, Restituid.

verses.KJV: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.WEB: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
verses.ASV: Who is there among you that will give ear to this? that will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem dentre vós dá ouvidos a isto? [Quem] presta atenção e ouve o que há de ser no futuro?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién de vosotros oirá esto? ¿quién atenderá y escuchará en orden al porvernir?

verses.KJV: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the Lord, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.WEB: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.
verses.ASV: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not Jehovah? he against whom we have sinned, and in whose ways they would not walk, neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem entregou a Jacó como roubo, e a Israel a ladrões? Por acaso não foi o SENHOR, aquele contra quem pecamos? Pois não queriam andar em seus caminhos, e não deram ouvidos à sua lei.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién dió á Jacob en presa, y entregó á Israel á saqueadores? ¿No fué Jehová, contra quien pecamos? y no quisieron andar en sus caminos, ni oyeron su ley.

verses.KJV: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
verses.WEB: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know. It burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”
verses.ASV: Therefore he poured upon him the fierceness of his anger, and the strength of battle; and it set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso ele derramou sobre eles o furor de sua ira, e a força da guerra; e os pôs em labaredas ao redor; porém [ainda assim] não entenderam; e ele os pôs para queimar, porém [ainda assim] não puseram [nisso] o coração.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto derramó sobre él el furor de su ira, y fuerza de guerra; púsole fuego de todas partes, empero no entendió; y encendióle, mas no ha parado mientes.

verses.KJV: But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
verses.WEB: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
verses.ASV: But now thus saith Jehovah that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed thee; I have called thee by thy name, thou art mine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém agora assim diz o SENHOR, o teu Criador, ó Jacó, e o teu Formador, ó Israel: Não temas, porque eu te resgatei; chamei a ti por teu nome; tu és meu.
verses.RVR09: Y AHORA, así dice Jehová Criador tuyo, oh Jacob, y Formador tuyo, oh Israel: No temas, porque yo te redimí; te puse nombre, mío eres tú.

verses.KJV: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.WEB: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
verses.ASV: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando passares pelas águas, estarei contigo; e [ao passares] pelos rios, eles não te submergirão; quando passares pelo fogo, não te queimarás, nem a chamas arderão em ti.
verses.RVR09: Cuando pasares por las aguas, yo seré contigo; y por los ríos, no te anegarán. Cuando pasares por el fuego, no te quemarás, ni la llama arderá en ti.

verses.KJV: For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
verses.WEB: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
verses.ASV: For I am Jehovah thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour; I have given Egypt as thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in thy stead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, o Santo de Israel, teu Salvador; dei ao Egito, a Cuxe, e a Seba como teu resgate, em teu lugar.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo Jehová Dios tuyo, el Santo de Israel, soy tu Salvador: á Egipto he dado por tu rescate, á Etiopía y á Seba por ti.

verses.KJV: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
verses.WEB: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
verses.ASV: Since thou hast been precious in my sight, [and] honorable, and I have loved thee; therefore will I give men in thy stead, and peoples instead of thy life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que foste precioso em meus olhos, [assim] foste glorificado, e eu te amei; por isso dei homens em troca de ti, e povos em troca de tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Porque en mis ojos fuiste de grande estima, fuiste honorable, y yo te amé: daré pues hombres por ti, y naciones por tu alma.

verses.KJV: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.
verses.ASV: Fear not; for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas, pois estou contigo; eu trarei tua semente desde o oriente, e te ajuntarei desde o ocidente.
verses.RVR09: No temas, porque yo soy contigo; del oriente traeré tu generación, y del occidente te recogeré.

verses.KJV: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
verses.WEB: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
verses.ASV: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back; bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the end of the earth;
verses.ALMEIDA: Direi ao norte: Dá!, E ao sul: Não retenhas! Trazei meus filhos de longe, e minhas filhas desde os confins da terra;
verses.RVR09: Diré al aquilón: Da acá; y al mediodía: No detengas: trae de lejos mis hijos, y mis hijas de los términos de la tierra,

verses.KJV: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
verses.WEB: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”
verses.ASV: every one that is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yea, whom I have made.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os chamados do meu nome, e os que criei para minha gloria; eu os formei; sim, eu os fiz.
verses.RVR09: Todos los llamados de mi nombre; para gloria mía los críe, los formé y los hice.

verses.KJV: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.WEB: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.
verses.ASV: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trazei ao povo cego, que tem olhos; e aos surdos, que tem ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Sacad al pueblo ciego que tiene ojos, y á los sordos que tienen oídos.

verses.KJV: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
verses.WEB: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified, or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”
verses.ASV: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled: who among them can declare this, and show us former things? let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as nações se reúnam, e os povos se ajuntem. Quem deles isto isto anuncia, e nos faz ouvir as coisas do passado? Mostrem suas testemunhas, para que se justifiquem, e se ouça, e se diga: É verdade.
verses.RVR09: Congréguense á una todas las gentes, y júntense todos los pueblos: ¿quién de ellos hay que nos dé nuevas de esto, y que nos haga oir las cosas primeras? Presenten sus testigos, y justifíquense; oigan, y digan: Verdad.

verses.KJV: Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
verses.WEB: “You are my witnesses,” says the LORD, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.
verses.ASV: Ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, and my servant whom I have chosen; that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós sois minhas testemunhas (diz o SENHOR); e meu servo, a quem escolhi; para que saibais, e creiais em mim, e entendais que eu sou o próprio, e [que] antes de mim nenhum Deus se formou, e depois de minha nenhum haverá.
verses.RVR09: Vosotros sois mis testigos, dice Jehová, y mi siervo que yo escogí; para que me conozcáis y creáis, y entendáis que yo mismo soy; antes de mí no fué formado Dios, ni lo será después de mí.

verses.KJV: I, even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no saviour.
verses.WEB: I myself am the LORD. Besides me, there is no savior.
verses.ASV: I, even I, am Jehovah; and besides me there is no saviour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, eu sou o SENHOR; e fora de mim não há salvador.
verses.RVR09: Yo, yo Jehová; y fuera de mí no hay quien salve.

verses.KJV: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, that I am God.
verses.WEB: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown, and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says the LORD, “and I am God.
verses.ASV: I have declared, and I have saved, and I have showed; and there was no strange [god] among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, and I am God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu anunciei, eu salvei, e eu fiz ouvir, e deus estrangeiro não houve entre vós, e vós sois minhas testemunhas, (diz o SENHOR), que eu sou Deus.
verses.RVR09: Yo anuncié, y salvé, é hice oir, y no hubo entre vosotros extraño. Vosotros pues sois mis testigos, dice Jehová, que yo soy Dios.

verses.KJV: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
verses.WEB: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
verses.ASV: Yea, since the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who can hinder it?
verses.ALMEIDA: E desde antes de haver dia, eu o sou; e ninguém há que possa livrar das minhas mãos. Eu estou agindo, quem pode impedir?
verses.RVR09: Aun antes que hubiera día, yo era; y no hay quien de mi mano libre: si yo hiciere, ¿quién lo estorbará?

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
verses.WEB: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring down all of them as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR o teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Por causa de vós eu enviei [inimigos] a Babilônia, e a todos eu os fiz descerem [como] fugitivos, inclusive os Caldeus, nos navios em que se orgulhavam.
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová, Redentor vuestro, el Santo de Israel: Por vosotros envié á Babilonia, é hice descender fugitivos todos ellos, y clamor de Caldeos en las naves.

verses.KJV: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
verses.WEB: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR, vosso Santo; o Criador de Israel, o vosso Rei.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová, Santo vuestro, Criador de Israel, vuestro Rey.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
verses.WEB: The LORD, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, who maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR, aquele que preparou no mar um caminho, e nas águas impetuosas uma vereda;
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová, el que da camino en la mar, y senda en las aguas impetuosas;

verses.KJV: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
verses.WEB: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:
verses.ASV: who bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched as a wick):
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que trouxe carruagens e cavalos, exército e forças; [todos] juntamente caíram, e não mais se levantaram; estão extintos, foram apagados como um pavio:
verses.RVR09: El que saca carro y caballo, ejército y fuerza; caen juntamente para no levantarse; quedan extinguidos, como pábilo quedan apagados.

verses.KJV: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
verses.WEB: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
verses.ASV: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos lembreis das coisas passadas, nem considereis as antigas;
verses.RVR09: No os acordéis de las cosas pasadas, ni traigáis á memoria las cosas antiguas.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will do a new thing; now shall it spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que farei uma coisa nova, agora surgirá; por acaso não a reconhecereis? Pois porei um caminho no deserto, [e] rios na terra vazia.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que yo hago cosa nueva: presto saldrá á luz: ¿no la sabréis? Otra vez pondré camino en el desierto, y ríos en la soledad.

verses.KJV: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
verses.WEB: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
verses.ASV: The beasts of the field shall honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
verses.ALMEIDA: Os animais do campo me honrarão; os chacais e os filhotes de avestruz; porque porei águas no deserto, rios na terra vazia, para dar de beber a meu povo, meu escolhido.
verses.RVR09: La bestia del campo me honrará, los chacales, y los pollos del avestruz: porque daré aguas en el desierto, ríos en la soledad, para que beba mi pueblo, mi escogido.

verses.KJV: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
verses.WEB: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
verses.ASV: the people which I formed for myself, that they might set forth my praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Este povo formei para mim, eles declararão louvor a mim.
verses.RVR09: Este pueblo crié para mí; mis alabanzas publicará.

verses.KJV: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
verses.WEB: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.
verses.ASV: Yet thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu não me invocaste, ó Jacó; pois te cansaste de mim, ó Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y no me invocaste á mí, oh Jacob; antes, de mí te cansaste, oh Israel.

verses.KJV: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
verses.WEB: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
verses.ASV: Thou hast not brought me of thy sheep for burnt-offerings; neither hast thou honored me with thy sacrifices. I have not burdened thee with offerings, nor wearied thee with frankincense.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me trouxeste o gado miúdo de teus holocaustos, nem me honraste [com] teus sacrifícios; eu não vos oprimi com ofertas, nem te cansei com incenso.
verses.RVR09: No me trajiste á mí los animales de tus holocaustos, ni á mí me honraste con tus sacrificios: no te hice servir con presente, ni te hice fatigar con perfume.

verses.KJV: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
verses.WEB: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
verses.ASV: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices; but thou hast burdened me with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não me compraste com dinheiro cana aromática, nem me saciaste com a gordura de teus sacrifícios; mas me oprimiste com teus pecados, [e] me cansaste com tuas maldades.
verses.RVR09: No compraste para mí caña aromática por dinero, ni me saciaste con la grosura de tus sacrificios; antes me hiciste servir en tus pecados, me has fatigado con tus maldades.

verses.KJV: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
verses.WEB: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
verses.ASV: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake; and I will not remember thy sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, eu sou o que anulo tuas transgressões por causa de mim; e te teus pecados eu não me lembro.
verses.RVR09: Yo, yo soy el que borro tus rebeliones por amor de mí; y no me acordaré de tus pecados.

verses.KJV: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
verses.WEB: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
verses.ASV: Put me in remembrance; let us plead together: set thou forth [thy cause], that thou mayest be justified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Faze-me lembrar, entremos em juízo juntos; mostra [teus argumentos] ,para que possas te justificar.
verses.RVR09: Hazme acordar, entremos en juicio juntamente; relata tú para abonarte.

verses.KJV: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.WEB: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.ASV: Thy first father sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teu primeiro pai pecou; e teus intérpretes transgrediram contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Tu primer padre pecó, y tus enseñadores prevaricaron contra mí.

verses.KJV: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
verses.ASV: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel a reviling.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso profanei os líderes do santuário, e entreguei Jacó à desgraça, e Israel à humilhação.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, yo profané los príncipes del santuario, y puse por anatema á Jacob, y por oprobio á Israel.

verses.KJV: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
verses.WEB: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.
verses.ASV: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant, and Israel, who I have chosen:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, ouve, ó Jacó, meu servo; tu, ó Israel, a quem escolhi.
verses.RVR09: AHORA pues oye, Jacob, siervo mío, y tú, Israel, á quien yo escogí.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.WEB: This is what the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, who will help thee: Fear not, O Jacob my servant; and thou, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR, aquele que te fez, e te formou desde o ventre, que te socorre: não temas, ó Jacó, meu servo; tu Jesurum, a quem escolhi.
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová, Hacedor tuyo, y el que te formó desde el vientre, el cual te ayudará: No temas, siervo mío Jacob, y tú, Jeshurun, á quien yo escogí.

verses.KJV: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
verses.WEB: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;
verses.ASV: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and streams upon the dry ground; I will pour my Spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque derramarei água sobre o sedento, e rios sobre a terra seca; derramarei meu Espírito sobre tua semente, e minha bênção sobre teus descendentes;
verses.RVR09: Porque yo derramaré aguas sobre el secadal, y ríos sobre la tierra árida: mi espíritu derramaré sobre tu generación, y mi bendición sobre tus renuevos:

verses.KJV: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
verses.WEB: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.
verses.ASV: and they shall spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.
verses.ALMEIDA: E brotarão entre a erva, como salgueiros junto a ribeiros de águas.
verses.RVR09: Y brotarán entre hierba, como sauces junto á las riberas de las aguas.

verses.KJV: One shall say, I am the Lord's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
verses.WEB: One will say, ‘I am the LORD’s.’ Another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to the LORD,’ and honor the name of Israel.”
verses.ASV: One shall say, I am Jehovah’s; and another shall call [himself] by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto Jehovah, and surname [himself] by the name of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um dirá: Eu sou do SENHOR; e outro se chamará pelo nome de Jacó; e um [terceiro] escreverá [em] sua mão: Eu sou do SENHOR, e tomará para si o nome de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Este dirá: Yo soy de Jehová; el otro se llamará del nombre de Jacob; y otro escribirá con su mano, A Jehová, y se apellidará con el nombre de Israel.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord the King of Israel, and his redeemer the Lord of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
verses.WEB: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, the LORD of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts: I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR, Rei de Israel, e seu Redentor, o SENHOR dos exércitos:Eu sou o primeiro, e sou o último; e além de mim não há Deus.
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová, Rey de Israel, y su Redentor, Jehová de los ejércitos: Yo el primero, y yo el postrero, y fuera de mí no hay Dios.

verses.KJV: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
verses.WEB: Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? Let them declare the things that are coming, and that will happen.
verses.ASV: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and that shall come to pass, let them declare.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem, como eu, anunciará isto? Que declare e explique para mim, visto que determinei um povo eterno! Anunciem-lhes as coisas futuras, as que estão para vir!
verses.RVR09: ¿Y quién llamará como yo, y denunciará esto, y lo ordenará por mí, desde que hice el pueblo antiguo? Anúncienles lo que viene, y lo que está por venir.

verses.KJV: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.
verses.WEB: Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.”
verses.ASV: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have I not declared unto thee of old, and showed it? and ye are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? yea, there is no Rock; I know not any.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vos assombreis, nem temais; por acaso eu não vos contei e anunciei com antecedência? Pois vós sois minhas testemunhas. Por acaso há outro Deus além de mim? Não há outra Rocha, não que eu conheça.
verses.RVR09: No temáis, ni os amedrentéis: ¿no te lo hice oir desde antiguo, y te lo dije? Luego vosotros sois mis testigos. No hay Dios sino yo. No hay Fuerte: no conozco ninguno.

verses.KJV: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
verses.WEB: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t see, nor know, that they may be disappointed.
verses.ASV: They that fashion a graven image are all of them vanity; and the things that they delight in shall not profit; and their own witnesses see not, nor know: that they may be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os que formam imagens de escultura são nada, e as coisas que eles se agradam são de nenhum proveito; e elas mesmas são suas testemunhas: nada veem, nem entendem; por isso serão envergonhados.
verses.RVR09: Los formadores de imágenes de talla, todos ellos son vanidad, y lo más precioso de ellos para nada es útil; y ellos mismos para su confusión son testigos, que ellos ni ven ni entienden.

verses.KJV: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
verses.WEB: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?
verses.ASV: Who hath fashioned a god, or molten an image that is profitable for nothing?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é que forma um deus e funde uma imagem de escultura que não lhe tem proveito algum?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién formó un dios, ó quién fundó una estatua que para nada es de provecho?

verses.KJV: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
verses.WEB: Behold, all his fellows will be disappointed; and the workmen are mere men. Let them all be gathered together. Let them stand up. They will fear. They will be put to shame together.
verses.ASV: Behold, all his fellows shall be put to shame; and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; they shall fear, they shall be put to shame together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que todos os companheiros dele serão envergonhados, pois os artífices nada são além de homens. Ajuntem-se todos, [e] fiquem de pé; eles se assombrarão, e juntamente serão envergonhados.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que todos sus compañeros serán avergonzados; porque los mismos artífices son de los hombres. Todos ellos se juntarán, estarán, se asombrarán, y serán avergonzados á una.

verses.KJV: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
verses.WEB: The blacksmith takes an ax, works in the coals, fashions it with hammers, and works it with his strong arm. He is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is faint.
verses.ASV: The smith [maketh] an axe, and worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with his strong arm: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth; he drinketh no water, and is faint.
verses.ALMEIDA: O ferreiro, [com] a ferramenta de corte, trabalha nas brasas, e forma [o ídolo] com martelos; e ele o faz com a força de seu braço; ele, porém, tem fome e perde as forças, e [se] não beber água, desfalece.
verses.RVR09: El herrero tomará la tenaza, obrará en las ascuas, darále forma con los martillos, y trabajará en ella con la fuerza de su brazo: tiene luego hambre, y le faltan las fuerzas; no beberá agua, y se desmaya.

verses.KJV: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
verses.WEB: The carpenter stretches out a line. He marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes. He marks it out with compasses, and shapes it like the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to reside in a house.
verses.ASV: The carpenter stretcheth out a line; he marketh it out with a pencil; he shapeth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compasses, and shapeth it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man, to dwell in a house.
verses.ALMEIDA: O carpinteiro estende a linha de medir, [e] o desenha com um marcador; ele o confecciona com formões, e o desenha com um compasso; e o faz à semelhança de um homem, conforme a beleza humana, para habitar numa casa.
verses.RVR09: El carpintero tiende la regla, señala aquélla con almagre, lábrala con los cepillos, dale figura con el compás, hácela en forma de varón, á semejanza de hombre hermoso, para estar en casa.

verses.KJV: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
verses.WEB: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes the cypress and the oak, and strengthens for himself one among the trees of the forest. He plants a cypress tree, and the rain nourishes it.
verses.ASV: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the holm-tree and the oak, and strengtheneth for himself one among the trees of the forest: he planteth a fir-tree, and the rain doth nourish it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele corta para si cedros, e toma um cipreste ou um carvalho, e reserva para si das árvores da floresta; ele planta um pinheiro, e a chuva [o] faz crescer.
verses.RVR09: Cortaráse cedros, y tomará encina y alcornoque, y entre los árboles del bosque se esforzará; plantará pino, que se críe con la lluvia.

verses.KJV: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
verses.WEB: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it and warms himself. Yes, he burns it and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.
verses.ASV: Then shall it be for a man to burn; and he taketh thereof, and warmeth himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread: yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então [tal madeira] servirá ao homem para queimar, e toma parte deles para se aquecer, e os acende, e aquece o pão; ele também faz um deus, e o adora; fabrica dela uma imagem de escultura, e se prostra diante dela.
verses.RVR09: De él se servirá luego el hombre para quemar, y tomará de ellos para calentarse; encenderá también el horno, y cocerá panes: hará además un dios, y lo adorará; fabricará un ídolo, y arrodillaráse delante de él.

verses.KJV: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
verses.WEB: He burns part of it in the fire. With part of it, he eats meat. He roasts a roast and is satisfied. Yes, he warms himself and says, “Aha! I am warm. I have seen the fire.”
verses.ASV: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied; yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua metade ele queima no fogo; com a [outra] metade como carne; prepara assado, e [dele] se sacia; também se esquenta, e diz: Ah! Já me aqueci! Já vi o fogo!
verses.RVR09: Parte del leño quemará en el fuego; con parte de él comerá carne, aderezará asado, y se saciará; después se calentará, y dirá: ¡Oh! heme calentado, he visto el fuego;

verses.KJV: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
verses.WEB: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, “Deliver me, for you are my god!”
verses.ASV: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image; he falleth down unto it and worshippeth, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então do resto ele faz um deus, para imagem de escultura para si; ele se ajoelha a ela, e a adora, e ora a ela, e diz: Livra-me, pois tu és meu deus.
verses.RVR09: Y torna su sobrante en un dios, en su escultura; humíllase delante de ella, adórala, y ruégale diciendo: Líbrame, que mi dios eres tú.

verses.KJV: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
verses.WEB: They don’t know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see, and their hearts, that they can’t understand.
verses.ASV: They know not, neither do they consider: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles nada sabem, nem entendem; porque seus olhos foram encobertos para que não vejam; [e] seus corações, para que não entendam.
verses.RVR09: No supieron ni entendieron: porque encostrados están sus ojos para no ver, y su corazón para no entender.

verses.KJV: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
verses.WEB: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”
verses.ASV: And none calleth to mind, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
verses.ALMEIDA: E nenhum deles pensa [sobre isso] em seu coração, e não tem conhecimento nem entendimento para dizer: A metade queimei no fogo; e aqueci pão sobre suas brasas; assei carne, e a comi; e faria eu do resto uma abominação? Prostraria eu ao que saiu de uma árvore?
verses.RVR09: No discurre para consigo, no tiene sentido ni entendimiento para decir: Parte de esto quemé en el fuego, y sobre sus brasas cocí pan, asé carne, y comíla; ¿he de tornar en una abominación lo restante de ello? ¿delante de un tronco de árbol tengo de humillarme?

verses.KJV: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
verses.WEB: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”
verses.ASV: He feedeth on ashes; a deceived heart hath turned him aside; and he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele se alimenta de cinzas; [seu] coração enganado o desviou, de modo que ele já não pode livrar a sua alma, nem dizer: Por acaso não é uma mentira [o que há] na minha mão direita?
verses.RVR09: De ceniza se apacienta; su corazón engañado le desvía, para que no libre su alma, ni diga: ¿No hay una mentira á mi mano derecha?

verses.KJV: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
verses.WEB: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.
verses.ASV: Remember these things, O Jacob, and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te destas coisas, ó Jacó e Israel, pois tu és meu servo; eu te formei. Meu servo és, ó Israel; eu não me esquecerei de ti.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de estas cosas, oh Jacob, é Israel, pues que tú mi siervo eres: Yo te formé; siervo mío eres tú: Israel, no me olvides.

verses.KJV: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
verses.WEB: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.
verses.ASV: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu elimino tuas transgressões como a névoa, e teus pecados como a nuvem; volta a mim, pois eu já te resgatei.
verses.RVR09: Yo deshice como á nube tus rebeliones, y como á niebla tus pecados: tórnate á mí, porque yo te redimí.

verses.KJV: Sing, O ye heavens; for the Lord hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
verses.WEB: Sing, you heavens, for the LORD has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.
verses.ASV: Sing, O ye heavens, for Jehovah hath done it; shout, ye lower parts of the earth; break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for Jehovah hath redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai louvores, vós céus, porque o SENHOR [assim] fez; gritai de alegria, vós partes baixas da terra; vós montes, fazei ruídos de júbilo, [também] vós bosques, e todas as árvores neles; porque o SENHOR regatou a Jacó, e glorificou a si mesmo em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Cantad loores, oh cielos, porque Jehová lo hizo; gritad con júbilo, lugares bajos de la tierra; prorrumpid, montes, en alabanza; bosque, y todo árbol que en él está: porque Jehová redimió á Jacob, y en Israel será glorificado.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the Lord that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
verses.WEB: The LORD, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb says: “I am the LORD, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb: I am Jehovah, that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth (who is with me?);
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR, o teu redentor, aquele que te formou desde o ventre: Eu sou o SENHOR que tudo faço; que sozinho estico os céus, e que estendo a terra por mim mesmo;
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová, tu Redentor, y formador tuyo desde el vientre: Yo Jehová, que lo hago todo, que extiendo solo los cielos, que extiendo la tierra por mí mismo;

verses.KJV: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
verses.WEB: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;
verses.ASV: that frustrateth the signs of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que desfaço os sinais dos inventores de mentiras, e faço de todos aos adivinhos; que faço aos sábios retrocederem, e torno o conhecimento deles em loucura;
verses.RVR09: Que deshago las señales de los adivinos, y enloquezco á los agoreros; que hago tornar atrás los sabios, y desvanezco su sabiduría;

verses.KJV: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
verses.WEB: who confirms the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be built,’ and ‘I will raise up its waste places;’
verses.ASV: that confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith of Jerusalem, She shall be inhabited; and of the cities of Judah, They shall be built, and I will raise up the waste places thereof;
verses.ALMEIDA: [Sou aquele] que confirma a palavra de seu servo, e cumpre o conselho de seus mensageiros; que diz a Jerusalém: Tu serás habitada; E às cidades de Judá: Sereis reconstruídas; e eu erguerei seus lugares arruinados.
verses.RVR09: Que despierta la palabra de su siervo, y cumple el consejo de sus mensajeros; que dice á Jerusalem: Serás habitada; y á las ciudades de Judá: Reedificadas serán, y sus ruinas levantaré;

verses.KJV: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
verses.WEB: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers,’
verses.ASV: that saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que diz à profundeza: Seca-te; e eu secarei teus rios.
verses.RVR09: Que dice al profundo: Sécate, y tus ríos haré secar;

verses.KJV: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
verses.WEB: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”
verses.ASV: That saith of Cyrus, [He is] my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure, even saying of Jerusalem, She shall be built; and of the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que diz de Ciro: Ele é meu pastor, e cumprirá toda a minha vontade, dizendo à Jerusalém: Serás edificada; e ao Templo: Terás posto teu fundamento.
verses.RVR09: Que dice de Ciro: Es mi pastor, y cumplirá todo lo que yo quiero, en diciendo á Jerusalem, Serás edificada; y al templo: Serás fundado.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
verses.WEB: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him, and I will loose the loins of kings; to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR a seu ungido, Ciro, ao qual tomou pela sua mão direita, para abater as nações diante dele, e tirar a proteção dos lombos dos reis; para abrir diante de sua presença as portas, e as portas não se fecharão:
verses.RVR09: ASÍ dice Jehová á su ungido, á Ciro, al cual tomé yo por su mano derecha, para sujetar gentes delante de él y desatar lomos de reyes; para abrir delante de él puertas, y las puertas no se cerrarán:

verses.KJV: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
verses.WEB: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.
verses.ASV: I will go before thee, and make the rough places smooth; I will break in pieces the doors of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu irei adiante de ti, e nivelarei os caminhos acidentados; quebrarei as portas de bronze, e despedaçarei os ferrolhos de ferro;
verses.RVR09: Yo iré delante de ti, y enderezaré las tortuosidades; quebrantaré puertas de bronce, y cerrojos de hierro haré pedazos;

verses.KJV: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.
verses.WEB: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, the LORD, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.
verses.ASV: and I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that it is I, Jehovah, who call thee by thy name, even the God of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te darei os tesouros das escuridões, e as riquezas escondidas; para que possas saber que eu sou o SENHOR, que [te] chama pelo teu nome, o Deus de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y te daré los tesoros escondidos, y los secretos muy guardados; para que sepas que yo soy Jehová, el Dios de Israel, que te pongo nombre.

verses.KJV: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
verses.WEB: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.
verses.ASV: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em favor de meu servo Jacó e de meu escolhido Israel, eu te chamei pelo teu nome; eu te pus teu título, ainda que tu não me conhecesses.
verses.RVR09: Por amor de mi siervo Jacob, y de Israel mi escogido, te llamé por tu nombre; púsete sobrenombre, aunque no me conociste.

verses.KJV: I am the Lord, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
verses.WEB: I am the LORD, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah, and there is none else; besides me there is no God. I will gird thee, though thou hast not known me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR, e ninguém mais; fora de mim não há Deus; eu te revestirei, ainda que tu não me conheças;
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová, y ninguno más hay: no hay Dios fuera de mí. Yo te ceñiré, aunque tú no me conociste;

verses.KJV: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the Lord, and there is none else.
verses.WEB: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no one else.
verses.ASV: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none besides me: I am Jehovah, and there is none else.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que saibam desde o oriente e desde o ocidente que fora de mim não há outro. Eu sou o SENHOR, e ninguém mais.
verses.RVR09: Para que se sepa desde el nacimiento del sol, y desde donde se pone, que no hay más que yo; yo Jehová, y ninguno más que yo:

verses.KJV: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things.
verses.WEB: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am the LORD, who does all these things.
verses.ASV: I form the light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil; I am Jehovah, that doeth all these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu formo a luz e crio as trevas; eu faço a paz, e crio a adversidade; eu, o SENHOR, faço todas estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: Que formo la luz y crío las tinieblas, que hago la paz y crío el mal. Yo Jehová que hago todo esto.

verses.KJV: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the Lord have created it.
verses.WEB: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, the LORD, have created it.
verses.ASV: Distil, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, that it may bring forth salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up together; I, Jehovah, have created it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Gotejai vós, céus, de cima, e as nuvens destilem justiça; abra-se a terra, e produza-se salvação, e a justiça juntamente frutifique; eu, o SENHOR, as criei.
verses.RVR09: Rociad, cielos, de arriba, y las nubes destilen la justicia; ábrase la tierra, y prodúzcanse la salud y la justicia; háganse brotar juntamente. Yo Jehová lo crié.

verses.KJV: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
verses.WEB: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?
verses.ASV: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! a potsherd among the potsherds of the earth! Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai daquele que briga com seu formador: [apenas] um caco entre outros cacos de barro! Por acaso o barro dirá ao seu formador: Que fazes? Ou tua obra: Não tem mãos?
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del que pleitea con su Hacedor! ¡el tiesto con los tiestos de la tierra! ¿Dirá el barro al que lo labra: Qué haces; ó tu obra: No tiene manos?

verses.KJV: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
verses.WEB: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’”
verses.ASV: Woe unto him that saith unto a father, What begettest thou? or to a woman, With what travailest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai daquele que diz ao pai: O que é que tu geras? E à mulher: O que é que tu fazes nascer?
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del que dice al padre: ¿Por qué engendraste? y á la mujer: ¿Por qué pariste?

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
verses.WEB: The LORD, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker: Ask me of the things that are to come; concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands, command ye me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR, o Santo de Israel, e seu formador: Perguntai-me sobre as coisas futuras; [por acaso] me dais ordens sobre os meus filhos, e sobre as obras de minhas mãos?
verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová, el Santo de Israel, y su Formador: Preguntadme de las cosas por venir; mandadme acerca de mis hijos, y acerca de la obra de mis manos.

verses.KJV: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
verses.WEB: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.
verses.ASV: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens; and all their host have I commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu fiz a terra, e criei nela o homem; fui eu, minhas próprias mãos estenderam os céus, e dei ordens sobre todo o seu exército.
verses.RVR09: Yo hice la tierra, y crié sobre ella al hombre. Yo, mis manos, extendieron los cielos, y á todo su ejército mandé.

verses.KJV: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward,” says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make straight all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu o despertei em justiça, e todos os seus caminhos endireitarei; ele edificará minha cidade, e soltará meus cativos; não por preço, nem por subornos,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Yo lo desperté en justicia, y enderezaré todos sus caminos; él edificará mi ciudad, y soltará mis cautivos, no por precio ni por dones, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall go after thee, in chains they shall come over; and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, [saying], Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: O trabalho do Egito, e o comércio dos cuxitas e dos sabeus, homens de alta estatura, passarão a ti, e serão teus; eles irão após ti, passarão acorrentados; e a ti se prostrarão, a ti suplicarão, [dizendo] : Certamente Deus está contigo, e nenhum outro Deus há.
