verses.RVR09: Así dice Jehová: El trabajo de Egipto, las mercaderías de Etiopía, y los Sabeos hombres agigantados, se pasarán á ti, y serán tuyos; irán en pos de ti, pasarán con grillos: á ti harán reverencia, y á ti suplicarán, diciendo: Cierto, en ti está Dios, y no hay otro fuera de Dios.

verses.KJV: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
verses.WEB: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’”
verses.ASV: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Verdadeiramente tu és o Deus que se encobre; o Deus de Israel, o Salvador.
verses.RVR09: Verdaderamente tú eres Dios que te encubres, Dios de Israel, que salvas.

verses.KJV: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
verses.WEB: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.
verses.ASV: They shall be put to shame, yea, confounded, all of them; they shall go into confusion together that are makers of idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: Serão envergonhados, e também humilhados, todos eles; juntamente irão embora com vergonha os que fabricam imagens.
verses.RVR09: Confusos y avergonzados serán todos ellos; irán con afrenta todos los fabricadores de imágenes.

verses.KJV: But Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
verses.WEB: Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.
verses.ASV: [But] Israel shall be saved by Jehovah with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be put to shame nor confounded world without end.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas] Israel é salvo pelo SENHOR, [com] salvação eterna; não sereis envergonhados nem humilhados para todo o sempre.
verses.RVR09: Israel es salvo en Jehová con salud eterna; no os avergonzaréis, ni os afrentaréis, por todos los siglos.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord; and there is none else.
verses.WEB: For the LORD who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am the LORD. There is no other.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah that created the heavens, the God that formed the earth and made it, that established it and created it not a waste, that formed it to be inhabited: I am Jehovah; and there is none else.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR, que criou os céus, o Deus que formou a terra, e a fez; ele a firmou, não a criou [para ser] vazia, [ao contrário] ,criou para que fosse habitada: Eu sou o SENHOR, e ninguém mais.
verses.RVR09: Porque así dijo Jehová, que crió los cielos; él es Dios, el que formó la tierra, el que la hizo y la compuso; no la crió en vano, para que fuese habitada la crió: Yo Jehová, y ninguno más que yo.

verses.KJV: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the Lord speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.WEB: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the LORD, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.
verses.ASV: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness; I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I, Jehovah, speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não falei em oculto, [nem] em algum lugar escuro da terra; não disse à semente de Jacó: Buscai-me, em vão; eu sou o SENHOR, que fala justiça, [e] anuncio coisas corretas.
verses.RVR09: No hablé en escondido, en lugar de tierra de tinieblas; no dije á la generación de Jacob: En vano me buscáis. Yo soy Jehová que hablo justicia, que anuncio rectitud.

verses.KJV: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
verses.WEB: “Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image, and pray to a god that can’t save.
verses.ASV: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that carry the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ajuntai-vos, e vinde; achegai-vos juntamente os que escapastes das nações. Os que carregam suas imagens de escultura de madeira, e rogam a um Deus que não pode salvar, nada conhecem.
verses.RVR09: Reuníos, y venid; allegaos, todos los escapados de las gentes: no saben aquellos que erigen el madero de su escultura, y los que ruegan al dios que no salva.

verses.KJV: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the Lord? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
verses.WEB: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, the LORD? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.
verses.ASV: Declare ye, and bring [it] forth; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath showed this from ancient time? who hath declared it of old? have not I, Jehovah? and there is no God else besides me, a just God and a Saviour; there is none besides me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Anunciai, e achegai-vos; e consultai juntamente em conselho; quem fez ouvir isto desde a antiguidade? [Quem] desde então tem anunciado? Por acaso não sou eu, o SENHOR? E não há ouro Deus além de mim, Deus justo e Salvador; ninguém, a não ser eu [mesmo] .
verses.RVR09: Publicad, y haced llegar, y entren todos en consulta: ¿quién hizo oir esto desde el principio, y lo tiene dicho desde entonces, sino yo Jehová? Y no hay más Dios que yo; Dios justo y Salvador: ningún otro fuera de mí.

verses.KJV: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
verses.WEB: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
verses.ASV: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is none else.
verses.ALMEIDA: Virai-vos a mim, e sede salvos, vós todos os limites da terra; porque eu sou Deus, e ninguém mais.
verses.RVR09: Mirad á mí, y sed salvos, todos los términos de la tierra: porque yo soy Dios, y no hay más.

verses.KJV: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
verses.WEB: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.
verses.ASV: By myself have I sworn, the word is gone forth from my mouth [in] righteousness, and shall not return, that unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por mim mesmo tenho jurado; já saiu da minha boca palavra de justiça, e não voltará atrás: que a mim se dobrará todo joelho, e toda língua prestará juramento;
verses.RVR09: Por mí hice juramento, de mi boca salió palabra en justicia, y no será revocada: Que á mí se doblará toda rodilla, jurará toda lengua.

verses.KJV: Surely, shall one say, in the Lord have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
verses.WEB: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in the LORD.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.
verses.ASV: Only in Jehovah, it is said of me, is righteousness and strength; even to him shall men come; and all they that were incensed against him shall be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: De mim se dirá: Certamente no SENHOR há justiça e poder; Até a ele chegarão, mas serão envergonhados todos os que o odeiam.
verses.RVR09: Y diráse de mí: Ciertamente en Jehová está la justicia y la fuerza: á él vendrán, y todos los que contra él se enardecen, serán avergonzados.

verses.KJV: In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
verses.WEB: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in the LORD, and will rejoice!
verses.ASV: In Jehovah shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém] no SENHOR todos [os que são da] semente de Israel serão justificados e se gloriarão.
verses.RVR09: En Jehová será justificada y se gloriará toda la generación de Israel.

verses.KJV: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
verses.WEB: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.
verses.ASV: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth; their idols are upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: the things that ye carried about are made a load, a burden to the weary [beast].
verses.ALMEIDA: Bel se abaixa, Nebo se curva; seus ídolos são postos sobre os animais e sobre o gado; as cargas de vossos fardos são exaustivas para os [animais] já cansados.
verses.RVR09: POSTRÓSE Bel, abatióse Nebo; sus simulacros fueron puestos sobre bestias, y sobre animales de carga: os llevarán cargados de vosotros, carga penosa.

verses.KJV: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.WEB: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.
verses.ASV: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Juntamente se encurvam e se abaixam; não podem salvar a carga, mas eles mesmos vão ao cativeiro.
verses.RVR09: Fueron humillados, fueron abatidos juntamente; no pudieron escaparse de la carga, sino que tuvieron ellos mismos que ir en cautiverio.

verses.KJV: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
verses.WEB: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.
verses.ASV: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been borne [by me] from their birth, that have been carried from the womb;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi-me, ó casa de Jacó, e todo o restante da casa de Israel; vós a quem eu carreguei desde o ventre, a quem levei desde o útero.
verses.RVR09: Oidme, oh casa de Jacob, y todo el resto de la casa de Israel, los que sois traídos por mí desde el vientre, los que sois llevados desde la matriz.

verses.KJV: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verses.WEB: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
verses.ASV: and even to old age I am he, and even to hoar hairs will I carry [you]; I have made, and I will bear; yea, I will carry, and will deliver.
verses.ALMEIDA: E até [vossa] velhice eu serei o mesmo, e ainda até [à idade dos] cabelos grisalhos eu [vos] carregarei; eu [vos] fiz, e eu [vos] levarei; eu [vos] carregarei e [vos] livrarei.
verses.RVR09: Y hasta la vejez yo mismo, y hasta las canas os soportaré yo: yo hice, yo llevaré, yo soportaré y guardaré.

verses.KJV: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
verses.WEB: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?
verses.ASV: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem me considerareis semelhante, e com quem [me] igualareis, e me comparareis, para que sejamos semelhantes?
verses.RVR09: ¿A quién me asemejáis, y me igualáis, y me comparáis, para que sea semejante?

verses.KJV: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
verses.WEB: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down— yes, they worship.
verses.ASV: Such as lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, they hire a goldsmith, and he maketh it a god; they fall down, yea, they worship.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles gastam o ouro da bolsa, e pesam a prata com balanças; pagam ao ourives, e daquilo ele faz um deus, e se prostram e adoram.
verses.RVR09: Sacan oro del talego, y pesan plata con balanzas, alquilan un platero para hacer un dios de ello; humíllanse y adoran.

verses.KJV: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.WEB: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.
verses.ASV: They bear it upon the shoulder, they carry it, and set it in its place, and it standeth, from its place shall it not remove: yea, one may cry unto it, yet can it not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre os ombros o temam, o carregam, e o põem em seu lugar; ali ele fica, de seu lugar não se move; e se chamarem por ele, resposta nenhuma ele dá, nem o livra de sua aflição.
verses.RVR09: Echanselo sobre los hombros, llévanlo, y asiéntanlo en su lugar; allí se está, y no se mueve de su sitio. Danle voces, y tampoco responde, ni libra de la tribulación.

verses.KJV: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
verses.WEB: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.
verses.ASV: Remember this, and show yourselves men; bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos disto, e sede corajosos; fazei memória disso no coração, ó transgressores!
verses.RVR09: Acordaos de esto, y tened vergüenza; tornad en vosotros, prevaricadores.

verses.KJV: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,
verses.WEB: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
verses.ASV: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; [I am] God, and there is none like me;
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembrai-vos das coisas passadas desde a antiguidade; porque eu sou Deus, e nenhum outro deus há, e ninguém há semelhante a mim,
verses.RVR09: Acordaos de las cosas pasadas desde el siglo; porque yo soy Dios, y no hay más Dios, y nada hay á mí semejante;

verses.KJV: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
verses.WEB: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.
verses.ASV: declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not [yet] done; saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que declaro o fim desde o princípio, e desde a antiguidade as coisas que ainda não aconteceram; que digo: Minha intenção será firme, e farei toda a minha vontade.
verses.RVR09: Que anuncio lo por venir desde el principio, y desde antiguo lo que aun no era hecho; que digo: Mi consejo permanecerá, y haré todo lo que quisiere;

verses.KJV: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
verses.WEB: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.
verses.ASV: calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country; yea, I have spoken, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed, I will also do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que chamo a ave de rapina desde o oriente, ao homem da minha intenção desde as terras distantes; porque assim disse; e assim o cumprirei; eu [o] formei, também o farei.
verses.RVR09: Que llamo desde el oriente al ave, y de tierra lejana al varón de mi consejo. Yo hablé, y lo haré venir: helo pensado, y también lo haré.

verses.KJV: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
verses.WEB: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
verses.ASV: Hearken unto me, ye stout-hearted, that are far from righteousness:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi-me, ó duros de coração; vós que estais longe da justiça:
verses.RVR09: Oidme, duros de corazón, que estáis lejos de la justicia.

verses.KJV: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
verses.WEB: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.
verses.ASV: I bring near my righteousness, it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry; and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu trago para perto minha justiça, ela não ficará longe; e minha salvação não tardará; mas porei salvação em Sião, a Israel minha glória.
verses.RVR09: Haré que se acerque mi justicia, no se alejará: y mi salud no se detendrá. Y pondré salud en Sión, y mi gloria en Israel.

verses.KJV: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
verses.WEB: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.
verses.ASV: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desce, e senta-te no pó da terra, ó virgem filha da Babilônia; senta-te no chão; já não há [mais] trono, ó filha dos caldeus; pois nunca mais serás chamada de tenra e delicada.
verses.RVR09: DESCIENDE, y siéntate en el polvo, virgen hija de Babilonia, siéntate en la tierra sin trono, hija de los Caldeos: que nunca más te llamarán tierna y delicada.

verses.KJV: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
verses.WEB: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.
verses.ASV: Take the millstones, and grind meal; remove thy veil, strip off the train, uncover the leg, pass through the rivers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma as pedras de moer, e mói farinha; descobre o teu véu, expõe as pernas, descobre as coxas, [e] passa os rios.
verses.RVR09: Toma el molino, y muele harina: descubre tus guedejas, descalza los pies, descubre las piernas, pasa los ríos.

verses.KJV: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.
verses.WEB: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Yes, your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and will spare no one.”
verses.ASV: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and will spare no man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua nudez será descoberta, e tua vergonha será vista; tomarei vingança, e a ninguém pouparei.
verses.RVR09: Descubierta será tu vergüenza, y tu deshonor será visto: tomaré venganza, y no encontraré hombre.

verses.KJV: As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: Our Redeemer, the LORD of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: Our Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: O nome de nosso Redentor é o SENHOR dos exércitos, o Santo de Israel!
verses.RVR09: Nuestro Redentor, Jehová de los ejércitos es su nombre, el Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
verses.WEB: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms.
verses.ASV: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; for thou shalt no more be called The mistress of kingdoms.
verses.ALMEIDA: Senta-te calada, e entra nas trevas, ó filha dos caldeus; porque nunca mais serás chamada de senhora dos reinos.
verses.RVR09: Siéntate, calla, y entra en tinieblas, hija de los Caldeos: porque nunca más te llamarán señora de reinos.

verses.KJV: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
verses.WEB: I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid a very heavy yoke on the aged.
verses.ASV: I was wroth with my people, I profaned mine inheritance, and gave them into thy hand: thou didst show them no mercy; upon the aged hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tive muita ira contra meu povo; profanei minha herança, e os entreguei em tuas mãos; [porém] tu não lhes foste misericordiosa, [e até] sobre os velhos puseste teu jugo muito pesado.
verses.RVR09: Enojéme contra mi pueblo, profané mi heredad, y entreguélos en tu mano: no les hiciste misericordias; sobre el viejo agravaste mucho tu yugo.

verses.KJV: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
verses.WEB: You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the results.
verses.ASV: And thou saidst, I shall be mistress for ever; so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizias: Serei senhora para sempre; Até agora não pensaste estas coisas em teu coração, nem te lembraste do fim que elas teriam.
verses.RVR09: Y dijiste: Para siempre seré señora: y no has pensado en esto, ni te acordaste de tu postrimería.

verses.KJV: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
verses.WEB: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won’t sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.’
verses.ASV: Now therefore hear this, thou that art given to pleasures, that sittest securely, that sayest in thy heart, I am, and there is none else besides me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, ouve isto, ó amante dos prazeres, que habitas tão segura, que dizes em teu coração: Somente eu, e ninguém mais; não ficarei viúva, nem saberei como é perder um filho.
verses.RVR09: Oye pues ahora esto, delicada, la que está sentada confiadamente, la que dice en su corazón: Yo soy, y fuera de mí no hay más; no quedaré viuda, ni conoceré orfandad.

verses.KJV: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
verses.WEB: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.
verses.ASV: but these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood; in their full measure shall they come upon thee, in the multitude of thy sorceries, and the great abundance of thine enchantments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ambas estas coisas virão sobre ti, em um momento no mesmo dia: perda de filhos e viuvez; em completa totalidade virão sobre ti, por causa de tuas muitas feitiçarias, por causa da abundância de teus muitos encantamentos.
verses.RVR09: Estas dos cosas te vendrán de repente en un mismo día, orfandad y viudez: en toda su perfección vendrán sobre ti, por la multitud de tus adivinanzas, y por la copia de tus muchos agüeros.

verses.KJV: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
verses.WEB: For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted you. You have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’
verses.ASV: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness; thou hast said, None seeth me; thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee, and thou hast said in thy heart, I am, and there is none else besides me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois confiaste em tua maldade, [e] disseste: Ninguém me vê.Tua sabedoria e teu conhecimento, esses te fizeram desviar, e disseste em teu coração: Somente eu, e ninguém mais.
verses.RVR09: Porque te confiaste en tu maldad, diciendo: Nadie me ve. Tu sabiduría y tu misma ciencia te engañaron, y dijiste en tu corazón: Yo, y no más.

verses.KJV: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.
verses.WEB: Therefore disaster will come on you. You won’t know when it dawns. Mischief will fall on you. You won’t be able to put it away. Desolation will come on you suddenly, which you don’t understand.
verses.ASV: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know the dawning thereof: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it away: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou knowest not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então virá sobre ti um mal do qual não saberás a origem, e destruição cairá sobre ti, a qual não poderás solucionar; porque virá sobre ti de repente [tão] tempestuosa assolação, que não poderás reconhecer [com antecedência] .
verses.RVR09: Vendrá pues sobre ti mal, cuyo nacimiento no sabrás: caerá sobre ti quebrantamiento, el cual no podrás remediar: y destrucción que no sabrás, vendrá de repente sobre ti.

verses.KJV: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
verses.WEB: “Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, as if you might profit, as if you might prevail.
verses.ASV: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast labored from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fica [ainda] com teus encantamentos, e com as tuas muitas feitiçarias, em que trabalhaste desde a tua juventude; para [ver se] talvez ter algum proveito, ou quem sabe provoques algum medo.
verses.RVR09: Estáte ahora en tus encantamentos, y con la multitud de tus agüeros, en los cuales te fatigaste desde tu niñez; quizá podrás mejorarte, quizá te fortificarás.

verses.KJV: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.
verses.WEB: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Now let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save you from the things that will happen to you.
verses.ASV: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels: let now the astrologers, the star-gazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from the things that shall come upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te cansaste com tantos conselhos que recebeste; levantem-se, pois, agora, os que observam o céu, os que contemplam as estrelas, os adivinhos das luas novas; e salvem-te daquilo que virá sobre ti.
verses.RVR09: Haste fatigado en la multitud de tus consejos. Parezcan ahora y defiéndante los contempladores de los cielos, los especuladores de las estrellas, los que contaban los meses, para pronosticar lo que vendrá sobre ti.

verses.KJV: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
verses.WEB: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won’t deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won’t be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by.
verses.ASV: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: it shall not be a coal to warm at, nor a fire to sit before.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eles serão como a palha: o fogo os queimará, não poderão livrar suas vidas do poder das chamas; [essas] não serão brasas para se aquecer, [nem] fogo para [meramente] se sentar perto.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que serán como tamo; fuego los quemará, no salvarán sus vidas del poder de la llama; no quedará brasa para calentarse, ni lumbre á la cual se sienten.

verses.KJV: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
verses.WEB: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you.
verses.ASV: Thus shall the things be unto thee wherein thou hast labored: they that have trafficked with thee from thy youth shall wander every one to his quarter; there shall be none to save thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim serão para ti aqueles com quem trabalhaste, aqueles com quem fizeste negócios desde a tua juventude. Cada um [deles] andará sem rumo em seu [próprio] caminho; ninguém te salvará.
verses.RVR09: Así te serán aquellos con quienes te fatigaste, tus negociantes desde tu niñez: cada uno echará por su camino, no habrá quien te salve.

verses.KJV: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the Lord, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.WEB: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by the LORD’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness—
verses.ASV: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah; who swear by the name of Jehovah, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi isto, casa de Jacó, que vos chamais pelo nome de Israel, e saístes das águas de Judá; que jurais pelo nome do SENHOR, e fazeis menção do Deus de Israel, [porém] não em verdade, nem em justiça.
verses.RVR09: OID esto, casa de Jacob, que os llamáis del nombre de Israel, los que salieron de las aguas de Judá, los que juran en el nombre de Jehová, y hacen memoria del Dios de Israel, mas no en verdad ni en justicia:

verses.KJV: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.WEB: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; the LORD of Armies is his name.
verses.ASV: (for they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; Jehovah of hosts is his name):
verses.ALMEIDA: E até da santa cidade se chamam; e confiam no Deus de Israel; EU-SOU dos exércitos é o seu nome.
verses.RVR09: Porque de la santa ciudad se nombran, y en el Dios de Israel confían: su nombre, Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
verses.WEB: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.
verses.ASV: I have declared the former things from of old; yea, they went forth out of my mouth, and I showed them: suddenly I did them, and they came to pass.
verses.ALMEIDA: As coisas passadas desde antes anunciei, procederam da minha boca, e eu as declarei publicamente; rapidamente eu as fiz, e elas aconteceram.
verses.RVR09: Lo que pasó, ya antes lo dije; y de mi boca salió; publiquélo, hícelo presto, y vino á ser.

verses.KJV: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
verses.WEB: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
verses.ASV: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sabia que tu eras obstinado, e teu pescoço era um nervo de ferro, e tua testa de bronze.
verses.RVR09: Porque conozco que eres duro, y nervio de hierro tu cerviz, y tu frente de metal,

verses.KJV: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
verses.WEB: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’
verses.ASV: therefore I have declared it to thee from of old; before it came to pass I showed it thee; lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu anunciei a ti com antecedência, [e] te declarei antes que acontecesse, para que não viesses a dizer: Meu ídolo fez estas coisas, ou minha imagem de escultura ou imagem de fundição, [foi ela que] isso ordenou.
verses.RVR09: Díjetelo ya días há; antes que viniese te lo enseñé, porque no dijeses: Mi ídolo lo hizo, mis estatuas de escultura y de fundición mandaron estas cosas.

verses.KJV: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
verses.WEB: You have heard it. Now see all this. And you, won’t you declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.
verses.ASV: Thou hast heard it; behold all this; and ye, will ye not declare it? I have showed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, which thou hast not known.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já tens escutado. Olha bem para tudo isto: por acaso vós não diríeis [que isto é verdade] ? A partir de agora eu te faço ouvir coisas novas, ocultas, e que nunca [antes] soubeste.
verses.RVR09: Oístelo, vístelo todo; ¿y no lo anunciaréis vosotros? Ahora pues te he hecho oir nuevas y ocultas cosas que tú no sabías.

verses.KJV: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
verses.WEB: They are created now, and not from of old. Before today, you didn’t hear them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’
verses.ASV: They are created now, and not from of old; and before this day thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora foram criadas, e não antes; e antes de hoje não as ouvistes; para que não viesses a dizer: Eis que eu já as sabia.
verses.RVR09: Ahora han sido criadas, no en días pasados; ni antes de este día las habías oído, porque no digas: He aquí que yo lo sabía.

verses.KJV: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.WEB: Yes, you didn’t hear. Yes, you didn’t know. Yes, from of old your ear was not opened, for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.ASV: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from of old thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou didst deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu não [as] ouviste, nem [as] soubeste, nem também teu ouvido havia sido aberto antes; porque eu sabia que agirias enganosamente, e que foste chamado de transgressor desde o ventre.
verses.RVR09: Sí, nunca lo habías oído, ni nunca lo habías conocido; ciertamente no se abrió antes tu oreja; porque sabía que desleal habías de desobedecer, por tanto te llamé rebelde desde el vientre.

verses.KJV: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
verses.WEB: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.
verses.ASV: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa do meu nome adiarei a minha ira, e por louvor a mim me conterei para contigo, para que eu não venha a te eliminar.
verses.RVR09: Por amor de mi nombre dilataré mi furor, y para alabanza mía te daré largas, para no talarte.

verses.KJV: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have refined thee, but not as silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu te purifiquei, porém não como a prata; eu te escolhi na fornalha da aflição.
verses.RVR09: He aquí te he purificado, y no como á plata; hete escogido en horno de aflicción.

verses.KJV: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
verses.WEB: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.
verses.ASV: For mine own sake, for mine own sake, will I do it; for how should [my name] be profaned? and my glory will I not give to another.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa de mim, por causa de mim eu o farei; pois como permitiria [meu nome] ser profanado? E minha glória não darei a outro.
verses.RVR09: Por mí, por amor de mí lo haré, para que no sea amancillado mi nombre, y mi honra no la daré á otro.

verses.KJV: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
verses.WEB: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.
verses.ASV: Hearken unto me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi-me, ó Jacó, e tu, ó Israel, por mim chamado; eu sou o mesmo; eu sou o primeiro, eu também sou o último.
verses.RVR09: Oyeme, Jacob, y tú, Israel, llamado de mí: Yo mismo, yo el primero, yo también el postrero.

verses.KJV: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
verses.WEB: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens. when I call to them, they stand up together.
verses.ASV: Yea, my hand hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spread out the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também minha mão fundou a terra, e minha mão direita estendeu os céus; quando eu os chamo, [logo] eles juntamente aparecem.
verses.RVR09: Mi mano fundó también la tierra, y mi mano derecha midió los cielos con el palmo; en llamándolos yo, parecieron juntamente.

verses.KJV: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The Lord hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
verses.WEB: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom the LORD loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.
verses.ASV: Assemble yourselves, all ye, and hear; who among them hath declared these things? He whom Jehovah loveth shall perform his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm [shall be on] the Chaldeans.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ajuntai-vos, todos vós, e ouvi, quem [há] dentre eles, anunciou estas coisas? O SENHOR o amou, [e] executará sua vontade contra a Babilônia, e seu braço será [contra] os caldeus.
verses.RVR09: Juntaos todos vosotros, y oid. ¿Quién hay entre ellos que anuncie estas cosas? Jehová lo amó, el cual ejecutará su voluntad en Babilonia, y su brazo en los Caldeos.

verses.KJV: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.WEB: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.ASV: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him; I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, eu mesmo tenho dito; também eu já o chamei. Eu o farei vir, e ele prosperará [em] seu caminho.
verses.RVR09: Yo, yo hablé, y le llamé, y le traje; por tanto será prosperado su camino.

verses.KJV: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord God, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
verses.WEB: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit.
verses.ASV: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord Jehovah hath sent me, and his Spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Achegai-vos a mim, ouvi isto: não falei em oculto desde o princípio; [ao contrário] ,desde o tempo em que aquilo se fez, ali eu estava; e agora o Senhor DEUS me enviou, e seu Espírito.
verses.RVR09: Allegaos á mí, oid esto; desde el principio no hablé en escondido; desde que la cosa se hizo, estuve allí: y ahora el Señor Jehová me envió, y su espíritu.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
verses.WEB: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am Jehovah thy God, who teacheth thee to profit, who leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR, teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, que te ensina o que é proveitoso, [e] te guia pelo caminho que deves andar.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová, Redentor tuyo, el Santo de Israel: Yo Jehová Dios tuyo, que te enseña provechosamente, que te encamina por el camino que andas.

verses.KJV: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.WEB: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
verses.ASV: Oh that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, se tu tivesses me dado ouvidos a meus mandamentos! Então tua paz teria sido como um rio, e tua justiça como as ondas do mar.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ojalá miraras tú á mis mandamientos! fuera entonces tu paz como un río, y tu justicia como las ondas de la mar.

verses.KJV: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.WEB: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”
verses.ASV: thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the grains thereof: his name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também tua semente teria sido como a areia, e os que procedem do teu corpo, como suas pedrinhas, cujo nome nunca seria cortado, nem destruído de minha face.
verses.RVR09: Fuera como la arena tu simiente, y los renuevos de tus entrañas como las pedrezuelas de ella; nunca su nombre fuera cortado, ni raído de mi presencia.

verses.KJV: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.WEB: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With the sound of joyful shouting announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth; say, “The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob!”
verses.ASV: Go ye forth from Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans; with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth: say ye, Jehovah hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: Saí da Babilônia, fugi dos caldeus; declarai com voz de júbilo, anunciai, [e] levai isto até o fim da terra; dizei: O SENHOR resgatou a seu servo Jacó!
verses.RVR09: Salid de Babilonia, huid de entre los Caldeos; dad nuevas de esto con voz de alegría, publicadlo, llevadlo hasta lo postrero de la tierra: decid: Redimió Jehová á Jacob su siervo.

verses.KJV: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.WEB: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out.
verses.ASV: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts; he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them; he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não tinham sede, [quando] ele os levava pelos desertos; fez correr para eles água da rocha; e quando ele fendia as rochas, águas manavam delas.
verses.RVR09: Y no tuvieron sed cuando los llevó por los desiertos; hízoles correr agua de la piedra; cortó la peña, y corrieron aguas.

verses.KJV: There is no peace, saith the Lord, unto the wicked.
verses.WEB: “There is no peace”, says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
verses.ASV: There is no peace, saith Jehovah, to the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Porém] para os perversos não haverá paz,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No hay paz para los malos, dijo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The Lord hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
verses.WEB: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: the LORD has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name.
verses.ASV: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye peoples, from far: Jehovah hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi-me, terras costeiras, e escutai, vós povos de longe; o SENHOR me chamou desde o ventre, desde as entranhas de minha mãe ele fez menção do meu nome;
verses.RVR09: OIDME, islas, y escuchad, pueblos lejanos: Jehová me llamó desde el vientre; desde las entrañas de mi madre tuvo mi nombre en memoria.

verses.KJV: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
verses.WEB: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver.
verses.ASV: and he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me: and he hath made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he kept me close:
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez da minha boca como uma espada afiada, com a sombra de sua mão ele me cobriu; e me pôs como uma flecha polida, [e] me guardou em sua aljava.
verses.RVR09: Y puso mi boca como espada aguda, cubrióme con la sombra de su mano; y púsome por saeta limpia, guardóme en su aljaba;

verses.KJV: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
verses.WEB: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”
verses.ASV: and he said unto me, Thou art my servant; Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me disse: Tu és meu servo, Israel, por quem serei glorificado.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome: Mi siervo eres, oh Israel, que en ti me gloriaré.

verses.KJV: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the Lord, and my work with my God.
verses.WEB: But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is with the LORD, and my reward with my God.”
verses.ASV: But I said, I have labored in vain, I have spent my strength for nought and vanity; yet surely the justice [due] to me is with Jehovah, and my recompense with my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eu disse: Inutilmente tenho trabalhado; por nada e em vão gastei minhas forças; todavia meu direito está perante o SENHOR, e minha recompensa perante meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero dije: Por demás he trabajado, en vano y sin provecho he consumido mi fortaleza; mas mi juicio está delante de Jehová, y mi recompensa con mi Dios.

verses.KJV: And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the Lord, and my God shall be my strength.
verses.WEB: Now the LORD, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in the LORD’s eyes, and my God has become my strength.
verses.ASV: And now saith Jehovah that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, and that Israel be gathered unto him (for I am honorable in the eyes of Jehovah, and my God is become my strength);
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora diz o SENHOR, que me formou desde o ventre para si por servo, que trazer Jacó de volta a si; porém Israel não se deixará ajuntar; contudo, nos olhos do SENHOR serei honrado, e meu Deus será minha força.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, dice Jehová, el que me formó desde el vientre por su siervo, para que convierta á él á Jacob. Bien que Israel no se juntará, con todo, estimado seré en los ojos de Jehová, y el Dios mío será mi fortaleza.

verses.KJV: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
verses.WEB: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”
verses.ASV: yea, he saith, It is too light a thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse também: É pouco demais que sejas meu servo [apenas] para restaurares as tribos de Jacó e restabeleceres os sobreviventes de Israel; eu também te dei como luz das nações, para seres minha salvação até o limite da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo: Poco es que tú me seas siervo para levantar las tribus de Jacob, y para que restaures los asolamientos de Israel: también te dí por luz de las gentes, para que seas mi salud hasta lo postrero de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the Lord that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: “Kings shall see and rise up, princes, and they shall worship, because of the LORD who is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, the Redeemer of Israel, [and] his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers: Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall worship; because of Jehovah that is faithful, [even] the Holy One of Israel, who hath chosen thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR, o Redentor de Israel, seu Santo, à alma desprezada, ao que a nação abomina, ao servo dos que dominam: Reis o verão e se levantarão, príncipes [também] ; e eles se prostrarão por causa do SENHOR, que é fiel, por causa do Santo de Israel, que te escolheu.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová, Redentor de Israel, el Santo suyo, al menospreciado de alma, al abominado de las gentes, al siervo de los tiranos: Verán reyes, y levantaránse príncipes, y adorarán por Jehová; porque fiel es el Santo de Israel, el cual te escogió.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage,
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, In an acceptable time have I answered thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee; and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: No tempo do favor eu te ouvi, e no dia da salvação eu te ajudei; e eu te guardarei, e te darei por pacto do povo, para restaurares a terra, para fazer tomar posse das propriedades assoladas;
verses.RVR09: Así dijo Jehová: En hora de contentamiento te oí, y en el día de salud te ayudé: y guardarte he, y te daré por alianza del pueblo, para que levantes la tierra, para que heredes asoladas heredades;

verses.KJV: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
verses.WEB: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.
verses.ASV: saying to them that are bound, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Show yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and on all bare heights shall be their pasture.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que tu digas aos presos: Saí; e aos que estão em trevas: Aparecei; eles se alimentarão nos caminhos, e em todos os lugares altos haverá pasto para eles.
verses.RVR09: Para que digas á los presos: Salid; y á los que están en tinieblas: Manifestaos. En los caminos serán apacentados, y en todas las cumbres serán sus pastos.

verses.KJV: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
verses.WEB: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.
verses.ASV: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them will lead them, even by springs of water will he guide them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca terão fome nem sede; nem o calor, nem o sol os afligirá; porque aquele que se compadece deles os guiará, e os levará mansamente a mananciais de águas.
verses.RVR09: No tendrán hambre ni sed, ni el calor ni el sol los afligirá; porque el que tiene de ellos misericordia los guiará, y los conducirá á manaderos de aguas.

verses.KJV: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.WEB: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.ASV: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei com que todos os meus montes se tornem um caminho; e minhas estradas serão levantadas.
verses.RVR09: Y tornaré camino todos mis montes, y mis calzadas serán levantadas.

verses.KJV: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
verses.WEB: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”
verses.ASV: Lo, these shall come from far; and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que estes virão de longe; e eis que alguns do norte, e do ocidente, e outros da terra de Sinim.
verses.RVR09: He aquí estos vendrán de lejos; y he aquí estotros del norte y del occidente, y estotros de la tierra de los Sineos.

verses.KJV: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the Lord hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
verses.WEB: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.
verses.ASV: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for Jehovah hath comforted his people, and will have compassion upon his afflicted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai de júbilo, ó céus, e alegra-te tu, ó terra; e vós montes, gritai de alegria; porque o SENHOR consolou a seu povo, e terá compaixão de seus aflitos.
verses.RVR09: Cantad alabanzas, oh cielos, y alégrate, tierra; y prorrumpid en alabanzas, oh montes: porque Jehová ha consolado su pueblo, y de sus pobres tendrá misericordia.

verses.KJV: But Zion said, The Lord hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
verses.WEB: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”
verses.ASV: But Zion said, Jehovah hath forsaken me, and the Lord hath forgotten me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas Sião diz: O SENHOR me desamparou; e o Senhor se esqueceu de mim.
verses.RVR09: Mas Sión dijo: Dejóme Jehová, y el Señor se olvidó de mí.

verses.KJV: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
verses.WEB: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
verses.ASV: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, these may forget, yet will not I forget thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pode, por acaso, uma mulher se esquecer do filho que ainda amamenta, de modo que não se compadeça do filho de seu próprio ventre? Ainda que elas se esquecessem, contudo, eu não me esquecerei de ti.
verses.RVR09: ¿Olvidaráse la mujer de lo que parió, para dejar de compadecerse del hijo de su vientre? Aunque se olviden ellas, yo no me olvidaré de ti.

verses.KJV: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
verses.ASV: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu te tenho escrito nas minhas palmas de ambas as mãos; teus muros estão continuamente perante mim.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que en las palmas te tengo esculpida: delante de mí están siempre tus muros.

verses.KJV: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
verses.WEB: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you.
verses.ASV: Thy children make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth from thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus filhos depressa virão; e teus destruidores e teus assoladores sairão de ti.
verses.RVR09: Tus edificadores vendrán aprisa; tus destruidores y tus asoladores saldrán de ti.

verses.KJV: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the Lord, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.
verses.WEB: Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says the LORD, “you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and dress yourself with them, like a bride.
verses.ASV: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith Jehovah, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all as with an ornament, and gird thyself with them, like a bride.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta teus olhos ao redor e olha; todos estes que se ajuntam vêm a ti; [tão certo como] eu vivo, diz o SENHOR, que de todos estes te vestirás, como de ornamento, e vestirás deles ao [teu] redor, como uma noiva.
verses.RVR09: Alza tus ojos alrededor, y mira: todos estos se han reunido, han venido á ti. Vivo yo, dice Jehová, que de todos, como de vestidura de honra, serás vestida; y de ellos serás ceñida como novia.

verses.KJV: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
verses.WEB: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.
verses.ASV: For, as for thy waste and thy desolate places, and thy land that hath been destroyed, surely now shalt thou be too strait for the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois [ainda que] teus desertos [sejam] lugares solitários, e tua terra [esteja] destruída, agora te verás apertada de moradores, e os que te consumiram se afastarão para longe de ti.
verses.RVR09: Porque tus asolamientos, y tus ruinas, y tu tierra desierta, ahora será angosta por la multitud de los moradores; y tus destruidores serán apartados lejos.

verses.KJV: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
verses.WEB: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’
verses.ASV: The children of thy bereavement shall yet say in thine ears, The place is too strait for me; give place to me that I may dwell.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até mesmo os filhos que nascerem depois de teres perdido os primeiros dirão aos teus ouvidos: Este lugar é muito apertado para mim! Dá-me espaço para que eu possa habitar.
verses.RVR09: Aun los hijos de tu orfandad dirán á tus oídos: Angosto es para mí este lugar; apártate por amor de mí, para que yo more.

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
verses.WEB: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought these up? Behold, I was left alone. Where were these?’”
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou say in thy heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have been bereaved of my children, and am solitary, an exile, and wandering to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where were they?
verses.ALMEIDA: E dirás em teu coração: Quem a estes me gerou? Pois eu estava sem filhos e solitária; quem, pois, [me] criou a estes? Eis que eu fui deixada sozinha; [e] estes, onde estavam?
verses.RVR09: Y dirás en tu corazón: ¿Quién me engendró estos? porque yo deshijada estaba y sola, peregrina y desterrada: ¿quién pues crió éstos? He aquí yo estaba dejada sola: éstos ¿dónde estaban?

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and lift up my banner to the peoples. They shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and set up my ensign to the peoples; and they shall bring thy sons in their bosom, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que levantarei minha mão às nações, e erguerei minha bandeira aos povos; então trarão teus filhos nos braços, e tuas filhas serão levadas sobre os ombros.
verses.RVR09: Así dijo el Señor Jehová: He aquí, yo alzaré mi mano á las gentes, y á los pueblos levantaré mi bandera; y traerán en brazos tus hijos, y tus hijas serán traídas en hombros.

verses.KJV: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
verses.WEB: Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; and those who wait for me won’t be disappointed.”
verses.ASV: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah; and they that wait for me shall not be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: E reis serão teus tutores, e suas princesas tuas amas; perante ti se inclinarão com o rosto em terra, e lamberão o pó de teus pés; e saberás que eu sou o SENHOR; aqueles que esperam por mim não serão envergonhados.
verses.RVR09: Y reyes serán tus ayos, y sus reinas tus amas de leche; el rostro inclinado á tierra te adorarán, y lamerán el polvo de tus pies: y conocerás que yo soy Jehová, que no se avergonzarán los que me esperan.

verses.KJV: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
verses.WEB: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?
verses.ASV: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pode, por acaso, se tirar a presa de um guerreiro, ou fazer escapar os presos capturados por um justo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Será quitada la presa al valiente? ó ¿libertaráse la cautividad legítima?

verses.KJV: But thus saith the Lord, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
verses.WEB: But the LORD says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children.
verses.ASV: But thus saith Jehovah, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered; for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém assim diz o SENHOR: Sim, os presos serão tirados do valente, e a presa do tirano escapará; porque eu brigarei com os que brigam contigo, e resgatarei teus filhos.
verses.RVR09: Así empero dice Jehová: Cierto, la cautividad será quitada al valiente, y la presa del robusto será librada; y tu pleito yo lo pleitearé, y yo salvaré á tus hijos.

verses.KJV: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.WEB: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”
verses.ASV: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I, Jehovah, am thy Saviour, and thy Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E darei de comer a teus opressores sua própria carne, e com seu próprio sangue se embriagarão, como com vinho; e todos saberão que eu sou o SENHOR teu Salvador, e teu Redentor, o Poderoso de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y á los que te despojaron haré comer sus carnes, y con su sangre serán embriagados como con mosto; y conocerá toda carne que yo Jehová soy Salvador tuyo, y Redentor tuyo, el Fuerte de Jacob.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, wherewith I have put her away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities were ye sold, and for your transgressions was your mother put away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Onde está a carta de divórcio de vossa mãe, com que eu a mandei embora? Ou a qual dos meus credores foi que eu vos vendi? Eis que por vossas maldades fostes vendidos, e por vossas transgressões vossa mãe foi expulsa.
verses.RVR09: ASÍ dijo Jehová: ¿Qué es de la carta de repudio de vuestra madre, con la cual yo la repudié? ¿ó quiénes son mis acreedores, á quienes os he yo vendido? He aquí que por vuestras maldades sois vendidos, y por vuestras rebeliones fué repudiada vuestra madre:

verses.KJV: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
verses.WEB: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.
verses.ASV: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stink, because there is no water, and die for thirst.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que razão quando eu vim ninguém apareceu? Chamei, e ninguém respondeu. Por acaso minha mão se encurtou tanto, que já não posso resgatar? Ou não há [mais] poder em mim para livrar? Eis que com minha repreensão faço secar o mar, torno os rios em deserto, até federem seus peixes por não haver água, e morrem de sede.
verses.RVR09: Porque vine, y nadie pareció; llamé, y nadie respondió. ¿Ha llegado á acortarse mi mano, para no redimir? ¿no hay en mí poder para librar? He aquí que con mi reprensión hago secar la mar; torno los ríos en desierto, hasta pudrirse sus peces, y morirse de sed por falta de agua.

verses.KJV: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.WEB: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”
verses.ASV: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu visto aos céus de negro, e ponho um saco como sua cobertura.
verses.RVR09: Visto de oscuridad los cielos, y torno como saco su cobertura.

verses.KJV: The Lord God hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.
verses.ASV: The Lord Jehovah hath given me the tongue of them that are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as they that are taught.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor DEUS me deu língua de instruídos, para que eu saiba falar no tempo devido uma [boa] palavra ao cansado; ele me desperta todas as manhãs, desperta o meu ouvido para que eu ouça como os instruídos.
verses.RVR09: El Señor Jehová me dió lengua de sabios, para saber hablar en sazón palabra al cansado; despertará de mañana, despertaráme de mañana oído, para que oiga como los sabios.

verses.KJV: The Lord God hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.
verses.ASV: The Lord Jehovah hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away backward.
verses.ALMEIDA: O Senhor DEUS abriu os meus ouvidos, e não sou rebelde; nem me viro para trás.
verses.RVR09: El Señor Jehová me abrió el oído, y yo no fuí rebelde, ni me torné atrás.

verses.KJV: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.WEB: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.
verses.ASV: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair; I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dei minhas costas aos que [me] feriam, e os lados do meu rosto aos que me arrancavam os pelos; não escondo minha face de humilhações e cuspidas;
verses.RVR09: Dí mi cuerpo á los heridores, y mis mejillas á los que me mesaban el cabello: no escondí mi rostro de las injurias y esputos.

verses.KJV: For the Lord God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verses.WEB: For the Lord GOD will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.
verses.ASV: For the Lord Jehovah will help me; therefore have I not been confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o Senhor DEUS me ajuda; portanto não me envergonho; por isso pus meu rosto como pedra muito dura; porque sei que não serei envergonhado.
verses.RVR09: Porque el Señor Jehová me ayudará; por tanto no me avergoncé: por eso puse mi rostro como un pedernal, y sé que no seré avergonzado.

verses.KJV: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.WEB: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.
verses.ASV: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand up together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perto está aquele que me justifica; quem se oporá a mim? Compareçamos juntos; quem é meu adversário? Venha até mim.
verses.RVR09: Cercano está de mí el que me justifica; ¿quién contenderá conmigo? juntémonos. ¿Quién es el adversario de mi causa? acérquese á mí.

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord God will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
verses.WEB: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.
verses.ASV: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? behold, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o Senhor DEUS me ajuda; quem é que [o que] me condenará? Eis que todos eles tal como vestidos se envelhecerão, [e] a traça os comerá.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que el Señor Jehová me ayudará; ¿quién hay que me condene? He aquí que todos ellos como ropa de vestir se envejecerán; los comerá polilla.

verses.KJV: Who is among you that feareth the Lord, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon his God.
verses.WEB: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in the LORD’s name, and rely on his God.
verses.ASV: Who is among you that feareth Jehovah, that obeyeth the voice of his servant? he that walketh in darkness, and hath no light, let him trust in the name of Jehovah, and rely upon his God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem há entre vós que tema ao SENHOR, [e] ouça a voz de seu servo? Aquele que andar em trevas, e não tiver luz nenhuma, confie no nome do SENHOR, e dependa de seu Deus.
