verses.ALMEIDA: Mas chegai-vos aqui, filhos da adivinha, descendência adúltera, e que cometeis pecados sexuais.
verses.RVR09: Mas vosotros llegaos acá, hijos de la agorera, generación de adúltero y de fornicaria.

verses.KJV: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood.
verses.WEB: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood,
verses.ASV: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and put out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
verses.ALMEIDA: De quem fazeis piadas de escárnio? Contra quem alargais a boca, e colocais a língua para fora? Por acaso não sois filhos da transgressão, [e] descendentes da falsidade?
verses.RVR09: ¿De quién os habéis mofado? ¿contra quién ensanchasteis la boca, y alargasteis la lengua? ¿No sois vosotros hijos rebeldes, simiente mentirosa,

verses.KJV: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
verses.WEB: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
verses.ASV: ye that inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; that slay the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Não sois] vós, que vos inflamais com os ídolos abaixo de toda árvore verde, [e] sacrificais os filhos nos vales, abaixo das fendas dos penhascos?
verses.RVR09: Que os enfervorizáis con los ídolos debajo de todo árbol umbroso, que sacrificáis los hijos en los valles, debajo de los peñascos?

verses.KJV: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.WEB: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?
verses.ASV: Among the smooth [stones] of the valley is thy portion; they, they are thy lot; even to them hast thou poured a drink-offering, thou hast offered an oblation. Shall I be appeased for these things?
verses.ALMEIDA: Nas pedras lisas dos ribeiros está tua parte; estas, estas são aquilo que te pertence; a estas também derramas ofertas de líquidos, [e] lhe apresenta ofertas. Por acaso ficaria eu contente com estas coisas?
verses.RVR09: En las pulimentadas piedras del valle está tu parte; ellas, ellas son tu suerte; y á ellas derramaste libación, y ofreciste presente. ¿No me tengo de vengar de estas cosas?

verses.KJV: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
verses.WEB: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
verses.ASV: Upon a high and lofty mountain hast thou set thy bed; thither also wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre altos e elevados montes pões tua cama; e a eles sobes para oferecer sacrifícios.
verses.RVR09: Sobre el monte alto y empinado pusiste tu cama: allí también subiste á hacer sacrificio.

verses.KJV: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
verses.WEB: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.
verses.ASV: And behind the doors and the posts hast thou set up thy memorial: for thou hast uncovered [thyself] to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them: thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E debaixo das portas e dos umbrais pões teus memoriais; porque a não a mim, mas a outros tu [te] descobres, e sobes, alargas tua cama, e fazes [pacto] com eles; amas a cama deles, a nudez que tu vês.
verses.RVR09: Y tras la puerta y el umbral pusiste tu recuerdo: porque á otro que á mí te descubriste, y subiste, y ensanchaste tu cama, é hiciste con ellos alianza: amaste su cama donde quiera que la veías.

verses.KJV: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
verses.WEB: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.
verses.ASV: And thou wentest to the king with oil, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thine ambassadors far off, and didst debase thyself even unto Sheol.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foste ao rei com óleo, e multiplicaste teus perfumes; e enviaste teus embaixadores para longe, e desceste até o Xeol.
verses.RVR09: Y fuiste al rey con ungüento, y multiplicaste tus perfumes, y enviaste tus embajadores lejos, y te abatiste hasta el profundo.

verses.KJV: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
verses.WEB: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.
verses.ASV: Thou wast wearied with the length of thy way; yet saidst thou not, It is in vain: thou didst find a quickening of thy strength; therefore thou wast not faint.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tua longa viagem te cansaste, [porém] não disseste: Não tenho mais esperança. Achaste força em tua mão, por isso não desanimaste.
verses.RVR09: En la multitud de tus caminos te cansaste, mas no dijiste: No hay remedio; hallaste la vida de tu mano, por tanto no te arrepentiste.

verses.KJV: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
verses.WEB: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?
verses.ASV: And of whom hast thou been afraid and in fear, that thou liest, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of long time, and thou fearest me not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas de quem tiveste receio e temeste? Por que mentiste, e não te lembraste de mim, nem pensaste em mim em teu coração? Por eu ter me calado desde muito tempo, [agora] não me temes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y de quién te asustaste y temiste, que has faltado á la fe, y no te has acordado de mí, ni te vino al pensamiento? ¿No he yo disimulado desde tiempos antiguos, y nunca me has temido?

verses.KJV: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
verses.WEB: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.
verses.ASV: I will declare thy righteousness; and as for thy works, they shall not profit thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu declararei abertamente a tua justiça, e tuas obras; mas elas não te trarão proveito.
verses.RVR09: Yo publicaré tu justicia y tus obras, que no te aprovecharán.

verses.KJV: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
verses.WEB: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”
verses.ASV: When thou criest, let them that thou hast gathered deliver thee; but the wind shall take them, a breath shall carry them all away: but he that taketh refuge in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando tu vieres a clamar, que os ídolos que juntaste te livrem; porém o vento levará a todos eles, e um sopro os arrebatará; mas aquele que confia em mim herdará a terra, e tomará posse do meu santo monte.
verses.RVR09: Cuando clamares, líbrente tus allegados; empero á todos ellos llevará el viento, un soplo los arrebatará; mas el que en mí espera, tendrá la tierra por heredad, y poseerá el monte de mi santidad.

verses.KJV: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
verses.WEB: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”
verses.ASV: And he will say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será dito: Aplanai! Aplanai! Preparai o caminho! Tirai os tropeços do caminho do meu povo!
verses.RVR09: Y dirá: Allanad, allanad; barred el camino, quitad los tropiezos del camino de mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.WEB: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
verses.ASV: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy: I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Alto e Sublime, que habita na eternidade, e cujo nome é santo: Na altura e no lugar santo habito; e também com o contrito e abatido espírito, para vivificar o espírito dos abatidos, e para vivificar o coração dos contritos.
verses.RVR09: Porque así dijo el Alto y Sublime, el que habita la eternidad, y cuyo nombre es el Santo: Yo habito en la altura y la santidad, y con el quebrantado y humilde de espíritu, para hacer vivir el espíritu de los humildes, y para vivificar el corazón de los quebrantados.

verses.KJV: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
verses.WEB: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.
verses.ASV: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls that I have made.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não brigarei para sempre, nem ficarei continuamente indignado; pois perderia todas as forças diante de mim o espírito, as almas que eu criei.
verses.RVR09: Porque no tengo de contender para siempre, ni para siempre me he de enojar: pues decaería ante mí el espíritu, y las almas que yo he criado.

verses.KJV: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
verses.WEB: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
verses.ASV: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him; I hid [my face] and was wroth; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pela maldade de sua cobiça eu me indignei, e o feri; eu me escondi, e me indignei; porém ele se rebelou seguindo o caminho de seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Por la iniquidad de su codicia me enojé y heríle, escondí mi rostro y ensañéme; y fué él rebelde por el camino de su corazón.

verses.KJV: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.WEB: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
verses.ASV: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho visto seus caminhos; porém eu o sararei, e o guiarei, e voltarei a dar consolo, a ele a os que por ele lamentam.
verses.RVR09: Visto he sus caminos, y le sanaré, y le pastorearé, y daréle consolaciones, á él y á sus enlutados.

verses.KJV: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the Lord; and I will heal him.
verses.WEB: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says the LORD; “and I will heal them.”
verses.ASV: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him that is far off and to him that is near, saith Jehovah; and I will heal him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu crio os frutos dos lábios; paz, paz para os que estão longe e para os que estão perto,diz o SENHOR, e eu os sararei.
verses.RVR09: Crío fruto de labios: Paz, paz al lejano y al cercano, dijo Jehová; y sanarélo.

verses.KJV: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.WEB: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.
verses.ASV: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it cannot rest, and its waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os perversos são como o mar bravo, que não pode se aquietar.
verses.RVR09: Mas los impíos son como la mar en tempestad, que no puede estarse quieta, y sus aguas arrojan cieno y lodo.

verses.KJV: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
verses.WEB: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
verses.ASV: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os perversos, (diz meu Deus), não tem paz.
verses.RVR09: No hay paz, dijo mi Dios, para los impíos.

verses.KJV: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.WEB: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.ASV: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and declare unto my people their transgression, and to the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Clama em alta voz, não te retenhas; levanta tua voz como trombeta; e anuncia a meu povo sua transgressão, e à casa de Jacó seus pecados.
verses.RVR09: CLAMA á voz en cuello, no te detengas; alza tu voz como trompeta, y anuncia á mi pueblo su rebelión, y á la casa de Jacob su pecado.

verses.KJV: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
verses.WEB: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.
verses.ASV: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways: as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments; they delight to draw near unto God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles me buscam diariamente, e tem prazer em conhecer os meus caminhos, como [se fossem] um povo que pratica justiça, e não abandona o juízo de seu Deus; perguntam-me pelos juízos de justiça, e tem prazer em se achegarem a Deus.
verses.RVR09: Que me buscan cada día, y quieren saber mis caminos, como gente que hubiese obrado justicia, y que no hubiese dejado el derecho de su Dios: pregúntanme derechos de justicia, y quieren acercarse á Dios.

verses.KJV: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
verses.WEB: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.
verses.ASV: Wherefore have we fasted, [say they], and thou seest not? [wherefore] have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find [your own] pleasure, and exact all your labors.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Eles dizem:] Por que nós jejuamos, e tu não dás atenção a isso? [Por que] afligimos nossas almas, e tu não o reconheces?Eis que nos dia em que jejuais, continuais a buscar [apenas] aquilo que vos agrada, e sobrecarregais todos os que trabalham para vós.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué, dicen, ayunamos, y no hiciste caso; humillamos nuestras almas, y no te diste por entendido? He aquí que en el día de vuestro ayuno halláis lo que queréis, y todos demandáis vuestras haciendas.

verses.KJV: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.WEB: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.ASV: Behold, ye fast for strife and contention, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye fast not this day so as to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que jejuais para brigas e discussões, e para dardes socos de maldade; não jejueis como [fazeis] hoje, para que vossa vossa voz seja ouvida no alto.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que para contiendas y debates ayunáis, y para herir con el puño inicuamente; no ayunéis como hoy, para que vuestra voz sea oída en lo alto.

verses.KJV: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the Lord?
verses.WEB: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
verses.ASV: Is such the fast that I have chosen? the day for a man to afflict his soul? Is it to bow down his head as a rush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Jehovah?
verses.ALMEIDA: Seria este o jejum que eu escolheria, que o homem um dia aflija sua alma, incline sua cabeça como o junco, e estenda debaixo [de si] saco e cinza? Chamarias tu a isto jejum e dia agradável ao SENHOR?
verses.RVR09: ¿Es tal el ayuno que yo escogí, que de día aflija el hombre su alma, que encorve su cabeza como junco, y haga cama de saco y de ceniza? ¿Llamaréis esto ayuno, y día agradable á Jehová?

verses.KJV: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verses.WEB: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?
verses.ASV: Is not this the fast that I have chosen: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the bands of the yoke, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não é este o jejum que eu escolheria: que soltes os nós de perversidade, que desfaças as amarras do jugo, e que libertes aos oprimidos, e quebres todo jugo?
verses.RVR09: ¿No es antes el ayuno que yo escogí, desatar las ligaduras de impiedad, deshacer los haces de opresión, y dejar ir libres á los quebrantados, y que rompáis todo yugo?

verses.KJV: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
verses.WEB: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?
verses.ASV: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não é [também] que repartas teu pão com o faminto, e aos pobres desamparados recolhas em casa, [e] vendo ao nu, que o cubras, e não te escondas de tua carne?
verses.RVR09: ¿No es que partas tu pan con el hambriento, y á los pobres errantes metas en casa; que cuando vieres al desnudo, lo cubras, y no te escondas de tu carne?

verses.KJV: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the Lord shall be thy reward.
verses.WEB: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and the LORD’s glory will be your rear guard.
verses.ASV: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thy healing shall spring forth speedily; and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of Jehovah shall be thy rearward.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Quando fizeres isto] , então tua luz surgirá como o amanhecer, e tua cura logo chegará; e tua justiça irá adiante de ti; a glória do SENHOR será tua retaguarda.
verses.RVR09: Entonces nacerá tu luz como el alba, y tu salud se dejará ver presto; é irá tu justicia delante de ti, y la gloria de Jehová será tu retaguardia.

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou call, and the Lord shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
verses.WEB: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou call, and Jehovah will answer; thou shalt cry, and he will say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking wickedly;
verses.ALMEIDA: Então clamarás, e o SENHOR [te] responderá; gritarás, e dirá: Eis-me aqui; se tirares do meio de ti o jugo, o estender de dedo, e o falar perversidade.
verses.RVR09: Entonces invocarás, y oirte ha Jehová; clamarás, y dirá él: Heme aquí. Si quitares de en medio de ti el yugo, el extender el dedo, y hablar vanidad;

verses.KJV: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noon day:
verses.WEB: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;
verses.ASV: and if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul: then shall thy light rise in darkness, and thine obscurity be as the noonday;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se abrires tua alma ao faminto, e fartares à alma afligida; então tua luz nascerá das trevas, e tua escuridão será como o meio-dia.
verses.RVR09: Y si derramares tu alma al hambriento, y saciares el alma afligida, en las tinieblas nacerá tu luz, y tu oscuridad será como el medio día;

verses.KJV: And the Lord shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.WEB: and the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
verses.ASV: and Jehovah will guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in dry places, and make strong thy bones; and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR te guiará continuamente, fartará a tua alma [mesmo] em grandes secas, e fortalecerá teus ossos; e tu serás como um jardim regado, como um manancial de águas, cujas águas nunca faltam.
verses.RVR09: Y Jehová te pastoreará siempre, y en las sequías hartará tu alma, y engordará tus huesos; y serás como huerta de riego, y como manadero de aguas, cuyas aguas nunca faltan.

verses.KJV: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verses.WEB: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings.
verses.ASV: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places; thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os que de ti [procederem] edificarão os lugares antes arruinados, e levantarás os fundamentos das gerações [passadas] ; e te chamarão reparador das coisas que se romperam, e restaurador das ruas para se morar.
verses.RVR09: Y edificarán los de ti los desiertos antiguos; los cimientos de generación y generación levantarás: y serás llamado reparador de portillos, restaurador de calzadas para habitar.

verses.KJV: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
verses.WEB: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, and the holy of the LORD honorable, and honor it, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words,
verses.ASV: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, [and] the holy of Jehovah honorable; and shalt honor it, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking [thine own] words:
verses.ALMEIDA: Se quanto ao sábado recusares fazer tua vontade no meu santo dia, e chamares ao sábado de agradável, santificado ao SENHOR, e glorioso, e tu o honrares, não seguindo teus caminhos, [nem] buscando tua própria vontade, falando [o que não se deve] ,
verses.RVR09: Si retrajeres del sábado tu pie, de hacer tu voluntad en mi día santo, y al sábado llamares delicias, santo, glorioso de Jehová; y lo venerares, no haciendo tus caminos, ni buscando tu voluntad, ni hablando tus palabras:

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the Lord; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.WEB: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.
verses.ASV: then shalt thou delight thyself in Jehovah; and I will make thee to ride upon the high places of the earth; and I will feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tu te agradarás no SENHOR, e te farei montar sobre as alturas da terra; e te darei sustento com a herança de teu pai Jacó; porque [assim] a boca do SENHOR falou.
verses.RVR09: Entonces te deleitarás en Jehová; y yo te haré subir sobre las alturas de la tierra, y te daré á comer la heredad de Jacob tu padre: porque la boca de Jehová lo ha hablado.

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.
verses.ASV: Behold, Jehovah’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que a mão do SENHOR não está encolhida, para que não possa salvar; nem seu ouvido surdo, para não poder ouvir.
verses.RVR09: HE aquí que no se ha acortado la mano de Jehová para salvar, ni hase agravado su oído para oir:

verses.KJV: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verses.WEB: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.
verses.ASV: but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, so that he will not hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém vossas perversidades fazem separação entre vós e vosso Deus; e vossos pecados encobrem o rosto dele de vós, para que não ouça.
verses.RVR09: Mas vuestras iniquidades han hecho división entre vosotros y vuestro Dios, y vuestros pecados han hecho ocultar su rostro de vosotros, para no oir.

verses.KJV: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
verses.WEB: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.
verses.ASV: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue muttereth wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque vossas mãos estão contaminadas de sangue, e vossos dedos de maldade; vossos lábios falam falsidade, vossa língua pronuncia perversidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque vuestras manos están contaminadas de sangre, y vuestros dedos de iniquidad; vuestros labios pronuncian mentira, habla maldad vuestra lengua.

verses.KJV: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.WEB: No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
verses.ASV: None sueth in righteousness, and none pleadeth in truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ninguém há que clame pela justiça, nem ninguém que defenda causa em juízo por meio da verdade; confiam naquilo que é inútil, e falam mentiras; são causadores de opressão, e geram injustiça;
verses.RVR09: No hay quien clame por la justicia, ni quien juzgue por la verdad: confían en vanidad, y hablan vanidades; conciben trabajo, y paren iniquidad.

verses.KJV: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
verses.WEB: They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.
verses.ASV: They hatch adders’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth; and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chocam ovos de serpente, e tecem teias de aranha; quem comer de seus ovos morrerá, e sairá uma cobra venenosa se forem pisados.
verses.RVR09: Ponen huevos de áspides, y tejen telas de arañas: el que comiere de sus huevos, morirá; y si lo apretaren, saldrá un basilisco.

verses.KJV: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.WEB: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.
verses.ASV: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas teias não servem para vestimentas, nem poderão se cobrir com suas obras; suas obras são obras de injustiça, e atos de violência há em suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Sus telas no servirán para vestir, ni de sus obras serán cubiertos: sus obras son obras de iniquidad, y obra de rapiña está en sus manos.

verses.KJV: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
verses.WEB: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.
verses.ASV: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their paths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus pés correm para o mal, e se apressam para derramarem sangue inocente; seus pensamentos são pensamentos de injustiça, destruição e ruína há em suas estradas.
verses.RVR09: Sus pies corren al mal, y se apresuran para derramar la sangre inocente; sus pensamientos, pensamientos de iniquidad, destrucción y quebrantamiento en sus caminos.

verses.KJV: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
verses.WEB: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.
verses.ASV: The way of peace they know not; and there is no justice in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein doth not know peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: O caminho da paz eles não conhecem, nem há justiça em seus percursos; entortam suas veredas para si mesmos; todo aquele que anda por elas não experimentará paz.
verses.RVR09: No conocieron camino de paz, ni hay derecho en sus caminos: sus veredas son torcidas; cualquiera que por ellas fuere, no conocerá paz.

verses.KJV: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
verses.WEB: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.
verses.ASV: Therefore is justice far from us, neither doth righteousness overtake us: we look for light, but, behold, darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso o juízo está longe de nós, nem a justiça nos alcança; esperamos luz , [porém] eis que há [somente] trevas; [esperamos] brilho, [porém] andamos às escuras.
verses.RVR09: Por esto se alejó de nosotros el juicio, y no nos alcanzó justicia: esperamos luz, y he aquí tinieblas; resplandores, y andamos en oscuridad.

verses.KJV: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noon day as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
verses.WEB: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.
verses.ASV: We grope for the wall like the blind; yea, we grope as they that have no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the twilight; among them that are lusty we are as dead men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apalpamos as paredes como cegos, e como se não tivéssemos olhos andamos apalpando; tropeçamos ao meio-dia como se fosse noite; entre os fortes estamos como mortos.
verses.RVR09: Palpamos la pared como ciegos, y andamos á tiento como sin ojos; tropezamos al medio día como de noche; estamos en oscuros lugares como muertos.

verses.KJV: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.WEB: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.ASV: We roar all like bears, and moan sore like doves: we look for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos nós bramamos como ursos, e continuamente gememos como pombas; esperamos pela justiça, e nada [acontece] ; [esperamos] pela salvação, [porem] ela está longe de nós.
verses.RVR09: Aullamos como osos todos nosotros, y gemimos lastimeramente como palomas: esperamos juicio, y no lo hay; salud, y alejóse de nosotros.

verses.KJV: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
verses.WEB: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
verses.ASV: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois nossas transgressões se multiplicaram diante de ti, e nossos pecados dão testemunho contra nós; pois nossas transgressões estão conosco, e conhecemos nossas perversidades,
verses.RVR09: Porque nuestras rebeliones se han multiplicado delante de ti, y nuestros pecados han atestiguado contra nosotros: porque con nosotros están nuestras iniquidades, y conocemos nuestros pecados:

verses.KJV: In transgressing and lying against the Lord, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.WEB: transgressing and denying the LORD, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.ASV: transgressing and denying Jehovah, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Tais como] : transgredir e mentir contra o SENHOR, e se desviar de seguir a nosso Deus; falar de opressão e rebelião, conceber e falar palavras de falsidade do coração.
verses.RVR09: El prevaricar y mentir contra Jehová, y tornar de en pos de nuestro Dios; el hablar calumnia y rebelión, concebir y proferir de corazón palabras de mentira.

verses.KJV: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
verses.WEB: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.
verses.ASV: And justice is turned away backward, and righteousness standeth afar off; for truth is fallen in the street, and uprightness cannot enter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso que o direito retrocedeu, e a justiça ficou de longe; pois a verdade tropeçou na praça, e a correta decisão não pode entrar.
verses.RVR09: Y el derecho se retiró, y la justicia se puso lejos: porque la verdad tropezó en la plaza, y la equidad no pudo venir.

verses.KJV: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
verses.WEB: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. The LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
verses.ASV: Yea, truth is lacking; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey. And Jehovah saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a verdade se perde, e quem se desvia do mal corre o risco de ser saqueado; e o SENHOR o viu, pareceu mal em seus olhos, por não haver justiça.
verses.RVR09: Y la verdad fué detenida; y el que se apartó del mal, fué puesto en presa: y viólo Jehová, y desagradó en sus ojos, porque pereció el derecho.

verses.KJV: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
verses.WEB: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.
verses.ASV: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his own arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it upheld him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vendo que ninguém havia, maravilhou-se de que não houvesse intercessor algum; por isso seu próprio braço lhe trouxe a salvação, e sua própria justiça o susteve.
verses.RVR09: Y vió que no había hombre, y maravillóse que no hubiera quien se interpusiese; y salvólo su brazo, y afirmóle su misma justicia.

verses.KJV: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloak.
verses.WEB: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.
verses.ASV: And he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele se vestu de justiça como uma armadura, e [pôs] o capacete da salvação em sua cabeça; e vestiu-se de roupas de vingança [como] vestimenta, e cobriu-se de selo como uma capa.
verses.RVR09: Pues de justicia se vistió como de loriga, con capacete de salud en su cabeza: y vistióse de vestido de venganza por vestidura, y cubrióse de celo como de manto,

verses.KJV: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
verses.WEB: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.
verses.ASV: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompense.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele [lhes] retribuirá conforme [suas] obras: furor a seus adversários, pagamento a seus inimigos; aos litorais ele pagará de volta.
verses.RVR09: Como para retribuir, como para retornar ira á sus enemigos, y dar el pago á sus adversarios: el pago dará á las islas.

verses.KJV: So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him.
verses.WEB: So they will fear the LORD’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the LORD’s breath drives.
verses.ASV: So shall they fear the name of Jehovah from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the breath of Jehovah driveth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então temerão o nome do SENHOR desde o ocidente, e sua glória desde o oriente; pois ele vem como uma correnteza impetuosa, empurrada pelo sopro do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y temerán desde el occidente el nombre de Jehová, y desde el nacimiento del sol su gloria: porque vendrá el enemigo como río, mas el espíritu de Jehová levantará bandera contra él.

verses.KJV: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And a Redeemer will come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E um Redentor virá a Sião, para aqueles que se arrependerem de [sua] transgressão em Jacó, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrá el Redentor á Sión, y á los que se volvieren de la iniquidad en Jacob, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the Lord; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.
verses.WEB: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”
verses.ASV: And as for me, this is my covenant with them, saith Jehovah: my Spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith Jehovah, from henceforth and for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto a mim, este é meu pacto com eles,diz o SENHOR; meu Espírito que está sobre ti, e minhas palavras que pus em tua boca, não se afastarão de tua boca nem da boca de teus descendentes, nem da boca dos descendentes de teus descendentes, diz o SENHOR, desde agora e para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y este será mi pacto con ellos, dijo Jehová: El espíritu mío que está sobre ti, y mis palabras que puse en tu boca, no faltarán de tu boca, ni de la boca de tu simiente, ni de la boca de la simiente de tu simiente, dijo Jehová, desde ahora y para siempre.

verses.KJV: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.
verses.WEB: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD’s glory has risen on you!
verses.ASV: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of Jehovah is risen upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te! Brilha! Porque já chegou a tua luz; e a glória do SENHOR já está raiando sobre ti.
verses.RVR09: LEVÁNTATE, resplandece; que ha venido tu lumbre, y la gloria de Jehová ha nacido sobre ti.

verses.KJV: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
verses.WEB: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.
verses.ASV: For, behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the peoples; but Jehovah will arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que as trevas cobrirão a terra, e a escuridão aos povos; porém sobre ti o SENHOR virá raiando, e sua glória será vista sobre ti.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí que tinieblas cubrirán la tierra, y oscuridad los pueblos: mas sobre ti nacerá Jehová, y sobre ti será vista su gloria.

verses.KJV: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
verses.WEB: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
verses.ASV: And nations shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as nações virão à tua luz, e os reis ao brilho que raiou a ti.
verses.RVR09: Y andarán las gentes á tu luz, y los reyes al resplandor de tu nacimiento.

verses.KJV: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
verses.WEB: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.
verses.ASV: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: they all gather themselves together, they come to thee; thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be carried in the arms.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta teus olhos ao redor, e vê; todos estes se ajuntaram, [e] vem a ti; teus filhos virão de longe, e tuas filhas serão criadas ao teu lado.
verses.RVR09: Alza tus ojos en derredor, y mira: todos estos se han juntado, vinieron á ti: tus hijos vendrán de lejos, y tus hijas sobre el lado serán criadas.

verses.KJV: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
verses.WEB: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.
verses.ASV: Then thou shalt see and be radiant, and thy heart shall thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be turned unto thee, the wealth of the nations shall come unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então verás, e te alegrarás; teu coração palpitará e se encherá de alegria, porque a abundância do mar a ti se voltará, as riquezas das nações a ti chegarão.
verses.RVR09: Entonces verás y resplandecerás; y se maravillará y ensanchará tu corazón, que se haya vuelto á ti la multitud de la mar, y la fortaleza de las gentes haya venido á ti.

verses.KJV: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the Lord.
verses.WEB: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of the LORD.
verses.ASV: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come; they shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall proclaim the praises of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Multidão de camelos te cobrirá; dromedários de Midiã e Efá, todos virão de Sabá; trarão ouro e incenso, e declararão louvores ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Multitud de camellos te cubrirá, dromedarios de Madián y de Epha; vendrán todos los de Seba; traerán oro é incienso, y publicarán alabanzas de Jehová.

verses.KJV: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
verses.WEB: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.
verses.ASV: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee; they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar; and I will glorify the house of my glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as ovelhas de Quedar se ajuntarão a ti; os carneiros de Nebaiote te servirão; com agrado subirão ao meu altar, e eu glorificarei a casa de minha glória.
verses.RVR09: Todo el ganado de Cedar será juntado para ti: carneros de Nebayoth te serán servidos: serán ofrecidos con agrado sobre mi altar, y glorificaré la casa de mi gloria.

verses.KJV: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.WEB: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.ASV: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem são estes que vêm voando como nuvens, e como pombas às suas janelas?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quiénes son estos que vuelan como nubes, y como palomas á sus ventanas?

verses.KJV: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the Lord thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
verses.WEB: Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has glorified you.
verses.ASV: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of Jehovah thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois as ilhas me esperarão, e primeiro os navios de Társis, para trazer teus filhos de longe, sua prata e seu ouro com eles; para o nome do SENHOR teu Deus, e para o Santo de Israel, porque ele te glorificou.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente á mí esperarán las islas, y las naves de Tarsis desde el principio, para traer tus hijos de lejos, su plata y su oro con ellos, al nombre de Jehová tu Dios, y al Santo de Israel, que te ha glorificado.

verses.KJV: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
verses.WEB: “Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.
verses.ASV: And foreigners shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favor have I had mercy on thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E filhos de estrangeiros edificarão teus muros, e seus reis te servirão; porque em minha ira eu te feri, porém em meu favor tive misericórdia de ti.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos de los extranjeros edificarán tus muros, y sus reyes te servirán; porque en mi ira te herí, mas en mi buena voluntad tendré de ti misericordia.

verses.KJV: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
verses.WEB: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.
verses.ASV: Thy gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tuas portas estarão continuamente abertas, nem de dia nem de noite se fecharão; para que tragam a ti as riquezas das nações, e seus reis [a ti] sejam trazidos.
verses.RVR09: Tus puertas estarán de continuo abiertas; no se cerrarán de día ni de noche; para que sea traída á ti fortaleza de gentes, y sus reyes conducidos.

verses.KJV: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.WEB: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.ASV: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a nação e reino que não te servirem perecerão; e tais nações serão assoladas por completo.
verses.RVR09: Porque la gente ó el reino que no te sirviere, perecerá; y del todo serán asoladas.

verses.KJV: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.WEB: “The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.ASV: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir-tree, the pine, and the box-tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.ALMEIDA: A glória do Líbano virá a ti, a faia, o pinheiro, e o cipreste juntamente, para ornamentarem o lugar do meu santuário, e glorificarei o lugar de meus pés.
verses.RVR09: La gloria del Líbano vendrá á ti, hayas, pinos, y bojes juntamente, para decorar el lugar de mi santuario; y yo honraré el lugar de mis pies.

verses.KJV: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee; The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.WEB: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you the LORD’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ASV: And the sons of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee The city of Jehovah, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também virão a ti inclinados os filhos dos que te oprimiram, e se prostrarão às pisadas de teus pés todos os que blasfemaram de ti; e te chamarão a cidade do SENHOR, a Sião do Santo de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán á ti humillados los hijos de los que te afligieron, y á las pisadas de tus pies se encorvarán todos los que te escarnecían, y llamarte han Ciudad de Jehová, Sión del Santo de Israel.

verses.KJV: Whereas thou has been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.WEB: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.ASV: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man passed through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez de abandonada e odiada, [de tal modo] que ninguém passava [por ti] ,eu farei de ti uma excelência eterna, alegria de geração após geração.
verses.RVR09: En lugar de que has sido desechada y aborrecida, y que no había quien por ti pasase, ponerte he en gloria perpetua, gozo de generación y generación.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.WEB: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the nations, and shalt suck the breast of kings; and thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, am thy Saviour, and thy Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.ALMEIDA: E mamarás o leite das nações, e mamarás os peitos dos reis; e saberás que eu sou o SENHOR, teu Salvador e teu Redentor, o Poderoso de Jacó.
verses.RVR09: Y mamarás la leche de las gentes, el pecho de los reyes mamarás; y conocerás que yo Jehová soy el Salvador tuyo, y Redentor tuyo, el Fuerte de Jacob.

verses.KJV: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
verses.WEB: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.
verses.ASV: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron. I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez de bronze trarei ouro, e em vez de ferro trarei prata, e em vez de madeira bronze, e em vez de pedras ferro; e farei pacíficos teus oficiais, e justos aqueles que cobram de ti.
verses.RVR09: En vez de cobre traeré oro, y por hierro plata, y por madera metal, y en lugar de piedras hierro; y pondré paz por tu tributo, y justicia por tus exactores.

verses.KJV: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
verses.WEB: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.
verses.ASV: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, desolation nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca mais se ouvirá falar de violência em tua terra; [nem] ruína, nem destruição dentro de tuas fronteiras; em vez disso, a teus muros chamarás Salvação, e a tuas portas Louvor.
verses.RVR09: Nunca más se oirá en tu tierra violencia, destrucción ni quebrantamiento en tus términos; mas á tus muros llamarás Salud, y á tus puertas Alabanza.

verses.KJV: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the Lord shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
verses.WEB: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
verses.ASV: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but Jehovah will be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca mais o sol te servirá para luz do dia, nem com [seu] brilho a lua te iluminará; mas o SENHOR será tua luz eterna, e teu Deus o teu ornamento.
verses.RVR09: El sol nunca más te servirá de luz para el día, ni el resplandor de la luna te alumbrará; sino que Jehová te será por luz perpetua, y el Dios tuyo por tu gloria.

verses.KJV: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
verses.WEB: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.
verses.ASV: Thy sun shall no more go down, neither shall thy moon withdraw itself; for Jehovah will be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca mais o teu sol irá se por, nem tua lua minguará; porque o SENHOR será tua luz eterna, e os dias de teu luto se acabarão.
verses.RVR09: No se pondrá jamás tu sol, ni menguará tu luna: porque te será Jehová por luz perpetua, y los días de tu luto serán acabados.

verses.KJV: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.WEB: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.ASV: Thy people also shall be all righteous; they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os de teu povo serão justos; para sempre terão posse da terra; serão renovo de minha plantação, obra de minhas mãos, para que eu seja glorificado.
verses.RVR09: Y tu pueblo, todos ellos serán justos, para siempre heredarán la tierra; renuevos de mi plantío, obra de mis manos, para glorificarme.

verses.KJV: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time.
verses.WEB: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will do this quickly in its time.”
verses.ASV: The little one shall become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation; I, Jehovah, will hasten it in its time.
verses.ALMEIDA: O menor será mil, e o de menor tamanho será um povo forte; eu, o SENHOR, o farei depressa em seu [devido] tempo.
verses.RVR09: El pequeño será por mil, el menor, por gente fuerte. Yo Jehová á su tiempo haré que esto sea presto.

verses.KJV: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,
verses.ASV: The Spirit of the Lord Jehovah is upon me; because Jehovah hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening [of the prison] to them that are bound;
verses.ALMEIDA: O Espírito do Senhor DEUS está sobre mim; pois o SENHOR me ungiu, para dar boas novas aos mansos; ele me enviou para sarar aos feridos de coração, para anunciar liberdade aos cativos, e libertação aos prisioneiros.
verses.RVR09: EL espíritu del Señor Jehová es sobre mí, porque me ungió Jehová; hame enviado á predicar buenas nuevas á los abatidos, á vendar á los quebrantados de corazón, á publicar libertad á los cautivos, y á los presos abertura de la cárcel;

verses.KJV: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
verses.WEB: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
verses.ASV: to proclaim the year of Jehovah’s favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para anunciar o ano do favor do SENHOR, e o dia da vingança de nosso Deus; para consolar todos os tristes.
verses.RVR09: A promulgar año de la buena voluntad de Jehová, y día de venganza del Dios nuestro; á consolar á todos los enlutados;

verses.KJV: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified.
verses.WEB: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.
verses.ASV: to appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Jehovah, that he may be glorified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para ordenar aos tristes de Sião, que lhes seja dado ornamento no lugar de cinza, óleo de alegria no lugar de tristeza, vestes de louvor no lugar de espírito angustiado; para que sejam chamados de carvalhos da justiça, plantação do SENHOR; para que ele seja glorificado.
verses.RVR09: A ordenar á Sión á los enlutados, para darles gloria en lugar de ceniza, óleo de gozo en lugar del luto, manto de alegría en lugar del espíritu angustiado; y serán llamados árboles de justicia, plantío de Jehová, para gloria suya.

verses.KJV: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.WEB: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.
verses.ASV: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificarão os lugares arruinados desde os tempos antigos, restaurarão os desde antes destruídos, e renovarão as cidades arruinadas, destruídas desde muitas gerações.
verses.RVR09: Y edificarán los desiertos antiguos, y levantarán los asolamientos primeros, y restaurarán las ciudades asoladas, los asolamientos de muchas generaciones.

verses.KJV: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.WEB: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.
verses.ASV: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and foreigners shall be your plowmen and your vine-dressers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estrangeiros apascentarão vossos rebanhos, e filhos de outras nações serão vossos lavradores e vossos trabalhadores nas vinhas.
verses.RVR09: Y estarán extranjeros, y apacentarán vuestras ovejas, y los extraños serán vuestros labradores y vuestros viñadores.

verses.KJV: But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
verses.WEB: But you will be called the LORD’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.
verses.ASV: But ye shall be named the priests of Jehovah; men shall call you the ministers of our God: ye shall eat the wealth of the nations, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém vós sereis chamados sacerdotes do SENHOR; chamarão a vós de trabalhadores a serviço de nosso Deus; comereis dos bens das nações, e da riqueza deles vós vos orgulhareis.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros seréis llamados sacerdotes de Jehová, ministros del Dios nuestro seréis dichos: comeréis las riquezas de las gentes, y con su gloria seréis sublimes.

verses.KJV: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.WEB: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.
verses.ASV: Instead of your shame [ye shall have] double; and instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess double; everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez de vossa vergonha, [tereis] porção dobrada; e [em vez] de humilhação, terão alegria sobre sua parte; pois em sua terra terão posse do dobro, [e] terão alegria eterna.
verses.RVR09: En lugar de vuestra doble confusión, y de vuestra deshonra, os alabarán en sus heredades; por lo cual en sus tierras poseerán doblado, y tendrán perpetuo gozo.

verses.KJV: For I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.WEB: “For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.ASV: For I, Jehovah, love justice, I hate robbery with iniquity; and I will give them their recompense in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu, o SENHOR, amo a justiça, e odeio o roubo com sacrifício de queima; e farei que sua obra seja em verdade, e farei um pacto eterno com eles.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo Jehová soy amador del derecho, aborrecedor del latrocinio para holocausto; por tanto afirmaré en verdad su obra, y haré con ellos pacto perpetuo.

verses.KJV: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.
verses.WEB: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which the LORD has blessed.”
verses.ASV: And their seed shall be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples; all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which Jehovah hath blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sua descendência será conhecida entre as nações, e seus descendentes em meio aos povos; todos quantos os virem, os reconhecerão, que são descendência abençoada pelo SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y la simiente de ellos será conocida entre las gentes, y sus renuevos en medio de los pueblos; todos los que los vieren, los conocerán, que son simiente bendita de Jehová.

verses.KJV: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
verses.WEB: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
verses.ASV: I will greatly rejoice in Jehovah, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with a garland, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu estou muito jubilante no SENHOR, minha alma se alegra em meu Deus; porque ele me vestiu de roupas de salvação; ele me cobriu com a capa da justiça, tal como o noivo [quando] se veste da roupa sacerdotal, e como a noiva se enfeita com suas joias.
verses.RVR09: En gran manera me gozaré en Jehová, mi alma se alegrará en mi Dios; porque me vistió de vestidos de salud, rodeóme de manto de justicia, como á novio me atavió, y como á novia compuesta de sus joyas.

verses.KJV: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.WEB: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
verses.ASV: For as the earth bringeth forth its bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord Jehovah will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque tal como a terra produz seus renovos, e como o jardim faz brotar o que nele se semeia, assim também o Senhor DEUS fará brotar justiça e louvor diante de todas as nações.
verses.RVR09: Porque como la tierra produce su renuevo, y como el huerto hace brotar su simiente, así el Señor Jehová hará brotar justicia y alabanza delante de todas las gentes.

verses.KJV: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
verses.WEB: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.
verses.ASV: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as brightness, and her salvation as a lamp that burneth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por Sião eu não me calarei, e por Jerusalém não me aquietarei, enquanto sua justiça não sair como um brilho, e sua salvação como uma tocha acesa.
verses.RVR09: POR amor de Sión no callaré, y por amor de Jerusalem no he de parar, hasta que salga como resplandor su justicia, y su salud se encienda como una antorcha.

verses.KJV: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.
verses.WEB: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORD’s mouth will name.
verses.ASV: And the nations shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory, and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of Jehovah shall name.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as nações verão tua justiça, e todos os reis [verão] tua glória; e te chamarão por um novo nome, que a boca do SENHOR determinará.
verses.RVR09: Entonces verán las gentes tu justicia, y todos los reyes tu gloria; y te será puesto un nombre nuevo, que la boca de Jehová nombrará.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
verses.WEB: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt also be a crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serás coroa de glória na mão do SENHOR, e diadema real na mão de teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y serás corona de gloria en la mano de Jehová, y diadema de reino en la mano del Dios tuyo.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the Lord delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
verses.WEB: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah; for Jehovah delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nunca mais te chamarão de abandonada, nem se referirão mais a tua terra como assolada; mas sim te chamarão de: “Nela Está Meu Prazer”, e à tua terra de “A Casada”, porque o SENHOR se agrade de ti, e tua terra se casará.
verses.RVR09: Nunca más te llamarán Desamparada, ni tu tierra se dirá más Asolamiento; sino que serás llamada Hephzibah, y tu tierra, Beulah; porque el amor de Jehová será en ti, y tu tierra será casada.

verses.KJV: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
verses.WEB: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
verses.ASV: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee; and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque [tal como] o rapaz se casa com a virgem, [assim também] teus filhos se casarão contigo; e [como] o noivo se alegra da noiva, [assim] o teu Deus se alegrará de ti.
verses.RVR09: Pues como el mancebo se casa con la virgen, se casarán contigo tus hijos; y como el gozo del esposo con la esposa, así se gozará contigo el Dios tuyo.

verses.KJV: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence,
verses.WEB: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on the LORD, take no rest,
verses.ASV: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem; they shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that are Jehovah’s remembrancers, take ye no rest,
verses.ALMEIDA: Jerusalém, obre os teus muros eu pus guardas, que o dia todo e a noite toda continuamente não se calarão; vós que fazeis menção do SENHOR, não haja silêncio em vós;
verses.RVR09: Sobre tus muros, oh Jerusalem, he puesto guardas; todo el día y toda la noche no callarán jamás. Los que os acordáis de Jehová, no ceséis,

verses.KJV: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.WEB: and give him no rest until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.ASV: and give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem deis descanso a ele, até que ele estabeleça, até que ele ponha a Jerusalém como louvor na terra.
