verses.RVR09: Ni le deis tregua, hasta que confirme, y hasta que ponga á Jerusalem en alabanza en la tierra.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
verses.WEB: The LORD has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy grain to be food for thine enemies; and foreigners shall not drink thy new wine, for which thou hast labored:
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR jurou por sua mão direita e pelo seu forte braço: Nunca mais darei teu trigo [como] comida a teus inimigos, nem estrangeiros beberão teu suco da uva em que trabalhaste.
verses.RVR09: Juró Jehová por su mano derecha, y por el brazo de su fortaleza: Que jamás daré tu trigo por comida á tus enemigos, ni beberán los extraños el vino que tú trabajaste:

verses.KJV: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the Lord; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
verses.WEB: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise the LORD. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”
verses.ASV: but they that have garnered it shall eat it, and praise Jehovah; and they that have gathered it shall drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sim aqueles que o ajuntarem o comerão, e louvarão ao SENHOR; e os que o colherem beberão nos pátios do meu santuário.
verses.RVR09: Mas los que lo allegaron lo comerán, y alabarán á Jehová; y los que lo cogieron, lo beberán en los atrios de mi santuario.

verses.KJV: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
verses.WEB: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.
verses.ASV: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up an ensign for the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Passai! Passai pelas portas! Preparai o caminho ao povo! Aplanai! Aplanai a estrada, limpai [-a] das pedras! Levantai uma bandeira aos povos!
verses.RVR09: Pasad, pasad por las puertas; barred el camino al pueblo; allanad, allanad la calzada, quitad las piedras, alzad pendón á los pueblos.

verses.KJV: Behold, the Lord hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”
verses.ASV: Behold, Jehovah hath proclaimed unto the end of the earth, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que o SENHOR fez ouvir até a extremidade da terra: Dizei à filha de Sião: eis que tua salvação está vindo; eis que [traz] sua recompensa consigo, e seu pagamento [vem] diante dele.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que Jehová hizo oir hasta lo último de la tierra: Decid á la hija de Sión: He aquí viene tu Salvador; he aquí su recompensa con él, y delante de él su obra.

verses.KJV: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.WEB: They will call them “The Holy People, The LORD’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.
verses.ASV: And they shall call them The holy people, The redeemed of Jehovah: and thou shalt be called Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os chamarão de povo santo, redimidos do SENHOR; e tu serás chamada “A Procurada, a Cidade Não Desemparada”.
verses.RVR09: Y llamarles han Pueblo Santo, Redimidos de Jehová; y á ti te llamarán Ciudad Buscada, no desamparada.

verses.KJV: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
verses.WEB: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”
verses.ASV: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, marching in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é este, que vem de Edom, de Bozra, com vestes salpicadas de vermelho, este ornado em sua vestimenta, que marcha com grande força? Eu, o que falo em justiça, poderoso para salvar.
verses.RVR09: ¿QUIÉN es éste que viene de Edom, de Bosra con vestidos bermejos? ¿éste hermoso en su vestido, que marcha en la grandeza de su poder? Yo, el que hablo en justicia, grande para salvar.

verses.KJV: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
verses.WEB: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?
verses.ASV: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winevat?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que tu estás de roupa vermelha, e tuas vestes como de alguém que pisa em uma prensa de uvas?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué es bermejo tu vestido, y tus ropas como del que ha pisado en lagar?

verses.KJV: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
verses.WEB: “I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath. Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.
verses.ASV: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the peoples there was no man with me: yea, I trod them in mine anger, and trampled them in my wrath; and their lifeblood is sprinkled upon my garments, and I have stained all my raiment.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sozinho pisei na prensa de uvas, e ninguém dos povos houve comigo; e os pisei em minha ira, e os esmaguei em meu furor; e o sangue deles salpicou sobre minhas roupas, e sujei toda a minha roupa.
verses.RVR09: Pisado he yo solo el lagar, y de los pueblos nadie fué conmigo: pisélos con mi ira, y hollélos con mi furor; y su sangre salpicó mis vestidos, y ensucié todas mis ropas.

verses.KJV: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
verses.WEB: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.
verses.ASV: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o dia da vingança estava em meu coração; e o ano de meus redimidos havia chegado.
verses.RVR09: Porque el día de la venganza está en mi corazón, y el año de mis redimidos es venido.

verses.KJV: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
verses.WEB: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.
verses.ASV: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my wrath, it upheld me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E olhei, e não havia quem [me] ajudasse; e me espantei de que não houvesse quem [me] apoiasse; por isso meu braço me trouxe a salvação, e meu furor me apoiou.
verses.RVR09: Y miré y no había quien ayudara, y maravilléme que no hubiera quien sustentase: y salvóme mi brazo, y sostúvome mi ira.

verses.KJV: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
verses.WEB: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”
verses.ASV: And I trod down the peoples in mine anger, and made them drunk in my wrath, and I poured out their lifeblood on the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E atropelei os povos em minha ira, e os embebedei em meu furor; e fiz descer o sangue deles até a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y con mi ira hollé los pueblos, y embriaguélos de mi furor, y derribé á tierra su fortaleza.

verses.KJV: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the Lord, and the praises of the Lord, according to all that the Lord hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.WEB: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
verses.ASV: I will make mention of the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah, [and] the praises of Jehovah, according to all that Jehovah hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farei menção das bondades do SENHOR, [e] dos louvores ao SENHOR, conforme tudo quanto o SENHOR fez para nós; e do grande bem à casa de Israel, que ele tem lhes concedido segundo suas misericórdias, e segundo a abundância de suas bondades;
verses.RVR09: De las misericordias de Jehová haré memoria, de las alabanzas de Jehová, conforme á todo lo que Jehová nos ha dado, y de la grandeza de su beneficencia hacia la casa de Israel, que les ha hecho según sus misericordias, y según la multitud de sus miseraciones.

verses.KJV: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
verses.WEB: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.
verses.ASV: For he said, Surely, they are my people, children that will not deal falsely: so he was their Saviour.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois ele dizia: Certamente eles são meu povo, são filhos que não mentirão; assim ele se tornou o Salvador deles.
verses.RVR09: Porque dijo: Ciertamente mi pueblo son, hijos que no mienten; y fué su Salvador.

verses.KJV: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
verses.WEB: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.
verses.ASV: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em toda a angústia deles, ele [também] se angustiou, e o anjo de sua presença os salvou; por seu amor e por sua piedade ele os redimiu; e os tomou, e os carregou [em] todos os dias antigos.
verses.RVR09: En toda angustia de ellos él fué angustiado, y el ángel de su faz los salvó: en su amor y en su clemencia los redimió, y los trajo, y los levantó todos los días del siglo.

verses.KJV: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
verses.WEB: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.
verses.ASV: But they rebelled, and grieved his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, [and] himself fought against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles foram rebeldes, e entristeceram seu Espírito Santo; por isso ele se tornou inimigo deles, [e] ele mesmo lutou contra eles.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos fueron rebeldes, é hicieron enojar su espíritu santo; por lo cual se les volvió enemigo, y él mismo peleó contra ellos.

verses.KJV: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
verses.WEB: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”
verses.ASV: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses [and] his people, [saying], Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit in the midst of them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo ele se lembrou dos dias antigos, de Moisés, [e] de seu povo. Onde está aquele que os fez subir do mar com os pastores de seu rebanho? Onde está aquele que punha no meio deles seu Espírito Santo?
verses.RVR09: Empero acordóse de los días antiguos, de Moisés y de su pueblo, diciendo: ¿Dónde está el que les hizo subir de la mar con el pastor de su rebaño? ¿dónde el que puso en medio de él su espíritu santo?

verses.KJV: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
verses.WEB: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
verses.ASV: that caused his glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses? that divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
verses.ALMEIDA: [Onde está] aquele que fez seu glorioso braço andar à direita de Moisés, que dividiu as águas perante a presença deles, para fazer seu nome eterno;
verses.RVR09: ¿El que los guió por la diestra de Moisés con el brazo de su gloria; el que rompió las aguas delante de ellos, haciéndose así nombre perpetuo?

verses.KJV: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
verses.WEB: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?
verses.ASV: that led them through the depths, as a horse in the wilderness, so that they stumbled not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que os guiou pelos abismos como cavalo no deserto, [de tal modo que] nunca tropeçaram?
verses.RVR09: ¿El que los condujo por los abismos, como un caballo por el desierto, sin que tropezaran?

verses.KJV: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the Lord caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
verses.WEB: As the livestock that go down into the valley, the LORD’s Spirit caused them to rest. So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name.
verses.ASV: As the cattle that go down into the valley, the Spirit of Jehovah caused them to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como um animal que desce aos vales, o Espírito do SENHOR lhes deu descanso; assim guiaste a teu povo, para fazeres teu nome ser glorioso.
verses.RVR09: El espíritu de Jehová los pastoreó, como á una bestia que desciende al valle; así pastoreaste tu pueblo, para hacerte nombre glorioso.

verses.KJV: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
verses.WEB: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.
verses.ASV: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where are thy zeal and thy mighty acts? the yearning of thy heart and thy compassions are restrained toward me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha desde os céus, e vê desde tua santa e gloriosa habitação; onde está teu zelo e tuas forças? A comoção dos sentimentos de teu interior e de tuas misericórdias se retiveram para comigo.
verses.RVR09: Mira desde el cielo, y contempla desde la morada de tu santidad y de tu gloria: ¿dónde está tu celo, y tu fortaleza, la conmoción de tus entrañas y de tus miseraciones para conmigo? ¿hanse estrechado?

verses.KJV: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O Lord, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
verses.WEB: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, LORD, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.
verses.ASV: For thou art our Father, though Abraham knoweth us not, and Israel doth not acknowledge us: thou, O Jehovah, art our Father; our Redeemer from everlasting is thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu és nosso Pai, porque Abraão não sabe de nós, nem Israel nos conhece. Tu, SENHOR, és nosso Pai; desde os tempos antigos o teu nome é Nosso Redentor.
verses.RVR09: Tú empero eres nuestro padre, si bien Abraham nos ignora, é Israel no nos conoce: tú, oh Jehová, eres nuestro padre; nuestro Redentor perpetuo es tu nombre.

verses.KJV: O Lord, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
verses.WEB: O LORD, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, why dost thou make us to err from thy ways, and hardenest our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants’ sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que, ó SENHOR, tu nos fazes andar fora de teus caminhos? Por que endureces nosso coração para que não tenhamos temor a ti? Volta, por favor a teus servos, às tribos de tua herança.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué, oh Jehová, nos has hecho errar de tus caminos, y endureciste nuestro corazón á tu temor? Vuélvete por amor de tus siervos, por las tribus de tu heredad.

verses.KJV: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
verses.WEB: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
verses.ASV: Thy holy people possessed [it] but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por um pouco de tempo teu santo povo [a] possuiu; nossos adversários pisaram teu santuário.
verses.RVR09: Por poco tiempo lo poseyó el pueblo de tu santidad: nuestros enemigos han hollado tu santuario.

verses.KJV: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
verses.WEB: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.
verses.ASV: We are become as they over whom thou never barest rule, as they that were not called by thy name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós nos tornamos [como aqueles] de quem nunca dominaste, [semelhantes] aos que nunca foram chamados pelo teu nome.
verses.RVR09: Hemos venido á ser como aquellos de quienes nunca te enseñoreaste, sobre los cuales nunca fué llamado tu nombre.

verses.KJV: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
verses.WEB: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—
verses.ASV: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might quake at thy presence,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, se tu rompesses os céus, [e] descesses, os montes se tremeriam de diante de tua presença,
verses.RVR09: ¡OH si rompieses los cielos, y descendieras, y á tu presencia se escurriesen los montes,

verses.KJV: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
verses.WEB: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
verses.ASV: as when fire kindleth the brushwood, [and] the fire causeth the waters to boil; to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como o fogo acende a madeira, [e] o fogo faz ferver as águas; para [assim] fazeres notório o teu nome a teus adversários, [de modo que] as nações tremessem de tua presença!
verses.RVR09: Como fuego abrasador de fundiciones, fuego que hace hervir las aguas, para que hicieras notorio tu nombre á tus enemigos, y las gentes temblasen á tu presencia!

verses.KJV: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
verses.WEB: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
verses.ASV: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains quaked at thy presence.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] quando fazias coisas temíveis, as quais nunca esperávamos; quando tu descias, [e] os montes se tremiam diante de tua presença.
verses.RVR09: Cuando, haciendo terriblezas cuales nunca esperábamos, descendiste, fluyeron los montes delante de ti.

verses.KJV: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
verses.WEB: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.
verses.ASV: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen a God besides thee, who worketh for him that waiteth for him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem desde os tempos antigos se ouviu, nem com os ouvidos se percebeu, nem olho viu outro Deus além de ti, que age [em favor] daquele que nele espera.
verses.RVR09: Ni nunca oyeron, ni oídos percibieron, ni ojo ha visto Dios fuera de ti, que hiciese por el que en él espera.

verses.KJV: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
verses.WEB: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?
verses.ASV: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou wast wroth, and we sinned: in them [have we been] of long time; and shall we be saved?
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu foste ao encontro do alegre, e do que pratica justiça, [e] aos que se lembram de ti em teus caminhos. Eis que te enfureceste porque pecamos por muito tempo. Seremos salvos?
verses.RVR09: Saliste al encuentro al que con alegría obraba justicia, á los que se acordaban de ti en tus caminos: he aquí, tú te enojaste porque pecamos; en esos hay perpetuidad, y seremos salvos.

verses.KJV: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
verses.WEB: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
verses.ASV: For we are all become as one that is unclean, and all our righteousnesses are as a polluted garment: and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém todos nós somos como um imundo, e todas as nossas justiças são como roupas contaminadas; e todos nós caímos como uma folha, e nossas culpas nos levam como o vento.
verses.RVR09: Si bien todos nosotros somos como suciedad, y todas nuestras justicias como trapo de inmundicia; y caímos todos nosotros como la hoja, y nuestras maldades nos llevaron como viento.

verses.KJV: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
verses.WEB: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.
verses.ASV: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee; for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us by means of our iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ninguém há que invoque a teu nome, que se desperte para se apegar a ti; pois tu escondeste teu rosto de nós, e nos consumiste por nossas perversidades.
verses.RVR09: Y nadie hay que invoque tu nombre, que se despierte para tenerte; por lo cual escondiste de nosotros tu rostro, y nos dejaste marchitar en poder de nuestras maldades.

verses.KJV: But now, O Lord, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
verses.WEB: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
verses.ASV: But now, O Jehovah, thou art our Father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém agora, SENHOR, tu és nosso Pai; nós somos barro, e tu és nosso oleiro; e todos nós somos obra de tuas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, Jehová, tú eres nuestro padre; nosotros lodo, y tú el que nos formaste; así que obra de tus manos, todos nosotros.

verses.KJV: Be not wroth very sore, O Lord, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
verses.WEB: Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.
verses.ASV: Be not wroth very sore, O Jehovah, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, look, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não te enfureças tanto, SENHOR, nem te lembres da [nossa] perversidade para sempre; vê, olha agora, [que] todos nós somos teu povo.
verses.RVR09: No te aires, oh Jehová, sobremanera, ni tengas perpetua memoria de la iniquidad: he aquí mira ahora, pueblo tuyo somos todos nosotros.

verses.KJV: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.WEB: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.ASV: Thy holy cities are become a wilderness, Zion is become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tuas santas cidades se tornaram um deserto; Sião se tornou um deserto; Jerusalém está assolada.
verses.RVR09: Tus santas ciudades están desiertas, Sión es un desierto, Jerusalem una soledad.

verses.KJV: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.WEB: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.
verses.ASV: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned with fire; and all our pleasant places are laid waste.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossa santa e nossa gloriosa casa, em que nossos pais te louvavam, foi queimada a fogo; e todas as coisas com que nos agradávamos se tornaram ruínas.
verses.RVR09: La casa de nuestro santuario y de nuestra gloria, en la cual te alabaron nuestros padres, fué consumida al fuego; y todas nuestras cosas preciosas han sido destruídas.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Lord? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.WEB: Will you hold yourself back for these things, LORD? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?
verses.ASV: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Jehovah? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.ALMEIDA: Será que continuarás a te conter sobre estas coisas, SENHOR? Continuarás quieto, e nos oprimindo tanto?
verses.RVR09: ¿Te estarás quieto, oh Jehová, sobre estas cosas? ¿callarás, y nos afligirás sobremanera?

verses.KJV: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
verses.WEB: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.
verses.ASV: I am inquired of by them that asked not [for me]; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fui buscado por aqueles que não perguntavam [por mim] ; fui achado por aqueles que não me buscavam; a uma nação que não se chamava pelo meu nome eu disse: Eis-me aqui! Eis-me aqui!
verses.RVR09: FUÍ buscado de los que no preguntaban por mi; fuí hallado de los que no me buscaban. Dije á gente que no invocaba mi nombre: Heme aquí, heme aquí.

verses.KJV: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.WEB: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.ASV: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, that walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.ALMEIDA: Estendi minhas mãos o dia todo a um povo rebelde, que anda por um caminho que não é bom, seguindo seus próprios pensamentos.
verses.RVR09: Extendí mis manos todo el día á pueblo rebelde, el cual anda por camino no bueno, en pos de sus pensamientos;

verses.KJV: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
verses.WEB: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;
verses.ASV: a people that provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense upon bricks;
verses.ALMEIDA: Povo que me irrita perante mim continuamente, sacrificando em jardins, e queimando incenso sobre tijolos,
verses.RVR09: Pueblo que en mi cara me provoca de continuo á ira, sacrificando en huertos, y ofreciendo perfume sobre ladrillos;

verses.KJV: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.WEB: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig’s meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.ASV: that sit among the graves, and lodge in the secret places; that eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.ALMEIDA: Sentando-se junto às sepulturas, e passando as noites em lugares secretos; comendo carne de porco, e [tendo] caldo de coisas abomináveis em suas vasilhas.
verses.RVR09: Que se quedan en los sepulcros, y en los desiertos tienen la noche; que comen carne de puerco, y en sus ollas hay caldo de cosas inmundas;

verses.KJV: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
verses.WEB: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.
verses.ASV: that say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me, for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dizem: Fica onde estás, e não te aproximes de de mim; pois sou mais santo do que tu; Estes são fumaça em minhas narinas, e fogo que arde o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Que dicen: Estáte en tu lugar, no te llegues á mí, que soy más santo que tú: éstos son humo en mi furor, fuego que arde todo el día.

verses.KJV: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
verses.WEB: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom
verses.ASV: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, yea, I will recompense into their bosom,
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que está escrito diante de mim: Não me calarei; mas eu pagarei, e lhes pagarei diretamente e por completo,
verses.RVR09: He aquí que escrito está delante de mí; no callaré, antes retornaré, y daré el pago en su seno,

verses.KJV: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the Lord, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
verses.WEB: your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says the LORD, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”
verses.ASV: your own iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith Jehovah, that have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I first measure their work into their bosom.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Por] vossas perversidades e juntamente [pelas] perversidades de vossos pais,diz o SENHOR, que com incensos perfumaram nos montes, e me provocaram nos morros; por isso eu lhes medirei de volta por completo o pagamento de suas obras anteriores.
verses.RVR09: Por vuestras iniquidades, y las iniquidades de vuestros padres juntamente, dice Jehová, los cuales hicieron perfume sobre los montes, y sobre los collados me afrentaron: por tanto yo les mediré su obra antigua en su seno.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not, for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Tal como quando se acha suco num cacho de uvas, dizem: Não o desperdices, pois há proveito nele; assim eu farei por meus servos; não destruirei a todos.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Como si alguno hallase mosto en un racimo, y dijese: No lo desperdicies, que bendición hay en él; así haré yo por mis siervos, que no lo destruiré todo.

verses.KJV: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
verses.WEB: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.
verses.ASV: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains; and my chosen shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas produzirei descendência de Jacó, e de Judá um herdeiro, que seja dono de meus montes; e meus escolhidos tomarão posse [da terra] ,e meus servos ali habitarão.
verses.RVR09: Mas sacaré simiente de Jacob, y de Judá heredero de mis montes; y mis escogidos poseerán por heredad la tierra, y mis siervos habitarán allí.

verses.KJV: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
verses.WEB: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.
verses.ASV: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Sarom servirá de pasto de ovelhas, e o vale de Acor como lugar de repouso de gado, para o meu povo, que me buscou.
verses.RVR09: Y será Sarón para habitación de ovejas, y el valle de Achôr para majada de vacas, á mi pueblo que me buscó.

verses.KJV: But ye are they that forsake the Lord, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
verses.WEB: “But you who forsake the LORD, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;
verses.ASV: But ye that forsake Jehovah, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for Fortune, and that fill up mingled wine unto Destiny;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a vós, que vos afastais do SENHOR, vós que esqueceis do meu santo monte, que preparais mesa para [o ídolo da] sorte, e que misturais bebida para [o ídolo do] destino;
verses.RVR09: Empero vosotros los que dejáis á Jehová, que olvidáis el monte de mi santidad, que ponéis mesa para la Fortuna, y suministráis libaciones para el Destino;

verses.KJV: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
verses.WEB: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”
verses.ASV: I will destine you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but ye did that which was evil in mine eyes, and chose that wherein I delighted not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos destinarei à espada, e todos vós encurvareis à matança; pois eu chamei, e vós não respondestes; falei, e não ouvistes; mas fizestes o que era mal aos meus olhos, e escolhestes aquilo de que não me agrado.
verses.RVR09: Yo también os destinaré al cuchillo, y todos vosotros os arrodillaréis al degolladero: por cuanto llamé, y no respondisteis; hablé, y no oisteis; sino que hicisteis lo malo delante de mis ojos, y escogisteis lo que á mí desagrada.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry; behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty; behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be put to shame;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que meus servos comerão, porém vós passareis fome; eis que meus servos beberão, porém vós tereis sede; eis que meus servos se alegrarão, porém vós vos envergonhareis.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto así dijo el Señor Jehová: He aquí que mis siervos comerán, y vosotros tendréis hambre; he aquí que mis siervos beberán, y vosotros tendréis sed; he aquí que mis siervos se alegrarán, y vosotros seréis avergonzados;

verses.KJV: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
verses.WEB: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.
verses.ASV: behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall wail for vexation of spirit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que meus servos cantarão de coração contente, porém vós gritareis de tristeza do coração; e uivareis pela angústia de espírito.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que mis siervos cantarán por júbilo del corazón, y vosotros clamaréis por el dolor del corazón, y por el quebrantamiento de espíritu aullaréis.

verses.KJV: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
verses.WEB: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord GOD will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,
verses.ASV: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen; and the Lord Jehovah will slay thee; and he will call his servants by another name:
verses.ALMEIDA: E deixarei vosso nome a meus eleitos como maldição; e o Senhor DEUS te matará; porém ele chamará aos seus servos por outro nome.
verses.RVR09: Y dejaréis vuestro nombre por maldición á mis escogidos, y el Señor Jehová te matará; y á sus siervos llamará por otro nombre.

verses.KJV: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
verses.WEB: so that he who blesses himself in the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears in the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.
verses.ASV: so that he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem se bendisser na terra, se bendirá no Deus da verdade; e quem jurar na terra, jurará pelo Deus da verdade; porque serão esquecidas as angústias passadas, e porque elas estarão encobertas de diante de meus olhos.
verses.RVR09: El que se bendijere en la tierra, en el Dios de verdad se bendecirá; y el que jurare en la tierra, por el Dios de verdad jurará; porque las angustias primeras serán olvidadas, y serán cubiertas de mis ojos.

verses.KJV: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.WEB: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.ASV: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que eu crio novos céus e nova terra; e não haverá[mais ] lembrança das coisas passadas, nem mais virão à mente.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí que yo crío nuevos cielos y nueva tierra: y de lo primero no habrá memoria, ni más vendrá al pensamiento.

verses.KJV: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
verses.WEB: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.
verses.ASV: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém vós ficai contentes e alegrai-vos para sempre [naquilo] que eu crio; porque eis que crio a Jerusalém uma alegria, e a seu povo um contentamento.
verses.RVR09: Mas os gozaréis y os alegraréis por siglo de siglo en las cosas que yo crío: porque he aquí que yo crío á Jerusalem alegría, y á su pueblo gozo.

verses.KJV: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
verses.WEB: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.
verses.ASV: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people; and there shall be heard in her no more the voice of weeping and the voice of crying.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me alegrarei de Jerusalém, e estarei muito contente com meu povo; e nunca mais se ouvirá nela voz de choro, nem voz de clamor.
verses.RVR09: Y alegraréme con Jerusalem, y gozaréme con mi pueblo; y nunca más se oirán en ella voz de lloro, ni voz de clamor.

verses.KJV: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.WEB: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.
verses.ASV: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days; for the child shall die a hundred years old, and the sinner being a hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não haverá mais ali bebês de [poucos] dias, nem velho que não cumpra seus dias; porque o jovem morrerá aos cem anos, porém o pecador de cem anos de idade será amaldiçoado.
verses.RVR09: No habrá más allí niño de días, ni viejo que sus días no cumpla: porque el niño morirá de cien años, y el pecador de cien años, será maldito.

verses.KJV: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.WEB: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.ASV: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificarão casas, e [as] habitarão; e plantarão vinhas, e comerão o fruto delas.
verses.RVR09: Y edificarán casas, y morarán en ellas; plantarán viñas, y comerán el fruto de ellas.

verses.KJV: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.WEB: They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.ASV: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree shall be the days of my people, and my chosen shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles não edificarão para que outros habitem, nem plantarão para que outros comam; porque os dias de meu povo serão como os dias das árvores, e meus escolhidos usarão das obras de suas mãos até a velhice.
verses.RVR09: No edificarán, y otro morará; no plantarán, y otro comerá: porque según los días de los árboles serán los días de mi pueblo, y mis escogidos perpetuarán las obras de sus manos.

verses.KJV: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them.
verses.WEB: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of the LORD’s blessed and their descendants with them.
verses.ASV: They shall not labor in vain, nor bring forth for calamity; for they are the seed of the blessed of Jehovah, and their offspring with them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não trabalharão em vão, nem terão filhos para a aflição; porque são a semente dos benditos do SENHOR, e seus descendentes com eles.
verses.RVR09: No trabajarán en vano, ni parirán para maldición; porque son simiente de los benditos de Jehová, y sus descendientes con ellos.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.WEB: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass that, before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, antes que clamem, eu responderei; enquanto ainda estiverem falando, eu ouvirei.
verses.RVR09: Y será que antes que clamen, responderé yo; aun estando ellos hablando, yo habré oído.

verses.KJV: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the ox; and dust shall be the serpent’s food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O lobo e o cordeiro ambos se alimentarão juntos, e o leão comerá palha como o boi, e pó será a comida da serpente; nenhum mal nem dano farão em todo o meu santo monte,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El lobo y el cordero serán apacentados juntos, y el león comerá paja como el buey; y á la serpiente el polvo será su comida. No afligirán, ni harán mal en todo mi santo monte, dijo Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: what manner of house will ye build unto me? and what place shall be my rest?
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Os céus são meu trono, e a terra o escabelo dos meus pés. Qual seria a casa que vós edificaríeis para mim? E qual seria o lugar de meu descanso?
verses.RVR09: JEHOVÁ dijo así: El cielo es mi solio, y la tierra estrado de mis pies: ¿dónde está la casa que me habréis de edificar, y dónde este lugar de mi reposo?

verses.KJV: For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith the Lord: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
verses.WEB: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says the LORD: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.
verses.ASV: For all these things hath my hand made, and [so] all these things came to be, saith Jehovah: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and that trembleth at my word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois minha mão fez todas estas coisas, e todas estas coisas passaram a existir,diz o SENHOR; mas para tal eu olharei: aquele que é pobre e abatido de espírito, e treme por minha palavra.
verses.RVR09: Mi mano hizo todas estas cosas, y así todas estas cosas fueron, dice Jehová: mas á aquél miraré que es pobre y humilde de espíritu, y que tiembla á mi palabra.

verses.KJV: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.
verses.WEB: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.
verses.ASV: He that killeth an ox is as he that slayeth a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as he that breaketh a dog’s neck; he that offereth an oblation, [as he that offereth] swine’s blood; he that burneth frankincense, as he that blesseth an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations:
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem mata boi fere de morte a um homem; quem sacrifica cordeiro degola a um cão; quem apresenta oferta, [oferece] sangue de proco; quem oferece incenso adora a um ídolo; também estes escolhem seus [próprios] caminhos, e sua alma tem prazer em suas abominações.
verses.RVR09: El que sacrifica buey, como si matase un hombre; el que sacrifica oveja, como si degollase un perro; el que ofrece presente, como si ofreciese sangre de puerco; el que ofrece perfume, como si bendijese á un ídolo. Y pues escogieron sus caminos, y su alma amó sus abominaciones,

verses.KJV: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.
verses.WEB: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”
verses.ASV: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did that which was evil in mine eyes, and chose that wherein I delighted not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, então, escolherei a punição para eles, e farei vir sobre eles os seus temores; pois clamei, mas ninguém respondeu; falei, mas não escutaram; ao invés disso fizeram o que era mal aos meus olhos, e escolheram aquilo que não me agrada.
verses.RVR09: También yo escogeré sus escarnios, y traeré sobre ellos lo que temieron; porque llamé, y nadie respondió; hablé, y no oyeron; antes hicieron lo malo delante de mis ojos, y escogieron lo que á mí desagrada.

verses.KJV: Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
verses.WEB: Hear the LORD’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.
verses.ASV: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye that tremble at his word: Your brethren that hate you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, Let Jehovah be glorified, that we may see your joy; but it is they that shall be put to shame.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, vós que tremeis por sua palavra; vossos irmãos, que vos odeiam, e vos expulsaram para longe por causa do meu nome, dizem: Que o SENHOR seja glorificado, para que vejamos vossa alegria; eles, porém, serão envergonhados.
verses.RVR09: Oid palabra de Jehová, vosotros los que tembláis á su palabra: Vuestros hermanos los que os aborrecen, y os niegan por causa de mi nombre, dijeron: Glorifíquese Jehová. Mas él se mostrará con alegría vuestra, y ellos serán confundidos.

verses.KJV: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the Lord that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
verses.WEB: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that repays his enemies what they deserve.
verses.ASV: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Jehovah that rendereth recompense to his enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haverá uma voz de grande ruído, uma voz do Templo: é a voz do SENHOR, que dá pagamento a seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Voz de alboroto de la ciudad, voz del templo, voz de Jehová que da el pago á sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
verses.WEB: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.
verses.ASV: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man-child.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que estivesse em trabalho de parto, ela já deu à luz; antes que viessem as dores, ela já fez sair de si um filho macho.
verses.RVR09: Antes que estuviese de parto, parió; antes que le viniesen dolores parió hijo.

verses.KJV: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
verses.WEB: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.
verses.ASV: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? shall a nation be brought forth at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem [jamais] ouviu tal coisa? Quem viu coisa semelhante? Poderia uma terra gerar filho em um só dia? Nasceria uma nação de uma só vez? Mas logo que Sião esteve de parto, já teve o nascimento de seus filhos.
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién oyó cosa semejante? ¿quién vió cosa tal? ¿parirá la tierra en un día? ¿nacerá una nación de una vez? Pues en cuanto Sión estuvo de parto, parió sus hijos.

verses.KJV: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the Lord: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.
verses.WEB: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says the LORD. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.
verses.ASV: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith Jehovah: shall I that cause to bring forth shut [the womb]? saith thy God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não iniciaria eu o nascimento e não geraria?,diz o SENHOR, Geraria eu, e fecharia [o ventre materno] ?, diz o teu Deus.
verses.RVR09: ¿Yo que hago parir, no pariré? dijo Jehová. ¿Yo que hago engendrar, seré detenido? dice el Dios tuyo.

verses.KJV: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
verses.WEB: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;
verses.ASV: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn over her;
verses.ALMEIDA: Alegrai-vos com Jerusalém, e enchei-vos de alegria por causa dela, todos vós que a amais; alegrai-vos muito com ela, todos vós que chorastes por ela;
verses.RVR09: Alegraos con Jerusalem, y gozaos con ella, todos los que la amáis: llenaos con ella de gozo, todos los que os enlutáis por ella:

verses.KJV: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
verses.WEB: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”
verses.ASV: that ye may suck and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que mameis e vos sacieis dos consoladores seios dela; para que sugueis e vos deleiteis com a abundância de sua glória.
verses.RVR09: Para que maméis y os saciéis de los pechos de sus consolaciones; para que ordeñéis, y os deleitéis con el resplandor de su gloria.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream: and ye shall suck [thereof]; ye shall be borne upon the side, and shall be dandled upon the knees.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que estenderei sobre ela a paz como um rio, e a glória das nações como um ribeiro que transborda; então mamareis; sereis levados ao colo, e sobre os joelhos vos afagarão.
verses.RVR09: Porque así dice Jehová: He aquí que yo extiendo sobre ella paz como un río, y la gloria de las gentes como un arroyo que sale de madre; y mamaréis, y sobre el lado seréis traídos, y sobre las rodillas seréis regalados.

verses.KJV: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”
verses.ASV: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como alguém a quem sua mãe consola, assim também eu vos consolarei; e em Jerusalém sereis consolados.
verses.RVR09: Como aquel á quien consuela su madre, así os consolaré yo á vosotros, y en Jerusalem tomaréis consuelo.

verses.KJV: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the Lord shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
verses.WEB: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. The LORD’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.
verses.ASV: And ye shall see [it], and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like the tender grass: and the hand of Jehovah shall be known toward his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vereis; então vossos corações se alegrarão, e vossos ossos se avivarão como a erva que brota. E a mão do do SENHOR será conhecida pelos seu servos, e se enfurecerá contra seus inimigos.
verses.RVR09: Y veréis, y alegraráse vuestro corazón, y vuestros huesos reverdecerán como la hierba: y la mano de Jehová para con sus siervos será conocida, y se airará contra sus enemigos.

verses.KJV: For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
verses.WEB: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to give his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
verses.ASV: For, behold, Jehovah will come with fire, and his chariots shall be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que o SENHOR virá com fogo, e suas carruagens como um redemoinho de vento; para transformar sua ira em furor, e sua repreensão em chamas de fogo.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí que Jehová vendrá con fuego, y sus carros como torbellino, para tornar su ira en furor, y su reprensión en llama de fuego.

verses.KJV: For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.
verses.WEB: For the LORD will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by the LORD will be many.
verses.ASV: For by fire will Jehovah execute judgment, and by his sword, upon all flesh; and the slain of Jehovah shall be many.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque com fogo e com sua espada o SENHOR julgará toda carne; e os mortos pelo SENHOR serão muitos.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová juzgará con fuego y con su espada á toda carne: y los muertos de Jehová serán multiplicados.

verses.KJV: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: They that sanctify themselves and purify themselves [to go] unto the gardens, behind one in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que se consagram e se purificam nos jardins para seguirem aquele que está no meio [deles] ; os que comem carne de porco, abominações, e ratos, juntamente serão consumidos, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Los que se santifican y los que se purifican en los huertos, unos tras otros, los que comen carne de puerco, y abominación, y ratón; juntamente serán talados, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
verses.WEB: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.
verses.ASV: For I [know] their works and their thoughts: [the time] cometh, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and shall see my glory.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu [conheço] suas obras e seus pensamentos. [O tempo] vem, em que juntarei todas as nações e línguas; e elas virão, e verão minha glória.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo entiendo sus obras y sus pensamientos: tiempo vendrá para juntar todas las gentes y lenguas; y vendrán, y verán mi gloria.

verses.KJV: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
verses.WEB: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.
verses.ASV: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send such as escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei nelas um sinal; e a uns que delas sobreviverem enviarei às nações: [a] Társis, Pul e Lude; [aos] flecheiros, [a] Tubal e Javã; até as terras costeiras [mais] distantes, que não ouviram minha fama, nem viram minha glória; e anunciarão minha glória entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré entre ellos señal, y enviaré de los escapados de ellos á las gentes, á Tarsis, á Pul y Lud, que disparan arco, á Tubal y á Javán, á las islas apartadas que no oyeron de mí, ni vieron mi gloria; y publicarán mi gloria entre las gentes.

verses.KJV: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the Lord, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to the LORD, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: And they shall bring all your brethren out of all the nations for an oblation unto Jehovah, upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon dromedaries, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith Jehovah, as the children of Israel bring their oblation in a clean vessel into the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trarão a todos os vossos irmãos dentre todas as nações [como] oferta ao SENHOR, sobre cavalos, e em carruagens, liteiras, mulas e dromedários, ao meu santo monte, [a] Jerusalém, diz o SENHOR, tal como os filhos de Israel trazem ofertas em vasos limpos à casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y traerán á todos vuestros hermanos de entre todas las naciones, por presente á Jehová, en caballos, en carros, en literas, y en mulos, y en camellos, á mi santo monte de Jerusalem, dice Jehová, al modo que los hijos de Israel traen el presente en vasos limpios á la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And of them also will I take for priests [and] for Levites, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também tomarei a alguns deles para [serem] sacerdotes [e] para Levitas,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaré también de ellos para sacerdotes y Levitas, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.
verses.WEB: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says the LORD, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.
verses.ASV: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith Jehovah, so shall your seed and your name remain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim como os novos céus e a nova terra, que farei, estarão perante mim,diz o SENHOR, assim também estará vossa descendência e vosso nome.
verses.RVR09: Porque como los cielos nuevos y la nueva tierra, que yo hago, permanecen delante de mí, dice Jehová, así permanecerá vuestra simiente y vuestro nombre.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, desde uma lua nova até a outra, e desde um sábado até o outro, todos virão para adorar perante mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y será que de mes en mes, y de sábado en sábado, vendrá toda carne á adorar delante de mí, dijo Jehová.

verses.KJV: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
verses.WEB: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”
verses.ASV: And they shall go forth, and look upon the dead bodies of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sairão, e verão os cadáveres dos homens que se rebelaram contra mim; porque o verme deles nunca morrerá, nem seu fogo se apagará; e serão horríveis a todos.
verses.RVR09: Y saldrán, y verán los cadáveres de los hombres que se rebelaron contra mí: porque su gusano nunca morirá, ni su fuego se apagará; y serán abominables á toda carne.

verses.KJV: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.WEB: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
verses.ASV: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavras de Jeremias, filho de Hilquias, [um] dos sacerdotes que estiveram em Anatote, na terra de Benjamim.
verses.RVR09: LAS palabras de Jeremías hijo de Hilcías, de los sacerdotes que estuvieron en Anathoth, en tierra de Benjamín.

verses.KJV: To whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.ASV: to whom the word of Jehovah came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao qual veio a palavra do SENHOR nos dias de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, no décimo terceiro ano de seu reinado.
verses.RVR09: La palabra de Jehová que fué á él en los días de Josías hijo de Amón, rey de Judá, en el año décimotercio de su reinado.

verses.KJV: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.WEB: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.ASV: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio também nos dias de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, até o fim do décimo primeiro ano de Zedequias, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, até que Jerusalém foi levada cativa no quinto mês.
verses.RVR09: Fué asimismo en días de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, hasta el fin del año undécimo de Sedechîas hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, hasta la cautividad de Jerusalem en el mes quinto.

verses.KJV: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Now the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio, pois, a palavra do SENHOR a mim, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Fué pues palabra de Jehová á mí, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.WEB: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
verses.ASV: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee, and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee; I have appointed thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que te formasse no ventre eu te conheci, e antes que saísses do útero eu te santifiquei, te dei por profeta às nações.
verses.RVR09: Antes que te formase en el vientre te conocí, y antes que salieses de la matriz te santifiqué, te dí por profeta á las gentes.

verses.KJV: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
verses.WEB: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
verses.ASV: Then said I, Ah, Lord Jehovah! behold, I know not how to speak; for I am a child.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu disse: Ah! Senhor DEUS! Eis que não sei falar, pois sou um menino.
verses.RVR09: Y yo dije: ¡Ah! ¡ah! ¡Señor Jehová! He aquí, no sé hablar, porque soy niño.

verses.KJV: But the Lord said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.WEB: But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah said unto me, Say not, I am a child; for to whomsoever I shall send thee thou shalt go, and whatsoever I shall command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o SENHOR me disse: Não digas: sou menino; porque a todos a quem eu te enviar tu irás, e falarás tudo quanto eu te mandar.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome Jehová: No digas, soy niño; porque á todo lo que te enviaré irás tú, y dirás todo lo que te mandaré.

verses.KJV: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Be not afraid because of them; for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não temas diante deles, porque estou contigo para te livrar, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No temas delante de ellos, porque contigo soy para librarte, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then the Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
verses.ASV: Then Jehovah put forth his hand, and touched my mouth; and Jehovah said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o SENHOR estendeu sua mão, e tocou em minha boca. E o SENHOR me disse: Eis que tenho posto minhas palavras em tua boca.
verses.RVR09: Y extendió Jehová su mano, y tocó sobre mi boca; y díjome Jehová: He aquí he puesto mis palabras en tu boca.

verses.KJV: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
verses.WEB: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
verses.ASV: see, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha que eu te pus neste dia sobre nações e sobre reinos, para arrancar e para derrubar, e para destruir e para arruinar, e para edificar e para plantar.
verses.RVR09: Mira que te he puesto en este día sobre gentes y sobre reinos, para arrancar y para destruir, y para arruinar y para derribar, y para edificar y para plantar.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
verses.ASV: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond-tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a palavra do SENHOR veio a mim, dizendo: O que tu vês, Jeremias? E eu disse: Vejo uma vara de amendoeira.
verses.RVR09: Y la palabra de Jehová fué á mí, diciendo: ¿Qué ves tú, Jeremías? Y dije: Yo veo una vara de almendro.

verses.KJV: Then said the Lord unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”
verses.ASV: Then said Jehovah unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I watch over my word to perform it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-me o SENHOR: Viste bem; porque eu apresso minha palavra para cumpri-la.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome Jehová: Bien has visto; porque yo apresuro mi palabra para ponerla por obra.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a boiling caldron; and the face thereof is from the north.
