verses.ALMEIDA: E que farás tu, ó assolada? Ainda que te vistas de vermelho, ainda que te adornes com ornamentos de ouro, ainda que pintes teus olhos, em vão te enfeitarias; os [teus] amantes te desprezam, [e] buscarão [matar] a tua alma.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, destruída, ¿qué harás? Bien que te vistas de grana, aunque te adornes con atavíos de oro, aunque pintes con antimonio tus ojos, en vano te engalanas; menospreciáronte los amadores, buscarán tu alma.

verses.KJV: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
verses.WEB: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”
verses.ASV: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that gaspeth for breath, that spreadeth her hands, [saying], Woe is me now! for my soul fainteth before the murderers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ouço uma voz, como de mulher que está de parto, uma angústia como de parto de primeiro filho; é a voz da filha de Sião, que lamenta e estende suas mãos, [dizendo] : Ai de mim agora! Pois minha alma desmaia por causa dos assassinos.
verses.RVR09: Porque voz oí como de mujer que está de parto, angustia como de primeriza; voz de la hija de Sión que lamenta y extiende sus manos, diciendo: ¡Ay ahora de mí! que mi alma desmaya á causa de los matadores.

verses.KJV: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
verses.WEB: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.
verses.ASV: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that doeth justly, that seeketh truth; and I will pardon her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Correi pelas ruas de Jerusalém, e olhai agora, e informai-vos, e buscai em suas praças, [para ver] se achais algum homem, se há alguém que faça juízo, que busque a verdade; e eu a perdoarei.
verses.RVR09: DISCURRID por las plazas de Jerusalem, y mirad ahora, y sabed, y buscad en sus plazas si halláis hombre, si hay alguno que haga juicio, que busque verdad; y yo la perdonaré.

verses.KJV: And though they say, The Lord liveth; surely they swear falsely.
verses.WEB: Though they say, ‘As the LORD lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”
verses.ASV: And though they say, As Jehovah liveth; surely they swear falsely.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda que digam: Vive o SENHOR; contudo juram falsamente.
verses.RVR09: Y si dijeren: Vive Jehová; por tanto jurarán mentira.

verses.KJV: O Lord, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.WEB: O LORD, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, do not thine eyes look upon truth? thou hast stricken them, but they were not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah SENHOR, por acaso teus olhos não [enxergam] a verdade? Tu os feriste, mas não lhes doeu; tu os consumiste, mas não aceitaram receber correção; endureceram seus rostos mais que rocha; não quiseram se converter.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, ¿no miran tus ojos á la verdad? Azotástelos, y no les dolió; consumístelos, y no quisieron recibir corrección; endurecieron sus rostros más que la piedra, no quisieron tornarse.

verses.KJV: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the Lord, nor the judgment of their God.
verses.WEB: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the LORD’s way, nor the law of their God.
verses.ASV: Then I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish; for they know not the way of Jehovah, nor the law of their God:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu porém disse: Certamente eles são pobres; enlouqueceram, pois não conhecem o caminho do SENHOR, o juízo de seu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Yo empero dije: Por cierto ellos son pobres, enloquecido han, pues no conocen el camino de Jehová, el juicio de su Dios.

verses.KJV: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the Lord, and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
verses.WEB: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of the LORD, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
verses.ASV: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they know the way of Jehovah, and the law of their God. But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Irei aos grandes, e falarei com eles; porque eles conhecem o caminho do SENHOR, o juízo de seu Deus.Porém eles também quebraram o jugo; [também] romperam as amarras.
verses.RVR09: Irme he á los grandes, y hablaréles; porque ellos conocen el camino de Jehová, el juicio de su Dios. Ciertamente ellos también quebraron el yugo, rompieron las coyundas.

verses.KJV: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
verses.WEB: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.
verses.ASV: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, a wolf of the evenings shall destroy them, a leopard shall watch against their cities; every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces; because their transgressions are many, [and] their backslidings are increased.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso um leão do bosque os ferirá; um lobo do deserto os destruirá; um leopardo vigiará sobre suas cidades; qualquer um que delas sair, será despedaçado; pois suas transgressões se multiplicaram, foram numerosas suas infidelidades.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, león del monte los herirá, destruirálos lobo del desierto, tigre acechará sobre sus ciudades; cualquiera que de ellas saliere, será arrebatado: porque sus rebeliones se han multiplicado, hanse aumentado sus deslealtades.

verses.KJV: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
verses.WEB: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.
verses.ASV: How can I pardon thee? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the harlots’ houses;
verses.ALMEIDA: Como te perdoaria por isto? Teus filhos me deixaram, e juram pelo que não é Deus. Eu os saciei, porém eles adulteraram, e se aglomeraram em casa de prostitutas.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo te he de perdonar por esto? Sus hijos me dejaron, y juraron por lo que no es Dios. Saciélos, y adulteraron, y en casa de ramera se juntaron en compañías.

verses.KJV: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
verses.WEB: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
verses.ASV: they were as fed horses roaming at large; every one neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] cavalos bem alimentados, levantam-se pela manhã; cada um relinchava à mulher de seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: Como caballos bien hartos fueron á la mañana, cada cual relinchaba á la mujer de su prójimo.

verses.KJV: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.WEB: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.ASV: Shall I not visit for these things? saith Jehovah; and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não teria eu de fazer visitação sobre isto?diz o SENHOR. De uma nação como esta não vingaria minha alma?
verses.RVR09: ¿No había de hacer visitación sobre esto? dijo Jehová. De una gente como ésta ¿no se había de vengar mi alma?

verses.KJV: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the Lord's.
verses.WEB: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not the LORD’s.
verses.ASV: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her branches; for they are not Jehovah’s.
verses.ALMEIDA: Subi seus muros, e destruí; mas não destruais por completo. Tirai os ramos de seus muros, porque não pertencem ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Escalad sus muros, y destruid; mas no hagáis consumación: quitad las almenas de sus muros, porque no son de Jehová.

verses.KJV: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a casa de Israel e a casa de Judá traíram enganosamente contra mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque resueltamente se rebelaron contra mí la casa de Israel y la casa de Judá, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: They have belied the Lord, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.WEB: They have denied the LORD, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.
verses.ASV: They have denied Jehovah, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.ALMEIDA: Negaram ao SENHOR, e disseram: Não é ele; não virá mal sobre nós; não veremos espada, nem fome;
verses.RVR09: Negaron á Jehová, y dijeron: El no es, y no vendrá mal sobre nosotros, ni veremos cuchillo ni hambre;

verses.KJV: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.WEB: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”
verses.ASV: and the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: e até os profetas serão [como] o vento, pois a palavra não está neles; assim acontecerá a eles mesmos.
verses.RVR09: Antes los profetas serán como viento, y no hay en ellos palabra; así se hará á ellos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.
verses.ASV: Wherefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos: Visto que falastes esta palavra, eis que tornarei minhas palavras em tua boca em fogo, e a este povo será lenha; e [o fogo] os consumirá.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová Dios de los ejércitos: Porque hablasteis esta palabra, he aquí yo pongo en tu boca mis palabras por fuego, y á este pueblo por leños, y los consumirá.

verses.KJV: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the Lord: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says the LORD. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.
verses.ASV: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que trarei sobre vós uma nação de longe, ó casa de Israel,diz o SENHOR; uma nação forte, nação bastante antiga; uma nação cuja língua não saberás, e o que falarem não entenderás.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo traigo sobre vosotros gente de lejos, oh casa de Israel, dice Jehová; gente robusta, gente antigua, gente cuya lengua ignorarás, y no entenderás lo que hablare.

verses.KJV: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
verses.WEB: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.
verses.ASV: Their quiver is an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sua aljava é como uma sepultura aberta; todos eles são poderosos.
verses.RVR09: Su aljaba como sepulcro abierto, todos valientes.

verses.KJV: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
verses.WEB: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.
verses.ASV: And they shall eat up thy harvest, and thy bread, [which] thy sons and thy daughters should eat; they shall eat up thy flocks and thy herds; they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig-trees; they shall beat down thy fortified cities, wherein thou trustest, with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: E comerão tua colheita e teu pão, que teus filhos e tuas filhas comeriam; comerão tuas ovelhas e tuas vacas, comerão tuas vides e tuas figueiras; e derrubarão por meio da espada tuas cidades fortes em que confias.
verses.RVR09: Y comerá tu mies y tu pan, que habían de comer tus hijos y tus hijas; comerá tus ovejas y tus vacas, comerá tus viñas y tus higueras; y tus ciudades fuertes en que tú confías, tornará en nada á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless in those days, saith the Lord, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.WEB: “But even in those days,” says the LORD, “I will not make a full end of you.
verses.ASV: But even in those days, saith Jehovah, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém naqueles dias, diz o SENHOR, não vos acabarei por completo.
verses.RVR09: Empero en aquellos días, dice Jehová, no os acabaré del todo.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the Lord our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not your's.
verses.WEB: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore hath Jehovah our God done all these things unto us? then shalt thou say unto them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served foreign gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que quando disserdes: Por que o SENHOR nosso Deus fez conosco todas estas coisas? Então lhes dirás: Assim como vós me abandonastes e servistes a deuses estrangeiros em vossa terra, assim também servireis a estrangeiros numa terra que não é vossa.
verses.RVR09: Y será que cuando dijereis: ¿Por qué hizo Jehová el Dios nuestro con nosotros todas estas cosas? entonces les dirás: De la manera que me dejasteis á mí, y servisteis á dioses ajenos en vuestra tierra, así serviréis á extraños en tierra ajena.

verses.KJV: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
verses.WEB: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
verses.ASV: Declare ye this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Anunciai isto na casa de Jacó, e fazei com que isto se ouça em Judá, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Denunciad esto en la casa de Jacob, y haced que esto se oiga en Judá, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
verses.WEB: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
verses.ASV: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; that have eyes, and see not; that have ears, and hear not:
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi agora isto, ó povo tolo e insensato, que têm olhos e não veem, que têm ouvidos e não ouvem:
verses.RVR09: Oid ahora esto, pueblo necio y sin corazón, que tienen ojos y no ven, que tienen oídos y no oyen:

verses.KJV: Fear ye not me? saith the Lord: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
verses.WEB: Don’t you fear me?’ says the LORD; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’
verses.ASV: Fear ye not me? saith Jehovah: will ye not tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea, by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it? and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não me temereis?diz o SENHOR; Não vos assombrareis perante mim, que pus a areia por limite ao mar por ordenança eterna, a qual não passará? Ainda que se levantarem suas ondas, mas elas não prevalecerão; ainda que bramem, não a passarão.
verses.RVR09: ¿A mí no temeréis? dice Jehová; ¿no os amedrentaréis á mi presencia, que al mar por ordenación eterna, la cual no quebrantará, puse arena por término? Se levantarán tempestades, mas no prevalecerán; bramarán sus ondas, mas no lo pasarán.

verses.KJV: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.WEB: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.
verses.ASV: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém este povo tem coração teimoso e rebelde; viraram-se, e se foram.
verses.RVR09: Empero este pueblo tiene corazón falso y rebelde; tornáronse y fuéronse.

verses.KJV: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the Lord our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.WEB: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear the LORD our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’
verses.ASV: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear Jehovah our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in its season; that preserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem sequer dizem em seu coração: Temamos agora ao SENHOR nosso Deus, que dá chuva temporã e tardia em seu tempo; os tempos estabelecidos da ceifa ele nos guarda.
verses.RVR09: Y no dijeron en su corazón: Temamos ahora á Jehová Dios nuestro, que da lluvia temprana y tardía en su tiempo; los tiempos establecidos de la siega nos guarda.

verses.KJV: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
verses.WEB: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
verses.ASV: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good from you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vossas perversidades têm desviado estas coisas; e vossos pecados afastaram de vós o bem.
verses.RVR09: Vuestras iniquidades han estorbado estas cosas; y vuestros pecados apartaron de vosotros el bien.

verses.KJV: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
verses.WEB: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
verses.ASV: For among my people are found wicked men: they watch, as fowlers lie in wait; they set a trap, they catch men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque foram achados perversos em meu povo; eles espiavam como quem põe laços; puseram armadilhas para prenderem homens.
verses.RVR09: Porque fueron hallados en mi pueblo impíos; acechaban como quien pone lazos; pusieron trampa para tomar hombres.

verses.KJV: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
verses.WEB: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.
verses.ASV: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxed rich.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como uma gaiola cheia de pássaros, assim estão suas casas cheias de engano: assim eles se fizeram grandes e ricos.
verses.RVR09: Como jaula llena de pájaros, así están sus casas llenas de engaño: así se hicieron grandes y ricos.

verses.KJV: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.WEB: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.
verses.ASV: They are waxed fat, they shine: yea, they overpass in deeds of wickedness; they plead not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se engordaram e ficaram lustrosos, e ultrapassaram os limites das obras do mal; não julgam causa nenhuma, [nem sequer] a causa do órfão; porém fizeram-se prósperos; nem julgam o direito dos necessitados.
verses.RVR09: Engordaron y pusiéronse lustrosos, y sobrepujaron los hechos del malo: no juzgaron la causa, la causa del huérfano; con todo hiciéronse prósperos, y la causa de los pobres no juzgaron.

verses.KJV: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.WEB: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.ASV: Shall I not visit for these things? saith Jehovah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eu não [os] puniria por causa disto? Diz o SENHOR; e de tal nação não se vingará minha alma?
verses.RVR09: ¿No tengo de visitar sobre esto? dice Jehová; ¿y de tal gente no se vengará mi alma?

verses.KJV: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
verses.WEB: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.
verses.ASV: A wonderful and horrible thing is come to pass in the land:
verses.ALMEIDA: Uma coisa espantosa e horrível está sendo feita na terra:
verses.RVR09: Cosa espantosa y fea es hecha en la tierra:

verses.KJV: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
verses.WEB: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?
verses.ASV: the prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
verses.ALMEIDA: Os profetas profetizam falsamente, e os sacerdotes exercem liderança por suas próprias mãos; e meu povo assim o quer. Mas o que fareis quando isto chegar ao fim?
verses.RVR09: Los profetas profetizaron mentira, y los sacerdotes dirigían por manos de ellos; y mi pueblo así lo quiso. ¿Qué pues haréis á su fin?

verses.KJV: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.WEB: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.
verses.ASV: Flee for safety, ye children of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise up a signal on Beth-haccherem; for evil looketh forth from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fugi, ó filhos de Benjamim, do meio de Jerusalém; e tocai trombeta em Tecoa, e levantai um sinal de fumaça sobre Bete-Haquerém; porque do norte já se vê o desastre e grande destruição.
verses.RVR09: HUID, hijos de Benjamín, de en medio de Jerusalem, y tocad bocina en Tecoa, y alzad por señal humo sobre Beth-hacchêrem: porque del aquilón se ha visto mal, y quebrantamiento grande.

verses.KJV: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
verses.WEB: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.
verses.ASV: The comely and delicate one, the daughter of Zion, will I cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Destruirei a filha de Sião [ainda que seja] formosa e delicada.
verses.RVR09: A mujer hermosa y delicada comparé á la hija de Sión.

verses.KJV: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.WEB: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”
verses.ASV: Shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ela virão pastores com seus rebanhos; levantarão contra ela tendas ao redor; [e] cada um apascentará em seu lugar.
verses.RVR09: A ella vendrán pastores y sus rebaños; junto á ella en derredor pondrán sus tiendas; cada uno apacentará á su parte.

verses.KJV: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.WEB: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.ASV: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day declineth, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Preparai guerra contra ela; levantai-vos e subamos até o meio-dia! Ai de nós! que vai caindo já o dia, que as sombras da tarde já estão se estendendo.
verses.RVR09: Denunciad guerra contra ella: levantaos y subamos hacia el mediodía. ¡Ay de nosotros! que va cayendo ya el día, que las sombras de la tarde se han extendido.

verses.KJV: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.WEB: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”
verses.ASV: Arise, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai-vos, e subamos de noite, e destruamos seus palácios.
verses.RVR09: Levantaos, y subamos de noche, y destruyamos sus palacios.

verses.KJV: For thus hath the Lord of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
verses.WEB: For the LORD of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.
verses.ASV: For thus hath Jehovah of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Cortai árvores, e levantai cercos junto a Jerusalém; esta é a cidade que tem de ser punida; opressão há no meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Porque así dijo Jehová de los ejércitos: Cortad árboles, y extended baluarte junto á Jerusalem: esta es la ciudad que toda ella ha de ser visitada; violencia hay en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
verses.WEB: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.
verses.ASV: As a well casteth forth its waters, so she casteth forth her wickedness: violence and destruction is heard in her; before me continually is sickness and wounds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como a fonte jorra suas águas, assim também ela constantemente jorra sua malícia; violência e destruição se ouve nela; continuamente há enfermidade e feridas perante mim.
verses.RVR09: Como la fuente nunca cesa de manar sus aguas, así nunca cesa de manar su malicia; injusticia y robo se oye en ella; continuamente en mi presencia, enfermedad y herida.

verses.KJV: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
verses.WEB: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”
verses.ASV: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from thee; lest I make thee a desolation, a land not inhabited.
verses.ALMEIDA: Corrige-te, Jerusalém, para que minha alma não se afaste de ti, para que eu não te torne desolada, uma terra não habitada.
verses.RVR09: Corrígete, Jerusalem, porque no se aparte mi alma de ti, porque no te torne desierta, tierra no habitada.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn again thy hand as a grape-gatherer into the baskets.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Sacudirão por completo o restante de Israel tal como a vide; volta tua mão aos cestos como alguém que colhe uvas.
verses.RVR09: Así dijo Jehová de los ejércitos: Del todo rebuscarán como á vid el resto de Israel: torna tu mano como vendimiador á los cestos.

verses.KJV: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the Lord is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.WEB: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, the LORD’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.
verses.ASV: To whom shall I speak and testify, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of Jehovah is become unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.ALMEIDA: A quem falarei e testemunharei, para que ouçam? Eis que que seus ouvidos são incircuncisos, e não podem escutar; eis que a palavra do SENHOR lhes é coisa vergonhosa, não gostam dela.
verses.RVR09: ¿A quién tengo de hablar y amonestar, para que oigan? He aquí que sus orejas son incircuncisas, y no pueden escuchar; he aquí que la palabra de Jehová les es cosa vergonzosa, no la aman.

verses.KJV: Therefore I am full of the fury of the Lord; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
verses.WEB: Therefore I am full of the LORD’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife will be taken, the aged with him who is full of days.
verses.ASV: Therefore I am full of the wrath of Jehovah; I am weary with holding in: pour it out upon the children in the street, and upon the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso estou cheio dá fúria do SENHOR, [e] cansado estou de retê [-la] ; eu a derramarei sobre os meninos pelas ruas, e sobre a reunião dos jovens juntamente; porque até o marido com a mulher serão presos, [e] o velho com o cheio de dias.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto estoy lleno de saña de Jehová, trabajado he por contenerme; derramaréla sobre los niños en la calle, y sobre la reunión de los jóvenes juntamente; porque el marido también será preso con la mujer, el viejo con el lleno de días.

verses.KJV: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And their houses shall be turned unto others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas casas passarão a ser de outros, suas propriedades e juntamente suas mulheres; porque estenderei minha mão contra os moradores da terra, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y sus casas serán traspasadas á otros, sus heredades y también sus mujeres; porque extenderé mi mano sobre los moradores de la tierra, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.WEB: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.
verses.ASV: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque desde o menor deles até o maior deles, cada um deseja com ganância; e desde o profeta até o sacerdote, todos agem com falsidade.
verses.RVR09: Porque desde el más chico de ellos hasta el más grande de ellos, cada uno sigue la avaricia; y desde el profeta hasta el sacerdote, todos son engañadores.

verses.KJV: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.WEB: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.
verses.ASV: They have healed also the hurt of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E curam a ferida da filha de meu povo apenas superficialmente, dizendo, Paz, paz; sem que haja paz.
verses.RVR09: Y curan el quebrantamiento de la hija de mi pueblo con liviandad, diciendo, Paz, paz; y no hay paz.

verses.KJV: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. When I visit them, they will be cast down,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall; at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles se envergonham de fazerem abominação? Não, não se envergonham de maneira nenhuma, nem sequer sabem ter vergonha. Por isso cairão entre os que caem; tropeçarão quando eu os visitar, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ¿Hanse avergonzado de haber hecho abominación? No por cierto, no se han avergonzado, ni aun saben tener vergüenza: por tanto caerán entre los que caerán; caerán cuando los visitaré, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Stand ye in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way; and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls: but they said, We will not walk [therein].
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Ficai parados nos caminhos, e vede, e perguntai pelas veredas antigas, qual é o bom caminho, e andai por ele; então achareis descanso para vossa alma. Mas disseram: Não andaremos.
verses.RVR09: Así dijo Jehová: Paraos en los caminos, y mirad, y preguntad por las sendas antiguas, cuál sea el buen camino, y andad por él, y hallaréis descanso para vuestra alma. Mas dijeron: No andaremos.

verses.KJV: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
verses.WEB: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’
verses.ASV: And I set watchmen over you, [saying], Hearken to the sound of the trumpet; but they said, We will not hearken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também pus vigilantes sobre vós, que dissessem: Prestai atenção à voz da trombeta. Mas eles disseram: Não prestaremos atenção.
verses.RVR09: Desperté también sobre vosotros atalayas, que dijesen: Escuchad á la voz de la trompeta. Y dijeron ellos: No escucharemos.

verses.KJV: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.WEB: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.
verses.ASV: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto ouvi, ó nações, e saiba disto, o multidão que nelas está;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto oid, gentes, y conoce, oh conjunto de ellas.

verses.KJV: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
verses.WEB: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.
verses.ASV: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouve tu, ó terra: Eis que eu trarei mal sobre este povo: o fruto de seus pensamentos; pois não dão atenção a minhas palavras, e rejeitam a minha lei.
verses.RVR09: Oye, tierra. He aquí yo traigo mal sobre este pueblo, el fruto de sus pensamientos; porque no escucharon á mis palabras, y aborrecieron mi ley.

verses.KJV: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
verses.WEB: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”
verses.ASV: To what purpose cometh there to me frankincense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt-offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices pleasing unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Afinal, para que vem a mim o incenso de Sabá, e a boa cana aromática de uma terra distante? Vossos holocaustosnão [me] são aceitáveis, nem vossos sacrifícios me são agradáveis.
verses.RVR09: ¿A qué viene para mí este incienso de Seba, y la buena caña olorosa de tierra lejana? Vuestros holocaustos no son á mi voluntad, ni vuestros sacrificios me dan gusto.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will lay stumbling-blocks before this people; and the fathers and the sons together shall stumble against them; the neighbor and his friend shall perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que porei tropeços a este povo, e cairão neles juntamente os pais e os filhos; o vizinho e seu companheiro perecerão.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto Jehová dice esto: He aquí yo pongo á este pueblo tropiezos, y caerán en ellos los padres y los hijos juntamente, el vecino y su cercano perecerán.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Behold, a people cometh from the north country; and a great nation shall be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que vem um povo da terra do norte; e uma grande nação se levantará dos confins da terra.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que viene pueblo de tierra del aquilón, y gente grande se levantará de los cantones de la tierra.

verses.KJV: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.WEB: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”
verses.ASV: They lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea, and they ride upon horses, every one set in array, as a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles trarão arco e lança; são cruéis, que não terão misericórdia; a voz deles rugirá como o mar, e sobre cavalo cavalgarão, como homens dispostos para a guerra contra ti, ó filha de Sião.
verses.RVR09: Arco y escudo arrebatarán; crueles son, que no tendrán misericordia; sonará la voz de ellos como la mar, y montarán á caballo como hombres dispuestos para la guerra, contra ti, oh hija de Sión.

verses.KJV: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.WEB: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
verses.ASV: We have heard the report thereof; our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, [and] pangs as of a woman in travail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós ouvimos a fama deles, e nossas mãos perderam a força; fomos tomados pela angústia, [e] dor como de mulher no parto.
verses.RVR09: Su fama oimos, y nuestras manos se descoyuntaron; apoderóse de nosotros angustia, dolor como de mujer que pare.

verses.KJV: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
verses.WEB: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.
verses.ASV: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy, [and] terror, are on every side.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não saiais ao campo, nem andeis pelo caminho; porque a espada do inimigo [e] o terror está ao redor.
verses.RVR09: No salgas al campo, ni andes por camino; porque espada de enemigo y temor hay por todas partes.

verses.KJV: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.WEB: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.
verses.ASV: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation; for the destroyer shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, filha de meu povo, veste-te de saco, e revolve-te em cinza; chora de luto [como] por um filho único, pranto de amarguras; porque logo virá sobre nós o destruidor.
verses.RVR09: Hija de mi pueblo, cíñete de saco, y revuélcate en ceniza; hazte luto como por hijo único, llanto de amarguras: porque presto vendrá sobre nosotros el destruidor.

verses.KJV: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.WEB: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.
verses.ASV: I have made thee a trier [and] a fortress among my people; that thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te pus por avaliador e por fortaleza entre meu povo, para que reconheças, e examines o caminho deles.
verses.RVR09: Por fortaleza te he puesto en mi pueblo, por torre: conocerás pues, y examinarás el camino de ellos.

verses.KJV: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
verses.WEB: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
verses.ASV: They are all grievous revolters, going about with slanders; they are brass and iron: they all of them deal corruptly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos eles são os mais teimosos rebeldes, que vivem enganando; são [duros como] cobre e ferro: todos eles são corruptos.
verses.RVR09: Todos ellos príncipes rebeldes, andan con engaño; son cobre y hierro: todos ellos son corruptores.

verses.KJV: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.WEB: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.ASV: The bellows blow fiercely; the lead is consumed of the fire: in vain do they go on refining; for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.ALMEIDA: O fole já se queimou, o chumbo já se consumiu pelo fogo; em vão é feita a fundição, pois os maus não são arrancados.
verses.RVR09: Quemóse el fuelle, del fuego se ha consumido el plomo: por demás fundió el fundidor, pues los malos no son arrancados.

verses.KJV: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the Lord hath rejected them.
verses.WEB: Men will call them rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”
verses.ASV: Refuse silver shall men call them, because Jehovah hath rejected them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles são chamados prata rejeitada, porque o SENHOR os rejeitou.
verses.RVR09: Plata desechada los llamarán, porque Jehová los desechó.

verses.KJV: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.WEB: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.ASV: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra que veio do SENHOR a Jeremias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: PALABRA que fué de Jehová á Jeremías, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Stand in the gate of the Lord's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the Lord, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: Stand in the gate of Jehovah’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of Jehovah, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Põe-te à porta da casa do SENHOR, e clama ali esta palavra, e dize: Ouvi palavra do SENHOR, toda Judá, vós que entrais por estas portas para adorar ao SENHOR!
verses.RVR09: Ponte á la puerta de la casa de Jehová, y predica allí esta palabra, y di: Oid palabra de Jehová, todo Judá, los que entráis por estas puertas para adorar á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Melhorai vossos caminhos e vossos atos, e eu vos farei habitar neste lugar.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: Mejorad vuestros caminos y vuestras obras, y os haré morar en este lugar.

verses.KJV: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the Lord, The temple of the Lord, The temple of the Lord, are these.
verses.WEB: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘The LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, are these.’
verses.ASV: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, are these.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não confieis em palavras falsas, que dizem: Templo do SENHOR! Templo do SENHOR! Este é o templo do SENHOR!
verses.RVR09: No fiéis en palabras de mentira, diciendo: Templo de Jehová, templo de Jehová, templo de Jehová es éste.

verses.KJV: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
verses.WEB: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
verses.ASV: For if ye thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se verdadeiramente melhorardes vossos caminhos e vossas obras; se verdadeiramente fizerdes justiça entre o homem e seu próximo;
verses.RVR09: Mas si mejorareis cumplidamente vuestros caminos y vuestras obras; si con exactitud hiciereis derecho entre el hombre y su prójimo,

verses.KJV: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
verses.WEB: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,
verses.ASV: if ye oppress not the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your own hurt:
verses.ALMEIDA: E não oprimirdes ao estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós, ao órfão, e à viúva, nem derramardes sangue inocente neste lugar, nem seguirdes deuses estrangeiros para vosso mal;
verses.RVR09: Ni oprimiereis al peregrino, al huérfano, y á la viuda, ni en este lugar derramareis la sangre inocente, ni anduviereis en pos de dioses ajenos para mal vuestro;

verses.KJV: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.WEB: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.
verses.ASV: then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even for evermore.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos farei morar neste lugar, na terra que dei a vossos pais desde os tempos antigos para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Os haré morar en este lugar, en la tierra que dí á vuestros padres para siempre.

verses.KJV: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.WEB: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.
verses.ASV: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vós os confiais em palavras falsas, que não têm proveito algum.
verses.RVR09: He aquí vosotros os confiáis en palabras de mentira, que no aprovechan.

verses.KJV: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
verses.WEB: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,
verses.ASV: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods that ye have not known,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso furtareis, matareis, e adulterareis, e jurareis falsamente, e queimareis incenso a Baal, e andareis atrás de deuses estrangeiros, a quem não conheceis,
verses.RVR09: ¿Hurtando, matando, y adulterando, y jurando falso, é incensando á Baal, y andando tras dioses extraños que no conocisteis,

verses.KJV: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
verses.WEB: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?
verses.ASV: and come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered; that ye may do all these abominations?
verses.ALMEIDA: E [então] vireis e vos poreis perante mim nesta casa , que se chama pelo meu nome, e direis: Libertos somos, para fazer todas estas abominações?
verses.RVR09: Vendréis y os pondréis delante de mí en esta casa sobre la cual es invocado mi nombre, y diréis: Librados somos: para hacer todas estas abominaciones?

verses.KJV: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I, even I, have seen it, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso esta casa, que se chama pelo meu nome, é uma caverna de assaltantes perante vossos olhos? Eis que também vi [isso] , diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ¿Es cueva de ladrones delante de vuestros ojos esta casa, sobre la cual es invocado mi nombre? He aquí que también yo veo, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.WEB: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.ASV: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ide agora a meu lugar, que era em Siló, onde fiz habitar meu nome no princípio; e vede o que lhe fiz pela maldade do meu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Andad empero ahora á mi lugar que fué en Silo, donde hice que morase mi nombre al principio, y ved lo que le hice por la maldad de mi pueblo Israel.

verses.KJV: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the Lord, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
verses.WEB: Now, because you have done all these works,” says the LORD, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;
verses.ASV: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith Jehovah, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto agora, visto que vós tendes feito todas estas obras, diz o SENHOR, e vos falei, insistindo em falar, mas não ouvistes, e eu os chamei, mas não respondestes;
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues, por cuanto habéis vosotros hecho todas estas obras, dice Jehová, y bien que os hablé, madrugando para hablar, no oísteis, y os llamé, y no respondisteis;

verses.KJV: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.WEB: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
verses.ASV: therefore will I do unto the house which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Farei também a esta casa, que se chama pelo meu nome, em que vós confiais, e a este lugar que dei a vós e a vossos pais, tal como fiz a Siló:
verses.RVR09: Haré también á esta casa sobre la cual es invocado mi nombre, en la que vosotros confiáis, y á este lugar que dí á vosotros y á vuestros padres, como hice á Silo:

verses.KJV: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.WEB: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.
verses.ASV: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos lançarei fora de minha presença, tal como lancei a todos os vossos irmãos, toda a geração de Efraim.
verses.RVR09: Que os echaré de mi presencia como eché á todos vuestros hermanos, á toda la generación de Ephraim.

verses.KJV: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
verses.WEB: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.
verses.ASV: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me; for I will not hear thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso não ores tu por este povo, nem levantes por eles clamor nem oração, nem rogues a mim, pois eu não te ouvirei.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues, no ores por este pueblo, ni levantes por ellos clamor ni oración, ni me ruegues; porque no te oiré.

verses.KJV: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.WEB: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.ASV: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não vês o que eles costumam fazer nas cidades de Judá e nas ruas de Jerusalém?
verses.RVR09: ¿No ves lo que estos hacen en las ciudades de Judá y en las calles de Jerusalem?

verses.KJV: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.WEB: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.ASV: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink-offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os filhos coletam a lenha, e os pais acendem o fogo, e as mulheres amassam a massa, para fazerem bolos à rainha dos céus e dedicarem ofertas de bebidas a deuses estrangeiros, para me provocarem à ira.
verses.RVR09: Los hijos cogen la leña, y los padres encienden el fuego, y las mujeres amasan la masa, para hacer tortas á la reina del cielo y para hacer ofrendas á dioses ajenos, por provocarme á ira.

verses.KJV: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the Lord: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.WEB: Do they provoke me to anger?” says the LORD. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”
verses.ASV: Do they provoke me to anger? saith Jehovah; [do they] not [provoke] themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eles me provocam à ira?diz o SENHOR, eles não [acabam provocando mais] a si mesmos, para vergonha de seus próprios rostos?
verses.RVR09: ¿Provocaránme ellos á ira, dice Jehová, y no más bien obran ellos mismos para confusión de sus rostros?

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, mine anger and my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que que minha ira e meu furor serão derramados sobre este lugar: sobre os homens, sobre os animais, sobre as árvores do campo, e sobre os frutos da terra; e se acenderá, e não se apagará.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí que mi furor y mi ira se derrama sobre este lugar, sobre los hombres, sobre los animales, y sobre los árboles del campo, y sobre los frutos de la tierra; y encenderáse, y no se apagará.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt-offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat ye flesh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Acrescentai os vossos holocaustos aos vossos sacrifícios, e comei carne.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: Añadid vuestros holocaustos sobre vuestros sacrificios, y comed carne.

verses.KJV: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
verses.WEB: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;
verses.ASV: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt-offerings or sacrifices:
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não falei a vossos pais, nem lhes mandei, no dia em que os tirei da terra do Egito, coisa alguma sobre holocaustos ou sacrifícios;
verses.RVR09: Porque no hablé yo con vuestros padres, ni les mandé el día que los saqué de la tierra de Egipto, acerca de holocaustos y de víctimas:

verses.KJV: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
verses.WEB: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’
verses.ASV: but this thing I commanded them, saying, Hearken unto my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people; and walk ye in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.
verses.ALMEIDA: porém isto lhes mandei, dizendo: Escutai a minha voz, e eu serei vosso Deus, e vós sereis meu povo; e andai em todo o caminho que eu vos mandar, para que o bem vos aconteça.
verses.RVR09: Mas esto les mandé, diciendo: Escuchad mi voz, y seré á vosotros por Dios, y vosotros me seréis por pueblo; y andad en todo camino que os mandare, para que os vaya bien.

verses.KJV: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.WEB: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.ASV: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in [their own] counsels [and] in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles não ouviram, nem inclinaram seus ouvidos; ao invés disso, caminharam em [seus próprios] conselhos, na teimosia de seu coração maligno, e foram para trás, e não para frente.
verses.RVR09: Y no oyeron ni inclinaron su oído; antes caminaron en sus consejos, en la dureza de su corazón malvado, y fueron hacia atrás y no hacia adelante,

verses.KJV: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
verses.WEB: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.
verses.ASV: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day, I have sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o dia em que vossos pais saíram da terra do Egito até hoje, eu vos enviei a todos os meus servos os profetas, e enviando-os dia após dia.
verses.RVR09: Desde el día que vuestros padres salieron de la tierra de Egipto hasta hoy. Y os envié á todos los profetas mis siervos, cada día madrugando y enviándolos:

verses.KJV: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.WEB: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.
verses.ASV: yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eles não me ouviram, nem inclinaram seu ouvidos; ao invés disso, teimaram ainda mais, e fizeram pior que seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Mas no me oyeron ni inclinaron su oído; antes endurecieron su cerviz, é hicieron peor que sus padres.

verses.KJV: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
verses.WEB: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.
verses.ASV: And thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso tu lhes dirás todas estas palavras, mas eles não te ouvirão; e tu os chamarás, mas eles não te responderão.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues les dirás todas estas palabras, mas no te oirán; aun los llamarás, y no te responderán.

verses.KJV: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the Lord their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
verses.WEB: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to the LORD their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’
verses.ASV: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the nation that hath not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah their God, nor received instruction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então tu lhes dirás: Esta é a nação que não escutou a voz do SENHOR seu Deus, nem aceitou correção; a verdade pereceu, e foi cortada de suas bocas.
verses.RVR09: Les dirás por tanto: Esta es la gente que no escuchó la voz de Jehová su Dios, ni tomó corrección; perdióse la fe, y de la boca de ellos fué cortada.

verses.KJV: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the Lord hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.WEB: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.ASV: Cut off thy hair, [O Jerusalem], and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Jehovah hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tosquia o teu cabelo, e lança-o fora, e levanta pranto sobre os lugares altos; porque o SENHOR tem rejeitado e abandonado a nação que causou sua ira.
verses.RVR09: Trasquila tu cabello, y arrójalo, y levanta llanto sobre las alturas; porque Jehová ha aborrecido y dejado la nación de su ira.

verses.KJV: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the Lord: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
verses.WEB: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says the LORD. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.ASV: For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight, saith Jehovah: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque os filhos de Judá fizeram o mal perante meus olhos, diz o SENHOR; puseram suas abominações na casa que se chama pelo meu nome, para contaminá-la.
verses.RVR09: Porque los hijos de Judá han hecho lo malo ante mis ojos, dice Jehová; pusieron sus abominaciones en la casa sobre la cual mi nombre fué invocado, amancillándola.

verses.KJV: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
verses.WEB: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.
verses.ASV: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded not, neither came it into my mind.
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificaram os altos de Tofete, que ficam no vale do filho de Hinom, para queimarem no fogo seus filhos e suas filhas, o que eu nunca mandei, nem pensei em meu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y han edificado los altos de Topheth, que es en el valle del hijo de Hinnom, para quemar al fuego sus hijos y sus hijas, cosa que yo no les mandé, ni subió en mi corazón.

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
verses.WEB: Therefore behold, the days come”, says the LORD, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.
verses.ASV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that it shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of Slaughter: for they shall bury in Topheth, till there be no place [to bury].
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eis que virão dias, diz o SENHOR, que não se dirá mais Tofete, nem Vale do filho de Hinom, mas sim Vale da Matança; e serão enterrados em Tofete, por não haver lugar.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí vendrán días, ha dicho Jehová, que no se diga más, Topheth, ni valle del hijo de Hinnom, sino Valle de la Matanza; y serán enterrados en Topheth, por no haber lugar.

verses.KJV: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
verses.WEB: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.
verses.ASV: And the dead bodies of this people shall be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall frighten them away.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os cadáveres deste povo serão para comida das aves dos céus e dos animais da terra; e ninguém os espantará.
verses.RVR09: Y serán los cuerpos muertos de este pueblo para comida de las aves del cielo y de las bestias de la tierra; y no habrá quien las espante.

verses.KJV: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
verses.WEB: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”
verses.ASV: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land shall become a waste.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei cessar das cidades de Judá e da ruas de Jerusalém a voz de júbilo e voz de alegria, voz de noivo e voz de noiva; porque a terra se tornará desolação.
verses.RVR09: Y haré cesar de las ciudades de Judá, y de la calles de Jerusalem, voz de gozo y voz de alegría, voz de esposo y voz de esposa; porque la tierra será en desolación.

verses.KJV: At that time, saith the Lord, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
verses.WEB: “At that time,” says the LORD, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.
verses.ASV: At that time, saith Jehovah, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves;
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo, diz o SENHOR, tirarão os ossos dos reis de Judá, e os ossos de seus príncipes, e os ossos dos sacerdotes, e os ossos dos profetas, e os ossos dos moradores de Jerusalém, para fora de suas sepulturas;
verses.RVR09: EN aquel tiempo, dice Jehová, sacarán los huesos de los reyes de Judá, y los huesos de sus príncipes, y los huesos de los sacerdotes, y los huesos de los profetas, y los huesos de los moradores de Jerusalem, fuera de sus sepulcros;

verses.KJV: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.WEB: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.
verses.ASV: and they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, which they have loved, and which they have served, and after which they have walked, and which they have sought, and which they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried, they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os estenderão ao sol, à lua, e a todo o exército do céu, a quem amaram, e a quem serviram, e atrás de quem se foram, e a quem buscaram, e a quem se prostraram. Não serão recolhidos nem sepultados: serão por esterco sobre a superfície da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y los esparcirán al sol, y á la luna, y á todo el ejército del cielo, á quien amaron, y á quienes sirvieron, y en pos de quienes anduvieron, y á quienes preguntaron, y á quienes se encorvaron. No serán recogidos, ni enterrados: serán por muladar sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a morte será preferida à vida por todos os restantes que restarem desta má geração, que restarem em todos os lugares onde eu os lancei, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Y escogeráse la muerte antes que la vida por todo el resto que quedare de esta mala generación, en todos los lugares á donde los arrojaré yo á los que quedaren, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
verses.WEB: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says: “‘Do men fall, and not rise up again? Does one turn away, and not return?
