verses.ASV: therefore will I cast you forth out of this land into the land that ye have not known, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; for I will show you no favor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu vos lançarei fora desta terra, para uma terra que nem vós nem vossos pais conhecestes; e lá servireis a deuses estrangeiros de dia e de noite, porque não terei misericórdia de vós.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, yo os haré echar de esta tierra á tierra que ni vosotros ni vuestros padres habéis conocido, y allá serviréis á dioses ajenos de día y de noche; porque no os mostraré clemencia.

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.WEB: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that it will no more be said, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’
verses.ASV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that it shall no more be said, As Jehovah liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, que não se dirá mais: Vive o SENHOR, que trouxe os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito;
verses.RVR09: Empero he aquí, vienen días, dice Jehová, que no se dirá más: Vive Jehová, que hizo subir á los hijos de Israel de tierra de Egipto;

verses.KJV: But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
verses.WEB: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them.’ I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.
verses.ASV: but, As Jehovah liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries whither he had driven them. And I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sim: Vive o SENHOR, que trouxe os filhos de Israel da terra do norte, e de todas as terras aonde ele tinha os lançado; pois eu os farei voltar à sua terra, a qual dei a seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Sino: Vive Jehová, que hizo subir á los hijos de Israel de la tierra del aquilón, y de todas las tierras á donde los había arrojado: y volverélos á su tierra, la cual dí á sus padres.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
verses.WEB: “Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says the LORD, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith Jehovah, and they shall fish them up; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que enviarei muitos pescadores, diz o SENHOR, que os pescarão; e depois enviarei muitos caçadores, que os caçarão de todo monte, e de todo morro, e até das fendas das rochas.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que yo envío muchos pescadores, dice Jehová, y los pescarán; y después enviaré muchos cazadores, y los cazarán de todo monte, y de todo collado, y de las cavernas de los peñascos.

verses.KJV: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
verses.WEB: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.
verses.ASV: For mine eyes are upon all their ways; they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity concealed from mine eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois meus olhos estão sobre todos seus caminhos; eles não estão escondidos de mim, nem a maldade deles está oculta de diante de meus olhos.
verses.RVR09: Porque mis ojos están sobre todos sus caminos, los cuales no se me ocultaron, ni su maldad se esconde de la presencia de mis ojos.

verses.KJV: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
verses.WEB: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.”
verses.ASV: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled mine inheritance with their abominations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas primeiro pagarei em dobro a iniquidade e o pecado deles, pois contaminaram minha terra com os cadáveres de suas coisas detestáveis, e encheram minha herança de suas abominações.
verses.RVR09: Mas primero pagaré al doble su iniquidad y su pecado; porque contaminaron mi tierra con los cuerpos muertos de sus abominaciones, y de sus abominaciones llenaron mi heredad.

verses.KJV: O Lord, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
verses.WEB: LORD, my strength, my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the nations will come to you from the ends of the earth, and will say, “Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, vanity and things in which there is no profit.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, my strength, and my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, unto thee shall the nations come from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Our fathers have inherited nought but lies, [even] vanity and things wherein there is no profit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, fortaleza minha, e força minha, e meu refúgio no tempo da aflição; a ti virão nações desde os confins da terra, e dirão: Certamente o que nossos pais possuíam era mentira e inutilidade; não havia nessas coisas proveito algum.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, fortaleza mía, y fuerza mía, y refugio mío en el tiempo de la aflicción; á ti vendrán gentes desde los extremos de la tierra, y dirán: Ciertamente mentira poseyeron nuestros padres, vanidad, y no hay en ellos provecho.

verses.KJV: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
verses.WEB: Should a man make to himself gods which yet are no gods?”
verses.ASV: Shall a man make unto himself gods, which yet are no gods?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pode, por acaso, o homem fazer deuses para si? Eles, porém, não são deuses.
verses.RVR09: ¿Ha de hacer el hombre dioses para sí? mas ellos no son dioses.

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The Lord.
verses.WEB: “Therefore behold, I will cause them to know, this once I will cause them to know my hand and my might. Then they will know that my name is the LORD.”
verses.ASV: Therefore, behold, I will cause them to know, this once will I cause them to know my hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eis que desta vez lhes farei conhecer, lhes farei conhecer minha mão e meu poder, e saberão que EU-SOU é o meu nome.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí, les enseñaré de esta vez, enseñarles he mi mano y mi fortaleza, y sabrán que mi nombre es Jehová.

verses.KJV: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
verses.WEB: “The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond. It is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars.
verses.ASV: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, [and] with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the tablet of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
verses.ALMEIDA: O pecado de Judá está escrito com cinzel de ferro, com ponta de diamante; está esculpido na tábua de seu coração, e nas pontas de vossos altares;
verses.RVR09: EL pecado de Judá escrito está con cincel de hierro, y con punta de diamante: esculpido está en la tabla de su corazón, y en los lados de vuestros altares;

verses.KJV: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
verses.WEB: Even their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles by the green trees on the high hills.
verses.ASV: whilst their children remember their altars and their Asherim by the green trees upon the high hills.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto seus filhos se lembram de seus altares e de seus bosques, junto às árvores verdes, sobre os altos morros.
verses.RVR09: Cuando sus hijos se acuerdan de sus altares y de sus bosques, junto á los árboles verdes y en los collados altos.

verses.KJV: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.
verses.WEB: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.
verses.ASV: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures for a spoil, [and] thy high places, because of sin, throughout all thy borders.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó minha montanha no campo! Tua riqueza e todos os teus tesouros darei como despojo por causa do pecado de teus altos em todos teus limites.
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh mi montaña! tu hacienda en el campo y todos tus tesoros daré á saco, por el pecado de tus altos en todos tus términos.

verses.KJV: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.
verses.WEB: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever.”
verses.ASV: And thou, even of thyself, shalt discontinue from thy heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger which shall burn for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim por causa de ti deixarás de ter a herança que eu te dei, e te farei servir a teus inimigos em uma terra que não conheces; porque acendestes fogo em minha ira, que arderá para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y habrá en ti cesación de tu heredad, la cual yo te dí, y te haré servir á tus enemigos en tierra que no conociste; porque fuego habéis encendido en mi furor, para siempre arderá.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from the LORD.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: Cursed is the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Maldito o homem que confia no homem, e põe sua confiança na força humana, ) e seu coração se afasta do SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Maldito el varón que confía en el hombre, y pone carne por su brazo, y su corazón se aparta de Jehová.

verses.KJV: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.
verses.WEB: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.
verses.ASV: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh, but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, a salt land and not inhabited.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois será como um arbusto no deserto, e não sente quando vier o bem; ao invés disso morará nas securas no deserto, em terra salgada e inabitável.
verses.RVR09: Pues será como la retama en el desierto, y no verá cuando viniere el bien; sino que morará en las securas en el desierto, en tierra despoblada y deshabitada.

verses.KJV: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is.
verses.WEB: “Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.
verses.ASV: Blessed is the man that trusteth in Jehovah, and whose trust Jehovah is.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bendito o homem que confia no SENHOR, cuja confiança é o SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Bendito el varón que se fía en Jehová, y cuya confianza es Jehová.

verses.KJV: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.WEB: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.
verses.ASV: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, that spreadeth out its roots by the river, and shall not fear when heat cometh, but its leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ele será como a árvore plantada junto a águas, que estende suas raízes junto à corrente; não tem preocupação quando vier o calor, e sua folha permanece verde; e no ano de seca não se cansa, nem deixa de dar fruto.
verses.RVR09: Porque él será como el árbol plantado junto á las aguas, que junto á la corriente echará sus raices, y no verá cuando viniere el calor, sino que su hoja estará verde; y en el año de sequía no se fatigará, ni dejará de hacer fruto.

verses.KJV: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
verses.WEB: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
verses.ASV: The heart is deceitful above all things, and it is exceedingly corrupt: who can know it?
verses.ALMEIDA: O coração é mais enganoso que todas as coisas, e perverso; quem pode conhecê-lo?
verses.RVR09: Engañoso es el corazón más que todas las cosas, y perverso; ¿quién lo conocerá?

verses.KJV: I the Lord search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
verses.WEB: “I, the LORD, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.”
verses.ASV: I, Jehovah, search the mind, I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, o SENHOR, que examino o coração, e provo os sentimentos, para dar a cada um conforme seus caminhos, conforme o fruto de suas ações.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová, que escudriño el corazón, que pruebo los riñones, para dar á cada uno según su camino, según el fruto de sus obras.

verses.KJV: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
verses.WEB: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right. In the middle of his days, they will leave him. At his end, he will be a fool.
verses.ASV: As the partridge that sitteth on [eggs] which she hath not laid, so is he that getteth riches, and not by right; in the midst of his days they shall leave him, and at his end he shall be a fool.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Como] a perdiz que choca [os ovos] que não pôs, [assim] é o que junta riquezas, mas não com justiça; no meio de seus dias ele deixará de tê-las, e em seu fim ele será tolo.
verses.RVR09: Como la perdiz que cubre lo que no puso, es el que allega riquezas, y no con justicia; en medio de sus días las dejará, y en su postrimería será insipiente.

verses.KJV: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.WEB: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.ASV: A glorious throne, [set] on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.ALMEIDA: Trono de glória, elevado desde o princípio, é o lugar de nosso santuário.
verses.RVR09: Trono de gloria, excelso desde el principio, es el lugar de nuestro santuario.

verses.KJV: O Lord, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the Lord, the fountain of living waters.
verses.WEB: LORD, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be disappointed. Those who depart from me will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the spring of living waters.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be put to shame. They that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Jehovah, the fountain of living waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, esperança de Israel! Todos os que te abandonam serão envergonhados; e os que de mim se afastam, serão escritos no chão; pois abandonaram ao SENHOR, a fonte de águas vivas.
verses.RVR09: ¡Oh Jehová, esperanza de Israel! todos los que te dejan, serán avergonzados; y los que de mí se apartan, serán escritos en el polvo; porque dejaron la vena de aguas vivas, á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
verses.WEB: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.
verses.ASV: Heal me, O Jehovah, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sara-me, ó SENHOR, e serei sarado; salva-me, e serei salvo; pois tu és meu louvor.
verses.RVR09: Sáname, oh Jehová, y seré sano; sálvame, y seré salvo: porque tú eres mi alabanza.

verses.KJV: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the Lord? let it come now.
verses.WEB: Behold, they ask me, “Where is the LORD’s word? Let it be fulfilled now.”
verses.ASV: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of Jehovah? let it come now.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eles me dizem: Onde está a palavra do SENHOR? Cumpra-se ela agora!
verses.RVR09: He aquí que ellos me dicen: ¿Dónde está la palabra de Jehová? venga ahora.

verses.KJV: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.
verses.WEB: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which came out of my lips was before your face.
verses.ASV: As for me, I have not hastened from being a shepherd after thee; neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was before thy face.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu não me apressei para deixar de ser ser pastor após ti, nem desejei o dia de calamidade, tu o sabes. O que saiu de minha boca foi em tua presença.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo no me entrometí á ser pastor en pos de ti, ni deseé día de calamidad, tú lo sabes. Lo que de mi boca ha salido, fué en tu presencia.

verses.KJV: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.
verses.WEB: Don’t be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil.
verses.ASV: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my refuge in the day of evil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não sejas tu assombro para mim; tu és minha esperança no dia mal.
verses.RVR09: No me seas tú por espanto: esperanza mía eres tú en el día malo.

verses.KJV: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
verses.WEB: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but don’t let me be disappointed. Let them be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed. Bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
verses.ASV: Let them be put to shame that persecute me, but let not me be put to shame; let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed; bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Envergonhem-se os que me perseguem, e eu não me envergonhe; assombre-se eles, e eu não me assombre: traze sobre eles o dia mal, e destrói-os com destruição dobrada.
verses.RVR09: Avergüéncense los que me persiguen, y no me avergüence yo; asómbrense ellos, y yo no me asombre: trae sobre ellos día malo, y quebrántalos con doble quebrantamiento.

verses.KJV: Thus said the Lord unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.WEB: The LORD said this to me: “Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Thus said Jehovah unto me: Go, and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim me disse o SENHOR: Vai, e põe-te à porta dos filhos do povo, pela qual entram e saem os reis de Judá, e a todas as portas de Jerusalém,
verses.RVR09: Así me ha dicho Jehová: Ve, y ponte á la puerta de los hijos del pueblo, por la cual entran y salen los reyes de Judá, y á todas las puertas de Jerusalem,

verses.KJV: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the Lord, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
verses.WEB: Tell them, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
verses.ASV: and say unto them, Hear ye the word of Jehovah, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize-lhes: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, vós reis de Judá, e todo Judá, e todos os moradores de Jerusalém que entrais por esta portas;
verses.RVR09: Y diles: Oid la palabra de Jehová, reyes de Judá, y todo Judá, y todos los moradores de Jerusalem que entráis por estas puertas.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Guardai-vos por vossas vidas, e não tragais carga no dia do sábado, para fazê-las entrar pelas portas de Jerusalém;
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Guardaos por vuestras vidas, y no traigáis carga en el día del sábado, para meter por las puertas de Jerusalem;

verses.KJV: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.WEB: Don’t carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Don’t do any work, but make the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.ASV: neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work: but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem tireis carga de vossas casas no dia do sábado, nem façais obra alguma; ao invés disso, santificai o dia do sábado, assim como mandei a vossos pais;
verses.RVR09: Ni saquéis carga de vuestras casas en el día del sábado, ni hagáis obra alguna: mas santificad el día del sábado, como mandé á vuestros padres;

verses.KJV: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
verses.WEB: But they didn’t listen. They didn’t turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.
verses.ASV: But they hearkened not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles não deram ouvidos, nem escutaram; ao invés disso, tornaram-se teimosos, ) para não ouvirem, nem receberem correção.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos no oyeron, ni inclinaron su oído, antes endurecieron su cerviz, por no oir, ni recibir corrección.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the Lord, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
verses.WEB: It will happen, if you diligently listen to me,” says the LORD, “to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith Jehovah, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but to hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
verses.ALMEIDA: Será, pois, se vós me ouvirdes cuidadosamente, diz o SENHOR, não fazendo entrar carga pelas portas desta cidade no dia do sábado, e santificardes o dia do sábado, não fazendo nele nenhuma obra;
verses.RVR09: Será empero, si vosotros me obedeciereis, dice Jehová, no metiendo carga por las puertas de esta ciudad en el día del sábado, sino que santificareis el día del sábado, no haciendo en él ninguna obra;

verses.KJV: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
verses.WEB: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will remain forever.
verses.ASV: then shall there enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall remain for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então entrarão pelas portas desta cidade reis e os príncipes que se sentem sobre o trono de Davi, [montados] em carros e em cavalos; eles e seus príncipes, e os homens de Judá, e os moradores de Jerusalém; e esta cidade será habitada para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Que entrarán por las puertas de esta ciudad, en carros y en caballos, los reyes y los príncipes que se sientan sobre el trono de David, ellos y sus príncipes, los varones de Judá, y los moradores de Jerusalem: y esta ciudad será habitada para siempre.

verses.KJV: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: They will come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places round about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the lowland, and from the hill-country, and from the South, bringing burnt-offerings, and sacrifices, and meal-offerings, and frankincense, and bringing [sacrifices of] thanksgiving, unto the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E [pessoas] virão das cidades de Judá, dos arredores de Jerusalém, da terra de Benjamim, dos campos, do monte, e do Negueve, trazendo holocaustos, sacrifícios, ofertas de alimento e incensos, e trazendo sacrifícios de louvor à casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán de las ciudades de Judá, y de los alrededores de Jerusalem, y de tierra de Benjamín, y de los campos, y del monte, y del austro, trayendo holocausto y sacrificio, y ofrenda é incienso, y trayendo sacrificio de alabanza á la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.WEB: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem. It will not be quenched.”’”
verses.ASV: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se não me ouvirdes para santificardes o dia do sábado, e para não trazerdes carga nem fazê-la entrar pelas portas de Jerusalém no dia de sábado, eu acenderei fogo em suas portas, que consumirá os palácios de Jerusalém, e não se apagará.
verses.RVR09: Mas si no me oyereis para santificar el día del sábado, y para no traer carga ni meterla por las puertas de Jerusalem en día de sábado, yo haré encender fuego en sus puertas, y consumirá los palacios de Jerusalem, y no se apagará.

verses.KJV: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.WEB: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.ASV: The word which came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra que veio do SENHOR a Jeremias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: LA palabra que fué á Jeremías de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
verses.WEB: “Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”
verses.ASV: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta-te, e desce à casa do oleiro; e ali te farei ouvir minhas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Levántate, y vete á casa del alfarero, y allí te haré oir mis palabras.

verses.KJV: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
verses.WEB: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels.
verses.ASV: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he was making a work on the wheels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então desci à casa do oleiro, e eis que ele estava fazendo uma obra sobre a roda.
verses.RVR09: Y descendí á casa del alfarero, y he aquí que él hacía obra sobre la rueda.

verses.KJV: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.WEB: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.ASV: And when the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o vaso de barro que ele estava fazendo se quebrou na mão do oleiro; então ele voltou a fazer dele outro vaso, conforme o que ao oleiro pareceu melhor fazer.
verses.RVR09: Y el vaso que él hacía de barro se quebró en la mano del alfarero; y tornó é hízolo otro vaso, según que al alfarero pareció mejor hacerlo.

verses.KJV: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the Lord. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
verses.WEB: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says the LORD. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.
verses.ASV: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith Jehovah. Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are ye in my hand, O house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não poderei eu fazer de vós como este oleiro, ó casa de Israel?diz o SENHOR. Eis que tal como o barro na mão do oleiro, assim sois vós em minha mão, ó casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: ¿No podré yo hacer de vosotros como este alfarero, oh casa de Israel, dice Jehová? He aquí que como el barro en la mano del alfarero, así sois vosotros en mi mano, oh casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
verses.WEB: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it,
verses.ASV: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it;
verses.ALMEIDA: Caso em algum momento eu falar contra uma nação e contra um reino, para arrancar, dissipar, e destruir,
verses.RVR09: En un instante hablaré contra gentes y contra reinos, para arrancar, y disipar, y destruir.

verses.KJV: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
verses.WEB: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.
verses.ASV: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se tal nação se converter de sua maldade, contra a qual falei, eu mudarei de ideia quanto ao mal que tinha pensado lhe fazer.
verses.RVR09: Empero si esas gentes se convirtieren de su maldad, de que habré hablado, yo me arrepentiré del mal que había pensado hacerles.

verses.KJV: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
verses.WEB: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it,
verses.ASV: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
verses.ALMEIDA: Caso em algum momento eu falar de uma nação e de um reino, para edificar e para plantar;
verses.RVR09: Y en un instante hablaré de la gente y del reino, para edificar y para plantar;

verses.KJV: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
verses.WEB: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they don’t obey my voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them.
verses.ASV: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se ela fizer o mal diante dos meus olhos, não obedecendo à minha voz, eu mudarei de ideia quanto ao bem que tinha dito lhe fazer.
verses.RVR09: Pero si hiciere lo malo delante de mis ojos, no oyendo mi voz, arrepentiréme del bien que había determinado hacerle.

verses.KJV: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
verses.WEB: “Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a plan against you. Everyone return from his evil way now, and amend your ways and your doings.”’
verses.ASV: Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and amend your ways and your doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então agora, fala, pois, a todo homem de Judá, e aos moradores de Jerusalém, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que eu determino o mal contra vós, e faço planos contra vós; convertei-vos agora, cada um de seu mau caminho, e melhorai vossos caminhos e vossas ações.
verses.RVR09: Ahora pues habla luego á todo hombre de Judá, y á los moradores de Jerusalem, diciendo: Así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que yo dispongo mal contra vosotros, y trazo contra vosotros designios: conviértase ahora cada uno de su mal camino, y mejorad vuestros caminos y vuestras obras.

verses.KJV: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
verses.WEB: But they say, ‘It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.’”
verses.ASV: But they say, It is in vain; for we will walk after our own devices, and we will do every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém dizem: Não há esperança; porque seguiremos nossas [próprias] intenções, e faremos cada um o pensamento de seu maligno coração.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron: Es por demás: porque en pos de nuestras imaginaciones hemos de ir, y hemos de hacer cada uno el pensamiento de su malvado corazón.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD says: “Ask now among the nations, ‘Who has heard such things?’ The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Ask ye now among the nations, who hath heard such things; the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR: Perguntai agora entre as nações, quem tenha ouvido tal coisa. Grande horror fez a virgem de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así dijo Jehová: Preguntad ahora á las gentes, quién tal haya oído. Gran fealdad ha hecho la virgen de Israel.

verses.KJV: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
verses.WEB: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?
verses.ASV: Shall the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? [or] shall the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso pode faltar neve nas rochas das montanhas do Líbano? Ou pode deixar de haver as águas frias que correm de terras distantes?
verses.RVR09: ¿Faltará la nieve del Líbano de la piedra del campo? ¿faltarán las aguas frías que corren de lejanas tierras?

verses.KJV: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
verses.WEB: For my people have forgotten me. They have burned incense to false gods. They have been made to stumble in their ways in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up,
verses.ASV: For my people have forgotten me, they have burned incense to false [gods]; and they have been made to stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths, to walk in bypaths, in a way not cast up;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém meu povo se esqueceu de mim, queimando incenso à inutilidade, e fazem- lhes tropeçar em seus caminhos, [nas] veredas antigas, para que andassem por veredas de caminho não aplanado;
verses.RVR09: Porque mi pueblo me ha olvidado, incensando á la vanidad, y hácenles tropezar en sus caminos, en las sendas antiguas, para que caminen por sendas, por camino no hollado;

verses.KJV: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
verses.WEB: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and shake his head.
verses.ASV: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and shake his head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para tornar sua terra em desolação, e em assovios perpétuos; todo aquele que passar por ela se espantará e balançará sua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Para poner su tierra en desolación, y en silbos perpetuos; todo aquel que pasare por ella se maravillará, y meneará su cabeza.

verses.KJV: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
verses.WEB: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy. I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
verses.ASV: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como vento oriental, eu os espalharei diante do inimigo; eu lhes mostrarei as costas, e não o rosto, no dia de sua perdição.
verses.RVR09: Como viento solano los esparciré delante del enemigo; mostraréles las espaldas, y no el rostro, en el día de su perdición.

verses.KJV: Then said they, Come and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
verses.WEB: Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let’s strike him with the tongue, and let’s not give heed to any of his words.”
verses.ASV: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então disseram: Vinde, e façamos planos contra Jeremias; porque a Lei não perecerá do sacerdote, nem o conselho do sábio, nem a palavra do profeta. Vinde e o firamos com a língua, e não prestemos atenção a nenhuma de suas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron: Venid, y tracemos maquinaciones contra Jeremías; porque la ley no faltará del sacerdote, ni consejo del sabio, ni palabra del profeta. Venid é hirámoslo de lengua, y no miremos á todas sus palabras.

verses.KJV: Give heed to me, O Lord, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
verses.WEB: Give heed to me, LORD, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.
verses.ASV: Give heed to me, O Jehovah, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ó SENHOR, presta atenção a mim, e ouve a voz dos que brigam comigo.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová, mira por mí, y oye la voz de los que contienden conmigo.

verses.KJV: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.
verses.WEB: Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.
verses.ASV: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before thee to speak good for them, to turn away thy wrath from them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso se pagará ao bem com o mal? Pois já cavaram uma cova para a minha alma! Lembra-te que me pus diante de ti para falar pelo bem deles, para desviar deles a tua ira.
verses.RVR09: ¿Dase mal por bien, para que hayan cavado hoyo á mi alma? Acuérdate que me puse delante de ti para hablar bien por ellos, para apartar de ellos tu ira.

verses.KJV: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
verses.WEB: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives become childless and widows. Let their men be killed and their young men struck by the sword in battle.
verses.ASV: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword; and let their wives become childless, and widows; and let their men be slain of death, [and] their young men smitten of the sword in battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto entrega os filhos deles à fome, e derrama-os pelo poder da espada; e restem suas mulheres sem filhos e viúvas; e seus maridos sejam postos a morte, e seus rapazes sejam feridos à espada na guerra.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, entrega sus hijos á hambre, y hazlos derramar por medio de la espada; y queden sus mujeres sin hijos, y viudas; y sus maridos sean puestos á muerte, y sus jóvenes heridos á cuchillo en la guerra.

verses.KJV: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
verses.WEB: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me and hidden snares for my feet.
verses.ASV: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them; for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouçam-se gritos de suas casas, quando tu trouxeres tropas contra eles de repente; pois cavaram uma cova para me prender, e armaram laços para meus pés.
verses.RVR09: Oigase clamor de sus casas, cuando trajeres sobre ellos ejército de repente: porque cavaron hoyo para prenderme, y á mis pies han escondido lazos.

verses.KJV: Yet, Lord, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.
verses.WEB: Yet, LORD, you know all their counsel against me to kill me. Don’t forgive their iniquity. Don’t blot out their sin from your sight, Let them be overthrown before you. Deal with them in the time of your anger.
verses.ASV: Yet, Jehovah, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me; forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight; but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thou with them in the time of thine anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tu, SENHOR, conheces todo o plano deles contra mim para me matar; não perdoes sua maldade, nem apagues o pecado deles de diante de tua presença, e tropecem diante de ti; faze [assim] com eles no tempo de tua ira.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, oh Jehová, conoces todo su consejo contra mí para muerte; no perdones su maldad, ni borres su pecado de delante de tu rostro: y tropiecen delante de ti; haz así con ellos en el tiempo de tu furor.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
verses.WEB: Thus said the LORD, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests;
verses.ASV: Thus said Jehovah, Go, and buy a potter’s earthen bottle, and [take] of the elders of the people, and of the elders of the priests;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Vai, e compra uma jarra de barro de oleiro, e [toma contigo] dos anciãos do povo e dos anciãos dos sacerdotes;
verses.RVR09: ASÍ dijo Jehová: Ve, y compra una vasija de barro del alfarero, y lleva contigo de los ancianos del pueblo, y de los ancianos de los sacerdotes;

verses.KJV: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
verses.WEB: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I will tell you.
verses.ASV: and go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee;
verses.ALMEIDA: E sai ao vale do filho de Hinom, que fica à entrada da porta oriental; e ali declara as palavras que eu te disser.
verses.RVR09: Y saldrás al valle del hijo de Hinnom, que está á la entrada de la puerta oriental, y publicarás allí las palabras que yo te hablaré.

verses.KJV: And say, Hear ye the word of the Lord, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
verses.WEB: Say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.
verses.ASV: and say, Hear ye the word of Jehovah, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, ó reis de Judá, e moradores de Jerusalém. Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que trarei calamidade sobre este lugar, de tal modo que quem o ouvir, lhe retinirão os ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Dirás pues: Oid palabra de Jehová, oh reyes de Judá, y moradores de Jerusalem. Así dice Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: He aquí que yo traigo mal sobre este lugar, tal que quien lo oyere, le retiñan los oídos.

verses.KJV: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
verses.WEB: Because they have forsaken me, and have defiled this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn’t know—they, their fathers, and the kings of Judah—and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,
verses.ASV: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, that they knew not, they and their fathers and the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois me abandonaram, e profanaram este lugar, e queimaram nele incenso a outros deuses, que nunca tinham conhecido, nem eles, nem seus pais, nem os reis de Judá; e encheram este lugar com sangue de inocentes;
verses.RVR09: Porque me dejaron, y enajenaron este lugar, y ofrecieron en él perfumes á dioses ajenos, los cuales no habían ellos conocido, ni sus padres, ni los reyes de Judá; y llenaron este lugar de sangre de inocentes;

verses.KJV: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
verses.WEB: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.
verses.ASV: and have built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons in the fire for burnt-offerings unto Baal; which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
verses.ALMEIDA: E edificaram altares a Baal, para queimarem a fogo seus filhos [como] holocaustos a Baal; coisa esta que nunca [lhes] mandei, nem falei, nem jamais pensei em meu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y edificaron alto á Baal, para quemar con fuego sus hijos en holocaustos al mismo Baal; cosa que no les mandé, ni hablé, ni me vino al pensamiento.

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
verses.WEB: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.
verses.ASV: therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that this place shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of Slaughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eis vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, que este lugar não se chamará mais Tofete, nem Vale do filho de Hinom, mas sim Vale da Matança.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí vienen días, dice Jehová, que este lugar no se llamará más Topheth, ni Valle del hijo de Hinnom, sino Valle de la Matanza.

verses.KJV: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.WEB: “‘“I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.
verses.ASV: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies will I give to be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tornarei vazio o conselho de Judá e de Jerusalém neste lugar; e os farei cair à espada diante de seus inimigos, e nas mãos dos que buscam [tirar] suas vidas; e darei seus cadáveres por comida às aves do céu e aos animais da terra;
verses.RVR09: Y desvaneceré el consejo de Judá y de Jerusalem en este lugar; y haréles caer á cuchillo delante de sus enemigos, y en las manos de los que buscan sus almas; y daré sus cuerpos para comida de las aves del cielo y de las bestias de la tierra:

verses.KJV: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
verses.WEB: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.
verses.ASV: And I will make this city an astonishment, and a hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei desta cidade espanto e assovio; todo aquele que passar por ela se espantará e assoviará por causa de todas as suas pragas.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré á esta ciudad por espanto y silbo: todo aquel que pasare por ella se maravillará, y silbará sobre todas sus plagas.

verses.KJV: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
verses.WEB: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, will distress them.”’
verses.ASV: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters; and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend, in the siege and in the distress, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their life, shall distress them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei com que comam a carne de seus filhos e a carne de suas filhas; e cada um comerá a carne de seu próximo durante o cerco e a opressão com que os seus inimigos e os que buscam [tirar] suas vidas lhes oprimirão.
verses.RVR09: Y haréles comer la carne de sus hijos y la carne de sus hijas; y cada uno comerá la carne de su amigo, en el cerco y en el apuro con que los estrecharán sus enemigos y los que buscan sus almas.

verses.KJV: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
verses.WEB: “Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you,
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então quebrarás a jarra perante os olhos dos homens que tiverem ido contigo,
verses.RVR09: Y quebrarás la vasija ante los ojos de los varones que van contigo,

verses.KJV: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
verses.WEB: and shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again. They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.
verses.ASV: and shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again; and they shall bury in Topheth, till there be no place to bury.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Assim quebrarei a este povo e a esta cidade, como quem quebra um vaso de oleiro, que não pode mais ser restaurado; e em Tofete serão enterrados, pois não haverá [outro] lugar para enterrar.
verses.RVR09: Y les dirás: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Así quebrantaré á este pueblo y á esta ciudad, como quien quiebra un vaso de barro, que no puede más restaurarse; y en Topheth se enterrarán, porque no habrá otro lugar para enterrar.

verses.KJV: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the Lord, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
verses.WEB: This is what I will do to this place,” says the LORD, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.
verses.ASV: Thus will I do unto this place, saith Jehovah, and to the inhabitants thereof, even making this city as Topheth:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim farei a este lugar, diz o SENHOR, e a seus moradores, para fazer desta cidade como a Tofete.
verses.RVR09: Así haré á este lugar, dice Jehová, y á sus moradores, poniendo esta ciudad como Topheth.

verses.KJV: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
verses.WEB: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”
verses.ASV: and the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, shall be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink-offerings unto other gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as casas de Jerusalém, e as casas dos reis de Judá, serão imundas tal como o lugar de Tofete; todas as casas sobre cujos telhados foi queimado incenso a todo o exército do céu, e derramaram ofertas de bebida a deuses estrangeiros.
verses.RVR09: Y las casas de Jerusalem, y las casas de los reyes de Judá, serán como el lugar de Topheth inmundas, por todas las casas sobre cuyos tejados ofrecieron perfumes á todo el ejército del cielo, y vertieron libaciones á dioses ajenos.

verses.KJV: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the Lord had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the Lord's house; and said to all the people,
verses.WEB: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the LORD’s house, and said to all the people:
verses.ASV: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth, whither Jehovah had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of Jehovah’s house, and said to all the people:
verses.ALMEIDA: Então voltou Jeremias de Tofete, onde o SENHOR tinha lhe mandado profetizar, e se pôs em pé no pátio da casa do SENHOR, e disse a todo o povo:
verses.RVR09: Y volvió Jeremías de Topheth, á donde le envió Jehová á profetizar, y paróse en el atrio de la casa de Jehová, y dijo á todo el pueblo.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
verses.WEB: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.’”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it; because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que eu trago sobre esta cidade e sobre todas as suas vilas todo o mal que falei contra ela; pois endureceram seu pescoço para não ouvirem minhas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: He aquí yo traigo sobre esta ciudad y sobre todas sus villas todo el mal que hablé contra ella: porque han endurecido su cerviz, para no oir mis palabras.

verses.KJV: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the Lord, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
verses.WEB: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the LORD’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
verses.ASV: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the house of Jehovah, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Pasur, filho de Imer, o sacerdote, que era o principal supervisor na casa do SENHOR, ouviu a Jeremias enquanto profetizava estas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Y PASHUR sacerdote, hijo de Immer, que presidía por príncipe en la casa de Jehová, oyó á Jeremías que profetizaba estas palabras.

verses.KJV: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: Then Pashhur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então Pasur feriu ao profeta Jeremias, e o pôs no tronco que ficava à porta superior de Benjamim, a qual fica na casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: E hirió Pashur á Jeremías profeta, y púsole en el cepo que estaba á la puerta de Benjamín en lo alto, la cual conducía á la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The Lord hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magormissabib.
verses.WEB: On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “The LORD has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashhur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, Jehovah hath not called thy name Pashhur, but Magor-missabib.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foi no dia seguinte que Pasur tirou a Jeremias do tronco. Disse-lhe então Jeremias: O SENHOR não chama teu nome Pasur, mas sim “Terror por todos os lados”.
verses.RVR09: Y el día siguiente Pashur sacó á Jeremías del cepo. Díjole entonces Jeremías: Jehová no ha llamado tu nombre Pashur, sino Magor-missabib.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it; and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive to Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que eu farei de ti um terror a ti mesmo, e a todos os teus amigos; e cairão pelo espada de seus inimigos, e teus olhos o verão; e a todo Judá entregarei na mão do rei da Babilônia, e os levará cativos a Babilônia, e os ferirá à espada.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí yo te pondré en espanto á ti, y á todos los que bien te quieren, y caerán por el cuchillo de sus enemigos, y tus ojos lo verán: y á todo Judá entregaré en mano del rey de Babilonia, y los trasportará á Babilonia, y herirálos á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.WEB: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.ASV: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all the gains thereof, and all the precious things thereof, yea, all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies; and they shall make them a prey, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Entregarei também toda a riqueza desta cidade, e todo seu trabalho, e todas suas coisas preciosas; e entregarei todos os tesouros dos reis de Judá nas mãos de seus inimigos, e os saquearão, e os tomarão, e os levarão a Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Entregaré asimismo toda la sustancia de esta ciudad, y todo su trabajo, y todas sus cosas preciosas; y daré todos los tesoros de los reyes de Judá en manos de sus enemigos, y los saquearán, y los tomarán, y llevaránlos á Babilonia.

verses.KJV: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.
verses.WEB: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”
verses.ASV: And thou, Pashhur, and all that dwell in thy house shall go into captivity; and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and there shalt thou be buried, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied falsely.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, Pasur, e todos os moradores de tua casa ireis ao cativeiro, e entrarás na Babilônia, e ali morrerás; e ali serás sepultado, tu, e todos os teus amigos, aos quais profetizaste falsamente.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, Pashur, y todos los moradores de tu casa iréis cautivos, y entrarás en Babilonia, y allí morirás, y serás allá enterrado, tú, y todos los que bien te quieren, á los cuales has profetizado con mentira.

verses.KJV: O Lord, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived; thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
verses.WEB: LORD, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day. Everyone mocks me.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, thou hast persuaded me, and I was persuaded; thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am become a laughing-stock all the day, every one mocketh me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Persuadiste-me, ó SENHOR, e eu fiquei persuadido; mais forte foste que eu, e prevaleceste; sirvo de escárnio o dia todo; cada deles zomba de mim.
verses.RVR09: Alucinásteme, oh Jehová, y hállome frustrado: más fuerte fuiste que yo, y vencísteme: cada día he sido escarnecido; cada cual se burla de mí.

verses.KJV: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the Lord was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
verses.WEB: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because the LORD’s word has been made a reproach to me, and a derision, all day.
verses.ASV: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, Violence and destruction! because the word of Jehovah is made a reproach unto me, and a derision, all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois desde que falo, grito; eu clamo violência e destruição; pois a palavra do SENHOR tem me servido de insulto e zombaria o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Porque desde que hablo, doy voces, grito, Violencia y destrucción: porque la palabra de Jehová me ha sido para afrenta y escarnio cada día.

verses.KJV: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
verses.WEB: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.
verses.ASV: And if I say, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I am weary with forbearing, and I cannot [contain].
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: Não me lembrarei dele, nem falarei mais em seu nome; porém [ela] foi em meu coração como um fogo ardente contido em meus ossos; resisti até me cansar, mas não pude.
verses.RVR09: Y dije: No me acordaré más de él, ni hablaré más en su nombre: empero fué en mi corazón como un fuego ardiente metido en mis huesos, trabajé por sufrirlo, y no pude.

verses.KJV: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
verses.WEB: For I have heard the defaming of many: “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall. “Perhaps he will be persuaded, and we will prevail against him, and we will take our revenge on him.”
verses.ASV: For I have heard the defaming of many, terror on every side. Denounce, and we will denounce him, [say] all my familiar friends, they that watch for my fall; peradventure he will be persuaded, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque ouço a murmuração de muitos, temor por todos os lados: Anunciai, e anunciaremos. Todos os meus amigos observam meu manquejar, [dizendo] : Talvez se enganará; então prevaleceremos contra ele, e nos vingaremos dele.
verses.RVR09: Porque oí la murmuración de muchos, temor de todas partes: Denunciad, y denunciaremos. Todos mis amigos miraban si claudicaría. Quizá se engañará, decían, y prevaleceremos contra él, y tomaremos de él nuestra venganza.

verses.KJV: But the Lord is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
verses.WEB: But the LORD is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten.
verses.ASV: But Jehovah is with me as a mighty one [and] a terrible: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail; they shall be utterly put to shame, because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which shall never be forgotten.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas o SENHOR está comigo como temível guerreiro; por isso meus perseguidores tropeçarão, e não prevalecerão; eles serão muito envergonhados, por não terem agido prudentemente; [terão] humilhação perpétua, que jamais será esquecida.
verses.RVR09: Mas Jehová está conmigo como poderoso gigante; por tanto los que me persiguen tropezarán, y no prevalecerán; serán avergonzados en gran manera, porque no prosperarán; tendrán perpetua confusión que jamás será olvidada.

verses.KJV: But, O Lord of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
verses.WEB: But the LORD of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.
verses.ASV: But, O Jehovah of hosts, that triest the righteous, that seest the heart and the mind, let me see thy vengeance on them; for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, SENHOR dos exércitos, que examinas o justo, que vês os sentimentos e pensamentos, faz-me ver a tua vingança sobre eles; pois a ti revelei a minha causa.
verses.RVR09: Oh Jehová de los ejércitos, que sondas los justos, que ves los riñones y el corazón, vea yo tu venganza de ellos; porque á ti he descubierto mi causa.

verses.KJV: Sing unto the Lord, praise ye the Lord: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
verses.WEB: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
verses.ASV: Sing unto Jehovah, praise ye Jehovah; for he hath delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evil-doers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cantai ao SENHOR, louvai ao SENHOR; pois ele livra a alma do necessitado da mão dos malfeitores.
verses.RVR09: Cantad á Jehová, load á Jehová: porque librado ha el alma del pobre de mano de los malignos.

verses.KJV: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
verses.WEB: Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
verses.ASV: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito seja o dia em que nasci! O dia em que minha mãe me teve não seja bendito!
verses.RVR09: Maldito el día en que nací: el día en que mi madre me parió no sea bendito.

verses.KJV: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
verses.WEB: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.
verses.ASV: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man-child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito seja o homem que deu as novas a meu pai, dizendo, Um filho macho te nasceu, trazendo-lhe assim muita alegria.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el hombre que dió nuevas á mi padre, diciendo, Hijo varón te ha nacido, haciéndole alegrarse así mucho.

verses.KJV: And let that man be as the cities which the Lord overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
verses.WEB: Let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and didn’t repent. Let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime,
verses.ASV: And let that man be as the cities which Jehovah overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime;
verses.ALMEIDA: E seja tal homem como as cidades que o SENHOR assolou sem se arrepender; e ouça gritos de manhã, e clamores ao meio dia;
verses.RVR09: Y sea el tal hombre como las ciudades que asoló Jehová, y no se arrepintió: y oiga gritos de mañana, y voces al medio día;

verses.KJV: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.
verses.WEB: because he didn’t kill me from the womb. So my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.
verses.ASV: because he slew me not from the womb; and so my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por ele não ter me matado no ventre, de modo que minha mãe teria sido minha sepultura, e o ventre uma gravidez perpétua.
verses.RVR09: Porque no me mató en el vientre, y mi madre me hubiera sido mi sepulcro, y su vientre concebimiento perpetuo.

verses.KJV: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.WEB: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.ASV: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que saí do ventre? Para ver trabalho e dor, e meus dias serem gastos com vergonha?
verses.RVR09: ¿Para qué salí del vientre? ¿para ver trabajo y dolor, y que mis días se gastasen en afrenta?

verses.KJV: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
verses.WEB: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,
verses.ASV: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra que veio do SENHOR a Jeremias, quando o rei Zedequias lhe enviou a Pasur filho de Malquias, e a Sofonias, sacerdote, filho de Maaseias, para que lhe dissessem:
verses.RVR09: PALABRA que fué á Jeremías de Jehová, cuando el rey Sedechîas envió á él á Pashur hijo de Malchîas, y á Sephanías sacerdote, hijo de Maasías, que le dijesen:

verses.KJV: Enquire, I pray thee, of the Lord for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the Lord will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
verses.WEB: “Please inquire of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may withdraw from us.”
