verses.ASV: Inquire, I pray thee, of Jehovah for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us: peradventure Jehovah will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pergunta agora por nós ao SENHOR; pois Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, está fazendo guerra contra nós; talvez o SENHOR faça conosco segundo todas as suas maravilhas, e o mande embora de sobre nós.
verses.RVR09: Pregunta ahora por nosotros á Jehová; porque Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia hace guerra contra nosotros: quizá Jehová hará con nosotros según todas sus maravillas, y aquél se irá de sobre nosotros.

verses.KJV: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
verses.WEB: Then Jeremiah said to them, “Tell Zedekiah:
verses.ASV: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jeremias lhes disse: Direis assim a Zedequias:
verses.RVR09: Y Jeremías les dijo: Diréis así á Sedechîas:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
verses.WEB: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans that besiege you, without the walls; and I will gather them into the midst of this city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Eis que eu virarei para trás as armas de guerra que estão em vossas mãos, com as quais lutais contra o rei da Babilônia e os Caldeus que vos têm cercado fora da muralha; e eu os juntarei no meio desta cidade.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová Dios de Israel: He aquí yo vuelvo las armas de guerra que están en vuestras manos, y con que vosotros peleáis con el rey de Babilonia; y los Caldeos que os tienen cercados fuera de la muralla, yo los juntaré en medio de esta ciudad.

verses.KJV: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
verses.WEB: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.
verses.ASV: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu mesmo lutarei contra vós com mão estendida e com braço forte; e com ira, indignação, e grande furor.
verses.RVR09: Y pelearé contra vosotros con mano alzada y con brazo fuerte, y con furor, y enojo, é ira grande:

verses.KJV: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.WEB: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.
verses.ASV: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ferirei aos moradores desta cidade; tanto aos homens quanto aos animais; morrerão de grande pestilência.
verses.RVR09: Y heriré los moradores de esta ciudad; y los hombres y las bestias morirán de pestilencia grande.

verses.KJV: And afterward, saith the Lord, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
verses.WEB: Afterward,” says the LORD, “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, even those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. He will strike them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, have pity, or have mercy.”’
verses.ASV: And afterward, saith Jehovah, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, even such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E depois, assim diz o SENHOR, entregarei a Zedequias rei de Judá, e a seus servos, e ao povo, e aos que restarem na cidade da pestilência, da espada, e da fome, nas mãos de Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia, nas mãos de seus inimigos, e na mão dos que buscam [tirar] suas vidas. Ele os matará ao fio de espada; não lhes poupará, nem terá deles compaixão, nem misericórdia.
verses.RVR09: Y después, así dice Jehová, entregaré á Sedechîas rey de Judá, y á sus criados, y al pueblo, y á los que quedaren en la ciudad de la pestilencia, y del cuchillo, y del hambre, en mano de Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, y en mano de sus enemigos, y en mano de los que buscan sus almas; y él los herirá á filo de espada; no los perdonará, ni los recibirá á merced, ni tendrá de ellos misericordia.

verses.KJV: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
verses.WEB: “You shall say to this people, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.ASV: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a este povo dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que ponho diante de vós caminho de vida e caminho de morte.
verses.RVR09: Y á este pueblo dirás: Así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí pongo delante de vosotros camino de vida y camino de muerte.

verses.KJV: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
verses.WEB: He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he will live, and he will escape with his life.
verses.ASV: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he that goeth out, and passeth over to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Aquele que permanecer nesta cidade, morrerá a espada, ou pela fome, ou pela pestilência; mas o que sair e se render aos Caldeus, que têm vos cercado, viverá, e terá sua vida como despojo.
verses.RVR09: El que se quedare en esta ciudad, morirá á cuchillo, ó de hambre, ó pestilencia: mas el que saliere, y se pasare á los Caldeos que os tienen cercados, vivirá, y su vida le será por despojo.

verses.KJV: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the Lord: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.WEB: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good,” says the LORD. “It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.”’
verses.ASV: For I have set my face upon this city for evil, and not for good, saith Jehovah: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque pus meu rosto contra esta cidade para o mal, e não para o bem, diz o SENHOR; nas mãos do rei de Babilônia será entregue, e ele a queimará a fogo.
verses.RVR09: Porque mi rostro he puesto contra esta ciudad para mal, y no para bien, dice Jehová: en mano del rey de Babilonia será entregada, y quemarála á fuego.

verses.KJV: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the Lord;
verses.WEB: “Concerning the house of the king of Judah, hear the LORD’s word:
verses.ASV: And touching the house of the king of Judah, hear ye the word of Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E à casa do rei de Judá dirás: Ouvi palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y á la casa del rey de Judá dirás: Oid palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: O house of David, thus saith the Lord; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.WEB: House of David, the LORD says, ‘Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.ASV: O house of David, thus saith Jehovah, Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him that is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Casa de Davi, assim diz o SENHOR: Julgai de manhã com justiça, e livrai a vítima de roubo da mão do opressor; para que minha ira não saia como fogo, e incendeie de modo que não haja quem apague, por causa da maldade de vossas ações.
verses.RVR09: Casa de David, así dijo Jehová: Juzgad de mañana juicio, y librad al oprimido de mano del opresor; porque mi ira no salga como fuego, y se encienda, y no haya quien apague, por la maldad de vuestras obras.

verses.KJV: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, saith the Lord; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
verses.WEB: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain,’ says the LORD. ‘You that say, “Who would come down against us?” or, “Who would enter into our homes?”
verses.ASV: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, [and] of the rock of the plain, saith Jehovah; you that say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu [sou] contra ti, ó moradora do vale, da rocha do planalto, diz o SENHOR; [contra] vós que dizeis: Quem descerá contra nós? E quem entrará em nossas moradas?
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo contra ti, moradora del valle de la piedra de la llanura, dice Jehová: los que decís: ¿Quién subirá contra nosotros? ¿y quién entrará en nuestras moradas?

verses.KJV: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the Lord: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
verses.WEB: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all that is around her.’”
verses.ASV: And I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith Jehovah; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all that is round about her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos punirei conforme o fruto de vossas ações, diz o SENHOR, e acenderei fogo em seu bosque, que consumirá tudo o que estiver ao redor dela.
verses.RVR09: Yo os visitaré conforme al fruto de vuestras obras, dice Jehová, y haré encender fuego en su breña, y consumirá todo lo que está alrededor de ella.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
verses.WEB: The LORD said, “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there:
verses.ASV: Thus said Jehovah: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Desce à casa do rei de Judá, e fala ali esta palavra,
verses.RVR09: ASÍ dijo Jehová: Desciende á la casa del rey de Judá, y habla allí esta palabra,

verses.KJV: And say, Hear the word of the Lord, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
verses.WEB: ‘Hear the LORD’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne—you, your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.
verses.ASV: and say, Hear the word of Jehovah, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize: Ouve a palavra do SENHOR, ó rei de Judá, que te sentas sobre o trono de Davi; tu, teus servos, e teu povo, que entrais por estas portas.
verses.RVR09: Y di: Oye palabra de Jehová, oh rey de Judá que estás sentado sobre el trono de David, tú, y tus criados, y tu pueblo que entran por estas puertas.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: Execute ye justice and righteousness, and deliver him that is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence, to the sojourner, the fatherless, nor the widow; neither shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Fazei juízo e justiça, e livrai a vítima de roubo da mão do opressor, e não oprimais, nem façais violência contra o estrangeiro, o órfão, ou à viúva, nem derrameis sangue inocente neste lugar.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Haced juicio y justicia, y librad al oprimido de mano del opresor, y no engañéis ni robéis al extranjero, ni al huérfano, ni á la viuda, ni derraméis sangre inocente en este lugar.

verses.KJV: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
verses.WEB: For if you do this thing indeed, then kings sitting on David’s throne will enter in by the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses—they, their servants, and their people.
verses.ASV: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque se verdadeiramente cumprirdes esta palavra, os reis que se sentam em lugar de Davi sobre seu trono entrarão montados sobre carruagens e sobre cavalos pelas portas desta casa; eles, e seus servos, e seu povo.
verses.RVR09: Porque si efectivamente hiciereis esta palabra, los reyes que en lugar de David se sientan sobre su trono, entrarán montados en carros y en caballos por las puertas de esta casa, ellos, y sus criados, y su pueblo.

verses.KJV: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the Lord, that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.WEB: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself,” says the LORD, “that this house will become a desolation.”’”
verses.ASV: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith Jehovah, that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se não obedecerdes estas palavras, por mim mesmo tenho jurado, diz o SENHOR, que esta casa se tornará deserta.
verses.RVR09: Mas si no oyereis estas palabras, por mí he jurado, dice Jehová, que esta casa será desierta.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord unto the king's house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah concerning the house of the king of Judah: Thou art Gilead unto me, [and] the head of Lebanon; [yet] surely I will make thee a wilderness, [and] cities which are not inhabited.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR quanto à casa do rei de Judá: Tu és para mim [como] Gileade, [e] o topo do Líbano; porém certamente te tornarei em deserto, [e] cidades desabitadas.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová sobre la casa del rey de Judá: Galaad eres tú para mí, y cabeza del Líbano: empero de cierto te pondré en soledad, y ciudades deshabitadas.

verses.KJV: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
verses.WEB: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons, and they will cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
verses.ASV: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons; and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois prepararei contra ti destruidores, cada um com suas armas; e cortarão teus mais valiosos cedros, e os lançarão no fogo.
verses.RVR09: Y señalaré contra ti disipadores, cada uno con sus armas; y cortarán tus cedros escogidos, y los echarán en el fuego.

verses.KJV: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this great city?
verses.WEB: “Many nations will pass by this city, and they will each ask his neighbor, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this great city?’
verses.ASV: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbor, Wherefore hath Jehovah done thus unto this great city?
verses.ALMEIDA: E muitas nações passarão junto a esta cidade; e cada um dirá a seu companheiro: Por que o SENHOR fez isto com esta grande cidade?
verses.RVR09: Y muchas gentes pasarán junto á esta ciudad, y dirán cada uno á su compañero: ¿Por qué lo hizo así Jehová con esta grande ciudad?

verses.KJV: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
verses.WEB: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”
verses.ASV: Then they shall answer, Because they forsook the covenant of Jehovah their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E responderão: Porque deixaram o pacto do SENHOR seu Deus, e adoraram a deuses estrangeiros, e os serviram.
verses.RVR09: Y dirán: Porque dejaron el pacto de Jehová su Dios, y adoraron dioses ajenos, y les sirvieron.

verses.KJV: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
verses.WEB: Don’t weep for the dead. Don’t bemoan him; but weep bitterly for him who goes away, for he will return no more, and not see his native country.
verses.ASV: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him; but weep sore for him that goeth away; for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não choreis pelo morto, nem dele vos lastimeis; mas chorai mesmo por aquele que vai embora; porque nunca mais voltará, nem verá a terra onde nasceu.
verses.RVR09: No lloréis al muerto, ni de él os condolezcáis: llorad amargamente por el que va; porque no volverá jamás, ni verá la tierra donde nació.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
verses.WEB: For the LORD says touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went out of this place: “He won’t return there any more.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, [and] who went forth out of this place: He shall not return thither any more;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR quanto a Salum, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, que reinava em lugar de Josias seu pai, que saiu deste lugar: Nunca mais voltará;
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová, de Sallum hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, que reina por Josías su padre, que salió de este lugar: No volverá acá más;

verses.KJV: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
verses.WEB: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”
verses.ASV: but in the place whither they have led him captive, there shall he die, and he shall see this land no more.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, morrerá no lugar aonde o levaram cativo, e nunca mais verá esta terra.
verses.RVR09: Antes morirá en el lugar adonde lo trasportaren, y no verá más esta tierra.

verses.KJV: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;
verses.WEB: “Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service without wages, and doesn’t give him his hire;
verses.ASV: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by injustice; that useth his neighbor’s service without wages, and giveth him not his hire;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai daquele que edifica sua casa com injustiça, e seus cômodos sem fazer o que é correto, que usa do serviço de seu próximo de graça, sem lhe dar o pagamento de seu trabalho!
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay del que edifica su casa y no en justicia, y sus salas y no en juicio, sirviéndose de su prójimo de balde, y no dándole el salario de su trabajo!

verses.KJV: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
verses.WEB: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’ and cuts out windows for himself, with a cedar ceiling, and painted with red.
verses.ASV: that saith, I will build me a wide house and spacious chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is ceiled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que diz: Edificarei para mim uma casa ampla, com cômodos arejados; e lhe abre janelas, e a cobre de cedro, e a pinta de vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Que dice: Edificaré para mí casa espaciosa, y airosas salas; y le abre ventanas, y la cubre de cedro, y la pinta de bermellón.

verses.KJV: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
verses.WEB: “Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.
verses.ASV: Shalt thou reign, because thou strivest to excel in cedar? Did not thy father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? then it was well with him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso é acumulando cedro que serás rei? Por acaso teu pai não comeu e bebeu, e fez juízo e justiça, [e] então teve o bem?
verses.RVR09: ¿Reinarás porque te cercas de cedro? ¿no comió y bebió tu padre, é hizo juicio y justicia, y entonces le fué bien?

verses.KJV: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so then it was well. Wasn’t this to know me?” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well. Was not this to know me? saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele julgou a causa do aflito e do necessitado, e então esteve bem. Por acaso conhecer a mim não é isto?diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El juzgó la causa del afligido y del menesteroso, y entonces estuvo bien. ¿No es esto conocerme á mí? dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
verses.WEB: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing violence.”
verses.ASV: But thine eyes and thy heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for shedding innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas teus olhos e teu coração não são [para outra coisa] , a não ser para tua ganância, para derramar sangue inocente, e para praticar opressão e violência.
verses.RVR09: Mas tus ojos y tu corazón no son sino á tu avaricia, y á derramar la sangre inocente, y á opresión, y á hacer agravio.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They won’t lament for him, saying, ‘Ah my brother!’ or, ‘Ah sister!’ They won’t lament for him, saying ‘Ah lord!’ or, ‘Ah his glory!’
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: they shall not lament for him, [saying], Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! They shall not lament for him, [saying] Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR quanto a Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá: Não lamentarão por ele, dizendo: Ai meu irmão!, ou Ai minha irmã!, Nem lamentarão por ele, dizendo: Ai senhor! Ai sua majestade!
verses.RVR09: Por tanto así ha dicho Jehová, de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá: No lo llorarán, diciendo: ¡Ay hermano mío! y ¡ay hermana! ni lo lamentarán, diciendo: ¡Ay señor! ¡ay su grandeza!

verses.KJV: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.”
verses.ASV: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com sepultamento de asno será sepultado; arrastando e lançando [-o] longe, fora das portas de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: En sepultura de asno será enterrado, arrastrándole y echándole fuera de las puertas de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
verses.WEB: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry out. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.
verses.ASV: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all thy lovers are destroyed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobe ao Líbano, e clama, levanta tua voz em Basã, e grita desde Abarim; porque todos teus amantes estão destruídos.
verses.RVR09: Sube al Líbano, y clama, y en Basán da tu voz, y grita hacia todas partes; porque todos tus enamorados son quebrantados.

verses.KJV: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.
verses.WEB: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from your youth, that you didn’t obey my voice.
verses.ASV: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.
verses.ALMEIDA: Falei contigo em tuas prosperidades; [mas] disseste: Não ouvirei. Este tem sido o teu caminho desde tua juventude, que nunca deste ouvidos à minha voz.
verses.RVR09: Hete hablado en tus prosperidades; mas dijiste: No oiré. Este fué tu camino desde tu juventud, que nunca oiste mi voz.

verses.KJV: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
verses.WEB: The wind will feed all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.
verses.ASV: The wind shall feed all thy shepherds, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: O vento apascentará a todos os teus pastores, e teus amantes irão ao cativeiro; então certamente te envergonharás e te humilharás por causa de toda a tua maldade.
verses.RVR09: A todos tus pastores pacerá el viento, y tus enamorados irán en cautiverio: entonces te avergonzarás y te confundirás á causa de toda tu malicia.

verses.KJV: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.WEB: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.ASV: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, que habitas no Líbano, que fazes teu ninho nos cedros: como gemerás quando te vierem as dores, os sofrimentos como de mulher em parto!
verses.RVR09: Habitaste en el Líbano, hiciste tu nido en los cedros: ¡cómo gemirás cuando te vinieren dolores, dolor como de mujer que está de parto!

verses.KJV: As I live, saith the Lord, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
verses.WEB: “As I live,” says the LORD, “though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, I would still pluck you from there.
verses.ASV: As I live, saith Jehovah, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivo eu,diz o SENHOR, que se Conias, filho de Jeoaquim rei de Judá, fosse um anel em minha mão direita, até dali eu te arrancaria;
verses.RVR09: Vivo yo, dice Jehová, que si Conías hijo de Joacím rey de Judá fuese anillo en mi mano diestra, aun de allí te arrancaré;

verses.KJV: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.WEB: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.ASV: and I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them of whom thou art afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu te entregarei na mão dos que buscam a tua vida, e na mão daqueles a quem tu temes: na mão de Nabucodonosor rei da Babilônia, e nas mão dos Caldeus.
verses.RVR09: Y te entregaré en mano de los que buscan tu alma, y en mano de aquellos cuya vista temes; sí, en mano de Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, y en mano de los Caldeos.

verses.KJV: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
verses.WEB: I will cast you out with your mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.
verses.ASV: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lançarei a ti e a tua mãe, que te fez nascer, em uma terra estrangeira, em que não nascestes; e lá morrereis.
verses.RVR09: Y hacerte he trasportar, á ti, y á tu madre que te parió, á tierra ajena en que no nacisteis; y allá moriréis.

verses.KJV: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
verses.WEB: But to the land to which their soul longs to return, there they will not return.”
verses.ASV: But to the land whereunto their soul longeth to return, thither shall they not return.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a terra à qual suas almas anseiam voltar, para lá nunca voltarão.
verses.RVR09: Y á la tierra á la cual levantan ellos su alma para tornar, allá no volverán.

verses.KJV: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
verses.WEB: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? Is he a vessel in which no one delights? Why are they cast out, he and his offspring, and cast into a land which they don’t know?
verses.ASV: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? is he a vessel wherein none delighteth? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into the land which they know not?
verses.ALMEIDA: É este homem Conias um pote quebrado, ou um vaso de quem ninguém se agrada? Por que ele e sua geração foram arremessados fora, e lançados a uma terra que não conhecem?
verses.RVR09: ¿Es este hombre Conías un ídolo vil quebrado? ¿es vaso con quien nadie se deleita? ¿Por qué fueron arrojados, él y su generación, y echados á tierra que no habían conocido?

verses.KJV: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.WEB: O earth, earth, earth, hear the LORD’s word!
verses.ASV: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Terra, terra, terra: ouve a palavra do SENHOR!
verses.RVR09: ¡Tierra, tierra, tierra! oye palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper, sitting on David’s throne and ruling in Judah.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days; for no more shall a man of his seed prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling in Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Escrevei este homem como sem filhos, homem a quem nada prosperará nos dias de sua vida; pois nenhum homem de sua semente prosperará em se sentar sobre o trono de Davi, e em reinar em Judá.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Escribid que será este hombre privado de generación, hombre á quien nada sucederá prósperamente en todos los días de su vida: porque ningún hombre de su simiente que se sentare sobre el trono de David, y que se enseñoreare sobre Judá, será jamás dichoso.

verses.KJV: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Woe unto the shepherds that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai dos pastores que destroem e dispersam as ovelhas de meu rebanho!,Diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ¡AY de los pastores que desperdician y derraman las ovejas de mi majada! dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, against the shepherds that feed my people: Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them; behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel quanto aos pastores que apascentam meu povo: Vós dispersastes minhas ovelhas, e as afugentastes, e não cuidastes delas; eis que eu cuidarei contra vós pela maldade de vossas ações,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová Dios de Israel á los pastores que apacientan mi pueblo: Vosotros derramasteis mis ovejas, y las espantasteis, y no las habéis visitado: he aquí que yo visito sobre vosotros la maldad de vuestras obras, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.WEB: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.
verses.ASV: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and multiply.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu mesmo recolherei o restante de minhas ovelhas de todas as terras para onde as afugentei, e as farei voltar a seus apriscos; e crescerão, e se multiplicarão.
verses.RVR09: Y yo recogeré el resto de mis ovejas de todas las tierras adonde las eché, y harélas volver á sus moradas; y crecerán, y se multiplicarán.

verses.KJV: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be lacking,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And I will set up shepherds over them, who shall feed them; and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall any be lacking, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei sobre elas pastores que as apascentem; e nunca mais temerão, nem se assombrarão, nem haverá falta de uma sequer,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré sobre ellas pastores que las apacienten; y no temerán más, ni se asombrarán, ni serán menoscabadas, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
verses.WEB: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.ASV: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vêm os dias,diz o SENHOR, que levantarei por Davi um justo Renovo, e sendo rei, reinará; o qual prosperará, e fará juízo e justiça na terra.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que vienen los días, dice Jehová, y despertaré á David renuevo justo, y reinará Rey, el cual será dichoso, y hará juicio y justicia en la tierra.

verses.KJV: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, The Lord Our Righteousness.
verses.WEB: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: The LORD our righteousness.
verses.ASV: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely; and this is his name whereby he shall be called: Jehovah our righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em seus dias Judá será salvo, e Israel habitará em segurança; e este será seu nome com que o chamarão: O SENHOR é nossa justiça.
verses.RVR09: En sus días será salvo Judá, é Israel habitará confiado: y este será su nombre que le llamarán: JEHOVÁ, JUSTICIA NUESTRA.

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that they shall no more say, The Lord liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.WEB: “Therefore, behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that they will no more say, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’
verses.ASV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that they shall no more say, As Jehovah liveth, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eis que vêm dias,diz o SENHOR, que não mais dirão: Vive o SENHOR, que fez subir os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí que vienen días, dice Jehová, y no dirán más: Vive Jehová que hizo subir los hijos de Israel de la tierra de Egipto;

verses.KJV: But, The Lord liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.WEB: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”
verses.ASV: but, As Jehovah liveth, who brought up and who led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries whither I had driven them. And they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sim: Vive o SENHOR, que fez subir e trouxe a geração da casa de Israel da terra do norte, e de todas as terras para onde eu os afugentei; e habitarão em sua terra.
verses.RVR09: Sino: Vive Jehová que hizo subir y trajo la simiente de la casa de Israel de tierra del aquilón, y de todas las tierras adonde los había yo echado; y habitarán en su tierra.

verses.KJV: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the Lord, and because of the words of his holiness.
verses.WEB: Concerning the prophets: My heart within me is broken. All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of the LORD, and because of his holy words.
verses.ASV: Concerning the prophets. My heart within me is broken, all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of Jehovah, and because of his holy words.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto aos profetas: meu coração está quebrantado em meu interior, todos os meus ossos tremem; estou como um homem bêbado, como um homem dominado pelo vinho, por causa do SENHOR, e por causa de suas santas palavras.
verses.RVR09: A causa de los profetas mi corazón está quebrantado en medio de mí, todos mis huesos tiemblan; estuve como hombre borracho, y como hombre á quien dominó el vino, delante de Jehová y delante de las palabras de su santidad.

verses.KJV: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
verses.WEB: “For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;
verses.ASV: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pastures of the wilderness are dried up. And their course is evil, and their might is not right;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois a terra está cheia de adúlteros: e por causa da maldição a terra lamenta; as cabanas do deserto se secaram; pois o percurso deles tem sido mau, e a força deles não é correta.
verses.RVR09: Porque la tierra está llena de adúlteros: porque á causa del juramento la tierra está desierta; las cabañas del desierto se secaron; la carrera de ellos fué mala, y su fortaleza no derecha.

verses.KJV: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: for both prophet and priest are profane. Yes, in my house I have found their wickedness,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: for both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tanto o profeta como o sacerdote são corruptos; até em minha casa achei sua maldade,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque así el profeta como el sacerdote son fingidos: aun en mi casa hallé su maldad, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery places in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto o caminho deles lhes será como lugares escorregadios na escuridão; serão empurrados, e nele cairão; porque eu trarei mal sobre eles [no] ano de sua punição,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, como resbaladeros en oscuridad les será su camino: serán empujados, y caerán en él: porque yo traeré mal sobre ellos, año de su visitación, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.WEB: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.ASV: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nos profetas de Samaria vi coisas desagradáveis: profetizavam por Baal, e faziam errar a meu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y en los profetas de Samaria he visto desatinos: profetizaban en Baal, é hicieron errar á mi pueblo Israel.

verses.KJV: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness; they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.WEB: In the prophets of Jerusalem I have also seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one returns from his wickedness. They have all become to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.”
verses.ASV: In the prophets of Jerusalem also I have seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies; and they strengthen the hands of evil-doers, so that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them become unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas nos profetas de Jerusalém tenho vejo coisas horríveis: cometem adultérios, e andam com falsidade, e fortalecem as mãos dos malfeitores, para que ninguém se converta de sua maldade. Para mim, todos eles são como Sodoma, e seus moradores como Gomorra.
verses.RVR09: Y en los profetas de Jerusalem he visto torpezas: cometían adulterios, y andaban en mentiras, y esforzaban las manos de los malos, para que ninguno se convirtiese de su malicia: fuéronme todos ellos como Sodoma, y sus moradores como Gomorra.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink poisoned water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land.”
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts concerning the prophets: Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall; for from the prophets of Jerusalem is ungodliness gone forth into all the land.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos sobre os profetas: Eis que eu lhes darei de comer absinto, e lhes farei beber águas envenenadas; porque dos profetas de Jerusalém a corrupção se espalhou sobre toda a terra.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos contra aquellos profetas: He aquí que yo les hago comer ajenjos, y les haré beber aguas de hiel; porque de los profetas de Jerusalem salió la hipocresía sobre toda la tierra.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says, “Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They teach you vanity. They speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they teach you vanity; they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Não deis ouvidos às palavras dos profetas que profetizam para vós; eles vos iludem; falam visão de seus próprios corações, e não da boca do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: No escuchéis las palabras de los profetas que os profetizan: os hacen desvanecer; hablan visión de su corazón, no de la boca de Jehová.

verses.KJV: They say still unto them that despise me, The Lord hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
verses.WEB: They say continually to those who despise me, ‘The LORD has said, “You will have peace;”’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, ‘No evil will come on you.’
verses.ASV: They say continually unto them that despise me, Jehovah hath said, Ye shall have peace; and unto every one that walketh in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, No evil shall come upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dizem continuamente aos que me desprezam: O SENHOR diz: Tereis paz; E a qualquer um que segue a teimosia de seu [próprio] coração, dizem: Não virá mal algum sobre vós.
verses.RVR09: Dicen atrevidamente á los que me irritan: Jehová dijo: Paz tendréis; y á cualquiera que anda tras la imaginación de su corazón, dijeron: No vendrá mal sobre vosotros.

verses.KJV: For who hath stood in the counsel of the Lord, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?
verses.WEB: For who has stood in the council of the LORD, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and heard it?
verses.ASV: For who hath stood in the council of Jehovah, that he should perceive and hear his word? who hath marked my word, and heard it?
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois quem esteve no conselho do SENHOR, e viu e ouviu sua palavra? Quem prestou atenção a sua palavra, e [a] ouviu?
verses.RVR09: Porque ¿quién estuvo en el secreto de Jehová, y vió, y oyó su palabra? ¿quién estuvo atento á su palabra, y oyó?

verses.KJV: Behold, a whirlwind of the Lord is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.
verses.ASV: Behold, the tempest of Jehovah, [even his] wrath, is gone forth, yea, a whirling tempest: it shall burst upon the head of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que a tempestade da ira do SENHOR já saiu; e a tempestade é violenta, que atingirá violentamente sobre a cabeça dos maus.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que la tempestad de Jehová saldrá con furor; y la tempestad que está aparejada, caerá sobre la cabeza de los malos.

verses.KJV: The anger of the Lord shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger will not return until he has executed and performed the intents of his heart. In the latter days, you will understand it perfectly.
verses.ASV: The anger of Jehovah shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall understand it perfectly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não se afastará a ira do SENHOR, enquanto não tiver executado e cumprido os pensamentos de seu coração; nos últimos dias entendereis isso claramente.
verses.RVR09: No se apartará el furor de Jehová, hasta tanto que haya hecho, y hasta tanto que haya cumplido los pensamientos de su corazón: en lo postrero de los días lo entenderéis cumplidamente.

verses.KJV: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.WEB: I didn’t send these prophets, yet they ran. I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.ASV: I sent not these prophets, yet they ran: I spake not unto them, yet they prophesied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu não enviei aqueles profetas, porém eles foram correndo; eu não lhes falei, porém eles profetizaram.
verses.RVR09: No envié yo aquellos profetas, y ellos corrían: yo no les hablé, y ellos profetizaban.

verses.KJV: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.WEB: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.ASV: But if they had stood in my council, then had they caused my people to hear my words, and had turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se eles tivessem estado em meu conselho, então teriam anunciado minhas palavras a meu povo; e teriam feito com que deixassem seu mau caminho e a maldade de suas ações.
verses.RVR09: Y si ellos hubieran estado en mi secreto, también hubieran hecho oir mis palabras á mi pueblo; y les hubieran hecho volver de su mal camino, y de la maldad de sus obras.

verses.KJV: Am I a God at hand, saith the Lord, and not a God afar off?
verses.WEB: “Am I a God at hand,” says the LORD, “and not a God afar off?
verses.ASV: Am I a God at hand, saith Jehovah, and not a God afar off?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso sou eu Deus [apenas] de perto,diz o SENHOR, e não também Deus de longe?
verses.RVR09: ¿Soy yo Dios de poco acá, dice Jehová, y no Dios de mucho ha?

verses.KJV: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the Lord. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says the LORD. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Can any hide himself in secret places so that I shall not see him? saith Jehovah. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pode alguém se esconder num esconderijo,diz o SENHOR, que eu não o veja? Por acaso não sou eu, diz o SENHOR, que encho os céus e a terra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Ocultaráse alguno, dice Jehová, en escondrijos que yo no lo vea? ¿No hincho yo, dice Jehová, el cielo y la tierra?

verses.KJV: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.WEB: “I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
verses.ASV: I have heard what the prophets have said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tenho ouvido o que aqueles profetas dizem, profetizando mentiras em meu nome, dizendo: Sonhei, sonhei.
verses.RVR09: Yo he oído lo que aquellos profetas dijeron, profetizando mentira en mi nombre, diciendo: Soñé, soñé.

verses.KJV: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
verses.WEB: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?
verses.ASV: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando [será isto] no coração dos profetas que profetizam mentiras, dos que profetizam o engano de seu coração?
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo será esto en el corazón de los profetas que profetizan mentira, y que profetizan el engaño de su corazón?

verses.KJV: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
verses.WEB: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal.
verses.ASV: that think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbor, as their fathers forgat my name for Baal.
verses.ALMEIDA: Que pretendem, por meio de seus sonhos que cada um conta a seu próximo, fazer com que meu povo se esqueça de meu nome, tal como seus pais se esqueceram de meu nome por causa de Baal.
verses.RVR09: ¿No piensan como hacen á mi pueblo olvidarse de mi nombre con sus sueños que cada uno cuenta á su compañero, al modo que sus padres se olvidaron de mi nombre por Baal?

verses.KJV: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat? saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O profeta que tiver sonho, conte o sonho; e aquele que tiver minha palavra, conte minha palavra de forma fiel. O que a palha tem a ver com o trigo?,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El profeta con quien fuere sueño, cuente sueño; y el con quien fuere mi palabra, cuente mi palabra verdadera. ¿Qué tiene que ver la paja con el trigo? dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.WEB: “Isn’t my word like fire?” says the LORD; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
verses.ASV: Is not my word like fire? saith Jehovah; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não é minha palavra como o fogo?diz o SENHOR, E como um martelo que esmigalha a pedra?
verses.RVR09: ¿No es mi palabra como el fuego, dice Jehová, y como martillo que quebranta la piedra?

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the Lord, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
verses.WEB: “Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” says the LORD, “who each steal my words from his neighbor.
verses.ASV: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith Jehovah, that steal my words every one from his neighbor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eis que eu sou contra os profetas,diz o SENHOR, que furtam minhas palavras cada um de seu próximo.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí yo contra los profetas, dice Jehová, que hurtan mis palabras cada uno de su más cercano.

verses.KJV: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the Lord, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
verses.WEB: Behold, I am against the prophets,” says the LORD, “who use their tongues, and say, ‘He says.’
verses.ASV: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith Jehovah, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu sou contra os profetas,diz o SENHOR, que usam suas línguas, e declaram: [Assim] ele disse.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo contra los profetas, dice Jehová, que endulzan sus lenguas, y dicen: El ha dicho.

verses.KJV: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the Lord, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams,” says the LORD, “who tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting; yet I didn’t send them or command them. They don’t profit this people at all,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Behold, I am against them that prophesy lying dreams, saith Jehovah, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting: yet I sent them not, nor commanded them; neither do they profit this people at all, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu sou contra os que profetizam sonhos mentirosos,diz o SENHOR, e os contam, e fazem meu povo errar com suas mentiras e com suas lisonjas. E eu não os enviei, nem lhes mandei; e proveito nenhum fizeram a este povo, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo contra los que profetizan sueños mentirosos, dice Jehová, y contáronlos, é hicieron errar á mi pueblo con sus mentiras y con sus lisonjas; y yo no los envié, ni les mandé; y ningún provecho hicieron á este pueblo, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the Lord? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from the LORD?’ Then you shall tell them, ‘“What message? I will cast you off,” says the LORD.’
verses.ASV: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of Jehovah? then shalt thou say unto them, What burden! I will cast you off, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando este povo, ou o profeta, ou o sacerdote, te peguntar, dizendo: Qual é a revelação, a carga do SENHOR? Então tu lhes dirás: Que carga? Eu os abandonarei, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando te preguntare este pueblo, ó el profeta, ó el sacerdote, diciendo: ¿Qué es la carga de Jehová? les dirás: ¿Qué carga? Os dejaré, ha dicho Jehová.

verses.KJV: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the Lord, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.WEB: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from the LORD,’ I will even punish that man and his household.
verses.ASV: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of Jehovah, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto ao profeta, o sacerdote, ou alguém do povo, que disser: Carga do SENHOR; eu enviarei castigo sobre tal homem e sobre sua casa.
verses.RVR09: Y el profeta, y el sacerdote, ó el pueblo, que dijere: Carga de Jehová; yo enviaré castigo sobre tal hombre y sobre su casa.

verses.KJV: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the Lord answered? and, What hath the Lord spoken?
verses.WEB: You will say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, ‘What has the LORD answered?’ and, ‘What has the LORD said?’
verses.ASV: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbor, and every one to his brother, What hath Jehovah answered? and, What hath Jehovah spoken?
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim direis cada um a seu próximo, e cada um a seu irmão: O que o SENHOR respondeu?, e, O que o SENHOR falou?
verses.RVR09: Así diréis cada cual á su compañero, y cada cual á su hermano: ¿Qué ha respondido Jehová, y qué habló Jehová?

verses.KJV: And the burden of the Lord shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the Lord of hosts our God.
verses.WEB: You will mention the message from the LORD no more, for every man’s own word has become his message; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of Armies, our God.
verses.ASV: And the burden of Jehovah shall ye mention no more: for every man’s own word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of Jehovah of hosts our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nunca mais mencionareis a carga do SENHOR; porque a palavra de cada um lhe servirá por carga; pois pervertestes as palavras do Deus vivente, do SENHOR dos exércitos, nosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y nunca más os vendrá á la memoria decir: Carga de Jehová: porque la palabra de cada uno le será por carga; pues pervertisteis las palabras del Dios viviente, de Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios nuestro.

verses.KJV: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the Lord answered thee? and, What hath the Lord spoken?
verses.WEB: You will say to the prophet, ‘What has the LORD answered you?’ and, ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
verses.ASV: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath Jehovah answered thee? and, What hath Jehovah spoken?
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim dirás ao profeta: O que o SENHOR te respondeu? e, O que o SENHOR falou?
verses.RVR09: Así dirás al profeta: ¿Qué te respondió Jehová, y qué habló Jehová?

verses.KJV: But since ye say, The burden of the Lord; therefore thus saith the Lord; Because ye say this word, The burden of the Lord, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the Lord;
verses.WEB: Although you say, ‘The message from the LORD,’ therefore the LORD says: ‘Because you say this word, “The message from the LORD,” and I have sent to you, telling you not to say, “The message from the LORD,”
verses.ASV: But if ye say, The burden of Jehovah; therefore thus saith Jehovah: Because ye say this word, The burden of Jehovah, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se disserdes: Carga do SENHOR; então por isso o assim diz o SENHOR: Porque dissestes esta palavra, Carga do SENHOR, tendo eu vos mandado, dizendo: Não digais “Carga do SENHOR”,
verses.RVR09: Mas si dijereis: Carga de Jehová: por eso Jehová dice así: Porque dijisteis esta palabra, Carga de Jehová, habiendo enviado á deciros: No digáis, Carga de Jehová:

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
verses.WEB: therefore behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off with the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence.
verses.ASV: therefore, behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off, and the city that I gave unto you and to your fathers, away from my presence:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eis que eu esquecerei totalmente; e lançarei fora de minha presença a vós, e à cidade que dei para vós e para vossos pais;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí que yo os echaré en olvido, y os arrancaré de mi presencia, y á la ciudad que os dí á vosotros y á vuestros padres;

verses.KJV: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.WEB: I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which will not be forgotten.’”
verses.ASV: and I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei sobre vós humilhação perpétua e vergonha eterna, que nunca será esquecida.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré sobre vosotros afrenta perpetua, y eterna confusión que nunca borrará el olvido.

verses.KJV: The Lord shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the Lord, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.WEB: The LORD showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs were set before the LORD’s temple, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.ASV: Jehovah showed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs set before the temple of Jehovah, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR me mostrou, e eis dois cestos de figos postos diante do templo do SENHOR, depois de Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, haver levado cativo a Jeconias, filho de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, e aos príncipes de Judá, e aos carpinteiros e ferreiros de Jerusalém, e os ter trazido à Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: MOSTRÓME Jehová, y he aquí dos cestas de higos puestas delante del templo de Jehová, después de haber trasportado Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia á Jechônías hijo de Joacim, rey de Judá, y á los príncipes de Judá, y á los oficiales y herreros de Jerusalem, y haberlos llevado á Babilonia.

verses.KJV: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.WEB: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.ASV: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Um cesto [tinha] figos muito bons, como os primeiros figos a ficarem maduros; e a outra cesta tinha figos muito ruins, que não podiam ser comidos de tão ruins.
verses.RVR09: La una cesta tenía higos muy buenos, como brevas; y la otra cesta tenía higos muy malos, que no se podían comer de malos.

verses.KJV: Then said the Lord unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.WEB: Then the LORD asked me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I said, “Figs. The good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, so bad that they can’t be eaten.”
verses.ASV: Then said Jehovah unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, that cannot be eaten, they are so bad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse-me o SENHOR: O que tu vês, Jeremias? E eu disse: Figos: os figos bons, muito bons; e os ruins, muito ruins, que de tão ruins não podem ser comidos.
verses.RVR09: Y díjome Jehová: ¿Qué ves tú, Jeremías? Y dije: Higos, higos buenos, muy buenos; y malos, muy malos, que de malos no se pueden comer.

verses.KJV: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
verses.WEB: “The LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, as good.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so will I regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, for good.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Tal como a estes bons figos, assim [também] conhecerei aos levados de Judá cativos, aos quais mandei embora deste lugar à terra de Caldeus, para o bem [deles] .
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová Dios de Israel: Como á estos buenos higos, así conoceré la trasportación de Judá al cual eché de este lugar á tierra de Caldeos, para bien.

verses.KJV: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.WEB: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. I will build them, and not pull them down. I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.ASV: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei meus olhos sobre eles para o bem, e os farei voltar a esta terra; eu os edificarei, e não os destruirei; eu os plantarei, e não os arrancarei.
verses.RVR09: Porque pondré mis ojos sobre ellos para bien, y volverélos á esta tierra; y los edificaré, y no los destruiré: plantarélos, y no los arrancaré.

verses.KJV: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the Lord: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
verses.WEB: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.
verses.ASV: And I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Jehovah: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God; for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes darei coração para que me conheçam, que eu sou o SENHOR; e eles serão meu povo, e eu lhes serei seu Deus; porque se converterão a mim de todo seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Y les daré corazón para que me conozcan, que yo soy Jehová: y me serán por pueblo, y yo les seré á ellos por Dios; porque se volverán á mí de todo su corazón.

verses.KJV: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the Lord, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
verses.WEB: “‘As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad,’ surely the LORD says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: And as the bad figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so bad, surely thus saith Jehovah, So will I give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tal como os figos ruins, que de tão ruins não podem ser comidos, assim diz o SENHOR, assim [também] farei a Zedequias rei de Judá, e a seus príncipes, e ao resto de Jerusalém que restarem nesta terra, e aos que habitam na terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y como los malos higos, que de malos no se pueden comer, así, ha dicho Jehová, daré á Sedechîas rey de Judá, y á sus príncipes, y al resto de Jerusalem que quedaron en esta tierra, y que moran en la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
verses.WEB: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.
verses.ASV: I will even give them up to be tossed to and fro among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os farei de motivo de horror para o mal a todos os reinos da terra; de insulto, de ditado, de ridículo, e de maldição a todos os lugares para onde eu os expulsei.
verses.RVR09: Y darélos por escarnio, por mal á todos los reinos de la tierra: por infamia, y por ejemplo, y por refrán, y por maldición á todos los lugares adonde yo los arrojaré.

verses.KJV: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
verses.WEB: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, until they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.’”
verses.ASV: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enviarei entre eles espada, fome, e pestilência, até que sejam eliminados de sobre a terra que dei a eles e a seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Y enviaré sobre ellos espada, hambre, y pestilencia, hasta que sean acabados de sobre la tierra que les dí á ellos y á sus padres.

verses.KJV: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
verses.WEB: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (this was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
verses.ASV: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (the same was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon),
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra que veio a Jeremias quanto a todo o povo de Judá, no quarto ano de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, (o qual é o primeiro ano de Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia);
verses.RVR09: PALABRA que fué á Jeremías acerca de todo el pueblo de Judá en el año cuarto de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, el cual es el año primero de Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia;

verses.KJV: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.WEB: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:
verses.ASV: which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:
verses.ALMEIDA: A qual o profeta Jeremias falou a todo o povo de Judá, e a todos os moradores de Jerusalém, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: La cual habló Jeremías profeta á todo el pueblo de Judá, y á todos los moradores de Jerusalem, diciendo:

verses.KJV: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the Lord hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
verses.WEB: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, the LORD’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.
verses.ASV: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even unto this day, these three and twenty years, the word of Jehovah hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising up early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desde o ano treze de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, até este dia, isto é, há vinte e três anos, tem vindo a mim a palavra do SENHOR; e eu tenho vos falado, insistentemente vos falando; porém vós não escutastes.
verses.RVR09: Desde el año trece de Josías hijo de Amón, rey de Judá, hasta este día, que son veintitrés años, fué á mí palabra de Jehová, y os he hablado, madrugando y dando aviso; mas no oisteis.
