verses.KJV: And the Lord hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
verses.WEB: The LORD has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear),
verses.ASV: And Jehovah hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, (but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear),
verses.ALMEIDA: E o SENHOR enviou a vós todos seus servos os profetas, insistentemente os enviando; porém vos não escutastes, nem inclinastes vossos ouvidos para escutar,
verses.RVR09: Y envió Jehová á vosotros todos sus siervos los profetas, madrugando y enviándolos; mas no oisteis, ni inclinasteis vuestro oído para escuchar,

verses.KJV: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the Lord hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
verses.WEB: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.
verses.ASV: saying, Return ye now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Jehovah hath given unto you and to your fathers, from of old and even for evermore;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando diziam: Convertei-vos agora, cada um de seu mau caminho, e da maldade de vossas ações, e habitai na terra que o SENHOR deu a vós e a vossos pais para todo o sempre;
verses.RVR09: Cuando decían: Volveos ahora de vuestro mal camino y de la maldad de vuestras obras, y morad en la tierra que os dió Jehová, á vosotros y á vuestros padres para siempre;

verses.KJV: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
verses.WEB: Don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.”
verses.ASV: and go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the work of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não segui deuses estrangeiros, para os servirdes e encurvardes a eles, nem me provoqueis à ira com a obra de vossas mãos; para que eu não vos faça mal.
verses.RVR09: Y no vayáis en pos de dioses ajenos, sirviéndoles y encorvándoos á ellos, ni me provoquéis á ira con la obra de vuestras manos; y no os haré mal.

verses.KJV: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the Lord; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.WEB: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says the LORD, “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”
verses.ASV: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith Jehovah; that ye may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém vós não me destes ouvidos, diz o SENHOR, para me provocardes à ira com a obra de vossas mãos, para o vosso mal.
verses.RVR09: Empero no me habéis oído, dice Jehová, para provocarme á ira con la obra de vuestras manos para mal vuestro.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Because ye have not heard my words,
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Visto quanto não tendes ouvido minhas palavras,
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Por cuanto no habéis oído mis palabras,

verses.KJV: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.WEB: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says the LORD, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around. I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.ASV: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith Jehovah, and [I will send] unto Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about; and I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu enviarei, e tomarei a todas as famílias do norte, diz o SENHOR, e a Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia, meu servo, e os trarei contra esta terra, e contra seus moradores, e contra todas estas nações ao redor; e os destruirei, e os farei de espanto, assovio, e de desolações perpétuas.
verses.RVR09: He aquí enviaré yo, y tomaré todos los linajes del aquilón, dice Jehová, y á Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, mi siervo, y traerélos contra esta tierra, y contra sus moradores, y contra todas estas naciones en derredor; y los destruiré, y pondrélos por escarnio, y por silbo, y en soledades perpetuas.

verses.KJV: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
verses.WEB: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
verses.ASV: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eliminarei dentre eles a voz de júbilo e voz de alegria, voz de noivo e voz de noiva, o ruído das pedras de moer, e a luz de lâmpada.
verses.RVR09: Y haré que perezca de entre ellos voz de gozo y voz de alegría, voz de desposado y voz de desposada, ruido de muelas, y luz de lámpara.

verses.KJV: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.WEB: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.ASV: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda esta terra se tornará em desolação, [e] em espanto; e estas nações servirão ao rei da Babilônia [por] setenta anos.
verses.RVR09: Y toda esta tierra será puesta en soledad, en espanto; y servirán estas gentes al rey de Babilonia setenta años.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the Lord, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
verses.WEB: “It will happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,” says the LORD, “for their iniquity. I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith Jehovah, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it desolate for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, quando os setenta anos forem completados, punirei ao rei da Babilônia e àquela nação por sua maldade, diz o SENHOR, assim como a terra dos Caldeus; e a tornarei em desolações para sempre.
verses.RVR09: Y será que, cuando fueren cumplidos los setenta años, visitaré sobre el rey de Babilonia y sobre aquella gente su maldad, ha dicho Jehová, y sobre la tierra de los Caldeos; y pondréla en desiertos para siempre.

verses.KJV: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
verses.WEB: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
verses.ASV: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trarei sobre aquela terra todas as minhas palavras que falado contra ela: tudo o que está escrito neste livro, que Jeremias profetizou contra todas as nações.
verses.RVR09: Y traeré sobre aquella tierra todas mis palabras que he hablado contra ella, con todo lo que está escrito en este libro, profetizado por Jeremías contra todas gentes.

verses.KJV: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
verses.WEB: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”
verses.ASV: For many nations and great kings shall make bondmen of them, even of them; and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque também deles se servirão muitas nações e grandes reis; assim lhes pagarei conforme seus feitos, conforme a obra de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Porque se servirán también de ellos muchas gentes, y reyes grandes; y yo les pagaré conforme á sus hechos, y conforme á la obra de sus manos.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
verses.WEB: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, unto me: Take this cup of the wine of wrath at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim me disse o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Toma de minha mão este copo de vinho do [meu] furor, e dá de beber dele a todas as nações às quais eu te envio.
verses.RVR09: Porque así me dijo Jehová Dios de Israel: Toma de mi mano el vaso del vino de este furor, y da á beber de él á todas las gentes á las cuales yo te envío.

verses.KJV: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
verses.WEB: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”
verses.ASV: And they shall drink, and reel to and fro, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E beberão, tremerão, e enlouquecerão, por causa da espada que eu envio entre eles.
verses.RVR09: Y beberán, y temblarán, y enloquecerán delante del cuchillo que yo envío entre ellos.

verses.KJV: Then took I the cup at the Lord's hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the Lord had sent me:
verses.WEB: Then I took the cup at the LORD’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom the LORD had sent me:
verses.ASV: Then took I the cup at Jehovah’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom Jehovah had sent me:
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu tomei o copo da mão do SENHOR, e dei de beber a todas as nações às quais o SENHOR tinha me enviado:
verses.RVR09: Y tomé el vaso de la mano de Jehová, y dí de beber á todas las gentes á las cuales me envió Jehová:

verses.KJV: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
verses.WEB: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;
verses.ASV: [to wit], Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is this day;
verses.ALMEIDA: A Jerusalém, às cidades de Judá; e a seus reis e seus príncipes, para torná-los em desolação, em espanto, em assovio, e em maldição, tal como é hoje;
verses.RVR09: A Jerusalem, á las ciudades de Judá, y á sus reyes, y á sus príncipes, para ponerlos en soledad, en escarnio, y en silbo, y en maldición, como este día;

verses.KJV: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.WEB: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;
verses.ASV: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.ALMEIDA: A Faraó rei do Egito, e a seus servos, seus príncipes, e a todo o seu povo;
verses.RVR09: A Faraón rey de Egipto, y á sus siervos, á sus príncipes, y á todo su pueblo;

verses.KJV: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
verses.WEB: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
verses.ASV: and all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todas os [povos ali] misturados; e a todos os reis da terra de Uz, e a todos os reis da terra dos filisteus, e a Asquelom, Gaza, e Ecrom; e aos restantes de Asdode;
verses.RVR09: Y á toda la mezcla de gente, y á todos los reyes de tierra de Hus, y á todos los reyes de tierra de Palestina, y á Ascalón, y Gaza, y Ecrón, y al residuo de Asdod;

verses.KJV: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
verses.WEB: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;
verses.ASV: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon;
verses.ALMEIDA: A Edom, Moabe, e aos filhos de Amom;
verses.RVR09: A Edom, y Moab, y á los hijos de Ammón;

verses.KJV: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
verses.WEB: and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;
verses.ASV: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todos os reis de Tiro, e a todos os reis da Sidom, e aos reis dos litorais que estão além do mar;
verses.RVR09: Y á todos los reyes de Tiro, y á todos los reyes de Sidón, y á los reyes de las islas que están de ese lado de la mar;

verses.KJV: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
verses.WEB: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;
verses.ASV: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that have the corners [of their hair] cut off;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Dedã, e Tema, e Buz, e a todos os dos cantos mais distantes.
verses.RVR09: Y á Dedán, y Tema, y Buz, y á todos los que están al cabo del mundo;

verses.KJV: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
verses.WEB: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;
verses.ASV: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the wilderness;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todos os reis de Arábia, e a todos os reis dos povos misturados que habitam no deserto;
verses.RVR09: Y á todos los reyes de Arabia, y á todos los reyes de pueblos mezclados que habitan en el desierto;

verses.KJV: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
verses.WEB: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
verses.ASV: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todos os reis de Zinri, e a todos os reis de Elão, e a todos os reis de Média;
verses.RVR09: Y á todos los reyes de Zimri, y á todos los reyes de Elam, y á todos los reyes de Media;

verses.KJV: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.WEB: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.
verses.ASV: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todos os reis do norte, os de perto e os de longe, tanto uns como os outros; e a todos os reinos da terra que estão sobre a face da terra; e o rei de Sesaque beberá depois deles.
verses.RVR09: Y á todos los reyes del aquilón, los de cerca y los de lejos, los unos con los otros; y á todos los reinos de la tierra que están sobre la haz de la tierra: y el rey de Sesach beberá después de ellos.

verses.KJV: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.WEB: “You shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.”’
verses.ASV: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Drink ye, and be drunken, and spew, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tu lhes dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Bebei, e embriagai-vos, vomitai, caí, e não vos levanteis, por causa da espada que eu envio entre vós.
verses.RVR09: Les dirás, pues: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: Bebed, y embriagaos, y vomitad, y caed, y no os levantéis delante del cuchillo que yo envío entre vosotros.

verses.KJV: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
verses.WEB: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.
verses.ASV: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thy hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Ye shall surely drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, se não querem tomar o copo de tua mão para beber, então tu lhes dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Certamente bebereis;
verses.RVR09: Y será que, si no quieren tomar el vaso de tu mano para beber, les dirás tú: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Habéis de beber.

verses.KJV: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You will not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says the LORD of Armies.”’
verses.ASV: For, lo, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eis que na cidade que se chama pelo meu nome eu começo a castigar; e vós ficaríeis impunes? Não ficareis impunes, porque eu estou chamando espada contra todos os moradores da terra, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí, que á la ciudad sobre la cual es invocado mi nombre yo comienzo á hacer mal; ¿y vosotros seréis absueltos? No seréis absueltos: porque espada traigo sobre todos los moradores de la tierra, dice Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The Lord shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.WEB: “Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them, “‘The LORD will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation. He will mightily roar against his fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.ASV: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, Jehovah will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he will mightily roar against his fold; he will give a shout, as they that tread [the grapes], against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, pois, profetizarás a eles todas estas palavras, e lhes dirás: O SENHOR bramará desde o alto, e levantará sua voz a sua santa morada; bramará intensamente sobre sua morada; dará forte grito, tal como os que pisam as uvas, contra todos os moradores da terra.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues, profetizarás á ellos todas estas palabras, y les dirás: Jehová bramará desde lo alto, y desde la morada de su santidad dará su voz: enfurecido bramará sobre su morada; canción de lagareros cantará contra todos los moradores de la tierra.

verses.KJV: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the Lord hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: A noise will come even to the end of the earth; for the LORD has a controversy with the nations. He will enter into judgment with all flesh. As for the wicked, he will give them to the sword,”’ says the LORD.”
verses.ASV: A noise shall come even to the end of the earth; for Jehovah hath a controversy with the nations; he will enter into judgment with all flesh: as for the wicked, he will give them to the sword, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Chegará o estrondo até o extremo da terra; porque o SENHOR disputa com as nações; entrará em juízo com todos; [e] entregará os perversos à espada, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Llegó el estruendo hasta el cabo de la tierra; porque juicio de Jehová con las gentes: él es el Juez de toda carne; entregará los impíos á cuchillo, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, evil will go out from nation to nation, and a great storm will be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great tempest shall be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eis que a calamidade sai de nação em nação, e uma grande tempestade se levantará desde os confins da terra.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: He aquí que el mal sale de gente en gente, y grande tempestad se levantará de los fines de la tierra.

verses.KJV: And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
verses.WEB: The slain of the LORD will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.
verses.ASV: And the slain of Jehovah shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the face of the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os mortos pelo SENHOR naquele dia serão desde um extremo da terra até o outro extremo; não serão lamentados, nem recolhidos, nem sepultados; serão como esterco sobre a face da terra.
verses.RVR09: Y serán muertos de Jehová en aquel día desde el un cabo de la tierra hasta el otro cabo; no se endecharán, ni se recogerán, ni serán enterrados; como estiércol serán sobre la haz de la tierra.

verses.KJV: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
verses.WEB: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come, and you will fall like fine pottery.
verses.ASV: Wail, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow [in ashes], ye principal of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are fully come, and ye shall fall like a goodly vessel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uivai, pastores, e clamai; e revolvei-vos [na cinza] , líderes do rebanho; porque já se cumpriram vossos dias para serdes mortos; e sereis dispersos e caireis como um vaso precioso.
verses.RVR09: Aullad, pastores, y clamad; y revolcaos en el polvo, mayorales del rebaño; porque cumplidos son vuestros días para ser vosotros degollados y esparcidos, y caeréis como vaso de codicia.

verses.KJV: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.WEB: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The leader of the flock will have no escape.
verses.ASV: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não haverá meio de fuga para os pastores, nem escape para os líderes do rebanho.
verses.RVR09: Y acabaráse la huída de los pastores, y el escape de los mayorales del rebaño.

verses.KJV: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the Lord hath spoiled their pasture.
verses.WEB: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for the LORD destroys their pasture.
verses.ASV: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the principal of the flock! for Jehovah layeth waste their pasture.
verses.ALMEIDA: Haverá voz do grito dos pastores, e uivo dos lideres do rebanho; porque o SENHOR assolou os seus pastos.
verses.RVR09: ¡Voz de la grita de los pastores, y aullido de los mayorales del rebaño! porque Jehová asoló sus majadas.

verses.KJV: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.ASV: And the peaceable folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as pastagens quietas serão devastadas por causa do furor da ira do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y las majadas quietas serán taladas por el furor de la ira de Jehová.

verses.KJV: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.WEB: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.ASV: He hath left his covert, as the lion; for their land is become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppressing [sword], and because of his fierce anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ele deixou seu abrigo tal como filhote de leão; pois assolada foi a terra deles, pelo furor do opressor, e pelo furor de sua ira.
verses.RVR09: Dejó cual leoncillo su guarida; pues asolada fué la tierra de ellos por la ira del opresor, y por el furor de su saña.

verses.KJV: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the Lord, saying,
verses.WEB: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:
verses.ASV: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word from Jehovah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: No princípio do reinado de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, veio esta palavra do SENHOR,dizendo:
verses.RVR09: EN el principio del reinado de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, fué esta palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Stand in the court of the Lord's house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the Lord's house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
verses.WEB: “The LORD says: ‘Stand in the court of the LORD’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah which come to worship in the LORD’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them. Don’t omit a word.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: Stand in the court of Jehovah’s house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in Jehovah’s house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Põe-te no pátio da casa do SENHOR, e fala a todas as cidades de Judá, que vêm para adorar [na] casa do SENHOR, todas as palavras que te mandei que lhes falasses; não diminuas uma só palavra.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Ponte en el atrio de la casa de Jehová, y habla á todas las ciudades de Judá, que vienen para adorar en la casa de Jehová, todas las palabras que yo te mandé les hablases; no retengas palabra.

verses.KJV: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.WEB: It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way, that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’”
verses.ASV: It may be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way; that I may repent me of the evil which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pode ser que ouçam, e se convertam cada um de seu mal caminho; então eu me arrependeria do mal que pretendo lhes fazer pela maldade de suas ações.
verses.RVR09: Quizá oirán, y se tornarán cada uno de su mal camino; y arrepentiréme yo del mal que pienso hacerles por la maldad de sus obras.

verses.KJV: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
verses.WEB: You shall tell them, “The LORD says: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law which I have set before you,
verses.ASV: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah: If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize-lhes, pois: Assim diz o SENHOR: Se não me ouvirdes para andardes em minha Lei, a qual dei diante de vós,
verses.RVR09: Les dirás pues: Así ha dicho Jehová: Si no me oyereis para andar en mi ley, la cual dí delante de vosotros,

verses.KJV: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;
verses.WEB: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them—but you have not listened—
verses.ASV: to hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I send unto you, even rising up early and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;
verses.ALMEIDA: Para dar atenção às palavras de meus servos, os profetas, que eu vos envio, insistentemente os enviando, mas não os ouvistes;
verses.RVR09: Para atender á las palabras de mis siervos los profetas que yo os envío, madrugando en enviarlos, á los cuales no habéis oído;

verses.KJV: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
verses.WEB: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.’”
verses.ASV: then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então farei desta casa como a Siló, e tornarei esta cidade em maldição a todas as nações da terra.
verses.RVR09: Yo pondré esta casa como Silo, y daré esta ciudad en maldición á todas las gentes de la tierra.

verses.KJV: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: And the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os sacerdotes, os profetas, e todo o povo, ouviram a Jeremias falar estas palavras na casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y los sacerdotes, los profetas, y todo el pueblo, oyeron á Jeremías hablar estas palabras en la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
verses.WEB: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You shall surely die!
verses.ASV: And it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that Jehovah had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold on him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, acabando Jeremias de falar tudo o que o SENHOR tinha lhe mandado falar a todo o povo, os sacerdotes e os profetas e todo o povo lhe pegaram, dizendo: Certamente morrerás;
verses.RVR09: Y fué que, acabando de hablar Jeremías todo lo que Jehová le había mandado que hablase á todo el pueblo, los sacerdotes y los profetas y todo el pueblo le echaron mano, diciendo: De cierto morirás.

verses.KJV: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.
verses.WEB: Why have you prophesied in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant’?” All the people were crowded around Jeremiah in the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of Jehovah, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate, without inhabitant? And all the people were gathered unto Jeremiah in the house of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois profetizaste em nome do SENHOR, dizendo: Esta casa será como Siló, e esta cidade será assolada até não restar morador.E juntou-se todo o povo contra Jeremias na casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué has profetizado en nombre de Jehová, diciendo: Esta casa será como Silo, y esta ciudad será asolada hasta no quedar morador? Y juntóse todo el pueblo contra Jeremías en la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of the Lord, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the Lord's house.
verses.WEB: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the LORD’s house; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house.
verses.ASV: And when the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house unto the house of Jehovah; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of Jehovah’s [house].
verses.ALMEIDA: E os príncipes de Judá, ao ouvirem estas coisas, subiram da casa do rei à casa do SENHOR; e sentaram-se à entrada da porta nova do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y los príncipes de Judá oyeron estas cosas, y subieron de casa del rey á la casa de Jehová; y sentáronse en la entrada de la puerta nueva de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
verses.WEB: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.”
verses.ASV: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy of death; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os sacerdotes e os profetas falaram aos príncipes e a todo o povo, dizendo: Pena de morte [deve ter] este homem, pois profetizou contra esta cidade, como ouvistes com vossos [próprios] ouvidos.
verses.RVR09: Entonces hablaron los sacerdotes y los profetas á los príncipes y á todo el pueblo, diciendo: En pena de muerte ha incurrido este hombre; porque profetizó contra esta ciudad, como vosotros habéis oído con vuestros oídos.

verses.KJV: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
verses.WEB: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
verses.ASV: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, Jehovah sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Jeremias falou a todos os príncipes e a todo o povo, dizendo: O SENHOR me enviou para profetizar contra esta casa e contra esta cidade todas as palavras que ouvistes.
verses.RVR09: Y habló Jeremías á todos los príncipes y á todo el pueblo, diciendo: Jehová me envió á que profetizase contra esta casa y contra esta ciudad, todas las palabras que habéis oído.

verses.KJV: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the Lord your God; and the Lord will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
verses.WEB: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the LORD your God’s voice; then the LORD will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.
verses.ASV: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of Jehovah your God; and Jehovah will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, portanto, melhorai vossos caminhos e vossas ações, e ouvi à voz do SENHOR vosso Deus; então o SENHOR mudará de ideia quanto ao mal que falou contra vós.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora, mejorad vuestros caminos y vuestras obras, y oid la voz de Jehová vuestro Dios, y arrepentiráse Jehová del mal que ha hablado contra vosotros.

verses.KJV: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
verses.WEB: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.
verses.ASV: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as is good and right in your eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, porém, eis que estou em vossas mãos: fazei de mim como parecer melhor e mais correto aos vossos olhos.
verses.RVR09: En lo que á mí toca, he aquí estoy en vuestras manos: haced de mí como mejor y más recto os pareciere.

verses.KJV: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the Lord hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
verses.WEB: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on its inhabitants; for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.”
verses.ASV: Only know ye for certain that, if ye put me to death, ye will bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof; for of a truth Jehovah hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas sabei certamente que, se vós me matardes, então trareis sangue inocente sobre vós, e sobre esta cidade, e sobre seus moradores; porque em verdade o SENHOR me enviou a vós para falar aos vossos ouvidos todas estas palavras.
verses.RVR09: Mas sabed de cierto que, si me matareis, sangre inocente echaréis sobre vosotros, y sobre esta ciudad, y sobre sus moradores: porque en verdad Jehová me envió á vosotros para que dijese todas estas palabras en vuestros oídos.

verses.KJV: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.WEB: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: “This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.”
verses.ASV: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets: This man is not worthy of death; for he hath spoken to us in the name of Jehovah our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então os príncipes e todo o povo disseram aos sacerdotes e profetas: Este homem não é merecedor de pena de morte, porque em nome do SENHOR nosso Deus ele nos falou.
verses.RVR09: Y dijeron los príncipes y todo el pueblo á los sacerdotes y profetas. No ha incurrido este hombre en pena de muerte, porque en nombre de Jehová nuestro Dios nos ha hablado.

verses.KJV: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.WEB: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.ASV: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E se levantaram alguns dos anciãos da terra, e falaram a todo o ajuntamento do povo, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Entonces se levantaron ciertos de los ancianos de la tierra, y hablaron á toda la junta del pueblo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.WEB: “Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “‘Zion will be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.’
verses.ASV: Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Zion shall be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Miqueias, o morastita, profetizou nos dias de Ezequias rei de Judá, e falou a todo o povo de Judá, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Sião será arada como campo, e Jerusalém se tornará em amontoados [de pedras] , e o monte do templo em lugares altos de mato.
verses.RVR09: Miqueas de Morasti profetizó en tiempo de Ezechîas rey de Judá, diciendo: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: Sión será arada como campo, y Jerusalem vendrá á ser montones, y el monte del templo en cumbres de bosque.

verses.KJV: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the Lord, and besought the Lord, and the Lord repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
verses.WEB: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear the LORD, and entreat the favor of the LORD, and the LORD relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way!”
verses.ASV: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? did he not fear Jehovah, and entreat the favor of Jehovah, and Jehovah repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus should we commit great evil against our own souls.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso foi ele morto por Ezequias rei de Judá e todo Judá? Por acaso [Ezequias] não temeu ao SENHOR, e orou na presença do SENHOR, e o SENHOR mudou de ideia quanto ao mal que tinha falado contra eles? E nós, faremos pois tão grande mal contra nossas [próprias] almas?
verses.RVR09: ¿Matáronlo luego Ezechîas rey de Judá y todo Judá? ¿no temió á Jehová, y oró en presencia de Jehová, y Jehová se arrepintió del mal que había hablado contra ellos? ¿Haremos pues nosotros tan grande mal contra nuestras almas?

verses.KJV: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the Lord, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.WEB: There was also a man who prophesied in the LORD’s name, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.ASV: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of Jehovah, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath-jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve também um homem que profetizava em nome do SENHOR: Urias, filho de Semaías de Quiriate-Jearim, o qual profetizou contra esta cidade e contra esta terra, conforme todas as palavras de Jeremias;
verses.RVR09: Hubo también un hombre que profetizaba en nombre de Jehová, Urías, hijo de Semaías de Chîriath-jearim, el cual profetizó contra esta ciudad y contra esta tierra, conforme á todas las palabras de Jeremías:

verses.KJV: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
verses.WEB: When Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt.
verses.ASV: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ouviu suas palavras o rei Jeoaquim, e todos seus grandes, e todos seus príncipes, então o rei procurou matá-lo; e Urias, ao ouvir [isso] , teve medo, fugiu, e foi ao Egito;
verses.RVR09: Y oyó sus palabras el rey Joacim, y todos sus grandes, y todos sus príncipes, y el rey procuró de matarle; lo cual entendiendo Urías, tuvo temor, y huyó, y metióse en Egipto:

verses.KJV: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
verses.WEB: Then Jehoiakim the king sent Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him into Egypt.
verses.ASV: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, [namely], Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him, into Egypt;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém o rei Jeoaquim enviou [alguns] homens a Egito: Elnatã filho de Acbor, e [outros] homens com ele, ao Egito;
verses.RVR09: Y el rey Joacim envió hombres á Egipto, á Elnathán hijo de Acbor, y otros hombres con él, á Egipto;

verses.KJV: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.WEB: They fetched Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.ASV: and they fetched forth Uriah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king, who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os quais tiraram a Urias do Egito, e o trouxeram ao rei Jeoaquim, que o feriu à espada, e lançou seu cadáver nas sepulturas do povo comum.
verses.RVR09: Los cuales sacaron á Urías de Egipto, y lo trajeron al rey Joacim, é hiriólo á cuchillo, y echó su cuerpo en los sepulcros del vulgo.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.WEB: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they didn’t give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.ASV: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém a mão de Aicã, filho de Safã, foi com Jeremias, para que não o entregassem nas mãos do povo para o matarem.
verses.RVR09: La mano empero de Ahicam hijo de Saphán era con Jeremías, porque no lo entregasen en las manos del pueblo para matarlo.

verses.KJV: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.WEB: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.ASV: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: No princípio do reinado de Jeoaquim ,filho de Josias, rei de Judá, veio do SENHOR esta palavra a Jeremias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: EN el principio del reinado de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, fué de Jehová esta palabra á Jeremías, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
verses.WEB: the LORD says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah to me: Make thee bonds and bars, and put them upon thy neck;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim me disse o SENHOR: Faz para ti amarras e jugos, e os põe sobre teu pescoço;
verses.RVR09: Jehová me ha dicho así: Hazte coyundas y yugos, y ponlos sobre tu cuello;

verses.KJV: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
verses.WEB: Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.ASV: and send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the children of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers that come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah:
verses.ALMEIDA: E envia-os ao rei de Edom, ao rei de Moabe, ao rei dos filhos de Amom, ao rei de Tiro, e ao rei de Sidom, pelas mãos dos mensageiros que vêm a Jerusalém a Zedequias, rei de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Y los enviarás al rey de Edom, y al rey de Moab, y al rey de los hijos de Ammón, y al rey de Tiro, y al rey de Sidón, por mano de los embajadores que vienen á Jerusalem á Sedechîas, rey de Judá.

verses.KJV: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
verses.WEB: Give them a command to their masters, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “You shall tell your masters:
verses.ASV: and give them a charge unto their masters, saying, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Thus shall ye say unto your masters:
verses.ALMEIDA: E manda-lhes que digam a seus senhores: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Assim direis a vossos senhores:
verses.RVR09: Y les mandarás que digan á sus señores: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: Así habéis de decir á vuestros señores:

verses.KJV: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
verses.WEB: ‘I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm. I give it to whom it seems right to me.
verses.ASV: I have made the earth, the men and the beasts that are upon the face of the earth, by my great power and by my outstretched arm; and I give it unto whom it seemeth right unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu fiz a terra, o homem, e os animais que estão sobre a face da terra, com meu grande poder e com meu braço estendido, e a dou a quem for do meu agrado.
verses.RVR09: Yo hice la tierra, el hombre y las bestias que están sobre la haz de la tierra, con mi grande potencia y con mi brazo extendido, y díla á quien me plugo.

verses.KJV: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
verses.WEB: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant. I have also given the animals of the field to him to serve him.
verses.ASV: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field also have I given him to serve him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora dei todas estas terras na mão de Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, meu servo, e até mesmo os animais do campo eu lhe dei, para que o sirvam.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora yo he dado todas estas tierras en mano de Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, mi siervo, y aun las bestias del campo le he dado para que le sirvan.

verses.KJV: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
verses.WEB: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.
verses.ASV: And all the nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land come: and then many nations and great kings shall make him their bondman.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todas as nações servirão a ele, a seu filho, e ao filho de seu filho, até que também venha o tempo de sua própria terra; então servirá a muitas nações e grandes reis.
verses.RVR09: Y todas las gentes le servirán á él, y á su hijo, y al hijo de su hijo, hasta que venga también el tiempo de su misma tierra; y le servirán muchas gentes y reyes grandes.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the Lord, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.WEB: “‘“‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,’ says the LORD, ‘with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith Jehovah, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que a nação e o reino que não servir a Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, e que não puser seu pescoço sob do jugo do rei de Babilônia, então com espada, com fome e com pestilência castigarei tal nação, diz o SENHOR, até que eu os consuma por meio de sua mão.
verses.RVR09: Y será, que la gente y el reino que no sirviere á Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, y que no pusiere su cuello debajo del yugo del rey de Babilonia, con espada y con hambre y con pestilencia visitaré á la tal gente, dice Jehová, hasta que los acabe yo por su mano.

verses.KJV: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
verses.WEB: But as for you, don’t listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, “You shall not serve the king of Babylon;”
verses.ASV: But as for you, hearken ye not to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreams, nor to your soothsayers, nor to your sorcerers, that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós não deis ouvidos a vossos profetas, nem a vossos adivinhos, nem a vossos sonhos, nem a vossos videntes, nem a vossos encantadores, que vos falam, dizendo: Não servireis ao rei da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros no prestéis oído á vuestros profetas, ni á vuestros adivinos, ni á vuestros sueños, ni á vuestros agoreros, ni á vuestros encantadores, que os hablan diciendo: No serviréis al rey de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
verses.WEB: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, so that I would drive you out, and you would perish.
verses.ASV: for they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land, and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eles vos profetizam mentiras, para vos afastardes de vossa terra, e para que eu vos afugente, e pereçais.
verses.RVR09: Porque ellos os profetizan mentira, por haceros alejar de vuestra tierra, y para que yo os arroje y perezcáis.

verses.KJV: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the Lord; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
verses.WEB: But the nation that brings their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, that nation I will let remain in their own land,’ says the LORD; ‘and they will till it and dwell in it.’”’”
verses.ASV: But the nation that shall bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, that [nation] will I let remain in their own land, saith Jehovah; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a nação que pôr seu pescoço sob o jugo do rei da Babilônia, e o servir, a essa eu deixarei ficar em seu terra, e a cultivará, e nela habitará diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas la gente que sometiere su cuello al yugo del rey de Babilonia, y le sirviere, haréla dejar en su tierra, dice Jehová, y labrarála, y morará en ella.

verses.KJV: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.WEB: I spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, “Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.ASV: And I spake to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falei também a Zedequias, rei de Judá, conforme todas estas palavras, dizendo: Ponde vossos pescoços sob o jugo do rei da Babilônia, e servi a ele e a seu povo; então vivereis.
verses.RVR09: Y hablé también á Sedechîas rey de Judá conforme á todas estas palabras, diciendo: Someted vuestros cuellos al yugo del rey de Babilonia, y servid á él y á su pueblo, y vivid.

verses.KJV: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the Lord hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.WEB: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.ASV: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Jehovah hath spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que morreríeis, tu e teu povo, pela espada, pela fome, pela pestilência, tal como disse o SENHOR sobre a nação que não servir ao rei da Babilônia?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué moriréis, tú y tu pueblo, á cuchillo, de hambre, y pestilencia, según ha dicho Jehová á la gente que no sirviere al rey de Babilonia?

verses.KJV: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.WEB: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.
verses.ASV: And hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon; for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não escuteis as palavras dos profetas que vos falam, dizendo: Não servireis ao rei da Babilônia; pois eles vos profetizam mentiras.
verses.RVR09: No oigáis las palabras de los profetas que os hablan, diciendo: No serviréis al rey de Babilonia; porque os profetizan mentira.

verses.KJV: For I have not sent them, saith the Lord, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
verses.WEB: For I have not sent them,” says the LORD, “but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.”
verses.ASV: For I have not sent them, saith Jehovah, but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that ye may perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu não os enviei, diz o SENHOR, e eles profetizam falsamente em meu nome, para que eu vos afugente, e pereçais, vós e os profetas que vos profetizam.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo no los envié, dice Jehová, y ellos profetizan falsamente en mi nombre, para que yo os arroje, y perezcáis, vosotros y los profetas que os profetizan.

verses.KJV: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the Lord's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.WEB: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, the LORD says, “Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Behold, the vessels of the LORD’s house will now shortly be brought again from Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.
verses.ASV: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of Jehovah’s house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon; for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também falei aos sacerdotes e a todo este povo, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: Não escuteis as palavras de vossos profetas, que vos profetizam, dizendo: Eis que os vasos da casa do SENHOR voltarão da Babilônia em breve. Pois eles vos profetizam mentiras.
verses.RVR09: También á los sacerdotes y á todo este pueblo hablé, diciendo: Así ha dicho Jehová: No oigáis las palabras de vuestros profetas que os profetizan diciendo: He aquí que los vasos de la casa de Jehová volverán de Babilonia ahora presto. Porque os profetizan mentira.

verses.KJV: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
verses.WEB: Don’t listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?
verses.ASV: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city become a desolation?
verses.ALMEIDA: Não escuteis a eles; servi ao rei de Babilônia, e então vivereis; por que se tornaria esta cidade em deserto?
verses.RVR09: No los oigáis; servid al rey de Babilonia, y vivid: ¿por qué ha de ser desierta esta ciudad?

verses.KJV: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the Lord be with them, let them now make intercession to the Lord of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
verses.WEB: But if they are prophets, and if the LORD’s word is with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of Armies, that the vessels which are left in the LORD’s house, in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.
verses.ASV: But if they be prophets, and if the word of Jehovah be with them, let them now make intercession to Jehovah of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of Jehovah, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se eles são profetas, e se a palavra do SENHOR é com eles, orem agora ao SENHOR dos exércitos, que os objetos de valor que restaram na casa do SENHOR, na casa do rei de Judá, e em Jerusalém, não vão para a Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Y si ellos son profetas, y si es con ellos palabra de Jehová, oren ahora á Jehová de los ejércitos, que los vasos que han quedado en la casa de Jehová y en la casa del rey de Judá y en Jerusalem, no vayan á Babilonia.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city.
verses.WEB: For the LORD of Armies says concerning the pillars, concerning the sea, concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that are left in this city,
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos quanto às colunas, ao mar, às bases, e ao restante dos objetos de valor que restaram nesta cidade,
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos de aquellas columnas, y del mar, y de las basas, y del resto de los vasos que quedan en esta ciudad,

verses.KJV: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
verses.WEB: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon didn’t take when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—
verses.ASV: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
verses.ALMEIDA: Que Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, não tomou, quando levou cativo de Jerusalém a Babilônia a Jeconias, filho de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, e a todos os nobres de Judá e de Jerusalém;
verses.RVR09: Que no quitó Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, cuando trasportó de Jerusalem á Babilonia á Jechônías hijo de Joacim, rey de Judá, y á todos los nobles de Judá y de Jerusalem:

verses.KJV: Yea, thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
verses.WEB: yes, the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in the LORD’s house, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:
verses.ASV: yea, thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that are left in the house of Jehovah, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim pois diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, quanto aos objetos de valor que restaram [na] casa do SENHOR, e [na] casa do rei de Judá, e [em] Jerusalém:
verses.RVR09: Así pues ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, acerca de los vasos que quedaron en la casa de Jehová, y en la casa del rey de Judá, y en Jerusalem:

verses.KJV: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the Lord; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
verses.WEB: ‘They will be carried to Babylon, and there they will be, until the day that I visit them,’ says the LORD; ‘then I will bring them up, and restore them to this place.’”
verses.ASV: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be, until the day that I visit them, saith Jehovah; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para a Babilônia serão levados, e ali ficarão até o dia em que eu os punirei, diz o SENHOR; então depois eu os farei subir, e os restituirei a este lugar.
verses.RVR09: A Babilonia serán trasportados, y allí estarán hasta el día en que yo los visitaré, dice Jehová; y después los haré subir, y restituirélos á este lugar.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the Lord, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.WEB: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in the LORD’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of Jehovah, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu no mesmo ano, no princípio do reinado de Zedequias, rei de Judá, no quarto ano, no quinto mês, que Hananias, filho de Azur, profeta que era de Gibeom, falou para mim na casa do SENHOR diante dos sacerdotes e de todo o povo, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ en el mismo año, en el principio del reinado de Sedechîas rey de Judá, en el año cuarto, en el quinto mes, que Hananías, hijo de Azur, profeta que era de Gabaón, me habló en la casa de Jehová delante de los sacerdotes y de todo el pueblo, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.WEB: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.ASV: Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim fala o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, dizendo: Quebrarei o jugo do rei da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Así habló Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, diciendo: Quebranté el yugo del rey de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the Lord's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
verses.WEB: Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.
verses.ASV: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of Jehovah’s house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried to Babylon:
verses.ALMEIDA: Dentro do tempo de dois anos, trarei de volta a este lugar todos os objetos de valor da casa do SENHOR, que Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, tomou deste lugar para os levar à Babilônia;
verses.RVR09: Dentro de dos años de días tornaré á este lugar todos los vasos de la casa de Jehová, que Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, llevó de este lugar para meterlos en Babilonia;

verses.KJV: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the Lord: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.WEB: I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon,’ says the LORD; ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”
verses.ASV: and I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went to Babylon, saith Jehovah; for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu trarei de volta a este lugar a Jeconias filho de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, e a todos os levados cativos de Judá que entraram na Babilônia, diz o SENHOR; pois quebrarei o jugo do rei da Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Y yo tornaré á este lugar á Jechônías hijo de Joacim, rey de Judá, y á todos los trasportados de Judá que entraron en Babilonia, dice Jehová; porque yo quebrantaré el yugo del rey de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the Lord,
verses.WEB: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in the LORD’s house,
verses.ASV: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of Jehovah,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o profeta Jeremias disse ao profeta Hananias, diante dos sacerdotes e diante de todo o povo que estava na casa do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Entonces respondió Jeremías profeta á Hananías profeta, delante de los sacerdotes y delante de todo el pueblo que estaba en la casa de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the Lord do so: the Lord perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the Lord's house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
verses.WEB: even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May the LORD do so. May the LORD perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’s house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place.
verses.ASV: even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: Jehovah do so; Jehovah perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of Jehovah’s house, and all them of the captivity, from Babylon unto this place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disse, pois, o profeta Jeremias: Amém! Assim o faça o SENHOR! Que o SENHOR confirme as tuas palavras, com que profetizaste; para que os objetos de valor da casa do SENHOR, e sejam trazidos de volta todos os cativos da Babilônia para este lugar.
verses.RVR09: Y dijo Jeremías profeta: Amén, así lo haga Jehová. Confirme Jehová tus palabras, con las cuales profetizaste que los vasos de la casa de Jehová, y todos los trasportados, han de ser tornados de Babilonia á este lugar.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
verses.WEB: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:
verses.ASV: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém ouve agora esta palavra, que eu falo aos teus ouvidos e aos ouvidos de todo o povo:
verses.RVR09: Con todo eso, oye ahora esta palabra que yo hablo en tus oídos y en los oídos de todo el pueblo:

verses.KJV: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.WEB: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.ASV: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os profetas que foram antes de mim e antes de ti, desde os tempos antigos, profetizaram contra muitas terras e grandes reinos, guerra, aflição, e pestilência.
verses.RVR09: Los profetas que fueron antes de mí y antes de ti en tiempos pasados, profetizaron sobre muchas tierras y grandes reinos, de guerra, y de aflicción, y de pestilencia.

verses.KJV: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the Lord hath truly sent him.
verses.WEB: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet happens, then the prophet will be known, that the LORD has truly sent him.”
verses.ASV: The prophet that prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that Jehovah hath truly sent him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O profeta que profetizar paz, quando suceder a palavra daquele profeta, será reconhecido tal profeta, que o SENHOR verdadeiramente o enviou.
verses.RVR09: El profeta que profetizó de paz, cuando sobreviniere la palabra del profeta, será conocido el profeta que Jehová en verdad lo envió.

verses.KJV: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.
verses.WEB: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.
verses.ASV: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então o profeta Hananias tomou o jugo do pescoço do profeta Jeremias, e o quebrou,
verses.RVR09: Entonces Hananías profeta quitó el yugo del cuello de Jeremías profeta, y quebrólo.

verses.KJV: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.WEB: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “The LORD says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.’” Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.ASV: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon within two full years from off the neck of all the nations. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falou Hananias diante dos olhos de todo o povo, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: Desta maneira quebrarei o jugo de Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, dentro do tempo de dois anos, de sobre o pescoço de todas as nações. E Jeremias saiu dali.
