verses.RVR09: Y habló Hananías en presencia de todo el pueblo, diciendo: Así ha dicho Jehová: De esta manera quebraré el yugo de Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, del cuello de todas las gentes dentro de dos años de días. Y fuése Jeremías su camino.

verses.KJV: Then the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.ASV: Then the word of Jehovah came unto Jeremiah, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas depois que o profeta Hananias quebrou o jugo do pescoço do profeta Jeremias, veio a palavra do SENHOR a Jeremias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y después que Hananías profeta quebró el yugo del cuello de Jeremías profeta, fué palabra de Jehová á Jeremías, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
verses.WEB: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘The LORD says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron.”
verses.ASV: Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: Thou hast broken the bars of wood; but thou hast made in their stead bars of iron.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vai, e fala a Hananias, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: Jugos de madeira quebraste, mas farás em seu lugar jugos de ferro.
verses.RVR09: Ve, y habla á Hananías, diciendo: Así ha dicho Jehová: Yugos de madera quebraste, mas en vez de ellos harás yugos de hierro.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
verses.WEB: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. I have also given him the animals of the field.”’”
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Jugo de ferro pus sobre o pescoço de todas estas nações, para que sirvam a Nabucodonosor rei da Babilônia, e a ele servirão; e até os animais do campo eu lhe dei.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: Yugo de hierro puse sobre el cuello de todas estas gentes, para que sirvan á Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, y han de servirle; y aun también le he dado las bestias del campo.

verses.KJV: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The Lord hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
verses.WEB: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent you, but you make this people trust in a lie.
verses.ASV: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah: Jehovah hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
verses.ALMEIDA: E disse o profeta Jeremias ao profeta Hananias: Agora ouve, Hananias: o SENHOR não te enviou, porém tu fizeste este povo confiar em mentiras.
verses.RVR09: Entonces dijo el profeta Jeremías á Hananías profeta: Ahora oye, Hananías; Jehová no te envió, y tú has hecho confiar á este pueblo en mentira.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the Lord.
verses.WEB: Therefore the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will send thee away from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast spoken rebellion against Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que eu te expulso de sobre a face da terra; morrerás neste ano, porque falaste rebelião contra o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que yo te envío de sobre la haz de la tierra: morirás en este año, porque hablaste rebelión contra Jehová.

verses.KJV: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.WEB: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.ASV: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.ALMEIDA: E morreu o profeta Hananias no mesmo ano, no sétimo mês.
verses.RVR09: Y en el mismo año murió Hananías en el mes séptimo.

verses.KJV: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
verses.WEB: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,
verses.ASV: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people, whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas são as palavras da carta que o profeta Jeremias enviou de Jerusalém ao restante dos anciãos levados cativos, como também aos sacerdotes e aos profetas, e a todo o povo, que Nabucodonosor havia transportado de Jerusalém para a Babilônia,
verses.RVR09: Y ESTAS son las palabras de la carta que Jeremías profeta envió de Jerusalem á los ancianos que habían quedado de los trasportados, y á los sacerdotes y profetas, y á todo el pueblo que Nabucodonosor llevó cautivo de Jerusalem á Babilonia:

verses.KJV: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
verses.WEB: (after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem),
verses.ASV: (after that Jeconiah the king, and the queen-mother, and the eunuchs, [and] the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem),
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois da saída do rei Jeconias, da rainha-mãe, dos príncipes de Judá e Jerusalém, e dos carpinteiros e ferreiros de Jerusalém,
verses.RVR09: (Después que salió el rey Jechônías y la reina, y los de palacio, y los príncipes de Judá y de Jerusalem, y los artífices, y los ingenieros de Jerusalem;)

verses.KJV: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
verses.WEB: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:
verses.ASV: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon), saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: [Enviada] pela mão de Elasá, filho de Safã, e de Gemarias, filho de Hilquias, os quais Zedequias rei de Judá enviou a Nabucodonosor rei da Babilônia, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Por mano de Elasa hijo de Saphán, y de Jemarías hijo de Hilcías, (los cuales envió Sedechîas rey de Judá á Babilonia, á Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia,) diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all the captivity, whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem unto Babylon:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, a todos os levados cativos, os quais fiz transportar de Jerusalém à Babilônia:
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, á todos los de la cautividad que hice trasportar de Jerusalem á Babilonia:

verses.KJV: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.WEB: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.
verses.ASV: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Edificai casas, e [nelas] habitai; plantai hortas, e comei o fruto delas.
verses.RVR09: Edificad casas, y morad; y plantad huertos, y comed del fruto de ellos;

verses.KJV: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.WEB: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.
verses.ASV: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters: and multiply ye there, and be not diminished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomai esposas, e gerai filhos e filhas, e tomai esposas para vossos filhos, e dai vossas filhas a homens, para que gerem filhos e filhas; e ali multiplicai-vos, e não vos diminuais.
verses.RVR09: Casaos, y engendrad hijos é hijas; dad mujeres á vuestros hijos, y dad maridos á vuestras hijas, para que paran hijos é hijas; y multiplicaos ahí, y no os hagáis pocos.

verses.KJV: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the Lord for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.WEB: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to the LORD for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”
verses.ASV: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray unto Jehovah for it; for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: E buscai a paz da cidade para onde eu vos levei, e orai por ela ao SENHOR; porque na paz dela vós tereis paz.
verses.RVR09: Y procurad la paz de la ciudad á la cual os hice traspasar, y rogad por ella á Jehová; porque en su paz tendréis vosotros paz.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.WEB: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Let not your prophets that are in the midst of you, and your diviners, deceive you; neither hearken ye to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Os vossos profetas, que há entre vós, e vossos adivinhos não vos enganem; nem escutais a vossos sonhos, que vós sonhais.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: No os engañen vuestros profetas que están entre vosotros, ni vuestros adivinos; ni miréis á vuestros sueños que soñáis.

verses.KJV: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eles vos profetizam falsamente em meu nome; eu não os enviei, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque falsamente os profetizan ellos en mi nombre: no los envié, ha dicho Jehová.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah, After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Certamente que, quando se cumprirem setenta anos na Babilônia, eu vos visitarei; e cumprirei sobre vós minha boa palavra, trazendo-vos de volta a este lugar.
verses.RVR09: Porque así dijo Jehová: Cuando en Babilonia se cumplieren los setenta años, yo os visitaré, y despertaré sobre vosotros mi buena palabra, para tornaros á este lugar.

verses.KJV: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.WEB: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
verses.ASV: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith Jehovah, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope in your latter end.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu sei os pensamentos que penso quanto a vós, diz o SENHOR, pensamentos de paz, e não de mal, para vos dar um futuro com esperança.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo sé los pensamientos que tengo acerca de vosotros, dice Jehová, pensamientos de paz, y no de mal, para daros el fin que esperáis.

verses.KJV: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.WEB: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
verses.ASV: And ye shall call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então me invocareis, e ireis, e orareis a mim, e eu vos ouvirei;
verses.RVR09: Entonces me invocaréis, é iréis y oraréis á mí, y yo os oiré:

verses.KJV: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.WEB: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
verses.ASV: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós me buscareis e achareis, quando me buscardes de todo o vosso coração.
verses.RVR09: Y me buscaréis y hallaréis, porque me buscaréis de todo vuestro corazón.

verses.KJV: And I will be found of you, saith the Lord: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the Lord; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.WEB: I will be found by you,” says the LORD, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says the LORD. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”
verses.ASV: And I will be found of you, saith Jehovah, and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith Jehovah; and I will bring you again unto the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.ALMEIDA: E serei achado por vós, diz o SENHOR, e vos restauarei de vosso infortúnio, e vos ajuntarei de todas as nações, e de todos os lugares para onde eu vos lancei, diz o SENHOR; e vos farei voltar ao lugar de onde vos fiz serdes levados cativos.
verses.RVR09: Y seré hallado de vosotros, dice Jehová, y tornaré vuestra cautividad, y os juntaré de todas las gentes, y de todos los lugares adonde os arrojé, dice Jehová; y os haré volver al lugar de donde os hice ser llevados.

verses.KJV: Because ye have said, The Lord hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
verses.WEB: Because you have said, “The LORD has raised us up prophets in Babylon,”
verses.ASV: Because ye have said, Jehovah hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
verses.ALMEIDA: Visto que dizeis: “O SENHOR tem nos levantado profetas na Babilônia”,
verses.RVR09: Mas habéis dicho: Jehová nos ha suscitado profetas en Babilonia.

verses.KJV: Know that thus saith the Lord of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.WEB: the LORD says concerning the king who sits on David’s throne, and concerning all the people who dwell in this city, your brothers who haven’t gone with you into captivity,
verses.ASV: thus saith Jehovah concerning the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and concerning all the people that dwell in this city, your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.ALMEIDA: por isso assim diz o SENHOR acerca do rei que se assenta sobre o trono de Davi, e de todo o povo que mora nesta cidade, os vossos irmãos que não saíram convosco ao cativeiro;
verses.RVR09: Así empero ha dicho Jehová, del rey que está sentado sobre el trono de David, y de todo el pueblo que mora en esta ciudad, de vuestros hermanos que no salieron con vosotros en cautiverio;

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.WEB: the LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like rotten figs that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.
verses.ASV: thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so bad.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eis que enviarei contra eles espada, fome, e pestilência; e farei deles como a figos podres, que de tão ruins não podem ser comidos.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: He aquí envío yo contra ellos cuchillo, hambre, y pestilencia, y pondrélos como los malos higos, que de malos no se pueden comer.

verses.KJV: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
verses.WEB: I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,
verses.ASV: And I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed to and fro among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an execration, and an astonishment, and a hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them;
verses.ALMEIDA: E os perseguirei com espada, com fome e com pestilência; e os farei de horror a todos os reinos da terra, de maldição e de espanto, e de assovio e de humilhação entre todas a nações às quais eu os tiver lançado;
verses.RVR09: Y perseguirélos con espada, con hambre y con pestilencia; y darélos por escarnio á todos los reinos de la tierra, por maldición y por espanto, y por silbo y por afrenta á todas la gentes á las cuales los habré arrojado;

verses.KJV: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the Lord, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: because they have not listened to my words,” says the LORD, “with which I sent to them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: because they have not hearkened to my words, saith Jehovah, wherewith I sent unto them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não deram ouvidos às minhas palavras, diz o SENHOR, que lhes enviei por meus servos os profetas, insistindo em os enviar; próem não escutastes, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque no oyeron mis palabras, dice Jehová, que les envié por mis siervos los profetas, madrugando en enviarlos; y no habéis escuchado, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Hear ye therefore the word of the Lord, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.WEB: Hear therefore the LORD’s word, all you captives whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.ASV: Hear ye therefore the word of Jehovah, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós, pois, ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, todos os do cativeiro que enviei de Jerusalém à Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Oid pues palabra de Jehová, vosotros todos los trasportados que eché de Jerusalem á Babilonia.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: “Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will kill them before your eyes.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie unto you in my name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, quanto a Acabe filho de Colaías, e quanto a Zedequias filho de Maaseias, que vos profetizam falsamente em meu nome: Eis que os entregarei na mão de Nabucodonosor rei da Babilônia, e ele os ferirá diante de vossos olhos.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, acerca de Achâb hijo de Colías, y acerca de Sedechîas hijo de Maasías, quienes os profetizan en mi nombre falsamente: He aquí los entrego yo en mano de Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, y él los herirá delante de vuestro ojos;

verses.KJV: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The Lord make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
verses.WEB: A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘The LORD make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;’
verses.ASV: and of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captives of Judah that are in Babylon, saying, Jehovah make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os exilados de Judá que estão na Babilônia, os usarão como objeto de maldição, dizendo: Que o SENHOR faça a ti como a Zedequias e como a Acabe, aos quais o rei de Babilônia assou no fogo;
verses.RVR09: Y todos los trasportados de Judá que están en Babilonia, tomarán de ellos maldición, diciendo: Póngate Jehová como á Sedechîas y como á Achâb, los cuales asó al fuego el rey de Babilonia.

verses.KJV: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: because they have done foolish things in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I didn’t command them. I am he who knows, and am witness,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: because they have wrought folly in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I commanded them not; and I am he that knoweth, and am witness, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: porque fizeram loucura em Israel, e cometeram adultério com as mulheres de seus próximos; e falaram falsamente em meu nome palavra que não lhes mandei; e disso eu sei, e sou testemunha, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Porque hicieron maldad en Israel, y cometieron adulterio con las mujeres de sus prójimos, y falsamente hablaron en mi nombre palabra que no les mandé; lo cual yo sé, y soy testigo, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
verses.WEB: Concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying,
verses.ASV: And concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite thou shalt speak, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E a Semaías o neelamita falarás, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y á Semaías de Nehelam hablarás, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.WEB: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.ASV: Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thine own name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, dizendo: Enviaste em teu nome cartas a todo o povo que está em Jerusalém, e a Sofonias, filho do sacerdote Maaseias, e a todos os sacerdotes, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Así habló Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, diciendo: Por cuanto enviaste letras en tu nombre á todo el pueblo que está en Jerusalem, y á Sophonías sacerdote hijo de Maasías, y á todos los sacerdotes, diciendo:

verses.KJV: The Lord hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the Lord, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
verses.WEB: “The LORD has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in the LORD’s house, for every man who is crazy and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in the house of Jehovah, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in the stocks and in shackles.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR te pôs por sacerdote em lugar do sacerdote Joiada, para que sejas supervisor na casa do SENHOR sobre todo homem furioso e profetizante, para o lançares na prisão e no tronco.
verses.RVR09: Jehová te ha puesto por sacerdote en lugar de Joiada sacerdote, para que presidáis en la casa de Jehová sobre todo hombre furioso y profetizante, poniéndolo en el calabozo y en el cepo.

verses.KJV: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
verses.WEB: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,
verses.ASV: Now therefore, why hast thou not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who maketh himself a prophet to you,
verses.ALMEIDA: Agora, pois, por que não repreendeste a Jeremias de Anatote, que vos profetiza?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué pues no has ahora reprendido á Jeremías de Anathoth, que os profetiza falsamente?

verses.KJV: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.WEB: because he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, The captivity is long. Build houses, and dwell in them. Plant gardens, and eat their fruit?”’”
verses.ASV: forasmuch as he hath sent unto us in Babylon, saying, [The captivity] is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque por isso ele nos mandou dizer na Babilônia: [O cativeiro] será duradouro; edificai casas, e [nelas] morai; plantai hortas, e comei o fruto delas.
verses.RVR09: Porque por eso nos envió á decir en Babilonia: Largo va el cautiverio: edificad casas, y morad; plantad huertos, y comed el fruto de ellos.

verses.KJV: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.WEB: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.ASV: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o sacerdote Sofonias leu esta carta aos ouvidos do profeta Jeremias.
verses.RVR09: Y Sophonías sacerdote había leído esta carta á oídos de Jeremías profeta.

verses.KJV: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.WEB: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.ASV: Then came the word of Jehovah unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Jeremias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué palabra de Jehová á Jeremías, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the Lord concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
verses.WEB: “Send to all of the captives, saying, ‘The LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn’t send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie,”
verses.ASV: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith Jehovah concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he hath caused you to trust in a lie;
verses.ALMEIDA: Manda dizer a todos os do cativeiro: Assim diz o SENHOR quanto a Semaías, o neelamita: Visto que Semaías vos profetizou, sem que eu tenha o enviado, e vos fez confiar em mentiras;
verses.RVR09: Envía á decir á toda la transmigración: Así ha dicho Jehová de Semaías de Nehelam: Porque os profetizó Semaías, y yo no lo envié, y os hizo confiar en mentira:

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the Lord; because he hath taught rebellion against the Lord.
verses.WEB: therefore the LORD says, “Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. He will not have a man to dwell among this people. He won’t see the good that I will do to my people,” says the LORD, “because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD.”’”
verses.ASV: therefore thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed; he shall not have a man to dwell among this people, neither shall he behold the good that I will do unto my people, saith Jehovah, because he hath spoken rebellion against Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que castigarei Semaías o neelamita, e a sua descendência; ele não terá ninguém que habite entre este povo, nem verá o bem que eu farei a meu povo, diz o SENHOR; pois ele falou rebelião contra o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que yo visito sobre Semaías de Nehelam, y sobre su generación: no tendrá varón que more entre este pueblo, ni verá aquel bien que haré yo á mi pueblo, dice Jehová: porque contra Jehová ha hablado rebelión.

verses.KJV: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.WEB: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.ASV: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra que veio do SENHOR a Jeremias, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: PALABRA que fué á Jeremías de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus speaketh the Lord God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.WEB: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.
verses.ASV: Thus speaketh Jehovah, the God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel, dizendo: Escreve para ti em um livro todas as palavras que tenho te falado;
verses.RVR09: Así habló Jehová Dios de Israel, diciendo: Escríbete en un libro todas las palabras que te he hablado.

verses.KJV: For, lo, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the Lord: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.WEB: For, behold, the days come,’ says the LORD, ‘that I will reverse the captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ says the LORD. ‘I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”
verses.ASV: For, lo, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will turn again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith Jehovah; and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que restaurarei o meu povo, Israel e Judá, de seus infortúnios, diz o SENHOR, e os trarei de volta à terra que dei a seus pais, e a possuirão.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí que vienen días, dice Jehová, en que tornaré la cautividad de mi pueblo Israel y Judá, ha dicho Jehová, y harélos volver á la tierra que dí á sus padres, y la poseerán.

verses.KJV: And these are the words that the Lord spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.WEB: These are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.ASV: And these are the words that Jehovah spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estas são as palavras que o SENHOR falou quanto a Israel e a Judá;
verses.RVR09: Estas pues son las palabras que habló Jehová acerca de Israel y de Judá.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says: “We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah: We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Ouvimos voz de tremor; há temor, e não paz.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová: Hemos oído voz de temblor: espanto, y no paz.

verses.KJV: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.WEB: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?
verses.ASV: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child: wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.ALMEIDA: Perguntai pois, e olhai se o homem dá à luz; então por que vejo que todo homem [com] as mãos sobre seus lombos, como [se fosse] mulher de parto? E [por que] todos os rostos ficaram pálidos?
verses.RVR09: Preguntad ahora, y mirad si pare el varón: porque he visto que todo hombre tenía las manos sobre sus lomos, como mujer de parto, y hanse tornado pálidos todos los rostros.

verses.KJV: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble, but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.WEB: Alas, for that day is great, so that none is like it! It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out of it.
verses.ASV: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai! Pois aquele dia é tão grande, que não houve outro semelhante; é tempo de angústia para Jacó; porém será livrado dela.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ah, cuán grande es aquel día! tanto, que no hay otro semejante á él: tiempo de angustia para Jacob; mas de ella será librado.

verses.KJV: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
verses.WEB: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds. Strangers will no more make them their bondservants;
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds; and strangers shall no more make him their bondman;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois será naquele dia,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, que eu quebrarei seu jugo de teu pescoço, e romperei tuas amarras; e estrangeiros nunca mais se servirão dele.
verses.RVR09: Y será en aquel día, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, que yo quebraré su yugo de tu cuello, y romperé tus coyundas, y extraños no lo volverán más á poner en servidumbre,

verses.KJV: But they shall serve the Lord their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.WEB: but they will serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.
verses.ASV: but they shall serve Jehovah their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso servirão ao SENHOR, seu Deus, e a Davi, seu rei, o qual lhes levantarei.
verses.RVR09: Sino que servirán á Jehová su Dios, y á David su rey, el cual les levantaré.

verses.KJV: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the Lord; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.WEB: Therefore don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says the LORD. Don’t be dismayed, Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar, and save your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.
verses.ASV: Therefore fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith Jehovah; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu pois, servo meu Jacó, não temas, diz o SENHOR, nem te espantes, ó Israel; porque eis que te salvarei de longe, e a tua descendência da terra do seu cativeiro; e Jacó voltará, descansará e sossegará, e não haverá quem [o] atemorize.
verses.RVR09: Tú pues, siervo mío Jacob, no temas, dice Jehová, ni te atemorices, Israel: porque he aquí que yo soy el que te salvo de lejos, y á tu simiente de la tierra de su cautividad; y Jacob tornará, y descansará y sosegará, y no habrá quien le espante.

verses.KJV: For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet I will not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
verses.WEB: For I am with you, says the LORD, to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”
verses.ASV: For I am with thee, saith Jehovah, to save thee: for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have scattered thee, but I will not make a full end of thee; but I will correct thee in measure, and will in no wise leave thee unpunished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois estou contigo,diz o SENHOR, para te salvar; e pois exterminarei todas as nações entre a quais te espalhei; porém eu não exterminarei, mas te castigarei com moderação, e não te deixarei impune.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo soy contigo, dice Jehová, para salvarte: y haré consumación en todas las gentes entre la cuales te esparcí; en ti empero no haré consumación, sino que te castigaré con juicio, y no te talaré del todo.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah, Thy hurt is incurable, and thy wound grievous.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Teu quebrantamento é incurável, tua ferida é grave.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová: Desahuciado es tu quebrantamiento, y dificultosa tu llaga.

verses.KJV: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.WEB: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
verses.ASV: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não há quem julgue tua causa quanto a [tua] enfermidade; não há para ti remédios que curem.
verses.RVR09: No hay quien juzgue tu causa para salud: no hay para ti eficaces medicamentos.

verses.KJV: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
verses.WEB: All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.
verses.ASV: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not: for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of thine iniquity, because thy sins were increased.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os teus amantes se esqueceram de ti [e] não te buscam; pois te feri [com] ferida de inimigo, [com] castigo [como] de [alguém] cruel, por causa da grandeza de tua maldade, e da multidão de teus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Todos tus enamorados te olvidaron; no te buscan; porque de herida de enemigo te herí, con azote de cruel, á causa de la muchedumbre de tu maldad, y de la multitud de tus pecados.

verses.KJV: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.WEB: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.
verses.ASV: Why criest thou for thy hurt? thy pain is incurable: for the greatness of thine iniquity, because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que gritas por causa de teu quebrantamento? Tua dor é incurável; [pois] pela grandeza de tua maldade, [e] pela multidão de teus pecados te fiz estas coisas.
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué gritas á causa de tu quebrantamiento? Desahuciado es tu dolor: porque por la grandeza de tu iniquidad, y por tus muchos pecados te he hecho esto.

verses.KJV: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.WEB: Therefore all those who devour you will be devoured. All your adversaries, everyone of them, will go into captivity. Those who plunder you will be plunder. I will make all who prey on you become prey.
verses.ASV: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that despoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém serão devorados todos os que te devoram; e todos os teus adversários, todos eles irão ao cativeiro; e roubados serão os que te roubam, e a todos os que te despojam entregarei para que sejam despojados.
verses.RVR09: Empero serán consumidos todos los que te consumen; y todos tus afligidores, todos irán en cautiverio; y hollados serán los que te hollaron, y á todos los que hicieron presa de ti daré en presa.

verses.KJV: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the Lord; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
verses.WEB: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds,” says the LORD, “because they have called you an outcast, saying, ‘It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.’”
verses.ASV: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith Jehovah; because they have called thee an outcast, [saying], It is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu te farei ter saúde, e sararei tuas feridas, diz o SENHOR; pois te chamaram de rejeitada, [dizendo] : Esta é Sião, a quem ninguém busca.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo haré venir sanidad para ti, y te sanaré de tus heridas, dice Jehová; porque Arrojada te llamaron, diciendo: Esta es Sión, á la que nadie busca.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will turn again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling-places; and the city shall be builded upon its own hill, and the palace shall be inhabited after its own manner.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que restaurarei as tendas de Jacó de seu infortúnio, e me compadecerei de suas moradas; e a cidade será reedificada de suas ruínas, e o templo será posto no lugar de costume.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí yo hago tornar la cautividad de las tiendas de Jacob, y de sus tiendas tendré misericordia; y la ciudad será edificada sobre su collado, y el templo será asentado según su forma.

verses.KJV: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.WEB: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.
verses.ASV: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sairá deles louvor, e voz dos que estão cheios de alegria; e eu os multiplicarei, e não serão diminuídos; eu os glorificarei, e não serão menosprezados.
verses.RVR09: Y saldrá de ellos alabanza, y voz de gente que está en regocijo: y los multiplicaré, y no serán disminuídos; multiplicarélos, y no serán menoscabados.

verses.KJV: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.WEB: Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them.
verses.ASV: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me; and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus filhos serão como no passado; e sua congregação será confirmada diante de mim; e punirei a todos os seus opressores.
verses.RVR09: Y serán sus hijos como de primero y su congregación delante de mí será confirmada; y visitaré á todos sus opresores.

verses.KJV: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he will approach me; for who is he who has had boldness to approach me?” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And their prince shall be of themselves, and their ruler shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is he that hath had boldness to approach unto me? saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seu líder será dele, e seu governador saíra do meio dele; e eu o farei chegar perto, e ele se achegará a mim; pois quem jamais confiou em seu próprio coração para se achegar a mim? diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y de él será su fuerte, y de en medio de él saldrá su enseñoreador; y haréle llegar cerca, y acercaráse á mí: porque ¿quién es aquel que ablandó su corazón para llegarse á mí? dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.WEB: “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.ASV: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vós sereis meu povo, e eu serei vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y me seréis por pueblo, y yo seré vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Behold, the whirlwind of the Lord goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
verses.WEB: Behold, the LORD’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked.
verses.ASV: Behold, the tempest of Jehovah, [even his] wrath, is gone forth, a sweeping tempest: it shall burst upon the head of the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que a tempestade do SENHOR sai [com] furor, a tempestade impetuosa, que sobre a cabeça dos ímpios cairá.
verses.RVR09: He aquí, la tempestad de Jehová sale con furor, la tempestad que se apareja; sobre la cabeza de los impíos reposará.

verses.KJV: The fierce anger of the Lord shall not return, until he hath done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
verses.WEB: The fierce anger of the LORD will not return until he has accomplished, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.”
verses.ASV: The fierce anger of Jehovah shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall understand it.
verses.ALMEIDA: A ardente ira do SENHOR não retrocederá enquanto não tiver feito e cumprido os pensamentos de seu coração; no fim dos dias entendereis isto.
verses.RVR09: No se volverá la ira del enojo de Jehová, hasta que haya hecho y cumplido los pensamientos de su corazón: en el fin de los días entenderéis esto.

verses.KJV: At the same time, saith the Lord, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
verses.WEB: “At that time,” says the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”
verses.ASV: At that time, saith Jehovah, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele tempo,diz o SENHOR, eu serei o Deus de todas as famílias de Israel, e elas serão o meu povo.
verses.RVR09: EN aquel tiempo, dice Jehová, yo seré por Dios á todos los linajes de Israel, y ellos me serán á mí por pueblo.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.WEB: The LORD says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah, The people that were left of the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: O povo dos que escaparam da espada encontrou graça no deserto; [este é] Israel, quando eu o fizer descansar.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Halló gracia en el desierto el pueblo, los que escaparon del cuchillo, yendo yo para hacer hallar reposo á Israel.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.WEB: The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.
verses.ASV: Jehovah appeared of old unto me, [saying], Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR apareceu a mim já há muito tempo, dizendo: Com amor eterno eu tenho te amado; por isso com bondade te sustento.
verses.RVR09: Jehová se manifestó á mí ya mucho tiempo há, diciendo: Con amor eterno te he amado; por tanto te soporté con misericordia.

verses.KJV: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.WEB: I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry.
verses.ASV: Again will I build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: again shalt thou be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Novamente te edificarei, e serás edificada, ó virgem de Israel; novamente serás adornada com teus tamborins, e sairás na dança dos que se alegram.
verses.RVR09: Aun te edificaré, y serás edificada, oh virgen de Israel: todavía serás adornada con tus panderos, y saldrás en corro de danzantes.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
verses.WEB: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit.
verses.ASV: Again shalt thou plant vineyards upon the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant, and shall enjoy [the fruit thereof].
verses.ALMEIDA: Novamente plantarás vinhas nos montes de Samaria; os plantadores plantarão, e [delas] desfrutarão.
verses.RVR09: Aun plantarás viñas en los montes de Samaria: plantarán los plantadores, y harán común uso de ellas.

verses.KJV: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the Lord our God.
verses.WEB: For there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry, ‘Arise! Let’s go up to Zion to the LORD our God.’”
verses.ASV: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the hills of Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto Jehovah our God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois haverá dia [em que] os vigilantes no monte de Efraim gritarão: Levantai-vos, e subamos a Sião, ao SENHOR nosso Deus!
verses.RVR09: Porque habrá día en que clamarán los guardas en el monte de Ephraim: Levantaos, y subamos á Sión, á Jehová nuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O Lord, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says, “Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations. Publish, praise, and say, ‘LORD, save your people, the remnant of Israel!’
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah, Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O Jehovah, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Cantai por Jacó com alegria, e jubilai por causa da principal de nações; anunciai, louvai, e dizei: Salva, SENHOR, o teu povo, o restante de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová: Regocijaos en Jacob con alegría, y dad voces de júbilo á la cabeza de gentes; haced oir, alabad, y decid: Oh Jehová, salva tu pueblo, el resto de Israel.

verses.KJV: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together. They will return as a great company.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, [and] with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall they return hither.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que eu os trarei da terra do norte, e os juntarei desde os confins da terra, entre os quais haverá cegos e aleijados, mulheres grávidas e as que tiveram parto juntamente; em grande multidão voltarão para cá.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo los vuelvo de tierra del aquilón, y los juntaré de los fines de la tierra, y entre ellos ciegos y cojos, la mujer preñada y la parida juntamente; en grande compañía tornarán acá.

verses.KJV: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.WEB: They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they won’t stumble; for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.ASV: They shall come with weeping; and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way wherein they shall not stumble; for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my first-born.
verses.ALMEIDA: Virão com choro, e com suplicações os trarei; e os guiarei a ribeiros de águas, por um caminho plano, em que não tropeçarão; porque sou um pai para Israel, e Efraim é meu primogênito.
verses.RVR09: Irán con lloro, mas con misericordias los haré volver, y harélos andar junto á arroyos de aguas, por camino derecho en el cual no tropezarán: porque soy á Israel por padre, y Ephraim es mi primogénito.

verses.KJV: Hear the word of the Lord, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
verses.WEB: “Hear the LORD’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.’
verses.ASV: Hear the word of Jehovah, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off; and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, ó nações, e [a] anunciai nos litorais de longe, e dizei: Aquele que espalhou a Israel o juntará e o guardará, tal como um pastor ao seu gado.
verses.RVR09: Oid palabra de Jehová, oh gentes, y hacedlo saber en las islas que están lejos, y decid: El que esparció á Israel lo juntará y guardará, como pastor á su ganado.

verses.KJV: For the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
verses.WEB: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.
verses.ASV: For Jehovah hath ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o SENHOR resgatou a Jacó, o livrou da mão do mais forte que ele.
verses.RVR09: Porque Jehová redimió á Jacob, redimiólo de mano del más fuerte que él.

verses.KJV: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the Lord, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.WEB: They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of the LORD, to the grain, to the new wine, to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd. Their soul will be as a watered garden. They will not sorrow any more at all.
verses.ASV: And they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow unto the goodness of Jehovah, to the grain, and to the new wine, and to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E virão, e jubilarão no lugar alto de Sião, e correrão para o bem do SENHOR: ao trigo, ao suco de uva, ao azeite, e aos cordeiros e bezerros; e a alma deles será como um jardim regado, e nunca mais se enfraquecerão.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrán, y harán alabanzas en lo alto de Sión, y correrán al bien de Jehová, al pan, y al vino, y al aceite, y al ganado de las ovejas y de las vacas; y su alma será como huerto de riego, ni nunca más tendrán dolor.

verses.KJV: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.WEB: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.ASV: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, and the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então a virgem se alegrará na dança, como também os jovens e os velhos juntamente; e tornarei seu pranto em alegria, e os consolarei, e os alegrarei em sua tristeza.
verses.RVR09: Entonces la virgen se holgará en la danza, los mozos y los viejos juntamente; y su lloro tornaré en gozo, y los consolaré, y los alegraré de su dolor.

verses.KJV: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E encherei a alma dos sacerdotes de fartura, e meu povo será saciado com o meu bem, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y el alma del sacerdote embriagaré de grosura, y será mi pueblo saciado de mi bien, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.”
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children; she refuseth to be comforted for her children, because they are not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Uma voz foi ouvida em Ramá, lamentação e choro amargo: Raquel chora por seus filhos; não quer ser consolada por causa de seus filhos, pois já não existem.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Voz fué oída en Ramá, llanto y lloro amargo: Rachêl que lamenta por sus hijos, no quiso ser consolada acerca de sus hijos, porque perecieron.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the Lord; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded,” says the LORD. “They will come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears; for thy work shall be rewarded, saith Jehovah; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Reprime tua voz de choro, e teus olhos de lágrimas; pois há recompensa para teu trabalho, diz o SENHOR, pois voltarão da terra do inimigo.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: Reprime tu voz del llanto, y tus ojos de las lágrimas; porque salario hay para tu obra, dice Jehová, y volverán de la tierra del enemigo.

verses.KJV: And there is hope in thine end, saith the Lord, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
verses.WEB: There is hope for your latter end,” says the LORD. “Your children will come again to their own territory.
verses.ASV: And there is hope for thy latter end, saith Jehovah; and [thy] children shall come again to their own border.
verses.ALMEIDA: E há esperança para o teu futuro,diz o SENHOR, pois os [teus] filhos voltarão a suas [próprias] fronteiras.
verses.RVR09: Esperanza también hay para tu fin, dice Jehová, y los hijos volverán á su término.

verses.KJV: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the Lord my God.
verses.WEB: “I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me, and I will be turned, for you are the LORD my God.
verses.ASV: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself [thus], Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a calf unaccustomed [to the yoke]: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art Jehovah my God.
verses.ALMEIDA: De fato ouvi Efraim se queixar, [dizendo] : Castigaste-me, e fui castigado como um novilho não domado; converte-me e serei convertido; pois tu és o SENHOR meu Deus.
verses.RVR09: Escuchando, he oído á Ephraim que se lamentaba: Azotásteme, y fuí castigado como novillo indómito: conviérteme y seré convertido; porque tú eres Jehová mi Dios.

verses.KJV: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.WEB: Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even confounded, because I bore the reproach of my youth.’
verses.ASV: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois depois que me desviei, arrependi-me; depois que entendi, golpeei-me na coxa; envergonhei-me, e me senti humilhado, porque levei a vergonha de minha juventude.
verses.RVR09: Porque después que me convertí, tuve arrepentimiento, y después que me conocí, herí el muslo: avergoncéme, y confundíme, porque llevé la afrenta de mis mocedades.

verses.KJV: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he a darling child? For as often as I speak against him, I still earnestly remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him. I will surely have mercy on him,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a darling child? for as often as I speak against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my heart yearneth for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não é Efraim um filho precioso para mim? Não é ele um filho do meu agrado? Pois mesmo tendo eu falado contra ele, eu me lembro dele constantemente. Por isso minhas entranhas se comovem por ele; certamente terei compaixão dele,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: ¿No es Ephraim hijo precioso para mí? ¿no es niño delicioso? pues desde que hablé de él, heme acordado de él constantemente. Por eso mis entrañas se conmovieron por él: apiadado, tendré de él misericordia, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
verses.WEB: “Set up road signs. Make guideposts. Set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went. Turn again, virgin of Israel. Turn again to these your cities.
verses.ASV: Set thee up waymarks, make thee guide-posts; set thy heart toward the highway, even the way by which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levanta para ti sinais, põe para ti marcos altos; presta atenção à vereda, ao caminho [por onde] vieste; volta-te, ó virgem de Israel, volta-te para estas tuas cidades.
verses.RVR09: Establécete señales, ponte majanos altos; nota atentamente la calzada, el camino por donde viniste: vuélvete, virgen de Israel, vuélvete á estas tus ciudades.

verses.KJV: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
verses.WEB: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the earth: a woman will encompass a man.”
verses.ASV: How long wilt thou go hither and thither, O thou backsliding daughter? for Jehovah hath created a new thing in the earth: A woman shall encompass a man.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando andarás sem rumo, ó filha rebelde? Pois o SENHOR criará uma coisa nova sobre a terra: uma fêmea cercará ao varão.
verses.RVR09: ¿Hasta cuándo andarás errante, oh hija contumaz? porque Jehová criará una cosa nueva sobre la tierra: una hembra rodeará al varón.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The Lord bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I reverse their captivity: ‘The LORD bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.’
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Yet again shall they use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity: Jehovah bless thee, O habitation of righteousness, O mountain of holiness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Novamente dirão esta palavra na terra de Judá e em suas cidades, quando eu os restaurar de seu infortúnio: O SENHOR te abençoe, ó morada de justiça, ó monte santo.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: Aun dirán esta palabra en la tierra de Judá y en sus ciudades, cuando yo convertiré su cautiverio: Jehová te bendiga, oh morada de justicia, oh monte santo.

verses.KJV: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
verses.WEB: Judah and all its cities will dwell therein together, the farmers, and those who go about with flocks.
verses.ASV: And Judah and all the cities thereof shall dwell therein together, the husbandmen, and they that go about with flocks.
verses.ALMEIDA: E nela habitarão Judá, e em todas as suas cidades juntamente: os lavradores, e os que caminham com o rebanho.
verses.RVR09: Y morarán allí Judá, y también en todas sus ciudades labradores, y los que van con rebaño.

verses.KJV: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verses.WEB: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”
verses.ASV: For I have satiated the weary soul, and every sorrowful soul have I replenished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque terei saciado a alma cansada, e enchido toda alma entristecida.
verses.RVR09: Porque habré embriagado el alma cansada, y henchido toda alma entristecida.

verses.KJV: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.WEB: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.
verses.ASV: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: (Nisto me despertei, e olhei; e meu sonho me foi agradável).
verses.RVR09: En esto me desperté, y vi, y mi sueño me fué sabroso.

verses.KJV: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.WEB: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of animal.
verses.ASV: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diz o SENHOR: Eis que vêm dias, em que semearei a casa de Israel e a casa de Judá com semente de homens e com semente de animais.
verses.RVR09: He aquí vienen días, dice Jehová, en que sembraré la casa de Israel y la casa de Judá de simiente de hombre y de simiente de animal.

verses.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: It will happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And it shall come to pass that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so will I watch over them to build and to plant, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, como tive atenção com eles para arrancar e para derrubar, para transtornar para destruir, e afligir, assim terei atenção com eles para edificar e plantar,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y será que, como tuve cuidado de ellos para arrancar y derribar, y trastornar y perder, y afligir, así tendré cuidado de ellos para edificar y plantar, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
verses.WEB: “In those days they will say no more, “‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’
verses.ASV: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naqueles dias nunca mais dirão: Os pais comeram uvas verdes, mas foram os dentes dos filhos que se estragaram.
verses.RVR09: En aquellos días no dirán más: Los padres comieron las uvas agraces, y los dientes de los hijos tienen la dentera.

verses.KJV: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.WEB: But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.
verses.ASV: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grapes, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao contrário, cada um morrerá por sua [própria] maldade; todo homem que comer as uvas verdes estragará seus dentes.
verses.RVR09: Sino que cada cual morirá por su maldad; los dientes de todo hombre que comiere las uvas agraces, tendrán la dentera.

verses.KJV: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
verses.WEB: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,
verses.ASV: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que vêm dias,diz o SENHOR, em que farei um novo pacto com a casa de Jacó e a casa de Judá;
verses.RVR09: He aquí que vienen días, dice Jehová, en los cuales haré nuevo pacto con la casa de Jacob y con la casa de Judá:

verses.KJV: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the Lord:
verses.WEB: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke, although I was a husband to them,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was a husband unto them, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não como o pacto que fiz com seus pais, no dia em que os tomei pela mão para os tirar da terra do Egito; pois invalidaram meu pacto, ainda que eu tenha me casado com eles,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No como el pacto que hice con sus padres el día que tomé su mano para sacarlos de tierra de Egipto; porque ellos invalidaron mi pacto, bien que fuí yo un marido para ellos, dice Jehová:

verses.KJV: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the Lord, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.WEB: “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the LORD: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart. I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.ASV: But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith Jehovah: I will put my law in their inward parts, and in their heart will I write it; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas este é o pacto que farei com a casa de Israel depois daqueles dias,diz o SENHOR: Darei minha lei em seu interior, e a escreverei em seus corações; e eu serei o Deus deles, e eles serão meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Mas éste es el pacto que haré con la casa de Israel después de aquellos días, dice Jehová: Daré mi ley en sus entrañas, y escribiréla en sus corazones; y seré yo á ellos por Dios, y ellos me serán por pueblo.

verses.KJV: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the Lord: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
