verses.WEB: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods and her kings, even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.
verses.ASV: Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, saith: Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods, and her kings; even Pharaoh, and them that trust in him:
verses.ALMEIDA: Diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que eu punirei a Amom de Nô, a Faraó e ao Egito; a seus deuses e a seus reis; tanto a Faraó como aos que nele confiam.
verses.RVR09: Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, ha dicho: He aquí que yo visito el pueblo de Amón de No, y á Faraón y á Egipto, y á sus dioses y á sus reyes; así á Faraón como á los que en él confían.

verses.KJV: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. Afterwards it will be inhabited, as in the days of old,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: and I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants; and afterwards it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os entregarei nas mãos dos que buscam [tirar] sua vida, e nas mãos de Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia, e nas mãos de seus servos; porém depois será habitada como nos dias anteriores,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y entregarélos en mano de los que buscan su alma, y en mano de Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, y en mano de sus siervos: mas después será habitada como en los días pasados, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.WEB: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.
verses.ASV: But fear not thou, O Jacob my servant, neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas tu não temas, meu servo Jacó, nem te espantes, ó Israel; porque eis que te salvarei desde [as terras] de longe, e teus descendentes da terra de seu cativeiro. E Jacó voltará, descansará, e viverá em paz; e não haverá quem o atemorize.
verses.RVR09: Y tú no temas, siervo mío Jacob, y no desmayes, Israel; porque he aquí que yo te salvo de lejos, y á tu simiente de la tierra de su cautividad. Y volverá Jacob, y descansará y será prosperado, y no habrá quien lo espante.

verses.KJV: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the Lord: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
verses.WEB: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says the LORD, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”
verses.ASV: Fear not thou, O Jacob my servant, saith Jehovah; for I am with thee: for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee; but I will not make a full end of thee, but I will correct thee in measure, and will in no wise leave thee unpunished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, meu servo Jacó, não temas,diz o SENHOR; pois eu estou contigo; porque destruirei por completo todas as nações entre as quais eu te lancei; porem a ti não destruirei por completo, mas te castigarei com moderação, e não te deixarei impune.
verses.RVR09: Tú, siervo mío Jacob, no temas, dice Jehová; porque yo soy contigo: porque haré consumación en todas las gentes á las cuales te habré echado; mas en ti no haré consumación, sino que te castigaré con juicio, y no te talaré del todo.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra do SENHOR que veio ao profeta Jeremias sobre os filisteus, antes que Faraó ferisse a Gaza.
verses.RVR09: PALABRA de Jehová que fué á Jeremías profeta acerca de los Palestinos, antes que Faraón hiriese á Gaza.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
verses.WEB: The LORD says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall become an overflowing stream, and shall overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and them that dwell therein; and the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall wail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que águas sobem do norte, e se tornarão em correnteza transbordante, e inundarão a terra e sua plenitude, as cidades, e moradores delas; os homens gritarão, e todos os moradores da terra uivarão,
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que suben aguas del aquilón, y tornaránse en torrente, é inundarán la tierra y su plenitud, ciudades y moradores de ellas; y los hombres clamarán, y aullará todo morador de la tierra.

verses.KJV: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.WEB: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back for their children because their hands are so feeble,
verses.ASV: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers look not back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao ruído dos cascos de seus fortes [cavalos] ,o tremor de suas caruagens, e o estrondo de suas rodas; os pais não olharão para os filhos por causa da fraqueza das mãos.
verses.RVR09: Por el sonido de las uñas de sus fuertes, por el alboroto de sus carros, por el estruendo de sus ruedas, los padres no miraron á los hijos por la flaqueza de las manos;

verses.KJV: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the Lord will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
verses.WEB: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for the LORD will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.
verses.ASV: because of the day that cometh to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remaineth: for Jehovah will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa do dia que vem, para arruinar a todos os filisteus, para cortar a Tiro e a Sidom todo ajudador que restar; pois o SENHOR destruirá aos filisteus, ao resto da ilha de Caftor.
verses.RVR09: A causa del día que viene para destrucción de todos los Palestinos, para talar á Tiro, y á Sidón, á todo ayudador que quedó vivo: porque Jehová destruirá á los Palestinos, al resto de la isla de Caphtor.

verses.KJV: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
verses.WEB: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?
verses.ASV: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nought, the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
verses.ALMEIDA: Veio calvície sobre Gaza; Ascalom e o resto de seu vale foram cortados fora. Até quando te ferirás com arranhões?
verses.RVR09: Sobre Gaza vino mesadura, Ascalón fué cortada, y el resto de su valle: ¿hasta cuándo te arañarás?

verses.KJV: O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
verses.WEB: “‘You sword of the LORD, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’
verses.ASV: O thou sword of Jehovah, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard; rest, and be still.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ah, espada do SENHOR! Até quando não te aquietarás? Volta-te em tua bainha, descansa, e aquieta-te.
verses.RVR09: Oh espada de Jehová, ¿hasta cuándo no reposarás? Métete en tu vaina, reposa y sosiega.

verses.KJV: How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
verses.WEB: “How can you be quiet, since the LORD has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there he has appointed it.”
verses.ASV: How canst thou be quiet, seeing Jehovah hath given thee a charge? Against Ashkelon, and against the sea-shore, there hath he appointed it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como te aquietarias? Pois o SENHOR lhe deu mandado contra Ascalom, e contra o litoral, [e] ali ele a ordenou.
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo reposarás? pues que Jehová lo ha enviado contra Ascalón, y á la ribera de la mar, allí lo puso.

verses.KJV: Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
verses.WEB: Of Moab. The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo! For it is laid waste. Kiriathaim is disappointed. It is taken. Misgab is put to shame and broken down.
verses.ASV: Of Moab. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Woe unto Nebo! for it is laid waste; Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and broken down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre Moabe.Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Ai de Nebo! Pois foi arruinada; envergonhada está Quiriataim, já foi tomada; Misgabe está envergonhada e espantada.
verses.RVR09: ACERCA de Moab. Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel: ¡Ay de Nebo! que fué destruída, fué avergonzada; Chîriathaim fué tomada; fué confusa Misgab, y desmayó.

verses.KJV: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
verses.WEB: The praise of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come! Let’s cut her off from being a nation.’ You also, Madmen, will be brought to silence. The sword will pursue you.
verses.ASV: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. Thou also, O Madmen, shalt be brought to silence; the sword shall pursue thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Já não há mais exaltação em Moabe; em Hesbom tramaram o mal contra ela, [dizendo] : Vinde, e a eliminemos das nações. Também tu, Madmém, serás cortada fora; a espada irá atrás de ti.
verses.RVR09: No se alabará ya más Moab; contra Hesbón maquinaron mal, diciendo: Venid, y quitémosla de entre las gentes. También tú, Madmén, serás cortada, espada irá tras ti.

verses.KJV: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
verses.WEB: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!
verses.ASV: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ouve-se] uma voz de clamor de Horonaim: Ruína e grande destruição!
verses.RVR09: ¡Voz de clamor de Horonaim, destrucción y gran quebrantamiento!

verses.KJV: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.WEB: Moab is destroyed. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.ASV: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: Moabe foi destruída; fizeram com que se ouvisse o grito de seus pequenos.
verses.RVR09: Moab fué quebrantada; hicieron que se oyese el clamor de sus pequeños.

verses.KJV: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
verses.WEB: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.
verses.ASV: For by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping shall they go up; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois na subida de Luíte subirão com grande choro; pois na descida de Horonaim os inimigos [de Moabe] ouviram clamor de destruição.
verses.RVR09: Porque á la subida de Luhith con lloro subirá el que llora; porque á la bajada de Horonaim los enemigos oyeron clamor de quebranto.

verses.KJV: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Flee! Save your lives! Be like the juniper bush in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fugi, livrai vossa vida, e sereis como um arbusto no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Huid, salvad vuestra vida, y sed como retama en el desierto.

verses.KJV: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
verses.WEB: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
verses.ASV: For, because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou also shalt be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois por causa de tua confiança confiaste em tuas obras e em teus tesouros, tu também serás tomada; e Quemos irá ao cativeiro, seus sacerdotes e juntamente seus príncipes.
verses.RVR09: Pues por cuanto confiaste en tus haciendas, en tus tesoros, tú también serás tomada: y Chêmos saldrá en cautiverio, los sacerdotes y sus príncipes juntamente.

verses.KJV: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord hath spoken.
verses.WEB: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as the LORD has spoken.
verses.ASV: And the destroyer shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; as Jehovah hath spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois virá o destruidor a cada uma das cidades, e nenhuma cidade escapará; e perecerá também o vale, e será destruída a planície,pois assim diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y vendrá destruidor á cada una de las ciudades, y ninguna ciudad escapará: arruinaráse también el valle, y será destruída la campiña, como ha dicho Jehová.

verses.KJV: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
verses.WEB: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.
verses.ASV: Give wings unto Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dai asas a Moabe, para que ele saia voando; pois suas cidades se tornarão desertas até não restar quem more nelas.
verses.RVR09: Dad alas á Moab, para que volando se vaya; pues serán desiertas sus ciudades hasta no quedar en ellas morador.

verses.KJV: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the Lord deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
verses.WEB: “Cursed is he who does the work of the LORD negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.
verses.ASV: Cursed be he that doeth the work of Jehovah negligently; and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Maldito aquele que fizer enganosamente a obra do SENHOR, e maldito aquele que detiver sua espada do sangue.
verses.RVR09: Maldito el que hiciere engañosamente la obra de Jehová, y maldito el que detuviere su cuchillo de la sangre.

verses.KJV: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.WEB: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.ASV: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remaineth in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tranquilo esteve Moabe desde sua juventude, e sobre suas impurezas esteve quieto; e não foi esvaziado de vaso em vaso, nem nunca foi ao cativeiro; por isso seu sabor ficou nele, e seu cheiro não mudou.
verses.RVR09: Quieto estuvo Moab desde su mocedad, y sobre sus heces ha estado él reposado, y no fué trasegado de vaso en vaso, ni nunca fué en cautiverio: por tanto quedó su sabor en él, y su olor no se ha trocado.

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
verses.WEB: Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.
verses.ASV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will send unto him them that pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que eu lhe enviarei derramadores que o derramarão; e esvaziarão seus vasos, e romperão seus jarros.
verses.RVR09: Por eso, he aquí que vienen días, ha dicho Jehová, en que yo le enviaré trasportadores que lo harán trasportar; y vaciarán sus vasos, y romperán sus odres.

verses.KJV: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
verses.WEB: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.
verses.ASV: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moabe se envergonhará de Quemos, assim como a casa de Israel se envergonhou de Betel, [que era] sua confiança.
verses.RVR09: Y avergonzaráse Moab de Chêmos, á la manera que la casa de Israel se avergonzó de Beth-el, su confianza.

verses.KJV: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
verses.WEB: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?
verses.ASV: How say ye, We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como direis: Somos guerreiros, homens valentes para a guerra?
verses.RVR09: ¿Cómo diréis: Somos valientes, y robustos hombres para la guerra?

verses.KJV: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Moabe é destruído, e suas cidades invadidas, e seus melhores rapazes descem ao degoladouro, diz o rei, cujo nome é EU-SOU dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Destruído fué Moab, y sus ciudades asoló, y sus escogidos mancebos descendieron al degolladero, ha dicho el Rey, cuyo nombre es Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
verses.WEB: “The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.
verses.ASV: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Próxima está a vinda da perdição de Moabe; e seu desastre vem com muita pressa.
verses.RVR09: Cercano está el quebrantamiento de Moab para venir, y su mal se apresura mucho.

verses.KJV: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
verses.WEB: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’
verses.ASV: All ye that are round about him, bemoan him, and all ye that know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!
verses.ALMEIDA: Condoei-vos dele todos vós que estais ao seu redor, e todos vós que sabeis seu nome. Dizei: Como se quebrou a vara forte, o belo cajado!
verses.RVR09: Compadeceos de él todos los que estáis alrededor suyo; y todos los que sabéis su nombre, decid: ¿Cómo se quebró la vara de fortaleza, el báculo de hermosura?

verses.KJV: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
verses.WEB: “You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.
verses.ASV: O thou daughter that dwellest in Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab is come up against thee, he hath destroyed thy strongholds.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desce da [tua] glória, e senta-te no lugar seco, ó moradora, filha de Dibom; pois o destruidor de Moabe subiu contra ti, e arruinou tuas fortalezas.
verses.RVR09: Desciende de la gloria, siéntate en seco, moradora hija de Dibón; porque el destruidor de Moab subió contra ti, disipó tus fortalezas.

verses.KJV: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
verses.WEB: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’
verses.ASV: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch: ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth; say, What hath been done?
verses.ALMEIDA: Para-te no caminho, e olha, ó moradora de Aroer; pergunta ao que vai fugindo, e à que escapou, dize: O que aconteceu?
verses.RVR09: Párate en el camino, y mira, oh moradora de Aroer: pregunta á la que va huyendo, y á la que escapó; dile: ¿Qué ha acontecido?

verses.KJV: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
verses.WEB: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
verses.ASV: Moab is put to shame; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell ye it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Responderão] : Moabe está envergonhado, porque foi quebrantado; uivai e gritai; anunciai em Arnom que Moabe foi destruído,
verses.RVR09: Avergonzóse Moab, porque fué quebrantado: aullad y clamad: denunciad en Arnón que Moab es destruído.

verses.KJV: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
verses.WEB: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,
verses.ASV: And judgment is come upon the plain country, upon Holon, and upon Jahzah, and upon Mephaath,
verses.ALMEIDA: O julgamento também veio juízo sobre a terra da planície: sobre Holom, sobre Jazá, e sobre Mefate;
verses.RVR09: Y que vino juicio sobre la tierra de la campiña; sobre Holón, y sobre Jahzah, y sobre Mephaath,

verses.KJV: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Bethdiblathaim,
verses.WEB: on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,
verses.ASV: and upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre Dibom, sobre Nebo, e sobre Bete-Diblataim;
verses.RVR09: Y sobre Dibón, y sobre Nebo, y sobre Beth-diblathaim,

verses.KJV: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Bethgamul, and upon Bethmeon,
verses.WEB: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,
verses.ASV: and upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre Quiriataim, sobre Bete-Gamul, e sobre Bete-Meom;
verses.RVR09: Y sobre Chîriathaim, y sobre Beth-gamul, y sobre Beth-meon,

verses.KJV: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.WEB: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.ASV: and upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre Queriote, sobre Bosra, e sobre todas as cidades da terra de Moabe, as de longe e as de perto.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre Chêrioth, y sobre Bosra, y sobre todas las ciudades de tierra de Moab, las de lejos y las de cerca.

verses.KJV: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O poder de Moabe foi cortado, e seu braço quebrado,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Cortado es el cuerno de Moab, y su brazo quebrantado, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
verses.WEB: “Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the LORD. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.
verses.ASV: Make ye him drunken; for he magnified himself against Jehovah: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
verses.ALMEIDA: Embriagai-o, pois contra o SENHOR se engrandeceu; e Moabe se revolverá sobre seu vômito, e ele também será por escárnio.
verses.RVR09: Embriagadlo, porque contra Jehová se engrandeció; y revuélquese Moab sobre su vómito, y sea también él por escarnio.

verses.KJV: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
verses.WEB: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.
verses.ASV: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for as often as thou speakest of him, thou waggest the head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois para ti não foi Israel por escárnio? Por acaso ele foi achado entre ladrões, para que balances a cabeça quando falas dele?
verses.RVR09: ¿Y no te fué á ti Israel por escarnio, como si lo tomaran entre ladrones? porque desde que de él hablaste, tú te has movido.

verses.KJV: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.
verses.WEB: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.
verses.ASV: O ye inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; and be like the dove that maketh her nest over the mouth of the abyss.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deixai as cidades, e habitai em rochedos, ó moradores de Moabe; e sejais como a pomba que faz ninho nas brechas da boca da caverna.
verses.RVR09: Desamparad las ciudades, y habitad en peñascos, oh moradores de Moab; y sed como la paloma que hace nido detrás de la boca de la caverna.

verses.KJV: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.WEB: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.
verses.ASV: We have heard of the pride of Moab, [that] he is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogancy, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.ALMEIDA: Temos ouvido a soberba de Moabe, que é soberbo demais, assim como sua arrogância e seu orgulho, sua altivez e a altura de seu coração.
verses.RVR09: Oído hemos la soberbia de Moab, que es muy soberbio: su hinchazón y su orgullo, y su altivez y la altanería de su corazón.

verses.KJV: I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
verses.WEB: I know his wrath,” says the LORD, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.
verses.ASV: I know his wrath, saith Jehovah, that it is nought; his boastings have wrought nothing.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu conheço sua insolência,diz o SENHOR; porém não será assim; suas mentiras lhe serão em vão.
verses.RVR09: Yo conozco, dice Jehová, su cólera; mas no tendrá efecto: sus mentiras no han de aprovecharle.

verses.KJV: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.
verses.WEB: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.
verses.ASV: Therefore will I wail for Moab; yea, I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir-heres shall they mourn.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu uivarei por Moabe, e gritarei por todo Moabe; gemerão por causa dos homens de Quir-Heres.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto yo aullaré sobre Moab, y sobre todo Moab haré clamor, y sobre los hombres de Kir-heres gemiré.

verses.KJV: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
verses.WEB: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.
verses.ASV: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for thee, O vine of Sibmah: thy branches passed over the sea, they reached even to the sea of Jazer: upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage the destroyer is fallen.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com o choro de Jazer chorarei por ti, ó vide de Sibma; teus sarmentos passaram o mar, [e] chegaram até o mar de Jazer; [porém] o destruidor veio sobre os frutos de teu verão, e sobre tua vindima.
verses.RVR09: Con lloro de Jazer lloraré por ti, oh vid de Sibma: tus sarmientos pasaron la mar, llegaron hasta la mar de Jazer: sobre tu agosto y sobre tu vendimia vino destruidor.

verses.KJV: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab, and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
verses.WEB: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.
verses.ASV: And gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim foram tirados a alegria e o regozijo dos campos férteis, e da terra de Moabe: pois fiz cessar o vinho das prensas; já não pisarão [uvas] com júbilo; o grito não será de júbilo.
verses.RVR09: Y será cortada la alegría y el regocijo de los campos labrados, y de la tierra de Moab: y haré cesar el vino de los lagares: no pisarán con canción; la canción no será canción.

verses.KJV: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
verses.WEB: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.
verses.ASV: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, even unto Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, to Eglath-shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Houve um grito desde Hesbom até Eleale e até Jaaz; deram sua voz desde Zoar até Horonaim e Eglate-Selísia; pois também as águas de Ninrim serão assoladas.
verses.RVR09: El clamor, desde Hesbón hasta Eleale; hasta Jaaz dieron su voz: desde Zoar hasta Horonaim, becerra de tres años: porque también las aguas de Nimrin serán destruídas.

verses.KJV: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the Lord, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
verses.WEB: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says the LORD, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.
verses.ASV: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith Jehovah, him that offereth in the high place, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu,diz o SENHOR, farei cessar de Moabe quem sacrifique no lugar alto, e quem ofereça incenso a seus deuses.
verses.RVR09: Y haré cesar de Moab, dice Jehová, quien sacrifique en altar, y quien ofrezca sahumerio á sus dioses.

verses.KJV: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kirheres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.
verses.WEB: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like flutes, and my heart sounds like flutes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.
verses.ASV: Therefore my heart soundeth for Moab like pipes, and my heart soundeth like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: therefore the abundance that he hath gotten is perished.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto meu coração ressoará como flautas por causa de Moab; também meu coração ressoará como flautas pelos homens de Quir-Heres; pois as riquezas que tinham acumulado se perderam;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, mi corazón resonará como flautas por causa de Moab, asimismo resonará mi corazón á modo de flautas por los hombres de Kir-heres: porque perecieron las riquezas que había hecho.

verses.KJV: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
verses.WEB: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.
verses.ASV: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands are cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois em toda cabeça haverá calva, e toda barba será cortada; sobre todas mãos há arranhões, e sobre todos os lombos há sacos.
verses.RVR09: Porque en toda cabeza habrá calva, y toda barba será raída; sobre todas manos rasguños, y sacos sobre todos los lomos.

verses.KJV: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: On all the housetops of Moab and in the streets thereof there is lamentation every where; for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein none delighteth, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre todas os terraços de Moabe e em suas ruas, em todo ele haverá pranto; pois eu quebrantei a Moabe como a um vaso desagradável,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Sobre todas las techumbres de Moab y en sus calles, todo él será llanto; porque yo quebranté á Moab como á vaso que no agrada, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
verses.WEB: “How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So will Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.”
verses.ASV: How is it broken down! [how] do they wail! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab become a derision and a terror to all that are round about him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como foi quebrantado! Como uivam! Como Moabe virou as costas, e se envergonhou! Assim Moabe servirá de escárnio e de espanto a todos os que estão ao seu redor.
verses.RVR09: Aullad: ¡Cómo ha sido quebrantado! ¡cómo volvió la cerviz Moab, y fué avergonzado! Y fué Moab en escarnio y en espanto á todos los que están en sus alrededores.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que voará como águia, e estenderá suas asas sobre Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que como águila volará, y extenderá sus alas á Moab.

verses.KJV: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.WEB: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.ASV: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomadas são as cidades, e invadidas são as fortalezas; e o coração dos guerreiros de Moabe naquele dia será como o coração de mulher em dores de parto.
verses.RVR09: Tomadas son las ciudades, y tomadas son las fortalezas; y será aquel día el corazón de los valientes de Moab como el corazón de mujer en angustias.

verses.KJV: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.
verses.WEB: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against the LORD.
verses.ASV: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Moabe será destruído de modo que deixará de ser povo, pois se engrandeceu contra o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y Moab será destruído para dejar de ser pueblo: porque se engrandeció contra Jehová.

verses.KJV: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Medo, cova, e laço [vem] sobre ti, ó morador de Moabe,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Miedo y hoyo y lazo sobre ti, oh morador de Moab, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon him, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O que fugir do medo, cairá na cova; e o que subir da cova, ficará preso do laço; porque eu trarei sobre ele, sobre Moabe, o ano de sua punição,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: El que huyere del miedo, caerá en el hoyo; y el que saliere del hoyo, será preso del lazo: porque yo traeré sobre él, sobre Moab, año de su visitación, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.WEB: “Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.ASV: They that fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire is gone forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and hath devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que fugiam da força, paravam à sombra de Hesbom; porém fogo saiu de Hesbom, e labareda do meio de Seom, e queimou a testa de Moabe, e o topo da cabeça dos filhos do tumulto.
verses.RVR09: A la sombra de Hesbón se pararon los que huían de la fuerza; mas salió fuego de Hesbón, y llama de en medio de Sihón, y quemó el rincón de Moab, y la mollera de los hijos revoltosos.

verses.KJV: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
verses.WEB: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.
verses.ASV: Woe unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh is undone; for thy sons are taken away captive, and thy daughters into captivity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ai de ti, Moabe! Pereceu o povo de Quemos; pois teus filhos foram levados cativos, e tuas filhas foram em cativeiro.
verses.RVR09: ¡Ay de ti, Moab! pereció el pueblo de Chêmos: porque tus hijos fueron presos para cautividad, y tus hijas para cautiverio.

verses.KJV: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.WEB: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.ASV: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith Jehovah. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém restaurarei Moabe de seu infortúnio nos últimos dias, diz o SENHOR. Até aqui é o julgamento de Moabe.
verses.RVR09: Empero haré tornar el cautiverio de Moab en lo postrero de los tiempos, dice Jehová. Hasta aquí es el juicio de Moab.

verses.KJV: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the Lord; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
verses.WEB: Of the children of Ammon. The LORD says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?
verses.ASV: Of the children of Ammon. Thus saith Jehovah: Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in the cities thereof?
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre os filhos de Amom.Assim diz o SENHOR: Por acaso Israel não tem filhos, nem tem herdeiro? Por que, pois, Malcã tomou posse de Gade, e seu povo habitou em suas cidades?
verses.RVR09: DE los hijos de Ammón. Así ha dicho Jehová: ¿No tiene hijos Israel? ¿No tiene heredero? ¿Por qué tomó como por heredad el rey de ellos á Gad, y su pueblo habitó en sus ciudades?

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and it will become a desolate heap, and her daughters will be burned with fire; then Israel will possess those who possessed him,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon; and it shall become a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel possess them that did possess him, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eis que vêm dias,diz o SENHOR, em que farei ouvir em Rabá dos filhos de Amom clamor de guerra; e se tornará em um amontoado de ruínas, e suas vilas serão queimadas a fogo; e Israel tomará posse daqueles que tinham lhes tomado, disse o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí vienen días, ha dicho Jehová, en que haré oir en Rabba de los hijos de Ammón clamor de guerra; y será puesta en montón de asolamiento, y sus ciudades serán puestas á fuego, é Israel tomará por heredad á los que los tomaron á ellos, ha dicho Jehová.

verses.KJV: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
verses.WEB: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah! Clothe yourself in sackcloth. Lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam will go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
verses.ASV: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste; cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth: lament, and run to and fro among the fences; for Malcam shall go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
verses.ALMEIDA: Uiva, ó Hesbom, porque Ai é destruída; clamai, ó filhas de Rabá, vesti-vos de sacos, lamentai, e rodeai pelas cercas, porque Malcã irá em cativeiro, seus sacerdotes e juntamente seus príncipes.
verses.RVR09: Aulla, oh Hesbón, porque destruída es Hai; clamad, hijas de Rabba, vestíos de sacos, endechad, y rodead por los vallados, porque el rey de ellos fué en cautiverio, sus sacerdotes y sus príncipes juntamente.

verses.KJV: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
verses.WEB: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come to me?’
verses.ASV: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, [saying], Who shall come unto me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que te orgulhas dos vales? Teu vale se desfez, ó filha rebelde, que confia em seus tesouros, [dizendo] : Quem virá contra mim?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué te glorías de los valles? Tu valle se deshizo, oh hija contumaz, la que confía en sus tesoros, la que dice: ¿Quién vendrá contra mí?

verses.KJV: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord God of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
verses.WEB: Behold, I will bring a terror on you,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies, “from all who are around you. All of you will be driven completely out, and there will be no one to gather together the fugitives.
verses.ASV: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, from all that are round about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth, and there shall be none to gather together the fugitives.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que trago medo sobre ti,diz o Senhor o SENHOR dos exércitos, de todos os que estão ao redor de ti; e sereis forçados a fugir, cada um por si, e não haverá quem consiga reunir os que andam sem rumo.
verses.RVR09: He aquí yo traigo sobre ti espanto, dice el Señor Jehová de los ejércitos, de todos tus alrededores; y seréis lanzados cada uno en derechura de su rostro, y no habrá quien recoja al errante.

verses.KJV: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: But afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas depois disso restaurarei os filhos de Amom de seu infortúnio, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y después de esto haré tornar la cautividad de los hijos de Ammón, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
verses.WEB: Of Edom, the LORD of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?
verses.ASV: Of Edom. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre Edom.Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Por acaso não há mais sabedoria em Temã? Pereceu o conselho dos prudentes? Estragou-se sua sabedoria?
verses.RVR09: De Edom. Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: ¿No hay más sabiduría en Temán? ¿ha perecido el consejo en los sabios? ¿corrompióse su sabiduría?

verses.KJV: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
verses.WEB: Flee! Turn back! Dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him when I visit him.
verses.ASV: Flee ye, turn back, dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I shall visit him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fugi, voltai-vos, escondei-vos em profundezas para habitar, ó moradores de Dedã; porque trarei sobre ele a calamidade de Esaú no tempo [em que] eu o punir.
verses.RVR09: Huid, volveos, escondeos en simas para estar, oh moradores de Dedán; porque el quebrantamiento de Esaú traeré sobre él, al tiempo que lo tengo de visitar.

verses.KJV: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
verses.WEB: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn’t they steal until they had enough?
verses.ASV: If grape-gatherers came to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, would they not destroy till they had enough?
verses.ALMEIDA: Se recolhedores de uva viessem contra ti, por acaso não deixarão sobras? Se ladrões de noite [viessem] não te danificariam [apenas] o que achassem suficiente?
verses.RVR09: Si vendimiadores vinieran contra ti, ¿no dejarán rebuscos? Si ladrones de noche, tomarán lo que hubieren menester.

verses.KJV: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
verses.WEB: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors; and he is no more.
verses.ASV: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is destroyed, and his brethren, and his neighbors; and he is not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eu despirei a Esaú, descobrirei seus esconderijos, e não poderá se esconder; será destruída sua descendência, e também seus irmãos e seus vizinhos; e deixará de existir.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo desnudaré á Esaú, descubriré sus escondrijos, y no podrá esconderse: será destruída su simiente, y sus hermanos, y sus vecinos; y no será.

verses.KJV: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
verses.WEB: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”
verses.ASV: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Deixa teus órfãos, eu os criarei; e em mim confiarão tuas viúvas.
verses.RVR09: Deja tus huérfanos, yo los criaré; y en mí se confiarán tus viudas.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.
verses.WEB: For the LORD says: “Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup will certainly drink; and are you he who will altogether go unpunished? You won’t go unpunished, but you will surely drink.
verses.ASV: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, they to whom it pertained not to drink of the cup shall assuredly drink; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que os que não estavam condenados a beberem do cálice, certamente o beberão; e ficarias tu impune por completo? Não ficarás impune, e certamente beberás.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí que los que no estaban condenados á beber del cáliz, beberán ciertamente; ¿y serás tú absuelto del todo? No serás absuelto, sino que de cierto beberás.

verses.KJV: For I have sworn by myself, saith the Lord, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.WEB: For I have sworn by myself,” says the LORD, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. All its cities will be perpetual wastes.”
verses.ASV: For I have sworn by myself, saith Jehovah, that Bozrah shall become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois jurei por mim mesmo,diz o SENHOR, que Bozra se tornará em espanto, humilhação, deserto e maldição; e todas as suas cidades se tornarão desolações perpétuas.
verses.RVR09: Porque por mí he jurado, dice Jehová, que en asolamiento, en oprobio, en soledad, y en maldición, será Bosra; y todas sus ciudades serán en asolamientos perpetuos.

verses.KJV: I have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
verses.WEB: I have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”
verses.ASV: I have heard tidings from Jehovah, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, [saying], Gather yourselves together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvi uma notícia do SENHOR que um mensageiro foi às nações, [para dizer] : Juntai-vos, e vinde contra ela, e levantai-vos para a guerra.
verses.RVR09: La fama oí, que de Jehová había sido enviado mensajero á las gentes, diciendo: Juntaos, y venid contra ella, y levantaos á la batalla.

verses.KJV: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.
verses.WEB: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.
verses.ASV: For, behold, I have made thee small among the nations, and despised among men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eis te fiz pequeno entre as nações, desprezado entre os homens.
verses.RVR09: Porque he aquí que pequeño te he puesto entre las gentes, menospreciado entre los hombres.

verses.KJV: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill, though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: As for thy terribleness, the pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: O terror que tu causas te enganou, assim como a arrogância de teu coração; tu que habitas nas cavernas das rochas, que tens a altura dos montes; ainda que levantes teu ninho como a águia, de lá eu te derrubarei,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Tu arrogancia te engañó, y la soberbia de tu corazón, tú que habitas en cavernas de peñas, que tienes la altura del monte: aunque alces como águila tu nido, de allí te haré descender, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.WEB: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.
verses.ASV: And Edom shall become an astonishment: every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Edom servirá de espanto; todo aquele que passar por ela se espantará, e assoviará por causa de todas as suas pragas.
verses.RVR09: Y será Edom en asolamiento: todo aquel que pasare por ella se espantará, y silbará sobre todas sus plagas.

verses.KJV: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
verses.WEB: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says the LORD, “no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.
verses.ASV: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities thereof, saith Jehovah, no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man sojourn therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como a destruição de Sodoma e de Gomorra, e de suas cidades vizinhas,diz o SENHOR, ninguém habitará ali, nem filho de homem morará nela.
verses.RVR09: Como el trastornamiento de Sodoma y de Gomorra, y de sus ciudades vecinas, dice Jehová, no morará allí nadie, ni la habitará hijo de hombre.

verses.KJV: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.WEB: “Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?”
verses.ASV: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoso is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que será como o leão que sobe da mata do Jordão contra a morada do forte; porque repentinamente o farei correr dela, e ordenarei contra ela a quem eu escolher; pois quem é semelhante a mim? E quem manda em mim? E quem é o pastor que pode subsistir diante de mim?
verses.RVR09: He aquí que como león subirá de la hinchazón del Jordán contra la bella y robusta; porque muy pronto harélo correr de sobre ella, y al que fuere escogido la encargaré; porque ¿quién es semejante á mí? ¿y quién me emplazará? ¿y quién será aquel pastor que me podrá resistir?

verses.KJV: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
verses.WEB: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he has taken against Edom, and his purposes that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they will drag them away, the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.
verses.ASV: Therefore hear ye the counsel of Jehovah, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they shall drag them away, [even] the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto ouvi o conselho do SENHOR, que ele determinou sobre Edom; e seus pensamentos, que decidiu sobre os moradores de Temã: Certamente os menores do rebanho os arrastarão, e destruirão suas moradas com eles.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, oid el consejo de Jehová, que ha acordado sobre Edom; y sus pensamientos, que ha resuelto sobre los moradores de Temán. Ciertamente los más pequeños del hato los arrastrarán, y destruirán sus moradas con ellos.

verses.KJV: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
verses.WEB: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.
verses.ASV: The earth trembleth at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise whereof is heard in the Red Sea.
verses.ALMEIDA: A terra treme do estrondo da queda deles; e o grito de sua voz foi ouvida até no mar Vermelho.
verses.RVR09: Del estruendo de la caída de ellos la tierra tembló, y el grito de su voz se oyó en el mar Bermejo.

verses.KJV: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.WEB: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.ASV: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah: and the heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que como águia subirá e voará, e estenderá suas asas sobre Bozra; e o coração dos guerreiros de Edom será naquele dia como o coração de mulher em dores de parto.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que como águila subirá y volará, y extenderá sus alas sobre Bosra: y el corazón de los valientes de Edom será en aquel día como el corazón de mujer en angustias.

verses.KJV: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.WEB: Of Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on the sea. It can’t be quiet.
verses.ASV: Of Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad; for they have heard evil tidings, they are melted away: there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre Damasco. Envergonharam-se Hamate e Arpade, porque ouviram más notícias; derreteram-se em mar de angústia, não podem se sossegar.
verses.RVR09: Acerca de Damasco. Confundióse Hamath, y Arphad, porque oyeron malas nuevas: derritiéronse en aguas de desmayo, no pueden sosegarse.

verses.KJV: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
verses.WEB: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.
verses.ASV: Damascus is waxed feeble, she turneth herself to flee, and trembling hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enfraquecida está Damasco; virou-se para fugir, e foi tomada de medo; angústia e dores a tomaram, como de mulher que está de parto.
verses.RVR09: Desmayóse Damasco, volvióse para huir, y tomóle temblor: angustia y dolores le tomaron, como de mujer que está de parto.

verses.KJV: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
verses.WEB: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?
verses.ASV: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?
verses.ALMEIDA: Como não foi abandonada a famosa cidade, a cidade de minha alegria?
verses.RVR09: ¡Cómo dejaron á la ciudad de alabanza, ciudad de mi gozo!

verses.KJV: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.WEB: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all the men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says the LORD of Armies.
verses.ASV: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso seus rapazes cairão em suas ruas, e todos os homens de guerra serão mortos naquele dia,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, sus mancebos caerán en sus plazas, y todos los hombres de guerra morirán en aquel día, ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos.

verses.KJV: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.WEB: “I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.”
verses.ASV: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acenderei fogo no muro de Damasco, que consumirá as casas de Ben-Hadade.
verses.RVR09: Y haré encender fuego en el muro de Damasco, y consumirá las casas de Ben-hadad.

verses.KJV: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the Lord; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
verses.WEB: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, The LORD says: “Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.
verses.ASV: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote. Thus saith Jehovah: Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sobre Quedar e dos reinos de Hazor, os quais Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, feriu.Assim diz o SENHOR: Levantai-vos, subi contra Quedar, e destruí os filhos de oriente.
verses.RVR09: De Cedar y de los reinos de Hasor, los cuales hirió Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia. Así ha dicho Jehová: Levantaos, subid contra Cedar, y destruid los hijos de oriente.

verses.KJV: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
verses.WEB: They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, ‘Terror on every side!’
verses.ASV: Their tents and their flocks shall they take; they shall carry away for themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Terror on every side!
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomarão suas tendas e seu gados; suas cortinas, e todos os seus vasos; e seus camelos, levarão para si; e lhes gritarão: O medo está ao redor.
verses.RVR09: Sus tiendas y sus ganados tomarán: sus cortinas, y todos sus vasos, y sus camellos, tomarán para sí; y llamarán contra ellos miedo alrededor.

verses.KJV: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the Lord; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.WEB: Flee! Wander far off! Dwell in the depths, you inhabitants of Hazor,” says the LORD; “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.
verses.ASV: Flee ye, wander far off, dwell in the depths, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith Jehovah; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fugi, afastai-vos para muito longe, buscai profundezas para habitar, ó moradores de Hazor, diz o SENHOR; porque Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, tomou conselho contra vós, e pensou um plano contra vós.
verses.RVR09: Huid, trasponeos muy lejos, meteos en simas para estar, oh moradores de Hasor, dice Jehová; porque tomó consejo contra vosotros Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, y contra vosotros ha formado designio.

verses.KJV: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the Lord, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
verses.WEB: Arise! Go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care,” says the LORD; “that has neither gates nor bars, that dwells alone.
verses.ASV: Arise, get you up unto a nation that is at ease, that dwelleth without care, saith Jehovah; that have neither gates nor bars, that dwell alone.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantai-vos, subi contra uma nação tranquila, que habita em segurança,diz o SENHOR, que nem têm portas nem ferrolhos, que vivem sozinhos.
verses.RVR09: Levantaos, subid á gente pacífica, que vive confiadamente, dice Jehová, que ni tienen puertas ni cerrojos, que viven solitarios.

verses.KJV: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: Their camels will be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a plunder. I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter unto all winds them that have the corners [of their hair] cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus serão camelos para presa, e a multidão de seus gados para despojo; e os espalharei por todos os lados, até os cantos mais distantes; e por todos os lados lhes trarei sua ruína,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y serán sus camellos por presa, y la multitud de sus ganados por despojo; y esparcirélos por todos vientos, echados hasta el postrer rincón; y de todos sus lados les traeré su ruina, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
verses.WEB: Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever. No man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.”
verses.ASV: And Hazor shall be a dwelling-place of jackals, a desolation for ever: no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man sojourn therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Hazor se tornará uma morada de chacais, desolada para sempre; ninguém habitará ali, nem filho de homem morará nela.
verses.RVR09: Y Hasor será morada de chacales, soledad para siempre: ninguno morará allí, ni la habitará hijo de hombre.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra do SENHOR que veio ao profeta Jeremias, sobre Elão, no princípio do reinado de Zedequias rei de Judá, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Palabra de Jehová que fué á Jeremías profeta acerca de Elam, en el principio del reinado de Sedechîas rey de Judá, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.WEB: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.ASV: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eis que quebrarei o arco de Elão, o principal de seu poder.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho Jehová de los ejércitos: He aquí que yo quiebro el arco de Elam, principio de su fortaleza.

verses.KJV: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.WEB: I will bring on Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds. There will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.
verses.ASV: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.ALMEIDA: E trarei sobre Elão os quatro ventos dos quatro cantos do céu, e os espalharei por todos estes ventos; não haverá nação para onde não venham exilados de Elão.
verses.RVR09: Y traeré sobre Elam los cuatro vientos de los cuatro puntos del cielo, y aventarélos á todos estos vientos; ni habrá gente adonde no vengan extranjeros de Elam.

verses.KJV: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the Lord; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.WEB: I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life. I will bring evil on them, even my fierce anger,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.
verses.ASV: And I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life; and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith Jehovah; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei com que Elão tenha medo diante de seus inimigos, e diante dos que buscam [tirar] sua vida; e trarei o mal sobre eles, o furor de minha ira,diz o SENHOR; e mandarei a espada atrás deles, até que os acabe por completo.
verses.RVR09: Y haré que Elam se intimide delante de sus enemigos, y delante de los que buscan su alma; y traeré sobre ellos mal, y el furor de mi enojo, dice Jehová; y enviaré en pos de ellos espada hasta que los acabe.

verses.KJV: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,’ says the LORD.
verses.ASV: and I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence king and princes, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei meu trono em Elão, e destruirei dali o rei e os príncipes,diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré mi silla en Elam, y destruiré de allí rey y príncipe, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: ‘But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,’ says the LORD.”
verses.ASV: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring back the captivity of Elam, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas será nos últimos dias, que restaurarei Elão de seu infortúnio, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Mas acontecerá en lo postrero de los días, que haré tornar la cautividad de Elam, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: The word that the Lord spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.WEB: The word that the LORD spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.ASV: The word that Jehovah spake concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.ALMEIDA: Palavra que o SENHOR falou sobre a Babilônia, sobre a terra dos caldeus, por meio do profeta Jeremias.
verses.RVR09: PALABRA que habló Jehová contra Babilonia, contra la tierra de los Caldeos, por mano de Jeremías profeta.

verses.KJV: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
verses.WEB: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal; say, ‘Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed! Her images are disappointed. Her idols are dismayed.’
verses.ASV: Declare ye among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed; her images are put to shame, her idols are dismayed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Anunciai entre as nações, declarai, e levantai bandeira; declarai, e não encubrais: dizei: Tomada é Babilônia, Bel é envergonhado, Merodaque é despedaçado; envergonhados são seus ídolos, despedaçados estão suas imagens de idolatria.
verses.RVR09: Denunciad en las gentes, y haced saber; levantad también bandera: publicad, y no encubráis: decid: Tomada es Babilonia, Bel es confundido, deshecho es Merodach; confundidas son sus esculturas, quebrados son sus ídolos.

verses.KJV: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
verses.WEB: For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it. They have fled. They are gone, both man and animal.
verses.ASV: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they are fled, they are gone, both man and beast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois subiu contra ela uma nação do norte, a qual tornará sua terra em desolação, e não haverá morador nela; desde os homens até os animais fugiram e se afastaram.
verses.RVR09: Porque subió contra ella gente del aquilón, la cual pondrá su tierra en asolamiento, y no habrá ni hombre ni animal que en ella more: moviéronse, se fueron.

verses.KJV: In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the Lord their God.
verses.WEB: “In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek the LORD their God.
verses.ASV: In those days, and in that time, saith Jehovah, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together; they shall go on their way weeping, and shall seek Jehovah their God.
