verses.KJV: Behold, O Lord, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.WEB: “Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.ASV: See, O Jehovah, and behold to whom thou hast done thus! Shall the women eat their fruit, the children that are dandled in the hands? Shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha, SENHOR, e considera a quem fizeste de tal modo; por acaso as mulheres comerão do seu [próprio] fruto, as criancinhas que carregam nos braços? Por acaso serão o sacerdote e o profeta mortos no santuário do Senhor?
verses.RVR09: Mira, oh Jehová, y considera á quién has hecho así. ¿Han de comer las mujeres su fruto, los pequeñitos de sus crías? ¿Han de ser muertos en el santuario del Señor el sacerdote y el profeta?

verses.KJV: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.
verses.WEB: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.
verses.ASV: The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword: Thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast slaughtered, [and] not pitied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Jovens e velhos jazem por [pelas] ruas; minhas virgens e meus rapazes caíram à espada; tu [os] mataste no dia de tua ira, degolaste sem ter compaixão.
verses.RVR09: Niños y viejos yacían por tierra en las calles; mis vírgenes y mis mancebos cayeron á cuchillo: mataste en el día de tu furor, degollaste, no perdonaste.

verses.KJV: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the Lord's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
verses.WEB: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of the LORD’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.
verses.ASV: Thou hast called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side; And there was none that escaped or remained in the day of Jehovah’s anger: Those that I have dandled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Convocaste meus temores ao redor, como se fosse um dia solene; não houve quem escapasse no dia do ira do SENHOR, nem que restasse vivo; aos que criei e sustentei, meu inimigo os consumiu.
verses.RVR09: Has llamado, como á día de solemnidad, mis temores de todas partes; y en el día del furor de Jehová no hubo quien escapase ni quedase vivo: los que crié y mantuve, mi enemigo los acabó.

verses.KJV: I Am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.WEB: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.ASV: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o homem que viu a aflição pela vara de seu furor.
verses.RVR09: YO soy el hombre que ha visto aflicción en la vara de su enojo.

verses.KJV: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
verses.WEB: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
verses.ASV: He hath led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
verses.ALMEIDA: Guiou-me e levou-me a trevas, e não à luz.
verses.RVR09: Guióme y llevóme en tinieblas, mas no en luz.

verses.KJV: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
verses.WEB: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
verses.ASV: Surely against me he turneth his hand again and again all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com certeza se virou contra mim, revirou sua mão o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Ciertamente contra mí volvió y revolvió su mano todo el día.

verses.KJV: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.WEB: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
verses.ASV: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez envelhecer minha carne e minha pele, quebrou meus ossos.
verses.RVR09: Hizo envejecer mi carne y mi piel; quebrantó mis huesos.

verses.KJV: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
verses.WEB: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
verses.ASV: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
verses.ALMEIDA: Edificou contra mim, e cercou [-me] de fel e de trabalho.
verses.RVR09: Edificó contra mí, y cercóme de tósigo y de trabajo.

verses.KJV: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
verses.WEB: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
verses.ASV: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez-me habitar em lugares escuros, como os que já morrera há muito tempo.
verses.RVR09: Asentóme en oscuridades, como los ya muertos de mucho tiempo.

verses.KJV: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.WEB: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
verses.ASV: He hath walled me about, that I cannot go forth; he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cercou-me por todos lados, e não posso sair; tornou pesados os meus grilhões.
verses.RVR09: Cercóme por todos lados, y no puedo salir; agravó mis grillos.

verses.KJV: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.WEB: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
verses.ASV: Yea, when I cry, and call for help, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até quando clamo e dou vozes, fechou [os ouvidos] à minha oração.
verses.RVR09: Aun cuando clamé y dí voces, cerro los oídos á mi oración.

verses.KJV: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.WEB: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
verses.ASV: He hath walled up my ways with hewn stone; he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cercou meus caminhos com pedras lavradas, retorceu as minhas veredas.
verses.RVR09: Cercó mis caminos con piedra tajada, torció mis senderos.

verses.KJV: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
verses.WEB: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.
verses.ASV: He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Foi para mim como um urso que espia, como um leão escondido.
verses.RVR09: Como oso que acecha fué para mí, como león en escondrijos.

verses.KJV: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
verses.WEB: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
verses.ASV: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he hath made me desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desviou meus caminhos, e fez-me em pedaços; deixou-me desolado.
verses.RVR09: Torció mis caminos, y depedazóme; tornóme asolado.

verses.KJV: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.WEB: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.ASV: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Armou seu arco, e me pôs como alvo para a flecha.
verses.RVR09: Su arco entesó, y púsome como blanco á la saeta.

verses.KJV: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.WEB: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
verses.ASV: He hath caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fez entrar em meus rins as flechas de sua aljava.
verses.RVR09: Hizo entrar en mis riñones las saetas de su aljaba.

verses.KJV: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
verses.WEB: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
verses.ASV: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Servi de escárnio a todo o meu povo, de canção ridícula deles o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Fuí escarnio á todo mi pueblo, canción de ellos todos los días.

verses.KJV: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.WEB: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
verses.ASV: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath sated me with wormwood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fartou-me de amarguras, embebedou-me de absinto.
verses.RVR09: Hartóme de amarguras, embriagóme de ajenjos.

verses.KJV: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.WEB: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
verses.ASV: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quebrou os meus dentes com cascalho, cobriu-me de cinzas.
verses.RVR09: Quebróme los dientes con cascajo, cubrióme de ceniza.

verses.KJV: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.WEB: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
verses.ASV: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace; I forgat prosperity.
verses.ALMEIDA: E afastou minha alma da paz, fez-me esquecer da boa vida.
verses.RVR09: Y mi alma se alejó de la paz, olvidéme del bien.

verses.KJV: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the Lord:
verses.WEB: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And I said, My strength is perished, and mine expectation from Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: Pereceram minha força e minha esperança no SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y dije: Pereció mi fortaleza, y mi esperanza de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.WEB: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
verses.ASV: Remember mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te da minha aflição e do meu sofrimento, do absinto e do fel.
verses.RVR09: Acuérdate de mi aflicción y de mi abatimiento, del ajenjo y de la hiel.

verses.KJV: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.WEB: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
verses.ASV: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is bowed down within me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Minha alma se lembra e se abate em mim.
verses.RVR09: Tendrálo aún en memoria mi alma, porque en mí está humillada.

verses.KJV: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.WEB: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
verses.ASV: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: Disto me recordarei na minha mente, por isso terei esperança:
verses.RVR09: Esto reduciré á mi corazón, por lo cual esperaré.

verses.KJV: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.WEB: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
verses.ASV: [It is of] Jehovah’s lovingkindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.ALMEIDA: É pelas bondades do SENHOR que não somos consumidos, porque suas misericórdias não têm fim.
verses.RVR09: Es por la misericordia de Jehová que no somos consumidos, porque nunca decayeron sus misericordias.

verses.KJV: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.WEB: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
verses.ASV: They are new every morning; great is thy faithfulness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Elas são novas a cada manhã; grande é a tua fidelidade.
verses.RVR09: Nuevas son cada mañana; grande es tu fidelidad.

verses.KJV: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.WEB: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
verses.ASV: Jehovah is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR é minha porção, diz a minha alma; portanto nele esperarei.
verses.RVR09: Mi parte es Jehová, dijo mi alma; por tanto en él esperaré.

verses.KJV: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verses.WEB: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
verses.ASV: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bom é o SENHOR para os que nele esperam, para a alma que o busca.
verses.RVR09: Bueno es Jehová á los que en él esperan, al alma que le buscare.

verses.KJV: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.
verses.WEB: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.ASV: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: É bom esperar e tranquilo aguardar a salvação do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Bueno es esperar callando en la salud de Jehová.

verses.KJV: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.WEB: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.ASV: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.ALMEIDA: É bom ao homem levar o jugo em sua juventude.
verses.RVR09: Bueno es al hombre, si llevare el yugo desde su mocedad.

verses.KJV: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
verses.WEB: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
verses.ASV: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he hath laid it upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sente-se só, e fique quieto; pois ele o pôs sobre si.
verses.RVR09: Sentaráse solo, y callará, porque lo llevó sobre sí.

verses.KJV: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.WEB: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
verses.ASV: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ponha sua boca no pó; talvez haja esperança.
verses.RVR09: Pondrá su boca en el polvo, por si quizá hay esperanza.

verses.KJV: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.WEB: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
verses.ASV: Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him; let him be filled full with reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dê a face ao que o ferir; farte-se de insultos.
verses.RVR09: Dará la mejilla al que le hiriere; hartaráse de afrenta.

verses.KJV: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.WEB: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
verses.ASV: For the Lord will not cast off for ever.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois o Senhor não rejeitará para sempre:
verses.RVR09: Porque el Señor no desechará para siempre:

verses.KJV: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.WEB: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
verses.ASV: For though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mesmo que cause aflição, ele também se compadecerá segundo a grandeza de suas misericórdias.
verses.RVR09: Antes si afligiere, también se compadecerá según la multitud de sus misericordias.

verses.KJV: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.WEB: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
verses.ASV: For he doth not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois não é sua vontade afligir nem entristecer os filhos dos homens.
verses.RVR09: Porque no aflige ni congoja de su corazón á los hijos de los hombres.

verses.KJV: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth.
verses.WEB: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.ASV: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.ALMEIDA: Esmagar debaixo de seus pés a todos os prisioneiros da terra,
verses.RVR09: Desmenuzar bajo de sus pies todos los encarcelados de la tierra,

verses.KJV: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
verses.WEB: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
verses.ASV: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
verses.ALMEIDA: Perverter o direito do homem diante da presença do Altíssimo,
verses.RVR09: Hacer apartar el derecho del hombre ante la presencia del Altísimo,

verses.KJV: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.WEB: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
verses.ASV: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Prejudicar ao homem em sua causa: o Senhor não aprova ) [tais coisas] .
verses.RVR09: Trastornar al hombre en su causa, el Señor no lo sabe.

verses.KJV: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
verses.WEB: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
verses.ASV: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
verses.ALMEIDA: Quem é que pode fazer suceder [algo] que diz, se o Senhor não tiver mandado?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quién será aquel que diga, que vino algo que el Señor no mandó?

verses.KJV: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.WEB: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
verses.ASV: Out of the mouth of the Most High cometh there not evil and good?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso da boca do Altíssimo não sai tanto a maldição como a bênção?
verses.RVR09: ¿De la boca del Altísimo no saldrá malo y bueno?

verses.KJV: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.WEB: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.ASV: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que o homem vivente se queixa da punição de seus próprios pecados?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué murmura el hombre viviente, el hombre en su pecado?

verses.KJV: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.
verses.WEB: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.ASV: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Examinemos nossos caminhos, investiguemos, e nos voltemos ao SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Escudriñemos nuestros caminos, y busquemos, y volvámonos á Jehová.

verses.KJV: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.WEB: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
verses.ASV: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levantemos nossos corações e as mãos a Deus nos céus,
verses.RVR09: Levantemos nuestros corazones con las manos á Dios en los cielos.

verses.KJV: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.WEB: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
verses.ASV: We have transgressed and have rebelled; thou hast not pardoned.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Dizendo:] Nós transgredimos e fomos rebeldes; tu não perdoaste.
verses.RVR09: Nosotros nos hemos rebelado, y fuimos desleales; tú no perdonaste.

verses.KJV: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.WEB: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
verses.ASV: Thou hast covered with anger and pursued us; thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cobriste-te de ira, e nos perseguiste; mataste sem teres compaixão.
verses.RVR09: Desplegaste la ira, y nos perseguiste; mataste, no perdonaste.

verses.KJV: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
verses.WEB: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
verses.ASV: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cobriste-te de nuvens, para que [nossa] oração não passasse.
verses.RVR09: Te cubriste de nube, porque no pasase la oración nuestra.

verses.KJV: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.WEB: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
verses.ASV: Thou hast made us an offscouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu nos tornaste como escória e rejeito no meio dos povos.
verses.RVR09: Raedura y abominación nos tornaste en medio de los pueblos.

verses.KJV: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.WEB: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
verses.ASV: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todos os nossos inimigos abriram sua boca contra nós.
verses.RVR09: Todos nuestros enemigos abrieron sobre nosotros su boca.

verses.KJV: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.WEB: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
verses.ASV: Fear and the pit are come upon us, devastation and destruction.
verses.ALMEIDA: Medo e cova vieram sobre nós, devastação e destruição.
verses.RVR09: Temor y lazo fué para nosotros, asolamiento y quebrantamiento.

verses.KJV: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.WEB: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.ASV: Mine eye runneth down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Rios de águas correm de meus olhos, por causa da destruição da filha de meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Ríos de aguas echan mis ojos, por el quebrantamiento de la hija de mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission.
verses.WEB: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
verses.ASV: Mine eye poureth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos destilam, e não cessam; não haverá descanso,
verses.RVR09: Mis ojos destilan, y no cesan, porque no hay alivio,

verses.KJV: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.WEB: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.
verses.ASV: Till Jehovah look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até que o SENHOR preste atenção, e veja desde os céus.
verses.RVR09: Hasta que Jehová mire y vea desde los cielos.

verses.KJV: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.WEB: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.ASV: Mine eye affecteth my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.ALMEIDA: Meus olhos afligem minha alma, por causa de todas as filhas de minha cidade.
verses.RVR09: Mis ojos contristaron mi alma, por todas las hijas de mi ciudad.

verses.KJV: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.WEB: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
verses.ASV: They have chased me sore like a bird, they that are mine enemies without cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: Sem motivo meus inimigos me caçam como a um passarinho.
verses.RVR09: Mis enemigos me dieron caza como á ave, sin por qué.

verses.KJV: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.WEB: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
verses.ASV: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone upon me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tentaram tirar minha vida na masmorra, e lançaram pedras sobre mim.
verses.RVR09: Ataron mi vida en mazmorra, pusieron piedra sobre mí.

verses.KJV: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
verses.WEB: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
verses.ASV: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.
verses.ALMEIDA: As águas inundaram sobre minha cabeça; eu disse: É o meu fim.
verses.RVR09: Aguas de avenida vinieron sobre mi cabeza; yo dije: Muerto soy.

verses.KJV: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.
verses.WEB: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.
verses.ASV: I called upon thy name, O Jehovah, out of the lowest dungeon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Invoquei o teu nome, SENHOR, desde a cova profunda.
verses.RVR09: Invoqué tu nombre, oh Jehová, desde la cárcel profunda.

verses.KJV: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.WEB: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
verses.ASV: Thou heardest my voice; hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouviste minha voz: não escondas o teu ouvido ao meu suspiro, ao meu clamor.
verses.RVR09: Oiste mi voz; no escondas tu oído á mi clamor, para mi respiro.

verses.KJV: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.WEB: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
verses.ASV: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee; thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu te achegaste no dia em que te invoquei; disseste: Não temas.
verses.RVR09: Acercástete el día que te invoqué: dijiste: No temas.

verses.KJV: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.WEB: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
verses.ASV: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.ALMEIDA: Defendeste, Senhor, as causas de minha alma; redimiste minha vida.
verses.RVR09: Abogaste, Señor, la causa de mi alma; redimiste mi vida.

verses.KJV: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
verses.WEB: LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
verses.ASV: O Jehovah, thou hast seen my wrong; judge thou my cause.
verses.ALMEIDA: Viste, SENHOR, a maldade que me fizeram; julga minha causa.
verses.RVR09: Tú has visto, oh Jehová, mi agravio; defiende mi causa.

verses.KJV: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
verses.WEB: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
verses.ASV: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Viste toda a vingança deles, todos os seus pensamentos contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Tú has visto toda su venganza; todos sus pensamientos contra mí.

verses.KJV: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;
verses.WEB: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,
verses.ASV: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Jehovah, and all their devices against me,
verses.ALMEIDA: Ouvido os seus insultos, ó SENHOR, todos os seus pensamentos contra mim;
verses.RVR09: Tú has oído el oprobio de ellos, oh Jehová, todas sus maquinaciones contra mí;

verses.KJV: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.WEB: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
verses.ASV: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.ALMEIDA: As coisas ditas pelos que se levantam contra mim, e seu planos contra mim o dia todo.
verses.RVR09: Los dichos de los que contra mí se levantaron, y su designio contra mí todo el día.

verses.KJV: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
verses.WEB: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
verses.ASV: Behold thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.
verses.ALMEIDA: Olha para tudo quanto eles fazem; com canções zombam de mim.
verses.RVR09: Su sentarse, y su levantarse mira: yo soy su canción.

verses.KJV: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.
verses.WEB: You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt render unto them a recompense, O Jehovah, according to the work of their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Retribui-lhes, SENHOR, conforme a obra de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Dales el pago, oh Jehová, según la obra de sus manos.

verses.KJV: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.WEB: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt give them hardness of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dá-lhes angústia de coração, tua maldição a eles.
verses.RVR09: Dales ansia de corazón, tu maldición á ellos.

verses.KJV: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.
verses.WEB: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.
verses.ASV: Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Persegue-os com ira, e destrua-os de debaixo dos céus do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Persíguelos en tu furor, y quebrántalos de debajo de los cielos, oh Jehová.

verses.KJV: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
verses.WEB: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
verses.ASV: How is the gold become dim! [how] is the most pure gold changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como se escureceu o ouro! Como mudou o bom e fino ouro! As pedras do Santuário estão espalhadas pelas esquinas de todas as ruas.
verses.RVR09: ¡CÓMO se ha oscurecido el oro! ¡Cómo el buen oro se ha demudado! Las piedras del santuario están esparcidas por las encrucijadas de todas las calles.

verses.KJV: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
verses.WEB: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
verses.ASV: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, How are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
verses.ALMEIDA: Os preciosos filhos de Sião, estimados como o ouro puro, como [agora] são considerados como vasos de barro, obra das mãos de oleiro!
verses.RVR09: Los hijos de Sión, preciados y estimados más que el oro puro, ¡cómo son tenidos por vasos de barro, obra de manos de alfarero!

verses.KJV: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: Even the jackals draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: The daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Até os chacais dão o peito para amamentar a seus filhotes; [porém] a filha de meu povo se tornou cruel, como os avestruzes no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Aun los monstruos marinos sacan la teta, dan de mamar á sus chiquitos: la hija de mi pueblo es cruel, como los avestruces en el desierto.

verses.KJV: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
verses.WEB: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.
verses.ASV: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: The young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa da sede a língua da criança de peito se grudou a seu céu da boca; os meninos pedem pão, e ninguém há lhes reparta.
verses.RVR09: La lengua del niño de teta, de sed se pegó á su paladar: los chiquitos pidieron pan, y no hubo quien se lo partiese.

verses.KJV: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
verses.WEB: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.
verses.ASV: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: They that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os que comiam das melhores iguarias, [agora] desfalecem nas ruas; os que se criaram em carmesim abraçam o lixo.
verses.RVR09: Los que comían delicadamente, asolados fueron en las calles; los que se criaron en carmesí, abrazaron los estercoleros.

verses.KJV: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
verses.WEB: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.
verses.ASV: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, That was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands were laid upon her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois maior é o castigo da filha de meu povo do que o [do] pecado de Sodoma, Que foi transtornada em um momento, e não assentaram sobre ela companhias.
verses.RVR09: Y aumentóse la iniquidad de la hija de mi pueblo más que el pecado de Sodoma, que fué trastornada en un momento, y no asentaron sobre ella compañías.

verses.KJV: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
verses.WEB: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.
verses.ASV: Her nobles were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk; They were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was as of sapphire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus nazireus eram mais alvos que a neve, mais brancos que o leite. Seus corpos eram mais avermelhados que rubis, [e] mais polidos que a safira;
verses.RVR09: Sus Nazareos fueron blancos más que la nieve, más lustrosos que la leche, su compostura más rubicunda que los rubíes, más bellos que el zafiro:

verses.KJV: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
verses.WEB: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.
verses.ASV: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: Their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas agora] sua aparência se escureceu mais que o carvão; não são mais reconhecidos nas ruas; sua pele está apegada a seus ossos, ficou seca como um pau.
verses.RVR09: Oscura más que la negrura es la forma de ellos; no los conocen por las calles: su piel está pegada á sus huesos, seca como un palo.

verses.KJV: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
verses.WEB: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.
verses.ASV: They that are slain with the sword are better than they that are slain with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, for want of the fruits of the field.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mais felizes foram os mortos pela espada do que os mortos pela fome; porque estes se abatem traspassados pela [falta] dos frutos do campo.
verses.RVR09: Más dichosos fueron los muertos á cuchillo que los muertos del hambre; porque éstos murieron poco á poco por falta de los frutos de la tierra.

verses.KJV: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.WEB: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.ASV: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children; They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.ALMEIDA: As mãos das mulheres compassivas cozeram a seus filhos; serviram-lhes de comida na destruição da filha de meu povo.
verses.RVR09: Las manos de las mujeres piadosas cocieron á sus hijos; fuéronles comida en el quebrantamiento de la hija de mi pueblo.

verses.KJV: The Lord hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
verses.WEB: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.
verses.ASV: Jehovah hath accomplished his wrath, he hath poured out his fierce anger; And he hath kindled a fire in Zion, which hath devoured the foundations thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: O SENHOR cumpriu o seu furor, derramou o ardor de sua ira; e acendeu fogo em Sião, que consumiu seus fundamentos.
verses.RVR09: Cumplió Jehová su enojo, derramó el ardor de su ira; y encendió fuego en Sión, que consumió sus fundamentos.

verses.KJV: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: The kings of the earth believed not, neither all the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem os reis da terra, nem todos os que habitam no mundo, criam que o adversário e o inimigo entraria pelas portas de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Nunca los reyes de la tierra, ni todos los que habitan en el mundo, creyeron que el enemigo y el adversario entrara por las puertas de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
verses.WEB: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.
verses.ASV: [It is] because of the sins of her prophets, [and] the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Assim] foi por causa dos pecados de seus profetas, por causa das maldades de seus sacerdotes, que derramaram o sangue dos justos em meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Es por los pecados de sus profetas, por las maldades de sus sacerdotes, que derramaron en medio de ella la sangre de los justos.

verses.KJV: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
verses.WEB: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.
verses.ASV: They wander as blind men in the streets, they are polluted with blood, So that men cannot touch their garments.
verses.ALMEIDA: Titubearam [como] cegos nas ruas, andaram contaminados de sangue, de maneira que ninguém podia tocar suas vestes.
verses.RVR09: Titubearon como ciegos en las calles, fueron contaminados en sangre, de modo que no pudiesen tocar á sus vestiduras.

verses.KJV: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
verses.WEB: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”
verses.ASV: Depart ye, they cried unto them, Unclean! depart, depart, touch not! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, They shall no more sojourn [here].
verses.ALMEIDA: Gritavam-lhes: Afastai-vos, imundos! Afastai-vos, afastai-vos, não toqueis. Quando fugiram e andaram sem rumo, foi dito entre as nações: Aqui não morarão.
verses.RVR09: Apartaos ¡inmundos!, les gritaban, Apartaos, apartaos, no toquéis. Cuando huyeron y fueron dispersos, dijeron entre las gentes: Nunca más morarán aquí.

verses.KJV: The anger of the Lord hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
verses.WEB: The LORD’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.
verses.ASV: The anger of Jehovah hath scattered them; he will no more regard them: They respected not the persons of the priests, they favored not the elders.
verses.ALMEIDA: A face do SENHOR os dispersou, não os olhará mais: não respeitaram a face dos sacerdotes, nem tiveram compaixão dos velhos.
verses.RVR09: La ira de Jehová los apartó, no los mirará más: no respetaron la faz de los sacerdotes, ni tuvieron compasión de los viejos.

verses.KJV: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
verses.WEB: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
verses.ASV: Our eyes do yet fail [in looking] for our vain help: In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto a nós, desfaleceram-se nossos olhos [esperando] por socorro para nós; aguardávamos atentamente uma nação que não podia salvar.
verses.RVR09: Aun nos han desfallecido nuestros ojos tras nuestro vano socorro: en nuestra esperanza aguardamos gente que no puede salvar.

verses.KJV: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
verses.WEB: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.
verses.ASV: They hunt our steps, so that we cannot go in our streets: Our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caçaram nossos passos, de modo que não podíamos andar por nossas ruas; achegou-se o nosso fim, nossos dias se completaram, pois nosso fim veio.
verses.RVR09: Cazaron nuestros pasos, que no anduviésemos por nuestras calles: acercóse nuestro fin, cumpliéronse nuestros días; porque nuestro fin vino.

verses.KJV: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens: They chased us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos perseguidores foram mais velozes que as águias do céu; sobre os montes nos perseguiram, no deserto armaram ciladas para nós.
verses.RVR09: Ligeros fueron nuestros perseguidores más que las águilas del cielo: sobre los montes nos persiguieron, en el desierto nos pusieron emboscadas.

verses.KJV: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
verses.WEB: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.
verses.ASV: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Jehovah, was taken in their pits; Of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: O fôlego de nossas narinas, o ungido do SENHOR, do qual dizíamos: Abaixo de sua sombra teremos vida entre as nações; foi preso em suas covas.
verses.RVR09: El resuello de nuestras narices, el ungido de Jehová, de quien habíamos dicho: A su sombra tendremos vida entre las gentes: fué preso en sus hoyos.

verses.KJV: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
verses.WEB: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.
verses.ASV: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz: The cup shall pass through unto thee also; thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
verses.ALMEIDA: Goza-te e alegra-te, filha de Edom, que habitas na terra de Uz: porém o cálice também passará por ti; tu te embriagarás, e te desnudarás.
verses.RVR09: Gózate y alégrate, hija de Edom, la que habitas en tierra de Hus: aun hasta ti pasará el cáliz; embriagarte has, y vomitarás.

verses.KJV: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
verses.WEB: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.
verses.ASV: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will uncover thy sins.
verses.ALMEIDA: Cumpriu-se o castigo por tua maldade, ó filha de Sião; nunca mais te levará em cativeiro. Ele punirá tua maldade, ó filha de Edom; revelará os teus pecados.
verses.RVR09: Cumplido es tu castigo, oh hija de Sión: nunca más te hará trasportar. Visitará tu iniquidad, oh hija de Edom; descubrirá tus pecados.

verses.KJV: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
verses.WEB: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
verses.ASV: Remember, O Jehovah, what is come upon us: Behold, and see our reproach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Lembra-te, SENHOR, do que tem nos acontecido; presta atenção e olha nossa humilhação.
verses.RVR09: ACUÉRDATE, oh Jehová, de lo que nos ha sucedido: ve y mira nuestro oprobio.

verses.KJV: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.WEB: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.ASV: Our inheritance is turned unto strangers, Our houses unto aliens.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossa herança passou a ser de estrangeiros, nossas casas de forasteiros.
verses.RVR09: Nuestra heredad se ha vuelto á extraños, nuestras casas á forasteros.

verses.KJV: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
verses.WEB: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
verses.ASV: We are orphans and fatherless; Our mothers are as widows.
verses.ALMEIDA: Órfãos somos sem pai, nossas mães são como viúvas.
verses.RVR09: Huérfanos somos sin padre, nuestras madres como viudas.

verses.KJV: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
verses.WEB: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.
verses.ASV: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold unto us.
verses.ALMEIDA: Bebemos nossa água por dinheiro; nossa lenha temos que pagar.
verses.RVR09: Nuestra agua bebemos por dinero; nuestra leña por precio compramos.

verses.KJV: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
verses.WEB: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
verses.ASV: Our pursuers are upon our necks: We are weary, and have no rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Perseguição sofremos sobre nossos pescoços; estamos cansados, mas não temos descanso.
verses.RVR09: Persecución padecemos sobre nuestra cerviz: nos cansamos, y no hay para nosotros reposo.

verses.KJV: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.WEB: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.ASV: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, And to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nós nos rendemos aos egípcios e aos assírios para nos saciarmos de pão.
verses.RVR09: Al Egipcio y al Asirio dimos la mano, para saciarnos de pan.

verses.KJV: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
verses.WEB: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
verses.ASV: Our fathers sinned, and are not; And we have borne their iniquities.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossos pais pecaram, e não existem mais; porém nós levamos seus castigos.
verses.RVR09: Nuestros padres pecaron, y son muertos; y nosotros llevamos sus castigos.

verses.KJV: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
verses.WEB: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
verses.ASV: Servants rule over us: There is none to deliver us out of their hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Servos passaram a nos dominar; ninguém há que [nos] livre de suas mãos.
verses.RVR09: Siervos se enseñorearon de nosotros; no hubo quien de su mano nos librase.

verses.KJV: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.WEB: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, Because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com risco de vida trazemos nosso pão, por causa da espada do deserto.
verses.RVR09: Con peligro de nuestras vidas traíamos nuestro pan delante del cuchillo del desierto.

verses.KJV: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
verses.WEB: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
verses.ASV: Our skin is black like an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Nossa pele se tornou negra como um forno, por causa do ardor da fome.
verses.RVR09: Nuestra piel se ennegreció como un horno á causa del ardor del hambre.

verses.KJV: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
verses.WEB: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
verses.ASV: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Abusaram das mulheres em Sião, das virgens nas cidades de Judá.
verses.RVR09: Violaron á las mujeres en Sión, á las vírgenes en las ciudades de Judá.

verses.KJV: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
verses.WEB: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
verses.ASV: Princes were hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honored.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os príncipes foram enforcados por sua mãos; não respeitaram as faces dos velhos.
verses.RVR09: A los príncipes colgaron por su mano; no respetaron el rostro de los viejos.

verses.KJV: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
verses.WEB: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
verses.ASV: The young men bare the mill; And the children stumbled under the wood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Levaram os rapazes para moer, e os moços caíram debaixo da lenha [que carregavam] .
verses.RVR09: Llevaron los mozos á moler, y los muchachos desfallecieron en la leña.

verses.KJV: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
verses.WEB: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
verses.ASV: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os anciãos deixaram de [se sentarem] junto as portas, os rapazes de suas canções.
verses.RVR09: Los ancianos cesaron de la puerta, los mancebos de sus canciones.

verses.KJV: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.WEB: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.ASV: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Acabou a alegria de nosso coração; nossa dança se tornou em luto.
verses.RVR09: Cesó el gozo de nuestro corazón; nuestro corro se tornó en luto.

verses.KJV: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
verses.WEB: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
verses.ASV: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe unto us! for we have sinned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caiu a coroa de nossa cabeça; ai agora de nós, porque pecamos.
verses.RVR09: Cayó la corona de nuestra cabeza: ¡ay ahora de nosotros! porque pecamos.

verses.KJV: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
verses.WEB: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:
verses.ASV: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso nosso coração ficou fraco, por isso nossos olhos escureceram;
verses.RVR09: Por esto fué entristecido nuestro corazón, por esto se entenebrecieron nuestros ojos:

verses.KJV: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
verses.WEB: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
verses.ASV: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: The foxes walk upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por causa do monte de Sião, que está desolado; raposas andam nele.
verses.RVR09: Por el monte de Sión que está asolado; zorras andan en él.

verses.KJV: Thou, O Lord, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verses.WEB: You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
verses.ASV: Thou, O Jehovah, abidest for ever; Thy throne is from generation to generation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu, SENHOR, permanecerás para sempre; [e] teu trono de geração após geração.
verses.RVR09: Mas tú, Jehová, permanecerás para siempre: tu trono de generación en generación.

verses.KJV: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
verses.WEB: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
verses.ASV: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, [And] forsake us so long time?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por que te esquecerias de nós para sempre e nos abandonarias por tanto tempo?
verses.RVR09: ¿Por qué te olvidarás para siempre de nosotros, y nos dejarás por largos días?

verses.KJV: Turn thou us unto thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
verses.WEB: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
verses.ASV: Turn thou us unto thee, O Jehovah, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.
verses.ALMEIDA: Converte-nos, SENHOR, a ti, e seremos convertidos; renova o nossos dias como antes;
verses.RVR09: Vuélvenos, oh Jehová, á ti, y nos volveremos: renueva nuestros días como al principio.

verses.KJV: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
verses.WEB: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
verses.ASV: But thou hast utterly rejected us; Thou art very wroth against us.
verses.ALMEIDA: A não ser que tenhas nos rejeitado totalmente, e estejas enfurecido contra nós ao extremo.
verses.RVR09: Porque repeliendo nos has desechado; te has airado contra nosotros en gran manera.

verses.KJV: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.WEB: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.ASV: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, aos trinta anos, no quarto [mês] , aos cinco do mês, estando eu em meio dos exilados, junto ao rio Quebar, os céus se abriram, e vi visões de Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ que á los treinta años, en el mes cuarto, á cinco del mes, estando yo en medio de los trasportados junto al río de Chebar, los cielos se abrieron, y vi visiones de Dios.

verses.KJV: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
verses.WEB: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
verses.ASV: In the fifth [day] of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
verses.ALMEIDA: Aos cinco do mês, que foi no quinto ano do cativeiro do rei Joaquim,
verses.RVR09: A los cinco del mes, que fué en el quinto año de la transmigración del rey Joachîn,

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was there upon him.
verses.WEB: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.
verses.ASV: the word of Jehovah came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of Jehovah was there upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: verdadeiramente veio a palavra do SENHOR ao sacerdote Ezequiel, filho de Buzi, na terra dos caldeus, junto ao rio Quebar; e ali a mão do SENHOR esteve sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Fué palabra de Jehová á Ezequiel sacerdote, hijo de Buzi, en la tierra de los Caldeos, junto al río de Chebar; fué allí sobre él la mano de Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
verses.WEB: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
verses.ASV: And I looked, and, behold, a stormy wind came out of the north, a great cloud, with a fire infolding itself, and a brightness round about it, and out of the midst thereof as it were glowing metal, out of the midst of the fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então olhei, e eis que um vento tempestuoso vinha do norte, uma grande nuvem, e um fogo incandescente, e ao seu redor um resplendor, e no meio do fogo uma coisa que parecia como de âmbar,
verses.RVR09: Y miré, y he aquí un viento tempestuoso venía del aquilón, una gran nube, con un fuego envolvente, y en derredor suyo un resplandor, y en medio del fuego una cosa que parecía como de ámbar,

verses.KJV: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
verses.WEB: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
verses.ASV: And out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man;
verses.ALMEIDA: E no meio dela havia a semelhança de quatro animais; e esta era sua aparência; eles tinham semelhança humana.
verses.RVR09: Y en medio de ella, figura de cuatro animales. Y este era su parecer; había en ellos semejanza de hombre.

verses.KJV: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
verses.WEB: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
verses.ASV: and every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cada um tinha quatro rostos, e cada um quatro asas.
verses.RVR09: Y cada uno tenía cuatro rostros, y cuatro alas.

verses.KJV: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
verses.WEB: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
verses.ASV: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished brass.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas pernas eram retas, e a planta de seus pés como a planta de pé de bezerro; e reluziam como o bronze polido.
verses.RVR09: Y los pies de ellos eran derechos, y la planta de sus pies como la planta de pie de becerro; y centelleaban á manera de bronce muy bruñido.

verses.KJV: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
verses.WEB: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:
verses.ASV: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings [thus]:
verses.ALMEIDA: E [tinham] mãos humanas debaixo de suas asas, em seus quatro lados; [assim] os quatro [tinham] seus rostos e suas asas.
verses.RVR09: Y debajo de sus alas, á sus cuatro lados, tenían manos de hombre; y sus rostros y sus alas por los cuatro lados.

verses.KJV: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
verses.WEB: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
verses.ASV: their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
verses.ALMEIDA: Suas asas se juntavam umas às outras. Não viravam quando se moviam; cada um andava na direção de seu rosto.
verses.RVR09: Con las alas se juntaban el uno al otro. No se volvían cuando andaban; cada uno caminaba en derecho de su rostro.

verses.KJV: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
verses.WEB: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.
verses.ASV: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man; and they four had the face of a lion on the right side; and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four had also the face of an eagle.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a aparência de seus rostos era [como] rosto de homem; e rosto de leão à direita nos quatro; e à esquerda rosto de boi nos quatro; também havia nos quatro um rosto de águia;
verses.RVR09: Y la figura de sus rostros era rostro de hombre; y rostro de león á la parte derecha en los cuatro; y á la izquierda rostro de buey en los cuatro; asimismo había en los cuatro rostro de águila.

verses.KJV: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.WEB: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.ASV: And their faces and their wings were separate above; two [wings] of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Assim] eram seus rostos. E suas asas estavam estendidas por cima, cada um duas, as quais se juntavam; e as outras duas cobriam seus corpos.
verses.RVR09: Tales eran sus rostros; y tenían sus alas extendidas por encima, cada uno dos, las cuales se juntaban; y las otras dos cubrían sus cuerpos.

verses.KJV: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
verses.WEB: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
verses.ASV: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; they turned not when they went.
verses.ALMEIDA: E cada um se movia na direção de seu rosto; para onde o espírito se dirigia, eles iam; não viravam quando se moviam.
verses.RVR09: Y cada uno caminaba en derecho de su rostro: hacia donde el espíritu era que anduviesen, andaban; cuando andaban, no se volvían.

verses.KJV: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.WEB: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.
verses.ASV: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches: [the fire] went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quanto à semelhança dos animais, sua aparência era como pedaços de carvão acesos, como aparência de tochas acesas; o fogo se movia entre os animais; e brilhava intensamente, e do fogo saíam relâmpagos.
verses.RVR09: Cuanto á la semejanza de los animales, su parecer era como de carbones de fuego encendidos, como parecer de hachones encendidos: discurría entre los animales; y el fuego resplandecía, y del fuego salían relámpagos.

verses.KJV: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.WEB: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.ASV: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os animais corriam e voltavam, à semelhança de relâmpagos.
verses.RVR09: Y los animales corrían y tornaban á semejanza de relámpagos.

verses.KJV: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
verses.WEB: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
verses.ASV: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold, one wheel upon the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: E enquanto eu estava vendo os animais, eis que uma roda estava na terra junto aos animais, junto a seus quatro rostos.
verses.RVR09: Y estando yo mirando los animales, he aquí una rueda en la tierra junto á los animales, á sus cuatro caras.

verses.KJV: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
verses.WEB: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
verses.ASV: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto a beryl: and they four had one likeness; and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a aparência das rodas, e sua feitura, era como da cor do berilo; e as quatro tinham uma mesma semelhança; sua aparência e sua obra era como se uma roda estivesse no meio de [outra] roda.
verses.RVR09: Y el parecer de las ruedas y su obra semejábase al color del topacio. Y las cuatro tenían una misma semejanza: su apariencia y su obra como rueda en medio de rueda.

verses.KJV: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
verses.WEB: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
verses.ASV: When they went, they went in their four directions: they turned not when they went.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando andavam, moviam-se sobre seus quatro lados; não viravam quando se moviam.
verses.RVR09: Cuando andaban, se movían sobre sus cuatro costados: no se volvían cuando andaban.

verses.KJV: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
verses.WEB: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
verses.ASV: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and they four had their rims full of eyes round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus aros eram altos e espantosos; e seus aros estavam cheios de olhos ao redor das quatro [rodas] .
verses.RVR09: Y sus cercos eran altos y espantosos, y llenos de ojos alrededor en las cuatro.

verses.KJV: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.WEB: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.ASV: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando os animais andavam, as rodas andavam junto a eles: e quando os animais se levantavam da terra, levantavam-se [também] as rodas.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando los animales andaban, las ruedas andaban junto á ellos: y cuando los animales se levantaban de la tierra, las ruedas se levantaban.

verses.KJV: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.WEB: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.ASV: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went; thither was the spirit to go: and the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para onde o espírito queria ir, iam, para onde era o espírito ia; e as rodas [também] se levantavam com eles, pois o espírito dos animais estava nas rodas.
verses.RVR09: Hacia donde el espíritu era que anduviesen, andaban; hacia donde era el espíritu que anduviesen, las ruedas también se levantaban tras ellos; porque el espíritu de los animales estaba en las ruedas.

verses.KJV: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.WEB: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.ASV: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando eles andavam, elas andavam; e quando eles paravam, elas paravam; e quando se levantavam da terra, as rodas se levantavam com eles; pois o espírito dos animais estava nas rodas.
verses.RVR09: Cuando ellos andaban, andaban ellas; y cuando ellos se paraban, se paraban ellas; asimismo cuando se levantaban de la tierra, las ruedas se levantaban tras ellos; porque el espíritu de los animales estaba en las ruedas.

verses.KJV: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
verses.WEB: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
verses.ASV: And over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of a firmament, like the terrible crystal to look upon, stretched forth over their heads above.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sobre as cabeças dos animais havia algo semelhante a um firmamento, da cor de um cristal espantoso, estendido acima sobre suas cabeças.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre las cabezas de cada animal aparecía expansión á manera de cristal maravilloso, extendido encima sobre sus cabezas.

verses.KJV: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
verses.WEB: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
verses.ASV: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two which covered on this side, and every one had two which covered on that side, their bodies.
verses.ALMEIDA: E debaixo do firmamento estavam suas asas deles estendidas uma à outra; a cada um tinha duas, e outras duas com que cobriam seus corpos.
verses.RVR09: Y debajo de la expansión estaban las alas de ellos derechas la una á la otra; á cada uno dos, y otras dos con que se cubrían sus cuerpos.

verses.KJV: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.WEB: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.ASV: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of a host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ouvi o ruído de suas asas quando se moviam, como o som de muitas águas, como a voz do Onipotente, o ruído de uma multidão, como o som de um exército. Quando paravam, abaixavam suas asas.
verses.RVR09: Y oí el sonido de sus alas cuando andaban, como sonido de muchas aguas, como la voz del Omnipotente, como ruido de muchedumbre, como la voz de un ejército. Cuando se paraban, aflojaban sus alas.

verses.KJV: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
verses.WEB: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.ASV: And there was a voice above the firmament that was over their heads: when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando se paravam e abaixavam suas asas, ouvia-se uma voz de cima do firmamento que estava sobre suas cabeças.
verses.RVR09: Y cuando se paraban y aflojaban sus alas, oíase voz de arriba de la expansión que había sobre sus cabezas.

verses.KJV: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
verses.WEB: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
verses.ASV: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man upon it above.
verses.ALMEIDA: E acima do firmamento que estava sobre suas cabeças, havia a figura de um trono, que parecia com a pedra de safira; e sobre a figura do trono havia uma semelhança que parecia com um homem sentado acima dele.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre la expansión que había sobre sus cabezas, veíase la figura de un trono que parecía de piedra de zafiro; y sobre la figura del trono había una semejanza que parecía de hombre sentado sobre él.

verses.KJV: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
verses.WEB: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
verses.ASV: And I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it round about, from the appearance of his loins and upward; and from the appearance of his loins and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness round about him.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vi o que parecia com o bronze polido, com a aparência de fogo ao seu redor do lado de dentro, da aparência de sua cintura para cima; e de sua cintura para baixo, vi que parecia como fogo, e havia um resplendor ao redor dele;
verses.RVR09: Y vi apariencia como de ámbar, como apariencia de fuego dentro de ella en contorno, por el aspecto de sus lomos para arriba; y desde sus lomos para abajo, vi que parecía como fuego, y que tenía resplandor alrededor.

verses.KJV: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
verses.WEB: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
verses.ASV: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Jehovah. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como a aparência do arco celeste, que surge nas nuvens em dia de chuva, assim era o aparência do resplendor ao redor. Esta foi a visão da semelhança da glória do SENHOR. E quando eu a vi, caí sobre meu rosto, e ouvi voz de um que falava.
verses.RVR09: Cual parece el arco del cielo que está en las nubes el día que llueve, así era el parecer del resplandor alrededor. Esta fué la visión de la semejanza de la gloria de Jehová. Y luego que yo la hube visto, caí sobre mi rostro, y oí voz de uno que hablaba.

verses.KJV: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
verses.WEB: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”
verses.ASV: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak with thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Disse-me: Filho do homem, fica de pé, e falarei contigo.
verses.RVR09: Y DÍJOME: Hijo del hombre, está sobre tus pies, y hablaré contigo.

verses.KJV: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
verses.WEB: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
verses.ASV: And the Spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet; and I heard him that spake unto me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então entrou em mim o Espírito enquanto falava comigo, e fez-me ficar de pé, e ouvi àquele que estava falando comigo.
verses.RVR09: Y entró espíritu en mí luego que me habló, y afirmóme sobre mis pies, y oía al que me hablaba.
