verses.ALMEIDA: Diante de seus olhos cava [um buraco] na parede, e tira por ele [a bagagem] .
verses.RVR09: Delante de sus ojos horadarás la pared, y saldrás por ella.

verses.KJV: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
verses.WEB: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”
verses.ASV: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulder, and carry it forth in the dark; thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the land: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Diante de seus olhos os levarás sobre teus ombros, ao anoitecer os tirarás; cobrirás teu rosto, para que não vejas a terra; pois eu fiz de ti por sinal à casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Delante de sus ojos los llevarás sobre tus hombros, de noche los sacarás; cubrirás tu rostro, y no mirarás la tierra: porque en señal te he dado á la casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
verses.WEB: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.
verses.ASV: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for removing, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I brought it forth in the dark, and bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu fiz assim como me foi mandado; tirei minha bagagem de dia, como bagagem de partida, e à tarde cavei [um buraco] na parede com a mão; tirei-os de noite, [e] os levei sobre os ombros diante dos olhos deles.
verses.RVR09: Y yo hice así como me fué mandado: saqué mis aparejos de día, como aparejos de partida, y á la tarde horadé la pared á mano; salí de noche, y llevélos sobre los hombros á vista de ellos.

verses.KJV: And in the morning came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: In the morning, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And in the morning came the word of Jehovah unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim palavra do SENHOR pela manhã, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová por la mañana, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
verses.WEB: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.ASV: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, por acaso a casa de Israel, aquela casa rebelde, não te perguntou: O que estás fazendo?
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, ¿no te ha dicho la casa de Israel, aquella casa rebelde: ¿Qué haces?

verses.KJV: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.
verses.WEB: “Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’
verses.ASV: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This burden [concerneth] the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: esta revelação é para o príncipe em Jerusalém, e para toda a casa de Israel que está em meio dela.
verses.RVR09: Diles: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Al príncipe en Jerusalem es esta carga, y á toda la casa de Israel que está en medio de ellos.

verses.KJV: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
verses.WEB: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.
verses.ASV: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them; they shall go into exile, into captivity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize: Eu sou vosso sinal; tal como eu fiz, assim se fará a eles; serão removidos; irão em cativeiro.
verses.RVR09: Diles: Yo soy vuestra señal: como yo hice, así les harán á ellos: al pasar á otro país irán en cautiverio.

verses.KJV: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
verses.WEB: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.
verses.ASV: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the dark, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, because he shall not see the land with his eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o príncipe que está entre eles, levará nos ombros [sua bagagem] de noite, e sairá; na parede cavarão [uma abertura] para saírem por ela; cobrirá seu rosto para não ver com [seus] olhos a terra.
verses.RVR09: Y al príncipe que está en medio de ellos llevarán á cuestas de noche, y saldrán; horadarán la pared para sacarlo por ella; cubrirá su rostro para no ver con sus ojos la tierra.

verses.KJV: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.WEB: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.
verses.ASV: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também estenderei minha rede sobre ele, e ele será preso em meu laço, e eu o levarei à Babilônia, à terra de caldeus; porém ele não a verá, ainda que morrerá ali.
verses.RVR09: Mas yo extenderé mi red sobre él, y será preso en mi malla, y harélo llevar á Babilonia, á tierra de Caldeos; mas no la verá, y allá morirá.

verses.KJV: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.WEB: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.ASV: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are round about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a todos os que estiverem ao redor dele para ajudá-lo, e a todas as suas tropas espalharei a todos os ventos, e desembainharei espada atrás deles.
verses.RVR09: Y á todos los que estuvieren alrededor de él para su ayuda, y á todas sus compañías esparciré á todo viento, y desenvainaré espada en pos de ellos.

verses.KJV: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
verses.WEB: “‘They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
verses.ASV: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall disperse them among the nations, and scatter them through the countries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu os espalhar entre as nações, e os dispersar pelas terras.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrán que yo soy Jehová, cuando los esparciere entre las gentes, y los derramare por la tierra.

verses.KJV: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the nations whither they come; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém deixarei alguns poucos sobreviventes da espada, da fome, e da pestilência, para que contem todas as suas abominações entre as nações para onde forem; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y haré que de ellos queden pocos en número, del cuchillo, y del hambre, y de la pestilencia, para que cuenten todas sus abominaciones entre las gentes adonde llegaren; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Moreover the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
verses.WEB: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.
verses.ASV: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with fearfulness;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, come teu pão com tremor, e bebe tua água com estremecimento e com ansiedade;
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, come tu pan con temblor, y bebe tu agua con estremecimiento y con anhelo;

verses.KJV: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord God of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
verses.WEB: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.
verses.ASV: and say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with fearfulness, and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, [and despoiled] of all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize ao povo da terra: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS sobre os moradores de Jerusalém, e sobre a terra de Israel: Comerão seu pão com ansiedade, e com espanto beberão sua água; porque sua terra será desolada de seu conteúdo, por causa da violência de todos os que nela habitam.
verses.RVR09: Y dirás al pueblo de la tierra: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová sobre los moradores de Jerusalem, y sobre la tierra de Israel: Su pan comerán con temor, y con espanto beberán su agua; porque su tierra será asolada de su multitud, por la maldad de todos los que en ella moran.

verses.KJV: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
verses.ASV: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be a desolation; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as cidades habitadas serão desoladas, e a terra se tornará em deserto; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y las ciudades habitadas serán asoladas, y la tierra será desierta; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
verses.WEB: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?
verses.ASV: Son of man, what is this proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, que ditado é este que vós tendes vós terra de Israel, que diz: Os dias se prolongarão, e toda visão perecerá?
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, ¿qué refrán es este que tenéis vosotros en la tierra de Israel, diciendo: Prolongarse han los días, y perecerá toda visión?

verses.KJV: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord God; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
verses.WEB: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.
verses.ASV: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the fulfilment of every vision.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei cessar este ditado, e não usarão mais esta frase em Israel. Ao invés disso, dize-lhes: Os dias chegaram, e o cumprimento de toda visão.
verses.RVR09: Diles por tanto: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Haré cesar este refrán, y no repetirán más este dicho en Israel. Diles pues: Se han acercado aquellos días, y la palabra de toda visión.

verses.KJV: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.WEB: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.ASV: For there shall be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não haverá mais uma visão falsa sequer, nem haverá adivinhação lisonjeira no meio da casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Porque no habrá más alguna visión vana, ni habrá adivinación de lisonjeros en medio de la casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: For I am the Lord: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: For I am the LORD. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: For I am Jehovah; I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be performed; it shall be no more deferred: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I speak the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois eu, o SENHOR, falarei; a palavra que eu falar se cumprirá; não se prolongará mais; porque em vossos dias, ó casa rebelde, falarei a palavra e a cumprirei, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo Jehová hablaré; cumpliráse la palabra que yo hablaré; no se dilatará más: antes en vuestros días, oh casa rebelde, hablaré palabra, y cumpliréla, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying.
verses.WEB: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Again the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Também veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
verses.WEB: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’
verses.ASV: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of times that are far off.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, eis que os da casa de Israel dizem: A visão que este vê é para muitos dias, e ele profetiza para tempos distantes.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, he aquí que los de la casa de Israel dicen: La visión que éste ve es para muchos días, y para lejanos tiempos profetiza éste.

verses.KJV: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: There shall none of my words be deferred any more, but the word which I shall speak shall be performed, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Nenhuma das minhas palavras se prolongará mais; e palavra que eu falei se cumprirá, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Diles por tanto: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: No se dilatarán más todas mis palabras: cumpliráse la palabra que yo hablaré, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the Lord;
verses.WEB: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the LORD’s word:
verses.ASV: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own heart, Hear ye the word of Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, profetiza contra os profetas de Israel que profetizam; e dize aos que profetizam de seu [próprio] coração: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, profetiza contra los profetas de Israel que profetizan, y di á los que profetizan de su corazón: Oid palabra de Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
verses.WEB: The Lord GOD says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai dos profetas tolos, que andam atrás de seu [próprio] espírito, e que nada viram!
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¡Ay de los profetas insensatos, que andan en pos de su propio espíritu, y nada vieron!

verses.KJV: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
verses.WEB: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.
verses.ASV: O Israel, thy prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.
verses.ALMEIDA: Teus profetas são como raposas nos desertos, ó Israel.
verses.RVR09: Como zorras en los desiertos fueron tus profetas, oh Israel.

verses.KJV: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the Lord.
verses.WEB: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the LORD’s day.
verses.ASV: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the day of Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não subistes às brechas, nem restaurastes o muro para a casa de Israel, para estardes na batalha no dia do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: No habéis subido á los portillos, ni echasteis vallado en la casa de Israel, estando en la batalla en el día de Jehová.

verses.KJV: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The Lord saith: and the Lord hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.
verses.WEB: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘The LORD says;’ but the LORD has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.
verses.ASV: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, that say, Jehovah saith; but Jehovah hath not sent them: and they have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles veem falsidade e adivinhação de mentira. Falam: O SENHOR disse, mas o SENHOR não os enviou; e [ainda] esperam que a palavra se cumpra.
verses.RVR09: Vieron vanidad y adivinación de mentira. Dicen: Ha dicho Jehová; y Jehová no los envió: y hacen esperar que se confirme la palabra.

verses.KJV: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The Lord saith it; albeit I have not spoken?
verses.WEB: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘The LORD says;’ but I have not spoken?”
verses.ASV: Have ye not seen a false vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, in that ye say, Jehovah saith; albeit I have not spoken?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso não vedes visão falsa, e não falais adivinhação de mentira, quando dizeis, O SENHOR disse, sem que eu tenha falado?
verses.RVR09: ¿No habéis visto visión vana, y no habéis dicho adivinación de mentira, por cuanto decís, Dijo Jehová; no habiendo yo hablado?

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have spoken falsehood, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que falais falsidade e vedes mentira, portanto eis que eu sou contra vós, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto vosotros habéis hablado vanidad, y habéis visto mentira, por tanto, he aquí yo contra vosotros, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
verses.ASV: And my hand shall be against the prophets that see false visions, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the council of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E minha mão será contra os profetas que veem falsidade, e adivinham mentira; não estarão na congregação do meu povo, nem estarão inscritos no livro da casa de Israel, nem voltarão para a terra de Israel; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y será mi mano contra los profetas que ven vanidad, y adivinan mentira: no serán en la congregación de mi pueblo, ni serán escritos en el libro de la casa de Israel, ni á la tierra de Israel volverán; y sabréis que yo soy el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
verses.WEB: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.
verses.ASV: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there is no peace; and when one buildeth up a wall, behold, they daub it with untempered [mortar]:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, por andarem enganando a meu povo, dizendo: Paz, sem que houvesse paz, e [quando] um edifica uma parede, eis que eles a rebocam com cal solta;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, y por cuanto engañaron á mi pueblo, diciendo, Paz, no habiendo paz; y el uno edificaba la pared, y he aquí que los otros la encostraban con lodo suelto;

verses.KJV: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
verses.WEB: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.
verses.ASV: say unto them that daub it with untempered [mortar], that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize aos que rebocam com cal solta, que cairá; haverá uma grande pancada de chuva, e vós ó grandes pedras de granizo, caireis, e um vento tempestuoso [a] fenderá.
verses.RVR09: Di á los encostradores con lodo suelto, que caerá; vendrá lluvia inundante, y daré piedras de granizo que la hagan caer, y viento tempestuoso la romperá.

verses.KJV: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
verses.WEB: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”
verses.ASV: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que, quando a parede tiver caído, não vos dirão: Onde está a reboco com que rebocastes?
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, cuando la pared habrá caído, no os dirán: ¿Dónde está la embarradura con que encostrasteis?

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
verses.WEB: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my wrath; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei com que rompa um vento tempestuoso em meu furor e haverá uma grande pancada de chuva em minha ira, e grande pedras de granizo em indignação, para destruir.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Y haré que la rompa viento tempestuoso con mi ira, y lluvia inundante vendrá con mi furor, y piedras de granizo con enojo para consumir.

verses.KJV: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered [mortar], and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be uncovered; and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E derrubarei a parede que vós rebocastes com cal solta, e a lançarei em terra, e seu fundamento ficará descoberto; assim cairá, e perecereis no meio dela; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Así desbarataré la pared que vosotros encostrasteis con lodo suelto, y echaréla á tierra, y será descubierto su cimiento, y caerá, y seréis consumidos en medio de ella; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
verses.WEB: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—
verses.ASV: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered [mortar]; and I will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim cumprirei meu furor contra a parede, e contra os que a rebocaram com lodo solto; e vos direi: Já não há a parede, nem os que a rebocavam,
verses.RVR09: Cumpliré así mi furor en la pared y en los que la encostraron con lodo suelto; y os diré: No existe la pared, ni aquellos que la encostraron,

verses.KJV: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: [to wit], the prophets of Israel that prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and that see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Os profetas de Israel que profetizam sobre Jerusalém, e veem para ela visão de paz, sem que haja paz,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Los profetas de Israel que profetizan á Jerusalem, y ven para ella visión de paz, no habiendo paz, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
verses.WEB: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,
verses.ASV: And thou, son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, that prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, filho do homem, dirige teu rosto às filhas de teu povo que profetizam de seu [próprio] coração, e profetiza contra elas,
verses.RVR09: Y tú, hijo del hombre, pon tu rostro á las hijas de tu pueblo que profetizan de su corazón, y profetiza contra ellas,

verses.KJV: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?
verses.WEB: and say, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?
verses.ASV: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the women that sew pillows upon all elbows, and make kerchiefs for the head of [persons of] every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and save souls alive for yourselves?
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai daquelas que costuram almofadas para todos os pulsos, e fazem lenços sobre as cabeças de todos os tamanhos para caçarem as almas! Por acaso caçareis as almas de meu povo, e guardareis a vossas [próprias] almas em vida?
verses.RVR09: Y di: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¡Ay de aquellas que cosen almohadillas á todos codos de manos, y hacen veletes sobre la cabeza de toda edad para cazar las almas! ¿Habéis de cazar las almas de mi pueblo, para mantener así vuestra propia vida?

verses.KJV: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
verses.WEB: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’
verses.ASV: And ye have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hearken unto lies.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vós me profanastes para com meu povo por punhados de cevada e por pedaços de pão, matando as almas que não deviam morrer, e mantendo em vida as almas que não deviam viver, mentindo a meu povo, que escuta a mentira.
verses.RVR09: ¿Y habéis de profanarme entre mi pueblo por puñados de cebada y por pedazos de pan, matando las almas que no mueren, y dando vida á las almas que no vivirán, mintiendo á mi pueblo que escucha la mentira?

verses.KJV: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.
verses.WEB: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.
verses.ASV: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make [them] fly, and I will tear them from your arms; and I will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make [them] fly.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu contra vossas almofadas, com que caçais as almas como [se fossem] pássaros; eu as arrancarei de vossos braços, e soltarei as almas, as almas que caçais como pássaros.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí yo contra vuestras almohadillas, con que cazáis ahí las almas volando; yo las arrancaré de vuestros brazos, y dejaré las almas, las almas que cazáis volando.

verses.KJV: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E rasgarei vossos lenços, e livrarei meu povo de vossas mãos, e não mais estarão em vossas mãos para serem caçadas; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Romperé asimismo vuestros veletes, y libraré mi pueblo de vuestra mano, y no estarán más en vuestra mano para caza; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
verses.WEB: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.
verses.ASV: Because with lies ye have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad, and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive;
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois com mentira entristecestes o coração do justo, ao qual eu não lhe causei dor, e fortalecestes as mãos do perverso, para que não se desviasse de seu mau caminho para se manter vivo;
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto entristecisteis con mentira el corazón del justo, al cual yo no entristecí, y esforzasteis las manos del impío, para que no se apartase de su mal camino, infundiéndole ánimo;

verses.KJV: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
verses.ASV: Therefore ye shall no more see false visions, nor divine divinations: and I will deliver my people out of your hand; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto não mais vereis falsidade, nem mais adivinhareis adivinhação. Mas livrarei meu povo de vossas mãos, e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto no veréis vanidad, ni más adivinaréis adivinación; y libraré mi pueblo de vuestra mano; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
verses.WEB: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
verses.ASV: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vieram a mim [alguns] dos anciãos de Israel, e se sentaram diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y VINIERON á mí algunos de los ancianos de Israel, y sentáronse delante de mí.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
verses.WEB: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?
verses.ASV: Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be inquired of at all by them?
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, estes levantaram ídolos em seus corações e puseram o tropeço de sua maldade diante de seus rostos. Por acaso devo eu deixar que me consultem?
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, estos hombres han puesto sus ídolos en su corazón, y establecido el tropiezo de su maldad delante de su rostro: ¿acaso he de ser yo verdaderamente consultado por ellos?

verses.KJV: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the Lord will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
verses.WEB: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,
verses.ASV: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Every man of the house of Israel that taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I Jehovah will answer him therein according to the multitude of his idols;
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto fala com eles, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Qualquer homem da casa de Israel que levantar a seus ídolos em seu coração, e puser o tropeço de sua maldade diante de seu rosto, e vier ao profeta, eu, o SENHOR responderei ao que vier conforme a multidão de seus ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Háblales por tanto, y diles: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Cualquier hombre de la casa de Israel que hubiere puesto sus ídolos en su corazón, y establecido el tropiezo de su maldad delante de su rostro, y viniere al profeta, yo Jehová responderé al que viniere en la multitud de sus ídolos;

verses.KJV: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
verses.WEB: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’
verses.ASV: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para eu tomar a casa de Israel em seus corações, pois todos se tornaram estranhos de mim por causa de seus ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Para tomar á la casa de Israel en su corazón, que se han apartado de mí todos ellos en sus ídolos.

verses.KJV: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.WEB: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.ASV: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Return ye, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Convertei-vos, virai-vos de costas a vossos ídolos, e desviai vossos rostos de todas as vossas abominações.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto di á la casa de Israel: Así dice el Señor Jehová: Convertíos, y volveos de vuestros ídolos, y apartad vuestro rostro de todas vuestras abominaciones.

verses.KJV: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the Lord will answer him by myself:
verses.WEB: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I the LORD will answer him by myself.
verses.ASV: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that separateth himself from me, and taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet to inquire for himself of me; I Jehovah will answer him by myself:
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque qualquer homem da casa de Israel, e dos estrangeiros que moram em Israel, que houver deixado de me seguir, e levantar seus ídolos em seu coração, e puser diante de seu rosto o tropeço de sua maldade, e vier ao profeta para me consultar por meio dele, eu, o SENHOR, lhe responderei por mim mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Porque cualquier hombre de la casa de Israel, y de los extranjeros que moran en Israel, que se hubiere apartado de andar en pos de mí, y hubiere puesto sus ídolos en su corazón, y establecido delante de su rostro el tropiezo de su maldad, y viniere al profeta para preguntarle por mí, yo Jehová le responderé por mí mismo:

verses.KJV: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.ASV: and I will set my face against that man, and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porei meu rosto contra tal homem, e farei com que ele seja um sinal e um ditado, e o cortarei do meio do meu povo; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré mi rostro contra aquel hombre, y le pondré por señal y por fábula, y yo lo cortaré de entre mi pueblo; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the Lord have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
verses.WEB: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.
verses.ASV: And if the prophet be deceived and speak a word, I, Jehovah, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E se o profeta se enganar e falar alguma palavra, eu o SENHOR enganei ao tal profeta; e estenderei minha mão contra ele, e eu o destruirei do meio de meu povo Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y el profeta, cuando fuere engañado y hablare palabra, yo Jehová engañé al tal profeta; y extenderé mi mano sobre él, y raeréle de en medio de mi pueblo de Israel.

verses.KJV: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;
verses.WEB: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,
verses.ASV: And they shall bear their iniquity: the iniquity of the prophet shall be even as the iniquity of him that seeketh [unto him];
verses.ALMEIDA: E levarão sua maldade; tal como a maldade do que pergunta, assim será a maldade do profeta;
verses.RVR09: Y llevarán su maldad: como la maldad del que pregunta, así será la maldad del profeta;

verses.KJV: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: that the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que a casa de Israel não mais se desvie de me seguir, nem se contaminem mais com todas as seus transgressões; e então serão meu povo, e eu serei seu Deus, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Para que no yerren más la casa de Israel de en pos de mí: ni más se contaminen en todas sus rebeliones, y me sean por pueblo, y yo les sea por Dios, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
verses.WEB: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—
verses.ASV: Son of man, when a land sinneth against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand upon it, and break the staff of the bread thereof, and send famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, quando uma terra pecar contra mim, rebelando-se gravemente, então estenderei minha mão contra ela, quebrarei o sustento de pão dela, mandarei nela fome, e cortarei dela homens e animais;
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, cuando la tierra pecare contra mí rebelándose pérfidamente, y extendiere yo mi mano sobre ella, y le quebrantare el arrimo del pan, y enviare en ella hambre, y talare de ella hombres y bestias;

verses.KJV: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ainda que estivessem no meio dela estes três homens, Noé, Daniel, e Jó, eles por sua justiça livrariam [somente] suas almas,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Si estuvieren en medio de ella estos tres varones, Noé, Daniel, y Job, ellos por su justicia librarán su vida, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
verses.WEB: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—
verses.ASV: If I cause evil beasts to pass through the land, and they ravage it, and it be made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the beasts;
verses.ALMEIDA: E se eu fizer passar os animais perigosos pela terra, e eles a despojarem, e ela for tão assolada que ninguém possa passar por ela por causa dos animais,
verses.RVR09: Y si hiciere pasar malas bestias por la tierra, y la asolaren, y fuere desolada que no haya quien pase á causa de las bestias,

verses.KJV: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
verses.WEB: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.
verses.ASV: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only should be delivered, but the land should be desolate.
verses.ALMEIDA: e estes três homens estivessem no meio dela, vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que não livrariam nem filhos nem filhas; somente eles ficariam livres, e a terra seria assolada.
verses.RVR09: Y estos tres varones estuvieren en medio de ella, vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, ni á sus hijos ni á sus hijas librarán; ellos solos serán libres, y la tierra será asolada.

verses.KJV: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
verses.WEB: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—
verses.ASV: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off from it man and beast;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou [se] eu trouxer a espada sobre a tal terra, e disser: Espada, passa pela terra; e eu exterminar dela homens e animais,
verses.RVR09: O si yo trajere espada sobre la tierra, y dijere: Espada, pasa por la tierra; é hiciere talar de ella hombres y bestias,

verses.KJV: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
verses.WEB: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.
verses.ASV: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only should be delivered themselves.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que estes três homens estivessem nela, vivo eu,diz o Senhor DEUS, que não livrariam filhos nem filhas; somente eles ficariam livres.
verses.RVR09: Y estos tres varones estuvieren en medio de ella, vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, no librarán sus hijos ni sus hijas; ellos solos serán libres.

verses.KJV: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
verses.WEB: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—
verses.ASV: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast;
verses.ALMEIDA: Ou [se] eu mandar pestilência sobre tal terra, e derramar meu furor sobre ela com sangue, para exterminar dela homens e animais,
verses.RVR09: O si pestilencia enviare sobre esa tierra, y derramare mi ira sobre ella en sangre, para talar de ella hombres y bestias,

verses.KJV: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.WEB: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”
verses.ASV: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither son nor daughter; they should but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ainda que Noé, Daniel, e Jó estivessem no meio dela, vivo eu,diz o Senhor DEUS, que não livrariam filho nem filha; eles por sua justiça livrariam suas [próprias] almas.
verses.RVR09: Y estuvieren en medio de ella Noé, Daniel, y Job, vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, no librarán hijo ni hija; ellos por su justicia librarán su vida.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
verses.WEB: For the Lord GOD says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the evil beasts, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast!
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quanto mais se eu enviar meus quatro calamitosos julgamentos, espada, fome, animais perigosos, e pestilência, contra Jerusalém, para exterminar dela homens e animais!
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¿Cuánto más, si mis cuatro malos juicios, espada, y hambre, y mala bestia, y pestilencia, enviare contra Jerusalem, para talar de ella hombres y bestias?

verses.KJV: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
verses.WEB: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.
verses.ASV: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be carried forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings; and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eis que restarão nela [alguns] sobreviventes, filhos e filhas, que serão transportados. Eis que eles chegarão até vós, e vereis seu caminho e seus feitos; e ficareis consolados do mal que eu trouxe sobre Jerusalém, de tudo que trouxe sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Sin embargo, he aquí quedarán en ella algunos residuos, hijos é hijas, que serán llevados fuera: he aquí que ellos entrarán á vosotros, y veréis su camino y sus hechos; y tomaréis consolación del mal que hice venir sobre Jerusalem, de todas las cosas que traje sobre ella.

verses.KJV: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their way and their doings; and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eles vos consolarão quando virdes seu caminho e seus feitos; e sabereis que não sem razão que fiz tudo quanto fiz nela,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y consolaros han cuando viereis su camino y sus hechos, y conoceréis que no sin causa hice todo lo que habré hecho en ella, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.WEB: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.ASV: Son of man, what is the vine-tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, em que é a madeira da videira é melhor que toda madeira? [Ou] o que é o sarmento entre as madeiras do bosque?
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, ¿qué es el palo de la vid más que todo palo? ¿qué es el sarmiento entre los maderos del bosque?

verses.KJV: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.WEB: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?
verses.ASV: Shall wood be taken thereof to make any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso tomam dele madeira para fazer alguma obra? Toma-se dele alguma estaca para pendurar nela algum vaso?
verses.RVR09: ¿Tomarán de él madera para hacer alguna obra? ¿tomarán de él una estaca para colgar de ella algún vaso?

verses.KJV: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
verses.WEB: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
verses.ASV: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire hath devoured both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned: is it profitable for any work?
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que é posto no fogo para ser consumido; suas duas pontas o fogo consome, e seu meio fica queimado. Por acaso serviria para alguma obra?
verses.RVR09: He aquí, que es puesto en el fuego para ser consumido; sus dos cabos consumió el fuego, y la parte del medio se quemó; ¿aprovechará para obra alguna?

verses.KJV: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
verses.WEB: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
verses.ASV: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned, shall it yet be meet for any work!
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que quando estava inteiro não se fazia [dele] obra; menos ainda depois de consumido pelo fogo, tendo se queimado, servir para obra alguma.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que cuando estaba entero no era para obra alguna: ¿cuánto menos después que el fuego lo hubiere consumido, y fuere quemado? ¿será más para alguna obra?

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As the vine-tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Tal como a madeira da videira entre as madeiras do bosque, a qual entreguei ao fogo para que seja consumida, assim entregarei os moradores de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Como el palo de la vid entre los maderos del bosque, el cual dí al fuego para que lo consuma, así haré á los moradores de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I set my face against them.
verses.WEB: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
verses.ASV: And I will set my face against them; they shall go forth from the fire, but the fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I set my face against them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois porei meu rosto contra eles; ainda que tenham saído do fogo, o fogo os consumirá; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR, quando tiver posto meu rosto contra eles.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré mi rostro contra ellos; de fuego salieron, y fuego los consumirá; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová, cuando pusiere mi rostro contra ellos.

verses.KJV: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tonarei a terra em desolação, pois transgrediram gravemente,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y tornaré la tierra en asolamiento, por cuanto cometieron prevaricación, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Again the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.WEB: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
verses.ASV: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, notifica a Jerusalém suas abominações,
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, notifica á Jerusalem sus abominaciones,

verses.KJV: And say, Thus saith the Lord God unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
verses.WEB: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.
verses.ASV: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto Jerusalem: Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of the Canaanite; the Amorite was thy father, and thy mother was a Hittite.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS a Jerusalém: Tua origem e teu nascimento [procedem] da terra de Canaã; teu pai era amorreu, e tua mãe Heteia.
verses.RVR09: Y di: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová sobre Jerusalem: Tu habitación y tu raza fué de la tierra de Canaán; tu padre Amorrheo, y tu madre Hethea.

verses.KJV: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.WEB: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.
verses.ASV: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to cleanse thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto a teu nascimento, no dia que nasceste não foi cortado o teu umbigo, nem foste lavada com água para ficares limpa; nem foste esfregada com sal, nem foste envolvida em faixas.
verses.RVR09: Y cuanto á tu nacimiento, el día que naciste no fué cortado tu ombligo, ni fuiste lavada con aguas para atemperarte, ni salada con sal, ni fuiste envuelta con fajas.

verses.KJV: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.WEB: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
verses.ASV: No eye pitied thee, to do any of these things unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, for that thy person was abhorred, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.ALMEIDA: Não houve olho algum que se compadecesse de ti, para te fazer algo disto, tendo misericórdia; ao invés disso, foste lançada sobre a face do campo, por nojo de tua alma, no dia em que nasceste.
verses.RVR09: No hubo ojo que se compadeciese de ti, para hacerte algo de esto, teniendo de ti misericordia; sino que fuiste echada sobre la haz del campo, con menosprecio de tu vida, en el día que naciste.

verses.KJV: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.
verses.WEB: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’
verses.ASV: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee weltering in thy blood, I said unto thee, [Though thou art] in thy blood, live; yea, I said unto thee, [Though thou art] in thy blood, live.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando passei junto a ti, vi-te suja em teu sangue, e te disse em teu sangue: Vive; e te disse em teu sangue: Vive.
verses.RVR09: Y yo pasé junto á ti, y te vi sucia en tus sangres, y díjete: En tus sangres, vive; vive, díjete, en tus sangres.

verses.KJV: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.
verses.WEB: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.
verses.ASV: I caused thee to multiply as that which groweth in the field, and thou didst increase and wax great, and thou attainedst to excellent ornament; thy breasts were fashioned, and thy hair was grown; yet thou wast naked and bare.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu te multipliquei como o broto do campo, e cresceste, e engrandeceste; e chegaste à grande formosura; os seios te cresceram, e teu pelo cresceu; porém estavas nua e descoberta.
verses.RVR09: En millares como la hierba del campo te puse, y fuiste aumentada y engrandecida, y viniste á ser adornada grandemente; los pechos te crecieron, y tu pelo brotó; mas tú estabas desnuda y descubierta.

verses.KJV: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord God, and thou becamest mine.
verses.WEB: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord GOD, “and you became mine.
verses.ASV: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord Jehovah, and thou becamest mine.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando passei junto a ti, e te vi, e eis que teu tempo era tempo de amores; e estendi meu manto sobre ti, e cobri tua nudez; e prestei juramento a ti, e entrei em pacto contigo, e foste minha diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y pasé yo junto á ti, y te miré, y he aquí que tu tiempo era tiempo de amores; y extendí mi manto sobre ti, y cubrí tu desnudez; y díte juramento, y entré en concierto contigo, dice el Señor Jehová, y fuiste mía:

verses.KJV: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
verses.WEB: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
verses.ASV: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então te lavei com água, e te enxaguei de teu sangue, e te ungi com óleo;
verses.RVR09: Y te lavé con agua, y lavé tus sangres de encima de ti, y ungíte con aceite;

verses.KJV: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
verses.WEB: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
verses.ASV: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with sealskin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and covered thee with silk.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te vesti de bordado, calcei-te com couro, cingi-te de linho fino, e te cobri de seda.
verses.RVR09: Y te vestí de bordado, y te calcé de tejón, y ceñíte de lino, y te vestí de seda.

verses.KJV: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.WEB: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.
verses.ASV: And I decked thee with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te adornei com ornamentos, e pus braceletes em teus braços, e colar em teu pescoço;
verses.RVR09: Y te atavíe con ornamentos, y puse ajorcas en tus brazos, y collar á tu cuello;

verses.KJV: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
verses.WEB: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
verses.ASV: And I put a ring upon thy nose, and ear-rings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thy head.
verses.ALMEIDA: E pus joias pendente em teu nariz, argolas em tuas orelhas, e uma linda coroa em tua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Y puse joyas sobre tus narices, y zarcillos en tus orejas, y diadema de hermosura en tu cabeza.

verses.KJV: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
verses.WEB: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
verses.ASV: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil; and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper unto royal estate.
verses.ALMEIDA: E foste adornada de ouro e de prata, e teu vestido foi linho fino, e seda, e bordado; comeste farinha fina, mel, e azeite; foste muito formosa, e prosperaste até ser rainha.
verses.RVR09: Y fuiste adornada de oro y de plata, y tu vestido fué lino, y seda, y bordado; comiste flor de harina de trigo, y miel, y aceite; y fuiste hermoseada en extremo, y has prosperado hasta reinar.

verses.KJV: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And thy renown went forth among the nations for thy beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: A tua fama percorreu entre as nações por causa da tua beleza; porque era perfeita, por causa da minha glória que eu havia posto sobre ti, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y salióte nombradía entre las gentes á causa de tu hermosura; porque era perfecta, á causa de mi hermosura que yo puse sobre ti, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.WEB: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.
verses.ASV: But thou didst trust in thy beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy whoredoms on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém confiaste na tua beleza, e te prostituíste por causa da tua fama, e derramaste tuas prostituições a todo que passava, para que fosse dele.
verses.RVR09: Mas confiaste en tu hermosura, y fornicaste á causa de tu nombradía, y derramaste tus fornicaciones á cuantos pasaron; suya eras.

verses.KJV: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
verses.WEB: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.
verses.ASV: And thou didst take of thy garments, and madest for thee high places decked with divers colors, and playedst the harlot upon them: [the like things] shall not come, neither shall it be [so].
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaste de teus vestidos, fizeste altares de diversas cores, e te prostituíste sobre eles: coisa semelhante não virá, nem será assim.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaste de tus vestidos, é hicístete diversos altos lugares, y fornicaste en ellos: cosa semejante no vendrá, ni será así.

verses.KJV: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
verses.WEB: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.
verses.ASV: Thou didst also take thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest for thee images of men, and didst play the harlot with them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Tomaste também os vasos de teu ornamento, que eu te dei de meu ouro e de minha prata, e fizeste para ti imagens de homens, e te prostituíste com elas.
verses.RVR09: Tomaste asimismo los vasos de tu hermosura de mi oro y de mi plata, que yo te había dado, é hicístete imágenes de hombre, y fornicaste con ellas.

verses.KJV: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
verses.WEB: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.
verses.ASV: and thou tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them, and didst set mine oil and mine incense before them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomaste teus vestidos bordados, e as cobriste; e puseste meu óleo e meu perfume diante delas.
verses.RVR09: Y tomaste tus vestidos de diversos colores, y cubrístelas; y mi aceite y mi perfume pusiste delante de ellas.

verses.KJV: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: My bread also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou didst even set it before them for a sweet savor; and [thus] it was, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o meu pão também que eu te dei, a farinha fina, o azeite, e o mel, com que eu te sustentava, puseste diante delas, como cheiro suave; e assim foi, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Mi pan también, que yo te había dado, la flor de la harina, y el aceite, y la miel, con que yo te mantuve, pusiste delante de ellas para olor suave; y fué así, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
verses.WEB: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,
verses.ASV: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Were thy whoredoms a small matter,
verses.ALMEIDA: Além disto, tomaste teus filhos e tuas filhas, que havias gerado para mim, e os sacrificaste a elas para que fossem consumidas. Por acaso são poucas as tuas prostituições?
verses.RVR09: Demás de esto, tomaste tus hijos y tus hijas que me habías engendrado, y los sacrificaste á ellas para consumación. ¿Es poco, esto de tus fornicaciones?

verses.KJV: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
verses.WEB: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?
verses.ASV: that thou hast slain my children, and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through [the fire] unto them?
verses.ALMEIDA: E mataste meus filhos, e os entregastes a elas para que passassem pelo [fogo] .
verses.RVR09: Y sacrificaste mis hijos, y dístelos á ellas para que los hiciesen pasar por el fuego.

verses.KJV: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
