verses.WEB: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.
verses.ASV: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast weltering in thy blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: E em todas as tuas abominações e tuas prostituições, não te lembraste dos dias de tua juventude, quando estavas nua e descoberta, quando estavas suja em teu sangue.
verses.RVR09: Y con todas tus abominaciones y tus fornicaciones no te has acordado de los días de tu mocedad, cuando estabas desnuda y descubierta, cuando estabas envuelta en tu sangre.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord God;)
verses.WEB: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord GOD—
verses.ASV: And it is come to pass after all thy wickedness (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord Jehovah),
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu que, depois de toda tua maldade (Ai, ai de ti! diz o Senhor DEUS),
verses.RVR09: Y fué que después de toda tu maldad (¡ay, ay de ti! dice el Señor Jehová,)

verses.KJV: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
verses.WEB: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.
verses.ASV: that thou hast built unto thee a vaulted place, and hast made thee a lofty place in every street.
verses.ALMEIDA: Edificaste para ti uma câmara, e fizeste para ti altares em todas as ruas:
verses.RVR09: Edificástete alto, y te hiciste altar en todas las plazas:

verses.KJV: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
verses.WEB: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
verses.ASV: Thou hast built thy lofty place at the head of every way, and hast made thy beauty an abomination, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredom.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em cada canto de caminho edificaste teu altar, fizeste abominável tua formosura, e abriste tuas pernas a todo que passava; e [assim] multiplicaste tuas prostituições.
verses.RVR09: En toda cabeza de camino edificaste tu altar, y tornaste abominable tu hermosura, y abriste tus piernas á cuantos pasaban, y multiplicaste tus fornicaciones.

verses.KJV: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
verses.WEB: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.
verses.ASV: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians, thy neighbors, great of flesh; and hast multiplied thy whoredom, to provoke me to anger.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te prostituíste com os filhos do Egito, teus vizinhos, grandemente promíscuos; e multiplicaste tuas prostituições, para me provocar à ira.
verses.RVR09: Y fornicaste con los hijos de Egipto, tus vecinos, de grandes carnes; y aumentaste tus fornicaciones para enojarme.

verses.KJV: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
verses.WEB: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.
verses.ASV: Behold therefore, I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary [food], and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, that are ashamed of thy lewd way.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eis que estendi minha mão sobre ti, e diminuí tua provisão; e te entreguei à vontade das que te odeiam, as filhas dos filisteus, as quais se envergonhavam de teu caminho pecaminoso.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí que yo extendí sobre ti mi mano, y disminuí tu provisión ordinaria, y te entregué á la voluntad de las hijas de los Filisteos que te aborrecen, las cuales se avergüenzan de tu camino deshonesto.

verses.KJV: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
verses.WEB: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.
verses.ASV: Thou hast played the harlot also with the Assyrians, because thou wast insatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet thou wast not satisfied.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também te prostituíste com os filhos da Assíria, por seres insaciável; e te prostituindo com eles, nem ainda te fartaste.
verses.RVR09: Fornicaste también con los hijos de Assur por no haberte hartado; y fornicaste con ellos, y tampoco te hartaste.

verses.KJV: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied therewith.
verses.WEB: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.
verses.ASV: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy whoredom unto the land of traffic, unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ao invés disso multiplicaste tuas prostituições na terra de Canaã até a Caldeia; e nem ainda com isso com isto te fartaste.
verses.RVR09: Multiplicaste asimismo tu fornicación en la tierra de Canaán y de los Caldeos: ni tampoco con esto te hartaste.

verses.KJV: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord God, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
verses.WEB: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord GOD, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;
verses.ASV: How weak is thy heart, saith the Lord Jehovah, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an impudent harlot;
verses.ALMEIDA: Como está fraco o teu coração, diz o Senhor DEUS, tendo tu feito todas estas coisas, obras de uma poderosa prostituta,
verses.RVR09: ¡Cuán inconstante es tu corazón, dice el Señor Jehová, habiendo hecho todas estas cosas, obras de una poderosa ramera,

verses.KJV: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;
verses.WEB: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.
verses.ASV: in that thou buildest thy vaulted place at the head of every way, and makest thy lofty place in every street, and hast not been as a harlot, in that thou scornest hire.
verses.ALMEIDA: Edificando tu tuas câmaras ao canto de cada caminho, e fazendo teus altares em cada rua; e nem sequer foste como a prostituta, [pois] desprezaste o pagamento,
verses.RVR09: Edificando tus altares en cabeza de todo camino, y haciendo tus altares en todas las plazas! Y no fuiste semejante á ramera, menospreciando el salario,

verses.KJV: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
verses.WEB: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!
verses.ASV: A wife that committeth adultery! that taketh strangers instead of her husband!
verses.ALMEIDA: [Mas foste] como uma mulher adúltera, que em lugar de seu marido recebe a estranhos.
verses.RVR09: Sino como mujer adúltera, por cuanto que en lugar de su marido recibe á ajenos.

verses.KJV: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
verses.WEB: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.
verses.ASV: They give gifts to all harlots; but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and bribest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredoms.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as prostitutas são pagas; mas tu deste teus pagamentos a todos os teus amantes; e lhes deste presentes, para que viessem a ti dos lugares ao redor, por causa de tuas prostituições.
verses.RVR09: A todas las rameras dan dones; mas tú diste tus dones á todos tus enamorados; y les diste presentes, porque entrasen á ti de todas partes por tus fornicaciones.

verses.KJV: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
verses.WEB: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’
verses.ASV: And thou art different from [other] women in thy whoredoms, in that none followeth thee to play the harlot; and whereas thou givest hire, and no hire is given unto thee, therefore thou art different.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim acontece contigo o contrário das mulheres que se prostituem, porque ninguém te buscou para prostituir; pois quando pagas ao invés de receber pagamento, tu tens sido o contrário [das outras] .
verses.RVR09: Y ha sido en ti al contrario de las mujeres en tus fornicaciones, ni nunca después de ti será así fornicado; porque en dar tú dones, y no ser dados dones á ti, ha sido al contrario.

verses.KJV: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.WEB: “Therefore, prostitute, hear the LORD’s word:
verses.ASV: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of Jehovah:
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, ó prostituta, ouve a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, ramera, oye palabra de Jehová:

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
verses.WEB: ‘The Lord GOD says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness uncovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers; and because of all the idols of thy abominations, and for the blood of thy children, that thou didst give unto them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Visto que se derramou teu dinheiro, e tuas vergonhas foram descobertas por tuas prostituições com teus amantes, como também com todos os ídolos de tuas abominações, e no sangue de teus filhos, os quais lhes deste;
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto han sido descubiertas tus vergüenzas, y tu confusión ha sido manifestada á tus enamorados en tus fornicaciones, y á los ídolos de tus abominaciones, y en la sangre de tus hijos, los cuales les diste;

verses.KJV: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.WEB: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
verses.ASV: therefore behold, I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them against thee on every side, and will uncover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eis que ajuntarei todos os teus amantes com os quais tiveste prazer, e também todos os que amaste, com todos quantos tu odiaste; e os ajuntarei contra ti ao redor, e descobrirei tua nudez diante deles, para que vejam toda a tua nudez.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí que yo junto todos tus enamorados con los cuales tomaste placer, y todos los que amaste, con todos los que aborreciste; y reunirélos contra ti alrededor, y descubriréles tu vergüenza, y verán toda tu torpeza.

verses.KJV: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
verses.WEB: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
verses.ASV: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring upon thee the blood of wrath and jealousy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu te julgarei pelas leis das adúlteras, e das que derramam sangue; e te entregarei ao sangue do furor e do ciúme.
verses.RVR09: Y yo te juzgaré por las leyes de las adúlteras, y de las que derraman sangre; y te daré en sangre de ira y de celo.

verses.KJV: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
verses.WEB: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.
verses.ASV: I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thy vaulted place, and break down thy lofty places; and they shall strip thee of thy clothes, and take thy fair jewels; and they shall leave thee naked and bare.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te entregarei na mão deles; e eles destruirão tua câmara, derrubarão teus altares, e te despirão de teus vestidos; e tomarão as joias de teu ornamento, e te deixarão nua e descoberta.
verses.RVR09: Y te entregaré en mano de ellos: y destruirán tu alto, y derribarán tus altares, y te harán desnudar de tus ropas, y se llevarán los vasos de tu gloria, y te dejarán desnuda y descubierta.

verses.KJV: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.WEB: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.
verses.ASV: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então farão subir contra ti uma multidão, e te apedrejarão com pedras, e te atravessarão com suas espadas.
verses.RVR09: Y harán subir contra ti reunión de gente, y te apedrearán con piedras, y te atravesarán con sus espadas.

verses.KJV: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
verses.WEB: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.
verses.ASV: And they shall burn thy houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women; and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou shalt also give no hire any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E queimarão tuas casas a fogo, e executarão julgamentos contra ti, diante dos olhos de muitas mulheres; e te farei cessar de ser prostituta, nem darás mais pagamento.
verses.RVR09: Y quemarán tus casas á fuego, y harán en ti juicios á ojos de muchas mujeres; y hacerte he cesar de ser ramera, ni tampoco darás más don.

verses.KJV: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.WEB: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.
verses.ASV: So will I cause my wrath toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim farei descansar meu furor sobre ti, meu ciúme se afastará de ti; eu me aquietarei, e não mais me indignarei.
verses.RVR09: Y haré reposar mi ira sobre ti, y apartaráse de ti mi celo, y descansaré de más enojarme.

verses.KJV: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord God: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
verses.WEB: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord GOD: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.
verses.ASV: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring thy way upon thy head, saith the Lord Jehovah: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness with all thine abominations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não te lembraste dos dias de tua juventude, e me provocaste à ira com tudo isto, por isso eis que também eu tornarei o teu caminho sobre [tua] cabeça, diz o Senhor DEUS; por acaso não cometeste tu tal promiscuidade além de todas as tuas abominações?
verses.RVR09: Por cuanto no te acordaste de los días de tu mocedad, y me provocaste á ira en todo esto, por eso, he aquí yo también he tornado tu camino sobre tu cabeza, dice el Señor Jehová; pues ni aun has pensado sobre todas tus abominaciones.

verses.KJV: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
verses.WEB: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
verses.ASV: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use [this] proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que todo aquele que usa de provérbios fará provérbio sobre ti, dizendo: Tal mãe, tal filha.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que todo proverbista hará de ti proverbio, diciendo: Como la madre, tal su hija.

verses.KJV: Thou art thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.WEB: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.ASV: Thou art the daughter of thy mother, that loatheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children: your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu és filha de tua mãe, que tinha nojo de seu marido e de seus filhos; e tu és irmã de tuas irmãs, que tinham nojo de seus maridos e de seus filhos; vossa mãe foi Heteia, e vosso pai amorreu.
verses.RVR09: Hija de tu madre eres tú, que desechó á su marido y á sus hijos; y hermana de tus hermanas eres tú, que desecharon á sus maridos y á sus hijos: vuestra madre fué Hethea, y vuestro padre Amorrheo.

verses.KJV: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.WEB: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.
verses.ASV: And thine elder sister is Samaria, that dwelleth at thy left hand, she and her daughters; and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tua irmã maior é Samaria, ela e suas filhas, a qual habita à tua esquerda; e tua irmã menor que tu é Sodoma com suas filhas, a qual habita à tua direita.
verses.RVR09: Y tu hermana mayor es Samaria con su hijas, la cual habita á tu mano izquierda; y tu hermana la menor que tú es Sodoma con sus hijas, la cual habita á tu mano derecha.

verses.KJV: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
verses.WEB: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.
verses.ASV: Yet hast thou not walked in their ways, nor done after their abominations; but, as [if that were] a very little [thing], thou wast more corrupt than they in all thy ways.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém não andaste em seus caminhos, nem fizeste conforme suas abominações; mas em vez disso, como se fosse muito pouco, tu te corrompeste ainda mais que elas em todos os teus caminhos.
verses.RVR09: Y aun no anduviste en sus caminos, ni hiciste según sus abominaciones; antes, como si esto fuera poco y muy poco, te corrompiste más que ellas en todos tus caminos.

verses.KJV: As I live, saith the Lord God, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.WEB: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
verses.ASV: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que tua irmã Sodoma e suas filhas não fizeram tanto como fizeste tu e tuas filhas.
verses.RVR09: Vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, Sodoma tu hermana, con sus hijas, no ha hecho como hiciste tú y tus hijas.

verses.KJV: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.WEB: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.ASV: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom: pride, fulness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que esta foi a maldade de tua irmã Sodoma: ela e suas filhas tiveram soberba, fartura de pão, e abundância de conforto; porém nunca ajudaram a mão do pobre e do necessitado.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que esta fué la maldad de Sodoma tu hermana: soberbia, hartura de pan, y abundancia de ociosidad tuvo ella y sus hijas; y no corroboró la mano del afligido y del menesteroso.

verses.KJV: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
verses.WEB: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
verses.ASV: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw [good].
verses.ALMEIDA: E se tornaram arrogantes, e fizeram abominação diante de mim, por isso eu as tirei quando vi [isto] .
verses.RVR09: Y ensoberbeciéronse, é hicieron abominación delante de mí, y quitélas como vi bueno.

verses.KJV: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.WEB: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.
verses.ASV: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters by all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também Samaria não cometeu sequer a metade de teus pecados; e tu multiplicaste tuas abominações mais que elas, e fizeste tuas irmãs parecerem justas em comparação a todas as tuas abominações que fizeste.
verses.RVR09: Y Samaria no cometió ni la mitad de tus pecados; porque tú multiplicaste tus abominaciones más que ellas, y has justificado á tus hermanas con todas tus abominaciones que hiciste.

verses.KJV: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.WEB: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
verses.ASV: Thou also, bear thou thine own shame, in that thou hast given judgment for thy sisters; through thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou also confounded, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu também, leva tua vergonha, tu que julgaste em favor de tuas irmãs por meio de teus pecados, que fizeste mais abomináveis que elas; mais justas são que tu; envergonha-te, pois, tu também, e leva tua vergonha, pois justificaste a tuas irmãs.
verses.RVR09: Tú también, que juzgaste á tus hermanas, lleva tu vergüenza en tus pecados que hiciste más abominables que ellas: más justas son que tú: avergüénzate pues tú también, y lleva tu confusión, pues que has justificado á tus hermanas.

verses.KJV: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
verses.WEB: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;
verses.ASV: And I will turn again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, pois, os restaurarei de seu infortúnio, os cativos de Sodoma e de suas filhas, e os cativos de Samaria e de suas filhas, e os cativos do teu cativeiro entre elas,
verses.RVR09: Yo pues haré tornar sus cautivos, los cautivos de Sodoma y de sus hijas, y los cautivos de Samaria y de sus hijas, y los cautivos de tus cautiverios entre ellas,

verses.KJV: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.WEB: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.
verses.ASV: that thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be ashamed because of all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que leves tua vergonha, e sejas envergonhada por tudo que fizeste, dando-lhes tu consolo.
verses.RVR09: Para que tú lleves tu confusión, y te avergüences de todo lo que has hecho, siéndoles tú motivo de consuelo.

verses.KJV: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.WEB: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.
verses.ASV: And thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate; and thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto tuas irmãs, Sodoma com suas filhas e Samaria com suas filhas, voltarão ao seu primeiro estado; também tu e tuas filhas voltareis a vosso primeiro estado.
verses.RVR09: Y tus hermanas, Sodoma con sus hijas y Samaria con sus hijas, volverán á su primer estado; tú también y tus hijas volveréis á vuestro primer estado.

verses.KJV: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
verses.WEB: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
verses.ASV: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não foi tua irmã Sodoma mencionada em tua boca no tempo de tuas soberbas,
verses.RVR09: Sodoma, tu hermana, no fué nombrada en tu boca en el tiempo de tus soberbias,

verses.KJV: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
verses.WEB: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.
verses.ASV: before thy wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, that do despite unto thee round about.
verses.ALMEIDA: Antes que tua maldade fosse descoberta? Semelhantemente [agora é teu] tempo de humilhação pelas filhas de Síria e de todos que estavam ao redor dela, e as filhas dos filisteus ao redor, que te desprezam.
verses.RVR09: Antes que tu maldad se descubriese, como en el tiempo de la vergüenza de las hijas de Siria y de todas las hijas de los Filisteos alrededor, que te menosprecian en contorno.

verses.KJV: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the Lord.
verses.WEB: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says the LORD.
verses.ASV: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tu levarás [a punição por] tua perversidade e tuas abominações, diz o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Tú has llevado tu enormidad y tus abominaciones, dice Jehová.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.WEB: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also deal with thee as thou hast done, who hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu farei contigo conforme tu fizeste, que desprezaste o juramento, quebrando o pacto.
verses.RVR09: Empero así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¿Haré yo contigo como tú hiciste, que menospreciaste el juramento para invalidar el pacto?

verses.KJV: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo eu me lembrarei do meu pacto contigo nos dias de tua juventude, e estabelecerei contigo um pacto eterno.
verses.RVR09: Antes yo tendré memoria de mi pacto que concerté contigo en los días de tu mocedad, y te confirmaré un pacto sempiterno.

verses.KJV: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
verses.WEB: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
verses.ASV: Then shalt thou remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder [sisters] and thy younger; and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então te lembrarás de teus caminhos, e te envergonharás, quando receberes a tuas irmãs maiores que tu com as menores que tu, pois eu as darei a ti por filhas, porém não por teu pacto.
verses.RVR09: Y acordarte has de tus caminos y te avergonzarás, cuando recibirás á tus hermanas, las mayores que tú con las menores que tú, las cuales yo te daré por hijas, mas no por tu pacto.

verses.KJV: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord:
verses.WEB: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am the LORD;
verses.ASV: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah;
verses.ALMEIDA: E estabelecerei meu pacto contigo, e saberás que eu sou o SENHOR;
verses.RVR09: Y confirmaré mi pacto contigo, y sabrás que yo soy Jehová;

verses.KJV: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: that thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more, because of thy shame, when I have forgiven thee all that thou hast done, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que te lembres [disso] , e te envergonhes, e nunca mais abras a boca por causa de tua vergonha, quando eu me reconciliar contigo de tudo quanto fizeste, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Para que te acuerdes, y te avergüences, y nunca más abras la boca á causa de tu vergüenza, cuando me aplacare para contigo de todo lo que hiciste, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
verses.WEB: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;
verses.ASV: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, propõe um enigma, e fala uma parábola à casa de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, propón una figura, y compón una parábola á la casa de Israel.

verses.KJV: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
verses.WEB: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.
verses.ASV: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A great eagle with great wings and long pinions, full of feathers, which had divers colors, came unto Lebanon, and took the top of the cedar:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Uma grande águia, de grandes asas e de comprida plumagem, cheia de penas de várias cores, veio ao Líbano, e tomou o mais alto ramo de um cedro.
verses.RVR09: Y dirás: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Una grande águila, de grandes alas y de largos miembros, llena de plumas de diversos colores, vino al Líbano, y tomó el cogollo del cedro:

verses.KJV: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
verses.WEB: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.
verses.ASV: he cropped off the topmost of the young twigs thereof, and carried it unto a land of traffic; he set it in a city of merchants.
verses.ALMEIDA: Arrancou o topo de seus renovos, e o trouxe à terra de comércio; na cidade de mercadores ela o pôs.
verses.RVR09: Arrancó el principal de sus renuevos, y llevólo á la tierra de mercaderes, y púsolo en la ciudad de los negociantes.

verses.KJV: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.
verses.WEB: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.
verses.ASV: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful soil; he placed it beside many waters; he set it as a willow-tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou da semente da terra, e a lançou em um campo fértil; tomando-a, plantou-a junto a grandes águas, como [se fosse] um salgueiro.
verses.RVR09: Tomó también de la simiente de la tierra, y púsola en un campo bueno para sembrar, plantóla junto á grandes aguas, púsola como un sauce.

verses.KJV: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
verses.WEB: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.
verses.ASV: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
verses.ALMEIDA: E brotou, e tornou-se uma videira larga, [porém] de baixa estatura; seus ramos olhavam para ela, e suas raízes estavam debaixo dela; e tornou-se uma videira, que produzia ramos e brotava renovos.
verses.RVR09: Y brotó, é hízose una vid de mucha rama, baja de estatura, que sus ramas la miraban, y sus raíces estaban debajo de ella: así que se hizo una vid, y arrojó sarmientos, y echó mugrones.

verses.KJV: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
verses.WEB: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.
verses.ASV: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend its roots toward him, and shot forth its branches toward him, from the beds of its plantation, that he might water it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E houve outra grande águia, de grandes asas e cheia de penas; e eis que esta videira juntou suas raízes para perto dela, e estendeu seus ramos para ela desde o lugar onde estava plantada, para que fosse regada.
verses.RVR09: Y fué otra grande águila, de grandes alas y de muchas plumas; y he aquí que esta vid juntó cerca de ella sus raíces, y extendió hacia ella sus ramos, para ser regada por ella por los surcos de su plantío.

verses.KJV: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
verses.WEB: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’
verses.ASV: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em uma boa terra, junto a muitas águas ela estava plantada, para produzir ramos e dar fruto, para que fosse uma videira excelente.
verses.RVR09: En un buen campo, junto á muchas aguas fué plantada, para que hiciese ramos y llevase fruto, y para que fuese vid robusta.

verses.KJV: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord God; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
verses.WEB: “Say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.
verses.ASV: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it may wither; that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? and not by a strong arm or much people can it be raised from the roots thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Por acaso [a videira] terá sucesso? Não arrancará [a águia] suas raízes, e cortará seu fruto, e se secará? Todas as folhas que dela brotavam se secarão; e nem [é necessário] um braço grande, nem muita gente, para a arrancar desde suas raízes.
verses.RVR09: Di: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¿Será prosperada? ¿No arrancará sus raíces, y destruirá su fruto, y secaráse? Todas las hojas de su lozanía secará, y no con gran brazo, ni con mucha gente, arrancándola de sus raíces.

verses.KJV: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
verses.WEB: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”
verses.ASV: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the beds where it grew.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas eis que, [mesmo] estando plantada, terá ela sucesso? Por acaso, quando o vento oriental a tocar, ela não se secará por completo? Nos canteiros de seus renovos se secará.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí que plantada está ella, ¿será prosperada? ¿No se secará del todo cuando el viento solano la tocare? En los surcos de su verdor se secará.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
verses.WEB: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.
verses.ASV: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and brought them to him to Babylon.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize agora à casa rebelde: Por acaso não sabeis o que significam estas coisas? Dize-lhes: Eis que o rei da Babilônia veio a Jerusalém, tomou o teu rei e seus príncipes, e os levou consigo à Babilônia.
verses.RVR09: Di ahora á la casa rebelde: ¿No habéis entendido qué significan estas cosas? Diles: He aquí que el rey de Babilonia vino á Jerusalem, y tomó tu rey y sus príncipes, y llevólos consigo á Babilonia.

verses.KJV: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:
verses.WEB: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,
verses.ASV: And he took of the seed royal, and made a covenant with him; he also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tomou [um] da família real, fez pacto com ele, fazendo-lhe prestar juramento; e tomou os poderosos da terra [consigo] ,
verses.RVR09: Tomó también de la simiente del reino, é hizo con él alianza, y trájole á juramento; y tomó los fuertes de la tierra,

verses.KJV: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
verses.WEB: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
verses.ASV: that the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que o reino ficasse humilhado, e não se levantasse; mas podendo continuar a existir se guardasse seu pacto.
verses.RVR09: Para que el reino fuese abatido y no se levantase, sino que guardase su alianza y estuviese en ella.

verses.KJV: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
verses.WEB: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?
verses.ASV: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? shall he break the covenant, and yet escape?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém rebelou-se contra ele, enviando seus mensageiros ao Egito, para que lhe dessem cavalos e muita gente. Por acaso terá sucesso, ou escapará aquele que faz tais coisas? Poderá quebrar o pacto, e [ainda assim] escapar?
verses.RVR09: Rebelóse empero contra él enviando sus embajadores á Egipto, para que le diese caballos y mucha gente. ¿Será prosperado, escapará, el que estas cosas hizo? ¿y el que rompió la alianza, podrá huir?

verses.KJV: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.WEB: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.
verses.ASV: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que morrerá em meio da Babilônia, no lugar do rei que o fez reinar, cujo juramento desprezou, e cujo pacto quebrou.
verses.RVR09: Vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, que morirá en medio de Babilonia, en el lugar del rey que le hizo reinar, cuyo juramento menospreció, y cuya alianza con él hecha rompió.

verses.KJV: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
verses.WEB: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.
verses.ASV: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts, to cut off many persons.
verses.ALMEIDA: E Faraó não lhe fará coisa alguma nem com grande exército, nem com muita multidão na batalha, quando levantarem cerco e edificarem fortificações para destruírem muitas vidas.
verses.RVR09: Y no con grande ejército, ni con mucha compañía hará con él Faraón en la batalla, cuando funden baluarte y edifiquen bastiones para cortar muchas vidas.

verses.KJV: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
verses.WEB: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.
verses.ASV: For he hath despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet hath done all these things; he shall not escape.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque desprezou o juramento, quebrando o pacto; e eis que havia firmado compromisso; havendo pois feito todas todas estas coisas, não escapará.
verses.RVR09: Pues menospreció el juramento, para invalidar el concierto cuando he aquí que había dado su mano, é hizo todas estas cosas, no escapará.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
verses.WEB: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, I will even bring it upon his own head.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Vivo eu, que meu juramento que ele desprezou, e meu pacto que ele quebrou, isto retribuirei sobre sua cabeça.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Vivo yo, que el juramento mío que menospreció, y mi concierto que ha invalidado, tornaré sobre su cabeza.

verses.KJV: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
verses.WEB: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.
verses.ASV: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E estenderei sobre ele minha rede, e ficará preso em minha malha; e eu o levarei à Babilônia, e ali entrarei em juízo contra ele, por sua rebeldia com que se rebelou contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Y extenderé sobre él mi red, y será preso en mi malla; y hacerlo he venir á Babilonia, y allí estaré á juicio con él, por su prevaricación con que contra mí se ha rebelado.

verses.KJV: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the Lord have spoken it.
verses.WEB: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it.’
verses.ASV: And all his fugitives in all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward every wind: and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos os seus fugitivos com todas as suas tropas cairão à espada, e os que restarem serão dispersos a todos os ventos; e sabereis que fui eu, o SENHOR, que falei.
verses.RVR09: Y todos sus fugitivos con todos sus escuadrones caerán á cuchillo, y los que quedaren serán esparcidos á todo viento; y sabréis que yo Jehová he hablado.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
verses.WEB: “The Lord GOD says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also take of the lofty top of the cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it upon a high and lofty mountain:
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Também eu tomarei do topo daquele alto cedro, e o plantarei; do mais alto de seus renovos cortarei o [mais] tenro, e eu o plantarei sobre um monte alto e sublime;
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Y tomaré yo del cogollo de aquel alto cedro, y pondrélo; del principal de sus renuevos cortaré un tallo, y plantarlo he yo sobre el monte alto y sublime;

verses.KJV: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
verses.WEB: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.
verses.ASV: in the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it; and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all birds of every wing; in the shade of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
verses.ALMEIDA: No monte alto de Israel o plantarei, e produzirá ramos, dará fruto, e se tronará um cedro excelente; e habitarão debaixo dele todas as aves, todos os que voam; e na sombra de seus ramos habitarão.
verses.RVR09: En el monte alto de Israel lo plantaré, y alzará ramos, y llevará fruto, y haráse magnífico cedro; y habitarán debajo de él todas las aves, toda cosa que vuela habitará á la sombra de sus ramos.

verses.KJV: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the Lord have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the Lord have spoken and have done it.
verses.WEB: All the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, the LORD, have spoken and have done it.’”
verses.ASV: And all the trees of the field shall know that I, Jehovah, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I, Jehovah, have spoken and have done it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim todas os árvores do campo saberão que eu, o SENHOR, rebaixei a árvore alta, levantei a árvore baixa, sequei a árvore verde, e tornei verde a árvore seca. Eu, o SENHOR, falei, e farei.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrán todos los árboles del campo que yo Jehová abatí el árbol sublime, levanté el árbol bajo, hice secar el árbol verde, é hice reverdecer el árbol seco. Yo Jehová hablé é hice.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
verses.WEB: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
verses.ASV: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?
verses.ALMEIDA: O que vós pensais, vós que dizeis este provérbio sobre a terra de Israel, dizendo: Os pais comeram uvas verdes, mas foram os dentes dos filhos que se estragaram?
verses.RVR09: ¿Qué pensáis vosotros, vosotros que usáis este refrán sobre la tierra de Israel, diciendo: Los padres comieron el agraz, y los dientes de los hijos tienen la dentera?

verses.KJV: As I live, saith the Lord God, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
verses.WEB: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.
verses.ASV: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, ye shall not have [occasion] any more to use this proverb in Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivo eu,diz o Senhor DEUS, que nunca mais direis este provérbio em Israel.
verses.RVR09: Vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, que nunca más tendréis por qué usar este refrán en Israel.

verses.KJV: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
verses.WEB: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.
verses.ASV: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que todas as almas são minhas; tanto a alma do pai como alma do filho são minhas; a alma que pecar, essa morrerá.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que todas las almas son mías; como el alma del padre, así el alma del hijo es mía; el alma que pecare, esa morirá.

verses.KJV: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
verses.WEB: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,
verses.ASV: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
verses.ALMEIDA: Se um homem for justo, e fizer juízo e justiça;
verses.RVR09: Y el hombre que fuere justo, é hiciere juicio y justicia;

verses.KJV: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
verses.WEB: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,
verses.ASV: and hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbor’s wife, neither hath come near to a woman in her impurity,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não comer sobre os montes, nem levantar seus olhos para os ídolos da casa de Israel, nem contaminar a mulher de seu próximo, nem se achegar à mulher menstruada,
verses.RVR09: Que no comiere sobre los montes, ni alzare sus ojos á los ídolos de la casa de Israel, ni violare la mujer de su prójimo, ni llegare á la mujer menstruosa,

verses.KJV: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
verses.WEB: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
verses.ASV: and hath not wronged any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath taken nought by robbery, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
verses.ALMEIDA: E a ninguém oprimir; devolver ao devedor o seu penhor, não cometer roubo, der de seu pão ao faminto, e cobrir com roupa ao nu;
verses.RVR09: Ni oprimiere á ninguno; al deudor tornare su prenda, no cometiere robo, diere de su pan al hambriento, y cubriere al desnudo con vestido,

verses.KJV: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
verses.WEB: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,
verses.ASV: he that hath not given forth upon interest, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true justice between man and man,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não emprestar a juros, nem receber lucros; e desviar sua mão da injustiça, e fizer juízo entre dois homens com base na verdade;
verses.RVR09: No diere á logro, ni recibiere aumento; de la maldad retrajere su mano, é hiciere juicio de verdad entre hombre y hombre,

verses.KJV: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept mine ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E andar em meus estatutos, e guardar meus juízos, para agir com base na verdade, este justo certamente viverá,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: En mis ordenanzas caminare, y guardare mis derechos para hacer verdad, éste es justo: éste vivirá, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,
verses.WEB: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,
verses.ASV: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth any one of these things,
verses.ALMEIDA: E se ele gerar um filho ladrão, derramador de sangue, que fizer a seu irmão alguma destas coisas;
verses.RVR09: Mas si engendrare hijo ladrón, derramador de sangre, ó que haga alguna cosa de éstas,

verses.KJV: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,
verses.WEB: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,
verses.ASV: and that doeth not any of those [duties], but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbor’s wife,
verses.ALMEIDA: (Ainda que [o pai] não faça tais coisas): como comer sobre os montes, contaminar a mulher de seu próximo,
verses.RVR09: Y que no haga las otras; antes comiere sobre los montes, ó violare la mujer de su prójimo,

verses.KJV: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
verses.WEB: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
verses.ASV: hath wronged the poor and needy, hath taken by robbery, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
verses.ALMEIDA: Oprimir o pobre e o necessitado, cometer roubos, não devolver o penhor, levantar seus olhos para os ídolos, praticar abominação,
verses.RVR09: Al pobre y menesteroso oprimiere, cometiere robos, no tornare la prenda, ó alzare sus ojos á los ídolos, é hiciere abominación,

verses.KJV: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.WEB: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.
verses.ASV: hath given forth upon interest, and hath taken increase; shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: Emprestar a juros, e receber lucro. Por acaso viveria? Não viverá. Ele fez todas estas abominações; certamente morrerá; o seu sangue será sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: Diere á usura, y recibiere aumento: ¿vivirá éste? No vivirá. Todas estas abominaciones hizo; de cierto morirá; su sangre será sobre él.

verses.KJV: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
verses.WEB: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,
verses.ASV: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins, which he hath done, and feareth, and doeth not such like;
verses.ALMEIDA: E eis que se, [por sua vez] ele gerar um filho, que vir todos os pecados que seu pai fez, e olhar para não fazer conforme a eles,
verses.RVR09: Pero si éste engendrare hijo, el cual viere todos los pecados que su padre hizo, y viéndolos no hiciere según ellos:

verses.KJV: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,
verses.WEB: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,
verses.ASV: that hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbor’s wife,
verses.ALMEIDA: Não comer sobre os montes, nem levantar seus olhos para os ídolos da casa de Israel; nem contaminar a mulher de seu próximo;
verses.RVR09: No comiere sobre los montes, ni alzare sus ojos á los ídolos de la casa de Israel; la mujer de su prójimo no violare,

verses.KJV: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,
verses.WEB: hasn’t wronged any, hasn’t taken anything to pledge, hasn’t taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
verses.ASV: neither hath wronged any, hath not taken aught to pledge, neither hath taken by robbery, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
verses.ALMEIDA: Nem oprimir a ninguém; nem retiver o penhor, nem cometer roubos; der de seu pão ao faminto, e cobrir com roupa ao nu;
verses.RVR09: Ni oprimiere á nadie; la prenda no empeñare, ni cometiere robos; al hambriento diere de su pan, y cubriere de vestido al desnudo;

verses.KJV: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
verses.WEB: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.
verses.ASV: that hath withdrawn his hand from the poor, that hath not received interest nor increase, hath executed mine ordinances, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desviar sua mão de [fazer mal a] o pobre, não receber juros nem lucro; e praticar meus juízos, e andar em meus estatutos, este não morrerá pela maldade de seu pai; certamente viverá.
verses.RVR09: Apartare su mano del pobre, usura ni aumento no recibiere; hiciere mis derechos, y anduviere en mis ordenanzas, éste no morirá por la maldad de su padre; de cierto vivirá.

verses.KJV: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
verses.WEB: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.
verses.ASV: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he shall die in his iniquity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seu pai, dado que fez opressão, roubou os bens do irmão, e fez o que não era bom no meio de seu povo, eis que morrerá por sua maldade.
verses.RVR09: Su padre, por cuanto hizo agravio, despojó violentamente al hermano, é hizo en medio de su pueblo lo que no es bueno, he aquí que él morirá por su maldad.

verses.KJV: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
verses.WEB: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.
verses.ASV: Yet say ye, Wherefore doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém dizeis: Por que o filho não será punido pela maldade do pai? Porque o filho fez juízo e justiça, guardou todas o meus estatutos, e as praticou, certamente viverá.
verses.RVR09: Y si dijereis: ¿Por qué el hijo no llevará por el pecado de su padre? Porque el hijo hizo juicio y justicia, guardó todas mis ordenanzas, y las hizo, de cierto vivirá.

verses.KJV: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
verses.WEB: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.
verses.ASV: The soul that sinneth, it shall die: the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
verses.ALMEIDA: A alma que pecar, essa morrerá; o filho não será punido pela maldade do pai, nem o pai será punido pela maldade do filho; a justiça do justo será sobre ele, e a perversidade do perverso será sobre ele.
verses.RVR09: El alma que pecare, esa morirá: el hijo no llevará por el pecado del padre, ni el padre llevará por el pecado del hijo: la justicia del justo será sobre él, y la impiedad del impío será sobre él.

verses.KJV: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.WEB: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
verses.ASV: But if the wicked turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se o perverso se converter de todos os seus pecados que cometeu, e [passar a] guardar todos os meus estatutos, e fizer juízo e justiça, certamente viverá; não morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Mas el impío, si se apartare de todos sus pecados que hizo, y guardare todas mis ordenanzas, é hiciere juicio y justicia, de cierto vivirá; no morirá.

verses.KJV: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
verses.WEB: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
verses.ASV: None of his transgressions that he hath committed shall be remembered against him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Todas as suas transgressões que cometeu não lhe serão lembradas; por sua justiça que praticou, viverá.
verses.RVR09: Todas sus rebeliones que cometió, no le serán recordadas: en su justicia que hizo vivirá.

verses.KJV: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord God: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
verses.WEB: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
verses.ASV: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked? saith the Lord Jehovah; and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso eu prefiro a morte do ímpio?,diz o Senhor DEUS, E não que ele se converta de seus caminhos, e viva?
verses.RVR09: ¿Quiero yo la muerte del impío? dice el Señor Jehová. ¿No vivirá, si se apartare de sus caminos?

verses.KJV: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
verses.WEB: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.
verses.ASV: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? None of his righteous deeds that he hath done shall be remembered: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas se o justo se desviar de sua justiça, e [passar a] praticar maldade, e fizer conforme a todas as abominações que o perverso faz, por acaso ele viveria? Todas as suas justiças que praticou não serão lembradas; por sua transgressão com que transgrediu, e por seu pecado com que pecou, por causa deles morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Mas si el justo se apartare de su justicia, y cometiere maldad, é hiciere conforme á todas las abominaciones que el impío hizo, ¿vivirá él? Todas las justicias que hizo no vendrán en memoria; por su rebelión con que prevaricó, y por su pecado que cometió, por ello morirá.

verses.KJV: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.WEB: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?
verses.ASV: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel: Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém dizeis: O caminho do Senhor não é justo. Ouvi agora, ó casa de Israel: por acaso o meu caminho não é justo? [Ou] não são os vossos caminhos que são injustos?
verses.RVR09: Y si dijereis: No es derecho el camino del Señor: oid ahora, casa de Israel: ¿No es derecho mi camino? ¿no son vuestros caminos torcidos?

verses.KJV: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
verses.WEB: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.
verses.ASV: When the righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth therein; in his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Se o justo de desviar de sua justiça, e [passar a] praticar maldade, ele morrerá por ela; pela maldade que cometeu, morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Apartándose el justo de su justicia, y haciendo iniquidad, él morirá por ello: por su iniquidad que hizo, morirá.

verses.KJV: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
verses.WEB: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.
verses.ASV: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém se o perverso se desviar de sua perversidade que cometeu, e [passar a] praticar juízo e justiça, esse conservará sua alma em vida;
verses.RVR09: Y apartándose el impío de su impiedad que hizo, y haciendo juicio y justicia, hará vivir su alma.

verses.KJV: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.WEB: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
verses.ASV: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque observou, e se converteu de todas as suas transgressões que cometera, certamente viverá, não morrerá.
verses.RVR09: Porque miró, y apartóse de todas sus prevaricaciones que hizo, de cierto vivirá, no morirá.

verses.KJV: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.WEB: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?
verses.ASV: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo a casa de Israel diz: O caminho do Senhor não é justo. Por acaso os meus caminhos não são justos, ó casa de Israel? [Ou] não são vossos caminhos que são injustos?
verses.RVR09: Si aun dijere la casa de Israel: No es derecho el camino del Señor: ¿No son derechos mis caminos, casa de Israel? Cierto, vuestros caminos no son derechos.

verses.KJV: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord God. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
verses.WEB: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.
verses.ASV: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord Jehovah. Return ye, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto eu vos julgarei a cada um conforme seus [próprios] caminhos, ó casa de Israel,diz o Senhor DEUS. Convertei-vos e desviai-vos de todas as vossas transgressões; e assim a maldade não será vossa queda.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, yo os juzgaré á cada uno según sus caminos, oh casa de Israel, dice el Señor Jehová. Convertíos, y volveos de todas vuestras iniquidades; y no os será la iniquidad causa de ruina.

verses.KJV: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verses.WEB: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?
verses.ASV: Cast away from you all your transgressions, wherein ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
