verses.ALMEIDA: Lançai fora de vós todas as vossas transgressões com que transgredistes, e fazei para vós um novo coração e um novo espírito. Pois por que tendes que morrer, ó casa de Israel?
verses.RVR09: Echad de vosotros todas vuestras iniquidades con que habéis prevaricado, y haceos corazón nuevo y espíritu nuevo. ¿Y por qué moriréis, casa de Israel?

verses.KJV: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord God: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
verses.WEB: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
verses.ASV: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord Jehovah: wherefore turn yourselves, and live.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque eu não me agrado da morte do que morre,diz o Senhor DEUS; convertei-vos, pois, e vivereis.
verses.RVR09: Que no quiero la muerte del que muere, dice el Señor Jehová; convertíos pues, y viviréis.

verses.KJV: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.WEB: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.ASV: Moreover, take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, levanta uma lamentação sobre os príncipes de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y TÚ levanta endecha sobre los príncipes de Israel.

verses.KJV: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
verses.WEB: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.
verses.ASV: and say, What was thy mother? A lioness: she couched among lions, in the midst of the young lions she nourished her whelps.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize: Quem foi tua mãe? Uma leoa deitada entre os leões; entre os leõezinhos ela criou seus filhotes.
verses.RVR09: Y dirás: ¡Cómo se echó entre los leones tu madre la leona! entre los leoncillos crió sus cachorros.

verses.KJV: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
verses.WEB: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
verses.ASV: And she brought up one of her whelps: he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fez crescer um de seus filhotes, que veio a ser um leãozinho; e ele aprendeu a caçar presa, e a devorar homens.
verses.RVR09: E hizo subir uno de sus cachorros: vino á ser leoncillo, y aprendió á prender presa, y á devorar hombres.

verses.KJV: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks unto the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: E as nações ouviram dele; ele foi preso na cova delas, e o trouxeram com ganchos à terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Y las gentes oyeron de él: fué tomado con el lazo de ellas, y lleváronlo con grillos á la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
verses.WEB: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.
verses.ASV: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quando ela viu que havia esperado [muito] , e que sua esperança era perdida, tomou outro de seus filhotes, e o pôs por leãozinho.
verses.RVR09: Y viendo ella que había esperado mucho tiempo, y que se perdía su esperanza, tomó otro de sus cachorros, y púsolo por leoncillo.

verses.KJV: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
verses.WEB: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
verses.ASV: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele andou entre os leões; tornou-se um leãozinho, aprendeu a caçar presa, e devorou homens.
verses.RVR09: Y él andaba entre los leones; hízose leoncillo, aprendió á hacer presa, devoró hombres.

verses.KJV: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
verses.WEB: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.
verses.ASV: And he knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, because of the noise of his roaring.
verses.ALMEIDA: E conheceu suas viúvas, e destruiu suas cidades; e a terra e tudo que ela continha foram devastadas à voz de seu bramido.
verses.RVR09: Y conoció sus viudas, y asoló sus ciudades; y la tierra fué asolada, y su abundancia, á la voz de su bramido.

verses.KJV: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
verses.WEB: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.
verses.ASV: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces; and they spread their net over him; he was taken in their pit.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então foram contra sobre ele as nações das províncias de seu ao redor; estenderam sobre ele sua rede, e ele foi preso na cova delas.
verses.RVR09: Y dieron sobre él las gentes de las provincias de alrededor, y extendieron sobre él su red; fué preso en su hoyo.

verses.KJV: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.WEB: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.
verses.ASV: And they put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o puseram em cárcere com ganchos, e o levaram ao rei da Babilônia; meteram-no em fortalezas, para que sua voz não fosse mais ouvida nos montes de Israel.
verses.RVR09: Y pusiéronlo en cárcel con cadenas, y lleváronlo al rey de Babilonia; metiéronlo en fortalezas, para que su voz no se oyese más sobre los montes de Israel.

verses.KJV: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.WEB: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.ASV: Thy mother was like a vine, in thy blood, planted by the waters: it was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tua mãe era como uma videira em teu sangue, plantada junto às águas; que frutificava e era cheia de ramos, por causa das muitas águas.
verses.RVR09: Tu madre fué como una vid en tu sangre, plantada junto á las aguas, haciendo fruto y echando vástagos á causa de las muchas aguas.

verses.KJV: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
verses.WEB: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.
verses.ASV: And it had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and their stature was exalted among the thick boughs, and they were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ela tinha varas fortes para cetros de senhores; e sua estatura se levantava por encima entre os ramos; e sua altura podia ser vista com a multidão de seus ramos.
verses.RVR09: Y ella tuvo varas fuertes para cetros de señores; y levantóse su estatura por encima entre las ramas, y fué vista en su altura, y con la multitud de sus sarmientos.

verses.KJV: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
verses.WEB: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered. The fire consumed them.
verses.ASV: But it was plucked up in fury, it was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit: its strong rods were broken off and withered; the fire consumed them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém foi arrancada com furor, derrubada na terra, e vento oriental secou seu fruto; suas fortes varas foram quebradas, e se secaram; o fogo as consumiu.
verses.RVR09: Empero fué arrancada con ira, derribada en tierra, y viento solano secó su fruto; fueron quebradas y secáronse sus varas fuertes; consumiólas el fuego.

verses.KJV: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
verses.WEB: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
verses.ASV: And now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
verses.ALMEIDA: E agora está plantada no deserto, em terra seca e sedenta.
verses.RVR09: Y ahora está plantada en el desierto, en tierra de sequedad y de aridez.

verses.KJV: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
verses.WEB: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”
verses.ASV: And fire is gone out of the rods of its branches, it hath devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
verses.ALMEIDA: E saiu fogo da uma vara de seus ramos, que consumido seu fruto; de modo que nela não há mais vara forte, cetro para senhorear.Esta é a lamentação, e para lamentação servirá.
verses.RVR09: Y ha salido fuego de la vara de sus ramos, ha consumido su fruto, y no ha quedado en ella vara fuerte, cetro para enseñorear. Endecha es esta, y de endecha servirá.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the Lord, and sat before me.
verses.WEB: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], the tenth [day] of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Jehovah, and sat before me.
verses.ALMEIDA: E aconteceu no sétimo ano, no quinto [mês] , aos dez do mês, que vieram alguns dos anciãos de Israel para consultarem ao SENHOR, e se assentaram diante de mim.
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ en el año séptimo, en el mes quinto, á los diez del mes, que vinieron algunos de los ancianos de Israel á consultar á Jehová, y sentáronse delante de mí.

verses.KJV: Then came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.WEB: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’
verses.ASV: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Is it to inquire of me that ye are come? As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, fala aos anciãos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Viestes vós para me consultar? Vivo eu, que eu não deixarei ser consultado por vós, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, habla á los ancianos de Israel, y diles: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¿A consultarme venís vosotros? Vivo yo, que yo no os responderé, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
verses.WEB: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.
verses.ASV: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por acaso tu os julgarias, julgarias tu, ó filho do homem? Notifica-lhes as abominações de seus pais;
verses.RVR09: ¿Quieres tú juzgarlos? ¿los quieres juzgar tú, hijo del hombre? Notifícales las abominaciones de sus padres;

verses.KJV: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the Lord your God;
verses.WEB: Tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am the LORD your God;’
verses.ASV: and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when I chose Israel, and sware unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I sware unto them, saying, I am Jehovah your God;
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: No dia em que escolhi a Israel, fiz juramento para a descendência da casa de Jacó, e me tornei conhecido por eles na terra do Egito, e fiz juramento para eles, dizendo: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus;
verses.RVR09: Y diles: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: El día que escogí á Israel, y que alcé mi mano por la simiente de la casa de Jacob, y que fuí conocido de ellos en la tierra de Egipto, cuando alcé mi mano á ellos, diciendo: Yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios;

verses.KJV: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
verses.WEB: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.
verses.ASV: in that day I sware unto them, to bring them forth out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia eu lhes fiz juramento de que os tiraria da terra do Egito para uma terra que eu já tinha observado para eles, que corre leite e mel, a qual é a mais bela de todas as terras;
verses.RVR09: Aquel día que les alcé mi mano, que los sacaría de la tierra de Egipto á la tierra que les había proveído, que fluye leche y miel, la cual es la más hermosa de todas las tierras;

verses.KJV: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’
verses.ASV: And I said unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu lhes disse: Cada um lance fora as abominações de seus olhos, e não vos contamineis com os ídolos do Egito. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Entonces les dije: Cada uno eche de sí las abominaciones de sus ojos, y no os contaminéis en los ídolos de Egipto. Yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me; they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém eles se rebelaram contra mim, e não quiseram me ouvir; não lançaram fora as abominações de seus olhos, nem deixaram os ídolos do Egito; por isso disse que derramaria meu furor sobre eles, para cumprir meu ira contra eles no meio da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Mas ellos se rebelaron contra mí, y no quisieron obedecerme: no echó de sí cada uno las abominaciones de sus ojos, ni dejaron los ídolos de Egipto; y dije que derramaría mi ira sobre ellos, para cumplir mi enojo en ellos en medio de la tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.WEB: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ASV: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém fiz por favor a meu nome, para que não fosse profanado diante olhos das nações no meio das quais estavam, pelas quais eu fui conhecido diante dos olhos delas, ao tirá-los da terra do Egito.
verses.RVR09: Con todo, á causa de mi nombre, porque no se infamase en los ojos de las gentes en medio de las cuales estaban, en cuyos ojos fuí conocido de ellos, hice para sacarlos de tierra de Egipto.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.WEB: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.ASV: So I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu os tirei da terra do Egito, e os levei ao deserto;
verses.RVR09: Saquélos pues de la tierra de Egipto, y trájelos al desierto;

verses.KJV: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
verses.WEB: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
verses.ASV: And I gave them my statutes, and showed them mine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live in them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E lhes dei meus estatutos, e lhes declarei meus juízos, os quais se o homem os fizer, por eles viverá.
verses.RVR09: Y díles mis ordenanzas, y declaréles mis derechos, los cuales el hombre que los hiciere, vivirá en ellos.

verses.KJV: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the Lord that sanctify them.
verses.WEB: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
verses.ASV: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Jehovah that sanctifieth them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também lhes dei meus sábados para que servissem de sinal entre mim e eles, para que soubessem que eu sou o SENHOR, que os santifico.
verses.RVR09: Y díles también mis sábados, que fuesen por señal entre mí y ellos, para que supiesen que yo soy Jehová que los santifico.

verses.KJV: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.WEB: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.ASV: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they rejected mine ordinances, which if a man keep, he shall live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly profaned. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas a casa de Israel se rebelou contra mim no deserto: não andaram em meus estatutos, rejeitaram meus juízos, os quais se o homem os fizer, por eles viverá; e profanaram grandemente meus sábados. Então eu disse que derramaria meu furor sobre eles no deserto, para os consumir.
verses.RVR09: Mas rebeláronse contra mí la casa de Israel en el desierto; no anduvieron en mis ordenanzas, y desecharon mis derechos, los cuales el hombre que los hiciere, vivirá en ellos; y mis sábados profanaron en gran manera; dije, por tanto, que había de derramar sobre ellos mi ira en el desierto para consumirlos.

verses.KJV: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.WEB: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.ASV: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém fiz por favor a meu nome, para que não fosse profanado diante dos olhos das nações, diante de cujos olhos os tirei.
verses.RVR09: Pero en atención á mi nombre hice porque no se infamase á la vista de las gentes, delante de cuyos ojos los saqué.

verses.KJV: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
verses.WEB: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,
verses.ASV: Moreover also I sware unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
verses.ALMEIDA: Contudo eu lhes jurei no deserto de que não os traria para a terra que havia lhes dado, que corre leite e mel, a qual é a mais bela de todas as terras;
verses.RVR09: Y también yo les alcé mi mano en el desierto, que no los metería en la tierra que les dí, que fluye leche y miel, la cual es la más hermosa de todas las tierras;

verses.KJV: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
verses.WEB: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.
verses.ASV: because they rejected mine ordinances, and walked not in my statutes, and profaned my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque rejeitaram meus juízos, não andaram em meus estatutos, e profanaram meus sábados; porque seus corações seguiam seus ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Porque desecharon mis derechos, y no anduvieron en mis ordenanzas, y mis sábados profanaron: porque tras sus ídolos iba su corazón.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless mine eye spared them, and I destroyed them not, neither did I make a full end of them in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém meu olho os poupou, não os destruindo, nem os consumindo no deserto;
verses.RVR09: Con todo los perdonó mi ojo, no matándolos, ni los consumí en el desierto;

verses.KJV: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
verses.WEB: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
verses.ASV: And I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their ordinances, nor defile yourselves with their idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em vez disso, eu disse a seus filhos no deserto: Não andeis nos estatutos de vossos pais, nem guardeis seus juízos, nem vos contamineis com seus ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Antes dije en el desierto á sus hijos: No andéis en las ordenanzas de vuestros padres, ni guardéis sus leyes, ni os contaminéis en sus ídolos.

verses.KJV: I am the Lord your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
verses.WEB: I am the LORD your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.
verses.ASV: I am Jehovah your God: walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus; andai em meus estatutos, guardai meus juízos, e os praticai;
verses.RVR09: Yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios; andad en mis ordenanzas, y guardad mis derechos, y ponedlos por obra:

verses.KJV: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.WEB: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’
verses.ASV: and hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am Jehovah your God.
verses.ALMEIDA: E santificai meus sábados, e sirvam de sinal entre mim e vós, para que saibais que eu sou o SENHOR, vosso Deus.
verses.RVR09: Y santificad mis sábados, y sean por señal entre mí y vosotros, para que sepáis que yo soy Jehová vuestro Dios.

verses.KJV: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.WEB: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.ASV: But the children rebelled against me; they walked not in my statutes, neither kept mine ordinances to do them, which if a man do, he shall live in them; they profaned my sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mas os filhos se rebelaram contra mim; não andaram em meus estatutos, nem guardaram meus juízos fazê-los, os quais se o homem os cumprir, por eles viverá; [e] profanaram meus sábados. Então eu disse que derramaria meu furor sobre eles, para cumprir minha ira contra eles no deserto.
verses.RVR09: Y los hijos se rebelaron contra mí: no anduvieron en mis ordenanzas, ni guardaron mis derechos para ponerlos por obra, los cuales el hombre que los cumpliere, vivirá en ellos; profanaron mis sábados. Dije entonces que derramaría mi ira sobre ellos, para cumplir mi enojo en ellos en el desierto.

verses.KJV: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
verses.WEB: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.ASV: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them forth.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém contive minha mão, e fiz por favor a meu nome, para que não fosse profanado diante dos olhos das nações, diante de cujos olhos os tirei.
verses.RVR09: Mas retraje mi mano, y en atención á mi nombre hice porque no se infamase á vista de las gentes, delante de cuyos ojos los saqué.

verses.KJV: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
verses.WEB: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,
verses.ASV: Moreover I sware unto them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations, and disperse them through the countries;
verses.ALMEIDA: E também lhes jurei no deserto que os espalharia entre as nações, e que os dispersaria pelas terras;
verses.RVR09: Y también les alcé yo mi mano en el desierto, que los esparciría entre las gentes, y que los aventaría por las tierras;

verses.KJV: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
verses.WEB: because they had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.
verses.ASV: because they had not executed mine ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque não praticaram meus juízos, rejeitaram meus estatutos, profanaram meus sábados, e seus olhos seguiram os ídolos de seus pais.
verses.RVR09: Porque no pusieron por obra mis derechos, y desecharon mis ordenanzas, y profanaron mis sábados, y tras los ídolos de sus padres se les fueron sus ojos.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
verses.WEB: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn’t live.
verses.ASV: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances wherein they should not live;
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso eu também lhes dei estatutos que não eram bons, e juízos pelos quais não viveriam;
verses.RVR09: Por eso yo también les dí ordenanzas no buenas, y derechos por los cuales no viviesen;

verses.KJV: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.”’
verses.ASV: and I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through [the fire] all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E os contaminei em suas ofertas, em que faziam passar pelo fogo todo primogênito, para eu os assolar, a fim de que soubessem que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y contaminélos en sus ofrendas cuando hacían pasar por el fuego todo primogénito, para que los desolase, á fin de que supiesen que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.WEB: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.ASV: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In this moreover have your fathers blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, filho do homem, fala à casa de Israel, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Até nisto vossos pais me afrontaram quando transgrediram contra mim.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, hijo del hombre, habla á la casa de Israel, y diles: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Aun en esto me afrentaron vuestros padres cuando cometieron contra mí rebelión.

verses.KJV: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
verses.WEB: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There they also made their pleasant aroma, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
verses.ASV: For when I had brought them into the land, which I sware to give unto them, then they saw every high hill, and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering; there also they made their sweet savor, and they poured out there their drink-offerings.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque quando eu os trouxe para a terra da qual eu tinha jurado que lhes daria, então olharam para todo morro alto e para toda árvore espessa, e ali sacrificaram suas sacrifícios, e ali deram suas ofertas irritantes, e ali derramaram suas ofertas de bebidas.
verses.RVR09: Porque yo los metí en la tierra sobre la cual había alzado mi mano que les había de dar, y miraron á todo collado alto, y á todo árbol espeso, y allí sacrificaron sus víctimas, y allí presentaron la irritación de sus ofrendas, allí pusieron también el olor de su suavidad, y allí derramaron sus libaciones.

verses.KJV: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name whereof is called Bamah unto this day.
verses.WEB: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.”’
verses.ASV: Then I said unto them, What meaneth the high place whereunto ye go? So the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu lhes disse: Que alto é esse para onde vós vais? E seu nome foi chamado Bamá até o dia de hoje.
verses.RVR09: Y yo les dije: ¿Qué es ese alto adonde vosotros vais? Y fué llamado su nombre Bamah hasta el día de hoy.

verses.KJV: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
verses.WEB: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations?
verses.ASV: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Do ye pollute yourselves after the manner of your fathers? and play ye the harlot after their abominations?
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Por acaso [não] vos contaminais assim como vossos pais, e vos prostituís segundo suas abominações?
verses.RVR09: Di, pues, á la casa de Israel: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¿No os contamináis vosotros á la manera de vuestros padres, y fornicáis tras sus abominaciones?

verses.KJV: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.WEB: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord GOD, I will not be inquired of by you!
verses.ASV: and when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, do ye pollute yourselves with all your idols unto this day? and shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you;
verses.ALMEIDA: Quando ofereceis vossas ofertas, e fazeis passar vossos filhos pelo fogo, vós estais contaminados com todos os vossos ídolos até hoje. E deixaria eu ser consultado por vós, ó casa de Israel? Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que não deixarei ser consultado por vós.
verses.RVR09: Porque ofreciendo vuestras ofrendas, haciendo pasar vuestros hijos por el fuego, os habéis contaminado con todos vuestros ídolos hasta hoy: ¿y he de responderos yo, casa de Israel? Vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, que no os responderé.

verses.KJV: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
verses.WEB: “‘“That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’
verses.ASV: and that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, in that ye say, We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
verses.ALMEIDA: E o que vós tendes pensado de maneira nenhuma sucederá. Pois vós dizeis: Seremos como as nações, como as famílias das terras, servindo à madeira e à pedra.
verses.RVR09: Y no ha de ser lo que habéis pensado. Porque vosotros decís: Seamos como las gentes, como las familias de las naciones, sirviendo á la madera y á la piedra.

verses.KJV: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
verses.WEB: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.
verses.ASV: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, will I be king over you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que reinarei sobre vós com mão forte, braço estendido, e ira derramada;
verses.RVR09: Vivo yo, dice el Señor Jehová, que con mano fuerte, y brazo extendido, y enojo derramado, tengo de reinar sobre vosotros:

verses.KJV: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.WEB: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.
verses.ASV: And I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out;
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos tirarei dentre os povos, e vos ajuntarei das terras em que estais espalhados, com mão forte, braço estendido, e ira derramada;
verses.RVR09: Y os sacaré de entre los pueblos, y os juntaré de las tierras en que estáis esparcidos, con mano fuerte, y brazo extendido, y enojo derramado:

verses.KJV: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
verses.WEB: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
verses.ASV: and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there will I enter into judgment with you face to face.
verses.ALMEIDA: E eu vos levarei ao deserto de povos, e ali entrarei em juízo convosco face a face,
verses.RVR09: Y os he de traer al desierto de pueblos, y allí litigaré con vosotros cara á cara.

verses.KJV: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: Like as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I enter into judgment with you, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tal como entrei em juízo com vossos pais no deserto da terra do Egito, assim entrarei em juízo convosco, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Como litigué con vuestros padres en el desierto de la tierra de Egipto, así litigaré con vosotros, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
verses.WEB: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
verses.ASV: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant;
verses.ALMEIDA: E vos farei passar debaixo da vara, e vos levarei em vínculo do pacto;
verses.RVR09: Y os haré pasar bajo de vara y os traeré en vínculo de concierto;

verses.KJV: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: and I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me; I will bring them forth out of the land where they sojourn, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E separarei dentre vós os rebeldes, e os que se transgrediram contra mim; da terra de suas peregrinações eu os tirarei, mas à terra de Israel não voltarão; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y apartaré de entre vosotros los rebeldes, y los que se rebelaron contra mí: de la tierra de sus destierros los sacaré, y á la tierra de Israel no vendrán; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord God; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
verses.WEB: “‘As for you, house of Israel, the Lord GOD says: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols.
verses.ASV: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Go ye, serve every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me; but my holy name shall ye no more profane with your gifts, and with your idols.
verses.ALMEIDA: E quanto a vós, ó casa de Israel, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ide, servi cada um a seus ídolos, e depois, se não quereis me ouvir; mas não profaneis mais meu santo nome com vossas ofertas, e com vossos ídolos.
verses.RVR09: Y vosotros, oh casa de Israel, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Andad cada uno tras sus ídolos, y servidles, pues que á mí no me obedecéis; y no profanéis más mi santo nombre con vuestras ofrendas, y con vuestros ídolos.

verses.KJV: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord God, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
verses.WEB: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord GOD, “there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.
verses.ASV: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them, serve me in the land: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the first-fruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque em meu santo monte, no monte alto de Israel, diz o Senhor DEUS, ali me servirá toda a casa de Israel, ela toda, naquela terra; ali eu os aceitarei, e ali demandarei vossas ofertas, e as primícias de vossas dádivas, com todas as vossas coisas santas.
verses.RVR09: Empero en mi santo monte, en el alto monte de Israel, dice el Señor Jehová, allí me servirá toda la casa de Israel, toda ella en la tierra: allí los querré, y allí demandaré vuestras ofrendas, y las primicias de vuestros dones, con todas vuestras cosas consagradas.

verses.KJV: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
verses.WEB: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.
verses.ASV: As a sweet savor will I accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com cheiro suave vos aceitarei, quando eu vos tirar dentre os povos, e vos ajuntar das terras em que estais espalhados; e serei santificado em vós diante dos olhos das nações.
verses.RVR09: En olor de suavidad os aceptaré, cuando os hubiere sacado de entre los pueblos, y os hubiere juntado de las tierras en que estáis esparcidos; y seré santificado en vosotros á los ojos de las gentes.

verses.KJV: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
verses.WEB: You will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.
verses.ASV: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I sware to give unto your fathers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu vos trouxer de volta à terra de Israel, à terra da qual jurei que daria a vossos pais.
verses.RVR09: Y sabréis que yo soy Jehová, cuando os hubiere metido en la tierra de Israel, en la tierra por la cual alcé mi mano que la daría á vuestros padres.

verses.KJV: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
verses.WEB: There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.
verses.ASV: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have polluted yourselves; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ali vos lembrareis de vossos caminhos e de todos os vossos atos em que vos contaminastes; e tereis nojo de vós mesmos, por causa de todos os vossos pecados que tendes cometido.
verses.RVR09: Y allí os acordaréis de vuestros caminos, y de todos vuestros hechos en que os contaminasteis; y seréis confusos en vuestra misma presencia por todos vuestros pecados que cometisteis.

verses.KJV: And ye shall know that I am the Lord when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR, quando fizer convosco por favor a meu nome, não conforme vossos maus caminhos, nem conforme vossos atos corruptos, ó casa de Israel, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y sabréis que yo soy Jehová cuando hiciere con vosotros por amor de mi nombre, no según vuestros caminos malos, ni según vuestras perversas obras, oh casa de Israel, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
verses.WEB: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the south.
verses.ASV: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop [thy word] toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the South;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, dirige teu rosto em direção ao sul, derrama [tua palavra] ao sul, e profetiza contra o bosque do campo do sul.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, pon tu rostro hacia el mediodía, y derrama tu palabra hacia la parte austral, y profetiza contra el bosque del campo del mediodía.

verses.KJV: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
verses.WEB: Tell the forest of the south, ‘Hear the LORD’s word: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree. The burning flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.
verses.ASV: and say to the forest of the South, Hear the word of Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burnt thereby.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize ao bosque do sul: Ouve a palavra do SENHOR! Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu acenderei em ti um fogo, que consumirá em ti toda árvore verde, e toda árvore seca; a chama do fogo não se apagará, e com ela serão queimados todos os rostos, desde o sul até o norte.
verses.RVR09: Y dirás al bosque del mediodía: Oye palabra de Jehová: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí que yo enciendo en ti fuego, el cual consumirá en ti todo árbol verde, y todo árbol seco: no se apagará la llama del fuego; y serán quemados en ella todos rostros, desde el mediodía hasta el norte.

verses.KJV: And all flesh shall see that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
verses.WEB: All flesh will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.”’”
verses.ASV: And all flesh shall see that I, Jehovah, have kindled it; it shall not be quenched.
verses.ALMEIDA: E toda carne verá que eu, o SENHOR, o acendi; não se apagará.
verses.RVR09: Y verá toda carne que yo Jehová lo encendí; no se apagará.

verses.KJV: Then said I, Ah Lord God! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
verses.WEB: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’”
verses.ASV: Then said I, Ah Lord Jehovah! they say of me, Is he not a speaker of parables?
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu disse: Ah, Senhor DEUS! Eles dizem de mim: Por acaso não é este um inventor de parábolas?
verses.RVR09: Y dije: ¡Ah, Señor Jehová! ellos dicen de mí: ¿No profiere éste parábolas?

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
verses.WEB: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
verses.ASV: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop [thy word] toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, dirige teu rosto contra Jerusalém, pronuncia contra os santuários, e profetiza contra a terra de Israel;
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, pon tu rostro contra Jerusalem, y derrama palabra sobre los santuarios, y profetiza sobre la tierra de Israel;

verses.KJV: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
verses.WEB: Tell the land of Israel, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
verses.ASV: and say to the land of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize à terra de Israel: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que eu [sou] contra ti, e tirarei minha espada de sua bainha, e exterminarei de ti o justo e o perverso.
verses.RVR09: Y dirás á la tierra de Israel: Así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí, que yo contra ti, y sacaré mi espada de su vaina, y talaré de ti al justo y al impío.

verses.KJV: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
verses.WEB: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.
verses.ASV: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
verses.ALMEIDA: E dado que exterminarei de ti ao justo e o perverso, por isso minha espada sairá de sua bainha contra todos, desde o sul até o norte.
verses.RVR09: Y por cuanto he de talar de ti al justo y al impío, por tanto, mi espada saldrá de su vaina contra toda carne, desde el mediodía hasta el aquilón:

verses.KJV: That all flesh may know that I the Lord have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
verses.WEB: All flesh will know that I, the LORD, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’
verses.ASV: and all flesh shall know that I, Jehovah, have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath; it shall not return any more.
verses.ALMEIDA: E todos saberão que eu, o SENHOR, tirei minha espada de sua bainha; ela nunca mais voltará.
verses.RVR09: Y sabrá toda carne que yo Jehová saqué mi espada de su vaina; no volverá más.

verses.KJV: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
verses.WEB: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.
verses.ASV: Sigh therefore, thou son of man; with the breaking of thy loins and with bitterness shalt thou sigh before their eyes.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porém tu, filho do homem, suspira com quebrantamento de lombos, e com amargura; suspira diante dos olhos deles.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, hijo del hombre, gime con quebrantamiento de lomos, y con amargura; gime delante de los ojos de ellos.

verses.KJV: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt say, Because of the tidings, for it cometh; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and it shall be done, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E será que, quando te disserem: Por que tu suspiras? Então dirás: Por causa da notícia que vêm; e todo coração se dissolverá, todas as mãos se enfraquecerão, todo espírito se angustiará, e todos joelhos se desfarão em águas; eis que já vem, e ela se cumprirá, diz o Senhor DEUS
verses.RVR09: Y será, que cuando te dijeren: ¿Por qué gimes tú? dirás: Por la fama que viene; y todo corazón se desleirá, y todas manos se debilitarán, y angustiaráse todo espíritu, y todas rodillas se irán en aguas: he aquí que viene, y hacerse ha, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
verses.WEB: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The LORD says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.
verses.ASV: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith Jehovah: Say, A sword, a sword, it is sharpened, and also furbished;
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dize: A espada, a espada está afiada, e também polida;
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, profetiza, y di: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Di: La espada, la espada está afilada, y aun acicalada;

verses.KJV: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.
verses.WEB: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Should we then make mirth? The rod of my son condemns every tree.
verses.ASV: it is sharpened that it may make a slaughter; it is furbished that it may be as lightning: shall we then make mirth? the rod of my son, it contemneth every tree.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para degolar matança está afiada, para reluzir como relâmpago está polida. Por acaso nos alegraremos? A vara de meu filho despreza toda árvore.
verses.RVR09: Para degollar víctimas está afilada, acicalada está para que relumbre. ¿Hemos de alegrarnos? A la vara de mi hijo viene menospreciando todo árbol.

verses.KJV: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
verses.WEB: It is given to be polished, that it may be handled. The sword is sharpened. Yes, it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer.”’
verses.ASV: And it is given to be furbished, that it may be handled: the sword, it is sharpened, yea, it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
verses.ALMEIDA: E ele a deu para polir, para usar dela com a mão; esta espada está afiada, e esta polida está, para a entregar na mão do matador.
verses.RVR09: Y dióla á acicalar para tenerla á mano: la espada está afilada, y acicalada está ella, para entregarla en mano del matador.

verses.KJV: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.
verses.WEB: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is on my people. It is on all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people. Therefore beat your thigh.
verses.ASV: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is upon my people, it is upon all the princes of Israel: they are delivered over to the sword with my people; smite therefore upon thy thigh.
verses.ALMEIDA: Grita e uiva, ó filho do homem; porque esta será contra meu povo, será contra todos os príncipes de Israel. Entregues à de espada são os do meu povo; portanto bate na coxa.
verses.RVR09: Clama y aulla, oh hijo del hombre; porque ésta será sobre mi pueblo, será ella sobre todos los príncipes de Israel. Temores de espada serán á mi pueblo: por tanto, hiere el muslo;

verses.KJV: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: For there is a trial; and what if even the rod that contemneth shall be no more? saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Pois tem que haver provação. E o que seria se a vara que despreza não mais existir?diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Porque está probado. ¿Y qué, si la espada desprecia aun el cetro? El no será más, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together. and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
verses.WEB: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the fatally wounded. It is the sword of the great one who is fatally wounded, which enters into their rooms.
verses.ASV: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thy hands together; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the deadly wounded: it is the sword of the great one that is deadly wounded, which entereth into their chambers.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso tu, filho do homem, profetiza, e bate uma mão com outra; por que a espada se dobrará até a terceira vez, a espada dos que forem mortos; esta é espada da grande matança que os cercará,
verses.RVR09: Tú pues, hijo del hombre, profetiza y bate una mano con otra, y dóblese la espada la tercera vez, la espada de muertos: ésta es espada de gran matanza que los penetrará,

verses.KJV: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
verses.WEB: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter.
verses.ASV: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied: ah! it is made as lightning, it is pointed for slaughter.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que os corações desmaiem, e os tropeços se multipliquem; eu pus a ponta da espada contra todas as suas portas. Ah! Ela feita foi para reluzir, e preparada está para degolar.
verses.RVR09: Para que el corazón desmaye, y los estragos se multipliquen: en todas las puertas de ellos he puesto espanto de espada. ¡Ah! dispuesta está para que relumbre, y aderezada para degollar.

verses.KJV: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
verses.WEB: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set.
verses.ASV: Gather thee together, go to the right, set thyself in array, go to the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
verses.ALMEIDA: [Ó espada] , move-te; vira-te à direita, prepara-te, vira-te à esquerda, para onde quer que tua face te apontar.
verses.RVR09: Ponte á una parte, ponte á la diestra, ó ponte á la siniestra, hacia donde tu rostro se determinare.

verses.KJV: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the Lord have said it.
verses.WEB: I will also strike my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest. I, the LORD, have spoken it.”
verses.ASV: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: E também eu baterei minhas mãos uma com a outra, e farei descansar minha ira. Eu, o SENHOR, falei.
verses.RVR09: Y yo también batiré mi mano con mi mano, y haré reposar mi ira. Yo Jehová he hablado.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra de SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.
verses.WEB: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
verses.ASV: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come; they twain shall come forth out of one land: and mark out a place, mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, filho do homem, propõe para ti dois caminhos por onde venha a espada do rei da Babilônia; ambos procederão de uma mesma terra; e põe um marco num lugar, põe um marco no começo do caminho da cidade.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, hijo del hombre, señálate dos caminos por donde venga la espada del rey de Babilonia: de una misma tierra salgan ambos: y echa mano á la suerte: en el principio del camino de la ciudad lo harás.

verses.KJV: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
verses.WEB: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
verses.ASV: Thou shalt appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
verses.ALMEIDA: Propõe um caminho, por onde venha a espada contra Rabá dos filhos de Amom, e contra Judá, contra a fortificada Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: El camino señalarás por donde venga la espada á Rabba de los hijos de Ammón, y á Judá contra Jerusalem la fuerte.

verses.KJV: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
verses.WEB: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.
verses.ASV: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he shook the arrows to and fro, he consulted the teraphim, he looked in the liver.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque o rei de Babilônia parará em uma encruzilhada, no começo de dois caminhos, para usar de adivinhação; ele sacudiu flechas, consultou ídolos, olhou o fígado.
verses.RVR09: Porque el rey de Babilonia se paró en una encrucijada, al principio de dos caminos, para tomar adivinación: acicaló saetas, consultó en ídolos, miró el hígado.

verses.KJV: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.
verses.WEB: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.
verses.ASV: In his right hand was the divination [for] Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, to build forts.
verses.ALMEIDA: A adivinhação será para a direita, sobre Jerusalém, para ordenar capitães, para abrir a boca à matança, para levantar a voz em grito, para pôr aríetes contra as portas, para levantar cercos, e edificar fortificações.
verses.RVR09: La adivinación fué á su mano derecha, sobre Jerusalem, para poner capitanes, para abrir la boca á la matanza, para levantar la voz en grito, para poner ingenios contra las puertas, para fundar baluarte, y edificar fuerte.

verses.KJV: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
verses.WEB: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.
verses.ASV: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths unto them; but he bringeth iniquity to remembrance, that they may be taken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E isto será como uma adivinhação falsa aos olhos daqueles que com juramentos firmaram compromisso com eles; porém ele se lembrará da maldade, para que sejam presos.
verses.RVR09: Y seráles como adivinación mentirosa en sus ojos, por estar juramentados con juramento á ellos: mas él trae á la memoria la maldad, para prenderlos.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
verses.WEB: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que fizestes relembrar vossas maldades, manifestando vossas rebeliões, e revelando vossos pecados em todas vossos atos; por teres feito relembrar, sereis presos com a mão.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto habéis hecho venir en memoria vuestras maldades, manifestando vuestras traiciones, y descubriendo vuestros pecados en todas vuestras obras; por cuanto habéis venido en memoria, seréis tomados á mano.

verses.KJV: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
verses.WEB: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
verses.ASV: And thou, O deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day is come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, profano e perverso príncipe de Israel, cujo dia do tempo do fim da maldade virá,
verses.RVR09: Y tú, profano é impío príncipe de Israel, cuyo día vino en el tiempo de la consumación de la maldad;

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
verses.WEB: the Lord GOD says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.
verses.ASV: thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Remove the mitre, and take off the crown; this [shall be] no more the same; exalt that which is low, and abase that which is high.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Tira o turbante, tira a coroa; esta não será a mesma; ao humilde exaltarei, e ao exaltado humilharei.
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Depón la tiara, quita la corona: ésta no será más ésta: al bajo alzaré, y al alto abatiré.

verses.KJV: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
verses.WEB: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’
verses.ASV: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it: this also shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it [him].
verses.ALMEIDA: Ruína! Ruína! Ruína a farei; e ela não será [restaurada] , até que venha aquele a quem lhe pertence por direito, e [a ele] a darei.
verses.RVR09: Del revés, del revés, del revés la tornaré; y no será ésta más, hasta que venga aquel cuyo es el derecho, y se la entregaré.

verses.KJV: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
verses.WEB: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord GOD says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;
verses.ASV: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and say thou, A sword, a sword is drawn, for the slaughter it is furbished, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, filho do homem, profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS sobre os filhos de Amom, e sua humilhação; Dize pois: A espada, a espada está desembainhada, polida para a matança, para destruir, para reluzir como relâmpago,
verses.RVR09: Y tú, hijo del hombre, profetiza, y di: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová sobre los hijos de Ammón, y su oprobio. Dirás pues: La espada, la espada está desenvainada para degollar; acicalada para consumir con resplandor.

verses.KJV: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
verses.WEB: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.
verses.ASV: while they see for thee false visions, while they divine lies unto thee, to lay thee upon the necks of the wicked that are deadly wounded, whose day is come in the time of the iniquity of the end.
verses.ALMEIDA: Enquanto te profetizam falsidade, enquanto te adivinham mentira; para te porem sobre os pescoços dos perversos condenados à morte, cujo dia virá no tempo do fim da maldade.
verses.RVR09: Te profetizan vanidad, adivínante mentira, para entregarte con los cuellos de los malos sentenciados á muerte, cuyo día vino en tiempo de la consumación de la maldad.

verses.KJV: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
verses.WEB: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.
verses.ASV: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy birth, will I judge thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Torna [tua espada] à sua bainha! No lugar onde foste criado, na terra de teu nascimento eu te julgarei.
verses.RVR09: ¿Tornaréla á su vaina? En el lugar donde te criaste, en la tierra donde has vivido, te tengo de juzgar.

verses.KJV: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.
verses.WEB: I will pour out my indignation on you. I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath. I will deliver you into the hand of brutish men, skillful to destroy.
verses.ASV: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee; I will blow upon thee with the fire of my wrath; and I will deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, skilful to destroy.
verses.ALMEIDA: E derramarei sobre ti minha ira; assoprarei contra ti o fogo do meu furor, e te entregarei na mão de homens violentos, habilidosos em destruir.
verses.RVR09: Y derramaré sobre ti mi ira: el fuego de mi enojo haré encender sobre ti, y te entregaré en mano de hombres temerarios, artífices de destrucción.

verses.KJV: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the Lord have spoken it.
verses.WEB: You will be for fuel to the fire. Your blood will be in the middle of the land. You will be remembered no more; for I, the LORD, have spoken it.”’”
verses.ASV: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para o fogo tu serás combustível; teu sangue estará no meio da terra; não haverá memória de ti; porque eu, o SENHOR, falei.
verses.RVR09: Del fuego serás para ser consumido; tu sangre será en medio de la tierra; no habrá más memoria de ti: porque yo Jehová he hablado.

verses.KJV: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
verses.WEB: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.
verses.ASV: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? then cause her to know all her abominations.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, filho do homem, Por acaso julgarás tu, por acaso julgarás tu a cidade derramadora de sanguinária? Notifica-lhe, pois, todas as suas abominações.
verses.RVR09: Y tú, hijo del hombre, ¿no juzgarás tú, no juzgarás tú á la ciudad derramadora de sangre, y le mostrarás todas sus abominaciones?
