verses.KJV: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord God, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
verses.WEB: You shall say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!
verses.ASV: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A city that sheddeth blood in the midst of her, that her time may come, and that maketh idols against herself to defile her!
verses.ALMEIDA: E dize: Assim disse o Senhor DEUS: Cidade que derrama sangue no meio de si, para que venha seu tempo, e que faz ídolos contra si mesma para se contaminar.
verses.RVR09: Dirás, pues: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¡Ciudad derramadora de sangre en medio de sí, para que venga su hora, y que hizo ídolos contra sí misma para contaminarse!

verses.KJV: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
verses.WEB: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
verses.ASV: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed, and art defiled in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
verses.ALMEIDA: Fizeste-te culpada com teu sangue que derramaste, e te contaminaste com teus ídolos que fizeste; e fizeste aproximar teus dias, e chegado a teus anos; por isso te entreguei por humilhação às nações, e por escárnio a todas as terras.
verses.RVR09: En tu sangre que derramaste has pecado, y te has contaminado en tus ídolos que hiciste; y has hecho acercar tus días, y has llegado á tus años: por tanto te he dado en oprobio á las gentes, y en escarnio á todas las tierras.

verses.KJV: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.
verses.WEB: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
verses.ASV: Those that are near, and those that are far from thee, shall mock thee, thou infamous one [and] full of tumult.
verses.ALMEIDA: As que estão perto e as que estão longe de ti escarnecerão de ti, [que és] imunda de nome, e cheia de inquietação.
verses.RVR09: Las que están cerca, y las que están lejos de ti, se reirán de ti, amancillada de fama, y de grande turbación.

verses.KJV: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
verses.WEB: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.
verses.ASV: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one according to his power, have been in thee to shed blood.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eis que os príncipes de Israel, cada um conforme seu poder, estiveram em ti para derramarem sangue.
verses.RVR09: He aquí que los príncipes de Israel, cada uno según su poder, fueron en ti para derramar sangre.

verses.KJV: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
verses.WEB: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.
verses.ASV: In thee have they set light by father and mother; in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the sojourner; in thee have they wronged the fatherless and the widow.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desprezaram ao pai e à mãe em ti; trataram ao estrangeiro com opressão no meio de ti; oprimiram ao órfão e à viúva em ti.
verses.RVR09: Al padre y á la madre despreciaron en ti: al extranjero trataron con calumnia en medio de ti: al huérfano y á la viuda despojaron en ti.

verses.KJV: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
verses.WEB: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
verses.ASV: Thou hast despised my holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
verses.ALMEIDA: Desprezaste minhas coisas santas, e profanaste meus sábados.
verses.RVR09: Mis santuarios menospreciaste, y mis sábados has profanado.

verses.KJV: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
verses.WEB: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.
verses.ASV: Slanderous men have been in thee to shed blood; and in thee they have eaten upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they have committed lewdness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Caluniadores houve em ti, para derramarem sangue; e comeram sobre os montes em ti; praticaram lascívia no meio de ti.
verses.RVR09: Calumniadores hubo en ti para derramar sangre; y sobre los montes comieron en ti: hicieron en medio de ti suciedades.

verses.KJV: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
verses.WEB: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.
verses.ASV: In thee have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness; in thee have they humbled her that was unclean in her impurity.

verses.RVR09: Precio recibieron en ti para derramar sangre; usura y logro tomaste, y á tus prójimos defraudaste con violencia: olvidástete de mí, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
verses.WEB: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.
verses.ASV: Behold, therefore, I have smitten my hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Mais eis que bati minhas mãos por causa de tua ganância que cometeste, e por causa de teu sangue, que houve no meio de ti.
verses.RVR09: Y he aquí, que herí mi mano á causa de tu avaricia que cometiste, y á causa de tus sangres que fueron en medio de ti.

verses.KJV: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the Lord have spoken it, and will do it.
verses.WEB: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken it, and will do it.
verses.ASV: Can thy heart endure, or can thy hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and will do it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Conseguirá, por acaso, ficar firme teu coração? Serão fortes tuas mãos nos dias em que eu agir contra ti? Eu, o SENHOR, falei, e farei.
verses.RVR09: ¿Estará firme tu corazón? ¿tus manos serán fuertes en los días que obraré yo contra ti? Yo Jehová he hablado, y harélo.

verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

verses.ASV: Son of man, the house of Israel is become dross unto me: all of them are brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.WEB: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que todos vós vos tornastes em escórias, por isso eis que eu vos ajuntarei no meio de Jerusalém.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto todos vosotros os habéis tornado en escorias, por tanto, he aquí que yo os junto en medio de Jerusalem.

verses.KJV: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
verses.WEB: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.
verses.ASV: As they gather silver and brass and iron and lead and tin into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como se ajunta prata, bronze, ferro, chumbo e estanho no meio do forno, para soprar fogo sobre eles para fundir, assim vos ajuntarei em minha ira e em meu furor, e [ali] vos deixarei, e vos fundirei.
verses.RVR09: Como quien junta plata y metal y hierro y plomo y estaño en medio del horno, para encender fuego en él para fundir; así os juntaré en mi furor y en mi ira, y haré reposar, y os fundiré.

verses.KJV: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst therof.
verses.WEB: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.
verses.ASV: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu vos reunirei, e soprarei sobre vós no fogo de meu furor, e no meio dela sereis fundidos.
verses.RVR09: Yo os juntaré y soplaré sobre vosotros en el fuego de mi furor, y en medio de él seréis fundidos.

verses.KJV: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the Lord have poured out my fury upon you.
verses.WEB: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my wrath on you.’”
verses.ASV: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have poured out my wrath upon you.
verses.ALMEIDA: Como se funde a prata no meio do forno, assim sereis fundidos no meio dela; e sabereis que eu, o SENHOR, derramei meu furor sobre vós.
verses.RVR09: Como se funde la plata en medio del horno, así seréis fundidos en medio de él; y sabréis que yo Jehová habré derramado mi enojo sobre vosotros.

verses.KJV: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.WEB: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’
verses.ASV: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art a land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, diz a ela: Tu não és uma terra limpa, nem molhada de chuva no dia da indignação.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, di á ella: Tú no eres tierra limpia, ni rociada con lluvia en el día del furor.

verses.KJV: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
verses.WEB: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.
verses.ASV: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey: they have devoured souls; they take treasure and precious things; they have made her widows many in the midst thereof.
verses.ALMEIDA: Há uma conspiração de seus profetas no meio dela, como um leão que brame, que arrebata a presa; devoraram almas, tomam bens e coisas preciosas, aumentam suas viúvas no meio dela.
verses.RVR09: La conjuración de sus profetas en medio de ella, como león bramando que arrebata presa: devoraron almas, tomaron haciendas y honra, aumentaron sus viudas en medio de ella.

verses.KJV: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
verses.WEB: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.
verses.ASV: Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus sacerdotes violentam minha lei, e profanam minhas coisas sagradas; não fazem diferença entre o santo e o profano, nem distinguem o impuro do puro; e escondem seus olhos de meus sábados. Assim eu sou profanado no meio deles.
verses.RVR09: Sus sacerdotes violentaron mi ley, y contaminaron mis santuarios: entre lo santo y lo profano no hicieron diferencia, ni distinguieron entre inmundo y limpio; y de mis sábados escondieron sus ojos, y yo era profanado en medio de ellos.

verses.KJV: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
verses.WEB: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
verses.ASV: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, [and] to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
verses.ALMEIDA: Seus príncipes no meio dela são como lobos que arrebatam presa para derramarem sangue, para destruírem almas, para obterem lucro desonesto.
verses.RVR09: Sus príncipes en medio de ella como lobos que arrebataban presa, derramando sangre, para destruir las almas, para pábulo de su avaricia.

verses.KJV: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken.
verses.WEB: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.
verses.ASV: And her prophets have daubed for them with untempered [mortar], seeing false visions, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, when Jehovah hath not spoken.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus profetas os rebocam com cal solta, profetizando-lhes falsidade, e adivinhando- lhes mentira, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS; sem que o SENHOR tenha falado.
verses.RVR09: Y sus profetas revocaban con lodo suelto, profetizándoles vanidad, y adivinándoles mentira, diciendo: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová; y Jehová no había hablado.

verses.KJV: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
verses.WEB: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.
verses.ASV: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery; yea, they have vexed the poor and needy, and have oppressed the sojourner wrongfully.
verses.ALMEIDA: O povo da terra faz graves extorsões, e pratica roubos; fazem violência ao aflito e necessitado, e oprimem sem motivo ao estrangeiro.
verses.RVR09: El pueblo de la tierra usaba de opresión, y cometía robo, y al afligido y menesteroso hacían violencia, y al extranjero oprimían sin derecho.

verses.KJV: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
verses.WEB: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
verses.ASV: And I sought for a man among them, that should build up the wall, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found none.
verses.ALMEIDA: E busquei dentre eles um homem que tapasse o muro, e que se pusesse na brecha diante de mim pela terra, para que eu não a destruísse; porém a ninguém achei.
verses.RVR09: Y busqué de ellos hombre que hiciese vallado, y que se pusiese al portillo delante de mí por la tierra, para que yo no la destruyese; y no lo hallé.

verses.KJV: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I brought upon their heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso derramarei sobre eles minha indignação; com o fogo de minha ira os consumirei; retribuirei o caminho deles sobre suas [próprias] cabeças,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto derramé sobre ellos mi ira; con el fuego de mi ira los consumí: torné el camino de ellos sobre su cabeza, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.ASV: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.WEB: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.
verses.ASV: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, houve duas mulheres, filhas de uma [mesma] mãe,
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, hubo dos mujeres, hijas de una madre,

verses.KJV: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
verses.WEB: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.
verses.ASV: and they played the harlot in Egypt; they played the harlot in their youth; there were their breasts pressed, and there was handled the bosom of their virginity.
verses.ALMEIDA: Estas se prostituíram no Egito; em suas juventudes se prostituíram. Ali foram apertados os seus peitos, e ali foram apalpados os seios de sua virgindade.
verses.RVR09: Las cuales fornicaron en Egipto; en sus mocedades fornicaron. Allí fueron apretados sus pechos, y allí fueron estrujados los pechos de su virginidad.

verses.KJV: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
verses.WEB: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
verses.ASV: And the names of them were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister: and they became mine, and they bare sons and daughters. And as for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E seus nomes eram: Oolá, a maior, e Oolibá sua irmã; e elas foram minhas, e tiveram filhos e filhas. Estes eram seus nomes: Samaria é Oolá, e Jerusalém Oolibá.
verses.RVR09: Y llamábanse, la mayor, Aholah, y su hermana, Aholibah; las cuales fueron mías, y parieron hijos é hijas. Y llamáronse, Samaria, Aholah; y Jerusalem, Aholibah.

verses.KJV: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
verses.WEB: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
verses.ASV: And Oholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians [her] neighbors,
verses.ALMEIDA: E Oolá prostituiu-se, mesmo sendo minha; e apaixonou-se por seus amantes, os assírios seus vizinhos,
verses.RVR09: Y Aholah cometió fornicación en mi poder: y prendóse de sus amantes, los Asirios sus vecinos,

verses.KJV: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.WEB: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
verses.ASV: who were clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.ALMEIDA: Vestidos de azul, governadores e príncipes, todos rapazes cobiçáveis, cavaleiros que andavam a cavalo.
verses.RVR09: Vestidos de cárdeno, capitanes y príncipes, mancebos todos de codiciar, caballeros que andaban á caballo.

verses.KJV: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.WEB: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.
verses.ASV: And she bestowed her whoredoms upon them, the choicest men of Assyria all of them; and on whomsoever she doted, with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim ela cometeu suas prostituições com eles, os quais eram os mais apreciados dos filhos da Assíria, e com todos aqueles por quem ela se apaixonou; contaminou-se com todos os ídolos deles.
verses.RVR09: Y puso sus fornicaciones con ellos, con todos los más escogidos de los hijos de los Asirios, y con todos aquellos de quienes se enamoró: contaminóse con todos los ídolos de ellos.

verses.KJV: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
verses.WEB: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.
verses.ASV: Neither hath she left her whoredoms since [the days of] Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her, and they handled the bosom of her virginity; and they poured out their whoredom upon her.
verses.ALMEIDA: E não deixou suas fornicações [que trouxe] do Egito; pois com ela se deitaram em sua juventude, e eles apalparam os seios de sua virgindade, e derramaram sua prostituição sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Y no dejó sus fornicaciones de Egipto: porque con ella se echaron en su mocedad, y ellos comprimieron los pechos de su virginidad, y derramaron sobre ella su fornicación.

verses.KJV: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.WEB: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.
verses.ASV: Wherefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso a entreguei na mão de seus amantes, na mão dos filhos da Assíria, por quem tinha se apaixonado.
verses.RVR09: Por lo cual la entregué en mano de sus amantes, en mano de los hijos de los Asirios, de quienes se había enamorado.

verses.KJV: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
verses.WEB: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.
verses.ASV: These uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters; and her they slew with the sword: and she became a byword among women; for they executed judgments upon her.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eles descobriram sua nudez, tomaram seus filhos e suas filhas, e a mataram à espada; e veio a ser famosa entre as mulheres, pois fizeram julgamentos contra ela.
verses.RVR09: Ellos descubrieron sus vergüenzas, tomaron sus hijos y sus hijas, y á ella mataron á cuchillo: y vino á ser de nombre entre las mujeres, pues en ella hicieron juicios.

verses.KJV: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.

verses.ASV: And her sister Oholibah saw this, yet was she more corrupt in her doting than she, and in her whoredoms which were more than the whoredoms of her sister.

verses.RVR09: Y viólo su hermana Aholibah, y estragó su amor más que ella; y sus fornicaciones, más que las fornicaciones de su hermana.

verses.KJV: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.WEB: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.ASV: She doted upon the Assyrians, governors and rulers, [her] neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Apaixonou-se pelos filhos da Assíria, pelos governadores e príncipes, seus vizinhos, vestidos com luxo, cavaleiros que andavam a cavalo, todos eles rapazes cobiçáveis.
verses.RVR09: Enamoróse de los hijos de los Asirios, sus vecinos, capitanes y príncipes, vestidos en perfección, caballeros que andaban á caballo, todos ellos mancebos de codiciar.

verses.KJV: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
verses.WEB: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.

verses.WEB: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.ASV: And righteous men, they shall judge them with the judgment of adulteresses, and with the judgment of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso homens justos as julgarão pela lei que pune as adúlteras, e pela lei que pune as que derramam sangue; pois são adúlteras, e há sangue há nas mãos delas.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, hombres justos las juzgarán por la ley de las adúlteras, y por la ley de las que derraman sangre: porque son adúlteras, y sangre hay en sus manos.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
verses.WEB: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company against them, and will give them to be tossed to and fro and robbed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei subir uma multidão contra elas, e as entregarei a terror e ao saque;
verses.RVR09: Por lo que así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Yo haré subir contra ellas compañías, las entregaré á turbación y á rapiña:

verses.KJV: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.WEB: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.ASV: And the company shall stone them with stones, and despatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: E a multidão as apedrejará com pedras, e as cortarão com suas espadas; matarão seus filhos e suas filhas, e queimarão com fogo suas casas.
verses.RVR09: Y la compañía de gentes las apedreará con piedras, y las acuchillará con sus espadas: matarán á sus hijos y á sus hijas, y sus casas consumirán con fuego.

verses.KJV: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.WEB: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.
verses.ASV: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim acabarei com a obscenidade da terra, para que todas as mulheres aprendam a não fazer conforme vossa obscenidade.
verses.RVR09: Y haré cesar la depravación de la tierra, y escarmentarán todas las mujeres, y no harán según vuestra torpeza.

verses.KJV: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.WEB: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E porão sobre vós [a culpa por] vossa obscenidade, e levareis os pecados de vossos ídolos; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y sobre vosotras pondrán vuestra obscenidad, y llevaréis los pecados de vuestros ídolos; y sabréis que yo soy el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth [day] of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: No nono ano, no décimo mês, aos dez do mês, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová en el noveno año, en el mes décimo, á los diez del mes, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
verses.WEB: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.
verses.ASV: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, [even] of this selfsame day: the king of Babylon drew close unto Jerusalem this selfsame day.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, escreve para ti o nome deste dia, hoje mesmo; [porque] o rei da Babilônia chegou a Jerusalém hoje mesmo.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, escríbete el nombre de este día: el rey de Babilonia se puso sobre Jerusalem este mismo día.

verses.KJV: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:
verses.WEB: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says, “Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it.
verses.ASV: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Set on the caldron, set it on, and also pour water into it:
verses.ALMEIDA: E fala uma parábola à casa rebelde, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Põe uma panela, põe [-a] ,e também deita água dentro dela;
verses.RVR09: Y habla á la casa de rebelión por parábola, y diles: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Pon una olla, ponla, y echa también en ella agua:

verses.KJV: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
verses.WEB: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece: the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choice bones.
verses.ASV: gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
verses.ALMEIDA: Ajunta seus pedaços [de carne] nela; todos bons pedaços, pernas e espáduas; enche-a dos melhores ossos.
verses.RVR09: Junta sus piezas en ella; todas buenas piezas, pierna y espalda; hínchela de huesos escogidos.

verses.KJV: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
verses.WEB: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it.”
verses.ASV: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile [of wood] for the bones under [the caldron]; make it boil well; yea, let the bones thereof be boiled in the midst of it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Toma do melhor do rebanho, e acende também os ossos debaixo dela; faze-a ferver bem; e assim seus ossos serão cozidos dentro dela.
verses.RVR09: Toma una oveja escogida; y también enciende los huesos debajo de ella; haz que hierva bien; coced también sus huesos dentro de ella.

verses.KJV: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
verses.WEB: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Woe to the bloody city, to the cauldron whose rust is in it, and whose rust hasn’t gone out of it! Take out of it piece after piece without casting lots for it.
verses.ASV: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city, to the caldron whose rust is therein, and whose rust is not gone out of it! take out of it piece after piece; No lot is fallen upon it.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai da cidade sanguinária, cuja sujeira está nela, e cuja sujeira não saiu dela! Tira dela pedaço por pedaço, não caia sorte sobre ela.
verses.RVR09: Pues así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¡Ay de la ciudad de sangres, de la olla no espumada, y cuya espuma no salió de ella! Por sus piezas, por sus piezas sácala; no caiga sobre ella suerte.

verses.KJV: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
verses.WEB: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her. She set it on the bare rock. She didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it with dust.
verses.ASV: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the bare rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque seu sangue está em meio dela; sobre uma pedra exposta ela o pôs; não o derramou sobre a terra, para que fosse coberto com pó.
verses.RVR09: Porque su sangre fué en medio de ella: sobre una piedra alisada la puso; no la derramó sobre la tierra para que fuese cubierta con polvo.

verses.KJV: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
verses.WEB: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be covered.”
verses.ASV: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood upon the bare rock, that it should not be covered.
verses.ALMEIDA: Para que eu faça subir a ira, para me vingar, eu pus seu sangue sobre a pedra exposta, para que não seja coberta.
verses.RVR09: Habiendo, pues, hecho subir la ira para hacer venganza, yo pondré su sangre sobre la dura piedra, para que no sea cubierta.

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
verses.WEB: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.
verses.ASV: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.
verses.ALMEIDA: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai da cidade sanguinária! Também eu farei uma grande fogueira,
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: ¡Ay de la ciudad de sangres! Pues también haré yo gran hoguera,

verses.KJV: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
verses.WEB: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.
verses.ASV: Heap on the wood, make the fire hot, boil well the flesh, and make thick the broth, and let the bones be burned.
verses.ALMEIDA: Amontoa lenha, acende o fogo, consome a carne, e a tempera com especiarias; e sejam queimados os ossos;
verses.RVR09: Multiplicando la leña, encendiendo el fuego, para consumir la carne, y hacer la salsa; y los huesos serán quemados:

verses.KJV: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
verses.WEB: Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its bronze may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed.
verses.ASV: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that it may be hot, and the brass thereof may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the rust of it may be consumed.
verses.ALMEIDA: Depois põe [a panela] vazia sobre suas brasas, para que se esquente, e seu cobre queime, e se funda sua imundícia no meio dela, e se consuma sua sujeira.
verses.RVR09: Asentando después la olla vacía sobre sus brasas, para que se caldee, y se queme su fondo, y se funda en ella su suciedad, y se consuma su espuma.

verses.KJV: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
verses.WEB: She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, doesn’t leave her.
verses.ASV: She hath wearied [herself] with toil; yet her great rust goeth not forth out of her; her rust [goeth not forth] by fire.
verses.ALMEIDA: De trabalhos ela [me] cansou, e sua muita sujeira não saiu dela. Sua sujeira [irá] para o fogo.
verses.RVR09: En fraude se cansó, y no salió de ella su mucha espuma. En fuego será su espuma consumida.

verses.KJV: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
verses.WEB: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.
verses.ASV: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have cleansed thee and thou wast not cleansed, thou shalt not be cleansed from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my wrath toward thee to rest.
verses.ALMEIDA: Em tua imundícia há obscenidade, porque eu te purifiquei, porém tu não te purificaste; não mais serás purificada de tua imundícia, enquanto eu não fizer repousar minha ira sobre ti.
verses.RVR09: En tu suciedad perversa padecerás: porque te limpié, y tú no te limpiaste de tu suciedad: nunca más te limpiarás, hasta que yo haga reposar mi ira sobre ti.

verses.KJV: I the Lord have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: “‘“I, the LORD, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.ASV: I, Jehovah, have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it: I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Eu, o SENHOR, falei; virá a acontecer, e o farei. Não me tonarei atrás, não pouparei, nem me arrependerei; conforme teus caminhos e teus atos te julgarão, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Yo Jehová he hablado; vendrá, y harélo. No me tornaré atrás, ni tendré misericordia, ni me arrepentiré: según tus caminos y tus obras te juzgarán, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Also the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Also the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Also the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
verses.WEB: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.
verses.ASV: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet thou shalt neither mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, eis que com um golpe tirarei de ti o desejo de teus olhos; não lamentes, nem chores, nem escorram de ti lágrimas.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, he aquí que yo te quito de golpe el deseo de tus ojos: no endeches, ni llores, ni corran tus lágrimas.

verses.KJV: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
verses.WEB: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”
verses.ASV: Sigh, but not aloud, make no mourning for the dead; bind thy headtire upon thee, and put thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: Geme em silêncio, não faças luto pelos mortos; ata teu turbante sobre ti, e põe teus sapatos em teus pés; e não te cubras os lábios, nem comas pão de homens.
verses.RVR09: Reprime el suspirar, no hagas luto de mortuorios: ata tu bonete sobre ti, y pon tus zapatos en tus pies, y no te cubras con rebozo, ni comas pan de hombres.

verses.KJV: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.WEB: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.ASV: So I spake unto the people in the morning; and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.ALMEIDA: E falei ao povo pela manhã, e minha mulher morreu à tarde; e pela manhã fiz como me fora mandado.
verses.RVR09: Y hablé al pueblo por la mañana, y á la tarde murió mi mujer: y á la mañana hice como me fué mandado.

verses.KJV: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?
verses.WEB: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”
verses.ASV: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?
verses.ALMEIDA: E o povo me disse: Por acaso não nos farás saber o que [significam] para nós estas coisas que tu estás fazendo?
verses.RVR09: Y díjome el pueblo: ¿No nos enseñarás qué nos significan estas cosas que tú haces?

verses.KJV: Then I answered them, The word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: Then I said to them, “The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: Then I said unto them, The word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: Então eu lhes disse: A palavra do SENHOR veio a mim, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y yo les dije: Palabra de Jehová fué á mí, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
verses.WEB: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
verses.ASV: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left behind shall fall by the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu profanarei meu santuário, a orgulho de vossa fortaleza, o desejo de vossos olhos, e o agrado de vossas almas; e vossos filhos e vossas filhas que deixastes cairão a espada.
verses.RVR09: Di á la casa de Israel: Así ha dicho el Señor Dios: He aquí yo profano mi santuario, la gloria de vuestra fortaleza, el deseo de vuestros ojos, y el regalo de vuestra alma: vuestros hijos y vuestras hijas que dejasteis, caerán á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
verses.WEB: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.
verses.ASV: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fareis como eu fiz: não cobrireis vossos lábios, nem comereis pão de homens;
verses.RVR09: Y haréis de la manera que yo hice: no os cubriréis con rebozo, ni comeréis pan de hombres;

verses.KJV: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
verses.WEB: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
verses.ASV: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
verses.ALMEIDA: E vossos turbantes estarão sobre vossas cabeças, e vossos sapatos em vossos pés; não lamentareis nem chorareis, em vez disso vos consumireis por causa de vossas maldades, e gemereis uns com outros.
verses.RVR09: Y vuestros bonetes estarán sobre vuestras cabezas, y vuestros zapatos en vuestros pies: no endecharéis ni lloraréis, sino que os consumiréis á causa de vuestras maldades, y gemiréis unos con otros.

verses.KJV: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.WEB: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”’”
verses.ASV: Thus shall Ezekiel be unto you a sign; according to all that he hath done shall ye do: when this cometh, then shall ye know that I am the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim Ezequiel vos será por sinal; conforme tudo o que ele fez, vós fareis. Quando isto acontecer, então sabereis que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Ezequiel pues os será por señal; según todas las cosas que él hizo, haréis: en viniendo esto, entonces sabréis que yo soy el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
verses.WEB: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—
verses.ASV: And thou, son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart, their sons and their daughters,
verses.ALMEIDA: E tu, filho do homem, por acaso não será no dia que eu lhes tirar sua fortaleza, o seu belo orgulho, o desejo de seus olhos, e o agrado de suas almas, seus filhos e suas filhas,
verses.RVR09: Y tú, hijo del hombre, el día que yo quitaré de ellos su fortaleza, el gozo de su gloria, el deseo de sus ojos, y el cuidado de sus almas, sus hijos y sus hijas,

verses.KJV: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
verses.WEB: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?
verses.ASV: that in that day he that escapeth shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
verses.ALMEIDA: Que no mesmo dia um que tiver escapado virá a ti para trazer as notícias aos teus ouvidos?
verses.RVR09: Este día vendrá á ti un escapado para traer las nuevas.

verses.KJV: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him that is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: so shalt thou be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Naquele dia tua boca se abrirá para falar com o escapado, e falarás, e não ficarás mais calado; e tu lhes serás por sinal, e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: En aquel día se abrirá tu boca para hablar con el escapado, y hablarás, y no estarás más mudo; y les serás por señal, y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y FUÉ á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
verses.WEB: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.
verses.ASV: Son of man, set thy face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, dirige tua face contra os filhos de Amom, e profetiza sobre eles.
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, pon tu rostro hacia los hijos de Ammón, y profetiza sobre ellos.

verses.KJV: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
verses.WEB: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,
verses.ASV: and say unto the children of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was made desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity:
verses.ALMEIDA: E diz aos filhos de Amom: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor DEUS; assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que disseste: Ha, ha! Acerca de meu santuário quando foi profanado, e acerca da terra de Israel quando foi desolada, e acerca da casa de Judá quando foram ao cativeiro,
verses.RVR09: Y dirás á los hijos de Ammón: Oid palabra del Señor Jehová. Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto dijiste ¡Ea! acerca de mi santuario que fué profanado, y sobre la tierra de Israel que fué asolada, y sobre la casa de Judá, porque fueron en cautiverio;

verses.KJV: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
verses.WEB: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
verses.ASV: therefore, behold, I will deliver thee to the children of the east for a possession, and they shall set their encampments in thee, and make their dwellings in thee; they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, eis, eu te entregarei como possessão aos filhos do oriente, e estabelecerão suas acampamentos em ti, e porão suas tendas em ti; eles comerão teus frutos e beberão teu leite.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí, yo te entrego á los Orientales por heredad, y pondrán en ti sus apriscos, y colocarán en ti sus tiendas: ellos comerán tus sementeras, y beberán tu leche.

verses.KJV: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couching place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the children of Ammon a couching-place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E tornarei a Rabá em estábulo de camelos, e os filhos de Amom em curral de ovelhas; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré á Rabba por habitación de camellos, y á los hijos de Ammón por majada de ovejas; y sabréis que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
verses.WEB: For the Lord GOD says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast clapped thy hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the despite of thy soul against the land of Israel;
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que bateste palmas, e bateste o pés, e te alegraste na alma em todo teu desprezo sobre a terra de Israel,
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto tú batiste tus manos, y pateaste, y te gozaste del alma en todo tu menosprecio sobre la tierra de Israel;

verses.KJV: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the nations; and I will cut thee off from the peoples, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, eis que eu estenderei minha mão contra ti, e te entregarei às nações para seres saqueada; e eu te cortarei dentre os povos, e te destruirei dentre as terras; eu te eliminarei, e saberás que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí yo extenderé mi mano sobre ti, y te entregaré á las gentes para ser saqueada; y yo te cortaré de entre los pueblos, y te destruiré de entre las tierras: te raeré; y sabrás que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the nations;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Visto que Moabe e Seir dizem: Eis que a casa de Judá é como todas as nações,
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por cuanto dijo Moab y Seir: He aquí la casa de Judá es como todas las gentes;

verses.KJV: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.WEB: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.ASV: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, eis que abrirei a lateral de Moabe desde as cidades, desde suas cidades que estão em suas fronteiras, as melhores terras: Bete-Jesimote, e Baal-Meom, e até Quiriataim;
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, he aquí yo abro el lado de Moab desde las ciudades, desde sus ciudades que están en su confín, las tierras deseables de Beth-jesimoth, y Baal-meón, y Chîriathaim,

verses.KJV: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.WEB: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.ASV: unto the children of the east, [to go] against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations:
verses.ALMEIDA: Serão para os filhos do oriente, com [a terra] dos filhos de Amom; e a entregarei por possessão, para que não haja lembrança dos filhos de Amom entre as nações.
verses.RVR09: A los hijos del oriente contra los hijos de Ammón; y entregaréla por heredad para que no haya más memoria de los hijos de Ammón entre las gentes.

verses.KJV: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.ASV: and I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: Também farei julgamentos em Moabe; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: También en Moab haré juicios; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que Edom se vingou contra a casa de Judá, e se tornaram extremamente culpados ao se vingarem deles;
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por lo que hizo Edom tomando venganza de la casa de Judá, pues delinquieron en extremo, y se vengaron de ellos;

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
verses.WEB: therefore the Lord GOD says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.
verses.ASV: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, I will stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; even unto Dedan shall they fall by the sword.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu também estenderei minha mão contra [a terra de] Edom: exterminarei dela homens e animais, e a tornarei desolada; desde Temã e Dedã cairão à espada.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Yo también extenderé mi mano sobre Edom, y talaré de ella hombres y bestias, y la asolaré: desde Temán y Dedán caerán á cuchillo.

verses.KJV: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel; and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my wrath; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E me vingarei contra Edom pela mão do meu povo Israel; e farão em Edom segundo minha ira, e conhecerão minha vingança, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y pondré mi venganza en Edom por la mano de mi pueblo Israel; y harán en Edom según mi enojo y según mi ira: y conocerán mi venganza, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
verses.WEB: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with despite of soul to destroy with perpetual enmity;
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que os filisteus agiram com vingança, quando se vingaram com desprezo na alma, destruindo por hostilidades antigas,
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: Por lo que hicieron los Palestinos con venganza, cuando se vengaron con despecho de ánimo, destruyendo por antiguas enemistades;

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.WEB: therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.ASV: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu estendo minha mão contra os filisteus, e exterminarei os queretitas, e destruirei o resto da costa do mar.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho Jehová: He aquí yo extiendo mi mano sobre los Palestinos, y talaré los Ceretheos, y destruiré el resto de la ribera de la mar.

verses.KJV: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
verses.WEB: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”
verses.ASV: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with wrathful rebukes; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei neles grandes vinganças, com castigos de furor; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando me vingar deles.
verses.RVR09: Y haré en ellos grandes venganzas con reprensiones de ira; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová, cuando diere mi venganza en ellos.

verses.KJV: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.WEB: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.ASV: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
verses.ALMEIDA: E sucedeu no décimo primeiro ano, no primeiro [dia] do mês, que veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.RVR09: Y ACONTECIÓ en el undécimo año, en el primero del mes, que fué á mí palabra de Jehová, diciendo:

verses.KJV: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
verses.WEB: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’
verses.ASV: Son of man, because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken [that was] the gate of the peoples; she is turned unto me; I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste:
verses.ALMEIDA: Filho do homem, dado que Tiro falou sobre Jerusalém: Ha, ha!, quebrada está a porta das nações; ela se virou para mim; eu me encherei [de riquezas] ,[agora] que ela está assolada;
verses.RVR09: Hijo del hombre, por cuanto dijo Tiro sobre Jerusalem: Ea, bien: quebrantada es la que era puerta de las naciones: á mí se volvió: seré llena; ella desierta:

verses.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
verses.WEB: therefore the Lord GOD says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
verses.ASV: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I am against thee, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth its waves to come up.
verses.ALMEIDA: Por isso, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu sou contra ti, ó Tiro; e farei subir contra ti muitas nações, tal como o mar faz subir suas ondas.
verses.RVR09: Por tanto, así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí yo contra ti, oh Tiro, y haré subir contra ti muchas gentes, como la mar hace subir sus ondas.

verses.KJV: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
verses.WEB: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
verses.ASV: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
verses.ALMEIDA: E demolirão os muros de Tiro, e derrubarão suas torres; varrerei dela seu pó, e a deixarei como uma rocha exposta.
verses.RVR09: Y demolerán los muros de Tiro, y derribarán sus torres: y raeré de ella su polvo, y la dejaré como una peña lisa.

verses.KJV: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
verses.WEB: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.
verses.ASV: She shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah; and she shall become a spoil to the nations.
verses.ALMEIDA: Servirá para estender redes no meio do mar, porque [assim] eu falei,diz o Senhor DEUS; e será saqueada pelas nações.
verses.RVR09: Tendedero de redes será en medio de la mar, porque yo he hablado, dice el Señor Jehová: y será saqueada de las gentes.

verses.KJV: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.WEB: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
verses.ASV: And her daughters that are in the field shall be slain with the sword: and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E suas filhas que estiverem no campo serão mortas à espada; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.RVR09: Y sus hijas que están en el campo, serán muertas á cuchillo; y sabrán que yo soy Jehová.

verses.KJV: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
verses.WEB: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.
verses.ASV: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and a company, and much people.
verses.ALMEIDA: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que desde o norte eu trarei contra Tiro a Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, rei de reis, com cavalos, carruagens, cavaleiros, tropas, e muito povo.
verses.RVR09: Porque así ha dicho el Señor Jehová: He aquí que del aquilón traigo yo contra Tiro á Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, rey de reyes, con caballos, y carros, y caballeros, y compañías, y mucho pueblo.

verses.KJV: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
verses.WEB: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.
verses.ASV: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field; and he shall make forts against thee, and cast up a mound against thee, and raise up the buckler against thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Tuas filhas no campo ele matará à espada; e porá contra ti fortalezas, fará cerco contra ti, e levantará escudos contra ti.
verses.RVR09: Tus hijas que están en el campo matará á cuchillo; y pondrá contra ti ingenios, y fundará contra ti baluarte, y afirmará contra ti escudo.

verses.KJV: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
verses.WEB: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
verses.ASV: And he shall set his battering engines against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
verses.ALMEIDA: E fará aríetes baterem contra teus muros, e derrubará tuas torres com suas espadas.
verses.RVR09: Y pondrá contra ella arietes, contra tus muros, y tus torres destruirá con sus martillos.

verses.KJV: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
verses.WEB: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.
verses.ASV: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com a multidão de seus cavalos o pó deles te cobrirá; teus muros tremerão com o estrondo dos cavaleiros, das rodas, e das carruagens, quando ele entrar por tuas portas como quem entra por uma cidade em ruínas.
verses.RVR09: Por la multitud de sus caballos te cubrirá el polvo de ellos: con el estruendo de los caballeros, y de las ruedas, y de los carros, temblarán tus muros, cuando entrare por tus puertas como por portillos de ciudad destruída.

verses.KJV: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
verses.WEB: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.
verses.ASV: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets; he shall slay thy people with the sword; and the pillars of thy strength shall go down to the ground.
verses.ALMEIDA: Com as unhas de seus cavalos pisará todas as tuas ruas; matará teu povo à espada, e as colunas de tua fortaleza cairão por terra.
verses.RVR09: Con las uñas de sus caballos hollará todas tus calles; á tu pueblo matará á cuchillo, y las estatuas de tu fortaleza caerán á tierra.

verses.KJV: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
verses.WEB: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.
verses.ASV: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise; and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses; and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the waters.
verses.ALMEIDA: E roubarão tuas riquezas, e saquearão tuas mercadorias; derrubarão teus muros, e arruinarão tuas preciosas casas; e lançarão tuas pedras, tua madeira e teu pó no meio das águas.
verses.RVR09: Y robarán tus riquezas, y saquearán tus mercaderías: y arruinarán tus muros, y tus casas preciosas destruirán; y pondrán tus piedras y tu madera y tu polvo en medio de las aguas.

verses.KJV: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
verses.WEB: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
verses.ASV: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
verses.ALMEIDA: E farei cessar o ruído de tuas canções, e o som de tuas harpas não será mais ouvido.
verses.RVR09: Y haré cesar el estrépito de tus canciones, y no se oirá más el son de tus vihuelas.

verses.KJV: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the Lord have spoken it, saith the Lord God.
verses.WEB: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.
verses.ASV: And I will make thee a bare rock; thou shalt be a place for the spreading of nets; thou shalt be built no more: for I Jehovah have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
verses.ALMEIDA: E te farei como uma rocha exposta; servirás para estender redes; e nunca mais serás reconstruída; porque eu, o SENHOR falei,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.RVR09: Y te pondré como una peña lisa: tendedero de redes serás; ni nunca más serás edificada: porque yo Jehová he hablado, dice el Señor Jehová.

verses.KJV: Thus saith the Lord God to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
verses.WEB: “The Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?
verses.ASV: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
verses.ALMEIDA: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS a Tiro: Por acaso não se estremecerão as ilhas com o estrondo de tua queda, quando os feridos gemerem, quando houver grande matança no meio de ti?
verses.RVR09: Así ha dicho el Señor Jehová á Tiro: ¿No se estremecerán las islas al estruendo de tu caída, cuando gritarán los heridos, cuando se hará la matanza en medio de ti?

verses.KJV: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.
verses.WEB: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.
verses.ASV: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble every moment, and be astonished at thee.
verses.ALMEIDA: Então todos os príncipes do mar descerão de seus tronos, tirarão de si seus mantos, e despirão suas roupas bordadas; com tremores se vestirão, sobre a terra se sentarão, e estremecerão em todo momento, e ficarão espantados por causa de ti.
verses.RVR09: Entonces todos los príncipes de la mar descenderán de sus sillas, y se quitarán sus mantos, y desnudarán sus bordadas ropas: de espanto se vestirán, sentaránse sobre la tierra, y temblarán á cada momento, y estarán sobre ti atónitos.

verses.KJV: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
verses.WEB: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, “How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!”
verses.ASV: And they shall take up a lamentation over thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, that was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, that caused their terror to be on all that dwelt there!
verses.ALMEIDA: E levantarão lamentação por causa de ti, e te dirão: Como pereceste tu, povoada dos mares, famosa cidade, que foi forte no mar; ela e seus moradores, que punham seu espanto a todos os moradores dela?
verses.RVR09: Y levantarán sobre ti endechas, y te dirán: ¿Cómo pereciste tú, poblada en los mares, ciudad que fué alabada, que fué fuerte en la mar, ella y sus habitantes, que ponían su espanto á todos sus moradores?

verses.KJV: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
verses.WEB: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’
